ingredients: 2 large ripe avocados, peeled, pitted and cut into 8 pieces | 1 package dried rice noodles | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 3/4 pound hot italian sausage, chopped | 1/2 cup diced pickled italian-style saltines ( optional )
instructions: Combine the avocados, and rice noodles in a large bowl.

Random Ingredients: mustard powder,saffron,lime wedge,double cream,irish cream,american cheese,spaghetti,cauliflower floret
title: Cauliflower Cheese Fondue
ingredients: 1/2 lb small cauliflower floret | 6 slices american cheese, cut into 3/4 inch cubes | 6 tablespoons irish cream | 6 ounces american cheese, cut into slices | 3 tablespoons double cream | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/4 teaspoon saffron | lime wedge ( to garnish )
instructions: Drain cauliflower and let it cool for 5 minutes. Place 2 pieces of cheese over each piece of cauliflower in a large, heavy skillet. Add saffron and mustard powder and stir over medium heat for a minute. Add cream and heat over medium heat about 10 minutes. Do not allow to boil, it will thicken as it cools. Add 3 tablespoons of saffron and 1/4 cup of water and stir into cheese mixture, cook over low heat for 15 minutes. Serve warm garnished with lime wedge.

title: Spiced Corn With Goat Cheese With Prosciutto
ingredients: 1 tablespoon oil | 1 tablespoon curry | 3/4 cup half-and-half cream | 1/4 cup half-and-half cream | 1/3 cup goat cheese | 2 teaspoons dark brown sugar, packed | 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg, grated | 1/4 cup prosciutto, thinly sliced, for serving | 1 cup fresh corn, kernels cut from cob, for garnish
instructions: Sauté the curry in the oil until fragrant, about 1 minute. Add the half and half and whip until smooth. Deglaze with cream or add nutmeg to taste. Set aside. Stir the goat cheese with brown sugar and half and half until well incorporated. Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper. Spread 1/2 cup of cheese on a medium plate. Top with 2 tablespoons of spice mixture and 1/2 cup shaved prosciutto. Garnish with fresh corn kernels.

title: Savory Beef Rissoles
ingredients: 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1 cup diced leftover roast beef or 1 cup cooked pork | 2 tablespoons minced dehydrated vegetables or 2 tablespoons dehydrated mixed vegetables | seasoning salt
instructions: In a medium sized mixing bowl, mix together graham cracker crumbs, diced beef or cooked pork and desired seasoning. Place in an oiled pan, and press into a rectangular shape with a 1/4 inch edge. Allow a little space between rissoles. Let cool slightly, then turn over onto plate. Serve with a spoonful of creamed butter for dipping.

title: Breadcrumbs of India - Chakshoka Kebab
ingredients: 2 - 2 1/2 cups breadcrumbs | 1 lb ginger-garlic paste | 2 hard-boiled eggs, peeled and chopped
instructions: Mix the baking soda with 1/2 cup of water and set aside. Mix the bread crumbs with 1/2 cup of water, then add garlic. Mix well. Add the ginger garlic paste, and beaten egg. Stir until well mixed. Shape into walnut sized balls about 1 - ¼ inches in diameter. Arrange on baking sheet. Bake at 300 degrees on baking sheet for about 12 - 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: goat cheese,pasta sauce,cocoa powder,artichoke heart,no salt tomato
title: No Salt Pasta Salad
ingredients: 4 ounces soft mild goat cheese | 1 teaspoon unsweetened cocoa powder | 2 tablespoons no-salt-added pasta sauce | 2 jars artichoke hearts, rinsed and coarsely chopped | 14 1/4 ounces no-salt-added whole tomato, drained
instructions: In a small bowl, combine goat cheese, cocoa powder and pasta sauce and allow to stand at room temperature for 15 minutes. Mix artichoke hearts and tomato slices into cheese mixture and chill for at least 8 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: cold water,white cheddar cheese,onion powder,liquid smoke,curry paste
title: Cheddar Beef Steak in Sour Cream Gravy
ingredients: 2 tablespoons onion powder | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke | 1/2 cup cold water | 1/2 cup shredded white cheddar cheese | 1 -2 teaspoon curry paste ( to taste )
instructions: Dissolve onion powder and liquid smoke in water in a glass bowl, add remaining ingredients and stir thoroughly.

title: Crock Pot Beef and Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 1 corned beef brisket, with spice packet | 1 package whole wheat pasta, any flavor | 1 jalapeno pepper, coarsely chopped | 1 cup soymilk | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish
instructions: Place beef in crock pot. Add remaining ingredients. Cover and cook on low for 7 - 9 hours. Remove meat and shred with two forks. Serve and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: active yeast,prosciutto,teriyaki sauce,tarragon,pepperoncini pepper,bread improver,cheddar cheese,salt
title: Sauce Lovers Baked Antipasto
ingredients: 2 packages active dry yeast | 2 teaspoons salt | 2 1/4 cups hot tap water ( 130-115 f ) | 1/4 cup teriyaki sauce | 1/4 cup shredded cheddar cheese | 1/4 cup sliced pepperoncini peppers or 1/4 cup red bell pepper | 12 slices prosciutto | 1/4 cup chopped fresh tarragon
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Stir in remaining ingredients except for prosciutto. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low and continue to stir 1 - 2 minutes. Transfer to a well oiled bowl, cover with a clean towel, and let stand until lukewarm, about 2 hours. Stir in prosciutto and 1 - 2 tarragon. Cover bowl and let rise. Punch down. On lightly floured board, knead dough until smooth and elastic. Roll out into a rectangle. Spread with pepperoncini and then prosciutto mixture and spread with remaining pepperoncini. Starting from long end, roll up jelly roll fashion, jelly roll style, beginning with ends. Cover with plastic wrap and let rise 1 hour. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Bake 45 - 50 minutes, or until lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: black bean,ice cube,veal,sherry wine,cream celery soup
title: Tender Veal and Black Bean Casserole
ingredients: 1/2 cup sherry wine or 1/2 cup white wine vinegar | 1/2 cup cream of celery soup, undiluted | 1/2 lb ground veal | 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed | 3 ice cubes
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. In saucepan combine sherry, celery soup and black beans. Heat through, stirring frequently. Pour into 1 1/2 quart baking dish or 9x13 baking dish. Cover and bake for 40 - 45 minutes or until heated through, stirring once. Sprinkle with ice cubes before serving.

title: Lentils and Rice
ingredients: 1/2 lb lentils | 2 cups long-grain white rice | 3/4 cup unsweetened salsa | 1 teaspoon fenugreek seeds | ice cream, to serve ( optional )
instructions: Place lentils and rice in a large heavy based saucepan, add water to cover and heat to boiling. Reduce heat and simmer covered 15 - 20 minutes, until lentils are tender. Add salsa and fenugreek seeds and continue cooking until rice is warm. Serve rice with ice cream if desired.

Random Ingredients: cod fish fillet,spanish onion,broth,chocolate,coffee liqueur,pistachio,italian seasoning,barley
title: Cod With Choc-Mint Glaze
ingredients: 2 tablespoons instant coffee liqueur | 1/4 cup chopped spanish onion | 1/4 cup chopped pistachios | 1 1/2 lbs cod fish fillets, cut in 2 pieces | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning | 1 1/2 cups chicken stock or 1 1/2 cups broth | 1 cup barley | 1 ounce chocolate, for garnish
instructions: Combine instant coffee and italian seasoning in small saucepan. Gradually stir in broth. Simmer, uncovered for about 5 minutes or until slightly thickened. Stir in barley. Heat oven to 350°f or place rack in middle of oven and heat broiler. Spray 13x9x2 inch glass baking pan with nonstick cooking spray. Place cod on baking rack and spread out with a paper towel. Combine sauce with coffee mixture. Sprinkle over cod and bake 15 to 20 minutes or until cod is golden brown. Remove from oven and swirl glaze over fish.

Random Ingredients: catfish fillet,kosher salt black pepper,prosciutto,chicken breast,celery,monterey jack pepper cheese
title: Catfish Wrapped in Provolone
ingredients: 1/4 cup minced celery | 1/4 cup minced prosciutto | 2 tablespoons finely chopped monterriechego cheese or 2 tablespoons smoked paprika | 4 -8 ounces catfish fillets, cut into 4 equal length portions | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper | 8 ounces shredded monterey jack pepper cheese ( about 2 cups ) or 8 ounces provolone cheese ( about 2 cups )
instructions: To form the catfish wraps, place the catfish fillets between sheets of plastic wrap and then using a meat pounder or a mallet, pound the catfish until the fish is 1/2 inch thick. Place the catfish in a shallow nonreactive dish. Add the celery, prosciutto, monterrie, and cheese and mix until combined. Cover the catfish with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 4 hours or up to overnight. Preheat the broiler to high. Unwrap the catfish and place on a rack in a shallow pan that goes well over the broiler pan. Sprinkle the catfish with salt and pepper and broil for 3 to 5 minutes per side, until the fish flakes easily with a fork. Serve immediately.

title: Korean Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 lb pasta, spaghetti as ukiyabim | dark sesame oil
instructions: Place a large pot of water on top of the spaghetti pot. When water comes to a boil, salt generously. Put the spaghetti pot on the table. When the water comes to a boil again, add a handful of spaghetti to the pot. Toss the spaghetti noodle with both hands until it's perfectly coated in hot oil. Cook for about 5 to 8 minutes with the heat on medium/high, stirring gently, until the pasta is al dente. Drain the spaghetti, reserving all the cooking water, and toss the spaghetti in the pot with the drained pasta. Add the sesame oil and mix. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt,golden raisin,hot chili sauce,hot water,stock
title: Sweet and Sour Raisin Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup hot stock, more for dipping | 1/8 cup stock | 1 tablespoon golden raisin, soaked in | 1 tablespoon hot chili sauce | kosher salt
instructions: In a small pan, bring the hot stock to a boil and remove from heat. Set aside to cool. Stir the reserved stock into the cooled raisin infused raisins and chilli sauce, then season to taste with salt.

Random Ingredients: shiitake mushroom,rice wine,orange,vegemite,sherry wine vinegar,squash,alfredo sauce,water chestnut
title: Spicy Shiitake and Water Chestnut Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup shiitake mushroom | 2 large oranges, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup shiitake water chestnut, sliced | 3 teaspoons rice wine ( or dry sherry ) | 1/2 teaspoon vegemite | 2 tablespoons shaoxing wine vinegar | 1/3 cup alfredo sauce | 1 teaspoon sherry wine vinegar | cooked rice and water chestnuts
instructions: In a small bowl, combine all ingredients except alfredo sauce and sherry. Allow to stand at room temperature for at least an hour to allow the flavors to mingle. Serve in a bowl over hot cooked rice and stir in the reserved shiitakes.

title: Guilt Free Egg Noodle Baked in a Bag and Rolled in Paper(Sani)
ingredients: 1 package plain dried guacamole | 1 cup tomato puree | 6 pieces parchment paper, cut into rounds | 12 ounces medium egg noodles, uncooked ( or more )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Arrange one parchment round, cut into 6 pieces, on a lightly oiled baking sheet. Spread 1/2 cup of guacamole in a wide shallow dish and spread it lightly. Repeat layering with other parchment rounds and one cake round. Sprinkle one side of each round with remaining guacamole. Bake for 45 minutes to an hour or until dry and crisp. Remove from the oven and stack on a board covered with aluminum foil. Let stand for 15 minutes before serving. Meanwhile, cook and drain egg noodles. In a large bowl, mash the cooked noodles with the tomato puree. Spread a thin layer of guacamole near the end of the baking time. Top with the remaining guacamole and bake, uncovered, for about 10 minutes longer. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: artichoke heart,fettuccine pasta,ginger ale,habanero pepper,baguette,fish sauce
title: Asian Style Fettuccine
ingredients: 2 cups dry fettuccine pasta | 1 jar marinated artichoke hearts, drained and cut into bite-size pieces | 1/4 cup fresh ginger ale | 4 hot habanero peppers | 1/4 cup fish sauce | 1 baguette, cut into slices | 1/4 cup fish sauce, for dipping
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: turkey,extra tofu,mushroom,taco seasoning mix,mint sprig,beef stew meat,mussel,yoghurt
title: Mediterranean Turkey Burgers
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground turkey | 2 ounces extra firm tofu | 1 ounce mushroom, minced | 1 ounce beef stew meat | 1 tablespoon of finely chopped of fresh mint, plus extra mint sprigs, to garnish | 1 -2 packet taco seasoning mix | 1/2 cup yoghurt, to mix, to serve
instructions: In a medium size frying pan, gently fry the turkey in 3 tbsp oil, add the spices and fry for 10 - 15 minutes, until the spices are fragrant. Remove from the frying pan, slice into 1/2 inch slices and set aside. Add the mushrooms for the final minute of stir frying. Add the ground meat and cook for about 10 minutes, stirring gently, until the meat changes colour. Remove from the heat. Allow to cool slightly. Break the meat into small pieces similar to ground prawns and combine with the meat mixture. Form into burgers about 4 to 5 inches across and 1½ to 1½ inch thick. To make the yoghurt put the yoghurt in a bowl and mix it with a fork. Leave to stand. Toast the mushrooms under a hot grill until golden, and serve the burgers with a spoon of yoghurt mixed with warm bread and garnished with mint sprigs.

title: White Rice With Chiles and Peanuts
ingredients: 2 poblano chiles | 1 1/2 cups white rice | 1/2 cup peanut butter | 3 tablespoons dry sherry
instructions: Place chiles on a foil lined baking sheet and roast with the pan on medium high heat for one minute on each side. Turn chiles and roast on other side for three to five minutes. Remove chiles from oven and peel away the skin, reserving the peppers. Discard the stems and seeds. Set peppers aside. Remove the reserved pepper halves from the pan and discard the cores, ribs and seeds. Cut the chiles into 1/4 inch strips, discarding the stems and cores. Rinse the rice under cold running water. Soak the rice in cold, running water for about 10 minutes and drain. Set rice aside. In a large frying pan, melt the peanut butter over medium low heat. Add the reserved pepper and chile strips and sherry and stir until blended. Add the rice and sherry mixture to the rice and stir gently. Bring to a boil, cover the pan and reduce heat to medium low. Cook for 20 minutes. Remove the cover and steam for about 10 minutes more or until the top is dark. Turn off the heat and let stand for 10 minutes. Transfer rice onto serving plates and sprinkle each serving with 1/2 teaspoon peanuts.

Random Ingredients: bean sprout,chili paste garlic,cream mushroom soup,saffron,peach,cinnamon,pea
title: Peachy Pea Soup
ingredients: 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 can baked beans with saffron | 1 jar frozen peas | 1 can sliced water chestnuts | 1 tablespoon cinnamon | 2 tablespoons chili paste with garlic | 1 -2 peach, halved and sliced
instructions: Mix all ingredients, except peaches, in a slow cooker. Cover and cook on low for 6 hours or on high for 1 - 2 hours. Add frozen peas on top and cook an additional 30 minutes or until peas are done.

Random Ingredients: pork,yellow bell pepper,baby bok choy,bean sprout,orange juice,oyster sauce,white breadcrumb
title: Baked Pork Toast
ingredients: 1 lb ground pork | 1/2 cup fresh white breadcrumb, fine crumbs | 1 teaspoon oyster sauce | 6 baby bok choy, cleaned, leaves separated, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon orange juice, freshly squeezed | 2 cups bean sprouts | 1 yellow bell pepper, julienned ( or other bell pepper )
instructions: Cook pork, drain very well. In a bowl, stir pork crumbs with oyster sauce until all crumbs are moistened and mixture is smooth. Add green pepper, bok choy, and orange juice to pork and mix well. Spoon mixture onto paper towels, cover with plastic wrap, and let drain until cool. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Brush a baking sheet with a little olive oil. Line pan with aluminum foil. Put 2 tbsp. Of filling into center of each slice of bread. Brush one side of each piece of bread with olive oil and place bread on prepared baking sheet. Bake about 25 minutes or until crisp and golden brown. Let cool slightly and serve with your favorite side dishes such as chow mein noodles, rice, salad, etc.

title: Spanish Spaghetti Con Pimento
ingredients: 1/2 cup whole-milk, or as needed | 5 ounces dry spaghetti | 6 pimento pepper, chopped large | 1 can reduced-sodium broth, or more as needed
instructions: Heat a large pot of water to boiling.

Random Ingredients: bacon,shallot,tamarind pulp,kaffir lime leaf,penne pasta,coriander seed
title: Penne With Tamarind and Bacon
ingredients: 1 lb capelline pasta | 3 slices lean thick bacon | 3 large shallots, minced | 1 1/4 cups tamarind pulp | 2 teaspoons coriander seeds | 1/2 cup kaffir lime leaf, torn
instructions: Cook pasta in large pot of boiling water till al dente. Drain and set aside. Place bacon in a large, heavy skillet. Cook over medium high heat until fat begins to render. Remove bacon slices, reserving drippings, and crumble. Add shallots and saute until lightly browned. Add reserved drippings and tamarind pulp.

title: Hot Pepperoni
ingredients: 16 slices pepperoni | 1/2 cup liquid smoke, any flavor
instructions: Spread pepperoni on cookie sheet and grill for 2 - 3 minutes before turning to brown evenly. Turn over and spray with liquid smoke. When you hear 2 - 4 minutes you know how long your grill is. Serve with pasta and other toppings.

title: Lemon Grass Infused Vodka
ingredients: 12 slices fresh lemon grass | 3 1/4 ounces vodka
instructions: Place the lemon grass in a pint jar and fill with vodka. Cover with lid.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt,black sesame seed,hokkien noodle,chicken meat
title: Korean Noodle Soup
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups chicken meat, minced or steamed | 3 1/2 cups hokkien noodles, rinsed | 1 tablespoon kosher salt | 2 tablespoons whole black sesame seeds | kosher salt ( for the noodles )
instructions: Add all ingredients, except noodles, into a medium pot or saucepan. Boil for 10 to 15 minutes. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: irish cream,lemon zest,garlic paste,french bread italian,mango chutney,salt,peanut butter
title: Mango Chutney Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread or 1 loaf italian bread, cut into 1 inch slices | 3 tablespoons peanut butter ( or cornstarch ) or 3 tablespoons almond milk ( or cornstarch ) | 2 teaspoons bottled garlic paste | 1 teaspoon lemon zest, minced | 1 teaspoon mango chutney or 1 teaspoon mango chutney | 2 -3 teaspoons fresh lemon juice | salt
instructions: Melt the peanut or cornstarch and stir in the remaining ingredients. Let stand 15 minutes to allow flavours to blend.

title: Tarragon Steak
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chopped tarragon | 2 teaspoons packed chopped fresh tarragon to taste
instructions: Stir the tarragon into the ground meat and marinate the meat in refrigerator for at least 1 hour, or overnight.

title: Strawberry Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups farfalle pasta | 1 1/2 cups strawberries | 1 can italian-style stewed tomatoes | 1 1/2 cups ketchup
instructions: Cook pasta according to directions. Drain. In a large bowl, mix in remaining ingredients. Cover and chill in the fridge 4 hours.

Random Ingredients: season salt,pie shell,spicy brown mustard,enchilada sauce,french bread,green pepper,pasta
title: Spicy French Bread Pasta Pie
ingredients: 1/3 cup spicy brown mustard | 1/4 cup green pepper, chopped | 1/2 cup french bread, cut into 1/4 inch pieces | 1 can enchilada sauce | 1 teaspoon season-all salt ( i use john's ) | 1 package refrigerated pie shells | 1 1/2 cups prepared crusty french toast ( i use the quick version of my crocker )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 f. In a medium bowl, mix the prepared mustard, green pepper, bread, enchilada sauce, and season all. Distribute the filling evenly among the prepared pie shells. Brush the top generously with prepared mustard. Layer the pie crusts over the filling. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until the bread is golden brown. Let stand for 5 minutes.

title: Munich Charred Churros
ingredients: 2 teaspoons table salt | 1/4 cup chopped pistachio nut
instructions: Whisk 2 teaspoons salt and pistachio nuts together well. Roll churrose into small balls, 1/2 to 1 inch thick, and press around to coat evenly. Store in an airtight container at room temperature up to 2 days.

title: Sweet and Savory Sausages With Coconut
ingredients: 300 g pork sausages | 8 large baking potatoes, washed and cut into chunks | 2 cups vegetable broth | 14 1/2 ml soy sauce | handful mixed fresh herbs | 3 cans coconut cream
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees centigrade. Lightly spray a large heatproof frying pan with nostro. Heat over a medium to high heat and fry the sausages for about 5 minutes on each side or until well browned and cooked through. Transfer meat to a bowl. Add potato chunks to the frying pan and fry for a further 5 minutes. Pour in the vegetable broth and soy. Bring to the boil, then cover and transfer to the oven for 15 minutes. Add the herbs, stir and return the sausages to the oven. Bake for 5 additional 10 minutes. Spoon coconut into bowls and serve.

title: Tangerine Roast Chicken - for Crock Pot or Stove Top Chicken
ingredients: 1 tangerine | 8 whole chickens | 2 tablespoons currants ( optional )
instructions: Wash tangerine very well. Cut off dark colored skin and cut into segments. Using scissors, split down the center of the body and remove loose sprigs. If using currants, cut them into the whole body just before opening. With scissors, split open and make cuts all the way through the body, stopping about 1/4 inch deep. You will now have two identical halves. Wash bird on inside inside and out. If using currants, make sure they are washed and dry. Rub inside and out with currants. Place bird in a crock pot and cover with a lid or a plate or large enough to fit the cavity into the bird. Cook on high for 2 hours, then for a final 20 minutes or so. This step is best if the bird is at room temperature for 3 - 4 hours. This step is best done after you have removed the cover or plate.

title: Spicy Indian
ingredients: 3 star anise ( i like the best ) | 1 tablespoon vanilla extract | 2 whole star anise ( i like the best )
instructions: Set oven on broil. Heat all of the star anise with the vanilla extract for about five minutes. Open the oven and immediately place all of the star anise open in a tea towel for a few seconds. Turn over and open the oven. Turn down until the star anise is all open. You can place the star anise or cinnamon sugar in a plastic bag. Seal and let cool in the refrigerator.

title: Almond Pork (Elote)
ingredients: 1/2 cup hazelnuts, toasted | 1/2 cup almonds, toasted | 1/2 cup sweet red pepper, chopped | 1 tablespoon roasted ancho chile powder | 3 lbs pork roast | 1 1/2 tablespoons pork drippings | 2 large oranges | 1 head lettuce, lettuce and red cabbage
instructions: Soak the hazelnuts and almonds in water for about 15 minutes. Drain and set aside. Place the red pepper with ancho chile in a clean coffee filter and allow to soften for about 10 minutes. Remove stems and seeds, then puree together with ancho chile powder and ground hazelnuts. Dice the pork into 1 inch cubes. Heat the pork drippings in a wok over medium heat. Add the orange and almonds. Add the pork.

title: The Reindeer
ingredients: 25 g split peas | 25 g rye flour | 25 g bread, crusts removed | 3 teaspoons whole wheat flour | 1 tablespoon marshmallow | 1 teaspoon grand marnier | 1/2 teaspoon white cooking chocolate, grated
instructions: Place the split peas in a bowl and cover with cold water. Leave overnight or for at least 4 hours to make a quick soak. Drain the grains and mix the cold water with the rye, wheat flour and marshmallow, mix with clean hands. Press each slice of bread, then dip into the mix. Place on a plate and put sprinklings of grated chocolate on top. Leave in the fridge until chocolate is firm.

title: Italian Wedding Cookies
ingredients: 2 packages instant vanilla pudding mix | 1 maraschino cherry
instructions: Open the package of vanilla pudding and put some coffee in a large bowl. Add the maraschino cherry to the bowl. If the coffee is too warm, it will make it easier to roll into balls if necessary. Roll balls with a little bit of the coffee to coat the tops of the balls. Refrigerate for 1 hour. When ready to serve, scoop out a few balls and spread out a bit of the preserves or sprinkle with sugar and decorate with a maraschino cherry.

title: Fried Beef With Chipotle Risotto
ingredients: 1 lb flank steak, 1/4-inch thick ( trimmed but left intact ) | 1 cup arborio rice ( not instant ) | 4 large eggs | 1/3 cup broth | 2 chipotle chiles, roasted, peeled, seeded and chopped | 1 tablespoon oil or 1 tablespoon sunflower oil
instructions: Cut steak lengthwise into 1 by 1/2 inch strips. Cook and stir steak until brown. Add rice to steak and onion mixture.

title: Mustard Vanilla Celery Ribs
ingredients: 2 celery ribs | 1 vanilla bean, split | 1 tablespoon prepared mustard
instructions: Split the vanilla bean and scrape out the seeds, then scrape out all the soft pith from the vanilla bean. Slice the vanilla bean into thin half moons, then split the vanilla bean lengthwise into halves again, removing the seeds. Sprinkle the inside of a 9x5x2 inch loaf pan with the mustard. Place the celery ribs on top, pressing them in so that they are packed snugly into the mustard. Cover and refrigerate for 6 to 8 hours. The celery will become so limp it will be easier to insert when using. This will take about 1 1/2 hours. Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Remove the loaf pan from the refrigerator and shake off any excess fat. Return the celery to the refrigerator for another 30 minutes or so. Turn the temperature down, then place the meat onto a roasting rack to roast, basting regularly with the celery. Cover the loaf pan loosely with tinfoil and bake for 1 hour, or until the celery is softened. Turn off stove and allow to let meat cool in pan for 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: mango chutney,half,manchego cheese,lemon,salt black pepper,green chilies,beef tenderloin,egg yolk
title: Mango Mint Beef Tenderloin Mini Chops
ingredients: 1 tablespoon mango chutney | 1/8 teaspoon grated lemon rind | 2 beef tenderloin, trimmed and scored | 2 large egg yolks | 1/4 cup half-and-half | 1/3 cup mango chutney | 1/3 cup shredded manchego cheese | 2 tablespoons finely chopped green chilies | salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste
instructions: Mix together the mango chutney and grated lemon peel.

title: Duck and Turnips Stew (Fassuliyye)
ingredients: 2 lbs chuck, cut into 1 1/2 to 2 inch cubes | 2 teaspoons almond paste | 2 tablespoons floury potatoes, diced | 1 egg mixed with 2 tablespoons water | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh thyme sprig | 7 cups chicken stock, warmed
instructions: Place the chuck in a large bowl and sprinkle with almond paste and mix lightly until evenly coated. Cover and refrigerate for 15 minutes. Heat the oven to 325°f rub the flour off the meat. Press flour over the meat. In the bowl of a 2 1/2 to 3 1/2 to 3 1/2 quart electric slow cooker combine the potatoes, egg mixture, thyme and pepper. Place the meat on top of the potatoes and top with the chicken stock. Cover and cook for 5 hours or until meat is tender and potatoes are cooked.

Random Ingredients: thai fish sauce,clove,chili pepper,shrimp,fennel bulb,vanilla extract
title: Marinated Shrimp
ingredients: 2 cups shrimp, peeled and deveined ( medium or large ) | 3 -6 tablespoons thai fish sauce ( to taste ) | 2 tablespoons fennel bulbs, diced finely ( to taste ) | 1/2 small chili pepper, seeded and minced | 1/4 cup vanilla extract | 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves
instructions: In a small bowl, toss shrimp with fish sauce, and set aside. Trim any excess muscle and devein shrimps, removing any loose shells. Place shrimp in a glass or ceramic dish, and sprinkle with fennel, chili pepper, and vanilla. Add the cloves and toss to thoroughly combine. Marinate in the fridge while making the rum sauce.

Random Ingredients: chicken meat,garlic powder,crisco cooking oil,dark rum,linguine,yellow bell pepper,meat,prune
title: Linguine With Rum and Chicken
ingredients: 1/4 lb boneless chicken meat or 1/4 lb chicken, strips | 1/2 lb shrimp ( raw peeled or not, tails left on ) or 1/2 lb meat ( raw peeled or not, tails left on ) | 1/2 lb prune ( pitted and chopped ) | 3/4 medium yellow bell pepper ( coarsely chopped ) or 3/4 cup red bell pepper, coarsely chopped ( medium or yellow ) | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 12 teaspoons crisco cooking oil | 1/2 cup dark rum ( can use captain morgan ) | 12 -16 ounces fresh linguine
instructions: Marinate chicken, shrimp or meat in 12 tblsps. Oil, garlic powder, all bell pepper and orange and plum tomatoes about 30 minutes. Preparation, heat 12 teaspoons of oil in skillet on med high heat. Add chicken strips and prunes. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Cook and stir until chicken is cooked to desired degree of doneness, adding more oil if needed. Remove from skillet and set aside. Cook linguine in large pot of boiling water until al dente. Drain, add more hot oil to skillet and saute 1/2 cup chopped/chopped bell pepper and 1/2 cup chopped/chopped tomatoes. Drain the linguine well and add back to skillet. Heat the mixture until warmed through.

title: Tropical Chickpeas and Mango Salad from Corfu
ingredients: 100 g mangoes, peeled, and diced | 100 g chick-peas, soaked overnight in water and drained | 1/2 cup marshmallows or 1/2 cup pine nuts, chopped
instructions: Dip the mango in boiling water for 3 - 5 minutes. Drain well. Mix all the ingredients well together. Serve on a plate sprinkled with nuts.

Random Ingredients: taco flour tortilla,mung bean sprout,cajun seasoning,self raising flour,dark rum,self rising flour,ginger juice
title: Mango and Ginger Roll Scones
ingredients: 4 cups self-raising flour | 1 teaspoon cajun seasoning | 3/4 teaspoon ground ginger | 4 cups mung bean sprouts or 4 cups thawed fresh sprouts | 1 1/4 cups dark rum | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 125 g self-raising flour, mixed with | 1/2 teaspoon dark rum
instructions: Preheat oven 180c. Line a baking tray with baking paper. Combine all ingredients except scones in a large bowl, stirring with a wooden spoon until just incorporated. Turn dough on to a lightly floured surface and knead until just combined. Using a rolling pin, roll out dough until about 6mm thick. Using a 2cm plain round cutter, cut 12 scones out of the dough and place on the baking tray. Using a 3cm star shaped cookie cutter, cut out 24 scones using 1/2 inch stars. Repeat with remaining dough and scones. Place scones on wire rack to cool. Preheat oven to 220c gas 4, bake scones for 15 minutes or until golden. Transfer to wire racks. Serve with mango and ginger cream.

Random Ingredients: green olive,vegetable stock,marinara sauce,cornflour,spaghetti sauce,banana,picante sauce
title: Picante Sauce & Bean Casserole
ingredients: 375 g spaghetti sauce | 400 g frozen peas or cans sliced black olives | 1 can vegetable stock | 1 package marinara sauce | 3 ripe bananas, diced | 4 tablespoons cornflour ( cornstarch ) | 150 ml picante sauce
instructions: Heat the spaghetti sauce in a saucepan, add the olive, stock and marinara sauce. Bring to the boil, reduce the heat and simmer for 20 - 25 minutes. Heat and stir cornflour in a pan. Add 1/2 cup of the marinara sauce to the cornflour and mix with a potato masher until smooth. Drain the beans and add them and the remaining sauce to the bean/pasta mixture and cook for 5 - 10 minutes over low heat until the sauce has thickened.

Random Ingredients: raisin,rice noodle,hamburger,oil,super fine sugar,grand marnier,beef roast
title: Beef Banh Mi
ingredients: 1 -2 lb beef roast ( any cut of the beef is fine ) | 1 package thin rice noodles | 6 tablespoons raisins ( optional ) | 2 -3 tablespoons superfine sugar or 2 -3 tablespoons brown sugar | 6 tablespoons grand marnier or 6 tablespoons lemon juice | 2 tablespoons oil
instructions: Brown beef in oil and drain. Brown rice noodles in oil and drain and set aside. Mix sugar with grand marnier till dissolved in a glass of hot water. Add to beef and other ingredients and put into refrigerator and enjoy.

title: Fettuccine With Beef
ingredients: 1 package fettuccine pasta | 3/4 lb filet of beef | 1 cup shell pasta, cooked
instructions: Place fettuccine in 3 quart saucepan.

title: Ginger Glazed Cornbread
ingredients: 3 cans canned italian-style stewed tomatoes | 1 cup frozen lemonade concentrate, thawed | 1/2 cup finely grated ginger | 1 tablespoon confectioners'sugar | 2 lbs ground chuck | 1 loaf frozen bread, cut into 1-inch cubes
instructions: In a large saucepan combine both cans of stewed tomatoes and the lemonade concentrate. Bring to a boil. Mix in ginger, sugar and ground chuck. Reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes. Place bread cubes in a baking pan and drizzle with beef mixture. Pour beef mixture over bread cubes. Bake at 350 degrees for about 20 minutes or until heated through and lightly browned. Serve hot.

title: Sweet-Sour Enchiladas
ingredients: 1/2 cup corn tortillas, chopped | 1 cup bread crumbs | 1/2 cup maple syrup | 1/2 cup shallot, chopped | 1/2 cup mexican blend cheese, shredded | 1 cup soymilk
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Combine crumbs, maple syrup and shallots. Add the cheese and mix. Fill tortillas with cheese/shallot mixture. Rinse the pan with cold water, then dip the tortilla side into the water and water. When the bottom is slightly browned pour about 1/2 cup soymilk into the pan. Turn the heat down and let it simmer for about 2 minutes. Let sit for a few minutes. Then turn and pour the other half of the soymilk in along with the corn tortillas. I like to leave the corn tortillas in the pan to soak up the delicious sauce. This is best when served immediately.

Random Ingredients: mustard,orange marmalade,spaghetti,head cauliflower,red bean,wheat bread,cilantro leaf
title: Cauliflower Spaghetti II
ingredients: 4 slices whole wheat bread | 1/4 cup orange marmalade | 12 ounces spaghetti, broken into 4-6 pieces | 1 small head cauliflower, cut into florets | 2 teaspoons dry mustard | 1/2 cup fresh cilantro leaves, coarsely chopped | 1 can red beans, drained
instructions: Remove crusts from bread. Cut 4 squares of bread into thirds. Lay the remaining squares on the baking sheet. Place under broiler briefly to dry bread slightly, but not completely. When toast is golden, immediately remove from oven. Spread 3/4 cup of the marmalade on the 1/2 of one of the squares of bread. Place the broken spaghetti in the spaces between the bread cubes and the marmalade in a large saucepan and add enough cold water to cover and bring to a boil. Add the cauliflower and mustard. Cover the pan and simmer for 3 to 4 minutes, or until cauliflower is tender. Add 1/2 cup of the cilantro and the beans and mix well. Drain the spaghetti well. Gently stir the spaghetti into the onion mixture and then transfer to a serving bowl. Sprinkle remaining 1/2 cup of the cilantro over the pasta.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce leaf,caper,caramel ice cream topping,pepper,spice,ra el hanout spice mix
title: Elegant Moroccan Salad
ingredients:
3 cups romaine lettuce or 3 cups rocket, washed and very well dried | 8 ounces caramel ice cream topping | 8 tablespoons olive oil or 8 tablespoons melted coconut oil | 2 tablespoons ras el hanout spice mix ( ras el hanout - moroccan spice mix from vegetarian times.
    -com ) | 1 dash pepper ( optional ) | spice ( optional )
instructions: Dice the lettuce. Spread the ice cream topping on top of the lettuce and sprinkle with all the remaining ingredients. Chill in the refrigerator. Serve with fresh bread.

Random Ingredients: egg wrap,pear,white fish fillet,rye bread,sun tomato oil,sauce,sage leaf
title: Fish and Pear Cakes
ingredients:
6 ounces boneless white fish fillets, coarsely diced | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 8 large pear slices, halved horizontally | 1/2 cup sage leaf | 1 package egg roll wraps | sweet and sour sauce, as desired | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon a.
    -1.
    - original sauce, as desired
instructions: Combine fish, sun dried tomatoes, and pear halves in a small bowl. Cover and chill 1 hour. Meanwhile, spray a 9 x 12 pan with nonstick cooking spray. Lay a wrapper on work surface and place 1/3 of pears in the center of the wrapper. Place 2 tablespoons of fish mixture, 2 tablespoons of prepared sweet sour sauce, 2 tablespoons of a1, and 1 tablespoon chopped sage on top of pears, leaving about 1/2 cup of sauce at the edges. Fold in the bottom edge of the wrapper, brushing in any beaten egg wash, and roll up the filling toward the filling. Place in the pan with the remaining sauce. Cover the fish parcels with 1/3 sauce and top with remaining 1/3 of chopped sage and 1 tablespoon chopped parsley. Dot fish and drizzle with remaining 2 tablespoons of prepared sweet sour sauce. Bake in a 375 degree f oven until fish is just cooked through, about 25 minutes. Serve fish and pear cakes warm.

Random Ingredients: chocolate syrup,cardamom,colby cheese,corn,barbecue sauce,bamboo shoot,champagne,taco seasoning
title: Chili-Glazed Corn Fondue
ingredients: 1 cup light sour corn | 1 cup bottled or prepared canned sweet corn | 1 package taco seasoning | 1 dash cardamom | 1 dash light beer ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon chili barbecue sauce | 2 packages barbecued chicken-flavored snacks ( i use `` chippouge barbecue sauce '' brand ) | 1 cup grated reduced fat colby cheese ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Combine sour corn and can of sweet corn in a small saucepan over low heat and bring to a boil. Stir constantly.

title: Roasted Tomato and Date Salad
ingredients: 4 lbs grape tomatoes | 1 lb lean boneless pork roast | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried tarragon | 4 -6 lbs fresh dates, pitted
instructions: Trim tomatoes from the stems. Reed and cut in half. Cut crosswise into 1/8 inch slices. Remove excess seeds from the center. Place in a large bowl. Trim ends and pith from pork. Cut into 1 inch pieces. Add tomatoes, tarragon and 3/4 of the sliced meat. Toss lightly. Transfer to a shallow roasting pan or baking pan. Roast at 300 degrees fahrenheit for two hours. To serve, remove meat from the pan and place on a large platter. Combine remaining sliced meat with dates. Serve.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed oil,gruyere cheese,asparagus spear,extra virgin olive oil
title: Asparagus Graubourme
ingredients: 1 pound asparagus spears, trimmed into 2-inch pieces | 3 tablespoons sesame seed oil | 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1 cup shredded gruyere cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Place asparagus into a large baking dish with about 3/4 inch water on the bottom, then sprinkle with 1 tablespoon sesame seed oil.

title: Orange Peel Teriyaki Sauce
ingredients: 5 oranges, peel and pith removed | 1/4 cup dark soy sauce, preferably kikkoman
instructions: In a medium glass bowl, using a mortar and pestle, grind the peel and pith by hand. Do not grind with a wood or glass tool. Add the soy sauce and mix well. Add as many pieces of orange peel as you like to make a teriyaki marinade. Taste for heat and acidity and adjust as needed. Use as a dipping sauce for meat or vegetables.

Random Ingredients: baby carrot,gelatin,pimento olive,bodied red wine,applesauce,ketchup,tomato sauce
title: Spicy Portuguese Barbecue Chicken
ingredients: 1 envelope unflavored gelatin | 2 tablespoons tomato sauce | 1/2 cup unsweetened applesauce | 3/4 cup full-bodied red wine | 1/4 cup pimento-stuffed olives, chopped | 12 baby carrots, sliced | 1/4 cup ketchup
instructions: Sprinkle gelatin over 1 1/2 cups boiling water and let stand 5 minutes until softened. Drain. Coat 13 by 9 glass baking dish with cooking spray. Combine tomato sauce, applesauce, wine, olives, carrots, gelatin, and ketchup in a saucepan. Cover and bring to a boil over high heat, stirring frequently. Reduce heat and simmer, stirring until thickened and carrots are tender, about 8 - 10 minutes. Cut chicken into strips.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,cocoa powder,baking potato,yoghurt,sesame oil,baby carrot
title: Baby Carrots With Swiss Cheese
ingredients: 4 large baking potatoes, scrubbed | 3 ounces swiss cheese, shredded | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 1 cup baby carrots | 1/2 cup natural yoghurt | 1 dash unsweetened cocoa powder
instructions: Bake the potatoes in a 400 oven for 80 minutes until cooked. While the potatoes are baking, heat a large nonstick frying pan over medium low heat. Once the potatoes have been in for an hour, turn the temperature up to medium and add the swiss cheese, saeeds. Stir regularly so the swiss doesn't burn. When the cheese has crisped up a little bit when the potatoes have baked, reduce the heat to very low. Add the sesame oil and carrots to the pan, stir, then drizzle the yoghurt on top. Sprinkle more cocoa on top and season with salt and pepper. Serve immediately.

title: Baked Aromatic Vegetables
ingredients: 1 medium eggplant, cut lengthwise | 1 cup thick natural yogurt | 1/4 cup yogurt | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1 teaspoon old bay seasoning | 1 -2 teaspoon crushed red pepper | 1 teaspoon tomato paste | 3/4 cup low fat whipped topping
instructions: Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper. Cut the eggplant into 1/2 inch cubes. Place in a colander and sprinkle evenly with salt. Let sit for 10 minutes. Transfer the eggplant, salt, and any liquid in the bowl to a food processor. Add 1/4 cup yogurt, 1 teaspoon almond extract, old bay seasoning, crushed red pepper, and tomato paste.

title: Curried Fingerling Potatoes
ingredients: 1 pinch dried oregano | 1 pinch ground cloves | 1 pinch dried basil pesto | 1 lemon wedge | 2 tablespoons margarine, melted | 2 teaspoons curry powder | 3 1/2 ounces fingerling potatoes, peeled | 1 tablespoon peas | 1 tablespoon chopped lemon wedges
instructions: Preheat broiler. In a small bowl, mix oregano, cloves, basil pesto, lemon wedge, margarine, and curry powder. Cut fingerling potatoes in half lengthwise. Remove skin, then cut each half into 5 wedges. Place wedges in a broiling pan. Brush wedges with vegetable oil. Broil 4 - 5 inches from heat for 5 - 8 minutes on each side, or until brown. Place potato slices on a platter and pour sauce over. Serve with lemon wedges.

Random Ingredients: red pepper,pecorino romano cheese,head garlic,chili flake,egg yolk,spice
title: Spiced Roasted Vegetables
ingredients: 1 garlic | 80 g pecorino romano cheese | 1 pinch ground mixed spice | 1 egg yolk, slightly beaten | 120 g roasted red peppers, drained and chopped | 1/3 teaspoon small dried chili flakes
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°c cut the top from the garlic bulb. Place the garlic on a baking tray. Drizzle with olive oil and bake gently in the oven, stirring occasionally for 40 minutes. When the garlic softens and starts to colour a little, remove and leave to cool. Finely grate the garlic on a cutting board and combine with the remaining ingredients. Season with salt and pepper. Allow to cool slightly. Scrape the mixture into a jar and refrigerate for up to 2 weeks.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,masa harina,dark chocolate,cabbage,tomato chutney,chili powder,vanilla bean
title: Taste of Home Cabbage-Chutney Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 large cabbage, shredded | 1 can tomato chutney | 1 1/2 cups dark chocolate, grated | 1 can masa harina | 1 teaspoon chili powder | couple shakes chili pepper flakes | 1 vanilla bean, split
instructions: Heat the beans, and add the chili powder and the rest of the ingredients. Bring to a boil and cook until thickened. Preheat oven 350. Place about 1/3 to 1/2 tablespoon of the sauce in each tortilla and top with some shredded cabbage. Roll up and put in a shallow baking pan. Repeat until all tortillas have been used. Bake for 15 minutes. Serve warm, with more sauce and/or toppings.

Random Ingredients: marsala wine,coffee granule,italian bread crumb,pumpkin pie spice,buttermilk,lime juice
title: Lime Marsala Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup buttermilk | 1 cup dry italian seasoned bread crumbs | 1/4 teaspoon dried limes juice | 1 1/2 teaspoons instant coffee granules | 1 1/2 teaspoons pumpkin pie spice | 1/4 cup marsala wine
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper. In a glass bowl, stir together the buttermilk, bread crumbs, lime juice, coffee granules, and pumpkin pie spice using your hands. Transfer the mixture to a glass serving dish. Toss the mixture with the pasta.

Random Ingredients: gingerroot,cream chicken soup,cake flour,wild mushroom,tomato puree,frying chicken,tart cooking apple,butter
title: Chicken and Wild Mushroom Casserole
ingredients: 1 frying chicken | 3 lbs sour cream or 3 lbs cream | 2 ounces butter | 6 ounces cake flour, sifted | 1 tablespoon gingerroot, grated | 2 cans cream of chicken soup | 2 tablespoons dried tomato puree | 1 large tart cooking apple, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 190c/375f/gas cut the chicken into 8 serving size pieces. Melt the butter in a frying pan and add the chicken, cooking until brown. Stir in the flour and add the cream of chicken soup and tomato puree. Cover with a lid and simmer for 25 minutes. Arrange the chicken pieces and apples on the base of an ovenproof dish. Pour in the soup mix and cover the dish. Put in the oven and bake for 1 hour. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: ginger powder,mustard seed,baby carrot,sea salt black pepper,lime wedge,heavy whipping cream,tomato green chilies
title: Saucy Spicy Tomato Mustard
ingredients: 5 tablespoons mustard seeds | 1 can diced tomatoes and green chilies | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | sea salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 tablespoon freshly grated ginger powder | 10 ounces baby carrots | lime wedge, for serving
instructions: Put the mustard seeds in a dry frying pan over medium high heat and fry for just a few seconds until it starts to pop. Then stir in the tomatoes and chilis. Reduce the heat to low, cover and simmer for 10 minutes. Add the cream and reduce again, uncovered, for a few minutes until reduced by almost half. Season with a little salt, pepper and ginger. Toss in the baby carrots, season again and cook for 3 - 4 minutes until warmed through. Serve at once, garnished with lime wedges.

title: Italian Zucchini
ingredients: 1/8 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1 zucchini, with peel
instructions: Cut 2 of the zucchini lengthwise in half. Open out the halves. Place one half on cutting board and top with the other, cut side down. Using your fingers, press down on each section until the skin is completely closed. Sprinkle italian seasoning on zucchini and place face down on foil lined cookie sheet. Freeze approximately 10 minutes, until hard.. Remove zucchini from packet and slice diagonally into 1/8 wedges. Serve warm.

title: Spicy Tomato and Rhubarb Salsa
ingredients: 1 lb fresh shiitake mushroom | 1/2 lb fresh rhubarb | 1 small tomatoes and green chilies ( chopped seeded ) | 1/3 cup pimiento, sliced ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar
instructions: Dice up the mushrooms and rhubarb into bite size pieces. Cut the chiles into thin slices and add to a pot with just enough water to cover. Bring to a boil and add the rhubarb. Cook slowly uncovered over medium heat for about 2 minutes. Drain, remove all the water and save the rhubarb. Add the mushrooms and chiles to the pot along with the juice from the tomatoes, pimientos and rice vinegar. Mix well and boil for 1 minute, then remove from the heat and serve.

title: Chinese Restaurant Green Onion Rings
ingredients: 1 cup soft wheat flour | 2 green onions | 2/3 cup chopped semisweet chocolate or 2/3 cup semisweet chocolate | 2 teaspoons finely grated lemon zest
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees. In a large mixing bowl, using a blender, puré the flour and green onions until well mixed. Stir in the chocolate and lemon zest. Stir in just enough of the warm flour to form a soft dough. Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and knead until a ball is formed. Using lightly floured hands, roll the dough out into a long, thin rectangle. Using the palms of your hands, make several slits in the dough, spacing them about 1 1/2 inches apart. Repeat with the remaining dough. Place the dough on a pizza peel. Bake for 25 minutes, flipping halfway through. After 20 minutes, remove from the oven and set a plate on top. Cut into 8 wedges.

Random Ingredients: corn,red grape,orange peel,vegetable stock,dark sesame oil,sesame seed,egg yolk,corn tortilla strip
title: Vegetarian Sesame Corn Tortillas
ingredients: 7 ounces corn | 2 cups hot vegetable stock | 5 red seedless grapes ( or green ) | 3 -4 drops orange peel | 3 egg yolks | 10 soft corn tortilla strips | 3 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 3 tablespoons sesame seeds | vegetable stock or vegetable broth
instructions: Heat the vegetable stock very slowly. Place the corn in the hot stock, season to taste with salt& pepper and leave to stand for 15 minutes. Halve grapes and remove seeds. Rinse corn from stock, pat dry with paper towel and slice into 8ths. Cut the egg yolks and egg whites in a small bowl, stirring well with a fork, then add yolks in a thin steady stream. Drain the corn and return to the stock. Heat a griddle or a flat griddle pan. Drain the corn in a sieve lined with muslin. Roughly tear the corn apart, stir together with the juice and orange peel, then set aside. Place the tortillas between damp kitchen towels, to keep warm, slightly damp. Fry the tortilla strips either in batches, on both sides until golden on both sides. Drain on kitchen paper. Make sauce from sesame oil and corn kernels. Stir in the sesame seeds. To assemble, place a strip of corn on top of each fried tortilla and top with a few spoonfuls of sauce. Fold in the sides of the tortilla, then the top of the corn. Serve immediately with salsa, guacamole, or crusty bread.

Random Ingredients: guacamole,basmati rice,rosemary sprig,topping,blackberry,puff pastry,water,green curry paste
title: Green Banana Leaves
ingredients: 2 cups basmati rice | 2 cups water | 1 package frozen puff pastry sheets, thawed | 2 tablespoons green curry paste | 2 bananas, sliced | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh rosemary sprigs | 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh blackberry or 1 1/2 tablespoons frozen blackberries | 1/2 cup low-fat guacamole
instructions: Bring the rice and 2 cups of water to a boil in saucepan over high heat. Cover tightly and reduce the heat to medium. Cook until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed, 25 to 30 minutes. Let rest, covered, for 5 minutes. Preheat the oven to 400°. Cut the pastry sheets crosswise into 1/8 inch thick slices using a pizza cutter. Lay the slices on a baking sheet, cut side up, and bake until golden, about 10 minutes. Let cool. Meanwhile, place 4 bananas in a microwave safe bowl, sprinkle with curry paste, then microwave 1 minute. Remove bananas from microwave. Scatter about 1 1/2 tablespoons of the cooked rice over each banana plant, then top with 2 tablespoons of the cooked rice and 1/4 cup of the roasted bananas. Spread evenly with guacamole. Sprinkle with rosemary and blackberries.

title: Curried Wild Rice
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked wild rice | 1 cup vegetable stock | 1 tablespoon curry paste | 1 can enchilada sauce | 2 tablespoons oat or 2 tablespoons peanuts, chopped | grated fresh dill | crushed ice
instructions: Steam wild rice with vegetable stock until soft. Sautee curry paste in oil in same pan. Remove from heat.

title: Baked Beans Sprouts With Salt
ingredients: 200 g fresh bean sprouts | 2 cups bicarbonate of soda | 1 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c. Place the sprouts in a pan, pour over just enough water to just cover them and toss. Place the sprouts onto a baking tray and place in the oven for 15 minutes, or until just tender. Cool. Sprout and mix with salt and baking soda. Enjoy.

title: Classic French Toast Appy
ingredients: 4 slices white bread ( i prefer to use cuban bread, but use what you like best ) | 4 tablespoons light tasting mayonnaise ( use what you like best )
instructions: Preheat a pan on the stove and add mayonnaise to your bread for dipping. Using a slotted spoon dip the bread into the mayo to partially coat it, then place the bread on a baking sheet. Once the pan is hot, immediately flip the bread and brown on the other side. If you like you can use more dressing then the amount you use is up to you.

title: Stir-Fried Beef With Mushrooms and Pickles
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef stew meat or 1 1/2 lbs flank steaks | 1 cup chopped fresh baby peas ( if using frozen peas, thaw first ) | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 1/2 teaspoons corn oil | 2 tablespoons chopped dill weed | 2 tablespoons minced pickled shiitake mushrooms ( i use about 3 tablespoons ) | 2 tablespoons pimentos, diced small ( use 2 small pimentos if available )
instructions: Place beef, peas, garlic salt, and 2 tablespoons water in a bowl.

title: Korean Chili Paste Snacks
ingredients: 1/2 cup light brown sugar | 1/4 cup chili paste, korean or chili paste
instructions: Mix all ingredients in small bowl. Use to store in refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: potato,bacon,mandarin orange segment,farfalle pasta,sage,nonfat milk,bread cube
title: Farfalle Italian Wedding Soup
ingredients: 15 ounces farfalle pasta, elbow or 16 ounces bow tie pasta | 3 slices bacon, chopped | 1 package potatoes, chopped 1 inch | 2 cups nonfat milk | 1 can mandarin orange segments, rinsed | 1 teaspoon dried sage, crushed | 1/2 cup nonfat milk
instructions: Cook farfalle according to package directions and drain. When cool enough to handle, chop and set aside. In large soup pot, cook bacon until crisp. Add potatoes, milk and other ingredients. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat.

Random Ingredients: spinach leaf,corn kernel,galangal,wheat pastry flour,orzo pasta,serrano pepper,ziti pasta
title: Thai Orzo Pasta and Spinach
ingredients: 1 teaspoon whole wheat pastry flour | 5 cups spinach leaves, chopped | 1/2 cup orzo pasta | 1 ziti pasta | 1 serrano pepper, chopped | 1/2 cup corn kernels | 1 teaspoon ground galangal
instructions: Place the flour in a small bowl. Toss in the spinach, and then toss in the orzo. In a skillet, heat the oil, then fry the chile for a few minutes, just to get it soft. Drain the pasta. Add the orzo and spinach to the corn kernels, and combine. Stir in the ground galangal over the pasta mixture, and serve.

Random Ingredients: fast rising yeast,lemon juice zest,vanilla pod,mint,fennel seed,lettuce,feta cheese
title: Lebanese Feta and Feta Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups chopped fresh mint | 1 1/2 cups coarsely chopped fresh fennel seeds | 1 cup lemon juice, fresh | 3 1/4 cups very strong feta cheese, coarsely crumbled | 2 teaspoons vanilla pod, crushed | 2 teaspoons fast rising yeast or 2 teaspoons active dry yeast | lettuce | mint
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large mixer bowl and beat on slow speed, scraping sides of bowl, about 10 minutes, or until dough forms. Turn dough out onto a floured surface and knead until smooth and elastic, about 10 minutes. Turn dough out onto lightly floured surface and press into a 10 x 16 inch rectangle. Let dough rest 10 minutes. Meanwhile, line a baking sheet with a silicone baking mat or parchment paper and dust with cornmeal. Cut lengthwise into four crosshatch strips about 3 inches wide. Place strips 3 inches apart on baking sheet. Let stand at room temperature until slightly cooled, about 15 minutes. Preheat broiler. Cut strips into eight even strips. Arrange on prepared baking sheet. Brush with melted butter or oil. Broil for 1 minute. Cut each piece into four triangles or six wedges. Serve immediately. Mint is a small decorative garnish for this dish. It may be frozen, wrapped in plastic wrap, for up to 3 months.

title: Bajara Masala Spice Mix
ingredients: 2 teaspoons ground anise seeds | 1 teaspoon dried sage leaves | 1 teaspoon coriander | 250 g salsa | 1 1/2 teaspoons banana peppers | 1 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Heat 1/4 cup of water and spices together in pan and boil for a few min until a paste like consistency. Add a little water if mixture becomes too thick. To serve, serve with hot indian basmati rice. Note, this recipe can be stored in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 2 weeks. For the variations, the recipe can be halved and served on biryani style hot biscuits.

Random Ingredients: pine nut,chili garlic sauce,red chili pepper,octopus,basil,cocoa
title: Pine Nut Octopus Dogs
ingredients: 1 octopus, cleaned-cut | 8 ounces pine nuts | 3 tablespoons chili-garlic sauce | 3 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa | chili-garlic sauce, to taste
instructions: Remove the eyes and any soft muscle and blemishes from the octopus, then place in a pot with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, then boil over medium heat for approximately 40 minutes, or until cooked. When octopus has cooked, remove excess water and reserve. Chop into small pieces. Break up the nuts with your hands into short lengths, then use to shape the octopus dogs. Once cooked, remove from water and allow to cool for 5 - 20 minutes. While the octopus dogs are cooling, place the chili sauce and cocoa in a bowl and mix thoroughly. Place the prepared octopus on clean wooden skewers and brush the tops with the chili sauce mixture. Grill the dogs on a preheated grill pan/broiler pan for approximately 10 - 15 minutes in a hot oven, or until golden brown.

title: Scallops with Grapes
ingredients: 4 scallops | 1 cup white grape juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Rinse scallops and pat dry with paper towels. Place on a baking sheet with a shallow rim. Bake in the preheated oven until cooked through, 8 to 13 minutes.

Random Ingredients: baking potato,stout beer,almond extract,brown sugar,rice wine,cooking wine,burgundy wine,baking powder
title: Sangies in Wine
ingredients: 24 peeled baking potatoes | cooking wine or beer | 1 cup brown sugar | 2 1/2 tablespoons dry rice wine ( can also use dry sherry ) | 2 1/2 tablespoons stout beer ( any brand ) | 3/4 tablespoon baking powder | 1/2 tablespoon almond extract | 1 cup cooked bokchoy ( i use green giant, but use as many cups as desired )
instructions: Dice potatoes.

title: Roasted Pork, Mushrooms, and Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 cups shiitake mushrooms, stems trimmed | 1 boneless pork roast ( fat trimmed )
instructions: Combine shiitake mushrooms, pork roast fat, and shiitake mushroom caps in a large bowl.

title: Jicama and Jicama Bread
ingredients: 1 lb jicama ( about 3 cups ) | 1 1/2 cups white flour
instructions: Place jicama in a colander, sprinkle with salt, and let stand for 15 minutes. Peel outer leaves off jicama, and slice about 1/8 thick. In a large bowl, thoroughly mix jicama and flour, then stir in jicama mixture. Form into a 1 inch thick round loaf. Poke holes, and put a wooden skewer in top to let escape as much grease as possible. Lightly brown on all sides in a large skillet. Serve warm, sprinkled with melted butter. Note, you can use jicama with butter.

Random Ingredients: turkey,green bean,vegetable broth,ginger garlic paste,panir,arborio rice
title: Paneer Biryani
ingredients: 1 package panir ( indian meat, soup bones or small curds ) | 3 cups vegetable broth | 1 lb ground turkey | 2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 4 cups arborio rice | 1 cup green beans, cut into thirds
instructions: In a large pot bring 2 cups vegetable broth to a boil. While broth is coming up to a boil, fry panir until it can be browned and crispy, approximately 5 minutes. In your mean time, cook 2 cups of the rice. When it is brown, break paneer into 2 inch pieces with your fingers and set aside. When broth is ready, add to panir and reduce heat. Add ginger garlic paste to hot broth. When broth is almost boiling, add cooked rice and cover to let steam out. In a separate pan, boil 2 cups of water. When water comes to a rolling boil, add the green beans and cook until tender. After rice is cooked, add to panir. When heated, add green beans and ginger garlic paste to panir mix. Serve.

Random Ingredients: littleneck clam,cabbage,graham cracker,raisin,hamburger bun,pecan,white wine vinegar,mace
title: Linguica
ingredients: 3 quarts littleneck clams with liquid | 1 cup raisins | 3 quarts cabbage | 2 1/2 cups dry white wine vinegar | 1/2 cup dry white wine | 2 teaspoons ground mace | 6 pounds lean ground hamburger buns | 1/4 cup raisins | 1/4 cup chopped pecans
instructions: Wash clams, and scrub under cold water. Reserve liquor. In a large stockpot or dutch oven, bring clam liquid to a boil.

title: Turkish Parsley
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh flat-leaf parsley, coarsely chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons dill seeds, coarsely ground ( dry or powdered )
instructions: The coarsely ground dill seeds will yield a slightly woody texture when cooked. Heat a heavy skillet over medium high heat. Add parsley and dill. Stir until fragrant, about 1 minute. Lower heat to medium high. Add about 1 cup water. Cover and cook, shaking the pan occasionally, until the liquid has just begun to evaporate and dry vegetables are shiny, about 15 minutes. Remove from heat and cool. Transfer to a blender and add 1 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon white pepper. Blend well.

title: Fried Salmon With Rigatoni and Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 300 g rigatoni pasta | 2 -4 tablespoons soy sauce | 1 -2 tablespoon oyster sauce ( optional ) | 1 kg small salmon
instructions: Cook rigatoni in boiling water until cooked. Drain, return to pan and dry slightly on paper towels. Meanwhile, heat a non stick frying pan, add a little oil, if using, and cook salmon until browned and crispy, around 3 - 4 minutes each side. Add soy sauce and oyster sauce, adjust if necessary.

title: Chile Con Queso
ingredients: 4 cups peanut oil for frying | 8 ounces flour tortillas, cut into 6 wedges
instructions: Heat oil in a deep fryer or deep heavy skillet to 325 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with waxed paper. Dip one piece of tortilla at a time into the hot oil, then immediately drop by the tablespoon into the hot oil. Cook until golden brown, then drain on paper towels. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,wheat flour,orange,rye flour,ginger garlic paste,tilapia fillet,watermelon
title: Watermelon & Swiss Steak Fritters
ingredients: 1/2 cup shredded watermelon | 1/2 cup shredded wheat flour | 1/4 cup shredded coconut | 1 tablespoon freshly grated orange rind | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 teaspoon cocoa powder | 6 ounces tilapia fillets, cut diagonally into 1/2 inch slices
instructions: Preheat a grill for medium high heat and lightly oil grate. To make the batter, add the remaining ingredients and mix well. Place the fish slices on a large platter in a single layer. Heat the oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Place the tilapia slices in the skillet and cook them for 3 to 4 minutes per side, or to desired doneness.

title: The Girls' Salad
ingredients: 2 cups mixed glace fruit, cut into 12 to 16 wedges | 5 cups romaine lettuce, torn
instructions: Arrange the mixed glace fruit and lettuce in a large bowl. Toss evenly until evenly coated with dressing. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: italian breadcrumb,sage leaf,chili pepper flake,green onion,nonfat plain yogurt,white sugar
title: Baked Italian Bread
ingredients: 1 cup shredded nonfat plain yogurt | 3 green onions, chopped | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 2 teaspoons chili pepper flakes, crushed | 1/4 teaspoon ground sage leaf | 3/4 cup dried italian seasoned breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit. Mix yogurt, green onions, sugar, chili flakes, and sage. Spoon mixture into a medium size baking dish, spreading evenly. Sprinkle bread crumbs over mixture. Bake in preheated oven for 35 to 40 minutes, or until golden.

title: Tarragon Seasoning-Candied Sugar
ingredients: 4 tablespoons tarragon, dried ( or fresh herb ) | 1 teaspoon sugar ( or honey, for sweetness )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in small dish or jar and shake to mix well. Store tightly covered in refridgerator.

title: Coconut Milk Chicken Legs
ingredients: 1 quart low-fat coconut milk | 8 chicken legs | 2 tablespoons grated fresh ginger | 1 purple onion, thinly sliced | 1 1/3 lbs mussels
instructions: Combine coconut milk and onion in deep non aluminum pan. Add chicken legs and sprinkle with ginger. Cover, bring to boil, remove cover. Simmer 30 - 35 minutes, until chicken becomes golden brown and onions are soft but not mushy. Serve chicken at once, with a sprinkling of extra ginger.

Random Ingredients: chicken,black pepper,pineapple juice orange,red chilies,greek seasoning
title: Grilled Chicken
ingredients: 1 whole chicken | 2 tablespoons all purpose greek-style seasoning | 2 tablespoons black pepper | 1 red chilies or 1 red pepper, chopped | 1 tablespoon pineapple juice or 1 tablespoon orange juice
instructions: Grill on a high heat until you notice the color change. Turn chicken over and brush with a little greek seasoning. Turn again and brush again. Mix together greek seasoning, black pepper, red chilies. Sprinkle half over chicken. Mix together the pineapple or juice and pour over chicken. Cover and grill for 20 minutes.

title: Penne With Coconut and Coconut
ingredients: 500 g penne | 2 tablespoons sweetened desiccated coconut | 2 tablespoons coconut oil
instructions: Cook the penne in boiling water, till al dente. Drain well and set to the side. While the pasta is cooking heat the coconut oil in a pan and add the desiccated coconut. Sauté until golden and slightly crisp. Add the penne to the oil on the top and toss till coated with coconut oil. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: pimiento,lemon juice,limeade,extra sharp cheddar cheese,raspberry,baby spinach,mustard,pecan nut
title: Cheddar-Lime Pesto Dressing
ingredients: 1 package extra-sharp cheddar cheese, shredded, divided | 3/4 cup extra-sharp cheddar cheese, chopped | 1/4 cup pecan nuts, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup limeade | 1/4 cup lemon juice | 1 jar pimientos, drained and chopped | 1 1/2 cups baby spinach, coarsely chopped | 1 jar raspberries | 1 teaspoon dry mustard
instructions: Combine 1 1/2 cups cheese, pecans and limeade in food processor. Add remaining 1 cheese, pimientos, spinach, lemon juice, mustard and remaining 2/3 cup cheese. Blend smooth. Cover.

title: French Cheeseburger Breakfast Burritos #5FIX
ingredients: 3/4 cup fat free egg substitute | 3/4 cup shredded swiss cheese | 10 eggs ( egg substitute equivalent ) | 12 tortillas
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Bring a saute pan of water to boil over high heat. In medium bowl, combine egg substitute and swiss cheese. Add egg substitute mixture and allow to cook until eggs are fluffy. Remove from heat. Dip tortillas into egg mixture until all ingredients are moist but not watery. Place 4 hot burritos in the bottom of a 10 inch cast iron skillet or heavy duty foil. Carefully fill each with 3/4 cup of mixture. Top with cheese. Close burritos and bake for approximately 10 minutes or until hot all the way through.

title: Papa's Potato and Dill Soup
ingredients: 5 onions, roughly chopped | 400 g diced fresh tomatoes with juice | 150 g potatoes, peeled and chopped | 150 g greek yogurt ( whole milk type ) | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 1 teaspoon dried dill ( or fresh dill ) | 1 teaspoon paprika
instructions: Cook the onions in a little olive oil. Once they are translucent add the diced tomatoes and bring to boil. Simmer gently for 15 minutes to allow the tomatoes to absorb some of the tomato liquid. Take a pan and crush the yam to a paste with the back of a spoon. Add it to the tomato mixture. Then add the cornflour and dill. If it tastes like you have to bring it to boil add a little cold water. Bring the mixture to the boil for about 5 minutes. Take heat down and simmer slowly until sauce is reduced to just a half of its consistancy. You want the soup to be like a thick cream soup, or it might be like nothing now and the consistency will probably not be quite the same. Add the paprika to taste. If it is too thick add a little water to thin it. Taste and add salt if necessary. Serve with crusty bread and chopped vegetables.

Random Ingredients: chili garlic sauce,adobo sauce,lamb shoulder,yellow cornmeal,mango,vegetable broth
title: Lamb and Mango Patties
ingredients: 1 pound lamb shoulder, cut into 2 inch cubes ( leg ) | 1/2 cup vegetable broth | 1/8 cup adobo sauce | 1 tablespoon chili-garlic sauce ( optional ) | 1 cup yellow cornmeal | 1 mango, peeled and cut into chunks
instructions: Mix lamb, broth, adobo sauce and chili garlic sauce in a bowl until combined. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat until hot, 2 to 3 minutes. Add the lamb mixture and reduce heat to medium. Cook until cooked through, 1 to 2 minutes. Remove the skillet from the heat and spoon the lamb mixture on top. Sprinkle cornmeal over the lamb and serve.

Random Ingredients: lime,dark chocolate,cream chicken soup,garam masala,wheat tortilla
title: Quick and Easy Chicken and Chocolate Enchiladas
ingredients: 4 ounces dark chocolate | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 lime, juice of | 1 packet of garam masala | 6 whole wheat tortillas
instructions: Place 1 teaspoon of garam masala on the bottom of a glass or baking dish. Place 1/2 cup of the chicken mixture evenly down the center of a tortilla. Roll and line your baking dish. Repeat for each tortilla, placing them side by side for even coverage. Heat the remaining 1 teaspoon of garam masala and remaining chicken until it begins to boil. Remove from heat. Mix soup, lime juice and remaining garam masala. Pour over enchiladas, mix well and chill for several hours or overnight. Heat up the remaining soup and pour over enchiladas. Cover and bake at 325 for 15 minutes or until hot. Garnish with fresh coriander, chopped cilantro and a squeeze of lime juice.

Random Ingredients: apple juice,cream cheese,cheddar cheese,yellow onion,soy sauce,cointreau liqueur
title: Tortas
ingredients: 1 small yellow onion | 1 1/2 - 2 cups low-fat cream cheese | 1 jar apple juice | 1/4 cup soy sauce | 1 teaspoon cointreau liqueur | 1/3 cup low fat cheddar cheese
instructions: Peel onion, cut in half, and slice very thinly into thin half rings. Melt butter in frying pan.. Saute' onion over medium heat till browned and a bit golden brown. Add cream cheese, and stir well. Add 1/4 cup of apple juice to skillet. Bring to a boil, lower heat, and let cream cheese cook till it's just melted and creamy and creamy. Add the rest of the apple juice to skillet, and simmer until it begins to bubble and thicken, then turn off heat. Spoon cheese/apple mixture onto tortillas, and fold into individual triangles. You can leave any leftover cheese inside, but it will still taste great in the end and help bind it better.

title: Blackberry Chocolate Chip Truffles
ingredients: 12 ounces chocolate chips | 14 -16 ounces blackberries ( i use frozen ) or 14 -16 ounces strawberries ( i use frozen ) | 2 tablespoons coarsely ground blackberry ( to garnish )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Combine the chocolate chips and blackberries in a medium bowl and, working with 1/2 t at a time, roll the truffle mixture into 1 inch balls. Place the balls on a baking sheet and flatten slightly. Bake in the oven for about 5 minutes or until the truffle softens slightly. Turn the truffles out onto wax paper and coat with the ground berries. Use a spatula to roll the truffles into smaller balls and dust with the blackberry. Store truffles in a small plastic jar.

Random Ingredients: vodka,up soda,portabella mushroom,enchilada sauce,chicken bouillon,honey,farfalle pasta,garam masala
title: Fast & Easy West Indian Mushroom Caviar Recipe
ingredients: 8 ounces farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 24 ounces enchilada sauce | 2 1/2 cups vodka | 2 1/2 chicken bouillon | 1 tablespoon honey | 1 1/2 tablespoons garam masala | 1 tablespoon old bay seasoning, blend | 2 1/2 cups cut up portabella mushrooms
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil, cook pasta for 8 minutes, drain and return to pot. Place enchilada sauce, vodka, bouillon, honey and garam masala in a saucepan and heat over medium. Stir occasionally until the mixture starts to thicken, about 5 minutes. Add the pasta and mushroom.

title: Cambodian Lemongrass & Rice (Vietnamese)
ingredients: 400 g brown rice | 2 tablespoons toasted sherry wine | 1/2 teaspoon caster sugar ( or superfine sugar ) | 1 1 stalk lemongrass, smashed
instructions: Place rice in a large bowl and cover with 6 cups boiling water.

title: Champirito Mushrooms (Champari) Croquettes
ingredients: 8 ounces cremini mushrooms, peeled and coarsely chopped | 1 teaspoon chopped green chile | 2 tablespoons coarse country bread, triangles or 2 tablespoons coarse country bread, crumbs
instructions: In a large saucepan of boiling water, cook mushrooms until tender, about 5 minutes. Drain and let cool. Transfer to a mixing bowl, gently mash with a potato masher. Stir in the chilies and mix well. Place the bread on a work surface and sprinkle with the chilies to coat. Roll the mixture into 1 inch long logs, then press into the bread cubes. Place on a paper towel lined baking sheet and let stand at room temperature 30 minutes to help them stay together. Arrange the croquettes on a platter and serve.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,italian turkey sausage,fine breadcrumb,bisquick baking mix,parmesan cheese,baking potato
title: Italian Sausage & Potatoes
ingredients: 1 lb italian turkey sausage | 2 lbs unpeeled baking potatoes | 1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Slice potatoes lengthwise into half, then across into 1/4 inch slices. Lay out on large rimmed baking sheet and roast for about 45 minutes or until slightly brown. While still hot, toss with remaining ingredients. Sprinkle cheese over potato mix and bake for 25 minutes.

title: Spicy Mexican Dip
ingredients: 1 can taco sauce | 1 dash tabasco sauce
instructions: Dump taco sauce in the bowl, but stir to combine well. Microwave taco sauce for about 30 seconds.

title: Danish Rice Ring
ingredients: 1/2 cup rice, plain or 1/2 cup brown rice | 1/2 cup cheese, grated ( i use cheddar or cheddar flavored, but you can choose your favorite ) | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon fresh minced rosemary ( more or less if desired ) or 1 -2 tablespoon fresh dill pickle spear ( more or less if desired ) | dill pickle spear ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Drain leftover rice and cheese, mix with rice until well combined. Place rice ring on a baking rack that is lined with waxed paper. Bake at 350 degrees uncovered for 20 minutes, or until rice is a translucent brown color and cheese is bubbling a little. Remove from oven. Garnish filling with pickle and/or dill pickle spears, if desired. Note, if you like it hot, you can add a little more pickle and/or dill..

title: Cilantro Fresh Broccoli
ingredients: 5 cups loosely packed frozen broccoli florets | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh cilantro leaves, or to taste | 1/4 teaspoon lemon extract
instructions: Place the broccoli in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,bouillon cube,mustard seed,jalapeno pepper,lamb shank,yellow squash
title: Cajun Lamb Shanks
ingredients: 4 lamb shank | 4 bouillon cubes | 1 yellow squash, sliced | 1 jalapeno pepper, sliced | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 2/3 cup shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Preheat grill for medium heat. Lightly oil the grate. Dissolve the bouillon in a bowl. Place lamb shanks inside. Place the squash, jalapeno pepper, mustard seed, and cheese onto the rack of the grill. Cook about 12 minutes per side, until browned.

title: Italian Chickpea Patties
ingredients: 6 medium dried red chili | 3 cups cooked chickpeas | 4 tablespoons minced figs | 1 lb sweet italian turkey sausage | 1 large potato, peeled grated | 2 egg whites | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: Split chiles in half, and place cut side down in a non aluminum dish sprayed with cooking spray. Set 1 chile half aside. Remove seeds, and stem, and veins from remaining chile. Soak overnight or about 8 hours, refrigerated until needed. Drain, and discard soaking water. Wipe out the dish, and remove chile. Break the sausage into 1 inch pieces, and fry in a nonstick skillet over medium heat in drippings. Drain. Place potatoes in a large bowl of ice water. Drain, and allow to sit for 30 minutes. Drain and pat dry. Using two large spoons, scoop out the seeds from chiles. Rinse chili, and set aside. Combine chile and potato in a medium bowl. Stir in 3 tablespoons figs, 3 tablespoons salt, and turmeric. Shape mixture into 1 inch balls. Set aside. Brush egg whites on a clean work surface, and place one of the patties in the center. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon of the remaining figs and 1 tablespoon of salt. Starting 1 side, roll the patties. Place seam side down on a baking sheet coated with cooking spray. Repeat process 4 more times for the remaining ingredients. Preheat grill to medium heat. Grill patties 4 inches from the heat for 16 minutes, turning once, or until meat flakes easily when tested with a fork, brushing with cooking oil. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: rosemary,bamboo shoot,chicken breast half,ginger root,spanish onion,lamb
title: Quick Curried Lamb with Noodles
ingredients: 1 sprig fresh rosemary | 2 pounds bone-in lamb, cut into pieces | 1 large spanish onion, cut into 1-inch chunks | 2 cups cubed scotch bonnet leg steak, or as needed | 1 small asian-style peeled and minced fresh ginger root | 2 1/2 cups canned bamboo shoots, drained and sliced
instructions: Place the rosemary sprigs in a large stockpot with enough cold water to cover.

title: Faux Mushrooms and Snow Peas
ingredients: 6 mushrooms | 1/2 cup button mushroom, cleaned and chopped in small pieces ( canned or fresh ) | 1/2 cup fresh snow peas
instructions: Clean the mushrooms. Cut them in half and remove the stems. Place the mushrooms in a medium size bowl. Cover with saran wrap and put it in the microwave for 3 minutes. Let it cool. Remove the wrap and cut each half into about 4 pieces. Put the button mushrooms and snow peas into a microwave safe bowl. Cover with a lid and microwave for 45 seconds to 1 minute or until the snow peas turn bright green. Put the contents into the bowl and stir. Serve.

title: Lentils and Chicken
ingredients: 2 tablespoons barbecue sauce | 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1 cup green lentil, rinsed and drained ( green beans ) | 1 package fresh strawberries, cut in half
instructions: Place chicken in a 8x12 inch baking dish. Bake, covered, in a 375 degree f oven for 45 minutes. Remove chicken, turn heat to high, and bake for 15 - 20 minutes more, or until golden and cooked through. Remove from oven. Heat bbq sauce in a skillet over medium heat until hot. Boil the lentils, covered, for 15 minutes, or until tender and thickened. Add the strawberries, and continue cooking 5 - 10 minutes. Spoon lentils into serving bowl and top with chicken.

title: Pork Tenderloin With Yellow Squash, Ham, and Serrano Chile
ingredients:
3 lbs pork tenderloin ( at least two per person.
