    - ) | 1 can serrano chilies | 6 ounces yellow squash, cut into fourths | 6 ounces ham steaks, cut into thirds | 4 tablespoons oil
instructions: Cut tenderloin into serving sized pieces and place into crockpot or heavy duty zip top plastic bag. If using a crockpot, place on medium high heat. When hot enough add a few tablespoons of oil on low, add chiles and let cook for about two minutes or until fragrant. Turn onto plate and set aside. Meanwhile roast squash on high until squash is tender. Remove from stove and transfer to a bowl. Spray with non stick cooking spray and cover with plastic wrap. Let marinate for approximately 20 minutes. Meanwhile, heat remaining oil in a frypan and add pork and the marinade mixture. Allow to heat through, about 5 minutes, until pork is no longer pink.

title: Mexican Pasta and Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 1 cup rigatoni pasta | 1 can refried beans | 1 can green chili, chopped | 1 cup broccoli, chopped | 1/2 cup pineapple juice
instructions: Cook pasta and drain. Mix all ingredients together.

Random Ingredients: garlic powder,sun tomato oil,kiwi,thyme leave,water,salt pepper,cilantro
title: Sun Dried Tomato and Kiwi Salsa
ingredients: 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 3/4 cup water | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh thyme leave | 1 tablespoon fine chopped fresh cilantro | 1 1/2 teaspoons salt & pepper | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder | 2 kiwi ( peeled, sliced )
instructions: Place the sun dried tomatoes in a bowl, pour 3/4 cup boiling water over and let stand for 5 minutes. Drain the tomatoes and discard the cooking water. Transfer the tomatoes to a blender, adding remaining ingredients except the kiwi. Blend on high speed for 1 minute, then on low speed for 30 seconds more. Transfer to a bowl and cover tightly with plastic wrap. Chill in refrigerator. Serve with warm tortilla chips.

title: Easy "smoking" Loco Loco Beef Brisket (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 5 lbs beef brisket, trimmed from fat, such as brisket | 1 1/2 cups low sodium chicken broth | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke flavoring | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: Trim excess fat from meat. Place meat, fat side up, in crockpot. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over meat. Cover and cook on low 10 to 12 hours or high 3 to 4 hours, or until desired tenderness. Remove meat and slice on the diagonal into 1/3 inch slices and serve as is or using recipe #.

title: Ganoush (Iranian Saffron Powder)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups saffron or 1 1/2 cups turkish saffron, broken up into pieces | 5 -8 cups poppy seeds
instructions: In a large bowl wash saffron pieces in cold water and remove the fine strands, set aside. In another large mixing bowl, dry roast poppy seeds to a reddish green color. Using a mortar and pestle crush poppy seeds until they are like sand. Place crushed poppy seeds in a small saucepan with the saffron. Heat and add warm water until a full covering is achieved. Bash in a little of this water until mixture becomes a paste. Pour hot mixture over remaining poppy poppy seeds. Mix in saffron, adding more or less water until desired consistency is achieved. If desired, leave poppy seed mixture in refrigerator for an hour before serving. Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: black eyed pea,rice,pork shoulder,lemon juice zest,garlic clove
title: Black-Eyed Peas and Rice
ingredients: 3 lbs pork shoulder or 3 lbs shoulder steaks | 2 cups dried black-eyed peas | 3 teaspoons lemon juice or 3 teaspoons lime juice, divided | 4 garlic cloves, peeled and finely chopped | 2 1/2 cups raw rice
instructions: Wash and sort the peas and place in large pot. Add 1/2 tsp of lemon juice or 1/2 tsp lime juice. Bring to boil and cook over medium heat until peas are tender, about 45 min. Drain. Cut pork into 1/2 inch cubes. Place in a frying pan and add the remaining 2 tbsp lemon juice or lime juice or lime extract. Stir fry meat until browned. Add the peas and 2/3 cup water. Reduce heat and simmer, covered, stirring once or twice until beans are tender, about 25 minutes. Add garlic and cook uncovered until fragrant. Serve over warm buttered rice.

title: Garlicky Oregano on Bread
ingredients: 5 tablespoons freshly chopped oregano leaves | 1 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Rinse the oregano using a fine mesh sieve, then transfer it to a small bowl. Add the chopped fresh oregano leaves. Slowly rub in the parmigiano reggiano cheese until the cheese resembles coarse bread crumbs. Scoop up the cheese with your hands and make several small wells in the dough. Drop the little oregano and parmigiano into the hot cheese and cook, mashing the mozzarella with a fork, until it forms a moist paste, about 4 minutes. If the oil separates, simply shake off any excess. Serve warm or room temperature.

Random Ingredients: chinese five spice powder,graham cracker crumb,chunky salsa,cauliflower floret,kalamata olive,milk,tamarind paste
title: Chunky Cauliflower Spread
ingredients: 1/3 cup milk | 1 tablespoon ground chunky salsa | 1/8 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 1 package cauliflower florets, chopped | 1/2 cup grated romaine's or cheddar cheese blend | 2 tablespoons chopped kalamata olives | 1 teaspoon tamarind paste
instructions: Place milk in a bowl, add chile, 5 spice power, cauliflower, cheese and olives. Mix well. Sprinkle on top with remaining cheese.

title: Italian Seasoning II
ingredients: 1 tablespoon italian seasoning | 1 small yellow onion
instructions: Cut onion into large chunks before grating. Place onions in a large, non reactive bowl. Sprinkle seasoning mixture on onion and toss. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until serving.

Random Ingredients: chicken drumstick,cornstarch,coconut rum,pita bread,red chili powder,molasses
title: Baked Haitian Faux Chicken (Bamil Gaeng)
ingredients: 1/2 cup coconut rum | 1/4 cup light molasses | 1/4 cup cornstarch | 1/4 cup ground red chili powder | 8 skinless chicken drumsticks | 8 pita bread, halves
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Mix coconut rum, molasses, cornstarch, and chile powder together in a bowl.

title: Spiced Popcorn (Shawarma)
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated biscuits or ( 7 ounce ) package prepared popcorn | 4 cups popped popcorn | 2 green cardamom pods or 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 3 -4 cups baking powder
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees f. Unroll each biscuit in ungreased 13x9 inch glass baking dish. Sift dry ingredients into a large bowl and set aside. Break each biscuit into 1 inch chunks. Drop into hot, full, dry popcorn, stirring vigorously.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,monterey jack cheese,cornstarch,fish,flat leaf parsley,allspice
title: Crispy Cheese Cranks
ingredients: 1 cup grated pecorino or romano cheese | 1 cup grated monterey jack cheese | 1/2 cup ground coriander fish ( not packed in oil ) | 1/4 cup finely chopped flat leaf parsley | 1/8 teaspoon ground allspice | 1/4 cup cornstarch
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Place cereal, cheeses, coriander and parsley in a bowl. Mix cornstarch and water in a small bowl until dissolved, then stir into the mixture. Roll mixture into walnut sized balls. Place balls on a parchment lined baking sheet and bake in the preheated 450 degrees f oven until golden brown, 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Chinese Pork for Two
ingredients: 1 tablespoon anise seed | 1 pork tenderloins
instructions: Grind anise seed in a spice grinder or coffee grinder with a mortar and pestle or spice mill. Place the pork tenderloins in a baking sheet and grind to remove any excess oil. Coat the meat with the aniseed oil and grill, turning once, until nicely browned and tender, approximately 30 minutes.

title: Baked Chocolate Rice Noodles
ingredients: 8 ounces fine rice noodles | 2 tablespoons brown sugar | 2 teaspoons garlic powder or 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/2 cup arborio rice | 1/2 ounce unsweetened chocolate
instructions: Soak rice noodles for 20 minutes. Mix together brown sugar, garlic powder, rice and chocolate. Put the mixture in a buttered casserole dish, dot with melted butter sprinkle with paprika bake 20 - 25 minutes at 350 degrees.

title: Beef Brisket Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 beef brisket | 2 ounces cashew halves | 1 bunch chopped pecan halves | 1 red onion, sliced | 1/2 cup toasted pecan halves
instructions: Preheat a grill pan for high heat. Rub the brisket with salt. Place the brisket in the pan in a single layer. Grill the brisket uncovered, about 10 minutes to medium rare. Cool slightly. Remove the brisket from the bones and shred or cut into small squares. Transfer the brisket to a mixing bowl. Sprinkle with the cashews, pecans, onion, 1/2 cup pecan halves, and remaining 1/2 cup pecan halves.

title: Tatties on a Stick
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped pecans | 1/4 cup finely chopped green pepper | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1 tablespoon tamari | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | lettuce
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients. Cover and chill. Form sticks with 3 or 4 wedges per stick. Grill, basting once or twice with remaining sauce, until lightly browned. Serve with salad.

Random Ingredients: wild mushroom,pecorino romano cheese,milk chocolate,saffron strand,peppermint extract,deli turkey,cardamom seed
title: Baked Wild Mushrooms With Cough Paddles (Cookman's Illustration)
ingredients:
500 g wild mushrooms, cleaned, stems and tough stems cut away | 6 tablespoons pecorino romano cheese, grated very fine | 350 g sliced deli turkey ( about 1 1/2 1.
    - 8oz ) | 1/4 cup milk chocolate, finely chopped | 1 pinch saffron strand | 3/4 teaspoon cardamom seed, crushed lightly | 1 teaspoon peppermint extract | 5 saffron strands, lightly crushed
instructions: Heat oven to 200 c / 220 c fan forced / 375f / gas mk put a few pieces of mushrooms and a couple of slices of turkey together in a baking dish. In a small saucepan, melt the cheese over a medium heat, stirring often, until golden. Remove the saucepan from the heat. Stir in the chocolate to combine. Stir in the saffron, cardamom and peppermint extract. Spoon half the cheese mixture over the mushrooms and turkey. Repeat with the remaining filling. Cover with foil and bake until the cheese is melted and bubbling, about 35 mins. Remove foil. To serve melt the remaining cheese and spoon over the mushrooms and turkey.

title: Spicy Cheese
ingredients:
4 large slices kasseri cheese ( or other mildly mild white cheese similar to kasseri ) | 1 tablespoon red wine | 1 bay leaf | 3 tablespoons spicy spices, of your choice ( your choices ) | bell pepper ( roasted onion, thyme, parsley, parsley, etc.
    - )
instructions: Place a slice of cheese on a large piece of foil. Spread the pepper slices evenly over the cheese, and roll up from the edge. Wrap tightly in the foil.

title: Scarface Mogs
ingredients: 2 cups parsnips, pared and sliced | 1 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Toss the parsnips with the mace. Place in an iron, uncovered roasting pan or baking sheet, and bake at 400 degrees f. Roast for 15 minutes. Allow to cool. Place on waxed paper. Use to stuff them. Note, for a crisper mogs, add a little water. To make a chewy mogs, add a little coarse sugar.

title: Torticas (Mexican Fried Carnitas)
ingredients: 1 lb ground buffalo meat | 1 lime, cut into 8 wedges | 1/2 cup cornflour
instructions: Place meat, lime wedge and cornflour in a deep frying pan or wok, stir fry over moderate heat, turning the meat gently until browned.

title: Pepper and Caper Frijoles
ingredients: 2 cans black beans, drained and rinsed | 1 cup sliced jarred roasted peppers | 1 cup coarsely-chopped capers
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. In a 2 quart casserole dish mix beans, peppers, capers and 1 t. Water. Bake in preheated oven 15 minutes or until hot. Spoon hot frijoles onto a plate and serve.

Random Ingredients: pinto bean,cardamom seed,coconut oil,peanut butter,pineapple tidbit,hamburger
title: Cindy's Pinto Beans and Pineapples
ingredients: 1 lb ground hamburger | 2 tablespoons crunchy peanut butter | 2 cans pinto beans, drained ( reserve liquid ) | 1/8 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1 can pineapple tidbits | 1/4 cup coconut oil
instructions: Cook/brown hamburger and set aside leaving fat in skillet. Return skillet to heat and add peanut butter. Allow to melt. Drain canned pinto beans and add to skillet with melted peanut butter along with drained pineapple tidbits, coconut oil and cardamom seeds. Simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.

Random Ingredients: angel hair pasta,cinnamon,fennel seed,seasoning salt,blueberry,caster sugar,beef,peach
title: Beef in Cranberry-Peach Pasta
ingredients: 8 ounces angel hair pasta | 1 lb lean ground beef | 1/4 cup caster sugar | 1 tablespoon fennel seed | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 6 cups mixed berries | 1 cup blueberries
instructions: Cook pasta as directed on package. When the rest of the ingredients are done, drain pasta and return it to the pan. Add the ground beef. Add the sugars, cinnamon, and seasoning salt. Drain the berries and add to the skillet. Stir. Cover and simmer until the berries are tender.

title: Spicy Baking Leeks
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups mixed leeks, cleaned, trimmed and lightly steamed ( white and light green parts only ) | 2 cups flax seed meal
instructions: In a large pot, cover leeks with just enough water to cover. Bring to a boil and cook 10 minutes. Remove from heat and let sit 10 minutes to steam. Drain and rinse with cold water. Pat dry. Heat oven to 400°f. Line baking sheet with heavy duty aluminum foil or parchment paper. In a small bowl, stir together flax meal and remaining water. Brush over leeks and sprinkle with flax mixture. Slide leeks onto hot baking sheet. Bake 7 - 10 minutes or until light golden brown. Cool on a rack.

Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,pumpkin seed,ginger root,asiago cheese,goat cheese
title: Pumpkin Spread with Asiago Cheese and Goat Cheese
ingredients: 1/2 cup pumpkin seeds | 5 ounces goat cheese, cut into cubes | 2 teaspoons ground cardamom pods | 1 teaspoon ground ginger root | 1/2 cup grated asiago cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spread pumpkin seeds onto a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until pumpkin seeds are light brown, about 20 minutes. Allow to cool, and coarsely grind the cooked pumpkin seeds. Stir together the poppy seeds, goat cheese, cardamom, ginger, and asiago cheese. Stir in the pumpkin seeds.

Random Ingredients: baby pea,maraschino juice,salt black pepper,celery,skirt steak,bell pepper,oil olive,tomato puree
title: Skirt Steak With Peas and Shredded Relish
ingredients: 2 lbs skirt steak, trimmed and cut into 1-inch cubes ( trimmed of excess fat and then cut against the grain into cubes ) | oil ( i used olive oil ) | 2 lbs fresh baby peas | 1 bell pepper, diced ( green or red, whichever you prefer ) | 1 cup chopped celery | 1 cup chopped tomato puree ( or pureed tomatoes of your choice ) | 1 1/2 cups maraschino juice ( i used heinz brand or any citrus based juice marinade you can find ) | 1 1/2 cups frozen tiny whole baby peas, thawed | salt and black pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Mix all the ingredients except the salt and pepper in a large baking dish. Add the salt and pepper. Place the cubes of steak in the mixture. Cover and leave for 20 minutes or longer, turning over once. Arrange on top of the peas or in the baking dish and bake for about 20 minutes or until the sauce is bubbling and vegetables are tender.

title: Almond Powder (Almond Sauce)
ingredients:
1/2 lb blanched almond | 1 cube chicken bouillon | 1 tablespoon powdered chicken powder ( powdered powdered chicken powder may be added, i have tried both of these.
    - i use a homemade chicken bullion ) or 1 tablespoon vegetable bouillon
instructions: Roast the almonds, place over a high heat and toast until they become dark and toasted. Take from pan and let cool. Place the almond powder in a bowl and add the bouillon. Add the almonds and stir. Store in refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: strawberry,french bread,onion soup mix,provolone cheese,orange bell pepper
title: French Toast Strawberry Upside Down
ingredients:
20 slices french bread | 1 -2 ounce dry onion soup mix ( one envelope, one envelope, or 2 1/2 oz.
    - packages ) | 1 orange bell pepper | 8 -10 strawberries | provolone cheese
instructions: Slice bread in half and spread with cream cheese. Place cut side up on cookie sheet. Sprinkle with soup mix. Place orange pepper on top and broil for about 3 - 4 minutes or until hot and starting to smoke/orange in color and juice is bubbling. Remove orange pepper. Slice strawberries and place around fruit. To top off your glass of goodness.

title: Orange Ginger Iced Beverage
ingredients: 2 cups dark brown sugar | 6 tablespoons orange juice
instructions: Heat brown sugar with the orange juice until a golden syrup consistency. Remove from heat and stir. Pour into ice filled glasses and serve.

title: Gravlax
ingredients: 1 jar apricot preserves | 1 -2 tablespoon adobo sauce, hot | 1/2 teaspoon saffron thread | 1/2 teaspoon adobo sauce | 1/4 teaspoon vinegar ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon orange rind, candied grated ( optional )
instructions: Drain apricot preserves, and add to dutch oven or heavy skillet. Add hot adobo sauce, saffron, adobo sauce, vinegar and orange rind if using, and simmer until thickened, stirring often. Adjust vinegar as needed for desired consistency. Serve as a garnish. Note, gravy can be frozen for up to 3 months.

title: Veal Fajitas
ingredients: 1/4 cup chopped kalamata olive | 3/4 lb ground veal | 2 flour tortillas | 6 slices french bread, toasted ( for serving )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Saute olives and ground veal over medium heat, stirring constantly, until heated through and flavors are blended. Place 1/2 tablespoon of mixture on each tortilla. Fold each tortilla in half over filling. Place on greased baking sheet. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes or until heated through.

title: Sweet Italian Breadcrumbs
ingredients: 2 cups brown rice | 1/4 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1/3 cup oil | 1/3 cup maraschino cherry, drained
instructions: Prepare brown rice according to package directions. Combine breadcrumbs, oil and cherries in a mixing bowl. Mix well. Dip breadcrumbs into crumbs then roll in additional breadcrumbs. Cook on each side over medium heat until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: red salmon,hot water,floury potato,peanut oil vegetable,liquid smoke
title:
Roasted Potato Wedges with Red Salmon.
    -
ingredients: 1 lb red salmon | 2 tablespoons salted peanuts oil or 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 5 lbs floury potatoes, halved and parboil | 1/3 cup liquid smoke ( optional substitue 1 tbsp tomato sauce if preferred ) | 1/4 cup hot water ( optional substitue hot water for the hot sauce or add salt substitute )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Drain and rinse salmon. Cut through the center bone in half. Open out meat of bones with a sharp knife. Pat flour and skin thoroughly onto each side of salmon. Then roll each piece of fish in the flour, making sure they are completely coated. Set the fish on a baking sheet and brush with a little veg. Oil. Bake 15 - 20 minutes or until the fish flakes and flakes easily when touched. While the fish is baking make the relish and potatoes. Peel the potatoes, cut into quarters and place in a bowl large enough to hold the potatoes. If not using oil and/or water use cooking spray for vegetable oil. Sprinkle lightly with salt. Toss potatoes with reserved salmon skin. Spread mashed potato on a baking sheet. Place in the oven. Bake 40 - 45 minutes until golden brown. Remove from oven and cover with foil to finish baking about 5 more minutes. Place the pan of potatoes and salmon on serving plates and keep them warm. Keep the remaining pan juices until serving.

title: Chutney Mango Chutney
ingredients: 2 cups finely diced mango chutney ( can use fruit chutney ) | 4 roma tomatoes, chopped | 4 tablespoons russian-style chutney | 1/2 cup fresh lime juice
instructions: Place all ingredients in a saucepan and cook over low until thick and chunky. Serve warm over fresh mango chutney.

Random Ingredients: chili garlic sauce,kaffir lime leaf,taco seasoning
title: Garlicky Taco Seasoning
ingredients: 1 packet taco seasoning | 1 bottle chili-garlic sauce | 3 kaffir lime leaves
instructions: Mix all ingredients in crockpot. Put all in crockpot on low 6 - 8 hours. Serve with tortilla chips or vegetables.

title: Chilled Tomatillo Grape Roll Ups
ingredients: 1 jar whole kernel corn, drained | 2 packages tomatillos, drained and sliced | 1 packet saucy steak creations best steak creations best tomato sauce | 1 package butter, melted | 1 dash hot sauce, as much as you like | 1 dash coriander seed, whole | grape | lemon slice
instructions: Put the corn, tomatillos, sauce, butter, hot sauce and spices in a food processor and pulse to a puree. Roll into balls the size of an orange. Roll in shredded cheese and leave to set. You can freeze the stuffed tomatoes if desired. Serve with a lemon slice.

title: Chinese Cilantro and Soy-Cilantro Dip (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 1/4 - 1/2 cup fresh cilantro leaves | 2 tablespoons light soy sauce ( or more to your taste ) | 1 teaspoon celery salt ( to taste )
instructions: Add all the ingredients in a food processor and process until smooth.

title: Easy Beef Soup
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef round | 2 slices white bread | 1 teaspoon beef bouillon granules | 1 can creamed corn
instructions: Place ground beef in a skillet. Drain excess fat. Sprinkle beef with breadcrumbs and granules. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer for 90 minutes or till beef is fully cooked. Stir in corn.

title: Mexican Green Cactus
ingredients: 4 tablespoons pimento stuffed olives, finely chopped | 1/4 cup salsa verde, medium heat | 2 green cardamom pods, crushed
instructions: Combine olives with the salsa verde. Serve in small glass bowl with a sprinkle of cardamom.

Random Ingredients: amaretto,oatmeal,clove,fish sauce,tomato green chilies,basil,malt vinegar,kosher salt
title: Sweet Tomato Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 ounces dried apricots or 1/2 ounce dried kalamata olives | 4 medium tomatoes or 2 medium green tomatoes | 1/2 cup dry oatmeal | 3 tablespoons gluten-free tamari ( or soy sauce ) | 3 tablespoons fish sauce | 1 teaspoon dried basil | kosher salt | 1/8 teaspoon clove
instructions: Soak apricots in hot water for 30 - 45 minutes. Drain and cut into small pieces. Cut tomatoes in half and cut crosswise into thin slices. Remove pulp and seeds from tomatoes. Using a spoon, scoop out the flesh from the tomatoes. Then coarsely chop the flesh and set aside. In a medium bowl, combine the oatmeal kernels and chopped tomatoes and toss lightly. Toast the oats in a dry large ungreased skillet over medium heat until well toasted, about 5 minutes each side. Drain on paper towels. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, combine the fish sauce, basil, salt and cloves. In a small bowl, combine the remaining ingredients. Dip your hands in the fish sauce mixture and place a scoop of the oatmeal into the palm of one hand and a scoop of the tomatoes onto the other. Squeeze out the extra liquid. Gently, using your right hand to press down onto the tomatoes, roll them up into a ball and then in the oatmeal or toss them into the tomato mixture until coated completely. Place in a serving bowl and serve.

title: Baked Pork and Potatoes
ingredients: 2 1/4 lbs yukon gold potatoes, sliced 1 1/4 inch thick | pork fat, from a can
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f degrees. In a large ovenproof nonstick skillet, heat enough pork fat to just coat the bottom of the pan over moderately high heat. Working in batches, fry 2 potatoes at a time, turning and sprinkling with salt, until golden brown, about 5 minutes total total. Transfer to paper towels to drain and reserve. Remove all but 1 tablespoon of the fat from the skillet. Add the remaining potato slices.

title: Geri Halliwella
ingredients: 1/2 cup tahini | 3 large tomatoes, peeled seeded and chopped | 1/4 cup cognac or 1/4 cup rose wine | 2 teaspoons flounder sea salt, plus extra to taste | 1/2 teaspoon fennel, leaves finely grated ( optional )
instructions: Tabbouleh, stir together the tahini, tomatoes and cognac until combined well and season with flounder salt. The geri halli, mix together the fennel leaves and a bit of olive oil and spread on an even layer of geri halli. Bake in a moderate oven, uncovered, for about 4 - 6 minutes, until softened. Spread the bahlu onto a serving platter and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: ginger juice,yellow onion,crouton,ginger root,garlic paste,curry powder,sun tomato pesto
title: Sun-Dried Tomato Pesto Croutons
ingredients: 1 cup sun-dried tomato pesto | 1/3 cup chopped yellow onion | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped fresh ginger root | 2 teaspoons garlic paste | 2 teaspoons curry powder | 1/4 teaspoon ground ginger juice, or more to taste | 1 cup crouton, or as desired for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Mix sun dried tomato pesto, yellow onion, minced ginger, garlic paste, curry powder, and ground ginger juice together in a bowl. Gently stir in croutons and optional croutons. Chill the croutons in the refrigerator until serving.

title: Moroccan Chocolate Covered Chestnuts
ingredients: 12 medium chestnuts | 4 ounces bittersweet semisweet chocolate | 2 ounces dried currants ( optional )
instructions: Place a rack in the center of your oven and preheat to 325°f butter a deep baking dish that is at least half full. Place the chestnuts in the pan and place in the over, skin side up. Bake for about 35 minutes or until a knife comes out very clean. Turning occasionally, bake for 5 more minutes or until golden. Remove from the oven and let cool. The chestnuts can be frozen or made ahead of time. Whip the chocolate until soft peaks form. Fold the chocolate into the chestnuts. The mixture will be very thick. Spread onto a cookie sheet lined with wax paper or plastic wrap and refrigerate until set. Use an ice cream scoop to cut the chestnuts. Place in a heatproof bowl, cover and refrigerate until hardened, at least 4 hours. Unwrap the chocolate then dip a cold chestnuts in melted chocolate and place back on the wax paper or plastic wrap.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,white bread,chocolate,green pepper,dill,chinese five spice powder
title: Stuffed Chinese Bread Bread Rounds
ingredients: 1 red bell pepper | 1/2 green pepper | 1/2 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 6 slices dry white bread | 4 slices miniature semisweet chocolate pieces | 1/2 teaspoon dried dill
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Lightly grease a baking sheet. Cut off tops of bell peppers, and remove seeds and membrane. Place pepper on baking sheet. Place roasted peppers in a baking tray with pepper side down. Bake on the lowest rack of the oven for 20 minutes. Turn peppers over, and bake for an additional 10 minutes. Remove from oven, and cool. In a mixing bowl, mix 5 spice powder, and all ingredients. Remove peppers from baking sheet, and carefully hollow out each pepper. Insert a chocolate piece in the center of each pepper. Place filled pepper upright in baking sheet. Place on the rack of a baking sheet, and bake for 25 minutes. Remove from oven, and cool. Serve with ice cream, milk or sour cream.

title: Smoked Gorgonzola Spread
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 2 3/4 ounces smoked gorgonzola | 1 1/4 ounces smoked salmon | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1/2 cup flat-leaf shelled pistachios, toasted | 2 cans kidney beans, drained, rinsed | 1/2 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: In a heavy pan, heat oil over medium low heat. Add gorgonzola and cook, stirring, for a few minutes. Add smoked salmon, worcestershire sauce and nuts and cook, stirring, until gorgonzola loses the raw taste. Stir in beans and heat through. Stir in 1/2 cup cheddar and heat through.

title: Rice, Kidney Bean and Lemon Zest Steamed
ingredients: 1 liter beef stock | 1 1/2 - 2 tablespoons dried kidney beans | 1 lemon, zest of, grated | 1/4 cup long-grain rice, rinsed
instructions: Heat stock in pan, add beans and bring to boil. Add zest, cook on low for 8 minutes drain off the fat. Rinse rice, add and stir. Put lid on and steam for another 1/2 hour.

title: Veal Fonduta
ingredients: 450 g veal, diced into small bite-size cubes and skin on ( i used lean veal in a tube ) | 1 tablespoon calvados ( red food colouring ) | 2 small red onions, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon red food coloring, optional ( optional ) | 1/2 cup chicken stock ( i used 2 tsp, i think that would make a difference ) | 2 -3 tablespoons pecans, ground ( optional )
instructions: In a frying pan, cook the diced veal over medium heat, stirring continuously until browned on all sides. Move to a plate. Dissolve the red food colouring in the stock and pour over the veg. Add the pecans. Cover and simmer until the veg is tender. When ready to serve, remove the cover and simmer for about 10 - 12 minutes or until the sauce just comes to the boil. Return the fonduta to the pan and reheat. Serve warm on a hot bread, with salad and pass the caramel sauce from the pan.

Random Ingredients: cinnamon,french green bean,almond extract,superfine sugar,bay leaf,deep frying oil
title: Cinnamon-Almond Green Beans
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh french style green bean, trimmed, cut in 1 inch pieces | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1 cardamom pod, outer light crushed | 3/4 teaspoon almond extract | 1/2 cup cold unsalted butter, cut into 1/2 inch pieces, cut into 1/2-inch pieces | 2 tablespoons superfine sugar, plus more for sprinkling
instructions: Drop the green beans into boiling water and blanch 5 seconds. Cover with cold water and set aside for 3 minutes. Drain well under cold water. Rinse with cold water and drain. Toss with the cinnamon, cardamom and almond extract. Heat the oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly grease a shallow baking dish. Add the butter and melt. Add the sugar and fry 1 minute, stirring constantly. Sprinkle the bean mixture in to the baking dish. Bake uncovered, stirring 2 minutes or until heated through. Watch carefully. Sprinkle with cinnamon sugar.

title: Beef Sausage Rolls
ingredients: 1 kg beef sausage | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1/2 cup cake flour | 1 garlic, clove
instructions: Boil the sausage in water until cooked all the way through. While the sausage is boiling, mix the garlic and rice vinegar together to make rice vinegar paste. Drain the sausage and add to the rice vinegar paste. Stir to mix and let cool to room temperature. Roll balls of sausage into balls and then flatten out with the palm of your hand. Cook balls in hot oil until brown, then turn over and cook second side. Serve on toast or sandwich buns for dipping. Can be eaten with sambal belachan bread, german noodles, or just serve on the side.

title: Tamari Salted Pork and Beans
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs thickly cut salt pork or 1 1/2 lbs rib roast | 1 1/2 cups tamari, divided
instructions: Dissolve tamari in 1/2 cup water. Trim off any excess fat. Cut salt pork lengthwise into 1 inch x 2 inch strips. Toss salt pork strips with 1 1/2 cups water and 1 1/2 cups tamari mixture. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight. The water may be used to moisten the meat if it is necessary. Transfer salt pork pieces to an ovenproof skillet and heat over high heat. Reduce heat to medium and bake, turning occasionally, for about 1 hour or until browned.. Serve hot with remaining tamari flavored sauce.

title: Maurice Salad (Morocco-Yaya)
ingredients: 1 small radish | 1/4 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1/8 teaspoon smoked paprika
instructions: Grate the radish and mix all other ingredients together. Serve immediately.

title: Veal With a Savory Mushroom
ingredients: 200 g ground veal | 200 g bean sprouts | 1 teaspoon chili paste | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 150 ml coconut cream | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried sage
instructions: Put the ground veal in a large dish. Add the bean sprouts, chili paste, flavour essence and coconut cream.

Random Ingredients: baby carrot,cornstarch,italian salad dressing mix,cilantro leaf,bread machine yeast,pork cutlet,raisin
title: Easy Italian Pork Cutlets
ingredients: 1 lb fresh bread, crusts removed | 4 pork cutlets | 2 tablespoons dry italian salad dressing mix | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 package baby carrots | 1/3 cup raisins | 2 tablespoons fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Place bread in bread machine pan in order given and select your basic or white bread cycle. Drain carrot and toss in a mixing bowl with the 1/2 cup raisins and 1 tbls cornstarch. Remove bread from the bread pan and discard the crusts. Push the cutlets onto a lightly greased baking sheet. If desired, coat the cutlets with a mixture of the salad dressing mix and 1 tbls cornstarch. Sprinkle tops of the cutlets with the 1 tbls cilantro. Cover and let rise in a warm place for 35 minutes. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Bake cutlets for 12 to 15 minutes, allowing 3 for each side. Turn cutlets over and bake an additional 10 to 15 minutes or until the internal temperature is 1/4°f. Remove cutlets from baking sheet and cool for 3 to 5 minutes. Turn cutlets again and brush with the remaining 1 tbls cornstarch wash, turning for a minute. Place cutlets on a serving platter and serve with a side of carrot sauce.

title: Smoked Salmon Croquettes
ingredients: 8 ounces dry chayote, husked and rinsed | 8 ounces egg noodles ( linguine or vermicelli ) | 1 cup smoked salmon, preferably from another smoked fish | 3 tablespoons fresh lime juice ( about 6 tablespoons ) | 1 tablespoon ground cumin | 4 slices italian bread, toasted ( to garnish )
instructions: Soak the chayote on a rack in warm water for 15 minutes. Soak the egg noodles in a separate kettle of cold water for 10 minutes. Drain the chayote and cut into ¾ inch dice. Meanwhile, in a bowl, combine the chayote, noodles, and salmon. Toss with the lime juice, cumin, and the salt and pepper to taste. Transfer the mixture to a bowl, and refrigerate for at least 20 minutes or up to overnight. To serve, place a slice of toasted bread on the tray. Fill the soup with the toasts and ladle over individual servings of soup. Note, to toast the bread just before serving, slice it diagonally into about ¼ inch slices and arrange on individual serving plates. Spoon the soup over the toasts.

title: Penne With Sesame Seeds and Hot Meat
ingredients: 200 g penne | 1/2 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1 small white onion | 350 g spicy red chili paste ( sambal oelek )
instructions: Boil water in a large pan, then add salt and half the sesame oil to the pan. Cook the pasta in the boiling water for 8 minutes. Heat the remaining sesame oil in a frying pan. Add the onion, and chili paste and saute for 6 minutes over a moderate heat. Season with salt if necessary, stir in and serve.

title: English Peas With Gingerroot
ingredients: 12 ounces frozen english peas | 2 inches gingerroot, peeled | 6 ounces frozen english peas
instructions: Place peas into pot. Add salt and enough hot water to cover the peas by 3 inches. Bring to boil. Reduce heat to simmer. Simmer for 1 - 2 hours until peas are tender. Meanwhile, cut ginger into thin slices, then chop into pieces, using a mortar and pestle. Remove peas from the water, drain, and add to the pot. If using fresh peas, place in a pot of hot water. Cook for about 10 more minutes until peas are crisp tender.

title: Bruschetta Italiano on an Acid Cloud
ingredients: 6 maraschino cherries, or | 1/3 cup orange extract | 6 tablespoons champagne | 2 tablespoons oil | french bread, cut into 1-inch pieces
instructions: Dump the dried cherries and 1/3 cup orange extract into a blender jar. Add the champagne.

title: Vanilla Fruit Jam
ingredients: 1/2 cup coriander seed | 2 cinnamon sticks | 1/4 cup amaretto ( almond-flavored liqueur )
instructions: Crush the coriander seeds and cinnamon sticks in a mortar and pestle until evenly crushed. Stir in amaretto and process until mixture is smooth and creamy.

title: Baby Arugula and Roma Chile Wraps
ingredients: 1/2 lb baby arugula, washed, spun dry ( arugula stems should be removed to remove excess moisture ) | 3 poblano peppers, roasted, chopped | 2 tablespoons rice wine or 2 tablespoons dry sherry
instructions: Heat grill. Line the rack with foil and heat on grill to medium. Transfer the arugula to a large serving plater and toss with the roasted chilies. Drizzle the chilies with a little sherry. Serve. Note, you can substitute 2 tbsp of the chile oil for the sherry.

Random Ingredients: cornstarch,double cream,ginger,cooking spray,filling,graham cracker crumb,fiddlehead,green chile
title: Fiddlehead Fritters
ingredients: mildly fiddleheads | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1/2 cup double cream ( or half and half ) | 1/4 cup chopped green chiles | 2 tablespoons grated fresh ginger | 1 teaspoon cornstarch | 1 lb fiddleheads ( about 1/2 inch diameter or small baby fritters ) | cooking spray | 2 cups graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f degrees and spray a baking sheet with cooking spray. Set fiddleheads aside. In a large bowl, thoroughly blend the cornstarch, cream, chiles, ginger and fiddleheads together with a wire whisk. If mixture is too thick, add milk or water. Stir in crumbs until desired consistency is achieved. Spoon out into a piping hot oiled 9x13 pan and bake until golden brown, about 25 minutes. Do not brown fiddleheads. Remove to a bowl with a slotted spoon and place back on the baking sheet covered with wax paper to absorb excess fat. Let cool slightly.

Random Ingredients: pasta,garlic clove,pandan leaf,chipotle chile adobo,amarula cream liqueur,pineapple juice,cream,plum tomato
title: Nuoc Cham
ingredients: 1/2 cup fresh pineapple juice | 1/2 cup amarula cream liqueur | pimento stuffed olive ( optional ) | 1/2 cup cannola cream ( optional ) | 4 plum tomatoes, seeded and chopped | 1/4 cup shaved pineapples or 1/4 cup fresh lemon rind, grated | 2 fresh garlic cloves, minced | 1 tablespoon pureed chipotle chile in adobo | 1 lb short pasta, cooked
instructions: In a food processor, combine pineapple juice, amarula and cream. Whirl until smooth. Add tomatoes, pineapples, garlic, chile, noodles, and chipotle. Whirl to blend. Taste and adjust seasoning. Serve in shallow serving bowls.

Random Ingredients: veggie crumbles,cream chicken soup,ice,black bean,gruyere cheese
title: Black Bean Gratin
ingredients: 1 package veggie crumbles | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup shredded gruyere cheese | 1 can black beans, drained | 5 1/4 cups crushed ice
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. In a 9x13 inch pan, mix the crumbles, cream of chicken soup, gruyere cheese, and black beans. Pour into the pan, and spread out to the edges. Bake in the preheated oven about 50 minutes, until bubbly and lightly browned.

title: Macaroni Snack Mix
ingredients: 100 g macaroni | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1/2 teaspoon sunflower seeds | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder
instructions: Cook macaroni to the package directions. Meanwhile, mix together all the ingredients well with no water and serve with crackers.

Random Ingredients: mussel,shell pasta,pepper,self rising flour,beef stew meat,sirloin
title: Steak and Stout Bangers
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless sirloin, cut in 1/2 inch cubes | 3 1/2 ounces self-rising flour | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1/2 teaspoon pepper | 1/2 lb fresh shrimps or 1/2 lb boneless tenderloin, cut in 1 pieces | 1/2 lb fresh mussels, cleaned
instructions: In large bowl, combine meat, 1 1/2 cups flour and pepper.

title: Garbanzo Chickpea Curry
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas, drained | 1 tablespoon honey | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1 -2 tablespoon gingerroot, minced | 1/4 english onion, chopped | 2 teaspoons honey | 1 1/2 slices whole wheat bread, torn into pieces | 1 can sliced dried apricots, drained
instructions: Combine chickpeas, 1 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp cornstarch, curry powder, 1 tsp ginger, and chopped onion in processor. Process until mixture is chunky and about the consistency of mayonnaise. Place bread pieces in lightly greased 13 x 9 inch baking pan.

title: Zucchini Chips
ingredients: 3 zucchini | 1/2 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom | 1/8 teaspoon allspice
instructions: Wash zucchini and scrub with fork. Cut in half lengthwise.. Slice diagonally into 1/2 inch pieces. Put zucchini chips on a plate and sprinkle with mustard, cardamom, allspice and salt. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: margarine,lemon lime beverage,dark molasses,harissa,tomato paste,anchovy paste
title: Anchovy-Lemon Spread
ingredients: 2 cans tomato paste | 1 can margarine | 1/2 cup dark molasses | 2/3 cup bottled lemon-lime beverage | 1 1/2 tablespoons harissa | 1 1/2 tablespoons anchovy paste or 1 1/2 tablespoons curry paste
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Store refrigerated in a tightly container. Refrigerate any unused portions for up to two weeks.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,chicken,pineapple juice,allspice,orange marmalade,cream cheese,baking soda
title: Quick and Easy Chicken Bites
ingredients: 4 cups skinless chicken pieces ( may replace chicken breast ) | 1 cup low-fat cream cheese | 4 tablespoons orange marmalade | 1/2 cup low-fat sour cream | 1/4 cup pineapple juice | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1/4 teaspoon allspice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a cookie sheet with foil. Toss chicken pieces with orange marmalade, sour cream, pineapple juice, baking soda, and allspice in a large mixing bowl. Pour the mixture onto the chicken pieces and bake in the oven for 45 - 60 minutes or until golden brown and cooked through. Serve with maple syrup or honey.

Random Ingredients: eggplant,graham cracker crumb,extra beef,apple cider vinegar,sea salt black pepper
title: Apple Chipotle Meatball
ingredients: 1 eggplant, halved lengthwise and seeded | sea salt and ground black pepper to taste | 6 ounces extra-lean ground beef | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs | 2 teaspoons apple cider vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Place eggplant cut side down on a baking sheet and season with sea salt and black pepper. Bake in the preheated oven until softened and slightly browned, about 20 minutes. Remove to a bowl and set aside. In a skillet, brown the ground beef over medium high heat until browned and crumbly. Stir in the eggplant, scraping any browned bits and leftover fat. Remove from heat. Stir the cheese, cracker crumbs, and vinegar into the meat. Using wet hands, form the meat mixture into balls about 2/3 inch in diameter. Transfer the cheese balls to a baking sheet, and bake for 10 minutes in the preheated oven, until lightly browned and cooked through. Serve with hoisin sauce for dipping.

title:
Baked Scallops.
    -
ingredients: 6 scallops, cleaned and chilled | 6 tablespoons mayonnaise | 3 tablespoons chicken bouillon granules
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Line a cookie sheet with foil. Put the scallops in a large bowl and add the mayonnaise. Combine the chicken bouillon and bouillon and stir into the mayonnaise and stir gently. Pour the mixture over the scallops and let stand 10 - 15 minutes, until the liquid has a nice, velvety texture and the scallops have a nice crisp coating on them. Place scallops on the cookie sheet and bake until the tops are slightly dry..

Random Ingredients: white mushroom,nonstick cooking spray,coriander,stew meat,chunky salsa,maraschino cherry,italian parsley
title: Ww 5 Points - Beef or Turkey Sausage
ingredients: 1 lb stew meat, cut into 1 inch pieces | 3 tablespoons chunky salsa ( medium or hot, to your taste ) | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh coriander | 1/2 teaspoon ground coriander | 1 bag fresh white mushrooms, sliced | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh italian parsley | nonstick cooking spray | fresh maraschino cherry, for serving
instructions: Coat a large nonstick skillet with nonstick cooking spray.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,green olive,cannellini bean,rigatoni pasta,pumpkin puree,spanish onion
title: Tuscan Beans and Rice
ingredients: 3/4 cup canned cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 spanish onion, chopped | 1 can pumpkin puree | 1 box rigatoni pasta, cooked & drained | 1/4 cup stuffed green olive, sliced | 1/4 cup long-grain white rice, cooked
instructions: Place beans, onion and pumpkin in a food processor. Puree to a smooth paste. Add pasta, olives and rice. Process til just mixed. Cook and stir over medium heat until heated through.

title: Barbecued Whole Leg of Lamb
ingredients: 1/4 cup cashews, roasted | 1/4 cup daikon radish, grated | 1 - 1 1/2 cup white onion, sliced thinly | 2 teaspoons roasted peanuts, chopped ( optional ) | 4 1/2 lbs leg of lamb | 1 teaspoon roasted peanut oil, mixed with the water, for coating
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f in a shallow fry pan, mix the cashews, daikon radish, onion and peanuts. Season the lamb with the spice and put it in a baking dish. Pour the peanut oil mixture onto the lamb. Bake for 2 hours or until a meat thermometer registers 160°f. Let stand for 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pork tenderloin,ra el hanout spice mix,chocolate sauce,coriander,watermelon
title: Grilled Fruit with Raisin and Spice
ingredients: 1/2 cup coarsely chopped fresh coriander | 1 cup coarsely chopped watermelon | 1/4 cup unsweetened chocolate sauce | 5 lbs pork tenderloin, cut into 3 inch segments | 2 tablespoons ras el hanout spice mix
instructions: For the marinade, combine coriander, watermelon and chocolate sauce in a 1 to 1 1/2 quart heavy duty plastic food storage plastic bag. Add pork and top with resealable plastic wrap. Turn bag to coat pork with marinade.

title: Tarragon Frappe
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 2 teaspoons mustard | 1 tablespoon greek oregano | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1/4 cup strong coffee, chilled
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together 1/2 of the soup's ingredients, and the coffee. Gently stir into remaining soup ingredients. Heat over medium heat until hot and bubbly, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: white sugar,celery rib,chocolate chip,pizza crust,water chestnut,yogurt,heavy cream,salt pork
title: Famous PA Dutch Chocolate Chip Pizza
ingredients: 1 package pizza crust, prepared | 1 package sliced smoked salt pork | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained and chopped | 1/4 cup white sugar | 1 cup plain fat-free yogurt | 1 tablespoon low-fat plain yogurt | 1 tablespoon sweetened condensed milk | 1 tablespoon heavy cream | 1 teaspoon white sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Place pizza crust onto a baking sheet. Mix salt pork, water chestnuts, and 1/4 cup sugar in a skillet on medium heat until boiling. Reduce heat to low and simmer until pork is no longer pink, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside to cool. In a bowl, mix the 1 cup plain yogurt, 1 tablespoon sweetened condensed milk, heavy cream, and sugar. Spread the onion sausage mixture over the prepared bread crust. Spread the cooled pork mixture evenly over the sausage mixture. Bake pizza in the preheated oven until the edges are golden brown, about 20 minutes.

title: Roasted Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 1 lb brussels sprout, trimmed | 3 tablespoons dry sherry
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Arrange the brussels sprouts in a roasting pan. Sprinkle with salt. Roast in the middle of the oven for about 15 minutes, or until almost tender. Remove from the oven, and set aside to cool to room temperature. Place in a small, heavy baking dish, and drizzle with the sherry. Bake for about 10 minutes, until the brussels sprouts are heated through and the sherry is bubbly.

title: Dried Apricots
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups dried apricots, soaked in plenty of water at least 30 minutes | 2 -3 cups sugar ( i like the caramelized kind )
instructions: Drain the apricots, reserving the soaking water. Rinse the apricots under running water until the water runs clear. Place in a non reactive pan. Mix the sugar and enough of the reserved soaking water so that the sugar is fully dissolved. Pour the mixture over the apricots, cover tightly, and cook over low heat, stirring occasionally, for 20 – 25 minutes. Uncover, turn off the heat. Cover tightly and set aside in an airtight container at room temperature for six hours. Stored in a cool, dark place, the apricots are ready to serve. To serve, bring about 2 1/4 cups of the reserved soaking water to a boil. Turn heat to very low, cover, and cook for 20 minutes. Remove jar from heat and let sit for 5 minutes. Pour off all but 1 1/2 cup of the liquid. Cool to room temperature. Stir, strain through a cheesecloth, and serve either warm or chilled.

title: Couscous with Fresh Salsa Verde and Mussels
ingredients: 2 cups couscous | 1 cup mild salsa verde | 1 tablespoon dried dill | 1 package ranch seasoning mix, divided | 2 lbs mussels, scrubbed and debearded
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the couscous with the salsa verde and dried dill. Stir in half the packet of ranch seasoning mix with the mussels, cover and refrigerate overnight, or up to 8 hours. Bring to room temperature before serving.

title: Rosemary, Smoked Chicken & Zucchini
ingredients: cooking spray | 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 2 medium zucchini, peeled, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 2 teaspoons dried rosemary sprigs | 2 tablespoons low sodium tea
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Spray a large nonstick skillet with oil and set over high heat. Add chicken.

title: Amar- Helen's Excellent Indian Cornflour
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cornflour | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 small green chilies, washed, ends trimmed and thinly sliced lengthwise | 1 tablespoon roasted coriander seed ( shahi jeera ) | 1 tablespoon roasted coriander seeds
instructions: Mix cornflour with 3 tbsp water in a bowl. Keep aside. Heat oil in a wok. Once its hot, toss in the asafetida. Once it stops spluttering, toss in asafoetida and green chillies. Stir fry for 7 minutes. Stir in the roasted corriander and roasted coriander seeds. Mix well. Add 2 - 3 tbsp water, mix well and remove from the heat. Serve, garnished with finely chopped corriander leaves.

title: French Bouillabaisse
ingredients: 1 pound stewing beef, cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes | 1 teaspoon confectioners'sugar | 1 thyme sprig
instructions: Combine the beef cubes, confectioners' sugar, and thyme sprig in a large pot. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium low. Simmer uncovered, stirring occasionally until potatoes are tender, about 1 hour. Cook time will vary depending on the meat used. Serve over mashed potatoes or noodles.

Random Ingredients: ice cube,extra virgin olive oil,dill weed,raspberry,horseradish,snow pea pod,pork shoulder
title: Chef John's Pork and Snow Pea Pies
ingredients: 2/3 cup extra virgin olive oil | 4 pounds boneless pork shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes and threaded onto the length of the rinds | 1 cup frozen snow pea pods, thawed | 1 1/2 teaspoons horseradish | ice cube | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh dill weed | 5 cups grated washington state cheese with raspberries
instructions: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium high heat. Stir in the pork, reduce heat to medium, and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Mix in the frozen peas, horseradish, and ice cubes. Return to a simmer and cook until pork is easily pulled from the bone, 4 to 6 minutes. Mix in the dill weed, stir and serve.

Random Ingredients: rosemary leaf,cottage cheese,summer squash,savory,farfalle pasta,lime wedge,swiss cheese,cinnamon
title: Cheese and Savory Pasta Bake with Winter Squash
ingredients: 1 lb farfalle pasta ( bowtie pasta ) | 2 cups low fat cottage cheese or 2 cups cream cheese | 1/4 cup grated swiss cheese ( can use other cheeses ) | 1/2 cup lime wedge ( optional ) | 1 1/4 lbs summer squash, peeled and sliced | 5 tablespoons minced fresh savory | 1 1/4 teaspoons ground cinnamon | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary leaves
instructions: In large pot of salted boiling water bring to a boil, add farfalle and cook according to package directions until just tender. Drain and set to the side. Preheat oven to 400 degrees farenheit. In a medium bowl, mix together cottage cheese, swiss cheese, lime wedges, cinnamon and rosemary using an electric mixer or a whisk. Put a 9x13 inch baking dish in the oven.

title: Quick and Easy Fritters (Peppered Vegetables)
ingredients: 500 g pickle relish | 1 cup egg substitute | 1 cup cornflour | 1 cup peanut oil | 2 cups kalamata olives, finely chopped
instructions: Stir together the relish, and egg substitute until combined and the mixture starts to look frothy. Add the cornflour and stir until the mixture thickens, then transfer to a plate. Heat a wok until very hot. Add oil and swirl until just smoking. Transfer half of the fritter mixture to a medium bowl, then add the olives and mix well. Add the remaining fritter mixture, cover and continue to cook over low heat, stirring occasionally. Continue to fry over medium heat with oil shaking the wok, for 2 minutes. Drain, garnish with the remaining olives and serve.

Random Ingredients: single cream,pecorino romano cheese,sage leaf,sun tomato,shallot
title: Sun-Dried Tomato Pesto
ingredients: 500 g pecorino romano cheese | 1 bunch fresh sage leaf, leaves roughly chopped | 450 g fresh sun-dried tomatoes | 85 g shallots | 400 ml single cream
instructions: Start by chopping the sun dried tomatoes into chunks and soaking them in warm water for about 20 minutes. Once the tomatoes have soaked, drain the water and chop the tomatoes into chunks. You want all of the dry ingredients to be slightly softened and have some liquid remaining. Dry the shallots and sun dried tomatoes with kitchen paper, or an absorbent paper or sieve and line a strainer with a layer of newspaper to catch any excess water. Put the pine kernels into a bowl and pour in about 1/4 of the single cream, or approximately 3/4 of a cup of the canned tomato base. Set aside. Add the chopped sage and fresh sage leaves to the rest of the cream and add 1/4 of the cheese and about 1/2 teaspoon of salt. Mix all together, or add a little more cream and cream to loosen if necessary. You should have a nice, creamy texture when done, pour into a serving bowl and gently toss around the sides. Serve with your favourite pasta. If you don’t have a strainer or pestle, you may use a sieve to strain out excess moisture from the sun dried tomatoes and sun dried tomatoes, though they might not sit up like that. Also, if using a strainer, drain all of the excess sun dried tomato juice from the jar if desired, making sure to shake or whisk to ensure even distribution of the juices and herbs. When serving, give it a final mix and scatter with the remaining grated cheese.

Random Ingredients: belgian endive,green tomato,granny smith apple,red wine,cayenne,sauce,red chili powder
title: Brunch Sauces & Granny Smith Apples
ingredients: 10 belgian endive, peeled and cut crosswise into 1 1/2 inch slices | 4 large granny smith apples | 1/4 cup hp steak sauce | 1/2 cup dry red wine | 1/2 cup hot sauce ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon red chili powder | 1/8 teaspoon ground cayenne
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 f. Arrange endive slices in baking dishes. Place apples evenly over brussels, then sprinkle with steak sauce and next 6 ingredients. Bake covered for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Lobster Tails
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 1 lemon grass, sliced thickly | 1/2 teaspoon crushed dried dill | 1 pound lobster tails, cut into halves | 1/8 teaspoon ground sumac
instructions: Preheat an oven to 300 degrees f. Heat the sunflower oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Stir in the lemon grass and dill, and cook about 10 minutes. Bring lobster tails lengthwise in the skillet, leaving the tails attached. Place tails in the skillet. Sprinkle with sumac. Cook and stir, until lobster is hot and crumbly, 5 to 10 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Napa Dave's Fingerling Potatoes
ingredients: 2 pounds fingerling potatoes | 2 large ripe avocados - peeled, pitted, and cubed | 1 package prosciutto | 2 packages fresh raspberry-flavored frozen raspberries, thawed | 1 bunch fresh thai basil, chopped
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add fingerling potatoes and cook for approximately 20 minutes. Drain, and set aside to cool slightly. Peel potatoes, and place into a bowl. Mash together the avocados and prosciutto. Set aside until ready to use. Once cooled, transfer to a bowl. Slice fingerling potatoes, and chop into chunks. Add potato chunks, prosciutto, and raspberries to the bowl. Add basil, and stir gently. Serve at room temperature.

title: spaghetti and Chips
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti | 2 1/2 cups ice water | 1/2 cup catsup ( optional ) | 1 bouquet garni, spice
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling water for approximately 5 - 7 minutes. Drain and place back into pot. Add catsup and bouquet garni and heat thoroughly. Pour into a warmed casserole dish, sprinkle with freshly ground black pepper and serve. The temperature of your microwave may be needed to dry out the spices.

title: Easy Blue Cheese Phyllo Triangles (Cookies)
ingredients: 1 lb blue cheese, crumbled ( i use the kind with pungent cheese ) | 1 package frozen phyllo dough
instructions: Thaw and cut phyllo sheets in half. Remove the thawed phyllo sheets from the refrigerator and defrost them under cold water. The sheets can be layered between sheets of waxed paper and sprinkled with additional plastic wrap. Dip each sheet in melted blue cheese then roll in the phyllo. Chill or remove the sheets from the refrigerator after dipping. To freeze, place the sheet in the freezer for about an hour or longer. If you want to freeze this for future use only as above.

Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,red wine vinegar,oil,chipotle chile adobo,green bean,radish
title: Ethiopian Green Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 lb fresh green beans, cut into 1-inch pieces ( or frozen if using frozen ) | 1 small chipotle chile in adobo, seeded and minced | 3 tablespoons red wine vinegar | one 1-inch cube oil | 4 large radishes, cut diagonally into 1-inch slices | 2 pods cardamom pods
instructions: Cook and drain green beans, let cool at room temperature for 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: beef broth,vegetable stock,pork shoulder,tarragon,vegetable oil cooking spray,horseradish,bamboo shoot
title: Roasted Pork
ingredients: 4 lbs pork shoulder, boneless | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/2 cup canned bamboo shoot, sliced | 1/4 cup prepared horseradish | 2 teaspoons dried tarragon | 1/2 cup low sodium beef broth | 3 tablespoons low sodium beef broth | 1 tablespoon prepared horseradish
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place pork in a roasting pan coated with cooking spray. Roast on top rack of oven for 30 minutes. Turn pork and roast for 20 minutes more. Remove pork from oven and cover loosely with foil. Let sit 15 minutes. Remove fat in roasting pan. Pour off fat from roasting pan. Turn oven temperature down to 130 degrees f. Remove fat from pan and place in a glass or plastic bowl. Set aside. In a bowl, combine 2 tablespoons of the horseradish, the tarragon and 3 tablespoons of the beef broth. Whisk to blend well, then pour over meat, tossing to coat. Cover with foil and set aside at room temperature for 30 minutes. Meanwhile, remove pan from oven. Place pan on middle rack and bake for 1 hour. Remove meat from pan and let sit 10 minutes, then transfer to a platter and tent with foil. Discard fat from the pan. Set aside. When roast is done remove from oven. Slice and serve with horseradish sauce.

title: Mexican Corn With Lychees
ingredients: 1 tablespoon brown mustard seeds | 1 tablespoon mexican-style corn | 1/2 cup chopped fresh lychee | 1/2 small orange, chopped | 1 1/2 cups cooked tapioca
instructions: Place the mustard seed in the dry skillet over medium heat. Cook, stirring, for about 1 minute, until mustard seeds begin to pop. Stir in the corn, lychee, orange, and rice vinegar. Reduce heat to medium low, cover, and cook for 20 minutes, stirring once. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: iceberg lettuce,red bell pepper,prosciutto,tamarind juice,mexican cheese,lemon peel,sesame seed
title: Churrascos (Caribbean Quesadillas)
ingredients: 1/2 lb thinly sliced prosciutto | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds, toasted | 1 red bell pepper, seeded and cut into thin strips | 1 tablespoon freshly grated lemon peel | 1/2 cup tamarind juice | 1/4 head iceberg lettuce, shredded | 1/4 cup shredded mexican blend cheese
instructions: Toast sesame seeds in a dry, ungreased nonstick skillet until browned, 2 - 3 minutes. Cool on a towel. Brush strips with a little oil and sprinkle with sesame seeds, bell pepper strips, and lemon peel. Combine the tamarind juice with some of the water in a glass measuring cup and use the back of a spoon to measure the liquid. Add just enough water to make a 2/3 cup. Add about 1/4 cup liquid and tamarind juice mixture to the salad. Add lettuce and cheese and toss to coat. Spread the mixture out on baking sheets and bake at 400 degrees f. For 4 - 5 minutes until crisp and beginning to brown. Allow to cool and store in a covered container at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke,golden syrup,bok choy,blue cheese,lemon peel,rice,cream mushroom soup,lemon zest
title: Wild Blue Cheese Casserole
ingredients: 3 cups cooked rice ( i like long grain or short grain but any will do ) | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 3 tablespoons golden syrup | 1 teaspoon grated lemon zest | 3 tablespoons lemon juice | 2 tablespoons melted blue cheese ( can use more if you prefer ) | 1 large bunch bok choy, chopped into bite size pieces | liquid smoke ( optional )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Mix all ingredients in a large casserole dish and bake in oven for approximately 30 minutes, or until top of casserole is crusty.

title: Walnut Crusted Rice Krispies Treats
ingredients: 1/2 lb asparagus tips | 1 1/2 cups korean dried seaweed ( not powder ) | 4 cups crispy rice krispies | 1/3 cup chopped walnuts
instructions: If using a 9x10 inch baking pan, cut two inch strips of korean korean noodles to make two squares each. Place beef tips and korean dried seaweed in a bowl, cover and let sit for 20 minutes. Drain the tips and seaweed. Place rice krispies in a microwavable bowl with just enough water to cover them.

Random Ingredients: coriander seed,saffron,self raising flour,chili oil,allspice,corn syrup,green chili pepper
title: Green Chile Pepper & Chilli Scones
ingredients: 2 lbs self-raising flour | 1 large green chili pepper, finely sliced | 1 tablespoon coriander seed | 1 teaspoon crushed saffron | 1 teaspoon allspice | 1 tablespoon corn syrup | 1 tablespoon chili oil
instructions: Heat a small non stick frying pan. Toss the chilli with the coriander, saffron, allspice and corn syrup. Roll out 2 1/4 to 3/4 inch thick, cut out scones and place on a lightly greased baking tray. Brush with a little oil and bake 40 to 45 minutes at 220°c / 220°c fan forced / gas mark 3 - 5 or until golden brown. Serve hot with jam.

title: Quick and Easy Vegetarian Paprika-Ponforate Chicken
ingredients: 1/4 cup breadcrumbs | 1/2 teaspoon sweet hungarian paprika | 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 2 tablespoons vegetable, chopped | 4 slices ripe fresh vegetables ( such as corn, mushrooms, spinach, mushrooms or zucchini ) | 1 egg, beaten | 2 tablespoons pizza sauce
instructions: Combine bread crumbs and paprika. Dip chicken into egg, then spread with crumbs using 2 tbs. Vegetable oil. In an 11 x 7 baking dish arrange chicken pieces, cut side up. Bake 30 - 45 minutes at 350 f or until juices run clear and chicken is no longer pink. Serve on a bed of fresh vegetables, with side of warmed spaghetti.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,baking powder,lamb shoulder,taco seasoning,oregano leaf,ginger paste,milk
title: Crock Pot Carnitas
ingredients: 4 lbs boneless lamb shoulder | 1 1/2 tablespoons ginger paste | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/4 cup milk | 1 teaspoon ground oregano leaves | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning | 1 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: Cut lamb in half. Remove as much fat as possible from the meat and discard. Cut meat into large chunks and dump into crock pot. In separate bowl, combine soup, milk, seasonings and baking powder. Pour over lamb and stir to combine. Cover and cook on low heat for about 7 to 8 hours. Serve with corn tortillas or serve on buns.

title: Pimientos and Steak Tip Sandwich Filling
ingredients: 2 tablespoons pimiento, drained | 1/2 cup frozen whipped topping, thawed | 2 sirloin tips
instructions: Blend the pimiento, thawed whipped topping, and the sirloin tips in a food processor until a smooth paste forms.

Random Ingredients: bay leaf,madras curry powder,tomato puree,lemon peel,pace picante sauce
title: Madras Curry Recipe
ingredients: 8 tablespoons madras curry powder | 1 1/2 cups tomato puree | 7 -8 bay leaves | 4 tablespoons lemon peel | 1/4 cup pace picante sauce ( mexican tomato sauce )
instructions: Saute the bay leaves and lemon peel. Place all ingredients including the madras curry powder in a blender. Mix well. Pour mixture over the green chili pepper in the blender. Blend all ingredients well. Chill to blend flavors. Serve over rice. Makes about 60 curry.

Random Ingredients: oregano leaf,blue curacao,yellow pepper,turnip,hash brown,pork roast,vanilla bean,sea salt pepper
title: Pork and Potatoes With Yellow Bell Peppers
ingredients: 1/2 lb lean boneless pork roast, cut in 1/2-inch cubes | 1 tablespoon sea salt and pepper | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves, crushed | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla bean, split lengthwise | 1 cup cut red potatoes, into 1/4 in slices | 1 large yellow sweet pepper, cut into 1/4 in slices | 1/2 cup finely chopped pared turnip | 2 tablespoons blue curacao
instructions: Sprinkle meat with salt, pepper, oregano, and bay leaf then add potato slices and orange peppers. Heat oil over medium heat, add pork, and brown slowly. Stir in curacao, cover, lower the heat, and cook until vegetables are cooked, about 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Thai Broccoli
ingredients: 1 lb frozen broccoli floret | 1/2 bell mixed pepper, chopped ( red, green, or yellow ) | 1/2 small dried red chili pepper, crushed
instructions: Cook broccoli in boiling water for 5 minutes, stirring to prevent sticking.

title: Tenderloin With Emulsion
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin steaks, trimmed | 2 romaine lettuce leaves | 1/2 head escarole, washed and separated into leaves | 1/2 lb deli sliced deli veal, sliced | 1/4 cup low-fat shredded mexican cheese blend
instructions: Prepare your favorite steak cooking. Brush with a good amount of the nonfat green olive oil and lightly sear. Set aside and tent with lettuce leaves. Prepare the remining meal of dinner by layering all ingredients in the order given except meat and cheese.

title: Asian Yaikon Radish & Snow
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs clean snow, trimmed | 1 cup daikon radish, cut into 1 cm strips ( about 3 medium radishes ) | oyster sauce ( optional )
instructions: Fill a large pot about halfway full with water. Scratch any bits of snow and scrub them with your fingers, being sure to rinse them gently. Cook the snow in boiling water for 1 - 2 minutes, until they are crisp and tender.

title: Skewered Japanese Salmon With Pumpkin Seeds
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs salmon fillets, skinned, scaled and butterflied with skin | 1/2 cup pumpkin seeds | 2 tablespoons wasabi | 1/4 cup mint leaf, coarsely chopped | fat-free soy milk ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the grill. Line the skewers with aluminum foil, sprayed with non stick cooking spray and lightly oil them. Thread the salmon onto the skewers. Spray with oil. Grill until flake easily, about 7 minutes per inch of thickness. In a small bowl, mix the pumpkin seeds, wasabi and mint. Spread on the smoked salmon. Serve with soy milk.

title: Easy Peanut Butter Guacamole
ingredients: 1 pear, peeled and grated | 1/8 teaspoon garam masala powder | 1 teaspoon guacamole
instructions: Place the grated pear in a bowl. In a small bowl, combine the grated pear, garam masala, and guacamole. Use a fork to stir all the ingredients together in the bowl.

title: Pickled Red Chilies
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried red chili, crushed ( can sub 1/4-1/3 cup green chili ) | 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper flakes
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and put in sterile jars. To jar before using, seal and cap. Shake well and leave in a dark place for at least 1 week before using.

title: Salsa Cruda With Peppers
ingredients: 3 lbs ground chuck | 1 lb frozen lima beans | 1 orange, juice of | 1 cup frozen sliced strawberries | 1/2 cup sliced green pepper | 2 tablespoons chopped onions | 1 jar of roasted red peppers, drained and chopped
instructions: Brown the meat, drain. Add all other ingredients to meat. Simmer for 15 minutes. Serve with warm tortillas and guacamole. Note, freeze in rigid freezer bags.

Random Ingredients: spinach leaf,orange zest,fruit,yellow tomato,wine,golden syrup,soya sauce
title: Spinach and Sun-dried Tomato Salad (A Memory of my Dad's Recipe)
ingredients: 250 g yellow tomatoes, sliced or 250 g pears, chopped | 100 g spinach leaves, washed, drained and chopped | 1/4 cup red wine | 2 tablespoons soya sauce | 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 2 teaspoons orange zest, grated | 1/2 teaspoon dried fruit, diced
instructions: Place the tomatoes and spinach in a bowl and toss it in the golden syrup and orange zest to mix well. Toss in the dried fruit. Serve warm and enjoy.

title: Low-Fat Tiny Tomato Sauce (For Pasta & Meatball)
ingredients: 1 can diced tomatoes with puree | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules or 1/4 teaspoon salt, to taste | 1/2 teaspoon lemon pepper
instructions: Combine the diced tomatoes, chicken bouillon or salt and lemon pepper in a large skillet or dutch oven. Simmer about 20 minutes. Serve over your favorite pasta and enjoy.

title: Kiwi Filling
ingredients: 2 kiwi fruits, peeled, chopped ( about 10 to 15 cups total ) | 2 tablespoons pine nuts, toasted | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seed, crushed
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and store in a covered jar in a cool, dark place until needed.

Random Ingredients: milk ricotta cheese,chicken broth,coconut milk,pistachio,fine breadcrumb,cooking oil
title: Indian Ricotta Soup With Pistachios
ingredients: 1 cup whole milk ricotta cheese ( i had purchased low fat ) | 1 cup skim milk or 1 cup reduced fat milk | 1 3/4 cups low sodium chicken broth | 1/2 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 1/2 cup toasted sliced pistachios, packed in oil | 1 tablespoon cooking oil
instructions: In large bowl, stir together ricotta, milk, broth and bread crumbs. Set aside 1 cup crumbs for garnish. In nonstick skillet, heat 1 tablespoon oil over medium heat. Add pistachios and saute until lightly browned, 3 to 5 minutes. Transfer to bowl with crumbs. Drain on paper towels. In the same skillet, using a small amount of oil, add remaining oil and pistachios. Cook until hot and lightly toasted, about 1 to 2 minutes. Sprinkle tops with reserved crumbs, stir and serve.

title: Ancho Chile & Barley
ingredients: 2 ancho chiles, stems and seeds discarded | 1 1/2 poblano chiles, stems and seeds discarded | 1 1/2 cups pearl barley
instructions: Place the ancho chiles and poblano chiles in a dry skillet over medium heat. Cook, turning occasionally, until the chiles are fragrant and beginning to pop, about 10 minutes. Place the barley in the slow cooker. Pour in the chile mixture. Cover.

title: Gurkensalat (Escarole Pastries)
ingredients: 1 large head escarole, chopped | 3 tablespoons plain yogurt | 12 -16 bamboo skewers, soaked in water for at least 2 hours | 1 can borlotti beans, drained | cinnamon | asiago cheese, freshly grated ( optional )
instructions: Grill borlotti stalks until soft and lightly marked. Squeeze out excess water.

title: Tender Italian Seasoning
ingredients: 2 teaspoons garlic paste | 1/3 cup capers | 1 teaspoon dried italian herb seasoning
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the garlic paste, capers and italian herb seasoning. Store in an air tight container.

title: Chile Spaghetti
ingredients: spaghetti | 1 quart boiling water | 1 cup freshly brewed coffee, room temperature | lime wedge | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon zest | 2 chile peppers, seeded and sliced into rings, or as desired | 1 cup chopped fresh parsley sprigs
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook spaghetti in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 11 minutes. Drain.

title: Chicken Taters
ingredients: 4 chicken breasts | 4 chicken thighs
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Rinse chicken and pat dry. Score the skin into strips about 2 inches wide and 1/4 inch thick. Place strips in a 13 x 9 inch pan or large baking dish large enough to accommodate the chicken. Cover with aluminum foil and bake for 1 hour. Turn the oven off and transfer the chicken breasts and thighs to a warm platter. Cover loosely with foil and let sit for about 30 minutes. Remove foil. Invert the chicken breasts and thighs onto the foil. Return the pan or baking dish to a oven for the last 20 minutes. Note, if you have extra time, transfer the pan to an oven that has been heated to 375 degrees f. Bake for 60 to 75 minutes, or until chicken is no longer pink and juices run clear.

Random Ingredients: green chili pepper,italian parsley,purpose flour,fennel seed,vinegar,red chile
title: Hot Fennel Seeds
ingredients: 4 cups all-purpose flour | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red chile | 1 medium green chili pepper, seeded and chopped | vinegar, 2-3 tablespoons | 1/4 cup finely chopped italian parsley
instructions: Pour water into pan. Add all dry ingredients. Stir until dough begins to form. Turn onto a lightly floured surface. Knead until smooth. Roll out 1 tbls. Of dough to 1/2 thickness and cut into strips about 2 inches long. Prick each strip lightly with a fork. Drop strips 1/2 apart onto lightly greased cooking sheet. Cover with a damp towel. Refrigerate at least 30 minutes. Meanwhile, combine vinegar with parsley. Pour over strips.

title: Bratwurst or Brat Wurst
ingredients:
1 lb bratwurst, sliced thin or 1 lb bulk sausage 
    - 1 bagels, split
instructions: Slice bratwurst into 1 slices. Place in a baking dish with bratwurst and turn to evenly coat.

Random Ingredients: cumin seed,pistachio,thyme,raspberry vinegar,french bread,yeast,beef bouillon cube
title: Egyptian Style Pistachio Bread (Kurdish Style)
ingredients: 1 kg french bread | 2 kg ground beef, lean | 200 g pistachios | 3 g salt | 1200 ml raspberry vinegar | 1200 ml beef bouillon cubes, powdered | 2 tablespoons cumin seeds, ground | 1 teaspoon dried thyme
instructions: Mix all the ingredients in a big bowl. Cover and leave aside in a cool place for 2 hours. Heat up a cast iron pan on the stove. Take a dough and stretch out to 5 cm diameter. Make sure you have enough space for it to expand, to let spread out the dough evenly. Take the dough out of the pan and lightly knead it on a floured board with the palms of your hands. Make sure that you don’t tear off any pieces of the dough. Cover the dough with a cloth and leave it to knead for 10 more minutes. Put it in a clean dish and leave it to rise for 2 hours or longer. Turn the oven on and place the bread on it pre heated on the gas burner or stove burner. If not using the gas burner start the oven to 180 degrees celsius. If using stove burner, put the pan in the oven for 5 minutes before the bread comes out, or bake the bread in the oven for 1 hour.. Take out of the oven. Cut in two slices if liked, or leave them covered in a cloth for 15 minutes and then cut in quarters or more before eating.

Random Ingredients: garbanzo bean,ham,peanut butter,green bell pepper,ice cube,yogurt,peanut oil
title: African Red Beans and Peppers
ingredients: 4 lbs dried garbanzo beans, soaked overnight | 1 green bell pepper, peeled, seeded and chopped | 8 ounces frozen cut up ham | 6 tablespoons peanut oil | 2 tablespoons peanut butter | 1/2 pint yogurt | 1 cup ice cube
instructions: Soak 6 - 3 oz. Garbanzo beans over night, drain and refill pot after it's been soaking. Drain the beans and put in food processor. Add 1 lb. Fresh peas. Puree the peas. Put peanut butter in a separate bowl and beat until foamy. Then add one cup of the strained garbanzo beans through creamier. Add to the peanut butter mixture. Add 3 cups and stir inches. Put lid on pot and let simmer for about 1 hour to 1 1/2 hours. Serve over rice.

Random Ingredients: chili bean,cilantro,chunky peanut butter,italian salad dressing mix,spring onion,garlic,corn tortilla chip
title: Thai Chili Bean-peanut Dip
ingredients: 2 cans chili beans, drained | 1 package dry italian-style salad dressing mix | 2/3 cup chunky peanut butter | 1 bunch fresh cilantro, roughly chopped | 1 bunch spring onion, trimmed and roughly chopped | 1 clove garlic, minced | 1 box corn tortilla chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a large bowl combine the chili beans, italian dressing mix and peanut butter. Mix well. Stir in the cilantro, spring onions, garlic and corn chips. Transfer to a 9 inch springform pan. Bake for 40 minutes, or until heated through. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Lebanese Chips
ingredients: 20 ounces corn tortilla chips | 1 1/3 cups honey ( i usually use 2 but this will be ok )
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to boil. Add the chips and when they float stir them for 3 - 4 seconds. Drain on paper towels. Add the honey to the chips and stir well. Spread onto a large, flat platter or on toasted bread. Refrigerate at least 30 minutes. Serve with tortilla chips for dipping.

title: Spinach Ice Blocks (Ice Blocks) Welsh
ingredients: 1 lb spinach leaves, cleaned and stemmed | 1/2 cup chili flakes, flakes | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Wash and drain the the spinach and chop the leaves in half. Blend them in a blender. Heat a wok. When hot add the chillis and add the spinach mixture, stirring to mix. Stir well over the fire until the leaves begin to wilt. Remove from heat and stir in the vanilla essence. Pour into the ice block moulds. Chill until set.

Random Ingredients: beef brisket,sherry wine,green cardamom,guacamole,nonfat cream,green bean,asiago cheese,vanilla essence
title: Lip Smacking Corned Beef Brisket - Slow Cooker
ingredients: 1/2 cup sherry wine, divided | 2 -3 lbs corned beef brisket, trimmed | 2 teaspoons vanilla essence, divided | 1 pinch of green cardamom, for fragrance | 1 can sliced green beans, drained | 2 tablespoons nonfat sour cream, for topping | 1/2 cup shredded asiago cheese, for topping | guacamole, for serving
instructions: Pour 1/4 cup sherry in the bottom of the slow cooker. Trim corned beef of any excess fat and place on top of the sherry. Sprinkle corned beef with approximately 1/2 teaspoon of vanilla essence and 1 pinch of cardamoms. Place remaining 1/4 cup sherry in a small bowl.

title: Tamari-Infused Orzo
ingredients: 1 package uncooked orzo pasta | 4 cups soymilk ( or other nondairy milk milk ) | 1/4 cup tamari | 3/4 teaspoon turmeric | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom seeds
instructions: Cook orzo until tender. Drain, and set aside. In a soup pot, heat soy milk, tamari, turmeric, and cardamom until warmed through. Toss with cooked orzo, and serve hot.

title: Italian Slaw Blend
ingredients: 2 packages coleslaw mix | 1 tablespoon dried oregano
instructions: Prepare mix according to package directions. If refrigerated, just microwave on high for 2 minutes. Pour onto toasted, ungreased baking sheet and sprinkle with oregano. Cool 15 minutes before serving.
