Random Ingredients: adobo seasoning,earl grey tea,greek black olive,flour tortilla,corn kernel,applesauce
title: Corn and Salsa Quesadillas
ingredients: 2 ears of grey tea, sliced crosswise | 1 tablespoon adobo seasoning | 8 flour tortillas | 2/3 cup fresh corn kernels | 1/3 cup unsweetened applesauce | 1/3 cup thinly sliced greek black olives ( optional )
instructions: Bring 2 cups water to a simmer in a medium nonstick skillet.

title: Honey and Fig Jam
ingredients: 8 cups crushed ice | 3 tablespoons liquid honey | 4 lbs figs, thinly sliced into 1/2 inch wide wedges
instructions: In a large pot on the stove top, cook the ice until the cubes are solid and the cubes solid white. Remove the ice, place it back onto the solid, and mash the ice with a fork or potato masher, until mostly smooth. Add the honey and stir until it is incorporated. If the jam gets too thick, add water. Add the figs and heat until the figs are soft and plump. You will probably not use all of the figs. Serve with ice.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,tomato juice,grain white rice,cranberry,lemon soda,leek,shallot,jalapeno pepper
title: Vegetable and Rice Salad
ingredients: 2 cups short-grain white rice, such as arborio | 1 cup chopped fresh leek | 1 cup chopped fresh cranberries, or to taste | 1 cup tomato juice | 1 cup diced jalapeno peppers, or to taste | 2 tablespoons minced shallots with tops | 2 cups shredded monterey jack cheese | 1/2 cup lemon soda
instructions: Bring a pot of water to a boil. Stir in rice, reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer 20 minutes. Mix in lemon cooking spray. In a bowl, mix together leeks, cranberries, tomato juice, jalapenos, and shallots. Set aside. Preheat oven season with salt and pepper to taste. Stir cheese into salad until melted. Ladle dressing over vegetables.

title: Tomato and Sage Soup from the Souchies
ingredients: 8 roma tomatoes | 300 g confectioners'sugar | stock | sage, to taste
instructions: Put the roma tomatoes in a saucepan with 100ml water and leave to soften slightly. Using an immersion blender blend for 5 minutes. Remove the skins from the tomatoes and squeeze out as much liquid as possible. Chop the remaining tomato and place in a food processor along with the confectioner's sugar and process on low for 1 - 2 minutes. Add the stock and process until it forms a smooth paste, then pour into a clean jug and season cautiously with salt and pepper. Serve hot, with sage as an optional garnish.

Random Ingredients: lime,beef,coconut cream,confectioner sugar,sultana,breadcrumb,rice wine vinegar,brown sugar
title: Aussie Grilled Burger
ingredients: 600 g ground beef | 2 tablespoons sultanas | 2 tablespoons brown sugar | 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 1/4 cup breadcrumbs | 1 1/2 tablespoons grated fresh lime rind | 1/3 cup coconut cream | 1/2 - 1 cup confectioners'sugar
instructions: Mix together, set aside. Mix ground beef, onions, sultanas, sugar, vinegar, breadcrumbs, lime rind and coconut cream. Divide into 4 equal portions. Shape each portion into a ball. Place on a greased grill rack, cook until cooked and browned on both sides. Combine, dust with icing sugar and serve with a dollop of cream.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,tomato soup,pork loin roast,extra beef,pepperoni,icing sugar
title: Pork & Beef Melt
ingredients: 1 boneless pork loin roast, trimmed of fat and cut into thin slabs about 1/4 inch thick | 1/2 cup icing sugar, sifted | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 8 slices rye bread, toasted | 6 slices pepperoni, about 6 slices ( preferably with a `` handle '' ) | 4 slices icing sugar, sifted
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Combine pork, 2 1/2 tablespoons of the icing sugar, the soup, and the bread slices in a shallow dal press. Spread the bread slices evenly with the tomato mixture. Place the pepperoni slices on top, and cover with the remaining bread slices. Using a pastry bag fitted with a 1/8 inch plain tip, pipe a heaping tablespoon of the soup mixture in the center of the bread slices. Lightly coat the edge of a large baking sheet with oil. Bake on middle rack of the oven for 12 to 14 minutes. Sprinkle with remaining icing sugar.

Random Ingredients: lettuce,virgin olive oil,yellow squash,ginger,corn niblet,canola oil,orange zest
title: Spicy Orange Salad with Squash
ingredients: 1 tablespoon canola oil | 2 teaspoons canola oil | 1 teaspoon canola oil | 1 teaspoon orange zest, grated | 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger | 1 cup yellow squash, julienned | 1/2 cup fresh corn niblet, chopped | 1 head lettuce, such as oak leaf, torn or torn into bite sized pieces | 1/2 lb lettuce | 1/2 cup red grapeseed oil or 1/2 cup olive oil
instructions: In a large bowl, mix the oils. Stir in orange peel. Combine squash and corn niblets with remaining ingredients, toss.

title: Mexican Cheese
ingredients: 12 ounces gruyere cheese, shredded | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/4 cup palm sugar, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a mixing bowl, stir together the mozzarella cheese, oregano, and sugar. Spread cheese mixture in an 8 x8 baking dish. Sprinkle cheese on top of the cheese mixture. Bake at 350 degrees f for about 10 minutes. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: olive,white vinegar,chinese five spice powder,beef chuck,wheat bread,white wheat flour,strawberry liqueur
title: Chinese Grilled Meatballs
ingredients: 2 tablespoons fresh whole wheat bread | 1/2 cup white whole wheat flour | 1/4 cup white white distilled vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon chinese five-spice powder | 2 tablespoons olive oil, or as needed | 1 pound lean ground beef chuck | 1 package frozen cut strawberries in jelly, thawed
instructions: Place bread in a shallow metal bowl. Cover with plastic wrap. Let stand until bread softens, about 10 minutes. Stir flour, vinegar powder, and 5 spice powder in a separate bowl.

Random Ingredients: brandy,chicken bouillon cube,anise seed,date syrup,cauliflower,pickling salt
title: Sweet Potatoes Dressed With Dates and Caraway
ingredients: 9 ounces medium firm bridget lettuce | 1 medium cauliflower ( leaves only ) | 12 1/2 ounces firm dates, cut in bite sized pieces | 1/2 cup low sodium chicken bouillon cube | 1/3 cup date syrup | 1 teaspoon dried anise seed | 1/4 cup pickling salt
instructions: Clean and wash lettuce, remove hard center vein and discard. Separate and discard leaves. Break each leaf very fine. Rinse the heads and cut into bite size pieces. Trim outer leaves and wash them well. Trim outer white layer with white residue. Cut out the hard center core of the head, then set leaves aside. Cut out core where core was attached, and place them into a small bowl. Soak the cherries in water 15 minutes. Drain them thoroughly and pat dry. Dice the head and cauliflower if appropriate. Place into a large saucepan and add 4 - 6 cups water. Set the mixture over medium heat and bring to a boil. Once it starts to boil, add the 1/3 cup of syrup, and 2 tsp sesame oil. When the syrup begins to thicken, turn off heat and allow the pan to cool for 5 minutes. After 5 minutes, remove the pan from the heat and set aside. After 5 minutes, taste, season with salt and stir. Pour the mixture over the bridget and cauliflower and stir. Put aside and allow to cool to room temperature or warmer. Add the date syrup, aniseed and stir. Fill the empty date jar halfway full of the sauce. Pour the date and sauce mixture into the jar and add 2 tsp sesame oil. If the jar is large, it may not fit if the lid is flat. If necessary, add anise seed, to taste and adjust to suit your tastes.

title: Homemade Beer Chips
ingredients: 16 fluid ounces beer ( we used hoegaarden ) | heavy duty aluminum foil, lightly packed
instructions: Preheat to 500°f. Combine beer and bag of beer in a large pitcher. Add some heavy duty aluminum foil to help keep the chips from sticking. Line a baking sheet or broiler pan with some of the beer chips. Pour in the beer mixture. Cover in the preheated oven for 10 minutes. Allow the chips to set up while the chips are still warm. Remove with a spatula and enjoy.

title: Spoy Chinese Green Pea Salad
ingredients: 100 g thai green peas | 150 g snow peas
instructions: Cook peas according to packet instructions. Chop snow peas into 3 4cm lengths and add to a colander in a sieve. Drain peas well and add to the colander. Toss over a couple of handfuls of sea salt until they are well coated and toss well again. Toss again until mixed well, then serve.

Random Ingredients: green food coloring,espresso powder,fenugreek seed,canola oil,goat cheese,taco seasoning mix,green chili pepper
title: Chile Colorado Mix
ingredients: 1 teaspoon canola oil | 1 teaspoon fenugreek seeds | 3 teaspoons green chili peppers, chopped | 1 1/2 ounces goat cheese or 1 1/2 ounces other white cheese, softened | 1 3/4 ounces taco seasoning mix | 3/4 cup instant espresso powder or 3/4 cup strong coffee | 2 drops green food coloring
instructions: In a small skillet over medium heat, heat canola oil, fenugreek, minced green chili pepper and goat cheese until mixture is melted, about 2 to 3 minutes. Combine the tequila and taco seasoning in a small bowl and set aside. Stir instant espresso powder with the remaining 1/4 cup cold water until well combined. Add espresso mixture and green food coloring to cheese mixture and stir to combine. Pour mix into a serving glass. Serve immediately. Keeps up to 2 weeks.

Random Ingredients: chipotle powder,pear,white vinegar,five spice powder,pepperoni,new potato,cardamom seed
title: Anticuchos (Anticuchos)
ingredients: 6 baby new potatoes ( about 1 1/2 pounds ) | 2 medium pears | 3 cups diced pepperoni ( canned and drained ) | 1/3 cup distilled white vinegar | 2 tablespoons five-spice powder | 1 tablespoon dried chipotle powder | 1 1/2 tablespoons cardamom seeds
instructions: Boil the potatoes until tender. Drain and cool potatoes, then combine with the apples, pears, pepperoni, vinegar, five spice powder, cardamom and chipotle powder. Let the mixture stand at room temperature until flavors combine, at least an hour.

title: Poritos (Phyllo Fish Rolls)
ingredients: 1 lb firm fish ( or any firm meat ) | 1 jar quick cooking oats | 1/3 cup fish sauce | 1 dash tabasco sauce
instructions: Wash fish and dry thoroughly. Put fish inside a buttered and floured container. Mix oats, fish sauce, and tabasco together. Roll up neatly lengthwise in phyllo sheets. Chop off 1 corner of phyllo, fold the other corner in half, then place over fish roll.

title: Chicken Jamee Casserole
ingredients: 5 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 1 jar marinated artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | 1/2 cup raisins | 1 1/2 cups baking powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Grease a 2x12 inch baking dish. Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the chicken and artichoke hearts, and return to a boil. Cook the chicken uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through, but firm, about 10 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Meanwhile, mix the raisins and baking powder together in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: mung bean,vegetable,spring onion,tofu,rice wine vinegar,meat,fettuccine pasta,peanut butter
title: Chinese Style Beef and Vegetables With Fried Tofu and Fettuccine
ingredients: 500 g lean ground meat | 100 g dried mung beans | 1 spring onion | 100 g cooked shredded tofu | 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar | 225 g rice noodles ( fettuccine ) | 1 tablespoon crunchy peanut butter | spring onion, to serve
instructions: Place the mung beans in a bowl and cover with cold water. Leave for 20 minutes or until soft. Drain and set aside. Place the spring onion in a large pan, cover, and sweat over a low heat for about 10 minutes. Add the tofu and brown, breaking up the chunks as it cooks, and breaking it up if necessary. Combine the drained mung beans with the cooked mung bean and spring onion. Heat the oil in a wok or karahi and add the ground meat. Cook over a high heat, stirring often so it doesn't stick. When the meat changes colour, stir in the soy sauce and vinegar, pour in the mung bean mixture, and allow to simmer for a couple of minutes, until the sauce has thickened. To serve, divide between 4 serving plates and arrange over one of the fried tofu and fettuccine. Scatter with spring onions.

title: Yeast Free Soda Popcorn
ingredients: 1/2 cup peanut oil | 2 teaspoons lemon zest | 5 tablespoons club soda | 1 pinch fenugreek
instructions: Heat the oil to 180ºc. Mix the dry ingredients in a mixing bowl. Pour in the hot oil, stirring constantly until the mixture thickens. Add more club soda if too thick. Scratch out the edge and stir. Fill into a cup with ice and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,fish sauce,raspberry,cottage cheese,pastry crust pie
title: Raspberry Cheesecake
ingredients: 4 sheets pastry for double crust pie | 1 cup fresh raspberries, diced | 1/2 cup cottage cheese | 2 teaspoons fish sauce | 6 green cardamom pods, split open and crushed
instructions: Bake the pastry shells according to package directions. Filling, in a bowl, combine the raspberries, cottage cheese and 1 tablespoons of the fish sauce. Stir in the crushed cardamom and mix well. Spoon half of the mousse into each pastry shell. Sprinkle with the remaining fish sauce and decoratively top with a piece of the reserved raspberries before serving.

Random Ingredients: muscovado sugar,butternut squash,avocado,bay leaf,raisin,pumpkin seed,tomato juice
title: Pumpkin Guacamole
ingredients: 3 tablespoons pumpkin seeds, toasted | 1/2 small butternut squash, peeled, seeded, cubed | 2 ripe tomatoes, seeded, chopped | 1 cup raisins | 1 bay leaf | 1 tablespoon muscovado sugar | 1 avocados cup tomato juice
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a bowl. Cover, and chill for at least 2 hours before serving.

title: Spicy Sausages With Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 12 red potatoes | 1/2 yellow onion, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons dry marsala wine | 4 whole cardamom seeds ( optional ) | 7 -8 lbs small squash or 7 -8 lbs other sweet potato | 1/2 lb mustard ( dijon or spicy )
instructions: Slice all the vegetables into 1/4 to 1/2 inch thick slices/strips. Layer them nicely in a 13x9x2 inch baking pan, in this order, 2 sliced onions, 1/2 cup of marsala wine, 1/2 teaspoon of prepared mustard, ½ teaspoon of seeds from 4 cardamom pods, 1/2 teaspoon of dijon or spicy brown mustard and 1/2 teaspoon of seeds from cardamom pods, place slices/triplices of meat/squash in rows on top of the onions. Cover with aluminum foil and bake at 325f for 45 - 50 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Remove from oven and let stand 10 - 12 minutes before serving. Variation, for a change of feel put a small slice of provolone cheese or smoked ham in the vacant spaces between the vegetables to replace the cheese. Variation, for additional flavor dimension, add 1/2 cup of chamomile sauce plus a pinch of sugar while cooking.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,ginger,self raising flour,white sugar,phyllo pastry,cooking sherry,rump roast,egg yolk
title: Steamed Whole-Day Beef Jerky
ingredients:
2 lbs rump roast, cut into 2-rib sections ( approx.
    - 5 - 6 each ) | 8 ounces self-raising flour | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 1 tablespoon ginger | 2 egg yolks, beaten | 1 tablespoon lemon juice ( zest of half the lemon ) | 12 sheets filo pastry sheets, thawed | cooking sherry ( optional )
instructions: Put the meat into a large saucepan and cover with water. Bring to the boil then simmer for approximately 3 hours, skimming the surface during to 3 hours, until the meat is tender. When the meat is tender, remove from heat and let stand to cool for 20 minutes. When you are able to handle the meat, remove the meat from the bones and shred into fine pieces using two forks. You may also do this with a food processor, slicing and pulsing to make finely chopped bits. Combine the flour, sugar, ginger, egg yolks and lemon peel in a large bowl, stir in the meat and the reserved saucepan juices, stirring to make a sticky mixture. Place about 2 tablespoons of the meat mixture into a square of greaseproof or parchment paper and roll it into a rectangle about 11½ x7 inches. Brush with the egg wash and sprinkle with sherry if using. Place another square of greaseproof or parchment paper on top. Press each pastry strip into the shape of a large star, pressing out any air bubbles. Trim off the excess pastry and cut each star crosswise into 12 equal strips. Place the stars onto a baking sheet, brush the pastry strips with egg wash and bake in a moderately hot oven for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Romantic Applesauce
ingredients: 3 cups unsweetened apple juice | 1 cup pared, cored, and sliced apple | 1 cup fresh cranberries
instructions: Pour the apple juice into a 3 quart saucepan. Cook over medium heat until the juice comes to a boil. Stir in the sliced apples, cranberries, and parmigiano cheese.

Random Ingredients: anchovy paste,pinto bean,green pea,asparagus,extra virgin olive oil,egg,lemon,ice water
title: Italian Asparagus, Peas and Anchovy Toss
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 cups asparagus | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 3 green peas, trimmed, frozen | 2 slices lemons, zest of ( reserve peel ) | 1 anchovy paste ( optional, but recommended ) | 3 1/4 cups ice water | 1/2 teaspoon dried minced anchovy paste | 1 egg
instructions: Trim and break asparagus into pieces no larger than 1 1/2 inches in size. Cover, and steam in microwave until asparagus is tender crisp, 30 - 40 minutes. Drain asparagus, and rinse under cold water to cool. Set aside. While the asparagus is steaming, make the dressing. In a large saucepan, add asparagus, oil, peas, zest, fish sauce and anchovy paste. Cover and cook over medium heat until shrimp is done and vegetables are crisp tender, 3 - 4 minutes. Stir in egg, then remove from heat. Ladle dressing over asparagus, and toss gently. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: pecorino cheese,chili powder,taco bell seasoning mix,vanilla bean,green leaf lettuce,shortening
title: Tortilla Española
ingredients: 1/2 cup shortening | 1 package taco bell taco seasoning mix | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder | 3 whole green leaves lettuce, washed, dried and torn into bite-size pieces | 1/2 cup finely grated pecorino cheese | 2 tablespoons finely chopped seeded canned green leaf lettuce
instructions: In a medium saucepan, place shortening and cream over medium low heat. Cook, stirring frequently, until melted, 5 to 10 minutes. Remove from heat add taco seasoning mix and chilli powder. Pour into a medium bowl and stir in lettuce. Dip tortilla shells into filling and place in a shallow pan lined with plastic wrap. Spoon in enough filling to fill the shells to cover.

Random Ingredients: cremini mushroom,red curry paste,maple syrup,horseradish,orange marmalade
title: Roasted Mushrooms With Orange Maple-Soy Glaze
ingredients: 12 -15 cremini mushrooms, cleaned and trimmed | 1 package orange marmalade ( i use trader joe's ) | 1 cup maple syrup | 1 cup prepared horseradish ( this will go fast ) | 1 -2 tablespoon red curry paste, to taste or 1 -2 tablespoon curry powder, to taste
instructions: Line your broiler tins with tin foil or parchment paper and spread sliced mushrooms out slightly. You want to be able to place them so they dont touch each other when they are broiling. Place the sliced mushrooms on their backs on the pan and top with the orange marmalade. Bake at 160 degrees for about 20 minutes turning around once. While they are cooking, prepare your sour cream. First, prepare the sour cream as directed on the package. You don't want soggy sour cream that will be too thick and creamy. Second, prepare your sauce by putting the maple syrup and horseradish in a pot on medium high heat. After about 10 minutes, the sauce will thicken some. Just be careful not to burn it. Add your desired amount of curry powder and then add a bit more if you don't like the intensity of the sauce. Turn up the heat a bit and simmer for about 20 minutes, to thicken the sauce a bit. The longer this sets the heat and the hotter you get your sour cream should be ready. It should thicken up quickly. Serve over cooked white rice or my favorite cold noodles in a shallow dish, garnishing each serving with a couple scoops of the sour cream.

title: Pepperoni and Jalapeno Pepper Snacks
ingredients: 12 slices pepperoni | 2 - 3 ounces pepperoni | 10 -12 whole pecans
instructions: On baking sheet place pepperoni, pepperoni and pecans on top of pepperoni. Bake on preheated to 350 for 10 - 15 minutes or until pepperoni is browned and pecans are softened.

title: Ricotta Mole Gravy
ingredients: 1 container whole milk ricotta cheese | 1 1/2 cups finely chopped fresh coriander ( cilantro ) | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary | 1/2 teaspoon ground coriander | 1/4 teaspoon freshly ground cayenne | 1 1/2 cups hot milk pepitas ( pomegranate seeds ), split in half
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the ricotta, coriander, rosemary, coriander and cayenne. Bring to a simmer over medium heat. Reduce simmer to low, cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until the ricotta is fully absorbed, about 15 minutes. Cool to room temperature. In medium bowl, stir 1 cup hot milk with the pepitas until thoroughly blended. Add the pepitas into the sauce, simmer, stirring occasionally, until cooked through, about 10 minutes. Puree 1/2 cup of the cheese mixture into the sauce and serve warm.

title: Portabella Oyster Sauce for Chinese New Year
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups portabella mushrooms | 1/2 cup oleo | 1 -2 teaspoon oyster sauce
instructions: In a small bowl, mix the oyster sauce and mix well. Cut a mushroom into 1/2 slices and set aside. Slice a hole in the base of each mushroom into the centre of each mushroom slice. Fill the mushroom with a bit of the oyster sauce mixture, then seal the mushroom slices around the oyster sauce. Place mushrooms onto a square of foil and wrap the foil in a packet. Refrigerate and use as directed above. Keep the foil covered over night, in the fridge. The mushrooms will double in flavours. To serve, simply wrap each mushroom slice in a piece of foil and tie them with string. Serve over steamed rice, as an extra meal.

Random Ingredients: buttermilk,lipton onion soup mix,phyllo dough,red food coloring,camembert cheese,purple onion,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Vegetable Manicotti
ingredients: 3 packages frozen whole-milk sweet potato roll thawed and well drained | 1 package lipton onion soup mix | 1 jar pitted pricked purple onions | 3 tablespoons buttermilk | 1 cup sharp cheddar cheese | 1 cup sharp camembert cheese, chopped | 1 1/2 cups shredded sharp red food coloring
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix sweet potato, onion soup mix, pricked purple onions, buttermilk, cheddar cheese, Camembert cheese, and red food coloring in a large bowl to blend. Place dough in an 11x7 inch baking dish coated with nonstick cooking spray. Spread sweet potato mixture evenly over dough, covering completely. Bake in the preheated oven until the top is golden brown, about 40 minutes.

title: alfalfa-Ganache Spread II
ingredients: 1 jar roasted alfalfa sprouts | 1 1/2 cups mayonnaise
instructions: Place sprouts in a medium bowl, and mix in mayonnaise. Refrigerate until serving.

title: Scallops With Cheese and Jam
ingredients: 4 scallops, with shells | 1/2 cup mexican cheese, grated | 3 -5 black cardamom pods, cracked
instructions: Heat olive oil in a skillet on medium high heat. When it's hot, sear scallops for 2 - 3 minutes on each side. Remove with slotted spoon and put on plate covered with towel to drain any excess oil. Mix cheese with cracked black pepper and the cracked cardamom pods into the skillet along with the scallops. Serve hot.

title: Beer Marinade for Beef Shread Steak
ingredients: 5 fluid ounces dark beer | 5 fluid ounces shortening | seasoning, salt, pepper, and pepper for seasoning bread
instructions: Place the shortening in a bowl or in freezer baggie and add the beer. Squeeze out the air and add salt, pepper, and seasoning salt to taste before marinating. Place the meat into the baggie and place in a freezer bag. This will take 1 to 2 hours depending on the amount of time you will be using depending on the size of the meat. Preheat oven to 450 degrees and lightly grease a rack in a roasting pan. Place the meat in the oven after the meat has been in it for 1 hour. Pour off the beer water from the jar and use to baste or baste the meat during the final 2 to 3 minutes of cooking.

Random Ingredients: paprika,black eyed pea,cold water,chicken bouillon cube,heather honey,bread crumb
title: Honeyed Black-Eyed Peas With Dried Hets
ingredients: 1 cup dried black-eyed peas | cold water, as needed | 4 chicken bouillon cubes | 1/4 cup finely minced fresh herbs ( such as thyme, dill, sage, parsley, tarragon, rosemary ) | 1 teaspoon paprika | 1/4 cup heather honey
instructions: Soak the beans overnight. Then wash thoroughly. Place everything in a saucepan except honey. Add enough cold water to cover the beans and bring to a boil. Cover and simmer for about 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Remove from the heat and leave until ready to serve. Serve at once. Place the beans in a serving dish with a little of the cooked liquid and garnish with honey. If you like you can use fresh herbs as a garnish.

title: Baby Greens With Arugula
ingredients: 2 tablespoons baby arugula or 2 tablespoons spinach leaves | 1/2 bell pepper, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup crumbled feta
instructions: Rinse off arugula. Wash and pat dry with paper towels.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning mix,chicken stock,almond,snow pea,red enchilada sauce,pearl barley,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Gnocchi's Almond & Rice Soup
ingredients: 1 medium pearl barley | 2 teaspoons taco seasoning mix | 1 cup snow peas | 1 1/2 cups slivered almonds ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons chicken stock | 1 can red enchilada sauce | 1 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Cook the barley in boiling water, until tender. Meanwhile, combine the taco seasoning mix with the snow peas, almonds, & chicken stock. Let the mixture simmer 5 minutes. Add the enchilada sauce, & simmer until heated through. To serve, ladle the soup into individual soup bowls.

title: Corn and Apple Hash - Pressure Cooker
ingredients: 800 g russet potatoes | 600 g creamed corn | 1 tablespoon coriander, powder | 225 g chopped tart apples
instructions: Using the pressure cooker cooker cook all of the ingredients. Cover and cook for 45 minutes on full pressure. The timing depends on your pressure cooker.

title: Hot Chili Powder
ingredients: 1 teaspoon celery salt | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Mix well and store in tightly sealed jar.

title: Robyn's Gin and Pepperoni Pizza

instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Sift flour into a large bowl. Stir in rosemary, parsley, gin, pepperoni, cucumber, and parsley. Transfer to a baking sheet, cut in half, and bake on the middle rack of the oven for 15 minutes, or until the crust is browned.

instructions: Place all ingredients in an electric blender. Blend until well mixed and melon is crushed into a ball. Pour the contents of the blender in a very thin slurry. This will stop your watermelon from turning black. Allow to settle for a few minutes, then pour into an ice cube tray covered with cheesecloth. Freeze overnight, then remove cheesecloth and refrigerate again. When ready to serve, remove cheesecloth from the freezer 15 minutes before serving. Serve with fresh herb.

title: Cashew Dhal
ingredients: 2 cans red beans, drained | 1/2 cup cashews, chopped ( unsalted-optional )
instructions: In medium size saucepan, combine the beans and cashews, and bring to a boil over medium heat. Reduce heat.

title: Beef Tongue With Caramelized Oranges and Orange
ingredients: 1 beef tongue, rinsed of any blood | 2 tablespoons grated orange rind | orange wedge | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Insert sharp knife in one end of each piece of beef tongue. Remove each piece of beef tongue, but don't remove it. Place the beef tongue in the boiling water and boil for 20 minutes until tender enough to slice thinly, 20 minutes to more. Remove the beef tongue from the water and let sit in the cold water for 10 minutes. Peel off the outer layer of skin and set aside. Trim off any dark or burned outer surface and trim off any thick sections of the tongue. Cut between the rind of the tongue and bones to form 1/2 inch slices. Heat a cast iron pan over medium high heat, drizzle a little oil or butter onto the pan and brown about 30 seconds on each side, or until golden.

title: Kielbasa in Adobo Sauce
ingredients:
2 fresh garlic cloves, halved | 1/2 lb fresh kielbasa, sliced into 3/8'rounds ( or use 3/8 '' of a 10 oz.
    - package of smoked sausage ) | 1/2 cup vegetable broth | 1/4 cup catsup | 1/2 cup unsalted dry roasted peanuts, chopped
instructions: Remove the papery skins from the kielbasa and saute them in a non stick skillet with the garlic and the broth, stirring a few times. Cover and simmer 15 - 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Uncover and cook an additional 5 minutes. Add catsup and peanuts, heat through.

title: Green Curry Paste
ingredients: 1 bunch green curry paste ( i like penzey's ) | 2 tablespoons coconut oil, plus extra | 2 tablespoons coconut oil | 1 cup whipping cream
instructions: Grind the curry paste in the food processor or with a mortar and pestle until you have a coarse paste. Heat the coconut oil over medium high heat in a pan. When hot, add the paste and cook, stirring, until hot but not brown. Quickly add the cream and simmer, stirring often, for about 5 minutes. Serve hot or cold.

Random Ingredients: lime wedge,vinegar,wheat flour,juniper berry,egg,jumbo shrimp,butterscotch chip,dill weed
title: Prawn Cocktail
ingredients: 1 dozen jumbo shrimp | 4 ounces butterscotch chips | 1 egg, beaten | 1 tablespoon wheat flour | 1 lime wedge, halved | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 2 teaspoons fresh dill weed or 2 teaspoons dried dill | 1/2 teaspoon juniper berries
instructions: Shell the prawns and reserve shells. Place the crushed chips in a small bowl and add the other ingredients. Mix until thoroughly mixed. Chill for at least an hour. Roll a small handful of prawn mixture at a time in the chips. Press into the chips. Dry the cocktail sticks onto a paper towel and store in an airtight container. Repeat until all mixture has been used.

title: Lemon Yogurt Ice Cream
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups prepared lemon yogurt | 1 tablespoon cornflour or 1 tablespoon rice flour | 1 tablespoon lime juice | 1 tablespoon grated orange peel
instructions: Whisk cornflour with lime juice and orange peel. Add to yogurt and stir well. Put ice cream in an ice cream maker. Press'start', then 'open', then'start again', and repeat.

Random Ingredients: dill weed,lamb shank,tomato sauce,yellow pepper,lump crabmeat,macaroni
title: Lamb Shanks
ingredients: 6 lamb shanks | 1 pound dried macaroni, such as ditalini | 1 can lump crabmeat | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 yellow pepper, chopped | 1 teaspoon dried dill weed
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Place the shanks onto a large piece of aluminum foil.

Random Ingredients: au gratin potato,green cardamom pod,chicken thigh,pea,kosher salt black pepper,maraschino cherry
title: Au Gratin Potatoes
ingredients: 4 1/2 lbs bone-in chicken thighs | kosher salt and black pepper | 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 4 green cardamom pods, split lengthwise | 20 frozen peas | 1/3 cup maraschino cherry, drained
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Season chicken pieces with salt and pepper to taste and transfer to a large baking dish. Cover with foil and bake until the chicken is golden brown and tender, about 30 to 40 minutes. Remove foil and continue to bake until chicken is slightly browned and tender, 10 to 12 minutes more. Remove the chicken from the oven and set aside. Warm the olive oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Working in batches, add the cardamom pods and cook, moving the pods in the hot oil to blacken the edges. Stir in the peas, cover and cook just until the peas are tender, 2 to 4 minutes. Using tongs or a slotted spoon, transfer the peas to the oven and return the dish to the oven. Cook until the sauce has reduced and thickened, about 10 minutes. Pour 1/2 of the pan juices over the chicken. Spoon the chicken over the warm sauce and sprinkle with the cherry.

Random Ingredients: rom tomato,soy sauce,pine nut,red enchilada sauce
title: Enchiladas Verde (Pasta Sauce With Pine Nuts)
ingredients: 2 lbs roma tomatoes, peeled, seeded and chopped | 1 bunch fresh pineapple nut | 1 3/4 cups red enchilada sauce or 1 3/4 cups salsa | 2 tablespoons soy sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in food processor and puree. Place sauce in medium size sauce pan and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer, stirring occasionally, until it thickens slightly. Pour over pasta and toss. Place pasta bowl in sink or large shallow bowl with ice.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,taco seasoning mix,cake flour
title: Taco Gravy Mix
ingredients: 3 tablespoons cake flour | 1 packet onion soup mix | 1 packet taco seasoning mix
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Moisten top of batter with water. Put batter in fryer and cook at 350 for 15 - 20 minutes or until desired consistancy is achieved.

Random Ingredients: fruit,cardamom,dark sesame oil,onion seed,olive,brown sugar,sultana,camembert cheese
title: Fruit Nuts With Sesame Oil
ingredients: 4 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 4 tablespoons olive oil | 4 tablespoons brown sugar | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom | 2 lbs mixed seeds ( prunes, pears, dates and raisins may be substituted ) | 3 1/2 lbs ripe fruit ( such as peaches, berries ), halved ( orange rindines may be substituted ) | 3 ounces sultanas or 3 ounces golden raisin | freshly made sweet onions would be a good substitute, sesame seeds, lemon wedges, crushed nuts, crushed sesame seeds, etc ( optional )
instructions: Heat the sesame and olive oils together in a heavy pan. When the oils are almost smoking, stir in the sugar. Add cardamom seeds and seeds and increase the heat. Whenever the sugar starts to caramelise, stir and mix constantly. If it scorches, mix in a little bit of water. Add the fruit, cover, and cook over a medium flame until the fruit is soft throughout. Cover and cook until fruit pieces have absorbed all the liquid and are starting to soften. Add the sultanas, sultanas and nuts just before serving. This can also be served as a sandwich spread with crackers or with crusty bread to dip into the nut mixture. Just stir them together and spread evenly, garnish with the freshly made sweet onions, or serve as a side dish with meat, poultry, poultry or meatless sandwiches.

Random Ingredients: almond,canola oil,berry cranberry sauce,korean red pepper powder
title: Berry Cranberry Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 1/2 cups berries or 1 1/2 cups cranberry sauce | 1/2 teaspoon korean red pepper powder | 1/8 cup toasted slivered almonds
instructions: Heat oil over low flame in a sauce pan or over low heat. Stir in the red pepper powder. Add drained mixed berries and stir to coat them until they're evenly coated. Remove from heat and stir in slivered almonds. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,vegetable oil,sherry wine,chili garlic sauce,self raising flour,savory
title: Papa Drexler's Chilli Pies
ingredients: 375 g self raising flour | 1 teaspoon dried savory ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon chili-garlic sauce | 2 tablespoons sherry wine ( or other sweet white wine ) | vegetable oil ( for frying ) | fresh garlic clove ( optional )
instructions: Mix sherry and chili garlic sauce in a small bowl. Heat the oil in a large frying pan to 180degc, or until lightly bubbling. Toss in the flour, and use your fingers to rub the flour into the flour to form a fine powder. Stir in the savory. Divide the dough into 8 portions. Working one portion at a time, roll into balls slightly larger than a golf ball. Dip each piece into the chilli garlic sauce, pressing the paste firmly onto it. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the hot patties to a baking tray lined with paper towel. Place another baking tray over the top, and repeat until the batter has been used. Cook the patties in batches for 3 - 5 minutes, or until golden on both sides. Remove from the oven, and place on kitchen paper towels to drain.

title: Spicy Vietnamese Fish
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped bok choy | 1 teaspoon salad oil | 2 tablespoons breadcrumbs | 1/2 onion, finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon chili paste, or to taste | 1/2 fresh orange, juiced | 1/8 teaspoon ground cloves
instructions: Combine bok choy, salad oil, bread crumbs, onion, chili paste, and orange juice in a large bowl. Season to taste with chili paste and ground cloves. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: half,pancake mix,ginger garlic paste,black bean sauce,stewing beef
title: Easiest Beef and Bean Mix
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs stewing beef | 1/2 cup black bean sauce | 1/4 cup half-and-half | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 2/3 cups prepared pancake mix
instructions: Mix ingredients together except pancakes. Place in crockpot and top with 1/3 cup of the prepared pancake mix. Cook on high for 4 hours. Serve over rice. If you want the sauce thicker, add 1/2 cup cream to the sauce.

title: Mustard and Mustard in Barley
ingredients: 2 ounces pearl barley | 14 ounces mustard, with extra | 1 fluid ounce mustard, for extra flavour
instructions: You are looking for a thin, well brined barley with a fairly stiff consistency and a well developed variety such as pilsner or stone ground barley. I like to use the medium grain and it has a good quality consistency. You need it to have a well developed variety but if it isn't already in your area, it would be best to use your standard method. It is important to use an organic barley that is in contact with the brinjal type which produces a brined flavour that will penetrate well but doesn't leave any traces of the barley grains sticking together. It should be able to break into strands similar to a hard boiled potato or similar similar product but different for texture and color. Place some mustard or prepared mustard into a small, hot frying pan, add the extra mustard and allow it to heat through. Add mustard to barley and allow it to warm through. This is one of those times when you need to use a whisk to loosen up the mustard mixture. This will give you a lovely porridge like porridge that is only cooked through. It will also help to give a richer flavour to the barley when cooking in a wok. When you want to serve the barley, you should first put a knob of mustard on each serving of barley. This tastes best served with meat and poultry.

Random Ingredients: chickpea,swiss cheese,virgin olive oil,lamb shank,spanish onion
title: Shankloaf With Chickpeas and Swiss Cheese
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil | 4 lamb shank | 3 slices thin spanish onions, 3/4 inch thick | 20 ounces canned chickpeas | 8 ounces swiss cheese, diced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Heat oil in 10 inch skillet over medium high heat. Sprinkle lamb with salt and pepper. Brown on all sides, 6 to 8 minutes per side. Transfer lamb to a plate. Return skillet to medium heat and add the onions, reserving oil. Cook, stirring, until browned, about 5 minutes. Transfer to a 9 inch by 2 inch baking dish. Place lamb back in skillet, add chickpeas, and cover with foil. Bake for 25 minutes. Remove from oven. Cover and continue baking 20 minutes longer, or until tender. Top with cheese and serve.

title: Homemade Cajun Cake Cracker
ingredients: 1/2 cup catsup | 2 packages non-dairy topping sheets
instructions: In a saucepan heat catsup over direct heat. Stir until dissolved. Pour 1/2 cup of hot catsup mixture into a 9 x 13 inch glass baking dish. Sprinkle topping mixture over catsup mixture. Cover with sheet of non stick wax or parchment paper and press down on top of the cake. Let sit at room temperature for 20 minutes. Carefully peel away wax paper.

title: Easy Beef & Cashews Hash #5FIX
ingredients: 1 package simply potatoes diced potatoes with onion | 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef chuck, cut into 1 inch cubes | 3 tablespoons dry pimiento | 12 fluid ounces small curd cottage cheese | 1/4 cup cashew nuts
instructions: In a large nonstick skillet, melt 1 tablespoon of butter on med high heat. Saute the pimentos until they are slightly browned and tender. Remove the pan from the heat and transfer the pimento to the same bowl as the potatoes and set aside. In the same pan, melt the remaining tablespoon of butter on med high heat. Brown the beef, drain. Combine the beef with cheese, potatoes and cashew nuts and mix. Return to heat. Cover and simmer until the party is ready.

title: Lavender Ham and Bacon Ragu
ingredients: 7 cups cooked quinoa | 1 lb sliced deli ham | 1 cup cooking oil | 8 leaves fresh lavender flowers | 12 lasagna noodles
instructions: In a large pot, mix qinoa and ham, and add enough cooking oil to completely cover the bottom of the pot. Add 1/2 of the lavender flowers, and layer the lasagna noodles on top of it, making sure to cover everything completely. Pour some of the cooked quinoa mixture on top and cook on low to medium heat. Allow to simmer for a few hours, or until the noodles soften to your liking. The pasta should not taste dry.

Random Ingredients: pine nut,bay leaf,rump roast,rotini pasta,water artichoke heart,dark sesame oil,chili sauce
title: Maggie Beer's Beef & Orzo
ingredients: 2 lbs rump roast | 1/4 cup chopped water-packed artichoke hearts, drained & chopped | 1 can rotini pasta or ( 16 ounce ) can ziti pasta | 1 can sliced bamboo water-packed artichoke hearts, drained & chopped | 1/2 cup chili sauce | 1/4 cup dark sesame oil | 1 bay leaf | chopped pine nuts
instructions: Season roast with salt and pepper. Put roast and remaining ingredients, except for beef, orzo & garnish, in slow cooker. Cover and cook on low heat setting for 7 - 9 hours or high heat setting for 4 - 5 hours. Remove roast from slow cooker and cover. Discard bay leaf or remove lid.

title: Indian Naan Bread Dip
ingredients: 2 cups light mayonnaise | 1/2 cup semolina flour | 1/2 cup roasted chopped seeded cucumber, well drained | 2 teaspoons finely chopped coriander leaves
instructions: Put everything into a bowl. Lightly beat until well combined with the electric mixer. Let stand for 30 minutes or longer. Stir well.

title: Spicy Broccoli
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh broccoli, trimmed and cut into 1-inch thick slices | 3/4 cup fresh berries, sliced | 4 ounces raspberries, rinsed and patted dry
instructions: Spray a large skillet with nonstick cooking spray and set over medium high heat. Add the broccoli and cook, stirring often, until crisp tender, about 1 minute. Add the berries, tossing lightly to coat the berries, and cook 1 minute.

Random Ingredients: almond extract,tomato,wheat flour,maraschino cherry,pasta,pork shoulder,beef bouillon cube
title: Cherry Almond Pork Pasta With Roasted Tomatoes
ingredients: 8 ounces whole wheat flour | 4 ounces beef bouillon cubes | 14 1/2 ounces tomatoes, cored, peeled and cut in half | 16 ounces cooked pork shoulder, roughly pulled into small shreds | 14 ounces sweet potatoes, cut in 3/4 inch dice | 1 1/2 teaspoons almond extract | 1/4 cup maraschino cherry, coarsely chopped
instructions: In a small bowl, mix the flour and bouillon a bit at a time until the salt and the flour are thoroughly incorporated into a paste. Add the remaining ingredients and mix until well combined.

title: Wattleseed Twists
ingredients: 2 cups plain flour | 1 3/4 teaspoons yeast | 2 1/3 cups fresh strawberries, hulled | 1/3 cup dried blue curacao | 1 1/2 cups purple strawberries, hulled
instructions: Put all ingredients into the bread machine in the order suggested by the manufacturer. Use the dough setting. Once the dough starts proving, shape and knead. Form into a log and place onto a floured tray and leave to rise in a warm place for about an hour or until doubled in size. Deflate the dough and let it rest for 5 minutes. Grease an 18x28cm slice tin or a 30cm round tin, with a thin film of olive oil. Using 3 fingers make a slit through the top of the dough, then gently squeeze in some of the curacao. Spoon the strawberries into the holes, keeping some strawberries whole. Cover with more curacao and press down gently. Cover and leave to rise for 1 hour. Preheat the oven to 120c/450f/gas 7 and bake for 45 - 60 minutes until golden brown. The dough should sound hollow when tapped. Remove from the oven and cut into 3s. Replace cover, return to oven and leave for 15 minutes or until loaf starts rising again.

Random Ingredients: rye flour,corn cob,creamy peanut butter,veal,sun tomato,spinach leaf,blueberry,grainy mustard
title: Wild Peanut Butter Corn Rounds
ingredients: 1/2 cup natural creamy peanut butter, not creamy peanut butter | 1 1/2 cups rye flour | 2 corn on the cob, coarsely grated | 12 spinach leaves | 12 slices sun-dried tomatoes, chopped | 1/2 cup fresh blueberries | 1 teaspoon grainy mustard | 1/2 cup veal, minced
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375f or mark place an oven proof griddle over moderately low heat. Stir together the peanut butter and the remaining cup of peanut butter. Gradually add the rye flour, a little at a time, stirring constantly with a wooden spoon. Continue stirring, until the mixture is smooth, rather stiff and dry. Transfer the mixture to a bowl. Using an electric mixer on medium high speed, slowly mix in the grated corn. Add the spinach, sun dried tomatoes, blueberries and mustard and mix well. Fold the mixture into the peanut butter mixture. Place the mixture in a buttered baking dish or muffin tin. Smooth the surface very gently while it is being baked. Bake for 20 minutes or until golden. Cool for 2 minutes on a baking rack.

title: Pasta Fagioli
ingredients: 1 lb macaroni, cooked | 5 ounces green chilies, chopped | 1 teaspoon dried italian parsley | 2 tablespoons golden raisins
instructions: Cook macaroni according to directions. Drain. Meanwhile heat a saucepan over low heat until hot. Add green chilies and parsley to saucepan. Reduce heat.

Random Ingredients: fennel seed,cheddar cheese,tomato paste,pasta,linguine,alfredo sauce,taco sauce
title: Spicy Noodle "lasagna"
ingredients: 1 package lasagna noodles | 1 jar alfredo sauce | 2 tablespoons tomato paste | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1/2 cup shredded cheddar cheese | 1 lb pasta, cooked | 1 jar taco sauce
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. In saucepan, combine remaining ingredients. Cover, and let simmer for 20 minutes. Add pasta to sauce, mix well, and simmer for 5 minutes. Spoon into 13 x 9 inch pan sprayed with nonstick cooking spray. Bake at 350 for 25 minutes.

title: Curry Kielbasa
ingredients: 14 ounces kielbasa | 2 tablespoons curry paste
instructions: Preheat broiler for 5 - 8 minutes. Remove from oven and rub with curry paste. Place on baking sheet, cut into 2 inch squares. Broil 8 - 10 minutes, or until beginning to brown.

title: Irish Salmon Egg Noodle Salad
ingredients: 3/4 lb fresh salmon, skinless and boneless ( skin on ) | 3/4 lb egg noodles
instructions: Rinse salmon fillet under running water with a fork and cut into 1 inch squares cut salmon diagonally into 2/3 inch strips. Boil noodles per package directions, drain. Toss salmon, noodles, and onion and sprinkle with lemon juice.

title: Auntie Lori's Risotto With Tomatoes and Cheese
ingredients: 1/2 cup finely chopped onion | 2 cups medium-grain rice, divided | 1 can diced tomatoes in tomato puree, undrained | 3 tablespoons coarsely chopped fresh italian parsley, divided | 2 teaspoons finely grated fresh italian spices such as dried parsley | 1 1/2 cups shredded sharp cheddar cheese, divided | 2 teaspoons ground cardamom seeds
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f. Combine the onion and 1 cup rice in the bowl of an electric mixer with the reserved 1/2 cup of uncooked rice. Using a spoon or pastry brush, spread 1/4 cup of the contents of the can of tomatoes in a 12” heavy skillet over medium high heat. Turn down the heat if the top of rice browns too quickly. When it starts to change color, and starts to soften, stir in 1/2 cup of the cheddar cheese. As soon as the cheese begins to melt, stir in the cardamom, remove from heat and stir in the remaining 1/2 cup of the cheddar. Stir in the remaining rice, along with the onions, tomato puree and 1/2 cup water. Spread in the bottom of a 9”x9” baking dish that has been coated with cooking spray. Top with the remaining cheddar and pour the remaining ¾ cup of water in the sauce. Bake, uncovered in the middle of the oven until the risotto is heated through, about 30 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Beef and Horseradish Sandwich
ingredients: 1 pound beef stew meat, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 jar sweet red peppers, chopped | 1 can green chilies, chopped | 1/2 cup greek yogurt | 1 tablespoon prepared horseradish | 1/2 cup dry bread crumbs | 1/4 cup melted nutella
instructions: In a 2 quart slow cooker, combine the stew meat, red peppers, green chilies, greek yogurt, horseradish, bread crumbs, and nutella. Cook on low heat setting until vegetables are tender, about 4 hours.

title: Irish Sourdough Croutons
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs rye bread, cubed | 4 cups cold water | tortillas ( optional )
instructions: Put all ingredients in a crock pot, stir well. Cover and cook on low 8 - 9 hours. Serve on tortillas with corn chips.

title: Simple Italian Rice
ingredients: 2 cups long grain white rice or 2 cups brown rice, uncooked | 2 - 2 1/2 teaspoons dried italian herbs
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Bring water to a boil, cover, and then let stand for 15 minutes. Fluff with a fork and serve.

title: Cardamom and Chilli Raita
ingredients: 1 cup chicken stock | 2 green cardamom pods
instructions: Heat the chicken stock in a pan.

title: Penne With Tuna, Dressing and Raspberry-Pepper Pesto
ingredients: 1/2 cup pimento stuffed olive, diced | 2 tablespoons raspberry-infused pesto | 1 tablespoon tamari | 250 g penne pasta | 2 tablespoons tuna packed in oil | 85 g tuscan raspberries or 90 g frozen raspberries, combined, to serve
instructions: Using 1 tbls of the pesto, mix well, then set aside. Boil the pasta as per packet directions and drain. Place pasta on an oven tray and bake in a 200c /fan 160c /gas 6 for 9 minutes. While pasta is cooking make the dressing by placing all ingredients into a food processor or blender. Process until smooth and then drizzle over the tomato pesto. Add a dash of salt to taste. Tip, to toast pistachios, line a baking tray with foil, otherwise, use a cast iron grill pan. Cut pistachios into thin half moon shapes with a knife. Spray the pan with pam and then toast pistachios until softened. Set aside and keep warm. Drain pasta and return to the pan. Drain the tuna well, pat dry, then stir through the tuna. Serve pasta with sauce poured over.

title: Maple Bacon Burgers
ingredients: 1 package smoked hamburger | 1 can chicken thighs, with skin | 4 ounces wakame seaweed, seaweed ( about 1 cup ) | 1/2 teaspoon maple syrup | 2 tablespoons honey-roasted maple syrup | 2 slices lemon | 1/4 cup strawberry jelly
instructions: Make a patty out of the ingredients, starting with the smoked hamburger. Form into four burgers about 2 1/2 inches in diameter.

title: Chilli Crab
ingredients: 2 lbs jumbo lump crabmeat | 2 cups dried white beans | 1 cup currants ( currants have a better flavour than black, so use less ) | 3 small dried red chilies, crushed | 1 teaspoon fresh ginger, finely grated
instructions: Shell crab and rinse in cold water to remove any bones or foreign matter. Place in bowl of cold water. Leave to soak for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, boil beans overnight. Drain and rinse in a saucepan, put aside water, drain crabmeat and put back into pan. Drain the crabmeat well under cold running water. Drain the crabmeat well under cold running water. Save this water in the same bowl in which you drained the crab meat. Place the liquid, drained beans, currants, crushed chillies, and fresh ginger in a bowl. Mix well, adding a little of this water to speed up the cooking. Taste and season with salt. Taste mixture and if it's too wet, add more currants and more hot water to get right consistency. Cover and return to the fridge overnight. The next day, take a handful of the crabmeat and mash well, adding 1 tablespoon of this mixture to the bowl and mixing well before adding the next. The mixture should be very smooth and homogenous. Do not add any of the remaining liquid and not have the crab and beans too wet. You should be able to form little clumps in the crab and beans, but beware it will dry out if it does chill for a few minutes in the fridge.

title:
Nuclear Melt on the Pan.

instructions: Drain hamburger, slice it and set hamburgers aside. Heat bean water and pepper until warm in microwave place drained bean and chili in microwave oven. title: Tortilla Strips

instructions: Whisk 1 cup confectioners' sugar and tortilla strips together in a bowl. Pour in 2 tablespoons water, about 1 tablespoon at a time, stirring quickly after each addition. Divide mixture evenly among tortilla strips.

title: Potato and Cheese Dip!

instructions: Boil, steam or microwave potatoes until just tender.

title: Thai Steamed Potato, Bar & Coconut Rissoles
ingredients: cooking spray, such as pam | 8 whole green cardamom pods | 6 medium baking potatoes, peeled | 6 cups shredded mar bar store-bought mar bar ( from asian grocery stores ) | 1 1/2 cups raw whole wheat berries, divided | 2 tablespoons thai fish sauce | 2 tablespoons tamarind paste | fresh thyme sprig ( optional )
instructions: Preheat grill to high. Place cardamom pods on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Toast just until blackened, about 1 minute. Transfer cardamom to a cutting board. Cook potatoes until very tender, about 15 minutes.

title: Baked Calamari & Cauliflower Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 bag cauliflower florets ( about 10 ounces ) | 3 cups cold water | 1 -2 tablespoon vinegar | 2 teaspoons minced seeded fresh jalapeno chiles | 1 container refrigerated french bread | 1 jar red enchilada sauce | 1 tablespoon scallions, chopped | 3 kaffir lime leaves ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f line a baking sheet with foil and spray with no stick cooking spray. In a 5 quart pot, add cauliflower, water, vinegar and chilies and bring to a boil. instructions: Cook the rice according to the packet instructions. Put the tomatoes in the bottom of a large saucepan. Add the rice, stock and herbs and pepper flakes. Bring to the boil then turn down the heat. Cover and cook for 15 minutes. Serve warm.
