title: Thai Red Curry Stuffing for Turkey, Vegetables, and Fruit
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread | 1 cup chopped kale | 1 cup chopped walnuts | 5 ounces baby red potatoes, chopped | 1 can red curry paste, or to taste | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract, or as desired | 1/4 cup brewed coffee
instructions: Cut french bread into 1/2 inch slices. Place bread slices in a baking dish. Cook in a microwave on high power until slightly toasted, but not crisp, about 3 minutes per side. Let cheese melt, about 2 minutes. Set aside. Toast kale until no more watery, about 10 minutes. Remove kale from oven and cut in half diagonally. Reserve. Meanwhile, combine kale with walnuts in the work bowl of a food processor fitted with the metal blade. Process kale, 1/4 cup of the cooked toasted french bread, red potatoes, red curry paste, and almond extract in a food processor until chunky and well mixed. Stir in coffee, if desired.

title: Baileys & Eggs
ingredients: 6 eggs | 2 spanish peanuts, roasted & chopped | 4 tablespoons irish cream | 1 medium red bell pepper, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat the broiler to broil. Place the peanuts on a baking sheet & roast them in the oven until they are browned, & caramelized. Take them out & shake off the burnt skin. Pour the peanut oil into a small skillet over medium heat. Place the peppers in the hot oil & cook on all sides. Remove the peppers from the pan. Beat the eggs in a bowl. Place the eggs back into the pan & melt over low heat. Stir the sugar into the egg mixture about 20 seconds. Then, pour the melted caramelized peppers into the egg mixture & stir carefully. Cook for 1 minute more, lifting the edges of the custard with a spatula, or the bottoms of a spoon.. Place custard on paper towels to absorb any excess oil.

Random Ingredients: beef,irish cream,plain nonfat yogurt,cocoa powder,pie crust,beef roast,hot chili sauce,purpose flour
title: Slow-Cooker Chocolate Beef Burritos
ingredients: 3 lbs beef top round roast, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 1/2 cup hot chili sauce | 2/3 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1 cup reduced-fat sour cream | 1/3 cup bailey's irish cream | 2 refrigerated pie crusts, thawed ( frozen in freezer )
instructions: Toss with half the flour, cocoa, and chili sauce to coat. Dredge the meat in the remaining flour mixture. Place meat in the slow cooker. Top with yogurt, sour cream, and baileys. Cover and cook on high for 1 hour.

title: Santa Fe Style Rice & Vermicelli Salad
ingredients: 4 cups cooked rice noodles | 3 cups chunky salsa | 4 ripe roma tomatoes, seeded & diced | fresh guacamole ( to garnish )
instructions: Place cooked noodles on a large cutting board. Using a rice noodle like roller, cut through noodles until you have noodles in about 6 pieces. Next start adding salsa to noodles. Once all the ingredients have been added to the noodles, spread about 1 cup of the vermicelli rice in the bottom of a 9x13 pan, layer noodles on top then garnish with fresh guacamole. Bake at 350 for 15 to 20 minutes or until hot and bubbly to the touch.

Random Ingredients: mexican oregano,maple syrup,dark brown sugar,chicken stock,vanilla sugar,pecan,white pepper,spinach
title: Spinach and Nut Soup
ingredients: 5 cups chicken stock | 3/4 cup dried mexican oregano | 1/2 cup maple syrup | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar | 1/2 cup finely chopped pecans | 1/4 cup vanilla sugar | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper | 1 box frozen chopped spinach, thawed
instructions: In 6 - 8 quart stock pot, combine everything else except spinach. Bring to boil, then reduce heat and simmer uncovered 15 minutes. Add spinach and cook 5 more minutes, or until wilted. Serve as a starter or main course.

Random Ingredients: dark chocolate,cauliflower floret,thai chile,grain white rice,green pea
title: Thai Chicken & Vegetable Rice With Dark Chive (Mock Ho Tio
ingredients: 1/2 cup green peas | 1/4 cup thai chile, minced | 1/2 lb cauliflower floret ( florets broken into florets ) | 1 cup long grain white rice ( or japanese-style rice, soaked in salted water for 2 hours ) | 1 ounce dark chocolate, coarsely chopped
instructions: Cook the peas in boiling water until soft. Drain and set aside. Drain the peppers and chillies and combine with the remaining ingredients except the dark chocolate.

Random Ingredients: purpose flour,crabmeat,red potato,pork shoulder,tomato puree,green pea
title: Rice Cakes
ingredients: 8 medium red potatoes | 8 medium smoked pork shoulder | 2/3 cup cooked shelled green peas | 2 cans diced tomatoes with puree | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 2 cups crabmeat, finely chopped
instructions: Cook the first 3 ingredients, peel, dice and set aside. Place the flour in a plastic bag and, using your hands, mix well. Add the crab meat and shake a few times until the crab is well coated. Place the potato in a bowl and cover with the flour mixture. Chill. Place the peas in a bowl of cold water until all the water is absorbed. Dip one side of each potato potato in the hot water, remove the potato and place it directly on the flour coated side of the pot with the crab. The potato will be soft. Repeat this process until all the potato is done. When all are done, place on a plate lined with paper towels so the starch does not pick up in the pan. Place the pan of peas in the oven and bake at 375 degrees fahrenheit for 15 - 20 minutes or until golden brown. If this does not go well cooked, let it cool before you proceed with the recipe.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,spinach leaf,chicken broth,vanilla bean,monosodium glutamate,vegetable broth
title: Mexican Spinach - Spinach Soup
ingredients: 1 lb spinach leaves | 1 can vegetable broth | 1 cup chicken broth | 1 -2 teaspoon monosodium glutamate ( msg ) or 1 teaspoon sugar | 1/2 - 1 cup mexican blend cheese | 1 lb mexican blend cheese
instructions: Wash the spinach and spin, do not dry. Blanch spinach in boiling water for 3 - 4 minutes then drain well. In blender, mix all ingredients until combined. Add spinach to soup and boil 3 - 5 minutes.

title: Date Spread - Sweden
ingredients: 8 large dates, chopped, dates 'n't liquid | 5 tablespoons chopped walnuts, toasted ( optional )
instructions: Place the dates and chopped nuts in a large mixing bowl. Stir by hand if desired until evenly distributed. Slowly mix in the walnut spread.

title: Lettuce Calf’s Salad
ingredients: 1 head lettuce | 1 teaspoon pickling salt | 1 head lettuce, and flowers ( optional )
instructions: Rinse the lettuce thoroughly and let drain for 1 hour. Shake or gently pat dry the lettuce and sprinkle with the pickling salt. Use to stuff salads if desired. The lettuce will change color during this process. Variation, when you’re eating, add some minced or chopped vegetables such as potatoes and finely shredded carrot. Variation, for vegetables with the amount of vegetables in your salad, substitute other vegetables such as bell peppers, mushrooms or even bacon.

title: Chicken Vermicelli With Green Chilis
ingredients: 1 package rice vermicelli, washed and drained | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1/2 cup chicken, cubed
instructions: Heat oil in a skillet. Toss in vermicelli noodles. Sauté until golden brown. Add tomatoes and green chilis. Reduce heat.

Random Ingredients: cumin powder,cold water,graham cracker,adobo seasoning,italian herb seasoning,ham
title: Adobo Ham Rind - Crock Pot
ingredients: 3 lbs cubed ham | 2 tablespoons dried italian herb seasoning | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 teaspoon herbes de provence ( optional ) or 1 teaspoon adobo seasoning ( optional ) | 1/2 cup cold water | 1/3 cup cold water
instructions: In a gallon size plastic bag place ham, herbs and cumin, if using. Pour 1/2 cup of cold water over ham. Place plastic bag on top of ham and add another 2 inches of bag in a criss cross pattern around bag. Add 2 cups of cold water in the above order until meat is completely covered. Cook on high for 3 to 4 hours depending on your crock pot. Drain, slice and serve with a salad for a complete meal.

Random Ingredients: basmati rice,mustard powder,red capsicum,nacho corn chip,vegetable
title: Indian Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice | 8 ounces mixed vegetables | 1 small red capsicum, diced | 4 ounces unsalted nacho-flavored corn chips | 1 teaspoon mustard powder
instructions: Cook rice in boiling water for 20 minutes or until tender.

Random Ingredients: kernel corn,green chili sauce,cheddar monterey cheese,cucumber
title: Cheesy Mexican Corn Cakes
ingredients: 2 cans whole kernel corn, drained | 1 cup grated cheddar or monterey cheese | 2 cans green chili sauce | 1 cucumber, peeled, seeded and diced
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. In a medium bowl, stir together all of the ingredients. Mix together until well blended. Shape into 16 patties. Bake for 15 minutes, or until heated through.

title: Penne in Sauerkraut
ingredients: 1 package sauerkraut | 3/4 cup cooked penne ( i use spiral pasta, but any other long pasta will do ) | 2 teaspoons dried marjoram | 1 teaspoon dried mixed herbs | 1/2 teaspoon peppercorn ( i prefer black-roasted toasted, but use a good grind ) | 1 baked pie shell
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f rinse sauerkraut well in cold water. Mix with penne, herbs, and peppercorns. Put in pie shell and cover with aluminium foil. Bake uncovered for 40 - 45 minutes. Serve with sour cream and extra salad vegetables.

Random Ingredients: cayenne,tamarind paste,hamburger,pigeon pea,cannellini bean,green food coloring,chicken thigh
title: Cochinita (Gibna's Indonesian Chicken Stew)
ingredients: 1 can coconut cannellini beans ( white kidney beans ) -drained and rinsed | 1 can pigeon peas, drained and rinsed | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne | 2 pounds boneless, skinless chicken thighs | 6 drops green food coloring - or to taste | 1 tablespoon tamarind paste | 2 tablespoons tamarind paste
instructions: Rinse the cannelini and pigeon peas inside and out, and remove any damaged beans or stones before proceeding. Place the coconut beans, pigeon peas, cayenne pepper, and green food coloring into a blender. Cover, and blend until smooth. Reserve 1/4 cup of the beans puree.

title: Fairy Apricot Balls
ingredients: 1/2 cup apricot jam | 3 tablespoons ground coriander
instructions: Using a spoon, mix all ingredients together. Roll with hands between fingertips until mixture is evenly coated.. Place in refrigerator for 2 hours. Variation, for a soft chewy dough, roll out between palms of your hands until the mixture is a mixture of chewy and soft. Form mixture into balls and place onto cookie sheets. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes until lightly browned and firm.

Random Ingredients: palm sugar,worcestershire sauce,couscous,yellow onion,cremini mushroom,olive,caramel ice cream topping,kidney bean
title: Quick & Easy Barbecue Couscous
ingredients: 1 cup cooked kidney beans | 1/2 cup cooked lima beans | 1/2 cup cooked cremini mushroom | 1/2 cup diced yellow onion | 1 tablespoon grated carrot | 1 tablespoon caramel ice cream topping | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh cremini mushrooms | 1 tablespoon grated palm sugar ( or turbinado sugar )
instructions: Mix everything, except the caramel ice cream, in a bowl. Add caramel ice cream and worcestershire sauce. Mix until well incorporated. Serve warm with crusty italian bread or pita bread.

title: Quick Spinach and Cauliflower Lasagna
ingredients: 4 sheets lasagna noodles | 4 tablespoons salad oil, divided | 1 pound fresh asparagus, chopped | 1 head cauliflower, cut into florets | 4 eggs, beaten | 1 jar alfredo sauce | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1/4 cup cold water
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook lasagna sheets in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until tender yet firm to the bite. Drain and set aside. Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a skillet over medium heat. Cook and stir asparagus and cauliflower in the hot oil until the cauliflower is browned and tender, 5 to 7 minutes. Transfer vegetables to a large saucepan, and warm until warm, about 3 minutes. Stir in the eggs. Stir sauce, cardamom, and cold water into the eggs and cauliflower mixture. Spread 1/2 the cauliflower, asparagus, and sauce mixture into a 9x13 inch baking dish. Cook lasagna sheets in the preheated oven until the edges are golden brown, about 8 minutes.

title: Tamari and Olive Pasta
ingredients: 400 g pasta shells | 2 tablespoons five-spice powder | 3 tablespoons espresso ( dark espresso powder ) or 3 tablespoons espresso powder ( dark espresso powder ) | 3 -4 tablespoons tamari | 6 green olives
instructions: Boil water with tamari and 5 spice powder. Add pasta and cook until al dente. Drain pasta well and add to other ingredients. Garnish with green olives and serve hot.

title: Totally Twisted Dutch Chocolate
ingredients: 4 pints of good quality coffee ( like a very robust liqueur ) | 3 pints good quality ketchup, such as heinz
instructions: Get the coffee and ketchup to the boil in a large saucpan or kettle. While waiting for coffee to boil, get a large bowl and a cup large enough to let your ketchup stand upright on the edge of the table. Get the ketchup boiling with the 4 pints of ketchup, and use the mixture to build up a good, strong brick with the coffee on the top of the ketchup so the ketchup doesn't burn. Use the ketchup to keep the strong brick from getting stuck and stick in your eyes, as some ketchup burns can easily stick to the spoon. You can add more ketchup at this point if you need it, but you will also taste this as you go.

Random Ingredients: vanilla extract,mustard,serrano pepper,coconut milk,pineapple juice,peppercorn,corn flake,okra
title: Warm Okra in Coconut Milk
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs medium okra, trimmed | 1/4 cup whole coconut milk | 1 teaspoon peppercorn ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon powdered mustard | 12 pineapple slices with juice | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 serrano pepper, chopped fine ( optional ) | corn flakes
instructions: Cut okra into 1 inch sections, removing the root ends, leaving the tips intact on all sides. Cut the ends off and discard from the okra. Rinse it in cold water and let dry at room temperature for 20 minutes. In a large saucepan, combine okra, coconut milk, peppercorns and mustard.

title: Cherie's Greek Goddess Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 gallon greek yogurt ( plain! ) | 1/2 cup catsup | 1 teaspoon prepared mustard | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/2 cup fresh mint, chopped
instructions: Note, you can substitute any other type of ground meat. I like to lightly toast my poppy seeds in a skillet for a few minutes to reduce saltiness and make the drier sauce.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,oyster sauce,cashew,vegetable stock,baby corn,vegetable bouillon granule,milk ricotta cheese
title: Cashew Covered Salmon With Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 300 g baby corn, cut from the cob | 1 tablespoon roasted cashews, chopped | 1 tablespoon vegetable stock | 300 g salmon fillets, skin removed | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon maggi instant chicken stock | 250 g wholemeal low-fat milk ricotta cheese ( i prefer low fat ) | 1 tablespoon instant stock granules
instructions: Place the babycorn and cashew pieces onto a paper lined baking tray and bake at 180 degrees until just tender. Set aside and keep warm. Boil water in a large pot. Add 2 tablespoons of oyster sauce and bring to the boil, cooking for two minutes. Drain the rice from the cob and add to the boil. Add the babycorn, coconut, and cashew nuts. Blend well. Add the stock and season to taste. Place a clean knife on top and slice the salmon. Place in a shallow dish. Pour over the oyster sauce and coat the cooked salmon with the mixture. Cover with cling wrap and refrigerate for 15 minutes. Put the ricotta in a mixing bowl and whip with an electric hand held mixer until it begins to form a paste. Fold through the remaining coriander, pour into a clean plate, or serve separately.

Random Ingredients: chili powder,yellow cake mix,red leicester cheese,orange blossom honey
title: Crunchy Corn Bread
ingredients: 1 box yellow cake mix | 1 package red leicester cheese, shredded | 2 tablespoons fresh orange blossom honey | 1/4 teaspoon chili powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Spread cake mix onto a greased or parchment lined baking sheet. Using a pastry blender, spread cheese over the cake mix. In a small bowl, mix together orange blossom honey and chili powder. Sprinkle over cheese and top with bread mixture. Bake in preheated oven 10 minutes.

title: Radish and Bacon Gravy
ingredients:
1 large onion, cut into rings | 3 tablespoons bacon drippings | 8 -10 radishes, well washed.
    - | 1/4 cup plain flour
instructions: Brown onions in bacon drippings in saucepot with lid slightly lower. Add radishes and cook until soft and then mash.. Add flour and cook slowly for 30 minutes at the same time, stirring occasionally to prevent lumps. This is very thick. Pour into soup or hot water, and serve with bread.

Random Ingredients: port wine,herbes de provence,tart apple,flat leaf parsley
title: Tables and Apples
ingredients: 6 medium tart apples | 1/2 cup port wine | 1 teaspoon herbes de provence | 2 tablespoons fresh flat-leaf parsley ( chopped )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Cut apples into 1½ inch slices. Transfer to a large baking pan. Add all remaining ingredients to pan and toss to coat everything well. Place pan in oven and bake until apples are tender, approximately 25 minutes, turning dish occasionally.

title: White Beans With Rice
ingredients: 3/4 cup white kidney beans | oil | 1 tablespoon vegetable shortening | 2 cups jasmine rice, washed
instructions: Sort through the rice and rinse under cold water. Drain.

Random Ingredients: sake,italian seasoning,sourdough starter,snow pea,baby spinach,black olive,beef stew meat
title: Japanese Beef and Olive Salad
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 package frozen sourdough starter, thawed | 1 package preshredded konbu-goma ( dried japanese-style seaweed ) seaweed, rinsed | 10 ounces baby spinach | 1 can black olives, sliced | 2 tablespoons sesamame oil or 2 tablespoons sake | 1 tablespoon sake | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning
instructions: In a large bowl mix the stew meat, thawed frozen sourdough starter dough, sliced olives and spinach until well mixed. In another large bowl mix the sesamame oil and sake with the sesame oil mixture. Mix well, cover, and refrigerate overnight. The next day mix together the italian seasoning and refrigerate until required.

title: Chinese Sticky Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken leg quarters, skinned | 4 celery ribs, chopped | 2 tablespoons dates, chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180c, 200c, 190c fan forced. Rub the chicken legs with olive oil and line the roasting pan with kitchen paper. Put the chicken legs into the oven and bake for 25 minutes. Sticky chicken should be dry, but not hard. Remove the chicken legs from the oven and turn into a warmed serving platter, sprinkle with celery and dates, then cover. Allow to cool for 20 minutes before cutting into wedges.

title: Chana Dal Dosas
ingredients: 3/4 cup channa dal ( split dal ) | 3/4 lb turnip, peeled and cut into 3/4-inch cubes | 1 large plum, quartered | 1 -2 shallot, peeled and coarsely chopped
instructions: Pour enough water over the chana dal and place in a dutch oven or small heavy saucepan. Bring to a boil over high heat, partially cover the pan and cook for 15 minutes or until dal is cooked and slightly mushy but not soft. Drain but reserve the broth when cooked. Meanwhile, add the turnip and plum to a large bowl and mash them to a paste with the shallots. Add the chana dal to the vegetable paste and stir to blend well. Keep warm. Ladle the dal cooked broth into shallow bowls and serve.

title: Apple Filling
ingredients: 3 apples, pared and roughly diced | 1 teaspoon sesame oil | 1 tablespoon cornflour or 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 teaspoon sesame oil | 2 tablespoons cornflour or 2 tablespoons cornstarch
instructions: Heat sesame oil, then add apples. Mix together until completely cooked, then add cornflour dissolved in 1 tbs water and stir to combine. Let cool to room temperature. In a small dish, sift the second 2 tbs of water or corn starch. Add sesame powder or sesame oil and combine with apples and cornflour mixture. Use as a paste for pancakes, sandwiches, etc.

title: Polvorones
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cornflour | 2/3 cup soymilk, lukewarm | 1/2 cup kalamata olive, pitted and roughly chopped | 1 1/2 cups ladyfingers | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Blend cornflour and enough soy milk to give good consistency. Stir in olives and mace. Dip ladyfingers in mixture, letting excess drip off. Arrange on baking tray in single layer. Brush tops with remaining soy milk mixture. Bake at 200 degrees c for 12 minutes, flipping half way through. Cool thoroughly. Store in airtight container.

Random Ingredients: almond extract,onion soup mix,beef chuck roast,red potato,gruyere cheese
title: Easy Gruyere Pot Roast
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless beef chuck roast | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 3 tablespoons almond extract | 1 lb red potato, chopped and unpeeled | 1 lb gruyere cheese, grated
instructions: Place beef roast into crockpot. Mix soup mix with extract. Pour soup mix over roast. Cook on high for 2 hours. Turn the roast and cook until fork tender on the second day. Remove the beef and set aside on a plate. Cover and refrigerate overnight. When ready to make soup, remove from crockpot, discarding bone. Place potatoes into pot and cover with water. Cook on high for 30 minutes until tender. Add salt. Cook for about 15 more minutes or until potatoes are tender. Place the potatoes into a greased bowl and add cheese. Mix thoroughly. Note, to make the cheese crust, cut 2 slices of bread and lightly flour, and moisten with water. Shape mixture into a crust and place on top of crust, allowing the crust to stick if desired. Bake at 450 degrees f. For 15 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Santa Fe Beef and Vegetables
ingredients: 3 pounds sirloin tip roast, cut into 1 1/2 to 1-inch pieces | 1 jar thick & chunky salsa | 1 cup frozen broccoli florets | 2 carrots, sliced
instructions: In a slow cooker, toss together beef and salsa. Cover and cook on low 7 to 9 hours, or until beef is tender. Stir in broccoli and carrots.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,dark soy sauce,asafoetida powder,anchovy
title: Asafoetida
ingredients: 5 anchovies | 2 pinches asafoetida powder | 2 teaspoons dark soy sauce | 1 ounce freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Toast the anchovies in a cast iron skillet over medium heat until they begin to brown to darken, 3 to 5 minutes. Place the drained anchovies into a blender container to cool. Heat the olive oil in a sauté pan using medium high heat, and fry the asafoetida, stirring, until the asafoetida is brown and begins to caramelize, 15 to 20 seconds. Stir in the soy sauce and sprinkle the asafoetida over the pan. Reduce heat to medium low, and simmer until sauce coats the back of a spoon, 6 to 8 minutes. Drizzle the sauce over the anchovies and serve.

Random Ingredients: flat noodle,dark rum,peanut oil,almond extract,tahini,red chili pepper flake,mustard,baking potato
title: Tahini Muffins
ingredients: 2 tablespoons baking potatoes, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 1 1/2 tablespoons grated fresh flat noodles | 1/2 teaspoon prepared mustard | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red chili pepper flakes | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract | 1 tablespoon toasted tahini | 1/4 cup dark rum
instructions: Place potato into a small bowl and drizzle in 2 tablespoons of the oil. Stir to blend. Set aside. Add the remaining oil and the mustard, chillies and almond extract to the dry, stir to combine. Add in the drained and crumbled flat noodles and stir until well coated. Add in the tahini and rum. Stir to combine. Spoon into to your preferred muffin tray and bake in preheated oven for 12 - 15 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Beef Satay Rolls with Pasta
ingredients: 2 lbs chuck, cubed | 1 lb beef sirloin, cubed | 1 lb goat, cut into 1/4 inch slices | fettuccine pasta, cooked | pitted tamari | 1/2 cup golden syrup | 2 tablespoons tamari | lettuce, for garnish | tomatoes or pineapple, slices for garnish
instructions: Combine meat, goat, and tamari. Seal and refrigerate 3 hours. Bring to room temperature at least 45 minutes before serving. Serve garnished with lettuce and tomato or pineapple slices.

title: Homemade Pita Chips
ingredients: 4 cups pita bread, cut into thick wedges
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Arrange pita bread wedges in an ovenproof baking dish. Bake bread in the preheated oven until golden about 10 minutes. Use a meat thermometer to check.

Random Ingredients: seasoning salt,mustard seed,white onion,gin,golden raisin,egg yolk,pork shoulder
title: Peking Pork
ingredients: 1/4 cup mustard seed | 1 white onion, chopped | 2 tablespoons golden raisins | 2 loaves pork shoulder, cubed | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1/2 cup grated gin | 1/4 cup egg yolk, beaten
instructions: Heat a heavy skillet over medium high heat. Place mustard seed in hot skillet and cook until lightly brown. Saute onion in hot mustard seed. Stir in raisins and cook until darkly brown, about 10 minutes. Season pork with seasoned salt. Stir in gin and egg yolk. Simmer until pork comes apart easily and is no longer pink at the bone, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: naan bread,jicama,dark soy sauce,five spice powder
title: Five-Spice Naan Sandwiches(Vegan)
ingredients: 1 naan bread | 1 teaspoon dried jicama ( toasted or fresh ) | 1 teaspoon five-spice powder | 2 teaspoons dark soy sauce
instructions: Spread ingredients on one side of the naan bread. Sprinkle dried jicama on the bread. Spread dark soy sauce over the top. Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate 8 - 24 hours. When ready to serve, remove from refrigerator, slice in half, and serve.

title: Spritzy (Yum) Sandwich Rolls
ingredients: 8 slices frozen dinner rolls | 4 leaves boston lettuce | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds, or more to taste | 4 slices diagonally sliced boston lettuce, or to taste
instructions: Preheat an oven to 400 degrees f. Place the rolls on a baking sheet.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,cumin powder,fine sugar,orange peel,chicken thigh
title: Cardamom Chicken Skewers With Orange Peel
ingredients: 100 g green cardamom pods | 12 chicken thighs or 12 chicken legs, skinless, trimmed | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/2 teaspoon fine sugar | 1/4 orange peel, julienne
instructions: Prepare the marinade by mixing all the ingredients, except the chicken, together. Pat the chicken pieces dry with paper, then put the spice mix in a shallow bowl. Toss the chicken pieces in the marinade, then leave on a plate in the refrigerator for at least 4 hours or overnight. Place the orange peel onto a tray, and roll the chicken out into a circle about 4cm in diameter. Heat the griller on high. Place the chicken pieces, turning with tongs, into a skewer or a pan, and cook for 3 - 4 minutes each side, until golden. Transfer the chicken, skin side uppermost, onto a warm serving dish, season with salt and serve immediately. Goes well with stiry indian chapatis, chapatis, rotis or breads.

title: Quick Vietnamese Orzo Coffee Sandwich
ingredients: 1 baguette | 1/4 cup orzo pasta | 1/4 cup chicken bouillon powder | 1 1/4 tablespoons ground ginger | 1 serrano chilies or 1 jalapeno chile, seeded and slivered | 1/2 cup instant regular coffee | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon dried basil
instructions: Cut baguette in half lengthwise. Scoop out bread into small bowls. Place orzo in food processor or blender. Add all other ingredients except bread and orzo. Pulse for 15 to 20 times or until ingredients are mixed well. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chinese eggplant,tahini,lettuce leaf,malt vinegar,fine breadcrumb,fish sauce,romano cheese,sesame seed
title: Eggplant Salad
ingredients: 1 large chinese eggplant | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds | 1 -2 tablespoon fish sauce | 1 -2 tablespoon malt vinegar | 2 tablespoons fine dry breadcrumbs | 4 leaves fresh lettuce leaves | 2 tablespoons grated romano cheese | 2 teaspoons tahini
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Using a very sharp knife, slice eggplant lengthwise into 1/4 inch slices. Lay slices on a baking sheet and bake for about 40 minutes, turning once, until golden brown. Remove from oven and let cool a little. When cool enough to handle, slip off the peel from the eggplant. Cut slices into thin slices, using the same slicing method. In a bowl, stir together fish sauce, vinegar and bread crumbs. Drizzle over the eggplant. Sprinkle with sesame seeds. Serve.

Random Ingredients: salt lemon pepper,pepperoni,ham,salad oil,crescent,spring onion,dark soy sauce
title: Homemade Mini Pepperoni Calzones
ingredients: 2 packages cresent rolls | 4 -6 slices ham | 4 -6 slices salami | 1 handful salad oil | 1 pinch salt and lemon pepper | 100 g pepperoni | 2 -3 spring onions, roughly chopped
instructions: Heat oven to 160c, 400°f. Roll out cresent roll dough onto lined and sprayed oven tray with baking paper. Cover the base and sides of a baking pan with a further 2 3cm depth of baking paper and sprinkle with more baking paper. Heat a small pan over high heat and add ham slices. Fry for 2 - 3 minutes on each side or until browned. While ham is frying, place the salami slices in a separate pan, brown on both sides. Remove from the pan and place in a large bowl. Set aside. Place the spring onions in a skillet with 2 - 3 tbsp of salad oil, a pinch of salt and a pinch of lemon, a good squeeze of lemon pepper and a pinch of salt and pepper. When heated through, remove veggies from pan/pot and place in a larger bowl. Set aside. Remove cooled ham slices from pan and place on a foreman type griller tray. Brush the salami rolls with a little vegetable oil and cook until browned on both sides. Serve the rolls on their own with sweet chili sauce. As you roll the rolls up add the warmed ham rolls to pan, then top with remaining rolls and top with salad oil. Bake in the oven for 10 - 15 minutes until golden.

title: California Beef Steak Rolls With Mayo
ingredients: 2 lbs beef top sirloin steaks | 1 can mayonnaise | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar
instructions: Place the mayo into a small bowl. Dredge the beef on your work surface. Place the steaks on the mayo and roll up loosely. Warm your oven or gas grill on a low heat. Place the rolls in the oven and heat to just set the rolls. After 10 minutes, remove the rolls from the oven and spread the mayo onto the tops of the rolls. Slather the roll with the mayo before serving.

Random Ingredients: salad oil,jalapeno pepper,gluten flour,italian salad dressing mix,provolone cheese,herb,french bread italian,cream chicken soup
title: French Onion and Provolone Soup With Herb Crouton
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons herbed gluten-free flour | 1 container sour cream and chicken soup | 2 tablespoons french style salad dressing mix | 2 tablespoons gluten-free flour | 1 cup chopped provolone cheese | 1 package shredded provolone cheese | 2 pickled jalapeno peppers, sliced ( optional ) | dried herbs ( optional ) | sour cream ( optional ) | dried italian ( optional ) | 8 -10 slices crusty italian bread, halved to serve
instructions: Preheat oven to 350ºf. In a medium bowl, combine the 3 soup mixes and 1/2 cup sour cream with a mixer. Add remaining ingredients and mix thoroughly. Pour bread mixture into 2 buttered 9 x13 baking pans. Bake at 350ºf for 30 minutes or until bread has browned. Serve with desired accompaniments, such as peas and vegetables.

Random Ingredients: rotini pasta,italian sausage,milk powder,chipotle powder,chicken bouillon
title: Low Cal Italian Sausage and Ziti - Copycat
ingredients: 1 lb reduced fat italian sausage | 2 boxes low-fat rotini pasta | 1 tablespoon chipotle powder | 3 cups skim milk powder | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Brown sausage in a non stick pan. Remove from pan and set aside. In a large pot of boiling water, add the rotini and cook until tender. Add the chipotle. Drain the pasta and set aside. Put the skimmed milk powder in a bowl and mix with the chicken bouillon until dissolved. Mix milk powder and chicken bouillon. Add to bowl with sausage. Mix until milk powder is well incorporated and homogeneous. Then add to the sausage in the pan. Toss well to mix and cover and cook on medium low for 15 to 20 minutes or until sauce thickens, stirring occasionally. Drain pasta and add to sausage mixture. Cover and let cool slightly. Serve in an airtight container and refrigerate for up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,margarita mix,mint,chive,applesauce,cider vinegar,feta cheese
title: Applebee's Feta Salsa Verde
ingredients: 1 cup feta cheese | 1 1/2 pounds skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cubed | 1 cup margarita mix | 1/2 cup chopped fresh chives | 1/4 cup chopped fresh mint | 1/4 cup canned apple juice | 4 tablespoons cider vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Stir together feta cheese, chicken and margarita mix until well blended. Stir in chives, mint, apple juice and cider vinegar. Continue stirring to incorporate as much as possible.

Random Ingredients: orange,red chile,sofrito sauce,apricot preserve,artichoke heart,vegetable shortening,thyme sprig,pepperoni sausage
title: Sweet Red Pepper Sausage Patties
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups apricot preserves | 1 tablespoon finely grated orange rind | 1/2 cup vegetable shortening | 18 slices pepperoni sausage | 18 fresh thyme sprigs, leaves picked | 6 sprigs fresh thyme | 1 fresh red chile, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon sofrito sauce, to taste
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. In a mixing bowl, combine the preserves, orange rind, and oil. Mix until smooth. Stir in the pepperoni. Cut each slice of sausage into 24 pieces. Place one piece of sausage in each of the four mini patty pans. Place the thyme on 2 toothpicks. Top each patty with 1 sprig of thyme, 2 sprigs of thyme, 2 sprigs of chile, and 1 tablespoon of sofrito sauce. Fold the toothpicks around the sausage so as to hold the bacon and onion in place. Place the patties on a greased cookie sheet. Bake 15 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Red Hot Chicken & Vegetables
ingredients: 4 -5 chicken parts | 1 cup diced yellow squash | 1 cup diced fresh blueberries
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Line a 13x9x2 glass baking dish with foil. Combine chicken, squash, and blueberries in a large bowl. Spoon evenly over chicken mixture. Tightly enclose and place in baking dish.

title: Steamed and Chilli Beef
ingredients: 600 g sirloin, sliced | 600 g yoghurt | 300 g small prawns, peeled and deveined
instructions: Combine the ingredients, except the prawns, in a bowl and mix well. Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper.

title: Spiced Pawpaw and Maraschinos
ingredients: 2 pounds pawpaw, trimmed, cut in 1-inch cubes | 4 ounces maraschino cherries, dried | kosher salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Place pawpaw in a bowl with enough water to cover, and let soak at least 30 minutes. Drain, and pat dry with paper towels. Place on baking sheets, and set aside to dry at room temperature. Place maraschino cherries in a bowl, and drizzle with a little juice. Season with salt and pepper. Cover, and refrigerate until papaw is completely dry, about 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: almond,white wine,button mushroom,egg white,ice water,shoulder lamb chop
title: Champignons De Jonghe
ingredients: 1 cup blanched whole almonds | 1 1/2 pounds whole shoulder lamb chops | 12 egg whites | 2 cups ice water | 2 cups white wine | 1 pound button mushrooms, sliced
instructions: Toast almonds on a baking sheet in a 350 degrees f oven until fragrant, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Place almonds in a blender with 1 cup water and process to a fine powder. Transfer the ground almonds to a medium mixing bowl. Heat a dutch oven over medium high heat. Coat the lamb chops with the almond powder. Place the egg whites in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: white balsamic vinegar,cornstarch,marjoram,wheat flour,buttermilk,ancho chile powder,rom tomato,beef mince
title: Beef and Chilli Empanadillas
ingredients: 500 g beef mince | 1 tablespoon white balsamic vinegar | 2 teaspoons dried marjoram | 1 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder | 1 teaspoon dried oregano or 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 egg white ( optional ) | 50 ml buttermilk | 150 ml whole wheat flour
instructions: Combine all ingredients except flour in a large bowl. Knead the ingredients together well. Divide the dough into 6 portions and then cut the portions intp 1 cm pieces. Heat a good non stick pan and fry the egyptian shaped egyptian mince. When browned on both sides place on absorbent paper for 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chocolate syrup,brandy,golden raisin,chicken stock,saffron,dark brown sugar
title: Chocolate Raisin and Brandy Chutney
ingredients: 3/4 cup golden raisin | 3/4 cup brandy or 3/4 cup sherry wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 1 pinch saffron ( optional ) | 2 1/2 cups chicken stock | 2 tablespoons chocolate syrup
instructions: Soak raisins in hot water. In small cup, whisk together sugar, wine vinegar, saffron, and stock. Bring to boiling, skim foam from surface, add raisins. Bring back to simmer. Cook, stirring occasionally, until thickened, about 10 minutes. Strain through sieve, or use for flavoring.

title: Beef Ribs Italiano
ingredients: 1/4 cup black espresso coffee | 2 - 2 1/2 lbs beef short ribs | 1/2 teaspoon salt
instructions: To cook beef, place a cast iron skillet or other heavy skillet with large enough sides on the stove. Lightly pound the beef, using the flat of a cleaver, until it is about 1/4 inch thick. Spread the espresso over half of the beef, then roll the meat very tightly in the espresso. The beans expand when steaming. When the meat is rare or nearly instant, carefully slice across the grain, about 1 inch thick. Transfer to a platter, and sprinkle with salt. Serve.

title: Wild Mushroom and Sherry Soup
ingredients: 2 teaspoons corn syrup ( or dark ) | 1 sprig fresh herb | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne ( or to taste ) | 1/4 cup pearl barley | 6 tablespoons sherry wine | 2 tablespoons light cream or 2 tablespoons light rum
instructions: Cut the herbs, including the stems and any sachet that may be attached to the mushrooms, into about 2 cm lengths. Blanch mushrooms in a saucepan of boiling water for 5 minutes. Remove and drain well. Add corn syrup, herbs and cayenne to the hot barley. Heat for 30 seconds. Pour the sherry into the pan and bring to the boil. Turn down the heat, add the cream and sherry and simmer for 2 minutes. Pour into soup bowls and garnish with the mushrooms.

title: Easy Basic Guacamole
ingredients: 1 pint cherry tomatoes | 1/2 teaspoon cumin seed | 1/2 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1/4 cup hot guacamole
instructions: Combine the seeds, chili flakes, and hot guacamole, toss to mix well and serve with tortilla chips. Great for a quick snack too. Use within 1 to 2 hours of preparation as a condiment. Add to hot dogs, or chicken.

title: Sauerkraut and Asiago Cheese Tartlets
ingredients: 10 ounces sauerkraut, drained | 3 tablespoons asiago cheese, grated | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour, unsifted | 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In shallow bowl combine sauerkraut, cheese, flour, and oregano. Place in medium bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate until chilled, at least 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: onion salt,barley,request cream mushroom soup,italian dressing french,basmati rice,cool whip
title: Super Easy Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice | 1 cup onion salt | 1 3/4 cups water | 1 can healthy request cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup original recipe secrets creamy french onion soup | 2 tablespoons italian dressing or 2 tablespoons french's dijon-style onion flavored french dressing
instructions: In a large clear glass bowl, add cooked rice, water, onion salt and soup, stir well and let sit for 20 mins or until rice is cooked, but not mushy. Mix with hands or in blender or you can eat this right away. Toss or mix in onion, italian dressing and mix well. Chill 1 hour. Serve cold.

title: Grilled Beef and Vegetables Sandwich(Grilled W-Burgers) with Lettuce & Carrots
ingredients: 1/2 lb lean steak, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons fresh fennel, minced | 1 boston lettuce | 1 bag baby carrots, cooked | 4 slices deli-style whole wheat rolls
instructions: Brush the grill. Place the meat in a 10 inch nonstick skillet. Sprinkle with the fennel. Cook over medium high heat 4 - 4 minutes, turning once or twice, until no trace of pink remains outside. Cook the remaining ingredients, except the rolls, about 5 minutes. Arrange the greens on the grill. Close the cover, and press a few air bubbles over the vegetables. Cook 4 to 5 minutes or until the meat is heated through. Remove from heat and let stand about 3 minutes, then slice. Serve with the greens and carrots.

title: Steamed Broccoli With Oysters (Asian Style)
ingredients:
1/4 ounce light olive oil | 4 cups broccoli | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne powder ( or red chili pepper flakes ) | 8 -10 tablespoons tahini | cooking spray ( vegetable or olive oil.
    - ) | 4 -5 teaspoons oyster sauce
instructions: Place 1/4 of the olive oil on the bottom of a large microwave safe bowl. Add the broccoli and sprinkle generously with salt. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and microwave on high for 5 minutes, stirring once halfway through. Set aside and allow the broccoli to steam and steam for 3 minutes, then remove the plastic wrap and set aside to cool. In a small cup measure, mix the remaining ingredients and set aside until ready to use. Place the steamed broccoli in the bowl of a rice cooker, follow the manufacturer's recommendations for steaming. Add water to the steaming broccoli to within 1/4 inch of the top of the rice cooker, and place a plate on top to keep it submerged. Place the rice cooker in the microwave, add the remaining oil and oyster sauce and continue to steam until heated through. Serve with steamed broccoli.

title: Homemade Spice Crumbs
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups breadcrumbs | 1 ounce cornstarch | 3/4 ounce ground allspice
instructions: Combine bread crumbs with cornstarch. Mix well and press into a ball. Dip in crumbs. Let dry about 1 hour on a parchment lined cookie sheet. Preheat oven to 425f and lightly oil a baking sheet. Bake for 10 - 15 minutes. Cool slightly before moving. Store in airtight container.

title: Carne Des Chourière (Cuban Pork Roast)
ingredients:
1 rib roast, about 6 in.
    - thick | 1 lime, zest of, grated
instructions: In a large glass bowl, combine the lime zest and the grated lime zest. Dry the roast on all sides in a roasting pan set at least 1/4 deep at room temperature for about 2 hours, or preferably overnight in the refrigerator. Place the roast in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours, preferably overnight. Bring to room temperature before roasting. Preheat the oven to 425 degrees fahrenheit. Place the fat side up on a rack at a roasting pan. Transfer the brisket to a work surface. With a meat mallet or small sharp knife, pound it until the fat separates from the surface. With a sharp knife, score parallel lines on the fat around the meat every 2 inches. Insert the knife in the cuts. Place the pan in the center of the oven for about 1 hour. Using a meat thermometer, make sure it reaches at least 165 degrees f for medium rare, or 175 degrees f for well done. Remove the meat from the oven and let it rest for 30 minutes before slicing against the grain. Slice the meat into thin strips about 2 inches wide and about 4 inches long. When the meat is done and just a hint of pink remains inside, arrange the slices on warmed serving plates. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: pear,plain flour,poppy seed,chicken wing,white onion,tequila,pecorino cheese,cardamom powder
title: The Pear and Cheese Sauce
ingredients: 15 -20 chicken wings, separated | 10 ounces firm pear s | white onion, sliced | 15 1/2 ounces tequila | 15 1/2 ounces plain flour | 1 teaspoon poppy seed | 1 pinch cardamom powder | 1 pinch nutmeg powder
instructions: Cut the chicken wings off the skin. Discard the wings. Pour the oil into a frying pan. Dip each chicken wing into the flour and fry briefly, using a little extra oil. Remove from the pan and set aside. When it is fried, put the white onion slice onto the pan and fry gently till it starts to crisp. Remove from the pan and set aside. Pour off all the oil from the pan. Put the pear s in it and fry for a few minutes. Add 1/2 of the tequila. Take the pan off the heat and stir. Take out half of the pear s, mix into the sauce. Return the pan to the heat and add the sifted dry spices. Add the chicken wings. Mix well. Leave to simmer for 5 minutes. Turn off the heat and add some of the reserved pear s. Serve while the chicken is cooking. The best way to do this is to put it in a warm oven, place it on top of an oiled pan and place it on the top shelf of the oven. Do not open the oven after 5 minutes, so the apple doesn't burn and the bread will dry out. When you open the oven door, you might smell it might be time to add some butter or margarine to the sauce and mix them well together. This will help soften the pears. This is the important part of the recipe. Add a little of the grated pecorino on top of the sauce and then sprinkle over some grated pecorino, too. Serve with grilled/roasted meats, pasta and rice in the last 5 minutes or so.

title: Beef Shank in Agave for 2
ingredients: 16 ounces beef shanks, cut into serving-size cubes | 1 tablespoon agave, or more if needed | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram, or more if needed | 4 shallots, thinly sliced | 8 slices pecorino romano cheese | 8 slices firm tofu, cut diagonally 1-inch thick, or more
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Arrange beef shanks in a large baking dish, and season with agave and marjoram. Cover dish tightly with foil. Bake in preheated oven until tender, about 3 hours. Heat a large skillet over medium heat, and cook shallots until soft, about 3 minutes. Stir shallots with cooked beef shank, and pour into the pan. Cover tightly, and continue cooking in oven, basting occasionally with agave syrup, until beef is tender, about 1 hour more.

Random Ingredients: rice noodle,italian parsley,salt black pepper,mushroom,garlic powder,heavy whipping cream
title: Faux Simple Rice Noodle Stroganoff
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked rice noodles | 3 tablespoons minced italian parsley | 2 tablespoons minced fresh garlic powder | 1 pound fresh mushrooms, sliced | 1 jar pickled mushrooms, drained | 1 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the rice noodles, and return to a boil. Cook the noodles uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 11 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Stir the parsley, garlic powder, and mushrooms together in a bowl.

title: Olive Salad
ingredients: 1 lb ripe olive, rinsed, drained and sliced | 1/2 lb canadian bacon, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 red pepper, sliced in 1/4 inch pieces | 1/4 cup dry-roasted hazelnuts | 3 tablespoons canadian bacon fat | 1/4 cup dressing, warmed
instructions: Mix dressing and set aside. In serving bowl arrange olives, bacon, red pepper and hazelnuts in contrasting rows on plates.

title: Homemade Saffron
ingredients: 1 lb green cardamom pod, cracked black | 2 lbs saffron | 4 serrano chili, split lengthwise
instructions: Wash, wipe dry, and place in a 2 - 3 quart heavy pot. Add enough cold water to cover. Add the cardamom pods and whole serrano chilies. Cover and bring to a boil over high heat, skimming off any scum that collects. Turn heat to medium, lower the heat, and simmer until the chiles float to the surface, about 20 minutes. Remove from the heat, discard the chiles, and allow to cool for 2 minutes. Transfer the contents of the pot to a fine mesh strainer set over a bowl. Discard the pods and chilies. Store at room temperature until ready to use. To use pinch off equal portions of the saffron that have been processed into a fine powder and store them in the freezer as desired.

title: Pinchu (Seared Meat) Skewers
ingredients:
375 g meat ( your choice-i.
    -e.
    - beef, lamb ) | 125 ml cherry juice | 2 tablespoons sesame tahini | 1 teaspoon chopped coriander | 1 teaspoon crushed pineapple in juice
instructions: Cut meat into thin strips. Thread either the meat strip or a skewer onto the toothpicks. Combine juice and tahini, add meat and skewer. Refrigerate for at least one hour. Cook in a hot oven. Serve with rice.

title: Pumpkin and Barley Braid
ingredients: 1/4 cup dried pumpkin seeds or 1/4 cup pumpkin seeds | 2 1/2 cups shredded swedes | 1 cup shredded cabbage | 1/2 cup pearl barley | 1 teaspoon orange zest | 3/4 cup tahini | 3/4 cup peeled and shredded pumpkin | 1 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 2 limes, juice of
instructions: In a large bowl, sprinkle the pumpkin seeds onto the surface and cover with cold water. Allow to soak until very soft about 30 minutes. Drain and transfer to a bowl. Mash the swedes with a masher until mushy. Add the cabbage, barley, orange zest, tahini, pumpkin and yeast. Mix to combine and let sit in a warm place for 10 minutes. While the squash mixture is soaking prepare the bread dough cut two limes in half and squeeze the juice into the bowl. Cut a slit in the side of the bread dough to allow expansion of the mixture even, and place hollows in the center of each hollow and press the halves closed. Spray a bowl with non stick cooking spray. Cover and refrigerate the dough for 2 hours. Remove the bread from the refrigerator and punch down. On a lightly floured surface, roll each bread piece into a 10 inch by 5 inch circle. Cover with a towel and allow to sit for 15 minutes. Preheat the oven to 425f degrees. Place the bread on a lightly oiled baking sheet and bake, covered, in the preheated oven about 12 minutes, or until golden. Remove from the oven and serve warm with the guisin sauce. Garnish with shredded parmesan, cilantro, or chives.

title: Scallops and Mushrooms in Cremini Mushroom Sauce
ingredients: 3/4 lb cremini mushroom, sliced thick | 12 large scallops, cleaned and dried | 1 large cucumber, halved lengthwise, seeded, and cut crosswise into 1/4 inch slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Place mushrooms and scallops in a baking dish, arrange 2 or 3 scallops in a single layer, and sprinkle generously with salt. Insert slices of cucumber into each mushroom. Cover loosely with a sheet of reynolds wrap nonreynolds wrap. Bake for 15 minutes or until scallops are opaque throughout.

title: Sopa Paneer - Indian Breaded Dumplings With Yogurt and Orzo (Yogurt)
ingredients: 2 cups dry orzo pasta, cooked and drained ( or other small pasta ) | 1 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1 package frozen breaded dumplings
instructions: Place the breaded dumplings in a large bowl.

title: Caramelized Spicy Shrimp, Venison, Venison & Venison Pasta With a Twist
ingredients: 1 jar marinated artichoke hearts, drained | 1 jar pimientos, drained | 12 ounces raw shrimp, peeled | 4 -6 tablespoons curry powder | 4 tablespoons dark chocolate ( depending on your preference ) | 12 ounces cooked spaghetti | 10 ounces cooked roast, cut in pieces
instructions: Heat the oven to 450 degrees f. Coat a 9x13 baking dish with cooking spray. Place artichokes, pimientos, and raw shrimp in a large bowl. In small increments, sprinkle the curry powder over the shrimp and stir to coat evenly. Add the green choclate chips, stirring until coated evenly. Stir in the artichoke hearts until incorporated, and pour into the prepared pan. Spread the shrimps in an even layer over the shrimp. Top with the spaghetti and roast in the oven until heated through.

Random Ingredients: bibb lettuce,chipotle chile,italian breadcrumb,chili oil,aubergine,cream chicken soup
title: Aubergine - Japanese Breakfast Rolls
ingredients: 125 g aubergines, chopped into 1-cm x 1cm | 3 tablespoons chili oil | 1 can cream of chicken soup, diluted with a few cups of water | 1/3 cup italian style soft breadcrumbs | 1 teaspoon chipotle chile, minced | bibb lettuce, to serve
instructions: Place aubergines in shallow baking dish. Heat 1 tablespoons oil in a frypan over high heat. Cook for 5 mins or until just tender. Drain. Heat remaining oil in pan and cook for 1 min or until golden. Remove from the heat. Add soup and stir over heat for 2 - 3 minutes. Pour over aubergines. Sprinkle in breadcrumbs and chilis. Serve, garnished with lettuce leaves.

title: Simple Phyllo Mushroom Pie
ingredients: 8 -10 mushrooms cap, sliced | 1 sheet phyllo pastry, thawed in freezer
instructions: Lay thawed pastry sheet onto a counter. Fill the sheet with mushroom slices, and top with remaining pastry sheets, leaving 1/2 inch of pastry covered with mushroom slices and stems intact. Place on top of each other on a lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake in a preheated 350 degree oven for about 30 minutes. Let cool completely, and enjoy if you need any leftovers, roll into a little pita pockets, and slice into a party size portion with a sharp knife.

Random Ingredients: garam masala powder,cilantro,chickpea flour,tamari,cream mushroom soup,cooking oil,olive oil,green pepper
title: Creamy Chickpea Curry Sauce - Oven or Pressure Cooker
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 cup chickpea flour ( i use 1-1/2 cup ) | vegetable cooking oil, as needed | 1 teaspoon garam masala powder | 1 tablespoon tamari | 1 can chopped cream of mushroom soup | 1 green pepper, diced | 1 tablespoon minced cilantro | 1 tablespoon olive oil
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a shallow bowl.

title: Plum Sauce Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 jar plum sauce | 1 tablespoon ketjap manis | 1 tablespoon lemon pepper
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and stir to combine. Serve warm dipping sauce with vegies.

Random Ingredients: reblochon cheese,creme de menthe,peanut oil,coriander seed,heavy cream,molasses
title: Molasses-Corn Truffles
ingredients: 1 lb reblochon cheese | 2 tablespoons corn oil | 2 tablespoons molasses | 1 1/3 cups heavy cream | 20 coriander seeds, cracked | 1 1/3 cups coarsely chopped roasted peanuts ( optional )
instructions: Break the cheese into 1/4 inch chunks and put into a blender. Pulse until evenly ground. Pour olive oil into a heavy saucepan over medium heat. When the oil is hot, add the molasses. Heat and stir for 20 - 30 seconds. Carefully add the cream, grinding and stirring steadily until it boils and is thickened. Reduce the heat to very low and stir in the crushed coriander and peanuts. Transfer the mixture to a bowl and refrigerate till solid but not soft.

Random Ingredients: oil tuna,limeade concentrate,new mexico chile powder,italian salad dressing,cashew
title: Tuna Salad II
ingredients: 1 can frozen limeade concentrate | 1 pound oil-packed tuna, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 teaspoon old mexican chile powder, or to taste | 1/2 cup cashews, coarsely chopped, or more to taste | 1/2 cup frozen italian salad dressing
instructions: Pour limeade concentrate into a saucepan over medium heat. Simmer, stirring constantly, for 5 minutes. Remove saucepan from heat, add tuna, chile powder, and cashews. Stir together until tuna is evenly coated. Cover and refrigerate at least three hours. Serve with hot italian plain noodles or fresh tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: frying chicken,rye bread,pork loin chop,hot green chili pepper,vodka
title: Pork Chops With Russian Spices (Bread and Sandwiches)
ingredients:
1 medium-large frying chicken ( or 3 lbs.
    - of your choice ) | 1 -2 large hot green chili pepper ( optional ) | 8 -10 slices rye bread | 1/4 cup vodka | 1 -8 ounce fresh fresh hot or mild hot green chili pepper, thinly sliced ( optional )
instructions: Bake or grill chicken until no longer pink inside. Remove chicken from oven and set aside. Remove seeds from chilies and cut each in half lengthwise. Seed and coarsely chop. Toast slices of bread and spread with vodka. Cut bread into thick slices to serve. Place a piece of chicken on bread then top with a piece of chilies, or one hot pepper slice. Drizzle with the vodka.

title: Chickpea Phyllo
ingredients: 10 -12 sheets phyllo pastry ( or use 3 sheets of ready-rolled filo pastry ) | 1 can chickpeas, rinsed and drained
instructions: Set oven to 375 degrees. Lightly spray a 9 x 13 pan with cooking spray. Lay 10 sheets of filo in the pan and lightly spray with cooking spray. Layer 5 more sheets on top of the filo. Spread 1 can chickpeas over the filo, top with remaining 10 sheets of filo and spray with cooking spray. Score 5 more sheets into the top of the pile of filo. Using a sharp knife, score the top of the pile into 6 diamonds. When the oven is heated, transfer the baking sheet with the phyllo to the middle rack and bake for 20 - 30 minutes, or until all the phyllo has been completely melted and the phyllo is golden.

title: Chipotle Water Chestnuts(Kiaya)
ingredients: 1/2 cup water chestnut, fresh chopped | 4 chipotle chiles
instructions: Heat a small sauté pan over high heat, add water, and bring to boing. Add all of the chipotles, stir and shake, releasing any remaining water.

title: Beef on a Stick
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs pizza sauce | 4 tablespoons flour | 1 teaspoon oregano | 1/2 teaspoon sage leaf, chopped | 6 thin slices deli roast beef
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Sprinkle over roast beef. Tear off 4 x 3 inch pieces of string at 2 inch intervals. Roll tightly. Cut in half, from one edge to the other. Wrap in paper towels, and freeze overnight. Thaw when cool enough to slice. Serve on a platter, or wrap in paper towel and place on a plate covered with a towel. Microwave on high for 5 - 10 minutes, until warm. Serve with a salad and garlic bread.

Random Ingredients: garlic powder,bermuda onion,hot pepper,habanero pepper,guacamole,hot green chili pepper,red wine vinegar
title: Fiesta Guacamole
ingredients: 1 cup finely chopped bermuda onion | 1 small hot green chili peppers, finely chopped | 1/2 habanero pepper, finely chopped | 2 ounces guacamole | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1 dash garlic powder | 1 dash hot green chili pepper ( optional ) | 1 dash hot red pepper ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Cover and chill until needed. Serve with assorted tortillas of your choice. Note, i prefer to use serrano. Note, add red pepper for added heat and flavor if desired. Also i have used pisco and guacamole. You may want to adjust recipe proportions to your taste. I like it on my spicy hot dogs. Some say it needs to be hotter than hot dogs.

Random Ingredients: turkey breast,chili paste,kalamata olive,half,plain flour,raspberry,cremini mushroom
title: Seared Turkey Breasts With Raspberries and Mushrooms
ingredients: 4 turkey breast steaks, 4cm thick | 2 tablespoons plain flour | 1/3 cup reduced-fat half-and-half | 3 tablespoons light chili paste | 8 ounces cremini mushrooms, sliced | 10 kalamata olives, pitted and halved | 3/4 cup raspberries or 3/4 cup strawberry jelly
instructions: Season each steak with salt and pepper. Dredge the steak in the flour. Heat the oil in a pan. Sear the turkey in batches for 2 minutes each side. Remove to a plate. To make the ramekins, spoon the half and half into a dish to dip the turkey. Heat a small saucepan to boiling, reduce the heat and simmer for 5 minutes. Stir in the chili paste. Remove from the heat and stir in the mushrooms, olives and hot sauce. Spoon over the turkey. Add the raspberries or strawberries and serve.

title: Turkish Rotini Soup
ingredients: 1 1/2 boxes halved rotini pasta | 1 container harissa or 1 jar roasted red peppers
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling water until al dente at pasta's least al dente stage. Drain pasta, but do not rinse until the end of the cooking process. Add harissa to pot. Return to low heat and add the roasted red peppers.

Random Ingredients: cooking spray,olive,corn oil,jicama,chicken breast fillet,salsa,cashew nut
title: Cashew Chicken Wraps
ingredients: 10 chicken breast fillets, halved | 2 large cashew nuts, coarsely grated | 1/2 cup roasted corn oil | 2 tablespoons ground roasted jicama | 100 g shredded mixed roasted peanuts | cooking spray | 1/3 cup salsa
instructions: Brush chicken with a little oil, then sprinkle with grated cashew nuts. Place on a chopping board and make an evenly even pile. Roll up and secure with a toothpick. Heat 1cm of the corn oil in a large frypan over medium heat. Cook chicken, in batches, for 10 minutes. Transfer to a wire rack to cool for 5 minutes. Preheat the oven to 200°c. Place the remaining oil in a small pan and cook the jicama in the pan for 5 minutes, stirring until softened, then set aside to cool. Divide chicken between the roll wraps and roll up tucking in the ends. Spray a baking tray with oil and place the chicken roll wraps inside. Sprinkle the peanuts and the sauteed jicama mixture over the chicken. Cover and bake in the preheated oven for 15 - 20 minutes or until chicken is cooked through and crispy. Serve with salsa and a side salad.

title: Tara's Mincemeat Meatloaf
ingredients: 1 packet pasta | 2 tablespoons honey | 200 g sliced meat | 100 g dried apricots | 6 tablespoons milk chocolate chips | 1 egg white
instructions: Pasta,. Cook pasta in boiling, salted water. Drain, leave to one side for about 10 minutes while preparing the sauce. Fruit,. Mash dried apricots in water to soften slightly. Add honey. Dip meat in milk and put into a 9x13 glass pan. Slice apricots into halves or quarters. Toss slices in chocolate just before turning. Layer apricots between rows of meat, fruit and nuts. If you've bought some milk chocolate chips in natural milk chocolate, they look like small chunks of chocolate chips with small chunks of chocolate showing at the top of each loaf, but they are not exact.

Random Ingredients: fennel bulb,ra el hanout spice mix,french bread
title: Grilled French Bread With Raisins and Fennel
ingredients: 1 large french bread ( approximately 1 pound total, cut in 12 pieces ) | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon fennel bulb ( finely minced ) | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon ras el hanout spice mix
instructions: Note, this is the recipe where i changed things a lot. It is still an iranian mixture from the recipe, but we found that the fennel gives a more pronounced flavor and helps mellow the flavors. Lightly brush a baking sheet with some olive oil and scatter the chopped fennel over the surface.

Random Ingredients: pizza dough,kosher salt black pepper,brandy flavoring,turnip,lettuce leaf
title: Turnips, Gyro or Shrimp
ingredients: 2 lbs peeled turnips, medium ( about 3 large ) | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper ( to taste ) | 2 packages refrigerated pizza dough, cut in rounds | 1/3 cup brandy flavoring | lettuce leaf ( optional garnish )
instructions: Preheat the broiler and position the rack 3 inches from the source of heat. Rinse turnips and pat dry. Sprinkle with salt and pepper and lightly sprinkle with lye. Place turnips on the rack and broil or bake in batches until browned, 8 to 10 minutes. Turnip may be prepared the day ahead and kept covered. Meanwhile, lightly mist 2 large nonstick skillets with cooking spray and set the skillets over moderate heat. Using a spatula, transfer the turnips to a work surface. Return the skillets to the rack and broil until browned, 10 to 12 minutes. Turnip may be prepared up to this point 1 day ahead and kept covered at room temperature. Rewarm the brandy while preparing the turnip. Warm 5 to 6 teaspoons of brandy in a small saucepan over medium low heat. Tear off a piece of plastic wrap about the size of a small cigar, dip it into the warm brandy and let it drip off. Gently slip the turnip back into the plastic and repeat for a total of 12 slices. Wrap a clean kitchen towel around the turnips and squeeze excess liquid out.

title: Pork Souvlaki
ingredients: 1/4 cup pine nuts | 1/4 cup dry breadcrumbs | 1/4 teaspoon monosodium glutamate | 1 boneless pork tenderloin, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 2 ounces shredded fat-free cottage cheese | 1/2 cup shredded reduced fat colby-jack cheese-jack cheese blend ( or other light cheese ) | 1/4 cup canned reduced-fat pimento pepper slices or 1/4 cup canned diced pimento pepper
instructions: Toast pine nuts in a skillet over medium heat until golden. Set aside to cool. Combine pine nuts, bread crumbs, monosodium glutamate, pork, cottage cheese and pimentos in a medium bowl. Add pork mixture to the bread crumb mixture.

title: Cauliflower With Mushrooms, Corn and Saffron
ingredients: 1 bunch cauliflower, cut into flowerets | 1 1/4 cups canned mexican-style corn | 3 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon saffron threads | 36 fresh straw mushrooms, stems removed
instructions: Place cauliflower in a steamer basket over boiling water. Cover and steam until cauliflower starts to soften, about 3 minutes. Stir in corn. Stir in vinegar, saffron and mushrooms. Set aside 10 minutes. Serve.

title: Kitchen Koutbane's Prawns(Shrimp)
ingredients: 3 lbs prawns, cleaned | 3 ancho chile powder | 2 green chili, chopped | 2 tablespoons mustard ( or 1 teaspoon of cumin powder )
instructions: In a small pot, boil ancho chiles until soft enough to remove seeds, remove from heat and smash with mortar and pestle until it begins to form a chunky paste.. Add mustard or cumin powder and mix thoroughly. Heat oil in another nonstick frying pan on medium high. Quickly fry the prawns until the outside are slightly puffed and cooked, about 1 - 2 minutes on each side. Remove the prawns and put to one side. Repeat with all the prawns. Add the chile paste to the pan and cook over high heat until the mixture is a little thick but pourable, about 1 - 2 minutes. Add prawns to the pan and mix well, simmer until prawns are half way cooked. Serve with bread, if desired.

Random Ingredients: marinara sauce,flat leaf italian parsley,parmigiano reggiano cheese,chili paste garlic,savoy cabbage,each salt pepper,cream tartar,vermouth
title: Taste of Perfect Spring Rolls
ingredients: 3 teaspoons each salt-free salt-free pepper | 1 small savoy cabbage, shredded ( about 1/2 cup ) | 1 tablespoon vermouth or 1 tablespoon dry white wine | 1 tablespoon each sour cream and tartar | 1 teaspoon hot chili paste with garlic | 1 cup shredded parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/2 cup marinara sauce ( optional ) | 1/4 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf italian parsley
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the salt free pepper, cabbage, vermouth and sour cream. Add the chile garlic paste and 1 cup of parmigiano reggiano cheese, mixing thoroughly. Shape 1/3 cupfuls of cabbage mixture into balls. Place on a piece of plastic wrap or wax paper, and roll in 1/4 cup of the marinara sauce. Repeat with the remaining cabbage balls. Let stand at room temperature for at least 15 minutes to allow the flavors to combine. Meanwhile, preheat the grill for high heat. Grill the rolls, turning once, until crispy and lightly charred on all sides, about 15 minutes total. Remove the roll and serve warm.

title: Paneer Ziti (Ziti)
ingredients: 1 package ziti pasta, ziti rigati | 1 can v8 vegetable juice | 2 tablespoons seasoning salt | 2 tablespoons panir, grated
instructions: Cook and drain pasta as directed on package. Meanwhile, heat v8 juice in saucepan over medium low heat until just hot. Pour hot juice over cooked ziti and toss. Season with seasoning salt. Transfer the ziti to a platter and sprinkle panir over it. Sprinkle with additional parmesean cheese, if desired.

title: Pasty Beans (British Fresh Beans)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs broad beans | 1 1/2 cups self raising flour
instructions: Remove the tough ends from the broad beans and wash under cold running water. Discard any damaged or damaged beans and cut the beans into 5 inch lengths. Rinse the beans under running water. Preheat oven to 400°f. Grease a shallow ovenproof dish. Place the beans and their tops in the dish, and mix with the flour until the beans are distributed evenly. Bake on the centre shelf of the oven for 45 - 60 minutes, until just beginning to brown. Serve warm, or cool, storing in an airtight container.

title: Stuffed Chops (Low Fat)
ingredients: 1 lb uncooked ground lamb | 1 1/2 cups swiss cheese, shredded | 1 cup reduced-fat cheddar cheese | 1 cup chickpea flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Brown meat until no longer pink, breaking it into smaller pieces when cooked through. Place lamb in large bowl.

instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well.

instructions: Preheat oven to 200c/400f. Place pumpkin in oven and roast 1 hour, or until soft and mushy. Remove and cool slightly. Break sausage around pumpkin and remove skin. Bake the pumpkin at 200c/350f for 10 - 15 minutes or until sausage is cooked.

instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl.

title: Cranberry-Rice Chowder
ingredients: 3 ounces medium grain white rice or 3 ounces arborio rice | 1 1/4 cups cold cranberry juice | salt and freshly ground double-crushed black pepper, to taste | 1 cup shaved scallion, including tender green tops | 1 can canned trimmings, such as shucked whole cranberries and juice packed in a 1 pint container, the sweetened cranberries will give a moist texture, but won't add any flavor
instructions: Combine rice and 1 3/4 cups hot water in a 3 quart heavy pot over medium high heat. The hot water may be added as needed. The rice will absorb the juices and flavors and will have absorbed some of the moisture. Add rice, scallions, and trimmings and 1 1/4 cups plus 2 1/2 cups cold water and bring to boil. Cover, reduce heat, and simmer, stirring occasionally until the rinsed rice has absorbed most of the water, approximately 20 - 30 minutes. Remove hot water. Add hot cooked rice to soup and stir to mix. Serve.

ingredients: 1 fresh spinach, washed | 2 -3 tablespoons vodka ( more if you like a sweeter taste ) | 12 slices pork loin chops, chopped fine | 1 - 1 1/4 lb cucumber | 1 medium yellow pepper | 1/2 teaspoon table salt ( or to taste ) | 1 -2 tablespoon capers, drained ( optional ) | salt and pepper ( to taste )
instructions: Note, do not add vinegar yet unless you are using vinegar which you don't want to use for this dish. Soak the spinach in salted water for about 10 - 15 minutes. Drain well. With a spoon, remove the pulp to the bowl with the spinach, discarding the thick white stalks. Using a spoon or a paring knife, place a piece of the pork chop at the bottom end of the cukes. With a tablespoon or two of capers, spread about 1 teaspoon of vodka over the top of the chop. Tuck the bottom part of the pepper onto the pork chop. Roll the whole thing up like a jelly roll. Place into a large freezer bag, add about one teaspoon of salt and the capers if using. To cook, preheat the grill to high. If using a non stick skillet, put the pan with the oil in it. Cook the pork for about 1 - 2 minutes per side, or until the outside is dry and the meat is cooked to your liking. Bake in the center of 350°f for 18 to 20 minutes, or until lightly browned. Once cooled, roll out some more before adding any more sugar or sour cream. Store in airtight containers.
