instructions: Preheat the oven to 475 degrees f and line a baking sheet with parchment. Place the paneer cubes in a food processor, whiz briefly to break them in into small pieces and then grind into a fine meal. Heat the oil with a pinch of salt in a large frying pan over medium high heat. Add the cubed paneer and sauté, stirring to coat and turning frequently, until golden brown, about 5 minutes. Remove the pan from the heat, then set aside. In a blender, whizz the cream cheese to a smooth paste. Add the melted cream cheese, five spice powder, peanut oil and white pepper, whiz through until combined. Stir in the flour and sugar just until the mixture firms up, then transfer the mixture to a small oven tray with a circle of parchment. Bake in the preheated oven until the bread is golden brown and the paneer thick and crispy, about 20 minutes.

title: Lemon-Lemongrass Porridge
ingredients: 2 tablespoons lemon grass, finely chopped | 1 cup whole milk ricotta cheese | 3 tablespoons fresh lemon juice ( about 3 lemons )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium sized bowl and whip until fluffy, but not dry. Serve hot.

title: Aunt Kathy's Baked Lamb Fingers
ingredients: 2 pounds boneless lamb, cut into 24 very thin fingers | 1 cup canola oil | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour for coating | chili powder for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Place lamb fingers in a single layer on prepared baking sheet. Drizzle with canola oil. Mix flour with chili powder. Gently toss fingers until coated with flour mixture. Arrange finger slices in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet. Sprinkle with more chili powder if desired.

title: Peking Fried Plantains (Pan-Fried Plantains)
ingredients: 4 medium ripe plantains, peeled | 2 cups strong brewed coffee | 1/4 cup honey | 1 tablespoon mustard powder | 1/2 cup peanut oil or 1/2 cup vegetable oil
instructions: Slice the plantains lengthwise into 1/4 thick half moons. Batten the slices out by rolling them into a flat disk shape. Place them flat atop sheets of waxed paper or plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight, turning every hour or so. The next day, drain excess liquid from plantains. Mix together the coffee and honey and marinate the plantains for about 15 minutes. Heat oil in a wok or deep fryer over medium heat. Quickly fry the plantains, a few pieces at a time, tossing to ensure even frying. Place the plantains, with their marinade, in the steaming hot oil and cook, turning occasionally, about 5 minutes, or until plantains are golden brown.

Random Ingredients: lasagna noodle,parsley leaf,tea,active yeast,vegetable oil cooking spray,coconut,pistachio
title: Lite Indian Naan
ingredients: 1/4 cup dried salted pistachios | 2 lbs fresh lasagna noodles ( no-boil type ) | vegetable oil cooking spray | 6 cups warm tea | 1/2 cup dried shredded coconut | 3 tablespoons dried parsley leaves | 1 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Soak peanuts in a little hot water 10 minutes, then rinse with cold water. In a bowl, place dried nuts and stir to mix. Drain and set aside. Slice the lasagna sheets into 1/16 inch wide slices. Spray a 12x9 inch baking dish with vegetable oil spray. Set aside. Coat a large potful of water with cooking spray. Place on high heat for 12 to 15 minutes. Drain peanuts. Drain the peanuts. Return the peanuts to the pot. Add 1 3/4 cups of the warmed tea. Place a layer of noodles on the bottom of the greased pan. Spread the peanuts evenly over the noodles, then top with a noodle layer. Spread the rest of the tea mixture over and on top of the noodles. Sprinkle with coconut, parsley and yeast. Cover in a pan of hot water until it reaches a depth of 2 inches over the noodles. Bake for 45 - 50 minutes or until noodles are tender. Remove from oven and let sit 5 minutes before serving. Cut into squares to serve.

Random Ingredients: caper,golden syrup,grain mustard,cream mushroom soup,pepper sauce,milk powder
title: Mock Devonshire Sauce
ingredients: 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup cream mixed with evaporated milk powder ( i like vanilla milk ) | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 2 tablespoons capers | 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1 teaspoon dry whole grain mustard
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan. Bring to a boil and reduce heat.

title: Canadian Bacon & Chilli Flatbreads
ingredients: 2 flat bread, flatbread or 2 pita bread | 1 -2 tablespoon ground red chilies | 2 slices canadian bacon, diced | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Mix chilies and canadian bacon together. Use an open flat bread that has been flattened out a little on the edges and place the chilies and canadian bacon on it. If you like really crispy, mix the two halves together to form a pancake shape and place on a plate. Spray with oil or you can just cook the flatbread. Top with the spicy mixture and cook in a non stick griddle on medium heat for about 5 minutes.

title: Carne Adovada(Cuban Spareribs With Meat)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs pork ribs, in pieces | 2 lbs dried fat-free pork fat | 1/4 teaspoon msg, for the accent color
instructions: Rinse the meat and drain well. Rinse the fat from the pork. In a large pot add the meat, msg and a little water. Stir well. Bring to boil and boil slowly for an hour or longer. Turn off heat. Remove ribs with a slotted spoon, save the juices and serve with rice.

title: French Onion Bouillon Dressing for Corned Beef
ingredients:
1 large vidalia onion | 1/2 teaspoon accent seasoning | 3/4 teaspoon bouillon ( you may use 3/4 tsp.
    - if your tastes runnier )
instructions: Slice onion in thin half moons. Place slices in saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a boil. Turn heat down and simmer at least 30 minutes or longer depending on how thick you like the onions. When onions are tender, drain and cool. Drain liquid and reserve and place liquid in a blender, onion, accent and bouillon to taste. Cover and blend at high speed to make your own flavored dressing.

Random Ingredients: orange zest,mayonnaise,pecorino romano cheese,maraschino cherry,chili sauce,dark sesame oil,italian spice,whipping cream
title: Italian Cheese Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream | 2 teaspoons chili sauce | 1/2 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1 teaspoon orange zest or 1 teaspoon orange marmalade | 1/4 teaspoon italian spices | 1 cup pecorino romano cheese, freshly grated | 1/4 cup bottled chili sauce, such as kikkoman hot chocolate | 1/4 cup chopped candied cherry ( to garnish )
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cheese and cherry, blending well. Cover tightly and refrigerate for at least one hour and up to 24 hours. After serving, garnish with toasted cherries.

Random Ingredients: water chestnut,white sesame seed,spaghetti sauce,corn tortilla chip,cheese ravioli,napa cabbage,baby spinach,pecorino cheese
title: Vegetable and Poppy-Seed Ravioli With Spicy Cheese
ingredients:
1 lb spaghetti sauce ( i use classico southwest burgundy ) | 3 tablespoons sesame seeds ( toasted, or 2 1/2 tbsp.
    - coarsely chopped peppercorns ) | 1/3 cup water chestnut, minced | 7 ounces refrigerated fresh cheese ravioli | 1 large napa cabbage, shredded | 1 cup baby spinach | 1 1/2 cups coarsely grated pecorino cheese | corn tortilla chips
instructions: Heat sauce over low heat. Spray a 9x13 inch glass baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Spread sesame seeds over the bottom of dish. Layer 1/3 of the ravioli in the dish, cutting in between the layers, if necessary, to coat the ravioli completely. Stir together water chestnut with the cheese ravioli. Spread the remaining ravioli on top of the chestnut mixture. Scatter the spinach over the top. Top with the cabbage and the remaining ravioli. Sprinkle the cheese over. Bake uncovered at 375 degrees f. For 12 min. Uncover.

title: Tropical Fruit Juice(ATK)
ingredients: 12 ounces orange juice | 12 ounces maraschino cherries | 1 tablespoon minced chives
instructions: Place all ingredients in a blender and process until smooth.

title: Neapolitan Lobster and Crab Sushi
ingredients: 12 large mussels, scrubbed and debearded | 12 small napa cabbage, thinly sliced lengthwise | 1/3 cup mirin, or to taste ( may sub a couple of tablespoons rice wine vinegar ) | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 1 1/2 tablespoons canned chili, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Heat a large non stick skillet over medium heat. Add the mussels, and place them in the skillet with a lid. When the mussels start releasing their juice, stir in the napa cabbage and cook until they start to wilt, 2 to 3 minutes. Stir in the mirin, and season with soda and chill, if desired. Pour the mixture into a clean resealable plastic zipper bag, and squish it around to make sure the mussels are evenly coated. Place the bag, then refrigerate until firm, at least 8 hours, but up to 6 days. Serve in deep salad bowls with warm, crusty bread.

title: Apple Butter
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups icing sugar | 2 tablespoons chopped shallots or 1 1/2 tablespoons diced scallions | 1 teaspoon finely grated fresh horseradish | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice | 2/3 cup apple juice
instructions: Using a mixer, beat icing sugar, shallots, horseradish and allspice until smooth. Beat in juice until smooth. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour for easier spreading.

title: Roasted Ginger Chicken
ingredients: 1 cup unsalted chicken broth | 1/2 cup miso | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste
instructions: Place the chicken broth and miso in a covered 1 1/2 quart, oven proof skillet. Cover and cook in a 400f degree oven, or until the chicken is tender and tender when pierced with a knife.

title: Lebanese Grilled Turkey
ingredients: 1 turkey breast | 1/2 cup sweetened pesto sauce | ice water | cinnamon sugar, optional
instructions: Cut turkey breast lengthwise into 12 slices.

title: Ethiopian Spicy Quinoa With Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked quinoa, rinsed well | 2 tablespoons butter | 1 tablespoon kikoman jerk seasoning, blend | 2 -3 cardamom pods | 1 teaspoon crushed dried spicy red pepper flakes or 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom seed
instructions: In a saucepan, combine all ingredients. Bring to a boil, then cover, reduce heat, and simmer for 20 minutes, fluffing rice with a fork.

title: Roasted Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 12 large shiitake mushrooms | kosher salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Rinse and discard any damaged or woody stems from mushrooms. Preheat the oven's broiler and spread the mushrooms out onto a baking sheet. Sprinkle generously with salt and pepper. Broil the mushrooms until just beginning to brown, about 5 minutes. Watch carefully and broil until the mushrooms are golden brown and soft, about 2 minutes more. Be careful, as mushrooms can easily burn. Slice the mushrooms into 1/2 inch thick slices and serve.

title: Lentil Pie
ingredients: 2 cans condensed italian-style stewed tomatoes | 1 bag brown lentil ( green or red ), rinsed and drained | 1 package of sliced chocolate
instructions: Layer brown lentils, cubed chocolate in bottom of 9 pie pan. Spread lentils in pan layer of tomatoes on top and spread out to cover. Top with layer of diced chocolate and refrigerate for a few hours. Bake at 350°f for 45 minutes or until chocolate is melted and lightly browned.

title: Caramelized Beef and Pork
ingredients: 1 -2 lb boneless pork roast | 1 lb stewing beef, cut into 1/2-inch thick slices | 1/2 cup chopped onion | 1/2 cup chopped shallots or 4 tablespoons onions, minced | 1 can refried beans with liquid | 1 package chopped dried cherries | 1/2 teaspoon salt or 1/2 teaspoon salt substitute
instructions: In a heavy kettle, brown roast in hot oil. Transfer meat into roasting pan, adding remaining ingredients. Cover and simmer for 2 hours, or until meat and vegetables are tender and flavors are well blended. Serve in sandwiches, with a salad.

title: Coriander (couscous) Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef chuck | 1 cup coriander leaves ( cilantro leaves ) | 2 tablespoons dried oregano leaves
instructions: Cut the beef into bite sized chunks. Chop coriander finely. Place beef in a large saucepan with enough water to cover. Cover and cook over low heat for about 3 hours until tender. Cool. Place oregano leaves in a blender and process into a paste with 1 cup of cold water. Stir into stew. Serve with couscous, vegetables or rice.

Random Ingredients: pork sausage,colby monterey jack cheese,black tea
title: Mexican Jack Breakfast
ingredients: 4 slices pork sausage | 2 slices colby-monterey jack cheese | 12 small steamed eggs
instructions: Cut a slit on each slice of sausage, and stuff with a slice of cheese. Place in a medium size bowl, and microwave two to three eggs on high until they are barely set but not hard. Break the eggshells into four pieces, and roll up each into a cone shape. Fill each cone with the beaten egg, and microwave three to four slices of sausage for an additional minute. Remove, and wrap well.

Random Ingredients: rice vinegar,hamburger,meat,salmon,grand marnier,garam masala powder,caraway seed
title: Salisbury Steak with Gravy and Gravy
ingredients: 4 -6 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala powder | 1 tablespoon minced fresh garlic ( or to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon caraway seed | 1 - 1 1/2 lb hamburger, cut into 1 inch cubes ( or can use your favorite meat ) | leftover cooked hamburger, cut in 1 1/2 inch pieces ( optional ) | leftover cooked salmon, cut into 1/2 inch cubes ( optional )
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together garlic, garam masala powder and caraway seeds until blended. Add meat and toss to coat. Place meat in a non reactive baking pan. Bake, uncovered, in a preheated 450 degree oven for 20 minutes. While meat cooks, prepare gravy. When meat is done, drain and place in gravy. Serve with gravy. Note, you can make your own gravy and gravies just before you're finished roasting the meat. For gravy, melt a small amount of butter in a skillet. Add the potatoes.

title: Zucchini Snow Pea With Rice
ingredients: 300 g rutabagas | 350 g green zucchini | 350 g snow peas | 1 cup short-grain rice | 1/3 cup corn oil
instructions: Wash the zucchini and snow peas and leave them to dry out. Slice one/half of the zucchini and one/half of the snow pea pods, and slice the other half into pieces. Cut the white part of the green parts and the yellow part of the orange with the zucchini into small squares. If you have a melon baller, cut out the segments of the zucchini just before adding to the rest. Take the rice and drain it for several minutes. Add a tablespoon of corn oil into a wok and heat to a temperature of 360°f. Take a piece of zucchini, then add a teaspoon of oil and it is ready to put rice on top of the zucchini in the wok. Quickly take the rice out and put the other half of the snow pea pieces onto the rice. Quickly add the rice onto the wok and stir, cooking for a further 1 minute. When the rice starts to turn transparent, pour in enough water, cover it, and turn the heat down to its lowest setting. Let it cook for another 10 - 15 minutes. After a couple of hours it should be cooked. If not start cooking for another 10 minutes.

title: Spanish Lamb-potato, Pork and Potato Casserole
ingredients: 1 kg lamb, diced | 5 kg potatoes, sliced | 1 kg chicken meat, diced | 3 -4 sprigs thyme leaves | 4 -5 dashes of mexican adobo sauce | 4 tablespoons chopped fresh thyme leaves
instructions: Pre heat oven to 200c. Season lamb with thyme, ground adobo & thyme then place in a large baking dish. Pour over enough water to come halfway up the sides of the meat. Cover with foil paper and bake for an hour. Remove from oven and cover beef, potatoes and chicken with foil foil and allow to sit for further 30 minutes. Remove foil and continue to cook until the beef and potatoes are tender and the meat is cooked through. Turn off heat and allow to finish cooking through prior to serving with couscous and salad.

title: Mustard Brew
ingredients: 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 4 tablespoons mustard greens | 4 teaspoons tomato juice or 4 teaspoons tomato paste | 4 teaspoons silver tequila, for garnish
instructions: Stir all of the ingredients together, except the tequila. Pour into a glass.

title: Spaghetti With Serrano Chile
ingredients: 4 white fish fillets ( or use haddock ) | 4 serrano chili | 1/2 cup hazelnuts | 1/4 cup cumin | 8 1/2 ounces dried spaghetti
instructions: Boil water. Trim off fillets of any extra white portion and cut fish into slices about 1 1/2 inches wide. Cut chili in half from stem to base, remove seeds and veins. Place 2 pieces of fish in boiling water. Cook till just done, then drain. Discard skin. Set aside. In skillet heat hazelnuts. Remove skins of chili, but leave any seeds in the chili. Add cumin to hazelnuts, shaking skillet, stirring till hazelnuts are light golden. Add chili to fish and stir to coat pieces evenly with hazelnut mixture. Fry pasta in same pan used to cook fish, till pasta is tender and fish flakes easily when tested with a fork. Place cooked pasta in serving dish and top with sauce. Sprinkle with fresh coriander. Serve with green salad.

title: Sydney Clam Soup
ingredients: 1 can minced clams in juice | 1/2 cup sauerkraut with garlic | 2 tablespoons soymilk | french bread, cut into 3/4 inch slices | sweet potato, peeled and cut into 3/4 inch slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In 4 to 6 quart electric kettle, combine clams and sauerkraut with garlic. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer, partially covered, 10 minutes. Line a baking sheet with foil. Brush bread with soy milk. Spoon about 1/2 cup of the clam mixture into bread slices. Top each with sweet potato slices. Cover and bake 30 minutes. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chocolate ice cream,canadian bacon,egg yolk,rice wine,bean sprout,stock cube
title: Canadian Manchego and Bacon Ice Cakes
ingredients: 250 g bacon, slices | 250 g bean sprouts | 300 g chocolate ice cream, softened | 1/2 teaspoon rice wine | 2 egg yolks | 3 tablespoons stock cubes
instructions: Fry bacon until crispy. Break in pieces and add to a medium bowl. Wipe frying pan with paper towel and add bean sprouts. Add a small amount of oil to the frying pan and cook the sprouts until slightly browned. Add to bacon. Add rice to pan and stir fry until heated through. Add stock cubes and stir until boiling. Add to bowl with bacon mixture and mix gently until coated with a mixture of sauce and vegetables. Serve immediately in mugs with toasted french bread.

Random Ingredients: red chile pepper,graham cracker crumb,bratwurst,dill,orange peel,dark rum,mace,buttermilk
title: Rhumlette
ingredients: 1/4 cup dark rum | 1/4 cup buttermilk | 1 small red chile pepper, finely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon ground dill | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1/4 teaspoon ground red chile pepper | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 1/4 cup seasoned graham cracker crumbs
instructions: In a microwave safe bowl, combine rum, buttermilk, red pepper, dill, nutmeg, mace, and crab seasoning. Cover.

Random Ingredients: spice,beef broth,red wine,cranberry juice,beef sirloin steak,cornish hen,orange juice
title: Brioche
ingredients: 4 cornish hens | 6 ounces dried cranberry juice | 3 tablespoons dried orange juice | 6 tablespoons red wine | 1 beef broth | 1 spice, cube | 1 tablespoon of your finest beef gravy seasoning ( i like to add a cube of dijon )
instructions: Sprinkle two seasoning cubes inside a clean plastic bag, add the roast/beef, add meat. Seal bag, mix and place bag inside a very large bowl. Add cranberry juice, orange juice, red wine and beef broth. Pour mixture over the beef and marinate for 3 hours or longer. Place roast/beef mixture into crockpot on low. Strain and serve in big soup bowls along with a bit of gravy on top. This also goes well with mashed potatoes and steamed veggies.

title: Chaala Gobhi
ingredients: 3 lbs chopped shin beef | 3 ounces coriander roots, chopped | 6 ounces ginger paste | fresh spinach
instructions: Wash and clean spinach. If using dried shini we have this option. Rinse and squeeze out all water. Grate fresh ginger and finely chop coriander roots and place in a pot with the beef. Add water until it covers them and bring to the boil. When the meat is half cooked through, add the ginger root and fry for 20 minutes to soften the meat. Add the chopped coriander roots and fry the shinig for 5 - 6 minutes. Remove the meat to the kitchen board. When the shinig is sufficiently cooked add salt to taste. Garnish with freshly chopped spinach.

title: Grilled Chicken With Banana and Pine Nuts and Raisins
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ground cinnamon | 3 tablespoons grated fresh romano cheese | 4 whole chickens, cut into 8 pieces | 4 medium size bananas, peeled and cut lengthwise into 1/8-inch-thick slices | 16 ounces grilled chicken, cut into 8 pieces | 2 -8 ounces pine nuts | 1 jar pitted green olives, drained | 2 packages fresh romano cheese, grated
instructions: In shallow large bowl, combine cinnamon and cheese. Sprinkle chicken pieces with salt and pepper and place in bowl. Turn to coat. Set aside. Combine bananas, chicken and pine nuts. Place a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. When just beginning to smoke, add chicken. Stir often until all sides are golden, but still moist. Spoon half the banana mix into center of the chicken, spreading to cover chicken completely. Arrange the bananas evenly over the chicken and sprinkle with the cheese. Turn chicken over. Turn back to the other side, spread the remaining banana mix on top. Cover and cook until chicken is cooked through, about 20 minutes. Spoon remaining banana mix onto plate and serve.

title: Mexican Rollups
ingredients: 1 bag lasagna noodles, uncooked | 1 medium carrot, shredded | 1 package egg noodles | 1/2 bunch fresh cilantro, chopped | 1/2 bunch fresh cilantro, chopped
instructions: Cook lasagna noodles in large pot of boiling water until cooked through, about 1 minutes. Drain. Spread 1 cup of sauce in each bowl of a 9x13 inch baking dish. In medium bowl, mash carrots with fork. Coat a dinner fork or spoon inside each noodle to form noodles. Spread 1/2 of noodles in the bottom of each noodle and top with 1/3 of carrots and 1/2 of cilantro. Repeat layers.

Random Ingredients: shiitake mushroom,kosher salt black pepper,sage,serrano chilies,allspice,sugar,cream milk,cooking oil
title: Jamaican Creamy Mushroom Chutney
ingredients: 6 tablespoons cooking oil | 1/4 cup dried shiitake mushrooms, stemmed | 4 dried serrano chilies, stemmed | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice | 1/4 cup granulated sugar | 1 cup cream or 1 cup milk | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Heat the oil in a saucepan over medium heat until just fragrant, 1 minute. Add the mushrooms, chilies and allspice and cook about 3 minutes. Add the sugar and cook 1 minute, stirring until the sugar dissolves. Raise the heat to high and cook until a strong aroma rises to the surface, 3 to 5 minutes or so. Reduce the heat to low and cook, stirring frequently, for 2 to 3 minutes or until the butter in the chilies is no longer translucent. Remove from heat. Remove from heat and stir in 1 cup of the cream or milk until well blended and smooth. Stir in the remaining 1 cup of milk until incorporated, stir in the salt and pepper, taste and adjust the seasoning. Note, chia seeds can also be added to the chutney during the final stages along with the sugar if desired.

title: Homemade Russian for Hair Volume
ingredients: 48 ounces italian-style stewed tomatoes | 3/4 cup kahlua, liqueur
instructions: Place the stewed tomatoes into a medium sized pot over medium heat. The time it takes to boil will depend on the thickness of the tomatoes. The longer you allow it to boil, the thicker your gravy and the longer it will be on the tomato side of the pot, the thicker your gravy will be. Lower the tomatoes to a simmer and continue cooking at all the time, until they are tender and starting to burst, but are not liquidy.. When the water has dried up to almost nothing but the consistency, stir in the kahlua. Taste and re season as necessary. Remove from heat and cool completely. When cool, chop into pieces when completely cool, and store in the freezer. Note, for a lower fat version, use reduced fat cream cheese and reduced fat Italian cheese blend.

Random Ingredients: fajita seasoning mix,jalapeno pepper,rigatoni pasta,heavy whipping cream,puff pastry,pork cutlet,italian cheese,hazelnut
title: Spicy Pork Tarts
ingredients: 2 tablespoons minced jalapeno peppers | 1 package of ready to fry rigatoni pasta | 1 tablespoon fajita seasoning mix | 3/4 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/2 cup hazelnuts, toasted and chopped | 4 pork cutlets, pounded thin | 2 packages frozen puff pastry sheet, thawed according to package directions | 1 1/2 cups shredded italian cheese blend
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. To make filling, mix jalapeno peppers and pasta sauce in a large saucepan and heat until hot. Stir in hazelnuts. Let mixture cool. To make pork, arrange pork cutlets on the pastry sheet. Brush with some of the sauce. Sprinkle with italian cheese blend. Roll pastry into a log shape and place on the pastry. Bake in preheated oven for 15 minutes. Remove from oven and cut crosswise into 4 equal pieces. Place a piece of pork slice on a hot roll, and top with more sauce. Return roll to oven and bake for 10 minutes or until bread is lightly browned.

title: French Onion Soup With Toasted Almonds
ingredients: 16 large eggs ( or 2 cups of egg substitute ) | 1 1/2 cups half-and-half cream ( or cream ) | 1 cup grated asiago cheese | 1/8 cup chopped pecans | 1/8 cup chopped scallion | 8 ounces sliced ripe olives ( or other type of sliced olives ) | 4 slices bread, toasted
instructions: For the soup. In a medium size soup pot, cook the chopped scallions and olives in olive oil until golden brown, remove to a bowl. Add the cooked onions to the soup. Add the bread slices to toast. Add the eggs and half and half to the soup. Stir the soup gently with a medium sized spoon so that it thickens.. For serving.

title: My Favorite Sauce
ingredients: 1 kg lard | 2 lbs good quality chicken stock | 3 tablespoons chili sauce ( the sauce ) | 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Get your butcher to do this. First of all get your butcher to shred some of your lard and then put it into your food processor. Then get your butcher to shred it more finely. Then put that into the food processor. Blend it until it is as fine or as coarse as you want it to be. Put that in a saucepan. Add the chili sauce and garlic and let it boil down to a thick, smooth gravy. Now get your butcher to shred it longer. Throw that in the gravy and let it boil down to a consistency like you would gravy.

Random Ingredients: rotini pasta,white mushroom,sharp cheddar cheese,colby monterey jack cheese,self raising flour,cinnamon,pearl tapioca
title: Quick Vegetarian Irish Tetrazzini
ingredients: 1 cup collard gold mini pearl tapioca | 1/2 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 1/2 cup shredded colby-monterey jack cheese | 1/2 cup self raising flour | 2 tablespoons sliced white mushrooms | 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon | 2 cups rotini pasta or 2 cups spiral shaped pasta
instructions: Add tapioca to just enough water to cover. Let stand 5 minutes or so until tapioca is cooked through. Drain. Meanwhile, combine all other ingredients except pasta. Drain water from tapioca, and add to cheese mixture in a large bowl. Drain tapioca and add. Add pasta, and mix thoroughly. Grease a 12 x 8 pan with butter. Spoon mixture into pan, and sprinkle with the reserved 1/2 cup of grated cheddar cheese. Place in oven on a rack, and bake 45 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: white pea overnight,lime zest,green chile pepper,doritos,pine nut,pickling spice,beer,chili pepper flake
title: Pickled Mexi-Rice (Rick Bayless)
ingredients: 12 ounces white pea ( white pearl onions, thawed ) | 12 ounces beer, such as corona or san marzano | 1 tablespoon pickling spice | 8 fresh chili peppers | 1 tablespoon red chili pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon lime zest | 1/4 cup pine nuts | 12 slices lorito cheese-filled dorito shells or 12 slices other soft white cheese, divided
instructions: Stir pea pearl onions, beer, spices and lime zest into a large jar with a tight fitting lid. Wipe out the jar before adding cheese. Cover tightly. Refrigerate at least 3 days before using. Shake bottles well to loosen any air bubbles. Place 1 cheese slice in each jar of beer with the remaining cheese slice on top. Refrigerate any remaining pea pearl onions in the bags. Serve as an accompaniment to rice tacos, salads, hot dogs, or hot dogs. For more delicious garlic may be made in recipes for a stronger garlic flavor, recipe can be doubled to make more pea pearl onions.

title: Brown Rice & Squash Wrap
ingredients: 1 cup brown rice | 3 yellow squash | 20 lettuce leaves
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium. Combine the brown rice and yellow squash in a microwave safe bowl. Place 2 lettuce leaves on the sheet of aluminum foil. Drizzle with a little oil and sprinkle with 1 tbsp. Repeat until the rice is completely coated. Wrap a wrap in foil.

title: Swiss Cheese With Dill
ingredients: 1/2 cup greek yogurt | 1/2 cup corn syrup | 2 tablespoons gruyere cheese, grated ( swiss cheese ) | 1/4 teaspoon dill, dried ( optional )
instructions: Stir yogurt, corn syrup, cheese & dill together in a small bowl. Cover & chill for 20 minutes or until thickened.

Random Ingredients: onion flake,dark raisin,green chilies,beef steak,water chestnut,chive,sea salt black pepper
title: Mexican Beef Round Steak
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef round steak | 1 small onion flakes | 1/4 cup water chestnut, chopped | 2 medium green chilies, cut in half lengthwise | 1/4 cup dark raisin | 1/4 cup chives, chopped | 1 tablespoon dark raisins | 1/4 teaspoon sea salt & freshly grated black pepper ( i omit this step )
instructions: Trim excess fat from steak. Combine remaining ingredients in a baking dish.

title: Easy Acorn Squash Enchilada Soup
ingredients: 2 acorn squash, peeled, seeded and mashed | 1 can enchilada sauce | 1 tablespoon ground mustard powder | 1 teaspoon apple-flavored vodka | 1 can crushed tomatoes with garlic, or more to taste
instructions: Mix squash, enchilada sauce, mustard powder, and vodka in a pot over medium low heat.

title: Spicy Bacon Wrapped Scallions
ingredients: 4 scallions, cleaned and finely chopped | 1/4 cup icing | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 -2 teaspoon chili oil | 1 -2 slice prosciutto
instructions: Mix all of the above in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,beef steak,chive,dark soy sauce,fish,red potato
title: Beef and Potato Stir Fry
ingredients: 1/2 small beef steak | 3 red potatoes | 3 1/2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon toasted sesame oil | 2 tablespoons fish or 2 tablespoons vegetables, of your choice | 3 tablespoons chives, roughly chopped
instructions: Score the beef steak in a small x on its side then grill it on a bbq or chargrill till medium rare. Cut the steak into thin strips then cut into thin strips. Meanwhile, bring the potatoes in salted water to the boil then cook till crisp tender. Drain and return them to the pan. Heat the sesame oil on a wok then stir in the potatoes, fish, or vegetables and chives. Stir fry for a couple of minutes then add the beef and stir fry, stirring until the beef is heated through and coated with the sauce.

Random Ingredients: corn pepper,yellow pea,almond paste,sesame seed,orange marmalade,lemon peel
title: Holiday Peas
ingredients: 1 bag frozen yellow peas, thawed | 2 tablespoons almond paste | 1 lemon peel, finely shredded | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds | 2 tablespoons orange marmalade | 2 ears corn on the cob, husked and cored
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f. Place peas in a large baking dish. Cover with water and soak overnight. In a small bowl, stir together the almond paste, lemon peel, sesame seeds and orange marmalade. Remove, discarding husk and corn, and mix with the corn mixture. Bake on a sheet pan, uncovered, for 45 minutes in the preheated oven, until thoroughly heated.

title: Miso Soup
ingredients: 3 1 medium glasses of warm chicken stock or 3 1/2 cups of good quality chicken stock | 1 -2 teaspoon miso | 1 teaspoon of grated fresh romano-free mountain mountain dew seasoning or 1 teaspoon of grated mountain dew seasoning | 1 teaspoon salt and pepper
instructions: In a pan mix ingredients together and bring to the boil. Take off the fire and immediately pour the heated mixture over a litre of freshly boiled water to stop the cooking. If using fresh mountain dew, soak each long time as this will help keep the soup from becoming too thick. Serve into soup plates, pour hot soup into the bowls and keep a cup of hot soup on the side. Enjoy.

title: Spicy Prosciutto
ingredients: 2 sheets puff pastry | 100 g prosciutto | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/2 teaspoon vinegar
instructions: Pre heat oven to 200 degrees celcius. Line the baking tray with baking paper. Cut proscuitto sheets in half. Arrange pieces of prosciutto on the baking tray with flat edges. Sprinkle with cumin and vinegar. Bake for 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: green bean,basmati rice,dill,chorizo sausage,white wine,garbanzo bean,ice cube
title: Cuban Green Beans, Chorizo & Rice
ingredients: 2 small green beans | 1/3 cup white wine | 4 teaspoons fresh dill, chopped ( or 2 teaspoons dried ) | 1/2 lb chorizo sausage | 1/4 cup garbanzo beans, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup basmati rice, cooked ( or white rice ) | 2 -4 cups ice cubes
instructions: Place beans in ice cube tray or ziplock bag with plastic wrap. Crush ice into ice cubes and place in freezer until solid and hard. Remove beans from freezer, place in a bowl and drain the liquid off. Rinse chorizo with cold water and remove meat from casings or crumble and set aside. Remove green beans from freezer and place in a large saucepan with about 1 tablespoon of oil. Add the white wine, dill, sausage, drained beans and rice. Cook over medium high heat, stirring occasionally for about 20 minutes, or until beans and rice are tender and sauce is fragrant. Remove from burner, stir in the chopped dill and serve immediately.

title: Niku Jyaga (Shiitake Oolar Milk)
ingredients: 1 pound bone-in lamb shoulder, cut into cubes | 3 2-inch dried shiitake mushrooms | 4 cups shiitake broth with mushroom ( available in japanese soup shops )
instructions: Place lamb in a large saucepan large enough to fit the meat. Cover and cook over medium high heat for about 15 minutes or until juices run clear. Remove lamb with a slotted spoon and set aside. Add mushrooms to pan. Pour soaking liquid over the mushrooms, return lamb to pan, reduce heat to medium low and cook for about 30 minutes, skimming off any fat that rises to the top. Cover and cook for another 35 minutes or until lamb is cooked through. Remove lamb and mushrooms from heat and let rest for 5 minutes before serving. Cut the meat into small cubes and serve.

title: Asiago-Spread Burger
ingredients: 1 package yeast, 2 packages | 1 cup warm half-and-half | 1/2 cup marmalade | 1/4 cup mirin | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 3/4 cup grated asiago cheese | 1/4 cup chopped black olives, drained | 2 cans baked beans thread noodles, drained
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup warm half and half in a large mixing bowl. Stir in marmalade, mirin and cumin. Add grated cheese and olives. Add remaining 10 ingredients stirring well. Cover bowl and let stand about 10 minutes or until bubbles appear on the surface and dough is elastic. Turn out onto lightly floured surface. Sprinkle with remaining 1/4 cup of flour and knead until smooth. Place in a oiled bowl and cover. Place in a warm place to double in bulk. Knock back air bubbles and let it rest for an additional 15 minutes. Shape into 12 patties. Place on lightly greased baking sheets, cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled, approximately 1 hour. Preheat grill on medium high heat. Brush top side of each patty with cooking spray. Place patties on grill and cook about 3 minutes per side or until bottoms are light brown and burgers are slightly charred in the middle. Cool on wire racks.

title: Beef Tenderloin  With Soy Milk
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg beef tenderloin | 1 cup bread flour | 1 cup soymilk
instructions: Mix the bread flour and soy milk together. Cut the beef into thin slices and deep fry the beef until cooked through. Drain the oil from the pan and pour some cooking oil to coat the underside. Turn them over and fry the other side until brown. You can also sprinkle it with the cinnamon before serving.

title: Peanut Stew
ingredients: 3 bags frozen stewing beef | 2 chicken bouillon cubes | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 1/2 cup milk | 1/8 cup finely chopped peanuts ( optional ) or 1/8 cup crushed peanuts ( optional )
instructions: Put all ingredients in crockpot or casserole, cook on high till meat is tender. Serve over rice and with a nice salad.

title: Cranberry Mac & Cheese
ingredients: 3 tablespoons canola oil | 1 cup chopped kumquats | 1/4 cup chicken broth ( or beef broth ) | 3/4 cup bottled picante sauce | 1/2 cup crumbled blueberries or 1/2 cup blueberries | 1/2 cup canned cranberries or 1/2 cup frozen cranberries | 1 1/2 cups macaroni, cooked | powdered blueberries ( optional ) or crushed red pepper flakes ( optional )
instructions: In a large saucepan on medium heat, add oil and kumquats. Cook, stirring, until they begin to soften, then add broth and picante sauce. Bring to a boil and reduce heat to a simmer. Cover and cook 15 - 20 minutes until kumquats are cooked through. Add blueberries, cranberries and macaroni and cook until heated through, but not mushy. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,orange flower water,broccoli floret,extra beef,spring onion
title: Quick Beef and Broccoli Soup
ingredients: 1 extra lean beef | 500 ml reduced cream of chicken soup | 200 g frozen broccoli florets, thawed and roughly chopped | 2 spring onions, finely sliced | 1 dash orange flower water ( optional )
instructions: Place beef in a frypan and brown in a little oil if necessary, remove and set aside. Add soup to the frypan and stir continuously until soup comes to the boil. Add broccoli, onions and beef then bring back to the boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes until broccoli is soft and beef is cooked through, stir occasionally. Stir in the orangeflower water if using before serving.

Random Ingredients: sultana,red chili pepper flake,vanilla essence,calvados,lemon juice,snow pea,great northern bean
title: Calvados Snow Pea Salad
ingredients: 1 large red chili pepper flakes ( or to taste ) | 1 can great northern beans ( drained ) | 1/2 cup sultana ( sliced thin ) | 2/3 cup snow peas ( washed, trimmed, or use young peas ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons lemon juice | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | ground vanilla and olive oil ( optional )
instructions: Finely mash chili pepper with fork, remove seeds. Place red chili in mixing bowl, cover with boiling water and refrigerate for 30 minutes or until cold. Add beans to bowl and mash gently with fork. Add snow peas and sultanas and mix gently. Add lemon juice, vanilla, and olive oil if desired. Stir, and serve.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,creme de cassis,coriander powder,garlic powder,mayonnaise,asparagus
title: Asparagus Salad
ingredients: 1 bunch asparagus | 1/4 cup mayonnaise | 1/2 tablespoon creme de cassis | 1/8 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/8 teaspoon coriander powder | salt and pepper
instructions: Cut the ends of the asparagus, and remove the center vein. Set aside. Steam the asparagus in a saucepan until they are crisp tender. In a large bowl, mix together the mayonnaise, creme de cassis, garlic powder, and coriander powder. Gently toss in the asparagus. Chill until serving.

Random Ingredients: dijon mustard,mint sprig,onion,green chili salsa,black eyed pea

Place black eyed peas in a small saucepan and add a bit of the reserved liquid. Cover and simmer over low heat for about 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. While black eyed peas are cooking, heat a small skillet. Sauté onion and chili sauce for about 5 minutes or until tender. Remove from heat. Stir in mustard, beans and reserved bean liquid. Serve hot with fresh mint.

title: Veggies in a Bottle With Smoked Cheese
ingredients: 1 head broccoli, cut into florets | 3 tablespoons dried dill weed | 4 tablespoons dried currant | 4 tablespoons smoked mushrooms, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat the broiler to its highest setting. Place the broccoli on a foil lined baking pan and cover with a layer of the dill and currant leaves. Sprinkle all over with smoked cheese and broil for 15 minutes, or until cheese is melted. Remove from heat, stir in mushrooms and serve hot.

title: Blue Ribbon Beef Steak #RSC
ingredients: 2 -3 sirloin steaks | 2 cups prepared marinade | ice | 1/2 cup orange sauce or 1/2 cup blue curacao | 3 eggs | 1 tablespoon blueberry jam or 1 tablespoon blueberry jam | 3 cups instant rice
instructions: Pound steaks to 1/4 x 3/4 thickness. Place in large resealable bag and refrigerate for 2 hours. Mix marinade, orange sauce and eggs. Dip steak into egg mixture and roll in marinade. Add rice to steaks. Refrigerate for 30 minute remove from steaks to serving dish. Spoon orange/blueberry jam over steaks and serve.

Random Ingredients: spanish onion,hoisin sauce,chutney,sea salt,broccoli,cake flour,salt black pepper
title: Chutney Roasted Broccoli
ingredients: 1 teaspoon sea salt | 1 tablespoon cake flour | 1 tablespoon sweet chutney | 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce | 8 ounces broccoli | 1 tablespoon spanish onion, finely chopped | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. Mix all ingredients in a large bowl. Spray a foil lined roasting tin with nonstick cooking spray. Pour the mixture onto the tin, leaving 1 cm of space around the edges. Bake in the oven for 40 minutes, until the broccoli is tender.

title: Beef Kebabs with Kalamata Olives
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs chuck steaks, cut 1-1/2 inch thick | 2 1/4 lbs beef tenderloin, cut 1/2 inch thick | 2 1/4 lbs pitted kalamata olives, drained | 3/4 lb country-style dried beef kalamata olive
instructions: Cut steak and beef into 1 cubes. Cut olives into 1/2 inch wide strips. Thread 2 meat cubes onto each skewer. Place skewers on a rack in a shallow baking dish. Cover with foil and marinate in refrigerator 12 hours. Arrange skewers on a wire rack in a shallow roasting pan large enough to hold all pieces of meat and Olives in a single layer. Drain excess marinade and discard. Roast meat and olives, covered, in a 450 degree f oven for 30 minutes. Turn skewers and roast until meat is browned and thermometer inserted in thickest part of meat registers 140 degrees f for medium rare, about 15 minutes longer. Transfer meat and olives to a platter with a slotted spoon and let rest 10 minutes. Thinly slice beef and olives. Serve beef and olives with any remaining marinade.

Random Ingredients: spiral pasta,red onion,tahini,poppy seed,self rising flour
title: Spiral Pasta Fritters
ingredients: 1 lb dried spiral shaped pasta | 1 cup thinly sliced red onion | 2 tablespoons tahini | 4 1/2 cups self-rising flour | 1 tablespoon poppy seed
instructions: Cook the spiral shaped pasta by following the package directions or the directions on the package. In a large bowl combine the noodles, onions, tahini and flour. Knead the dough well to form a soft dough. Let dough rest in the refrigerator for about 10 - 15 minutes. While dough is resting, heat a large frying pan over medium to medium high heat. Drop some of the dough in to the pan and spread out for 1 min to make a thin, flat sheet. Cook approximately 8 - 9 minutes, turning once or until the dough is slightly browned and crispy on the bottom. Remove from the pan and serve immediately.

title: Lime-Glazed Pancetta

instructions: In a small nonstick skillet over medium heat, cook pancetta in 1 tablespoon of the bacon fat, stirring, until crisp, then stir in the wine and lime zest. Add a small handful of the pancetta, if using, and cook for 1 minute. Continue cooking for a further minute, then pour in the remaining 3 tablespoons of pancetta and any accumulated juices and, if liked, a few cubes of bread.

Once the chicken is cooked, set aside for now. Once the chicken is done, cut into pieces, rinse with fresh water and rinse with cool water. Return the chicken pieces to the pot, add the onion slices and vinegar. Simmer on low or medium heat until everything is heated through..

instructions: Mix mustard with grand marnier until well blended. If using in a bowl whisk together in a little water before pouring over salad enjoy.

title: Irish Stew I
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless beef stew meat or 2 lbs round steaks | 2 cans beef soup bones with liquid | 1 jar hot sauce | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 2 tablespoons dried tarragon | 1 package macaroni, uncooked | 2/3 cup cold water
instructions: Trim excess fat from meat and cut into 1 inch cubes. Place meat into crock pot. Combine soup bones with liquid, hot sauce, sugar, tarragon, and macaroni. Pour 1/3 of mixture over meat. Cover crockpot and cook 6 hours on high.

title: Texas Mint Pita Chips

instructions: Preheat the oven's broiler and set the oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Combine the mint, bread crumbs, and picante sauce in a bowl. Using wet hands, press handfuls of the bread mix together to form 1 inch thick chips. Arrange them on the prepared baking sheet.

title: Cashew Beef Koftas
ingredients: 4 ounces cashews | 1/4 cup extra-virgin olive oil | 2 ounces chopped fresh ginger-garlic paste | 2 pounds ground beef | 1 pinch salt to taste | 2 tablespoons all-purpose white flour ( optional )
instructions: Lightly grease a baking sheet. Mix cashews, olive oil, ginger garlic paste, and beef in a blender to make smooth batter.

title: Homemade Pesto Eggs
ingredients: 6 hard-boiled eggs | 1 tablespoon lemon rind, finely grated | 2 tablespoons red pesto sauce | 50 fluid ounces mineral water ( or more if needed ) | 3 tablespoons mineral water ( or more if needed )
instructions: Peel the eggs and remove the yolks, reserving all yolks. Mash the whites on an electric mixer till pale yellow or very thick, and add the lemon rind and red pesto sauce. Slowly stir in the mineral water as required to obtain an emulsified consistency. If necessary, add a little extra mineral water until the desired texture is achieved. Place the whites in a clean bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for 10 - 15 minutes. Remove the white shells from the egg and using a teaspoon, gently press the yolks through a sieve into the whites. If any eggs are left, mix them with the white shells in a non metallic bowl. Pour the egg white mixture into a sterilized jar and set aside for 2 days in fridge. It is advisable that you refrigerate the pesto eggs for at least 4 - 6 days before using. After 2 days pass the taste of the pesto eggs through a strainer and serve with your favourite flatbread, pita bread and other fresh bread.

instructions: Place beef, spinach, mint, raisins, pecans, grand marnier, and liquid smoke in crock pot. Add water until just covered. Cook on low for 8 to 10 hours, or on high for 5 to 6 hours. Discard bay leaf, stir well, and serve.

Random Ingredients: provolone cheese,lipton onion soup mix,caraway seed,cinnamon,clear honey

ingredients: 1 head lipton dry onion soup mix | 3 -4 tablespoons clear honey | 1 head caraway seed, sliced thin | 1 teaspoon cinnamon ( optional ) | 12 slices provolone cheese
instructions: Mix all ingredients except provolone with hands to make a paste the size of a large cigar. Wrap each piece of cheese with a slice of the french type onion. Then wrap in foil and bake at 300 degrees for 45 - 50 minutes or until the cheese is firm. Enjoy with a dollop of sour dough and a leaf of spinach.

title: Quick & Easy Pilaf Chicken (Pilaf)

instructions: Mix well the rice, garlic, and chicken together.

instructions: Pour beans into a large crockpot. Mix beans and cream cheese until well blended. Add the curry and parsley. Cook on low for 2 hours or on high for 3 hours. Serve with crackers, assorted vegetables and french bread.

instructions: Use a melon baller to scoop out the egg white, leaving 2/3 to 1/2 inch shell. Rinse the hard cooked eggs under cold water, drain and pat dry. Cut the hard boiled eggs into wedges. In a mixing bowl, combine the chili sauce, ginger, sugar, cream style corn and yogurt. Drizzle the dressing over the egg whites and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for 8 hours to overnight.

instructions: Coat a grill with cooking spray and place over medium high heat. Brush all sides of the bratwurst with olive oil. Cook on grill until the bratwurst is browned, 4 to 6 minutes per side.

title: Cheddar Beef Potatoes
ingredients: 4 russet potatoes | 1 tablespoon minced chili pepper flakes | 3/4 lb ground beef or 3/4 lb ground turkey | 1 large beef bouillon cube, crushed | 4 ounces cheddar cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Wash and pierce potatoes with fork. Place potatoes in large roasting pan with lid. Cover potatoes with water. Roast for 1 hour or until tender. Drain potatoes and set aside. Return water to pan. Add chili pepper flakes. Simmer over medium heat about 5 minutes. Cut a slit in the top of each potato and remove meat from shells. Return meat to skillet and cook meat over low heat until evenly brown, 1 - 2 minutes. Dissolve bouillon cube in water and pour liquid over meat. Cover and simmer on low while potatoes roast for 20 min or until potatoes are tender. Turn meat over. Continue to simmer uncovered about 15 minutes or until most of the liquid has evaporated. Top with cheese. Return potatoes to oven for about 10 minutes to melt cheese. Remove from oven and place on serving plate. Serve with warm breads.

title: Belgian Endive with Herbs and Herbs

title: Cod and Roasted Noodles for the Freezer
ingredients: 14 ounces cod, cooked and chopped | 1/2 cup golden brown sugar | 10 lasagna noodles, uncooked | 1/3 cup salad oil
instructions: Drain cod and place in a bowl. Cover with brown sugar. Preheat oven to 450 degrees fahrenheit. Spray an 11x7 inch glass baking pan with cooking spray. In a small bowl toss noodles with oil. Place three noodles onto prepared baking sheet and top with the sauce. Bake for 5 minutes, or until noodles are bubbly and hot. Let stand for 5 minutes and cut into wedges.

title: Cracked Scallops
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh scallops | 1 yellow sweet pepper, seeded and sliced | 1 -2 tablespoon hot pepper flakes
instructions: If the pepper is large, cut it long enough to crack it. Remove the skin and veins, then cut into thin strips. Rinse scallops and dry on a paper towel. Slice peppers into narrow, thin strips. Arrange pepper strips on a plate. Roll the scallops in pepper flakes, then carefully drain the seafood. Serve in a shallow dish with plenty of sauce.

title: Toad in the Hole

instructions: Combine the self raising flour, tomato soup and plain flour. Mix with a wooden spoon till you have a soft dough. Roll out onto a floured board and cut into circles from the center. title: Thai Tuna Pasta

instructions: Place the tuna in a bowl. Add both flours and mix. Leave to rest for 20 - 30 minutes. While waiting for the tuna to flake it should have enough moisture clinging to it to shred easily.
