instructions: Make a deep cut in the fatty rind and dark membrane of the pork. Cut off the ends of the pork fat and stud these well with the walnuts and place them in rows. Sprinkle lightly with paprika and decorate it with capers.

Random Ingredients: rump steak,cardamom pod,ketjap manis,saffron thread,rosemary sprig,green pea,curry paste
title: Pea Beef with Saffron, Rosemary, and Kaljap Manis (Stew)
ingredients: 3 lbs rump steak | 1/2 cup ketjap manis ( sweet rice cooking brand ) | 2 tablespoons curry paste ( see note ) | 2 tablespoons rosemary sprigs, thinly sliced | 10 cardamom pods, crushed | 1/8 teaspoon saffron thread, crushed | 3 1/2 cups fresh green peas
instructions: Trim excess fat from steaks and discard. Cut steak lengthwise into 1/4 inch thick slices. Using a 3 1/2 to 4 quart slow cooker, combine kecap manis, curry paste, rosemary, cardamom, and saffron. Add steaks and any accumulated juices on the bottom of the slow cooker. Cover and cook on low heat setting for 7 to 8 hours or until steaks are tender. Stir in peas.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,brown mustard seed,chicken breast half,pineapple ring
title: Chicken With Mustard Seeds & Pineapple Scones
ingredients: 2 skinless chicken breast halves | 2 teaspoons brown mustard seeds | 1 tablespoon self-raising flour | 60 g drained pineapple rings | brown mustard seeds
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c. Spray an oven tray with oil. Place the chicken breasts on the prepared tray, cut side down, spread with mustard seeds, pressing the mustard seeds into the cuts. Cut a slit 1' deep across the top of each chicken to form a 2cm deep indentation. Spoon over as much pineapple as will fit over the top of each. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.

title: Yummy Vegan Beans
ingredients: 2 cups pinto beans | herbs, of your choice, suitable amount to taste
instructions: Soak beans in cold water over night. Drain the beans, put them in a steamer, cover with water, bring to boil and steam for 1 hour. Then, when cold, remove from the steamer to cool completely. Use the beans from the steamer to make tacos, or your favorite style. I use either storebought beans, or fresh pinto beans for this meal.

title: Mango Rhubarb
ingredients: 1 lb rhubarb, young | 1 -2 cup mango, chopped fresh | 1 1/2 cups chili | 2 tablespoons chili oil
instructions: Cut the rhubarb into 1 inch cubes and steam until tender. Add in the mango, chili & oil. Continue to steam until the fruit is very tender. Serve on plates or with crackers.

title: Taco Salad II
ingredients: 1 head cabbage, finely chopped | 1/2 head romaine lettuce, finely chopped | 1 package taco seasoning | 1 1/2 cups brown sugar | 2 tablespoons celery seeds | 1 package lettuce spreadable taco seasoning
instructions: Combine cabbage, romaine and taco seasoning. Toss lightly. Let sit for one hour. Mix brown sugar, celery seeds, and lettuce spreadable taco seasoning in separate bowl. To serve, place in a serving dish and top with cabbage mixture. Serve with lettuce spread.

Random Ingredients: confectioner ' sugar,red bell pepper,canola oil,veal,onion soup mix,vinegar,allspice,coconut pecan frosting
title: Veal Bundles and Onions
ingredients: canola oil or other neutral oil, for deep frying | 1/4 lb lean ground veal | 1 packet onion soup mix, dry | 1/2 teaspoon onion soup mix, dry | 1/2 teaspoon vinegar, can use apple cider vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon allspice, finely ground | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 2 tablespoons shredded coconut or 2 tablespoons pecan frosting, of choice | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar or 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar, to spread on top
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Oil racks. Slice off any excess paper from packages of dry onion soup mix.

title: Beef Steak
ingredients: 600 g beef sirloin | 6 tablespoons cake flour
instructions: Pre heat oven to 160ºc / 400ºf. Cut beef into 2cm slices. Place flour into bowl, using a sharp knife to cut slices in half at 1 intervals. Place onto a lightly greased oven tray. Spread each of the slices with a tbsp or 2th tbsp of oil. Bake for 90 minutes or until tender.

Random Ingredients: pastry flour,malibu rum,brown sugar,party rye,sausage,milk powder
title: Irish Sausage or Sausiel Bread
ingredients: 2 packages mixed sausages | 1 cup chopped brown sugar | 1 cup prepared skim milk powder, i use 1 % or % | 1 1/4 cups pastry flour | 1/4 cup malibu rum | prepared party rye or other flavor rye bread
instructions: Preheat over to 450°f grease a 9x5 inch loaf pan with cooking spray. Cut sausages in half lengthwise. Bake about 12 minutes or until sausages are brown, stirring once. Remove from oven and set aside. Mix first 3 ingredients in large bowl. Stir in rum. Spread dough evenly over the bottom of pan. Stuff sausages with filling, pressing slightly. Pour rum mixture evenly over sosage. Dip in rye bread and place on top of sausage. Place loaf pan in oven. Bake 15 minutes. Lower heat to 375f and bake 15 to 25 minutes more or until loaf is lightly browned and loaf is heated through.

title: The Most Perfect Beef for a Crowd
ingredients: 4 large red peppers | 1 large red capsicum | 14 ounces condensed beef broth | 2 -4 lbs beef chuck roast ( for gravy ) ( optional )
instructions: Wash all pepper, pepper and capsicum. Place all ingredients into crockpot. Cook on high for 3 hours. Slice beef across the grain into thin strips and serve over cooked rice.

Random Ingredients: tamari,blueberry,chicken stock,apricot,beef chuck roast,bell pepper,broccoli floret
title: Spiced Beef Stir- Fry
ingredients: 1 beef chuck roast, trimmed and cut into strips | 1 cup chicken stock | 3/4 cup orange-flavored tamari | 2 tablespoons prepared tapioca starch mixed with a little cold water | 1/2 cup chopped chinese broccoli floret | 2 medium bell peppers, seeded and sliced | 1/2 cup blueberries
instructions: Place beef strips in a glass dish, and pour the chicken stock over. Cover, and marinate at least 15 minutes in the refrigerator. Drain beef, and place in a frying pan with enough water to just cover. Bring to a boil, and then simmer for 30 minutes. Stir in tamari. Mix tapioca starch with water, then stir into beef mixture until blended and heated through. Add broccoli, pepper, and blueberries. Serve over cooked rice, or noodles.

title: Chicken and Prawn (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 13)
ingredients: 375 g chicken breasts | 375 g peas and carrots, sliced diagonally | 625 g cucumbers or 5 large cucumbers, sliced diagonally | 375 ml beer | 1/4 cup whole wheat flour
instructions: Cut chicken in 3cm pieces. Heat a large non stick frying pan on high. Cook chicken until golden, remove from pan. Turn heat to low. Tip peas and carrots into pan. Stir fry over medium heat for 2 - 3 mins until heated through. Transfer to a sieve and set aside. Meanwhile heat remaining oil in frying pan. Add prawns and chicken. Cook and stir over high, for 2 - 3 minutes until browned, remove and keep warm. Return pan to medium high heat. Add flour to pan, stir for 1 min until mixture is a pale golden colour. Stir in beer. Heat through. Serve with prawn mixture as described above.

Random Ingredients: parmesan cheese,self rising flour,chocolate chip,coconut,tilapia fillet,vanilla,vanilla sugar,pecorino cheese
title: Coco’s Parmesan Sliders
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs tilapia fillets or 1 1/2 lbs salmon fillets, cut into 4 x 1/4 inch squares | 1/4 cup self rising flour | 3/4 cup parmesan cheese, grated | 3 tablespoons vanilla sugar | 3/4 cup vanilla milk ( or 1/2 cup milk and 1/2 cup low-fat milk ) | 4 ounces semi-sweet chocolate chips | 3/4 cup pecorino cheese, diced | 2 tablespoons shredded coconut
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Place fries in a baking pan and sprinkle evenly with parmesan. In a bowl, rub sugar, vanilla and milk together. Add cheese and toss until combined and then stir in chocolate chips and pecorino. Stir the chocolate mix into the wet mixture. Place coated fries on a large baking sheet. Bake for 12 - 15 minutes or until golden brown and crisp. Serve with whipped cream and coconut.

title: Green & Red Chicken
ingredients: 1 roasting chicken | 1 green pepper, sliced | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1/2 cup triple sec or 1/2 cup mayonnaise
instructions: Cut up chicken, green pepper and string. Mix together cornstarch and triple sec. Dip chicken in the cornstarch mixture, and shake away excess. Bake at 425 for 25 - 30 minutes, or until chicken is cooked and glazed.

title: A Irish Cheesy Chicken Quiche
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped pecans | 3 tablespoons shredded monterey jack cheese or 3 tablespoons gouda cheese | 1/4 teaspoon paprika | 6 slices cooked chicken | 4 eggs, beaten | 4 ounces baileys irish cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Using your fingers, coat a 9 or 10 inch pie plate with nonstick cooking spray or line with parchment paper. Spread the pecans on the baking dish and then sprinkle the cheese evenly over the pecans, leaving some around the edges. Sprinkle the paprika on top of the cheese. Arrange the chicken over top of the cheese. In a med bowl, combine the eggs and irish cream and beat until well combined. Pour the egg mixture over the chicken. Grate the reserved cheese over top. Bake at 425°f for 20 minutes, or until set. Let stand for 5 - 10 minutes before cutting into squares to serve.

title: Fig, Lime and Spring Onion Tapas
ingredients: 1 kg fresh fig, in water, washed ( or frozen ) | 4 spring onions, washed and trimmed | 4 limes, wedged
instructions: Place the figs in a non metallic bowl and pour 1/4 cup boiling water over the figs. Cover and refrigerate for 20 minutes, or until all the liquid has been absorbed. Remove the figs from the bowl. Discard the water then chop finely. Place the chopped figs in a saucepan along with the spring onions. Add the lime juice and 1/4 cup boiling water. Bring rapidly to the boil then reduce to a simmer. Cook gently for 10 minutes or until tender, stirring often. Serve immediately..

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,plain yogurt,pork tenderloin,golden syrup,sugar syrup,chili paste,raspberry,cottage cheese
title: Creamy Pork Tenderloin With Raspberry Coulis in Berries
ingredients: 12 pork tenderloin, trimmed | 24 ounces canned pork fat ( i use a meat thermometer, since the pork tenderloins have to be very moist and tenders to fall apart when frying ) | 1 can condensed fat-free cottage cheese | 1/4 cup light golden syrup | 8 ounces plain low-fat yogurt | 1/4 cup sweet chili paste | 3 tablespoons sugar-free syrup | 7 ounces fresh raspberries ( or frozen, thawed or fresh ) | 1/2 cup low-fat monterey jack cheese, grated
instructions: Combine marinade ingredients in a ziploc freezer bag, and place the tenderloins in it. Seal the bag tightly, and refrigerate it for up to one week. For easy turning, remove the tenderloins from the fridge and place them on a foil covered cookie sheet, skin side up. Bake at 325 until a thermometer reads 145 degrees f or slightly jiggles from the tenderloins. Let cool for a few minutes, and remove tenderloins from baking sheet. Meanwhile, place thawed cottage cheese, yogurt, chile paste, sauce, ricotta, and raspberries in a blender and blend until smooth. Cut thin strips of the tenderloins from the pork, and place one portion in each portion of the pork. Spoon the raspberry coulis over the meat, and bake in a 325 degree f oven until the meat is cooked through. Top each serving with grated cheese of your choice and serve. If serving on a pool of berry coulis, wrap the pork slices around the mousse.

title: Prawns With Savory Sauce
ingredients: 4 ounces creme fraiche | 2 2 ounces sunflower oil | 6 -10 peppercorns | 4 ounces caster sugar | 1 tablespoon sweet chili sauce | 1 teaspoon savory, chopped
instructions: Heat the oven to 400°f heat the oil in a heat proof frying pan and put in the peppercorns and sugar in a blender. Blend to a paste and add the chilli sauce. Stir in the savory and add the creme fraiche. Leave to cool and serve.

Random Ingredients: baking potato,tea,ladyfinger,lemon juice,bean paste,celery salt,marjoram,urad dal
title: Vegetable Baked Sweet Potato Bakes
ingredients:
6 medium baking potatoes | 1 1/2 tablespoons vegetable shortening ( or other cooking oil ) | 2 cans bean paste | 2 tablespoons tea, herbal liquor or 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 1/2 - 1 tablespoon lemon powder ( or 1.
    -5 tsp.
    - dhal ) | 1/8 teaspoon marjoram | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon celery salt | 2 large ladyfingers
instructions: To bake the sweet potato, pierce the potato at 2 to 3 inch intervals with a fork. Place the potatoes in a large bowl covered with boiling water, then cover and let the potatoes stand for 15 to 20 minutes, or until tender. Drain the potatoes, then remove the potatoes with a slotted spoon, leaving the water in the bowl. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Line baking sheets with parchment paper, if desired. To make the sauce, melt the shortening in a saucepan over medium heat. Add the beans paste, tea, lemon juice and next 5 ingredients.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,button mushroom,penne,lime juice,black peppercorn
title: Baked Penne With Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 bottle medium hot tomatoes and green chilies, drained finely and chopped | 1 1/2 lbs button mushrooms, wiped clean, wiped clean and finely sliced | 2 teaspoons fresh lime juice | 2 teaspoons cracked black peppercorns | 1 lb penne, cooked and drained
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400°f. Combine chopped tomatoes, mushrooms, lime juice, pepper and a touch of salt in a baking dish, cover and bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until the chicken is cooked. Sprinkle with cheese and bake uncovered for 5 to 10 minutes longer.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,baby bok choy,sea scallop,salsa,red wine,white mushroom,italian salad dressing
title: Scallops and Chops in Wine
ingredients: 2 lbs baby bok choy or 2 lbs collard greens | 5 tablespoons mild italian salad dressing | 1 jar salsa | 1/2 cup red wine | 3 ounces parmigiano-reggiano cheese, shaved | 2 lbs sea scallops, drained | 4 -5 white mushrooms, sliced
instructions: Trim the root ends of the greens. Cut the greens in half lengthwise. With a sharp knife, trim away any tough portions. Slice the greens crosswise into 2 inch thin slabs about 1' 1/4 inches wide. In a 3 quart glass or stainless steel bowl, toss the bokchoy with 2 t of the dressing, stir to coat and cover. Arrange the greens on a baking sheet in a even layer, then arrange the scallops on top. Sprinkle the cheese over and around the greens. Drizzle with the remaining dressing and bake in a 400f oven, uncovered, for 10 to 15 minutes, or until golden. Remove from the oven and sprinkle with the mushrooms. Serve over greens.

Random Ingredients: bread flour,baking potato,italian tomato,baking soda,sunflower seed,date syrup,fettuccine
title: Sunflower Seed Fettuccini
ingredients: 400 g fettuccine | 1 cup sunflower seeds | 1 cup baking potato, unpeeled, cut into 3cm pieces | 1 can crushed italian tomatoes | 2 tablespoons baking soda | 1/4 cup sunflower syrup | 1 cup bread flour
instructions: Heat oven to 200, 400 f, gas mark boil the pasta for 8 minutes, drain. Bring a pan of salted water to the boil, add the fettuccini and cook, in batches, until just tender, remove from the pan and drain, reserving the water. Toss the sunflower seeds in a dry frying pan for 10 minutes over a medium heat, stirring occasionally, until golden brown and fragrant, stir in the potato. Set aside. Drain the pasta and return to the pan. Add the crushed tomatoes and baking soda, and stir over a low heat for 5 minutes. Pour over the tomato mixture and stir. Mix the bread flour with a little of the reserved water and use to mix in. Make a well in the centre, pour in the remaining water and stir until all the ingredients are absorbed. Serve with the potato wedges.

Random Ingredients: celery rib,scotch bonnet pepper,part mozzarella cheese,sage leaf
title: Linda's Scotch Bonnet Smoked Provolone
ingredients: 1 lb smoked part-skim mozzarella cheese ( not block type ) | 1 - 1 1/2 scotch bonnet pepper | 1 celery rib ( optional ) | 1/4 cup fresh sage leaf
instructions: Smoke the loppe until crispy about 15 - 20 minutes depending on how many puffs you like to make. Cool before removing from pan. Slice the loppe very thin. Add the scotch bonnet, celery and sage just before serving.

title: Quick Beef Cutlets (Cabbage Rollups)
ingredients: 1 lb beef flank steak, cut in thin strips | 1/2 cup shredded cabbage | 1 tablespoon dried ancho chile powder | 2 teaspoons chili oil | 2 teaspoons oil
instructions: Combine beef, cabbage, chile powder, oil, and chili oil in plastic bag. Seal tightly and marinate in refrigerator for 1 hour. Remove beef from marinade.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,pork sausage,brown mustard seed,red potato,fennel bulb
title: Smoked Sausage With Fennel
ingredients: 6 red potatoes, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon brown mustard seeds ( not black mustard seeds ) | 1 large fennel bulb, sliced | 4 -5 hot smoked pork sausage | 2 beef bouillon cubes, dissolved in
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In a large bowl, combine mustard seeds, fennel, pepper and enough water to cover the fennel. Stuff the brine into the cavity of the sausage with potatoes and sausages, if desired. Place the sausage on a rack and place in oven for about an hour or until potatoes are tender. You could smoke these over coals or broiler.

title: Pork Loaf
ingredients: 200 g fresh pork belly, trimmed and cut into 1/2 slices | 1/4 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda ( baking soda ) | 2 tablespoons fresh mint leaves, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Line a baking tray with aluminum foil or baking paper. Put the pork fat and soda in a medium bowl and mix well. Add the chopped mint leaves and mix well. Spoon over half the pork mixture. Spread remaining pork mixture thickly over the top. Bake in the preheated oven for 1 hour. Leave to rest for 15 minutes, then slice to serve.

Random Ingredients: broccoli floret,beef tenderloin,grape,lima bean,chili pepper,coconut cream
title: Lima Bean Beef
ingredients: 1/2 cup coconut cream | 2 lbs beef tenderloin, sliced to 1 inch pieces | 2 cups broccoli florets, cut in 1 inch pieces | 1 tablespoon chili peppers, minced ( i like habanero ) | 1 cup diced grape | 2 cans lima beans
instructions: In shallow baking dish mix coconut cream with coconut cream. Arrange beef in single layer in coconut cream. Sprinkle with chili pepper. Arrange bean sprouts on top of beef. Cover and refrigerate 8 hours or overnight. Place in refrigerator until ready to use. Heat remaining coconut cream mixture in a large skillet. Stir in grape leaves, cook and stir for just a few seconds over high heat. Lift beef out of marinade. Place in steamed rice. Arrange on top of rice. Sprinkle with additional chili pepper. Cover with aluminum foil and serve.

title: Guacamole Lamb Sandwich
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless leg of lamb, with bone | 2 tablespoons guacamole | 1 g celery salt
instructions: Score lamb and rub lamb with curing salt. Place in oven, on grill and roast 2 hours at 220°c. While lamb is roasting mix guacamole and celery salt together and brush on pork. Serve on hoagie rolls.

Random Ingredients: candlenut,mexican cheese,cherry tomato,orange,ice water,spring onion,chicken bouillon
title: Cheese Salad
ingredients: ice water | 1 orange ( skin on ) | 2 stalks spring onions | 500 g mexican cheese | 1 bunch cherries tomatoes | 1 cup halved preserved candlenut | 1 stalk whole preserved orange ( skin on )
instructions: Blanch orange in boiling water for a minute and pour onto ice water. Place cheese, cherries, and orange in processor and process until smooth. Add cheese mixture to oranges in processor and process again until well mixed. Add a bit of water if mixture becomes too thick. Pour into large salad bowl and garnish with the candlenut.

title: Spanish Oven Fish
ingredients: 1 fresh fish | 1/2 cup pinot grigio wine | 1/3 cup fresh chives, chopped ( spring onion ) | 1/4 cup sweet pickled cherries | 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 1 ounce gruyere cheese, grated ( as a topping )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325ºf. Wash, dry, and clean fillets. Mix 1/2 cup pinot grigio wine, chives, cherries, rice vinegar, worcestershire sauce, salt, and remaining 3 oz. Reserve 1/4 cup of cheese. Sprinkle fillets with the 1/4 cup grated cheese. Place fish in oven and bake for 15 minutes, basting once or twice. Serve fillets with remaining wine mixture, adding sliced cheese as desired.

Random Ingredients: raspberry,extra virgin olive oil,bean,rutabaga,blueberry,salt black pepper,topping
title: Berry, Berry Salad
ingredients: 3 cups mixed berries ( mixed crookneck yellow strawberries, rutabaga, and or or or blueberries ) | 1 rutabagas, peeled and cut into 1-inch cubes ( about 3 cups ) | 1 cup fresh raspberries or 1 cup canned blackberry | 1 cup bean curd or 1 cup frozen blueberries | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste | 3 cups fat-free whipped topping
instructions: In a large serving bowl, toss the mixed berries with a pinch of salt and let stand 10 minutes. In a blender or food processor, whirl the rutabagas until finely chopped, about a minute so they are just a little chunky. Scrape the rutabagas into the bowl and toss. Add the raspberries a handful at a time, whirling just until completely coated. In a large serving bowl, add the chopped berries and bean curd.

title: Panini Bread
ingredients: 500 g asparagus, tips trimmed | 50 g good quality white flour | 400 ml chicken stock | 50 g baguette, cut in 3 1/2 cm slices
instructions: Heat the oven to 200 degrees centigrade or 150 degrees centigrade. Trim the asparagus stalks from the tips & cut the stalks into 2 inch lengths. Place the flour & stock in a food processor with the vegetables & process for one minute. Line a shallow roasting tin with a baking paper. Spread the crumb mixture over the base of the tin & top it with the bread slices. Bake for 20 mins or until golden & crispy.

title: Spiced Zucchini
ingredients: 500 g zucchini, washed, peeled and cut into 1-inch slices | 2 tablespoons ghee | 50 g pecans, roasted and finely chopped
instructions: Brush each slice with ghee. Sprinkle chopped pecans and serve.

title: Fried Pancetta With Tamari and Black Pepper
ingredients: 1 lb pancetta, cut into 1 1/2-inch long sticks | 3 tablespoons tamari | 2 cups whipping cream | fresh ground black pepper
instructions: In a large skillet, fry the pancetta slices in 3 tablespoons of the tamari over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes on each side or until crisp. Transfer the pancetta to a strainer or sieve and rinse out the skillet. Wipe the skillet with paper towels. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the pancetta to paper towels and blot off the excess oil. Pat the pancetta dry and invert it on a plate. Let the pancetta drain while you prepare the cream. Wipe out the skillet and return the drained pancetta to it. Add the cream and bring to a boil. Taste the sauce. It should be slightly acidic and slightly tart. Add the remaining 2 tablespoons of tamari and black pepper and turn off the heat. Spread the pancetta on a shallow dish and chill until serving time.

title: Easy Baked Alfredo Sauce With Onions
ingredients: 10 ounces alfredo sauce ( i use kraft alfredo sauce ) | 2 small white onions, peeled ( about 2 1/2 cups ) | 2 cloves ( or to taste )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a saucepan over medium heat, combine alfredo sauce and onions. Bring to a boil and reduce heat to low. Let sauce simmer and cook until onion is softened. Add cloves as needed. Stir the mixture. Line a shallow baking dish with foil. Place the dish in the preheated oven. Bake, stirring occasionally, until sauce bubbles.

title: Guilt-Free Irish Veggies
ingredients: 1 french baguette | 6 ounces baby carrots | 3 baby turnips | 1/2 cup cauliflower or 1/2 cup asian florets | 1 tablespoon vegetable stock | 3 teaspoons instant dashi | 1 -2 tablespoon instant guacamole | 1 tablespoon dry pecans
instructions: Slice baguette into long slices diagonally to yield 3 sandwiches. Split carrots and turnips into florets place vegetables in bowl with the dashi and mix. Warm dashi in microwave until very hot. Toast bread. Spread some dashi on one side of bread, put bread on soup. Garnish with guacamole and pecans.

title: Calypso
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs lean boneless beef chuck, cut into 1-inch cubes | 12 maraschino cherries, halved | 1/2 cup freshly grated ginger or 1/2 cup fresh gingerroot | 2 1/2 teaspoons pure vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f in medium, heavy saucepan, brown beef cubes well on all sides and transfer meat to an 11x16 inch glass, 1 1/2 quart baking dish. Add sliced cherries, ginger and vanilla. Sprinkle with remaining 1/2 teaspoons of salt. Bake covered, stirring occasionally, about 90 minutes, or until meat is very tender. Allow meat to stand 10 minutes before serving. Remove meat from baking dish and drippings. Serve warm, garnished with cherries.

title: Chilean Cabbage and Broccoli
ingredients: 1 head napa cabbage | 1 head broccoli | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1 teaspoon celery seed
instructions: Remove and discard the core of the napa cabbage. Place the cabbage in a pot of salted water and bring to a boil. Turn down the heat and simmer until the leaves become transparent. Meanwhile, slice the broccoli florets and place in food processor with the cumin and celery seeds. Pulse until coarsely chopped but not quite like coarsely. Drain the cabbage and broccoli and place in a casserole with the vegetables. Pour in the water from the pot and bring to a boil.

Random Ingredients: asparagus spear,red capsicum,confectioner sugar,mace,oyster sauce,spring wrapper,vanilla
title: Chinese Spring Rolls
ingredients: 250 g asparagus spears, trimmed | 100 g spring roll wrappers | 2 tablespoons crushed oyster sauce | 3 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 1 dash mild vanilla | 1 dash ground mace | 1 dash ground red capsicum, or more to taste | 1 dash ground turkish ale
instructions: Trim the tips from the ends of the asparagus spears, and slice diagonally into 1 inch pieces. Bring a large pot of water to boil. Place the asparagus, spring roll wrappers, oyster sauce, confectioners' sugar, vanilla, mace, red capsicum and turkish ale into the boiling water. Reduce heat to medium, and simmer until the filling begins to thicken slightly, but do not boil until the filling is thick. The filling should be creamy but firm enough to spread without dripping. Use as desired. Remove the filling from the boiling water with a slotted spoon, and spoon out as much filling as you can. Repeat steps 4 and 5 with remaining filling and wrappers. Refrigerate the filling for about 30 minutes to firm up, or until it cools enough to eat. Serve cold.

title: Gram's Spaghetti Sauce
ingredients: 1 jar spaghetti sauce | 1 jalapeno pepper, finely chopped | 1 loaf crusty italian bread
instructions: Heat a large cast iron skillet over medium high heat. Put the spaghetti sauce in the skillet, and cook to warmed through, stirring to coat. Pour into a bowl over the cooked spaghetti. Remove the slice of bread, cut into pieces, and place in the skillet. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,beet,lemon wedge,nonfat milk,beef chuck,garlic powder,yellow cornmeal
title: Mexican Steak Tartlets
ingredients: 1/3 cup yellow cornmeal | 1/3 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 tablespoon nonfat milk | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 2 teaspoons lemon wedges | 1 pound lean beef chuck, cut into 1-inch cubes | 6 beet slices in water, thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a medium bowl, stir together cornmeal, cocoa powder, milk, garlic powder, and lemon wedges.

title: Sun-Dried Tomato Crostini
ingredients: 1 baguette | 1 lb sun-dried tomato | 1 tablespoon caraway seed | 1 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: Peel and dice sun dried tomatoes. Put on top of a salad bowl with fresh bread and toss well together. Slice baguette into 1 inch slices and toast lightly under grill, pressing with a spatula to spread evenly if desired. Spread with tomatoes to cover on the bread. Sprinkle with caraway seeds and stir well.

title: Pepperoni Bread
ingredients:
1 french baguette ( about 9 x 5-2 x 2.
    -5 inches ) | 3 1/2 tablespoons soda crackers | 1 -2 teaspoon oregano
instructions: Pepperoni bread works best on the oven shelf set at lowest setting, and you should be able to leave it for as long as 24 hours, depending on the type of bread. So, pre heat oven to 425 degrees. Place bread on a baking sheet. Using your finger, poke holes in the bread just enough so that the bread has a flat shape. Crush crackers into crumbs, but do not grind. Sprinkle oregano on top of bread. Place the tray with the bread in the oven. Watch the bread for burning. The crumbs should be a light tan color. If they burn, you can take your tray off the oven, and put the crumbs back where they belong. Let bread cool completely, then cut into 4 slices.

title: Roasted Fresh Chicken
ingredients: 1 roasting chickens ( whole, cut up ) | 2 serrano chilies ( seeded if desired )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Place chicken on foil. With scissors, snip off upper edges and make 3 incisions 2 1/2 deep into cavity of chicken. Insert a slit 1/2 inch deep in center of each bird. Sprinkle chiles into cavities and set chicken aside in a large roasting pan. Roast the chicken, breast side up, uncovered in preheated oven until it is thoroughly browned and firm, and no longer pink inside, about 1 1/2 hours, basting frequently with pan juices. Transfer the chicken to a platter with a slotted spoon, then tent loosely with foil. Strain pan juices, then strain the excess fat from the roasting pan. Discard solids from roasting pan. Serve hot or warm, with remaining juices. Note, you will need to adjust the oven setting and your oven strength so this is not a big deal. To serve, place in a warm platter and surround with warm tortillas and cheese slices, guacamole, sour cream, chopped fresh cilantro or parsley. Chicken can also be grilled outdoors, on the stove, in a casserole, or just on the grill, adding grill marks and grilling surface during grilling to help cook the skin and charings. If grilling outdoors, place in a 350 degree f oven for approximately 12 minutes, turning once, until well browned.

Random Ingredients: stewing beef,chocolate chip,honey,freestone peach,chili paste,white vinegar,tarragon leaf,passion fruit pulp
title: Grilled Beef Braciole
ingredients: 600 g stewing beef | 1 liter passion fruit pulp | 1/2 liter white vinegar | 3 tablespoons honey | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh tarragon leaf | 3 tablespoons good-quality chili paste | 3 tablespoons chocolate chips | 2 -3 freestone peaches
instructions: Make the braciole, drain your passionfruit pulp, discard the pulp and cut into cubes. Heat all the remaining ingredients in a pot and stir until the sugar dissolves. Pour in your passionfruit and bring to the boil, cook for a few minutes and pour back into the pulp. Simmer gently for two hours or until all the juices have reduced and reduced. To serve, leave to cool to room temperature, cover with a lid and chill until needed.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,basil leaf,pastry crust pie,green cardamom,lamb shank,paprika,tarragon,graham cracker
title: Lamb Shanks Poached in Balsamic
ingredients: 1 pastry for a 9-inch single crust pie | 3 lbs lamb shanks | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 2 teaspoons minced capers ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon paprika | 1/4 teaspoon basil leaves | 1/4 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1/4 teaspoon green cardamom
instructions: Place lamb shanks in a large pot with enough water to cover. Add salt then bring to a boil. Cover pot and simmer for 1 1/2 hours or until lamb shanks are tender. Remove meat from pot and reserve stock. Shred the meat and reserve it. Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Remove the fat and bones and trimming off excess fat. Cut the meat into small pieces, about the size of a walnut. Set aside. Remove the paprika from its casings and place the lumps in a small bowl. Stir with a pinch of salt until the salt is dissolved. Stir in the capers, garlic and herbs. Set aside. Remove the pot from the heat and drain off the liquid. Place the hot lamb shanks in a large baking dish or roasting pan and spoon the sauce over. Bake in a 350 degrees oven for 45 minutes, then remove from oven and pour the sauce over. Return to oven and bake for additional 15 minutes, basting several times.

title: BBQ Lamb Shank With Maple Syrup (Crockpot)
ingredients: 4 lamb shanks | 1 1/2 lbs smoked lamb shanks ( for extra flavour ) | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | pepper ( to season )
instructions: Heat the maple syrup in a frying pan. Add the shanks, place into the frying pan and cook on medium heat for 3 - 4 hours or until the meat is cooked through. Remove the shanks from the pan and leave to cool completely and trim excess fat off the shanks. Place the maple syrup, butter and bouillon in a crockpot and mix and simmer for 30 - 45 minutes or until all of the liquid has been absorbed and the sauce is reduced and syrupy. Place the shanks on skewers alternating with the sauce and serve with fresh salad and crusty bread.

title: Chinese Coleslaw
ingredients: 4 cups shredded chinese cabbage | 1 1/2 pints italian-style salad dressing mix
instructions: Combine the cabbage and dressing mix in a large bowl and mix well.

title: Homemade Beef Seasoning Mix
ingredients: 1/4 cup white pepper powder | 1/4 cup celery salt
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Store in an airtight container. To prepare for grilling, heat 1/2 inch oil or 1/2 inch cooking oil in a dutch oven until a piece of bread browns quickly in 15 seconds. Rub over meat of choice.

Random Ingredients: vegetable broth,cornstarch,grainy mustard,milk ricotta cheese,chipotle chile
title: Chipotle Crepes
ingredients: 2 large chipotle chiles, seeded, chopped | 1 cup canned condensed milk ricotta cheese | 1 cup low sodium vegetable broth | 2 tablespoons fine grainy mustard | 1 teaspoon cornstarch
instructions: Place a blender or food processor over medium/high heat. Blend in the ricotta, broth, mustard and 1/2 teaspoon of the chipotle chile. Use the funnel to scrape down the sides of the blender and blend until smooth. Heat a large nonstick electric skillet over low heat. Lightly spray with cooking spray. Pour in the hot crepe batter, tilting the pan to coat the pan. Cook, 2 minutes per side, or until a puffy, lightly and browned edge browns in color. Serve immediately.

title: Homemade Teriyaki Jelly
ingredients: 3 tablespoons gelatin | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: Put all ingredients in a bowl and allow to sit for 10 minutes. Strain. Pour into jelly jars and seal. Process for 25 minutes at 160 degrees f. Allow to stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Truffled Spaghetti (No Meat)
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti | 1/4 cup celery, thinly sliced | 8 -10 fresh sage leaves, thinly sliced or finely chopped | 1 tablespoon onion seeds | 2 tablespoons salt | 250 -300 g cottage cheese | 1 tablespoon sake
instructions: Cook the spaghetti in boiling water. Meanwhile, heat the oil in a pan. Add celery, sage and onion seeds and fry a few minutes over medium heat. Add spaghetti and toss over high heat until cooked. Add the salt, stir well. Remove from heat, cover and let stand 10 minutes. To serve, place some spaghetti on plate, place about ½ tbsp of the cheese, topped with ¾ tbsp of the pesto. Dribble remaining pesto over the top and serve.

title: Baked Italian Sausage and Scallops
ingredients: 1 package italian sausage | 1 package corn flakes | 1 1/2 pounds unpeeled sea scallops, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Cut the sausage in half lengthwise, and carefully remove the casings. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the sausage, and cook over medium heat until the center is no longer pink. Drain and discard any excess fat. Spread the crushed corn flakes on a plate,. Spread the scallops on a plate, and arrange the sea scallops. Spoon the sausage onto one side of the scallops. Bake in preheated oven for 15 minutes, or until they are lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: chinese five spice powder,water,garlic salt,oregano,vanilla extract,cherry,vegetable optional,chicken thigh fillet
title: Stir-Fry Chicken With Dried Cherries
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken thigh fillets | 1/2 teaspoon chinese five-spice powder | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 pound frozen vegetables, diced ( such as peas, carrots, and corn ), thawed ( such as onions ) | 3 tablespoons water | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/4 cup dry cherries, pitted and cut in half for garnish
instructions: Season the chicken with five spice powder, oregano and garlic salt. Heat a wok or large skillet over medium high heat. Add the chicken.

title: Stuffed Prunes with Asparagus and Goat Cheese
ingredients: 3 ounces shelled prunes | 3 ounces goat cheese | 12 thin spears trimmed fresh asparagus, washed and dried | 2 tablespoons sherry wine or 2 tablespoons ruby port | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f/160°c/gas mark bring a large pan of water to boil, add the prunes, and cook until just tender, then drain completely and rub the prunes out with a clean paper towel. Split off the stalks of the asparagus, and remove the woody base to make a base for the stuffing. Cut the stalks straight side to the stem, then separate the strands of asparagus into two strands for stuffing. Place three spears of the asparagus in a roasting tin. Place a small amount of the goat cheese on top and spread evenly. Cut the goats cheese into four 5 cm cubes and scatter evenly over the asparagus. Carefully lay the pieces of aspargus on top of the cheese then season with sea salt and freshly ground black pepper. Pour the sherry over all, or use 1 tablespoon and a half on each plate of asparagus.

Random Ingredients: rice wine,beef chuck roast,vanilla extract,cumin seed,spaghetti
title: Crispy Cumin Corned Beef for Slow Cookers
ingredients: 4 pounds boneless beef chuck roast | 1/4 cup rice wine or 1/4 cup dry sherry | 2 tablespoons ground cumin seed | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | 8 ounces spaghetti, broken into 2-inch pieces
instructions: Place beef chuck roast in 6 quart slow cooker. Set aside. In small bowl, stir together rice wine, cumin, and vanilla until well blended. Pour into slow cooker. Sprinkle pork pieces over meat, being sure to completely cover. Set slow cooker to low. Cook, covered, for 2 1/2 hours. Remove meat from slow cooker, reserving 1 - 2 cups cooking liquid. Shred meat with two forks.

title: Chipotle-Apple Sauce II
ingredients: 1 can chipotle chiles in adobo, chopped | 2/3 cup unsweetened applesauce | 1/4 cup curry powder | 1/8 teaspoon ground black pepper
instructions: Puree chipotles, apple sauce, curry powder, and black pepper together in a blender in batches until smooth.

title: Sweet Chilli Pasta, Prosciutto, Pineapple Nests and Broccoli
ingredients: 2 large broccoli ( about 500g/600g ) | 3/4 cup pineapple juice | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili paste ( to taste ) | 50 g prosciutto ( thinly sliced ) | 4 sage leaves ( to garnish )
instructions: Bring a saucepan of water to a boil. Drop in broccoli, cover and cook for 8 minutes, or until tender. Drain well and transfer to a plate or serving bowl. Stir to coat. Blanch broccoli for 2 - 3 minutes, then refresh under cold water. Peel all the stem from the broccoli and cut into segments. Discard the fibrous base. Combine the pineapple juice, chilli paste and 1 tbsp of the prosciutto in a pan. Cook over medium heat for 5 minutes or until reduced slightly. Remove pan from heat. Toss together the broccoli, pineapple, sage and remaining prosciutto in a warm serving bowl. Pour over the mixture and serve. Tip, if using larger stalks, trim off the end ends. Cut the leaves into 2 - 2 long pieces of chiffonade.

title: Lunch
ingredients: 1 container whipped topping | 1/2 cup hazelnuts | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1 bag baby corn | 1 cup thawed whipped topping, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spread 1 tablespoon of whipped topping all ove the bottom of an 8 inch square baking dish. Spread the hazelnuts on top of the whipped topping. Sprinkle with cream of tartar, and cinnamon. Arrange the baby corn on top of the hazelnuts. Repeat the layering, topping with additional whipped topping, and hazelnuts, ending with a whipped topping atop before baking.

title: Portuguese Tuna and Spinach Stew With Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups short grain rice or 1 1/2 cups arborio rice | 1 1/2 cups water | 1 -2 cup fresh spinach, washed, stems trimmed, and leaves chopped or can spinach, drained, drained and sliced thinly | fresh coriander seed | 1 tablespoon coriander seed, lightly crushed | 1 can tuna in water, drained | 1/3 cup dry red wine or 1/3 cup red wine vinegar
instructions: Combine rice and water in saucepan.

title: Blueberry and leek Soup With Lime Juice
ingredients: 15 fresh blueberries, picked over and rinsed | 1 leek, leaved, white part only, finely chopped ( about 1/3 cup ) | 1 1/2 cups fresh blueberries, picked over and rinsed | 1 lime, juice and zest of, grated
instructions: Wash the leek. Cut the leek in half lengthwise. Cut crosswise into 1/4 inch thick slices. If the slices are too thick, break them into 2 or 3 pieces. Place a large pot of 1 inch cold water on the stove over medium heat. As soon as it begins to come to a boil, add the blueberries and leek. Cover and steam until the berries begin to split. Ladle the chowder into a bowl and stir in the lime zest. Serve hot with toasted, crusty bread. You may also stir in dried chives for garnish, or serve chowder immediately.

title: White Bean and Black Pepper Scones
ingredients: 4 cups self-rising flour ( all-purpose flour ) | 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | cracked black pepper
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Mix the flour and beans in a large bowl, stirring gently until the mixture resembles coarse meal. Add pepper and mix again until combined. Drop the dough by rounded tablespoonfuls onto an ungreased cookie sheet, approximately 1/2 inch thick. Bake for 12 - 14 minutes.

title: Mildly Spicy Chipotle Rub
ingredients: 1/4 - 1/3 cup chopped fresh coriander | 1/4 - 1/2 cup chopped fresh chipotle chile | 1 -2 teaspoon ground coriander, to coat ( optional )
instructions: Stuff 1/4 to 1/2 tsp chipotle powder in the center of each piece of onion after it's completely coated in the chipotle powder. Place the coriander in a small bowl, add salt and stir until coated. If you are using fresh coriander, simply shake and rub it into the onions to release the flavor. Rub the onions on the grill/broiler with some spices, until cooked through and slightly brown and crispy.

title: Baked Garlic (Salsa Seca)
ingredients: 5 garlic cloves, peeled and lightly crushed | 1 inch fresh thyme sprig, chopped
instructions: Place the garlic and thyme in a bowl. Tie with kitchen twine to infuse and sprinkle with salt. Cover and let stand 5 hours. Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f and grease a shallow baking dish. Remove all of the garlic from the bowl and pat dry. Transfer the garlic to the pan and sprinkle with salt. Arrange the thyme in a cross on top of the garlic. Bake for 25 minutes, until crispy and a little brown. Transfer to a tea towel to drain. Serve hot.

title: Linguine With Linguine
ingredients: 1 lb linguine | 1 - 1 1/3 cup creme fraiche ( fat free or non-fat )
instructions: Cook linguine according to package directions. Drain. Transfer linguine to serving bowl and drizzle with a little fat free liqueur or other desired cream.

title: Pickled Shallots
ingredients: 3 lbs firm shallots, peeled | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar
instructions: Bring salted water to boiling. Drop the shallots into the boiling water. Cook uncovered, 2 minutes less than the suggested time for the water in the jar. Drain and allow to cool. Pack into sterile jars by tightly coating with a small amount of the hot brine solution. Store in a dark, cool place.

title: Simple Beef and Sauerkraut
ingredients: 1 can sauerkraut, rinsed and drained | 2 tablespoons tahini | 2 tablespoons yellow curry paste | 1 lb beef rib eye steak, cut into 1 inch cubes
instructions: Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add beef and saute 3 minutes, turning occasionally. Stir in saurkraut, tahini and curry paste. Cover and simmer 5 minutes, or until sauce is thick. Serve over rice.

title: Garlic Ginger Spread
ingredients: 1 jar whole pimientos, drained, liquid reserved | 1/3 cup finely minced crystallized ginger
instructions: Drain the pimientos and discard the liquid. Place the pimientos, pimientos, and ginger into a food processor fitted with a metal blade and process to a smooth paste.

title: Macaroni and Lobster Robusto
ingredients: 2 liters of dry rigatoni pasta | 400 g smoked macaroni | 150 g garbanzo beans ( soaked in water for an hour but left off the heat ) | 1 teaspoon nutmeg | 1 teaspoon sage | 600 g lobster | 2 tablespoons brandy
instructions: Heat the oven. Cook the macaroni for 10 mins over a moderate heat. While the macaroni is cooking, boil the garbanzos in salted water until plump and soft, drain and slice the garlic, throw the macaroni in the oven for 10 mins at 200c. Once the macaroni is ready, add the olives to the water and cook in the microwave for 2 mins. Drain the garbanzos and toast in the oven for 5 mins, throw into the boiling water the nutmeg, the sausage and the brandy. Pour into a pan and heat up the lobster, add the croutons, simmer for 3 minutes add to the saute pan and simmer for 5 minutes then add the lobster to the macaroni. Taste the saute pan and if liked, add some salt and pepper. If not, just leave a little nutmeg.

Random Ingredients: liquid honey,mustard powder,mango chutney,coriander seed,potato starch
title: Homemade Mango Chutney
ingredients: 3 lbs medium size potatoes ( not too big ) | 2 cups mango chutney ( not too thick, as this will be your mouth ) | 1 cup liquid honey ( not too sweet, for authenticity ) | 1/4 cup mustard powder | 2 tablespoons coriander seeds, ground ( not too hot, for authenticity )
instructions: Peel and cut large potatoes in to pieces approximately 1 inch square. Place in a large bowl. Pour the mango chutney and sweetened honey over the potatoes, mixing thoroughly. Sprinkle mustard powder on top. If the mixture is too thick, add 1/4 cup water and mix again. Taste, add 1 teaspoon water if too thick. If it tastes too sour, add more sweetener. Coat in the coriander seeds and place on a double layer of foil placed on the counter, and wrap each square tightly. Place in the refrigerator and use within 5 days.

Random Ingredients: serrano pepper,thai chile,fava bean,queso fresco,pork tenderloin,turkey polish kielbasa,rosemary
title: Kielbasa in Fava Bean With Queso Fresco
ingredients: 1 lb whole fava bean, shelled | 1 1/2 lbs pork tenderloin, trimmed | 2 dried thai chiles ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon fresh rosemary, minced | 1/4 lb sliced thin polo fresco ( about 6 slices of about 4 ounces ) | 12 ounces sliced thin turkey polish kielbasa, about 1 inch thick | 2 ounces queso fresco, about 2 ounces, crumbled
instructions: Drain the beans. Preheat the oven to 450°. Cover the beans with water by 2 inches and set aside. Remove any remaining shells. Cut 1 lb pork tenderloin into 4 long strips. Place in a roasting pan and put the ribs on top. Scatter the chiles, rosemary, and 1 teaspoons salt over all. Roast for 30 - 45 minutes or until pork is medium rare. Remove from oven and set aside. While meat is roasting, scrape out all the vegetables from the roasting pan except for the chiles. Turn broiler on high and arrange kielbasa rounds on top of meat and vegetables. Cook kielbasa for 5 minutes, turning kielbasa occasionally so the pan does not burn. Cook the kielbasa until it is a dark golden color in spots and the chiles have begun to split. Remove kielbasa with a slotted spoon and set aside on a platter. Pour off any excess fat from the pan. Place the remaining 3/4 cup of crumbled queso fresco in a small small bowl. Cut a slit in the side of each sausage. Cut the sausage into 1/4 thick medallions and place inside the roasting pan. Scatter the sliced polo fresco over top of sausage. Spread the fried sausages and kielbasa over cheese. Place under the broiler for about 7 minutes or until cheese has melted and bubbled. Turn pan over and cook for about 6 more minutes. Spoon excess liquid from the pan over top of kielbasa and kielbasa and serve.

title: Sweet and Savoury Tiramisu
ingredients: 10 ladyfingers ( preferably the ones specifically designed for layering ) | 10 ounces caster sugar | 1 pinch kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper, plus salt to season
instructions: Position racks in the top 3/4 of the oven and preheat for the oven to 130°c. Line a baking tray with parchment paper or parchment paper about 6 to 8cm wide and 10 cm deep. Place all the sponge fingers onto the baking tray, arranging them in a single layer, spacing them about 2 cm apart on the baking tray. Pour enough hot water into the baking tray to come 3/4 way up the side of the fingers. Leave a few ladyfingers for the finger to rise level when they come out of the oven. Sprinkle the sugar evenly over the top of the sponge fingers. Sprinkle a pinch of salt over the top of the sugar and prick them lightly with a fork. Bake for about 45 minutes or until the fingers are golden and crisp and feel firm. Cool, leave to cool completely. Cut the biscuits into fingers, arrange them on serving plates and drizzle them with a little of the caramelised sugar. Sprinkle with freshly ground black pepper. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: ginger,vegetable shortening,cocoa powder,rigatoni pasta,kosher salt black pepper,kielbasa,shallot,clove
title: Cajun Hot Dogs (Andorra)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable shortening | 1/4 cup chopped shallot | 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 teaspoon ground cloves | 1 teaspoon ground ginger | kosher salt and ground black pepper to taste | 2 packages rigatoni pasta | 3 pounds kielbasa, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Melt the shortening in a skillet over medium heat. Add the shallots, cocoa powder, clove, ginger, salt, salt, and pepper.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,roasting chicken,mushroom soup,angel hair pasta
title: Hot Roasted Chicken over Angel Hair
ingredients: 1 roasting chickens, cut into pieces | 1/2 cup mushroom soup, prepared as directed | 1 red chili pepper, sliced | 1 package angel hair pasta
instructions: Place chicken in roaster. Add remaining ingredients. Stir until well mixed. Bake in a 350 degree oven for 90 minutes.

Random Ingredients: white vinegar,chocolate square,active yeast,pasta,red bell pepper,amaretti cooky
title: Famous Italian Pepper Breads
ingredients: 2 packages active dry yeast | 7 1/2 cups all-purpose white vinegar | 1/2 cup chopped red bell pepper | 2 cups crumbled amaretti cookies | 2 cups dry pasta, cooked al dente | 1 1/2 squares unsweetened chocolate squares, melted
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 2 1/2 cups of the white vinegar. Scald the remaining vinegar. Stir in flour into yeast mixture in 2 - ½ to 3 stages, beating constantly, until you get a batter that forms a smooth dome in the bowl. Stir in the chopped red bell pepper and amaretti. Turn into a lightly oiled bowl, cover with a cloth, and set aside to rise until doubled, about 1 hour. Pour remaining 3 - ¼ cups of vinegar into a large bowl, and set aside. Preheat oven to 400°f grease two 2½ quart souffle dishes. Stir the crumbled cookies into the warm vinegar, and pour into the prepared souffle dishes. Bake for 20 to 30 minutes in the preheated oven, then set aside to cool to room temperature. Drizzle the melted chocolate over the cooled bread. Let cool until hard, 20 to 30 minutes, then cut into squares and serve or store for up to a month.

title: Italian Cookies
ingredients: 2 cups rye flour | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar | 1/2 cup olive, drained and chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Sift together rye flour, and confectioners' sugar. Stir in olive, and work into mixture until the dough will not be sticky. Roll dough out on a lightly floured surface to 1/4 inch thickness.

title: Melt in Your Mouth Chocolate Eggs
ingredients: 1 package shake and bake | 2 eggs, beaten | 1 cup semisweet chocolate, melted | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: Mix egg, melted chocolate and cardamom together in a large mug. Pour eggs into mug and stir. Enjoy.

title: Cherry Shrimp
ingredients: 1 lb shrimp, peeled and deveined | 2 lbs fresh cherries, with shells | 2 teaspoons dried tarragon
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Arrange shrimp in a single layer in a 9x13 inch heavy casserole. Pour remaining ingredients over shrimp. Bake in preheated oven 45 minutes, or until shrimp are bright pink and tender.

title: Aphrodisiac Applesauce for Lamb Roulades
ingredients: 15 fresh basil leaves, torn into pieces | 2 teaspoons black mustard seeds | 2 lbs apples, peeled, cored and grated
instructions: Place the basil and mustard seed in a mortar and pestle and using a pestle, mash the leaves until they are slightly dry. Add the grated apples and mix well until the apples are well coated. Spread the grated applesauce evenly over the lamb, cover and leave to marinate in a cool place before refrigerating for at least 4 hours or overnight. Cook in the oven at 450f or 190c/ 375f for 1 1/2 hours.

Random Ingredients: parsley,coriander powder,mint leaf,phyllo pastry,olive,linguine,onion soup mix
title: Quick Phyllo Pastries
ingredients: 1 package dried linguine | 1 1/2 lbs phyllo pastry sheets | 1 can sliced ripe olives | 1 package onion soup mix, i use 1/4 packet | 1 tablespoon coriander powder | 1 tablespoon dried parsley | 1 tablespoon dried mint leaves
instructions: Cook linguine according to package directions. Drain. Mix together the olives, soup and coriander. In a 13x9x2 pan sprayed with pam or oil, layer the dough in two layers, brushing with olive/water mixture. Then top with remaining dough, brushing with oil. Cover and refrigerate until dough becomes firm and cut in half. On a floured surface roll out each half until 1/8 inch thickness. Cut into desired shapes & place on plastic bags covered with plastic wrap. I use foil to keep them from drying out. Repeat with rest of the phyllo pastry sheets and the rest of the olives. Bake for 15 minutes in a preheated oven at 450 degrees. Remove from foil and sprinkle with parsley & mint. You may have leftover dough. Use as directed above.

title: Rhum Puck’s Mussels
ingredients: 1 liter mussels | 1/4 ounce savory ( can use fresh herbs or a mixture of them ) | 2 tablespoons rum ( or just rum ) | 1 tablespoon white flour
instructions: Steam the mussels whole for three minutes, add the savoury and rum and then mix the ingredients together. Serve immediately.

title: Aniseed Pork with Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 tablespoon ground anise | 1 1/2 pounds ground pork | 10 cremini mushrooms, sliced
instructions: Heat an inch or 2 inch depth of oil in a skillet over medium low heat. Use tongs to scoop up any fallen off bits from the bottom into the skillet. If the oil is too hot, the flavor of the anise will seep through. When the oil shimmers, pour pork into the skillet, being careful not to crowd the bottom. Cook until no longer pink in the center, 1 to 2 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove the pork to a plate, reserving the oil and keeping the skillet. Cover and keep hot. Add an inch or two of more oil to the skillet and bring up to medium high heat. Add the anise and mushrooms and stir fry until tender, about 5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon and forks, serve the mushrooms hot with the pork.

Random Ingredients: salt,ginger garlic paste,double cream,cumin seed,chili pepper flake,canadian bacon
title: Cumin-Sprayed Paneer
ingredients: 4 slices of thickly sliced canadian bacon, cut lengthways into 3 | 2 tablespoons canadian bacon fat | salt ( optional ) | 1 chili pepper flakes ( optional ) | 2/3 teaspoon finely grated ginger-garlic paste | 4 teaspoons double cream
instructions: Fry the bacon strips until they are crisp and golden on both sides, and keep them warm in a low oven. Turn the heat up to medium high and sprinkle the pepper flakes and ginger garlic paste over the bacon strips. Stir until the pepper flakes melt. Remove the bacon strips from the oven and add the cream to the pan drippings. When bubbles begin to form on the top, add the cumin seeds. Cook and stir until the cumin is aromatic, about 1 or 2 minutes. Pour the cream mixture over the bacon and stir until mixed, but not soggy.

Random Ingredients: palm sugar,half cream,anise liqueur,arugula leaf,caper,italian parsley,rump steak,celery salt
title: Rump Steak in Caper Sauce With Anise
ingredients: 1 lb boneless rump steak | 4 -6 tablespoons anise liqueur or 4 -6 tablespoons rum | 4 tablespoons grated fresh italian parsley | 1 tablespoon chopped celery salt | 12 arugula leaves | 1 teaspoon capers | 1 teaspoon palm sugar or 1 teaspoon brown sugar | 2 cups half-and-half cream
instructions: Sprinkle salt on both sides of the steak. Combine remaining ingredients except cream and marinate the steak in the refridgerator for at least 2 hours or the night before. Grill steak over medium hot fire or broil until done to preference. Remove steak and let rest for 5 minutes. Serve immediately. Serve on a bed of cooked jasmine rice. Garnish with sliced fruit.

Random Ingredients: blue curacao,vegetable oil,mexican cheese,vegetable shortening,flat bread,rump roast,bamboo shoot
title: Beef Stuffed Wraps
ingredients: 4 pounds boneless rump roast | 1 1/2 cups chopped vegetable shortening | 1/4 cup vegetable oil | 1/4 cup mexican-style processed cheese | 12 stuffed green creamed corn tortillas with holes | 1 can sliced bamboo shoots, drained | 6 drops blue curacao
instructions: Set oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source and preheat the oven's broiler. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Place the roast on the prepared baking sheet. In a medium bowl, combine the shortening, vegetable oil, and processed cheese. Mix until well combined. Spread tortillas with shortening mixture and top with shredded beef. Fold sides over the corned beef, covering completely. Sew closed each taco with a dampened toothpick. Arrange upright on the prepared baking sheet. Broil until the outside is golden brown and the outside is starting to crispy, about 15 minutes. Watch carefully to make sure the toothpick doesn't burn. Slice and serve with blue curacao.

title: Trout Bisque
ingredients:
1/4 cup heavy cream | 12 small whole trout ( about 1 1/2 lb.
    - )
instructions: Heat the cream in a small heavy skillet over moderate heat, stirring, until it is hot, but not boiling. Pour hot cream into a blender and whish or stir until very smooth. Ladle the cream mixture into a clean shallow bowl or platter. Place the fish in the cream. Using tongs, dip the fish in the cream. Put fish onto a platter and keep warm in a broiler, covered with foil or foil. Boil or steam the trout for about 20 minutes or until cooked through, turning once.

Random Ingredients: milk chocolate,graham cracker crumb,pesto sauce,bacon dripping
title: Caramelized Pesto Curd
ingredients: 1/4 cup bacon drippings | 2 cups graham cracker crumbs | 1 cup milk chocolate candy bar, melted | 2 teaspoons pesto sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. In a medium saucepan, melt the bacon drippings. Mix in graham cracker crumbs, melted chocolate candy, and pesto. Add warm milk chocolate, stirring thoroughly until well blended. Transfer mixture to a 1 quart baking dish. Bake in preheated oven 45 to 55 minutes, until crust is golden brown. Let stand 20 minutes before serving.

title: Crunchy Fruit Scones
ingredients: 2 cups bread flour | 2 ounces dried fruit ( such as prunes, dried apricots or peaches )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f / 200°c / gas mark mix flour and fruit in a bowl. Make a well in the centre of the flour mixture. Make a well in the centre. Stir in 1 teaspoon of the baking soda mixed with 1 teaspoon water. Knead quickly, drawing in corners of the bowl and kneading in enough extra flour until dough holds together in a large, roundishish roll. Cut into 6 - 10 scones. Place on prepared baking sheets and brush with remaining soda and water. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes or until golden and crisp.

title: Spanish Beans - Vegan
ingredients: 1 yellow onion, diced | 1 can white beans ( or kidney beans ) | 1 -2 tablespoon soy sauce ( to taste )
instructions: Place the chopped onion in a non stick pan with a lid on it. Place the lid on the pan and cook on medium low flame. While the onion is cooking, you can begin to drain the liquid from the can of white and yellow beans you used. Turn the heat down to low. Drain the can from can and put into a microwave safe container. Add the soy sauce and heat until warm. When beans are warm, set aside. In a large bowl, add the 1 - 2 tablespoons of soy sauce. Once onion is heated through, dump the contents of the non stick pan in and stir to combine. Turn off the burner. Afterwards, dump the empty white bean liquid into a small bowl and stir. Strain the empty bean juice/water into the empty bean bowl and pour back into the bowl with the sauce. Cook for 2 - 3 minutes. Dump the contents of the non stick pan in and stir to combine. Turn off the burner. Let sit for a few minutes to let the flavors combine then serve hot.

Random Ingredients: italian salad dressing,pork tenderloin,mozzarella cheese,strawberry,rib celery,white wine vinegar
title: Italian-Style Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 2 ribs celery, sliced thin | 2 tablespoons italian salad dressing | 2 tablespoons wine vinegar | 1 lb pork tenderloin, boned | 1/2 lb fresh strawberries, quartered | 1/2 lb fresh mozzarella cheese, cut into cubes
instructions: Slice the tenderloins in half lengthwise and set aside. Combine the salad dressing, vinegar, and salt and pepper in a gallon ziploc bag and place in a resealable plastic bag with 2 or 3 pieces of the tenderloin pieces. Add the ziploc bag and massage to combine. Add the beef, swiss cheese, and strawberries, stirring to coat the meat.

title: Mushroom Alfredo
ingredients: 8 ounces button mushrooms | 1 jar alfredo sauce, divided | 1/2 cup peanut butter | 1 teaspoon cornstarch | 1/4 teaspoon black pepper | 3/4 cup granulated sugar
instructions: Set a few aside for sprinkling over finished product. You can also preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place mushrooms on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, and drizzle with half of the sauce. Sprinkle on the other half of the sauce and half of the peanut butter. Mix together the corn starch and remaining sauce ingredients until smooth. Spread mixture over mushrooms, and bake in preheated oven until the mixture begins to bubble up, about 35 to 40 minutes. Sprinkle with the reserved chopped pecans if desired.

Random Ingredients: tahini,hoisin sauce,bow tie pasta,grain white rice,red onion,red leaf lettuce,red kidney bean,red curry paste
title: Vietnamese Rice Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup grain white rice | 1 can red kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 1/2 cup red onion, sliced | 6 cups mixed fresh red leaf lettuce, rinsed and drained | 1/2 cup red curry paste | 1/4 cup tahini | 3 tablespoons hoisin sauce | 1 1/2 cups cooked bow tie pasta, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Cook rice in a pot with enough lightly salted water to cover until just tender, about 12 minutes. Drain and rinse. Place rice, kidney beans, onion, and half of the salad greens in a large bowl. Whisk together curry paste, tahini, and hoisin sauce.

title: Raspberry and Cumin Cream Dressing
ingredients: 300 ml double cream | 250 g raspberries | 1 teaspoon fresh ground black pepper | 1 teaspoon ground cumin seeds | 1 teaspoon finely chopped celery seed
instructions: Line a chilled bowl with clingfilm. Place the cream, raspberries, pepper, cumin and celery seed in the bowl. Toss to combine. Serve immediately.

title: Simmered Greek Vegetables With Yogurt
ingredients: 1 medium head red cabbage, shredded | 2 medium yellow peppers, diced | 1 1/2 cups greek yogurt | 3 tablespoons tomato juice
instructions: Place cabbage, peppers and 3 tbsp yogurt in a serving bowl. Add remaining ingredients and stir well to combine. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: sirloin tip roast,tomato sauce,red kidney bean,double cream,scallion,mango chutney,carrot,tortilla
title: Tortilla Beef With Brown Beans & Mango Chutney
ingredients: 1/4 sirloin tip roast | 2 large carrots, sliced or | 1 red kidney beans, rinsed & amp, drained | 14 1/2 fluid ounces tomato sauce | 1 ounce double cream | 6 small tortillas | 4 scallions or 4 green onions | 1 tablespoon mango chutney
instructions: Place the shredded sirloin tip into a frying pan, add the red beans, tomato sauce & cream. Heat & allow to cook for 5 minutes remove from the heat & add the chutney & keep warm. Meanwhile fry the tortillas in hot fat & drain well, set aside. Serve the beef, carrot & beans with the chutney on the side. Spoon the chutney on the beef & garnish with the tortillas and scallions or green onions.

title: Easy Mexican Chili Oil
ingredients: 1/2 cup chili oil | 2 -3 serrano chilies, deveined seeded and chopped
instructions: Heat chili oil in a small saucepan on low heat. Once the oil is heated add the chiles and stir. Do not let it boil.

title:
