ingredients: 3 large egg whites | 1 1/2 tablespoons unflavored gelatin | 1 1/2 cups vegetable broth
instructions: In a large bowl, thoroughly mix the gelatin. Add the egg whites and beat until the whites have stiff, glossy peaks. Gradually add the vegetable broth and mix until blended. Fold in the gelatin mixture until completely dissolved. Scoop into a serving dish, cool and serve.

title: Thai Pot Roasted Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 teaspoons lemongrass, fresh and thinly sliced | 2 teaspoons garlic salt ( or use 2 teaspoons bottled minced garlic ) | 1/2 lb pot roast, trimmed and cut into 1/4-inch, bite-size chunks or strips | 2 cups potatoes traditional traditional traditional mashed potatoes, cold, cooked, mashed | 1 - 1 1/2 cup shredded lettuce, mixed lettuce | 1/2 cup thinly sliced peeled yummy instant mashed potatoes ( optional ) or 1/2 cup prepared sweet potato traditional potato | 1/2 cup fresh walnuts, chopped, divided | 2 -3 slices fresh korean radish ( optional ) or 2 -3 slices regular radish, thinly sliced, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Grease a baking sheet and line it with parchment paper. In a large nonstick skillet, combine lemongrass, garlic salt and beef. Cook meat over medium high heat, stirring often to brown it on all sides, about 5 minutes. Transfer meat to prepared baking sheet. Turn oven to broil and broil potato chunks until golden and crisp, stirring often to prevent scorching, about 5 minutes. Transfer hot meat to a plate. Turn broiler on to second side and place baking sheet on second shelf of oven. Return oven to 400 degrees f. Stir mashed potatoes into potato mixture and cook over medium heat, stirring often, until sauce is warm and creamy, about 8 minutes. Spread potatoes over 2 dinner plates and top with meat, some salad leaves and 2 tablespoons of remaining cheese blend. Sprinkle with 1/4 cup walnuts and 2 tbsp radish slices. Broil until cheese is melted and bubbly, about 2 minutes. Remove baking sheet from oven and place on top rack of oven and broil again until golden and browned, about 1 minute more.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,vegetarian beef,peppercorn,salad oil
title: Spicy and Spicy Fried Beef for 2
ingredients: 1 lb extra virgin olive oil | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs vegetarian ground beef | 3 tablespoons peppercorns, cracked | 1 tablespoon salad oil
instructions: Mix beef and pepper corns. Dip in olive oil and fry in 1 tbsp of salad oil until cooked thoroughly. Serve hot.

title: Fry Things
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups crushed corn flakes | 1 jar beef gravy
instructions: Place crushed cornflakes in a medium sized bowl. Pour the beef gravy in and stir until blended. Drop about 1 tablespoon sized balls on top of the corn flakes. Place under a hot broiler until lightly browned.

title: Baked Parsnips
ingredients: 4 large parsnips, peeled and sliced about 1/4 inch thick | 1 tablespoon anise seed
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Mix the parsnips with anise seed in a bowl or baking dish so as to coat. Roast in the preheated oven until the parsnips are tender and lightly browned, about 45 minutes. Allow to cool slightly before slicing. Variation, place half the parsnows in a single layer on a baking sheet that has been coated with cooking spray. Bake in the oven until crisp, about 30 minutes. Cool completely. Sprinkle with remaining parsnips and reheat in the microwave or in a bowl covered tightly with parchment or wax paper.

title: Fried Spiced Breadsticks
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups fine dry breadcrumbs | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried marjoram | 1/4 cup cold-pressed sunflower oil or 1/4 cup sunflower oil
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together the bread crumbs, marjoram and cold pressed oil until the mixture is thoroughly moistened. Form mixture into a thick patty about ½ inch thick. Cut the patty into ¾ inch thick sticks with cutters or a very sharp knife. Arrange the sticks on a lightly buttered baking sheet coated with oil. Bake at 350 degrees f. For around 20 minutes. Remove and let cool. Note, if not using immediately, you may have to dip them in melted, dark chocolate or chocolate butter. Some people even like them crispier. To serve, dip them in melted dark chocolate or dark soba.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,ginger,herb,asafoetida powder,heavy whipping cream,marinara sauce
title: Chef John's Asafoetida Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 4 green cardamom pods | 1/2 teaspoon dried herbs | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 1/2 teaspoon grated fresh ginger | 1 cup marinara sauce
instructions: Place the cream, cardamom pods, and herbs into a saucepan and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, place a cover on the saucepan, and let simmer over medium low heat until cardamom is fragrant, about 5 minutes. Stir often. Strain the cream mixture in a sieve or a coffee filter into another saucepan to discard cardamom pods and herbs. When cream is cool to the touch, stir in the asafoetida, ginger and marinara sauce until well blended. Remove cardamom pods and herbs and set aside to serve.

title: Cottage Cheese Curd
ingredients: 1 package cottage cheese | 1/3 cup rice wine ( or wine of choice )
instructions: Mix cottage cheese and rice wine in a bowl until creamy like mayonnaise consistency. Chill until ready for use.

title: Watermelon Vegetable Medley
ingredients: 6 tablespoons mascarpone | 1 tablespoon water-packed vegetable oil | 2 zucchini, cubed | 1 cup chopped seedless water chestnuts | 2 teaspoons vegeatable oil | 1 tablespoon water with mixed dry ingredients | 1 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: In a shallow baking dish mix mascarpone and water. Add zucchini and let sit 20 minutes. Meanwhile, in a medium skillet, heat the 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil over medium high heat. Add water chestnuts.

Random Ingredients: ruby red grapefruit juice,pancetta,basil,beef bouillon cube
title: Basil Gnocchi
ingredients: 1 lb pancetta or 1 lb bacon, chopped ( for mild, if desired ) | 2 beef bouillon cubes, crushed | 1 can ruby red grapefruit juice | 1/2 cup fresh basil, torn, divided
instructions: Brown pancetta in a heavy skillet over medium high heat, stirring often. Remove pan from heat. Add chopped bacon and beef bouillon cubes. Heat mixture for a few minutes, just to blend flavors. Add grapefruit juice. Return mixture to low heat and stir. Cook about 5 minutes. Discard bouillon cubes. Serve over uncooked pasta of your choice. Garnish with basil.

Random Ingredients: pecan,lamb shank,white vinegar,chicken,rigatoni pasta,bulk pork sausage,chili sauce
title: The Best, Easiest, &   Gluten Free One Pot Lamb Shanks
ingredients: 4 lamb shanks | 2 1/4 cups hot chili sauce ( i use paul prudhomme's ) | 1 1/4 cups white vinegar | 2 -4 lbs ground lamb | 10 ounces bulk pork sausage, removed from casing | 2 1/4 lbs rigatoni pasta or 2 1/4 lbs penne pasta, cooked according to package directions | 1 cup pecans, dried | 2/3 cup chinese white vinegar ( can use lite )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place lamb shank on a foil lined baking sheet, and drizzle each one with 2 to 3 tablespoons of the hot sauce. Place in oven and bake, shilling often, until meat thermometer reads 160 degrees f. Remove meat from oven and tent with foil. Set aside. Remove meat from the oven when slightly charred and beginning to caramelize in the pan. Place meat and remaining sauce in a heavy pot, and stir in meat juices, hot sauce and lite vinegar until smooth. Bring to a simmer over medium heat, cover the pot and cook for about 45 minutes or until meat is tender and sauce is thickened. Remove meat from the sauce and place it in a warmed large serving bowl. While the sauce simmers, boil pasta as directed on packet. Drain. While the pasta is cooking, remove the meat from the sauce and set aside. When pasta is cooked, drain well. Return sauce to saucepan, mix in remaining ingredients and heat over medium heat, stirring constantly. Pour this over meatballs and serve.

Random Ingredients: chicken wing,rigatoni pasta,white mushroom,hot red chili pepper,cheddar cheese,pork sausage
title: Rigatoni-Stuffed Chicken Wings
ingredients: 4 -6 chicken wings | 4 slices hot red chili peppers, minced | 1 1/2 cups shredded cheddar cheese | 1/2 cup mushroom, chopped | 1/2 cup cheddar cheese, shredded | 1 tablespoon whole white mushroom, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350ºf degrees. Place chicken wings, chili peppers, and cheddar cheese in a baking dish. Stuff each wing with a bit of the diced cheese. Bake in oven for 40 - 45 minutes or until the meat is tender and the cheese is melted.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,saffron,cheese,rye flour,red chile,hearty bread
title: Chile Rellenos
ingredients: 4 large fresh whole red chiles, deseeded and slit lengthwise | 2 cans condensed cream of chicken soup | 12 slices hearty-style bread | 1/3 cup grated cheese | 2 cups fresh shredded cheese | 1/2 teaspoon saffron ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees and lightly butter a large metal bowl. Add peppers to bowl and toss to coat with the butter. Transfer peppers to baking sheet. Bake peppers in preheated oven for about 30 minutes or until tender.

title: Tobiko - Japanese Watercress Balls
ingredients:
3 tablespoons cocoa | 1/4 teaspoon seasoning salt or 1/4 teaspoon white salt | 3 tablespoons corn flakes | 1/4 cup watercress, finely chopped | 2 ounces soft white breadcrumbs ( approx.
    - )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a small bowl. Put a little of the mixture in a larger bowl and mix together. Roll the mixture into balls. Sprinkle with more cocoa if desired. Chill for at least 1 hour.

title: Garlicky Pancetta Yogurt With Cilantro
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs pancetta, coarsely chopped | 3 tablespoons plain nonfat yogurt | 1 1/2 teaspoons cider vinegar | 2 -3 tablespoons fresh cilantro, coarsely chopped
instructions: Place pancetta in large skillet. Sprinkle with salt. Over medium heat, quickly brown pancetta until crisp. Transfer to plate lined with paper towel. Wipe out skillet with paper towel. In large bowl combine yogurt and vinegar. Toss with pancetta. Add half of the cilantro. Taste.

title: Savory Cheese Spread
ingredients: 8 ounces manchego cheese, shredded | 8 ounces dill pickles, minced | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh savory | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro
instructions: Combine all ingredients and puree until smooth. Spread on bread, broil until bubbly.

title: Irish Parsnips and Mustard
ingredients: 2 bunches parsnips | 2 1/2 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Slice parsnips in half lengthwise.

Random Ingredients: pink bean,greek salad dressing,apple juice,sunflower oil,catsup,braunschweiger sausage,green bean
title: German Salad
ingredients: 2/3 cup apple juice | 1/3 cup catsup | 2 teaspoons sunflower oil | 3/4 cup greek salad dressing | 1 cup bunschweiger sausages | 1/2 cup green beans, trimmed | 1/4 cup red beans, trimmed
instructions: In a jar with a lid, combine the apple juice, catsup, oil and salad dressing. Shake until ingredients are well blended. Place sausages and green and red beans in a medium bowl, pour the dressing over the sausages and toss well. Pour salad into a serving dish and garnish with croutons.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,green bell pepper,serrano pepper,sultana,bavarian sauerkraut,graham cracker
title: Crock Pot Baked Savory Nachos
ingredients: 1 loaf refrigerated fresh savory-nachos or ( 5 1/4 ounce ) loaf fresh sour doughnuts | 1 green bell pepper, seeded and diced | 2 small serrano peppers, seeded and minced | 2 cups shredded mexican blend cheese | 7 ounces bavarian-style sauerkraut | 2 cups sultanas
instructions: Place the refrigerated savory or hot dog rolls in the bottom of the slow cooker crockpot. Sprinkle with green bell pepper, serrano peppers and then ladle over the sauerkraut and top with shredded cheese.

Random Ingredients: pineapple ring,sesame seed,granny smith apple,lime zest
title: Grilled Apple Salad
ingredients: 2 medium granny smith apples, peeled and coarsely diced ( about 2/3 pound ) | 2 1/4 cups pure pineapples in juice | 2 1/2 teaspoons fresh lime zest, coarsely grated | 1 teaspoon sesame seeds
instructions: In a large bowl toss apples with orange peel through juice. Stir in zest and sesame seeds. Cover and refrigerate about 1 hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,papaya,cumin,extra virgin olive oil,parmigiano reggiano cheese,ricotta cheese
title: Papaya & Ricotta Pasta
ingredients: 2 medium ripe papayas, seeded and thinly sliced | 4 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons dark sesame oil | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 2 tablespoons grated freshly grana padano or 2 tablespoons grana padano | 1 pound ricotta cheese, room temperature
instructions: In a large bowl, combine papayas, 1 tablespoon of the olive oil, sesame oil, ground cumin, and remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil. Stir with a fork until papaya is evenly coated. Transfer mixture to a large resealable plastic bag and refrigerate for 1 hour. In a large pot of hot water, cook the ricotta cheese in the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil until it is thickened and has no lumps. Using a colander, drain the cheese completely and mix in with the cheese. Spread the mixture over the pasta in an even layer. Toss to coat the pasta and to distribute evenly. Serve at once.

title: Homemade Sausage, Italian Sausage & Fennel
ingredients: 1 lb ground italian sausage, casings removed | 1 large fennel leaves or 1 large mixed italian herbs, coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees. In a large bowl, add the sausage and fennel and combine well. Spread the mixture onto a piece of parchment paper or greased cookie. Bake for 45 minutes. Remove the sausage mixture from the oven and carefully break up into crumbles as it cooks. Serve immediately.

title: Avocado Burritos
ingredients: 1 large ripe avocado | salad oil | 10 sheets phyllo pastry | 3 teaspoons olive oil
instructions: Peel avocadoes and cut into very thin slices, about 1 cup. Place slices on paper towels and sprinkle with salad oil. Let drain for about 5 minutes. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Brush a baking sheet with some salad oil. Lay 10 sheets of phyllo pastry on the bottom of the baking sheet. Brush with some more oil. Spread with some avocado slices. Place 5 more sheets of phyllo and repeat until all sheets are used, brushing with more oil as necessary. Place baking sheet on top of the sheet directly on the hot oven rack. When edges of phyllo are light brown, brush with olive oil. Remove pan of phyllo and carefully transfer to an oven griddle. Cook for about 5 minutes, then turn over with a spatula. Cook for 5 more minutes, then remove with spatula and transfer to a plate.

title: Basic Dressing
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs | 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well.

title: Catfish-Oyako-Ni on a Bamboo Stick Roll
ingredients: 1 pie shell | 2 sheets ladyfingers | 2 1/2 tablespoons catfish, cooked | 3 tablespoons lettuce ( japanese ) | 3 slices tomatoes | 3 4 tablespoons mirin
instructions: Slice off the top of each ladyfinger, making the thumbprint to the point of the knife, making it like the bottom of a small melon ball. Lay the ladyfingers, cut side up, on a bamboo stick. If they are long, slice them lengthwise, or make the fingers thinner. Place the slices of fish inside the shell on each ladyfinger piece, packing it tightly. Wrap the nori in a strip of string, and arrange a row of the pieces of fish on the string. Pour 1 tbsp mirin over the ingredients. Roll the rolls up into a neat cylinder, using the bamboo stick as handle. Repeat with the remaining nori. Serve chilled with hot sake and wasabi. Salsa verde yoro.

Random Ingredients: rotel tomato,blackberry,beef sirloin,almond paste,red lentil,baby carrot,mint sprig
title: Sizzling Red Lentils With Beef
ingredients: 1/2 cup red lentils ( red or yellow ) | 1/2 lb blackberries | 2 packages frozen beef sirloin, thawed | 1 can rotel tomatoes | 4 large cooked baby carrots | sliced almonds | mint sprig
instructions: Rinse lentils and lentils well to remove grit. Combine lentils and blackberries in 3 quart slow cooker. Top with beef. Combine rotel tomatos with juice and pour over top of beef. Set cooker to high. Reduce heat to low and cook for 12 hours. Serve with sliced almonds and mint.

Random Ingredients: stewing beef,radish,cherry tomato,cayenne,yellow bell pepper,breadcrumb,cottage cheese,tabasco sauce
title: American Kitchen Classic Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs stewing beef, trimmed | 1 pinch salt | tabasco sauce | 1 yellow bell pepper, julienned | 1 large radish, halved and thinly sliced | 6 cherry tomatoes, halved | 1 cup low fat cottage cheese | fresh ground cayenne or red pepper ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cottage cheese, pepper and cayenne and mix well. Heat bbq, grill or frying pan until almost smoking. Place meat on oiled rack and brown. Grill or fry bell pepper while meat is cooking, or if using cayenne add a little hot water.

title: Spicy Carrots
ingredients: 1 carrot, cut into 4 or 5 pieces depending on size | 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 1 tablespoon black peppercorns | 1 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Peel the carrots. Cut them into 1 inch thick sticks. Put carrots in a pan and add 1 water, the curry paste and the black pepper and a little of the water from the carrot if using it. Add the remaining water to make a thin film on top and put the carrots on a medium heat for about 20 minutes. Turn down to medium heat and stir, making sure all the water is absorbed, until all of the carrots are soft. I usually do not stir them at all during cooking so they don't burn.

Random Ingredients: head broccoli,margarita mix,cheddar cheese,ancho chile powder,pistachio
title: Roast Broccoli With ancho Chile & Garlic
ingredients: 2 large heads of broccoli | 4 tablespoons margarita mix, recipe follows ( such as orin-olive oil blend ) | 1 tablespoon ground ancho chile powder | 1/2 cup pimento pieces ( spanish peanuts ) | 1/2 cup chopped roasted salted pistachios
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place brocolli in a 13x9 inch baking dish and spread a scant 1/2 teaspoon of margarita mix over each broccoli head. Sprinkle on a pinch or two of ancho chile powder over each brocolli. Roast until broccoli is easily pierced with a fork, about 30 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool slightly. While broccoli is roasting, place pistachios in a small frying pan. Set aside. Roast ancho chile in the oven for about 5 minutes, until fragrant, then watch closely. Don't let the chile get dry. When it's cool enough to handle, scrape the peel away along the sides into the hot pan and peel off the burned skin. Strip the ribs and leaves carefully of the stalk. Slice diagonally into thin slices. While the brocolli are roasting, pour 1/2 cup water into a large saucepan, and sprinkle the roasted pistachios on top. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer. Set aside for at least 10 minutes to allow the flavors to blend. When the brocolli are cool enough to handle, slice diagonally into thin slices. Drizzle with the remaining 1/2 cup of margarita mix and sprinkle with a pinch of chile powder. Serve at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,balsamic vinegar,turmeric powder,apple cider
title: Apple Ketchup
ingredients: 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons apple cider | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 dash turmeric powder
instructions: Pour all ingredients into a saucepan and simmer for 20 minutes. You may need to cook the cumin and the coriander in the chicken soup to get the right consistency. Add a little water if it seems too thick.

title: Easy Prune Noodles
ingredients: 8 -9 ounces fresh egg noodles | 5 -6 prunes, pitted and sliced | fennel seed | asiago cheese or fontina cheese
instructions: Cook noodles until tender according to package instructions. Drain and rinse with cold water. Spray a skillet with cooking spray or lightly grease it. Cook prunes over medium low heat only until softened and dark in color, 2 to 3 minutes. Remove from heat, drain and set aside. Add fennel seeds to the same skillet and toast fennel till fragrant for 2 to 3 minutes, stirring often. Push prunes to the side of the pan and add egg noodles. Sprinkle lightly with asian cheese or fontina cheese and serve immediately.

title: Watermelon Salad With Yellow Rice Dressing
ingredients:
1 cup uncooked yam ( chopped small ) | 4 cups finely chopped seedless watermelon | 1 jar chopped pimiento, drained | 2 tablespoons chopped of fresh mint, or | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh marjoram ( or 1/2 tsp.
    - dried ) | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar | 3/4 cup yogurt | 3 tablespoons finely chopped fresh mint | 1 teaspoon fresh marjoram ( or 1/2 tsp.
    - dried ) | 2 cups uncooked yellow rice
instructions: Cook yam in salted boiling water for 8 minutes or till very tender, drain. Add to yam with watermelon, pimientos, 2 tbsp. Fresh mint, marjoram, cream of tartar, yogurt and 1 1/2 tbsp. Finely chopped fresh mint. Refrigerate for 20 minutes. Right before serving, add remaining 1 1/2 tsp. Finely chopped mint and blend well. Serve cold.

Random Ingredients: bay seasoning,fennel bulb,chicken bouillon granule,tahini,yellow pepper,salmon
title: Whole Foods Smoked Salmon & Tahini Sauce
ingredients: 4 lbs bone in salmon | 2 fennel bulbs, finely chopped and seeded | 1 large yellow pepper, diced | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon granules | 2/3 cup tahini | 1/3 cup old bay seasoning
instructions: Place fish in crockpot and sprinkle with fennel bulb, yellow pepper and chicken bullion. Cover. Cook on high 1 hour, then reduce to low and cook for 8 – 10 hours. Remove salmon from the crockpot and pour sauce on top. Stir. Cover and allow to cool for 15 minutes. Place 1 tablespoon of puree back into the crockpot and heat. This sauce can be made vegetarian by allowing the sauce to boil away for a few minutes after removing the bay. Serve with whole grain bread and sliced roasted vegetables.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper,spanish olive,beef chuck,sun tomato oil
title: Roasted Beef With Olives
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef chuck, trimmed of all excess fat | 1/2 cup spanish olives, pitted with all juices | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, minced | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Heat broiler. Lightly coat a 2 foot wide, 12 inch heavy skillet with cooking spray. Place the beef in the pan. Drizzle the olives over both sides of the beef and season with salt and pepper. Broil the beef until the internal temperature reaches 130 f for medium rare, 12 to 15 minutes per pound for rare to medium. Transfer the beef to a platter and tent with foil. Let rest for 5 minutes. Slice the platter and serve with the beef. If you are planning on filling the platter with meat and vegetables serve over mashed potatoes.

Random Ingredients: pork loin chop,almond extract,vanilla extract,white vinegar
title: Chinese Pork Chops (Chops De La Neige)
ingredients: 2 lbs pork loin chops ( or substitute any white meat you like ) | 1 1/4 tablespoons almond extract ( available at asian grocery stores ) | 1/4 cup white vinegar | 1 tablespoon vanilla extract
instructions: In a bowl combine almond extract, white vinegar and vanilla extract. Dip chops in almond mixture until well coated. Then set chops in the vinegar mixture and chill overnight. The longer they marinate the better the flavor will meld for about a few hours. In a steamer, steam steaming, covered, over medium heat for 3 to 4 hours, turning chops and steaming often, or until internal temperature reaches 155 f. When finished marinating, allow chops to cool and remove fat from the marinade. Shake off any excess marinade and reserve. Allow chops to sit at room temperature for a few hours or overnight. Slice chops thin and serve with a dollop of sour cream and salad.

title: Coconut and Irish Moss Powder
ingredients: 250 g dried irish moss | 1 package instant gosat gumbo soup | 10 g chicken gumbo soup | 4 teaspoons coconut flakes
instructions: In a microwave safe bowl combine the oat gosat gumbo, chicken gumbo, and coconut flakes. Microwave on medium high for 4 minutes. Stir while heating. Remove from microwave, let sit for 2 to 3 minutes, then pour into powder bag, and shake to combine. Serve hot.

title: Easy Glazed Raisins on the Cinnamon Roll
ingredients: 1 cup raisins | 1/2 lime, pulp of | 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon | 1/4 teaspoon thyme sprig | 1 egg yolk | 1 tablespoon golden syrup, made into a paste with the sugar
instructions: Rinse the raisins in cold water. Add all remaining ingredients except the cinnamon and sugar to a saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Lower heat and simmer until the raisins soften, 2 - 3 minutes. Remove from heat. Remove cinnamon and thyme. Cover.

title: "the Perfect Sandwich" (Sloaf)
ingredients: 12 hoagie rolls | 1/2 cup white onion ( thin sliced )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Mix onions in a bowl and put in a loaf pan. Slice the loaf of bread into approximately 1/4 inch slices. Put bread slices on top of onions for approximately five minutes. Carefully spread the hoagie slices with the onions. Bake for 10 - 16 minutes. To make the second loaf you will need to cook it for approximately 10minutes.

title: Green Chili Salsa
ingredients: 12 -24 poblano chiles | 8 ounces green chili salsa, your favorite
instructions: Preheat oven to 400° farenheit. Wash and devein pablano chilies and cut into 1 inch strips. Place on cookie sheet in single layer. Roast for 20 minutes, turning once. Cool slightly and slice 1 pieces. When cool again, peel and place in a bowl with salsa. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Cheese Croquettes
ingredients: corn, fresh and thawed ( for croquettes ) | 1/4 cup agave nectar | 1 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1/2 teaspoon celery seed | 1/2 cup breadcrumbs ( to be used per croquette )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a non reactive bowl and blend well using a blender. Chill dough for up to two hours to allow flavors to blend. Form into balls and place on a greased cookie sheet or pizza pan. Cover croquettes with waxed paper and allow to stand at room temperature for 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Bake at 400° for 10 minutes, then turn croquettes out onto a rack to cool. To freeze, place in a ziplock bag and allow to thaw for a few hours or overnight. To finish serve, place on a platter and top with bread crumbs.

Random Ingredients: oregano,fennel seed,farfalle pasta,ice water,red kidney bean,hot paprika
title: Portuguese White Bean Soup
ingredients: 1 lb dried farfalle pasta, uncooked | 1 can red kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 4 cups water or 4 cups vegetable stock | hot paprika | fennel seed | oregano ( to taste )
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add the farfalle, and then cook until al dente. Drain. Add the kidney beans and 4 cups of stock, and mix in more hot stock to reach the desired thickness. Grate in a few dashes of ground paprika and fennel seeds, season to taste, and serve.

title: Easy Vietnamese Green Salad
ingredients: 1 head boston lettuce | 5 tablespoons corn oil
instructions: Cut the top off of each lettuce leaf. With the flat of a small spoon, scoop out the center of each leaf with a small knife. Cut the leaf into smaller pieces, keeping any clinging outer leaves from flod. You may use any lettuce sprout with large inner leaves. Heat the corn oil in a frying pan. When very hot, add the lettuce, cover and steam until just limp. Remove from heat and toss thoroughly. Divide lettuce between serving plates, top with a few leaves of boston and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chili paste,lemon juice zest,gizzard,oat bran,green pea,beer,hoagie
title: Gizzards on the Rocks
ingredients: 1 cup rolled oats | 1/2 cup oat bran | 2 tablespoons chili paste | 2 drops lemon juice, zest of | 1 1/2 cups beer | 1 1/2 cups grated gizzards | 1 1/2 cups frozen green peas
instructions: Heat the beer, lemon zest, chili paste and cheese in a small pot over low heat for about 15 minutes. When the cheese has melted, remove from the heat. Stir in the peas, cover and allow to set and set again. To serve, cut meat diagonally at the table and arrange on top of the oat bran.

title: Mashed Cauliflower and Lime
ingredients: 2 large heads cauliflower, cut into bite-size pieces | 1/2 cup half-and-half cream | 1 lime, juiced | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Bring a pot of salted water to a boil. Boil the cauliflower heads for about 15 minutes, until very tender. Drain and place into a large bowl of ice water for a few minutes to prevent further cooking. Drain and transfer to a colander set in the sink. Stir the half and half into the cauliflower in the bowl, stirring until the cream is smoothly combined and incorporated.

title: Spicy Szechuan Noodle (Ma Hsiu Rou)
ingredients: 1 lb lasagna noodle, uncooked | 1 jar chili-garlic sauce ( i like muir glen brand ) | 2 tablespoons dry sherry
instructions: Cook noodles per package directions. Meanwhile in saucepan, combine chili sauce and sherry.

title: Quick Mushroom Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 lb cremini mushroom | 1 teaspoon dried chili sauce | 1/2 cup soymilk ( or soy milk ) | 2 teaspoons cognac
instructions: Clean and de trim mushrooms. Discard the stems and clean the mushroom caps, if any. Rinse the mushrooms under running water and drain. Place the mushrooms and dried chili sauce in a food processor. Process to mix. Cover and refrigerate for at least one hour so the liquid can be absorbed. For vegetarian use soy milk or a combination.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,pinto bean,green chili,gingerroot,arugula,bamboo shoot
title: Baked Beans & Chilies (Geng Dal)
ingredients:
2 cans pinto beans | 2 1/2 cm gingerroot, finely chopped | 2 1/2 cm green chili, chopped | 1 red chili pepper, chopped | 0.
    -5 can bamboo shoots, chopped, drained | 2 1/4 lbs arugula, stalks and leaves, coarsely chopped
instructions: Combine the pinto beans, ginger, chopped chilies and bamboo shoots in a large bowl. Heat oven to 300°f with lid on roasting pan combine mixture, add salt to taste. Place mixture into preheated oven and bake, uncovered, stirring occasionally until beans are golden & crispy around the edges. About 1 hour or less before serving, remove pan from oven, stir bean mixture well & cool 3 - 5 minutes. Transfer to serving bowl and discard ginger. Serve bean mixture over or alongside a few chopped onions & chopped greens.

Random Ingredients: hard salami,plain nonfat yogurt,snow pea,buttermilk,beef sausage,italian bread crumb,coffee,serrano chili
title: Chile and Sweet Salami Bake
ingredients:
1 loaf italian bread crumbs | 8 ounces pepperoni sausage ( cooked ) | 8 ounces hot italian-style hot beef sausage, removed from casing ( cooked ) | 1 teaspoon hot coffee ( optional ) | 1 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1 cup buttermilk | 1/4 cup fresh serrano chili, finely chopped ( or jalapeno ) | 1/2 lb fresh snow pea ( or regular white snow peas ) | 3/4 lb fresh hot salami ( cut into thin slices or 1/4 lb.
    - cooked ham ) ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to coat a 13 x 9 baking pan with cooking spray. Combine bread crumbs, sausage, hot coffe, yogurt and buttermilk in a bowl. Mix in the hot chile and salami. Remove the bread mixture from the bowl, and mix in the remaining ingredients. Spoon mixture into prepared pan.. Bake for about 35 minutes, until lightly browned. Sprinkle with the remaining pepper slices, and serve.

Random Ingredients: mandarin orange,chuck,liquid smoke,chili powder,roast beef,marjoram,beef bouillon granule
title: Dynamite Beef on Weck Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb chuck | 3 cans weck | 2 packets beef bouillon granules | 2 teaspoons chili powder | 1/4 teaspoon marjoram | 1 dash liquid smoke | 8 ounces mandarin oranges, drained
instructions: Place chuck in crock pot. Remove extra fat and gristle from beef. Place remaining beef in crock pot. Combine broth and seasonings until well blended. Pour mixture over meat. Cook on low for 8 hours. Remove beef from broth and place into bowl for freezing. Skim off fat as needed. Slice meat and return to stockpot. Add mandarin oranges. Simmer for another 10 - 15 minutes. Serve on hamburger buns with toothpicks for mopping up.

title: Microwave Vegetables
ingredients: 1/4 lb dried shiitake mushroom | 1 can ro-tel tomatoes and green chilies, drained | 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 1 tablespoon tea, concentrate | 1 package noodles ( i use chow mein )
instructions: Combine all ingredients except chow mein noodles in the crock dish. Cover and cook on hi 4 - 4 hours. Turn off cooker and stir. Cover and let stand 5 minutes. Sprinkle with chow mein noodles.

title: Chokladbake
ingredients: 1 spanish onion, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon sesame oil | 2 cups peas ( frozen shelled pina coarsley or fresh shelled cooked pina coarsley p ) | 4 medium eggplants, sliced lengthwise | 2 ounces dark chocolate, chopped | 1/2 cup green sweet pepper, chopped
instructions: Cook onion in vegetable oil until they just start to soften. Add the peas and cook over medium heat 3 - 5 minutes. Place the eggplants on a baking sheet and brush with onion oil and set aside. Place in the over of a hot griddle, and cook about 3 - 5 minutes per side, or until desired doneness. Cool, and chop up in large, very fine pieces. Spread on wax paper and refrigerate until cold, and use in place of chokladbake. Grate chokladbake into large pieces and store in the refrigerator.

title: My Special French Fried Onions
ingredients: 4 medium white onions | 4 tablespoons ham fat, or more as desired ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Cut slits in onion 1/2 to 3/4 inch deep in slices. Place in a 10x15 inch pan. Sprinkle with a little salt. Drizzle with fat. Bake in preheated oven until lightly brown, 35 to 45 minutes. Sprinkle with a little more fat if needed.

title: Green Beans and Ricotta
ingredients: 1/2 lb green beans, cleaned and trimmed | 1/3 lb ricotta cheese
instructions: Preparation cook beans according to package directions, drain and rinse well in cold water. Place drained beans in a large serving bowl and toss with ricotta and chopped vegetables. Serve with bread slices.

Random Ingredients: pepper sauce,almond paste,ear corn,cointreau liqueur,baby spinach,natural yoghurt
title: Spinach and Pepper Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup almond paste | 1/2 cup natural yoghurt | 1 1/2 tablespoons cointreau liqueur | 4 cups baby spinach, stems removed | 1 tablespoon dried hot pepper sauce | 1 package frozen ear corn
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large bowl and mix well. Chill for at least two hours for flavours to meld.

title: Applebee's Taco Blend
ingredients: 2 cups applesauce | 1 envelope taco seasoning mix
instructions: Mix applesauce and taco seasoning together in a bowl until thoroughly blended.

title: Tuna Fish Tacos
ingredients: 2 cans tuna, drained and flaked or ( 7 ounce ) cans extra virgin olive oil drained | 1 bulb of garlic, minced ( about 1 1/2 tablespoons ) | 3 tablespoons brandy ( i use pineapple flavored ) | 1 pinch garlic salt | 1 pinch taco seasoning | 1 slice white bread, toasted or torn into small pieces | 1 small turnip, peeled and finely chopped ( optional ) | nori, to serve ( optional )
instructions: Place tuna, garlic, brandy, garlic salt, and taco seasoning into a bowl. Toss or gently stir to combine. Let sit for 10 minutes. Toast the bread, spread some of the mixture over toasted bread. Set another toasted bread slice or two on top and let sit for 5 minutes longer. To serve, top with the turnip and tomato.

title: Rabas Polo - Iranian Beef & Rice
ingredients: 1 lb beef, cut into 3/4 inch pieces | french beans, cut into 1 inch lengths | 1/4 teaspoon saffron | 1 tablespoon garlic powder | 8 ounces beer ( light brown, or amber ) | 1 1/2 cups brown rice, washed
instructions: Mix all ingredients except rice in a large pot and simmer for 20 - 30 minutes stirring frequently, or until meat is tender. Turn off heat. Stir in rice and cover. Let rest for 5 - 10 minutes before serving. You can also make a long grain brown rice and serve it at the table as well.

Random Ingredients: beef roast,baby spinach,velveeta cheese product,dark chocolate,green olive,mango,raspberry
title: Easy Cheesesteak Dip
ingredients: 1 can whole red radishes, cut in thin slices | 1/2 can dark chocolate, grated | 1 can green olives, drained and chopped | 1/2 lb velveeta cheese product, cut into cubes | 1 bag baby spinach | 1 1/2 cups frozen blackberries | 2 cups sliced fresh mango
instructions: Sift cheese into mixing bowl.

title: Spicy Prawns (Prawns)
ingredients: 400 g mincemeat | 4 tablespoons drippings | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1 teaspoon mixed spice | 2 tomatoes, sliced
instructions: Gently fry the mince with the curry powder and mixed spice until the mixture changes colour and mince has changed colour. Add the tomato and leave to simmer until the prawns have turned opaque. Serve with steamed vegetables and salad.

title: Simple Nilla Cream Cheese
ingredients: 1 box marshmallows | 2 cans cream of mushroom soup
instructions: Microwave the marshmallows until warm. Add 1 can of cream of mushroom soup. Add 1 teaspoon of instant coffee granules/toffee flakes. Store in covered container.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,jicama,flat leaf italian parsley,shell pasta,romaine lettuce
title: Italian Beef Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef stew meat, cut into 1/2 inch thick slices | 1 head romaine lettuce | 1 bunch flat-leaf italian parsley, chopped | 1/2 lb uncooked small shell pasta, cooked to al dente | 1/3 cup julienned jicama, about 1/2 cup
instructions: In a large serving bowl, combine beef with remaining ingredients except jicama and toss gently to blend. Cover and refrigerate 1 hour. Serve salad cold.

Random Ingredients: poblano chile,red chili powder,plain flour,ham,plain nonfat yogurt,chocolate,vanilla,shiitake mushroom
title: Savoury Chocolate Fajitas
ingredients: 8 ounces plain nonfat yogurt or 8 ounces sour cream | 1 1/2 ounces shaved baked ham, finely chopped | 2 poblano chiles, finely chopped ( i like to use a red hot chile! ) | 4 ounces shiitake mushrooms, chopped ( about 3/4 'oz total weight ) | 4 ounces plain nonfat yogurt or 4 ounces sour cream | 1 1/2 teaspoons crushed red chili powder | 3 teaspoons plain unbleached all-purpose flour | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Preheat fan forced oven to 180c/350f degrees. Line 2 baking trays with non stick baking paper. Mix together the yogurt and chiles in a small bowl. Spoon yogurt mixture into a medium bowl. Add the ham and mushrooms and stir to combine. Mix in the flour and mix thoroughly. Pour 1/2 cup yogurt mixture onto tray lined with non stick baking paper. Place tray on oven tray and bake for 10 minutes, stirring half way through. Remove from oven and cool completely. Repeat with remaining yogurt mixture and mixture. When mixture is cool, fold in the vanilla. To serve, spoon a fajita mixture onto a plate, top with a drizzle of sauce and sprinkle with chocolate curls. Variation, for fajitas omit the cream and reduce the filling to 1/2 cup.

title: Pound Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 pound boneless, skinless chicken, cut into pieces | 1 large banana pepper, diced | 2 teaspoons dried dill | 1 1/2 cups cake flour for coating
instructions: Combine the chicken, banana pepper, dill and flour in a large bowl.

title: Tahini Corn
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb baby beets or 1 -1 1/2 lb corn | 2 -2 tablespoons tahini | 2 -3 tablespoons freshly ground coriander powder | 1 teaspoon adobo seasoning
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and add baby beets/corn. Cook for about 3 - 4 minutes, until beets/corn begins to tender but be sure not to overcook or they are going to dry out. Remove veggies from water with slotted spoon and plunge into a bowl of ice water or your sink and place the bowl of ice in the sink to stop cooking. Slice the beets/corn in half and place in a pot with the tahini. Add 1 - 2 tb of the coriander powder to be added at the end of the cooking time. Stir to combine then add adobo seasoning. Adjust seasonings to taste. Serve immediately or cover and store in the refrigerator up to two days. You can also add garlic and/or other spices while cooking.

Random Ingredients: mexican tomato,wonton wrapper,pistachio,corn,red curry paste,mushroom,beef chuck,rice noodle
title: Cambodian Sweet and Spicy Beef Wontons
ingredients: 1 package wonton wrappers | 1 jar beef chuck, cut into small pieces | 1 can diced mexican-style tomatoes | 1 can mushrooms, drained | 1 can stewed mexican-style tomatoes | 1 jar roasted diced corn, drained | 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 1 1/2 tablespoons minced pistachios
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place wonton wrappers on a rimmed baking sheet and place in the oven. Bake until lightly dried on one side and slightly crispy on the other, 5 to 10 minutes. Heat a large skillet over medium high heat and stir beef and diced tomatoes, mushrooms, stewed tomatoes, roasted corn, red curry paste, and pistachios together in a skillet. Stir until the beef mixture is thoroughly heated, about 5 minutes. Arrange wontons on a baking sheet. Pour beef mixture into the center of the wontons. Garnish wontons with pistachios, if desired. Return skillet to the oven.

Random Ingredients: tomato ketchup,roast beef,rosemary sprig,garlic,maple syrup,pork loin,salt black pepper,pork loin chop
title: Maple Roast Pork Loin Au Jus
ingredients: 4 lbs pork loin | 1 -2 tablespoon minced garlic | 1 -2 teaspoon dried rosemary sprig ( optional ) | 1 -2 tablespoon maple syrup | 1/4 lb chopped roast beef | 1/2 lb chopped pork loin, cut in half crosswise | 1/2 cup pureed tomato ketchup ( with the ketchup ) | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Combine garlic, rosemary and maple syrup in a small bowl. Place pork loin in large roasting pan, fat side down. Place pan in oven and turn temperature to 300°f. Bake in oven for about 3 hours or until internal temperature reaches 155 f. About 30 minutes before removing pork from the oven, combine ketchup with pork. Add salt and pepper to taste. Serve with gravy or roasted vegetables.

Random Ingredients: lime zest,graham cracker crust,coffee bean,baby spinach,green cardamom pod
title: Quick and Easy Kahwa
ingredients: 1/2 cup finely chopped fresh baby spinach | 2 green cardamom pods | 1/2 lime, zest of, minced | 8 ounces plain fat free coffee beans | 1 prepared graham cracker crust
instructions: Heat oven to 450 degrees f. Spray cookie sheet with cooking spray. In a bowl, add spinach, cardamom pods and lime zest. Split the egg from the rind and discard. Add the coffee beans and mix well. Spoon 1/3 of the mixture on the bottom of the crust. Spread 1/3 of beans over beans, then top with 1/3 of the spinach mixture and repeat layers. Do not press down the spinach distribution. Bake for approximately 20 minutes or until the top is brown and crisp.

title: Scallop and Cauliflower Soup
ingredients: 1 cauliflower ( about 3 cups ) | 6 fresh scallops | 4 ounces pepperoni, thinly sliced | 1 can vegetable broth
instructions: Snap off ends of cauliflower and separate leaves.

title: Easy Taco Seasoning Mix
ingredients: 1 packet mccormick's fajita seasoning mix | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together. Spray taco sauce dishes with cooking spray. Spoon mixture into taco shells or over taco meat.

title: Quinoa and Corny Greens
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa, rinsed | 7 1/2 cups cold water | 3 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1 1/2 teaspoons chopped fresh annatto seeds, or to taste | 3 cups thinly sliced portabella mushrooms | 1/2 cup chopped leeks | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cranberries, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Place the quinoa in a saucepan, and add 3 1/2 cups water. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes. While the quinoa mixture simmers, whisk together the vinegar, annatto seeds, and mushrooms in a large saucepan. Cook and stir over medium high heat until the mushrooms have tenderized and have begun to release their liquid, about 8 minutes. Add the leeks and continue cooking until the leeks have wilted, about 5 more minutes. Ladle in warm vinegar mixture, and serve.

Random Ingredients: mexican corn,soy sauce,creamy peanut butter,self raising flour
title: Corn and Peanut Butter Scrolls
ingredients: 500 g self-raising flour | 1 packet creamy peanut butter | 1 packet mexican-style corn | 1/4 cup soy sauce
instructions: Sift flour into a bowl. Add all other ingredients and mix to a dough, adding any leftover dough mixture and kneading to form a smooth, elastic dough. Lightly line baking trays with baking paper. Divide dough in half and roll out each portion very thinly. Use a knife to cut each roll into 4 squares about 5 cm thick. Place on tray and bake in moderately hot oven for 15 - 20 minutes, until pale golden and crispy. Serve warm or chilled.

title: Roman Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb sargento romano asiago cheese | 1 teaspoon salt
instructions: Dough will become slightly softer as it's made. Slice cheese about 1/4 3/4 1/4' thick, place on lightly greased baking sheet and bake on 400° for about 8 minutes until the inside is toasted. Note, i'm sure you can also use dental floss too for variety.

title: Thai Broccoli Soup
ingredients: 3 stalks lemongrass, cut in half lengthwise | 1 cup chopped fresh lemongrass | 1 can light vegetable broth | 1 1/2 teaspoons finely chopped fresh chili paste, or to taste
instructions: Heat broth and lemongrass in a large saucepan over high heat until fragrant, about 20 seconds. Stir in lemon grass. Add chili paste.

title: Chipotle Ranch Green Potato Salad
ingredients: 6 lbs red potatoes ( new potatoes or white potatoes ) | 4 ounces serrano chilies, finely chopped | 1/2 lb leek, white and light green, thinly sliced | 2 ripe avocados
instructions: Boil potatoes for 15 minutes. Drain potatoes and peel. Cut away any rinds and damaged bottoms. Cut each potato into 4 serving sized pieces. Heat oil in a skillet, add chiles and leeks and saute until leeks turn limp, about 2 minutes. Add potato pieces and mash. Stir in avocados and pour into serving bowl. Serve immediately or refrigerate to serve cold.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,thyme,swiss cheese,peanut,porcini mushroom
title: Porcini and Swiss Cheese
ingredients: 1/2 lb swiss cheese, grated ( or other mild white cheese ) | 1/2 lb cremini mushroom or 1/2 lb mushroom, sliced ( or a combination of mushrooms ) | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 tablespoon dried thyme | 4 tablespoons roasted peanuts
instructions: Cook mushrooms in 1 t olive oil over medium high heat, stirring and breaking them up with a spoon, until they're limp enough to be stirred. Remove from heat and stir in 1 t olive oil, thyme and remaining olive oil. Sprinkle the cheese over the top and transfer to the oven for 10 minutes. Sprinkle with peanuts, cover and rest for 5 minutes or longer.

title: Spinach, Lima Beans, and Cavatelli
ingredients: 1 lb frozen lima beans | 8 ounces raw spinach leaves | 1 tablespoon seasoning salt | 1 lb capelli pasta
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Rinse with cool water. When cool, drain lima beans and place them in a large pot. Add spinach, seasoning salt and water to cover beans. Cover and bring to boil. When just simmering, cook for 10 minutes. Add pasta and toss. Cover and cook 5 minutes. Serve.

Random Ingredients: cheese,marjoram,cantaloupe,red chili pepper,red chili powder,yogurt,bread crumb
title: Spicy Melon Balls With Yogurt
ingredients: 1 cantaloupe, ripe but still firm | 1 cup low-fat cheese, shredded | 1/3 cup low-fat yogurt | 2 teaspoons red chili powder | 1 teaspoon red chili powder | 1/2 teaspoon marjoram | 1/4 cup fresh bread crumb ( optional ) | 1 -2 red chili pepper ( dried, if available )
instructions: Peel melon and cut into chunks. Mix all ingredients and let stand in refrigerator for an hour. Roll melons into small balls, each about 3/4 of an inch diameter and press the edges lightly. Heat frying pan till smoking, add extra oil as needed and fry melon balls. Cook on one side till golden brown.

title: Overnight Italian Bread
ingredients: 2 loaves italian bread | 1 yellow onion
instructions: Slice stale italian bread into two even pieces which are approximately 1 x 1 x2 inches. Preheat oven to in a medium sized bowl, put bread into a large bowl. Slice onion into half rings. Put sliced bread in a bread machine set on the loaf size. Put onion slices in bread machine and select for the smallest and last loaf. Slice onion, and place on a baking tray. Put baking tray into oven on the lowest setting and bake for approximately 30 minutes. When done remove bread from pan, place on a chopping board, and place in a large bowl. Using a fork or a pastry brush, coat bread with olive oil and set aside. Turn bread pieces over, and lightly coat with olive oil. Spray nonstick frying pan with pam and heat on medium. When hot, place bread into the frying pan, and lightly brown both sides of it. Remove from frying pan, and put onto plates. Cut bread pieces into portions, and garnish with onion slices.

Random Ingredients: squid,bok choy,mustard seed,red onion,coconut oil,brown bean,self rising flour
title: Fried Calamari
ingredients: 1 kg squid | 200 g cooked brown beans | 300 g bok choy | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 1 small head spring roll mixed vegetables ( optional ) or 8 ounces frozen mixed vegetables ( optional ) | 150 ml coconut oil | 1 large red onion, halved and thinly sliced
instructions: Separate the squid into rings. Remove the ink sack from the tentacles and split through twice horizontally. Reserve the ink sack. Cook the squid, bean and vegetables until the squid is just tender. Drain well and refresh in cold water. Cut the squid body into small pieces. Place the squid, squid, beans, vegetables, coconut oil, mustard seeds and sliced onion in a large deep frying pan. Cover and cook over a medium heat for 10 - 15 minutes, until the vegetables are tender and the onion has softened and turned golden. Serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: skirt steak,savoy cabbage,fast rising yeast,celery seed,prosciutto,basil
title: Homemade Braciole
ingredients: 2 cups zucchini, shredded | 12 leaves savoy cabbage, shredded | 12 leaves prosciutto, chopped | 2 teaspoons celery seeds | 1 teaspoon ground savoy cabbage | 3 teaspoons fast rising yeast | 1 teaspoon dried basil
instructions: Place the shredded zucchini, shredded savoy cabbage, prosciutto, celery seeds, savoy cabbage, yeast, and dried basil into a bowl.

Random Ingredients: elbow macaroni,yellow bell pepper,sunflower seed,pomegranate syrup,broccoli floret,butternut squash
title: Broccoli and Macaroni Salad
ingredients: 10 ounces small broccoli florets, broken into florets | 10 ounces butternut squash, cubed | 1 yellow bell pepper, diced | 1/2 bunch esca leaf, chopped | 1/2 cup pomegranate syrup | 4 tablespoons sunflower seeds | 5 ounces elbow macaroni, cooked
instructions: In a large saucepan, cook elbow macaroni according to package directions. Drain, rinse with cold water and drain again. Add broccoli, squash, bell pepper and esca leaves, mixing well. Cover & cook over medium heat 6 - 7 minutes or until vegetables are tender crisp. Add pomegranate and pomegranate syrup, cook 1 - 2 minutes longer. Toss with cooked macaroni.

Random Ingredients: milk ricotta cheese,egg yolk,bread,tangerine juice,tomato puree,dark chocolate
title: Tomato Chocolate Ricotta Bread Pudding
ingredients: 4 3/4 cups milk ricotta cheese ( drained and chilled ) | 3 eggs | 1 egg yolk | 4 slices bread | 1 cup tangerine juice | 2 ounces dark chocolate, grated ( about 1 ounce ) | 1/2 cup tomato puree ( about 1 1/2 ounces )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400f degrees. Butter a 2 1/2 quart loaf pan. Pour the milk into a large bowl and then add the ricotta and stir until well combined. In a medium size bowl, beat the eggs yolk and egg yolk with an electric mixer on low speed. Add the grated chocolate, making sure all the liquid is absorbed. Stir until smooth. In a separate small bowl, pour the tangerine juice over the bread and then spread the bread slices well with the ricotta and the bread mixture. Pour the tomato puree over the bread and stir gently so the bread is evenly coated. Spread the tomato puree over the bread. Bake until the surface is golden brown and the loaf is puffed, about 50 minutes. Let cool in the pan on a rack, about 30 minutes. Slice into 2 inch squares.

title: Spanish Tapenade
ingredients: 4 -6 tablespoons olive, olive oil ( for sauteing ) | adobo seasoning ( optional )
instructions: Mix olive oil and adobo seasoning in a glass jar. This will keep 2 days if stored properly. Pour olive oil mixture onto your favorite tapenade fill martini shaker halfway and pour contents over tapenade. Shake vigorously. Tastes best if allowed to settle overnight before using. Keep refrigerated for up to 3 months.

title: Cochinita (Castilian Ghee)
ingredients: 3 medium spanish onions, quartered | 2 tablespoons masa harina | 6 leaves kale, shredded ( optional ) | 1 cup madeira wine
instructions: Heat a cast iron or other heavy skillet over medium heat. Add the onions, and cook about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally to avoid sticking. Stir in the masa harina, and cook a few minutes. Stir in the kale and madeira. Cover, and simmer over a low heat for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.

title: Italian Style Steak With Vegetables
ingredients: 1/2 lb salami, cut into 1/4-inch thick slices | 1/2 lb spicy steak of choice | 1 large red pepper, cut into thin rings | 1 small yellow onion | 3/4 cup coffee liqueur | 2 medium broccoli, cut into 1-inch pieces
instructions: Prepare your grill. On a hot grill, grill the steak for 3 - 5 minutes on each side or until desired doneness.

title: Simple and Easy Sweet and Sour Cream Soup
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 1 tablespoon malt vinegar
instructions: Pour the condensed soup into a large pot over medium heat. Mix gently, but thoroughly, into the soup. When the soup begins to bubble, stir in the vinegar. Do not let the soup boil, because the vinegar can cause a skin to form on top.

title: Beer and Chicken Tenderloins
ingredients: 4 chicken breast fillets | 2 1/2 ounces marmalade | 2 1/2 ounces fish fillets, steamed or 1 1/2 ounces shrimp | 3 ounces beer or 3 ounces stout beer
instructions: Place the chicken fillets in a lightly greased oven proof dish. Place the marmalade and fish fillets over the chicken and top with beer or stout. If using shrimp, steam for 10 - 15 minutes or until the chicken is just cooked.

Random Ingredients: greek yogurt,black bean,courgette,cream mushroom soup,sage leaf,plain flour,bread
title: Mushroom, Garlic & Sage Crostini
ingredients: 300 g plain flour ( for use can use gluten free flour or a mixture of the two ) | 1 teaspoon dried sage leaves | 2 cans condensed cream of mushroom soup | 150 ml greek yogurt | 1 carton low fat sour cream | 400 g black beans, drained and rinsed | 150 g fresh sage leaves, finely chopped | 1 courgette, sliced
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c. Grease a medium ovenproof frying pan, it should fit snugly. Stir the flour and sage in a large bowl. Stir in the soup, yogurt and sour cream. Spoon the mixture into the pan and top with the black beans, sage, courgette and sage. Bake in the oven for 30 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Mexican Flag Dip
ingredients: 4 cups crushed tortilla chips | 2 -3 drops red food coloring ( optional )
instructions: Toss chips with food coloring.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,vegetable oil peanut,puff pastry,maple syrup,mango powder,buttermilk
title: Cheezy Indian Naan Pizza Puffs
ingredients: 1 sheet frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1 cup mango powder ( or your favorite mango nessity spice ) | 1 cup low-fat buttermilk | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil or 1 tablespoon peanut oil
instructions: Bake the frozen puff pastry according to package instructions, according to package directions. Remove from oven and add the mango powder, buttermilk, and garlic salt to a bowl. Stir in the maple syrup and oil. Brush 1 tablespoon of the mixture onto the edges of each puff pastry round, fold the dough over, and brush tops with the remaining mixture. Place on a baking sheet, and score your round tops with a sharp knife, using a sharp knife in a criss cross pattern. Bake at 375°f for 12 - 16 minutes, or until the tops are crusty and the filling is set.

title: Straw Hats
ingredients: 6 -8 baby shrimp, peeled | 15 ounces frozen corn
instructions: Place shrimp in a large bowl. With a fork, remove the head and intestinal threads from each shrimp. Add the shrimp to the bowl with the shrimp and leave the tail on the shrimp. The shrimp heads should be whole on the shell side. Open the shrimp out. Add the thawed frozen corn, remove the head, and throw the shrimp back in the bowl. Mix all the ingredients together. If you are serving on a cold romantic night, leave the shrimp in the bowl until you are ready to eat.

title: Simple Mexican Gelato
ingredients: 1 cup 1 % low-fat milk | 1/2 cup cornstarch | 1 tablespoon vanilla | 1 cup low-fat tomato sauce ( hunts ) | 1/2 cup parmesan cheese, grated | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla | 1/4 cup kahlua | 1 tablespoon vanilla | powdered sugar ( optional )
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine milk, cornstarch and tomato sauce. Bring to boil and then add cheese, vanilla and kahlua. Stir constantly until cheese has melted. Remove from heat and beat in kahlua and vanilla sugar. Add water if the mixture has thickened. Pour into 2 jelly Roll mold or custard cups. Cool and refrigerate overnight and remove the sides before serving.

title: Cachaca (Brazilian Cauliflower Soup)
ingredients: 600 g fresh cauliflower | 3 tablespoons heavy cream | 3 tablespoons canth cachaca | 1 lebanese cucumber, sliced
instructions: Wash cauliflower in cold water and chop finely. Heat cream, canth cacha in a large heavy based saucepan on the stove. Add cauliflower and stir. Bring to the boil. Reduce heat and simmer 30 - 45 minutes, without adding any additional water, until tender. Add cucumber and stir for approx 25 minutes. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: yukon gold potato,millet,sauvignon blanc wine white,baby green
title: Baby-Green and Smoked Champagne Salat With Smashed Potato
ingredients: 1 lb yukon gold potato, sliced into 1/8 inch thick rounds | 2 cups mixed baby greens | 2 tablespoons smoky sauvignon blanc wine ( or other dry white wine ) | 1/2 cup reduced-fat milk
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f place the greens in a 2 quart glass baking dish. Toss with the wine and salt and cover tightly with foil. On a high speed, toss vegetables with 1/4 cup of the mustard. Bake, covered for 45 minutes. Remove from the oven, scoop out and discard the top of the potatoes with a spoon, and place under the broiler. Bake for 10 minutes, or until potatoes begin to turn a dark gold color. title: Ancho Beer

title: Simple Pinto Beans With Broth
