title: Swiss Onion-And-Cheese Dip
ingredients: 8 ounces stilton cheese | 8 ounces gruyere cheese | 1/3 cup grated onion-and-cheese blend | 1 pinch ground cumin | 1 pinch dried oregano leaves | 1 pinch dried coriander leaves | 10 ounces margarita mix | 1 tablespoon apricot jam
instructions: Crush the stilton into little small cubes. Use half the onion and half the gruyere cheese to layer in the bottom of a 1 1/2 to 2 quart casserole dish. Sprinkle the cumin over. Sprinkle with oregano, coriander, and a little onion powder. Top with the second cheeses. Top with the remaining onions and gruyere cheese. Whisk together the margarita mix and remaining margarita mix. Drizzle over all. Bake at 375º for 20 minute or until heated through, and the cheese is just starting to melt. Remove from the oven, and sprinkle the top with the apricot and warm jam immediately before serving.

title: Spanish Potato Rounds With Olives
ingredients: 3 cups yellow potatoes, peeled and diced | 2 -3 large black olives ( optional )
instructions: Cook the potatoes until they are just tender enough to pierce with a fork, but not browned in a frying pan. Drain the potatoes thoroughly and place them in a lightly greased 6 by 8 by 2 inch baking pan. Sprinkle with the olives. Bake for 25 minutes at 375°f or until the top is golden brown. Watch for browning while baking so they don't burn.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,vanilla essence,pork loin,bouquet garni
title: Pork Loins
ingredients: 500 g pork loin | 1 bouquet garni | 200 g graham cracker crumbs | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Cut pork loin into 3cm cubes and place in crock with bouquet garni, crush pork to a thickness of about two mm. Roll 1 cm of pork into about 150 mm crescent shape and seal on both sides. Place crumbs in a bowl. Cover pork with crumb mixture. Mix well with hands until the mixture looks moist. Place in fridge for a day. Preheat oven to 180°c, then bake for at least 3 hours or until internal temperature is 170°c.

Random Ingredients: spanish onion,prosciutto,grape tomato,ghee,dark sesame oil,artichoke heart,pineapple juice,thai chili sauce
title: Chilled Antipasto Salad
ingredients: 6 cups grape tomatoes, halved | 1 large spanish onion, thinly sliced | 2 cans artichoke hearts, quartered | 8 slices prosciutto | 1/4 cup pineapple juice | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1/4 cup thai sweet chili sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons ghee
instructions: Arrange the tomatoes, onion and artichoke hearts in a serving bowl. Toss with the prosciutto, pineapple juice, sesame oil, sweet chili sauce and ghee. Serve at room temperature.

title: Easy Brown Rice and Sauerkraut Casserole
ingredients: 1 cup long grain brown rice | 1 package sauerkraut | 1 cup grated low-fat monterey jack cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350º f. In a greased 9 x 13 oven safe dish or casserole dish combine the rice, sauerkraut and 1/3 cup grated cheese. Bake, covered, about 25 minutes or until all ingredients are hot and center has been warmed through.

title: Roasted Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried thyme | 1 beef tenderloin steaks, trimmed
instructions: Sprinkle thyme onto steak. Tie steak tightly with twine. Marinate in refrigerator for 24 hours, occasionally brushing with marinade. Roast medium hot coals or gas grill for 8 to 10 minutes per inch of thickness. Remove from heat.

Random Ingredients: cold water,salmon steak,tortilla,baby pea,lettuce,green cabbage,egg noodle
title: Cabbage and Salmon Wrap #5FIX
ingredients: 1 lb salmon steak, cut into strips ( skin on ) | 1 package frozen baby peas, thawed ( about 5 ) | 1 package tortilla | 6 ounces tortillas | 1 bag shredded lettuce | 1 green cabbage, julienned | 2 eggs noodles
instructions: Cook noodles as directed on package.

Random Ingredients: butterscotch chip,mexican cheese,mozzarella cheese,cannellini bean,pinto bean,cooking oil
title: Mexican White Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 can of drained pinto beans | 1 can cannellini beans | 1/4 cup butterscotch chips | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 tablespoon butter | 2 cups shredded mexican-style cheese blend | 2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Place pinto beans, cannellini beans, butterscotch chips, and oil in a food processor. Process until smooth. Pour into a deep, medium sized bowl, or crockpot. Top with butter and cheese. Add as much cheese as desires to make it the dish you want. Serve with tortilla chips or corn chips.

title: Super Easy Marinara Sauce
ingredients: 1 can italian-style stewed tomatoes | oyster sauce
instructions: Mix tomatoes and oyster sauce together in a large pan and simmer over medium medium heat for 10 - 15 minutes. Serve over your favorite pasta of choice.

Random Ingredients: pepperoncini pepper,sea salt,bamboo skewer,parmigiano reggiano cheese,clam,hot pepper
title: Prawns and Clams with Pepperoncini
ingredients: 2 lbs uncooked medium to large prawns, heads and tails intact | 5 large squid, tentacles on ( tubes and tentacles halved length wise ) | 10 large fresh clams | 1 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated | 3 dozen pepperoncini peppers, sliced, divided | sea salt | fresh hot pepper, to taste on each shell
instructions: Cut off and remove the white meat only from the tail section of the prawns, leaving on the head, tail segment, and tentacles for garnish. Rinse and drain well and set aside. Peel and devein the prawns and set aside. Wash and discard any clams that are open, scrubbing, and discarding any that are closed and not closed on the under side of the meat. Slice the clams well lengthwise. Cut the clams into quarters and cut the squid in half lengthwise, discarding the tentacles and tentacles. Thread the clams and tentacles onto metal skewers, cutting them into 1 inch lengths. Place onto a tray and refrigerate for about 15 to 20 minutes, then remove from the brine and set aside. When all the seafood is set, place it into the sink with a fine mesh sieve. Squeeze the excess liquid into a bowl, and transfer the prawns and the juice into the bowl. Add the cheese and half of the pepperoncini and toss to coat evenly. Season with salt and pepper, and set aside to serve, covered. To serve, place some prawns into each of six small bowls, garnish with pepperoncini and extra pepperoncini, and serve with lemon wedges.

title: Chicken and Artichokes over Basmati Rice
ingredients: 1 lb chicken, cubed | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained, chopped | 3 tablespoons uncooked long grain brown rice | 2 1/2 cups boiling water
instructions: Place the chicken over boiling water and simmer for 5 minutes. Place the artichokes and rice in a 2 quart casserole.

title: Korean Kimchi Beef - Bok Eeek Kimchi
ingredients: 1 small cabbage, finely shredded or finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt ( or salt of choice )
instructions: Sprinkle rice with seasonings, to taste. Cover and eat immediately. Note 1 cabbage can be frozen. Note 2 cabbage can be boiled and left in uncooked egg for 5 minutes. Note 3 cabbage can be left in raw egged water, just like the cabbage.

title: Crock Pot Swedish Meatballs With Linguine
ingredients: 1 lb frozen precooked meatballs, thawed | 1 small onion, chopped | 1 medium yellow sweet pepper, cut into 1 inch squares | 1/3 cup sambuca liqueur | 1 teaspoon salt | hot cooked linguine
instructions: Combine all ingredients in crock pot. Cover and cook on low for 6 - 8 hours.

Random Ingredients: hunt tomato paste,bread crumb,burgundy wine,baking soda,salmon,currant,pork
title: Burgundy Smoked Salmon and Pork
ingredients: 3 lbs whole salmon | 1 lb ground lean pork | 1/2 cup stale bread crumbs, seasoned | 1/2 lb crab ( can use other types if desired ) | 2 tablespoons currants ( or raisins ) | 2 tablespoons hunts tomato paste | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Cut salmon into four serving pieces and place in one layer over the bottom of a 9x13 pan with several inches of water on the sides. Bake at 375 degrees for one hour, then check after 30 minutes. Fish should just flake. If you don't fish the bones, remove the fish, remove and cut into bite size pieces, then set aside in separate dish and continue cooking rest of the ingredients. Meanwhile mix all ingredients in a large mixing bowl and then set aside. When you think it will be time to serve, carefully open the salmon out to check for pin bones or cooke holes in the fish and add to the tomato sauce. Note, if sauce is too thick, add a little water to thin. It will thicken up as it cools. Note, the salmon should be cooked about 20 minutes before fish is done, which is usually not very full cooking as it should be.

Random Ingredients: honey,baking potato,brown sugar,egg noodle,kielbasa,matzo meal,spanish onion,cardamom seed
title: Sweet Potato and Kielbasa Goulash
ingredients: 4 large baking potatoes, pared, halved, divided | 1 1/2 cups chopped spanish onions | 1/3 cup sliced fresh kielbasa or 1/3 cup other spicy sausage, cut into thirds | 1/2 cup honey | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom seed | 2 tablespoons brown sugar, packed | 1 package dry egg noodles, cooked and drained | 1/2 cup prepared matzo meal
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Lightly spray a 2 1/2 quart baking dish with cooking spray. Place 1/2 cup potatoes in a small mixing bowl stir in 1 cup onion, kielbasa and 1/2 cup onion gravy mix. Spread potato mixture into dish and sprinkle with 1/4 cup onions each. Combine next 6 ingredients in a small bowl stir in remaining 1/2 cup onion gravy mixture. Spoon half the mixtures over the potatoes in dish. Sprinkle with remaining 1/4 cup onions. Sprinkle with matzo meal, drizzle with remaining gravy mixture. Bake covered for 15 minutes. Uncover, bake uncovered for 15 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: juice from one lime,lasagna noodle,carrot,arborio rice
title: Quick and Easy Risotto
ingredients: 3/4 cup arborio rice ( arborio rice, 3/4 cup can be substituted ) | 1 1/2 cups grated carrots | 2 tablespoons juice from a 1-2-2 limes | 6 tablespoons chopped fresh arugula or 6 tablespoons torn curly cilantro leaves ( 2-1/2 tablespoons per serving )
instructions: Cook rice and carrots until lightly browned and the carrots are crisp tender. Stir in juice and set aside. Heat 1 tablespoon or more of oil or butter in a 2 1/2 quart sauce pan and cook rice mixture, stirring constantly, until oil and butter are absorbed. Remove from heat. Meanwhile, warm remaining 1/2 tablespoon oil in 12 inch skillet over medium heat until hot but not smoking. Add 1/2 cup hot rice mixture.

Random Ingredients: cream onion soup,biscuit dough,parsley leaf,oyster sauce
title: Creamy Onion Rolls
ingredients: 1 can refrigerated biscuit dough, 1 lb | 1 can cream of onion soup | 1 teaspoon parsley leaves | 1 teaspoon oyster sauce ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to roll out biscuits in small batches to fit pan. Spread 1/4 cup of the soup. Add a small amount of parsley and layer between biscuits, making a layer if using. Repeat until all biscuits/noodles are used. Bake for 15 to 20 mins or until biscuits/noodles are golden brown.

title: Beef Tenderloin Sandwich on Polenta
ingredients: 1 packet polenta | 200 g beef tenderloin, cut in 4 pieces | 1 tablespoon instant coffee | 1/2 teaspoon lemon zest, grated | 1/2 teaspoon ground coriander | 1/2 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon bread flour | pumpernickel bread, crusts trimmed and bread torn into pieces for dipping
instructions: Preheat oven to 120°c / 350°f. Combine all ingredients, except beef, in a food processor and blend until smooth. Place beef in a shallow, ungreased, ovenproof bowl. Evenly spread beef with polenta mixture, pressing beef together. Place on a tray and bake for 30 - 40 minutes until browned and cooked through. Cut into 6 portions.

title: Scotch Scallop Pasta Primavera
ingredients: salt and pepper | 4 lbs scallops | 1 -2 bell pepper ( any color diced ) | 1 lb rotini pasta
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil til steaming. Rinse scallops in cold water with a little milk or clam juice, drain & coat with a little melted butter. Put in a baking pan or deep pan. Sprinkle pepper over scallops. Spread a few slices of scallop over scallops, then layer a few diced bell peppers on top. Put in a 400 degree oven for 15 minutes. Meanwhile cook pasta with a little salt & pepper according to package directions, drain & add to boiling kettle. Cover and transfer to oven for about 5 - 10 minutes, stirring about every 5 minutes, or until scallops are done and sauce is thick. Drain pasta & add to scallops, mix & serve.

title: Pan Bagels - Bread Machine
ingredients: 7 cups peanut oil | 4 teaspoons yeast | 1 1/4 cups double cream, plus extra for brushing | 2 bottles storebought double cream of garlic and herb breads, warmed for brushing
instructions: Combine the 6 cups oil, the yeast and 4 teaspoons salt in the pan of a bread machine. Add the flour, 1 cup at a time, until you have a fairly stiff dough. Knead on a floured surface until smooth and elastic, about 5 minutes. Place the dough into a clean, oiled bowl and cover with a clean, damp cloth. Set aside in a warm place for about an hour, until doubled in bulk. Divide dough into 8 equal sized portions and roll each portion into a flat, narrow, oval shaped patty about 1/8 inch thick. Place the patties on a greased cookie sheet, cover with a clean towel and leave in a warm place for 15 minutes. Preheat the oven to 425°f. Heat up the remaining cup of cream with the garlic and herb breads. Brush the breads with the warm melted cream and bake in oven for 15 minutes, or until golden, brushing with extra cream as required.

title: Pear Filling Gyros
ingredients: 2 tablespoons caraway seeds | 12 ounces fresh pears, coarsely chopped | 12 ounces fresh strawberries or 12 ounces mixed green salad leaves | 2 ounces walnuts, coarsely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 1/4 cups iceberg lettuce or 1 1/4 cups iceberg lettuce | pear, slices to serve ( optional )
instructions: To make the filling, combine the caraway seeds with the remaining filling ingredients and stir until the filling is well mixed and it is smooth. Heat a sauté pan at medium heat and fry the walnuts for a few minutes until lightly toasted. Spread the walnuts on a clean, dry surface. Spread the walnuts on the toasted walnuts and place on the hot pan. Turn the heat down so the nuts don't burn. When the nuts are toasted and the walnuts are softened, remove the pan from the heat. Using a spatula, scoop out the hot walnuts. Place the lettuce in a bowl and pour the filling mixture over it. Top with the walnuts. Chill for about 2 hours or until ready to serve, if possible.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,peanut butter,tomato jalapeno,white rice,feta cheese,grain white rice,turmeric powder,beef broth
title: Greek-Style Indian-Style Rice
ingredients: 1 cup long grain white rice | 1 cup medium grain white rice ( not instant ) | 1 1/3 cups beef broth, divided | 3 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/2 cup feta cheese, crumbled | 1/2 cup peanut butter | 1 medium tomatoes and jalapeno, diced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Wash and stir the rice, 1 cup broth, sun dried tomatoes, and turmeric together in a large baking dish.

title: Kiwi & Kidney Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans | 2 kiwi fruits | 1 packet artificial sweetener | 1/4 cup breadcrumbs | 1 teaspoon rosemary or 1 teaspoon sage | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon
instructions: Drain kidney and kiwifruit and mash with fork or potato masher until just mixed. Combine all ingredients, including the breadcrumbs and mix well. Put into casserole dish and lightly sprinkle with cinnamon.

title: Portabella and Pecan Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 tablespoons lemon curd | 1/4 cup pecans, coarsely chopped | 4 portabella mushrooms, stems trimmed, caps sliced
instructions: Place lemon curd in bowl of a standing mixer fitted with the paddle attachment. Cover with plastic wrap.

title: Italian Roast Chicken and Beef
ingredients: 3 lbs skinless roasting chickens, cut into 8 pieces | 3 loaves bacon | 1 tablespoon oregano | 1/4 cup amaretto | 12 large hazelnuts, toasted, skinned and coarsely chopped | 10 ounces stewing beef, cut into 1/4-inch slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f wrap chicken pieces in foil. Bake uncovered for 1 hour. Remove foil and bake additional 35 minutes or until juices run clear. Place bacon in large skillet. Cook over medium heat for 7 minutes or until crisp. Remove bacon from skillet and drain on paper towels, reserving drippings. Cut bacon into thin strips and set aside. Add oregano, amaretto and hazelnuts to skillet. Cook and stir until mixture is well blended. Place chicken on a rack in a shallow roasting pan. Brush with reserved bacon drippings. Roast in center of oven for 1 hour, or until done. Add reserved drippings and the stew meat to pan drippings and cook for 15 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened slightly. Spoon stew into a serving bowl and serve.

Random Ingredients: halibut fillet,cream mushroom soup,macaroni,paprika,peanut,poppy seed,coconut milk
title: Savory Pasta
ingredients: 1 box macaroni ( can use bowtie if macaroni is uncooked ) | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 can coconut milk | 1/4 cup paprika | 1/4 cup poppy seed | 1/4 cup salted peanuts, coarsely chopped | 3 cups packed boneless halibut fillets
instructions: Stir together the cream of mushroom soup, coconut milk, paprika, poppy seeds and peanuts. Set aside. Cook macaroni in boiling water until al dente. Drain and set aside. Coat a nonstick skillet with a cooking spray. Saute the halibut fillets over medium heat for 5 minutes on each side. Place the tomato sauce mixture in the pan and reduce until thickened and bubbly. Top with halibut fillets, and serve with a nice tossed green salad.

title: Trout, Broiled and Cracked Aromatic on Cabbage, Gruyere & Smoked Provolone Muffins
ingredients:
8 thick slices prosciutto, halved ( or smoked ham, deli smoked ham, salami, etc.
    - ) | 8 stalks celery ribs, thinly sliced | 1 1/2 lbs whole smoked trout, about 2 pounds ( or other firm white fish ) | 3 ounces gruyere cheese, grated | 1 1/2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 1/4 2 teaspoons ground aromatic sumac or 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. Slice the prosciutto or smoked ham into thin slivers. Cut the celery sticks into thin wedges, and drop them into a bowl of ice water. When the slices are fully covered with ice, drain them completely and pat dry with paper towels. Remove the hard, tender bottom of each slice of proscuitto, with the sharp point facing up, and slice the rounds into half diagonally. In a small mixing bowl, stir together the aged gruyere cheese, brown sugar, and ground aromatic sumac. Add a few teaspoons of the cheese mixture to each slice of ham and celery and, shaping it into a flat sandwich. Put six slices of the sandwich in the muffin tin in the shape of a lid, but do not pack it tightly. Bake for 7 to 8 minutes, or until the bottom of each slice is golden brown. Remove the sandwiches from the oven, and remove the lid. Turn the oven temperature up to 200°f. Place the stuffed trays on a baking sheet. Sprinkle the trays with the ground cinnamon. Return to the oven and bake for 15 - 20 minutes or until the top is golden brown.

Random Ingredients: yeast,oregano leaf,sage leaf,chutney,chicken breast half,fenugreek seed
title: Spicy Chicken on Toast
ingredients: 8 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 1/2 cup chutney, unsweetened | 1/2 teaspoon fenugreek seeds | 1/2 cup dried, crushed oregano leaves | 1/2 teaspoon dried, crushed sage leaves | 1/2 teaspoon dried, crushed mustard seeds
instructions: Place chicken breasts in a gallon size plastic bag, and coat each with the chutney and fenugreek seeds. In a separate bowl, blend together oregano, sage, mustard seeds, and the 2 1/2 cups of reserved chutney liquid. Coat chicken with spice mixture, pressing out excess air. Marinate chicken in the refrigerator at least 1 hour, or up to 8 hours. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly grease an 8x8 inch baking dish. Transfer chicken to the prepared baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven until cooked through, and internal temperature reaches 165 degrees f in the thickest part, about 1 hour. Remove from oven, and let stand 5 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,eggplant,rosemary leaf,beef tenderloin,baby spinach,rye bread
title: Beef, Eggplant & Spinach Pan-Fried With Rye Bread
ingredients: 1/3 cup thinly sliced green bell pepper, about 1/4-1/3 of a yellow | 1 eggplant, sliced, 1/3 of a large | 1/4 cup chopped fresh rosemary leaf, divided | 4 slices rye bread, 1/3 thick, about 3 slices ( about 1-inches ) | 1 lb beef tenderloin, cut into 1/4-inch thick slices ( about 4 ) | 4 cups baby spinach
instructions: Toast the bread. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Sprinkle the bread with pepper strips, sprinkle evenly with rosemary, and saute until lightly toasted, about 3 minutes. Meanwhile, spread slices with the pepper slices, keeping them to an even thickness. Sprinkle beef slices with salt. Scatter veggies evenly on top, and spoon some of the crumb mixture over every other slice. Scatter the spinach over all. Cover, and cook until vegetables are tender.

title: Pigs in Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 1 dozen mexican-style stewed tomatoes | 1/2 bunch flat leaf parsley ( leaves ) | 3/4 lb radish ( about 8 )
instructions: Simmer tomatoes, parsley and radishes on low heat for 15 minutes. Use a spoon or slotted spoon to remove the skin from the tomatoes and discard. Serve hot.

title: Baked New York Style Lasagna
ingredients: 7 lasagna noodles, cooked and drained ( fresh or frozen and thawed ) | 2 teaspoons sweetened palm oil | 1/2 cup pecorino romano cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. In a small bowl, combine the palm oil and cheese, and set aside. Spray a 9 x 13 baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Arrange a single layer of lasagna noodles about 1/2 inch thick, breaking noodles as they lay flat to fit the baking dish. Pour palm oil and cheese mixture over noodles. Repeat the layers until all ingredients are used up. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake 20 minutes or until top is lightly browned and bubbly.

title: Spanish Green Olives
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ripe tomatoes with juice | 1/4 cup black pitted green olives | 1 poblano pepper, minced | 3 hard-cooked eggs, chopped | 1/2 cup blanched almond, coarsely chopped
instructions: Combine tomatoes, salt and pepper in a saucepan and simmer, covered, about 10 minutes. Add olives and poblano. Increase heat to high and simmer, uncovered, until poblano has softened, about 5 minutes. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Fold in eggs. Sprinkle over almonds.

title: Lazy Cabbage Noodles
ingredients: 500 g green cabbage, finely shredded | 200 g wide egg noodles
instructions: Place noodles in a large pot of boiling water and cook. For 1minute. Add cabbage to the noodles and set to one side. Place noodles in the sink with a large slotted spoon and drain. Repeat with the other noodles and then serve.

title: Quick and Easy Grilled Beef Skewers
ingredients: 3 - 3 1/2 lbs rump steak or 3 -3 1/2 lbs sirloin steaks, cut into 2-inch cubes | 1 ounce fresh raspberry vinegar ( or cider vinegar ) | 2 celery ribs, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup salsa con queso ( optional ) | 2 cups cooked fish or 2 cups fish sauce, from the jar
instructions: Wash the beef cubes in a sink full of cold water. Remove the thin layer of fat on the meat with the grain and make sure it's not stuck to your clean bowl or strainer. Place the meat in the refrigerator for a few hours or overnight. Drain the meat and then thread onto skewers with the sliced celery. Reserve any left over ingredients on skewers. The meat can be broiled on high heat or gas grill on the broiler shelf under the rack. Use tongs or a sharp knife to hold the skewers on the rack. Grill the skewers for 6 to 8 minutes or until they are well browned and the meat is cooked to your liking. Serve with your favorite condiments such as salsa con queso, or over rice. For dipping, serve with steamed baby quesadillas or fresh lime wedges.

Random Ingredients: dark chocolate,irish whiskey,chicken wing,steak,banana,asafoetida powder,star anise,oat bran
title: Slow-Cooked Barbecue Chicken Wings
ingredients: 1/2 cup orange-flavored oat bran or 1/2 cup psyllium husks | 1/2 lb flank steak | 6 chicken wings, split lengthwise | 1/4 cup dark chocolate | 3 stars anise | 1 1/2 tablespoons irish whiskey | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 1/2 tablespoons dark chocolate, shaved across the grill
instructions: In a large resealable plastic bag, combine the oat bran and flank steak. Add the wings to the bag, making sure all of the air has been squeezed out. Press bag to release all excess air.

title: Red Pepper Fajita Seasoning
ingredients: 2 red bell peppers | 1 tablespoon fennel seed | 2 slices bacon, cut into 1-inch pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Cut peppers lengthwise into 1/4 slices, and discard seeds. Place on prepared baking sheet, and sprinkle peppers with fennel seed. Bake for 5 to 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until peppers are tender. Meanwhile, crumble bacon pieces into a skillet and cook over medium heat until evenly browned. Strain grease into a bowl, and set aside. Spread about half of pepper mixture into the bottom of a large resealable plastic bag. Stuff peppers with bacon pieces. Place peppers on prepared baking sheet, and bake 10 to 15 minutes in the preheated oven, until peppers are hot and easily pierced with a fork. Turn peppers over, and bake about 5 minutes, until peppers are tender.

title: Spicy Lime Cream
ingredients: 1 cup whipping cream | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh red chili ( or a jalapeno or serrano ) | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon crushed dried red chili ( or a small pinch of fideo kombu )
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a small bowl and whip with an electric mixer until soft peaks form. Serve warm or chilled.

Random Ingredients: plain yogurt,breadcrumb,mace,champagne,almond essence,water chestnut,half,yellow bell pepper
title: Champagne Almond Crunch
ingredients: 1 cup plain yogurt | 1/2 cup half-and-half or 1/2 cup milk | 1/2 teaspoon almond essence | 1/2 teaspoon champagne ( optional ) | 1/8 teaspoon mace | 1/4 cup breadcrumbs | 1 cup chopped yellow bell pepper | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained
instructions: Mix first 7 ingredients until well blended and spoon into sprayed 12 x 8 baking pan. Sprinkle tops with breadcrumbs. Bake at 350 for 40 - 45 minutes or until lightly browned and bubbly and center is firm. Remove from oven and cool slightly. Cut into squares.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,kidney bean,english muffin,bell pepper,thyme
title: Curried Kidney Beans
ingredients: 2 english muffins | 3 cans kidney beans, undrained ( reserve liquid ) | 3 tablespoons red curry paste, divided | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 1 bell pepper, roughly chopped
instructions: Split english muffins lengthwise and toast under broiler until lightly browned. In mixing bowl, combine beans, 1 tablespoon curry paste, and remaining 1/4 teaspoon curry paste and thyme. Mix well with hands or spoon. Add peppers and top with rest of curry paste to serve.

title: Chickpea and Okra Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup chickpeas, drained | 1/2 cup red wine | 1 1/2 cups romaine lettuce, leaves | 2 cups okra, chopped | 1/4 cup cilantro leaf, washed and coarse chopped
instructions: In a large bowl combine the chickpeas, wine, romaine leaves and okra. Fold the mixture gently to combine. Taste to see if the dressing tastes right for you, and adjust seasonings if necessary. Refrigerate for at least one hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: ancho chile powder,plain flour,ginger juice,pickle,green chile pepper,dark brown sugar
title: Prawns Cocktail Fritters
ingredients: 30 large peeled and deveined prawns | 12 slices pickles | 3 tablespoons plain flour | 1 teaspoon fresh ginger juice | 1/2 teaspoon ground ancho chile powder | 1/4 teaspoon crushed dried ancho chile powder | 1 tablespoon green chile pepper, chopped
instructions: Blend the prawn meat, pickles, flour, ginger, ancho chile powder and chile juice until well combined. Place about 2 teaspoons of mixture into the base of a cocktail shaker.

title: Grilled Chicken Pasta and Vermouth
ingredients: 12 ounces rigatoni pasta | 2 lbs chicken breast | 1/4 cup vermouth | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg ( optional )
instructions: Heat grill to high. Place chicken breast on grate over a drip pan and add vermouth. Grill 15 - 25 mins till chicken reaches 165°, turning once or twice. Pour vermouth onto slow cooker with chicken. Cover. Cook 15 mins on high till it reaches 165f, turn off. In large skillet brown chicken, stir fry vermouth with cooked rigatoni and ground nutmeg. Serve over pasta with the chicken.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker,mace,pork roast,black olive,streaky bacon,grain rice
title: Spanish Pork & Rice
ingredients: 1 pork roast | 2 slices streaky bacon, chopped finely | 2 tablespoons cracked black olives, chopped finely | 1/2 teaspoon mace | 4 cups cooked long-grain rice | 1 -2 cup cheese free ruz french crispy rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Place roast in a casserole dish with chopped bacon, chopped olives, mace and rice. Sprinkles of cheese or crisp rice are also optional. Bake uncovered in the preheated oven for 30 mins 15 mins until the pork is cooked. Allow to rest for 5 mins before slicing into serving pieces.

title: Potatoes Dicing Chips
ingredients: 14 small red potatoes, peeled and cut into wedges | 1/3 cup dry ranch dressing mix | 4 tablespoons vegetable oil or 4 tablespoons olive oil | 1 1/2 lbs ground fish
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. In a large saute pan mix dressing mix with oil and fish. In a baking dish lined with parchment paper add potatoes, bread crumbs and seasoning. Make sure baking soda is gone, then add seasoning mixture. Bake 20 to 25 minutes. Enjoy.

title: Lobster Burritos
ingredients: 2 tablespoons lard | 1 package tortillas | 1 can shredded colby cheese | 1 package shredded green cabbage | 2 packages hokkien noodles | 1 package smoked trout or ( 4 ounce ) package haddock fillets, cubed
instructions: Heat lard in skillet over medium heat until hot. Cook tortillas 1 minute per side and drain on paper towels. Warm tortillas in microwave, about one minute per side. Spoon 1/4 cup colby cheese in center of tortilla, leaving 1/2 inch border. Place 1/4 of the noodles on colby cheese, leaving some around edge. Place 1/4 of the chopped cabbage around edge of cheese. Place 1/4 of the smoked salmon on top of the cabbage mix. Bring two opposite sides of burrito together, overlapping each other. Wrap tightly with a clean towel. Repeat until all burritos are wrapped. Heat remaining 1/4 of colby cheese on griddle or frying pan until cheese is melted. Serve with spanish rice, refried beans, and salsa.

Random Ingredients: red cabbage,bread flour,cardamom seed,salami,cream cheese,cooking oil
title: Cardamom Sausages (Shakshouka)
ingredients: 1/4 lb salami | 10 1/4 ounces cream cheese, at room temperature | 1/2 lb fresh bread flour | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom seed | 1 teaspoon cream or 1 teaspoon milk, for thinner consistency | 1/2 small red cabbage
instructions: Blend all of the ingredients in a food processor until smooth. Transfer mixture to an oven proof bowl. Bake 350 for 5 minutes at 350 degrees. Serve warm. Drain any excess fat. Serve with sauteed greens for breakfast.

title: Orzo Baked With Apple, Mozzarella & Orzo
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups orzo pasta | 2 1/2 cups apple juice | 1 1/2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese | 3 1/2 cups ice water | peppercorn ( optional )
instructions: Cook orzo in boiling water til al dente, drain& set aside. Meanwhile in small baking dish, combine apple juice& orzo. Boil till liquid is almost absorbed& orzo is tender. Add shredded cheese& orzo& stir till heated through. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: kidney bean,orange peel,onion powder,german chocolate cake mix,napa cabbage,green chile pepper,chicken breast half
title: Gewürztraminer Kugel
ingredients: 1 package german chocolate cake mix | 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves, cut into strips | 2 green chile peppers, sliced | 1/2 onion powder | 1/4 cup orange peel, minced | 1 package sliced napa cabbage
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix the potato cake mix, drained kidney beans and diced green chiles with green onion powder. Spread the mixture into the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Arrange chicken strips over the mixture. Pour orange peel over chicken. Cover with sliced napa cabbage. Cover with aluminum foil. Bake at 325 degrees f for 90 minutes. Uncover the kugel after 30 minutes.

title: Shrimp Tacos With Mango and Serrano
ingredients: 1 mango, peeled, quartered | 1 serrano pepper, chopped | 1/2 - 3/4 lb shrimp or 1/2-3/4 lb chicken | 1/2 - 3/4 cup honey-roasted chili sauce | 1 carton greek yogurt | 2 flour tortillas | lime
instructions: Marinade shrimp, mix mango, serrano pepper, shrimp, chili sauce, and mango dressing in a bowl, stir until well blended. Grill shrimp, and let cool. Serve with mango and lime wedges.

Random Ingredients: walnut oil,chocolate,yukon gold potato,yellow pepper,peach juice,key lime juice
title: Peach-Mashed Potatoes With Chocolate Crème Sauce
ingredients: 3 large yukon gold potatoes, about 4-5 pounds, cut into wedges and boiled until tender and just tender then mashed potatoes | 2 tablespoons walnut oil | 1 sweet potato, peeled and finely shredded | 1 small sweet potato, peeled and finely shredded | 1/2 cup peach juice ( from the garden ) | 1 small fresh peach, peeled and diced | 1 tablespoon key lime juice
instructions: Drain the potatoes and place them on plates. Set aside. In a small skillet, heat a tablespoon of oil over medium heat, add the sweet potato and brown the potato, then add the peach juice, peach, lime juice, and walnut oil. Heat all together, stirring frequently, until the vegetables are warmed and the flavor is absorbed before serving. Serve topped with freshly grated parmesan or romano cheese, if desired.

title: Mom's Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 pound beef stew meat, cut into 1 inch cubes | 3 tablespoons vegetable cooking spray | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Spray skillet with cooking spray. Add stew meat and brown over medium high heat. Mix in garlic.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast,red curry paste,tequila,self rising flour,red cabbage
title: Cabbage Chicken Mince With a Mince!
ingredients: 1 cup self rising flour | 1 1/4 cups red cabbage, shredded | 1 1/2 cups roasted chicken breasts or 1 1/2 cups diced cooked chicken | 2 tablespoons tequila | 1 teaspoon red curry paste
instructions: In a saucepan, melt cheesecloth or parchment paper. Stir together flour and vegetables.

Random Ingredients: turkey,wheat hamburger bun,chicken breast,queso fresco,red rice,pork butt roast
title: Chicken Fajitas
ingredients: 4 lbs boneless turkey breast | 4 lbs boneless pork butt roast | 4 lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts | 4 lbs boneless wheat hamburger buns or 4 lbs guacamole | 4 queso fresco or 4 queso cotija cheese | 4 cups cooked rice
instructions: First, preheat the oven to 300 degrees. Season the turkey with salt, add to two 3 lbs of the bone in shoulder beef, pork butt and chicken breast and season with salt, both to taste. If you have a butcher's mesquite and charcoal grill, remove the excess fat and place in the oven to roast until the meat can be easily sliced from the bone. When the meat has roasted, remove from the oven. Place in a large roasting pan or dutch oven, cover with 1 queso fresco or to taste and bring up to temperature on the stove top. When the liquid in the pan begins to bubble, remove from heat.

title: Smoked Trout with Nuts
ingredients: 16 ounces smoked trout, smoked | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh sage leaf | 2 tablespoons dried parsley flakes | 2 teaspoons grated german sweet chocolate | 4 tablespoons boiling watermelon or 4 tablespoons canned watermelon | 4 tablespoons mixed sprouts or 4 tablespoons watermelon blossoms
instructions: Heat a non stick skillet over medium high. Remove the smoked fish from the skillet leaving the skin on. Sprinkle with the sage, parsley flakes and german sweet chocolate. Dab 3 trout pieces into watermelon juice, ensuring they are completely covered with the sauce. Allow to sit for a few minutes. Spoon onto a platter and garnish with mixed sprouts or blossoms.

Random Ingredients: active yeast,baby rocket,chicken broth,extra virgin olive oil,half cream,cumin powder
title: Greek Borracho
ingredients: 2 packages active dry yeast | 1 cup chicken broth or 1 cup water | 4 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 3/4 cup whipping cream or 3/4 cup half-and-half cream | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 2 lbs baby rocket
instructions: In a small saucepan dissolve yeast in 1 cup of the broth or water. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes. In a saucepan over medium heat, warm the olive oil. Add the remaining broth or water and the cumin. Bring to a vigorous boil. Gradually stir in the yeast mixture. Cover and let stand until the liquid has been absorbed. The amount of liquid absorbed will depend on the size of the yeast, though you may not need all of it. Stir the mixture vigorously for 10 minutes, then remove from the heat and cool to lukewarm. Stir the cooled liquid into the yeast and cook in the 1 1/2 cups of the reserved broth or water until it has turned into an oozy creamy foam. Keep warm. Stir in the whipped half and half and warm to lukewarm. In a large bowl or a crockpot on the stovetop, mix the rocket leaves with the remaining 3/4 cup broth. Cover. Let stand 10 minutes. Arrange the rocket leaves over the sauce in a decorative pattern and sprinkle with the remaining 1/8 cup of cumin. Cover and let stand 5 minutes. To serve, spoon the sorbet over the greens and serve immediately.

title: Homemade Creme (Lemon Crumble)
ingredients:
3 cups fresh lemon-dill chives, chopped ( from approx.
    - 6 large stalks ) | 2 cups graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Place the minced chives in a small bowl and sprinkle with enough of the graham cracker crumbs to cover them. Roll the mixture around the bowl in the crumbs until it is evenly coated. Pour enough water to cover the bottom and sides of a large pot. Bring to a boil over high heat. When starts bubbling, immediately reduce the heat to medium low and simmer for 5 minutes or until the liquid starts to bubble, and is thick. Stir in the lemon dill. When the mixture comes to a boil, remove the pot from the heat and set aside for 15 minutes or until cool. Remove the ball of mixture from the water and form each small ball around the reversed blade of a large paring knife. Gently press out your balls as much as possible with the tip of the knife. Serve warm or warm.

title: Pumpkin Doubles
ingredients: 450 g pumpkin puree | salt | 1 teaspoon sumaq | 2 red onions
instructions: Mix pumpkin puree with salt and spices. Grate the finely cut onion. Add onion slices and pumpkin cubes. Leave until use. Pour over hot buttered basmati rice or flatbread.

title: Asian Scampi Shrimp
ingredients: 3/4 cup chopped green bell pepper | 3 tablespoons sweet chili sauce | 1/4 cup canola oil | 1/4 teaspoon ground dried savory | 1 pound uncooked shrimp, peeled and deveined
instructions: Combine green pepper, sweet chili sauce, oil, savory and shrimp in a bowl. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour. Cook shrimp in a large skillet over medium heat in the canola oil until just pink, about 4 minutes. Serve shrimp with the green pepper filling.

Random Ingredients: coriander,pearl onion,kosher salt,lettuce,artichoke heart,romaine lettuce,thyme sprig
title: Artichoke and Pearl Onion Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup pearl onions ( yellow or white ) | 1 1/4 cups finely chopped romaine lettuce | 3 -4 small fresh thyme sprigs, plus additional sprigs for garnish ( optional ) | 1 can artichoke hearts, roughly chopped | kosher salt | 1/2 cup chopped fresh coriander, plus additional sprigs for garnish ( optional ) | 2 -3 tablespoons chopped fresh thyme sprigs ( optional )
instructions: Toss the onions, lettuce, thyme, artichoke hearts, and ¼ tsp salt in a large salad bowl. Add in reserved thyme and coriander for garnish. Serve chilled or at room temperature. Garnish with additional sprigs of thyme and additional sprigs of coriander.

title: Chinese-style Salt Crackers
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups flour | canola oil ( for frying )
instructions: Mix flour and salt in medium bowl. Shape dough into 1 1/2 inch diameter circles. Refrigerate approximately 15 minutes. Poke holes through with a fork. Place 2 inches of oil in pot. Let oil temperature reach 350°, approximately 10 - 12 minutes. Place one cookie at a time in hot oil. Carefully slide onto paper towel lined baking sheet to drain excess oil. Let drain about 10 - 15 minutes and then serve hot.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,plain nonfat yogurt,escarole,snow pea,bay leaf,olive oil
title: Scalloped Escarole and Rice
ingredients: 3 tablespoons olive oil | 1 bay leaf ( or 1 cinnamon stick ) | 1 ounce whole grain white rice | 4 ounces escarole ( about 2 bunches ) | 10 ounces snow peas, trimmed | 3 tablespoons plain nonfat yogurt, stirred
instructions: Heat the 1 tbs. Of the oil in a medium pan until very hot, then add the bay leaf. Add the rice and fry over medium heat until well toasted. Remove and set aside. Add the remaining 1 tbs. Olive oil to the same pan and heat for 30 seconds. Then add the escarole and peas, stir in the rice and 3/4 cup of water. Cover and simmer over low heat for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally until the water has been reduced and the mixture is creamy and cooked. Remove the bay leaf. Remove from the heat. Stir in the yogurt just before serving.

title: Frijoles Borracho (Drunken Beans) Soup
ingredients: 28 ounces pinto beans, drained and rinsed | 3 cups fish stock, divided | 12 corn tortilla chips, coarsely crushed
instructions: Combine beans and 1 cup fish stock in a large saucepan and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium, cover and simmer until beans are very tender and most of the stock has been absorbed, 3 to 4 hours. Drain beans and season with salt. Transfer to a food processor and pulse until well mixed. Return bean mixture to the saucepan and add the remaining 1 cup of fish stock and tortilla chips. Bring to a boil, stirring frequently, then cover and simmer until tortilla chips are soft, about 3 minutes. Season soup with salt to taste and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,head bok choy,pineapple,prune,asparagus spear,cocoa powder,vegetable stock
title: Pineapple, Asparagus and Prunes in Chocolate Sauce
ingredients: 2 large heads bok choy, coarsely chopped | 1 bunch asparagus spear, trimmed and cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 large pineapple, pealed, cored and cut into 1 inch chunks | 1/2 cup prune, in natural juice, pits removed and removed | 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 cup vegetable stock | 1 tablespoon curry powder | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa powder, for dusting
instructions: Place the bok choy, asparagus, asparagus, and pineapple into a large saucepan and drizzle with 1/2 cup prune juice. Cover and bring the mixture to a boil over medium high heat. Reduce the heat to medium low and continue cooking until asparagus are very tender, about 30 minutes. Stir the pineapple into the asparagus mixture and cook until pineapple is tender, about 5 minutes. Transfer the mixture into a large heatproof serving bowl. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and set aside to allow the flavors to meld for 15 minutes. Whisk the remaining prune juice and 1/2 cup orange juice together in a separate bowl. Whisk 1 3/4 cup orange juice and 1/4 cup orange juice mixture and 2 tablespoons cocoa powder together in a small bowl. Pour the hot sauce over the pineapple mixture, stirring to coat. Sift 1/2 cup cocoa powder over the top of the mixture, turning to coat. Cover and refrigerate to marinate at least six hours or overnight. Allow the remaining sauce to thicken slightly. Remove the orange juice mixture from the refrigerator 15 minutes before serving, stirring with a fork.

title: Cheesy Vegetable Lasagna
ingredients: 1 yellow squash | 4 roma ( plum ) tomatoes, cut in bite-size pieces | 4 packages cellophane noodles | 1 jar marinara sauce
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Line a 9x13 inch dish with a silicon pad or a silicon pad. Stove an inch or less from the edge of the dish. Peel the squash and slice into thick slices. Arrange half of the squash and tomato pieces in the dish. Cover with half of the cellophane noodles. Spoon half of the sauce over the vegetables. Cover with remaining squash and tomato pieces. Sprinkle with remaining cellophane noodles. Cover with remaining sauce. Cover with a layer of foil. Bake in the preheated oven until the top is brown and bubbly, about 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: single cream,dijon mustard,salt black pepper,catsup,mint leaf
title: Minty Mustard Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons mustard powder | 2 tablespoons catsup | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1 teaspoon fresh mint leaves, chopped finely | 1/4 cup single cream ( to thin it to desired consistency ) | salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste
instructions: To make the smooth mustard sauce, in a small bowl whisk all the ingredients together. Slowly whisk in the cream to reach desired consistency. Season with salt and pepper. For a silky smooth thick sauce, for a chunky more robust taste, blend in a few drops of worcestershire sauce and a little of the sauce mixture from the spoon. This serves as a dipping sauce for cooked meats and vegetables.

title: Frozen Mexican Hot Rotel Tomatoes
ingredients: 3 cans rotel tomatoes | 1 1/2 tablespoons rock salt
instructions: Open all 3 cans. Open the cans. Dump in the tomatoes and grind them on your hand with a meat mallet or rolling pin. If your rolling pin can go back and forth to get them evenly mixed and uniform. Add the Rock salt to the crumbs/salt mixture and stir. Then add 2 tbsp of water to each can. Microwave for 30 seconds to 1 minute or so, then stir again and continue microwaving until the tomatoes are hot and the salt is all the way to the rim. I use my 5 quart flat or oval, round cast iron skillet type pan. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: hot sauce,thai red curry paste,pine nut,black bean,cranberry sauce,brown sugar,lime juice,jalapeno chile pepper
title: Spicy Cranberry Salsa
ingredients: 1 can pineapple tidbits in water, drained | 1 cup dried cranberry sauce | 1/4 cup fresh lime juice, or to taste | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh jalapeno chile peppers | 1 tablespoon thai red curry paste | 3/4 cup hot sauce | 1/2 cup brown sugar, or more to taste | 1/2 cup fresh lime juice, or to taste
instructions: Put 3/4 cup pineapple tidbits into a blender, and stir in cranberry sauce, 2 tablespoons lime juice, jalapeno peppers, red curry paste, hot sauce, brown sugar, 1/2 cup lime juice, and 2 cups water in a pot. Heat through, stirring constantly, but occasionally.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed,green cardamom pod,self rising flour,cucumber,cumin seed,garlic powder
title: Gramma's Indian Parsa Masala Bread - Aka Esau Ki Kebab
ingredients: 1 pint self-rising flour | 1/2 cup sesame seeds | 2 tablespoons whole cloves or 2 tablespoons ground garlic | 2 pods green cardamom pods, split | 1/2 teaspoon cumin seed | 2 teaspoons garlic powder
instructions: Combine flour, seeds, garlic powder, and powder in a big bowl and mix well to combine. Add sesame seeds and mix well. If necessary mix in 1 - 2 tbsp water to make a soft dough. If dough is too dry add up to 2 cups of water. Cover and chill 1 hour or longer. If dough shrinks back on the counter, add 1 or 2 more tbsp water to dough. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Knead dough for 10 - 15 minute roll the dough into small balls, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter. Flatten each one to approximately 1/2 inch thickness. Place on a greased baking sheet in a single layer. Lightly dust tops with flour. Bake for 10 minutes, then reduce heat to 300 degrees f. Bake for an additional 20 minutes or until dough is puffed and dry.

Random Ingredients: chicken wing,lettuce leaf,gruyere cheese,part mozzarella cheese,green pepper
title: Finger-Lickies for Your Dogs
ingredients: 1 chicken wings | 2 -3 green peppers, sliced | 2 -3 tablespoons gruyere cheese, grated | 1 lettuce leaf | 2 teaspoons part-skim mozzarella cheese
instructions: First make the wing sauce, heat up your wok over hot stove top. Lay out the wings and heat them in a single layer of oil until they are cooked but not overcooked. Place the peppers in a small bowl, add the 2 tablespoons of grated gruyere or asiago cheese, a tablespoon of the mozzarella and any other toppings you wish to use. Place the chicken wings on a plate and put on the plate with 1/4 cheese. Top with the chicken sauce and sprinkle with the remaining cheese and green peppers. Serve hot with your favorite meal.

title: Sizzling Fennel and Cheese on One Plate
ingredients: 1 cup fresh fennel seed | 3 ounces grated mexican cheese or 3 ounces old el paso cheese | lettuce leaf
instructions: Combine and use as required.

Random Ingredients: marinara sauce,goat cheese,plum tomato,yogurt,chicken wing,clam juice,pork loin,margarine
title: Pork and Goat Cheese Pizza
ingredients: 2 tablespoons margarine | 1 tablespoon minced fresh speckly rosemary or 1 teaspoon dried rosemary, crushed | 1 -2 tablespoon margarine | 1 boneless skinless pork loin, thinly sliced | 1 container goat cheese, crumbled | 1 container marinara sauce | 1/2 cup plain yogurt or 1/2 cup sour cream | 1 plum tomato, thinly sliced | 2 cans clams in juice, drained ( with their juice ) | 16 ounces marinating jars, such as mahogany
instructions: Place the 1 tablespoon of margarine in a skillet over medium high heat. Saute the chopped rosemary for 2 to 3 minutes, or until tender. Remove from the heat and set aside for at least 30 minutes or up to overnight. Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. Melt the 2 tablespoons butter in a large skillet. Add the pork and saute for 3 to 5 minutes. Add the marinara sauce and yogurt. Simmer for 3 to 5 minutes. Place the tomato slices over the pork and drizzle with the remaining 1 tablespoon margarine. Place the clams in the can with the juice from the clams. Pour some of the marinara sauce over the top of the tomato slices. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, or until the sauce is bubbly. Serve the pizza on a serving platter, top with the greek yogurt and tomato pieces.

title: Lamb Kebabs
ingredients: 2 - 3 1/2 lbs leg of lamb, cut into 3/4 inch cubes | 1 tablespoon ground allspice | 1 1/4 cups sour cherry or 1 1/4 cups grape tomatoes, halved | lime wedge
instructions: Sprinkle meat with allspice. Place in refrigerator to marinate for 1 to 4 hours. Thread meat on skewers, alternating with tomatoes, and cook on hot coals or under a preheated grill for 4 minutes per side, or to desired doneness. Serve garnished with lime wedges.

Random Ingredients: chicken,grainy mustard,italian dressing,cream,apple cider,cream mushroom soup,tamari
title: Italian Chicken Dip With Creamed Mushroom Soup
ingredients: 1 lb chicken, chopped | 1 cup sour cream | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 tablespoon dry italian dressing | 8 ounces apple cider | 4 teaspoons grainy mustard | 1/4 cup tamari ( i use airtles bristol cream sauce )
instructions: Combine sour cream, soup, dressing, apple cider, mustard, and tamari to make a thick paste. Put chicken in 9x13 pan. Top with soup mixture. Bake covered at 350 f for 1 hour or till chicken is done.

title: Korean Asiago Cheese Spread
ingredients: 2 lbs asiago cheese, shredded | 2 1/2 cups aged dark sesame oil | 2 tablespoons vanilla beans
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the shredded cheese, sesame oil, and vanilla beans. Cover and chill in the fridge at least 2 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,molasses,chili pepper flake,green chilies,raspberry syrup
title: Raspberry Chile Relish
ingredients: 1/2 cup light molasses | 1/2 cup seedless raspberry syrup | 3 fresh hot chili peppers, minced | 2 tablespoons green chilies, chopped | salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste
instructions: In a saucepan, combine the molasses, raspberry syrup, chilies, chilies and black pepper.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,red cabbage,hamburger,granny smith apple,yeast,horseradish sauce,chili pepper flake
title: Quick and Easy Baked Red Cabbage
ingredients: 1 kg red cabbage | 300 g hamburger | 1 granny smith apple | 3 tablespoons onion flakes | 3 tablespoons horseradish sauce | 1 tablespoon dried chili pepper flakes | 2 teaspoons instant yeast
instructions: Boil the cabbage leaves in salt water. Chop the outer leaves carefully. Set aside. Cut the hamburger into small bits. Slice the apple into slices. Heat the frying pan over medium high heat. Add the onion, hamburger, chili flakes, yeast. Cook until it starts to become cooked. Add the honey mixed with a little water. Drain the cabbage leaves carefully and put on a baking tray. Spread the mustard on the cabbage and spread it out evenly. Cook in the oven, 350°c, for 20 - 25 minutes. Garnish with cheese. Serve with mashed potato and hot mustard.

title: Chinese Spaghetti
ingredients: 1/2 cup kahlua ( optional ) or 1/2 cup strong coffee flavored liqueur ( optional ) | 1 large chocolate square, chopped | 1 can tomato sauce | 2 cups spaghetti sauce | 1 apple, peeled and halved lengthwise, leave core intact | 1 tablespoon ketchup
instructions: Over medium heat, sauté chocolate for 5 minutes. Pour 1/2 cup kahlua over the top of the chocolate, and set aside for at least 10 minutes. While cheese is sizzling, sauté the pineapple slices in a little bit of peanut oil for 2 minutes. Remove pineapple and set aside. In large pot, mix spaghetti sauce with pineapple. Place half of the spaghetti sauce mixture over the pineapple, and top with the 2nd cup of chocolate. Continue to mix. Serve immediately, enjoy.

Random Ingredients: lemon pepper,pizza sauce,breadcrumb,red chili pepper flake,lemon zest,orange peel,dill pickle
title: Pizza Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups low fat pizza sauce | 1/3 cup breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon fresh dill pickles, finely diced | 1 teaspoon lemon zest, finely grated | 1 teaspoon orange peel, finely diced | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon red chili pepper flakes | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon lemon pepper or 1/8-1/4 teaspoon black pepper
instructions: Combine all the ingredients together. Toss with cooked pasta of your choice.

Random Ingredients: basil leaf,beer,natural peanut butter,coriander powder,thyme,stock cube,olive oil,polenta
title: Peanut Soup
ingredients: olive oil | 1 tablespoon ground coriander powder | 1 tablespoon dried thyme | 1 pint beer | 250 ml chicken stock cubes | 2 cups polenta | 1/4 cup natural-style peanut butter | 1 ounce dried basil leaves
instructions: For beer, add 1 pint of the beer to a saucepan of simmering water, season with salt, add all the thyme. Simmer gently for 15 minutes. For soup, bring stock to boil and add polenta and simmer until it thickens, stirring often. For peanut soup, melt peanut butter in a pan over a medium heat, stirring until it melts and stir in the basil. Add the cooled peanut/basil mixture to the bowl and stir until well combined.

title: Kashmiri Kebab (Vodka Soup)
ingredients: 6 cups chicken stock | 3 tablespoons catsup | 2 tablespoons vodka | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 1 loaf french bread ( optional ) or 1 loaf french bread, cut into small cubes, for topping ( optional )
instructions: Place chicken stock, catsup and vodka in a large saucepan and bring to a boil. Add asafoetida and remove from heat. Cover and allow soup to cool to room temperature. Remove bread cubes from the crockpot and discard. Using 2 forks, tear the bread into small pieces. Spoon half the soup into each crockpot or bowl. Place bread cubes on top of soup, leaving about 2 inches at the top of the crockpot wall. Cover and allow soup to cool completely. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: green lentil,green onion,cinnamon sugar,lemon juice zest,tarragon,salt pepper
title: Green Lentil Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup green lentil | 1 medium lemon, juice and zest of | 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon sugar | 1/4 teaspoon dried tarragon | 4 -8 green onions, chopped ( spring onions, scallions ) | salt and pepper, to taste
instructions: To remove any stones or bad looking lentils soak in water overnight. Drain and rinse well in fresh water. In a large pot, combine lentils, lemon rind, cinnamon, dried tarragon, chopped green onions and lemon juice. Taste and season with salt and pepper to taste. Bring to a boil, cover and simmer on medium low heat for 20 minutes to 1 hour. Remove from heat, cover, and let stand for 10 minutes. Uncover and let stand for 10 more minutes before serving. Taste and adjust seasoning with more lemon juice, red chili powder, salt and pepper if necessary.

Random Ingredients: hot chili sauce,cardamom,white bean,turmeric powder,mango chutney,black olive,white wine vinegar,rice wine
title: Frozen White Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 cup white beans | 1/8 cup dry white wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom | 1 -2 tablespoon hot chili sauce ( i use `` flying goose '' brand in the asian market ) | 1 small mango chutney, coarsely chopped ( may substitue mango chutney and can use more ) | 1 tablespoon black olives, sliced ( optional ) | rice wine or brown rice vinegar ( optional )
instructions: Wash and cut the beans into 2 inch lengths. Place in plastic bag and pour boiling water over them. Let sit at least 1 hour, preferably 2 to 3 hours. Drain. Rinse and rinse beans a second time. Dry beans on paper towels. Mix salt, spices. Taste the vinegar and mix it in with the beans. Add the chutney and black olives and mix. If you feel it is necessary, just add more chilli sauce and water.. Drain beans again. Pour the vinegar and chutney into a salad bowl and mix thoroughly. Chill until serving time. Serve cold..

Random Ingredients: snow pea,baking powder,raspberry,margarine,pignoli nut,cashew,green onion,lettuce leaf
title: Cashew Crunch
ingredients: 1 package fresh or frozen snow peas, thawed | 1 cup finely chopped fresh pistachios | 1 bunch green onions, sliced | 1/2 cup cashews, divided | 1 package shredded fresh or frozen shelled, crushed roasted almonds | 2 cups shredded lettuce leaves | 2 teaspoons margarine | 1/4 teaspoon baking powder | pignoli nuts ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven broiler. Place the snow peas under the broiler, and place on a parchment lined baking sheet. Broil for no more than 3 minutes, or until lightly browned on both sides. Transfer the snow peas to paper towels to cool. Transfer the peels to a bowl and mash well to a coarse paste with 1 1/2 cups pistachios. Set aside. Separate the green onions. In a small skillet, cook the cashews over medium heat, stirring constantly until golden. Remove from the heat, and set aside. In a large bowl, mix the cashews, green onions, cashews, almonds and lettuce with the margarine, and baking powder. Pour the cashew mixture into the vegetable mixture and stir to combine. If desired, garnish with pignoli nuts, if desired.

Random Ingredients: creole seasoning,ritz cracker,scotch bonnet pepper,parmigiano reggiano cheese,green chilies
title: Chile Ritz
ingredients: 20 ritz crackers, crushed ( just the kind for shells, just plain crackers ) | 3 cans of chopped green chilies | 2 packages sliced scotch bonnet peppers ( if small, use half a can of chili paste and half a can of jalapeno ) | 3 tablespoons creole seasoning ( i used paul prudhomme's creole seasoning ) | shredded parmigiano-reggiano cheese, for topping
instructions: You will need a very large skillet at least 8 inches in diameter, preferably cast iron or mahtoon or aluminum foil. First, make the salsa. Place 1 c of chilies and the rest of the chiles in the blender. Add 2 tablespoons of creole seasoning to the salsa. Blend on high for about 10 seconds or until the chiles and chiles are mixed. Add another can of chilies and seasoning. Add 2 more cans of chiles and seasoning and blend on high for another 10 seconds or so. Add your shredded parmigiano reggiano cheese and blend on low/medium for about 10 seconds or so or until everything is combined. You may add more creole seasoning to your taste or chiles and/or seasoning, depending on your taste. Preheat your oven to 350 degrees, but take the foil and spray the inside of your pan with cooking spray. Pour the chile salsa in your pan. This is the most important part of the recipe. Bake until the salsa is bubbling and starting to brown in color, or about 1 hour and 15 minutes. While this is heating up, take the aluminum foil out and cut a couple of slits across the top for the last few minutes of baking. You want the chile slices to brown a lot, and not just burnt bits or puffs.

Random Ingredients: celery seed,cumin seed,hot chili powder,pineapple,asafoetida powder,greek seasoning
title: Homemade Pineapple  Phulik
ingredients:
1 lb fresh pineapple, about 4 cups | 1 tablespoon greek seasoning ( or 1 tbsp.
    - more ) | 1 tablespoon cumin seed | 1 tablespoon celery seed | 1 tablespoon hot chili powder | 1 pinch asafoetida powder
instructions: Peel pineapple and cut in small chunks. Put pineapple chunks into a small bowl and add all the other ingredients and stir until spices are mixed. Add to a covered bowl and refrigerate 2 - 4 hours. It will become thicker as it ages. Tastes better the second day.

Random Ingredients: baking powder,yellow pepper,tamarind paste,mint,pea,chicken breast,cremini mushroom
title: Indian Chicken With Peas
ingredients: 14 ounces cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1 package frozen peas | 1 yellow pepper, sliced | 1 tablespoon minced of fresh mint | 1 tablespoon tamarind paste | 1 tablespoon baking powder | 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts
instructions: Combine all ingredients except chicken in slow cooker. Cover and cook on low 6 to 8 hours or on high 4 to 6 hours. Place chicken breasts on skewers and grill, basting with reduced head fat. Spoon chicken mixture over steaks and serve.

title: Simple Chiles and Mushroom Filling for Tacos
ingredients: 4 large green fresh anaheim chilies, stemmed and seeded | 1 cup chopped portabella mushroom caps | 1 can chopped taco seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon paprika
instructions: Place anaheim chiles in a medium saucepan over medium high heat.

Random Ingredients: ketchup,hoisin sauce,bergamot oil,apple cider vinegar,chipotle powder
title: Beef Ribs With Chipotle (Slow Cooker, Not Crock Pot)

title: Easy Hominy
ingredients: 2 cans white hominy, undrained | 2 - 2 1/2 cups vegetable stock | fresh herbs ( optional )
instructions: Place the hominy and vegetable stock into a 5 quart pot and put a lid on the pot. Boil for 3 minutes and then turn off the heat. Let sit for 5 minutes. Discard contents of pot. This can be eaten with your favorite cheese or serve with bread and beans.

title: Sizzlin' Tajine (Crock Pot)

instructions: Remove and discard any tough ribs and cut away any excess fat. Use a meat tenderizing tool to pound meat.

Random Ingredients: corn husk,oil,canola oil,bailey irish cream,baby corn
title: Baileys Caramel Corn
ingredients: 16 ounces canola oil | 1 package corn husks ( found at the mexican farmers market ) | 1 lb baby corn | 1/2 cup baileys irish cream or 1/2 cup kahlua | 1/2 cup baileys irish cream
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400 f. In a saucepan, add 1/2 cup of bailey's and 1/2 cup of irish cream and bring to a low boil for 5 minute. While the mix is heating, clean the husks and dry completely with paper towels. Lay out the dry corn husks and cover with aluminum foil. Place on cookie sheet and bake for 40 min or until nicely brown. Turn off oven and allow to cool slightly. When cooled, spread a little of the bailey's at a time onto the cooked corn husks to coat the kernels. Use a fork to press the kernels down and then continue to let them dry. Once all the corn is dry, spread the corn on a double thickness of aluminum foil and place back in the oven for 5 mins to dry the corn slightly. After five mins, spread any remaining bailey's in a jar. When everything is dry again, mix in the bailey's and add to the corn. Allow to cool slightly before serving.

title: Lemon Pepper Beef Roast

instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Rub the lamb with lemon pulp and peel or peel if desired. Place meat in a roasting pan. Sprinkle with mace and pour enough water, 1/2 inch/3 of the water, on top of the meat. Cover and cook roasting pan for 1 hour. Uncover and cook until the roast reaches an internal temperature of about 140 degrees f, about 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Transfer meat to a carving board and let stand for 15 minutes. Skim fat from pan drippings. Pour fat into a saucepan, discarding solids. Cook over medium heat, stirring frequently until mixture is thickened.

title: Chicken and Water Chestnut Soup
ingredients: 8 ounces fresh water chestnuts | 8 cups water | 1 pound skinless, boneless chicken breast meat, diced
instructions: Bring water to a boil in a stockpot.

Random Ingredients: hard egg,celery rib,soy sauce,cardamom,garam masala,carrot,grain white rice,chocolate candy

instructions: To make the rice ball, in a small bowl combine the soy sauce, chipotle pepper, garlic, cardamom, rice, carrot, celery and chocolate. Dip each rice Ball in the soy sauce and allow to marinate for 3 minutes. Place the rice balls, chilled, on waxed paper and press out excess air.

Random Ingredients: orange juice zest,breadcrumb,ice cube,farfalle pasta,mascarpone cheese,chili powder,beet,shrimp
title: Larpoli Stuffed Beet Salad
ingredients: 2 large beets | 1/3 lb raw shrimp or 1/3 lb large shrimp, unpeeled, deveined | 1/3 cup breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup mascarpone cheese | 1/2 cup orange juice, fresh juice and zest of | 1/4 teaspoon chili powder | 1 package farfalle pasta or ( 16 ounce ) package bow tie shaped pasta, cooked and drained | shredded ice cube, for serving ( optional )
instructions: Cut beets at an angle about 1/4 inch thick. With a mandoline or other sharp knife, slice the beets about 1/8 inch thick. Rinse the beets and pat dry. Cut shells in half. Remove the beets from the shell and cut the larger ones in half once again to make smaller pieces even more large and the length of each piece. Cut shrimp at an angle into 1 inch pieces. Place them on a plate and crush them slightly with a cleaver. Preheat a saute pan over moderate heat. When hot, add shrimp, crumb, cheese, orange juice, and chili powder. Stir well. When butter is melted, add shrimp, beets, and beets and season with salt and pepper to taste. Arrange beets and shrimp in large serving bowl and serve with ice cubes, if desired.

title: Pasta Florentine
ingredients: 2 bunches washed spinach, stems removed | 5 ounces sun-dried tomatoes, in oil, cut into thin strips
instructions: Wash and dry the spinach. Wear wet washcloth in a large sauté pan. Drain the spinach and squeeze as much water out as possible. In a large bowl of cold water, combine spinach and sun dried tomatoes. Put the spinach in the bowl, cover, and refrigerate over night. Toss before serving.

Random Ingredients: grape tomato,lasagna noodle,coconut milk,sun tomato,broccoli floret,mini chocolate chip,mustard powder
title: Sesame Macaroni With Broccoli & Sun Dried Tomato
ingredients: 3/4 cup coconut milk | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 garlic clove, diced finely | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato, chopped finely | 1 jar grape tomatoes, drained chopped | 16 ounces lasagna noodles, cooked | 3 1/2 ounces mini chocolate chips
instructions: Bring coconut milk to a boil in a small saucepan over medium heat, stirring constantly, until it starts to thicken slightly. Remove from heat and stir together mustard and garlic until it is fragrant. Stir in sun dried tomatoes. Spread a thin layer of sun dried tomato mixture into a 9x13 x2 casserole dish. Spread a layer of pasta on top of the tomato mixture. Spread a layer of the broccoli spears over pasta followed by a layer of chopped tomatoes. Continue layering pasta, tomatoes, broccoli, and sun dried tomatoes as above until you have a complete layer of layered noodles. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least a couple of hours and up to 8 hours. Preheat oven to 375°f remove plastic wrap and sprinkle each serving with chocolate chips. Bake for 10 - 15 minutes or until melted and garnished with more parmesan if desired.

Random Ingredients: allspice,turnip,red chili powder,lettuce leaf,cake flour,shortcrust pastry
title: Indian Turnip Cake
ingredients: 2 lbs turnips ( the turnip with the peel ) | 2 teaspoons red chili powder | 1 teaspoon ground allspice | 1 tablespoon cake flour | 4 sheets frozen shortcrust pastry or 4 sheets frozen puff pastry | lots lettuce leaf ( for garnish )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f peel turnips and cut them in into long wedges, about 1/4 inch thick. Boil in salted water until tender, about 15 minutes, drain. Cool. Rinse with cold water. Mix in chili powder, allspice, flour and salt and pepper to taste. Roll out pastry to fit the deep casserole dish. Prick half of the pastry in the centre and bake for 15 minutes, then reduce the oven temperature to 350f and bake for an further 15 minutes or until the pastry is puffed up, golden brown. Cool and roll out remaining pastry to thaw. Cut top of casserole out from the shortcrust pastry sheet. Turn the pastry upside down on a board and cut out the empty pastry sheet. Place the pastry on top and brush generously with a little water. Drape over the beetroot leaf and roll into a spiral until you have a circle in the centre of the pastry and about 10cm wider than the turnip slice. Press the beetroot down and stretch over the top edge. Press down and stretch again to cover. Serve in wedges or squares.

title: Danish Tons
ingredients: 1 package wonton skins | 1/2 cup chili oil | 3 cups quick oats | 2 tablespoons seasoning salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Spray cookie sheets with cooking spray. Place won ton skins on the bottom of a large baking sheet. Brush with chili oil and seasonings. Bake for 10 minutes. Turn, and continue to bake for another 10 minutes. Cool to room temperature. Keep in refrigerator.

title: Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 2 cans tomato paste | 1 jar ham, chopped | 1 package round steaks | 8 italian bread, cut in half
instructions: Preheat the oven to 275 degrees f. Combine the tomato paste and ham in a large saucepan over low heat and cook gently 5 minutes. Stir in the steaks and italian bread halves to coat. Transfer to an oven safe baking dish. Cover the baking dish and bake in the preheated oven for 1 1/2 hours, or until heated through.

title: Cheese Stuffed Focaccia
ingredients: 2 -3 slices white bread | 1 package velveeta cheese | 1 -2 tablespoon dried sprigs | 10 -15 spinach ( fresh or frozen )
instructions: Slice the top off each loaf of bread, just below the top of the crust. Carefully hollow out the bread by scooping out the bread the sides and leaving 1/2 inch or more of the bread at the center. Mix the crumbles and cheese together until well blended. Fill each hollowed out loaf with cheese mixture. Place on a cookie sheet sprayed with olive oil or pam. Steam for at least 15 minutes. Remove from oven and enjoy note, depending on whether you want to cut the loaf into 4 pieces or two, you can remove cheese mixture from loaf, scoop out a portion or serve as pie crust for the top. Or you can roll the bread slices into a ball or eat them as fingerfingers. You can store them in the refrigerator for up to 3 days, but it is best to refrigerate them in a labeled plastic bag for up to five days. Note, i use spinach which is already cooked and has been peeled and chopped. If this does not want to be eaten, place the washed pasta on the same plate as your crumbled bread, and then top with the hot, spicy garlic crumbles and sprinkle with the sprig of fresh mint or dried mixed herbs. Also, you can eat these with a salad of fresh veggies or just the cheese in the crostini for a change twist on the recipe.

title: Avocado Balsamic Shrimp With Chilli
ingredients: 300 g peeled and deveined jumbo shrimp | 1 tablespoon cornflour ( cornstarch ) | avocado | balsamic vinegar, to taste | mace ( optional )
instructions: Cook the shrimp according to your preferences. Keep warm. Mix the cornflour with a little cold water and mix into the shrimp. Keep adding a little water to make a thick sauce. Add the rest of the ingredients and cook until thickened. Add a chilli, if desired. Serve with a green salad.

Random Ingredients: kraft parmesan cheese,orange,tart apple,pork rib,puff pastry,pimiento,bean,coffee
title: Costa Rican Thanksgiving Salad
ingredients: 6 -8 puffed and cut tart apples | 4 tart apples | 1 orange | 1 jar chopped pimiento, with juice, drained | 1 jar beans, with liquid, drained | 1 jar fried beans ( optional ) | 1 package kraft parmesan cheese, grated | 1 puff pastry sheet, thawed
instructions: Bake tart apples in the oven, cut side up, for ten minutes at 400 degrees, until fork tender. Carefully remove the core, then slice crosswise into halves. Place the orange and pimientos in a saucepan with the cooked onions.

title: Guava Avocado Toss

instructions: Rinse avocados. Cut avocados lengthwise, scoop out pit, and smash avocados into medium sized bowl. Finely grate zucchini/vegetable into avocado and mash. Place in a bowl, and squeeze lime juice over and add remaining ingredients. Serve with warm pita and corn chips.

title: Seafood Sausage-Roasted Calamari
ingredients: 1/2 lb italian sausage | 1 beef tenderloin, large enough to fully lie on a table | 12 scallops, medium size, whole with patted sides, and tails left on | 3 poblano chilies or 3 anaheim chilies, roasted | 12 slices salami, thinly sliced
instructions: Place the sausages into a heavy skillet or baking dish. Slice the sausages across the grain into thin slices. Scatter the slices evenly over the sausages in the skillet or baking dish.

title: Huey's Crabnoodle Casserole

instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add noodles and cook for 8 minutes or until al dente.

title: Mexican Spaghetti Sauce
ingredients: 1 jar green olives, drained | 6 garlic cloves | 1/2 teaspoon fresh lemon juice, lemon zest of | 1/2 teaspoon dried sweet basil leaves | 1 packet taco seasoning | 1 jar frozen peas pods | 1 cup nonfat milk | 1/2 lb dry vermicelli, broken into 1-inch pieces ( or pasta of your choice )

To serve, add pasta and remaining pico de gallo sauce to the pan and stir to coat.

Random Ingredients: tahini,baby lima bean,mexican cheese,celery rib,beef stew meat,canola oil
title: Tuscan Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons canola oil | 3 lbs beef stew meat, cut into 1 1/2-inch chunks | 3 tablespoons tahini | 2 celery ribs, cut into 1/2-inch chunks | 1 1/2 cups mexican blend cheese, shredded divided | 1 can baby lima beans, rinsed and drained
instructions: Heat oil in large dutch oven over medium high heat. Dredge meat in spice mixture. Brown meat in oil. Remove meat from the pan. title: Italian Meatloaf and Lentils
ingredients: 1 lb pork shoulder, boneless and diced | 2 1/2 lbs italian plum tomatoes, canned with their juice | 6 ounces lentils, picked over ( about 7 cups ) | 1 lb boneless pork shoulder, cut into 1 1/2-inch cubes
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Transfer to a large roasting pan. Insert a meat thermometer. title: Lentil Wrapped Mini Shiitakes With Creamy Tamale Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped shiitake mushroom, stalks removed | 3/4 cup frozen cornflour | 3 tablespoons light taco sauce | 600 g lentils, rinsed and drained | 600 ml vanilla ice cream | taco sauce, to serve
instructions: Combine the mushrooms, cornflour and taco sauce in a large bowl. Cook the lentils in a large saucepan of rapidly boiling water for about 20 mins or until tender. title: Apple Gravy

instructions: In a 2 quart saucepan combine apple juice, molasses, oregano and honey. Let simmer on medium heat. To serve, place one sausage on the bottom of a gravy crockpot. Cook on medium heat for at least 3 hours or until tender.

title: Steamed Spicy Sole Pasta Dinner

Place the baking sheet with the fillet onto the steamer.

title: German Kinderbrot Kartoffel #5FIX

instructions: Heat chocolate chips in a double boiler until completely melted.

instructions: Place breadcrumbs, thyme sprigs and peppercorns in a large bowl. Mix thoroughly until mixture is moist and holds its shape. title: Coconut Rasaspberry Salad

instructions: Mix all the ingredients together and toss lightly to mix. Cover and refrigerate for 1/2 hour or more. Serve cold. Enjoy.

title: Mocha Colada

instructions: Roll two leaf napkins together to make four rectangular rolls. Wrap each with plastic wrap and place in the refrigerator. Melt chocolate in a double boiler set over simmering water. Remove from heat and allow to melt. Remove wrap and transfer to an airtight container. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until thickened. Cut each roll crosswise into 4 slices. instructions: Remove all visible fat from the pork and discard. Place in a single layer in a foil lined roasting pan. Allow to baste and cook for 2 - 3 minutes or until cooked through. Slice pork into large pieces and serve.

title: Quick & Easy Sweet Potato Pizza
ingredients: 1 medium sweet potato ( red sweet potato ) | 2 cans pizza sauce | 1 teaspoon thai fish sauce | 1 can rotel tomatoes ( optional )
instructions: Cut up sweet potato into small chunks, peel. Bake in pan that has been sprayed with olive or canola oil and let cook on medium heat and until soft and slightly crispy on the outside. Remove from oven and put on cutting board. Slice with a serated knife into 1 inch pieces. Spread pizza sauce on the top of the potato slices and then place the pieces of potato on top of the sauce. Top with rotel tomatoes. Sprinkle with fresh herbs if desired. Serve hot.

ingredients: 1 lb red snapper fillet | 1 lb jicama, cut into 3/4 inch cubes | 1 lb snow peas | 1 lemon, zest of, finely shredded | parsley leaves ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Spray a roasting pan with cooking spray. Put fish fillets in pan. Sprinkle wit jicama and snow peas. Sprinkle with lemon zest, tossing gently. Bake 40 minutes or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork.

title: Garbanzo Chicken
ingredients: 1 can garbanzo beans or ( 15 ounce ) can kidney beans, drained | 1 can chicken ( cut up ) | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1/4 maraschino cherry ( optional )
instructions: Combine bean, chicken, and vinegar in a 2 quart casserole dish. Sprinkle with maraschino. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight. Bake 375 for 30 minutes covered. Remove lid and bake 30 more minutes covered.

title: Beef and Chickpea Flour Stir-Fry

instructions: Cut meat into thin strips. In a small bowl, mix pepper paste& 2 tablespoons of curry paste and spread over both sides of the steak. Place a bamboo steamer in a saucepan.
