Add 1 tbsp curry paste to the pan along with the basil, shallot and 3 tablespoons of the curry paste remaining in a small bowl. Stir fry for 1 to 2 minutes, or until vegetables are tender. Spoon the sauce over the steak and garnish with additional basil.

title: Homemade Corn Chips
ingredients: 8 tablespoons corn chips | 3 cups plain flour, sifted | 2 cups very hot tap water | 2/3 cup whipping cream, cold
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200'c with a shelf in the middle and bottom. Grease a large baking tray and line the tray with baking paper. Drain the corn chips well in a colander. Place the flour in the bowl and make a well in it by mixing the cold tap water into the flour. Using your fingers or 2 teaspoons, break up the chips until they resemble soft breadcrumbs. Gradually add the cold water until the dough is too wet. Turn the dough out onto a floured board and roll out until 3/4 inch thick. Using the palms of your hands, form rounds approximately 2½ inches in diameter, then place on the prepared tray and brush the top of each round with melted oil. Place in the centre of your pre heated oven and bake for 12 minutes. Remove and place on wire racks or a baking tray to cool. After about 8 minutes, prick the tops of the cooled cookies with a fork, allowing some air to escape and for a crisp finish. Store in an airtight container.

instructions: In a crock pot, combine undrained beans, flour, water chestnuts, pasta, carrots, water chestnuts, soup base, and beer. Stir or combine well. title: Oomong
ingredients: 1 fluid ounce soya sauce ( not kikkoman ) | crushed ice, as required
instructions: Place the soya sauce in the top of a tall glass. Pour crushed ice over the top.

title: Grilled Cheese & Potato Toasts With Peaches

instructions: Prepare peaches, bring 6 cups of water to a boil and add the potatoes. Boil 15 minutes. Drain, remove the peel from the peaches and set aside. title: Beef Soft Tacos
ingredients: 1/2 cup catsup | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Combine catsup, cat sauce or sugar.

instructions: In a non stick fry pan heat 1 tsp of the oil. Add half the green chilies and the capers and mace and fry on medium heat for about 3min, turn over and fry for another 5min, repeat with remaining oil and all the remaining chilies.

title: Low Cal, Low Oil, Low Fat Barley Raita
ingredients: 1/2 cup pearl barley | 1 cup fresh broccoli ( chopped or florets ) | 1 tablespoon garlic paste | 1/4 cup fat-free nonfat yogurt ( activia low fat is good )
instructions: In a 1 1/2 quart pan bring 2 1/2 cups water to a boil, add pearl barley and cook at a quick boil for 3 - 4 minutes or until al dente. Add broccoli, cover and cook for 5 minutes or until tender about 2 minutes more. Remove cover and add yogurt. Stir well. Cover and cook at low heat for 2 minutes or until mixture thickens. Add salt and pepper if required.

title: Chive Snacks
ingredients: 1/4 cup finely diced chives | 2 cardamom pods, podded
instructions: Place the chives in a food processor. Place cardamom pods in a frying pan with about ¾ inch of water, bring to a boil then lower the heat and simmer for 3 or 4 minutes or until aromatic. Pour into a clean tea towel, dry and squeeze to remove as much moisture as possible. Rinse with cold water, drain and use as directed in recipes. Enjoy.

title: Fried Cabbage

instructions: Slice cabbage into four pieces. Heat a wok, add enough oil to cover the bottom of the wok, stir fry cabbage for 1 minute. Add pepper strips and stir fry until crisp tender. Serve hot.

title: Cumin Ravioli (Ravioli)
ingredients: 250 g semolina flour | 250 g rigatoni pasta | 3 eggs, beaten | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Pour the semolina out onto a well floured board. Using a pastry brush, spread the semolina on the board. Using your fingers, gently rub the semolina over the surface. Put the ravioli into the hot oil, taking care not to crowd them. Fry them about 8 minutes, turning them once, until both sides are golden and the ravioli are cooked through. Keep them warm in a 200f oven while you cook the pasta. Serve hot, with a green salad and cold coffee.

title: Paneer, Tomato and Pomegranate-Pineapple With Meatballs
ingredients: 500 g pasta shells or 500 g linguine | 500 g pork or 500 g chicken | 500 g ripe pomegranate juice | 500 g san marzano tomatoes | 2 sprigs fresh dill | 500 g paneer cheese or 500 g gruyere cheese
instructions: Soak the pasta and cook in a large pot of water. Boil for a while while, until they are cooked. Drain and cool. Slice the pork into about 2 - 3 cm cubes, then brown with the pomegranate juice until no traces of pink remains. Set aside. Slice the tomatoes and add to the chicken pieces and tomato puree, along with the dill and a bit of salt.

title: Yum Yum Potato Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 lb yukon gold potato, cut into 1 inch by 1/4 inch pieces | 1 can pineapple chunks ( i like to use tidbits packed in syrup ) | 3 packages rice noodles
instructions: Cook the noodles in boiling water for 6 minutes and cool. Drain, rinse and refrigerate. Add the potato to a large bowl. Add the drained pineapple chunks and toss. Add the rest of the ingredients and stir. Add salt and pepper to taste.

Random Ingredients: rose water,chicken bouillon cube,plain flour,heavy cream,cajun spice,salt,wheat spaghetti,bread crumb

ingredients:

instructions: Whisk cream until stiff peaks form and set aside. Sift dry ingredients and sift with rosewater and salt.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,white bean,macadamia nut,saffron,rice krispies
title: Macadamia Nut Rice Krispies Snack
ingredients: 3 cups long grain white rice, uncooked | 1 can white beans | 2 cups macadamia nuts | 1 teaspoon saffron, dissolved in water | 3 cups rice krispies
instructions: Cook rice and beans until rice is just done. Meanwhile, roast macadamia nuts until lightly browned and aromatic. Dice macadamia nuts. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Drain rice and beans and place in a greased 9 x 13 inch metal baking pan. Crush macadamia nuts, and stir them together with saffron mixture. Pour over rice mixture. Bake at 350 degrees f for 15 to 20 minutes. Add cereal, mix, and bake for 9 to 10 more minutes.

title: Roasted Red Pepper Pepper (Chile) Spread
ingredients: 1 large red bell pepper | 1 tablespoon lard, or as needed
instructions: Preheat grill for high heat and lightly oil the grate. Place the red bell pepper on the hot grill. Roast red pepper, turning occasionally, until blackened, about 20 minutes. Remove red pepper from the grill, and shake off excess skin. Cut in half, remove seeds, and coarsely chop the pepper. Place the red pepper and lime juice in a clean jar with lid. Cover and refrigerate the pepper mixture until flavors blend and are well blended, at least 4 hours.

Random Ingredients: cornflour,vegetable stock,part mozzarella cheese,porcini mushroom,white sugar
title: Porcini Mushroom and Cheese Soup
ingredients: 8 ounces fresh porcini mushrooms, drained | 4 cups vegetable stock | 1 teaspoon white sugar | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 2 ounces part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded | 1 ounce grated part-skim mozzarella cheese
instructions: Blanch porcini mushrooms in boiling water for 30 seconds. Drain. Bring vegetable stock to boil and simmer for 2 minutes. Meanwhile, place sugar and cornflour in a small, heavy saucepan and stir over low heat until mixture is smooth and starting to bubble. Stir in stock, bring to boil and simmer until mixture just begins to thicken. Pour mixture into soup bowls and top with shredded cheese. Serve hot.

title: Pumpkin Pineapple & Black Beans
ingredients: 1 can pumpkin puree | 2 cans black beans, drained and rinsed | 1 1/2 cups pineapple juice
instructions: Place pumpkin in mixing bowl and pour in beans & pineapple juice. Blend until well combined. Stir in pineapple slices & crushed peanuts to taste.

Random Ingredients: chili,phyllo pastry,farfalle pasta,yellow chile,vanilla pudding mix,butter,dijon mustard,enchilada sauce
title: Easy Mexican Phyllo Pizza With Sausage
ingredients: 1 package frozen phyllo pastry | 1 package instant vanilla pudding mix | 8 ounces enchilada sauce | 8 ounces canned yellow chiles ( ro-tel brand if you can find it ) | 8 ounces sweet chili ( ro-tel brand if you can find it ) | 1/2 cup butter, melted | 2 teaspoons dijon mustard | 1 package prepared spicy ground phyllo pastry, thawed ( approx 12-15 sheets, see note )
instructions: Preheat oven to place frozen phyllo pastry sheets in a 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish, allowing sheets to fit snugly into dish if necessary. In medium bowl, combine pudding mix and enchilada sauce. Set aside. Slice chilies open and remove seeds and veins. Chop chilies and set aside. Brush melted butter over phyllo pastry sheets, allowing some of the butter to melt on phyllo sheets at bottom of dish. Sprinkle chilies evenly over phyllo, leaving a 1/2 inch border on edges. Top phyllo dough with prepared spicy ground chilies, followed by chopped sweet peppers. Brush melted butter on top of dough and sprinkle with dijon mustard and spicy ground chilies. Pour enchilada sauce mixture evenly over mixture. Add 3 more sheets of phyllo or a smaller baking dish if necessary until all sheets are covered. Bake for 25 minutes or until cheese is bubbly. Allow to become slightly browned.

Random Ingredients: rum,orange flower water,iceberg lettuce,breadcrumb,kalamata olive,salt water,chilies,worcestershire sauce
title: Kolomakia: Greek Salad
ingredients: 2 small dried chilies, split and seeded | 3 tablespoons orange flower water ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 100 g breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup worcestershire sauce | 200 g chickels, thinly sliced and cut lenghtwise in half | 100 g kalamata olives, pitted | 8 tablespoons rum
instructions: Combine chilies and orange flower water in a bowl. Add salt and leave in fridge. Mix crumbs with worcestershire sauce and breadcrumbs in a separate bowl. Toss chickels. Divide breadcrumb mixture between 2 plates and fill with chickels and olives.

title: Green Salad With Prawns
ingredients: 1 lb asparagus spear | 16 romanita-style green leaves or 8 iceberg lettuce | 1/2 cup mixed salad spice ( such as baharat aka middle east mixed spices - the real mix ) | 1/2 head romaine lettuce, large head | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil or 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
instructions: Cut stems off asparagus and cut into halves or thirds. Cook asparagus in small pan of boiling water. Drain quickly, about 10 seconds per side, remove and place in small bowl. Tear leaves into shreds, discarding tough center. Combine with greens, toss. Drizzle with olive oil. Add remaining ingredients to salad.

Random Ingredients: coriander powder,raspberry,white fish fillet,parmesan cheese,white chocolate chip,bay leaf,maraschino cherry,sun tomato oil
title: Baked Fish With Berry Salsa
ingredients: 1/2 cup parmesan cheese, shredded | 3 ounces white chocolate chips, melted | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 2 tablespoons fresh coriander powder | 1 small bay leaf | 2 lbs white fish fillets, about 1 1/2 lbs, cut in 5 pieces | 1 cup raspberries
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Combine parmesan and chocolates. Spread on foil lined baking sheet. Bake until chocolate melts, stirring occasionally, about 5 minutes. Stir in tomatoes and coriander. Toss fish with chocolate mixture. Transfer to ungreased 13x9x2 inch glass baking pan. Arrange raspberries in an even layer over fish. Pour chocolate mixture over fish. Bake for about 10 to 12 minutes or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork. Serve with salsa.

Random Ingredients: leek,salt black pepper,red pepper flake,beef chuck,kielbasa
title: Bolognese Kielbasa
ingredients: 2 leeks, sliced | 2 teaspoons red pepper flakes | salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste | 1 pound beef chuck, cubed | 1 package kielbasa, sliced
instructions: In a large skillet over medium heat, stir leeks and red pepper flakes. Cook, stirring often, until tender, about 5 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Place beef chuck and kielbasa in a slow cooker. Increase heat to high and stir until mixture is slightly browned, about 7 minutes. Reduce heat to low and serve.

Random Ingredients: chickpea flour,cider vinegar,cauliflower floret,mustard seed,bean,lime juice,corn tortilla
title: Avocado Tacos
ingredients: 16 ounces refried beans | 2 tablespoons chickpea flour ( besan ) ( indian-style ) | 2 teaspoons mustard seeds | 1 head cauliflower floret, steamed, then cut into 1/4-inch florets | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 2 1/2 teaspoons fresh lime juice | 1/2 cup drained canned chickpea cooked chickpeas ( i used canned baked in seasoned oil ) | 12 corn tortillas
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a 10 nonstick skillet over medium heat. When the first side of the pan smoke, add the mustard seeds and stir, cooking for about 1 minute. When the mustard seeds are very dark in color, remove them from the pan with a slotted spoon. When the mustard seeds are light brown in color, remove their pan from the heat and place them in a small bowl. When the mustard seeds begin bubbling, add the cauliflower and cook them, stirring occasionally, until the cauliflower is bright green and has lost its harsh harsh raw smell, 8 - 10 minutes. Drain the cauliflower, transfer it to a bowl, and stir in the vinegar, lime juice, and chickpeas. Serve warm, with tortillas and the other tbsp of cooking oil on the side.

Random Ingredients: pork,chili pepper flake,green onion,turkey sausage,ginger root,pine nut,white bread
title: Chinese Style Thanksgiving Stuffing
ingredients: 3 slices fresh white bread, crusts removed | 1/2 pound ground pork | 1/3 pound ground turkey sausage | 1/3 cup chili pepper flakes | 1/3 cup chopped green onion | 1/8 cup pine nuts, lightly toasted | 4 teaspoons grated fresh ginger root ( can also use 2 teaspoons ground ginger )
instructions: Preheat oven to 355 degrees f. Using a food processor, process bread to a fine crumb, removing chunks of bread. Place bread crumbs in a large bowl, and set aside. In a large skillet over medium heat, combine pork, sausage, chili flakes, green onions, pine nuts, ginger and pork mixture. Saute the mixture until the sausage is completely crumbly, about 8 minutes. Drain grease from the skillet, if necessary, and set aside. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Using your hands, pat the sausage/pork mixture into the baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until the stuffing has cooked through, about 35 minutes. Cool stuffing slightly before stuffing, before removing from foil.

title: Bacon Wrapped Cheese with Swiss and Canadian Bacon on Skewers
ingredients: 1 slice canadian bacon | peppercorn | 500 g swiss cheese | canadian bacon ( use 1 slice if possible ) | 12 hot peppercorns, coarsely pounded
instructions: Preheat the oven to 150 degrees f. Cut a half inch deep slit in each side of a cheese cube. Soak the whole piece of cheese in water while you are making the rest of the sandwich. Place the slices of cheese in a small roasting bowl. Spread the sliced, Canadian bacon on the cheese. Using the flat of your knife, poke holes in the cheese. Place the peppercorns in the holes. Place the ham, swiss cheese, bacon and toasted peppercorns in the cheese and place on top of the mushrooms. Place in the oven and bake for about 12 to 15 minutes, or until the cheese has melted and the mushrooms are golden. Allow to stand at room temperature for about 5 to 7 minutes before turning out onto a plate.

Random Ingredients: beef roast,heavy cream,beef,parmesan cheese,red jalapeno chile,fennel seed
title: Hot Roast Beef
ingredients: 1 teaspoon fennel seed, plus extra for tossing | 4 tablespoons heavy cream | 1 3/4 lbs boneless beef, halved lengthwise | 1 1/4 lbs beef short ribs | 2 red jalapeno chiles, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese
instructions: To lightly roast the fennel seeds, spread a dry 12 inch skillet over moderately high heat until it just begins to smoke, then immediately add the fennel seeds and cook, stirring, until toasted, 1 to 2 minutes. Transfer the fennel seeds to a medium bowl and grind to a coarse powder with a mortar and pestle. Cover and chill the ground fennel powder for 1 hour. Place 1 cup of the cream in a saucepan and bring to a simmer over moderate heat. Add the remaining cup of cream and continue simmering until the cream is very thick enough to coat a wooden spoon. Working with one piece of the beef at a time, transfer the cutlets to a carving board and cut them lengthwise into 1 inch wide strips. Season the fat with salt and pepper and reserve, covered, at room temp. To reheat the cream, heat the oven to 350°f coat the skillet with an oil and arrange over moderately high heat. Working with a few pieces of the cutlets, arrange the strips on a rimmed baking sheet and bake, turning once, until they are golden and tender, 4 to 6 minutes. Transfer the beef with a slotted spoon to a deep platter and keep warm, covered loosely with foil. Add the jalapenos to the skillet and stir a few times and remove from the heat. Cook the beef and the chiles over moderate heat, turning them, until they are golden, 4 to 6 minutes. Remove the beef with a slotted spoon and keep warm. Remove the fat from the skillet. Bring the cream to a boil and season with salt and pepper. Pour 1/2 of the cream over the meat and toss to coat. Scatter half of the beef and chiles over the top and sprinkle with one fourth of the cheese. Heat the pan over moderate heat until the pan is hot and add the reserved cream mixture. Cook the mixture until it is hot, about 3 minutes. Slide the beef over the top. Transfer to a carving plate and keep warm. Repeat with the remaining cutlets and chiles. Serve with reserved cream mixture and a sprig of fennel.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno pepper,five spice powder,pork roast,chicken bouillon,pistachio,red capsicum,chicken stock
title: Pistachio Pork
ingredients: 2 kg pork roast, cut into 3cm pieces | 20 g pistachios, shelled, roughly chopped | 2 dried jalapeno peppers, finely chopped | 2 red capsicums, halved, stoned and cut into 3cm lengths | 1/2 cup chicken stock | 1 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon | 1/4 teaspoon five-spice powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 degrees centigrade.

Random Ingredients: lemon peel,parmigiano reggiano cheese,lime juice,herb,coriander seed,cucumber,serrano chilies,chili sauce thai chli
title: Cucumber Tomato Salad (Greece)
ingredients: 1 small cucumber, peeled | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 1/4 cup sweet chili sauce ( i use thai sweet chili sauce ( i use herbs of the table ) | 1/4 cup sweet coriander seed, crushed | 1/4 cup finely minced fresh herb ( see note ) | freshly grated lime peel, plus more for passing | shredded parmigiano-reggiano cheese, for garnish | 1 jalapenos chli, stemmed and thinly sliced ( optional )
instructions: Cut the cucumber in half lengthwise and scoop out the seeds with a spoon. Cut the halves into 2 inch segments and put into a large bowl. Combine the lime juice, sweet chili sauce, coriander, herbs and lime peel. Add the cucumber, and toss to coat with the lime juice mixture. Taste and add salt if needed, then garnish with cheese, if desired. Note, i prefer jalapenos, not serrano chilies. Note, i have also made it without the lime peel. Don't substitute other than jalapeno powder.

title: Tahini-Crusted Fish
ingredients: 400 g dried fish fillets, such as cod, halibut, hake, king prawns or 400 g tuna | 400 g pepperoni | 1 cup tahini ( see notes ) | 1 inch cube star anise or 1 inch guajillo chilli
instructions: If using canned fish, make sure you have drained the blood and dry the fish under a tap. If using fresh fish bring the blood to the boil and then simmer for 10 minutes. The blood should reduce to a glaze. While this is simmering remove the shells and bones from the fish and cut off the ends of the fish to make a striped pattern, removing the filmy bones that float to the surface. Cut each piece of fish into 4 pieces roughly the same size from top to bottom along the length and width of the filet. Lay the fish on a tray lined with paper or plastic wrap. Place the pepperoni on top of the fish in an overlapping circle around each other and on top of each other. Brush with tahini, sprinkle with star anise and ground chilli. Set aside for 30 minutes. Rinse your hands with warm water and shake off any excess. Spoon the fish onto a tray lined with paper or plastic wrap and repeat with the remaining fish to make four servings.

Random Ingredients: caster sugar,cinnamon,oyster sauce,cream tartar,napa cabbage,vanilla bean
title: Yum Yum (Sweet Cabbage)
ingredients: 1 small napa cabbage, cored and cut into matchsticks | 1 can light cream of tartar | 1/2 vanilla bean, split lengthwise | 1 teaspoon caster sugar | 1 teaspoon oyster sauce | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon
instructions: Place the cabbage, cream of tartar and vanilla bean in a large microwave safe dish. Cover with boiling water.

title: Sautéed Vidalia Onions
ingredients: 8 sweet vidalia onions or 8 very sweet onions | 1/4 cup olive oil
instructions: Using a vegetable peeler or sharp knife cut strips lengthwise, then crosswise into 1/8 inch wide strips. Add olive oil and vidalia onion slices, and gently stir fry or toss with slotted spoon, until all the onion pieces are nicely coated and the onion is bright red.

Random Ingredients: blue cheese,tequila,corn oil,plain flour,chili pepper flake,venison steak,cilantro
title: Grilled Tequila Beef With Blue Cheese and Chili (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 10)

instructions: Preheat oven to 200c/gas mix flour, cilantro, cheese and chili flakes in a bowl. Cut steaks into 4 serving portions. Brush meat with tequila.

title: Persian Farofa
ingredients: 200 g white flour | 200 g apricots | 2/3 g chopped dried apricot
instructions: Sieve flour into a large glass bowl, add rest of ingredients. Mix very well. Chill for 1 hour or you can leave overnight. Preheat oven to 220 degree celcius or 160 degrees celsius. Roll out dough thin and cut into four portions. Place one portion on an almond, top with a little of apricot jelly and top with other two portions. Dip half in dough and lay on greased tray.

title: Cocktail
ingredients: 2 - 2 1/2 lbs haddock fillets | 1 -2 cup mashed potatoes | 1/2 cup diced red pepper
instructions: Rinse and fillet with cold water. Combine fish, mashed potatoes, drained red pepper, and any remaining mixture in a large, deep frying pan. Bake in a preheated 450f oven until fish is just opaque and potatoes are light brown and hot.

title: Sukiyaki Shrimp Cocktail
ingredients: 1/2 cup iceberg lettuce, chopped | 1/3 cup canned kiwi fruit, sliced ( optional ) | 1/2 lb small shrimp ( medium raw, peeled and deveined ) | 2 teaspoons salt | 1/2 lb cooked shrimp, peeled and deveined ( 1 lb )
instructions: Combine lettuce, kiwi fruit, shrimp, and salt in a mixing bowl. Serve immediately. Note, shrimp can also be served in a large cocktail glass, lined with lettuce leaves. Make sure that the shrimp are cooked first and not overcooked.

Random Ingredients: thai red curry paste,baking potato,rosemary sprig
title: Rosemary Potatoes
ingredients: 3 lbs baking potatoes, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped fresh rosemary sprigs | 1 1/2 tablespoons thai red curry paste ( or to taste )
instructions: Heat oven to 475°. Place potatoes into a 9x13 inch or 11x7 1/2 inch baking dish. Sprinkle with rosemary, chili paste and any remaining mixture. Cover and bake 25 minutes or until potatoes are tender and liquid is absorbed.

Random Ingredients: pink peppercorn,irish cream,penne pasta,white rice,half,mushroom soup
title: Creamy Eggnog
ingredients: 9 ounces uncooked penne pasta | 1 can condensed mushroom soup | 3/4 cup half-and-half | 2 ounces irish cream | 1 cup shredded part-skim italian cheese blend | 1/4 teaspoon pink peppercorns, crushed | 1/4 teaspoon white peppercorns, crushed
instructions: In a medium saucepan with a lid, combine pasta, mushroom soup, half and half, irish cream, italian cheese blend, crushed pepper and white peppercorns. Bring to a boil.

title: Diabetic Red Pepper and Hoagie Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 -12 thin slice red pepper | 4 hoagie rolls
instructions: Place 1 or 2 slices of red pepper on each hoagie roll, leaving an inch open with a small amount of the red pepper showing on each roll. Replace the top of the hoagie roll and slice all the way through the red pepper into thin slices. Serve on a festive bbq.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder,beef bouillon cube,frying chicken,white rice,rosemary leaf,kalamata olive,miracle whip,lite olive oil
title: Mom's Baked Chicken and Rice Casserole
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs pork shoulder, cut into 2-inch cubes | 1 tablespoon beef bouillon cube, crushed | 1 cup minute white rice | 2 lbs frying chickens, cut into 6 8 pieces, cut into eighths | 1/3 cup lite olive oil | 1/3 cup miracle whip | 24 kalamata olives | rosemary leaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In a nonstick roasting pan coat with nonstick cooking spray sprinkle meat with crushed bouillon cube. Evenly sprinkle in rice. In a large saucepan coat with nonstick cooking spray place chicken in one layer skin side down. Place over low heat. Cook 10 minutes. Remove chicken, pour off juices. In large roasting pan, mix meat and juices. Pour 1/3 of the sauce over meat. Top with 1/3 of olives. Repeat layers, topping with olives and sprinkle with rosemary. Bake 50 - 60 minutes, until bubbly. Let cool 10 - 15 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: green pepper,pearl barley,self rising flour,tamari soy sauce,angel hair pasta,bok choy,ricotta cheese,garlic
title: Tasty Chinese Noodles - Vegan!
ingredients: 100 g angel hair pasta, cooked | 1 teaspoon minced garlic | 1/3 cup finely chopped green pepper | 250 g ricotta cheese | 25 g chopped bok choy | 3 teaspoons tamari soy sauce | 1/3 cup self-rising flour | 2 tablespoons pearl barley | 1/2 cup frozen petite peas ( thawed if frozen )
instructions: Preheat oven to 160c. Cook pasta following packet instructions. Drain and set aside in large bowl. Mix together garlic, pepper, chopped bok choy, soy sauce, flour, and barley. Add pasta and mix to combine. Spray large ovenproof jug with spray oil. Spread pasta mixture into jug. Top with peas. Bake for 30 minutes or until golden and bubbly. Serve with fresh salad or steamed broccoli.

Random Ingredients: meat,egg substitute,horseradish,white rum,bay leaf,raisin,balsamic vinegar,golden syrup
title: Sausage Rolls Aka Meat Loaf
ingredients: 1 lb meat ( johnsonville recommended ) | 2 tablespoons horseradish | 1 egg substitute | 2 tablespoons white rum | 1/2 cup raisins | 3 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 bay leaf | 3 tablespoons golden syrup
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Mix the first five ingredients in a bowl. Make small balls and place on a rack over a cookie sheet. Bake at 375 degrees f for approx 20 minutes. Make sure to watch for them. When they are a little bubbly remove to a plate. Prepare the bbq for cooking. Roll out one sausage using the technique indicated on your package. Cook for 10 minutes per side. Serve.

title: Green and Gold Fresh  and Simple Grilled Provolone
ingredients: 8 ounces fontina cheese | 2 large fresh blueberries | 1/2 cup fresh mint, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons sweet paprika | 12 large lettuce leaves | 1/4 cup fresh marjoram, finely chopped
instructions: Place a non stick griddle or skillet on medium high heat. Dry all the cheese over a cutting board about 10 minutes or until slightly browned and bubbly. When finished, remove from heat and sprinkle it with the blueberries. Toast under grill, until the cheese is melted and bubbly, 5 - 8 minutes. Top with parsley and marjoram and serve warm.

title: Beef, Eggplant and Baked Salmon Meatpies
ingredients: 300 g beef, minced ( i used rump ) | 1 tablespoon mustard, crushed | 2 eggplants, sliced | 1/2 cup beef stock | 1/4 cup gin | 2 tablespoons dry oregano leaves | 1/4 cup pasta sauce with dried tomato
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degreesc. Put beef and mustard into a bowl and mix together. Add onions, eggplant and mix together very well. Add stock, yoghurt and spices and mix together. Put half the mixture into a greased, shallow baking dish. Put remaining meat mixture over it. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese and bake for 30 minutes. Take the pies out of the oven, cut them in half and serve.

title: Crock-Pot Broccoli
ingredients: 2 lbs broccoli, cut into florets | dark molasses, to taste ( or treacle or molasses )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a slow cooker. Cover and cook on high 4 hours, turning once. Enjoy.

title: Lentil Bread Spread

instructions: Place lentils in a saucepan with just enough water to cover. Bring to boil, reduce heat, and simmer, uncovered, about 45 minutes or until lentils are slightly tender but still firm. title: Broccoli in Marsala Sauce(Maradjala Marmellata)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs broccoli, small florets cut in 1/3 inch slices | 1 can diced tomatoes, slightly drained | 1/4 cup dry marsala wine ( sweet marsala gives a good taste, and the tomatoes reduce heat if needed ) | 1/4 cup soy sauce | 1/4 cup worcestershire sauce | 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard | 1/2 cup chopped fresh mint leaves | 2 tablespoons chopped dried apricots, lightly toasted
instructions: Cook broccoli in boiling water 6 - 10 minutes or until tender crisp.

title: Green Peas Ala Elieh
ingredients: 2 cups frozen green peas | 1 tablespoon tomato puree | 1 tablespoon fresh cilantro leaves ( or mint leaves )
instructions: Place peas, puree, and 1/2 cup water in a pressure cooker. Cook, on high pressure, for 15 minutes, then reduce to medium, on slow release. Carefully remove from heat, and serve in shallow bowls. Garnish with mint or cilantro and serve with naan breads or chapatis.

Random Ingredients: banana,fennel seed,flour tortilla,turkey sausage,thai fish sauce
title: Baked Wraps
ingredients: 1 lb ground turkey sausage | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed, crushed | 1 large banana, peeled and halved | 4 flour tortillas, softened | 2 tablespoons thai fish sauce
instructions: In an ungreased 10 inch skillet, cook sausage over medium heat, breaking up sausage with a spoon, until no longer pink. Stir in fennel seed.

Random Ingredients: green chili,dark soy sauce,purpose white flour,serrano chili pepper,fenugreek seed,iceberg lettuce,white rice
title: Chili Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried fenugreek seeds or 1/2 cup sunflower seeds | 1/2 head iceberg lettuce, shredded or 1 head mixed salad greens | 1 pinch dried hot green chili | 1 small fresh serrano chili pepper, sliced thin | 1/3 cup dark soy sauce | 1/2 cup unbleached all-purpose white flour or 1/2 cup white sugar | 3 cups cold white rice, cooked
instructions: Mix fenugreek and sunflower seeds in a very hot frying pan and toast over medium heat, stirring often, until they begin to smell aromatic and toasted. Remove and keep aside to cool. title: Apple Fettuccine
ingredients: 12 ounces fresh fettuccine | 1 cup apple juice ( or to taste )
instructions: Cook the fettuccine according to package directions. In a microwavable bowl, combine the apple juice and apple fettuccine, tossing to coat. Serve right away.

title: Savory Spaghettini With Hazelnuts and Oysters
ingredients: 3 packages spaghettini | 4 tablespoons packed brown sugar | 1/2 teaspoon ground cayenne powder | 1/4 cup chopped hazelnuts | 1/2 teaspoon minced fresh dill | 1/8 teaspoon dry instant minced onion
instructions: Cook spaghettini according to package directions. Drain and return to saucepan. Stir in sugar, cayenne, hazelnuts, dill, and onion. Toss well and warm through.

title: Best Greek Dip
ingredients: 1 lb pinto beans, rinsed in cold water and drained | 1 lb crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Combine the beans with the feta cheese in a large bowl and toss. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: white bread,cannellini bean,cake flour,chorizo sausage,cheddar cheese,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Cannellini Bean Croissants
ingredients: 1/4 lb chorizo sausage, casing removed | 1 1/2 cups cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 4 slices best quality white bread, crusts removed | 1/2 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese, more for sprinkling | 1/4 cup cake flour | 1/4 cup grated cheddar cheese, more for sprinkling ( optional )
instructions: Over medium heat, cook chorizo, breaking it apart with a spoon, until browned, about 5 minutes. Add beans and stir together until warmed through, about 10 minutes. Preheat oven to 350°f cut crusts from bread. Using a 1 1/2 round cookie cutter, cut bread into 4 triangles. Spoon bean mixture into a 9x5x3 inch loaf pan, spreading it evenly. Sprinkle with cheese and top with triangles. Bake 10 minutes or until golden and hot through. Remove from pan and let sit 5 minutes before serving.

title: Coconut Soup
ingredients: 2 cans coconut milk | 1 can vegetable broth | 2 cans orange sections
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small saucepan. Cook over medium high heat for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.

title: Moroccan Saffron Appetizer for Eats and Chips
ingredients: 1/2 liter tbsps saffron ( i use saffron packets with an added dash of yellow food coloring or a bit of the saffron cooking liquid ) | 12 -16 dashes of tabasco sauce ( i used tbsps sweet and sour sauce mix from my homemade version, found at some middle eastern specialty food stores )
instructions: If using a non metal spoon, crush the saffron into a fine powder with a mortar & pestle or in a spice mill. If using the glass, pour boiling water over the saffron till the paste is covered.. Pour this onto your food processor bowl using the flat blade of the processor, process till the mixture is coarse and fine. Add in the tabasco sauce & process for another few seconds. Note, i made this in my electric mixer with a flat blade & it took me less than 5 minutes, but it was still tasty. I stored it in the frigeator in a plastic bag, it was always a keeper for months & enjoyed my food was tastier the next day. Please note, i made a big batch & it all went inches. I made this with 3 tbsps saffron & 1 tbsps sugar. I store in a plastic bottle & have a jar that is tightly sealed. One day i didn't have the jar with the opened jar & used 2 tsp of saffron flavouring. My food network switched my food maker to quick pulses & it took closer to 20 minutes + 1 minute for the tbsps, which i had never had before. When you tap on it on the pak, it should be soft & slightly sticky. A little sticky, but tasty. So quick and easy. Note, if you use a pastry cloth, you have to wipe it clean after rolling out the dough. If you roll it too thin, it will become tough & unappealing. Don't worry if it has the texture of cookie dough.

title: Pita Bread Triangles
ingredients: 1 package phyllo pastry sheets ( two sheets ) | 2 pita bread, triangles
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees and have at hand a baking sheet ready. Take one sheet of phyllo and lay it flat on its horizontal side. Trim the excess or wax paper if needed. You will end up with a layered stack of very thin triangles of phyllo in your oven. Line the phyllo sheets with your dampened paper towel and put them to the table. Cover with dampened towels and stack the phyllo sheets together. Take one triangle of phyllo and spread it out so that it’s about 2 in diameter. Brush it lightly with a little olive oil and lay it on the dough. Lay the triangles together and cut in half vertically and diagonally.. Repeat until your phyllo and triangles are used up. Place the triangles on the baking sheet. If you’re using them all, stack them and brush them with olive oil. Bake for 15 minutes, flipping over halfway through. Turn over and bake for five more minutes or until golden.

Random Ingredients: chunk pineapple,milk powder,pinto bean,lemon lime beverage,red wine,poppy seed
title: My Favorite Poke and Beans
ingredients: 1 can evaporated milk powder | 1 can pinto beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can chunk pineapple, drained | 2/3 cup pomegranate-infused red wine | 2 fluid ounces lemon-lime beverage ( i recommend eclairs ) | 1 -2 teaspoon poppy seed ( optional )
instructions: Drain the canned beans. Add all ingredients except poppy seeds. Mix well. Refrigerate overnight before serving if using. If using a beverage stir in 1 - 2 teaspoons poppy seeds or other flavor enhancer. Serve cold in pita bread, crackers or tostados.

title: Mochi Roll
ingredients: 2 -3 cups rice flour | 1 lit cold coffee ice cream
instructions: Put all the ingredients in a blender and blend until smooth.

title: Grilled White Bread Salad
ingredients: 4 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 2 -6 tablespoons fresh thyme leaves | 12 slices white bread, toasted
instructions: In a glass bowl, combine vinegar and thyme leaves. Arrange toast on a serving plate or platter with a few spoons. Pour dressing over bread, using just enough to coat. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 1 hour to develop crispness.

title: Indian Poppy Seed Filling for Fish Rolls, Tastes Not Fried
ingredients:
3 tablespoons poppy seeds ( regular poppy seeds are fine.
    - i use a mix ) | 4 teaspoons turmeric powder | 6 tablespoons dark rum ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon parsley flakes | chopped nuts ( optional )
instructions: Soak poppy seeds for 15 minutes in 1/4 cup hot water. Drain the seeds again, but don't let them cool completely. Grind the ground poppy seed with turmeric, rum and parsley flakes. When the water is cooled, put in small bowl and whip with a fork to give this a paste. Stir in more rum if using. Add the water/mint flakes to this paste. Roll mixture into 2 inch balls. You shouldn't need a whole dozen at this point. If you don't have them, you can wrap them in plastic wrap.

title: Spicy Red Pepper Strips
ingredients: 2 large red bell peppers | 2 cans diced green chile peppers
instructions: Trim all of the stem from the bell peppers and cut the bell peppers into strips about 1 1/2 inch wide and 1 1/2 inches long. Wash the peppers and cut strips into 1 inch pieces. Spread out the strips about 1 1/2 inches in diameter on a wire rack set in a baking dish. Arrange the peppers on the rack and bake in a preheated oven. Turn the heat off once the oven is hot and place the baking dish in the oven overnight, stirring every 15 minutes. The next day, stir the pepper strips every 15 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool. Store in an airtight container at room temperature.

title: Simple and Easy Chicken Koora Kebabs
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 2 tablespoons kasuri methi ( dried fenugreek leaves )
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium heat, and lightly oil grate. Pour oil into a large disposable roasting pan large enough to accommodate the chicken. Place chicken breasts in the pan, and poke holes in the chicken with a fork. Sprinkle chicken with a pinch of kasuri methi between the breasts.

title: Easy Pea Curry
ingredients: 1 cup green peas, frozen ( fresh peas or 1 cup defrosted peas ) | 3 teaspoons curry paste | 1 cup baby onions, chopped | 1/3 cup parsley flakes or 1/3 cup basil, chopped | 1 cup sweet peas, frozen ( thawed )
instructions: Cook peas according to package directions. Add curry paste, green onions and parsley. Toss to coat. Add sweet peas, toss again. Serve over rice or noodles.

title: Italian Pumpkin Pizza
ingredients: 2 cups self rising flour | 1/2 cup water | 1 can pumpkin | 1 1/2 tablespoons olive oil | 1/2 teaspoon dried basil leaves | 3 cups shredded cooked chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Lightly grease a 9x9 inch baking dish. In a medium bowl, mix together the self rising flour and water. Stir in pumpkin, olive oil and basil. Pour into prepared baking dish, and top with chicken. Bake at 425 degrees f for 20 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Italian Beans (Pressure Cooker)
ingredients: 400 g red beans | salt and pepper
instructions: Rinse red beans and transfer to pressure cooker. Add salt and pepper. Close lid and set up pressure on high. Reduce pressure to medium and simmer for 15 minutes.

title: Pecan-Rum Balls - Gluten Free
ingredients: 2 cups pecans, finely chopped | 1/2 cup dark rum, such as myers's ( dry ) or 1/2 cup light rum ( dry ) | 1 orange, juice and zest of, grated zest of | 1 - 1 1/2 cup dark rum ( dark )
instructions: Add pecan nuts in a microwave safe bowl of hot water, and microwave 1 minute. Remove from heat and add ½ cup rum or light rum. Stir all together, and set aside to cool to room temperature. Stir in the orange zest and juice. Cover and place in the refrigerator for several hours. This will keep for up to a week. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: pea,panang curry paste,broccoli,shiitake mushroom,french bread,baby carrot
title: Crispy Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoonpanang curry paste | 12 ounces shiitake mushrooms, cleaned and sliced | 3 cups fresh broccoli, trimmed and cut into florets | 4 fresh baby carrots, cut into sticks | 1 cup frozen peas | 1 loaf french bread
instructions: In a large bowl, mix all the vegetables.

Random Ingredients: pork tenderloin,brown rice,poblano pepper,beef mince,chicken bouillon granule,white grape
title: Pork and Pear Rice for a Crowd
ingredients: 4 pork tenderloin, bone scored at 1/4 inch intervals | 4 poblano peppers | 2 large red shallots | 1 tablespoon low sodium beef bouillon granules | 1 tablespoon beef mince | 500 g white grapes, halved
instructions: Preheat a heavy based oven proof fry pan on high heat. Add the pork and poblano peppers, then add just enough water to just cover the meat. Cover and simmer on high heat on the stove for 30 minutes. Remove the pork from the pan, place the pan in a larger pan, and cook on high heat for 7 to 10 minutes until the pork has browned. Add the mince, bouillon granules and shallot, then stir in the grapes. Cook in the oven for 15 minutes longer. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: water chestnut,shiitake mushroom,fish sauce,maraschino cherry,chinese five spice powder,cooking spray
title: Sherry and Mushrooms Skewers
ingredients: 3 cups sliced shiitake mushrooms | 4 dried shiitake mushrooms | 8 water chestnuts | cooking spray | 1 teaspoon chinese five-spice powder, or to taste | 2 tablespoons fish sauce, or to taste | 1 tablespoon water, or as needed | 12 maraschino cherries
instructions: Place 1 mushroom and 1 water chestnut in a bowl of water and soak 15 minutes to soften. Remove and discard any stems from the fungus with a slotted spoon and cut the fungus into 1-inch pieces. Cut the remaining mushroom into 1 pieces and set aside. Place the 3 remaining mushrooms in a bowl of water and soak 15 minutes to rehydrate. Remove and discard the hard stems.

Random Ingredients: granny smith apple,wild mushroom,apricot preserve,saffron,american cheese,tequila,baking chocolate,yellow pear tomato
title: Grilled Smoky Apricot Bites
ingredients: 1 lb wild mushroom, quartered | 1 lb granny smith apple, sliced thin | 1 large yellow pear tomatoes | 4 ounces salted butter or 4 ounces margarine, cut into thin slices | 1 ounce baking chocolate, finely grated | 1 ounce tequila | 1 pinch saffron | 4 ounces saffron-glaze or 4 ounces apricot preserves
instructions: Preheat grill to high. Place mushrooms, apples, pear and apricot preserve in medium mixing bowl, stir well. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours. Brush with saffron glaze and grill to taste.

Random Ingredients: olive oil,green bell pepper,green chilies,cream chicken soup,vegetable stock,apricot,creole seasoning,corn tortilla
title: Apricot Chicken Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 package corn tortillas | 1 package creole seasoning | 1 package frozen chopped peas and corn tortillas | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 green bell pepper, chopped | 3 medium fresh green chilies, chopped ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons vegetable stock
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add tortilla and cook until lightly browned. Place into a 9x13 inch baking dish. In a saucepan over medium heat, combine cream of chicken soup, green bell pepper, and green chilies. Heat until cream of chicken soup is hot and green bell pepper is tender. Pour mixture over the tortillas, and top with creole seasoning. Bake in the preheated oven for 35 to 40 minutes, or until hot through and bubbly. Serve topped with sour cream if desired.

title: Mango Lassi
ingredients: 200 g fresh mangoes ( not frozen ) | 150 ml orange juice | 1 tablespoon ghee or 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Blend all ingredients. Pour into glasses. Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: green peppercorn,onion garlic crouton,cardamom pod,white vinegar,jamaican spice mixture,shallot,mozzarella cheese,fig
title: Figs and Prosciutto
ingredients: 1 lb fresh fig, quartered | 1/2 cup onion and garlic-flavored croutons | 1/3 cup white vinegar | 3 tablespoons shallots, minced | 1 teaspoon cardamom pod, cracked | 2 teaspoons jamaican spice mixture | 3/4 teaspoon crushed green peppercorn | 2 ounces mozzarella cheese
instructions: In large frying or griddle, lightly toast croutons. Set aside. Heat all other ingredients except cheese, in a pan. Cook over high heat, stirring, until boiling. Let simmer for five minutes. Stir in cheese, and continue cooking. Serve warm or cold.

title: Crispy Curried Corn
ingredients: 1 can yellow corn kernels ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 2 tablespoons curry | salt or ground pepper | 1 lb medium thick slices thin salt pork, chopped
instructions: Pour enough water into a large pot to almost cover the corn. Bring it to a boil. Boil the corn for 15 minutes or until the kernels are tender. Drain the corn and reserve the water. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of water to a boil. Pour 1/4 cup or so of oil in the empty pot and when it starts to sizzle, add the corn and curry. Stir to coat the corn with the oil. Lower the heat, cover and simmer until tender, about 10 minutes. Season with salt. Cook the pork in the reserved water until it's cooked through, but not dry. Ladle the corn into the bowl with the curry, and toss to coat.

Random Ingredients: french bread,blue cheese,lobster tail,vanilla bean,dill pickle,cream tartar
title: Lobster Toast With Bleu Cheese Topping
ingredients: 12 slices crusty french bread, 3/4 thick | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla bean | 5/8 cup light cream of tartar | 1 pint fresh lobster tail, cooked | 12 ounces country blue cheese, cubed | 24 -32 slices dill pickles
instructions: Toast bread on both sides and spread with cream of tartar. Spread lobster flat. Next layer the remaining ingredients in the following order, bread, lobster, cheese and finish with cream of tartar. You may use a pizza cutter to cut if preferred. Serve with fruit salad and cold beer.

Random Ingredients: ra el hanout spice mix,macaroni,habanero pepper,tequila,topping,self raising flour
title: Macaroni & Habanero Pepper - Batheen-Tequila With Mac & Tequila
ingredients:
macaroni | 2 cups self-raising flour ( or wholemeal flour, or plain flour with baking soda ) | 1/2 teaspoon ras el hanout spice mix ( spice mix # 25283 ) or 1/2 teaspoon shahook spice mix ( spice mix # 25283 ) | 3 tobasco habanero peppers ( or other peppers if you like, or one of each ) | 3 tablespoons tequila | 3 cups macaroni ( orzo, macaroni, etc.
    - ) | 2 cups prepared whipped topping ( see note )
instructions: To start, cook the macaroni orzo as directed on the package, drain, return to the pan and set aside. Meanwhile, place 3 tablespoons olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add ras el hanout and fry for 1 minute. Add tequila, habanero peppers and cook for another couple of minutes. Remove from the pan and allow to cool to room temperature. Drain your macaroni and habanero then add to the pan along with some tomato sauce to coat. Stir together until well combined. Add the flour and spices. Mix very well and cook for 2 minutes, just to incorporate the flour. Transfer it to a large ovenproof bowl or plate and cover with plastic wrap. Place in a preheated oven and cook for 90 minutes using your preferred method. Remove from the oven and cool. When the macaroni/habanero mixture has cooled to warm temperature, add the whipped topping and cook for 2 to 3 minutes on medium heat. Cut into pieces and serve as is or in the style of your choice.

title: Asian-Style Chili Tuna
ingredients: 1 can tuna in vegetable oil | 1/2 cup sweet chili sauce ( kikkoman is the best brand )
instructions: Prepare the tuna according to package directions, drain and set aside. Drain the oil from the tuna, as you will be grilling it later. Combine the tuna, sweet chili sauce and oil in large bowl. Taste and adjust the seasoning. Serve warm with french bread slices and jasmine rice.

title: Chickpea and Chipotle Pizza Wedges
ingredients:
2 cans chickpeas, rinsed and drained | 2 tablespoons extra-virgin oleo | 2 canned chipotle chiles in adobo, finely chopped ( about 1 t0.
    - ) | 2 cracked black peppercorns | 2 large prepared pizza crusts, toasted
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Line 4 sheets with foil. Spread all of the chickpeas with the oleo. Top with the chipotles, pepper corns and peppercorns. Place the remaining ingredients on top. Slide the pizza onto a baking sheet. Broil 6 from the heat of the broiler for about 6 minutes.

title: Jicama Rice Ball in Microwave
ingredients: 1 jicama, diced ( about 1-1/2 cups ) | 1 cup brown rice, raw | 1/3 cup soya sauce, low sodium | 2 liters ice ( optional but recommended )
instructions: Place jicama cubes in microwave safe bowl. Microwave on high power for about 10 seconds or until jicama is warm. Add rice. Microwave on high power about 20 seconds or until liquid has been absorbed. Stir until rice is coated. Remove from microwave. Microwave on high power about 1 minute or until liquid has been absorbed. Stir and cool. Cover with plastic wrap or waxed paper to avoid microwave drying out. Chill or overnight. Serve cold.

title: Lime Asafetida Pasta With Fresh Lime
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( or to taste ) | 3 cups half-and-half | 1 lb fresh angel hair pasta, broken into 2-inch lengths | lime wedge
instructions: Bring a kettle of water to a boil. Meanwhile, in a small frying pan, toast the asafetida powder over medium low heat, swirling pan occasionally, until just fragrant, about 1 minute. Add half and half and simmer about 6 minutes, stirring occasionally. Meanwhile, add pasta to a large pot of boiling water and cook until tender, stirring constantly with a wooden pickled fork. Drain pasta and toss with asafetida lime syrup. Serve, garnished with lime wedges.

title: Jicama With Wild Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 cup jicama, diced | 1 cup wild mushroom, sliced | 1 lime, zest of, finely grated | 2 tablespoons brown sauce
instructions: Put jicama and mushrooms in a bowl, add the lime zest and brown sauce. Toss gently. Serve.

title: Chili Prawns for Two
ingredients: 20 large prawns ( uncooked ) | 2 tablespoons hot chili powder | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1 tablespoon oil or 1 tablespoon coconut oil
instructions: Rinse the prawns under running water. Pat dry by hand. Heat oil in wok and add prawns and stir fry for two minutes. Mix in chilli powder and pour over prawns and serve.

title: Simple Seasoning Mix
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried fenugreek leaves | 1 teaspoon seasoning
instructions: Combine all ingredients or store in a tightly sealed bowl for up to 2 months.

title: Spicy Thai Pepper Strips
ingredients: 2 large bell peppers | 12 -24 ounces medium fresh tomatoes | 1/4 cup shortening | sriracha asian chili sauce | oil, for stir frying
instructions: Peel and dice bell peppers and cook in microwave for 4 minutes. Remove from microwave, add shortening and stir fry. Add pepper strips and cook for 2 - 3 minutes. Add sriracha chilli sauce to taste. Continue to stir fry until pepper strips and tomato slices have crisped up. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock,oregano leaf,turmeric powder,marjoram,anise seed,plain yogurt,vanilla ice cream
title: Yogurt Soup
ingredients: 2 cups chicken stock | 2 teaspoons fresh marjoram | 1 teaspoon ground anise seed | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/2 cup finely chopped plain yogurt or 1/2 cup sour cream | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves, soaked in | 1/4 cup boiling water | 2 -3 tablespoons milk chocolate shavings ( optional ) or 2 -3 tablespoons vanilla ice cream ( optional )
instructions: Combine stock, marjoram and anise seeds in a saucepan. Bring to boil over low heat. Add turmeric powder. Stir to mix well. Lower heat, cover and cook for 7 minute remove from heat. Whisk together yogurt and oregano until smooth. Stir into soup. Serve in individual bowls garnished with a dollop of chocolate shavings or a spoonful of vanilla ice cream.

title: Potato-Tandoori Quinoa Pies
ingredients: 400 g potatoes ( peel and cut into 1 cm cubes ) | 1 large beetroot ( trimmed and cut into pieces ) | 1/2 cup dry-roasted plain yogurt ( greek is best ) | 2 garlic cloves ( minced ) | 1 tablespoon hot paprika | 1/2 cup quinoa ( to taste ) | 5 slices white bread ( cut into 4cm slices )
instructions: Rinse the quinoa thoroughly. Preheat oven to 240c/fan 160c/gas. Place the potato cubes and beetroot into a roasting tin along with enough water/ghee to just cover the potato cubes. Prick the potatoes all over with a fork and place on the shelf in the preheated oven, leaving the lid slightly ajar. Bake for 30 mins or until the vegetables and beetroot are very tender. Shake the pan every so often during the cooking to ensure even cooking. Mix together the yogurt, garlic and paprika in a bowl, season to taste and stir in the quinoa. Add the potato mixture and stir together until well combined. Spread out the bread slices on a tray and bake for 10 mins, until crisp and golden. Spread the quinoa mixture evenly on the toasted bread slices and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: vanilla bean,icing sugar,green chile pepper,tart apple,ginger
title: Green Apple Jam  (Fruchtsuppe)
ingredients:
350 g tart apples, peeled and cut into chunks.
    - | 1/2 cup icing sugar | 2 teaspoons grated fresh ginger | 1 teaspoon green chile pepper, seeds removed | 1 vanilla bean, split lengthwise
instructions: Place apples into a saucepan over low heat and cover. Cook until soft. Remove from heat and mash the apples until finely diced. Stir in 2/3 cup icing sugar, ginger, green chile pepper seeds and vanilla bean, reserving the vanilla bean skin. Stir in remaining icing sugar. Cool to room temperature.

title: Italian Easter Eggs and Pear Meatballs
ingredients: 1 pound hot italian sausage | 6 large firm pears in the shell, peeled and cored | 1 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Preheat the oven broiler. Arrange sausage on a cookie sheet and broil, turning once, until evenly browned and crumbly, about 10 minutes. Transfer to a resealable plastic bag or ziploc bag, pressing in the sausage. Arrange pears on the sausage and peppers. Sprinkle with pepper. Bake in the preheated oven until pears are tender, about 15 minutes.

title: Cobodile Sauce
ingredients: 250 ml double cream | 1 tablespoon desiccated coconut oil | 1 tablespoon tarragon, chopped
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a heavy based saucepan, add the tarragon and simmer for 30 seconds. Add 300ml of cream and stir until it thickens. Add the remaining cream, bring to boiling point and simmer for 30 seconds.

Random Ingredients: hot chili pepper,onion soup mix,cannellini bean,caper
title: Cannellini Beans (From a Vegetarian)
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 2 tablespoons dry minced onions or 2 tablespoons dried minced onion soup mix | 1 tablespoon minced capers | 1 tablespoon chopped sweet dried hot chili peppers ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients except the chilies in a saucepan and gently mix.

title: Lazy Daydream Dessert
ingredients: 4 tablespoons aise extract | 1 lb low fat pizza sauce, any flavor | 1/4 teaspoon dried lrggelatin | 24 ladyfingers | 1 celery rib, thinly sliced, leaves separated
instructions: Bring pizza sauce to boil, dissolving gelatin in hot water. Remove from heat. Stir a small amount of gelatine into sauce. Spoon enough sauce on bottom of lightly greased 13x9 pan to coat rim with a thin layer. Scrunch with fingers. Lay ladyfingers 1 at a time on sauce. Spread with a thin layer of sauce. Sprinkle with celery then top with remaining ladyfingers. Brush with remaining sauce. Cover with plastic wrap, let rest 15 mins. Uncover and refrigerate several hours so that the flavors blend.

title: Chinese Style Pizza Crust
ingredients: 4 1/2 cups whole wheat flour or 4 1/2 cups bread flour
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together in a bowl or your food processor. Add liquid ingredients into the mixture and knead to form a soft dough. Place on lightly floured surface and roll out 1/4 to 1/8 inch thick circles. Place on an uncovered pizza tray and brush top with beaten egg. Spray tops with a little olive oil if you wish. Bake at 400°f for 18 minutes.

Random Ingredients: salt,orange marmalade,sauerkraut,white pepper,beef stew meat,garlic,white rice,green bell pepper
title: Sauerkraut and Rice for Two
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked white rice | 1 teaspoon salt | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 3 cloves garlic, minced | 2 pounds beef stew meat | 1 can sauerkraut - rinsed and drained | 1 cup orange marmalade | 1 cup chopped green bell pepper
instructions: Combine rice, salt, and pepper in a large plastic resealable bag.

title: Painted Oysters With Oysters (Mabéliz)
ingredients: 24 oysters, shucked | 2 2/3 tablespoons mirin or 2 2/3 tablespoons sake | 2 teaspoons extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Using a sharp knife, remove the white and light outer shell from the oysters. Do not remove the muscle and dark shell from inside. Carefully remove and discard the beard from the shell. With a long knife, cut the oysters lengthwise, into halves. In a small bowl, combine the oysters, mirin, olive oil and salt and pepper and coat evenly. Place half of the oysters into a glass baking dish and sprinkle with half of the oyster flesh. Scatter with half each of the reserved oysters and the remaining oyster flesh.

Random Ingredients: pecan,orange,plain nonfat yogurt,curry paste,jasmine rice,white sugar,salt pepper
title: Spicy Rice and Pecan Salad
ingredients: 1 cup cooked jasmine rice | 1 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 2 teaspoons orange rind | 1 teaspoon curry paste | 1/8 teaspoon white sugar | 1/4 teaspoon salt and pepper, to taste | 1/3 cup pecans, finely coarsely chopped
instructions: Combine the rice, yogurt, orange peel, curry paste, sugar, salt, and pepper in a bowl and mix well. Garnish with pecans and serve immediately.

title: Stuffed French Bread (Pain Patisserie)
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread | 6 -10 dates, depending on size | 3 tablespoons anchovy paste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place bread on a baking tray and cut a slice of the cross lengthways. Pipe small, thin diagonal slices from bread into the hollowed out side of each date. Sprinkle on the anchovy paste, and top with a few drops of water. Place into the oven and bake until bread is golden around the edges of the bread, and crusty in places.

title: Vegetarian Pecan and Pear Nuts
ingredients: 1 cup pecans, toasted | 2 tablespoons rice wine ( or more ) | 3 -4 fresh thyme sprigs | 1 teaspoon curry paste | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves, crumbled | 1 large ripe mixed sweet potato ( or 3 medium ) | 1 small radicchio
instructions: Combine the pecans and rice wine in a small to medium bowl& set aside. Add the thyme sprigs, curry paste& oregano. Toss lightly to coat the pecan mixture. Peel and cut the potato into small, bite size chunks, soak in cold water about 30 minutes& drain excess water, drain, and pat dry with paper towels to remove excess moisture. Cut the radicchio crosswise into 1/4 inch thick slices& set aside. In a wok or small skillet over high heat, warm the vegetable oil until a bead of steam emits, stir fry the pecan mixture, a few pieces at a time, until it is hot& crunchy, about 5 to 7 minutes.

Random Ingredients: lime juice,beef consomme,cardamom,coconut milk,pineapple chunk,icing sugar
title: Pineapple Cubed Beef in Coconut Milk
ingredients: 1 can pineapple chunks, drained and juice reserved | 1 can coconut milk | 2 tablespoons lime juice | 3 packets beef consomme | 1/4 teaspoon icing sugar ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom ( optional )
instructions: Place a few cubed pineapple in the bottom of an 11 x 7 inch baking dish. Combine the remaining ingredients except the coconut milk and pour over the pineapple. Cover with plastic wrap and place in fridge for at least 4 hours or overnight. Prepare a cold fire in your grill or pre heat oven to 500°f. Lightly spray grill with cooking spray. Grill pineapple until golden on all sides and cooked to your liking.

Random Ingredients: prosciutto,pineapple juice,onion powder,pork tenderloin,phyllo pastry,apple juice,heavy whipping cream
title: Sweet Apple, Prosciutto, and Pineapple Strudel
ingredients: 2 pork tenderloin | 18 sheets phyllo pastry | 15 slices prosciutto | 2 apples - peeled, cored, and thinly sliced | 1 onion, minced | 1/2 cup pineapple juice | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: Place the pork tenderloins in a large skillet and add enough water to cover. Bring to a boil and cook for 15 to 20 minutes or until the pork is no longer pink in the center and the juices run clear. Remove the pork from the skillet and drain. While the water is coming to a boil, slice the prosciutto into 1 1/2 inch wide strips approximately 6 inches long and 1/4 inch wide. Arrange the prosciutto strips on a large baking sheet, making sure to cover the dough completely. Place the apple slices in the center of each pastry strip. Place equal amounts of sliced prosciutto on top of each apple slice, making sure they are fully covered. Sprinkle evenly with minced onion. Spoon 1 1/2 tablespoons of pineapple juice and equal amounts of heavy whipping cream on top of the onion and prosciutto. Cover and refrigerate for 6 hours or overnight to let the flavors blend. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Uncover the top of the sausage and top with the remaining prosciutto slices. Bake for 20 minutes or until the sauce is lightly golden. Remove the strudel from the oven and serve.

Random Ingredients: cumin seed,vinegar,oyster sauce,mustard seed,apple cider,green chilies,monterey jack cheese,meatless spaghetti sauce
title: Baked Mexican Nachos
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cumin seed | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 5 small green chilies | 1 can spicy salted water-packed tomatoes with onion and garlic, drained, coarsely chopped, liquid reserved | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish-based barbecue sauce | 2 tablespoons apple cider | 1/4 cup extra-virgin olive oil or 1/4 cup canola oil | 1 lb cooked and drained meatless spaghetti or 1 lb spaghetti, broken into 2-inch pieces | 2 cups reduced-fat monterey jack cheese
instructions: Heat oven to 400ºf. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a medium skillet, toast cumin seeds and mustard seeds over medium heat, stirring until fragrant, about 20 seconds. Add chilies.

title: Spinach Appetizer Kebabs
ingredients: 2 lbs spinach leaves | 4 skewers | 1/2 cup dijon mustard
instructions: Cut the spinach leaves diagonally into 2 inch strips. Thread the spinach accordion style onto 4 skewers. Pour the mustard onto the skewers. Grill the kebabs under high heat or broil them until golden brown and crisp, turning once. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: swiss chard,polish kielbasa,beef sirloin,bean,wine vinegar,thyme sprig,vinegar,shrimp
title: Stuffed Swiss Chard - Le Trinquet Restaurant Style
ingredients: 12 large stalks swiss chard | 3 ounces beef sirloin | 12 large shrimp | 1/2 lb polish kielbasa, sliced thin | 1/2 cup wine vinegar | 1/4 cup wine vinegar | 1/4 cup vinegar | 2 tablespoons thyme sprigs | salt and pepper
instructions: Clean leaves, wash and dry thoroughly. Remove stems from chard. Slice off center ribs of chard from stem end. Remove leaves from stems just below stem and save.. Cut off stems and separate stems from leaves. Remove tough base about 3/4 inch from stem on outside of chard. Cut 1/8 inch off top of leaves. Fill center of chard stalks with 1 shrimp with a quarter portion of the sliced kielbasa. Add 1/4 cup wine vinegar. Place 1/4 cup of the reserved leaf base base in leaves of chard over top of sausages. Seal e at one end. Repeat with rest of chard. Tie ends with kitchen string. Heat grill to high. Brush grill with oil. Place all 4 stuffed chard leaves inside and side by side. Grill approximately 4 - 5 minutes per side. While still hot, brush with remaining 1/4 cup of red wine vinegar. Sprinkle with thyme. Serve with french bread cut diagonally and enjoy.

title: Thai Beef Cheese Foldover
ingredients: 4 sheets phyllo pastry sheets | 2 lbs stewing beef, thinly sliced | 3 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 1 cup cottage cheese, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Lightly spray a medium skillet with cooking spray. Saute beef in skillet over medium heat until beef is browned and no pink remains, about 15 minutes. Transfer meat to a bowl. Add vinegar and fish sauce to meat and mix well. Set aside. Brush edges of phyllo pastry sheets with some water. Place 1 - 2 tablespoons of meat mixture in the center of 1 phyllo sheet. Drizzle meat mixture over meat, making a 6 long rectangle. Carefully fold the 2 sheets over the top of the meat and brush on top of the pastry. Place a damp towel over the top of the pastry to keep the phyllo moist. In a 9 x 13 inch baking dish spray the top of pastry with water. Place the baking dish in the preheated oven. Bake for about 40 minutes or until the phyllo is brown. Remove dish from oven. Spoon cottage cheese into the centre of pastry, allowing room for filling. Place the remaining phyllo pastry over the cheese and brush on top of filling. Place in a preheated broiler for about 5 minutes or until dough bubbles and is golden brown.

instructions: Spread olives onto aluminum foil, top with remaining olives. Stir together remaining ingredients, brush over olives. title: Potato & Pepperoni Salad with Chili Sauce
ingredients: 2 large red potatoes, boiled in a pot of salted water till tender | 1 -3 stalk lemongrass, finely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon chili sauce | 1/8 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace | 200 g sliced pepperoni | 1 cup greek yogurt
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high. Combine all ingredients except yogurt in a medium bowl. Dress potato mixture well with the yogurt. Put mixture in a warm oven and bake for about 20 - 30 minutes, till warmed through but not burnt inside. Serve warm. Note, use the green pea pods or green beans instead of potatoes.

title: Mexican Seasoning Cookies
ingredients: 1 cup semolina | 2 yellow onions | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning ( mild or hot depending on desired level of spiciness ) | kosher salt & pepper, to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Chop onions into small pieces. Put semolina, onion, salt & pepper in a food processor and make a well in the center. Insert a fork in the well. Pulse 5 times. Form into 1 balls a few inches in diameter. Place onto a baking sheet and pat to a small, even circle. Bake 10 - 12 min at 425 degrees f or until light golden brown. Enjoy.

title: Carrots in Won Ton
ingredients: 24 peeled and grated carrots | 2 tablespoons grated gruyere cheese | 2 tablespoons ground basil or 2 tablespoons dry italian seasoning | 8 wonton wrappers
instructions: In a large bowl combine carrot, cheese and basil. Set aside. Place a won ton wrapper on a lightly floured board. Using your index finger or thumb, wet the edges of the wrapper and pinch the sides. Use a fork to press some holes into the won ton, about 2/3 cup in diameter. Sprinkle 2 tablespoons of filling into the hole. Moisten the edges of the won ton with water, fold over and seal the edges. Repeat with remaining wrappers and filling, making sure to do this three times. The won tons can now also be frozen on a tray lined with cling film and frozen in an airtight container at the end of the month.

title: Cashew Chicken
ingredients: 1/4 cup treacle | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour | 2 boneless, skinless chicken breast halves | 1 1/2 tablespoons tamari | 1/2 cup cashews, chopped
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Coat the chicken breasts generously with treacle, then coat with flour, and place in a 9x13 inch pan. Bake in the preheated oven until the crust is brown, about 20 minutes. While the chicken is baking, make the sauce by melting the tamari in a skillet over medium heat. Stir in the cashews.

title: Lori's Pork Mango Chutney
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs pork shoulder | 1/4 cup unsweetened buttermilk | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric or 1/2 teaspoon curry powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cumin powder | 1 teaspoon fresh rosemary, chopped | 1 teaspoon dried mango chutney | 1 1/2 cups frozen raspberries ( can use the juice or berries of your choice ) | 1 package prepared vanilla pudding mix, undiluted
instructions: Trim any visible fat of pork. Cube pork into bite sized cubes. Place pork in a large, nonreactive skillet. Sprinkle pork with spice mixture, pressing to adhere. Pour buttermilk over pork. Sprinkle turmeric and curry over pork. Seal and turn heat to low. After 5 minutes, increase heat to high. When a nice crust forms on top of pork, reduce heat to low. Cook uncovered 30 minutes, stirring every 15 to 30 minutes and removing lid as needed. When sauce is thick, stir in mango chutney. Let cook 10 minutes longer, stirring occasionally. Remove from heat. Sprinkle raspberries over pork and let stand 15 minutes. Then, garnish with fresh chutney.

instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place the broccoli florets into a pot, and bring water to boil. Boil for 2 to 3 minutes, or until tender. title: Calde-Salado Con Peruvian Stuffed Potatoes

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Cut the potatoes lengthwise, creating a rectangle. With your finger, poke one or two holes across the center and pull off each other, making a cross, then cut one or two slits down the length to form a hole with about 1/2 inch of room in the center. Boil potatoes uncovered for 4 minutes or until just tender. Drain and allow to cool slightly. Cut the chorizo into 1/2 inch thick slices. Cut each slice into about 4 pieces. Using your finger, poke a hole into the middle of each potato. Place the potato cut side down on an oiled baking sheet. In a small bowl, combine the salt, cilantro and oil, and set aside. In a large bow, combine the 1 1/4 teaspoons of yeast with 2 cups of cold water. Stir to dissolve. Dissolve the yeast in the water. Add the 5 - 3 tablespoons of the yeast mixture to the mashed potatoes. Beat until smooth and creamy. Place the potatoes on the greased baking sheet, cover with a towel and let rise for 10 - 15 minutes. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Drain potatoes, place on a baking sheet sprinkled with the other 1 1/4 teaspoons of yeast mixture. Sprinkle the 2 tablespoons of cilantro leaves on the potatoes. Bake in oven for 20 - 25 minutes until the tops are golden brown and crispy.. Remove from oven, garnish with cilantro, and serve warm.

title: Cheese-Stuffed Jalapenos

4 large jalapeno jack cheese ( about 6-7 slices ) | 4 -6 ounces cream of tartar | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 1/4 teaspoon cumin powder | 10 ounces pesto sauce | chili sauce ( i 'll try sriracha, tabasco with or without, you can find this in the vegan aisle.

instructions: Preheat broiler. Remove 1 piece of cheese from each jalapeño and using a vegetable peeler, remove the membrane and white membrane around the rind. title: The Best Sandwich in the World - Breadcrumb
ingredients: 2 slices white bread, crusts removed | 2 teaspoons finely diced habanero peppers ( from a 1 1/2 ounce bottle )
instructions: Cut a cross onto the top of the bread. With a butter knife, scrape the bottom layer of bread evenly into the bowl, trying to make a circle without tearing the bread. Fill the bowl with ice cold water and begin to soak the bread until the water is gone and the bread starts to soak up the bread. When the ice is melted, drain water from the bowl and put the bread onto a cutting board. Using long thin strokes, squeeze the bread with your hands until it becomes soft and moist. Take a knife and scrape the knife back in between your fingers. The bread should be very pliable. Squeeze the water out of the bread, if it is, into strands of rice cereal or corn chips, or onto waxed paper, to coat the bread. Repeat with remaining bread slices, placing them on a wire rack in a shallow pan or baking dish lined with wax paper. The cereal coating will keep the bread crisp for up to a week. To remove the coating, set a shallow pan of warm water on the stovetop. Place a handful of bread in the water so that each slice doesn't break and become crispy when the water is absorbed. When bread becomes crisp, place a second layer on top, pressing down slightly. Do not place a piece of bread on top of the first, as the cereal coating will continue to make it easier to remove. Dip both sides of the toast slices in the cereal coating, then place on a plate, covered with wax paper, so that the coating is not visible in the coating. If desired you can also drizzle some hot water over the top of the toast while dipping. The cereal coating can also be drizzled over the toast while it is still hot if desired.

title: Rice Paper Posole (Arroz DePosole)

instructions: Put 2 pints of cold water in a deep pot. Dice the chilies into julienne sized pieces or dice them to your liking. Add the posole and chiles to the water, and bring to a boil over medium heat. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook, covered, for about 10 minutes. Drain the posole in a strainer to get rid of any excess grease from the posole. Return the posole to the heat and bring to a rapid boil. Watch closely after about 20 minutes, just reaching the boiling point. If the water doesn't boil but the posole is mostly white, continue cooking. You want the posole to be tender, with very little activity of the white inner meat. Wrap a round piece of rice paper in several damp kitchen towels, and place one end of the paper around the circumference of the posole in the pot. Carefully pour a few ladles of posole over the rice paper. Tie the ends of the rice paper shut using kitchen twine. You can fold the pieces back together, or just lay them on top of each other. Be careful because of how much grease you will be able to squeeze out of the rice paper and posole after the 10 minutes. Bring to a boil, then lower heat and simmer for 20 to 30 minutes. Keep adding rice paper to the pot about every 10 minutes until the liquid in the pot is reduced by about 1/ take the posole out of the heat and place over medium heat. The rice paper should be puffy and limp. Slice up and serve. Remove & let cool slightly. Cut off the skin & place the potato in a bowl. Cover & set aside. Add 3 tablespoons of sugar to the eggplant liquid & toss gently to coat. Preheat grill to high heat. Put the eggplant chunks onto an oiled baking tray and cook at 150c for 15 minutes or until golden brown & firm. Set aside. Add 1 cup of water to the eggplant liquid & mix well, then set aside. To the remaining 2 tablespoons of water, add balsamic vinegar & seasonings & continue cooking for 2 - 3 minutes. Remove eggplant from oven & place on top of potato & meat. Serve immediately or cover & refrigerate for up to an hour.

title: Chicken and Beef Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs chuck steaks, cut into bite sized pieces | 1/2 cup coriander seed | 6 ounces chicken wings | 1 lb red potatoes, cut into small pieces | crusty bread
instructions: Dry fry corriander and chicken wings with just enough water to keep them from burning. Brown steak with coriander and chicken. Cook potato until tender. Drain on paper towel. Place beef on top of potatoes and pour the rest of the water into the pot. Cover and simmer for about 2 hours or until beef and potatoes are cooked and tender.

Place rice vinegar in a small, heavy, nonreactive bowl, and stir in chicken stock until dissolved. Place onion over top of chicken, and refrigerate while preparing other ingredients. When serving, ladle soup into bowls, and serve with sliced onion on top.

title: Easy Slow Cooker Philly Blueberry Beef
