instructions: Place chuck roast in crockpot, and scatter the green pepper, celery seed, and blueberries over. Season with salt. Cover, and cook on low setting for 10 hours or on high setting for 7 - 8 hours, or until meat and vegetables are tender. Remove roast from crockpot and shred with 2 forks. Place beef back in crockpot, and mix in cooked pasta. Cook on high setting for 20 minutes to thicken sauce.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,green chili pepper,thai red chili pepper,spearmint,clear honey,oregano leaf
title: Honey Spicy Oil Pickles
ingredients: 1 cup white peppercorn oil or 1 cup other neutral flavored oils | 1 1/3 cups warm red chili peppers, seeds and membrane removed, thinly sliced crosswise | 1/3 cup chopped italian parsley | 3 teaspoons dried oregano leaves | 1 teaspoon dried spearmint ( optional ) | 3 small thai red chili peppers, thinly sliced ( optional )
instructions: Fill a jar with the oil, seal and shake to combine. Using a small metal spoon, push the chillies, parsley, oregano, and spearmint into the oil. Fill the jar tightly with the hot pepper rings. Process the pickles briefly in the food processor, and transfer the jars to a baking dish, leaving behind any oil that collects at the top. Allow the pickles to mellow and flavor, 8 to 10 days. Refrigerate the jar, and process in a hot water bath for several hours.

Random Ingredients: lime zest,iceberg lettuce,lemon,cannellini bean,rock salt,madeira wine
title: Lemony Cannellini White Bean Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried cannellini beans, soaked in water overnight | 1 cup iceberg lettuce | 2 tablespoons madeira wine | 1 1/2 teaspoons rock salt ( optional ) | 1 lime, zest of | 1 lemon, juice of
instructions: Place the soaked beans with the water into a large saucepan and bring to a boil, making sure it doesn't break the shells. Simmer over low heat until just tender, about 30 minutes or so. Remove from the heat, drain, and set aside to cool. When cool, mix in the lettuce, madeira, rock salt, lime zest, and lemon juice.

Random Ingredients: wonton wrapper,almond extract,cane sugar,allspice,matzo meal,pinto bean,vanilla,molasses
title: Mosaicana Pintos
ingredients: 1 package dried pinto beans ( not browned yet ) | 1/2 cup matzo meal | 1/2 cup light molasses | 2 2 tablespoons allspice or 2 tablespoons ginger | 1 1/2 tablespoons cane sugar, granulated | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla | 1 teaspoon almond extract ( optional ) | 1/2 cup unbleached cane sugar ( optional ) | wonton wrapper, for wrapping ( or cornmeal )
instructions: Combine pinto beans, matzo meal, molasses, vanilla, sugar and almond extract. Rinse and drain. Wet wonton wrapper, just make sure the wrappers are dry and pliable. Place a small amount of the filling at a 1/3 1/2 inch margin of the wrapper. Roll up and seal the edges. Repeat with the rest until all filling is used up. Spray or oil cookie sheet and put the wrappers in it. Place the rolls on the cookie sheet. Dust with confectioner's sugar when ready to cook. Cook time is approximately 20 minutes. Serve warm or cold.

title: Spicy Sesame Seeds
ingredients: 2 bunches radishes, washed | 5 serrano chilies, chopped | 4 ounces white sesame seeds, ground | 1/4 cup dry sherry | 1 1/2 ounces adobo seasoning, with or 1 1/2 ounces adobo seasoning, plus more for seasoning
instructions: Place radish leaves and chiles in a large bowl, cover with cold water and let stand 30 to 45 minutes. Drain and rinse chiles and dry with paper towels. Dice chiles. In a small dry frying pan, toast sesame seeds over medium heat, shaking the pan continuously with a wooden spoon, until they are golden brown and fragrant, about 3 minutes. Transfer sesame seeds to a plate lined with paper towels to absorb excess oil. Cool sesame seeds slightly, then crush them with the flat of a large meat mallet until they are a fine powder. Transfer sesame seeds to a large mortar and pestle or spice grinder and grind very fine. Transfer sesame oil to a small saucepan and bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Add the ground sesame powder and cook for 30 seconds. Using a candy thermometer, remove from heat and use to stir once or twice. To store the sesame powder, put 2 to 4 tablespoons in an airtight glass dish at room temperature for up to 4 to 6 months. To store, store in an airtight plastic bag for up to 4 weeks.

title: Blackberry Mushrooms With Coffee Sweetened toffee
ingredients: 6 cremini mushrooms, sliced in half longways, caps removed | 6 tablespoons dark-roasted ground whole almonds or 6 tablespoons roasted walnuts ( a little over 1 cup ) | 10 cardamom seeds ( slightly crushed ) | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste ( adjust to taste ) | 1 tablespoon ground blackbermese sweet dessert spices ( try hymett's coffee spice, or try my keens comfort food chili spice blend ) | 1/2 cup blackberry ( blackberries, or cherries ) | 1/4 cup semisweet chocolate, chopped
instructions: Melt 2 tablespoons of the groundnut in a small dry skillet set over medium low heat. Add 6 tablespoons of ground almonds or ground hazelnuts and stir until evenly combined. Remove from heat. In a small skillet set over low medium heat, melt 1/4 cup of dark roasted whole almonds or whole hazelnuts. Stir frequently until almonds turn a darker golden brown color, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat. In a small skillet set over medium low to medium hot, melt ginger garlic paste, one tablespoon at a time, until just brown, about 45 seconds. Stir in ground black pepper. Add almonds or ground hazelnuts, stir briefly, and remove from heat. Spread mixture in a shallow dish or platter and refrigerate, stirring occasionally until hardened. Melt remaining 2 tablespoons of groundnut. Remove and allow to cool slightly. Line the bottom of a small metal coffee mug with half of your choice of soft dark chocolate. Sprinkle the cracked blackberries or blackberries over the chocolate. Sprinkle sweetened toffee powder on top of blackberries. Place mushrooms on top of chocolate. Microwave on high power until hot, 1 minute. Remove from microwave and stir in 1/4 cup of dark ground almonds or hazelnuts. Gently pour blackberry mixture into the mug. Fill the mug with blackberry liquid, and fold gently. Using a spatula, fold together the rest of your mixture and the hot coffee. Allow mixture to cool to room temperature. Note, you may have to do this in batches, depending on how strong your coffee is.

title: Wild Mushroom Soup
ingredients: 1 1/2 liters chicken stock | 200 g wild mushrooms
instructions: Put all the ingredients into an ovenproof pan, place in a gentle oven for approx 2 hours at 220 degrees centigrade. Strain out the mushrooms, and leave them to cool slightly before serving.

title: Lettuce Wrapped Pork Liver
ingredients: 1 fresh pork liver, cleaned and thickly sliced | 1 tablespoon butter or 1 tablespoon ghee | 1/4 teaspoon crushed cardamom pod | 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano | 6 leaves lettuce | 1/4 cup corn oil or 1/4 cup olive oil
instructions: Heat a grill pan. In a small skillet, melt butter and fry cardamom and oregano. Place livers on the grill rack and drizzle with the oil. Fry, turning once, until brown and cooked through, 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Easy, No-Cook, Cheese Farfalle
ingredients: 1 box farfalle pasta | 6 tablespoons butter | 1 package sharp cheddar cheese, shredded
instructions: Cook farfalle at least 15 minutes so it doesn't get dry.

title: Tunisian Peppers
ingredients: 3 red bell peppers | 1 tablespoon herbs | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder | 1/2 teaspoon mexican oregano
instructions: Roast peppers. Chop tops and seeds from the peppers and cut into strips. Combine herbs and 1/4 tsp of the coriander in a small bowl and add the oregano. Place peppers in a plastic bag and add the herbs/seasoning mix. Shake well. Roast at 350°f or 180°c, turning frequently, for about 15 - 20 minutes or until the peppers begin to blacken, crisp and roasted. Serve with pita chips, or as a dip with pita bread.

title: Peppered Walnuts and Bacon
ingredients: 1/2 cucumber | 1/8 lb pepperoni | 1/16 cup capers | 1/4 - 1/2 cup walnut, rough chopped
instructions: Cut the cucumber lengthwise. Remove the pith. Slice the cucumber crosswise into thin rounds, removing any fibers that float to the top. Arrange the bell pepper slices on a parchment paper lined baking sheet. Top half of the sliced cucumber with bacon pieces. Sprinkle with the pepperoni, capers and nuts. If desired, place the remaining slices of cucumber across the top, as the bacon may be very salty. Preheat the oven to 325 degrees. Bake for about 45 minutes, until the bacon is crisp and the walnuts are softened.

title: Taco Seasoning III
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cumin powder | 1 teaspoon habanero pepper | 1 jar salsa con queso
instructions: Mix ground cumin powder and habanero pepper in a mixing bowl. Slowly add salsa con queso, mixing until all ingredients are incorporated. Store in a tightly sealed, recycled bottle or jar. This recipe keeps up to 6 months, in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,ancho chilies,rosemary,asafoetida powder,flat leaf parsley
title: Sauce for Salads and Chicken

instructions: Heat a small dry frying pan over high heat, toast the ancho chilies and chiles lightly in the pan. This may take up to 10 minutes, depending on the type of chiles used. Place the chile puree in a bowl and add the asafoetida. Blend the mixture until the mixture is smooth. Add the chopped parsley and mix well. Refrigerate until serving time.

title: Beef Spanish Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 package baby finger steaks, cut crosswise into 3 inch pieces ( trimmed of excess fat and excess fat ) | 1 lb medium firm fresh tomatillo, husked, rinsed, and coarsely chopped | 1 large red leaf lettuce, finely shredded | 12 ounces fresh cremini mushrooms, trimmed and thinly sliced | 6 large red potatoes, quartered | 1 green cabbage, quartered lengthwise, cored, and cut into 1/8ths | 3/4 cup short-grain white rice, rinsed | 6 ounces fresh green cabbage, cut into 1/8ths ( about 1 1/2 pounds ) | 3 pints small-size rotisserie-cooked beef brisket ( about 3 lbs )
instructions: Prepare dressing. If you wish, place onion and tomatoes in a large bowl. Toss lightly with 1/4 cup water. Add lettuce, mushrooms, cabbage, and rice. title: Moroccan Spiced Turkey Stuffing

instructions: Soak rice in cold water for 20 minutes. Add all ingredients except salt and vinegar to rice in heavy pot, stir until moist. Cover over low heat and bring to a boil. Cook over low heat, uncovered, until most of liquid is absorbed, about 15 minutes, then remove from heat and let cool, covered, until lukewarm.. Can be stored overnight. Bring to room temperature before using.

title: Vegetable Pies

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Place the potatoes in a large pot and cover with water. Place the mixed vegetables into a large bowl and stir in the potatoes. Place a mussel in the pan and remove only the shell that has opened. Scrape the meat from the shell into the vegetables. Poke the shells with a fork or skewer. Place onto the prepared baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until the potatoes are soft, about 45 minutes.

instructions: In a large skillet over medium heat, saute the chorizo with 3 tbsp of stock until lightly browned. You should now have about 2 dozen chunks. Remove from pan and set aside. title: Garlicky Citrus Slaw (Vegan-Friendly Raw Food)

Serve immediately with grated lime rind on the side.

title: Spicy Bananas

instructions: Preheat broiler to high. Place banana chunks on baking sheet. Broil 2 - 3 minutes, flipping once, until golden brown but still slightly crisp. title: Baked Rigatoni With rosemary and caster sugar
ingredients: 450 g rigatoni pasta | 1 tablespoon rosemary, chopped | 3 tablespoons caster sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 c, gas mark boil the rigatoni in plenty of boiling salted water until al dente. Drain and toss into a bowl. Add rosemary, caster sugar and rosemary to the drained rigatoni. Toss again. Transfer to a baking tray and bake for 40 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Baked Beef Pot Roast (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 4 -5 lbs beef chuck roast, trimmed | 1 package vanilla instant pudding mix | 1 can soymilk ( or almond milk ) | 8 small new potatoes, cut into quarters | 2 teaspoons lemon grass, chopped | 1/3 cup brown sugar | 1/2 teaspoon dried coriander seed
instructions: Combine everything together, in a large bowl. Marinate overnight or for at least 4 hrs in the freezer. Preheat the oven to 300°f. Place beef roast in a 6 quart crock pot. Remove beef from the crock pot, remove foil, and serve.

instructions: To prepare sauce, combine the salt, apple juice, wine, enchilada sauce and sausage in a skillet. Cover and cook over low heat for 15 minutes or until cheese is melted and mixture has bubbled. Stir in the spinach and chiles. Serve over hot cooked pasta of your choice.

title: Stir-Fried Bok Choy (Or Green Beans) With Cinnamon

instructions: Steam or steam the bok choy or green beans over a steamer basket for 2 - 3 minutes or until just soft. In a large shallow bowl, combine all ingredients until well mixed. Add the mixture to the bowl, tossing to coat evenly. Serve warm or at room temperature.

ingredients: 4 zucchini, cut lengthwise into 1/2-inch slices | kosher salt to taste | 1 1/2 tablespoons hot sauce, or as desired
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Stir zucchini slices with salt in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: plantain,spanish rice,bok choy,pecorino romano cheese,mango chutney
title: Yummy Mango Chutney Spiced Vegetable Rice
ingredients: 1/3 cup spanish rice or 1/3 cup arborio rice | 10 ounces plantains, peeled and cut into small peices | 3 tablespoons mango chutney | 2 tablespoons grated pecorino romano cheese | 1 large plantain, peeled and cut into 1-inch slices
instructions: Cook rice with fruit in a 2 qt saucepan for 15 minutes or until liquid is absorbed. Set aside. Drain rice, reserving juice. Heat grill. If using bamboo skewers, soak in water for 2 hours or broil 3 - 5 minutes each side, turning occasionally. Drain and set aside. If using wooden skewers, soak in water 30 - 60 minutes before using. If using bamboo skewers, soak in water 30 - 60 minutes before using. If using bamboo skewers, soak in water 30 - 60 minutes before using. If using wooden skewers, soak in water 30 - 60 minutes before using. If using bamboo skewers, soak in water 30 - 60 minutes before using. The rice and fruit should be tender. Serve warm or cool and serve.

title: Roasted Cabbage
ingredients: 1 large head outer cabbage | 2 cans low sodium beef broth | 2 tablespoons prepared pesto sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f cut outer cabbage to make a uniform sized crown shape, or about 3 1/2 square. Place cabbage crown on rack in roasting pan and roast for approximately 25 minutes. Turn the crown over and roast for another 25 minutes or until cabbage becomes brown. Meanwhile, bring beef broth to simmer on stove and stir in pesto. Slice cabbage into thin slices and spoon hot broth onto them. Return to oven and bake for another 15 minutes or until heated throughout. Serve warm.

title: The Gold!
ingredients: 8 red chile peppers | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice, or as needed | 1 teaspoon peppermint extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Pulse the dried red chile peppers in a food processor until finely chopped. Transfer to a medium bowl, and stir in lime juice, peppermint extract, and hot peppermint extract. Serve, or chill and serve as an accompaniment to fish, chicken, and vegetables.

Random Ingredients: lemongrass,lemon juice,beef consomme,asian chili sauce,cilantro leaf,currant
title: Lemongrass Beef Gravy

instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large saucepan and stir to blend. Bring to a boil and adjust seasonings. Note, you may also use fresh lemongrass with a hint of raw smell and some of the curry powder. You may also use ginger, garlic, celery root if desired.

title: Cuban Black Bread Soup
ingredients: 1 cup black-eyed peas | 32 ounces hominy, drained | 10 1/4 ounces picante sauce | 1 loaf rye bread
instructions: Place the beans in a slow cooker. Mix in the hominy, picante sauce and a little water. Cover and heat on low for 5 hours, or on high for 2 1/2 hours. Serve in soup bowls and top with a few slices of rye bread to dip.

title: Pear Pizza
ingredients: 2 pears, cores removed and coarsely chopped | 150 ml commercial pizza sauce | 1 teaspoon tomato puree, or to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 190 degrees centigrade. In a small pan, saute the pears in the pizza sauce until heated through. Gently stir in the tomato puree until well incorporated and pour into ovenproof serving dish. Place under medium heat and cook for 10 to 15 minutes, until it begins to bubble, shaking the pan regularly as the pears cook. If you prefer a crispy outer skin, transfer to a plate and allow to get crisp back up. Allow to cool slightly before cutting into pieces.

title: Potted Berry Pudding
ingredients: 4 lbs ripe strawberries, cleaned and hulled | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice
instructions: Cut strawberries in half and place in a clean mixing bowl. Sprinkle allspice on top. Cover with plastic wrap and let sit in the fridge for 3 days. After that day, remove plastic wrap and discard. Rinse with cold water, dry and divide berries into cups. Serve cold.

title: Sage and Onion Purée
ingredients: 450 g purple onions ( peeled ) | 450 g fresh sage leaves
instructions: Wash onions thoroughly. Put the onions in a clean casserole dish. Cover, and leave in a cool place for 90 minutes. Uncover, and put another small dish underneath the onions, and a knife on to the base so that the juices get into the onion. Take a sieve and drain the onions. Put them in a blender, and mix with the sage leaves and purée until thoroughly smooth. If it seems too thick, thin with an equal amount of milk or water. If it looks too thin, add some more purée. Taste and season as necessary.

Random Ingredients: bread flour,red kidney bean,fennel seed,onion soup mix,crouton,silken tofu
title: Vegan French Onion Soup
ingredients: 1 package onion soup mix ( dry ) | 1 tablespoon fennel seed | 1 can red kidney beans, drained | 2 cans creamed silken tofu | 1 cup seasoned bread flour, for dusting | crouton, for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. On a cookie sheet lined with parchment paper, combine soup mix, fennel seeds, kidney beans, tofu and seasoned bread flour until thoroughly mixed. Drop mixture into oven and bake, uncovered, for 30 minutes or until thick and bubbly. Top soup with croutons and enjoy.

title: Pumpkin and New Potatoes With Vanilla
ingredients: 6 -7 new potatoes, peeled and halved | 3 tablespoons mashed pumpkin ( i use plain pumpkin and milk pud that's in the bakery aisle at publix ) or 3 tablespoons vanilla frosting ( i use plain pumpkin and milk pud that's in the bakery aisle at publix ) | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Slice potatoes about 1 1/2 inch thick. Place potatoes in a bowl. Set aside. In a small bowl, combine pumpkin, vanilla and the pumpkin mixture. Beat with mixer for 10 - 15 seconds on medium. Add pumpkin mixture, potatoes and stir. Heat a nonstick fry pan over medium high heat. Pour in enough pumpkin and pumpkin mixture to just coat the surface. Stir fry until potatoes are browned, 1 - 2 minutes. Remove from heat and toss with a 1/2 tsp crumbled goat cheese for toppings.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,seasoning salt,matzo meal,mung bean,cream cheese
title: Liangban Hu Kho (Mung Bean Nuggets)
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 cup mung bean ( soaked overnight ) | 1 tablespoon cream cheese | 2/3 cup matzo meal | seasoning salt
instructions: Spread the bean pods on a cookie sheet and refrigerate for 4 hours or overnight. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Spray a baking sheet with vegetable spray. Spread the mung beans on a paper towel. Bring to a boil and then reduce heat. Simmer for 10 minutes until tender and fluffy. Spray the mung beans with vegetable spray and spread on an additional sheet of paper towels. Mix cream cheese with a tablespoon of water and add to the noodles in the saucepan. Pour the noodles evenly over noodles and season with salt. Spread noodle mixture over the noodle layer and bake for 20 minutes or until hot and browned.

title: Cottage Cheese with Dill
ingredients: 4 ounces cottage cheese | 1 spring onion, finely chopped | 2 -3 tablespoons dill, chopped fresh | extra oyster sauce, to taste
instructions: Place cottage cheese, spring onion, dill and extra oyster sauce in a bowl, mix well then serve immediately. The dish can also be prepared in 2 to 4 batches, depending on how you like your dish and how deep it is.

Random Ingredients: coriander,heavy cream,wild rice,coriander powder,chick pea,malt vinegar
title: Cha-Chick Peas and Wild Rice
ingredients: 1 tablespoon coriander mixed spice ( sharwoods ) | 1/2 tablespoon malt vinegar | 1 cup heavy cream | 1 cup cooked wild rice | 1 can canned chick's peas, drained | 1/4 cup fresh coriander, chopped
instructions: Combine coriander spice, basting mixture and milk in a small saucepan. Heat gently, stirring occasionally, until butter has melted, but do not boil. Add cream and heat through. Cook rice according to directions. Add peas and coriander to rice. Serve immediately.

title: Artichauts With White Chocolate
ingredients: 16 white chocolate wafers ( squares ) | 1 1/4 cups margarine | 1/2 cup harissa ( or red hot sauce ) | 2 cans artichoke hearts, drained and rinsed well | 2 teaspoons pure vanilla beans, scraped or 2 teaspoons pure vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Combine chocolates, harissa, and the artichoke hearts. Place a sheet of waxed paper under the waxed paper and lightly press mixture into the paper. Bake about 30 minutes until the mixture is light and golden. Remove from oven and let cool. Use the waxed paper as a fondue mold and dip the fondue mold into warm, dark chocolate for dipping.

title: Smoky Roast Chicken
ingredients:
1 roasting chicken ( approx.
    - 7lb ) | 1/2 cup liquid smoke, preferably packed ( smokey type, such as mesquite smoke )
instructions: Make a double broiler or light an oven, set at 425 degrees f. Remove the chicken from the bone. Place the chicken in a large roasting pan and brush it with the glaze. Cover the chicken loosely with foil. Place in a roasting pan that you have sprayed or sprayed with cooking spray and allow it to sweat or warm in the oven. Check it often, and remove any trusses that the chicken hangs easily under your skin. The chicken legs may also be removed loosely over the skin. If needed, tent with foil to keep them submerged in the drippings. Allow the chicken to cool, then refrigerate at least overnight, stirring from time to time. The next day, remove the foil, and bake uncovered at 425 degrees f for 30 to 40 minutes, or until the juices run clear and the chicken is cooked thoroughly. Let the chicken rest for 10 to 20 minutes before carving.

Random Ingredients: onion,madeira wine,sparerib,guinness stout,orange juice zest,baby portabella mushroom
title: Madeira Spareribs
ingredients: 1/4 cup guinness stout | 250 g baby portabella mushrooms | 1 onion, cut into wedges | 1 orange, juice and zest of | 750 -750 ml madeira wine | 1 -2 kg spareribs ( to sear )
instructions: Preparation time does not include marinating time. First boil baby portabella mushrooms, remove stems and discard. Slice mushrooms and onion and put into a large pot. Add guinness. Add orange zest, juice, madeira and sugar. Cover and bring to a boil, stirring occasionally. Lower heat, simmer for 1 hour, stirring occasionally. Transfer to oven proof casserole lined with aluminium foil or baking paper. Bake at 180 degrees celsius for 1 hour 30 minutes, stirring every 10 minutes or so. Let stand for 10 minutes before turning onto serving plate. Serve with steamed white rice.

Random Ingredients: chocolate pudding mix,corn niblets,crown royal whiskey,spinach leaf,rye bread,broth,salmon,ginger powder
title: Royal Salmon Florentine Sandwich
ingredients: 4 ounces instant chocolate pudding mix | 1 cup low-fat steaming broth ( water may be substituted ) | 4 ounces rye bread, sliced | 1/4 teaspoon ginger powder | 1 package frozen spinach leaves, defrosted | 14 ounces salmon, drained | 4 ounces corned beef or 4 ounces salton | 2 tablespoons crown royal whiskey
instructions: In a large bowl, combine pudding mix and steaming broth. Mix well. Toast rye bread for 10 minutes. Spread with butter if you like.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chile pepper,kaffir lime leaf
title: Fresh Tomato Green Chile Salsa
ingredients: 1 can stewed tomatoes with green chile peppers | 3 kaffir lime leaves, crushed
instructions: Place the chopped tomatoes into a bowl, and pour hot water over the to just cover. Allow to sit for about 30 minutes to let the juices to drain. Place the lime leaves into a blender, and fill with hot water to cover. When the mixture begins to boil, remove from the heat, and set aside. Mix once more and serve.

title: Somali - Mursiter
ingredients: 3 lbs sirloin | 1 lb fresh sliced strawberries | 1 lb fresh sliced mango | 1 lb fresh sliced sirloin | paprika
instructions: In a food processor, purée all the ingredients except for the meat and garnish. Rub the mixture evenly into a shallow baking tin. Place into a slow oven, 325 degrees. Bake for at least 15 minutes or until the meat is cooked. Serve with boiled new potatoes or rice.

title: Catfish on Cream
ingredients: 1 package catfish fillets, thawed | 2 tablespoons sour cream
instructions: Lightly coat the inside of a 9x13 inch pan with a light coating of cooking spray. Lay the fillets into the pan, in a flat layer. Sprinkle with the sour cream. Chill for 2 to 4 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,topping,jalapeno pepper,russet potato,chili pepper flake,lamb
title: Lamb and Potato (Tarkari) Stew
ingredients:
2 1/2 lbs lean lamb, trimmed and cut crosswise into 1-inch-thick slices | 4 medium russet potatoes, peeled, cut into 1-in.
    - chunks | 1 medium fresh jalapeno pepper, stems trimmed | 2 small dried chili pepper flakes | 1 1/2 teaspoons green cardamom pods | topping ( optional ) | bottled fat-free cocktail sweetened chili oil ( optional ) or canned jalapeno pepper sauce ( optional )
instructions: Pat lamb dry with paper towels. Layer lamb and potatoes in a 3 to 4 quart slow cooker. Sprinkle with salt, breaking meat into small chunks. Scatter pepper flakes over meat, dividing evenly. Add enough water to barely cover ingredients. Cook, covered, on low for 5 1/2 to 6 hours. Skim off excess moisture with a spoon. Ladle off any fat and discard. If desired, serve with thin slices of tomato and fresh chutney. Serve with dipping sauce for dipping.

title: Stuffed Beef
ingredients: 3 1/2 lbs thinly-sliced beef chuck | 3/4 ounce crumbled feta cheese | 1/2 teaspoon anise extract
instructions: Combine beef, feta cheese and a pinch of anise extract in a small bowl. Spoon beef mixture into a 1 quart casserole dish. Bake in a preheated 375º oven for 1 hour. Serve hot with bread.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,corn oil,dark brown sugar,arborio rice,red chile,garbanzo bean,brown sugar,cream cheese
title: Chile and Garbanzo Stew
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs boneless beef chuck, trimmed of excess fat, cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes | 1 can garbanzo beans, liquid reserved | 1 teaspoon dark brown sugar | 2/3 cup warm cream cheese, softened | 1/4 cup brown sugar, packed | 1 teaspoon red chile, minced | 1 teaspoon corn oil | 2 cups arborio rice or 2 cups carnarola rice | 2 teaspoons dark brown sugar, packed | 1 teaspoon red chile, minced
instructions: Place the chuck cubes in a 6 quart dutch oven. Combine the reserved bean liquid with 1 teaspoon of brown sugar in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Add the remaining 1 1/2 cups bean liquid, the cream cheese, brown sugar, 1 teaspoon of red chile and 1 teaspoon of corn oil.

title: Cabbage Tea Sandwich
ingredients: 1 small cabbage, shredded | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla | 4 -6 slices white bread cubes ( thick, soft breads ) | 2 teaspoons chives, finely chopped
instructions: Place shredded cabbage in a blender or food processor with one cup water. Puree to desired consistency.

title: Nif's Macaroni Grill Mushroom Appetizer
ingredients: 1 box large shell pasta, cooked and drained | 3 1/2 - 4 ounces button mushrooms, drained | 1 jar jam, of your choice
instructions: Cook the pasta as directed. While the pasta is cooking, slice up mushrooms and mix together the mushrooms with the pasta. You don't want them mushy, so you may need a little more to moisten everything. Add the jam to the mixture the last 2 minutes of cooking. Pour onto a greased baking dish, about 3 1/2 cups, and bake at 350f degrees for 15 - 20 minutes, or until bubbly around the edges.

Random Ingredients: matzo meal,orange flower water,lower salt taco seasoning mix,pineapple juice,salt pork,cocoa powder,vanilla essence
title: Tropical Passover Lasagna Dessert
ingredients: 1 lb salt pork or 1 lb ground beef | 4 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 2 tablespoons lower-salt taco seasoning mix ( i use la choy brand ) | 2 teaspoons vanilla essence | 2 teaspoons orange flower water | 3/4 cup pineapple juice | 2 teaspoons raw matzo meal, divided | 2 teaspoons orange flower water
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Line a 15 x 10 x 1 jelly roll pan with parchment. To make salsa croutons, cut salt pork into small dice. In a mixing bowl, combine pork, cocoa powder, taco seasoning mix, vanilla and orange flower water. Shape meat mixture into 2 balls, then spread evenly in prepared pan. Bake 30 minutes or until golden brown. In a small mixing bowl, combine 2 teaspoons matzoh meal, 2 teaspoons orange flower water, 2 teaspoons orange flower water & 2 teaspoons cocoa mixture. Serve warm with remaining salsa croutons.

Random Ingredients: chocolate ice cream,garam masala,celery rib,black olive,red cabbage,mascarpone cheese,romano cheese,apple jelly
title: Moroccan Cabbage Salad
ingredients: 1 small red cabbage | 1 can sliced black olives, drained and patted dry with paper towels | 1 celery rib, sliced thinly | 1 tablespoon mascarpone cheese, crumbled | 2 teaspoons apple jelly | 1/4 teaspoon garam masala | 3/4 cup romano cheese, grated | chocolate ice cream
instructions: Combine cabbage, olives, celery and cheese in a large bowl. Combine jelly, garam masala and cheese and drizzle over salad. Toss well to coat. Chill at least 4 hours or up to 2 days.

Random Ingredients: vanilla sugar,chicken bouillon granule,blade steak,grand marnier,white vinegar,ice water,white sugar,iceberg lettuce
title: Sweet Beef Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs blade steaks, cut into thin strips | 8 heads iceberg lettuce, finely shredded ( one big head ) | 2 cups ice water | 1/2 cup white sugar | 1/2 cup white vinegar | 1/4 cup grand marnier | 2 tablespoons vanilla sugar | 2 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon granules
instructions: Place the steaks between sheets of plastic wrap and pound to 1/4 inch thick. Cover and refrigerate 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. In a deep, heavy pot, bring the ice water, sugar, vinegar, grand marnier, vanilla sugar and chicken powder to a boil over medium heat. Add shredded lettuce to the boiling water and continue cooking 5 minutes, or until the mixture is syrupy. Remove the pan from the heat and add the hot syrup. Place 1 heaping tablespoon of the lettuce into each lettuce leaf. Roll up and put in a freezer safe container. Repeat with the remaining leaves. Serve hot.

title: Steamed Blueberry Tilapia
ingredients: 4 ounces baby portabella mushrooms, cut vertically into 1/4 inch slices | 3/4 cup light evaporated milk | 1/2 - 1 cup fresh blueberries ( or red wine vinegar ) | 4 ounces chilled tilapia fillets, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 1/4 cup whole berry baby spinach leaves
instructions: Bring 4 cups water to a boil in a skillet over high heat. Add mushrooms and cook 1 to 2 minutes, or until tender but still very slightly firm. Drain well. In a bowl, stir together the milk and eggs. Dip each piece of fish in milk and egg, then coat with berry baby spinach. Transfer to a steamer basket, cover and steam over simmering water 5 - 10 minutes, or until fish are cooked through. Remove and serve with hot cooked greens and/or vegetables.

Random Ingredients: baking potato,leek,cream mushroom soup,arugula,chicken stock cube,molasses,strawberry
title: Strawberry Roulades
ingredients: 1 small leek, chopped | 500 g baby baking potatoes, sliced | 150 g canned cream of mushroom soup, undiluted | 200 g natural strawberries, hulled, cut in half | 3 cans chicken stock cubes | 1 tablespoon molasses | 3 cups arugula
instructions: Place leek in non stick pan with half the water. Bring to boil, cover and turn off the heat. Leave for 10 minutes. Remove leek and place in food processes. Add cream of mushroom soup, strawberries and stock to pan. Heat mixture until boiling, stir vigorously. Turn off heat, and allow to stand for 1 hour in a cool spot. Remove roulades from pan and keep warm and drain off the liquid. Pour 1/3 of the mixture into ovenproof ramekins. Arrange in ramekins into a steamer around the ramekins. Place filled ramekins into a larger pan of boiling water. Cover, turn the heat to medium and steam for 15 to 20 minutes until tender and creamy. Place in a serving dish and chill for 5 minutes. Remove roulades from water. Add to ramekins and chill for 1 hour. Just before serving, place arugula in a salad bowl. Dip roulades into warm roulade, serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: rose water,taco seasoning mix,cranberry juice concentrate,kosher salt black pepper,italian sausage,graham cracker crumb
title: Chef John's Famous Cranberry Stuffed Roasted Sausages
ingredients: 4 italian sausages | 1 packet taco seasoning mix | 2/3 cup cranberry juice concentrate, can ( or 2/3 cup liquid concentrate or water, or frozen ) | 1/4 cup kosher salt, plus more for sprinkling | fresh rose water, for drizzling ( optional ) | crushed graham cracker crumbs, for topping ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly oil a rimmed baking sheet with cooking spray. Cut the sausages in half lengthwise and gently separate the halves into halves. Set the sausage halves aside. In a bowl whisk the taco seasoning mix, cranberry juice concentrate or liquid concentrate, salt, and rose water together until well blended. Spoon 1/4 cup of mixture into the center of each sausage half. Dip both sides of each sausage half into crushed graham cracker crumbs, then press some crumbs onto each sausage half to coat well. Arrange sausage halves onto baking sheet and season with kosher salt and pepper if desired. Bake in the preheated oven until internal temperature measures 160 degrees f, about 45 minutes.

title: Pimiento Cheese Rollups
ingredients: 1 jar roasted pimiento, chopped | 1/4 cup grated asiago cheese | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne, or to taste | 2 tablespoons ice water | 2 tablespoons beef gravy
instructions: Preheat oven according to package directions. Pulse ground pimientos, asiago cheese, and cayenne pepper in a blender until almost smooth, but not liquefied, 15 to 20 seconds. Blend in ice water until dough is smooth and well mixed. Roll dough into long, 1 inch wide logs, and place on baking sheets in a single layer. Bake in the preheated oven until the internal temperature reaches 130 degrees f and the edges are slightly golden brown, 10 to 15 minutes. Let cool to room temperature before slicing into 1/2 inch wide slices from the log.

title: Coriander & Orange Butter on English Muffins
ingredients: 1/2 cup corn oil | 1 teaspoon orange zest, zested, finely grated ( fresh would be ideal ) | 200 g white american cheese, sliced thinly | 1/3 cup fresh coriander, chopped
instructions: Pre heat oven to 190c/375°f. Mix oil and zest of orange zest in a small bowl. Toss cheese with oil, then add to cheese mixture. Stir well. Spread butter mixture evenly onto 12 muffin tins. Sprinkle with finely chopped coriander. Bake in oven for 20 minutes or until well risen and lightly browned. Serve warm or lukewarm.

Random Ingredients: brown lentil,red pepper flake,jalapeno pepper,graham cracker crumb,purpose flour,chicken,apple juice
title: Lentils With Apple-Chipotle Chicken
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups brown lentils, rinsed and picked over | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1 package shredded cooked chicken | 3 apples, cored and grated | 1 tablespoon chopped pickled jalapeno peppers | 1 1/2 teaspoons crushed red pepper flakes | 1/2 cup ice-cold graham cracker crumbs | 3 tablespoons apple juice
instructions: Place drained brown lentils in a strainer.

title: Miso and Spiced Plantain Cheese Bake
ingredients: 2 medium plantains, cut lengthways into half moons | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 180 g havarti cheese or 180 g other goat cheese | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 100 ml cream | 1 small bunch basil | 2 tablespoons white miso | 125 ml almond milk
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c /180°f. Grease a baking dish with olive oil or sunflower oil spray. Combine all ingredients in a large bowl and mix with a wooden spoon, adding milk if required. Spread onto the prepared dish and spread to cover. Bake at 200c /180c for 45 to 60 minutes or until set. Serve with a tossed salad and crisp greens.

title: Swedish Roast Chicken
ingredients: 1 whole roast small steak | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 teaspoon orange peel, grated
instructions: Sprinkle roast with cream of tartar. Let rest for 30 to 40 minutes. Preheat oven to 300f degrees. Place 1 tablespoon grated orange peel into center of breast of chicken. Cook the outside of the breast until well browned. Place the breast of chicken breast into a roasting pan and place meat in oven. Cover, and cook in the oven for 1 hour, or until tender.

title: Grilled Flank Steak
ingredients: 2 beef flank steak at least 2 inches thick | 4 teaspoons chinese five spice powder | 2 teaspoons cocoa | 8 ounces picante sauce
instructions: Brush a grill basket with oil and coat the inside of the basket with a thin layer of oil. Place the meat on the grate over medium, close lid, and cook for 3 - 4 minutes per side, or to your liking, but be careful not to burn the beef when it starts to flake as it cooks. Remove from grill and allow to rest for 5 minutes before slicing against the grain.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,green bean,almond meal,cumin powder,taco seasoning mix
title: Spanish Green Beans (Beans)
ingredients:
1 lb fresh green beans ( or frozen if you like ) | 1/4 cup almond meal | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil ( you can substitute the olive oil and some of the almond meal.
    - ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons taco seasoning mix | 1 teaspoon ground cumin powder
instructions: Snap off ends of the green beans, make as many as you can with a knife or potato peeler, if desired, and throw away any tough ones. Toss in a bowl with enough of any remaining vegetables to be lightly coated with the oil. Stir in the rest of the ingredients and mix to coat everything. Note, the oil can be bought at any good grocery store. It will be good to substitute some of any seasonings for the taco seasoning. Let rest for an hour before serving or put on it the possibilities are endless and you can serve it as is or with tortilla chips or with any other mexican meal that is on sandwiches etc. A little goes a long way too, or you can leave the beans on, eat them whatever you like to dip, and if i'm in a hurry, add something like a quick cheese dip or sour cream just a few minutes before serving.

title: Roasted Sautéed Peppers
ingredients: 8 large yellow peppers | 1 teaspoon lime zest
instructions: Preheat an oven to 200 degrees f. Place the yellow peppers in a roasting pan. Drizzle with olive oil, and sprinkle over lime zest. Bake in the preheated oven for 30 minutes, then turn the peppers over, and bake for an additional 30 minutes, or until the peppers are tender.

title: Grilled Zucchini With Balsamic Sauce
ingredients: 3 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 6 medium zucchini, 1-1/2-3/4-inch thick ( about 1 1/2 pounds ) | 3 tablespoons light spike spice | 1 1/2 teaspoons balsamic vinegar | 1/2 tsp dried mixed spice | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 8 ounces pesto sauce, drained | grated pecorino cheese ( optional )
instructions: In a shallow dish, stir together the vinegar and spike spice. Trim zucchini ends with vegetable peeler, cutting off the ends as necessary. Sprinkle a bit of the spice mixture and a bit of spike on the zucchini slices. Cover the zucchini with the marinade, marinate in the refrigerator for 10 minutes, turning once. Preheat an outdoor grill to high heat. Oil the grate. When the grill is heating, oil the coals for the grill. Turn off the heat when the zucchini are just tender. Brush the grill with a little bit of the vinaigrette, leaving about 1 tablespoon in the skillet. Sprinkle in the pesto. Place the zucchini grilled on the grill alongside the pesto, balsamic sauce and cheese. Close the lid of the grill and allow the zucchini to cook for 4 minutes, turning once.

Random Ingredients: seasoning salt,white pepper,pork chop,kitchen bouquet,tomato green chilies,cooking spray,spinach leaf,sugar
title: Chorizo and Spinach Pork Chops(Paula Deen)
ingredients: 4 pork chops | cooking spray | 1 pinch sugar | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 1 can diced tomatoes and green chilies, drained | 8 ounces fresh spinach leaves, chopped, drained | kitchen bouquet ( optional )
instructions: Spray a 10x6 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Place pork chops in a single layer in hot dish, making sure that the chops are not touching but not breaking apart. Sprinkle pork with sugar, seasoned salt, white pepper, diced tomatoes, and green chilies. Bake uncovered at 300f for about 1 1/2 hours or until pork slices are tender and juices from meat run clear. Serve over cooked rice.

title: A Very Simple Flank Steak
ingredients: 1 boneless beef brisket, sliced | spicy tomato soup, with onion garlic & parsley ( or tomato and onion chili seasoning mix for a really nice touch ) | pepper | turmeric powder | tamari | cheese ravioli
instructions: Boil the brisket brisket brisket brisket brisket brisket brisket brisket brisket in a pot of boiling water about 5 minutes. Reduce heat to simmer and cook for 1 hour. Remove brisket brisket from pot and place on a plated platter. Spoon any juice or vegetables left behind on the brisket across the brisket with your preferred method. This recipe makes about 7 servings from the brisket and about 2 cups beef broth.

title: Portuguese Fried Chorizo
ingredients: 1 ounce butter | 12 ounces chorizo sausages | 1/2 teaspoon anise seed
instructions: Heat the butter in a skillet and sear the the chorizo until golden, breaking it up into smaller pieces as it cooks. Drain the chorizo on paper towels and let any excess fat drain off. Add the chorizo, the anise seed and the butter to your skillet with the oil. Let the butter and chorizo cook over medium heat, stirring frequently, until all of the chorizo is golden.

Random Ingredients: enoki mushroom,pecan half,onion soup mix,lobster tail,nonstick cooking spray,capicola
title: Lobster Etoufee
ingredients: nonstick cooking spray | 1 package frozen oyster tail | 1/3 cup onion soup mix | 2 tablespoons minced capicola | 1/2 cup chopped pecans | 1 package frozen chopped onions in mushroom soup mix, thawed
instructions: Heat oven to 425 degrees f. Spray 9x13 inch glass baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Unroll oyster tail.

Random Ingredients: herb,crabmeat,guinness stout,white wine,pork loin chop,taco seasoning mix,garlic salt
title: Guinness Pork
ingredients: 8 ounces imitation crabmeat, thawed | 1 bottle guinness stout | 1/2 teaspoon dried herbs | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 1/2 tablespoons taco seasoning mix or 1 1/2 tablespoons dry taco seasoning mix | 4 pork loin chops, 1/2-inch thick
instructions: Drain the imitation crabmeat. Combine the guinness and herbs in a bowl. Mix in the garlic and taco seasoning mix, add a few spoonfuls of the beer to the crabmeat and crabmeat to make it easier to handle. Let marinate at least 2 hours or overnight. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Place pork chops on a greased baking sheet. Sprinkle top of chops with a little of the taco seasoning mixture. Bake for 45 minutes to an hour or until the internal temperature reaches 140 degrees f, brushing with more of the taco seasoning during the last 15 minutes of baking. Remove from oven and let rest for 10 minutes before slicing.

title: Mexican Baked Beans
ingredients: 200 g dried beans, soaked overnight in | 2 cups sunflower oil | 2 tablespoons of chopped pitted black olives
instructions: Heat oven to 200c/180c/gas line a roasting tin with baking paper. Place the soaked beans in a large pan with enough water to cover. Place over high heat and bring to the boil. Then reduce the heat to a simmer and cover with a large piece of kitchen foil. Cook for about 2 1/2 hours. After the beans have soaked overnight, remove the beans from the water and pat dry with kitchen paper. In a large bowl, break up the beans using a large fork. Add the olive oil and mix together. Add the olives. Taste, season and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: linguine,jalapeno pepper,ice water,sunflower oil,cream chicken soup,lamb shoulder,date,sage leaf
title: Lamb and Sunflower Pasta
ingredients: 1 kg boneless lamb shoulder, trimmed | 8 -10 fresh sage leaves | 4 jalapeno peppers, halved and deseeded | 4 tablespoons sunflower oil | 2 tablespoons fresh cream of chicken soup | ice water | 375 g linguine, cooked
instructions: Freezing instructions, remove any fat from roast in crockpot or roasting tin. Place all of the chopped herbs and pepper halves onto a chopping board and cut into small cubes. Heat the oil in a large skillet. Cut the roast in half and toss in the meat, sage and jalapeno for 4 - 5 minutes, or until browned on all sides. Stir cream of chicken soup into the pan. Add ice water and bring to the boil. Place the roast back into the pan and mix in the chopped herbs and pepper halves. Cover and cook on low for 4 hours. When ready to serve, drain the mixture, reserving 1 cup of cooking liquid. Toss pasta in a large jug of the reserved cooking liquid and add to the meat and sauce mixture. Cook until the pasta is tender and the sauce is hot.

Random Ingredients: savoy cabbage,hot sauce,fine sugar,beef bouillon cube
title: Sweet Potatoes Dressed With Savoy Carrots
ingredients: 9 ounces savoy cabbage, grated | 1 tablespoon beef bouillon cube | 2 tablespoons fine sugar | 1 dash hot sauce
instructions: Heat the grill or the oven to 350f degrees. Drain cabbage well and mix in a bowl with the bouillon and sugar. Lightly oil the vegetables, then place on the grill or ovenproof dish. Cover and cook for 5 - 10 minutes until cooked and caramelised. Remove the cover for the last 1 minute to ensure browning. Serve hot or cold. Variation, after boiling the cabbage for 5 minutes, allow to cool slightly. Transfer the contents to a freezer bag. Slice the cabbage and then put in a freezer bag. Seal the bag and return the contents to the freezer. The contents will have begun to thaw a bit while chilling. After chilling, use as directed. If the contents start to stick, simply heat up the sauce a bit.

Random Ingredients: chinese five spice powder,turmeric,yellow bell pepper,chili paste,grand marnier,double cream
title: Chinese Sweet Spiced Pepper Condiment
ingredients: 1 medium yellow bell pepper | 4 tablespoons sweet chili paste ( sirachi ) | 2 tablespoons dark muscat wine or 2 tablespoons sweet sherry wine | 2 teaspoons chinese five spice powder | 1 -4 tablespoon grand marnier or 1 -4 tablespoon other sweet orange flavor liqueur | 250 ml double cream
instructions: Char slice of bell pepper on grill over direct heat. Watch closely, as the pepper can readily scorch during this step remove and place in a plastic bag while it cools to stop the cooking process. Peel and finely chop the bell pepper, place in a bowl and stir in sweet and dark sirachi paste, muscat wine, 5 spice powder and grand marnier or orange flavouring. Taste and adjust the sweet/dark flavours to your liking. Spoon the mixture into hot sterilized jars leaving 1/2 inch headspace. Wipe the rims of the jars with a clean, damp paper towel. Place the seal on top of the jar with the screw on rings. Place a sheet of cling film on the top and seal jar. Place a heavy dish on the edge of the jar and invert over it the remaining slices of pepper and cling film. Refrigerate for at least 2 days before using with care.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,stewing beef,yukon gold potato,beef chuck
title: Beef and Potato Backs With Pepper and Garlic
ingredients: 1 can stewed tomatoes with peppers and garlic | 1 1/2 lbs lean boneless beef chuck, cut into very 1 1/4 & quot, cubes | 4 lbs yukon gold potatoes, quartered | 1 red bell pepper, cut into 1-inch chunks
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f mix undrained tomatoes and contents of can in large deep, heavy duty baking dish. Add beef, breaking meat into small pieces, and toss to coat with sauce. Cover tightly with foil. Bake 45 minutes. Uncover and bake 30 minutes longer or until meat and vegetables are tender. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Serves 6 as is traditional in bahia.

title: Grilled Aubergines
ingredients: 4 baby aubergines | 2 cans aubergines, chilled | 2 cans instant lemonade concentrate
instructions: Slice the ends off the aubergines and then in half length ways without removing. If the skin is very thin slice down the centre for quicker cooking. Toast the aubergines lengthways on both sides under a hot grill until softened. If no skin is at least 2cm deep cut into strips. Heat up the can of lemonade concentrate and add to aubergines, coating them thoroughly. Serve immediately and enjoy.

title: Beef Daal
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef stew meat, cubed | 2 tablespoons ghee | 2 tablespoons chat masala | 1 tablespoon dried yeast | 1/4 cup fresh celery leaves
instructions: In skillet, heat ghee, add yeast and fry to make sure it is no big. Add beef and saute until browned on all sides. Add chaat masala, celery leaves and meat. Cover and let simmer for 50 minutes to 1hr 15 minutes on low heat.

title: Peperonata Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup white port wine | 1 large cumin seed | 1/2 cup white wine
instructions: Finely grind cumin seeds in your grinder. Add white wine and process until smooth.

Random Ingredients: crabmeat,chili paste,marsala wine,lime wedge,swiss cheese,baby carrot,sherry,worcestershire sauce
title: Crabmeat Cordon Bleu
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs crabmeat | 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 4 ounces swiss cheese | 1 tablespoon dried parsala wine | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon chili paste | 1 1/2 cups baby carrots | 1 lime wedge
instructions: Mix crabmeat with 2 tbsp of dried sherry, 3 oz of swiss cheese, and dried parsala. Combine the worcestershire, chili paste, and remaining 1/2 cup swiss cheese and 1 tbsp of the sherry in a shallow dish. Make 1 inch slits into the top of the crabmeat mixture in each slit. Place shrimp in the marinade, turn to coat, and refrigerate for 2 hours, or until crab is firm. Turn the dish once or twice during the cooking period. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place carrots on a baking sheet with sides and arrange 1/2 inch apart. Place crabmeat mixture and 1/2 tsp of the green sauce mixture in the center of each carrot and place the baking sheet in the upper half of the oven. Broil for about 5 minutes, or until the crab is just opaque around the edges. Turn out the crab and sauce onto a platter, and garnish with the remaining green sauce. Serve and enjoy.

title: Coriander and Bean Sprouts
ingredients: 6 cups bean sprouts | 7 ounces coriander ( cilantro ) leaves | 1 teaspoon active dry yeast | 3/4 cup maraschino cherry, coarsely chopped
instructions: Mix and put the bean sprouts in a greased, covered bowl. Sprinkle the coriander on top. Allow to rise to double in bulk before proceeding to step crumble the coriander, and combine with the remaining ingredients. Beat the mixture again, and then knead for several minutes. Shape as desired, and spread on bread pans/tables, etc, and place in a preheated oven or on baking tray.

Random Ingredients: turmeric powder,onion powder,pumpkin puree,savory,bread,virgin olive oil,lasagna noodle,quark
title: Spiced Squash Lasagna
ingredients: 12 ounces dry lasagna noodles | 2 teaspoons virgin olive oil | 1/2 medium onion, chopped | 1 1/2 lbs squash or 1 1/2 lbs zucchini, cubed | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/2 teaspoon savory | 1/2 cup quark | 1/2 cup canned pumpkin puree
instructions: In large frying pan, add olive oil and onion over medium heat till onion is translucent, about 7 mins or till onions are almost translucent. Add yellow squash, turmeric, & savory. Toss lightly and cook till squash is tender and squash is soft, 10 minute add quark & pumpkin & simmer till thickened slightly, about 15 minute meanwhile drain pasta noodles and rinse under cold water and add to other sauce ingredients. Cover and simmer till pasta is tender and sauce is creamy, about 5 minute. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Spoon 1/8 cup of sauce mixture over pasta, then arrange noodles in overlapping manner in a baking dish sprayed with pam. Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes or until noodles are tender but firm. Uncover and bake a few minutes more. Let stand for 5 minute before serving.

title: Sauerkraut & Cilantro
ingredients: 1 bag sauerkraut | 2 spring onions, diced | 1/2 cup fresh cilantro leaves, chopped
instructions: Place sauerkraut in pan on medium low heat. Add chopped spring onions and cilantro. Enjoy.

title: Chili-Rice
ingredients: 4 tablespoons chili-seasoned salsa | 5 tablespoons sugar | 2 teaspoons ground dried mint | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 pinch cayenne
instructions: Combine all ingredients and chill for 1 hour.

title: Hazelnut Chog
ingredients: 75 g hazelnuts, skinned and coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons wine or 2 tablespoons sherry wine | 125 ml double cream ( or thickened cream ) | 125 ml pink beans, washed and drained
instructions: Place hazelnuts in a small pan and add 2 teaspoons of water.

title: Strawberry Garlic Dip
ingredients: 1/2 cup vegetable, diced | 2 cloves garlic oil, halved | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh mint flakes ( optional ) | 1 frozen mixed vegetables, rinsed and patted dry
instructions: Place the vegetable, garlic, and mint in a blender with 3 tablespoons water and puree until smooth. Transfer to a serving bowl and top with frozen mixed vegetables, a bit at a time.

Random Ingredients: cooking spray,mushroom stem,red curry paste,ice water,granny smith apple,seasoning salt,baking powder,bacon
title: Spicy Apple Crumble
ingredients: 3 large granny smith apples | cooking spray | 16 large mushroom stems, trimmed and cut in half | 3/4 cup fresh sliced mushrooms in caps | 1 teaspoon red curry paste or 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1/4 teaspoon baking powder | 1 tablespoon ice-cold water
instructions: Peel and core apples, remove core and slice thinly.

title: Italian Style Mussels
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried savory, crushed | 1 teaspoon onion salt | 2 teaspoons fennel | 2 tablespoons margarine or 2 tablespoons butter, melted | 3 cups vegetable broth | 2 tablespoons espresso powder | 1 teaspoon maple syrup | 2 lbs mussels, scrubbed and debearded
instructions: In a large bowl mix together savory, onion, fennel, and melted margarine with a wire whisk. Add the vegetable broth, espresso powder and maple syrup and mix well. Heat a large sauté pan on medium heat. Coat pan with cooking spray and when it is hot add mussels and cook for 3 minutes or until opened. Remove from heat and let sit for about 3 - 5 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: breadcrumb,amaretto liqueur,liquid smoke flavoring,fish sauce,pineapple juice
title: Homemade Amaretto Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: 3/4 cup pineapple juice ( juice from 1 pineapple ) | 1/4 cup amaretto liqueur | 3/4 teaspoon liquid smoke flavoring | 1 1/2 teaspoons fish sauce | 1/4 cup breadcrumbs
instructions: Place ingredients in a small bowl.

title: Apple Glazed Salmon
ingredients: 1 small apple | 2 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon | 1 slice turkey steak | 1 tablespoon sultana ( optional ) | 1/8 cup shredded steak ( optional )
instructions: Peel and core apple. Slice off the stem and remove core and white center, then cut fruit into chunks, then combine with the rest of the ingredients and mix well. Place in a covered dish and refrigerate for 1 - 2 hours. Cook in oven or grill as desired, or heat in a skillet until desired doneness, or cook in a crockpot for no more than 2 hours on low or high.

title: Sweet Parsnip and Jicama With Prawns
ingredients: 1 lb jicama, cut into thin strips | 2 large parsnips, peeled and cut into 2cm pieces | 4 tablespoons cornstarch | 3 tablespoons corn syrup | 1/4 cup pistachios, toasted | 1 2/3 lbs king prawns, peeled and cooked
instructions: Steam or boil the jicama, parsnips and prawns in salted water until they are tender, about 5 minutes, depending on their size. Drain and set aside keeping warm. Mix together the cornstarch and corn syrup until smooth and set aside. Arrange the pistachios on a baking tray and toast under a preheated oven at 180c for 10 to 15 minutes, stirring occasionally so they don't burn. Add all the prawns and the warm prawns to the cornstarch mixture and toss to combine. Serve warm or cool.

title: Simple Mexican Green Chili Peppers
ingredients:
8 large green chilies ( fresh is best.
    - i like the ones i use fresh green chilies in the jar ) | 1/2 cup melted butter
instructions: Place all the ingredients into a large zip top bag and mix thoroughly. Close the bag and place in the fridge until ready to use. To serve, preheat grill or broiler. Take each chile and split lengthwise into thirds. Grill for about 10 - 15 minutes or just until the chile is blackened and tender. Note, if using fresh green chili peppers, cut off ends just before serving.

title: Pork Loin With the Spring Onion
ingredients: 1 lb pork loin | 2 -3 spring onions, cut in 1 `` ( or more ) | 2 tablespoons margarine | 1 teaspoon fenugreek seeds
instructions: Pierce the loin and trim some around the edges with a sharp knife. Bake in a 400° f oven for 30 minutes for medium or until you can feel the whole thing. Take out of the oven. Use a kitchen towel to drain most of the juices off. Cut into thin slices. In a small fry pan, heat the margarine. Add the fenugreek and fry on high heat until the color becomes medium. Dry with kitchen paper towel. Place the onions on the loins, sprinkle with the fenugreek and serve with bread.

title: Corn Hash With poblano and Hintro
ingredients: 3 ears corn, shucked, husked & kernels reserved | 1/2 lb potato, peeled | 1/4 lb poblano pepper | 1 cup creme fraiche | 2 tablespoons currants
instructions: Preheat broiler. Place corn in a large shallow roasting pan and broil, turning occasionally, until marked all over, about 8 minutes. When cool, pull kernels off cobs, removing the kernels and leaving the husks intact. Cut the kernels from the cob and transfer to a food processor, discarding the kernels. Place potato, pepper, poblano and reserved corn kernels in a bowl and mash with a potato masher, a fork or fork until the mixture is smooth but chunky. Stir in the creme frache and currants. Spread potato mixture over the corn in the roasting pan. Broil, turning often, until topping is browned and bubbling, 6 to 8 minutes.

title: Chicken Salad
ingredients: 2 large heads cauliflower head | 10 chicken wings | 1 cucumber | 5 tablespoons vinegar | 2 1/4 cups chicken fat or 2 1/4 cups vegetable fat
instructions: Slice cauliflower into 1 inch segments.

Random Ingredients: red capsicum,brandy,espresso powder,cayenne,black cardamom pod,ice cube,pineapple tidbit,okra
title: Jamaican Style Okra Salad
ingredients: 4 oranges, juice of | 1 red capsicum ( bell pepper ) | 8 ounces pineapple tidbits | 3 packages frozen okra | 2 teaspoons instant espresso powder | 2 teaspoons brandy or 2 teaspoons rum | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne ( to taste ) | 2 black cardamom pods ( with pods )
instructions: Cut oranges and capsicum into 1/2” slices. In a bowl, combine okra, pineapple chunks and juice from the oranges and capsicum.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,sherry wine vinegar,white bread,beef stock,cream
title: Smothered Peppers
ingredients: 4 large green bell peppers, halved lengthwise ( or any color combination ) | 1 - 1 1/2 cup beef broth | 1/3 cup sour cream | 3/4 cup dry sherry wine vinegar | 8 slices white bread, cut into pieces ( approx 1 inch thick )
instructions: Line a jellyroll pan with foil. Place the bell peppers on the foil, place in a 400f oven for 15 minutes, or until the skins blister and blacken. Transfer the peppers to a bowl and cover with plastic wrap, releasing the steam. Set aside and cover tightly with foil. Set the oven temperature to broil. In the meantime, bring beef broth to a boil in a small saucepan, stirring. In a small bowl, combine the sour cream and sherry vinegar and set aside. Remove the peppers from the oven and slice into thin slices, about 1/4 inch thick. Place the bread on a foil lined baking sheet. Using a tablespoon, spread 1/12 of the sour cream/sherry mixture over each slice of bread. Spoon 1 tbsp of the pepper mixture over the tops of the bread to cover the bread. Wrap each pepper with a slice of bread. Broil for about 10minutes, or until the tops are browned. Remove and serve immediately.

title: Pea Polenta
ingredients: 1 cup yellow cornmeal, or as needed | 1 cup frozen green peas, thawed and drained | 3/4 cup crumbled pepperoni
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Mix together cornmeal and peas in a bowl until thoroughly combined. Stir in pepperoni. Pour 1/2 cup polenta into a 9x13 inch baking dish to cover the entire dish. Bake in the preheated oven until edges are crisp, about 30 minutes.

title: Sukiyaki-Dipped Pine Nuts
ingredients: 1 jar pine nuts | 2 -3 tablespoons thai fish sauce ( nam pla )
instructions: Place nuts in a small, shallow pan, and toast over medium heat. Toast only a few minutes just enough to warm through. Pour sauce over nuts right before serving.

Random Ingredients: ginger root,graham cracker crumb,cannellini bean,pea carrot,molasses,mango
title: Ginger & Molasses Pumpkin Pie
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can peas and carrots, drained | 1 medium mango, peeled and diced | 1 tablespoon ginger root, minced | 1 teaspoon molasses | 2 cups graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Mix beans, peas, carrots, mango and ginger. Line a 9 inch tart pan with crumbs. Spoon bean mixture into pan. Press crumbs onto surface of pumpkin mixture. Bake until golden with cracks and edges, about 30 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Spicy Yummy Fettuccine With Kale and Dates
ingredients: 4 ounces semolina or 4 ounces flour | 12 ounces fettuccine | 12 tablespoons chopped dates | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 2 1/2 - 3 ounces of kahlua | 7 -8 tablespoons of chopped kale, from a bunch such as kale, chard or chinese kale, and roughly chopped greens ( such as kale, micture ) | 6 -8 slices of good quality kahlua margarine, to taste, maybe more | cinnamon, to taste, maybe more | skewer, if desired
instructions: Pasta, make the sauce, combine all the sauce ingredients in a small to medium saucepan. Stir to dissolve the kahlua and add to the saucepan. Bring to a simmer and turn the heat to low. Add chopped greens just before serving and stir. Pasta, bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and then add the pasta. Stir in the kahlua and reduce heat to slightly under the water. Add the cooked pasta and a splash of the reserved kahlua. Turn off heat. Add the rest of the chopped kale. Add more optional spices if you like and serve. Note, if you feel like adding more kahlua, add 1 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tsp lemon peel, or some cayenne pepper if you like.

title: Cornflake Balls
ingredients: 1 cup corn flakes | 2 tablespoons tamarind pulp, boiled | 1/2 banana, mashed | 1/4 cup plain low-fat yogurt | pork sauce
instructions: Mix the ground cornflakes in 1 tbsp warm water and mix well. Mix in sugar and salt to taste. Mix in the mashed banana. Make balls of this mixture. Deep fry in hot oil and drain. Dip in a cup of plain yogurt or water.

title: Easy Cheese Rollups
ingredients: 1 cup shredded ricotta cheese | 1 can refrigerated but not drained plain rolled oats | 1/4 green bell pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Unroll the rolled oats on a clean towel and pat into a rectangle on a jellyroll pan. Sprinkle the ricotta cheese on top of the rolled oats. Slice the bell pepper and arrange around the cheese as you roll. Spread some of the rollups with green pepper slices. Bake in the preheated oven for 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,brown mustard seed,chocolate candy,lime zest,olive oil,bacon
title: Lime and Bacon Queso Dip
ingredients: 1/2 cup olive oil | 1 lime, zest of | 1 teaspoon brown mustard seeds | 1 cup chopped bacon, cooked and drained ( i used a bacon rind ) | 2 packages chocolate candy, cut in 1/2 inch squares ( i used bacon bits ) | 1 package monterey jack cheese
instructions: Dry fry bacon pieces in oil. Set aside and keep warm. Saute onion in bacon fat, then add mustard seed and mix well. Add lime juice and zest. Add cheese cubes, then add the bacon pieces. Bring to a boil, then lower temperature and simmer until cheese is melted and bubbly.

title: Mixed Mushrooms
ingredients: 100 g button mushrooms | 100 g bitter rolls, sliced length ways ( bitter pats ) | 150 g ground hazelnuts | 80 g honey
instructions: Wash the mushrooms thoroughly and slice diagonally. Place the sliced mushrooms and the bitter pats inside a saucepan and add water. Boil over low heat for about 20 minutes. If using a skillet, place it in a large bowl and add some cold water. Leave to simmer for about 10 minutes until the bitter pats float. Remove the bitter pats with a slotted spoon and serve warm. Tips, one of the key ingredients in the final step is always bitter pats. Honey brings out all the flavours. Honey is a bitter fruit that is placed in the pan and is thus removed from its bitter taste. As a variation or a garnish, you can also place the bitter pats in a small cup or tin and set aside. If you are using bitters pats, add a few drops of honey and mix into the bitter pats. Honey is a bitter fruit that is bitter and thus removed from its bitter taste. You may try this method instead.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,rotel,hoisin sauce,walnut half,purpose flour,roast beef,english muffin
title: Beef Sticks
ingredients: 2 lbs round roast or 2 lbs top sirloin steaks, tenderized with seasoning, cut 1-in thick | 1/2 cup hoisin sauce ( i like kikkoman's extreme dark & sweet, but any dark ) | 1 can original rotel, original | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar ( optional ) | 12 english muffins (, split, about 7-1/4-inch in diameter ) | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour | 1/2 cup walnut halves ( toasted if desired )
instructions: Dissolve dark brown sugar in hoisin sauce with rotel according to package directions. Marinate meat at least three hours or overnight, stirring often to blend flavors. Grill or broil meat, turning once, until well browned, basting often with the juices. Serve over toasted english muffins with remaining sauce and toasted walnuts. Note, if using the brown sugar can, make sure to soak it with a little warm water in it first before adding to the meat. You can leave out the walnuts or use a combination if you desire.

Random Ingredients: coconut flake,chive,grape tomato,american cheese,serrano pepper,cauliflower,coriander leaf
title: Cauliflower Cheese Skewers With Tomatoes and Goat Cheese
ingredients: 12 grape tomatoes | 1/2 cup unsweetened coconut flakes, finely shredded | 1 tablespoon chives, chopped | 1 tablespoon of fresh mint, chopped | 1 serrano pepper, minced | 1 small cauliflower, cut in florets | 1/4 cup fresh coriander leaves, loosely packed and chopped ( optional )
instructions: In a large bowl, combine tomatoes, coconut and chives. Mix well. Season with mint, chilies, pepper, and coriander. Thread 3 or 4 skewers onto each plate. Skewer tomato mixture on top of vegetables and serve immediately, with coriander sprigs for garnish.

Random Ingredients: heart palm,espresso powder,beef stock,breadcrumb,dream whip,garlic,vegetable stock,bean
title: Dreamswiss Savoury Bean Burgers
ingredients: 1 lb bean ( red and green beans ) | 1/2 cup vegetarian beef stock | 1/4 cup beef stock | 1/4 cup dream whip | 1 teaspoon instant espresso powder | 1 teaspoon instant espresso powder | 2 tablespoons breadcrumbs | 1 teaspoon garlic, mashed | heart palm, slices ( optional )
instructions: Soak the beans overnight in hot water to cover. Remove and repeat soaking process a few times. Drain and place in a strainer and sprinkle with salt. Let drain overnight so as to draw out excess water. Drain off liquid and refrigerate overnight. Preheat an outdoor grill pan over medium heat. In a medium sized bowl, combine the beans, veggie stock, beef stock, dream whip, espresso powder, and espresso powder. Mix well and place on the grill as close to the heat as possible and cook for 1 minute. Mix in the bread crumbs and garlic. The topping should be thick and creamy. Top with crispy skinned hearts of palm if using.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,chicken broth,bacon,dark rum,green chili,jalapeno
title: Big D's Famous Beer Can Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 cup chicken broth | 1/2 cup dark rum | 5 slices finely diced jalapenos | 6 slices bacon, chopped | 2 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs | 1/8 cup green chili, chopped
instructions: Pour chicken broth into can or regular size ramekin size plastic bucket, being sure there is 1/2 inch of head space at top of bucket.

Random Ingredients: salad green,swiss cheese,turnip,ice water,cornflour,chunky salsa,tomato green chilies,rosemary sprig
title: Mexican Turnip and Swiss Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cornflour | 5 cups peeled and thinly sliced turnips | 3/4 cup chunky salsa | 1/2 cup diced tomato and green chilies | 1/4 cup torn fresh rosemary sprig | 2 cups swiss cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup chilled salad greens | ice water
instructions: Mix cornflour and water in a small bowl until batter resembles breadcrumbs, then mix in turnip, salsa, chilies, and rosemary. Gently fold the greens and swiss cheese into the batter until the greens are evenly coated with the batter. Heat a medium nonstick skillet over medium heat. Cook until crisp and golden brown, stirring often, about 3 minutes. Remove from skillet. Sprinkle with green onions and serve.

Random Ingredients: pecan,cumin powder,sole fillet,cardamom powder,blackberry,walnut,cottage cheese,sesame seed
title: Kurdish Fish and Blackberry Salad
ingredients: 2 sole fillets | 1 1 cup blackberry ( pitted & sliced ) | 3/4 cup cottage cheese or 3/4 cup ricotta cheese | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder | 2 teaspoons cumin powder | 1 teaspoon sesame seeds | 1 teaspoon finely chopped walnuts | 1 teaspoon finely chopped pecans
instructions: Mix all ingredients except for the fish together and let sit for 30 minutes, at least for flavors to develop and the pices to blend. Serve over salad. This will also serve as a snack item.

title: Easy Pizza Crust
ingredients: 1 teaspoon instant yeast | 1 cup chicken leg fat, warmed and drained | 1 1/2 cups dry multigrain flour tortillas or 1 1/2 cups flour tortillas | 1 jar cranberry sauce or ( 12 ounce ) jar raspberry preserves
instructions: Mix yeast, chicken and 1/2 cup of the flour.

Random Ingredients: green chilies,veal,italian salad dressing mix,tenkasu,picante sauce
title: Picante Verde
ingredients: 2 lbs ground veal | 1 cup picante sauce | 2 packages dry italian salad dressing mix | 16 ounces green chilies, chopped ( can be from a can, or more to taste ) | 2 cans diced mild green chilies
instructions: Combine veal, picante sauce, salad dressing mix, and green chiles in large saucepan, cover and simmer over low heat 5 to 10 minutes or until veal is no longer pink. Remove from heat, stir, taste for seasoning and adjust if necessary.

title: Fried Onions: Guisados
ingredients: 4 large onions, sliced 1/2 inch thick | 1/4 cup walnut oil | 2 tablespoons minced chives | 2 tablespoons dried onion flakes | 2 tablespoons annatto seeds
instructions: In a heavy skillet, saute onion in walnut oil until it turns a deep golden brown. Add the chives and dried onion flakes and allow them to sizzle for a minute or two. Sprinkle annatto seed and allow to cook for another minute, until seed begins to pop. Remove and drain all onions and keep warm. Serve warm or cold.

title: Japanese Salad
ingredients: 3 -6 large potatoes, sliced | 14 ounces salami, cut into thick slices | 12 ounces chinese rice wine | 1 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Steam potatoes until tender on the water bath, then immediately drain, peel while still warm. To serve, place a layer of potato on a serving plate, then top with about 6 slices salami. Place a thin layer of rice wine over this, then stir a couple of times to incorporate. Sprinkle the pepper on top, then repeat layers. Serve.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon,digestive biscuit,green bell pepper,seashell pasta,sea salt
title: Homemade Beef Patties
ingredients: 450 g seashell pasta | 4 tablespoons granulated salt | 1/2 small green bell pepper, chopped | 1 tablespoon beef bouillon | 1/4 cup digestive biscuit ( plain or flavored )
instructions: Boil a large pot of salted water, add noodles and break into 1 inch pieces. Drain noodles, return to boiling water and add beef broth. Simmer for 5 minutes then drain and rinse with cold water. Pour noodles into your favourite pasta recipe that has been prepared from the meat. Add salt, pepper, onion and mix well. Note, if mixing biscuit into meat mixture, this step is not necessary. If dough doesn’t stick to the sides of the vessel, it should work out. Roll meat into balls and put onto a baking tray lined with oiled parchment paper. Bake at 220°c for around 20 - 25 minutes or until well browned.

title: Raw Pad See
ingredients: 2 lemons | 1/4 cup nutritional yeast
instructions: Wash thoroughly and dry thoroughly to release juices. Peel the lemons, removing as much pith as possible. Slice them almost in half, and then cut off the ends and slice again into quarters. Place these quarters in a bowl that is coated with olive oil, just to cover the bottom, and drizzle with olive oil. Soak at room temperature for 1 hour, stirring once or twice.. Pour one cup of olive oil into a small stainless steel bowl, place over high heat, and when it begins to smoke, immediately pour in one cup of lemon juice, avoiding splattering this will cause bitterness. When the juice has completely soaked into the mixture, immediately reduce heat to a low setting, and stir all ingredients together, adding more lemon juice as needed to get a good consistency.

Random Ingredients: no salt tomato,green chili pepper pepperoncini,red chili powder,ice,tuna,yellow tomato,tarragon
title: Spanish Tuna With Tomatoes and Green Chili
ingredients: 1 can tuna, drained | 4 medium green chili peppers, seeded and minced | 1 cup diced yellow tomato | 1 tablespoon red chili powder | 1/3 cup sliced red chili pepperoncini, rinsed and drained | 1/4 teaspoon tarragon or 1/4 teaspoon dried tarragon or 1/4 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1 can no-salt-added diced tomatoes, undrained | crushed ice, for serving
instructions: In a large bowl, combine all ingredients. Pour equal amounts of crushed ice into a large wide mouth, shallow bowl or platter. Serve with crushed ice.

title: Poultry Stock
ingredients: 1 pound leaves fresh sage leaf, torn | 1 cup chicken broth
instructions: Cut the sage leaves crosswise into thin strips. In a medium stock pot over medium high heat, combine the sage leaves, chicken broth, and the leftover sage flavored oil and water. Bring to a boil over medium high heat, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer until the chicken is easily shredded with a fork, about 2 hours. Store in a tightly covered container or in the refrigerator for up to one week.

title: Tasty Beef Stuffing
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups finely ground vegetable, such as mushrooms, celery, and onions | 4 1/2 cups cooked and finely ground sirloin steak, about 1 package
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a 13x9 inch baking dish with heavy duty foil. Mix vegetables and ground sirloin in a large bowl until evenly blended. Spoon 1/4 cup of meat mixture into prepared baking dish. Top with remaining stuffing mixture.

title:

ingredients: 1 can fat-free refried beans, heated | 4 ounces jalapeno jack cheese ( shredded or grated ) | 3/4 cup sweet pickle relish ( with caraway seeds ) | 1/4 cup raisins | 1/4 cup pine nuts ( toasted ) | 1/4 cup fat-free shortening | 1/4 teaspoon seasoning salt
instructions: Heat oven to 350 f. Spray a jelly roll pan with cooking spray. In a medium bowl, stir together refried beans, cheddar cheese, pickle relish, and raisins. Stir in pine nuts until coated. In a bowl, combine shortening and pepperononcini cheese.

Random Ingredients: ginger garlic paste,chunky peanut butter,cauliflower,baby back rib,baby carrot,peach,bamboo skewer
title: Peachy Stir-Fry Beef Skewers
ingredients: 500 g baby back ribs | 12 baby carrots | 12 cauliflower ( i use a big head of cauliflower but any size will do ) | 1 peach, small sized jarred | 3 tablespoons good's chunky peanut butter | 3 teaspoons ground ginger and garlic paste ( optional ) | 4 bamboo skewers, trimmed
instructions: Rinse the ribs out and place in a ziploc bag with the ginger and garlic paste and allow to marinate overnight. Boil the cauliflower and carrots in a large pot of water until you can pick them off the heat. Drain. Cut each carrot or potato in half and put them in a small bowl. Drain the beef cubes. Heat wok. Pour peanut butter into the hot wok and quickly stir fry the beef cubes until they can colour for about 1 2mins. Remove beef cubes from wok with a slotted spoon and place in a bowl. Remove cauliflower and carrot mixture from the wok and place in the same wok. Add the drained beef cubes back to the wok and stir fry until beef cubes are cooked. Add the peanut sauce and stir fry for 1 minute. Grate a handful of the peaches and add them to the meat sauce. Add the baby carrots, stir fry for 4 or 5 minutes and serve with steamed rice.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,corn tortilla,button mushroom,garam masala,spaghetti sauce
title: Vegetable Tostadas
ingredients: 1 package corn tortillas, cut into 1-inch strips | 1 pound fresh button mushrooms | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1 teaspoon extra-virgin olive oil | 1 can spaghetti sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Arrange 1 tortilla onto the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Arrange 2 mushrooms over the tortilla, and sprinkle with half each of the garam masala and olive oil. Roll up, and place seam side down in the baking dish. Repeat with remaining tortillas and mushrooms, laying them side by side in a crisscross pattern. Pour spaghetti sauce over top, and sprinkle with remaining garam masala and olive oil. Bake in the preheated oven until bubbling and beginning to brown, about 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: plain nonfat yogurt,mexican cheese,grain rice,bamboo skewer,green cardamom,navy bean,parmesan cheese
title: Mexican White Beans and Rice (Rice Cooker)
