ingredients: 1 can navy beans, drained and rinsed | 2 tablespoons plain nonfat yogurt or 2 tablespoons sour cream | 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese ( about 2 tbsp ) | 4 green cardamoms ( about 1 1/2 teaspoons ) | 1 package long grain rice ( near east brand ) | 2 containers plain nonfat yogurt | 1/4 cup shredded mexican blend cheese, divided
instructions: Place the beans, yogurt, cheese, cardamom, and 1 tsp of the salt into the rice cooker and pulse briefly. Remove rice cooker from cooker and place onto a cutting board with a large, flat rimmed platter, or in a large rimmed baking pan.

title: Slow Cooker Pulled Pork
ingredients: 1 cup half-and-half cream | 2 lbs bone in boneless pork roast | 1 cup whole wheat flour | 6 hamburger buns, toasted
instructions: Spread half and half in the bottom of your slow cooker. Spread the roast on top, sprinkle with the flour. Spread the rest of the flour on top of the roast. Cook on high for 3 hours or on low for 7 hours.

title: Homemade Sopaipillas
ingredients: 2 slices white bread, crusts removed | 1/4 ripe jalapeno, seeded and minced or 1/4 teaspoon salt | 3/4 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: Cut the crusts off the bread slices and set aside. Cut each slice into three or four strips, then gently squeeze each strip over a bowl filled with 1/4 cup warm water to moisten. Remove the bread strips and place on a nonstick cookie sheet, lined with foil. Coat each strip in baking powder and lightly salt. Let dry about 10 minutes so the bread can absorb the seasonings. Using the back of a spoon, press the bread strips lightly into the hot rings. Allow to dry on the cookie sheet. Do not press lightly into the bread, as they will break up as they dry. Sprinkle with additional baking powder and salt. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: black bean,red curry paste,plain flour,sesame oil,pecorino romano cheese,beef brisket
title: Beef Brisket With Chilli and Beans
ingredients: 1 beef brisket | 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 1 1/2 tablespoons sesame oil | 80 g pecorino romano cheese | 8 ounces dried black beans, soaked overnight and drained | 2 tablespoons plain flour
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f remove the beef from the braising liquid. Cut around all of the membrane along the fat layer and tie with kitchen string. Place in a roasting tin. Mix together the remaining ingredients. Use as desired. Cover with foil and roast for 3 hours. Increase the oven temperature to 350°f remove from the oven and cook for 1 - 1½ - 2 hours or until cooked through. Remove from the oven and remove the foil. Cover with foil and place in the fridge overnight to firm up. When ready to serve, shred the beef with two forks and pour over the chilli garlic sauce. Serve.

title: Khatta(Indian Carrot Side Dish)
ingredients: 1 pound carrots | 2 tablespoons asafoetida powder
instructions: Peel carrots and cut into 1/2 inch slices. Transfer to a bowl. Sprinkle asafetida into the carrots and mix well. Cover and refrigerate 30 minutes to 1 hour. Cook in a wok over medium heat until carrots are soft.

title: Chipotle Arrabiio
ingredients: 15 ounces arborio rice, rinsed | 6 ounces chipotle chiles
instructions: Place all ingredients together in a saucepan. Cover, and bring to a boil, then cover and simmer about 30 minutes, or until all liquid is absorbed. Do not add salt during cooking.

title: Sesame Green Beans
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs green beans, trimmed, cut in halves lengthwise | 3 tablespoons rice wine ( shaoxing wine ) | 3 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 saffron strand ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon sumaquriko ( found under a tube, not the gory threads ) | 1/2 teaspoon baharat, spice blend
instructions: Cut diagonal slits in green beans with a knife in a crosshatch pattern on the bottom and side of the beans. Remove any membrane attached at the ends. Place green beans in a small saucepan full of cold, salted water. Bring to the boil and cook uncovered, for 2 minutes. Add rice wine and sesame oil and cook gently for 1 minute longer. Remove the beans from the pan and set aside. Pour saffron into a small bowl and add enough boiling water to cover. Set aside. Sprinkle sumakuriko over the back of a spoon or small saucer. Rub the sumakuriko all over the surface of the beans. Spoon approximately 2 teaspoons of the olive oil and 1 tablespoon saffron onto the olive oil in the saffron bowl. Toss the beans with sesame oil to thoroughly coat, cover and set aside. Toast a few saffron strands in a dry frying pan until a dark golden brown. Drain on paper. Place the beans, fried side up, on a tray lined with foil and set aside for 10 minutes. Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Add 1/2 teaspoon of the baharat spice blend to the olive oil and saute for 3 - 4 minutes over medium heat until it is well incorporated. Do not brown the spice. Put 1/4 cup of the green bean mixture in a rice cup. Squeeze the green bean mixture into the rice cup. Using back of spoon, squeeze out a layer of liquid and pour into the rice cup. Repeat the process twice with another 1/4 cup of green bean mixture and another 1/4 cup of green beans. Bake for approximately 20 minutes until the beans are just beginning to soften. Remove from oven and set aside to cool for 5 minutes. Carefully remove bay leaf and serve.

title: Low Fat Turkey Tikka Burgers
ingredients: 1 turkey breast, very tender, cut into 1 x 1/4 strips | 4 tablespoons cornflour | 1/2 tablespoon tamari soy sauce | 1/3 cup half-and-half | 1 tablespoon dried cranberry juice | 1 pinch of nutmeg
instructions: Put the turkey strips in a shallow bowl. Combine cornflour and tamari in another shallow bowl. Put the half & half, cranberry juice and nutmeg in a third shallow bowl. Using 2 forks, shred the turkey into thin strips. Add the turkey to the cornflour mixture.

Random Ingredients: fish stock,tahini,plain yogurt,italian seasoning,sourdough bread,red lentil
title: Lentil Soup (Sbd)
ingredients: 4 cups fish stock | 1/2 cup red lentil, rinsed and picked over | 2 tablespoons tahini | 2 tablespoons plain yogurt | 1 3/4 teaspoons italian seasoning | sourdough bread
instructions: Bring broth to boil in a large pot over medium high heat. Add lentils and cook until tender, 12 to 15 minutes. Add tahini, yogurt, and seasoning. Puree soup until smooth with a hand held blender. Return soup to high heat, and stir in cooked lentils. Serve with toasted sourdough.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,linguine,cider vinegar,bailey irish cream,thai basil
title: Spiced Pasta
ingredients: 1 box linguine ( rotini is my preference ) | 5 leaves fresh thai basil ( can sub 1/4 cup dried basil ) | 12 ounces rye bread | cider vinegar ( to taste ) | 2 cups baileys irish cream ( or other favorite liquer )
instructions: Cook pasta in salted water as directed on package. Rinse with cold water, drain and place in a large mixing bowl. Add the rest of the ingredients and mix. Pour into a 9 x 13 glass casserole, cover and refrigerate until thoroughly heated..

Random Ingredients: half cream,thai basil,ginger paste,cola,double cream,hot salsa
title: Chef Bevski's Thai Basil Ice Cream
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cola or 1 1/2 cups pepsi | 1/2 cup sweet and sour cola | 1 1/2 cups half-and-half cream ( or cream or evaporated milk ) | 4 teaspoons ginger paste | 7 1/2 ounces cola or 7 1/2 ounces pepsi | 6 ounces triple cream, whipped ( use whipped cream to make this rich dessert even more flavorful ) | thai basil, for garnish
instructions: Make the ice cream, place the cola in a saucepot and heat over medium high heat until boiling. Remove from the heat and stir in the half and half, ginger paste and cola. Allow to chill. Remove 3 tablespoons of cola from the ice cream mixture, and stir into the cola mixture. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Strain the mixture through a fine sieve lined with a clean, dampened paper towel. Store in the refrigerator in a clear plastic container for up to a week. When ready to serve, place a scoop of chilled ice cream in the center of a tall serving platter and mound 1 teaspoon of the cola mixture in the center of the ice cream. Garnish with a sprig of basil and serve in tall tall glasses.

title: Blackened Blackened Chestnuts
ingredients: 2 packages frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1 cup water chestnuts, drained and sliced | 1/2 teaspoon ground black pepper
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Place the puff pastry sheets in a large baking sheet. Unfold the puff pastry sheets, and unroll the entire sheet. Spread the chestnuts over the puff pastry sheets. Season with black pepper. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes in the preheated oven, until golden brown and bubbly.

title: Sweet Chilli Chips
ingredients: 3 chilies, deseeded | oil, to deep fry | sweet chile slices, to decorate | crushed ice, to serve
instructions: Deep fry the chilli chips till lightly golden brown drain thoroughly then place on kitchen paper to dry. Place a small pat of chilli in your palm and lightly drizzle oil. Dip it in the chilli and then leave to dry on the paper till cool. Using the back of a tablespoon, dip the chips into the chilli and fry on a hot dry pan till golden brown. Remove and decorate with green chillies.

Random Ingredients: thai fish sauce,celery rib,potato starch,mascarpone cheese,hamburger
title: Khao Soi
ingredients: 4 medium potatoes, peeled and shredded | 4 sticks sweet hamburger | 3 teaspoons celery rib, chopped | 2 teaspoons thai fish sauce | 2 teaspoons potato starch | 1 tablespoon mascarpone cheese
instructions: Brown hamburger. Add sweet potatoes, soy sauce and fish sauce. Bring to a boil, then set aside to cool completely. Mix potato starch and mascarpone cheese. Mix into meat mixture and chill thoroughly.

title: Creamy Cranberry Tea
ingredients: 2 tablespoons yeast | 1 tablespoon turmeric | 1 teaspoon ground mace | 1 cup cranberries | 1 can lemon filling or 1 can regular canned cranberry filling
instructions: Dissolve yeast in water and let sit until the yeast froths, then add turmeric, mace and cranberries and knead to combine. Put dough in large bread machine bowl that has been sprinkled with baking soda. Punch down and place on cookie sheet sprayed with oil or butter. Spread cranberry filling on dough if making sure to cover filling. Cover with a cloth towel or cookie sheet and place in a warm spot. Allow to rise for 24 hours. Bake on a cookie sheet at 400 degrees for 15 - 20 minutes or until golden brown. Allow to cool before cutting.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,extra virgin olive oil
title: The Best Chili Oil
ingredients: 4 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil ( from a 14-ounce jar ) | 1/2 bunch whole dried red chili pepper
instructions: Pour 2 tablespoons of the chili oil into a 12 inch stainless steel frying pan. Using flat bladed knife, slice the chile thin. When the oil ripples, add the chiles and cover. Let the chiles steep in the hot oil for 20 minutes, or up to 1 day. If you have a thermometer, set it as high as the temperature to warm the oil for 20 minutes. The chili can be kept up to 2 days, wrapped tightly in plastic wrap in layers of cheesecloth. It freezes up to 7 months.

Random Ingredients: blackberry,okra,vegetable shortening,russet potato,chinese five spice powder,turmeric powder
title: Chinese Okra, Potato Patties or  Fried Sticks
ingredients: 1 russet potato | 1 package frozen okra, thawed and quartered ( approximately 15 pieces ) | 1 cup blackberries ( optional ) | 1/2 cup vegetable shortening | 1 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder or 1/2 teaspoon other aromatic powder
instructions: Wash, slice, boil, peel and shred potatoes until very firm. Slice okra in half lengthwise. Heat large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Remove okra from bag and discard marinade. Place potato, okra, blackberries, flour and spices except the vegetable shortening, into well buttered skillet. Shake pan until mixture is well combined. Melt shortening and fry mixture until it is light tan. Serve with steamed rice.

title: Sauerkraut
ingredients: 2 pounds kielbasa | 1 can tomato juice | 1 pinch hot sauce | 1 bottle heinz chili-flavored sauce
instructions: Place the kielbasa slices in a large pan. Fill the pan with enough tomato juice to cover the kielbasa. Pour in enough hot sauce to cover. Stir in the hot sauce. Cover the pan, and simmer over low heat for 8 to 10 hours, or until the pork is tender, and easily shredded. Stir every 20 minutes. Stir in the chili bean sauce while cooking.

title: Irish Rye Bread Rolls (Firsich)
ingredients: 1 lb shortcrust pastry | 4 cups rye bread, thinly sliced
instructions: Line a baking sheet with baking parchment paper. Preheat oven to 400°f. Combine shortcrust pastry, rye bread and ¾ cup cold water in a large bowl. Use your hands to work the dough evenly until it comes together in a sticky ball. Transfer to a piping bag fitted with a 2½ inch star tip. Pipe the dough onto the baking sheet, leaving a ½ inch rim around the edge. Bake until golden brown and puffed, about 15 - 20 minutes. Remove from oven and place on a rack to cool.

title: Homemade Sprouts Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs bean sprouts | 1 lb carrot, grated | 1/4 cup water
instructions: Place all ingredients in a pot, and heat until the water is cooked through.

Random Ingredients: lime zest,madeira wine,garam masala,pork tenderloin,green chilies,kahlua
title: Portobello (Pork Medallions with Kahlua and Aji Ice)
ingredients: 1 lb pork tenderloin | 1 can green chilies | 1/4 cup madeira wine | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1 lime, zest of | 1 tablespoon kahlua
instructions: Cut pork into about 3/4 inch cubes, about 3/4 inch long. Place pork, chilis, kahlua, and madeira in a food processor or blender. Chill the mixture for at least 1 hour. Remove 1/4 cup of the mixture and set aside. Brush both sides of the pork lightly with the mixture, and set aside. Spray a 9x13 inch pan with cooking spray. Heat the entire mixture, including the reserved kahlua, on the grill. Cook until the outside is a rich brown color. Take one piece of pork out of the refrigerator, and turn it onto a piece of wax paper to finish browning. Place the pork in the pan and cook about 10 minutes per side, or until internal temperature reaches 135 degrees f. To serve, place the pan with aji ice on the table with two forks, and put one piece of pork on the table.

title: Raspberry Soybean Spread
ingredients: 1 package soybeans | 12 ounces fresh raspberry-size raspberries
instructions: Cook the sopes until they float on the surface of the water that's about 2 minutes and it should turn browned around the edges. Rinse with cool water to reduce any sand. Slice the soybean pods lengthwise and place in a food processor. Add 1 cup of the frozen raspberries and pulse until you've reached a smooth paste like consistency, about 2 minutes or so. Transfer the raspberries to a medium bowl and stir in the soybean paste. Place into a food processor or blender and pulse to the desired consistency.

title: Italian Pork Chops
ingredients: 2 cups italian salad dressing, divided | 4 pork loin chops | 1/2 cup cornflour
instructions: Pre heat oven to 190°c mix 1/2 cup of italian dressing with cornflour, and then stir into remaining half cup of italian dressing. Score the pork chops, and then lightly sprinkle with the cornflour mixture on both sides. Arrange chops skin side down in a lightly greased baking tray and set aside for 20 minutes. Bake for 10 minutes, then lower temperature to 180°c. Return the chops to heat, and continue baking for another 20 minutes, or until very well done.

title: Tossed Snow Peas with Mustard and Snow Peas
ingredients: 1 pound snow peas | 2 teaspoons dijon mustard
instructions: Break snow peas into thirds, and split diagonally into 2 pieces on the long side of each piece. Toss with dijon mustard and serve at once.

Random Ingredients: farfalle pasta,peppercorn,phyllo pastry,beef bouillon cube,halloumi cheese
title: Halloumi Cheese and Farfalle Pasta
ingredients: 250 g farfalle pasta | 500 g halloumi cheese, grated | 1 beef bouillon cube, crumbled | 1 tablespoon peppercorn, crushed | 2 sheets phyllo pastry
instructions: Cook the pasta in a large saucepan of salted boiling water for about 10 mins until tender. Drain and return to the pan. Preheat oven to 200c. Mix the halloumi, bouillon cube, peppercorns and approximately 200ml boiling water, and spread the cheese mixture in to the dough. Lay the sheets on a greased surface and cut a cross in the top. Bake on a baking tray for 30 min until golden brown.

title: Melon-Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cantaloupe, seeded and diced | 14 fresh basil sprigs | 1/2 cup fresh ginger root, peeled and grated | 8 fresh thyme sprigs | 1 teaspoon ground mace | 1 cup grated mozzarella cheese
instructions: Blend cantaloupe, basil, ginger, thyme sprigs, and mace together in a large bowl. Sprinkle with cheese and mix to coat. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: shiso leaf,pecan,rye bread,veal,cremini mushroom,chipotle chile adobo
title: Chipotle-Veal Pattyettes
ingredients:
1 tablespoon chipotle chile in adobo | 1 ounce cremini mushroom, finely chopped | 1/2 ounce roasted deli sliced deli mixed shiso leaves | 1 tablespoon pecans, chopped | 1 teaspoon cremini shaved peppercorn 
    - 2 1/2 tablespoons coarsely chopped dry-roasted vegetarian steamed veal, shredded | 5 slices rye bread
instructions: In a nonstick skillet, mash the chipotle chile with adobo and mushrooms. Add shiso leaves, pecans and veal. Place sandwiches on a grill rack and grill to desired crispness.

title: Italian Tomato Rolls
ingredients: 1 pint cherry tomatoes, quartered | 2 cups part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded
instructions: Place a cherry tomato on a clean work surface. Sprinkle with cheese. Using your hands, roll the tomato around the cheese, trying not to break it completely. Repeat with the remaining ingredients.

title: Almond Filling for Dipping
ingredients: 1 cup sliced almonds | 1 teaspoon granulated garlic ( granulated, not garlic paste! ) | 1/2 cup oil, for frying | 1 1/2 teaspoons grand marnier, plus more | grand marnier, for drizzling
instructions: Combine almonds, ghee, garlic and grand marnier in a blender, blend until a fine paste forms. Add more grand marnier if desired.

title: Cheesecakes
ingredients: 2 cups shredded okra | 2 cups plain yogurt | 1/4 cup shredded cajun seasoning, or to taste | 1/2 cup grated pecorino-romano cheese
instructions: Preheat an oven to 400 degrees f. Combine the okra, yogurt, cajun seasoning, and cheese in a bowl. Form the mixture into cakes about 2 inches long by 2 inches wide. Place about 2 tablespoons of the crumb mixture onto the center of each cake. Bake under the preheated broiler until golden brown, 3 to 5 minutes. Allow the cakes to cool, cut into slices, and serve.

Random Ingredients: vegetable broth,snow pea,garam masala,pork shoulder,butterscotch pudding mix,grain rice,serrano ham
title: Pork Stew
ingredients: 5 lbs boneless pork shoulder or 5 lbs round steaks, cubed | 2 packages butterscotch pudding mix | 1 can vegetable broth | 1 box long grain rice | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1/2 lb snow peas ( optional ) | 6 ounces serrano ham, chunked
instructions: Heat oven to 325°f. Coat crockpot with cooking spray. Put pork into crockpot add pudding spice and broth and stir. Cover and cook on high for 10 hours. Add ham and peas cook for 2 more hours. Serve over basmati rice.

title: Spicy Pineapple Alfredo
ingredients: 2 cans chicken broth | 1/2 cup frozen pineapple chunks | 1 cup prepared alfredo sauce | 1/2 cup coffee
instructions: Pour all contents of sauce into a large skillet on the stove. Heat over medium heat until hot, stirring frequently. Pour the contents of one can of chicken broth into saucepan, and bring to a boil. Remove from heat, and stir in the pineapple, breaking each piece in half as it melts. Pour the sauce over noodles, and serve.

Random Ingredients: dark chocolate,dark brown sugar,french baguette,chinese wine,havarti cheese,thai red curry paste,sesame oil
title: Chile-Seared Cheesecake French Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf french baguette, cut into 3/4-inch-thick slices | 1/2 cup dark aged dark chocolate, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup sweet asian wine | 2 tablespoons sweetened dark brown sugar | 3 tablespoons chinese wine | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 3 tablespoons french baguette, cut diagonally into 1/3-inch-thick slices | 1/2 cup havarti cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat broiler. Place slices of bread in a single layer on an oiled baking sheet, and broil until lightly toasted, about 2 minutes. Immediately remove from baking sheet, and set aside. Melt chocolates in a small bowl over hot water. Stir in brown sugar until smooth.

title: Pimentos De Florina (Pimentos Frescas)
ingredients: 2 cups diced papiento | 1 tablespoon parsley flakes
instructions: Add the pimiento to a skillet over medium heat. Cook stirring constantly with a wooden spoon until the pimentos have become limp and starting to smell slightly dry. Remove the skillet from the heat. Stir in the parsley flakes. Spoon the contents of the skillet into a bowl and let cool completely. Store in refrigerator, pressing the mixture into hot air.

title: Korean Bok Choy Snack
ingredients: 1 lb fresh baby bok choy ( substitute baby bok choy ) | 2 teaspoons ground coriander
instructions: Heat a wok or kdium on medium high, and add a few tablespoons of water, and swirl around to coat the bottom of the pan. When it starts to sizzle, add the baby bok choy, and stir fry for a few minutes. Toss in the ground coriander, and continue to stir fry until it's wilted and coated with the spices. Serve with white rice.

title: Papa Dave's Saffron Pasta
ingredients: 1/4 cup dried rubbed sage leaves | 2 tablespoons sweet paprika | 1/2 teaspoon saffron threads or 1/4 teaspoon ground dried saffron | 7 cups boiling water | 1 cup chopped fresh sage leaves ( for garnish ) | 1 cup plain yogurt ( for garnish ) or 1 cup sour cream ( for garnish ) | 1 lb rigatoni pasta or 1 lb other thin spaghetti | confectioners'sugar or plain yogurt, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f. For the pesto, in small bowl, mix 1/4 cup sage leaves with paprika and saffron. Stir in 5 cups hot water until mixture comes to a boil. Remove from heat. Stir in 6 cups sage leaves. For the pasta, bring 4 quarts water to boiling in large kettle with 1 1/2 tablespoons salt. Add 1 pound rigatoni pasta or other spiral shaped pasta. Cook until 'al dente', stirring occasionally. Drain. In a large bowl, mix yogurt with pesto. Stir in remaining sage. Taste, and add more salt if needed. If desired, garnish with reserved sage and drizzle with soured topping. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours. Serve with reserved sage dressing or yogurt.

title: Basic Taco Sauce
ingredients: 12 ounces hot sauce | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and store in a covered glass container.

title: Ancho Chili Butter
ingredients: 3 dried red chilies | 2 teaspoons dried ancho chile powder | 2 tablespoons dried basil | 1 2/3 cups dashi | 1/4 cup butter or margarine, softened | topping :
instructions: Place the chilies in a small dry skillet over medium heat and toast chilies until soft. Transfer chilies to a blender or food processor and blend until finely chopped. Add the ancho chili powder and basil to the pureed chilies. Heat dashi in a small saucepan until simmering. In a medium saucepan over medium heat, combine the butter and the roasted chilies. Add enough hot water to cover the chilies and bring to a boil, stirring frequently. Boil for 5 minutes. Remove from heat, stir into the chili mixture and pour into a pastry bag fitted with a 3/4 inch star tip. Keep pastry bag covered at all times with plastic wrap to prevent drying. To freeze, refrigerate covered container up to 6 days.

Random Ingredients: mustard powder,sage,taco seasoning,mushroom cap,walnut,pineapple chunk,chicken bouillon granule,baby spinach
title: Hawaiian Spinach
ingredients: 2 packages baby spinach, washed | 1 can pineapple chunks, drained | 1 jar sliced mushroom caps | 3 tablespoons chicken bouillon granules | 1/4 cup chopped walnuts | 1 tablespoon dry mustard powder | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon dried sage
instructions: Heat the oven to 300 degrees f. Tightly mix all ingredients together in a 2 quart casserole dish. Cover and bake for 45 - 60 minutes, or until the spinach becomes tender. If the mixture becomes too dry, rinse with 1 or 2 tablespoons water. Allow to cool and serve.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,tomato paste,lamb shoulder,pinto bean,cherry,pepperoni
title: Stuffed Cherry Bombs
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans | 12 cherry tomatoes | 1/2 cup sharp cheddar cheese | 3 tablespoons tomato paste ( ketchup ) | 6 lamb shoulder | pepperoni, chopped
instructions: Cook pinto beans in boiling water according to package directions. Drain and cool to room temperature. Chop remaining ingredients. Dab hands and roll lamb shank into balls. Place on baking sheet. Cover with foil and bake at 375 degrees for about 35 minutes or until well done. Remove the foil and bake another 10 minutes or until desired browning is achieved. Serve at room temeprature.

title: Bayerische Schweinepuffer (Danish Feta Cheese Spread)
ingredients:
2 cups non-fat milk | 1 cup sliced dry mushrooms | 1/4 cup crumbled feta ( about 3/4 of a 10 oz.
    - package ) | 1/4 cup seedless raisin ( about 3-4 raisins ) | 4 tablespoons creme de cacao ( optional, or substitute with 1/4 cup powdered sugar and 1/4 cup water ) | 1 pinch grated nutmeg | fresh dill sprig, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Whisk the milk and the next three ingredients in a medium saucepan over medium high heat. Whisk often, making sure the milk doesn't boil over. Remove from the heat when the mixture begins to bubble, and stir in the feta, raisins, and the crème de cacao. Stir to blend. Transfer to a serving bowl or a platter. Garnish with a sprinkle of ground nutmeg and fresh dill springs if using.

title: Polish Sausages and Smoked Salmon With Rice and Sweet-Hot Salami
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs smoked lean pork ( or smoked ham ) or 1 1/2-2 lbs other turkey fillets ( or smoked ham ) | 1 tablespoon olive, for sauteing | 3 slices smoked polish sausage ( see directions ) | 1 cup bulgar saffron rice or 1 cup arborio rice | 1/4 cup seasoned vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1 1/2 lbs mixed and smoked salmon fillets, cut into 3 to 4 inch length | 1 1/2 1 1/2 lbs smoked salmon fillet, cut into 3 to 4 inch lengths | 1 1/2 cups sliced ripe olives or 1 1/2 cups pimiento stuffed olives
instructions: The day before. Cut sausage into 3/4 thick slices. Arrange sausage slices lengthwise in a broiler proof casserole dish, top with sliced meats. Mix together bulgur, vinegar and cinnamon in a bowl. Add bulgur mixture and mix with hands to combine. Arrange olives evenly over meat, cover tightly and marinate at room temperature for 8 to 24 hours. Remove casings from casings and rinse in cold water. Preheat oven to 350°f place a rack on a roasting pan. In a 2 quart casserole dish, arrange salmon over meat mixture. Pour bulgur mixture over fish, cover tightly and bake 45 to 50 minutes or until fish is firm. Remove from oven and arrange olives on top. Cook until fish flakes easily with a fork.

title: Tortellini With Sesame Chipotle Dip for One
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated cheese tortellini, cooked according to package directions and drained | 1 cup dry sesame seeds | 1/2 cup melon, sliced in half, seeds removed | 1/4 cup chipotle chile, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons wine or 2 tablespoons beer, for cooking
instructions: Heat 3/4 - 1 cup water to boiling in shallow saucepan. Add pasta and cook until just tender but firm, stirring occasionally, about 6 minutes. Drain well and return to pan. Combine sesame seeds and remaining 1/4 cup liquid used to cook the pasta in and mix well. Pour over pasta and toss with chile and remaining 1/4 cup sesame seed mixture. Serve immediately.

title: Chinese Steakhouse Steak Seasoning
ingredients: 6 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1 tablespoon steak seasoning salt ( like lawreys ) | 1 tablespoon hot pepper flakes or 1 tablespoon minced fresh hot pepper
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large, wide shallow nonreactive frying pan or wok. Heat over high heat. As soon as the oil shimmers, immediately move the pan from the heat source into your warm skillet. It will warm the wok, creating steam that will be needed to maintain a steady steady flow of oil in the pan. Let the pan cook until the temperature at the thickest part of your steaks registers 190°f. Slice the steaks into 1/2 inch thick slices and serve with sweet and sour sauce, brown rice, or noodles.

Random Ingredients: thai red curry paste,pineapple chunk,hot chili sauce,bread crumb,salt pork,bean sprout,chinese five spice powder,chili paste
title: Spicy Pineapple Crumb Breaded Spam Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/2 pound lean salt pork, cut into 1/8-inch cubes | 1/2 cup dry bread crumbs | 1 teaspoon chinese five-spice powder | 1/4 teaspoon bottled hot chili paste ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon thai red curry paste ( optional ) | 2 cans unsweetened pineapple chunks, drained | 1 cup fresh bean sprouts | 1 jar prepared chili paste ( optional ) | salt to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Place the salt pork with bread crumbs, five spice powder, chili paste, and hot chili in a large bowl and toss to blend. Place pineapple chunks in a third bowl of ice water to soften, about 10 minutes. Pat pineapple mixture down with fingers. Place bean sprouts on a clean work surface and drizzle each one with 1/4 cup of chile paste. Toss gently to coat beans sprouts slightly with paste. Sprinkle 1/4 cup of basil on each burger, being careful not to break them. Cover burger halves with a clean sheet of aluminum foil. Bake in preheated oven, about 30 minutes, or until crisp and lightly browned. Serve immediately.

title: Smoked Salmon Wrapped in Spicy Tortillas
ingredients: 14 ounces smoked salmon fillets | 14 ounces pimento stuffed olives, sliced | 14 ounces tortillas
instructions: Slice salmon on two long diagonal slabs, place on a cutting board and cut the lengthways down the centre to make a cross cut. Use the two long diagonal cuts to make a cross shape. Take the two halves out and cut out the centre of the salmon with scissors. Reserve the trimmings for the sauce. Stuff the slices of salmon with the olives inside. Wrap each piece of salmon with a thick slice of tortilla.

Random Ingredients: cheese tortellini,scallion,buckwheat flour,white onion,grand marnier,bulk pork sausage,pumpkin,wild rice
title: Crock Pot Wild Rice Goulash
ingredients: 2 lbs bulk pork sausage | 1 large white onion, minced | 3 cups fresh brown rice | 1 1/2 cups buckwheat flour | 1 jar pumpkin | 1/4 cup grand marnier or 1/4 cup other brandy | 1 handful of shredded cheese tortellini | 1 bunch of chopped scallion ( green onions )
instructions: Brown sausage in skillet, and place in bottom rack. Place brown rice in bottom of crock pot. Cut sausage into 1 inch slices, then place into crock pot. If the pork sausage is large you can use one of the large links, depending on the size of the sausage links. Add minced white onion, rice, buckwheat flour. Stir until flour coated all of the rice and breads. You may not use entire jar of pumpkin but you may have leftover. Cook on low for 7 - 9 hours. You may uncover to check for leaks and cook for longer if desired. Turn crock pot on high for 1 hour then turn to low. After 1 hour you will have a delicious gooey green onion top over cooked rice and a beautiful green top. Top with shredded cheese and chopped green onions, as desired. I served this on a crisp bed of rice with some chopped fresh parsley and a salad. We also served this with red onion salad with fresh guacamole for a kick on the end of cooking.

title: Roasted Beet and Carrot Saute
ingredients:
2 1/3 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1/2 cup warm water, about 110 degrees | 3 1/2 cups mixed baby carrots or 3 1/2 cups kale, torn into 1/2 inch pieces ( about 12-inch or 1.
    -5 pounds ) | 2 tablespoons soft butter | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water in a large bowl, stirring well. Sprinkle carrot with salt and set aside to rise until creamy, about 1 hour. Preheat oven to 450 degrees fahrenheit. Butter a large loaf pan or a jellyroll pan and set aside. Add butter to baking sheet and set oven rack about 6 inches from heat. Transfer carrots and 1/4 cup water to the buttered pan, spreading into an even layer. Cover and bake until just tender, about 1 hour, stirring occasionally. Add 1/4 teaspoon turmeric and toss to mix. Season with 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper if desired. If not using kale, you may be tempted to add a little liquid to help keep the carrots from browning too much. Remove from oven and brush with remaining 1/4 cup water, if needed. Transfer to a serving platter and serve.

title: Chickpea and Peas Puree
ingredients: 2 cups split peas | 125 g chickpeas, washed and soaked overnight | 150 ml heavy cream | extra peas ( to garnish )
instructions: Soak the peas overnight in water, bring to the boil.

title: Red Beans with Red Pepper
ingredients: 1 lb dried red kidney beans | 2 large red peppers, roasted and peeled | 2 tablespoons fine salt | 2 tablespoons currants or 2 tablespoons sultanas ( optional )
instructions: Sort the beans, discarding any damaged ones they may have. Put them in a wide saucepan and cover with water. Add 2 pinches of salt. Simmer gently for about 1 hour, until tender and creamy. Rinse the beans under running water until all the water has been absorbed. Drain, reserving about 1 cup of the cooking liquid. Return the beans to the pan and add the peppers and juice. Cover and allow to simmer, stirring every so often, for about 1 hour. Taste and make sure the beans are soft and tender. If necessary, cook the mixture up to 30 more minutes for a slightly chunky consistency. The beans may be heated gently right away, but be careful not to mash them for too long, as this will toughen them if they don't taste like they're cooked.

title: Terra's Ultimate Vegan Black Bread
ingredients: 1/2 cup brown rice, steamed ( not instant or instant ) | 1 teaspoon salt | 1 ounce tequila | 1/4 ounce xanthan gum | 1 packet dry yeast cakes | 4 cups cooked rice, any kind | 1 1/2 cups dried cranberry juice
instructions: Put all ingredients in your food processor and blend until smooth, stopping once or twice to scrape down the sides with flat blade. Set aside. Bake in a very hot oven, 375°f for approx 40 - 45 minutes or until lightly brown. For a 1200 proof loaf, bake for 40 - 50 minutes at 175°f.

title: Blue Cheese, Garam Masala &rocket Fingers
ingredients: 200 g blue cheese, sliced | 3 teaspoons garam masala | 65 g rocket, rocket leaves, washed, dried & coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c / fan 180c / 375f / gas put the blue cheese slices in a shallow ovenproof dish & scatter over the garam masala. Roast in the oven for 5 - 10 minutes or until golden & crisp. Toss the rocket leaves & rocket with half the remaining garam masala & sprinkle over the remaining garam masala. Serve, drizzled with remaining sauce.

title: Mashed Pumpkin Bread
ingredients: 3 cups mashed pumpkin with puree | 2 cans canned cherries in tomato juice | 3 serrano peppers, chopped | 2 tablespoons strong coffee | 8 flour tortillas | 3 tablespoons grated parmigiano
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Combine the pumpkin, cherry juice, serrano peppers, and strong coffee in a large mixing bowl, and stir well to mix. Line a 9x5 inch loaf pan with aluminum foil. Spread the mashed pumpkin mixture on the foil, and top evenly with the tortillas. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake in the preheated oven until heated through, about 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pimiento,egg noodle,chicken breast,kidney bean,lemon extract,green chili
title: Hannah's Mexican Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken breasts, bone-in | 1 can kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 2 tablespoons pimientos, minced | 2 tablespoons green chili, sliced | 1/2 teaspoon lemon extract, if desired | 7 ounces egg noodles, uncooked
instructions: In deep freezer dish, mix chicken, beans, pimientos, chili, lemon extract and eggs. Seal.

title: Spicy Cashew Nut Soup
ingredients: 2 cups vegetable broth or 2 cups canned vegetable broth | 1 1/4 ounces cashew nuts
instructions: In a small pot place the cashews and water on low heat and leave to soak for about 30 minutes. In a large pot pour the boiling broth and leave to boil. Add the cashews and return to the boil. Reduce the heat and leave at gentle boil to reduce the liquid on top of the pot by about 1/ serve hot.

Random Ingredients: currant,vanilla ice cream,green bell pepper,pepperoni,chili pepper flake,potato traditional
title: Creamy Potato and Pepperoni Parfait
ingredients: 2 lbs potatoes ( about 2 medium-size, peeled ) | 3 green bell peppers, seeded, and sliced thin | 2 lbs pepperoni, sliced thin ( or more ) | 1/2 cup dried currant, soaked in hot water | 1/2 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 1 scoops vanilla ice cream
instructions: Bring potatoes and 5 quarts water to boil in a large stock pot over medium high heat. Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, 15 minutes. Add peppers, and cook 15 minutes longer. Reduce heat to medium and stir in remaining ingredients. Increase heat, and simmer, uncovered, 5 minutes, stirring frequently. Remove from heat and let sit undisturbed, 5 minutes to rest for 10 minutes. Remove pepperoni slices from pot, cool, slice, and arrange on a platter. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,corn chip,vegetable shortening,pork sausage,apricot preserve,fig
title: South Beach Diet Mexican Lasagna
ingredients: 2 cups crushed corn chips | 1/4 cup vegetable shortening | 1 package smoked pork sausage, diced | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained | 1/4 cup apricot preserves, crushed | 1 box frozen figs, thawed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. In a medium bowl, mix together the corn chips and shortening. Stir in the sausage. Place half of the sausage mixture into the bottom of the prepared baking dish. Spread half of the preserves over the sausage mixture, and sprinkle with the remaining sausage mixture. Arrange half of the figs over the preserve, and top with the remaining figs. Bake for 25 minutes in the preheated oven, until hot and bubbly.

title: Lamb Cutlets
ingredients: 4 lamb cutlets | 3 vanilla pods
instructions: Heat a pan over a medium flame. If you have a thick bottom glass pan, like one from the bakery, you need to do this. Add the vanilla pods to the pan before browning them on both sides. As soon as the edges start to brown, sprinkle them with salt and pepper and lower the heat. Leave the cutlets to cook for about 20 - 25 minutes. These cutlets should be very nicely browned on the outside but still moist in the middle when cooked. Serve warm with plain yoghurt and lemon curd.

title: Grapefruit Meatloaf
ingredients: 1 lb ground lean pork | 1/2 lb ground ham | 1/2 tablespoon dried chili pepper flakes | 3/4 cup kalamata olive, sliced | lime wedge
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Combine pork, ham, chili flakes and olives. Mix with hands to blend well. Place into a large, flat loaf pan and add the olive slices. Sprinkle with lime wedge. Bake for 45 - 50 minutes or until a thermometer reads 160°f.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,red pepper flake,pimiento,raisin,frangelico,tofu,picante sauce,grain white rice
title: Spicy Rice With Tofu and Veggies
ingredients: 1/2 package firm tofu, drained of fat ( i just used 2 packages of regular tofu ) | 3/4 cup medium grain white rice | 1/2 lb ripe raisins or 1/2 lb currants, halved | 2 tablespoons dry onion soup mix | 1 jar sliced pimiento | 1 ounce hot sauce or 1 ounce dry red pepper flakes | 1 bag frangelico ( or ricotta cheese combined with 1/4 cup milk ) | 1/4 cup picante sauce, for drizzling
instructions: Cut the tofu into 1/2 inch cubes. Cook the rice, drain and set aside. Preheat oven to 350°f. In a large skillet, over medium heat brown tofu in a little olive oil. Remove tofu from skillet and put to the side. In the same skillet, combine the other tablespoon of olive oil with the onion soup mix, pimentos, red pepper flakes and 1/2 of the rice. Cook until rice is well coated, stirring frequently. Stir in the tofu and hot sauce. Spoon in 1/2 of the liquid from the skillet. Bake covered for 25 - 30 minutes. Serve sprinkled with picante.

title: Parsley Butter Spread for Chilled Seafood
ingredients: 3 tablespoons unsalted butter, unsalted | 1 tablespoon minced flat leaf parsley | 1 teaspoon mustard | 1 small serrano pepper, minced | 1/4 cup pistachios, coarsely crushed or 1/4 cup cashews, coarsely chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Mix well. Refrigerate until ready to use. Keeps several days.

title: Irish Bread Pudding
ingredients: 1 box jiffy yellow cake mix, you may not use it all | 1 1/3 cups raisins | 1 teaspoon nutmeg
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Dump all dry ingredients and mix. Dump all items into greased oven dish. Bake for about 50 minutes until golden brown and cake is done.

Random Ingredients: chicken,ketchup,spinach leaf,sage leaf,rice noodle,cream onion soup
title: Easy, Quick and Easy Chicken and Beef Noodle Soup
ingredients: 1 lb chicken, cooked and cubed | 3 cups chicken or 3 cups beef broth | 1 can cream of onion soup | 4 -5 fresh spinach leaves | 4 cups fresh rice noodles ( about 6 ounces ) or 4 -5 japanese noodles ( about 6 ounces ) | 1 bunch fresh sage leaf
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. Saute chicken and add to meat, soup, and spinach. Simmer for ten minutes until flavors blend. Add noodles and sage. Serve soup as directed and add the sage leaves before serving. Also, you can add the noodles to broth, just allow them to soak up the flavors. Serve with extra ketchup or salt, if desired.

title: Tongolian Beef Sandwiches
ingredients:
1/4 cup fresh parsley flakes | 2 lettuce leaves | 4 slices tasty cheese ( recommended, e.
    -g.
    - kraft ) | 6 tea bags
instructions: In a small bowl combine the parsley flakes and 1/4 cup water to make a sauce.

title: Mamool's Butterflavoring I
ingredients: 1 package active dry yeast | 5 cups flour, approximately
instructions: Dissolve the yeast in 1/4 cup of hot water. Add the flour until you have a loose dough. Let rise in a bowl for about one hour. Turn dough onto lightly floured surface and knead until smooth and elastic. Set dough aside. Grease 2 pans or line with parchment paper. Let raise until dough is almost double in size. Punch dough down. Turn out onto floured surface. Divide into 16 equal pieces. Roll each piece into a rope about 14 inches long. Cut into 2 equal strips for 2 loaves. Place the loaves on greased pans. Brush each loaf with an egg wash. Let rise in a warm place until doubled, about 1 hour, depending on your oven. Preheat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit. Bake the loaves for approximately 1 hour and 15 minutes until golden brown.

title: The Easiest & Best Turkey Tender Packet for Turkey
ingredients: 2 kg turkey breast, in pieces if you can see the fat of the skin | 1/3 cup red wine, a fruity red ( or to taste ) | 1/2 cup water, a fruity red ( or to taste ) or 1/2 cup water ( or to taste )
instructions: Preheat oven to 150c. Cut the turkey into 1cm thick slices. Spread a layer of foil on a baking tray. Place turkey slices in a well buttered & oiled packet. Mix red wine/water mix well & apply to turkey with a brush. Place packet on oven tray and bake for 12 - 14 mins or until turkey is cooked & tender. Serve with gravy or your favourite veggies.

title: Tor Dal
ingredients: 225 g toor dal | 375 ml molasses | 125 ml sun-dried tomato molasses | 225 g dark brown sugar | 5 saffron strands | 3 teaspoons oil
instructions: Clean the lentils and soak them in water overnight. Drain them, bring them to a boil on the hob and simmer over high heat for 45 to 50 minutes or until tender. Strain. Add the dark brown sugar and stir well. In a frying pan, saffron strands can be added if you like a stronger flavour. Make sure to heat well, because otherwise they can burn. Heat up two teaspoons of oil and fry the croutons. Pour this all over the lentils. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: pinto bean,extra virgin olive oil,kaffir lime leaf,anaheim chilies,white truffle oil,chicken bouillon granule
title: Spicy Refried Beans
ingredients: 1 cup pinto bean, rinsed and picked over | 2 fresh kaffir lime leaves, stems removed and finely chopped | 8 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil, divided | 1/3 - 1/2 cup chicken bouillon granules | 4 large white truffle oil, for frying | 1 anaheim chilies or 1 poblano pepper, seeded and cut in 2-inch squares, for garnish
instructions: Soak beans in water overnight, or at least 8 hours for a softer, more intense flavor. Drain and place in a large mixing bowl. Cover with fresh water. Dry roast the kaffir lime leaves over a burner of hot water until lightly colored. Remove from heat and crush. Set aside. Heat 1 t. Olive oil in a large non stick skillet over medium heat. Add beans and stir, coating all of them with the olive oil. Cook, stirring often, until the beans are softened. Add 3 t. Of the chicken stock and stir. Add 1 c. Of the remaining stock. Return to a boil, reduce heat, cover and simmer until very soft, about 20 - 30 minutes.. Stir in the remaining lime leaves and remove from heat. Toss the beans with the truffle oil just before serving, and garnish with julienned chilies.

title: Curry Tacos
ingredients: 1 lb lasagna sheet | 1 can spaghetti sauce | 1/2 - 3/4 cup sour cream | 8 ounces sour cream | 2 -3 teaspoons curry powder | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 -2 bunch fresh herbs, chopped or 2 -3 dried herbs | 1 -2 bunch fresh mint leaves
instructions: Layer 1 ingredients, starting with noodles, then sauce, then mint leaves. Repeat layers until the filling is used up.

title: Chile Con Limone (Grilled Mojito Balls)
ingredients: 1 cup dried breadcrumbs | 1 serrano chilies, minced or 1 minced jalapeno | 1 small garlic clove, minced | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 1 tablespoon dried currants
instructions: To make mojito, combine all ingredients in a small bowl and mix well with hands. For best results, make a paste with the dried currant leaves and set aside to last for a few days to let flavors develop. Makes about 1/3 cup.

title: Nagie's Indian Risotto
ingredients: 1 cup potato ( cooked, peeled and chopped ) | 1 1/4 cups arborio rice | 4 tablespoons plain yogurt | 2 sheets nori
instructions: Prepare the risotto as per package directions using cold water. Drain. Mix together the potatoes and arborio rice. Mix in the yogurt. To wrap, place about 1 tablespoons of mixture on one end of a nori sheet and sprinkle with a pinch of salt. Fold in half and roll up like a cigar. Repeat. After the nori sheet is done, put a plate on top and place each roll in a large bowl or deep bowl. Serve immediately with lots of your favorite condiments.

Random Ingredients: pimiento,cayenne pepper,coffee bean,sherry,palm sugar,celery rib,italian salad dressing,five spice powder
title: French Dressing Dressing
ingredients: 2 celery ribs, coarsely chopped, white parts reserved | 3 -4 tablespoons canned espresso beans or 3 -4 tablespoons dry sherry ( about 2 ounces ) | 3 tablespoons fat-free coffee beans, liquid reserved from canned espresso beans | 4 tablespoons reduced-fat italian salad dressing | 2 tablespoons snipped pimento | 1/4 teaspoon five-spice powder | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 tablespoon palm sugar ( optional ) or 1 tablespoon granulated sugar ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a small mixing bowl. Cover and chill in the refrigerator until fully chilled, at least 3 hours or overnight. Serve over salads, bread, crackers, lettuce or vegetables of your choice.

title: Beef and Potato Potatoes
ingredients: 6 small baking potatoes | 200 g white mushrooms | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 2 teaspoons coarsely crushed dried breadcrumbs ( chewy ) | salt and pepper
instructions: Pre heat the oven to 200°c. Peel the potatoes and slice the potato thickly. In a bowl, mix the seasoning ingredients. Brush a baking tray with oil. Place a layer of potato on it and top with the seasoning mixture. Repeat with another layer of potato and seasoning. Cover with foil or lid to prevent potatoes from drying out. Place on the centre shelf of the oven and bake for around 12 minutes. Turn the oven down to 150°c and cook for 1 hour. Serve with your favourite vegies.

Random Ingredients: pepperoni,icing sugar,tostada shell,eggplant,plum sauce,balsamic vinegar,seasoning salt
title: Soy and Pepperoni Stuffed Eggplant Rollups
ingredients: 1 eggplant, medium size | 1 package pepperoni | 3 -5 tablespoons soy and pepper sauce | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil or 3 tablespoons vegetable oil | 4 sheets tostada shell, warmed
instructions: First peel and cut the eggplant into cubes. Slice all the way around and scrape out their pulp without cutting all the way around. Mix the soy and pepper sauce with the vinegar into a large bowl. Stir in the soy and pepper sauce mixture. Set aside. Heat the oil or vegetable oil in a skillet. Fry eggplant in a single layer in the heated oil until golden brown. Sprinkle with some salt. Roll each eggplant eggplant in the dressing/vinegar mixture using a slice or two of pepperoni and a spoonful of the heated soy and pepper sauce mixture. Repeat until all the eggplant and pepperoni are used. You may serve these on a plate and drizzle them with any of the remaining dressing/vinegar mixture.

title: Baked Sweet Corned Beef BBQ
ingredients: 4 whole sweet cornish game hens | 1/4 cup sweet pickle relish
instructions: Place honey mustard on each slit in the corned beef. Cover with desired amount of sweet pickle relish. Place on foil.

Random Ingredients: phyllo pastry,pine nut,swiss chard,veal stock,bean,nutritional yeast
title: Veggy Phyllo Braid
ingredients: 5 -6 ounces lean ground veal or 5 -6 ounces lean ground lean chicken | 8 ounces swiss chard, chopped | 1 can baked beans, drained | 1 cup veal stock | 1 box frozen phyllo pastry, thawed | 1/4 cup pine nuts, toasted
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. In a pan, place the ground veal or chicken, chili, swiss chard and undrained baked beans. Heat the veg over medium heat for 10 - 15 minutes. The stock may be reduced considerably by half if you use fat free products. Remove from heat and cool, then combine in a freezer bag or bowl and freeze overnight until solid. Unwrap the phyllo pastry sheets from the freezer and thaw. Preheat oven to 375°f. Using a large mixing bowl, mix the tofu or ground meat mixture, spinach, bean mixture and nuts until well blended. Transfer to a 9 x 13 baking dish and place in preheated oven. For an added touch, add some berry, fresh herb, parsley or parsley flakes to the veggie mixture to give the dish a nice color. Bake 40 - 45 minutes or until puffed, golden and bubbly. Allow to cool. Slice and serve.

Random Ingredients: bacon,raspberry,tortilla strip,wide egg noodle,bread,cardamom seed,milk,brown sugar
title: Raspberry Noodles With Crisp Bacon Crunch
ingredients: 1 ounce raspberries | 1 dash cardamom seed | 2 tablespoons brown sugar | 1 slice bread, crusts removed, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 cup milk | 1/2 ounce bacon, sliced diagonally across the grain 1/4 inch thick | 4 -6 large tortilla strips, 8 inch
instructions: Place the raspberries, cardamom, cinnamon, brown sugar in a small bowl and let it sit at room temperature while you prepare the rest of the meal. Place the bread cubes in a microwave safe bowl, add water just to cover, and allow to soak for 1 minute on high. Drain the bread, but leave excess water in the bowl to prevent burning. Place the bread cubes and remaining brown sugar into a small saucepan, and melt the mixture over medium heat. Add the milk, bacon, and bring to a simmer. Add the noodles, and return to a simmer. Cover and cook 10 minutes or until tender. Serve immediately.

title: Chef John's Halva
ingredients: 1 1/3 cups canola oil | 1 tablespoon aleppo pepper ( mazhar ) | 6 cups confectioners'sugar
instructions: Place 1 1/3 cup canola oil in a deep, heavy skillet. Place the mazhar in the oil, and pour a small amount of water into the skillet. Sprinkle aleppo pepper into the oil, and cook the halva for 15 minutes. Remove the halva from the skillet, cover with a paper towel, and cool until able to handle, 3 to 8 minutes. Cut the halva into squares 3/4 inch thick and roll into confectioners' sugar while still warm. Store halva in a airtight container at room temperature.

title: Pineapple Fried Rice
ingredients: 2 cups long-grain white rice or 2 cups brown rice, washed and drained | 1 1/3 cups pineapple chunks | 2 -3 tablespoons oil
instructions: In a wok, heat the oil. Drop in the rice, stirring continuously. It will sizzle. Immediately add the pineapples and pineapple. Toss for 2 minutes and then put on a plate covered with paper towel to drain any excess oil in the pan. Serve with warm tea, hot water or ice cold. Enjoy.

title: Lebanese Spice Mix
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried italian herb seasoning | 3/4 cup dried currants
instructions: Combine well and store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,white onion,bailey irish cream
title: Baileys French Onion Juice
ingredients: 5 onions or 5 large onions, peeled and sliced | 1 tablespoon beef bouillon cube | 1 tablespoon baileys irish cream
instructions: Gently peel onions and slice in half. Place sliced onions back in the pan with some stock or beer. Add the boullion cube. Cover with the lid and place in a very slow oven. Cook for 6 hours stirring regularly. Add baileys to taste.

title: Cabbage Salad
ingredients: 1 small head cabbage, cored and shredded | 1/2 cup dried currants | 2 medium tart cherries, pitted and halved | 1/2 cup baby spinach, washed | 1/4 cup finely shredded lettuce
instructions: Arrange cabbage on serving platter. Sprinkle currants over top. Top with cherries and spinach. Sprinkle with lettuce. Voila.

Random Ingredients: heavy duty aluminum foil,oyster sauce,bamboo shoot,brown rice
title: Quick Brown Rice Steak
ingredients: 2 lbs of top sirloin steak | 1 can bamboo shoot, drained | 2 cups cooked brown rice | 6 tablespoons oyster sauce | extra heavy-duty aluminum foil
instructions: Trim excess fat from the steak, making sure it is cut very thin against the grain. Remove the steak from the freezer and season it with olive oil, salt and pepper if you wish. Brush oil on a large, heavy skillet. Heat over medium heat until oil sizzles. Add the meat and sear it on all sides. Place steak into the oil and sear it on all sides until it is brown on one side. Transfer the steaks to a large baking dish. In the same skillet, pour in the oyster sauce and heat for a few seconds to make sure the mixture is hot. Pour sauce over warm meat, then cover and bake at 325 degrees for 1 hour. Serve over hot cooked brown rice.

Random Ingredients: cilantro stem,black cardamom pod,pineapple,tequila,sirloin,mango chutney,jalapeno pepper,tomato juice
title: Grilled Beef Skewers With Tangy Sweet and Sour Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin | 4 tablespoons fresh cilantro stems, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon black cardamom pod, crushed | 1 tablespoon tequila | 4 tablespoons mango chutney ( i prefer dark ) | 1 tablespoon sweet and sour sauce | 1 medium ripe tomatoes with juice, chopped | 1 medium fresh pineapple, peeled, cored, and shredded
instructions: Remove excess fat from sirloin. Cut sirloin into 1inch chunks. Cut into cubes and toss with remaining ingredients. Thread onto skewers and let stand at room temperature 1 hour or refrigerate overnight. Grill over direct medium hot heat about 10 minutes or until no longer pink, turning and rearranging skewers as necessary to prevent sticking. Alternatively the meat can be grilled over indirect medium heat 8 to 10 minutes to an internal temperature of 160 degrees f or medium well. For best results, cover with aluminum foil when cooked, and allow time for meat to relax. Serve with warm sweet and sour sauce.

title: Colombian Queso Dip
ingredients: 1 head cabbage, shredded | 2 poblano chiles, fresh, seeded and thinly sliced | 1/2 cup yellow mustard | 1/4 cup dried sage
instructions: To assemble the queso, place shredded cabbage on a large platter. Place poblano pepper slices over the cabbage, and sprinkle with mustard and sage. Serve with warm corn tortillas.

Random Ingredients: veal,vegetarian beef strip,anaheim chilies,black eyed pea,poppy seed,basmati rice
title: Aussie Cape Beef and Peas Pilaf
ingredients: 1 lb ground veal | 8 ounces veggie beef strips | 32 ounces black-eyed peas, drained and rinsed | 1/4 cup poppy seed, toasted | 7 ounces basmati rice | 3 anaheim chilies, halved lengthwise, seeded, deveined, deseeded and sliced
instructions: Brown meat in frying pan with peppers, set aside. Drain fat from meat. Stir fry peas in fat for 3 min, add rice. Stir fry for 3 min, season with salt and black pepper. Pour in meat into pan with peas, cover and cook over low heat for 35 min, turn off heat and leave for 10 min. Note, a vegetarian can be used in place of beef in this recipe. For vegetarians increase peas & rice.

title: Baked Fish Polevka
ingredients: 5 tilapia fillets | 1/8 cup vodka ( optional ) | 1/4 cup egg substitute ( any type ) | 1 1/2 cups packaged coleslaw mix | 2 tablespoons granulated sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Line 9x9 pan with parchment or aluminum foil and coat with vegetable oil cooking spray or cooking spray. Lay fish out on tray, brush with vodka if using, then spray with egg substitute and sprinkle with granulated sugar. Bake in 350f oven for 10 - 18 minutes, or until fish flakes when prodded.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper,celery rib,rice flour,lettuce,blue food coloring,molasses,radish,allspice
title: Blue Ribbon Hawaiians
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups unsweetened molasses | 2 tablespoons rice flour | 2 teaspoons ground allspice | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 tablespoon rice flour | 1/2 teaspoon red food coloring | 1 tablespoon celery rib, finely chopped | 8 -10 leaves lettuce | 3 -5 radishes
instructions: In saucepan, bring molasses and 1 cup water to boil and remove from heat. Stir in 2 tblsps. Rice flour, allspice and cayenne pepper. Let cool, stirring occasionally. While mixture is cooling, sprinkle rice flour and rest of spice onto a plate. Heat skillet over medium heat and stir in celery and remaining 1/2 cup water. When mixture reaches boiling, stir in food coloring. Continue stirring for 2 - 3 minutes. Add cornflake crumbs, stirring to coat well.

title: Crunchy Oatmeal
ingredients: 1 cup oatmeal | 1 -2 tablespoon chives, chopped, with green tops also | chive, chopped ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Empty oatmeal into a bowl and mix in the chives and if desired sprinkle with chives. Serve immediately.

title: Blueberry Chip Cookie Crumb Pie
ingredients: 1/2 cup seasoned breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup blueberries, chopped | 2 tablespoons broken corn tortilla chips | 1 teaspoon vanilla wafer crumbs | 1/4 teaspoon spices
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Mix all of the ingredients together and coat your pie plate. Bake for 15 minute remove slice and enjoy with a side of guacomole.

title: Zippy Italian Sausages (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 12 italian pork sausage, fully cooked, cut into 1/2 inch slices ( i get those ) or 12 hot italian pork sausages ( i get those ) | 1 cup brown basmati rice or 1 cup brown basmati rice
instructions: Place rice and sausages in crock pot. Top with browns and cook on high for 3 1/2 hours.

title: Cherry Tomato Almond Cream With Almonds
ingredients: 1 cup cherry tomatoes ( about 12 to 16 whole cherry tomatoes ) | 1/3 cup nonfat milk | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract | 4 tablespoons unsalted butter, plus more for coating and basting
instructions: In a saucepan, combine cherry tomatoes, milk and almond extract.

title: Brown Lentil Burgers and Toast
ingredients: 1 cup brown lentils | 250 g honey burger | 1/3 cup currants | 1 teaspoon dried fruit, chopped | 4 slices multigrain bread | 1/2 cup coriander leaves
instructions: Place lentils, burger, currants and dried fruit in a bowl and mash with the back of a fork until combined. Place bread on a tray with the mixture. Cook in a moderate oven for 10 - 15 mins until lightly toasted and heated through. Spread with remaining toasted bread and scatter with coriander leaves.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon granule,cannellini bean,ginger,yellow moong dal,egg noodle,coleslaw mix
title: Quick and Easy Tasty Indian Noodles (Quick & Easy, Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1/2 cup yellow moong dal, raw, thawed | 7 ounces cooked cannellini beans | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon granules, sodium reduced | 2 teaspoons fresh ginger, grated | 1 package coleslaw mix ( i use frozen, but can use other kinds of salad veggies ) | egg noodles, cooked, drained
instructions: Combine the moong dal, cannellini beans and chicken bouillon in the slow cooker. Sprinkle the ginger and coleslaw mix over the bean mixture. Cover & cook on low setting for 6 hours.

Random Ingredients: butternut squash,chicken sausage,ice,half cream,soya sauce,salt pepper,red chili pepper
title: Sauteed Squash
ingredients: 200 g butternut squash | 1 1/4 kg chicken sausage, chinese style if possible | 200 ml half-and-half cream | 75 ml soya sauce | 1 red chili pepper, deseeded, dried, deseeded, dried and finely chopped | salt and pepper
instructions: Peel the squash and cut into chunks. Heat a large frying pan, add the squash, cover and cook very gently on 1 1/4 kgs prawns and keep them stirring until they turn pink and are cooked but not overcooked. When they are cooked, take them out and put aside to cool off as much fat as possible. Pour off any excess fat in the pan, add the chilli and stir fry until fragrant. Return the squash to the pan, add the cream and some seasoning, mix everything and taste. Serve at once topped with the chilli chili mixture.

title: Egg and Tamarind Salad
ingredients: 6 hard-boiled eggs, hard boiled | 1 large yellow onion, diced ( about 1/3 cup ) | 3 tablespoons tamarind juice
instructions: Peel and hard boil the eggs. Slice thin. Add a little fresh water if necessary. Mix the egg slices into the onion. Drizzle with oil and vinegar just before serving.

title: Truffle Mango Salsa With Buckwheat Cracker Broth
ingredients: 2 mangoes, halved and pitted | 1 green bell pepper, chopped | 2 tablespoons coarsely chopped fresh chives | 1 tablespoon coarsely chopped fresh chives | 1/4 cup buckwheat quick-cooking barley | 2 tablespoons salsa | 1 cup besan ( burghul ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 1/4 cup crumbled blue cheese
instructions: Place mango, bell pepper, chives, and chive in a medium bowl. Stir in buckwheat quick cooking barley.

Random Ingredients: cinnamon,beef bouillon cube,mexican tomato,vegetable stock,cashew,italian parsley,cornmeal
title: Ranchero Sauce
ingredients: 1 can mexican-style stewed tomatoes | 5 beef bouillon cubes | 2 cups vegetable stock | 1 cup cornmeal, or as desired | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon | chopped italian parsley, for garnish | chopped cashews, for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Place tomatoes, bouillon cubes, vegetable stock, cornmeal, and cinnamon in a large saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium high heat, then reduce heat to medium low.

title: Cherie's Spinach
ingredients: 1 box spinach ( fresh or frozen ) | 1 lb queso fresco ( sliced small ) | 1 teaspoon dried dill | 1/4 cup sherry ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon vinegar
instructions: Boil 1 box fresh spinach, drain and let drain on paper towel or dish towel for at least 10 minutes to remove excess moisture. Squeeze as much liquid into a bowl as you can with a paper towel or paper towels. Cut off the stems and slice the smaller spinach stems into rings. Cut cheese into 1/2 inch cubes. Put sherry, vinegar and spinach in a large bowl. Add cheese and mix well. Add dried dill and mix well. Let sit for 2 - 3 minutes. Spoon and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: soda water,sea salt,green chili pepper,white sugar,sun tomato oil,lime,almond paste,puff pastry
title: South African Shellfish (Prawns)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon salt | 1 1/2 cups almond paste | 1 teaspoon white sugar | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and chopped | 3 green chili peppers, seeded and chopped | 1 tablespoon lime peel, finely grated | 2/3 cup soda water | 2 puff pastry sheets
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Mix salt, almond paste, sugar and tomatoes in bowl. Dip prawns in almond paste mixture. Arrange in 2 large ovenproof dishes. Bake 15 - 20 minutes, turning once, until golden.

title: Crunchy Corn Chips
ingredients: 2 cups shredded corn chips | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1/4 teaspoon onion powder | 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon | 3 dashes garlic salt | 1 dash orange liqueur or 1 dash worcestershire sauce
instructions: Prepare a large platter with a light coat of cooking spray. Mix all the ingredients together, sprinkle with cheese and toss well. Spread the chips on the platter and surround with the crisp chips. Serve with your favorite chips and sauces.

Random Ingredients: black pepper,puff pastry,ice cream,graham cracker crumb,carrot
title: Cream Pie
ingredients: 1 package frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1 1/2 cups shredded carrots | 1 1/3 cups fresh graham cracker crumbs | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground black pepper | 1/2 cup ice cream as needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Place frozen puff pastry onto a large baking sheet. Combine carrots, graham cracker crumbs, and black pepper in a bowl.

title: Horseradish Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1/4 cup capers | 1 tablespoon dry horseradish
instructions: Mix the capers, horseradish, and dry horseradish together. Refrigerate 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: white vinegar,wheat couscous,golden raisin,ham hock,buttermilk biscuit,browning sauce,coriander,bucatini pasta
title: Litch's Kibbee Noodle Salad
ingredients: 2 cups wheat couscous | 1 can of chopped ham hocks | 1/2 cup browning sauce | 1/2 cup white vinegar | 1 cup buttermilk biscuits, crushed | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 1/4 cup chopped coriander | 1 packet brown-and-serve refrigerated buttermilk biscuits
instructions: Bring 3 cups of water to the boil. Add 2 tsp salt and the couscous and cook according to package directions. Once cooked, fluff the couscous and cool. While the couscous is cooling, prepare the ham meat,. Place the browning sauce, vinegar and chopped ham in a bowl and mix to combine. When the couscous is cool, combine with the remaining ingredients, including the biscuit crumbs.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,meat,fish fillet,pumpkin puree,cocoa powder,daikon radish
title: Spicy Malaysian Meatballs
ingredients: 1 kg meat, diced | 50 g red curry paste | 50 g daikon radishes, finely julienned | 10 -12 medium pumpkin puree ( use a good variety ) | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa powder
instructions: Mix all the ingredients thoroughly except the meat. Make into a small ball sized meatballs, using a bit of your favourite curry paste or vegetable oil. Grill or fry with a little oil and brush with a little oil. Serve with rice and salad. Note, for a variation, add red chili paste or ginger when mashing the meatballs and stir fry the meatballs.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,seasoning salt,red wine,mango chutney
title: Sun Dried Tomato and Mango Chutney
ingredients: 2 cups mango chutney | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, chopped | 1 dash maggi seasoning salt | 1/3 cup red wine ( i use port )
instructions: In a bowl mix all ingredients until blended. Serve hot. Tip, after mixing i use about 1 cup of red wine to 1/2 cup of water to make sure flavors will be blended with everything.

title: Grilled Mustard Lentils in a Snap
ingredients: 1 tablespoon brown lentils, crumbled | 1 tablespoon fresh herb, chopped | 12 marinated artichoke hearts, drained & coarsely chopped | 1 teaspoon grated fresh ginger | 8 ounces bacon grease or 8 ounces vegetable shortening | 1/4 cup chopped mixed fresh herbs or 1/4 cup tarragon
instructions: Cook lentils according to package directions. While lentils are cooking, combine the cooked lentils, chopped artichokes, ginger, and bacon grease/veggie shortening in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: egg white,green bell pepper,cider vinegar,baking powder,salmon fillet
title: Salmon Filet
ingredients: 2 egg whites | 1 3/4 cups cider vinegar | 6 tablespoons finely chopped green bell peppers or 6 tablespoons red bell peppers | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1 pound salmon fillets, skin and bones removed or can salmon fillets, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease a rimmed baking sheet with a vegetable spray. Beat egg whites and vinegar in a glass or metal bowl until foamy. Add peppers, and stir in baking powder. Place 3 fillets in one layer on top of egg whites. Pour half of egg mixture over fish. Using a fork, poke holes in the egg mixture into the holes until it forms a firm, crusty layer. Sprinkle remaining egg mixture on top layer. Bake in preheated oven for 30 minutes or to desired crispiness.

title: Rhubarb Medley
ingredients: 1 lb fresh rhubarb, cut into 1 inch pieces | 8 -10 large fresh thyme sprigs | 1/4 cup maple syrup or 1/4 cup apricot syrup | 1 small yellow bell pepper, cut into 1/8 inch dice | 1/2 cup prunes ( or other plump plums ) | 2 tablespoons granulated sugar
instructions: Place rhubarb in large pot. Add water to cover and bring to a boil. Simmer for 20 minutes or until rhubarb is tender. Cool, then chop into 1 inch pieces. To test for tenderness, poke a small hole in the center of a piece with a spoon. Spoon rhubarb juice inside the hole. Stir in thyme, maple or apricot syrup, bell pepper, prunes and sugar. Let the sauce sit for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Tasteedy Mango and Bacon Lassi
ingredients: 2 bananas, cut vertically in half lengthwise | 3 ounces bacon, sliced crosswise in very thin strips | 6 slices bacon, cut crosswise in half | 1 1/2 cups soymilk | 2 cans frozen orange juice concentrate, undiluted | 2 tablespoons liquid honey | 2 lemon peel, cut into 1/4 in rounds
instructions: Place banana sections cut side up on cutting board. With a sharp knife, score bananas 1/4 inch, then cut bananas crosswise in half. Place 2 strips bacon and 2 pieces of bacon in a large non stick skillet over medium high heat, then cook until bacon is lightly browned, stirring often. Transfer to separate bowl. Place remaining 2 banana halves and remaining 2 strips of bacon in same skillet. Cook, stirring constantly, until bacon is lightly browned and bacon is crisp. Spoon 2 slices of bacon mixture into banana halves and top with 2 slices orange rind, bacon strips and orange marmalade.

title: Sweet and Tangy Italian Dessert
ingredients: 1 package semi-sweet chocolate ( with or without milk or cream ) | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1 cup half-and-half | 1/3 cup palm sugar or 1/3 cup brown sugar, firmly packed | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon palm sugar or 1/2-1 teaspoon brown sugar | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon red bell pepper, finely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Heat chocolate or cream in a small saucepan until very hot. Remove from heat. Dump contents into a medium size bowl. Add cream, sugar, bell pepper and mix well. Stir until sugar is completely dissolved, then pour into a 9 x13 baking dish. Let cool for about 15 minutes, then cut into 3/4 inch squares. Serve cold. Note, can use a square of unsweetened chocolate as an added flavor dimension, instead you might want to use table cocoa or even a hint of raw sugar.

title: Sweet Heat Yam Fudge
ingredients: 5 yams | 2 cups chili sauce | 2 tablespoons brown sugar | 2 tablespoons white sugar | 1 1/2 cups corn chips, crushed
instructions: Place yams in a pan with the chili sauce, brown sugar, and white sugar. In a separate bowl, mix the crushed corn chips together with a little bit of the crushed corn chips. Spread this over the yams. If you are using the whole package of corn chips, leave them in and save for later use. If you are using fresh yams, cut in half and remove the top part of each yam half to make 4 large sections. Spread the crushed corn chips onto the top of the entire yam. You want it to be about a 1/4 inch thick layer, but not completely covering the tops of the yams. Let it sit for about 10 minutes before eating. If you need to eat it now, put in the fridge for 30 minutes. You can use a fork to eat it or in a dish before eating if you like.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil vegetable,black bean,balsamic vinegar,confectioner sugar,lime,mint sprig,brandy
title: Marinated Black Beans
ingredients: 1 pound dried black beans | 1 tablespoon peanut oil or other vegetable oil | 1 1/2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1/2 lime, juiced | 1 tablespoon confectioners'sugar | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh mint sprigs | 1 tablespoon brandy
instructions: Soak black beans in water to cover overnight, or for best texture, until beans are tender. Drain and set aside. Heat oil in a skillet over medium high heat. Add black beans, balsamic vinegar, lime juice and sugar. Cook 5 to 7 minutes, or until sugar is dissolved and syrupy. Stir in mint and cook about 2 minutes longer. Remove from heat and stir into beans. Allow to cool to room temperature. Transfer beans to a serving bowl and refrigerate, covered, at least 1 hour, or overnight. Sprinkle brandy over beans before serving.

title: Miso Snack Mix II
ingredients: 2 cups fresh okra, chopped | 2 cups fresh broccoli florets, chopped | 8 teaspoons miso | 4 teaspoons ground pepper | 2 teaspoons baking soda | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/2 cup finely chopped pecans
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Coat a cookie sheet with non stick cooking spray. In a large bowl, combine okra, broccoli, miso sauce, pepper, baking soda, and oregano. Stir well and cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate for 2 to 24 hours. Spread mixture in a 9x9 inch baking dish. Sprinkle with pecans to serve.

title: Homemade Shortbread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups crisco | 1 cup heavy whipping cream ( heavy cream )
instructions: In a medium bowl, cream together crisco and heavy cream. Mix in the dry ingredients. Turn mixture into a well buttered 9 inch cake pan. Bake at 300 degrees for about 3 1/2 hours on the center rack. Remove and cool completely before cutting with a serrated knife.

title: Spiced Shells and Spring Onions
ingredients: 1 package jumbo pasta shells | 3 cups spring onions, sliced | 2 1/2 teaspoons baking powder | 1 pinch mixed spice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Cook the pasta shells in boiling water until shells are crisp and slightly undercooked. Drain, let cool. Slice the shells in half and place on a lightly greased baking sheet. Bake at 350 degrees f for 10 minutes. Place the onions in a bowl and sprinkle with baking powder, mixed spice and the cooked shells. Bake for 20 minutes or until warmed through and the onion is tender. You may serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Caesar Salad Dressing Beans
ingredients: 3 ounces caesar salad dressing | 14 ounces kidney beans, drained
instructions: Mix all ingredients with crushed pasta.

Random Ingredients: cointreau liqueur,brown sugar,chive,butter,green bell pepper,lemon juice
title:
St.
    - Patrick's Day Teaser
ingredients: 20 tablespoons unsalted butter, at room temperature | 1/2 green bell pepper, finely chopped | 1/4 cup cointreau liqueur | 1/4 cup brown sugar | 1/4 cup lemon juice | 1 tablespoon minced fresh chives
instructions: Combine butter and green bell pepper in a medium bowl. Heat cointreau, brown sugar, lemon juice and chives in microwave for 15 seconds. Immediately pour hot cointreau mixture over salted cold green pepper.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,maraschino cherry,active yeast,self raising flour,cornflour,sesame seed oil,cooking spray,ricotta cheese
title: Fruit & Cheese Loaf
ingredients: 2 cups self-raising flour | 1/2 teaspoon active dry yeast | 1 cup ricotta cheese | 1 cup swiss cheese, shredded | 8 ounces cannage's glace cherries or 8 ounces other dried fruit | 1/4 cup cornflour | 6 tablespoons sesame seed oil | cooking spray
instructions: Place the flour and yeast in a large bowl and, using a fork, stir in the ricotta, swiss cheese, cherries or mixed fruit, cornflour, sesame oil and half of the sesame seeds oil. Pour into a greased loaf tin. Lightly spray a large non stick frying pan with oil and heat on the hob. Drain the loaf and turn out onto a lightly greased, baking sheet, pushing any excess flour into the loaf. Sprinkle with remaining sesame seeds. Slash the loaf into 12 slices, 1cm thick. Brush each loaf with remaining oil, and bake at 190 c for 30 minutes until crisp and golden brown. Serve warm with butter or honey, whipped cream or ice cream.

title: Red Lentil and Cheese Salad
ingredients: 1 green lentil | 1/4 cup red lentil | 1/3 cup cheese, grated
instructions: Place a piece of greaseproof paper on the surface of the salad. Add the red and green lentils. Add grated cheese on top. Heat a small pan on the stove, add water and bring to the boil. Once boiling, carefully pour out the red water. Serve immediately.

title: Easy Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 lb extra lean ground beef | 1 cup vegetable broth | 1/2 cup apple cider | 1/4 cup palm sugar | 1 couscous, cooked
instructions: Cook beef in large skillet, using all the fat, stirring to break up cooked meat. Once done, drain. Return beef to skillet and add broth. Bring to boil, stir in sugar. Cover and simmer for about 10 minutes over medium heat or until meat is done.

title: Homemade Chipotle Rub
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chipotle chiles, or more to taste | 12 tablespoons cornflour, or more if needed
instructions: Blend chipotle chiles with cornflour to make a smooth paste.

Random Ingredients: cornflour,wide egg noodle,mushroom,pumpkin seed,vegetable broth,salmon,orange bell pepper,bicarbonate soda
title: Smoked Salmon and Seed Noodle Soup
ingredients: 1 onion, peeled and chopped | 415 g canned pumpkin seeds | 1 can diced tomatoes | 1 1/2 cups vegetable broth ( i used organic ) | 3/4 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 200 g dried wide egg noodles | 1 orange bell pepper, sliced
instructions: In a large saucepan fry the onion in 1 tbsp of the oil until golden. Drain off any excess fat. Add the pumpkin seeds and the tomatoes and bring to the boil. Slowly pour over the broth. Season, then leave for 1/2 hour or until the soup thickens. Stir in the bicarbonate of soda and stir well. Add the cornflour until a dough forms. Meanwhile, in a separate pan, bring a large amount of salted water to the boil, add the egg noodles, and cook until cooked through. Drain well and set aside. Stir fry the remaining onion and pepper in the remaining oil in a pan for 3 - 4 minutes, then add the hot soup. Serve, sprinkled with orange bell pepper.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,bread dough,graham cracker crumb,worcestershire sauce,bamboo shoot
title: BBQ Melts
ingredients: 1 loaf frozen bread dough | 2 cans bamboo shoots | 1/2 cup vegetable oil | 1/2 cup worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon dry crushed graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Preheat grill on medium heat. Roll out dough on a floured surface and cut into 12 squares. Place on a lightly oiled grill pan. Top each square with 1 tablespoon of the canned bamboo shoots and 3/4 cup of vegetable oil.
