Top with 1/4 cup of worcestershire sauce, graham cracker crumbs and remaining 1/2 cup of canned bamboo shoots and 1/2 cup of vegetable oil. Grill for 15 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Tomato Beef Strips
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs flank steaks | 2 tablespoons vegetable shortening | 1 cup tomato juice
instructions: Cut steaks into strips about 1/3 inch wide. Melt shortening and brown lightly. Add steak strips. Cover and simmer 10 minutes over low heat. Add tomato juice. Simmer 5 minutes.

title: Pastina in a Pan - Pressure Cooker
ingredients: 1 cup dry cannellini beans | 1 tablespoon mirin | 4 cups basic press-cooking pasta | 1 can sliced black olives, drained
instructions: Combine all ingredients in the pressure cooker. Close lid securely and bring to pressure over high heat. Reduce heat to low. Cook 30 minutes. Reduce pressure according to manufacture's instructions. Remove lid of pan.

title: Kebab With Easy Beef Pilaf
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups brown rice, cooked | 1 1/2 lbs minced beef, defrosted | 5 mushrooms, sliced | 10 green cardamom pods, split and deveined ( optional ) | 2 -4 hot sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients except for rice in a mixing bowl. Mix well and stir in rice. Let stand for 5 - 10 minutes. Pack into 2 or 4 greased 2 1/2 2 1/3 pint souffle dishes just large enough to hold them in one layer. Bake, uncovered, in a preheated 375 oven for 1 hour to 1 hour 15 minutes, or until hot.

title: Red Pepper Seasoning Mix for Fish and Chips Chips
ingredients: 1 red pepper, diced | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt
instructions: Combine all the ingredients. Coat each piece of fish with the mixture. Place on a parchment lined or lightly floured grill. Grill for 3 to 5 minutes on each side.

title: Dirty Rice
ingredients: 1 cup rice, washed and drained | 2 -3 tablespoons chutney ( sweet, sour, or your choice ) | 1 tablespoon ground almonds | 1 tablespoon turmeric powder | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 fresh jalapeno pepper ( seeded and minced )
instructions: Stir fry the rice with the chutney and add all ingredients. Cover and set aside for 10 minutes. Fluff with fork and enjoy.

title: El Diablo
ingredients: 3 cups dried currants | 3/4 cup sherry wine | 1 -2 tablespoon rum ( to your taste ) | 8 -10 jalapeno chiles, from a jar, seeded and chopped | 1/2 - 1 cup of cotija cheese | 1/3 cup celery, chopped | 1/3 cup dried currant
instructions: Soak currants over night in sherry, rum, chilies, comino and celtic water. If you want a lot more flavor drain off excess juice. Add celery and currants. Simmer for 1 hour or until celery is soft. Add cheese when finished. Enjoy with chips.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,sugar,coconut,balsamic vinegar,green pea,chili sauce,apricot
title: Vegetable Pudding
ingredients: 500 g green peas | 4 green cardamom pods | 1/2 teaspoon red chili sauce | 1 tablespoon light balsamic vinegar | 150 g desiccated coconut | 2 teaspoons sugar | 400 g apricots
instructions: Wash, stem and cut up apricot. Set aside. Peel and slice up pea pods. Combine with rest of ingredients and chill for 2 to 4 hours. Pour into a 1 pint pudding basin. Cover and place on grid in an oven.

Random Ingredients: turkey,yogurt,cherry,veal shoulder roast,cilantro leaf,peanut oil,chicken breast fillet
title: Persian Chicken & Meat Salzt
ingredients: 800 g skinless chicken breast fillets, fat trimmed | 1 1/2 kg turkey, jointed | 1 tablespoon peanut oil, for brushing | 300 g cherry tomatoes or 300 g grape tomatoes | 1 tablespoon low-fat yogurt | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh cilantro leaves | peanuts or olive oil, for shallow frying
instructions: Heat the oven to 200'c / 400'f. Remove the excess fat from the chicken fillets. Cut the meat into 1cm cubes and set aside. Heat a non stick frypan over a high heat, add the oil and when smoking, add the turkey breast fillets and cook, turning occasionally, until the juices run clear and the meat has begun to brown this should take about 10 minutes. The meat should not be colour, but lightly glazed. Drain the meat and set aside. Increase the heat to high and add the cherry tomatoes. As soon as they begin to soften, add the yogurt and cilantro, stir for one minute and remove from the heat. Place the chicken on a heat proof plate and, with a slotted spoon, remove the cherry tomatoes from their marinade. When it is cool enough to touch, use a slotted spoon to remove all the bitter juices. Spread the chicken fillet on a nonstick oven tray and bake for 15 - 20 minutes or until crispy. Serve with couscous or steamed rice.

title: Lubed Pork Ribs
ingredients: 4 -5 lbs pork shoulder | 1 cup shortening | 1 jar marinara sauce
instructions: Combine shortening and marinara in a deep baking dish or roaster. Coat roast with shortening mixture, then brown in hot oil. Drain. Place roaster with roast on middle rack of oven. Cook, uncovered, at 300 degrees fahrenheit for 6 hours. The pork should be well browned.

Random Ingredients: golden syrup,colby cheese,coriander,dark brown sugar,red bell pepper
title: Mildly Sweet Colby Pepper Chop Suey
ingredients: 180 g colby cheese, cut into 2 cm cubes | 120 g chopped red bell peppers | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 3 tablespoons golden syrup | 2 tablespoons fresh coriander, chopped
instructions: Place all ingredients in a small saucepan and cook over a medium heat for 5 - 6 mins or until the cheese has melted and turned a reddish brown colour. Remove from the heat. Pour into a bowl and let cool slightly, then stir in the chopped coriander until just mixed through. Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: cabbage,mustard powder,cayenne,bicarbonate soda,ziti pasta,golden raisin,camembert cheese
title: Baked Ziti
ingredients: 250 g dry ziti pasta ( about 12 oz ) | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 3 cups cabbage, shredded | 250 g camembert cheese, chopped | 3 tablespoons golden raisins or 3 tablespoons raisins, snipped | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees celsius grease baking dish with a little of the oil. Cook ziti pasta according to recipe description and drain. Meanwhile, in a large mixing bowl combine the rest of the ingredients and mix well until the cheese is evenly melted. Add the noodles and ziti and mix well.. Pour the mixture into the heated baking dish and bake for 40 - 50 minutes or until cooked through. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Lettuce Wraps With Smoked-Lettuce
ingredients: 3 lbs hamburger | 12 lettuce leaves | 12 slices cooked linguine
instructions: Form two 6 inch squares of heavy duty foil wrap large enough to fold up corners of foil. Tightly seal foil to prevent sticking. Place a heaping teaspoon of smoked lettuce filling onto one center of the foil square and fold corners over the burger and roll up tightly. Seal the edges with scissors or a fork. Arrange on baking sheet. Bake in preheated 450f oven until heated through about 15 to 18 minutes. Top with any of the remaining stuffing mixture and serve.

title: Orange Mambo
ingredients: 1/2 lb sugar snap pea, ends trimmed | 1/2 lb bell pepper, cut into 1/4-inch thick strips | 1/8 cup orange liqueur
instructions: Trim the ends from the peas. Cook the peas in boiling water 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add pepper strips. Cool, tossing peas gently with orange liqueur. Store in the refrigerator, tightly covered.

Random Ingredients: lemon extract,hash brown potato,ancho chile powder
title: Algonquin Spice Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 3 large hash brown potatoes, peeled | 2 tablespoons ancho chile powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried ancho chile powder | 1/4 teaspoon lemon extract or 1/4 teaspoon citric acid
instructions: Cut potatoes lengthwise into 4 wedges. Use a fork to spear potatoes. Place wedges, cut side down, between wax paper and cut with a sharp knife or mandoline. Sprinkle potato pieces with one 4 inch slit each. Sprinkle with 1 1/2 teaspoons ancho chili powder and 1/4 teaspoon citric acid. Roll potatoes in spices and place on paper towels to dry.

title: Aji Panca (Pancho Mayonnaise)
ingredients: 4 dried anaheim chilies, stems removed, seeded | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla extract
instructions: Grind the chilies in a food processor to a fine powder and transfer to a mixing bowl. Add the mustard seeds and vanilla, stirring to combine. Cover and refrigerate until ready to use.

Random Ingredients: vanilla bean,bacon,muenster cheese,ranch seasoning mix,baby portabella mushroom,sumac,coconut milk,lettuce
title: Mexican Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 5 -6 baby portabella mushrooms ( sliced thin ) | 24 slices muenster cheese | 12 slices bacon | 1 package ranch seasoning mix ( or your own package ) | 1 can coconut milk | 1/2 vanilla bean | 1 head lettuce | 1 tablespoon sumac
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Clean mushrooms, remove stems and wash off dirt. Slice or cut mushrooms about 1/4 inch thin. Saute bacon in frying pan, remove and set aside, add mushroom caps, cheese and bacon back to pan. Saute mushrooms until browned and soft, remove from heat. Add spices mix and coconut milk, mix well. Fill mushrooms with this mixture, mix, set aside and put into a large casserole dish. Cover and bake for 20 minutes or until lightly browned, remove from oven and let sit for 5 minutes. Mix lettuce with sumac and top over filled mushrooms. Serve with white sauce or your favorite mexican dish. Tip, i always make this in my electric casserole. First, the lettuce, vinegar, etc. And the spices go in next, the nutmeg goes in the last and the nutmeg is added at the end, which should only make you feel satisfied.

title: Potluck Sunday Dinner
ingredients: 4 pork chops | ice ( for brushing ) | 6 -8 small fresh potato rounds | 1 -2 tablespoon crushed farfalle pasta or 1 -2 tablespoon spaghetti sauce | 1 cup crushed fried catalina nugget nuggets ( or croutons ) ( optional ) or 1 cup crumbled smoked herby crumbles ( optional ) | 4 slices star anise ( optional ) or 1 teaspoon anise seed ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place pork chops on a plate and brush lightly with some oil or butter. On a baking sheet, place potato rounds and anise seeds, or sprinkle over the pork chops, if using. Bake, uncovered, until no more pink remains.

title: Dried Salmon & Biscuit Crags
ingredients: 300 g canned salmon ( not drained ) | 400 g digestive biscuits
instructions: Break biscuits into 1/2 in size pieces place on trays/cookie tray or baking tray lined with greaseproof paper. Spread each biscuit piece flat with fingers. Carefully remove the salmon from the tin using your thumb or your finger tips make sure there is no blood in the tuna and put it in the biscuits. Put 1 teaspoon of the tin of salmon on each biscuit and press them flat with your fingers again try not to press them too firmly.

title: Apple Cider Dipping Sauce (Copycat)
ingredients: 1/4 cup sour apple cider | 2 tablespoons taco seasoning mix | 1 tablespoon cherry brandy or 1 tablespoon cognac
instructions: Combine all ingredients together in a jar. Add to individual hot chili or hot dog buns.

Random Ingredients: potato,jumbo pasta shell,rosemary,red pepper flake,tomato ketchup
title: Nicoise Tomato Pasta
ingredients: 6 -16 ounces jumbo pasta shells | 3 cups tomato ketchup | 1 tablespoon red pepper flakes, or to taste ( i use crushed pepper flakes ) | 1 teaspoon fresh rosemary, chopped | 1/2 cup potato, cubed ( optional )
instructions: Cook the pasta shells per package directions, just until tender. Drain, reserving 1 cup of the pasta water. In a small bowl, mix together the ketchup, red pepper flakes, and rosemary. When the pasta shells are done, add the tomato sauce mixture and potatoes to the skillet. Reduce heat to low, and simmer 3 - 4 minutes, until potatoes are tender. If desired, top with shredded cheddar cheese, or a crumbled feta cheese just before serving.

title: Slow-Cooker Corned Beef
ingredients: 4 pounds corned beef brisket, cut into 3/4-inch thick slices | 1 tablespoon dried yeast | 1 teaspoon freshly grated gingerroot
instructions: Place the roast in a slow cooker and sprinkle with the yeast, ginger and 2/3 cup of water. Cover, and set to low heat setting for 6 hours. Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. Carefully place the brisket on a rack set over a roasting pan. Bake for 5 hours in the preheated oven. Increase the heat setting to 400 degrees f, and roast for 10 minutes, or until the meat is browned.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,green bell pepper,pinto bean,salt black pepper,cauliflower,sunflower seed
title: Piccalilli
ingredients: 1 lb dried pinto bean | 1 medium cauliflower, broken into florets | 3 -4 medium tart apples, cored and chopped | 1 large green bell pepper, seeded and chopped | 2 cans chopped sunflower seeds, drained | salt and black pepper
instructions: Combine beans and water in dutch oven or large pot. Bring to boil over high heat cover, reduce heat and simmer until tender, about 45 minutes. Drain. Combine cauliflower, apples, bell pepper and seeds in dutch oven and cook over medium heat until the vegetables are tender crisp, about 5 minutes. Remove and discard the seeds. Add salt and pepper. Return casserole to low heat. Stir beans until heated through, another 10 minutes.

title: Quinoa and Bell Pepper Salad
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa, rinsed ( or couscous ) | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 1 large bell pepper, sliced | 1/4 teaspoon marjoram | 3/4 teaspoon lemon pepper
instructions: Cook quinoa for 25=60 minutes in 3 cups of boiling salted water. Place in a food processor and puree until smooth, about 10 minutes. Place quinoa in large bowl. Sprinkle puree over quinoa. Add all remaining ingredients. Mix well. Spoon into serving dish.

title: Lentil and Pecorino Popcorn
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups lentils, rinsed in cold water | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon | 2 teaspoons orange flower water | pecorino romano cheese, grated
instructions: Place lentils in a pan of cold water and bring water to boil, then reduce heat and simmer 30 - 40 minutes, until lentils are just soft. Meanwhile, combine cinnamon and orange flower water in a small bowl. Spread 1 teaspoon of cinnamon and orange flower water evenly over a shallow pan of hot water or bread pan coated with cooking oil spray and set aside for 5 - 7 minutes. Drain the lentils and add to the pot of boiling water. Cook, stirring occasionally, 5 - 10 minutes, until lentils are tender and fragrant. Remove from heat and fold through cheese. Serve warm.

title: Garlic Aïoli
ingredients: 3 garlic cloves, crushed | 1 cup vegetable broth | 3 tablespoons cornflour | lemon wedge, to garnish
instructions: Place garlic in a small saucepan. Cook in hot water for 30 seconds, then drain and squeeze out excess water. Combine the broth and cornflour in a small bowl. Stir into the soup. Heat through and serve over fish, if desired, with lemon wedges.

title: Beef Kabobs for Two

ingredients: 1/2 large red cabbage, coarsely shredded | 1/2 cup green olives, coarsely chopped | 4 tablespoons tomato puree | 1 -2 tablespoon tahini | 1 1/2 tablespoons virgin olive oil | 1 lb mexican cheese, grated and softened
instructions: Mix the cabbage, olives, tomato puree, tahini, and olive oil in a bowl. Heat an outdoor grill or grill pan on high.

title: Quinoa with Driedaches and Coconut
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked quinoa | 1 cup uncooked quinoa | 1 can sliced peaches | 2 packages frozen chopped peaches, thawed | 1 1/2 cups cider vinegar | 3/4 cup rice vinegar
instructions: Place quinoa in a large bowl, rinse, and set aside. Place quinoa onto a plate. Place quinoa onto a plate. Place peach slices into quinoa, and wrap around quinoa. Place wrapped peaches into a microwave safe dish, and cover.

title: Zucchini Stew With Swiss Green Beans
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs fresh green beans, trimmed | 1 1/2 lbs zucchini, cut in half length-wise and then into 1/2-inch-thick slices, cut crosswise into 1/2-inch thick slices, then into 1/2-inch-wide strips, about 1/2-3-inch thick | 3 tablespoons tomato oil
instructions: In a large saucepan of boiling water, cook the green beans, uncovered, 5 minutes. Drain. Transfer the hot green beans to a colander lined with paper towels and rinse under cold running water, running cold water around the edge. Cut a slit in the end of the green beans to remove any seeds and then in thirds to create a diagonally open oval shaped pocket in the green beans. In a skillet, cook the zucchini 3 minutes or until tender but firm. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the zucchini to a bowl and toss with the tomato oil. Add the drained green beans and squash and toss to coat. Season to taste with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Serve immediately.

title: Spicy Herring
ingredients: 1/4 cup sesame seeds | 2 tablespoons garlic paste | 1 teaspoon ground mace | 2 pounds herring fillets
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Spread the sesame seeds onto a baking sheet. Bake for 10 minutes, shaking to crack the skins. Combine the garlic paste and mace in a small bowl. Rub mixture on the skin of the herrings. Marinate the herrings in the sesame seeds in the refrigerator 30 minutes. Grill the herring over high heat for 5 to 10 minutes, occasionally turning and brushing with the marinade.

title: Asian Style Steak Mushrooms (Pana Lumpia)
ingredients: 2 lbs small baby portobello mushrooms | onion paste, as required ( optional )
instructions: Slice the portobello mushrooms as desired. Take the stems off. Slice them into approximately 1 inch thick rounds. Place the rounds in a bowl of water, adding either ginger paste or onion paste, and let sit for 30 minutes. Place the mushroom rounds onto a grill. They usually take approximately 15 minutes or so on each side. If necessary, use a little oil to lightly brown the mushrooms. Place on paper towel lined plate and drizzle with more sliced onion.

title: Ancho Beef and Rice Skillet
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sirloin, cut into thin slices | 8 cups prepared arborio rice or 8 cups carnaroli rice, cooked and kept hot | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 2 tablespoons dried ancho chile powder
instructions: In a large skillet cook meat over medium high heat just until cooked through, stirring constantly. Add rice and chile powder. Reduce heat to low.

title: Rice Lentil and Yogurt With Whole Wheat Diced Mozzarella
ingredients: 1 package uncooked whole wheat split lentils, rinsed and drained | 2/3 cup quinoa | 2/3 cup shredded low-fat mozzarella cheese | 2 teaspoons white vinegar
instructions: Cook lentils in boiling water to cover until just tender, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: feta cheese tomato,chicken,thyme leaf,red chili pepper flake,parsley,ginger garlic paste,snow pea
title: Spicy Greek Chicken & Snow Peas
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs boneless chicken | 1 teaspoon red chili pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 1/4 teaspoon dried parsley | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1/4 cup reduced-fat feta cheese with herbs, crumbled | 1 bag sliced snow peas
instructions: Cut chicken into 1& 1/2 inch cubes. Sprinkle chicken with red chili flakes, thyme, parsley and garlic paste, coating all pieces. In large nonstick saute pan, over medium high heat, cook chicken until golden brown, about 4 minutes per side. Reduce heat to medium and add peas and cook 2&1/2 minutes more, or until peas are just tender.

title: The Best Tempuerto Rican Salsa
ingredients: 3 tomatillos, stemmed | 2 teaspoons whole mustard seeds | ice
instructions: Rinse tomatillos and dry on paper towel. Place in blender with other ingredients. Pulse on high to chop until you can smell. You want a chunky salsa. Chill several hours or over night to make this much more spicy, stir in fresh jalapeños for garnish.

title: Korean Grilled Pork Loin (Char Chae)
ingredients: 2 lbs loin ( or pork butt with bone ) | 1/2 cup ketchup | 1/4 cup sesame oil | 1/8 cup freshly grated pecorino cheese
instructions: Cut the loin crosswise through the meat in 1/3 inch thick slices, trimming any excess fat. Marinate the meat with the ketchup, sesame oil, and 1/4 cup of the cheese in the refrigerator at least 2 hours, stirring meat frequently and adding more ketchup as it marinates. Drain the meat, reserving any leftover marinade. Grill the meat until it is nicely browned about 8 minutes. Remove meat, and serve.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,orange,cilantro leaf,pita bread,spinach,red pepper flake,butter,cooking oat
title: Spinach Pita Bread Pizzas
ingredients: 3 tablespoons butter | 2 pita breads, cut into halves | 1 cup quick-cooking oats | 1/2 cup chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 1/8 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 8 ounces fresh spinach | 1 tablespoon orange zest from can | 1/4 cup maraschino cherries, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Preheat pizzas pan or pizzelle iron on high. Spread butter over one side of each pita half. Place pita halves face down on hot pan or iron and press firmly. Cook for 6 - 8 minutes on each side or until crust is lightly browned. Set pita halves aside to cool. In processor or blender, combine oats, cilantro, & crushed red pepper. Process to make fine crumbs. Add spinach and pulse until spinach is coated with crumbs. Add orange zest, mix well. Fill each pita half with 1 tablespoon spinach mixture, dividing evenly. Top with remaining spinach mixture, and sprinkles with cherries. Serve.

title: Cheese Shrimp Appetizers
ingredients: 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1/3 cup grated gruyere or 1/3 cup swiss cheese | 1 tablespoon canned chipotle chile | 1 teaspoon canned shrimp, sliced into strips ( optional ) | cooked noodles
instructions: Combine all ingredients in small bowl, mix well. Divide mixture between 4 serving plates. Top with shrimp strips. Serve on bed of noodles.

Random Ingredients: tabasco sauce,salt black pepper,salmon fillet,asiago cheese,honey,kaffir lime leaf,pre mozzarella cheese,lemon pepper
title: BBQ Salmon
ingredients: 6 ounces fresh boneless skinless salmon fillets | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1/4 cup reduced-sodium honey | 2 tablespoons tabasco sauce | 2 teaspoons lemon pepper | 1 lemon-peel lime leaf | 1/2 cup shredded asiago cheese | 1/2 cup shredded low-fat mozzarella cheese
instructions: Lightly oil grill. Dry salmon on paper towels. Season with salt and pepper. To prepare marinade, combine honey, tabasco and lemon pepper. Set aside. Split salmon fillet into 4 thin slices. Place one salmon slice in a bowl. Repeat with remaining salmon. Add kaffir lime leaves and asiago to marinade and stir. Brush salmon with marinade and grill over indirect heat for 5 minutes each side, or until just cooked through. Spoon warm marinade over salmon. Top salmon with mozzarella cheese and serve.

title: Pumpkin Seeds and Radishes: Canapes with Coconut and Coconut
ingredients: 400 -500 g fresh pumpkin | 3 -4 tablespoons desiccated coconut ( depending on size ) | 3 -6 whole cloves | 1 tablespoon shredded dried unsweetened coconut ( optional ) | 24 radishes, medium size
instructions: Place pumpkin in a medium size saucepan, add 2 1/2 cups cold water.

title: Zest Orange Chips
ingredients: 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons orange zest, grated
instructions: In a small heat proof bowl, combine oil and grated orange zest. Place the zest in a micro safe dish or in a ziplock bag. Micro wave for 30 seconds, or until the zest is dry and slightly darkened at the edges. Using two small spoons or a slotted spoon, press the zest into a bowl. Cover and set aside for about 30 minutes to allow the oil to get cold and dark in texture.

title: Grilled Eggplant With Italian-Style Parsley Cheese
ingredients: 1 large eggplant, halved lengthwise | 4 slices fontina cheese, about 1/8 inch thick ( about 1 cup ) | 2 teaspoons whole wheat spiced maple syrup | 2 teaspoons unsalted pesto ( optional ) | italian-style parsley, minced
instructions: Set oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source and preheat the broiler. Line baking sheet with aluminum foil. Place eggplant halves on prepared baking sheet. Top with a single layer of fontina cheese slices. Drizzle with maple syrup. Broil, switching the positions of the slices as necessary, until the cheese is browned, about 5 minutes. Sprinkle top with pesto, if desired, and sprinkle with minced fresh parsley. Serve at once.

title: Kitchenaid Wet Seasoning
ingredients: 3 tablespoons lime wedge | 3 tablespoons dried sage | 3 lbs dried ground tomato and green chilies | 1 package taco seasoning
instructions: Combine lime wedges, sage and ground chiles. In non stick fry pan set over medium heat cook ground chile mixture, stirring, until no longer pink. Stir in taco seasoning according to pkg. To prepare, spoon warm ground chile mixture into paper bag with a star tip, close and seal and shake to coat meat and vegetables. Let sit at room temperature for 1 hour.

title: Ranch Anchovies
ingredients: 2 lbs anchovies packed in oil, drained | 3 tablespoons coriander powder
instructions: Cut the anchovies in half, shaking off the oil and pat them dry with a paper towel. Arrange the anchovies in a single layer on a buttered baking tray. Combine the coriander and italian dressing to make a dressing of dipping consistency. Spread over the anchovies and bake, stirring frequently, for about 20 minutes or until crisp.

title: Pumpkin, Pineapple and Pimento
ingredients: 2 cups peeled cubed pumpkin | 2 jar diced pimientos, drained
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine cubed pumpkin, pimientos and pimentos. Spoon mixture into a medium saucepan, and add water to cover completely. Bring to a boil, and reduce heat to low. Cover, and simmer 15 minutes, or until pumpkin is tender. Stir often during cooking. Serve warm.

title: Sweet-And-Sour Squash With Nutella
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon chili oil | 1 -2 tablespoon heavy cream | 1 small yellow squash, roasted peeled, sliced or 8 ounces frozen small yellow squash, thawed | 2 ounces neufchatel cheese or 2 ounces light cream, softened
instructions: Heat the chili oil in a small saucepan, then stir in the cream. Heat the cream slowly in large skillet over medium heat until it is steaming through. Stir in the squash slices, increase heat to high and simmer, stirring regularly until the squash is warmed through and tender, but not mushy. Stir in the neufchatel, then serve hot or warm.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,chicken stock,plum tomato,white wine vinegar
title: Roasted Thai Red Curry Chicken
ingredients: 2 teaspoons red curry paste | 1 1/2 cups chicken stock | 4 plum tomatoes, chopped | 1/4 cup dry white wine vinegar ( or regular or cider vinegar )
instructions: Preheat broiler. In a small bowl, mix curry paste until dissolved, then stir in chicken stock. Place tomatoes on a baking sheet and broil 2 minutes until they are slightly softened. Turn tomato on other side and broil 2 to 4 minutes more until charred all over. Transfer tomatoes to a plate and set aside. Stir vinegar into curry, then pour over reserved tomato and chicken. Toss to combine. Let the curry warm up for about 3 minutes before serving.

title: Pigs in a Blanket
ingredients: 8 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley | 8 tablespoons chopped fresh chile | 2 tablespoons grated lemon peel | 1 lb sweet italian sausage | 1 lb phyllo dough
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. In a bowl, combine parsley, chiles, lemon peel, and sausage. Lay out 1 sheet of phyllo dough at a time and brush generously with melted butter or margarine. Spread 1/4 of sausage mixture along the pastry, leaving a 2 inch border. Repeat process with remaining sheets. Place about 2 or 3 tablespoons of filling on phyllo. Bake until golden brown, about 15 to 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: heavy cream,chicken,italian seasoning,self raising flour,white rice,dill pickle
title: Lite Chicken Rollen
ingredients: 4 ounces self-raising flour | 1/4 cup white rice | 4 ounces cooked chicken, cut into chunks | 1 teaspoon dried dill pickles, diced, or | 2 tablespoons diced dill pickle | 1/3 cup heavy cream
instructions: Combine 1st 8 ingredients, and roll out to make roll of desired size. Wrap well with plastic wrap and place in refrigerator 10 - 15 minutes. Preheat oven to 200°c place rolls onto greased oven trays and bake for 10 - 15 minutes or until browned and cooked through.

title: Murgul Maudie
ingredients: 1 1 cup split urad dal | 2 cups cooked italian-style maccia ( i like marble or maudie mary mix ) | 2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1 pinch mace | 20 small meat-free manicotti
instructions: Place the split urad dal in a large bowl. Add the ginger garlic paste, vinegar, and mace. Mix together until everything is evenly distributed. Add the uncooked maccia. Toss until coated with mixture and let sit for 5 minutes. Fill a large pot with water and bring to a boil. Add the drained maccia. When it begins to boil, reduce it to medium or medium low for 20 - 30 minutes or until the water is mostly evaporated. Let cool. While waiting for the water to boil, remove the outer perimeter of the manicotti shells by using a sharp knife, removing all the minuestes from inside the shell. Stuff the shells with the maudie mix. Set aside. When you are ready to serve, ladle the maudie mixture into the shells and cook in the boiling water for 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: tarragon,rice wine vinegar,salt pepper,sushi rice,chile powder,pizza sauce,ginger paste
title: Sushi Roll (Kushi)
ingredients: 2 cups sushi rice or 2 cups sushi rice, cooked | 1 2/3 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon ginger paste | 1/2 teaspoon tarragon | 1/4 teaspoon salt and pepper, to taste | chili powder | pizza sauce ( optional )
instructions: Mix all the ingredients. Roll into a flat, even rectangle, about 1 1/2 inches thick and 1/4 inch thick. Repeat on the other side. Slaying slices on a bamboo sushi roller or you can use toothpicks or bamboo skewers so as not to trap air pockets beneath them, or on your hands. Brush with a little oil, wrap in plastic wrap or place in ziploc bags. Refrigerate overnight. The next day, cut diagonally or square into slices. Serve alongside a dipping sauce.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,salmon fillet,red chili,plain flour
title: Salmon With Chilli Crampets and Sweet Rice
ingredients: 400 g thickly sliced salmon fillets | 30 g plain flour ( or plain flour of your choice ) | 60 ml chilled dry red chili | steamed jasmine rice or sweet naan bread, to serve
instructions: Pre heat the grill. Combine the flour and chillies. Coat the salmon fillet in the flour mixture and grill for 4 - 5 minutes each side until cooked to your liking. Cut into 5 pieces and serve with the sweet rice.

Random Ingredients: red pepper,green chili pepper,cream cottage cheese,feta,pine nut,guinness stout,teriyaki sauce,cannellini bean
title: Pizzas (Australian Cheese Dip With Beans)
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans ( drained ) | 1 can cream-style cottage cheese | 2/3 cup crumbled feta | 1/3 cup diced red pepper ( jarred sliced ) | 4 ounces bottled chopped green chili peppers ( green chopped ) | 1/3 cup teriyaki sauce | 2 tablespoons chopped sun-dried tomatoes in oil ( oil packed ) | 1 tablespoon crushed pine nuts
instructions: Add first 11 ingredients to a food processor.

title: Pomegranate Pork Roasted on Nori
ingredients: 3 cups pomegranates | 1 boneless pork loin roast | 1 package nori ( dry seaweed ) | 1/4 cup walnuts, chopped
instructions: Pre heat oven to 400 degrees f. Slice pork loin into 1/4 inch strips. Put meat in a roasting pan and sprinkle with pomegranate seeds covering meat completely. Roast in pre heated oven uncovered about 45 minutes or until cooked through. Drain meat from pan and place meat on a cutting board. Add nori sheets to cutting board with one inch side facing you. Place meat on nori making a cross cutting board and place board directly on top of meat and nori. Cut a small slit along the side of the nori leaving enough room on each side to fold in thirds like a book. Wrap nori around meat, tearing until it reaches the desired thickness. After meat is done cooking, cut slices across grain into 1 inch lengths and place on platter. Sprinkle with walnuts. Serve with rice.

title: Beef Salpicao or Beef Rib Roast
ingredients: 2 lbs beef round steak, bone-in, trimmed of external fat | 1 lemon peel, cut into 3/4-inch dice
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f rub the spice all over the steak, using some of the lemon peels as a base layer and some extra on top. Place the steak in a baking pan and rub the rest of the lemon peel over it. Roast in oven for 1 hour and 15 minutes to 1 hour and 15 minutes, brushing twice with remaining fat, until just cooked. While beef is roasting, arrange the lemon peel around the meat and cook under a hot broiler for 10 - 15 minutes, until crisp and light brown. Watch carefully. The fat will rise to the surface and darken very quickly. Let rest for a few minutes then slice.

title: Tropical Crackers(Cookies)
ingredients: 125 g whole wheat flour | 125 ml coconut milk | pepper
instructions: Sift flour into a bowl. Bring coconut milk, pepper and flour into a jug. Add flour slowly. Roll teaspoonfuls on a floured board. Press into 1cm thick oblong shapes with a floured fork. Bake on 180 deg c / 350f / gas mark 3 for 15 mins or until lightly golden. Serve.

title: Frijoles Borrachos (Mexican Bean Popsicles)
ingredients: 2 lbs pinto beans | 12 -24 ice ( depending on the size of your popsicle trays )
instructions: Fill large pot 3/4 full with water, add ice and bring to a boil. Place the popsicle trays in the water. Drain the beans with a slotted spoon into separate bowls. Drop fresh ice on the popsicle trays. Keep popsicle trays in your sink while you reheat the beans. You want to keep the ice in the pot overnight so it stays cold. As the pops are toasting, scoop as many popsicles as you can from the popsicle trays. You want 8 popsicles. To make these tasty little snacks you want the scooped popsicles to float. To freeze, place all of the frozen popsicles in an ice cream maker and freeze. Bake at 325 or on the top rack of your crock pot, until the snow is crispy.

title: No-Salt Tomato, Peanuts, And Cherry Salsa
ingredients: 1 jar no-salt-added diced tomatoes | 1 jar maraschino cherries, drained and chopped | 1/4 cup dry roasted peanuts, chopped | 1 roma tomato, diced
instructions: Combine tomatoes, cherries, peanuts, and lemon pepper seasoning in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower,large shrimp,extra virgin olive oil,spring onion,maraschino cherry,white kidney bean,mandarin orange
title: Shrimp, Cauliflower and White Kidney Bean Salad from Frisee
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, broken into florets | 1 can white kidney beans, drained | 1 cup mandarin oranges, drained | 400 g large shrimp | 3 spring onions, sliced | extra virgin olive oil | dried maraschino cherry, to decorate
instructions: Cook cauliflower for 10 minutes in plenty of boiling salted water, until crisp tender. Drain the cauliflower. Cut the heads into small florets. Place in a bowl. Cut the shrimp in half lengthwise, then open a crack and then pull out the centre of the shrimp. Dice up the shrimp and place in the salad. Chop the spring onions and add to the salad. To serve, place a few chopped anchovies over each plate and decorate with the dried cherries.

Random Ingredients: thyme leave,red bell pepper,grain rice,soy sauce,cremini mushroom
title: Vegetable Rice
ingredients: 2 cups long grain rice, washed and drained ( or other long-grain rice such as nishiki ) | 2 cups thinly-sliced cremini mushrooms ( about 3/4 '' ) | 1 red bell pepper, cut to julienne strips | 1/2 teaspoon ground thyme leave | 1/8 cup low sodium soy sauce, reduced sodium soy sauce may be substituted for salt
instructions: Heat a medium nonstick pot over medium heat. Add rice, spreading it evenly in a circular motion. When it starts to bubble, add the mushrooms, bell pepper, and thyme. Sprinkle with light soy sauce. Stir and cook just until the mixture is heated through. Serve immediately, or keep warm until all the ingredients are hot, about 10 minutes.

title: Spiced Chicken and Watermelon
ingredients: 3 tablespoons peppercorns | 3 boneless chicken thighs | 1/2 teaspoon salt, divided | 4 tilapia fillets | 1 -2 eggplant, cut into 1-inch chunks | 1 small fresh watermelon, cut into 1-inch chunks
instructions: Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add peppercorns to the pan.

title: Kolokithaya Kon Ore (Walnut and Fresh Turnip Soup)
ingredients: 6 -8 ounces dried pasta shells or 6 -8 ounces pasta shells, cooked according to package direction | 8 ounces turnips, peeled and cut in chunks | 1 lb shiitake mushrooms | 1 lb lean ground meat | salt and pepper | 1/4 cup toasted walnuts ( use to garnish ) | 2 tablespoons dry sherry or 2 tablespoons dry vermouth | fresh fig, sliced, for garnish
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling salted water, drain& set aside. Cook turnips in boiling water for 3 - 6 minutes, drain& set aside. Rinse shiitake mushrooms and remove stems, slice, and cut mushrooms into slices. Brown meat in a large pot with salt & pepper until barely pink, add turnips, mushrooms& sherry and mix well. Simmer soup while preparing figs. Garnish with sliced figs& toasted walnuts.

Random Ingredients: heath candy bar,pine nut,cooking oil,wheat flour,collard green
title: Spicy Collard Greens
ingredients: 1 cup wheat flour | 1/2 cup chopped collard greens, drained | 1/2 cup toasted pine nuts | cooking oil | whole heath candy bar, to coat
instructions: Combine flour, cheese and nuts in a food processor. Process until well mixed. Shape dough, knead into ball and cover with plastic wrap. Chill at least an hour or overnight. Divide dough into 4 balls, then roll each one out with the rolling pin so it feels like a 12 inch round. Heat a little oil in a large skillet. Cook each round of dough until it's nicely browned on both sides, 1 to 2 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate as soon as the second side begins to brown, then remove. Continue until all remaining dough has been used up, then repeat process process with remaining rounds of dough. Serve hot, with milk, vanilla or cinnamon.

Random Ingredients: broiler fryer chicken,picante sauce,russet potato,white wine vinegar,yellow pepper
title: Pollo Picante - Chicken Picante Fritters
ingredients: 1 broiler-fryer chickens | 2 russet potatoes, sliced into thick rings | 1/2 cup dry white wine vinegar | 1/3 cup picante sauce | 1 small yellow pepper, sliced into thin strips
instructions: Rinse chicken, and separate from skin and bones, if any. Cut meat into long strips. Combine vinegar, picante sauce and vegetables in a bowl, and refrigerate overnight. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place chicken on a foil lined baking sheet, and bake in preheated oven, stirring occasionally, for 45 minutes. Unwrap chicken, and drain off any fat. Spoon sauce over chicken, and place on serving platter. Serve hot.

title: Penne and Quinoa Pilaf
ingredients: 8 ounces penne pasta | 1 tablespoon unsalted butter | 1 cup quinoa | 2 teaspoons onions, finely chopped
instructions: Bring 5 cups water to a boil in a large pot. Add pasta and cook until al dente. Drain and set aside. Pour off all but 1 tbls water from the pot with the pasta. While the water is coming to a boil, heat the butter in a large non stick sauté pan over medium high heat. Add onions and sauté until golden. Stir in the quinoa and reduce heat to low. Cook, covered, for 15 minutes. Remove from heat. Add the reserved pasta to the pan. Toss, then transfer to plates, sprinkling with the onions.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,vidalia onion,salmon,superfine sugar,sage,ancho chile powder,cognac
title: Aegean Salmon With Cognac
ingredients: 1/4 cup cognac | 1/4 cup peanut oil | 3 stalks chopped vidalia onions | 1/2 teaspoon chopped dried sage | 1 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder | 1 lb skinless salmon | 1/4 cup superfine sugar
instructions: Mix the cognac and oil to blend and then marinate the salmon for 1 hour in the refrigerator. In a large sauté pan sauté the onion, chile powder, sage and seafood seasoning. Remove salmon from marinade and grill, brushing often with pan drippings until just cooked, about 5 minutes on each side. Place fish on serving platter and sprinkle with sugar.

Random Ingredients: oyster sauce,fennel leaf,curry powder,curry,ice cream,creole seasoning,barbecue sauce,olive
title: Quickie Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup olive, sliced | 1/4 cup barbecue sauce | 1/2 teaspoon curry | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon creole seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon fennel leaves, crushed | 1 pinch crushed hot dry crushed red pepper flakes ( optional ) | 2 cups ice cream
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together oil, bbq, curry powder, oyster sauce, creole seasoning, fennel leaves, and hot dry crushed red pepper flakes, if desired. Cover, and refrigerate for at least 2 hours. Place ice cream into a bowl, and drizzle with some of the marinade. Serve ice cream topped with barbeque sauce.

title: The Easy Easy Enchilada Dinner
ingredients: 1 lb stew meat | 1 bag tortillas
instructions: Cube stew meat. In large frying pan, heat all ingredients and simmer till meat is nearly done. Serve with shredded cheese, salsa, salsa con queso and black beans, or just eat with your favorite mexican meal.

Random Ingredients: honey,beef chuck,cilantro leaf,macaroni,cardamom pod,raspberry jam,wine vinegar,ajwain
title: Raspberry-Cardamom Scented Beef and Macaroni Salad
ingredients: 600 g beef chuck | 1/3 cup raspberry jam | 2 tablespoons wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon honey | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1/4 cup parsley, chopped | 1/4 cup cilantro leaf | 4 slices cotyro ( coriander )
instructions: Cut beef into thin strips. Place in a shallow dish. Combine jam, vinegar, honey, cardamom and ½ cup water in a jug and set aside for 15 minutes. Add meat, parsley, half the coriander and remaining coriander to marinate. Cover beef with remaining marinade and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight. Remove beef from marinade and discard marinade. Preheat oven to 160°c. Line a shallow baking tray with baking paper. Place meat in a single layer on tray. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes, turning once. Remove meat from oven, transfer to a serving platter, cover with foil and keep warm. Pour cooking juices into a saucepan, bring to the boil and boil for 5 minutes. Pour over meat, sprinkle with remaining coriander and remaining coriander, serve.

title: Algerian Beef Patties
ingredients: 8 ounces veal scallopini | 4 teaspoons coriander | 1 small green chili pepper, finely minced
instructions: Place beef in a dry frying pan and add enough water to cover. Add spices and stir until beef is sealed. Cook over very low heat for 20 minutes or until beef is cooked to your liking. Serve.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,pista,fine sugar,cocoa powder,milk,lemon,applesauce,yellow rice
title: Macaroons
ingredients: 1/2 cup unsweetened applesauce | 1/2 teaspoon lemon juice, freshly squeezed | 1/2 teaspoon unsweetened cocoa powder | 1/8 cup fine sugar | 1/4 cup milk | 2 small red rice, such as arborio or 2 small white rice | 1/4 cup pista | 1/2 cup lemon rind, finely grated | 1 teaspoon lemon juice, freshly squeezed
instructions: Put all ingredients in a blender fitted with a whisk attachment and blend until smooth, about 20 seconds. Pour into a mixing bowl and cool to room temperature, about 10 minutes. Beat again with the whisk attachment until fluffy and creamy, about 1 minute. Fold through your rice, cover and refrigerate until very firm, about 3 hours. Serve as a snack or snack with pats of butter and/or drizzle with melted butter or honey.

title: Mexican Beer Chips
ingredients: 1 gallon beer ( mexican style beer ) | 2 -3 chopped chipotle peppers, to taste | 1 teaspoon dried mint | 2 cups crisco
instructions: Pour beer into a large freezer bag. Add peppers, mint and crisco and shake until well blended. Place bag into food storage bag or resealable plastic container and freeze. To serve, thaw slightly, then remove chips from freezer. Place on a paper towel covered chopping board and cut into pieces. Serve with salsa or cheese for dipping. These chips can also be baked in a crockpot on low for hours. The dough freezes very well and the flavors mellow.

title: Duck and Potato Bake
ingredients: 1 russet potato | 2 tablespoons yellow mustard | 1 1/2 lbs bratwursts, sliced | 1/2 lb thinly sliced turnip | 2 tablespoons chopped shallots | 1 pound thinly sliced russet potatoes | 2 tablespoons grated romano cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Cut potato in half across the middle, lengthwise, and remove the hard ends. Place the cut side down on a rimmed baking sheet, and bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes. Then carefully remove the potato and let sit another 15 minutes. Meanwhile, heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Add mustard and brown bratwurst. Remove from heat and spread on the inside of an 8x8 inch rectangle. Layer sausage and potato slices, brushing with olive oil. Sprinkle with shallots and romano cheese. Bake in the preheated oven for 20 to 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: orzo pasta,bean,french onion,beef chuck,savoy cabbage,nori,mostaccioli pasta,cornstarch
title: Beef Orzo with Nori Soup
ingredients: 1/2 pound ground beef chuck | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 package uncooked orzo pasta | 24 ounces orzo pasta | frozen northern vietnamese cabbage, or any other green preferred, cut into 3 inch pieces | french-fried onions | cooked beans | nori
instructions: Cook ground beef in a large frying pan or dutch oven until browned, but not dark.

Random Ingredients: brown rice,wheat flour tortilla,quinoa,liquid smoke,red pepper
title: Smoky Brown Rice and Quinoa Burritos
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked instant brown rice | 3 cups dry quinoa | 2 teaspoons liquid smoke, or more if needed | 1 can diced fire-roasted red peppers, drained | 12 whole wheat flour tortillas
instructions: Combine brown rice, quinoa, liquid smoke, and peppers in a large microwave safe dish.

title: Fig & Bacon Potato Salad
ingredients: 3 lbs yellow potatoes ( about 1 pound peeled, cut into wedges ) | 6 slices bacon bits ( about 5 thick slices ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried caraway seed | 1 jar dried figs, packed in oil, drained, patted dry, and halved | 8 ounces fresh figs, trimmed | lime slice ( to garnish )
instructions: Cook potatoes in their jacket with water until tender, about 15 minutes. While the potatoes are cooking, in a small skillet cook bacon over medium high heat until crisp. Drain on paper towels and then coarsely crumble. In bowl mix bacon bits, caraway seeds, 2 cups cold water and figs. Bring to a boil and then lower flame to medium and simmer about 3 minutes. Arrange warm potatoes on plate with fig mixture and top with reserved figs. Garnish with lime slices and serve immediately.

title: Blueberry, Pine Nut and Fenugreek Bark
ingredients: 2 cups fresh blueberries | 1/4 cup finely chopped apple | 1/4 cup dried maraschino cherries, divided | 1/4 cup pine nuts | 1 teaspoon fenugreek seeds | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Place blueberries, apple, 2 tablespoons dried cherries, pine nuts, fenugreek, and cayenne pepper into the container of a food processor.

title: Ouzo Rice With Shrimp
ingredients: 2 cups short-grain rice | 3 tablespoons ouzo ( sesame oil ) | 1 lb shrimp ( raw, peeled, deveined ) | 1 teaspoon sesame oil | 1/2 teaspoon salt
instructions: Rinse the rice well. Place a steamer in a saucepan with 1 1/4 cups hot water over high heat. Place rice in steamer, cover and cook until all the water is absorbed, about 15 minutes. Combine the ouzo and ½ cup boiling water, whisk in the ouzo mixture. Combine shrimp and salt and toss in with the sesame oil and ouzo mixture to coat. Serve.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,plum jam,anise seed,red onion
title: Italian Jam Snack
ingredients: 4 1/2 pounds red onion, peeled and very thinly sliced | 2 1/4 pounds plum jam, cut into pieces | 1 1/2 tablespoons salt and ground black pepper, divided | 1 teaspoon anise seed
instructions: Place onions, plum jam, 1/2 teaspoon salt, black pepper, and anise seed in a slow cooker. Cover and cook on high 1 hour and on low for 3 1/2 to 4 1/2 hours, stirring every 15 minutes. Fill a bowlful of crushed, cold jam with water, and mix to loosen the jam.

title: Peach Beer Jelly Rollups  (Kinomaki No Yaki)
ingredients: 3 cans sliced peaches, juice reserved | 1 cup dark beer ( use the lesser `` beer '', use less water for the jelly than the rest and make sure its non-alcoholic ) | 2 teaspoons unflavored gelatin | 1 green bell pepper, seeded, finely chopped | nori
instructions: In a small saucepan over medium heat, add the reserved peach juice and reserved beer. Add the gelatin powder and whisk until the gelatin dissolves. Allow the gelatin to bloom at least five minutes. Add the cooked peach slices, mix well. If the jelly is still runny, stir in a little of the water until you have all the peaches incorporated. Add the green bell pepper. Fill four jelly roll cups 3/4 full of jelly and place in the refrigerator. After two hours, check the mixture so you don't feel it is bubbling. If you feel the jelly is still bubbling, use the same pitcher to measure out any remaining peach juice and set aside while waiting for the pryps to swell. When ready to serve, make the rolls, cut open one end of each roll and fill with jelly and pepper jelly. Serve warm or cold. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt,jasmine rice,cream corn,chicken stock cube,coriander powder
title: Namakay's Spiced Corn and Rice
ingredients: 2 cans cream-style corn, drained | 3 chicken stock cubes or 2 chicken stock cubes, dissolved in | 2 cups boiled jasmine rice, drained and rinsed | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder | 1 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: Pour the liquid from the cream style corn into a small saucepan. Place over medium heat.

title: Tasty Potato Wedges
ingredients: 600 g russet potatoes ( or any potato variety ) | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Peel & cut russet potatoes into wedges. Cover w/o warm water & leave the pot at room temp for 30 minutes. Drain. Meanwhile, rinse & remove excess salt from w/a strainer. Dry wedges well & sprinkle w/salt & pepper. Combine the garam masala & sprinkle evenly over w/salt & pepper. Cover & leave for 15 minutes or longer. Drain off any excess liquid before serving. Note, this can also be made for curry & served as an appetizer, as well as a side along indian curries. Variation i made & turned this into a delicious tasty curry dish. I had to cook it w/an asian style curry & found myself w/the right mix of tastebuds for my tastebuds so quick, but so yummy.

title: Beef
ingredients: 550 g chuck | sesame oil | 1 tablespoon sesame oil
instructions: Mix sesame oil with sesame oil and massage through meat. Refrigerate for 2 days before cooking.

title: Ricard a la Meurette
ingredients: 5 cups soymilk | 1 1/4 cups yellow cornmeal | 4 teaspoons english mustard | 1 lb rhubarb, cut into 1-inch pieces
instructions: Combine soymilk, cornmeal and mustard in saucepan. Bring mixture to boil. Cool mixture for 5 minutes. Add rhubarb. Cover and cook over low heat until just starting to set.

Random Ingredients: veal,golden syrup,brown rice,fish sauce,large shrimp,cooking sherry,rom tomato
title: Steamed Shrimp With Rice(Asian Style)
ingredients: 1 lb large shrimp, shelled ( raw shrimp ) | 4 roma tomatoes ( seeded and cut into long thin strips ) | 1 1/2 cups uncooked brown rice | 1 teaspoon cooking sherry | 1 tablespoon brown sugar | 1 teaspoon fish sauce ( nam pla ) | 1 tablespoon golden syrup
instructions: Spray steamer or bowl with nonstick spray. Bring 1 inch water to boil. Meanwhile, drain shrimp.

title: Polish Sausage
ingredients: linguica sausage ( about 1 pound ) | 1 tablespoon turmeric
instructions: Remove casings and any loose pieces. Place sausage in a skillet over medium heat and cook until casings are browned and crispy, about 10 minutes. Remove casings. Spread sausages on baking sheet. Bake in a 425°f oven until sausage is evenly browned.

title: Bok Choy with Mint
ingredients: 18 bok choy | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1/2 cup miniature chocolate chip | sea salt | 1 teaspoon fresh mint, chopped
instructions: In a microwave safe bowl combine the mayonnaise, chocolate chips, salt & mint. Microwave on high for 30 seconds or until the chocolate has melted, stir well & set aside to cool a few minutes. When you're ready to serve the bok choy, place a handful of bok choy in the center of a plate. Spoon 1/2 cup of the mint and mint spread over the bok choy. Roll each bok choy so that the mint covers it completely, then wrap the bok choy tightly in the chocolate mixture.

Random Ingredients: cranberry,wonton wrapper,rigatoni pasta,lemon juice zest,milk,peanut butter
title: Cranberry Crisp With Wonton Dumplings
ingredients: 1/4 cup chopped dried cranberries | 1/4 cup peanut butter | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 10 wonton wrappers | 1 lb rigatoni pasta | 1 1/2 cups milk
instructions: Dumplings, stir all ingredients together except wrapper and milk in a large bowl. Drop about two tablespoons of dough onto ungreased cookie sheets. Using 2 1/2 tablespoons of dough for each wonton, form 8 rounded wedges lengthwise along two opposite points of each triangle. Bake for 10 minutes at 400 degrees. Dab with a glaze of your choice. Serve drizzled with remaining peanut butter.

Random Ingredients: chile pepper,asparagus,chili pepper flake,courgette,hazelnut,onion soup mix,self rising flour,catsup
title: Chilli Dogs
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chili powder pepper flakes | 350 g asparagus, trimmed | 1 tablespoon sweet chili pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon dried basil or 1 teaspoon coriander | 1 packet onion soup mix | 1 tablespoon catsup | chile pepper | 1 courgette, chopped | 1 tablespoon hazelnuts, chopped
instructions: Mix together the chili and basil in a large bowl. Place the onion soup mix, catsup and chili flakes into a food processor, and blitz the mixture. Add the mix to the chili and basil. Place the asparagus into the food processor with the sweet chilli and basil, and process until it is finely chopped. Add the courgette and hazelnuts and process until the mixture becomes paste like. Roll the mixture into walnut sized balls and roll in flour. Heat a frypan for 2 - 3 minutes and cook each burger until well browned. Drain on kitchen paper and serve immediately.

title: Buttermilk Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 1 quart buttermilk | 1 package dry onion soup mix ( such as onion, garlic, dijon ) | 12 ounces oysters, drained | 1 teaspoon hot sauce ( to taste ) | 1 -2 teaspoon thai fish sauce ( such as nonya sweet soy sauce )
instructions: In a large bowl, combine buttermilk, soup mix, oysters and hot sauce.

title:
Lamb and Artichoke Ragu W.
    - Pork and Artichoke.
    -
ingredients: 3/4 lb lean ground lamb, preferably ground chuck | 1/2 lb lamb shoulder, ground lean | 1 ounce artichoke, chopped | 3 artichoke pieces | orecchiette
instructions: Place the lamb into a large, deep, heavy frying pan, add a little olive oil from the artichokes, and brown well on all sides. When the meat has browned sufficiently, add the artichoke to it. Cook for about 5 minutes, turning and stirring them all the time. Remove meat from pan and reserve. Add a little olive oil to the pan and stir fry the lamb in it until it is browned and cooked through. Add the reserved meat and stir fry, scraping up any bits of meat, until it is almost cooked thoroughly. Taste and add more lemon peel, if needed,. Return to heat for a couple of minutes, stir the sauce, and serve it while the ragu is still hot.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,stewing beef,ra el hanout spice mix,apricot,cornmeal
title: Moroccan Beef
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs stewing beef ( cut into bite size chunks ) or 1 1/2 lbs pork ( cut into bite size chunks ) | 1 package moroccan-style ra el hanout spice mix | 2 tablespoons cornmeal | 1 cup dried apricot ( i use the ones in the jar, which will be in the freezer ) or 1 cup apricot preserves ( i use the ones in the jar, which will be in the freezer ) | 1/2 cup grated monterey jack cheese or 1/2 cup pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Combine all ingredients, except cheese and the cornmeal and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, about 30 minutes or until beef is tender. Add cheese to beef, stirring until melted and the sauce is smooth. Cook until cheese is just beginning to get hot, stirring often. Serve over rice. Note, for a crisper stew the meat and the cheese will have to saute for a few minutes.

title: Alfredo
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups all-purpose flour | 1 1/2 cups crumbled feta | 1 jar alfredo sauce | 1/4 cup white vinegar
instructions: In a medium bowl, place flour and feta cheese, and stir until well blended. Pour in alfredo sauce and vinegar.

title: Hot Dog Mix
ingredients: 1 cup shortening | 1 1/2 cups mustard seed | 1 1/2 cups hp steak spice ( mccormicks'spice mix ) | 1 tablespoon steak sauce
instructions: Mix mustard seeds in blender. In a large resealable bag, combine shortening, steak spice mix and sauce, and shake to mix. Add mustard mixture to bag and stir. Store unused portions in refrigerator. Heat oven to 150 deg c or lower. Coat a 9 x 12 inch cake or pie plate with cooking spray. Remove spice bag.

Random Ingredients: pie shell,calvados,anise seed,mexican cheese,red wine vinegar,wild mushroom,grain rice
title: Cuban Wild Mushrooms and Rice (Chef Scott topped)
ingredients: 1 cup calvados | 1 teaspoon mexican-style cheese ( can use mild, if you prefer ) | 1 unbaked pie shell | 1/4 teaspoon anise seeds | 2 cups wild mushrooms, sliced thin | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 1 1/2 cups uncooked long grain rice
instructions: Place calvados in a heatproof bowl and set aside for 30 - 45 minutes, or until they just start to smoke. Drain off any access calvados. Season with mexican style cheese and set aside. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Combine remaining ingredients and pour evenly into dough, spreading into the oven shell. Bake in the preheated oven for about 15 minutes, or until browned. Note, serve on italian bread to scoop the gravy, or place a mushroom or tomato slice on top of the pie crust.

Random Ingredients: dill weed,mussel,ranch bean,rotel,chipotle chile,stew meat,poblano pepper
title: Nacho Style Chili and Chips
ingredients: 3 cups stew meat, cubed | 1 can rotel | 1 can ranch style beans | 1 jar poblano peppers | 12 whole chipotle chiles | 15 dill weed | 1 teaspoon dried dill weed
instructions: Place all ingredients into crockpot, and cook for 6 hours, stirring often.. To thaw, refrigerate for 6 hrs, or overnight. Serve with tortilla chips, sour cream, shredded cheese, guacamole or guacomole.

title: Italian Country-Style Scallions
ingredients: 2 bunches scallions, white and light green parts only, cleaned and trimmed | 1/2 cup italian-style dried bread crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper, or coat with cooking spray. Cut scallions lengthwise into 1/4 inch wide slices. Cut a slit into each slit using a sharp knife. Place the scallions in a small baking dish, and drizzle with cooking spray. Bake scallions in the preheated oven until tops are lightly browned, about 6 minutes, and beginning to caramelize, about 10 minutes to lightly brown scallions. Remove scallions from the oven, and set aside. Place bread crumbs in a shallow bowl. Dip scallions into crumbs, and roll in crumbs until coated. Arrange scallions on a baking sheet, and bake in the preheated oven until slightly browned and crispy, 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Italian Gravy For Chicken
ingredients: 2 teaspoons dried marjoram | 3 cups chicken broth or 3 cups stock
instructions: Place the marjoram and chicken broth in a saucepan and set to simmer. Simmer the broth until slightly reduced. Remove the chicken breasts and discard the marjoram. Cut off any fat from the bones and return them to the pan. Simmer all together over low heat for about 35 minutes.

title: Basic Whole Wheat Sandwich
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon cubes | 1/2 cup whole wheat bread, cubed | 2 1/2 teaspoons dried bay leaves
instructions: Place boullion in microwave safe measuring cup, pour water into dish. Microwave bread cubes in water 1 minute, remove cube. Microwave bread in bread bowl with 1/4 cup water at a full power until bread is just melted, about 45 seconds. Toast in toaster. Spread melted bread with remaining butter and sprinkle with bay leaves. Serve hot.

title:
Cheddar Spiced Noodles.
    -
ingredients: 1/2 cup instant noodles or 1/2 cup any dried noodles | 1 1/2 cups leftover broth | 1 teaspoon dried parsley flakes | 1/8 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 2 1/2 cups grated cheddar cheese | 4 cups thinly sliced cooking apples or 4 cups turnips, peeled and chopped | 2 ounces teabags ( to seal ) or 2 ounces other crisp-cooked vegetables ( to seal )
instructions: Cook noodles until tender according to package directions, drain well on paper towels and set aside. Stir soup and reserved noodles into noodles, cover and refrigerate until cold. Stir cheese into soup with celery root, pea pods, carrots, and apples. Season to taste with salt and pepper and serve immediately.

title: Quick and Easy Sausage Noodle Kugel
ingredients: 2 eggs noodles, preferably whole wheat | 1 pound sweet italian sausage links, sliced into 1/8-inch slices | 2 tablespoons sugar, divided
instructions: Cook bagels according to package directions. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook egg noodles in boiling water, stirring occasionally until tender yet firm to the bite, 6 to 8 minutes. Drain, rinse with cold water, and drain again. While noodles are cooking, place 3 or 4 slices of sausage in a large skillet. Cook over medium high heat, breaking up sausage with a spoon, until browned, about 3 minutes. Drain sausage and set aside. When noodles are done, drain, and combine with sausage and 2 tablespoons sugar in a bowl. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

Random Ingredients: basmati rice,cooking spray,kale,tarragon leaf,seasoning salt,turmeric powder,white button mushroom
title: Creamy Cabbage Rice
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups basmati rice or 2 1/2 cups other long grain rice, soaked in hot water, rinsed | cooking spray | 1 1/2 cups white button mushrooms, sliced | 2 cups cabbage, coarsely cut into 1/4-inch wedges | 2 medium kale, tough stalk discarded, leaves washed, and torn into bite size pieces | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/4 teaspoon fresh tarragon leaves, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Set aside 1 cup of the rice soaking water, then rinse and drain the second cup of water. Place the rice, cooking spray, mushrooms, and remaining 3 1/2 cups water in the pot. Place over medium high heat until the boiling dies down. Cover, lower the heat to low, and continue cooking for 5 to 10 minutes until the rice is fluffy and the liquid has been absorbed. Garnish with the chopped tarragon. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: cold water,chinese wine,green onion,yellow onion,fish fillet,cream cheese,sirloin steak
title: Quick Beef Noodle Soup
ingredients: 2 cans cream cheese | 1 lb ground sirloin steak | 2 large red onions ( chopped or shredded ) | 8 cups cold water | 1/2 cup chinese sweet wine or 1/2 cup beef broth | 1 green onion ( chopped or minced ) | 8 ounces fresh cold water
instructions: Set oven to 350f degrees. In a 13x9 inch baking dish add the cream cheese, beef, onions, sauces, water, and green onion. Place into preheated oven for 40 minutes or until cream cheese has melted.

title: Whole-Grain Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 large cauliflower, washed and trimmed ( about 1 2/3 pounds ) | 1/4 cup honey mustard
instructions: Place cauliflower in a steamer and stir in enough water to cover. Bring to a boil and steam until vegetables are tender but still firm, about 10 minutes.

title: Rice and Vegetables With Smoked Saffron and Smoked Saffron
ingredients: 350 g macaroni, uncooked | 100 g baby shiitake mushrooms | 150 g broccoli florets | 1 leek ( cleaned and chopped ) | 150 g long-grain white rice | 5 eggs ( lightly beaten ) | 1 pinch saffron threads or 1 pinch saffron | 2 -3 tablespoons smokey smoked saffron threads
instructions: Place the first four ingredients in a pan. Cover and cook gently. Meanwhile steam the leek in a tea towel. When it is soft take 2 tablespoons of the leek grease and pour over rice. Mix. Add 3 tablespoons of the smoked saffron oil. Put the rice in the pan. Fry till it turns opaque and then turn the rice. It should look kind of grainy. Put 2 - 3 tablespoons of smokey saffron on top. Cover. Boil 15 minutes or until half cooked. Serve.

Random Ingredients: curry paste,sushi rice,splenda sugar substitute,red curry paste,brown mustard seed,pesto sauce,steak
title: Pesto Beef
ingredients: 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 1 tablespoon bengal rice or 1 tablespoon jasmine rice | 1 lb flank steak, sliced thinly ( cut thin, you may use chicken ) | 4 cups prepared sushi rice ( homemade or package directions ) | 15 ounces refrigerated reduced-calorie pesto sauce ( about one cup ) | 3 ounces prepared brown mustard seeds | 1 ounce splenda sugar substitute
instructions: Rinse steak with water.

title: Ancho Chile Molasses
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon active dry yeast | 1 pinch ground ancho chile powder | 1/4 cup cider vinegar
instructions: Dissolve the yeast and chili powder in 1/4 cup water. Let stand until foamy, about 7 minutes. Stir in the vinegar. Cover, and let stand until doubled in bulk, about 5 hours.

Random Ingredients: broccoli floret,active yeast,black eyed pea,beef stew meat,yukon gold potato,celery rib
title: Vegetable Beef and Black-Eyed Peas Pot Roast
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups water | 2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 1/2 lbs beef stew meat, cut into 1-inch cubes | 4 medium yukon gold potatoes, peeled, cut in half crosswise, then cut crosswise into 1-inch chunks | 3 large celery ribs, cut into 1-inch pieces ( include leaves ) | 1 1/2 cups broccoli florets | 1 can black-eyed peas
instructions: Place the first 3 ingredients into a 3+ 1 quart saucepan and bring to a boil to bring out the flavors. Lower heat and simmer covered, stirring occasionally, until the beef is just tender, about 1 1/2 hours. Add the potatoes, celery and broccoli.

title: Sausage Wrapped in Chocolates (Danish)
ingredients:
1 lb polish sausage, cut 1/4 thick | 2 tablespoons ancho chile powder ( or 2 2 t.
    - of dry chili powder mixed with 2 t.
    - water, or to taste ) | 1/2 cup chocolate chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Line 2 heavy baking sheets with foil, leaving 2 inches of foil at the ends of the foil. Remove sausage casings, and sprinkle both sides with chile and ancho. Wrap each skewer in foil to seal, and place on oven rack. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until sausage is cooked through. Remove from oven, and cool slightly. When cool, cut into 2 inch squares. Place chocolate in bowl, and melt over hot water. Stir until creamy and smooth, then set aside to cool, then chill until slightly firm.

Random Ingredients: brown rice,parsley sprig,cornstarch,onion powder,cranberry juice cocktail
title: Quick and Easy Cranberry Rice
ingredients: 2 cups cooked brown rice | 1 can cranberry juice cocktail | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 tablespoon light brown rice vinegar | 1 teaspoon instant minced onion powder | fresh parsley sprigs ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Cook in microwave for five minutes on medium heat, stirring twice, till rice is done. Stir before eating.

Random Ingredients: pea pod,ghee,extra virgin olive oil,skewer,lump crabmeat
title: Easy Fried Crabsticks (Bahrain)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lump crabmeat, picked over and cut into 1/4-inch cubes | 4 tablespoons ghee or 4 tablespoons clarified butter | 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 1/2 cups split peas pods, fresh ( pakistani-style ) | skewer
instructions: In a large frying pan, melt the ghee or butter over medium heat. Add the crab and continue to fry, stirring often, over low heat until the crab is crumbly and all of the liquid from the crab is absorbed, 3 or 4 minutes. The crab will need to turn a translucent color. Transfer the crab to a bowl and set aside. Place the cooked crabmeat and 1 1/2 cups of the cooking broth from the crabmeat in the pan and bring to a boil. Let boil until the broth is reduced by half and the flavor of the broth is somewhat more concentrated, about 5 minutes. Stir in the remaining broth. The crab sticks may be cooked right away, frozen, or slightly warmed right away, while still hot. Keep warm until ready to use. Fill a large frying pan with enough oil to reach a depth of 1 inch. Heat the oil over medium heat until it registers 350 degrees f. Fry the crab sticks until they have a rich golden color, about 3 to 5 minutes. Don't leave the crab too long, they're delicate. They may take a bit longer as the crab cooks. Use a slotted spoon to transfer the crab sticks to serving dishes. Serve hot along with some of the cooking broth and pakistani style split peas, if desired.

Random Ingredients: caster sugar,peach juice,oyster,spinach,tomato green chilies,bread,milk,vanilla pudding mix
title: Oyster Pie (Spinach & Tomato Salad)
ingredients: 3 slices bread, broken | 1/4 cup milk | 3/4 cup caster sugar | 2 packages vanilla instant pudding mix | 14 oysters, drained | 1 can tomatoes and green chilies | 1 box frozen spinach | fresh peach slices, to serve ( optional )
instructions: Toast the bread & spread with a little milk. Set aside. Place sugar, pudding mixes, oysters & tomatoes in a pan, simmer until all ingredients are soft and mixture is hot. Allow to cool slightly, transfer to a bowl & stir through the spinach. Pour the filling over the bread & allow to cool completely. Serve with peas, if desired. Notes, to make the topping, place the spinach & tomatoes in boiling water, remove when it rises to the surface. To serve, place a little peach slice in the center of the plate & top on the warm filling.

title: Basil Infused Lemon and Spice Sorbet
ingredients: 2 cups fresh basil leaves, tightly packed, rinsed | 1 lemon, juice and zest of, grated | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme | 1/8 teaspoon chili flakes
instructions: In a saucepan over medium heat, bring 1 cup of water to a simmer. Add the basil and remove from heat. Let stand until wilted, about 5 minutes, then squeeze the basil to remove excess liquid. In a small bowl combine lemon zest and remaining ingredients. Stir well until blended. Pour mixture into a large freezer ziplock bag. Seal, place in freezer and place a dish underneath the freezer. Chill overnight in freezer.

Random Ingredients: serrano pepper,almond extract,sugar syrup,hard egg,garlic,panko breadcrumb
title: Almond Stuffed Serrano Spoons (Kadisimo)
ingredients: 8 serrano peppers | 1 1/2 cups panko breadcrumbs ( japanese bread crumbs ) | 2 tablespoons granulated sugar syrup | 1 tablespoon ground garlic | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 1 hard-boiled egg, sliced 1/3-inch thick
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°f place the serrano peppers upside down on aluminum foil and put it in the oven. Roast for 30 minutes. Cool. The serrano peppers may take a little longer. Remove and discard the stem and seeds once roasted, remove the stems and set aside. Remove the black skin of the serrano chilies and discard. Remove the black veins and veins in a small saucepan. Add the chilies to a food processor, fitted with the metal blade. Add the panko, sugar, garlic, and almond extract. Blend until smooth. Place the chile mixture in a bowl and add the hard boiled egg. Let it sit for 15 minutes, then taste and season with more sugar if desired.

title: Chinese Pork
ingredients: 1 pound boneless pork shoulder, cubed | 4 cups graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Place pork fat side up in the baking dish. In a large bowl blend graham crackers using a cheese grater and stir together with pork pieces. Spread the crushed graham crackers on top of the pork. Bake in preheated oven for 2 hours.

title: Crock Pot Norwegian Church Fingers
ingredients: 1 package dry onion soup mix ( use good for 1 pound ) | 1 can fat-free half & half or 1 can light cream | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
instructions: Stir all ingredients. Refrigerate. Keeps up to 5 days.

title: Tomato and Arugula Pudding (Mark Bittman)
ingredients: 3/4 lb fresh tomato ( chopped into 1/2 slices ) | 8 tablespoons arugula leaves ( chopped in small pieces ) | 3 tablespoons cornflour
instructions: Heat the oven to 320°f. Put the tomatoes and arugula, cornflour and 2 1/2 teaspoons salt in a pan and cook till the tomatoes turn light golden brown.. Sprinkle over the remaining salt while cooking.

Random Ingredients: soy sauce,tamari,jumbo pasta shell,fish stock,wheat bread,cream celery soup,cumin powder
title: Quick and Easy Baked Shells
ingredients: 16 ounces jumbo pasta shells ( medium or small ) | 2 cans condensed cream of celery soup | 1 cup fish stock | 2 tablespoons tamari | 2 teaspoons cumin powder | 2 teaspoons soy sauce | 2 cups light cream of celery soup | 1 cup whole wheat bread, toasted ( or toasted pumpernickel bread )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Cook shells according to package directions. When done, drain and rinse with cold water and set aside in a large bowl. In a blender or food processor, mix together soup, stock, tamari, cumin and soy sauce until well combined. Set aside. Mix together crumbled cooked shells, cream of celery soup and light cream of celery soup in a large bowl and stir well. Pour soup mixture into large casserole dish with the shells and top bread on top. Cook for approximately 30 minutes, uncovered, until bread crusts are golden brown and bubbly.

title: Brazilian Cheese Rolls
ingredients: 1 package flour tortillas | 2 teaspoons tapioca | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 12 slices thick-cut french or italian cheese blend
instructions: Preheat the oven's broiler and set the oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Wrap each tortilla in a strip of aluminum foil and place on the prepared baking sheet. Place under the broiler about 2 minute. Remove the tortillas from the oven and sprinkle the tapioca powder and garlic salt over the tortillas. Remove from the heat and slice into about 1/4 inch wide strips. Place the cheese slices on top of the tortillas and place under the broiler about 2 to 3 minutes to melt the cheese, but watch carefully. Spread the cheese slices with the tapioca. Return the tortillas to the broiler until the cheese on top is lightly browned, about 3 minutes.

title: Quick Yogurt Cinnamon Scones
ingredients: 2 cups plain low-fat yogurt | 1 cup orange peel, shredded ( about 4 slices ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cinnamon | 1 tablespoon liquid honey | 4 teaspoons baking powder | 1/2 cup dried cake or 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar | 1 lime, cut crosswise into 8 slices
instructions: Scones, in a large bowl, toss yogurt with orange peel, cinnamon, honey, and baking powder. Cover and chill for at least 30 minutes. Preheat broiler. Arrange cake on a baking sheet and brush with shortening. Sprinkle with yogurt mixture and arrange the lime slices on top. Place scones on a baking rack and broil for about 5 minutes, turning once, until golden. Transfer scones onto a baking sheet and sprinkle with sugar.

Random Ingredients: adobo sauce,taco seasoning mix,pork,cheddar monterey jack cheese,roasting chicken,lemonade,grain white rice,sambal oelek
title: Fiesta Baked Chicken
ingredients: 2 tablespoons taco seasoning mix | 2 lbs roasting chickens, cut into 8 pieces | 1 package fat free lemonade, frozen concentrate, thawed | 3 cups cooked long-grain white rice | 1 jar salsa ( i use green ) | 2 -3 cups fat-free cheddar and monterey jack cheese blend, shredded ( depending on how strong you want it ) | 1 -2 teaspoon sambal oelek ( go for sriracha ) | additional salsa, for topping
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 f. Add taco seasoning and chicken to a large baking dish, then pour frozen concentrate & lemonade over. Bake 45 minutes, or until chicken is fully cooked. Uncover, sprinkle with cheese, and bake for 5 - 10 minutes longer or until cheese is melted and slightly browned.

title: Nacho Sauce
ingredients: 10 slices pepperoni, cut into rings | 8 avocados, cut in rings | chili powder, for garnish
instructions: To help cool the avocado slices, arrange the avocado chunks on a plate covered with plastic wrap. Place slices of pepperoni in the middle and then pile on the avocado slices. Drizzle each serving with chili powder. Repeat with remaining ingredients.

title: Greek Olives
ingredients:
1 anaheim chilies, deseeded, deveined and cut into thin wedges | 2 teaspoons orange zest, lightly packed, finely minced | 5 tablespoons plus 2 tbsp.
    - extra virgin olive oil | fresh thyme sprig | 20 hazelnuts, toasted ( husk removed and cut into halves or quarters, depending on size )
instructions: Heat a grill or dry broiler. Toast the chilies until darkly roasted and slightly softened, about 3 - 5 minutes, depending on the size of your chilis. Use a small heatproof bowl and set aside. Preheat a grill pan or broiler. Toss the olives with the zest and 1 tablespoons olive oil. If grilling, cover with foil and cook over medium heat for 2 - 3 minutes. Season to taste with salt and pepper and garnish with thyme leaves. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: rose petal,monterey jack cheese,linguine,vinegar,vanilla extract,brown rice,ricotta
title: Linguine With Rose Petals and Ricotta in Cheese
ingredients: 8 ounces linguine | 8 large rose petals, patted dry on paper towel ( or more ) | 1/2 cup fresh ricotta, drained, coarsely crumbled | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/4 teaspoon vinegar | 1/4 cup brown rice or 1/4 cup wild rice | 1/4 cup diced monterey jack cheese
instructions: Cook pasta, drain and set aside. To prepare the topping, mix cheeses together in a small bowl. Dip pasta in saucepan of boiling salted water and drain. Arrange on a plate with a thin layer of the cheese. Cover the pasta with sauce, sprinkle evenly with cheese, and serve.

title: Salmon with Carrot-Grape Sauce
ingredients: 2 salmon steaks | 1/2 cup halved grape | 1/2 cup halved carrot | 1 orange, peel of | 1/2 cup slivered fresh basil or 1/2 cup regular basil | 12 ounces sliced smoked salmon steak
instructions: Lay the salmon steaks in a shallow baking dish and top with grape and carrot slices, orange peel and basil. Pour 1/2 cup of water over the salmon and dressing and turn to coat. Cover and refrigerate overnite. Spray grill with pam, if desired and heat to medium. Remove salmon from marinade and grill to desired doneness, about 5 to 8 minutes per side for medium rare or 6 to 8 minutes per side for well done.

title: Burger for the Grill
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 1 can tomato juice
instructions: Cut up hamburger. Combine all ingredients in pan. Cook on med low heat until bubbly.

Random Ingredients: leek,hot water,beef bouillon granule,cumin powder,orange bell pepper,fruit,cane sugar,italian seasoning
title: Homemade Sweet Italian Peppers
ingredients: 4 tablespoons beef bouillon granules | 1 teaspoon dried italian seasoning | 1 tablespoon cumin powder | 2 lbs leeks, small, white ends only, chopped | 1/2 cup dry mixed fruit, finely chopped | 1/4 cup hot water | 1/4 cup unbleached cane sugar, firmly packed | 1 tablespoon hot water
instructions: In a large saucepan combine sugar, mixed water and hot water. Heat mixture to boiling. Add bouillon granules, stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Stir in vegetables. Cover and let stand overnight. Boil vigorously for 10 minutes to remove flavor. Remove from heat and drain well. Serve as desired, sprinkled with cinnamon.
