title: Terrific Roasted Tomatillo Guacamole
ingredients: 12 medium tomatillos, husked | 2 tablespoons kosher salt | 2 tablespoons dried apricot | 1 teaspoon fresh guacamole
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Line baking sheet with aluminum foil. Line a rimmed baking sheet with foil. Place tomatillos on prepared baking sheet. Roast in oven with 1/2 teaspoon salt until tender and wrinkly, stirring halfway through, about 10 minutes. Pull the tomatillos off the foil, cool and cut into 1/4 inch slices. Transfer to a plate and add apricots. Toss to mix well. Spread guacamole on foil lined baking sheet. Bake for about 5 minutes or until hot. Transfer tomatillo mixture to bowl. Serve immediately.

title: Mexican Kale and Cheese Loaf
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups golden tequila ( a red gold preferred ) | 2 packages dry yeast cakes | 12 ounces pinto beans, drained | 1 lb fresh kale | 1 lb kielbasa, cut into 1/4-inch thick slices | 1 teaspoon ground nutmeg, to taste | 1/2 cup shredded asiago cheese
instructions: Place all ingredients except cheese into a large bowl and blend on high speed until creamy, about 15 minutes. Beat cheese into mixture with a mixer. Beat until melted and starting to foam. Pour into an 8 x 10 inch loaf pan and cover loosely with waxed paper and a towel. Let rise 15 minutes. Pre heat oven to 375 °f. Bake, covered, until center is almost set, about 50 minutes. Let cool at least 10 minutes before cutting.

Random Ingredients: vanilla essence,cottage cheese,lettuce leaf,mozart black chocolate liqueur,semolina
title: Cottage Cheese Salad With Chocolate-Mozer Topping
ingredients: 1 tablespoon semolina ( not instant ) | 350 g cottage cheese ( or similar ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence ( optional ) | 2 slices mozart ( good quality-quality black chocolate liqueur ) | 8 -10 lettuce leaves ( preferably green )
instructions: Combine the semolina and cottage cheese, vanilla and juice in a mixing bowl. Chill while preparing the salad. Put lettuce leaves in a large bowl in a design with a design resembling a zebra or star shaped pattern. Pour the salad on top and sprinkle with mozart powder.

Random Ingredients: salsa verde,hard egg,wooden skewer overnight,chickpea,kosher salt
title: Egg Patties
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 2 hard-boiled eggs, peeled and chopped | 2 tablespoons salsa verde ( salsa ) | kosher salt | wooden skewer ( soaked overnight in water before using overnight, soaked in cold water )
instructions: Combine drained chick peas, eggs, salsa and salt in bowl. Roll patties in soaked, drained, chopped eggs then transfer to a plate. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 1 hour and up to 2 days. Preheat grill to medium high.

Random Ingredients: green pea,salt pepper,single cream,white bread,saffron,golden syrup,italian dressing
title: Aussie Pea, Bread and Saffron Pudding
ingredients: 1 tablespoon saffron | 150 ml strong italian dressing | 100 g green peas | 50 g bread | 100 -150 ml single cream | 150 ml single cream | 150 g english toasted bread | salt and pepper
instructions: Pre heat the oven to 180 c. Place the saffron strands in a mortar and pestle, making sure they are evenly distributed. Stir in italian dressing, peas, bread and toasted bread. Line a square tin with baking parchment. Add water to come half way up the tin. Put the pudding mixture on the baking tray in the oven and roast in the middle of the oven for 30 minutes. Remove the pudding from the oven, add a little cream and reheat the pudding until warmed through. Remove from the oven and set aside to stand for 5 minutes before topping with remaining cream and toasted bread. Serve dusted with paprika.

title: Ancho Yogurt Sauce
ingredients: 2 cans plain yogurt | 1/4 cup chopped italian parsley | 1 teaspoon ground ancho chile
instructions: Stir the yogurt and parsley together in a small bowl, then sprinkle in the ground chile. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Asian Steamed Sesame Chicken
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sherry | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 2 tablespoons chicken broth ( or water )
instructions: Heat 1 t sherry and 1 t sesame oil together in a small saucepan. When the sherry is sizzling, add the chicken broth or water. Cover the pan and bring to a boil. Turn the heat to low.

Random Ingredients: mozzarella cheese,spanish olive oil,graham cracker crumb,cilantro,gouda cheese,lemon juice
title: Spanish Cheese With Olives
ingredients: 1 lb mild gouda cheese, preferably aged, grated | 6 ounces very ripe spanish olives,, pitted, thinly sliced and lightly toasted | 1 teaspoon fresh lemon juice | 1 cup finely shredded low-fat mozzarella cheese | 1 cup fine crumbly graham cracker crumb | 3/4 cup fresh cilantro, chopped
instructions: Position oven rack to middle in oven and preheat broiler to high. In a large mixing bowl, toss together gouda, olives, lemon juice and 2/3 cup mozzarella cheese. Spread mixture evenly in a 12 inch ovenproof baking dish or quiche dish. Sprinkle crumbs evenly over cheese mixture. Bake cheese 35 minutes, or until edges have just begun to brown. Sprinkle remaining 1/3 cup mozzarella cheese over cheese and bake uncovered 10 minutes or until bubbly. Top with remaining 1/2 cup mozzarella cheese. Broil 3 to 4 inches from heat for 1 1/2 minutes or until cheese is lightly browned and beginning to melt. Sprinkle with remaining 1/3 cup mozzarella and broil, until bubbly and browned. Let stand 10 minutes before serving. Serve at once, topped with cilantro.

title: Italian Roast Vegetable Dip for Two
ingredients: 4 medium onions | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 28 ounces italian tomatoes, chopped ( can use italian diced tomatoes )
instructions: Put everything but the tomatoes in a crockpot until hot. Do not drain tomatoes. Pour into crockpot and cook on low for 10 to 12 hours.

title: Ancho Chilies Paste Seasoning
ingredients: 10 ancho chilies, chopped | 1 teaspoon white onion, chopped | 1 tablespoon mirin ( adjust to taste )
instructions: Combine all ingredients into a small bowl. Use to season prawns.

Random Ingredients: english cucumber,black olive,irish cream,dark rum,yellow squash,habanero pepper,salad oil
title: Peach 'n' Shreds
ingredients: 1 large english cucumber | 1 small yellow squash | 1/4 cup salad oil | 1 cup irish cream | 4 ounces black olives, drained and chopped | 2 tablespoons dark rum | 1 habanero pepper, minced
instructions: Cut off and discard the hard ends of the squash. Cut the cucumber lengthwise in half and remove the seeds with a teaspoon, if they're any wider. Cut the squash into 1/4 inch thick slices. Alternating them on a cutting board with a sharp knife, cut away the ends just a few places. Cut the squash into 1/4 inch thick slices. Cut the leaves, and stems, off the long side of the stems with a kitchen scissors. Cut them into 1 inch segments as follows, each slice starting with the wide end, cut away the long, thin part from the sides when you cut 1 inch of crosshatch strips. Alternate cuters of the opposite crosshatch strips. Cut out and discard the seeds from each peice and set them aside. Place the olive oil, sour cream, black olives, rum, minced habanero pepper, and freshly shucked squash in a blender, add a small amount of water if necessary, and blend for about 1 minute to combine the ingredients. Transfer the mixture into a serving tray and serve.

title: Easy Macaroni & Beef
ingredients: 1 big baking potato, large dice | 4 ounces sliced mushrooms ( any kind, can add more ) | 5 ounces portobello mushroom gravy | 2 1/2 cups cooked macaroni ( or make your own ) | 1/2 cup walnut pieces
instructions: Boil potatoes for 10 - 15 minutes until just fork tender. While the potatoes are boiling place your oil/grains and mushrooms in a bowl with gravy and mix to combine. Cut potatoes into quarters and place into the bowl and mix throughly. When done add into the mushrooms and mix throughly. You may wish to drain the potatoes, but they will retain their crispness. Add the walnuts and mix well. Serve with your favourite biscuits and vegetable of your choice.

title: Shrimp and Roasted Red Pepper Soup
ingredients: 3 lbs peeled and deveined medium shrimp | 1 red bell pepper, cut into 1/2-inch dice | 5 cups beef broth | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 2 tablespoons dry-roasted ketchup
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f combine beef broth, red bell pepper, ketchup, and dry roasted ketchup in small saucepan. Bring to boil over high heat. Add shrimp and cook 3 minutes or until pink. Transfer to bowl and serve warm.

title: Camp Fire Spaghettini
ingredients: 3 cups spaghettini | 1 cup quick-cooking oats ( not instant ) | 1/2 small jalapeno pepper, seeded | 1/4 cup pepper ( fresh or dry )
instructions: Cook spaghettini according to package directions. Drain, and mix with oats, jalapeño and pepper. Tear into bite size pieces, or shape into a ball shape and serve.

Random Ingredients: raisin,white bread,semolina,red pepper flake,polish sausage,rigatoni pasta
title: Ragout a La Polishka (Bread Pasta With Sausage)
ingredients:
1 loaf crusty white bread, cut into thick slices | 8 ounces sweet polish sausage, casings removed ( i use sage ) | 1/4 cup raisins | 1/2 - 3/4 cup semolina ( or coarsely ground fine.
    - ) | crushed red pepper flakes | 1 lb rigatoni pasta or 1 lb other tubular pasta
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Cut bread into 1 slices. Toast bread, remove crust and discard. Cut sausage into 1/4 slices. Drain raisins and place in bowl of food processor. Blend till fine. Stir in sausage, raisins, semolina, and red pepper flakes. Dice pasta, making sure it is dry all in one pile. Pour pasta into a lightly greased 12x9 pan. Pat dry bread slices. Sprinkle bread with bread. Bake 35 - 40 minutes until bread bread is bubbling and sausage is browned.

title: Green Salsa Dip
ingredients: 1 jar green salsa | 1/4 cup mirin | 1/4 teaspoon mustard powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients and chill well before serving. Serve with chips, vegetables, and fish. Note, i like to use a red onion, for some flavor.

title: Scotch Chips and Italian Sausage
ingredients: 1 lb italian sausage | 2 ounces butterscotch chips | 1 box bulgur
instructions: Brown sausage with butterscotch chips. Spread wheat into a 3 quart baking dish and cover with crumbled butterscotch chips. Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 1/2 hour. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: cremini mushroom,salmon fillet,cardamom pod,pimiento,tomato sauce,stewing beef,tamarind paste
title: Stir-Fried Oriental Beef and Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef | 12 ounces cremini mushrooms | 1/2 cup pimiento, halved then sliced thin | 1 large tomatoes, cut into 8 wedges each ( or use 2 roma tomatoes and 3 seeded and diced ) | 1/2 cup canned tomato sauce | 2 tablespoons tamarind paste | 8 cardamom pods or 1 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: Slice stewing beef into thin strips about 1/2 inch wide. Slice mushrooms into halves or quarters if large, but do not cut all the way through to the bottom of the mushrooms. Cut any large ones halfway into thirds. Mix all ingredients in a large wok or skillet, except for the cardamom pods, and saute over high heat to a boil. Lower the heat slightly, cover, and simmer until the sauce has reduced down and thickened to your preferred consistency, 8 to 10 minutes. Sprinkle with cardamom or cardamom flakes before serving.

Random Ingredients: bouquet garni,purpose flour,shiitake mushroom,white vinegar,pecorino romano cheese
title: Potato Gnocchi With Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 6 ounces unbleached all-purpose flour | 6 ounces shiitake mushrooms | 1/3 cup white vinegar | 2 tablespoons pecorino romano cheese, grated | 1/2 bouquet garni ( see below for instructions )
instructions: Place the flour in a large mixing bowl, add the mushrooms and mash with your finger tips until they are coarsely ground. Add the vinegar and cheese, and season to taste with the bouquet garni. Gradually add water, until a firm dough forms. Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. Place about 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 cups of the mashed gnocchi into a medium size baking dish, cover with parchment or waxed paper, then drizzle with oil. Bake for 10 minutes. Serve gnocchi hot or cold.

title: Beef Balls (Bhuna Kebabs)
ingredients: 600 g ground meatballs | 200 g spinach, washed & chopped | 200 g raw oats | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 1 cardamom seed | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seed | 2 tablespoons fresh cardamom, washed
instructions: Mix the meat balls together with the spinach and oats in a bowl. Add water, fish sauce, cardamom seed & turmeric powder knead well. Divide into 10 equal balls. Flatten each onto a greased tava. Press the edges with circular motions. Cook in a slow oven till golden.

Random Ingredients: cucumber,lentil,black cardamom pod,bottom roast,corn tortilla chip,salad oil,chervil,beef stew meat
title: Lentil Soup for Chilean Recipes
ingredients: 6 cups red lentils, cooked ( mexican red lentil preferred, see note below ) | 4 cups beef stew meat ( for stew meat, use one with bone in the bone ) | 2 1/2 tablespoons salad oil | 3 black cardamom pods ( see note below ) | 1/2 small cucumber, seeded and diced | 1/2 bunch fresh chervil, including stems | 8 -12 crisp corn tortilla chips, to garnish ( see note below ) | 1/2 cup salad oil
instructions: Drain and discard any excess water from the red lentils. If you have the time, place the lentils in a 4 quart pot and cover with water.

title: Beer and Wine Gland Sauce
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup good beer | 2 tablespoons rice flour | 1/3 cup sour cream or 1/3 cup yogurt | 1/4 teaspoon cracked black pepper
instructions: Scoop the cream of chicken soup into a small bowl and whisk until smooth. Stir in the beer, rice flour, sour cream or yogurt and pepper. Enjoy. You can freeze this to use later.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,pepper,ice water,ketchup,hot red chili pepper,chocolate syrup,spinach
title: Spinach with Hot Cherries and Chocolate Syrup(Karabiedes)
ingredients: 8 ounces fresh spinach | 4 hot red chili peppers | 2 tablespoons chocolate syrup or 2 tablespoons honey | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 1 tablespoon ice water | 1/4 cup maraschino cherry ( optional ) | pepper
instructions: Cook spinach according to recipe directions. Add other ingredients and stir. Serve with karo brand cookies.

title: Smoked Salmon Rollups
ingredients: 1 frozen pounder salmon fillet | 1/4 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded | 1/4 cup diced tomato
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium heat. Place the frozen pounder in the skillet, and cook until the crusty bread starts to crisp, about 5 minutes. Flip, and cook a few additional seconds to cook on the sides. Place the salmon fillet on a plate, and slice into thin, bite size chunks. Spoon the mozzarella cheese onto the bread, and top with slices of tomato. Roll up the salmon, then serve.

Random Ingredients: cardamom,graham cracker crumb,hot red pepper flake,dill,pastry
title: Danish Christmas Stars (Danish Christmas Cookies)
ingredients: 2 cups graham cracker crumbs | 1 1/2 cups powdered graham cracker crumbs | ground dried dill | ground cardamom | hot red pepper flakes
instructions: In a large bowl mix graham cracker crumbs, powdered graham cracker crumbs, powdered dill, cardamom and hot red pepper flakes. Shape into 1 inch balls and place on lightly greased cookie sheets. Refrigerate until set, about 8 hours.

title: Spicy Apple Jam (Cameroon)
ingredients: 2 medium tart apples, peeled, cored and chopped | 1 teaspoon minced lemongrass, or more to taste | 1 jalapeno pepper, seeded and finely chopped, or more to taste | black peppercorns to taste
instructions: Stir apples and lemon grass together in a bowl. Pour hot, tangy water over mixture until it measures 3/4 inch thick. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate mixture for 90 minutes to overnight before using.

Random Ingredients: beef sirloin tip,chipotle pepper,white flour,vodka,mandarin orange,italian tomato paste
title: Beef Kabobs W-Orange-Chipotle Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef top sirloin tip ( any cut of beef will do ) | 4 canned mandarin oranges, drained and halved crosswise ( reserve juice ) | 1 can mandarin orange juice | 1 can italian tomato paste | 2 tablespoons vodka ( i use pinot grigio ) | 2 tablespoons white flour ( i use 1 1/2 tbsp white for a thicker sauce )
instructions: Place the sirloin tips into a ziplock. Pour in the canned mandarin oranges, reserving the juice. Pour the mandarin orange juice and tomato paste into the ziplock including the reserved juice, into the ziplock and stir. Cover and freeze for at least 4 hours, longer if you have the time. Remove the beef and zakobs from the freezer, placing the beef in a shallow roaster/stone dish. Pour the reserved juice along the sides of the beef, place in the refrigerator. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Remove the beef in the morning and allow to cool completely. Reserve the marinade. Pour the reserved juice over the beef and refrigerate for at least 1 to 3 hours before serving. The juices will thicken as you pour them into the dish. I usually leave overnight. After the beef has marinated and chilled, i grill the beef on medium hot grill about 10 minutes on each side or until medium rare. Remove the beef from the grill to a platter and place on a serving platter. Drizzle with the orange chipotle sauce. For thinner sauce, reduce the juice so that the sauce simmers to your desired thickness.

title: Sweet Potato Masa
ingredients: 3 lbs sweet potatoes, cut in 1/2 `` chunks | 3 tablespoons masa harina | 1/2 cup sherry wine | 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley flakes | 3/4 cup packed brown sugar
instructions: Place potatoes in saucepan. Cover with water. Bring to boil and cook about 15 minutes, or until tender when pierced with a fork. Drain. Place in a large bowl, mash with potato masa harina, sherry, parsley, and brown sugar. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

title: Peking Sauce
ingredients: 2 ounces sherry | 1 teaspoon cornflour
instructions: Heat a saucepan, pour in the sherry. Add in the cornflour and heat through. Turn off the gas and leave for 30 minutes. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: thyme,pear,oil black olive,black mustard seed,seasoning salt,anchovy paste
title: Pear Tapenade
ingredients: 4 -6 pears, peeled, cored | 2 tablespoons oil ( black ) | 1 tablespoon anchovy paste | 1 teaspoon black mustard seeds | 1/2 teaspoon thyme | 2 -3 teaspoons maggi seasoning salt
instructions: Peel the pears, core them and dice them into fine pieces. In a bowl, mix together the oil, anchovy paste, mustard seeds and thyme. Add the pears and marinate about 1 hour. Strain if desired. Keep refrigerated for up to 2 days before serving.

title: Baked Green Olives (Oignons de Almagro Com Séri (Spanish Olive Paste)
ingredients: 2 bunches green olives | 1/2 teaspoon cornflour, for dusting
instructions: Remove the white papery skinned outer leaves that float on the surface and carefully remove and finely chop the white green olives. Place the green olives in a large dry frying pan and add enough cold water to come roughly half way up the side of the olives. Bring to the boil and cook for 5 minutes, or until the olives are cooked through. Remove from the heat, allow to cool, and place in a clean, dry jar. Cover with olive paste, and lightly dust with cornflour, and then seal the jar.

title: Coconut and Beef Filling for Peruvian Stack
ingredients: 1 lb extra lean ground beef | 1 lb pork shoulder | 1 lb coconut ( fresh or frozen ) | 2 cans fat-free baked beans
instructions: If using a fresh coconut, remove skin and place in refrigerator. Rinse or trim the grated coconut to desired size and finely chop. If using canned beans, drain canned beans and place in medium sized bowl. Dice up the beef and pork if desired, and put in large bowl. Add 2 cans of the baked beans and the shredded coconut. Mix well. If making in a food processor, put the coconut and beef mixture in a food processor and pulse till just combined. Add the rest of the cans of beans and pulse just to combine. If making in a food processor, just put everything in the food chopper bag and pulse til just combined. If combining with a mortar and pestle or a meat pounder, mix well. Put mixture in small bowl and add an extra can of coconut and beef mixture. Mix well. If making from a food processor, put all of the ingredients in a large food chopper, pulse till just mixed. Add coconut mixture when mixing with a meat pounder or a meat pounder, pulse till just mixed. If making in a food chopper, put all ingredients in small food chopper bag and pulse till just mixed. If using a meat pounder, mix all of the ingredients in a food chopper bag and pulse till just mixed. Put the mixture into small food chopper bag and pipe into medium size balls about the size of a walnut. Let the dough rest for 20 minutes. Use toothpicks for inserting the meat. Take the toothpicks and pinch off pieces of dough. Roll these pieces into ropes about the size of the walnuts. If using a meat pounder, wrap dough around the walnuts. Place on a tray and refrigerate for an hour. Bake in preheated oven 375 until golden brown, stirring every 15 minutes. If using a meat pounder, wrap dough around the walnuts and pinch off pieces of dough. Let the pastry rise until doubled, about 30 minutes before removing from oven. Remove toothpicks from pastry and cool on a rack for a few minutes before cutting as desired.

title: Cranberry Apples
ingredients: 2 medium cooking apples | 3 hard-boiled eggs ( optional ) | 1/4 cup dried apricot, chopped | 3 tablespoons sweetened dried cranberries, chopped ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons tamari | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 2 tablespoons dried sweetened cranberries | 1/4 cup sweetened dried sweetened cranberries
instructions: Core apples and cut into bite size pieces. Place apples on baking sheet. Bake at 375 degrees for 20 minutes. Cool slightly. Peel, remove pulp and cores and slices, reserving liquid. Break egg whites to pieces. Heat 1 t. Oil over medium high heat. When hot, add egg whites and cook until eggs are almost set, stir frequently. Using a slotted spoon, remove egg whites and place on paper towels to drain. Remove egg whites from paper towels and set aside. Place apples in baking sheet. Pour 1 t. Oz. Of reserved liquid into a small bowl. Place apricots and dates in separate small bowl. Dip apples into oz. In bowl. Place apricots, dates, and cranberries into egg whites. Gently but thoroughly, fold in the reserved liquid and mix well. If using hard boiled eggs, place on paper towels to soak up the flavor. When cranberries have soaked up the juice, place cranberries in a small saucepan of hot water to cover. Bring to a boil. Remove from heat. Drain. Serve warm with fruit, or serve cold.

title: Lebanese Zucchini
ingredients: 1 medium zucchini, cut lengthwise | 2 tablespoons ghee | 2 teaspoons ground cinnamon
instructions: Grill zucchini, cut side up, on medium hot cooking grate with grill rack about 3 inches from flame, 5 to 7 minutes. Turn and grill for about 10 minutes or until grill sides are dark brown and tender, turning with tongs as needed. Transfer zucchini to an airtight container and cover with waxed paper. Allow to cool. Heat ghee in a 12 inch nonstick skillet over low heat. Add zucchini and cinnamon.

title: Seared Strawberries With Rice Noodles
ingredients: 200 g rice noodles | 1/4 cup dark soy sauce | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon sweet paprika | 1 1/2 cups strawberries, thawed
instructions: Start by soaking the rice noodles in hot tap water for five minutes. Drain and rinse under cold water then drain well. Toss the noodles with the dark soy sauce, balsamic vinegar, paprika, and the cooked shrimp and crab meat and vegetables. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: yeast,sun tomato oil,poblano chile,broccoli floret,chickpea,blueberry,green enchilada sauce
title: Blueberry, Chicken and Poblano Bean Filling for Burritos
ingredients: 1/2 cup instant hot green enchilada sauce | 1 large poblano chiles or 1 large anaheim chili, roasted, skinned, seeded, cut in thin strips ( about 1 cup ) | 3 cups fresh broccoli florets | 1 can chickpeas, drained and well rinsed | 1 1/4 cups frozen blueberries, thawed | 1 1/2 cups sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained, roughly chopped | 2 1/2 cups unbleached all purpose flour ( to add flour 1/2 cup at a time to dough, see illustration above )
instructions: First make the filling, combine and set aside all the ingredients. Make the dough, process both the flour and the yeast in a mill or on a large, clean surface, about 3 minutes. Gradually add about a quarter cup of the reserved flour, and continue milling until the dough forms a ball. If the dough is too wet, add more flour. Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and knead, about 10 minutes. Cover and let stand for 15 minutes. Knead the dough again until it is smooth, about 1 minute. Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover, and let it rise in a warm spot until doubled, about 2 hours. Punch the dough down. Working with one quarter of the dough at a time, transfer it to a lightly floured surface, and then roll it into a 6″ x 11″ rectangle. Spread half the bean sprouts evenly over the dough, then spoon 1 cup of the poblano or anaheim hot sauce evenly over the bean sprouts. Top with the remaining dough rectangle, bean sprouts, bean sprouts and sauce. Fold the dough over the filling, press it together, and seal the edges slightly with your fingers. Turn the burritos, using a sharp knife on the outer edges, and cut off any rough edges. Repeat until all of the filling has been used. Place the burritos onto parchment paper lined cookie sheets. Cover and let rise until puffy, about 30 minutes. Bake in a preheated 350°f oven until golden brown, about 30 minutes. Transfer the burritos to a rack and let cool slightly.

title: Quick Sukiyaki
ingredients: 1 package fresh shiitake mushrooms | 1/2 cup bean sauce | 1 package brown rice
instructions: Wipe mushrooms with clean damp cloth towels. Slice mushrooms and toss with bean sauce in 9x13 baking dish. Bake at 375º 30 - 40 minutes. If you like your rice crispy, stir now and bake for another 10 - 15 minutes until lightly browned.

title: Jicama Salad
ingredients: 4 -6 large zucchini or 4 -6 large summer squash, sliced 1 inch thick ( about 1 pound ) | 1 cup jicama, cut into bite sized chunks | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato, chopped ( oil packed ) | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained and sliced thin or ( 16 ounce ) can regular sliced drained canned water chestnuts, drained and sliced thin | 1/4 cup vinegar | salt and pepper
instructions: Cut squash into large bite size pieces.. Arrange in a salad bowl or on a platter. Combine in a small mixing bowl the jicama, sun dried tomatoes, water chestnuts, vinegar, and salt and pepper. Add dressing just prior to serving.. Let sit for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Russian Almond Potato Salad
ingredients: 2 pounds yukon gold potatoes, peeled | 3 slices bacon, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 10 leaves romaine lettuce | 1 3/4 tablespoons smoked tea | 1 tablespoon almond extract
instructions: Place the potatoes into a large pot and fill with enough water to cover.

title: Sausage and Cabbage
ingredients: 1 lb dried salted tofu | 3/4 lb fully cooked firm sausage | 1 package cabbage | 1 bunch coriander ( optional ) | 1/2 cup extra-virgin applesauce | 1/2 cup grated pecorino cheese | 1 package chili seasoning mix ( spicy, dry or dry )
instructions: Cook and cool tofu completely. Remove excess moisture. Cut into 1/4 inch thick slices and cut each slice into 3 pieces. In a small bowl, combine all remaining ingredients except the macerated cheese and a few drops of chili seasoning and stir until blended throughly. Place sausages in a greased 13 x 9 inch baking dish and top with cabbage and macerated cheese evenly. Bake in a hot oven for 20 minutes, or until hot and browned and cabbage is tender. Stir again and serve.

title: Portabella Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 package portabella mushroom | 1/3 cup basil leaves, chopped | 1/3 teaspoon nutmeg
instructions: Rinse and slice mushrooms. Heat the oil in a skillet on medium high heat. Add the mushrooms and cook, stirring occasionally, until some of the liquid has evaporated, 6 - 8 minutes. Add the basil and nutmeg to the mushrooms and cook for another 2 - 3 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Chipotle Meatloaf
ingredients: 1 package white mushrooms | 1 lb fresh lean ground, pork | 1 cup cooked brown rice ( can use white or black ) | 8 ounces thinly sliced salami | 3 -4 chipotle peppers ( can use more ) | 1 cup fresh grated romano cheese | 1 lime, cut into wedges
instructions: Saute mushrooms in a little oil and set aside. Brown the pork in a little more oil. Transfer to a loaf pan. Add all the remaining ingredients to the pan. Mix well and spread on top of pork. Preheat oven at 350 degrees. Bake about 1 hour. Let sit 15 minutes before slicing, then slice and serve with hot tortillas, mexican rice, guacamole, sour cream, salsa, cilantro.

title: Quick and Easy Zesty Tomato Prunes
ingredients: 1 package johnsonville & # 174 ; mild tomato paste | 1 can tomato paste | 1 tablespoon crushed garlic salt ( or 1 1/2 teaspoons garlic powder ) | 3 cups hot jasmine rice | 4 pitted prunes ( optional ) or 4 sweet olives ( optional )
instructions: Heat tomato paste in large non stick skillet on medium heat for about 20 minutes. Stir, breaking it up as it cooks with one long handled wooden spoon. After 20 minutes, stir in remaining ingredients. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes or until rice is tender, stirring twice. Garnish with fresh prunes or sliced black olives.

title: Homemade Guacamole
ingredients: 2 cans crushed tomatoes, do not drain | 2 tablespoons dried onion soup mix | 2 -3 tablespoons sour cream or 2 -3 tablespoons soup mix | salt | 1/8 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/8 teaspoon basil | 1 1/2 cups pineapple juice
instructions: Mix ingredients together in blender or food processor. Blend at low speed until well melded. Store in refrigerator, it will keep a months to weeks in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: flour tortilla,italian plum tomato,taco seasoning,red curry paste,salsa
title: Spicy Veggie Burritos
ingredients: 2 flour tortillas | 1 -2 tablespoon light red curry paste ( mild, hot, or your liking ) | 1 1/2 lbs frozen italian plum tomatoes, thawed | 1 package taco seasoning | 1 jar salsa ( mild, medium, or your favorite )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Spread 1 1/2 oz of the curry paste on one side of each tortilla. Sprinkle on one the tomatoes and wrap around the entire tortilla. Place on a baking sheet in a single layer and bake for about 20 - 25 minutes or until heated through. While burritos are baking, combine remaining ingredients in a bowl and toss. Serve with the salsa.

title: Noodle Salad
ingredients: 225 g noodles | 1 cup golden raisin ( or any color ) | 2 star anise | soy sauce ( to taste ) or soy sauce ( to taste ) | pepperoni, slices ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 240f or 190°c. Pour boiling water down the inside of an oven safe bowl. Break up the noodles into tiny pieces. Boil, covered, for 3 - 4 minutes until the noodles are soft. Drain. When cool enough, drain well. While they're still hot, toss all of the ingredients in the bowl, adding soy or any combination of flavors desired. Cover and chill until ready to serve. Sprinkle with pepperoni slices to taste and serve.

Random Ingredients: green bird eye chilies,golden raisin,taco shell,dark chocolate,vermicelli,hoagie
title: Green Snaps
ingredients: 1 lb green bird's eye chilies | 6 ounces vermicelli, broken in 2-in lengths | 1 1/2 cups golden raisins | 8 hoagie rolls, split | 8 ounces dark chocolate, melted | 20 taco shells ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 375f and place oven rack in center of oven. Grease 15x10x1 inch jelly roll pan. Roast green chiles in small nonstick skillet over medium heat until blistered and blistered, about 5 minutes. Cool and peel seeds from chiles. Combine chillies, vermicelli, raisins and 4 tbsp of melted chile oil together in medium bowl. Arrange mixture in pan. Bake, uncovered, for 10 minutes or until firm. Serve with remaining 1 tbsp chile oil and 1/2 cup cheese for topping.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,pearl barley,lemon juice,fruit,cottage cheese,cardamom pod,romaine lettuce
title: Vegan Gyros
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups chopped romaine lettuce | 1 cup small dried puffed pearl barley | 1 cup low fat cottage cheese | 1 garlic clove, peeled & minced | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1 teaspoon lemon juice | 3 -4 tablespoons chopped fresh fruit slices ( optional )
instructions: In medium bowl, toss lettuce, barley, cottage cheese, garlic, cardamom and lemon juice. Cover.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,nori,chili oil,self rising flour,stew meat,turmeric,chicken breast fillet
title: Chili, Chicken and Meat Rolls (Jillavil)
ingredients: 7 ounces lean stew meat, diced | 6 ounces skinless chicken breast fillets, diced | 3 ounces soft self-rising flour, sifted | 1 teaspoon chili oil | fresh turmeric | 1/2 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 2 sheets nori, toasted
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220c/450°f. Place the flour, chile oil and turmeric in a food processor and pulse until the mixture forms a rough paste. Sprinkle the vegetable mixture onto a work surface, and gently mix to ensure the mixture is evenly distributed. Add the meat and roll into 4 rolls with the long side facing you, then place them onto a baking tray so the meat fits snugly around the tray. Brush or spray lightly with a little more oil. Bake for 20 mins, basting with the oil if needed, then increase the oven temperature to 220c/450f/gas mark 4 and bake another 15 - 20 mins, or until golden brown. Meanwhile, cook the rolls on a hot tray for 2 - 3 mins on each side or until cooked through. Serve straight from the tray with chutney.

title: Battered Fried Fish Corn
ingredients: 2 cups cornmeal | 2 tablespoons fish sauce
instructions: In a shallow bowl, mix cornmeal and fish sauce. Dip fish into fish sauce. Preheat frying pan over high heat, or leave until smoking before dropping into pan. This will cook the cornmeal. Using a pastry brush, lightly paint all sides of the fish with oil. Remove fish from pan, and pat dry. Place on a clean tray, and bake in preheated oven for 8 to 10 minutes at 220 degrees centigrade / 220 degrees f. Serve with vegetables and rice.

title: Sauce for Beef (Bbq)
ingredients: 1 can condensed beef broth | 2 tablespoons syrup ( or honey ) | sea salt
instructions: Mix well and store in fridge. Shake bottle occasionally to distribute flavour. Use as desired.

title: Ziti with Rye Bread Crumbs
ingredients: 1/2 pound ziti pasta | 1 pint rye bread | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Fill a saucepan with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the ziti and return to a boil. Cook the ziti uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through but is still firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Drain and let cool slightly. Transfer the ziti to a dry skillet and toss with a little of the rye bread crumbs until coated. Season the ziti with salt and pepper.

title: Persian Pork Roast in Champagne
ingredients: 1/8 teaspoon turmeric | 1/8 teaspoon cardamom pod | 1 1/2 lbs boneless lean pork roast | 8 fluid ounces dry champagne | 1 bottle champagne | 1 tablespoon rice wine ( or dry vermicelli, sweet rice wine, or rice powder ) | 1/4 cup slivered almonds, toasted
instructions: Place the turmeric, cardamom, and pork roast in a dutch oven. Pour the champagne over the pork. Cover and simmer over low heat until the meat is tender, about 2 1/2 hours. Remove the roast, reserving the marinade and vegetables, and skim off the fat. Cut and discard the vegetables. Remove the pork from the heat and stir in the rice wine or vermicelli. Cool slightly, slice meat and serve warm, accompanied by the vegetables. Garnish with slivered almonds.

Random Ingredients: apricot nectar,rye bread,ginger root,lemon extract,yellow onion,fish sauce,tapioca flour
title: Peppered Corned Beef
ingredients: 1/2 cup minute tapioca flour | 1 cup apricot nectar | 1 tablespoon minced yellow onion | 2 tablespoons minced fresh ginger root | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 1 tablespoon lemon extract | 1 loaf rye bread, cut into 1-inch slices
instructions: Whisk tapioca flour in a bowl. Combine apricot nectar, onion, ginger, fish sauce, lemon extract, and rye bread in a saucepan, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low.

title: Italian Style Meatballs
ingredients: 1 package whole wheat spaghetti | 1 pound turkey liver | 2 packages asiago cheese, cubed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook spaghetti in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 8 minutes.

Random Ingredients: lime zest,chuck steak,coriander seed,hot red chili pepper,almond,oil
title: Grilled Beef Satays
ingredients: 1 kg chuck steak, cut into 1-cm pieces | 2 tablespoons coriander seeds | 2 hot red chili peppers, split and thinly sliced lengthways | 2 tablespoons oil | 1 lime, zest of, grated and juiced | 1/2 cup blanched almond
instructions: Mix the coriander seeds, chillis, oil and zest together. Add the beef strips and rub well until coated. Thread onto skewers and barbecue or grill for 15 minutes or till cooked through. Serve with your favourite sauce.

title: Froken
ingredients: 1 tablespoon xanthan gum | 1 apple | 1 large plantain | ice
instructions: Mix the xanthan gum and the apple with half the water in a blender, add remaining water and blend with some ice until smooth. Cut the plantain into quarters and peel then slice. Heat up the remaining oil and fry the plantain slices quickly a few seconds each side until golden.

title: Pita Crisps With Sausage (Cajun-Style Beef)
ingredients:
4 boneless leg of lamb, trimmed of fat ( about 1.
    -1 pounds ) | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon lemon pepper | 2 tablespoons mustard powder | 1 teaspoon seasoning ( i like spicy ) | 1 lb kielbasa, cut into 1/4 inch slices ( i use hillshire farms `` bannock `` or '' other polish sausage ) | 1/4 cup pita bread ( optional )
instructions: Using a sharp knife, poke 12 small cuts in your meat. Insert a slice of kielbasa into each slit. If you have any leftover sausage, stuff it into those cuts with the meat. Season the meat with mustard powder, seasoned salt, and lemon pepper on all sides. Roll the meat in pita breads, and secure with kitchen string. In a large skillet, place the kielbasa slices over medium heat. Saute for approx 8 minutes, or to desired degree of doneness. Remove from skillet, and serve.

title: Pears Cheese Foldover
ingredients: 4 tablespoons rye bread, grated | 1 tablespoon coarsely chopped cilantro stem | 4 pears, peeled cored and diced | 12 sheets frozen phyllo dough, thawed
instructions: Preheat grill pan, rack 4 inches from heat. In food processor, pulse bread, cilantro and pears until finely minced, about 15 seconds. Pour equal 1 tablespoon of stuffing into center of each sheet of phyllo dough. Moisten edges of sheet with water.

Random Ingredients: edam cheese,pear,pork,taco seasoning,margarine butter,pine nut,hot chili pepper,chili flake
title: Easy Taco Salad
ingredients: 500 g pears, sliced | 250 g edam cheese, sliced | 2 hot chili peppers | 1 teaspoon chili flakes | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon margarine or 1/2 teaspoon butter | 1/3 cup pine nuts | 1/2 cup sweet chili pepper, sliced ( or more )
instructions: Fry pears over low heat until soft, add salt, pepper, chili flakes and taco seasoning and fry for 2 - 3 minutes or until golden and heated through. Shred or cut cheese on the diagonal while warm, and drain on paper towel if using sour cream. Put mixture in a bowl, combine nuts, chilli, and margarine, toss to make sure cheese melts. Put some mixture in the centre and fold up the bottom. Repeat with the other slice of pears. Note, i don't add the butter or oil into this.

title: Easy Pulled Pork
ingredients: 5 large pounds pork shoulder | 4 1/2 cups packed dark brown sugar | 10 golden raisins
instructions: Place pork shoulder in a large, heavy pot.

Random Ingredients: lime zest,lemon wedge,white onion,enoki mushroom,cardamom seed,red capsicum,wild rice
title: Wild Rice, Red Capsicum & Onion Salad
ingredients: 1 lb wild rice, cooked | 1/4 - 1/2 cup red capsicum, chopped ( red bell pepper ) | 1/4 white onion, chopped | 1/4 - 1/2 cup enoki mushrooms or 1/4-1/2 cup mushroom, chopped | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice or 2 tablespoons lime juice | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed | lemon wedge, to serve
instructions: Combine all the ingredients except the lemon wedges in a large bowl, stir well. Serve with the lemon wedges.

title: Thai -style Garlic Paste
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh lemongrass, ends trimmed ( i also like to use 2-inch lengths of fresh lemongrass ) | 2 bulbs of garlic
instructions: Slice lemongrass into thin slices, removing tips. If slicing from a stem, cut slices into 1 inch pieces. Add garlic to a wide, non aluminum pan or skillet that has been coated with a few drops of oil. Turn heat to medium and place the lemongrass pieces in the pan. Cook for about 10 minutes or until it turns a dark brown color, stirring periodically. Stir in some of the cooking liquid into the pan with the lemongrass and let the mixture simmer about 10 minutes. It must be the consistency of thick milk or cream. Turn off heat and allow the to sit at room temperature. If making from frozen, transfer to refrigerator over night, stirring occasionally, then transfer to a freezer bag. Allow to sit at room temperature for 24 hours. Strip garlic cloves from freezer.

title: Easy No-Cook Easy Hot Sauce
ingredients: 1 can condensed tomato soup | hot sauce ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan and heat through over medium heat.

title: Hazelnut Paste
ingredients: 1 lb hazelnuts, well toasted | 20 dried red chilies
instructions: Remove from heat, let cool, and grate. Combine well and store in an airtight container.

title: Tasty Hot Honey
ingredients: 2 tablespoons honey | 1 beef bouillon cube
instructions: Pour half the honey into a small bowl. Heat the remaining honey in a small saucepan on the stove. Turn the heat up to medium high and add the bouillon cube. Bring the honey to a boil. When the honey starts to boil, add the honey in small amounts. When the honey is almost completely mixed with the bouillon, take off the heat, add the remaining bouillon and stir. Enjoy.

title: Italian Tomato Kielbasa and Beans
ingredients: 1 package kielbasa, sliced into 1/2 inch slices | 2 cans italian-style canned tomatoes, drained | 1 can canned chopped italian-style tomatoes | 1 cup lemonade | 1 cup fresh lemonade | 1 can bean sprouts
instructions: Place kielbasa and tomatoes in food processor. Pulse briefly to combine. Spoon tomato mixture into large pot. Mix together remaining ingredients. Place on top of kielbasa. Cover and bring to a boil. Cover and simmer 15 - 20 minutes until beans are tender.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,ponzu sauce,jelly crystal,caraway seed,chili,vegetable oil,kosher salt,italian seasoning
title: Jelly-Yolks
ingredients: 1/4 cup vegetable oil | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 2 lbs fresh jumbo shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1/4 cup ponzu sauce | 2 teaspoons dried italian seasoning | 2 teaspoons caraway seeds | 1/2 teaspoon chili | 1 1 tablespoon fresh italian parsley, chopped
instructions: Combine the vegetable oil and the salt in a large skillet. Add the shrimp and cook over high heat until just pink. Remove shrimp and set aside. Place the ponzu, seasoning, caraway seeds, chili and parsley in a blender container. With the motor running, slowly add the oil mixture from the skillet into the blender jar. When blended, heat the mixture until hot. Toss the shrimp with the ponzu sauce in a large bowl and refrigerate for 2 hours to marinate.

Random Ingredients: plum tomato,yellow onion,ketchup,apple cider vinegar,corn tortilla,coleslaw
title: Sweet and Sour Slaw, My Way
ingredients: 1 bag coleslaw | 1 small red onion, cut in half, cut in half to make half moon slices | 1 plum tomato, halved, seeded and cut in half cross wise | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 1 tablespoon apple cider vinegar | 8 soft corn tortillas
instructions: Dip veggies in vinegar on both sides and roll up in tortilla. Place seam side down on a non stick baking pan, in rows if needed if you have to. Pierce in any air pockets as well as to the slaw, making sure edges are sealed. Bake 325 for 20 minutes or until all the juices are gone and they are starting to brown around the edges. This makes a large number of slaw, with dressing and salad dressing and a salad and crusty bread to sop up the delicious juices.

title: Lobcracker Mix (Lobscouse)
ingredients: 1/2 cup sweet green pepper, chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili pepper flakes ( or to taste ) | 1 teaspoon dried chili pepper ( or to taste ) ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients into a medium sized bowl. Allow to stand for 2 hours before enjoying the taste. Use 1 teaspoon for each pound of lobster meat.

title: Velveeta Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 lb velveeta cheese, cubed | 1/2 cup mayonnaise
instructions: Combine cubed cheese, mayo and mix well. Cover and refrigerate several hours ahead.

title: Simple, Delicious and Delicious Beef Noodle Soup
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs chuck roast | 1 can fish stock | 1/2 cup molasses ( i like light ) | 1 cup whole wheat noodles
instructions: Preheat your oven to 300 degrees. Trim fat from meat using a bonfire wand. Throw roast into oven and let it roast for about 2 - 3 hours. It should be golden brown. Shred meat with a fork, then add fish and stock. In a separate pan, heat molasses and stir until it liquefies and becomes a bit syrupy. Once you're done cooking, stir through noodles. The noodles will soak up broth, so let them simmer on low. Enjoy i like to put my noodles in the bottom of each cup, then ladle broth over the top, then add just a bit more broth for more liquid.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt pepper,chive,cilantro leaf,gorgonzola,russet potato,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Potato and Cheese Bites
ingredients: 12 russet potatoes, peeled ( about 4 pounds ) | kosher salt and pepper | 2 -3 tablespoons fresh chives, chopped fine | 1/2 lb gorgonzola, crumbled | 1/2 cup grated sharp cheddar cheese | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Bring russet potatoes to a boil in lightly salted water and cook until just tender when pierced with a knife, about 15 minutes. Drain well and cut into 2 inch chunks.

title: Muesli
ingredients: 1 loaf bread | 1/2 cup hazelnuts
instructions: The first step is to remove it from the loaf pan on a cutting board or in a plastic bag. If you remove the bread from the pan, it will crack and become brittle. If it breaks up, simply remove it and repeat this process until all the breads are gone. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Wash and dry the breads. Dry the hazelnuts by pressing them on a clean cloth over the bowl to remove all the skin and excess moisture. Place the bowl of hazelnuts in oven and immediately toast the hazelnuts until they are golden brown, approximately 8 minutes. Remove them from oven and place on a cloth to drain. Let the hazelnuts cool while you prepare the muesli. When you are at the 300 degrees f stage, remove the bread from the pan and cut horizontally down the length of the loaf. Toast the loafs for approximately 30 minutes. Pre heat the broiler to high. Place the loaf pan on a sheet tray so that the entire loaf can touch eachother. Place the bread slices in the oven until well warmed, approximately 3 to 5 minutes on each side. After taking the bread out of the oven, pour 1/4 cup of the muesli onto the toast. Place the toast on a serving platter. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice,green bean,liquid smoke,sambal oelek,cream mushroom soup,garlic powder
title: Baked Green Beans (Veggie-Beef)
ingredients: 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 cup green beans ( fresh cut ) | 2 tablespoons lemon juice ( you may use lime ) | 1 teaspoon lemon juice ( you may use lime ) | 1/2 teaspoon sambal oelek | 1/2 teaspoon crushed garlic powder ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour into casserole dish and bake at 375 until browned and bubbly about 30 minutes.

title: Indian Spiced Eggs
ingredients: 3 medium eggplants or 3 medium zucchini, each about 5 '' x 1/4 '' | 1/2 cup peanut oil or 1/2 cup vegetable oil | 2 teaspoons mustard seeds
instructions: With vegetable peeler, remove peel from zucchini just enough so that the slices stay on the peel and the zucchini won't break while cooking. Slice into 1/2 inch pieces. In large skillet, combine the oil and the mustard seeds. When oil is just starting to smoke, add the zucchini and the seeds. Cover pan, turn heat to medium and cook for 10 minutes, shaking the pan from time to time. It should be nicely colored, but there should not be any signs of burning so watch it, and don't worry, it should be all done in about 3 minutes. With slotted spoons, remove the eggplant mixture from skillet and place on paper towels to drain. Serve immediately, drizzling extra oil and/or chilies over the top if desired.

Random Ingredients: iceberg lettuce,cranberry,hot pepper,orange zest,berbere,pie shell,swiss cheese,almond
title: Moroccan-Style Grilled Cheese With Cranberry-Almond Pecans-Slices
ingredients: 5 cups shredded swiss cheese | 5 tablespoons ground berbere or 5 tablespoons other grainy biber and wheat bran cereal | 1/2 cup diced almonds | 1/4 cup finely chopped blanched whole almond | 1 teaspoon grated orange zest | 2 packages refrigerated pie shells, chilled | 2 cups finely chopped fresh cranberries, well drained | 2 large hot peppers, seeded and finely chopped
instructions: In a 12 inch nonstick skillet, cook cheese and Berbere over medium heat, stirring frequently, about 2 minutes, until melted. Stir in remaining ingredients except pie shells and broths. Reduce heat to low. Cook 6 1/2 minutes. Spoon mixture into each pie shell. Top with broths. Place shells on greased grill rack. Bake 5 minutes or until crust is light golden brown.

title: Simple Lamb for a Crowd
ingredients: 2 large lamb, chunks | 1/2 - 3/4 cup crumbled blueberry wine | 1 beef bouillon cube
instructions: Preheat the oven to 175°c. Toss the lamb chunks with the blueberry wine and pour into an oven proof casserole dish, place in the centre of the oven and bake for 2 hours or until the meat is tender and lightly browned. Serve with bread.

Random Ingredients: broccoli floret,vanilla,caper,beef brisket,lemon juice,lamb,ricotta cheese,tomato juice
title: Delicious Beef and Broccoli
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated fresh cheese-filled, baked and mashed potatoes, chilled | 4 -5 lbs ground beef brisket ( or use cooked boneless chuck steak ) | 1 1/2 lbs fresh broccoli florets | 3 cans diced tomatoes with juice | 1 jar small capers, drained and rinsed | 2/3 cup low-fat ricotta cheese | 1 1/2 tablespoons lemon juice | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees. Slice meat into 1 inch slices and add to potatoes. Mix together the meat and potatoes, breaking apart the beef as necessary to remove as much of the larger pieces as possible. Form into 4 patties. Bake 30 minutes or until heated through. While meat is cooking, prepare the stuffing. Put potatoes in a large bowl, add the beef and cheese, breaking apart the beef as necessary to add moisture.. Stir in the drained tomatoes, capers and remaining ingredients. Bake, covered, for one hour, or until hot and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: crouton,mozzarella cheese,vegetable oil cooking spray,peanut,yellow pea,flour tortilla,cayenne powder
title: Papadak's Easy Peanut and Pea Quesadillas
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons cooking spray | 2 flour tortillas or 2 corn tortillas | 1 package yellow split peas | 6 ounces fresh mozzarella cheese or 6 ounces provolone cheese, sliced | 1 -2 tablespoon sliced peanuts ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne powder | additional sliced peanuts ( optional )
instructions: Preheat your large ungreased nonstick skillet over medium heat. Spray lightly with cooking spray. Place the 4 tortillas in the hot skillet. Top the 4 tortillas with 1/2 of the peas, 1/3 of the cheese, then the 1/3 peas and 1/4 teaspoon seasoning. Cover the surface with another 2 tortillas, covering the first and fourths. Spray the remaining tortillas and top the quesadillas with the rest of the cheese. When your pan is hot, add the remaining 2 tablespoons oil and, when it is hot again, add the quesadillas. I flip the quesadillas over several times and cook the quesadillas until golden brown and bubbling, about 2 - 4 minutes. Remove quesadillas to plate with slotted spatula. Serve with additional syrup, if desired. Variation, add green vegetables and/or/or green beans, stir into the cheese. Instead of peas you can use fresh tomatoes, halved or quartered, sliced carrots and/or celery cubes, drained and rinsed canned corn, chopped, or use chopped or frozen green beans and/or potatoes. To make peas cheep up more liquid and crunch, add drained peas. Or to taste. Variation, add dried shredded chicken breasts or diced cooked chicken breast meat.

title: Homemade Hot Chocolate (Microwave) Mix
ingredients: 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa powder | 2 teaspoons red pepper flakes
instructions: Microwave on high power for 1 to 2 minutes. Add hot cocoa and mix. Store in airtight jar away from light for up to 1 year.

title: Peanut Oil for Spring Rolls
ingredients: peanut oil ( for frying ) | 1/4 cup chinkiang vinegar
instructions: Place the peanut oil in a saucepan. Heat over medium heat. When the oil is hot, about a tablespoon at a time, add the peanut oil in a slow, steady stream. Stir the oil constantly until it is heated to 325 f, or is a nice medium thick icing. You can add a little hot water if you want – this will thicken it a little. When it is done, use a strainer to drain off excess oil and add the vinegar in a slow stream while stirring. Try not to use too much vinegar. This is better stored in the refrigerator, although it will last up to a year. The oil can also be kept in the freezer for a very long, time time.

Random Ingredients: fennel seed,grape juice,worcestershire sauce,grain brown rice,thai chile,monterey jack cheese,icing sugar,corn
title: Cheese and Peppered Rice Bowls
ingredients: 1 cup long grain brown rice | 1 can diced tomatoes with juice | 1/2 cup grape juice | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh dill or 1 tablespoon basil | 1 tablespoon fennel seed | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon thai chile ( optional ) | 1 cup grated monterey jack cheese or 1 cup mild cheddar cheese
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. Strain tomatoes, chop, and set aside. Heat reserved tomato juice in medium saucepan over medium high heat. Stir in remaining ingredients except cheese. Bring to boil, reduce heat, and simmer, uncovered, 5 minutes, stirring often. Serve garnished with cheese.

Random Ingredients: baking potato,savoy cabbage,anise seed,italian turkey sausage,chili pepper flake,turkey,sultana,spinach leaf
title: Toad in Hot Sauce (Andalusian)
ingredients: 1 small baking potato | 4 ounces turkey or 4 ounces ground chicken | 1/2 small savoy cabbage, shredded | 1 bunch fresh spinach leaves | 3 slices aniseed from a 50 gram jar ( or dried or fresh ) | 2 chili peppers ( or anise seeds, to go with your own taste ) or 1 small red hot pepper, deseeded and chopped ( or anise seeds, to go with your own taste ) | 3 ounces sultanas ( to go with your own taste ) | 2 tablespoons sweet italian turkey sausage, diced ( or other ground meat of your choice ) or 2 tablespoons sausage meat ( or other ground meat of your choice )
instructions: Boil potato in salted water until very tender. Drain and mash with a potato masher to a paste. Add the remaining ingredients and combine well. Serve with a salad. Note, if you want to serve the sausage with italian sausage as well, add anise seeds and chiles to the sauce as well.

Random Ingredients: chutney,leg lamb,napa cabbage,asian fish sauce,lemon zest,black olive,chive,risotto rice
title: Lamb With Asian Noodles and Asparagus
ingredients: 8 slices beef-leg lamb, about 8 ounces total | 1/4 cup chive, chopped | 8 chichocari tomatoes | 5 ounces chutney | 1/2 cup rice | 1/2 teaspoon freshly grated lemon, zest of, plus | 2 teaspoons fresh lemon zest, for garnish | 2 bunches napa cabbage, stemmed, leaves separated | 8 black olives, halved, pitted and sliced
instructions: Spray a grill with oil. Thread 2 pieces of lamb, each about 3 ounces each, onto 10 - 12 metal skewers, each about 2 inches long, each piece about 5 inches long and 3 inches wide with long ends interlaced. Put the skewers on the grill and cook over moderately high heat for 8 - 10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until cooked to your liking. Remove from the grill and place on a warmed platter. Place the tomato on a platter and place on the platter. Cut a cross in the tomato skin about 2 inches wide and 4 inches long and place in a small bowl and put with the chutney. Heat the oven to 400ëš f. Place the rice in a shallow baking pan and place in the oven for 8 - 10 minutes, or until just beginning to dry. Add the lemon zest to the chutney along with the zest, chives and cabbage, stir well and bake for about 10 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender and the rice is hot. Top the lamb with the sautéed vegetables and the olives. Serve with the vegetables and olives.

Random Ingredients: baking potato,pork,escarole,cream mushroom soup,baby spinach leaf,asparagus,baby green
title: Beef and Asparagus Hash
ingredients: 1 pound ground pork | 1 1/2 cups chopped baby greens | 1 1/2 cups chopped escarole | 2 cans condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 pound fresh asparagus, chopped | 2 baking potatoes, peeled and cubed | 7 cups fresh baby spinach leaves
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Cook and stir ground pork in the hot skillet until browned and crumbly, 5 to 7 minutes.

Random Ingredients: bean sprout,beef brisket,chocolate,edamame,provolone cheese,garlic salt,romano cheese
title: Edamole Wrapped Beef Brisket
ingredients: 2 beef brisket | 1 1/2 cups edamame ( rice or other grains may be used also ) | 2 cups fresh bean sprouts | 1 ounce bittersweet chocolate | 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt ( to taste ) | 1/4 teaspoon graded romano cheese | 2 slices provolone cheese ( or other cheese as desired )
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a medium pot, cover and simmer over low heat for 45 - 50 minutes. Remove from heat, uncover and allow to cool. Using a sharp paring knife cut brisket across the grain into 1/8 inch thick strips. Serve on a plate. Wrap each piece with cheese slice and return to the pot. Add water to cover. Bring to a boil over medium heat, lower heat, and simmer for 5 minutes or until cheese melts.

title: Ancho Chile Focaccia
ingredients: 1 cascabel ancho chile, halved | 1 tablespoon chinese five spice powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Insert a knife in the cut side of each ancho pepper half to make a guide for turning. Roast peppers, skin side down on the prepared baking sheet, until blackened, 5 to 7 minutes. Move peppers with a metal spatula onto a clean kitchen towel and roll to remove some of the blackened surface. Scrape peppers and all of the juices from the skins into a bowl. Mix in chinese five spice powder. Continue to roast peppers, covered, turning peppers over every 10 to 15 minutes, until they start to darken, 6 to 7 minutes. Transfer peppers with a slotted spatula to a bowl and let cool, still covered, before removing the garlic and discarding skins.

Random Ingredients: cooking spray,penne rigate,bay leaf,ice water,brown lentil,ham,rosemary sprig,rump steak
title: Lennie's Lamb and Lentil Pasta
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry brown lentils | 1 cup water | 2 teaspoons dried rosemary sprigs | 1 bay leaf | 2 large cooked ham slices | 1 tablespoon chopped cooking spray | 6 ounces cooked penne rigate, rinsed and drained | ice water
instructions: Place the lentils and water in a small saucepan. Add the rosemary, bay leaf, ham, and pepper. Bring to a simmer over medium heat.

title: Alfgano Baked Manchego Cheese
ingredients: 8 -10 slices pancetta | 2 ounces manchego cheese, grated | 8 -10 lettuce leaves | 1/2 jar sweet peas | 1/2 jar bamboo shoots, drained | 1/3 lb italian sausage | 1/4 ounce semolina
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Place pancetta on foil and place on oven rack. Bake for about 20 minutes until crispy and slightly crispy. Meanwhile, toast your semolina in a medium saucepan of boiling water until it is slightly golden. Cut it into 3/4 inch slices and set aside to cool. Remove the fat from the sausage. Remove the casings from your sausage and crumble them into a medium fry pan, using medium heat. When the sausage is cooked, mix in your peas and bean sprouts. Spread the peas on a baking sheet and place in the oven. While your semolina is baking, heat your sausage on a grill pan over medium heat for about 3 to 5 minutes per side, until no longer pink inside and a bit crispy. While this should take about 6 to 10 minutes, mix up your italian sausage meat and place into a glass bowl. Slice your cheese thin and place into the bowl and mix this into the bowl. When your semolina's are ready, remove them from the oven and spread half of the italian sausage onto the top of each plate. Once the sausage is fully cooked, spread out your pea and bean sprouts, using a spoon. Next, place a slice of pancetta on top.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile adobo,marjoram,marshmallow,almond extract,cocoa powder,cream tartar,kielbasa
title: Quick Chipotle Kielbasa
ingredients: 1 cup reduced-fat sour cream or 1 cup whole-milk plain yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon ground chipotle chile in adobo | 1/3 cup finely chopped marmalade or 1/3 cup miniature marshmallow | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 package kielbasa, 1/2 inch pieces ( or links, your choice ) | 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa powder
instructions: Cook's note, can also be prepared in slowcooker at low heat and served on top of plain cookies, if desired, such as cashews.

title: Chinese Poppers
ingredients: 2 tablespoons szechuan peppercorns | 4 shallots
instructions: Place the peppercorns and shallots in a mortar and crush with a pestle. Place them in a small bowl and pour in enough water to cover. Bring to boil, then add the rest of the ingredients and stir until well mixed. Keep warm until ready to use. The mushrooms may be eaten hot or cold.

title: Caribbean Satay
ingredients: 1/2 cup peanut butter | 1/4 cup plum tomato, seeded and diced | 1 teaspoon hot sauce | 2 tablespoons barbecue sauce | 1 teaspoon vodka | 10 mint sprigs, for garnish
instructions: Blend all ingredients until smooth. Chill for 1 hour. Cut into 3 pieces and serve.

title: Mexican Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 package wide egg noodles | 1 1/2 cups plum tomatoes, chopped | 2 tablespoons liqueur
instructions: Cook eggs in boiling water 7 to 9 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cooking spray,lettuce leaf,double gloucester cheese,romano cheese,mint,russet potato,basmati rice
title: Potato, Basil and Cheese Rolls
ingredients: 12 large lettuce leaves, washed and dried | 1 1/4 lbs russet potatoes, peeled and sliced 1/4 inch thick | 4 ounces grated russet potatoes | cooking spray | 6 ounces grated double gloucester cheese | 1 teaspoon dried basil | 1 teaspoon dried mint | 4 ounces freshly shredded romano cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f in a large shallow baking dish, arrange lettuce leaves. Top each with a piece of russet potato. Sprinkle with half of the grated cheese, and sprinkle each with a tablespoon of the basil and mint. Roll up tightly, and lay slices on top of the potatoes. Coat the rolls in cooking spray. Sprinkle with 1 pinch salt and a sprinkling of pepper. Bake in preheated oven for 20 minutes. Sprinkle with remaining cheese, turn, top and bake for 10 minutes longer. Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: pico de gallo,galanga root,salmon,bok choy,green lentil,olive oil
title: Salmon Salad With Bok Choy and Lentils
ingredients: 200 g bok choy | 200 g red lentils | 1 teaspoon olive oil | 1 tablespoon fresh galanga root, finely chopped | 200 g green lentils ( yellow masoor dal ) | 1 cup pico de gallo ( fresh guijillo root ) | 1 can salmon, drained and flaked
instructions: Wash bok choy in several changes of water and pat dry with paper towel. Cut in half and finely chop the leaves. Cook the bok choy in lightly salted boiling water for about 1 minute and drain. Place lentils in a pan, cover with cold water and cook over moderate heat for around 20 minutes or until tender. Drain. Place rinsed lentils through a fine sieve and mash them with the olive oil and add the ginger. Stir until well mixed. Add the lentils, fish sauce, and 3/4 cup water. Transfer to a lettuce lined serving platter. Toss with pico de gallo and the remaining 1/4 cup of water. Spoon over top of the salads and sprinkle the salmon over the top.

title: Italian Turkey
ingredients: 8 ounces ground turkey | 2 cans italian-style diced tomatoes, drained | 1/3 cup dry white wine | 1/4 cup flat leaf parsley, chopped
instructions: Cook turkey in a 10 inch skillet over medium high heat until well browned. Remove turkey to a bowl. Strain juices into skillet. Add tomatoes and their juices, the wine, and parsley to turkey. Stir to combine. Simmer turkey over medium low heat 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: black bean,beef brisket,apricot half,kaffir lime leaf
title: Caribbean-Style Black Bean Stew
ingredients: 1/4 cup dried black beans | 2 kaffir lime leaves | 2 pounds beef brisket | 15 dried apricot halves
instructions: Pick over and rinse the black beans and place in a large bowl. Add the lime leaves. Turn several times to remove any excess water and drain. Reserve the lime leaves. Cut the brisket into large chunks. Add 5 chunks of meat to the black beans and pour 1 1/2 cups water over the meat. Bring to a boil and reduce heat to low. Keep heat at medium until meat is tender, at least 3 to 4 hours, but can take up to 24 hours. Add more water as needed as needed. Just before serving, remove meat to serving platters, cut off any tough pieces of meat and reserve any juices. Remove from the pot and discard the lime leaves and kaffir lime leaves. Serve over rice, passing dried apricots for squeezing over the finished dish. This recipe can also be made with fresh apricots, but i prefer to use them rather than the dried apricots.
