title: Wild Rice With Quinces in It
ingredients: 4 cups wild rice | 2 tablespoons quinces, minced | 2 teaspoons black pepper, grated
instructions: Rinse the wild rice under hot water and drain completely.

title: Roasted Cabbage and Applesauce Salad With Bacon
ingredients: 1 1/2 heads cabbage, with core | 2 bunches rocket, washed | 100 g applesauce ( apple blossom ) | 60 g shaved fat bacon | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c. Using a large sharp knife, cut the outer leaves of the cabbage, and cut them into quarters to make leaves and bundles. Separate the leaves, and cut them crossways into quarters. Place on a baking tray, and bake for 10 minutes. The bacon should be cooked, but not crispy. Leave to cool slightly, and then crumble. When cool, rub the fat from the bacon into the base of a serving dish. Toss the cabbage, rocket leaves, applesauce, shaved bacon and creamed tartar into the baking dish, and drizzle over any remaining fat. Squeeze over the baking soda, and bake for 15 minutes. If you like a little crunch to the bacon, serve some fresh grated parmesan at the table.

title: Frijoles Negros-Eggs Mexican Style
ingredients: 1 can tomato paste | 1 can black beans, drained ( reserve liquid ) | 1 can fennel, drained, finely chopped ( also called cilantro )
instructions: Mix tomato paste and reserved tomato liquid in a bowl. Mix in beans and fennel. Cover with plastic wrap, place a plate on top, and weight it down. Chill for several hours or overnight. Remove plastic wrap and form into patties, about 3/4 inch thick and 1/4 inch in diameter. Heat a dry non stick skillet over medium heat. Oil should be just barely smoking, but not smoking. Cook patties 4 minutes per side or until desired doneness.

title: Jalapeno Spread
ingredients: 1 can condensed consomme | 1/2 cup fresh cilantro stems ( optional ) | 1 fresh jalapeno pepper, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Stir consomme and cilantro in medium saucepan over medium heat until combined. Heat through.

title: Sweet Corn With Coconut (Oma's Recipe)
ingredients: 1 package frozen sweet corn with roasted yellow peppers | 1 teaspoon accent seasoning ( or other flavor enhancer ) | 1/2 cup shredded coconut
instructions: Rinse and dry sweet corn on paper towels. Cut corn into 1 inch segments, removing any pieces of green or red flesh. Mix the accent seasoning with coconut in a small mixing bowl. Dip each peace ear in coconut mixture. The coconut mixture should be able to fluff easily. Arrange corn in a casserole dish. Sprinkle with coconut. Bake in a 375 oven for 30 to 40 minutes, or until corn is cooked and crispy.

title: Serves Hot & Sour Corned Beef
ingredients: 1 corned beef brisket, trimmed of fat | 1 large pear, peeled
instructions: Preheat a broiler. Put corned beef on a rack in a roasting pan and top with beef. Slice pear crosswise into 1/4 inch thick wedges. Close up the broiler and bake for 3 to 5 hours, or until well done. Remove beef from oven and let it rest for 20 minutes. Remove the peel from the corned beef and cut the meat into 1/4 inch wedges. Add the wedges to the juices. Re cover and continue baking until the corned beef is crisp and sauce thickened, about 1 1/2 hours longer. Serve with irish soda bread.

Random Ingredients: paprika,brown onion,chipotle powder,chicken leg,seasoning salt,pasta,white wine
title: Tavukay Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken legs, with thigh joint | 1/4 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1/2 teaspoon paprika | 1/4 teaspoon white wine | 1/2 teaspoon dried chipotle powder | 1/2 cup brown onion, chopped | 1/2 cup pasta, cooked
instructions: Cut chicken legs into small pieces that will fit comfortably in a casserole dish. Mix seasoning salt, paprika powder, white wine, chipotle powder, brown onion, and pasta until well blended. Spoon mixture over chicken. Cover and refrigerate 30 minutes or longer. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Roast chicken in prepared casserole, covered, for 45 minutes, then remove lid and continue to roast, uncovered, for an additional 45 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through and cooked through.

Random Ingredients: garam masala powder,cannellini bean,celery,tabasco sauce,tomato paste
title: Easy Low Calorie Spicy Beans
ingredients: 1 cup low fat baked cannellini beans | 4 tablespoons tomato paste ( i like contadina's brand ) | 2 -4 drops tabasco sauce ( to taste ) ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon garam masala powder ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon celery, finely chopped
instructions: Drain beans. Mix remaining ingredients together and add to beans. Mix well. Pour into a sprayed 8 x 8 baking dish and bake in a 350 degree oven for 1 hour.

title: Sautéed Lentils
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups red lentils | 1/4 cup chopped olives
instructions: Pick over & rinse lentils. Add lentils to pot. Add enough water to cover lentils with 6 - 8 inches of water. Bring to boil on stove. Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, until lentils are tender and beginning to shrink. Stir occasionally. Drain, reserving 1 1/2 cups liquid. Add olives to lentils. Sauté for 5 minutes, or until cooked. Remove from heat and let stand for 20 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Green Curry Oysters
ingredients: 8 ounces freshly shelled and deveined oysters, room temp | 8 ounces whipping cream | 2 green cardamom pods ( optional )
instructions: Divide the cream among 4 small glasses. Place a cardamon pod in each glass and pour over the chilled oysters. Top with a green cardamom pod and serve.

title: Spicy and Thick Gravy for Vegans
ingredients:
1 package unflavored gelatin powder | 1 1/2 tumeric powder ( or 1-3 tumeric-2 tsp.
    - ground turmeric ) | 3 -4 black cardamom pods
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the 1 1/2 tumeric with a little bit of water.

title: Quince with Noodles
ingredients: 1 package egg noodles | 3 green chiles, chopped | 2 tablespoons dried cherries in tomato sauce or 2 tablespoons cherry tomatoes | 1/2 teaspoon dried dill weed | 1 jar quince-filled baby dill pickle halves ( in brine )
instructions: In a large pot of salted boiling water, cook the egg noodles until tender, but firm. Drain and rinse quickly under cold water to stop the cooking. Reserve 1/2 cup of the noodles cooking water. Add the chiles, cherry tomatoes and dill weed to the noodles and toss until mixed well. Remove from the heat and add the reserved noodles cooking water. Transfer to a serving bowl. Garnish with reserved cherry tomatoes and/ or pickle brine.

Random Ingredients: pork loin,red curry paste,green bean,molasses,garam masala,yogurt
title: Baked Pork Loin With Yummy Sauce
ingredients: 800 g pork loin, trimmed | 6 tablespoons red curry paste | 1/2 cup molasses | 1/2 cup yogurt | 5 teaspoons garam masala | 200 g green beans, trimmed
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c/180°c. Line a baking tray with baking paper. Place pork loin on tray. Mix curry paste, molasses, yoghurt, garam masala and 2 tsp each of salt and pepper in a small bowl. Brush half the mixture over pork loin to coat. Spread remaining mixture onto pork. Place on baking tray. Bake 45mins or until meat thermometer reads 160°c.

title: Canadian Bacon Salad
ingredients: 1 slice canadian bacon, diced | 4 romano cheese slices | 4 serrano peppers | 2 tablespoons catsup
instructions: Add the diced canadian bacon, the romano cheese slices, and serrano peppers to a salad bowl. Drizzle with catsup. Toss to mix. Refrigerate for at least an hour before serving to allow flavors to blend. Enjoy.

title: Creamy Swedish Pickled Beets
ingredients: 1 beet, cleaned and peeled | 3 1/4 cups prepared pickled mixed crawfish ( or 2 cups fresh baby beets, washed and sliced into ribbons ) or 3 1/4 cups crabmeat | 1/2 cup hoagie roll ( or other firm vegetarian crackers ) | 12 ounces pineapple chunks, drained | 1/2 cup sour cream | 1/2 an bay leaf
instructions: Chop beets very thinly. Put all ingredients except the pickled beets and sour cream into a large saucepan. Dill pickles in sour cream. Bring to a boil and cook over moderate heat for 2 minutes, stirring frequently. Remove from heat. Drain can of beets with juice thoroughly, but reserve juice. Pack 1 tbsp of beet juice into each bag of mixed beets. Pack about 1/2 cup mixed beet beet juice into each bag. Cover the bag tightly and chill the pickles. You may serve the pickles in pickled beets or on a platter, as a garnish, with or without the pickles.

title: Polenta and Cabbage
ingredients: 1 package prepared polenta | 10 ounces kielbasa, cut into 1/4-inch coins | 8 toothpicks | 2 tablespoons brandy | 1/2 cup sherry wine | 1/2 head chinese cabbage, cut into bite-size wedges | 1 can pinto beans, drained | 4 teaspoons crumbled blue cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Cut polenta into 18 slices.

Random Ingredients: scallion,sumac,turnip,black pepper,cilantro leaf,fruit,pork loin chop,lime wedge
title: Turnip Patties
ingredients: 3 turnips, peeled and sliced | 1 lb boneless pork loin chop, sliced | cilantro leaf | 1/2 cup chopped scallion, tops included | 1 teaspoon ground black pepper | 1 teaspoon ground sumac | 2 tablespoons limes or 2 tablespoons lemon juice | fresh fruit ( optional )
instructions: In a 6 cup grilling machine, combine the turnips, pork, scallions, pepper, sumac and 1/2 c c lime juice. Grill over direct medium heat, turning once for 15 - 20 minutes, or until pork is cooked through. Stir as needed for moistening.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,iceberg lettuce,chutney,yoghurt,cucumber,active yeast,plum tomato
title: Cucumber and Yoghurt Saladas
ingredients: 1/2 cup white yoghurt ( plain ) | 1/2 tablespoon active dry yeast | 2 cups iceberg lettuce, well drained | 1 cucumber, sliced thinly | 3 tablespoons grated pecorino romano cheese | 1 plum tomato, quartered | 1/4 cup chutney ( to taste )
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm tepid water. Combine yoghurt and iceburg lettuce.

title: The Best Cajun Asparagus Salad
ingredients: 1 lb fresh asparagus, trimmed with 2-3 inches of ends cut off | 1/2 cup dry breadcrumbs | 1 teaspoon sugar | 1 teaspoon creole mustard | 1/2 teaspoon anise seed | 3 tablespoons parsley flakes | ice | amaretto
instructions: Cook asparagus with sugar and mustard till tender and crisp. Remove asparagus to clean towel and allow to cool. Drain asparagus and set aside. Using an immersion blender or potato masher, break asparagus into pieces or cut pieces you like and mix. Add bread crumbs, sugar, and anise, and mix until combined. Spoon into serving bowl or serving dish and top with asparagus mixture, a drizzle of amaretto and chopped parsley flakes. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: vanilla wafer,flour,sunflower seed,ginger paste,coriander sprig,chicken bouillon
title: Vanilla Wafers
ingredients: 3 tablespoons flour | 1/2 teaspoon ginger paste | 2 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla wafer, crushed | 1/4 cup sunflower seeds | coriander sprig
instructions: Whisk together the dry ingredients in a bowl. Add the wet ingredients and mix until combined with a fork. Shape into about 15 balls. Place on a tray lined with greased clingfilm. Bake in oven for 20 minutes or until golden brown. Leave on the tray for 5 minutes or until cool. If planning on serving as an appetiser serve immediately with drinks or a relish.

title: Fig and Lamb Skewers
ingredients: 500 g figs, halved | 500 g ground lamb | 2 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste | 1 teaspoon chili oil | 1 teaspoon honey | 1 cucumber, peeled, seeded and finely diced | 1 teaspoon guacamole
instructions: In a medium size bowl, mix together the lamb, ginger and garlic and mix well. Shape into long saties approximately 1/2 inch thick. Thread onto the skewers and cook over hot coals for 7 minutes or until cooked to your liking. While still in the bowl, mix together the remaining ingredients. Serve hot with dipping sauce.

title: Penne with Krazy Hot Water and Sweet and Spicy Diced Salt
ingredients: 1 lb penne pasta | 1/3 teaspoon kosher salt ( or to taste )
instructions: Bring 6 cups of cold salted water to the boil in a pot fitted with a large rack. Meanwhile, trim the spaghetti base and ends with scissors. Drop a few pinches of salt all around the table. Cook the pasta until it just starts to turn tender, a few minutes less than the package suggests, stirring frequently. Rinse with cold water to cool. Drain. When the pasta is still hot, toss with the hot diced red pepper and toss well with the pasta. Sprinkle with the good things and serve right away.

title: A Different Kind of Toffee
ingredients: 2 cups toffee pieces | 1/3 cup mayonnaise | pepper, to taste
instructions: Mix all ingredients together until smooth. Spread on the warm toast. Use in a sandwich.

title: Nori Sushi Rolls
ingredients: 1 package rice noodles | 4 -6 sheets nori | 1 egg substitute, beaten to a pulp or 1 egg white | 1/8 teaspoon lime wedge
instructions: Rinse noodles under cold water and drain well. Place noodles on a plate and cover with water. Allow to soak for 30 minutes. Drain, and squeeze out most of the water with your hands. In a bowl, mix the nori, egg substitute and lime juice until well combined.

title: Italian Cheese Sauce, Easy for Dipping
ingredients: 1 cup ketchup | 1/2 cup shredded asiago cheese ( or parmesan )
instructions: Combine all ingredients and let mellow at least 3 - 4 hours.

Random Ingredients: gingerroot,kaffir lime leaf,kalamata olive,parmigiano reggiano cheese,soya sauce,wheat flour,ginger,baby lima bean
title: Baby Lima Beans With Kaffir Lime Juice
ingredients: 1/2 cup whole wheat flour | 3 tablespoons soya sauce | 1 tablespoon kaffir lime leaf | 1 inch fresh ginger, peeled and cut into fine julienne ( about 2 inches long ) | 16 ounces baby lima beans, washed | 1 lb kalamata olive, washed, dried, pitted and quartered | 1/4 cup freshly grated grana padano or 1/4 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 12 fresh baby lima beans, washed trimmed, ends trimmed and cut up into 2-3 inch lengths | 1 tablespoon fresh gingerroot, minced
instructions: In a large plastic bag, combine the flour and next four ingredients, tossing the bag to coat. Add the lima beans and toss to coat. Transfer to a lightly oiled shallow tray. Let sit at least 1 hour, tossing and tossing as required. Preheat the broiler, setting the rack 6 below the heat. Arrange the baby beans and kalamata olives on a broiler tray, piling each mound on top of a mound of beans and omitting the tops. Sprinkle with ginger and broil 2 - 5 minutes, until the tops are crusty and golden. Serve warm or at room temperature with kassir lime juice.

title: Swiss Mexican Pizza Dip
ingredients: 1 can red kidney beans, drained | 1 package shredded swiss cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, combine red kidney beans and swiss cheese.

title: Cheese & Pesto Balls
ingredients: 10 ounces cheese-filled celery, chopped | 1/3 cup fine breadcrumbs | 1/4 teaspoon basil pesto | 1/4 teaspoon paprika | 1/2 3/4 ounces velveeta cheese or 3/4 ounce feta cheese
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix throughly. Form into bite size balls the size of a walnut. Enjoy these little balls taste richer and more appetizing than the old days, so plan on adding more of your favourite vegetables. They are addictive.

title: Chef John's Potato Farls
ingredients: 6 yukon gold potatoes | 1 cup whole wheat flour | 1/2 cup white cornmeal
instructions: Fill a medium saucepan with water and bring to a boil. Add potatoes, cover, and cook until tender, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: rom tomato,red pepper flake,baby spinach,cardamom powder,chicken bouillon granule,sourdough bread
title: Spinach-Tomato Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 can roma tomatoes, chopped | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon granules | 2 tablespoons baby spinach | 1 teaspoon garam masala powder | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom powder | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Combine the tomatoes and their juices in a medium bowl, or food processor.. Transfer the mixture to a small saucepan and mix in the bouillon granules until dissolved. Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring frequently. Reduce heat to low, add the spinach and continue cooking on low heat, stirring frequently, until the liquid has reduced and all of the spinach is wilted. Stir in the garam masala powder, cardamom and red pepper flakes and continue cooking and stirring until heated through.

title: Lebanese Mustard Lamb Burgers
ingredients: 1 cup prepared mustard | 2 tablespoons catsup | 1 tablespoon chinese yogurt | 1 tablespoon salad oil | 1 tablespoon ground cumin | 1 teaspoon ground mixed dried lemongrass, crushed
instructions: In a bowl, mix mustard, catsup, yogurt, salad oil, cumin, and lemon grass. Cover and refrigerate 4 hours.

Random Ingredients: leek,cocoa powder,tomato green chile pepper,beef broth
title: Chile Soup
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups chopped leeks | 1 can chopped tomatoes with green chile peppers | 1 can condensed beef broth | 1 pound unsweetened cocoa powder
instructions: Mix the leeks, tomatoes, and beef broth in a pot over medium to low heat. Cook, stirring frequently, about 8 minutes. Transfer the hot soup mixture to a blender and blend for 5 minutes, or until smooth. Stir the hot soup mixture into the soup in batches. Return soup to the soup pot and simmer 30 minutes, until heated through. To serve, stir a cup of chile soup into the soup.

title: Satay Sauce
ingredients: 30 g pickled pimento, drained and finely diced | 2 tablespoons satay sauce
instructions: Pile the pimento into a small bowl, add the sweet pickles and toss to mix. Stir through the satay until melted.

Random Ingredients: ice water,tortilla chip,lemon zest,braeburn apple,chipotle chile,beef sirloin,chive
title: Sizzling Apple Beef Nachos
ingredients: 1/2 cup lemon zest ( fresh or canned ) | 1/2 cup chopped canned chipotle chile | 1 boneless beef top sirloin, cut 1 inch wide by 3 inches long | 1/4 cup ice water | 4 1/2 ounces chilled soft tortilla chips, broken | 2 small braeburn apples, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup finely snipped fresh chives
instructions: Place the lemon zest in a small bowl with 1 tsp of the chipotle, and let stand for 15 minutes. Cut the beef lengthwise in half, about 1/4 inch thick. Place the beef and 1/4 tsp of the chipotle mixture in a plastic bag.

Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,egg yolk,pork shoulder,cucumber,italian bread,habanero pepper,cornbread
title: Sicilian Meatballs With Cucumber Habanero
ingredients: 1/2 lb pork shoulder ( cut into 2-inch cubes ) | 1 egg yolk | 1 teaspoon freshly ground cardamom pod | 1/2 cup diced cucumber | 1 teaspoon minced garlic ( from a jar ) | 1 teaspoon chopped seeded habanero pepper ( seeded in a large pinch ) | crusty cornbread, for garnish
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large bowl.

title: Creamy Low Fat Chocolate Sundae
ingredients: 1 cup lowfat margarine | 10 ice cream, softened | 1/2 cup sweetened flaked chocolate ice cream ( about )
instructions: Beat the margarine with a handheld mixer on medium speed until light and fluffy. Add the ice cream and continue beating. Add the sweetened flaked chocolate and beat until just combined. Keep on low speed while making ice cream. Serve immediately before serving.

Random Ingredients: triple sec,russet potato,baby spinach leaf,grainy mustard,cocoa,catsup
title: Roast Beef Hashbrowns #RSC
ingredients: 1 lb russet potato, scrubbed | 1 tablespoon light cocoa, heaping ( dutch ) | 1 tablespoon grainy mustard | 1 tablespoon triple sec | 1 1/2 cups baby spinach leaves | 2 tablespoons catsup
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place potatoes in a bowl of cold water. Stir to separate the skins from the potatoes and place the potatoes in a roasting pan with a few inches of space between them. Bake at 400 degrees for 45 minutes then remove from oven and allow to cool in the oven for an additional 20 - 25 minutes until completely cool. After cooled completely dice potatoes roughly and place back in the oven and continue until desired texture occurs. If the potatoes start to burn after 25 minutes, remove the pan from the oven and add the cocoa at the end of the 45 minute interval. It should just be warm and melted. In a bowl add the remaining ingredients except for the catsup. Combine well with a fork. When potatoes are cool enough to handle, pull the meat out into the bag into the hot hash browns on the rack. Drain off any excess fat. Spread catsauce on top of the hash browns and bake for 15 to 20 minutes until crisp and brown. Let cool slightly then cut into 1/2 to ¾ inch slices.

Random Ingredients: garbanzo bean,salt black pepper,pear,rice wine,sake,white wine
title: Chanko Yakiniku
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups dried garbanzo beans, soaked overnight and drained | 7 cups white wine | 1/3 cup sake | 1/3 cup rice wine | 1 teaspoon salt and ground black pepper to taste | 1 pear, finely chopped
instructions: Place the soaked garbanzo beans into a large bowl and cover with 3 cups of white wine and bring to a boil. Cook over medium heat until the beans are tender. Reserve the bean liquid. Stir the cooked garbanzo beans, rice wine, salt, and pepper into the cooked garbanzo bean liquid. Return to a boil, reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer until the sauce has become syrupy, about 1 1/2 hours.

title: Easy Sun-dried Tomato Chicken
ingredients: 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast | 4 ounces sun-dried tomatoes | 1 can deli sliced italian style mushrooms
instructions: Drain sliced tomatoes and mushrooms reserving juices, set aside. Using a meat mallot, pound chicken breast until thin. Add sun dried tomatoes and reserved juices to chicken and marinate at least an hour. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Spray 9x13 inch baking dish with non stick cooking spray. Place chicken in dish and top with sundried tomato mixture. Bake for 30 minutes or until chicken is cooked through and juices run clear.

title: Roasted Garlic and Fruity Cheese
ingredients: 3 medium bulbs of garlic | 2 teaspoons dried oregano leaves | 1 pound camembert cheese, cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 medium ripe fruit, peeled, cored and cut into 1-inch cubes
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Place the garlic bulbs in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Sprinkle with oregano and drizzle with olive oil. Roast garlic in the preheated oven for 25 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 300 degrees f. Roast garlic until tender and the cloves are beginning to peel off the skins, about 1 hour 30 minutes. Turn garlic cloves out onto a work surface, place on a large platter, cover with aluminum foil, and continue baking until tender, about 1 hour more. Reserve juices in dish. Once garlic is cool enough to handle, peel off garlic bulb, and break into chunks. Strain the garlic and oil through a fine mesh sieve into a bowl and discard the garlic. Stir in the goat cheese cubes. Cover bowl and refrigerate until served.

title: Basil & Lemon Twirls
ingredients: 4 cups creme fraiche | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon dried basil | 1/2 teaspoon za'atar spice mix | 1/4 cup teabags ( miniature size bag )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl & mix thoroughly. Pour into a serving bowl & refrigerate for 6 hours or overnight before serving. Can be served as a spread or spread w/french bread & bread sticks.

title: Roasted Squash With Kumquats and Kythoni Sweet Sauce
ingredients: 1 large poblano chile | 1 cup light corn syrup | 1/4 cup kumquat, pureed ( sweetened soy sauce )
instructions: Preheat the broiler so the oven is about 4 inches from the heat source. Rub the poblano with the salt. Roast the chile under the broiler for about 10 minutes, turn and roil until the skin blisters and blisters, about 5 minutes longer. Set the chile aside to cool. When cool enough to handle, rub off as much skin and remaining flesh of the chile and discard the black membrane and seeds. Cut the chile in 1/2 inch cubes and set aside. Transfer 1/2 cup of the syrup to a small bowl. Sprinkle the poblano with the cooked corn syrup and set aside.
