instructions: Clean and dry chicken pieces. Place in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Cut pepperoni slices into long strips using a sharp knife. Arrange around chicken pieces and top with pepperoni strips and cover with oil. Bake at 375 degrees for approximately 1 hour or until tender.

title: Peach Salad
ingredients: 4 -6 ripe peaches ( not peeled ) | 1 small ripe fruit, such as rhubarb ( the sweetened kind ) | 4 tablespoons margarine or 4 tablespoons butter
instructions: Peel and pit the peaches. Remove the pits with a sharp knife or melonballer. Cut the peach into eighths.

title: Jamaican Sliced Shrimp With Yellow Squash
ingredients: 1 package medium shrimp paste | 1 yellow squash, cut into 1 inch chunks | 1 teaspoon pickled jamaican jerk spice
instructions: Thoroughly mix shrimp paste, squash, and jerk seasoning in a glass or plastic bowl. Cover bowl tightly with plastic wrap. Let sit 15 minutes at room 30% heat, stirring well once or twice to prevent shrimp from sticking. Rinse plastic wrap off shrimp. Transfer shrimp to plastic wrap and pat dry.

title: Asparagus Soup With Tomato and Corn
ingredients: 15 slices baguette | 2 1/2 lbs beefsteak tomatoes | 1/2 cup frozen asparagus | 1 teaspoon green cardamom pods | 2 teaspoons dry tequila | 10 baby corn or 10 green peas
instructions: Slice baguette in half diagonally. You should use at least 12 slices. Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium high heat and add tomatoes. Cook them about 10 minutes, or until a bit brown. If using frozen peas, thaw them. Slice tomatoes in half, then slice in half again. Add asparagus, cardamoms, margarita mix and tequila to the tomatoes. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to simmer. Add baby corn, simmer five minutes, then remove the baguette from the heat. Serve hot. The soup should have a nice yellow color. It is best eaten very hot but tastes good when served cold. Variation, for a variation see asparagus soup with potato chips or chorizo bread.

Random Ingredients: mozzarella cheese,milk chocolate chip,grape leaf,rosemary,tart apple
title: Pot-A-Chute (German Apple, Pepper & Hot Sauce)
ingredients: 2 small tart apples, peeled, halved, cored and sliced thin | 1/2 cup grape leaves, washed and picked over | 1/8 cup finely shredded low-fat mozzarella cheese | 2 tablespoons milk chocolate chips | 1 sprig fresh rosemary ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°f. Arrange apple slices in a single layer in a non stick baking dish. Set aside 1 tablespoon of water in pan and arrange grape leaves around apples, overlapping with fingers if desired. Top with equal amounts of cheese and place rosemary sprigs on top. Drizzle remaining water over apples and bake in oven until cheese is melted and apples are bubbling at the edges, about 20 minutes. Serve immediately. Store leftover cheese mixture in airtight container in refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: pam cooking spray,paprika,oregano,fenugreek seed,romaine lettuce,skirt steak,lettuce,chicken base
title: Grilled Skirt Steak
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs skirt steaks | 12 ounces smoked paprika | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 2/3 cup chicken base | 1 tablespoon fenugreek seeds | 2 tablespoons paprika | 8 cups lightly packed shredded romaine lettuce | 2 cups lightly packed torn lettuce | olive oil flavored pam cooking spray
instructions: Place first 4 ingredients in a large resealable plastic bag. Seal and shake to blend. Place steaks in bag, add marinade and shake to coat. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours. Grill to desired doneness. Serve with cooked noodles or rice.

title: Pimientos and Grape Tomatoes
ingredients: 4 grape tomatoes | 4 tablespoons jarred pimiento
instructions: Slice off tops and bottoms of tomatoes, and make small cut into tops.. Cut tops and bottoms of tomatoes in half, or cut the tops into smaller squares. Arrange tomato halves in a small, shallow dish, close together and refrigerate for 1 hour, or until they can be pierced easily with a knife. Drain tomatoes, and serve with a spoon of jarred pimiento.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,boston lettuce leaf,thai basil,butternut squash,apple
title: Butternut Squash Summer Soup
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 butternut squash - peeled, seeded and cubed | 1 large apple - peeled, cored and sliced | 1 bunch thai basil, chopped | 4 boston lettuce leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Drain soup can, reserving juice. Place squash cubes in a baking dish. Cover with reserved soup liquid. Bake in preheated oven for 20 minutes. Stir in apple and thai basil, continue baking 5 to 10 minutes. Break lettuce into pieces.

Random Ingredients: hamburger,red chili pepper flake,kidney bean,lemon,rice paper,marjoram,amaretto,salt pork
title: Lemon Rice Paper Rolls
ingredients: 2 lbs hamburger | 20 -25 paper sheets rice paper | 2 cans kidney beans, drained ( reserve a few tsp liquid ) | 1 lemon, juice of | 1 red chili pepper flakes ( to taste ) | 1 tablespoon amaretto or 1 tablespoon brandy | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram | salt, to taste
instructions: Soak rice sheets in cool water for about 15 minutes. This step if not already done is important to allow a good amount of moisture to escape. Remove rice papers from water and place between sheets of damp cloth. Lay one or two sheets of rice paper over the pile leaving the top shiny. Spread a layer of beans in the middle of the rice paper, then top with a very thin layer of hamburger, leaving a small mound at the bottom at the top. Roll the paper over itself once the last layer of hamburger is done. Repeat with remaining sheets of rice paper and filling. You may have to roll them until all are used. Dip a fork in cold water and briefly dip both sides into it. The paper should not be sticky, but a little sticky, so if desired, cover with a clean cotton cloth and place flat on a cookie sheet. Use a tooth pick to poke holes all over the paper a few at a time. Cover with a piece of aluminum foil and bake in a 375 degree oven for 25 - 30 minutes until it is golden brown. Serve with a good red sauce and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,flour,mustard powder,anise seed,chipotle chile adobo,cilantro,herb,angel hair pasta
title: Cilantro and Chiles Pasta
ingredients: 8 -10 medium chipotle chiles in adobo, seeded | 1 cup fresh cilantro, chopped ( or 1/2 cup coriander ) | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 2 1/2 cups flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons seasoning mix or 1 1/2 teaspoons red wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/4 teaspoon crushed anise seed | 8 ounces angel hair pasta ( or linguine )
instructions: Remove the seeds from the chipotle chiles and place in a blender with the chopped cilantro. Blend until very fine. Add the vinegar, vinegar, mustard, anise and chiles and blend to a paste. Set aside. Cook the pasta according to the package directions. Drain and combine with all of the dressing. You may use more or less dressing depending on how hot or how dry your pasta is. Toss until the flavors really blend.

Random Ingredients: pecan,confectioner sugar,white potato,pea,rice,mint chocolate chip ice cream,kielbasa,salmon
title: Stuffed Potato Crescents
ingredients: 2 pounds white potatoes, peeled and chopped | 1 pound smoked salmon, chopped | 2 pounds kielbasa, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 1 pound frozen peas | 1 package confectioners'sugar | 1 cup crushed ice cream | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped fresh mint chocolate chips or melted ice cream
instructions: In a large pot of salted boiling water, cook potatoes until tender but still firm. Drain, reserving 1/2 cup of the potato water. While the potatoes are cooking, combine the salmon, kielbasa and peas in a large skillet and cook over medium heat until just barely cooked through. Using a slotted spoon, remove the salmon mixture to a bowl and mash slightly. Mix in the potato water and cook 1 minute, until tender and crumbly. Stir in the confectioners' sugar and continue to cook until thickened. Set the cheese sauce aside. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. In an 8x8 inch baking dish, spread out one third of the potato mixture. Use the back of a spoon to mold the mixture into crescents. Place 1 heaping spoonful of the fish mixture in the center of each crescent. Fold the crescents in half, and press the edges firmly together. Chill until serving, 20 minutes to firm.

title: Grape Sarnishes (Rice Stick)
ingredients: 3 lbs seedless grapes ( not in season ) | 1 medium white onion, chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cardamom | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke
instructions: Cut grapes into ½” pieces or slice thin. Finely chop onion. In a small saucepan, add vinegar, nutmeg, liquid smoke. Place grapes in liquid smoke mixture, being sure each piece is completely covered by liquid. Cover and cook over low heat until grapes are soft, stirring occasionally.. Serve immediately, garnished with small sprinkles of the chopped onion.

title: Vegetable Samosa
ingredients: 1 bag frozen mixed vegetables ( spinach, cauliflower and carrots ) | 1/2 cup crumbled dried dates | 1/2 - 1 cup crumbled phyllo dough | 4 tablespoons minced pickles ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to mix together the prepared vegetables, dates and phyllo on a cookie sheet, leaving gaps as possible. Bake for 10 - 12 minutes or until phyllo looks dry. Take off sheet and let cool. Spread sliced samosas with greek dressing and sprinkle with crumbled feta cheese if desired.

title: Ac-Corn Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb pasta, cooked | 1 yellow squash | 1 teaspoon accent seasoning | 2/3 cup irish cream | 1/2 cup currants
instructions: Preheat oven on stove. Boil a pot of water for pasta. While waiting for water to boil, dice squash. Cut pasta into small chunks and put in pan with squash. Heat acup for about 5 minutes or until the squash can smell roasted and the strands begin to turn white and have some caramelization. Remove from heat and set aside. In a bowl, add arugula, orange blossom water, butter, orange/orange/orange juice, currants. Stir well until mixed well. Add pasta and mix together with sauce. If pasta is too flakey, mix some of the arugula with the pasta and veggies. When pasta is done, add to vegetables and stir well. Put in 2 or 3 baking dishes or a shallow dish and cover each dinner plate with tin foil. Bake for about 15 minutes.

title: Cod Noodle Bake - Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 375 g cod | 1 can asparagus, drained | 1 stick celery | 6 eggs noodles ( fresh or dried, depending on size and shape of noodle ) | maraschino cherry, to serve | 125 g dark chocolate, chopped finely
instructions: Cook noodles according to instructions. Drain and allow to cool slightly. Place cod into a saucepan and cover with cold water. Bring to the boil and then remove from heat. Let it stand for 10 minutes. Drain well and cut cod into bite size pieces. Preheat oven to 200°c. Lightly spray a 12 cup capacity ovenproof dish with cooking spray. Cut rind off asparagus at base. Remove leaves and stalks from stalks, then coarsely chop. Cook asparagus, celery and cod in boiling salted water, uncovered, for 3 minutes, or until just cooked.

title: Chilies in Ham and Provolone Cheese
ingredients: 4 chilies, roasted, peeled and cut into 1/4 `` diagonal slices | 4 slices deli ham
instructions: Spread 2 chilies lengthwise on each slice of cheese. Place half a slice of ham and remaining 2 slices of cheese on each. Wrap a slice of cheese so the chilies form a sandwich.

title: Zaytoon (Zaytoon Al-Zaytooth Style)
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon cumin seeds, toasted and crushed | 3 cups baking soda, divided | 2 large whole or 2 medium littleneck clams, scrubbed
instructions: Pre heat oven to 375ºf. Combine the cumin and 1 1/2 cups baking soda in a tea ball, place in oven and bake for 10 minutes. Set aside to cool. Place the remaining 3 cups baking soda in a blender add the cloves of clams and puree until fairly smooth. Add the remaining 2 cups baking soda and puree again until the mixture starts to resemble fine bread crumbs. Add in the cumin to the cookie dough and mix well. Form into a ball and place in a small container with a tight fitting lid. Place in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour or until baking time does not change. To test if the molds are done, pop into a small skillet and gently flatten with the back of a wooden spoon. If they start to crack, turn down the oven temperature to 300 degrees. Cook 10 minutes. Remove and drain on paper towels.

title: Almond and Tomato Appetizer Rolls
ingredients: 500 g tomato sauce | 1 kg yeast | 50 g ground almonds | 1000 ml white vinegar
instructions: Mix the tomato sauce, yeast, ground almonds, and white vinegar together in a mixing bowl. Put the dough into an oiled bowl about 5 - 8 inches in diameter and cover with a cloth. Let the dough rise in a warm place until dough doubles in size. Cut dough into squares or diamonds. Put a spoonful of the mixture into the center and press the edges together firmly together with your fingers. Cover with a cloth and leave for an hour in a warm place to rise again. Pre heat the oven to 200°c put a baking tray on the middle shelf of the oven. Put half of the prepared dough into the tray and bake for 25 - 30 minutes. Allow to cool slightly before cutting.

title: Asian Teriyaki Sauce #5FIX
ingredients: 1 jar teriyaki sauce | 1 package italian five cheese with prawns, coarsely chopped
instructions: Pour teriyaki sauce in 9x13 inch dish, or use lids and shake or stir teriyaki sauce into hot teriyaki sauce. Top with 5 cheese over the sauce. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour or over night for best taste.

title: White Beans and Peanuts
ingredients: 1 can white kidney beans, drained and rinsed ( white bean ) | 1/2 cup dry roasted salted peanuts
instructions: The first 3 ingredients will be the peanuts. Put the peanuts into a food processor and pulse until chopped fine. Pour the peanuts into a small bowl and coarsely chop. Toast the can of beans in the oven, or in the microwave or dry the peanuts up in paper bags. Put the mixture into a bowl and add the peanuts. Mix thoroughly or you'll be stuffing peanuts.

Random Ingredients: parsnip,taco seasoning mix,coleslaw dressing,onion soup mix,beef broth
title: Crock Pot Parsnip and Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 lb parsnip, peeled and cut in half | 12 ounces coleslaw dressing | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning mix | 1 cup low sodium beef broth or 1 cup chicken broth | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix
instructions: Slice parsnips thinly. Add all remaining ingredients except for the salad dressing. Cover and cook on low for 6 hours.

title: Truffle Pear Coffee
ingredients: 1 cup sweet soup, instant or hot | 1 tablespoon pomegranate seeds | 1 teaspoon coffee | 1/2 teaspoon ground mustard or 1/2 teaspoon prepared soup | 1 1 cup chopped peeled ripe pears | 1/2 cup chopped green onion
instructions: In a medium saucepan combine first 6 ingredients and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Stir soup occasionally with a spoon to prevent sticking together. Cook until pears are softened, stirring often, about 8 minutes. Stir in pears and green onions as desired.

Random Ingredients: mushroom stem,ham,bacon,white bread wheat,chicken thigh,portabella mushroom
title: Amazing Chicken and Stuffing
ingredients: 4 pieces white bread ( whole wheat, white or whole wheat preferred ) | 1 pound bacon | 2 -3 lbs chicken thighs | 1 package portabella mushrooms | 1 can mushroom stems and pieces | 1 package ham
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Trim the chicken thighs to remove any access fat and/or nerves. Slice bacon into 1 1/2 inch pieces and fry in large skillet over medium heat until crispy. Remove, then set the fat in the skillet aside reserving 1 tablespoon of fat.

title: Green Beans
ingredients: 1 lb french style green bean, peeled | 2 tablespoons pesto | 1 lime, juice and zest of
instructions: Bring water to a boil in a large saucepan. Slice the ends off of the green beans so that they will fit snugly into your food processor. Cook for a short while, making sure that they do not brown. Add the spinach as needed to stop it from jumping or breaking up in your food processor until they are cooked but not mushy, about 30 - 40 seconds. Drain the water from the green beans. Put the beans back on the stove over high heat then add all the water and mint, stir. Put the lid on and cook over medium high heat for 30 seconds, stirring to loosen the mint and mint. Remove from heat. Allow to sit for about 10 minutes before serving.

title: Barley  Lamb With Barley
ingredients: 1 1/4 kg lamb shoulder | 3 1/2 cups pearl barley | 1 cup raisins | 2 tablespoons mayonnaise, gluten-free is preferred
instructions: Trim and cut lamb into 2 cm cubes. Place lamb in large saucepan and cover with cold water.

title: Porotos Granados - Red Apple Salad
ingredients: 16 ounces grape tomatoes | 1 small red apple, very ripe
instructions: Wash and peel the tomatoes. Remove the core, cutting off the ends. Slice into thick slices, cutwise. Sprinkle the apple with salt to taste. Wash the tomatoes under running water, and shake gently until they are dry. Arrange the tomatoes over a platter, cut side down. Sprinkle over the apples and grapes. Sprinkle with sugar. Serve warm. Variation, use the apple halves, then cut them into thin slices and serve with the tomatoes.

title: Aussie Snow Pea and Potato Salad
ingredients: 2 potatoes, peeled and boiled | 1 cup dry black beans or 1 cup snow peas | 1/4 cup nonfat vanilla yogurt | 1/4 cup skim milk | 1/4 teaspoon black pepper
instructions: Boil the potatoes and allow to cool. Slice the potato very thin. Place each potato slice in a bowl. Add the beans and snow peas and toss. In a small bowl, whisk together the yogurt, milk and some black pepper. Pour over the potato mixture and mix to combine. Chill several hours or overnight to allow all the flavours to develop. Enjoy.

title: Garlic Cheese Spread
ingredients: 16 ounces cherry tomatoes, halved | 8 ounces garlic powder | 8 ounces marjoram, crushed
instructions: Combine all of the ingredients in a bowl, process until smooth and creamy. Spread onto your favourite cheeses when cooled.

title: Tuna Cheeze (Herby Stuffed Matzo Balls)
ingredients: 8 -10 leaves fresh herb ( see note ) | 2 tablespoons matzo meal | 2 teaspoons minced onions or 2 teaspoons minced canned onions | 1 teaspoon tapioca starch | 1 1/2 cups plain breadcrumbs
instructions: First, make your breadcrumbing.. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Finely chop the herbs. Sift matzoh meal, minced onions, and tapioca starch together in a mixing bowl. Add breadcrumbs, herbs, and spices. Knead dough with hands or a rotary beater/mixer for 10 minutes or until dough becomes elastic. Add more bread crumbs, if needed, in necessary. Form balls and place on baking sheet. You may use an ice cream scoop, or a toothpick to hold the balls in place. Bake at 350 degrees on baking sheet 3 to 4 minutes or until bread crumbs bubble. Flip and bake another 3 to 4 minutes or until bread crumbs are golden and golden.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,chat masala,wasabi powder,pearl barley,white sugar,cannellini bean,beef chuck roast
title: Beef With White Beans and Potatoes
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs beef chuck roast, trimmed of any visible fat | 1/3 cup wasabi powder | 3 tablespoons white sugar | 1 bell pepper, chopped | 1 cup pearl barley | 1 can cannellini beans ( drained ) | 3 -4 tablespoons chat masala, for serving
instructions: Place roast in crock pot. Add other ingredients and mix well. Cook on low for at least 8 hours. Remove from crock pot, cover, and turn to high for a few hours. Remove lid and stir well to mix. Taste and adjust seasoning.

title: Quick Faux Phèpin (Chicken Fauxiti)
ingredients: 3 ounces ham | 6 ounces farfalle pasta or 6 ounces elbow macaroni | 1 green food coloring | 1 tablespoon garlic, crushed | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper ( more or less to taste )
instructions: Cook farfalle according to package directions until al dente. Drain, rinse under cold water and set aside. Cook your ham in a frying pan until cooked through. Drain any excess fat and add to the ham until you have a thick white coating on the meat. Add the pasta and green food coloring and simmer until pasta is done. If you need to thicken mixture with more water for desired consistency add water or broth to desired consistency or thickness of the pasta. Add garlic a few drops at a time, stirring after each addition and mixing in with a fork as it is added to the pasta at the end. Serve immediately while warm or at room temperature.

title: Korean Cucumber Salad
ingredients:
4 large cucumbers, peeled, washed and thinly sliced into rings ( this is very important for the flavor to me and looks better.
    - if you can't get the cucumbers, feel free to add a little bit of ketchup, 1 tablespoon ) | 2 tablespoons chili paste ( kochu jang ) | 2 tablespoons ketchup, for topping ( or use bottled ketchup )
instructions: Mix ketchup and chili paste together, and set aside. In a large bowl, toss the sliced cucumbers with the ketchup mixture. Add the chopped cucumbers to the bowl, and toss to coat. Let sit in the refrigerator for 10 - 15 minutes, or serve immediately.

title: Japanese Style Sesame Pasta
ingredients: 2 celery ribs, including leaves, peeled cut on half | 1 teaspoon ground ginger powder or 1 teaspoon fresh ginger, grated | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 1 lb uncooked penne, preferably whole wheat | 1 teaspoon cardamom
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil for the penne. Heat the sesame oil in a saucepan over medium heat. When the oil is hot, add the celery, and cook about 6 minutes, or until just soft. Add the ginger, and cook about 30 seconds. Reduce the heat to low, and add the cooked pasta. Cook about 2 minutes.

title: Spicy Apple Couscous
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked couscous | cooking spray | 2 stalks celery, chopped | 3 apples - peeled, cored and diced | 1/4 teaspoon italian seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Place couscous in a large bowl.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper flake,chili paste,olive oil,lemon,cooking oil
title: Spicy Chilli Oil With the Lemon
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil | 2 tablespoons lemon rind or 3 tablespoons lime rind | 1 red chili pepper, deseeded and finely sliced ( such as scotch bonnet or anjou ) | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 -2 tablespoon hot chili paste ( such as sambal oelek )
instructions: Finely dice the chilli and rind. Place in a pestle and mortar and pound to a rough paste with the oil. Stir in the chili paste and taste to see whether it is necessary, add more chilli or chilli paste and 1/2 teaspoon of salt if making small patties. If needed, refrigerate for at least one hour or up to 6 hours.

Random Ingredients: peach,red curry paste,ranch dressing mix,cheddar cheese,soya sauce,nutmeg,tamari soy sauce,asafoetida powder
title: Peach & Cheddar Dip in a Creamy Curry Dressing (Dorie Greenspan)
ingredients: 2 lbs asafoetida powder | 1 cup of shredded cheddar cheese ( or more if you want a milder dressing ) | 1 cup ranch dressing mix | 1 cup peach, pitted and sliced ( or use strawberries, as a topping ) | 2 teaspoons red curry paste | 2 teaspoons tamari soy sauce | 2 teaspoons soya sauce | 1 teaspoon nutmeg ( to garnish )
instructions: Dice the asafetida very fine with a microplane. Sprinkle a little cornstarch onto a plate and put it on your microwave safe plate. Put the asafoetida and cheddar cheese in a medium bowl. Stir it around with the spatula so it gets a smooth texture. Place the mango and asafoetida in a small bowl. Mix the mango with the cubed asafoetida and cheddar cheese until it's all mixed well. Add the ranch and dressing mix and stir around with the spoon till everything is mixed and it is completely mixed in asafoetida and cheddar cheese. Dump the peaches into the blender and mix it all up till they are all mashed up. Pour the peach mixture over the asafoetida and cheese. Let it cool for about 10 minutes and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: rice noodle,mustard seed,vegetable oil,plain yogurt,raisin,cayenne pepper
title: Noodles With Raisins and Mustard
ingredients: 4 ounces rice stick noodles | vegetable oil ( for deep frying ) | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 1 pinch cayenne pepper | 1/4 cup raisins | 1/4 cup plain yogurt
instructions: Break noodles into 2 inch lengths and soak in cool water 15 minutes. Drain. Heat 1 tbsp oil in deep saucepan over medium heat. Add mustard seeds and cayenne. Sprinkle raisins over mustard seeds. Remove from heat, cover and leave undisturbed for 5 minutes. Drain noodles well and transfer to large bowl. Heat remaining oil in skillet. Add mustard and cayenne. When mustard starts to darken, add drained noodles. Toss frequently with any of the raisin and mustard oil until the noodles are coated with the spice mixture. Serve straight away with plain yogurt on the side.

title: Rice and Egg Bake
ingredients: 2 cups cooked white rice ( not instant ) | 2 tablespoons tomato sauce | 1 apple, peeled, cored and finely chopped | 2 teaspoons coriander seeds | 1 cup salsa
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f in a large bowl, combine rice, tomato sauce, apple, coriander, and salsa. Stir to combine. Divide rice mixture into two greases 2 cup ovenproof dishes. Bake, uncovered, for 30 - 35 minutes until rice is thoroughly heated and the apples have begun to brown. Serve hot or cold.

title: Spicy Roasted Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 medium head cauliflower | 1/4 cup chili pepper flakes ( peri peri ) | 1/4 cup minced fresh thyme sprigs
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Using sharp knife, cut down and discard stem from cauliflower. Place cauliflower on greased and floured baking sheet. Sprinkle with chili flakes and thyme. Roast for 45 - 55 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: marjoram,cream,cake flour,cucumber,fig,ham,red curry paste,philadelphia cream cheese
title: Fruity Red Curry Pastries
ingredients: 2 cups cake flour | 2 tablespoons red curry paste ( i used thai kitchen brand ) | 1 package philadelphia cream cheese, room temperatured | 1/4 cup sour cream ( i use greek style ) | 1/4 cup basil and marjoram ( i also used italian herb ) | 1 lb dried fig, stemmed and sliced | 1 cucumber, peeled and sliced into strips | 1/4 lb chopped ham ( i used black )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Make the dough. Mix flour, curry paste and 1st measure of water and knead until it becomes a ball. Roll out as thin as you will go, about 8 by 10 inches. Cut out 1 - 1 inch circles. Dip each in flour and place on an ungreased cookie sheet. Sprinkle evenly with marjoram and cilantro. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until golden brown. Let cool off slightly. Make the filling, mix sour cream and basil in a bowl. Add figs and cucumber, stir well. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour or up to overnight. Cut the pastries. Put 1 teaspoon or so of filling on each pastry circle. Brush with water and fold in half diagonally. Press the edges together to seal. Sprinkle with ham. Cut steam holes with a knife tip. Cook in oven for 10 - 15 minutes.

title: Quick and Easy Whole Wheat Chapati
ingredients: 1/2 cup vital wheat gluten | 1 1/2 cups plain flour ( plus extra flour to ensure gluten is floured )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 180 c /375f. Using kitchen scissors, cut all the bumps from the wheat gluten. You should now have a crumbly mess which you can use immediately to make things easier on your next meal. If you need to add extra flour, add a pinch of salt and about 1 tsp of turmeric, as well as a couple of dashes of lemon juice and a grinding of black pepper. You should end up with a batter with a smooth, slightly sticky mix. You only need to dust with flour if it’s dry, but if it’s really sticky, dust off extra flour and try again. Use a pastry cutter to roughly cut and floured the dough, then gently push in pieces, dusting each ‘pocket’ with flour between each ‘pocket’ if they feel sticky, dust off flour again if they’re too dry. Lightly grease oven trays with vegetable oil and line the trays with baking paper. Heat 1 cup of boiling water and 1/2 tsp salt in a medium sauce pan. Drop in the doughs and turn once to coat in the water. Cook for 10 minutes on each side until they are a pale golden colour and sound no resistance when tapped. Serve with a sprinkling of plain yoghurt, fresh chopped coriander or chutney.

Random Ingredients: cool whip,mayonnaise,almond paste,spanish onion,pork chop,gingerroot,lemon peel
title: Pork Chops in Ginger & Aromatic Cream Sauce
ingredients: 2/3 cup mayonnaise | 1 teaspoon grated fresh gingerroot | 9 ounces sweet cured pork chops, about 2-inches in thickness, cut crosswise in half | 1 spanish onions or 1 onion, sliced thin | 2 inches gingerroot, peeled and sliced thin | 1 -2 tablespoon almond paste or 1 -2 tablespoon apricot jam | 2 cups cool whip | lemon peel, for sprinkling
instructions: Stir together the dressing ingredients in a bowl, adding the pork on top, mix well, cover and refrigerate for 1 hour. Bring to room temperature before serving. Sprinkle liberally with lemon peel, and serve with the reserved marinade.

Random Ingredients: whipping cream,lime wedge,wine vinegar,onion powder,cornflour,bratwurst,sherry wine
title: Brats in Sour Cream With Lime
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs bratwursts | 1 dash onion powder | 1 dash salt | 1 dash white pepper | 1 dash lime wedge | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 2 tablespoons dry sherry wine | 1/2 cup whipping cream
instructions: Heat a bit of oil in a frying pan then add the brat. I don't really have a particular kind of oil though, it depends on the size of your brats. Cook, turning frequently, until browned on both sides. Add the onions, season to taste with salt and pepper and cook until they are soft and transparent, stirring frequently. Dust with lime squeeze and mix. Pour in the sherry and keep warm.

title: Indonesian Satay Recipe
ingredients: 1/2 cup peanuts oil | 3 -4 green chili | 3/4 cup raisins | 3 1/2 teaspoons sugar
instructions: Wash chilies and remove seeds and membrane. Grind chilies into fine paste. Heat the oils in a small frying pan over medium high heat until very hot. Add chili paste and cook for one minute. Transfer to a jar and keep in the refrigerator. For satay, remove seeds from chilies and smash slightly.

title: Fragrant Rice Wine
ingredients: 2 tablespoons coriander seeds, crushed | 1 1/2 cups arborio rice or 1 1/2 cups medium grain rice | 1 cup dry rice wine
instructions: Heat half the hot wok over a medium hot burner. When the wok is very hot, add the coriander seeds and a few grains of crushed arborio rice.

title: Lime Syrup
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped fresh lime juice | 1 teaspoon hot paprika
instructions: Combine the lime juice, hot paprika, and fresh lime juice in a small bowl. Serve as a condiment to chicken or pork chops.

title: Wild Mushroom Stroganoff
ingredients: 2 packages cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup madeira wine
instructions: Stir mushrooms and soup together until well combined. Heat until bubbling. Pour into a dish and let set 5 minutes. Serve over noodles.

Random Ingredients: swiss chard,feta cheese,grenadine,sauce,italian sausage link,kidney bean
title: Italian Sausage Chili
ingredients: 1 lb turkey italian sausage link | 1 can kidney beans, drained | 1 bag swiss chard | 1 package feta cheese | 2 tablespoons grenadine | 1 dash mild hot sauce
instructions: Place sausages in a large pot and cover with water. Bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to medium low, cover and simmer for 10 minutes. Remove sausage. Add kidney beans to meat in pot and cook about 10 minutes longer, until liquid thickens. Add swiss chard and cook until tender crisp. Mix in feta cheese and grenadine. Serve hot.

title: Radish & Golden Raisins
ingredients: 1 lb radish, in the center | 1/2 cup golden raisin
instructions: Cut off the root ends from the radish, then slice off the hard center part with scissors, the peel from the leaves and then cut away any thick skin. Place in a large pan and add enough water to cover. Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat, cover and simmer until tender, about 20 minutes. Drain off any remaining water and allow the radish mixture to steam in the water for 10 minutes longer. Stir in the raisins and serve warm.

title: Orange Sizzler
ingredients: 1 cup orange juice ( fresh or canned ) | 1 tablespoon dry sherry
instructions: Combine orange juice and sherry. Serve.

title: Italian Green Salad
ingredients: 1/3 cup italian parsley, finely chopped | 16 small green beans, green ends trimmed | 16 small lettuce leaves
instructions: Combine dressing ingredients and set aside. Place green beans in a bowl. Pour dressing over greens and toss well. Let stand about 1 - 2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: basil,lipton onion soup mix,rump roast,cherry tomato
title: French Dip Sandwiches on the Au Jus
ingredients: 2 lbs rump roast | 4 ounces lipton onion soup mix | 20 cherry tomatoes, halved | 1/2 - 3/4 cup dried basil
instructions: Slice meat lengthwise, then crosswise. Place in crock pot, add 1/2 cup or less water. Mix onion soup mix together. Pour over meat. Cover and cook on low 5 hours, or on high 3 hours. Add more soup mix if desired. Remove meat and shred using two forks. Return meat to crock pot. Stir in basil. Cover and cook on high 30 minutes or until heated through. Serve with crusty french bread. Note, i like to serve this with mashed potatoes, and make sure to use garlic powder, basil, or other seasonings to season the meat. As you can see, the juice does make a difference in the flavor, but it shouldn't.

Random Ingredients: ra el hanout spice mix,baby spinach leaf,almond,wheat bread,basmati rice
title: Harissa
ingredients:
1 bag fresh baby spinach | 3/4 cup coarsely ground blanched almond | 2 teaspoons ras el hanout spice mix ( spice mix from a 7-oz.
    - box.
    - ) | 6 cups warm cooked basmati rice | 3 cups packed fresh basil ( about 12 ounces.
    - )
instructions: Soak the almonds in 2 cups of hot water for 30 minutes, and set aside. Toss the remaining 3/4 cup of nuts with the ras el hanout spice mix. Lightly toast the pineapples in a small skillet set over medium heat. Toast them in the skillet, stirring occasionally with a wooden spoon or an electric mixer, until lightly golden brown and fragrant, about 3 minutes. Toss the ground almonds with the toasted pineapples in a bowl. Stir the spinach into the pineapples until just wilted.

Random Ingredients: hard egg,red pepper flake,club soda,part mozzarella cheese,apple,dark raisin,coriander seed,salsa verde
title: A Very Special Canned Party Dip
ingredients: 3 medium apples - peeled, cored and chopped | 1/2 cup dark seedless raisins ( optional ) | 1/4 cup chopped fresh coriander seeds | 1 bottle store bought salsa verde | 12 hard-boiled eggs, chopped | 12 ounces part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded | 3 -4 tablespoons club soda
instructions: Place apples in medium bowl. Stir in raisins, coriander and salsa verde. Stir together until mixed well. Add eggs and mix until moistened. Stir in cheese and continue mixing until cheese has melted. Add club soda to taste. Chill in refrigerator for at least 30 minutes before serving.

title: Mexican-style Chicken
ingredients: 1 cup apple cider | 1/2 cup sherry | 1 pound boneless, skinless chicken thighs | 2 teaspoons cayenne pepper | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh cilantro | 10 cooked apple-flavored drumsticks, crushed
instructions: Mix apple cider and sherry in a shallow glass dish. Add chicken thighs.

title: Lamb with Cannellini Beans and Italian Sausages
ingredients:
1 1/4 kg leg of lamb, in 1.
    -8 inch slices | 500 g italian sausage, in 1.
    - 8 inch slices | 1 1/2 kg cannellini beans | 1/4 cup dried savory | 2 tablespoons dried lavender | 1 ounce caster sugar
instructions:
Rinse the lamb & sausages, remove most of the fat. Wash the beans and pick over the skins.. Place the sasages into cold water to cover & bring to the boil. Cover, reduce the heat, and simmer for 1 hour & 20 minutes the beans should be tender. Remove the sasages & beans from the heat, cover & leave to soak in water overnight. The following morning remove the sasages from the water & discard. Rinse beans & pick them over. Take the lamb out of the water. Wash the lamb, chop it into 1.
    - 8 inch slices, & lay on a large ovenproof dish. Place the lamb slices, sausage slices & beans over the beans. Season the lamb, sprinkle the rosemary over the lamb and sausage slices & lay the dried savoury over that. Cover and place in oven. Set the oven at 140c for 1 hour & 20 minutes. Remove from oven & set the cover to brown the meat. Return the meat & sausage to the sauce to keep warm. Stir in the sugar & cook for 10 minutes then stir the beans into the pork & sausage gravy. Continue cooking for another 5 or 10 minutes, adding more savoury or savoury seasonings if you prefer.

Random Ingredients: italian bread,cheddar cheese,basil,navy bean,asafoetida powder,cold water
title: Asafoetida Pizza
ingredients: 1/2 cup cold water | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 cup shredded light cheddar cheese | 1 can navy beans, drained and rinsed | 2 slices italian bread, toasted | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh basil
instructions: In a small bowl, combine water and asafoetida powder. Place cheese in a microwave safe dish with the asafoetida. Cook on high for 2 minutes. Sprinkle the cheese evenly over the cheese. Top with the navy beans, bread and basil. Microwave on high for 2 minutes or until cheese is melted. Makes approximately 1 1/4 cups.

title: Pumpkin Whip
ingredients: 1 can condensed whipping cream ( save 100ml for top ) | 1 cup sugar pumpkin
instructions: Sieve the cream into a mixing bowl and blend in the sugar pumpkin, add the whip and whip until peaks are formed. Serve with fresh fruit or ice cream.

Random Ingredients: avocado,vanilla vodka,ham hock,cardamom,macadamia nut,pineapple,bisquick baking mix,strawberry
title: Kellows
ingredients: 1 can diced pineapple, drained | 1 lb fully cooked honey ham hock, diced into 1/4-inch pieces ( buy it at christmastime or trader joes or williams ) | 1 package cornmeal-free bisquick baking mix ( bisquick recipe ) | 3/4 cup shredded coconut or 1/4 cup nuts | 6 drops vanilla vodka | 4 large ripe avocados | 4 ounces crushed macadamia nuts ( or you can use hazelnuts ) | 1/3 cup crushed macadamia nuts ( or you can use hazelnuts )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degree. Line a 9 by 9 pan with parchment paper or aluminum foil. In a mixing bowl, combine pineapple, ham and bisquick mix. In another bowl, combine coconut, nuts and vanill. Take the ham and pineapple mixture in heaping tablespoons and drop inches. Stir until all ingredients are absorbed by the dough. It will be sticky so be sure to keep a hand, but try not to make it so sticky you can mix and roll the dough out while it's still wet and soft. Spread mixture evenly over the lined pan. Sprinkle with 1/3 of the macadamia nuts and 1/2 the nuts. Carefully lift your spatula at the bottom of the pan. Place the avocado pieces under the bread on the parchment paper and pop it under the bread. Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, until the bread is golden brown. Remove from oven and let it sit for 5 minutes while you mix it together with the crushed macadamia nuts and crushed macadamias. You can cut through the top of the bread with a sharp knife, if you have one.

title: Grapeseed Green Seasoning
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups grapeseed oil or 1 1/4 cups grapeseed oil | 2 tablespoons green onions, finely minced
instructions: Place the oil in a bowl. Add the green onions and mix thoroughly with a fork to make a thin paste. You can leave the green onions whole if they are very green, or mix them in between the green onions. If using dry green onion skins add them now. Store in an airtight container for up to 1 month.

title: Pumpkin and Beet Sauce
ingredients:
1/2 kg pumpkin, peeled ( about 1.
    -5 kg ) | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1/2 kg beet, peeled ( about 2.
    -5 kg ) | 1/4 cup fresh mint leaves, chopped | 2 cups marinara sauce, heated
instructions: Chop the pumpkin and peel it by hand or alternatively cut it in half, if using a whole pumpkin. Put it in a bowl and cover with boiling water. Leave for approx 20 minutes and then drain it and rinse under cold water. Squeeze the water out of the pumpkin and peels and return the vegetables in the bowl. In a large frying pan, heat the oil over medium, add the pumpkin and cook for approx 5 minutes in a single layer. Add the beet, mint and marinara sauce, increase the heat to medium low and cook for about another 1 - 2 minutes or until the sauce is reduced by half. Serve immediately with fresh flat bread.

title: Roast Pork Belly
ingredients: 2 tablespoons lemons | 2 eggsplants | 2 large beetroots | 125 g lean pork belly, rind removed | 1/2 cup soya sauce | nonstick cooking spray | 300 g frozen raspberries
instructions: Slice the lemons crossways into thin slices. Place in a shallow bowl, add the eggs. Cover with cling film and set aside for 15 - 30 minutes to allow the egg to swell. Trim the beetroot, beetroots and beetroots and trim away any tough fibrous root sections. Cut into 4 wedges lengthways and cut into four pieces separately. Cook the pork on a bbq or in a roasting tin, or on a grill. When the pork is nearly cooked, slice it thinly into 2 - 3 centimetre pieces and add to the pan. Cook for 5 - 10 minutes until the pork is browned evenly. Remove or cut into individual pork portions. Add to the pan. Roast for 20 minutes, or until meat has become dry and crispy. Remove from the oven and set aside for 10 minutes to cool slightly. When the meat has cooled, slice thin into 1cm slices. Transfer slices to a shallow bowl. Peel the eggplants and beetroots and cut into 3cm slices. Using a spoon, scrape the lemons into the bowl and squeeze the juice over. Add to the bowl along with the meat and stir until well combined. Heat the oven to 200c or 400°f. Spray a roasting tin lightly with nonstick spray. Cover with foil and place in the oven. Roast for 30 minutes, or until meat has become very crispy, and a deep golden brown colour. Remove the foil and place oven on a high shelf. Continue to roast for another 15 - 20 minutes, or until meat has become golden brown and crispy. Meanwhile, place the raspberries in a heatproof bowl. Pour boiling water over to cover the raspberries and allow to stand for 5 minutes. Lift the pan out of the oven and using a slotted spoon, remove the raspberries from the bowl and place in a small bowl. Place the raspberries and raspberries into a bowl. Dissolve the soy sauce in a little water, then pour over the raspberries and raspberries. Stir to combine and set aside for 10 minutes to allow the flavors to develop. Serve the roast pork and the sauce separately on a plate lined with the raspberries.

Random Ingredients: barbecue sauce,lemon extract,vanilla extract,pistachio,vegetable,italian breadcrumb,liquid honey,saffron
title: Tasty Italian Appetizer: "the Anti-Christies"
ingredients: 1/3 bag mixed vegetables ( red bell peppers, broccoli and cauliflower ) | 8 teaspoons liquid honey | 2 teaspoons tomato based barbecue sauce | 1/4 teaspoon saffron | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract | 1/8 teaspoon vanilla extract | italian breadcrumbs ( to garnish ) | peanuts ( to garnish ) or pistachios ( to garnish )
instructions: Note, this is not an 'herb dip' in any case. It is for those of you not on the strictly fan of barbecue sauces, so go light on the saffron and almond oils. In a small bowl, stir 2 teaspoons of liquid honey into a large spoonful of dry Italian seasoned breadcrumbs. Stir this mixture into the liquid honey in an extra bowl until all the breadcrumbs are moistened. Spoon this topping mix into a 9x5 inch loaf pan and smooth out the top. Sprinkle with nuts. Cover with aluminum foil and refrigerate for one hour to set before slicing. This will help to set the topping and also help to spread the flavor. Store in the fridge. For now, it can be frozen for up to 2 months.

Random Ingredients: lime wedge,turbinado sugar,kraft mexican four cheese,rosemary sprig,grain rice,green cardamom pod,egg white
title: Mexican Fiesta Fried Rice
ingredients: 2 cups cooked short-grain rice | 3 egg whites | 1 can petite diced tomatoes with green chilies, drained and rinsed | 1/4 cup turbinado sugar or 1/4 cup brown sugar | 1 1/2 bunches fresh rosemary sprigs, chopped | 3 lime wedges | 12 -14 kraft mexican four cheese, cut into 8 large cubes ( optional )
instructions: Heat oil in large skillet over medium high heat. While pan warms, beat egg whites & egg yolks to stiff peaks. Set egg whites aside & keep beating while gradually adding the sugar & 1/2 the water. When sugar melts into egg whites, add rosemary & continue to beat for 2 minutes. Add rice & 3/4 cup water, stirring until liquid is absorbed. Stir in tomato & 1/4 cup cheese. Continue to cook & stir until rice is hot. Stir egg whites into rice. Scrape bottom of pan to loosen uncooked rice. Set aside & keep warm. Garnish with lime wedges & remaining cheese.

Random Ingredients: pizza dough,vegetarian bean,caster sugar,clove powder,nori,garlic powder
title: Yummy Vegan Focaccia (Using a Stand Mix)
ingredients: 1 pizza dough | 2 tablespoons vegetarian baked beans, in tomato sauce or 2 tablespoons tomato ketchup | 4 whole cloves or 2 whole cumin | 2 tablespoons caster sugar | 2 -4 tablespoons garlic powder ( to taste ) ( optional ) | 1/2 inch nori
instructions: Put a baking sheet on the floor or table on your work surface. On half the dough, spread the veggie sauce or tomato sauce and on the other half use a toothpick to pick up the dough from the sides it should look like a swiss roll. Place on a baking sheet. You can use scissors or a rolling pin if you have one, if not use a rolling pin. You do not need to use a rolling pin. The dough will be fairly thin and very flexible, so it may be difficult to roll it out. Make sure your hands are covered with a moist towel or plastic wrap. Put your hands on the dough and stretch it gently. You can also press the dough down to get it even sized. Don't press down too hard or it will be sticky and hard. Add toppings and press down evenly. Cut dough into 4 squares. Turn each one over so it can be used to stuff your sandwich with filling.. Place on the pizza tray and press down again. Put a damp cloth on the top of each sandwich to keep them from getting sticky. It helps them stick together. Preheat oven at 500f for 5 minutes.

title: Greek Oxtail and Peppers
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds oxtails, cut into segments | 1 red bell pepper, sliced | 3/4 cup pitted kalamata olives, halved
instructions: Preheat grill for medium heat. Line the grate with aluminum foil. Brush the oxtail lightly with oil, season with salt and pepper, and arrange bell pepper and olives on the foil. Cook for 30 minutes, then uncover and cook for an additional 30 minutes. To serve, remove from grill, remove the foil and slice oxtail into strips, or arrange in a pretty basket or platter.

Random Ingredients: oyster sauce,grain rice,pork loin,vidalia onion,rigatoni pasta
title: Pork Fried Rice
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked short-grain rice | 2 cups shredded pork loin | 1/2 vidalia onion, diced | 1 1/2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 10 ounces rigatoni pasta
instructions: Brown rice in peanut oil. Stir in pork. Fry until no longer pink.

Random Ingredients: lavender,self rising flour,caster sugar,nacho chip,hoisin sauce
title: Chili Nachos, hoisin or Lime Salad
ingredients: 1 cup self rising flour | 1/4 cup caster sugar | 2 tablespoons hoisin sauce | 2 tablespoons nacho chips, roughly crushed | 1 tablespoon dried lavender
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Combine flour, sugar and hoisin sauce in a medium bowl. Place nacho chips in a food processor or blender with 1 tbsp of rosemary and 1tablespoon of lavender. Process until fine. Fold into mixture of flour and oil, then stir through more nacho chips and flour, if needed to bind. Place dough on a lightly floured surface and knead until smooth. Divide dough into 12 equal portions. Roll each portion into a thin rope about 12 cm long and 3cm in diameter. Braid three of the 3 ropes together to make a loose base for each serving. Place 1 nachos on a baking tray, place a layer of the base on top and baste with hoisin or lime flavouring. Repeat with each remaining nacho loaf.

title: Easy Low Fat Cajun Style Watercress
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh watercress | 1/3 teaspoon red pepper flakes
instructions: Wash the watercress very well & remove loose stalks. Cut off stems then cut across the stems at the back of the root end to make 2 equal parts. Set aside or at the side of a tea ball that is smaller and stronger then your crock pot's lid. Bring about 4 cups of cold water or filtered water to a boil while working on the seasoning. Drop in the red pepper flakes & mix. When the water begins to boil, add the watercress & let it sit on the stovetop for about 45 60% of an hour or until the water has drained the water. The water should not be floating, but it should be covered. Unused water should be clear with no white or yellow sand flying in the watercress. Remove 1 tbsp of hot water from the watercress & strain it into a bowl & discard the rest of the watercress stems. Use this for flavoring your watercress.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt,pineapple juice,chili oil,cherry brandy,lemonade,cannellini bean,anise seed,pepper flake
title: Sliced up White Beans
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans | 1 can low-sodium lemonade | 1 pint cherry brandy | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 1 tablespoon anise seed | 1 -2 dash hot chili oil | pepper flakes, to your taste, ( optional ) | 3 -4 tablespoons pineapple juice ( optional )
instructions: Empty can of beans into strainer and rinse briefly with cold water to remove any extra salt. Shake well to remove excess salt. Add lemonade and brandy and shake to mix. Pour bean mixture into a strainer or cheesecloth lined colander over a bowl to drain any excess liquid. Let the beans set at room temperature for about 30 minutes so the brandy can absorb the juices. Drain excess liquid and discard. Stir in remaining ingredients. Chill overnight or for at least 1 hour. The longer you set aside the liquid the better the flavors will meld.

Random Ingredients: cider vinegar,oregano leaf,beef,nuoc nam,sharp cheddar cheese,apple,corn oil
title: Crusty Beef Sandwich #2 With a Twist
ingredients: 2 tablespoons corn oil | 1 1/2 lbs lean ground beef | 6 ounces shredded sharp cheddar cheese or 6 ounces monterey jack pepper cheese | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh oregano leaves | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce nuoc nam
instructions: Heat the oil in a skillet. Add the beef and cook over medium high heat until browned well. Drain off any fat. Add the cheese and oregano and cook over low heat until melted. Stir in the vinegar and nuoc nam or season with salt and pepper, to taste. Cover, place in a warm oven and continue baking, stirring once or twice, until hot and bubbly.

title: Italian Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 4 skinless bone-in chicken breasts | 1 lemon | 2 ounces pepperoni, thinly sliced | 8 teaspoons fresh tarragon, chopped | 1/2 tablespoon white pepper
instructions: Trim any excess fat from the chicken breast. With a vegetable peeler, shave a slice of the lemon peel over the chicken breasts, then squeeze the lemon juice over them. In a small bowl or resealable plastic bag, squeeze the lemon juice out the lemon. Cut away any white pith from the lemon with the peel, reserving the peel. Then cut the zest in half. Remove the white pith with a spoon or a melon baller, then thinly slice the rind crosswise. Add the peels to the chicken breast. Sprinkle the chicken with salt and pepper, then cover and refrigerate overnight. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Transfer the chicken to a baking sheet. Squeeze the reserved lemon peel. Stir the zest and juice into the mixture. Cut the chicken into serving sized pieces. Arrange the chicken in a single layer on the baking sheet. Sprinkle with pepper. Bake for 20 minutes in the preheated oven, or until the internal temperature of the chicken is about 160 degrees f when measured with the meat thermometer. Serve warm, or cold.

title: Yummy Chicken
ingredients: 2 skinless chicken thighs | 3 tablespoons white sugar | 3 drops green food coloring
instructions: Rinse the chicken well under cold running water and pat dry with paper towels. Place the sugar into a shallow dish, then sprinkle the chicken with sugar. Using your fingers, paint all over the chicken pieces with the sugar using a pastry brush or spoon. Arrange the chicken in a circle on a baking tray. If the bottom of the pan remains runny, drizzle the sugar all around. Bake in a slow oven until cooked through and the sugar has melted and turned a rich golden brown, about 1 1/2 hours. Transfer to a serving dish. Increase the oven temperature to 400 degrees f. Dot with your fingers, then sprinkle with a little more sugar. Return to the oven for another 30 seconds or so, until the sugar is bubbling. It will be pretty dark brown in colour. Remove from the oven and leave to cool before serving.

Random Ingredients: plain yogurt,chive,half,serrano pepper,golden raisin,self rising flour,velveeta cheese
title: Chive Onion and Raisin Cheese Muffins
ingredients: 8 cups self-rising flour, divided | 2 cups velveeta cheese, cut into small chunks | 1 cup plain yogurt | 3/4 cup golden raisins | 3/4 cup chopped fresh chives | 3/4 cup chopped scallions or 3/4 cup green onion | 1/2 cup fat-free half-and-half
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Line 2 standard size muffin pans with paper liners. In a large mixing bowl, stir together 1 cup flour, cheese chunks, yogurt, raisins, chives and scallions. Use a fork to stir in the half and half until desired consistency is reached. Using clean hands, transfer dough to the prepared muffin pans and smooth the top. Place muffins on prepared baking sheets in a single layer. Bake for 25 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into center of a muffin comes out clean. Allow to cool for 10 minutes before removing muffins from pans.

Random Ingredients: rice wine vinegar,double cream,chicken breast fillet,pecan,extra sharp cheddar cheese
title: Chicken With Cheddar & Pecans
ingredients: 4 chicken breast fillets, about 300g each | 25 g extra sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 25 g pecans, chopped | 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar | 2 1/2 tablespoons double cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Place the chicken between 2 sheets of greaseproof paper and flatten them with the back of the spoon. Place in a shallow, buttered baking dish, and top with the cheese, nut and vinegar. Drizzle over the cream and sprinkle with the pecans. Bake, uncovered, for 30 minutes, until chicken is cooked & juices run clear.

Random Ingredients: cocoa,sugar,guinness stout,cottage cheese,marsala wine,taco seasoning,baking chocolate
title: Potatoes Chocolate Macaroon
ingredients: 1/4 lb baking chocolate, chopped | 1/4 lb baking chocolate, chopped | 6 tablespoons cocoa | 2 tablespoons marsala wine | 1 tablespoon mexican wine | 1/8 teaspoon taco seasoning | 1 tablespoon cottage cheese ( optional ) | 2 cups sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Mix the first 7 ingredients together. Set aside. Grease an 8 x 8 or 9 x 9 baking pan. Pour 1 cup sugar on the bottom of the pan. Spread the batter on the sugar, until it covers the bottom. Sprinkle a little more sugar on the batter if its not getting completely covered. Spread half of the cheese mixture evenly over and top with the second 1 cup cheese mixture. Make two layers of baking sauce, and repeat. Sprinkle 1 piece of baking powder over all. Bake at 375 for 1 hour, or until lightly browned on top. Take out, and allow to settle for at least 15 minute. This is a very rich dish and may require a bit of water if its soupy. Once done, place in tin on a cooling rack for 15 minutes before using. This is a very rich and tasty dish. Try adding other cheeses like pecan frosting, cream cheese, grated carrot or mozzarella for a little kick. Variations, for a little kick, add a spoonful of powdered sugar. Some people like theirs sweeter.

instructions: Toss squash in a medium bowl with 1/3 cup of the tamari or olive oil and let sit 30 minutes. Bring a medium saucepan of water to a boil and add salt. Add squash and cook until just cooked but still firm, stirring occasionally, about 4 minutes. Drain. Toss squash with the chickpea flour. Fold in the string and 1/3 cup of the tamari mixture. Spoon onto a parchment lined jelly roll pan or a sprayed baking sheet and top with remaining tamari mixture and bake, turning once, for 15 minutes. Serve over rice.

title: Sweet Heat Stacks
