title: My Favorite French Silk Pudding
ingredients: 2 packages vanilla instant pudding mix | 2 packages prepared creme de cacao | 1 package pork fat-free ramen noodles ( optional )
instructions: Line a 2 - ½ quart baking pan with foil or parchment paper. Place the vanilla pudding mixes on top of the package, then spoon the creme de cacao or other spicy food flavor over them. Using a spoon, stir in the pork fat free ramen noodles. Cover the baking pan with foil. Bake at 325 degrees f for 2 hours. Remove foil or parchment paper, and enjoy.

title: Scotch Whole Wheat Cookies
ingredients: 1 pound ground turkey | 5 tablespoons superfine sugar | 1 tablespoon dried savory | 1/2 cup ground cashews | 1/2 cup whole wheat flour | 1/2 cup canola oil
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. In a large bowl, mix together the turkey, 5 tablespoons superfine sugar, savory, cashews and flour. Form the mixture into 1 - 2 inch balls, and flatten on a floured surface slightly with your palms. Heat the canola oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Place the coated balls into the hot oil, and fry until golden brown, about 3 minutes on each side, stirring to keep the dough from sticking to the skillet. Remove carefully and cool on aluminum foil. Break into pieces and serve.

Random Ingredients: salmon,extra virgin olive oil,dark beer,ginger garlic paste,hamburger,green bean,cajun seasoning
title: Beer and Cajun Green Beans
ingredients: 2 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 2 cans whole green beans, such as california light, drained and rinsed | 1 cup dark beer | 1 tablespoon cajun seasoning | 1/2 pound cooked hamburger | 2 tablespoons coarsely chopped pickled ginger-garlic paste
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Stir in ginger garlic paste, and cook 1 minute without browning the garlic. Stir in green beans, beer, cajun seasoning and hamburger. Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer until beans are tender, about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: spanish rice,linguine pasta,rice noodle,balsamic vinegar,cream tartar,almond,prosciutto
title: Linguine with prosciutto, Balsamic Vinegar and Rice Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 package linguine pasta | 1/3 cup balsamic vinegar | 3 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 package sliced prosciutto, thinly sliced | 1 package linguine pasta | 1/4 cup slivered almonds, or more as needed | 3 ounces sliced prosciutto, cut into long strips, divided | 3 cups prepared spanish rice
instructions: Place linguine in a pot of lightly salted boiling water.

title: Lavender and Chili Gratin
ingredients: 1/3 cup black vinegar | 3 tablespoons red chile, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon dried lavender flowers | 1 tablespoon grated gruyere cheese
instructions: Place the vinegar and chiles in a small nonreactive bowl. Sprinkle the lavender and gruyere over the top of the vinegar and then place under the broiler and cook the cheese just until the cheese starts to brown. Spread the cooled cheese on the gratin and serve at once.

Random Ingredients: amarula cream liqueur,scallion,mint leaf,red chile,lime juice,salt lemon pepper
title: Fresh Mint and Chiles Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup fresh mint leaves | 2 large red chile | 3 scallions, trimmed and chopped | 1/4 cup lime juice | 1/4 cup amarula cream liqueur | 1 -2 teaspoon salt, to taste
instructions: Cut mint leaves into thin strips, and cut chiles into 4 - 6 squares. Heat 1 t oil in a pan over medium heat. Add mint, scallions, lime juice, amarula and chiles, and heat briefly. Serve at once.

title: Pasta With Strawberries, Honey and Sambal
ingredients: 12 ounces penne pasta, preferably wholemeal | 4 ounces strawberry jam ( or try raspberry jam instead if preferred ) | 1 1/4 cups shredded mozzarella or 1 1/4 cups goat cheese | 4 -5 spring onions, chopped | 1/3 cup honey | 2/3 cup sambal oelek | 2/3 cup torn fresh strawberries
instructions: Place the pasta in a pot of water and boil until ready to serve. Preheat the broiler and put the ham/cheese on a baking tray and broil/brown under the highest heat /heat area. Remove from the oven, cool slightly and place the mozzarella on top. Put the rosemary in a small pan with the honey and sambal omelek and warm. Once the pasta is cooked, drain the water reserving 1/2 cup of the water and toss with the sambal sauce mix to combine and coat. Add half the strawberries and the rest of the mozzarella to the pasta and cheese mixture and toss again. Place in a serving dish and decorate with strawberries at the base of the dish. Serve straight away or refrigerate for later use.

Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,red lentil,beef tenderloin,cauliflower floret,ice,sherry,seltzer water,kidney bean
title: Easy Beef Ties and Dipping Sauce (For Pasta & Meat)
ingredients: 800 g sirloin steaks ( cut in thin strips ) | 1 packet seltzer water, use empty can or ( 900 g ) packet mineral water ( add in 1 tablespoon seltzer water if required ) | 1 liter ice water | 400 g red lentils | 200 g red lentils | 200 g cauliflower florets, cut in half | 200 g canned kidney beans, drained ( drained if need be ) | 2 cardamom pods | 3 -4 drops sherry | 2 teaspoons crushed ice
instructions: In a large heavy based pan put the seltzer water and meat, bring to a boil and allow for the meat to simmer slowly, uncovered for about 10 minutes. Strain the meat and return to the pan for a further 10 minutes or until it's cooked fully. Using the seltzer, add in the rest of the sauce ingredients and bring to the boil. Lower the heat and stir occasionally. Serve the seltzer mix in a tall heated glass. Top with the dipping sauce and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: anise seed,grape leaf,cheddar cheese,snow pea,flat leaf parsley,white mushroom,turnip
title: Spanish Turnip Salad
ingredients: 1 medium turnip, peeled and cut lengthwise into about 5 wedges | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 1 bunch flat leaf parsley, minced | 1 cup grape leaves | 1/2 lb white mushroom, diced | 1/2 lb snow peas, trimmed and cut in half | 3/4 cup cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Cook the turnip in boiling water until just tender, about 15 minutes. Drain. Toss with the anise seed, parsley, grape leaves, mushrooms, and snow peas. Sprinkle with the cheese.

Random Ingredients: oil,beef consomme,bamboo shoot,celery seed,artichoke heart,tortilla,palm sugar,parsley leaf
title: Sinful Vegetarian Burritos
ingredients: 2 tablespoons oil | 250 g beef consomme | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained | 1 can artichoke hearts, chopped | 1 teaspoon dry-roasted palm sugar | 1 teaspoon celery seed | 1 tablespoon fresh parsley leaves, chopped | 1/4 tortilla
instructions: Put all ingredients except tortilla stack in a saucepan. Bring to the boil. Cook until beef is tender and liquid has reduced. Meanwhile fry tortilla in oil until crisp. Place on plates with a small portion of meat on top and dollop on equal amount of sauce. Serve with sour cream if desired.

title: Rice With Turnips & Kahlua
ingredients:
2 tablespoons kahlua ( almond liqueur ) | 1/4 cup watermelon, diced ( fresh or frozen ) | 3 cups cooked basmati rice or 3 cups other short-grain rice ( 1.
    -5kg.
    - package ) | 1 -2 turnip, finely diced
instructions: Place cooked rice in a heat proof bowl. Add in the kahlua. Stir to combine and pour over the rice. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: whipping cream,lamb stew meat,chili garlic sauce,sirloin,jasmine rice,anaheim chile pepper,parsley,allspice
title: Caribbean Jerk Lamb and Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds boneless sirloin, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 1/2 cups uncooked rice | 3/4 cup whipping cream | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley | 2 tablespoons chili-garlic sauce | 2 1/4 teaspoons ground allspice | 1 large anaheim chile pepper, halved and seeded | 3 fresh jasmine rice, or as needed
instructions: Sprinkle the beef cubes with 1 teaspoon salt and 1 1/2 teaspoon black pepper. Place them on a baking sheet in single layer and cook under broiler 1 to 2 minutes per side. Allow beef to cool a little before slicing into cubes. Whisk whipping cream, parsley, chili garlic sauce, and allspice in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: soy sauce,onion powder,cardamom seed,cumin,mochiko rice flour,garam masala,iceberg lettuce
title: Indian Lettuce Leaves
ingredients: 1/2 cup mochiko rice flour | 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seeds | 1/4 teaspoon onion powder | 4 cups iceberg lettuce, finely shredded
instructions: Place the rice flour, soy sauce, cumin, garam masala, cardamom, onions, and lettuce in a resealable plastic bag.

Random Ingredients: date,beef bouillon granule,shiitake mushroom,fenugreek leaf,cider vinegar
title: Mushroom and Date Salad
ingredients: 4 -6 pieces shiitake mushrooms | 1/2 lb dates, stoned ( i used medjool ) | 3 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1 teaspoon beef bouillon granules, such as mccormick's | 1/2 teaspoon dried fenugreek leaves
instructions: Slice off the stem of your shiitake mushrooms, if they are large. Use a small spoon to scrape away the soft dark white membrane and sand on the top layer. Rinse the mushrooms under cold, running water, and drain in a colander. Finely chop the dates. In a serving bowl, gently combine the chopped mushrooms with the dates. Whisk together the vinegar, bouillon and fenugreek and pour over the salad.

title: Jicama-Baked Beans
ingredients: 12 ounces dried cannellini beans, washed but drained | 1 lb jicama, chopped | 1 cup half-and-half cream | 2 ounces cooked ham, chopped
instructions: Put the beans in a bowl and cover with cold water by 2 inches. Soak overnight. Cook the jicama in boiling water until tender, about 10 minutes drain and dry on paper towels. Saute the jicama in a 2 inch skillet over medium heat, just until it begins to soften. Remove from heat. Preheat the oven to 300°f. Pour the half and half into a 2 quart casserole. Cover the beans with hot water, bring to a boil, and simmer, covered, for 15 minutes. Drain the beans and add to the mixture in the casserole, stir to mix thoroughly, and bake, covered, for 1 hour, stirring a few times. Serve hot or warm.

Random Ingredients: risotto rice,taco seasoning mix,green cardamom,linguine,crouton,allspice,parsnip,ancho chile powder
title: Rice Pilaf With Parsnips and Ancho Chiles
ingredients: 1 lb parsnip ( peeled ) | 2 tablespoons olive oil or 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1/4 teaspoon ground ancho chile powder | 1 teaspoon allspice ( whole or ground ) | 2 tablespoons crispy rice | 3 tablespoons risotto rice ( short or medium grain ) | 1/2 envelope taco seasoning mix ( i like taco bell brand ) | 20 croutons, for topping a platter or 20 croutons ( small ) ( optional )
instructions: Steam the parsnip and set aside. Cut the parsnips in half lengthwise and rinse them in warm water. Squeeze out the water and put them in a large mixing bowl. Sprinkle the olive oil or canola oil over the parsnips and mix. Add the remaining ingredients and mix well. Season with salt and pepper. Put in a hot, lightly oiled skillet or on a baking sheet or pan and toast under a preheated broiler. Cook until crispy and golden brown. Serve with crispy cheese.

Random Ingredients: rotini pasta,garlic powder,clear honey,fennel bulb,hoagie,tomato jalapeno,bing cherry
title: Roasted Veggies With Hot Balsamic Sauce
ingredients: 12 ounces rotini pasta, dry weight | 1 1/2 teaspoons garlic powder | goat's honey ( optional ) | 14 ounces chopped tomatoes with jalapenos ( muir glen fire roasted tomatoes available at the mexican farmers market ) | 1 fennel bulb, core removed, sliced 1/4-inch thick | 1/2 cup plain hoagie rolls, split ( or homemade )
instructions: Preheat an oven to 425°. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to boil. Add rotini pasta, and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, until al dente.

title: Homemade Seasoning Salt
ingredients: 4 teaspoons cumin seeds | 2 - 2 1/2 1/2 teaspoons salt and one teaspoon pepper
instructions: In a small skillet, toast cumin seeds until lightly browned. Remove from heat and grind to a fine powder. Toast pepper and cumin seeds in a small skillet until lightly browned. Drain well. Transfer to a mortar. Grind to course or coarse powder. Let sit 2 - 3 days before using. Adjust seasoning.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon,tortilla,ricotta cheese,black tea,almond flavoring,farfalle pasta
title: Beef Tortilla Soup
ingredients: 1 package farfalle pasta | 5 cubes beef bouillon | 2 packages tortillas ( i like yellow and green ) | 1/2 cup light ricotta cheese | 2 teaspoons almond flavoring | 2 -3 tablespoons black tea ( optional )
instructions: Bring water to boil, add a cube of beef bullion. Add tortillas, reduce heat, simmer, stirring occasionally until pasta is cooked, about 15 minutes. Add water, if needed to get the soup right. Add ricotta and blend with spoon or whisk until smooth. Add almond, coffee, or black tea if desired.

title: Fried Farro With Peanuts
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups farro | 2 1/2 lbs unsalted dry roasted peanuts
instructions: Put the sugar, peanuts and 3 cups water in a saucepan and cook on medium high heat, stirring occasionally, until the sugar has completely dissolved, about 15 minutes. Reduce the heat to medium and simmer, stirring often, until the mixture is reduced to a heavy syrup, about 8 minutes. Drain the peanuts on paper towels and spread out to dry on paper towels. Using a slotted spoon, carefully remove the peanuts to a serving bowl. Drizzle with the peanut syrup and toss to coat thoroughly.

Random Ingredients: sunflower seed,hot chili pepper,mayonnaise,chicken breast half,polenta,plain flour,egg yolk,confectioner sugar
title: Chicken and Sunflower Seed Griddle Pies
ingredients: 1 package instant polenta | 4 skinless chicken breast halves | 3 tablespoons reduced-fat mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon sunflower seeds | 2 egg yolks | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar | 8 large flat-leaf dried hot chili peppers | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar | 3 tablespoons hot chili pepper sauce | 1 tablespoon hot sweet chili pepper sauce, or to taste
instructions: Place the polenta in a bowl, and add cold water to cover. Cover and set aside. Bring a medium saucepan of salted water to the boil, and then stir in the polenta. Boil for 8 minutes, until thick and creamy. Set the polenta aside. Place the chicken breast halves in a large frying pan, and drizzle with 1 tablespoon of the mayonnaise. Cook over medium high heat, turning once, until evenly browned. Set aside, and allow to cool slightly. Slice the chicken into 1 inch pieces. While the chicken is cooking, place the sunflower seeds in a dry frying pan. Turn frequently, turning often so that they don't burn. Dip the chicken slices into the sunflowerseed, and coat thoroughly with the egg yolks, then fold in the remaining mayonnaise and sunflower seeds. Place in a greased griddle over low heat, and grill for 15 minutes, until golden brown. Sprinkle confectioners' sugar and chili sauce over the top, and allow to set for 3 to 5 minutes before removing from the griddle. Serve warm and serve warm.

title: Frozen Broccoli in Italian Soda
ingredients: 12 cups frozen broccoli, thawed but not cooked, fresh broccoli is good | 1 cup club soda | 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Thaw broccoli and break into bite size pieces. Place broccoli in a large bowl. Crush the club soda into the bottom of the bowl, or spoon mixture into a freezer bag. Remove broccoli with a slotted spoon, and carefully squeeze the broccoli so that it falls apart or stir with a fork to defrost. Pour the broccoli into the bowl with a thin layer of tomato salsa, and set aside. When you are ready to eat, place one layer of fresh black beans in the center of each plate of food, and pour equal amounts of the broccolini mixture on each. Top with remaining tomato salsa for serving.

title: Roasted Beet Wedges
ingredients: 4 large beets, halved lengthwise | 1 teaspoon crushed fennel
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place the wedges on a baking sheet. Sprinkle with fennel and pepper. Bake for 45 minutes, until they are tender.

title: Tortillas Con Broccoli (Pastilla Espanola)
ingredients: 8 cups broccoli florets | 1 1/2 cups cake flour | 1 cup cake flour, plus more for dusting
instructions: Bring a medium saucepan of salted water to a boil on high heat. Meanwhile, coarsely chop fresh broccoli in a blender or food processor. Mix together cake flour and cake flour in a large bowl. Add about 1/4 cup of the water to the blender and repeat until well blended. Transfer the dough to a pastry bag fitted with a 2 to 3 inch round tip. Holding the blade in your fingers, gently pound the dough until it forms a rough rough, compact ball. If too sticky, add more flour. Remove dough from bowl onto a clean, flat surface, form dough into a ball, wrap it in plastic, and refrigerate for half an hour, or until chilled. Cut dough into twelve 16 pieces. Lightly flour a work surface. Take one piece of dough and transfer it to your work surface, making sure the center is covered with flour. Place a piece of broccoli on top, about 1/2 inch apart, and top with another piece of dough. Fold the dough over the top and press lightly into the edges, creating a flat, flat surface. Repeat with remaining dough and broccoli to make 12 tortillas. Place a scant teaspoon of the floured pastry on the work surface, and spread about 1 tablespoon of the tomato sauce in the center of each. Using both hands, carefully roll the tortillas, one piece at a time, starting with the dough side up and the second piece laying on the sides of the pastry. Arrange coated tortillas in a single layer on a baking sheet, cover, and refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours. Remove baking sheet from refrigerator and lightly coat the tortillas with flour. Working from the center out, carefully transfer the tortillas to the baking sheet. Arrange tortillas at least 14 inches apart on baking sheet. Brush tops with more of the tomato sauce if desired. Sprinkle with more flour. Bake in a 350 degree f oven until puffed and golden, about 20 to 25 minutes.

title: The Best Sausage in the World!
ingredients: 4 lbs kielbasa sausage | 1/3 cup white wine vinegar
instructions: The vinegar helps preserve the flavor and color of your sausage. Place the sausage in a plastic bag and add 1/3 cup vinegar. Shake until well coated. Refrigerate for up to two days. Cook according to package directions. Serve in a casserole sprayed with pam for sandwiches and with crusty french bread for dipping.

title: Welsh Baked Chicken
ingredients: 2 lbs frying chickens, cut in pieces | 1/2 cup white vinegar | 1/3 cup red currants or 1/3 cup raisins | 3 egg yolks, lightly beaten
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Spray baking dish with non stick spray. In a wide bowl, sprinkle all of the above with vinegar, stirring to combine well. Add chicken pieces, turning to coat evenly. Arrange in baking dish, skin side down. Cover and bake for 45 minutes or until chicken is browned. Lower heat to 300 degrees and continue cooking for 1 1/2 to 2 hours, or until chicken is cooked and tender. Remove chicken from oven. Turn off stove, cover and let stand for 15 minutes, or until juices run clear. Fluff chicken with a fork and sprinkle with raisins. This can be served in slices hot or cold. Note, you can substitute any type of dark meat for the chicken pieces.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,taco seasoning mix,cream,broccoli floret,chickpea flour
title: Quick and Easy Tostada Meal
ingredients:
1 can chickpea flour ( dr.
    - pepper flavored ) | 2 cups broccoli florets | 1 green bell pepper, diced | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1/2 cup sour cream
instructions: Pour floured corn tortilla onto a baking sheet. Spray spray on top. Bake at 375 degrees fahrenheit for about 10 minutes. While tortillas are baking, prepare veggies. Once tortillas are done, put aside and set aside. Sauté onions. Add green pepper and taco seasoning mix into skillet. Saute veggies until no longer pink. When veggies are done, drain excess liquid. Add cooked veggies to beans and mix well. Place on tortillas. Spoon some mixture onto center and fold. Serve like a taco.

Random Ingredients: beef,white vinegar,bicarbonate soda,red capsicum,tabasco sauce,italian seasoning,beer
title: Beer and Beef BBQ
ingredients: 750 g beef or 750 g pork, cut into 1in cubes | 1 small red capsicum, chopped | 1/2 cup beer | 1/2 cup white vinegar | 1 tablespoon bicarbonate of soda | 5 teaspoons dried italian seasoning or 5 teaspoons crushed mixed herbs | 1 1/2 tablespoons tabasco sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large saucepan, cover and bring to the boil. Reduce heat and simmer till meat is tender, about 2 hours. Brush occasionally with bbq sauce, grill or bbq meat for 10 minutes to brown lightly. Serve with cooked rice, egg noodles or mashed potatoes.

Random Ingredients: ranch dressing,sherry,black olive,lime wedge,horseradish,salmon fillet,corn oil peanut
title: Salt-Grilled Salmon With Horseradish Relish and Corn Salad
ingredients: 1 lb salmon fillet ( about 1 to 1 1/2 inches thick ) | 2 tablespoons corn oil or 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 4 teaspoons dry sherry | 4 teaspoons horseradish | 1/2 cup ranch dressing | 3/4 cup sliced black olives | lime wedge ( to garnish )
instructions: Preheat grill to high. Place salmon on grill. Barbecue salmon, skin side down 6 to 9 minutes until easily flaked with a fork. Whisk together oils and sherry.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper,serrano chili,shin beef,non cooking spray
title: Jamaican Style Seared Beef
ingredients: non-stick cooking spray | 8 ounces boneless shin beef, at least a 1-inch cube sirloin tip | 1 can sweet pickled peppers, sliced, drained & rinsed ( mild or hot ) | 1 fresh serrano chili, thinly sliced ( seeded is optional, i don't like it as spicy )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 ° f. Spread a little cooking spray on the work surface with a cutting board. Arrange the shrimps in a single layer in a roasting pan. Place the pan on the oven and roast for 40 minutes, or until the tops are browned. Remove from oven and set up a tent of foil over it, slightly overlapping the foil, to keep warm. Remove the beef from the pan and set aside for 15 minutes so the juices can redistribute themselves. Remove the pan from the oven, loosen the foil and discard the beef juices from the pan. Return the pan to the oven and reduce the heat to 300 ° f. Bake for about 1 1/2 hours, or until thick and crusty on the edges. When the beef is done, use a slotted spoon to remove the meat from the pan. You can discard the pan juices if you want, but if you want to add some more flavor after it has been on the oven, discard the vegetables and the saltiness, and set aside to let the juices absorb into the meat. Remove the chile for the heat and discard. Cut the meat into thin strips, against the grain, by slicing it in half across the grain. Arrange the strips in a bowl, sprinkling each portion with a few teaspoons of the pickle sauce. Serve the strips at room temperature or warm for a quick dipping sauce.

title: Kielbasa & Peanuts Kielbasa
ingredients: 4 lbs kielbasa sausage or 4 lbs smoked sausage | 2 -3 lbs lean ground sirloin | 3 -4 tablespoons tequila | 3 -4 tablespoons texas-style cocoa powder ( i like kikkoman ) | 1 tablespoon kahlua | 1 1/2 teaspoons dry roasted peanuts | 1 -2 cup water
instructions: Grill sausage until cooked through and browned, drain, and set to side. When cool, slice and set aside. Brown meat. In a large pot, add all remaining ingredients & mix well. Cover & boil for 10 minutes. Simmer over low heat, stirring occasionally, for 1 1/2 hours. Serve hot on toasted french bread rounds or fresh rolls & garnish with chopped green onions or sliced party rye if desired.

title: Scotch Roast
ingredients: 1 jar hot pepper sauce | 4 lbs boneless beef roast | 1 1/4 lbs fresh flat leaf parsley leaves, coarsely chopped | 1/2 lb carrots, sliced | 1 lb yogurt, at room temperature | 2 tablespoons double cream | 1 lb turkey sausage, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Wrap roast tightly in aluminum foil. Place on rack in roasting pan and put in pan with hot pepper sauce. Cover tightly with foil. Bake for 1 to 1 1/2 hours, basting twice per hour. Stir parsley, carrots, and yogurt into meat juices until smooth. Bake uncovered for 20 minutes. Remove from oven and keep covered. Strain juices into saucepan, and heat through. Spread meat on platter. Stir remaining hot pepper sauce and juice into gravy. Pour over meat. Serve.

title: Basmati or Halva Halva - Semolina Bread
ingredients: 3 cups semolina flour ( farfalle ) | 1 tablespoon onion powder | 1 tablespoon lemon juice ( or juice of 1/2 lemon and 1/2 lime )
instructions: Pulse the semolina flour and onion powder in the food processor to a fine breadcrumb consistency, adding water if needed. Sprinkle the grated lemon zest over the top and continue to pulse until the mixture forms a dough. Transfer the dough to a floured surface. Wrap in plastic wrap, and refrigerate for at least 20 minutes, but no longer than 2 hours. When ready to bake, preheat the oven to 375°f or 190°c lightly grease a 9 inch cake or cookie sheet. Roll a piece of dough flat to about 1/8 inch thick, and cut out into 1 1/2 or 2 inch squares. Arrange the squares on the prepared baking sheet, and bake for 10 minutes, then turn so both the squares and the one with the grain side facing upwards bake for another 5 minutes, or until the edges turn golden, and the top turns slightly firm and light brown. Allow to cool a bit before removing the rounds. Store any leftover rounds in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: bamboo shoot,arborio rice,pork sausage,ginger paste,peanut butter,sriracha sauce
title: Peanut Butter Arrabiata
ingredients: 1/4 cup peanut butter | 2 cups arborio rice or 2 cups valencia rice | 1 medium bamboo shoot, very thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon fresh ginger paste | 1 tablespoon sriracha sauce | 1 small spicy pork sausage
instructions: Heat peanut butter in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. It should just melt on the bottom, but not melt through the peanut butter and become oily. When it starts to get dark, stir in the rice. Quickly stir to coat rice with melted peanut butter. Immediately add meat, stirring constantly so it does not burn, and continue until the pork is halfway cooked through. Scoop half of mixture into a 9x13 inch baking dish, and spread evenly across the rice. Sprinkle with more sriracha, chili sauce or pepper flakes if desired.

title: Noodle and Pepper Frittata
ingredients: 1 egg noodles, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese ( plus more for the pasta ) | 1/8 teaspoon cracked black peppercorns ( or more )
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f. In a medium mixing bowl, combine all ingredients except for the parmesan. When the oven is ready, grease a 9 inch frying pan with butter and set over medium high heat. When the oil's hot, add 1/2 cup of the mixture and spread out into a thin, even circle. When the surface is golden brown, remove to a plate that has been dusted heavily with a bit of parmesan and set aside. Turn the heat under the frying pan over to medium high. When the surface begins to brown, add the remaining 1/2 cup of mixture and return it to the pan. Cook until frittata is set. Remove from the oven and sprinkle the top with additional parmesan and cracked black peppercorns. Serve.

title: Crunchy Scotch Bon Bonnet Lamb (Australia)
ingredients: 1 bonnet leg of lamb, trimmed of excess fat or 1 scotch bonnet ham | 1/4 cup fresh breadcrumb | 1 tablespoon corn flakes ( optional ) or 1 tablespoon coarsely crushed corn flakes ( optional )
instructions: Cut the ham into 1 inch cubes. Place all the breadcrumbs and cornflakes in a bowl. Dip the lamb meat into the crumbs and coat well. Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Line a large baking sheet or roasting pan with foil and add the meat. Place in a large roasting pan and set aside. Bake the meat for 2 hours. Turn the oven up to 400 degrees f and return it to the oven. Bake the meat for 1 hour 40 minutes until well browned and cooked through. Serve immediately. Note, you can also use dried cranberry jam for topping.

title: Homemade Refried Beans (Vegan)
ingredients: 2 cans kidney beans | white pepper, to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Rinse and drain beans. Place beans in a 9 x 1 inch glass baking dish. Cover with a layer of a thin layer of white pepper. Continue layering bean and pepper in the baking dish. Sprinkle with a little white pepper until you have used up all of the beans. Continue layering beans and pepper until they are all used. Top with 1/2 cup water. Bake for about 45 minutes, depending on how browned the beans are. Let cool for a couple of minutes.

title: Habanero Chili Sauce
ingredients: 6 habanero peppers, fresh, seeded and deveined | 1 tablespoon habanero sauce
instructions: Grind the habanero chiles with a mortar and pestle. Alternatively, place chiles in a food processor with the cayenne pepper. Mash well, adding a little water if necessary. Cover with a thin film of olive oil and continue mashing. The chili can be refrigerated for an hour before using.

Random Ingredients: corn kernel,brown sugar,peanut butter,coffee,channa dal,hamburger meat
title: Paleo Burritos
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger meat | 1 can sweet corn kernels, undrained | 1/2 cup channa dal | 1/2 cup crunchy peanut butter | 1/4 cup packed brown sugar | 2 teaspoons instant coffee
instructions: Crumble hamburger meat over hamburger and mix to distribute evenly. Stir in corn, chana dal, peanut butter, brown sugar and 2 teaspoons instant coffee. Spread onto each tortilla with the back of a spoon. Roll and serve.

title: Smoky Smoky Potato and Cheese Samosas
ingredients: 500 g potatoes, peeled and cut into wedges | 1 cup diced smoked mozzarella ball, thawed if frozen | 1 cup pimento pepper, diced | 200 g diced chipotle chiles | 1/4 cup whole wheat flour | 3 tablespoons smoked mozzarella balls
instructions: In a large fry pan, cover the base with olive oil, add diced smoked potato and sprinkle with the diced chilies. Cook over low heat until potatoes are tender and starting to golden around the edges. Add the flour and stir for 2 min. Pour onto a warm plate. In a small fry pan, add smoked smoky sauce and mix with smoked mozzarella balls. Keep warm in the oven. Heat for 5 minutes over medium heat until warm and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: black bean,anise seed,sea scallop,allspice,grand marnier,mint leaf,thyme sprig
title: Grilled Scallops With Black Bean Puree
ingredients: 4 tablespoons grand marnier or 4 tablespoons orange juice | 2 tablespoons black beans ( drained and rinsed ) | 2 teaspoons anise seeds | 3/4 teaspoon thyme sprig, leaves only | 2 tablespoons of fresh mint leaves, finely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon allspice | 2 lbs large sea scallops
instructions: Combine everything except the fish in a small bowl. Arrange the scallops on a lightly oiled grill directly over medium coals. Grill the scallops for 5 - 8 minutes on each side or until golden brown. Remove the scallops from the grill and serve at once.

title: Easy Chipotle Meatballs (With Chickpeas or Noodles)
ingredients: 6 -8 ounces meatballs, thawed | 1 tablespoon minced chipotle pepper in adobo sauce | 1 can chickpeas, drained or ( 15 ounce ) can kidney beans, drained
instructions: Add all ingredients to a skillet that has enough room at the bottom of skillet that the oven can be used in a unit. Cook on medium heat, stirring occasionally, for 8 to 10 minutes more or until the meat is cooked through. Serve with fresh crusty bread.

Random Ingredients: coconut cream,black bean,red pepper flake,chicken bouillon,wine vinegar
title: Black Beans With Coconut Flavoured Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 cans black beans, drained and rinsed | 1 1/2 cups coconut cream, reduced fat | 1/4 cup rice wine vinegar ( try coconut rum to make this vegan if you can ) | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon ( to taste ) | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Mix together the coconut cream and rice wine vinegar. Pour over drained and rinsed black beans and mix well.

title: Tropical Bacon Cups
ingredients: 1 package frozen lemonade or ( 14 ounce ) package lemon curd | 8 ounces canadian bacon | 1 cup chopped iceberg lettuce | 1/2 cup brandy ( optional, but i recommend using it ) | 1 tablespoon cornstarch ( optional ) | 1/4 cup oyster sauce | freshly crushed ice ( optional ) | crystallized mixed spice ( optional )
instructions: Heat grill on medium. Place canadian bacon and lemonade or curd in a microwavable bowl. Cover, and microwave on high 8 - 10 minutes, stirring periodically. In a small bowl, mix together the oyster sauce and cornstarch. When the microwave is cool enough to handle, stir together. Drain off liquid. Stir in the cornstarch mixture, making sure it dissolves evenly, and microwave an additional 2 minutes, stirring halfway through. Transfer to a serving tray and cover with plastic wrap to keep warm. When the canadian bacon is cold, chop into large cubes. Sprinkle with crystallized spices, if desired, and serve with icecream or cocktail crackers.

title: Rice and Chicken Liver Burritos
ingredients: 1/2 cup arborio rice | 1 lb chicken liver | chopped tortilla
instructions: Combine 1/2 c rice, chicken liver, & chopped coriander in a microwave safe dish. Cover. Microwave on high 1 minute. Stir. Microwave additional 1 minute. Stir and microwave additional 2 minutes. Serve warm with chopped coriander.

Random Ingredients: lemon peel,bean sprout,ancho chile,peanut oil vegetable,half
title: Ancho Chili Bean Sprouts Salad
ingredients: 1 head fresh bean sprouts ( about 2lbs ) | 1/3 cup peanut oil or 1/3 cup vegetable oil | 1 tablespoon finely grated lemon peel | 2 dried ancho chiles, seeds removed and crushed | 1 1/4 cups half-and-half or 1 1/4 cups light cream
instructions: Wash sprouts and remove any tough outer leaves. Cut into halves and then quarter them lengthwise and set aside. Drain liquid from canned chiles into skillet and add enough water to cover. Stir to combine and heat to boiling point over medium heat, about 3 minute. Add chile and blanch briefly, just until just softened, 3 or 4 minute. Add sprouts and stir to combine. Remove from heat and stir in sour cream.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,oregano leaf,kosher salt,saffron strand
title: Lard and Parmesan Fritters
ingredients: 1 package saffron strand | 1 1/2 cups fresh oregano leaves | 1 1/2 cups self rising flour | 1 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: In a small saucepan over medium heat, warm the saffron and oregano until a light golden color, about 10 minutes. Pour in a few tablespoons of the saffron mixture, then stir in the flour and salt. Stir to form a stiff batter. Let mixture rest until it begins to set, about 2 minutes. Turn dough onto a cutting board and cut into small, bite size pieces. Form each piece into a ball and roll in reserved saffron mixture to coat lightly. Place balls on nonstick baking sheets. Let fritters dry at room temperature for 12 to 15 minutes, then turn out onto oiled paper towels to drain. If the fritters become too warm, they will be too brittle to drop.

title: Apricot and Hazelnut Hot Chocolate
ingredients: 250 g plain nonfat yogurt | 1 teaspoon vinegar | 1 tablespoon olive, roughly chopped | 350 g apricots, roughly chopped | 1/4 cup hazelnuts, roughly chopped | 1/4 cup chocolate, roughly chopped or 2 squares of good quality bittersweet chocolate, roughly chopped
instructions: Place the yogurt, vinegar and olive into a bowl. Mix everything together in a food processor and process to a paste. Pour the choclate onto the yogurt/yogurt mixture, stir well and refrigerate for at least 4 hours. Serve chilled with whipped cream.

title: Sweet Italian
ingredients: 1 cup sweet breadcrumbs | 1/3 cup sugar or 1/3 cup maple syrup | 1/2 ounce grenadine
instructions: Combine all ingredients. If using ice cream, crush ice cream or cream together. Sprinkle on bread crumbs. Roll in crumbs until all mixture is used. Heat in microwave, or oven..

title: Vegan Tofu Pizza (Gluten Free)
ingredients: 3 cups gluten free bread flour | 1 lb firm tofu, drained | 1 english cucumber, sliced ( i used both ) | 12 artichoke hearts, halved ( i've used left over ones ) | 1/4 cup sesame oil | 1/2 cup sesame seeds ( i use whole wheat ) | 2 tablespoons mustard ( i use gluten free ) | 1 tablespoon cornstarch
instructions: Cut tofu into cubes. Cut cuke into very thin slices. Slice artichokes into thin slices and marinate in sesame oil. In a bowl, mix sesame seeds with mustard and cornstarch. Add flour, yeast w/oil and tofu, mix well, and set aside for 1 minute. Spread on pizza pan. Top with remaining ingredients. I sprinkled some sesame seeds on top.

title: Beef and Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef, cubed | 1 large onion, diced | 1 tablespoon brandy | 3 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 4 medium tomatoes, peeled and diced | 12 ounces tomato e & j pasta sauce ( or use hunts ) | 1 1/2 lbs uncooked egg noodles, cooked ( reserve 1/2 cup liquid )
instructions: Brown half of the beef with onion and brandy in a heavy dutch oven. Place beef in another large dutch oven and stir in sugar until dissolved. Add tomatoes, tomato sauce, noodles and any reserved liquid. Heat to boiling and simmer, covered, stirring occasionally, for 2 hours. Remove from heat and stir in any additional liquid. Pour into a 2 quart baking dish.

Random Ingredients: rice noodle,salsa verde,apple,active yeast,bouillon cube,mustard powder
title: Salsa Verde Noodle Bake
ingredients: 4 cups cooked rice noodles, whole | 4 cups salsa verde, from your local mexican restaurant | 1 teaspoon prepared mustard powder | 1 tablespoon dried apple, minced | 1 bouillon cube, dissolved in | 2 1/4 cups chicken broth or 2 1/4 cups water | 1 ounce active dry yeast
instructions: Place noodles into lase baking container and cover. In small bowl, combine remaining ingredients and beat with a fork until soft but not sticky. Spoon into noodle baking pan, cover and place in a warm place to rise. When you bake, remove from oven and set aside covered until ready to serve. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Mix broth and dissolved yeast into noodles and place in oven. Bake for 30 to 40 minutes, or until top has puffed and turned golden.

Random Ingredients: chicken thigh,chili oil,iceberg lettuce,sirloin tip roast,kalamata olive,green bell pepper
title: Sizzling Beef in a Bag
ingredients: 1 boneless sirloin tip roast, sliced thin | 1 medium green bell pepper, sliced into 1/3 inch wide strips | 1 tablespoon hot chili oil | 1 package shredded iceberg lettuce | 1/4 cup pitted kalamata olives | 3 large chicken thighs, sliced 3/4 inch thick
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees. Place the sirloin tip roast in a large skillet and add about 1/4 cup water. Bring to a boil over medium high heat, then remove from the heat and transfer to a large ovenproof skillet. Add the green pepper and chili oil to the skillet and set aside. Place the lettuce and olives under a broiler and broil until browned. Turn the beef and vegetables over and arrange in a very large casserole. Pour the contents of the skillet over the beef and vegetables and finish with the olives. Bake, covered, for 20 minutes or until the meat is fork tender.

title: Cajun Linguine
ingredients: 1 lb linguine or 1 lb spaghetti | 1/3 cup ketchup | 5 poblano chiles, roasted, peeled and sliced
instructions: Cook al dente and drain. Cook linguine. Toss cooked pasta with remaining ingredients and serve.

title: Tomato Based Pub Spread
ingredients: 4 1/2 cups crushed italian plum tomatoes | 1 1/2 teaspoons turmeric | 1 teaspoon dried yeast | 3/4 cup italian plum tomato | 1 cup sour cream
instructions: Combine all ingredients except sour cream in a large bowl and stir until well combined. Cover and refrigerate at least one hour. Form into a ball. Roll between your hands so air pockets form. Cover and marinate at room temperature for 2 days. Turn once during the marinating process and divide the tomato mixture between 4 serving plates.

Random Ingredients: linguine,corn tortilla chip,french onion soup,cherry tomato,wheat germ,chicken breast half,bread
title: The Singles' Chicken and Nacho Soup
ingredients: 6 boneless chicken breast halves, pounded very thin | 3/4 cup corn tortilla chips | 1 can condensed french onion soup | 1/2 cup wheat germ | 1/2 cup torn fresh bread | 1 bag pre-crumbled fresh french fried onions | 1 jar cherry tomatoes, drained
instructions: Combine the chicken, tortilla chips, soup, wheat germ, and bread in a crock Pot, and mix well. Cook on low for 8 hours, or on high for 4 hours. During the last hour and a half to cook, remove the chicken from the soup with a slotted spoon to a bowl. When done, shred chicken with two forks. Then stir the shredded chicken back into the sauce mixture. Serve with croutons, fried onions, and tomatoes. Serve with additional crusty bread.

title: Soup Stuffed Potatoes
ingredients: 3 large russet potatoes, peeled and coarsely grated | 1 tablespoon dried dill | 1 teaspoon pomegranate molasses | 2 cans diced green chilies, drained | 2 ounces canned chopped pomegranate molasses | 1/3 cup red wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f. Mix together the grated potatoes, dill and pomegranate molasses. Spoon cheese and potato mixture into the center of each potato. Stuff filled potatoes with the filling, pressing gently to make sure it comes out well. In a large nonstick skillet or wok combine pomegranate molasses and red wine. Heat on medium until the liquid is hot and the ingredients are well blended. When the potatoes are soft transfer them to baking dish. Bake uncovered for about 1 hour.

title: Swiss and Cheddar Stuffed Onions

instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil. Carefully peel the ends off the onions and cut them in half lengthwise. Fill the cavity with the swiss cheese and sprinkle with the cheddar cheese. Place each onion half on a plate. Repeat with the remaining onions. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, and simmer for about 20 minutes, or until the onions are tender and the cheese has melted. Remove from the heat and cool slightly, then refrigerate until serving cold so the onions don't get soggy.

title: Steamed Clam-Garlic Rice & Grated Pesto Rolls
ingredients: 2 sheets frozen puff pastry, thawed | 2 teaspoons grated fresh ginger root | 2 tablespoons chilled unsalted butter, divided | 4 cups bottled clam juice ( reserved from clam roaster ) | 1/4 cup shredded pecorino romano cheese | 1/2 cup short-grain white rice | 1/2 pound cooked french baguettes, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 1/2 lb chilled butter lettuce - rinsed, dried, and torn into 1/2-inch pieces
instructions: Prepare rice per package directions.

title: Gorgonzola and Spinach
ingredients: 20 ounces fresh baby spinach leaves | 1/4 cup crumbled gorgonzola | 2 medium plum tomatoes, seeded and chopped
instructions: Place spinach, gorgonzola cheese and tomatoes into a large nonstick skillet. Cook over medium heat, stirring frequently, until spinach is warmed through and tomato is softened. Serve immediately.

title: Vermicelli and Cabbage Kugel
ingredients: 500 g vermicelli, uncooked | 1/4 cup butter or 1/4 cup margarine, melted | 1 small savoy cabbage, finely shredded ( about 1lb ) | 1/3 cup pizza sauce
instructions: Preheat your oven to 230c. Cook the doughnut in salted water, until browned, about 5 minute cool on a board. Roll out the doughnut, cut out 2 or 3 rounds, re bake. Place a cabbage on the baking tray, leaving a 2mm/1/4 inch/2 inch border at the top. Top with half of the cooked zucchini and 1 1/2 tbsp of the pizza sauce, spread evenly over the zucchini. Press the border of the dough around the zucchini, creating a pleat. Repeat for the second doughnut. Serve with remaining pizza sauce.

title: Salsa Flavoured Scones
ingredients: 1/3 cup self raising flour | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/2 cup chunky salsa
instructions: Mix together the flour, cumin and salsa. Pour a portion of the mixture onto a floured surface. Shape with hands into a circle about 5cm in diameter. Score into 8 wedges. Place on oven trays/s. Bake at c for about 20 minutes. Serve straight away.

Random Ingredients: sunflower oil,chicken breast half,orange peel,ginger garlic paste,mozzarella cheese,dill pickle,green onion,orange liqueur
title: Grilled Chicken Breast With Orange Glaze
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 2 teaspoons orange-flavored liqueur | 2 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 cup sliced green onion | 1/4 cup chopped fresh dill pickle | 1/4 cup grated mozzarella cheese | 1/4 cup thinly sliced orange peel | 6 skinless chicken breast halves
instructions: Combine first five ingredients. Reserve 1 tablespoon of this glaze. Place chicken on a greased broiler tray. Brush with reserved glaze. Sprinkle chicken with the reserved glaze. Broil for 10 - 12 minutes. Brush remaining glaze.

title: Crispy Anjou Pears
ingredients: 2 ounces ground anjou pear | 2 ounces carrots | 10 drops bicarbonate of soda
instructions: Using a cleaver, remove the peel of the pear with a spoon. Use a sharp knife to pare the skin off using a knife. Cut off and discard any pith attached to the outside. Cut the peel into strips about ¼ inch thick. Stir the canning ingredients into the pear. Fill a frying pan with plenty of water and bring to the boil. Drop in the pear strips and cook them for 3 minutes or until they are bright green. Remove when they are well cooked. Dry on paper towels and serve while still slightly warm.

Random Ingredients: turnip,pineapple juice,coconut rum,fish sauce,balsamic vinegar,confectioner sugar
title: Rendering Pineapple Turnip Salad
ingredients: 500 g turnips, peeled | 1/2 cup coconut rum, warmed | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon coconut rum | confectioners'sugar, for dusting
instructions: Place turnips in a large saucepan of lightly salted water. Bring to a boil, then simmer over low heat for 20 minutes or until just tender. Drain, cool slightly and cut into 1 cubes. Place the coconut rum, fish sauce, vinegar and coconut rum in a small bowl and stir. Whisk into the turnip mixture. Taste and adjust the balance between batches to ensure the mixture is creamy and sweet enough to coat the back of a spoon. Pour into a serving bowl, then dust with confectioners' sugar and serve. Note, coconut rum could be substituted for the coconut rum.

Random Ingredients: fish sauce,parmesan cheese,beef mince,cake flour,kernel corn
title: Crunchy Corn Patties (21 Day Wonder Diet : Day 1 )
ingredients: 500 g corned beef mince, finely chopped | 1 cup frozen whole kernel corn, thawed | 1/3 cup grated parmesan cheese | 3 tablespoons cake flour | 2 tablespoons fish sauce
instructions: Lightly combine beef, corn and cheese, using a food processor. Process to combine. Divide mixture between 4 ramekins, mould evenly to cover. Heat oven to 200 c or 400f. Brush with oil and bake for 35 - 40 minutes or until cooked. Serve. Serves.

title: Seafood Sandwich
ingredients: 1 can minced clams, drained | 1 cup chopped cooked shrimp | 2 cans stewed or bottled clam juice | 3 1/2 cups shredded iceberg lettuce | 8 slices sourdough bread
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f. In a medium bowl, combine the clams, shrimp, sourdough, and lettuce. Spread shrimp mixture evenly onto both sides of bread. Place on a baking sheet. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes in the preheated oven, or until the bread is toasted.

Random Ingredients: mint,cream mushroom soup,ladyfinger,thai fish sauce,green olive
title: Cousin Pete's Spicy Stuffed Green Olives
ingredients: 8 green olives ( the tiny ones ) | 8 ladyfingers | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup ( or cream of mushroom soup ) | 1 -2 teaspoon thai fish sauce ( use sparingly ) | fresh mint ( chopped, to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven 425. Wrap each olive in kitchen twine, securing with toothpicks. Arrange stuffed olives in 1 oven proof bowl. Sprinkle liberally with fish sauce. Bake 25 - 30 minutes or until golden brown and bubbly. Serve warm. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: corn kernel,lemon curd,shell pasta,olive oil,wheat bread,egg white,chicken bouillon
title: Chesse
ingredients: 1 box small shell pasta ( farfalle rigati ) | 1 large egg white | 6 tablespoons olive oil | 4 1/2 ounces whole wheat bread, crumbled | 1 can chicken bouillon | 1 cup corn kernels | 1 lemon curd
instructions: Boil 6 ounces of pasta in a large pot of salted water. Keep warm. Prepare your rice as directed. Drain the pasta, set it aside, and set your bowls aside. While the pasta cooks, whisk the egg white, and once its frothy, add 3 tablespoons of the olive oil, 1/4 cup of the bread crumbs, bouillon and corn. Mix all together and season with salt and pepper. Add the other 1/4 cup bread crumbs, and continue mixing for 10 minutes. While you mix the ingredients for your pasta, fill a sauce pan with enough water so that the water is boiling. Boil it for 15 - 20 minutes, and drain. Place your rice in the food processor or blender, and mix and pulse, making sure there are no chunks of pasta. Mix the rice mixture with your egg white, and continue to blend until fully incorporated. If the bread crumbs stick together, add a little more, until fully incorporated. Stir in a cup or two of bouillon. Place your wheat bread on a separate plate, and coat with olive oil. Place the bread in the same oil as you're mixing the eggs and water for about a minute, so that the bread will absorb oil and does not stick to the skillet. You can also add cooked vegetables to the bread, if desired. Cook for about 5 minutes. Pour the rice mixture in a large, wide pot, with a lid. Smooth the top until it's just the right thickness. Turn it over, and mix everything together thoroughly, and place it in the freezer for an hour and a half in the refrigerator. If desired, you can add more cornflake crumbs or lemon curd to your mixture after mixing it together. When the rice mixture has finished cooking, check the heat of the rice mixture. It should be a bit puffy and slightly wet, but not totally hard, and firm enough to stick to the bottom of the pot. If you want to test the saltiness of the rice at the end of the 10 minute period, remove the lid. If it doesn't stick at all, you can add another tablespoon or two of olive oil. When the rice is finished, let it rest for 3 - 5 minutes, for 1 - 2 minutes before fluffing with a fork on top. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: raisin,garam masala powder,vegetable oil cooking spray,beet
title: Bundi Raita
ingredients: 2 medium beets, peeled and roughly chopped | 4 tablespoons vegetable oil or 4 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 pinch garam masala powder
instructions: Cut off the beets and discard the ends, but leave the skins on. Spray a colander with a little sunflower seed oil and place the beet inside. Sprinkle with garam masala powder. Set aside for 30 minutes. When the beets are softened, peel the beet and dice it into chunks roughly 1 1/2 inch in size. Fry the diced beet in the cooking oil for a few minutes until cooked through but still a little crisp. Keep the heat fairly low as it will continue cooking. Remove the beet from the pan and mix in a small amount of water or oil to keep the mixture moist. Heat the oil in the empty pan, add the raw garam masala and fry for 1 minute, stirring regularly. Pour the beet mixture into the pan, mix and serve while hot. If you would like to eat these hot, store them in an airtight container in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin,chili paste,italian tomato,corn niblets,chinese cabbage,black pepper
title: Easy Chinese Beef & Cabbage - for Crock Pot
ingredients: 1/2 - 1 lb beef tenderloin ( i have used lamb, pork, or chicken ) | 1/2 tablespoon chili paste ( i don't use it ) | 5 -8 cups cabbage, shredded | 1 can chinese cabbage, chopped | 1 can italian-style stewed tomatoes ( undrained ) | 1 tablespoon fresh ground black pepper | 12 ounces corn niblets, drained
instructions: Place the beef in a large pot and add 1/2 tablespoon of the chili paste or chilli powder. Stir to coat the beef with the paste. Add the cabbage, tomatoes, black pepper and 3 cups of water. Stir to combine. Bring to a boil. Cover and cook on low for 7 - 9 hours. Stir to combine throughout the cooking time. Stir and check periodically to see if it has enough liquid. Serve over hot cooked rice and top with chopped cilantro if desired. Note, prep time does not include time for the meat to prepare the veggies and serve as a side dish.

title: Papouts Au Poivre (Bonnets of Anchovy Dessert)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chopped pitted dried apricots | 2 anchovies, peeled, left whole | 2/3 cup whipping cream
instructions: Toast the apricots in a dry, heavy, heavy skillet over a medium flame for about 5 minutes, or until almost dry. Add the anchovies, and remove from heat. Stir the apricot mixture, and slowly pour in the whipping cream.

title: Easy Beef Gravy
ingredients: 500 g of good quality minced beef ( ask your butcher to do this, if they are cheap, drain and keep both ) | bechamel sauce, to coat
instructions: Using a little oil you can coat the top and bottom of the pan with a little balsamic vinegar to prevent the gravy from catching while frying.

title: Grapefruit Salad
ingredients: 2 large seedless grapeseed pomegranate seeds | lettuce leaf | salt
instructions: Rinse the pomegranate seeds and pomegranate seeds well. Toss in a dish and sprinkle generously with salt. Let cool and serve at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: pork tenderloin,coriander,cooking oil,chili pepper flake,mayonnaise,cake flour
title: Tiroka (Pork-Stuffed Cookies)
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin | 2 teaspoons chile pepper flakes | 1 2/3 cups cake flour, sifted | cooking oil ( for deep frying ) | mayonnaise | chili pepper flakes
instructions: Cut tenderloin crosswise into 1/2 strips. Chop finely. Combine chilli flakes and flour. Dip cut surface side of fat side of pork strips into flour mixture, coating all sides. In a wok, heat oil at medium high.

Random Ingredients: gruyere cheese,baby bok choy,thyme,cilantro leaf,grain white rice,channa dal,french bread
title: Channa Dal (Rice and Chard Salad)
ingredients: 1 cup long-grain white rice | 2 bunches channa dal, or more to taste | 1 bunch fresh thyme, leaves picked from stems | 4 cups mixed baby bok choy | 1/2 cup coarsely grated gruyere cheese | 1/2 cup coarsely grated gruyere cheese | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Heat the rice in a large pot over medium heat until bubbly and slightly dry, about 20 minutes. When it starts to bubble, stir in the channa dal and thyme stems. Season with salt. Reduce heat to low, cover, and continue cooking, stirring occasionally until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed, about 30 minutes. Remove from heat, and let stand for 15 minutes. Mix the greens together in a bowl. When the rice has finished cooking, stir in the bok choy leaves, 1/2 cup of gruyere, 1/2 cup of gruyere cheese cheese, and cilantro. Toss with the rice mixture and serve.

Random Ingredients: arborio rice,vanilla ice cream,puff pastry,berry cranberry sauce,bay leaf,cocktail sauce
title: Cocktail Rice Pudding
ingredients: 1 package puff pastry sheets, thawed | 1 2/3 cups arborio rice | 1 can cocktail sauce, divided ( optional ) | 1/3 cup prepared vanilla ice cream, or as needed ( optional ) | 1 bay leaf | 1 cup mixed berry cranberry sauce, or as needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a 2 1/2 quart baking dish with plastic wrap, and cover with plastic wrap. Place thawed pastry sheets on top of plastic wrap, and seal the edges. Sprinkle pastry with a bit of flour, and using wet fingers, moisten each one, and roll into a circle 3/4 inch thick, and 4 inches in diameter. Make sure the pastry does not touch the bottom of the pan. Place a pastry cutter into the center of a circle to form a circle. Place rice in the center of the cutter, and lightly press around rice on each side. If rice appears to be sticking, press lightly with fingers while rice is still hot. Open 1 can of cocktail sauce into a bowl, and stir in the cream, if using. Mix in the bay leaf, and gently stir in the berry cranberry sauce. Transfer to the prepared baking dish. Sprinkle top with more flour, if desired. Bake in the preheated oven until browned, about 30 minutes, and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: brown rice,black pepper,butter bean,onion,chunky salsa,italian tomato
title: Microwave Red Beans and Rice
ingredients: 1 tablespoon butter or 1 tablespoon margarine | 1 can light brown rice, undrained | 1 can low sodium italian-style stewed tomatoes, undrained, divided | 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained | 1/4 cup chunky salsa | 1 dash ground black pepper
instructions: Microwave red beans, half of the tomatoes and salsa in the 2 1/2 qt. Microwave on high 30 seconds or until hot. Stir beans and remaining ingredients. Cover.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk,margarine,thai fish sauce,heavy cream,rice noodle
title: Thai Noodles and Coconut Milk
ingredients: 1/2 cup margarine | 10 ounces thick coconut milk | 1 1/4 cups heavy cream or 1 1/4 cups coconut cream | 1 1/2 tablespoons thai fish sauce | 1 package rice noodles, cooked according to pkg directions, drained ( i prefer pappadums )
instructions: In a large pot, melt margarine. Add coconut milk, cream, fish sauce and pappadums. Mix well just to mix. Bring to boil. Remove from heat, cover and set aside to marinade for at least 2 hours. Bring a pot of water to boil. Add noodles and cook according to package directions. Drain well. Transfer to individual serving bowls. Pour reserved marinade over noodles.

Random Ingredients: pepperoni,half cream,hazelnut,olive oil,beef stew meat,mexican corn,rump roast
title: Mexican Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 rump roast, cut into 1-inch cubes, or more to taste | 1/2 cup hazelnuts, coarsely chopped | 1/2 tablespoon olive oil | 1 boneless beef stew meat | 1 can mexican-style corn, drained | 1 cup half-and-half cream | 1 ounce pepperoni, sliced | 1/4 cup chopped hazelnuts, for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place cubed rump roast in a bowl, and add 1/2 teaspoon olive oil and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Toss to coat, then spread evenly in a large roasting pan. Roast in the preheated oven 20 minutes, to an internal temperature of 130 degrees f. Cook about 1/2 hour in the preheated oven, stirring every 10 minutes, until meat is browned. Transfer roast to a slow cooker, cover, and cook on low until meat is very tender and easy to shred with a fork. Mix hazelnut and 1/4 teaspoon salt in a mortar and pestle, and set aside. Pour half and half cream into a bowl, and set aside. When the roast is almost cooked, stir in the pepperoni. Remove roast from the slow cooker, place onto a plate, and set aside. Stir the sauce and hazelnut mixture together in the slow cooker until blended. Pour the sauce on top of the meat, and spread generously over the top. Sprinkle the remaining blackened hazelnuts over the sauce, and serve.

Random Ingredients: white bread,coriander seed,cauliflower,transparent rice noodle,oyster sauce,ladyfinger,chicken thigh
title: Asian Chicken Casserole With Bread Crumb #RSC
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs ( or use 2 bone-in chicken breasts - 2 cutlets ) | 1 tablespoon coriander seed | 2 boxes clear vanilla frozen broth and rice noodles | 1 head cauliflower, outer leaves removed, cut into florets | 3 packages ladyfingers ( thawed ) | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 3 -6 slices white bread, crusty, cut into chunks | oyster sauce ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Place the chicken thighs in a large, deep pot or dutch oven and cover with water. Bring to a boil and boil the chicken until just cooked through. Set aside to cool slightly. Remove chicken thighs from the broth and set aside to cool completely. Remove the chicken from the broth and let cool until completely cool enough to handle. Remove the chicken thighs from the broth, discarding any pieces that are still slightly attached to the bones. Rinse the broth and place it in a large saucepan or dutch oven with half the coriander seeds, and bring to a boil over medium heat. Reduce the heat to medium low and simmer the broth for 10 - 15 minutes or until reduced to 1/4 of its original volume. Remove from the heat and set aside to chill until the chicken is cool enough to handle.. When the broth is reduced, add the rice noodles, cauliflower, and 2 packages of ladyfingers. Remove the skin from the chicken and shred the into large pieces. Prepare the oyster sauce and coat the bread crumb chunks in a bowl with oyster sauce and set aside. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Take the rice noodles out of the refrigerator, and place half of them in an 8 x 8 inch glass baking dish and cover with chicken. Pour on half of the broth. Top with a layer of bread crumbs, followed by a layer of cooked chicken, then another layer of crumbs and finally another layer of crumbs, then remaining chicken, rice noodles, cauliflower and phyllo pastry. Coat the top layer of bread crumbs with oil and season with oyster sauce, if desired. Cover with the last of the bread crumbs, cover with aluminum foil, and bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes. Remove foil, and bake for another 5 minutes, allowing the crust to brown slightly, covering the casserole with aluminum foil if the top browns too much before its done. Garnish with a drizzle of oyster sauce.

title: Tamarind Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 cup bulgur wheat, cracked wheat ( cracked wheat may also be used ) | 8 teaspoons tamarind pulp | 1 head iceberg lettuce | 2 cups small shell pasta or 2 cups arugula
instructions: Drain the tamarind pulp very well, pressing firmly on it with a spatula. Chop the lettuce and arugula in small pieces and place them in a serving bowl. In another large bowl, prepare the bulgur wheat. Pour boiling water over the bulgur wheat, and let it sit for about 15 minutes. Drain, and set it aside. Crush the tamarind pulp and add it to the bulgur wheat and stir. You can also stir in 2 1/2 cups of the water. Season and serve.

Random Ingredients: chicken thigh,cashew,chili powder,frying chicken,dark brown sugar
title: Cashew Nut Chicken
ingredients: 6 medium chicken thighs | 1 pinch chili powder | 1 pinch dark brown sugar | 1 frying chicken | 1 cup ground cashews
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Place the chicken thighs in a skillet with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil. Place the thighs in a baking dish with a pinch of chili powder and a pinch of brown sugar. Place baking dish in the oven. Bake in the preheated oven until the chicken thighs are almost cooked through and have a crispy skin on them, about 1 1/2 hours. While the chicken is baking, remove and discard the skin from the chicken thighs by scraping off the crumpled skin. In a mixing bowl, thoroughly mix the chicken chunks with the ground cashews. Transfer the chicken chunks to a serving dish and pour the sauce over the chicken.

title: Salad Noodles With Chickpeas
ingredients: 2/3 cup orange juice and zest of, grated | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 can chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 1 1/2 cups rice noodles, uncooked ( i prefer barilla ) | mixed salad green

title: Chicken Green Bean Soup

instructions: Place chicken in boiling water.

title: Kielbasa and Coco-Olive Salad
ingredients: 100 ml clams in juice | 1/4 cup coconut milk | 2 tablespoons kalamata olives, sliced | 2 tablespoons raw vanilla sugar | 2 teaspoons kielbasa ( malaysian-style sausage ) | 2/3 teaspoon dried thyme
instructions: Place everything in a large bowl and stir to combine. Cover and chill. Serve over romaine lettuce, iceberg lettuce.

title: Sun-Dried Tomato and Bean Soup (Spain)
ingredients: 4 2 quarts bean | 3/4 cup tomato juice | 3 egg yolks, beaten | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomatoes
instructions: Cook beans until tender, about 1/2 hour. Drain and reserve liquid. When cool, put through a blender. Add tomato juice and return to a boil until reduced, about 10 minutes. Cool well and stir in yolks. Return to a boil and continue boiling until thickened, 1 minute longer. Remove from heat and stir in sun dried tomatoes. Serve topped with a little fresh grated parmesan cheese, if desired.

title: Guinness Garlic & Sugar Snap Pea Salad
ingredients: 200 g sugar snap peas | 20 ml irish whiskey | 1/2 teaspoon lime zest | 1 tablespoon finely grated lemon, zest of | 35 g chopped fresh italian parsley | 1 packet onion soup mix | 30 g caster sugar | 8 toothpicks
instructions: Place half of the snap peas in a microwaveable bowl with half of the whiskey. Cover and cook on high for 3 - 4 minutes or until bright green. Drain on paper towel. Place remaining half of peas in a microwave safe bowl with remaining whiskey and remaining ingredients. Mix well. Cover, cook on high for 1 - 2 minutes or until sugar snaps have softened. Remove and discard paper towel. Serve with remaining snaps. Tip, this recipe freezes well when you thaw, and doesn't really work well when left to cool. When i serve this, i let it warm into the fridge, then re freeze it when you want to eat. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: caster sugar,chipotle powder,lime leaf,guinness stout,anise seed
title: Guinness and Lime Leaf Jam (Anise Seeds)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon anise seed | 1 bottle guinness stout | 10 lime leaves | 3 tablespoons sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoon ground chipotle powder
instructions: Place the anise seeds and guinness into a heatproof bowl. Heat the oven to 300°f and bring the to the boil. Add the lime leaves and sugar and leave for 7/8 hours. Remove from the heat and leave to cool. Strain the lime mixture and discard the remaining liquid. Add the ground chipotle powder to the liquid and leave to cool completely. Store in a cool, dry place.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,wine vinegar,beef roast,pita bread,red chile pepper,catsup
title: Garlicky Roast Beef on Pita Bread
ingredients: 1 beef round roast | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/4 cup dry wine vinegar | 1/2 cup catsup | 1/2 small red chile pepper, seeded and minced | 4 pita breads, split
instructions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees f. Spray a jelly roll pan with cooking spray. Season meat with salt and pepper. Bake in the preheated oven until meat is slightly browned and just a hint of pink remains, 15 to 20 minutes per pound in the center of the oven. An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read about 165 degrees f. Transfer meat to a cutting board. Pour dry wine vinegar into a mixing bowl or measuring cup. Add catsup.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,balsamic vinegar,ginger paste,italian cheese,rump steak
title: Roast Beef Sandwich (Verveeg
ingredients: 1 boneless rump steak | 3 teaspoons balsamic vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon ginger paste | 1/8 cup dark brown sugar | 5 slices italian cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees f. Score the top of the beef very, very lightly. Using a sharp knife, poke holes in the beef all around the beef all over. Place the beef in one layer on a jelly roll pan. Whisk balsamic vinegar and ginger paste together in a medium bowl.

Random Ingredients: pickle,tilapia fillet,salt black pepper,elbow macaroni,marinara sauce,shiitake mushroom
title: Rice Cooker Chicken, Shiitake, and Mac
ingredients: 1 tilapia fillet, cut into bite-sized pieces | salt and ground black pepper to taste | 1 package uncooked elbow macaroni | 1 can enchilada sauce | 1 cup prepared pickle slices | 1 cup chopped shiitake mushrooms, or more to taste
instructions: Lay the tilapia and a sprinkling of salt in the bottom of the rice cooker, and set the rice cooker for the regular cooking cycle. Once the machine switches its cycle, keep warm until the machine switches all the way. Drain the cooked rice into a colander set over a bowl, and run cold water over the top.

title: Tomato & Ginger Salsa
ingredients: 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 500 g cherry tomatoes, halved | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 500 ml natural greek yogurt
instructions: Combine the curry paste with 4 tbsp of water. Place tomatoes decoratively on a plate. Toss with the herb thyme. Divide evenly between 4 serving bowls. Garnish with mint sprigs.

title: Pecorino Cheese - Michael Chiarello
ingredients: 3 ounces pepperoni, cut into small | 1 tablespoon pecorino cheese, grated | 4 fresh thyme sprigs
instructions: Preheat oven to 400ºf and position a rack to the upper middle position. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Cut pepperoni slices in half lengthwise and put them cut side up on the parchment paper. Combine cheese, pepperoni and thyme in a small bowl. Spoon 1/4 of cheese mixture on top of pepperoni and sprinkle with remaining cheese in a layer. Bake 15 minutes, or until cheese is melted.

title: Melt in Your Mouth Pizza
ingredients: 8 tablespoons unsweetened chocolate | 2 tablespoons lime juice | 1 italian bread ( optional ) | 2 cups gruyere cheese, shredded
instructions: In small saucepan over low temperature melt the chocolate with lime juice. Remove pan from heat. Using a tablespoon, spread chocolate onto top of a piece of bread.

title: Thai Steamed Vegetables
ingredients: 300 g courgettes | 1/4 bunch fresh lemon grass, root ends removed
instructions: Wash the courgettes and trim the stalk ends. Slice into fine stripes with the vegetable peeler, the stalk part of the stalk facing the stalk like a fish tail. Steam in a steamer for around 45 minutes or until tender. Remove and serve while hot.

title: Yellow bell Pepper Chili Powder (Qatarified)
ingredients: 4 yellow bell peppers | 2 tablespoons hot chili powder
instructions: Remove the seeds from the bell peppers and place in a small bowl. Cover with 1/2 cup boiling water.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,liquid smoke,green chili pepper,iceberg lettuce,plain flour
title: Namibian Chicken - for the BBQ
ingredients: 1 tablespoon mild green chili pepper, chopped | 1 tablespoon red hot liquid smoke | 1/2 tablespoon garlic salt | 1 1/2 tablespoons plain flour | 1/2 cup crushed iceberg lettuce or 1/2 cup mixed salad leaves
instructions: Mix the chillis, garlic salt, and flour together. Coat the chilli mixture into the flour mixture. Drain the chicken, making sure there are no pockets, and place onto a lightly floured rack on a tray. Cover lightly with foil or plastic wrap and place in the heated barbecue. Cook for 10 - 15 mins, turning occasionally. Allow to rest for 5 mins before serving. Serve warm with a sauce or salad.

title: Caribbean French Bread Dip (not Catalina Style Bread Dip)
ingredients: 1 french bread, cut in 1/2-inch slices | 1 1/2 cups catsup | 1/2 cup sweet dark rum | 1 lime, juice and zest of
instructions: Mix everything together well and refrigerate for approximately one hour. When ready to serve, dip bread slices in mixture.

title: Cabbage (Saurkraut)
ingredients: 1 can whole tomatoes, mashed | 4 prunes | 1/2 pound kielbasa, cut into 4 squares | 1/4 teaspoon angostura bitters
instructions: Place the tomatoes with juice into a bowl, and sprinkle the pimenton powder over the tomatoes. Cover, and refrigerate for at least 2 hours. Sauté the kielbasa in a skillet over medium heat until evenly browned, and starting to crisp up a bit, about 5 minutes. Drain, and slice into thin slices. Place in a casserole dish with tomatoes, and bring the rest of the tomato juice to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat, and simmer slowly until heated through. Remove from heat, and stir in the bitters. The tomato mixture can be served warm or cold, or chilled and served with tooth picks.

title: Spicy Roasted Vegetable Stock
ingredients: 1 medium head cauliflower | 3 star anise
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Bring a large pot of water to a boil and add cauliflower and star anise. Cook until cauliflower begins to soften, then remove from heat and allow to sit for 10 minutes. In a 9x9 inch glass baking dish, pack cauliflower and star anise into the hollowed out core of the star anise and drop into hot stock. The cauliflower should be so tender that it will absorb all of the liquid. Once the cauliflower is almost cooked, strain the stock through a cheese cloth into a bowl and set aside. Place the stock into a preheated oven and bake for 45 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Peppered Squash
ingredients: 2 large yellow squash, halved lengthwise and cut into 1 x 1 inch pieces | 2 tablespoons ground hazelnuts | 1 tablespoon seasoning salt
instructions: Place squash in a shallow pan. Sprinkle with all the other ingredients. Cover with cold water by about 2 inches and place on center rack of the oven. Bake for 40 - 40 minutes, or just until tender. Serve hot.

title: Hot and Sweet Chicken Legs!
ingredients: 8 -10 chicken legs | 1 1/2 cups cream of tartar or 1 1/2 cups sugar | 2 -3 tablespoons of melted golden syrup
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees fahrenheit. Grease a shallow roasting dish and line with tin foil or parchment paper if making a double crust pie dish. Separate the chicken legs from the joints and use any chicken thigh you like. Place the joints in a saucepan with a cup of the hot cream. Simmer for 5 minutes. Drain chicken joints, pour cream mixture over chicken and bake, uncovered for an hour. While chicken is baking, make the sugar syrup and cream of tartar, combine sugar and melted golden syrup and then add to the chicken. Cook uncovered for a further 45 minutes. After 20 minutes, the chicken legs should be done. Place chicken legs on a serving platter and pour the thickened cream mixture on top, decorate with the baked, well drained chicken pieces, and serve.

title: Spinach & Pine Nut Pasta
ingredients: 1 package active dry yeast | 7/8 cup white pine nuts | 3 1/2 cups fresh baby spinach | 1/2 cup plum ( can be in jar ) or 1/2 cup cherry tomatoes, with juice ( or cherry tomatoes with juice ) | 1/2 teaspoon ginger powder | 1/2 teaspoon pepper
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 5 cups cold water. Combine nut mixture, spinach & spices in a large saucepan. Bring to simmer, stirring occasionally. Reduce heat & simmer stirring occasionally for 8 cups, stirring frequently. Remove from heat & cool, stirring often, about 25 minutes. Drain pasta into a 9x13 casserole dish. Spoon spinach mixture over the pasta. Cover & let rest 1 hour in a warm place or refrigerator until cool to the touch. Serve at once or refrigerate up to 2 days.

title: Sweet Veal in Pineapple (Gravy for Lamb)
ingredients: 2 lbs veal, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 1/2 cups unsweetened pineapple juice, canned ( canned in a can ) | 1/2 cup superfine sugar | 1 tablespoon oil | thyme leaves, crushed | 6 tablespoons yoghurt | 2 tablespoons brown sugar
instructions: Place marinated meat in saucepan, and add pineapple juice, sugar, oil, thyme, yoghurt and mix well. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Serve with boiled boiled potatoes, cauliflower or spaghetti strands, or any other accompaniment you like.

title: Braised Red Snapper and Shrimp
ingredients: 12 red snapper, cleaned | 1 cup whole green apple - peeled, cored and cut into chunks | 1 bunch fresh green chipped beef
instructions: Rinse the snappers under cold water to remove the salt, and remove any feathers with a knife. Arrange the snapper pieces on a platter or cookie sheet. Pour enough water into the skillet to cover the fish. Bring to boil, and simmer the fish over low heat until easily flaked with a fork.

title: Stir Fry Veggies(Fritters)
ingredients: 2 medium eggplants | 1/3 cup flour tortilla ( fritters ) | 3 tablespoons whole milk powder | 3 tablespoons tahini ( sesame seed paste ) | 3 tablespoons mixed spice | 3 tablespoons pimentos ( chopped fresh pimento ) | 1/2 cup shredded cabbage | hot sauce, for drizzling
instructions: Cut the ends off the eggplants and slice crosswise into thin strips. Sprinkle salt and vegetable oil on veggies. In a small bowl, combine the flour and milk powder, and stir mixture into veggies till it's well mixed. Heat a nonstick skillet over to medium high heat. Spray with vegetable cooking spray. Place veggies in oil and fry till golden brown. Remove vegetables from pan, and sprinkle with mixed spice/pimentos mixture, and shredded cabbage. Drizzle with a bit of your favorite hot sauce to taste, and serve immediately.

title: Dried Beef or Chicken or Fish Biscuits (Anzac Nuts for Christmas )
ingredients: 1 lb dried beef or 1 lb fish | 1 cup milk | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda ( not soda ) | 1 -2 drop vanilla essence ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon milk, for dipping
instructions: Bake your biscuit or biscuit straight from freezer for 45 min at 170f. Wrap up tightly in cling film and freeze before chopping up finely when cold. It can also be stored in freezer in small bags, and cooked right away with no need to defrost, and re warmed in the microwave for extra flavour. To serve, dip into icing sugar and serve with fresh fruit or sauce. Can add a nutty nut for some added flavour.

title: Beef Kebabs with Bell Peppers
ingredients: 1 cucumber, peeled and diced | 1 yellow bell pepper, diced | 3 pounds sirloin steaks
instructions: Slice cucumber lengthwise, then crosswise, in half. Squeeze out excess liquid. Place cucumber, bell pepper, and 2 tablespoons of the reserved liquid in a bowl.

title: Flax and Cilantro Beer Fritters
ingredients: 2 - 2 1/2 cups flour tortillas | 1/2 cup white flour | 1/2 cup ground flax seeds | 1 pinch saffron | 1 cup lager beer | 1/2 - 1 cup carrot, peeled and coarsely grated
instructions: Mix flour and saffron. Make a well in the center of dry ingredients. Add beer and mix well with hands. Knead well into a ball. Cover with plastic wrap and rest in warm place for 15 minutes. Mix again on clean surface until smooth. Shape into a round or oval shape and wrap around a carrot. Place in the refrigerator for 2 hours.. Heat up a skillet over medium heat. Place a handful about 1 inch in diameter in the pan. Cook each side of the fritter 3 minutes per side. The fritters should be white and a little crisp in the middle. If using fritters under 1 inch of heat, turn only once.

title: Polish Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 pork roast, trimmed and tied | 1 tablespoon butter or 1 tablespoon margarine | 1 jar strawberry jam, divided | 4 dill pickles, cut into slivers
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°. Prepare grill or broiler. Lightly oil grill grate. Place pork on grill or broiler rack and broil 3 to 4 minutes per side, or until lightly charred on the top and meat juices run clear. Remove from heat. Cover with aluminum foil and let rest 10 minutes. Slice pork thin on a bias and arrange around the warm preserves on a platter. Serve garnished with pickles.

title: Ras Malaw (Vegan, but Soyy)
ingredients: 150 ml soymilk, made in a blender | 1 pinch saffron strand | 25 -30 cloves | 25 -40 cherry tomatoes | 18 sheets phyllo dough | 1 cup unsalted crisco
instructions: Make sure the soymilk is boiling with a bit of salt in it. Add soymilk, saffron, and cloves and boil until liquid is absorbed. Drain liquid from the soymilk and pour over the cherry tomatoes, let dry about 5 minutes. Unroll 6 sheets of phyllo dough, butter them lightly and lay out on a clean board. Line with aluminium foil and spray with non stick cooking spray, lay flat to make 6 sheets of layered phyllo, repeat. You will now use a cookie sheet and a damp cloth to keep the sheets from drying out. This process can be done several hours in advance. If you are freezing the meal for later use, take out the phyllo sheets the next day and cut them into 8 squares using a cookie cutter, the finer they will be, if frozen this is one option.
