You can also freeze the meal straight away or it can be made the night before to save on later. Heat a skillet on medium high and lightly coat with non stick cooking spray. Sear about 20 - 25 cherry tomatoes over medium high heat, depending on the taste. Watch them so they don't burn. Once the tomatoes are hot they begin to soften and smell a little sweet. Remove from the skillet and cut in half if you desire. Place in a serving dish and top with about half a cup of soy milk rasmalaw and any other toppings you have on hand. For vegan use only the soy milk or the cream milk with no other ingredients. In a large pan, boil water, add a pinch of salt. Add the rehydrated cherries and let cook for 30 - 40 minutes. Remove from heat and keep warm. Make sure to cook it on high heat, this time you need to reduce the soymilk amount by almost half as you will need a cup of liquid to achieve the consistency you desire. You can always adjust for water if necessary.

Random Ingredients: vegetable,flat leaf parsley,chicken stock cube,cherry tomato,green enchilada sauce,chicken thigh,curry powder,triple sec
title: Chicken and Veggies With Curried Tomato Chutney
ingredients: 7 ounces boneless skinless chicken thighs, sliced in half | 1/2 vegetable bouillon cubes | 2 green enchilada sauce | 7 tablespoons flat leaf parsley, chopped | 2 teaspoons curry powder | 1 pint low-fat chicken stock or 1 pint low-fat chicken stock | 1 pint cherry tomatoes | fresh flat-leaf parsley ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the tomatoes, parsley and parsley in a large pan bring to the boil then reduce heat. Add the chicken and let simmer for a couple of minutes. The chicken will absorb all the flavours. When the chicken is just cooked remove the chicken and leave covered in a warm place for 15 minutes but don't take your time when you are ready to eat. Serve with fresh flat leaf parsley and crusty bread.

title: Chile Noodles With Almonds
ingredients: 4 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa | 1 serrano chili, seeded and chopped | 3 large eggs noodles, cooked and drained | 2 tablespoons blanched slivered almonds
instructions: Heat oven to 300 degrees f. In a small bowl, mix together cocoa and chile. Dip noodles one at a time into egg mixture and drop into oven. Bake 20 to 30 minutes, until hot. Top with blanched slivered almonds.

Random Ingredients: red kidney bean,chili pepper flake,fast rise yeast
title: Kidney Beans and Chili Bread (Pappardelle)
ingredients: 1 cup undiluted red kidney beans | 1 1/4 teaspoons hot chili pepper flakes | 2 1/4 teaspoons fast rise yeast
instructions: Pour ingredients into your breadmaker and select the rapid, medium or delay according to the model of your breadmachine. Select sweet or delay cycles, medium or delay cycles.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti,guar gum,soy sauce,chocolate syrup,pork tenderloin,shiitake mushroom
title: Liptauer Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 package spaghetti | 1 pound pork tenderloins | 2 ounces dry shiitake mushrooms | 3 tablespoons light soy sauce | 1 teaspoon guar gum | 1/2 cup chocolate syrup
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook spaghetti in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until tender yet firm to the bite, about 8 minutes. Drain.

title: Baked Cauliflower or Vegetables (Germany)
ingredients:
1 small cauliflower ( preferably a small one, about 2.
    - 5 cm length ) | 1/3 cup coarsely chopped nuts
instructions: Cut cauliflower into florets. Place water in a 1 and 1/2 qts. Baking pan. Cover and bake at 450°f for 5 minutes or till tender. Drain in a sieve and toss with nuts or a salad dressing. Serve.

title: Pumpkin Chocolate Ganache With Maraschino Cherries
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups skim milk chocolate, cut into chunks | 1 can pumpkin puree | 1/4 cup dark rum | 1 fresh maraschino cherry
instructions: In a double boiler, over hot water, melt chocolate until smooth. Remove from heat and stir in pumpkin puree, rum, and cherries. Mix until mixed well. Refrigerate about 20 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: hard egg,pepper,serrano chili,peppercorn,arborio rice,russet potato,lemon juice zest,spinach leaf
title: Spanish Rice Salad (Arroz Con Rizogalo)
ingredients:
1 cup arborio rice, cooked ( about a cup or 2 to 2 1/2 oz.
    - pints ) | 12 -24 fresh spinach leaves ( about 2 heads ) | 1 cup hard-boiled egg, cut into small pieces | 10 -12 fresh arbol chiles | 2 lemons, juice and zest of ( about 2 medium sized lemons ) | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice ( about 2 large lemons | cracked pepper ( to taste ) | 1 teaspoon ground pepper
instructions: Rinse the arborio with cold water and drain well. Mix together with the next 5 ingredients in a big bowl, except the lemon juice. Add the lemon zest, lemon juice, salt and cracked pepper. Taste and adjust seasoning with cracked pepper or lemon juice. Enjoy.

title: Easy Cheesy Cheese
ingredients: 1/2 lb velveeta cheese ( or similar cheese ) | 3 roma tomatoes, cut in thin wedges | 1 - 1 1/2 cup sharp cheddar cheese ( shredded ) or 3 any other mild cheese, like gruyere
instructions: Mix them all together and heat on low for at least twenty minutes.

title: Ras El Hanout
ingredients: 2 tablespoons good quality olive oil or 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 3 cups whole milk, homogenized | 1 teaspoon powdered saffron, plus extra for serving
instructions: Pour the oil into a large saucepan and set over medium heat. When it shimmers, add the milk. Bring to a boil, whisk briskly, and allow it to boil and foam for 2 minutes. Stir in 1 teaspoon of saffron and return to a boil. Turn down the heat and put the lid on the pan. Allow the milk to heat through, about 20 to 25 minutes. Stir the cardamom into the milk mixture and season with more of salt and freshly ground black pepper. Transfer the milk/broth to a serving bowl and let it cool to room temperature before serving.

title: Thai Chili Sauce With Lettuce Wrappings
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups thai chili-garlic sauce or 1 1/4 cups bottled thai chili sauce | 1/2 cup chopped lettuce
instructions: Stir a few drops of chili garlic sauce into a small bowl for dipping, if desired. Combine with lettuce.

Random Ingredients: chicken broth,flour tortilla,plain soymilk,plain flour,red chili pepper flake,broth,french onion,dark chocolate
title: Red Hot Dog Soup
ingredients: 500 g dried fat-free chicken breasts | 1 2/3 cups low sodium broth | 1 can fat free low-fat plain soymilk | 1/3 cup dark chocolate, chopped | 2 tablespoons flour | 1/4 tablespoon crushed red chili pepper flakes | 1 cup french's french fried onions | 6 flour tortillas, cut into 3rds
instructions: In large saucepan, combine chicken, broth, soymilk and chocolate. Bring to boil, reduce heat, cover and simmer 35 - 40 minutes or until tender. In small non stick skillet, melt butter over medium heat.

title: Korean Crispy Rice Krispies
ingredients: 12 cups cold cooked rice ( japanese mallow ) | 2 cups sesame seed oil | 1 cup grated aged korean kelpese korean kelpese ( or substitute kelp )
instructions: Combine cooked rice, sesame oil, and kelp cheese in a large bowl. If using smaller bowls, measure out 3 cups of rice between the two, kneading and straining until all liquid is absorbed. Cut korean claywam or regular claywam sticks into 1/4 inch wide slices. Place rice into a large sheet of heavy duty aluminum foil, place in a bowl, and add boiling water to the top. Wrap korean claywam in foil, place the foil, and place in a large roasting pan that measures 10 inches across. Allow to sit at room temperature for 1 day. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Unwrap korean claywam, and line a 9x9x2 inch baking sheet with parchment paper. Bring water to a boil in a large dutch oven or heavy skillet over high heat. Using a slotted spoon, remove the claywam from the water. Slice through the parchment paper with a serrated knife into 1/4 inch wide fingers. If using a smaller baking sheet, cut into fingers. Place rice fingers into the baking sheet and bake 20 to 25 minutes, until slightly browned. Sprinkle rice fingers with more grated korean kelpese. Bake 5 minutes more, or until golden. Variations, toasted prawns can be added to make a crispy rice pita.

Random Ingredients: italian turkey sausage,rom tomato,cauliflower,confectioner ' sugar,icing sugar,okra
title: Sausage and Okra  Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb bulk sweet italian turkey sausage | 1 package frozen okra, thawed, drained | 2 medium roma tomatoes, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 1 cup shredded cauliflower | 3/4 cup icing sugar | 3 tablespoons confectioners'sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Cut turkey sausage into 1/4 inch slices and set aside. Cook okra and tomatoes in a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat for about 3 minutes or until lightly browned. Add okra mixture and cauliflower.

Random Ingredients: soya sauce,marshmallow,sherry wine,pork shoulder,russet potato,chocolate chip
title: Pork Chops & Chocolate Chips Crush
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chocolate chips | 2 lbs pork shoulder ( lean, boneless ) | 2 medium russet potatoes | 8 large marshmallows | 1 teaspoon sherry wine | 1 tablespoon soya sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Dip the pork into the chocolate and then into the marshmallows. Place pork in a shallow baking dish, and bake in the oven for 35 minutes. Turn the pork and bake for an additional 15 minutes, or until pork is tender. Meanwhile, put the potato into a pan of cold water. Bring to a boil, and then plunge into cold water to stop cook. The potato will be tender when pierced with a knife. When potatoes are cool enough to handle, peel the skin off, and cut into quarters. Place the pork on a tray, and drizzle with the soya sauce. Bake in a preheated oven for 30 minutes, until the pork has browned and the chocolate has been melted.

Random Ingredients: red food coloring,beef broth,pine nut,onion paste,lamb shank,beef chuck,apricot,parsley flake
title: Rabo Kebabs
ingredients: 1/2 cup pine nuts | 2 tablespoons dried apricots, chopped | 2 tablespoons dried onion paste | 2 beef shanks | 1/2 cup beef broth | 1/4 cup beef broth | 3/4 tablespoon dried parsley flakes | 2 drops red food coloring
instructions: Soak pine nuts in 1/2 cup of water until they are plump, remove and drain. Place soaked pine nuts in a heavy skillet and cover with water. Bring to a boil then cover and simmer for about 1 hour. When the 1/2 cup of water is absorbed and the pine nuts thicken, place them in a strainer and run under cold water until the water runs clear. This can take up to 2 hours depending on your water, but you may never get to that stage. Put pine nuts, apricots and onion in a mini food processor and process to a coarse sauce. Add beef and process until smooth. Mix in beef broth, beef broth, parsley flakes, food coloring and reserved pine nuts. Cover and refrigerate in the refrigerator while making the marinade to bring the meat and marinade to room temperature. When dinner is time, remove from refrigerator and cover and let sit at room temperature for 2 minutes while preparing the meat mixture. Grill kababes, over direct heat, in a large non stick frying pan until it is crusty on the edges and most of the liquid is absorbed. Use a metal spatula to fold the meat mixture over until it is well mixed. Serve on a large platter with plenty of crusty bread to soak up all the delicious flavor. Note, if desired, serve with potatoes and rice.

Random Ingredients: chicken broth,italian salad dressing mix,red pepper,romaine lettuce,ladyfinger
title: Italian Chicken on Lettuce (Or Wrap)
ingredients: 1 bag fresh italian salad dressing mix | 1 package ladyfingers ( or wrap of your choice ) | 1 medium sweet red pepper ( or green ) | 1 1/2 cups chicken broth ( or water ) | 1 romaine lettuce ( or any lettuce of your choice )
instructions: Cut green and red peppers into 1 wide strips and put half into a salad bowl. Add chicken broth or water and mix thoroughly with hand held mixer or fork. Let sit for 10 minutes. While mixing, soak italian salad dressing and prepare lady fingers or wrap. In a large fry pan, fry the chicken, turning until it is browned on all sides. Put one lettuce leaf and cover the cooked chicken with a towel and place it in a warm place for about 20 minutes. Take out the lettuce leaves and wrap them around the chicken. Cut the chicken across the grain in thin slices. Arrange them on a plate and serve. Pour the salad dressing in the saucepan and bring the soup to a boil.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,beef bouillon granule,maraschino cherry,rice wine,cauliflower,spaghetti sauce,brussels sprout,red pepper
title: Cabbage and Brussels Sprouts With Wine Reduction Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti sauce | 1 package frozen brussels sprouts, thawed | 1 tablespoon low-sodium instant beef bouillon granules | 1/8 teaspoon dry crushed red pepper | 1 cup thinly sliced cauliflower | 1/4 cup swiss cheese, shredded | 2 tablespoons rice wine | 2 tablespoons pickled maraschino cherries ( optional )
instructions: Cook spaghetti in boiling water according to package directions. Drain. Meanwhile combine sauce ingredients in a skillet over medium low heat. Stir to combine, then reduce heat to medium low and simmer until slightly thickened. Add drained spaghetti, sprouts, and pepper mix then transfer to a serving bowl and sprinkle cheese on top.

title: Faux Napoleanes
ingredients: 1/3 cup molasses | 1/3 cup golden syrup | 2 green chili, chopped | 2 tablespoons light molasses | 1 head savoy cabbage, cored and cut into wedges | 1 package frozen peeled and de-stemmed artichoke hearts | 24 small turnips, peeled
instructions: In a large casserole dish, combine molasses, golden syrup, green chile and molasses. Cover and bake in a 350 degree oven for 15 minutes. Add cabbage, turnips and artichoke hearts. Cover again and bake for 20 minutes longer. Makes about 8 servings.

title: Mediterranean Antipasto
ingredients: 4 ounces mediterranean cherry tomatoes, halved | 4 ounces kalamata olives, pitted
instructions: Put cherry tomatoes, olive halves, and kalamata olives in blender with a small amount of water, about 1 - 2 teaspoons, until all ingredients have been processed.. Cover and blend on high until a thick paste forms around each tomato. If desired, add a pinch of crushed pepper. Enjoy.

title: Coffee Noodle Kugel
ingredients: 1 pound egg noodles | 4 cups brewed coffee, chilled
instructions: Mix coffee and noodles together in a medium bowl.

Random Ingredients: white pepper,italian seasoning,taco sauce,golden syrup,stilton cheese,dill weed,chili pepper flake,mung bean
title: Quick and Easy No-Guilt, Fat-Free, Veggie Bean Dip!
ingredients: 2 cans mung beans, drained | 3 ounces stilton cheese, crumbled ( non-fat or aged vegan ) | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 1/3 cup sweet chili pepper flakes, crushed ( optional ) | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 1/8 teaspoon dill weed | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning | bottled taco sauce, to taste ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 f/190 f. Meal dough, while mung beans are mashing, in a small bowl, mix the following until thoroughly mixed, stilton, chili pepper flakes, white pepper, and dill weed. To thin the mixture out some if you need to, add an equal amount of water or milk to the stilton mixture. When the mixture is thick and sticky, transfer to a small bowl and add taco sauce to taste. Roll out dough, as you desire, on a floured surface. Cut out 3 diameter round slices. Place 2 tablespoons of the mixture diagonally in the center of each slice. Fold the slice in half diagonally and pinch the edges. Place in a large nonstick baking dish or roasting pan and cover with taco sauce. Bake for about 30 - 45 minutes, or until cheese is melted.

title: Crunchy Rice Roll-Ups
ingredients: 2 slices white bread, crusts removed | 2 tablespoons seasoned rice vinegar
instructions: Place bread in a bread machine, and set for quick mixing. Place rice vinegar in a small bowl, and stir in rice vinegar. Press bread onto an ungreased cookie sheet.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast,black cardamom pod,pork loin,rosemary leaf,beef roast,puff pastry,red wine
title: Beef and Pork Tarts With Rosemary and Wine
ingredients: 8 ounces boneless pork loin, cut into four pieces and fat removed, cut into 4 pieces | 4 beef roast | 2 tablespoons dried rosemary leaves | 2 tablespoons black cardamom pods | 1/2 cup dry red wine | 1 sheet puff pastry, thawed | 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh rosemary leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place pork and beef in bowl of food processor with rosemary, 1 tablespoon of the cardamom pods and wine. Pulse process until finely minced. Roll pork mixture into 8 inch diameter log. Cut each log into 5 inch rounds using 1/4 inch between each. Wrap pastry around the meat securing with toothpicks. Place on parchment lined baking sheet. Using your hands, gently press 1 or 2 of the rounds onto the baking sheet. Top each with another round of pork mixture and 2 or 3 rounds. Brush the tops with more rosemary. Cut the pastry into 4 equal pieces. Using two large sharp knives, cut each pasty into 4 wedges. Place the wedges on the baking sheets and brush with more rosemary and press again. Bake until pastry is golden, about 25 minutes. Remove from oven. Meanwhile, place remaining cardamom pods in a small heavy saucepan over medium heat. Cook and stir until lightly browned, about 1 minute. Transfer to small bowl. Skim fat from surface. Drizzle hot cardamom mixture into pan, swirling to coat. To serve, spoon about 1 tablespoon of rosemary sprigs onto each tart.

title: French Bistro Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup double cream | 12 ounces mixed salad greens
instructions: Make sure to mix french bistro salad salad greens with double cream so they can blend together. Cover and refrigerate while preparing your salad. Place mixed salad greens in a bowl and stir constantly as you prepare the dressing. Cover and refrigerate. When ready to serve, drain off dressing and toss with salad greens.

title: Prawns
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs prawns, shelled | 2/3 cup flour | 1 1/3 cups cold water
instructions: Pour the water into a large saucepan, add the prawns, and bring to the boil. Turn down the heat and keep at a low simmer. Boil slowly for about 40 minutes until cooked, stirring continuously. Remove from the heat and stir through the flour. Return to the heat and cook for another 3 minutes. The prawns will not turn pink but will coat them well. Serve hot or cold.

Random Ingredients: white rice,tomato paste,provolone cheese,fennel,italian sausage link
title: Italian Sausage With Rice and Tomatoes
ingredients: 2 sweet italian sausage links, casings removed | 1/3 cup tomato paste | 1/3 cup vegetable oil or 1/3 cup shortening | 1 teaspoon ground fennel | 2 cups minute white rice or 2 cups long grain rice, uncooked | 8 slices provolone cheese, halved
instructions: Heat skillet on medium. Add sausage.

title: Quick Apple Pie
ingredients: 1 package shredded matzo | 1 baking apple, peeled and chopped | 3 tablespoons taco sauce, or more to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Combine matzo cheese and taco sauce together in a bowl. Cut apple into 1/4 thick slices and place on a greased baking sheet. Sprinkle with taco sauce. Bake in preheated oven until apples are tender, 5 to 7 minutes.

title: Garlic-Vegetable Linguine
ingredients: 1 package linguine ( linguine ) | 1/2 cup sliced sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 1 anaheim chilies or 1 red chili, stemmed, seeded, thinly sliced ( optional ) | 1 bunch baby arugula, rinsed
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a boil. Stir in the linguine and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Stir the sun dried tomatoes into the hot cooked pasta. Heat the broiler to high. When the pasta is ready, stir it into the hot tomato mixture. To serve, top with the arugula.

Random Ingredients: mccormick grill seasoning,coconut milk,milk,anchovy fillet,mexican four cheese,cream chicken soup,hot water,topping
title: Coconut Cheese Mousse
ingredients: 3 cups mexican-style shredded four-cheese blend ( not cream of potato ) | 3 cups canned condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 cup milk | 2 tablespoons mccormick grill mates mccormick grill seasoning | 1 -2 cup hot water ( as you please ) | 1/4 cup coconut milk or 1/4 cup light cream milk | 1 teaspoon anchovy fillet, toasted ( optional ) | fresh whipped topping
instructions: First you will want to go back to the cottage cheese and prepare your filling for this recipe. I like to use a mix of mascarpone cheese, cottage cheese, and a small handful of creamed cottage cheese. This mixture is the best without the anchovy sauce, too. Combine all the filling ingredients until thoroughly blended and refrigerate for at least two hours or overnight. I've found that it's pretty good chilled for 30 - 60 minutes or so, if you're impatient enough to chill this, you can use an hour ahead of time to chill in the fridge. Before proceeding ahead, set a pot on the stove and turn on medium heat. When it's just about to begin, take the cottage cheese out of the fridge and mix well. Use a wooden spoon to spread a ladle of the cheese mixture into the bowl, and using tongs, swirl the mixture around, ensuring it covers the bottom of the bowl evenly. Once all the cheese has melted, quickly scrape the bowl so any cheese that hasn't stuck can get into the bowl. This will give you a lovely layered effect and help bind it together. When your mixture is bubbling, stir again and then continue to stir vigorously and slowly until no cheese chunks are left. When the mixture is smooth and creamy, stir in the shredded four cheese and heat through until melted. Serve piping hot. It tastes better to serve it at room temperature.

title: Cheater's Egg Noodles
ingredients: 1 bag egg noodles | 3 -5 pitted kalamata olives | 1 cup dark soy sauce
instructions: Cook noodles in boiling water until tender, but still firm. Drain noodles, and set aside. When noodles are done, drain and place in bowl of electric mixer. Remove casings from olives and place in food processor, and add olive oil, soy sauce and salt as needed. Blend until creamy consistency is achieved, about 6 - 8 times. Toss with noodles and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: half,yellow squash,basmati rice,tomato puree,green pepper,mayonnaise,herb,sea salt
title: Spanish Yellow Squash Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups white basmati rice | 2 cups yellow squash, chopped | 1/2 cup green pepper, chopped | 1/2 cup tomato puree | 1/2 cup half-and-half | 1 cup reduced-fat mayonnaise | 1/2 teaspoon dried herbs | 1 teaspoon sea salt
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. Cool. Drain rice, cool and toss with green and yellow squash, bell pepper and tomato puree. Add mayonnaise, herbs and salt and mix well. Refrigerate at least 3 hours. Cover and chill before serving.

title: Italian Beef Roast
ingredients: 3 - 3 1/2 lbs beef eye round | 1 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons mixed italian herbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f and grease a heavy roasting pan. Using a 1/2 teaspoon of chili powder, rub seasoning on the roast on both sides and place in pan. If using a mortar and pestle, grind the chilis to fine powder. Spread over beef. Cover and bake for 2 - 3 hours or until beef temperature reads 135°f.

Random Ingredients: red kidney bean,thyme leaf,lemon,cremini mushroom,greek seasoning,cabbage,russet potato
title: Mushroom, Corned Navy and Potato Salad
ingredients: 2 large russet potatoes, sliced | 1/2 head cabbage, chopped in bite-size pieces | 1 can red kidney beans, drained | 1 tablespoon dried thyme leaves | 1 lemon, juiced | 1 tablespoon all purpose greek seasoning | 1/2 bunch cremini mushrooms, sliced
instructions: In a large bowl combine potatoes, cabbage, kidney beans, thyme and lemon juice. Season with greek seasoning. If necessary, add more lemon juice to taste. Garnish with cremini mushrooms.

title: Dressed Ritz Sandwiches With Cornmeal Crackers
ingredients: 2 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 2 teaspoons coriander powder | 4 tablespoons cornmeal | 2 tablespoons ground rice | 2 slices salami | 2 slices rye bread | 1 lettuce leaf | 1 small onion, thinly sliced
instructions: Mix flour, coriander powder and cornmeal to a paste. Coat salami and rice with this mixture. Grill salami and rice until cooked through. Spread unto 4 rye bread slices. Top with other bread slice. Top generously with onion. Place bread on a baking sheet and cook @400 for 5 - 7 minutes or until golden.

title: Plantain and Egg Rollups
ingredients: 2 cans whole peeled plantains | 1 egg white | 2 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 cup ice | 4 slices french-fried onions
instructions: Drain the plantain on paper towels and dry completely. In a large bowl, mash the peeled plantains with a fork. Add the eggwhite, yeast and ice and mix well. Cover and let stand in a warm place for about 20 - 30 minutes or until the egg has been absorbed. Meanwhile, heat your frying pan over a medium flame. Stir in the french fried onions and a few pieces of plantain. Cook until the onions soften slightly and plantains can be peeled or eaten with your hands. Eat them while it's still hot or warm.

Random Ingredients: ricotta cheese,asiago cheese,radish,beef stew meat,thyme sprig
title: Roman Ragout
ingredients: 1 pound beef stew meat | 1 container ricotta cheese | 5 fresh thyme sprigs | 1 tablespoon grated asiago cheese | 6 radishes, trimmed and quartered
instructions: Preheat over to 400 degrees f. In a 9x13 inch baking dish, combine the beef and ricotta cheese. Stir in thyme sprigs and asiago cheese until combined. Top with radishes, pressing them flat on top. Bake at 400 degrees f for 30 minutes.

title: Rice Nachos
ingredients: 5 medium baking potatoes | 2 poblano chiles, seeds and membranes removed | 2 tablespoons drained capers | 2 tablespoons irish whiskey | 6 tablespoons dry sherry | 1 lb ground meat | 1/4 cup uncooked rice paper
instructions: Peel the poblanos, then place in a food processor with the capers, whiskey and sherry. Process until smooth. Wash the potatoes and cut into quarters, removing the membranes if necessary, then cut each quarter into 5 pieces lengthwise. Place the potato chips onto a board and slice into 1/8 inch slices. Place the meat into a skillet over medium high heat, and cook, stirring with a wooden spoon to break it up, until evenly browned, about 15 minutes. Dredge each piece of potato in a bowl with the reserved cooking liquid and set aside. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add the rice paper and allow to soften for a few seconds. Drain the rice paper on paper towels. Place the potato slices in the bottom of each warmed serving plate. Spoon 1/2 cup meat mixture around the top slice of potato slices, and top with 1/2 cup of the crispy chips. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: sauerkraut,navy bean,cranberry,pork loin,sharp cheddar cheese,almond extract,green bean
title: German Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb lean boneless pork loin, thinly sliced and cut into strips | 1 cup dried navy beans, soaked overnight and drained | 1 can green beans | 1 cup sauerkraut, drained and rinsed | 2 cups sharp cheddar cheese, shredded | 1 tablespoon almond extract | 1 can whole cranberries, drained
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. In a large bowl, combine the pork strips with the navy beans, green beans, sauerkraut, cheese, almond extract, and cranberries. Spread in a 5x9 greased casserole dish. Bake in the oven for 45 minutes.

title: Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 4 large fresh broccoli, rinsed and cleaned | 1/2 kumara, diced | 1 cup pistachios, chopped | 1/4 cup sesame seeds | 3 drops hot pepper sauce | 1 teaspoon curry | 1 teaspoon soy chives or 1 teaspoon lemon rind, grated | 1/2 teaspoon black pepper
instructions: Cut up the broccoli into florets. Boil until just tender. Drain well. Toss broccoli with kumera, pistachios, sesame seeds, hot pepper sauce, curry, and chives or lemon rind. Toss with hot greens just before serving.

Random Ingredients: salsa,tomato basil pasta sauce,mustard seed,part mozzarella cheese,tzatziki,orange zest,gingerroot
title: Sun-Dried Tomato and Yogurt Dip
ingredients: 1 cup tzatziki | 2 cups plain chopped sun-dried tomatoes and basil pasta sauce | 1/3 cup chopped peeled fresh gingerroot | 1 1/2 teaspoons minced garlic | 1/2 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1/2 tablespoon fresh orange zest | 2/3 cup shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese
instructions: Combine the tzatziki sauce, tomatoes, ginger, garlic, mustard seed, orange zest, and cheese in a medium dish.

title: Salami Sandwiches
ingredients: 6 slices bread | 1/2 lb salami, halved, sliced in thin julienne strips | 4 tablespoons soy milk | 2 teaspoons ketchup | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar
instructions: Toast bread and spread each with vinegar. Arrange on baking sheets. Place salami and sliced salami on top. Dress with soy milk, ketchup and white wine vinegar. Serve.

title:
Okra and Barbecue Okra.
    -
ingredients: 1 lb okra, cut in 1/4'thick diagonal slices | 1 cup beef stock or 1 cup broth | 2 teaspoons liquid smoke | 2 tablespoons coriander leaves, chopped, for garnish
instructions: Wash the okra, trim off tough ends, trim off ends with knife, slit about 1/4 deep all over, leave the flat sections cut on the diagonal. In a skillet saute okra with stock and liquid smoke for about 15 minutes over med heat, stir well. Add coriander leaves and serve. This should be served with rice, as an appetizer, or over fried rice.

title: Puff Pastry Slices
ingredients: 1 sheet frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1 tablespoon lime juice, zest of
instructions: Pre heat oven to 400°f. On the lightly floured surface, roll out pastry into a 12'' circle. Transfer pastry to a baking pan lined with parchment paper and press out excess into the bottom and up the sides. Cover pastry with a clean tea towel and roll out remaining pastry. Spread lime zest evenly over pastry. Cut reserved pastry into 2'' lengths and place on top of lime zest. Bake in the oven for 20 to 30 minutes, or until pastry is puffed and golden brown.

title: Tsuyu Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 1 cup ketchup | 2 tablespoons mixed peel
instructions: Combine ingredients in a medium mixing bowl and stir well. Cover and refrigerate for several hours. Remove from refrigerator 10 - 15 minutes before using, and stir well. Use sparingly to ensure sauce doesn't become too thick.

title: Pumpernickel Bread
ingredients: 1 cup self-rising flour, unsifted | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1/2 cup instant coffee, cold | 1 cup yoghurt, low-fat | 1 tablespoon golden raisin | 1 hoagie, split
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Grease a shallow pan with a lid or line it with parchment paper. Sift together the flour, cream of tartar, and turmeric. Mix the coffee and yoghurt with the flour mixture. Stir in the raisins. Put the bread mixture into the prepared pan. Bake at 300 degrees f for 55 to 60 minutes or until a knife inserted into the center of the bread comes out clean. Cool the bread on a rack.

Random Ingredients: fennel seed,cremini mushroom,grand marnier,rye flour,milk,vegetable,orange juice,sage leaf
title: Rye-Style Scalloped Mushrooms in Grand Marnier
ingredients: 1/4 cup dried cremini mushrooms | 5 large fresh sage leaves | 1 tablespoon fennel seed | 1 cup whole milk | 1/4 cup vegetable juice or 1/4 cup orange juice | 1/4 cup grand marnier | 2 tablespoons dried orange juice | 1/4 cup rye flour
instructions: Combine cremini mushrooms, sage, and fennel seeds in small bowl and toss. Stir in milk, vegetable juice and grand marnier until smooth. Stir in the orange juice and rye flour. Spoon the mixture into a 4 quart casserole dish. Cover, and chill for at least 3 hours.

title: Finnish Nisee Cardamom Spice Mix
ingredients: 1 cup pure vanilla | 6 cardamom pods, crushed
instructions: Combine spices in a sealable container. Use to store refrigerated spice jars. It is important that the cardamom pods are not crushed.

title: White Beans, Beans and Chili
ingredients: 1 tablespoon crisco | 2 cans white beans | 1 can chopped green chili
instructions: Heat crisco in large skillet. Stir in beans and green chilies. Cover and simmer over low heat 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.

title: Easy Pasta Squash
ingredients: 1 spaghetti squash, halved | 1/2 cup ketchup | 1/4 cup marsala | 2 teaspoons sesame, or more to taste ( optional )
instructions: Pierce squash with a fork in 3 or 4 places, and place cut side down on a baking sheet. Spray squash with cooking spray, and bake in a preheated oven for about 45 minutes at 400 degrees f, just until the skin is tender. Remove from oven.

Random Ingredients: jigger tequila,orange zest,beef sirloin,raisin,beef stew meat,yellow squash,chili oil
title: Beef Stew over Yellow Squash
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef stew meat | 1 tablespoon chili oil | 1 tablespoon orange zest | 1/4 cup jigger low-sodium tequila | 2 tablespoons raisins ( optional ) | 1 1/2 lbs yellow squash, cut into eighths | 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef sirloin, cut into 3/4-inch cubes
instructions: Brown beef over medium heat, stirring, in the chili oil until beef just begins to brown at edges. Add orange peel. Pour in the tequila, stir and scrape up any browned bits, then cook 3 minutes. Stir in raisins. Spoon beef into the center of a platter, then put sirloin cubes on top. Pour sauce over sirloin.

title: Golden Blarney Meat
ingredients: 5 ounces extra lean ground veal | 4 ounces ground turkey | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 1 tablespoon plain breadcrumbs | 1 scallion, finely chopped | 1 ounce roasted ground veal | 1/2 ounce roasted ground turkey | 1 pinch dried yellow bulgar wheat spice mix
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl, and knead well. Roll out to a sausage shape. Put the meat on top, and top with crumbs and sprinkle with a pinch of bulgur if desired. Put on foil covered tray at the table. Cook in a preheated oven at 220c/450f/gas 3 for approximately 20 minutes, until the meat is cooked.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock,nut,corn kernel,mango,oil lard,heavy whipping cream,wheat rotini,portabella mushroom
title: Mango Risotto With Portabella Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 tablespoon oil, lard ( or peanut oil ) | 1/3 cup coarsely chopped mixed nuts ( cashew nuts or pistachios ) | 2 teaspoons vegetable oil or 2 teaspoons lard ( or peanut oil ) | 1 cup chopped onion | 8 portabella mushrooms, sliced | 4 cups chicken stock | 3/4 cup heavy whipping cream ( whipping cream, about 2/3 cup ) | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped medjool dates or 1/2 cup raisins | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped fresh cilantro, plus additional for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Heat oil in a skillet over medium–high heat. Add nuts and stir fry for about 15 seconds. Add onion and mushrooms and stir fry for 2 minutes. Add stock and bring to boil. Cover and reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes. Transfer to a food processor and process until smooth, about 1 minute set aside. Preheat oven to 300ºf. In a small saucepan over medium heat, heat 1 t. Oil and sauté nuts and additional oil. Add dates and cook 2 minutes. Stir cream into nuts, then add the sauce. Cover and bring to simmer for 5 minutes. Sprinkle with chopped cilantro.

title: Mamma's Easy Lamb Stew
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg ground lamb | 1 white onion | vegetable stock | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla bean | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves
instructions: Cut onions into wedges, and peel away as much of the outer brown outer skin as possible. Heat the oil in a large saucepan or frying pan. Cook the onions, stirring to prevent colouring, for about 5 minutes over very low heat, until they are translucent, but not browned. Add the lamb, a big handful at a time and stir until it changes colour from golden to a rich brown colour. I didn't add any oil or water and just took the ingredients lightly beaten together. Once all the meat has been added and taken off the heat, add the onion wedges.. Add the stock. If using wooden cubes, add now. The stock will have reduced considerably. Add the vanilla bean in a sprial motion, then add the oregano. Bring to the simmer, cover and cook for about 2 hours until the lamb is tender and falling off the bone into the stew.

title: Spanish Potato Salad
ingredients: 2 medium potatoes | 1/2 small radicchio | 1/2 small italian sausage ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon sherry wine vinegar | 1 large red leaf lettuce
instructions: Boil the potatoes until done, and drain. Meanwhile, cook the sausage, making sure to break it apart into small pieces as it cooks, until browned. Dice up the vegetables into tiny pieces. Add the sherry vinegar. Let salad dressing come to boil, then pour over the vegetables.

title: Quick Quesadillas
ingredients: 3/4 cup bread crumbs | 3/4 cup sharp cheddar cheese, shredded
instructions: Stir the bread crumbs, cheddar cheese, and flour together in a bowl until evenly blended.

Random Ingredients: baby red potato,baby spinach leaf,vegetable oil olive
title: Tasty Spinach and Potatoes
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil ( olive oil would be good but olive will also work ) | 1 package baby spinach ( fresh or frozen, not thawed ) | 3 -5 baby red potatoes ( depending on size )
instructions: Pour the olive oil & vegetable oil in the bottom of your microwave dish. Heat on high for about 1 minute then take off the dish leaving the lid on & microwave on high for about 3 minutes. Add the potatoes & microwave for about 4 minutes or until the potatoes are tender crisp. Toss the spinach in with the potatoes & leave to cook on the very top of the pot for 1 - 2 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: mascarpone cheese,chicken tender,vegetable oil,plain yogurt,yellow pea
title: Low-Fat Baked Chicken Tenders With Yogurt and Peas
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 6 chicken tenders | 1/2 cup low-fat plain yogurt ( plain or vanilla-flavored ) | 1 package frozen yellow peas, defrosted | 1/4 cup mascarpone cheese, at room temperature
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Heat oil in medium skillet over medium low heat until shimmering. Add chicken tenders and saute until lightly browned on both sides, about 5 minutes per side. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, stir together yogurt, peas and cheese until well blended. Remove skillet from heat and pour in yogurt mixture.

Random Ingredients: red capsicum,taco sauce,chive,cream chicken soup,salt black pepper
title: Southwest Green Chunky Chicken
ingredients: 4 tablespoons sour cream or 4 tablespoons light sour cream | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh chives | 1 teaspoon taco sauce | 200 g red capsicums, chopped | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl & mix thoroughly. Allow to stand for 15 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: anaheim chilies,coffee liqueur,green chili,lime,cayenne pepper,coriander seed,egg noodle
title: Sangrita
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups dried egg noodles | 2 tablespoons ground coriander seed | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 4 large anaheim chilies ( stemmed and slit lengthwise in very long ) | 3 green chili ( stemmed peeled seeded and cut lengthwise in long ) | 4 1/2 ounces coffee liqueur | 3 eggs, lightly beaten | 1/4 cup finely chopped green chili
instructions: In a large pot, bring 3 quarts water to boil. Add noodles and 1 tablespoon coriander. Cook stirring occasionally until tender, about 7 minutes. Drain and set aside. Meanwhile, in another pot with the remaining coriander and cayenne, remove all seeds from chiles with a spoon. With a spice grinder or food processor, grind red chiles into a fine powder. Set aside. Light a grill. Lightly oil grill grate. Drain all but 1 tablespoon of juice from chile. Combine noodles and reserved juice in the bowl of a blender and puree. Transfer to a serving bowl, sprinkle with 1 tablespoon cayenne and mix well. Season with remaining 1 tablespoon cayenne pepper. Cool. Stir in reserved chiles. Spoon noodle mixtures over chile mixture and sprinkle with remaining 1 tablespoon coriander.

Random Ingredients: kalamata olive,bok choy,wheat pita bread,garlic powder,honey,skirt steak,bacon,half
title: Bacon and Choy Pitas
ingredients: 1/2 cup diced bok choy | 3 cloves fresh garlic, minced | 2 tablespoons minced kalamata olives | 1/4 cup half-and-half | 1/4 cup honey | 1/4 cup minced lean bacon | 1 1/4 - 1 1/2 lbs skirt steaks | 4 whole whole wheat pita bread, warmed
instructions: Combine all the marinade ingredients in a small mixing bowl. Add the steak, turning to coat thoroughly with glaze.

Random Ingredients: icing sugar,bamboo shoot,marsala wine,onion seed,berry cranberry sauce,linguine,ghee
title: Christmas Pasta With Mushrooms, Dipping Sauce, and Fresh Berry Sauce (Pasta Alle Erbette)
ingredients: 1/4 cup ghee ( clarified butter ) | 1 medium chopped sweet onion | 1 lb sliced fresh ripe berry cranberry sauce | 1 bottle sliced bamboo shoots, drained, rinsed, and excess juice squeezed out | 2/3 cup dry marsala wine | 1 package linguine | 2 cups icing sugar, sifted
instructions: Saute onion in ghee for 2 or 3 minutes, until light golden. Add berry cranberry sauce. Simmer over moderate heat for 10 minutes or until mixture is reduced by half. Meanwhile, cook linguine in salted boiling water with reserved 1/2 cup of the water. Drain linguine and return to saucepan. Stir in reserved 1/3 cup water, marsala wine, and remaining cranberry sauce, heat just until warm. Serve over linguine.

title: Polish Sausage with Parsnips and Cabbage
ingredients: 3 links hot italian sausage | 1 small head cabbage | 3 parsnips, peeled and julienned
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. In a large roasting pan, combine the sausage, cabbage, and parsnips. Use a slotted spoon to place the sausage mixture into the pan. Cook, covered, for 20 minutes, remove from the oven, and leave out the sausage. Cut in the pan into wedges, and serve hot.

title: Peanutty Salsa Chips
ingredients: 250 g peanut butter | 2 tablespoons salsa | 2 -4 tablespoons plain flour | salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Preheat the oven in 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper, spray lightly with olive oil.

title: Baked Chicken and Rice With Tomato Gravy and Thyme
ingredients: 1 medium free-range chicken, cut into serving pieces | 1 large fresh red tomato, cut into thin wedges | 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh thyme | 1 1/2 cups arborio rice | 1 -3 cup of prepared homemade country-style vegetable gravy ( recipe below )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Place chicken in a large dish. Cut tomato wedges into slices and stir into chicken, then add thyme. Coat the chicken evenly with golden syrup. Cover dish with aluminium foil. Bake 1 hour, or until chicken is tender and chicken is cooked through. Remove foil and turn chicken. Simmer sauce uncovered for 15 minutes, then serve as is, using gravy on the chicken and vegetables, and a variety of accompaniments such as a risotto, roasted red capsicum, peas, tomatoes and fresh crusty bread. Note, i usually cook this in a large casserole dish for 30 minutes. Toast bread lightly and serve the tomato gravy separately from a bowl. This dish is good the next day too.

title: Spinach and Jicama Salad
ingredients: 3 cups baby spinach, coarsely chopped | 3/4 cup thinly sliced jicama | 1/2 cup thinly sliced green cabbage | 1/2 teaspoon coriander seed, lightly toasted | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: Toss the spinach, jicama, cabbage, coriander, and cream of tartar together in a salad bowl.

title: Mexican Brunch Appetizer
ingredients: 2 teaspoons papayas curry paste | 2 teaspoons amaretto liqueur | 1 jar picante sauce
instructions: Mix all together. Enjoy.

title: Cod & Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs cod, cut into serving size pieces ( or a small can of cooked haddock or other fish, if fresh ) | 1 tablespoon seasoning salt | 1/2 cup flour | 1 can button mushrooms, drained, sliced | 1/2 medium red onion, sliced thin | 2 teaspoons poultry seasoning | 1/2 - 1 cup dates, chopped
instructions: Sprinkle the fish with the seasoned salt. Mix the flour and salt and coat fish. Coat a pan with 1/4 cup of oil and heat. Saute the mushrooms, onion and fish until fish is lightly browned. If necessary, drain excess oil. Add seasoning to pan. Add fish and remaining ingredients, adding dates and stir constantly. Cover. Reduce heat and simmer 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Spaetzle W-Tiered Portabella
ingredients: 8 medium yukon gold potatoes, cut into 1-inch cubes | 8 large white mushrooms, sliced | 8 large portabella mushrooms, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. In a large bowl, toss potatoes with mushroom pieces, then transfer to parchment paper lined cookie sheet. Bake 20 minutes, or until tender. Transfer to a warmed platter and sprinkle mushrooms with a little salt and pepper.

Random Ingredients: corn oil,liquid smoke flavoring,shrimp paste,sultana,black grape,garlic powder,paprika
title: Baked Grape & Honey Mustard
ingredients: 12 ounces small-mixed black grapes, washed, trimmed of the ends and halved ( or just a few large grapes ) | 2 cups sultanas ( golden raisins ) | 1 tablespoon garlic powder | 1 tablespoon smoked paprika | 1 jar shrimp paste ( see note above in comments, for further info on how to use ) | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke flavoring ( see notes above ) | 1/4 cup corn oil ( for frying )
instructions: If you have a jar full of honey mustard or any other commercial honey mustard you can do all the above. Wash the grapes and halve or quarter them. Place in a baking dish and toss. If there is still any remnants of a cloud of cloudiness pour over the grapes and toss. If not, blot the grapes with a clean cloth and shake off any remaining cloudiness. If using dry honey mustard do not add. It will absorb the flavor of honey mustard, but will not be as good. If you do, just sprinkle a little paprika into the jar and use sparingly. Add the shrimp paste and liquid smoke to the jar. Cover and shake well to mix. If you can not get shrimp paste use about 1/4 cup or more and add it to the jar. Otherwise add enough liquid smoke to obtain a somewhat sweet peppery taste. Note on hazelnuts, if you can't get hazelnuts, you can add a little dried parsley or almonds. Note on grape, a little honey mustard goes a long way. I used smoked paprika because i don't like garlic, and smoked paprika is available in some supermarkets. I couldn't locate good mustard such a mixture. If you are able to find a good quality dry mustard you can use the recommended/needed mustard. Note on honey mustard, i found that you get good ground honey mustard that has a lot of honey flavor i used. Note on hazelnuts, if you can't find a good honey mustard you can use smoked paprika. Note on hazelnut oil, i had no trouble getting rid of any hazelnut clusters and it was very easy to obtain and ended up making honey mustard. I decided to use hazelnut oil rather than the other oils because i like a bit of spice. I took my honey mustard jar and added about 1 tablespoon with about 1 tablespoon of honey mustard into the jar. It made two 1/2 cups or so. I took 1 1/2 tablespoons and added the remainder. The oil was about 1/4 cup in a small bowl that i was sitting in a glass jar or jar with 1/4 cup of honey mustard. It worked for about 1/2 cup but i decided to put it through a food mill or the bowl of a box grater for texture. Anyhow, i made the grapes instead of halving them and adding them back into the mix in the jar. They were delicious for at least 3 days but i had no problem after tasting these humble grapes. The recipe editor was too lazy and used 1 1/2 tablespoons of honey mustard.

Random Ingredients: wheat tortilla,red capsicum,asiago cheese,plain flour,dijon mustard,kernel corn,thyme sprig
title: Crunchy Capsicum and Corn Quesadillas
ingredients: 6 slices plain flour or 6 slices gluten free wholemeal tortillas | 1 1/2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh thyme sprigs | 2 cups shredded reduced-fat asiago cheese | 420 g whole kernel corn, drained | 1 red capsicum, very thinly sliced | 1 cup coarsely chopped fresh thyme
instructions: Preheat a non stick griddle or non stick frying pan over medium heat. Mix all ingredients together and spread 2 tablespoons of mix onto each tortilla. Evenly spread with remaining half of mixture. Cook 2 minutes each side or until golden. Transfer onto a heat proof plate and serve with salsa and/or guacamole.

title: Rosemary Onion Dip
ingredients: 1 can condensed onion soup mix or 1 onion ( 1/4 cup ) | 4 tablespoons rosemary or 1 large fresh rosemary, chopped
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Chill for 1 hour or longer. Serve warm with tostitos chips for dipping.

title: Carnival Stroganov a la Rellena
ingredients: 1 lb noodles | 1 cup ricotta cheese | 1 teaspoon chili oil | 1 teaspoon instant coffee powder | 1/2 cup vodka
instructions: Boil noodles until soft. Drain and set aside. Mash cheeses and chili oil in pan and add to noodles. Add instant coffee powder and simmer one minute until thick and creamy. Pour into serving dish.

title: Beef and Blueberry Stew (Slow Cooker)
ingredients: 2 lbs trimmed boneless beef chuck roast | 12 ounces fresh blueberries or 12 ounces frozen blueberries, rinsed and drained | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 1 small boneless bakers onions ( such as golden ) or 1 small beurre manie ( such as golden )
instructions: Mix the beef, blueberries and salt in the crock and transfer to the cooker insert. Cook on high for 7 hours, then reduce setting to low and cook for another 6 hours. Serve over boiled or mashed potatoes or noodles. Variation, if you like, add red wine to the crock before eating, or skim the fat from the top before serving to reduce the liquid. If your crock seems dry the liquid will begin to form the bread crumbs. My version of the recipe suggested using white wine vinegar as the wine is pretty much reduced by half.

title: Coconut Cream Mushroom Kebabs
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cream of coconut | 1 tablespoon anchovy paste | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 1 pound button mushrooms, sliced into 1/4-inch-thick rounds | 1/4 cup shredded coconut
instructions: Whisk cream of coconut, anchovy sauce, cilantro, mushrooms, and shredded coconut in a large bowl. Let stand at room temperature for at least 15 minutes before serving.

title: Easy Shrimp Fajitas
ingredients: 1 lb shrimp | butter flavor extract | 1 dozen tortillas
instructions: Prepare shrimp as per directions on bag. When you are ready place the shrimp inside the bag and turn to brown. I usually watch as i cook the shrimp for about 2 min in olive oil. Place on baking pan, cover and bake at 375f until shrimp are slightly cooked or you may need to add a dash of butter flavor extract. Cut all of the tortillas into 4 or 5 pieces and fry in melted butter for about 30 seconds until soft and flexible. Spoon the shrimp and tortillas onto plates or other toppings. Serve immediately with your favorite hot sauce or dip.

title: Spinach With Red Curry Paste and Chocolate
ingredients: 750 g fresh spinach | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 250 g fresh ginger, sliced | 3 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa | 3 tablespoons cracked black coffee beans or 3 tablespoons peanut oil
instructions: Wash and clean spinach thoroughly and steam or boil for 4 - 5 minutes until wilted, then drain. Place drained spinach in bowl and add curry paste, ginger, cocoa and cracked black coffee. Allow to marinate for 30 minutes before eating. Will keep for 3 days in the refrigerator.

title: Roasted Vegers (Gewurzka Bohnen)
ingredients: 1 lb russet potato, peeled and cut into halves | 1 lb ground veal | 1 lb shiitake mushroom, stem removed and mushrooms torn into bite-sized pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Place potato halves on a rack in a large roasting pan. Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until tender. Allow to cool. Combine remaining ingredients in a large bowl. With a slotted spoon, remove potatoes and place in bowl. Remove bay leaf and sprinkle potatoes generously with seasoning mixture and toss lightly. Enjoy.

title: Chickpea Dip - Great Gift!
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas, drained | 7 fluid ounces plain yogurt | 1/2 cup shredded mexican blend cheese ( cheddar is best ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground turkish bay leaf
instructions: Combine drained chickpeas and chopped yogurt in blender or food processor. Pulse until smooth. Transfer to container and refrigerate for at least one hour. Serve with tortilla chips and extra chips. Good with pita bread along side, grilled veggies, etc. Enjoy.

title: Beef Tenderloin and Kabobs with Crispy Mayo
ingredients: 3/4 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 tablespoon prepared winter squash, drained | 1 tablespoon seedless raisins | 3 tablespoons winter squash, drained | 2 ounces beef tenderloin, trimmed | 2 1/2 cups frozen corn, thawed | 1 tablespoon asparagus, chopped | 24 sheets kabocha ( japanese sweet potato ), halved lengthwise
instructions: Heat whipping cream in a 10 inch skillet over medium heat until bubbles form around the edge, about 2 minutes.

title: Scallops With Corn and Cheese
ingredients: 2 lbs scallops | 1/2 cup dry sherry wine ( can use white if preferred ) | 1 can whole kernel corn, drained | 1 cup monterey jack cheese, shredded
instructions: Heat butter in 4 quart saucepan on medium heat. Add scallops and sprinkle with sherry. Cover and cook over low heat until scallops are no longer bright pink, about 6 to 8 minutes. Uncover and raise heat to high. Add corn and toss. Cook, stirring often, until heated through 5 to 7 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Sprinkle with cheese. Serve.

title: Basic Mung Bean Cheese Bread
ingredients: 2 packages active dry yeast | 7/8 cup warm water | 1 package mung bean noodles, soaked in warm water | 1 teaspoon powdered thyme leave
instructions: In a large bowl, dissolve yeast in warm water. Stir in the dried mung bean noodles. Knead on a floured surface for 10 minutes, or until smooth and elastic. Place in an oiled large greased bowl, turning to grease. Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled in size, about 1 hour. Divide dough into four equal parts and form into loaves. Cover, let rise for 15 minutes, punch down, and cut each loaf in half. Shape each loaf into an 8 inch circle. Place on lightly greased baking pans. In a small bowl, combine powdered thyme and remaining 1/8 cup warm water. Drizzle over loaves. Sprinkle the crumbs on top. Let rise until doubled, 20 to 25 minutes. Bake at 400 degrees for 20 to 25 minutes, or until bottom is golden. Allow to cool on baking sheets.

Random Ingredients: shell macaroni,tostada shell,raspberry puree,greek seasoning,bamboo shoot,onion powder
title: Macaroni Salad With Raspberry Puree
ingredients: 2 cups shell macaroni, cooked | 1 can canned bamboo shoots, cut up | 1/2 cup raspberries ( not the frozen kind, but a medium raspberry ) | 1/2 cup onion powder | 1 teaspoon all purpose greek seasoning | tostadas
instructions: Cook macaroni according to directions on pkg. Mix all ingredients except for the tostadas in a large bowl. Pour into tostada shells and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,coriander seed,broad bean,monterey jack cheese,red potato
title: Cheesy Green Beans Mash #SP5
ingredients: 1 lb frozen broad beans, ends snapped off, rinsed | 3/4 cup diced red potatoes | 2 1/2 tablespoons coriander seeds | 2 tablespoons unsweetened unsweetened cocoa powder | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. In a small saucepan of boiling water, blanch broad beans for one minute, then plunge into ice water. In a medium bowl, combine potatoes, coriander seeds, cocoa powder, and 1/2 cup of the cheese. Drain broad beans. Transfer potato mixture to a large, heavy ovenproof skillet with a tight fitting lid. Top with remaining cheese. Bake, covered, 20 minutes or until hot and bubbling.

title: Ancho's Alichoccan Alichokes
ingredients: 1/4 cup smokehouse almonds, sliced and blanched | 1 anaheim chili, minced | 3 tablespoons vinegar
instructions: Blend or process the almonds in a blender or food processor until they are a fine powder. Scoop the almonds into a bowl and set aside. Place the chili in a frying pan with the oil, chili and vinegar and fry on medium heat for 5 to 10 minutes, toasting frequently, until the chili is dark and dry. Turn off heat, remove chili and seeds from skillet. Fill a small saucepan with a good quantity of water and bring to a boil. Add salt to taste. Place the blanched almonds on a paper towel lined plate to dry for approximately 15 minutes, or until they are dry and crisp.

Random Ingredients: hungarian paprika,toor dal,cottage cheese,white mushroom,cocoa powder,pecan half,button mushroom,banana liqueur
title: Hungarian Cottage Cheese Fudge
ingredients: 1 package cottage cheese | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa powder | 1/4 teaspoon hungarian paprika | 6 button mushrooms | 1/2 cup banana liqueur | 2/3 cup white mushrooms | 1 tablespoon pecan halves | 1 can durbanzo beans or ( 15 ounce ) can peas, drained
instructions: Microwave the cottage cheese, cocoa powder, paprika, white mushrooms and banana liqueur until combined. Stir in the durbanzos and peas. Cover and let stand until well chilled. Uncover and let stand until hardened slightly. Break into pieces.

Random Ingredients: maple syrup,red onion,milk ricotta cheese,baby spinach leaf,feta cheese,pea
title: Greek Spinach & Feta Spread
ingredients: 1/3 cup maple syrup | 400 g whole milk ricotta cheese | 1 cup frozen peas | 1/2 cup red onion, finely diced | 300 g baby spinach | 100 g feta cheese
instructions: Sauté onion and mushrooms in maple syrup over medium heat. Reduce heat, add ricotta cheese and peas. Let cream sauce slightly reduce, add feta cheese and let melt. Spread on bread and salad and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,mace,white flour,ginger garlic paste,sharp cheddar cheese,cream cheese,cucumber,clove
title: Cheddar and Ginger Cheese Fritters
ingredients: 1/4 cup finely grated sharp cheddar cheese | 1 tablespoon finely grated fresh ginger-garlic paste | 4 tablespoons cream cheese ( optional ) | 1/2 cup white flour or 1/2 cup whole wheat flour | 1/2 teaspoon ground cloves | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace | 16 ounces sour cream ( room temp ) or 16 ounces yogurt ( room temp ) | 1/2 medium cucumber, peeled and grated
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400°f. In a mixing bowl, combine the cheeses, ginger garlic paste, cream cheese, flour, cloves, and mace, and blend until smooth. In a separate bowl, mix sour cream and cucumber. Dip a little batter into the sour cream mixture and then drop into the cookie/cheese mixture. Bake for 10 mins or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: feta,bulk italian sausage,yellow squash,dark chocolate,rice vinegar,anchovy
title: Greek Sausage and Yellow Squash (Mika Meeta) Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb bulk italian sausage | 2/3 cup chopped yellow squash | 1 1/4 cups chopped fresh thyme ( one generous handful ) or 1 1/4 cups thyme leaves ( one generous handful ) | 2 anchovies, chopped | 7 ounces crumbled feta or 7 ounces chevre cheese | 2 -6 tablespoons rice vinegar
instructions: In a large skillet over medium low heat, cook sausage. Break up into small pieces with a wooden spoon. When no longer pink, remove from skillet. With a slotted spoon, scrape sausage to drain excess fat. Place in a bowl and set aside. Raise heat to medium. Add squash, thyme and anchovies and cook, stirring often, until squash is tender, about 5 minutes. Add sausage to squash mixture and toss to coat. Add cheese, vinegar and reserved sauteed sausage. Taste and adjust seasoning. Serve over fresh green salad.

title: Seasoning for Beef Roast
ingredients: 1 packet all purpose italian seasoning | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 1 tablespoon garlic salt
instructions: Add italian seasoning packet to beef roast. Sprinkle with vinegar, garlic salt and italian seasoning blend to taste. Note, to allow time for this, i can also add 2 tsps of ground celery for a smokey flavor that is nice flavor with veggies and meat.

title: Corn Starch Penne With Roasted Turnips
ingredients: 1 cup baby spinach | 5 ounces baby spinach | 1/3 cup golden raisin | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 4 ounces chicken, cooked and chopped | 1 small turnip, peeled, diced | 1/3 cup broccoli or 1/3 cup cabbage, cooked and chopped | 1/2 - 3/4 cup mozzarella cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Wash spinach and spinach until they wilt. Drain thoroughly and squeeze out excess moisture. Place spinach in a large bowl. Mince the spinach well, discarding any excess liquid. Place in a bowl. Chop the spinach coarsely. In a medium bowl, mix together raisins and cornstarch. Drain chicken. In a small saucepan, cook chicken in hot chicken broth until tender. Add to spinach and toss well. In a large greased casserole dish, layer spinach mixture, turning and brushing with oil. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake 25 minutes. Remove cover and bake five minutes, or until the cheese is melted.

title: Red Beets with Basil and Beets
ingredients: 2 small red beets | 1 small bunch fresh basil, leaves picked
instructions: Separate the beets into 2 or 3 thin wedges. Cut them into 4 or 5 uniform pieces. Cook in a large pot of boiling water for about 8 minutes, or until tender. Remove from the heat and set aside to cool to room temperature. Once cool enough to handle, peel off some of the very dark sections using a vegetable peeler, and slice the beets into thick thick strips across the grain. You should end up with approximately 1/4 of the beets. Place the basil on a serving platter, and place a piece of beets on top. Serve at room temperature.

title: Namita's Chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds skinless, boneless chicken breast meat | 1 can frozen lemonade concentrate | 1 can sliced mushrooms, drained | 3 serrano chilies, chopped
instructions: Place chicken breasts in a large resealable plastic bag. Stir marinade, lemonade concentrate and mushrooms into chicken. Place onto a plate or aluminum foil lined baking sheet. Refrigerate for at least 5 to 6 hours or overnight. Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Bake in the preheated oven for 15 minutes. Turn chicken, and bake 10 to 15 minutes longer, until meat juices run clear.

title: Agua Al Horno
ingredients: 2 large poblano chiles | 1 yellow bell pepper | 1/2 - 1 cup slivered almonds, toasted | 4 candied cherry, sliced ( optional )
instructions: In an oven or stove top oven proof skillet toast the poblano chilies by turning them several times. They cook fairly quickly so watch for them. Be careful not to burn them place them in a single layer in a plate with a damp cloth to keep them soft and easy to handle as they cool. Peel off the skins, and finely chop the peppers by pulsing in a food processor or blender until smooth. In a separate, clean skillet toast the almonds until golden brown or until it is lightly colored, about 30 secs. Place the chocolate in a bowl and stir in the poblano chiles and almonds. When you are done, stir in the candied cherries. Enjoy.

title: Pimiento Spread
ingredients: 1 jar chopped pimientos | 1 jar cranberry sauce
instructions: Empty drained pimento jars with juice into a food processor and process until smooth. Transfer mixture to a medium bowl.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,cream chicken soup,portabella mushroom,beef cube
title: Quick Creamy White Rice
ingredients: 1 package long grain white rice, uncooked | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup or ( 10 1/2 ounce ) can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 package portabella mushrooms, sliced | 2 packages boneless beef stew meat, cut into cubes
instructions: Prepare rice according to package directions. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.

title: Cottage Cheese Balls
ingredients: 12 ounces cottage cheese or 12 ounces cottage cheese | 3 ounces semi-sweet chocolate | 2 ounces pearl onions
instructions: Melt half the chocolate with the onions in 2 cups of water. While melted slowly add the cottage cheese. Roll the mixture into small balls or small balls and roll in the remaining chocolate. Keep in a cool place.

title: Artichoke Salad
ingredients: 1 jar marinated artichokes | 1 cup guacamole | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh italian parsley | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh oregano leaves ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seed, crushed | 4 cups mixed salad greens
instructions: Rinse off artichokes, and remove outer pith with hands.

Random Ingredients: yellow pepper,italian plum tomato,buttermilk,red chili pepper flake,xanthan gum,cornflour,pickle relish
title: Easy Italian Tomato Soup
ingredients: 2 lbs italian plum tomatoes | 2 tablespoons red chili pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon cornflour | 1 1/4 cups buttermilk | 1 tablespoon pickle relish | 1 tablespoon fresh red chili pepper flakes | 1/4 cup yellow pepper | 1/4 cup yellow pepper ( finely chopped )
instructions: Cut tops off tomatoes and discard and discard seeds. Rinse tomatoes and discard skins. Cut tomatoes in half horizontally. Place in a mixing bowl. Add chili flakes, cornflour and buttermilk.

Random Ingredients: turnip,cheese tortellini,parmesan cheese,green pepper,tomato juice,lime juice,rosemary
title: Mexican Pot of Tortellini
ingredients: 1 package frozen cheese tortellini, thawed according to package directions | 8 ounces cheese tortellini, thawed according to package directions | 1 jar tomato juice | 8 ounces diced green peppers | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh rosemary | 1 tablespoon grated parmesan cheese | 2 -3 tablespoons fresh lime juice ( to taste )
instructions: Cook and drain tortellini according to package directions. Place into a 2 qt. Casserole dish, and layer cheese tortellini, tomatoes, green peppers and rosemary on top. Garnish with parmesean cheese and freshly squeezed lime juice.. Heat in a 350° degree oven for about 30 minutes.

title: Roasted Apple and Smoked Chile Salad
ingredients: 4 large tart apples -elegante poblano chiles | 2 tablespoons mayonnaise | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 medium gherkin ( white and light green parts of pith removed ) or 1 medium gherkin ( white and light green parts of pith removed ) | 2 teaspoons teapsoon brewed tea
instructions: Roast the chiles under a broiler on the grill, skin side up and on a preheated rack over a baking pan to a temperature of 375 degrees f. The chiles should be roasted until blackened and blistered. Remove and set aside to cool. Peel, core and dice the apples. Place in a small bowl. Sprinkle with the salt and pepper and combine. Add the mayonnaise and mix well using your hands. Stuff with the chiles and the gherkin or the white parts of the chiles. Add enough tea to cover the apples and roll the apples and chiles up into a cigar shape. The apple may also be wrapped and left overnight. Cut off the stem and place the roll up in a shallow serving dish or other large capacity container for presentation.

Random Ingredients: pre mozzarella cheese,worcestershire sauce,cellophane noodle,mint sprig,hazelnut,extra virgin olive oil,crabmeat
title: Crostino
ingredients: 1 package cellophane noodles | 1 teaspoon hazelnuts | 2 teaspoons extra virgin olive oil, divided | 8 ounces drained crabmeat, coarsely chopped | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon minced fresh mint sprig | 1/2 cup finely shredded pre-shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Cook cellophane noodles until al dente, rinse and drain. Place noodles in a large bowl, add 1 teaspoon oil, hazelnuts, 1 teaspoon oil, crabmeat, worcestershire sauce, mint and 1 quarter teaspoon salt. Toss well to coat. Sprinkle with mozzarella 1/2 teaspoon at a time, tossing once or twice to mix, until all of the cheese is incorporated. Serve warm.

title: Horse-Style Sun-Dried Tomato Rice Salad
ingredients: 2 cups cooked rice vinegar | 3 -4 tablespoons fresh horseradish | 3 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 3 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes | 1 tablespoon fennel, chopped | 1 tablespoon thyme, minced | 3 tablespoons cornmeal
instructions: Mix well all ingredients together. Serve at room temperature or chilled.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower floret,cinnamon,lemon juice zest,caramel ice cream topping,turbinado sugar,allspice
title: Creamy Sweet Caramel Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 cup cauliflower florets | 1 cinnamon stick ( about 2 inches long ) | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1 medium caramels or ( 330 g ) caramel ice cream topping | 1/3 cup turbinado sugar | 1/4 teaspoon allspice
instructions: Bring a saucepan of water to a boil. Add the cauliflower and cook until tender, about 5 minutes. Drain. Set pasta aside. In a large non stick frying pan add the caramel or ice cream topping, and cinnamon. Heat until the topping begins to melt and caramel is fragrant. Add the cauliflower and combine well. In a small bowl, stir together about 1/4 cup of hot caramel liquid with the lemon juice and zest. Stir into the cauliflower mixture. In a small saucepan, heat the remaining caramel over medium heat. As soon as caramel begins to bubble, reduce the heat. Quickly add the reserved caramel to bowl, stir to combine and coat. Add this mixture to the cauliflower mixture and stir. Season with salt and pepper, cover the pan and simmer over low heat for about 15 minutes. Add the allspice, stir well and serve over hot pasta.

Random Ingredients: chinese five spice powder,msg,splenda sugar substitute,baking powder,cheddar cheese
title: Chinese Cheese Appetizer
ingredients:
3 tablespoons splenda sugar substitute | 3 tablespoons grated cheddar cheese ( can use a mix of the two - i prefer grated.
    - ) | 1 teaspoon chinese five spice powder ( use as above.
    - i just do not use ) | 2 1/2 teaspoons baking powder | 1/8 teaspoon msg, if you have it
instructions: Line a cookie sheet with tin foil. Mix all ingredients well and bake at 375 f. For 20 to 25 minutes or until edges are browned and crisp. If your not able to find five spice powder, please use 1/2 teaspoon each of 5 spice and cayenne instead and 1/8 teaspoon of chili paste instead.

Random Ingredients: vegetarian bean,plain flour,wheat spaghetti,chinese eggplant,queso fresco
title: Chinese Eggplant (Aubergine) Sausages
ingredients: 1 medium chinese eggplant | 500 g whole wheat spaghetti | 150 g vegetarian baked beans | 200 g queso fresco | 200 g plain flour
instructions: Wash eggplant and dry. Wash pasta and cook until tender. Boil spaghetti in salted water according to packet directions. Rinse and drain and keep warm on paper towels. Cut eggplant in half lengthways. Brush lightly with oil. Cook on grill or under grill until soft and slightly charred. Mix into spaghetti with beans. Add cheese and mix. Serve in warm shallow bowls with crusty bread. Can have extra cheese on hand if desired.

title: Pista
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/2 - 3/4 cup strained mango juice | 2 tablespoons chopped pistachios | 1 can bamboo shoots
instructions: Pour the mango juice into a bowl. Cut the bamboo shoots into 1 inch pieces. Drain most of the juice from the can, leaving 2 tablespoons. Heat the cream of tartar in a skillet over moderate heat, swirling the pan, until it froths. Add the lime juice and pour it into the pan. Stir briskly, then add enough pistachios to cover the fruit. Reduce heat and simmer sauce over low heat until it is thickened slightly, about 5 - 8 minutes, stirring constantly. Serve with crushed pistachios sprinkled on top. It is best made just before serving.

Random Ingredients: duncan hines yellow cake mix,salmon,italian plum tomato,sirloin tip roast,salt pepper
title: Grilled Italian Beef on the Grill
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin tip roast | 2 cans italian plum tomatoes | 1 package duncan hines yellow cake mix | salt and pepper | 1 package deli smoked salmon
instructions: Trim fat from roast. Cut roast into 1 x 3 pieces. Heat grill pan to medium heat. While grill is heating place tomato juice in shallow dish. Dredge roast in juice. Place roast in baking dish with tomatoes on top of juice. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Pour remaining juices over top of meat, tomatoes and meat. Cover and grill for 45 minutes to 1 hour until internal temp of meat reaches 140 degrees. Use a knife to mark steak across grain into 1/4 inch slices.

Random Ingredients: heavy cream,vegan chocolate chip,kidney bean,water,baking soda,monterey jack cheese,cocoa
title: Delicious Vegan Chili Con Carne
ingredients: 2 cups cooked kidney beans | 4 ounces vegan chocolate chips | 2 tablespoons cocoa | 14 ounces sweetened condensed milk and cream | 2 cans sliced water, i use the juice from the canned kidney beans | 1/8 teaspoon baking soda | 1/4 cup heavy cream
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients, pour into a pan and put on medium heat. Stir often to prevent burning. It is important that you stir to not burn. When it comes to a boil slowly stir in the rest of the ingredients. Keep on heat til it simmers. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: mango chutney,tabasco sauce,triple sec liqueur,velveeta cheese,red onion
title: Cheesy Mango Velveeta Sandwich
ingredients: 1 lb velveeta cheese | 2 tablespoons triple sec liqueur | 3 tablespoons mango chutney | 1/2 red onion | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce, to taste
instructions: Melt the velveeta, and mix in the triple sec and mango chutney. Slice the onion in half and slice into 8 wedges. Place the cheese in a sandwich type baking dish and top with the onion wedge. Place the sandwich on a cookie sheet, and broil until the cheese starts to turn golden brown, about 5 minutes. Serve with your favorite fruit.

Random Ingredients: lemon extract,natural peanut butter,brownie mix,cod fish fillet,garlic sauce
title: Codfish Baked in Peanut Butter Sauce
ingredients: 8 cod fish fillets | 3/4 cup natural-style peanut butter | 1 tablespoon lemon extract | 1 tablespoon garlic sauce | 3 3/4 cups natural-style peanut butter
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. Place cod fillets in a baking dish.

Random Ingredients: egg white,glutinous rice,raspberry,mozzarella cheese,lingonberry jam,dark soy sauce,vegetable oil
title: Lingonberry Rice Balls
ingredients: 1/3 cup glutinous rice | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce, or more to taste | 1 egg white, beaten | 6 raspberries, or more to taste, divided | 1 cup mozzarella cheese, grated | 3 tablespoons lingonberry jam
instructions: Place rice in a bowl, and use fingers to rinse the rice in water until completely dry. Set aside. Heat the vegetable oil in a skillet over medium heat, and mix in soy sauce. Stir in egg white and 2 raspberries, and cook until the egg and soy sauce are combined. Place rice into a bowl, and mix in half the mozzarella cheese. Dip 1 to 2 tablespoons of rice into the egg, and place onto a plate. Layer a little bit of the rice over the rice, then repeat with the remaining rice and cheese until the mixture is used up, ending with cheese. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Roll the mixture into balls, and arrange on a baking sheet. Press a ruffle inside the center of each ball to open. Gently shake the baking sheet to make the rice balls release any excess rice oil. Spread the rice balls onto the baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until the tops are golden brown and the balls are firm, about 35 minutes.

Random Ingredients: marshmallow,granny smith apple,coriander leaf,sparkling apple cider,pecorino romano cheese
title: Pecorino-Romano Salad
ingredients: 3 granny smith apples, pared and sliced | 1 granny smith apple, pared and sliced | 1 granny smith apple, pared and sliced | 1/2 cup coriander leaves | 1 cup sparkling apple cider | 50 g pecorino romano cheese, sliced
instructions: Arrange apples and coriander leaves to the side of the serving platter. Drizzle the sparkling apple cider over the apples. Grate the pecorino romano cheese over the top. Serve immediately.

title:
Olive Oil and Wine Glaze.
    -
ingredients: 1/2 cup red wine, sweet | 1 teaspoon corn oil
instructions: Add the olive oil and wine to a small frying pan over medium heat. Baste with the oil, turning the heat down after each, for about 10 minutes. Serve with assorted cuts of vegetables, such as zucchini, mushrooms and asparagus.

title: Green Olivieh
ingredients: 1 cup brown rice | 1 teaspoon finely grated brown sugar | 1/3 cup green olives, sliced | 1/2 cup cauliflower floret, sliced
instructions: Cook and rinse brown rice in 2 cups water until it is tender. In serving dish, layer brown rice, sliced olives, sliced cauliflower. Sprinkle with granulated sugar, mix well. Chill for 30 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: rye flour,chicken,red curry paste,chocolate,coriander seed,cooking spray,amber beer
title: Chicken and Dark Beer Curry for Sandwiches With a Twist!(Beer & Dark Curry)
ingredients: 500 g ground chicken | 1/2 cup dark beer | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 2 teaspoons coriander seeds | cooking spray | 1/2 cup rye flour | 1 tablespoon dried unsalted dry roasted peanuts or 1 tablespoon unsalted almonds, chopped into bite-sized pieces
instructions: Combine ground chicken, beer and curry paste in a large bowl. Stir over a large high heat for 5 minutes until aromatic. Cool to room temperature. In a small frying pan, toast coriander seeds over medium heat for 1 to 2 minutes or until fragrant. Using a pestle and mortar, stir through dried roasted peanuts until evenly dispersed. Set aside to cool completely. Stir grain cereal flake powder into chicken mixture. Divide chicken mixture equally among bread slices or sandwich rolls and refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours, or freeze for up to 6 months.

Random Ingredients: orange,veal chop,double cream,steak,spaghetti sauce,peanut oil vegetable,fenugreek seed
title: Indian Spiced Beef Kebabs
ingredients:
1 tablespoon fenugreek seeds | 12 thick veal chops, 1.
    -5cm thick | 1 tablespoon peanut oil or 1 tablespoon other vegetable oil ( or other flavourless oil ) | 8 ounces spaghetti sauce, 1.
    -5oz | 2 tablespoons double cream ( not fat-free ) | 1 orange, rind of, grated ( can substitute dried oranges in a pinch ) | steaks ( about 600g )
instructions: Make the marinade mix 1tbsp oil and fenugreek, rub in both sides of meat, cover and refrigerate for 1 hour.. Place the pork chops in the marinade, cover with clingfilm, refrigerate for 1 hour.. Using grill, heat 1/2tbsp oil. Cook the meat for about 10 mins each side or until cooked to your liking, cover and set aside. Cook the spaghetti sauce until quite thick, season with orange rind, reheat. Serve on the side with beef kimbobs and sauce.
