title: Grilled Veggie Salad With Peanut Butter Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 cup canned sliced olive oil or 1/2 cup peanut oil | 2 green peas, cut into 1-inch segments | 3 medium tomatoes, diced | 1 large green pepper, diced | 2 cups cauliflower florets, chopped | 4 ounces italian salad dressing | 1 tablespoon hot italian salad dressing | 2 tablespoons smooth peanut butter
instructions: Combine the olive oil & peas in a large bowl and mix together. Add the veggies, italian dressing & peanut butter and mix together. Serve at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: lite olive oil,gluten baking powder,green cardamom pod,pork shoulder,ice cube,bamboo skewer,baking powder,green peppercorn
title: Pork Shank Kebabs (Aka Arhar Dal Pork Shank Skewers)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons lite olive oil | 1 green cardamom pod, split open | 1/2 teaspoon green peppercorn, crushed | 1/3 cup bibbq chicken stock or 1/3 cup canned low-sodium pork stock | 1 teaspoon gluten-free baking powder | 4 1/2 - 5 lbs pork shoulder ( or leg of pork ) | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 3 tablespoons fresh lite olive oil, for brushing or 2 teaspoons extra virgin olive oil | ice cube ( for serving )
instructions: Using a small, sharp knife, make 1 - ½ inch thick slices from the side of the cardamom pods and discard ends. Remove the seeds from the cardamom pods. In a small bowl, combine the oil, oil, cardamom pods, and green pepper, and set aside. Trim and discard fat from pork shoulder or leg of pork. Cut into 1 cubes. Combine chicken, baking powder, and flour in a glass bowl, and pour oil into the pan. Dredge the pork in the flour, coating evenly. Heat the oil or extra virgin olive oil in a large, heavy skillet over medium heat. Add the pork and cook until the edges are dark brown and crispy. Do not crowd the ingredients in the skillet. Place a few cubes of pork on top of each other. When the pork is about half done and the cubes are cooked, stir in the remaining 2 tablespoons of olive oil. Serve immediately.

title:
Chew Crunch - Quick & Easy.
    -
ingredients: 2 cups raw cashews | 1 small yellow onion, chopped | 1/4 cup light brown sugar | 1/4 cup malt vinegar | 2 tablespoons light malt vinegar ( or more if needed )
instructions: Bring a pot of water to rolling boil. Meanwhile, in a large bowl, combine cashews, yellow onion, brown sugar and malt vinegar vinegar. Pour boiling water over mixture and stir to combine. Cook according to package directions. Use more water to keep moist until ready to serve. Note, this recipe tastes best when it has been baked in the oven with good results. Also, after the last time, if needed, add a bit of water.

title: Roasted Tri-Colored Tri-Colored Oysters
ingredients: 5 pounds whole large fresh oysters | 5 pounds phyllo dough, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 320 degrees f. Open each oyster on a flat surface and trim off the hard shell to 2 1/2 x 5 1/2x1 inch thick. Cut a slit on the top of each one. Cut a slit in the top of each oyster.

Random Ingredients: beef,rapeseed oil,canola oil,parsley flake,extra large egg,marshmallow,eggplant
title: Eggplant and Beef-Aubergine Patties
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground beef | 1 extra-large eggplant, cut into quarters | 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley flakes | 1 tablespoon rapeseed oil | 1 egg | 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1/4 cup miniature marshmallows | 1/4 cup extra-virgin olive oil | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1/2 cup chopped fresh parsley flakes
instructions: Mix the ground beef and eggplant together in a large bowl. Gently mix together the parsley, rapeseed oil, and egg in a small bowl and set aside. Preheat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. When the pan is very hot, add the canola oil to the pan and swirl to coat. Add the ground beef mixture and cook, breaking up the meat into small pieces, until lightly browned. Reduce the heat to medium and cook until the meat is no longer pink, stirring often, about 5 to 10 minutes. Turn the heat off. Remove the skillet from the heat, stir in the marshmallows, and set aside. Form into 6 patties and place on a baking sheet lined with foil. Bake until the inside is set, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: plain flour,red pepper flake,cider vinegar,pineapple chunk,fontina cheese,peanut butter
title: Spiced Peanut Butter Slice
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups drained canned pineapple chunks | 3 tablespoons crunchy peanut butter | 1/2 cup plain flour | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1/2 cup grated fontina cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 170 degrees celsius. Combine pineapple, peanut butter, flour paste, vinegar, crushed red pepper and cheese.

title: Bhapa Ghanoush
ingredients: 1 medium eggplant | fennel | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed | 2 ounces okra | 4 ounces sweet english toffee bars | 2 teaspoons sugar syrup
instructions: Preferably leave the eggplant whole. Slice it thinly. Wash the fennel. Dice the okra crosswise. Slice the eggplant into slices. Wash and slice the okra crosswise. In a large container, mix all this prepared ingredients together. Put the mixture into the refrigerator for an hour or more. To serve, pour about 1/4 cup of this prepared brine onto a dessert plate. Place a piece of mixture on the toffee and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: cheddar cheese,green onion,chili powder,green pepper,cayenne pepper
title: Texas Taco Dip
ingredients: 2 cups shredded cheddar cheese | 16 ounces chopped green peppers | 1 can diced green onions | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in medium saucepan. Heat over medium heat until cheese is melted. Serve with corn chips or tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: avocado,paprika,ginger garlic paste,classico spicy red pepper pasta sauce,lamb kidney,baby spinach,salad green,yellow bell pepper
title: Spicy Lamb and Vegetable Stir-Fry
ingredients: 4 ounces lean lamb or 4 ounces stewing beef, cut into bite sized pieces | 1 cup mixed salad greens | 1 medium yellow bell pepper, cut into bite sized pieces ( or use red or green ) | 1 can baby spinach ( drained or thawed ) | 2 teaspoons pickapeppa spicy red pepper pasta sauce | 2 teaspoons pickapeppa spicy red pepper dry sauce or 1 1/2 teaspoons pickapeppa spicy red pepper dry sauce | 1 teaspoon grated ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 teaspoon paprika
instructions: Add all vegetables to a large wok or skillet and stir fry over medium high heat with dry sauce and ginger garlic paste for about 5 minutes until veggies are just tender. Add cubed lamb if using or pan cook another minute and add veggie mixture to wok. Add more dry ingredients to the wok or skillet mix well and heat, stirring constantly until meat is warmed through.

title: Channa Masala for Dummies
ingredients: 1 cup chickpea flour | 1/4 cup chili sauce | 1 tablespoon molasses | 3 tablespoons ground tea | 1 tablespoon dried instant espresso | 1/2 teaspoon curry | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1 pinch ground ginger
instructions: Put all the ingredients in a bowl, add warm water and mix well with a fork. Dough should be sticky but not sticky. Cover with cling film and let sit 20 minutes. Preheat your oven's broiler. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and put your dumplings on it. Brush with cooking oil if desired and broil for about 7 minutes or until lightly golden. Remove and serve with your favorite indian meal.

title: Italian Herbed Bread and Spoon - Microwave
ingredients: 1 lb stale crusty italian bread, sliced 1/4-3/4 `` thick ( or 1 lb stale white bread, cut in 1/4-1 `` cubes ) | 1 cup pearl barley | 2 teaspoons dried basil or 2 teaspoons basil leaves
instructions: Microwave bread, covered, on high power 3 to 5 minutes or until warm. Spoon barley into large mixing bowl. Add 1 tsp basil or 1 tsp oregano, and 2 tsp rosemary. Spread bread and herbs evenly. Microwave until bread is dry and crisp, 6 to 8 minutes.

Random Ingredients: vodka,acinus di pepe pasta,lamb shoulder,buttermilk,milk greek yogurt,oregano leaf,horseradish,balsamic vinegar
title: Lamb and Greek Yogurt Soup
ingredients: 1 lb dried acini di pepe pasta | 1 lb lamb shoulder, chopped | 1/2 cup buttermilk | 1/3 cup milk greek yogurt | 1 teaspoon horseradish | 1 1/2 teaspoons vodka | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried oregano leaves | 3 -4 teaspoons balsamic vinegar
instructions: Bring 6 cups water to boil and add the acine de pepe pasta. Cook covered until al dente about 1 hour. While the pasta is cooking, make the greek yogurt by combining yogurt, horseradish, vodka, oregano and vinegar. Reserve 1/2 cup of yogurt mixture for garnish. When the pasta is cooked and al dente, drain well and toss with yogurt mixture. Serve in bowls on the side. Top with reserved goat’s yogurt.

title: Mandarin Oranges in a Blanket
ingredients: 1 container mandarin oranges | 1 package shredded mozzarella
instructions: Slice mandarins into strips. Arrange orange strips in a large, lightly buttered baking dish. Top with mozzarella cheese. Cook in a microwave on high in microwave until cheese is melted, about 1 1/2 minutes. You may need to stir halfway through cook time.

Random Ingredients: portabella mushroom,salsa,hot paprika,vidalia onion,kalamata olive,rhubarb,mackerel,orange peel
title: Smoked Grel
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs smoked sea bass, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 teaspoon hot paprika | 2 cups portabella mushrooms, quartered | 1 cup fresh rhubarb, sliced | 3/4 cup salsa | 3/4 cup orange peel, pith removed and scored | 12 kalamata olives, pitted and sliced | 1 tablespoon minced vidalia onion ( optional )
instructions: Sprinkle fish lightly with paprika. On a baking sheet, arrange mushrooms on top, then arrange rhubarb on top. Bake in a 450f oven for 20 minutes or until fish is done and rhubarb is tender. Remove from the oven.

title: Beef and Olive Curry With Olives
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin steak, cut into thin slices | 2 cups spanish olives, pitted and sliced | 2 cups ghee | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 teaspoon curry powder
instructions: Boil water and add beef. Cook to desired tenderness. Keep water while preparing ingredients. Heat ghee. In another pan add asafoetida and curry powder and fry for a minute now add olives. Fry for 5 minutes add beef and fry until done. Remove from heat and serve.

title: Black Beans with Cream
ingredients: 1 lb black beans, drained | 1/4 cup shallot, chopped ( approximately ) | 2 tablespoons sour cream
instructions: Rinse beans. Place beans in a large bowl and add salt and let stand at least 4 hours. Drain beans well and place in a large, shallow soup bowl. Pour sour cream over beans and stir gently. Cook covered over medium low heat for 2 hours or until beans are creamy.

title: Wild Rice and Grits
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups cold uncooked wild rice ( i use uncle ben's ) or 2 1/2 cups medium-grain wild rice ( i use uncle ben's ) | 2 celery ribs ( with leaves, about 2/3 cup pieces ) | 2 lemons ( use 2 lemons ) | 1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs | paprika
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Wash wild rice in several changes of water, drain, and allow to cool completely. Cut celery into chunks and add. Slice the lemons. Place both rice and juice in a large bowl, and stir in crushed graham cracker crumbs. Sprinkle rice mixture with paprika. Stir to coat. Pour into a 9x13 inch glass baking dish. Add 1 cup boiling water and cover tightly with foil. Bake for 2 hours in the preheated oven. Let cool slightly, then remove foil and continue baking for an additional 30 minutes or until desired doneness.

title: Fried Radishes With Fontina Cheese
ingredients: 8 large radishes, each 2 1/4 inches long | 1/4 cup garlic paste | 1/4 teaspoon onion salt | 3 ounces fontina cheese, cut into 1/2-inch cubes
instructions: In a mixing bowl, mix all ingredients together.. Cut radishes into 1/4 inch slices. Dip each slice in the melted butter to cover the slices. Place radishes on a serving platter.

title: The Easiest Hot Sauce
ingredients: 1 jalapeno pepper - seeded and diced
instructions: Stem and dice jalapeno pepper. Place in a saucepan over medium high heat and stir until fragrant, about 5 minutes. Reduce heat to low and allow to simmer 10 minutes. Serve sauce with meat and other vegetable of choice.

title: Tasty Black Bean Sprouts
ingredients: 450 g dried black beans ( about 1lb weight ) or 450 g green beans ( about 1lb weight ) | 450 g dried plums ( about 1lb weight ) | 1 bunch fresh coriander, to garnish ( cilantro )
instructions: Place the beans in a large pan, cover with the cold water, add some more water if necessary and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat as low as possible, cover the pan tightly, and simmer for about 30 minutes. Leave to simmer for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, place the plums and coriander in a dry frying pan and cook over medium heat, stirring regularly, for about 10 minutes until they begin to smell roasted. Remove from the heat. Drain the soaked beans well. Rinse under tap water, pat dry and set aside. Add the beans and plums to the pan and simmer gently for about 30 minutes, uncovered. Garnish with the coriander and serve.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,marinara sauce,rice wine,sharp cheddar cheese,water chestnut,tomato green chilies
title: Cheddar Cheese Rissoles
ingredients: 1/3 cup rice wine | 3 1/2 ounces canned diced tomatoes with green chilies ( undrained ) | salt and pepper | 1/3 cup canned water chestnuts, drained | 12 ounces shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 1/3 cup marinara sauce, warmed
instructions: Lightly oil a large, nonstick skillet or crepe pan. Add rice wine, tomatoes, salt and pepper to pan. Simmer on medium low heat 3 - 3 minutes. Add water chestnuts.

title: Pumpkin & Pumpkin Fritters
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 8 ounces pumpkin, chopped | 8 ounces self-raising flour ( optional ) | 1/2 cup pumpkin cooking juice concentrate or 1/2 cup skim milk
instructions: Place chicken and pumpkin in a bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Place in the microwave for 2 minutes, or until tender. Place flour, pumpkin juice and some of the cooking juices in a bowl, mixing with a fork. Stir until the mixture has a smooth, slightly thick consistency. Add the flour mixture to the chicken mixture and mix well to combine. Shape into small balls. Place onto a lightly greased baking tray. Spray some non stick cooking spray onto the top of each fritter and bake in a moderately hot oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until cooked through.

title: Homemade Enchiladas (Enchiladas De Tortillas)
ingredients: corn tortilla | cumin
instructions: First, wrap a piece of corn tortilla in aluminum foil. It will become easier to work with this dish after about an hour if you have an ungreased pan on the stovetop. Then, take your tortilla and wrap it in some cayenne pepper and cumin while it's rolling. Then, place it on the pan and repeat this for every tortilla. When all the tortillas have been wrapped, place them in a 300 degree oven for 20 minutes, or until they are golden brown. Let cool and cut into small squares. Serve with salsa as a dip.

Random Ingredients: mushroom soup,taco sauce,mint,rice flour,cooking oil,parsley,cauliflower floret
title: Cauliflower Wraps
ingredients: 500 g cauliflower florets ( blooms ) | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1/3 cup rice flour | 400 g condensed mushroom soup ( campbell's condensed ) | salt and pepper | chopped fresh parsley, for garnish | taco sauce, for serving
instructions: Steam cauliflower florets for 8 minutes or until just tender. Heat oil in a non stick pan. Stir in flour and stir constantly for 1 minute. Add soup and salt and pepper and cook for 2 minutes over low heat. Add soup and heat through for another 2 minutes. Place 1/3 cups of the cauliflower mixture onto a flat surface. Spread out the top with a spoon or spoonfull. Spoon a generous amount of cauliflower mixture onto the cauliflower in the center of the wrap. Fold sides over and roll up firmly. Serve with taco sauce.

Random Ingredients: american cheese,cumin,lemon pepper,flat leaf parsley,coriander seed,pecorino romano cheese
title: Caprese Cheese
ingredients: 1 slice american cheese, at room temperature | 1/4 cup freshly grated pecorino romano cheese | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/2 teaspoon ground coriander seed | 1/2 teaspoon lemon pepper | 1/2 cup finely minced flat leaf parsley
instructions: Preheat the grill pan to medium high. Place the cheese slice between two sheets of wax paper and flatten with a rolling pin until 1/4 inch thick. Using a sharp serrated knife, cut the slice diagonally into 4 equal pieces. Sprinkle cheese with the grated cheese, cumin, coriander seed, and lemon pepper. Starting at 1 side of each cheese slice, roll the cheese up to enclose completely. Lay slices on a cutting board and press to flatten slightly. Cut each roll into 6 slices. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Peach Strawberry Sauce
ingredients: 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 1/4 cup browning sauce ( like grand chachere's ) | powdered sugar | strawberry | fresh cilantro | sliced sliced peach ( optional )
instructions: In bowl, mix soup, maple syrup, browning sauce, and powdered sugar. Add strawberries, olives, cilantro, if desired, and mix thoroughly. Serve on crackers.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,olive,spicy sausage,ginger powder,salsa,kale,beef chuck roast,asafoetida powder
title: Ginger Beef and Kale Skillet
ingredients: 1 -2 lb beef chuck roast or 1 -2 lb boneless sirloin tip roast | 1/2 lb spicy italian sausage ( casings removed ) | 1 teaspoon ginger powder | 1 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( optional ) | 1 bunch kale ( tough stems removed ) or ( 1 lb ) bunch other greens ( tough stems removed ) | salt and pepper | 3/4 cup prepared salsa | olive ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Place roast in crock pot. Place sausage in same place. Sprinkle ginger, asafetida, salt and pepper on meat. Place kale around meat. Pour salsa over meat. Cover and cook on low for 8 hours. Shred meat and serve.

title: Salty Goat's Feet (Jamaican Eggs)
ingredients: 8 fresh tomatillos | 4 jalapenos, chopped | 2 tablespoons minced ginger root | 1 cup soymilk | 2 eggs, beaten | 1/2 cup maraschino cherries, halved
instructions: Rinse tomatillos and pierce with a toothpick if desired. Place in a saucepan with enough water to come 2 to 3 inches from tomatoes. Bring to a boil.

title: Summer Gazpacho - 3 Points Per Cup
ingredients: 1 large plum tomato, in 2-inch chunks and 2-inch chunks | 1 tablespoon sherry wine ( optional ) or 1 tablespoon vermouth ( optional )
instructions: Combine the tomatoes, sherry and optional vermouth, in an electric blender or food processor.

title: Sauerkraut Dog
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sauerkraut | 4 medium red bell peppers, cut into thin strips | 1 small green chili pepper, minced | 1/4 cup sultana
instructions: Prepare the sauerkraut according to the package instructions, adding the peppers during the last 5 minutes of cooking. Drain. Transfer the sauerkraut and peppers to a crock pot. Pour the sultanas around the sauerkraut and peppers. Cover and cook on low 7 - 8 hours. Turn the sauerkraut after 6 - 8 hours in a 250 degree oven or cook on high for up to 2 hours.

title: Cherry Tomatoes for Two
ingredients: 4 baby cherry tomatoes | 2 tablespoons hot pepper sauce
instructions: In a nonstick skillet, heat the olive oil until hot. Scoop a generous amount of tomatoes into the skillet. Sprinkle on the hot pepper sauce to taste.

title: Dates and Loafs
ingredients: 600 g dates | 1 egg white | 250 g of ground dry date breads
instructions: Grease and line 2 trays with baking paper, place the sugar into the centre of the paper and crumble the sugar evenly around the base. Separate the egg and place the egg white into a large bowl, with a fork mix and then add the date. Mix well and then break the egg white into small pieces and dip the sugar pieces into. Roll them in the egg white and then the date. Place the tray in a preheated oven of 230 degrees centigrade for 40 minutes until golden brown and cooked. Enjoy with jam too.

title: Calypso
ingredients: 1/2 kg sirloin | 1/4 kg ground sirloin | 1/4 kg ground veal | 1/4 cup kraft zesty italian dressing | 1 cup coconut ( grated ) | olive oil ( for frying )
instructions: Mix everything and place in a covered container. Leave in the fridge for at least 24 hours, or in the fridge for over night, to set up. To cook, either fry on med high heat, until dark outside or fry on the bbq. They will puff up and then curl up in the middle for extra wow factor. Enjoy with your favourite sauce, pasta, or bread or salads.

title: One Pot Chicken Fried With Linguine
ingredients: 8 thin slice tomatoes with green chilies | 4 medium chicken cutlets | 2 packages linguine | 1/2 cup agave nectar | 2 tablespoons agave juice
instructions: Combine the ingredients for the one pot. Cover and let sit in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours. Drain the linguine and put into a bowl. Add the 3 pkgns of chicken. Mix. Pour the agave nectar over the chicken and cover. Marinate the chicken for at least 20 minutes in the refrigerator. Heat up a frying pan on medium heat. Add some extra oil to the pan. If you want to fry the chicken, put it in there to cook the chicken. Heat up the rest of the oil. Put the cutlets into the pan, sprinkle on some extra agave juice and let cook for 2 - 3 minutes until browned. When you are done, stir them up. Serve over the linguine, enjoy.

title: Creamy Banana 'n Chicken Noodle Soup
ingredients: 1 packet instant chicken noodle soup mix | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup mix ( from the packet or a low sugar flavour ) | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 2 bananas | half-and-half
instructions: Boil the soup mix, cream of chicken and sugar together. Slice the bananas. Bring the soup back to the boil and pour into a large bowl add the nuggets. Add the cream of chicken to the soup and stir into the soup. Cook on high for five minutes before removing from heat and adding half and half just before serving. This is also very tasty served with croutons.

Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,pie crust,chicken thigh,cocoa powder,adobo seasoning,cream mushroom soup
title: Chicken Chocolate Pizza
ingredients: 1/2 gallon sour cream with mushrooms soup | 1 package refrigerated pie crusts, unbaked | 2 tablespoons adobo seasoning | 1 tablespoon cocoa powder | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1 chicken thigh, deboned and cut into 2 inch pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Spread sour cream over prebaked pie crust. Sprinkle with adobo, cocoa powder, cardamom, and chicken pieces. Bake in preheated oven on bottom rack until puffed and bubbly, about 45 minutes.

title: The Perfect Salmon, Your Heart, and Your Mac
ingredients: 8 ounces mackerel, shucked | 3 tablespoons cocoa | 1 teaspoon teapsoon dried mint | 1 teaspoon dry grated orange rind | 1 1/2 tablespoons mirin | 1/4 cup fresh orange juice | 1/2 teaspoon salt
instructions: Mix the salmon through the cocoa, mint & orange zest. Put in a shallow serving bowl and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Before serving mix the rind, mirin, & salt. Serve with your heart & your mackerel on top.

title: Spicy Chili Powder
ingredients: 9 -10 cups chilies, chopped ( or 4 cups canned chopped red peppers, drained ) | 3/4 - 1 cup finely chopped lemon peel ( white rind only )
instructions: Combine chili peppers, peel and juice of one lemon in a large bowl and set aside.. Store unused chili peppers and juice in another medium pot. Do not burn, but regulate heat so that spices do not burn while cooking. When mixture begins to boil, lower heat to medium and cover with a lid. Stir the contents frequently and cook until desired consistency is achieved, about 35 - 40 minutes. Stir in salt and pepper and serve immediately. Store in a covered container. Makes 5 - 10 servings.

title: Apple, Leek, and Herbed Spaghetti Pie
ingredients: 1 pound spaghetti | 2 quarts apple cider | 18 large leeks | 1 can sliced pickled apples in syrup | 1 tablespoon dried mixed herbs ( such as marjoram, sage, and oregano )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add spaghetti, and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,coconut cream,bamboo shoot,cider vinegar,golden raisin,gravy mix,olive oil
title: Creamy Sweet-Sour Glazed Vegetables
ingredients: 2 cans mixed sweet potatoes, drained | 1 can sliced ripe olives in light syrup, drained | 3/4 cup golden raisins | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained and chopped | 4 tablespoons sweet and sour gravy mix | 2 tablespoons light olive oil | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 2 teaspoons garlic salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place sweet potatoes in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Stir olives, raisins, bamboo, sweet and sour mix, olive oil, cider vinegar, and garlic salt in a blender until smooth. Pour over mixture in baking dish. Bake 1 hour in the preheated oven.

Random Ingredients: baking soda,plum tomato,pie crust,blueberry,vanilla ice cream,cream
title: Tomato and Blueberry Parfait
ingredients: 2 unbaked pie crusts | 2 quarts ripe plum tomatoes ( halved or quartered ) | 1 pint vanilla ice cream, chilled | 4 teaspoons baking soda | 1 pint sour cream | 2 packages fresh blueberries
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place tomatoes cut side up in a baking dish or jelly roll pan lined with parchment paper. Bake until skins wrinkle on tomatoes and are slightly blackened. Turn tomatoes over and bake an additional 20 minutes. Remove from oven and turn tomatoes upright on a cutting board. Place ice cream in a large bowl and sprinkle with baking soda and spread tomatoes evenly across each crust. Top tomatoes with sour cream, sprinkling each with a layer of blueberries. Bake until hot and bubbly around the edges, about 10 minutes.

title: Chile Green Salad
ingredients: 1 red chili sauce, deseeded, deseeded and finely chopped | 8 medium lettuce leaves
instructions: Place the chilli sauce in a small pan with the red chili sauce, add 300ml hot water and stir to combine. Bring the mixture to the boil and then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 15 minutes. When cool, cover and chill for up to 1 hour. Place the lettuce leaves on four dinner plates and pile the chili mixture on top. Serve.

title: Nungakaya Namul (Egg Salad)
ingredients: 3 hard-boiled eggs | 1 tablespoon fish sauce
instructions: Slice eggs in halves. In a bowl, mash egg whites with a fork. Mix in fish sauce and fish sauce. Put the halves on a plate and spoon the fish sauce mixture over them.

Random Ingredients: swiss chard,chile powder,sausage,simple syrup,fennel seed,egg white,cooking grit,shortening
title: Sausage and Swiss Chard Grits
ingredients: 2 cups quick-cooking grits | 1 tablespoon shortening | 1 bunch swiss chard, trimmed and coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons chile powder | 3 links fresh sausage | 1 egg white | 1 teaspoon fennel seed ( optional ) | 1/3 cup simple syrup
instructions: Preheat an oven to 400 degrees f. Grease a baking sheet. Place the grits on a plate, and cut in the shortening until it has the texture of coarse meal. Spread the chopped chard over the bottom of the baking sheet. Sprinkle with chile powder and toss to coat. Tear or coarsely chop the sausage into 1/2 inch pieces. Break the sausage meat into bite size pieces, and place in a bowl. Whisk together the egg white, fennel seed, and simple syrup in a bowl until well blended. Pour the wet mixture over the chard mixture, and toss until all ingredients are evenly moistened.

Random Ingredients: feta cheese,orange zest,beef stew meat,italian bread
title: Greek Beef Sandwich
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat or 1 lb lamb stew meat | 1 1/2 teaspoons grated orange zest | 1 cup crumbled feta cheese | 2 italian bread, slices
instructions: Place meat into baking pan. Sprinkle with zest. Bake in 350 degree oven about 30 minutes or until done. Remove from oven, drain off fat. Sprinkle feta cheese over meat. Place on slices of bread. Broil about 4 from heat until cheese is melted.

Random Ingredients: prosciutto,vanilla ice cream,chicken breast,ketchup,coffee,green pepper,orange juice
title: Chicken Coffee Wrapped in Provolone Provolone
ingredients: 1/2 lb fully cooked boneless chicken breast, very thinly sliced | 1/2 green pepper, finely chopped | 1/2 cup coffee, strong hot | 1/4 cup fresh orange juice | 1 tablespoon ketchup | 1/2 teaspoon pure vanilla extract or 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | prosciutto | 4 pieces provolone cheese
instructions: Pound chicken until it is thin and malleable. Combine with onions and green peppers in a heavy skillet. Add all remaining ingredients and mix well. Spread the mixture out on a plate, place sliced provolone cheese on top and place under broiler to melt.

title: Kebabs (Turkish Sandwich)
ingredients: 600 g sandwich steaks | saffron strand, soaked in | olive oil
instructions: Cut a lengthwise slit through the thickness of the saffron. Rub the saffron into both sides of the steaks. Place the saffron on the steaks and press firmly so you have the saffron covered completely. Leave to sit for half an hour. Brush oil around the steaks. Thread onto skewers and cook over a hot coals for about 5 minutes on each side, or until they are just cooked through.

title: Easy Easy Chick Pea Spread
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas, drained | 1 can neufchatel cheese | salt and pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat chick peas in a pan in butter until warmed through. Add cheese an stir well. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Serve.

title: Blue Cheese Steak
ingredients: 1/2 lb blue cheese | 1 rump steak
instructions: Sprinkle cheese evenly over steak. Place on grill. Grill 15 - 20 minutes or until browned on all sides.

title: Pickled Red Kidney Beans
ingredients: 1 can dark red kidney beans | peppercorn
instructions: Open the cans of kidney beans and rinse with cold water. Drain the excess water into a large mixing bowl. Place the drained beans in the hot kidney beans with the peppercorns. Close the lid of the bowl with cheese cloth and tighten so that everything in the bowl gets some of the water. Set aside to macerate. Refrigerate overnight. Keep in the fridge.

title: Indian Spiced Nuts
ingredients: 10 baguette, sliced to 1/2 inch thickness | 1 1/2 lbs stewing beef ( trimmed of fat and cubed ) | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon fresh lemon peel | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped coriander | 3 1/2 tablespoons chopped chilies | 1/2 - 3/4 tablespoon hot green chili pepper
instructions: Spread baguette slices on foil and place on baking sheet. Broil in toaster to melt butter. Combine meat, peel, coriander, salt, pepper and chillies in a bowl, mixing well. Arrange seasoned baguettes on hot baking sheet and broil 10 - 15 minutes and serve with warm chutney.

title: Broccoli Pasta
ingredients: 8 ounces linguine pasta or 8 ounces spaghetti | 1 lb fresh broccoli floret, broken into florets | 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce, or more to taste
instructions: Cook the linguine in a large pot of boiling water until al dente. Meanwhile, steam the broccoli florets in the microwave for 3 minutes or until soft. Drain the broccoli. Transfer the cooked pasta to a wide bowl. Add the broccoli to the boiling water.

title: Chilli Beef Skewers
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin steaks | 2 tablespoons mustard seeds | 1/2 cup chopped fresh coriander | 1 bunch frozen asparagus
instructions: Grill steak to desired doneness and cut into cubes. Thread on skewers. Place in pan of marinade. Broil, turning often, until blackened.

title: The Easiest Beef Brisket Ever - Slow Cooker
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs beef brisket | 2 -3 fresh serrano chilies, seeded and minced | 4 tablespoons curry powder, to taste ( i usually just use madras curry powder ) | 1 roma tomato, diced
instructions: Place brisket in slow cooker and add all other ingredients except tomato. Cover and cook on low until tender and serve in a bowl.

title: Radishes with Pimentos
ingredients: 2 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 2 large radishes, cut into 1/4 inch slices | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 3 tablespoons chopped pimientos
instructions: Heat the oven to 425°f. Sprinkle flour on a sheet of parchment paper or lined baking sheet and toss to evenly moisten. Toss the radishes with the flour and transfer to the prepared baking sheet. Season lightly with salt and pepper. Bake until golden, about 10 minutes. Sprinkle the pimentos over the radishes and bake 2 minutes longer.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed,mackerel,bok choy,beef rib,hazelnut,chipotle chile adobo
title: Mexican-Style Spiced Grilled Beef Ribs with Beetroot and Hazelnuts
ingredients: 1 can hazelnuts, in a glass pie plate or pan | 1 chipotle chile in adobo, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 1 tablespoon sesame oil or 1 tablespoon olive oil | 8 -10 beef rib eye steaks | 4 large bok choy or 4 large spinach
instructions: Soak the hazelnuts in a glass or plastic dish at least one hour or up to 6 hours. Drain the hazelnuts and pulse them with the chipotle, sesame seeds and oil. Spread the meat and marinate over night at room temperature. Meanwhile, clean the grill and preheat it to high. Place the ribs in a roasting pan or grill pan, with plenty of oil. Sprinkle the bok choy or spinach over the bones or wood and grill over high heat, turning, until cooked to your liking. Beef rib eye steaks should be well done and should be slightly charred outside but have slightly firm internal temperature at the top of the meat. Remove the steaks from the grill and pour the nuts over them. Serve immediately.

title: Guacamole and Tarragon Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 package potato starch or 3 tablespoons potato flour | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon | purchased guacamole | 10 7-inch flour tortillas
instructions: In lrg bowl, mix potato flour w/tarragon & mix well. Spoon 2 tb batter into each tortilla & roll up. Pour 1/4 cup guacamole onto each, roll up & sprinkle w/tarragon. Arrange enchiladas in casserole. Sprinkle w/tarragon & serve. Note, prep time does not reflect baking time.

title: Bengali Tomato-Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 1 can tomato paste | 1 teaspoon ground ginger root, or more to taste ( optional )
instructions: Drain juice from can of tomato paste can. Transfer tomato paste to a blender.

title: Spicy Eggplant (Aubergine) Spread
ingredients: 1 large eggplant | 1 large red chili pepper, deseeded and finely chopped | 1 small bell pepper, deseeded and finely chopped | 1/2 cup flax seed | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla or 2 tablespoons maple syrup, to taste
instructions: Peel eggplant and cut into 1cm slices. Place in boiling water. Remove from heat and cook a few minutes until just soft. Drain. Set aside. Chop chilli. Wash eggplant and drain. Scoop out flesh, then chop into 1cm cubes. In a food processor or blender combine all the ingredients. Mix well and store in fridge for several hours or overnight if possible.

title: Rosemary Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 package sliced cremini mushrooms
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the cornstarch and rosemary. Stir in the oyster sauce. Place the mushrooms into a skillet over medium heat. Cook and stir until lightly browned and tender. Serve.

Random Ingredients: asparagus spear,grape,hash brown,red bell pepper,raisin bread,serrano chilies
title: Spanish Stuffed Peppers
ingredients: 12 ounces frozen hash browns | 3/4 cup raisins or 3/4 cup currants | 3 -4 fresh serrano chilies, seeded and chopped | 12 ounces frozen asparagus spears, thawed and cut in half | 1 medium red bell pepper, cut into thin strips | 1 loaf unsliced grape ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f grease 6 - 8 or 9 inch diameter round cake pans. Stir hash browns, raisins or currants, chiles, and asparagas in a large bowl. Fill each bread pan half full with stuffing. Arrange around edges of pan. Bake about 45 minutes until beginning to brown, and tops are lightly golden brown, and center is hot and crisp. Let cool, in pan about 10 minutes. Serve with additional grape wedges.

title: Pesto Seasoned Dressing
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons onion powder | 2 tablespoons pine nuts
instructions: Mix 1 1/2 teaspoon onion powder and pine nuts together in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: palm sugar,asafoetida powder,cream mushroom soup,lamb shank,onion flake
title: Easy Microwave Kebab  (Punjabi Lamb Shank Fry)
ingredients: 2 pounds lamb shank, cubed | 8 cans cream of mushroom soup | 2 tablespoons dried onion flakes | 5 tablespoons palm sugar | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder, or to taste
instructions: Combine lamb, cream of mushroom soup, dried onion flakes, palm sugar, and asafoetida powder in a large resealable plastic bag.

title: Dynamite Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons hot sauce | 3 tablespoons sugar | 2 teaspoons powdered sauze
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl.

title: Homemade Buttermilk
ingredients: 1 cup buttermilk | 1 tablespoon turmeric | 5 serrano chilies
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Let stand at room temperature for at least 1/2 hour to allow the flavors to meld. Serve over your favourite greens.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,fire tomato,banana pepper,italian tomato,spaghettini,spinach leaf,kaffir lime leaf,scotch bonnet pepper
title: Spice-free Spicy Sausage
ingredients: 1 lb spaghettini or 1 lb tagliatelle pasta | 10 ounces fire-roasted tomatoes | 1 can italian-style stewed tomatoes | 1 bunch fresh spinach leaves, rinsed, trimmed, stemmed, and torn into bite-sized pieces | 1 bulb roasted banana pepper, chopped | 6 kaffir lime leaves ( optional ) | 1 -3 scotch bonnet pepper | 1 -2 fresh serrano peppers or 1 -2 jalapeno pepper, depending on taste
instructions: Cook sausage, according to package directions. Rinse tomato sauce and place in a large crockpot. Add the stewed tomatoes and stir to combine. Add the remaining ingredients except for the pepper. Cook on low for 8 - 10 hrs or on high for 4 - 6 hours. Stir frequently to prevent the sausage from sticking. Serve with warm tortillas.

title: Pigorously Puree (Shrine) in Cream (Ricci Pecorino Al Pecorino)
ingredients: 4 fluid ounces dark rum ( preferably sicilian brand, not san marzano brand ) | 1 1/2 cups heavy cream | 3/4 cup grated pecorino romano cheese | 1 1/2 lbs flour
instructions: Heat rum, cream and romano cheese in a double boiler over boiling water until cream is thick and slightly reduced, stirring constantly, and set aside. Place a large sieve over a bowl. Make sure that the bowl is well covered with a double thickness of muslin paper. Place the cream, romano and cream mixture, and any remaining rum in another bowl. Use a clean whisk to mix and bring the mixture to simmering point.

title: Chicken and Torta Kiev
ingredients: 2 boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut into 1 1/4 inch thick slices | 1/3 cup fresh coriander, chopped | 1/3 cup vodka | 1/4 cup bread, crumbs | 1/4 cup parmesan cheese | 1/2 cup freshly grated parmesan cheese | 1 pinch nutmeg | 6 lemon wedges
instructions: Spray a large baking sheet with veggie spray. Toss the chicken with the coriander and half the vodka. Arrange in the bag, close the cover completely and shake to coat. Let marinate in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour, but preferably up to 2 days. Preheat oven to 425°f. Pour the beer into an 8x8x2 inch baking dish, or two ovenproof baking dishes. Bake in preheated oven until golden, about 20 minutes. While chicken is cooking, mix the bread crumbs, 1/4 cup parmesan, salt and nutmeg. Sprinkle over the chicken. Remove from heat. Let stand for 5 minutes. Squeeze lemon juice over chicken, then sprinkle with remaining vodka. Garnish with fresh mint sprigs. Serve with some steamed greens.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,fine egg noodle,purpose flour,taco seasoning,sherry wine vinegar,chicken,thai red curry paste,curry
title: Chicken Oriental Style
ingredients: 1 jar hot curry flavoured tandoori paste ( found in oriental food stores ) | 1 package egg noodles | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | 1 tablespoon fine egg noodles | 4 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar | 2/3 cup extra-virgin spanish rice wine | 2 teaspoons fine egg noodles | 1/3 cup cooked chicken, chopped | 1 cup crispy plain rye bread, toasted
instructions: Heat curry paste and 1/2 cup of water in a small saucepan over low heat, stirring until fragrant. Remove from heat. Meanwhile, cook noodles in a large pot of boiling salted water until just tender, stirring occasionally. Drain well and return to pot. Add 3 tablespoons of the curry paste, noodles and vinegar. Simmer, covered, for 5 minutes, or until noodles are just heated. Stir in 1/3 cup of rice wine. Add remaining 1/3 cup curry paste and rice wine mixture. Cook, stirring, 3 minutes or until noodles are hot. Serve with toasted bread.

title: Crock Pot Braised Sage Leaves
ingredients: 1/4 cup dried sage leaves, rubbed | 1 can condensed beef consomme, undiluted
instructions: Combine sage leaves, consomme, and salt and pepper to taste in crock pot. Set on low heat and cook for 8 hours.

Random Ingredients: cashew nut,italian salad dressing,topping,black bean,chicken bouillon,italian tomato,asparagus spear,ranch dressing mix
title: Italian Sausage Salad
ingredients:
20 fresh asparagus spears | 2 cans black beans, rinsed and drained | 1 can italian-style diced tomatoes | 1 package ranch dressing mix | 3/4 cup bottled italian salad dressing | 1 (.
    -7 ounce ) packet ranch dressing mix | 1 chicken bouillon | 1/4 cup cashew nuts
instructions: In a large saucepan, bring 1 inch of water to a boil over high heat. Add asparagus spears and boil for 5 minutes, or until crisp tender. Drain and run under cold water to cool to just under room temperature. While asparagus is cooking, prepare the dressing. Combine 3/4 cup of the dressing ingredients in a bowl and whisk until blended. Stir in remaining 1/4 cup of dressing and reserved 1 tablespoon of dressing. Toss with asparagus to coat.

Random Ingredients: lemon pepper,rutabaga,egg yolk,chinese black mushroom,chunky peanut butter,nonfat beef broth,duck leg,chutney
title: Chinese-style Pork Cordon Bleu With Vegetables
ingredients: 6 duck legs | 1 1/2 lbs rutabagas, peeled and cut in 1-inch chunks | 1 lb chunky peanut butter | 1/4 cup chutney | 8 large eggs | 8 3/4 cups nonfat beef broth | 1 tablespoon lemon pepper | 1 lb chinese black mushroom, chopped
instructions: Place duck legs in a large dutch oven and cover with cold water. Bring to a boil over high heat. Using the back of a spoon, gently pierce legs several times. When duck legs are just about tender, remove from heat. Let sit for 5 minutes. Remove duck legs from cold water and place into a bowl. Cut off both ends of the legs and discard. Slice off the duck legs as thinly as possible.

title: Tibetan Cabbage (Czech Style) Salad
ingredients: 1 head chinese cabbage | 1 can pinto beans | 1 can tomato juice | 1/4 cup instant coffee | 1 teaspoon orange peel
instructions: Rinse cabbage under running water and drain. Place in a serving bowl. In a pan, combine beans, tomato, coffee, orange peel, and juice. Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer for 5 minutes, or until cabbage is tender.

Random Ingredients: coriander seed,chicken breast half,topping,cheese,okra,french fry,filet beef,kalamata olive
title: Cheesy Beef and Okra Stuffed Chicken Rolls
ingredients: 1 lb stir fry steak, cubed | 1 lb frozen okra, thawed | 1 lb frozen frozen shredded spinach, thawed and drained | 8 kalamata olives, pitted and chopped | 2 teaspoons coriander seeds, crushed | 1 boneless skinless chicken breast half, cubed | 2 tablespoons shredded light sandwich spreadable cheese | 1 slice processed cheese ( or a blend of cheeses, cheddar, fontina or other melting type cheese )
instructions: Place first 3 ingredients in a large zip top plastic bag and microwave with lid on high, about 4 minutes, or until okra is crisp tender. While steak is cooking, cook okra in nonstick nonstick skillet over medium high heat 2 minutes, turning once. Remove from skillet and drain, then place on a paper towel lined plate. Remove cooked okra from skillet and reserve. Spray work area of chicken with cooking spray. Place spinach, olives and coriander seeds in a small bowl, and toss to combine.

Random Ingredients: red wine,vegan cream,polish sausage,molasses,olive,garlic,chicken bouillon cube,italian tomato
title: Polish Sausage Cacciatore (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 8 links polish sausage | 2 cans italian-style tomatoes | 1 tablespoon olive oil, divided | 4 tablespoons red wine | 2 tablespoons light molasses | 2 tablespoons roasted garlic, pureed in blender with garlic | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 4 tablespoons vegan sour cream
instructions: Cut sausage into 1/2 inch cubes and cook in a skillet. Cook till crumbly and crumbly. Drain and set aside. Add remaining ingredients. Put in crock pot and cook on low for 5 days. Remove meat from pot, take meat out of casings and dice. Put back in pot and mix italian style sauce in. Serve over pasta of your choice.

Random Ingredients: stew meat,cilantro leaf,onion salt,cherry,rigatoni pasta,bell pepper,yogurt,turnip
title: A Jaffle
ingredients: 1 lb stew meat | 2 small turnips, peeled and cut into 1-inch chunks | 2 large sweet onions, peeled | fresh cilantro leaves | salt | 1 box rigatoni pasta | 2 small sweet bell peppers, cut into 1-inch chunks | 1 cup low lactose sour cream | 3/4 cup lowfat yogurt
instructions: Place all ingredients except rigatoni in a skillet and cook until meat and onions are tender, breaking lamb meat apart as necessary. Serve over hot cooked rigatoni. Garnish with cilantro. Also great with fresh mint, cilantro or parsley.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,brown rice,baby spinach leaf,green chili salsa,camembert cheese
title: Camembert & Spinach Rollups
ingredients: 2 ounces camembert cheese | 2 ounces pecorino romano cheese | 5 -6 baby spinach leaves | 2 tablespoons green chili salsa | 1 1/2 cups cooked brown rice
instructions: Slice camembert, romano & spinach leaves. Combine in a bowl with green salsa. Chill for up to 1 hour, although the longer this is to serve, the better it gets.

title: Accent Endive French Toast
ingredients: 4 belgian endive, washed and dried | 1 1/2 ounces bananas ( sliced or quartered depending on how much flavor you prefer ) | 1/4 teaspoon salt and pepper | 1/4 teaspoon accent seasoning | 1/8 teaspoon pure vanilla extract
instructions: Combine salt, pepper, sugar, vanilla and accent in small dish and toss to combine. Arrange endive in baking pan and pat the top of the endive dry with paper towel. Place all the other ingredients in another small bowl. Dip endive in oil mixture, laying endive in pan, and cook at 300 degrees about 12 - 15 minutes, or until light brown. Serve warm.

title: Gluten-Free Mocha Tea
ingredients: 1 teaspoon cajun seasoning | 1 teaspoon honey or 1 teaspoon coconut extract | 2 teaspoons brewed coffee
instructions: Combine coffee and honey in a mug. Garnish with a pinch or two of the cajun seasoning and serve.

title: Banana and Yoghurt Rice Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup sticky rice | 1/2 cup yoghurt | 1 large stalk lemons, juiced | 5 small chile peppers, seeded and minced | 1 yellow pepper, minced | 4 firm bananas, sliced | 6 ounces crumbled blue cheese ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom, or more as needed
instructions: Wash sticky rice in a colander under cold water until water runs clear. Place in medium bowl. Add lemon juice and let stand 20 minutes until rice has absorbed the lemon juice.

title: Deep-Fried Crepes
ingredients: 2 crepes | 1 teaspoon mayonnaise
instructions: Wrap each crepe in a piece of wax paper. Fry in about 1 inch hot oil in deep fryer to brown on both sides. Remove from oil and drain on paper towels. Sprinkle with mayonnaise before serving.

title: Easy Chocolate Spanish Vinegar
ingredients: 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa powder
instructions: Place ingredients in a blender jar and blend until creamy. Chill in refrigerator for 30 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: green chili pepper,bacon dripping,lime wedge,portabella mushroom
title: Portabella and Mushrooms in Green Chili Gravy
ingredients: 2 tablespoons bacon drippings | 2 large portabella mushrooms, sliced | 4 limes, wedges | 4 mild green chili peppers, sliced ( or your favorite chile )
instructions: Heat bacon drippings in a skillet over high heat.

title: Vermicelli With Key Lime and Key Lime
ingredients: 3 tablespoons unflavored gelatin ( made with 2 1/2 cups ) | 3/4 cup vegetable stock | 1/2 cup key lime juice | 4 slices ripe vermicelli
instructions: Heat the gelatin and vegetable stock in a small saucepan over medium heat until hot, about 4 minutes. Pour 1/2 cup hot gelatin mixture over vermicelli in a serving dish. Gently stir the lime juice and remaining hot gelatin mixture into the warm gelatin mixture. Chill 3 to 5 minutes and serve with vermicelli.

Random Ingredients: lettuce,sea salt black pepper,provolone cheese,green food coloring,bread,onion white
title: Homemade Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 tablespoons finely chopped onion white | 1 tablespoon finely chopped green food coloring | 1 1/2 tablespoons sea salt or 1 1/2 tablespoons kosher salt | 1 loaf unsliced soft bread | 2 cups shredded lettuce | 2 -3 tablespoons shredded provolone cheese or 2 -3 tablespoons monterey jack cheese
instructions: Mix onion, food coloring, and salt in a small bowl. Cut bread into 6 pieces and spread with mixture. Place on a baking sheet and bake at 400 degrees f. For 15 minutes or until tops are lightly browned. Spread lettuce, cheese, and onion mixture on tops of bread.

Random Ingredients: celery,red onion,yoghurt,egg white,apple juice,thyme sprig,liquid honey
title: Apple Yogurt Parfaits
ingredients: 6 ounces yoghurt, plain | 3 tablespoons apple juice | 2 tablespoons liquid honey | salt or natural salt | 1 egg white, unbeaten | 3/4 red onion, sliced | 1 fresh apple, peeled, cored, and chopped with juice | fresh thyme sprig ( optional )
instructions: Place yoghurt, apple juice, honey, and salt in a strainer over a bowl and place to one side under running water for 1 minute. Remove the bowl, squeezing liquid into yoghurt and adding egg white, whisk to combine. Gently fold yoghurt mixture into egg white, cover and refrigerate for at least an hour or overnight. Before serving, line a baking sheet with parchment paper and preheat oven to 200 degrees celsius. Put yoghurt in a bowl and stir in remaining marinade. Add a dash of honey just before serving and garnish with a fresh thyme sprig if using.

title: Mushroom, Apple, and Wine Applesauce
ingredients: 1 apple, unpeeled, cored, quartered, and thinly sliced | 1/4 cup chopped mushrooms
instructions: Place apple and mushrooms inside of a microwave safe bowl. Microwave on high power for 4 to 6 minutes, stirring once, until apple softens and begins to brown, 3 to 5 minutes.

title: Italian Asparagus with Sun-Dried Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 lb asparagus | 1/2 cup vodka | 1/3 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped fresh mint leaves
instructions: Boil asparagus 4 minutes or until barely tender. Toss with oil and add sun dried tomatoes. To save the time, let the pasta drain for 20 minutes before serving.

title: The Best Steak Ever!
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef sirloin steaks | 1/2 cup vegetable broth | 1 teaspoon garlic, minced | 1/4 cup honey ( can also add more if desired ) | 1/2 cup shredded cheese ( optional )
instructions: Trim all visible fat from steak. Cut steak into cubes. Combine broth, garlic and honey. Boil until mixture is reduced to 1 cup. Stir well. Pour over steak. Mix well. Cover and refrigerate for 3 hours. When ready to serve, remove steak from refrigerator, reserving marinade. Grill steak on high heat 4 - 5 minutes per side or until desired doneness is reached.

title: Beef Goulash
ingredients: 2 lbs beef, cut in slices across grain ( top shin beef ) | 1 can tomato paste
instructions: Brown meat in a skillet and place in a casserole dish that has lid. Heat tomato paste. Pour over meat. Cover and bake in a 325 degree f. Oven for 4 hours. Serve over noodles.

title: Mexican Style Lobster
ingredients: 4 lobsters | 2 cups shredded monterey jack pepper cheese | 1 tablespoon coffee granules
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Rinse lobsters under cold water, and crack them into 1 1/2 inch lengths onto baking sheets. Sprinkle each lobster with cheese twice, and sprinkle the top with the coffee granules. Bake in preheated oven until bubbly and beginning to brown, about 8 minutes. Serve with crackers.

Random Ingredients: wonton wrapper,plain yogurt,egg beater substitute,coriander leaf
title: Vegan Cheezy Wonton Pillows
ingredients: 2 tablespoons plain low-fat yogurt | 1 tablespoon egg beaters egg substitute ( or egg substitute equivalent ) | 1 teaspoon coriander leaves | 50 wonton wrappers
instructions: In a small bowl, combine yogurt, egg beaters/egg substitute, chopped coriander. Pinch of about 5 cm from the edge of wonton wrappers on each wonton wrapper. Brush the edges with some egg wash, brush with more egg wash. Place two heaped teaspoonfuls of the filling at a time onto the won ton wrapper. Press down to compact. Repeat until all filling is used. Cut into 2 triangles. Can be frozen at this stage or frozen for up to a month. To reheat, run a thin knife around the edges of the wontons to make a crisscross pattern. To freeze, transfer wontons to a zip lock bag and store in freezer bags for 5 minutes, or to flash freeze for up to 1 hour. When ready to serve, heat the oven to 425 degrees. Transfer wontons from freezer to a baking sheet. Bake on the middle shelf for 4 mins or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: apple juice,clove,glace cherry,broccoli floret,orange juice,blue cheese,curd cottage cheese
title: Burgers With Grated Blue Cheese
ingredients: 1 jar broccoli florets, drained | 1/3 cup apple juice | 2 tablespoons curd cottage cheese | 1 orange, juice and rind of, grated | 1/8 teaspoon ground cloves | 1 tablespoon orange juice | 1/4 lb blue cheese, crumbled
instructions: Drain greens and place in saucepan with apple juice and enough water to barely cover. Cover, bring to boil and cook 2 minutes. Drain. Mix the curd cottage cheese, juice and orange rind, cloves and orange juice in small bowl. Make 4 - 6 patties out of the greens and pat them completely dry with paper towels. Spread 1 tablespoon of the cheese mixture on each patty. Place on baking sheet. Broil 4 to 5 inches from heat until golden on each side, about 3 minutes in all. Top with chopped parsley.

Random Ingredients: pepperoni,corn tortilla,cocoa powder,buttermilk,pine nut,anaheim chili,pecorino romano cheese
title: Pesto Lasagna #5FIX
ingredients: 8 corn tortillas | 1/3 cup pecorino romano cheese | 1/2 cup pecorino romano cheese | 12 ounces pepperoni | 6 ounces pine nuts | 2 cans baby bella chili | 1 cup buttermilk | 1 can cotney-dipped peppercorn oats
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees. Lightly spray a 9x13 pan with cooking spray. In a food processor, finely chop the pepperoni, pine nuts, chili, 1 cup of the cheese and 1/2 cup of the pecorino. Reserve. Spread out tortilla in the pan, making each tortilla thinner than and not square. Scatter 3/4 cup cheese mixture evenly over tortillas in pan. Top with remaining tortillas, pepperoni mixture and remaining cheddar cheese. Bake 20 - 25 minutes or until cheese is bubbly and lightly browned. Remove from oven and allow to cool slightly. Cut into squares and drizzle with remaining 1/2 cup of the cheese. Serve.

Random Ingredients: chive,irish cream,chinese vegetable,accent seasoning,vermicelli,spinach,pomegranate syrup,maraschino cherry
title: Sweet and Sour Noodle Salad
ingredients: 225 g vermicelli, broken into 3cm florets | 2 liters of mixed chinese vegetables | 400 g spinach, thawed | 50 g chives | 1/4 cup pomegranate syrup ( if available ) | 20 ounces irish cream ( or 1/2 cup light cream of apple liqueur ) | asparagus, salad ( mixed vegetables ) | asphino cherry, sliced
instructions: Boil vermicelli according to direction on package. Meanwhile, cut up vegetables. Combine chopped vegetables and chopped pasta in large salad bowl. Fold in cream of apple liqueur. Serve immediately with chopped asparagus or mixed salad leaves.

Random Ingredients: pepper,olive oil,chicken bouillon granule,ranch salad dressing,rosemary leaf,beef roast,hard egg
title: Mom's Beef Burgers
ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon granules | 1/2 teaspoon dried rosemary leaves | 12 thin slices cooked beef roast ( see note ) | 4 hard-boiled eggs ( optional ) | 1 jar ranch salad dressing ( or mix salad dressing with meat )
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Whisk together the bouillon granules and rosemary.

Random Ingredients: broad bean,tomato juice,coconut milk,orange lentil,pepperoni,black pepper,radish
title: Hot and Hearty Tomato and Lentil Soup
ingredients: 12 ounces red lentils, drained | 1 orange lentil | 1 lb broad bean | 3 3/4 cups reduced-fat coconut milk | 1 cup chopped radish | 1 teaspoon black pepper | 1/2 cup chopped pepperoni
instructions: Rinse and sort lentils. Place lentils in pressure cooker and water to cover. Drain beans and broad bean, reserving liquid, and rinse broad beans. Combine beans and broad beans in large soup pot over low heat. Cover, turn down heat slightly, and let stand 2 hours. In pressure cooker, cook broad beans and broad beans until thickened, stirring frequently. Add reserved tomato liquid and pepperoni.

Random Ingredients: plain flour,anise seed,pizza dough,cinnamon sugar,mexican cheese,garlic salt,guacamole,scallion
title: Mexican Style Pizza
ingredients: 1 cup sour cream, divided ( low fat is okay ) | 1 teaspoon instant minced garlic salt | 1/4 cup mexican cheese, finely grated | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning mix ( i used guacamole ) | 1 teaspoon anise seeds or 1 teaspoon caraway, lightly crushed | 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon sugar | 8 -12 pre-baked pizza dough, thawed | 4 scallions, white parts only, sliced thin
instructions: In medium bowl, stir 1 cup of the sour cream with the garlic salt. Set aside. In medium bowl, stir together the remaining sour cream, cheese, taco seasoning mix, chili powder, anise seeds and cinnamon sugar. Stir the ground spices into the cheese mixture until well combined. Stir in the remaining 1/2 cup sour cream and the chopped white parts from the scallions. On a lightly floured surface sprinkled with remaining 1/2 cup sour cream, roll out the dough to about 1/4 inch thick. Cut into 3 inch squares. Arrange the scallions in a circle of about 1/4 inch apart over the dough. Top with reserved guacamole and pinch to seal. Place on a lightly greased pizza tray and top with remaining scallions. Bake in a 425 degree f oven for 12 to 15 minutes, or until crust is lightly browned and the filling is heated through. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: molasses,worcestershire sauce,grape,lemongrass,cream chicken soup,salad oil,taco seasoning
title: Crock Pot Cantonese Wet Sticks
ingredients: 1 cup sour cream | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup, undiluted | 2 tablespoons salad oil | 4 tablespoons molasses | 2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning | 1 tablespoon chopped green lemongrass, fresh ( optional )
instructions: In a medium bowl combine sour cream, cream of chicken soup, oil, molasses, worcestershire sauce, taco seasoning, and green chiles. Spread mixture in an oblong pan or similar size dish. Cover the sauce and refrigerate overnight, turning 1 hour later. Remove the lemon grass before serving.

title: Spicy Lime Oil (Zwt3)
ingredients: 3 -4 limes, zest of | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Using a vegetable peeler, carefully remove the zest from the zest by cutting a piece into about 1 inch long slivers. The zest should be removed easily if you don't have peeler. Place the zest in a small bowl and add 1/8 cup of olive oil and mix well. Pour the olive oil into a shallow metal pan. Using a very sharp knife, make a long diagable cut through the zest, being careful not only to cut through the slivers but also through the slivers. Pour the oil mixture into the pan and leave to sit for 30 minutes to allow the fat to run. The olive oil should be very hot. Pour over grilled or broiled vegetable wedges. Dollop up with chips and serve immediately. Store in an air tight container away from direct sunlight for up to about 6 weeks when using. Note, when buying a zippy zesty oil you may want to check the taste and add some salt. It is important that the zest is freshly grated and the olive oil is aged. If you would like to use a zesty oil, add 1 to 2 tablespoons of olive oil and 1/4 cup of grated fresh parmesan. Follow recommendations on your zwt 3 and 2 to make zesty zesty oil.

Random Ingredients: okra,red chili powder,hot chili pepper,buttermilk,steak sauce,cherry tomato
title: Spicy and Spicy Okra (Dunked Beef)
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin steak, cut in 1-inch dice | 1 package frozen okra | 2 cherry tomatoes, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup hot chili pepper, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons buttermilk or 2 tablespoons sour cream | 2 teaspoons red chili powder
instructions: Combine okra, tomatoes, chile and buttermilk in a zip lock bag. Toss to coat with. Shake to coat well and refrigerate. Drain beef well. Grill under broiler for 5 mins and then turn and grill for 10 minutes more. Serve immediately over white rice with wedges of yogurt and mango salsa.

title: Spicy Tomato & Pine Nut Pesto
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tomato juice | 1 fresh red chili pepper, seeded and finely sliced ( the seeds, ribs and ribs from a mild red pepper can also be used ) | 1/2 cup toasted pine nuts
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender with 1/2 cup of boiling water and process until smooth. Add to any pasta you prefer.

title: Eggplant and Marmalade
ingredients: 2 large eggplants | 4 ounces orange marmalade ( can vary ) | 4 ounces orange marmalade
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Cut the top off the eggplant, and carefully scoop out the flesh so that the skin is easy to peel. Cut the flesh into medium sized chunks and place them in an ovenproof dish. Bake for about 45 minutes, or until the flesh is golden on top or, for a shorter cooking time, cover with foil and cook for 25 - 30 minutes. Remove the foil, increase temperature to 400f and return the eggplant to oven. Stir the marmalade into the juices and pour over the eggplant.. Bake for 25 minutes, or until heated through, then serve, or refrigerate for a further 3 hours for a thicker flavour.

title: Balsamic-Glazed Herbs (Churrasco)
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh churrasco watercress leaf, stems and leaves picked | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar
instructions: Wash the churrasco well in a colander under cold running water, shaking it as it leaves the water spatter. Transfer to a small mixing bowl and add the vinegar, stir well until the herbs are well coated with vinegar. Cover and let stand at room temperature for 1 hour before serving.

title: Tomato Gravy in a Snap
ingredients: 1 can condensed tomato soup | 2 tablespoons white vinegar | 1 tablespoon thai fish sauce

title: Pista _ Persian Cheese Bread (Kabachi)
ingredients: 4 -5 cups corn chips | 1 1/4 cups saffron
instructions: First, you need to purchase a wooden or glass bowl for making the bread. I do this using a durkee lady that we had in our household. If you would you have used a regular wooden bowl, soak the bread in water while making the bread, just until the water is absorbed so as to not allow it to soften and burn. This is optional. You may also have to replace the water you had soaked in with water 1/4 cup at a time with the saffron. Soak the chips in the bowl for 2 - 5 hours. After the 2 - 5 hours, drain the soaked chips, let them cool in the water for 5 minutes. Dry the chips dry on kitchen towels. Pour 1/4 cup of saffron into a pan. Heat this over a medium heat until it begins to foam, then lower the heat. Pour the saffron into your bread bowl and sprinkle some of the cheese at the bottom, then layer the cheesy chips on top of the cheese. You may have to work in small batches with the saffron, until the bread becomes saturated with the saffron and cheese, but you must work fast and quickly. Repeat this process until the entire bread is coated with the saffron. When it is done, you may arrange the bread on a cookie sheet and place it in the freezer once more overnight. You can serve the bread immediately. The cheese is done when it is very hard to detect with a sharp knife. I always use a fork and the crumbs that come out of the bread, which is very hard and has little or no binding attachment, but it does not change the taste at all. This could eat at it's finaly finaly finaly finaly stage when you pull the tray out of the freezer. If you don't have a bread maker, you may use butter, margarine, or canola oil. Another option if you like is to add 2 tbsp powdered sugar, 1 tsp ground cinnamon, 1 tsp ground cardamom powder, 1/2 tsp ground nutmeg, 1/3 tsp ground rosemary, 1/4 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/4 tsp ground ginger, 1/4 tsp rosemary powder, 1/4 tsp ground cloves, 1/4 tsp ground cloves. I use an electric knife to blend everything, except the saffron, in a food processor. After blending, transfer the mixture to your bread bowl, spreading it out evenly. Sprinkle some of the saffron on top of the bread, then add another layer of cheese on top of the cheese. Top with another layer of cheese. This is your bread bowl, so if there are any bread crusts still on top, that's okay. Spread saffron mixture evenly across bread and place the tray in the freezer, until the cheese has hardened. This will take between 2 days or longer. After several hours or longer, you will need to thaw the bread and the cheese. When you are ready to eat, remove the tray from the freezer and place in your refrigerator. Scoop out bread pieces and place in a storage bag, and keep in the freezer. To serve, cut into fingers. This recipe can be made ahead, and frozen in small portions just make sure the bread is soft before serving.
