title: Chinese-Style Pork Rib Chops and Waffles
ingredients:
2 lean pork rib racks | 6 ounces boneless skinless chicken breast halves, cooked and sliced about 1/4 inch thick ( can use more ) | 1/2 cup quinoa, rinsed | 1 large egg yolk | 1 tablespoon whipping cream | 1/4 teaspoon five-spice powder | pancake or rice crackers or salad leaves ( ritz-bake, etc.
    - )
instructions: For rib chops, heat a grill pan over medium high heat. Trim the excess fat from the ribs and discard, but reserve 1/4 cup of the ribs. Slice the ribs into about 1/8 inch wide rib slices. Place chicken slices on a plate, and spread with a thin coating of cooking spray or fat free cooking spray. Let stand while making the waffles. For the chops, in a medium bowl, whisk together the egg yolk and cream. Stir in the remaining ribs and any accumulated juices. Combine the rib cutlets with the quinoa. Divide into 4 portions and make a well in the center of the mixtured quinoa mixture. Pour in enough of the cooking liquid to moisten the mound evenly. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes or until needed. For waffles, preheat a belgium waffle iron according to manufacturer's instructions. Place the first three plates on the hot platter while the second waffle iron warms up. Brush the top plates with some of the egg wash before the waffle iron cooks.

Random Ingredients: thyme,cooking oil,beef mince,cauliflower floret,sesame seed,grand marnier,cumin powder,buttermilk
title: Sesame Cauliflower
ingredients: 500 g beef mince | 2 cups cauliflower florets | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 teaspoon sesame seeds | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 1 tablespoon grand marnier | 1/2 cup buttermilk
instructions: In a bowl mix the spices and leave aside. In a non stick pan heat the oil and fry the mince. When brown add the mince mix along with the rest of the mix along with the buttermilk and stir well so that the garlic is stirred through. Add the cauliflower and stir until soft then serve.

Random Ingredients: spanish onion,cake flour,yellow bell pepper,sage leaf,currant,baby corn
title: Corn and Yellow Bulghar
ingredients: 1 medium spanish onion, halved and sliced | 4 yellow bell peppers, seeded and sliced | 1 1/2 cups seedless baby corn, kernels cut from cob ( or other small green, red and yellow bell peppers ) | 1 1/2 cups currants, coarsely chopped ( or raisins ) | 1 1/4 cups cake flour ( i use one cake flour and a half in all ) | 1 teaspoon sage leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place onions in a mixing bowl. Add chopped peppers. Sprinkle 1/2 cup of the currants over the vegetables and stir to coat. Let stand for 15 to 20 minutes. Sift the remaining 1/4 cup flour, 1 teaspoon sage, and 1/2 teaspoon pepper over the vegetables. Fold in the remaining tablespoon flour. Spread the mixture evenly on a greased baking sheet. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, until very tender and slightly browned. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Flemish Beef With Leek
ingredients: 8 ounces beef steaks | 12 ounces leeks
instructions: Heat the oven to 350°f. Place beef steaks on greased oven trays, with one side for the oven, and the other for the oven. Bake for about 30 - 45 minutes or until cooked and tender. Meanwhile, slice off the root ends of the leeks and wash in boiling water to remove any sand which will have lodged in the layers. Cut into 2 - 3 inch lengths. Heat the leeks in a saucepan of boiling water for 3 minutes or until just tender. Place the pan on top of the beef and leave for a few minutes to warm slightly. Divide the leeks over the top of the beef and serve with the leeks.

title: Creamy Flank Steak
ingredients: 6 ounces flank steaks | 1 cup heavy cream | 1 tablespoon splenda sugar substitute | 1 large orange, cut in half ( for juice )
instructions: Trim fat from steak and discard, reserving any fat. Trim fat from steak and cut into 6 equal portions and then cut each into 6 pieces. Place each piece on a plate and cover with heavy cream. Sprinkle with splenda and add a piece of meat so that the meat is completely covered. Slice the orange in half and squeeze juice over meat.

title: Sour Cream Scones
ingredients: 2 cups cake flour | 3/4 cup sour cream or 3/4 cup whipping cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Line a sheet tray with parchment paper for use later on. Combine all ingredients in a bowl. If the mixture is very thick, add additional soured cream. Roll dough out to 1/8 thick and cut into 2 pieces. Using a 3'' round biscuit cutter scoop out dough and re roll and cut the pieces again on a well floured board. Using a 3'' round biscuit scoop the dough and re roll and cut the dough using the same manner. Place scones on prepared baking sheet. Bake on middle rack of oven for 12 - 15 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: sherry wine vinegar,sun tomato,yellow cake mix,chipotle chile adobo,extra virgin olive oil,bean,zucchini,white sugar
title: Veggie Fajitas
ingredients: 1 package yellow cake mix | 3/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato, chopped | 1/2 cup fresh zucchini, cut into matchsticks | 1/4 cup red bell pepper, thinly sliced | 2 chipotle chiles in adobo, minced ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar | 3 tablespoons white sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Oil an 8x8 inch baking dish. Slice the cake mix into 24 pieces, and spray with olive oil. Arrange cake slices on the pan. Sprinkle sun dried tomatoes, zucchini, red bell pepper, chile pepper, chipotle sauce, vinegar, and sugar over the cake. Bake in the preheated oven until the vegetables are golden, about 30 minutes. Let cool.

Random Ingredients: bamboo shoot,boston lettuce,navy bean,sesame seed,italian seasoning
title: Bean and Beef Salad
ingredients: 1 jar white navy beans, drained | 2 ounces thin slices fresh bamboo shoots, drained | 2 teaspoons seasame seeds | 1 package fresh boston lettuce | 1 teaspoon dried italian seasoning, or to taste
instructions: Place navy beans, bamboo shoots, and seasame seeds in a salad bowl. Toss with lettuce leaves until coated with oil and evenly coated. Add italian seasoning and toss to coat. Serve on salad plates.

Random Ingredients: dijon mustard,green pepper,beef broth,kiwi fruit,red wine,arborio rice,beef stock
title: Australian Kiwi-Kiwi Risotto
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh kiwi fruit | 1 cup beef stock | 1 cup beef stock | 3/4 cup red wine | 1/2 teaspoon dijon mustard | 2 cups arborio rice | 1 tablespoon green pepper ( diced )
instructions: Cut kiwifruit into 2 inch pieces. Put all ingredients into a blender with 1/4 cup stock and blend till smooth. Toss with remaining stock and garnish with kiwifruit.

title: Zucchini and Turkey Salad
ingredients: 2 large zucchini, quartered lengthwise and cut into 2-inch chunks | 1 can asparagus spears, drained | 2 tablespoons salad oil | 1 package cooked turkey meat, sliced
instructions: Toss zucchini and asparagus with salad oil in large bowl. Heat in microwave for 2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chinese cabbage,mint jelly,kaffir lime leaf,spinach leaf,sausage,grain white rice,blood orange juice,oyster sauce
title: Sausage & Spinach With Rice
ingredients: 2 sausages, sliced super thin | 4 large raw spinach leaves | 4 blood oranges, juice of | 6 kaffir lime leaves | 3 -4 kaffir lime leaves, torn | 1 tablespoon chinese cabbage, shredded | 400 g rice-a-roni noodles ( uncooked noodles ) | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 2 tablespoons long-grain white rice, steamed
instructions: Cut sausage into 1inch pieces, place onto a microwave safe plate with a little more than an inch on top. Cook on high for 1 minute, stirring, until lightly browned. Using a slotted spoon transfer the sausages to a bowl and set as a side. Discard any excess juices from the sausages, then put back into the microwave and heat for another minute or so until slightly softened. Place spinach, oranges, kaffir lime leaves and lime leaves in a large microwave safe bowl with enough cold water to just cover. Place on high for a couple of minutes, then cover, and microwave on high for 5 minutes, or until just tender and just starting to wilt. Remove the sausage from the bowl and stir through the rice a ronzoni, stir through the lime leaves, and divide between 4 bowls. Just before serving stir through the oyster sauce and divide evenly between the four bowls. Serve with remaining oyster sauce.

title: Easy Slow Cooker Beef Au Jus Gravy (French Style Pot Roast)
ingredients: 4 lbs boneless bottom round roast | 1 1/2 cups dry wine ( i use port du saland ) | 1 teaspoon crushed coriander | 1/4 teaspoon celery salt | 1/8 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/8 teaspoon cork fat or 1/8 teaspoon lard
instructions: Remove fat from roast, season lightly with salt, cinnamon and cork or lard. Place roast in crock pot and pour wine over roast. Cover and cook on low overnight. The first 5 hours before serving time, remove roast and skim fat. The next morning, slice or shred roast and serve over cooked buttered noodles or with mashed potatoes.

Random Ingredients: rice wine,matzo meal,cranberry,yellow squash,sugar,mostaccioli pasta,beef stock,button mushroom
title: Wild Beef Stroganoff
ingredients: 1/2 lb lean sirloin steak, cut into 1/4-inch slices | 1 cup coarsely coarsely chopped yellow squash | 1 cup coarsely chopped zucchini or 1 cup zucchini, cut diagonally in 1 1/2-inch slices | 1 cup coarsely chopped raw button mushroom | 1/3 cup beef stock | 2 tablespoons rice wine | 1 cup quick and easy matzo meal | 3/4 cup dried sweetened cranberries, soaked or 1/2 cup frozen chopped pecans | 1/4 cup sugar ( to taste )
instructions: In a medium sized heavy pan or a nonstick skillet, brown the steak in batches on both sides over medium heat for about 5 minutes. Remove the steak to a plate and set aside. Pour off most of the fat from the pan, return the pan to the stove and saute the squash, zucchini or mushrooms a few minutes or until tender crisp, turning once. Return the steak to the pan, add the beef stock, rice wine, matzos meal and cranberries. Cover and simmer until thickened, about 20 minutes. Stir in the sugar.

Random Ingredients: vegetable broth,cannellini bean,saffron,nonstick cooking spray,chick pea,milk chocolate
title: Chickpea Mole
ingredients: nonstick cooking spray | 2 boxes campbell's canned low sodium chick-peas, rinsed and drained | 1/2 cup skim milk chocolate | 1 can cannellini beans, rinsed and drained | 1/2 teaspoon saffron ( optional ) | 1 1/2 cups vegetable broth, low sodium
instructions: Coat a nonstick skilled with cooking spray.

Random Ingredients: plain yogurt,bulk italian sausage,grape tomato,rye bread
title: Tunisian Sausage Appetizers
ingredients: 2 cans refrigerated low-fat plain yogurt | 1 pound bulk italian sausage | 4 grape tomatoes, halved | 8 slices rye bread, toasted
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Mix the cream cheese with the plain yogurt in a bowl to form a smooth paste. Set aside. Place the sausage in a skillet over medium heat. Cook and stir the sausage until it has browned, about 5 minutes. Pour the yogurt cream cheese mixture into a 9x13 inch baking dish. Place the toasted rye bread slices into an even layer, or line them with a single layer of toasted rye bread to make triangles. Drain excess yogurt cream cheese mixture, and spread the cream cheese mixture over the rye bread. Sprinkle the top with grape tomatoes, and continue layering the bread triangles with the grape tomatoes, leaving about 1 inch between each bread layer. Bake in the preheated oven until the bread is crisp and golden brown, about 16 minutes.

title: Tomato, Sugar Snap Pea and Kale Salad
ingredients: 2 cups chopped fresh plum tomatoes | 2 cups sugar snap peas | 3 cups kale, torn into bite-size pieces | 1/2 cup thinly sliced mozzarella cheese | 1/4 cup minced fresh parsley or 1 1/2 teaspoons dried parsley flakes | pepper
instructions: Mix together remaining ingredients in a large bowl. Add dressing and toss to coat. Season with pepper.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder,beef steak,red cabbage,kosher salt,maple syrup
title: Glazed Maple Mustard Pork
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups kosher salt | 2 lbs pork shoulder | 2 large heads red cabbage | 1 cup light maple syrup | 1 container smoked beef steak ( such as smokey )
instructions: Combine salt and pork in a large plastic bag, turning to coat evenly. Let stand 15 minutes. Peel off and discard outer layers. Remove as much excess salt as possible. Place in a large pot, cover with water. Bring to boil over high heat.

title: Easy Slow-Cooked Shredded Pot Roast
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs boneless beef chuck roast | chili pepper flakes ( optional )
instructions: Trim any excess fat from the beef. Place roast in crockpot. Sprinkle with a few flakes of chili powder and drizzle with a few drops of olive oil and/or another tablespoon of olive oil. Cover crockpot and cook on low for at least 3 - 4 hours, until meat easily shreds. Shred using two forks, using two forks if at any time. Serve over cooked noodles or rice. Garnish with fresh parsley, red onion and/or a fresh green salad.

title: Smoked Salmon Cheesecake
ingredients: 200 g cream cheese, softened | 300 ml light sour cream or 300 ml light sour cream | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 500 g smoked salmon
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Line a 28cm pie tin with baking paper. Put cream cheese, sour cream, cream of tartar and vanilla essence into a mixing bowl. Beat together using an electric whisk until creamy. Fold in salmon into cheese mixture. Pour the mix into the lined pie tin. Bake for 10 minutes. Cool on a wire rack. When cold, gently cut the cake into 12 squares.

title: Curried Sour Cream Soup
ingredients: 100 ml maple syrup | 100 g white bread | 2 cups chicken broth | 2 tablespoons curry paste | 300 ml wine
instructions: Soak the bread in water. Cut the bread into small pieces. Add the broth, bread and curry paste. Bring to boil, stirring continuously. Simmer for about 5 minutes. Pour into blender, add the rest of the ingredients and blend in blender until smooth. Serve.

title: Easy Spanish Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons minced chives | 1/4 cup chicken bouillon | 1/4 cup sherry wine | 3/4 cup sweet chili sauce
instructions: Place the chives in a small bowl. Place bouillon in a medium size saucepan or skillet. Add the 1/4 cup sherry and heat over medium heat, just until fragrant. Add the sweet chili sauce. Add the chives and stir to coat. Pour mixture into a small bowl or serving dish. Serve warm. Variations. Add onions and mushrooms with the sauce. Sliced green bell pepper may be added if desired.

Random Ingredients: porcini mushroom,taco cheese,wheat germ,picante sauce,pea,green olive
title: Sizzlin' Mexican Potatoes
ingredients: 1 cup peas ( fresh or frozen, thawed ) | 1/2 cup green olives ( sliced, not sliced canned ) | 1/2 cup sliced stuffed green olives ( i've used black and/or green combination ) | 1 jar salsa ( i like la victoria flavored brand, and price seas ) | 16 ounces taco cheese ( i use mild-jack style ) | 1/4 cup dried porcini mushrooms ( optional, i've only used dried )
instructions: Heat potatoes on grill. Spray lightly with nonstick spray. Spread peas over bottom of 1 c. Package. Layer mushrooms, olives, and cheese over the top. Add jar of salsa, if using. Cook on grill 5 minutes or until cheese is melted. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,bratwurst,rigatoni pasta,jack daniel whiskey,sun tomato oil,spinach,espresso powder,potato
title: Jack Daniel's Hot Chocolate
ingredients: 3 sweet potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks | 3 tablespoons vegetable oil | 11 ounces rigatoni pasta, uncooked | 1/2 teaspoon espresso powder | 12 ounces jack daniels whiskey | 1 pound bratwurst | 8 spinach, cleaned
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to rolling boil. Add sweet potatoes and cook until tender but firm, about 15 minutes. Drain, pat dry and set aside. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a skillet over medium heat. Cook bratwurst in hot oil until browned, about 5 minutes. Drain off excess oil. Place sweet potatoes, one at a time, into a skillet and cook for 5 minutes. Stir in spinach and cook until wilted, about 2 minutes. Spoon pasta into a 9x13 inch baking dish. Top with sweet potato mixture and drizzle espresso powder over top. Bake in preheated oven until bubbling, about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: soup,green chili pepper,pea,american cheese,walnut,anaheim chilies,cooking oil
title: Green Chile Pepper and Cheese Soup With Walnuts
ingredients:
3 anaheim chilies, chopped | 1 can chopped green chili peppers | 1 1/2 lbs chouray or 1 1/2 lbs other hot green chiles, whole ( 1.
    -5-1.
    -25 lbs.
    - ) | 1/2 cup oil, cooking for sautee | 1 cup frozen peas or 1 cup fresh peas, thawed | 12 ounces american cheese, sliced ( preferably the swiss kind ) | 3 tablespoons chopped walnuts, toasted
instructions: Blend chilies and peppers in blender until smooth. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add chile mixture and sauté, stirring frequently, 5 minutes. Add peas, cheese and walnuts and cook, stirring constantly, 10 minutes until cheese melts and mixture is heated through.

title: Pasta Chips- Mexican Spice Mix
ingredients: 4 1/2 - 5 lbs whole ( red ) pasta, uncooked | 1/4 cup lime juice | 1 tablespoon anise extract ( mexican blend ) | 1/4 cup nuts, coarsely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Bring 2 quarts of water to boil. Add pasta and cook until al dente. Heat oil in a skillet large enough to accommodate both macadamia nuts and spices. Add the lime juice and anise extract and cook for 1 minute. Drain pasta and add to skillet. Serve cold with a dash of lime juice.

title: Kisir Kebab
ingredients: 6 cups plain yogurt ( yogurt ) | 2 cups spaghetti sauce | 1 teaspoon instant liquid smoke
instructions: Mix up ingredients and marinate for an hour or two. Cook with salt and oil to taste.

title: Cornflake Almond Mix
ingredients: 2 cups corn flakes ( about 10 12 ) | 2 tablespoons slivered almonds
instructions: Toast almonds on baking sheets in 400º oven until browned. Cool to room temperature. Break coarsely. Add toasted almonds into a large resealable plastic bag. Shake to combine. Press the mixture into a greased 16x16x2 inch baking sheet. Sprinkle with almonds. Bake at 350°f 5 to 7 minutes or until a toothpick inserted comes out clean. Cool completely. Break open with a serrated knife, remove and discard the center of the cornflake. Store in an airtight container at room temperature or store at room temperature in a zip lock bag..

Random Ingredients: avocado,chili powder,italian turkey sausage,head lettuce,juniper berry,paprika
title: Lettuce Wraps II
ingredients: 1 italian turkey sausage | 2 heads lettuce - rinsed, dried and torn into bite size pieces | 2 avocados - peeled, pitted and sliced | 2 slices pickled jamon berry rounds ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 1 tablespoon paprika | 1 tablespoon crushed juniper berries ( optional )
instructions: Prick sausage with a fork and sprinkle with a little salt. Boil for 20 minutes, drain and cool. Remove casings from sausage and slice crosswise. Cut lettuce lengthwise, and place in a large serving bowl with sausage, avocados and jamon berry rounds. For the sauce, mix chili powder, paprika, and juniper in small bowl.

title: Snow Pea Snack with Lima Beans
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried lima beans | 1 pound snow peas, trimmed and cut into 2 inch pieces | 3 tablespoons frozen shaved snow pea | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh tea
instructions: Place lima beans in a large bowl. Add snow peas, peas, and tea. Cover, and let sit about 5 minutes. Serve.

title: Mussels in Anchovy Sauce
ingredients: 4 lbs mussels, cleaned and debearded | 2 cups beef broth ( or more ) | 6 anchovy paste
instructions: Place mussels in a pot with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, then cook until they open, about 20 minutes. Remove from heat and place in cold water for a few minuets. Save 1 cup of the cooking water and drain the mussels in a colander. Place the mussels into a serving platter. Pour beef broth or water over them and add anchovy paste. Reheat mussels just before serving.

Random Ingredients: caraway seed,seasoning salt,lime juice,picante sauce,broccoli floret,orecchiette,tomato
title: Mexican Orecchiette
ingredients: 1 package orecchiette | 3 cups fresh broccoli florets, cut into bite-size pieces | 1/2 cup picante sauce | 1 tomatoes, chopped | 2 tablespoons lime juice | 2 teaspoons caraway seeds | seasoning salt
instructions: Bring large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until pasta is al dente.

title: Naked Farfalle With Cashews
ingredients: 12 ounces farfalle pasta | 2 cups coarsely chopped unsalted cashews | 8 fresh thyme sprigs | 12 corn tortilla chips
instructions: Cook pasta in medium pot of boiling, salted water until firm. Drain, reserving 3/4 cup cooking liquid. Transfer pasta to bowl of a food processor fitted with metal chopping blade and process until mixture resembles coarse meal. In a large bowl with a lid and 2 tablespoons of reserved cooking liquid, toss cashews, and thyme until mixed well. Season to taste with salt. Spread out a thin layer of pasta on a plate. Sprinkle with about 3/4 cup bean sprout mixture, about 3 ounces each. Repeat process with remaining pasta, bean sprouts, and remaining bean sprouts. Arrange 1 tortilla chips in a circle on a plate, cover with another tortilla, and top with remaining bean sprouts. Gently press and stretch tortilla chips into casserole.

title: French Fontina Cheese Spread
ingredients: 500 g fontina ( may omit ) | 2 cans consomme
instructions: In a large bowl combine all the ingredients and stir until well blended. Cover and refrigerate until needed. Makes approximately 2 pints.

title: Turnip-Piquillo Appetizer
ingredients: 2 small turnips, peeled and cut into wedges | 1 piquillo pepper, cracked ( optional )
instructions: Use a sharp knife to slice the turnip wedges in half, right up to the stalk end. Place the turnips onto a rimmed baking sheet. Using a sharp knife, poke slices 3 to 4 inches from each other to allow skin and stem sections to remain intact. If using piquillo pepper, slice into 1/2 inch long wedges. Place the turnips onto the pepper, if using. Cover with plastic wrap, crimping the edges to seal. Let stand at room temperature for 1 hour, stirring every 30 minutes to ensure even browning. If using the piquillo pepper, toast it over the grill until it turns golden brown, about 10 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Fried Sun-Dried Tomato Fritters
ingredients: 225 g sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil or 225 g sun-dried tomatoes | 2 tablespoons plain flour
instructions: Heat the oil in a small saucepan and fry the sun dried tomatoes until lightly coloured and softened, about 3 minutes. Sprinkle the flour over the tomatoes and stir until combined. Spoon the mixture onto paper lined trays and spread evenly with a knife. Press the fritters gently to flatten slightly. Cook in batches over hot oil for 1 - 2 minutes or until the prawns have turned white and are cooked through. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,pita bread,russet potato,egg yolk
title: Potato Omelet With French Onion Bake
ingredients: 3 large russet potatoes, peeled and diced | 1 small onion soup mix | 4 egg yolks | 1 large onion, finely diced
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. In a pot, cook the potatoes in boiling water until tender. Drain and transfer to a mixing bowl, and mash until smooth. While potatoes are cooking, pour the onion soup mix into a skillet over medium heat.

title: Veal Fritters
ingredients: 1/2 kg veal fat, cubed | 4 tablespoons rice flour
instructions: Mix the 2 tbsp of rice flour into the fat and mix well. Heat a deep pan and add the veal. Stir fry on both sides until golden brown.

title: Saffron Potlatch (Pork)
ingredients: 1/4 lb of thick pork shoulder or 1/4 lb lean pork | 4 pieces of saffron strands, soaked in warm water | 1/2 teaspoon paprika | 2 -3 cups of warm water
instructions: Put the pork shoulder into a large pot and add 5 cups of good water to cover the meat. Bring to the boil and then lower the heat to just below the level of the meat. You may leave the meat in the pot, but take your weight up with a fork and use that as a shield. Cook for 2 hours, checking the pot regularly, to make sure there is enough water. If not, continue to cook and let the mixture cool. After 2 hours, remove all the fat, and discard it. Place the pork into a food processor or blender. Add the saffron water and paprika and blend into a thick paste. This will take about 10 - 15 minutes to make in your food processor or you’ll have to stop and mix all the ingredients. Adjust the seasonings with more paprika, salt, pepper and more saffron flavour if necessary. Remove the pot from the heat. Cover and leave in the room temperature room temperature for 1 hour. Turn the dough out onto a floured surface. Shape into balls or small patties and brown in a hot pan. Serve with gravy. Note, after the day, you can freeze the potlatch until needed. Then, place the pots back into the freezer. You can do this with any meat that you do not like. A sharp knife works well for this, and if you feel adventurous you can freeze the potlatch. If meat is cut up in one piece and not sliced, remove from freezer overnight and re heat the pan on the stove over medium high heat before adding other ingredients, turning heat down as necessary. These are great over cooked pasta just stir everything together, and serve.

title: Quick Quesadillas
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sour cream or 2 tablespoons yogurt | 1 1/2 tablespoons finely shredded american cheese | 1/4 teaspoon paprika
instructions: Warm a nonstick skillet over medium heat. Combine sour cream, grated cheese, and paprika in small bowl, stir to mix. Add a ladleful of sour cream mixture to center of skillet, add cheese cheese to edge of curd. Top with other side to form a taco, press down lightly. Cook one minute, or until cheese starts to melt and turn golden.

title: Faux Phyllo Fish in Tomato and Blueberry Sauce
ingredients: 2 fillets catfish | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh watercress | 4 slices blueberries | 1 teaspoon tomato puree | 1 tablespoon water | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh pepper | 1 sheets phyllo dough, thawed and cut in half lengthwise
instructions: Place catfish pieces, skin side up, on the dull side of a preheated griddle or skillet over medium low heat. Sprinkle with watercress and allow to come to a simmer. Cover and continue cooking until easily flaked with a fork, about 30 seconds. Meanwhile, combine blueberries and tomato puree in a small saucepan and simmer for 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in water and pepper. Spoon equal portions of the blueberry mixture onto each cut side of 1 phyllo. Place a fillet fillet on top of each stack of fillets and brush with tomato puree sauce. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: bread crumb choice,cheddar cheese,lime juice zest,cane sugar,cauliflower floret
title: Quick & Easy Cauliflower Grilled Cheese
ingredients: 1 cauliflower floret | 1/3 cup coarse dry bread crumbs ( about, or use 1/2 cup of bread crumbs mixed with 1/2 cup of bread crumbs, or use 1/2 cup soft breaded and diced cubes of cheese ) | 1 teaspoon lime juice, plus lime zest of one freshly squeezed | 1/3 cup soft unbleached cane sugar, sifted | 1/2 cup aged cheddar cheese, coarsely grated
instructions: Heat grill to high and heat griddle. Using a small spoon to press down on all the core, shred cauliflower florets into 1/2 inch chunky, bite sized pieces, and place over hot coals, tossing to coat. When cauliflower is golden brown and crusty on the edges and golden, 1 to 2 minutes, remove from heat. Meanwhile, combine bread crumbs, lime zest, and sugar in a 2 to 4 quart bowl. Divid cauliflower among four dinner plates. Divide crumb mixture among the plates. Sprinkle with cheese and drizzle with lime juice and season with salt and pepper. Serve immediately.

title: Hot Chilli Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons caster sugar, grated | 1/2 teaspoon caster sugar | 2 fresh green chilies, deseeded and finely chopped | 2 tablespoons lime rind, finely grated | 1 1/2 tablespoons brandy or 1 1/2 tablespoons dark rum | 1 -2/3 cup red wine | 1 pinch cayenne pepper, to sprinkle on top | 1/2 cup cilantro, finely chopped
instructions: Combine the sugar with the chillies, rind and brandy in a small saucepan and simmer until the sugar has melted and the mixture has a syrupy consistency. Remove from the heat and stir in the wine and cayenne. Cool and chill, then blend the chilli sauce with the cilantro just before serving. This is lovely with chips or pak choi.

title: Penne With Chickpeas and Gruyère
ingredients: 2 cans chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/4 cup gruyere cheese, shredded | 1 lb penne pasta ( or linguine )
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. In a large bowl, combine drained chickpeas and cream and stir. Sprinkle with cheese and toss to distribute cheese. Meanwhile, cook pasta to desired doneness, until heated through. Drain pasta and transfer to a serving platter. Rinse with cold water and top with sauce.

Random Ingredients: mint sprig,vegetable broth,cilantro,rotel tomato,worcestershire sauce,red chili paste,tart apple,bottom steak
title: Apple Beef Jerky
ingredients: 2 lbs taro apples, cut into 1/4 thick slices | 1 cup vegetable broth | 1/4 cup sweet red chili paste, such as sambal oelek | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1 can rotel tomatoes, undrained | mint sprig ( optional ) | 1/4 cup chopped cilantro, optional ( optional )
instructions: In bowl of heavy duty plastic bag, combine apples and broth. Cover & marinate in refrigerator 8 hours, turning bag or opening as needed. Meanwhile, in medium saucepan over medium heat, combine chili paste, worcestershire sauce and rotel tomatoes. Bring to boil.

title: Potato and Apricot Balls (Aussie Muffins)
ingredients: 500 g chat potatoes, cooked, peeled, finely chopped | 225 g dried apricots, chopped | 150 g montreal prime asadero cheese, grated | 2 green onions, finely chopped | 200 g chevre cheese, shredded | 2 tablespoons cornflour, mixed with | 1 tablespoon grand marnier
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Mix all ingredients together. Shape mixture into walnut sized balls using about 1/3 cup mixture for each. Roll balls in cornflour mixture. Bake on lined oven tray for 20 minutes or until cooked. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: thyme,mozzarella cheese,thyme sprig,swiss cheese,cilantro leaf,part ricotta cheese,lamb shank
title: Lamb Shank Stuffed With Swiss and Herbs (Lamb Shanks Stuffed With
ingredients: 8 small lamb shanks, 4 1/2-pound, fat cap removed | 3 cups part-skim ricotta cheese | 1 cup shredded swiss cheese | 3/4 cup shredded mozzarella cheese | 2 tablespoons snipped fresh cilantro leaves | 2 fresh thyme sprigs | fresh thyme sprigs
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325°f. Place the lamb shanks on a foil lined baking sheet and top with a layer of cheese. Top with a layer of swiss cheese. Repeat the layers. Combine the ricotta, herbs and the remaining swiss cheese on a large platter. Place 1/3 of the cheese mixture at a time atop the cheese and shanks. Fold in half at a 45 degree angle and pinch edges to seal. Using a sharp knife, cut into the cheese and shanks to form 2 1/2 inch long, oval shaped pockets. title: Lavender Rice Blend

instructions: Spray large ovenproof skillet with cooking spray. Heat shortening on low heat until melted. Add pork.

instructions: In a dutch oven bring water to a boil. Add barley and salt.

title: Sassy Steak

instructions: Place the steak slices between sheets of plastic wrap and pound lightly with a meat mallet to an even thickness. Add the toasted soy mustard and lightly mix to combine. Spoon the brussels sprouts on top of the meat. Serve sprinkled with chives or green onion tops.

title: Canadian Bacon and Macadamia Stuffed Mussels
ingredients: 14 large fresh mussels, scrubbed, debearded | 4 slices smoked canadian bacon ( sliced thick, 1-inch thick ) | 1/2 cup flour | 2 tablespoons canadian bacon pieces, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon paprika | 1 teaspoon cumin seed, lightly crushed | 2 celery ribs, finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 f. Remove beards from mussels and discard. In a heavy 12x18 inch heavy ovenproof skillet, cook bacon over medium heat, turning occasionally until crisp, about 10 minutes. Transfer bacon to paper towels with slotted spoon.

Random Ingredients: prosciutto,green bean,margarine,gruyere cheese,shrimp,chickpea,extra virgin olive oil,rice milk
title: Stuffed Green Beans and Shrimp With Gruyère and Puffed Shells
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh green beans, trimmed | 4 ounces gruyere cheese, grated | 4 ounces thinly sliced prosciutto | 1 cup chickpeas, drained, rinsed and drained | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 2 tablespoons margarine | 2 cups rice milk | 1 lb shrimp, cooked, peeled and deveined
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the green beans and cook for 2 minutes. Drain and immediately plunge into ice water. Drain again and plunge into a bowl of ice water. Drain again and put in a bowl of cold water again. After 2 minutes, pull the beans apart with a small knife and then put them into a bowl of cold water, so that the shells stay completely cold. Cut the tops of the green beans lengthwise, then scoop out the tender strings leaving 1/4 inch from their tops. Cut back the stalks into 1/4 inch pieces and set aside. Sprinkle half of the gruyere cheese and the prosciutto over the beans. On the top layer of ham, place the reserved green beans and then scatter the remaining gruyere cheese on top. Place 2 tablespoons of the olive oil and 2 tablespoons of margarine in a large saute pan and allow to melt on medium heat, about 1 minute. Add the shrimps and cook, turning until pink and cooked through, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat, then pour in the rice milk, stirring constantly, and letting each bubble for about 1 minute or so until the rice milk thickens enough to coat the shrimps. Portion half of this liquid into a baking dish, cover and chill until needed. When ready to serve, remove the shells and green beans from the water with a slotted spoon and arrange in one layer on top of the cheese in the dish, in neat rows. Spoon the shrimp mixture onto the shells. Drizzle the remaining 2 tablespoons margarine over the green beans and shrimps. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,pear,sourdough bread,orange liqueur,black peppercorn
title: Steamed French Toast
ingredients: 1 slice sourdough bread ( diagonally sliced long grain bread ) | 4 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1/4 cup fresh orange-flavored liqueur, such as an orange, orange-flavored liqueur or 1 teaspoon orange juice | 2 black peppercorns | 2 slices arugula ( can substitute baby beet leaves if you wish )
instructions: Place sourdough bread on a work surface. Top with 2 tablespoons sesame oil, 2 tablespoons orange liqueur or 1 teaspoon orange juice and 1 peppercorn.

title: Hainan Kebab

instructions: Arrange the burger or hamburger on a large serving platter. In a bowl, stir together the cashews, cream cayenne pepper, and turnip. Drizzle over the cream sauce. Serve with bread or toast.

title: Roast Beef With Champagne Vinegar
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs boneless top round roast, fat trimmed | 2 teaspoons garlic salt | 2 teaspoons champagne vinegar | 1 egg yolk
instructions: Trim any excess fat from the roast, and season with garlic salt. Cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for 5 hours, or overnight. Bring to room temperature, and prepare a large baking sheet with aluminum foil lining it, and preheat the oven to 375°. Remove wrap, and transfer meat to the baking sheet. Bake for 1 hour. Remove and discard wrap, and transfer meat to a carving board. Carve into thin slices. To thicken sauce, whisk together the egg yolk and a little cold water. Drizzle over meat when serving.

Random Ingredients: hot salsa,bulk italian sausage,peanut,vanilla syrup,coffee,plum tomato,black pepper,coconut cream
title: Korean Sausage Chili
ingredients: 1/4 lb bulk italian sausage, or more to taste | 1 tablespoon vanilla-flavored syrup | 1 tablespoon coconut cream | 2 1/2 cups hot salsa, divided | 1 cup pecans, coarsely chopped | 1 3/4 cups hot coffee, divided | 1 plum tomatoes, seeded and chopped | 1 pinch freshly ground black pepper ( optional )
instructions: Place sausage and vanilla syrup in a large dutch oven over low heat. Cook, stirring, until sausage has browned and mixture is no longer pink, about 5 minutes. Bring to a simmer and cook until thickened, about 10 minutes. Stir in plum tomatoes during the last minute or so of cooking time. Season with salt and black pepper, if desired.

title: Chicharrones Con Ciel

instructions: Remove outer shell of tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: queso sauce,beef,baking powder,red enchilada sauce,fruit,strawberry jam,dark corn syrup
title: Easy Cheeseburger Salad
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef | 1 cup prepared guacamole mixed dried fruit | 2 teaspoons baking powder | 1 can red enchilada sauce | 1 jar queso hot sauce | 1/4 cup dark corn syrup | 2 1/2 tablespoons crushed dried fruit
instructions: Over medium heat, cook ground beef until browned. Drain. Pour into a greased 9 inch round dish. Arrange 1/2 cup guacamole mixed dried fruit in the center of the meat. Pour enchilada sauce over the guacamole. Top with remaining guacamole and sauce. Combine baking powder and 1/3 cup of enchilada sauce and sprinkle over the guacamole mixture. Combine remaining 1/2 cup enchilada sauce and 1/4 cup of dark corn syrup, stirring well. Spoon over top of guacamole mixture in dish. Sprinkle crushed dried fruit over dish. Bake in a preheated 350 degree f oven for 30 minutes, or until heated throughout and cheese is melted.

Random Ingredients: pork chop,parmesan cheese,greek seasoning,rack lamb,spanish onion,almond extract,plum tomato
title: Spanish Pork Rack Lamb Back
ingredients: 1 1/2 racks of lamb, bone in | 1/2 large spanish onion, sliced | 1/2/4 large rack of lamb bone in | 3 plum tomatoes, sliced in 1 `` thin layers | 1/2 cup blanched almond, sliced thinly | 6 tablespoons parmesan cheese | 1 teaspoon himalayan pink seasoning | 1 teaspoon all purpose greek seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Spray a 7x11 casserole dish with nonstick spray. Set aside. Place 1 rack of lamb onto a cutting board and using a meat tenderizing mallet, pound the rack until even in thickness. Place 1/2 onion, 1/2 rack of lamb, 2 slices each the onion, and 2 plum tomato to the cutting board and work with the mallet or the meat as you work to remove some of the excess fat. Spread each stack with 4 tblsp of the parmmento mixed with 3 tblsp of greek seasoning. Repeat with the remaining rack of lamb. Lay 3nd rack of lamb onto a cutting board and using the mallet or the meat as you work to remove extra fat. Lay the 3rd rack of lamb onto the cutting board on top of the onion. Spread 1/2 the sliced almonds on each slab, being careful to spread around the lamb. Using a very sharp knife, slice diagonally across the roast. Using a very sharp knife, slice diagonally across the roast. Repeat with the other 3 racks of lamb. Spread the 3 tblsp of greek seasoning on both racks of lamb. Sprinkle the remaining 3 tblsp of greek seasoning on both racks of lamb. Use a very sharp knife. Place the sliced tomatoes over the racks of lamb and top with any remaining sliced onions. Add an extra layer of sliced tomatoes. Press down on the meat with a fork to flatten it. Add the additional layer of sliced tomatoes, being careful not to push down on the tomatoes as they will stick the lamb. Spread 1/2 the cheese over the lamb, being very careful not to push down on tomato slices as they will stick. Top with the remaining sliced tomatoes. Cover the roast with foil and place in preheated oven. Bake for 5 hours or until a meat thermometer reads 170 degrees when inserted into center of meat. Remove foil, sprinkle with a light layer of remaining cheese and continue to bake until cheese is melted and begins to brown at edges. Turn out of oven and cover with foil just long enough to rest for the cheese to melt. Let sit for 5 - 10 minutes before carving. Slice into very thin slices, serve.

instructions: Prick scallops all over with a fork and then place them on paper towl to dry. Heat oil in a large wide, heavy skillet over high heat.
