Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,onion powder,heavy cream,coleslaw mix,soymilk
title: Vegetarian Coleslaw
ingredients: 4 cups coleslaw mix | 1/4 cup soy milk | 1 1/2 teaspoons red wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 1/2 cup heavy cream ( optional )
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together the coleslaw mix, soy milk, vinegar, onion powder, and cream. Refrigerate several hours for flavors to develop.

title: Wild Rice Cake(Gluten Free)
ingredients: 1 cup rice flour ( i use self-rising flour ) | 2/3 cup creamy goat cheese | 12 ounces fresh tomatillos, stems removed, rinsed well and cut in half if large | 1 teaspoon tea ( i use regular ) | 1 -2 teaspoon strawberry jam ( optional ) or 1 -2 strawberry syrup ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f. Put the rice flour in a large mixing bowl. Mix in the goats cheese. Add the tomatillos and give a good mix with a spoon. Add tea, if using. You want to soften the tomatos. Add the rice flour at this stage and mix with the mixture. The finished batter will be soft and somewhat sticky. Spread the cake batter into a round pyrex dish, or other oven proof pan that will hold the tomatos and cake in a single layer without any holes, about an inch or less in diameter. Spoon the jam over the cake. Pour the hot cake mixture on top of the jam and spread evenly. If you are using strawberry jam, spread evenly over the cake. If possible, cut a knife to fit through the top of the cake and place a plate under the knife to cut a decorative pattern, or use a skewer. Place the cake in a baking dish and prick a few holes randomly all around. Bake the cake for about 60 minutes until golden brown.

title: Lily Kwong's Ambrosia
ingredients: 12 ounces mandarin oranges | 6 ounces pineapple | 1 pint raspberry | 1/2 pint mandarin oranges | 1/2 pint raspberry | 1/2 pint grand marnier or 1/2 pint cherry brandy
instructions: Open a can of mandarin oranges. If they are large, cut down and remove any membrane you can see from the mandarin skins and pulp. Open the canned mandarin oranges. Pour most of the pulp from the mandarin oranges over the mandarin oranges. Slice the pineapple in half and lay flat in a cone shape on top of each other. Slice the orange sections and distribute on top of the mandarin orange sections in the cone. Slice the raspberry in half and arrange on top of the pineapple slices. Add the rum, grand marnier or brandy to taste. Serve over icecream or icecream and a few more raspberries. Tip, make sure your oranges are very clean and no bitter juice penetrates the skin, especially the skin on the top layer. If the peel is not totally transparent, use a sharp knife to slice the peel from both the sides.

title: Beef and Noodle Stir-Fry With Red Beans - Yummy!
ingredients: 2 tablespoons baking cocoa | 8 ounces beef tenderloin | 2 lbs scallops | 14 ounces dried red beans | 1 small egg noodles ( optional ) or 1 small shellfish ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 300°f. Break beef into 1 1/2 to 2 inch chunks. Heat 2 t of oil in 12 nonstick skillet over medium high heat until ripples appear around edges, about 1 minute. Add beef and scallops, lower heat, cover and cook 3 minutes or until meat is browned, lifting cover to keep beef moist. Remove from heat. Arrange beans on a baking sheet. Spoon beef mixture among beans. Place in a 300°f oven. Cook 40 minutes or until noodles are tender and crisp. Uncover and cook 5 additional minutes or until beef and scallops are tender and beans are heated through. Top with cooked noodles and serve.

Random Ingredients: asparagus,cinnamon,thyme sprig,egg wrap,jalapeno pepper,vanilla bean,cheddar cheese
title: Guatemalan Asparagus
ingredients: 8 ounces asparagus, trimmed, coarsely chopped | 2 small jalapeno peppers, stems removed, minced | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 12 large egg roll wraps | 1/2 cup cheddar cheese, shredded | fresh thyme sprig | 1 vanilla bean, split lengthwise, seeds scraped
instructions: Toss asparagus, jalapeño peppers, cinnamon, and asparagus mixture with bread rolls in large bowl. Place in lightly oiled 13x9 inch glass baking dish, spreading asparagus mixture evenly over rolls. Top with cheese and thyme sprigs. Scatter with seeds from vanilla bean. Cover with foil. Chill 1 hour or until cold. Serve with salsa.

title: Guatemalan Manicotti
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups guajillo manicotti | 1 can enchilada sauce | 2 -3 canned chipotle peppers, chopped | 1/2 cup orange flower water | 1 tablespoon cocoa | 1/4 cup beer, chilled | 1 green
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. In a bowl mix enchilada sauce, chipotle peppers, orange flower water, cocoa and beer until smooth. Remove and discard stem end of each mezze. Place pasta in boiling water. Once pasta is done, drain and place in bowl with sauce. Toss with cheese and a dash of orange flower water. Place mixture in a 9x13 baking dish. Bake 45 minutes.

title: Aussie Fruit and Nut Lunch
ingredients: 1 cup crushed sweetened coconut | 2/3 cup flour tortilla ( i prefer flour ) | 1/4 cup shredded sweetened coconut | 1/2 cup diced candied orange zest | 8 flour tortillas, approximately 3/4-inch-thick | 1/2 cup chopped nuts ( mixed ) or 1/2 cup desiccated coconut ( mixed ) | 1 teaspoon chopped orange zest | 1/4 cup applesauce
instructions: Lightly flour tortillas. Combine coconut, flour and chopped oranges and zests. Dip flour tortillas in fruit/nut mixture and roll into little logs measuring around the length of the tortilla. Place on baking sheet.

title: Mock Chicken
ingredients: 1 can cream of coconut | 1 1/1 cups broth ( or can your own homemade chicken stock ) | 1 small anaheim chilies or 1 large jalapeno chilies | 2 teaspoons sesame oil
instructions: Cut off the ends of anaheim and jalapeno and remove seeds. In blender or food processor combine the cream of coconut and 3/4 cup of broth powder. Blend until mixture is smooth. In skillet, add sesame oil, stir fry chopped chilies until they are a medium color. Add the remaining broth and simmer over low heat for 10 minutes. Add cream of coconut mixture and simmer for about 5 minutes longer.

Random Ingredients: green olive,coriander,jumbo shrimp,whipping cream,cannellini bean,ancho chile powder,malt vinegar
title: Ancho Blanco
ingredients: 2 cans cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 3 tablespoons malt vinegar | 1 jar chopped green olives | 3 tablespoons minced dry ancho chile powder | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried coriander | 12 jumbo shrimp, peeled and deveined | 3/4 cup whipping cream
instructions: In a large pot combine the beans and 2/3 cup water, then cover and bring to a boil. Stir in the remaining ingredients and simmer over medium low heat for 15 minutes. Add shrimp to the broth and cook for 5 minutes or until shrimp turn pink. Stir in remaining cup of whipping cream and heat through until warm.

title: Simple Crunchy Tuna Salada
ingredients: 1 packet nori, dried ( it only has 3 grams of goo in it, but some people like the dried seaweed ) | 6 -8 tablespoons salad oil | 1 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: Soak tuna in a bowl of water in the refrigerator for about 20 minutes prior to making sushi. Squeeze out excess water from the tuna and use a strainer lined with a coffee filter or paper towel to filter out as much excess water as possible. Discard the hard shell from the nori sheets. Slice the tuna in 1/2 inch to 1 inch slabs. You can put all sushi ingredients in the freezer in one portion and you may need to use half the ingredients for each meal. Once the tuna is done, use a large wooden spoon to gently break the pieces apart while they're still wet. This part seems messy, and if any of your hands don't hold it together you may need to use a spoon. Dip each piece on one side in the prepared nori so the pieces get a little crispy on the outside. This will take a couple of minutes on each side so keep an eye on the edges and work quickly. Cook tuna in hot oil in a frying pan until golden brown and crisp about 2 - 3 minutes. Repeat with remaining nori. Serve with soy sauce and sugar to taste.

Random Ingredients: anise oil,rye flour,pea,heavy cream,new york,sirloin tip,pineapple chunk juice
title: Sirloin Tip Sandwich
ingredients: 1 sirloin tip | 2 teaspoons ground anise oil | 1 can pineapple chunks with juice | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 1/4 cup frozen peas, thawed | 2 new york strip steaks | 2 teaspoons ritzi's light rye flour
instructions: Trim fat from tip and discard outside of tip. Wrap tip with 3/4 inch slices of beef. In a skillet, heat oil over medium heat, add beef and cook for 4 - 5 minutes until browned. Remove beef from skillet and place on paper towels. Pour off fat from skillet and place pineapple chunks and 2 tbsp of the juice mixture into skillet. Pour in heavy cream and add peas. Mix well. Heat for 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Slice sandwiches in half and spread with rice. Top with beef tips and remaining juice mixture. Sprinkle ritzi with rye. Serve with fries or potatoes.

Random Ingredients: french bread,orange juice,custard powder,mustard seed,shrimp,beef bouillon cube,sirloin tip roast,self raising flour
title: Beef and Shrimp Loaf
ingredients: 1 sirloin tip roast, trimmed and cut into 5 pieces | 1 kg peeled prawns, cooked ( deveined ) | 1 liter french bread | 1 1/2 cups frozen self raising flour | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 1 beef bouillon cube | 2 1/2 tablespoons custard powder | 1 cup orange juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c or 170c if fan assisted. Line loaf pan with baking paper. Arrange beef on prepared pan. Combine all ingredients except the bread and beef in a freezer bag. Add beef and shake to combine,. Spoon beef mixture into prepared pan,. Bake 45 - 50 minutes depending on how well cooked you prefer your beef. Remove from oven. Slice loaf in half, lengthways, and arrange on serving plate. Serve with french bread.

title: Mexican-Style Italian Sausage
ingredients: 3 tablespoons chunky salsa | 1 package mild italian sausage, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Pour chunky salsa on the sausage. Add the optional italian sausage, if using. Cover.

title: Easy Tahini and Buttermilk Hummus
ingredients: 4 cups buttermilk, divided | 1/2 cup tahini
instructions: In a blender or food processor, blend 1 cup of the buttermilk and the tahini together. Refrigerate until needed. Add remaining buttermilk and add remaining 1 cup of buttermilk and blend until smooth. Cover and shake well before serving.

title: Grand Marnier Olive Chutney
ingredients: 1 cup sliced green olives ( drained ) | 1/4 cup grand marnier | 2 tablespoons curry powder | 1/4 teaspoon pepper | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne | 3 cups of ice cubes
instructions: Place all ingredients in blender and process until smooth. Keep refrigerated until ready to use.

Random Ingredients: malt vinegar,cornmeal,ice water,parsley,red chili powder,red potato,orange,cumin
title: Moroccan Vegetable Stew
ingredients: 1 lb small red potato, halved crosswise | 1/2 cup cornmeal | ice water | 2/3 cup cornmeal | 1 cup stone-ground red chili powder | 1/2 cup malt vinegar | 1 cup freshly diced orange rind | 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley | 1 tablespoon ground cumin
instructions: Combine potato, cornmeal, and 1 cup of cold water in a large bowl and mash to a coarse paste. Stirring constantly, transfer potato mixture to food processor or blender and pulse until mixture forms a thick paste. Place paste in a bowl and chill for 3 hours or overnight. To make couscous, combine chili powder, vinegar, orange rind, parsley, cumin, and remaining 1/2 cup cold water in a small saucepan and cook over medium heat for 10 minutes or until mixture comes to a boil. Remove from heat, cover, and set aside to cool. Heat oven to 400 degrees f. Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper or lightly oil baking sheets. Combine potato paste, cornmeal, and cold water in a large bowl. Toss with hands to combine.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin,pork shoulder butt,coconut cream,dark brown sugar
title: Coconut Glazed Tenderloin
ingredients: 4 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 2 lbs boneless beef tenderloin ( boston butt, or other trimmed roast ) | 3 2 lbs sweet pork shoulder, fat trimmed | 2 cans coconut cream, drained
instructions: Cut beef into 1/4 inch slices. Combine sugar and meat in large skillet and brown well on both sides. Remove meat and place in large roasting pan. Add coconut cream to pan drippings and heat over medium low heat. Place meat on bottom rack of roaster. Insert a metal skewer or string around meat to avoid burning. Roast on middle rack of oven at 350 degrees, meat temperature about 90 minutes per pound for medium, 90 minutes per pound for medium well.

Random Ingredients: vegetable shortening,fusilli pasta,pine nut,onion soup mix,stewing beef,ha avocadoes,quinoa
title: Terrific Beef & Quinoa Fusilli
ingredients: 500 g stewing beef, thinly sliced | 3 tablespoons vegetable shortening | 500 g quinoa, washed | 1 envelope onion soup mix | 375 g ha avocadoes, in water | 45 g pine nuts | 400 fusilli pasta, cooked
instructions: In a pan, heat the oil. Add the beef, and fry until browned. Add the onion soup mix and cook for 2 - 3 minutes, until warm. Add enough water to the beef mixture to cover the meat. Bring to a boil, and reduce to simmer. Cook for a further 2 - 3 minutes. Remove the pan from the heat and allow to set for 5 minutes. Meanwhile, mash the avocadoes with a fork, and mix into the beef mixture. To serve, place the quinoa in a large bowl with enough hot water to cover. Allow to soak for 1 hour, then drain and transfer to a large serving bowl. Drain the quinoa well, and add to the beef mixture. Stir through the guacamole. Add to your favourite salad, or serve in a sandwich bag with extra cheese and sour cream for the extra flavour. To serve, divide the fusilli into serving bowls, sprinkle on more cheese and drizzle on the guacamole.

Random Ingredients: flour tortilla,linguica sausage,vegetable,salt black pepper,golden syrup,oil,dough,cider vinegar
title: Linguica (Spanish Sausage and Fritters)
ingredients: 1 slice fresh linguica sausage, casing removed | 1 tablespoon golden syrup | salt and ground black pepper to taste | 1 1/2 teaspoons cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 12 flour tortillas, warmed | 6 tablespoons shredded fresh spinach
instructions: Cook linguica in a skillet over medium heat until the sausage is no longer pink, 5 to 10 minutes. Remove sausage and slice. Cook fritters in a skillet over medium heat until golden brown, about 3 minutes per side. Remove from heat and keep warm. Toss sausage with golden syrup to coat. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Transfer to a serving platter. Drizzle with vegetable oil and vinegar. Wipe out skillet. Heat in the microwave until a drop of water sizzles on the surface.

Random Ingredients: lamb shank,fontina cheese,angel hair pasta,italian breadcrumb,spaghetti
title: Lamb Shank Patties With Tomato and Fontina Cheese
ingredients: 2 loaves crusty italian breadcrumbs | 1 pound lamb shanks | 1 jar spaghetti, drained | 1/3 cup shredded fontina cheese | 1 1/2 cups italian style breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper. Place loaves on the baking sheets. Bake at 350 degrees f 2 hours, or until no longer pink. Shred in large bite size pieces by hand. Set aside. Lightly oil a baking sheet. Toss the lamb shanks in 3/4 cup of olive oil with 2/3 cup of bread crumbs in a bowl.

title: Peking Beef
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs stewing beef | 1 tablespoon chili oil
instructions: Place beef in a bowl of cold water and allow to soak at least 20 minutes, stirring every 5 - 7 minutes. Preheat oven to 300°f and place a large cast iron skillet in the skillet and heat over high heat until a bead of water vaporizes on contact. Remove beef with a slotted spoon and place into the hot skillet. Cook for 1 hour over high heat, stirring occasionally until internal temp reaches 140°f for medium rare. The beef should register 125°f on the thermometer when you reach the desired degree of doneness.

title: Easy Curried Garlic Chicken
ingredients: 4 cloves garlic | 3 tablespoons chicken bouillon
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Place the garlic in a glass baking dish and drizzle with chicken bouillon. Bake for 30 minutes in the preheated oven, then sprinkle any remaining butter on top. Continue to bake for 15 more minutes.

Random Ingredients: turbinado sugar,brown lentil,cider vinegar,italian salad dressing mix,sherry,feta,tarragon,cottage cheese
title: Baked Lentils With Cheddar-Tarragon Dressing
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lentils | 1 package italian salad dressing mix ( cheddar herb mix ) | 1 cup fat-free cottage cheese | 1/2 cup dry sherry, divided | 3 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon packed brown sugar | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh tarragon | 1 teaspoon turbinado sugar
instructions: Cover, then bring to a boil. Remove from heat. Rinse and drain the lentils. In a large bowl, combine the lentils, salad dressing mix, cottage cheese, 1/2 cup sherry, vinegar, sugar, 1 teaspoon tarragon and turbinate. Mix well to combine. In a greased 2 quart casserole, bake uncovered in 350°f oven for 30 minutes. Top with remaining 1/2 cup sherry and bake another 10 minutes, or until heated through.

title: Touscous With Fresh Strawberries in Crushed Strawberries
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked couscous | 4 fresh strawberries, hulled and sliced
instructions: Heat couscous in a 2 - 3 qt casserole over medium heat until just beginning to simmer.

title: Anchovies - Chile Prawns
ingredients: 6 large peeled deveined shrimp ( prawns ) | 1 large firm ripe canned peach | 1 small hot green chili pepper | 3 ounces soft flaked coconut | 4 ounces whole wheat flour | 4 anchovies, chopped
instructions: Boil the prawns for 7 minutes in salted water, remove from heat and drain. Peel the prawns and remove the shells. Remove the flesh and keep them aside. Chop peach, chilli, desiccated coconut and anchovies coarsely. Combine flour, coconut and prawn's in a medium sized bowl and work through. Place a small spoonful of flour in the centre and coat the prawns to soften, about 5 minutes knead the mixture in with fingers or a wooden spoon for 2 minutes. Cover in plastic wrap and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Drain the prawns, wash them and dry. Dip into the flour mixture and remove the excess flour. Dry all the prawns on the paper towel. Cook in the oven on a tray lined with parchment paper on low flame or in a heated oven until they are cooked through. Serve from the oven or grill or eat with salad.

Random Ingredients: snow pea pod,head cabbage,barley,farfalle pasta,english cucumber,pear
title: Nova Scotia Corn Salad
ingredients: 1 head cabbage, cored and sliced | 1 english cucumber, halved and sliced | 1 pear | 4 snow pea pods, trimmed | 12 ounces farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 1/2 cup barley
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Arrange cabbage, cucumber, and pear on a large salad plate. Arrange snow peas and watercress over vegetables. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil, then add farfalle pasta and cook for 9 minutes. Drain pasta, then place in a large salad bowl, and toss with barley.

title: Nicoise Olive Alfredo Sauce
ingredients: 1 jar nicoise olives | 1 jar alfredo sauce
instructions: Open a bottle of alfredo sauce and drain the olives on a paper towel. Take 1/3 of the alfredo sauce and warm in medium low to medium heat. Add the olives. Simmer for about 5 minutes on medium low. Serve over your favorite pasta.

Random Ingredients: chocolate cake mix,pecorino romano cheese,green chili pepper,wheat flour
title: Italian Slices
ingredients: 1 package chocolate cake mix | 1/2 cup whole wheat flour | 2 green chili peppers, minced | 1/2 cup freshly grated pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Spray a baking sheet with cooking spray. Prepare cake mix according to package directions for a 13 by 9 baking dish. Spray a 9 x 9 baking dish with cooking spray. In a small mixing bowl, combine flour and chili peppers.

title: Picmatian Beef Tenderloins
ingredients: 1/2 cup kalamata olives, pitted | 1/4 cup molasses | 2 tablespoons margarine | 2 beef tenderloin steaks | 2 teaspoons molasses
instructions: Preheat an oven to 300 degrees f. Mix 1/2 cup of olives, 1/4 cup of molasses, and margarine in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,almond paste,cointreau liqueur,ziti pasta,sun tomato oil,peanut oil
title: Pasta With Shredded Ziti
ingredients: 12 ounces ziti pasta | 4 ounces almond paste | 3 -4 tablespoons cointreau liqueur | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 1/2 cup slivered almonds ( roasted will give the ziti a more pronounced flavor ) | 4 tablespoons dark sesame oil
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to boil. Add the ziti and cook until al dente, but still slightly firm. Drain the pasta and set aside. When you are done cooking the ziti, heat the pan that the sun dried tomatoes were fried in and add the almond paste. Stir and sauté for about 30 seconds. Add the cointreau and stir. Add the sun dried tomatoes, stirring again along with the olive oil. Continue to cook on a medium heat. When all ingredients are mixed well, season to taste with salt and pepper. Add the shredded ziti and toasted slivered almonds and toss well. Serve with soy sauce, pita chips or toasted bread sticks.

title: Radish Rice
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice or 1 cup long grain rice | 1 -2 radish, sliced in rounds
instructions: Combine salt and water in a 3 to 5 quart saucepan. Warm over medium high heat to just under a boil, then add rice, stir to coat, and cover. Simmer over low heat about 20 minute remove from heat, sprinkle with radish slices and serve.

title: Savory Onion and Garlic Rye Crisp
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry white bread, cut into 1x1-inch pieces | 3 tablespoons fresh minced lavender ( plus additional for garnish ) | 2 tablespoons finely minced pimiento | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1 teaspoon dried minced primros chive or 1/4 teaspoon dried lavender | 1 1/4 cups rye flour ( stone ground or unbleached, if available ) | 1/4 cup seedless ranch-style currants ( or raisins ) | 6 tablespoons guacamole ( or salsa, if you prefer )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. In a large bowl, toss bread with lavender, pimientos, worcestershire sauce, rice vinegar, and chives. Gradually add rye flour, mixing well. Spread bread into an ungreased 10x15 baking pan with a 1/4 cup capacity. Bake 10 minutes till golden and bubbly. Turn bread over. Sprinkle with currants. Bake an additional 3 - 5 minutes till golden, bubbling, and bubbling.

Random Ingredients: coca cola,garlic salt,monterey jack cheese,pork chop,applesauce,coriander powder
title: Mexican Pork Chops
ingredients: 1 pork chop | 1 1/2 cups applesauce | 1 1/2 cups coca-cola | 2 teaspoons coriander powder | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 4 tablespoons shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a dish just until ingredients are blended then refrigerate for at least 3 hours, turning chops over in marinade periodically. Preheat charcoal grill or gas grill to coals medium for ash/golden brown sections.

title: Cumin-Cream Cheese With Parmigiano-Reggiano
ingredients: 2 cups parmigiano-reggiano cheese, freshly grated | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cumin seeds | 1/8 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: In a mortar and pestle, grind the cumin and cream of tartar until they're powdery. Place the parmigiano reggiano in a bowl and gradually add the cream, beating steadily until the cheese is creamy. Stir in the ground cumin, cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: italian cheese,egg noodle,cream tartar,chicken leg,rice vinegar,italian parsley,belgian endive,soymilk
title: Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 large egg noodles | 4 chicken legs or 2 -3 large drumsticks | 1 bunch of fresh italian fresh parsley | 1 bunch fresh italian endive, chopped | 1/2 cup soy milk | 4 tablespoons homemade sour cream or 4 tablespoons sour cream | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 2 teaspoons cream of tartar
instructions: Boil the noodles and drain. When cool enough, cut the pieces in half. Place in a large mixing bowl and add the chicken pieces. Sprinkle parsley over the chicken, making sure the leaves are covered with the chicken. Mix together the soy milk, sour cream, vinegar and cream of tartar. Pour over the salad and mix well. Cover and refrigerate in the refrigerator for 2 - 24 hours. Cook the chicken as per instructions on the package. It should be cooked through but slightly pink in the center. Serve warm with lots of napkins, such as whole wheat french rolls or french bread pieces. Note, if using a bbq, place chicken on a preheated hot grill and brown on both sides, then flip and brown on both sides before turning.

Random Ingredients: margarine,cooking spray,sun tomato oil,salt pepper,mascarpone cheese
title: Mascarpone Sun Dried Tomatoes and Sun-Dried Tomatoes
ingredients: 8 sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, sliced | 1 package mascarpone cheese | 4 tablespoons margarine | salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees f. Spread the sun dried tomatoes out to dry in a single layer in a 9x13 inch pan. Sprinkle with a little salt and pepper. Mix mascarpone cheese and margarine together in a bowl and spread over the dried sun dried tomatoes. Place into the hot oven for 20 minutes, or until lightly browned and bubbly. Remove from oven and carefully top with sun dried tomatoes and serve.

title: Sweet Chili Paste Snacks
ingredients: pastry crust pie ( ready made, i have used frozen and it works very well ) | 1 can chili paste | 2 tablespoons chili paste | 1/4 teaspoon sea salt
instructions: Heat oven to 425ºf. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a food processor, process chili paste and chili paste until very fine. Stir in 1/2 tsp of salt and pour mixture into pastry bag or ziploc bag, add in the chili paste/salt blend thoroughly. Press mixture into a piping bag with sharp rinsed edge or tip into a piping bag. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: cottage cheese,sesame seed,spinach leaf,vegetable broth,hot pepper jalapeno,blue cheese
title: Spinach in Sesame-Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup cottage cheese | 3 tablespoons vegetable broth | 4 ounces blue cheese, crumbled | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds, toasted | 2 cups shredded spinach leaves | 1/2 small hot pepper ( or less to taste )
instructions: Add all ingredients to your bread machine in the order recommended by your bread machine's manufacturer and process on the suggested cycle ( crust light ok for me ).

title: Beef in Mustard Sauce
ingredients: 1/3 cup coarse grain mustard | 3 1/2 lbs beef stew meat, 1 1/2 inch thick | 1 cup dry-roasted walnuts | 1 1/4 teaspoons allspice berries | 3 tablespoons fish, sauce
instructions: Heat the mustard in a heavy skillet. Place allspice berries in a spice bag, add bag to skillet and shake as much air from bag as possible.

title: Spanish Piri Piri Oysters (Shrimp)
ingredients: 2 cans shrimp ( shell on, raw ) | 1 large shallot, sliced thinly | 1 jar pimientos, chopped | 1 chicken stock cube | 1 tablespoon red chili powder
instructions: Pour shrimp and shallots into a large deep glass and ceramic pan. Stir fry in hot oil until pink. Add pimentos and fry for a further 5 minutes. Stir stock cube into sauce and pour over the oysters. Stir well and leave to simmer for an additional 10 minutes, until shrimp are cooked through and liquid is reduced. Serve with lots of bread.

Random Ingredients: red snapper fillet,mustard seed,black olive,serrano chilies,apple,provolone cheese
title: Grilled Southwestern Red Snapper
ingredients: 2 teaspoons mustard seeds | 1 cup chopped fresh apple | 2 serrano chilies, seeded and minced | 1 cup chopped black olives | 1/2 pound cod or red snapper fillets, chopped | 1/4 cup shredded provolone cheese
instructions: In a shallow baking dish, mix mustard seed and apple. Add chiles, then olives. Arrange fish on top, cover, and refrigerate for 30 minutes to 1 hour. Remove fish from refrigerator 15 minutes before serving. Sprinkle fish with cheese and season with pepper.

title: The Easiest Flank Steak
ingredients: 250 g steak, sliced thinly | 2 -3 tablespoons plain flour | 2 tablespoons icing sugar | 3 prawns ( i've used other types of shrimp and i just add them when i use meat ) | 1 jar of chopped pimientos or ( 15 ounce ) jar drained ranchero peppers, drained | 1 packet of rotti salade with grated cheese or ( 50 g ) packet coriander rosamersbury swiss cheese and pepper ricotta cheese | icing sugar, for dusting
instructions: Coat all sides and then sprinkle over a little icing sugar. Cook the beef in a pan with just enough oil to just fry the beef. I use a fairly deep frying pan but it might take a little longer. Remove from the pan and slice thinly. Put into a oven proof dish, sprinkle over a little more icing sugar and return to the oven until it's very hot. I also sometimes add an equal amount of shredded cheese to the meat, or add a cube of chicken and a handful of raw vegetables, etc, then make the gravy up as you go. When there's about 10 minutes left to cook in the pan, mix the gravy with a fork, then pour into the pan with the meat and vegetables. You may also add a packet of rosamersbury swiss cheese or other tasty cheese. Put the lid on the pan, leave until the cheese is completely melted into the stew. I usually serve this with a slice of toasted crusty bread, but whatever you choose is fine. Also this should also be served with rice..

title: Oyster Sauce Enchilada Dressing (Coxin Free
ingredients: 2 cans reduced-fat cream of chicken soup | 1 cup dry currants | 1/4 cup tequila | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 4 roma tomatoes
instructions: Preparation directions, mix cream of chicken soup, currants, tequila, oyster sauce, and jalapeño peppers in a blender until well blended and smooth. Chill before serving.

title: Simple-Cooking Glaze on Fruit and Nuts
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 cup quick-cooking sherry or 1 cup dry white wine | 1/4 cup sweet onion or 1/4 cup brown sweet onion, chopped | 1/4 cup honey mustard | 1/2 teaspoon dried onion salt ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 350f degrees. Lightly spray 8 inch square or rectangular pan with cooking spray. Combine the first 6 ingredients in a large heavy duty zip top plastic bag. Add the fruit and shake to coat. Transfer the fruit to the prepared pan. Bake 15 to 20 minutes, until the glaze is bubbly. Allow to cool slightly, then turn the fruit out onto a plate and sprinkle with onion salt. Enjoy.

title: Spanish Smoked Hamburger
ingredients: 3 lbs hamburger | 1 large spanish onion, peeled and coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup molasses | 1/4 cup soymilk | 1/4 cup peanuts
instructions: Combine all ingredients in pot and simmer on low heat for 1 hour.

title: Sultana Lasagna
ingredients: 2 cups sultanas ( golden raisins ) | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 2 sheets no-boil lasagna noodles
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the sultanas and soda. Place a sheet of lasagna in the bottom of the container of a 9x13 inch pan. Top with a layer of sultana mixture. Repeat two more times, ending with a layer of lasagna on top. Cover and refrigerate for 4 days, flipping every so often.

title: Skewered Beef With Coconut Coleslaw Dressing
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs flank steaks, cut into 3/4 inch thick strips | 3/4 cup coconut milk | 2 tablespoons prepared french-style mustard | 3 tablespoons oil | 1/2 lb kielbasa, cut diagonally into 1/4 inch thick slices | 1 1/2 lbs fresh snow peas, washed thoroughly | 4 ounces snow peas with liquid
instructions: Pour coconut milk into measuring cup.

Random Ingredients: turmeric powder,sugar snap pea,grain white rice,egg white,coconut extract,hamburger bun,pearl onion,pepperoni
title: Rice Burgers on Sweet Pepperoni
ingredients: 12 ounces lean hamburger buns, split | 1 egg white, beaten | 1/3 cup thinly sliced frozen pearl onions | 1/2 cup frozen pepperoni, chopped | 10 ounces sweet pepperoni, thinly sliced | 1/2 teaspoon coconut extract | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/4 cup unsweetened flaked coconut ( optional )
instructions: Heat a nonstick fry pan over medium high heat. In a shallow bowl, add egg whites, onions, pepper strips, sweet pepperoni, coconut extract, and turmeric. Add the meat mixture and stir to combine. Divide and spread ingredients evenly into both the buns. Drizzle with coconut if using. Enjoy.

title: Mexican Style Cheese
ingredients: 1/2 pound shredded mexican-style cheese blend | 1 tablespoon garlic paste | 1 teaspoon dried sage
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix together cheese, garlic paste, and sage. Spread cheese mixture into an 8x8 inch baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven until evenly browned, about 25 minutes.

title: Quick Beef Tips for Flaming
ingredients: 2 lbs beef round tip steaks, fat removed | 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves
instructions: Place the steaks between two sheets of waxed paper or plastic wrap and pound to 1/4 inch thickness. Rub each steak with 1/4 teaspoon of ground cloves. Using a sharp, heavy knife slice the steaks into 1 1/2 inch sections, and arrange them on 2 plates. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or overnight, turning occasionally. Bring steaks to room temperature. Turn plates occasionally so they cook evenly. Arrange steaks on a bed of browned white rice. Drizzle with any remaining juice from plate.

title: Greek Fried fish (Baked Noodles)
ingredients: 1 lb white fish fillet ( such as cod, hake, cod, orange roughy, or salmon ) | 1 lb cooked noodles ( such as pappardelle, dill, or any other type of small, long noodles, such as linguine orzo ) | 1 teaspoon oregano leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Wash fish and dry with paper towel. Cut into 6 equal pieces lengthwise. Coat with cooking spray. Arrange fish and noodles on a rack in a shallow baking pan in single layer, allowing space at least 1 inch above fish. Add enough water to cover or water to a depth of 3/4 of an inch. Cover with aluminum foil. Bake or bake 20 to 25 minutes or until fish flakes when tested with a fork. While fish is cooking, remove 1/2 cup hot water from pan. Add 1 tablespoon oil to pan and saute fish with oregano. Remove fish from pan and place on a warm serving platter and cover loosely with foil. Continue cooking fish for 10 to 12 minutes, until juices run clear. Add water.

title: Spiced Corn
ingredients: 3 teaspoons dried apricot jam | 3 teaspoons asafoetida powder | 3 cans creamed corn | 3 tablespoons dried orange rind ( or candied orange ) | 8 dried serrano chilies | 1/4 teaspoon chopped fresh thyme
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Spread jam evenly in the bottom of a 3 quart casserole or dutch oven. Place corn on top of the jam, making sure it fits snugly in the pan. Sprinkle asafetida evenly over the top. Arrange chiles, thyme and orange rinds around the chiles and pour liquid over them. Bake 30 minutes.

title: Irish Whiskey Leaf and Garlic Paste Seasoning
ingredients: 50 fresh shallots, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup chopped celery leaves | 10 tablespoons irish whiskey, room temperature | 1 tablespoon garlic paste
instructions: Using a mortar and pestle or a hand held blender, mince the shallots and garlic until very fine. Add in the remaining ingredients or blend until paste is completely smooth.

title: Fruit Salad
ingredients: 4 oranges, peeled, pith removed and cut in half lengthwise | 4 cups mixed fruit, cut in 1-inch squares ( orange sections, strawberries, melon, bananas, bananas ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger
instructions: Cut the orange halves lengthwise and squeeze out the pulp. In a large bowl, mix the fruit, ginger and orange peel. Cover and refrigerate until the desired serving consistency is reached.

title: Tropical Beef
ingredients: 4 lbs rump roast | 1 cup orange juice | 1/3 cup steak sauce or 1/3 cup oyster sauce | 1 cup dried fruit, finely chopped or ( 1 liter ) cup raisins, coarsely chopped
instructions: Place the roast in a baking dish, add the orange juice, steak sauce or oyster sauce and fruit. Cover and bake at 350°f for 3 hours, basting several times. Remove the roast, and cool. Remove the fat, shred and return meat to the pan juices. Bring to room temperature and serve.

Random Ingredients: pinto bean,baking potato,kaiser,lettuce leaf,ziti pasta,worcestershire sauce,potato
title: Cajun Potatoes and Ziti
ingredients: 4 large baking potatoes, peeled and cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 2 -3 large baking potatoes | 2 cans pinto beans | 1 can pinto beans with liquid | 2 tablespoons quick-cooking dill pickle strips ( or 1/4 teaspoon dried dill weed ) | 1 head romaine lettuce leaf ( washed very well ) | 8 kaiser rolls
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place the cut potatoes on a rimmed baking sheet. Bake for 1 hour. The potatoes should be lightly browned and the potatoes soft.. Remove and discard the potatoes. When they are cool enough for you to handle, place them in a blender or food processor along with the worcestershire sauce. Blend on high or low until the potatoes are coarsely chopped. Drain the pinto beans and put them in a pot with enough water to cover them. Bring to a boil over high heat. Turn down the heat to medium and add the pinto beans and pickles. Simmer for 20 minutes or until they are soft and beans are tender. When they are done, remove the pinto beans and pickles. Add 1/2 cup cooked rice, about 1/2 cup water and stir to combine. Heat oven to 350 degrees. Put the romaine lettuce in a bowl with a little water and season to taste with salt. Place a few handfuls of the rice on each of the rolls. Spoon the beans and the hot rice on top of the lettuce. Sprinkle with the dill and serve at once on top of the hot rice. Enjoy.

title: Red Chili Sauce
ingredients:
1 fresh red chili pepper, deseeded and finely chopped ( or to taste ) | 2 tablespoons sour cream | 1 -2 teaspoon cream of tartar ( or use 1 2 tbsp.
    - cold water ) | fresh thyme sprig or fresh oregano sprig
instructions: Place the chile, sour cream, cream of tartar and herbs in a small bowl. Whisk well. Pour into a saucepan and simmer for 5 - 10 minutes. Serve immediately, or refrigerate until required.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper,jalapeno pepper,basmati rice,red capsicum,parchment paper,vanilla pudding,savoy cabbage,anise seed
title: Jalapeno Rice Paper Wraps
ingredients: 1/2 savoy cabbage, shredded | 1/4 red capsicum, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon grated fresh ginger | 1/2 teaspoon anise seed | 1 jalapeno pepper, deseeded and finely chopped | 1 teaspoon vanilla instant pudding | 1/2 cup basmati rice, cooked and cold | 3 cups parchment paper, cases ready prepared ( round paper ) | cayenne pepper
instructions: Place all ingredients except the parchment paper in a bowl and mix well. Using a small, sharp knife, slice paper rounds in half. Place 2 - 2 tbsp rice into each half. Fold two thirds of rice into the cabbage mixture to form a rice package. Place 1/2 cup of boiling water on a board. Place each wrapper on the board, bring 4 sides together, then turn over gently and repeat with remaining wrappers and filling until all the water has been used, stacking the wraps between folds of paper towels. Set out 12 paper wraps on a large tray. Using a pastry brush, brush tops of wraps with egg white, then set on paper. Cut a slit in each wrap with a sharp knife and fill with the filling mixture. Continue with remaining wraps until all the mixture is used. Use 2 small sharp kitchen scissors to cut a slit in the top of each wrap. Brush wraps with more egg white, then set aside on paper plates.

title: Strawberry Egg Rolls
ingredients: 1 package egg roll wraps | 2 cups strawberries or 2 cups raspberries
instructions: Prepare filling as directed on the package, but not too thick. Lay one sheet of egg roll wrap in front of you with a long edge going at you and a point near the filling. Fold over and pinch closed with a toothpick. You should have a large, even rectangle envelope with two ends tucked down so the roll doesn't fall out, or a picture of a fruit roll is on your right. Fold the entire length of your egg roll out and the inside folded to form a rectangle shape. Repeat steps with other half of eggroll. Wrap in wax paper or cellophane. Refrigerate 30 minutes or longer, turning up the edges to make sure there are no leaks or crumbs on it. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Slice rolls into 1/4 inch slices. Arrange on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake at 350 degrees for about 25 minutes or until golden brown in color.

Random Ingredients: greek seasoning,cauliflower,nutmeg,quinoa,water chestnut,orange marmalade,red wine vinegar,arborio rice
title: Orange Primavera (Rice and Cauliflower)
ingredients: 1 medium head cauliflower, broken into florets | 2 cups water chestnuts, halved | 4 1/2 cups dry red wine-flavored rice | 1 1/2 cups uncooked quinoa | 1/3 cup orange marmalade | 1 1/4 tablespoons extra-virgin lemon-grain greek seasoning | 1/8 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1/4 teaspoon all-purpose greek seasoning
instructions: Cook cauliflower in boiling salted water just until tender tender. Drain and set aside to cool. Cook quinoa in 2 - 2 1/2 cups boiling water in 3 quart saucepan over medium high heat, stirring frequently, until just tender. Stir in cooled cauliflower, water chestnuts, red wine, marmalade, greek seasoning, nutmeg, and other 1/4 teaspoon seasoning. Cover, remove from heat, and refrigerate at least 1 1/2 hours, or up to one day.

title: Spiced Dessert Rub
ingredients: 3 tablespoons salt | 3 tablespoons red pepper flakes ( or less ) | 4 teaspoons garam masala ( optional ) | 1 1/4 teaspoons vanilla essence ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Apply the mixture generously over cake or serve as a spice mix to crackle or spread on a cake.

title: The Ultimate Arugula Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups water | 1/3 cup unsweetened cocoa | 1 teaspoon savory | 1 head baby arugula | 1 head lettuce, torn into bite sized pieces
instructions: Bring the water to a boil in a medium saucepan. Stir in the cocoa and savory. Remove the pan from the heat and stir until the cocoa and savory are completely dissolved. Mix in the arugula.

Random Ingredients: tomato sauce,yukon gold potato,bread,pineapple juice,oregano,cherry tomato,green chili,cayenne pepper
title: Sweet Potato Pizza with Pineapple Sweet Chili and Cherry Tomatoes for One
ingredients: 2 lbs yukon gold potatoes, peeled & diced | 2 cans tomato sauce | 3 teaspoons dried oregano | 7 tablespoons pineapple juice or 7 tablespoons apple juice, divided ( juice from one pineapple ) | 1 pinch ground cayenne pepper | sliced fresh chili, to taste ( optional ) | 3 -4 slices crusty bread | cherry tomatoes, cut in quarters
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Place the potatoes in a bowl with cold water and mash to make a smooth paste. Add tomato sauce and dried oregano and stir to mix. Place in a baking dish or pie plate. Bake 45 - 50 minutes.

Random Ingredients: brown lentil,vodka,pork belly,plain yogurt,caraway seed,beef stock,chicken thigh
title: Chowning Soup
ingredients: 1/4 cup brown lentils | 1/4 cup smoked pork belly, bone-in, skin on | 1 1/2 pounds boneless chicken thighs, cut into 2-inch pieces | 6 cans beef stock | 1 cup plain yogurt | 1 tablespoon caraway seeds | 1/4 cup vodka
instructions: Place brown lentils in a large pot, and fill with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil over high heat, and boil until lentils are tender, about 15 minutes. Remove from heat, and set aside. Place smoked pork and chicken bones in a large pot over medium heat. Bring stock to a boil, and reduce heat to medium low. Cover, and simmer until chicken is no longer pink in the center, 15 to 20 minutes. Remove the chicken, and skim off excess fat. Cover, and simmer 10 minutes. Remove bones and pork skins. When lentils are done, pour chicken stock over everything, and stir in the yogurt, caraway seeds, and vodka. Simmer until yogurt is warmed through, about 10 minutes.

title: Easy Cheese Roast Beef
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon gouda cheese | 1 -2 tablespoon roast beef, deli
instructions: Put the roast beef out on a plate. If your cheese doesn't melt evenly, just put a layer of it on the slice of the cheese. Spread the cheese on to cover the beef. Microwave for about 7 minutes, you want it to get melted and bubbly. Eat.

title: Raspberry and Provolone Crisp
ingredients: 4 ounces smoked provolone cheese, diced | 4 ounces sweet white cheese ( like danish ) | 4 ounces provolone cheese, diced | 2 ounces jasmine rice ( i use jasmine ) or 2 ounces pumpernickel bread ( i use jasmine ) | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar, packed | salt and pepper | sweet chili sauce ( optional, i don't add ) | 1/3 cup raspberries and sweet chili sauce ( optional ) | italian herb, garnish ( optional, i don't add )
instructions: Mix in a large bowl. Spoon onto a small piece of foil large enough to completely wrap around one large slice of your choice of cheese, spreading to the edges. instructions: Use two baking tins of greaseproof paper. Peel and core apples. Slice thinly on a mandoline or in a food processor. Remove paper, and use a fork to mix it all together. Sprinkle with flour, and bake for 20 minutes in a preheated oven at 220 degrees celcius until golden. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: penne,english cucumber,chinese five spice powder,great northern bean,maraschino cherry

instructions: In a large bowl, combine all ingredients except cherry. Toss to coat. If desired, garnish with a cherry.

instructions: Place gammon steaks in a ziplock bag with potato and beans. Add apple cider vinegar and pour over marinade. Put in fridge to marinate for at least 1 hour. title: Gramma's Thanksgiving Pork Burger

Combine ramen noodles, eggs, green asparagus, fresh coriander, and sage in a large bowl.

instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees. Thaw the pastry. Roll out half of the dough, cut into 4 equal size squares. Using a cookie cutter, cut circles, using 2 smaller circles as a guide. title: Molho de Bodil

1 lb red lentil | 2 lbs beef, cubed.

instructions: Place lentils in large saucepan and cover with water. Bring to boil and lower heat to simmer. Simmer for 1 hour, until very soft. Add meat and pears. Cover, and cook 1/2 hour longer, or until meat is tender.

title: Frozen Polish Radishes With Cream

instructions: Make dressing cream sour cream saffron, cornflour, radish and pickle stir well in a bowl. Add dressing to sour cream and mix. title: Mortoni

instructions: Soak the eel and walnuts in cold water for 10 minutes in the refrigerator. Remove the eel from the water with a teaspoon and scrape off the skin with your fingers. Discard the hard outer shell. Slice into 1/4 1/2 inch slices. Bring a medium pot of water to a boil. Add the eel. Lower the heat, and simmer for 4 to 5 minutes. Drain, and cool in cold water. Douse with a mixture of the nuts and eel. Store in a cool, dry place.

instructions: Heat oven to 400&deg.

title: Potato Noodle for 1
ingredients: 1/4 cup potato flakes | 2 tablespoons minced italian parsley or 1 tablespoon fresh parsley, chopped
instructions: Combine potato flakes and parsley in a small bowl. Cover and chill until ready to use.

title: Low Fat Pear and Ricotta Crostini
ingredients: 1 can reduced fat ricotta cheese ( reduced-fat, low sugar is ok ) or ( 16 ounce ) can low fat ricotta cheese, drained | 8 ounces nonfat dry milk powder | 1/3 cup light brown sugar | 1/4 cup orange juice | 1 fresh pear, peeled, halved ( optional ) | toast cracker ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f mix ingredients and pour into shallow baking dish and bake in oven for 30 minutes or until center is set and golden brown. Serve with toasted bread, crackers or toasted sliced apples.

title: Nacho Grande

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. Brown sausage in a large skillet over medium heat. Place sausage in the baking dish, and set aside. instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c lightly grease a 20cm round cake tin with oil. Place the chopped clams and flour in a large bowl, making sure to combine. title: Irish Stout Chicken and Rice

instructions: Preheat the broiler. Cook the chicken at least 5 minutes on each side or until juices run clear and meat is cooked through. Drain off the fat. While the chicken is cooking mix the cream cheese, chives and cream cheese until well blended. Put a scant 1/3 cup of this mixture among the uncooked manicotti shells, covering the noodles and filling. Roll the stuffed noodles up lengthwise and place them in a lightly greased 13x9 baking dish. In a medium bowl, combine the bread crumbs and ¼ cup of water and season to taste with salt and pepper. Sprinkle the bread crumbs over the stuffed noodle rolls. Bake 15 minutes or until the topping is nicely browned and bubbly. Serve sauce on the side with the manicotti.

title: Spicy Chocolate-Chipped Chipped Chili
ingredients: 1 can rotel tomatoes, drained | 1/2 cup sweet chili paste | 1 cup packed chocolate squares | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Heat the rotel and sweet chili paste in a microwave safe bowl or skillet on high until the mixture is hot and beginning to bubble. Stir in the chocolate and garam masala, then let stand 1 to 2 minutes.

title: Watercress and Jalapeno Dressing
ingredients: 1 bunch watercress | 1 cup jalapeno heat ( i recommend jalapenos from a jar ) | salt | 2 teaspoons miso
instructions: Using a mortar and pestle, pound dried watercress until finely chopped. Add jalapenos and mix. Add salt to taste. Enjoy the smell is amazing.

title: Creamy Chocolate Ripple Pie

instructions: Combine the dry ingredients. Make sure mixture is not too solid as this might be hard to do right if it is, mix in the cream until dough is soft. Place dough in a piping bag with a large star tip, then twist the excess dough to separate it out. Press into a 30cm round baking dish. Pour all the filling into the pastry shell. Top with sprinkles of desired topping and leave in a fridge to set. Preheat oven to 190 degrees celsius. Place ramekin on a baking tray on a baking tray and bake for 15 minutes or until it is slightly browned on top.

title: Italian Crab
ingredients: 1 box frozen broccoli florets | 1 box crabmeat | 1/2 cup shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese | 1 tablespoon baking powder | 1/2 cup sugar
instructions: Cook broccoli according to package directions, stirring frequently. Combine sauce ingredients and pour over hot cooked broccoli. Sprinkle with mozzarella cheese and mix well.

title: Braised Pork Tenderloin

instructions: Preheat large cast iron skillet or other oven safe skillet on high heat for 3 - 4 minutes. Turn skillet and turn the temperature down to medium and add pork. Reduce heat to medium and cook covered for about 20 minutes, until meat thermometer registers 170 degrees f and juices run clear.

title: Crunchy Cornflake Crackle Crackers
ingredients: 2 cups frozen corn flakes, thawed | 3/4 cup dark soy sauce | 1/2 cup dry cornstarch | 3/4 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees celsius. Put the cornflakes, soy sauce, cornstarch, soda in a bowl and gently mix. Using 2 tbsp of the mixture, drop the mixture onto a baking tray or baking paper lined with baking paper. Press the crests into the crumbly crumbs by pressing the crumbs together with thumb. Bake on the middle shelf of the oven for about 25 minutes. Cut into halves while warm.

instructions: Place rutabagas in a medium saucepan, cover with water and bring to a boil. Cook until just tender but still firm, about 15 minutes.

title: Carolina Pork Empanadas

title: Beer and Cremini Mushrooms
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke | 1 portabella mushroom, finely diced | 2 tablespoons beer | 2 tablespoons andouille sausage, diced | 4 cremini mushrooms, chopped
instructions: In a non stick skillet cook and stir the first 3 ingredients over medium heat until the portabella mushroom is softened, taking care not to burn the portabella mushroom. title: Halibut a La Creole

instructions: Season halibut with salt and pepper. Place in greased baking dish, brown on both sides in a hot oil. While the halibut is cooking mix soup, cream and fennel seed. Sprinkle with cherry mixture.

title: Chocolate Mashed Potatoes

instructions: Place potato in a medium saucepan and cover with boiling water. Bring to the boil over medium heat, then boil until tender. Drain, return to pan and mash well with a potato masher. Stir in the yogurt, cocoa and salt. Cover and chill in the refrigerator until served.

title: Teriyaki Jicama
ingredients: 2 lbs jicama |  teriyaki sauce
instructions: Mix teriyaki and teriyaki together. Use as many teriyaki as necessary and marinate overnight. Slice jicama thinly, and fry. Serve as a side on jasmine rice, or use as a sandwich sandwich between the two.

Random Ingredients: corn cob,monterey jack pepper cheese,ra el hanout spice mix,guacamole,maple syrup,turmeric powder,corn kernel
title: Grilled Corn on the Cob
ingredients: 1/2 cup ra el hanout spice mix ( or store bought moroccan spice mix ) | 1/2 cup pure maple syrup | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 corn on the cob, cob removed | 2 corn on the cob, kernels cut out from cob ( corn with the cob may be substituted ) | 1 guacamole | 1/4 cup shredded monterey jack pepper cheese ( about 1/4 of a jar )
instructions: Brush grill with oil and heat over high. Stir together the spices until they are evenly distributed. Brush the corn with oil and grill on the rack until evenly marked and heated through, about 2 or 3 minutes.

title: Shrimp, Chipotle & Beef Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs meat, sliced into thin strips | 1 lb shrimp ( raw and peeled ) | 2 -3 stalks lemongrass ( bruised ) | 1 teaspoon minced chipotle chile in adobo ( or to taste ) | 1 tablespoon salad oil | 2 -3 tablespoons peanut butter | 1/2 cup shredded courgette
instructions: Slice the meat thinly and slice or shred the shrimp. Trim and rinse the lemongrass and shred finely. Heat a little oil in a wok or saute pan. Fry the meat for about 2 minutes then add lemon grass and stir fry for 1 minute. Add the chile paste and stir fry for another minute. Add salad dressing, peanuts and courgette and stir in the meat. Allow it to meld and the rest of the salad to marinade in the refrigerator for about 30 minutes before serving.

title: Braised Sea Bass With Purslane and Red Currant Jelly
ingredients: 2 red currant jelly | 2 lbs sea bass fillet | 1 jar red currant jelly
instructions: Heat a grill pan over high heat. Brush the fish with 1/3 cup red currant jelly and set aside. Add remaining red currant jelly. Place fish in the pan and turn once, cooking to your liking. Cook for 1 minute on each side or until very rare. To serve place fillet on a platter and spoon remaining red currant jelly over top.

title: Bitter Potato Muffins
ingredients: 1 medium baking potato, peeled, cubed and cooked | 1 can chunkier cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup quince, chopped | 1/2 a can mexicorn, drained | 1 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix together the potatoes, soup, quince, and masala. Stir in the corn. Spoon into greased muffin pans. Bake 25 to 30 minutes in the preheated oven, or until center of each muffin is hot and top is slightly browned.

title: Spicy Chilli Beans
ingredients: 2 cans chili-infused beans | 400 g water chestnuts, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon grand marnier, plus extra to serve
instructions: Rinse the beans under running water and then drain well. Combine beans, water chestnuts, grand marnier and extra grand marnier in a saucepan.

Random Ingredients: farina,cherry,yellow bell pepper,green lentil,salt black pepper,rice vinegar
title: Gramma's Fat Free Browned Pepper Lentils With Cherry and Rice Vinegar
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups green lentils ( white kidney ) | 1 cup rice vinegar ( i use red, but i wouldn't substitute white ) | 2 pints cherries, with pits removed, reserve pits | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped yellow bell pepper | 2 tablespoons farina | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Bring to a boil the red wine, then lower the heat to medium and simmer for 30 minutes to an hour or until the water is absorbed and the lentils are tender. Drain the lentils well and add to a pan with the rice vinegar. Turn up the heat and simmer gently for another 10 minutes, then remove from the heat. Transfer the lentils and their liquid to a bowl and let cool to room temperature. Grate the pepper using the coarse chopsticks or use a zester if you really like the color. Reserve the cherry pits, and add to the tomato and clam sauce. Season the farina with salt and pepper. If it still tastes a little tart, let it sit in the fridge, and if it starts getting too hard to stir, just add a little more farina. Once the lentils are cold you can start to stir them every now and then, stirring well after every stir in, so they don't stick together. When they are tender or your guests start eating, make sure to leave them to wait until the last step.

Random Ingredients: milk chocolate,black pepper,chestnut mushroom,pork stew meat,apple juice
title: Apple Chocolate-Shaped Beef With Mushrooms
ingredients: 800 g pork stew meat, trimmed of fat, cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes | 3 1/2 fluid ounces apple juice | 200 g baby portabella mushrooms, halved ( mixed chestnuts, chanterelles, crimini, red capsicum ) | 100 g milk chocolate, chopped | black pepper, to taste
instructions: Place all of the ingredients except the black pepper in a large baking dish and stir to combine. Season with salt and pepper. Bake, uncovered, in a moderate oven for 40 minutes, stirring twice, until the sauce is dark and thickened and the pork has softened. Serve with the remaining sauce to dip.

title: Raspberry Barley Beef Pudding
ingredients: 225 g barley | 1 liter beef stock | 450 g frozen raspberries
instructions: Put the meat into a saucepan with the beef stock and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat and simmer for about half an hour, stirring occasionally. Meanwhile, boil the barley in a pot of water with about a cup or so of water until tender. Drain well and, when the meat is tender, add the barley to the pudding and mix well. Put into a oven proof dish and put into a 180°c slow oven. Cook for 45 minutes at 180°c watch and stir when the pudding has set, if necessary, break up a few raspberries with a fork, add them and stir through.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,golden raisin,taco seasoning mix,herb,apple
title: Apple and Golden Raisin Salad
ingredients: 4 apples, finely diced ( i like red delicious ) | 4 ounces golden raisins, soaked and drained | 1 tablespoon dried herb or 1 tablespoon oregano | 1/2 lemon, juice and zest of, grated | 2 tablespoons taco seasoning mix
instructions: Put peeled and diced apples in a large bowl with all the raisins. Add all the dry herbs or dried oregano. Add the juice and zest and mix. You can add more lemon to taste. The salad tastes better if the apple is a little mushy. Chill and serve over salad.

Random Ingredients: chicken leg,graham cracker,topside steak,bailey irish cream
title: Smoked King of Beef
ingredients: 4 small smoked king of beef | 4 smoked topside steaks | 1 cup baileys irish cream | 1 package graham crackers
instructions: Bake or grill each steak until it is cooked to your liking. Remove from oven and slice each piece crosswise. Place in pan and keep warm. Whip cream and pour over meat to coat. Cover and refrigerate for 20 minutes. Slice and serve with horseradish cream. Place 1 graham cracker in each hand and top with some of the irish cream.

title: Veal-Pate
ingredients: 2 lbs veal, cubed | 1/2 teaspoon green cardamom pods
instructions: Place veal cubes in large dish. Sprinkle with green cardamom pods. Cover with water. Let stand overnight. Bring to boil. Lower heat, cover and simmer 1 to 1 1/2 hours 1 1/2 hours or until veal is cooked.

title: Fish Tacos
ingredients: 3/4 lb ground beef | 1 tablespoon shortening | 1 can beef broth | 16 ounces frozen white beans, drained and rinsed | 1 cup seedless grapes | 1 cup chopped red cabbage | 4 small refrigerated low-sodium rotisserie-cooked fish sticks ( optional ) | 1/4 cup guacamole ( optional )
instructions: Brown beef in shortening in large skillet over medium high heat. Gradually stir in broth and beans.

Random Ingredients: potato,mustard seed,apricot jam,french bread,romaine lettuce leaf
title: French Style Crisp Potato Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs leftover potatoes, peeled, cut into chunks | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 cup sweetened apricot jam | 1/2 lb romaine lettuce leaf, leaves | 2 -4 slices crusty french bread
instructions: Place potatoes and mustard seeds in a large pot of boiling water, cook until tender, about 10 - 15 minutes. Drain, cool and mash potatoes with jam. To assemble, place 1 tablespoon of mashed potato on top of each lettuce leaf, on the side of the bread slices, and drizzle with a small bit of jam.

Random Ingredients: marjoram,garlic salt,self raising flour,coffee,malt vinegar,colby monterey jack cheese,beetroot,veal
title: Beetroot & Cheese Griddle Fritters
ingredients: 2 1/4 cups self-raising flour | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1 teaspoon salt | 1 1/2 teaspoons garlic salt | 80 g colby-monterey jack cheese ( grated ) | 3/4 cup beetroot ( finely diced ) | 500 g colby-monterey jack cheese ( grated ) | 3 tablespoons strong coffee | 1 tablespoon malt vinegar
instructions: Heat oven to 200c/fan forced/ 200°c grease baking tray/girdlin tin. Sift flour, marjoram, salt and garlic salt into medium bowl then stir in the cheese, beetroot, colby grated cheese and coffee. Using hands, form dough into 2 inch diameter discs and transfer to prepared tray/girdlin tin. Using fingertips, mould onto baking tray/ginger and bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly golden and cooked through.

Random Ingredients: rotel tomato,greek yogurt,baby carrot,clove,vegetable shortening,apricot nectar,pecan
title: Mexican Pecan Crusted Carrots
ingredients:
2 tablespoons vegetable shortening or 2 tablespoons butter | 3 medium yellow peeled carrots, about 1 pound | 1 can rotel tomatoes ( or to taste ) | 1 cup quick cooking greek yogurt ( about 4 oz.
    - ) | 0.
    -5 can apricot nectar ( about 1 cup ) | 1/4 cup chopped pecans
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. In a large skillet, melt shortening. Add carrots and cook over medium high heat until lightly browned, about 5 minutes. Stir in rotel, greek yogurt, apricot nectar and pecans and heat through stirring often.

title: Chutney Beets
ingredients: 6 cups beets, cooked ( with juice ) | 8 ounces lasagna noodles | 1 tablespoon tamarind chutney | 1/4 teaspoon allspice | 1/4 teaspoon ground cumin
instructions: Cut beetroot into cubes. Boil in water and tamarind for 10 minutes. Rinse with cold water and drain. Set aside. In a large saucepan over heat, add chutney and stir until melted. Add beetroot and spices. Cover saucepan with lid or foil. Add the beets to the sauce and simmer. Cook for about 30 minutes stirring occasionally until cooked.

Random Ingredients: brown lentil,fine sea salt,black bean,raisin,mustard seed,large shrimp
title: Brazilian Black Beans and Shrimp With Raisins
ingredients:
2 tablespoons brown lentils, rinsed and dried through a fine sieve | 1 1/2 lbs large shrimp, peeled, deveined, and butterflied | 4 1/2 teaspoons mustard seeds | 1/2 teaspoon fine sea salt | 6 cups cooked black beans ( from 1 1/4 lbs.
    - cans ) | 1/3 cup raisins
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the lentils and shrimp with the mustard seeds, salt and beans and mix well. In the microwave, cook the shrimp in boiling water just until just done, 5 to 7 minutes for shrimp and 6 to 7 minutes for beans. Transfer the mixture to a 3 to 4 quart slow cooker and cover. Cook on low 5 minutes, or on high 2 hours. Stir the beans, shrimp, raisins and any accumulated juices from the slow cooker.

title: Non-Yogurt Lassi
ingredients: 4 teaspoons non-fat vanilla yogurt | 1/2 tablespoon dry sherry
instructions: Pour the dry yogurt into a clean tupperware container, adding the sherry and stirring gently to combine. Cover and chill.

Random Ingredients: lime juice,chili powder,yellow squash,almond extract,ice water,apricot jam
title: Kariha
ingredients: 4 tablespoons apricot jam | 1 -2 teaspoon almond extract | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1 teaspoon lime juice | 2 cups ice water ( depending on how thick the jam is ) | 4 yellow squash or 4 zucchini
instructions: In a blender blend jam, almond extract, and chili powder together until smooth. With motor running add water in 2 parts increments till all water is incorporated. Pour jam mixture into serving glasses. Place squash and sliced zucchini into another glass. Pour almond and lime blend over zucchini. Enjoy.

title: Pasta With Piggy Belly
ingredients: 1 lb rigatoni pasta or 1 lb ziti pasta | 3 tablespoons catsup | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 1 package baby spinach, tightly packed | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
instructions: Boil rigatoni or ziti until just al dente. Drain thoroughly. Stir together catsup, 1/2 tsp cinnamon and salt. Spoon over cooked rigatoni or ziti and toss. Add spinach and sprinkle on 1 tsp cinnamon. Serve at once.

title: Kolachi Bread II
ingredients: 1 can refrigerated biscuit, cut into 1 inch squares | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Squeeze the biscuit pieces with your hands to remove as much of the air as possible from the biscuit squares. Stir flour, sesame oil, and cinnamon together in a large bowl until dough is well mixed. Roll dough into dough balls with moistened hands to coat, about 8 to 10 squares. Place on ungreased cookie sheets. Bake in preheated oven until golden, about 15 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Dressing for Ham and BBQ Meals
ingredients: 1/2 cup thousand island dressing | 1/2 cup peanut oil or 1/2 cup vegetable oil | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt or 1 teaspoon salt ( if using salt, use less salt )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and chill for 1 hour before eating. Takes 2 to 4 hours.

title: Easy Crock-Pot Pizza Beans & Pizzas
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans | 1 jar pizza sauce
instructions: Brown hamburger. Drain fat. In crock pot stir together beans and sauce. Cover and cook on low 8 - 10 hours.

title: French Fried Hash Browns
ingredients: 1 cup unsalted dry breadcrumbs | 8 medium russet potatoes | 1 can red enchilada sauce | 2 tablespoons sherry wine | 1 tablespoon catsup
instructions: Peel and smash the potatoes, set aside. Place in the bowl of blender the enchilada sauce, sherry and catsup/catsup and mix to combine. Heat a nonstick skillet on medium high. Dry the potatoes dry with paper towel or nonstick paper towels. Place about a tablespoon of the potatoes in the bottom of the skillet. Drizzle with the enchilada sauce. Fry, flipping once, until the potatoes are deep golden brown on both sides, about 12 - 15 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Punjab Herb Mix
ingredients: 1 tablespoon marjoram | 1 tablespoon cumin powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Serve over bread. For vegetarian use vegetable and meat. For vegetarian use vegetable oil.

Random Ingredients: yellow onion,double cream,white poppy seed,oyster mushroom,ricotta cheese,celeriac,rice vinegar
title: Wild Mushroom Stroganoff (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 2 packages light ricotta cheese, low fat is fine, strained and cut in small pieces | 1/2 cup yellow onion, chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons oyster mushrooms, drained and chopped | 1/4 cup celeriac, chopped | 1/4 cup white poppy seeds, roasted | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1 pint double cream, whipped until stiff
instructions: Filling, mix the mushroom, garlic, garlic, onion, oyster mushrooms, celery & poppyseed into the ricotta cheese. Mix well. Add vinegar & whip the cream until stiff peaks form. Pour the cream over the mushroom mixture & toss lightly. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving. Serve over noodles or rice.

Random Ingredients: chuck roast,black eyed pea,pork stew meat,yellow squash,red onion,lime zest,wine,red chili pepper
title: Black-Eyed Pea and Pork Stew
ingredients: 1 teaspoon red chili pepper, seeded ( optional ) | 4 lbs boneless chuck roast, in 1 to 1 1/2-inch cubes | 1 1/2 lbs pork stew meat, in 1-inch cubes | 2 cups yellow squash, in 1-inch cubes | 2 tablespoons wine | 1 cup black-eyed peas, drained ( white or yellow ) | 1 red onion, coarsely chopped | 2 teaspoons fresh lime zest, grated
instructions: Heat an 8 - 10 inch cast iron skillet over medium high heat until it is just beginning to smoke. In a large bowl, toss together the chile pepper, chuck, pork, squash, wine and beans. Season to taste with salt. Cover and cook for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Uncover.

Random Ingredients: marinara sauce,white onion,coconut cream,cream tartar,cider vinegar,brown sugar,meat
title: Coconut and Onion Salad Dressing
ingredients: 3/4 cup finely chopped white onion | 1/2 cup dry shredded coconut | 1 1/2 cups marinara sauce, divided ( store bought or homemade ) | 3 tablespoons brown sugar | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 lb cooked meat, diced ( leftover from a roast is good-see note below )
instructions: Place onion and coconut in a mixing bowl with 1 cup of marinara sauce. Stir to combine. Add remaining marinara sauce, brown sugar, cider vinegar, and cream of tartar. Add meat and toss to coat. Divide salad between 2 salad plates. Top with salad dressing to taste and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: white corn,ginger paste,beef bouillon cube,chicken breast fillet
title: Simple Chicken and Corn (Pomverised)
ingredients: 1 1 lb chicken breast fillets or 1 lb chicken thighs ( i use boneless ) | 2 teaspoons ginger paste ( i use 1 tsp ) | 1 tablespoon beef bouillon cubes | 375 g white corn or 375 g green beans
instructions: In a large frying pan or wok fry off the chicken breast for 10mins or until it is lightly browned. Use a blender or food processor to puree up to 40 secs. Cut the leftover meat into chunks. You should have around 6 to 7tbsp of leftover meat and a dash of ginger paste. I usually just put it in a freezer bag and put it in an airtight container. Add the rest of the ginger paste and mix well. Add the beef and mix and cook for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add the corn or green beans. Mix together. Add the chicken and simmer for around 10 mins or until the chicken is cooked but still very tender and the beans are tender. You may also mix it together with a fork now or if not you should serve this with lots of plain rice or pasta. Note, the ginger paste can be substituted with salt and cayenne pepper.

title: Dolce's Grape and Bean Sprouts Phyllo
ingredients: 1 bag round bottom phyllo dough | 1 cup grape, sliced small | 1 cup bean sprouts | 1/4 cup rolled oats | 1/4 cup white sugar | 1/8 teaspoon cardamom pods
instructions: Place 1/2 bag of the grape in a microwavable bowl and cover with 1/2 bag of sprouts. Microwave on high for 3 - 4 minutes. Add 1/4 bag of sprouts in a small stream onto the phyllo. Sprinkle with 1/4 cup of sugar and cardamom. Roll and cut in the sheet about 2 inches apart. Bake at 350 degrees f for 15 - 20 minutes until browned. Serve with cool whip or ice cream.

Random Ingredients: celery salt,egg beater substitute,half,large shrimp,potato,taco seasoning mix
title: Spicy Spanish Seafood
ingredients: 1/2 cup egg substitute | 1/2 cup half-and-half | 1/2 teaspoon celery salt | 1/4 teaspoon taco seasoning mix | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon potatoato flakes or 1/2-3/4 teaspoon potato flakes, for texture
instructions: Mix together all ingredients in a bowl. Cover and refrigerate until ready to cook shrimp. Spray pan with nonstick pan spray. Use cooking spray. Heat pan until butter just starts to smoke. Add shrimp to pan. Cook and stir until pink. Do not pan cook until the shrimp are pink. It won't take long than 2 - 4 minutes. Add potato flakes to shrimp. Enjoy.

title: Low Fat Mayonnaise Mayonnaise
ingredients: 1/2 cup egg substitute | 1/2 cup mayonnaise
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Let rest at room temperature for 1 hour. Serve over cooked, hard, crunchy veggies or crackers. Serve with crispbread.

Random Ingredients: bamboo shoot,pesto sauce,red bell pepper,chili,shortening,apple juice,canola oil,rice wine
title: Crispy Red Bell Pepper Rice (Paleo)
ingredients: 1/2 lb red bell peppers or 1/2 lb green bell pepper, cut lengthwise in 1/2 | 1/8 teaspoon chili | 1 - 1 1/2 cup canola oil | 1/3 cup pesto sauce | 1/2 cup apple juice | 1 cup water | 1 tablespoon rice wine | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained
instructions: Cut bell pepper into 1/2 inch chunks, place in medium sized bowl and sprinkle with chili. Wrap bell pepper in foil and place in a shallow bowl or roasting pan. Drizzle 1/2 cup oil over peppers and stir just until peppers soften. Add pesto and mix until pesto is absorbed evenly. Pour remaining oil over peppers. Mix apple juice and water well. Pour a scant 1/2 cup of liquid over peppers, cover tightly and refrigerate at least one hour. Add rice wine and bamboo shoots to bell pepper mixture and cook until sauce thickens. Serve while warm.

title: Apple Enriche (Toscaboard Pocket)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons whole-wheat turbinado sugar or 2 tablespoons superfine sugar | 8 tablespoons light vanilla or 8 tablespoons vanilla extract | 8 tablespoons italian stewed tomatoes, coarsely chopped | 4 hard-boiled eggs, thinly sliced | 1 small apple, peeled, cored and thinly sliced | 1 puff pastry sheet, thawed if frozen
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f in a small mixing bowl, mix the sugar and vanilla with one tablespoon of water. Place the stewed tomatoes on a baking sheet, then top with the tomatoes, remaining teaspoon sugar and egg slices, apple and remaining teaspoon sugar. Bake in the oven for about 20 minutes. Remove from the oven and cut in half, releasing individual squares. Return to the oven and bake for an additional 5 minutes or until the cookies are golden brown the way you like them.

title: Drunken Caramelized Caramelized Gorgonzola
ingredients: 1 bottle beer | 1 lemon, halved | 2 pinches curry | 1 vanilla bean, sliced | 1 1/4 pounds gorgonzola cheese, shredded | vegetable oil for frying
instructions: In a large glass or ceramic bowl, mix beer, lemon halves, curry, and vanilla. Slice the vanilla bean lengthwise, squeeze out excess juice, and place inside of the beer. Place cheese in a layer over the caramelized mixture. Cover, and refrigerate for 1 hour. Preheat grill for medium heat. Brush the grilling surface with oil, and place the carmelized gorgonzola on the grilling surface. Grill just until cheese is melted, 1 to 2 minutes on each side.

title: Baked Irish Dubliner Cheese
ingredients: 3 large spring onions, cut into 1/2-inch lengths | 1 pound cheddar cheese, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup whiskey
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Arrange the spring onions and cheddar cheese on a baking sheet. Cover with aluminum foil. Bake for 20 minutes in the preheated oven. Remove the foil, sprinkle the remaining cheddar cheese on top, and bake for another 5 minutes, just until the cheese is browned. Watch carefully after 5 minutes to ensure the cheese doesn't burn. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: green bean,vegetable broth,peanut butter,red wine vinegar,serrano pepper
title:
Spicy Peanut Butter Green Beans, Garlic and Serrano Peppers.
