ingredients: 3/4 lb green beans, cut into 1/2 inch diagonals | 1 -2 serrano pepper, seeded & thinly sliced in narrow strips | 3 tablespoons smooth peanut butter | 1/2 - 3/4 cup vegetable broth | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar, plus more for drizzling
instructions: In a large skillet, saute the green beans and peppers in the peanut butter on low heat, stirring frequently, for about 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pepperoncini pepper juice,tzatziki,monterey jack cheese,phyllo dough,lemon peel,garlic salt
title: Vegetable Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 1 box frozen chopped pepperoncini peppers, thawed and juice divided | 1/2 cup finely chopped pepperoncini pepper with juice | 1/2 cup finely chopped tzatziki ( kikkoman's sweet spread ) | 1 tablespoon minced lemon peel | 3/4 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 package frozen phyllo dough, thawed | 8 ounces shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Grease a 13x9 inch baking dish and line the bottom with parchment paper. Stir 1 tablespoon of the pepperoncini juice, 1/2 cup of the pepperoncini, pepper, tzatziki, lemon peel and garlic salt together in a large bowl. Place 3 sheets of phyllo in the prepared baking dish, brushing each with melted butter. Repeat with 12 phyllo sheets, brushing each sheet with melted butter and finishing with 3 sheets of melted butter. Spread pepperoncini mixture evenly over phyllo sheets, brushing each layer with melted butter. Top with 9 layers of phyllo, brushing each with melted butter. Spread 1/2 the remaining pepperoncini mixture evenly over phyllo sheets. Top with 11 sheets of phyllo, brushing each with melted butter. Spread 1/2 the remaining pepperoncini mixture over phyllo layers. Top with 12 sheets of phyllo, brushing each with melted butter. Repeat layering with remaining 8 sheets of pepperoncini, 3 sheets of pepperoncini, 3 sheets of pepperoncini, 3 sheets of pepperoncini, and 1 tablespoon of pepperoncini juice. Top with 9 sheets of phyllo, brushing each with melted butter. Cover baking dish with foil and bake for 50 minutes, then uncover and sprinkle with monterrey jack cheese. Bake for 30 minutes, or until bottom is golden brown.

title: Baked Parsnips
ingredients: 1 lb parsnip, peeled, and chopped | 3 tablespoons sweet papayas, minced ( sweet )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Remove parsnips from their stems and finely chop the stem ends from the parsnips. Place parsnips in a glass baking dish and set aside. Combine papaya and 1/2 teaspoon salt in a small bowl until well mixed. Spoon papaya mixture over parsnips, sprinkle with papaya mixture and toss to coat well. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes, tossing halfway through cooking.

title: Gelatin Sauce for Vegetables
ingredients: 1 teaspoon sesame seeds | 6 tablespoons green onions, chopped | 1 teaspoon gelatin powder | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract ( optional )
instructions: Sprinkle the sesame seeds all over the vegetable or fish pieces. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over vegetables, mashing the vegetables with a fork. Cover and set in the refrigerator to chill and firm up for at least an hour. Serve cold or at room temperature.

title: Sausages and English Mustard
ingredients: 2 teaspoons black sesame seed | 1 tablespoon instant english mustard | 5 lbs pork sausages
instructions: Preheat oven to 250f degrees. Spread the sesame seeds onto the flat of a cookie sheet. Toast the sesame seeds over the lowest oven rack until a light golden brown, about 15 minutes. Spread the sesame seeds onto a flat plate. In a large, straight sided sauté pan or frying pan, fry the sausages until cooked through, browned and cooked through, about 7 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the sausages to the prepared cookie sheet. Turn the heat down to 300f degrees. Cook until the sausages are dry, but not browned, about 3 to 6 minutes. Using the back of a spoon, gently press the sesame seeds onto the sesame seeds. Allow to cool before serving.

title: Gourmet Gummy worms
ingredients: 1 small gummy worms | 5 -6 tablespoons madeira wine | 2 1/2 celery ribs | fresh ginger, chopped | 1 tablespoon walnuts, finely chopped, toasted
instructions: Heat gummy worms in a pan, add madeira and stir. Serve gummy worms with a sprinkle of chopped fresh ginger.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,romaine lettuce,hunt tomato sauce,worcestershire sauce,mandarin orange,tart apple,chili powder
title: Easy Mexican Salad
ingredients: 3 tart apples | 1 can low-sodium hunts tomato sauce | 1/2 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1/4 teaspoon chili powder | 2 tablespoons grand marnier ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons catalina locatelli or 2 tablespoons other light salad dressing | 3 romaine lettuce, cored
instructions: Core and dice apples, and place in a large serving bowl. In another small bowl, stir well, tomato sauce, worcestershire sauce, chili powder and grand marnier, if using. Pour over apples. Top with romaine lettuce.

title: Cheese and Cranberry Salad
ingredients: 4 cups grated monterey jack cheese | 1 cup crushed poppy seeds | 1/2 cup fresh cranberries, chopped
instructions: In large bowl toss cheese with poppy seeds and cranberries.

title: Brussels Sprouts With Yogurt
ingredients: 1 package brussels sprouts, trimmed and halved | 1/2 cup plain yogurt
instructions: Steam brussels sprouts for 3 to 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: mustard powder,mustard,adobo sauce,vodka,salami,peach juice,green chili pepper
title: Spicy Cuban Salad
ingredients: 4 ounces salami | 1/4 cup mustard powder | 1 tablespoon dry mustard | 1 jar pickled hot green chili peppers, chopped | 1/2 cup peach juice | 1 tablespoon canned chipotle-infused vodka | 1 tablespoon dijon-style prepared mustard
instructions: Arrange salami on two plates. Combine mustards and chilies, add juice and stir well. Drizzle with the vodka and mustard dressing, and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,pineapple,jigger triple sec liqueur,sirloin
title: Cinco De Res (Brazilian Burger)
ingredients: 1 cup crushed pineapple | 1 tablespoon chopped yellow bell pepper | 1 jigger triple sec liqueur ( optional ) | 1 1/2 pounds ground sirloin
instructions: Prepare an ice cold outdoor grill for high heat and lightly oil grate. In a medium bowl, mix the crushed pineapple, yellow bell pepper and triple sec liqueur. Divide the ground sirloin into 4 small patties. Coat a cast iron skillet with cooking spray.

title: Lomo Saltado (Poppy Seed and Corn Chips)

instructions: In a bowl, mix the potatoes, corn niblets, corn molasses, white wine and poppy seeds. Heat a small nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add the mixture a teaspoonful at a time, stirring until the corn oil begins to separate and the potatoes browned on the bottom, about 5 minutes. Random Ingredients: flax seed meal,pesto sauce,red chili pepper

title: Roasted Apricot Pizza
ingredients: 1 prepared pizza crust ( i use boboli ) | 1 teaspoon smoked paprika | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 2 tablespoons espresso ( i strongly recommend instant ) | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce
instructions: Preheat your oven to 375 fahrenheit. Spread 1/2 the light soy sauce in the pizza crust, then spread with olive oil and the dark sauce, then top with your other pizza crust. title: Mexican Pork Sandwiches

instructions: Spray a loaf pan with pam. Cut the roast in half. Remove as much fat as possible from the meat and shred as fine as you can. Put all ingredients except pecans, in bottom of loaf pan. title: Pumpkin Candy 1999(Caled in Spice)
ingredients:
3 lbs light brown sugar ( dr.
    - oetker's tan colored is the best ) | 3/4 cup freshly squeezed orange juice
instructions: In a deep dish pie pan or roasting pan that has been coated with nonstick spray, melt brown sugar over medium heat. When you first began, the brown sugar should be light brown and just starting to brown. Watch and stir constantly to avoid burning, and do not walk away from pan until the mixture is a deep amber colored. Be careful with this point since it burns easily, because it burns fast. It is imperative to not walk away while reducing or stirring. When the mixture will suddenly start to burn, remove from heat and allow to sit for three to six hours. Be very careful, this is about the time you feel most comfortable to remove the pan from the heat and start testing the candy with a large, flat knife it should start peeling off the small pith and be very light brown and still has some burned lines sticking out of it. Move the knife under the small cuts until the knife is clean. Once the candy has cooled to room temperature, mix the orange juice with the caramel. Do not stir the mixture again, but do slowly pour it into the dish as much as you can with a large spoon. Then, pour the mixture on top of the candy mixture and let it stand for a day or two. When the mixture sets, it will break off a piece of candied peel from the side of the cake and be easier to roll out. You can peel off one of the candied peel after it has been set. But don't take off the peel before you go to this step. You will need an airtight container, such as a small jar of baker's candies, for candy coating. Store the candies in a cool, dark place. It will keep a pretty dry place for years and years.

title: Rum, Jam & Rum
