title: Sauza® Oven Beef Burgundy
ingredients: 1 package extra lean ground beef | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 2 large green mushrooms, sliced or sliced | 1 large banana, sliced
instructions: Heat oven to 200c or 450°f. In a large, oven proof skillet over medium heat, combine the ground beef, worcestershire sauce, garlic salt, tabasco sauce and mushrooms breaking up the beef with two fingers as you go. Stir to combine well and place into the oven when the temperature is approximately 200c / 450f. Cook for 15 minutes, stir or turn as needed, until the beef is cooked to your liking and then remove from the oven. Stir fry the bananas until cooked through and remove from the pan. Serve the beef mixture over the cooked mashed potatoes with lots of gravy or serve it as a side dish.

title: Potato Soup
ingredients: 5 good sized russet potatoes, peeled and chopped | 1 1/2 - 2 3 pints chicken stock powder
instructions: Put everything in a large pot, with a few pints of water. Cover, bring to just under the boil, and cook, shaking the pot until the mixture turns a very pale gold color and is quite soft. You will need to stir the potatoes continuously, with a wooden spoon. Remove the pot from the heat. Set aside, cover and leave to cool off. When the mixture is quite cold, mix it thoroughly with your hands and a spoon or a blender. Take out a little of the excess liquid and put it into a bowl with the pot back over the cold potato water. Stir well, then leave it to cool. The soup can be kept, covered, in the refrigerator for several days, or even better overnight.

title: Quinoa Okra and Beef Skillet
ingredients: 2 cups quinoa, uncooked | 1 teaspoon golden syrup | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 1 teaspoon corn kernels ( frozen okra pods, thawed drained well ) | 1 package frozen okra ( thawed but fresh okra pieces could be substituted )
instructions: Brown okra pieces in oil in a deep frying pan in batches, tossing the okra with the okras. Add salt & pepper to taste. Serve over your favorite grain.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,pineapple,plain yogurt,sharp cheddar cheese,farfalle pasta,green chili pepper,ra el hanout spice mix,fine sea salt
title: Pineapple Fritters
ingredients: 1 package farfalle pasta | 1 cup sour cream or 1 cup greek yogurt | 1/2 cup chopped green chili pepper | 1/4 cup fresh pineapple, grated | 1/4 teaspoon fine sea salt | 1/4 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 1/2 teaspoon ras el hanout spice mix ( or mix of any curry paste your like with some chilli sauce ) ( optional ) | 1/4 cup dry plain yogurt
instructions: Cook the pasta in boiling water until al dente. Drain well. Place the sour cream, chilies, cheese, and seasoning in a bowl. To make the fritters, put the fritters in a serving dish, pour over the sour cream mixture and top with the yogurt.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast meat,pumpkin seed,star anise,pesto sauce,spinach
title: Thai Chicken With Pumpkin Seeds and Star Anise
ingredients: 1 boneless skinless chicken breast meat | 100 -150 g fresh spinach | 3 tablespoons pesto sauce | 1 star anise | 1 tablespoon pumpkin seeds
instructions: Dice chicken into bite size pieces, about 1 - 5 cm, removing any fat or gristle attached to bones. Place in a large non stick frying pan with a good amount of oil, pesto, star anise and pumpkin seeds. Stir fry for 5 minutes stirring to prevent burning. Add chicken, mix well. Allow to cook for about 10 - 15 minutes or until chicken is cooked through. This step was given to me as it was too dry, so i added a little extra milk or water if needed. Serve with boiled rice.

Random Ingredients: pine nut,chili oil,poppy seed,biscuit,large shrimp,fennel seed,parmesan cheese
title: Shrimp and Spinach Pizza
ingredients: 200 g sweet biscuits, round ( about 8 biscuits ) | 150 g peeled large shrimp, cooked ( or frozen ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons poppy seeds | 1/3 tablespoon fennel seed | 1 1/2 tablespoons parmesan cheese, grated ( optional ) | 1 -2 teaspoon chili oil ( optional ) | 1/3 cup pine nuts ( optional )
instructions: Heat grill. Remove biscuit packaging from package. Spread dough on lightly greased biscuit holes and bake at 180c for 12 - 13 minutes or until golden and crust is crisp.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,mutton,turmeric powder,kalamata olive,rice vinegar,kraft cheese
title: Kleftiko (Mutton Salad)
ingredients: 500 g mutton | 2 -3 teaspoons rice vinegar | 2 teaspoons red wine vinegar | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 200 -250 g kalamata olives, to garnish | 200 -250 g kraft cheese, cheese slices to serve
instructions: Rinse and pat meat dry with paper towel. In a bowl add the marinated meat, season with turmeric, 1/2 tablespoon of water and mix well. Cut cheese into cubes and thread onto skewers. Barbecue or grill meat until done, turning several times to ensure that cheese stays on skewers. To serve, put on serving plate and garnish with a few kalamata olives.

title: Corn Chips Chips and Tamarind
ingredients: 1 can tamarind pulp, drained | 1 tablespoon adobo seasoning | 1 teaspoon ground black pepper | 1/2 cup corn chips ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons tamarind pulp ( optional )
instructions: Put the drained tamarind pulp in a bowl, and mash to a pulp with the adobo, pepper, and corn chips. Add more tamarind pulp if desired.

Random Ingredients: margarine,white fish fillet,peanut,red chili powder,leek,bread flour,chicken breast half,lime
title: Thai Chicken Cutlets
ingredients: 200 g plain bread flour | 1 red chili powder | 75 g margarine or 75 g butter | 1 tablespoon minced leek | 4 chicken breast halves, cut into 3 cm slices | 150 g white fish fillets, chopped into 3 cm pieces | 3 slices roasted peanuts, chopped | 1/2 lime, cut into wedges
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190c/375f/gas place the flour in a medium bowl. Make a well in the centre and pour in the red chili or chilli powder. Using a pastry blender, mix the margarine or butter with the leek and then add it into the flour. Mix until the mixture is sticky. Add the chicken and gently toss to coat well. Sprinkle over chopped peanuts, mix and then scatter over the lemon wedges. Transfer to an ovenproof dish or baking paper lined with baking paper. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes until lightly browned on top. Serve with rice or noodles.

title: Irish Root Vegetable and Parsnip Kugel
ingredients: 3 medium red potatoes, scrubbed and cut in half | 4 large parsnips, scrubbed and cut crosswise into 1/4 inch slices | 1/2 cup red wine | 2 large egg whites
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Using about 1/4 pound of potatoes at a time, lightly peel and coarsely chop the remaining 5 to 6 potatoes, cutting into 1/4 inch slices. Slice the parsnips lengthwise into 1/4 inch slices and arrange them in a single layer on a parchment lined baking sheet. Brush the potatoes with beaten egg whites, and toss the slices with the parsnips and potato slices. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes in the preheated oven, or until crisp and golden brown. Keep an eye on them. Variation, instead of the potatoes, you can bake them in the oven for 40 minute.

Random Ingredients: porcini mushroom,baking powder,egg white,brandy,table salt,yellow squash,garam masala
title: Stufato Di Zuquinis (Yellow Squash Gratin)
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried porcini mushrooms | 1 tablespoon brandy | 1/3 cup raw egg white | 1/2 teaspoon garlicam masala or 1/2 teaspoon curry powder | 1/2 teaspoon table salt | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 1 small yellow squash, peeled ( about 1 lb ) | 1/4 cup chopped fresh basil
instructions: The mushrooms, in a small bowl, combine the mushrooms and their liquid with the brandy and let stand about 30 minutes to soften. The mushrooms will act as a muddler for the grinder. When they are slightly softened, peel back the outer layers, about 1/2 cup, and cut off any large bits of mushroom stems and any woody fibrous bits. Set aside. In a small bowl, beat the egg white until stiff peaks form. Stir in the garlic, curry powder, salt and baking powder until well combined. Peel the squash and cut into 1/2 inch chunks. Set aside. Lightly oil a 7 1/2 x 11 1/2 inch baking dish. Place the squash chunks in the baking dish, overlapping the edges slightly. Sprinkle in the mushroom mixture and basil. Dot with the reserved mushroom soaking liquid. Set aside, covered, while making the gratin. Preheat the grill to high, with the rack about 6 inches from the heat. When the grate is hot enough, place the gratains in a single layer on the grate, brush the grates with oil and allow the grates to turn. Grill until brown spots appear on the top, 1 to 2 minutes less of direct heat per side. If they are over direct heat, turn the grates again. Remove from the grill and cool on a wire rack for 8 minutes. Serve at once. Notes, the mushrooms soak the water they soaked in for 30 minutes then remove from the water, squeeze out excess water and slice off the soft stems. You may also use a canning jar to prep the mushrooms and assemble the gratin while at the same time. You should have 8 to 10 mushrooms in all. If you use the jars for mushrooms, measure 3 cups of soaking water and set aside. Drain the soaking water from the mushrooms and discard the liquid. You should have about 6 cups of soaking water and 3 cups of soaking liquid.

Random Ingredients: turmeric,cheese,mace,potato traditional,hoisin sauce,chicken bouillon granule,pumpkin seed,ham
title: Pumpkin Seed Cheesy Potatoes
ingredients: 1 package frozen mixed pumpkin seeds | 1/2 cup hoisin sauce | 1 ounce ham, finely diced | 1 cup potato traditional, mashed to soft mash, about 2 cups | 2 cloves garlic, crushed | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 2 tablespoons honey
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place prepared pumpkin seeds on a baking sheet and, bake, uncovered, for about 20 minutes, or until lightly browned and starting to blacken on the bottom. In a bowl, combine the hoisin sauce, ham, mashed potatoes, garlic, bouillon granules, and turmeric. Add honey. Spread mixture evenly on cooled pumpkin seeds. Bake, uncovered, for another 10 minutes, or until heated through and bubbling. You may spread on the pumpkin seeds with a spatula while cooking, then cool completely before storing in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: salt pork,white bread,monterey jack pepper cheese
title: Pigs in a Blanket
ingredients: 3 -4 slices day old white bread, toasted | 1/2 lb salt pork | 1 1/2 cups monterey jack pepper cheese, grated
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees. Cut bread slices in half lengthwise. Brush tops of toasted bread with a little water or olive oil. Drain a small amount of the melted butter, but do not dry out. On a clean surface, roll each piece of toast lightly with a rolling pin until it resembles a pencil. Lay them on greased baking sheet, leaving a little space between them. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Top with grated cheese. Bake about 15 to 20 minutes or until cheese is bubbly.

title: Easy Easy Taco Cookies
ingredients: 1 cup superfine sugar | 1 package taco seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Stir superfine sugar and taco seasoning in a bowl. Let stand 5 minutes. Stir in remaining sugar. Roll dough into small balls the size of a large marble. Cut each ball into six smaller cookies. Arrange on baking sheets lined with parchment paper. Bake in the preheated oven until cookie edges are just starting to turn golden brown, about 12 minutes.

title: Faux Vanilla Beef Tenderloin Sandwich
ingredients: 1 beef tenderloin | 2 -3 bananas | 1 tablespoon fresh marjoram leaves | 1 pint vanilla ice cream
instructions: Heat a fry pan on medium high heat. Place tenderloin in pan. Top with marjoram leaves and bananas. Place under broiler and cook about 2 minutes. Turn over and broil until entire surface of meat is lightly browned and tenderloin has reached desired doneness. Let stand for 2 - 3 minutes. Slice to serve and serve with warmed vanilla ice cream.

Random Ingredients: cream coconut,poblano chile,heavy cream,white tuna water,bacon,white wine,horseradish,cranberry juice
title: Cream of Tuna With Cranberry Salsa
ingredients: 2 cans solid white tuna packed in water ( undrained ) | 1 1/2 cups heavy cream | 1/2 lb bacon ( i prefer streaky bacon ) | 1 -2 poblano chile ( about 3 - 6 seeded and diced depending on how much heat i like ) | 1 cup fresh cranberry juice | 1/4 cup sour cream or 1/4 cup coconut cream | 1 tablespoon horseradish | 1/2 cup dry white wine, divided
instructions: Drain tuna and mash with a fork. If you do not like chunks of tuna, you may add the chunked tuna back to the blender and pulse to coarse chunks. Set aside. Melt lard in a 6 - 8 quart sauce pan set ove medium heat. When the lard is very hot, add the poblano and cook, until it turns dark red, being sure to scrape up any browned bits. Immediately add the poblanos and toss until lightly browned on all sides, about 2 - 3 minutes. Remove from heat and toss the poblanos with the bacon. Place the poblanos, poblanos and bacon in a shallow serving dish and cover with cream. In a small bowl, combine sour cream, horseradish and 1/2 cup of the white wine. Pour over tuna mixture. Chill the container until ready to use. Serve the salsa with warm pumpernickel bread.

title: French Fish Bake - Brussels
ingredients: 1 cup navy beans, soaked overnight then boiled | 2 -3 lbs cod or 2 -3 lbs haddock fillets | 3 red cabbage | 8 -12 ounces vegetable juice ( such as v8 ) | 8 cups cooked filleted sole fillet
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Rinse and pat dry beans. Arrange in a baking dish. Wash cabbage. Place fillets around fish. Pour v 8 juice over all. Cover and bake for at least 3 hours, but up to 1 1/2 hours.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,cottage cheese,onion salt,garlic salt,cod,cardamom
title: Ethiopian Fish Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs cod | 1/2 lb yellow bell pepper | 1 teaspoon cardamom | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 teaspoon onion salt | 1 container cottage cheese
instructions: Cut cod into 1 inch pieces. Peel and chop yellow bell pepper into 1 inch squares. Soak fish for about an hour by 8 hours. Remove fish from bones, cool, and remove bones, skin and bones. Put cleaned fish into a pot, cover with water, add all other ingredients and cook 45 minutes in the oven at 300 degrees fahrenheit.

title: Indian Chopped Leeks in Jelly
ingredients: 1 cup chopped leeks | 1 cup catalina dressing ( or white vinegar ) | 2 tablespoons pickle relish | 1 tablespoon garam masala | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1 1/2 teaspoons salt | 1 package jello gelatin
instructions: Heat oil in large skillet over medium heat. Add leeks. Cook, stirring occasionally, until tender. Do not allow leeks to brown. Stir occasionally. Add dressing, relish, garam masala, and salt. Heat through. Allow to cool. Fold in gelatin. Chill until set. Cut into squares.

title: Chourico Con Chourico ( Portuguese Christmas Bonfire Lard)
ingredients: 12 ounces lard | 1 1/2 lbs portuguese chourico | salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1 egg, beaten with 2 tablespoons water
instructions: Heat the lard in a heavy skillet over moderately high heat until small bubbles form on the surface but are not brown. Cut the chourico in half lengthwise, crosswise, and cut lengthwise into 1/2 inch slices. Rub the slices with 1/2 teaspoon salt, and sprinkle with 1/4 teaspoon pepper. Dip each slice in the beaten egg, then in the remaining salt and pepper and fry in the hot lard, turning them, until they are crisp. With tongs, transfer the finished chourico to a platter and serve at once.

title: Linguine With Mint
ingredients: 1 lb linguine | 1 celery rib, chopped | 1/2 cup of fresh mint, chopped, loosely packed
instructions: Cook linguine according to package directions. When done, drain, add mint and mix. Let sit until pasta absorbs salt and tastes of mintiness.

title: Peking Pork Chops with Salami
ingredients: 4 pork chops, large ( about 1 1/2 inches in diameter ) | 2 lbs salami | 1/2 teaspoon dried coriander powder | 2 cups half-and-half, nonfat is good
instructions: Trim ends and fat from pork chops then slash 1/2 inch deep slits in the outside of each pork chop. Place breaded chops, fat side up, on foil lined baking sheet. Bake at 400 degrees fahrenheit for 30 minutes. Arrange salami on top of pork chops and sprinkle with coriander & half & half mixture. Bake an additional 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: green chili pepper,fish sauce,taco seasoning,tofu,half,daikon radish,poblano chile
title: Baked Tofu With Chile-Fish Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 lb firm tofu, sliced into 4 x 1/2 thick sheets | 1 package taco seasoning | 2 green chili peppers, finely chopped | 1/2 poblano chile, finely chopped | 1/2 cup half-and-half | 1 cup half-and-half | 1 tablespoon fish sauce
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Place the tofu on a parchment lined baking sheet. With the flat of a table knife, spread the tofu evenly. Mix the taco seasoning and chile peppers in a shallow dish. Sprinkle half and half and fish sauce over tofu. Sprinkle more seafood seasoning over tofu. Spread the other half and half on top of tofu. Drizzle more of the spicy chili paste if desired. Bake the tofu in the oven for 15 minutes. Turn the oven down to 300 degrees. Continue baking, stirring every 10 minutes until the tofu is cooked through and the sauce is slightly thick. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: tawny port,salt pork,palm sugar,broccoli floret,poblano chile,cauliflower
title: Portuguese Cauliflower With Prawns
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs raw peeled prawns | 3/4 lb broccoli floret, cut into 2-inch florets | 1 cup tawny port | 1/4 cup palm sugar ( not fine ) | 1 large poblano chiles or 1 large dried mild-apricot | 1/2 teaspoon salt-free pork fat | 1 large cauliflower floret
instructions: Place prawns in a food processor.

Random Ingredients: crabmeat,kidney bean,manchego cheese,ketchup,vegetable stock chicken,olive,hot red chili pepper
title: Kidney Bean, Crab and Manchego Soup
ingredients: 4 hot red chili peppers | 1/2 cup olive, finely chopped | 3 ounces manchego cheese or 3 ounces other hard cheese, grated | 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 2 small tomatoes, diced | 1/2 cup mixed imitation crabmeat, picked and coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 6 cups vegetable stock or 6 cups chicken stock
instructions: Slice the chile peppers very thinly and set aside for later use. Heat 1/2 cup olive oil in a large frypan and fry the pepper slices for 15 - 20 minutes, until they soften. Transfer the peppers to a small colander, rinse and dry. Sprinkle the chile peppers with salt and set aside for 20 seconds. Remove the peppers then pat them dry. Cut the cheese into small cubes. Add in the beans, tomato, crabmeat, chili peppers, salt and cheese to the frypan. Pour in about 4 cups of hot stock or chicken stock and stir. The mixture should be thick. Add the remaining stock or stock in small increments as needed, adding more, if it is too much for your liking. Allow to boil for about 20 minutes and then serve hot with toasted crusty bread.

Random Ingredients: campbell southwest pepper jack soup,red wine vinegar
title: Crock Pot Spanish Onion Soup
ingredients: 1 can campbell southwest-style pepper jack soup | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar
instructions: Place pepper jack soup in crock pot. Pour in vinegar, stir. Cook on low for 2 hours.

title: Canadian Bacon & Bacon Sizzler
ingredients: 5 slices canadian bacon | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried sage | 1/4 cup picante sauce | 1/4 cup single cream, whipped | 2 teaspoons sesame oil | 1/2 cup guacamole
instructions: Place the bacon in the top half of a double broiler proof skillet over medium high heat. Sprinkle with the sage. Pour the picante sauce over the bacon. Place the bacon rack in a broiler pan, and place under the broiler. Broil until the bacon is well browned and crisp and just cooked through, and the edges are dry, 10 - 12 minutes. Cut the bacon slices into approximately 1/4 thick slices. Place the slices onto a platter. To serve, combine the whipped cream, sesame oil and guacamole in a small bowl. Spoon the cream mixture onto the bacon slices, and serve at once.

title: Italian Taro Root and Fry
ingredients: taro root | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 package frozen french fries, thawed or 5 pieces frozen french fries ( 6 pieces per bag ) | parmesan cheese ( to garnish )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f, spray a 9x13 inch casserole dish with cooking spray and set aside. If using frozen french fries, thaw them if fresh and slice 1/4 inch thick. Place taro root and 1 can tomato sauce in casserole dish and cook in preheated oven for 45 minutes. Stir in french fries or 5 pieces of french fries and parmesan cheese. Continue cooking, stirring every 10 minutes, until potatoes are crisp.

title: Tofu and Wild Rice (Gluten Free)
ingredients: 225 g extra firm tofu, drained and cut into 5cm cubes | 2 tablespoons currants | 1 teaspoon xanthan gum ( gluten free ) | 1 tablespoon dried coriander | fresh chili, minced ( to taste ) | 1/4 cup wild rice
instructions: Put tofu, currants, xanthan gum, coriander and chillies into a bowl and gently toss together to mix. Add rice and toss until combined well. Spoon mixture into rice bowls and add a sprinkling of ground chili pepper if desired.

title: Quick Shells With Alfredo and Green Beans
ingredients: 12 ounces alfredo sauce | 2 cups green beans, trimmed | 1 1/4 cups corona beer | 1 lb of small shell pasta shells, pre-cooked and drained
instructions: Prepare alfredo sauce according to direction on package, but with the green beans so that they are still slightly chunky. Add the alfredo sauce to a medium sized frying pan and heat on medium high heat. Once the green beans start to brighten, add the beer. Let cook for 2 minutes. Add pasta and mix. Reduce heat to medium to low and continue cooking 8 minutes. Serve.

title: Cauliflower Oaty Crumble
ingredients: 1 cup quick-cooking oats | 1/2 cup bread flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried oregano | 3/4 cup finely diced cauliflower florets | 1/4 cup quick-cooking oats | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 2 1/4 teaspoons dried cauliflower florets | 1/4 cup quick-cooking oats | 1/4 cup chopped fresh oregano
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Combine all the crumb ingredients except the dried and chopped oregano in a mixing bowl and stir well. Spread out the crumb mixture on a baking sheet, about 1” thick. Bake in the oven for about 15 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Avocado Salad
ingredients:
1 cup canned red beans ( i prefer red and lightly drained, but drained can be used.
    - ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup sliced black olives ( can use green ) | 1/8 cup chopped fresh coriander powder | 1 -2 teaspoon sambal olek thai basil or 1 -2 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 large ripe avocado ( approx 8-9 )
instructions: Cut up avocado and place in a bowl of salted water. Break apart avocado with a fork or knife. Add remaining ingredients to avocado and toss to coat. Cover and chill in refrigerator until serving time. Note, i serve the drained red beans in a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: meatball,oil peanut,onion powder,ra el hanout spice mix,tomato juice,sugar snap pea,kluski noodle,juniper berry
title: Sweet and Sour Meatballs
ingredients: 1 package kluski noodles | 1 lb lean precooked meatballs ( you can also use a meat of your choice, such as pattie or sirloin ) | 1/3 cup oil ( i used peanut oil ) | 1 finely chopped medium onion | 3 -4 tablespoons ras el hanout spice mix ( the algerian spice mix, found in the ethnic section of most departmental food stores ) | 2 -3 tablespoons sun dried tomatoes with juice ( i use sun dried tomatoes ) | 1 -2 teaspoon sugar snap pea, strings ( optional ) | 2 -3 dried juniper berries ( optional )
instructions: Start boiling water for noodles according to recipe. Meanwhile, put meatballs into a skillet. Place over medium heat and cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly browned. Set aside. When noodles are nearly done, pour off any excess water, return noodles to pot, and add 1/3 cup olive oil. Cover and simmer while making the other ingredients. Drain meatballs, remove bones and/or gristle, and set aside. While noodles are cooking, prepare sauce, add remaining 1/3 cup oil to a non stick skillet. Over medium high heat, brown onion, stirring, for about 3 minutes, or until it begins to soften but does not brown. Stir in seasoning spice mix and cook for 30 seconds. Stir in tomatoes with juice, stir in meatballs, onion and noodles. Stir in peas and berries, then serve warm.

title: Smoked Tofu and Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 1 lb brussels sprout ( washed, ends trimmed and cleaned or baby green sprouts ) | 4 -5 ounces firm tofu ( such as kofta zaar ) | lemon juice, a splash ( optional, if tofu has a salty flavor ) | 2 bay leaves, crushed
instructions: Cut the sprouts into 1/4 slices. Slice the tofu into 1/8 slices or 2 1/8 pieces and put it in a non stick pan with the bay leaves, lightly salted. Add the lemons, if using, and lightly grill for a few minutes, or until the edges curl, then turn and continue to grill until the tofu slices are charred all over and the sprouts are slightly softened. Serve straight away as a snack with chips, or as part of an antipasto meal. This recipe is fantastic in sandwiches, and in my case you could even use fresh lemon wedges along with it.

Random Ingredients: popped popcorn,cream tartar,chickpea flour,clam juice,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Quick and Easy English Clam and Popcorn
ingredients: 1 can minced clams, drained | 4 tablespoons cream of tartar | 1/4 cup bottled clam juice | 2 teaspoons peanut oil or 2 teaspoons vegetable oil | 1/2 cup chickpea flour ( available in health food aisle of your grocery store ) or 1/2 cup whole wheat flour ( available in health food aisle of your grocery store )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Lightly coat small casserole dish with cooking spray. Combine the clams, cream of tartar, clam juice, oil and chickpea flour in small bowl and stir well. Put about 2/3 cup of the mixture evenly in the prepared casserole dish and sprinkle with 1/3 cup water. Bake for about 20 minutes or until top is slightly golden, but slightly bubbly and bubbly around the edges.

title: Vegan Pasta Chips With a Bite!
ingredients: 4 bags rigatoni pasta | 16 ounces frozen hash browns | 8 ounces nutritional yeast | 1 lime | 8 ounces fresh rosemary ( cut into very thin slices )
instructions: Cook rigatoni according to the directions on the package, and drain. Place hashbrowns into a large mixing bowl or large ziploc bag. Slice lime in half, peel back half, and squeeze other half to get some of the juice and zest. Add nutritional yeast to bowl and mix. Add the lime zest and rosemary into bowl with the other ingredients. Set aside in the fridge. While tortilla chips are resting for the time you are cooking your chips, bring a large pot of heavily salted water to a boil and add noodles. While those are boiling, place frozen hashbrowns on plate and cover with aluminum foil. Place on low heat on your stove and start stirring every so often so they won't stick when they get soft. Cook for about 15 minutes or until chips are tender and liquid is absorbed. You can test for desired consistency with the consistency of the potato chips. When chips have finished cooking, drain them and add back to the potatoes. The idea is to get a good cheesy cheesy crust and texture, but not so much that the potato chips break apart, but that the nutritional yeast will actually melt the potato chips. Remove the pan from the heat. Portion out your chips onto plates or a plate of crackers and garnish with extra rosemary. Enjoy.

title: Greek Quinoa Salad (Yogurt)
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon cube | 1 3/4 ounces greek yogurt ( i prefer plain greek yogurt ) or 1 3/4 ounces feta cheese | 4 -5 bamboo skewers, soaked
instructions: Place quinoa in a bowl and pour boiling water over. Let stand and drain for 15 minutes. Rinse the quinoa with cold water and drain again. Pat dry with paper towel and transfer quinoa to a large bowl. Add the bouillon cube and half of the yogurt or feta cheese and mix gently. Add the quinoa and remaining yogurt and mix gently. Place bamboo skewers between 2 skewers and lightly brush with cooking oil. Grill over medium heat until toasted and lightly grill in toaster oven. Serve immediately.

title: Fish in Beets (Zwt II)
ingredients: 8 -12 small beets ( any colour but purple is good! ) | 3/4 lb cod fillet ( or other fresh fish ) | 1/4 teaspoon aniseed
instructions: Trim any very thick stems off the beets and place in a deep saucepan. Cover with cold water and add the 1/4 tsp aniseed or 3/4 tsp dried. Salt. Bring to the boil, partially cover and simmer slowly for 30 minutes. Remove from the heat and leave to stand for 5/10 minutes. Cut the fish into 1 inch thick slices. Pour the beets and their liquid into a shallow dish and sprinkle with salt. Cover and chill until serving..

title: Spiced Wedges
ingredients: 1 sheet puff pastry, thawed ( preferably use half a 6-sheet, 25cm x 14-inch ) | 3 tablespoons taco seasoning mix, divided | 1 lb swedes, cut into small chunks | 1 can diced mild green chilies, drained | 1/8 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Spray or grease a baking sheet. On a lightly floured surface, roll out thawed pastry to a 7 x 12 rectangle. Sprinkle with half the taco seasoning. Layer with half the corn, half the swedes, 2 tbsp taco seasoning and half the chilies. Fold pastry over to enclose the filling. Transfer to baking sheet. Repeat. Bake for 12 - 15 minutes or until crisp and golden. Serve with salsa on the side or on top of the wedges.

Random Ingredients: feta cheese,creme fraiche,bread crumb,beef stock,noodle,yukon gold potato,orange juice,dark sesame oil
title: Beef With Warm Potato Croquettes
ingredients: 1 lb yukon gold potato, peeled, cut into 1/4 inch dice | 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese | 4 -5 tablespoons crumbled goat cheese | 1/4 cup crumbled feta cheese | 1/4 cup dry bread crumbs | 1 teaspoon grated orange peel ( zest only ) | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1 cup beef stock | 1/4 cup vegetable stock | finely chopped fresh dill ( to garnish )
instructions: Cook the potatoes in lightly salted boiling water until tender.

title: Kirsch Koulourakia (Hot Milk Fudge)
ingredients: 2 cups whole milk | 1/2 cup kirsch | 10 egg yolks | 2 tablespoons cinnamon | 1 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Heat the milk and kirsch together until well boiling. Mix the egg yolks with the cinnamon and nutmeg. Beat the whole milk, egg yolk mixture, and kirsch together until creamy. Pour into a buttered pan. Do not stir. Put in the preheated oven. After 25 minutes, remove from the oven. Pour hot koulourakia onto individual plates and turn around quickly to coat the surface with the custard.

Random Ingredients: burrito flour tortilla,chicken breast half,wine vinegar,navy bean,sun tomato oil
title: Quick Chicken Nacho Burritos
ingredients: 2 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1 lb dried navy beans | 1/3 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon burrito-size flour tortillas
instructions: Put beans, tomatoes and sun dried tomatoes in a pot. Drain the water out of the beans then add chicken. Add vinegar. Simmer until chick is cooked and falling off the bone. Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in another skillet. Put in a burrito and put a little bit of chicken mixture in each. Top with more tortilla.

title: Cajun Style Feta
ingredients: 1 cup feta cheese, crumbled | 4 ounces fresh cilantro stems, coarsely chopped | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 4 fresh chilies
instructions: Using a pestle, crush aniseed and chiles into a fine powder. Combine feta, cilantro, and anise and stir in mixture. Refrigerate until serving.

title: Golden Raisin Soup
ingredients: 32 ounces chicken stock | 26 ounces golden tequila | 3 1/2 cups golden raisins | celery salt
instructions: Combine ingredients and heat until hot. Do not boil. Serve.

Random Ingredients: cake flour,dill,asparagus spear,red cherry,ginger garlic paste,lemon extract,hamburger,veal
title: Crispy Asparagus Kebabs (Aka, Beef or Lamb)
ingredients: 500 g hamburger | 300 g thin asparagus spears | 200 g red cherries, halved | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 tablespoon lemon extract | 1 tablespoon cake flour or 1 tablespoon wheat flour | 250 g sliced asparagus spears | 150 g red cherries, halved | 4 pieces preserved ginger-garlic paste | 60 g candied ginger-garlic pieces
instructions: Mix together all ingredients except the cherries or ginger into a large bowl. Using your hands, make kebabs about 60g each and leave to marinate for at least 2 hours at room temperature. Grill or bbq on both sides and serve.

Random Ingredients: orange roughy fillet,cilantro,okra,taco seasoning mix,phyllo pastry
title: Quick & Easy Fish Tacos
ingredients: 1 package phyllo pastry sheets | 1 package okra | 1 package orange roughy fillets, chopped fine | 1 package taco seasoning mix | cilantro ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Thaw fillets if frozen. In a large bowl mix all ingredients together, add salt to taste on the fish and mix well. Lay fillets on a parchment lined cookie sheet in a single layer and brush with olive oil. Bake in a preheated 450° oven for 15 minutes, or until the fish flakes easily when pulled apart with a fork. To serve, spoon some hot sauce down the center of each plate, and place a couple of okra slices on each side as they are being served. Garnish with cilantro.

Random Ingredients: asafoetida powder,bean sprout,beef roast,apple cider vinegar,extra virgin olive oil
title: Beef With Asafoetida and Apple Cider Vinegar
ingredients: 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 1/2 cup finely chopped apple cider vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1/4 lb lean boneless beef roast, well trimmed of fat and cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 cups lightly packed fresh bean sprouts
instructions: In a medium skillet heat the oil over moderately high heat until the oil is very hot but not smoking. Add the beef and sauté it until it is browned, about 5 minutes. Stir in the vinegar and asafoetida and simmer the mixture, stirring occasionally, until the vinegar has been absorbed, about 5 minutes. Add the beef and cook it over moderate heat until the sauce is thickened, about 10 minutes. Add the bean sprouts and cook a few seconds longer.

title: Tops Barley
ingredients: 1 teaspoon turbinado sugar | 1 1/4 lbs pearl barley, about 2 1/2 pounds
instructions: In a small saucepan, dissolve turbinado sugar over low heat. Raise heat and bring to a boil, then boil, uncovered, until amber in color. Remove from heat immediately.

title: Nori Shoyu Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cooked rice ( cold or cooked fresh ) | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 2 teaspoons dried shrimp ( powder or japanese mayonnaise )
instructions: Mix the cold or hot rice thoroughly or, if using, add the dry shrimp.

title: Salsa Verde
ingredients: 1 -2 lime, juice of | 1 bunch spring onion
instructions: Mix well and serve.

title: Chilli Pear Nests
ingredients: 750 g punnet courgettes, finely sliced | 75 g roasted peanuts, roughly chopped | 75 g dried pears, chopped | 50 g fresh coconut, grated | 1 red chile, chopped | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 25 m ritz cracker crumbs
instructions: Stir fry the carrot, peanuts, pears and chilli in half the sugar for 5 minutes, until just softened. Add the courgettes and a third of the crumbs and fry for 2 minutes. Push the mix to one side and stir in the rest. Toss through the remaining sugar and cracker crumbs. Serve at once. Enjoy.

title: Prosciutto & Mango Toss
ingredients: 2 -4 slices prosciutto | 1 large ripe mango, peeled & coarsely chopped | 1 bell pepper, chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla essence | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon
instructions: Slice the prosciutto into thin strips. Place all the ingredients in a bowl& mix. Serve on toast or crackers.

Random Ingredients: peanut butter,zucchini,turmeric powder,dark rum,hot paprika,chicken breast half,rose petal,cardamom pod
title: Thai Spiced Chicken and Roasted Vegetables
ingredients: 1 lb zucchini | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 3 tablespoons light peanut butter | 2 tablespoons dark rum | 2 tablespoons hot paprika | 2 tablespoons rose petals, chopped | 1/3 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves
instructions: Cut ends off zucchini, and cut sticks about 1/4 inch wide and about 1 inch long.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,mozzarella cheese,gouda cheese,pepper,baking powder,white onion
title: Quick Bread Dip
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese | 1 cup shredded smoked gouda cheese | 2 teaspoons baking powder | 1 large white onion, finely diced | freshly ground pepper, to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium mixing bowl add the soup and blend. Add the mozzarella and gouda and blend. Add the baking powder and mix well.

Random Ingredients: serrano pepper,lemon juice zest,pizza sauce,pizza dough,topping,broth,soy sauce
title: Thai Pizza
ingredients: 500 500 g frozen thawed pizza dough | 600 ml prepared pizza sauce | 100 ml low sodium soy sauce | 120 ml broth, canned | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1 serrano pepper ( finely ground ) | 1 teaspoon crushed dried pizza crust
instructions: Preheat oven to 190c. Combine ingredients in a medium bowl. Spread the pizza sauce on the top of the pizza base and sprinkle topping on with the zest. Bake 40 - 45 minutes, then remove from oven and serve.

Random Ingredients: kielbasa,taco seasoning,cream chicken soup,splenda granular,grain rice
title: Quick N Easy Mexican Rice Bake
ingredients: 1 package kielbasa, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 1 can cream of chicken soup ( fat free, 2 %, fat free ) | 1/3 cup long grain rice, uncooked | 2 teaspoons splenda granular ( to taste ) or 1/2 teaspoon sugar | 1/2 teaspoon taco seasoning
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f. Preheat casserole. Spray or line with foil and grease or line with parchment paper. Lightly spray or grease an 8x8 glass baking dish. Place the kielbasa in a skillet over medium high heat. Cook, stirring, until sausage is thoroughly cooked.

Random Ingredients: crabmeat,peppercorn,red chilies,leek,vegetable oil cooking spray,hoisin sauce,yellow rice mix
title: Quick Caribbean Pork and Rice
ingredients: 1 leek | 1 lb fresh crabmeat | 1 package yellow rice mix ( i like goya brand ) | vegetable oil flavored cooking spray | 2 small red chilies | 6 whole fresh red chilies | 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce | 1/8 teaspoon whole peppercorn
instructions: Trim the ends about 2 inches from the leek and cut it lengthwise into 1 1/2 inch wide ribbons. Place the lemon in a large nonstick skillet. Slice the leek lengthwise into 1/2 inch wide ribbons. Place over high heat and warm just until the surface of the leek starts to sizzle, 3 - 4 minutes. Turn the leek and its rib membrane over and cook until the second side is just beginning to color, 3 - 4 minutes. Repeat until the leek is dark and very tender, 3 - 4 minutes. Transfer the leeks to a plate and let drain. Reserve 1 tablespoon liquid from skillet. Return the empty skillet to medium heat. Coat the bottom and sides of an 8 x 8 inch baking dish with cooking spray.

title: Gravlax
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless salmon fillets | 1 can chicken meat, drained | 1 cup frozen peas | 2 tablespoons dried dill
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Place a salmon fillet into a 9x13 inch baking dish. Squeeze the juice from the chicken meat into the baking dish, and put the chicken and peas into the dish. Pour the chicken juice over the salmon fillet. Sprinkle the dill over the fish. Cover the dish with aluminum foil, and bake in the preheated oven until salmon easily flakes easily with a fork, 30 to 35 minutes.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,carrot,white button mushroom,chili powder,adobo sauce,flour tortilla
title: Easy and Delicious Beef Fajitas
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped onion ( can add onion powder also ) | 2 teaspoons chili powder | 1 can white button mushrooms | 1 can carrot, drained | 2 envelopes dry onion soup mix | 2 -3 soft tortillas
instructions: Saute onion, mushrooms, and carrots in a small amount of oil a couple of minutes.

title: Chinese Style Sunflower Oil
ingredients: sunflower oil, for deep frying | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon soya sauce
instructions: Mix the sunflower oil with the soy sauce or any sweetener. Once all the oil has been added, heat frying oil on a hot pan. Tip, this oil should take about 15 to 30 seconds at one inch. The trick with a tall pancake turner is to slide the pan over the oil and keep turning it over a few times so it can coat the bottom evenly.

Random Ingredients: bay leaf,spice,egg substitute,quinoa,green enchilada sauce,breadcrumb,aluminum foil,coffee granule
title: Soft N' Spicy Quinoa Breaded Green Enchiladas
ingredients: 2 cups dry quinoa | 1 teaspoon instant coffee granules | 2 bay leaves | 3/4 cup fat free egg substitute | 1/2 cup green enchilada sauce | 1 1/2 cups breadcrumbs, divided | 1 teaspoon mixed spice | 1 teaspoon instant coffee granules | 1 cup green enchilada sauce, warmed
instructions: Rinse quinoa with cool water and drain. In a food processor, pulse dry quinoa, quinoa, 1 teaspoon instant coffee granules, and bay leaves until combined, about 1 minute. Add egg substitute and 1/4 cup bread crumbs, mixing until combined. Spoon about 2 tablespoons of the quinoa mixture in the bottom of a 13x9x2 inch baking dish. Arrange 2 enchilada sauce on top of quinoa mixture to cover. Repeat with remaining quinoa mixture and enchilada sauce in an 11 x 2 inch baking dish. Cover loosely with aluminum foil and bake in a preheated 350°f oven until breadcrumbs are golden and bubbly, about 35 minutes. Heat remaining 1/4 teaspoon instant coffee granules in a small saucepan over low heat until warm, about 1 minute. Pour into a shallow dish and sprinkle with 1 tbsp bread crumbs. Cut with a hot knife to make 3 diagonal slices. Drizzle with 1 tablespoon or 1/2 c water. Place remaining 1/2 cup bread crumbs in a small bowl and sprinkle with 1 tbsp bread crumbs. Brush tops of 2 enchiladas with the espresso granules and coat with remaining 1 tablespoon bread crumbs. Bake at 350°f until heated through about 15 minutes.

title: Russian Orange Splash
ingredients: 6 ounces orange juice | 10 ounces irish cream
instructions: Gently stir in the orange juice. Serve over ice.

title: Garlic and Sherry Sauce for Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 cup sherry wine | 1/2 cup honey | 2 teaspoons garlic powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Allow to rest for at least 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: tuna water,brown mustard seed,saffron strand,grain rice,lemon essence,kimchi,orange juice,shallot
title: Korean-Style Rice
ingredients: 200 g long-grain rice | 6 cups prepared kimchi, finely chopped | 1/2 cup tuna in water, drained and flaked | 2 tablespoons shallots, finely chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons brown mustard seeds | 2 teaspoons saffron strands | 1 tablespoon grated orange rind | 1 tablespoon kimchi, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons fresh orange juice
instructions: Cook the rice on its own heat then set aside. Place all the ingredients into a pan with enough water to just cover them and bring to the boil, lower the heat cover tight and simmer for about 15 to 20 minutes or until all the liquid is absorbed, and the rice is tender. The kimchi should still be quite firm, but with a little less water. Mix all the contents of both the pan and the rice together. Place on a serving dish and garnish with fresh chives.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,sesame oil,sun tomato oil,sage leaf,kalamata olive,coriander seed
title: Marinated Sesame Olives
ingredients: 8 large pitted, roasted, sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained | 8 large kalamata olives, pitted | 1/8 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained | 2 teaspoons crumbled sesame oil | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh coriander seeds | 1 teaspoon rubbed sage leaves
instructions: In a medium bowl, toss sun dried tomatoes, olives, sun dried tomato oil, sesame oil, coriander, and sage together. Cover bowl and refrigerate at least 2 hours.

title: Garlicky French Bread Dip
ingredients: 1/4 cup chopped fresh chives | 2 teaspoons garlic salt | 2 teaspoons clings fresh minced cilantro or 2 teaspoons parsley
instructions: Combine all ingredients in bowl and mash in bowl with fork. Enjoy with crackers or spread on toasted baguettes.

title: Turmeric and Lime Oil
ingredients: 2 teaspoons turmeric | 2 -3 limes, juiced
instructions: Mix the turmeric with the lime juice. This can be done in an automatic blender and is great for those who like a little kick.

title: Italian coffee with pistachios
ingredients: 1 cup brewed coffee beans ( espresso-hot ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons italian seasoning | 3 tablespoons pistachios, chopped
instructions: In a large bowl, combine coffee beans, italian seasoning, and pistachios.

Random Ingredients: coffee powder,green cardamom pod,spinach leaf,mango,bread,onion powder,ghee,poblano chile
title: Spinach and Mango Chappeh ( Indian Bread Pudding)
ingredients: 5 slices bread, crusts removed from the crusts | 2 cans spinach leaves | 1 large mango, cut into pieces | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1/8 teaspoon instant coffee powder | 1/8 teaspoon green cardamom pod | 1/8 teaspoon ground poblano chile | 2 tablespoons ghee or 2 tablespoons butter
instructions: Pour enough water into a pot to come half of the way up the sides of your coconut. Preheat the oven to 400°f. Place the bread slices in the pot and cover with water. Place over medium heat. Boil for about 5 minutes, until it starts boiling. Turn heat off. Place all the remaining ingredients in a food processor. Pulse until smooth the mixture can be refrigerated for up to 1 week. Pour mixture into a 2 1/2 quart baking dish and evenly spread. Toast under the broiler for about 5 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Honey Stuffed Portabella Mushrooms
ingredients: 4 portabella mushrooms | 1 package dried rice noodles | 1 1/2 cups italian style breadcrumbs | 1 - 1 1/2 cup chopped of fresh mint | 2 tablespoons mirin ( sweet cooking sauce ) ( optional ) or 2 tablespoons orange juice ( sweet cooking sauce ) | 1 dash honey
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Clean mushrooms removing stems. Slice a small amount off the tops of the stems, and remove the mushroom stems. Place stem caps of mushrooms in a baking dish and cover mushrooms with water. Cover the dish and refrigerate for 20 - 25 minutes. Remove any stems from the mushrooms using a slotted spoon, or a fine mesh sieve, and drain water. Place rice noodles in a large bowl. Combine with bread crumbs or chopped mint and set aside. Unwrap the mushrooms and set aside in the serving bowl. Stuff the mushroom caps, with the stuffing, starting on the stem part, and packing in the stuffing. Top with mint and drizzle with mirin or orange juice. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: apple cider vinegar,bonito shaving,ginger root,coconut,celery seed,ice water
title: Applejack
ingredients: 5 tablespoons grated fresh coconut | 5 tablespoons apple cider vinegar | 6 pounds unpeeled, partially thawed, and cut into cubes | 3/4 cup cold water | 1 teaspoon celery seed | 1 teaspoon ginger root, or more to taste | bonito shaving, divided
instructions: Mix coconut, apple cider vinegar, and water together in a blender or food processor, until grated and water has been mostly absorbed. Place half of the cubes of orange peel and all of the celery seed into the food processor and pulse once or twice to finely chop. Add the ginger and pulse just until mixture starts to look coarsely ground. Repeat with the remaining cubes of orange peel and celery seed. Divide the grape flavored chunks into the containers of a large sealable plastic bag. Pour in about 1/2 cup of the water. Add the pineapple and seal the bag. Refrigerate the bag until completely chilled, about 2 hours. Discard the remaining water and refrigerate the bag for 1 to 4 days to fully appreciate the sweetness of the mixture and your beverage.

Random Ingredients: dijon mustard,tapioca flour,trout,parmesan cheese,green chilies,cream tartar
title: Low Fat Tasty Trout With Raita
ingredients: 400 g fresh trays, cooked, cut into 2 x 1 cm slices | 3 tablespoons trident tapioca flour ( you can also use flour made into gluten free flour ) | 1/8 teaspoon cream of tartar | 3/4 teaspoon dijon mustard | 2 green chilies, chopped | 80 g shaved parmesan cheese | 1 teaspoon lowfat sour cream
instructions: Combine the tapioca flour, cream of tarter, mustard, chillies and parmesan. Stir well. Spread tapioca mixture on top and sides of the cooked trout. Roll up and serve.

title: Gkai Yefalonitissa
ingredients: 1 tablespoon granulated sugar | 1 tablespoon seasoning salt | 1 cup deep fat natural yogurt | 1/4 package frozen mixed delicatessen cuts rolls ( found in latin markets around the store ) or 1/4 package kaiware daikon radish roll ( found in latin markets around the store ) | 1/4 cup chopped fresh garlic | 1/4 cup chopped peeled fresh daikon radish | 3 tablespoons nutritional yeast
instructions: Mash the granulated sugar, granulated salt, and yogurt up with a fork or potato masher until well mixed. Add the garlic, radish, and nutritional yeast and mix till everything is well combined. Refrigerate for 1 hour. Stir well before serving. Serve with pita bread, pitas, pita chips, tortillas, or any other fillings desired.

title: Pot Roasted Beets
ingredients: 2 pounds pork loin roast | 1 cup dried mixed beet, stems removed
instructions: Cover the roast with water in a large pot or dutch oven. Add salt to taste and bring to a boil. Cover, reduce heat, and simmer until very tender, about 2 1/2 hours. Remove roast with a slotted spoon and place roasts in a roasting pan. Boil beetroot over medium low heat until tender, 30 to 40 minutes. Remove beetroot and mash with a potato masher. When the roast is cool, shred or cube enough to thicken and toss with beet mixture.

title: Melon Balls in Brandy
ingredients: 3 firm cantaloupe ( fruit of your choice ) | 2 tablespoons brandy or 2 tablespoons whiskey, see note above
instructions: Remove the tops of the melons and cut all the flesh into small cubes about 1/4 inch, discarding the peel, seeds and all, about 1/2 in diameter. Place the melons in the bowl of a food processor fitted with the metal blade. Add the brandy or whisky and process until a rough paste forms. With a spatula or a spoon, add the melon balls and process until the mixture forms a ball. Chill until served garnished with a little coarse sugar. Note, you may buy melon balls with fruit in small glass jars. Note, you may have to pass the melon balls through a meat grinder before you eat. Note, fruit may be used in place of cantaloupe in this recipe. Instead of melon balls, you may chop up the fruit into small cubes and add them to the melon balls. Note, melon balls may be served for lunch, with crackers and/or toasted katakor bread.

title: Quick Mashed Potato Salad
ingredients: 4 medium potatoes, peeled | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 small carrot, shredded | 8 large lettuce leaves
instructions: Place potatoes in large saucepan and cover with salted water. Cook over high heat until tender, about 25 minutes. Drain. Return to pan. Stir in soup and carrot. Heat through. Add lettuce and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,cranberry juice,rosemary,coconut,sea salt pepper,mozzarella cheese,green bean,yellow pepper
title: Easy Apple Tarte Salad
ingredients: 1 cup green beans | 1 medium tart apple, peeled, cored and diced ( i like red delicious or fuji ) | 1/4 cup dried cranberry juice | sea salt and pepper | 1/4 cup shredded mozzarella cheese | 1/4 cup coarsely grated coconut ( about 1-2 tbsp will be the right consistency for my tartar ) | 1/2 green apple, cored, core removed, diced ( or 2 -3 cups applesauce and 1/2 - 1-1/2-1 cup apple juice ) | 1 sprig fresh rosemary
instructions: To roast the apple and set out on a cookie sheet, place oven rack in the middle of the oven and preheat to 400°f. Roast the green beans about 20 minutes, until crisp tender, then cut into 2 inch lengths. Cut the apple into chunks and set aside in a bowl. To make the lemon cream dressing, mix together the cranberry and apple juices in a small bowl and season with salt and pepper. Pour mixture into a small, heavy duty plastic container and refrigerate. To prepare the salad, arrange the green beans at the center of a salad plate, top with the apple and pineapple. Sprinkle the cheese, coconut, and green apple into the salad. Top with the lemon cream dressing and decorate with rosemary sprigs.

title: Steak Supper (Kinderi)
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin | 2 chinese egg noodles | 6 tablespoons amaretti | 12 ounces kasseri cheese | 6 chinese egg noodles, cooked | 6 tablespoons cheese | 1 teaspoon sambal oelek
instructions: Cut sirloin into 4 slices. Arrange on skewers on foil covered rack in broiler pan broiling 400f for 15 minutes or until medium rare. Meanwhile, boil chinese egg noodles according to package directions. Remove noodles from pan with a slotted spoon and toss with 3 tbsps. Olive oil and 2 tablespoons olive oil. Spread noodles on a baking sheet, and broil for 2 minutes. Stir noodles into sizzling meat mixture until just warm, drain noodles on paper towels, transfer to warmed serving platter, sprinkle with amaretti slices. Top with kegeri. Place chinese style egg noodles and cheese on a serving platter. Serve kegeri skewers piled onto noodles.

Random Ingredients: apple,kosher salt,honeydew melon,thyme leaf,fajita seasoning mix,walnut half
title: Honeydew and Apple Melon Salad
ingredients: 1 honeydew melon, rinsed and sliced ( about 8 cups ) | 1 small apple, halved, cored, and sliced | 1/3 cup walnut halves, toasted and coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon kosher salt | 1 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 1 packet fajita seasoning mix
instructions: Divide melon slices in half, then each half into quarters. On a plate, spread a layer of the apple slices and walnuts. Sprinkle the salt, thyme, and fajita seasoning over the vegetables. Top with a final layer of melon slices. Enjoy.

title: Homemade Yogurt
ingredients: 2 liters low-fat yogurt | 1 dash mustard powder | 4 drops salad oil
instructions: Mix yogurt and mustard powder together. Keep refrigerated over night. Drain well. Serve chilled with bread and vegetables of your choice. It should keep for at least 4 days in the refrigerator.

title: Swiss Triples
ingredients: 1 pint currants | 10 black mushrooms, wiped clean and halved | 1/4 cup triple sec
instructions: Place currants in a large container and pour boiling water over them. Gently squish currants with your fingers to remove any excess moisture. When they have absorbed all the water, add mushroom halves, squeeze in a teaspoon of triple sec, and cover. Let soak at least 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: red chilies,cheese,new potato,kosher salt,miso paste,rump roast,taco seasoning
title: Miso and Chilli Pot Roast
ingredients: 3 lbs rump roast | 1 small red chilies, seeded and cut into thin strips | 1/2 cup sweet red chilies, seeded and chopped | 2 tablespoons miso paste | 1/4 cup taco seasoning | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 1/4 cup new potato
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Place roast on a rack in a roasting pan. Insert metal slivers or skewers on top of it. Sprinkle with chilies, jerk salt and taco seasoning. Place in roasting pan. Roast in the oven for 75 minutes per pound for medium rare. Remove from oven and remove meat and drain off any fat. Slice and serve. Serve with warm tortillas with cheese and salad.

title: Roasted Okra (Ajwain)
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh okra | 1 lb plum tomato, cut into 2-inch pieces | 1/2 cup desiccated coconut
instructions: Trim the okra, then wash it and cut off the ends and ends. Cut into 3/4 inch pieces. Place the okra in a deep baking dish with the tomatoes and coconut. Sprinkle with the salt, cover and bake in a preheated oven, stirring occasionally, for about 50 minutes.

Random Ingredients: artichoke heart,pineapple tidbit,cornflour,flat leaf parsley,savory,pork sparerib
title: Spicy Pork Spareribs
ingredients: 1 quart pineapple tidbits | 1 can artichoke hearts ( drained ) | 1 cup cooked pork spareribs, cut in half | 2 tablespoons chopped savory | 1 tablespoon snipped fresh flat-leaf parsley | 4 teaspoons cornflour ( optional )
instructions: Mix well all together.

title: Chunky Strawberry Puree
ingredients: 4 tablespoons vegetable oil ( olive or sunflower, just not extra virgin ) | 6 strawberries, hulled, quartered | 2 large egg whites | 1/4 teaspoon celery salt
instructions: Puree the remaining ingredients in a food processor until smooth, using up to 2 tablespoons of puree or to desired consistency. Return to a serving bowl, cover and chill for up to 2 days.

title: Sausages Au Jus
ingredients: 2 cups small white mushrooms | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram
instructions: Place mushrooms over high heat in a small skillet, and bring to a boil. Turn heat to low, and cook for 10 minutes, stirring every so often. Remove from heat. Stir in marjoram and mix well. Use to stuff sausage casings.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,parmigiano reggiano cheese,french bread,lobster,liquid smoke
title: Apples With Lobster on Toast
ingredients: 2 tart apples, cut into thin wedges | 1 loaf french bread, sliced in half lengthwise | 2 cups cooked lobsters, in butter, shredded ( optional ) | 1/4 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Arrange apples in a single layer in a baking dish. Bake, turning once, for 15 to 20 minutes until apple is tender and golden, and centers are tender but not crisp. Meanwhile, toast bread slices, one slice at a time, on a baking sheet, 1 to 2 inches apart. Place in oven and decrease heat if necessary. Remove from heat and sprinkle top and bottom with cheese. Return to and oven for 5 minutes until cheese melts and begins to lightly brown. Pour liquid smoke into a small bowl and pour into bowl with cheese. Microwave lobster meat, in butter, on top of a double boiler over simmering water until melted and combined, about 3 minutes. Pour lobster mixture onto toasted bread, sprinkle with cheese, and serve.

title: Spiced Pork Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless pork butt, trimmed of fat | 1 cup beef broth, hot | 2 teaspoons allspice berries | 1 cucumber, peeled, seeded and chopped | 1/2 head iceberg lettuce ( about 8 cups ) | 1 cup strawberry, sliced
instructions: Cut the pork lengthwise into 1 inch wide strips. Combine the broth and allspice in a medium saucepan and bring to a boil. Add the pork strips and simmer, uncovered, stirring often, 15 minutes, until the pork is cooked through and tender. Transfer to a bowl. Pour the hot broth over the pork and toss to coat evenly. Add the cucumber and toss briefly. Add the lettuce and strawberries and toss. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: tortilla,yellow bell pepper,linguine,celery salt,lemonade,grape tomato,ricotta cheese,breadcrumb
title: Lemon Stuffed Peppers & Tomato Rollups
ingredients: 8 medium yellow bell peppers ( red and yellow ) | 8 grape tomatoes | 4 ounces ricotta cheese | 1 tablespoon dried breadcrumbs | 2 teaspoons celery salt | 1/2 teaspoon lemonade | 14 ounces tortillas, warm ( any flavor )
instructions: Clean the inside of the peppers and remove the seeds and membrane. Cut out the stems from each tomato, slice off the tops just below the tops and remove the seeds and membrane to produce nice grape sized pieces about 3 to 4 inches long. Cut the reserved tops off of the peppers and discard. Fill the tomato shells with cheese and leave enough in each cup to wrap the stuffed pepper around the bowl, trying to keep an equal size slice in the cheese. Sprinkle a little bread crumbs over the stuffed peppers and set aside. Mix the ricotta, bread crumbs, celery salt, and lemonade together until thoroughly incorporated. You should have a moist cheese mixture that can be mixed together by hand. Dip each stuffed pepper in the cheese mixture and then lay them, overlapping them slightly, in a warm buttered frying pan, seam side down. Spread half the filling evenly over the peppers, then top with tortillas, again trying not to crowd them. Roll up tightly and place seam side down into a shallow baking dish or roasting pan. Cover the tops completely with the remaining filling. Bake at 350°f for about 20 minutes. Remove the stuffed peppers and slice them open from each other and carefully remove the pulp, juices and the membrane between the slices to serve.

Random Ingredients: corn kernel,chunky salsa,cream,curry leaf,pine nut,cold water,jumbo shrimp,yellow squash
title: Curried Shrimp With Squash and Pumpkin
ingredients: 1/4 cup chunky salsa ( homemade or bottled ) | 1 lb jumbo shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 cup fresh corn kernels, cut from the cob ( if frozen, thaw before thawing ) | 1 cup small squash, cut into 2 1-inch cubes ( about 1-1/2-3/4 pounds ) | 1/4 cup pine nuts | 2 tablespoons sour cream | 5 curry leaves ( fresh or purchased, optional ) | 6 cups cold water
instructions: Make the salsa, in a small bowl stir together salsa and 1/4 cup water. Cover and refrigerate for flavors to meld. In a medium, heavy skillet over medium high heat, bring shrimp to a boil with the corn and squash. Cook 2 minutes, stirring. Remove shrimp with a slotted spoon and set aside with the corn and squash. Stir in remaining water. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to medium low, and continue cooking and stirring until shrimp are cooked through and water is almost evaporated, about 3 minutes. Stir shrimp, corn/squash mixture, and pine nuts into shrimp and cook until shrimp are just heated through and sauce is heated through, 1 to 2 minutes. Stir sour cream into shrimp mixture. Spoon shrimp mixture into a large serving bowl.

Random Ingredients: corn tortilla chip,pearl barley,cocoa powder,pickling vinegar,green onion
title: Mexican Barley Salad
ingredients: 5 cups packaged pearl barley, rinsed and drained | 1 cup chopped green onion | 1 tablespoon pickling vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon unsweetened cocoa powder | assorted raw corn tortilla chips
instructions: In small bowl, combine barley, onions, vinegar, and cocoa. Place 2 - 3 tablespoons salad mixture on each of six salad plates. Serve.

title: Fennel & Green Olive Salad
ingredients: 5 lbs fennel bulbs, trimmed & fronds reserved ( about 12 large bulbs ) | 1 cup rice vinegar | 3 cups green olives, pitted | 1/2 cup low sodium soy sauce ( or tamari )
instructions: Cut fennel bulbs into 1/2 inch cubes. Put fennel into a strainer or colander & rinse in cold water.

Random Ingredients: egg white,lime juice,white vinegar,fontina,lemon juice,kidney bean
title: Kidney Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans | 3 eggs, hard boiled, peeled, sliced and quartered | 1/2 cup chopped fontina | 1/2 cup chopped rinsed lime juice | 1/4 cup white vinegar | 2 teaspoons fresh lemon juice | 1 teaspoon orange juice
instructions: Add all ingredients to a salad bowl.

Random Ingredients: grape,black peppercorn,black cardamom pod,chicken breast,mayonnaise,onion,vanilla pod,chive
title: Chilled Chicken Breasts With Grape and Poppered Caramelized Pearl Onions
ingredients: 2 -12 chicken breasts | 100 g grapes | 25 g onions or 10 g shallots, sliced into long slivers | 1 ounce black peppercorns | 6 black cardamom pods | 2 -3 fresh chives | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla pod | 10 -11 tablespoons mayonnaise | 2 -4 tablespoons fresh chives, chopped | 1 teaspoon vanilla pod
instructions: For the pearl onions, heat 1 tbsp of the mayonnaise in a saucepan. Add the chives and 1 tbs of the chives and cook until they are soft. Remove the pan from the heat and put the pan aside to cool. Cut a circle about 4 in diameter and a roundabout 8 in diameter. Remove the shell and discard. Cut slices of chicken lengthwise with a sharp knife, cutting at a 45 degree angle. Arrange the sliced chicken on a serving platter and layer the onion slices over them. Cut the grapes in half down one side, then cut the halves into thin slices. Arrange the pearls at the bottom of the plate. The peeled grapes will make them difficult to detect. Place the grapes around the chicken and the chicken. Use a double thickness of cheesecloth to press and place the cardamon, the black peppercorns, and the vanilla pods. You may have to do this in stages, depending on your preference in order to get the spices to penetrate through the chicken. Cover the platter with foil, place it on the side of the dish, and marinate the chicken overnight in the refrigerator. The next day remove the meat and pour off a little of the marinade. Preheat the oven to 325f degrees. Brush the grapes with the remaining 1/4 cup mayonnaise, sprinkle with the remaining chives, and place them on the rack over the pan. Roast the chicken, uncovered, for about 55 minutes, until the breasts just start to colour, then add the sliced onions and cook until they are soft and golden. Remove them from the oven, arrange them around the chicken, and leave to rest for 15 minutes or until they are firm. Strain the fat from the pan, if possible. Remove the cardamon pods and pour them over the chicken and onions for the final step, coating everything with the mayonnaise. Serve at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: kraft parmesan cheese,butternut squash,tomato juice,shiitake mushroom,chunky salsa,lemon juice zest
title: Mexican Butternut Squash Tomato Soup
ingredients: 2 tablespoons butter | 1 medium butternut squash, peeled, seeded, and cubed | 3 cans stewed tomatoes with juice | 1 1/2 cups chunky salsa | 1 lemons, juice and zest of | kraft parmesan cheese, grated
instructions: Heat butter in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add cubed squash and saute for 5 minutes. Add in tomatoes with their juices, salsa, and lemon and zest, and simmer for 15 minutes on medium. Serve hot with grated parmesan cheese.

Random Ingredients: almond milk,worcestershire sauce,apple juice,green chile,olive oil cooking spray,garlic salt
title: Almond Chiles Rellenos
ingredients: 1 can refrigerated almond milk | 1/2 cup apple juice, chilled | 2 green chiles, sliced thinly | 1/2 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon garlic salt | olive oil flavored cooking spray
instructions: Spray non stick cooking spray on bottom of a greased 13x9 baking dish in a row, place the chiles on top of the slabs, sprinkle evenly with the worcestershire sauce and garlic salt, evenly sprinkle evenly with the apple juice. Spray all of the chiles with olive oil cooking spray. Bake uncovered at 375 degrees for 18 - 20 minutes or until the tops are lightly browned and the liquid is syrupy and the chiles are no longer glossy and are soft.

title: Cincinnati-Style Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds beef stew meat | 1 can condensed beef flavored stew meat | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
instructions: Place all ingredients in a crock.

Random Ingredients: greek yogurt,red lentil,lemon grass,broccoli floret,rosemary sprig
title: Red Lentil Lemon Grass and Broccoli Soup
ingredients: 2 1/4 lbs fresh broccoli florets | 4 fresh rosemary sprigs | 1/2 cup red lentil | 1/2 cup plain greek yogurt | 1 tablespoon grated lemon grass, plus | fresh rosemary sprig, for garnish
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to boil. Add broccoli and simmer until tender when pierced with a knife, about 3 minutes. Reserve 3 cups cooking water in the pot, reserving rest for soup. Drain greens, cool slightly, remove tough outer leaves and stalks. Wrap greens in cheesecloth or paper towels and shred with a knife. Discard stems. Strain broth to remove solids that settle to the bottom, then stir in remaining ingredients except reserved cooking water. Bring just to a boil, then reduce heat. Simmer for 4 minutes to blend flavors. Stir through reserved cooking water and serve. Garnish with the fresh rosemary.

title: Marinated Olive Pesto for Pasta and Chicken
ingredients: 2 cups marinara sauce | 1 cup bourbon ( dark, brie or applejack ) | 1/3 cup liquid smoke ( mesquite type ) | 1/3 cup kalamata olive, pitted, sliced | parsley and kalamata olive halves
instructions: Drain liquid smoke from brie, and add bourbon, liquid smoke & olives. Bring marinara to a boil for about 15 minutes to thicken up a bit. Add olive halves and heat through serve over pasta with kalamata olive halves & chopped parsley/parsley on top.

title: Snow Peas With Capsicum & Rice
ingredients: 1 cup long-grain white rice | 2 -3 medium capsicums, halved lengthways ( use the red capsicum ) | 100 g snow peas, trimmed
instructions: Put rice & capsicum into a bowl and stir to combine. Cook in microwave on high until rice is tender. Stir to stop rice from sticking and to bits & rice grains forming. Add the capsicum and cook for 2 - 3 minutes more. Sprinkle top with snow peas. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: farfalle pasta,apple cider vinegar,cream chicken soup,flat leaf italian parsley,flat leaf parsley,rye flour,rosemary,heavy whipping cream
title: Apple and Herbs Farfalle Pasta
ingredients: 2 2/3 cups farfalle or 2 2/3 cups spaghetti, rotelle, elbow pasta | 2 cans condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 cup sour cream | 1 1/4 cups apple cider vinegar | 1/2 cup finely chopped fresh flat-leaf italian parsley | 2 tablespoons minced fresh rosemary | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/4 cup fresh flat-leaf italian parsley, chopped | 1/4 cup fresh flat-leaf italian parsley, chopped
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,deli roast beef,hard egg,cake flour,chili garlic sauce,rotel tomato chilies,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Quick Chili Mac & Cheese
ingredients: 1 cup vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 cups deli roast beef | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1 can rotel tomatoes & chilies | 1 can chili-garlic sauce | 6 hard-boiled eggs, sliced | 1 1/2 cups cake flour
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Spray a 9x13 pan with veggie oil spray. Place roast in roaster on top of paper towels. Combine tomatoes with green chilies and chili sauce. Pour over roast. Cover and bake for 1 hour or until thermometer reads 165 degrees. Remove roast and allow to sit 5 - 10 minutes, then place in a food processor. Add eggs and flour. Blend until dough begins to clump. Spread on top of roast and bake uncovered for 10 min or until hot& bubbly. If using toothpick, wrap around it and poke holes on top. Enjoy.

title: Cherry Ripe Rice Wine Bottle
ingredients: 500 ml rice wine ( i use low-sodium ) or 500 ml sweet rice wine ( i use low-sodium ) | 1/2 cup of red pectin ( such as cherry essence ) | 12 slices of fresh cherries
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes or until fruit is soft. Use a slotted spoon, remove the lid and add the cherries. Stir well.

title: Cranberry Mango Salad
ingredients: 1 mango, peeled and cut into wedges | 1/4 cup dried cranberries
instructions: Arrange mango wedges in a serving dish.

Random Ingredients: serrano chili,chicken bouillon cube,chicken bouillon granule,chive
title: Simple Mexican Garlic Bread
ingredients: 1 tablespoon minced chives | 2 tablespoons minced serrano chili ( or any other mild green hot pepper ) | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 4 -5 teaspoons chicken bouillon granules
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine chives, chile peppers, and 1 1/2 teaspoons chicken bouillon granules. Pour over chive mixture, stir to combine. If mixture is too dry, add a bit more chicken bouillon. Let stand 30 minutes to 2 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: beer,almond paste,caster sugar,red wine vinegar,beef,oatmeal,cajun seasoning,parmesan cheese
title: Beef Burger With Rote Grilled Cheese
ingredients: 500 g ground beef | 1 cup cheddar old-fashioned oatmeal ( or similar amount-for-all ratio grated ) | 60 g parmesan cheese | 1/3 cup gluten free beer | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 1/2 teaspoon cajun seasoning | 2 tablespoons almond paste
instructions: Preheat grill. Mix all ingredients well and form into 4 patties. Cook over hot grill. When burgers begin to turn brown on both sides flip and cook the other side. Serve on toasted toasted wholemeal bun with tomato sauce or herb sauce.

title: Blueberry Lemongrass Salad
ingredients: 4 stalks lemongrass | 1 -2 red chili | 1 cup fresh blueberries, plus a few fresh whole berries | 1 small lime wedge | 1/4 cup white vinegar | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt
instructions: Rinse lemongrass and chilies under running water and dry with paper towels. Cut lemon grass into 1 1/2 inch lengths and set aside. Cut blueberries into 1/4 inch slices and set aside in a bowl. Remove peel from chilies and tear into shreds with hands. Cut the stem end off the lemongrass and chop into thin slices across the length of the berries and discard remainder. Toss lemon grass mixture with the chopped lemon grass and chopped blueberries in a large serving bowl. Drizzle with lime juice, sprinkle with fish sauce and the seasoned salt and scatter with whole berries.

Random Ingredients: anchovy fillet,yellow bell pepper,monterey jack cheddar cheese,gorgonzola,bulgar wheat,golden raisin,red bean,hot red chili pepper
title: Roasted Garlic and Cheese Bread With Beans and Gorgonzola
ingredients:

instructions: Toast raisins and chilies on a rack in a 400 deg. Oven, stirring occasionally, until golden, 20 - 25 minutes. Set pan over a burner. Add gorgonzola and stir until melted. Random Ingredients: brown rice,peanut oil,beef rib,paprika,bechamel sauce,chilies,hollandaise sauce
title: Beef Ribs With Hot Chilies
ingredients: 1 kg beef short rib | 250 g chilies, sliced | 1 tablespoon paprika | 500 ml beetchamel sauce | 1/2 cup peanut oil | 200 g brown rice | 2 tablespoons hollandaise sauce
instructions: Rub the beef ribs with your hand to remove some of the salt and extra fat. Place them in a single layer on a plate without skin. Heat the oil in a heavy based frying pan. Cook the beef ribs for 5 minutes on each side over a high heat. Remove from the pan or oven and set aside. Heat the remaining oil in the same frying pan, pour in the beetchamel and spread it evenly over the ribs. Simmer for 15 minutes, covered. Add the rice, stir, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally until cooked through.

title: Artichoke Choclo-Pokerers
ingredients: 12 artichoke hearts, about 3 pounds | 12 dark chocolate, pieces about 1 inch each
instructions: Slice artichoke hearts crosswise into thin wedges about 1/4 inch thick, and set aside. Cover cut sides of wedge of dark chocolate with plastic or wax paper, letting excess water drip off. Melt chocolate and water in a double boiler just until completely melted, about 5 minutes. Stir occasionally. Line a 9x13x2 pan with foil. Toss artichoke wedges in melted chocolate over the bottom of the pan to coat evenly. Pour excess chocolate over the artichoke hearts, spreading to cover. Chill until hardened. Spread remaining dark chocolate evenly over the hardened chocolate. When serving make sure all sides are coated or they will stick. If not, stir a spoonful about 1/2 tablespoon at a time to prevent sticking.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach leaf,chicken wing,green chili pepper,cooking brown rice,piquillo pepper,beef brisket,celery rib
title: Piquillo Beef and Rice Salad
ingredients: 4 -6 lbs beef brisket or 4 -6 lbs beef brisket | 4 large piquillo peppers | 1 large onion, peeled and quartered | 1/2 bunch celery rib, sliced | 2 -3 green chili peppers, stemmed, seeded, and sliced thin | 1 lb baby spinach
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Heat a cast iron dutch oven or large heavy pot over high heat until a bead of water vaporizes. Fry brisket on all sides until brown, about 3 minutes per side. Transfer meat to a plate. Drain excess fat from pot and pour off excess fat. Add piquillo peppers, onion, celery and chiles to pot and simmer, covered, until all the liquid has reduced and the vegetables have softened, about 15 to 20 minutes. Stir in spinach. Pour contents of pot onto salad greens and sprinkle with salt and pepper if necessary.

title: Creamy Rice Corn With Raspberries
ingredients: 1 can cream-style sweet corn | 1/2 cup fresh raspberries
instructions: Heat oven to 300 degrees. Mix cream style corn and fresh raspberry in a bowl. Put mixture in a 2 quart baking dish sprayed with non stick spray. Bake uncovered, stirring every 10 minutes to prevent rice from sticking or burning until corn is heated through and cream has been absorbed, 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Quick Thai Basil Dump Dip
ingredients: 3 tablespoons plain low-fat yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1/2 teaspoon mixed dried herbs ( optional ) | 1/4 cup thai sweet basil
instructions: Combine yogurt and baking soda in medium bowl. Add herbs if using. Chill, covered, until ready to serve.

title: Baked Fettuccine With Pear Stuffing
ingredients: 4 slices fried bacon bits | 8 ounces fettuccine, cooked well and drained | 1/4 cup golden raisin | 4 small pears ( the large ones would probably not need to be peeled ) | 1/4 cup bread bits
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Spray 11x7 pan with cooking spray. Cook bacon bits in frying pan over medium heat until bacon is crisp. Add raisins and cook about one minute until slightly browned. Lightly grease a small bowl, mix cooked pasta, bacon mixture and pears. Transfer mixture to prepared pan. Bake at 400 for about 20 to 25 minutes, or until mixture is hot through and slightly browned on top.

title: Beef Fondue
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef | 1/2 cup picante sauce | 2 teaspoons turmeric or 2 teaspoons chili powder | 1 baguette, cut into 1 inch cubes, then toasted and chilled | freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Trim excess fat from meat. Cut meat in 1 inch cubes. Put meat in a heavy saucepan. Add picante sauce and turmeric.

title: Holy Basil Bell Peppers: Low Fat
ingredients: 6 yellow bell peppers, halved and deseeded | 1/4 cup orange juice | 1/4 cup fresh basil, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Line a baking sheet with foil or parchment paper. Place the whole peppers on the prepared baking sheet. Place the foil or parchment paper in the oven. Bake on the middle rack, stirring halfway through, until the peppers are tender when pierced with a knife, about 30 minutes. Remove from oven and remove the foil or paper and bell peppers from baking sheet and place them at cool room temperature. In a small bowl, stir together the orange juice and basil about 45 seconds and set aside. Transfer bell peppers to a food processor or blender with orange juice mixture and process until smooth. Transfer to a serving tray, cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours to allow flavors to develop..

title: Tatties Iraqi Style
ingredients: 6 medium red potatoes | 1 lb turnip | 1/2 lb snow peas | 1 cup white flour | 2 tablespoons tomato juice | 2 -4 tablespoons tamari or 2 -4 tablespoons soy sauce, if necessary
instructions: Peel potatoes and turnip. Cut potatoes into 2 inch chunks. Peel turnips. Cut potatoes into 4 inch chunks. Cut snow peas into 3 inch lengths. Mix flour and tomato juice well, and stir into flour until batter is well blended. Divide batter into four portions and then shallow fry. Fry until crisp outside and very dry inside.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning,chili pepper flake,angel food cake,black mustard seed,white onion,thyme leave,chorizo sausage,milk ricotta cheese
title: Chorizo Angel Food Cake (Spicy)
