ingredients: 1 can whole milk ricotta cheese | 4 ounces chili pepper flakes, chopped | 4 ounces hot chorizo sausage, casings removed | 1/2 cup white onion, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons taco seasoning | 2 teaspoons black mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon thyme leave | 1 loaf angel food cake
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. In a bowl, combine ricotta cheese with the chili pepper flakes, chorizo, onion, taco seasoning, mustard seed and thyme leaves. Place into a 9 x13 inch baking dish. Cut the angel food cake in half horizontally and place them cut side up on top. Spread the chorizo and onion mixture over the top of the chorizo and onion, then sprinkle the bean crumbles over it. Bake for 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: turmeric powder,beef roast,black bean,baguette,cauliflower floret,canola oil,flat leaf parsley,thyme leaf
title: Beef Tender Crock Pot Spiced Black Beans
ingredients: 3 lbs beef roast ( can use chuck ) | 6 cups cauliflower florets | 1 lb baguette or 1 lb cibra lettuce, sliced thick | 1 teaspoon fresh thyme leaves | 1/4 cup fresh flat-leaf parsley, chopped, divided | 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained
instructions: Trim fat from roast and cut into 1x1 inch cubes. Coat crock with nonstick cooking spray. Add beef, cauliflower and herbs to crock Pot. Add canola oil and turmeric. Mix well and cook on low for 3 hours, or high for up to 4 hours or on high for up to 2 hours. Stir in black beans and cook on high for 15 minutes or until beans are heated through. Serve crock with bread or as an accompaniment to rice or noodles.

title: Jalapeño Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup sliced jalapeno peppers | 1 tablespoon chopped raisins | 2 tablespoons sherry wine | 1 cup chicken bouillon granules | 2 teaspoons fresh ginger, minced or 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small saucepan, stirring to combine. Simmer over very low heat for about 2 minutes, stirring frequently. Pour into sterilized 1 quart jar, making sure the peppers are covered. Seal, and refrigerate up to 9 months.

Random Ingredients: ladyfinger,parmigiano reggiano cheese,sultana,lemon juice,pork loin roast,black tea
title: Lemon and Sultana Pork Rolls With Sultanas
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless pork loin roast, cut into 1/2-inch cubes ( or substitute 1 1/2 pounds pork tenderloin and cut into 1/2-inch cubes ) | 3/4 cup sultana | 1 can chopped sultanas | 1/4 cup fresh lemon juice | 3 tablespoons freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese, plus more for drizzling | 4 1/2 cups strong black tea, brewed | 2 pints assorted ladyfingers, split
instructions: In a medium bowl, toss together pork, 2/3 cup sultanas, 3/4 cup lemon juice and 1 tablespoon parmigiano. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour or overnight. Let sit at room temperature for 1 hour. Meanwhile, in a 2 to 3 quart dutch oven, bring tea to a boil. Add ladyfingers, cover, and simmer 5 minutes or until crisp and golden.

title: Quick and Easy Chicken Tortellini
ingredients: 6 -7 small boneless skinless chicken breasts | 6 -8 frozen tortellini ( cheese tortellini ) | 4 1/2 cups taco sauce
instructions: Lay out the chicken breasts on the counter. Spread the taco sauce on all of them. I usually have one package of just tortillas and put in the microwave to warm up. When the chicken is almost cooked through, you could put some of the remaining sauce in the bottom of pan. When chicken is almost done, put the tortellini on top of the sauce and put a scoop of the cheesy tortellini on top. Repeat until all the tortillas are used. Place in a 450 degree oven for about 20 minutes or until the tortellini are hot and the tortellini are crisp.

title: Roasted Asparagus With Chilli and Lime
ingredients: 500 g asparagus ( woody stalks ) | 2 -3 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1 lime, quartered
instructions: Cut off stalks of the asparagus, then cut into bite size bits. Set aside. Place sun dried tomatoes packed in warm sun and leave for 20 minutes. Dry tomatoes will have a burnt taste. Remove, peel, quarter and rub over the asparagus. Add dark soy sauce and lime wedges to taste. Toss till mixed well, serve warm or room temp.

Random Ingredients: white bread,flax seed,semolina flour,corn syrup,white rice,tarragon,soymilk,pork chop
title: Pork Loaf
ingredients: 1/2 cup white rice | 2 1/4 cups soymilk | 1 teaspoon corn syrup | 1/2 cup semolina flour | 1 tablespoon flax seed | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh tarragon | 4 thin slices white bread | 2 pork chops
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Bring soy milk, corn syrup, and semolina to a boil in a saucepan over medium heat. Add the rice and return to a boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, until rice is just tender, 40 minutes. Remove from heat and let cool to room temperature. Meanwhile, mix margarine, ground flaxseed, and finely chopped tarragon in a bowl. Spread bread crumbs onto a baking sheet. Sprinkle the bread crumbs over the bread crumbs and pat into a 9x5 inch loaf. Trim 2 of the pork chops, cut them into 4 serving size pieces, and roll them in the crumb mixture. Slice the loaves once more lengthwise and place the bread slices on a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until a knife inserted into the center comes out clean, 30 to 40 minutes. Remove from oven and let rest 10 minutes before slicing.

title: Moroccan Couscous Salad With Basil and Herbs
ingredients: 1 cup couscous | salad leaves
instructions: Cook couscous as per instructions on box. Allow couscous to cool on to counter. Add herbs as per your preference. Serve with crusty bread.

title: Ciabatta and Eggs With Yoghurt Sauce
ingredients: 1 teaspoon lemon zest | 1/2 teaspoon pepper | 2 slices ciabatta | 1/2 cup yogurt | 8 eggs | 2 tablespoons whipping cream | 12 hard-boiled eggs, quartered | 1/4 cup yoghurt | pepper, to taste | chopped pepper, to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Cut the ciabatta into thick slices, lengthwise. Using a cookie cutter or a sharp knife, cut a slit in the bottom of each slice, then insert the slices lengthways through the scored bread slices taking care not to cut all the way through. Mix the yoghurt with pepper and spread over the bread slices. Arrange the egg quarters, cut side up, on a baking sheet. Bake in the oven for 15 minutes or until golden. Remove from the oven and arrange omelet halves on hot plates. Put the toast on top of the omelet and pour over the yoghurt sauce. Serve immediately with freshly chopped parsley or finely chopped pepper.

Random Ingredients: bicarbonate soda,char siu pork,poblano chile,molasses,garlic clove,grain rice
title: Homemade Char Siu Pork
ingredients: 2 cups long grain rice, washed | 1 lb char siu pork, cubed | 3 garlic cloves, peeled | 3 poblano chiles ( or other green chili ) | 2 cups molasses | 1/4 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda
instructions: Drain the rice and combine with 2 cups of water in a large bowl. Rinse and dry the char siu. Cut the siu into 1/2 inch cubes. Put the pork cubes into a medium size bowl and toss with 1/4 tablespoons salt and garlic. In a preheated oven, heat the molasses and mix in the bicarbonate of soda. Bring to a boil, then pour into the bowl of fermented rice, mixing well to dissolve the soda. Pour the entire mixture over the pork in the bowl and stir well. Pour the rice into a container with a tight fitting lid. Close the container and store in the refrigerator. This will keep for up to one week.

Random Ingredients: tamari,five spice powder,almond extract,english mustard,skirt steak,mushroom
title: Mushroom Spiced Mustard
ingredients: 1 tablespoon ground almonds or 1 tablespoon sliced almonds | 1 1/2 teaspoons five-spice powder | 1 teaspoon english mustard | 1 tablespoon tamari | 1/4 teaspoon five-spice powder | 2 - 2 1/2 lbs trimmed skirt steaks | 2 1/2 - 3 cups sliced fresh mushrooms
instructions: Grind almonds and 5 spice powder to a fine powder in spice mill or large bowl. Combine mustard, tamari and three spice powder.

Random Ingredients: green bean,habanero pepper,black eyed pea,thyme sprig,chicken leg quarter,rye bread,ham
title: Black Eyed Pea Bread Soup
ingredients: 6 cups fresh green beans, sliced | 1 habanero pepper, seeded and thinly sliced | 6 chicken leg quarters, with thigh attached | 1 cup small smoked ham | 1/4 cup frozen ham, cut into 2-inch strips | 1 cup frozen rye bread | fresh thyme sprig, for garnish
instructions: In large pot, combine green beans, habanero pepper, and half of the chicken. Pour in water, and bring to boil. Turn off heat and cover, letting stand for 15 to 20 minutes. In blender or food processor, process remaining chicken meat, ham, and frozen rye bread until it reaches desired consistency. Return mixture to large pot, and let stand 5 minutes. Serve in soup bowls, garnished with thyme.

title: Pimento Strips
ingredients: 1 pound pimento pepper slices | 1/2 cup crushed ice
instructions: Place pimento peppers in a pan with the crushed ice. Cover, and cook on low until tender.

title: Chicken and Veggies With Beef Broth
ingredients: 3/4 cup beef bouillon | 6 large red potatoes, halved | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 3 -4 chicken cutlets, cut into serving sized pieces
instructions: Place chicken pieces. Dissolve the boullion in 3/4 cup water. Add to the slow cooker, potatoes, and oregano. Cook on low heat setting for 7 hours or high heat setting for 2 hour. Adjust seasonings to taste.

title: Green Chili (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 can green chilies, halved | 2 lbs chicken wings | 1 1/2 cups buttermilk biscuits, small | 1/2 teaspoon freshly grated nutmeg
instructions: Separate wings into 3 pieces. Skin and bone chicken. Cut wings into serving sizes. In crockpot put green chilies, chicken wings, buttermilk biscuits. Sprinkle ground nutmeg over.

Random Ingredients: bean sprout,superfine sugar,ketchup,asafoetida powder,red cabbage,arborio rice
title: Sweet Rice and Vegetables
ingredients: 1 cup arborio rice | 1/2 cup ketchup | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 8 ounces red cabbage, shredded | 1/4 cup superfine sugar | 2 cups bean sprouts, halved
instructions: In a saucepan over medium heat, mix ketchup & asafoetida. Add uncooked rice and cabbage. Increase heat to medium high and bring to a boil. Lower heat and simmer for 10 minutes, then pour into serving dishes or a glass bowl. Sprinkle top with sugar and cut bean sprouts into thin triangles.

title: Spicy Sausage Chutney
ingredients: 1/2 cup chutney | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder | 3 ounces sliced canadian bacon | 1 can italian-style sausage | lime wedge
instructions: Combine chutney and coriander powder in microwave proof bowl. Cook and stir over very low heat until mixture is hot and very warm. Stir in bacon, sausage and lime wedges.

title: Beet Brownie
ingredients: 1 box yellow cake mix | 1 package fettuccine | 1 cup whipping cream | 1 cup whipping cream | 8 cups drained canned beet slices, julienned | 1 jar hot sauce, such as tabasco or equivalent | 1 lb fresh asparagus, chopped | 1/2 cup chopped pecans
instructions: Prepare yellow cake mix according to package directions. Remove cake mixture from oven and set aside to cool. In a large mixing bowl, whip cream until soft peaks form. Continue beating until fluffy. Beat in beets and hot sauce. Mix in cooked noodles and asparagus and pecans. Spread evenly into an ungreased 13 x 9 x 2 inch cake pan. Bake at 300 degrees f for 40 minutes or until heated through. Let cool for 5 minutes, then turn out onto a serving plate.

Random Ingredients: yellow squash,fennel seed,hazelnut,tequila,chili pepper,saffron thread,havarti cheese,orange juice
title: Mague's Chocolate Hazelnut Squash Gratin
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs havarti cheese or 1 1/2 lbs grana padano cheese, at room temperature | 1/4 cup sweet tequila | 1 pinch saffron thread | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1/3 cup hazelnuts, finely diced | 1 sweet chili pepper, sliced thinly | 1 tablespoon fresh orange juice | 1 orange, sliced into 2-inch wedges
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Cut cheese into 3 x 1/4 inch slices. Place cheese on a greased baking sheet and sprinkle with salt. Bake for 15 minutes or until cheese has melted. Turn over and bake for 1 minute longer. Transfer to a bowl and set aside. Meanwhile, in a blender jar with a tight fitting lid, combine the tequila, saffron, fennel seeds and hazelnuts. Cover and shake well. Reserve 1/8 cup of the sauce and add 1 tablespoon of the reserved sauce to the blender jar. Add sweet chili and orange juice. Cover and blend until smooth. Place cheese over a plate and spoon the reserved sauce over. Sprinkle with remaining salt. In a skillet over medium heat, saute the orange, skin side down for 2 minutes, or until just starting to turn transparent. Turn to brown the other side. Remove from skillet and serve hot.

title: Flammin Eggs
ingredients: 1 hard-boiled egg, hard boiled, shelled cut into 1/2 `` slices | 1/2 bunch of fresh mint, mint chopped fine | catsup, for dipping
instructions: Drop hard boiled egg slices by tablespoons into rapidly boiling salted water for five minutes then carefully remove and set aside. Repeat until all the hard boiled eggs are drained and cooled, then cut each egg in half and place in a jar. Add mint, a little at a time, tossing to coat. To serve, dip the egg halves in the catsup then in the mint.

Random Ingredients: celery seed,coconut extract,kosher salt,green chilies,almond extract,baking powder
title: Red Chilies
ingredients: 2 cups desiccated coconut ( about 2 cups ) | 1 can diced green chilies ( or to taste ) | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract | 1/4 teaspoon coconut extract | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 1/8 teaspoon celery seed
instructions: Preheat oven to 325. Spray a 9x9″ pan with cooking spray. In food processor blend all dry ingredients and set aside. Add wet ingredients and blend well. Spread evenly in pan and bake about 30 minutes or until it cracks and is dry. Cut into squares, serve warm.

Random Ingredients: mango,sherry wine,bean sprout,irish cream,cream tartar,extra sharp cheddar cheese,hazelnut,pico de gallo
title: Baked Chocolate Bean Covered Mango Salad
ingredients: 1 mango | 1 cup plain punnet bean sprouts | 1 cup pico de gallo | 1 cup extra-sharp cheddar cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup unsalted hazelnuts, toasted | 1/4 cup sherry wine | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/4 cup sweet sherry
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place the mango and pico de gallo on a parchment lined baking sheet. Bake at 350 degrees f until heated through, about 8 minutes, stirring several times. Remove from oven and allow to cool to room temperature. Stir the cheddar cheese, hazelnuts and sherry into the mango until well blended. Drizzle sherry mixture over the mango and mix well. Set mangoes in a large serving bowl. Spread bean mixture over the bean mixture and top with toasted hazelnuts. Serve immediately.

title: Indian Corn and Herb Powder
ingredients: 2 cups corn ( use frozen if using frozen ) | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1 teaspoon dried sweet thyme leaves
instructions: Cook corn and herbs over medium heat in a non stick skillet until tender and creamy, about 5 minutes. Stir in the cardamom and dried sweet thyme. Enjoy.

title: Roasted Beet and Cauliflower Filling
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups white vinegar | 1/4 cup fast rising yeast | 1 head cauliflower, cut into florets | 2 plum, quartered | 2 beets, peeled and halved
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. In a large bowl, whisk together the vinegar and yeast, and spread the cauliflower, tomatoes, beets, and beets onto a baking sheet. Place into a preheated oven, and roast vegetables until the edges are browned and the vegetables are tender, about 25 minutes.

title: Quick & Easy Barley Rellenos
ingredients: 1 can enchilada sauce ( or equivalent ) | 1 can sliced pearl barley ( or similar ) | 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce
instructions: Combine the jar of ingredients.

Random Ingredients: dill pickle,seafood,golden raisin,curry leaf,vegetable broth,ricotta cheese,italian cheese,lemon
title: Seafood Raita
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups reduced-sodium vegetable broth | 2 teaspoons vegetable broth | 10 large fresh curry leaves | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped fresh dill pickle | 3 ounces fresh ricotta cheese | 1 1/2 cups coarsely grated italian cheese blend | 1 tablespoon finely grated lemon, rind of | 2 tablespoons golden raisins
instructions: To make curry sauce, place the 2 teaspoons vegetable and the 2 teaspoons vegetable broth in a small saucepan over medium heat and bring to a simmer. When the broth is hot, stir in the curry leaves and pickles and simmer about 1 minute. Cool the soup and serve at once over ice cold, thin slices of fresh cheese. To make raita, in a medium bowl, mix the ricotta, italian cheese blend, lemon rind, and golden raisins until thoroughly mixed. Spoon some of the sauce and the chopped tomatoes into a wide mouth bowl, top with some of the creamy raita and tomatoes, drizzle with additional of the sauce and top with curry, then sprinkle with fresh croutons.

Random Ingredients: cajun seasoning,mexican cheese,beet,cooking oil,tomato sauce,mustard oil,canola oil,chipotle chile pepper
title: Mashed Potatoes Ole'
ingredients: 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1 pound fresh mixed pickled beets | 1 can whole peeled tomatoes with liquid | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 1/2 tablespoons canola oil | 1 tablespoon mustard oil | 1 tablespoon ground chipotle chile pepper | 1 3/4 teaspoons cajun seasoning | 1 1/2 cups shredded mexican cheese blend
instructions: Place the 2 tablespoons canola oil in the bottom of a large pot over medium heat. Place the beets into the pot, and cook, turning occasionally, until tender, and the skins begin to blacken, about 20 minutes. Drain, and rinse the beets under cold running water, place them into a bowl, and mash with a potato masher until smooth. Stem and set aside. Place the tomatoes and 1 1/2 tablespoons canola oil, mustard oil, and ground chipotle pepper in a saucepan, and bring to a low boil. Reduce heat, and simmer until the tomatoes lose their shape and the chips begin to melt into the oil and spices, about 10 minutes. Place the shredded cheese into a bowl, and stir in 1 teaspoon hot sauce, and set aside. Cook the beets over medium heat for 15 minutes. Stir in 2 1/4 cups water, and season with 1 1/2 teaspoons cajun seasoning. Cover, and simmer 10 minutes, then remove from the heat. Allow to cool slightly. Remove the beets and tomatoes to a food processor, and pulse about 1/4 to 1/4 and 1/4 until almost smooth. Reserve some cheese for another use. Stir the pureed puree back into the mashed potatoes. Remove the potato puree from the heat, and stir in the pickled beet mixture. Mash 1/4 of the potatoes into the mash and vegetables until no lumps remain. Transfer potatoes and tomato mixture to a 9x13 inch casserole dish, and spread remaining potatoes out over the top. Sprinkle top with the reserved cheese. Heat in the preheated oven until the potatoes are golden brown and the top is bubbly, 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Homemade Whiskey and Chilli Jam
ingredients: 500 ml fresh whiskey, from chippies and tom | 1 kg golden syrup, from chippies and chilies | 3 -6 thai red chili peppers
instructions: Peel chilis and leave whole. In a big pot heat whiskey until it starts bubbling up. Remove from heat and add sugar and chilli's. Stir until sugar dissolves and then place back on stove. Heat for about 90 minutes. Allow to set then pour into clean lids and seal. After 90 minutes, remove lids and chillis and store in airtight tin.

title: Chile Salt Body Polish
ingredients: 1/2 cup mirin ( sweet rice wine ) | 1/2 cup red wine ( not a sweet dessert wine ) | 3 dried red chilies, soaked in water for 30 minutes and finely chopped | 1/4 cup sweet basil | 1 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Pour 2/3 cup dry white wine and 2 tablespoons mirin into a large bowl. Chop dried chili very fine and add to mixture. Add basil and garlic salt mix well. Set aside for a few hours, allowing the flavors to develop. Pour mixture into a funnel and carefully into a clean plastic container. The salt will slowly start to form a skin on the skin. This process takes a lot of time but the process should take a quick 20 minute. Take mixture off the plastic container, shaking off excess and seal. This allows the salt to air dry. This can take anywhere from 2 - 3 days to get a good seal or for a longer marinating time.

Random Ingredients: chili flake,cherry,dill pickle,cashew,cardamom powder,beef stew meat
title: Dried Cherries Beef Kabobs
ingredients: 1 1/4 kg beef stew meat, cut in cubes or 1 kg lamb stew meat, cut into cubes | 4 sprigs dill pickles, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup sweet cherries or 1/2 cup kalamata olive, in a jar | 1 tablespoon fresh dill pickle, snipped | 1 tablespoon fresh sweet chili flakes ( or to taste ) | 2 tablespoons cashews, chuncks or 2 tablespoons cashews, for garnishing ( optional )
instructions: Put the meat into glass or stainless steel bowl. Cover with boiling water. Remove the hard outer layer. Cover tightly and set aside to soak for 5 minutes. Cut all the meat into cubes or chunks. Add the pickles, olives and dill pickles to the water in a large bowl and stir to combine. Drain the meat, reserve the water. Put the meat into a resealable plastic bag. Mix in the pickle mixture and its water. Close the bag and transfer the meat to the refrigerator. Refrigerate, refrigerated, for at least 3 hours, or overnight. Thread the meat on soaked metal skewers. Grill over hot coals, turning occasionally, until well charred, about 20 - 25 minutes or until done. Serve garnished with cashews, if desired.

Random Ingredients: asafoetida powder,snow pea,tomato ketchup,strawberry,golden raisin,mint,red jalapeno chile,green cardamom pod
title: Indian Style Fresh Strawberries
ingredients: 3/4 lb strawberry ( cut in half horizontally, about 1-inch thick ) | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1/4 cup tomato ketchup | 2 tablespoons golden raisins | 4 tablespoons diced green chiles | 1 1/2 teaspoons red jalapeno chiles | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh mint | 2 green cardamom pods, split open | 10 fresh snow peas ( if using frozen, thaw before using ) or 10 thin green pea pods ( if using frozen, thaw before using )
instructions: Cut fresh strawberries into halves lengthwise and remove the dark hulls. Cut each half into 4 wedges and set aside. Place the sliced strawberries into a small bowl. Season with asafoetida, pour tomato ketchup over and set aside. In another small bowl, stir together sugar and half of the sliced green chilies. Pour into a small serving dish or bowl and set aside. In a small pan, heat the remaining green chilies until fragrant, stir in half the red jalapeno and half the mint. Dip the strawberry wedges in the sieve, then add them to the sieve. Pour the tomato ketchup mixture over the strawberries and leave over night. Heat remaining green chilies over low heat and stir until the sugar dissolves. Remove from heat and sprinkle the reserved redjalapeno and mint over the strawberry mixture. Let stand for 10 minutes and then serve.

Random Ingredients: peach preserve,peanut,coconut extract,graham cracker crumb,almond,mozzarella cheese,dark raisin
title: Peach and Feta Cheesecake
ingredients: 10 ounces mozzarella cheese | 3/4 cup roasted peanuts, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup dark seedless raisin | 1 tablespoon coconut extract | 1/3 cup peach preserves | 1/3 cup shredded coconut | 1 graham cracker crumb
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Crumble cheese into a medium bowl. Add peanuts, raisins, extract, and coconut and mix well. Press mixture evenly into a 9 inch springform pan with parchment paper. Sprinkle top of cheesecake evenly with crumbs. Bake for 45 to 50 minutes until the edges begin to brown. Remove cheesecake from oven and cool. Cut into wedges.

title: Mango Chutney Corn Chips
ingredients: 4 cups corn tortilla chips | 1 cup mango chutney, divided | 1/2 cup canola oil, or as needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees f. Spread crushed corn tortilla chips onto a baking sheet. Roast in the preheated oven until the edges are lightly browned, 10 to 15 minutes. Spread 1/2 cup sweet mango chutney on 1 side of each corn chip, then spread 1 tablespoon mango chutney into the corn chip, half on top of both mango chutney, and more mango chutney over the seasoned cheese. Spread remaining 1/2 cup sweet mango chutney over the seasoned cheese. Return to the oven, and bake until the cheese has melted, about 10 minutes.

title: Southern Cajun Mustard
ingredients: 3 pounds coarse grain mustard | cajun seasoning to taste
instructions: In a large cast iron skillet, dry mustard on both sides until slightly browned. Sprinkle with cajun seasoning. Warm mustard up and serve.

title: Pineapple Hot Sauce
ingredients: 1 can crushed pineapple | 1/2 cup sweetened chili peppers ( from a jar of hot chili peppers )
instructions: In a food processor, pulse the pineapple, sweetened chili peppers and sweetened chili peppers until smooth. Store in a glass jar in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: rice vinegar,nut pecan,chinese five spice powder
title: Chinese Cabbage Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup chinese five spice powder, or more to taste | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1/2 cup chopped nuts, or more to taste
instructions: Mix 1/2 cup chinese five spice powder, rice vinegar, and nuts in a bowl.

title: Torshi - Ozark Tacos
ingredients: 3 ounces bok choy, peeled & coarsely shredded | 1/2 piece napa cabbage, coarsely shredded | 1/2 lb sausage | 1/4 cup chopped tomato | 12 no-salt-added stewed tomatoes | 2 ounces vodka
instructions: Torshi sauce, in a large skillet, fry the sausage, breaking up the chunks, until cooked through, remove with a slotted spoon and set aside. Add the bok choy, cabbage & tomato to the pork drippings & heat through. Add the vodka to deglaze the skillet and scrape it in well. Slice sausage & sausages into strips & add to the pot, cook for 1 minute over low heat. Then add the meat back to the pan to warm through the meat mixture. Serve with the nappa cabbage & pita bread. Enjoy note, to save sodium, you can use turkey bacon slices. You may also fry the meat in a skillet, breaking it up & adding a drizzle of olive oil.

title: Maple Roast Beef
ingredients: 3 lbs roast ( not rump steak ) | 1 cup maple syrup
instructions: The night before, place roast in crockpot. Pour maple syrup over roast. Cook on low 6 to 8 hours. Remove from crockpot and let rest for 15 minutes before slicing. Note, you may cook turkey for a different cooking method. When done, slice thinly or into strips.

title: Merry Spice Cookies
ingredients: 1 package light sour cream or 1 package light sour cream | 1/2 - 1 1/2 teaspoon clove, ground | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves | 1 cup ground almonds | 1 cup quick oats | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped blanched almond, toasted with the cloves
instructions: In a bowl, combine the sour cream and seasonings. Mix well. Gradually add the oats, mixing until well incorporated. If not using immediately, store in the refrigerator.

title: Simple Rice With Bread
ingredients: 1 lb cooked rice | 1 cup of cooked cubed italian bread
instructions: Brown the rice and place on a baking tray, spread with rice, top with bread, and bake in an oven for 25 mins at 350, until the bread is browned.

title: Foil Baked Asparagus
ingredients: 1/4 lb thin salt pork or 1/4 lb beef, diced | 2 tablespoons green cardamom pods, lightly crushed | 8 -12 inches asparagus, trimmed and heads cut crosswise into 2-inch pieces | 1 pinch ground cinnamon
instructions: Combine salt pork and green cardamom in a large mixing bowl. Add asparagus stir to coat with spices. Cover mixture and chill 8 hours or overnight. Turn asparagus pieces over and discard the salt pork pieces. Heat oven to 400°f. Spread salt pork mixture onto lightly oiled baking sheet. Bake asparagus pieces, 1 1/2 hours, until tender and golden.

title: Guilt-free Four-Ingredient Cheese for Breakfast
ingredients: 1 green mango, peeled and cubed | 1/2 cup shredded cheese ( i used cheddar jack )
instructions: Combine cheese with a little water in a bowl. Microwave until melted and starting to bubble. Stir in mango and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: lettuce,lite olive oil,white chocolate,chipotle chile,purpose flour,salmon
title: Smoked Salmon and Chipotle Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 500 g smoked salmon, chopped | 2 -4 tablespoons lite olive oil | 2 -4 teaspoons chipotle chiles, coarsely chopped ( from the can of chipotles ) | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | 2 -4 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1/4 cup lite olive oil | lettuce or baby greens
instructions: In a bowl, combine the chipotle chile, flour, oil and olive oil and add the salmon pieces, tossing until just coated. Spoon the salmon onto a plate and roll into a cylinder. Wrap each roll with a lettuce or other salad leaf and refrigerate until ready to use. Heat a small frying pan over medium high heat. When the pan is hot lightly fry the wrap until golden, about 3 - 4 minutes. If the wrap sticks to the pan, gently shake the pan back and forth until the wrap begins to crisp up. If any flour sticks outside the wrap, sprinkle it over a little more oil and sprinkle it over the wrap. Place the wrapped wrap on a sheet of aluminium foil and keep warm in a low oven while you are making the wraps. To serve, cut each wrap into 6 equal pieces and serve with a dip or cocktail rye bread. Variation, you can roll up each wrap in a bread shape, place onto a plate, cover with foil and keep warm in a low oven while you cook the rest.

title: Quinoa and Ham Appetizer Platters
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa, rinsed well | 12 slices deli ham | 12 asparagus, trimmed | 12 biscuits | fresh mint sprig ( to garnish )
instructions: Rinse quinoa and dry thoroughly, 1/4 cup at a time. Soak quinoa briefly in a very hot, but not boiling, cup of water for about 20 minutes before using to cover. Heat oven to 400 degrees. Cut ham into 1 inch pieces. Bake ham in a small ovenproof skillet until well browned, 10 to 15 minutes. Cut tips off asparagus with a vegetable peeler and cut into small pieces. Arrange ham in the hollowed out of each biscuit. Remove 1/4 cup warm quinoa with a spoon and set aside. Place each biscuit on top of a rack of a baking sheet and bake until tops are golden brown and crusty, 5 to 7 minutes. Top each cookie with a ham slice, then serve garnished with mint.

title: Red and Yellow Tomato Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 large red ripe tomato, seeded, peeled, finely diced | 1 medium cucumber, seeded, peeled, finely diced | 1 3/4 cups finely diced red ripe tomatoes | 1/2 cup water | tabasco jalapeno sauce
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the oil, diced tomato and cucumber. In 1 cup of the water, add the diced red tomatoes.

title: Spicy Red Curry Crunch
ingredients: 1 teaspoon red curry paste | 1 3/4 cups water | 3/4 cup mascarpone | 3/4 cup cream cheese | 1 1/4 cups mascarpone | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 1 egg yolk | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 1/4 cup ciabatta, finely shredded | 2 tablespoons fresh mint, thinly sliced
instructions: Place the red curry paste and water in a small saucepan. Bring to the boil, reduce heat and simmer for 1 minute. Pour the mixture in a large bowl and set aside for 12 minutes to allow the flavors to develop. Whip the mascarpone, cream cheese and red curry paste in a bowl. Add the egg yolk and mace. Blend well. Spread evenly over the bread, pressing it into the mixture to form a compact dough. Cut into bite size squares, place 1cm apart on a lightly greased baking paper lined tray and bake in a moderate oven for 8 minutes or until golden brown. Remove from the oven, pour the warm curry and mascarpone mixture over and set aside to cool completely. Store in an airtight container for up to 2 weeks. To serve, remove the bread from the bread from the bowl. Place on a serving plate, cut into squares and scatter with mint.

title: Hot German Sausage (Sausages a La Rydberg)
ingredients: 1 bunch kielbasa | ice water | 2 tablespoons yellow mustard | 1 tablespoon unsweetened coffee | 2 tablespoons white vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Slice sausages lengthwise.

Random Ingredients: tabasco sauce,ear corn cob,heavy whipping cream,chicken breast,cardamom,date
title: Saffron Chicken and Corn on the Cob
ingredients: 2 cans large whole chicken breasts, undrained ( about 6 chicken breasts ) | 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream | 2 tablespoons crushed dried dates | 2 tablespoons finely chopped pitted dates | 1 teaspoon crushed cardamom | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce ( or other hot pepper sauce to your taste ) | 6 ears corn on the cob
instructions: Combine the chicken, cream, dates, dates, cardamom, hot pepper sauce and pepper sauce in a bowl. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving. Preheat the broiler. Place the corn on the broiler pan rack. Broil 2 - 3 inches from the heat, uncovered, 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: extra large egg,white rice,curd cottage cheese,yogurt,pork loin chop
title: Lebanese Maitouja
ingredients: 1 lb pork loin chop, cubed | 1/2 cup white rice | 1 lb small curd cottage cheese | 10 extra-large eggs | 1 1/2 cups yogurt
instructions: Prepare rice and put into a medium sized pot over medium heat.

title: Devonshire Clod
ingredients: 1 1/2 ounces cocktail onions, chopped | crushed ice | lemon extract ( optional )
instructions: Place ice, onion and lemon extract in blender.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce,beet,pig tail,italian sausage,flour tortilla,red chili pepper,cabbage,white wine
title: Bale Wrapped Pig Tails with Sausage and Veggies
ingredients: 1/4 lb italian sausage | 2 tablespoons flour tortillas or 2 tablespoons corn tortillas | 4 large soft fresh pig tail | 1 small romaine lettuce head or 1 small head fresh spinach | 1 lb roasted red chili pepper, sliced with seeds, finely chopped | 1 head cabbage, finely shredded | 1/2 cup white wine or 1/2 cup chicken stock
instructions: Trim meat and cut into strips about 1in x 3in. Place strips into a skillet and sauté over medium high heat, stirring occasionally, until browned. Remove, drain, and set aside to drain the drippings. Wipe out pan. Place in a bowl with some of the drippings from the skillet. Wear a heavy duty paper towel to wash the pan. Wipe out pan and reserve. Place a large, heavy ovenproof skillet on the stove top over medium high heat. When pan's hot, arrange the tortillas in a circle of parchment or wax paper, overlapping one another slightly. As each tortilla is toasted, place on the skillet. Quickly arrange the meat strips on the tortillas in a single layer, laying them in the same fashion as the tortillas but leaving a 1/2 to 1/2 inch space at the top. Lay 1/2 the chopped lettuce and 1/2 the sliced peppers over the meat, laying them next to each other at the edge of the tortilla. Carefully remove the parchment or wax paper from the sides of the skillet and roll the meat up tightly. Continue until all the meat is used. Wipe the pan clean, wipe the pan clean and wipe out the pan. Arrange all the wrapped meat on the hot skillet, piling it attractively. Add the remaining ingredients and bring to the boil. Cover tightly and simmer over low heat until the meat is falling off the bones, about 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Adjust the seasoning. Serve piping hot.

Random Ingredients: chunky salsa,cream chicken soup,coconut milk,french fry,beef chuck,tomato sauce,star anise,phyllo dough
title: Baja Beef Pie
ingredients: 1 1/4 pounds boneless beef chuck | 1 bottle thick and chunky salsa | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 1/4 cups coconut milk | 1 star anise | 12 slices pre-cooked french fries, divided | 1 package frozen miniature phyllo dough
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Slice beef into 1/2 inch pieces. Place beef and salsa in a large baking dish. Cover with water. Bake in the preheated oven until beef is browned and tender, about 1 hour. Remove from oven and drain liquid from beef. Stir rice, cream of chicken soup, tomato sauce, and coconut milk into beef mixture. Simmer 20 minutes. Place a layer of french fries over beef and pour a little bit of broth over the top of the beef. Place another layer of french fries over beef and pour a little bit of broth over the top. Place layers of sliced beef over french fries and spoon a little bit of broth over the top. Place a third layer of star anise over beef. Place 12 phyllo dough sheets along dish. Brush top sheet with a little bit of melted butter. Bake in preheated oven until layers have puffed and are crisp, 10 to 15 minutes. Serve with sour cream.

Random Ingredients: salt pork,hot italian sausage,rosemary leaf,broccoli,miracle whip,spanish onion,tamari,clove
title: Nam Chien
ingredients: 1 lb broccoli | 3 lbs hot italian sausage | 1 sprig rosemary leaf | 2 whole cloves | 1 teaspoon kosher salt ( optional ) | 2 -3 cups miracle whip | 1 spanish onion ( thinly sliced ) | 12 ounces crumbled salt pork or 12 ounces bacon
instructions: In a saucepan over medium high heat, boil 3 quarts of water. When it comes to a boil, add the broccoli. Once you see small bubbles begin to form, remove it and set aside. In a medium saucepan over medium heat and add 2 - 4 quarts of salted water. When it comes to a boil, add the sausage. When it starts to get brown, raise the heat to medium high and cook, stirring to brown the sausage, 4 - 5 minutes. Add the rosemary leaves and cloves. Stir and cook for 5 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand. While the sauce is browning, microwave the salted veggies on high for about 12 minutes, stirring occasionally, until softened but not cooked as well as mushy. Turn off heat. Drain the water and set aside. When the sausage has cooled, add the cooked veggies to the saucepan. Stir and cook for another 10 minutes, until all the veggies are covered with the sausage and veggies. Place the mix into a serving bowl or divide among 4 plates. For best results serve with a bit of grated parmesan cheese sprinkled on top.

title: Marinade for Fish, Chicken, and Pork
ingredients: 2 teaspoons lime peel | 1 tablespoon garlic, minced
instructions: Combine all ingredients and add to chicken, pork, or fish. Allow to marinate in fridge for 3 to 4 days. To fry, fry fish until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: yellow onion,cranberry,maraschino cherry,pea carrot,green chili pepper,golden raisin
title: Cranberry, Carrots and Peas
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups frozen peas and carrots, thawed | 1/2 cup dried cranberries | 1 small red fresh green chili pepper, seeded and minced | 1 small yellow onion, minced | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 1/4 cup maraschino cherries, drained
instructions: Cook peas in 3 cups lightly salted water until crisp tender, about 8 minutes.

Random Ingredients: peanut butter,feta cheese,tomato sauce,asparagus,lime juice,sugar snap pea,active yeast
title: Easy Peanut Butter and Tomato Pretzels
ingredients: 1 package active dry yeast | 1 teaspoon sugar | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 1/2 cups peanut butter, melted | 1/2 cup light cream or 1/2 cup yogurt | 1/4 cup lime juice | 1/2 lb asparagus, cut on the diagonal into 1-inch slices | 1 package frozen sugar snap peas | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley or 2 tablespoons chopped cilantro
instructions: To prepare dough, in a large mixing bowl, dissolve the yeast and sugar in the tomato sauce and pour into a measuring cup. In a saucepan of boiling water, melt the peanut butter and stir in the cream until blended. Stir in the yeast mixture and the lime juice. Let stand 10 minutes or until the mixture is foamy. Drain the asparagus in a sieve and put into a bowl. Toss with the peanut butter, lime juice and sugar. Let stand 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 350°f. On a lightly floured surface, pat the asparagus into a 3 inch circle. Using a 2 inch cookie cutter, cut out the asparagus with the cutter at an angle about 1/2 inch deep, being careful not to cut all the way through. Arrange asparagus on a greased cookie sheet, about 1 inch apart. Sprinkle with the chopped parsley or cilantro and bake 30 minutes or until golden.

Random Ingredients: spinach fettuccine,soymilk,chicken stock cube,double cream,cider vinegar,bacon,vanilla
title: Chicken & Bacon Fettucine
ingredients: 4 ounces bacon, chopped ( use one smidge bacon ) | 2 cans chicken stock cubes, drained | 2 3/4 cups soymilk or 2 3/4 cups milk | 1 teaspoon vanilla, to taste | 1 double cream | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 250 g spinach fettuccine, cooked
instructions: Heat bacon fat in large saucepan until bacon becomes crisp, add stock cubes, stir over low heat until dissolved, add milk all at once and bring to boil. Reduce heat, simmer until milk thickens. Stir in vanilla until smooth to taste and vinegar. Add cream and stir until well blended and heated through. Meanwhile cook pasta according to package directions and drain. Rinse under cold water and drain well. Toss with sauce, serve immediately. Alternatively serve separately.

title: Easy Parsnips and Date
ingredients: 1 large parsnip, peeled and chopped | 1 packet dry onion soup mix | 1 can condensed dates | 1 1/2 teaspoons sugar
instructions: Place parsnip in a large pot with cold water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium and steam for 8 - 10 minutes. Drain, return to pot in 2 - 3 changes of water, stir well. Re cover, and allow to steam for 8 - 10 minutes. Pour off boiling water, then stir in the dry onion soup mix. Pour can of dates over the parsnip mixture. Cover, and bring to a slow boil for 5 minutes. Remove from heat, stir in sugar, and serve.

title: Wild Mushroom & Vanilla Instant Pudding
ingredients: 1 box vanilla instant pudding mix | 1 package wild mushrooms ( i use 2 packages depending on how much flavor the mushrooms are using )
instructions: In a large bowl combine all ingredients and mix until well combined. Refrigerate overnight for best results.

title: Pina Colada Dip
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas, rinsed and drained | 1 can chopped tomato ketchup | 1 can pineapple juice | 1/2 cup buttermilk | 1 lb tortilla chips
instructions: Combine drained chickpeas, chopped tomato ketchup and pineapple juice. Stir in buttermilk. Cover, and refrigerate until serving time. Serve with tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: peppermint candy,sazon goya coriander annatto,orange marmalade,rice,teriyaki sauce,yeast
title: Teriyaki Bread
ingredients: 1 envelope fresh yeast | 1/4 cup teriyaki sauce | 1/4 cup orange marmalade | 2 ounces rice, cold ( any long grain, short grain, or long grain is ok ) | 1 teaspoon sazon goya with coriander and annatto | peppermint candy ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°. In a large mixing bowl, dissolve the yeast in 2/3 cup of the teriyaki sauce. Add the rest of the teriyaki sauce and beat well with a mixer. Add the cold rice and the rest of the teriyaki sauce and beat again. Mix in a tablespoon of the reserved mixture. If the rice is dry before adding the marmalade, add a tablespoon or two of water. Cover loosely with plastic wrap and allow to ferment for about 20 minutes. If it is too wet you can add a little more flour.. To use, punch holes in the top of the dough with a fork, or prick with a toothpick. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes, until a hollow sounding sound comes out of the bread. Remove from the cookie sheet and cool for a few minutes. When cool, cut into 2 or 3 smaller pieces. Place each piece on a serving platter. Sprinkle with peppermint candy if desired.

Random Ingredients: polenta,almond extract,habanero pepper,fennel seed,dijon mustard,chili sauce,vanilla pod,red potato
title: Spicy Potato and Pepper Roundup #5FIX
ingredients: 3 red potatoes, cut into wedges | 1 1/2 cups polenta | 1 cup chinese chili sauce ( sriracha brand recommended ) | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1/8 teaspoon pure vanilla pod, seeds of | 1/2 habanero pepper, sliced into rings | 1/4 teaspoon fennel seed, crushed | 3 drops almond extract ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Place the potato wedges in a large saucepan of cold water.

title: Chicken in Cream Sauce!
ingredients: 4 chicken thighs, cut into three pieces | 1 cup double cream | 4 tablespoons lemon peel, finely grated
instructions: Place the chicken in a casserole dish, cover with a thick layer of cream and sprinkle with the grated lemon peel. Place under a hot grill for 15 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked. Serve with mashed potatoes and salad.

title: Pears in Black Pecan
ingredients: 1 lb fresh mixed fruit ( pears-ears, lemon wedges or assorted fresh fruits ) | 3 tablespoons white flour | 1/4 cup fresh pineapple juice ( optional ) | 1/2 cup white wine ( optional ) | 1/2 cup dark rum ( optional ) | cherries ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Pour the flour on to a clean dry surface. Rub in the fresh fruit for 1 minute using your fingers. Add the pineapple juice. If using, stir in the white wine and rum. Garnish with cherries. Chill for at least 2 - 3 hours.

Random Ingredients: ketchup,onion soup mix,chipotle chile,garam masala powder,chorizo sausage,lemon peel
title: Spicy Chorizo Dip
ingredients: 3 links chorizo sausage | 2 small onions, chopped | 3 chipotle chiles, diced | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 2/3 cup ketchup | 1/4 teaspoon garam masala powder
instructions: Preheat oven 350°f grease a 8x8 inch baking dish. In a skillet, brown chorizo over medium heat and drain. In blender, puree cooked chorizo, onion, chipotle peppers, onion soup mix, ketchup, and garam masala until smooth.

Random Ingredients: fennel seed,hungarian paprika,halibut fillet,cream celery soup,plantain,canning salt
title: Roasted Halibut with Sweet Plantain Dip
ingredients: 1 pound center cut halibut fillets | 1 can cream of celery soup | 2/3 cup canning salt | 3/4 teaspoon fennel seed | 1 dash hungarian paprika
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place halibut, cut side down, in a large, deep roasting pan with a lid. Combine cannelnut soup, cream of celery, fennel seeds, paprika and salt in small bowl.

Random Ingredients: pickle juice,tomato salsa,juniper berry,mexican cheese,red cabbage
title: Smokin Envu-Envu-Envu - Pickled Red Cabbage
ingredients: 2 lbs pickle juice or 2 lbs lime juice | 4 tablespoons dried italian spices | 6 juniper berries ( optional ) | 1 medium red cabbage | 1 lb mexican blend cheese, for garnishing ( optional )
instructions: Place pickle and oregano in a bowl. Squeeze some of the juice into the mixture and mix it with remaining ingredients. Add more oregano if desired. Let the pickles marinate in the refrigerator about 3 hours. When ready to serve them, add the mexican cheese to soften and mix well. Serve over white rice. Garnish with a nice red cabbage leaf.

title: Low Fat Swiss Chard for a Potluck and Dinner
ingredients: 3 whole tenderloin, with ends trimmed | 1 lb swiss chard, cut crosswise, rinsed & stems trimmed ( or your favorite spinach ) | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit or grill. Cut slit in each tenderloin& remove tenderloins. Using a cutting board or sharp knife, cut crosswise into 2 wide slices.

Random Ingredients: cider vinegar,spanish onion,mozzarella cheese,beer,sherry wine,blueberry,pork rib,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Slow Cooker Country Style Pork Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/2 - 1 lb country-style pork rib ( or use 2 bone-in pork ribs with the shoulder ) | 1/2 cup chopped spanish onion | 1/4 cup low sodium soy sauce ( i use low-sodium ) | 2 tablespoons dry sherry wine | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar ( or use white wine vinegar ) | 1 cup dry blueberries ( or other berries ) | 8 slices firm smoked mozzarella cheese
instructions: Coat slow cooker with vegetable oil cooking spray. Place pork, onion, soy sauce, sherry and vinegar in crockpot and stir to combine. Cover and cook on low setting for 8 hours. Remove pork and discard onion and juices from pork and discard the pork. Strain liquid from crockpot into saucepan. Add berry liquid and reheat. If using wine vinegar, stir in to saucepan, then keep warm until serving. To assemble sandwiches thinly slice pork, then arrange pork on bread.

title: Roast Pot Roast with Cauliflower & Green Olives
ingredients: 1 large potato roast | 2 1/2 teaspoons self raising flour | 1/2 cup breadcrumbs, approx | 6 -10 large stuffed green olives | 1 large cauliflower, chopped | 6 -20 stuffed olives, left whole
instructions: If using a lean beef, cut the meat into 6 - 10 pieces. Toss the flour, breadcrumbs and 3 tblspn olive oil. Wash, dry and core the cauliflower. Cut into 5cm pieces. Bring a large pan of generously salted water to a boil and add the beef. Cook for 5 minutes and drain. Return the beef to the pan with the cauliflower, olives and remaining oil and simmer gently for 1/2 hour until the beef is tender and the cauliflower well tender. The beef should be tender in the middle, and the vegetables tenderized in the middle. This would take up to an hour, depending on the size the roast. If the pan dries during cooking the beef, pour a little water into it. If not, continue cooking, or your beef may toughen. Remove the beef and vegetables to a cutting board and allow to rest 15 minutes before carving the roast. Serve the beef on your favourite dishes with crusty bread.

title: Kythoni Glyko (Zucchini Stew)
ingredients: 5 lbs zucchini | 2 1/2 lbs sweet italian sausage | 1/4 cup red wine | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric | 2 leeks, chopped
instructions: Cut zucchini into large cubes. Cut the sausages into 1 3/4 inch pieces. Trim fat from sausages. Heat 4 quarts water in a 6 quart or larger pot. Add zucchini, sausage, wine and turmeric. Cover the pot and bring to a boil. Cook at the lowest heat for about 1 hour. Add minced leeks in the last 15 minutes to thicken. Serve hot. Note~ this can be made in advance, and reheated in a 350° oven.

Random Ingredients: tangerine,italian herb seasoning,rice vinegar,couscous,cornstarch,peanut butter,cream chicken soup,sirloin steak
title: Peanut Butter Beef over Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sirloin steaks, cut into thin strips | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried italian herb seasoning | 7 1/2 ounces cream of chicken soup | 3 tablespoons rice vinegar | 3 tablespoons peanut butter | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 3 tablespoons tangerine juice or 3 tablespoons orange juice | 1/2 cup toasted and chopped peanuts or 1/2 cup cashews
instructions: Mix steak with seasoning, cream soup, vinegar, peanut butter and cornstarch.

title: Baked Winter Squash Filling With a Big Kick
ingredients: 1 container ricotta cheese | 3/4 cup yviteo or 3/4 cup greek yogurt | 1 tablespoon grated orange rind | 1 yellow squash, small, chopped | 1 lb ground chuck | 1/2 lb velveeta cheese, cut in small cubes | filling : | 2 tablespoons melted fat-free butter for brushing ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees f. Mix ricotta, yogurt and orange rind in a small bowl. Boil squash about 30 minutes or until tender. Drain well. Mix squash with meat. Dice velveeta and set aside. Melt butter in a small saucepan over medium heat. When butter has melted, stir in flour until smooth. Remove from heat, and add the cheese mixture. Stir until smooth, about 3 minutes, stirring constantly. Mix 1/4 of the warm velveeta mixture into flour in saucepan until well blended. Stir into cheese mixture, and continue stirring until filling is smooth. Remove from heat and stir in remaining velveeta mixture. Fill greased 9 x 13 inch baking dish with filling. Brush tops with melted fat free butter. Bake 30 minutes in the preheated oven, or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: nonfat cream,cheddar cheese,plain yogurt,chavrie goat cheese,corn tortilla,beetroot
title: Gnocchi
ingredients: 2 cups light plain yogurt | 1/2 cup nonfat sour cream | 1/2 cup finely shredded beetroot | 1/2 cup shredded cheddar cheese | 12 hot corn tortillas | 2 cups grated cheddar cheese | minced beetroots, for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Put yogurt, sour cream, 1/2 cup shredded beetroot, and 1/2 cup shredded cheddar cheese into a bowl. Toss to mix, then divide among tortillas. Top with minced beets. Roll up to taper with toothpicks. Arrange on a baking sheet, and bake for 9 minutes or until golden.

Random Ingredients: hard egg,ketchup,roasting chicken,hot green chili pepper,golden syrup,cabbage,cider vinegar,half
title: Homemade BBQ Chicken
ingredients: 1 roasting chicken | 1 tablespoon brown sugar | 8 hot green chili peppers | 4 hard-boiled eggs, diced | 3 tablespoons ketchup | 3 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon half-and-half | 3 tablespoons golden syrup
instructions: Place chicken in a large nonporous glass dish. Sprinkle brown sugar on top. Place hot green chiles on top of brown sugar. Cover dish and cook in microwave, on high power until chiles turn dark green with darker green spots and liquid in the dish. When done, remove from microwave. Peel chicken and cut into two pieces. When chicken juices run clear inside, add half and half, ketchup and vinegar to dish and stir. Cook, stirring for 2 minutes. Place chicken pieces back into dish and remove blackened skin. Chop flesh and place into medium saucepan. Add half and half and cook, stirring occasionally, until hot and thickened. If desired, spoon gravy over chicken. Serve with crusty bread. Great with potatoes and vegetable sticks.

Random Ingredients: water,white chocolate,meat,self rising flour,zucchini,romano cheese,oyster sauce
title: Pot Sticker Zucchini Cookies
ingredients: 1 lb frozen meat ( ground from deli rotisserie ) | 1 cup zucchini ( cut into small 1/4 inch slices ) | 1/2 cup white chocolate ( chopped ) | 2 tablespoons water ( lukewarm ) | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce ( lukewarm ) | 1 tablespoon self rising flour | 1 cup grated romano cheese
instructions: Cook meat, zucchini, white chocolate, and 2 tablespoons water in a heavy saucepan over moderate heat, stirring, until the chocolate melts and the mixture is smooth and creamy and the zucchini is just tender, about 5 minutes or less. Remove from heat and cool to room temperature. Stir the remaining tablespoon of water, the oyster sauce and flour into the cooled meat mixture and add the grated cheese, stirring until the zucchini is well coated and the dough has formed long, thin strands, about 2 minutes longer. Divide the mixture among paper cups. Make several small indentations in the dough with fingers and spoon 1 teaspoonful of the filling down the center and press down to form a circle about 10 inches in diameter. Repeat with the remaining filling, zucchini mixture and filling before transferring the dough, placing them on a baking sheet lined with wax paper. Chill the dough in the refrigerator for about 20 minutes before baking.

title: Chipotle Dry Rub
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried chipotle powder | 2 1/2 teaspoons ground peppercorns | 4 tablespoons oyster sauce | 3 teaspoons dry sherry wine | 1/2 teaspoon molasses | 8 -10 slices bread, cut into 1 inch cubes ( i recommend cuban or french bread ) | your favourite salsa
instructions: In a small bowl, sprinkle the chipotle and peppercorns with the oyster sauce, sherry, & molasses. Then spread the bread cubes on a non stick baking sheet. Bake at 350 degrees for 5 - 7 minutes per side. Serve over toast with salsa.

Random Ingredients: cheddar cheese,part ricotta cheese,corn tortilla chip,rice wine vinegar,spinach leaf,chicken,confectioner ' sugar,pomegranate juice
title: Chicken Nests With Chiles and Confiture
ingredients: 1/2 cup part-skim ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup diced roasted chicken | 3 tablespoons freshly grated kraft free singles reduced-fat cheddar cheese | 1/4 cup confectioners'sugar | 1 teaspoon rice wine vinegar | 2 cups packed fresh spinach leaves | 4 ounces pomegranate juice | 12 ounces corn tortilla chips, coarsely crumbs
instructions: In large bowl, combine cheese, chicken, and all but 3 tablespoons of spinach. In medium saucepan, combine remaining spinach, pomegranate juice and 2 tablespoons sugar and bring to boil. Add chicken mixture and simmer until spinach is just tender, stirring constantly. Remove from heat. To plate, sprinkle remaining cheese evenly over nestars. Ladle nests on a bed of cheddar cheese.

Random Ingredients: cabbage,dill weed,splenda sugar substitute,graham cracker crumb,coffee
title: Dilly Colcannon
ingredients: 1/2 - 3/4 cup prepared strong coffee | 3 cups colcannon cabbage | 1/4 teaspoon dill weed | 1/4 cup splenda sugar substitute | 1 small graham cracker crumb
instructions: Break finely shredded cabbage into large bowl, add splenda and chopped cabbage. Stir to mix well. Add dry crumbs and mix well. Chill until firm. You may need to add a little more coffee to help thicken the mixture. Form into a log with 1 or 2 pieces of biscuit sized dough, cut into 1 inch thick slices. Wrap each slice in waxed paper, freeze until firm. Serve on top of hot coffe beans.

title: French Fried Chicken
ingredients: 10 -12 chicken pieces | 4 tablespoons white flour | 1/4 cup white flour
instructions: The flour is the important part of the batter. It is sold as powder after the dish is painted with flour. It does not rise, but it rises slowly, until bubbles form around the chicken pieces. Dip chicken pieces first in flour and coat with flour, then fry in a large frying pan. Brown lightly and serve immediately, as a snack.

title: Broccoli and Apple Crumble (Low Fat) Appetizer
ingredients: 1 lb broccoli floret | 6 slices white breadcrumbs, stale or 3/4 - 1 cup stale white bread | 2 tablespoons apple fat ( from cooking apples ) | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
instructions: Steam the broccoli for 6 - 8 minutes. Rinse with cold water. When cool enough to handle wash well and cut into florets. Place broccoli in a bowl and mix in the bread crumbs and apple fat. Stir thoroughly. Spread mixture onto a large baking sheet and bake in a preheated 400ff oven for 15 - 20 minutes. While still hot, sprinkle with a little more bread crumbs just before serving.

title: Tortillas With Strawberry Jam and Chives
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs roasting chickens | 2 large yellow onions, finely chopped | 3 tablespoons brandy | chopped fresh chives | 1 1/2 cups whipped cream | 8 large free range tortillas or 8 large flour tortillas | 2 tablespoons jelly beans or 2 tablespoons strawberry jam
instructions: Place chicken in a large pot, cover and cook over low heat for approximately 4 hours, or until tender. Remove chicken from the stock and discard stock. Cool slightly. Remove meat from bones and skin from the breast and shred meat. Discard bone and skin. Place meat, 1 onion and 1/2 cup of brandy in a blender and process until smooth. Transfer mixture to a shallow dish and place in refrigerator. Add chives, 2 tbsp brandy and remaining 1/4 cup brandy to dressing in blender and blend till smooth. Whip cream and stir into chicken mixture. Wipe dressing out blender and return 1 tbsp of brandy and pour over salad and let sit to cool. Cut tortillas in half lengthwise. Lightly brush tortilla rounds with remaining brandy and place on baking sheet. Spoon half chicken salad on each tortilla and place in oven on broiler to toast, then turn over and toast other side. Toast under broiler, spread with 1 tbsp jelly before toasting until slightly brown and slightly crispy. Spread each tortilla with about 2 tbsp of salad dressing, then top with remaining chicken salad and the remaining dressing. Garnish with sliced chives.

title: Hominy and Cheese Pizzas
ingredients: 10 whole english muffins, split in half | 1 can hominy, drained, rinsed and reserve liquid | 2 -3 cups cheese spread | 2/3 cup ice water
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Spread one half of the english muffin halves with cheese spread. Place one half on the cheese spread. Place another half on top. Place on foil, cut side up on oven rack. Spray tops with cooking spray and put in oven. When muffins are slightly browned on top and bottom, remove from oven and allow to cool slightly. Repeat process until all muffins have been done. This helps keep the heat going and makes them crisp on the tops.

title: Moroccan Shrimp Salad
ingredients: 1 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 1/4 cup sweet white fish sauce or 1/4 cup wine vinegar | 36 fresh cilantro stems | 1 package couscous
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f arrange shrimp in a single layer in a nonreactive shallow baking dish. Combine wine vinegar, sweet white fish sauce, and cilantro in a small bowl and season with salt. Pour enough salad dressing over shrimp to coat completely.

title: Coriander & Ouzo Spaghetti
ingredients: 400 g spaghetti | 250 g ouzo | 3 3 tablespoons coriander seeds | 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin seeds
instructions: Cook the spaghetti. When it is cooked, drain the pasta, reserve some of the water. Add the ouzo and spices. When it starts to bubble, add some of the cooking water from the spaghetti to make a sauce like consistency. It should not be too thick but a little creamy. Serve with lots of fresh bread.

title: Spice Crusted French Loaf
ingredients: 3 tablespoons mixed spice ( i use 1/2 tsp baking blend mixed with 1/2 tsp cinnamon, 1 tsp british soda mixed with 1/2 tsp sugar ) | 1 loaf french bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c in a mixing bowl, combine mixed spice and soda. Cut bread into 4cm cubes and press cubes into a bread slice to make a breadcrumb size loaf. Spray a baking tray with cooking spray, and place bread and spice mixture in the tray.. Bake 40 minutes until lightly browned and crispy and serve with butter.

title: Salsa Verde - Southwest Relish
ingredients: 1/2 bell pepper, chopped | 3 -4 radishes | 1/4 cup salsa verde ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients and serve.

title: Quick and Easy Spaghetti Bolognese
ingredients: 3 tablespoons single cream | 6 ounces thin ramen noodles | 1 italian plum tomato
instructions: Place noodles in a saucepan of boiling water. Boil for 8 minutes, drain, and allow to cool. Meanwhile, place cream, tomato, and seasoning in a blender, and puree until smooth. Pour a little of the reserved pasta water into the soup, and stir, ensuring each noodle is submerged. Serve with additional cream on the side.

Random Ingredients: prune,tart apple,cheddar cheese,purpose flour,coriander powder,italian plum tomato,cocoa
title: Prunes and Cheddar Apples Au Gratin
ingredients: 2 cups all-purpose flour | 1 tablespoon cocoa | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 2 firm tart apples, peeled, thinly sliced and cut into 1 x 3/4-inch pieces | 1 1/4 cups cheddar cheese, freshly grated and divided | 4 ounces pitted prunes, soaked and drained | 1 can italian plum tomatoes, drained and coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. In a large bowl, mix together the flour, cocoa, and coriander powder. Add apples and 1/4 cup of the cheese. Mix until well mixed. Add chopped prunes and tomatoes. Stir until the apples are evenly coated in the batter. Transfer apple mixture to a baking dish and sprinkle with remaining 2/3 cup cheese. Bake in a preheated oven until the top turns a medium brown, 50 minutes to 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: chunky salsa,serranos,sirloin,bell pepper,cilantro leaf,poppy seed,spanish onion,orange
title: Peruvian Steak Sandwiches from the Crock Pot
ingredients: 2 lbs top sirloin, trimmed of excess fat, cut into four 4 by 1/2 slices, then into four equal 4 by 1/2 inch slices | 2 tablespoons poppy seeds | 1 sprig fresh cilantro leaves, for garnish | 2 serrano peppers ( seeded if you prefer more heat ) or 2 jalapeno chilies, seeded if desired ( seeded if you prefer more heat ) | 2 tablespoons chunky salsa | 1 orange, thinly sliced, for garnish ( zest of one orange-jelly-optional ) | 2 large spanish onions, peeled, halved lengthwise, then cut crosswise into 4 lengthwise slices | 2 tablespoons fresh cilantro leaves, for garnish | 1 small bell pepper, seeded and sliced, for garnish
instructions: Place each slice of meat onto a skewer alternating the strips of meat from 1/4 to 1/2 inches thick. Mix the poppy seeds and cilantro in a small bowl. Spread each with 1 tablespoon of the chunky salsa. Roll each piece of meat up the skewer and tuck the skewer through. Place in a crock pot or other crock pot that has been coated on the bottom with a light coating of pam and a medium high heat on your stove top for 20 minutes, or until the meat is starting to caramelize and the vegetables begin to soften. Garnish with orange slices and thinly sliced orange slices. Serve with hot bread. To freeze, transfer the meat to a freezer plastic bag, cover and place in the freezer. To serve, place on dinner plates and top with the vegetables of your choice garnished with cilantro sprigs, sliced oranges and peppers.

title: Fiesta Biscuits
ingredients: 1 package arugula or 1 package spinach | 1 cup half-and-half | 2/3 cup canned jalapeno slices | 1/4 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: In medium size bowl, combine chopped spinach, half and half mix well. Heat griddle. In a small bowl, using a fork, scrape up any dry bread bits left on the skillet. Pour off and discard excess liquid. Add jalapenos and baking powder to dry bread bits. Mix well and add to the cooked mix, stirring constantly until mixture is well coated. Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls on hot griddle. Bake on both side until crusty. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: thyme,italian parsley,syrup,italian turkey sausage,chicken bouillon,carrot,pickle,manicotti shell
title: Italian Sausage Stuffed Manicotti Shells
ingredients: 12 large manicotti shells | 2 cups shredded carrots | 1 cup chopped italian turkey sausage | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 2 teaspoons dried italian parsley | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon, divided | 2 cups prepared syrup ( i recommend bull's eye glaze or heinz ) | 1/4 cup pickle slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Bring a large pan of lightly salted water to a boil. Add manicotti and cook for 8 to 10 minute or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: head cabbage,bailey irish cream,grain rice,onion salt,pepperoni,cauliflower,taco seasoning,jam
title: Taco Cabbage-And-Onion Soup in a Hurry
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground round | 1 can fat-free evaporated milk or ( 10 ounce ) can fat-free evaporated milk | 1 package taco seasoning | 1 head cabbage, sliced thin | 1 large onion, sliced thin | 1 head cauliflower, broken into large flowerets | 1 jar jalapenos or ( 8 ounce ) jar hot pepperjack cheese slices | 1/2 cup long grain rice | 1/2 cup prepared karo baile irish cream ( or more if desired )
instructions: In a large non stick sauté pan over medium heat cook and stir ground beef until completely browned. Drain excess fat. Add evaporated milk/milk, taco seasoning and cabbage. Cover and cook until cabbage is tender, 10 to 15 minutes. In a separate skillet over medium heat cook the cauliflower flowerets in a small amount of oil until crisp tender. Reserve about 1/4 c cauliflower flowerets for garnish for garnish. Drain beef mixture and return to skillet. Top with cheese and sauté vegetables until melted and beginning to brown. Transfer to serving bowl and garnish with reserved cauliflower flowerets. Serve with jello gulee on the side for dipping. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: bartlett pear,creamy peanut butter,artichoke heart,rotini pasta,baby green,whipping cream,ancho chile powder,golden raisin
title: Artichoke and Pear Pasta Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces rotini pasta | 12 ounces canned artichoke hearts, drained | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 1 cup sour cream | 1/2 cup creamy peanut butter | 2 tablespoons minced ancho chile powder | 1 cup chopped baby greens | 1/2 cup chopped fresh bartlett pear
instructions: Cook pasta in a large pot of boiling, salted water until al dente, about 10 minutes.

title: Herbed Popcorn
ingredients: 4 cans refrigerated popcorn | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/2 cup chopped fresh herb, such as flat-leaf parsley | 2 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon
instructions: Place popcorn, cream, herb, and bouillon in the bowl of a food processor. Pulse until mixture resembles a coarse popcorn mix. Transfer the popcorn mix to 4 individual metal molds, or 6 cups for a larger pan.

Random Ingredients: dark chocolate,beef sirloin steak,shrimp,bean sprout,fennel seed,liquid smoke
title: Melt-In-Your-mouth Beef and Shrimp
ingredients: 3 tablespoons blackened liquid smoke | 2 tablespoons dark chocolate | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef top sirloin steaks, cut into 3-inch cubes | 2 cups beef sirloin steaks, cut into 3-inch cubes | 1/2 cup shredded unpeeled fresh seaweed ( about 7 ounces ) | 2 cups bean sprouts
instructions: Preheat broiler. Combine korean red pepper paste with liquid smoke, blackened liquid smoke, and chocolate. Coat steak and shrimp with mixture. Broil steak and shrimp until cooked through, 3 - 4 minutes per side for medium rare beef, 5 - 6 minutes per side for medium. Add beef, shrimps and seaweed to pan and cook until heated through, about 2 minutes. Garnish ocstk with sprouts.

Random Ingredients: olive,angel hair pasta,provolone cheese,thai chile,garlic,berry,cayenne pepper
title: Pasta with Three Kind of Three Kinds of Crunch
ingredients: 1 pound angel hair pasta ( fusilli ) | 8 cups mixed fresh berries | 1/2 cup sliced fresh thai chiles | 1/2 cup sliced provolone cheese | 1/2 cup olive, pitted and sliced | 1 1/2 teaspoons minced garlic | 1/8 teaspoon ground cayenne pepper
instructions: Fill a deep pot with lightly salted boiling water and bring to a rolling boil. Once the water is boiling, stir in the angel hair pasta, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 8 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink, and immediately return to the hot pasta water. Meanwhile, mix together the fresh berries with the thai chiles, provolone cheese, olive slices, garlic, and cayenne pepper. Stir this mixture into the cooked pasta. Remove the green leaves from the berry mixture and stir until well mixed. Serve warm.

title: Miss Pixie Dust
ingredients: 2 teaspoons vanilla | 2 teaspoons triple sec | 2 teaspoons liquid smoke
instructions: Mix together and roll into a ball. Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: chive,shiitake mushroom,extra virgin olive oil,celery,italian salad dressing mix,cream cheese
title: Italian Cream Cheese and Shiitake Mushroom Dip
ingredients: 2 cups shiitake mushrooms, finely chopped | 1 cup celery, finely chopped | 1 package cream cheese, cut into chunks | 1/2 cup italian salad dressing mix | 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil | 2 tablespoons fresh chives, minced
instructions: Heat oil in large saucepan until very hot. Add chopped mushrooms and celery. Sauté until vegetables are tender. Stir cream cheese until thoroughly blended. Add mushrooms and celery.

Random Ingredients: pie crust,cannellini bean,red wine vinegar,celery,dark soy sauce,garlic clove,brown lentil
title: Faux Dressing Vegetables
ingredients: 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 1 garlic clove, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons dark soy sauce | 1 teaspoon brown lentils | 3 tablespoons brown lentils | 3 tablespoons canned cannellini beans | 1/8 cup red wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon celery, finely chopped | 1 prepared oven-ready pie crust ( for the crust ), pie crust to serve
instructions: To make the dressing, combine all the ingredients into a jar with a tight fitting lid. Shake well. Store in the refrigerator until ready to use.

title: Mexican Apple Barley Pilaf
ingredients: 4 1/2 lbs apples, peeled, cored and cubed | 1 cup pearl barley | 2 tablespoons lemon zest | 1 1/2 tablespoons chili powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl and refrigerate. Bring to room temperature before serving.

Random Ingredients: stewing beef,white vinegar,bean,cooking oil,zucchini,cumin seed,radish,porridge oat
title: Beef and Bean Soup (Beef and Oats)
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 2 tablespoons white vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon cumin seed | 1 small radish | 2 zucchini | 1 can beans | 1/4 cup quick-cooking oats
instructions: Slice beef into very thin slices. Trim seeds from zucchini and cut into 1 inch pieces. Combine oil, vinegar and cumin seed in heavy skillet. Add beef and onion and sauté until beef is brown. Add zucchini and bring to boiling.

title: Quick Cuban Rice
ingredients: 1/2 pound country-style spareribs | 2 baking potatoes, cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes | 1 cup canned pineapple chunks, drained | 1 cup uncooked long-grain white rice
instructions: Place the spareribs in a large pot, and cover with enough water to just cover the ribs. Add the potatoes, and bring to a boil. Cover, reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes, or until tender. Drain the vegetables, and set aside. When the ribs are cool enough to handle, cut up into bite size pieces. Discard any pieces of ribs that don't. Return the meat and potato cubes to the pot, stir in the pineapple, and cook 2 minutes. Remove from the heat and set aside. Place 1/2 cup of rice in a glass bowl, and add the reserved pineapple chunks. Cover, and refrigerate 30 minutes. Pour the chilled rice into the bowl, mix well, and serve.

title: Guacamole Filets
ingredients: 2 lbs beef tenderloin | 1/4 cup guacamole | 4 star anise, crushed
instructions: Rinse tenderloin and pat dry. Cut into 12 slices. Heat coals or gas grill for direct heat. Place tenderloin on grill and cook until golden brown and instant read thermometer inserted in center registers 125 or 14 minutes. Transfer meat slice to cutting board and allow to rest for 5 minutes. Cut crosswise into thin slices. Place slices between plastic wrap and plastic wrap and flatten. Cool slightly. Using sharp knife, slice diagonally on diagonal into 1/4 inch slices. Place slices in storage jars. Sauce,. Add guacamole and star anise. Seal and place in refrigerator. Store in refrigerator for up to 1 month.

title: Nigella Lawson Prawn Bagels
ingredients: 600 g large raw prawns, shelled | 2 containers soymilk | 4 bagels ( or wholemeal bag )
instructions: Shell the prawns and reserve the shells. Chop the shells and discard the heads, tail fin and fins. Wrap the bagels in heavy duty foil and put on a baking tray in a preheated 350°f oven for 6 to 7 minutes. Remove the foil and put aside. Add the prawn heads and shells to the oven and cook for 10 to 12 minutes or until the prawns change colour. Remove from the oven and drain. Pour off the liquid from the pan. Add soymilk to the pan and bring to the boil. Add the bagels. Return to the oven and cook for 12 to 15 minutes more. Remove from the oven, drain and cool. Serve as is or on its own. Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: golden raisin,artichoke heart,ra el hanout spice mix,chorizo sausage,asiago cheese,fruit preserve,ha avocadoes,pasta sauce
title: Spicy Italian Nachos With Artichoke Hearts
ingredients: 12 ounces pasta sauce | 6 medium asiago cheese ( rind removed ) or 6 medium fontina ( rind removed ) cheese, cut into 1/4 `` thin rounds | 2 packages frozen marinated artichoke hearts, thawed and patted dry | 3 tablespoons golden raisins or 3 tablespoons raisins, slivered | 1 package chorizo sausage, casing removed | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon mixed arabic spices ( see note ) | 1 small hass avocado, peeled and pitted and thinly sliced ( optional ) | 12 small asian-style cooked and drained pasta shells or 12 small other small cooked medium cheese ( naan )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f in a medium size saucepan, combine all the sauce ingredients. Heat over medium heat until almost boiling, stirring frequently. Remove from heat. Place 1 layer of pasta in a nonstick baking pan. Top with 1/3 of the chorizo or sausage slices, then 1/3 of the asiago, 1/3 of the artichoke hearts and 1/3 of the raisins/raisins. Continue layering the chorizo and artichoke hearts, raisins/raisins, chorizo, pasta, asiago/artichoke slices and top with remaining sauce. Cover and bake until heated through and lightly browned and bubbling and beginning to bubble around the edges, 15 to 20 minutes. Meanwhile, heat a nonstick skillet over medium high heat for 3 seconds and sprinkle 1 teaspoon of the mixed arugula spice mix on the top. Turn skillet over and transfer the hot skillet to the oven. Bake uncovered until sauce is bubbling and beginning to brown, 5 to 8 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside. In a small bowl, combine 1/4 cup of the hot sauce and 1/8 cup water. Heat a small skillet over medium high heat.

title: Fried Oysters with Peanut Sauce
ingredients: 12 oysters in water, or as needed | 1/2 cup chopped nuts | 2 tablespoons creamy peanut butter | 1 teaspoon minced fresh ginger root | 2 teaspoons oyster sauce
instructions: Place oysters in a skillet with water, and bring to a simmer over medium low heat.

Random Ingredients: extra tofu,canola oil,beef steak,red chili powder,corn niblets,hazelnut,greek oregano,grain rice
title: Yummy Korean Beef
ingredients: 1 package extra firm tofu, cut into 6 wedges | 3 tablespoons canola oil | 3 cups cooked long-grain rice ( i used korean, but any rice will do ( i used jasmine ) | 2 tablespoons minced fresh greek oregano | 1 teaspoon dried red chili powder | 1 can corn niblets, drained | 1/2 cup chopped hazelnuts
instructions: Place meat wedges between two sheets of waxed paper on a work surface. Using a meat mallet, pound tofu on paper towels to flatten to a uniform thickness of 1/8 inch. This will not be necessary to shape. Meanwhile, heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add the tofu and brown on both sides. Transfer to plate. Drain the oil from the pan, reserving it. Add reserved oil to empty skillet. Add rice.

title: Arugula Salad With Crispy Fried Onions
ingredients: 8 bunches baby arugula | 2 tablespoons margarine | 2 medium hot red chili peppers | 1 cup chopped cilantro
instructions: In a small bowl, blend margarine, chile peppers, and cilantro. Divide arugula among 4 salad plates. Heat remaining margarine in skillet over medium heat. Add onions, and cook until brown, 5 - 7 minutes.

Random Ingredients: oriental flavor ramen noodle,white bread,white vinegar
title: Noodle Salad (Dynamite)
ingredients: 2 packages oriental-flavor instant ramen noodles | 1 cup white vinegar | 4 slices white bread
instructions: Combine ramen noodles in a bowl. Mix in vinegar. Cover and refrigerate until serving.

Random Ingredients: grain rice,sofrito sauce,breadcrumb,russet potato,vanilla extract,dark red kidney bean
title: Rice Crackfry (Rice Cooker)
ingredients: 1 lb russet potato | 2 cans dark red kidney beans, drained | 4 cups uncooked long grain rice ( cold ) | 3 tablespoons sofrito sauce ( i use soya brand ) | 1 tablespoon pure vanilla extract ( optional ) | 2 1/2 - 3 cups breadcrumbs ( fine )
instructions: In a pot, boil potatoes. Peel and dice potatoes, and add beans to the potatoes while rinsing it under running water to rinse out all the starch. Rinse them under running water to rinse out all the starch. Transfer the potatoes to a mixing bowl. Place the rice into the bowl, and the sofrito. Stir to combine ingredients. Cut the beans into long strips lengthwise, about 1 1/2 inches wide. If necessary, slice the strips into smaller sticks about 1/2 inch wide. Transfer to the mixing bowl with the potato mixture. Stir until the rice is evenly coated with this mixture. Spread the bean mixture into a shallow pan, and set aside about 2 1/2 tablespoons of bean mix that you may use for topping. To do this, place a plate on top of the sofrito to hold it, then a plate on the side. Using the back of your spoon, press mixture in the plate to coat with the mixture.. The mixture should not be runny. Set aside to cool for 15 minutes. In small batches, gently mix rice mixture into the rice.
