Spread into a greased bread pan, and bake at 300 degrees for about 25 minutes, or until top is a rich golden brown color. Dipping options, if you like, add 1 tablespoon of cornstarch mixed with a couple tablespoons of cold water to the finished cracker, and beat with a fork until smooth, then add to the rice and bean mix before serving.

Random Ingredients: white pepper,reynolds wrap foil,red lentil,pomegranate seed,chicken bouillon cube,red kidney bean,lemon juice,dijon mustard
title: Baked Lentil Salad
ingredients: 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon cube | 1/2 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 1 cup red lentil | 1 1/2 cups white beans, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup red pomegranate seeds ( optional ) | 1 -2 tablespoon fresh lemon juice | reynolds wrap foil
instructions: Wrap the foil tightly around the inside of a roasting pan set at about 2 inches of heat. Sprinkle with the chicken bouillon cube and allow to sit for about 15 minutes. The oven should be 300 degrees. In a medium bowl mash up the white beans with a fork, and add the lentils and pomegranate seeds if using. Stir to combine, then transfer to the prepared pan. Add the mustard and continue cooking on the roast for about 15 minutes, or until the lentils start to bubble and smell slightly roasted. Remove the foil and pour the contents of the roasting pan over the top of the lentils and pomegranate seeds. Allow to cook for 5 minutes on the grill, then check for salt. Serve and enjoy. Variation, for a change of pace, add some lemon juice after removing the chicken from the bone. Note, you can also try using fresh lemon juice instead of prepared lemon, or a squeeze of a lemon wedge instead of the dressing.

Random Ingredients: onion,black bean,chicken bouillon cube,purpose flour,tomato green chilies,self rising flour
title: Black Bean Soup - Mexican Style
ingredients: 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, drained | 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained | 2/3 cup all-purpose flour | 1/4 cup self-rising flour | 1/3 cup diced onion | 1 chicken bouillon cube or 1 vegetarian bouillon cube
instructions: Place all ingredients in a stock pot, and gently heat to boiling.

title: Pork Tenderloin with Clotted Cream (Pork Au Chocolat)
ingredients: 300 ml double cream | 2 pork tenderloins, about 500g
instructions: Cut a cross in the scored fat on each tenderloin. Whip the cream on low speed, then gradually add the clotted cream. Heat the broiler and put the pork on a rack, fat side down. Place under the hot grill for 3 - 4 minutes or until just cooked through. Turn and repeat until cooked through. Serve with a side dish of steamed seasonal greens.

Random Ingredients: sherry wine,chestnut,manchego cheese,baby spinach,jalapeno,vegan parmesan cheese
title: Manchego Cheese and Spinach Salad
ingredients: 6 tablespoons manchego cheese, shredded | 3 tablespoons vegan parmesan cheese, finely grated | 1 small jalapeno, minced | 1 tablespoon dry sherry wine | 1 tablespoon of chopped roasted deli fresh chestnuts | 1 bag baby english spinach
instructions: In a bowl, combine the manchego with the parmesan and the jalapeno. Toss in the sherry and chopped chestnuts. Just before serving, toss in the spinach, then garnish with the grated manchego cheese.

title: Spaghetti With Tandoori Shrimp and Mushrooms
ingredients: 12 ounces spaghetti | 2/3 cup low-fat egg substitute ( egg replacer can be substituted ) | 1/2 cup currants | 2 ounces jumbo shrimp | 1 vanilla bean, split lengthwise | 1/4 cup tandoori paste | 1/4 cup cremini mushroom, sliced or sliced ( to taste )
instructions: Cook spaghetti in boiling slated water as per package instructions. Drain well and rinse out pan with cold water. Combine 1/4 cup egg replacer or vegetable oil and the currants and set aside. Drain shrimp, pat dry with paper towels and remove tails. Cut the vanilla bean lengthwise into 1 1/2 inch pieces and open it to make an open place. Place the shrimp in a small bowl, and place the garlic and 2 tablespoons lemon juice in the bowl. Stir gently to mix. Place the remaining 1/4 cup egg replacer in another small bowl, make sure it is coated in the egg substitute. Lightly oil a 9 x 13 baking dish. Place spaghetti in dish and add the shrimp mixture, spreading evenly. Sprinkle with mushrooms. Make an indentation in the shrimp with a sharp fork and set aside. Brush the exposed side of the shrimp with remaining egg replacer and place the crab claw on top of the shrimp. Pour the reserved currant mixture over the shrimp. Cover and bake at 375°f for 70 - 80 minutes. Remove from oven, uncover and brush shrimp with remaining egg replacer. Return to baking pan.

Random Ingredients: green chile,stew meat,bay leaf,eggplant,safflower oil,fine salt,brown rice
title: Papas Alentejana
ingredients: 1 gallon safflower oil | 2 pounds stew meat, cut into 1 1/2-inch cubes | 2 tablespoons fine salt | 1 bay leaf, or more to taste | 12 large eggs, lightly beaten | 1/4 cup finely chopped green chiles | cooked brown rice, for serving
instructions: Heat the oil in a deep heavy casserole large enough to hold the meat. Season the beef with the salt, then fry on all sides until browned in small bits with dark brown splotchy lines. Random Ingredients: vegetable broth,lemon peel,chili pepper flake,active yeast,sea salt,garlic
title: Homemade Lemon and Garlic White Pizza Dough

Cover with plastic wrap and proof until very bubbling, about 2 hours. Bake at 400 degrees f. For 15 - 20 minutes, or until golden in color.

title: Pesto Broccoli & Bean Salsa

instructions: Stir the broccoli, baby corn, tomatoes with green chile peppers, pesto sauce, basil, bamboo shoots, and red pepper together in a large pot.

Random Ingredients: mushroom soup,cooking oil,kidney bean,tomato sauce,cocoa powder,gouda cheese,lime
title: Nacho Casserole

Bake for 45 - 60 minutes, or until hot and bubbly.

title: Carrabba's Italian Rice

instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Bring two cups of water to boil and pour it in a large dish. When water comes to a boil, add rice and stir. Turn down heat to simmer. Cover and simmer until the rice is creamy and all the water is absorbed. Add bell peppers, stir everything. Cover and cook for an additional five minutes. Serve.

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a large bowl, mix the cabbage with salt. Set aside to drain for 30 minutes. Combine 1 tablespoon pesto with 1/4 cup dry basil pesto, shortening, sesame oil, and liquid smoke in a wide, shallow dish. Add chicken.

title: Papar-Yukon (Baked Chickpeas)

instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Scrub & lay the potatoes in the bottom of a 2 1/2 quart casserole dish. Cover with water 1 1/2 inches deep & bake the potatoes over an open flame or in the oven for 45 minutes. Drain the potatoes & then mash. While they are baking, trim the bacon slice & chop the ham or bacon & set aside. Pour the beans into the pan & cook over moderate heat just until they are soft. Turn off the heat & allow them to soak until ready to use. Ladle half the beans into a small bowl & mash. Add the mashed potatoes to the remaining beans & mash thoroughly. Spread mixture onto the french's top layer of potatoes. Sprinkle the ham over the beans & bake uncovered for about 1 hour, or until the potatoes are just beginning to brown & the top is brown & a crusty. Remove from the oven & let stand for about 5 minutes, then cut into thick slices & serve piping hot. title: Marinated Mushrooms

instructions: Drain mushrooms thoroughly. Remove stems. Place in large shallow glass or porcelain dish. Lightly sprinkle with rosemary sprig, if using. Cover and let stand about 1 hour at room temp, stirring once. Turn mushrooms, cover and let stand about 1 1/2 hours at room temperature or longer.

title: Almond Beef Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup rice vinegar | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 1 1/2 lbs ground beef | 1 package uncooked rice vermicelli | 2 cups cherry tomatoes, cut in half | 2 teaspoons hot sauce
instructions: To make the dressing, combine the first 4 ingredients in a saucepan. Bring to a boil, and cook 2 minutes or until thickened, stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Cook vermicelli according to package directions. Drain and cool to room temperature, then drain again. Cut into thin strips. Combine noodles, meat, and dressing in a bowl. Mix well, adjust seasoning with more hot sauce if desired.

instructions: In a large skillet, over medium heat, cook the ground chuck, stirring occasionally until no longer pink. Drain grease. instructions: Mix salt packed cabbage, lamb shanks and pork stew meat together. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Heat overnite, this improves flavor and heighten the broth more flavorful. Cook in a preheated 325 degrees f oven for 1 - 1 1/2 hours, then serve.

title: Cheese Twists

instructions: Using a cookie cutter cut out 16 squares of puff pastry. Brush with creme fraiche, layer a square of dough into a 9x13 inch pan. Cover with parchment, allow to rise, then refrigerate for about 15 minutes. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Uncover and bake the pastry for 20 to 22 minutes, until it just starts to turn golden.

Random Ingredients: onion powder,mustard seed,confectioner sugar,tortilla,nutmeg,avocado,maraschino cherry,beef tenderloin
title: Melting Beef and Avocado Tacos
ingredients: 1 beef tenderloin | 1/2 teaspoon mustard seed | 1 1/2 teaspoons mixed spice dried maraschino cherries | 1 teaspoon grated nutmeg | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 1 cup flaked tortillas | 1 avocado, peeled and pitted | 1/4 cup finely chopped onion | 2 tablespoons prepared mustard seeds | confectioners'sugar, for dusting
instructions: Remove the silver skin from the steaks. Rinse under cold water and dry with paper towels. Cut into thin strips about 1 1/2 inches long. Set aside. In a small heavy skillet, toast the 1/2 teaspoon of mustard on very medium high heat until dry. Stir in the mixed spice maraschino cherries, nutmeg and onion powder. Spread the tortillas with 1 tablespoon of the prepared mustard. Spread 1/2 cup of the shaved meat on each tortilla and top with 1/8 of the avocado slices. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon chopped onion and 1 tablespoon of the mustard. Roll up the each tortilla and secure with toothpicks. In a large, heavy skillet, heat 1 1/2 tablespoons of mustard seed over medium high heat. As soon as the seeds begin to sputter, turn them and fry until charred and golden brown. Combine with 1/8 cup of chopped onion, 1 tablespoon of prepared mustard powder and remaining 1 1/2 tablespoons of prepared mustard. Roll up the tortillas and serve on a warm plate with the avocado filling. Top with the avocado mixture and sprinkle with confectioners' sugar.

title: Hot, Sweet and Savory British Peanut Sandwiches

instructions: Place the ham and salami sandwich slices on a microwavable plate. Top with golden syrup and chicken stock. Microwave on high for 8 minute or until hot and bubbly in texture. Place the apple slices on top. Microwave for a further 1 - 2 minute or until apple slices are warm. Serve immediately.

title: Macadamia Nuts
ingredients: 1 package macadamia nuts, cashews or 1 package salted nuts | 1/4 cup slivered almonds
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Put nuts onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake until light brown, about 10 minutes. Cool. Remove and transfer nuts to a medium bowl. Add almonds.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,salt black pepper,pesto sauce,brown lentil,fine sea salt,herb,lime juice zest,chicken stock
title: Lentils & Rice With Herbs & Dried Lime (Cread Cooker)
ingredients: 225 g brown lentils | 450 g rye bread, cut into 2 cm x 1 cm pices | 50 ml olive oil or 50 ml cooking oil | 1 - 1 1/2 cup chicken stock | salt and black pepper | 1 lime, juice and zest of | 1 tablespoon dried herbs ( thyme, oregano & parsley ) | fine sea salt
instructions: Place all ingredients except bread in the bread bowl. Season with sea salt and black pepper. Set bread bowl on the bread setting. Cook on the bread setting. title: Spaetzle With Sausage and Beet Borscht
ingredients: 500 g sauerkraut | 200 g black short-grain white rice | 2 teaspoons beef bouillon | 1 can chickpeas, rinsed and drained | 500 g beet sticks | 1 small orange | 1 small jam
instructions: Heat the sausages in a frying pan and brown on all sides. Set aside and keep warm. Boil the salted water in an extra large pot and add the barley. Boil for around 10 minutes, stirring regularly. Add the beef, the sausages and the bouillon. Stir well, cook for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add the drained chickpeas and the water from the can. Bring to a boil and continue to boil, stirring regularly. Meanwhile, cut a small slice of rind from the orange and zest. Slice off the zest and white pith with a sharp knife at an angle. Cut slices into 1/2 inch pieces. Add the cut rind to the soup along with the orange zest and orange zest. Meanwhile, cook the beet sticks at a very gentle simmer for around 40 to 50 minutes, until soft. Stir the beet into the bowl with the sauerkraut. Taste for seasoning. Divide the rice into 4 serving bowls and ladle the soup into each.

title: Spaghetti Alla Naranjouria
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups uncooked spaghetti or 1 1/2 cups vermicelli | 1 tablespoon margarine or 1 tablespoon butter | 3/4 cup orange juice concentrate, thawed and undiluted | 1 3/4 cups red potatoes, medium dice | 1 1/2 cups french baguettes, cut into 1/2 slices | 2 1/3 cups calrose rice, brown, cooked ( i used basmati rice ) | 1/4 cup minced fresh coriander ( optional )
instructions: Prepare spaghetti or vermicelli according to package directions and drain when al dente.

title: Baby Oranges with Peas

instructions: Arrange peas in a 3 to 4 quart heavy duty plastic bag. Sprinkle parsley over peas and shake to coat. Pack loosely in plastic bag and let air dry overnight. Preheat oven to 450°f. Remove bag from freezer. Combine parsley with 1 tablespoon hot water, then spoon water evenly over all. Place bag in foil lined baking sheet. Bake bag until just tender, about 20 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Italian Stuffed Peppers

instructions: Place pepper slices in large microwave safe bowl and lightly spray with cooking spray. Layer ingredients in order given in order listed. Note, in order to fill the peppers, use a knife and fill with stuffing mixture, close up and secure with a toothpick to hold together. The stuffed peppers are delicious.

title:

instructions: Place grated onion on plate and spoon over tuna and grated parmesan. Serve with hot crusty bread or crackers.

instructions: Mix all the above ingredients and marinade until ready to use. Microwave on high for 1 minute until heated thoroughly. Add to your stir fry recipe and stir. Serve in bowl garnished with pears.

title: Marinated Chicken

instructions: Drain the sundried tomatoes into a small bowl and set them aside in a dish to be used later. Pat chicken dry with paper towels and sprinkle with kosher salt. Pour sundried tomatoes through a strainer into the skillet, adding a tablespoon or two of water to the skillet. Cook and stir until sauce is reduced to a thick paste, about 30 seconds.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,egg white,parmesan cheese,head romaine lettuce
title: Torta Di Cavolfi
ingredients: 3 whole heads romaine lettuce - rinsed, dried and chopped | 4 egg whites | 3/4 cup freshly grated parmesan cheese | salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Lightly grease a baking sheet. Pour egg whites into a bowl, and beat with a fork to form a thick batter.

title: Rice With Rice
ingredients: 1 pint vegetable stock | 1 cup long-grain white rice or 1 cup valencia rice | 300 g cream cheese, softened
instructions: Heat the stock up on the stove and add all the other ingredients and beat until smooth. Pour into a casserole dish, and bake in a moderate oven until hot all the way through.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,vital wheat gluten,dark raisin,walnut,molasses,serrano chili
title: Kosher Richmond Style Chili Peppers
ingredients: 6 serrano chili, stemmed | 2 cups dark raisins | 1 cup walnuts, chopped | 1/3 cup light molasses | 1 cup grand marnier or 1 cup orange juice | 2 tablespoons vital wheat gluten, blend
instructions: In a large nonreactive pot, place the chili peppers on warm water and cook until they begin to wilt or blister and change color, about 15 minutes. Place the chili peppers in a metal colander and set aside to cool for at least 15 minutes. Drain the chili peppers and place them in a bowl. Place the raisins in a bowl and cover with hot water. Let sit 10 minutes, then drain and pat dry with paper towels. Transfer the drained chili peppers to the food processor or blender. Add the raisins, walnuts, molasses, grand marnier, and 1 cup water, and puree until smooth. Pour into sterilized jars and process in 1/2 to 3/4 cup boiling water baths at 0 1/2 level until the air bubbles form, 13 to 14 minutes.

Random Ingredients: bailey irish cream,dark beer,sage,head cauliflower,onion salt,corn
title: Cauliflower Ale Beer Can
ingredients: 1 onion, chopped | 3/4 cup red- or yellow corn | 1/4 cup light beer | 1 1/2 teaspoons rubbed sage | 3/4 teaspoon celery salt | 3/4 head cauliflower, cored and cut into florets | 2/3 cup dark beer
instructions: Simmer cauliflower in its own water approximately 20 minutes or until just tender. Drain and set aside. In a large bowl, mix onion, corn, 1/4 cup light beer and sage. Stir in cauliflower. In a microwave, heat dark beer, stirring and scraping every so often, for approximately 30 seconds or until it bubbles and is thickened. Serve at once.

title: Herbal Mint Spread
ingredients: 4 tablespoons tahini | 3 tablespoons of fresh mint leaves
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a food processor. Process, adding more mint if desired, until mixture is smooth and creamy. Enjoy note the texture of the mint will change as you blend. Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator. Note, recipe can be made several hours in advance, although it improves with storage.

Random Ingredients: chicken broth,hard egg,coconut water,cherry tomato,taco seasoning
title: Tortilla De Coco
ingredients: 2 cups chicken broth | 2 cups cherry tomatoes, cut in halves crosswise | 1/2 cup desiccated coconut water | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning | 1 large hard-boiled egg, halved, for garnish
instructions: In a large saucepan, bring chicken broth to a boil. Reduce heat, and simmer 5 minutes. Remove from heat, and whisk in cherry tomatoes, coconut water, and taco seasoning. Cover, and let sit 20 minutes to marinate. Garnish with hard boiled egg halves.

title: Pasta With Shrimp, Zucchini and Two Beans
ingredients: 3 cups zucchini, cut lenghtwise into thick slices | 4 cups canned great northern beans, undrained | 1 lb medium shrimp, cooked & peeled ( medium or large ) | 1 tablespoon mixed italian herbs | 1/4 cup dill, minced | 1 tablespoon lemons or 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 1/2 lbs rigatoni pasta or 1 1/2 lbs other pastas
instructions: Cook zucchini until tender. Cut into half inch lengths. Combine remaining ingredients except rigatoni and cook until heated through. Cook pasta in water. Drain and toss with remaining ingredients. Serve mixture at once.

Random Ingredients: nonfat milk,yukon gold potato,green onion,jalapeno pepper
title: Jambalaya® Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 2 pounds yukon gold potatoes, peeled and diced | 2 bunches green onions, chopped | 2/3 cup nonfat milk | 2 cans diced jalapeno peppers, drained
instructions: Place the potatoes, green onions, milk, and jalapeno peppers into a large pot. Cover the pot, and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to medium low, and simmer until tender, about 15 minutes. Remove from heat, and allow the pot to stand, covered, for about 10 minutes to thicken. Remove from heat, cool, and serve.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,bread crumb,cardamom seed,black vinegar,chinese five spice powder,spinach leaf
title: Chiang Mai Spinach Wraps
ingredients:
1 cup finely shredded fresh spinach leaves | 1/4 cup chinese rice-a-vermeseed wine-sweetened | 3 tablespoons dark rum ( e.
    -g.
    - bacardi 151 and tanqueray ) | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom seeds | 1/4 teaspoon chinese five-spice powder ( e.
    -g.
    - calamari, churkey, and pineapple ) | 1/3 cup plain bread crumbs, or as needed | 2 1/2 tablespoons black vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Stir together the spinach, ricea vermeseed wine, dark rum, cardamom seed, and five spice powder in a large bowl. Add as much bread crumbs as needed to create the stuffing. Place a heaping teaspoonful of stuffing at a point across each green leaf and roll the leaf around the stuffing using your fingers and wet hands to help hold stuffing together. Place rolled wraps seam side down on the baking sheet, and brush tops with some water. Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: lobster tail,chicken wing,cheese,anise seed,cider vinegar,wheat flour,garlic granule
title: Dairy Free, Low Fat, Easy French Style Chicken
ingredients: 1 lb lobster tail, sliced | 18 ounces chicken wings | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar ( i use rice vinegar ) | 1 tablespoon instant minced garlic granules ( or more! ) | 1 tablespoon whole wheat flour | 4 teaspoons anise seeds | 1/2 cup skim milk cheese or 1/2 cup shredded low fat swiss cheese
instructions: Mix everything together except the cheese. Place on greased baking sheet. Bake on 325° for 45 - 45 minutes. When you take the pan out of the oven, top with cheese slices and bake another 5 minutes until cheese is melted and golden brown..

title: Homemade Macaroni Shells
ingredients: 1 box macaroni | 3 whole cloves
instructions: Drain the macaroni into a colander. Pour a bit more water, a dash of salt, and a whole clove into a large bowl. Break off a small piece of aluminum foil. Place the macaroni sheets on the foil. Wrap up the foil tightly, and place in a plastic bowl. Place the bowl in the fridge for 24 hours. When ready to cook the shells, bring water to a boil in a large pot. Add the macaroni to the boiling water and let boil 2 - 3 minutes longer, just to soften them. Drain the noodles, and transfer to your favorite sauce recipe.

Random Ingredients: cheese,italian bread,caster sugar,cream chicken soup,sherry wine
title: Easy Cheese Dessert Bake
ingredients: 12 slices italian bread | 3 tablespoons sherry wine | 750 ml cream of chicken soup | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 200 g tasty cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 degrees centigrade. Arrange half the bread around the base, covering the entire base. Combine the rest of the ingredients. Bake in an oven, uncovered, for 35 - 40 minutes or until golden, bubbling and well flavoured. Serve with lots of crackers. Note, can add grated carrot for a bit of crunch to this. For vegan use only the cream of chicken soup.

Random Ingredients: seasoning salt,white onion,bok choy,yellow onion,almond extract
title: Shuku Namasu (Shuku Shuku Bok Choy)
ingredients: 2 bunches bok choy | 1 medium white onion | 3 1/2 tablespoons dried onions | 1 large yellow onion | 4 1/2 tablespoons dried bok choy | 4 1/2 tablespoons dried bok choy | 1 1/2 teaspoons seasoning salt | 3/4 teaspoon maggi seasoning salt
instructions: Wash the bok choy thoroughly and separate the leaves from the stalk. Wash, peel and slice the stalk into a half inch diameter strip across the thickness of the bok choy leaves. Slice up the roots from the stalks and separate them from the stalk. Slice the root ends with the tips into about 1 inch long strips. Cut the root ends in half so that you end up with half a large piece. Cut the root ends into about 1 inch lengths. Cut the root part into about 2 inch lengths. Slice 1 small white onion into 1 1/2 inch squares. Wash the 2 large yellow onions and separate them into rings. Slice the green part of the onion into 1 inch long slices. Wash the 2 large yellow onion rings. Cut the 1 small red part into 1 inch long strips. Wash the 2 large yellow onion rings. Rinse and dry the 5 large kosher salt squares well and cut them into pieces, or you can use regular salt squares. Wash the 3 large yellow onion rings well and cut them into 1 inch long slices. Wash and dry the 3 white onion rings well and cut them into 1 inch long slices. Wash the 2 small green part of the green part of the green part of the green part. Clean, wash and dry the 3 large green part of the green part of the green part. Take a large bowl, and put in the dried onion pieces. Drain the water from the dried onion. Add the salt, maggi seasoning salt and mix until it is all combined and the salt has dissolved. Add the chopped onion, green part of the green part of the green part of the green part of the onion. Rinse the 4 1/2 tablespoons dried onion pieces so they do not stick together. Cut about 4 1/2 tablespoons dried onion sections into 2 inch long pieces. Cut about 4 1/2 tablespoons dried onion pieces into 2 inch lengths. Make a slit in one side of each leaf, place the 3 1/2 to 5 pieces of onion, green part of green part of the green part of the green onion and a little piece of dried onion. Close, and place on a large plate. Repeat above steps for the 3 remaining leaves. Cover with a piece of parchment paper, place the package into bowl, and turn upside down onto the top plate. This step can then be kept for up to a week in the refrigerator. Once you have finished chopping or cutting the package, cover with a clean, damp cloth. Wash the entire package and place in a kitchen sink. Place a small square of saran wrap in a large, deep skillet or wok with a tight fitting lid. Heat the toaster over medium heat, then add 2 tablespoons of the vegetable stock and 2 tablespoons of the remaining vegetable stock. When the saran wrap boils, add the 4 1/2 tablespoons of dried onion pieces and continue to stir the liquid to keep it from drying out. When it is just to boil, add the 2 - 3 tablespoons of stock to the saran wrap and stir well so the dissolved. Cover the saran wrap tightly with the saran wrap, place into the toaster over medium heat and let cook until the moisture is absorbed. Allow the saran wrap to cool before opening it.

Random Ingredients: matzo meal,ziti pasta,margarine,spice,turnip,parmigiano reggiano cheese,cardamom pod,shrimp
title: Vegetable Pudding
ingredients: 1 lb ziti pasta or 1 lb penne | 1/2 lb raw shrimp, peeled and deveined | 10 slices raw cashew nuts | 3 large turnips, sliced into 1/4 inch rounds | 1/2 tablespoon margarine or 1/2 tablespoon butter | 1/4 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 2 cardamom pods, crushed | spices
instructions: In large saucepan of boiling water cook ziti noodles until just tender, about 11 minutes. In 4 x 1 inch pan, heat oil. Add shrimp.

title: Saucy Bacon Bits
ingredients:
2 cans tomato juice | 1 1/2 - 2 cups fat ( bacon bits, and a couple tbsp.
    - of fat ) | 10 -12 ounces of good dark soy sauce
instructions: Pour in large crock pot. Add bacon bits, soy sauce and brown sugar. Cook on high setting about two hours, stirring every now and then, until thickened to your liking. This recipe is fairly large but will still be in the bag if it gets reheated on the stove. Serve over your favourite pasta. Variation, add grated cheddar or swiss cheese.

title:
genoa salami - genoa salami roll sandwich for a double crust sandwich.
    -
ingredients: 1/2 cup genoa salami roll packed in olive oil ( about 2 slices ) | 2 tablespoons cheddar cheese | 1 round rye bread ( about 35cm-thick )
instructions: Roll up the salami slice, and cut into 4 even slices. Arrange the salami slices cut side down on a platter and scatter cheese over the top. Serve warm with rye bread.

Random Ingredients: cod fish fillet,dill pickle,almond,vanilla ice cream
title: Danish Cod Casserole
ingredients: 2 cod fish fillets, skinned | 1 quart vanilla ice cream, softened | 1/3 cup crushed almonds,, toasted | 1/4 cup chopped dill pickle, to serve
instructions: Preheat the broiler or light a fire in oven set at 400°f/200°c. Wrap the cod in foil, and place under the broiler until the skin is crisp and the fish opaque, 3 to 4 minutes. Let flake with a fork, then immediately immerse in a bowl of ice cream. Drain the cod well. Melt the butter in a 10 inch nonstick skillet over medium high heat until foaming, about 3 minutes. Dunk the cod into the butter. Remove the cod. Divide the cooked cod onto 4 plates. Place the plates evenly over the cod. Spoon the ice cream over and around the plated cod. Serve with the pickle. Serves.

title: Easy Prosciutto Wrapped Stuffed Tomatoes
ingredients: 20 -24 slices prosciutto | 20 -24 marzipan
instructions: Make your own prosciutto by slicing the slices of prosciutto you need only 5 slices. Start by piling your prosciutto to the edge of a tomatoes slice. Lay the marzipan all around the tomatoes. They'll shrink some depending on their size. Wrap the prosciutto around the tomatoes. I didn't just put them all in one neat row in front of each other. Wrap the top prosciutto around the tomatoes. Don't shake the tomatoes. I used a serrated knife to slice them as thin as my hands can get. I kept a knife handy to slice them in a sawing motion. I found that it took me about about 20 minutes to slice them. I probably used less time because some of us don't eat them all the time. These aren't baked right in the oven, but they can be done before baking on a pan lined with parchment paper. I made them a while ago and it was still amazing. Freezing is important. I wrapped them in plastic wrap and placed them in the freezer.

Random Ingredients: mushroom,vegetable oil,purple onion,white pepper,ricotta cheese,white onion
title: Cannelloni Di Ricotta
ingredients: 1 medium white onion, finely chopped | 1 medium purple onion, finely sliced | 1/2 lb mushroom, sliced | 4 tablespoons vegetable oil | 8 ounces ricotta cheese | white pepper
instructions: Mix onion and mushrooms in a bowl with the chopped ricotta cheese. Sprinkle with pepper, to taste. Roll bean curd with palms into a log, and secure with cocktail sticks or a toothpick. Heat some oil in a pan over medium.

title: Couscous and Turnips
ingredients: 1 package couscous | 1 lb turnip, peeled and grated | 1 teaspoon minced onion powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons kosher salt | 2 plum tomatoes, seeded, minced
instructions: Place the couscous or a medium bowl, and cover with water. Set aside. Place the turnip in a large pot of boiling water. Reduce the heat to medium low, cover, and cook until tender, about 8 minutes. Drain, and then let sit until cool enough to handle. Meanwhile, combine the onion powder and salt in a large bowl. Stir in the diced tomatoes. In a saucepan, cover the turnip with water. Bring to a boil and then simmer, covered, 15 minutes. Drain and allow to steam dry for 10 minutes. Remove the turnip from the water, mash it with a fork to break apart the pieces and return to the pot. Mash a little bit of tomato paste into the water and stir to combine. Add the turnip, and stir. Cook another 5 minutes, or until the liquid has absorbed and the turnip is tender.

title: Dried Heirloom Endive
ingredients: 1/4 lb unsalted unsalted butter | 1 bunch endive, large leaves
instructions: Place endive leaves in boiling water for 1 minute to blanch them, toss, remove with sloted spoon. When softened, drain, pat dry and sprinkle with salt to taste. Melt butter in large baking dish on lowest rack of oven and fry in butter for 45 minutes until golden. Transfer to a warmed platter or individual plates. Serve warm with additional butter for dipping or, better still, pass the mint at the table.

Random Ingredients: white peppercorn,guajillo chilies,milk chocolate,pistachio nut,orange zest,allspice berry,peach,golden syrup
title: Peach and Pistachio Covered in a Creamy Hot Chocolate
ingredients: 4 peaches, halved and pitted | 1/4 cup finely chopped pistachio nut | 1 1/2 tablespoons whole white peppercorns | 3 tablespoons golden syrup, such as dark brown | 8 guajillo chilies, halved lengthwise and seeded | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice berry | 2 teaspoons grated orange zest | 2 tablespoons sweetened condensed milk chocolate
instructions: Melt the chocolate in a double boiler over barely simmering water and stir in the remaining ingredients. Cover and refrigerate until the chocolate is set.

title: Raspberry Fizz - Sweden
ingredients: 250 g raspberry jam | 1 cup crushed ice | 3 tablespoons margarine or 3 tablespoons butter | 3 tablespoons chopped nuts
instructions: Melt margarine or butter in a small sauce pan on the lowest heat and leave it to get cold. Combine ice with jam. Put the pan on the burner on high and put on the burner for 1 minute then slowly shake all the rum out of the pan. Put the raspberry jam on a plate and pour the ice mixture on top. Dust the nuts on top of the jam and leave feedbacks from the heat forever before eating.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,coriander seed,pork,chicken breast,white wine,red potato,vegetable oil cooking spray,stew meat
title: Picante Chicken and Potatoes (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 4 -6 medium red potatoes, cut in half | vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 lbs stew meat, cut in 1 1/2 inch cubes | 1 package boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut in 1 1/2 inch cubes | 1 jar picante sauce | 2 cups dry white wine | 1 tablespoon coriander seed, ground | 4 ounces pickled red potatoes, quartered ( optional, i don't add these )
instructions: Spray crock pot with cooking spray. Add red potatoes to crock pot and set aside. In large bowl, combine stew meat, chicken, picante sauce, white wine and coriander seeds togther and mix well. Stir in potato cubes if using. Cover and cook on high for 4 hours or on low for six to eight hours. Serve over a bed of tortillas, with cheddar cheese, sour cream, salsa, sour cream, etc.

title: Spanish Rice with Pesto
ingredients: 1 cup white rice | 1 package liquid smoke, with | 1/4 - 1/2 cup liquid amti or 1 cup yoghurt, of choice | 1/4 cup chopped herbs, of choice | 1/3 cup crisp crisco shortening | 1 tablespoon rotel | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce or 2 tablespoons olive oil | crushed ice
instructions: Cook rice in a large amount of water for 15 - 20 mins until most of the water evaporates. If cooking in batches, reserve. Drain, and allow to cool completely. While rice is cooking, put the oil into the bottom of an ice filled pan. When it is hot, add the cream/yogurt, and cook, stirring for 1 - 2 mins on medium. Next add the rest of the ingredients, stir well and bring to a boil, and then simmer on low for 10 mins or until rice is cooked and there is no remaining liquid or oil and all ingredients are mixed well.. Serve warm. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: bulgar wheat,sun tomato pesto,cranberry sauce,spicy portuguese sausage,tortilla chip,italian seasoning,sirloin beef
title: Italian Sausage and Beef Nachos
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin beef, trimmed | 1 lb spicy portuguese sausage, casing removed | 3/4 cup bulgar wheat, uncooked | 1/3 cup sun-dried tomato pesto | 1/2 cup pine nuts or 1/2 cup sliced almonds | 1/2 teaspoon italian seasoning | 2 -3 tablespoons dried cranberry sauce
instructions: Heat a 12 inch nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add beef, casings, and dried cranberries to pan and cook 5 - 6 minutes, stirring occasionally, breaking meat up with a wooden spoon. Stir in cooked sausage and cook about 4 - 5 minutes, or until meat loses most of its pink color. Add pesto and cook an additional 3 - 4 minutes or until pesto thickens. Remove from heat and stir in drained cooked bulgur wheat, sun dried tomatoes, and pine nuts. Serve nachos warm with crumbled hard boiled egg, or drizzle with extra spice sauce.

title: Thyme Onion Soup
ingredients: 1 yellow onion, cut into thin wedges | 2 teaspoons fresh thyme leaves
instructions: Place the onion wedges and thyme in a bowl. Cover with cheesecloth, place a plate on top of the bowl and weight it down with a plate on top of the bowl so the onion pieces don't escape while it is curing. Refrigerate the onion cure until serving.

Random Ingredients: milk ricotta cheese,hamburger,celery,thai red curry paste,tea,cilantro
title: Cedar Door Indian Curry Broth
ingredients: 3/4 lb whole milk ricotta cheese ( well stirred to blend together ) | 6 tablespoons steamed steamed chopped celery ( well steamed ) | 1 tablespoon cilantro | 1 tablespoon thai red curry paste ( to taste ) | 1 sprig cedar door original irish stewing spices ( optional ) or 1 sprigs coriander ( to taste ) | 24 -25 hamburger rolls ( you may also use rolls of choice )
instructions: Sauté the celery and garlic until the garlic is slightly brown. Add the steamed meats and continue to sauté until the meat is cooked completely. Add the steamed spices. Allow to cool for a few minutes. Add the steamed spices and stir thoroughly. Serve with a tostada and a roll or other hearty choice.

Random Ingredients: kielbasa,plain flour,graham cracker crumb,irish cream,parsley leaf,parmesan cheese,saffron
title: Kielbasa Fingers
ingredients: 1 lb kielbasa | 1 cup plain flour | 3/4 cup of grated fresh parmesan cheese | 1 tablespoon saffron | 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley leaves | 2 tablespoons irish cream | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs ( optional )
instructions: Cut kielbasa into finger sized pieces. Line up the following in a flat serving dish or tin dish. Mix the flour, parmesan, saffron, parsley, and irish cream in a bowl. Sprinkle half the cheese and half the kielbasa on the mixture. Spread the remaining cheese and kielbasa over the top. Grate remaining cheese and kielbasa on top, pressing gently to avoid breaking the mixture up. Sprinkle the bread crumbs over the top. Refrigerate until required serve with ice cream/coffee.

title: White Ale Mustard
ingredients: 2 bottles strong ale | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 8 ounces brown mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon old english ale | 2 tablespoons chives, snipped | 2 tablespoons grand marnier ( optional )
instructions: Dissolve mustard seeds in 1 cup of ale. Heat to medium, stirring constantly. Remove from heat and stir in remaining ingredients.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,tempeh,stew meat,beef,plum tomato,cumin seed,pork roast,coffee
title: Beef and Swiss Casserole or Chimichangas
ingredients: 1/2 lb stew meat | 1/2 lb swiss cheese, grated | 1/2 lb meat, of your choice ( use lean ) | 1/3 lb pork roast, with bone with bone | 2 -3 cups crushed plum tomatoes ( use a good quality plum tomatoes if you can find it ) | 4 cups brewed coffee ( i prefer decaf ) | cumin seeds or a teaspoon, for the timid ( saffron would be perfect for this ) | 1 package tempeh ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f, or according to package instructions. Set your oven rack about 5 inches from the heat, and in it sprinkle a little salt. In a roasting pan put the meats and brown. Set aside in a bowl. In a small sauté pan put the liquid up to about 1/4 inch, which will help thin the spices while deglazing the pan. Add it to the meat with the tomatoes, wine and seasonings. Spread your tempeh out so your meat will be slightly rounded and about 1/4 inch thick. Add the meat and any juices from the pan. You now have what to do with your cheese. You can put a small pan of water on your pan to keep it from sticking and burn. Whatever you like. To the pan add your cheese and cook for 2 - 3 minutes. Do not brown. If you use a different kind of cheese, like a cheddar for this, stir it into the cheese. Take the pan out of the oven, top with a little breadcrumbs and add a little water. Put it back in the oven for about 30 minutes, or until the cheese has melted, bubbling and bubbling. When the cheese has melted, top with the tempeh and add the rest of your cheese. Cook until cheese is almost melted and cheese is just lightly browned. Put the casserole or chimichanga on a large plate and serve.

Random Ingredients: fish sauce,savoy cabbage,chipotle pepper,heavy cream,french bread,beef
title: Creamy Chipotle Corned Beef on Bread
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground beef | 1 chipotle pepper, sliced in half crosswise ( or more ) | 1 savoy cabbage, cored and cut crosswise into 1/2-inch slices | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 3/4 teaspoon fish sauce | 1/4 bread, cut in 1/4-inch cubes ( or more )
instructions: In a skillet, brown ground beef with chipotle pepper and cabbage, in small batches, 5 to 7 minutes or until cabbage is just tender and meat is cooked through. Transfer beef mixture to a bowl. Return skillet to a medium heat. Add cream and fish sauce and heat to a boil. Stir in beef mixture and cook 1 minute. Return beef mixture to skillet and heat through.

Random Ingredients: dark corn syrup,manchego cheese,squash,cherry,bread crumb,mustard seed,steak,sofrito sauce
title: Mexican Soya Beef Bake
ingredients: 1 lb flank steak ( cut into thin slices ) | 1 can dark sweet corn syrup | 1/4 cup sofrito sauce | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 1 cup dry bread crumbs | 1/4 cup shredded manchego cheese | 1/2 lb sweet potato squash ( cut into thin sticks ) | 3 cups cherry
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Coat a 13x9 greased baking dish with non stick cooking spray. In a medium bowl combine the corn syrup, sofrito and mustard seeds. Spread the bread crumbs on a plate. Spread the bread crumbs in a bowl. Spread the steak on the bread crumbs until the beef is well coated. In a skillet, saute the squash sticks in the corn syrup for five minutes, remove them from the skillet and place them on a plate as you prepare the other ingredients. Drain the fat from the skillet. In a 9x13 baking dish, arrange the beef into a thin layer and place the squash sticks over the beef. Sprinkle evenly with the cheese. Top it off with the bread crumbs. Place baking dish in oven for 90 minutes. Remove and top with additional cheese. Return to oven for 30 or until the cheese is melted and lightly browned. You may prepare this as a side dish.

title: Beef and Coconut Nachos
ingredients: 4 beef steak, strips or 1-inch cubes | 1 1/2 cups couscous | 1 1/2 cups brandy | 1 teaspoon coconut extract | 1/4 cup sesame seeds | 1 bag shredded montreal tortilla chips
instructions: Spray crockpot with cooking oil spray. Spread beef on bottom and top with remaining ingredients except chips. Cover& cook on low for 6 - 7 hours or high 5 - 6 hours. Serve with chips. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: queso fresco,yellow bell pepper,lemon extract,beef bouillon granule,graham wafer crumb,ginger garlic paste,steak
title: Quick Beef Kebabs
ingredients: 2 tablespoons lemon extract | 2 teaspoons instant beef bouillon granules | 2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 4 1/2 teaspoons lemon extract | 2 lbs top round steaks, cut into 1 1/4 inch cubes | 1 1/2 cups kosher stone-ground graham wafer crumbs | 1 green bell pepper, cut into 18 1/4 inch slices | 1 yellow bell pepper, cut into 18 1/4 inch slices
instructions: In a large bowl, stir 2 tablespoons lemon extract, beef bouillon granules, 1 tablespoon ginger garlic paste, and 2 teaspoons lemon extract. Add the meat and mix well to coat. Cover and refrigerate 15 minutes. Preheat the broiler. Place the graham wafer crumbs in a medium bowl. Push the garlic paste through a sieve into a clean bowl. Push the peeling paste through with a rubber spatula. Pat beef dry with paper towel. Dredge each piece of meat in the crumbs, then press into the graham wafer crumbs. Place the kabobs on an aluminum foil lined baking sheet. Broil, turning once, until browned, about 8 minutes.

Random Ingredients: lime juice,ra el hanout spice mix,almond extract
title: Baked Raita Chips With Preserved Lemons (Yogurt)
ingredients: 12 ounces ra el hanout spice mix | 2 limes, juice of | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon almond extract ( optional )
instructions: Prepare a baking sheet with parchment paper or aluminum foil. Dry the raita cookies. If using regular lime juice let it sit out on the counter to drain any excess juice. If using the almond extract add more lemon juice as desired. Using a pastry brush, apply a thin layer of rasa el hanout with the almond extract or a teaspoon of lime juice. Layer the raita cookies with the raita mixture until you have used up all the dough. Place in oven at 350°f for 10 - 12 mints or until crisp and golden. Remove from oven and let set 10 minutes. Eat with indian sweet snacks or cool completely. Note, this can be stored in airtight container at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: butter bean,romaine lettuce heart,coffee,dark sesame oil,bean,bourbon whiskey
title: Bourbon Sweet Bean, Romaine Style Salad for Two
ingredients: 1 head romaine lettuce hearts, outer leaves only | 1 can baked beans | 3 tablespoons butter flavored beans | 1/2 cup bourbon whiskey | 2 teaspoons dark sesame oil | 1 teaspoon instant coffee
instructions: In a large bowl, toss romaine with warm refried beans. Mix the remaining ingredients in a jar, shake and pour over the entire salad. Toss lightly to coat. Serve immediately.

title: Basic Sushi
ingredients: 1 cup all-purpose flour | 1 cup self-rising flour | 1/4 cup unsweetened applesauce | nori, for sushi
instructions: Sift the flours on a board and combine with enough applesauce to make a soft, pliable dough. Knead into a ball and divide into 4 portions. Make each piece the size of a golf ball and set aside. Roll each portion of dough in the flour to coat evenly. Gently stretch out each portion on the board until the sushi ball is fully developed, and then place the dough on a sheet of plastic wrap so that no air seeps through it and is not touching the edge of the plastic wrap. Cut each portion into three or four balls. Flatten each piece with one hand and place on a clean flat surface. Pick up the plastic and, using the tines of a fork, lightly press around the sushi. You should be able to form the sushi in the way you would make a regular sushi. Repeat with any of the dough balls remaining in the sheets. Cut the sheets in half to form two long, slightly thinner pieces. Skewer each piece on the bamboo sushi roller to complete a simple, deep skewer. Place onto sushi mat with the edge of the plastic wrap directly on the sushi, allowing space between the pieces. Place onto the sushi mat using a bamboo sushi roller, which will cause gaps to open at the top. Press firmly until the sushi becomes a uniform color, about 4 to 5 minutes. Cut the sushi into 1 1/2 or 2 strips. Serve immediately.

title: Wild Rice Chicken Kabobs
ingredients: 2 1/4 ounces quick-cooking wild rice mix | 4 frozen boneless skinless chicken breasts | 16 ounces grape tomatoes, halved | 1 medium spanish onion, halved and sliced | 2 tablespoons garlic paste | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar
instructions: Prepare the wild rice according to package directions, cool slightly, cut into cubes. Meanwhile, place the chicken in a zipper bag and add 1 tablespoons of the salt and 1/2 cup water. Seal and shake until the chicken is completely covered. Place the bag in the refrigerator for at least 20 minutes. Rinse the bag and remove the chicken from the marinade. Place the grape tomatoes and onion in a microwave safe bowl and microwave on high for about 20 seconds, or until heated through. Spray the inside of the large metal skewers with cooking spray. Place the chicken and tomatoes in the skewers and marinate at least 10 minutes, in the refrigerator. Place the onions onto 2 toothpicks or aluminum foil, poke holes in them with a fork so the onions can stand on the skewer. Place the skewers onto pre soaked bamboo skewers and place under an uncovered grill for 15 minutes, or until well browned. Mix together the cooked wild rice, remaining salt, brown sugar and garlic paste and spread over the skewers. Place the skewered chicken on a heated metal serving platter or cutting board with the onions around it. Serve with hot spanish red beans, frijoles and hot spanish saffron rice if desired.

title: Low-Tamari Spicy Garlicky Vegetables
ingredients: 1 tablespoon tamari ( light soy sauce ) | 1 tablespoon chopped chipotle chile in adobo ( the canned chipotle chile peppers in adobo ) | 1 tablespoon red capsicum, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon dried mediterranean oregano | 1 tablespoon turnip | 2 small cauliflower, cut into florets
instructions: Rinse, dry and coarsely chop vegetables. Place the garlic, chilli, oregano and tamari in a mortar and pound to a paste with a pestle and mortar. Place the vegetables in a shallow baking dish and pour on the marinade. Turn on the oven to 200c/450f/gas 2, and preheat the grill. Remove the vegetables from the marinade and lightly brush the vegetables with a little olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Grill for 5–7 minutes, turning frequently until firm. Serve warm, while hot or cold.

title: Sizzling Marsala Cheese
ingredients: 1 slice dry italian cheese | 1/4 teaspoon sugar-free syrup | 2 teaspoons marsala wine ( optional )
instructions: Using two small, round sticks of cheese attached to a stick of cheese, pipe 1 to 1 1/2 teaspoons of syrup onto stick of cheese to cover stick. Repeat until all cheese has been used. Sprinkle cheese with sugar syrup. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: cake flour,shiitake mushroom,wonton wrapper,golden raisin,red food coloring,gochujang,soymilk
title: Wild Mushroom Dumplings
ingredients: 2 cups cake flour | 1 quart soymilk ( see note ) | 1 package sliced shiitake mushrooms ( see note ) | 1 package shiitake powder dried mushrooms ( see note ) | 1 package shichimi gochujang ( see note ) | 1 package dry green edible doughnuts | 20 square wonton wrappers
instructions: The doughnuts should be the size of the mushroom in size measures. Place all 3 wet ingredients in a large heavy skillet or stockpot. Heat to medium, then allow to come to a boil, stirring occasionally,. Turn off heat and immediately add shiitakes and mushrooms, stirring. Do not let mushrooms brown. Take the pan off the heat. In a plastic bag, put five dumplings in and lightly pound with a rolling pin to flatten them into little dumplings. Repeat till all dumplings are done. Cook covered for about 10 minutes. Let cool. In a food processor or blender, add shiitake powder and green edible doughnuts and puree until very smooth. Add mushroom puree to dumplings in skillet. Using a tablespoon, fill each wrapper with about 2 tablespoons of the mixture. Fold wrappers in half and repeat until you have dumplings in all. Cook dumplings uncovered on a tray in a pre heated oven over medium heat for about 2 minutes. Cover with a towel to prevent drying out or sticking.

Random Ingredients: cooking oil,head iceberg lettuce,bourbon,taco seasoning mix,jasmine rice,garlic clove,purpose flour,chinese wine
title: Mongolian Lettuce Wraps (Copycat)
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce, chopped | 3/4 cup all-purpose flour | 1 envelope taco seasoning mix | 3 tablespoons cooking oil | 2 garlic cloves, minced | 1/2 cup chinese wine ( or cooking wine ) | 1/2 cup bourbon | hot cooked jasmine rice
instructions: Boil water for rice. Add lettuce, cover and set aside for 5 minutes. Remove lettuce from water, drain and place in large bowl. Toss lettuce with remaining ingredients and serve on a plate. Note, copycat directions, using pillsbury cooking rice is preferred for this dish.

title: Strawberry and Vodka Sorbet
ingredients: 10 fresh strawberries, hulled | 1/4 cup unsweetened vodka | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 2 fluid ounces fresh strawberries
instructions: Using an electric mixer with a paddle attachment, lightly crush the strawberries to release some of the juice. Transfer to a bowl and sprinkle in the vodka and salt. Gently stir to combine. Transfer to the freezer until the mixture starts to freeze around 12 hours and then transfer the sorbet to an ice cream maker and follow the manufacturer's directions for freezing. To serve, scoop the sorbet into six 6 oz glasses and top with fresh strawberries.

title: Brandy Penne W- Strawberries
ingredients: 1 package penne or 1 package cavatelli | 1 cup strawberry, hulled | 1/2 cup light cream or 1/2 cup milk | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh tarragon | 2 tablespoons brandy ( optional ) | 1 pinch black pepper
instructions: Boil 2 quarts of water in a large pot. Meanwhile, cut strawberries in half. Remove the stems from the berries & gently break apart. Place a large serving plate on the table then take a handful of fresh berries & gently push down through the bowl into the bowl, gently squeezing as you do so. Then, with a paring knife or a spoon, gently push the strawberries out again & break apart with the blade of your knife. You need to break the berries up a little & add them as you do so. When you are done, drain off any liquid you have left, then add the strawberries back into the pot & mix well with the rest of the ingredients. Taste & correct seasonings. Serve & enjoy.

title: Ancho Chile and Chile Manicotti
ingredients: 10 ounces manicotti | 7 teaspoons ancho chile powder
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the manicotti and cook until tender, about 8 minutes. Drain and transfer to a 9x13 inch baking dish. Sprinkle the ancho chili powder over them. Bake at 350f for 25 minutes. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: eggplant,white wine,white wine vinegar,raspberry jelly,coconut milk
title: Sweet and Sour Japanese Eggplant
ingredients: 2 large eggplants | 1/2 cup white wine vinegar | 1 cup coconut milk | 1 cup raspberry jelly or 1 cup raspberry preserves | 1/4 cup white wine
instructions: Peel eggplant, slice in half crosswise and remove stem and all seeds. Place eggplant in microwave safe dish, cover with lid and cook on high for 7 minutes. Using fork and potato masher, mash eggplant until no liquid remains. Turn off microwave and stir in wine vinegar until mixture has turned into creamy liquid. Stir well and set aside in refrigerator. Spread raspberry jelly or preserves over slice of eggplant. Pour in coconut milk and vinegar mixture, stirring until preserves have melted. Place in serving bowl and top with pieces of raspberries.

title: Merry Lobster Eggs
ingredients: 3 large egg whites | 2 cans kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1/2 pint sour cream | 1 teaspoon red food coloring
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and set aside. Beat the egg whites in a large bowl until they are foamy.

Random Ingredients: watercress,white pepper powder,half cream,oat,parmesan cheese,thyme,vegetable broth
title: Vegetable & Oaty Parcels With Thyme
ingredients: 1 packet oaty porridge oats | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh thyme | 1 cup low sodium vegetable broth | 1/2 cup watercress | 1/2 cup half-and-half cream | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper powder | 1/2 cup freshly grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c. Lightly grease and line a baking tray with non stick baking paper. Toast porridge oats on tray for 5 mins, stirring at every two minutes, until they are golden brown and fragrant. Allow to cool. Place chopped thyme and broth in the microwave proof jug. Microwave on high for 5 mins, stirring every minute for 10 minutes or until hot. Place oaty porridge oats & 2/3 cup watercress in a large bowl and mix. Stir in cream. Add white pepper powder, mix well. Spoon mixture into an ovenproof bowl. Sprinkle with remaining 1/3 cup watercress. Bake in oven for 50 mins or until top is firm and topping is golden brown. Sprinkle top with parmesan cheese.

Random Ingredients: oatmeal,shiitake mushroom,genoa salami,red snapper fillet,parmigiano reggiano cheese,sesame seed oil,pear,cumin
title: Soy & Salt Poached Red Snapper With Pears & Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 24 ounces red snapper fillets ( about 6-inch x 3-4-inch ) | 3/4 cup coarse oatmeal | 12 ounces shiitake mushrooms, stemmed and sliced | 1 teaspoon sesame seed oil | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/2 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/2 lb genoa salami | 8 slices pear ( about 5-inch diameter )
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Line a glass or stainless steel bowl with foil, allowing excess moisture to drain off. Using a slotted spoon, remove any skin on the fish and discard. Slice the fish into 1/4 thick slices, about 3 per piece. Place snapper on a piece of foil, drizzle with the sesame oil, and using your fingers, press lightly to coat the fish with oil. Broil, brushing fish with oil, until the fish is just barely cooked through, 7 to 10 minutes. Spread the mushrooms on a plate and place the snapper on top of the mushrooms. Top with the mozzarella and top with the salami and pear slices. Sprinkle with the cumin and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: creme de cacao,hot pepper,cumin,tea,chili paste,garlic clove
title: Thai Hot Pepper  - Roasted Pepper Tea
ingredients: 1 -2 teaspoon dried chili paste ( thai red chili ) | 1 -2 teaspoon cumin | 1 -2 hot pepper, deseeded | 2 garlic cloves | 1/4 cup creme de cacao ( or other liqueur of choice ) | 6 ounces cold fresh brewed tea | 1 ounce teabags ( to garnish ) or 1 ounce loose tea, to seal the tea bag
instructions: Combine the chili paste, cumin, chile peppers, garlic and creme de cacao in a small bowl. Add 6 oz cold tea, cover with plastic wrap and give a stir. Let sit for 15 min, then strain. Serve in teacups with a slotted spoon dipped in hot tea on top.

title: Wild Rice With Green Chilies and Wild Rice
ingredients: 1/2 cup wild rice | 2 1/2 inches fresh green chili peppers
instructions: Rinse the wild rice thoroughly under running water, and drain. Cut the chile pepper in half lengthwise. Discard seeds and remaining stem and veins and chop coarsely. Heat a generous amount of oil over medium high heat in a large, heavy 2 quart covered saucepan. Add the rice and fry, stirring, until it is very lightly toasted and begins to turn translucent, about 30 seconds. Add the rice and chilies.

title: Cilantro Chimichangas
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chicken | 1 cup loosely packed fresh cilantro leaves | tortillas or corn tortilla | worcestershire sauce
instructions: Remove and discard as much skin as possible from chicken. Cut chicken into 1 inch pieces. Combine cilantro leaves with a small amount of Worcestershire. Combine chicken with the cilantro mixture. Roll each piece into either corn tortillas or tortilla. Fry in a skillet with a dash of oil over medium heat for 5 - 7 minutes per side. Great with salsa and fresh fruit.

title: Crock Pot - Russian Chicken
ingredients: 1 broiler-fryer chickens | 3 cans beef broth | 3 -4 dashi pieces, depending on how much broth you're planning to use | 1 1/2 tablespoons cocoa powder | 1/2 cup mixed berries, optional, i 'le add
instructions: Rinse chicken under cool water and dry. Cut into pieces 1 - 2 wide. Place chicken in crock pot. Add beef broth and dashi. Cook on low for 6 - 8 hours. You can add more broth if you feel it's more liquidy or thicker. If you want a thicker broth, you can either stir in a little cornstarch and berry's. Serve over plain white rice. If you feel adventurous, try adding 1/4 cup rice or a little bit of the beef broth to the soy sauce for added protein.

Random Ingredients: beef,allspice,hot red pepper flake,chive,stock,lemon peel,vegetable oil cooking spray,lettuce leaf
title: Beef and Pepper Salad
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground beef or 1 lb lean ground lamb | 1 teaspoon hot red pepper flakes | 1/2 teaspoon allspice | 2 pints stock | 1 large fresh lettuce leaf | 1 lemon peel, cut into thin strips | 5 tablespoons chives | 10 crisp fresh salad leaves
instructions: To make the meat mixture, heat a frying pan over medium heat, add the mince and chilli flakes and cook, stirring, until lightly browned. Drain any excess fat into a large bowl, then stir in the stock and season with salt and pepper. Add the freshly grated lemon peel and chives to the beef mixture and simmer, covered, stirring occasionally, until the stock has reduced slightly. Meanwhile, place the lettuce leaves on individual lettuce leaves, then put the top of the pile on a lettuce leaf, pressing down slightly with the back of a spoon or palette knife to help it down. Put a few strips of lemon peel on top of each lettuce leaf and pile with a few of the beef mixture strips.

title: Mint Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup cold water | 2 tablespoons cornflour | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 tablespoon mint leaf, leaves washed
instructions: In small microwave safe bowl combine the water with the cornflour. Microwave on high power level for about 1 minute until mixture starts to thicken, stirring once in a while. Add salt and pepper to taste and mix well. Pour into a small dish and serve immediately. Garnish with mint leaves.

title: Brussels Sprouts With Raisins
ingredients:
1 bag brussels sprouts, cut in halves | 1 cup raisins | 1/4 cup basil, chopped | 1 teaspoon thyme ( or 1 tsp.
    - dried ) | club soda, to taste | fresh mint ( optional )
instructions: Cook brussels sprouts in boiling water until just tender or cool, 5 - 10 minutes. Drain. Combine all ingredients and serve. Garnish with fresh mint if desired.

title: Hotty Hush Puppies
ingredients: 1 lb raw peeled butternut squash, halved lengthwise | 24 slices canned chilies
instructions: Cut pumpkin halves crosswise into 1/2 inch thick pieces.

title: Risotto With Watermelon, English Cucumber and Cream Cheese
ingredients: 7 1/2 ounces condensed cream of chicken soup | 4 1/2 ounces risotto rice | 1 1/2 ounces watermelon, rind removed, diced fine ( no seed ) | 1 english cucumber, rind removed, diced fine ( do not peel ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons fresh marjoram, chopped
instructions: Blend soup and watermelon rind until very smooth. Stir in rice and herbs. Transfer to serving dish and chill. Serve with crusty bread.

title: Pineapple Cheese Smoothie
ingredients: 1 cup cottage cheese | 1 can crushed pineapple, in syrup ( drained )
instructions: Empty cottage cheese and pineapple contents into blender and puree with. Pineapple for a more full flavour kick.

title: Simple Mexican Chili Dip
ingredients: 3 cans stewed chopped tomatoes and green chilies | 1 cup grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Pumpkin Seeds With Yogurt
ingredients: 500 g fresh pumpkin seeds ( or 1 1/2-3 pints, preferably pumpkin seeds in a pinch ) | 1/2 liter thick yogurt
instructions: Put the pumpkin seeds in a large bowl. Pour over 1 litre of warm water and leave until the water is absorbed and the mixture starts to fluff up. Meanwhile, bring 2 - 3 pints of water to the boil with 1 teaspoon of salt and 1 tablespoon of oil. Put the yogurt in a strainer and set it over a bowl. When the water is absorbed, drain the excess water away. The yogurt should have dissolved and the mixture will bubble up. Transfer the chickpeas to a large bowl and mix in the chickpeas, and 1/4 the yogurt. Serve.

title: Healthy Chapati
ingredients: 1 ounce wheat flour | 1 ounce lettuce
instructions: Mix flour and wheat very well and knead till elastic. Form small balls about 2 to 3 inches diameter with your hands. Heat griddle/pan on medium and fry the chapati till golden brown in colour and smelly. Remove from heat and leave on one side on some paper towels. Put on your favourite side on your lunch box, or serve on its own without the lettuce or onions. Note, if you are using a non gluten option do not add wheat flour as it makes it soggy.

Random Ingredients: ginger garlic paste,sea salt,red food coloring,olive oil
title: Ginger Garlic Roasted Shallots
ingredients: 200 g fresh ginger-garlic paste | 1/3 - 1/2 cup black olive oil | 1 1/2 - 2 teaspoons sea salt | 2 -3 drops hot red food coloring ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together, except shallots, and place in a tightly sealed plastic container. Marinate for at least an hour or longer, turning the container over occasionally. Heat oil over medium heat in small frying pan, then sear shallots until crispy and golden on all sides. Serve immediately.

title: Quick Pork With Peppers and Cranberries
ingredients: 1/2 green pepper, diced | 1/2 cup dried cranberries, chopped | 1/4 cup pasta sauce | 1 pound pork loin, cut into 1 inch pieces
instructions: In a bowl, mix the green pepper, cranberries, and pasta sauce. Place the pork in a large, shallow, skillet. Pour the remaining sauce over the meat, spreading evenly. Cover and cook over medium low heat until the pork is no longer pink in the center, 1 to 1 1/2 hours, flipping the pieces once halfway through cooking.

title: Cardamom Stuffed Sweet Things   [gluten Free] - Norway
ingredients: 2 puff pastry sheets ( thawed ) | strawberry | cardamom
instructions: Drape your pastry sheets with a pastry cloth or a large, colourful plastic one. Use a sharp knife to cut at least an inch from the sides of the pastry sheets, as if they were a cutout route. Take the bottom edge of the pastry sheet with the cut out part and gently squeeze it out, and put it back into the cut out end.

title: Easy Crock Pot Pulled Pork
ingredients: 3 gallons of good pork shoulder | 1 bottle ranch salad dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients and cover with plastic wrap. Place in crock pot for 8 hours on high, or 7 hours on low for 6.

title: Liz Berry's broad Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 can mandarin oranges | 1 package dry broad beans | 1 container nonfat sour cream | 1 container plain yogurt, whipped
instructions: In a large bowl, layer together mandarin oranges, broad beans, sour cream and yogurt.

Random Ingredients: molasses,tart apple,cajun spice,dark beer,kidney bean,pumpkin pie spice,chervil
title: Mexican Party Spread
ingredients: 2 jars dark beer | 1 jar whole-grain molasses | 1 can baked beans | 1/4 cup diced tart apple | 1/2 cup dried chervil | 1 teaspoon pumpkin pie spice | 1 1/2 teaspoons cajun-style mixed spice
instructions: Place dark beer, molasses, baked beans, apple, chervil, and pumpkin pie spice into the work bowl of a food processor.

title: Beef Tenderloins
ingredients: 1 can garbanzo beans, drained and rinsed | 1 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin, fat trimmed | 7 ounces camembert cheese, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 1/2 cup sherry wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°. Line a baking sheet with foil. Put the garbanzo beans in a large bowl. Cut the beef into about 1 inch strips and drop into the garbanzo bean, using your hands. Roll the beef up with your hands, until all is coated with the garbanzo beans, with the end of a wooden chop stick facing out. Place the beef on the baking sheet and bake in the center of the oven until meat thermometer reads 140° for medium rare, or 140° for medium. Transfer the beef to a cutting board, cut into slices, and arrange on serving platter. Slice and serve with the sherry.

title: OAMC Bacon Croutes (Using Baked Bread)
ingredients: 12 slices bacon | bread, toasted from
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Lay the bacon on a baking sheet. Bake on one side 1 minute, then turn and bake on the other side about 1 minute or until crispy. Let cool. Cut each slice of bread in half and toast the croutons. To serve, place a crouton shell on a plate, top with chopped onions, hot dog diagonally. Drizzle with maple syrup or honey to taste.

title: Phyllo Pastries
ingredients: 10 sheets phyllo pastry | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Place a pastry sheet on a parchment paper covered cutting board. Use a sharp knife to spread the phyllo out evenly. Trim some with a pastry brush, or use a sharp knife to cut away any pastry that hangs out of the sides. Spray a baking sheet with cooking spray. Place the cut phyllo pastry on top of the phyllo and brush with the milk. With a sharp knife, push down to make a rectangle. You may have to do this in 2 batches. Use about an inch/half between sheets to prevent sticking. It should be easy to roll out when done. Using the same method, using only the pastry scraps, roll out and cut out the remaining sheets. You need to let the phyllo sheets dry out and then roll to the correct size and thickness. If you use too much phyllo and the sheets still sticking to the board, you might want to add a bit more of the milk. Cut each phyllo pastry heart into 6 or 8 triangles. If you use too much phyllo, you may need to add a bit more water or a bit more water. Place a triangle on the cutting board. With your fingers, lightly pinch the triangle to make it even. Once you have created layers, place a square or two of phyllo pastry on top of the triangle and brush with milk. You now have 6 or 8 layers of pastry and filling per pastry. Lay on parchment paper or a clean square or another clean square or a square pan. Add a few more triangles on top of the phyllo pastry. Using a sharp knife, cut the stack into slices diagonally to make triangles. You should have a total of 12 strips of pastry. Bake at 450 degrees f for 12 minutes. Take out and cool on wire racks. Store in airtight tins.

title: Spanish Stewed Beef
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground beef | 1 small yellow potato, cubed, cubed | 1 small onion, diced | 1 can green chilies, chopped | 1/4 cup sultana
instructions: In skillet brown ground beef. Drain, drain all but 2 tablespoons of fat. Add potatoes and onion and fry until tender crisp. Mix in chilies. Reduce heat to low and add sultanas. Cook uncovered about 10 minutes or until potatoes are hot and have absorbed all the fat. Serve with cornbread muffins if desired.

title: Pigs & Ham - Norway
ingredients: 1 lb ham meat, cubed or 1 lb ham cubes | 1 1/2 cups egg substitute | 1 cup canned pigeon peas
instructions: Add ham cubes to a greased baking dish and sprinkle with egg substitute. Cover with canned peas.. Bake at 350 degrees for about 40 minutes. Serve with boiled carrots and fresh bread.

title: Fig and Sugar Snap Peas
ingredients: 2 figs | 1 package frozen sugar snap peas | 1 tablespoon poppy seed
instructions: Put peas in a steamer and cover with water. Set over high heat, cover and steam for 10 minutes or until tender. In a bowl, sprinkle with poppy seeds. Gently stir up figs and snap peas and sprinkle with poppy seeds. Steam for 3 minutes or until crisp. Let cool slightly.

title: Homemade Lemon Thyme Seasoning
ingredients: 1 quart fresh lemon juice ( about 3 lemons ) | 1 tablespoon dried thyme
instructions: In a large resealable plastic bag, combine 1 quart lemon juice and thyme. Shake to mix. Seal and massage into dried lemons. Cover.

Random Ingredients: sausage,mexican cheese,coriander seed,lime juice,gem lettuce,taco seasoning mix,szechuan peppercorn
title: Sausage & Herb Tacos
ingredients:
2 cups shredded mexican blend cheese | 1/2 head gem lettuce ( can use any leafy lettuce of choice, ie.
    - romaine leaf ) or 2 cups mixed greens ( can use any leafy lettuce of choice, ie.
    - romaine leaf ) | 1 lb ground sirloin or 1 lb ground turkey | 1 lb ground sausage | 1 cup taco seasoning mix | 1 teaspoon ground coriander seed | 1/2 teaspoon whole szechuan peppercorn | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice
instructions: If using fresh greens, blanch in boiling water for a few seconds, drain & rinse in cold water to remove the sand. Otherwise rinse in cold water to remove sand and sand. Wash in salad spinner and dry thoroughly. Wash greens and chop into bite sized pieces. Brown sausage over medium heat, drain. Mix ground sausage & taco seasoning & coriander seeds. Put sausage into a bowl & add the greens. Add olive oil. Mix well. Heat oil on medium. Put 1/2 cup of mixture in the palm of one hand, and flip the other side. Then add to oil in the same way and stir. When the mixture starts to bubble and form a ball, flip over and let it cook one more minute. When finished, the meat should be browned.

title: Crispy Dill Dill Cakes
ingredients: 500 g strong white flour | 200 g finely chopped red peppers | 200 g finely chopped dill | 200 g finely chopped fresh dill | 300 -500 ml good quality vegetable oil | 5 -10 teaspoons salt
instructions: Combine all the dough ingredients into a bowl. Form into patties and drop in to oil for about five minutes or until nicely browned on both sides. Remove from the oil and allow to cool slightly. Place the patties on a paper towel to dry out. To serve, cut into 4 - 6 pieces and serve asap.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,egg white,pine nut,french bread,cranberry,mustard seed
title: Roasted Cranberry French Toast
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread, cut into bite size slices | 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil | 3 egg whites | 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard seeds | 1 cup fresh cranberries ( or frozen ) | 1/2 cup pine nuts
instructions: Place sliced french bread between a large piece of wax paper. Place paper between slices. Combine the oil, egg whites, mustard seeds, and cranberries in a shallow dish until well blended. Place bread slices in egg mixture. Sprinkle with pine nuts and continue to press bread in oil mixture to coat thoroughly. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Place bread slices in pan. Pan fry approximately 2 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: pasta shell,jumbo shrimp,jalapeno chile,penne pasta,hot water,parmesan cheese,half
title: Jumbo Shrimp and Pasta With Jalapeno Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 lb uncooked jumbo shrimp, peeled & deveined | 1/2 lb penne pasta | 8 ounces jumbo shrimp and jalapeno chiles, chopped | 4 -5 tablespoons hot water | 1/2 cup half-and-half | 1/4 cup parmesan cheese, grated | 1/2 cup old-fashioned parmesan cheese | 1/4 cup julienned jalapeno chile
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Cook shrimp until pink, remove from skillet & set aside. Cook pasta in boiling water until al dente. Drain pasta & shrimp, reserving 1/2 cup pasta water. Return shrimp mixture to skillet, add 2 tbs of water and peppers, heat for 1 minute. Pour cream over pasta and shrimp mixture.

title: Vietnamese Spaghetti (Nhum Nhum - Vietnamese Spaghetti)
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti | 2 -3 fresh lime leaves, remove the zest and juice from 4 lime leaves | 4 teaspoons grated fresh galangal | 4 teaspoons pure vanilla extract | 6 ounces extra firm firm oysters, drained
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package instructions. While spaghetti is cooking, place bay leaf in a saucepan with 2 - 3 inches of water and cook over medium high heat until boiling. Add lime leaves, galangal, and vanilla extract and lower heat to medium. Simmer for 3 minutes, stirring constantly. Drain spaghetti well and add to sauce. Toss well and serve at once.

title: Homemade Rice Vinegar Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1 cup rice wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon dried italian seasoning
instructions: In a large glass jar, combine the vinegar, italian seasoning and rice wine vinegar. Shake well.. Cover and refrigerate 1 to 2 hours, shaking occasionally.

Random Ingredients: red snapper,mexican cheese,chicken stock cube,red chili pepper flake,plain flour
title: Mexican Fish Pie
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs red snapper or 2 1/2 lbs cod | 2 teaspoons dried red chili peppers flakes | 2 chicken stock cubes, crushed and mixed with | 1 tablespoon plain flour | 1 cup mexican blend cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees celsius. Combine fish with the chili, chicken, flour, and half the cheese. Pour into a greased oven proof baking dish. Cover with remaining cheese and bake for 20 minutes, or until the fish flakes easily when tested with a fork.

Random Ingredients: wild mushroom,half,pearl barley,pepper,soya sauce,chili pepper flake
title: Wild Mushroom Barley Pilaf
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs wild mushrooms, trimmed | 1 1/2 cups pearl barley | 1 teaspoon dried hot pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon soya sauce | 1/4 cup half-and-half | 1 teaspoon chili pepper flakes
instructions: Saute mushrooms in saucepan over gentle heat in a bit of oil for about 5 minutes or until mushrooms are tender. Stir in barley and hot pepper flakes. Bring to the boil and reduce heat. Simmer 25 minutes or 'til barley is just tender. While barley is cooking chop the nuts.

title: Jalapeños
ingredients: 2 ounces smoked cheese | 1 bunch spring onion | 12 ounces arugula | 3 jalapeno peppers | 3 tablespoons molasses | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage leaves
instructions: Blend the jalapeños, olives, molasses and sage and leave the mixture to stand overnight in the fridge. Boil your water in a pan and pour half of this into the molasses mix well and simmer gently for 5 - 10 minutes until the arugula wilts. Drain, remove the leaves and blend with the rest of the mixture. Cool completely then refrigerate and serve in slices for breakfast.

title: Kale and Rice Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 package dry rice noodles, broken up | 1 bunch kale, cleaned and shredded | 1 package sauteed spanish onion | 1/2 teaspoon caraway seed | 1 cup halved blueberries
instructions: Fill a large pot with about 1 inch of water and bring to a boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the rice noodles, then reduce heat to medium low. Cover, and simmer until the noodles are tender and the liquid has been absorbed, about 20 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Cook the kale in the boiling water until tender, about 5 minutes, and then drain well. Place in a large bowl, and stir in the sauteed onions, caraway seed, and blueberries. Toss with the noodles until coated well, then sprinkle with sea salt.

title: Struffoli (Dairy Free Stuffing)
ingredients: 3/4 cup instant coffee, room temperature | 1/3 cup pine nuts | 1 1/2 - 2 cups shredded celery salt | 1/3 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/4 teaspoon celery salt
instructions: Place the coffee in a medium sauce pan, heating slowly. Add pine nuts to warm coffee, then stir in celery salt. Add cheese and stir until combined. Let mixture cool slightly. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour before using. Can be stored for up to 4 days.

title: Jamaican Green Chili
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef chuck roast | 1 large green chili, roasted | corn oil
instructions: Prick the roast numerous times using a fork. Brown roast on all sides in oil, turning as needed. Do not overcook the roast. Once roast is browned, sprinkle with green chilies. Serve with mashed potatoes or as an accompaniment to tacos.

title: Quick Noodle Salad
ingredients: 3/4 lb dried farfalle pasta | 2 tablespoons oil | 4 teaspoons chopped fresh italian parsley | 4 ounces udon noodles
instructions: Cook farfalle according to package, not the quick noodle package directions, just al dente. Drain pasta and return to pot. Add oil and toss to coat. Add parsley, tossing to coat. Add noodles and toss, mixing well. Serve at once.

title: Chicken Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 cup dates, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons vinegar | 2 teaspoons lime juice | chicken seasoning, to taste
instructions: Combine all ingredients in tightly covered container. Store covered in refrigerator 1 - 3 days.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke,baby arugula leaf,red wine,salsa,lime juice,spinach,orange bitter,garlic pepper seasoning
title: Grilled Spinach & Arugula Salad
ingredients: 1 lb fresh spinach, cleaned and stems removed | 1/4 cup bottled orange bitters | 5 tablespoons liquid smoke | 4 tablespoons lime juice | 4 ounces sliced roasted garlic pepper seasoning ( i use mccormick's pepperjack seasoning blend ) | 2/3 cup salsa or 2/3 cup vinaigrette dressing ( vinaigrette house ) | 1/2 cup red wine | 1/2 cup fresh baby spinach
instructions: Mix all ingredients together & let sit 5 - 10 minutes until flavors meld. Toss with greens just before serving.

title: Thai Ginger Beer
ingredients: 3 pieces peeled and chopped gingerroot | 1 red chili sauce | 1/2 cup triple sec
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a non metallic bowl. Cover with saran wrap or cling film, and place in the fridge overnight. The next day, strain beer and discard solids. Pour beer into bottles and refrigerate. To use, stir in double sec. Serve with lime wedges.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,grain white rice,cashew,beef bouillon cube,self rising flour,kalamata olive,pita bread
title: My Own Middle Eastern Pizza
