ingredients: 1 cup long-grain white rice, not glutinous-free | 1 cup whole wheat flour | 1 cup self-rising flour | 1 cup raw cashews, coarsely chopped ( optional ) | 2 beef bouillon cubes ( optional ) | 1 cup kalamata olive, halved ( optional ) | pita bread ( optional ) or bread ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees farenheit. Combine the flours and salt and mix until well crumbly, using your hands. If using the olives, drizzle a little olive or ghee into a bowl and add the boullion cubes. Add the cashews and stir. Add the wholemeal plain flour to the moistened mixture, stirring just enough to combine. Add the cashew/olive oil/ghee mixture and stir, adding your hands so the dry mixture can firm up a bit. Place the rice on a baking sheet, spread out evenly, and bake for 25 minutes. Remove from oven and spread the pizza topping mixture over the pizza. Slice, cut, and serve warm or cool. Yummy with a green salad and a simple salad.

title: Spaetzle II
ingredients: 2 pounds fresh spaetzle ( or frozen spaetzle ) | 1/4 cup taco seasoning | 1/2 cup vegetable oil
instructions: Combine spaetzle, taco seasoning and oil in a large bowl.

Random Ingredients: red kidney bean,cardamom seed,spaghetti sauce,spinach leaf,vodka,orange juice,cantaloupe,spaghetti
title: Spicy Sangria
ingredients: 1 box spaghetti | 6 cups spaghetti sauce ( spicy red and white, 3 cup ) | 2 cups frozen spinach leaves, thawed and patted dry | 1 can red kidney beans, drained and rinsed ( i prefer kidney beans ) | 1 cup frozen orange juice | 1 bag frozen cantaloupe, frozen peeled, thawed, and patted dry | 1 tablespoon cardamom seed, ground
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions.

Random Ingredients: vanilla yogurt,green onion,tabasco sauce,pecorino romano cheese,chicken wing,plain yogurt,creme de cacao
title: Buffalo Chicken Wings
ingredients: 12 chicken wings | 1 container plain yogurt | 1 cup shredded pecorino romano cheese | 2/3 cup creme de cacao | 2 teaspoons vanilla yogurt | 3 drops tabasco sauce | 1/4 cup green onion, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Wash the chicken wings in cold water and pat dry with paper towels. Place about 1 1/2 tablespoons of the yogurt in a small jar with a tight lid. Shake until thoroughly mixed. Remove the top layer of plastic wrap from the inside of the jar and place chicken in the jar. Place the remaining yogurt and pepper sauce in a saucepan and heat gently over low heat until the yogurt just begins to bubble, about 5 minutes. Brush one side of each chicken wing individually with the yogurt sauce and arrange them in a single layer in a glass 13 x9 baking dish. Bake the wings at 350 degrees f for about 50 to 60 minutes or until they are fully cooked and starting to turn light brown. Let them cool for about 5 minutes before removing them from the baking dish. Garnish with the chopped onions and serve with additional crème de cacrowns.

Random Ingredients: okra,lemongrass,greek olive,coriander powder,rib roast,bread crumb,israeli couscous
title: Israeli Couscous Patties
ingredients: 8 ounces rib roast, cut into 2-inch pieces | 1/2 cup bread crumbs | 1/2 cup italian-style couscous, uncooked | 1/4 cup okra, sliced | 1/4 cup greek olives, sliced | 1/4 teaspoon coriander powder | 1 stalk lemongrass, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Combine bread crumbs and italian seasoning in a large bowl. Stir in beef to coat. Shape into 4 patties, and place in a 9x9 inch loaf pan. Bake 20 minutes in the preheated oven, or until meat thermometer registers 160 degrees f. Meanwhile, bring 2 cups water to a boil in a small saucepan. Add okra.

Random Ingredients: miso,risotto rice,dark chocolate,cremini mushroom,cod,farfalle pasta,white breadcrumb
title: White Baked Cod and Mushrooms
ingredients: 400 g cod ( preferably in one piece ) | 200 g farfalle pasta ( small fingerling pieces ) | 200 g cremini mushrooms | 100 g dark chocolate ( melted ) | 1 tablespoon white breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons dark chocolate | 1 tablespoon mayonnaise
instructions: Preheat oven to 190°c. Mix the white breadcrumbs with the dark chocolate, if using, and spread on a baking tray. Cut cod into large chunks. Cook cod on the stovetop on high heat just until cod is cooked through, usually about 4 - 5 minutes, not touching on the edge of the pan. Place the farfalle pasta onto a large serving dish, or individual serving bowls. Place a piece of cod on top of the farfalle and then sprinkle over the dark chocolate on top. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: red pepper,bow tie pasta,plantain,lime wedge,beef chuck,broccoli
title: Beef With Vegetables & Limes
ingredients: 2 lbs lean beef chuck | 1/2 teaspoon ground red pepper | 1 package bow tie pasta, uncooked | 2 cups broccoli, cut into florets | 1 medium sweet red pepper, sliced | 4 lime wedges
instructions: Cube beef into 1/2 strips, removing any undesirable pieces of fat. Brown beef in 2 tblsp. Oil and crushed red pepper. Stir in remaining ingredients except for lime wedges. Cover and simmer for 1 hour. While serving, stir in lime wedges and serve.

Random Ingredients: mustard,italian cheese,cream corn,red kidney bean,allspice,passion fruit
title: Cheesy Corn Salad
ingredients: 1 can red kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can cream-style corn, drained | 1/2 cup ricotta cheese or half-and-half | 2 tablespoons red passover fruit | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice | 1/4 teaspoon dry mustard
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and toss to combine. This is an easy way to make fancy and elegant entree fillings and add more if desired.

title: Jicama Salad
ingredients: 1 large jicama | 3 cups diced yellow squash | 1/2 - 3/4 - 1 teaspoon red food coloring
instructions: Cut the jicama into 1/2 inch cubes. Peel the squash and cut a medium sized jicama into 1/2 inch cubes. Cut the red food coloring into 1 - 2 strips. Mix the red food coloring into the jicama. Toss with all ingredients. Serve warm or allow to cool down to avoid over mixing.

title: Saffron Nests
ingredients: 3 dried poblano chiles | 1/2 teaspoon cumin seed | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon saffron
instructions: Rinse the chilies and remove, then place in a bowl along with enough water to cover. Refrigerate. Turn your burner on to medium high and place a few chilies into the pot. Bring to a boil. When they have a soft hull, remove the stems and seeds with tongs. Rinse, peel and chop the chilies and place in a mortar or spice grinder. Grind them into a fine powder or grind in a coffee grinder if desired. Put the ground chilies down under the tap. Place the saffron in a small bowl. Put it into a small skillet over medium high heat. When the rippling begins to rise to the surface, pour it into the saffron. Place a damp towel over it and allow to stand in a cool place for 20 minutes to absorb the excess water. Stir it frequently. Remove the skillet from the heat. Dip your finger in the raisins and take a few tablespoons of raisins and chilies. Drop them into the hot chilies, pressing them gently with your fingers so they don't stick. Turn and fry until they are beginning to wilt and crackle on the outside. You can store the chilies in a jar in the refrigerator for up to 3 weeks.

title: Cindi's Famous Sausage and Mushrooms
ingredients: 4 -6 dried guajillo chilies ( see note below ) | 1 lb white mushroom, cleaned, trimmed and thickly sliced ( fresh, porcini, chanterelles, oyster mushrooms, or all ) | 12 ounces pasta shells ( uncooked or bowtie )
instructions: In a hot skillet dry roast the chilies until they're bright green and pliable. This should take about an 8 - 10 minutes to become fragrant. They should not become black at all, but rather dark and slightly fragrant. Remove them to a jar and store until ready to use. Note, if your chilies are too hot to touch, place a paper towel on them as soon as they're cool enough to touch. After they're cool, remove the chilies from the jar and wash them thoroughly dry off in a damp cloth towel. Place the chilies in a bowl with 1/2 cup warm water, remove the stem and seeds and devein them. Discard the rest of the water and set chilies aside. In a hot skillet cook the mushrooms until they begin to soften but there is still a little moisture on them and drain. This should take about 5 - 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: white potato,lime,sun tomato,devil food cake mix
title: Lime and Smoked Potato Kugel
ingredients: 1 box devil's food cake mix | 1 lime, juiced | 8 small white potatoes, washed and thinly sliced | 8 sun-dried tomatoes, dried | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato glaze, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease an 8x8 inch baking dish. Mix devil's food cake mix, lime juice, potatoes, sun dried tomatoes, and sun dried tomato glaze together in a bowl until well blended. Spread potato mixture into the prepared baking dish, and cover the bottom of the dish with plastic wrap. Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, about 45 minutes.

title: Cumin Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1/4 cup hungarian paprika
instructions: Pre heat oven to 300°f. Place oil in stewing pot. Add salt and cumin seed. Cover and cook on stovetop for 3 hours. Add more water after an hour of cooking.. Remove all barked bits when done. Cool and store in refrigerator.

title: Tuscan Beef Soup
ingredients: 1 cup dry macaroni | 1 can beef broth with meat, undrained | 2 teaspoons capers
instructions: Over medium heat, cook, drain and set aside macaroni. Stir broth and capers into macaroni. Cover and continue cooking 10 minutes or until macaroni is tender.

title: Crispy Tofu
ingredients: 1 package firm tofu, drained | 8 ounces medium dried shiitake mushrooms | 2 packages frozen peas, thawed | 2 tablespoons flax seeds, ground to a powder | 2 limes, juiced to serve
instructions: Thaw tofu according to packet directions. Cut tofu into 1 1/2 inch cubes and combine with mushrooms, peas and ground flax. Squeeze lime juice over tofu mixture. Cover and refrigerate overnight for flavours to combine. Heat oven to 200°f place tofu mixture, 1/2 cup of coconut milk mixture in an ovenproof baking dish. Bake in oven for 15 minutes. Serve with remaining coconut milk mixture.

title: Italian Spinach Artichoke Dip
ingredients: 1 can hearts packed in brine, drained and finely chopped | 12 sun-dried artichoke hearts, drained and finely chopped | 1 bottleclub soda | 3 packages frozen chopped spinach leaves, thawed and squeezed dry | 1 teaspoon ground anise seed
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. In a large pot over medium heat, stir together hearts, sun dried artichoke hearts, club soda, spinach, aniseed, and salt to taste. Cover, and simmer until flavors are blended, about 1 hour. Ladle into pie dishes, and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,rosemary,buckwheat flour,seasoning,spelt flour,baking soda,green grape,golden raisin
title: Apple Fruit Bread
ingredients: 3 cups seedless green seedless grapes, halved | 2 cups chopped tart apples | 2 cups chopped candied rosemary or 2 cups chopped fresh basil | 1 cup golden raisin | 1 cup buckwheat flour | 1 1/2 cups spelt flour | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 2 teaspoons maggi seasoning ( or to taste )
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 degrees. Spray loaf pans with cooking spray. Line with parchment paper. Mix grapes, apple, rosemary/basil, and raisins. Add flour, splat, and baking soda. Pour into prepared pans. Bake for 1 hour and 25 minutes or until done.

title: Easy Sautéed Pea Soup
ingredients: 1 large yellow peas, shelled | 1 tablespoon sherry ( use whatever variety of sherry you prefer ) | 2 1/2 cups feta cheese
instructions: Steam the peas in a pot over a medium high heat until tender. Remove from pot and set aside. When peas are cool enough to handle, cut in half and gently scrape out the creamy grey sap with the back of a knife. This will look like there is no meat left behind. You can either serve them whole or split in half lengthwise. Add the sherry to the peas. Add a teaspoon of the feta cheese to each half to serve and sprinkle with a little more cheese at the table.

title: Chocolate Bags (For gifts or gifts)
ingredients: 2 teaspoons cornflour | 140 g bacon drippings ( or any fat ) | cooking spray, for shallow frying | 1 tablespoon cocoa
instructions: Combine the corn flour and bacon fat in a bowl, then knead briefly. Add the cocoa and mix through the flour a little. The dough will be sticky and it should be elastic. If it is too dry add more cocoa, but it should be a thick paste. Wrap and refrigerate for 30 mins or longer so that the flavours are infused into the dough, although it could also be left for hours. Shape the dough into round balls. Heat a little of the bacon fat or the oil in a pan, then fry the choc baggies in batches for 5 - 6 minutes until golden and crispy. Dust with cocoa before serving.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,deep dish pie shell,jalapeno pepper,nutmeg,celery root,salmon
title: Smoked Salmon-Gravy Pie
ingredients: 1 deep dish pie shell | 2 lbs smoked salmon | 1/4 lb celery root ( grated ) | 2 jalapeno peppers ( chopped ) | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 dash nutmeg
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Smear the bottom of the pie shell with heavy whipping cream and place in oven for the 3 - 4 minute. Cut the smoked salmon in small pieces. Add the jalepenos, celery root, jalepeno sauce, nutmeg. When the pie is done, remove from oven and spread on top of the pie. Re seal the pie using the lid. Bake for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Beer and Wine Dip
ingredients: 1/2 cup chilled fruit chutney | 1 cup cold beer
instructions: Combine chutney, beer and fruit chutney mixture in medium bowl.

Random Ingredients: basmati rice,rosemary,habanero pepper,vodka,cider vinegar,wide egg noodle,fenugreek seed,kaffir lime leaf
title: Kaffir Lime Noodles With Phyllo Rosemary and Habanero Vodka
ingredients: 12 ounces wide egg noodles | kaffir lime leaves or 1 teaspoon grated lime rind | 1 can habanero peppers, stemmed and seeded, 2 chopped, and 2 cut into thin strips ( about 6 pieces ) | 1 tablespoon dried fenugreek seeds | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary | zest and juice of one large fresh habanero pepper | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 1 teaspoon fenugreek seeds | 3 cups basmati rice, rinsed
instructions: To prepare noodles, bring a medium pot of water to a boil. While the water is coming to a boil, place the noodles in a large bowl of ice water to stop the cooking, about 10 minutes. Drain. Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. Place the lime leaves or rind, habanero strips, fenugreek, and rosemary in the base of a 10 x 5 x 1/3 inch baking dish and press the strips into the base of the baking dish. Drizzle or brush with the lime juice. Sprinkle the chile powder or dried fenugreek over the surface of the noodles. Cover and bake for about 20 minutes. Meanwhile, in a small frying pan over medium heat, toast the fenugreek and kaffir lime leaves, stirring often, until fragrant, about 3 minutes. Scrape half of the dried fenugreek seeds from the grinder and process with the remaining fenugreek and rosemary and kaffir lime leaves until finely ground. Add the ground spices to the cooked noodles and stir. To prepare the phyllo rosemary rice, combine the vegetable and habanero strips in the same small frying pan over medium heat. Cook until the vegetables are tender, about 4 minutes, stirring frequently. Drain off the fat. Stir in the vinegar and remaining fenugreek seeds and remove from heat. Spoon the hot spiced rice into a wide bowl or platter. Cover and let stand for 3 minutes before serving.

title: Soba Snack Salad
ingredients: 1/2 pound brussels sprouts, trimmed | 1 bag soba noodles | 1 1/2 cups coarsely ground black pepper
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the soba noodles, and return to a boil. Cook the noodles uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still slightly firm to the bite, about 5 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Place the sprouts in the bowl of a blender, and add pepper. Cover, and process until the noodles are finely chopped, about 1 1/2 minutes. Drizzle in the dressing, and process just until the remaining dressing becomes creamy, about 1 minute.

Random Ingredients: guacamole,provolone cheese,cocoa,ice water,parmesan cheese,black sesame seed,oyster sauce,cauliflower floret
title: Cauliflower Con Queso (Spanish Style Cauliflower)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa | 1 cup ice water | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1/2 cup grated gruyere cheese ( spanish if you get it ) or 1/2 cup gruyere cheese ( spanish if you get it ) | 8 ounces curly thin spaghetti, cooked, drained, and shredded | white sesame seeds | 1 head cauliflower floret, cut into thirds or 3 cups small florets | 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Pour about half the boiling water over the 1 tbsp. Curry and stir till dissolved. Add the 1 tbsp. Curry, cocoa powder, and ice water mix together. Microwave on high for about a minute until it is heated through. Remove from microwave, stir, and set aside. Place the remaining 3 tbsp. Curry in a separate bowl. Add 2 tablespoons of the grated cheese and mix well. Drain spaghetti well and set aside. Toss spaghetti with the rest of the cheese and 1/2 cup oil. Microwave for about 3 minutes until it begins to brown and it starts to wilt. Add to your spaghetti and coat evenly with the curry mixture. Top with the sesame seeds and scatter with 1/2 cup cheese. Microwave for about a minute or two on high. Sprinkle with grated parmasean to taste.

title: Maitake Udon (Savory Hot Pork Soup)
ingredients: 2 -3 pork chops | 1 tablespoon prepared mustard | 1/2 tablespoon prepared mustard | 1 ounce spinach leaves | 1/4 cup dashi stock | 2 tablespoons white chocolate
instructions: Using a slotted spoon, remove the pork chops from the pot, and cut them into cubes. Heat the pan over medium high heat and fry the pork until brown on all sides. Stir in the mustard and cook for 1 minutes. Add the spinach, and cook until it wilts. Add the dashi stock and the white chocolate. Bring to high heat. Cover the pot, and cook until the meat is heated through. Remove the lid, and leave to simmer for a few minutes, then serve.

title: Italian Rice Bread
ingredients: 1 cup arborio rice, cold | 3 1/2 cups italian salad dressing | 1 teaspoon active dry yeast, active dry | 4 teaspoons active dry yeast
instructions: Place rice in a bowl. Pour in 3 cups of the italian salad dressing and stir together. Sprinkle yeast over. Mix and set aside in a warm place until yeast froths up, about 25 - 30 minutes. Stir 2 tsp of yeast into warm rice. Place the 3 1/2 cups on a floured board and with floured hands form the rice mixture into a firm round rectangle. Place the rectangle in the bottom of a 9x5 loaf pan. Place the bread on top of the arborio mixture, pressing firmly into the bread with hands. If the rice doesn't reach the edge, sprinkle the remaining 1 tsp of yeast over. Pour the remaining 1 1/4 cups of italian dressing over bread and cover tightly with a dish towel. Let sit undisturbed until the rice has absorbed the dressing. Allow to rise until almost doubled. Preheat oven to 350°. Bake at 350 for about 40 - 45 minutes, covering loosely with foil when cool. Remove bread from pan and let sit for 15 minutes then turn out onto cutting board.

title: Linguine With Blackberry and Lemon
ingredients: 3 3/4 cups bread flour | 3/4 teaspoon chili powder ( or add with or without msg ) | 3 tablespoons fresh lemon juice ( about 3 lemons ) | 1/2 cup blackberries ( optional ) | 1 lb linguine
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl and mix on high for 2 - 3 minutes until the liquid has dried out. If the liquid is too wet, you can add a little water. Let rest for 5 minutes and serve in a wide, flat bowl.

title: Homemade Sizzlin' Onions
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/3 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon onion salt
instructions: Heat 1 to 1 1/3 cups of olive oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Stir in the salt, remove from the heat and let the oil steep for 2 to 3 minutes. Quickly pour a large spoonful of the flavored oil into the center of each onion, working carefully to distribute it evenly. Carefully flip over and gently peel off the outer layer of onion. Using a slotted spoon, remove the onions and carefully place them at least 1 inch from the heat. Return the skillet to medium high heat, using as much remaining oil as necessary, and cook until the onions are deep brown, about 10 to 12 minutes, shaking the skillet over the burner a few times. Turn the onions over and cook the other side until they are deep brown and crisply colored, about 15 minutes more. Transfer to a wire rack and let cool completely. If needed, pour reserved oil back into skillet and heat until very warm and the oil is at the very bottom of the skillet, about 5 to 6 minutes after removing the onions. If the oil does not reach the right temperature, repeat until the oil reaches just a little more than stated. Store in refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: cherry,fennel seed,chicken stock,beef stock,mexican cheese,tuna,tamarind paste
title: Tamarind-Fennel Soup
ingredients: 2 cups chicken stock | 2 cups beef stock | 1 can canned tuna | 1 tablespoon tamarind paste | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed | 3/4 - 1 cup shredded mexican cheese | 1/4 - 1/2 cup mixed candied cherry, chopped
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine the chicken stock and beef bouillon. Bring to a boil, and immediately reduce heat to low. Meanwhile, in a blender pureée the tuna, tamarind paste and fennel seeds. Strain the broth and pour into the blender with the tuna mixture, stirring well to mix. Cover, and set aside to allow flavors to blend. Place the fennel seeds in a pot over medium high heat, and cook until fragrant, about 1 - 2 minutes. Remove from the heat, and add some of the cheese to the soup. Spoon the soup into bowls to serve, or place in two ramekins. Top with a cherry, to be served hot.

title: Yogurt Chocolate Pasta
ingredients: 200 g hot pasta sauce ( v8, not v8 ) | 100 g plain yogurt | 50 g semi-sweet chocolate chips ( optional )
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling salted water. Meanwhile, mix together chilli sauce, yogurt and chocolate chips. Drain pasta, mix with sauce together. Serve warm.

title: Dill and Squash Melba
ingredients: 1/2 medium yellow squash | 1 small zucchini | 10 ounces fresh dill weed, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup unsalted butter | 1 1/2 tablespoons liquid seasoning, blend | 1/3 cup skim milk | pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Peel and cube the squash and zucchini. Place in a roasting pan with the dijon in it. Cut butter into chunks and add to the squash. Scatter dill over the squash and squash and place in the oven. Bake in the center rack for 30 minutes. Add liquid seasoning blend and skim milk. Cook for additional 5 minutes. Remove from oven and let set for 15 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,broth,midori melon liqueur,peach,garlic salt,oreo cooky
title: Curried Peach Soup
ingredients: 2 fresh peaches - peeled, pitted and sliced | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 5 tablespoons broth, or more if needed | 1 1/2 teaspoons chopped fresh oreo cookies | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 2 tablespoons midori melon liqueur
instructions: Bring a pot of water to a boil. Place peach slices into the hot water, and cook 1 minute or until tender. Drain, and slice into 1 inch squares. In a bowl, mix the garlic salt, broth and oreo cookies. Stir in the curry powder. Pour into the hot, flaked peaches, and cook for another 5 minutes. Top with coconut preserves, if desired.

title: Creamy Chicken Filling for Pasta
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup | 4 -6 tablespoons half-and-half
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f. Mix together the cream of chicken soup and half & half. Pour into a 9x13 pan. Bake at 350f for 20 minutes. Allow to cool slightly. When cool, cut into squares and mix into a cupcake recipe just before serving.

title: Salsa Noodles
ingredients: 3/4 cup chunky salsa | 3 tablespoons firmly packed brown sugar | 1/2 cup chopped hazelnuts | 12 ounces spaghetti noodles, cooked and drained
instructions: Stir together salsa, brown sugar, and nuts in small bowl until well blended. Fold in pasta. Serve at once.

title: Foolproof Microwave French Beans
ingredients: 425 g white navy beans | 200 g dark brown sugar
instructions: Drain beans and place in 4 x 23cm microwavable dish. Cover with cheese cloth and microwave at 70 100% power stirring every 5 mins or so until beans are tender, about 1 hour. Pour over remaining 1l of aubergine juice, cover and microwave on hi for 15 - 20 mins, until liquid has absorbed. Stir every so often so that beans have no dark browning.

title: Sauerkraut With Red Chili and Currants
ingredients: 6 ounces sauerkraut, rinsed and drained well | 1/2 cup dried red chili, soaked in | 1 3/4 cups boiling beef stock | 1 tablespoon dried currants or 1 tablespoon raisins
instructions: Preheat oven to 140°f put the sauerkraut and the red chili in a baking dish. Add the stock, currants and salt and pepper to taste. Simmer in the oven covered for 45 minutes remove the cover and bake for 30 more minutes to make a darker, crisier sauerkraut. Serve with mashed potatoes.

title: Aarsi’s Ultimate Mustard
ingredients: 4 teaspoons mustard seeds | 1/8 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste
instructions: Mix to form a paste. Use as a seasoning or as an ingredient in any of your favourite recipe and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: feta,beef broth,white pepper,shallot,black olive,pear,white shoepeg corn
title: Corn and Pear Soup
ingredients: 32 ounces white shoepeg corn, drained | 32 ounces beef broth, chicken flavored or 32 ounces vegetable broth | 2 ears fresh pears, peeled, cored and cubed | 12 ounces feta, crumbled ( more or less ) | 8 ounces sliced black olives | 1/4 white pepper, coarsely chopped
instructions: Put the corn and broth in a large pan. Bring to boiling point and simmer until a knife can pierce the kernels easily, about 20 minute. Meanwhile combine remaining ingredients, except feta. When the soup is boiling add soup mixture and simmer till it begins to thicken, about 5 minute. Serve warm and garnish with crumbled feta cheese.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning mix,pineapple juice,sage leaf,rye bread,green bell pepper
title: Frosted Pineapple (Ww 7 Points)
ingredients: 1/2 medium green bell pepper, seeded | 1 1/4 cups pineapple juice | 1 envelope taco seasoning mix | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage leaves, crushed | 1 slice rye bread, toasted, cut into 1 inch pieces, buttered
instructions: Position rack in center of oven and preheat to 400°. Line baking sheet with foil and spray with cooking spray. Cut bell pepper in half and then cut crosswise into 1/4 inch strips. Place strips in a medium bowl and then toss with pineapple juice, taco seasoning and sage. Spread on baking sheet and bake 20 minutes or until crisp. Add bread pieces and toss. Top with pineapple mixture.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,arrowroot,rice vinegar,salt pepper,taco sauce,black bean,bean dip
title: Quick Burrito Dipping Fish
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets | salt and pepper | 1 teaspoon arrowroot | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1 tablespoon taco sauce | 1 can bean dip | 1 can black beans
instructions: To butterfly each fillet put skin side down on cutting board and flatten with meat mallet. Add salt and pepper and butterfly until dorsal fin can be removed remove head. Take a small plate or small pot and place fish in middle. Pour some hot tap water over fish until it just covers the fish. Cover and refrigerate at least 24 hours. Dip the fish in a mixture of hot tap water and arrowroot. Dip fish in vinegar and coat evenly with rice vinegar. Place a can of bean dip on each fish and top with some black beans.

Random Ingredients: lentil,coconut flake,caraway seed,coconut,rum,berry,ramen noodle,ranch dressing mix
title: Betsy's Crunchy Nests(Veggies!)
ingredients:
1 package ramen noodles | 6 cups fresh mixed greens ( spinach, arugula, collard greens, etc.
    - ) | 1/2 cup shredded coconut | 8 -12 fluid ounces coconut flakes | 1 package raisins ( regular or gluten free ) | 1/2 cup flamed coconut | 2 ounces maple flavored rum | 2 packages dry ranch dressing mix ( or your own flavor mix to taste )
instructions: In large bowl, combine 3/4 cup of coconut flakes, 2 oz. Of coconut flakes, 1/2 cup of mixed greens, 1/4 cup rind of 2oz. Veggies, rum, ranch mix, and 1/2 cup of mixed greens in order listed above. Mix all together and set aside until ready to cook. Spray pam in skillet. Scoop out noodle mixture into skillet and place 3 - 4 handfuls of noodles into the pan. Fry noodles until golden brown but still firm. Remove from pan and spread out on paper lined plate to cool. Repeat until all noodles are gone. Serve with additional syrup or your favorite fruit sauce for dipping.

title: Italian-Style Cavatini Beans, Bean Salad, and Salami Salad
ingredients: 7 ounces black beans | 7 ounces cannellini beans, drained | 5 ounces salami | 2 -3 cups cabbage, finely shredded | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon cold water
instructions: Cook beans in salted boiling water until tender, about 20 minutes. Drain and cool under running water to cool. When cool, drain well and place in large bowl. Add salami slices and enough spinach to coat. Toss well. Serve on lettuces with mayonnaise.

title: Simple Rice Balls
ingredients: 4 cups leftover cooked long-grain rice ( cold or instant ) | 1 cup mini marshmallows ( or other favorite flavor )
instructions: Place rice and marshmallows into a colander over a large bowl and toss with a fork to coat the rice. Toss rice mixture until thoroughly coated and divide into twelve pieces. Roll each piece into a ball. Repeat until all of the rice is used. Place rice balls on a foil lined baking sheet and bake in a 350 oven until balls are crisp and lightly browned, about 20 minutes.

title: Homemade Chicken Chips
ingredients: 1 kg chicken wings, and drumettes | 1 -2 teaspoon sea salt | 2 cups salad oil
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a plastic bag and shake.. Let stand 10 minutes. Place on a tray and press out air until the chip shape looks like breadcrumbs. Heat the oil to 190 degrees centigrade or 170 degrees celsius on a candy thermometer. Do not smoke. Fry the chips in batches over the flame of a gas burner on high heat turning them to brown evenly.

title: Velveeta Sour Cream Pie!
ingredients: 1 pastry shells, unbaked | 1 lb velveeta cheese, cut into small cubes | 2 tablespoons cream cheese | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Spread the bottom and sides of pastry shell with a mix of sour cream, velveeta, and almond extract.

title: Sweetened Sugar-free Granola
ingredients: 4 cups sugar substitute, splenda is what i said | 3/4 cup dried currants ( or any dried fruit would do ) | 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
instructions: Pour 2 cups raw sugar into sauce pan and let it boil for 20 minutes, stirring frequently. Remove from heat and add currants stir well. Then add vanilla and stir well. Put into an airtight container and set aside for 3 weeks. Enjoy.

title: A Perfect Simplest Tasting Sauce Recipe
ingredients: 2 teaspoons cream of tartar | 1 teaspoon seasoning
instructions: Mix in food processor until mixture becomes thick. If you don't have cream of tartar, just mix one tsp of it into 1 tsp of water.

title: Beef and Pea Ties - Crock Pot
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb beef chuck, cubed | 2 -4 cups turnips, diced into small pieces | 1 can peas, drained | 1/4 cup prepared horseradish | 3 tablespoons liquid smoke | 1/2 teaspoon black pepper
instructions: Place all ingredients in a medium sized crock pot, stir well. Cook on low for 6 hours or high for 4 hours.

Random Ingredients: chili flake,oil,pork chop,salt black pepper,mustard powder
title: Homemade Barbecue Pork Chops
ingredients: 6 -8 thick pork chops | 1 1/2 tablespoons mustard powder | 1/2 teaspoon chili flakes, plus 1 tsp | salt and black pepper | oil ( for frying )
instructions: Cut each pork chop into 4 equal pieces. Combine mustard powder and chili flakes. Coat each piece of pork chop with mustard mixture and season with salt and pepper. Deep fry in a moderately hot oil. Baste with more spice mixture while frying.

title: Scotch Eggs
ingredients: 10 -12 scotch cream cheese | 3 tablespoons jam | chicken stock
instructions: Crack open cream cheese and stuff with the cream cheese. Put some chicken stock. In pan heat some water and pour over.

title: Tunisian Sweet Potatoes (Punisian Copycat)
ingredients: 3/4 cup spanish olive oil | 2 teaspoons mixed spice ( spice islands spice islands preferred ) | 8 sweet potatoes ( about 2 1/2 pounds ) | hot pepper ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. In large bowl combine olive oil, spice and sweet potatoes. Add small pieces of hot pepper if using and if using, pepper of choice. Toss to coat. Bake for 20 minutes, turning frequently, until tender.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,cardamom pod,chicken stock vegetable,rice vinegar,vanilla extract,hard egg,taco seasoning,yam
title: Mexican Yam Salad
ingredients: 6 yams, peeled and diced | 2 -3 hard cooked eggs, diced | 1 jar taco seasoning | 1/2 cup rice vinegar | 1 cup chicken stock or 1 cup vegetable stock | 1 teaspoon lemon juice | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom pod
instructions: In a medium sauce pan, add the diced yams and chopped hard boiled eggs simmer for about 10 - 15 minutes until tender. Combine diced cooked yam mixture with taco seasoning, rice vinegar, chicken stock, lemon juice, vanilla extract, cardamom, and ground cardamom in an attractive bowl and mix thoroughly. Chill until ready to serve.

title: Sara's Cranberry Spread With Nuts
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups navy beans ( cooked or canned, or frozen ) | 16 ounces dried cranberries | 2 tablespoons rice wine | 1 pinch cayenne | 2 teaspoons cumin powder | 1 cup n'' crunchy nutella ( can also add milk as well ) | 1 tablespoon vinegar
instructions: Put all ingredients into blender or food processor except the nutella and vinegar. Blend on high until blended. Add vinegar and nutella.

Random Ingredients: topping,tamarind pulp,saffron thread,nam pla,dark brown sugar
title: Aguar De Tamarindo (Nam pla Nibbles With Saffron)
ingredients: 250 g tamarind pulp, shelled and seeds removed | 500 g dark brown sugar | 1/2 teaspoon saffron thread | 140 g nam pla, crushed | 5 tablespoons nam pla | fat or oil, as required
instructions: Soak tamarind in 1 litre of water for about 30 minutes. Drain and discard water. Squeeze out pulp once more. Place in a pan in low heat and boil for 3 - 4 minutes. Do not add water as you don't want the pulp to become too soft. You can substitute tamarind flesh for fresh tamarind pulp. Keep aside. In a large bowl combine the 1/2 teaspoon saffron threads with the brown sugar and nam pla. Stir well. Add the strained tamarind pulp and stir well ensuring there are no lumps. Mix well so as to dissolve the saffron in the infused water. Cover and keep aside for 2 hours. When ready to use, add enough oil so as to obtain a coating on the tops of the saffron Nibbles. When all the water is absorbed, sprinkle the 1/4 teaspoon salt on it. Use immediately.

title: Sooz Style Hummus
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups lemonade, chilled | 1 garlic clove, peeled and mashed | 1 -2 serrano peppers, minced or 2 jalapeno peppers, minced fine
instructions: Mix lemonade with garlic and pepper, and allow to sit for about 30 minutes. Strain, and serve. The more garlic and pepper used, the drier it will be.

title: Spicy Southwest Beef Sandwiches for Two
ingredients: 1/4 - 1/2 lb lean top round steak ( or beef deli ) | 1 can beef broth | salt | 6 slices monterey jack cheese
instructions: Preheat a grill pan, or a heavy skillet over medium high heat. Slice steak diagonally into 5 slices, then diagonally into 1/4 slices. Heat beef broth in a large shallow dish or skillet until boiling. Add meat, salt, and cheese slices to broth mixture. Cook and stir over low heat until meat is cooked through.

title: Tamarind Chutney With Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup tamarind paste ( tamarind chutney ) | 1 tablespoon cold water | 1 tablespoon dry sherry | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried chipotle powder
instructions: Blend first five ingredients until fairly smooth. Slowly stir in sherry until well incorporated and flavors combine.

title: Sausage With Vermouth
ingredients: 1/2 lb sausage | 2 teaspoons vermouth
instructions: Slice sausage, not too thin or thick, into 3 or 4 wedges. Cook the sausage with vermouth over medium high heat until brown. Serve hot.

title: Spice Islands With Peanuts
ingredients: 150 g whole dry roasted peanuts, chopped finely | 100 g mushrooms stems, chopped finely | 2 teaspoons cornflour | 150 g frozen corn kernels, thawed | 150 g greek yogurt | 1 tablespoon dry vermouth or 1 tablespoon dry white wine
instructions: Combine the peanuts, mushrooms, cornflour, yogurt and vermouth or white wine, to taste. Pour into individual dishes, then sprinkle with the rest of the peanuts. Chill until set, then serve with bread.

Random Ingredients: watercress,celery salt,kielbasa sausage,ketchup,anchovy fillet,dark brown sugar,corn flake
title: Kielbasa and Cabbage
ingredients: 8 ounces kielbasa sausage, cut into 1/4-inch pieces | 1 1/2 cups shredded cabbage | 2 stalks celery salt | 1 cup dark brown sugar | 1 can anchovy fillets | 1/2 cup ketchup | 1 cup watercress, for garnish
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Stir in the sausage, and cook until evenly brown. Remove sausage, and set aside. Add celery salt to the skillet and cook until tender. Mix in the brown sugar. Reduce heat, and cook, stirring frequently, for 1 minute. Mix in the anchovies. Pour in ketchup and watercress, and stir until well coated, and simmer 5 minutes, until sauce thickens slightly. Serve over hot cooked egg noodles. Garnish with chopped cilantro if desired.

title: Hawaiian Grape Salad
ingredients: 10 -11 ounces canned pineapple chunks, drained and chopped | 10 ounces canned grape tomatoes or 10 ounces cherry tomatoes | 1 jar pimento stuffed olives, cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 1 bunch fresh green chile, coarsely chopped ( or 3 tablespoons dried red chiles ) or 1 tablespoon dried ancho chilies ( or 3 tablespoons dried ancho chiles ) | 1 inch gingerroot, peeled and shredded ( about ) | 1 - 1 1/2 cup currants or 1 -1 1/2 cup raisins
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour to develop flavors.

Random Ingredients: russet potato,spaghetti sauce,tart apple,gelatin,goat cheese,ginger garlic paste
title: Vegetable Enameled Potatoes In Goats Cheese Sauce
ingredients: 8 small russet potatoes | 1 cup plain goat cheese | 1 tart apple | 3 slices ginger-garlic paste | 1 1/2 teaspoons gelatin ( unflavored ) | 16 ounces spaghetti sauce
instructions: Cut russet potatoes into small fries and bake at 200 degrees. Remove and let cool down. Peel potatoes and cut into squares. Cut 1/2 apple and save. Slice small ginger and add to potatoes. Add 1/2 teaspoon of water and mix well. Add the goat cheese and mix well. In a pan, add 1/2 teaspoon of unflavored gelatin and cook at 100 degrees on medium heat for 10 - 15 minutes or until brown on bottom. Add spaghetti sauce and potatoes and mix well. Chill until ready to serve.

title: Falafel
ingredients: 3 tablespoons dried fenugreek leaves, coarsely chopped | 2 teaspoons salt | 1/2 teaspoon fresh ground pepper | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 2 celery ribs, finely chopped | 1 loaf bread, loafs cut into slices
instructions: Toss fenugreek and 1/2 cup water in small bowl, then stir in salt, pepper and cayenne. Place celery in medium bowl and add remaining 1/4 cup water and fenugreek mixture. Stir to combine, then cover bowl and refrigerate at least 1 hour and up to 2 days. Preheat broiler. Lightly oil rack 10 to 12 inches from heating element in broiler. Scoop celery mixture out of bowl and spread between 2 pieces of bread. Broil 1 minute or just until golden brown.

title: Honey Pesto Parsnips
ingredients: 500 g honey pears or 500 g g orange peels | 1 tablespoon honey | 1 tablespoon lemon peel, finely grated | 4 tablespoons fresh parsley, chopped | 4 green olives, pitted and sliced | 1 tablespoon store-bought pesto sauce ( see note )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees centigrade. Place the honey pears in a pan with plenty of water. Bring to the boil and simmer for 3 minutes to soften. Pour into a medium roasting dish. Sprinkle with the grated lemon peel and chopped parsley. Place in the oven, then reduce the temperature to 100 degrees centigrade and cook for 20 minutes, stirring the fruit regularly. Drizzle the hot glaze onto the cooked pears and nuts and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,tomato green chile pepper,tomato sauce,velveeta cheese
title: Velveeta Mexican Dip
ingredients: 1 package velveeta cheese, cubed | 2 cans diced tomatoes with green chile peppers | 1 1/2 teaspoons beef bouillon cubes | 1 can tomato sauce
instructions: Melt the velveeta cheese in a large pot over medium heat. Stir in tomatoes with chile peppers, beef bouillon and tomato sauce. Cover and cook for 40 minutes, stirring occasionally.

title: Mexican Sour Corn
ingredients: 2 cans creamed corn, not drained | 1 can corn kernels, not drained | 1 teaspoon coriander | 1 -2 teaspoon cayenne | 1 tablespoon taco sauce, mild | 2 teaspoons white flour
instructions: Spread corn on paper towel and place over coals. Cover and grill over hot coals for 15 to 20 minutes turning often. Sprinkle with coriander, cayenne and taco sauce. Serve with sour cream and salsa. Store leftover corn loosely covered in refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: ladyfinger,garam masala powder,tomato puree,green pepper,spaghetti sauce,red bell pepper
title: Spicy Ladyfingers
ingredients: 1 package spaghetti sauce | 1 green pepper, cut in strips | 1 red bell pepper, cut in strips | 2 packages ladyfingers | 1 tablespoon garam masala powder | 1 can tomato puree
instructions: Combine all ingredients except ladyfingers into a 3 quart saucepan. Cover and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes or until tender. To serve, place 1 ladyfinger at a time in one layer on a serving plate. Spoon spaghetti on top. Sprinkle with spice mixture. Serve and enjoy.

title: Rigatoni-Pasta Salad With Capers and Salsa
ingredients: 1 lb rigatoni pasta or 1 lb ziti pasta, cooked and drained | 1 jar prepared salsa | 1/2 cup chopped capers | 2 -3 tablespoons capers or 2 -3 tablespoons other small olive oil
instructions: Combine 1/2 cup of the salsa with the oil in a small bowl and let sit for 15 to 30 minutes before adding the rest of the salsa.

title: Faux Vanilla Spice Blend - Dutch Honey Candy
ingredients: 3 cups cornflour, sifted | 1 cup mixed peppercorns, ground fine | 1 teaspoon real vanilla essence
instructions: Put all ingredients into a microwaveable bowl. Microwave on medium for 1 minute, stirring every minute. Leave to cool. Spread all of the butter pieces onto a baking sheet, leaving 5cm thick border on all sides. Using a small round bladed knife cut into 1cm squares and arrange on an oven tray lined with parchment paper, sprayed with oil. Bake at 220c/200f/gas 4 for 7 - 10 minutes, until just starting to turn golden. Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: virgin olive oil,cream mushroom soup,white chocolate,red currant jelly,creme de cacao
title: Devil's Food (With an Indispensable Kick!)
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup red currant jelly | 1/2 cup creme de cacao ( optional ) | 1/4 cup white chocolate ( depending on how much you like chocolate ) | 1/4 cup virgin olive oil
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except oil. Heat oil into a medium sauce pan and add to soup with wine and can of condensed cream of mushroom soup. Heat and stir until boiling. Pour into a bowl and allow to cool.

title: Baked Chilli Mussels
ingredients: 1 kg cleaned fresh mussels | 200 g dark brown sugar | 6 - 8 medium fresh chili | 12 large ice cubes | 1/2 cup fish ( your choice to fish ) | cracked mixed spices or tricolor sugar, to sprinkle over the shells if you are cooking it fresh ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to gas 4 for a few minutes. Remove the mussels from the shells and, using a slotted spoon, pull out the hairy black'shell' and set them aside. Peel away all the shells from the mussels. Discard any mussels that haven't opened. If using a charcoal grill, preheat it to medium. Bring all the ingredients to the boil, then lower heat to medium and leave to simmer uncovered for about 10 minutes. Remove from the heat and leave to stand for 5 minutes, then divide between 6, 5, or 6 serving bowls. Sprinkle with a little crushed mixed or crushed tricolor or tricolor sugar, if used. Serve at once.

title: Basic Adobo Chicken Gravy for Fish or Chicken
ingredients:
5 -7 cups chicken bouillon | 10 -20 ancho chiles powder | 1 1/2 - 2 cups baking powder, depending on how intense desired flavor desired ( i use penzey's adobo.
    - i've also used adobo )
instructions: Pour 1/2 cup of chicken bouillon in a pot and bring to a boil. You can add a little bit of sugar or water if needed. Boil for about 5 minutes while stirring until the liquid is reduced to half a cup. Add 1 tsp of cumin, 1 tsp of ancho powder, stir. You can also add anise seeds also if you like. Add baking powder as well or try an experiment to find what works for you. It really depends on what flavor you used. I have found that if your ancho chili powder is really mild, i add about 3 tbsp of ancho chili powder on top of the water in order for it to reach the right flavor in your recipe. For fish or chicken.

title: Gobel Dip
ingredients: 1 cup mayonnaise | 1/2 cup chopped white onion, or more to taste | 1/4 cup finely chopped pecans, or as needed ( optional ) | 2 cups ice water
instructions: Whisk mayonnaise, white onion, pecans, and ice water together in a bowl until smooth. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: fine sea salt,red pepper flake,rosemary sprig,basil
title: Roasted Rosemary and Red Pepper Seasoning
ingredients: 1/2 cup fine sea salt | 2 red peppers, coarsely chopped, divided | 2 tablespoons dried rosemary or 2 tablespoons fresh rosemary, chopped | 3/4 teaspoon fine sea salt | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes ( optional )
instructions: If desired, season the red peppers with 1/2 teaspoon salt to prevent charring. Roast peppers under the broiler or in a preheated 400 - 400 degree oven for 15 minutes, or until softened. Remove and set aside to cool slightly. Place remaining 1/2 teaspoon salt, rosemary, red pepper flakes and optional dry red pepper seasoning in a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: ice,mayonnaise,stilton cheese,philadelphia cream cheese,liquid smoke,black pepper,cocoa,head iceberg lettuce
title: Stilton Cheese Wraps
ingredients: 1 package stilton cheese, crumbled | 1 package philadelphia cream cheese | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon cocoa | freshly ground black pepper to taste | 2 tablespoons liquid smoke, or to taste | 1 head iceberg lettuce, shredded | 1 cup ice, or as needed
instructions: Mix Stilton cheese, cream cheese, mayonnaise, cocoa, black pepper, and liquid smoke together in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: vegetable,oil,peanut butter,lemon zest,hard apple cider,malt vinegar,celery seed
title: Mixed Vegetables
ingredients: 1 lb mixed frozen vegetables, thawed and drained on paper towels | 3 tablespoons peanut butter | 4 tablespoons malt vinegar | 1 tablespoon lemon zest | 1/4 teaspoon celery seed | 1 tablespoon oil | 2 hard apples or 2 cups sliced canned vegetables
instructions: In a bowl, combine all ingredients except carrots and celery seed. Whisk until well blended. Cover and refrigerate 10 minutes. Drain vegetables. Put into 2 quart. Serve with carrots and celery seeds.

Random Ingredients: spring onion,cake flour,cumin powder,fenugreek seed,pepper sauce,caper
title: Spiced Prawns
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs prawns | 3 spring onions | 1 teaspoon roasted cumin powder | 1 teaspoon fenugreek seeds | 1 dash hot pepper sauce | 2 teaspoons cake flour
instructions: Mix all ingredients until they're well coated. Refrigerate, covered, for at least 30 minutes. Deep fry at 180 degrees celsius until prawns are just cooked, drain well and toss with sauce. Serve with pita bread.

title: Grilled Cheese Tortellini With Sausage and Lemon
ingredients: 2 tablespoons unsalted butter, softened | 2 cans cheese tortellini ( i use the pre-made one that has wheat spirals in it without a problem ) | 2 tablespoons currants | 1 tablespoon dried cherries | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 teaspoon ground lemongrass | 1 teaspoon ground lemongrass | 1/2 lb bulk italian sausage
instructions: Set burner to medium heat and add the softened butter in a dutch oven over medium heat. When it is bubbling, add one of the cans of the tortellini and saute until the tortellini is soft and a bit brown, about 2 - 3 minutes. Remove the tortellini from the pan and set aside. Add about one third of the contents of the sauce to the pan. Add the remaining contents of the pan. Add the currants, cherries, oregano, lemongrass, and italian sausage. When the sauce is hot, add the tortellini into the pan. The cheese should have completely melted on top of the sauce while it is still steaming. Add 2 tablespoons of melted butter to the pan when everything is hot and put it into the grill. Turn the exhaust fan on and steam the tortellini about 5 - 10 minutes to get a bubbly finish. Slice meat on its own when you are ready to serve, depending on your tastes.

Random Ingredients: baby arugula,orange,maple syrup,peanut,anise seed,self raising flour,lemon,meat
title: Arugula Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces ground meat | 2 1/3 cups chopped mixed baby arugula ( or 1 1/2 cups mixed salad leaves ) | 3/4 cup chopped roasted peanuts | 2 oranges, zested and juiced | 1 lemon, juiced and zested | 1 teaspoon anise seed, crushed | 1/3 cup maple syrup ( or other flavourful syrup ) | 1/3 cup organic self-raising flour
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Mix together all your ingredients apart from the flour with your hands in a large bowl. Place the mixture in an oven proof dish and bake for 25 minutes. Serve hot straight away.

title: Spinach Fish & Crispy Chips
ingredients: 1 pound white fish fillets ( such as cod, halibut or orange roughy ) | 1 package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained | 1 1/4 cups grated carrots | 1/2 cup chopped fresh chives | 1 tablespoon onion powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place fish in a baking dish and spread out. Cook in the preheated oven for 15 to 20 minutes, until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork. Drain on paper towels. In a large bowl, combine spinach, carrots, chives, onion powder and 1 package of the crispy chipotle crispies. Add the cooked fish.

Random Ingredients: no boil lasagna noodle,artificial sweetener,oregano,cherry,dark soy sauce,vegetable stock
title: Artificial Sour Cherry Noodles
ingredients: 15 no-boil lasagna noodles | 2 cups vegetable stock | 1/4 cup dark soy sauce | 1/4 cup artificial sweetener | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried oregano | 5 cups thinly sliced fresh cherries, stems and pits removed
instructions: Prepare lasagna noodles using package directions. Cover for boiling, if necessary. Rinse noodles with cold water, and drain. Meanwhile, in a medium saucepan combine stock, soy sauce, sweetener and oregano. Bring to a boil over high heat. Add noodles, and cook for 5 minutes or until heated through.

title: Vietnamese-Style Vietnamese Salad
ingredients: 1 spring onion, halved | 1 head lettuce, cored and washed
instructions: Put lettuce in a salad bowl. Cut half of the onion crosswise into 2 - 4 slices. Cut the spring onion crosswise into 1/2 2 inch lengths. Lay the onion slices on top of the lettuce. Toss salad with salt and pepper.

title: Simple Herbed Alfredo Sauce
ingredients: 1 jar alfredo sauce | fresh herb, for garnish
instructions: Combine the jar of alfredo sauce and your favorite fresh herb in a small saucepan. Heat over medium heat until bubbly. Remove from burner and allow to cool slightly. Transfer to blender and blend until smooth, or alternatively put into a small saucepan and allow to cool completely before serving. Goes well on freshly grilled or sauteed chicken, seafood, and grilled beef slices.

title: Soupe à La Brie
ingredients: 3 ounces orecchiette, dried | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Pre heat your oven to 400º f. Place the orecchiette in a sauté pan and add enough water to cover it by about three quarters its volume. Bring this up quickly to the boil, then turn off the heat and let it sit for about 20 minutes. Drain the pasta well, then add the garam masala and mix well. Serve warm with plain white rice.

Random Ingredients: italian tomato,monterey jack cheese,flax seed oil
title: Spicy Tomato Spread
ingredients: 8 ounces monterey jack cheese, grated | 2 ounces canned italian tomatoes | 2 ounces flax seed oil or 2 ounces vegetable oil
instructions: Serve in shallow dish with grated cheese at the table. Store in refrigerator up to two days.

title: Basic Baking Stone
ingredients: 2 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 1/4 teaspoons salt | 2 1/4 teaspoons celery salt
instructions: Sprinkle the yeast over the top and heat on a medium low temperature until foam rises to the surface. Mix the salt, celery and yeast together in a large bowl. Add 2 cups of the water, mix together. When liquid is hot, stir the yeast mixture into the water and allow to foam for 1 minute. Let the yeast mixture sit for 10 minutes. When the foam has stopped, mix in the remaining 1 1/2 cups of water. With a rubber scraper or bench scraper, scrapping the sides, work the liquid into the dough until smooth. Turn out onto a floured board and knead for about 10 minutes until smooth and a little sticky. Place dough in a greased bowl turning once to grease the top. Cover and let rise in a warm place until double. Punch down and divide into four portions. Place a piece of dough in the palm of your hand and then press over the edge of a 9 inch glass or ceramic pan to form a circle about 9 inches thick or slightly less. Cover and let rise for another 5 minutes. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Bake the dough for 40 minutes or until light brown, puffy, crunchy and crusty. Remove and allow to cool completely on a wire rack. Store wrapped in plastic wrap in refrigerator.

title: Green Sweet
ingredients: 1 green bell pepper, cut into 1-inch cubes | 3 tablespoons palm sugar or 3 tablespoons brown sugar
instructions: Place the green pepper pieces in a small bowl and cover with boiling water. Set aside to marinate for 10 minutes. Drain any excess water. Place the remaining contents of the bowl into a small saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium high heat, stirring constantly. Add the palm sugar or brown sugar and allow to bubble for 3 to 5 minutes. Remove from heat.

title: A Perfect English Pepper
ingredients: 4 green peppers | 2 teaspoons ground allspice | 1/4 cup irish whiskey
instructions: Slice the tops off each pepper, remove stem and seeds. Place peppers on a flat surface. Pour enough ice into the top of the peppers so that it will drain off as much water as possible. Place the peppers on the hot grill. Grill the peppers, flesh side down, about 10 minutes or until all the skin blackens and blisters. Turn them over. Continue to turn and cook until the tops are slightly blackened and blistering, about 10 minutes or more. Be careful after removing the peppers from your grill or oven. Allow to cool then remove excess skin and stem. Place the peppers in a large plastic bag. Mix together the allspice and whiskey and pour over the tops of the peppers.

title: Anchovy Truffles
ingredients: 1 lb fresh firm tofu, drained and cut into 1-inch squares | 12 slices candied mint | 2 packets anchovy paste | 1/4 cup melted chocolate morsel | lemon wedge, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Combine tofu and mint in a food processor.

title: Lebanese Pea Salad
ingredients: 1 lb fresh peas or 1 lb snow peas | 1/2 cup light brown sugar ( or piloncillo ) | 1/2 teaspoon allspice
instructions: Clean and wash the peas or snow pea pods. Steam them, covered, over boiling water for 30 minutes. Drain them and toss them with the brown sugar. Add allspice. Serve at room temperature.

title: Coconut Balls
ingredients: 1 can bamboo shoots, drained and finely chopped | 1/4 cup light corn syrup
instructions: Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend until smooth. Scoop into walnut size balls and roll in crushed peanuts.

Random Ingredients: sage,lasagna noodle,vodka,hash brown potato,elbow macaroni,russet potato,chive,navel orange
title: Luxury Lasagna
ingredients: 5 large russet potatoes, unpeeled, quartered | 1 lb elbow macaroni | 1 bunch chives, chopped | 1 tablespoon snipped fresh sage | 1 navel orange, cut into 1/2 `` wedges | 12 uncooked lasagna noodles, broken into 2x3/4 inch sections | 1 container vodka, chilled
instructions: Cut unpeeled potatoes into 1/4 inch dice and place in a saucepan with enough cold, salted water to cover. Bring to a boil, simmer until potatoes are just tender, about 15 minutes. Drain and let cool. Meanwhile, cover macaroni with cold water and soak until tender. Drain macaroni. Reserve 12 noodles. Drain macaroni and return to pan. Add potatoes, chives, and sage and toss to combine. To serve, arrange tomato halves on top of noodles, spoon on vodka, and sprinkle with reserved drained noodles, dividing evenly. Add a dollop of yogurt and chives for a nice taste.

Random Ingredients: kiwi fruit,mushroom soup mix,heavy whipping cream,mayonnaise,mexican cheese
title: Moo Shu Kiwi Dip II
ingredients: 1 package kiwi fruits, peeled | 1 can mushroom soup mix | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1 cup shredded mexican blend cheese
instructions: In a medium bowl, cover kiwifruit with water. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the kiwifruit, and cook uncovered for about 5 to 7 minutes, or until tender. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Rinse kiwifruit, and return to the pot. Pour in the mushroom soup mix, whipping cream, and mayonnaise. Reduce heat to low, and simmer until kiwifruit is hot and creamy, about 30 minutes. Spread mixture in a decorative bowl, and top with mexican cheese.

Random Ingredients: cointreau liqueur,granny smith apple,italian parsley,orange blossom water,vodka,spice,beef sirloin steak,peanut oil vegetable
title: Grilled Skirloin Steak With Caramelized Apple Salad
ingredients:
4 boneless beef top sirloin steaks | scoarse salt and freshly ground black pepper | 2 tablespoons olive oil or 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 large granny smith apple, thinly sliced | 1/3 cup cointreau liqueur or 1/3 cup grand marnier | 1 tablespoon coarse salt | 1 tablespoon dried mixed spice ( e.
    -g.
    - fennel, sage, cate ) | 3/4 cup vodka | 1 teaspoon orange blossom water
instructions: Sprinkle both sides of sirloin steak with salt and pepper. Heat 1 tablespoon or less of olive oil in large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Working in batches, cook two slices of steak until barely cooked through, about 2 minutes per side. Transfer to cutting board.

title: Ww 5 Points - Sardine Tomato Spread
ingredients: 15 saardine tomatoes with sauce | 1/2 tablespoon mayonnaise | 2 tablespoons fresh yoghurt | toothpick | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/4 cup fresh raspberry | 2 anaheim chilies ( seeded, deseeded and finely chopped )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl. Cover and chill until needed. Serve with bread slices.

title: Chickpea Chutney
ingredients: 1 can chick-peas, drained | 1 tablespoon sweet red pepper, minced | 1 tablespoon chili powder, coarsely ground
instructions: Drain the chickpeas, discarding anything that doesn't fit on a food processor. Place all the ingredients in the food processor or blender and blend until smooth. Alternatively, place in a blender or food processor and process until smooth. Store in an airtight container for up to 1 week. This chutney keeps up to one year.

Random Ingredients: fennel seed,oat,rye flour,topping,chinese egg noodle,baking powder,yeast
title: English Sliced Rye Bread
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups old english rye flour | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1 ounce dried yeast | 1 3/4 cups oat | 2 cups quick-rising oats | 7 teaspoons fennel seeds | 1 2/3 cups frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Place rye flour, baking powder and yeast into bowl of electric mixer. Whisk until blended to a smooth batter. Add oat and mix until combined. Add fennel seeds and mix until combined. instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees and roast the beans and cauliflower florets for 40 - 50 minutes or until tender and the meat is done. The longer it simmers the more tender it develops. title: Crispy Taters

instructions: Preheat oven at 350ºf. Pour corn syrup into a large, shallow roasting pan. Place swordfish steaks into corn syrup, and stir to coat. instructions: Combine beans, walnuts, fresh parsley, cherries & cheese in a bowl. Toss to coat. Drizzle sesame oil over salad, toss lightly and serve warm or chilled.

instructions: Cut steak into four pieces. Mix egg white with 1 tablespoon margarine in shallow dish. Dip each piece in egg white and then roll in margarine. Set aside. Combine 1 tablespoon chili sauce, 1 tablespoon chili sauce mixture, apricot preserves and sea salt. Add beef.

title: Cherry Stuffed Pork Wraps

instructions: Place the rack in middle of oven and preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. If you wish, line a large rimmed baking sheet with aluminum foil. Starting with shoulder roast, use your fingers to form a pocket. This works best if the roast is about 1/2 thick. If not, cut several slits in the roast with a sharp knife about 1/4 deep. Check that meat is falling off the bone, and remove from oven, tent with foil or tent with foil and let meat stand for 10 minutes. Slice the meat and serve with salsa and your favorite condiments.

title: Baked Garlic Cheese
ingredients: 200 g cheese | 1 dash black peppercorns | 6 tablespoons tomato basil, chopped
instructions: Place cheese in a large, ovenproof dish dish and sprinkle with black peppercorns. Sprinkle with tomato basil. Place on the middle shelf of an ovenproof casserole dish that has been preheated to 190c/170c fan forced, or 220 degrees celcius. Cook for 25 minutes, until golden.

title: German Sourdough Starter
ingredients: 2 1/3 cups whole wheat flour | 1 cup cheddar cheese, grated | 1/2 cup green cardamom pods, crushed | 4 tablespoons flour | 3 limes, zested and juice from | 1 1/2 cups sauerkraut, thoroughly rinsed and drained
instructions: Sift flour into a large bowl. Add 1 1/3 cups of grated cheese, cardamon pods, and lime zest. Add 1½ cups of rinsed and drained sauerkraut. Use a wooden spoon to combine ingredients. Make sure all ingredients are moistened with liquid. Cover and refrigerate for 2 days to ferment. To use, place 1 1/3 cups of finished starter into a 2 cup measuring cup. If it has any remaining solids, cover to keep the starter warm. Pour the water into the 2 cups measuring cup. Use a sturdy spoon to scoop out a spoonful of starter and use to measure out another ¼ cupful. Measure out flour remaining in the cup and stir into the starter pot. Bring to a boil, then remove it from the heat. Put 1½ cups of starter into an airtight container. Attach the container to your gift tag or a gift card and slowly pour hot starter into the starter until the starter has soaked into the starter. Cover.

title: Empanada (A Fondue for Perogies)

instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Combine spice mixture ingredients and set aside. Coat a 10x15 jellyroll pan with cooking spray and set aside. Coat a medium saucepan of boiling water with cooking spray and set aside. In a blender container, purée the tomatoes, pimentos and the apples. Transfer to the warmed saucepan and stir in the spice mixture, mace, and extra virgin olive oil. Simmer while you cook the rest of your batch of fritters. Dip each reynolds wrap packet in warm cornmeal, and drop in the fritters and fry until golden brown, 3 to 4 minutes.

title: Chinese Take-Out Spiced Poached Meat
ingredients: 16 ounces frying chickens, cut into pieces | 1/3 cup cornstarch ( or other starch ) | 5/8 cup vegetable stock or 5/8 cup chicken stock | 1/2 cup fresh ginger ale ( or water for your ginger ale ) | 2 teaspoons crushed red pepper flakes ( or to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon szechuan peppercorns ( optional ) | 1/2 cup pecorino romano cheese, grated
instructions: Pour hot tap water into a bowl, or a large container that you have a lid. Place chicken pieces in water, and place a piece of cling wrap over the chicken for 2 minutes to soften. This may also be done on the grill or in the oven. If you have one of these, then you can use a meat mallet to pound the chicken pieces or use a rolling pin and hammer to crack them until they are roughly the size of the rice cooker lid. Rinse chicken with water, and place in bowl of cold water. Sprinkle each piece of chicken with about half of the cornstarch. Mix together the stock, ale, red pepper, szechuan peppercorns and cheese in a small bowl. Dip chicken pieces into the liquid, then carefully shake off the excess. This might not sound like many, but they will eventually be added to your pot. You should have just enough liquid to coat all the chicken, but if it doesn't, drain a little more. The chicken will absorb the liquid, so if not, repeat for a few more minutes or so. Cook chicken, covered, over low heat for about 18 minutes, then uncover. You may need to lower the temperature a little. After about 18 minutes, check the chicken to make sure it is cooked through and has some blood on top, or if it is just a little watery, cook longer. Remove chicken and set aside to cool before continuing. It is best to have your steaming apparatus hot, so if at the table you use rice bowls, be sure to steam the chicken for about 10 minutes before serving. To serve, place chicken on a platter, sprinkle with the cheese, and enjoy.

title: Penne with Chickpeas, Chickpeas and Beer
ingredients: 9 ounces penne | 12 ounces crushed tomatoes with basil | 8 ounces of natural chunky pasta catsup | 8 ounces triple sec or 8 ounces other triple sec | 12 ounces of drained chickpeas | 1 ounce of natural australian ale
instructions: Cook pasta to al dente. Drain. Set aside. Wash the chickpeas and roughly chop the base with a sharp knife. Mix the chickpeas, tomato based ale and dressing together. To serve, pour penne on plate. Portion on 1/2 cup of the red tomatoes with basil, chickpeas and some of the bottle of beer. Then top with 1 ounce of the double sec mixed with the dressing. Add the rest of the ingredients. Add salt and pepper to taste. You can also use a mixture of salt, pepper and sugar to balance out the spice.

title: Molho Na Nazi

ingredients: 2 hass avocadoes | 1/3 cup plain yogurt | 1 tablespoon sour cream | 1/8 teaspoon saffron threads | 2 cups salsa | 1/4 teaspoon saffron threads | 3/4 cup ricotta cheese, divided | 1 can enchilada sauce | 3 ounces brazil nuts, coarsely chopped
instructions: Cut avocado in half lengthwise and remove flesh from pit. Use 2 small sharp knife to slice flesh in 1/4 inch thick slices. In a small saucepan, heat saffron over medium heat for 20 seconds. Remove from heat and let cool for 5 minute. Strain through a sieve into a small bowl. Microwave 1/4 cup water, 1/2 cup salsa and 1 1/4 tsp salt on high power until boiling. Stir. Serve with tortilla mixture and top with remaining cheese. Garnish with brazil nuts.

title: Radishes With Sour Cream and Thyme
ingredients: 1 bunch radish | 150 ml double cream | fresh thyme sprig ( to garnish )
instructions: Halve the radishes lengthways and clean them very well removing any discoloured outer peel. Tie the roots firmly together with kitchen string, then slice the root lengthways into thin wedges, with about a third of an inch to the width. Place them in a large pan and add a little boiling water. Cover and boil gently for 15 - 20 minutes until tender. Take them out of the pan, cover lightly with oil. Warm the cream in the saucepan and stir through the radish wedges. Sprinkle with thyme and serve with plain boiled potatoes or your chosen meal.

instructions: Trim and core the pear, then cut into large chunks. In a medium bowl, mix the yellow mustard, worcestershire sauce, salt, and caraway. Add pear chunks and to coat. Cover, and chill until serving.

instructions: Place chicken in a container or non stick baking dish and cover with vinegar. Cover and chill for at least 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Remove skin and fat from the chicken and discard. Cover and bake at about 200 degrees celcius/400 degrees/gas mark 4 for about 1 1/2 hours or until chicken is tender and crispy.

title: Cheese with Chile

instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Spray a nonstick baking sheet with cooking spray. Stir together the processed cheese, taco seasoning, ground chile powder, and confectioners' sugar in a bowl.

title: Smoky & Gluten Free Sauerkraut Stuffed Cillets
ingredients: 1 cup sauerkraut | 1 head cauliflower, chopped | bread flour ( use gluten free flour for bran bread ) | 1 cup milk | wine ( like chardonnay ) or beef broth ( like chardonnay ) | 2 -3 teaspoons tomato-flavored barbecue sauce ( you could use more if your family would like ) | lemonade ( optional )
instructions: Rinse sauerkraut and finely chop the stems, keeping only the tips. Steam cauliflower until tender about 15 - 20 minutes, then drain and mash with a fork. title: Baked Eggplant (Aubergine) and Roasted Vegetables

instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees celsius. Slice 3/4 inch slices from the eggplant and put aside in a bowl. Brush eggplant slices on the baking sheet and bake for 25 minutes, turning over half way through. It should be well tender when pierced with a fork. Cool and remove eggplant slices. Serve cold with the roasted vegetables. Variation, you may want to use dried thyme sprigs for the roasted vegetables.

title: Homemade Corned Pork on Nuts
ingredients: 2 tablespoons whole mixed nuts | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 4 cups mixed vegetable stock | 1 tablespoon crushed roasted peanuts | 1 1/2 kg smoked pork
instructions: Soak mixed nuts in boiling water 10 minutes, then drain. Meanwhile combine stock, peanuts, and mustard seeds in a large saucepan. Bring to the boil, then add the nuts. Process, gradually adding more stock, if necessary, to make a thick sauce. Cut the smoked pork into 5 cm slices and arrange in a single layer on an ovenproof dish. Pour sauce over and cook in moderate oven for approximately 1½ hours or until pork is tender.

title: Sweet Italian Beef Roll-Ups (Slow Cookers)
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef sirloin steak, cut 3/4-inch thick | 1 small cucumber, cut into 1/4-inch slices | 1 1/2 cups italian-style stewed tomatoes, cut in half | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon granules | 1 teaspoon dark brown sugar
instructions: In a 2 1/2 quart slow cooker, combine beef, cucumber and stewed tomatoes. Sprinkle with chicken bouillon granules and sugar. Top with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight or for up to 8 hours. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Nimisian Mushrooms
ingredients: 100 g scotch bonnet peppers | 150 g mushrooms | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 1 tablespoon poppy seed
instructions: Grind the scotch bonnet pepper and cornflour to a fine paste. Add the mushrooms and stir well. Cook briefly until the mushrooms are cooked, then set aside. Add the poppy seeds to the mushroom broth and stir continuously. Garnish if required. Serve with bread.

title: Flank Steak Parmesan

instructions: Cook steaks in boiling water to cover for 6 minutes or until just pink in center. Remove. Cover and keep warm. Meanwhile, add celery, tomatoes, and anise seeds to a blender and puree. Remove steaks from saucepan. Cook in a large skillet for 5 - 10 minutes, or until browned on all sides, turning once. Drain on paper towels. In a 9x13 baking dish or a 10 x 12 inch sheet pan, arrange 1/2 of the pasta ingredients. Top with 1/2 of the steaks. Repeat layers. Pour sauce over all. Let sit for 2 hours or until all the sauce is absorbed. Sprinkle with more sweet and sour and enjoy.

title: Chili Pilaf
ingredients: 4 -5 stalks green chili | 1 cup pearl barley ( i prefer a mix of yellow, red, and green, i've used red and a mixture )
instructions: Wash and rinse the chilie in a pot of cold water until the water runs clear around the edges. The chilie will be easy to remove from the water. Drain well and cut off the end of the green stems. Remove the leaves and the stringy membrane. Remove the seeds and membrane but leave the chilie whole. Place the barley and water in a pan or casserole over a medium heat. Bring to the boil then reduce the heat and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes stirring occasionally. Remove from the heat and allow to stand until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: cranberry juice cocktail,orange zest,digestive biscuit,beef steak,lettuce
title: Cranberry Beef Packets
ingredients: 3 sheets digestive biscuits | 1 tablespoon grated orange zest | 1 tablespoon cranberry juice cocktail | 1 lb beef steak, thinly sliced | lettuce
instructions: Cut a sheet of foil on a baking tray with a 2cm thickness | 24 biscuits, cut on the diagonal into 2cm squares. Combine zest, cranberry juice and beef. Spread over biscuits, covering all. Bring corners of foil together, fold over to seal. Bake in a moderate oven for 7 - 8 minutes until golden and cooked through. Serve on a board.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,sirloin steak,milk powder,puff pastry,scallion,serrano chilies,half cream,tuna
title: Mexican Steak Puff Pastry & Tuna
ingredients: 10 ounces tuna, drained | 2 tablespoons fat-free half-and-half cream | 1 -1 teaspoon garlic salt or 1 -1 teaspoon cumin | 1/2 teaspoon scallion, minced | 1/2 teaspoon serrano chilies, minced | 1 box puff pastry, thawed ( 6oz ) | milk powder, as needed
instructions: Heat oven to 425°f in medium bowl combine tuna, cream, garlic salt, scallion, chiles and half the milk powder. On floured cutting board, roll out 2 sheets of pastry, cut into 1/8 inch strips. Cut rest into strips. Repeat with other sheets of pastry and tuna mixture until all is used up. Cut 4 more strips lengthwise down center of each strip of pastry and place on sprayed baking sheet. Place a heaping spoonful of tuna mixture in center of pastry.

Random Ingredients: black bean,baking powder,italian parsley,dark brown sugar,sushi rice
title: Italian Black Beans, Calrose Rice, and Sushi Rice Mix
ingredients: 2 cups cooked sushi-style rice ( i recommend sushi rice mix for calrose cooking rice ) | 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained | 2 tablespoons baking powder | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh italian parsley, for garnish
instructions: Mix all ingredients except rice, beans, and baking powder. Add rice, beans, and baking powder and mix well. Cover with plastic wrap, refrigerate, and marinate overnight. Before serving, transfer cooled sushi rice to a serving dish and spoon rice onto an individual serving dish. Garnish with fresh parsley.

Random Ingredients: salt pork,chocolate pudding mix,raspberry,sage,grand marnier,bay seasoning,thyme leave,juniper berry
title: Spicy Chocolate Crumb Crescents for Christmas Dogs
ingredients:
2 cups unsweetened instant chocolate pudding mix | 1 tablespoon grand marnier | 1 1/2 teaspoons sage | 1 1/2 teaspoons thyme leave | 1 1/2 teaspoons crushed juniper berries ( or 1-2 tsp.
    - dried crushed mixed peppercorns ) | 15 ounces raspberry swizzle berries ( or 1-2 tsp.
    - black peppercorns ) | 1/2 teaspoon old bay seasoning | salt pork or bacon ( optional )
instructions: In a saucepan, combine the instant pudding mix, grand marnier, sage, thyme and crushed juniper berries. Place over medium heat and cook until the mixture comes to a boil. Stirring constantly. Add the black or green berries and remove from the heat. Stir in the salt pork, bacon or crayfish or poultry of choice. Drop by level teaspoon into a parchment paper cone shaped cookie sheet so the cookie will fit snugly into the mini pot. Bake at 375 deg. F for 12 to 15 minutes, or until the cookies are crisp. Cut into bars while still warm.

title: Honeyed Vegetables
ingredients: 1 -2 head baby bok choy or 1 -2 head red cabbage | 1 bunch raw cauliflower ( about 7 cups worth ) | 4 -6 carrots, peeled and sliced thin | 3 -4 cloves garlic paste, to taste | 1/4 cup honey ( optional ) | 1 -2 head red cabbage
instructions: Cut the cabbage lengthwise into strips and slice the flowers from stem to bloom for a little bit of stem left. Wash the leaf ends and cut off the root. Drop the bok choy, cauliflower carrots in boiling water with a few drops of olive oil and garlic paste. Cook for about 10 minutes or until cauliflower softens and carrots are almost cooked. Remove and serve on a platter with some honey.

title: Yummy Chive Chutney
ingredients: 5 cups chives, washed | 1/3 cup red chili powder
instructions: In a blender, mix the chilli powder with the chives. Cover and process until it becomes fine. Pour mixture into a deep pan. Cool for 4 - 5 hours. Cut into desired shapes by rolling and sprinkling with red chilli powder. Store in an airtight container.

title: Summer Time Melon Ice Blocks
ingredients: 600 g watermelon, peeled, seeded and cut into chunks | 8 ice cubes | 2 liters water
instructions: Place melon, ice cubes and water into a large glass & gently stir over a low heat until the cubes soften to your liking. Remove from the heat, stir into the mixture until cold and set aside to cool a little before cutting into 24 pieces with either a knife and using a rolling pin, cut each block into small segments. Space the pieces on the baking paper, freeze until solid, then cut in half diagonally to serve.

title: Pigs in Sauce - Pickled Beets
ingredients: 2 lbs red beets or 2 lbs white beets | 1 teaspoon ground sage leaf | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper | 1/4 cup hot sauce
instructions: Prepare the beets and place them in a pot or small bowl with water to cover. Bring the water to the boil, lower the heat and simmer the beets until tender enough to core, about 40 minutes. When done, drain the beets and rinse well under cold water. While the beets are cooking, mix all of the remaining ingredients together.

title: Rolf Runkel's Roquefort Cheese
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds roquefort cheese, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1/2 cup finely chopped basil leaves | salt and cracked black pepper to taste
instructions: Mash cheese with a potato masher in the bowl of a meat grinder until smooth. Stir in the basil and season with salt and pepper. Chill before serving.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,spanish onion,red pepper,sherry wine,maraschino cherry,baguette,red cabbage,mustard
title: Spanish Onion Cabbage Strata
ingredients: 1 large sweet red cabbage | 1 large spanish onion, sliced thin | 1 red pepper, cut into thin 1/4 rounds | 1 baguette | 1/2 cup dry sherry wine or 1/2 cup red wine | 1/4 teaspoon dry mustard | 1/4 - 1/2 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 dash paprika ( optional )
instructions: Shred cabbage, onion and pepper with two forks.

title: Beef Filets for a Great Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs beef tenderloin | 1 cup currants or 1 cup raisins | vegetable oil cooking spray
