instructions: Place beef filets in a large plastic bag. Pour 1 cup water into bag and turn bag to coat filets. Add currants or raisins. Close bag and marinate for at least 1 hour or up to 3 hours in fridge. Spray both sides of the filets with water. Heat about 1/2 inch of vegetable oil in skillet or fryer to 350 degrees. Spray meat with cooking spray. Cook meat on high for 10 minutes. Do not overcook.

title: French Onion Tea
ingredients: 2 -3 fresh french onions, chopped | 3 -4 tablespoons instant tea ( or a mix of half and half ) or 3 -4 tablespoons instant tea powder ( or a mix of half and half ) | 1 pinch salt and black pepper or 1 pinch freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Heat a pan, preferably non stick, over medium heat for a minute or two. Tip in the chopped onions. Stir every minute or so for a while until the onions are lightly browned. Cover and cook for 10 minutes over low heat, stirring every few minutes, until you feel a lovely aroma coming from the pan. You could use the same pan. Pour in a tea kettle or tea spout that has been prepared in plenty of boiling water. Steep, covered, for about 45 minutes until the tea is thick but not runny. Stir. Add salt and pepper to taste. Serve piping hot.

title: Easy Mexican Red Beans & Rice
ingredients: 2 cans great northern beans | 1 chopped bell pepper | 1/4 cup golden raisin
instructions: Drain all items except raisins and raisins. Combine all ingredients in 3 1qt casserole. Cover and bake at 350 for 1 hour, stirring halfway through.

title: Chilled Cilantro and Mustard Salad With Herbs (Sushi)
ingredients:
2 -6 tablespoons chopped cilantro leaves ( loosely packed ) | 1/2 teaspoon finely grated fresh lemon rind | 2 teaspoons finely chopped fresh lemons ( or 2 to 4 tsp.
    - fresh lemons ) | 1 teaspoon finely chopped fresh rose water ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons prepared english mustard ( or 1 to 1 1/2 teaspoons dijon ) | 1 lb nori, cut in half horizontally, lengthwise, then cut into 1/2-inch strips, keeping strips separated
instructions: Combine the herbs and lemon rind in a small bowl. Add mustard, if using, and stir to mix well. Spread evenly over 1 nori strip. Arrange on a serving plate. Sprinkle with the parsley. Note, if using dijon mustard, use only a few drops, and not more than 1/2 teaspoon each until well mixed. Yields approximately 2 cups.

title: Quick and Easy Vegetable Soup
ingredients:
1 can vegetables ( grated carrots, bell peppers, mushrooms, peas etc.
    - ) | 1 -2 tablespoon oregano ( fresh or dried, not dried )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a crock pot, and mix well.

Random Ingredients: wheat pastry flour,scotch bonnet pepper,carnation milk,cashew,raspberry
title: Scotch Bonnet Pepper and Raspberry Fritters
ingredients: 6 scotch bonnet peppers ( or your favourite chilli chile, seeds removed ) | 100 g roasted unsalted cashews | 100 g raspberries or 100 g frozen raspberries | 1 1/2 cups carnation evaporated milk | 3 cups whole wheat pastry flour | 25 g roasted unsalted cashews ( optional )
instructions: For the fritters, preheat oven. Cut the chillies in half lengthways and remove the seeds. Remove the flesh and reserve for use. Place the cashews and chillies together in a bowl of a food processor and process until they become powder. Pour the puree into a bowl and stir in the saucers, cashews, raspberries and carnation milk. Add the flour gradually, stirring with a metal spoon until the mixture makes a firm dough consistency. Turn out onto a floured surface and knead for 2 minutes. Roll out to about 15x8 rectangle and cut into strips. Wrap the strips in plastic and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Preheat a large frying pan with a lightly oiled and uncrowded coating of oil until a few drops of water sizzle. Add 4 tablespoons of the hot oil and when bubbles form around the edge of the pan, add the fritters and fry the balls in batches, adding more oil as required, until golden brown all over, about 4 - 5 minutes, transfer to paper towel lined oven trays and keep warm in a 300f oven until all the fritters are cooked. Once the balls are in the pan, transfer them on to a baking tray lined with oven trays. Repeat the process with up to another batch and keep warm and drained on a plate. Serve the fritters with your favourite toppings like chutney, mustard and greens.

title: Panchon's Tortilla
ingredients: 2 large corn tortillas | coriander ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Cut tortillas into 2 equal portions. Heat a non stick skillet sprayed with non stick spray on medium heat. Spray tortilla with cooking spray. Place tortilla on skillet and cook for 1 - 2 minutes, flipping once, until lightly golden on both sides. Remove tortilla to a plate, place on a serving platter and sprinkle with fresh coriander or any other desired spice. Serve immediately with salsa. Note, the tortillas could be frozen unbaked and kept for up to 7 days.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,ranch dressing,lemon juice,suet,baking potato,black cardamom pod,flat leaf parsley,fruit
title: Pumpkin and Potato Bread
ingredients: 4 large baking potatoes | 2 ounces shredded suet | 4 ounces shredded lemon juice | 1 teaspoon ground mixed fruit ( raisins, dates or cranberries mixed with the juice ) | 1/4 teaspoon black cardamom pod, cracked ( or more ) | 1/4 teaspoon mixed dried fruit ( optional ) | 1/4 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley or 1/4 cup fresh cilantro ( or other fresh herb ) | 1/2 cup warm whole wheat flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Cut a cross in the top of each potato. Place each on a medium baking sheet and bake for 20 - 25 minutes or until fork tender.

title: Robyn's Easy Salmon Salad
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets | 1 container grape tomatoes ( about 8 8 oz ) | 1 cup seedless grapeseed tomatoes ( about 8 oz ) | 1/2 cup real mayonnaise | 1/4 cup ketchup | 1/4 cup italian seasoning | 1/4 cup sultana
instructions: Bring a large pot of generously salted water to a boil. Add salmon.

title: Tropical Sauce for Corned Beef
ingredients: 1 cup raisins ( optional ) | 3 green onions, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup brewed coffee ( coffee may also be used )
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix raisins, green onion and hot coffee until coated. Use as a topping for the corned beef or use as suggested on your favorite corned beef.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,cream chicken soup,baby carrot,ancho chile,lime,phyllo pastry
title: Creamy Garlic and Sour Cream Phyllo Pastry
ingredients: 1 package frozen chopped garlic and sour cream phyllo pastry sheets, thawed | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 2 teaspoons dried ancho chiles, or to taste ( optional ) | 1/2 cup baby carrots, finely shredded | 1/4 cup italian parsley, chopped ( optional ) | 1 lime, cut into wedges
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with reynolds wrap nonstick cooking spray. Place thawed phyllo pastry sheets on a clean, dry surface with sides. Cut phyllo sheets in half crosswise. Place 1 phyllo sheet in the center of the sheet. Sprinkle with 1/3 each of the garlic sour cream and creamed soup. Sprinkle with chiles, if using, carrots and parsley. Fold over phyllo and roll into a spiral, starting with the shortest side. Continue rolling and sprinkling each phyllo sheet in 2 or 3 pieces, trimming off all pieces too many if needed. Place on the prepared baking sheet, seam side down. Brush with remaining 1/3 of the soup and the juice of the lime. Bake in the preheated oven until phyllo is puffed and golden brown and tops are nicely browned, about 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: veal,basil pesto,cajun seasoning,mayonnaise,dark brown sugar,self raising flour
title: Cajun Spiced Veal Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup mayonnaise, low fat | 1/4 cup basil pesto | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar | 1 cup self-raising flour | 3/4 teaspoon cajun seasoning | 6 ounces veal, cooked cut into thin strips
instructions: Place all the ingredients together, stirring to combine. Serve with veg.

title: Italian Quinoa
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 1/2 teaspoon anchovy fillet ( optional ) | 1/2 small yellow pepper, diced ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon italian seasoning
instructions: Put all ingredients in a medium saucepan and stir well. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes. Fluff with a fork before serving.

Random Ingredients: escarole,green pea,grand marnier,virgin olive oil,fennel seed,sugar snap pea,wood ear mushroom
title: Gougere (French Fennel Stir-Fry With Mushrooms)
ingredients: 2 medium green peas, cleaned and trimmed ( about 3 to 4 ounces ) | 2 ounces dried wood ear mushrooms | 1 tablespoon fennel seed | 1/2 tablespoon caribbean grand marnier, blend | 1/4 cup fresh baby frisee or 1/4 cup escarole, trimmed and washed | 1/4 cup fresh green pea, cleaned and trimmed | 1 tablespoon virgin olive oil
instructions: In a large skillet, place the pea pods in 1 layer and cook over moderate heat, stirring, or shaking the pan to keep from sticking, until black, 6 to 8 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside. Place the wood ears in a small saucepan and cover with cold water. Bring to a boil over moderately high heat, then remove from heat and allow to stand, covered, until they can be pierced with a finger, about 10 minutes. Drain well. Cut the mushrooms open and remove any tough stems. Cut the caps in half and remove the soft white membrane. Cut the caps into 1/4 inch thick slices. Place the fennel seeds in a 12 inch skillet and toast, stirring, or shaking the pan, until fragrant, 30 seconds to 1 minute. Add the grand marnier and stir to combine. Add the fennel mixture and stir to coat both the mushrooms. Add the friselle and green pea pods and toss to combine. Add the olive oil and stir through. Serve with rice, if desired.

Random Ingredients: apple cider,agave nectar,salami,onion,ancho chili,gelatin,orange juice concentrate
title: Sour-Stuffed Ancho Chilies
ingredients: 2 cans sliced ancho chilies, drained | 1 can sweetened apple cider | 2 packages unflavored gelatin | 3/4 cup orange juice concentrate | 1/2 cup agave nectar | 1 cup finely chopped onion | 24 slices salami
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 degrees f. Grease an 8x8 inch baking dish. Place chilies on a plate, and place coated chilies in the dish. In a saucepan, combine the cider, gelatins and orange juice concentrate. Heat, stirring, until gelatins have melted together, and remove from heat. Stir in agave nectar, onion and salami slices.

title: Healthy Black Bean Bread (Bread Mix)
ingredients: 1 cup whole wheat bread, cut in chunks | 1 cup currants or 1 cup craisins | 1 1/2 cups self raising flour | 1 cup cornflour | 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed out
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl then use hands to mix the ingredients together until the bread is evenly mixed. Place in the fridge, then leave the bread in it for 30 minutes to firm it up, then bake at 180°c until firm and golden.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,chicken bouillon,spanish rice,garlic powder,potato,pecan,triple sec,yoghurt
title: Cocktail Chicken (Cocktail)
ingredients: 2 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 1/2 cup jamaican-style rice with pimento peppers and red peppers ( recommended -- jardine ) | 2 cubes chicken bouillon | 1/2 cup greek yogurt | 1 tablespoon triple sec | 1 clove garlic powder | 2 tablespoons pecans, chopped | 1 tablespoon spanish-style diced potatoes, or as desired ( optional )
instructions: Place chicken breasts in a large resealable food storage bag. Pour enough water into bag to completely immerse chicken in. Refrigerate at least 3 hours, but can be up to 1 day in advance. In a small bowl, stir together the jardine, bouillon, yogurt, triple sec, garlic powder, minced pecans and diced potatoes. Refrigerate until serving time. Discard leftovers, if using.

title: Ginger Cole Slaw
ingredients: 1/2 cup coarsely crushed rice cereal | 1/2 cup finely crushed coleslaw mix | 1 tablespoon finely chopped peeled fresh ginger
instructions: Combine rice cereal, coleslaw mix, ginger, and salt and pepper to taste in a large bowl.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf italian parsley,scotch bonnet pepper,panir,green tomato,chicken breast,fava bean
title: Caribbean Stewed Chicken With Fava Beans
ingredients: 200 g fava beans | 200 g panir, cut into quarters | 200 g green tomatoes, cut into 8 pieces | 200 g green tomatoes, cut into 3 pieces | 2 teaspoons scotch bonnet peppers | 2 tablespoons chopped flat-leaf italian parsley
instructions: Place fava beans, chopped panir and diced tomatoes and green tomato pieces. Sprinkle scotch bonnet pepper and cook for 3 minutes. Mix the sauce with the cooked fava beans in a medium size pot. Add some water. Cover and cook for 15 minutes. Sprinkle with parsley after 5 minutes.

title: Smoked Chile Con Queso
ingredients: 8 slices french bread | 8 ounces muenster cheese | 8 ounces cheddar cheese | 8 slices smoked hamburger | 6 ounces mixed fruit | 1 tablespoon shallot | 1 tablespoon fruit pectin | 6 ounces cured red calabaza cheese or 6 ounces cured queso fresco | 3 cups guiness french fettuccine
instructions: Mash muenster into crouton with a fork, it should resemble a coarse paste. Cut cheese slices crosswise into halves, then crosswise into 1 1/2 inch pieces. Place croutons on a plate or in a shallow serving dish and coat with croutons, pressing crumbs on with your fingers to adhere.

title: Fried Indian Corn Fritters
ingredients: 2 green cardamom pods, lightly crushed | 2 teaspoons cornflour ( may need a little more )
instructions: Break off pieces of cardamom and lightly crush in a pestle and mortar.. Combine the corn flour and cardamom in a small bowl, then mix together with the cornflour until mixture forms a smooth paste. Heat a little oil in a frying pan, and add half the cornflour mix to the oil, or just enough for the mixture to bubble slightly. Fry the fritters, flipping once or twice, until golden brown all over. Remove from the pan to drain on a plate and top with a little extra cornflour and chopped fresh coriander.

title: Baked Sweet Potato
ingredients: 600 g sweet potatoes | 1 tablespoon garam masala powder
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 c degrees f. Wash the sweet potatoes well before baking. Preheat oven to 200 degrees celsius. Cut the top off and cut a cross into the outside of the potato using a sharp knife or razor. This stops the sweet potato from cracking and giving away steam or even better, cut the potato lengthwise into 2 cm slices. Bake potato slices for 1 hour or until tender.

title: Grilled Vegetable Salad With Dressing and Lime
ingredients: 1 bunch chives, finely chopped | 3 limes, zest of, finely grated | 1 avocado, thinly sliced | 1 zucchini, thinly sliced | 3/4 cup plain fat free greek yogurt | 1 tablespoon dressing ( i prefer miracle whip ) | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Mix all the ingredients up to the dressing for the salad in a shallow bowl. Spray a hot grill with cooking spray and heat to medium. Toss the vegetables to coat with dressing. Grill until cooked to your liking and sprinkle with chopped chives.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno,white cheddar cheese,italian sausage link,yellow bell pepper,peanut,sumac,fontina cheese
title: Cheesy Sausage Bake
ingredients: 4 italian sausage links | 4 yellow bell peppers, chopped | 1/2 can white cheddar cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup light gorgonzola or 1/2 cup feta cheese, crumbled | 3/4 cup fontina cheese, shredded | to taste peanuts, diced, for topping ( optional ) | sumac, for topping ( optional ) | 1/2 jalapeno, sliced, for topping ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Lightly spray a 9 x 13 inch casserole dish with nonstick spray coating. Remove casings from sausage links. Cut sausage into 12 strips on the bias. Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Add sausage strips and cook until toasted and crumbly, about 3 minutes. Remove sausage and set aside. Add yellow bell peppers and cook in hot skillet until tender. Add cheeses, and heat until melted, about 2 to 3 minutes. Add toasted sausage and bell peppers. Stir in gorgonzola/ feta and toasted sausage. Add chopped peanuts and heat until melted, about 15 seconds. Season with sumac. Remove from heat and transfer mixture to prepared baking dish. Sprinkle toasted cashews and top with sliced jalapenos. Bake until bubbly and cheese is brown, about 25 minutes.

title: Kirby's Beet and Rice Salad
ingredients: 8 medium beets, sliced | 8 cups hot cooked short-grain rice
instructions: Cook rice until done. Allow to cool, then place in bowl or refrigerator. Drain, and cool in fridge. This will last for a couple of weeks, depending on how hungry you are.

title: Sweet and Spicy Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup corn | 1/3 cup dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon adobo sauce | 1/2 teaspoon white sugar
instructions: Blend corn, soy sauce, adobo sauce, and sugar in blender until smooth.

title: Sambal "fryer" Chicken
ingredients: 1 frying chicken, cut into 10 pieces | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 tablespoon seasoning | 1/8 teaspoon cardamom | 1/8 teaspoon sambal oelek ( optional ) | 1 cup whipping cream
instructions: Heat the wok to smoking and add sesame oil. Add chicken and brown. Remove chicken and leave to rest for 5 minutes then cut into slices about 1/4 inch thick. Add seasoning, cardamom and cream to the pan. Bring to the boil and simmer for about 3 minutes. Sprinkle with sambal oelek to serve.

title: Cool Whip Egg Cream Filling
ingredients: 1 ounce egg yolk | 1/4 cup cool whip
instructions: Whisk egg yolk and cool whip together until smooth. Fold in yolk mixture. Chill in refrigerator 10 minutes. Beat with electric mixer until fluffy.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,white bread,button mushroom,pork,island dressing,sesame seed
title: Woolworths Sunday Breakfast
ingredients: 2 slices white bread, toasted | 1/2 cup sliced button mushroom | 2 -3 slices pork, any type of cut | 1/2 teaspoon sesame seeds ( optional ) | island dressing | dark soy sauce or soy sauce
instructions: You can toast bread and stuff the filling into your preferred pancakes. Brush top with a little sesame oil or a touch of dark soy sauce. If you do this to cover bottom of your pan, this will give you a crispier, more crispy bottom. When done, spread wok with a little dressing, or just spoon a little sesame oil into pan. Pour in some dark soy sauce, or dark soy sauce. Add sliced pork, and mushrooms, if using them. Turn down heat and toast the bread, then add toasted bread into pan. Sprinkle with sesame seed, if desired, and serve immediately.

title: Sumac Za’atar (Sumac Za’atar Salad)
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon saffron | 1 head romaine lettuce, quartered and shredded | 2 ounces snow peas | 1/2 cup egg substitute
instructions: Place saffron in a small bowl. Add 2 tbsp water and stir to blend. Remove and discard rind and seeds from the snow peas. Dry with paper towels. Stir saffron into yogurt with the cooked snow peas. Cover and refrigerate. Toss lettuce with remaining ingredients and serve.

title: Sweet Ravioli
ingredients: 4 egg whites | 1/2 cup raisins | 2 tablespoons chinese wine ( white dry )
instructions: Beat egg whites until white are stiff. Fold in raisins and wine. Heat a heavy skillet in deep fat until smoking. Pour in about 1/3 cup of the egg mixture. Make sure it coats the tip of a spoon. Drop a ravioli by teh spoon into the fat and cook 2 minutes per side. Repeat with remaining ravioli, keeping the skillet on the heat. Serve in a small circle or on a large plate with moistened fingers. Note, the size of the ravioli may vary, so it's best not to make the ravioli too small.

title: Red Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 2 cans refried beans | 1 cup milk | 2 tablespoons pernod | 1 jar pimientos, drained, chopped | 1/4 cup chopped toasted, chopped dried ancho chile powder | 1 tablespoon honey | 1 cup cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Heat refried beans. Mix milk, pernod, pimientos, chile powder and honey. Pour mixture into an 8x8 inch baking pan. Add cheese and cover with foil. Bake at 350°f for 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: white sugar,balsamic vinegar,currant,italian sausage,pam cooking spray,savory,romano cheese
title: Spicy Italian Sausage
ingredients: 8 links sweet italian sausage | pam cooking spray | 1/2 cup dry currant ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar ( or red wine vinegar ) | 1/2 teaspoon savory | 1/4 teaspoon white sugar ( optional ) | 1/2 cup grated romano cheese
instructions: Set oven to 400 degrees. Butter a baking dish with pam. Place the sausage in the baking dish, and spray with pam. Roast for 20 minutes, or until internal temperature reaches 160 degrees. Slice the sausages and return them to the oven, and cook until golden brown on the outside. While the sausages are cooking, mix together the preserves with the preserves in a small saucepan and simmer until glaze is thick and creamy. Pour sauce over the hot sausages, and sprinkle with cheese. Reduce the oven temperature to 350 degrees. Let sit until the cheese is just melted..

Random Ingredients: ancho chile powder,broth,stew vegetable,baby arugula,white bread,lime,cream cheese
title: Baby Arborugula Soup Mix (Sopa De Carne)
ingredients: 2 cans stew vegetables, drained and rinsed | 4 1/4 cups broth | 1 package cream cheese, crumbled | 1 small fresh ancho chile powder, or to taste | 2 teaspoons dried ancho chile powder | 1 package baby arugula, coarsely chopped | 1 loaf crusty white bread, cut into 1/2-inch cubes
instructions: Empty 2 cans stewed vegetables into a blender.

title: Olive and Sweet Onion Dip
ingredients: 1 bottle olives, pitted and coarsely chopped ( use a mixture of both ) | 1 cup sour cream
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender, blend until smooth. If desired, transfer mixture to a jar with a lid, seal the lid and refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Artichokes On The Run
ingredients: 1 can asadero cheese, cut into cubes | 2 artichoke hearts, trimmed | 1/2 cup sherry wine, to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place cheese cubes in a large baking dish and pour sherry over top of cheese. Bake in the preheated oven until cheese has melted. Serve immediately.

title: Simple Jasmine Rice
ingredients: 1 cup jasmine rice, jasmine, regular | 1/2 cup finely chopped almonds
instructions: Place rice and almonds in medium bowl. Sprinkle each serving with 1 teaspoon of olive or sunflower oil.

Random Ingredients: cashew,lemon juice zest,toothpick,prosciutto,fennel seed,french bread,pork shoulder
title: Pork Roast Lovers With Cashews
ingredients: 2 lbs pork shoulder | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 8 ounces fresh cashews | 12 ounces prosciutto, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons grated fennel seeds | 30 pieces deep-dish french bread | toothpick
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°f using the tip of a sharp knife, cut off any top of the meat and trim off any visible fat. Score the meat on the scores you cut into the meat with a sharp knife. Reserve any fat in a bowl. To make the marinade, place the lemon and zest in the bowl of a food processor or blender with the lemon juice and the fennel seeds. Process to a paste. Add the cashews and 1/3 of the prosciutto slices. Process to a paste or pulse until combined. Spread the cashew mixture evenly all over the entire roast, followed by the marinade. Place the loaves in a roasting pan with enough room to catch the juice. Roast the loaves until they’re very tender and begin giving them a stir midway through the roast.

Random Ingredients: apple cider vinegar,bean sprout,thyme sprig,sake,eggplant,oatmeal,fish sauce,marsala wine
title: Baked Oatcakes With Eggplant, Marsala and Thyme
ingredients: 1 medium eggplant, large | 3 tablespoons chicken broth or 3 tablespoons wine | 4 tablespoons oatmeal | 2 tablespoons apple cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 2 tablespoons sake | 4 fresh thyme sprigs | 2 cups bean sprouts
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f and line 2 baking trays with parchment paper. Slice the eggplant in half lengthwise and then crosswise into 1/4 inch thick slices. Place eggplant in a colander and sprinkle evenly with salt. Let sit for 30 minutes or until softened and slightly softened. Pat dry with paper towels. Place the eggplant slices on the baking trays and bake at 350 for 12 minutes or until eggplant is softened and lightly browned. Transfer the eggplant to a cutting board and let sit 5 minutes. Then, using wet hands, tear the eggplant into small bits about the size of a large marble. Combine the broth or wine, oatmeal, vinegar, fish sauce and sake in a small saucepan and heat until it becomes a bit syrupy, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Line a cookie sheet with parchment paper. Place the eggplant in a baking tray and arrange the eggplant on the parchment. Bake at 350f for 30 minutes or until crispy and browned. To assemble, remove and discard the parchment paper, then spoon about 1 tablespoon of the eggplant in to the center of each piece of eggplant. Sprinkle with 1/4 ounce of the bean sprouts and 1/4 teaspoon of the thyme. Serve warm.

title: Fennel Salt
ingredients: 3 egg yolks, beaten | 1 teaspoon fennel seeds
instructions: Combine the egg yolks and fennel seeds in a bowl. Stir in the fennel salt. If using hot water, add the water gradually until the mixture is creamy. Chill several hours before using to prevent sticking.

title: Black Beans
ingredients: 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 3 cans black beans, drained and washed
instructions: Place the sugar and black beans into a large bowl. Add enough liquid to just cover the sugar. Leave to macerate for 1 hour, stirring regularly. Reheat over a low heat, but do not allow the liquid to boil.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,rump roast,phyllo pastry,egg substitute,lemon juice zest,mango chutney,sage
title: Slow Cooker Caribbean Lamb Sandwich (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 1)
ingredients: 400 g rump roast, trimmed of fat | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 40 g fat free lime gelatin or 40 g regular gelatin | 2/3 cup heavy whipping cream | 3 tablespoons mango chutney | 1 leaf sage, about 8 | 2 sheets phyllo pastry
instructions: Using a sharp knife, slice meat into short thin strips, then place them into a mixing bowl with lemon juice and the juice. Add the lime gelatin and stir well until it is dissolved. Stir in the cream. Place the beef strips in the crockpot, then add the mango chutney and sage. Pour mixture over the meat and cook on a low setting for 8 hours, or on high setting for 4 hours. Meanwhile, place the sheets of phyllo on a work surface or on baking parchment lined with parchment paper. Brush the tops with milk to moisten each sheet, then cut crosswise into 8 equal squares. Place a row of phyllo in the centre of the phyllo and brush with milk. Place 8 almond slivers between each row of pastry. Fold over the edges of the pastry and place on a baking tray. Repeat with all of the mixture to make 8 sandwiches and refrigerate for 30 minutes or until firm. Slice diagonally and serve accompanied with fresh fruit and chutney.

title: Quick and Easy Ham Salad
ingredients: 1/2 - 3/4 lb thinly sliced deli ham | 2 -3 tablespoons sambal oelek | 1 pinch of coarsely ground ginger | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon coriander powder or 1/2-3/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Put ham on top of ham and drizzle with some sambal over all. Add coriander. Mix lightly. Add pepper and ginger. Enjoy.

title: Steamed Pork With Mussel
ingredients: 500 g pork tenderloin | 2 tablespoons rice wine | 400 g mussels, cleaned and debearded
instructions: Score pork using a small piece of ginger. Place pork in a steaming basket. Place in freezer for 20 minutes, then remove from thawing. Cook mussels the same way on clean grill rack. Put mussels into steamer over boiling water. Add rice wine while mussels are coming to a boil. Cook until mussels open. Place mussels over steaming tray and steam for 4 minutes, or until the meat starts to split open.

title: Unstuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 tablespoon garlic, minced | 5 fresh cremini mushrooms | 1/2 cup meat, minced | 1/2 cup leek, minced | 1/4 cup pepperoni, minced | 2 cups mozzarella cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. In a large bowl, combine garlic, mushrooms, meat, leek, pepperoni and cheese. Reserve 1/2 cup cheese. Separate each mushroom cap from one end and remove stem to make a stem cap. Fill stems with mix. Set mushroom caps aside. Place reserved cheese on top of mushroom caps and wrap mushrooms around cheese. Place on a lightly greased piece of tin foil. Bake for 45 minutes.

title: Simple Cauliflower "crouton"
ingredients: 1 small cauliflower floret, chopped | 3/4 cup grated fresh celery seed | 1/2 teaspoon celery seed | 1/4 cup minced fresh chives
instructions: In a microwave safe bowl, combine cauliflower, celery seed, and chives. Microwave on high power for 1 minute. Stir to blend. Microwave on high for 60 seconds more. Serve with crackers or flatbread.

title: Easy Beef Goulash
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef | 2 teaspoons orange zest, minced | 2 teaspoons cilantro, dried
instructions: Trim all visible fat from beef. Slice meat into very thin strips about 1/2 to 3/4 wide and 1/4 thick. Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Cover and refrigerate overnight, stirring occasionally. Heat oven to 325 degrees. Uncover and bake, covered, for about 2 hour or until meat is tender. Stir occasionally.

title: Homemade Kiwi Chips
ingredients: 12 kiwi | 6 tablespoons bacon drippings | 1 package bacon shreaded with pao hsing sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Place 1 kiwi, 3 tablespoons bacon drippings and pao hsing sauce in a glass baking dish. Cover with water and bake for 30 minutes. Cut kiwi in half, remove seeds, then slice 1/4 inch thick. Drizzle with extra bacon drippings, drizzle with extra pane hsing sauce and use as needed. Bake for 15 more minutes, stirring the kiwi in between.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock,snow pea,burgundy wine,orzo pasta,taco seasoning,cognac
title: Orzo and Wine With Snow Peas and Cognac
ingredients: 1/2 lb orzo pasta | 1/2 cup chicken stock ( or a combo of broth ) or 1/2 cup beef broth | 1/2 teaspoon taco seasoning, divided ( mexican seasoning, can use other herbs ) | 3/4 lb fresh snow pea ( or 2 bags frozen peas ) | 1 tablespoon cognac
instructions: Cook pasta according to directions and drain. Return pasta to dutch oven, add chicken stock, 1/2 tsp of the taco seasoning and orzo all at once. Cover and heat until the orzo is creamy, but not boiling. Toss with cooked snow peas. Drizzle cognac. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: bailey irish cream,cream tartar,roasting chicken,soymilk,basmati rice,plum tomato
title: Creamy Chicken With Rice (Low Fat)
ingredients:
1/4 cup soymilk ( light may be substituted ) | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 roasting chickens | 1 cup basmati rice or 1 cup short-grain rice, cooked | 0.
    -5 can light plum tomatoes, roughly chopped | 1/2 cup biley irish cream
instructions: Bring all ingredients to boil in a large pot over medium heat. Lower to simmer, then cover and simmer for 5 minutes. Remove the chicken to a plate and discard the skin and bones. Using two forks, shred the chicken into strips about 1/2 inch wide and 1/2 inch long. Return the chicken to the pot along with the tomato mixture. Turn to coat. Serve either on top of the rice or on the side. Variation, for a variation, for a vegetarian option serve yogurt with the tomato & meat mixture on the side.

title: Hot Green Chile Relish -  Hot Green Chilies
ingredients: 4 -5 fresh green chili peppers or 8 -10 mild green chili peppers, chopped | 1 teaspoon dried dill, crumbled
instructions: Combine minced pepper, hot green chile and dill in bowl to blend. Cover and chill. Serve with crackers or fresh bread crumbs.

title: Sambocian Okra Salad With Eggs
ingredients: 1 eggplant, peeled and cut lengthwise into quarters | 1 medium head okra, trimmed | 1/2 cup tahini | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 teaspoon fresh ginger, grated or 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger
instructions: Preheat oven to 475°. Place eggplant halves on a foil lined baking sheet. Bake in oven until they are very tender and wrinkled, about 15 - 20 minutes. Cool. Remove the vegetables from the pan. When cool enough to handle, peel and cut into quarters. Arrange the pieces in a large salad bowl. Set aside. Slice okra into 1/4 inch slices. Add okra slices, tahini, oregano and ginger to the salad bowl. Toss until well blended. Cover with plastic wrap and chill until serving time. Enjoy.

title: Spicy Mexi-Fish
ingredients: 2 pounds tilapia fillets | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper, or to taste | 1 can mixed vegetables, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Arrange the tilapias in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Sprinkle with cayenne pepper, and dot with mixed vegetables. Bake in preheated oven for 15 minutes, until fish flakes easily with a fork.

title: Cherry Vinegar (German)
ingredients: 2 lbs whole celery, ends and strings removed | 1 bunch fresh parsley
instructions: Using a sharp knife, cut into 1 1/2 inch pieces. Place pieces in a stainless steel saucepan or dutch oven with a cover. Cover and cook over medium low heat until tender, about 11 hours. Add fresh parsley to pan. Cover and allow to cool, 3 hour longer.

title: Tortilla Chip Cookies
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1 package cream cheese, at room temperature | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa | 1 tablespoon distilled white vinegar | 9 ounces tortilla chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Mix baking soda and cream cheese together in a bowl. Combine cocoa and vinegar in a separate bowl.

title: Bifte De Queso - French Barbecue Style Sticky Biscuits (Guiness)
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 2 tablespoons dry sherry wine | 1/2 teaspoon coconut rum | 1 teaspoon fresh grated lemon zest | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin seed | 4 apricots, sliced or 1 cup dried apricot, finely chopped
instructions: Grind the soaked apricots finely with your hands, or mash in a mortar. Combine the minced lamb with the rum, lemon zest, ground cumin, and the soaked apricots. Form into patties that are 1 inch in diameter. Arrange on a lightly greased grill over a medium high heat. Cook for 15 to 18 minutes, turning once, or until cooked through. Remove from the grill, cover, and set aside. To serve, warm the barbecue for a few minutes, then place a patty on a chopping board and spread with some of the warmed rum/apricot sauce. Using a fork, poke holes all over the meat, about 1/2 inch deep. Spread a small coating of rum/apricot sauce over the top, then sprinkle with cumin & lemon zest.

Random Ingredients: plain yogurt,soymilk,tiger shrimp,pork roast,peanut butter,white wine vinegar,monterey jack cheddar cheese,chili pepper flake
title: Shrimp Stuffed Peppers
ingredients: 12 large fresh tiger shrimp | 1/4 cup plain yogurt | 1/4 cup soymilk | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons smooth peanut butter | 1/4 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 2 1/2 cups shredded monterey jack and cheddar cheese blend | 1/4 cup chopped dry roasted peanuts, for topping
instructions: Preheat the broiler to high. Rinse and pat the shrimp dry with paper towels. Cut the shrimp shells in half or thirds lengthwise. Rinse well and remove tails. Reserve shrimp heads. Place the shrimp heads, heads, and shells into an oiled baking dish. Bake shrimp for 3 minutes. Stir in yogurt, soy milk, vinegar, peanut butter and chili flakes, and mix well. Spoon about 1 1/2 tablespoons of mixture into each shrimp shell. Sprinkle each shrimp with 1 1/2 cups of the cheese blend. Broil shrimp for 4 minutes or until tops are hot and bubbly, 5 to 7 minutes.

Random Ingredients: italian prune plum,yellow cake mix,orange marmalade,nonfat milk powder,leg lamb,ranch dressing,cremini mushroom
title: Scotch Dried Beef or Chicken Bundt Cake and Gravy With Prunes
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless leg of lamb ( leg is very tender ) or 2 lbs goat meat ( leg is very tender ) | 1 package yellow cake mix or ( 14 ounce ) package white cake mix | 1/4 cup nonfat dry milk powder | 1/4 cup italian prune plum ( plum pickled plum pickled plums ) | 1/3 cup italian cremini mushroom ( coarsely chopped ) | 1/3 cup ranch dressing | 1/4 cup orange marmalade or 1/4 cup apricot preserves | 1/2 - 1 tablespoon nonfat dry milk powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 350ºf. Remove and discard giblets and very excess fat from leg of lamb, or goat and chop meat into about ½” cubes. In a large bowl combine lamb, cake mix, 1/4 cup dry milk powder, plum pickled plums, 1/3 cup ranch dressing, marmalade or preserves, and mix well until well combined. Arrange mixture in a well greased bundt cake pan that’s been sprayed well with pam cooking spray or pam. Spread evenly or lightly place in pan with a lid. Bake 55 - 60 minutes, or until firm and golden brown. Let cake cool, then remove the pan, and invert onto wax paper. Remove all excess oil that has hardened and place sliced potatoes, along with any leftover sauce, between layers of potato slices. To serve, spread the remainder of the sauce evenly over the top of the meat or potato to simulate a traditional american american american meal. Place remaining slices of bread over the top. Place the sliced bread on top of the meat or potato and pour the rest of the sauce over everything. Serve with more sliced country bread if you like.

Random Ingredients: noodle,xanthan gum,italian salad dressing,red wine vinegar
title: Homemade Noodles
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked noodles | 1/2 cup italian-style salad dressing | 3 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons xanthan gum
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. Drain. While noodles are still hot, add remaining ingredients and mix well.

Random Ingredients: white sesame seed,sesame oil,green bell pepper,lime juice,chicken wing,red food coloring
title: Grilled Thai Chicken Wings
ingredients: 6 chicken wings, separated at joint | 1 1/2 tablespoons light sesame oil | 2 1/2 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 2 1/2 tablespoons white sesame seeds | 1 teaspoon red food coloring ( optional ) | 2 1/2 teaspoons green bell peppers, finely chopped ( optional )
instructions: In a shallow ceramic dish or bowl, combine the sesame oil, lime juice and sesame seeds. Sprinkle the food coloring evenly over the bottom of the bowl and set aside for 10 - 15 minutes to allow the dark sesame flavor to develop. Preheat grill to medium heat. Using a pastry brush, lightly coat the wings with sesame and lime juice mixture and brush lightly with more of the sesame oil mixture. Grill over medium high heat, turning often, until chicken is lightly browned and cooked through, about 25 - 30 minutes. Remove from heat. Divide wings between 2 plates and spoon some of the dark chile sauce over. Serve warm. Suggested dippers, asian pickle, onion rings, fried green onion, pickled jalapeno's cut side of green onion. Thai basil, fresh basil or fresh mint leaves can be added to the chile sauce if desired.

title: Greek Olive Croquettes (Bread Machine)
ingredients: 2 cups whole pitted kalamata olives | 1 cup chopped fresh mint leaves | 1 teaspoon ground cloves ( optional ) | 2 1/2 cups all purpose white flour
instructions: Place all ingredients in the pan of a bread machine in the order specified. Select dough setting and start cooking. Form a small indentation in the lid of the bread machine. If you like to make walnut sized croquettes, line the indentations with saran wrap. Select basic or white bread dough crust settings. Cover dough. Wait five minutes before removing bread from bread machine. Let cool on a wire rack.

title: Sausages in Bacon Gravy
ingredients: 4 lbs country-style sausages | 1 tablespoon bacon drippings
instructions: In a large, heavy frypan over medium high heat, heat the bacon drippings. When almost smoking, season sausages with salt and pepper. Add to frypan. Cook, turning often with wire skimmer or tongs, until sausages are brown on all sides. Remove sausage and drain off all but 1 tablespoon fat. Cook about 8 minutes over medium heat. Serve in warm gravy.

Random Ingredients: egg yolk,marsala wine,vodka,xanthan gum,sherry,nut,cashew,lemon juice zest
title: Gluten Free Spritz
ingredients: 1/4 cup lemon juice, fresh | 1/4 cup dry sherry or 1/4 cup marsala wine | 2 large egg yolks | 1 dash xanthan gum | 5 tablespoons unsalted cashews, chopped | 1/2 cup chopped nuts ( optional ) | 1/2 cup vodka | chopped nuts, for garnishing
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Using a pastry brush or an oiled vegetable spreader, brush the bottom of a cupcake pan with olive oil or butter and set aside, but do not discard the oil. In a mixing bowl, thoroughly whisk together the lemon juice, dry sherry or marsala wine, egg yolks, and xanthan gum. If using nuts, add now. Spread in the pan in a circular motion, spreading evenly. Using your hands or an offset spatula, sprinkle cashews and nuts into the cream and pour over the gluten free cake. Sprinkle with a little lemon juice or other fragrance, then bake for 45 - 50 minutes, until tests done with a wooden pick. Allow to cool for 10 minutes before removing, cutting into pieces, and garnishing with chopped nuts, if desired.

Random Ingredients: whipping cream,potato starch,penne pasta,san marzano tomato,pecorino romano cheese,yoghurt,red potato,sun tomato
title: Pasta With Tomato, Sun-Dried Tomato, and Sun-Dried Tomato Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb penne pasta | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato | 1/4 cup pecorino romano cheese, shredded | 1 cup mozzarella cheese, shredded | 12 ounces diced red potatoes | 6 ounces diced fresh san marzano tomatoes | 1/2 cup whipping cream | 2 tablespoons potato starch
instructions: In a large saucepan, bring 4 quarts of water to a rolling boil. Add salt. Add pasta and cook for 13 to 16 minutes, until al dente.

title: Simple Oven Fried Chicken Tenders
ingredients: 1 chicken tenderloins | 12 slices french bread
instructions: Preheat your oven to 425°f place the tenderloins in a roaster with a lip size baking pan. Open up the bread slices and place on top of the chickens. Drizzle with butter from the pan to moisten. Place in the oven. Bake 20 minutes or until the bread is crispy and lightly browned.

title: Lentil & Poblano Stir Fry and Rice
ingredients: 1/2 cup wild rice | 1 cup lentils | 1/3 cup diced poblano pepper, strips | 2 garlic cloves, minced | 10 slices pepperoni | pepperoni, for garnish
instructions: Cook the wild rice according to the package directions. While rice is cooking, sauté pepperoni in the olive oil over medium high heat until slightly browned and softened. Add garlic and pepper strips and sauté for 2 minutes. Add the lentils and wild rice to the skillet. Pour mixture into a large serving dish and add pepperoni, sprinkle with fresh pepper and sliced pepperoni. Serve over rice.

title: Candy Roasted French Hoagies
ingredients: 10 hoagie rolls | 1 tablespoon red food coloring | 1 sprig rosemary
instructions: Slice rolls into 6 slices, lengthwise. Place on baking sheet. Sprinkle with food coloring. Bake at 225° for 10 to 15 minutes. Remove and slice each slice in half diagonally, and set aside. Place rosemary with about 2 tablespoons of the drippings, warm. Place halves between french toast and heat until liquid is syrupy. Place one slice on each warmed french toast, and put back into place. Repeat with other slice.

title: Green Beans With Brandy
ingredients: 15 ounces part-skim ricotta cheese | 1 package frozen green beans, thawed and drained | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 2 tablespoons brandy, for drizzling
instructions: Combine ricotta and green beans in a microwave safe bowl and sprinkle with cardamom. Microwave on high high, uncovered, on high power for 2 minutes. Stir and microwave on medium to medium low.

title: Chicken Paillards With Beer and Shrimp
ingredients:
1 bottle stout beer ( such as corona or tecate ) | 1 lb chicken, diced ( about 2 lbs.
    - ) | 1/4 lb shrimp ( peeled deveined ) | 1 cup stock | 1 can diced tomatoes ( drained canned is okay ) | 1 tablespoon pine nuts or 1 tablespoon chopped pecorino cheese | 1 lb large red seedless grapesfruit, halved
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the beer with about 2 tblsp. Of water, cover and let stand for 30 minutes. Meanwhile, cook the chicken in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat and cook just until lightly browned, stirring occasionally. Remove chicken and set aside. Add shrimp to the skillet and cook, stirring, until pink, about 1 minute. Pour off excess fat. Return chicken to the skillet with the beer and stock and cook and stir until the liquid is reduced by half. Add tomatoes and cook until slightly thickened. Return the shrimp to the skillet and sprinkle with cheese. Cook until cheese has melted and the shrimp are hot. Serve, passing grapefruit halves at the table.

title: Dumplings
ingredients: 1 cup sunflower seeds ( raw or raw ) | 1 cup rice flour ( available in oriental supermarkets ) | 2 -3 tablespoons water chestnuts | 3 -4 tablespoons water
instructions: Toast seeds in dry pan until they darken a little bit and pop. Remove. Chop and fry in a cup of hot water until it turns a nice brown color remove from pan and put on absorbent paper. When cool mix together flour and water until the consistency you like. Pour into your dumpling maker. Add water chestnuts and sunflower seeds. Let sit to drain when cool roll into small balls. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: bouquet garni,margarine,yellow bell pepper,pizza crust,ginger,breadcrumb,graham cracker
title: Gingerbread With Beef Strips(ATK)
ingredients: 1 pizza crust ( such as boboli ) | margarine, melted | 1/2 lb lean ground beef | 1/2 yellow bell pepper, seeded and cut into 6 slices longitudinally | 4 bouquet garni | 12 -15 graham crackers | 1 tablespoon grated fresh ginger | 1/4 cup fresh breadcrumb
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f or grill to medium high.

title: Almond Glazed Ginger Cookies
ingredients: 2 teaspoons ground gingernap cookies | 1 tablespoon margarine | 1 1/2 teaspoons almond extract | 2 tablespoons sliced almonds
instructions: Preheat the broiler or light your gas or electric oven. Break cookies into small chunks and drop them one by one into the melted butter or margarine, stirring and mixing with a wooden spoon to soften them. Remove cookies from the mixture and scatter the almonds over them. Place the cookies on an unprepared cookie sheet and drizzle with olive oil. Bake for 10 - 15 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach,strawberry,spice,wine vinegar,basil,thai peanut sauce,vegetable stock
title: Thai Spinach
ingredients: 1 kg baby spinach | 300 ml vegetable stock | 300 g thai peanut sauce | 1 tablespoon vietnamese mixed spice | 3 slices fresh basil or 1 teaspoon dried basil | 3 -4 fresh thai strawberries, for garnishing ( optional ) | 100 -150 ml wine vinegar ( or any other type you prefer )
instructions: Wash and dry spinach. Using a salad spinner, remove the outer layers of the spinach, trim off the stem and set aside. Heat a large saucepan, add stock and stir in peanut sauce. Add the mixed spice vietnamese season to the heated stock with the basil and thai basil, bring to the boil and then lower the heat and simmer for 5 minutes. Spoon mixture into serving bowls and top with strawberries if serving, add more lemon and vinegar. Serves.

title: Cheese Board Rice
ingredients: 1 lb rice | 1 tablespoon cherryvil, chopped | 1 tablespoon barbeca hot sauce | 2 tablespoons parmigiano-reggiano cheese, freshly grated
instructions: Boil 4 cups of water, add rice and stir. When it starts to boil, add barbeque sauce, stir, and remove from heat. Let sit for several minutes to draw out any excess water. Put rice in an 8 inch square dish and top with parmesan shavings, stirring until combined. Store in fridge. To serve, top with some sauce or green olives if desired.

title: Soy and Smoked Chicken on the Barbie
ingredients:
6 boneless skinless chicken halves | 2 tablespoons sweet paprika | 1/4 - 1/3 cup mirin ( sweet rice wine or japanese cooking wine.
    - mild, not sweet.
    - ) | 12 ounces kale or 12 ounces spinach, cleaned and finely chopped | 2 -4 jalapenos, finely chopped | 1/3 cup pitted black olives, chopped ( optional ) | 3/4 cup red grape | 3 firm ripe bananas, peeled and sliced and placed on skewers
instructions: Mix the paprika, mirin and enough water to give you 1/4 cup. Add the remaining ingredients and marinate the chicken in it for at least 3 hours in the refrigerator. Heat your grill or grill pan at very high heat and add the chicken. Grill for 3 to 3 1/2 minutes, or until chicken is no longer pink inside and the juices run clear. During this time remove the chicken to a serving dish. When ready to serve, remove the grilled breasts from the skewers and arrange on top, leaving about 1/2 inch of fat on each. If you need the sauce for a sweeter finish, remove all the bones and other pieces of fat. Serve with rice.

title: Slow Cooker Beef Skewers
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds cubed beef stew meat | 8 bamboo skewers
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium heat.

title: Faux Beurrego Nibbles
ingredients: 1 package macaroni | 1 can beef stock | 1/4 cup liquid honey | 1/4 cup apricot nectar | 1/4 cup chopped pecans
instructions: Boil macaroni until al dente. Drain and rinse in cold water. Combine beef stock and honey in large pot. Add macaroni and nuts. Add nectar and simmer until macaroni is tender.

title: Duck Wrapped Basted in Phyllo With Avocados
ingredients: 9 ounces duck fat or 9 ounces duck fat, melted | 10 ounces corn kernels, drained | 6 ounces phyllo pastry, thawed | 1 fresh rosemary, sprigs | 1 large hass avocado, cut in half & pitted | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Set oven to 425°f. In a mixing bowl, combine the duck fat with 1 teaspoon of water, beat in corn, then add the phyllo pastry. Sprinkle the rosemary leaves into the phyllo pastry & brush them with some water to soften and to coat. Lay a piece of aluminum foil over the phyllo pastry, then place on a sheet of parchment paper & spray it with water. Fold the parchment in half making a half moon roll, then transfer your pastry circle to the foil & fold it over the entire length of the foil to form a half moon shape. Brush with some of the duck fat & bake in the oven for about 25 minutes, before testing its doneness by touching the middle. It should rise to the top by the time it's done as it should shrink back in volume when tested with a fork, this should be expected.

Random Ingredients: bow tie pasta,tortilla,orange juice,beef mince,barbecue sauce,whipping cream
title: Beef Mince and Pasta Bake
ingredients: 500 g beef mince | 1 1/2 cups bottled barbecue sauce | 1/4 cup orange juice | 3 1/2 cups bow tie pasta, cooked | 1/2 cup whipping cream | 1/2 cup sour cream | tortilla, to serve
instructions: Combine mince and barbecue sauce in a frypan. Stir over high heat until meat is browned. Add 3/4 cup orange juice and bring to the boil. Stir in pasta and cook over high heat for 3 - 4 minutes or until pasta is cooked. Divide mince between two 8 cup capacity ovenproof serving dishes. Drizzle with remaining orange juice. To serve, top with cream. To serve, add sour cream.

title: Green Enchilada Sauce (Tamarind Dip)
ingredients: 1 can green enchilada sauce, medium hot | 1/4 cup frozen tamarind paste, thawed | 1 tablespoon roasted garlic, minced | 2 cups canned mexicorn, drained | 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: Heat the oven to 350 degrees. Transfer 1/2 cup of the enchilada sauce to a small baking dish. Toss in the tamarind paste, garlic, chopped mexicorn, and salt. Roast the enchilada sauce in the oven until thickened, about 20 minutes. Transfer to a food processor, and process until smooth. Serve the enchilada sauce over warm tortillas with your favorite toppings such as sour cream and guacamole.

title: Salsa Ranchero
ingredients: 8 ounces tortilla chips, slightly broken into quarters | 4 roma tomatoes, roughly chopped | 2 tablespoons almonds, ground
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together in a bowl and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: yeast,apple,queso fresco,gouda cheese,kaffir lime leaf,cherry tomato
title: Cheesy Baked Pizza
ingredients: 10 lbs pizza dough | 4 lbs grated gouda cheese | 2 lbs grated grated grana padano cheese | 1 box yeast | 2 lbs cherry tomatoes | 7 -10 saffron limes, zested and juiced
instructions: Prepare the dough by mixing all ingredients thoroughly together in a large bowl. Dip pizza crust into flour, then turn dough onto pizza pan that has been greaseed, greased and buttered. Place in oven. You will have about 1 hour to bake the pizza, so check it after 30 minutes or so. Check that the crust is not burning, it should be. The crust should be medium brown. Remove it from the oven and spread out onto a pizza pan. Bake in a 375 degree oven at about 550 degrees for about 20 minute. Remove from oven when crust is nicely browned and crispy. Top with toppings from your choice. I use the salsa, sour cream, guacamole, avocados and cheese for a twist. Note that i never add the cheese directly to the hot pizza, i always add it, just because i love the way the gouda and gouda cheese is packed. If you like things more hot, add more of the tomato sauce. This recipe is quite easy to make and it goes well with fried and baked fish or vegetables, especially shrimp as a starter.

title: Caribbean Green Chili
ingredients: 8 ounces smoked pork shoulder | 1 green chili peppers or 1 red birdseye chili | 1 -2 ounce salmon ( optional ) or 1 -2 tablespoon other thick fish sauce ( optional )
instructions: Take the smoked pork loin and slit it up to use as a wrap for the salmon or fish. Take all the seeds out of the chili or birdseye. Take some of the white part of the chili or birdseye and slice thinly. Place these slices inside the slit in the pork. Add the green chili pepper or other thick fish sauce. Cover and set aside for 20 - 30 minutes. Strain. Serve with white rice and hot pita bread. Also nice to do with yogurt.

Random Ingredients: plain soymilk,dijon mustard,marsala wine,goose,tomato juice,dark soy sauce,bell pepper,cocoa powder
title: Creamy Roast Veggie Burgers
ingredients: 3 -5 lbs small whole-wheat wild rice burgers | 1 can tomato juice | 1 1/2 cups soymilk | 4 tablespoons unsweetened dutch-processed cocoa powder | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1/2 cup dry marsala wine ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1/4 cup chopped bell pepper ( optional )
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the tomato juice, soymilk, cocoa powder, mustard, marsala, soy sauce, and pepper. Place beef burgers on racks, fat side up, in a baking pan or crock. Pour tomato mixture over beef. Cover and chill. Preheat oven to 325 degrees fahrenheit. Bake in a 350 degree fahrenheit oven for about 1 hour or until browned. Be sure to turn them halfway through until they’ve internal temperature reaches 160 degrees fahrenheit. During this time remove cover and stir up any browned bits from bowl. When done, allow them to sit for a few minutes. You are finished. Serve on buns or rolls.

title: Tortilla Soup - Easy!
ingredients: 16 ounces cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup brown sugar | 1 box penne, cooked and drained | 16 corn tortillas
instructions: Add cream of chicken soup, brown sugar and corn tortilla to a large pot and heat on low until simmering. Eat.

title: Spinach Chapati
ingredients: 3 cups uncooked white rice | 1 cup spinach, washed, trimmed and chopped | 1/4 cup hot water | 1 tablespoon whole wheat flour
instructions: Heat wok over medium high. Add 3/4 cup water. When water begins to boil, add rice. Cover and bring to boil. Lower heat to medium. Cook until water is absorbed, about 10 minutes. Fluff with fork and let cool to room temperature. When cool, knead dough well for 4 - 5 minutes. Divide dough into 16 equal portions. Shape rounds according to desired size. Cut each round on 1/2 inch wide side to form rounds. Spread 1 tablespoon flour on each round. Arrange 1 - 2 chapati on lightly oiled cookie sheet. Sprinkle lightly with salt. Cook Chapati in hot water to soften, 3 - 5 minutes on each side or until lightly browned. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: pie crust,turkey sausage,creme fraiche,almond extract,chicken wing,pie shell,white vinegar
title: Dynamite Meat Pie
ingredients: 4 ounces turkey sausage ( hot or sweet ) | 2 cups creme fraiche, plus a dollop of creme fraiche for sprinkling | 1 teaspoon white vinegar ( or to taste ) | 1 pinch almond extract | 2 tablespoons finely chopped blanched almonds (, toasted if you prefer ) or 2 tablespoons finely chopped walnuts ( toasted if you prefer ) | 1 ready-made pie shell, and | 3 -4 whole chicken wings, separated and washed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Slice the turkey sausage into 1 inch slices. Mix the creme fraiche, vinegar and almond extract. Spoon the mixture into the pie shell. Arrange the chicken wings at the top. Pour the hot chicken juices and almond extract all over the meat, placing the nuts or walnuts on top. Bake for 30 minutes and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,margarine,chili oil,cumin seed,philadelphia cream cheese
title: Crispy Cumin-Crusted Dip
ingredients: 1 package philadelphia cream cheese | 1 tablespoon margarine | 1/4 teaspoon ground cumin seed | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1 -2 tablespoon chili oil, depending on what strength and heat you like
instructions: In a small bowl, add one teaspoon of margarine, one teaspoon of cumin seeds, one teaspoon of crushed red pepper and chili oil. Mix well with a fork or spoon. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate. This is a dip for tortilla chips or as a topping for veggies, meats, etc. This dip may become a little more or less thin.

title: Sicilian-Style Peas
ingredients:
1 lb fresh yellow pea, cleaned | 0.
    -5 can sweet basil or 8 leaves, washed | 1 bottle catsup | 5 tablespoons crumbled italian bread | 2 tablespoons cocoa, sifted | frangelico, sauce or brandy, for garnish
instructions: Rinse the peas and snap them into pieces. Combine the beans, 1 tablespoon basil, catsup and bread crumbs. Line a roasting pan with waxed paper. Spread the beans evenly into the roasting pan. Add enough crumbs to absorb the liquid from the can. Cover pan and bake on middle rack of oven for 2 - 3 hours, or until the peas are tender.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach,sharp cheddar cheese,tomato juice,fish fillet,hamburger,arugula,lamb
title: Lamb and Steak Stew
ingredients: 500 g lamb ( trimmed of fat, cut into 3cm cubes ) | 350 g sandwich steaks ( trimmed of fat, cut into 4cm cubes ) | 50 g baby arugula | 100 g baby spinach | 50 g steakhouse processed cheese ( such as kraft singles brand ) | 140 ml tomato juice | 50 g baby mountain mountain arugula
instructions: Heat a large non stick pan and add the lamb and cook until browned on all sides, but not cooked through. Add the steaks and fry for 3 - 4 minutes, adding a dusting of sea salt and some freshly ground black pepper, to season. Add the spinach, arugula and tomato juices and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes until the greens are just wilted. Serve either in the rolls with the burger, with extra tomato sauce or just by itself with boiled orzo.

Random Ingredients: tomato paste,mozzarella cheese,coconut milk,red bell pepper,picante sauce,orange,brown rice,lemon pepper
title: Pork & Rice
ingredients: 2 cups rice, raw | 2 cups coconut milk | 1 cup tomato paste | 1 red bell pepper, diced | 1 lemon pepper, diced | 1 orange, sliced | 1 1/2 cups mozzarella cheese, shredded | 1/4 cup picante sauce ( optional )
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. While rice is cooking, combine red bell pepper, lemon pepper & orange juice in a food processor or blender. Process until combined. Add the rice & mix well. Add the tomato paste & coconut milk, mix well & simmer for a few minutes. Pour sauce onto a serving platter, top with mozzarella cheese & continue cooking at serving temperature.

title: Chile Flowers
ingredients: 2 -6 canned chipotle chiles | 1 head lettuce, shredded | 1 teaspoon margarine
instructions: In a blender, puree the chipotles with the chiles, then spread onto a large platter. Decorate the platter with the lettuce. Cut the slashes into the lettuce to resemble flowers.

title: Thai Chile Asparagus Skewers
ingredients: 1 lb asparagus ( fresh or frozen ) | 1 cup coconut milk ( unsweetened or low-fat ) | 2 teaspoons finely chopped thyme | 1 jalapeno, seeded and finely chopped ( optional, remove seeds if desired )
instructions: Cut each piece of asparagus in half lengthwise. Cut on the diagonal into 1/8 inch slices. Thread about 5 pieces onto each skewer and set aside. If using frozen asparagus, place in a microwave safe bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Microwave on high for about 7 minutes to thaw. Remove plastic wrap. Stir coconut milk into coconut milk mixture on high. Add thyme. Skewer about 1/2 cup pieces onto each skewer. Place skewers on a dish, cover, and marinate at least 2 hours, or overnight. Skewer the asparagus pieces onto metal or bamboo skewers set bamboo skewers aside. Cook over a hot grill plate for about 2 minutes each side. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: annatto seed,ginger paste,monterey jack cheddar cheese,pillsbury pizza dough,vinegar,cream mushroom soup
title: Pizzas
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vinegar | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 teaspoon ginger paste | 1 -2 tablespoon instant minced garlic ( according to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon crushed annatto seeds | 12 inches pizza dough, at room temperature | 4 ounces monterey jack and cheddar cheese blend
instructions: Combine the cream of mushroom soup, ginger paste, garlic and annatto seeds in a small bowl. Cover and refrigerate until ready to use. Roll pizza dough out on a lightly floured surface. Transfer the dough to a pizza pan, stretching it and leaving about an inch on one side. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Arrange the pizza crust on the pizza pan. Spread the soup mixture evenly over the dough, leaving about an inch of the crust exposed at one edge.

Random Ingredients: cake flour,cornflour,italian salad dressing,basil,apple juice,artichoke heart,matzo cracker
title: Apple and Artichoke Rounds on Matzoh
ingredients: 8 matzoh crackers | 1 1/3 cups cake flour | 1/2 cup cornflour | 1/2 cup fresh italian salad dressing | 1/3 cup apple juice | 3/4 cup apple juice | 3/4 cup basil
instructions: Combine the dry ingredients and mix to make the crusts into 4 squares on a greased pan. Spread 2/3 of the crust mixture on each square. Sprinkle 1/2 of the basil on top. Mix together the 2 apples and sauce and pour half over all in the crust layer. Spread the other half of the crust mixture. Sprinkle the remaining basil on top. Cover with foil and let rest for 15 - 20 minutes while you preheat the oven. Bake for 13 - 15 minutes.

title: Apple Leeks
ingredients: 4 tablespoons olive oil | 2 tablespoons taco seasoning mix, divided | 1 lb leek, chopped | 1 apple, cored and sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f degrees. In a pot heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil and add the taco seasoning mix. Cook until the bottom is covered. Add in leeks and apple, stirring to cover all in the olive oil. Transfer mixture to a jellyroll pan and bake for 15 - 20 minutes until brown and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: espresso coffee,peach schnapps,shortening,cumin seed,salmon fillet,apricot,flax seed,onion
title: Coffee-Crusted Salmon With Apricot Glaze
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried apricot | 1/2 cup dried apricot | 24 ounces salmon fillets | 1 tablespoon cumin seed | 1 1/2 tablespoons flax seeds, toasted | 3 tablespoons shortening | 3 tablespoons espresso coffee | 3 tablespoons peaches schnapps | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon instant espresso coffee | 1 medium onion, finely chopped
instructions: Toast the cumin seeds in a dry skillet over medium heat, shaking and stirring to toast evenly, for about 2 minutes or until fragrant. Grind cumin seeds in mortar and pestle or coffee grinder. Grind flax seeds in coffee grinder to coarse powder. Coat salmon fillets with cumin powder and drizzle over apricots. Cover and put in the refrigerator overnite. Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Place apricots in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Drizzle with 1 tablespoon each glaze. Sprinkle with cumin. For the glaze, in a small heavy skillet, melt together shortening. Stir in remaining glaze. Bake for 10 minutes then turn fillets over and bake for an additional 10 minutes. The salmon should have a nice, golden color and the apricots soft. Top with a drizzle of glaze.

title: Roast Pork Lasagna
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs large raw pork shoulder | 1 can lasagna noodles, drained | 2 packages small raw shrimp ( frozen ) | 5 -6 lbs raw sea scallops, rinsed | 1 eggplant
instructions: Place pork shoulder in bottom of large pot and pour 1/2 of water into the bottom. Bring water up to a boil, and add lasagna noodles, shrimp and scallops. Simmer 3 hours, skimming off scum as needed. Add eggplant and remaining 2/3 of water. Simmer 30 - 45 minutes longer, until pork is cooked through. Let cool 10 - 15 minutes. Slice crosswise into thin slices. Add salt to taste and serve with your favorite sauce.

Random Ingredients: herb stuffing mix,prune,chickpea flour,cardamom,italian dressing,parsnip,green decorator sugar,pecorino romano cheese
title: Giant Parsnips With Prunes
ingredients: 1 large parsnip | 1 package herb stuffing mix ( you can use all prunes, but the stuffing mixes better ) | 4 -5 -6 small pitted prunes | 1/2 cup good quality italian dressing | 4 -6 green decorator sugar, finely granulated sugar | 1/2 cup finely grated pecorino romano cheese or 1/2 cup pecorino cheese | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: Peel the parsnip, cut apart at the stem, and set aside. Place the stuffing mix in the food processor and blend until well blended... Cut pears into thin wedges and place in large mixing bowl. Fill parsnips with stuffing mix. Add prunes. Add pecorino, romano cheese, and cardamom. Fold all gently to combine, and refrigerate for several hours for flavors to develop. Enjoy.

title: Sausage Patties
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sausage | 1 cup bread flour | 1 teaspoon salt | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 3 -4 slices of your favorite bread, torn ( optional ) | 1/2 - 1 1/2-1 fresh jalapeno chile, sliced ( optional ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Mix all ingredients in food processor. Roll into small patties about 3 1/2 in diameter. Bake on a greased griddle or frying pan on low heat. Flip patties after 5 minutes, and cook the second side until browned.

Random Ingredients: brandy,rye bread,herb,ginger garlic paste,saffron,yellow squash,white cheddar cheese,red bell pepper
title: Gramma's Absurd Grilled Yellow Squash
ingredients: 2 large yellow squash, about 3/4-1 inch thick | 1/4 - 1/2 cup brandy ( i like bertolli extra virgin ) | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1/4 cup grated white cheddar cheese ( optional ) | 1 pinch saffron | 1 teaspoon dried herbs | 1/3 - 1/2 cup coarsely grated yellow squash or 1/3-1/2 cup red bell pepper
instructions: Cut squash in 6ths lengthwise. Score each slice in a diamond pattern with sharp knife. Place seeds in a ziploc bag and add brandy to baggie. Shake to mix and coat squash. Let marinate while you preheat grill. Combine spices to form a paste. Reserve 1 teaspoon spice mixture for saffron glaze. Remove squash from marinade and place on a rack in an uncovered broilerproof pan. Brush squash with bbq sauce and grill, grill marks, and remove. Brush squash with oil and grill another couple of minutes, turning once. Brush with reserved spice mixture. Grill for an additional 5 to 10 minutes or until tender. Remove from grill, spread grated cheese on top, and serve.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,zucchini,beef stew meat,black olive
title: Quick Italian Chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds boneless, skinless chicken breast halves - cut into bite-size pieces | 1 can sliced black olives, drained | 1 zucchini, chopped | 1 can beef stew meat
instructions: In a slow cooker combine the chicken, olives, zucchini and stew beef. Cover and cook on medium high setting until the meat is no longer pink and the vegetables are beginning to soften, about 6 hours.

Random Ingredients: stewing beef,ramen noodle,rotini pasta,crouton,red chilies,saffron thread,sauce,date
title: Quick and Easy Beef Ramen Soup (With Saffron)
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef ( i like to use leftover cubed ) | 1 package ramen noodles, broken ( reserve seasoning packet ) | 8 ounces red chilies | 1/2 cup dates, chopped | 1/4 cup saffron thread | 2 tablespoons hot sauce ( such as tabasco ) | 1/2 cup coarse crushed seasoned croutons | additional ramen noodles or other crouton, to top ( optional )
instructions: Bring beef and seasoning packet to boil & simmer for about 3 - 5 minutes, then add broken ramen noodles to beef. Simmer for 3 - 5 minutes for best flavor. Add red chilies, dates, saffron threads, hot sauce, & croutons as directed on packet. Simmer for 5 minutes longer.

Random Ingredients: herring,allspice berry,bean pork,port wine,xanthan gum,raspberry,sugar cube
title: Portuguese Beans, Pickles and Raspberries
ingredients: 8 ounces port wine | 1 tablespoon sugar cube | 1/2 teaspoon herring | 1/8 teaspoon oregano ( herring is used in place of oregano in latin american mix ) | 1/8 teaspoon allspice berry ( myglantine ) | 2 ounces raspberries or 2 ounces blackberry | seedless raspberry | 3 ounces beans, pickled in juice ( fresh or canned, such as pigeon peas )
instructions: Place port, sugar, herring, oregano, allspice and raspberries in blender. Blend until almost a paste, adding more sugar to produce a smooth paste. Cut berries in half and add to blender. Blend until mixed thoroughly. Spoon into small glasses and top with blackberry halves and berries. Serve immediately.

title: Quick and Easy Chicken Wings
ingredients: 8 ounces chicken wings, tips discarded | 12 jalapeno peppers, sliced and seeded | 1/2 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Lay wings in a large dish on the counter. Using a sharp knife, carefully cut deep pockets lengthwise to within 1/2 of the center of each wing. Separate into 2 pieces. Place each one half on top of a separate piece of parchment paper. Brush top of the dough with water to keep it from drying out. Place 1/8 of a jalapeno pepper inside each piece. Using the back edge of paper as a helpful tool, roll each piece of chicken back to its point. Place each piece of chicken on a lightly greased cookie sheet. Sprinkle with cheddar cheese. Bake in the preheated oven until golden, 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Sweet Bell Pepper Condiment
ingredients: 2 red peppers, seeds removed and membrane shredded | 1 can yellow bell peppers
instructions: Place the yellow bell peppers and shredded pepper cheese in a food processor and puree until smooth, adding water as necessary or until the mixture reaches the desired consistency. Transfer to a storage container, cover and refrigerate until the peppers are chilled, up to a month.

Random Ingredients: salt,simple syrup,mint,wine vinegar,onion flake,liqueur,red leaf lettuce,tahini
title: Tahini Dressing
ingredients:
1/4 cup simple syrup | 1/4 cup red leaf lettuce ( can use any green leaf lettuce ) | 1/4 cup red leaf lettuce ( can use any green leaf lettuce ) | 1 tablespoon dried onion flakes | 1 tablespoon tahini | 1 tablespoon wine vinegar | 1/2 tablespoon instant powdered drink and alcohol ( e.
    -g.
    - sprite ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried mint
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Cover and shake to combine.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,pancetta,large curd cottage cheese,grapefruit
title: Pancetta Cheese Pate
ingredients: 1 1/2 ounces bacon, chopped into small pieces | 8 ounces large curd cottage cheese | 1 grapefruit, peel left on | 6 -12 kaffir lime leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Cook bacon in frypan until starting to brown in color. Remove from heat and add cottage cheese and lime peel. Stir until mixture is smooth and creamy. Add the pate to a plate and garnish with grapefruit slices and the kaffir lime leaves. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,pork loin,red pepper flake,hard egg,lamb,tortilla chip,basmati rice
title: Empanadas a la Huancaina
ingredients: 1 kg ground lamb | 350 g ground pork loin | 4 tablespoons red pepper flakes | 500 g basmati rice | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 4 hard-boiled eggs, chopped | tortilla chips, to serve
instructions: In a hot pan brown lamb and pork, drain excess fat and set aside. In a pan heat soup, egg and pepper flakes and stir in rice. Cover and simmer for 10 - 15 minutes until rice is soft. Stir mixture well. Set a colander inside a mixing bowl and pour mixture into it, pressing down well with a spoon. Cover the bowl with a cloth towel and leave the mixture inside to drain liquid out. Heat a small amount of oil in a pan and add drained rice mixture. Sauté well until rice is golden and rice is heated through. Place filling on top of rice and roll up. Serve with chips.

title: Harry Potter's Chocolate Shake (With Chicken)
ingredients: 600 ml chicken stock or 600 ml vegetable stock | 1 litre chocolate ice cream
instructions: Put stock into a jug and heat in a roiling pan set to high. Add the ice cream to the boiling stock and then the chocolate. Mix well with a wire whisk and pour into a chilled jug. Alternatively, for a more colourful effect, melt the ice cream into the chocolate and serve right away.

title: Sesame Oil Dip-Dipping Frites from Mali
ingredients: 100 g palm sugar | 200 g fresh parsley leaves | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil
instructions: Put the palm sugar, chopped parsley leaves and dark sesame oil into a bowl and mix well. Dip the frites first in the oil and then in the sugar mixture and then dip again in the oil and sugar mixture. Serve when cool before sprinkling with grated pecorino romano cheese if desired. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning,fine sea salt,sun tomato,asparagus spear,thyme leaf,garlic salt,nutmeg
title: Roasted Asparagus for One
ingredients: 1 pound fresh asparagus spears, tough ends snapped off and stems cut into 1 inch pieces | 2 tablespoons taco seasoning | 1/8 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1/8 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 1/8 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/8 teaspoon dried sun-dried tomatoes | 1/8 teaspoon fine sea salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and spray with oil. Place the asparagus into a large resealable plastic bag, sprinkle with taco seasoning, nutmeg, thyme, garlic salt, sun dried tomatoes and sea salt. Seal bag, and shake to mix. Place bag onto the prepared baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until asparagus is tender, about 8 minutes.

title: Crock Pot French Onion Soup
ingredients: 5 large onions | 3 tablespoons corn oil | 1 teaspoon beef bouillon granules | 2 tablespoons sour cream
instructions: Slice the onions, and place into slow cooker or crock pot. Sprinkle with the beef bullion granules, and mix thoroughly. Add the sour cream. Put the lid back on, set to low, and cook 8 to 10 hours.

Random Ingredients: belgian endive,beef,sea salt,hoisin sauce,strawberry,green chile,mango chutney,chicken stock cube
title: Endive, Mango and Beef Kebabs With Mango Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 700 g beef, cut into 1 inch cubes | 2 tablespoons hoisin sauce | 1 chicken stock cube | 100 g belgian endive, leaves only, halved lengthways and halved | 50 g strawberries, thinly sliced | 2 green chile, halved lengthways and deseeded, thinly sliced | mango chutney, to serve | sea salt, to taste
instructions: In a glass or ceramic dish, toss all ingredients. Add beef and turn to coat. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour or up to 4 hours. Thread beef onto skewers using endive. Grill for 4 - 5 minutes each side or until cooked to taste.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning mix,ice cube,herb,fajita seasoning mix,red curry paste
title: Super Easy Fiesta Dip
ingredients: 1 packet fajita seasoning mix | 1 packet taco seasoning mix | 1 packet red curry paste | 1 bottle ice cubes, crushed | 1 tablespoon mixed herbs
instructions: Mix your fajita seasoning packet and taco seasoning mix in a large bowl. Dump in your crushed ice and add your curry paste and mixed herbs. Mix together and enjoy.

title: Chile Colorado
ingredients: 3 pounds beef stew meat, cubed | 2 cans or bottles refrigerated biscuits | 1 1/2 teaspoons chile powder, or to taste
instructions: Place stew meat and biscuits in a large pot and cover with water.

Random Ingredients: raisin,beef bouillon,adobo seasoning,hamburger,chicken bouillon cube,beef stock,asparagus,marinara sauce
title: Authentic Guisado (Guisado)
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 2 1/3 cups asparagus, peeled and diced | 1 beef bouillon | 2 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon or 2 tablespoons beef consomme | 1 teaspoon minced marinara sauce | 1 teaspoon adobo seasoning | 2 cups beef stock | 1 cup raisins ( optional )
instructions: Brown hamburger with asparagus. Add rest of ingredients except raisins. Simmer over low heat for 20 minutes.

title: Crock Pot Caserole
ingredients: 1/2 cup sweetened cider vinegar | 1/4 cup golden syrup | 1/4 cup mexican oregano ( i use mexican oregano ) | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 2 celery ribs, diced | 2 lbs cheese, grated
instructions: Combine vinegar, syrup, oregano, cornstarch, celery, and cheese in crock pot, stir well. Cook on low 6 - 8 hours, enjoy.

Random Ingredients: shallot,greek yogurt,chili oil,fusion liqueur,double cream,white breadcrumb
title: Greek Yogurt With Chimichurri Dressing
ingredients: 150 g plain white breadcrumbs | 75 g greek yogurt | 150 g fusion liqueur, chilled | 300 ml double cream | 1 teaspoon chili oil | 2 shallots, finely chopped | extra fyi chili oil
instructions: In a food processor, pulse the breadcrumbs with the greek yoghurt until mixed. Spoon into a well buttered shallow dish. Cover and refrigerate until needed or up to 1 day ahead. Beat the cream and chilli oil together with a fork in a bowl until just combined. Add the shallots, chilli oil and cream, and fold through. Lift individual portions of the breadcrumb mixture onto the chilled breadcrumb mixture, and sprinkle with extra fyi chili oil, to finish.

title: Spicy Scallops  With Almond Vinaigrette
ingredients: 6 slices bacon, sliced into 1 inch pieces ( bacon bits are particularly flavorful in this recipe, but you can use a tablespoon, or a bit of bacon grease ) | 12 scallops ( fresh or thawed ) | 3 tablespoons fresh cilantro, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 1 -2 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 -2 tablespoon dry sweet wine vinegar
instructions: Cook the bacon pieces over medium heat until crispy. Take care not to burn them. When browned, remove them. Drain the bacon fat and place the fat in a medium pan. Place the drained scallops into the hot fat and cook over medium high heat until just cooked through, about 3 - 5 minutes. Remove them and coat with the cilantro and season with salt. Add almond extract. Serve on top of the bacon on the side, or in the center of your dinner.

title: Yummy Easy Tomato Phyllo Rolls
ingredients:
12 sheets phyllo dough | 2 cups nonfat milk ( approx.
    -, skim only ) | 2 cups tomato juice ( approx.
    - to juice the tomatoes )
instructions: Prepare the filling either by mixing the tomato juice with the juice the juice or by bringing it to a boil over a medium heat. Reduce the heat to very low and simmer gently, uncovered for about 20 minutes. Let cool for about 1 hour. Prepare the rest of the pastry for the rolls. Dip a spoon or pastry brush into the milk, then lightly coat the sheets with it using a pastry brush. Place about 2 tablespoons of filling about 4 inches from one end of each sheet of pastry.
