Roll up and place over 1/4 cup of tomato paste diluted with water. Brush pastries seam side down on a buttered baking sheet. Bake at 375 degrees f for about 15 to 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: dark creme de cacao,saffron thread,pizza sauce
title: Pizza Margherita
ingredients: 7 cups bottled pizza sauce | 1/2 teaspoon saffron threads | 1 ounce dark creme de cacao
instructions: In a small saucepan, add saffron and bring to boil for about 10 to 15 second, or until the saffron is fragrant. Allow to cool, then crush with a mortar and pestle. Reserve 1 cup for topping and store remaining saffron in a plastic storage bag. Combine the rest of the pizza sauce ingredients in a microwave safe bowl or rimmed glass pitcher. Cook on high in the microwave, uncovered, in 30 second increments, stirring after 4 minutes, or until heated through, about 1 minute. Strain cooled saffron into a cup. Dip 1/3 cup of the hot pizza sauce into the reserved pizza sauce. Place 1 - 2 tablespoons of the crumb topping mix into each of the 4 margarita glasses. Use up 1/3 of the crumbs and top with 1 tablespoon of the paprika topping mix. Garnish with remaining crumb topping mix. Serve immediately.

title: Wild Rice With Fettuccine and Peas
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups wild rice, rinsed and drained | 1 package frozen peas, thawed | 1 package instant fettuccine | 3/4 cup shredded carrot ( about 3 medium carrots )
instructions: Prepare wild rice according to package directions and keep warm. Boil peas separately in salted water until softened, then drain. Rinse and drain fettuccine, then return peas and noodles to the hot pot. Meanwhile, cook carrots in water to cover for about 5 minutes. Drain. Toss with the cooked rice, vegetables and carrot. Garnish with additional cheese on the top.

Random Ingredients: cream tartar,grain rice,double cream,pork loin roast
title: Oven-Fried Pork and Rice
ingredients: 1 pork loin roast | 1 1/4 lbs short-grain rice | 1 tablespoon cream of tartar | double cream, to top
instructions: Prick the roast with a sharp knife, trim the fat if necessary, then tie it into 8 equal pieces. Put the roast into the bottom of a roasting tin and sprinkle with salt. Cover the tin with foil and cook in a moderate oven for about 2 1/2 hours or until a skewer inserted into the fleshy part of the roast comes out with no trace of pink. Allow the roast to rest with the foil on top. Take the rice out of the oven and let sit for 15 - 20 minutes before removing it from the oven. Meanwhile, remove any fat from the roasting tin and set aside. When the roast has rested, remove the foil and set to one side to drain any fat off. Pour off any excess fat and cut the rice into cubes or chunks. In a separate pan, pour around 1/2 cup water and bring to the boil. Add the rice and cream of tartar to the water and stir vigorously over a low heat so that the water does not boil away, you only need to give the rice a good stir every so often. Continue cooking the rice on the hob over a medium heat for about 10 minutes, stirring from time to time as it thickens. Add a little cream to stop the cooking and stir through the rice. Slice the roast thinly across the grain and sprinkle with the finely shredded cheese. Serve with mash or other accompaniments such as spinach or chutney.

Random Ingredients: espresso powder,cheese,chicken stock,accent seasoning,dark chocolate,water artichoke heart
title: Angel Hair (Angel Hair with Dark Chocolate)
ingredients: 3/4 cup chicken stock | 1/2 teaspoon instant espresso powder | 1/2 cup water-packed artichoke hearts, drained and chopped in half | 1/4 teaspoon accent seasoning | 1 ounce dark chocolate, chopped | 2 ounces cheese
instructions: Combine the chicken stock and espresso powder in a blender or food processor. Cover and process until the liquid is frothy.

Random Ingredients: anchovy paste,lasagna noodle,garlic powder,onion powder,mushroom,baking soda,white shoepeg corn
title: Home-Style Corn and Shredded Beef Lasagna
ingredients: 4 cups cooked white shoepeg corn | 12 ounces sliced mushrooms | 2 1/2 teaspoons anchovy paste | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 lb lasagna noodle
instructions: Preheat oven to 350º. In a large bowl, combine the corn, mushrooms, anchovy paste, garlic, onion powder and baking soda. Place the crushed casings in the bottom of a 9x13 baking dish. Make a layer of noodles, then pour the corn mixture on top. Continue making layers until the dish is full. Cover with tomato onion garlic basil sauce. Cover with aluminum foil and bake for 45 minutes. Remove the foil and bake for 10 more minutes until bubbly.

Random Ingredients: sugar,rosemary,vidalia onion,marsala wine,tomato juice,extra beef,baby carrot lengthwise,lasagna noodle
title: Baked Beef and Onions
ingredients: 8 lasagna noodles | 1 1/2 lbs extra lean ground beef | 2 large vidalia onions, sliced lengthwise | 1 can diced tomatoes with juice | 1 1/2 cups marsala wine | 1 tablespoon sugar | 1/2 teaspoon dried rosemary | 1 cup baby carrots, halved lengthwise
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Cook lasagna noodles 1 at a time according to package directions. Drain. Cook beef in a large skillet until browned. Drain. Transfer meat to a 2 quart baking dish. Stir in onions, tomatoes with juices, marsala wine, sugar and rosemary. Bake, covered, 10 minutes. Stir noodles, carrots, and meat mixture in the last 10 minutes of baking. Cover.

title: Apple Habanero Pepper Jelly

instructions: Heat a grill pan to medium high heat. If using jalapeno or serrano pepper, place on the grill and toast over the heat for a few minutes or until the skin just begins to blister. title: Lemongrass Kebabs
ingredients: 1 cup heavy cream | 1/2 cup sweetened plain yogurt | 1 tablespoon white sugar, or to taste | 2 ounces sauerkraut, chopped | 1 cup fresh sliced vegetables | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh lemongrass | 1 tablespoon chopped pineapple tidbits | vegetable oil cooking spray
instructions: Heat cream, yogurt, and sugar in a blender or food processor until smooth. Stir sauerkraut, vegetables, and lemon grass into cream mixture in a bowl. Transfer mixture to a resealable plastic bag. Squeeze out air as needed, place in an airtight container, and refrigerate overnight. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Coat a baking sheet with cooking spray. Thread 2 skewers alternately on baking sheet with metal skewers, placing each skewer on prepared baking sheet. Skewer vegetables should be at least 1 inch apart. Spray kababobs with cooking spray. Bake in the preheated oven until grill marks form, about 15 minutes. Cool for a few minutes before serving.

title: Crock Pot Irish Beef Sandwiches
ingredients:
1 stew meat ( i.
    -e.
    - 1 beef chuck roast, 4 bone in chunks, 3 of beef brisket or 3 other cuts of beef ) | 6 tablespoons broth | 1/2 cup irish whiskey | 3 tablespoons fresh gherkin ( minced ) | 1 teaspoon lemon extract ( or 3/8 tsp.
    - dried ) | 4 whole pita bread, split | 4 small gherkins, cut
instructions: Place the meat in the crock pot. Add the broth, irish whiskey, gherkin, lemon extract, and 1 teaspoons salt and stir. Cover and cook on high for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 300° f. Place pita halves on a baking sheet and cut each in half to form 8 triangles. Brush each half with extra of the broth and bake the triangles for 25 minutes for rare and 30 for medium rare. Serve hot, with the gherkins on the side for dipping if desired.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,chive,active yeast,red pepper flake,shrimp,apricot
title: Baked Shrimp & Apricots
ingredients: 8 ounces unpeeled shelled shrimp | 1 tablespoon active dry yeast, dissolved in | 1/4 cup warm water | 1 cup sharp cheddar cheese, shredded | 18 dried apricots, halved and pitted | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons chives, chopped
instructions: Wash shrimp, remove tails and pice. Place shrimp in the bowl of a plastic bag. Add the yeast. Pour water over and seal bag. Let stand in a warm place for 5 minutes, then shake bag to remove excess water. Place in a bowl, cover and refrigerate overnight. The following day, preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Remove the bag of shrimp and reserve. Place the shrimp in a small pan and sprinkle with the crushed red pepper flakes and chives. Bake shrimp in preheated oven for 5 to 7 minutes, or until cooked through. Stir shrimp gently to coat with oil and sprinkle with cheese.

title: Southwest Sloppy Joes
ingredients: 3 lbs ground lean pork | 2 tablespoons low-sodium plain flour | 1 jar mild chunky salsa | 1/4 cup prepared horseradish
instructions: In a large non stick frying pan, cook pork over medium high heat until browned. In a large bowl, blend the pork, flour, salsa and horseradish well. Spoon the mixture into 6 large greased or sprayed baking dishes. Bake in a 300°f oven for 35 to 40 minutes, or until the crumbs are crispy.

title: Couscous with Sun-Dried Tomatoes
ingredients: 7 -8 ounces couscous, prepared ( cooked ) | sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and chopped | parmesan cheese, grated, to serve
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350f degrees degrees. Place the couscous along with about ¾ tablespoons of the oil in a large bowl, toss it around to combine. Stir in the sun dried tomatoes and parmesan. Spoon the remaining oil around the rim of a small ovenproof dish and pour in enough hot water just to cover the base. Set in a pre heated oven and bake for 35 - 40 minutes, until the rice is just firm to the touch and hot, tender and the liquid has been absorbed. Serve immediately with more freshly ground black pepper sprinkled in the pan and the remaining parmesan if desired.

title: Guinness Chili
ingredients: 8 ounces guinness stout | 1 red chili pepper
instructions: Pour 2oz/5oz lager into a small saucepan. Add 1 red chili pepper. Stir in. Simmer 15 min over very low heat, until flavors blend but are still slightly chunky, or to taste. Pour into a cup and add 2oz/5oz lager to taste.

title: Mock Oyster Halibut
ingredients: 1 white fish fillet ( fresh or frozen ) | 4 sheets nori ( fish seaweed )
instructions: Put fish fillet on seaweed. Lay nori on top of the fish. Cut into bite sized squares or rectangles. Steam is about 5 - 6 minutes depending on the size of the sheet of nori sheets. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: turkey thigh,bay leaf,white potato,broccoli,rice wine,beef brisket,wine
title: Korean Beef and Broccoli Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs beef brisket | 1/2 cup rice wine | 2 bay leaves, crushed | 12 cups white potatoes ( cut into 3/4-inch cubes ) | 1 1/2 lbs broccoli ( flowerets ) | 1 1/2 lbs turkey thighs ( or other tender cuts of beef cut in 1/2-1 inch cubes )
instructions: Place meat mixture in slow cooker. Add rice wine, bay leaves, potatoes and broccoli. Cover and cook on low setting for 8 - 10 hours until meat and vegetables are tender, adding water as needed. Remove meat to serving platter.

title: Thai Beetroot Salad
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups thinly sliced peeled baking potatoes | 1/2 cup watermelon, cut into pieces | 3 cups peeled and sliced beets, about 1/2 inch thick | 1 can diced beets, drained | 1 medium bell pepper, chopped | 1/2 - 2/3 cup picante sauce, jarred salsa can be used | 2 -3 tablespoons thai tamarind paste or 2 -3 tablespoons garlic-flavored tamarind | 1 1/4 cups low sodium chicken stock or 1 1/4 cups low sodium broth | 1/2 cup chopped fresh cranberries
instructions: Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over high heat. Add potatoes and sauté until golden, about 3 minutes. Remove skillet from heat and stir in watermelon, beets, bell pepper and 1/4 cup picante sauce. Heat to boiling over medium heat, then reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer until vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in tamarind paste. To serve, mound the salad onto a large platter. Spoon remaining picante sauce over and garnish with cranberries. Serve immediately.

title: Cuban Pot With Hominy and Beef
ingredients: 1 jar hominy, drained | 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef top sirloin steaks, cut into thin strips, 3/4-inch x 2-inch | 2 serrano chilies, deveined, seeded, and minced | 1/4 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1 can diced spanish onions
instructions: Combine hominy and beef in medium bowl.

Random Ingredients: bean sprout,ha avocadoes,bread dough,sesame seed,red kidney bean
title: Korean Bean Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 1 lb firm bread dough | 2 cups frozen breadsticks or 2 cups bean sprouts | 1 1/2 cups red kidney beans, cooked and drained ( black beans ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 2 hass avocadoes, peeled | 1/4 cup soy bean sprouts ( optional )
instructions: Defrost bean sprouts in a bowl, about 30 minutes in the microwave. Slice breadsticks diagonally into 12 diagonal pieces. If using bean sprouts, cut rounds in half diagonally. Place bean sprouts, chopped bean sprouts and kidney beans in a bowl, cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Drain bean sprouts well, then place on a lightly greased baking sheet. Lightly spray baking sheet with vegetable oil spray. Bake bread sticks at 400 degrees f. Assemble rolls by spreading bread sticks on a lightly floured surface, leaving one inch of an inch of room at the top. Starting with bread sticks, lay bean sprouts on top and sprinkle with sesame seeds and some bean sprout pieces. Starting with bread sticks, carefully roll up bean sprouts. Serve immediately.

title: Beef Burrito (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 3 lbs bone-in beef brisket | 1 can chopped green curry paste | 1 can chili beans, undrained | 12 ounces shredded mexican blend cheese ( such as kraft ) | 1 tablespoon green curry paste | 1/2 teaspoon dried herbs ( optional ) | 1/2 cup frozen whipped topping
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a 4 quart crock pot, stir well and cook on high for 2 hours, then on low for 3 - 5 hours. Remove beef and meat and shred. Serve with salsa or other spicy toppings..

title: Caribbean Style Hot Shred
ingredients: 1 can bamboo shoots | 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 1 tablespoon coriander
instructions: Drain canned bamboo shoots and put the drained bamboo through a food processor or blender. Mix all the ingredients together and put in a saucepan. Bring to a boil and stir until it thickens.

title: Ouzo Balls (Sofrito-Stuffed Pasta)
ingredients: 3 teaspoons ouzo | 3 teaspoons sofrito sauce | 3 -4 tablespoons whipping cream | 2 teaspoons whole wheat flour | 1 lb spaghetti, cooked and drained | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees celsius. In bowl, combine ouzo, sofrito and cream. Add flour, stir in until a ball forms. Place balls onto a lightly greased baking tray and sprinkle with pepper. Cook in oven for 10 - 15 minutes or until light brown.

title: Dynamite
ingredients: 1 teaspoon turmeric | 1 teaspoon veggie burgers ( optional ) | carbonated lemon-lime beverage ( optional )
instructions: Combine turmeric and lemongrass buds in a mortar or non reactive saucepan. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 1 minute. Slowly pour in carbonated lemon lime beverage, if desired. Stir until the beverage loses its raw taste, about 1 minute.

title: Sally's English Muffins
ingredients: 1 large onion ( or 1 cup diced ) | 2 -3 cups mixed salad greens
instructions: Cut large onion slices in half. Slice into thin half rings. Set aside. Open salad green bag and sprinkle generously with salt and pepper. Place leafy greens in salad bowl, add onions and mix well. Spread evenly on 2 clean plates. Place large scooped mushroom mixture into center of green salad and arrange around them. Place a clean towel over the top of bowl and let sit in fridge for 8 hours.

title: Dressed Asparagus with Watermelon (Mustard and Asparagus)
ingredients: 225 g frozen puff pastry, thawed | 5 teaspoons mustard | 5 teaspoons anchovy paste | 75 100 ml chicken bouillon | 1 teaspoon watermelon, chopped coarsely | 100 g asparagus, cut into 2 1 1/2 cm segments ( rocket ) | grated cardamom, to sprinkle
instructions: Thaw puff pastry sheets on oven trays. Preheat oven to 200&#9702&#8260.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,jumbo shrimp,veal cutlet,butternut squash
title: Jumbo Shrimp and Beef Pilaf With Squash
ingredients: 1 lb jumbo shrimp, peeled | 1 lb veal cutlet, cut into 3/4 inch cubes | 2 cups butternut squash, halved lengthwise and cut into 1/4 inch slices | 3 cups medium-grain white rice, cooked and hot
instructions: Cook seafood, separately, as follows, peel shrimp and set aside. Rinse and pat dry with paper towels and set aside. Cook squash, cut sides down in boiling water for 7 minutes. Drain and transfer to a serving bowl. Cut beef in half horizontally down the center, then crosswise into 1/2 inch thick slices. Add shrimp, carrots, and squash to the bowl and toss to combine. Serve warm.

title: Pork Banh Mi (Pork Tenderloin With Shiitake Mushrooms and Macadamia Noodle Sauce)
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin ( about 1 1/2 inches thick ) | 1/2 cup mushroom ( shiitake mushrooms, stems removed or 1 1/2 cups cremini mushrooms, sliced caps thinly ) | 1/2 cup water | 1/4 cup mayonnaise | 2 tablespoons chopped macadamia nuts ( optional ) | rice vermicelli ( thin noodles )
instructions: Rinse the pork tenderloin under cold water and pat dry with paper towels. Heat some oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Sprinkle the pork with salt and pepper. Cook the pork 3 to 4 minutes per side, until medium well. Transfer the pork to a large plate. Pour the remaining oil into the skillet. Saute the mushrooms and water for 10 seconds. Add the mayonnaise and cook for 1 minute, stirring. Add the macadamia nuts and cook 1 minute more. Add the pork and stir to combine. Serve. Pass the mayonnaise sauce separately along the side. Note, in macadamia nuts, you can make a roux by coating with a little water, cooking in the skillet over low heat until the oil starts to turn a medium brown. Pour the roux into a small bowl and toss with the noodles.

title: Arabic Asphargis
ingredients: 4 -5 orange zest | 2 tablespoons asafoetida powder | maraschino cherry, to decorate
instructions: Take the zest of a card the size of a hazel and cut into fine slivers on a cutting board. Remove the white dark filament in the zest. Place the zest in a teardrop or a jar with oil. Heat it over the fire, swirling until the zest darkens in color. Remove the zest. Pour cold water to cover the zest and let it stand for about 20 minutes or until it has stopped darkening. Take it out on its paper towel, sprinkle with salt and toss it over the other ingredients. Drain off any excess liquid from the zest. Place in an airtight container. Decorate as needed. Keeps for several days. Variation,. Add sugar as desired. Use a candy if desired. Serve with butter as an accompaniment. Enjoy.

title: Hungarian Chocolate Cookies
ingredients: 200 g dark chocolate, chopped | 400 g icing sugar, sifted | 1/2 teaspoon hungarian paprika
instructions: Blend all ingredients until fluffy. Using 1/4 cup of dough, roll into balls. Refrigerate until solid before placing on the tray and setting as desired.

Random Ingredients: ice cream,rump roast,red thai chile,maple syrup,head cauliflower,corn oil
title: Beef on Crunchy Crunchy-Crusted Roast Hawaiian Style
ingredients: ice cream | 1 lb boneless rump roast, trimmed | 2 large heads cauliflower, separated into florets | 2 -3 tablespoons hot corn oil | 1 teaspoon ground red thai chile | 2 tablespoons maple syrup
instructions: To prepare grill, using a grill rack set 6 inches from the heat, arrange roast on the rack. Using tongs or a large spatula, turn roast once, allow meat to drain on paper towels. Grill roast until thermometer inserted into center registers 140°f for medium rare, about 2 minutes per side for medium or 15 minutes per side for medium well, or until thermometer registers 175°f for medium well, about 3 minutes total time. Cool meat. Cut each roast into thirds for each half and each piece into 3 wedges to total 15 pieces. Place cauliflower florets on plates. Spread 1 tablespoon hot oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. When oil shimmers, add chiles and roast. Cook until nicely browned, about 3 minutes per side. Place cauliflower florets on plates. Pour 2 tablespoons maple syrup on top and top with 1/2 cup beef. Garnish with reserved beef. Serve.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,cornmeal,chive,cayenne pepper,almond,flour tortilla,phyllo dough,tuna steak
title: Steak Phyllo Pizza
ingredients: 1 gallon pre-made flour tortilla | 1 cup shredded thawed whole tuna steaks | 1/4 yellow bell pepper, finely chopped | 1/4 cup sliced blanched almond, chopped | 1 bunch fresh chives, sliced | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 cup lightly packed slivered almonds | 1 teaspoon fresh chives, snipped | 8 sheets miniature phyllo dough
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees fahrenheit. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or oil lightly. Sprinkle flour tortillas lightly with salt. Place in the bottom of a gallon size bag and shake to even. Remove bag from the corner of bag. Place tuna steak and bell pepper in bag and shake to mix. Place in bag and repeat for remaining tuna and bell pepper, placing meat and peppers between two flour tortillas. Spread almond slivers and chopped chives over meat and peppers, making sure all the nuts cover all the seafood. Place on parchment lined baking sheet, sprayed side down. Bake for 1 1/2 hours or until meat is cooked through and vegetables are tender. Remove from oven and let sit 10 minutes. Remove from sheet, garnish with additional chopped chives, and serve.

title: Potato Salsa
ingredients: 2 lbs red potatoes, cut into quarters if smaller | 8 ounces jicama | 4 ounces tamari | 4 ounces condensed tomato soup | 12 pitted dates
instructions: Cut potatoes in 3/4 inch cubes. Boil unpeeled jicama, drain and add to potatoes. Stir well and let tomatoes brown. Add tamari, soup and dates. Mix well. Cook over medium heat until potatoes are tender.

title: Soko
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 loaves french bread, crusts removed and cut into 1 3/4-inch cubes ( about 10 ounces ) | 10 cups soymilk ( the amount is approximate ) | soymilk, for brushing the bread
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 f. Butter a 2 quart souffle dish or 9 individual glass bowls. Divide the bread into four pieces. Toast the bread in the oven for 8 - 10 minutes or til light golden and dry. Spread the bread with a little soymilk and spread a little soya milk on the untoasted bread. Lay the bowls of soaked bread over the soya milk and bring them to the surface of the oven.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,dark soy sauce,mustard seed,avocado,turnip,rye bread,bacon dripping,chicken thigh
title: Quick Microwave Chicken, Turnips and Avocado Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs ( about 4 pieces ) | vegetable oil cooking spray ( for cooking ) | 1/4 cup diced bacon drippings ( from a package of sliced bacon ) | 2 medium turnips, peeled and finely diced ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 1/4 cup dark soy sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons mustard seeds | 12 slices rye bread ( toasted or soft bread ) | 4 slices fresh ripe avocado ( halved or halved lengthwise, to serve )
instructions: Cut chicken from thigh bone, if large. Pat chicken dry with paper towels.

title: Fishcakes With Toasted Dried Apricot-Filling
ingredients: 4 lbs corned beef brisket | 1 lb firm white fish fillet | 1 cup brewed coffee, cooled and strained | 1/3 cup dried apricot, finely chopped | beef chuck, sliced 1/2-inch thick
instructions: Line a heavy rimmed baking sheet with foil. Place the brisket, fat side up, on the prepared baking sheet. Soak corned beef in hot coffee for 30 minutes, carefully removing it from coffee, when cool and drained. Arrange on a work surface with enough fat to cover. Arrange the fish fillet on top, slightly overlapping the fillet. Spread 1/2 cup of the apricot fig jamonnue over the fillet. Starting from the short end of the brisket roll up the brisket beginning from the short end and jelly roll fashion, and tie loosely with string. Cut the meat into 1 inch thick slices, place on foil lined baking sheet. Brush each slice with apricot jamonnue. Top with slices of beef.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,rose lime juice,brandy,arborio rice,dijon mustard
title: Cherry Risotto With Rose Limes
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups arborio rice | 15 1/4 ounces brandy | 10 -12 maraschino cherries | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon rose lime juice
instructions: Begin by cooking the rice according to the package directions. In a medium pot, combine the brandy, cherries, dijon mustard and rose lime juice and cook over medium heat, stirring to combine. When the alcohol cooks off from the alcohol, add the brandy mixture and cook until it is reduced by half. Serve hot.

title: Artichoke Heart Chickpeas
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained and quartered | 1 1/2 teaspoons poultry seasoning
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together the chickpeas and artichoke hearts. Mix in poultry seasoning until evenly distributed. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour, or overnight to blend flavors.

Random Ingredients: lemon flavoring,seasoning salt,snow pea,purpose flour,spicy brown mustard,poppy seed,american cheese
title: Swiss Snow Pea Filling for Cheese
ingredients: 1 package frozen snow peas, defrosted | 3/4 cup shredded american cheese | 2 tablespoons poppy seeds | 1 tablespoon seasoning salt | 2 teaspoons all-purpose flour | 2 tablespoons spicy brown mustard | 1/4 cup lemon flavoring, with a hint of lime
instructions: Boil the peas for about 3 minutes or until tender. Drain. Drain. Toss with cheese. Mix poppy seeds, seasoned salt, flour, mustard and lemon flavoring. Pour over cheese and mix well. Cool to room temperature and put in refrigerated until it is thick and creamy.

Random Ingredients: egg white,black coffee,chipotle chile adobo,red chili paste,tequila,purpose flour,bisquick
title: Chile-Chipotle Tequila Black Cupcakes
ingredients: 3/4 cup julienne-cut dried chipotle chiles in adobo | 1 tablespoon red chili paste | 1 1/4 cups all-purpose flour | 1/2 cup bisquick | 1 1/2 cups tequila | 1/2 cup strong black coffee | 2 egg whites
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°.

Random Ingredients: banana,green chile pepper,stewing beef,tomato green chilies
title: Beef and Chile
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs stewing beef, cut into 2 inch chunks | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1 hot green chile pepper, seeded and chopped | 1 banana, cut into 4 wedges
instructions: Place beef in large pot over low heat. Cover and cook until beef is tender enough to handle. Stir in tomatoes, green chile peppers and banana. Cover and reduce heat to medium low.

title: Hummus on Refried Beans
ingredients: 1 cup pinto beans | 1/8 cup dried dates | 1/16 teaspoon cardamom | 1/8 teaspoon marjoram
instructions: Place beans in pressure cooker. Top with enough hot water to cover and press cook. After 5 minutes of stanching place on a paper towel covered plate to rest. Fyi, i've never had a problem before, because the texture is soooo soft when i make this. Drain the beans and discard the cooking water. Add the dates and marjoram. Stir fry for 10 minutes. Remove from heat. Remove paper towel. Cool and store in the fridge.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,creole seasoning,cayenne pepper,olive,green chili pepper,iceberg lettuce
title: Mexican Steak Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup pitted ripe olives | 4 teaspoons extra virgin olive oil | 1/2 cup finely chopped green chili pepper | 1/4 cup shredded iceberg lettuce | 1/4 teaspoon creole seasoning | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Place the olives in a large shallow dish in a single layer, not touching. In a small bowl, combine the olive oil, green pepper, and lettuce. Sprinkle creole seasoning evenly over the top. Let stand for 5 minutes to develop the flavors. Gently press the olives together to coat. Using a long handled fork, press the dressing into a shallow dish and arrange the steak over top. Turn and tap on the counter for 10 seconds to coat. Turn again and sprinkle the steak with the creole seasoning and cayenne pepper.

title: Chili-Cumin Green Beans & Olive Stew
ingredients: 1 teaspoon vegetable broth | 1/2 teaspoon cumin | 1/2 teaspoon chili oil | 8 ounces black olives, pitted, quartered lengthwise | 1 teaspoon fresh chives, coarsely chopped
instructions: Pour broth into a medium bowl.

title: Colombian Sausages
ingredients: 12 polish sausage | 3/4 cup low-fat mascarpone cheese | 1/2 cup beer ( i like pacifico or bitter ) | 1/4 cup picante sauce | 1 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Pound out the sausage and cut in small pieces. Heat beer on low heat to a medium heat. Add mascarpone cheese and mix with your dry stuffing and spices. Put sausage pieces in fry pan, and cook over medium heat until they are browned, turning several times. Add picante sauce and cook for 15 minutes. Put mixture on platter. I usually serve on my rice. Also, i add green chilies that have been left on my plate while eating.

Random Ingredients: white cheese,ginger,almond extract,heavy whipping cream,pastry crust pie
title: Gingersnaps
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ground ginger | 12 ounces pastry for a 9 inch double crust pie | 1 cup white cheese, grated ( optional ) | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Combine ginger and cheese. Cut pastry in half and spread on bottom and sides of pie pan. Spread cheese mix evenly over pastry. Cover with pastry cut outs. Bake in oven for 15 minutes then score top with fingers.

Random Ingredients: fava bean,pork neck,mirin,tart apple,coriander seed,white cornmeal
title: Fava Bean and Sausage Pie
ingredients: 1/2 pound dried fava beans | 1 pound pork neck bones, soaked in water and drained | 1 medium tart apple, sliced | 3 tablespoons white cornmeal | 3 tablespoons finely chopped coriander seeds | mirin, or japanese sweet cooking sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place beans in a large pot. Cover with just enough water to cover. Soak overnight. The next day, remove the casings from the beans with your fingers and discard. Rinse the beans, then, if necessary, boil with water until tender, about 15 minutes. Reserve 1 cup of the cooking liquid. Drain the beans and reserve. Place pork bones in a large ovenproof skillet. Pour enough water into the pan to just cover the bones. Cover and bake in a preheated 400 degrees f oven until the fat is rendered and the bones have begun to brown, about 1 hour. Set aside and keep warm. Skim fat off remaining fat. Dice apple into thin strips. Sprinkle cornmeal on the top of the hot beans. Bake and stir until browned, about 15 minutes. Spoon apple slices and sausages over the beans. Bake until sausages are browned and sausages are crisp, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: romano bean,italian flat leaf parsley,green olive,chicken bouillon,broccoli floret,white flour,daikon radish
title: Daikon (Soupy Broccoli Beans and Rice)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups green olives ( pitted and halved ) or 1 1/2 cups kalamata olives ( pitted and halved ) | 1/2 cup red snipped green olives | 1 1/2 cups daikon radishes ( chopped ) or 1 1/2 cups julienned daikon radish | 1 cup finely chopped italian flat leaf parsley ( or 1 t dried parsley ) | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon | 1 tablespoon unbleached white flour | 1/2 cup grated romano beans ( about a small cup, or 1/2 cup white plain yogurt ) | 1/2 cup finely chopped broccoli floret
instructions: Drain the olives but reserve the juice. Slice the olives in half lengthwise and remove and discard the stems. Cut the halves in half crosswise and place the cut halves and bottoms back together in a large non reactive mixing bowl. Stir in the chopped daikon or julienne radishes, green olives, and 1/2 cup of the reserved juice. Add the chopped parsley and bouillon and beat until thoroughly blended. Pour into a nonstick baking dish coated with cooking spray and let stand at room temp 10 to 15 minutes. Meanwhile, combine chicken broth and 1 1/2 cups water in a medium soup pot. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Stir in the flour on low heat for at least 2 minutes, stir constantly to avoid lumps. Add the remaining 1 cup of the reserved juice and the bean liquid. Cook 3 minutes, then remove from heat and stir in the romano and broccoli. Taste for seasoning, adjust as needed. Serve directly from the dish with some additional romano or parsley sprinkled on top. Serves.

title: Chipotle Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 packages active dry yeast | 1/2 cup very warm water | 16 ounces button mushrooms, cleaned | 2 chipotle chiles, finely chopped
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water on a large lg. Round baking sheet. Using a 6 - 8 round bladed knife, cut a few slits along the bottom and sides of each mushroom cap. Combine mushrooms and chilies and add to the yeast and stir well until well mixed. Let cool for 20 - 25 minutes. Meanwhile mix 1/4 cup of the chile flavored beer with the chipotle and sprinkle over top of the mushrooms before topping with the remaining beer. Allow to rise uncovered in a warm place for another 30 minutes or until the beer has risen to the surface. Bake according to package directions at 205 degrees f for 20 minutes. Allow to cool.

title: Smooth Mango Parsnips on Spareribs
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs parsnips | 2 limes, cut into wedges ( reserve juice ) | 1 tablespoon mango chutney
instructions: Peel, then cut the parsnips into 1 inch chunks. Toss the parsnips with the lime juice in a bowl. Spread the chutney over and under your cooked ribs and refrigerate for 1 hour or overnight before serving.

title: Chicken in a Simple Creamy Rice
ingredients: 4 -5 chicken thighs ( bone-in or boneless ) | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 1/2 - 2 cups jasmine rice ( about 15 minutes in cooking, to yield 2 2/3 cups cooked rice )
instructions: Heat oven to 325ºf. In large dutch oven or heavy roasting pan, combine chicken thighs and cornstarch and toss to coat evenly. Add water and stir to mix. Cover with foil. Heat until thighs are quite tender, about 1 1/2 to 2 hours.. Transfer chicken to platter and sprinkle with rice. Serve right away.

title: Italian Quinoa With Italian Salad Dressing
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 package italian salad dressing mix | 3 cups quinoa
instructions: Place ingredients into a 2 - 3 quart casserole dish. Cover and bake for 45 - 50 minutes. Remove lid and bake another 15 - 20 minutes. Cool. You can also add your own favourite veggies to this recipe.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,parsnip,ruby red grapefruit juice,italian herb seasoning
title: Pine Parsnips
ingredients: 3 large parsnips | 1 1/2 cups ruby red grapefruit juice | 1/4 teaspoon italian herb seasoning | 1 tablespoon cocoa powder
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f. Cook the parsnips in boiling water until crisp tender, 5 - 7 minutes. Drain and set aside. Place in a serving bowl. Pour the grapefruit juice over the parsnips and sprinkle with the italian herb seasoning. Mix very well and drizzle the cocoa powder over all. Eat warm or let cool, and serve at room temperature.

title:
Simple Vietnamese Fish Sauce.
    -
ingredients: 1 packet of your favorite fish sauce | 1 tablespoon garlic salt | 1 teaspoon chili pepper flakes ( optional )
instructions: First mix the fish sauce, garlic salt and chili flakes in a small sauce pot. Bring just to a boil. Lower heat and simmer for 1 - 2 minutes or until thickened slightly. Allow to cool. You may take the fish sauce off heat of fish sauce or use immediately.

title: Nam Prik Num (Lemongrass Poppercorns Nuts)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons coarse-grind mustard seeds | 2 stalks lemongrass, tough outer leaves removed and insides finely chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons coarsely-grind mustard seeds | 4 teaspoons finely-grated dijon mustard
instructions: Toast mustard seeds and coarse peel on a lightly oiled grill pan, being careful to flip as necessary. Set out a bowl of warm water in it to drain off all the excess moisture. Mix dijon mustard with a pinch of salt in a small bowl. Trim and discard outer leaves from lemongrass, then cut bulb into 5 inch lengths. Place lemongrass pieces at bottom of bowl, then pour dressing over, and toss to coat. Sprinkle generously with salt, then let sit at room temperature 30 minutes before serving.

title: Macaroni in Espresso-Spice
ingredients: 250 g macaroni | 250 g caster sugar | 2 teaspoons espresso powder | 1 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 15 dried red chilies, soaked in hot water for 10 minutes
instructions: Boil the macaroni in salted water till al dente. Drain and keep aside. Heat sugar, espresso powder, nutmeg and chillies together in a sauce pan until the sugar starts to change colour. Add the macaroni and stir. Heat thoroughly. Add the water drained macaroni and cook for 5 minutes. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: cooking oat,green bell pepper,drambuie,basil chiffonade,extra virgin olive oil,garlic clove
title: Herb Oatmeal Wedges
ingredients: 1 tablespoon quick-cooking oats | 1 tablespoon snipped fresh basil chiffonade ( plus extra for sprinkling if serving dish ) | 2 tablespoons trasiamelled quick-cooking oats | 2 tablespoons snipped green bell peppers | 2 tablespoons snipped garlic cloves | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil
instructions: In a shallow microwave safe dish, combine the first 5 ingredients. Cover and microwave on high power for 2 to 3 minutes, or until hot and bubbly. Stir in olive oil. Serve with herbed oat topping if desired.

title: Orecchiette Wraps
ingredients: 1 pound beef tenderloins, chopped | 1 pound chevre cheese, shredded | 8 ounces uncooked dried wagon wheel macaroni
instructions: Cook and stir beef in a large skillet over medium low heat until browned, 5 to 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: parsnip,lemon wedge,thai fish sauce,clove,extra virgin olive oil,fettuccini noodle
title: Grilled Parsnips With Fettuccini, Lemons, and Spicy Fish Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 tablespoon thai fish sauce | 1/2 cup parsnip, peeled and diagonally chopped | 2 cloves, chopped | 2 tablespoons finely snipped fresh parsley leaves | lemon wedge, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Make the fettuccini according to package directions. Meanwhile, combine the oil, fish sauce and parsnips in a large bowl. Toss to combine well. Heat a grill pan at medium high heat. Add the garlic, parsley and cloves. Serve the fettuccine with a wedge of lemon and/or fish sauce.

title: Peach Pancakes
ingredients: 2 fresh ripe peaches | 1/4 cup semolina flour ( or cornmeal ) | 2 hard-boiled eggs
instructions: Peel and core the peaches, removing the stone, then cut them into slices. Cut a pocket along the length of each slice and gently squeeze out the pulp, taking care not to get any seeds to be able to come out. Pour the semolina flour into a bowl, slowly pour in the peach pulp and beat lightly with a fork. Add the beaten eggs, salt and pepper and mix until the batter is well blended and smooth. Heat a non stick frying pan with just a little buttered spray on a medium high heat and shallow fry the pancakes, about 2 minutes on each side, until golden. Serve with whipped cream, icecream, custard or ice cold cream.

Random Ingredients: pimiento,shell pasta,five spice powder,tomato puree,streaky bacon,kiwi fruit
title: Moorish Sausages
ingredients: 500 g streaky bacon, trimmed of fat and chopped | 1 kiwi fruit, roughly sliced | 2 tablespoons crushed dried pimiento | 300 g dry large shell pasta | 1/4 teaspoon five-spice powder | 1 tablespoon tomato puree
instructions: Cook bacon in a large frypan over medium heat, add kiwi fruit, pimento and 1 teaspoon of curry powder. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 4 - 5 minutes or until kiwifruit is tender and bacon is browned. Cook pasta according to packet instructions. Meanwhile, mix together remaining curry powder, pesto and remaining pimento. Add to the bacon mixture and cook, stirring, for 1 - 2 minutes or until sauce thickens. Serve sausage with pasta.

Random Ingredients: cardamom seed,red pepper flake,lamb,coleslaw mix,ice water,cooking apple,broccoli floret
title: Barefoot Contessa's Lamb Kebabs with Broccoli, Apples, and Coleslaw
ingredients:
1 1/2 lbs lean lamb ( shoulder or shoulder, 1.
    -5 in.
    - thick ) | 2 teaspoons ground cardamom seeds | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes ( optional ) | 1 cup quick-cooking applewood smoke flavored cooking apple, diced | 2 cups coleslaw mix ( cabbage slaw ) | 1 1/2 cups small broccoli florets, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup cold water
instructions: Place meat in a bowl with cardamom seeds, red pepper flakes, apple, and coleslaw. Toss to combine. Divide mixture between 4 skewers. Brush with water. Soak skewers in water 15 minutes. Grill over high heat for 4 minutes, brushing with any remaining juices. Cut meat into 1 cubes and serve with vegetables and sauce.

title: Raspberry Mango Salad
ingredients: 2 mangoes, peeled, halved and thinly sliced | 1 raspberries, rinsed, dried and sliced | 1 fennel, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 8 teaspoons vegetable oil cooking spray
instructions: Toss mango, raspberries, fennel and fish sauce in a bowl. Spray a nonstick frypan with cooking spray, heat over high heat for 1 minute until hot. Pour mango mixture into pan and cook for 5 minutes or until lightly browned and cooked through.

Random Ingredients: coleslaw dressing,parmigiano reggiano cheese,apple butter,baby spinach,tomato soup,arugula,malt vinegar,nori
title: Crunchy Spinach Rollatini Salad
ingredients: 1 can condensed 98 % fat-free cream of mushroom soup, undiluted | 1/2 cup malt vinegar | 1/3 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese, divided | 1/4 cup coleslaw dressing ( homemade or prepared ) | 3 tablespoons prepared malt vinegar | 1/2 lb baby spinach | 9 nori | 2 cups thinly sliced coleslaw dressing ( homemade or from a packaged italian salad dressing ) | 2 cups chopped salad spinach | 1/4 cup finely chopped dried arugula
instructions: Stir first 4 ingredients in medium bowl to blend. Let stand 1 - 2 minutes. Combine remaining ingredients in medium bowl.

title: Spinach Balls
ingredients: 12 cups mixed fresh spinach | 2 cups grated spanish onion | 1/2 cup hot coffee | 1/4 cup grated bonito flakes | 2 1/2 cups confectioners'sugar
instructions: Wash and dry the spinach. Rinse well to remove any excess water. Place spinach in a bowl, and sprinkle with cold water until the water is completely covering the spinach. Cover and let Spinach sit for 20 minutes. Uncover, and squeeze to remove water. Drain any excess water. Place the spinach mixture in a clean container. Place onion and hot coffee into a medium saucepan over medium heat, and stir until the butter melts. Stir in the bonito flakes and let sit until the mixture has cooled to room temperature. Pour the coffee mixture over the spinach in the container, and mix well. Place 1 cup of mixture in the center of an ice cream scoop, and press down gently until the mixture holds the shape of a ball. Place onto waxed paper to cool. Once cool, dust with confectioners' sugar.

title: Vegetable Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti, uncooked | 1 fennel bulb | 1 -2 garlic clove | 2 tablespoons butter or 2 tablespoons margarine, melted
instructions: First cook the fennel bulb, cut on stem part with a sharp knife, leaving the bulb in thin rings. Cut each ring lengthwise into thin strips, using the core, if present. Slice the fennel bulb thinly on a diagonal and arrange across the bottom of a deep, handsome baking pan. Scatter the sliced fennel over the fennel. Add a few cloves of garlic, cut into thin slivers, and pour the melted butter over the fennel bulbs. Bake at 400 degrees for about thirty to forty minutes, or until the fennel has all softened and shrunk considerably. Serve hot or cold. Note, the idea is to make them without the fennel. We do this the night before to allow the fennel in the liquid to mellow the flavor. The recipe says simmering with a lid on, but i have no problem just put the lid on. The pasta then will begin to absorb the heat from the water in the pan. Cook the fennel bulb in enough water to cover under a medium high heat until tender. Drain the pasta and place in a bowl with the fennel and drained fennel liquid. Toss. Add salt to taste. Serve warm or cold, with fruit and some raisins, or other filling.

title: BakedCourgettes with Bacon
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 6 ounces bacon, chopped | 1 bunch fresh dill, chopped | 8 medium courgettes | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 1/4 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325º. In a small bowl, mix together the cornstarch and sugar until it begins to foam. Add a few drops of water if it starts to foam. Set aside. Heat half of the bacon fat in a large skillet over medium heat. Cut the ends off the courgettes. Discard the cores, and discard. Cut into 1 cubes or wedges. Place into the skillet, and stir in the cornstarch and sugar mixture. Cook and stir for several minutes on low heat, until thickened. Stir in the rest of the ingredients, and simmer until tender. Serve over hot white rice.

Random Ingredients: marjoram,self rising flour,white chocolate chip,green chilies,green olive,tiger shrimp,french fry
title: Shrimp & White Chocolate Stuffed Fries
ingredients: 12 -14 cooked tiger shrimp | 1 green chilies, chopped finely or 1 jalapeno pepper, chopped finely | 1/4 cup shredded white chocolate chip | 4 -6 ounces self-rising flour ( or 1 1/2 cups plain all purpose flour ) | marjoram, fresh herb, to taste | 1 can green olives, sliced
instructions: Chop up shrimp finely. Add all ingredients except the olives and mix well. Pinch strips of green olives onto the mixture and sprinkle with a teaspoon of chopped marjoram or fresh herb if using. Tightly wrap each strip of green olive with a long strip of green olive and a thin slice of jalapeno or mild red jalapeno pepper. Secure with tines of a fork on the tip of an orange. Cook on each side at a temperature of 180 degrees celcius for about 5 - 10 minutes.

title: Pan Fried Fish With Pistachios
ingredients: 1 ounce pancetta, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon sunflower oil | 1 cup fish, fillet chopped in small chunks | 1 cup confectioners'sugar | 12 tortillas | 1 tablespoon rice flour | 1 cup unsalted shelled pistachios, toasted
instructions: In a small frying pan, fry the pancetta over medium heat for 1 minute. Add the oil, then add the fish and cook. Stir the ingredients together until the fish changes color. Take care not to overcook it. Serve over the toasted tortillas topped with pistachios.

title: Shaoxing Won Tons
ingredients: 1/2 cup almond milk | 6 wonton wrappers | 1/4 cup shaoxing wine
instructions: Bring together almond cream and shaoxing wine in a heatproof bowl, set aside. Place wonton wrappers on a dry surface. Working with a few won ton wrappers at a time, brush lightly with the almond cream. Place in front of you with the back of a wooden spoon, pinch the edges together with your fingers and draw the wontons along the perimeter of the bowl to form a triangle. Transfer to a lightly oiled tray, cover and place in freezer for 20 minutes. Working with one won ton at a time, place parchment squares on your working surface. Preheat a dry wok over a medium heat, add a few tablespoons of shaoxing wine and swirl to coat surface. When the wine starts to bubble remove from the heat and transfer won tons to the parchment lined pan. Gently press the pastry into the corners and allow it to cool completely. Repeat with remaining wontons and place over an open flame or a plate lined with a clean cloth. Serve warm.

title: Chicken Cacciatore With French Bread
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1/2 cup fennel | 1 cup cooked rice noodles, with liquid | 1 loaf crusty french bread
instructions: Slice chicken into 1/2 inch squares, then place in shallow baking pans. Sprinkle chicken with fennel and cover chicken with noodles. Bake at 375°f for 20 minutes, making sure chicken is cooked through and no pink remains. Slice french bread into 1/2 inch slices and place on cookie sheet. Place bread slices over top of chicken. Bake for 5 minutes at 375°f.

title: Prosciutto Wrapped Cheese
ingredients: 4 slices prosciutto ( thin slices ) | 1 tablespoon mixed herbs ( basil, sage, oregano ) | 1/8 teaspoon saffron | 1 pinch red pepper flakes | 1/8 teaspoon coriander powder | sliced fresh herb, of your choice, to garnish ( cilantro, basil )
instructions: Wrap a slice of prosciutto with a small bunch of fresh herbs, using a small amount of herbs for each wrap/chop. Sprinkle the mixed herbs with saffron, followed by red pepper flakes and coriander powder. Sprinkle extra herbs over the top if desired. Roll up the cheese and slice into 1 - 2 inch lengths, securing with toothpicks.

title: A Simple Apricot Sesame Snacks
ingredients: 1 can apricot halves or ( 16 ounce ) can diced apricots | toasted sesame seeds
instructions: Drain the apricots, reserving the juices. Drain the apricots if they are large, cut them into halves or quarters. Place a piece of toasted sesame seed on each apricot half. Place the apricots on a large baking sheet. Sprinkle with the toasted sesame seeds. Serve.

title: Chewy Chocolate French Toast
ingredients: 8 slices bread cubes ( multicolored or gluten free will work too ) | 2 eggs ( you could also use egg beaters egg substitute for 1 egg ) | 1 pinch cocoa powder, for coloring | 1 tablespoon cornstarch
instructions: Dissolve corn starch in 1/2 c hot water. Beat eggs with a pinch of cocoa. Dip bread into egg mixture. Fry in hot cooking spray for 3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: cayenne,jasmine rice,baking soda,pork,potato starch,white onion,vanilla essence,chili powder
title: Jamaican Sweet Potato Cake
ingredients: 250 g jasmine rice, raw | 3 potatoes, medium size, small, peeled, diced into small bits | 150 g ground pork ( lean ) | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne | 1/4 teaspoon chili powder | 1/2 cup white onion, diced finely | 1/2 cup white onion, diced finely | 1/2 cup coconut-flavored jam or 1/2 cup chili paste
instructions: Note, for the sweet potato cake, cook the rice about 1/2 hr or until tender. Drain and set aside. Meanwhile to make filling, dice the white onions roughly and saute with the pork and the spices. If you use a pork, dice it up as finely as possible so that it can be picked up and left out for later use. Once the mix is dry, add the sweet potato and mix well. Spread half of the sweet potato mix and half the coconut mixture over the sweet potatoes and cinnamon mix, cover with half of the white onion and half the coconut. Cover with the rest of the sweet potato mix and half of the white onion and the coconut mix. Cover with all of the sweet potato mix and half of the white onion and the coconut mix. Cover with half of the sweet potato mix and half of the white onion and coconut mix. Cover with wrap and ventiliser and ventiliser for about 30 minutes. If you need a hard time cover the wrap with aluminium foil to avoid steam. Note, for a spicier cake try adding some chili paste to taste. Please note, i found 2 tbsp of chilli powder which has been added to the sweet potato mix when it is cooked before mixing the sweet potato mix. I also added in a small piece of sunflower oil cooking spray on the sweet potato mix before mixing it in before adding in the sunflower oil. This result will result in a more tender sweet potato dish.

title: Garlicky Russian Tea Bread - Microwave
ingredients: 4 slices french bread | 1/4 cup teabags ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1/2 teaspoon dried dill | 2 tablespoons kalamata olives, coarsely chopped
instructions: Place bread on a microwave safe plate and lightly brush with worcestershire sauce and dill. Microwave on high, uncovered, for 7 minutes. Stir in parmesan cheese if desired. Microwave for another 2 seconds or until cheese is melted. Remove from oven and top with olives. Serve. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: matzo meal,cocoa powder,pine nut,chili pepper flake
title: Nutty Matzo Meal
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups matzo meal | 2 tablespoons cocoa powder | 1 teaspoon chili pepper flakes ( or to taste ) | 1/4 cup pine nuts
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large bowl and mix well using your hands. Shape mixture into little flat sticks about 5 inches long and 5 cm wide. Place in the freezer and freeze about 1 hour. Remove matzos from the freezer and place on a flat surface and flatten with a rolling pin. Place approximately 1/4 teaspoon of matzo meal on each piece of matzilla and roll lightly. Flatten matzos on a paper towel for 10 minutes. Grill in a grill pan or fry pan using medium heat and turning every minute for about 5 - 6 minutes or until browned. Serve warm or cold.

title: Easy Baked Lasagna
ingredients: 1 3/4 pounds mozzarella cheese, shredded | 1 cup tamari | 1 teaspoon dry bay leaf powder | 12 lasagna noodles, broken in half
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. In a medium bowl combine the mozzarella cheese, tamari, and bay leaf. Mix well and spread two thirds of the mixture in a 13x9 inch baking dish. Arrange three of the broken lasagna halves over this, overlapping so they look almost like circles of noodles. Top with mozzarella cheese mixture. Repeat with the third layer of noodles. Cook in the preheated oven until the noodles are tender, about 30 minutes.

title: Phyllo Wrapped Cantaloupe Chips
ingredients: 1/2 cantaloupe, cut in half lenghwise and seeded | 3 tablespoons kosher salt | 1 lb phyllo pastry ( you could also use a pastry bag, but my friend does not like floury phyllo's ) | deep frying oil, for deep frying
instructions: Using a sharp knife, carefully pierce the tines of the cantaloupe halves in a horizontal line down the length of each cut. Remove them from the olive oil. If you are using a bag, do the same with the salt. If you are using a bag, just seal and use scissors to cut about ½ inch thick all around the cut surface. Place the cantaloupe on a plate or tray lined with plastic wrap and sprinkle generously with the kosher salt. Leave at room temperature for about 5 minutes. Preheat the oven to about 400 degrees f. Place a sheet of parchment paper on top of your pastry lined baking sheet. You may use a 9×13 inch baking pan. Cut a 2×8 inch lengthwise slit in the center of the phyllo sheets, making a “x” on the bottom and sides.. Sprinkle the tines liberally with the kosher salt. Place another sheet on top of the sheets on top of the first and lightly sprinkle with a little more. Working quickly, pull the sides down to form a “x” on the bottom and sides of the sheet. Do not “break” the sheets by itself. Add a few sheets of parchment to the parchment paper and place them on the sheet. Keep repeating until all the phyllo has been used. You may need a bit more or less for your stack. The sheets should look like loose sheets, about ¼ inch diameter. Fold on one side and cut in half. With a sharp knife, cut each half open like a book in 1/2 inch thick slices. You do not need to cut all the way through. Fry the “patty” 4 at a time in the deep fryer until golden brown and crispy  they should take about 12 minutes total. If you cook them in batches, you may need to drain them on paper towels after they have been fried to remove excess oil. They should be slightly charred on the outside and crispy on the inside. Remove from the oil and drain well. These can be kept in cool oven or refrigerated for up to 5 days or can be reheated and frozen for up to 6 months.

title: Baked Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb grated cheese | 1 pint meat stock | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 1/2 lb grated monterey jack cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 250f. Place grated cheese in a casserole dish that has a lid or a shallow loaf tin that will fit the cheese and meat. Mix all remaining ingredients together, including the cheese and pour into the casserole dish. Place a piece of foil over the top of the casserole dish to weigh down the cheese completely. Bake for approximately two hours. When it has cooled, remove foil and allow it to stand off the sides of the tin. When you remove cheese it will be fairly rare or very hard and delicious now it is time to eat.

Random Ingredients: gruyere cheese,sun tomato oil,lemon,pumpernickel bread,red chili powder,mango chutney
title: Grilled Cretters on a Pumpernickel and Mango Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lemon, juice of | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and chopped | 1 pinch red chili powder, to taste | 1 cup gruyere cheese, grated | 4 slices pumpernickel bread, toasted | mango chutney
instructions: In a bowl, combine the lemon juice and the sun dried tomatoes and mix well. Add the chili powder, stirring to coat. Add the cheese and mix well. Brush both sides of the toasted pumpernickel over both sides with the herb and olive oil mix. Grill for 2 minutes per side, or until golden brown. Top with mango chutney and serve.

title: Broccolied Spareribs
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs spareribs ( cut into three pieces ) | 1 medium head fresh broccoli | 3 cups water | 1/2 cup awamori | 3 packets artificial sweetener ( kikkoman's ) | 4 cups cooking oil
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350°f line a large rimmed baking sheet with aluminum foil. Tear off a large piece of parchment paper and lay evenly over the foil. Remove the string from the spareribs. Rinse and pat dry. Using tongs, place a rack 2 inches from the broccolades in a large roasting pan. Place the ribs on the foil lined pan and set aside for 2 hours or until the ribs are tender and easily removed from the bones. Remove ribs and discard the bones. Pull off the membrane from the broccoli and rinse it under cold water. Cut off the root ends of the broccoli and cut it into smaller pieces. Place the water, awamori and the sweetener in a blender and blend until combined. In a large heavy saucepan or dutch oven, heat the oil. Add the ribs and broccoli pieces and cook for 3 minutes over medium heat. Cover and place in the oven. Bake for 1 1/2 hours or until vegetables are tender. Remove the cover and cook for 20 minutes.

title: Tomato Pesto
ingredients: 1/3 cup chopped plum tomatoes | 1/3 cup chopped parsnips | 1 dash vanilla ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Pour into a small container.

Random Ingredients: millet,ginger garlic paste,flat leaf parsley,grain,white wine,tortilla
title: Moroccan Style Meatloaf
ingredients: 3 lbs ground meat, such as beef round | 1 large grain or 1 large flour, for dredging meat | 1/2 cup millet, soaked in warm water and drained | 1/2 cup white wine ( i use sauvignon blanc ) | 1/2 cup finely chopped fresh flat leaf parsley | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste, mixed with some water | warm tortilla, warmed if desired
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Combine meat and millet in bowl and mix well. Knead dough until smooth throughout mixture. Form into loaf on lightly floured surface, about 1 - ½ inches thick and 3 - ¼ inches deep. Arrange in 2 or 3 shallow baking pans. Pour just enough hot water into pans to come halfway up sides of pans. Bake until deep golden brown, about 40 - 45 minutes. About 30 minutes before meat is finished, spread parsley over loaf, then sprinkle with ginger garlic paste. Return loaf to oven, and bake for 40 minutes longer or until crust is puffed and golden brown, and juices appear clear. Cool slightly, then slice and serve.

title: Quick and Easy Green Chile
ingredients: 3 large green chili peppers | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin and 1/2 teaspoon of chopped fresh thyme sprig
instructions: Grind green chilies with a blender to your desired texture. In a medium sized non stick saucepan heat the ground cumin and thyme over medium heat until the smells fragrant. Add the chilies. Cook, stirring, until most of the water from the chilies can be absorbed and the green chilies begin to wilt. The longer it cooks, the sharper and spicier it gets. Transfer the chilies to a baking dish to cool. This is very important so the spices don't burn. Serve warm.

title: Crock Pot Baked Barley - Vegetables
ingredients: 1 cup barley ( soaked in water until tender ) | 1 bay leaf, broken into pieces | 3 tablespoons light soy sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients except vegetables in crock pot, turn on and on high. Stir and cook 30 - 40 minutes. The longer it simmers the sharper it gets. Do not stir it too vigorously. Put into a bowl, cover, and refrigerate for up to 5 days.

title: Spicy Maple Citrus Tea
ingredients: 2/3 cup pure maple syrup | 1/3 cup sriracha chili sauce | 1/4 cup fresh orange peel, minced | 2/3 cup fresh cilantro leaves, minced
instructions: In a small saucepan over medium low heat, combine maple syrup, sriracha sauce, and orange peel. Bring to a boil, then remove from the heat. Allow to cool, then refrigerate until thoroughly chilled. Pour cooled syrup into a tea cup.

title: Tuscan Scallops and Pork (Piglets Con Gringes)
ingredients: 6 large scallops ( about 1 1/2 pounds total ) | 2 -3 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained, finely chopped | 1 lb ground pork | 1 cup granulated sugar, divided | 3 cups chicken stock or 3 cups reduced sodium broth | 1 cup fresh broccoli, coarsely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Place scallops in a small bowl, cover with boiling water and let stand 10 minutes before cutting scallops into 3/4 wide strips. Drain in a colander and squeeze all liquid out and discard the oil that clings to the meat. In a medium saucepan, combine 2 tablespoons sun dried tomatoes, pork, 1 teaspoon sugar and chicken or vegetable stock. Bring to a boil.

title: Green Soup
ingredients: 2 ounces french bread | 10 ounces frozen spinach leaves, thawed | 1 1/2 cups strong hot coffee
instructions: Cut the bread into 1/2 inch cubes. Place into a large saucepan with 1/4 cup water. Cover and simmer 5 minutes. Add the spinach, and cook until tender, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat, and stir in the hot coffee. Cover and let stand about 30 minutes before serving.

title: Fried Snapper(Or Fish)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons soy sauce | 3 tablespoons masa harina | 1 teaspoon grenadine, plus | 2 tablespoons grenadine | 1 medium red snapper fillets, quartered ( or other firm white fish )
instructions: In a bowl, mix the soy sauce, masa harina and grenadine until well blended and creamy. Add the snapper or fish and turn to coat both sides well. Heat a 10 inch skillet or griddle. Add a few pieces of fish at a time so they do not overcrowd and cook to desired doneness. As the fish cooks, the moisture left in the base of the pan will evaporate. When the fish becomes firm, remove from pan and arrange on warmed plates. Drizzle each piece with some of the reserved sauce.

title: Sweet Garlic Basil Spaghetti!
ingredients: 2 garlic cloves, crushed | 1 tablespoon cumin powder | 1/4 cup ketchup | 1 tablespoon honey | 1 tablespoon basil, chopped fresh | 200 g cooked spaghetti
instructions: Boil the spaghetti until al dente, reserve some water. While waiting for the pasta to boil, combine all other ingredients in a bowl and blend well. Serve over hot pasta & serve.

Random Ingredients: chicken wing,coconut extract,serrano pepper,vegetable,veal,vanilla essence,dijon mustard
title: Easy Vanilla Chicken Wings
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg chicken wings, cut into 4 segments | 4 large vegetables, cut into 4 pieces each ( carrots, potatoes, leeks and onion ) | 125 g coconut extract | 3/4 cup dijon mustard | 1 -2 serrano pepper | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 600 ml v8 vegetable juice concentrate
instructions: Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet on medium heat, then turn heat down to low until oil smoke and bubbles. Add all veggies and cook until they are browned and slightly crisp, and add coconut extract, dijon and vanilla. Simmer for about 10 minutes, uncovered. Once they are tender mix with the veggie mixture and serve.

Random Ingredients: lemon peel,cabbage,italian parsley,romaine lettuce,lime juice,salt,egg noodle
title: Baggy's Lettuce Salad
ingredients: 3 eggs noodles, cooked, drained, & cooled | 1 head cabbage, shredded or shredded | 2 tablespoons italian parsley, chopped | 1 teaspoon lemon peel | 1 tablespoon fresh lime juice | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 2 cups romaine lettuce, shredded
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Refrigerate at least one hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: turnip,chocolate square,flat leaf parsley,yeast,water chestnut,pomegranate molasses
title: Choc-Pacific Wonder Bread
ingredients: 3 cups bread flour or 3 cups bread flour, divided | 2 cups pomegranate molasses ( not diet ) | 2 ounces yeast, plus | 2 teaspoons yeast, softened in | 1/2 cup warm water or 1/2 cup chicken stock | 1 small turnip, peeled and shredded | 1/2 cup chopped flat leaf parsley or 1/2 cup cilantro | 1 can water chestnuts, drained and chopped
instructions: Combine 2 cups plus 2 cups of the flour or bread flour with the pomegranate molasses, and yeast in the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with a paddle attachment or in the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with dough hook. Turn the dough on to the dough hook, add the remaining flour 1 cup, and mix for a few minutes on low speed. If the mixture is too wet, add a little more flour. Add the turnip and parsley and mix until the mixture forms a ball. Add the water chestnuts, and add the remaining 1/2 cup flour, mix well, then cover and let rise until doubled. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and shape into a round loaf about 1/8 inch thick, and place in a greased 9 x 5 x 3 - 3 inch or larger baking pan. Cover with a towel and let rise for an hour. Preheat oven to 375°f and lightly butter a sheet pan. Turn the dough out onto the prepared sheet pan and poke with a skewer all over. Let the loaf rise until doubled in size, around 45 minutes, brushing the top of the loaf twice with olive oil every 10 - 30 minutes or so. Bake the loaf for 40 - 45 minutes or until the top of the bread is golden brown and the loaf sounds hollow when tapped on the bottom. Allow the loaf to cool to room temperature, and store it tightly wrapped in plastic or plastic storage bag or in a cool, dry place.

title: Flaming Olive Tansiyaki
ingredients: 100 ml mirin | 200 g green olives | 1 1/2 tablespoons brown gravy mix | 2 -3 pinches saffron ( optional ) | 4 tablespoons peanut oil
instructions: Remove pits from olives, slice into a little dice. In a non stick pan, heat oil on high until smoking and then add olives and stir fry until the olives are soft. Dissolve gravy mix with water, add to pan and stir until boiling and then reduce heat and simmer, stirring intermittently and ensuring the olives do not stick to each other. Remove from heat and stir in saffron powder and salt. Serve immediately over grilled fish and sweet potato fries.

title: Homemade French Bread Machine  (Paneer)
ingredients: 5 lbs fresh yeast ( approximately ) | 1 1/4 quarts mustard powder | 12 ounces bacon ( approximately ) | 24 ounces sherry wine vinegar | 24 ounces garlic paste
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 3 1/2 cups of warm water. If your yeast doesn't foam, you may need to add a little more warm water. Place mustard & salt in the bottom of the pan with a large flat bottom such as saucer. Make sure the top of the mustard is clean before you place any yeast on top unless necessary. You should only need 1 teaspoon of salt per loaf. Begin to mix the yeast with one cup of the remaining water, bacon drippings and garlic. Place the bread machine on the dough cycle. After the rest of the dough cycle, remove the bread from the loaf pan, place on a clean towel and let rise until doubled. Turn the loaf out onto a floured counter. With lightly floured hands, form the dough into a long loaf shape. Place the loaf in a lightly floured baking pan. Cover with parchment and let rise until almost double. Place bread in a preheated 350 degree to 400 degree oven. Bake until browned and loaves sound hollow when tapped on the bottom, about 30 minutes. Watch closely.

title: Tahini Chicken
ingredients: 600 g rump steak, cut into chunks | 1 tablespoon brown rice flour | 2 tablespoons tahini | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried rosemary | 2 tablespoons roasting chickens
instructions: Preheat oven to 190°c. Combine the rice flour, oil, rosemary and tahini in a large bowl. Add the meat and toss to coast. Place the chicken pieces on a greased tray and bake in the pre heated oven for 15 - 20 minutes, basting occasionally. Serve immediately with salads and garden salad or steamed veggies.

Random Ingredients: lychee,stewing beef,egg noodle,apricot,arborio rice,button mushroom,french baguette,superfine sugar
title: Beef & Mushroom Stuffed Baguettes
ingredients: 4 ounces button mushrooms, cleaned ( such as chanterelles, about 12 medium ) | 8 ounces lean stewing beef, fat removed, finely chopped | 1 egg noodles, such as chewy ones | 1 teaspoon superfine sugar | 4 ounces risotto rice | 2 1/2 fluid ounces ouzo or 2 1/2 fluid ounces extra virgin olive oil | 25 large dried apricots, snipped into halves | 4 ounces french baguettes, halved lenghtways
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c/180°c. Heat a large non stick frying pan over medium hig heat and add the beef and brown it well on all sides. Remove the beef from the pan and set aside. Using the same pan, cook the egg noodles until tender, drain. Add the sugar to the beef in the pan, then stir in the rice and set aside until ready to use. Meanwhile, roughly chop the mushrooms, then place them into a large bowl with the beef and egg noodles. Mix in the ouzo and season with salt and pepper. Preheat the broiler, and line a large baking tray with foil. Spoon the mixture into the baguettes, then transfer them to the tray and cut a cross in the top, to allow space to expand. Put the baguette on a baking sheet and bake for 10 - 15 minutes, or until the tops are lightly golden. Serve the baguettes immediately with fresh garden salad leaves, a sharp green salad and a crisp green salad.

title: Smoked Salmon Stew
ingredients: 1/2 - 2/3 lb smoked salmon, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1/2 - 3/4 lb meatballs ( i usually buy 2 packages ) | 1/2 - 3/4 cup frozen peas | poultry seasoning ( i actually use poultry salt and pepper powder ) | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon cumin or 1/2-1 teaspoon other spices | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon allspice, as desired
instructions: Mix spices together in a microwave safe casserole.

title: Homestyle Meat Patties for Two Recipe
ingredients: 1 package dry egg noodles | 3/4 lb ground meat | 1 cup bread crumbs | 1 cup grated pecorino-romano cheese
instructions: Cook egg noodles according to package directions until al dente and drain. In large bowl, add ground meat, bread crumbs, cheese and drained egg noodles and combine. Shape into 15 large patties. Place patties in a skillet with a bit of oil on all sides and cook until they are browned approximately 5 minutes per side.

Random Ingredients: cornflour,chive,flat leaf parsley,mushroom,black eyed pea,bird eye chile,lentil,poblano chile
title: Spiced Lentil & Corned Beef
ingredients: 250 g dried black-eyed peas ( soaked overnight ) | 500 g lentils ( soaked overnight ) | 1/2 teaspoon crushed dried poblano chile | 150 g flat leaf parsley ( chopped ) | 300 g mushrooms ( sliced ) | 1 bird's eye chile ( chopped ) | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 3 -4 tablespoons fresh chives, shredded ( for garnishing )
instructions: Cook lentils & lentils in a large sauce pan of plenty of water, for approx 20 mins, till lentils are softened & cooked. Stir well. Meanwhile chop parsley finely and put aside. Saute mushrooms, chilie, chives. Drain lentils and lentils. Mix cornflour w/salt & pepper to taste & add to lentils. Cook on slow/low heat for approx 30 mins stirring a few times. This should be a dark thick paste. Garnish w/cream & serve w/grated parmesan.

title: Chicken Roulades
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves ( about 1 pound total ) | 1 cup chopped fresh parsley leaves | 1 package refrigerated crispy rolls ( about 24 rolls ) | 2/3 cup chopped fresh dill pickle
instructions: Place the chicken breasts in a saucepan. Pour in enough water to cover the chicken. Bring to a boil.

title: Fruit and Vegable Fritters, Crock Pot
ingredients: 1 tablespoon white flour | 1 1/2 cups vegetarian refried beans | 1 cup guinness stout | 2 cups shredded lettuce | 1 small turnip, peeled, grated ( or grated ) | 1 cup shredded celery seed | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 1/2 cup shredded lettuce
instructions: Spray a 1 1/2 quart slow cooker with cooking spray. Combine flour, refried beans, guinness, lettuce, turnip, celery seed and salt in the slow cooker, stir until evenly coated with flour mixture. Cover and cook on high 7 - 10 hours or on low 4 - 5 hours or until crisp and tender. Remove cover and serve immediately over rice. Serves.

title: Easy Roast Beef
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs roast ( any cuts will do ) | 3 turnips, peeled | 1 can enchilada sauce
instructions: Cut the roast into small pieces place on a baking dish. Bake in oven until very tender. About 3 hours or so at low temperature. Remove from the oven. Add 1 can of the enchilada sauce, stirring to mix. Pour over the roast. Put back in the oven and bake another 30 minutes or so. Serve with flour tortillas or fresh veggies.

title: Crispy Asian Sprout
ingredients: 2 cups fresh alfalfa sprouts | 1 tablespoon chili sauce | 1 dash ginger-chili sauce | 1 dash powdered marinade
instructions: First, make sure you have all the ingredients ready and then mix well. You can let it rest for a few minutes then add the sprouts. It is easier to put the ingredients in together if you let them sit on the counter for a few hours.

title: Simple & Delicious Beef
ingredients: 1/4 cup simple syrup | 1 lb stewing beef | 1 bottle guiness salsa-flavored tomato dressing | 1 cup crumbled queso fresco
instructions: Heat simple syrup over low heat in deep heavy pot. Bring to boil then pour over meat. Cover and simmer about 1 1/2 hours stirring occasionally until meat is tender. Add salsa and cheese. Simmer over low heat until cheese is melted, stirring often. Serve over plain buttered egg noodles.

Random Ingredients: gruyere cheese,chicken broth,kosher salt black pepper,pork loin roast
title: Pork Roast in Gruyere Sauce
ingredients: kosher salt and ground black pepper to taste | 1 boneless pork loin roast | 1 jar prepared chicken broth, divided | 1 cup shredded gruyere cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Season salt and pepper to taste on one side of the pork roast. Place the pork roast in a roasting pan. Arrange 1 cup of the chicken broth over the pork roast. Spread the gruyere cheese evenly over the pork roast. Place the roasting pan on the center rack of a preheated oven, and roast until the meat thermometer inserted into the center of the roast registers 160 degrees f, about 1 1/2 hours. Let the roast rest for 10 minutes. Serve warm or at room temperature. Serves.

Random Ingredients: nectarine,italian plum tomato,plum tomato,rice vinegar,sauce,eggplant,red grape,clove
title: Grilled Eggplant Antipasto
ingredients: 1 eggplant, cut into 1 1/2 inch slices | 2 plum tomatoes, cut into wedges | 2 nectarines - peeled, cored, and quartered | 5 plums, halved | red grapes, quartered | hot sauce, such as tabasco, to taste | 1 teaspoon rice vinegar | 2 cloves
instructions: Place the eggplant in shallow glass or ceramic dish. Add enough hot water to cover and let stand for 1 hour. Drain. Brush lightly with hot sauce and grill until browned on all sides and tender, 3 to 4 minutes per side. Brush the eggplant with oil and grill, turning frequently, until crisp and light brown, about 5 minutes. Grill the nectarines, plums, and tomatoes until the plums, tomatoes, and eggplant have given off their juice, about 20 minutes. Turn the broiler on so the flame is moderately high. Sprinkle the grilled eggplant mixture with a pinch of salt and pepper and serve with guacamole and red onion, if desired.

title: Lions Too Sweet Beef
ingredients:
1 3/4 lbs stew beef chunks, 1.
    -667 to 2kg | 1 1/4 cups saki dipping sauce ( we use kikkoman's golden syrup sweet & spicy soy sauce ) | 1/3 cup soy sauce
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Place the beef in a baking dish. In a small bowl, combine the dipping sauce, soy sauce, and golden syrup or saki. Pour over the beef. Sprinkle with more sugar and bake about 4 hours or until tender.

title: Lahmahjoon (Beef over Bulgur Wheat)
ingredients: 1 lb beef chuck, boneless, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 tablespoon ginger paste | 2 poblano chiles, minced | 1/8 cup dry bulgur, medium grain | 1/4 lb ground fresh plum tomatoes or 1/4 lb canned plum tomatoes | 3 cans of chopped clams
instructions: To make a paste, combine ginger and garlic paste in a heavy dutch oven. Cut chuck into 1 inch cubes and saute over med high heat. Stir frequently so nothing sticks. When meat changes color, add ginger garlic paste and continue to stir well. Add poblano chilies. Stir and fry for 1 - 2 minutes. Add bulgur and stir well to blend. Stir in clams and heat through. Serve in a large bowl.

Random Ingredients: jumbo pasta shell,black eyed pea,masa harina,paprika,shiitake mushroom
title: Jambalaya (Peruvian Black Bean Stew with Shells)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons masa harina | 1 can black-eyed peas, rinsed and drained | 12 ounces shiitake mushrooms, cleaned and sliced | 12 ounces jumbo pasta shells | 2 tablespoons paprika
instructions: In a large saucepan, stir together the masa harina, black eyed peas, shiitake mushrooms, and jumbo pasta shells. Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring often. Simmer about 2 minutes, then remove from heat. Season with paprika to taste. When ready to serve, spoon stew into bowls.

title: Chinese Five Spice
ingredients: 1 teaspoon celery seed | 1 teaspoon chili flakes | 1/2 teaspoon allspice | 1 teaspoon hoisin sauce
instructions: Combine ingredients, cover and store in a cool dark, dry place.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,rye bread,walnut,thai basil,italian tomato,pineapple juice,picante sauce,iceberg lettuce
title: Rye Salad
ingredients: 4 cups chopped iceberg lettuce | 1 loaf fresh rye bread ( about 6 loaves ) | 1/3 cup picante sauce | 4 cups diced swiss cheese | 1 can pineapple tidbits in tomato juice, drained | 1/2 cup chopped walnuts | 1/2 cup fresh thai basil, minced
instructions: Cut the bread loaves in half lengthwise. Hollow out and reserve the crust and cut pieces into bite size pieces and place together in a large bowl. In a small bowl, combine the picante sauce and the 1/2 cup pineapple juice. Add to the other ingredients. Toss with the bread and let chill 1 hour. Remove the bread, reserving the bread liquid. Coat the chilled bread pieces in the picante sauce and let sit at room temperature until ready to serve. Cut the reserved bread into small bite size pieces and stir in with the salad. Serve salad sprinkled with nuts and basil.

Random Ingredients: tomato juice,rose lime juice,pancetta,caramel ice cream topping,apple,quinoa

instructions: Preheat oven to 400f degrees. Combine quinoa and apples in a large baking dish and cover with liquid from tomatoes. Add pancetta, tomato juice and rosemary. Drizzle with the caramel coating. Bake for 15 minutes. Turn off oven and allow to cool approximately 20 minutes. Spoon quinoa mixture into food processor and pulse until semi smooth. Divide among four warmed oven proof serving dishes and top with ice cream topping.
