title: Lazy Peruvian Black Beans
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs russet potatoes, peeled and diced unpeeled | 1 can black beans | 1 tablespoon shortening or 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili powder | 1 teaspoon beef bouillon ( or granules, to thicken ) | 1/3 cup fresh parsley leaves, snipped
instructions: Dice potatoes into 1/2 cubes and set aside. Place black beans in a pot and cover with water. Bring to boil. Boil for 30 to 40 minutes or until beans become soft. Drain and set aside. In a frying pan, melt shortening or lard and cook potato cubes in the oil until golden brown on all sides. Add beans, salt and 1 teaspoon of beef bouillon powder. Stir to combine. Turn heat down to low. Cover and cook over low heat about 30 minutes or until potatoes are soft. Add parsley and cooked black beans, stir to combine and let simmer on low about 15 minutes. Serve and enjoy.

title: Cambodian Okra (Sweet Potato) and Okra Juice
ingredients: 6 okra, cut into quarters | 4 tablespoons madras curry powder ( to taste ) | 1 cup pomegranate juice ( or a bit of jaggery ) | 1 -2 green cardamom pod
instructions: Slice the okra quarters. Place okra in a saucepan and stir in curry powder. Bring to a boil then reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring regularly, or until okra is tender. Place pomegranate juice, cardamom pods and green cardamom pods in a blender and process until smooth. Pour mixture over okra and let cool, then refrigerate and serve.

title: Ginger-Ginger Marinade
ingredients: 1/4 cup minced gingerroot | 4 tablespoons minced fresh parsley sprig | 7 tablespoons grand marnier
instructions: Combine all ingredients.

title: Kirma Kebab and Mixed Berries
ingredients: 250 g mixed berries | 1/2 teaspoon saffron strand | 1 tablespoon tahini | 275 ml yogurt, beaten ( full fat ) | 4 teaspoons red bell peppers, finely chopped ( or green or red )
instructions: Place the first three ingredients in a pan, sprinkle with the saffron and stir in the tahini. Allow to simmer a few minutes, stirring well. Add the red peppers, stir again to heat through. Allow to cool a little bit, then gently pour into serving bowls. Serve with pitta bread.

title: Shakespearean Bistro's Baked Rigatoni With Fresh Herbs & Sour Cream
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs rigatoni pasta, uncooked | 8 fresh thyme sprigs, leaves picked ( about a handful ) | 2 1/2 cups sour cream | fresh chives, finely chopped ( for garnish )
instructions: Bring large pot of water to boil and add salt. Add the rigatoni, and cook until al dente. Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Drain the rigatoni and pour into a shallow bowl. Add the thyme leaves and sour cream to the rigatoni and mix until well combined. Stir in the chives just before serving. Place in a large oven proof dish and bake until hot through, about 30 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Indian Meatball Appetizer
ingredients: 1 bag frozen precooked meatballs, cooked | 1/4 cup chili sauce | 2 tablespoons light soy sauce | 1 teaspoon garam masala ( or curry powder ) | 1 1/2 cups broccolini, finely chopped or 1 1/2 cups baby spinach, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup fat free greek yogurt
instructions: Place frozen meatballs in a plastic bag with the chili sauce, light soy, garam masala and broccolini & shake to coat meatballs. Bake in a 325 degree oven for 20 - 25 minutes. Combine yogurt and meatballs in a medium mixing bowl. Serve with warm pita bread, pita chips, salad or panko bread to go with your meal.

Random Ingredients: rose petal,cayenne pepper,marshmallow,mint leaf,graham cracker crumb,chicken wing
title: Harry's Secret Chicken Wings
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds chicken wings, tips removed | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs | 2 teaspoons dried mint leaves | 1/2 teaspoon ground cayenne pepper | 1 sprig fresh mint leaves, for garnish | 12 rose petals, for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place chicken wings in a shallow dish or resealable plastic bag. In a medium bowl, stir graham cracker crumbs into ground mint, cayenne pepper, and mint leaves. Roll wing tips in cracker mixture, one at a time, coating the tips of the wings and tossing to evenly coat. Place coated wings in a baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven 45 minutes, or until done. Cool wings in the baking dish on a rack. Repeat with remaining chicken wings. Transfer wings to a serving dish and garnish with rose petals. Serve with plain yogurt and chutney.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon,sugar cube,red chile,cornstarch,olive,nonfat cream,caster sugar
title: Chilli Pepper and Lime Glaze  (With Freezing Only)
ingredients: 4 -5 red chiles | 2 1/4 cups nonfat sour cream ( full fat, low fat ) | 4 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 1/3 cups sugar cubes | 1 1/3 cups pitted ripe olives | 1 pinch chicken bouillon, crushed ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons nonfat sour cream
instructions: To prepare the glaze, roast the dried chilies, in a dry fryingpan, over medium high heat until the chilies soften, turning them a few times, for 2 - 3 minutes. Remove and allow to cool. Halve the chiles lengthways, remove the seeds and cores and cut off the hard stem. Place them in a small blender with the water and the sour cream and puree. In a non stick frying pan or a wok place the soured cream and the cornstarch and cook over medium heat, whisking until the sauce thickens. Add the sugar, olives, and chicken bouillon and cook on medium high heat until the mixture thickens a little. Add the sweetened sour cream and reduce the heat to low. Place the chilies, with the heat still on, in a plastic bag and marinate in the refrigerator overnight. Bring to room temperature before using.

title: French Onion Cream Cheese Dip #2
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese, softened | 1 egg white | 1 tablespoon white vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Beat cream cheese and egg white well together to blend well. Blend white vinegar and cream cheese in a separate bowl until smooth. Fold cream cheese and vinegar mix into egg white. Blend well. Transfer the mixture to a glass baking dish, but not more than ¾ cup capacity. Bake the mixture for approximately 50 minutes. Serve with crackers or french fries.

title: Pittsburghsburgh Potatoes
ingredients: 3 pounds red potatoes, quartered | 2 pounds red potatoes, quartered
instructions: Place the red potatoes into a large pot and cover with salted water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer until tender, 20 to 25 minutes. Drain and allow to steam dry for a bit of steam. Transfer the potatoes to a large bowl and mash with a potato masher until the potatoes are finely ground. Return potatoes to the cooking pot and mash until desired texture is achieved. Place about 1 1/2 cups of the mashed potato into each of two soup dishes and drop each potato into the hot soup. Cook the potatoes over medium heat until the bottoms are lightly toasted and the inner edges are starting to soften, 4 to 10 minutes. Turn the heat off and allow the to steam dry for a bit of steam.

title: Noodle Kugel
ingredients: 1 beef bouillon cube | 3 tablespoons lemon peel | 1 package egg noodles
instructions: Mix the beef bouillon and the juice from the jar of noodles and the lemon peel. The key is on the noodles to be really soft. Pour the kugel into a bowl and let it sit until they're done to your liking. This will give you time to work with them. After the noodles are done drain them and then place them in a paper sack to allow some of the water to run off before you go on to prep the rest. When you are ready for the noodles and the kugel bag is in the sink mix them together and eat.

title: Tibetan Meatballs
ingredients: 1 egg yolk | 1 1/4 cups sugar | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1/4 cup catsup | 1/4 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Place all of the ingredients into a large bowl and beat with a mixer. Shape the mixture into meatballs the size of your index finger. Arrange on a greased, floured surface. Spray your hands with non stick spray and flatten the meatballs.. Heat a skillet over medium high heat & cook the meatballs for 10 minutes, turning once. Serve with your favorite dipping sauce or fruit dipping sauce and or a loaf of bread.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,vegetable shortening,greek yogurt,cajun seasoning
title: Sun-Dried Tomato Cream
ingredients: 1/2 cup plain balkan greek yogurt | 4 teaspoons cajun seasoning | 1/2 cup vegetable shortening | 8 dried sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained and patted dry
instructions: In small bowl, stir together the yogurt and cajun seasoning. Set aside. In microwave safe bowl, microwave shortening in medium microwave for 15 seconds, or until completely melted and shortening is very hot. Carefully stir in sun dried tomatoes. Microwave on high 1 minute, stirring after every 30 seconds. Remove from microwave.

title: Bombay Crab Cocktail
ingredients: 1 packet imitation crabmeat | 1 teaspoon sweet cayenne | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 1/2 lime, juice of | 1/2 teaspoon custard powder
instructions: Mix the cayenne and coriander powder in a glass bowl. Slice the limejuice into small peices and then into a small bowl with the rest of the ingredients. Pour the limey mixture into the bowl with the crabmeat. Mix the mixture well. Chill before serving.

Random Ingredients: white fish fillet,chicken broth,head broccoli,dill,quinoa,espresso powder,heavy whipping cream,fava bean
title: Baked Fish
ingredients: 1 package dry quinoa | 1 head broccoli, cut into florets | 1 can fava beans | 1 1/2 cups chicken broth | 1 tablespoon instant espresso powder | 1/3 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/3 cup chopped fresh dill | 1 pound skinless white fish fillets
instructions: Place quinoa in a large bowl. Place broccoli in the bowl and cover with 2 inches of water.

title: Vanillekipferln (Vanilla Vanilla Bean Balls)
ingredients: 2 packages vanilla beans, split lengthwise | 4 cups rice flour ( to make the dough ) | 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce or 1/2 teaspoon paprika
instructions: Place the split vanilla pods into a pan of hot water, stir, and set aside. Place the rice flour in a small bowl, and add 1/2 cup water. Stir well, making sure the flour doesn't clump. Place the remaining 1/2 cup of water in a plastic bag, add the hot flour, and close the bag with your hands. Allow the water to soak into the flour until it begins to form small, grainy clumps, and take the flour out of the sack. Repeat, until the flour is all gone. Roll the dough between your palms, place the balls on a tray lined with parchment paper, and let rest for 20 minutes. Once the 20 minutes are up, knead the dough a couple of times, and roll into 1 inch balls. Roll each ball in your hands until they have a well coated, flat surface. Place the balls on a tray lined with parchment paper, and let rest before you roll them in the next step. Once the 20 minutes are up, preheat your grill or stovetop grill, setting a gas grill to high and cooking them on high until they are light to medium, about 5 minutes. Cut the vanilla pod lengthwise into 1/2 inch slices, and place onto the grill to dry off the skin slightly.

title: Steamed Noodles With Mustard and Orange Peel
ingredients: 12 ounces noodles, boiled according to package instructions ( any long width noodles ) | 1 1/2 lbs ground veal | 1/2 cup minced fresh ginger ale | 1 orange peel, finely grated ( zest of one small ) | 15 wonton skins
instructions: Cook noodles until tender. Meanwhile, heat grill. In a large bowl, combine ground meat, grated orange peel, and grated ginger ale. Place wonton skins on a dry work surface and mound about 1/4 cup meat mixture on each. Brush edges of wrapper with some water, then cover wrapper with wax paper. Bring 2 inches of water to boil and gently place wrapper on top of the wrapper, about 1/2 inch from top. Steam for 2 minutes, then remove wrapper, place on cutting board and place on board with tongs. Repeat with remaining wrapper and meat mixture. To serve, place cooked noodle on plate and ladle sauce over.

title: Japanese Pot Roast - Shio-Kami
ingredients: 3 lbs top round rump roast, preferably with 1 to 1 1/2 inch thick roast | 2 tablespoons lime juice | 3/4 cup finely chopped onion | 1 tablespoon sake
instructions: Combine lime juice and onion together in a small mixing bowl and set aside. Score the top round roast by slicing very deeply into top layer of roast diagonally across the center at 1 inch intervals. Lay on top of onion mixture. Put shio kami in a large sealable container and pour lime juice/onion mixture overtop. Seal tightly and allow to marinate in refrigerator overnight, turning several times. Cook time is marinating time for shio kami. Preheat grill to high heat. Cut a slit in top and bottom of roast at 2 to 3 inches deep and cut parallel lines across the length of the roast. Push between cuts to make a diamond design. You will be placing the roast on the grill. Grill the roast for 1 minute on each side, until nicely browned and tender. Place shio kami on a hot platter, remove the bone. Add rice kami to the platter. Serve.

title: Agedi
ingredients: 12 large button mushrooms | 6 ounces halibut fillets | 1 teaspoon reduced tamari | 1 tablespoon toasted sesame oil | 7 ounces tofu
instructions: Wipe mushrooms from caps to remove any dirt and cut away the stems. Cut away the white membrane by rubbing underneath with a soft cloth. Set mushrooms aside in a bowl and pour the water from the mushrooms and the cooking water over. Turn the mushroom caps occasionally and cover tightly. Cook in a saucepan of boiling, slated water for 3 minutes. Add halibut and heat through for 2 - 3 minutes more, then season with salt and pepper to taste. Divide the steamed mushrooms among 6 ramekins or warmed serving bowls, then top with tofu, then carefully pour over tamari. Sprinkle sesame oil over the top. Serve at once.

title: Coconut Magic
ingredients: 2 cups coconut milk | 1 whole serrano chilies
instructions: Puree the coconut milk, whole chilies, and red onion together in a blender or food processor until they become a paste.

title: Low Fat Shrimp and Chicken
ingredients: 1 can fat free condensed cream of chicken soup | 8 ounces medium shrimp, unpeeled and peeled | 3 cups chicken broth or 3 cups water
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together soup and shrimp. Stir in broth. Chill the mixture at least 2 hours.

title: Brothy White Chili With Tomatoes, Tomatoes and White Chocolate
ingredients: 1/2 cup unsalted white chocolate | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, no substitutes ( undrained ) | 1/3 cup orange juice concentrate, thawed | 1/2 cup broth
instructions: Microwave chocolate to soften, stir in tomatoes. Stir in orange juice concentrate.

title: Capellini With Black Beans and Swiss Chard
ingredients: 1 lb swiss chard, stemmed | 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained | 4 green chilies, seeded, diced | 1/4 cup basil leaves, thinly sliced | 2 teaspoons sesame oil | 1 lb capellini, cooked
instructions: Heat a large pot of water with salt according to directions, then add the pasta. Toss the chard until wilted and beginning to color, 1 to 2 minutes. Drain well, then toss in the swiss chard with the beans, chiles, basil, and sesame oil. Add the pasta to the hot water, reduce heat, and simmer 5 minutes or until the pasta is done. Serve with grated parmesan.

title: My Favorite Rice and Veggies for Canning
ingredients: 1 cup textured vegetable protein ( i like the french fries ) | 1/2 fresh lemon zest | 3 cups cooked instant rice
instructions: To make rice, place all ingredients in a saucepan.

title: Garnishful Poblano Chili
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds poblano chiles, stemmed and deveined | 1/2 cup guacamole | 1/4 cup basil pesto | 3 tablespoons molasses
instructions: Heat a grill pan over medium high heat to medium high heat. Place the poblano chilies on the grill and grill until blackened on all sides, about 10 minutes. Turn and grill for 7 to 10 minutes more, then remove from heat and cut off the blackened skin. Transfer the chilies to an airtight container until cool enough to handle. Use your fingers or a spoon to pull out and discard the pulp and white seeds. Place the chilies in a medium bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Chill until firm, about 30 minutes. Preheat grill pan over medium heat. Toast and spread the poblano chilies in the pan and spread with the guacamole. Place the pesto sauce in a blender and add the molasses, then pour into a small saucepan. Bring to a boil and cook about 5 minutes, until thickened. Place poblano salsa in a small bowl and stir in the guacamole and pesto until well blended. Spoon into a shallow bowl and top with remaining poblano salsa.

title: Pork Sauce and Marshmallows Filled Spicy Sausages for One
ingredients: 1 kg bulk sweet italian sausage | 1 large sweet potato | 1 cup soymilk | 1/4 cup chocolate syrup | 1 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1 teaspoon cornflour
instructions: Cut up sausage into 1 cm slices. Warm potato in microwave for 5 minutes. Pierce potato several times with a fork and place in microwave safe bowl. Microwave on high for 8 minutes. Turn heat down to medium and cook for another 6 minutes. Turn and cook another 5 minutes. Drain sausage and mash using a fork. In a large bowl, mix sweet potato, soymilk, chocolate syrup, cardamom powder and cornflour. Stir to combine. Lightly spray fry pan with pam and place over medium heat. Add sausage slices and cook until lightly browned, breaking up with a wooden spoon. Remove sausage slices. Spoon sausage and sauce onto serving plate.

title: Fiery cardamom (Powder)
ingredients: 8 dried chilies, crushed | 1/2 cup cardamom seeds, crushed | 1 teaspoon pure chile, preferably bird's eye
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a non reactive bowl. Cover and refrigerate until required.

title: Italian Beef and Bean-Stuffed Ciabatta Sandwiches
ingredients: 3/4-inch-thick slices canned spaghetti sauce | 1 1/2 lbs lean boneless lean beef chuck, thinly sliced | 1 ciabatta rolls or ( 5 inch ) other round bread roll | 12 ounces bean sprouts
instructions: Heat oven to 375°f spread spaghetti sauce over bottom of 10x15 inch glass baking dish. Arrange beef evenly over sauce.

Random Ingredients: pizza crust,greek yogurt,dark molasses,cream,baking soda,white bread,dark brown sugar,chicken
title: Greek Chicken Pizza
ingredients: 2 1/2 - 3 lbs chicken, cooked, cubed | 2 cups greek yogurt | 2 tablespoons dark molasses | 2 teaspoons white molasses | 2 teaspoons baking soda | 6 tablespoons sour cream | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar | 1 pizza crust, unbaked, greased | 1 dark molasses, blended with | 2 teaspoons dark brown sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Mix together sour cream, 1/2 cup dark molasses, soda & sour cream. Fold in brown sugar to mixture. Spread yogurt mixture over crust. Distribute remaining sauce over the top, spreading to all areas. Cover with parchment paper. Bake 35 minutes or until bubbly.

Random Ingredients: chocolate chip,water chestnut,self rising flour,pickle,sage leaf,pistachio,dill,tuna vegetable oil
title: Sage Tuna Melt
ingredients: 5 ounces self-rising flour | 1/2 cup boiling water | 1 ounce unsweetened chocolate chips | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh sage leaf | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh dill | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh sage leaves | 1 can tuna in vegetable oil, drained | 1 small pickle, finely diced | 4 ounces shaved bittersweet chocolate round, cut into matchsticks
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place flour and hot water in a bowl.

title: Irish Herb Bread
ingredients: 3 cups unbleached white flour | 2 tablespoons reduced-salt instant yeast ( about 2 1/2 tablespoons ) | 1 tablespoon fresh parsley leaves, coarsely chopped ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon thyme leaves, crushed ( optional )
instructions: Place the flour in a large bowl and sprinkle the yeast over it. Using an electic mixer, beat the flour for a minute or two on high until it bubbles. Then add the remaining ingredients and mix until they are incorporated completely. Turn out onto a well floured surface and knead for about 8 minutes, working in the flour a little at a time, until the dough is soft and elastic. Place in an oiled mixing bowl and cover tightly with a cloth. Let rise for about 1 hour, or until the dough has doubled in size. Grease a 7½ x 3½ x 2 - ½ inch loaf pan and turn the dough out onto the prepared pan. Stretch the top crust to fit into the 5½ x 3½ inch loaf pan and set aside it for the top crust allowance. Bake the bread in a preheated 450 degree f oven for 22 minutes, or until golden brown. Let cool on a wire rack for about 10 minutes and carefully remove the cake from the pan. Transfer to a wire rack to cool completely. Store in an airtight container.

title: Luxury Lasagna
ingredients: 10 large uncooked lasagna noodles | 1 cup green and white wine | 1/2 cup golden raisins | 3/4 cup grated pecorino cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add lasagna pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: guinness stout,peanut,part mozzarella cheese,brown onion,lager beer,chicken thigh,marjoram
title: Guinness-Lager Chicken
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs chicken thighs skinned, boned, and cut into 1- 1/2-inch pieces | 4 medium brown onions, cut into wedges | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried marjoram | 1 bottle lager beer | 8 ounces guinness stout | 2 cups shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese | 1/3 cup dry roasted peanuts, coarsely chopped
instructions: Place chicken pieces in a shallow 2 1/2 quart glass baking dish. Sprinkle browned onions, marjoram, beer, and guinness on top. Cover and refrigerate at least 3 hours or overnight. Preheat oven to 375°f meanwhile, preheat broiler. Bake in preheated oven uncovered 40 to 50 minutes or until chicken is cooked. Remove chicken to a serving platter and place in a warm oven to keep warm. Increase oven temperature to 375°f. Spoon sauce over chicken. Sprinkle with cheese and peanuts.

title: Cafe Rio Shrimp With Pineapple
ingredients: 1 cup yellow split peas, washed | 1 cup green tomato ( canned for less spice ) | 1 tablespoon dried shrimp | 1 tablespoon pineapple chunk | 1/2 teaspoon instant coffee
instructions: Cook yellow split peas on the stove top or in the microwave on medium high. They should be dry enough to easily mash with fork or fingers. Once the peas are dry, add to pot. Add the shrimp and dried shrimp, toss. Add the pineapple chunk and mix. Mix and enjoy.

title: Italian Easter Eggs (Egg Yolk Omelette)
ingredients: 6 large egg yolks | 1 package italian salad dressing
instructions: In a bowl, whip 4 large egg yolks with a mixer on medium to high speed until thick and pale in colour, about 5 minutes. Transfer the whites of the bowl to a large metal bowl. Using a spatula, carefully fold the whites into the the egg yolks. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 1 to 1½ hours, or overnight. Heat the oven to 400 degrees f. Spray two baking sheets with cooking spray and arrange the eggs on the sheet. Bake until the eggs are puffy and dry, about 40 minutes.

title: Pancake With Chilies
ingredients: 3 small fresh chilies | 1 small yellow pepper | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/4 cup mirin ( or sweet rice wine ) | 2 -4 croissants, split lengthwise
instructions: Place chilies on a plate and cover with a film of water. Soak and wash the chilies for 10 minutes. Skin the chilies on one side and remove the seeds with a spoon. Rinse with salt water and peel the chilies. Cut them into chunky slivers. Bring the water on high heat. Put the sliced chilies in the water and leave for 10 - 12 seconds. Put the sliced chilies in a blender with the garlic powder and mirin and blend well. Put a croissant bottom slice of croissant in the center of each plate. Pour 1/6 of the creamed chili paste over the croissant. Close the plate and turn the croissant over. Close the plate to give a seal.

title: Noodle Rice Dish (Rice Cooker)
ingredients: 3 cups rice noodles, washed in several changes rinsed in cold water | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Heat the rice cooker on the stove. When warm, put the noodles in a bowl or flat tray on the shelf. Press the power button. When the rice cooker stops the automatic cycle from running, stir in the vanilla essence{off the power, but do not throw away the contents of the bowl}. The idea is to ensure that the ingredients become evenly distributed and the dish will not be too soggy}. Note,. This is not a dish to let food safety and power go wrong. Instead, the idea is to ensure that the dish cooks quickly.. For a slightly different flavour, 1 tsp of almond essence is added to the dish. For a breakfast dish, eat this dish with any meat and vegetables.

Random Ingredients: beef brisket,prosciutto,taco seasoning mix,splenda sugar substitute,dark sesame oil
title: Homemade Taco Brisket
ingredients: 1 tablespoon splenda sugar substitute or 1 tablespoon other artificial sweetener, or 3 tablespoons sugar | 1/3 cup dark sesame oil | 1 lb beef brisket, tied | 10 slices prosciutto, chopped into thin strips
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Combine the splenda, sesame oil and sugar in gallon sized zipper lock bag, or use 1 tablespoon splenda per gallon of meat, cut brisket into 10 portions. Squeeze out and discard any excess air before using, seal bags tightly and place in a large roasting pan to dry for 5 hours. Meanwhile, put a roasting pan in the oven to brown brisket on both sides. Place meat on a rack on the rack and bake until meat is tender, about 1 1/2 hours or more. Transfer meat to a serving platter before slicing and serving.

title: Savoury Minced Nuts and Meat
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger meat | 1 can pumpkin and beans | 1 can cannellini beans | 1 small turnip, chopped | 2 tablespoons vanilla wafers | 1/4 teaspoon amchoor powder ( indian spice mix ) or 1/4 teaspoon cardamom powder
instructions: Brown beef in large skillet on medium low/med high. Drain fat from beef. Add all remaining ingredients except wafers. Heat through. Serve on vanilla waffles, topped with a sprinkling of amchoor. Cook with rice or toast.

Random Ingredients: shell pasta,caster sugar,quinoa,chorizo sausage,tomato cilantro,mushroom,pineapple,ginger garlic paste
title: Spicy Quinoa and Chorizo Pasta
ingredients: 1 cup raw quinoa, rinsed and drained | 1 cup small shell pasta, such as fusilli or 1 cup similar type | 1 1/2 cups mushrooms, sliced | 1 1/2 cups canned tomato cilantro, packed | 1/2 cup caster sugar | 1/2 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 chopped pineapple ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon pineapple ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c, 400f, gas mark rinse the quinoa with cold water and drain. Place the quinoa in a large baking dish. Add the mushrooms, the tinned tomatoes and cilantro. Dissolve the sugar in 1/2 tablespoon of water and sprinkle over the quinoa. Add the ginger, garlic paste, pineapple and pineapples, if using. Cover with foil and bake for 30 minutes, turning the contents over if necessary. Taste and check seasonings and serve.

Random Ingredients: thyme sprig,chicken bouillon cube,fine sugar,vanilla essence,pancetta,avocado,chicken ramen noodle,cherry
title: Viva Madrid
ingredients: 12 ounces chicken ramen noodles | 1/2 medium avocado | 2 tablespoons pancetta ( sliced on a mandolin ) | 1 teaspoon thyme sprig | 1/4 cup canned low-fat cherry tomatoes or 1/4 cup canned chopped tomatoes | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 teaspoon fine sugar | 1/8 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Dice up the avocado then slice in to 1/4 slices. Cook the ramen noodles according to package directions with about 1 1/2 tbs of water. Cut up pancetta then fry in a skillet until crispy. Reserve the pancetta. Add all other ingredients and let it simmer for about 5 minutes. Add avocado and the pancetta to the mixture. Let simmer a few minutes longer. Serve hot with whipped cream or vanilla yogurt.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,chuck steak,lime wedge,beet green,vermicelli,mccormick seasoning,oyster sauce
title: Steak Noodle Bowl for 2
ingredients: 12 ounces dry vermicelli | 1 cup fresh sliced fresh beets ( about 2 green or red hot green peppers, halved ) | 1 1/2 lbs lean chuck steaks, trimmed coarsely chopped | 1 cup fresh italian parsley, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup oyster sauce | 2 tablespoons mccormick's montreal brand steak seasoning | lime wedge ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Cook vermicelli according to pkg. Directions. Drain.. Meanwhile, heat 1/4 cup water to boiling. Add beets and cook, stirring occasionally, until crisp tender, about 2 minutes. Drain potatoes and/or carrots.

title: Hot Chile Sauce
ingredients: 1 can chopped green chili peppers | 1 1/2 cups half-and-half
instructions: In a medium saucepan over medium heat, combine the green chilies and half and half. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, and simmer until mixture is reduced by half, about 25 minutes. Strain the mixture, and return to the saucepan.

Random Ingredients: green chili pepper,milk ricotta cheese,italian breadcrumb,red bell pepper
title: Pizzas
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups whole milk ricotta cheese or 1 1/2 cups cottage cheese | 0.
    -5 can chopped green chili peppers | 3/4 cup roasted red bell peppers, chopped | 2 1/2 cups italian seasoned breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, stir together the ricotta, chilies, roasted red pepper, and bread crumbs until evenly mixed. Spoon the pizzas batter onto baking sheets coated with cooking spray. Bake for 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pumpkin seed,almond essence,cottage cheese,tortilla,onion soup mix
title: Pumpkin-Garlicky Tortilla Wraps
ingredients: 1 package tortilla | 200 g fresh mashed pumpkin seeds ( or canned pumpkin puree ) | 150 g cottage cheese | 1 packet onion soup mix | 1 tablespoon almond essence
instructions: First soak tortillas with cold water. Heat oven to 200degc and cut the tortillas into 3 x 1cm strips. Place 1 tbsp of mashed pumpkin on each tortilla strip and sprinkle with 1 tsp of onion soup mix. Top with 1 tbsp of cottage cheese. Roll up and cut into 6 even pieces. Repeat with remaining tortillas. To make almond essence, add 1 tbsp of almond essence to honey. Remove from heat and drizzle over wraps before serving.

Random Ingredients: spinach leaf,swiss chard,jalapeno pepper,garam masala,guacamole,bay leaf,half
title: Stir-Fried Spicy Swiss Chard and Swiss Chard
ingredients: 2 bunches fresh spinach leaves, stems removed | 1 cup chopped fresh jalapeno peppers | 1/2 cup chopped fresh swiss chard | 1 cup fat-free half-and-half | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 2 bay leaves | 1/4 cup half-and-half | guacamole, for garnish
instructions: Set a large wok over high heat. Add 1/2 teaspoon olive oil. When the oil shimmers, add the spinach and jalapeno. Stir fry 3 minutes or until wilted. Set aside. Place a second wok over medium high, and repeat with 2 more teaspoon olive oil, olive oil and spinach. Once the spinach is crisp tender, stir in the swiss chard.

Random Ingredients: ginger garlic paste,genoa salami,taco seasoning,pizza crust,muenster cheese,pecorino romano cheese,tortilla
title: Genoa-Style Pizza
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried minced onion | 2 teaspoons finely grated fresh ginger-garlic paste | 1 can refrigerated pizza crusts | 1/4 cup finely grated muenster cheese | 1/4 teaspoon taco seasoning | 1/4 cup shredded grated fontina or genoa salami | 2 tablespoons shredded provolone cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f combine the minced onions, ginger and garlic in a small bowl and mix well. Distribute one pizza crust on a large cookie sheet. Spread onion mixture all over the crust and top dough with muenster cheese and fontina. Sprinkle taco seasoning on top of cheese, then top with salami. Dredge the other pizza crust in the taco seasoning for 3 to 5 minutes, pressing it to the edges. Set onto cookie sheet and cook for 7 to 10 minutes, until crust is golden. Place under broiler for a few minutes to brown the bottom crust.

Random Ingredients: cider vinegar,clove garlic,turnip,cremini mushroom,peanut oil,jumbo shrimp,wild mushroom,garlic salt
title: Garlicky Buttery Shrimp
ingredients: 1 lb uncooked jumbo shrimp ( peeled, deveined and cleaned ) | 1/4 cup peanut oil | 1 tablespoon garlic salt | 1 tablespoon cremini mushroom or 1 tablespoon red mushroom, chopped | 1 tablespoon turnip, chopped | 1 tablespoon turnip, chopped | 3 whole cloves garlic, pressed or 2 teaspoons garlic salt | 3 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1 -2 lb fresh wild mushroom, stems trimmed
instructions: Slice the shrimp. Put shrimps in bowl with a large pinch of salt. Set aside to marinate. Heat 1/4 cup peanut oil in a deep frying pan over high heat. When the oil is very hot but not smoking, add the garlic. Dry shrimp with a paper towel for a few seconds until opaque and starting to turn pink in color. Remove with slotted spoon, drain on paper towel, and set aside. Wipe out the remaining oil in the pan. When the oil is very hot add the mushrooms and turnip and saute until golden brown. Remove mushrooms and turnips with slotted spoon and set aside, keeping the liquid cooking away. Add turnip, turnip, garlic salt, and 1 tbs of cider vinegar to the marinated shrimp. Add the remaining 1 tbs of cider vinegar and continue cooking on high heat, stirring often to keep the mixture slightly thickened. The shrimp will curl up and turn slightly golden in appearance and smell delicious after 10 minutes. Stir the mushrooms once or twice as they start cooking so they don't burn. Toss in the shrimp and stir to mix. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke,iceberg lettuce,coconut cream,vegetable stock,french bread,basil leaf
title: Foghorns With Basil & Coconut
ingredients: 400 g french bread | 200 ml coconut cream ( or a splash of coconut-flavored lite yogurt ) | 125 ml vegetable stock | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke | 1 bunch fresh basil leaf, leaves picked | 1 cup iceberg lettuce, in medium chunks, washed and dried
instructions: Heat a frying pan over a high heat & add the coconut cream, liquid smoke, chopped basil leaves & shredded lettuce.

Random Ingredients: dark chocolate,mini chocolate chip,berry cranberry sauce,bean sprout
title: Double Berry Dessert With Dark Chipped Chocolate
ingredients: 1 jar berry cranberry sauce | 1 ounce dark chocolate, chopped | 1 jar bean sprouts | 1/2 bag mini chocolate chips
instructions: Warm cranberry sauce. Dip the berries into chocolate allowing the excess to drip off. Dip bean sprouts in chocolate ensuring both sides are coated. Place them in a 9x13 dish. Sprinkle the top with mini chocolate chips. Chill in fridge for at least 3 hours. Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,romaine lettuce,radish,barbecue sauce
title: Beer-Battered Romaine
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 4 large romaine lettuce | 3 tablespoons barbecue sauce | 1 teaspoon finely shredded fresh radish
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Line a 9x13 baking dish with a kitchen towel so your oven won't interfere with the oil. In a large bowl, thinly slice the green tops and the bitter. Place the romaine into a single layer over the towel. Remove the bitter, taking care not to tear the lettuce.

title: Aussie Garlic Mushrooms on a Stick
ingredients: 1 large head of garlic or 500 g baby garlic | 1 cup sultana | 2/3 cup mayonnaise, may need more ( if it is too sour just add a little more ) | peanuts ( optional ) | 1 large head of garlic or 1 large head of garlic | 1 cup light mayonnaise | 1/4 cup finely chopped peanuts ( optional )
instructions: Wash garlic thoroughly. Cut into 6 - 8 cloves or 8 cloves per head. Wash and pat dry the remaining garlic. Bring 4 litres of water to boil in a large pot with a high lip. Cut off a portion of the pointed end of the garlic if it is large and put in a medium bowl with a lid. Dice the head of garlic into pieces approx 2 inches in size. Put the garlic and sultanas into the bowl of a food processor and process until fine. Add mayonnaise to the garlic mixture and mix well. Take half the mixture and put in a larger bowl. Take about 1 teaspoon of mixture and roll into a ball. Repeat until all mixture is used. Put a small amount of mayo in plastic wrap. Take the smaller ball of mixture and roll out around your rolling pin very thin. Spread a small amount of mayo on a wooden board. Take about 5 cloves of garlic and put on the clove. Take the remainder of the garlic and put in the small bowl. Take the large head of garlic and put in the small bowl. Take the small ballof mixture and roll out around the rolling pin very thin. Take a little bit of mayo and spread onto the clove. Take a little bit of the chopped peanuts. Take your stick and spread the garlic mixture thinly across the stick. Take another piece of cling wrap, and put this on the clove. Take the same cling wrap and wrap around the stick. Put in the fridge for at least 4 hours to set. Place sticks on a tray and put in the refrigerator. These freeze well in the fridge but don't let them get frozen solid.

title: Tarte Flambee
ingredients: 1/2 piece dense bread | 1/2 - 1 fluid ounce cognac ( or sherry ) | 1 1/2 fluid ounces half-and-half | 3 fluid ounces double cream | 2 tablespoons brandy, preferably sweet | 4 fluid ounces half-and-half milk
instructions: Cut the bread into thick slices about an inch and a half thick. Place the slices in a shallow dish and pour in the cognac. Cover with cling film and leave for about 2 hours. This might take up to 2 - 4 hours. When completely absorbed, strain the bread through a sieve into a large saucepan. Discard the bread. If you have any left over cognac, add a little butter to the bottom of a small saucepan to melt. Add the half and half and cream and simmer until you have thickened the cream, but not too thin. Place the brandy into a small bowl and pour in about 2 tbsp of this, whisking vigorously, into the cream. Pour over the bread and leave to set in a cool place for 20 minutes, then stir a few times. The idea is to coat the bread with the cream, but it's not necessary. Place an ovenproof dish or ovenproof dish of this crouton in a steamer and steam for 5 - 10 minutes.

title: Taste of Home Spicy Salsa and Sun Dried Tomatoes
ingredients: 3/4 cup sun-dried tomato ( chopped ) | 1/2 cup salsa | 1/2 teaspoon tamari | 1/2 teaspoon ground cloves | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1/2 cup light cornstarch | 1/4 cup walnut pieces
instructions: In a small bowl, with a small whisk, mix the cornstarch and the milk until smooth. Add the cornstarch mixture and stir to mix. Fold in the tomatoes and sun dried tomatoes. Pour into a well oiled baking dish. Top with walnuts and bake at 375°f for about 30 - 40 minutes, or until golden brown. Enjoy.

title: Sweet Potato Bites
ingredients: 1 lb sweet potato, peeled and finely chopped | 1/2 lb pork, minced | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons flat leaf parsley, minced | 1 lb lean pork shoulder, shaved | 1 lb ground pork
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees fahrenheit. Combine sweet potatoes, pork, balsamic vinegar, parsley and ground pork in a large bowl. Divide among 12 pieces of paper towel and flatten until the size of a 1/8 inch thick patty. Place on a large rimmed baking sheet and bake until crisp, about 20 minutes.

title: Piquant Chervil ( Plum Preserved Appetizer)
ingredients: 1 lb plums ( plums should be very ripe and not just pit removed ) | 1/4 cup chervil ( chervil should not be necessary )
instructions: Wash plums and remove stones. Place plums in food mill fitted with metal blade. Place finely chopped chervil in center and bring together gradually. Use a funnel to carefully scrape through the pits, pushing chervil through. Continue to process for two minutes. Pour into sterilized jars and cover each with a clean cloth. Seal and place in a cool dark place for about 3 weeks. Note, plums will keep for at least two months in a cool dark place before using. If you have any pits left, place in food processor fitted with metal blade and process finely.

Random Ingredients: garlic paste,coriander seed,kidney bean,pepper sauce,green pea,thyme
title: Bahama Mama Peas
ingredients: 2 cups dry kidney beans | 1/4 cup canned green peas | 1 teaspoon coriander seed | 1 teaspoon pepper sauce | 2/3 teaspoon dried thyme | 1/4 teaspoon garlic paste
instructions: Place beans in large saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer for 1 hour. Add peas to bean mixture during the last 30 minutes of cooking time. Combine thyme, garlic, and coriander in a small skillet. Saute over medium heat until fragrant, about 1 minute. Stir into bean mixture. Serve hot.

title: Curried Chorizo Skewers
ingredients: 600 g kumara ( red skinned kumara ) | 350 g chorizo sausage | 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 400 -500 g canned chickpeas, rinsed and drained | 1/2 cup pretzel, finely crushed
instructions: Cut zucchini in half lengthwise. Cut it in half crossways. Put chorizo, chickpeas and pretzels in large saucepan. Cover with water. Bring to boil over high. Decrease heat, and simmer 5 minutes. Drain.

Random Ingredients: orange,asiago cheese,grain white rice,ginger grain,turnip,pork shoulder
title: Gratine of Romano
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups uncooked short-grain white rice | 6 1/2 cups chopped turnips | 1 orange, zested and juiced but not pulp | 2 teaspoons grated peeled fresh ginger ( romano or shard ) | 4 1/2 ounces thinly sliced thin asiago cheese
instructions: Bring 4 cups water to a boil in a 2 quart pot, then stir in rice and turnip. Cover, reduce heat to a simmer, and cook until rice is tender but still firm to the bite, about 15 minutes. Drain, then stir in orange zest and juice. Taste for seasoning, adding more orange zest if desired. Place 1/4 cup grated orange peel in a small bowl and sprinkle with 1 teaspoon or less of grated ginger. Rub 1/4 of orange peel all over both sides of the grated orange peel. Preheat oven to 400°f use your hands to scoop out rind just before serving, then transfer to a small baking dish. Sprinkle a few more teaspoons grated ginger over top. Cover with foil and bake until grated peel is dark brown and orange peel is crisp, about 30 minutes. Uncover, sprinkle with remaining grated orange peel, and bake 5 - 10 minutes longer or until a golden brown crust forms. Remove foil and bake 5 - 10 minutes longer or until a candy thermometer reads 170f, adding more orange peel after 5 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool for 5 - 10 minutes. Transfer to a serving bowl and serve right away.

title: Chiles Con Duro (Chipotles or Pineapple Saffron-Candied Dried Fruit)
ingredients: 2 cans of prepared mangoes, pureed ( in liquid, no need to thicken ) or 1 cup pureed pineapple ( in liquid, no need to thicken ) | 6 -8 canned chipotle chiles in adobo | 1/4 cup caper, drained | 1 1/4 cups rice or 1 1/4 cups arborio rice | 1/4 cup malt vinegar | 1 1/2 cups pineapple juice
instructions: Heat in a microwave a jar with a tight fitting lid, the 2 tablespoons of pureed mango puree which has been pureed. Strain to remove impurities and seeds and add chipotles, capers, rice, vinegar and juice. If using pineapple, add when adding. Cover and bake. Serve at room temperature.

title: Italian Beef & Potato Mix (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 2 lbs lean ground veal | 1/2 cup finely crushed potato barley | 1 tablespoon dried italian seasoning
instructions: Combine the ground veal meat with the potato barley and seasoning. Mix well. Make this mixture into 3 large patties, about 1 1/2 lbs. Spray a large nonstick skillet with nonstick cooking spray. Place the meat patties over the pan and cook over medium high heat, uncovered, about 8 or 10 minutes per side, or until the meat is fully cooked.

title: Pasta Sauce With Scallions
ingredients: 3 ounces pasta sauce or 3 ounces meat sauce | 3 scallions, sliced
instructions: Saute the scallions in a little oil over low heat. Add pasta sauce and stir. Cook for one minute. Add meat and scallions. Do not overcook this.

Random Ingredients: cream,pineapple chunk juice,red pepper flake,manchego cheese,pasta,seasoning,chicken drumstick
title: Spicy Chicken in Pineapple and Cheese
ingredients: 2 tablespoons of melted butter or 2 tablespoons margarine | 4 chicken drumsticks | 8 ounces manchego cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup sour cream | 1 can pineapple chunks in juice | 1/2 cup crushed red pepper flakes | 1 ounce dry pasta | 1 teaspoon seasoning ( optional )
instructions: In a medium sized saute pan melt 1 tbs of the butter or margarine with the chicken drumsticks, sauteeing until lightly browned. Remove the chicken from pan and coat with the remaining 1 tbs of butter or margarine. In the same pan, add the cheese, sour cream, pineapple chunks and chiles, sauteeing until the cheese is melted and the pineapple is hot. In a 9x13 baking dish combine the crushed red pepper, pasta, seasonings and pour the hot cheese mixture over it. Cover with tin foil, but do not add the lid. Bake, in a 375 degrees fahrenheit oven for about 30 minutes, remove the foil, let sit for 5 minutes and dig in.

title: Tamaboko (Nasu No-Yaki)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons mirin | 3 1/2 tablespoons oil
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour over fish before baking.

title: Roasted Eggplant
ingredients: 4 medium unpeeled eggplants ( about 3 3/4 lbs ) | 1 cup hulled sunflower seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°. Using sharp paring knife, carefully cut slits into eggplants, and using knife, slice lengthwise 1/4 inch/1 inch deep, to make 2 1/2 inch wide. Place on large rimmed baking sheet and drizzle with 1 1/2 tablespoons hot olive oil, then sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoons salt and pepper. Roast, in center of oven until tender and just slightly blackened in spots, about 50 to 55 minutes or until tender when pierced with fork. Transfer to plate. Meanwhile, toast sunflower seeds in a small dry skillet over low heat, stirring often, until light brown, about 3 minutes. Transfer sunflower seeds to paper towels to drain. Heat remaining 1/2 tablespoon oil in large nonstick skillet over medium high heat until just smoking. Working in batches, add eggplant and cook, turning once, until darkly browned both sides, about 10 minutes total. Transfer to paper towels to drain.

Random Ingredients: topping,red wine vinegar,basil,bacon dripping,grand marnier,fine breadcrumb,broccoli floret
title: French Style Broccoli With Toasted Garlic
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs broccoli florets | 1/4 cup chopped fresh basil ( or use 1/2 tsp dried basil ) | 2 tablespoons reserved fresh basil ( or use 1/2 tsp dried basil ) | 1/3 cup good red wine vinegar or 1/3 cup balsamic vinegar | 1/2 cup crumbled bacon drippings or 1/2 cup vegetable oil | 1/3 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 1/2 cup grand marnier
instructions: In a colander, snip off any tough ends of the garlic.

title: McKay's Famous Whisky
ingredients: 1 cup irish whiskey, divided | 1 tablespoon grenadine syrup | 3 dashes grenadine
instructions: Fill a large glass with ice. Pour half of the drambuie syrup in with the ice. Place the rest of the drambuie syrup in a shot glass, and fill with the remaining drambuie syrup. Fill with the remaining drambuie syrup. Stir, and pour 1/2 cup of whiskey into the glass. Use a slotted spoon to float the whiskey.

title: Easy Salami   (    for the BBQ
ingredients: 500 g bacon, cooked & sliced into strips | 1/2 chili, minced ( the bottled chilli type or red is fine ) | 1/2 teaspoon pepperoni, minced ( a pungent red pepper if you can find it ) | 1/2 cup vegetable stock | 2 ounces romano cheese, grated | 1 3/4 tablespoons cake flour
instructions: Melt the bacon in a frying pan until crisp, remove and set aside but leave the drippings in the pan. Add the chili and pepperoni, cook until lightly brown, add the stock, stir and bring to boil. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Pour the mix into a greased and lined 8 cake pan. Bake at 150c/400f/gas 3 for at least 90 minutes and serve.

Random Ingredients: bun,pecorino romano cheese,beef brisket,white pepper,flat leaf parsley,shell pasta,cherry tomato,ladyfinger
title: Olive Garden Sicilian Brisket & Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef brisket | 1/2 cup chopped flat leaf parsley | 1/4 cup grated pecorino romano cheese | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper | 3/4 cup small shell pasta, such as ditalini | 1 1/2 cups canned canned cherry tomatoes with liquid, drained, quartered | 1 cup mixed babyfingers or 1 cup ladyfinger roll
instructions: Place brisket in large dutch oven and add water to cover. Bring to a boil and skim foam as it forms on top. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 1 1/2 hours skim foam as needed. Remove brisket. Let rest, covered, about 20 minutes. Heat oven to 425 degrees. Remove brisket from pot and refrigerate for 1 hour. Reserve broth and refrigerate beef for future use. Bake brisket in upper and lower thirds of oven until very tender, basting and turning as needed to brown evenly, about 2 hours to 3 hours per pound. Meanwhile, boil large pot of salted water over high heat until lightly salted. Add pasta and cook until al dente, drain and set aside. Meanwhile, place drained tomatoes and reserved broth in small bowl. Toss gently with tomato mixture, reserving 1/2 cup tomatoes. Place reserved tomatoes on serving platter. Remove meat from liquid in skillet and place on top of tomatoes. Place 1/4 cup tomato mixture in skillet with reserved broth and sprinkle evenly with grated cheese. Top with mixed babyfinger rolls. Place platter in center of table and serve with remaining tomato and cheese mixture.

title: Smoky Spanish Apple and Cherry Salsa
ingredients: 2 small red apples, cored and sliced | 2 cans fire-roasted tomatoes | 1 lime, juiced
instructions: Bring a saucepan of water to a boil and add the apple slices. Boil until softened, about 5 minutes. Drain and transfer apple slices and juice to a medium bowl. Stir tomatoes into apple juice, then add the lime juice. Cover the bowl and refrigerate salsa for at least 1 hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: thai red curry paste,bread,pastry shell,soymilk,egg substitute,grenadine
title: Thai Spicy Toast
ingredients: 1 pastry shells, ready-made | 1 cup soymilk | 1 1/2 tablespoons thai red curry paste ( to taste ) | 1/2 cup egg substitute | 1 -2 teaspoon grenadine, to taste ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon plain bread, toasted
instructions: In a large non stick skillet, combine soymilk, curry paste, egg substitute and grenadine. Simmer on low medium for 5 minutes, stirring often. While the mixture simmers, toast your shells in the oven on a parchment parchment lined cookie sheet set at 400°f for 5 - 7 minutes, or until golden brown. When the toast is done, pour into a serving bowl. Serve warm, with warmed slices of toast.

Random Ingredients: yeast granule,tomato puree,cherry,chicken broth,fish sauce,skewer,ancho chile,sherry wine vinegar
title: Ancho Chiles With Chili Sour
ingredients: 15 ounces canned diced tomatoes with puree | 20 dried ancho chiles, seeded and torn into chunks | 1/2 teaspoon dry yeast granules | 1 cup chicken broth, about | 3 tablespoons chinese rice wine or 3 tablespoons sake ( or sherry ) | 2 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 1/4 cup cherries
instructions: Soak chiles in water to soften.

title: Greek Dolmas
ingredients: 1 teaspoon anise seed | 4 saffron strands | dill, for decorating
instructions: Heat the oven to 375°f. In a small bowl, combine the anise seeds and saffron. Stir well. Sprinkle in enough dill to lightly cover the bottom of a baking dish or pan. Layer the saffron mixture on top of the dill. Cover the dish or pan completely with aluminum foil, and put in the preheated oven. Bake for 1 hour. Remove from the oven, and remove foil, and continue baking until the dill is browned. Allow to cool for a few minutes, then cut into squares.

title: Pasta Primavera With Ziti
ingredients: 1 lb ziti pasta or 1 lb penne pasta | 1 cup heavy cream
instructions: Cook ziti according to package directions. Drain pasta, and cover to keep warm. Meanwhile, heat cream in a large, heavy skillet. When cream is almost simmering, add ziti to cream, and heat through. Serve warm.

title: Homemade Cardamom Crackers
ingredients:
150 gr.
    - palm sugar, powdered sugar ( powdered ) | 3 -5 green cardamoms ( ground ) | 4 -1 1/2 cups dough | 1 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese ( plus some additional for sprinkling ) | 1 -2 teaspoon cardamom
instructions: You will need a bowl with 1 inch sides for the crust. In a small bowl, stir all the sugar until smooth. Add cardamom to the sugar & stir well. Pour the cardamom mixture in the bowl & mix well. You don't need to cover it, but if it does, stir every 30 seconds for 30 seconds. Put the dough in a large ziploc bag & cut a small opening in the center. Add about half the sugar mixture along with the rest of the sugar to the bag. Shake the bag to release any air pockets & roll the dough into small balls ~ you should have some bag pieces. Refrigerate the balls for 6 hours or overnight. Preheat the oven to 475 degrees. Slice the chilled dough into fingers ~ if the fingers are very big, cut them in half. Use a fork to pull the dough apart so it will be easier to work with. Dip the fingers into water then roll in sugar & put in a baking tray. Sprinkle all the sugar over the fingers & give them a few turns on both sides till they're light gold. Sprinkle the cardamom to the bread, then bake for 5 minutes, then turn the trays over & bake for another 3 - 6 minutes. Remove from the oven & let cool completely. Enjoy.

title: Tawny's Favorite Pimento Almonds
ingredients: 1 cup slivered sun-dried tomato | 1 cup light chutney | 1/2 cup raw cashews | 1/4 cup garam masala | 1/8 teaspoon sundried tomato
instructions: Mix the sun dried tomatoes, chutney, cashews and garam masala together and spread onto a cookie sheet or shallow serving dish. Use a tooth pick to spear the sun dried tomato mixture into the nuts. You should be able to cover all of the nuts with the mixture. Sprinkle with dried tomato pieces and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: spanish onion,lemon peel,red pepper flake,stock,part ricotta cheese,coconut cream
title: Spicy Ricotta Soup
ingredients: 5 tablespoons part-skim ricotta cheese | 3 tablespoons reduced-fat spanish onion | 2 tablespoons fresh grated lemon peel | 1/8 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons coconut cream | 1 small vegetarian part-skim ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup stock
instructions: Combine ricotta, onion, lemon peel and red pepper flakes in medium bowl, stirring to blend. Add coconut cream.

Random Ingredients: molasses,maraschino cherry,rotel,cottage cheese,salmon,orange juice concentrate,white onion,cheese
title: Cottage Cheese Salmon and Sour Cream Dip
ingredients: 3 ounces cottage cheese | 2 ounces canned salmon, drained | 1 ounce white onion, chopped | 2 ounces canned rotel | 1/2 ounce imitation orange juice concentrate | 1 dash maraschino cherry | 2 ounces molasses | 1/4 ounce cheese, grated
instructions: Blend or process all ingredients until smooth. Spoon into serving bowl and top with grated cheese.

title: Baked Calamari
ingredients: 1 -2 kg calamari | 100 g sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 2 teaspoons dried thyme
instructions: Pre heat the oven to 200c. Remove the shell and ink sacs from the calamari, removing any damaged or wilted tissue or blemished matter on the outside of the calamari. Rinse off the calamari with cold water, drain well and cut crossways in half. Place the halved calamari half on a baking paper lined tray and spread with the tomato halves, sprinkle with thyme. Smooth the surface and bake in the oven for about 40 minutes or until tender and lightly browned. To serve, cut each calamari half crossways to expose the flesh.

title: Arugula and Arugula
ingredients: 2 cups baby arugula ( can use frozen or fresh ) | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules ( optional )
instructions: Rinse arugula and drain very well. Transfer arugula to a small bowl.

title: Tangerine Tacos
ingredients: 10 small taco shells, softened | 12 ounces tobasco sauce, of your choice | 12 ounces white flour | 2 tablespoons taco seasoning ( optional ) | 8 dashes tabasco sauce ( optional )
instructions: Blend with a fork the taco sauce with the taco seasoning to desired thickness. To build, roll a taco with soft taco shell, fill with taco filling, and top with your favorite fixings.

title: Ginger-Scented Baja Romaine Wedges
ingredients: 1 teaspoon gelatin ( powder or powder ) | 2 cups whole wheat flour | 12 small romaine lettuce (, hearts ) | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 1 jicama, peeled and grated
instructions: In a small bowl, sprinkle gelatin over 1 cup cold water and stir until gelatin is dissolved. Let stand 10 minutes until gelatin is softened, then stir the gelatin and water into the flour until smooth, about 1 minute. Set aside. Rinse lettuce and dry with paper towels and cut into slices about 1/4 thick. Set aside. Place jicama in a colander and sprinkle evenly with the anise seed. Drain jicama.

Random Ingredients: milk ricotta cheese,french baguette,rye bread,pasta,beef brisket,garlic
title: Danish Beef and Ricotta Soup
ingredients: 1/2 pound sliced corned beef brisket | 1 clove garlic, minced | 1 can condensed milk ricotta cheese | 1 teaspoon dried minced garlic | 9 cups milk | 2 packages dry medium-grain jarlsberg's ready to eat whole-grain jarlsberg's ready to eat whole-grain jarlsberg's ready to eat whole-grain jarlsberg's ready to eat whole-rice soup | 12 large french baguettes, sliced in half lengthwise and toasted
instructions: Place the sliced meat into a large saucepan or dutch oven. Add enough water just to cover the meat. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to a simmer, and cook until no longer pink, about 20 minutes. Drain. Strain the meat into a large bowl, reserving the cooking liquid. Using 2 forks, shred the meat. Return the meat to the saucepan. Add the reserved cooking liquid, garlic, ricotta cheese, minced garlic, and 3 cups of water. Bring to simmer, and cook until the liquid is reduced and the mixture slightly thickened, about 20 minutes. Stir in the jarlsberg's ready to eat whole grain jarlsbergs® broth and bring to a boil. Simmer for 5 minutes. Spoon the mixture into soup bowls, top with toasted baguette slices, and serve.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,yellow pepper,tomato puree,tart apple,midori melon liqueur,beef flavor ramen noodle,egg,salad dressing
title: Midori Beef Loaf
ingredients: 2 cups cooked beef-flavor ramen noodles ( or your favorite brand ) ( optional ) | 2 cups diced tart apples ( or your favorite brand ) | 1 yellow sweet pepper, diced | 2 tablespoons tomato puree ( or your favorite homemade tomato sauce ) | 2 tablespoons salad dressing | 1/3 cup midori melon liqueur | 1/4 cup whole wheat flour or 1/4 cup brown rice flour | 2 large eggs
instructions: Mix together beef ramen, apples, sweet pepper, tomato puree, salad dressing, and midori, stir well until thoroughly mixed, set aside. In a separate bowl, mix together the flour, eggs, and water in a measuring cup. Add enough water to the flour to make a thick batter consistency, make sure it is well mixed. Pour the batter into a 9x5x2 pan, then top with the beef mixture, making sure it is evenly distributed. Bake in a preheated oven at 350°f for 55 - 65 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center of the loaf comes out clean or toothpick is clean. If this loaf is done, after 45 - 50 minutes, it will be ready to unmold on a cooling rack. Let cool before slicing.

title: Sauteed Pork Loin on Skewers (Bamella)
ingredients: 1 pork loin, about 3/4-inch thick | olive | peeled bamboo shoot ( i used canned bamboo shoots, but fresh is good for soaking up the oil ) | turmeric powder
instructions: Soak skewers in water for 20 minutes. In a heavy skillet with plenty of good good ventilation, cook pork about five minutes on each side. Once you know your done, remove from heat and drain of any excess fat. Let rest for five minutes. Skewer meat. Cut in small pieces and drizzle with oil. Sprinkle with turmeric. I use a mixture of all four spices. Place on medium heat for five minutes, turning often to coat. Serve hot with a green salad, rice, beans, and beans of your choice.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,cool whip lite,sunflower oil
title: French Onion Soup
ingredients: 2 lbs onions | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 2 1/2 cups cool whip lite | 1 tablespoon sunflower oil
instructions: Slice the onion thinly in slices and put them in a large bowl. Sprinkle with the sunflower oil. Mix together soup and cream together. Serve with a swirl of cool whip and hot water.

title:
St.
    - Patrick's Day Special Asparagus
ingredients: 1 inch fresh asparagus | 1 yellow pepper ( optional )
instructions: Trim ends from each asparagus. Place tips in boiling water, cook for 1 1/2 minutes or just until tender, not overcooked. While still hot, use tongs to carefully separate tips of asparagus around seeds, then quickly turn asparagus over. Toss tips with yellow & pepper.

title: Homemade Cream Cheese Pudding
ingredients: 1 cup plain soymilk | 1/4 cup cream cheese spread | 1/4 cup 1 % fat cottage cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a blender or food processor place soy milk, cream cheese spread and cottage cheese. Blend until smooth. Pour into a well greased shallow baking dish. Place in preheated oven and bake, covered, for 45 minutes. Remove cover and bake, uncovered until the pudding has a golden brown color and the cottage cheese has melted, about 10 minute. Allow to set completely.

Random Ingredients: cooking oat,tamari,chili paste,hard egg,water,white sugar,serrano ham
title: Spicy Oatmeal with Ham (Yum Yum Mamma)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups quick cooking oats | 2 large hard-boiled eggs, chopped | 12 ounces white sugar | 1 cup water | 1 serrano ham, chopped | 2 teaspoons chili paste | 2 teaspoons tamari or 2 teaspoons soy sauce
instructions: Dry the oats with a paper towel and put the oats on a plate lined with waxed paper or parchment and allow to cool to room temperature. In a mixing bowl, gently mix together the eggs, sugar, water, chili paste and tamari. Pour the egg mixture into the ground oats, stir to combine and set aside for 10 minutes. Heat 2 tablespoons or so of oil in medium sized pot over medium heat and add the ham and onions. Cook until ham is starting to brown, about 8 minutes. Pour in the egg mixture, stir until heated through and reduce heat. Cover and cook for about 5 minutes, stirring until the sauce thickens slightly. Remove from heat and serve.

Random Ingredients: lump crabmeat,tea,dill pickle,tomato juice,cream mushroom soup,pine nut
title: Easy Baked Crab
ingredients: 2 cans lump crabmeat | 1 cup tomato and clam juice cocktail, drained | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup chopped dill pickle | 1/4 cup chopped pine nuts | 2 1/2 teaspoons instant tea ( optional )
instructions: Preheat an oven to 400 degrees f. Spread the crabmeat out into a glass, 8x8 inch baking dish. Drizzle the tomato juice into the dish.

title: Nana's Delicious Egg Applesauce(Caribbean)
ingredients: 1 large firm apple ( or two small fiji apples ) | 2 hard-boiled eggs | 1 1/2 cups half-and-half | 1/2 cup tamarind juice ( or sherry vinegar ) | 1 1/2 cups fat free egg substitute ( or 1 egg, or egg beaters ), beaten
instructions: Peel the apple and if it is large dice up into small cubes. Cut the hard boiled eggs in a food processor until fine. If using the noodles, cut it into small pieces. Place all of your ingredients in a blender, blender is small enough to work with. Blend all ingredients to a smooth paste, then pour into saucepan. Heat on stovetop over medium heat until mixture simmers. Do not bring to boil.

Random Ingredients: green,red chili pepper,cocoa powder,green chili pepper,tamari,chicken bouillon,broth,coconut flake
title: Coconut Chile Conch (Sweet Chili Sauce)
ingredients: 1/2 cup unsweetened instant coconut flakes | 1 tablespoon red chili pepper, minced | 1 green chili pepper, minced | 1 3/4 cups chicken base or 1 3/4 cups broth | 1 tablespoon tamari | 1 tablespoon unsweetened alkalized cocoa powder | 1 cup green ( chile-infused chiles, such as anaheim ) concentrate | 2 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix all of the ingredients together, stirring until well combined. Cover and refrigerate overnite. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: parmesan cheese,fish fillet,dark chocolate,cheddar cheese,prosciutto,cooking spray,plain flour
title: Broiled-Fish Fillets With Prosciutto (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 1 )
ingredients: 500 g fish fillets, skin removed | cooking spray | 200 g dark chocolate | 50 g thinly sliced prosciutto | 1/2 cup plain flour | 2/3 cup shredded cheddar cheese | 1/3 cup freshly shaved parmesan cheese
instructions: Place fish fillets in a heatproof bowl. Melt chocolates in a microwave on high. Spread onto both sides of each fillet. Spoon over chocolate mixture. Sprinkle with cheese. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Remove fish fillets from bowl.

title: Salmon Cakes
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups seasoned bread flour | 1/2 lb salmon, cooked | 1 egg white, lightly whisked
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375f and grease two baking tins with butter. Sift the flour into a large bowl, add the salmon and egg white. Stir to blend well. Divide and flatten into cakes about 1 1/2 in diameter. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes depending on the thickness of the cakes, or until cooked through. Remove from the oven and serve hot.

title: Italian Style Salad Salad
ingredients: 4 sheets pie shells | 1 can refrigerated fresh green peas, drained and chilled | 4 hard-cooked eggs, chopped | 3 tablespoons pimiento, diced | 1 romaine lettuce - rinsed, dried and shredded
instructions: On two sheets of plastic wrap, place 1 pie shell on each of the four salad plates. Spread each with about 1 tablespoon of the green peas.

Random Ingredients: thyme sprig,golden brown sugar,five spice powder,lamb shoulder,black pepper,leek,garlic powder
title: Lamb Shoulder - Crock Pot Recipe
ingredients: 4 large lamb shoulder, skin on ( about 4 pounds ) | 2 large leeks, cleaned well, chopped ( include tender green tops ) | 5 garlic powder ( i use 6 cloves ) | 2 tablespoons dried thyme sprigs | 2 tablespoons five-spice powder | 1/2 teaspoon black pepper | 3 tablespoons golden brown sugar ( or more if you like )
instructions: Preheat crock pot to 275°f. Using a sharp knife or a very sharp knife, carve off about 6 or 7 slices of heavy fat from the top of the lamb. If planning on stuffing as a side dish, cut slits in the meat. Reserve the rest of the bacon fat, but discard all remaining fat. Place leeks and garlic powder in a medium mixing bowl. Combine thyme, five spice powder, pepper, and sugar in a measuring cup, set aside. In the bottom of the slower cooker, place bacon fat. Heat on low setting until most of the bacon is rendered and there are no remnants of any bacon grease remaining in the bottom of cooker, about 10 minutes on high. Remove meat from crockpot and add leeks and garlic powder, stirring to coat lightly with the bacon fat. Cover and cook on low heat setting for at least 10 hours or until the meat is tender and falling off the bone. It is recommended to check temperature early in the cooking to make sure the slow cooker does not get too hot. The cooking time will vary depending on the size of the meat and how you are planning to cook. Taste and adjust seasoning with salt or pepper if desired. You should have a thick gravy rather than a bland one.

title: Fakari Dukkah
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice | 1/4 teaspoon toasted sesame seeds, or to taste | 1 hard-cooked egg, quartered, or more as needed | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds
instructions: Place allspice, 1/4 teaspoon toasted sesame seeds, egg, and 2 to 3 tablespoons sesame seed in the bowl of a food processor. Process until allspice has been pulverized, about 5 seconds. Pour the mixture into a small bowl.

title: Fried Stuffed Rye Bread
ingredients: 2/3 cup ricotta cheese | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 loaf rye bread, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 4 ounces roasted honey-roasted red peppers, sliced | 4 ounces maraschino cherries, halved | 12 cherry rolls, split
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Whisk the ricotta, cumin, and 1/3 cup of the dry bread cubes in a bowl. Arrange 1/2 the bread in the baking sheet. Drizzle with 1/2 the cheese mixture, spreading evenly on each bread cube. Gently press 1/2 the red peppers into the cheese mixture. Repeat, ending with the remaining bread cubes and cheese mixture. Place the 2 loafs on the prepared baking sheet,. Bake until bread is heated through and golden brown.

title: Yummy Spinach Kage and Feta Kale Breakfast
ingredients: 6 ounces kale ( or baby spinach ) | 2 tablespoons crumbled feta cheese | 1/2 tablespoon kale ( any leafy leafy greens such as arugula can be used ) | 1/8 teaspoon dried thyme sprig | 1 egg white | 1 teaspoon chili powder
instructions: Cook kale in boiling water for 6 - 7 minutes, or according to package directions. Drain, then rinse under cold water to cool slightly. Chop coarsely. Stir feta, dried thyme, egg white into kale, until combined. Spoon mixture into 4 wide wide mouthed soup dishes, making beds of leafy greens in the center of each. Sprinkle with chili powder. Yum.

title: Stolen Eggs, Scandinavian Style
ingredients: 5 slices ham | spice, to taste | 7 ripe olives, sliced
instructions: First put the slice of ham, and then a bit of the sliced olives and a small pinch of spice. The end result is a very sticky egg. This also takes place a piece of rye bread into the frying pan, which is fairly close in size to the eggs. Cook the eggs for 10 - 12 minutes over a moderate fire until they are just set. This will take a few moments, but they should finish off in a minute or so. Remove the egg carefully from the pan and on the spot put back on the stove.

title: Cheddar and Cashew Spread
ingredients: 1 cup grated sharp cheddar cheese | 1 cup raw cashews, roasted ( see note, my note on raw cashews ) | 2 tablespoons tomato paste | fresh coriander, chopped
instructions: Combine ingredients in a food processor and process until creamy. Transfer to a bowl and sprinkle with coriander before serving for a light meal with a dip for your favourite winter meal with a light touch of sweetness or chill it in the fridge. Also note, it is a favourite the size i got from my local deli.

title: Easy Sweet-Spicy Lime Pie
ingredients: 1/2 cup nonfat milk | 1 tablespoon ketchup | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil ( diced ) | 8 fresh lime leaves, chopped | 3 -8 ladyfingers | lime leaf ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Combine milk, ketchup, tomato and mint leaves in pan. Stir over low heat until thick. Pour over ladyfingers and refrigerate for 10 minutes.

title: Tilapia Al Kahlua
ingredients: 4 tilapia fillets | 2/3 cup kahlua | 1/2 cup monterey jack cheese, shredded | 2/3 teaspoon salt | 2/3 teaspoon turmeric | 1/4 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Combine kahlua, kahlua, monterey jack cheese, salt, turmeric and garam masala in blender and process until well blended. Place tilapia in shallow baking dish. Pour sauce mixture over fish. Marinate at least 30 minutes and up to 3 hours. Preheat broiler. Place fish on broiler pan to heat.

title: Portuguese Daisy
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups soymilk | 1/2 cup dark rum | cooking spray | 1 1/2 cups lemonade
instructions: Preheat an oven to 425 degrees f. Whisk the soy milk, rum, and cooking spray together in a bowl. Pour the mixture into a 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven until it thickens and becomes creamy, about 30 minutes. Cool in the baking dish for 15 minutes, then drizzle it with lemonade.

Random Ingredients: savory,cottage cheese,paprika,ginger garlic paste,chinese noodle,campbell tomato soup,toast,yellow onion
title: Chinese Noodle and Cheese (Campbells)
ingredients: 2 cans campbell's condensed tomato soup | 1 large yellow onion, diced | 2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 1 tablespoon savory | 1 tablespoon sweet paprika | 1/2 teaspoon rubbed sage | 1 package frozen toast, thawed | 1 package chinese noodles, cooked
instructions: Combine both cans of campbell's soup, onion, ginger garlic paste, savory, paprika, and sage in a large bowl. Mix well. Heat oven to 400 degrees f. Spray two 13 x9 inch baking dishes with nonstick spray. Arrange half the uncooked noodles in the baking dishes. Pour soup mixture evenly over noodles. Top with remaining noodles. Bake uncovered for 15 minutes, then remove from oven and sprinkle with remaining soup mixture. Return to oven and bake for 45 minutes. Remove from oven, cool for 5 minutes, then slice and serve.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese,glutinous rice,pork chop,lasagna noodle,piri,tabasco brand chipotle pepper sauce,irish whiskey
title: Pork and Rice Noodle Lasagna
ingredients: 400 g uncooked glutinous rice | 200 g minced pork ( lean pork shoulder ) | 200 g shredded mild cheese ( dublin cheddar cheese ) | 1/4 cup sour cream ( light cream ) | 1 tablespoon piri piri hot sauce | 1 dash tabasco brand chipotle pepper sauce | 1 tablespoon chopped coriander ( fresh coriander leaves ) or 1 tablespoon cilantro ( fresh coriander leaves )
instructions: Cook rice according to the package instructions, drain and set aside. Rinse and pat dry the pork and cut into thin strips, then set aside. Melt the sour cream over a gentle heat, in a small bowl, stir in the piri piri hot sauce and tabasco. Add the pork and stir until well mixed. Line a baking sheet with greaseproof paper. Mix the rice, sour cream and pork and place in a layer in the pan, top with cheese. Place in a preheated oven and bake at 200°c for 30 minutes, stir the pork and cheese until melted and evenly distributed. Remove from the oven and stir through the coriander. Allow to rest for 5 minutes before slicing and eating. Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator. Serve with fresh coriander.

title: Porcini Herb and Tomato Salad
ingredients: 1/4 ounce dried porcini mushrooms | salad greens ( fresh or dried mixed herbs )
instructions: Soak the mushrooms in hot water for 20 minutes. Drain, remove all the stems and chop finely. Dry the mushrooms roughly and chop roughly. Arrange the salad leaves and a generous portion of the chopped mushrooms on serving plates. Pour boiling water over it to cover. Stir well then let the salad sit for about 5 - 10 minutes to wilt the mushrooms. Top with the extra chopped mushrooms and serve at once.

title: Cheating Sticks
ingredients: 1 sheet frozen puff pastry sheets ( thawed and lightly floured ) | 14 ounces greek yogurt | chopped pistachios or almonds | 12 thin slices crusty bread
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f. Roll out one sheet of pastry dough into a 6 inch long rectangle about 1/8 inch thick. Place over a damp towel and stretch to about 3 inches across the bottom and up the sides of rectangle. Spread the yogurt evenly over the surface of each dough strip. Top with 1 tablespoon of pistachios or almonds, and 2 slices of bread. Place the remaining 2 slices of bread on top. Using a pastry wheel or sharp knife. Place an oven rack on top of the baking sheet, and place in the oven. Bake until puffed, golden brown, and the crust is lightly browned, about 40 minutes.

title: Danish Hamburger and Cheese Rolls
ingredients: 1/4 cup bread flour | 1 1/2 cups beef broth | 2 tablespoons syrup | 2 tablespoons cottage cheese | 2 tablespoons pearl barley | 1 lb ground chuck
instructions: Combine the bread flour, broth, syrup and cottage cheese in a bowl and mix well. Add the beef and shape into 2 cylinders about 3 or 4 inches in diameter. Wrap each with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Preheat the oven to 325°f. Put half of the rolls in a roasting pan. Pour the remaining sauce on top. Cover tightly with aluminum foil. Bake for 1 1/2 hours, or until the rolls are browned. Note, the rolls aren't baked at one time and may be left at room temperature for up to 15 minutes.

title: Famous Swiss Cheese Dip
ingredients: 4 ounces swiss cheese, grated | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 1 teaspoon seasoning | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 dash seasoning salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Coat a medium sized oven proof casserole dish with nonstick cooking spray. Mix together grated swiss cheese and cornflour in a bowl until well blended. Add heavy cream and seasoning salt. Stir to combine and cook until the mixture thickens, stirring constantly for 3 minute. Spoon the mixture into prepared casserole dish, sprinkle the top with the grated swiss cheese. Bake for approximately 50 minutes or until golden brown and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: lemon pepper,chili paste,saffron thread,cottage cheese,chili pepper
title: Spicy Tomato Dip
ingredients: 1 package cottage cheese | 2 tablespoons chili paste | 2 tablespoons lemon pepper | 1 tablespoon chili pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon saffron threads
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender and puree until smooth.

Random Ingredients: white pepper,pork tenderloin,cocoa powder,heavy cream,thyme sprig,pinto bean,italian sausage
title: Pork and Sausage Pork Cannelloni
ingredients: 4 links pork tenderloin | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa powder | 2 cups heavy cream | 1 cup split pinto beans, drained and rinsed | 1 teaspoon dried thyme sprigs | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 1/2 lb sweet italian sausage, sliced and crumbled, with casing removed
instructions: Place pork in a baking dish. Sprinkle with cocoa and set aside. In a saucepan, place cream, beans, thyme, pepper and sausage. Cover and simmer over medium heat for 20 minutes. Reserve 1/2 cup sauce.

title: Kanavile (Tofu and Spinach Soup)
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups fresh spinach | 1 cup soymilk
instructions: Wash spinach under running water, and remove coarse leafy sand. Shake off excess water and cut up into a large bowl. Drain any liquid. Rinse the spinach lightly and spin on paper towels. Transfer spinach to a large saucepan. Add soymilk and bring to simmer. Cover and simmer until spinach is softened, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Serve topped with bread crumbs of your choice and fresh fruit of choice.

Random Ingredients: fish fillet,cauliflower,wild rice,turmeric powder,flour,anaheim chilies,rice vinegar,spaghetti
title: Seared Fish With Cauliflower and Wild Rice
ingredients:
4 salmon fillets, skin removed ( appx.
    - 2 lb.
    - each ) or 4 freshwater fillets ( appx.
    - 2 lb.
    - each ) | 3/4 cup uncooked wild rice | 1/3 cup rice vinegar or 1/3 cup white wine vinegar ( or to taste ) | 1/2 lb cauliflower, separated into florets | 4 fresh large anaheim chilies | 1 1/2 teaspoons turmeric or 1 1/2 teaspoons chili powder | 2 teaspoons flour | cauliflower, tops chopped small ( optional )
instructions: For fish, if using the fresh green chilies, slice them in half and remove and discard the seeds. Chop the flesh into 1/2 inch chunks. Arrange the salmon at the bottom of a 9 skillet. Place the rice on top of the salmon. Combine the vinegar/wine and brush the vinegar around the salmon, making sure that it coats all sides of the salmon. Layer the cauliflower on top of the rice. Add the chilies on top of cauliflower. Sprinkle turmeric, chilli powder and flour over the fish. Cook uncovered in a 350°f oven for 30 to 45 minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork. Serve over steamed white rice.

title: Cafe Rio Peppers with Mushrooms
ingredients: 3 tablespoons black peppercorns | 1 lb button mushroom, sliced 1/2-inch thick | 3 green bell peppers | 1 bunch leeks or 3 chopped green onions, green parts only
