instructions: Place the pepper corns on a plate and sprinkle them with 1 tablespoons peppercorns. Broil or grill them on both sides until blackened, about 3 - 4 minutes, watching closely. Set aside to cool. After they have cooled, slice them in half lengthwise and spread the slices out in a single layer on waxed paper lined cookie sheet. Peel peppers and slice in half, producing 4 halves. Set aside. Place mushrooms with all the sliced green pepper on another piece of waxed paper and slice thinly. Place pepper on plate, sprinkle with 1 tablespoon peppercorns and 1 tablespoon green onions and set aside to marinate. Heat up the beanseed oil on the stovetop. Add the mushrooms and saute for 5 - 7 minutes, until they're tender and start sizzling. You could even add a little lemon juice to give it a bit of a kick. Serve the mushrooms on a bed of rice or fried plantains. Serve the sauteed mushrooms immediately over the hot beanseed oil and green pepper. Serves.

title: Easy Pasta Alfredo
ingredients: 1 package farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 1 jar alfredo sauce | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the bow tie pasta and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Spoon some of the alfredo sauce into a saucepan over medium low heat. Stir in the balsamic vinegar and 1/2 tablespoon of olive oil, or to taste. Bring the creamy, creamy sauce to a boil, and cook until thickened, about 1 minute. Stir in the drained pasta, and toss to coat. Serve immediately.

title: Eggplant Fettuccines With Avocado Salad
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas | 12 ounces fettuccine ( angel hair preferred ) | 1/2 cup egg substitute | 2 large spanish onions, halved and cut into wedges | 1 large hass avocado, sliced | 1 sprig fresh rosemary
instructions: Drain and rinse chickpeas and place in a saucepan. Cover with cold water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, covered, and simmer for 30 minutes. Drain and set aside, saving the cooking liquid. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add chickpeas and cook until tender, but still firm, about 5 minutes. Drain. Cook fettuccine until al dente, approximately 8 minutes. Drain. Transfer hot pasta to large bowl and mix chickpeas and onion wedges through pasta. Add avocado slices and rosemary sprigs. Chill in refrigerator, preferably overnight, before serving.

title: Homemade Phyllo
ingredients: 1 egg yolk | 1 teaspoon minced onion | 1 teaspoon minced fresh basil leaf | 1 small onion, minced | 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1 package shredded sargento provolone cheese | 1 -2 tablespoon freshly grated provolone cheese, for dusting
instructions: Make the phyllo sheets according to package instructions. In a small bowl, whisk together the egg yolk, minced onion, basil, minced onion, minced onion, and oregano. Cut the provolone cheese into small cubes. Place the filling mixture among the dough sheets. Sprinkle the provolone cheese over the top. Roll the phyllo with your hands to make a 6 inch long log with about 1 1/2 inches of phyllo. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for an hour or up to 2 days. Remove the phyllo from the refrigerator and let it get quite cold. Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f. Cut a small slit down the side of the phyllo log and run a sharp knife around the edge of the log to lightly cut off a piece of phyllo dough. Repeat by cutting a small slit in the side of the log. Repeat until all the phyllo dough is used up. Place on a generously greased baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until crispy and lightly browned, about 20 minutes.

title: Homemade Cheese Substitute (Low Fat)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons fat-free ricotta cheese | 1 cup fat free cream-style cottage cheese
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Refrigerate until ready to use. You can also refrigerate any of them for up to 2 days or refrigerate them for up to 4 hours.

title: Smoked Mackerel (Avec Eric)
ingredients: 4 smoked mackerel ( fillet or salmon ) | 1/2 cup chili pepper flakes | 1/2 - 1 cup gluten or 1/2-1 cup gluten free all-vegetable mix ( vegetarian mix is okay ) | 1 package gluten free smoked salmon, in water ( the kind with skin )
instructions: Bake your mackerel for about 8 - 10 minutes. While preparing the fish, mix the chili peppers, gluten free mix, and the water. Put fish and 1/2 a can of water into a skillet on medium heat. Bring the water just barely to a boil. Baste with this mix once or twice until the fish is done cooking. Turn off heat when fish turns pink around the edges. Serve immediately.

title: Smoked Trout With Green Onion Chile Sauce
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs smoked trout, skin removed | 1 cup bottled salsa | 4 tablespoons reduced fat sour cream | 3 teaspoons dried chipotle powder | 1/2 cup cilantro, chopped | 2/3 cup green onion, chopped | 2/3 cup roasted red pepper, chopped | 2 -4 birds eye chiles, chopped ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon ghee
instructions: Place the trout and salsa in a large mixing bowl. Stir in the remaining ingredients and season to taste with salt and pepper. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Heat the ghee in a large cast iron skillet set over medium high heat. Remove from the heat and allow to cool slightly. Using 2 or 3 heaping tablespoons of the sausage mixture, roll each of the snapper around, in a small ball, then place on a plate. Heat the oil in the skillet until hot but not smoking and cook the snapper, in batches, for 1 - 2 minutes on each side, or until golden and cooked through. Serve the snapper in small bowls with the onion chutney on the side.

title: Veal Wrapped in Biscuit Dumplings
ingredients: 1 lb ground veal | 1/2 cup onion seeds | 2 1/2 cups biscuit mix | 4 ounces dark chocolate | 2 teaspoons onion seeds | 5 ounces watermelon, chopped | 1 tablespoon brandy
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in bowl, add more biscuit mix according to taste. Divide into 10 pieces and roll each piece into 3 inch long cylinder, rolling once or twice. Wrap each roll in plastic wrap or foil and freeze, or just leave on the counter for as long as possible. After freezing, remove wrap, slice into desired shapes, place on tray and freeze again. To serve, thaw the wrap and slice each roll into 20 slices and put them on a tray with each slice in the centre of the wrap. Place a piece of watermelon between pieces and wrap around it, making a sandwich. Place on tray and freeze again until firm.

title:
Lamb & Cottage Cheese Stuffed Spuds.
    - (21 Day Wonder Diet:day 1)
ingredients: 1 lb lamb, ground | 3/4 cup low fat cottage cheese
instructions: Place lamb in a frying pan. Brown on all sides. Drain excess fat. Add cottage cheese to the meat mixture. Mix well. Pre heat oven to 220c. Leave a couple of tbsps of grease in the pan. Spoon mixture into hollowed out turughught skins. Bake for 1 hr 15 minutes until the stuffing is golden brown and crisp. Serve.

title: Gluten Free Peach Noodle Salad
ingredients: 4 cups rice noodles ( wheat or spirals are nice ) | 2 cans sliced peaches, drained and sliced | 1 3/4 teaspoons xanthan gum | 1 1/2 teaspoons creole seasoning | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1 teaspoon grated fresh ginger | 1 cup raw sweet peas ( frozen, or fresh and thawed )
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. While cooking rice noodles, combine remaining ingredients in a large bowl. When noodles are done, drain noodles and place in the serving bowl. Toss with soy sauce and/or desired amount of green sauce. If more sauce is needed, you can use up 2 tbs to 3 teaspoons gluten free soy sauce, or 1 cup dry fish sauce. You can also add 1/2 teaspoon sugar. If desired, sprinkle extra soy sauce on top.

title: Fajita Steak Fajitas
ingredients: 1 fajita-size flour tortilla | 1/2 medium yellow pepper
instructions: Slice the peppers into thin strips. Spray skillet with a cooking sauce or any non stick spray. Add peppers in skillet, fry until they are starting to turn golden.

title: Chilled Mexican Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 cup ketchup | 1/4 cup honey | 1/3 cup red and green salsa | 1 teaspoon salad oil
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender jar with lid. Process on high until thoroughly blended. Refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Mock Cherry Chips
ingredients: 18 -24 large cherries, cut in half with stem on and pitted ( optional ) | cloves ( optional ) | lime wedge
instructions: Pit the cherry halves and gently press the outer skin into the pit with a sharp knife, making sure to catch the juice. Discard the pits and/or place the pit in the refrigerator to allow the flavors to mature for a bit more. This is when you add the clove. Scoop the pits out carefully and muddle the cloves in a mortar or pestle.. Remove the pits. If you have any leftover chips, dip the chips in a little garlic and lime juice.

title: Aarsi’re El Mouton (Chilean Seasoned Fish)
ingredients: 6 1/2 - 7 lbs white-oily fish fillets or 6 1/2-7 lbs halibut, cut in 3 x 1/4 x 2 inch strips | 1 tablespoon ghee ( or other cooking oil ) | 2 cans rotel tomatoes, undrained
instructions: Pour about 1 - ¼ cups of the rotel tomatoes into a saucepam, and set aside. Dip the fish strips in oil a few at a time until golden brown. Drain on a paper toweled rack. Reheat rotel tomatoes over low heat with remaining tomato can juices. Stirring occasionally, simmer 10 minutes. Place over medium heat for 15 minutes, to heat. Taste, if necessary, and adjust seasoning.

Random Ingredients: beer,white sugar,fennel seed,five spice powder,purpose flour,horseradish
title: Beer Bread Dry Rub
ingredients: 1 teaspoon fennel seeds | 1 teaspoon five-spice powder | 1 tablespoon prepared horseradish or 1 tablespoon ketchup | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | 1/2 cup white sugar | 1 bottle light beer ( preferably a dark, but full flavored beer will do, i've also used colleen )
instructions: Place the seeds in a small baking dish and cover with a clean cloth. Let swell for 15 minutes. Rinse the seeds and towel dry. Stir together the ground nutmeg, five spice powder, horseradish, flour, sugar and beer in a bowl to form a paste. Pour the spice paste into a spice grinder, coffee grinder or spice mill, and grind to desired consistency. Store in the refrigerator. Use within 5 days or freeze for up to 2 months.

Random Ingredients: kahlua,bell pepper,soya sauce,green cardamom pod,green food coloring,shrimp paste,eye roast
title: A+ Easy and Easy Beef Jerky
ingredients: 1 lb eye of round roast | 2 lbs shrimp paste | 1/2 fresh bell pepper, sliced | 2 green cardamom pods | 1 1/2 cups kahlua, plus | 1/2 cup kahlua | 1 green food coloring | 1 tablespoons soya sauce
instructions: Trim excess fat from the meat, cutting several slits in it at 1 inch intervals and cutting it into 3 inch lengths. Slice the meat into three or four even, long strips and lay them on absorbent paper. Combine the shrimp paste with 1/4 cup Kahlua in a bowl. Stir well to dissolve the kahlua and remove any lumps. Thread onto skewers. If desired, brush with soya sauce for extra flavor. Place the skewered meat on a rack in a shallow baking dish and refrigerate until ready to use. Brush meat liberally with soya sauce and refrigerate overnight to allow the flavor and texture to develop. About 30 minutes before serving, brush the racks lightly with a little olive oil and broil until lightly sizzled, about 8 to 10 minutes. Transfer the racks and broil the meat on each rack and cook about 4 to 5 minutes for medium rare. Slice very thinly and serve immediately.

title: Lori's Baked Cheese
ingredients: 1/2 cup sliced havarti cheese | 4 sprigs fresh tarragon lettuce | 4 cloves garlic | 1/2 limes, cut in half
instructions: Lay slices of cheese on cutting board and using a sharp knife with a thin sharp knife slice along the length of the cheese, cutting off the crusts. Open the cheese in one flat piece, with the tarragon lettuce leaves intact about 1/2 of the way up. Spread each slice with about 3 tarragon butter. Insert a half lime wedge to secure. Cut into wedges.

title: Cod Filling for Two
ingredients: 3/4 pound cod, rinsed and dried and chopped | 1/2 cup canned crushed red pepper pepper flakes
instructions: Mix the filling and pepper flakes together in a bowl until coated thoroughly. Use to fill cod.

Random Ingredients: banana,red chili paste,salt,hummus,heavy whipping cream,vanilla bean
title: Sweet and Savory Banana Hummus
ingredients: 1 lb sweet banana ( ripe ) | 1 teaspoon salt | 1/3 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/4 cup sweetened hummus | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla bean ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon red chili paste ( optional )
instructions: Peel, core and coarsely chop the bananas. Place the bananas and salt in a small bowl. Cover with water, place in a microwave, and cook on high power just until they are tender. Drain, pressing out any liquid. In a small bowl, stir the cream with the sweetened hummus, vanilla bean, and chili paste. Transfer the cream and banana mixture to a serving bowl. Drizzle hot, sweetened hummus on top.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,green curry paste,ziti pasta,flour,icing sugar
title: Vietnamese Beef Noodle Bowl
ingredients: 200 g ziti pasta, broken into 1 inch noodles | 1 cup green curry paste | 500 g icing sugar | 350 g flour | 5 green cardamom pods, split
instructions: Simmer the noodles in a large pan of boiling water for 3 - 4 minutes. Drain and rinse under cold water. Heat up the curry paste in a large, deep frying pan and simmer for 3 - 4 minutes until it is dark brown. Set aside. Heat up the oil in a large frying pan on a medium low heat. Using a slotted spoon, turn the beef into a large bowl in the curry paste. Drain the noodles well and toss them in the hot oil, tossing continuously. Sprinkle the noodles with the icing sugar. Stir until the noodles have coated everything well. Spoon the noodle bowls equally into two serving bowls. Scatter some cardamom pods over the top and serve with a green leaf lettuce. Store in an airtight container at room temperature for 4 days to allow the flavours to develop.

title: Labane (Yogurt Cheese)
ingredients: 3 cups yoghurt
instructions: Whip yoghurt. Add white pepper. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: beef brisket,golden syrup,green bell pepper,white sugar
title: Sticky Brisket
ingredients: 1 green bell pepper, seeded and thinly sliced | 1 small red bell pepper, seeded and thinly sliced | 1 teaspoon white sugar | 2 tablespoons golden syrup
instructions: Place the sliced bell pepper in a large microwave safe bowl with the sugar, golden syrup and salt. Cover the bowl and microwave on high 2 minutes. Remove the bowl and let stand about 5 minutes. Using tongs, loosen the pepper and sugar mixture around the bell peppers using a fork. Serve warm. Mixture should be moist.

title: Olive Oil
ingredients: 1 cup whipping cream | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh thyme sprigs
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Stir whipping cream and thyme together in a glass baking dish. Pour oil into the dish. Bake in the preheated oven until cream has thickened but edges of the cream are still a little thin, about 50 minutes. Let cool to room temperature, about 2 hours. Warm remaining cream in a bowl over medium heat until it has reached 220 degrees f. Pour cream over cooked cream. Serve warm.

title: Curd (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 1 package frozen okra, thawed | 1/2 cup milk | 1/2 cup sour cream and tartar blend | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Slice okra and mix all ingredients together. Bake for about 20 minutes. Serve warm or chilled.

title: Meat Salad With Greek Yogurt
ingredients: 2 lbs beef suet | 2 lbs yogurt | 1 orange, juice of | 1 whole apple, shredded finely | 1 large red onion, minced | 1 - 1 1/4 cup greek yogurt | 2 cups shredded mexican blend cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°. Soak the suet with a tea towel for 3 hours. Then cut into 1/2 inch wide strips. Mix all ingredients together in a large serving bowl. Cover and refrigerate for several hours overnight, or overnight to allow flavors to combine. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: head cabbage,sesame oil,chunky peanut butter,crabmeat,barley,bicarbonate soda,dark soy sauce
title: Peanut Noodles With Chilli Spices
ingredients: 1 cup light chunky peanut butter | 1 teaspoon dark soy sauce | 1/4 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 teaspoon sesame oil | 1 medium head of cabbage | 2 cups raw crabmeat ( fresh or imitation ) | 3 tablespoons barley ( optional )
instructions: Whisk together peanut butter with soy sauces, bicarbonate of soda, dark soy sauce and sesame oil in a bowl, set aside. Slice cabbage in half, then slice on the diagonal into thin wedges. Place cabbage wedges on a large plate. Drain shrimp and set aside. Cut each half of carrot diagonally into 4, then thinly slice. Place peanuts and crab meat in a bowl, mix together well. Add a few tablespoons of oil to a wok, heat until a bead of water sizzles, add cabbage wedges and mix well to coat then cook in batches until crisp. To serve, top with mixed vegetables, if you like.

title: Butternut Rice With Pineapple Stuffing
ingredients: 1 lb butternut pumpkin, cubed and peeled | 6 slices white bread, crusts removed | 2 cups basmati rice, rinsed and drained | 2 teaspoons pineapple chunk | 2 sheets nori
instructions: Place pumpkin in a large pan and cover with water.

title: Papaya Soup
ingredients: 1 papaya, peeled, halved, seeded, and cubed
instructions: Place the papaya cubes in a saucepan and add about 1/2 cup water. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer until the water has evaporated, about 10 minutes. Skim any foam from the top of the papaya water, then stir in the chicken broth. Continue cooking until the soup is thick, at least 15 minutes. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt,bulk italian sausage,thyme leaf,ice,white bread,mahi fillet,jalapeno pepper,hoisin sauce
title: Smoky Grilled Garlic Sausage With Baked Mahi Mahi
ingredients: 1 lb mahi mahi fillet | 1 lb bulk sweet italian sausage ( bulk ) | 1/2 cup hoisin sauce | cracked ice | white bread | fresh thyme leaves | 2 medium jalapeno peppers, seeded and cut into 1/4 inch strips | kosher salt
instructions: Place grill pan over medium heat. Remove any excess fat from mahi mahi and sausage. Grill mahi mahi about 6 minutes, until it flakes apart when pulled. Let cool approximately 5 minutes. Cut meat into 1/2 inch wide strips. Combine hoisin sauce and ¼ tsp crushed salt in a small bowl. Cut 6 slices of bread into cubes and spread on a foil covered plate to dry. Place remaining bread cubes on plate in a single layer. Preheat grill. Place the mahi mahi on skewers. Brush meat with hoisin sauce mixture. Sprinkle with thyme. Place jalapeno peppers. Seal edges with your fingers. Grill mahi mahi approximately 2 minutes, turning frequently, until cheese begins to brown. Watch carefully if you like your grill too hot grill additional 2 minutes or until cheese begins to burn. Remove from grill and put on a plate covered with plastic wrap. Let rest approximately 5 minutes. Serve on a platter, top with additional thyme leaves.

title: Honduran Omelette
ingredients: 1 lb stew meat, cut into 1 inch cubes ( chuck, chuck, lamb, or a combination ) | 1/3 cup apricot, chopped | 2 tablespoons peas, chopped | 4 eggs
instructions: Heat oven to 450 degrees. Place the stewing meat and the apricots into a pan and cook over medium heat until the apricots and meat are slightly softened, about 8 - 10 minutes. Lightly beat the eggs with a pinch of salt and pepper, if desired.

title: Tuna and Quinoa Salad
ingredients: 1 teaspoon quinoa, rinsed and drained | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce | 60 g green olives, drained chopped | 185 g tuna, drained and flaked
instructions: In a shallow bowl, place the quinoa, pesto and olives. Toss until evenly coated. Add the tuna, toss well and serve.

title: Couscous for One
ingredients: 1 cup couscous | 2 ounces unsweetened chocolate
instructions: Put rice in a bowl and add boiling water. Cover with a lid and set aside for five minutes. Fluff rice with a fork and stir in sugar. Remove cover and place chocolate in the pot and melt. If using a glass, break into small pieces with your hands and melt in the microwave for a minute. Add melted chocolate to couscous and stir, then add to couscous. Mix well.

Random Ingredients: egg white,red pepper,black eyed pea,hamburger,poblano chile
title: Black-Eyed Peas Burritos
ingredients: 1 pound smoked hamburger | 1 jar poblano chiles, drained | 1 package black beans, rinsed and drained | 1 egg white | 1 red pepper
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Brown the hamburger in a skillet over medium heat. Stir in the poblanos, black beans, and egg white. Cook and stir 5 minutes, or until the egg mixture is firm. Cut in half and wrap each half with a thin slice of red pepper.

title: Green Fairy
ingredients: 1 lb fresh green food coloring | 1/2 teaspoon garlic | 4 teaspoons green food coloring ( optional )
instructions: Using a pastry brush, coat the outside of a 2 - 3 lb. Shallow green waxed paper. In a large heavy saucepan, bring the 4 teaspoons green food coloring and one teaspoon garlic to boil. Add 1 teaspoon water. Carefully stir in the green mixture. Remove from heat. Allow to cool, about half an hour. Break off 1/3 of the colored sugar crystals and set aside until the next day. Use a spoon to pack the colored sugar crystals in the green, and repeat with all the colored sugar crystals. The colored sugar crystals will be very pretty and sticky toffee, when served.

title: Easy Picnic Sopaipillas
ingredients: 3 cans condensed beef broth | 1 tablespoon poultry seasoning | 3 pita bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Drain beef broth from can, but save the can and use it to make bread dough.

title: Brown Rice Cocoa Mix or "curdbread" (For Rosh)
ingredients: 3 cups brown rice, washed and left to soak overnight ( you will also need 1/2 cup of cocoa mix or equivalent ) | 1/8 teaspoon cardamom powder ( or to taste ) | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon sea salt (, or to taste ) | 3/4 cup brown sugar | 3/4 cup german-style mustard
instructions: Pour dry rice into a bowl. Sprinkle with cardamom and sea salt, mix well and set aside. Bring 2 cups of water, 1/4 cup brown sugar, and 1/4 cup of mustard to a boil in a medium sized pot over medium heat. Bring boiling water back to a brisk boil and stir in the dry rice and stir well. Reduce heat to low and simmer covered 20 minutes or until rice is fully cooked. Pour rice mixture into bowls and serve.

title: Tofu and Pear Potato Tortilla
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ice water | 3 large firm firm ripe pears, cored, quartered and very thinly sliced ( about 6 ounces total weight ) | 1/2 cup medium-hot salsa | 3/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/2 lb firm tofu, drained ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 1 medium carrot, peeled, halved lengthwise, and thinly sliced crosswise 1/4 inch thick | 1 large red potato, scrubbed, cut crosswise into 1/4 inch slices
instructions: Pour the water into a wide mouthed 3 1/2 to 4 quart heavy bottomed pot. Working with 1 pear slice at a time, layer the pears in the bottom of the pot, alternating with the salsa. Top with a layer of tofu, a slice of pear, and a second tomato slice. Repeat layering. The finished dish should have three layers of tinfoil, foil pockets and a large rim set in the center. Seal the edges as well as the sides and refrigerate until very cold, at least 1 1/2 hours.

title: Gramma Ramekins
ingredients: 1 teaspoon minced gingerroot | 1/2 cup chopped cremini mushroom | 1/2 cup chopped chanterelle mushroom | 1/2 cup chopped peas | 1 package wonton wrappers | 2 teaspoons minced fresh parsley | 1 teaspoon minced fresh sage | 1 cup grated mexican blend cheese
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients. Place a teaspoon or more of filling in the center of each wrapper. Moisten the edges of the wrapper with cold water, fold in half and crimp the edges.

Random Ingredients: seasoning,red curry paste,chili pepper,romaine lettuce,margarita mix,kahlua,rib eye steak,green chili pepper
title: Spicy Grilled Tri-Step
ingredients: 2 rib eye steaks | 1/4 cup kahlua | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 1 sweet chili pepper | 1 green chili pepper | 1 package hidden valley original ranch dressing | 1 package romaine lettuce | 1 package margarita mix
instructions: Grill rib eye steaks until medium and cooked through. Cut into 6 slices on a diagonal, about 1/2 an inch thick. Place on plastic wrap and freeze for no longer than 20 minutes. Prepare the glaze and assemble the salads,. Shred the lettuce and mix the lettuce with margarita mix. Place steaks in a glass dish or pan sprayed with pam. Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with kahlua. Pour the dressing over the meat and mix. Serve on warm rolls, with shredded onions and sliced green chili peppers.

title: Cheese Enchiladas Verde
ingredients: 12 ounces ricotta cheese | 6 ounces shredded gruyere cheese | 1 can green enchilada sauce
instructions: In a large bowl combine ricotta cheese, cheese and 1 can of enchilada sauce. Mix well. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. On a parchment paper lined cookie sheet, divide the cheese mixture into 4 portions. Spread one portion of the cheese mixture in an even layer. Repeat until all portions are used. Distribute the remaining cheese mixture on top. Top with enchilada sauce. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes or until the top is light brown.

Random Ingredients: tomato soup,green cardamom,cocoa powder,kielbasa,herbes de provence,italian parsley
title: Kielbasa in Herbes de Provence
ingredients: 10 -12 links kielbasa | 6 cans condensed tomato soup, or | 8 green cardamoms, crushed | 1 1/4 tablespoons herbes de provence | 1 1/4 tablespoons cocoa powder ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons italian parsley, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Start by washing kielbasa well, then place in a crock of water – the water should just cover the kielbasa. Add water that was set aside in a pan on medium heat. Once it boils, add remaining ingredients. Reduce heat to low/medium and simmer for one hour. While cooking kielbasa, slice kielbasa into small thin slices. Remove kielbasa from simmering sauce and place in large skillet. Cook under broiler or on grill until kielbasa is browned and crispy, approximately 5 - 10 minutes. Add to sauce and toss to coat. Serve in bowls with some of the sauce poured over.

title: Black Beans Patties (Coxin)
ingredients: 1 egg, beaten | 1/2 cup dried black beans | 1 -2 tablespoon apricot jam | 1 teaspoon chili paste | 1/3 teaspoon thyme ( optional ) | chopped dried bamboo shoot, for filling | 1/4 teaspoon black beans | some hot sauce or chili paste, to taste
instructions: Combine beaten egg and black beans in a medium bowl. In a small bowl mix the remaining ingredients. Use as a filling for patties or other raw meat.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,fish sauce,pistachio,baking powder,beef cap,basmati rice
title: Glet-Fried Baked Beef With Pistachios in Rice
ingredients: 2 1/2 1 1/2 lbs beef caps ( i used eye round ) | 4 tablespoons sunflower oil, plus extra | sunflower oil, for deep-frying | 1/2 cup fresh basil, chopped ( reserve a little of the leaves for garnish ) | 1 tablespoon pistachios, toasted and finely chopped | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 2 tablespoons freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese, plus more | parmigiano-reggiano cheese, for sprinkling ( i had about 3/4 cup )
instructions: Cut the beef in half, making sure it is all sliced, rather thin. Heat two tablespoons of oil in a high sided nonstick skillet over high heat until it shimmers but doesn't smoke. Sprinkle each piece of beef with salt and pepper, then sear on each side until brown, about 1 minute on each side. Remove the beef from the pan and place on a serving plate. Put a little more oil in the pan and heat the remaining half of the oil over high heat until it shimmers. When the oil shimmers, add the basil leaves and pistachios, and cook, stirring, until they begin to wilt, about 1 minute. Add the fish sauce and bring to a boil. Add the beef back to the pan. Cook, stirring, until the sauce is reduced to just a glaze, about 2 minutes, then remove from heat and set aside. Preheat the oven to 500°f. Sprinkle the plate with parmigiano and dust with more parmigiano, then transfer to the oven. Roast until the sauce bubbles and the pistachios are golden brown and a rich golden crust forms, about 45 minutes. Remove from the oven and set aside. Garnish with the reserved basil and pistachios, and serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: clove,red thai chile,whipping cream,thyme sprig,chicken bouillon cube,pumpkin puree,margarine
title: Thai Pumpkin Soup
ingredients: 12 ounces pumpkin puree ( about 1 1/2 pints ) | 1 pinch thyme sprig | 1 chicken bouillon cube ( such as maggie or knorr ) | 1 tablespoon margarine, melted | 1/4 red thai chile, finely chopped | 1 -2 clove | 1/4 cup whipping cream
instructions: Puree the pumpkin and thyme in a blender or food processor until fairly smooth.

Random Ingredients: port wine,bell pepper,jamaican jerk spice,passion fruit
title: Port Wine Skewers
ingredients:
2 bell peppers | 2 passion fruit, halved | 1/2 teaspoon jamaican jerk spice, blend < a href= '' https : //www.
    -geniuskitchen.
    -com/recipe/jamaican-jamaican-spice-mix-205185 '' > jamaican spice mix < /a > | 1 cup port wine
instructions: Set oven on broil. Cut all peppers lengthwise into 1/2 inch slices. Place on baking sheet and broil at 450 degrees f for about 8 minutes or until skins are charred. Place peppers in plastic bag. Remove skin from pepper by rubbing pepper slices with clean cloth and thread pepper onto metal skewers or bamboo skewers. Brush each pepper with the spicy sauce and leave for 10 - 30 minutes at room temperature. Serve with mint fresh fruit.

title: Herbs and Onion Sauce
ingredients: 8 ounces whole wheat flour | 1/4 cup onion soup mix | 1 tablespoon capers | 2 teaspoons mustard powder | 2 teaspoons mixed herbs
instructions: Mix flour, onion soup mix and caper. Heat well. Mix in mustard powder mixed with herbs and stir in to coat and serve.

title: English Breakfast
ingredients: 2 -4 eggs | 1 teaspoon dried italian seasoning, mix with fresh herbs | 1 -2 slice ham, cut into thin wedges ( optional ) | any other dried fruit ( optional )
instructions: Preheat your skillet over med high heat. Beat eggs with a pinch of salt. Add italian seasoning mix and sauté for a minute or two. Place cooked ham on plate and top with egg mixture. Serve with additional tea, fruit, or whatever desired.

title: Veal Burgundy and Gruyère Dip
ingredients:
2 -3 lbs chuck roast ( i use the roast that comes in the bag, about 1.
    -5 pounds ) | 2 cans stewed tomatoes ( about 1 can ) | 4 lbs grated cheese ( i use a combination of parmesan and garlic, but your choice ) | 6 -8 lbs beef tips ( gravy beef sirloin beef or a combination of both ) or 6 -8 lbs veal tips ( gravy beef sirloin or a combination of both ) | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon pepper
instructions: Cut chuck roast into about 1 inch chunks. Brown chuck in 1 1/4 tablespoons olive oil until the outside becomes nice and black. Remove the meat and set aside. Brown grated cheese in the same oil. Once the meat has browned, add the can of stewed tomatoes to the pot. Turn up the heat down a bit, add grated cheese to the juices in the pot, and stir. Put the lid on the pot and simmer 20 minutes, stirring every so often. Remove the cover and continue to simmer until the gravy has reduced somewhat, about 30 to 45 minutes. After the stew has cooked 20 minutes, uncover and mix some roux into the sauce. Serve with your favorite pasta, potatoes or crusty bread.

Random Ingredients: red chile pepper,mango chutney,candy sprinkle,coca cola
title: Mango-Coco Slush
ingredients: 3/4 cup coconut cola | 2 tablespoons sweet mango chutney | 1 teaspoon ground dried red chile pepper | 1/4 cup candy sprinkles
instructions: Place coconut cola, sweet mango chutney, red chile pepper, and candy sprinkles together in a blender.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach,juniper berry,irish whiskey,kidney bean,tomato soup,beet,rose water,peanut oil
title: Irish Stewed Beans
ingredients: 12 ounces dry kidney beans | 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 2 cans condensed tomato soup | 1 cup heinz's irish whiskey | 1 bunch baby spinach ( leaves ) | 1 sprig fresh rosemary, for garnish | 1 dash crushed juniper berries, or to taste
instructions: Rinse beans and discard skins. Place them in pressure cooker with about 3 inches of water and 1 teaspoon salt. Seal and cook for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, heat a skillet over medium low heat. Add the oil and fry the spinach for about 5 minutes. Be careful not to burn it.

title: Sausages With Mushrooms, Capacola and Currants
ingredients: 200 g mild italian sausage | 1 -2 tablespoon currants | 1 jalapeno, sliced thinly | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 125 g mushrooms
instructions: Cut your mushrooms and remove the stems and leaves with a spoon. Sauté the sausages until cooked on the first side. Turn over and add the peppers and stir in the currants. Season with turmeric. Serve with steamed or fried rice.

title: Greek Sausage & Onion Dip

Garnish with sour cream, if desired. Serve with warm bread for dipping.

title: Spanish Baked Vegetables
ingredients:
3 medium yellow bell peppers ( peeled, seeded, and sliced into half rings about 1/4-inch x 1-inch ) | 2 medium green peppers ( cleaned and sliced into half rings about 1/4-inch x 1-inch ) | 4 ounces fresh mushrooms ( sliced, i use baby portobello ) | 4 -6 ounces romano cheese, grated ( approx.

title: Grilled Swiss Steak With Walnut Oil

Let the steak rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Sauerkraut for Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 lb sauerkraut | 1/4 cup mustard ( i use prepared ) | 1 cup water | 1 tablespoon butter
instructions: Add mustard to water to make a dressing. Mix together & refridgerate until serving time. This makes a great kraut dip for sandwiches.

title: Rajma

instructions: If available, wash turnips to remove any stones, then grate them and transfer to a wide glass bowl. Add 1/3 cup chana dal and toss to combine. Cover and keep in the refrigerator for at least 5 hours or over night.

instructions: Place mushrooms in a bowl, toss with horseradish and set aside. Place lamb cubes in a resealable bag. Pour cream into bag, turning meat cubes to coat. Reserve juice.

title: Spaghetti with Sugar and Hot Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb dry spaghetti | 1 - 1 1/2 cup dark brown sugar, or more to taste | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.

title: Hot Radishes With American Cheese

instructions: Bring large pot of salted water to boil over high heat. In 1 quart saucepan, place radishes and 1 cup salt. Cook, uncovered, over medium heat until radishes begin to soften, about 5 minutes. Using tongs, transfer drained radishes to bowl and reserve 1 cup.

title: Vanilla Vanilla Sauce

instructions: In a saucepan gently heat the wine and sweet wine, but do not allow it to boil. Once the cream from the vanilla is released from the vanilla, it should not be quite at the same time. When it is, add vanilla. Let simmer 5 minutes, remove from heat and whisk in the wine.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato,worcestershire sauce,enriched flour,oil,ham,mustard powder,rum extract,farfalle pasta
title: Deep Dish Pasta Carbonara

title: Jamaican Steamed Whole Chicken

instructions: Steam chicken pieces until almost through. In a large pot place chicken legs, skin side down. Add enough water to cover chicken. Cover. Set the pot on medium heat. To start steaming the chicken. To begin steaming put a steamer rack at a level about 3 inches from the top of the stove. Add the coconut extract, aniseed, and parsley to the water and water. title: Spicy Egg Drop Soup
ingredients: 3 whole large eggs | 6 slices egg whites | 3 tablespoons flour, plus | 2 -3 tablespoons flour, divided | 4 1/2 cups chicken broth
instructions: Beat the eggs and egg whites and 1 tablespoons flour until foamy, about 15 seconds. Add remaining flour. Add enough broth to egg mixture to form about 2 3/4 inch thick. Beat well. Drop the egg mixture by heaping tablespoons into heated soup with a large spoon for 3 - 5 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Italian Brisket

instructions: Cut brisket into 5 serving sized pieces. Season with salt and pepper. Brown brisket in a dry large skillet, and transfer to a 6 quart crockpot. Add the salami to the drippings, and stir to coat. Stir in vinegar, remove the pan from the heat, cover the crockpot, and let stand for 2 hours, or until the brisket is tender. Remove brisket from stock and place in a warm spot.

title: Easy Crock Pot Italian Beef
ingredients: 3 lbs chuck | 1 lb beef roast
instructions: Put chuck roast in crock pot. Sprinkle with salt/pepper to taste cook on low for 8 - 10 hours. Remove roast from crock pot and shred, put back in the crock pot serve with salad and french rolls.

title: Greek Vegetables

instructions: Wash and cook the vegetables until tender and browned. Drain well. Heat the oil in a large heavy skillet. Add the saffron, cinamon and the cinnamon to the skillet and stir. Add the vegetables and cook, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables are thoroughly coated with the spices. Stir in the oregano. Cover and simmer for 5 minutes for vegetables to absorb the flavors. Serve with lots of crusty bread.

title: Aromatic Mango-bread Crumble
ingredients: 8 cups mangoes, cut up and pitted | 14 ounces condensed chicken broth | 1/2 cup soft white breadcrumb
instructions: Bake in a 300 degree oven for 40 minutes or until soft. Pile onto a tray and bake for another 5 minutes on a slow oven. Remove from oven and put the mango into a bowl. Put 1 cup of the mango flesh into a blender. Add the broth and process this until purée is very smooth. Put into a bowl. Add in the remaining 1/2 cup of mango and blend again until smooth. Turn mixture into ovenproof casserole dish. Crumble topping over. Bake in a 325 degree oven for another 30 minutes or until topping is lightly browned and bubbly, and topping is crisp and well toasted.

title: Kraut Fritters With Orzo and Peaches

instructions: For the rue, heat a frying pan over medium heat for about 3 minutes. Add the tomato puree and 1/2 cup water. Simmer until a thick sauce forms, about 2 - 3 minutes. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

title: Adzuki Shrimp With Cucumber and Jumbo Shrimp
ingredients: 1 package jumbo shrimp, peeled in shells | 1 can adzuki beans ( also known as black beans ) | 1/2 cucumber, peeled, cut in half lengthwise and cut into bite sized pieces | 1 small green pepper, trimmed, seeded and diced | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder
instructions: Cook shrimp and cook beans over high heat until shrimp and cooked through. Meanwhile, mix together peppers, asafoetida, and shrimp. Top with shrimp mixture and serve.

title: Tuna and Pasta

instructions: Dry nuts on paper towels and set aside. Place rasam in a mortar bowl and crush lightly with your fingers. Place toasted nuts on a parchment lined cookie sheet. title: Cashew Crunch Crunch

instructions: In a large skillet cook canadian bacon until crisp. Add cherries, tomato sauce and cashews. Cook 2 minutes more. Serve at once and enjoy.

title: Cara's Irish Feijoada

instructions: Put all ingredients in a bowl and mix well. Serve chilled.

title: Chickpea, Salt and Chilli Potato Tofu #5FIX
ingredients: 1 box frozen mixed potatoes | 1 lb extra firm tofu | 1/2 cup chickpeas, cooked | 1/4 cup lite silken extra firm tofu ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon rose water | 1 chipotle chile, chopped into chunks | 2 teaspoons corn
instructions: Preheat grill / oven to 350 degrees. Wash potatoes, place in a mixing bowl & rinse with cold water. Cut into chunks & roughly chop. Cut tofu into 4 - 6 squares & then into chunks. Slice chilli & add to bowl with potatoes. Toss to combine. Toss together & set aside. Place the oil or extra firm tofu in a frying pan and sear on all sides, turning often. Remove to plate & place on cooling rack over foil lined baking sheet to catch drippings. Heat a small pot over medium heat & add the rose water. title: Gorgonzola Crabe Cakes(Albicuchos En Cremoogadas)
ingredients: 2 1/4 cups cake flour | 2 3/4 cups egg substitute | 2 lbs fresh clams | 3/4 cup clam fat, reserved | 8 ounces gorgonzola | 3/4 cup margarine | 12 peppercorns | 3 ounces white rice flour
instructions: Pastry, in a medium bowl, sift flour and salt into a mound on a work surface. Set aside. Fill a deep pot generously with salted water. Heat half the clam fat to a near boil then remove from the stove. Add clams, cover and shake off any remaining sand that rises to surface. Repeat procedure with remaining oil and clams. Set aside for 10 minutes. Do not overcook or the shells will burst. Set the clams aside. Mix remaining clam fat with gorgonzola cheese until dissolved. Set cheese aside. In a bowl, sift rice flour, flour and salt into a mound on the work surface. Work with the hand until well mixed. Cover dough with a clean cloth and roll out on a lightly floured board to 1/8 inch thickness. Cut dough into circles and place 1 1/4 cups filling in the center and fold over to form a ball. Repeat until all the filling and gorgonzola has been used. You will have to flatten each circle thin with your rolling pin. Sprinkle ciabellos with a little flour. In a large skillet, fry ciabellos in batches over medium heat, turning once, for 5 - 7 minutes or until light brown on all sides. Cool on paper towels. Note, cookers will be hot so use a deep fryer for reheating. Drain on paper towels, serve hot with a dollop of cream and a sprinkle of chopped onion. They also freeze well.

title: Seared Mushrooms in Creamy Mushroom Sauce

instructions: Heat heavy non stick frying pan over medium heat. Add mushroom and saute, stirring often, about 3 minutes. Add cream.

title: Fettuccine With Baked Sausage and Cocoa

instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add the fettuccine and cook until almost tender, 8 to 10 minutes. Drain and rinse well with cold water. Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,spanish onion,bok choy,wooden skewer,adobo sauce,cumin powder
title: Spicy Indian Kebabs With Vegetables

Cook over medium heat, stirring frequently, for about ten minutes until the tomatoes are softened, the onions are slightly charred and the onions are a dark gold color. Transfer the onions and tomato mixture to a plate and season to taste with salt and pepper. Arrange the pieces of bok choy on a plate and serve immediately.

instructions: Heat 1/4 cup maple syrup in a dutch oven over medium high heat until hot but not smoking, about 2 minutes. Add potatoes and 3/4 cup maple syrup, stirring to coat. Bring to a boil. Lower heat.

Canapes that are Gluten-Free.

title: Wild Rice and Green Peas (Rice Cooker)

Serve immediately after the rice is done chilling the rice and green peas.

title: Homemade Chilled Vinegar
ingredients: 2 quarts chicken broth ( homebrew or organic ) | 2 1/2 lbs pared mild apple cider vinegar ( about 7 cups ) | 1 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Place the cider vinegar and mace in a small saucepan and bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring occasionally, then remove from the heat. title: Chipotle Adobo and Onion Soup
ingredients: 1 packet dry onion soup mix | 1 teaspoon saffron | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried chipotle chiles in adobo | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/4 teaspoon ground anise seed
instructions: In a 4 to 5 quart pot brown the onion soup mix, chipotle pepper adobo, cinnamon and anise for 3 to 5 minutes. Stir in the soup mix and simmer for 8 to 10 minutes. Chill for one hour in the refrigerator.

title: Tunisian Oyster Motoyu
ingredients: 12 oysters, shucked, with liquid reserved | 1/2 cup buttermilk | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed | 1 pinch cayenne pepper | 1 pinch vanilla extract | 8 ounces salami | 1 pinch cayenne pepper
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together oysters, buttermilk, fennel seeds, cayenne pepper, and vanilla extract. Place salami in a bowl with the reserved liquid. Spoon equal amounts of the tapenade into each oyster shell, and sprinkle with 1 tablespoon of the cayenne pepper.

Random Ingredients: red pepper,cognac,yellow bell pepper,chinese cabbage,green onion,mirin,ice cube,lime wedge
title: Mojito Coleslaw
ingredients: 1/2 cup mirin | 3 tablespoons green onions, chopped | 1 tablespoon red pepper, diced ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons red onions, diced ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons yellow bell peppers, minced ( optional ) | 1/3 cup cognac | 6 -8 ice cubes | 2 green onions, chopped ( optional ) | lime wedge ( optional )
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together mirin, green onions, red pepper, red onion and red onion. Place ice cubes in a blender or food processor. Blend until smooth, about 2 minutes. Place the green onions, red pepper, and red onion on a serving plate. Add the cognac to the wine mixture and then pour over the green onion mixture and stir to combine. Serve on a wedge with ice and garnish with lime wedges.

Random Ingredients: green enchilada sauce,red chili powder,biscuit,milk chocolate,hatch chile,tarragon,confectioner sugar,cranberry
title: Chile Conchiladas
ingredients: 6 ounces evaporated milk chocolate | 1 can green enchilada sauce | 3 tablespoons minced fresh tarragon | 4 ounces diced canned chiles | 1/2 teaspoon red chili powder | 1/4 teaspoon dried tarragon, crushed | 1 package refrigerated biscuits | 1 1/2 cups diced, cooked smoked garlicky white or napa cabbage, or | 1 1/2 cups confectioners'sugar, for dusting
instructions: Grease a 1 1/2 quart casserole. In a medium bowl, combine the evaporated milk chocolate, enchilada sauce, tarragon, chiles, chili powder and crushed tarragon until well combined. Reserve 1 tablespoon of chili powder mixture. Place 1 biscuit in the bottom of the prepared baking dish. Top with half of the chocolate mixture. Repeat layers with the remaining biscuits and chocolate mixture, ending with a layer of reserved chili powder mixture and a sprinkle of shredded cabbage. Let stand at room temperature for 1 hour. Sprinkle with confectioners' sugar before serving if desired.

title: Honey Oil
ingredients: 1 tablespoon honey | 1 tablespoon canola oil
instructions: Mix all ingredients until well combined.

title: Quick Mixed Mushroom and Spice Soup
ingredients: 100 g button mushrooms, chopped | 100 g mixed dried cherries | 2 tablespoons mixed spice | 5 cups chicken stock or 5 cups broth
instructions: Place the mushrooms in a saucepan with the water that they soaked. Place over a moderate heat and gently boil for about 15 minutes until the mushrooms are tender and have given off their liquid. Drain through a sieve. Add the cherries to the simmering soup and then add the mixed spice. Add the chicken stock and cook over a high heat for 5 minutes, or until the soup is thick.

Random Ingredients: milk chocolate,garlic powder,peanut oil vegetable,white wine
title: Prawns, Milk Chocolate & Garlic
ingredients: 2 lbs prawns, shells on | 3/4 cup white wine | 1/4 cup peanut oil or 1/4 cup vegetable oil ( for frying ) | 1/4 cup condensed milk chocolate ( optional )
instructions: Mix the white wine and condensed milk in a glass container. Add the prawns and keep refrigerating. Heat up the oil in a skillet or wok until very hot. Add the prawns in batches and stir quickly with a wooden spoon. When they turn pink and give off their sheen, remove from the skillet and drain. Pour off excess oil leaving the prawns undisturbed. Reheat the white wine and condensed milk in the same pan that the prawns was sitting in to get all the coating oil off the prawns. Add the prawns back into the pan or wok and simmer for a few minutes to coat any remaining coating oil. Serve immediately and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: spring onion,corn kernel,fish sauce,great northern bean,plum sauce
title: Plum-Crusted Fish and Bean Salad
ingredients: 450 g great northern beans, drained and washed and rinsed | 450 g plum fresh fish ( or shellfish ) | 1 large bunch spring onion, coarsley chopped | 60 g corn kernels | 2 tablespoons plum sauce
instructions: Place beans in a bowl, cover with water and leave undisturbed overnight. Bring the following morning, drain and rinse. Bring a large pan of lightly salted water to the boil and stir in beans. Cook for 8 - 10 minutes until al dente. Drain, cool slightly and cut in half. Cut fish into thick slices. Coat with plum sauce and scatter over bean mixture. Toss and scatter spring onions over salad. Sprinkle over corn kernels.

title: Blue Cheese, Broccoli & Chicken Bake
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 3 cups fresh broccoli, washed, trimmed and cut into 1/2-inch pieces | 2 tablespoons crumbled blue cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Bake chicken for 35 in. Oven about 25 minutes or until tender and internal temperature reaches 165 degrees. Transfer chicken to plate. Add broccoli. Sprinkle with 1 t. Cheddar and top with remaining cheese. Bake for 10 minutes or until heated through.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,tortilla,white rice,flour,asiago cheese,chicken broth,purpose flour,balsamic vinegar
title: Cheesy Tortillas
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups white rice, such as basmati | 4 tablespoons all-purpose flour, plus more | all-purpose flour, for dusting | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 2 1/2 cups chicken broth | 1/2 cup shredded asiago cheese | 6 tortillas, such as as monterey jack or 6 commercially prepared tortillas, about 1/2 inch thick, warm
instructions: Combine the rice, flour, bouillon cubes and vinegar in a saucepan. Over high heat, scald the broth, stirring to dissolve the bouillon. When the broth begins to boil, add the asiago cheese. Quickly whisk in the hot broth. Cover, reduce the heat, and simmer until the rice is cooked, 18 to 25 minutes. Add the tortillas to the rice and toss until hot, about 2 minutes.

title: Beats in Blankets--Tasty Bean Sprouts Salad
ingredients: 1 can campbell's condensed cream of celery soup | 1/2 cup catsup | 1 can bean sprouts | 1/4 cup minced canned celery | 1/8 teaspoon curry | 1/2 cup uncooked barley
instructions: Spray a large cookie sheet with nonstick spray. Combine bean sprouts, celery, curry, and soup, stirring to blend. Spoon 1/2 cup bean sprout mixture onto the cookie sheet or roll up the cookie. Place on cookie sheet and cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate overnight. Turn over and lightly press the top of the rolls with a rolling pin.

title: Spiced Ham and Provolone Rounds
ingredients: 8 slices prosciutto, cut in half crossways | 4 large red chilies ( seeds removed ) | 1 teaspoon mixed spice | 1/2 teaspoon cornflour | 1 teaspoon rice wine | 2 teaspoons curry powder | 2 tablespoons chopped pimiento, drained over a few minutes
instructions: Trim and discard as much of the ribs, cores and seeds as possible from the ham you should have 8 thin and all the fat. If it is too hard, add a small amount of water. Cut each piece lengthways into 5 thin rounds. Cut two long strips of string around each side of the ham, about 6 inches long. Put 2 chilies at one end of each piece of ham and roll up. Chill for 1 hour. Mix the rest of the ingredients together in a small bowl and set aside to be used later. Place a piece of foil on a flat surface. Take a piece of ham, wrap up loosely in the foil and gently squeeze out as much excess air as possible. Season with freshly ground black pepper and salt if desired this will help keep it crisp. Put the ham rolls on the paper towel in a small roasting tin and grill over hot coals for 10 to 15 minutes until crisp and golden. Serve ham rolled up with some curry.

title: Beef and Avocado Rollatikio with Alfredo Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef | 1 envelope cream of alfredo sauce | 2 packets nori, seaweed sheets | 1/2 cup hot beef broth ( from refried beans ) | 1/2 avocado, peeled, pitted and cubed | 1/8 teaspoon allspice | 1/2 cup canadian bacon, cooked, torn into pieces | 2 small ladyfingers, cut in half
instructions: Combine ground beef with saag, alfredo and nori in a large skillet. Brown quickly over medium high heat. Cook until beef is no longer pink, stirring often to prevent scorching. Divide mixture into 2 portions. Using 1 portion, roll 1 portion of mixture around the edge of 1 nori sheet.

title: Olive Oil's Steak and Brandy
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups beef stock or 1 1/2 cups beef hot water | 1 1/2 tablespoons all-purpose seasoning | 2 tablespoons teabagold brandy | 1 lb sirloin, cut into 2 inch cubes
instructions: Preheat broiler. In a medium bowl, combine the beef stock, seasoning, teabagold and brandy using a whisk. Add sirloin and toss to coat. Transfer the beef to a broiling pan or jellyroll pan. Broil 3 inches from the heat 10 - 12 minutes, or to desired doneness.

title: Grilled Sirloin W-Asafetida(Ethiopian Steak Tarkari)
ingredients: 3 -4 sirloin steaks | 4 1/2 tablespoons asafoetida powder ( optional ) | 4 grape, quartered | 1 lb ground sirloin
instructions: Combine both the sirloin steaks and one cup of water in a blender or food processor and puree. You may also use a hand held blender for this step. Add 1/4 cup water to the puree to make 2 cups or more. Refrigerate, covered for at least 4 hours. Combine the beef, remaining 1/4 cup water and the asafetida in a non stick skillet. Cover and cook over medium heat for 20 minutes or until the beef is browned, stirring occasionally.

title: Persian Saffron Balls
ingredients: 2 cups breadcrumbs | 2 saffron | 2 -4 maraschino cherries
instructions: Dip saffron into crumbs until all the pieces are coated with the saffron. Place in a medium bowl. Break saffron pieces into chunks with a spoon and toss with bread crumbs. Arrange on a plate and place the cherries onto cherries. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: almond extract,red curry paste,french dressing,sea salt,yeast
title: Easy Red Curry Fry Bread
ingredients: 1 ounce yeast | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 2 tablespoons french dressing | 1/2 teaspoon dried instant yeast | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt | 2 tablespoons ground almonds
instructions: Add yeast to creamed french dressing in a small bowl, cover the bowl and set aside to proof for 5 minutes. Pre heat oven to 350° f. When yeast mixture is foamy stir in remaining dry ingredients. Turn onto a floured surface and knead until elastic, adding more white flour as needed. Roll dough out onto a lightly floured surface to a thickness of 1 inch. Cut dough into 4 or 6 equal portions. Roll each piece into a ball, place on a lightly greased cookie sheet, cover and let rise for 30 minutes. Sprinkle top with almonds. Bake for 20 minutes, or until crust is lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,flour,romaine lettuce,vegetable oil,basil leaf,lemon peel
title: Mushroom, Lettuce and Parsley Salad (Salade No Mayo)
ingredients: 200 g button mushrooms, wiped clean, trimmed and finely chopped | 1/3 cup fresh basil leaf, tightly packed, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley leaves | 1/4 cup flour | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 teaspoon grated lemon peel
instructions: Combine the mushrooms, basil, parsley, and flour, and stir to combine. Let stand for 5 minutes. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Whisk the vegetable oil into the salad. Pour over the mushrooms and toss to combine.

title: Tomato, Parsley and Oregano Sauce
ingredients: 28 ounces crushed tomatoes ( italian style or italian-style ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/2 cup flat-leaf italian parsley
instructions: Pour crushed tomatoes into a nonreactive bowl. Add dry oregano and parsley and toss well to combine. Let stand for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Pickled Red Cabbage
ingredients: 1/2 head red cabbage, cored | 8 large fresh sage leaves | 6 1/2 tablespoons light palm sugar or 6 1/2 tablespoons brown sugar | 6 tablespoons dark mussels, cleaned and debearded | 2 whole cloves, peeled ( or more ) | 1 3/4 tablespoons golden raisins
instructions: Remove the center core from the cabbage. Place cabbage in a glass jar. Separate leaves of each fresh leaf, then tie with kitchen twine about 2 inches long. Wash the sage leaves in a colander under running water. Remove spines and discard. Fill a large pot with water and bring to a boil. As soon as it boils, drain the cabbage leaves and place into an ice bath to chill for 2 hours. Place the sugar, nutmeg, mussels and cloves into a pot, pour in just enough water to cover and bring to a boil. Lower the heat, cover and boil for one hour. Add the golden raisins and cabbage, taste for seasoning and add more sugar or nutmeg if necessary. Cover and keep warm over low heat until serving.

Random Ingredients: saffron strand,maraschino cherry,black bean,pistachio,green chile pepper,giblet,lemon zest
title: Black Bean Preserves
ingredients: 1 pound dry black beans | 1/4 teaspoon saffron strands | 1/4 teaspoon freshly grated lemon zest | 1 can diced green chile peppers, drained | 2 tablespoons chopped pistachios | 4 maraschino cherries, halved | 2 teaspoons pureed dried giblet
instructions: Place black beans in a large bowl, and mash until coarsely ground. Add saffron, lemon zest, green chile peppers, pistachios, cherries, giblet, and salt.

title: Lentil and Lentil burritos
ingredients: 2 tablespoons pesto pernod | 1 can lentils | 1 cup mixed salad green | 1 cup flour tortilla ( whole wheat or black ) | paprika | salt & pepper
instructions: Combine pesto and lentils in microwave safe bowl. Heat on high for 3 minutes. Place one tortilla on work surface and, using about 1/4 cup pesto mixture, spread down centre. Cover with 3 layers of greens. Fold into thirds. Repeat for other tortillas until all the greens are used up. Place burritos on cookie sheet. Brush with remaining pesto. Sprinkle with paprika. Sprinkle with salt and pepper if desired.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,espresso powder,golden brown sugar,almond extract,beef brisket,bread crumb,baking powder
title: Brisket of Beef
ingredients: 4 pounds beef brisket | 4 1/2 cups bread crumbs | 1 cup golden brown sugar | 2 cups freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 2 teaspoons baking powder | 2 teaspoons coffee powder | 1 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Place brisket in a large crock or stock pot, and sprinkle with the bread crumbs. Season with brown sugar, parmigiano reggiano cheese, baking powder, coffee powder, and almond extract. Cover, and set to low for 6 - 8 hours. Let cool, then slice. Serve with meat.

title: Steamed White Bean With Blue Cheese
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups navy beans | 1/4 lb oyster mushrooms | 5 stalks celery, cut in 2-inch pieces | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 3 tablespoons lime juice | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice
instructions: Cook beans about 4 minutes or until crisp tender. Drain beans, transfer to a bowl. Wipe out a skillet and place over medium heat. When it shimmers, add mushrooms, sprinkle with turmeric. Cook 1 minute stirring often. Drain mushrooms and discard the liquid. Add cooked beans and lime juice and mix well. Divide bean mix among 4 warmed cups and serve.

title: The Old Fashioned English Seven Hour Marinade for Beef
ingredients: 200 g worcestershire sauce | 250 g grated lemon peel
instructions: For beef, the bottle should be clean, but not sticky. Leave the worcestershire sauce at room temperature until needed. For sauce, the bottle should not be dry. After the beef is trimmed of excess fat and grated with a vegetable peeler or in a food processor. It will only take about 10 minutes for the grating and grating to get the meat to be as creamy as possible. Pour worcestershire sauce into the bottle and use the grated lemon peel to spread a thin layer of marinade over the meat. Allow to sit for 5 minutes before cooking.

Random Ingredients: almond extract,bitter,cornflour,gelatin,triple sec,self rising flour,white bread,kidney bean
title: Ghetto White Bread & Bean Jelly Rolls!
ingredients: 1 package unflavoured gelatin | 1 can white kidney beans, drained | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract | 1/4 teaspoon bitters | 3 1/2 cups self-rising flour | 1 1/2 cups white bread | 1 cup triple sec | 1 cup cornflour
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in hot water. Blend in tomatoes and extract until well blended. Blend together dry ingredients and bread with a mixer. Pour in the gelatin mixture and mix well with a wooden spoon. Grease 12 muffin cups. Divide bean mixture evenly among cups. Spread evenly. Sprinkle top with triple sec. Bake in a pre heated oven for 55 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast,brie cheese,grain mustard,heavy cream,bouillon cube,hard egg,bacon dripping,prosciutto
title: Chicken Bacon With Cheese and Hard Boiled Eggs
ingredients: 6 ounces bacon drippings | 3 onions, peeled and halved | 1 chicken breast | 2 ounces prosciutto, chopped | 4 ounces brie cheese, sliced | 7 ounces whole-grain mustard | 6 ounces heavy cream | 1 bouillon cube
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Heat the bacon drippings in a large, high sided frying pan, preferably non stick. Cook the onions for 3 mins or so until soft and transparent, then add the chicken cutlets, prosciutto and brie and cook, stirring, until the prosciutto has melted. In a small bowl, mix together the mustard and cream, add to the ham and pork and mix well. Put the ham and pork on a plate and scatter over the ham and bacon mixture. Pour over the mustard cream and the bouillon and mix well. Transfer to an ovenproof dish, bake for 45 mins until the bacon and sausages are cooked through.

Random Ingredients: provolone cheese,green lentil,ciabatta,herb,parmigiano reggiano cheese,phyllo pastry
title: Green Lentil Bread & Prosciutto Panini
ingredients: 1 lb green lentil ( in pulses ) | 9 small ciabatta ( loaf ) | 6 slices provolone cheese ( or mozzarella cheese ) | 12 fresh herb ( mixed such as dill, parsley, and thyme or try it with basil ) | 2 ounces fresh parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 2 sheets phyllo pastry, thawed ( or you can use a package regular frozen phyllo filled slices, thawed )
instructions: Place the lentils in a large pot & cover with water. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to low & simmer, covered & checking the color of the beans, about 40 minutes. Meanwhile, using a slotted spoon or a slotted strainer, transfer the black lentils to a bowl & mash until mostly smooth. Reserve 2 tbsp of the lentils & reserve the remaining lentils for a topping. Cut the ciabatta loaf in half lengthwise. Remove the crusts & cut the halves into 6 equal triangles. Working with 1 triangles at a time, arrange a ciabatta half on the work surface & lay 1 strip across the top. Spread 1 tbsp of parmesan cheese over the pasion & lay a sheet of the remaining strips across the top. Top with 2nd bread & place the 4 triangles on top of the cheese. Repeat with the remaining bread & the 2 tbsp cheese. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium high heat & lightly oil the grate. Bake the bread for 5 minutes or until the surface is golden.

Random Ingredients: egg noodle,golden syrup,cardamom powder,quinoa,sesame oil,pomegranate seed,beer
title: Mock Noodle and Quinoa Kebab
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 1/2 cup golden syrup, i use honey | 1/2 cup sesame oil | 1/4 cup pomegranate seeds | 1 1/2 teaspoons cardamom powder | 4 bottles beer | 1 egg noodles
instructions: Soak quinoa until very soft but not liquid, 20 - 30 minutes, depending on your time frame. Drain and rinse well with cool water, drain again, rinse again and set aside. In a large bowl, combine all ingredients except for noodles, mix well. Add noodles and toss together and set aside in the refrigerator 15 minutes, or until noodles are fully cooked. Toss noodles with sauce and serve.

title: Namibian Mjukka (Kielbasa Ladyfingers) (Low Fat, cholesterol free)
ingredients: 1 bunch kielbasa, sliced into 1-inch thick rounds ( sweet or low fat ) | 500 g greek yogurt | 250 g ladyfingers ( cut into 1/2-inch triangles ) | 1 teaspoon chili pepper flakes
instructions: Place the sliced kielbasa rounds in a colander. Remove excess moisture from the yogurt by drying between layers of paper towels, then squeeze out as much water as possible. In a small bowl combine the chili pepper flakes with the yogurt and combine well. Place half the ladyfingers on a work surface, spread with half the yogurt mixture, and top with half the chili sauce and half the remaining ladyfingers. Repeat layers with remaining pieces of kielbasa, chili flakes and remaining yogurt mixture, ending with a final layer of ladyfingers. Let sit at room temperature for 20 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: coconut oil,rice noodle,white wine vinegar,lemon zest
title: Vietnamese Lemongrass Noodle Salad
ingredients: 15 ounces rice noodles ( vermicelli, long thin ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon grated lemon zest ( fresh ) | 1/4 cup coconut oil
instructions: Add noodles to a pan of boiling water. Cook until tender but still firm.. Drain. Rinse with cold water and then drain. Add all other ingredients into a large bowl. Toss with coconut oil in the measuring cups until well mixed.

Random Ingredients: gruyere,potato gnocchi,chipotle chile adobo,ginger garlic paste,white vinegar
title: Chipotle Gnocchi and Chipotle
ingredients: 6 potatoes gnocchi | 1 chipotle chile in adobo, minced | 2 teaspoons white vinegar | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1/4 cup grated gruyere, or to taste
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook gnocchi about 3 minutes, or until al dente.

title: Spicy Pineapple-Pineapple Stock
ingredients: 2 large head escarole - rinsed, dried and chopped
instructions: Place the escarole in a large container with a tight fitting lid. Add enough water to cover the top. Place a plate on top and refrigerate for at least 24 hours. When ready to serve, drain and shake off any excess water. Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: kitchen bouquet,beef stew meat,five spice powder,fajita seasoning mix,chinese five spice powder,onion
title: Sweet and Sour Beef
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs beef stew meat | 1 large onion, sliced | 2 cups fajita seasoning mix | 1 5/8 ounces five-spice powder | 1 teaspoon five-spice powder | 1 tablespoon kitchen bouquet
instructions: Combine all ingredients. If using a crockpot, place on low and cook for 5 - 8 hours, stirring occasionally. Soups, heat in a crockpot 10 minutes before meal. Note, if you want to cut beef into large chunks cut into chunks before serving. Soup, place stew meat in soup pot, add fajita seasoning mixes, and stir. Add soup mix and cook for another 5 - 10 minutes, or until stew is tender. Serve with flour or cornbread or rice.

title: Portabella and Mushroom Lovers on a Bed of Garlic Toast
ingredients: 1 loaf garlic toast ( toasted and crusty type ) | 1 can beef fat-free refried beans | 1 jar portabella mushrooms ( drained, not dry ) | 1 cup vegetable broth | 1 tablespoon molasses | 1 teaspoon celery salt ( i like spicy ) | 1 teaspoon haricot bean ( optional ) | 1/2 cup yogurt
instructions: Slice the garlic toast in half horizontally. Arrange half of the bread evenly on a round serving platter. Strain all but 1 tbsp of the liquid from the jar of mushrooms into a small saucepan. Stir in the refried beans, mushrooms, broth, molasses, celery salt, and haricot bean. Bring the heat to medium high and simmer the mixture, uncovered, for 10 minutes. Drizzle with remaining yogurt and fold in remaining bread. Serve warm.

title: Curry Pie Crust

instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f place biscuit mix in a bowl, stir in coriander seeds. Press biscuit mix into a 9 inch pie dish. Spread biscuit mixture over biscuits. Bake for about 20 minutes or until golden.

title: Thai Spring Roll
ingredients: 2 tablespoons minced fresh lemongrass ( white parts only ) | 2/3 cup sweet corn | 1 tablespoon hot chili sauce | 1 package rice noodles | 1/4 cup spring greens | 1 teaspoon pepper
instructions: Prepare noodles according to package directions, omitting any oil and salt. Coarsely chop lemongrass. Remove and discard stems from chopped lemongrass and crush lightly with a rolling pin or heavy skillet. Stir in hot chili sauce and minced sweet corn. Remove rinsed noodles and cut in half lengthwise. Roll each half into a ball by rolling a wooden spoon lengthwise. Place 2 noodles onto each half. Place half the greens and 1/2 teaspoon pepper in center of the balls. Roll in reserved greens. Roll the tortilla in water until wraps are completely wrapped and pliable. Serve with a variety of dipping sauces.

title: Nuoc Cham (Vietnamese Dipping Sauce)
ingredients: 1 cup sesame seeds, toasted | 1 teaspoon fresh orange peel, grated | 3 tablespoons fish sauce ( nuoc mam or korma )
instructions: Grind the seeds and orange peel together into a fine powder. Gradually add the fish sauce, pounding it with the back of a wooden spoon. It should have the consistency of a thick paste. Variation, for shrimp tacos, stir the sesame seeds with a little hot water to remove their fragrance. Thin with a little more fish sauce.

title: Scallops in Chile Pepper Sauce

6 large scallops, about 1.

instructions: Rinse scallops under running water.

Random Ingredients: cherry,mushroom,lime juice zest,egg beater substitute,vanilla powder
title: Cherries, Diced Mushrooms & Egg Beaters
ingredients: 4 medium mushrooms, washed, dried and finely chopped | 60 ml lime juice, zest of ( optional ) | 2 egg whites, beaten | 1 tablespoon vanilla powder | 30 ml non-hydrogenated canola oil or 30 ml vegetable oil
instructions: Mix everything together except the oil. Sprinkle on the oil and refrigerate for 2 hours. Just before grilling, use the egg beater, to beat with a wire whisk.

title: Spinach and Barbecue Fried Cannellini Beans
ingredients: 2 teaspoons oil | 1 bulb of garlic | 2 packages baby spinach | 2 cups prepared barbecue sauce | 1 tablespoon thai red curry paste | 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1/3 cup strawberry preserves
instructions: Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add the garlic, and saute just until golden, about 10 seconds. Add the spinach and stir around. Remove from heat. Stir the bbq sauce, curry paste and cannellini beans into the spinach, and toss to combine. Place the spinach mixture in a large bowl, and set aside. Heat the preserves in a small saucepan over medium heat, until a small piece in the center of a piece of foil sizzles.

title: Mushroom Pita Bread  With Grand Marnier
ingredients: 2 pita bread | 6 large portabella mushrooms, cleaned, washed and stems removed | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/2 cup grand marnier | guacamole
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Slice mushrooms into thick rings. Layer in your food processor, mushrooms, garlic salt, grand marnier and guacamole. Repeat till all ingredients are used. Using a 2½ inch round biscuit cutter, cut 8 rounds. Insert a few slices in each round. Bake 15 minutes. Serve warm. Variation, try substituting shrimp with garlic powder to make 2 pita breads and 1 pita bread or 2 pita bread halves cut into half moon shaped pieces. May also sub crab legs with chicken breasts. Mushroom sauce suggestion, substitute 1/2 cup chopped onions for mushroom mixture.

ingredients:
4 tablespoons brandy | 1 lemon pepper | 1 tablespoon caraway seed | 4 whole trout fillets ( about 1 3 lb.

instructions: For caramelizing caraway seed, combine brandy, lemon pepper and caraway in a small skillet over medium low heat, heating through. Remove from heat. For fish, cover fish with 1/3 cup light caramelized sauce.

Random Ingredients: walla onion,mushroom stem,ahi tuna steak,buttermilk,spicy brown mustard
title: Smoked Ahi Tuna & Smoked Mushroom Saute
ingredients: 1/2 cup low-fat buttermilk | 8 ounces medium shrimp mushrooms stems ( may substitute light mayo & mayo ) | 1/2 cup spicy brown mustard | 1/2 lb fresh ahi tuna steak or 1/2 lb ahi sushi grade tuna steak, sliced ( 4-6 oz or per person, may substitute another type of fish ) | 1/2 cup finely chopped walla walla walla onion
instructions: Whisk buttermilk in small bowl until smooth but not frothy. Season to taste with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Arrange mushrooms, mustard & tuna slices, overlapping, to within 1/4 of edges of each other near center of large sauté pan. Top each with 1/2 cup of the the mushroom mix. Using a teaspoon, gently spread the mushroom mix toward the edge of sauté pan over mushrooms, creating a hidden valley over each mound. Cook, covered, over medium low heat until mushrooms are browned & tender crisp, about 40 minutes. Uncover skillet & let stand uncovered 5 minutes. Remove lid from pan & brush on top of smoky anhi sauce, until all is absorbed. If any sauce thickens sufficiently, remove from heat & serve immediately.

title: Rice and Salmon
ingredients: 2 cups short-grain rice | 1/2 pound salmon, cut into chunks
instructions: Place the salmon and rice into a bowl, cover, and refrigerate for 1 hour to marinate. Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Place the rice on a baking sheet. Bake for 5 minutes in the preheated oven, to crisp the grains. Fluff up the rice with a fork.

title: Homemade Devon Beer
ingredients: 16 ounces mustard greens | 1/4 cup pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Wash and pat dry mustard greens. Remove stems and wash hard fiber ends. Wash mustard greens and pat dry. Tear mustard greens into bite size pieces. Place in gallon sized canning container. Sprinkle pecorino romano cheese over top. Let sit until cheese softens. May also be made with other hard rolls if desired.

Random Ingredients: bacon,mustard powder,soy sauce,rotini pasta,asafoetida powder,lime juice,brown sugar,white chocolate
title: Vegtable Roll Up
ingredients: 12 ounces dry rotini pasta, any medium sized pasta shape | 1 tablespoon dry mustard powder | 1 teaspoon powdered asafoetida powder ( or a combo of 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder and 1/2 teaspoon a pinch of a pinch of white pepper powder ) | 1/3 cup soy sauce | 1/4 teaspoon lime juice | 12 slices bacon, chopped | 12 thin limes, cut into 2-inch sections | 1 white chocolate, halved and sliced into 8 pieces
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain all but 1 tablespoon of water, and set aside. Combine dry mustard powder, asafoetida powder, soy sauce, and lime juice in a small bowl. Add drained pasta and bacon to bowl, stirring to combine well. Divide evenly among 4 serving plates. Roll up limes and place on top. Sprinkle orange slice over roll ups. Sprinkle white chocolate on top of roll ups and serve immediately.

title: Oriental Ravioli Appetizers
ingredients: 10 -12 round cheese ravioli | 1 can tomato juice | 1 tbsps mirin
instructions: Boil water and add ravioli, cook until they float, drain. In a saucepan add tomato juice, and cook over medium heat until they get a nice thick gravy consistency. Pour 1 tbsps. Of mirin into a plate. Dip drained ravioli in gravy before serving.

title: Mexican Pizza
ingredients: 1 can no-sliced mixed mushrooms | 12 ounces prepared pizza sauce | 1/2 cup fruit filling | 12 taco-size soft wafers | pasta sauce or your favorite pasta sauce
instructions: Lay out all ingredients. Spread with pizza sauce or top with your favorite meat toppings and bake at 350 for 15 minutes or until crusty, heated through. Add cheese.

title: Lek Confit (Leek and Pepper Puree)
ingredients: 1/2 pound fresh leek, trimmed and chopped | 1/2 teaspoon chopped fresh sage | 1 small yellow pepper, chopped | 1 container lemonade | 1/4 cup confectioners'sugar, or as needed
instructions: Combine leeks, sage, and yellow pepper in a blender.

Random Ingredients: orange juice zest,beef broth,french lentil,spring onion
title: Lentil Soup with Orange
ingredients: 6 -8 cups beef broth ( or chicken broth ) | 2 ounces french lentils | 3 spring onions, sliced as if you were making pita bread | 5 slices orange rind, grated as if you were making pita bread
instructions: In large pot, bring 2 cups of beef broth, lentils and spring onions to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 15 - 20 minutes until lentils are tender. Remove rind before serving with pita bread. Serve with orange rind for garnishment.

Random Ingredients: biscuit,spanish onion,new potato,beef tenderloin,mix,italian green bean,gruyere,green chilies
title: Beef Tenderloin & Potato Pizza With Swiss Potatoes
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin, trimmed | 2 packages refrigerated biscuits | 1 can chopped green chilies, divided | 2 lbs small new potatoes, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 medium spanish onion, thinly sliced | 1 package frozen mixed italian cut green beans, thawed | 8 ounces shredded gruyere or 8 ounces swiss cheese blend
instructions: Heat oven to 425°f wrap beef in plastic wrap, and place on a wire rack in a shallow roasting pan. Place pan in oven and roast until meat thermometer registers 140°f for rare, about 10 minutes. Remove from oven and carefully tent with foil. Let roast rest at room temperature for 20 minutes, then thinly slice. While oven is heating, place biscuits on a baking sheet and toast in oven until they are lightly browned and fragrant, about 4 minutes. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add chiles and cook, stirring frequently, until they begin to soften, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside. Place potatoes, onion, 3/4 of the cheese, 3/4 of the beef and chile mixture in the pan, then sprinkle over remaining cheese. Bake, patted dry, until heated through, 15 to 18 minutes, and remove from the oven. Place cheese on a serving plate and bake potato mixture according to package directions. Place on a serving platter, tent with foil, and let rest 5 minutes. Cut crosswise into thick slices. Serve potatoes on side. Note, if you like your crust to crispy and crunchy, preheat oven to 400°f in a small baking dish, arrange potato on the bottom of the dish and top with beef slices, onions and remaining 1/4 of cheese. Drizzle on more chile sauce. Cover and bake in the oven until the cheese is melted, 20 to 30 minutes. Sprinkle with remaining 1/4 cheese and bake for 5 minutes until cheese is melted. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: white chocolate,shallot,rye flour,cream chicken soup,cayenne pepper,baby shrimp,chili oil
title: Shrimp White Chocolate Mousse Cake
ingredients: 500 ml light cream of chicken soup | 200 g white chocolate | 1/2 cup shallot, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon chili oil | 10 baby shrimp, cooked | 1 pinch cayenne pepper | 2 teaspoons rye flour
instructions: Place the light cream of chicken soup and finely chopped white chocolate in a bowl. Heat the chili oil in a small saucepan, add the shallots and cook, stirring, for 2 or 3 minutes, until soft. Add the shrimp to the bowl and cook for 1 minute on medium to high heat. Pour in the chocolate mixture. Let cool slightly. Add the rye flour and stir well to mix. Spread half the mousse between a greased 20cm round cake tin. Press the baby shrimp into the mousse to cover evenly. Spread the remaining mousse over the shrimp and allow to set. Sprinkle with cayenne pepper and leave in the fridge for 4 hours to set. Remove from the refrigerator and leave to set completely. When set, scatter the shrimps over the top, remove from the tin and cut into slices. Serve chilled.

title: Nanaimo (Grilled Pumpkin Skewers)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs pumpkin ( about 2 1/2 pounds ) | 1 1/4 cups beef tenderloin | 1 japanese serrano chili, thinly sliced ( seeds included ) | 2 cups flour | sake ( optional )
instructions: Prepare your grill or broiler. Cut a lengthwise slice from one side of pumpkin to the other.
