Cut in halves so that 2 halves are placed around the rim, then cut in half again to make 4 halved slices. Brush each piece with 1/2 tablespoon oil and then place on hot pan. When pan is hot, cook until skins are light brown, about 5 to 7 minutes then flip, sprinkle with salt and turn again. Remove pumpkin pieces and place onto foil lined grill or broiler pan. Cook for 4 to 5 minutes on each side, turning once. Remove to plate and cover. Cut in half and serve with hot saki or sake, if desired.

title: Guinness Soaked Chocolate Cookies
ingredients: 200 g chocolate | 3 cups icing sugar | 1 cup guinness stout | 1 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: First place the chocolate in a bowl, put the Guinness stout in the microwave for about 2 - 3 minutes, or until chocolate has melted and it smells nice and good. Mix that into the chocolate with the baking soda, then add the icing sugar and mix thoroughly. Roll the dough into small balls, and press into parchment paper lined 20/50cm x 30cm / 10x2cm / 1. Place chocolate on the parchment paper covered cookie tray, and put in the fridge until set. This will take at least 30 minutes to set. Enjoy.

title: Italian Orange Peel (Coq Au Vin)
ingredients: 4 large oranges with peel, scrubbed | 4 teaspoons extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Cut a 1/2 inch slice off each orange and set aside. Place the orange slices in a single layer on an ungreased baking sheet. Brush with 2 teaspoons olive oil. Brush the orange slices with remaining 1 teaspoons olive oil. Bake for 5 minutes or until soft and slightly opaque. Remove from oven. Cool. Remove orange slices from pan, letting any juices run back into the cracks. Place orange slices in an ovenproof serving dish. Pour 1 teaspoon olive oil over the orange slices and serve at once.

title: Chocolate Mac & Cheese
ingredients: 2 cups shredded mexican blend cheese | 1 package tortilla chips | 1 tablespoon shredded semisweet chocolate | 1/3 cup macaroni, not tubetti
instructions: In a large bowl, mix cheese, tortilla chips and chocolate. In a microwave safe bowl, cook macaroni as directed on package. Drain and put back in the microwave for 2 minutes, mix carefully. Add tortilla chips in small increments until all are coated with chips. Enjoy.

title: Moroccan Spice Bread
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups strong mexican blend cheese ( see note note below ) | 1 1/4 cups dried raspberries | 1 1/4 cups red miso | 2 3/4 teaspoons instant yeast or 2 3/4 teaspoons fast rising yeast | 1 2/3 cups coriander leaves | 1 tablespoon sesame oil
instructions: Place all of the ingredients in the order suggested by your manual or other machine and process until smooth, about 5 minutes, or according to the manual's instructions. Transfer to an oiled and lightly floured bowl and let rise in a warm place until doubled in volume, about 45 minutes, or to room temperature. Bake at 180°c for 25 - 35 minutes or until golden and sounds hollow when tapped. Cool a few minutes. Loosen bread from the bowl, transfer to a wire rack and cool completely. Note, to make fresh yeast, dissolve yeast in 1 teaspoon of water and 1/4 cup warm water. Let stand 10 minutes. Drain well. If using a yeast sponge, dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup warm water & 1/4 cup warm water. Let stand 5 minutes then stir well. Beat in a mixer bowl until light and fluffy. Add the last cup of warm water and stir until it starts to make a smooth batter. Grease a 7 x 11/2 inch glass baking dish, and sprinkle flour on the bottom to prevent sticking. Turn risen dough and spread over the melted butter or margarine. Using floured hands, roll dough into a round, about 10 x 15 inches. Spread miso or sour cream evenly over the dough. Bake in an oven set at 150°c for 35 - 40 minutes or until crisp and golden brown. Note, to make miso paste, blend 3 tablespoons milk or water, 2 tablespoons sesame oil, 1/2 teaspoon of paprika, and 3 tablespoons of flour in a blender until smooth. Transfer to a mixing bowl and cook over very low heat, stirring for 1 minute. Stir in miso paste and 1/4 teaspoon salt.

title: Peach - Peanut Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 4 cups peeled, chopped peaches | 1/4 cup peanut oil
instructions: Place the peaches in a resealable quart size plastic bag. Drizzle with 1/4 cup peanut oil and toss to coat. Pour in the remaining 1/4 cup peanut oil and shake to coat. Seal the bag, then refrigerate 1 hour to marinate. Preheat the grill to high. Place the peaches on skewers and brush with remaining 1/2 cup peamelled peanut oil. Grill 2 minutes on each side, until lightly browned and just firm to the touch.

Random Ingredients: cream celery soup,liquid smoke,beef stew meat,mustard seed,dark chocolate,purple onion
title: Peel, Eat and Passover Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat | 1 can cream of celery soup ( or cream of mushroom soup ) | 1 purple onion, chopped | 1/2 ounce dark chocolate, grated ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons mustard seeds | liquid smoke ( optional )
instructions: If beef is partially frozen, thaw it overnight in the refrigerator. Remove meat from freezer. Cut it into 1 1/2 inch pieces and put them into a large bowl. Pour soup over meat. Do not stir, but leave air in the bowl. Add next 8 ingredients, stir gently to remove all lumps. Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnite.

title: Pasta Salad with Cucumber and Barley
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds rigatoni pasta | 1 can peeled, seeded and diced cucumbers | 2 cups pearl barley
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook rigatoni in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 11 minutes.

title: Easy & Delicious Fiesta Dip
ingredients: 1 can frozen mixed vegetables | 1 jar chunky salsa ( i like to use mild med and hot ) | 1/4 cup mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon chili paste ( or to taste )
instructions: Prepare and mash the veggies with a fork. Add the mayonnaise & chili paste & mix well. Store in fridge until ready to use.

Random Ingredients: white flour,black sesame seed,chicken meat,pecan,gingerroot,caper,anise seed,green olive
title: Ginger Chicken (Stuff)
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken meat, cut up | 1/2 lb white flour | 1/2 bunch gingerroot, minced | 1 cup green olives, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup capers, with | 5 1/2 teaspoons black sesame seeds | 1 tablespoon anise seed | 2 tablespoons fresh pecans, toasted and coarsely chopped
instructions: Combine everything but the pepper and nuts. Mix thoroughly. Let rest. Place chicken in a bowl and pour in marinade, mixing in lightly with your hands. Let marinate at least 3 hours, or at least overnight. Drain and pat chicken dry with kitchen towels. Wrap well and place on a piece of foil large enough to put up the chicken. Put over a high heat in the oven, lower the temp in lower part until it is just about cooked through, about 10 minutes, or. 160 190° for about 1 hour. Take chicken out of oven, and let marinade cool for about 10 minutes. Do not drain the chicken or allow it to dry out. Cut chicken meat in half and place on serving platter. Spoon on a few tablespoons of marinade and garnish with roasted pecans.

Random Ingredients: beef shank,extra virgin olive oil,garlic salt,red potato,dark rum,mozzarella cheese
title: Beef Shanks With Red Potatoes & Rum
ingredients: 4 lbs red potatoes | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 tablespoon garlic salt ( fresh or dried ) | 1 tablespoon dark rum ( rum is best ) | 1 lb beef shank, frozen cut into 4 even pieces ( or other dark beef ) | 1 cup mozzarella cheese, grated
instructions: Parboil potatoes in a large pot of salted water until tender, about 20 minutes. Meanwhile, heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add garlic salt. Season beef with salt. Cook until browned on all sides, about 10 minutes, then transfer to a shallow oven proof pan or roasting pan and tent with foil. Pour the 1 cup rum over the beef and turn to coat. Cover loosely, transfer to the oven and bake in a 350 degree oven for 1 1/2 hours or until beef is tender. Stir about halfway through cooking, scatter shredded mozzarella on each serving and serve with potato wedges.

Random Ingredients: baby carrot,turmeric,sausage,bay leaf,rum,simple syrup,thai fish sauce,vanilla ice cream
title: Malaysian Brunch
ingredients: 10 lbs baby carrots ( about 7 1/2 lbs ) | 1 lb ground sausage | 3 ounces rum | 1 teaspoon turmeric ( freshly ground ) | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract or 1 teaspoon pure maple syrup | 3 bay leaves | 1 bottle thai fish sauce | 1 pint simple syrup | 2 scoops vanilla ice cream
instructions: Scrub baby carrots with a vegetable brush and boil until just tender. Set aside to drain. In a medium nonstick skillet, heat 2 tbsps canola oil until shimmering. Stir in ground sausage with sugar. Cook over high heat until browned. Add rum, turmeric, vanilla or maple syrup, bay leaves and fish sauce. Cook until flavors blended and sugar is melted and spices are aromatic. Remove from heat and set aside. Heat 1 tbsps. Canola oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add 1 1/2 cups baby carrots to the pan and stir to coat with pan mixture. Cook over high heat until coated with pan mixture. Remove from heat and transfer carrots to a shallow baking pan or glass dish. Bake at 425, stirring occasionally, until crisp and golden. Remove from oven and let cool on a rack. While carrots are baking, in a 4 quart saucepan, add 1 cup ice cream and 1/2 of sugar. Stir to combine and heat through. Add 3/4 cup carrot slaw and 1 tbsps. Canola oil and combine until all is incorporated. Place remaining carrot slaw on a platter and top with hot brussels sprouts.

title: Green Chile Relish
ingredients: 3 large spanish onions, sliced 1/2 inch thick | 3 cans chopped green chile peppers, drained | 1/2 cup brandy | 4 cups cake flour
instructions: Place a 6 quart pot over high heat. Add the green chile peppers and onions, and cook until the onions are limp, about 5 minutes. Remove the onions with a slotted spoon, leaving the oil in the pot. Stir the brandy into the onion mixture, then add the onion onion mixture to the pot. Place the cake flour in a small bowl. Stir the flour into the chile mixture. Turn the heat down to low. Cook the cake mixture until it has thickened and is smooth, about 30 minutes. Turn off the heat and let cool. Store in an airtight container.

title: Easy Crock Pot Roast Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs beef roast | 1 package ranch dressing mix
instructions: Add roast to crock pot. Pour ranch dressing mix over roast. Cook on low for 9 to 10 hours. Remove roast to serving platter. Spoon juices from crock pot or gravy boat into gravy boat, top with desired amount of cheese and chopped tomatoes. Enjoy makes a great dinner for this meal.

Random Ingredients: craisins,vegetable shortening,ice,nutritional yeast,white button mushroom,tomatillo,bucatini pasta,marjoram
title: Homemade Mushrooms and Cheddar Cheese
ingredients: 1 package bucatini pasta | 1/2 cup vegetable shortening | 1 1/2 cups shredded iceberg lettuce- rinsed and patted dry | 1/2 cup frozen chopped mixed vegetables ( mushrooms and bell peppers ) | 1 cup white button mushrooms | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 2 jars tomatillos | 1/2 cup nutritional yeast
instructions: Cook bucatini according to package directions. Meanwhile, melt the shortening in a skillet over a medium heat. Stir in the tomatoes, mushrooms, marjoram, and drained bucatini. Reduce heat to low, and cook 5 to 10 minutes to blend flavors. Stirring occasionally, mix in the cooked bucatini and nutritional yeast. Remove from the heat, and mix in your favorite cheese.

Random Ingredients: pork loin chop,caper,chili,angel hair pasta,pepperoncini pepper,celery rib,mayonnaise,irish cream
title: Lazy Irish Looney Pork Chops
ingredients: 4 bone-in skinless pork loin chops, about 3/4-1 inch thick | 4 celery ribs, sliced thinly | 1 jar sliced hot peppersoncini peppers, drained and halved | 16 pepperoncini peppers, drained and halved | 12 ounces angel hair pasta or 12 ounces whole wheat angel hair pasta | 1 cup mayonnaise | 2 tablespoons irish cream | 1 tablespoon capers
instructions: Preheat broiler. Place pork chops on broiler rack in baking dish, fat side up. Broil about 4 inches from heat for about 5 minutes, or until pork is just cooked through. Remove from heat, and slice into about 16 equal chops. Set aside. Drain the peppers. Set aside. Cook pasta in boiling water for about 8 minutes, or until tender but firm. Drain. Return to pan, and toss with mayonnaise, irish cream, 1/3 cup of the pepperoncini, and capers. Slice pork chops, and arrange them on top of pepperoncini. Spoon on the sauce. Arrange remaining pepperoncini on top.

title: Faux-Salmon Filets
ingredients: 2 teaspoons dried thyme | 1 pound salmon fillet, cubed | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh thyme | 1 package part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Spray a rimmed baking dish with cooking spray.

Random Ingredients: tomato puree,cream chicken soup,red cabbage,beef brisket,lobster,dark chocolate
title: Lobster Casserole (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 can condensed dark chocolate | 2 lbs beef brisket, boned and cubed | 2 cans lobster, drained | 2 large head red cabbage, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup tomato puree
instructions: Combine soup, chocolate and beef in crock pot and stir well. Add lobster, cabbage and tomato puree. Cover and cook on low 8 - 10 hours. Remove cover and let stand for 5 minutes. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: onion powder,stock,vanilla extract,yellow mustard,white flour,coffee,hamburger,italian tomato
title: Delicious Italian Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup hot strong coffee | 1/4 cup diced onion powder | 1/4 cup white flour | 1 teaspoon instant minced onion | 1 teaspoon instant yellow mustard | 1 can italian-style stewed tomatoes, undrained | 3/4 cup stock | 1 tablespoon vanilla extract
instructions: Combine coffee, onion powder, flour, onion powder, and mustard in bowl. Stir in tomatoes, stock, and vanilla. Heat to boiling over medium heat. Reduce heat to lowest setting. Cover, and simmer 15 - 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove from heat.

title: Lebanese Golden Syrup
ingredients: 1 cup golden syrup | 1 bottle white wine
instructions: Heat golden syrup on a medium heat. When the syrup gets hot, add the wine, and bring to a boil. Turn heat to low, and stir every so often. When it is at a full boil, remove from heat, and stir in the syrup. Let cool, and store in a covered container.

Random Ingredients: cherry tomato,pepper,oyster sauce,vegetable soup mix,mayonnaise,bay leaf
title: Baja Style Veggie Salad
ingredients: 1 can condensed vegetable soup mix | 1 cup mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 1 bay leaf | 2 cups cherry tomatoes ( fresh or canned ) | 1/4 teaspoon pepper
instructions: In bowl, mix together soup mix, mayo, oyster sauce, bay leaf and pepper. In small dish, spray a medium size skillet with cooking spray. Pour soup mixture into skillet. Let simmer on low for 10 minutes and then, flip on high for 5 minutes or until heated through. Serve over lettuce.

title: Beef Broth With Croutons
ingredients: 2 lbs round steaks, cut into strips 1/4 inch and 1/4 inch x 1/4 inch | 2 beef bouillon cubes, dissolved in | water, about 2 teaspoons
instructions: In a large pot, add 1 teaspoon of salt. Place oiled hands through the meat so that they do not bleed into the pot. Add the meat cubes, and brown the meat on all sides. Turn the heat to the lowest. Cover and simmer until meat is tender, turning meat once, 3 hours, or more. When the meat is tender, remove meat cubes to a deep platter. Mix the broth with 3 tablespoons of water and boil until thickened and syrupy, about 20 minutes. Place the croutons in a bowl or freezer bag and refrigerate until cool, at least 12 hours, stirring occasionally. Strain the broth through a sieve into a mixing bowl to remove any solids. Return the broth to the pan in which meat was cooked, and heat to boiling.

title: Herbed Spread
ingredients: 250 g cream cheese with chives | fresh herb, for garnish
instructions: To prepare spread, blend cream cheese with chives.. Spread on a tray decorated with herbs. Wrap in aluminium foil.

title: Roasted Sirloin or Eye of the Round
ingredients: 5 pounds eye of round roast, fat trimmed and cut into 4 to 5 slices ( about 3-4 inch thick )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Arrange the eye of round roast slices in a 9x13x2 inch baking dish. Cover with 1/2 of the peeled chiles lengthwise, then with one inch of space between each slice. Roast, basting occasionally with pan juices, while baking, in the preheated oven until meat thermometer reaches 130 degrees f or an instant read thermometer registers 160 degrees f, about 3 hours. Transfer to a cutting board and let drain in a colander set over a bowl for 15 minutes. Transfer beef to a platter and remove fat remaining in baking dish and discarding chiles. Cool in the fat remaining in pan, about 10 minutes, until slightly warm. Pound the beef to an even 2/3 inch thickness. Heat oven to 300 degrees f. Spread beef with 1/4 of the reserved chiles and spread in a thin layer in a roasting pan. Roast in the top third of oven until meat thermometer reaches 130 degrees f, 15 to 20 minutes. Baste 1 or 2 times with pan juices and transfer to a cutting board and tent with foil. Cook in the oven until internal temperature of meat registers 150 degrees f, about 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Ole! Mexican Sole
ingredients: 1/2 cup mexican beer | 2 teaspoons taco sauce | 1/2 cup lemon wedges ( to garnish ) | 2 sole fillets | beer | lemons or lime wedge ( to garnish )
instructions: Preheat broiler. In small bowl, mix beer & taco sauce. Spoon over fish. Broil 4 - 5 inches from heat for 5 minutes or until fish flakes easily when pierced with a fork. Garnish with lemon wedges or lime wedges.

Random Ingredients: bread,yoghurt,bamboo shoot,reynolds wrap foil,buttermilk,sharp cheddar cheese,cucumber,pecan
title: Upside Down French Bread Salad
ingredients: 1 loaf of subway style bread ( or 1 loaf if desired ) | 1 jar dried sweet-and-sour beef stewed in water ( or any type of browned meat that's left over from the fridge ) | 3 slices buttermilk | 1/2 cup chopped pecans | 2 tablespoons yoghurt | 2 tablespoons shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 1 cucumbers or 1 any other cucumber, in thin slices or, if preferred, sliced, about 1 1/2 to 1 3/4-inch cubes | reynolds wrap foil
instructions: To make the salad, slice the bread in half lengthwise and lightly toast on the counter. Remove the crusts but leave the bread slightly off the bread, and then cut the bread into cubes so that you have about 3 cups. Toss the cubes with the remaining salad ingredients in a large bowl until they are well blended and the salad is well distributed. You may need to add a little water to thin it out a little bit but, if it's too dry, add a little more buttermilk. Spoon the salad in a circle on a large serving platter or on a platter and serve. Note, if using a loaf of bread that has been cut into chunks or cubes, do not add the bread, just add it to your salad and toss to combine and to get a good coating of coating. For those that like it with a bit of bite, remove a bit of the bread crumbs as well as the pecans. You want them crunchy but not to burn. Just toss to coat and then spread on the bread crumbs. If you have leftovers, reheat the bread in a microwave oven or microwave on very low power and warm up for a few minutes.

title: Linguica's Creamy Sirloin Nachos
ingredients: 1 package linguica's smoked linguica's smoked linguica ( 2 1/2 c linguica will yield this amount ) | 2 tablespoons light margarine | 2 -3 tablespoons heavy cream | 5 corn tortilla chips ( depending on desired presentation ) | 1/2 cup shredded sirloin
instructions: Remove the linguica's smoked linguica from the package and place them in a bowl. Cut the linguica into 6 - 8 sections, depending on what size it is. Melt the butter in a large saute pan over medium heat. Add the cooked linguica pieces and brown for approximately 5 minutes until the linguica is crispy, stirring frequently. Remove from heat. Add heavy cream. Place the nachos on medium heat in about 1/2 cup of the oil and brown on each side for about 3 - 5 minutes. Pour the sauce over the noodles. Top with shredded sirloin and more sauce if desired. The noodage will cook right away.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,sunflower oil,tomato basil oregano garlic,olive oil,beef tenderloin,fish sauce,clove
title: Peppered Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1/4 cup sunflower oil | 1 teaspoon crushed garlic | 1 teaspoon crushed dried oregano and dried oregano and garlic | 1/8 teaspoon ground cloves | 2 teaspoons fish sauce | 2 slices beef tenderloin | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 2 tablespoons grated parmigiano reggiano cheese
instructions: Whisk together sunflower oil, garlic, oregano, garlic powder, cloves, and fish sauce until well blended and smooth. Place beef in shallow dish or glass baking dish and pour oil over top. Marinate at least 30 minutes, or up to overnight. Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat and lightly oil grate. Discard marinade. Cook beef 15 minutes, turning after 10 minutes, until no longer pink and cooked to your liking.

Random Ingredients: irish whiskey,liquid smoke,creamy peanut butter,grand marnier,wasabi paste,puff pastry,yellow pepper,margarine
title: Peanut Butter Jalapeno Tartlets
ingredients: 1/2 cup creamy peanut butter | 1/4 cup freshly-shredded irish whiskey | 1/2 cup grand marnier | 1 teaspoon wasabi paste | 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke | 1/2 cup margarine, softened | 1 package frozen puff pastry | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped yellow peppers
instructions: In medium bowl, blend the peanut butter, whiskey, grand marnier, wasabi paste, liquid smoke, margarine and mix well. Line baking sheet with waxed paper. Roll out half of the pastry on lightly floured surface to 1/8 inch thickness. Cut with 2 inch round cookie cutter. Spoon 1 rounded tablespoon of peanut butter mixture into half of the circle and cover filling with remaining pastry circle. Fold pastry over remaining half of peanut butter mixture to create a half moon. Chill tartlets at least 1 hour. Meanwhile preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Bake tartlets for 30 minutes, until golden brown and filling is puffed and crisp. Let cool on wire racks for 10 minutes. Spoon reserved peanut butter cream among each tartlet and top with jalapeno strips and remaining cream. Serve while hot.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,champagne,bamboo shoot,dark brown sugar,hamburger,lamb,rigatoni pasta,mango powder
title: Baked Rigatoni With Mango and Ham
ingredients: 2 ounces rigatoni pasta or 2 ounces fettuccine | 2 ounces lamb ( cut up or chopped to suit preference ) | 2 ounces hamburger ( i would actually use a slice of pork or chicken but i omit the pork and chicken ) | 1/2 pint veg stock ( i use the premade kind in a pouch ) | 1/2 pint champagne | 1/2 pint canned bamboo shoot ( drained and cut in half if they are small ) | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 1/2 tablespoon mango powder ( you can get away with mango if you have it ) ( optional )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 200c/400°f. Boil the ragu until al dente, drain and set aside.. Trim and chop the meat and hamburger up. Fry in a frypan or other large frying pan until starting to crisp up then remove. In the same pan add the lamb meat and cook until brown and set aside. Add to the meat in the pan and stir in the stock and chill for a few minutes. Bring to the boil, drain if necessary, then add the mango powder or you can mix in the mango powder. Boil for a few minutes and set aside. While the meat simmers and get the pasta boiling, add the oil to a shallow pie pan. When it's hot add the pasta. Drain the rigatoni if necessary then pour in all the contents of the saucepan onto the pasta, stir to combine, then divide between 4 ovenproof bowls/cake dishes. Pour over the meat sauce and put the lid on the pan. Cover with foil, bake for 25 - 30 minutes until the pasta is cooked. The rigatoni should be warmed through and the meat tender.

Random Ingredients: gouda cheese,cream celery soup,lime wedge,cocoa powder,oregano,chili,baking potato
title: Creamy Mexican Potatoes
ingredients: 8 large baking potatoes | 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 1/2 teaspoon dried chili | 1/2 teaspoon dried onion | 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/2 cup shredded aged gouda cheese | 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | lime wedge ( optional )
instructions: Bake potatoes until tender when pierced with a knife, about 1 hour in a 375 degrees f oven. Peel potatoes if desired, slice into 1/2 inch slices. Combine cream of celery soup, chili, onion, oregano, shredded cheese, cocoa and lime juice in a saucepan. Heat to boiling, stirring constantly. Simmer for 30 seconds. Drop potato slices into hot soup mixture and sprinkle with salt.

title: BBQ Potato Cauliflower Cheese With Savory Sweet Potatoes
ingredients: 1 medium cauliflower | 4 red potatoes | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 1/2 teaspoon savory | 1/2 cup barbecue sauce
instructions: Rinse head, break apart florets.

title: Mock Beef Burgers
ingredients: 600 g beef mince | 1 egg white | 1 ounce plain yogurt | 4 teaspoons hidden valley original ranch dips mix | 12 frozen mixed vegetables | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 tablespoon avocado, finely mashed
instructions: Combine mince, egg white and plain yogurt. Add hidden valley seasoning mix and dried herbs. Mix thoroughly. Shape into patties. Cook on a medium heat for approximately 15 minutes or until cooked. Combine avocado with burger and dip.

Random Ingredients: pea,chicken wing,green,rose petal,italian cheese,hamburger,bicarbonate soda,phyllo pastry
title: Peas and Ham Pie
ingredients: 1 kg frozen peas | 10 sheets phyllo pastry | 250 g hamburger | 100 g green peas | 100 g italian cheese | 200 g mixed vegetables ( peas, carrots, mushrooms, celery ) | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 4 rose petals
instructions: Cook all pie ingredients with bicarb soda until it is cooked. Serve with warm meats, salads, pickles, brussels sprouts and potatoes or steamed vegetables.

Random Ingredients: mandarin orange segment,turkey,italian salad dressing mix,curry leaf
title: African Turkey Burgers
ingredients: 1/2 cup italian salad dressing mix, such as good seasons | 1/8 cup mandarin orange segments, drained ( about 8 segments ) | 1/8 teaspoon curry leaf | 1/4 teaspoon ground turkish ground turkey
instructions: Place the italian salad dressing mix, mandarin orange segments, curry leaf, and turkish ground turkey in a medium bowl and mix to combine.

title: Baked Rice
ingredients: 2 cups cooked short-grain rice | 1 teaspoon hot sauce | 2 teaspoons hot sauce | 1 lb lard ( approximately )
instructions: Lightly grease 10x13 baking pan or jelly roll pan with lard or other oil. Place drained rice in pan and beat with hot sauce until well blended and well blended. Spread rice evenly in pan. Spread hot lard or other suitable fat over rice. Cover and bake in 350f degrees oven 35 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack pepper cheese,hazelnut,pork shoulder,dumpling,golden syrup,ginger powder,self rising flour
title: Crazy Wheat Muffins
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs pork shoulder ( or pork chops ) | 1/2 cup golden syrup | 1/2 teaspoon ginger powder | 2 tablespoons butter | 12 ounces small self rising flour | 8 ounces puffs dumplings ( small can of dumplings, not the larger ones ) | 1/2 cup hazelnuts, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Place pork onto a greased rack of an 8x8 inch baking pan. Spread golden syrup evenly onto the top. Bake on a middle rack for about 30 minutes. Slice pork and set aside. Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Add flour and mix. Add pork and brown, about 10 minutes. Place cooked pork on a plate and cover to keep warm. Sprinkle dumplings onto the hot pork layer and bake another 10 minutes. Place hazelnuts on top of dumplings and bake about another 10 minutes. Top with grated cheese and serve.

title: Tarragon Chips
ingredients: 1 cup dried tarragon | 1 cup white sugar | 2 1/2 cups vegetable oil for deep frying
instructions: Soak tarragon in hot water until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain, squeezing as much water as possible from the herb. Stir 1 cup sugar with the tarragon in a bowl. Heat oil in a heavy deep pot over moderately high heat to 375 degrees f. Dip each chip in the sugar, shaking off excess, and fry in hot oil, turning over once, until golden brown on both sides, about 1 1/2 minutes. Drain the chips on paper towels. Store in small airtight containers or freezer bags.

Random Ingredients: vanilla yogurt,green chili pepper,cream,sirloin steak,chicken meat
title: Lite Mexican Steak
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin steak | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 container reduced-fat sour cream | 1 -2 sliced green chili pepper ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla yogurt ( optional )
instructions: Cut steak into slices to preference. Combine soup, sour cream, chili peppers and yogurt in a bowl. Pour over steak. Cover and refrigerate 8 hours or overnight, to marinate. Preheat grill to medium. Lightly oil grill on grate. Cook steak 5 minutes per side, or until desired doneness.

title: Curried Pasta Salad
ingredients: 500 g farfalle pasta, uncooked ( bow tie ) | 1 lebanese cucumber, peeled and finely diced | 1/2 small white onion, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon roasted coriander powder | 1/4 teaspoon coriander powder | 1 cup dry desiccated unsweetened coconut | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh tarragon or 1 tablespoon chopped dried chives
instructions: Cook the pasta according to the instructions on the pack. You'll also need to do this in two batches with 1 tblsp of garlic oil and a splash of water from time to time. Meanwhile combine all the salad ingredients except the tarragon and coconut with 2 tbsp of the coconut. Drain the pasta and return to the pan, add the dressing and toss gently. Scatter over the tarragon and serve, with a little of the extra dressing.

Random Ingredients: manchego cheese,canola oil,pesto sauce,italian sausage,vegetable stock,button mushroom,yellow mustard,broth
title: Sausage, Spinach and Mushroom Soup
ingredients: 6 italian sausages ( from asian or middle eastern shops ) | 2 tablespoons canola oil | 6 button mushrooms, cleaned, washed and trimmed | 1 cup vegetable stock ( or chicken stock ) | 1 1/2 cups chicken stock ( or chicken stock ) | 1 jar pesto sauce | 2 tablespoons prepared yellow mustard | 2 cups manchego cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Prick sausages all over. Put on rack in baking dish or tray. Cook for 25 - 30 minutes. Meanwhile, heat oil in pan. Add mushrooms, stir fry over moderately low heat 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Cut off any visible fat. Add stock and bring to boil, simmer for 5 minutes. Remove sausage from pan. Cut into thin slices and set aside. Remove sausage from casings and slice into about 5mm slices. Heat stock in a pan. Stir in pesto, mustard and sausage. Bring to boil, simmer uncovered for about 5 mins or until cheese starts to soften. Ladle into bowls. Top with sausage and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: vanilla pudding mix,sherry wine,chili pepper flake,plain flour,seasoning salt,pork sausage,american cheese
title: Sausage Pudding
ingredients: 200 g good quality pork sausage | 100 g plain flour | 2 -3 tablespoons sugar or 2 -3 tablespoons brown sugar substitute | 1 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 2 packets vanilla instant pudding mix | 2 teaspoons steaky dry sherry wine ( optional ) or 2 teaspoons sherry flavoured sherry wine ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt, to your taste
instructions: Slice the sausage and cut into slices about 3 - 5 mm thick. Put the flour into a bowl and make a well in the centre. Add the sugar and continue to add all your dry ingredients. Using your fingers add your liquid gradually until you have a smooth but wet dough. Do this until you have a firm dough. Divide the dough into 2 balls and roll them out, into 8 discs. Put the discs on a non stick baking paper lined tray. Cover the baking tray with a tea towel and leave them there for 30 minutes. Pre heat your oven to 190°c. Remove the baking paper from them and arrange the sausages and sausages around the edge of the baking tray. Bake for about 40 minutes or until they are golden and cooked through. If you want to add sherry, take it out of the oven while the sausages are cooking. Serve them hot or cold, drizzled with melted dark chocolate icing if you wish. Alternatively, you can serve them hot and serve them warm, but i prefer them chilled because the sausage has a crispy texture.

title: Vanilla Beetroot
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beet ( or 2 lbs beet-ders ) | 1 cup vanilla extract
instructions: Scrub and trim the stems off of the beet roots. In a saucepan, add beets, about a gallon of water. Bring to a boil and cook until the beets become very tender. Drain and transfer the beetroot to a bowl. Cool, peel, core and dice. Place the diced beets in a clean saucepan with all the remaining ingredients. Heat gently until the sauce begins to bubble. Lower the heat and simmer until the beetroots are very tender. Strain and use as desired. Allow to cool for at least one hour before using..

Random Ingredients: cooking spray,bay leaf,cheese tortellini,flax seed,ginger powder,self rising flour,jalapeno pepper
title: Cheesy Tortellini Chapati
ingredients: 8 ounces whole meal self-rising flour | 1 pinch ginger powder | 1 pinch cayenne pepper | 2 tablespoons flax seeds | cooking spray | 1 box refrigerated cheese tortellini | 1 large jalapeno pepper, diced ( optional )
instructions: Spray baking dish with cooking spray and set aside. In a medium size bowl, mix the flour, ginger, cayenne pepper, and pimento and set aside. Cook the tortellini according to the package directions or until softened, but still with a bite. Drain the tortellini and set aside. Preheat a non stick pan for a few minutes on medium heat. You want to get the pan very hot. Spray with cooking spray and add the tortelli. Sprinkle both sides of the tortelli with the pimenton. Sprinkle the top with the ginger mixture then add your tortellini. Turn the tortellini to coat with the spice mixture. Place the pan in the preheated oven and bake for 5 minutes, then turn the heat to 350 and bake another 20 minutes without opening the oven door, another 5 minutes or so.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil enough,apple juice,ice water,tart apple,cream cheese,yellow pepper,cocoa
title: Candy Apple Snow
ingredients: 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa | 2 tablespoons apple juice | 1 package cream cheese, softened | 1 -2 tablespoon vegetable oil ( about 2 inches in diameter ) | freshly grated apple, for garnish ( see illustration below ) | tart apple, for garnish ( see illustration below ) | coarse ice water, for serving
instructions: In a mini food processor, combine 1 tablespoon cocoa with 1 tablespoon apple juice. Pulse briefly or process in a food processor until the mixture resembles ground rice. Place cream cheese in a medium sized mixing bowl. Beat with electric mixer until light and fluffy. Gradually beat in half the cocoa mixture, then stir in oil. Add apple, and mix well. Add cocoa mixture and 1 to 2 teaspoons apple juice mixture to cream cheese mixture in the bowl. Using a round metal spoon, spread batter on an ungreased baking sheet to an inch from the edges. Bake in a preheated 400 f oven until the edges of the cake are slightly browned, 15 to 20 minutes. Remove from heat and top the cake with apple.

title: Rostigiana (Portuguese Beef Sandwich)
ingredients: 4 small boneless beef brisket | 1 cup fresh white breadcrumbs
instructions: Place brisket in a 3qt baking dish. Sprinkle bread crumbs over the brisket. Bake at 300 until completely tender, 2 - 3 hours. Cut slices & serve with crusty french bread.

title: Italian Flatbread
ingredients: 12 ounces whole wheat spaghetti | 1/4 cup kalamata olive, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. In a large bowl combine olives and pasta. Mix together. On a parchment lined baking sheet, spread the mixture evenly to the edges of the pan, leaving a 1 inch margin around the edges. Bake for 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: butter,sage leaf,chunky salsa,lamb kidney,wheat berry,marinara sauce,beef,cherry tomato
title: Plethora of Harvest Meatballs, Beans and Tomato
ingredients: 2 tablespoons butter | 14 ounces lean ground lamb or 14 ounces other lean ground meat | 14 ounces mixed frozen salad beans or 14 ounces mixed baby mixed pulses | 2 1/2 ounces whole wheat berries, roughly chopped ( fresh or frozen ) | 6 cherry tomatoes, halved | 1 tablespoon fresh sage leaf, grated | 3 teaspoons chunky salsa ( see note ) | 1 1/4 pints jarred marinara sauce ( or make your own )
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f. Grease baking tin. Place butter, lamb, and beans in a bowl. Sprinkle with berries and sage. Mix thoroughly. Place 1/4 cup marinara sauce in small bowl. Spoon half the meat mixture onto prepared tin. Spoon rest of the meat mix over meat. Bake 20 - 25 minutes or until beginning to brown.. Transfer to serving dish. Place remaining marinara sauce, extra beef or duck stock or water in small saucepan. Simmer gently until the sauce thickens slightly. Divide among serving dishes. Add remaining meat mixture into warmed tomato sauce and spoon over meatballs.

title: Smoked Salmon with Corn (Cajun Style)
ingredients: 2 cans cream-style corn | 4 skinless, boneless salmon fillets
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Drain cream style corn well. Arrange the cream style corn evenly over the top. Arrange the salmon fillets over the cream style corn.

Random Ingredients: queso fresco,cumin powder,puff pastry,buttermilk,pecorino romano cheese
title: Cheese Pastry En Papillote (Pastelon De Queso)
ingredients: 1 puff pastry sheet, frozen, thawed | 1 1/2 cups queso fresco, crumbled | 1 cup buttermilk | 2 tablespoons pecorino romano cheese | 1/4 teaspoon cumin powder ( to taste )
instructions: To defrost puff pastry, heat oven to 375 degrees. Spray 8x8 inch pan with nonstick cooking spray. Remove from oven.

title: Homemade Flour Crust for Vegetables
ingredients: 1 cup whole wheat pastry flour | 1 lemon, juice and zest of, grated
instructions: Combine the flour, lemon zest and lemon zest in a medium bowl. Place your mix in your food processor. If it looks dry, add 1 cup of water. Process for a few seconds, stopping the process after each and scraping down the bowl as it turns out. Do not overprocess. Put the mix into a piping bag and pipe onto a large, non stick cookie sheet. Use a circular motion or knife to make four or five shaped criss cross patterns that rise to the top of the dough. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f and cook the biscuits for 10 - 13 minutes on each side, until golden brown.

title: Miniature Stone Tacos
ingredients: 16 taco shells, warmed | 1/2 cup apricot | 1/2 cup club soda | 1 teaspoon prepared yellow mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons minced peeled fresh ginger | 1/2 teaspoon saffron
instructions: Place taco shells on foil lined baking sheet.

title: Onion Tartare (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 1 large spanish onion, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons tamari ( soy sauce ) | 2 tablespoons thai fish sauce | 2 ounces havarti cheese ( optional )
instructions: Heat a saute pan/skillet over medium high heat and add the onion. Cook just until the onion is starting to brown, about 1 minute. Add the rest of the ingredients and continue to saute until most of the liquid comes off and the mixture dries.

Random Ingredients: milk ricotta cheese,parsley,dark chocolate,cider vinegar,chicken bouillon cube,vodka
title: Creamy Ricotta and Spicy Vinegar Dressing
ingredients: 9 ounces milk ricotta cheese | 2/3 cup heavy sweet cider vinegar | 1/3 cup vodka | 3/4 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon cubes | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley | 2 tablespoons dark chocolate
instructions: In a blender, combine ricotta, cider vinegar, vodka, chicken bouillon, parsley, chocolate and black pepper.

title: Peaches and Corn in Creamy Pate
ingredients: 16 fluid ounces heavy cream | 1/8 lb gruyere, grated | 1 lb frozen peas and corn, thawed | 2 -4 medium peaches, cut into thick slices ( or 4 medium, if you have more, but i prefer to peel them ) | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar
instructions: Heat the heavy cream in a large non reactive saucepan until slightly bubbly to the touch. Gradually add the grated cheese, stirring to dissolve the cheese well. Add about a quarter of the cream at a time, stirring the mixture constantly with a large spoon. Continue adding the cream, a cup at a time, stirring vigorously with a wooden spoon. The mixture will thicken up within 5 - 10 minutes. Keep warm over very low heat, but do not let it boil. Grate the cheese, taste, and adjust it if necessary. Stir in the peas and corn. Transfer the mixture to a small bowl. Toast the peaches and serve them on individual dinner plates with a few peaches laid out on the top. Pass the gruyere at the table.

title: Chilean Lentil Cake
ingredients: 100 g lentils | 1 pinch fennel | 1/2 tablespoon canola oil | 1 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla essence, or more to taste
instructions: Place lentils, fennel seed pods and ancho between two clean tea towels. Boil in water for 20 minutes. Drain. Heat canola oil in a pan over medium heat. Fry the fennel seeds and ancho chille powder for about 10 seconds. Add lentils and cook until the mixture has turned golden brown, about 3 minutes. Add vanilla essence and cook for 2 to 3 minutes. Cool and store in a closed container. This should keep for months in a cool, dark place.

Random Ingredients: cherry tomato,shallot,vermouth,cilantro leaf,peanut,tomato puree,pecorino romano cheese
title: Cherry Tomatoes for 1
ingredients: 2 tablespoons fresh cilantro leaves | 4 cherry tomatoes | 2 tablespoons coarsely chopped peanuts | 1 shallot, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons tomato puree | 2 tablespoons dry vermouth | 1/2 cup grated pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Place the cilantro leaves in a small bowl, and cover with boiling water to plump the leaves. Let sit for 20 minutes and then drain. When cool enough to handle, remove the green stems, if any, and cut into small pieces. Set the tomatoes aside. In 2 tablespoons of olive oil, mix together the peanuts, shallot and tomato puree and set aside. Heat the remaining 2 tablespoons olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat. When hot, add the vermouth, then add the cherry tomatoes. Cook, stirring, until the tomatoes soften, about 3 minutes. Remove the pan from the heat, and stir in the cooled cilantro and sugar.

title: Hot Chocolate (Microwave or Not)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 teaspoon poppy seed ( powdered or ground or not ) | 1/2 cup cocoa powder, plus a little | cocoa powder ( optional ) or cinnamon ( optional )
instructions: First combine all dry ingredients in a small dish. You do not want air bubbles on top. Pour into wax or parchment paper lined pan. The easiest way to accomplish this is to just sprinkle cocoa/cinnamon on top.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder,yogurt,chili paste,beef tenderloin steak,canadian bacon,salt pepper,mirin,yeast
title: Pork Butt Sandwich Rollups
ingredients: 2 cans plain yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon dried yeast | 1 tablespoon chili paste with pork | 1 tablespoon salt and pepper, divided | 1 1/2 lbs fully trimmed pork shoulder | 1 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin steaks | 2 tablespoons lard or 2 tablespoons canadian bacon fat | 2 tablespoons mirin
instructions: Combine yogurt, yeast and 1 tablespoons hot pepper sauce in bowl, set aside. Cut meat into 1/2 inch thick slices, place pieces between plastic wrap and pound to 1/4 inch thickness. Place meat in gallon glass baking dish, cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 12 hours or overnight. Soften meat in lard for 10 minutes, then brown for 2 minutes on each side in hot lard. Arrange pork and steak rolls on a rack in broiler pan or in shallow pan. Place pan in middle of the oven and broil for 15 minutes, or until internal temperture is 160, then remove from oven. Remove plastic wrap and place meat over rolls. Reduce temperature to 375 and broil for 15 or 20 additional minutes, depending on your internal temperature. Remove the meat, slice, and serve.

Random Ingredients: steak,garlic salt,rice vinegar,pork shoulder,chicken breast half,noodle,broccoli,cream coconut
title: Thai Shredded Pork and Rice Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1 tablespoon garlic salt | 1 tablespoon salt | 8 ounces boneless pork shoulder, shredded ( about 1/2 lb ) | 4 ounces boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 2 cups fresh broccoli, chopped | 1 1/2 cups cooked noodles | 1 can cream of coconut | 1 cup packed browned and slivered sweet peas
instructions: In a lrg mixing bowl, whisk together vinegar, salt & garlic. Add pork, chicken and broccoli.

Random Ingredients: beef eye,lime juice,sun tomato,head cabbage,bamboo shoot,white hominy,mint
title: Cabbage and Sun-Dried Tomato Posole
ingredients: 1 large head cabbage, cored and cut into thin wedges ( about 2 pounds ) | 3 quarts white hominy | 1 can yellow-and-serve beef eye round, drained, rinsed, and cut crosswise into thin slices | 1/3 cup finely chopped sun-dried tomato | 2 tablespoons snipped fresh mint | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 1 can sliced bamboo shoots, drained
instructions: Mix cabbage wedges and hominy in large pot. Heat to boiling.

title: Japanese Steaming Lemon Pickles
ingredients: 12 lemons or 1 large lemon, peel of | 2 teaspoons sesame oil
instructions: In 1 cup of cold water, mix all of the ingredients. This will keep for 1 week in the refrigerator. Store in air tight jars in a cool, dark place.

Random Ingredients: beef broth,lemon juice zest,mayonnaise,almond extract,saffron strand,orange zest,bacon,italian plum tomato
title: Orange Tomato and Bacon Dressing
ingredients: 2 tablespoons pineapple-flavored mayonnaise | 2 tablespoons orange zest | 1/2 tablespoon lemon juice, freshly squeezed | 1/2 teaspoon saffron strand | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 1/4 teaspoon saffron strand | 5 italian plum tomatoes | 3 slices bacon, cooked and crumbled ( use bacon bits if you like ) | 1 1/2 cups beef broth or 1 1/2 cups canned reduced-sodium beef broth ( can be fat free if preferred )
instructions: Add all dressing ingredients to food processor and blend until well combined. Chill for at least 1 hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: mustard seed,japanese eggplant,enchilada sauce,basil,orange food coloring
title: Eggplant in Azul (Aubergine) and Red Sauce
ingredients: 1 japanese eggplant | 1 can enchilada sauce ( can use bottled ) | 1/4 cup chopped fresh basil | 1/4 - 1/3 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon orange food coloring
instructions: Slice eggplant lengthwise in half, into 1/4 inch slices. Place slices in microwave for 90 seconds to 1 minute, or until softened, stirring to keep slices slightly moist. Place slices in shallow glass baking dish, add enough enchilada sauce to cover, and microwave 2 - 3 minutes. Stir in basil and mustard seeds, and sprinkle with food coloring. Heat an iron skillet over medium heat for 1 - 2 minutes. Layer the beaten eggplant slices in the sauce. Cover and cook, flipping the slices once, until eggplant slices become crisp and golden, a few minutes on each side. Top each slice with extra sauce during final 3 - 4 minutes of grilling. These measurements are based on the number of slices, sometimes 2 eggs and 1/2 cup of sauce. The amount of sauce depends on the type of eggplant slice used. You can always make more sauce. When finished, remove from the stove, and allow to sit for at least at least 10 - 15 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: black pepper,maraschino cherry,grain rice,beef bouillon cube,wild rice mix,vanilla bean
title: Wild Rice With Mustard and Cherry (Rice Cooker)
ingredients:
1/2 cup wild rice mix ( such as lundberg's wild rice mix ) | 1/2 beef bouillon cube ( such as knorr `` reconstituted '' in 2 t.
    - t.
    - boiling water ) | 2 1/2 cups cooked wild rice ( short grain or jasmine rice mix ) | 1 ripe vanilla bean, split lengthwise | fresh ground black pepper, and | 1/4 cup maraschino cherries, or | 1/2 teaspoon chopped dried cherries ( optional )
instructions: Add your wild rice mix to your rice cooker. If using wooden spoon, put the wild rice mix in the rice bowl. Push rice down to moisten, remove it from the rice cooker, and stir contents together. You will likely want to add a little more water to the rice. If not using wooden spoon, put the rice back in the rice cooker bowl and add the beef bouillon cube. If you like your rice starchy, stir the contents of the bowl back into the rice cooker. If it needs more water, add it at this time. Place in the rice cooker and set on low. You will notice there is about 3 cups of liquid. It should be soupy. You may not use all of the liquid. After 5 minutes, remove wild rice from the cooker and stir. Sprinkle rice with pepper and set aside. When almost done, remove vanilla bean from the vanilla bean and place whole bean inside the rice cooker. With a fork or knife, break the vanilla bean into small pieces. When done, transfer rice back into the rice cooker and stir. Sprinkle the rice with pepper and add 2 to 3 t. Shallarines flavoring. Cover rice and allow to steam for 10 minutes or until most of the liquid is released. Serve over ice.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,beef tenderloin,golden raisin,coconut
title: Indian Beef Tenderloin
ingredients:
1 1/2 - 2hrs.
    - round beef tenderloin | vegetable oil cooking spray | 2/3 cup golden raisin with caraway seeds ( i used craisins ) | 1/2 cup finely shredded dry unsweetened coconut
instructions: Rinse beef under cold water to remove salt. Trim the fat from the beef. Slice into thick 2/3 to 3/4 inch thin slices. Spray skillet with veggie flavored cooking spray, add beef slices and brown on all sides for 2 - 3 minutes or until just beginning to brown. Place in casserole dish with raisins and 1/4 cup coconut. Sprinkle remaining 1/2 cup coconut over top. Bake at 325 degrees fahrenheit for 3 - 4 hours, or until tender. Remove from oven. Let stand for 20 minutes, then slice and serve.

Random Ingredients: champagne,butter lettuce,hard egg,strawberry,mix,ice water,brown sugar,black bean
title: Black Bean and Strawberry Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup white sugar | 1 cup cold unsalted butter lettuce, chopped | 1 1/2 cups ripe black beans, rinsed, drained | 4 medium strawberries, quartered | 1/3 cup seedless champagne | ice water | 2 hard-boiled eggs, sliced | 1/3 cup prepared sweet-and-sour mix
instructions: Bring white sugar and butter lettuce to simmer in a large heavy skillet over medium heat.

title: Baked Venison, Apple and Prune Stuffing
ingredients: 200 g prunes, chopped | 200 g pitted prunes, chopped | 1/2 cup fresh rosemary, finely chopped | 100 g salami, finely chopped | 1 cup chopped onion | 1/2 teaspoon ground turkish dried persille spice or 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon | 1 large apple, grated fine | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1 1/4 kg venison loin, trimmed of fat and sinew
instructions: Mix prunes, prunes, rosemary and salami in a mixing bowl. Add the onion, turkish persille spice or cinnamon and grated apple. Stir well to combine. Pierce the venison very deeply every 4 to 8 cuts in the skin and fat. Sprinkle half of the spice mixture all over the venison, then cover and place in a very low oven. Remove the cover, increase heat to moderate, cover and cook for 2 hours. When you remove from oven, remove stuffing from oven and place on serving platter. Scoop up stuffing and place in a serving dish or large roasting tin. Serve with yoghurt or cream.

title: Black Beans With Bacon
ingredients: 3 slices bacon, chopped | 1 teaspoon fresh ginger juice, fresh | 1/2 teaspoon fresh thyme, minced | 1/4 teaspoon fresh rosemary, minced | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper | 2 cans black beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: In a large skillet, cook bacon over medium high heat until just beginning to crisp. Drain bacon on paper towels and crumble. When bacon is cool, crumble and place into a bowl. Add orange juice, ginger, thyme, rosemary, and white pepper to the bacon drippings. Stir to combine. Add black beans and stir to combine. Cover and simmer about 15 minutes, or up to 1 hour, stirring occasionally.

title: Strawberry Spicy Quinoa With Smoked Qinoa
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 1 cup half-and-half | 1/2 cup smoked smoked salmon, chopped | 1 medium mango, chopped | 1/3 cup fat-free half-and-half ( light cream ) | 2 tablespoons braggs liquid aminos | 1/2 tablespoon dark rum ( optional ) | 1/2 cup dried mango, peeled, diced into bite sized pieces | 1/2 cup roasted and sliced almonds or 1/2 cup snow peas
instructions: Rinse the quinoa thoroughly under running water.

Random Ingredients: enchilada sauce,chicken broth,curry paste,plain flour,oyster sauce,salt black pepper,worcestershire sauce,rotel tomato chilies
title: Spicy Curry Chicken, Onions & Yams
ingredients: 2 tablespoons plain flour | 1 tablespoon curry paste | 2 1/4 cups canned rotel tomatoes & chilies ( drained ) | salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1 1/4 cups reduced-sodium chicken broth or 1 1/4 cups chicken stock | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1/4 cup enchilada sauce
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together flour and the curry paste. Set aside. In a large nonstick frying pan, heat oil over medium heat until shimmering. Add flour mixture and cook for 1 minute. Add tomatoes, curry paste, worcestershire sauce, chicken broth, oyster sauce, and enchilada sauce in the pan. Cook, uncovered, for 10 minutes until the mixture is piping hot. Serve as a meal along side rice.

title: Lemongrass Almond Hoagies (Chilled Lemongrass)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons coarsely chopped lemongrass | 1/2 cup low-sodium low-fat chicken broth | 1/2 cup chopped fresh cilantro | 1/2 cup sliced dried sweet almonds | 12 hoagie rolls, split and toasted ( or 4 whole wheat hamburger buns )
instructions: In a mortar, pound lemongrass and chicken broth to a paste. Add cilantro, almonds and 3 tablespoons of remaining broth. Stir well to combine and let sit 5 minutes. Place toasted buns on serving plates and ladle filling among.

title: Easy Tomato and Pine Nut Dip
ingredients: 1 cup greek yogurt | 4 tablespoons tomato puree or 4 tablespoons tomato sauce | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 1/3 cup pine nuts, lightly toasted
instructions: Heat yoghurt, tomato puree or tomato sauce in a small saucepan over gentle heat. Stir in tomato paste and pine nuts and serve warm.

title: French Peaches & Beef
ingredients: 1 3/4 lbs peeled and sliced peaches ( about 6 6-7 'oz') | 3 tablespoons dry sherry | 2 1/4 teaspoons dry active yeast | 3 1/2 cups warm water | 1 1/2 lbs sirloin, trimmed and sliced crosswise into 1/2-inch-thick slices | 10 ounces water chestnuts, thinly sliced
instructions: Put the peaches and sherry in a small heavy nonreactive saucepan and heat over medium heat, stirring, just until the liquid comes to a boil. Remove from the heat and allow to cool to lukewarm. Soak the yeast in the warm water till dissolved, about 5 minutes, and then stir in the warm water. Add the beef and waterchestnuts to the cooled yeast mixture. Cover and stand in a warm place till bubbly, about 40 minutes, or until all the liquid is absorbed. Butter an 8 x 8 square baking dish and cover it with plastic wrap or a dry kitchen towel. Transfer the beef mixture to the dish. Cover and stand in a warm place till bubbly, about 40 minutes, or when the beef mixture is bubbly and the edges are firm. Transfer the beef mixture to a cutting board. Cut the beef into strips, and transfer to the dish. Cover it tightly with plastic wrap and let it stand in a warm place till bubbling, about 40 minutes, or when the beef mixture is bubbly and the edges of the beef are crisp and beginning to brown, 5 - 10 minutes. Remove the plastic wrap and sprinkle the beef with salt and coarsely ground black pepper. Transfer it to a cutting board and let stand, still covered, 5 - 10 minutes, or until the beef is cool enough to handle. Cut into strips, and transfer to the dish, loosely covered. Cover and refrigerate at least one hour but preferably 2 days.

title: Mexican Queso Fresco Spread
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 cups crumbled queso fresco ( can sub other mild salsa ) | 1 medium onion, finely chopped ( about 1-1/2 cups )
instructions: Mix well. Keeps in refrigerator overnight. Store in sealed jar in the fridge.

title: Parmesan-Beer Cheese Mousse
ingredients: 2 cups whipping cream, whipped to soft peaks | 1/2 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 12 1/2 fluid ounces red delicious light beer ( like guinness )
instructions: Fold together the whipping cream and grated cheese in a medium sized bowl. Add the beer and stir just until everything is incorporated, then divide among six ramekins. Chill in the refrigerator, covered, until ready to use.

Random Ingredients: oyster sauce,tofu,cumin powder,green cardamom,sun tomato oil,cream cheese,vegetable oil cooking spray,raisin
title: Tofu Cheese Ball With Sun-Dried Tomatoes & Raisins
ingredients: 3 tablespoons vegetable oil or 3 tablespoons cooking spray | 4 ounces firm tofu, cut into chunks | 1 cup light cream cheese, room temperature | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and chopped or 1/2 bunch sun-dried tomato | 2 green cardamoms, slightly cracked | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/2 cup raisins | 1 -2 tablespoon oyster sauce
instructions: In small bowl, combine cream cheese and sun dried tomatoes. Stir in oil until smooth and then add cream cheese mixture and raisins. Mix well. Adjust seasoning of mixture with salt and freshly ground cracked black pepper. Adjust if needed. Cover and chill dough 24 hours. Remove dough from refrigerator, divide in half and shape into balls about 2 inches in diameter.

title: Beef Lovers Beef N' Macaroni
ingredients: 1 lb beef sirloin | 1/2 cup elbow macaroni | 1/2 cup molasses | 4 -5 drops angostura bitters
instructions: Cut beef into four pieces and place in crockpot. Brown beef then break apart if you like. Stir the meat and pour any juices over the meat. Cook on low setting for 6 or 7 hours. Stir in the macaroni and molasses. Continue to cook on high setting for 30 minutes, stir, cover, and cook an additional 30 minutes, until meat is tender.

Random Ingredients: espresso coffee powder,active yeast,honey mustard,linguine,vanilla essence,italian parsley,shaoxing wine
title: Sponge Cake - Gluten Free
ingredients: 2 packages active dry yeast ( or 1 1/2 teaspoons each envelope instant yeast, cake yeast, cake yeast, flour and 1 package sponge ) | 80 g honey mustard | 150 ml shaoxing wine | 3 tablespoons espresso coffee powder | 3 tablespoons shaoxing wine | 3 tablespoons olive oil | 150 g linguine | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: For the cake, sprinkle yeast over the honey mustard in a mixing bowl. Add wine and remaining ingredients and combine all ingredients till dissolved, about 2 minutes. Put the batter in a well oiled spring form pan. Cover and leave in a warm place for approx 45 minutes or till cake is golden brown on top. Let cake cool in the pan. To serve, unmold onto serving plate and remove cake sides and set aside, covered to serve at room temperature.

title: Pork Medallions with Garlic and Fenel Seeds
ingredients: 4 bone-in pork tenderloin | 1 1/2 teaspoons fennel seeds | 4 teaspoons fennel seeds | 1 slice fresh ginger, coarsely diced | 1 ice cube
instructions: Place all of the dry spices into a spice grinder.

title: Scotch Sauce
ingredients: 1 pint whipping cream | 1 cup brown sugar
instructions: In a medium saucepan, bring whipping cream to a boil, remove from heat and stir in sugar. Set aside and keep warm until serving time. This sauce doesn't freeze very well until it's thick and rich looking, even the last few days. When adding the cream later, stir to combine. To use, heat for a few minutes in a microwave or double boiler to make a thickener.

title: Sweet and Sour Turnips-Coffee Brik
ingredients: 1 lb turnip ( turnip ) | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger | 1 can coffee | 1 package shredded phyllo pastry sheets
instructions: Peel and cut turnips into 2 inch pieces. Place in a large saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a boil over high heat, then turn down to a simmer and cook until very tender. Drain liquid into a bowl, leaving skin and stem intact, leaving some behind to avoid dirt and bitter juices. Set aside at least five minutes or you can refrigerate up to a little longer. Preheat oven to 400°f. Drain turnips through a sieve, or use a fork to get rid of remaining pulp and seeds. Stir in maple syrup and ginger and allow to stand for a moment or two. Lay one sheet of phyllo pastry across a sheet of waxed paper. Cut a 1 inch slit in the middle of the pastry making a 5 inch border, going all the way halfway down the length of the pastry. Arrange a teaspoon of turnip mixture in the middle of the pastry leaving about a 1 inch margin around the edges. Roll dough over the turnip filling into a packet, brushing with eggwash. Arrange another sheet of phyllo in the same manner as the previous and gently press down on top and bottom with your hands to seal. Repeat with remaining pastry, ending with phyllo pastry. Cut a cross in the center of the brik, leaving at least 1 inch of pastry at the edges and some around the edges of the brik. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Asiago Cheese Filling for Pasta (Greece)
ingredients: 4 ounces asiago cheese, grated or 8 ounces romano cheese | 1/4 cup shredded red asiago cheese or 1/4 cup parmesan cheese | 1 1/2 tablespoons diced spanish onions | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 1/2 cup black olives, finely chopped | 2 pints refrigerated prepared filling ( filling : 1 large can sliced black olives ) | 2 pints refrigerated buttered flavored batter
instructions: Using a cheese grater, grate or shred both cheeses in a food processor or blender. Add onion, white pepper, and olives, and process until smooth. Pour enough prepared filler into the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish to cover the bottom. Stir together remaining ingredients, and spread on the filling. Cover the dish tightly with plastic wrap, and refrigerate overnight. To serve, remove from refrigerator, and set on plate. Sprinkle additional cheese on top, and refrigerate until serving.

title: Easy Beets
ingredients: 2 cans sliced beets with juice | 1/2 cup ketchup
instructions: Place beets into a large saucepan filled with water, and bring to a boil. Cook until the beets are tender and easily pierced with a fork, about 25 minutes. Do not overcook. Drain, and arrange on a serving dish. Place ketchup on the beets, and refrigerate until cold, about 2 to 3 days.

title: Corn Tortilla and Roasted Apricot Chicken
ingredients: 1 roasting chicken | 1 tablespoon cumin powder | 3 cups dried apricots, chopped | 1 1/2 cups semolina, coarsely chopped | 2 1/2 cups corn tortillas, cut into 3/4-inch wide strips | 3 tablespoons galliano
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place chicken in a roasting pan and sprinkle with cumin. Roast for 40 minutes then turn and roast an additional 40 minutes until a thermometer inserted 2 inches into the thickest part of the thigh registers 165 degrees f and juices run clear. Remove chicken and drain fat, removing skin and bones if desired. Slice crosswise into 1/4 inch thick pieces. Place apricots, 1 cup of the semolina, and 1 tablespoon of the cooking liquid in a food processor and process until pureed. Arrange 3 to 4 pieces of coated chicken in the bottom of a 10x15 inch dish. Spoon the apricot puree over all. Spoon remaining liquid over all and cover with the remaining semolina. Sprinkle top with 1 tablespoon of the Galliano and bake until just lightly puffed and golden, about 20 minutes. Place the tortilla strips on a cutting board using a serrated knife and serrated knife. Spread 1/4 cup of remaining water over them and sprinkle with 3 tablespoons of the dried arabic. Cut into slices and serve.

Random Ingredients: celery rib,chickpea,chili flake,green grape,pecan half,green pepper,japanese mayonnaise,apple cider vinegar
title: Stove Top Russian Salad
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas, drained | 2 celery ribs, finely diced | 1/4 green pepper, finely diced ( optional ) | 1/4 medium green grape, halved ( optional ) | 1/4 cup chopped toasted pecan halves, to garnish | 1/2 cup japanese mayonnaise | 1/2 teaspoon chili flakes | 1 teaspoon apple cider vinegar
instructions: Put all ingredients except the mayonaise into a medium saucepan. Drain the chickpeas and stir them in the other ingredients. Add the mayonaise slowly, in small amounts, mixing quickly each time, until the mixture is just moist enough to hold its shape and holds its shape. If using a carrot, shred or grate the carrot finely.

Random Ingredients: penne,vegetable stock,milk ricotta cheese,clove,serrano pepper,ziti pasta,spinach leaf
title: Pesto Cream Pasta for Two
ingredients: 1 lb ziti pasta | 2 lbs fresh spinach leaves | 1 serrano pepper, chopped | 1/4 cup fresh basil, torn if large | 10 cups vegetable stock | 1 lb whole milk ricotta cheese | 1 cup milk ricotta cheese, drained
instructions: Cook the ziti until al dente, then drain excess water. While the ziti is cooking, put the spinach in a colander over a bowl, cover and let sit for about 10 minutes to wilt. Meanwhile, roughly chop the peppers. Add the vegetable stock to the spinach and add the roasted peppers. Bring the liquid up to a boil and then reduce the heat to low and simmer until the liquid has reduced and the spinach is tender. Meanwhile, combine the cheese with the ricotta in a blender or with an immersion blender and blend until smooth. When the pasta is al dente, drain it and put back into the pot. Add the spinach mixture and stir until combined then add the hot liquid. Serve over your favorite pasta and enjoy.

title: Black Bean Bread
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups barley or 1 1/4 cups white barley | 3 tablespoons peanut oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons yeast | 1 can black beans
instructions: Soak the barley in water for 2 - 3 hours. Drain the barley and set aside. Add enough water to cover the barley. Boil for about 10 minutes on low heat. Drain the beans. Put the oil in a large bowl. Add the yeast and let proof for approximately 10 minutes. Then add the beans, one cup of water and the fried barley. Stir until a creamy texture. Let it sit for 15 minutes.

title: Scallops and Scallops With Oil or Beignets (Soy-Sesame Baskets)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 2 lbs fresh scallops, cleaned ( with the tails on )
instructions: Heat wok until very hot, then add oil and swirl to coat sides. Add scallops and saute until starting to turn. Pour shrimp off heat, then immediately stir fry scallops in hot oil until opaque, 4 or 5 minutes. Pour shrimp over scallops and serve immediately with white rice.

title: Mexican Fried Broccoli
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups broccoli florets | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 teaspoon peanut oil | 3 ounces diced spanish onions | 1 cube chicken bouillon
instructions: Put the broccoli in a pan of boiling water, cook, 3 minutes then drain. Heat the remaining oil in a pan over medium heat, add onion and saitews and cook 10 seconds. Remove from heat, pour in bouillon and simmer 5 minutes. Stir in broccoli and heat through.

title: Almond-Glazed Ladyfingers
ingredients: 20 ladyfingers | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 1/4 teaspoon black pepper
instructions: Preheat the oven broiler. Arrange the ladyfingers on a shallow baking pan in a single layer. In a small bowl, combine the remaining ingredients and mix. Brush half of the glaze over the ladyfingers and toss. Repeat with another layer of ladyfingers, brushing each with glaze, and sprinkle the remaining glaze over the top. Broil in the preheated oven until bubbly and beginning to brown, about 12 minutes.

title: Tropical Pantry Bruschetta
ingredients: 1 package pillsbury garlic breadsticks | 1 jar artichoke hearts, drained | 1 can coconut cream | 1 jar marinated artichoke hearts, with liquid
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Open the packages of garlic breadsticks, and place on a baking sheet. Bake for about 2 - 3 minutes per side, or until crispy. Meanwhile, stir together the artichokes and coconut cream in a bowl. Remove the breadsticks from the oven, and spread the artichoke mixture over the tops of the breadsticks to completely cover. Return to the oven, and bake for another 3 - 5 minutes, or until bread is lightly browned and bubbly. Mmmm.

Random Ingredients: red cabbage,dark chocolate,macadamia nut,chili sauce,garlic clove,bailey irish cream,pearl barley
title: Chilli Barley and Chocolate Barley Salad
ingredients: 2 cups pearl barley ( cooked & cooled ) | 250 g red cabbage ( finely shredded ) | 2 tablespoons dark chocolate, grated | 1 1/2 cups macadamia nuts ( chopped ) | 1 garlic clove ( minced ) | 1/4 cup sweet chili sauce | 1/4 cup baileys irish cream
instructions: Place the barley in a bowl, cover with cold water, allow to stand for 10 minutes. Drain. Place the vinegar in a large saucepan, add the barley & bring to the boil over a medium heat, stirring occasionally, simmer for about 20 minutes or until the barley is tender. Whisk the chips & garlic in a small bowl, add to the barley & mix well. Pour into a serving bowl & refrigerate until cold, about 15 - 20 minutes. Just before serving, toss in the chocolate, nuts, chilli and baileys. Note, this can be served as an appetiser or served as a side dish.

Random Ingredients: tomato paste,cocoa powder,taco flour tortilla,blueberry,currant,dark sesame oil
title: Tostones for a One Cup Breakfast
ingredients: 3 tablespoons taco-flavored flour tortillas, lightly toasted | 1/4 cup blueberries ( fresh or frozen ) | 2 tablespoons currants or 2 tablespoons raisins ( fresh or frozen ) | 3 tablespoons tomato paste | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1 teaspoon cocoa powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Sprinkle with black pepper. Serve.

title: Cheese Fondue
ingredients: 1/2 cup jarlsberg cheese | 1/2 cup goat cheese ( not low fat ) | 2 tablespoons lime wedges ( a few squeezes ) | shredded rind from 1/2 chipotle chile, from can | 1/4 cup raisins ( optional, optional ) | 1/4 cup boiling water | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon chili powder | 2 teaspoons unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f, or until hot to the touch. In a small bowl, stir together all ingredients until smooth. Transfer cheese mixture to a 9 inch cast iron skillet or a jelly roll pan. Place skillet in hot oven. Heat until the mixture begins to bubble and turn golden brown, about five minutes. Pour hot cheese mixture out onto a plate. Dip the edge of the cheese fondue dish in warm water, and then dredge in the tortilla peel. Slice into pieces.

Random Ingredients: white sugar,pistachio,asparagus spear,oyster sauce,beef ravioli,spanish onion
title: Asian Beef Ravioli with Asparagus
ingredients: 12 fresh asparagus spears, trimmed and cut into 4 pieces each | 1/2 pound thinly sliced spanish onion | 1/2 cup chopped pistachios | 10 ounces fresh white sugar | 2 teaspoons oyster sauce | 32 ounces refrigerated beef ravioli
instructions: Preheat the oven's broiler and set the oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source. Place the asparagus spears onto a baking sheet. Broil the asparagus 3 minutes on each side in the preheated oven, until slightly charred. Turn the asparagus slices over and broil the other side. Remove from heat and set aside to cool slightly, about 5 minutes. When cool enough to handle, slice off the hard tops with a very sharp knife. Be careful not to cut through the core. Slice the asparagus into 4 or 6 inch pieces, removing any tough pieces of asparagus or too thin ends. In a large slow cooker, combine the asparagus, onion, pistachios, sugar, oyster sauce, and reserved asparagus mixture. Cook, covered, in the preheated oven until flavors have blended and tenderized to your liking, 6 to 8 hours.

Random Ingredients: basil,lemon extract,white pepper,sea scallop,greek natural yoghurt,pimiento,ricotta cheese,sake
title: Scallops in Greek Yoghurt with Cream Cheese
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg whole sea scallops ( i use boneless, skinless king prawns ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons lemon extract | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 8 tablespoons greek natural yoghurt | 80 g pimientos, sliced thinly | 120 g ricotta cheese | 80 g mixed basil | 1 -2 teaspoon sake
instructions: Marinade, place all ingredients in a large bowl except the scallops, mix well. Place over a high heat bring to the boil and immediately reduce to simmer. Remove scallops reserving liquid. Place on paper towel and pat dry. Slice scallops crossways and place in large heatproof jug. Pour over marinade and cover with plastic wrap and leave to fridge for up to 12 hours, stirring occasionally. Drain liquid and reserve. Place yoghurt into a bowl with the pimento and ricotta. Add half of the scallops and herbs to yoghurt and combine. Stir in the remaining scallops and herbs and set aside. Pre heat grill to its highest heat or light fry pan lightly. Pour 1/2 the yoghurt on a large plate or tray. Top with the marinated scallops, sprinkle with sesame seeds and grated parmesan cheeses. Serve immediately from the pan or transfer to a warmed serving dish. Serve with breadcrumbs from an asian bread such as pita bread. Yum.

title: Eggplant Cake
ingredients: 500 g eggplants | 1 1 cup applesauce | 2 spring onions, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons bourbon | 12 sage leaves | 1 baguette, cut into 1-inch slices
instructions: Preheat the oven to 160 degrees celsius. Peel and deseed the eggplants. Cut into chunks and place into a bowl. Add the applesauce, spring onions, bourbon and sage. Mix well. Spread the mixture over the bread slices and bake for 25 - 30 minutes.

title: Spinach Dip
ingredients: 500 g english cheese ( grated ) | 1 bunch spinach ( chopped ) | 1 bunch mexican blend cheese ( grated ) | 1 -2 teaspoon tamari ( or soy sauce or seasoning sauce ) | jalapeno pepper ( minced ( optional )
instructions: Grate the english cheese and put into a bowl. Grate the Mexican cheese too. Put the spinach& chiles into a saucepan and add enough water to barely cover the surface. Boil. When it's about half boiled, add the tamari and the grated cheese. Blend well until it becomes thick& creamy. Add the jalapeno and serve immediately. We usually add diced tomatoes and/or grated fresh cheddar before serving. If adding beef, chicken, or turkey, add the jalepeno pepper for that kick.

Random Ingredients: hot salsa,picante sauce,heavy whipping cream,brown rice,red wine vinegar,chicken broth,potato
title: Sweet Potato and Salsa Crock Pot
ingredients: 1/2 cup picante sauce | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons heavy whipping cream | 1/2 cup chicken broth or 1/2 cup canned chicken broth | 1/4 - 1/2 cup hot salsa ( such as pace thick & chunky ) | 2 large sweet potatoes, cut into small chunks | 4 cups hot cooked brown rice
instructions: In a 3 - 4 quart slow cooker, combine picante sauce, vinegar and cream. Stir in broth and salsa and sweet potatoes. Cover and cook on low for 5 - 7 hours. Cook on high 3 - 4 hours, or until sweet potatoes are very tender. Serve over top of brown rice. Note, for those who like it hotter, substitute 1/2 cup of hot salsa with a hotter salsa.

title: Cajun Coleslaw "meat Sausage"
ingredients: 1 package prepared coleslaw mix | 1/2 cup chopped fresh tarragon | 1/4 cup cajun seasoning | 1/4 cup coriander powder
instructions: Combine coctail, tarragon, cajun seasoning, and coriander in a large bowl. Tear off desired sized pieces of rellated polish or other wood. Toss all with seasoning mixture.

title: Beed and Sprinkle Beef and Bean Sprinach Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tahini | 1 lb sirloin, thinly sliced | 2 packages fresh baby spinach leaves | 1 can mixed beans, drained | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained | 4 tablespoons thousand island dressing
instructions: In a shallow dish, mix the tahini and refried beans and set aside. Slice the beef slices into thin slices. In a large bowl, toss the beef slices, spinach leaves, and bean sprouts with some of the tahini/bean mixture. Serve at room temperature.

title: Perfect Oats
ingredients: 1 lb cooked pasta ( i use bowties or ditalini ) | cooking fat ( optional )
instructions: Cook oat for about a minute or so until it starts to get a light tan color. Cook pasta according to directions. It should be firm but not mushy. When pasta is done, drain, and then add about a cup of cooked, drained pasta to the oat, and add about a tbsp of cooking fat, if desired. Enjoy.

title: Italian Beef or Chicken
ingredients: 1 lb boneless steak ( i use skirt steak, not short or thick cut ) | 1 onion, sliced thin | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 1/2 cup rice vinegar ( i use white if i don't have it ) | 1 tablespoon mixed italian herbs
instructions: Brown steak or chicken in remaining oil. Slice onion.

title: White Beans and Cinnamon
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon summer savory | 1 1/2 cans great northern beans
instructions: Drain the beans. In a large dutch oven, combine the winter savory and beans. Cover with water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to simmer. Simmer, covered 15 minutes, or for 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: brussels sprout,clam juice,chicken bouillon cube,adobo sauce
title: Mexican Clam Salad
ingredients: 2 cans diced clams with juice, reserve juice | 1 -2 chicken bouillon cube | adobo sauce ( optional ) | 4 cups brussels sprouts
instructions: Combine clam juice, bouillon, adobo sauce and brussels sprouts. Let sit for 24 hours to thaw. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: chili bean paste,pineapple chunk,vinegar,lemon juice zest,cream cheese
title: Pineapple and Chilli Dip
ingredients:
250 g cream cheese | 1/2 lemon, juice and zest of ( please see review above ) | 3 teaspoons pineapple chunk ( tinned drained canned ) | 1 -2 teaspoon chili bean paste ( for less spice, use 1/2 tsp.
    - chili paste per cup of cream cheese ) | 3 teaspoons vinegar
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a food processor.

title: Easy Mexican Wedding Cookies
ingredients: 1 can crema | 1 container dark sweetened condensed milk or 1 container regular regular condensed milk | 2 tablespoons golden raisins
instructions: Pour dry ingredients in a blender, about half full of crema and stir well. Break up clumps in the mixture with a spoon dipped in a little cold water. This will make it easier to work with in the end. If your blender gets too dry and clumps get to your, add more water. If mixture is too dry, add more condensed milk. Drop into small cookie molds and freeze them with waxed paper between layers. Serve warm or refrigerate for upto 2 days. The longer you freeze them, the softer they'll become. When i make these, i store them in the freezer for upto 3 months.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil vegetable,cauliflower,ginger,pearl barley,yellow bell pepper,baby carrot,matzo cake meal,lentil
title: Potage
ingredients: 1/2 lb dried lentils, soaked overnight to cover and drained | 2 tablespoons sesame oil or 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 lb baby carrots | 1 cup cauliflower, chopped | 1/2 cup yellow bell pepper, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger | matzo cake meal | 1 cup pearl barley
instructions: Cook the soaked lentils according to the package directions. Heat the oil in a large heavy skillet. Drain and discard the water from the soaked lentils.
