Add carrots, cauliflower, bell pepper, ginger, and barley. Mix well. Simmer uncovered for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add the cooked lentils, stir well and serve with matzo meal.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck roast,bouquet garni,pineapple juice,catsup,green tomato
title: Pareve Beef with Pineapple
ingredients:
1 1/2 lbs beef chuck roast, cut into 4 serving pieces | 4 ounces pineapple juice | 4 ounces catsup | 1 bouquet garni ( or 1 tsp.
    - dried thyme ) | 3 -4 green tomatoes
instructions: Combine all ingredients and marinate several hours or, preferably, in the refrigerator. Grill or broil meat until nicely browned on all sides. Serve with rice or noodles.

title: Homemade Muffins
ingredients: 1/4 cup whole wheat flour | 1/4 cup romano cheese, minced ( italian cheese )
instructions: Combine your flours and 1/4 cup grated cheese and process or pulse briefly. Form into balls about the size of your walnuts. Roll each balls in the cheese and bake at 400 degrees for about 9 - 12 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cheese,green cardamom pod,walnut,cottage cheese,bell pepper,vodka,salt,corn oil
title: Chiron-Tunisian Breadcrumbs
ingredients: 7 ounces cottage cheese | 4 ounces shredded cheese ( or substitute with colby jack cheese ) | 1 small bell pepper, finely minced | 1 green cardamom pods | 4 tablespoons corn oil ( or as needed ) | 12 tablespoons vodka ( optional ) | salt | chopped walnuts ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 250°f. In a mixing bowl mix cottage cheese, cheese with a sprinkles of salt. Stir in pepper, cardamom pods, oil and vodka, if using. If using right away, refrigerate for at least 1 hour to allow flavor to develop. When ready to bake, form into small balls, roll them around in the walnuts to coat well. Bake on a baking sheet for 15 - 20 minutes, flipping once, to brown color. Best served hot or at room temperature, but they'll keep about 3 hours.

title: Peanut Oil Beef Strips
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin | 1 cup self rising flour | 1/4 cup chopped tomatoes | 1 tablespoon peanut oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Cut beef into strips.

title: Spinach Salad with Dark Sesame Oil
ingredients: 4 cups baby spinach | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil
instructions: Prepare the sesame oil if using store bought sesame oil, it tends to burn very quickly for this recipe. Cut the spinach into bite size pieces. Heat the sesame oil in a pan over medium high heat, add the spinach, and toss until the spinach just starts to wilt, just before it becomes crisp and fragrant. If you like your salad spongy, try substituting 1 tbs for 1/2 tbs. Shallots if you are using other oils. Enjoy note, to change the flavor, you can use fresh mushrooms, oysters or shrimp instead. Note, i used regular sesame oil and this was great. The kids only liked it, but you can use any sesame oil you like. Enjoy note, this is really good. It will mellow out the more you toss it, and the crunch will mix with your salad.

Random Ingredients: purpose flour,red chili powder,apricot,hot red chili pepper,taco shell,sage leaf,spring onion,ramen noodle
title: Hot Apricot and Noodle Samosas
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon red chili powder | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh sage leaf | 1 tablespoon chopped spring onion | 500 g dried apricots | 1/2 teaspoon hot red chili pepper | 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour | 1 packet ramen noodles ( flavour packet ) | 1 -2 tablespoon hot red chili powder | 2 cups hot flat dried tomatoes | 2 -3 treserved apricot juice | 12 taco shells
instructions: Make the seasoning mix by heating the jam on the stovetop until bubbly. Cool off to room temperature. Crush the dried apricots with your hands. Stir in the hot red chilli peppers and the flour. Add in the seasoning and simmer for 5 minutes. Add the seasoning packet and the noodles and stir in well. To serve sprinkle the tomatos and apricots on top of the ssamosas. Serve with the reserved tomato juices and crispy taco shells. Can be served with any savoury, crisp bread.

Random Ingredients: sherry,beef bouillon cube,cherry tomato,mandarin orange segment,hoisin sauce,potato traditional,sesame seed,sugar
title: Mandarin Orange Beef
ingredients: 1 beef bouillon cube ( can use granulated as desired ) | 12 cherry tomatoes | 2 tablespoons hoisin sauce | 8 large ginger-flavoured mandarin orange segments | 8 slices sweet potato traditional sesame seeds | 1/2 cup dry sherry | 1/2 teaspoon sugar | 1 tablespoon honey
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine bouillon, tomatoes, hoisin, mandarin oranges and sesame seeds. Cook over medium high heat for 10 minutes, or until tomatoes are soft. Stir in sherry and sugar. Remove from heat before serving.

Random Ingredients: hoagie,italian seasoning,pinto bean,phyllo pastry,cornflour,glutinous rice flour
title: Baked Gianduja Beans and Rice Pie
ingredients: 2 cups cooked pigeon peas | 1 cup sweet cornflour ( cornstarch ) | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1 package frozen phyllo pastry sheets, thawed and covered | 1 1/4 cups glutinous-rice flour | 12 ounces can pinto beans, drained well | 4 hoagie rolls
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f. Place the sweetcorn flour, italian seasoning and peas in a large saucepan. Bring to the boil and then remove the pan from the heat. Let it cool for a couple of minutes. Place thawed phyllo pastry on a lined baking sheet. Cover with a damp towel and generously brush with a little hot water. Let it sit out for 10 minutes. Uncover phyllo pastry sheet with the plastic and using a sharp knife cut away pastry from you and trim edges. Place one sheet on top of a table or cutting board and use a sharp knife cut to make as many sheets as you can fit into the bottom of the pie sheet. Cover with another sheet and the same amount of water. Using your fingers cut the pastry into six equal strips. Lay four strips across each other on the same flat countertop. Spread some rice flour on the top top and side of the pastry strips leaving about a 1/2 inch border around the edge. Spread the cornflour/rice flour mixture on the outside of the pastry strips making sure all 8 of the pastry have been covered with flour. Drain and rinse the cans of pinto beans well. Using a small spoon spread the beans down the center of the phyllo pastry. Carefully place the remaining 4 phyllo strips on top of the beans. Cut each roll diagonally. Seal the pastry with a bit of water, then sprinkle it with sugar if it is desired. Bake for about 30 - 40 minutes until golden. Let cool for 20 minutes, then slice diagonally to serve.

Random Ingredients: serrano pepper,bacon dripping,cumin powder,lime juice,cumin seed,sage leaf
title: Fry Rub
ingredients: 1 tablespoon bacon drippings | 2 teaspoons ground cumin powder | 2 teaspoons dried sage leaves | 1 tablespoon limes, juice of | 1/4 teaspoon ground cumin seed ( or more ) | 1/4 teaspoon dried ground serrano pepper or 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Place drippings and spices in a small bowl. Cover drippings with a clean cloth. Seal well. Keep refrigerated. Use in season fritters, meat grills, enchiladas and salads. Also great in a vegetable side dish for a tasty meal.

Random Ingredients: french bread,brandy,rye bread,merlot,worcestershire sauce,rice flour,canola oil
title: Rye Bread and Butter With Riesling
ingredients: 1/3 cup canola oil | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon brandy | 1 loaf french bread, cut into 1 inch to 1 1/2 inch cubes | 2 tablespoons rice flour | 2 tablespoons dry merlot | 1 tablespoon brandy | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1/2 loaf rye bread, cut into 1 inch to 1 inch cubes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In a small bowl, mix together the canola oil, worcestershire sauce, 1 teaspoon brandy, and 1 teaspoon dry merlot. Spread mixture on 1 tablespoon bread cubes. Sprinkle evenly with 1 tablespoon rice flour. Repeat with remaining bread cubes. Heat canola oil and 3 tablespoons canola oil in a large frying pan. Place cubes of riesling into the hot oil, and fry on all sides until golden. Turn and fry the other side. Pour all but 1 tablespoon of the canola oil from the pan into a small saucepan. Add the remaining ingredients to the saucepan. Cover and simmer for 45 minutes. To serve, serve on the side of warmed riesling with the rye bread cubes.

title: M&M's Easy Candle Pepper Butter
ingredients: 9 ounces white chocolate chips | 1/2 teaspoon chopped tarragon | 2 ounces garlic paste | 1 pinch cayenne pepper | 1 pinch cayenne pepper | 1 pinch tarragon
instructions: In a small saucepan, melt the white chocolate on the stove top. Remove the pan from the stove top onto a towel with the pot holder loosened. When the chocolate has melted, combine in the bowl with the rest of the ingredients and mix until melted again with no lumps.

title: Chilled Cheese Dip (Aka Green Tea) - Pressure Cooker
ingredients: 600 g cream cheese | 2 teaspoons cream of tartar | 2 -5 green cardamoms
instructions: Put all of the ingredients in the pressure cooker. Lock the lid into place and set on high for 5 minutes. When the pressure indicator goes off, release the pressure. Let it rest for at least five hours before opening the cooker. If you are really concerned about the cheese, refrigerate the dip to develop its flavor.

title: Blue Blarney Salmon
ingredients: 4 ounces smoked salmon fillets, cut into 2 serving portions | 4 ounces sliced ripe olives | 1 teaspoon cornflour | 1/4 cup blue curacao | 2 tablespoons sliced almonds
instructions: Combine the cornflour and blue curacao. Heat oven to 200c. Place salmon on rack in roasting pan. Heat for 10 - 15 minutes until just cooked through. Combine olives then drizzle over salmon. Sprinkle with almonds and serve.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,rice noodle,navy bean,velveeta cheese,vegetable shortening
title: Noodle Beef Bake
ingredients: 2 cans navy beans, rinsed and drained | 2 cups cooked rice noodles ( i like whole wheat ) | 1 1/2 lbs velveeta cheese, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 2 tablespoons vegetable shortening
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. In medium bowl, combine navy beans, noodles, cheese, soup and shortening. Spread mixture into ungreased shallow 2 1/2 quart casserole. Cover. Bake in 300f oven for 1 1/2 hours til heated through, stirring twice. Stir twice during baking during baking.

Random Ingredients: cucumber,alfredo sauce mix,apple juice,dill weed,tapioca flour,white yellow hominy
title: Apple Cucumber Tomato Posole
ingredients: 2 bunches medium cucumbers, seeded and shredded | 3/4 cup apple juice | 2 cans white yellow hominy, drained | 1 package dry alfredo sauce mix | 1/2 cup dried chopped fresh dill weed | 2 cups tapioca flour, divided | 2 tablespoons dried dill weed
instructions: Place shredded cucumber in a salad bowl, and cover with water. Gently squeeze out excess water. Place cucumbers in a colander, and place in the sink. When cucumbers are cool enough to handle, slice in half, and scoop out about 1/3 of the pulp. Discard pulp, and transfer pulp and juice to a deep saucepan. Add hominy, and place over medium low heat. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, and simmer about 20 minutes. Cover, and set aside. Combine 1/2 cup of dill weed with 1/2 cup of tapioca flour in a bowl, and stir in the remaining 1/2 cup of tapioca flour. Gradually stir into the soup. Continue to simmer 5 minutes, or until soup is creamy. Taste, and adjust spices with salt and pepper as needed. Ladle into bowls on top of the cooked posole. Top with remaining 1/2 cup of dill weed.

Random Ingredients: fennel bulb,salsa,whipping cream milk,arbol chile,walnut oil
title: Fennel Queso Fresca
ingredients: 1 fennel bulb | 1 jar salsa | 1 cup whipping cream or 1 cup milk | 1 tablespoon walnut oil ( or other neutral oil ) | 1 teaspoon dried arbol chiles ( optional )
instructions: Cut off lower 1/2 an fennel bulb, and discard the inner core then cut fennel crosswise with a thin knife blade into 1/4 inch slices. Cut fennel leaves into 1 1/2 pieces. Place fennel on a cookie sheet with no overlap to trap the cooking juices. In a saucepan, combine the rest of the ingredients, add the fennel, cover and bring to a boil over medium heat. Decrease heat and simmer uncovered for about 35 - 45 minutes. Serve and enjoy.

title: Granny's Best Noodle Pudding - Barfi
ingredients: 2 pounds country-style lamb, cut into 1 1/4-inch cubes | 2 pounds pork ribs, cut into 1 1/4-inch pieces | 1/2 cup halved hazelnuts | 1/2 cup chopped walnuts | 1 cup farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 3 1/2 cups beer
instructions: Pour 1 1/2 quarts of the olive oil into a large pot. Layer the lamb and pork rib in the pot, alternating the layers until the pork is gone. Pour the halved olives and chopped walnuts into a 9x13 inch baking dish. Cover with 1 1/2 pound water. Bring this to a boil, then turn off the heat. Let this sit for 30 minutes. Pour off the water. Drain the meat well. Add the farfalle pasta with about 1 1/2 cups of water to the meat. Cover and bring to a boil, then simmer over medium heat for 40 minutes. When done, place the cooked farfalle pasta in a colander and run cold water around it. Drain. Gently stir the farfalle into the tomato mixture. Top with the remaining 1 1/2 pound of meat and serve hot.

title: Beef Potatoes
ingredients: 2 lbs beef chuck, cut into 1 1/2 inch chunks | 12 baking potatoes, peeled and quartered | 1 1/2 cups sliced green onions
instructions: Place potato quarters in a 3 quart baking dish coated with cooking spray. Top with beef chuck. Pour remaining 1 1/2 cup water over beef cubes. Cover and refrigerate 4 hours. Bake, covered, in a preheated 375°f oven 1 hour and 15 minutes. Add green onions. Note, i bake them, uncovered, for 45 minutes at 375°f.

Random Ingredients: star anise,chipotle chile,complete seasoning,beef sirloin steak,active yeast,cornflour
title: Chipotle Steak
ingredients: 500 g all-purpose beef sirloin steaks | 4 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 1/4 teaspoons complete seasoning | 3 1/2 tablespoons cornflour | 1 teaspoon pure dried chipotle chile | 5 star anise
instructions: Place the beef in a large bowl that has been coated with cooking spray. Add 4 teaspoons of the active dry yeast, 1 1/4 teaspoons of the complete seasoning, 3 cups of the corn flour and 1 teaspoons of the chipotle puree. Mix well. Cover and set aside in a warm place for 5 to 8 hours. Remove the beef from the mixture, reserving the liquid. Slice the top 1 inch off of the steak to prevent it from curling as they sit. Reserve the slices and slice off the thin membrane from the outside of each rib of beef. Slice in half crosswise to make 2 thick steaks. Place the steak, fat side down, between two sheets of wax paper, sprinkle evenly with salt and black pepper and roll the meat up tightly in the flour. Roll the meat and paper around the pin to give an even pressure and leave to rise for an hour or more. Meanwhile bring the reserved liquid and 1½ cups of water to the boil. Add the remaining yeast mixture, 1 1/2 tablespoons of the cornflour, and 1 teaspoons of the pure chipotle puree and stir until dissolved. Stir in the beef and bring to the boil. Cover and let the mixture boil for 15 minutes or until the steak has tenderized and is cooked through. Slice each piece of beef as thinly as possible and place on a serving plate. Spoon the sauce over the steak slices and serve.

title: Roasted Garlic Herb Wrap
ingredients: 2 heads garlic herb wraps ( or to taste ) | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 2 -3 teaspoons peanut oil ( optional ) | 1 rosemary, shredded | 3 -4 fresh thyme sprigs ( or to taste ) | lettuce leaf ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Place garlic on a foil lined tray. Drizzle with 3 tablespoons of oil. Roast in a 300 degree oven for 30 minutes or longer if you wish. Remove from oven, remove garlic from oven when golden brown and reserve. Place cooked garlic on a cutting board and sprinkle with 3 tablespoons salt or the desired amount of salt. Remove the skins if desired and chop finely in a food processor or mortar & pestle. Alternatively, using a blender or food processor, place all herb oils and herbs including rosemary, thyme, or any other flavourings to taste.

title: Cheese Dip
ingredients: 2 cups corn chips, coarsely crushed | 1 can garbanzo beans ( drained and rinsed ) | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: Mix all ingredients well together and serve.

Random Ingredients: okra,barbecue sauce,simple syrup,beef rib,meat beef,tomato soup
title: Bbq Beef, Okra and Barbecue
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs boneless meat ( use lean, not lean cut ) | 1 1/2 lbs meaty beef ribs or 1 1/2 lbs beef brisket | 10 ounces condensed tomato soup | 1/2 cup simple syrup | 1/4 cup barbecue sauce | 1 lb okra
instructions: Cut meat into bite size cubes. Place all ingredients in crock, and stir with the lid on for approximately 8 hours. Remove everything from crock and place in roaster, and cover and heat in oven at 350 degrees for at least 3 hours. Cut okra into slices. Place okra on a large platter with okra and pour barbecue sauce over.

Random Ingredients: coconut,maple syrup,cooking oat,bicarbonate soda,butternut squash,red bell pepper
title: Roasted Butternut Squash and Coconut Fritters
ingredients: 4 ounces butternut squash | 8 ounces red bell peppers | 8 ounces sweetened coconut | 2 ounces cooking oats | 1 pinch bicarbonate of soda | maple syrup or honey
instructions: Slice squash into 3cm slices. Place the squash, red bell peppers and sweetened coconut into a roasting tin. Add the oats and bicarb of soda. Drizzle with maple syrup or honey and cook in a moderately hot oven or grill until well heated through and the coconut has turned golden. Place squash and red bell pepper mixture into hot sterilised jars, close and seal. Process for 1 - 2 minutes or until the vegetables are well combined. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: parmesan cheese,brioche bread,fruit,cranberry,wooden skewer,onion soup mix
title: Wild Forest Bread
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried mixed fruit | 1 tablespoon onion soup mix | 1 tablespoon cranberries or 1 tablespoon other wild fruit salad | 1 dash dried mixed fruit | 1/2 cup parmesan cheese | 8 -10 wooden skewers ( soaked in water 30 to 60 minutes ) | 3 pints brioche bread
instructions: Soak mixed fruit, onion soup mix and dried fruit.

title: Raspberry and Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 1/2 cup diced shiitake mushrooms | 1 teaspoon crushed dried shiitake mushrooms | 1/2 cup frozen raspberries | 5 pita bread, halved and toasted
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f in a medium bowl, mix mushrooms and dried mushrooms. Stir in raspberries. Place pita bread halves on a baking sheet. Spread raspberries lightly over the pitas. Bake until raspberries are melted and warm, about 10 minutes. Sprinkle with minced fresh parsley and serve hot.

title: Jumbo Shrimp with Cottage Cheese
ingredients: 2 cans low fat cottage cheese | 1 teaspoon poultry seasoning | 1 teaspoon cinnamon | 1/4 cup fat-free cottage cheese | 1 -2 tablespoon jumbo shrimp, cooked, peeled and deveined
instructions: In large bowl, mix 2 cans low fat cottage cheese, poultry seasoning, cinnamon and shrimp. Refrigerate for 1 hour. Pour into greased 9x13 pan. Sprinkle with 2 tablespoons of fat free cottage cheese. Bake uncovered at 350°f for 30 minutes. Sauce will be bubbly. Serve hot or cold so that cheese can melt.

title: Ancho Chile Chips
ingredients: 1/2 cup light corn syrup | 1 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder | 1/2 cup light cream of coconut
instructions: Bring corn syrup, ancho powder, and cream of coconut to a boil in a nonreactive saucepan. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno,chunky salsa,sirloin tip roast,spice,cake flour,pork butt,horseradish,coconut cream
title: Tasty Chilli Beef Stew
ingredients: 450 g sirloin tip roast | 4 ounces chunky salsa, medium | 1 packet spicy jamaican jerk spice | 1/2 ounce cake flour | 3 -4 tablespoons cake flour | 1 1/2 ounces beef broth or 1 1/2 ounces canned beef stock | 1 tablespoon creamed horseradish | 1/2 ounce shredded jalapeno | 2 tablespoons thick & chunky salsa
instructions: Place the roast in the freezer, with salt to stop it from cooking too quickly. Preheat the oven to gas 4 / 220 degrees. Cut the roast into slices 1 /4 inch thick. Place the slices, in an oven dish, and spray with olive oil. Sprinkle with the marinade. Bake for 40 mins at gas 4 / 220 degrees, spraying the dish with more oil every five minutes. Remove from the oven. Pour the chunky salsa over, stir with a fork, and return to the oven. When ready to serve, place the beef, and leftover sauce, in a large bowl. Cut the roast in two and stir into the beef. Sprinkle over the cake flour and mix well. Serve as is on top of the beef mixture or in the bowls, with thick & chunky salsa on the side before you top with shredded jalapeños.

title: Easy and Elegant Chutney
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 6 navel oranges
instructions: Combine vinegar and orange juice with a wire strainer. You should have about 1 cup of liquid. You can keep this chutney in the fridge for up to one week or freeze for up to 3 months.

Random Ingredients: coriander powder,filet beef,confectioner sugar,salt black pepper,cilantro,spanish onion,gin
title: Beef Filet Kabobs
ingredients: 1 cup chopped spanish onion | 1/2 cup chopped fresh cilantro | 1/4 cup gin | salt and ground black pepper to taste | 1 pound thinly sliced filet of beef | 1 cup confectioners'sugar | 1 teaspoon dried cilantro, or as desired
instructions: Mix 1 cup chopped onion, 1/2 cup chopped cilantro, gin, salt, and pepper together in a bowl. Add the sliced filets to the marinade, and mix well. Place slices of beef in a resealable plastic bag with plastic wrap. Pour the marinade over the meat, coating the whole thing. Allow to marinate, refrigerated, in the refrigerator for 1 hour. Preheat an outdoor grill for medium high heat, and lightly oil the grate. Lightly oil the grate so the kabobs remain uncooked on the inside of the grill.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,ginger garlic paste,salad oil,fish fillet,beef broth,lettuce,bamboo shoot,saffron strand
title: Fish in Saffron
ingredients: 2 tablespoons oil | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 200 ml fish broth | 3 saffron strands, soaked in a little warm water | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar or 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 2 1/2 - 3 lbs fresh lettuce, trimmed, washed and patted dry ( mixed of romaine, beet, iceberg and red leaf lettuce are best ) | lettuce, shredded ( to garnish ) | bamboo shoot, garnish ( to garnish )
instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add ginger garlic paste and continue cooking 1 minute. Pour in broth.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,coffee,almond,grain,mexican cheese,virgin olive oil,lemon juice zest
title: Mexican-Style Almond-Cheese Blend
ingredients: 1 cup blanched whole almond | 1/4 cup virgin olive oil | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1 lemon, juice and zest of, grated | 1 cup mexican cheese, shredded | 2 ounces strong coffee | 1 zested lemon, juice and zest of
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f / 190c / gas mark sieve the almonds, rinse and set aside. Wash the almonds & chop coarsely. Heat 2 tbsp of the oil in a pan over medium heat, add the almond and fry, stirring, for 1 minute. Remove from the heat, pour in the rest of the oil, the vinegar, lemon juice and zest, coffee, lemon juice and zest and remaining 2 tbsp of olive oil and simmer for 3 minutes. Add the almonds and mix well. Transfer to a well buttered shallow ovenproof dish and smooth the top. Bake for 25 minutes or until golden. Allow to stand for 5 minutes, serve hot or warm.

Random Ingredients: tortilla chip,red chile,beef tenderloin steak,eggplant,red cabbage,chili sauce,italian seasoning
title: Beef and Cabbage Wraps
ingredients: 1 beef tenderloin steak, trimmed | 2 tablespoons chili sauce | 1 tablespoon dried italian seasoning | 1 cup torn red cabbage ( if lettuce isn't available, tear it up with your hands ) | 1/2 cup torn red cabbage | 1 tablespoon thinly sliced red chile | 4 tablespoons crushed tortilla chips
instructions: Season the tenderloin steak with italian seasoning. Slice the steaks thinly if desired. Brush each steak with chili sauce and set aside. In a medium bowl, combine the cabbage, pepper, tortilla chips and chilis. Spread about half of the cabbage mixture on each steak.

Random Ingredients: cracker,yogurt,pie shell,sherry wine,red cabbage,coffee ice cream,vegetable broth
title: Cafe Rio's Instant Coffee Pie
ingredients: 12 inches refrigerated pie shells | 1/2 cup strong brewed coffee or 1/2 cup strong sherry wine | 1/4 cup sherry wine ( white or brown ) | 1 1/2 cups low-fat yogurt | 6 cups hot low sodium vegetable broth | 1 large red cabbage, thinly sliced | 2 cups instant low-fat coffee ice cream
instructions: For the coffee pie, put the coffee and sherry in a microwave safe bowl and heat on high power until the liquid boils and the liquid is reduced to 1 3/4 cups, about 2 minutes. Stir. Pour the hot coffee mixture into the pie shells and place in a cold oven or toaster oven. Set oven to 225°f. For the soup, stir the soup, yogurt, broth, cabbage and cold coffee in a large saucepan. Heat through, about 20 minutes. If the soup is too thick, add a little water or cream, stirring until smooth. Serve the carbonated soup in the pie shell.

Random Ingredients: bean,grain white rice,golden caster sugar,white cheddar cheese,fajita seasoning mix
title: Rice Balls With Beans and Fajita Seasonings
ingredients: 300 g long grain white rice | 1/3 cup fajita seasoning mix ( see fajita seasoning mix ) | 1/4 cup golden caster sugar | 300 g refried beans | 150 g grated white cheddar cheese
instructions: Place the rice in a large heatproof bowl and cover with boiling water. Keep aside for 10 minutes. Drain the rice from the water and run under cold water to wash away any residual starch. Rinse the rice until the water runs clear, pour the water off, and stir well. Cover with a wet cloth and set in the refrigerator. Place the oven to 200c/400f/gas place the brownie mix in a heatproof bowl, pour in enough boiling water to cover it and set aside for 30 minutes. Meanwhile, place the fajita seasoning in a frying pan and cook over a medium high heat, stirring all the time for 1 - 2 minutes. Pour in the sugar, remove from heat and then set aside. When the rice has absorbed all the water, turn the heat down to a gentle simmer and stir once or twice. Stir in the beans, cover, and leave to stand for 5 minutes, until the beans have absorbed all the water and the rice is cooked. Remove the fajita seasoning from the heat and transfer the mixture to a lightly greased 20 x 30 cm baking tin. Sprinkle with the cheese and bake in a preheated oven for 15 to 20 minutes until the cheese has melted and is bubbling.

title: Quick and Easy Steak Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup dehydrated onion soup mix | 1/2 cup beef broth
instructions: In a medium saucepan, mix onion soup mix, beef broth, and dehydrated onion soup mix. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 30 to 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: rice wine vinegar,butter,tilapia fillet,oyster sauce,beef chuck,basil leaf,italian parsley,garam masala
title: Baked Tilapia with Garlic, Basil and Asian Herb
ingredients: 2 tilapia fillets, cut in half | 1/2 cup minced fresh basil leaves | 1 1/4 teaspoons garam masala | 2 teaspoons butter | 2 tablespoons minced garlic | 2 tablespoons minced italian parsley | 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons oyster sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Mix basil, garam masala, butter, garlic, parsley, rice wine vinegar, oyster sauce in a glass jar to make a marinade. Add tilapia fillets and turn to coat evenly. Marinate in refrigerator for 15 minutes, turning the pieces once. Transfer fillets, skin side down, to a lightly oiled baking dish. Bake in preheated oven until fish flakes easily with a fork, 25 to 35 minutes. Drain juice from fish into a saucepan.

title: Pineapple Kielbasa
ingredients: 2 links kielbasa | 1 can pineapple chunks, drained | 1/2 pound fresh shrimp- peeled and deveined | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: In a skillet over medium high heat, cook kielbasa in the hot syrup until browned on the inside, 5 to 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,orange zest,yellow mustard,sirloin,bitter melon,cornstarch
title: Grilled Beef & Sweet Chilli (Melon Skink)
ingredients: 600 g sirloin or 600 g flank steaks | 3 teaspoons cornstarch | 1 tablespoon yellow mustard | 1 teaspoon orange zest ( grated ) | 1 pinch chili pepper flakes | sweet chili pepper flakes ( optional )
instructions: Combine the cornstarch, mustard, orange zest and chilli flakes and mix in the trimmed sirloin or flank steak to evenly coat. Grill or broil the meat until cooked to your liking.

title: Guilt Free Creamy Caesar Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour | 4 fluid ounces dry red wine vinegar | 4 fluid ounces reduced fat honey | 1 1/2 tablespoons finely chopped drained roasted peanuts | 4 cloves garlic, crushed | 1 orange, zested and juiced | 1 jar sliced large pimientos, drained | 1 can anchovy fillets, drained and roughly chopped
instructions: Place flour in a medium bowl. Gradually add red wine vinegar, honey, nuts, garlic, orange zest and juiced. Stir to mix well, then add pimentos and anchovies. Toss well to combine and serve.

Random Ingredients: bean sprout,caster sugar,vegetable stock,tomato sauce,balsamic vinegar,cooking barley,ice water,plain nonfat yogurt
title: Sweet Rice Extraordinaire
ingredients: 3 cups vegetable stock | 1 cup quick-cooking barley | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 1 teaspoon balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons plain nonfat yogurt | 2 cups fresh bean sprouts | ice water
instructions: Place stock and barley in a saucepan over a medium heat and bring to the boil. Reduce heat and simmer until barley is tender, 20 - 25 minutes. Transfer to a bowl and stir in tomato sauce, sugar, vinegar and yoghurt. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Meanwhile, cook bean sprouts in boiling water for 2 minutes or until tender. Drain and pat well with paper towel to remove excess moisture. To serve, pour the rice into a bowl, add bean sprouts, spooning tomato mixture over. Swirl lightly with a fork.

title: Spam, Nut & Feta Filling
ingredients: 2 lbs spam | 1/2 lb feta cheese | 1/2 lb cashews | 4 tablespoons ketchup | 1/3 cup flat leaf parsley
instructions: Melt cashew nuts and ketchup in a medium pan over low heat, stirring regularly, until cashews are well roasted. Cool slightly. Cut spam into 1/2 inch cubes and put into a bowl. Add ketchup mixture and stir to mix well. Pour into a shallow pan and cook at 400 degrees fahrenheit for 8 - 10 minutes until the mixture is reduced in half and spam is crispy. Remove from heat and cool a few minutes to cool. Place nuts, feta, and cashews into a food processor and whiz til smooth. Add ketchup mixture along with parsley and process until well mixed and well blended, stopping and scraping down the sides with a spatula as needed. Spoon into sterilised jars and seal.

title: Gramma's Potato Mushroom Salad
ingredients: 2 large potatoes, peeled and boiled | 15 fresh shiitake mushrooms | 1 container nonfat yogurt | 1 1/2 cups fresh berries
instructions: Remove from heat and drain potatoes. Cut the shiitake mushrooms into halves or quarters. Cut up the berries. Pour potatoes into a large bowl. Add salt, pepper, and yogurt. Mix into potato mixture until well mixed. Place in fridge and chill until serving.

title: Mujadarra (Dried Kidney Beans)
ingredients: 1 cup dry kidney beans | 6 cups ice water | 1 pinch saffron ( optional ) | 1/2 cup dijon mustard | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom | 3 tablespoons chopped cilantro ( optional ) ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cilantro in a large saucepan and bring to a boil over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice,beef stew meat,wheat germ,yeast,kalamata olive,thyme,lettuce leaf,egg
title: Beef Burgers
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 2 lbs trimmed beef stew meat | 8 eggs, lightly beaten | 1/2 cup kalamata olive, chopped | 1/2 cup fresh lemon juice | 8 slices whole wheat germ | 4 cups lettuce leaves | 2 tablespoons whole wheat germ
instructions: For the meat mixture, in a large bowl, combine the beef, thyme and 1/4 cup water. Soak in the refrigerator. Place beef on the counter and make small balls, inserting into the centers with a meat mallet to flatten, using 1 tablespoon per burger. For the topping, in a medium bowl, combine the olives, lemon juice, and half of the bread crumbs. Brush over the patties. Spread with the lemon topping. Sprinkle with the remaining crumbs. Let it stand 10 minutes. Heat a griddle over medium high heat. Place the patties on the griddle and cook 6 minutes per side or until medium rare. Serve on the lettuce leaves with the topping.

title: Danish Trifle (Sandieskaag)
ingredients: 1 jar salami | 1 container soft custard powder
instructions: Spread a thin layer of custard powder on the salami. Repeat layers then serve.

title: Apple, Vegetable and Peanut Crisp
ingredients: 4 medium tart apples, peeled, chopped roughly | 8 young courgettes, washed, trimmed and chopped roughly | 1/2 cup roasted green peanut oil or 1/2 cup vegetable oil | 1/4 cup roasted red beans or 1/4 cup frozen red beans, thawed | 1/4 cup dry roasted pecans
instructions: Combine all the ingredients, except for the peanuts, in a large fry pan and fry over a high heat, stirring occasionally, for approx 20 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender. Sprinkle toasted peanuts on toasted apple mixture.

title: Chuck and Oatmeal
ingredients: 1 packet active dry yeast or 3 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 2 1/2 cups quick cooking oats | 4 -5 lbs chuck | 1 tablespoon monosodium glutamate ( msg ) | 1 1/2 cups canned tomatoes with juice, undrained ( san-gale, petite tomatillo, petite blend tomatillo, or equivalent brand ) | fresh cilantro, snipped ( optional )
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the yeast, and oaty and stir well to blend. Scald the tomatoes and tomato juice, and pour into the yeast. Add the 1 - 2 tsp monosodium glutamate and stir well to combine. Set aside to let it bubble for 5 minutes. Remove the pan from heat and allow to sit 10 - 10 minutes before serving. This allows the water to rise. If you use active dry yeast, stir well, and then let raise 5 minutes, stirring once or twice. It is worth it to have a little bit of a stretch to it. When it rises again, remove the pan and allow to chill for about 45 minutes. Punch down the crusts, cut off a little off the top and discard. Then make a hole in the center of the crust with your thumb and spoon 1 1/2 cups of the oaty mixture into the hole. Press around the hole. Cover and allow to rise until the loaf is about 1/2 inch above the walls of the loaf. Bake at 375 degrees fahrenheit for about 2 hours, or until a crusty/shrimp like consistency is achieved. If you use the dry yeast, stir well into the oaty and seasonings.

title: Raspberry Pork Spareribs
ingredients: 1/2 cup raspberry jam | 1 tablespoon vegetable stock | 1 pinch dried chili flakes | 1 lb pork spareribs
instructions: In a microwave safe bowl, mix jam, stock and chili flakes. Cook, uncovered on high for 2 minutes. Add spareribs and cook covered on high for 3 minutes. Stir, cook covered on high for 1 minute before turning pan for remaining cooking time.

Random Ingredients: serrano chili,skor english toffee bit,fruit peel,tomato puree,ladyfinger
title: Mascarpone
ingredients: 1 cup skor english toffee bits ( store-bought or home-made ) | 4 tablespoons tomato puree | 1 serrano chili, chopped ( or other chile ) | 4 sheets ladyfingers ( fresh or dried ) | 1 tablespoon dried fruit peel, finely chopped
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Place the skor bits, puree, chiles, and a few tablespoons of the dried fruit and truffles on a plate, and spread them out to cover the baking sheet. Bake at 450° for 10 - 15 minutes, or until the skor bits are lightly browned. Remove from the oven, and let them cool for several minutes. Cut them diagonally into 1/2 inch pieces. Place a small scoop of the softened ice cream on top, and then sprinkle the other tablespoon of dried fruit and truffles over the ice cream. Serve immediately.

title: Italian Sausages
ingredients: 1/4 - 1/2 lb mild italian sausage | 3 -4 tablespoons italian seasoning | 1/2 cup apple cider
instructions: Dry italian sausage with paper towel, remove casings. In large skillet combine sausage, cider and seasoning. Cook and stir until warm, but don't burn serve over hot cooked pasta.

title: Sweet and Savory Fresh Green Beans
ingredients: 2 pounds fresh green beans, trimmed | 1 jar apricot preserves | 1/4 cup fish sauce | 3 serrano chilies, sliced
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add green beans, and cook until tender crisp, about 5 minutes. Drain, and set aside. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Stir preserves and fish sauce together in a bowl, and spread over a 9x13 inch baking dish. Top with green beans, and sprinkle with serrano peppers. Bake in the preheated oven until bubbly, about 35 minutes.

title: Beer-Braised Portobello Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dark beer | 1 lb portabella mushroom, halved | 150 g dry medium pasta | 1 red capsicum, seeds removed, diced finely | 4 teaspoons fresh parsley, chopped finely | salt & pepper
instructions: Pare capsicum off capsicum. Place capsicum on absorbent paper and microwave with beer for 2 - 3 minutes, depending on your wattage. Set aside and let stand for 3 hours. Pre heat oven to 200c. Boil saucepan if using. Place mushrooms on an oven tray and cook for 3 - 5 minutes. Place pasta on oven tray and add 2 tbsp oil, 1 tbsp butter or half a tablespoon of butter to saucepan. Add the capsicum and cook for a few minutes to release the juices. Add the parsley and seasoning and continue cooking, uncovered for 2 - 3 minutes. Serve with remaining sauce.

Random Ingredients: filling,hot chili sauce,cocoa,artichoke heart,sea salt,pork shoulder,cherry
title: Chile Colorado
ingredients: 4 lbs pork shoulder ( bone in or boneless ) | 2 jars chile paste with artichoke hearts ( optional, see note below ) | 3 cans whole cherry tomatoes ( with juice ) | 1 cup sweet pickled cocoa ( use `` anejo '' ) | 1/2 - 1 cup sweet hot chili sauce ( see note below ( see note below ) | sea salt, to taste | 1 cup hulled hulled dried cherries ( optional )
instructions: Place the pork shoulder and cherry tomatoes in a 3 - 4 quart crockpot. Remove the skin from the pork shoulder and put the pork into the pot.

title: Shishito Beef Brisket
ingredients: 8 ounces beef brisket, trimmed
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Line a large roasting pan with foil and set it aside. Place the brisket in the roasting pan and season it generously with salt and pepper. Pour salsa evenly over the meat. Bake in the preheated oven about 3 hours, basting frequently with pan juices. When done, meat will be tender and very tender.

title: Roasted Sun Dried Tomato Ices
ingredients: 1/3 cup roasted sun-dried tomato, packed in oil, drained | 3 tablespoons prepared coffee, cooled
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir sun dried tomato until coated with oil, then spoon into the center of a square of parchment paper or aluminum foil to form a pouch.

Random Ingredients: tea,milk ricotta cheese,chili garlic sauce,aubergine,ketchup,nut,cold water
title: Aubergine & Ricotta Stuffed Daubergines
ingredients: 2 medium aubergines | 1 1/2 tablespoons teabags chili-garlic sauce | 2 cups cold water | 1 can evaporated milk ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup chopped nuts | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 1/4 cup strong tea
instructions: Cut ends off the aubergines and carefully hollow out the ends. Carefully scoop out the flesh with a teaspoon, then place hollowed out aubergines in a large glass dish. Add chili garlic sauce, water, ricotta, and nuts. Mix well to combine the mixture. Pour the mixture into the aubergine hollows and marinate in the fridge for 1 hour or overnight before serving.

Random Ingredients: catalina salad dressing,thai fish sauce,ricotta cheese
title: Quick Greek Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 pound ricotta cheese | 1 bottle catalina salad dressing | 1/2 cup thai fish sauce for dipping
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together the ricotta cheese, salad dressing, and fish sauce. Cover bowl, and refrigerate 1 hour to blend flavors, before serving.

Random Ingredients: broccoli floret,white breadcrumb,white wine vinegar,ricotta cheese,star anise,oyster sauce
title: Broccoli (Stir-Fry) With Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 2 -3 stalks broccoli florets, trimmed | 2 tablespoons fresh white breadcrumbs | 1 star anise, bruised | 2 teaspoons white wine vinegar | 1 cup low-fat ricotta cheese ( low fat is fine ) | 1/4 cup oyster sauce
instructions: Place all ingredients except broccoli in small bowl and stir well to combine. Cover and chill while preparing ingredients. Heat a pan over medium heat. Drain the vegetables under cold running water, if any. Add the broccoli and fry until the broccoli has wilted, 2 - 3 minutes. Stir into the cheese mixture and keep stirring until the cheese is melted and the sauce just begins to thicken slightly. Season to taste with s&p. Serve immediately.

title: Chocolate Maccha and Turnips for Two
ingredients: 10 ounces sweet mini penne | 6 ounces turnips | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Slice and par boil the turnips in the microwave for approximately 8 minutes.. Remove turnips from the microwave and put into a bowl of cold water. Add the cocoa and whisk until smooth. Set aside. Place pasta onto a large baking dish. Using a vegetable peeler, remove the zest of the turnips and pith. Cut the turnips into 4 or 5 chunks of any length the turnips should be smaller. Place in a large zip lock bag. Pour the melted turnip cocoa over top. Bake for approximately 45 minutes. Note, this maccha is delicious if refrigerated the same day it is made. If it's stored, the turnips will get eaten sooner.

title: Bell Peppers With Cheese and Smoked Sausage
ingredients: 1 lb whole wheat bread | 1 yellow bell pepper | 1 tablespoon monosodium glutamate per 1/2 cup of cheese | 1 dash monosodium glutamate ( optional )
instructions: Cut the bread into 1/4 slices. Make slices 3/4 thick. Spread cheese on untoasted bread slices. Sprinkle with monosodium glutamate. Place into a covered iron skillet over medium heat for 2 - 3 minutes, turning once. Carefully remove bread from skillet and let cool for 5 - 10 minutes before cutting into 1/2 inch slices.

title: Chilli Beans
ingredients: 200 g of long green beans, with tender stalks | 1 dried chili pepper ( dried jaffarines ), crushed ( optional )
instructions: Place the beans and other ingredients in a saucepan and bring to a boil, stirring frequently. Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer. Check often to make sure they are just tender.

Random Ingredients: polenta,bell pepper,cream cheese,baking powder,crabmeat,yeast,dark soy sauce
title: Crab and Pepper Mini Muffins
ingredients: 2 cups cream cheese, room temperature | 1 envelope instant yeast | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce ( low sodium ) | 1 cup coarse polenta | 2 cups chopped bell peppers ( one small yellow florina or orange and one medium ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder | 14 ounces crabmeat, drained
instructions: In a bowl, combine all ingredients and mix to thoroughly combine the ingredients. The mixture should be fluffy. Divide the dough in half and shape into 12 mini muffin size balls. Place the mini muffins onto a sprayed foil lined baking sheet in a single layer. Bake in 400 degree oven until the tops of the mini muffins start to turn golden, about 12 minutes. Check with a toothpick that they are done. You should not need to grease the tops of the muffins, or they will not rise up like traditional muffins. Remove the muffins and let cool completely. Enjoy.

title: Spinach With Fresh Spring Onions
ingredients: 14 ounces baby spinach | 4 spring onions, small, green ones, finely sliced | 1 1/2 teaspoons garam masala | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: Wash the spinach and remove the hard stems by removing the tough outer leaves. Chop to about the size of the chopped spinach. Heat a little olive oil in a frying pan until very hot. Add the spring onions and fry for a minute or two, until golden in colour. Add the garam masala and turmeric, stirring well. Stir in the chopped spinach. Stir for about two minutes until the spinach becomes very soft, then remove the lid. Leave to rest for about 5 minutes. Serve warm with chapatis or puris.

title: Mexican Beef Medallions
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 2 cups milk ( i use 2 % ) or 2 cups light cream ( i use 2 % ) | 2 cups beef tenderloin, trimmed and cut into 4 medallions ( or tenderloin of your choice ) | 1 teaspoon adobo sauce ( i use mild ) | 1/4 cup currants ( optional ) | warm broth, from broiling beef and vegetables | 2 tablespoons skim milk or 2 tablespoons light cream
instructions: Set oven on broil setting. Combine milk and cream in a medium saucepan.

title: Bubba's Okra
ingredients: 1 lb frozen cut okra, any length, thawed if fresh | 1 cup picante sauce | 1/2 teaspoon paprika ( or more to taste ) | 2/3 teaspoon xanthan gum | 2 -3 jalapeno peppers, seeded and minced
instructions: Cook the okra in boiling water until they are just tender. Drain and rinse well. Place in a sauce pan with picante and seasonings. Heat through while stirring.

title: Crock Pot Thyme French Toast
ingredients: 1 loaf white bread, cubed ( or white ) | 1 package fresh thyme leaves
instructions: Add onions to crock pot. Add thyme leaves. Cover and cook on low for 4 - 6 hours. Slice bread into 4 slices. Serve on serving platter, garnish with thyme leaves or parsley flowers.

title: Liangban Huiharitos (Vietnamese Stir-Fried Bok Choy) With Caramelized Caramelized Caramel Spread
ingredients: 10 lbs bok choy, leaves trimmed | 6 tablespoons brown sugar | 15 fluid ounces caramelized caramelized caramelized caramel sauce ( see description )
instructions: Trim the root ends and tops off of the bok choy stems, cutting off the root ends. Cut off and discard any shiny bits of white remaining attached to the leaves. Break off a section of the leaves and cut each portion into six wedges. Repeat with remaining leaves. Place about two dozen pieces of bok choy in a deep skillet and lightly season with salt. Cover the pan and place over high heat. Heat for 1 minute. Stir in 5 tablespoons sugar and caramelized caramel sauce until the caramel coating is dark and bubbly. Continue to cook until the caramel coating is hot and the flavor is well blended, about 1 minute. Toss the bok choy heads with the caramel sauce. Set aside at room temperature for about a hour before serving.

title: Capellone Rum Roll
ingredients: 1 envelope unflavored gelatin | 4 1/2 cups strong brewed coffee | 1 package frozen chopped spinach leaves, thawed and drained | 2 tablespoons superfine sugar | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1 tablespoon rum
instructions: In a 3qt. Saucepan, stir gelatin over medium heat and let stand 5 minutes to soften. Stir in coffee and spinach. Heat to boiling.

title: Shir Kurma - Simple Indian Coconut Rice
ingredients: 2 -3 cups cooked white rice | 1 tablespoon ginger paste | 1 tablespoon coco-style rum
instructions: Saute the ginger and rice until transparent.

title: Tortilla Escarole With Marsala Sauce #5FIX
ingredients: 12 soft taco-size flour tortillas ( i like the 6 '12-inch size ) | 2 tablespoons taco-flavored flour tortillas ( i like the 6 '12-inch size ) | 2 tablespoons marsala wine or 2 tablespoons chicken broth | 2 cups shredded escarole | 1 jar pizza sauce
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. In a 9x13 glass casserole dish, spread out each of the soft taco tortillas by placing them in the middle of the dish and covering them with the tortillas. Sprinkle the tortillas with 2 teaspoons of flour and 1 tablespoon of the marsala or broth. Top this layer with the escarole. Top the escarole with another 2 teaspoons of flour and 1 tablespoon of olive oil. Place the baking dish into the oven and heat the oven to bake for 20 minutes depending on how hot your oven is. You may have to take the lid off for the 20 minutes so the tortillas can get soft and crispy. Slice and serve with the pizza sauce on the side.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,yellow cornmeal,beer,golden raisin,chicken meat,chickpea,feta cheese
title: Chicken and Chickpea Crusted Mini Taco Meatloaves
ingredients: 1 cup shredded chicken meat | 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese | 1/4 cup chopped yellow cornmeal | 1/4 cup halved golden raisins | 1/2 cup can chickpeas | 1 cup beer, divided | 1 1/4 cups prepared mini taco shells or 1 1/4 cups mini graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°. In medium bowl, stir together meat, feta, cornmeal, raisins, chickpeas, 1/2 cup beer and cheese. Cut crumb mixture into 1 1/2 inch cubes. Spoon 1/4 cup chicken mixture into center of each bread mini taco shell. Roll up taco shells, securing with toothpicks. Arrange taco roll ups on a baking sheet. Bake in oven 18 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Cottage Cheese Beef Brisket
ingredients: 2 tablespoons fresh herbs, minced ( mixed cilantro, parsley and basil ) | 2 garlic chives, minced | 4 -5 lbs small beef brisket
instructions: Remove fat and silverskin from beef and discard. Place in crockpot. Add herbs, garlic chives, salt, pepper, and remaining ingredients. Cover and cook on high for 3 hours or low for 8 - 10 hours or until beef is tender.

title: Cucumber and Chiles
ingredients: 5 lebanese cucumbers | 1 serrano pepper | 1 tablespoon vanilla yogurt ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder ( optional ) or 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper ( optional )
instructions: Slice cucumbers and chiles into thin rounds. Place on large cookie sheet. Slice serrano pepper in rounds. Mix together all ingredients. Pour over cucumbers and chiles. Make a small fat layer of saran wrap on top. Cover dish and place in fridge to stand at least 8 hours. Serve with french bread, breadcrumbs, crackers, or toasted rye bread. Note, the less you eat the less of the flavour of your chiles will be.

title: Slightly Asian Pineapple Triangles
ingredients: 32 sheets phyllo dough, thawed ( use as many sheets as needed to make a stack ) | 1 cup palm sugar or 1 cup light brown sugar, packed | 1/2 cup finely chopped onion | 2 2 cups drained fresh green beans or 2 cups frozen green beans | 3/4 cup pineapple juice ( or 1 -2 drop of red wine vinegar to taste )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400/f/175 degrees. In a small bowl, combine sugar, onion, green beans and pineapple juice. Fold in the phyllo, and place a generous 4 to 5 tablespoons on a cookie sheet. Bake for about 5 to 10 minutes. Cool slightly. Using a pencil blade cut out a small portion of the dough and shape into a 1 inch square diagonally across the square root. Place a scant 1 teaspoon of filling along the center of the square. Moisten the edges with water, fold in the top corners, pressing gently to seal. Repeat with remaining sheets. Place on a baking sheet and bake for about 20 to 30 minutes or until golden brown and crisp. Serve hot or cool and cut diagonally to serve.

Random Ingredients: flour tortilla,grinder,apricot,kosher salt,cheese,sauce,green onion,green chili pepper
title: Sarasota's Spanish Tortilla Filling
ingredients: 1/2 cup apricot, diced | 1 tablespoon green chili pepper, diced | 1 1/2 tablespoons green onions, diced | 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt | 2 teaspoons kraft cheese, shredded | 1/8 teaspoon hot sauce | 1 round flour tortillas | 10 slices cheese ( optional )
instructions: Sauté green chile, green onions, and salt. Add apricots and chili peppers to sauté. Stir well. Stir in cheese and hot sauce. Fry tortillas on each side until brown and crisp. Optional, garnish with chopped parsley before serving. Also you can pour the sautéed mixture on top of the tortilla and bake. It also works great on sourdough bread.

title: Mushroom Almond Paste
ingredients: 2 ounces almond paste | 1 lb fresh shiitake mushrooms | 1/8 cup sweet red pepper, roasted
instructions: Wipe mushrooms dry.

title: Beer and Coconut Crockpot Chicken
ingredients: 1 cup crushed coconut | 1 cup sour cream | 1 can beer ( i use campbell's ) | 1 onion, diced | 1 bay leaf | 2 lbs chicken thighs or 2 lbs pork fillets, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 tablespoon flour | 1 ounce cream cheese
instructions: Combine coconut, sour cream, beer and onion in the crockpot. Sprinkle with bay leaf. Arrange chicken over top. Cover and cook on low 8 - 10 hours. Remove bay leaf. Remove chicken and stir fry vegetables for about 5 minutes. Blend flour and cream cheese. Gradually stir into crockpot mixture. Return chicken to crockpot and cook 1 more hour, or until desired temperature. Serve over rice, with vegetables and rice mixed with the flour and cream cheese.

title: New Year's Eve Clam and Noodle Salad
ingredients: 3 dried red chilies, thinly sliced | 4 ounces noodles, any style, boiled | 2 cups cranberries ( dried cranberries ) | 24 pieces clams, in the shell on the shell, scrubbed | 2 tablespoons chili oil or 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1/2 cup thawed frozen raspberries ( optional )
instructions: Place dried chilies and noodles in a food processor and pulse until desired texture. Pour into a shallow bowl. Cut clam shells in half and remove deveined clams. Cut whole clams in half lengthwise again for garnish. Heat chilies and noodles in water to cover over high heat until noodles are tender but firm to the bite. Drain noodles and set aside. Heat chili oil or sesame oil over medium heat until hot. Add clams and toss until coated. Cook for 3 to 5 minutes or until clams open. Remove from heat and toss in drained noodles, raspberries and any additional liquid. Serve immediately.

title: Veal Milanese
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs veal, well trimmed | veal or bacon, of your choice | fresh double cream | 2 slices vanilla vodka | 6 kaffir lime leaves
instructions: Cut the meat into slices about 2/3 inch thick. Cut slices of veal into pieces about a quarter inch wide. Put in a large, heavy frying pan with the veal pieces so that they are brown on each side in a little fat. Add the vanilla vodka. When all of the pieces are brown add the cream and kaffir lime leaves. Cook gently, stirring very often, until the sauce just begins to thicken, around 5 to 10 minutes. Serve over hot rice.

title: Spaghetti and Sweet Meatballs (Sinagang Na Tanigue)
ingredients: 1/2 lb of soft and smooth cured boneless pork butt | 4 ounces firm tofu | 1 egg white | 1/4 cup mayonnaise ( to taste ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 12 ounces spaghetti, cooked al dente and drained | 1/4 cup cognac ( or other brandy, sherry is okay ) | cognac or brandy, to taste
instructions: Cube the pork butt into approximately 1/2 inch cubes. In a bowl combine the soft pork with the egg white, mayonnaise, and vanilla. Mix together well and set aside. Combine three cups of cold water, the pasta, and the cognac into a saucer or bowl and put the mixture into a large saucer. Use a sturdy spoon or your hands to take small chunks of the pork mixture and roll them between your palms into uniform balls. Toss the balls in the cognac. Refrigerate for a few hours or overnight. After chilling, cook the pork balls over high heat in a large saute pan until they are browned on all sides. Remove the meatballs with a slotted spoon and put them into a bowl to cool, then set aside and save until serving time. Add the cream sauce to the pan used for the meatballs and bring to a simmer, then immediately reduce to a slow simmer. Add the meatballs back into the pan and return to the simmer. Adjust the seasonings to taste, cover with a lid, and continue to cook the sauce until the meatballs are tender.

Random Ingredients: mexican oregano,white wine,pepper sauce,scotch bonnet pepper,worcestershire sauce,berbere,cocoa
title: Chef John's Chayote (Huitlacoche)
ingredients: 2 bunches woody chayote ( or any combatively woody chayote ) | 2 -3 tablespoons red unsweetened cocoa | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon hot pepper sauce | 1 tablespoon dried mexican oregano | 1 tablespoon mexican oregano | 2 tablespoons dry white wine | 1 tablespoon sifted cocoa | 2 1/3 ounces unsweetened liqueur-optional ( like peris island ) ( optional ) | 1/8 teaspoon ground scotch bonnet peppers ( optional )
instructions: Wash the cleaned chayote, removing any woody ends. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Remove pan from heat and submerge chayote. Allow to sit for 10 to 15 minutes. Meanwhile, in a medium bowl whisk together the 2 1/3 cups cocoa, worcestershire sauce, chili powder, dried mexican oregano, mexican oregano, dry white wine and cocoa. Place the chayote in the hot water and cook until the chayote is al dente, about 6 to 8 minutes. Meanwhile, transfer chayote water to a large, deep pan and add the 1/8 teaspoon pepper sauce. Cook over moderately low heat until bubbling.

Random Ingredients: pork chop,ham,lemongrass,stewing beef,dark sesame oil,maraschino cherry,asafoetida powder
title: Lemongrass Pork Chop
ingredients: 1/2 lb sliced pork chop | 1/2 lb stewing beef | 1/2 teaspoon ground asafoetida powder or 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1 stalk lemongrass, cut into 6 thin slices, bottom 1 inch part sliced, bottom 2 inches | 2 cups fresh maraschino cherries, pitted and sliced | dried maraschino cherry, for garnish
instructions: In a small bowl, combine all ingredients except cherries and dry cherries. Add meat mixture and marinate overnight. Grill or broil the meat mixture about 10 minutes on each side for medium or until done.

title: Chickpea and Jalapeno Seasoning
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups canned chickpeas, rinsed and drained ( or rinsed and drained canned chickpeas ) | 1/4 teaspoon liquid smoke | 1 tablespoon pickled jalapeno chile, finely chopped ( or 1 tsp jalapeno powder if desired )
instructions: Open and rinse chickpeas. Mix chickpeas with liquid smoke and jalapeno. Store in a spice/seasoning container at room temperature for up to 2 days.

title: Kidney Bean Snack (Kidney Bean Snack)
ingredients: 4 large loaf brioche bread, crusts removed and cut in half | 3 cans kidney beans | 1 large red onion, minced | salt
instructions: Drain the beans, reserving a big pinch of the liquid. Place the onions in the bowl of a food processor fitted with the steel blade pulse a few times until very finely minced. Transfer the minced onions to a bowl, add the reserved bean liquid and mash the beans with a fork until fairly smooth. Transfer the mashed beans to a bowl and stir in the croutons. Salt to taste. Preheat the oven to 200 degrees f. Place the loaf of brioche in the oven for 20 minutes, or until toasted. Break the bread into 1 inch chunks and scoop out most of the bread. Stir each chunk back into the beans and bake for 20 more minutes. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: horseradish,vegetable oil,parsnip,cornflour,lipton onion soup mix,celery rib,fish fillet,orange
title: Faux Dill Fish
ingredients: 1 fish fillet | 1 packet lipton onion soup mix | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 1 onion, chopped | 1 celery rib, chopped | 1 -2 tablespoon horseradish, chopped | 2 teaspoons grated orange rind | vegetable oil ( for frying )
instructions: Preheat gas or 180°c/350°. Cut fillet into 5 inch cubes. Sprinkle fillettes with soup mix. Add cornflour, onion, celery and zest. Fry fish until golden brown. Drain. Serve with sauce. Dice of choice.

title: Creamy Cranberry and Black Olive Salad
ingredients: 1 package dried cranberries | 1 can sliced black olives | 1 tablespoon garam masala
instructions: In a large bowl, toss together the dried cranberries and sliced black olives. Dry roast the garam masala in a dry, dry skillet over medium low heat, stirring, until fragrant, about 2 minutes. Remove from the heat and stir in the garam masala. Let the dressing cool slightly. Stir in the cooked cranberry mixture.

title: Easy Baked Spicy Sausages
ingredients: 1/2 lb cooked sausage, cut into 1-inch pieces ( sweet or hot type ) | 1/2 lb ground veal | 1 jar coffee flavored liqueur | 1/2 cup dates, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Mix all ingredients. Grease 2 1/2 quart baking dish. Bake in preheated oven 45 minutes, or until well browned.

title: Quick and Easy Salisbury Steak
ingredients: 1 beef tenderloin | 1/2 cup red wine | 1/4 teaspoon hot sauce | 1/4 teaspoon lemon zest | 2 cloves fresh garlic, crushed and chopped | 4 ounces mushrooms, sliced | 1/2 teaspoon dried or fresh fenugreek | 1/4 teaspoon dried fenugreek
instructions: Remove tenderloin from a container. Rinse the tenderloin under cold water. Place in a glass bowl with wine, hot sauce, lemon peel, garlic, fenugreek, and vegetable oil. Allow to marinate at least 5 hours or overnight, turning on the grill to medium high heat before grilling. Grill steaks until a thermometer inserted into the center registers 140° for medium rare or 175° for medium, about 12 minutes a side. Serve.

title: Crunchy Oat Bran Muffins
ingredients: 200 g dried oat bran | 180 g oat bran | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 150 ml water | 150 ml buttermilk | 150 g cherry, quartered | 150 g dried apricot jam | 350 g farfalle pasta | 1 teaspoon oven roasted oat bran rounds ( toasted )
instructions: Preheat a large, non stick, lightly greased pan to medium heat. Place the oat bran and oat bran in a bowl and add the cream, tarragon and 100ml of water to make a liquid. Set aside and allow to sit for at least 15 minutes, or up to 2 hours time. In a large measuring jug, add your water, buttermilk, cherries, apricot jam and baking rolled oats. Stir well until the jam starts to melt. Stir in your oat bran then pour in the dry ingredients. Stir to combine, then cover with a wet, dry towel. Cook on a medium low heat for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, cook your pasta according to the directions on the packet. Drain, then transfer to a large, clean, dry baking tin. Spoon the warm pasta into the pan, spreading it evenly. Add 2 - 3 tablespoons of the cream from the jar, then spread over the pasta. If the pasta mixture looks dry, add more buttermilk and if it is too dry, add some more of the cream, then bake for 15 minutes. Allow to cool before serving.

title: Tortillas With Bean Dip
ingredients: 3 tortillas | 2 cups refried beans | 12 1/2 ounces canned diced refried beans | 1/2 cup corn oil
instructions: Heat a skillet to medium high heat, add corn oil. Add tortilla and fry until golden brown. Remove from skillet and place on paper towels. Spread 2 tbsp refried beans in the bottom of the tortilla. Spoon bean dip onto tortilla and spread evenly. Roll up tortilla with the two ends of the tortilla. Enjoy.

title: Beef Steak Sandwich
ingredients: 2 beef sirloin steaks, sliced | 2 tablespoons lettuce, shredded
instructions: Place each steak between sheets of waxed paper and pound to 1/4 inch thickness. Arrange on lettuce lined baking sheets and cover with waxed paper. Place in refrigerator. Turn often during this process to evenly coat steaks. Cut into 4 equal pieces. Brush lightly with marinade. Place on baking sheets. Bake in a 400 f. Oven for 15 minutes or until desired degree of doneness.

title: Seeded Tuna in Tomato
ingredients: 500 g plum tomatoes | 1 cucumber ( peeled and shredded ) | 1/2 teaspoon yeast ( i use an instant yeast ) | 200 g salted drained canned tuna ( drained )
instructions: Slice the tomatoes and cucumbers into about 12 wedges each. Drain the tuna and put it in a bowl. Sprinkle the yeast over the tuna. Place the tomatoes and cucumber on your hands and sprinkle a little salt and dried up yeast over the tomatoes then knead until the dough is elastic. Place it in a greased bowl, cover and leave it to prove for about half an hour to develop the gluten in the tuna. Pre heat the oven to 200 degrees c, 400 degrees f, gas mark 6 and grease a baking tin with olive oil. Roll out the dough to about 1/4 inch thick and spread out to the edges. Using your hands or scissors, stretch it around to make a round shape about an inch in diameter. Put it on your prepared baking tin, cover it and leave to rise in a warm place for about 30 minutes. Sprinkle the remaining yeast over the tomatoes and cucumber and bake in the over for 10 to 15 minutes or until the dough has risen and is crispy and golden. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: pork loin roast,self rising flour,mexican chocolate
title: Coco's Pork Loin
ingredients: 1 boneless pork loin roast | 2 ounces mexican's chocolate | 2 1/2 cups self-rising flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place pork loin roast in a roasting pan. Rub chocolate in the roasting pan, and sprinkle on top of the pork. Bake for 45 minutes in the preheated oven.

title: Bazakh Spice Mix
ingredients: 2 cups sugar | 4 tablespoons dutch-processed cocoa, sifted | 1 teaspoon whole cloves or 1 teaspoon ground cloves | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 1 teaspoon cocoa | 1 bottle maple syrup or ( 16 ounce ) bottle tamarind syrup | extra sugar ( optional ) or cocoa ( optional )
instructions: Heat sugar in 2 cups of water until it reaches 1/4 to 1/3 a cup, or reach a low boil. Add cocoa, cloves, and asafoetida and cook 2 minutes to blend. Remove from heat and let cool completely. Stir in cocoa, syrup and extra sugar or cocoa. Store in an air tight container.

title: Spicy German Potato Chips #5FIX
ingredients: 1 bag red potatoes, scrubbed and crisped | 3/4 cup ketchup | 1 teaspoon onion salt | 6 vegetarian burger rolls
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. In a medium bowl, combine the potatoes with the ketchup and seasoning. Arrange the potatoes on a baking sheet. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, or until golden. Allow to cool before removing from the cookie sheet.

Random Ingredients: green onion,seasoning salt,serrano chilies,beef tenderloin,flour,artichoke heart,cheddar cheese
title: Beef and Artichokes Au Gratin
ingredients: 10 ounces beef tenderloin | 4 ounces fresh artichoke hearts | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 teaspoon flour | 1/2 teaspoon chopped green onion | 16 ounces shredded cheddar cheese | 2 tablespoons minced serrano chilies
instructions: Preheat oven to broil. Thinly slice tenderloin. Drain. Cover with foil and lightly salt beef slices. Broil 3 minutes or until meat thermometer inserted in center registers 140° for rare, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat, slice into thin 1/4 inch slices. While beef slices are broiling, make béchamel sauce, stir together sour cream, seasoning salt and flour. Gradually stir in onion, cheddar cheese and chilies. Spread over heated beef slices. Place under broiler 3 to 4 minutes or until bubbly. Serve beef and béchamel sauce.

Random Ingredients: basil leaf,baking powder,corn oil,teriyaki marinade,chive,vanilla pudding mix
title: Spaghetti Sauce (Teriyaki)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons corn oil | 3/4 cup teriyaki marinade | 2 2 tablespoons dried chives or 2 tablespoons green onions, minced | 5 cups packed chopped fresh basil leaves ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1 box instant vanilla pudding mix ( i use betty crocker's sugar islands sweet island easy dessert )
instructions: Combine oil, teriyaki and chili peppers together in a small saucepan. Heat on medium until very hot and bring to full boil. Allow to boil for 5 minutes and add basil and pudding mix. Cook 7 minutes on very low. Serve over cooked spaghetti and enjoy i use this as a side dish with other dishes i am taking on the weekend with a salad of red meat and pasta and i like to serve this all at once.

title: Veggies Salad
ingredients: 1 bag salad greens | 1 bag baby carrots | 1/2 - 1 cup raisins
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. While water is coming to a boil put in bag of greens and carrots. As soon as they are about 4 - 6 inches from the boiling water dump them out with a slotted spoon into cold water and let sit for 5 minutes. Slip them into cold water, drain and set aside. When water is done remove bag of greens and cut into 2 - 3 inch lengths. Toss in bowl with carrots and raisins. Toss until just mixed.

title: Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 2 packages wonton skins | 1 head lettuce
instructions: Heat the oven to 250°f. Spread a few wonton leaves on the inside of a bun,. Place a lettuce leaf on top of the wonton and roll into a cylinder. Repeat until all won tons are wrapped up. Place on a baking pan in one layer. Bake, flipping halfway through, for 15 minutes or until golden. Cool on foil.

title: How to Sprout Spinach (Greens Cooker)
ingredients:
1 lb fresh spinach ( coarse stems picked, about 4 cups.
    - ) | spices, for sprouting ( optional )
instructions: Using a regular rice cooker, place the first 5 ingredients in the bottom of your cooker. Push the button to rinse the spinach into the pan, then press the sprouts as shown above. Continue to push as many as you can. Continue until the rice cooker serves the time specified on your machine's specifications, or you have used all 5 ingredients from the cooked spinach. If using extras, serve on top of vegetables or fresh bread.

title: Greek-Style Cheddar
ingredients: 1/2 lb old cheddar cheese | 1 teaspoon dried oregano or 1 teaspoon dried mint | 1/2 teaspoon dried lavender | 1 tablespoon sherry wine
instructions: Cut the cheese into 1/4 inch cubes and mix with the seasoning ingredients. Melt the butter in a small skillet over medium heat. When it's slightly bubbly, add the cheese and shake until it's thoroughly melted and the cheese is completely evenly distributed. Sprinkle the sherry over the cheese and stir until melted. Serve at once.

title: Brandy Saganaki
ingredients: 1 cup crumbled feta cheese, packed | 1 cup unsweetened cocoa | 1 1/2 tablespoons brandy | 2 cloves garlic, sliced thin | 1 tablespoon finely grated lemon peel | 1 teaspoon wondra flour | 16 slices soft white bread | 3 tablespoons clarified butter
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a medium bowl, mix the feta cheese, unsweetened cocoa, brandy, garlic, lemon peel, and flour. Place 3 slices of bread on the prepared baking sheet. Top with the herbed feta cheese mixture. Repeat with remaining bread slices. If using a non stick pan, heat butter and clarified butter in the pan. Place the sandwiches in the pan and cook 20 to 25 minutes or until lightly browned and slightly crisp.

title: Noodle Salad from Noodle Cakes
ingredients: 2 packages egg noodles, cooked | 1/2 cup sugar
instructions: Combine the noodles and sugar. Let stand for ten minutes.

title: Whole Wheat Chocolate Crisp
ingredients: 3 tablespoons cocoa | 3 ounces whole wheat pastry flour
instructions: Preheat the oven to 170°c. Line a 2 - 3 tins with baking paper. Stir the cocoa and flour together in a bowl. Place a heaped teaspoonful of the cocoa mixture into the dry ingredients and roll dough into a roll about 5 cm thick. Place on the prepared paper, cut side down, and roll out further sugar if necessary. Repeat this process for all the cookies. When all the cookies have been rolled out, use a little cold water to grease the tin. Bake for 15 - 20 mins, or until very light gold brown. Allow to cool completely on a wire rack.

title: Quinoa Pork Tenderloins
ingredients: 2 teaspoons cumin seeds | 1 pork tenderloin, trimmed | 2 tablespoons quinoa, plus more for sprinkling
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Spread the cumin seeds on a baking sheet, and place in the oven for 30 minutes, until fragrant and lightly browned. Grind the cumin seeds in a mortar and pestle. Cut the pork tenderloins lengthwise into thin half moons, and rub the pork with the cumin seeds. Sprinkle the quinoa over the pork and bake for 15 minutes. Remove from oven, and scatter with water, cover, and let sit 15 minutes before slicing.

title: Pancetta for the BBQ or Grill
ingredients: 1 ham hock | 1 pint dark rum | 12 sun-dried tomatoes | 2 ounces fresh tea ( or 2 tsp dried )
instructions: Put ham hock and rum into a casserole dish. Cover with tin foil. Slice sun dried tomatoes into thin strips. Pour rum over, then leave overnight to marinate. The next day remove hock from casserole. Skim marinade from casserole and keep warm. Place casserole with rum on a grill, then leave to cook the ham slowly over the coals, turning regularly until it is nicely browned. Add the reserved marinade to the casserole and continue cooking until it has reduced to a syrupy consistency. Remove from grill and let stand for a few minutes before serving with freshly steamed greens.

Random Ingredients: lemon extract,hoisin sauce,salad oil,kosher salt,camembert cheese,farfalle pasta,tart apple
title: Farfalle With Apples, Honey-Apple Crust
ingredients: 3 ounces farfalle pasta or 3 ounces other slender tubular pasta | 3 ounces tart apples, such as fuji, such as fuji | 1 tablespoon salad oil | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon lemon extract | 2 ounces herbed hoisin sauce | 1 pinch kosher salt or 1 pinch table salt | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon finely chopped or slivered toasted hazelnuts or 1/2-1 teaspoon slivered toasted slivered almonds, toasted
instructions: Cook the pasta in a medium pot of boiling salted water until al dente. Meanwhile to make the sauce, combine the apple, oil, lemon extract, herbed hoisin sauce, salt, and 1/4 cup water in a medium saucepan with a lid. Cook over moderate heat, stirring, until the sauce glistens about 6 to 8 minutes. Drain the pasta and toss with half the sauce.

title: Italian Chicken and Fusilli Bake
ingredients: 1 small roasting chicken, about 3 pounds | 3 cups hot cooked fusilli | 1 can refried beans with mixed sprouts | 1 jar guacamole, with pimento | 1 1/2 cups arborio rice, uncooked
instructions: Pound chicken with flat side of mallet to 1/8 inch thickness. Place in 13x9 inch oven proof baking dish and spread with beans. Bake at 400°f for 45 to 50 minutes. Meanwhile, heat refried beans with pimento in saucepan over medium heat, stirring occasionally. Remove chicken from pan and arrange over beans. Bake an additional 20 minutes. Turn over bones, spoon bean mixture over chicken and bake for an additional 20 minutes or until chicken is cooked through. Meanwhile, prepare rice as package directs. Cool slightly before serving. When rice is done, place over beans in baking dish and top with cooked chicken.

title: Chicken and Potato
ingredients: 3 1/4 lbs baking potatoes, peeled | 2 lbs meat, chicken, and veal | dried stuffing vegetables ( your choice ) or fresh vegetables ( your choice ) | cottage cheese
instructions: Pre heat the oven on 425 deg f/180 deg celsius. Cut potatoes into 6 wedges each. Put 1/2 of the potato wedges into a roasting tin and roast in the oven for about 45 min. Then turn the oven down on 180 deg celsius to roast the veg for 45 min or so. This should be golden brown and firm. While the veg is roasting, put everything into a roasting pan and fry in a pan or frying pan. When the veg is cooked, drain the veg and put into a bowl, put on the roast pan and mix it around in the pan. Put the rest of ingredients, except the salad, in the pot, mix well and put on the lid at this stage and simmer to let the flavours meld, about 1 hr or so, stirring frequently. When you want to serve it, place the salad on a large platter, then spoon the soup through it, serve with the celery.

title: Florentine White Wine
ingredients: 3 lbs fresh spinach, washed ( or fresh baby spinach variety ) | 2/3 cup cognac ( good quality )
instructions: Wash and pick the spinach thoroughly, removing the stalks/stalstalstalstalstalstalstalstalstalstalstalstalstalstals on the spinach leaves. If the stems/stalstalstalstalstalstals are long, blanch in boiling water, rinse and drain well. If the stems/stalstalstalstalstalstals are small, blanch on a hot griddle pan, toast under the grated flame about 1/4 inch in depth until the skin turns translucent but the fragrance is still released, then place in an airtight container or plastic bag overnight. Pour the cognac over the spinach leaves and mix well. Serve on the side of hot breakfast, dessert, or with a meat dish or as a light meal.

Random Ingredients: rye flour,mace,serrano chili,green cardamom pod,ranch bean,pork steak,chinese five spice powder
title: Chinese Five-Spice Pork Steaks with Soybean (Kao Choy)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chinese five spice powder, divided | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 1 lb boneless pork steak, 1/4 thick | 2 teaspoons rye flour | 1 serrano chili, finely chopped | 1 can ranch style beans, drained | 1/3 cup soy sauce
instructions: Sprinkle each piece of pork with 1/2 t. Spice powder, mace and 1/2 t. Butter. Mix together the flour and 1/4 tsp. Chili powder. Dredge each piece of pork in flour mixture and let rest. Brown pork on all sides in a nonstick skillet, remove and put on paper towel. Saute chili until fragrant and brown, and remove chili. Add the beans and soy and bring to boil. Return pork to skillet and cook 3 minutes, adding more butter to pan if needed. Serve.

Random Ingredients: pineapple tidbit,grain white rice,vanilla pod,golden syrup,tortilla chip,ranch bean
title: Rice, Bean and Pineapple Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup long grain white rice | 1/3 cup fat-free ranch beans, drained well | 1/3 cup canned pineapple tidbits, rinsed and drained well | 1/2 cup golden syrup ( i use karo ) | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla pod | 1/4 cup crushed tortilla chips | 1 can low-fat crushed pineapple tidbits
instructions: In a bowl combine the rice, beans, pineapple wine, golden syrup & vanilla pod. Pour over the rice & allow to soak for 30 minutes. Toss lightly & serve as is or with tortilla chips.

title: Sautéed Okra and Spinach (Citrus)
ingredients: 1 kg okra | 250 g fresh spinach | 1/3 cup caster sugar | 375 g fresh apricots
instructions: Wash okra and dry them lightly. Cut the okra into about 5 cm pieces and chop up the spinach coarsely. Cut stems out from okra. Slice okra finely. Place all ingredients in a large bowl and stir it together with a wooden spoon. The idea is to strike a pattern and take some hints of the mixture into the bowl and let it stick. It really needs patience. When it's all in the bowl stir it again and continue to stir frequently until all ingredients are coated in the mixture and the okra starts to wilt,. Serve immediately from a jar in a decorative container.

title: Easy Tiramisu
ingredients: 2 packages ladyfingers | 1 jar pasta, any flavor
instructions: Prepare your angel food cake and prepare according to package directions. When cake is cooked, layer on the following order, lady fingers, 1 cup cooked pasta, and 2 - 3 tablespoons of prepared angel food. Place in freezer for 6 hours. After 6 hours, remove from freezer and finish chilling for 2 hours. When serving, remove from freezer, take out a portion of the angel food. Arrange on a serving plate and sprinkle with additional angel food. Serve with a fresh fruit.

title: Golden Syrup-Glazed Guajillo Chilies
ingredients: 4 large guajillo chilies | 1/4 cup golden syrup | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar
instructions: Roast the chiles on the grill pan under the broiler until blackened on all sides, about 2 - 5 minutes. Transfer them to a plastic bag and seal tightly. Refrigerate until cooled, about 2 1/2 hours. Remove the stems and seeds from the chiles and cut them into slices 1/4 thick. Strain the chiles and reserve. In a small saucepan, stir together the golden syrup and brown sugar. Bring to a boil and then reduce heat to low and simmer about 5 minutes. Pour the glazed chiles into a shallow nonreactive casserole dish and bake, uncovered, until heated through, about 30 minutes. Cool slightly and serve.

title: Tunisian Lentil and Apple Stew
