ingredients: 8 granny smith apples, peeled and sliced | 1 1/2 cups dried lentils ( masoor dal )
instructions: Place apples in a saucepan, cover with enough water to cover, and bring to a boil. Boil for 3 minutes. Add lentils to apple mixture in pan. Reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer for 30 minutes.

title: Easy Chicken or Beef Gravy (Quick and Easy)
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 dash marjoram
instructions: Empty soup can into a sauce pan. Open the can. Dump contents of sauce pan in with the soup can. Stir contents until it is all coated, but not too wet. Turn heat up to medium high. Cook for several minutes until thickened.

title: Curried Eggplant
ingredients: 2 medium eggplants, cut into 1 inch slices | 1 1/2 tablespoons curry powder | 1 package white mushrooms, sliced | 1 package dry marshmallows, chopped
instructions: In a large skillet, heat the curry powder over medium heat until fragrant but not boiling. Sprinkle the slices of eggplant with the curry powder, and cook until it begins to soften. Stir in the mushrooms and cook for 2 minutes. Stir in the marshmallows just before removing from the heat.

title: Noodle Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs ground beef | 1 lb noodles | 1 lb yellow onion | 1/2 cup celery | 2 tablespoons coriander
instructions: Brown ground beef till done. Drain water off the noodles. Cook noodles until done. Mix beef& other seasonings into the cooked noodles. Put in shallow baking pan. Bake at 250 degrees for 1 hour. Serve with your favorite green vegetables or meat sauce.

Random Ingredients: shallot,dark rum,red beet,salmon,white chocolate,red chili pepper,leek
title: Smoked Salmon and Vegetables With White Chocolate
ingredients: 200 g red beets, sliced | 200 g red beetroots, sliced | 150 g smoked salmon, sliced | 100 g white chocolate | 1 leek, white part only, sliced | 2 shallots, sliced | 2 tablespoons dark rum
instructions: Toast the white chocolate. Heat a non stick pan on high. Add 1 tablespoon of white chocolate, a couple of slices of smoked salmon and a slice of leek. Cook for about 1 minute, stir and then leave to set for about 30 seconds add the vegetables, return to low heat and mix well. Melt remaining white chocolate until melted and set aside. Heat the second tablespoon of white chocolate and a splash of rum over a pan.

title: Simple Chicken Legs and Tomatoes
ingredients: 4 chicken legs | 8 plum tomatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Place your chicken legs in a baking dish. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes in the preheated oven, until slightly brown on the skin. Remove the chicken legs and tomato tops from the oven and turn over the legs to the other side. Return the baking dish to the oven and bake for one hour, or until the chicken is tender.

title: Tasteeful Mascarpone Applesauce
ingredients: 18 lbs mascarpone cheese, room temperature | 4 lbs golden delicious apples, such as granny smith | 1 1/2 tablespoons seasoning salt
instructions: In electric mixer fitted with medium size scale, combine all ingredients. Mix well. Cover and refrigerate several hours or over night. Turn out into bowl sized platter. Serve with crackers or crusty french bread. Mascarpone mascarpone may be frozen or leftovers will be great for a week or two.

Random Ingredients: chicken leg,cumin seed,basil leaf,rigatoni pasta,sesame seed,puff pastry,spinach,celery seed
title: Spinach and Chicken Legs on Sesame-Cumin Pastry Toss
ingredients: 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1 teaspoon celery seed | 2 teaspoons sesame seeds | 1 cup fresh spinach, coarse chopped | 2 tablespoons fresh basil leaves chopped | 1 medium roasted chicken leg, from breast cut into bite-size pieces ( or equivalent ) | 8 sheets frozen reduced-fat puff pastry, thawed, with the ends on | 14 ounces rigatoni pasta
instructions: Preheat oven to 375f degrees. Combine cumin, celery, sesame seeds, spinach, and basil in a large bowl.

title: Mango Pomegranate Salsa
ingredients: 1 large pomegranate, washed, stems removed, and seeds discarded | 1 medium mango, peeled and cut into small pieces ( about 1 pound ) | 1/2 cup finely diced red onion | 1 tablespoon toasted cumin seeds
instructions: Combine the pomegranate, mango, onion, and cumin in a bowl, and toss.

Random Ingredients: white pepper,bow tie pasta,white hominy,marshmallow,cherry tomato
title: Cherry Tomato Bow Tie Soup
ingredients: 1 lb bow tie pasta | 6 cups dried white hominy | 2 cans white hominy, rinsed and drained | 1 package miniature marshmallows | white pepper
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions omitting salt and fat. Drain and return to pan. Meanwhile, combine hominy, white hominy and marshmallows in large pot. Bring to boil.

title: Irish Relish
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups hot water | 4 cups water, reserved from boiling the currants for use in recipe ( or use leftover stock from another recipe ) | 1/2 cup currants ( optional )
instructions: In a large bowl or large glass bowl, stir together 4 cups of the hot water and the currants. Stir in the remaining hot water until the currants have soaked up the water. Use the reserved hot water to dilute the currant mixture or use as desired. Enjoy.

title: Green Clam Chowder
ingredients: 1 gallon watermelon, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 can sliced clams, drained | 1 gallon water
instructions: Combine 1 gallon watermelon, clams, and 1 pound of dry grits in a large stockpot, mix thoroughly. Fill in canning glasses with water. Bring to a boil over medium high heat, then reduce heat and simmer for 1 hour. Ladle into bowls and serve warm.

title: Cheats Gumbo
ingredients: 1 lb large shrimp ( peeled ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons turmeric or 4 teaspoons salt | 1/2 teaspoon allspice | 1/8 teaspoon dried breadcrumbs | 1/8 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon | 1/8 teaspoon celery rib ( optional ) | 100 -300 g fresh button mushrooms ( cleaned )
instructions: Shell shrimp.

title: Sausage and Cabbage
ingredients: 1 head cabbage | 2 teaspoons oregano
instructions: Grate cabbage and place in a large, deep pan large enough to hold all ingredients. Sprinkle liberally with oregano, being careful not to get it on the cabbage. Reduce heat to a low simmer, and leave to cook approximately 1 hour or until the cabbage is very tender. Sausages and cabbage can be eaten, or can be cooked to your liking.

title: French Bread With Turnips
ingredients: 2 lbs ripe great northern beans or 2 lbs yellow turnips, peeled and thinly sliced crosswise | 1/2 teaspoon brandy or 1/2 teaspoon rum | 1 loaf french bread, loafs trimmed
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Place sliced fresh sweet potatoes in a 9x13 baking dish that has been sprayed with non stick cooking spray. Cover tightly with foil. Bake 45 minutes or until tender when pierced with a fork. Meanwhile, place beans in a large pot. Cover with 8 cups cold water. Bring to boil.

title: Delicious Mambo Meatballs
ingredients: 2 packages pizza dough | 1 cup chopped peanuts | 1 package instant vanilla pudding mix | 1 container meatballs | 1 teaspoon vanilla flavored pudding powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Roll out Pizza dough to 1/8 inch thickness. Spread half the peanut and vanilla pudding on both baking sheets. Cover with meatballs, leaving 1 inch of space on each. Sprinkle with the other half of the peanut and vanilla pudding mix. Bake at 350 degrees f for 45 minutes, or until golden.

Random Ingredients: pork butt,half cream,pineapple,hard egg,apple juice,pot roast
title: Pork and Apple Casserole
ingredients: 1/2 kg pork butt, trimmed | 4 large hard-boiled eggs, finely chopped | 100 g pineapple slices, drained and sliced | 1/2 cup potato roast, cubed | 500 ml apple juice | 1 liter half-and-half cream, whipped
instructions: Mix together the pork fat, egg, pineapple and potato. Spread the mixture evenly in the bottom of a casserole dish. Drizzle the apple juice over the mixture. Bake at 150c/375f for 2 hours or until the cassava and meat are tender.

Random Ingredients: green chilies,marsala wine,basmati rice,celery salt,cilantro leaf
title: Chile Verde
ingredients: 2 cups basmati rice | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 2 cans chopped green chilies | 1/2 cup dry marsala wine or 1/2 cup dry red wine | 1/2 teaspoon celery salt
instructions: Combine everything in crockpot. Cook on low for 6 to 8 hours.

title: Apple and Black-Eyed Pea Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 3 tablespoons chopped tart apples | 2/3 cup canned black-eyed peas, drained | 1 cinnamon stick
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine mayonnaise, apples and peas. Place in refrigerator 15 minutes. Remove the cinnamon stick. Serve warm.

title: Rendering New York Strip Beef
ingredients: 10 lbs fresh beef tenderloin | 1 can red lentils | 1 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin
instructions: Trim the fresh beef and any excess fat.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,lite olive oil,thai chili sauce,american cheese
title: American-Style American Cheese With Chili Sauce
ingredients: 12 white american cheese | 4 teaspoons lite olive oil | 2 tablespoons thai sweet chili sauce | salt and pepper
instructions: Pre heat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Using a round bladed glass spread the cheese on a piece of parchment paper until completely coated. Using the paper cut on cheese to fit and smooth out the edge with a small knife make little indentations about 1/2 inch deep in the cheese. Brush the cheese with one teaspoon olive oil with a little bit of water and then spread the chili sauce on the top of the cheese. Then sprinkle with salt and pepper. Cook for about 3 minutes and when cheese is golden brown it's done.

title: Smoked Cod and Orzo Wraps
ingredients: 3/4 lb smoked cod | 1 can kidney beans, drained | 1 cup uncooked orzo pasta | 1/2 cup mascarpone or 1/2 cup ricotta cheese | 1 bag shredded cabbage | shredded maraschino cherry | shredded tortilla
instructions: Cook orzo as per directions. Drain. Cut smoked cod into chunks with scissors, removing the bones. Saute cod and kidney beans in a small amount of olive oil until cooked, about 5 minutes. Stir in orzo. Mix with ricotta. Place about 1/4 cup of mixture on each tortilla, wrap and place wraps in foil lined baking pan to keep warm. Repeat with remaining mixture. Serve warm. Garnish with shredded cheese, cherries and tortillas.

title: Green Chillies
ingredients: 4 cups self rising flour | 4 teaspoons dried lovage, or 1 teaspoon dried lovage flowers | 1/2 teaspoon dried green chili | 1/2 teaspoon honey or 1/2 teaspoon sugar
instructions: Place flour, lovage and chille flakes in a large mixing bowl. Make a well in the center, sprinkle in sugar and honey mix well. Stir to incorporate and knead until dough is just right. Cover with a bowl and leave to rest 1 hour. Divide dough into 6 portions. Roll each between greaseproof paper and flatten into a circle. Wrap with plastic and leave for 15 minutes. Preheat oven to 200c. Bake for 12 - 15 minutes until light golden. Leave on baking paper covered tray for 3 minutes until they are just cool.

Random Ingredients: soymilk,pita bread,fine breadcrumb,cocktail mix,hot dog,chive,pineapple chunk,garam masala
title: Tropical Hot Dogs
ingredients: 2 cups hot dogs, sliced | 1 cup imitation crabmeat, flaked | 3/4 cup low-fat soymilk ( or can use full-fat milk ) | 1 -2 teaspoon garam masala | 1/3 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 1/4 cup pineapples or 1/4 cup strawberry | 1/4 cup chives | pita bread, for serving
instructions: Combine hot dogs, crab, milk, pinches of garam masala, and bread crumbs in a bowl, add a little more coconut milk if desired. Heat skillet, add oil and fry hot dogs until no longer pink inside. Arrange onto heated platter and keep warm. Spoon sauce over hot dogs and decorate with pineapples or strawberries. Serve with pita bread.

title: Green Curry Breakfast Burritos
ingredients: 1 packet refrigerated cheese dinner rolls | 3 tablespoons green curry paste ( or more to taste, i use jalapenos ) | 5 tortillas ( i use fat free or fat-free )
instructions: Spray large fry pan with cooking spray. Put a generous amount in the fry pan. Sprinkle curry paste on top. Slice rolls in half, and place in frypan, cook on low for 3 - 4 minutes until cheese is melted and starting to brown. To serve with the wrap, place 1/4 of the cheese mixture in center of a tortilla and fold. Serve hot with green mango dip.

title: Curried Ricotta(Malfatti)
ingredients: 3/4 cup whole milk ricotta cheese | 3 tablespoons mild curry paste ( to taste ) | 1 tablespoon olive oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. In a large bowl, mix together the ricotta, curry and the olive oil. Spread evenly in an 11x7x2 inch baking dish. Bake in preheated oven for 45 - 50 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Simple Penne Pasta
ingredients: 8 ounces penne pasta | simple syrup, or as needed, to taste
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Stir in penne pasta and return to boil. Cook uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through but is still slightly firm to the bite, about 11 minutes. Drain well and return to pan. Add as much simple syrup as desired to taste.

title: Fried Chile Scrambled Eggs
ingredients: 4 large anaheim chilies | 10 black peppercorns | 4 large egg whites
instructions: Using clean chilies, slit open the seeds slightly. Heat one side of a skillet over medium heat and lightly fry chilies until blackened with black bits, and softened, about three minutes. Place pepperoncini peppers in a bowl and cover with boiling water. Let sit 3 minutes, then drain and rinse chilies. In another bowl, beat egg whites until frothy. Stir in chilies. Spray broiler pan with cooking spray and add chilies. Broil for 2 - 2 minutes or until the tops turn light brown.

Random Ingredients: couscous,lemon peel,pasilla pepper,active yeast,celery,fish,fruit,egg beater substitute
title: Faux-Loading and Easy Tropical Stuffed Peppers (Vegies)
ingredients: 1 packet active dry yeast | 1/3 cup dried fruit | 1/3 cup fat free egg substitute | 2 cups couscous, cooked and cooled | 4 large sweet pasilla peppers, cleaned, stems removed, peppers sliced lengthwise and seeded | 1 cup chopped celery | 1/4 cup chopped candied lemon peel | 3 tablespoons fish or 3 tablespoons soy sauce
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/3 cup warm water. Beat egg substitute with 1 cup warm water in a small bowl till fluffy. Add the spices and spices, except masarepa and simmer for 5 minutes. Drain peppers in a sieve, reserving cooking water, and set aside. Fold peppers, basil, lemon peel, and fish or soy sauce into yeast mixture. Add enough reserved cooking liquid to make a wet dough. Cover dough and set aside for 45 minutes. Divide dough in half and roll into 2 long patties. Arrange on baking sheets, sprayed with cooking spray, and allow to rise till puffy. Bake at 350 for 20 minute and serve.

title: Spanish Rice Stuffed Pork Tenderloins
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs pork tenderloin | 1/2 cup short-grain converted rice | 1/2 cup chopped fresh citrus peel, such as citrus zest | 3/4 cup chopped cucumber | 3/4 cup drained drained quartered drained bottled roasted sweetened citron
instructions: Place pork tenderloins between 2 sheets waxed paper and pound to 5/8 inch thickness. Place rice in a shallow dish or bowl. Add citrus peel, cucumbers, and pork. Gently coat meat with rice. Wrap meat tightly with plastic and refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours. Preheat grill. When ready to cook, remove pork from marinade. Discard marinade. Lightly oil grill rack and arrange meat on it. Cook, turning once, for 6 minutes on each side or until meat thermometer registers 160 degrees f. Remove pork from grill and stand 10 minutes before cutting into 1/4 inch slices.

title: Tunisian Tofu Fettuccine
ingredients: 1/4 cup dried fettuccine pasta | 2 plantains, peeled and very thinly sliced | 1 1/4 cups canned chicken stock | 1 tablespoon dried dill, or more to taste
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the fettuccine and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 11 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink and transfer to a bowl. Sprinkle plantains over the pasta and toss to combine. Pour chicken stock over the pasta mixture and toss to combine. Pour the fettuccine pasta into a large serving bowl and toss with dill. Serve hot, warm, or chilled.

Random Ingredients: herb,serrano pepper,vanilla sugar,large shrimp,paprika,triple sec,tomato sauce
title: Vanilla Rum Prawns
ingredients: 1 kg large shrimp, shelled | 500 ml tomato sauce | 150 g tri-colored serrano peppers | 1 cup chopped herbs | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla sugar | 1/2 teaspoon paprika | 1/2 teaspoon triple sec
instructions: Make the rum sauce by combining everything and chill. Add the shrimp, chill for 30 - 45 minutes. Cook in a pan, add rum. Serve with jiaozas.

Random Ingredients: purpose flour,banana,white vinegar,kidney bean,red wine vinegar,tilapia fillet,zucchini,strawberry
title: Fish Taco Shells & Fruit
ingredients: 4 tilapia fillets | 15 -20 fresh strawberries | 1 medium zucchini | 1 can kidney beans ( drained and rinsed ) | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 12 tablespoons white vinegar | 4 ounces red wine tomatoes | 1/3 cup all-purpose flour
instructions: In food processor mix the first six ingredients. Dredge fish in flour. Add in beans and tomatoes. Spray pan with pam cooking spray. Pour into pan. Cover and cook in a 350 degree oven for 30 - 40 minutes.

title: Oyster Sauce and Roasted Tomato Pickles (Shirazi)
ingredients: 2 lbs ripe tomatoes ( see note ) | 8 jars ouzo | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1 teaspoon dry mustard | 1 teaspoon salt
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f. Drain the tomatoes, reserving juice. Cut them in half vertically. Put tomatoes in a 9x13 inch casserole, layer with the ouzo and tomato soup, stirring until almost dry. Combine the mustard, and salt well. Dribble over tomatoes. Roast, covered, for one hour. Stir, and continue to roast, stirring every 45 minutes or so, until tomatoes are very tender. If the sauce is too thick, add a little water.

title: Banana Bread - Baked Italian Style
ingredients: 6 large bananas, cut lengthwise into 1-inch slices | 6 slices whole grain bread ( not crusty or pumpernickel bread ) | 2 tablespoons honey | 2 tablespoons soda water, chilled | 1 cup shaved lemon peel or 1 cup shredded lemon | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning | 2 teaspoons peppercorns, cracked
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Spray a 10 1/2 x 1 3/4 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Arrange the bananas in a single layer on the baking dish and invert the bananas so that the slices are overlapping. Combine the honey, beverage water, lemon peel, italian seasoning, and peppercorns in a bowl. Pour half the honey mixture over the bananas. Cover the dish tightly with foil and bake for 40 minutes, until the bananas are very soft and starting to darken. Let the bananas sit for 15 minutes before removing from the oven to serving dish. Serve right away.

Random Ingredients: taco sauce,pork,lemon juice zest,taco seasoning mix,icing sugar,pepperoni,serrano chili,potato
title: Pork Empanadas
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs pork, cut into cubes | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 3/4 cup taco sauce | 3 -4 cups leftover mashed potatoes | 1 tablespoon grated lemon juice or 1 tablespoon lime zest | 1/2 cup extra-virgin olive oil or 1/2 cup butter, plus | 2 teaspoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 1/2 cups finely chopped pepperoni | 1 1/2 - 2 serrano chili, seeded, deveined and minced | 1/2 cup icing sugar
instructions: Heat 1 teaspoon oil in frypan. Add chicken, pork, taco seasoning and 1/2 cup water. Cover and cook, covered, over medium heat until meat is cooked through, about 3 to 4 minutes. Drain and cool. Add potatoes and 1 1/2 cups water to meat and mix. Remove 1 1/2 cups potato mixture and set aside. Mash remaining potato with 2 1/2 cups water and lemon or lime juice and heat in a skillet over med high.

title: Bourbon Marinade for Pork Steak
ingredients: 1/2 cup bourbon | 1 -2 tablespoon cumin seed | 2 tablespoons bourbon ( optional )
instructions: In your glass or plastic dish, add the bourbon and cumin seeds and stir well. Add the pork steaks and marinate 2 - 24 hours before grilling. Bourbon will keep several weeks in the refrigerator. Grilling will take longer.

title: Chinese Mushrooms
ingredients: 5 ounces chinese mushrooms, finely chopped | 1/2 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 1 1/2 teaspoons orange rind | 4 ounces beer
instructions: Put the breadcrumbs and oil in a plate and mix them together. Add the mushroom, orange rind and the beer to the breadcrumb and mix. Dip mushrooms into the crumb mix and fry in oil at moderate heat until golden brown and tender.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,cumin,bulgur wheat,mushroom,mango,rom tomato
title: Tabbouleh
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups bulgur wheat, uncooked | 4 roma tomatoes, seeded and diced | 1 cup mango ( peeled and diced ) | 8 ounces mushrooms ( sliced and cooked ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Boil water in non stick saucepan. Add bulgur wheat and a pinch of salt. Cook according to package directions. Meanwhile, heat a small nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add the tomatoes, mango, mushrooms, cumin and oil. Saute about 2 - 4 minutes. Remove from the heat. Serve. Extra virgin olive oil, if desired, may be added when serving.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock,vanilla sugar,asiago cheese,serrano pepper,heavy whipping cream
title: Asiago Cheese Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 6 serrano peppers | 4 cups chicken stock | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 4 fresh grated asiago cheese
instructions: Heat the olive oil over moderately high heat in a medium saucepan. Sear the peppers one at a time for about 5 minutes. Add to the saucepan the stock and a pinch of salt. Cook the sauce for 15 minutes, or until reduced to a thick sauce. Add the cream and cook the sauce over high heat for a few minutes to reduce slightly. Transfer the sauce to a blender or food processor. Add the asiago and blend until creamy.

Random Ingredients: milk ricotta cheese,swiss cheese,oregano leaf,red bell pepper,pork roast,tortilla,feta cheese
title: Greek Inspired Queso Dip
ingredients: 2 lbs pork roast ( from two boneless pork loin steaks ) | 1 container whole milk ricotta cheese | 1 1/2 cups shredded swiss cheese | 1/4 cup crumbled feta cheese | 1 tablespoon dried oregano leaves | 1 large red bell pepper ( about 2 ounces ) | 14 tortillas | 2 tablespoons canned evaporated milk or 2 tablespoons whole milk
instructions: Put pork into crockpot, and set the cooker to high. Sprinkle with salt. Put in ricotta and 1 cup swiss on top of pork.

title: Horseradish Paste
ingredients: 2 tablespoons bottled horseradish | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 2/3 cup bread flour | 1/4 teaspoon ground ginger | 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Combine horseradish, sesame seeds, flour, ginger and garlic salt in a food processor. Process until almost smooth. Add water if too thick or pulse a few times and transfer to an airtight container. Keep refrigerated.

title: Smoked Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 12 ounces beef tenderloin | 2 tablespoons lemon-pepper seasoning | 4 ounces of good quality dark chocolate | 3 bananas, sliced in half lengthwise and then cut in half lengthwise
instructions: Season tenderloin with lemon pepper. Grill on high heat for a few minutes on each side until it has a nice black and deep crust. Transfer to a baking dish and bake at 400 degrees for 25 - 30 minutes. Watch out for the steam. It should be good at first, but will go down later on the grill after removing from the oven. Allow the meat to cool. In a microwave safe bowl, melt the dark chocolate, then pour the melted chocolate over the meat and let sit to get it heated evenly.

title: Easy Crunchy Danish
ingredients: 1/4 cup granulated egg | 1/4 cup sweetened cranberries | 1 tablespoon liquid honey | 1 package frozen puff pastry, thawed according to package directions | 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine egg, cranberries& honey, stir well. Brush each sheet of pastries with vegetable oil. Cut out an “x” around each pastry top. Cover with parchment paper, fold over, pinch excess over edges. Brush tops with remaining oil. Bake in a 350°f degree oven for about 20 minutes, or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: chili paste,chili sauce,hot italian sausage,vegetable shortening,thai red chili pepper,basil
title: Sausage Pepper Chili Dogs
ingredients: 5 lbs hot italian sausage | 1 lb vegetable shortening | 2 stalks fresh basil | 2 thai red chili peppers, chopped | 1/4 cup sweet chili sauce | 1 tablespoon chili paste ( vietnamese-style chili sauce )
instructions: Place sausage in large, heavy pot. Brown over medium high heat, breaking into pieces. Transfer to large bowl. Discard fat from pan. Return sausage to pan. Brown over medium high heat, breaking meat up with back of spoon. Stir in basil and chilies. Combine chili sauce and paste in small bowl. Stir chili sauce mixture into sausage mixture in pot and stir until well blended. Bring to boil.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,cold water,scallop,tarragon,grape juice,stout beer
title: Sailor's Beer, Chicken or Shrimp
ingredients: 2 lbs medium shrimp ( in shell ) | 2 quarts cold water | 6 chicken bouillon cubes | 2 bottles guinness stout or ( 330 g ) bottles light beer | 2 dozen fresh tarragon ( leaves only, finely chop a few ) | 2 bottles medium pilsner-flavoured grape juice
instructions: Add shrimp or scallops to a 2 quart container and cover with the cold water. Let sit about 5 minutes and press a tooth pick into the top with the point of a small paring knife to make a simple insert into the shrimp or scallops if you wish. Add 2 of the bouillon cubes. Cover with the guinness or beer and a few tarragon leaves. Let sit in the refrigerator for a couple of hours or overnight. Remove shrimp or scallops and reserve. When ready to serve, drain the shrimps or scallops and pat dry. Remove and discard the heads from the shrimp or scallops. Chop the shrimp and serve on top of the bottle of grape juice with lots of cracked pepper.

title: Gorditas (Lettuce Tacos)
ingredients: 2 large lettuce leaves, washed and dried | 2 slices habanero peppers, chopped
instructions: Lay lettuce leaves on a large cutting board. Spread the dried habanero pepper evenly on the lettuce leaves. Top with a small spoonful of grated cheese, if desired.

title: Olive Garden Italian Vegetables
ingredients: 1 lb small red potato, with some of the peel on | 1/2 lb small eggplant, with some of the peel on | 1 cup apricot nectar | 1/2 lb spaghetti ( or more )
instructions: Boil some water and add some salt, and cook the pasta and potato. Heat the apricot nectar over medium heat until it just begins to boil.

title: Strawberry and Mushroom Frizzles
ingredients: 1/2 pint fresh strawberries | 8 ounces smoked pimento, sliced, drained on paper towels | 1 1/2 tablespoons cornflour, combined with the cornflour | 1 1/2 tablespoons pimientos, strips ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons smoked paprika ( or add 1 dash extra pimentonos or chilli flakes ) | 1 packet chicken bouillon | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon seasoning salt
instructions: Cut away crown of the strawberries and hull. Cut away base or seeds. Set aside. Finely chop or slice the rest of the berries and place either in a bowl or bowl container and toss with the pimentos, cornflour and paprika. Stir in chicken stock, enough to almost cover the berries and place in fridge. Roll or pound the softened berries until small cubes. If using, roll/scatten the berries, place in a saucepan of simmering water and cook for 5 - 10 minutes until berries are tender. Drain and set aside. When ready to serve, heat oven to 400°f lightly grease 4 frizzle pans and line them with parchment paper or grease and flour frizzle mats. Sprinkle sugar over frizzles and bake for 8 - 10 minutes. Remove from oven and place a baking dish on center rack. Place the frizzle molds on a baking sheet. Place 6 hot coffee/hot water in a small saucepan over moderate heat to warm slightly, then place tea kettle on burner. Add a 1/4 cup of hot water to each frizzle, and shake pan and heat through. Remove the muffels from the pan and divide them among the prepared frizzle pans/plates, spreading them around the dish with a spatula to cover the filling. Dot with a spoonful of sweet butter and sprinkle with a pinch of salt, to taste. Bake frizzle in middle of oven about 12 minutes or until frizzles are golden and very hot. Remove from oven and place on rack lined with aluminum foil and cool frizzle completely. Remove foil with frizzle from frizzles and arrange them on a platter or plate. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: heavy cream,hamburger bun,burrito flour tortilla,raspberry,coconut milk
title: Coconut Baked Burritos
ingredients: 14 ounces coconut milk | 1 -2 lb hamburger bun | 10 -12 burrito-size flour tortillas | 8 ounces raspberries | 2 cups heavy cream
instructions: Preheat oven to in 2 quart saucepan add coconut milk, stir and heat for about 5 minutes. Meanwhile heat your burritos in a skillet. Wrap your burger in flour tortillas and place in baking dish. Pour your coconut cream mixture over the wrap. Spoon over your burritos and bake for 35 - 45 minutes. Serve over fresh berries or fresh fruit.

title: Faux Gingerbread
ingredients: 2 mangoes ( or a small delicata sized one ) | 1 cup breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup ground ginger
instructions: Peel mangos or delicata. Mix it with your favourite breadcrumbs. Form into 1 inch sized balls the size of a marble or if you want to use a small tin, it can be made into round patties out of the mixture. Bake at 375f for about 10 minutes. Cool completely and store in airtight tins which have been well buttered and coloured. Variant, serve as is, in sandwiches with yoghurt, yoghurt, pickles or anything else that compliments your appetites.

title: Nutty Woodruff Oil
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 cup chopped walnuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f.

title: Quick and Easy Hoisin Tomatillo Salsa
ingredients: 12 tomatillo salsa | 2 teaspoons hoisin sauce | 1/2 cup unsweetened applesauce or 1/2 cup tomato puree
instructions: Heat salsa in large nonreactive saucepan over medium high heat, about 3 minutes, until warm. In small bowl, stir hoisin sauce until blended. Stir applesauce mixture into warm salsa, and cook 2 minutes. Pour into hot sterilized quart jars, leaving 1/2 inch headspace. Cool completely, about 5 minutes. Remove air bubbles as needed. Seal, and store in pantry up to 2 weeks. To freeze, place on cookie sheet in 2 layers. Warm in 300f oven for 20 minutes, or until thickened.

Random Ingredients: canadian bacon,garbanzo bean,cocoa powder,beer,milk ricotta cheese,hard egg
title: Quick and Easy Ricotta and Beer Canapes
ingredients: 3 cans garbanzo beans, rinsed and drained | 2 cups canadian bacon, chopped | 4 hard-boiled eggs, chopped | 1/2 cup light beer | 3 tablespoons unsweetened dutch-processed cocoa powder | 4 cups whole milk ricotta cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Arrange the garbanzo beans on the baking sheet, then scatter the garlic and canadian bacon slices evenly over the beans. Bake in the preheated oven until the bananas are crispy and the bacon is beginning to show brown bits and blood, about 20 minutes. Mix the eggs, beer, cocoa powder and half of the cheese in a bowl with a fork and stir until smooth. Return the bananas to the oven, spread the cheese mixture evenly over the bananas, and bake 15 to 20 minutes longer. Remove the cheeses to a wire rack and let cool completely before serving.

Random Ingredients: cooking oil,green bell pepper,apple juice,champagne,orange zest
title: Champagne Dressing
ingredients: 3/4 cup apple juice | 2 tablespoons orange zest ( grated ) | 3 tablespoons cooking oil | 1/4 cup champagne ( dry ) | 1/2 green bell pepper ( green )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl. Chill in refridgerator until ready to use. Will keep about ¾ week.

Random Ingredients: tarragon vinegar,ricotta cheese,yeast,raisin,chili flake,grain white rice,cayenne,coriander
title: Rice and Raisins Salad - W- Yeast & Tarragon
ingredients: 3 cups cooked long-grain white rice ( not minute rice ) | 100 g raisins | 3 teaspoons dried lindt tarragon vinegar | 2 teaspoons fresh coriander | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne, ground | 1/4 teaspoon chili flakes, extra | 500 g ricotta cheese | 1 teaspoon yeast
instructions: Soak the raisins in boiling water until soft. Drain. Soak the tarragon vinegar and coriander together in a cup of boiling water. Mix the yoghurt, vinegar, and lindt with a fork. Set aside. Soak the rice in cold water and leave to soak for 10 minutes. Drain and put to one side. Cook the rice until al dente. Cool completely and add, stir in the curd, raisins, vinegar, chilies, and spices. Cover and refrigerate 3 hours. When ready to serve, spoon into a bowl and sprinkle with icing sugar.

title: Spicy Corn Rolls
ingredients: 2 cans bean sprouts, drained | 1 cup red cabbage, shredded | 1/2 cup cashews, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons chili paste | 1 1/2 tablespoons sugar or 1 1/2 tablespoons splenda granular | 1 cup heavy cream
instructions: Spread a thin layer of corn wrap on counter. Lay bean sprouts on foil and lightly spray with nonstick vegetable spray. Place shredded cabbage on top, followed by chopped cashews in a smll even layer. Whisk together chili paste & sugar or splenda. Pour into a skillet & heat over low heat until sugar has dissolved. When mixture starts to bubble at the edges of the pan, remove from heat and stir in cream. Using a large spoon spread about 2 tbsp of cream onto corn roll and roll up. Serve immediately.

title: Blueberry Cream for Dining
ingredients: 100 g blueberries | 250 g ladyfingers | 100 g strawberries | 2 -3 sprigs cherries | 2 medium celery ribs | 100 g chestnuts ( canned ) | 1 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( hing ) | 1/4 liter milk
instructions: Soak the berries in warm water to cover for at least 30 mins to overnight, drain the berries, chop the berries and add to a saucepan with the celery, chestnuts and the asafoetida. Add the milk and bring to boil. When boiling add the lady fingers and cook until they turn a golden color. Put aside. Spread out one layer of the cream on each plate and place 4 rose petals next to them. Top with the blueberries, cherries and the mixed berries. Serve the cream warm.

Random Ingredients: jicama,sun tomato oil,mace,red chili pepper,pork shoulder,savoy cabbage,walnut
title: Pork and Veggies With Jicama
ingredients: 1 savoy cabbage, sliced | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, sliced | 1/4 cup walnuts, chopped | 1 tablespoon roasted jicama, shredded | 1 large red chili pepper, sliced | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Prepare a large baking dish with cooking spray. In a medium bowl, combine the cabbage, tomatoes, walnuts, jicama, red chili and mace. Add the pork, season with salt and toss to coat evenly. Bake at 400 for 45 minutes or until pork is tender and vegetables are tender.

title: Brandy-Filled Onions
ingredients: 1 lb onion, peeled | 1/2 cup brandy | 1/2 lb cake, cubed and fried
instructions: Combine the onions, brandy and crumbs, and mix well. Spread on a platter and cut thin slices.

title: Sliced Apples
ingredients: 2 cups thinly sliced fresh apples | 1 tablespoon freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Spread the apples out on the prepared baking sheet. Sprinkle with parmesan over the apples. Bake in the preheated oven until lightly browned and tender, 30 to 40 minutes. Remove apples from the oven, cut into quarters, and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: chilies,green olive,oregano,button mushroom,pea pod,chicken stock cube,oregano leaf,palm sugar
title: Easy Peasy Sweet Pea Pods and Mushrooms for the Crock for One
ingredients: 350 g frozen peas pea pods | 1 teaspoon dried oregano, crushed | 4 tablespoons vegetable oil | 100 g green olives, sliced | 250 g button mushrooms, halved | 1 green chili, chopped | 1/2 chicken stock cube | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Line a baking tray with baking paper. Using a sharp knife tear pea pods in half, scoop out seeds and place in a blender and combine with oregano. Place oil in a non stick frying pan over medium heat and saute the peas over a moderate heat for 3 minutes or until they turn white and just just start to soften. Set aside. Heat remaining oil in the same pan over high heat and stir in chilli and mushrooms and saute for 3 to 4 minutes. Add stock cube, oregano and half the reserved peas/mushrooms/peas to the pan and bring to the boil. Cover, reduce heat to low and simmer for 7 to 10 minutes or until peas are tender. Stir in remaining peas/mushrooms and remaining oregano. Remove pan from heat and stir in remaining pepper to taste. Transfer mixture to ovenproof casserole dish and bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until vegetables are crisp and hot and sauce is starting to bubble. Serve sauce over the peas/mushrooms.

title: Caul-Yogurt
ingredients: 1 medium caul, separated into florets | 1 pinch pecorino romano cheese | 1/2 cup plain fat-free yogurt
instructions: Pour yogurt into serving dish with cauliflower. Sprinkle with cheese. Let rest on the counter over night just to allow the cheese to melt. Cover and let cheese set.

Random Ingredients: apple cider,vinegar,pork loin,egg noodle,deli roast beef,yeast
title: Apple Noodle Beef and Pork Dinner
ingredients:
1 medium egg noodles, cooked ( approx.
    - 7.
    -5 ounces per package ) | 1 lb lean boneless pork loin, cubed | 10 ounces lean deli roast beef or 10 ounces beef, cubed | 1 tablespoon apple cider ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons vinegar ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon instant yeast
instructions: Place macaroni in a large bowl, top with water with beef, and microwave or mix in a ziploc bag with wire whisk to get the water to the bottom of the bag. Cover with wax paper and set aside.. In another bowl combine the rest of the ingredients and whisk to blend. Set aside. Heat a dutch oven or soup pot with lid until hot. Do not bring to a full boil. While the broth is heating, brown pork for about 7 minutes. Add meat and stir. Simmer for a minimum of 10 minutes, until meat starts getting tender. Cover, remove lid and put in preheated oven, on broil. Watch carefully, because if the broth simmers too quickly, the noodles will burn and get mushy. Stir the noodles periodically and if the broth looks too watery, reduce until it is the consistency of a broth. If it's too thin, raise temperature a bit to make sure it gets to a low boil. When the noodles are done, check to see if the noodles are tender enough. If they feel any way runny, turn off heat and remove the noodle bags and noodles from the broiler. Return the meat to the dutch oven. The broth should be boiling, but not boiling hard. The noodles will absorb some of the broth. If not, let the broth simmer on a simmer.

title: The Devil's Food (The Real Thing)
ingredients: 150 g good quality dark chocolate | 200 ml tomato ketchup | 1 vanilla bean | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice
instructions: First, remove the scum from the vanilla bean. Break it up into smaller pieces and place them together with the vanilla bean. Place this wicked spicy flavourful flavour in a blender and then blend on high for about 1 minute. Stour off onto paper towels. Take a small glass dish in the process. Break up the dark chocolate into smaller pieces and put in that dish, add the lime juice and mix it up with the contents of the blender, then pour into the dish while holding the dish over the sink. If it looks as a bit dry, add a spoonful of clear water. Turn it back on to high for about a minute and repeat this step until you have a thick chocolate sauce, or just a couple of thick chunks of chocolate.

title: Panko-Style Brisket
ingredients: 1 corned beef brisket, trimmed of fat | 2 cups panko breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup panko breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup fat-free chicken stock or 1/2 cup beef broth | 1 can fat-free chickpeas, drained | 1 can mushrooms, drained and coarsely chopped | 5 ounces smoked salmon, cut into 8 slices
instructions: Trim excess fat from brisket, then discard visible fat, cut into 8 medallions, then place in a plastic bag. Combine 1 and 1/2 cup panko, 1/2 cup broth, chickpeas, mushrooms, and salmon in a shallow dish. Roll brisket in remaining panko mixture to coat. Grill brisket, covered, over medium heat for 20 to 30 minutes, or until well browned, basting once with juices.

title: Tofu Pizza
ingredients: 1/2 cup light firm tofu, drained and sliced on one side into 16 slices | 2 teaspoons chili paste ( to taste, i used homemade chili sauce ) | 3 whole garlic cloves, minced ( i also used minced fresh garlic ) | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon dried savory or 1/4-1/2 teaspoon oregano | 1 small handfuls fontina, grated ( may be substituted with goat cheese ) | fresh ground pepperoni | ice
instructions: Place tofu, chili paste, garlic and oregano in a bowl and mash together with a fork or a masher. Add the grated fontina and stir until it's evenly distributed. Sprinkle with freshly ground pepper and adjust seasoning, to taste. Top with shredded cheese and bake at 450°f for 7 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.

title: Apple and Sliced Onion Salad
ingredients: 1 large white onion, cut into 1/2 inch wedges | 3 large granny smith apples, cut into 1/2 inch thick slices ( about 1/2 pound ) | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 1/4 cup honey | 2 teaspoons dried dill
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the onion, apples and 1/4 cup water. Cover and chill until ready to serve. Dressing, whisk together vinegar, honey, 1/2 teaspoon dried dill and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Pour dressing over chilled onions and toss to coat.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crust,okra,superfine sugar,hot pepper,tomato puree,yellow curry paste,banana
title: Curried Okra and Banana Pie
ingredients: 1 fresh okra, halved lengthways | 1 lb sweet potato ( yellow or red potatoes peeled chopped ) | 1 teaspoon hot pepper ( or more, to taste ) | 1 tablespoon yellow curry paste | 1 tablespoon superfine sugar | 1 teaspoon hot red pepper ( or more, to taste ) | 1/4 cup tomato puree or 1/4 cup tomato juice | 1 graham cracker crust, baked
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350ºf. Line a large rectangular or square shaped roasting tin with plastic wrap. Arrange the okra, sweet potato, curry paste, sugar and red pepper in the plastic wrap. Pour tomato puree into the tin and spread evenly. Cover tightly with foil and put in the refrigerator overnight. The next day, remove the plastic wrap from the pan then place on a preheated barbecue over a high heat. Cook for 6 - 8 minutes each side, turning occasionally to brown both sides. Remove from the oven and remove the foil/grease. Spread a layer of yoghurt in the base of the pastry shell and decorate with more okra and sweet potato then the caramelised tomato and garbanzo mixture you've previously sprinkled over the top of the pie. Return to the oven and bake for 15 - 20 minutes until the cheese has melted and browned a little and the pie has a nice golden crust. Serve with jasmine rice and salad to soak up the extra juice.

title: Super Simple Mexican Blend (For Baking)
ingredients: 4 tablespoons aquavit | 3 teaspoons celery seed
instructions: Crush the quaker base into the bottom of a mixing bowl with a pestle or a wooden spoon. Combine aquavit, celery seed and celery seed in the top of a double boiler and melt them together over medium heat, stirring frequently, until they have melted about 5 minutes. Turn off the heat and allow to cool for about 10 minutes until the base is cool. Dough can be used immediately or stored in the refrigerator for up to 2 months.

Random Ingredients: fish sauce,natural peanut butter,kosher salt,bay leaf,grand marnier
title: American Kitchen Classic Authentic Vietnamese Peanut Sauce (Vietnamese)
ingredients: 14 ounces sweet natural-style peanut butter, well stirred | 1 1/2 tablespoons fish sauce ( or to taste ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons grand marnier ( optional ) or 1 1/2 tablespoons other orange-flavored liqueur ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 1 small bay leaf
instructions: Using an electric mixer, beat all ingredients until smooth. Use for dipping or stir fry.

title: Balsamic Glaze for Meat
ingredients: 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon ground cloves
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and let set for 1 hour before serving.

title: Kaffir Lime Fish Balls
ingredients: 40 -50 g kefir lime leaves | 1 -2 tablespoon vodka | 50 g grated cheese or 50 g feta cheese | 1 egg | 1 dash corn oil | 1 -2 grape tomatoes or 1 -2 cherry tomatoes, sliced | corn oil ( for deep frying ) | grape tomatoes | kaffir lime leaf ( optional ) | tzatziki or other condiments ( optional )
instructions: In a deep frying pan with oil, fry the kaffir lime leaves in it until golden brown. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. Set aside. In a small bowl beat the kaffir lime leaves and vodka until creamy. Add garlic powder and cheese. Mix well. Cover and set aside. In a separate bowl mix the egg, water and salt. With wet hands form the mixture into balls/tables. Deep fry in hot oil until golden and crispy. Set on paper towels, remove the kaffir lime leaves and serve with grape tomatoes, tzatziki or other condiments of your choice. Serve with pita or toasted pita, hummus and tomato salad. Garnish with lemon wedges and grated orange rind and a kaffir lime leaf or mint leaf if desired.

title: Red Onion Soup
ingredients: 1 small red onion | 2 tablespoons fenugreek seeds | 2 cups chicken bouillon | 1 cup sugar | 2 -3 tablespoons red pepper or 2 -3 tablespoons black pepper, chopped
instructions: Heat oil in large pot and sprinkle in fenugreek. Sauté onion for about 10 minutes. Add rest of ingredients and simmer 15 - 20 mins until onions have reduced a bit and mixture has thickened. I prefer this with my immersion blender. Enjoy this soup for breakfast, or with a crisp salad and crusty bread. The flavour is great with yogurt or pita bread.

Random Ingredients: beef brisket,heavy cream,sharp cheddar cheese,filet beef,green cardamom pod,mint leaf,agave nectar
title: Beef Kefta
ingredients: 2 tablespoons agave nectar | 3 beef slices brisket, 3/4-inch thick | 1 jar pickled ginger & cream, undiluted | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 2 green cardamom pods | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh mint leaves | 1 1/2 cups sharp cheddar cheese, grated, divided
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the agave and beef. Cover and let stand 10 minutes. Preheat the broiler. Coat a 9 x 13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Combine the ginger, cream and tomatoes in a medium bowl. Pour 1/2 cup of cream mixture over the beef mixture.

Random Ingredients: bread flour,dark red kidney bean,spring onion
title: Pasta Fagioli
ingredients: 400 g dark red kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1 bunch spring onion, ends trimmed | 1 3/4 cups bread flour
instructions: Place the drained red kidney beans in a large pan, pour in enough boiling water to cover the beans and bring to the boil. Lower the heat and simmer for 30 minutes, or until tender. Drain beans, discard the cooking water and set aside for five minutes to cool slightly. Meanwhile, place chopped spring onions into a food processor and blend until finely chopped. Toss flour into the bean mixture until well combined and transfer to a large mixing bowl. Gradually beat in enough bread to form a firm dough. Turn off the heat and stir in the cooked kidney beans. Heat a frying pan, add a little olive oil and heat until hot. Drop rounded tablespoonfuls of the dough into the pan and flatten slightly. Cook on both sides for 1 - 2 minutes each side until golden.

title: Banana Chowder
ingredients: 2 cans cream of mushroom soup | 3 medium bananas, sliced | 2 tablespoons shrimp paste | 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh minced lime or 1 1/2 tablespoons lemon juice
instructions: Mix all ingredients in large saucepan or pot. Heat through. Do not boil.

title: Hot Chocolate Hot Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup medium hot cocoa ( i use hershey's ) | 1 1/3 cups mild green curry paste ( or you can use an instant matchstick with the `` matchstick '' in the can ) | 2 teaspoons white pepper, course grind | 2 cups hot salsa ( i like pace medium )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Refrigerate.

title: Peanut Butter Crumbs
ingredients: 1/2 cup crunchy peanut butter | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 1/2 teaspoon dried crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Lightly coat a baking sheet with cooking spray. In an medium bowl, beat together the peanut butter, white pepper and dried crumbs. Spoon onto baking sheet. Bake in preheated oven until puffs up and dry, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,savoy cabbage,wheat flour,chile,feta cheese
title: Cabbage-Stuffed Cabbage
ingredients: 1 head savoy cabbage, about 1 1/2 inch | 1 1/2 tablespoons ground dried chile | 1 cup whole wheat flour | 2 tablespoons light dark sesame oil | 1/3 cup crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Place the cabbage head in the pot and cook uncovered until just beginning to wilt, 2 to 4 minutes depending on the size of the head.

title: Noodle and Snow Pea Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 package dried rice noodles | 1 1/2 lbs snow peas, trimmed and sliced diagonally ( can use more ) | 1 lb fresh gingerroot, peeled and finely chopped | 6 hoagie rolls, split lengthwise | 1 package mixed oriental masala | onion powder | pepper | 6 -8 hoagie rolls, split lengthwise
instructions: Set oven to 275 degrees. Cook rice noodles according to package directions. Drain, rince under cold water, place in large bowl, reserve. Cook snow peas in boiling water until just tender, 2 to 3 minutes, drain. In 12 inch skillet, cook ginger for 4 minutes or until tender, stirring constantly. Add noodles, peas, and ginger remaining in bowl, toss well. Spread out meat mixture evenly in a rectangular, 5x6 inch jelly roll pan. Bake in preheated oven for 45 minutes. Remove meat mixture from oven, increase heat to 375 degrees, and bake an additional 45 to 50 minutes or until meat mixture is very dark brown, breaking apart meat as it cooks. Transfer meat to a cutting board and let cool slightly. In small bowl, combine spice mix ingredients. Cut hoagie rolls lengthwise and arrange on work surface, cover with a tea towel, and lightly rub spice mixture onto roll halves. Arrange meat mixture over rolls, and roll tops up, covering meat mixture with some sauce.

Random Ingredients: red kidney bean,purpose flour,lettuce,bean sprout,pancetta,habanero pepper,red chili pepper
title: Gourmet Chili
ingredients: 100 g pancetta | 100 g red kidney beans | 100 g red kidney beans | 200 g bean sprouts | 1 large head lettuce | 2 -3 chopped fresh red chili peppers ( or less, to taste ) | 1 fresh habanero pepper, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Cut pancetta into small pieces roughly 1cm dice. Place in microwave safe bowl with red kidney beans and beans and cook on high for 3 - 4 minutes until the beans begin changing colour. Chop lettuce into 1cm pieces and place on serving plate. Tear basil leaves or oregano leaves into shreds and place on the lettuce. Garnish with sliced red chillies and pickled habanero if using. Pour gourmet chili sauce over the top and allow to stir as you eat it.

title: Korean Hot Apricot Patties
ingredients: 1 lb firm green prawns | 1/2 lb green split peas ( kimchi ) | 9 apricot jam | chili | chili pepper
instructions: Shell the prawns and then slice them in half lengthwise. Using a knife slice the hard end off the prawns and remove the head from the peels. Then slice the meat in small strips. Place the prawns, peas, jam and chili in a pan with about 1 1/4 cups water and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes on medium low heat until tender. Serve the prawn mixture into small, flat serving bowls and drizzle with warm prawns.

Random Ingredients: miracle whip,apple juice,lamb,raspberry,bread machine yeast,plain yogurt,lemon zest
title: Fruited Lamb Loaf
ingredients: 500 g bread ( white loaf ) | 1 tablespoon grated lemon zest | 2/3 cup miracle whip | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1 egg ( lightly beaten ) | 1 tablespoon plain yogurt | 250 g of chopped lamb ( cooked, meat cut into 1/3in cubes or leftover leg ) | raspberry, washed and drained
instructions: Cube the bread into 1/2in cubes or chunks. Place all ingredients in bread machine in the order recommended by its manufacturer. Select bread from dough setting. When the bread has finished baking, immediately transfer it onto a lightly floured tray and lightly brush with melted butter. With a sharp knife, slash the loaf into 12 slices. Place the slices into a lightly greased oven proof dish. Brush the top with some melted butter. Bake at 180°c for 35 - 40 minutes or until golden and golden brown. Serve loaf with hot raspberries and strawberries.

title: Simple Onion Dipping Sauce - Quicker Recipe
ingredients: 1 packet onion soup mix | 1 1/4 - 1 1/2 cups ice water
instructions: In the small bowl of the onion soup mix, stir together about 1/4 cup of the water and the onion soup mix. Add the ice and the rest of the water. Stir the mix thoroughly to combine and store in the refrigerator.

title: Wild Chocolate Banana Lollipops
ingredients: 8 ounces dark chocolate | 1/2 ounce sunflower oil | 1/2 ounce flour | 4 black mushrooms | 1/2 ounce strong brewed tea | 2 black mushrooms | 3 ounces blue curacao | 4 small thin bananas
instructions: Heat the chocolate until melted. Stir in the oil, flour and black mushrooms. Set aside. Heat briquettes or hot griddle pan until very hot. Lightly stir in the brewed tea. Remove from heat and place on a plate. Add the mushrooms, curacao, and banana slices to chocolate mixture and stir until melted. Spread half of the mushroom mixture over each banana lollipop, and top with the remaining mushroom mixture. Place lollipops on the barbecue and grill until dark chocolate melts and rolls around them, and lollipops are done.

title: Frozen Cool Whip for Kids
ingredients: 1 cup cool whip | 5 teaspoons brown sugar, packed ( or to taste )
instructions: Add sweetener in a microwavable container.

title: Pork Tenderloin With Champagne
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin, trimmed | 1 ounce galliano | 1 ounce ketchup | 1 ounce sweet potato ( kiwi ) | 1 ounce espresso | 6 slices french bread
instructions: Heat grill to moderate high or 180°c. Place tenderloin on grill rack and brush with half side beer. Cook for 15 minutes until cooked throughly and golden brown and tender, but still pink inside. When cool, leave in fridge for 6 hours. Peel off any thin skin over the surface of the pork. Cut into 1 inch slices. Place on serving platter. Pour remaining beer over. Serve with boiled new potatoes, fresh vegetables, chutney or coriander leaves. Cooks note, for a variation, replace the galliano with 1 oz olive oil or other flavourful oil and 1 ounce sherry wine vinegar.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder,process american cheese,mayonnaise,parmigiano reggiano cheese,tomato sauce,sugar,nutmeg
title: Pork Shoulder Mac 'n Cheese
ingredients: 5 lbs pork shoulder | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1 lb process american cheese | 1/2 lb parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/2 lb process american cheese, grated | 1 teaspoon sugar | 1 teaspoon nutmeg | 1 can tomato sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Wash the pork well and rub some salt into the meat to ensure a good slashing. Remove all excess fat. Combine the mayonnaise with the grated cheeses and mix well with the meat. Sprinkle the sugar evenly in a shallow dish. Dip the pork into the tomato sauce to coat. Place the pork in a roasting pan. Sprinkle over the nutmeg. Roast at 350 degrees f for 90 minutes. Allow to rest 10 minutes before cutting and serving.

title: Basil-Garden Herb-Smear
ingredients: 1 tablespoon wheat germ, cracked wheat germ | 1/2 cup basil leaves, firmly packed
instructions: Combine all ingredients, rubbing generously between your palms. Store in a clean dry container.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,lettuce leaf,active yeast,parsnip,cream chicken soup,black peppercorn
title: Garlic Herb Parsnop Bread
ingredients: 2 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1/4 teaspoon granulated garlic salt | 1/8 teaspoon black peppercorns, cracked | 3 - 1 1/2 cups unbleached, chopped parsnips | 1 1/2 cups chopped lettuce leaves | 3 can cream of chicken soup, undiluted
instructions: Heat oven to 375°f in bread machine bucket or large bowl, dissolve yeast and granulated garlic salt in warm, but not hot, water until creamy. Stir in peppercorns, parsnips, lettuce and cream of chicken soup.

Random Ingredients: date,beef bouillon cube,nutmeg,heavy whipping cream,red snapper,soya sauce,cornstarch
title: Red Snapper With Dates
ingredients: 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 3 teaspoons soya sauce | 1 beef bouillon cube ( knorr ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 cup dates, chopped | 1 teaspoon cornstarch | 1 lb red snapper, cut into 1 inch pieces
instructions: Beat 3 cups cream and soya sauce together over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: sauerkraut,raspberry,saffron strand,lemon juice,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Saffron Sauerkraut With Raspberry
ingredients: 8 saffron strands | vegetable oil-flavored cooking spray | 1 1/2 lbs raspberries | 1 1/4 lbs sauerkraut, drained well | 2/3 cup raspberries | 2 teaspoons fresh lemon juice
instructions: Place saffron strands, about 1 tablespoon each, in a small bag and shake. Heat a 12 inch skillet over medium high heat until hot. Coat pan with cooking spray. Add saffron and sauté until golden, about 2 minutes. Immediately stir in raspberries. Remove from heat and divide between 4 plates. Spoon 1/4 cup raspberries over raspberries and top with sauerkraut.

title: Sausage Stuffed Apples, Apple or Not
ingredients: 6 apples ( i like golden delight's ) | 6 large garlic cloves ( minced ) | 1/4 cup seedless raisin | ice | 3/4 lb turkey sausage, cut into pieces ( i like sainato's )
instructions: Core apples with a small knife and scoop out every but a very thin slice of the way around. Chop or use a knife to carefully peel off the outside of the apples. Cut out the core and fill out the entire circle with cheesecloth, leaving just a thin lip or you can remove the entire top. Remove all soft and soft stuff insides of the apples. Use a knife to cut them open so you can carefully remove any stuffing left inside. Fill the apple cavity with the meat and top with the raisins/poppy seed. Place the filled apples on a plate, packing them in tightly. Pour ice over the apples. Chill in the refrigerator or freeze and reheat when serving the next day.

title: Shahi Kebab
ingredients: 2 tablespoons shredded chicken breasts | 1 tablespoon yogurt or 1 tablespoon curds | 1 tablespoon vinegar
instructions: Mix ingredients and serve over rice.

title: Spinach Salad
ingredients: 1 package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry | 1/2 cup dijon mustard | 1/4 cup toasted sesame seeds | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano, or to taste
instructions: Mix frozen spinach, dijon mustard, sesame seeds, and oregano together in a bowl.

title: Quick and Easy Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 8 russet potatoes, scrubbed | 1 carrot
instructions: If you are using a peeled russet potato, peel and grate into a large pot. Bring 4 cups water to a boil and add the russet potatoes. Cook for 15 to 20 minutes or until the potatoes are soft. If you are using a microwave, put potatoes in a large bowl, cover with a towel and microwave on high until tender, 5 to 7 minutes. Drain potatoes, discard vegetables. Transfer the potatoes to a large bowl of cheesecloth to allow moisture to escape. Mash potatoes and mash with a hand masher until smooth. You may need to add a splash of milk to loosen the texture. Transfer mashed potatoes to a serving dish and refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours until chilled. Add carrots to the mash and mix well.

title: Chili Balls
ingredients: 8 ounces canadian bacon, finely chopped | 1 cup peanut butter | 1 cup sweet chili sauce | 1 1/2 cups sifted cake flour
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp. Drain on paper towel and crumble bacon well. In bowl combine peanut butter with sweet chili sauce, sifted cake flour and bacon. Mix with fingers until well mixed. Roll into 1 inch balls and brown in oven at 250 degrees for 20 minutes.

title: Kafta Snoober
ingredients: 1 pound ground lamb | 1 pound citrus peel
instructions: Soak citrus peel in cold water for 10 minutes. Drain. Preheat the oven to 250 degrees f. On a sheet pan, mix the mince, citrus peel and water. Form into a log about 2 to 3 inches in diameter. Score the log about 1/2 inch diagonally.

title: Aussie Curacao Blush
ingredients: 1/2 ounce blue curacao | 8 ounces very finely chopped bell peppers | 24 ounces very finely chopped raisins
instructions: Mix together and pour into glass bottles. Shake over ice and refrigerate.

title: Chicken with Wild Chutney
ingredients: 3 cups diced, cooked chicken | 1 mango chutney ( the kind with sugar added ) | 1 packet taco seasoning | 1 can green cherries with small pears - drained | 1/4 cup slivered almonds | 2 tablespoons shredded celery
instructions: Toss chicken with mango chutney until coated. Sprinkle taco seasoning over chicken.

Random Ingredients: chile powder,honey,fennel seed,mozzarella cheese,white wine vinegar
title: Fennel Cheese
ingredients: 4 ounces mozzarella cheese | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon chile powder | 1/4 teaspoon honey | 1/8 teaspoon fennel seed
instructions: Cut cheese into 3/4 inch cubes. Add remaining ingredients& mix well. Place cubes in serving dish& serve.

title: Crazy Oyster Pie
ingredients: 1 prepared shortcrust pastry | 2 sheets vanilla instant pudding mix | 8 -10 oysters, open and uncooked | 2 tablespoons apple, puree
instructions: If ready to use, preheat oven to 180 deg c, or 180 deg c if using a fan forced oven. Roll out the pastry on a lightly floured board or a lightly floured pastry cloth. Place a single sheet of pastry onto a pie tin or baking paper or lightly greased biscuit tin. Spread with 1 tsp. Of the puree on the edge of the pastry, then place the cooked oysters on top of that. Repeat until your fillings have been used ending with the puréed puréed purée on top. Sprinkle liberally with cinnamon or sugar then bake for 20mins, or until the pastry is golden and springy to the touch.

Random Ingredients: allspice berry,cumin,feta cheese,cellophane noodle,chicken breast fillet,plain flour
title: Easy Noodles With Chicken, Feta, and Nuts
ingredients: 2 tablespoons plain flour | 1/4 teaspoon allspice berries | 1/4 teaspoon ground cumin | 250 g low-fat chicken breast fillets, chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons crumbled reduced-fat feta cheese | 4 sheets cellophane noodles
instructions: Place the flour in a shallow pie plate or baking dish and season with allspice and cumin. Dredge the chicken pieces in the flour, shaking off any excess. Place the chicken in a non stick frying pan and cook over medium low heat for 2 - 5 minutes on each side, or until golden brown. Transfer to a plate. Stir in the feta. Cover and cook for 5 - 8 minutes more. Meanwhile, cook the cellophane noodles until al dente, according to package directions. Drain the noodles and transfer to a large serving bowl. Spoon the chicken, cheese and any juices from the frying pan over the noodles and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,parmigiano reggiano cheese,thai chili paste
title: Homemade Hot Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup thai chili paste | 2 tablespoons grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/4 cup bottled sweetened chili oil
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together hot sauce or chili paste. Stir in cheese, and refrigerate until served.

Random Ingredients: cashew,flat leaf italian parsley,fiddlehead,stewing beef,tomato,rump steak,cauliflower,tomato soup
title: Beef Noodle Soup
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs stewing beef, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 head cauliflower, cut into florets | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1 can petite diced tomatoes, undrained | 3 ounces dry cashews or 3 ounces walnut pieces | 4 ounces whole fiddleheads, sliced thin ( about 1/4 cup for garnish ) | fresh flat-leaf italian parsley, chopped ( optional )
instructions: In dutch oven or a large soup pot, combine beef, cauliflower, tomato soup and tomatoes. Bring to boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer 15 minutes. Add cashews.

title: Pasta with Spinach, Scallops, and Spinach
ingredients: 1 package uncooked penne | 1 pound fresh spinach, washed | 1 pound scallops
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook penne in boiling water, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 6 minutes.

Random Ingredients: green apple,lettuce leaf,greek seasoning,chunky salsa,ear corn cob,kosher salt black pepper,barley,chili sauce
title: Barley and Apple Salad with Spicy Salsa
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups barley | 1/2 cup chunky salsa | 2 ears corn on the cob, roasted and sliced | 1 green apple, cored and coarsely chopped | 2 teaspoons chili sauce | 1 teaspoon all purpose greek's seasoning | kosher salt and black pepper | 5 lettuce leaves
instructions: Place the barley in a large pot. Bring to a boil, then turn the heat up to medium and simmer for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Drain and rinse to remove the excess water, then add the salsa and simmer 2 - 5 minutes longer, until the barley is tender. Toss with the corn, apple, chili sauce, greek seasoning, black pepper and salt. Serve warm or room temperature.

Random Ingredients: cannellini bean,lemon juice,egg noodle,flour tortilla,fennel seed
title: Italian Noodles
ingredients: 1 package fennel seed twists | 1 can cannellini beans, rinsed and drained | 1 pound egg noodles | 1/3 cup lemon juice | 12 flour tortillas
instructions: Combine the fennel powder and cannellini beans in the work bowl of a blender. Cover and blend for about 15 seconds. Add egg noodles, cook until slightly undercooked, stirring to coat. Add lemon juice, cook one or two minutes longer. Spoon noodles onto bowls and top with fennel mixture.

Random Ingredients: catsup,apricot preserve,baking potato,turmeric,onion soup mix,liquid smoke,thyme sprig,black vinegar
title: Easy Jewish Glazed Potatoes
ingredients: 1 lb baking potato, scrubbed | 1 package onion soup mix | 1 cup catsup | 1/2 cup blood vinegar | 1/4 cup black vinegar | 2 tablespoons liquid smoke | 1 teaspoon black vinegar | 1 teaspoon dried thyme sprig | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a crockpot and cook on low for 8 to 10 hours or until potatoes are tender. Remove potatoes from crockpot and place in a bowl. Remove the excess moisture from the crockpot, leaving the onions in the crockpot and add back the potatoes back in for 8 to 12 hours. Stir before serving.

title: Hazelnut Fingers (Using Nut Pikes)
ingredients: 8 ounces ground hazelnuts | 1 teaspoon dried savory | 4 ounces pine nuts | 2 ounces baking soda | 2 cups cold water
instructions: Add all the dry ingredients to a food processor and mix lightly until the mixture resembles fine bread crumbs. Add the water and mix until the dough is well blended. Chill overnight. Pre heat oven to 375°f. Roll out onto a silpat about 1 inch thickness. Cut cookies on the bias and spread with hazelhorns or butter. Bake for 12 - 15 minutes, or until light brown on top.

Random Ingredients: chicken broth,tahini,onion powder,anchovy paste,spanish olive,cocoa powder,red pepper flake,mushroom
title: Mama's Secret Sauce for Veggies
ingredients: 1/3 cup tahini ( or sesame ) | 1/3 cup spanish olives ( optional ) or 1/3 cup chopped green olives ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons chicken broth | 1/4 teaspoon onion powder | 1 tablespoon smoked paprika ( not dry, it is dry and adds smoke ) | 1 teaspoon unsweetened cocoa powder ( not dutch sweet ) | 1/4 teaspoon red pepper flakes ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon anchovy paste ( optional ) or 1/2 tablespoon soy sauce ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Keep in refridgerator. It will keep overnight. Can be stored in refridgerator for later use. It will keep well 1 - 2 weeks. You can take the leftovers and store it in the freezer for up to a month.

title: Granola Di Scalli (Scallops a La Granola)
ingredients: 300 g scallops | 1 cup superfine sugar | 2 vanilla pod | 1 -2 cup brown rice flour
instructions: Place the scallops in cold water and leave to soak for at least an hour, or longer, in the fridge. Heat a frying pan over a high heat and coat with a little peanut oil. Shake the scallops all over, pour on just enough brown rice flour to cover and fry for 3 - 4 minutes or until golden. Remove them from the pan, drain and set aside. Add the vanilla pods to the pan and fry for anther 4 - 5 minutes, adding sugar a little at a time and stirring until it has dissolved. Remove from heat and allow to cool for 5 minutes. Serve right away.

Random Ingredients: lamb,macadamia nut,irish cream,caraway seed,arborio rice,strawberry,mexican cheese
title: The Big Apple Chili
ingredients: 400 g ground lamb | 400 g fresh strawberries, halved | 2 teaspoons caraway seeds | 6 -8 ounces fresh arborio rice | 1/2 cup macadamia nuts, roughly chopped | 4 tablespoons irish cream or 4 tablespoons dark rum | 1 cup shredded mexican blend cheese ( i sometimes add a dash of cream of tartar )
instructions: Preheat over to 160 degrees celsius or 180 degrees celcius. In a heavy based saucepan heat lamb on a medium heat and cook until browned. Remove lamb from heat. Add 1/4c kernels from tomatoes and all the other diced tomatoes to the lamb. Season well. Drain any excess liquid from tomatoes into a strainer and set aside. In a separate saucepan heat macadamia nuts in a little oil. Add the rice and cook for one minute then add the cream and nut mixture. Cook over a medium heat for 10 minutes or until heated through – stirring all the time to ensure all the nuts and rice have mixed well. Spread half the rice over the base and top with half the chile mixture and half the cheese. Repeat with the rest of the rice followed by the rest of the chile mixture and cheese. Pour the whisky and light cream over the top. Stir to combine. Remove from heat. Sprinkle the top with shredded cheese and serve with a few fresh steamed english muffins, some crunchy bread, salad and lots of cauli dolce.

title: Pasta With Chili and Chilli
ingredients: 2 red chili peppers, halved | 150 g pasta, of your choice
instructions: Place chillies in a large, deep frying pan, and cook over a medium heat, stirring often for 10 minutes, until evenly darkened and softened. Add the pasta and boil until it is cooked but still quite firm to the bite. Drain and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: arborio rice,green chilies,red potato,ziti pasta,italian breadcrumb,cornmeal,kaffir lime leaf,chicken meat
title: Rice Baked Ziti
ingredients: 1 lb chicken, cut in large pieces | 3 eggs | 1/2 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup cornmeal | 1 can diced green chilies, drained | 2 kaffir lime leaves, diced | 1 lb red potatoes, cut in half, then diced | 1 lb uncooked ziti pasta, cooked
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f grease a 13x9 glass baking dish. In large bowl, combine chicken, eggs, bread crumbs, cornmeal and chilies. Mix well and transfer to the baking dish, then sprinkle potato, ziti and seasoning on top. Bake uncovered for 40 - 45 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Do not stir.

title: Black Olive Jelly
ingredients:
1/2 cup black olives, finely diced | 2 sheets unflavored gelatin ( about 7 oz.
    - ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1 tablespoon minced cilantro leaves
instructions: Sprinkle gelatin over black olives in bowl.

title: Cape Malay Sauce
ingredients: 3/4 cup palm sugar, or | 3/4 cup light brown sugar | 1 3/4 cups tomato puree ( see note ) ( optional )
instructions: In a medium saucepan over medium heat, stirring until it turns golden brown. It should take about 5 minutes. Stir in the palm of your choice and cook for 1 minute. Add the tomato puree and reduce heat so that the sauce coats the back of a spoon. Allow to simmer for 5 to 10 minutes, stirring constantly, until the sauce thickens and comes to a boil. Remove from heat and serve hot.

title: Grilled Mushroom, Sourdough and Pickle
ingredients: 1 pint lemon sorbet ( or other non-dairy sourdough ) | 2 tablespoons berbere ( spice mix ) | 8 ounces cremini mushrooms, stemmed and thinly sliced | 12 pickle spears
instructions: Prepare the sourdough by combining the sorbet, berbere, mushrooms, and pickles in a bowl. The flavors will blend into each other, so adjust your cooking time accordingly. Preheat the grill to high. Brush a grill basket or a plate with oil and place 1 tablespoon of the prepared mixture. Cook the brad with the grill basket. Cook for 3 minutes or until the mushrooms are bubbling and beginning to brown on the sides when the cutter is lifted out. Turn and cook for 2 more minutes or until the second side is browned.

Random Ingredients: yeast,bread crumb,cardamom seed,serrano pepper,red wine,red snapper fillet,pine nut
title: Pina Colada
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds serrano peppers - rinsed, stemmed, and chopped, divided | 4 pounds red snapper fillets | 3 cups bread crumbs | 1/2 cup pine nuts | 7 cardamom seeds | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried yeast | 1/2 cup red wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Lightly grease a jelly roll pan. Place half of the serrano peppers in a food processor with 1/4 cup of the ground fine or cayenne pepper. Add 1/4 cup of the chopped fine or cayenne pepper and process until very chopped. Transfer the pepper mixture to a large bowl. Add the chopped serrano peppers, 4 of the remaining ground fine or cayenne peppers, the 1/2 cup of cayenne pepper, the 4 cardamom seeds, and the dried yeast. Stir to combine. Cover and allow to rest at room temperature for 10 to 15 minutes. Rinse the remaining 2 serrano peppers under cold water until water runs clear, and pat dry. Coat the fish with the red wine inside and out. Set aside in the refrigerator until chilled. Heat oven to 400 degrees f. Butter the jellyroll pan. Line with a single layer of waxed paper. Working with 1 piece of the fish, spread a scant 1/2 cup of the bread crumbs on the bottom of the prepared pan. Top the crumbs with more bread crumbs, pressing and pressing the bread crumbs into the fish. Layer with 1/2 cup of the ground fine or cayenne pepper mixture, followed by the remaining chopped peppers, 1/2 cup ground fine or cayenne pepper, 1/2 cup ground cayenne pepper or 1 teaspoon ground cardamom seeds, and 1/2 cup red wine. Spread with the second piece of fish. Top with 1/2 cup bread crumbs to make a rough layer. Press the bread crumbs into the fish using the other 1/2 cup of crumbs to make a rough layer. Cover the fish with the waxed paper, and refrigerate overnight. Arrange the fish on top of the bread crumbs, and cover tightly with plastic wrap. Place the jellyroll pan on a baking sheet with a lip. Bake in preheated oven for 45 to 55 minutes. Remove from oven, and allow to cool, then refrigerate.

title: Chipped Beef and Asparagus Rollups
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat | 2 packages nori | 3 cups mango salsa | 4 cups asian vegetables or 4 cups asparagus, steamed
instructions: Cut the beef up in small cubes and trim off any excess fat, if necessary. Roll the beef into a ball shape about the size of the nori sheet it is about 3/4. Place the meat on a plastic wrap or aluminum foil that is about 2 inches wide. Make sure you remove the wrap, or plastic wrap does not work. Place it on your work surface or in a plastic freezer bag. Remove the nori sheet from the freezer. You can just use a rolling pin or a rolling pin to cut it. Place the meat on the nori sheets so it will be easy to work with. Spread the mango salsa evenly over the meat. Place the asparagus or vegetables over the salsa. Starting with one side of the nori sheet, roll it tightly. You are now ready to roll up. Cut the roll into slices about 2 1/2 inches long and then cut each slice diagonally about 3/4 inch wide. Serve at once with rice.

title: Cauliflower Parmesan
ingredients: 1 large cauliflower floret | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 2/3 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1 teaspoon tomato puree
instructions: Preheat a nonstick saute pan over high heat. Combine sauce ingredients and simmer for 3 to 5 minutes. Place florets on saute pan and cover. Reduce heat to medium. Simmer for 4 to 5 minutes, tossing occasionally or until cauliflower is tender but still slightly crisp. Serve with a nice, crusty bread and a sprinkling of fresh herbs and garlic. Make sure you use lots of dry roasted garlic and fresh herbs.

title: Lizzie's Fondue
ingredients: 1/4 cup fresh lemon zest | 2 tablespoons grated, or to taste | 1 cup oil, or as needed | 1/8 cup white rum
instructions: Place lemon zest in a bowl. Stir white rum into grated lemon zest until liquefied. Slowly pour in oil. Heat fondue pot over medium low heat until hot, but not smoking, about 1 minute. Ladle hot oil into fondue pot, tilting to coat bottom. Stir juice.

title: Garlic Soy Milk Pasta
ingredients: 1/2 pinch saffron threads | 1 cup soymilk | 1 pound rigatoni pasta | 1 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium heat. Stir in the saffron.

title: Taco Ring Bread
ingredients: 1 1/4 teaspoons yeast | 1/8 teaspoon crushed marjoram | 1/8 teaspoon taco seasoning mix | 2 1/4 cups warm water | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Add remaining ingredients and mix until blended. Let rise in a warm, draft free place for 5 - 10 minutes, until doubled. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Place in bread pans and bake at 350 for 15 - 20 minutes, or until crust is lightly browned.

title: Bread & Butter Pickles
ingredients: 1 lb bread, unsalted ( use 1/2 a baguette ) | 1 teaspoon dried basil leaves | 1 teaspoon dried yeast | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 2 lbs ground lean pork
instructions: Place the bread, fresh basil, yeast, and garam masala in a large bowl. With your hands, work the mixture together until well blended. Add the pork, and mix well to incorporate the mixture well. Place the bread in an oiled bowl, and place in a warm, draft free spot to rise until the temperature reaches 300°f. Preheat oven to 325°f, slash the top surface with a knife and place a baking dish on the rack below. Fill a dutch oven with warm water, and place over medium heat. Place an ovenproof cutting board into the dutch oven, and fill with warm water to reach 2 3/4 inches above the bottom of the dutch oven.. Pour boiling water into the dutch oven, to reach about 3/4 inch up the side of the dutch oven. Carefully remove the dutch oven from the water with a slotted spoon, draining immediately to cool, on the cutting board. Carefully unroll the bread loaf, place into jars, and label the jars with date, date rings, and/or capers in a jar. You should have about 2 1/2 cups packed volume with a tight seal. Let the pickles come to room temperature, then place them into the refrigerator. Allow the pickles to come to room temperature before using, allowing about 6 hours to mature, stirring once every 10 days to allow the sourness to develop fully before using.

title: Easy Beef Caldillo
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat | 1 lb pork ( cubed ) | 1 can chopped kale ( drained ) | 2/3 cup water | 1 package velveeta cheese
