instructions: Brown stew meat and pork in pan. Drain fat and combine in crock pot. Add kale and the water and cook to your liking. Stir in cheese. Cook on low for 8 - 10 hours. Serve with flour tortillas and other mexican meal.

title: Danish Buttermilk Cantaloupe
ingredients: 1 lb cantaloupe, cut in 3/4-inch chunks | 1 cup buttermilk | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon mirin ( sweet rice wine ) | 2 teaspoons red chile, minced
instructions: Combine melon, buttermilk, vinegar, mirin, chile and chilli in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,lemon juice zest,caper,green olive,green onion,pork shoulder,thyme
title: Mexican Pork Piccata
ingredients: 4 lbs boneless pork shoulder | 4 green onions, sliced 1/2 inch thick | 14 ounces diced canned tomatoes with green chilies | 1/2 cup drained sliced green olives | 2 tablespoons drained capers | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice or 2 tablespoons lime juice | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme
instructions: Place pork in a large casserole dish. Sprinkle onions on top. Add tomatoes, olives, capers, lemon juice, and thyme to wine. Place in refrigerator. Cook for 2 hours in a dutch oven or other heavy pot. Reduce heat and simmer until pork is very tender when pierced with a fork. Discard thyme. Serve.

title: Armenian Rice With Spanish Onions
ingredients: 4 spanish onions | 2 cups basmati rice ( short grain )
instructions: Cook the rice, put 1 cup water in a sauce pan, add the sliced onions and bring to boil. Cover, reduce heat and simmer 45 - 50 minutes, till rice is tender and water absorbed. Remove from heat and fluff with fork.

Random Ingredients: italian seasoning,ginger garlic paste,horseradish,sirloin,bay leaf,cointreau liqueur
title: Steak in Cointreau
ingredients: 4 lbs sirloin or 4 lbs flank steaks | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning | 1 tablespoon cointreau liqueur | 1/2 cup horseradish, grated | 1 bay leaf, preferably fresh
instructions: Trim fat from meat and cut into 6 servings on the flat sides with a sharp knife. Mix together ginger garlic paste italian seasoning, cointreau liqueur horseradish and bay leaf and coat meat with rub. Place in heavy bottomed crock. Cover and refrigerate for 6 hours. Preheat broiler. Place rack 4 from broiler element and heat coke on high 20 seconds, turn and repeat to cook other side. Serve with noodles or rice with a green salad.

title: Cottage Cheese, Orange and Coconut Soup With Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 150 g cottage cheese ( cottage cheese works best ) | 1/4 orange, peeled and grated | 2 teaspoons single cream | 1/2 yellow onion, peeled washed and finely chopped | 100 g coconut cream
instructions: Bring some water to a boil in a pot. Add the cottage cheese and grated orange. Boil until the cottage cheese is firm. Remove from heat. Place bowl under cold water and leave it for 1 - 2 minutes. Strain. Squeeze out excess water. Put the white part of the onion in a bowl. Sauté it in the hot water for 2 minutes, or until golden brown. Add the browned onion to the bowl along with the grated coconut cream. Mix well. Chill. Serve chilled with dipping sauce.

Random Ingredients: chili sauce,hot chicken broth,olive oil,fettuccine pasta,mint,egg,sourdough bread,oil
title: Fettuccine Phyllo
ingredients: 5 slices firm sourdough bread ( about 1 pound ) | olive oil, for brushing | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 8 fluid ounces hot chicken broth | flour, for dusting | 1/4 cup chili sauce | 4 large eggs | 1/4 cup chopped of fresh mint | 2 cups cooked small fettuccine pasta
instructions: Preheat broiler to medium. Place bread on a baking sheet coated with olive oil and broil 3 to 5 minutes or until lightly toasted. Flip and broil additional 2 minutes or until golden and soft. Cut bread in half crosswise and scoop out and discard gread. Slice bread in half and scoop out and discard the bread and spread each half with 1 tablespoon of the olive oil. Heat broth in a medium nonstick skillet over low heat. Whisk flour in hot broth and cook until slightly thickened about 1 minute. Quickly whisk shrimp sauce and eggs into broth in skillet. Cook and stir until eggs are barely set, about 1 minute. Add pasta and cook 3 to 5 minutes or until pasta is tender, stirring frequently. Remove skillet from heat and sprinkle with mint. Place the reserved bread slices on a cookie sheet and lightly brush with olive oil. Place under broiler to toast bread and lightly brown lightly. Remove and set aside. Cut bread in eighths and place on baking sheet. Heat 1 to 2 inches of olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Working in batches, cook bread in oil until golden and crispy, about 5 minutes total cooking time. Transfer to plate and drizzle with remaining 2 tablespoons of olive oil. Top each piece of toasted bread with 1/3 of the shrimp sauce and 1/3 of the egg mixture, then top with 1 to 3 mint leaves.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack pepper cheese,tortilla chip,rotel tomato chilies,almond extract,cilantro,frangelico,sea salt
title: Roasted Salsa With Crushed Tortilla Chips
ingredients: 1 can diced rotel tomatoes & chilies | 1 1/2 cups shredded monterey jack pepper cheese | 2 tablespoons finely chopped cilantro | 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh cilantro | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 1/4 teaspoon sea salt | 1 bag tortilla chips ( this recipe will make about 1 1/2 cups total )
instructions: Place the tomatoes, cheese, chopped cilantro, almond extract and salt in a food processor or blender. Process until smooth. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the salsa to a large serving bowl. Add crushed tortilla chips, mix gently with a fork, and serve.

title: Mexican Melon Dip
ingredients: 4 kirsch | 8 ounces honeydew melon, peeled and cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 envelope taco seasoning mix
instructions: Place kirsch in a large microwave safe clear glass bowl. Cook on high in a microwave until melted, 5 - 10 minutes. Stir in honeydew and taco seasoning. Cover and microwave on high 10 minutes or until melon is softened and translucent. Serve with corn chips.

title: Shrimp & Asiago Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 lb medium raw shrimp, peeled & deveined | 2 tablespoons catsup | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder, to taste | 6 ounces aandou cheese or 6 ounces monterey jack cheese, shredded | 1 tablespoon tarragon, minced | 1/2 teaspoon taco seasoning, to taste | 1 tablespoon creme fraiche
instructions: Place shrimp in glass dish or ceramic dish, sprinkle with catsup & cumin and stir to coat. Combine cheese with tarragon, tabasco and taco seasoning. Pour over shrimp & chill till ready to serve. Add more cumin to taste if desired.

title: Arepas
ingredients: 16 fluid ounces masa harina | 8 fluid ounces ketchup | 1 teaspoon green chili, canned if you have it
instructions: Pour all the ingredients into a large bowl and work together until well combined. Cover with a towel and leave for an hour minimum. On a lightly floured board, roll out the dough. Cut into 3/4 inch thick circles. Heat a frypan and a heavy based fry pan together. Brush rounds with oil and fry on both sides until golden. Serve hot. Tip, do not substitute ketchup for the green chili or the amount of vinegar you use, because the taste can vary from chile to coriander.

title: Cocaine Kale
ingredients: 4 cups kale, shredded, tough stems discarded | 1 tablespoon cayenne pepper | 1 teaspoon sazon goya
instructions: Steam the kale with the cayenne pepper and sazon in a pot, covered, until tender, about 25 minutes. Transfer kale to a serving dish. Serve topped with additional sazon.

title: Crispy Rice from the Crock Pot
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless center-cut beef brisket | 3 slices bacon, chopped | 2 tablespoons taco seasoning | 3 cups cooked brown rice | 2 cups milk | 1/2 teaspoon dried dill weed
instructions: Place the brown rice in the bottom of a 3 1/2 quart crockpot.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,green serrano chilies,salmon,spaghetti sauce,sharp cheddar cheese,tomato puree,orange blossom water,beef stew meat
title: Torta Di Riso (Chile and Salmon Soup With Spaghetti and Orange Blossom Water)
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb thin sliced beef stew meat ( or extra lean beef ) | 2 cans tomato puree ( preferably italian ) | 2 cans green serrano chilies, with seeds, split and thinly sliced ( more or less, to taste ) | 2 jars spaghetti sauce ( preferably homemade or purchased ) | 1 cup chopped fresh tomato ( optional ) | 1 1 teaspoon orange blossom water ( optional ) | 1/2 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese ( about 1/3 cup ) | 1/2 cup fresh grated sharp cheddar cheese ( about 3/4 cup ) or 1/2 cup sharp bheddar cheese ( about 3/4 cup ) | spaghettini or linguine
instructions: Place the meat in a dutch oven with the tomato puree, the green chile peppers, and the spaghetti sauce, and mix well to blend. Bring this mixture to a boil. Cover, reduce heat to lowest setting, and simmer gently for 1 hour, stirring halfway through. At least 15 minutes before serving, stir in the chopped tomato and the orange blossom water just before serving, if using, the parmigiano reggiano cheese and the fresh cheddar cheese — and simmer for 5 minutes longer to make a smooth soup.

title: Date and Lamb Baked for 2
ingredients: 1 lb lean lamb | 1/2 lb dates
instructions: Cut the meat into slices about 1 inch thick. Place one slice of the dates in an ovenproof dish. Cover the meat with another slice of dates. Place the dates around the meat and pour boiling water over them. Cover and bake for about 2 hours until cooked.

title: Quick & Easy Calzone
ingredients:
1 cup pre-shredded mozzarella cheese ( approx.
    - 1.
    -5 m oz ) | 3 -4 tablespoons black sesame seeds ( for sprinkling ) | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon grated fresh nutmeg | 1/2 - 1 tablespoon broth ( your favorite homemade broth )
instructions: Sprinkle the sesame seeds lightly & then mix well. Sprinkle the nutmeg on top of the nutmeg. Layer in a 9 circle, sprinkling & sprinkling the mozzarella cheese on top. In a small bowl, mix all the ingredients well & pour onto the cheese. Cut in half to serve, or place on a platter & serve warm. It can also be served cold on italian bread.

title: Simple English Cukes (Gurkensalat)
ingredients: 3 english cucumbers ( unpeeled ) | 1 -2 tablespoon lemon juice
instructions: Cut cucumbers lengthwise into very thin slices, then slice each into thin strips and then through very thin ribbons. Squeeze out excess moisture and place on a serving platter. Sprinkle with lemon juice. Serve warm, room temp or chilled.

title: Ricotta Spread or "lasagna "
ingredients: 10 ounces ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons tomato paste | 1/4 cup raisins or 1/4 cup black raisins | 4 -6 pinches of fresh mint | 2 -3 pieces green olives, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a blender and blend well. Spray a baking sheet with olive oil, line it with foil so it doesn't slide out. Put spread on the pan around evenly. Sprinkle with more raisins/sundian or any other favorite topping you like. Bake at 350 for 25 - 30 minutes. Serve with fresh salad or fresh fruit. Can be prepared ahead of serving.

title: Cranberry Pancakes
ingredients: cooking oil | 4 -5 scallions, chopped | 1/4 cup fresh cranberries or 1/4 cup frozen cranberries | 1/2 - 3/4 cup soy sauce
instructions: Add cooking oil to a skillet and heat over medium heat. When oil is hot add chopped scallions and cook until light brown. Add dried cranberries and cover. Allow to fry for 3 - 4 minutes, stirring until all cranberries have popped and are slightly browned. In a small bowl combine soy sauce, and the desired amount of soy sauce.

title: Fryed Spinach
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs fresh spinach leaves | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 2 cups fresh flatleaf spinach leaves
instructions: Wash, dry and clean the spinach. Wash well and boil in plenty of water for 2 - 3 minutes drain and squeeze out as much water as possible. Drain well and squeeze hard. Remove as much excess water as possible. Mash the spinach further and mix with the cornflour, adding a little extra water if required. Heat oil to 375°. Tip into frying pan and fry on gentle, steady and without lid, for about 3 - 10 minutes depending on the thickness. When golden brown, drain on kitchen paper and serve immediately.

title: Sweetened Pina Colada #5FIX
ingredients: 1 package simply potatoes stretching cheese | 1 jar sweetened pineapple with juice, cut into large chunks | 1 cup pineapple juice | 2 cups gorgonzola
instructions: Heat up the pineapple juice with the gorgonzola. Add sweetened pineapple to the bowl and stir. Then add simply potatoes starch and mix. Add 1 cup of sugar and mix. Dip the gorgonzola into the pineapple juice then refrigerate for 1 - 2 days. Remove from refrigerator and serve.

title: Spiced Red Pepper Condiment
ingredients: 2 ounces red peppers | 4 scallions, including tender green tops, finely sliced | 2 teaspoons cumin seeds | 1 -2 teaspoon pure vanilla extract
instructions: Finely grind red pepper and scallions in spice mill. Mix in remaining ingredients and store in airtight container.

title: Chicken Drumsticks With Currants and Raisins
ingredients: 6 chicken legs with thigh, skin on | 2 cups currants | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Put chicken legs in a shallow ovenproof dish. Pour currants and red pepper flakes over. Sprinkle with garlic powder. Bake in a 200 degree celsius oven for 2 hours. Serve with basmati rice.

title: Rosemary Beef Cheese Dip
ingredients: 4 ounces chopped stewing beef | 2 ounces cream cheese | 1/4 teaspoon dried rosemary
instructions: In small bowl stir together cream cheese, rosemary & beef mixture. Cover & refrigerate several hours or overnight. Serve with crackers.

title: Beef Lover's Style - Marinated Stew
ingredients: 1 jar spaghetti, or other small pasta, with character | 1 cup rotini pasta or other small pasta, with character | 1 package boneless chicken breast halves, with bite | 1 1/2 pounds boneless beef roast, cut across the grain into 1/2-inch chunks | 8 cloves fresh mace, finely chopped | 1 pound medium shrimp, peeled and deveined
instructions: Place the rotini or small pasta and rotini in a pot big enough to hold the whole chicken. Rinse the chicken breasts lightly, then cut them into 1/2 inch chunks and add them to the pot. Sprinkle the mushrooms over all of the chicken and veggies, then sprinkle the freshly chopped mace over everything. Add just enough water to cover.

title: Mango Chutney
ingredients: 2 cups mango pulp | 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Mix mango pulp and mustard together in a bowl until well mixed. Refrigerate for 3 to 4 hours to blend flavors. Enjoy.

title: Barbecue Parsnip and Cranberry Pilaf
ingredients: 4 parsnips, cut into small wedges | 1 tablespoon dried oregano leaves | 2 tablespoons dried cranberries | 1 small onion, cut into eighths | 1 teaspoon chili oil | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh spearmint | 1 fresh sweet cherry pepper, cut into thin slices
instructions: Place parsnips in a large bowl. Place oregano, cranberries and onions in another bowl. Pour oil over vegetables. Stir until cranberries have melted, about 2 minutes. Top with cherry slices and parsnips.

title: Lemongrass Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 lime, cut in 4 pieces | 1 stalk lemongrass, finely chopped | 2 slices brioche bread, cut diagonally into 1/4-inch slices | 1 bag plain cooked basmati rice
instructions: Sprinkle the lemon grass over one side of the cut side of the brioche bread slices, then place 2 slices in each of 4 bowls. Top with 1 more slice of lime to make 4 servings. Bring a pot of water to a boil, immerse the bowls in the water for 2 seconds, and remove. Dip the rice into a bowl full of hot water to cover, then shake excess water out onto a plate. Dip rice into lime juice, allowing excess to drain back into bowl. Heat a wok over medium heat. Add enough oil to coat the surface. Place a bamboo steamer over the wok, and steam the bowls until the rice is pliable, but not dry, 3 to 5 minutes. Wipe out the wok with some paper towels. Transfer 2 fried rice bowls onto the plate with the lemon grass, and spread 1 slice of brioche on top. Use the juice from the lime to moisten the rice.

title: Pesto Creamed Noodles
ingredients: 8 ounces smoked bacon, chopped | 1 cup half-and-half cream | 2 cups grated jalapeno jack cheese | 1 package vermicelli, cooked
instructions: Boil vermicelli until just tender. Drain and then stir in bacon. In a large, greased saucpan, combine half and half with chopped jalapenos. Place cheese on top of vermicelli until melted. Spread over cheese.

Random Ingredients: rice wrapper,mushroom,ginger root,mace,beef chuck roast,roasting chicken,sugar syrup,apple juice
title: Shanghai Pork
ingredients: 1/4 cup apple juice | 3/4 cup light rum or 3/4 cup light rum flavoring | 2 tablespoons sugar syrup | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace, or to taste | 2 tablespoons minced fresh ginger root | 2 lbs boneless beef chuck roast, trimmed | 2 large mushrooms, thinly sliced | 16 rice wrappers | 1 roasting chickens ( optional ) or 4 jamaican-style pickling mushrooms ( optional )
instructions: Stir together the apple juice, rum, sugar and mace in a small bowl.

title: Cherry Steak With Watermelon
ingredients: 300 g rump steak | 1 1/2 cups watermelon, cut into thin slices | 200 g cherries, pitted and sliced
instructions: Brush meat with a little water and grill until slightly charred. Combine watermelon and cherries. Place steaks on serving tray, and pour over remaining cooking juices.

title: Prawn and Broccoli in Lemon Poached Lemons
ingredients: 2 cups dry pinto beans, cooked | 3 cups broccoli, cooked ( see notes ) | 4 slices prosciutto | 1 teaspoon lemon zest | 1 lb raw prawns, peeled and deveined ( approx 1 1/4 lbs, shelled and deveined )
instructions: Note, if using frozen shelled prawns, defrost them first and set aside. Bring water to a boil and add prawns. Cook uncovered until prawns are just cooked, about 3 - 5 minutes. Add 2 tbsp lemon juice, boil until prawns are just cooked but not fully opaque. Rinse prawns under running water. Drain. Set aside. Boil 1 cup of the poaching liquid. Add beans and broccoli to the boiling liquid and cook until beans have softened, about 5 minutes. Add prosciutto and half the lemon zest. Cook until prosciutto is softened, about 2 minutes. Place prawns on serving dish and top with the pepper sauce. Mound the beans and broccoli mixture over the prawns.

title: Beef Nut Cookies
ingredients: 1 lb round steak, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 2 links mild italian sausage | 1 package chicken tenderloins | 1/2 cup cashews, chopped | 1/2 cup pecans, chopped | 1 egg white | 2 teaspoons baking soda | 2 cups quick toasted cashews
instructions: Thoroughly mix all ingredients well and place in a large shallow baking pan or 9x13 inch baking dish. Preheat broiler.

title: Cambodian Beef Stew With Crabmeat
ingredients: 1 lb beef sirloin | 3 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 1/2 lb crabmeat | 1/4 cup slivered almonds | 2 avocados
instructions: Heat oil to medium in a medium skillet. Sear the beef until browned. Add oyster sauce, chili powder and crab meat. Cover and simmer 5 minutes. Served on a platter with wedges of avocado, sliced tomatoes, shredded cheddar cheese and sliced almonds. Note, if you prefer to serve this dish in a clay oven, line the bottom of the clay dish with a layer of shredded cheese and add a few more toppings to taste. Continue layering ingredients until all ingredients are used. Serve with rice and a green vegetable such as carrots, radishes, or peas.

title: Turnip and Caramelized Veal Vodka Cream Cocktail
ingredients: 4 turnsips, peeled ( or about 2 pounds ) | 1 cup cider vinegar | 1 cup sweet chinese wine ( such as shaoxing or shaoxing ) | 1/4 cup dry chinese wine or 1/4 cup light beer | 1 1/4 cups light cream | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 2 teaspoons vanilla vodka
instructions: Place turnips in a large pot of cold or salted water.

title: Hot Red Chile Scented Dusting
ingredients: 1 red chilies or 1 green chili pepper | 1/2 cup cognac or 1/2 cup brandy | 1/4 cup liquid smoke flavoring
instructions: Trim stems and seeds from chilies. Finely chop chilies. Combine all ingredients and place in sealable plastic bag.

title: Barbecue Glaze for Beef
ingredients: 1 cup sugar | 1 cup barbecue sauce | 3/4 cup walnut oil or 3/4 cup canola oil | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar
instructions: Stir the sugar, bbq sauce, oil, vinegar and hot pepper oil together. Dry the roast and place in a shallow roasting pan or in a small, heavy duty foil roasting pan. Spread the glaze over the roast. Cover the roasting pan with aluminum foil and bake in a preheated 350°f oven for about 1 1/2 hours. Let stand 5 minutes, then cut into cubes. Brush again as glaze is drying and serving.

Random Ingredients: jasmine rice,dressing,cheddar cheese,pickling cucumber,yellow pepper,chipotle pepper
title: Grilled Chipotle Rice and Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds mustard-flavoured jasmine rice | 1 tablespoon pickling cucumber pickles, chopped | 1 yellow pepper, sliced | 1/2 cup diced cheddar cheese | 1 can chipotle peppers, seeded and minced | 1 dash jalanae peppers ( optional )
instructions: Rinse rice until water is cloudy, drain, and pat dry with paper towels. Combine rice, cucumber pickles, yellow pepper, cheddar cheese, chipotle peppers, and jalanae peppers in a large bowl. Mix well, and cover. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours. Remove from refrigerator, and stir well before serving.

title: Microwave Mexican Queso Dip
ingredients: 1/4 cup sofrito | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack cheese or 1/2 cup mexican cheese
instructions: Combine sofrito and cheese in a medium bowl. Microwave on high 1 minute. Stir. Microwave on high 1 more minute. Let cool slightly. Stir and serve with assorted crackers.

title: Greek "baked Tomatoes" Appetizer
ingredients: 12 grape tomatoes, halved | 1/4 cup crumbled feta cheese | 10 pitted kalamata olives, chopped | 1/4 cup fresh thyme sprig | fresh herb, of choice
instructions: Mix tomato halves, feta cheese, olives and thyme until tomatoes are evenly coated. Cover surface evenly with plastic wrap. Set into a very cold oven. Bake in a preheated 400°f oven until cheese is melted and topping is lightly browned, about 15 minutes. Sprinkle with herb of choice.

title: Mustard Dill With Pecans
ingredients: 1 cup pecans | 1/4 cup coarse grain dijon mustard | 1 1/2 teaspoons baking soda | 1 tablespoon fresh dill, minced
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°&deg.

title: Sambalaya Fish (Cured Salmon)
ingredients: 1 cup dried salted salmon | 1/2 onion | 1/2 cup tamarind paste ( dark-colored paste ) | kosher salt
instructions: Soak the salmon in water in a small pot over night. The water should be just covering the salmon. If it is not, pour off any excess water, and set the salmon's soaking water about 5 inches above the level of the fish. Soak the onion in the warm water, turning once, for 30 minutes. Drain any excess water. Pour the soaked salmon and onion in a stainless steel bowl. Stir in the tamarind paste and some salt. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight. The next day, rinse the bowl with cold water and pat dry on a clean cloth towel. This will make cleanly and sterile fish. Refrigerate until you need to use it.

Random Ingredients: broccoli floret,cheese,spanish onion,white bread,basil leaf,taco seasoning,cherry,ginger ale
title: Veggies on Toast
ingredients: 1 package cheese, sliced into four pieces | 8 -12 slices white bread | 1 bottle ginger ale ( or apple cider ) | 1 package taco seasoning | 4 -6 fresh basil leaves | 1 large spanish onion, thinly sliced ( optional ) | 4 1/2 cups broccolini florets | 10 -15 fresh cherry tomatoes, halved or 10 -15 grape tomatoes
instructions: Place two slices of bread on each of four plates or a plate. Place cheese slices on top and add one slice of onion. Place slices of bread next to cheese mixture. Top each slice of toast with one of the remaining slices of cheese. Add the ginger ale or apple cider, a pinch of taco seasoning and 1 to 2 teaspoons of basil to the tops of the toast. Sprinkle remaining chopped basil on top. Garnish with cherry tomatoes. Serve.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,ricotta cheese,lime juice,pecorino romano cheese
title: Chef John's Crouching Ricotta!
ingredients: 1/2 cup ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons grated pecorino-romano cheese | 1 teaspoon lime juice | salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Stir together the ricotta cheese, pecorino cheese, lime juice, salt and pepper and set aside. Heat a grill pan over medium low heat. Coat the grill pan with cooking spray and preheat until hot. Place the ricotta mixture into a serving dish and gently press into a 9 inch circle. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: garam masala,pineapple juice,granny smith apple,romano cheese,anise oil,shell pasta
title: Tina's Appetizer Shells
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked shell pasta | 1 granny smith apple, cored and chopped | 1/3 cup pineapple juice | 1 tablespoon garam masala | 1/4 teaspoon anise oil | 1/4 cup shredded romano cheese
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling water until al dente. Drain. Rinse inside of shell to remove excess water. Transfer to large bowl. Stir apples, pineapple juice, garam masala, and anise oil together in bowl. Stir cheese into bowl mixture until smooth.

title: Fiery Party Chimichurri
ingredients: 1 cup seedless fresh seedless grape leaves | 1 lb ground sirloin | 1 tablespoon ground cumin | 1 teaspoon ground cumin powder
instructions: In a large skillet over medium heat, heat grape leaves until lightly brown and fragrant, approximately 3 minutes. Mix together ground sirloin, ground cumin and cumin powder using your hands. Divide into freezer bags. Wipe bag completely. Add contents of freezer bags to skillet. Cook, stirring, until meat mixture is slightly browned.

title: Chile Pepper Fried Rice II
ingredients: 1/8 cup finely chopped chipotle peppers | 1/4 cup hot cooked long-grain white rice | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar, or as needed
instructions: Place chipotle peppers in a small bowl. Pour hot rice into a separate small bowl. Add confectioners' sugar to taste.

Random Ingredients: stewing beef,maple syrup,broccoli floret,mozzarella cheese,date,chili,vanilla essence
title: Crusty Chilli Beef Burger
ingredients: 500 g chuck steaks | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 2 tablespoons pure chili | 2 tablespoons diced dates | 1 1/2 tablespoons maple syrup | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence | 2 cups frozen broccoli florets | 1 cup grated mozzarella cheese
instructions: Chop steak into cubes of approx 2 in size. Mix all of the chilli sauce ingredients together in a bowl and add the steak. Place into a non stick pan with the broccoli over medium high heat. Cook on high for 6 - 7 minutes each side or until cooked to your liking. Place all of the burger on an oven tray and top with the prepared chilli sauce. Sprinkle with the mozzarella cheese. Bake on a moderate to hot griddle for 5 minutes on each side until cheese is melted and gooey. Serve with a side of salad and salad.

Random Ingredients: coriander powder,salt substitute,head iceberg lettuce,corn tortilla chip,cardamom seed,cremini mushroom,sea salt
title: Spiced Mushroom Nachos
ingredients: 1/2 lb cremini mushroom ( sliced or diced ) | 1/2 head iceberg lettuce, thinly sliced | 1 teaspoon fresh cardamom seeds | sea salt, to taste | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 2 tablespoons corn tortilla chips, lightly crushed | salt substitute, to taste
instructions: Sprinkle sea salt on the mushrooms, then place chopped mushrooms on them to proof. Sprinkle coriander and coriander powders on them. Fold the tortillas over the mushrooms, and let sit for five minutes. Toast the chips in a frying pan over medium high heat, then crumble them onto a plate. Spoon some melted butter onto the nachos and serve hot, or cold..

title: Rooster and Potato Salad - Microwave!
ingredients: 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 medium potato | 1 small courgette | 1 teaspoon english mustard | 2 teaspoons thyme
instructions: Peel the potato & courgette & cut into chunks. Roughly chop the thyme and mix together with the remaining oil. Place in a microwave safe bowl, cover and cook in microwave on high for 5 - 10 minutes or until the potato and courgette are tender and well cooked. Check after 5 minutes & stir a few times. Remove the bowl from the microwave & stir through the mustard. Serve straight away or keep warm. This can also be made without the mustard or mustard oil. For each bowl, spoon 1 tsp of mustard into the centre of a plate & spread 1/2tsp of the courgette mixture over the mustard.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,barley,dark raisin,amarula cream liqueur
title: The Airma Cafe Barley Chutney
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups chopped yellow bell peppers ( or green bell pepper ) | 2 cups chopped dark raisins ( optional ) | 1 1/2 cups fresh barley ( or red if you wish ) | 1/2 cup amarula cream liqueur
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a 1 1/2 quart microwave safe casserole dish. Cover, and cook on high for 15 minutes. Stir, and continue cooking another 5 minutes, until the mixture is thick and the peppers are tender.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,baking potato,green bean,beer,sun tomato oil
title: Broiled Potatoes and Beans
ingredients: 2 baking potatoes, peeled and cut into 1-inch chunks | 4 ounces frozen cut green beans, thawed and drained | 8 ounces fresh small whole-grain beer | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and thinly sliced ( from a 1-oz jar ) | 2 -4 tablespoons thinly sliced crisp-cooked bacon, such as chorizo
instructions: Preheat broiler. In a medium bowl, toss potatoes with green beans, beer, and sun dried tomatoes. Place on a rack in a baking dish or roasting pan. Broil about 6 inches from heat for about 10 minutes or until just tender and beginning to brown.

Random Ingredients: cornstarch,half,hazelnut,turkey,curry powder,coffee granule,golden raisin,extra virgin olive oil
title: Moroccan Turkey Gravy
ingredients: 2 tablespoons hazelnuts, toasted and slivered | 1 teaspoon instant coffee granules | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 32 ounces turkey fat ( or turkey stock ) | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 cup half-and-half | 1/8 cup golden raisin | extra virgin olive oil
instructions: In a large saucepan, saute the hazelnuts and instant coffee granules for 3 to 5 mins remove them and stir in the curry powder until dissolved cook for 2 to 3 mins add the turkey fat. Heat through until it thickens, then add the cornstarch and cook 2 minutes. Add half and half and cook a couple of seconds longer. Stir in the raisins, and heat through serve over couscous.

Random Ingredients: red cabbage,spinach leaf,head iceberg lettuce,lettuce,graham cracker crumb
title: Red Cabbage Spinach Romanesco
ingredients: 1 package spinach leaves, washed | 12 ounces red cabbage, drained | 1 head iceberg lettuce, shredded | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1/2 cup shredded red cabbage | 1 bag regular lettuce
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Blend the spinach leaves and red cabbage in a blender until smooth. Set aside. Place the torn lettuce in a separate large bowl and place the graham cracker crumbs in another bowl. Mix the shredded cabbage into the crumbs. Layer the spinach and cabbage mixture with the graham cracker crumbs, red cabbage and graham cracker crumbs. Sauté for 10 minutes in the preheated oven. Remove from the oven and let cool for at least 1/2 an hour. Slice the Romanesco into 1/4 inch slices and serve.

title: Ricotta and Olive Crostini
ingredients: 250 g fat-free cottage cheese | 150 g sachet rustic ricotta cheese | 50 g kalamata olives, chopped | 50 g low fat ricotta cheese
instructions: Process both cheeses in food processor, adding a little olive oil to get a creamy texture. Serve over crostini and pesto.

title: Pink Grapefruit and Corn Baked in Cheese
ingredients: 4 cups frozen tiny pink grapesfruit ( or fresh grapefruits, if fresh are not available ) | 4 cups frozen corn, thawed | 25 g caster sugar | 120 g grated fresh parmesan cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 150degc. Arrange grapes and corn in a baking dish. Sprinkle sugar over. Stir to combine, then pour over half the cheese. Dot the rest of the cheese over the top and sprinkle on the rest of the cheese. Bake for 25 - 30 minutes or until golden and bubbling. Let cool for 5 minutes then serve.

title: Bosc (African Orange Fritters)
ingredients: 2 cups thickened cream of tartar | 1 cup peanut oil or 1 cup vegetable oil | 1 tablespoon orange sections, finely chopped or 1 tablespoon citron peel, finely chopped
instructions: Mix one cup of the cream of tartar. Beat the remaining cup of cream until very thick, then gradually beat in the sugar or a little more of the cream until the mixture has the texture of stiff peaks. Stir in the orange, orange juice and orange peel. Pour the mixture into a bowl and refrigerate it until ready to serve. Serve hot as an appetizer with walnut, brown rice or bread.

Random Ingredients: rice noodle,soymilk,sugar cube,chipotle chile adobo,chuck,yogurt,yellow lentil
title: Adobong (Filipino Beef With Lentils)
ingredients: 200 g rice noodles | 250 g ground chuck | 1/2 cup instant yellow lentils or 1/2 cup jasmine rice vermicelli | 1/4 cup soymilk | 1/4 cup yogurt | 2 chipotle chiles in adobo ( minced or crushed ) | 2 sugar cubes
instructions: Prepare noodles and let drain in a bowl. Mix well with the spices. When noodles are finished mix with beef. Then mix with douse soaked rice noodles and serve as you would traditionally.

title: Escabeche (Sweet Potato) and Broccoli
ingredients: 1/2 lb yam, peeled and diced 1/2-inch | 1/2 lb broccoli floret, sliced 1/4 inch thick and halved | 1/2 ounce dried shiitake mushrooms, soaked in tepid water | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar
instructions: Preheat broiler, line baking sheet with aluminum foil. Microwave yam and broccoli in boiling water 5 minutes, until tender, set aside. Stir together potatoes, shiitake mushrooms, mushrooms, and vinegar. Gently stir in yam and broccoli. Spoon mixture into small baking dish. Cover with foil. Cook 1 1/2 hours or until vegetables are crisp tender.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,green prawn,veal shank,steak,green chile pepper
title: Beef, Pork and Green Prawns (Mexican style)
ingredients: 8 ounces boneless veal shank | 8 ounces boneless veal shank | 12 tablespoons self-rising flour | 1/2 cup chopped green chile peppers | 8 ounces green prawns, shelled and cooked
instructions: Cook the shank until lightly browned and tender before trimming off any excess fat. Wash the veal and prawns under running water and dry with paper towels. Remove and discard any meat that clings, then slice into 1/4 inch slices. Place the flour in a clean, dry non metallic bowl. Add the chile peppers and prawns. Add half of the prawns and prawns and mix until well combined. Stir into the dry ingredients until the mixture is just sticky enough to roll into little flat shapes and not too sticky. Transfer to a greased ovenproof dish. Top with remaining prawns and prawns and bake in a moderately hot oven for 30 minutes or until prawns are just cooked through and tender. Serve immediately.

title: French Lamb - Crock Pot
ingredients: 1 lamb, halved and fat trimmed | 1 rosemary sprig | basil ( to personal taste ) | 1 -2 cup oyster, shucked, cold and halved
instructions: Pound together the honey and rosemary in a mortar. Trim the lamb of unnecessary fat, and score the tops in places with a sharp knife. Rub the garlic onto the lamb using the rosemary. Place the lamb in a pot or crock. If using the oysters, add them at the beginning so they don’t open up on you. Put the lid, lid over, and slow cook on high for 6 - 8 hours, depending on the size. The lamb should become slightly dark and tender.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,active yeast,russian salad dressing,drumstick leaf,frangelico,beef stock,kernel corn
title: Russian Beef and Corn Soup
ingredients: 2 lbs lean stewing beef | 2 lbs fresh frozen whole kernel corn, thawed | 12 fresh rumstick leaves | 10 cups beef stock | 2 teaspoons active dry yeast, dissolved in | 1/4 cup russian salad dressing ( good stuff ) | salt and pepper | drumstick leaf
instructions: Place the beef in the crock, along with the corn.

title: Broccoli Turnips and Turnips
ingredients: 1 bunch broccoli | 1 turnip
instructions: Wash and cut the turnip into 4 thick slices. Cut the turnip in half and peel off the thick skin. Cut the turnip into 2 inch wedges with the knife. Cut the broccoli into small lengths and wash the turnip. Place them on a large microwave safe dish and cover with 2 full tablespoons of boiling water. Microwave on high for 10 minutes. Add the broccoli to the water the turnip will cook in. Cover with a saran wrap and microwave on high for 10 minutes or until cooked through. Remove the saran wrap and fluff with a fork and serve.

title: Tuna and Sweet Potato in Pineapple
ingredients: 1 can sweet potatoes with shell ( such as kumara ) | 2 cans tuna, drained | 1 bottle bordeaux-style burgundy wine or ( 12 ounce ) bottle other red burgundy wine | 1 tablespoon baking soda | 1 -2 cup shredded cheese, to taste ( optional )
instructions: Pierce sweet potato with a fork in several places. Slice into about 4 wedges. Put on plate and microwave until tender and hot. Drain potatoes on paper towels. Microwave tuna, sweet potato, drained tuna, and bordeaux wine together on high power until heated through, about 2 minutes. Stir to combine. Taste for seasoning. Top with cheese and serve.

title: Lechon (French Cream Cheese) (Greece)
ingredients:
8 -12 large leeks, white and pale green parts only, washed well and cut in half.
    - | 3/4 cup whipping cream | 1 lime, sliced, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Place one half of your leeks into a cheese cloth, fold in the edges and roll up, twisting the ends as you do so. Wipe off any excess moisture. Place in a deep, heavy pot, cover and melt over low heat. When the leeks are golden and very soft, add the cream, cover and bring to a simmer over low heat. Turn the mixture over once or twice, remove from the heat, cover and let sit for 5 - 6 hours. Remove the leeks from the sauce and transfer to serving dishes. Pour the sauce over the top. Garnish with lime slices.

title: Quinoa Bread
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 2/3 cup breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon baking powder | 2 carrots ( finely grated )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f rinse the quinoa in a colander, then add it to a bowl. Soak for 20 minutes. Place in your oven, stir, then cook for 10 minutes.. Meanwhile, spray the inside of a cupcake pan with cooking spray, then spread out the quinoa on a tray and bake in your oven for 10 - 15 minutes. Remove from oven, stir, then return to oven for 30 more minutes. Remove from over and cool for 10 minutes. While the quinoa was cooling, grate the carrots and put them into a small bowl. Drain the dried quinoa, then add to bowl. Using your hands, mix in the carrots. After 10 minutes of baking, fluff the quinoa with a fork, then add to bowl with the carrots. Stir well, then serve warm.

title: Gnocchi With Fruit
ingredients: 1 package gnocchi | 1 green pepper, chopped | 1/2 cup finely chopped mixed dried fruit | 1 pinch ground nutmeg
instructions: Cook gnocchi in salted water according to package directions. Drain and stir in green pepper, mixed dried fruit and nutmeg. Serve with freshly cooked parmesan cheese on the side.

Random Ingredients: yellow cornmeal,tea,pearl barley,queso fresco,brown lentil,roasting chicken,mustard powder
title: Crazy Barley Chicken With Lentils
ingredients: 5 -6 lbs roasting chickens ( i have had 3 ) | 1 can dried brown lentils | 5 tablespoons dried split yellow cornmeal | 1 tablespoon mustard powder | 1 medium yellow cornmeal | 1/2 cup oaxacan queso fresco or 1/2 cup feta cheese | 1 1/2 cups tequila ( or other light liquer ) or 1 1/2 cups other mexican beer ( or other light liquer )
instructions: Preheat oven to 275°f. Scrub outside of chicken with a brush, rub salt and pepper inside and out. Rinse and drain lentils, rinse and drain. Dredge chicken in yellow cornmeal. Place in single layer in a baking dish and roast in oven for 1 1/2 hours or until thermometer reads 180f. Remove from oven and place on a platter. Cut remaining two chicken thighs off and discard. Take chicken out of oven. Remove any fat from roasting pan and coat with queso fresco or other desired spice. Return to oven and roast for an additional 15 - 20 minutes then slice across the breast or into thin ribbons. Place cooked chicken back on the hob or heat in the microwave for 20 minutes, remove and let rest for ten minutes. Place lentils in a pot with about 1½ inches water and bring to a boil over high heat, lower heat and simmer until water is absorbed and the lentils are tender. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, dissolve 2 tbsp mustard powder in ¾ cup water. Pour into a medium size bowl. Dissolve remaining 2 tbsp mustard powder into 3 cups water and then add to bowl, stir until combined. Add enough tequila to achieve desired consistency, adjust to taste. Remove chicken from roasting pan and discard or save liquid. Slice in ½ thick pieces and return to roasting pan. Pour lentils over chicken, top with cheese and serve.

title: Spicy Stuffed Vegetables
ingredients: 1 cup chopped uncooked mixed vegetables | 3/4 cup sliced salami or 3/4 cup ground turkey | cooking spray | 1 package sliced cooked sausage
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish. In a medium bowl, mix together the first 4 ingredients. Add sausage slices to meat, and stuff evenly into 8 small hot vegetable sausages. Spray a large oven proof skillet with cooking spray. Arrange stuffed vegetables in the skillet. Bake in preheated oven until heated through, 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Peach Artichokes
ingredients: 4 artichoke hearts | 4 1/2 cups all-purpose white flour | 1 can sliced peaches
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Place the artichokes into a pot with enough water so that they are about 2 inches from the bottom in the can. Bring to a boil, and cook for about 10 minutes. Drain in a colander, then cool on paper towels. Place flour into a bowl, and quickly stir in the drained artichokes. Dip your hands into the flour, and form an oval or square shape out of the flour. Fold the artichoke heart's lengthwise in half, roll the artichoke heart, and tuck the entire artichoke heart right under the rolled out flour to cover a whole artichoke heart. Repeat to make additional protdiations, placing the stuffed artichoke heart in a casserole dish. Cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for at least 2 hours. To cook the stuffed artichokes, place the casserole dish in the preheated oven, and bake for about 1 hour, or until golden.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,cream mushroom soup,vegetable oil cooking spray,white flour,cake flour
title: Beef or Pork Strips and Gravy
ingredients: 1 kg sirloin or 1 kg pork steak, cut into 1 strips | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 cup cake flour, sifted | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup, undiluted | 1/2 cup white flour
instructions: Coat meat strips with flour and shake off excess. Heat vegetable oil and add meat strips to fry pan and quickly brown on all sides. Combine soup and flour together and stir into beef. Cover and simmer for 1 hour until meat is tender.

title: Chicken-Korean Style
ingredients: 4 -6 chicken thighs | 1 orange, sliced into half moons | 6 kiwi fruits, sliced into half moons ( the korean version also works ) | 1 tablespoon fresh ginger, minced | 1/4 cup orange juice or 1/4 cup dry sherry | 1 can navy beans ( drained and rinsed )
instructions: Place chicken in a 9 x 13 pyrex dish, skin side down. In a small bowl, lightly beat 1 tbsp of orange juice or dry sherry and stir in the orange slices and kiwis. Pour over chicken. Cover and refrigerate at least 3 hours or overnight. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Remove chicken from the refrigerator and bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour remove and discard the orange slices and kiwifruit and bake an additional 5 - 10 minutes. Spoon the chicken and kiwifruit mixture over cooked rice.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile,green chili pepper,graham cracker crumb,soya sauce,rhubarb,red chili pepper flake,pork loin roast
title: Rhubarb Pulled Pork
ingredients: 1 lb pork loin roast | 2 tablespoons soya sauce | 2 tablespoons fresh chopped green chili peppers | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried red chili pepper flakes | 2 teaspoons crushed canned chipotle chiles | 1 ounce dried graham cracker crumbs | 1 small fresh red chili pepper, seeded and sliced
instructions: In a medium size bowl, stir together pork, soya sauce, green chiles, red chili flakes, and crushed chipotle chilies. Place pork between two sheets of wax paper or plastic wrap and pound with a mallet until pork is ¾ inch thick. Wrap one side of a wooden or metal cutting board with foil, and gently press meat with a rolling pin to flatten, about ½ inch thick. Repeat with remaining pork, and then wrap in foil. Refrigerate at least six hours. Remove meat from the refrigerator and place on waxed paper. Sprinkle with graham cracker crumbs and continue to roll until well rolled. Roll each piece out like you’ve made a rectangle. Wrap foil around roast with additional parchment, and set into refrigerator 1 hour. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place the steaks on a foil lined baking sheet. Season with salt. Bake in oven for 1 hour. Slice into thin slices, and serve.

Random Ingredients: lime,white hominy,yogurt,chicken breast,balsamic vinegar,pistachio,chicken stock cube
title: White Chili With Yogurt & Pistachios
ingredients:
1/2 lime, chopped | 1 small chicken bouillon cube ( can add up to 1/4 tsp.
    - fresh lime juice ) | 2 cans white hominy | 7 ounces low-fat yogurt | 4 ounces chopped pistachios ( can add up to 3/4 cup chopped almonds as well ) | 3 1/2 ounces chicken breast, cut into strips | 1 teaspoon balsamic vinegar
instructions: In a saute pan, saute the chicken strips in the chicken fat until chicken is cooked through, about 10 minute add bouillion cube. Add the rest of the ingredients, stir and heat to boiling. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes or until thickened.

title: Mildly Spiced Vinegar
ingredients: 2 cups vinegar | 1/4 cup fresh ginger-garlic paste | 1 kaffir lime leaf ( optional )
instructions: Stir to blend. Stir in ginger garlic paste.

Random Ingredients: coriander seed,purpose flour,head broccoli,salt black pepper
title: Stir-Fried Broccoli
ingredients: 1 tablespoon coriander seeds, crushed | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | 1/2 teaspoon salt and ground black pepper to taste | 1 bunch broccoli, trimmed | 1 small head fresh broccoli, trimmed
instructions: Heat a nonstick skillet over medium high heat.

title: Roast Duck Confit
ingredients: 2 duck legs ( per breast ) | 1 garlic clove, per breast | 1 tablespoon roasted garlic ( dried crushed )
instructions: Dry duck legs. Baste with garlic then with salt, let rest one hour. Make sure the internal temperature of the duck is at least 150 degrees. Baste regularly. Grill on all sides until crispy. Enjoy.

title: Vegan-Friendly Chicken Kebabs
ingredients: 1 can mushrooms, drained and minced | 1/2 cup pea carrots ( or celery & carrots, if you prefer, i use pre-sliced sliced carrots ) | 1/4 cup reduced sodium cider or 1/4 cup apple juice | 1/2 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | 2 cups cooked chicken breast meat ( cut into strips or chunks )
instructions: Combine mushrooms, vegetables, cider, and vanilla together. Mix thoroughly, and set aside. Place chicken in a dish, and spoon mixture over top. Serve with a salad, or use a veggie dish as a meat choice.

Random Ingredients: chive,red capsicum,potato,balsamic vinegar,jalapeno pepper,jasmine rice,vegetable shortening
title: Tijuana Potato Stir Fry
ingredients: 2 potatoes, sliced | 2 tablespoons vegetable shortening ( or lard ) | 1 jalapeno pepper, sliced | 1 red capsicum, sliced | 1/2 cup red jasmine rice | 3/4 cup chives, finely chopped | 1 -2 tablespoon balsamic vinegar, lime juice can be sub with | 1 -2 tablespoon vegetable oil or 1 -2 tablespoon lard
instructions: Drain the potatoes, place them in a deep, non stick frying pan and cover with cold water. Bring to the boil on high heat, reduce the heat to medium. Simmer the potatoes until just starting to tender and the water has been absorbed, 10 - 15 minutes, until tender. Drain any residual cooking water and place the potatoes under cold water until cool enough to handle. Drain thoroughly. Mash the potatoes through a food processor. Heat the oil or lard in a clean, non stick frying pan on medium high heat. Add the chives and jalapeno pepper.

Random Ingredients: purpose flour,stew meat,monterey jack cheese,orange juice,chicken tender,wheat bread,fenugreek,catfish fillet
title: Chicken and Fish Stuffed Whole Wheat Bread Crank
ingredients: 2 lbs stew meat, cubed | 1 lb catfish fillet, cut in 2 inch squares | 3 ounces dried fenugreek | 2 1/2 cups monterey jack cheese, grated | 2 large whole wheat bread | 4 cups all-purpose flour | 1 cup orange juice | 12 ounces stew meat, cooked and shredded | 1/4 cup fresh orange juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Spray cookie sheet with nonstick spray. In a large bowl combine the meat, fish fillets or catfish, fenugreek and ¾ cup of monterey jack cheese. On a sheet of waxed paper spread out the bread cubes and top with the meat mixture. Bake the uncovered bread for 35 to 45 minutes, or until the bread cubes are lightly toasted.

title: Easy Beef Stew!
ingredients: 4 -5 lbs chuck ( or use stew meat ) | 1 tablespoon white pepper ( i use freshly ground black pepper ) | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar
instructions: Place meat, and any juices that came out of the meat, and the vinegar in a bowl. Mix well and place in a crockpot. Cook for at least 8 hours. Enjoy.

title: Houses of Parliament Steak Fajitas
ingredients: 1 3/4 lbs beef liver | guacamole ( to taste )
instructions: Slice liver into 1/4 inch wide strips with a sharp knife. Place in a baking dish and pour guacamole on top. Cover and bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit for 30 minutes.

title: Simple Crawfish on the Bottom
ingredients: 1 can whole canned tomatoes, juice drained | 1 package cooked and crawfish tails ( in the shrimp '' tails '' ), chopped, with tails on
instructions: Toss all ingredients together and serve.

Random Ingredients: hamburger,chilies,apricot,pepper flake,chinese five spice powder,tomato puree,mint
title: Homemade Chinese 5 Spice
ingredients: 2 lbs hamburger | 2 tablespoons chinese five spice powder | 2 tablespoons dried apricots, finely diced | 1/2 tablespoon dried chinese five spice powder | 2 tablespoons dried sweet peppers or 2 tablespoons dried chilies, finely diced | 1/2 cup dry tomato puree or 1/2 cup tomato sauce | 2 teaspoons dried mint or 2 tablespoons dried mint, finely chopped
instructions: Cook beef in a skillet with chinese 5 spice and 5 spice, stirring till browned.

Random Ingredients: sage,chicken breast half,basil,sugar snap pea,brown lentil,summer savory,chive,pesto sauce
title: Easy Baked Lentil Salad With Chive Dressing
ingredients: 1/4 cup packed fresh basil | 1/4 cup packed fresh chives | 1/4 cup chopped fresh sage | 1/4 teaspoon summer savory | 1/2 cup toasted brown lentils or 1/2 cup green lentil, rinsed and drained | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce | 1 can chicken breast halves, drained ( i love this ) or ( 10 ounce ) can pork and pork with skinless bone in, boneless
instructions: Combine basil, chives, sage, brown lentils, pesto, chicken, and 1/2 cup broth in a small bowl. Cover and chill several hours. Sprinkle salad with remaining 1/4 cup broth if desired.

title: Scallops, Potato and Olive Bake
ingredients: 200 g baby red potatoes | 200 g sirloin, cut into thin slices | 2 tablespoons olive, divided | sea scallops ( if using a whole scallop, leave the bone in ) | 12 pieces pecans, chopped | 1 large egg white, lightly beaten | 2 tablespoons half-and-half
instructions: Preheat oven to 220ºc. Pierce a small deep pocket through each potato with a sharp knife and place on a baking tray. Bake for about 20 to 25 minutes or until tender. Drain, cool, slice thinly and place on a serving platter. Cut the sirloin into thin slices, stir in the half and half and set aside. Sprinkle the scallops and pecans over the potato and scallops and then pour over the egg and half and heat through.

title: Sopa Ponzu (Spinach and Kiwi Fritters)
ingredients: 4 ounces frozen chopped spinach, thawed and well drained | 1/2 cup sliced green olives | 4 -8 slices bread, buttered | 1 -2 tablespoon ponzu or 1 -2 tablespoon other fruity greek yogurt | 1 kiwi fruit, peeled, cut in 1/2-inch slices
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Place the spinach and olives in a small baking dish, leaving a few inches between them. Broil, watching carefully, until the kiwi is just softened, about 2 minutes. Brush both sides of the bread with about 1 tablespoon of the ponzu. Cut into wedges and arrange on a serving platter. Spoon the spinach over top. Drizzle about 2 teaspoons of yogurt over the tops. Broil about 3 - 4 inches from the heat for 2 - 3 minutes, or until golden.

Random Ingredients: anchovy fillet,cooking oat,mango chutney,cream chicken soup,parsley,nut,cardamom seed,tuna
title: Spicy Tuna Salad
ingredients: 1 can tuna, drained | 2 cans condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 tablespoon quick cooking oats | 1 3/4 cups fresh pared seeded and chopped mango chutney | 1/8 teaspoon crushed cardamom seeds ( optional ) | 1/8 teaspoon anchovy fillet | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley | 1/2 teaspoon ground nut
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the tuna, soup, oats, chutney, cardamom and anchovy. Mix gently and chill for one hour in the fridge. Just before serving, stir in the parsley and nut.

title: Easy Pumpkin Gluten Free Broth
ingredients: 2 cups pumpkin puree | 1/2 cup vegetable broth | 1/2 cup canned salmon
instructions: Combine the pumpkin, vegetable broth, salmon and salmon in a slow cooker. Cook on high 2 to 5 hours or on low for 4 to 6 hours. Remove salmon from slow cooker and serve.

title: Thai Red Chili Paste(Qatar)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon oil | 3/4 teaspoon red chili pepper | 3/4 teaspoon red chili pepper oil ( or a splash of balsamic vinegar )
instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat. Add red chili pepper stirfry for 5 minutes. Add cilantro and mix. Serve with other dip dishes, such as pita chips, pita bread, hummus, crackers or rice.

title: Spicy Curried Onions
ingredients: 1 large sweet spanish onion, sliced diagonally | 1 1/2 tablespoons red curry paste ( thai or indian style ) | juice ( splash of lemon, or more )
instructions: In a frying pan, saute onions in curry paste with 1 1/2 cups of water, over medium heat, stirring occasionally, about 10 minutes or until golden and tender, but not mushy. Add a little bit of water as needed, if mixture looks dry. Cover and simmer 10 more minutes. Serve warm, or cool completely, cover and refrigerate up to 6 months.

Random Ingredients: madeira wine,green pepper,pecan nut,pinto bean,tamari soy sauce,beef broth,oyster
title: Aglio E Olio
ingredients:
1 tablespoon cornstarch dissolved in 2 tbsps.
    - beef broth | 1 lb beef top round steak, cut in thin strips ( or cut up ) | 1/4 cup oyster, drained, and cut lengthwise into 1/4-inch slices ( refrigerated till solid, this is to your taste ) | 1 green pepper, in 1-inch long strips ( or red pepper sliced ) | 4 teaspoons tamari soy sauce | 1/2 cup madeira wine ( or other dry white wine ) | 1/4 cup pecan nuts, sliced
instructions: Heat 2 tbsps. Of beef broth in a small skillet over medium heat and saute the beef until browned. Transfer to a plate. Repeat with remaining beef broth. Mix the cornstarch and 1/4 cup water in a small bowl and set aside. Strain beef juices and pour into pan. Add onions, peppers, and remaining broth. Cover and simmer till vegetables are done. Add cornstarch mixture, tamari and wine to pan and boil til thickened and bubbly about 1 minute. Toss in pecan nuts, remove from heat. If desired, stir in reserved sauteed beef. Serve topped with remaining pecan nuts.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti,chicken breast fillet,chicken breast meat,buttermilk,amaretto,watermelon,cream corn,greek yogurt
title: Chicken Filled With Pasta
ingredients: 2 chicken breast fillets, roughly chopped | 1 cup cream-style corn | 1 cup buttermilk | 4 tablespoons greek yogurt | 1 cup crumbled spaghetti | 1/3 cup amaretto ( dry sherry ) | 3/4 cup chopped watermelon | 1/2 cup frozen corn
instructions: Combine the chicken, cream style corn, buttermilk, yoghurt, and spaghetti in a shallow glass dish. Gently stir in the melgrocerate mixture. Cover, and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Drain pasta and return to pot. Place a small piece of plastic wrap on edge of pasta to prevent sticking. Dip a tortilla in and put into a microwave for 20 - 45 seconds, or according to the package instructions. Spoon the chicken mixture onto tortilla and wrap in the tortilla. Place on a baking sheet. Bake for 30 minutes in the preheated oven, until cooked through and crispy. Serve with a side salad.

Random Ingredients: veal,white rice,chicken stock,green bell pepper,cavatappi pasta
title: Chef Flower's Spicy Avgolemono Soup
ingredients: 1 veal, cut into cubes about 1-1/2 inches by 1 1-3/4 inches | 4 cans chicken stock | 2 cups uncooked white rice | 3 green bell peppers, cut in large strips with some green pith attached | 1 lb capelline, cooked al dente
instructions: Pour vegetable stock and veal into soup pan and stir well.

title: Spicy Sushi
ingredients: 1 cup sushi rice | 1 1/2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 2 sheets dried sushi rice, sushi mat or 2 sheets rice mat
instructions: Divide each sheet of nori into two equal parts and press one part between two damp paper towels until shiny. Bring a saucepan of lightly salted water to a boil. Place the nori on a baking sheet and cook under the broiler until blackened on both sides, about 2 minutes. Turn and re broil until lightly browned. Drain well and cut both sheets into 3 x 1 inch squares using a serrated knife. Arrange 1 square of nori, 1 square of sushi rice, and 1 square of water along nori edges and bring to a boil over an high heat. Reduce heat to medium and simmer for 3 - 4 minutes, or until liquid is absorbed.

Random Ingredients: mushroom,hot chicken broth,chicken wing,catsup,chili bean,part mozzarella cheese,chili oil,yoghurt
title: Hot & Sour Chicken Casserole
ingredients:
1 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded | 3 tablespoons chili oil or 3 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 can sliced mushrooms | 1 can chicken wings, chopped and skinned | 0.
    -75 jar chili beans | 0.
    -25 container chicken broth | 3 tablespoons catsup | 2 tablespoons fat-free yogurt
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In large bowl, combine mozzarella and 1 tablespoon chili oil and mix well. Spoon into well oiled 4 cup ovenproof casserole dish. Bake 15 minutes. Meanwhile, cook and stir mushrooms, wings and chili in any oil remaining in skillet in a 10 inch skillet over medium high heat until tender. Drain off extra oil, then stir in beans, broth, catsup and remaining 1 tablespoon oil. Spoon over top of casserole. Bake 15 to 20 minutes more.

title: Green asparagus Rollups
ingredients: 3 green asparagus, ends trimmed, each cut lengthwise | 1 cup swiss cheese, shredded ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1/3 cup shaoxing rice vinegar | 1 fresh chili pepper
instructions: Steam asparagus 7 - 10 minutes until tender crisp, remove to bowl and drain well. Cut top into 3/4 inch wide slivers. Place cheese on top of cooked asparagus and roll up jellyroll style. Serve warm with a side salad. Serves.

title: Aussie Sausage Cookies
ingredients: 4 links sausage | 8 ounces baking powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 190c/375°f. Cut a 4 inch round hole in each sausage link. Push one sausage link onto a greased baking sheet. Cover with a second sausage. Sprinkle baking powder over sausage and bake for 20 - 25 minutes, depends on temperature. Serve with melted butter or sourcream.

Random Ingredients: amaretto,oyster sauce,tri tip roast,garlic powder,chunky salsa,balsamic vinegar
title: Steak with Black Beans (Sbd P1)
ingredients: 1/2 cup chunky salsa | 3 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons honey | 1 tablespoon garlic powder | 1 tablespoon amaretto | 1/2 cup beef tri tip roast, cut into small pieces
instructions: Combine salsa, vinegar, honey, garlic powder, and amaretto in a large bowl. Remove sbd pkg from fridge, add meat, and coat well with mixture. Refrigerate for several hours or overnight.

title: Cajun Three-Bean Stew
ingredients: 2 pounds potatoes, peeled and cubed | 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1 tablespoon molasses | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground allspice | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground star anise | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne, or more to taste
instructions: Place the potato and kidney beans into a large pot. Mix in a splash of molasses. Set aside enough water to cover the ingredients. Bring to a boil over medium heat, and cook until the potatoes and beans are tender, about 20 minutes. Reduce heat to low, and stir in the anise, cayenne pepper, and more salt and pepper if needed. Simmer about 1 hour, until flavors have blended and the stew has darkened.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,active yeast,chili bean,sourdough bread,yellow mustard seed,head garlic
title: Yummy Garlic Chili Beans
ingredients: 2 cups dried chili beans, such as california black beans or cans black beans - drained ( reserve 3/4 cup liquid ) | 2 packages active dry yeast | 3 1/2 cups bread flour ( for cooking the bread ) | 1 medium head garlic, peeled, cloves cut crosswise into halves | 3 large green cardamom pods | 1 teaspoon yellow mustard seeds | sourdough bread, for serving ( optional )
instructions: Place the chili beans or canned beans into a large bowl, cover tightly with very warm water, and set aside. Soak for at least 8 hours or for up to 8 days. Drain the chili beans and place them into a large bowl. Sprinkle the beans with the yeast and cover. Let sit for 5 or 10 minutes, or until frothy. Put the flour in a large bowl and make a well in the centre. Pour the reserved 2 3/4 cup of the bean liquid or water you've used inches into the well. Dry the garlic cloves by dipping them into warm water, then shaking out the excess water. Heat a small nonstick frying pan over medium high heat. Sprinkle the garlic with the cardamom seeds. Quickly add the garlic and toast until lightly browned, about 2 minutes. Carefully add the mustard seeds and continue to toast until the chili is hot but not burning. Carefully add the chili to the flour along with their soaking water and fry, stirring constantly, for 5 to 10 minutes, then cover, and continue to cook over low heat for 10 minutes. Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Sterilize a 3 or 4 quart baking dish, if desired. Turn the heat of the chili bean mixture down to low. Pour the chili mixture into the baking dish. Add enough bread flour to make a thick paste. Sprinkle the mustard seeds on top of the chili bean mixture in the baking dish on top. Cover with heavy duty aluminum foil, and place in the preheated oven. Cook for 30 minutes. Remove the foil and let cool for 5 minutes before serving. Serve warm, room temperature, with a sourdough bread of your choice.

Random Ingredients: plain flour,maida flour,red chile,white pepper,peach,nutritional yeast
title: Peach Melba
ingredients: 200 g peach slices | 125 g raw raw mange-touts flour ( corn flour ) | 100 g plain flour | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 1/2 teaspoon nigella dried red chile | 1 teaspoon nutritional yeast
instructions: In an electric mixer combine the first 8 ingredients. Mix on low speed for 5 min or on high for 2 minutes or until dough is elastic, then stir in the nutritional yeast. The dough should hold its shape and not stick to your finger tips. Cover and leave in a cool place for 40 minute preheat oven to 180 degrees celsius. Roll out dough with a rolling pin on a floured surface with a rolling pin to a rectangle of about 30 x 75 and about 2 cm by 3 cm. Spread the chilled melba mixture over the melba, then roll up from the long side. Cut off the ends with kitchen scissors. Place melba on a baking tray and brush with melted butter. Bake on 15 cm for about 15 minute turn out and brush and bake on a clean tray for a further 15 minute.

Random Ingredients: cumin seed,salmon,red wine,hot water,apricot,white bean,flat leaf italian parsley
title: Grilled Salmon and Apricots With Apricots
ingredients: 4 1/2 lbs fresh salmon or 4 1/2 lbs fresh salmon, cut into 8 slices | 4 teaspoons cumin seeds or 4 teaspoons black cumin seeds | 1 can diced apricots ( 12 small ) | 3/4 cup dry red wine | 1 1/2 cups hot water | 1 1/2 cups white beans, drained, rinsed and split in half lengthwise | 4 teaspoons flat-leaf italian parsley
instructions: Place a small amount of water in a dutch oven, set over medium high heat. Add the cumin seeds and cook, stirring, until they begin to sputter. Stir in the chopped apricots and cook until the apricots change color slightly. Do not overcook the apricots, remove them from the pan when they are still warm. Pour the wine over the salmon and scatter the sesame seeds over to coat. Add half of the beans and cover, heating until the steam subsides. Remove the cover and continue boiling, 3 - 5 minutes until the beans are crisp tender. Remove from the heat immediately, add the remaining beans and the parsley and remove from heat.

Random Ingredients: savoy cabbage,extra spicy seasoning,cornflour,kosher salt black pepper,carrot,ham,caper,pork sauce
title: The Real Deal Hot Ham Salad!
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/4 lb ham, cut in half and cooked | 1/2 head savoy cabbage | 1 carrot, cut into thin matchsticks | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste | 1 -2 tablespoon cornflour, to thicken | extra spicy seasoning, to taste | 4 tablespoons pork sauce | 2 tablespoons capers, drained
instructions: Place ham in a bowl and add the sliced cabbage and carrot. Sprinkle over 2 tablespoons each of black and purple peppery spice. Toss to coat evenly. Add 1 - 2 tablespoons of cornflour to thicken dressing and pour over salad. Add 3 more tablespoons of cornflour to thicken and spread over salad. Season with a little salt and pepper to taste. Chill before eating. If you can wait 2 hours for the flavors to combine…it’s up to you.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,strawberry,dark brown sugar,vidalia onion
title: Strawberries Consommé
ingredients: 4 lbs fresh strawberries | 1 large vidalia onion | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar, packed | 1 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: In a large, ovenproof pan, gently fold the strawberries with the onion. Drizzle the dark brown sugar and cream atop the strawberries. Place under the broiler. Turn the strawberries once, so that bottoms and edges brown and caramelize quickly. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: brie cheese,italian plum tomato,caraway seed,oyster sauce,romano cheese,chickpea flour,rice,flour
title: Chickpea Bread (Baked)
ingredients: 1/2 cup chickpea flour | 1/2 cup rice flour | 1 1/2 cups romano cheese | 2 tablespoons flour | 1 tablespoon caraway seed ( optional ) | 1 cup italian plum tomatoes, chopped | 1 -2 tablespoon oyster sauce | 1/2 cup brie cheese, diced ( optional ) | 1/2 cup italian plum tomato, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to blend the flours, romano and caraway seeds together. Set aside. Combine the chopped tomatoes and oyster sauce together and set aside. Mix the chickpea flour, rice flour and egg into a smooth dough. Mix in the flour and caraway seeds until dough sticks together. Pinch off small balls of dough and roll into thin discs. Arrange the coated discs on a greased baking sheet. Cover with the romano mixture and spread evenly over the top. Place under the broiler for 5 minutes. Remove from the oven and let cool. Place the diced brie, if using, in the center of the bread. Sprinkle with the italian plum tomato mixture and top with the tomato mixture. Place under the broiler until the top is golden brown. Serve warm.

title: Coconut Sorbet
ingredients: 3 cups unsweetened dried shredded sweetened coconut | 2 cups white wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons ground cinnamon
instructions: Using a strainer, rinse the coconut until all the water is absorbed. Combine the coconut and wine vinegar in a large bowl, and stir in the dried coconut. Pour the mixture into an ice cream maker, and freeze according to the manufacturer's directions. Serve in long grain dishes.

title: Pasta with Pepper and Chicken
ingredients: 1 package rigatoni pasta | 2 cubes chicken bouillon, or more to taste | 1 yellow bell pepper, chopped
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook rigatoni in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 12 minutes.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,tortilla chip,chilies,saffron thread,egg,vegan margarine,angel hair pasta
title: Spicy Breakfast Bites
ingredients: 3 whole free range eggs | 6 -8 tortilla chips | 300 g sebago angel hair pasta or 300 g vermicelli ( 4 pieces per person ) | 2 -3 chilies ( depending on desired heat ) | 3 -4 tablespoons vegan margarine | 3 -4 tablespoons peanut oil | 1 pinch saffron threads or 3 -4 tablespoons szechuan peppercorns
instructions: First, make a fried egg white sauce with 2 cups peanut oil. Put in the egg whits at about 180 grades c and let set off the heat. Then, fry the angel hair in the veg oil, this will take only a couple of minutes. Then, put on a plate and slice the chilies, put them aside. Now, cook your angel hair pasta as you can. Once that is done, let set aside and you will also need to clean up the pan. Start with your egg white sauce at around 175 grades c and when you add the salt, fry with a little bit of veg oil, you will see that the consistency is going to change up, this is important for the consistency, let set off the heat, you might need more or less. Then, in a serving bowl, put the chips, some of them, put some of the fried egg white sauce, some fried egg white sauce, mix the two, and you will have to put them together in the serving bowls. Now, take one piece of egg and put the middle cut side on top of the chips. You will also need to use a spoon to push the egg in, it will be difficult to make this with the egg. After that, you will need to put it on the plate, you can put it in the fridge until you need it, then you will put up to 10 pieces. And finally, you can put it on a plate, put the chips on it and put some more fried egg on top and eat them immediately or you can cut them in pieces.

title: The Best Indian Boba Bread
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups bread flour | 2 green cardamom pods, or more if necessary, seeded and crumbled | 1 tablespoon mango puree
instructions: Place bread flour, cardamom pods, and mango puree in the bowl of a food processor. Process until the mixture resembles coarse breadcrumbs. Turn into a bowl, cover, and chill 8 hours. Form into a smooth round disc. Cut a few slits on top of the Boba about halfway through. Allow the Boba to dry out a bit. Transfer to a baking sheet and set aside at room temperature until the boba bread becomes firm and a little crusty, about 2 hours.

title: Root and Eat Mix
ingredients: 1 stalk fresh rosemary, leaves picked off and discarded, chopped | 1 teaspoon finely dried savory, leaves picked off and discarded | 1 teaspoon finely ground dried coriander | 1 teaspoon chinese five spice powder ( or more to taste ) | 1 pinch ground anise extract | 3 large turnips or 3 large yellow turnips, peeled halved lengthwise, cut into 1-inch wedges | 1/2 lb raw rice
instructions: Place all ingredients except turnips in a small serving dish or bowl. Cover, refrigerate overnight. Turnips can be covered at this point. Bring to the table for 10 - 15 minutes prior to using, to allow flavors to blend. Stir rice into vegetable mixture until mixed. Sprinkle generously with salt, if desired.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,eggplant,pork chop,lime juice,ear corn,lemon pepper,garlic powder
title: Grilled Pork Chops on the Barbie
ingredients: 1 eggplant | 2 ears corn | 3 -4 pieces pork chops | pesto sauce, to taste | 1/2 cup lime juice ( i've used fresh ) | 1/2 teaspoon red pepper | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Grill eggplant until done, cut length wise in half, and remove black skin. Set on cutting board and sprinkle with salt and black pepper. Let cool about 30 minutes. Slice eggplant and corn into 1/2 inch strips. In bowl, combine eggplant and corn.

Random Ingredients: pork sausage,chicken wing,peanut,spice,beef brisket,tomato sauce,bechamel sauce
title: Beef Brisket and Sausage Stew (Crock Pot)
ingredients:
4 -4 lbs beef brisket or 4 -4 lbs pork sausages | 3/4 cup ground peanuts | 2 teaspoons mixed spice ( like cinnamon, nutmeg, cloves,.
    -.
    -.
    - ) | 2 cans tomato sauce | 1 can chicken wings, or ( 10 ounce ) can chicken legs-discard tips | 1 can sliced ripe olives with chilies, drained
instructions: Place brisket in bottom of pan. Sprinkle with the peanuts and mixed spice. Spread tomato sauce over brisket. Top evenly with chicken wings and olives. Place brisket in 4 - 5 quart crock pot. Cover and cook on high for a minimum of 6 hours or on low 8 - 10 hours.

title: Beets on the Barbie - Low-Salt, Low-Carb!
ingredients: 4 beet, trimmed | 4 maraschino cherries | 3 -4 tablespoons plain flour, for dusting | 2 teaspoons coarse salt or 3 teaspoons coarse sea salt
instructions: Place scrubbed beet in a colander, add salt and toss until well coated. Wipe the beet with a paper towel, dry with kitchen paper and sprinkle with the coarse salt. Leave on a plate while you prepare the rest of your ingredients. Wash and dry the cherries then toss them in a bowl. Dust the griddle with flour and preheat to hot right before the beets are just about ready. Cook the beet on the hot griddle, turning them over with tongs when one side starts to curl up. They are ready when the tops are golden brown and their flesh is charred and juicy. Transfer the beet on to a bowl, serve with lots of mustard.

Random Ingredients: lasagna noodle,caster sugar,turmeric,ranch bean,russet potato,gruyere cheese,pepper flake,red onion
title: Beef, Potato, & Ranch Lasagne
ingredients: 250 g lasagna noodles, cooked ( i recommend fage's recipe # 111624 ) | 2 tablespoons caster sugar | 1 tablespoon hot pepper flakes, to taste | 450 g russet potatoes, peeled, thinly sliced and rinsed | 1 red onion, thinly sliced & thinly sliced | 300 g baby grey mountain cheese, grated | 700 g thinly sliced whole grain baguette, crust removed, cut into 4 triangles
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c. Cook lasagne noodles according to packet instructions and drain. Meanwhile in a large frying pan, heat sugar and pepper flakes and cook until sugar starts to melt and stir in potato slices. Remove from heat, and transfer mixture to an ovenproof dish. Layer half of the lasagne, half of the potato mixture, half of the onions& half of the grated cheese over the base of the dish. Repeat the layers, then top off with remaining cheese. Bake for 45 minutes, until the cheese has melted, and the lasagne crust is golden.

title: Simple & Zesty Chicken for Two
ingredients: 4 1/2 cups chicken bouillon granules | 20 cups ice water
instructions: Put one cube of chicken bouillon in your freezer. Take the other cube of bouillon and put it into a pan with water to cover. If it does not cover, add water. Add the remaining bouillon and stir until dissolved. Bring to a boil, then simmer for 2 - 3 minutes. Serve.

title: Rice Wine Shrimp
ingredients: 1 cup rice wine | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 1/2 lb shrimp, peeled & deveined | 2 tablespoons vodka
instructions: Heat a saucepan over medium heat. Add vodka and shrimp. Place shrimp on top. Reduce heat to low.

title: Smoked Salmon and Halibut (Gomae)
ingredients: 8 ounces smoked salmon ( fresh or frozen, thawed ) | 1 tablespoon garlic paste ( asian or korean-style available ) | 6 ounces chinese noodles, soaked until soft | 2 whole green cardamoms | 1 - 1 1/4 lb halibut ( or other smoked fish ) | 1 tablespoon oatmeal, quick- cooking or 1 tablespoon fine-grain rice ( or other grainy meal )
instructions: Place fish, garlic paste, and one cup water in medium size nonstick skillet and bring to boil. Reduce heat to low once liquid boils off. Cook covered 3 - 6 minutes until fish flakes with fork. Stir fish throughly. Remove fish from skillet and set aside for 2 minutes. Transfer the fish to an 8x12x2x3 pan. Break up into flakes with spoon, if necessary. Return any fish to skillet and gently stir to coat. Place the soaked noodles in a large bowl and add the cardamon and mix. Add the fish and coat with flakes. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight. Before serving, preheat the broiler or place the fish on a baking sheet lined with aluminum foil, basting with the oatmeal/rice/meal. Return fish to pan. Broil 4 - 4 inches from heat about 2 - 3 minutes until fish flakes easily with a fork and flakes slightly.

Random Ingredients: sage,chicken breast,yukon gold potato,ginger root,vegetable oil,grain rice
title: Slow-Cooked Rosemary Potatoes and Chicken
ingredients: 2 cups long grain rice | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 1/2 pounds chicken breast, cut into bite-size pieces | 4 yukon gold potatoes, cut into bite-size pieces | 2 tablespoons minced fresh sage | 2 slices fresh ginger root
instructions: Place rice in a bowl and cover with water.

title: Shallot En Cocottees with Apples, Capers and Mint
ingredients: 1 lb ground chuck | 2 tablespoons capers | 5 dried arbol chiles, seeded and sliced into slivers | 19 ounces canned tart apples | 3/4 cup catsup | handful of fresh mint leaves, for garnish
instructions: Combine the meat with the capers in a skillet. Heat over high heat and cook until browned. Add the chillies and continue to cook for 2 to 3 minutes, stirring constantly. Add the apples and stir until they are hot. Stir in the catsup and cook until sauce thickens. Divide among 6 to 8 enameled or stainless steel molds or crocks. Cool slightly and garnish with mint leaves. Serve cool.

title: Pink Beans
ingredients: 4 bone-in beef chuck, cut into cubes | 1 1/2 cups prepared chunky salsa | 15 fluid ounces hot chunky salsa | 5 ice cubes, or as needed
instructions: Pour 2 pounds of water over beef in a large bowl. Cover, and refrigerate until beef cubes are tender. Stir chunky salsa into beef.

Random Ingredients: oriental tofu,red bell pepper,cannellini bean,rump roast,extra beef,milk ricotta cheese,irish cream
title: Quick Beef Casserole (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 rump roast, trimmed of fat | 1 can french-style tofu, drained | 1 medium red bell pepper, diced | 1 can cannellini beans, drained | 1 cup fat-free baby russet potatoes ( optional ) or 1 cup other low-fat potato slices ( optional ) | 1/2 cup skim milk ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons irish cream
instructions: Place roast in a 3 1/2 or 4 quart slow cooker. Cut up tofu into 8 1x8 inch pieces and place in dish. Drain beans and rinse potatoes and mix with ricotta. Place potatoes on top of roast and spread with cannards. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and let marinate in refrigerator for 1 hour or up to 3 hours. Remove roast from slow cooker and place on a platter and sprinkle with red pepper. Cover and cook on high for 4 hours or low for 3 hours. Sprinkle potatoes with 1/2 c water and serve atop beef.

title: Crazy Low Fat Vegetarian Enchilada Sauce
