ingredients: 1 can red enchilada sauce ( or 2 cups homemade enchilada sauce ) | 4 -5 tablespoons nutritional yeast | 1 english cucumber, cut into pieces
instructions: Boil water in pot add nutritional yeast and remove from heat, strain out fat. Add red enchilada sauce to pan, stir in and heat through add sliced cucumber. This is best served over rice.

Random Ingredients: pepper sauce,mushroom,splenda sugar substitute,beer,beef tenderloin,duck breast
title: Beer Marinated Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 12 ounces frozen boneless beef tenderloin | 1 bottle pepper sauce | 1 package splenda sugar substitute | 1 can sliced mushrooms | 1 bottle beer | 1 bottle beer | 12 dashes hot pepper sauce
instructions: Place beef in a large resealable plastic bag. Combine pepper sauce, splenda, and mushrooms in a bowl and pour over beef. Refrigerate for 1 to 1 1/2 hours, turning once or twice. Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Insert meat thermometer into center of meat. Insert knife into thickest part of tenderloin. Stuff with remaining pepper sauce mixture. Place meat in oven and roast for about 1 1/2 hours. Remove from oven and let stand about 20 minutes before carving.

Random Ingredients: clear honey,red chili powder,bacon,chili pepper flake,sun tomato oil,icing sugar,whipping cream
title: Creamy Sun-Dried Tomato and Chilli Sauce
ingredients: 150 ml whipping cream | 250 g thick-cut bacon, trimmed and sliced | 1 teaspoon sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and chopped | 1 small red chili pepper, deseeded and finely chopped ( hot pepper ) | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder | 1 tablespoon clear honey | 1 tablespoon icing sugar, sifted
instructions: Whip cream until stiff peaks form. Gently fold in bacon, sun dried tomatoes and hot pepper. Chill sauce. To make chilli glaze. Place all ingredients in small frying pan over medium heat, stirring until heated through. Serve over cooked pasta.

title: Ceylonese Fish Pies
ingredients: 2 lbs kingfisher fish fillets, cut into chunks | 1 large baking potato, peeled | 1 large white onions or 1 large yellow onion, chopped | 4 small radishes, sliced, optional | 4 -6 tiny shrimp, shelled if desired | 1 can light cream of fish and veg | 1 tablespoon flaked dried shrimp or 1 tablespoon dried shrimp, as optional garnish | 4 cups whole wheat flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f mix fish with potato, onion, radishes, shrimp, cream of fish and dried shrimp in a large bowl. Pour in some of the fish flour if needed. Put the remaining fish flour in a small bowl and set aside. Sift a little of the flour onto a pastry board and lightly floured work surface and roll out about 1/4 in thick. Cut out 4 - 6 in circles and put 1 tbsp cream from 1/2 cup cream in your measuring cup, if using the fresh kind of fruit for example. Cut another circle and repeat this. Place on a parchment lined baking sheet. Flatten the edge of each circle with the bottom of a glass to make thinner circles. Brush the center of each circle with the fish water. Place the circle onto the parchment and press gently. Cut a slit crosswise through the centre, remove and discard the seeds. Make 4 pinches in the center of each pastry. If the edges of the dough are too narrow, add a little more flour. You want the edges very slightly thinner. Place pinches of the fish mixture on the pastry, slightly less than 1/2 apart. Bake until browned. Remove to a rack to cool.

title: Tropical Spice Balls (Pudim de Natale)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons sweet roasted peanuts | 1 tablespoon ground cinnamon
instructions: Finely grind the peanuts and cinnamon in a mortar and pestle, making sure you dont grind to a paste. If you grind all the spices together before grinding add 1/2 teaspoon at a time. Roll the mixture into balls with wet hands, then roll each ball in the peanuts. Store at room temperature in an air tight container.

title: Hot Chutney for Shrimp
ingredients: 1 tablespoon gelatin powder | 3 tablespoons mango chutney | 1 1/2 teaspoons hot sauce | 1/4 cup coriander
instructions: Dissolve gelatin powder in hot water. Stir in chutney and pepper. Chill to set. Sprinkle with coriander to serve. Variation, add 1 tablespoon dried chutney and 1 teaspoon ground turmeric before adding water or apricot liqueur.

title: Watermelon, Swiss and Squash Quesadillas
ingredients: 1 cup sliced watermelon | 2 roma tomatoes, diced | 1/2 cup swiss cheese, shredded | 1 teaspoon water | 1 tablespoon margarine | 1 tablespoon sweetened condensed milk | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla | 2 teaspoons lemon rind, grated | 1/2 teaspoon fresh lemon rind, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Combine watermelon, tomatoes, cheese, butter, condensed milk, vanilla, lemon rind, and lemon rind in an 8 inch square baking dish. Dollop 1/4 cup of filling into the center of each rectangle. Wrap the quesadillas around the filling and place in a large baking dish. Bake for 20 minutes or until heated through. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: vanilla extract,white onion,bay leaf,poppy seed,salmon,olive,cottage cheese,champagne
title: Smoked Salmon and Eggnog Cheese
ingredients: 3/4 lb smoked salmon (, 1 large packet ) | 1 1/2 cups low fat cottage cheese | 1 white onion | 1 small red bay leaf | 2 teaspoons chopped pimento stuffed olives | 1 teaspoon poppy seed | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/4 cup champagne ( optional, but recommended! ) or 1/4 cup sparkling white wine ( optional, but recommended! )
instructions: Cut smoked salmon into 6 long strips and set aside. Cut onion into 1 dice and set aside for garnish. Cut grapefruit in half and separate segments, removing all but 1/4 inch thick sections. Using a vegetable peeler, peel skin from 1/2 onion then finely chop onion and set aside for garnish. Place the remaining 2 onions into a small bowl or pot with a bit of olive oil, salt, and pepper and set aside. Slice the other 1/4 onion into 1/4 slices. Chop up the pimento stuffed olive and set aside, along with the poppy seeds to use for garnish later. In a blender, or by hand, blend the cottage cheese and remaining 2 onions with 2 tbsp olive oil with bay leaf, and vanilla extract until smooth. Add the blended cheese mixture into the blender, along with the champagne, which should fill into a 1/4 cup measuring cup. Mix well. When serving add a small scoop of sweet pickled berries for garnish.

title: Peachy-Tomato Salsa
ingredients: 8 ounces canned whole peaches, drained ( reserve the liquid ) | 1 can rotel tomatoes & chilies | 1 serrano pepper
instructions: Mix all ingredients in bowl. Cover and refrigerate overnight to let flavors blend.

title: Chipotle Chicken
ingredients: 2 whole chickens, halved | 2 quarts chicken stock | 1 lime, juiced | 1/8 teaspoon ground chipotle chiles in adobo
instructions: Place the chicken in the refrigerator. Bring the chicken stock to a boil in a large pot. Pour in the lime juice, reduce heat to medium, and let simmer. Drain the chicken, and place the chicken into a mixing bowl. Cover, and refrigerate at least 4 hours. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place the chicken pieces into a lightly oiled baking dish. Season with salt and pepper. Drizzle with a little more olive oil. Sprinkle with chipotle. Bake in the preheated oven until the chicken juices run clear, about 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chip,veal,cottage cheese,pecorino romano cheese,phyllo pastry,cinnamon swirl bread,red capsicum
title: Cheese-Filled Baklava
ingredients:
500 g fat free cottage cheese | 1/2 cup pecorino romano cheese, grated | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon ( or 1 tsp.
    - powder ) | 50 g chipoltes vegetarian shredded veal | 1/2 red capsicum, sliced into long strips, deseeded, deseeded, thinly sliced | 1 package phyllo pastry | 400 g grated pecorino romano cheese
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the cottage cheese, spices, zest from 50g of the grated pecorino, veal and 1 tbsp of the grated pecorino and mix until well combined. Lay pastry on a clean work surface and place a piece of plastic wrap on it. Brush with olive oil, place your hands in a way that the dough doesn't stick to the rolling pin. Then put about 1 tbsp mixture onto the pastry sheet, making sure it's fully covered. Take a piece of plastic wrap and place the second phyllo piece on top, brushing with olive oil. Dip the pastry piece in the oil, one by one, taking the whole piece of plastic wrap and using your hands. Once it's completely covered, place it on a greased baking tray. Repeat to make all the sheets and pastry. After 4 sheets are used, lay the 2nd phyllo sheet, brushing with olive oil. Sprinkle with a bit of the grated pecorino to give it a nice glossy color. Then place the 2nd phyllo sheet on top. Spread the cheese/cheese mix over the 2 sheets of phyllo, overlapping slightly. Add a handful of the grated pecorino on top of the mix. Place the top phyllo sheet onto the grated pecorino, brushing with olive oil. Dip the top sheet of phyllo pastry into the grated pecorino and brush olive oil over the whole stack to give it a nice glossy and solidified look. Place on the baking tray and sprinkle the shredded pecorino all over it again. Preheat the oven to 180c or 400°f. Place the tray into the preheated oven and bake for about 45minutes until golden in colour. Remove from the oven and leave the tray to rest for 5 minutes before cutting into quarters.

title: Italian Restaurant Style Gorgonzola
ingredients: 12 ounces linguine, cooked | 1/2 cup gruyere cheese, shredded | 1 teaspoon anise seed
instructions: Turn on broiler and set to high. In bowl combine bread crumbs and egg yolk. Take half the cheese and sprinkle over cheese mixing thoroughly. Place bowl over a skillet of hot water. While bread crumbs are forming a creamy paste, spread rest of cheese on bread and turn when slightly brown. Spread mixture on untoasted side of noodles. If desired, sprinkle with additional cheese to make it slightly crispy. Let cheese melt.

title: Tender Herbed  Sichuan Spice Rub
ingredients: 1 cup szechuan peppercorns | 1 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 3/4 cup italian parsley | 1/2 lime
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a clean spice mill and grind to a fine paste using the grating blade of a mortar or a pestle. Rub into the meat of your choice and refrigerate for at least 3 days.

Random Ingredients: fajita seasoning mix,dill,picante sauce,egg noodle,serrano chili
title: Baked Eggs With Salsa
ingredients: 24 large free range eggs ( or 7 to 10 eggs depending on the size ) | 4 ounces uncooked egg noodles | 1 - 1 1/2 cup picante sauce ( or to taste ) | 1 -2 serrano chili, chopped finely | 1 envelope fajita seasoning mix, from a 6 ounce package ( mccormick brand )
instructions: Spray a 13x9 inch glass baking dish with cooking spray. Place egg noodles in a large mixing bowl. Mix sauce with the fajita seasoning packet and pour over the noodles. Coat the eggs in the sauce with the egg noodles. Sprinkle with remaining fajita seasoning. Make sure all the noodle is covered with sauce. Cover the pan and refrigerate overnight. Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Uncover and bake for 40 to 50 minutes or until the eggs are just cooked and the top is light brown all the way through.

title: Aussie Flag Cocktail
ingredients: 30 ml tomato soup | 150 ml thickened cream or 150 ml thickened cream | 75 ml dark rum | 2 tablespoons red curacao | 1 cup fresh raspberries | fresh rosemary ( optional )
instructions: Pour tomato soup into a mixing glass and stir in cream. Stir in rum and curacao pour into glasses. Garnish with fresh raspberries and an umbrella. Optional, add a dash or two of rosemary or chives on top before serving.

Random Ingredients: chicken,tapioca starch,green olive,nori,phyllo pastry,self rising flour,cheddar cheese
title: Baked Cheese and Olive Rounds
ingredients: 1/2 cup self-rising flour | 1/2 cup white cheddar cheese | 1/2 cup tapioca starch | 1/2 cup mashed green olives, drained | 1 cup cooked chicken, shredded | 1 sheet phyllo pastry | nori, to serve
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees c. Combine the flour and cheese in a bowl, then mix with the olives and chicken. Place on a lightly floured surface and roll into a rectangle. Brush the top of the pastry with water and fold in half. Press the edges together a little. Repeat with remaining pastry and filling. Place onto a lightly greased baking tray. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown. Cut into slices, and serve with nori.

Random Ingredients: ro tel tomato,beef stock,nonstick cooking spray,superfine sugar,splenda granular
title: Mexican Tomato Soup With Roasted Veggie Filling
ingredients: 3 extra large ripe rotel tomatoes ( cut in half crosswise ) | 1/2 cup nonstick cooking spray | 1 teaspoon superfine sugar | 1 can non-fat beef stock ( homemade, store-bought recommended ) | 1 teaspoon splenda granular
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f with a sharp knife, cut a 1/2 inch deep slit into the tomato halves and cut an x into the top of each half with kitchen shears. Place cut side down on a foil lined baking sheet and bake until the tomatoes are browned on both sides, 20 to 25 minutes. Remove the tomatoes from the oven, then cool on a paper towel. Transfer the tomatoes to a blender and process them to a smooth puree. Set aside. Meanwhile, coat a large saucepan with cooking spray, then add the superfine sugar and cook over medium high heat, stirring, until it begins to caramelize around the edges. Stir in the broth, tomato puree and splenda, then bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, until the flavor is melded and the tomatoes are very tender, about 15 minutes. Use a slotted spoon, transfer the soup to a blender, then puree in batches until no purees remain. Adjust the seasoning with splenda, if desired. Pour soup into warmed sterilized mason jars and place in a large baking pan and cover with plastic wrap. The soup may also be prepared up to this point 1 day in advance and frozen, covered. Bring to a boil and spoon the soup into each jar to cover the tops. Seal the jar if desired.

title: Paella
ingredients: 4 boneless pork chops ( country-style ) | 1/2 teaspoon saffron | 2 kiwi fruits, julienned
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium high heat, then rub pork chops with saffron. Add pork chops and kiwis to the skillet with saffron, then gently stir the skillet. Cook pork chops until cooked. Serve the pork chops hot.

Random Ingredients: swiss chard,cornflour,red chili pepper,dark sesame oil,cheese tortellini,chickpea flour,cardamom pod
title: Tortellini Bean Sesame Seed Tortellini
ingredients: 12 ounces cheese tortellini, frozen | 1 1/2 cups cornflour ( for dusting ) | 1/2 cup chickpea flour ( for dusting ) | 4 cardamom pods ( for dusting ) | 3 dried red chili peppers | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil ( for deep frying ) | 2 bunches swiss chard ( roughly chopped )
instructions: Heat oil in a large frying pan. Sprinkle on chili pepper flakes and fry briefly. Remove chili peppers and add to oil using a slotted spoon to drain off the oil. Place cornflour, chickpea flour, cardamom and sesame oil in a bowl, stirring with an electric hand mixer until dough is smooth and satiny. Stir in chopped swiss chard and allow to cool. Line a tray with baking paper. Place approximately 2 tablespoons of dough mixture in the centre of the tray, slightly overlapping the edges. Cut through dough with a sharp knife into squares then enclose the filling mixture completely by overlapping the corners. Allow to cool whilst cooking. Deep fry tortellini in batches until golden brown and drain on kitchen paper.

title: Wearl Muffuletta
ingredients: 4 romaine lettuce hearts, washed drained | 3 tablespoons jam
instructions: Cut each romaine heart in half lengthwise and scoop out the center with melon baller. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and lay out each half. Spread jam on the cut sides of each round. Place on the baking sheet, cut side down. Bake 10 minutes at 400 degrees f or until the romaine is tender. Serve in cut squares with a spoon.

Random Ingredients: sauce,kosher salt black pepper,cake flour,tahini,caster sugar,green cardamom pod,ice,turnip
title: Indian Turnips and Carrots
ingredients: 4 1/2 lbs turnips, peeled and cut into match sticks or 2 1/2 lbs carrots, peeled and cut into matchsticks | 7 ounces unsalted tahini | 3 teaspoons caster sugar | 2 green cardamom pods | 3 cups cake flour | 4 tablespoons hot sauce | 1/2 cup unprocessed ice | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c / 300°f line a roasting tray with parchment paper. Place the turnips and carrots in a large saucepan that will hold them comfortably. Add water to just cover. Bring to the boil, then turn down the heat. Cover and simmer gently for 15 minutes until all of the vegetables are tender and the water has been absorbed. Drain the vegetables, reserving the water. Transfer the vegetables to a large bowl. In a large bowl, whisk the tahini, sugar, cardamom pods, flour, sauces, garlic and salt and pepper. Taste and adjust any seasoning. Add the vegetables and the liquid from the pan. Mix in the ice and mix to combine. Transfer the mixture to the prepared tray, in a single layer, then bake for 20 minutes, or until evenly browned. Serve hot.

title: Swiss Raspberry Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 3 large baking potatoes | 3 1/2 tablespoons cornflour | 2 teaspoons splenda granular or 2 teaspoons sugar | 2 teaspoons salt | 1/2 cup raspberry jam
instructions: Scrub and dry potatoes. Bake in a moderately hot oven for 30 - 40 minutes or until soft. Cool completely. Peel and mash. Add flour, sugar and salt to potato and mix thoroughly. Put in a greased, lined 28cm x 12 cm pan. Press raspberry jam onto top of potato until totally covered. Bake for 40 - 45 minutes or until golden brown. Serve warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: hoisin sauce,cool whip,cumin seed,lamb shoulder,cooking wine,tomato paste,cream mushroom soup,red chili pepper flake
title: Lamb in Chili Sauce (Slow Cooker)
ingredients: 1 lb boneless lamb shoulder, cut in 4 chunks or 1 lb boneless stewing beef, cut in half in 1 inch pieces | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 can tomato paste | 2 tablespoons hot cooking wine or 2 tablespoons chili flakes, depending on hotness of lamb | 1/2 cup hoisin sauce, divided | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1/4 teaspoon red chili pepper flakes
instructions: In a 4 quart slow cooker combine all ingredients except hoisin sauce and cumin seeds, and mix well. Remove lamb from the slow cooker, reserving the liquid, and place meat in the slow cooker. Pour reserved liquid over the meat, reserving about 4 cups. Cover and cook on high setting for 5 - 2 hours, or on low setting for 7 - 9 hours, or till the meat is tender. Turn up the temperature to high, and stir in remaining hoisin sauce and cumin seeds.

title: Chili Mango
ingredients: 4 ripe mangoes, peeled seeded and diced | 2 tablespoons fresh minced cilantro leaves | 1/4 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1/4 teaspoon chili powder | 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves
instructions: Place diced mangoes in a medium bowl. Sprinkle with fresh minced cilantro, seasoned salt, chili powder and ground cloves. Toss to combine. Serve immediately or refrigerate, covered for up to a week.

title: Sausages With Apricots and Olives
ingredients: 450 g fresh smoked sausage | 1 kg pear tomatoes ( about 15 ) or 1 kg plum tomato, halved ( about 15 ) | 1 sprig mint leaf ( to garnish ) | 12 whole cardamom pods | 1 large handful kalamata olive | 4 tablespoons roasted peanuts | 20 g dried apricots | 20 g raw peanuts, for sprinkling
instructions: Place the sausage, tomato, mint and broken cardamom pods in a large bowl. Sprinkle with half of the olives. Add the peanuts. Mix gently. The mixture should have some liquidised form.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,rose petal,apple cider vinegar,spicy brown mustard,pecan,red chili pepper
title: Heritage Bintos
ingredients: 3 cups self-rising flour | 1 cup spicy brown mustard | 1 cup white pecans, finely chopped | 1/2 cup chopped pecans | 1/2 red chili pepper, finely chopped | 1 bottle apple cider vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 250°f. Spray a baking dish with the cooking spray. Whisk together the flour, mustard, chopped pecans, ground chili pepper and vinegar. Spoon the mixture on top and form a well. Mix thoroughly, forming a patty. Place on the middle shelf in the oven for 1 1/2 hours. The top should be lightly browned. Cool on a rack. Split into halves. Keep warm in a warm oven. Store in a tightly closed container. The flavour will improve as it ages.

title: Easy and Good Easy Brown Rice and Spring Onion Rolls
ingredients: 2 cups cooked brown rice | 1/2 - 1 cup of spring onion | 1/2 cup self-rising flour | 5 -6 hoagie rolls
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 and spray a baking pan with a little oil spray. Cut the spring onion in half and slice into thin slices, about 1/2 inch thick. Spread the flour onto a clean surface and lightly flour and cut your roll of bread with a knife or knife. Place slices of onion in the center of your bread, then roll up, pinching the edges to close the roll closed so everything gets under the rice. You might need to put in a little more than half the spring onion. Pour the rice and spring onion slices in to your bread and place the roll into the pre heated oven.. Cook for 20 - 25 minutes, until golden. Serve warm and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,burrito seasoning mix taco seasoning,cardamom pod,nonstick cooking spray,yellow pepper,vegetable broth
title: Ethiopian Fried Spicy Burritos
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1/4 cup vegetable broth | 1 package burrito seasoning mix or ( 4 ounce ) package taco seasoning mix | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1/8 teaspoon ground yellow pepper | nonstick cooking spray
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon sesame oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Stir in the 1/4 cup vegetable broth, burrito seasoning mix, cardamom pod, yellow pepper, and 1/8 teaspoon salt. Heat to a boil.

Random Ingredients: vegetable,stew meat,tamarind pulp,red chilies,almond extract,pesto,bay leaf,lamb shank
title: Marinated Lamb Shank
ingredients: 1 kg lean stew meat, cubed | 500 g ground lamb shank | 8 dried red chilies | 3 tablespoons roasted sesame seedless almonds ( soaked ) | 4 tablespoons dried tamarind pulp ( soaked in 100ml hot water for 30 mins ) | 2 tablespoons mixed vegetables ( frozen ) | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil or 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 tablespoon pesto | 2 -3 dried bay leaves
instructions: Mix together the lamb shank, marinade and chillies in a plastic bag. Refrigerate for 1 to 3 hours. Meanwhile, heat 1 tbs. Of oil in a skillet in a wok over medium high heat, and brown the meat on all sides. Drain off excess oil, and set the lamb aside. Heat the remaining oil in the skillet and cook the almonds for 3 to 4 mins over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: granny smith apple,liquid smoke,spaghettini,gorgonzola,limeade concentrate,port wine,msg,penne pasta
title: Gorgonzola & Lime Pasta
ingredients: 1 envelope liquid smoke | 3 slices smoked gorgonzola | 1 lb penne pasta ( i like whole wheat penne pasta best ) | 2 granny smith apples, cored and diced | 1 packet frozen limeade concentrate | 1/4 cup port wine | 1 jar dry spaghettini ( i use the large box ) | 1 teaspoon msg, to taste
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the liquid smoke & gorgonzola. Heat for about 5 minutes. Add the pasta & saute until just tender. Do not overcook. Stir in remaining ingredients & serve.

title: Crankey's Nanaimo Bars
ingredients: 4 egg whites | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs ( or more if you like )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f brush 9 x 2 pan with a little olive or vegetable oil. Beat the egg whites until frothy, and then stir in the graham cracker crumbs. Pour the crumb layer over the bottom of the pan, tilting the pan so it evenly coats the bottom. Bake in oven at 375 degrees for 15 minutes, then reduce temperature to 300°f and bake for another 15 - 20 minutes, or until a tester inserted in the middle of the bar comes out dry. Remove from oven and let stand 5 - 10 minutes before using for best results. The bars can be eaten as is or drizzled with any chocolate frosting you prefer.

title: Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs dried shiitake mushrooms | 3 tablespoons sunflower seeds, toasted | 1 1/4 cups grand marnier or 1 1/4 cups orange juice
instructions: Place mushrooms in a bowl. Cover with enough hot water to cover them by 2 inches. Soak at room temperature for 2 hours, then drain. Reserve the soaking water. Strain the mushrooms if necessary. Spread the sunflower seeds on a baking sheet and toast in a 425 degree f oven for about 4 - 6 minutes until golden brown. Cool and crush well by hand or with a mortar and pestle. Add the mushrooms and remaining ingredients and blend well.

title: Yakisoba
ingredients: 6 ounces rice noodles | 2 ounces tea, brew preferred
instructions: Put noodles in water to cover and refrigerate until ready to use. Drain noodles into a colander. Place tea kettle on the table and pour 1/2 t. Of tea in each. Put noodles in, stir and let stand 1 minute. If liquid tastes too strong, add water. Serve with more tea.

title: Baked Onions
ingredients: 8 large yellow onions, halved ( about 2 pounds ) | 1 large unpeeled lime, zest of | 1/2 cup apple juice | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 8 cups fresh mixed berries
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°°f line a rimmed baking sheet with aluminum foil. Place onions on the prepared baking sheet and put in the oven to roast about 1 hour or until very tender, stirring occasionally. Drain onions in colander and set aside. Turn oven temperature up to 450°f unwrap onion halves and carefully peel away all of the charred outer leaves. Starting at the stem end of the onion, gently roll each half into a tight cylinder shape about 1/2 inch thick. Place one half of the rolled onions, cut sides down, on the baking sheet. Pour the apple juice into a 2 1/2 to 3 quart saucepan, add the cardamom pods, and bring to a boil over high heat. Boil for 1 minute. Pour half of the boiling apple juice mixture over the onion half rolls, then add the remaining onion halves, cut side up, on top of the apple juice mixture. Bake in oven, uncovered, for about 20 minutes or until onions are tender and slightly browned.

title: Bread and Butter Chicken for 2
ingredients: 1/4 cup finely chopped scallion | 1 teaspoon marjoram | 1/8 teaspoon pepper sauce | 2 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 2 tablespoons sliced buns, toasted
instructions: Combine scallion, marjoram and pepper sauce in heavy medium skillet and heat to boiling, stirring frequently. Add chicken and cook 4 minutes per side or until well browned. Serve with toast and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: italian sausage,onion flake,cool whip,italian tomato,extra virgin olive oil,salmon fillet
title: Italian Salmon
ingredients: 1 pound salmon fillets | 8 ounces italian sausage | 1 can italian-style stewed tomatoes | 3 tablespoons chopped onion flakes | 1 tablespoon dried italian-style dried mixed-dried salad flakes | 1 cup cool whip
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place salmon in a shallow baking dish with a tight fitting lid. Bake in the preheated oven for 12 to 15 minutes, turning once or twice, until opaque and flakey.

Random Ingredients: pesto sauce,egg yolk,rump roast,avocado,coconut,cream mushroom soup,san marzano tomato
title: Caribbean Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 rump roast, cut 1 inch thick | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 egg yolk, beaten | 1 can diced san marzano tomatoes, drained | 1/2 cup avocado - peeled, pitted and diced | 1/4 cup pesto sauce | 1 tablespoon grated coconut
instructions: Place the beef roast in a slow cooker and mix with the mushroom soup, egg yolk, tomatoes, avocado, pesto and coconut. Cover, and cook on high for 7 hours.

title: Scallop and Pizza Crust
ingredients: 1 pizza crust | 6 large unpeeled sea scallops
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Stretch and stretch the dough out onto a baking sheet to about 1/8 inch thick, making sure the dough extends beyond the edges of your baking sheet. Lay the scallops in a single layer on the dough in a single layer. Cover with another sheet of dough and cut 2 squares. Bake in the preheated oven until the scallops are cooked through, and starting to brown, about 20 minutes.

title: Hot Corn Chowder
ingredients: 2 tablespoons red wine ( optional ) | 1/3 cup coconut cream or 1/3 cup coconut milk | 1 teaspoon brown sugar ( optional, but recommended ) | 10 ounces frozen corn, thawed | 1/2 cup strong black tea, chilled
instructions: Mix everything together except the tea and refrigerate overnight. When ready to serve, stir in the tea.

title: Cashew Spread (Filling)
ingredients: 3 medium spring onions, chopped | 3 celery ribs, chopped | 150 g cashews | 100 g gorgonzola, chopped | 1 green olive, roughly chopped | 2 teaspoons capers, rinsed and chopped | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 2 teaspoons bottled roasted ground pepper
instructions: Place spring onion, celery and cashews into a food processor and process until fine. Add gorgonzola, olives and capers and process until smooth in a food processor. The dip will be thick. Pour into sterilized jars and store in a cool place. This is a lovely spread for bread, crackers, or cakes.

title: Spinach, Tomatillo and Lima Bean Soup
ingredients: 2 cups yellow tomatillos | 1/2 cup canned baby lima beans, drained | 2 teaspoons dill, chopped | 1 cup pumpkin seeds ( khus-khus )
instructions: Remove stems from tomatillos and set aside. Slice tomatoes in half cross wise and remove seeds. Remove husks from lima beans and set aside. Fill a large pot with water and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Add the reserved tomatillos, lima beans, dill, and pumpkin seeds. Bring to a simmer, reduce heat to low, and cook for 10 - 15 minutes. Remove from heat, cover, and leave for 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: lime peel,tabasco sauce,green food coloring,lemon,oil,beef sirloin,black bean
title: Quick and Easy Belly Beef Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs beef sirloin, thinly sliced | 2 limes, thinly sliced lemon rind | 1 lemon, sliced into 8 thin wedges | oil, for deep frying | 1 can black beans, drained | 3 drops green food coloring, approximate | 2 tablespoons tabasco sauce ( to taste )
instructions: In a large resealable bag, toss the beef with 3/4 of the lime rind and juice. Let sit 5 minutes. Heat oil to 375 - 350 degrees f, and deep fry the beef until browned and crispy. Drain on paper towels. Drain the oil. In a mixing bowl, stir together the black beans and remaining lime juice. Season with green food coloring or tabasco. To serve, place the beef on the salad and sprinkle with the black bean/lime mixture and remaining rind. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: baking soda,asparagus spear,green chili,garbanzo bean,baby spinach,cider vinegar,pine nut,grand marnier
title: Baked Vegetables With Garbanzo Beans and Chiles
ingredients: 20 -30 asparagus spears | 400 g garbanzo beans | 2 lbs fresh baby spinach | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 1/4 cup grand marnier ( or other flavourful liqueur ) | 1/2 cup pine nuts | 1 small green chili ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f. Prepare the garbanzo beans using the recipe on the packaging, adding baking soda to water for each bean. Cut off the ends of the spears and cut the spears into 3/4 inch lengths. If you prefer whole sticks, cut them in half if they look a little too tough. Place on a baking sheet and bake for about an hour, or until golden in colour. When cooled, remove the tips from the spears and set the spears aside. To make the sauce, in a large frying pan heat the oil over medium heat. Add the asparagus and cook for 2 or 3 minutes until the asparagus just begins to soften. Next, add the beans, water and vinegar. Bring to a boil then reduce the heat, cover and simmer for 20 minutes. Stir in the grand marnier and cook for another 5 minutes. Remove from the heat and season with salt and pepper. Meanwhile. Remove the stems of the asparagus and set them aside. Drain the water from the beans and place them in a blender or food processor with the spinache and nuts. Season with salt and pepper and process for 30 seconds. Stir the spinach mixture into the asparagus and add the garlic cloves. Season again with salt and pepper. Serve immediately.

title: Navel Orange Rice
ingredients: 2 large navel oranges | 2 tablespoons bacon drippings | 3 cups cooked rice | 1 cup plain yogurt | 1 tablespoon sunflower oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Scrub the orange rind very well with a vegetable peeler so as to remove the pith from inside of the oranges without breaking the membrane. Slice rind into 2 long strips crosswise, 2 inches wide. Arrange strips on a baking sheet. Place in the center of the oven and bake for 20 minutes. Remove from oven. Arrange orange slices in an overlapping circular pattern on the toasted rice. In a medium bowl, stir together the remaining ingredients until well blended. Pour the yogurt mixture over oranges and then spoon over rice. Return to the oven. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes or until crisp and bubbly.

title: Manchego (Mandarin Cheese) Dip
ingredients: 1 package mexican blend cheese | 1 can mandarin oranges packed in oil, drained | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 1 teaspoon fennel
instructions: Mix together in blender & place in fondue pot. Tastes best if reheated for a few minutes, but i recommend it a day ahead.

Random Ingredients: cheese tortellini,large shrimp,corn oil,pizza crust,parsley leaf,canola oil,italian sausage
title: Baked Tortellini With Sausage and Shrimp
ingredients: 16 ounces of refrigerated large shrimp | 2 cups fresh pizza crust ( i prefer a boboli pizza crust ) or 1 can cheese tortellini ( i prefer a boboli pizza crust ) | canola oil, for frying ( or other oil ) | 4 tablespoons corn oil | 1 lb italian sausage | 1 tablespoon fresh parsley leaves, lightly chopped | 6 ounces large shrimp, peeled and deveined
instructions: Heat the canola oil in a deep fryer. Drain the shrimp well on paper towels. Tear into small pieces and set aside. Heat the oven to 400 degrees f with the rack set 6 inches below it.. Roll out the crust on your board. Use a 2 inch round or square cookie cutter as a guide, cut out circles from the crust. Place some shrimp in the center of each circle and cover with some of the cheese tortellini. Fold the crust over the shrimp to form a half circle. Repeat with the remaining dough and shrimp. Place on a baking sheet. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes, until golden and crisp. Meanwhile, in a large saute pan over med high heat, add the hot oil. Add the sausage and cook until browned, breaking it up as it cooks, about 3 or 4 minutes. Remove the sausage and set aside. Drain the shrimp well and set aside. Discard any excess oil. Add the parsley and shrimp to the sausage and cook until shrimp are pink and tender, about 4 minutes. Remove and set aside. In a large skillet over med high, heat the corn oil. Add the shrimp and sausage and cook until well browned, about 3 minutes. Add the reserved sausage, spaghetti sauce, and parsley and toss well. Spoon the shrimp mixture into the tortellini shells, sprinkle with the grated cheese, and bake for 10 to 15 minutes, until heated through. This could also be made with left over shrimp mixture or shrimp in small casseroles.

title: Chinese New Year Baked Crescent Rolls
ingredients: 16 small button mushrooms | 1 chinese cabbage, shredded, large is best | 4 ounces pizza sauce | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/2 cup catsup | 2 raspberries
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°. Spray a cookie sheet with olive oil cooking spray. In a bowl mix cheese sauce and cumin powder.

Random Ingredients: pork rib,bread flour,asafoetida powder,coriander leaf,pork,celery rib,blueberry,plum tomato
title: Cabbage and Blueberry Dumplings
ingredients: 1 lb country-style dried blueberries | 2/3 lb country-style cooked pork, shredded | 4 ounces country-style baked pork ribs, finely chopped | 14 ounces plum tomatoes, preferably plum tomatoes, chopped | 2 large celery ribs, finely chopped ( about 1 cup ) | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( hing ) | 2 tablespoons bread flour | finely chopped coriander leaves ( to garnish ) or mint leaf ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Place the dried blueberries in a small bowl and cover with hot water. Let soak 30 minutes to 20 minutes or longer. Drain thoroughly, and set aside. In a large bowl, combine the shredded pork, chopped pork, tomatoes, celery, and a few tablespoons of water.

title: Potato Cones
ingredients: 1 lb cremini mushroom | 1/2 cup white flour | 2 slices gingerroot, peeled and crushed | 1 tablespoon vinegar
instructions: Wash the mushrooms and slice thickly. Put them in a pan with a tablespoon of water for 3 - 5 minutes and drain. Stir in the flour, ginger and vinegar. Put in a greased oven proof dish, put in a hot oven for 15 to 25 minutes. Serve hot straight from the oven.

title: Lemonade Bread
ingredients: 1 package light yellow sweet pepper, chopped fine | 1 can yellow sweet pepper, chopped fine | 3 cans lemonade, chilled | green food coloring
instructions: Mix all ingredients in an electric blender. Pour into pita bread or muffin pan. Broil until toasted. This makes about 20 40. Variation, stir 2 tblsp. Yogurt for a smooth dip.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,brandy,fettuccine,part ricotta cheese,cottage cheese,bacon,eggplant
title: Bacon and Eggplant Fettuccine
ingredients: 4 slices bacon, chopped, divided | 1 eggplant, sliced | 3 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 20 ounces part-skim ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons brandy or 2 tablespoons rum | 10 ounces low fat cottage cheese | 3/4 cup self-rising flour | cooked fettuccine
instructions: Cook and drain bacon. Crumble bacon and set aside. Cook eggplant slices in boiling water until tender. Remove to paper towels and drain well. Heat 2 tablespoons bacon fat in a pan. Add eggplant and fry until soft. Add flour, cheese and brandy or rum and stir over high heat until well incorporated. To serve, place a portion of noodles on each plate and spread with cheese mixture.

Random Ingredients: ginger powder,brown rice,spice,black olive,white pepper,lime juice
title: Olive Tapenade or Ancient Roman Seasoning Mix
ingredients:
1 cup black olives | 1 1/2 cups mixed spice ( ie.
    - rosemary, oregano, etc ) | 1/4 cup brown rice | 2 teaspoons brown rice flour mixed spice | 1 teaspoon lime juice | 1/2 teaspoon ginger powder | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper ( optional )
instructions: Put all the ingredients in a food processor or blender and pulse 2 to 4 times or until the olives are finely chopped. Enjoy your tapenade.

Random Ingredients: double cream,black eyed pea,table salt,parmigiano reggiano cheese,cooking oil,salt pepper,hot red chili pepper
title: Chilie and Black-Eyed Pea Soup
ingredients: 1 package dried black-eyed peas | 2 cups chopped cooked canned hot red chili peppers | 5 tablespoons cooking oil | 8 cups double cream | table salt, to taste | coarsely grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese, for sprinkling | ground black pepper, to taste
instructions: Sort through peas, removing any tough or shriveled areas and discarding any foreign matter. Chop into 1/4 inch bite size strips. Place peas into a small bowl. Add hot peppers, 3 tablespoons of the oil, and cream, and stir until combined.

Random Ingredients: rigatoni pasta,cardamom seed,italian tomato paste,salt black pepper,cabbage,pinto bean
title: Stuffed Italian Bread with Beans and Cabbage
ingredients: 2 tablespoons italian-style tomato paste | 1 package rigatoni pasta | 4 cups shredded cabbage | 1 can pinto beans, rinsed and drained | 1 pinch ground cardamom seed | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat the oven's broiler and set the oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook rigatoni in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 8 minutes. Drain and cool. Spread each slice of bread with tomato paste. Place a handful of cabbage into the bottom of an 11x7 inch baking dish. Spread pinto beans over the cabbage, then top with a layer of soaked pasta. Dot with remaining cabbage. Season with cardamom pod, and season with salt and pepper. Sprinkle with more tomato paste, if desired. Broil in the preheated oven until cheese is bubbling, about 10 minutes.

title: Crispy Onions
ingredients: 1 lb sweet white sugar | 18 large red peppers or 18 large green peppers
instructions: Peel and cut the onion lengthwise into very thin strips. Cut the peppers into thin strips, cutting about ¼ inch wide and 2 inches long. If you're concerned about burning the onions, use a little water, which helps keep them from burning. Heat a large skillet or griddle over medium high heat until hot. Add sugar in a single layer, stirring occasionally to dissolve it completely, then place sweet onions in the skillet and brown the outside. Cover tightly and cook slowly over low heat for about 1 hour. The last 15 to 20 minutes of cooking, or when onions are a dark brown color, turn the onions, sprinkle with a tablespoon of ground red pepper, and close the lid and continue cooking over low heat for another 15 to 20 minutes or until the onions have turned a deep deep, rich golden brown color. Remove from heat, cover, and store at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: half,thai red curry paste,halibut fillet,tahini,american cheese,cauliflower,chicken meat
title: Grilled Tahini Halibut
ingredients: 2 tablespoons creamy tahini | 2 tablespoons half-and-half or 2 tablespoons cream | 1 tablespoon minced drained canned chicken meat | 2 tablespoons finely grated american cheese or 2 tablespoons shredded monterey jack cheese | 1 -2 teaspoon thai red curry paste | 1 box halibut fillets | 1 medium cauliflower, ends trimmed, separated and cut crosswise into thin florets
instructions: In a small bowl, combine first three ingredients. Set aside. Place halibut fillets, skin side down, on an oiled rack of grill pan or broiler pan and brush with the tahini sauce. Grill over medium high heat to desired doneness of fish. Sprinkle with cheese and curry paste. Let set about 5 minutes. Top each fillet with cauliflower, spreading it out evenly. Serve the fish hot.

title: Fettuccine With Apricot-Chili Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb dry rye bread, cut into 3/4-inch cubes or 1 lb dry pita bread, torn into large chunks into 1-inch lengths ( pumpernickel bread is good ) | 1 can apricot jam | 1/4 cup chopped fresh chives | 2 ounces chile peppers, halved lengthwise, seeded, and thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons sweet chili paste | 1 1/2 teaspoons vinegar | 1 1/2 teaspoons sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons chopped fresh chives | 8 ounces fettuccine or 8 ounces linguine, cooked until just tender
instructions: Combine jam with chives and chilies in a small bowl, and set aside. Using a slotted spoon, transfer bread to a bowl, and drizzle with jam mixture.

title: Green Tomato Zingy Appams
ingredients: 2 cups green tomatoes, diced | 1 1/2 cups fresh lemon juice
instructions: Puree the tomatoes in a food processor or blender. Transfer half the puree to a small bowl or pan. Add the remaining puree into that same large bowl. Stir in the lemon juice. If the paste seems too thick, add a few tablespoons of water.

title: Couscous Wedge
ingredients: 1/2 cup tequila | 6 cups couscous | 1 1/4 cups alfredo sauce | 1/2 cup yellow bell pepper, diced | 1/2 cup gruyere cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Heat tequila in 3 quart sauce pan over high heat for 30 seconds. Remove from heat. Stir in couscous and let sit for 5 minutes. Stir in alfredo sauce and bell pepper. Transfer couscous to a 12 inch circle on a floured surface. Press mixture into the center of the circle with the palms of your hand. Sprinkle over the cheese. Return to oven. Cook until top is golden brown, about 25 minutes.

title: Cheese With Shrimp- Asiago and Asiago Prawns
ingredients: 24 large cooked shrimp ( i like to use pre-cooked, shelled ) | 1/2 cup asiago cheese, finely grated | 1/2 teaspoon pure vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Combine shrimp and asiago cheese in a small bowl. Stir in pure vanilla. Bake mixture on a cookie sheet pan lined with parchment paper for 10 minutes, or until garlic is just beginning to bubble.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,pimiento,potato,flat leaf parsley,sausage,ham,cayenne pepper,eggplant
title: Eggplant (Aubergine)  Sausages and Peppers
ingredients: 250 g small eggplants or 2 medium eggplants | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 500 g sweet potatoes or 500 g russet potatoes, peeled and cut into 1 cm slices | 100 medium raw smoked sausage, cut into 1 cm slices | 2 teaspoons crushed dried pimientos ( optional ) | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper | flat leaf parsley | 4 -6 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Cut eggplants in half lengthwise and discard the skin. Cut the halves into thick wedges.

Random Ingredients: oyster sauce,urad dal,swiss cheese,star fruit,rosemary,golden raisin,poblano chile
title: Roasted Corned Beef With Queso Dip
ingredients: 1/4 cup golden raisin | 2 poblano chiles | 3 star fruit, sliced lengthwise in half | 1 1/2 lbs corned beef | 6 tablespoons oyster sauce | 6 tablespoons aged celtic mania wate sauce ( such as jiffy brand ) or 6 tablespoons mania flour ( such as jiffy brand ) | 1/2 lb swiss cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place raisins in a small bowl and set aside. Peel chilies and seeds and cut in half crosswise. Place in a large bowl of ice water. Soak about 15 minutes, or until soft. Place chilies on jelly roll pan lined with parchment and place in oven. Cook about 10 minutes, turning and rearranging as needed, until skins are a little charred and blistered, about 5 minutes total. Let set about 10 minutes. Peel off skins with a serrated knife and slit each in half horizontally. Reserve seeds, keeping the flesh small enough so that the beef is still holding the shape of the chilies. Coarsely chop chilies, placing in a bowl. Toss sliced chilies with 1 t vegetable oil, a tablespoon of the oyster sauce, and 1 t mania or flour. Place half of a beef slice in the center of a cornish half. Place 1 t of the chile mixture on top of the beef. Add a layer of the onion, then a layer of the remaining pepper. Place half of the cheese on top. Repeat layering as noted above. Bake about 20 - 25 minutes or until top is crispy and golden. Add more oil if necessary. Serve warm or warm. Note, the cornish half should be completely cooked before assembling the casserole.

title: Potato Surprise
ingredients: 2 lbs baking potatoes, peeled and chopped | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/2 teaspoon orgeatest seeds
instructions: Place all ingredients in crock pot and cook on low 4 - 6 hours or desired doneness.

title: Blackberry Banana Split
ingredients: 1/2 cup uncooked barley | 2 cups chicken, shredded | 3/4 cup blackberries | 1/2 cup sliced cucumber | 2 tablespoons raisins | 1 1/2 teaspoons garam masala | 2 packages ladyfingers | 1 can enchilada sauce
instructions: In a large pot, rinse the barley until the water runs clear. Place the barley in a double layer of cheesecloth. Spread the liquid over the barley. In a small bowl, blend the chicken, blackberries, cucumber, raisins, garam masala, and 2 dozen ladyfinger halves to make banana split ladyfingers. Use fingers to line the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish with 2 inch depth of enchilada sauce. Arrange ladyfingers in the baking dish. Spread split bananas on top of the ladyfingers. Pour remaining sauce over the bananas and spread over the top. Cover and bake at 350 degrees f for 30 minutes. Remove cover and cook at 350 degrees f for an additional 15 minutes. Let rest for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Currant Semolina (Fava) Pasta
ingredients: 3 lbs semolina | 3 1/2 cups dried currants | salt & pepper
instructions: Bring 5 quarts of water to a boil in a large, wide pot. Meanwhile, trim and discard stems from currants. Soak semolina in water to cover for 10 minutes. Drain, and pour into boiling water. Stir and boil for about 10 minutes, then remove from heat, add salt and pepper.

Random Ingredients: turmeric,rye flour,beef stew meat,onion salt,corn,egg yolk,pizza dough
title: Mini Beef and Corn Fritters
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef stew meat | 3 cans corn, drained | 3 egg yolks | 1 tablespoon onion salt | 3 tablespoons turmeric | 1 1/4 cups rye flour | 2 packages refrigerated pizza dough, defrosted | 1 cup light rye flour
instructions: In a large bowl, mix the beef and corn. Stir in the egg yolks, onion salt, turmeric and rye flour. Remove 1 package of dough from refrigerator and lightly fold up on the long side. Do the same with the second package of dough, folding each onto a second package if necessary, ensuring both packages come together tightly. Then roll the dough into two 8 inch circles. Make sure the sides aren't too tight, they will be hard, and not stick together.

Random Ingredients: salad green exotic,flat leaf parsley,stewing beef,vegetarian bean
title: Beef, Vegan & Bean Salad
ingredients: 450 g stewing beef or 450 g braising steak | 500 g vegetarian baked beans, canned, drained and rinsed | 200 g mixed salad greens ( exotic, mixed vegetables, cauliflower, baby corn and mix together the salad ) | 1 tablespoon chopped flat leaf parsley
instructions: Cut the beef into thin slices. Place in a casserole over medium high heat on the hob and cook, stirring until it has changed colour. Tip all of it into a bowl. Tip the baked beans into the casserole, along with the rest of the cooked beef. Pour over about half a cup boiling water. Bring to the boil and then cover and simmer for 50 minutes. Uncover and simmer for a further 20 minutes till the beef is cooked and tender. Taste, and stir in the parsley. Serve and enjoy.

title: Roasted Salmon With Rose Water
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets ( skin on ) | 1 tablespoon rose water | 1 tablespoon oil ( for cooking )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees celsius. Wash the salmon fillets under cold water then place in a large casserole. Sprinkle with rosewater to cover. In a small pan or saucepan heat oil over low heat, adding rosewater. Simmer for 10 minutes. Pour over the salmon and bake for 30 minutes.

title: Salmon With Cherries
ingredients: 1/2 - 1 tablespoon garlic paste or 1/2-1 tablespoon fresh garlic, finely minced | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs fresh boneless skinless red salmon | 7 -10 ounces cherries in juice
instructions: Trim the salmon, and cut into six individual pieces about 1-2 wide. Spread the garlic evenly over the salmon and then place into a shallow glass container or glass baking dish, or a plastic zipper top jar. Add the cherries and any juice. Refrigerate for 2 to 6 hours, or overnight, turning twice. Remove from the refrigerator 20 to 25 minutes before serving. The next day, preheat the grill to high. Remove the salmon from the marinade, shaking off any excess marinade. Brush the surface lightly with olive oil, and place the top on the grill. Close the lid, and let sear until the salmon is crisp and opaque throughout and the liquid is reduced or absorbed, about 30 minutes. Serve with your choice of cooked vegetables such as roasted zucchini, carrots or broccoli.

title: Cremini Mofongo
ingredients: 1/2 pound coarsely ground pork shoulder | 12 fresh sage leaves | 1 package sliced cremini mushrooms | 1 can tomato puree
instructions: Preheat an oven to 300 degrees f. Combine the pork shoulder, sage, and mushrooms in a large glass or ceramic bowl. Stir in the tomato puree and enough water to moisten the mixture. Transfer the mixture to a baking dish. Cover the dish with aluminum foil. Bake in the preheated oven until the pork is dry, about 1 1/2 hours. Cool, and serve.

title: Cashew Nut and Cream Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 cup cashew nuts, chopped | 1/4 cup flour tortillas, torn into small, 1-inch pieces | 2 tablespoons whipping cream | 1 tablespoon rice wine ( or dark sherry )
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 degrees celsius lightly grease a baking dish and set aside. Toast cashew nuts in a dry frying pan over medium heat for 3 - 5 minutes until golden. Drain nuts in a colander until all the nuts have been processed. Transfer to a bowl. Place tortilla pieces in a large frying pan with approximately 2 tbs of oil. Quickly cook over medium heat for one minute. Add cashew nuts and mix well. Remove from heat when golden. In a small bowl combine cream and sherry, pour over heated cashew nuts. Quickly transfer to prepared baking dish and bake for 10 - 15 minutes or until heated through. Serve enchiladas, garnish with cashew nuts and sour cream.

title: Pork Roast in Hot Sauce (Pollo Borraccio)
ingredients: 1 boneless pork roast | 1/2 cup hot sauce | 1 tablespoon anchovy
instructions: In a large roasting pan or dutch oven, combine the hot sauce, anchovy and the pork roast. Rub the pork well into the hot sauce. Place in the oven, covered. Let cook on low heat for 3 hours. Remove roast.

Random Ingredients: gelatin,green onion,creme fraiche,snow pea,mushroom,white mushroom,plain yogurt
title: Vegetable Tzatziki
ingredients: 6 tablespoons plain low-fat yogurt | 2 1/2 tablespoons creme fraiche | 2 1/2 tablespoons chopped green onions ( white and green parts ) | 1 teaspoon gelatin | 2/3 cup sliced fresh white mushrooms | 1/3 cup sliced green onion | 1/2 cup sliced fresh mushrooms | 1/4 cup sliced snow peas
instructions: Place the yogurt, creme fraiche, green onion, mushroom, green onion, green onion and gelatin in a food processor and puree until smooth. Stir in the white mushrooms and snow peas and puree until just combined.

title: Chicago Style Salami
ingredients: 3 packages dry yeast | 1 cup white sugar | 1 1/2 cups black vinegar | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground nutmeg
instructions: Mix the sugar and the ground nutmeg together and set aside. Dissolve the yeast in 1/2 cup of the sugar and add to the rest of the sugar. Add the vinegar and salt to the yeast mixture and beat into a thick foam on the table until bubbles form. Cover tightly and let rise until double. Add to a very small bowl or mold and place in a warm place overnight. The next day drain and then allow to harden. This can be frozen or refrigerated for up to three months. Once fully cooled, remove from the mold and cut into 1 inch pieces. Bake.

title: Hot Scotch Roast Pork Spareribs (Brine)
ingredients: 1 sprig fresh chili pepper | 2 -3 juniper berries | 2/3 cup scotch whisky or 2/3 cup scotch prosecco
instructions: Cut a fine slice from the tip of the chile, removing the seeds and white membrane. Place into a large pan and add two thirds of the juniper berries and about 2/3 cup water. Wet the rind from the remaining chile pepper, and add to pan. Bring to the boil over high heat, and boil for a moment, then remove from heat. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap pressed directly on top of the bowl with a paper towel and leave it to rest in a cool place for 5 hours. After 5 hours, remove the rind from the bowl with a slotted spoon and place it on a piece of parchment or foil. Remove the membrane and all of the remaining juniper ribs from the bowl with the pulp and skin. Discard the membrane. Measure the liquid in the pan and add the remaining juniper berries. Heat until the liquid boils, then reduce the heat and simmer for 20 minutes. Remove from the heat and add the whisky or prosecco. Strain through a fine mesh sieve or cheesecloth lining a fine mesh sieve into a bowl, pressing down on the solids with the back of a spoon extracting as much juice as possible. Discard solids. Heat up another 5 litre mark of water in a medium size saucepan to boiling point. Carefully drain the pork meat from the parchment paper, patting each piece dry and rub with the reserved juice from the sieve. Add enough pork to the saucepan to hold it snugly, cover and leave at least 15 minutes. Reheat your oven to 400 degrees f. Score thick lines across the surface of the meat, and transfer to a roasting pan. Bake for 1 hour, basting every 30 minutes until done. Remove to a warmed serving platter and serve at once. This dish goes especially well with mashed potatoes, cooked cabbage or other vegetables.

title: Hot Fadai Bites
ingredients: 1 lb ladyfinger | white vinegar, to taste ( i recommend 1/8 cup )
instructions: Brush the ladyfingers with a bit of vinegar and place them in a serving bowl. Add the hot fadai. Let cool down a little and then serve.

title: Curried Snapper Sandwich Toasts
ingredients: 6 slices smoked rye bread | 6 tablespoons horseradish | 1 teaspoon ground ginger | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1/4 teaspoon onion powder ( optional )
instructions: Cut each piece of rye bread crosswise into 24 very thin slices. Mix together horseradish, ginger, curry powder, and onion powder. Dip the rye bread into the mixture, coating evenly. Place on a baking sheet. Bake at 400 degrees f for 1 minute, or until bread lightly browns.

title: Potato Cheese and Coriander Hot Pot
ingredients: 2 ounces ground coriander leaves | 1 teaspoon ground ginger | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 1 red potato, peeled and diced | 1/2 lb small-mature white curd cottage cheese | white pepper ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients into a large, clean non stick frying pan, cook over medium heat until all the ingredients are well combined, stirring occasionally. title: Lemon Chutney
ingredients: 1 cup sultanas | 1/4 cup lemon juice, freshly squeezed
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl, stir to blend or mix well. Cover and refrigerate until ready to use. Store covered.

title: White Chocolate Mayonnaise Roll-Ups
ingredients: 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1/2 cup sweet italian salad dressing
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together mayonnaise, sweet italian dressing, and the mayo mix until well combined. Place mixture onto a serving plate, and roll the roll ups if desired.

title: Guacamole with Black
ingredients: 5 tablespoons guacamole ( homemade or prepared, purchased or prepared ) | 2 1/2 tablespoons black beans or 2 1/2 tablespoons pinto beans
instructions: Place all ingredients in a small container and mix to combine.

title: Taste Saffron Rice Dish
ingredients: 1 teaspoon saffron | 1 teaspoon dark soy sauce | 1 teaspoon tamari soy sauce | 2 teaspoons dried currants ( or raisins ) | 1 teaspoon thai sweet chili sauce
instructions: Soak raisins in hot soy sauce for 2 hours. Drain and grind to a fine powder using a spice grinder or mortar and pestle. In a small bowl mix together saffron powder, dark soy sauce, tamari and currants. Then heat the saki sauce until tamer and bring to a boil. Turn down the heat and add to rice in the bowl. Enjoy note, this dish may look strange at first, but the results are well developed because the rice is not sticky. Note, if you feel more comfortable with the flavor of the saffron, you can add up to 1 tsp of ginger if you feel like adding more.

Random Ingredients: bread,pizza sauce,cottage cheese,maraschino cherry,yellow pepper,cardamom seed
title: Easy Italian Bread Pies
ingredients: 2 - 2 1/4 cups of your favorite bread | 1 large yellow pepper, chopped | 1 cup cottage cheese ( use light cream cheese if you have it ) | 1/4 cup pizza sauce ( or as needed to achieve consistency ) | 3 -4 cardamom seeds | paprika or parmesan cheese ( to topping )
instructions: Grease muffin tin with cooking spray. Set aside. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Mix together all the dry ingredients in a big bowl. Fold in the bread and cheese until dough is firm enough to mold. Grease mini muffin tin with cooking spray and spoon a scant 1/3 cup of the dough into each muffin tin. Sprinkle some paprika or cheese on top if desired. Place the muffin tin on an oven grill and cook for 10 minutes or until golden brown. Remove from oven. Let cool 5 minutes before removing from tin.

Random Ingredients: fine sea salt,mozzarella cheese,corn oil,parmigiano reggiano cheese,frosting
title: Sausage and Cheese Appetizer
ingredients: 4 -8 ounces mozzarella cheese, grated | 1/2 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated | 1/4 cup corn oil | fine sea salt | corn oil ( for frying ) | parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated
instructions: Heat 4 tablespoons corn oil in a large frying pan on medium low heat. Dip each bread slice into corn oil, shaking off any excess. Cook in hot oil until golden brown, turning once or twice. Serve warm topped with a sprinkling of parmigiano reggiano cheese.

title: Chilli Pot Roast
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb boneless beef chuck | 1 can diced green chili | 1/2 cup toasted hazelnuts | 3/4 - 1 bell pepper, halved
instructions: Rinse and dry roast, i use 4 - 5 rib racks for this. In a large bowl, toss all ingredients together with hands until well combined and spread into a 5 quart crock pot. Cook on low for 8 hours or on high for up to 2 - 3 hours.

title: African Chili Powder
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon turmeric | 1/4 teaspoon ground chili pepper
instructions: Combine turmeric and chili pepper. Store in an airtight container at room temperature. Use as a spice for french fries.

Random Ingredients: chicken tender,chicken broth,peanut oil vegetable,buttermilk,salmon fillet,black bean
title: Chinese-Style Smoked Salmon With Green Peanut Sauce
ingredients: 4 skin on smoked salmon fillets | 1 cup low-fat buttermilk | 1/2 cup low fat chicken broth | 1 tablespoon peanut oil, for cooking salmon | 1 cup canned black beans, drained and rinsed | 16 slices salted mixed vegetables
instructions: To make the green peanut sauce. In a small bowl, combine buttermilk, broth, oil and black beans and mix well. Add the salmon and turn to coat. Refrigerate for 15 minutes. Preheat wok or frying pan over medium high heat until hot. Add the oil. Swirl to coat and add the salmon. Cook for 4 mins, then stir fry for 1 - 2 mins, or until just cooked through. Place a salmon in each bowl. Spoon black bean sauce over the hot salmon.

Random Ingredients: cottage cheese,dark beer,coriander seed,soy margarine,orange juice
title: Guinness Cottage Cheese Dip (No Beer Recipe) #A1
ingredients: 375 g cottage cheese | 1 tablespoon coriander seed | 1 tablespoon brown soy margarine | 10 fluid ounces dark beer or 10 fluid ounces lager beer, room temperature | 1 tablespoon orange juice ( to taste )
instructions: Melt margarine in saucepan over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: chicken thigh,garlic powder,garlic clove,kidney bean,red bell pepper,pineapple preserve,vanilla extract
title: Quick Caribbean Chicken
ingredients: 2 cans kidney beans, drained | 1 red bell peppers, cut into strips | 4 garlic cloves, minced | 1 tablespoon imitation pineapple preserves | 1 tablespoon pure vanilla extract | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 4 -6 pieces boneless skinless chicken thighs
instructions: In a large skillet, add all ingredients except chicken and simmer 5 minutes, covered. Turn off heat, remove chicken and allow to cook in the sauce. Add chicken, simmer about 30 minutes, uncovered.

Random Ingredients: onion flake,cider vinegar,corn tortilla chip,head cabbage,tomato paste,tomato juice,queso fresco
title: Mexican Caesar Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried onion flakes | 1 large head cabbage, coarsely shredded | 1 cup tomato juice | 2 cans tomato paste | 1 cup queso fresco | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | corn tortilla chips, for garnish
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Line a 2 1/2 to 3 quart baking dish with aluminum foil. Sprinkle the onion flakes over the top of the cabbage.

title: Pasta Caponata
ingredients: 12 ounces linguine | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | finely caper, for garnish
instructions: Cook the pasta in boiling salted water until al dente drain but reserve the cooking water. Meanwhile, heat the olive oil in a skillet, add the vanilla essence and capers. Add the drained pasta, tossing over a medium heat, until heated through. Serve on a bed of warm caper.

title: Kalamata Olive Tapenade - Tapenade
ingredients: 2 cups kalamata olives, pitted | kamata beef bouillon cube, such as knorr | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom seed ( optional )
instructions: Place the olives in a food processor or blender and pulse until finely chopped. Pour kamata into a large bowl and mix in 1 beef bouillon cube. Rub in the black pepper until evenly blended. Transfer the tapenade to a glass jar. Cover and let stand at room temperature for 2 to 3 days. Taste and adjust seasoning. Strain tapenade through a fine mesh sieve, discarding solids and pits.

Random Ingredients: chinese wine,fajita seasoning mix,seasoning salt,green tomato,egg yolk,cabbage
title: Spanish Eggs and Cabbage (Packs)
ingredients:
8 -10 large green tomatoes, sliced in thin wedges | 4 -5 ounces cabbage, shredded ( about 10 cups ) | 1 teaspoon fajita seasoning mix ( or 1/2 tsp.
    - of your favorite taco seasoning mix ) | 3 -4 teaspoons chinese wine ( optional ) | 1 pinch seasoning salt | 8 egg yolks, slightly beaten
instructions: Combine the egg yolks and the wine on medium high heat in a small bowl, whisk or blend. Add about 1/4 of the cabbage to the yolks and stir fry until it is slightly browned. Add the tomato wedges and saute for 3 - 4 minutes. Mix in the fajita seasoning mix and stir until it loses its raw taste. Turn down the heat, add the egg mixture, and simmer until lightly thickened. Serve or refrigerate for about 15 minutes, or until cold. Serve with other dishes, such as rice or guacamole.

title: Apple Noodle Salad II
ingredients: 3/4 cup apple cider | 4 teaspoons garlic granules | 1/2 teaspoon dried basil leaves | 4 cups egg noodles, uncooked
instructions: Pour cider in a small sauce pan and stir in garlic and basil. Bring to a boil and remove from heat. Place noodles in a large bowl of ice water. Soak for 3 - 5 minutes or until tender. Drain and rinse with cold water. Drain again. Transfer the noodles to a large salad bowl. Pour the wine mix over and toss to coat evenly.

title: Mexican Marinated Chicken Skewers (For Grill)
ingredients: 4 lbs chicken tenders | 2 teaspoons salt | 2 tablespoons parsley, chopped | 4 lime wedges, halved
instructions: Place the chicken tenders on a rack in a shallow 1/2 to 3/4 qt. Baking dish. Pour the salt onto the rack and sprinkle all over. Insert 2 tsp per pound of chicken tenders into the salt.

title: Sauéedescarole
ingredients: 1/2 lb escarole, washed and trimmed | vegetable oil cooking spray
instructions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees f. Spray shallow skillet with nonstick cooking spray. Cover with lid. Put escarole in skillet. Sprinkle with salt. Cover.

title: Kedgeree
ingredients: 1/2 pound okra | 1/2 pound cranberry beans, cut into 2-inch pieces | 1/2 pound cucumber - peeled, seeded and chopped | 1 pound smoked ham hocks | worcestershire sauce to taste | 1 tablespoon fenugreek seeds | 1 tablespoon whole oats, or to taste
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook okra at a boil until easily flaked with a fork, about 12 minutes.

title: Mexican Pork
ingredients: 3 lbs pork loin roast | cumin powder
instructions: Wipe out rind with a cloth. Trim off most of the white fat from the pork. Place in a roaster or heavy duty foil and put in a warm place to let it get moist. Pre heat grill. Sprinkle with cumin and fold in half. Cook 10 to 15 minutes to sear the flavor of the meat. It took me about 5 - 7 minutes for them to reach 145 degrees f and it took the remaining 15 minutes for them to reach 175 degrees f and test for doneness at the end of the cooking. Use a meat thermometer. Serve over hot cooked rice or beans or with tortillas as an accompaniment to meat, vegetables, rice or beans.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,vanilla essence,club soda,white sugar,almond extract,vanilla
title: Vanilla Almond Mousse
ingredients: 1/2 cup white sugar | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar | 2 tablespoons vanilla essence | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | club soda | white sugar, a few teaspoons at a time, to taste
instructions: Combine the sugars, vanilla and almond extracts in a saucepan and cook until the sugar dissolves. Cool the mixture slightly. Beat in the soda until well blended. Remove from the heat and add enough more soda so that the mixture remains a little soft. Allow to cool. Place in a bowl, cover with plastic wrap and chill for 2 hours. When ready to serve, stir again to smooth, but not completely smooth. When ready to serve, garnish with coloured sugars.

title: Vegan Mexican Veggie Spread
ingredients: 1 package frozen or brown bagged lentils | 2 tablespoons margarine | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 1 can whole kernel corn, drained | 1 -2 teaspoon guacamole ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 f. Toss lentils in 2 tablespoons margarine, and seasame seeds in a large bowl. Coat a baking sheet or loaf pan with nonstick spray. Spread lentils with the lentils. Bake for 50 - 60 minutes, or until they are browned and the lentils are tender. Spread all the other ingredients over the lentils and serve.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,french bread cube,caraway seed,granola cereal,rosemary,picante sauce,chipotle powder,catsup
title: Smokin' Hot Frito Bread Tacos
ingredients: 1 yellow bell pepper, thinly sliced | 1/2 teaspoon ground caraway seeds | 1/4 teaspoon rosemary | 1/4 teaspoon dried chipotle powder | 3/4 cup catsup | 1/2 cup catalula-style cereal | 1 loaf french bread cubes ( see note ) | 1/2 cup crumbled dried granola cereal
instructions: Put bell pepper, caraway seeds, rosemary, chipotle powder, catsup, and french bread in a medium bowl. Mix in crumbled cereal until well mixed. Spoon mixture into a large resealable plastic bag. Snip off bag with scissors. Place bag in a bowl or on a plate to catch any juices. Refrigerate 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 400°f remove plastic bag with cereal and crumb mixture from bag. Garnish with crumb mixture if desired.

title: Cucumber Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons molasses | 2 teaspoons molasses | 2 teaspoons white vinegar | 1 1/2 pounds beef tenderloin
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. In a small bowl, mix 1 1/2 teaspoons molasses and molasses flavored liqueur and set aside. Rub a large roasting pan with 1 teaspoon of molasses. Place the tenderloin into the prepared pan and pour the remaining molasses mixture over. Cover tightly with aluminum foil and place into the preheated oven. Bake in the preheated oven until the internal temperature of the beef is at least 140 degrees f, 50 to 60 minutes. Remove the beef from the oven and set aside to rest for 10 minutes. Slice the beef thinly and return it to the roasting pan. Pour reserved molasses mixture over the beef slices and cook in the preheated oven for about 10 minutes per pound of beef.

title: Karela
ingredients: 2 lbs beef chuck roast or 2 lbs braising steak | 1 pinch asafoetida powder ( hing ) | 2 tablespoons mixed nuts | 1 tablespoon ground mixed nuts
instructions: Make a small bundle with the asafoetida, 2 tablespoons of mixed nuts and 2 tablespoons of ground mixed nuts. Place the meat in one flat dish and cover completely with the spice bundle. Refrigerate for at least 24 hours or up to 24 hours before cooking with vegetables. When cooking, brown the beef in a large frying pan over medium high heat. When all the sides are brown and crusty on the outside, remove the meat from the pan and place on paper towel lined plate to drain off any excess excess fat. Return the pan to medium heat, add 3 tablespoons oil and allow it to get very hot. Place beef back in the pan and brown on all sides. Remove from pan and brown the vegetables in the remaining oil on all sides. This may take as little as 5 minutes, depending on how well you brown them. Serve over hot buttered rice and eat like you would eat a meatloaf.

title: Tutti's Favourite Low-Fat Macaroni Balls
ingredients: 2/3 cup light coconut cream | 1 egg substitute ( or equivalent egg substitute and equivalent dry white ) | 1/3 cup non-dairy breadcrumbs | 1/2 teaspoon dried dill | 1/2 teaspoon clear chutney ( optional ) | 4 tablespoons non-dairy breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons unbleached cane sugar ( optional )
instructions: Mix coconut cream, egg substitute, and 1/3 cup of non dairy bread crumbs and dill in a bowl, then add chutney, if using, and mix thoroughly. Drop rounded tablespoonfuls onto a non stick frying pan. Flip when golden brown on the underside. Cut the mixture into approximately 20 little or 20 equal portions. Place in a medium mixing bowl and spoon around 2 tbsp of sugar on top of each one. Serve with crackers, fresh fruit or maple syrup.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,food coloring,red enchilada sauce
title: Easy Red Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 3 cans red enchilada sauce | food coloring ( optional ) | 1/2 red bell pepper, julienned | 1/2 red bell pepper, julienned
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Pour 1/2 can of enchilada sauce into a 1 quart casserole dish. Sprinkle bell peppers and julienned bell peppers across the sauce. Pour remaining enchilada sauce over the contents of the casserole. Cover, and bake in the preheated oven until the sauce is hot and bubbling, about 45 minutes.

title: Spicy Coconut Peppers
ingredients: 2 red bell peppers | 1 cup heavy cream | 1/2 cup unsweetened shredded coconut
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Cut red bell peppers in half, leaving stem and seeds intact. Place bell peppers in a roasting pan, and drizzle a little olive oil onto them. Roast peppers in the preheated oven, stirring occasionally, for about 1 hour. Remove peppers to a bowl, and mix in cream, coconut, and optional crushed red pepper flakes. Continue roasting peppers, stirring occasionally, until a mixture forms a creamy sauce, about 15 to 20 more minutes.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk,red potato,chocolate,cumin powder,salt pepper,parmigiano reggiano cheese,shallot,mint leaf
title: Sweet Potato and Chocolate Potatoes With Mint and Coconut Milk
ingredients: 2 red potatoes | 1 bunch fresh mint leaves ( or 2 tbsp dried mint ) | 8 slices unsweetened chocolate | 2 shallots, thinly sliced | 1 can coconut milk ( or more depending of your taste ) | 1/4 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cumin powder | salt and pepper
instructions: Peel the potatoes, then slice them in half lengthwise. If they aren't thick, cut into 3/4 inch slices. I find that by using a vegetable peeler you don't get a problem. Otherwise, you may peel them into a small bowl or ziplock bag and slice off the ends to remove any excess starch. Add the potatoes to boiling water, then cook the whole thing, covered with a lid for 40 minutes. Don't remove the lid until you are ready to serve the potatoes, then drain the potatoes, saving the water. Place the mint leaves in a small saute pan, add the chocolate and melt them over low heat, stirring occasionally. Add the shallots, stir, and then add the coconut milk. When the mixture is heated through turn off the heat, but don't allow it to boil. The coconut milk will burn, and the mint will release its aroma, so be careful. Add the potatoes and mint water to the pan. Season with the cheese and cumin and stir. Serve immediately.

title: Chunky Curry Fruit
ingredients: 1/2 kg cherry tomatoes or 1/2 kg plum tomato | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1/2 teaspoon ground dried fruit | 1/2 teaspoon red curry paste | 1/3 cup roasted peanuts, roughly chopped
instructions: Slice 1/2 of the tomatoes and mix with the dressing. Wash and chop the rest. Place in an ovenproof dish, scatter over the peanuts and scatter over the remaining tomatoes. Mix well and place under the grill to brown. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: sherry wine,bean,olive oil,salmon,cool whip lite,green salsa,chili sauce,carrot
title: Asian Grilled Fish (Pse) #2
ingredients: 4 whole salmon | 1/3 cup green salsa | 2 teaspoons olive oil | 2 tablespoons sherry wine | 1 3/4 lbs fresh bean, fresh | 1/3 cup sweet chili sauce | 1/2 cup cool whip lite, fat free | 3/4 cup shredded carrot
instructions: Rinse beans lightly. Heat oven to 425 degrees. Place the salmon on a cutting board and cut horizontally through fish flesh to within 1 inch of spine and backbone. Cut salmon in half lengthwise. Using the same knife, slice horizontally through the fish. Place flesh side up in a well oiled 9x13 baking pan and surround with salsa. Add 1 teaspoon olive oil to pan on top of salsa. Wrap baking pan in foil and place in oven. Heat oven to 400°f. Remove foil and bake salmon for 20 minutes for rare. While it is cooking, in a medium bowl combine remaining ingredients and season with salt and pepper to taste. Remove fish from oven and place on top of bean mixture. Spoon dressing onto the top and serve. Serve with warm rolls or rice.

Random Ingredients: elevated challah,russet potato,celery rib,heavy whipping cream
title: Elevated Potato-Hazelnut Gratin
ingredients: 6 large russet potatoes, peeled, cored and sliced 1/8 inch thick | 3 large celery ribs, trimmed and cut into 1/2 inch slices | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 7 cups grated challah or 7 cups coarsely grated gruyere
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. In a large bowl, toss together potatoes, celery slices and cream. Spoon into a 2 - 1 box gratin dish or baking dish that has been well oiled and tented with a double layer of pam. Place 1/3 of grated challah on top and sprinkle with 1/3 of grated cheese. Repeat layers once, ending with cheese on the top. Cover gratin tightly with foil and bake for 1 hour, until bread is puffed and golden brown.

title: Pomegranate Dumpling Pockets
ingredients: 1 package instant fresh pomegranate syrup | 1 package regular dumpling wrappers
instructions: Prepare your pomegranate dough according to the instructions of the package i use my food processor. Place 2 tablespoons of the dough onto 1 wrapper, top it with 2 tablespoons of the pomegranate mixture, using the rest of the dough to make 2 patties. Bring up two opposite sides together to form a triangle. Seal and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper or baking wax paper. Repeat with the other 6 dumplings. Heat a nonstick frying pan over medium heat. Place about half of the dumplings in the frying pan. Make sure they are cooked through and golden on both sides. Use a slotted spoon to remove the dumplings from the pan and place on a paper towel lined tray. Repeat until all of the dough is used.

title: Hot Rum  Mushroom Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 12 large cremini mushrooms | 1 1/2 cups dark rum | 1/4 cup ginger, chopped | 2 meyer's dark rum
instructions: In a small saucepan, bring 1 1/2 cups rum, ginger, and remaining rum to a boil. Remove the mushrooms from the pan and place the flat side of a mushroom with some of the filling in it. Pull the mushroom up from the inside of the mushroom cap, and stuff the mushroom. You can also do this by putting it in an enameled casserole, and holding it with toothpicks. Stuff the mushrooms with the rum mixture. Let sit for at least an hour before serving.

title: Mango Eggnog
ingredients: 8 cups diced fresh mango | 1 can white hominy, drained | 2 egg yolks | 3 cups ice, or as desired ( optional )
instructions: Cook and stir mango and hominy in a large saucepan over medium heat until liquid has evaporated, about 5 minutes.

title: Quick Cabbage Casserole
ingredients: 1 package dry macaroni | 1 small head cabbage, cored and chopped | 1 can condensed onion soup mix | 1 1/2 cups heavy cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the macaroni and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Pizza Asiago Roll Ups (Zwt Core)
