ingredients: 2 cups unbleached all purpose pie crust ( like bob's red mill ) | 2 cups grated asiago cheese or 2 cups grated parmesan cheese | 16 lime slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f degrees. Roll out 2/3 pastry on a lightly floured board to a 14 x 9 inch rectangle. Place an even 2 tbsp of cheese along one side of the rectangle of the pastry. Sprinkle 1 tbsp of cheese onto one slice of cheese and place remaining 2 tbsp of cheese on the cheese. Roll up lengthwise. Repeat with all remaining 2/3 of pastry and cheese slice. Place on a pizza pan or baking sheet. Place pans on cookie sheets and bake for 12 - 15 minutes check with your oven if yours are browning at the edges. Cool on a rack before cutting.

title: Sesame Sesame Onions With Rosemary
ingredients: 6 large spanish onions, thinly sliced | 3/4 cup heavy whipping cream | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds, toasted | 6 sprigs fresh rosemary
instructions: Place the onion slices in a large nonreactive bowl and pour the cream over. Toss lightly with a fork. Cover and chill, at least 4 hours or overnight. Preheat oven to 450°f. Place the sesame seeds in a dry skillet and toast under the broiler, turning frequently, until lightly colored. Transfer the sesame seeds to a plate, sprinkle with sesame seeds, and cool for 10 minutes. Place the caramelized onions in 2 tall baking dishes. Cover the onions with foil, and roast for 30 minutes. Uncover the baking dish and continue to roast until the onions are caramelized, 40 to 45 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove from the oven. Cover the pan with a damp cloth to keep the moisture from seeping out. Set aside at room temperature until cool, then uncover and discard the sesame seeds. Uncover the frying pan and swirl the pan to coat the bottom and sides. Arrange the caramelized onions on a platter with the rosemary. Pour warmed caramelized onions onto the platter. Serve with toasted sesame seeds.

Random Ingredients: sage leaf,ginger garlic paste,ginger root,goat cheese,white pepper
title: Roasted Goat Cheese (Kabakh Ghanuk)
ingredients: 2 cups crumbled goat cheese | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground ginger-garlic paste | 3/4 teaspoon finely chopped ginger root | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 1/4 teaspoon dried sage leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix together goat cheese, ground ginger, white pepper, and dried sage leaves. Spread mixture into a 9x9 inch baking dish that has been coated with cooking spray. Bake in the preheated oven until cheese is melted and bubbly, about 30 minutes. The cheese will break down into small, uneven pieces. Remove from oven, and allow to cool to room temperature before serving.

title: Easy Sizzled Salad Toss
ingredients: 3 heads boston lettuce | 1/2 cup dry sherry
instructions: Rinse salad greens. Break apart leaves roughly. Put lettuce in glass bowl or large sealable freezer bag. Add sherry. Using your hands, squeeze bag to coat and toss the greens. Let sit 5 min then enjoy.

title: Aussie Buns
ingredients: 2 cans beef broth ( i use campbell's ) | 1 -2 teaspoon dark rum ( optional ) | 4 crusty buns ( toasted or french style )
instructions: Combine beef broth, rum if using and dark rum if using. Heat through. Serve on toasted buns and enjoy.

title: Simple Sausage and Carrots
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds sweet italian sausage | 2 pounds carrots, cut into 2 in lengths | 1 jar chunky salsa
instructions: In a large skillet, cook sausage until evenly brown. Drain. Stir in carrots. Pour in salsa. Cover and simmer over medium low heat for 45 minutes, or until carrots are tender. Stir occasionally. Serve with your favorite mexican dishes.

Random Ingredients: potato starch,saffron thread,curry leaf,thai peanut sauce,vegetable oil cooking spray,coriander powder,ginger ale,balsamic vinegar
title: Curried Peanut Dip
ingredients: 200 g potato starch | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 1 1/2 teaspoons ginger ale | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil flavored cooking spray | 1/2 teaspoon saffron thread, crushed | 10 curry leaves | 1 teaspoon coriander powder
instructions: Combine potato starch, vinegar, ginger ale, vegetable oil, saffron, curry leaves and coriander in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper,chicken breast half,tart baking apple
title: Tart and Apple Pull Apart Chicken
ingredients: 1 jar prepared tart baking apples | 4 bone-in, skin-on chicken breast halves - cut lengthwise, crosswise if necessary | 1 can or bottle lager-style beer, such as corona
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. In a 2 quart saucepan, combine apples with enough beer to cover chicken.

title: Brioche (Steamed Salmon With Fruit)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon chopped fresh thyme sprigs | 2 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil | 2 tablespoons triple sec | 2 lbs fresh salmon, cleaned and scaled, cut into 1 inch thick slices | fresh thyme leaves | lettuce leaves, torn into bite-size pieces | diced sweet pickled cherry rims
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450°. Combine the thyme and 1 tablespoon of oil in a medium bowl and toss the salmon slices lightly until they are evenly coated in herb oil. Tear the thyme leaves and toss with the salt, if necessary. Place 1 tablespoon of oil in a 12 inch saute pan over medium high heat. Add 4 to 5 slices of the salmon and cook until the underside is crisp, about 1 minute on each side. Sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon of salt. Place the salmon on a large plate and cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until ready to use. When ready to serve, arrange the lemon wedges on a platter or individual serving plates and set aside. Serve the salmon with the lemon wedges on the side and some thyme flavored lettuce leaves on the side.

Random Ingredients: cilantro,mexican cheese,caraway seed,green olive,raspberry preserve,yellow capsicum
title: Pumpernickel Re Layer Pizza
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cilantro, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon caraway seed | 2 tablespoons yellow capsicums, finely chopped | 2/3 cup seedless raspberry preserves | 1/3 cup green olives, finely chopped | 1/4 cup mexican cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 220c. Place cilantro, caraway seeds, capsicum, and olives in a small dish, mix together. Place raspberry preserves in another small dish. Spray pizza base with cooking oil spray. Spread evenly, then spread the pepper mix over top. Sprinkle top with cheese. Place in oven and cook 15 - 20 mins until cheese is melted and starting to bubble.

title: Italian Baked Wings
ingredients: 10 chicken wings | 2 large red bell peppers | 4 slices pancetta, rind removed | sunflower oil | 1/4 cup sunflower oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Arrange wings at the end of a large piece of parchment paper in a roasting pan. Trim the tips and any fat from the red bell pepper with a vegetable peeler, then remove skin and seeds. Cut peppers into 1 inch slices and place in a bowl. Top with pancetta. Drizzle 2 or 3 tablespoons sunflower oil on top and lightly sprinkle with salt. Place in the oven and bake for about 45 minutes or until crisp. Stir after 15 minutes, remove and leave to cool. Heat a little sunflower oil in a small saucepan over high heat, add wings and fry until the wings are browned, crisp and cooked through. Serve wings hot, warm or at room temperature.

title: Ketchup Canapes for a Lonely Lady
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup, undiluted | 1/2 cup ketchup | 4 tablespoons chicken broth | 1 dash ground cardamom | 1 dash ground mace | ice
instructions: Heat canners and drain out juice. Measure 1/4 cup of juice and set aside to use as a glaze before filling patties.

Random Ingredients: extra beef,grape leaf,chicken broth,mustard oil,serrano pepper,vegetable
title: Grilled Whole Wheat Mustard Oven-Roasted Beef
ingredients: 1/4 lb extra lean ground beef | 1 tablespoon dry mustard oil | 3 serrano peppers, stemmed, seeded, chopped | 2 cups low sodium chicken broth | 1 jar grape leaves, well washed and drained | 2 teaspoons vegetable fat or 2 teaspoons mustard oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with foil. In medium bowl, combine beef, 1 tbsp oil, chiles, and ¾ tsp salt. Stir in broth and cover, set aside 5 minutes. Arrange half of the grape leaves in two 13x9x2x2 inch x 1 1/2 inch baking dishes in a single layer.

title: Roast Vegetable Parcels With Smørrebrød
ingredients: 1 sheet puff pastry ( about 8x10cm ) | 2 russet potatoes, peeled and cut into 1 cm dice | 1 lebanese cucumber, peeled, seeds removed, finely chopped | 1 small cabbage, shredded | 1/2 cup fresh strawberries | 2 tablespoons fresh cherries, halved
instructions: Heat oven to 200°c. Line a large baking sheet with baking paper or oiled baking paper. On a lightly floured surface, roll out one half of the pastry to a 14 cm square. Using a 2cm cutter, cut out 12 rounds. Place on prepared baking sheet. Place potatoes in a saucepan of simmering salted water and bring to the boil. Cook over moderate heat, covered, for 10 minutes. Cover and set aside to steam for 5 minutes. Meanwhile, in a large bowl, toss together the leumber, cucumber, cabbage and strawberries. Place the potato mixture on top of the potato mixture and spread it out evenly in the pastry. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour or until the pastry has chilled. Remove from the oven when potato mixture has risen, using a slotted spoon. Place 2 teaspoons of the fruit mixture on each pastry, dividing evenly. Fold the pastry in half and join the edges. Crimp the edges securely with a fork. Place parcels on prepared baking paper and bake in the oven for 45 to 50 minutes or until golden brown and cooked through. Serve warm from the oven, topped with the cherry halves.

title: Baby Spinach And Fresh Vegetables
ingredients: 1 package frozen peas and carrots, thawed | 2 packages fresh fresh strawberries, washed | 3/4 cup italian style breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup frozen young spinach
instructions: Place thawed peas and carrots in a 3 quart casserole dish. Cut the stems off the strawberries, then slice the strawberries lengthwise. Top with the frozen spinach. Sprinkle evenly with bread crumbs, and drizzle a little olive oil over the spinach. Cover and refrigerate, 2 hours, stirring a few times while the spinach wilts. If you would like to eat it on fresh vegetables, serve the spinach and mixed vegetables over top.

title: Parmesan-Sherry Pudding
ingredients: 1 lb parmigiano | 1/3 cup dry sherry
instructions: Grind the parmigiano by pulsing with a mortar and pestle. Mix the parmigiano with the sherry and pass through a fine mesh strainer set over a saucepan. Bring the mixture to the boil and boil steadily, stirring constantly with a wooden spoon or a wooden spoon, until the mixture is thick and creamy, about 2 to 4 minutes. Turn the heat to very low during the thickening, and pour in the sherry. Stir until all the sherry has dissolved.

title: Lime and Ham Breakfast Burritos
ingredients: 2 flour tortillas, warmed | 1/2 cup ham, chopped | 1/2 cup half-and-half | 1/2 cup soymilk | 1/2 limes, grated & divided
instructions: Heat the oven to 400 degrees f. Place the tortillas between two damp paper towels. Microwave the ham for a few seconds on high with the side of a chopstick or small knife, moving it around to soften. Spread the ham out on a warm dinner plate. Dip both of the warmed tortillas into the milk. Place them on top of the ham, and spread one side with half and half. Roll each into a burrito, pressing lightly. Squeeze 1/4 cup lime juice over everything. If the burritos aren't sticking, cut them in half before assembling them, and if they're, place them on a cookie sheet. Bake in the oven for 15 minutes, flipping them halfway through cooking.

Random Ingredients: celery rib,molasses,white flour,semolina flour,savory,chicken thigh,vanilla sugar,baby spinach
title: Molasses Chicken Stew
ingredients: 1 kg chicken thigh, bone removed | 300 ml white flour | 300 g semolina flour | 6 cups baby spinach | 12 small celery ribs | 2 cups molasses | 1 teaspoon savory | 2 tablespoons vanilla sugar
instructions: Mix together flour, semolina, spinach, celery, molasses, savory, and vanilla sugar. Melt butter on a very high heat in a large stainless steel pot. Dip chicken pieces in flour and brown on all sides, but don’t cook through. Drain fat. Return to pot. Pour remaining butter on top. Cover pot and simmer on gentle heat for 1 1/2 hours or until meat is cooked and falling off the bone. Serve with maple flavored topping, maple syrup, or fresh fruit.

title: Mussels in Spiced Wine
ingredients: 16 large mussels ( fresh or frozen, not canned ) | 8 lbs stew meat ( i use all fat and light meat )
instructions: Scrub the mussels, remove the beards. Place the mussels and stew meat in a heavy, large saucepan. Scrub the outside of the mussels well under cold running water. Discard any that don't close to the touch. Add water to cover the mussels. Cover and simmer over medium heat until the mussels are open, about 5 hours. Discard any unopened mussels. Skim as often as possible from any froth that forms. Serve in bowls, with bread rolls or as a salad with boiled new potatoes on the side. Mashed potatoes. Salsa. Tomatoes. Refrigerate until serving time. The wine looks beautiful when served cold, warm, or at room temperature, but this is not a problem if you reheat in the microwave, heat to boiling point, and pour into a large warmed bowl. Serve with fresh crusty bread.

Random Ingredients: soymilk,extra virgin olive oil,bell pepper,red wine vinegar,duck,yellow squash,pancetta
title: Duck and Yellow Squash Salad with Pancetta
ingredients: 3/4 lb duck | 14 ounces soymilk or 14 ounces milk | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 7 ounces pancetta ( cured in olive oil, drained ) or 7 ounces bacon ( cured in olive oil, drained ) | 3 ounces yellow squash, sliced | 1 tablespoon soymilk | sliced fresh red bell pepper ( to garnish ) | chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 f degrees. Cut the duck into 6 equal pieces. Heat the milk and vinegar in a small saucepan to boiling and remove from heat. Pour the hot milk/vinegar mixture over the duck and let stand until cool. Halve and deseed the squash and slice very thinly. Toss the duck in olive oil, then add the squash and soymilk. Add the pancetta, sliced red pepper. Add the dressing and toss. Serve at room temperature on a bed of lettuce leaves accompanied by the red bell pepper slices and extra chopped parsley.

Random Ingredients: peanut butter,chicken bouillon,yautia,olive oil,icing sugar,feta cheese
title: Greek Feta & Peanut Butter  Dip
ingredients: 6 ounces feta cheese | 1/3 cup peanut butter | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon | 1 teaspoon icing sugar ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 tablespoon sweetened condensed milk chocolate ( optional ) or 1 tablespoon milk orange juice ( optional )
instructions: Combine ingredients in the bowl of a food processor, whiz until very smooth. Pour into a serving dish, dip into extra condensed milk chocolate and drizzle over fresh fruit, pita chips, pita wedges, etc.

Random Ingredients: iceberg lettuce,extra finely sugar,rice vinegar,tomato paste,pepperoncini pepper,chicken liver
title: Coleslaw
ingredients: 1 cup extra finely granulated sugar ( to taste ) | 1 cup rice vinegar | 2 tablespoons tomato paste | 1/2 cup finely chopped pepperoncini pepper ( a pickled pepperoncini pepper packed ) | 1/2 lb chicken liver | 1 cup shredded iceberg lettuce
instructions: Dressing blend sugar in a clean jar with lid or food processor. Or if you don't have bottled pickled pepperoncini with peppers add a few drops of cornstarch to the boiling water to thicken, stir frequently. Transfer dressing mix to a small bowl and toss with the lettuce until chilled. If desired, you can add more sugar to taste before serving.

Random Ingredients: cumin powder,water,chili,greek yogurt,curry powder,soda water,pineapple chunk,shortening
title: Curried Pineapple
ingredients: 1/2 cup plain greek yogurt | 1/4 teaspoon curry powder | 2 teaspoons water | 2 tablespoons soda water | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 teaspoon chili, chopped | 1 tablespoon pineapple chunk | 2 tablespoons shortening
instructions: In large bowl combine 1/4 cup greek yogurt, curry powder, water, soda water, cumin and chilli. Stir in pineapple. Divide mixture evenly among two 8 ounce ramekins or glasses. Place ramekins in fridge for 30 minutes. In a medium sauce pan melt fat over medium high heat. Add pineapple and cook about 2 minutes, stirring constantly. Remove mixture from heat. Place one ramekin in the fryer basket of a broiler pan. Place pineapple pieces on top of the pineapple. Broil pineapple 3 inches from heat 5 minutes or until pineapple is crispy.

Random Ingredients: jumbo shrimp,cilantro,canola oil,malt vinegar,tomato onion garlic,mirin,tortilla chip,tomato juice
title: Shrimp and Chips With Cilantro Vinaigrette Salad
ingredients: 2 tomatos with onions and garlic | 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1 tablespoon mirin | 1 lb jumbo shrimp, frozen shelled | 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1 1/2 tablespoons malt vinegar | 1 teaspoon tomato juice | 1/2 teaspoon minced cilantro | crushed tortilla chips
instructions: In medium bowl, toss tomatoes with 1 tablespoon oil, malt vinegar, tomato juice and cilantro. Arrange tortilla chips on four salad plates. Arrange shrimp on chips and refrigerate for 1 hour. Remove shrimp, reserving marinade. Thread onto four skewers. Grill shrimp until slightly charred, about 3 minutes per side. Serve shrimp with reserved marinade.

title: Pepperoncini Cheese Dip
ingredients: 2 packages shredded nonfat american cheese ( regular is fine ) | 4 canned pepperoncini peppers, drained and chopped | 2 packages shredded nonfat sour cream ( regular is fine )
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix the american cheese, pepperoncini peppers, and sour cream until well blended. Chill before eating, as this dip will turn to mush.

title: British Breadsticks
ingredients: 1 egg | 1 cup bread flour | 1 cup bread flour | 1 cup margarine or 1 cup butter, melted
instructions: Beat eggs with an electric hand mixer. Add � cup of flour. Add half the bread flour to the egg mixture.

Random Ingredients: spinach,carrot,kosher salt black pepper,pork stew meat,ramen noodle,fast rising yeast,confectioner sugar
title: Cheater's Polish Spinach
ingredients: 1 teaspoon fast rising yeast | 1 pinch confectioners'sugar | kosher salt and ground black pepper to taste | 2 pounds pork stew meat, cubed | 1 pound frozen chopped spinach | 2 carrots, peeled and chopped | 4 cups prepared ramen noodles | 1 bunch fresh spinach, roughly chopped for garnish
instructions: Poke holes through the yeast mixture with a fork in several places, and place in a bowl along with confectioners' sugar and salt and pepper. Mix well until yeast is dissolved, about 5 minutes. Cover, and set aside on a baking sheet until the mixture begins to foam, 40 to 50 minutes. Meanwhile, place the pork, frozen chopped spinach, carrots, noodles, and kosher salt in a large pot and cover with cold water. Bring to a boil, and then simmer over medium high heat until the pork is no longer pink inside and the vegetables are tender, 20 to 25 minutes. Set the pot aside until ready to serve. After 20 minutes, remove the cover from the pork. Mix the ramen noodles into the pot and serve over the spinach.

Random Ingredients: red wine,dill pickle,grand marnier,italian parsley,corn kernel,cardamom,lime juice
title: Pickled Corn
ingredients: 2 cups fresh corn kernels | 3 tablespoons white wine | 3 tablespoons orange-flavored lime juice | 3 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 1/4 cup grated fresh cilantro | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom, or more to taste | 1 teaspoon grand marnier
instructions: Combine the corn kernels, white wine, 3 tablespoons orange flavored liqueur, lime juice, cilantro, cardamom, and grand marnier in a large bowl. Cover, and refrigerate overnight. To make more intense flavor, pour more orange flavored liqueur into a small bottle.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,pineapple juice,beef rib,coke,red wine vinegar,cheese
title: Sweet and Sour Ribs (Crockpot)
ingredients: 1 3/4 lbs beef ribs or 3 3/4 lbs ham, bone in | 1 can coke | 1 can pineapple juice, reserve juice | 2 beef bouillon cubes, dissolved | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1/3 cup cheese, shredded
instructions: Remove fat from ribs and cut into serving strips. Put meat pieces in crockpot and pour remaining juices over meat. Sprinkle with dissolved beef cube. Add remaining ingredients, including reserved pineapple juice, reserving juice to serve on the side. Keep in crockpot on low 8 to 10 hours. Serve with rice.

title: Simple Pita Chips
ingredients: 50 g soya sauce | 100 -200 g pita bread
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together with a fork. Spread on your pita or bread sticks. Serve.

title: Baked Pasta Primavera
ingredients: 1/2 large challah, cut into 1 pieces with a serrated blade | 300 g bowelle pasta | 2 medium courgettes, peeled and finely sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c/400f/gas mark 6 on a baking tray place 2 pieces of bread on each and cut to small chunks and lightly sprinkle with salt. Place over the oven shelf in the middle of the oven. Using a small sharp knife with a sharp blade slash each piece of bread around the edges of the toasted bread around it and then into craters. Place pasta in a pan of boiling water and cook under a medium heat for 10 minutes until just tender and drain. Place drained pasta in a large bowl with courgettes and half the croutons and toss with remaining croutons and serve.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato,vegetable broth,caesar salad dressing,mustard seed,pineapple juice
title: Quick Italian Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 cup caesar salad dressing in olive oil | 1/2 cup pineapple juice from pineapple | 1/4 cup vegetable broth, mixed with | 1 tablespoon sun-dried tomato | 1/8 teaspoon mustard seeds
instructions: Combine dressing with remaining ingredients.

title: Sweet N' Sweet Sesame Dip
ingredients: 1 cup light mayonnaise ( may use regular but taste should be lemony in flavor ) | 4 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1 1/4 cups chicken broth | 1/4 cup brandy ( may sub cognac ) | ice cube
instructions: Preheat oven to 325f and place sesame oil in a small, deep oven safe dish. Heat oil in oven safe pan about 3 minutes or until sesame oil is hot. Remove from heat and stir in mayonnaise. Stir in the broth and brandy. Pour in the ice cubes. Cover and bake, stirring once, for 60 - 80 minutes or until the dip is heated through and has a rich, sweet consistency.

Random Ingredients: horseradish,plain yogurt,rye bread,molasses,red cabbage,red pepper flake
title: Slow-Bake Irish Coleslaw
ingredients: 1 package sliced rye bread, such as the pumpernickel type | 1 package sliced red cabbage | 3/4 cup plain yogurt ( plain is fine ) | 3 tablespoons molasses | 2 teaspoons dried horseradish | 1 teaspoon red pepper flakes
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit. Slice the rye bread 1/8 inch thick. Arrange a layer of cabbage and a sprinkling of yogurt in a medium sized casserole. Mix the molasses, horseradish, pepper flakes, and a handful of shredded cheese. Spoon over the salad. Continue layering until you have 4 layers. Bake for 20 minutes. If you're not serving immediately, just let it sit on the baking sheet for 5 - 10 minutes or until it's dry. Serve immediately.

title: Mushrooms for the BBQ
ingredients: 2 large baby portabella mushrooms | 1 tablespoon dried rosemary or 1 tablespoon dried sage | 1 tablespoon dried lavender | 1/4 cup mixed peppercorns | 1/2 cup currants or 1/2 cup raisins
instructions: Wash mushrooms. Remove stems and remove silver stalks. Rinse with cold water and pat dry. Combine with all other ingredients and toss. Marinate for two hours or leave overnight. Place in the refrigerator for 30 minutes to mature and to marinate dinner.

title: Curried Raspberry Beans
ingredients: 1 lb raspberries | 1/2 small spanish onion, chopped | 2 cloves garlic powder | 2 teaspoons curry powder | 1 tablespoon minced fresh herb ( coriander, basil, oregano ) | 1/2 teaspoon canola oil
instructions: Soak the raspberries in ice water for several hours. Drain and discard the liquid. Set aside. Melt the garlic powder in the canola oil until it turns light brown and fragrant. Add the onion and cook the mixture until it begins to caramelize. Add the raspberries and curry powder. Cook for 5 - 10 minutes, stirring constantly. Add 2/3 cup of raiberry water. Mix well. Simmer on low heat for 1/2 hour while you prepare the beans. After an hour, check for taste, adding salt if necessary. You may serve these warm or chilled. These beans are very rich, with lots of flavor.

Random Ingredients: egg noodle,herring fillet,macaroni,red wine vinegar,bouillon cube,shiitake mushroom,sage,walnut
title: Herring Salad With Noodles
ingredients: 600 g shiitake mushrooms | 1/2 cup chopped walnuts | 2 cups small macaroni | 5 herring fillets | 1 bouillon cube | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 1/2 cup instant beef stock cube | 200 g egg noodles
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the noodles in a medium sized pot. Bring to the boil.

Random Ingredients: vanilla bean,ouzo,vegetable shortening,ginger root,whipping cream,thyme,half cream,vinegar
title: Ouzo Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups whipping cream | 1 1/2 cups half-and-half cream | 2 ounces ouzo ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla bean, split | 3 cloves | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh thyme | 3 tablespoons minced fresh ginger root | 3 tablespoons ouzo ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons vinegar, or to taste
instructions: Combine whipping cream, half and half, ouzo, vanilla bean, cloves, and thyme in a saucepan.

title: Foolproof White Chocolate
ingredients: 4 ounces cheddar cheese | 4 ounces coffee
instructions: Blend it with a fork. Pour into tall glasses, or tall beer glasses for some fancy effect. Use some of the cheese to make the mocha sign in your mug, and for fiddleheads.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheddar cheese,beef chuck,natural yoghurt
title: Beef Steakhouse (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 2 lbs beef chuck, fat trimmed | 1/2 cup natural yoghurt | 1/3 cup monterey jack and cheddar cheese blend
instructions: Trim meat of all excess fat, such as rind, etc. Slice meat into six 1 pieces. Place in slow cooker. Combine together yoghurt and cheese in small bowl. Pour over meat. Cover and cook on low for 6 - 8 hours, or on high for 4 - 5 hours.

title: Wasabi Green Tomatoes (Fried Green Tomatoes)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons wasabi paste | 2 medium green tomatoes, sliced | 1 teaspoon crushed dried fenugreek seeds | 1 teaspoon cornstarch | 1 teaspoon dried fenugreek seeds | 1 bay seasoning
instructions: Mix the wasabi with a little water to make a thick paste. Coat the tomatoes with the paste. Heat a small amount of oil over a high flame. When it smokes, put in the tomatoes. After 3 minutes, put down the heat under the tomatoes so that the wasabi will penetrate the tomato easily and cook on the bottom. Add fenugreek and bay seasoning. Keep stirring for 5 - 10 minutes. Put the sauce in a bowl and serve.

title: Turkish Coffee Bread
ingredients: 1/2 cup black regular grind coffee | 1 tablespoon orange zest | 2 loaves bread ( i like multi-grain )
instructions: Pour 2 tablespoons coffee into bowl of your food processor and process until coffee begins to drip. Add orange zest and process until it is about the consistency of coffee.

title: Butternut Squash and Ricotta Cheese Salad
ingredients: 2 medium butternut squash, peeled and cubed | 2 cups ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup shredded italian bread, divided | 2 tablespoons flour | 2 bags italian rolls or ( 8 ounce ) bags flour tortillas, cut into 1-inch slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a 2 1/2 to 3 quart baking dish, toss together 1/2 lb. Ricotta cheese with flour to coat and set aside. In another saucepan, steam squash about 15 minutes until tender. Combine squash and ricotta cheese with remaining 2 cups bread crumbs and 1/2 cup italian bread crumbs. Toss with cheese mixture until lightly coated. Transfer to a medium bowl and sprinkle with remaining 2/3 cup bread crumbs. Toss to flake and set aside. Arrange sliced italian rolls on a serving platter. Spoon squash/ricotta mixture on breadcrumb mound in center. Serve with additional shredded cheese mixture on the side.

title: Peppyseed-Crusted Chicken Souvlaki
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken thighs | 1/4 pound white american cheese, cut into 12 slices | 1/2 cup hazelnuts | 1/3 cup raspberry vinegar | 1/4 cup nigella seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Lightly coat a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Place chicken thighs in the prepared baking dish and scatter sliced cheese over the meat.

title: Easy Crock Pot Glazed Veal
ingredients: 2 teaspoons liquid pectin | 3/4 cup port wine | 1 package frozen sugar snap peas | 1/2 lb ground veal
instructions: In bowl, place pectin. Over hot water in a small bowl, stir in port. Pour port into crock pot and turn crock pot on high. Remove cords of twine and strings or string and discard. Place frozen peas into crock and cover with plastic wrap. Freeze for at least 8 hours or overnight. Remove string or strings from peas and drain and place in a skillet. Cover with a bit of water and bring to a boil. Cook until thawed. Pour peas into a zip lock bag or other storage container and add the ground veal. Press into peas. Refrigerate at least 8 hours. Slice meat with a sharp chef's knife into 1 inch slices. Place meat in crock pot with peas and veal, stirring to combine. Cover and cook on auto for 1 hour. Serve on buns.

Random Ingredients: amaretto,ice water,red cabbage,mustard seed,cilantro leaf,beef bouillon cube
title: Red Cabbage Soup With Amaretto
ingredients: 4 lbs red cabbage, finely grated | 1/2 cup finely chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 2 tablespoons mustard seeds | 1 -2 cup amaretto ( almond liqueur ) | 1/4 cup ice water
instructions: Combine all ingredients in slow cooker. Cover, cook 8 - 10 hours on low. Stir every 15 - 20 minutes on high until thoroughly heated.

Random Ingredients: pizza sauce,self rising flour,leek,cumin powder,simple syrup
title: Simple and Easy Leek Pizza Dough
ingredients: 2 cups self-rising flour, sifted | 1 tablespoon cumin powder | 6 tablespoons simple syrup, divided - half is for topping | 1/2 cup pizza sauce, divided ( to taste ) | 2 leeks, white and light green parts, sliced thinly
instructions: Mix flour and cumin and set aside. Mix together 2 tablespoons syrup, 2 tablespoons or water, and 1 tablespoons of syrup. In bowl, add 2 tbsp or water. Combine 2 tablespoons or water, and 1 tbsp or water with pizza sauce. If you don't have a pizza topping or sauce, combine 2 tbsp each of syrup and water and add to flour mixture. Stir just until moistened. Add more water if dough is too sticky. Knead on a floured surface for 5 minutes. Cut in half diagonally. Place, un buttered side up, on lightly greased pizza pan. Sprinkle the scallion and/or cheese blend on top of dough. Bake on medium hot stone for 15 minutes, or until cheese is golden brown.

title: Easy Salmon and Coffee Raita
ingredients: 2 salmon fillets | 3 tablespoons coffee | 2 tablespoons buttermilk | 1 -2 red chili pepper, finely chopped ( or more to taste ) | 1/3 cup queso fresco, crumbled ( or to taste ) | 1/3 cup almonds, chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Arrange the salmon on a greased baking sheet and bake for 10 minutes. Turn and bake for an additional 8 minutes, or until just done. Remove, and let stand for about 3 minutes. Cut into 6 servings. Serve with the coffee and crumbled cheese.

title: Grilled Kielbasa or Polish Sausage and Chicken Wings
ingredients: 1 package kielbasa or other polish sausage | 3 pounds chicken wings, separated
instructions: Cut the sausage into 2 pieces, 1 inch thick. Remove the meat from the casings, and cut the meat into 6 pieces. Place the meat on a plate, and add a piece of foil. Dip each piece into the saute' coating. Pour enough oil into a frying pan to coat the pan entirely. Heat oil over medium high heat, and carefully place the chicken in the oil. Reduce heat to medium, and cook for 30 minutes, turning and stirring occasionally. Serve the sausage on the side for dipping.

title: Cheese and Coconut Burritos
ingredients: 1 packet active dry yeast | 2 cups warm water | 3/4 cup margarine | 5 - 6 cups cheese tortellini, cooked | 2 teaspoons salt | 1/3 cup chopped fresh basil | 1/3 cup jaggery ( or palm sugar ) | 1/3 cup grated coconut ( optional )
instructions: Add yeast to warm water, then set aside for five minutes in a warm place to foamy. Add butter to a large non stick skillet. Stir continuously so it doesn't burn. Add a 2 - 3 cups of flour. When the butter is melted, add one cup of the warm water and stir continuously until the dough begins to form a ball. Turn off heat, but leave for five minutes after the five minutes. Knead the dough on a lightly floured surface for five minutes. Form into a ball and place in lightly oiled bowl, cover & allow to rise in a cool place until doubled. While this is rising, steam tortellini in a steamer until tender. Drain tortellini and set aside. Remove dough from bowl. Divide into ten to ten equal parts. Roll flat into circles, then place cut side down, onto a plate. Spoon 1 to 10 t of tomatillo sauce into center of each dough circle. Sprinkle on about 1 t of cheese. Sprinkle chopped basil over the cheese, basil & jaggery or palm sugar if using. Roll up burritos and secure each rolled and sealed edge with toothpicks. Place the burritos in a deep baking dish filled with hot water. Cover and let rise for 20 minutes. Bake at 375°f for 15 minutes or until golden. Serve warm with additional tomato sauce, salsa or salsa.

Random Ingredients: white sugar,nonfat milk,lemon peel,vanilla extract,parsley sprig
title: Low Fat, Low Fat French Silk Syrup
ingredients: 3 cups nonfat milk | 3/4 cup white sugar | 2 tablespoons vanilla extract | 1 teaspoon lemon peel, grated | 1/2 cup fresh parsley sprig, chopped
instructions: In a large saucepan, over high heat, combine milk, sugar, vanilla and lemon peel. Bring to boil, stirring constantly. Pour mixture into a small bowl and set aside. Melt mixture until creamy, about 20 minutes, then pour it into a 9 inch square pan. Place in freezer till set. Before serving, pour warm syrup over the top and garnish with parsley.

title: Spiced Clarified Brandy
ingredients: 1/2 cup very soft amaretto | 1/2 cup double cream | 3/4 cup finely crushed tart apple | 1/2 teaspoon whole cardamom seed, slightly crushed ( about 2-3 pinches ) | 1/4 cup finely crushed juniper berries
instructions: Place all ingredients in a small pot and bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring to dissolve the flavors. Reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring frequently, for 10 minutes. Strain the solids through a fine sieve into a heavy pan and refrigerate 1 hour or until cold. Store in a tightly covered container at room temperature. For 1 cup of pure clarified butter or 1 cup clarified creme fat, melt the 2/4 cup condensed light cream, stirring regularly, in a small saucepan over low heat. Do not boil, as lumps of butter will form. When the cream has simmered for 10 minutes, remove from heat. Cool 5 minutes. Add the cardamom seeds to the cream, then carefully fold in the juniper. Store in an airtight container.

title: German Plum Sauce
ingredients: 2 pounds plum, plums, plums, pears | 1 can sweetened condensed milk
instructions: Grind plum plums into a fine consistency with the pulp. Stir in the condensed milk to get desired consistency.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,picante sauce,beef brisket,lemon pudding,cumin powder
title: Microwave Chet Thing Beef Sandwich
ingredients: 1 beef brisket | 12 ounces picante sauce | 1/2 tablespoon cumin powder | 1 package lemon pudding | 12 slices rye bread ( you might need more depending on what type of bread you use )
instructions: Put brisket, picante sauce, and cumin in microwave safe crock. Cover and cook on hi for 3 to 4 minutes or until meat is cooked. Remove meat, discard sauce mix, and cool for 3 to 5 minutes. Slice meat and serve on bread with cracker, tortillas, or warmed pita bread. For vegetarian use only the tomato sauce.

Random Ingredients: steak,orange juice zest,anise seed,apple cider,coriander leaf,pita bread,salt,pork
title: Bolihorra -- Cuban Pork and Beef Pilaf
ingredients: 5 lbs flank steak | 4 lbs pork, in 1-inch cubes | 1 orange, juice and zest of | 8 large fresh coriander leaves, stems removed and leaves chopped | 3/4 cup apple cider | 3 tablespoons anise seeds, lightly crushed | salt | pita bread
instructions: Heat oven to 350ºf. Place meat in a large roasting pan. Combine with orange juice. Add coriander, orange rind and juice. Season with anise. Poke holes in meat with a fork, a sharp skewer or kitchen skewer. Insert meat with wet fork in center of meat. Bake 1 hour 1 hour 15 minutes, or until internal temperature reaches 140ºf. Cool. Cover and refrigerate up to 2 days. Cooks note, preparation for pork only needs to be prepared ahead and refrigerated a minimum of 2 days and not longer than 4 hours. Bolíhorra can be prepared up to a day before cooking. It can also be frozen overnight. Reheat, covered, in a 350ºf oven for 1 hour or till heated through. Serving suggestion, garnish with pita bread.

title: Steamed Sweet Beef Brisket
ingredients: 2 beef brisket ( i use a round ) | 1/16 - 1/4 cup pineapple juice | sourdough bread or crusty bread | 10 -12 anchovies, drained, oil reserved | sliced canned tomato, pepper rings, shrimp, cherry tomatoes, pineapple, cucumber pickle slices, kalamata olives ( optional )
instructions: Place brisket on rack in large pan and pour 1/8 to 1/4 cup water.

title: Kumquat's Fajita Soup
ingredients: 1 box corkscrew macaroni ( large size ) | 5 medium yukon gold potatoes ( small, cubed ) | 1 can sliced black olives, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Bring water to a boil and cook macaroni per instruction on the box. Drain and set aside. While waiting for water to boil, dice yukon gold potatoes, and boil them in about 1/2 cup of water with salt. Set aside. Drain and set aside. Cook cubed potatoes in about 1/2 cup of water with salt for about 10 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Set aside. When water is ready, dump contents of 1 can into a large pot that the water was inches add potatoes and olives to soup. Cover and cook for about 20 minutes. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: great northern bean,pearl barley,chicken breast half,chuck,water,arborio rice
title: Italian Baked Chicken and Barley With Beans and Rice
ingredients: 6 chicken breast halves | 1 can great northern beans, rinsed and drained ( reserve liquid ) | 1 cup pearl barley, uncooked | 2 cups water | 3 1/4 cups uncooked arborio rice or 3 1/4 cups carnaroli rice | 16 ounces 90 % lean ground chuck or 16 ounces lean ground turkey breast half, cooked and diced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Grease 2 quart casserole dish. Place chicken in dish.

title: Southern Style Mustard
ingredients: 1 cup mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon orange bitter | 1 1/2 cups shortening | 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley leaves
instructions: Place mustard seeds in a heatproof bowl. Add orange bitter.

Random Ingredients: espresso powder,fish cake,sirloin tip roast,basil leaf,gingerroot,chipotle chile adobo,champagne white wine
title: Peppery Roast Beef Sandwich
ingredients: 16 ounces sirloin tip roast | 3/4 ounce fresh gingerroot, cut into 1/4-inch-thick slices | 3/4 ounce dried basil leaves | 1 1/2 teaspoons instant espresso powder | 3 chipotle chiles in adobo ( in adobo sauce with chili powder ) | 1/2 cup dry champagne or 1/2 cup dry white wine | 1/2 cup champagne or 1/2 cup dry white wine | 10 slices sandwich bread or 10 slices sandwich buns
instructions: Trim fat from roast and discard remaining fat. Cut roast in half horizontally.

title: Prawns With Zest and Orange
ingredients: 200 g large shrimp, deveined and butterflied | 1/4 yellow pepper, julienne-cut | 1 orange, zest of
instructions: Slice zest into thin strips. Cut pepper lengthwise in half, removing any seeds. Place all ingredients in fryer and stir until shrimp are pink. Remove from fryer and serve immediately.

title: Fish in Gravy on top (Kari Bhalaate)
ingredients:
2 lbs fish, cut into 2 portions about 2-1/2 inches thick.
    - ( i use the head, tail and eyes ) | creole seasoning, to taste | 1/8 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Sprinkle a little creole seasoning to the fish. Rub fish with about ¼ teaspoon of the creole seasoning. Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes. Lightly oil a large frying pan or sauté pan and set over medium low heat. When the pan is hot enough to sizzle a piece of fish, remove fish from the pan or sauté it in it's own juices on all sides until cooked through. Transfer to a platter and keep warm. Add rest of the creole seasoning to pan and melt the butter. Season the fish with the remaining creole seasoning, add to the pan, and serve.

title: Rose Oil
ingredients: 4 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 teaspoon rose water or 1 teaspoon almond extract, to your taste
instructions: Pour olive oil into a shallow bowl. If you like a bit of a thicker oil, you can add small pinches of almond extract or rose essence. Add 1/8 teaspoon of rose water or almond extract to the drippings. Stir until oil is completely moistened. Allow to stand for about 10 minutes until needed with cold water. If you don't have a bottle like i do now, just shake the bowl periodically. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: basil leaf,baking soda,poblano pepper,chinese egg noodle,sugar,mushroom,shallot,beef chuck roast
title: Lazy Tongue
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless beef chuck roast, cut in 1-inch cubes | 1/2 lb fresh mushrooms | 1 large shallot | 3 tablespoons sugar | 2 teaspoons cinnnamate basil leaves | 1 large poblano pepper | 12 ounces chinese egg noodles or 12 ounces spaghetti | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: In crockpot, combine the beef, mushrooms, shallots, sugar, basil, and pepper. Pour over cooked noodles.

title: Sun Dried Salt & Sun Dried Tomato Squid
ingredients: 12 sun-dried tomatoes ( about 1 1/2 ounces ) | 1 cup oyster sauce
instructions: In medium bowl, combine tomatoes and oyster sauce. Cover and refrigerate for 1 - 2 hours, stirring occasionally. Serve hot or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: semolina,pineapple juice,diet lemon lime soda,ro tel tomato
title: Quick and Easy Mexican Soda
ingredients: 1 can organic light syrup | 1 can healthy request tomato paste | 8 ounces sprite or 8 ounces lemon-lime soda | 2 cups semolina, or coarsely ground into powder
instructions: In a large pitcher combine your ingredients. Stir and taste.

Random Ingredients: red chile powder,grand marnier,pork,jumbo shrimp,corn oil,hard egg,nutmeg,stewing beef
title: Spicy Hot Beef Shrimp (Grouper)
ingredients: 1 lb uncooked boneless stewing beef | 3/4 lb uncooked jumbo shrimp, peeled | 12 small hard-boiled eggs, yolks only ( reserve whites ) | 1 1/2 cups corn oil | 2 tablespoons grand marnier ( optional ) or 2 tablespoons apple juice ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons chile powder ( optional ) | 1/4 cup chopped nutmeg
instructions: Cut steak up into 3/4 inch cubes, then cut into 1 inch pieces. In a large container with a lid, dump beef and shrimp, set aside. Using a blender or other small measuring cup, lightly smash unpeeled eggs until the size of a whole egg. In the center of a double boiler begin heating oil on high heat. When oil is almost smoking, add all the beaten eggs and scramble for one minute while stirring constantly. Lower heat to medium and cook until mixture is fairly dark red in color, but not browned. This takes about 5 minutes or until oil is fairly deep again. Now crack open the double boiler and add the hot beef/shrimp mixture, mixing thoroughly with all of the yolks in the bowl. Continue to cook on medium heat for 10 minutes or until the shrimp are done. You may have to add water/pepper to thicken the sauce a little bit if the sauce seems too thin. Just before serving, stir in the grand marnier and chile powder. Sprinkle nutmeg on top.

title: Lentered Corn Salad With Ginger
ingredients: 4 ears fresh corn kernels, trimmed, cut from the cob ( about 1 c of kernels per ear or 4 cups cobs ) | 2 ounces finely chopped peeled fresh gingerroot | 1 kaffir lime leaf, finely finely chopped | 1 tablespoon finely chopped unsalted almonds, toasted, skin removed and finely chopped
instructions: Place the chicken, corn kernels, ginger and lime leaf in a pan with a little cold water and bring to the boil. Lower the heat, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes until the chicken is cooked. Lift the chicken onto a warmed plate and allow to stand for 5 minutes, before cutting the kernels from the cob into bite sized pieces. Sprinkle over the almonds and serve.

Random Ingredients: lavender,maraschino cherry,allspice berry,cream tartar,rye bread,vanilla,italian parsley
title: Victorian Blintze
ingredients: 1/2 cup sour cream | 2 teaspoons vanilla | 1/2 teaspoon lavender | 1/2 teaspoon allspice berry | 1/2 tablespoon dried oregano | 2 slices rye bread, crusts trimmed | 1 teaspoon italian parsley, finely chopped | 2 maraschino cherries, pitted and coarsely chopped ( optional )
instructions: In a mixing bowl, combine sour cream, vanilla, lavender, allspice, oregano, and rye bread. Chill. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spread bottom of a baking dish with 1 teaspoon of butter. Distribute bread mixture evenly into the baking dish. Sprinkle top with chopped parsley. Bake in the preheated oven 35 to 45 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Chile Sorbet
ingredients: 2 cans chopped canned green chiles ( optional ) | 1 can chopped orange juice
instructions: In a blender or food processor add green chiles, orange juice and green chile juice. Process until smooth.

Random Ingredients: mexican tomato,jalapeno pepper,pomegranate seed,peanut oil,corn oil,italian seasoning,cremini mushroom
title: Tomato and Mushroom Stir Fry-Ups
ingredients: 6 -10 cremini mushrooms, thinly sliced | 1 jalapeno pepper, seeded and sliced in rounds ( i've used other hot peppers too ) | 1/2 cup mexican-style stewed tomatoes ( i usually buy the pre-sliced ones that come in a tube or a bag ) | 2 teaspoons peanut oil | 1/4 teaspoon italian seasoning | 2 teaspoons corn oil, reserved from above | 1 teaspoon crushed pomegranate seeds
instructions: Heat a large non stick wok or skillet over medium heat. Add peanut oil and swirl to coat the pan. Add the mushrooms, jalapeno peppers, stewed tomatoes and seasoning. Stir fry for a few minutes until the tomatoes begin to soften. Add the corn oil and the pomegranate seeds. Stir fry for a few seconds then pour the contents onto the pan. Simmer for 3 - 4 minutes until it's piping hot.

Random Ingredients: rice vermicelli,cornflour,horseradish,red chili pepper,wood ear mushroom
title: Smoked Horseradish Rice Noodle Rolls
ingredients: 1 red chili pepper, finely diced | 10 dried wood ear mushrooms, roughly chopped | 1 teaspoon cornflour | 180 g rice vermicelli | 2 -4 tablespoons pickled horseradish, drained
instructions: Finely grind the chili and set aside. Blanch the wood ears of mushrooms in boiling water for 30 seconds, then drain and cool. Put the cornflour in a small bowl, season with salt and then stir in a little water. Soak the vermicelli in boiling water for 2 - 3 minutes, then drain well. Stir the noodles into the cornflour mixture and stir in the horseradish. Divide between 2 clean paper cases and roll up. Serve while warm.

title: Blueberry Cranberry Saffron Blueberry Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup cranberry juice, fresh or in bottled glass jar | 1/4 cup blueberry juice | 1 tablespoon dried savory | 1 dash hot sauce or 1 dash paprika
instructions: Whisk all ingredients together. Cover and place in refrigerator 3 - 4 hours. Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,bechamel sauce,green apple,skirt steak,pistachio,russet potato,pesto sauce,lettuce leaf
title: Beef Skirt Steak and Potato Salad
ingredients: 250 g russet potatoes, peeled and cut into cubes | 2 green apples, cut into chunks | 2 tablespoons pistachios | 1 tablespoon self-raising flour or 1 tablespoon polenta flour | 400 g skirt steaks | 2 tablespoons prepared pesto sauce | 1/4 cup ready to serve beetchamel sauce ( optional ) | lettuce leaf, to serve
instructions: Place the potatoes in a pan of salted water and bring to the boil over a high heat. Cook uncovered for 15 mins, or until tender, then drain. Transfer to a large heatproof bowl, cover, and chill for 20 mins, then transfer to a cutting board. Add apples to the pan a few pieces at a time, tossing them around in the pan so they just start to colour. Once all of the potatoes have been coated with spilt pesto brush with a little oil and scatter over the top of the potatoes. Sprinkle with pistachios, then top with the skirt steak, then drizzle over the beetchamel. Sprinkle over the top of the steak, then season with salt and pepper. Cook over a low heat for 5 mins on each side. Remove from the heat and stir through the pesto. Transfer to an ovenproof serving bowl or serving plates. Arrange the lettuce leaves on top and serve straight away with the spicy beetchamel. Alternatively, wrap the dressing in wrap, then place on plates. Serve straight away. This serves a couple of people.

title: Irish Cranberry Colcannon
ingredients: 1 head cabbage, shredded | 1 cup chopped fresh cranberries | 1/2 cup milk, or to taste
instructions: Toss cabbage, cranberries, and milk together in a serving bowl. Cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate to allow cabbage flavors to mellow, about 1 hour.

title: Breaded Dates With Cognac Spread
ingredients: 1 lb dates | 1 tablespoon hazelnut oil | 1/4 cup cognac ( almond brandy ) | 2/3 cup fresh breadcrumb | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 2 teaspoons white wine vinegar
instructions: Peel the dates with a vegetable peeler, slice them longways into very thin ribbons about ¼ inch thick. Remove the pitted dates and discard pit. Place in a small saucepan, cover with water and stir in the oil and the cognac. Bring to a boil, lower the heat, cover and simmer for 10 - 15 minutes. In a bowl mix the dates and half the crumbs with the remaining crumbs, the coriander powder and the vinegar then stir in the dates and liquid. Transfer to a serving dish and sprinkle with the remaining crumbs.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,romaine lettuce,broccoli,alfredo sauce,white wine vinegar,pear
title: Green and White Gourmet Salad
ingredients: 1 head romaine lettuce | 1 head broccoli | 1 medium ripe pear | 1 can of chopped tomatoes with green chilies | 1 can alfredo sauce | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar
instructions: Rinse all the lettuce and the fresh broccoli. Trim any woody bits. Cut the pear into large chunks and place in a large bowl of ice water to stop the cooking. Let sit for 10 minutes to soften. Then drain thoroughly and remove the outer green leaves from the broccoli. Cut the florets into small pieces. Place the broccoli in as many of the large green leaves as will fit in one layer and any broken leaves from the lettuce. Peel and quarter the apple. Place all the above in the lettuce and dress with alfredo sauce. Sprinkle on the vinegar and refrigerate for several hours or overnight to let the flavors marry. Note, some people like it best eaten with a crunchy bbq sauce.

title: Mushroom & Apple Salad
ingredients: 150 500 g courgettes, unpeeled | 200 g green apples ( fuji ) | 2 tablespoons rice wine | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 1 tablespoon fresh cilantro leaves | fresh basil leaf
instructions: Cut the ends off the courgettes and dice them into small pieces. Slice the apple thinly, cutting into thin rounds. In a bowl, combine the rice wine, vinegar and basil and mix well. Add the sliced vegetables and toss. Let stand for at least one hour before serving to develop the flavors and texture.

title: Spicy Honey Glazed Shrimp
ingredients: 1/2 cup clear honey | 1 teaspoon splenda granular | 12 large shrimp, peeled, 31-35 per pound
instructions: In a 1 quart glass jar with a tight fitting lid, combine honey and splenda. Using a funnel, carefully dump contents of jar into jar, leaving 1/4 to 1/4 inch of headspace.

Random Ingredients: mango chutney,sun tomato oil,sherry,plain nonfat yogurt
title: Tomato Chutney Smoothies
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons plain nonfat yogurt | 1 tablespoon sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and finely chopped | 1 tablespoon mango chutney or 1 tablespoon chutney | 1/4 teaspoon dry sherry
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a food process, blender or a food processor and puree till smooth. Serve as an accompaniment to salads or cold indian breads.

Random Ingredients: pear,rice noodle,bouillon,chinese bean,sherry wine vinegar,celery salt,coconut rum
title: Japanese Rice Balls
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups cooked rice noodles | 2 tablespoons light coconut rum | 2 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon chicken stock or 1 tablespoon bouillon | 2 tablespoons chopped celery salt | 200 g fresh chinese beans, cut into thirds | 1 pear, cut into 1 cm cubes
instructions: Place the cooked rice noodles in a bowl and pour boiling water over. Leave to soak for 5 minutes or more. Drain the noodles. In a bowl, mix together the coconut rum, vinegar, stock, celery salt and dried bean. Using a melon baller, scoop out the meat from the pear and throw it in with the bean mix. Fold in the noodles. Shape into balls, or shape into small rice balls and place in an ovenproof dish. Bake for 15 - 30 minutes or until hot, stirring the rice balls at the end. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: rice vinegar,halloumi cheese,asparagus,red curry paste,chili powder
title: Chilli-Spice Grilled Halloumi With Chiles & Asparagus
ingredients: 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1 tablespoon sweet chili powder | 100 g shaved halloumi cheese or 100 g thinly sliced goat cheese | 350 g trimmed asparagus
instructions: To make the dressing, combine the first three ingredients in small bowl. Set aside. Cut asparagus into 3cm lengths. Cook the asparagus over a high heat for 5 - 6 minutes or until bright green. Set aside to drain and drain on absorbent paper. Combine the reserved dressing ingredients in medium bowl. Add the cooked asparagus and toss to combine. To serve, place a dollop of dressing into a wide shallow bowl or plate. Top with some of the sliced halloumi, then serve immediately.

title: Baked Peaches in a Lighty Oat
ingredients: 4 large firm ripe peaches, peeled, pitted and cut into 1 slices | 1/4 cup longhorn cheese, chopped | 1/4 cup cornstarch | 2/3 cup oats | 3 tablespoons lukewarm tomato puree | 1 tablespoon marinade
instructions: Combine all ingredients, except the cornstarch, in a small saucepan, and cook over medium heat until sauce thickens slightly and apples are tender but not mushy. Pour over peaches. Coat a 1 1/2 pint griddle or an ovenproof baking dish with cooking spray. Spray with cooking spray. Put peaches in in an ovenproof dish and bake in a 400f oven until heated through. Pour tomato puree and marinade over the peaches and bake, uncovered, for 30 to 40 minutes, or until hot and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,chicken breast meat,serrano chilies,olive,rye bread,mustard powder
title: Grilled Chicken Sandwiches with Roasted Salsa
ingredients: 3 tablespoons olive, divided | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 serrano chilies, minced | 1 jar roasted peppers, drained and cut into strips | 1 can sliced ripe olives, drained | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar
instructions: Combine 1 tablespoon olive oil, mustard powder, serrano chilies.

Random Ingredients: pork sausage,mustard seed,chili sauce,cider vinegar,rosemary sprig,liquid smoke
title: Chinese Style Pickled Pork Sausages #2
ingredients: 1/2 cup chili sauce | 1/2 cup bottled mustard seeds | 1 1/2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 3 tablespoons chili sauce | 2 tablespoons liquid smoke | 1 tablespoon dried rosemary sprig, with leaves | 1 lb pork sausage ( recommended -- kielbasa )
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Turn down heat, cover and simmer until pork can be pierced easily, about 4 hours. Pour the sticky sauce into a jar and let sit, turning often, until flavors are well blended, about an hour.

Random Ingredients: gruyere cheese,salt pepper,mustard powder,red potato,egg,mozzarella cheese,onion soup mix
title: Potato and Cheese Souffle
ingredients: 6 slices gruyere cheese | 6 red potatoes | 1 egg | 1 teaspoon dry onion soup mix | 1 teaspoon dry mustard powder | salt and pepper | 1/2 cup shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Slice potatoes thinly and put in microwave safe bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and microwave on high for 7 minutes. Turn off microwaving and stir potatoes until potatoes are cooled and well coated. Mash potatoes for several minutes and mix with egg, soup mix, mustard, salt and pepper. Put half the potato mixture into the greased souffle dish. Sprinkle on half of the shredded mozzarella cheese. Repeat with the rest of the potato mixture, cheese and cream. Bake 20 minutes.

title: Tuna Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1/4 cup mayonnaise | 2 tablespoons white sugar | 2 cans tuna in vegetable oil, drained | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together the mayonnaise and sugar until smooth. Stir in tuna, and season with pepper. Cover, and refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Alfajores a La Rydberg
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sultanas | 3 tablespoons cognac ( or brandy ) | 3 tablespoons bacon drippings | 36 extra virgin olive oil | 36 cooked linguine or 36 prepared small to medium sized shrimp
instructions: Put a tablespoon or two of oil in a medium sized saucpan. Keep the oil on high to just begin to smoke. Add the onions, cognac or brandy. When they start to sizzle and brown, add sultanas. Keep sizzling and turning until the sizzling stops and the juices have reduced, then turn heat to medium low. Meanwhile, warm up a large skillet over medium heat and add enough olive oil to cover the bottom of the pan. The original tip of the pan is to swirl it over the burner so that the pan will not burn. Add the linguini or shrimp to the pan, toss and toss until each side is golden. Remove the sizzling oil, toss in a couple of sultanas, then let them fry just a moment or two. Do this until all ingredients are cooked. Add the bacon drippings, and mix well. Keep frying until the flames die down, then serve hot immediately, garnishing with sprigs of parsley or your favourite green salad.

title: Penne with Chicken
ingredients: 2 cups chopped cooked chicken | 1/4 cup chopped pitted ripe olives, divided | 1/2 cup sherry wine | 2 cups hot cooked penne pasta
instructions: Combine chicken, 1/4 cup of olives, sherry, and 1/2 cup of the pasta in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: plum tomato,coriander seed,cocoa powder,plain yogurt,saffron thread,beef brisket
title: Rachael Ray's Crock Pot Smoked Beef Brisket
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs thin sliced thin-cut beef brisket, of choice | 2 teaspoons coriander seeds | 2 teaspoons saffron threads | 5 1/2 teaspoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 2 plum tomatoes, quartered | 1/2 cup plain yogurt
instructions: Heat oven to 325 degrees f. Combine coriander, saffron, cocoa and tomatoes in small bowl.

title: Sage and Mango Chutney Fries
ingredients: 2 eggs | 3 grated parsnips | 1/2 cup chopped fresh sage | 3 tablespoons sweet mango chutney | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh thyme | 1/4 cup grand marnier
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. In a mixing bowl, whisk together eggs, parsnips, sage, chutney, thyme and grand marnier until well incorporated. Place a large baking sheet over medium heat. Drop a tablespoon or two of the mixture onto the hot baking sheet. Bake for approximately 8 minutes, or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: chili paste garlic,green olive,bell pepper,pork shoulder
title: BBQ Pork With Roasted Pepper and Green Olive Sauce
ingredients: 500 g pork shoulder | 1/4 cup sweet chili paste with garlic ( i use garlic ) | 1 bell pepper | 4 large green olives
instructions: Place the pork shoulder in a ziploc bag or bowl, and pour the olive oil into the bag over to coat. Marinate for at least 8 hours or over night to marinate. Preheat the grill to high, or alternatively, heat the oven to 230°c. Roast the sliced pork on the bbq or in the oven for 12 - 15 minutes depending on temperature of meat. Turn around and roast for another 2 - 2 minutes, or until brown. Place a small amount of water on the barbeque to steam the vegetables for a few minutes. Remove from the grill and set aside. Pour the olive sauce into a small pan. Roast the pepper and olives for 1 - 2 minutes under a preheated grill until softened. Remove from the grill and slice into thin slices. Serve with the roasted pepper and olive sauce and a green salad.

title: Mustard Seeds and Potato Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs red potatoes, cut into wedges | 3 tablespoons vegetable oil | 2 tablespoons brown mustard seeds | 3 tablespoons lettuce, coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a bowl toss potatoes with oil. Place in a greased ovenproof skillet, and bake uncovered 15 minutes or until tender. Meanwhile, in a small frying pan over medium heat, toast mustard seeds 30 seconds to 1 minute. Remove from heat and stir in lettuce. Cover and sprinkle with ground mustard seeds. Enjoy.

title: Sausages With Cardamom
ingredients: 1/2 kg spicy pork sausage | 1 teaspoon hing | 2 teaspoons cardamom powder
instructions: Heat oil in a skillet and fry the sausages. Remove the sausages from the skillet and keep aside. Grind the spices using a mortar and pestle. The mixture should be a fine powder. You can also make a smooth powder with some water and the same. Pour the spices into the skillet and cook over medium medium heat, adding water until the gravy thickens. Do not heat until the gravy thickens before leaving on the sides of the pan. Serve hot with naan bread.

title: Oven-Ready Glazed Carrots
ingredients: 4 large carrots | 1 teaspoon ginger powder | 1 teaspoon dill weed | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard | 4 teaspoons cooking oil
instructions: Peel carrots, remove any peel from the top and bottom and place on a greased baking sheet. Place in the sun for 30 minutes approximately. Spray pam on a baking stone. Remove carrot pices from the sheet. Cut the peel away into bite size pieces. Keep both carrot and potato in it. Place the carrot and potato pieces in a microwave safe bowl. Add oil and mix thoroughly. Cover with cling film and microwave on high until the pieces are tender apprx 3 to 5 minutes. Turn and microwave on high apprx 5 minutes more for softer carrots. Toss the carrots with salt & pepper to taste.

title: Faggots Filling, Filling for Fajitas, Mexican Carne Asada, or Chimichurri-Fajitas
ingredients: 8 ounces pancetta, chopped | 8 ounces ground pork
instructions: In a bowl, combine pancetta, ground pork and seasonings. Mix thoroughly. Let sit in refrigerator for 24 hours. Shape into balls using 1 1/2 tablespoons on each shell, or shape fritos by laying on a plate and placing the side of a meat mallet or other cutting board flat. To make chimichurri asafetida, add 3 tablespoons of chimichurri mixture to equal 1 tbs. Corn meal.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,pork sausage,sage,cream celery soup,purpose flour,irish cream,rom tomato
title: Spicy Sausage With Creamy Tomato Sour Cream Sauce
ingredients: 4 medium roma tomatoes | 1 -2 teaspoon finely minced fresh sage | 1/2 teaspoon grated fresh lemon zest | 1 small onion, minced ( to taste ) | 1 -2 tablespoon all-purpose flour, approximate | 4 ounces hot pork sausage, bulk | 2 tablespoons sour cream or 2 tablespoons creamed cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Slice the roma tomatoes crosswise down the center, remove seeds and chop 1/4 inch dice off the end of the roma tomatoes to make room for the sauce. Sauté sage, lemon peppercorns, and minced onion in the skillet on medium low heat until the onion is soft. Add the flour and mix well. Add the hot sausage and stir until sausage pieces are cooked. Place sausage and sour cream/cream soup in a casserole dish and bake in oven until heated through, 10 - 15 minutes. Enjoy with grated fresh cheddar cheese.

Random Ingredients: green pea,wheat germ,ricotta cheese,apple butter,beef chuck,ladyfinger,bragg liquid amino,garam masala powder
title: Mutter Mutter Kebabs
ingredients: 8 ladyfingers, washed | 1 pound ground beef chuck | 2 ounces fat-free ricotta cheese | 3 tablespoons low-fat apple butter | 1 1/2 teaspoons garam masala powder | 1 tablespoon whole wheat germ ( optional ) | 1 cup fresh green peas | 2 teaspoons braggs liquid aminos
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Place the ladyfingers onto the prepared baking sheet. In a medium bowl, mix together the ground beef, ricotta cheese, apple butter, garam masala powder, whole wheat germ, and green peas. Cover, and refrigerate for 1 hour to blend flavors. Brush a grill pan with cooking spray. Cook the kababs for 5 minutes on each side, or to desired degree of doneness. Serve kababs with lemon wedges on the side.

title: Swiss Cheese and Cauliflower Quiche
ingredients: 1 large cauliflower, florets florets only | 1 egg white, lightly beaten | 4 ounces swiss cheese | 2 tablespoons honey | 1/4 cup dried cranberries
instructions: Set oven to 400 degrees. Spread the cauliflower in a 9 pie pan, lightly sprinkle on the cheese, then drizzle with the honey, cranberries. Bake at 400 for 40 - 45 minutes, until golden brown. Let stand for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Canadian Bacon Appetizer (Appetizer)
ingredients: 1 medium cooked ham or 1 medium sweet potato | 6 -8 slices canadian bacon, cut into 1/2 inch squares | 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
instructions: Place ham or sweet potato in microwaveable bowl. Sprinkle with canadian bacon slices and stir to cover ham or sweet potato with bacon and stir well. Repeat with another layer of ham or sweet potato. Microwave for 10 minutes using 600w.

title: Lentil & Peeled English Muffin Wedges
ingredients: 4 slices english muffins, toasted | 1 1/2 tablespoons honey mustard | 2 teaspoons fresh ginger, grated | 1/2 cup dried red lentils | 1/4 cup ice
instructions: Place english muffin on baking tray & spread with mustard & ginger. To serve, sprinkle with red lentils & top with the ice. Serve warm.

title: Sookay
ingredients: 1 onion, chopped | 1/4 cup ginger paste | 1 can kidney beans
instructions: Cook onion and ginger paste in oil until it is translucent. Add beans cook for about 5 minutes. Enjoy and your sakinay.

title: Pax Seed Balls
ingredients: 1 cup ground flax seeds | 1 cup semolina ( white sweet rice flour ) | 1/3 cup grated gruyere cheese | 2 tablespoons light tzatziki | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 2 teaspoons grated mango chutney ( indian sweet chili dipping sauce ) | 1 celery rib, finely chopped | 8 eggs, lightly beaten
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Combine flaxseed, semolina and gruyere in a large bowl and mash with a fork. Stir in tzatziki, vinegar and mango chutney until well combined.

Random Ingredients: penne,streaky bacon,plain nonfat yogurt,iceberg lettuce,cauliflower floret,spring wrapper,pineapple juice
title: Aussie Sweet & Sour Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 3 ounces smoked streaky bacon, minced | 1 bunch spring roll wrappers | 2 tablespoons plain nonfat yogurt | 2 tablespoons pineapple juice | 2 tablespoons pineapple juice | 3/4 cup iceberg lettuce, shredded | 1/2 cup small cauliflower floret, coarsely chopped | crushed iceberg lettuce
instructions: In a small saucepan cook the bacon under a medium heat for 5 mins or until slightly crisp. Remove from the pan and drain on kitchen paper. Using a slotted spoon transfer the bacon on to a cutting board. Add the pastry to the drippings and fry for 1 - 2 mins or until crisp, stirring well. Remove from the pan and onto a board. Cut the bacon into strips. Place the wonton wrappers on a clean tea towel or lined baking tray, brush the edges with milk, then sprinkle over a little oregano and salt and pepper. Wet your fingers with cold water and use a pastry brush dipped in cold water to glue them around the wrappers. Pop to the table for each serving.

Random Ingredients: cherry tomato,dark soy sauce,rice milk,red pepper
title: Pina Colada (Pine-Rice Custard)
ingredients: 6 cups cooked rice milk | 8 ounces cherry tomatoes, cut in quarters | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon red pepper
instructions: Set aside. In a large bowl mix all ingredients with a whisk. Pour into a greased pie plate. Bake in a preheated 350°f oven for 30 - 40 minutes, until puffed and browned. Let cool and serve.

title: Easy Miso and Rosemary Chilt-Roasted Rosemary
ingredients: 1 cup miso ( white-rice like japanese hon-shikata ) | 2 -4 teaspoons chopped fresh rosemary | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and mix thoroughly. Cover and let rest for about 1 - 2 hours or use your food grade miso for roasting. Roast should be hot and dry. Roasted rosemary will perfume any dry foods that may come off roast. Roast often with rice.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil vegetable,sea scallop,slab bacon,rye bread,neufchatel cheese
title: Scallop and Bacon Melted Cheese Skewers
ingredients: 4 ounces thick slab bacon, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons peanut oil or 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1/4 lb sea scallops, sliced crosswise into 1/4 inch slices | 6 -8 ounces neufchatel cheese | 1 loaf crusty rye bread
instructions: In a nonstick skillet over medium high heat, cook the bacon until slightly crisp, about 5 minutes. Remove the bacon and drain on paper towels. Reserve 1 tablespoon drippings in the skillet, and add the oil. Add the scallops and cook, stirring, until barely opaque throughout, just a few seconds. Remove from the heat and set aside. To serve, mix the cheese, reserved drippings, and bacon in a small bowl, and season with pepper. To serve, place 1 scallop slice on the skewer, top with the reserved drippings and crumbled bacon.

title: Hshiitakehi-Style Noodle With Tofu and Tahini
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cumin seed | 1 3/4 lbs tenderloin, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1/8 cup toasted tahini | 5 tablespoons warm chili flakes ( to taste, we like hot ) | 2 tablespoons hot pepper sauce ( to taste ) | 1 package frozen light egg noodles | 3 ounces firm tofu ( in oil )
instructions: On your cutting board, toast your cumin seeds over high heat until fragrant. Be careful, they burn fast. Cool slightly and grind until a powdery consistency. Transfer to a small bowl or cup, cover with plastic wrap, and set aside. In a small saute pan, toast the tahini in your pan until fragrant, taking care not to scorch. Cool slightly, then mix with the hot chili flakes and hot pepper sauce and set aside. In the meantime, cook the noodles on your hottest method, according to package directions. When done, drain and rinse, and set aside. Cut the tenderloin into 1/2 inch cubes and set aside. On your cutting board, put your cumin mix into a mortar. Add the meat cubes on top of the spices, and pound with a sturdy knife to flatten them out. Towards the end or after the noodles are done, poke with a fork and make 3 diagonal slits along the length of the noodles and, using a teaspoon, poke through the noodles and meat, to release the flavors and aromas. These slits will open up the dish a little and you will have a bowl to store any liquid that may be left in the pot. Add the tofu and any liquid that has collected in the bowl to the pot, and mash to combine. Heat the vegetables over medium high heat, stirring frequently, for about 3 min, making sure not to let the liquid smoke. Remove from heat, let cool for 3 min, then season with salt and pepper to taste. Enjoy.

title: Fondue Dèpine (Puerto Rican Steating Wine) (Pao De Cerdo)
ingredients: 1 bottle dry red wine | 1 1/2 cups grapeseed oil | 1 cup grapeseed oil for frying
instructions: Combine 2 bottles red wine and 1 1/2 cup grapeseed oil in a large baking pan. Heat to simmering, but don't let it boil dry. Pour into the bowl of a food processor fitted with the steel blade. Process briefly, scraping down the sides of the bowl, and pour the wine through a strainer set over a large bowl. Stir in enough more wine to absorb the liquid, but make sure it is evenly dry. Let cool, at least one hour and up to an hour, stirring from time to time to blend. Transfer to a fondue pot and use as dipping sauce for meat or chicken pieces.

title: Italian Chicken
ingredients: 1/3 cup amaretto | 1 tablespoon amaretto | 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts
instructions: In a small bowl, combine 1/3 cup amaretto and the 1 t. Amaretto. Place the chicken breasts in a shallow glass baking dish. Pour 2/3 cup amaretto mixture over. Turn the chicken breasts over to coat. Cover tightly and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Preheat the oven to 450 °f. Place the chicken and marinade in a shallow roasting pan and cover tightly. Bake the chicken 25 minutes, basting occasionally, or until tender. Remove, cover with foil, and continue baking until done.

Random Ingredients: panko bread crumb,confectioner ' sugar,garlic clove,orange juice
title: Fried Mozzarella - Bobby Flay
ingredients: 1 cup panko bread crumbs | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar | 1 garlic clove | 1/4 cup orange juice
instructions: Combine panko, garlic, and sugar in a bowl, add orange juice. Combine well. Pour over mozzarella. Toss well. Wrap well and refrigerate for 30 to 60 minutes prior to frying. Heat oil to 350 degrees in a deep fryer or large deep skillet. Drop a handful of mozzarella in and fry to a crisp on one side, turn, and fry on the other side. When crisp transfer to a paper towel to drain.

title: Pillsbury French Toast Meatballs
ingredients: 12 frozen meatballs | 2 cans pumpkin | 1/4 cup brown sugar | 1/4 cup light corn syrup | 1 tablespoon cinnamon | 2 cans french bread | 1/4 cup brown sugar | 2 teaspoons cinnamon, plus extra | cinnamon, for topping
instructions: Put all ingredients in crockpot, stir, cook on high 3 - 4 hours, stirring occasionally. Sprinkle with cinnamon, stir, cook until thouroughly heated.

Random Ingredients: artichoke heart,celery salt,orange peel,anaheim chilies,ginger paste,cornflour,flat leaf parsley
title: Artichoke Paste With Corn
ingredients: 8 anaheim chilies, seeded and finely chopped | 8 artichoke hearts, in water | 1 piece fresh ginger paste | 150 g cornflour | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley | 1 tablespoon grated fresh orange peel | 1 teaspoon celery salt
instructions: Place anaheim chillies and artichoke hearts in a saucepan and cover with water. Bring to the boil, then reduce heat and simmer for five minutes. Drain and chill until very cold. Place ginger paste in a bowl and gradually blend in about three quarters of the oil. Add the cornflour and stir until well blended. Transfer mixture to a saucepan, add parsley, orange peel, celery salt and remaining oil. Cook, stirring constantly, over medium heat, until mixture starts to thicken, then remove from heat. Place cooked chilli mixture and the rest of the artichoke paste into a blender and process till smooth. Transfer to a bowl and pour into a hot serving dish. Serve immediately.

title: Fantastic Chicken and Bean Tortilla
ingredients: 500 g chicken meat | 1 liter buttermilk | 400 g canned kidney beans | 1 can cannellini beans | 1/2 tablespoon baharat ( baharat aka middle east mixed spices - the real mix ) | 1 tablespoon hot sauce | 1/2 cup cashews, roasted and chopped | 12 -25 tortillas, cut into halves
instructions: Mix well. Fry tortillas with oil spray in skillet for 5 mins each side.. Place on rack to cool. Spread on plate with spatula and sprinkle with a little salt and bake in oven at 180°c for 8 - 10 minutes. Fry chicken in pan for 5 mins each side, if cooked through, it should be golden brown. Meanwhile combine drained beans, hot sauce and cashews. Fry a small amount of chicken on stove top. Add beans and stir. Simmer a while. Take up a large spoonful of mixture and put in tortilla, top with cashew mix and roll them up. Serve with couscous or rice.

Random Ingredients: brie cheese,banana pepper,cardamom seed,mustard seed,rice wine,beef broth,lime juice zest
title: Baked Rouladenbrot
ingredients: 2 1/2 tablespoons mustard seeds | 1 1/2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes seeds or 1 1/2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes | 1 tablespoon berry grated banana pepper ( can use regular peppers, but do not try banana peppers ) | 1/2 lime, juice and zest of | 1/2 cup beef broth | 1/4 cup rice wine or 1/4 cup dry vermouth | 1/8 teaspoon ground cardamom seed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375f and position a rack in the middle of the oven. Arrange all the seeds in a heavy, dry skillet. Heat over moderate heat, stirring frequently with a wooden spoon, until they pop. Pour into a shallow casserole dish or pie plate. Place the sun dried tomatoes inside the skillet and sprinkle them with the pepper. Drip the lime juice or zest over the vegetables and pepper. Scatter the bacon bits over the top. Put the dish on a rack and bake for 25 minutes. Remove the rack from the oven and let it rest for 20 minutes, then serve.

title: Lumpia (Indonesian Beef Stew)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon curry paste ( or to taste- kari is preferable ) | 2 lbs boneless beef chuck, cut into 1 1/2-inch cubes | 1 yellow onion, chopped | 1/4 cup low-fat ketchup | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped fresh chives ( or scallion )
instructions: Heat a heavy pot over medium flame. Add curry paste.

title: Sausage & Bean - Sausage & Bean
ingredients: 1 1/4 kg fresh sausage, sliced | 20 -24 tiny white beans, washed & drained | 1 tea bag
instructions: Put one tea bag in a pot or deep, large enough for all the sausage to fit in one piece. Pour enough boiling water into the pot to come up 1/2 of the depth of the sausage. Put the sausage & bean into the pot, then add enough water to come up about 15cm above the beans. Cover & simmer gently for about 1 hr then remove the sausage & set aside. Cover & continue to cook for a further 25 - 30 mins until tender. Allow to cool & then place into covered glass jar.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,nonfat cream,red wine vinegar,green chili pepper,soda water
title: Chile Rellenos With Garlic Sauce
ingredients: 3 large garlic cloves, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons finely diced green chili peppers | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 1/3 cup nonfat sour cream | 1 tablespoon finely diced fresh mild green chili pepper | 1/4 cup soda water ( optional )
instructions: Combine garlic with green chile peppers and vinegar in medium saucepan over moderate heat and whisk until garlic is softened to mixture. Bring mixture to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer until mixture is reduced by half, about 15 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir sour cream, green chili pepper, and soda water into garlic mixture in saucepan until mixture is just combined. Cook and stir over moderate heat until heated through, about 1 minute. Transfer sauce to bowl and cool.

title: Simple and Delicious Mexican Dip
ingredients: 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1/2 cup shredded low-fat cheddar cheese or 1/2 cup shredded mexican cheese food, blend | 1/2 cup sliced sweet olives | 1/4 cup chopped italian cheese blend ( for topping ) ( optional )
instructions: Combine mayonnaise and shredded cheese. Spread in a shallow baking dish. Add remaining ingredients. Bake at 350°f or until bubbly about 15 to 20 minutes serve hot with tortilla chips, veggies, veggies & veggies.

title: Pimento Strips
ingredients: 1 can pimento-stuffed green peppers, drained | 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley
