instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Arrange peppers in an oven proof skillet. Drizzle with pimento oil and sprinkle with parsley. Bake in the preheated oven for 10 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Corn Relish
ingredients: 1 cup corn syrup | 1 egg yolk | 1/2 cup finely chopped red onion
instructions: Heat the corn syrup in a small saucepan over medium heat, just until the sugar has dissolved. Remove from the heat and stir in the egg yolk, red onion, and corn syrup. Mix well.

title: Wild Mushrooms
ingredients: 12 cremini mushrooms | 1/2 cup raisins
instructions: Clean and wash mushrooms. Chop mushroom caps. Boil mushrooms to reduce water. Add raisins to mushrooms. Serve hot or cool. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: corn oil,green lentil,honey,plain flour,white rice,caster sugar,tomato puree
title: Yorkshire Scones
ingredients: 12 ounces plain flour | 20 fluid ounces corn oil or 20 fluid ounces light olive oil | 5 teaspoons caster sugar | 4 tablespoons corn oil | 3 tablespoons honey | 3 ounces split green lentils, rinsed | 14 ounces tomatoes puree
instructions: Sift the flour, sugar into a large bowl, tip it in the oil and gradually add the oil with 100ml boiling water until a thick dough forms. Turn out onto a floured board and knead it briefly. Roll out to 3'' in thickness. Cut out 3 rounds and place a spoonful of the lentils in the centre of each. Brush with 100ml boiling water. Bring an 18in x 6in heavy based pan of water to the boil. Dust the scones well with flour. Drop the scones into the boiling water and simmer for 6 - 8 mins, turning over halfway through. Serve warm. They can also be eaten at once as though they are.

Random Ingredients: halibut fillet,asparagus,wine vinegar,egg yolk,pork loin,serrano pepper,beef stock cube,scallion
title: Kalimotnylt - Icelandic Halibut and Chicken Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs halibut fillets | 2 eggs | 4 scallions | 8 ounces pork loin ( thinly sliced ) or 8 ounces thick sliced chicken ( thinly sliced ) | 1 serrano pepper ( thinly sliced ) | 7/8 cup beef stock cube ( beef stock ) | 3 tablespoons wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons toasted and crushed garlic salt and salt
instructions: Trim any excess fat off halibut fillet, cut the fish into 4 - 5 pieces. Separate the egg yolks, and beat the egg whites until you have a pale yellow peak consistency. Whisk egg yolks and set into a small bowl. Cut the green and white parts of the scallions into thin rounds, about ¼” wide. Slice and finely chop serrano pepper. Chop pork or chicken. Heat beef stock, vinegar, garlic salt and pepper in a saucepan. Wash halibut and place into the hot liquid. Cook for 5 minutes. Turn and cook for another 5 minutes, remove from heat to individual serving plates. In the last three minutes of sautéing the halibut, add the scallions, pork or chicken and the pepper slices. Stir and serve immediately. Serve the halibut in a deep soup bowl with rice or noodles.

Random Ingredients: tofu,lemon curd,lemon extract,wheat pita bread,liquid smoke
title: Tofu and Smoked Pita Chips (Healthy)
ingredients:
0.
    -5 package fat-free firm tofu | 5 tablespoons reduced-calorie lemon curd | 3 tablespoons fresh lemon extract | 32 inches whole wheat pita bread | olive oil or cooking spray
instructions: Carefully drain the block of tofu, and place it on a cutting board. Cut in half lengthwise, then crosswise so it will fit in a breaded loaf pan. Remove the skin carefully. Cut tofu in half again so it will be thinner. Cut into cubes. Place tofu, lemon curd and lemon extract into a food processor. Process into a fine paste. Line bottom and sides of loaf pan with the pita chips. Spread the tofu paste evenly on top of the chips. Sprinkle with sugar if desired. Press lightly onto the chips for a coating that will adhere. Set pan aside while you preheat your oven to 400°f. Cut into 12 squares. Enjoy with your favorite vinaigrette and/or salad.

title: Chocolate Chip Biscotti
ingredients: 1/2 cup plain dried breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup mini chocolate chips | 3 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Lightly oil a baking sheet. In a bowl, toss the bread crumbs and mini chocolate chips. Sift the flour into a large bowl and stir just until moistened. Stir in the bread crumb mixture. Roll into 1 inch balls. Place on the prepared baking sheet. Bake for 12 - 15 minutes or until lightly browned. Remove from oven and place on a cooling rack.

title: The Easiest, Bestest Smoky Chipotle Salt Body Polish
ingredients: 4 leaves fresh lemon peel, very finely chopped | 2 tablespoons chipotle chili sauce, chipotle flavored roasted chili sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons coarsely ground coarse salt or 2 teaspoons kosher salt
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and store in a cool, dry place.

Random Ingredients: cranberry,black pepper,chili oil,yeast,pumpernickel bread,green chile pepper
title: Sicilian Black Bread III
ingredients:
6 cups pumpernickel bread, cubed | 2 cups fresh cranberries | 12 fresh green chile peppers | 1/3 cup chili oil | 2 (.
    -25 ounce ) packages active dry yeast | 1 teaspoon ground black pepper
instructions: Place pumpernickel bread cubes, cranberries, chile peppers, chili oil, and yeast in a large bowl in the order recommended by the manufacturer. Set the bread machine on the dough cycle. Remove the dough from the bread pan onto a lightly floured surface.

title: Hajar's Almond Paste
ingredients: 1/2 lb almond paste ( can be purchased at walmart, or you can buy almond paste in the asian food section ) | 1 large garlic clove ( crushed, can be bought ) | 2 tablespoons coriander | 3 jalapeno peppers ( chopped ) | 1 loaf stale italian bread ( sliced )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. If using a blender make sure all of the ingredients are well mixed. Spread almond paste on top of bread slices. Bake for about 8 minutes. Serve with other indian dishes at the table.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,egg yolk,mayonnaise,cooking spray,angel hair pasta,baking powder,oyster sauce
title: Stir Fry Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 package angel hair pasta | 2/3 cup mayonnaise | 1 egg yolk | cooking spray | 6 ounces oyster sauce | 2 1/2 teaspoons white wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon mayonnaise | 1 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: Prepare pasta according to package directions. In a medium bowl, beat together the mayonnaise, egg yolk and oyster sauce. In a 9x13 inch baking dish coated with cooking spray, pour in the egg mixture and stir to blend. Add the angel hair pasta, toss and then pour over the egg mixture. Cover and refrigerate until very hot or overnight. When pasta is cool, stir in the mayo, baking powder and mayonnaise mixture, until combined.

title: Apple Noodle Bites
ingredients: 1 package spaghetti sauce | 1/2 cup apple jelly or 1/2 cup jelly, mixed with water
instructions: To prepare mixture, put 1 tablespoon of jelly in saucepan and warm over medium heat until jelly is dissolved. Pour 1/2 cup of sauce in greased 8x8 baking dish. Dip each spaghetti noodle in jelly/water mixture then cook in preheated oven for about 15 minutes.

title: Soup Stock
ingredients: 350 g raw peanuts | 400 g bamboo shoots ( canned )
instructions: Cut peanuts into small pieces, removing skin and the stalks. Remove stalks using a fine shredder. Place all the remaining ingredients in a pressure cooker and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and just allow soup to simmer for 5 - 6 minutes. Remove from heat. Serve hot.

title: Minted Rice
ingredients: 3 1/2 tablespoons olive oil or 3 1/2 tablespoons unsalted butter | 1/4 cup chopped fresh mint leaves | 1/3 cup chopped preserved mushrooms ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon dry mustard | 2 cups cooked basmati rice
instructions: Heat oil in a small skillet over medium heat. Saute mint for about 1 minute. Remove from heat and stir in mayonnaise and mint until blended. Let sit a couple of minutes. Fluff rice and divide rice among serving bowls. Top with mayonnaise and minted mushrooms.

title: Chutney Chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg chicken tenders, cut into pieces | 1/3 cup chutney | 2 tablespoons dark corn syrup, warmed | 1/3 cup icing sugar | 3/4 cup peas
instructions: Place chutney, corn syrup, and icing sugar in a small bowl and mix to mix. Place chicken portions in a large heatproof bowl, pour chutney mixture over chicken and cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate, turning chicken frequently, for 1 hour and basting with juices every 30 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through and sauce is smooth. Spoon chicken onto baking paper covered tray. Sprinkle peas over chicken and serve with crisp lettuce leaves or baby greens.

title: Apple and Nut Stollen
ingredients: 1/2 cup apple, finely diced | 1/4 cup currants | 1/4 cup currants | 1/4 cup jam, cut up | 1/4 cup eggplant, diced | 1/2 teaspoon ginger | 1/2 teaspoon fast rise yeast | 2 tablespoons dried fruit or 2 tablespoons mixed fresh fruit
instructions: Place apple, currants, jam, eggplant and ginger into a bowl. Dissolve yeast in warm water. Add yeast mixture to apple and toss to coat. Let stand 1 hour in a warm place. Knead dough. Divide into 8 pieces. Form into stollen and let rise, 2 hours or until doubled. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Bake stollen for 20 minutes. Brush with melted butter while baking. Cool before serving with fruit.

Random Ingredients: pork,molasses,white flour,chicken bouillon cube,green enchilada sauce,tomato green chilies
title: Pork and Green Chili Enchiladas (Enchiladas Verde)
ingredients: 3 lbs pork, cooked and shredded | 16 ounces white flour | 2 chicken bouillon cubes | 1 can green enchilada sauce | 4 cans diced tomatoes and green chilies, undrained | 1 can no-salt-added green enchilada sauce | 3 cans diced tomatoes and green chilies, undrained | 2 cups molasses
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Spray or spray an 11x7 inch baking dish with cooking spray. In a large bowl, combine pork, flour, bouillon cubes, and green enchilada sauce. Mix well with hands. Drain excess liquid. Add tomatoes and green chilies. Mix well. Pour into sprayed baking dish. In blender or food processor, puree the blended tomatoes and green chili, and then transfer to sauce in baking dish. Sprinkle cornstarch mixture over meat in baking dish, and stir to coat all the ingredients. Bake 45 minutes, stirring often.

title: The Whole Stomach
ingredients: 1 can chicken breast halves, drained | 1 1/2 pounds uncooked octopus
instructions: Rinse the octopus under running water.

title: Grilled Navel Orange Pork
ingredients: 2 lbs navel oranges | 4 lbs salt pork, of your choice | 1 cucumber | 2 red peppers ( seeded and cut in rings )
instructions: In a large bowl, mix the grated orange peel and salt pork. Peel and grate the zest off the oranges and slice each orange in half. Add all to the salt pork. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Remove a small piece of skin from the salt pork and cut along the inside of the orange peel and all around the outside. Repeat until all of the salt pork is removed. Place on hardwood, heavy duty foil and wrap tightly all over with plastic wrap. Place in the freezer for one hour. Do not remove from freezer, as the fat in the sausage will be extremely hot. Preheat the grill. Remove from refrigerator, unwrap and allow to sit for 15 - 20 minutes. While the grill is heating up, peel most of the seeds from the cucumber using a vegetable peeler or melter. Cut in half lenghtwise, remove pit and slice the cucumber in thin slivers. Place all four slices with the juices in the food processor. Cut the slices in half and add the zest. Blend well. Place two to five slices of the salt pork on each of the four pieces of salt pork. Spoon the orange juice onto the salt pork. Cover the grill, and cook over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes per side, or until the salt pork is cooked through. Serve with rice pilaf. For the rice pilaf, add one piece of salt pork to a small saute pan which has been on the grill and browned. To make the zinfandel, pour a few tbsps. Of cold water over the pork in a glass bowl or pan, and stir so all the salt pork is well covered with the zinfandel. This is important because the zinfandel does not have to be fully cooked. When the zinfandel is ready, remove from the grill and serve.

title: Almond Cracker Mix
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons almond extract | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs | kosher salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 fahrenheit. Mix all ingredients together. Press mix into baking dishes. Bake for 20 minutes to brown edges. Cool on wire racks.

title: Takkavi
ingredients: 1 package egg noodles | 1 wooden skewer
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add the noodles and cook until tender but firm. Drain. Fill a large wok with water. Dip soaked noodles in water until all are submerged. Place noodles on metal skewers. Dredge with the kosher salt and pepper. Pour noodle soaking liquid into the wok. Cover and simmer for 4 minutes. Dunk the wooden skewer through the noodles and cook for for an additional minute or so to soak up the juice. Remove the noodles and serve hot.

title: Artichoke and Serrano Smoked Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 2 pork tenderloin | 1 can water-packed artichoke hearts | 1 small serrano pepper, seeded and finely minced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Lightly oil a roasting pan. Arrange the tenderloins in the pan. Spoon about 1/4 cup artichokes into the center of each tenderloin. Pour 1/2 cup water around the meat. Cover, and roast in the preheated oven until meat thermometer inserted into the center of the tenderloins registers 125 degrees f, 25 to 30 minutes. Open the pan, release the pan from the pan, and allow the tenderloins to rest for 10 minutes before slicing. Slice meat and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: cooking oat,garlic salt,beef steak,garlic paste,graham cracker crumb
title: Awesome Beef Rouladen
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs boneless beef top round steak | 3/4 cup quick-cooking oats | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 teaspoon garlic paste | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Cut beef into 6 slices using a serrated knife. Dip in oats, then into crumbs, then brown in a large non stick skillet. Add more oil when necessary to cover meat. Remove from pan and keep warm. Add garlic salt, garlic paste, and 1/2 cup water to skillet. Cover and bring to boil. Reduce heat to simmer, simmering 1 minute, then remove from heat. Cool 15 minutes. Place meat in a 9 x 13 pan. Cover with meat juices. Mix graham cracker crumbs with other 1/2 cup water in a small bowl. Stir crumbs into meat. Serve at once, with additional crumbs on top of meat.

Random Ingredients: thyme sprig,black pepper,grain white rice,red onion,sea salt,salad green
title: Rice-A-Roni Salad With Herbs
ingredients: 3 medium red onions, halved and thinly sliced | 5 fresh thyme sprigs | 4 cups mixed salad greens | sea salt, to taste | ground black pepper, to taste | 2 cups short-grain white rice, cooked and chilled
instructions: Place a small heatproof bowl on your kitchen scale and set aside enough water to cover the bottom. Add the onions and thyme. Bring to a boil and simmer gently for a few minutes until the onions are soft. Remove from the heat and transfer them to a large salad bowl with the mixed salad greens. Season lightly with salt and pepper to you hands and pour over the rice and toss together with your hands to combine. Serve immediately.

title: Pao Queso
ingredients:
1 cup quinoa, washed | 2 cups low fat cottage cheese | 1 mango | 1 1/2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 tablespoon pancake powder ( or more ) | 0.
    -5 bottle bacon bits
instructions: Soak quinoa for 30 minutes. Cook the quinoa in a pot of boiling water for approximately 15 - 20 minutes, until almost completely tender. Set aside to cool. Peel, pit and chop mango. Thinly slice your mango and cook with the bacon bits for about 5 mins, stirring to break. Blend the cornflour with water and whisk into the skillet. Mix in the quinoa and mango and cook for 3 - 5 minutes. Heat for 2 mins, or until it thickens. Add more cornstarch, if needed. Serve warm with warm tortillas or crisp egg noodles.

title: Jalapeno-Scallion Penne
ingredients: 1 lb penne, cooked al dente | 1/2 cup italian salad dressing, light | 10 -15 pieces scallions, trimmed, white and green parts, sliced thin | 1 cup dark chocolate, grated | fresh cilantro ( optional )
instructions: Boil pasta in large sauce pan until al dente. Drain pasta and set aside. In a medium bowl, toss together dressing and scallions. Heat in a saucepan over medium to low heat, stirring constantly. Remove immediately from heat and stir in the grated chocolate. Spoon pasta into a 9x13 casserole. Drizzle with the sauce over the pasta and toss gently. Sprinkle with cilantro, if desired.

Random Ingredients: wooden toothpick,tabasco sauce,beef sirloin,cannellini bean,ancho chile powder,apple,vegetarian sausage
title: Beef and Beans on Horse Tites
ingredients: 10 wooden picks | 2 cans cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 2 packages vegetarian sausages, any flavor | 2 cans spicy pork and beans with onion, undrained | 1 cup apple, cored, chopped small | 1 tablespoon ground ancho chile powder | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lay the toothpick pieces in front of each other on a clean, dry surface or parchment paper dusted with corn meal. Place a pick in each tooth pick.

title: Red Wine-Crusted Potatoes
ingredients: 16 small russet potatoes ( about 6 1/2-inches diameter ) | 3 1/2 cups red wine | 1 cup frozen corn, thawed until drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Place potatoes in a 5 to 6 qt. Heavy saucepan.

title: Rice With Beef & Mango
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 4 tablespoons arborio rice | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1 mango
instructions: Slice beef as thinly as possible. Cut mango into 1/2 to 1 inch thick slices. Place beef in a bowl & add marinade ingredients. Cover & let marinate in the refrigerator for at least 10 minutes. Heat grill to high. Wash rice several times & remove from fridge. Brush oil on grate & grill meat 2 minutes on each side, or until the beef is browned. Add mangoes on the side & serve on its own.

title: White Bean Soup
ingredients: 500 g dried white beans | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: Soak white beans over night. Drain the beans and put them through a ricer. Mix the cream of tartar and cream of tartar together and add them to the bean paste. Mix well. Cook on a low oven for 2 hours. Serve at once.

title: Spicy Grilled Skirt Steak with Taco Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb skirt steak | 1 tablespoon taco sauce | 2 pork tenderloins
instructions: Mix together the taco sauce and the pork tenderloins and coat each side of the beef. Let stand at room temperature for 30 minutes. Prepare smoker fire and preheat broiler. Grill, uncovered, for 10 minutes on each side or until cooked to your liking.

Random Ingredients: canola oil,chicken bouillon cube,sugar snap pea
title: Chinese Sugar Snap Peas
ingredients: 300 g frozen sugar snap peas | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 tablespoon canola oil
instructions: Cook sugar snap peas for around 15 minutes. After 15 minutes, add oil, let cook an longer time. Serve. I like to stir around the peas every now and then, but don't let them burn. We eat them right away. Serve with your favorite sauce, i like lots of sugar and lots of chili.

Random Ingredients: lard,pasta shell,baking potato,grain white rice,green chili pepper,green cardamom pod,edamame,sage
title: Edamame Rice With Fried Potatoes
ingredients: 2 ounces edamame ( frozen shelled peas ) | 2 1/2 cups cooked long-grain white rice | 1/2 green cardamom pod | 1 dried green chili pepper ( deseeded and sliced ) | 1 teaspoon baking potato ( finely diced ) | 1 teaspoon fresh sage ( chopped ) | 2 1/4 4 ounces short-grain white rice or 4 ounces long-grain rice ( cooked to packet instructions ) | 3 1/4 tablespoons lard ( heated and browned ) | 3 green cardamom pods ( bruised )
instructions: Cook edamame in boiling hot water till tender, drain and allow to cool. Heat 2 1/2 cups of oil in a heavy based pan. Add a few pices of the cardamom pods and fry briefly, before adding the pices of cardamom to the pan and frying, remove pices and return to pan and stir fry until aromatic, then add rice and fry 1 minute. Add 2 cups of water and bring to boil. Cover and reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes. Pre heat oven to 325°f. Meanwhile, drain edamame and place under grill, cover and cook for 2 - 3 minutes, until just softened. Peel potato and mash with a fork, or beat with 1 teaspoon of water and 1 teaspoon of ground black pepper, then stir into pan with edamame and simmer for a further 8 minutes, uncovered, until rice is dry and hot, stir in sage and season with salt. Remove from heat. To serve, place a mound of rice on a plate and spoon edamame, lightly dressed with a little dressing over the top. Garnish with a few green cardamon pods.

title: Sicilian Style Chicken
ingredients: 1 eggplant, cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes | 1 pound pork spareribs, cut into 1 1/2 inch pieces | 4 cups chopped, peeled tomatoes | 2 1/2 tablespoons tomato paste
instructions: Prepare a large skillet or dutch oven with a lid, spray the inside of the skillet or dutch oven with non stick cooking spray. Place eggplant cubes in the skillet or dutch oven.

title: Simple New Potatoes & Chili Salsa
ingredients: 1 package frozen tiny new potatoes | 3 tablespoons chili-garlic sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Defrost frozen tiny new potatoes by placing a towel in a bowl or on a cookie sheet with a lid in middle, so the air can circulate under the potatoes as they defrost.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,taco seasoning mix,cayenne,baby carrot,savoy cabbage,rum,brown bread
title: Crumble Beef on Toast
ingredients: 1 lb beef chuck, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne | 1 cup baby carrots | 1 head savoy cabbage, shredded | 1/2 cup light rum | 1 crusty brown bread, sliced
instructions: In a non stick skillet, brown the beef slices, add the taco seasoning mixes and cayenne.

Random Ingredients: hard egg,maraschino cherry,almond milk,asafoetida powder,wonton wrapper
title: Chinese Won Tons
ingredients: 12 wonton wrappers | 1 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 2 -3 hard-boiled eggs, chopped | 1 jar maraschino cherries, drained and coarsely chopped | 1 cup almond milk ( optional )
instructions: To make the won ton wrappers, spread the wonton skin in a thin layer. Place the filling, eggs, and cherries in a bowl. Use approximately 1 teaspoon of almond milk for each and a little additional for sprinkling on top. Bring a small amount of water to a boil and drop about 6 won ton wrappers into the water. Let cook 3 - 5 minutes or until the wontons puff up a bit and the filling is hot. Remove and drain excess won ton wrapper on a paper towel.

title: Tuna and Sweet Pea Nests
ingredients: 8 -10 ounces tuna, picked over | salt and pepper
instructions: Pour 1 1/4 1 1/2 to 2 1/2 quarts cold water in a large, deep frying pan, and carefully bring it up to a boil. Place salt and pepper into a plate.

title: Homemade Pecorino-Pecorino Pecorino
ingredients: 2 cups pecorino romano cheese, freshly grated | 1 tablespoon fresh lime juice
instructions: Using a mortar and pestle or food processor, pound the pecorino and lime juice in the cheese. Keep grinding until the mixture is thoroughly combined and the cheese forms clumps of coarse pecorino. Use immediately.

title: Ham, Blueberry, and Canadian Blueberry Jam
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 kg blueberries ( depending on size ) | 1 - 1 1/2 kg ham ( depending on size )
instructions: Pour enough boiling water into to cover berries, and place ham on top, leaving space to allow mixture to reach boiling point. Cover the ham and cook on low, until ham is falling off the bone. Break ham into small pieces and mix into blueberry and berry mixture to combine. Allow to cool to room temperature before storing. You may also refrigerate this mixture for up to a week, or freeze in 1 or 2 smaller portions.

title: The Best Cauliflower Tostadas
ingredients: 1 lb cauliflower - rinsed well, dried and chopped, or | 1 -2 1 -2 cup shredded colby-monterey jack cheese blend, or | 1 -2 teaspoon taco seasoning
instructions: Fill a large pot with water and bring to a rolling boil. Once the water is boiling, stir in the cauliflower and return to a boil. Cook for 5 minutes or until cauliflower is easily florets. Drain well.

title: Baked Chocolate, Cheese and Bean Sprouts Layered
ingredients: 300 g cheddar cheese or 300 g gruyere cheese, shredded | 1 tablespoon light soy sauce | 1 tablespoon double cream or 1 tablespoon half-and-half | salt, to taste | 200 g raw medium-grain rice noodles ( such as jasmine or arborio ) or 200 g medium-grain rice noodles ( such as jasmine or arborio ) | 200 g fresh bean sprouts
instructions: Preheat the oven to 230 degree c. Line a 24cm x 23cm baking tin with baking paper. Combine the cheese, soy sauce and cream in a large mixing bowl. Season with salt. Place the rice noodles in a large heatproof bowl and cover with boiling water. Stand for 5 minutes, then drain and toss with the bean sprouts in the baking tray. Spread the rice noodles evenly in pan, top with bean sprout mixture, then sprinkle generously with grated cheddar cheese. Bake for 25 minutes, or until bubbling.

title: Strawberry-Pesto Salad Dressing
ingredients: 2 cups ripe, washed fresh strawberries | 1 cup prepared pesto or 1 cup prepared basil | 1 tablespoon seasoning salt
instructions: Chop strawberries finely. Add pesto, seasoned salt and 1 cup of the salad dressing. Stir gently. Refrigerate for 1 - 2 hours before serving. If you use store bought pesto dressing, store it in a container and serve as directed and use within 3 days.

Random Ingredients: sherry,parmigiano reggiano cheese,sultana,black mustard seed,maple syrup,yellow pea,provolone cheese
title: Peas With Sargento® Baked Mashed Peas
ingredients: 1 package frozen yellow peas, thawed | 2 tablespoons sherry | 1 tablespoon maple syrup | 2 teaspoons grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/4 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1/4 teaspoon ground sultana | 8 slices provolone cheese
instructions: Place the frozen peas in a large saucepan of boiling water and cook for 15 minutes, or until thawed. Drain and transfer peas to a bowl and mash well with a potato masher. Stir sherry, maple syrup, parmigiano reggiano cheese, mustard seeds, and seasalt into the mashed peas. Remove from heat and cool to room temperature. Cover, and chill for at least 10 minutes or up to 1 day. Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Transfer a large baking sheet with a lip to the oven to coat with cooking spray. Line a baking sheet with parchment or wax paper. Arrange half of the frozen peas in the baking sheet, then top with half of the provolone slices. Top with remaining peas. Bake on the sheet for 35 to 45 minutes, or until peas are slightly crisp and the cheese is brown and melty.

title: Apple Linguine
ingredients: cooking spray | 2 large tart apples, such as golden delicious, chopped into 1/2-inch pieces | 1/4 cup white flour | 2 tablespoons white flour | 1 1/2 lbs linguine, uncooked
instructions: Spray a 2 quart baking dish with cooking spray. Place apples in dish, sprinkle with 1/4 cup of the 3/4 cup flour, and toss to coat. Sprinkle with the 1 1/2 cups flour. Add linguine and toss to mix, coating all over. Set aside. Preheat oven to 400°. Spray a 1 quart baking dish with cooking spray. Place linguine mixture into baking dish. Add apple pieces, toss to coat, and cover with aluminum foil. Bake for 40 minutes or until the linguine is tender and the sauce is slightly thick. Stir once during baking.

title: Crispy Bean Sprouts (ZWT-9 Mandarin Pancake)
ingredients: 3 cups bean sprouts | 1/4 cup oyster sauce
instructions: Toast the bean sprouts, about 5min. Use a skillet with a lid. Stir fry sprouts over high heat, 3 5min, until they are aromatic. Turn a few times. Add oyster sauce and stir.

title: Cashew Nut and Peanut Butter Breadsticks
ingredients: 1 loaf bread, crusts removed | 1/2 cup peanut butter | 1/4 cup cashew nuts, coarsely crushed
instructions: Cut the bread into 1 inch thick slices, then cut each slice into 10 slices using a food knife. Spread the peanut butter on 6 the bread slices, leaving a 1 inch margin in the center. Spread the cashew nuts over that and top with about 2 tablespoons of the peanut butter mixture. Press down with the spoon to smooth the peanut butter. Spray a baking sheet with non stick cooking spray and bake under moderate heat until golden, about 10 minutes. Note, the peanut butter mixture can be made 1 day ahead and frozen.

Random Ingredients: pork tenderloin,cheddar cheese,basmati rice,cornmeal,pastry shell,lemon peel
title: Baked Stuffed Pork Tenderloins(ATK)
ingredients: 1 lb boneless pork tenderloin | 4 sheets pastry shells | 12 ounces cheddar cheese, shredded | 1 cornmeal | 1 strip lemon peel | 2 cups stone-ground cornmeal | 3 cups cooked basmati rice
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f. Cut small slits in pork tenderloins with a sharp, serrated knife. In a shallow bowl, mix together cheese with cornmeal and lemon peel. Spoon about 1 cup cheese mixture into center of each slice. Roll up pastry around the cheese and tie shut with a piece of orange or red ribbon to secure. Arrange rolled meat side by side in a baking pan. Bake for 30 minutes, then remove toothpicks and brown under broiler. Serve over rice.

Random Ingredients: stew meat,leg lamb,monterey jack pepper cheese,radish,garlic paste
title: Smothered Leg of Lamb
ingredients: 3 lbs stew meat ( or other leg of lamb, cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes ) | 8 ounces monterey jack pepper cheese ( grated ) | 3 tablespoons garlic paste | 8 ounces radishes, cut into 2-inch pieces | 1 lb boneless leg of lamb
instructions: In a large baking dish that is sprayed with nonstick cooking spray or a non stick cooking spray, combine first 4 ingredients. Add lamb and turn to coat well. Cover and refrigerate several hours or overnight. Preheat oven to 375°f place meat on a rack in the broiler pan, and broil for 45 minutes. Turn over, and broil for 45 - 60 minutes more, or until tender. Serve over rice or pasta with grated cheese and radish.

Random Ingredients: herbes de provence,cold water,muenster cheese,kielbasa,chicken thigh,chicken thigh fillet,chicken tender,red chile pepper
title: Chicken Choucroute
ingredients: 2 pounds bone-in chicken thigh fillets | 2 pounds chicken thigh fillets | 2 cans chicken thighs | 1/2 teaspoon dried herbes de provence, or to taste | 1 medium red chile pepper, sliced | 1 cup cold water | 4 slices muenster cheese | 2 tablespoons herbes de provence, or to taste ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons herbes de provence, or to taste ( optional ) | 2 fresh red chile peppers, sliced
instructions: Place chicken thigh and chicken thigh fillets in a large pot and pour in enough water to cover. Add 2 more cans of chicken breast meat and herbes de provence. Bring to a boil, cover and reduce heat to medium. Cook for about 30 to 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: basmati rice,kosher salt,half cream,pizza crust,brown rice,cumin,wheat spaghetti
title: Indian Restaurant's Baked Pizza Pie
ingredients: 1 large prepared crust ( i use kraft brand ) | 12 ounces whole wheat spaghetti | 2 cans pizza crust ( i use kraft brand for this ) | 1 cup half-and-half cream ( i use full-fat, or more if necessary ) | 1 1/2 cups brown rice ( or more if needed ) | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 2 teaspoons ground cumin
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Spread about 3/4 cup cream evenly to the edge of the crust. In a saucepan, cook the spaghetti according to package directions. Drain, and transfer to a bowl. Remove the spaghetti from the heat and add to the bowl with the spaghetti. Stir to coat the spaghetti with cream. Pour spaghetti mixture onto the crust. Add the mozzarella to the pizza crust. Sprinkle rice on top of the sauce, then sprinkle evenly with the cheese. Bake for 10 minutes, then let cool for 5 minutes before cutting into squares to serve.

title: Cheddar Salad Dressing for Fish, Chips, or Salad
ingredients: 1 cup sharp cheddar cheese, shredded | 1/4 cup salad oil
instructions: In a small bowl combine the cheese, oil and seasoning. Stir to combine. Add more cheese if desired. To prepare fish, preheat oven to 400°f. Line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper. Using a fork, blend cheese into dressing until it starts to clump up. Stir in reserved cheese.

Random Ingredients: bean,wheat flour,pesto sauce,cider vinegar,red onion,anise seed,thai red curry paste,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Curried Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 tablespoon whole wheat flour | 1 tablespoon peanut oil or 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 medium red onion, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon thai red curry paste | 1 1/2 cups light refried beans ( about 1/3 cup ) | 2 tablespoons fresh basil or 2 tablespoons of fresh mint, chopped | 2 -3 teaspoons cider vinegar ( if serving ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground anise seed
instructions: Combine 1 tablespoon of flour, peanut oil, onion and curry paste in bowl, and mash to make a paste. Set aside. Combine remaining flour, bean, basil and vinegar, add to mixture, and mix well. Chill. Add mustard seeds, or to taste, at this stage. If using bread or toast, toast over medium heat, turning occasionally, until browned.

Random Ingredients: mustard,mango,camembert cheese,chunky salsa,onion seed,pimento pepper,icing sugar,ghee
title: Mango Quesadillas
ingredients: 1 ripe mango | 4 ounces chopped pitted pimento pepper ( optional ) | 6 tablespoons chopped mild cheddar and chunky salsa or 6 tablespoons chunky salsa or 6 tablespoons picante sauce | 2 teaspoons dry mustard | 1 tablespoon onion seeds | 1 tablespoon icing sugar, sifted | 2 teaspoons melted ghee | 1/4 cup smooth smooth smooth low-fat can't serve low-fat icing sugar
instructions: Preheat the grill to high. Cut mango in half and remove the stone. Wash, rinse and dice. Place the mango, pimento pepper, salsa, mustard and onion seeds in a blender container and process to a smooth paste. Place the smooth can't serve icing sugar, ghee and 1/4 cup of the smooth sauce in a shallow bowl. Drizzle the mixture over the mango mixture and gently toss. Spoon the mango mixture onto a lightly seasoned platter and serve with the remaining smooth sauce, if desired. To serve, place tortilla on a hot griddle and bake until crisp and starting to brown underneath, 1 - 2 minutes per side.

title: Beer Battered Anchovies (Anchovy Dip- Spread)
ingredients: 3 -4 anchovies ( depending on size ) | 1 cup miracle whip ( or your choice of cream cheese ) | 1 teaspoon coriander seed ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons ale
instructions: Combine all the ingredients together in a mixing bowl, adding the beer last before serving so the flavours travel through the mix. Enjoy.

title: Lebanese Aji Pies (Vietnamese Aji Pies)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups mayonnaise | 6 serrano chile peppers, chopped | 1 clove garlic, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Prepare the aji pales as per directions on a package. When ready, spread them on a baking sheet and place in a preheated oven for 10 minutes. Spread mayonaisse down the center of the aji pales and top with your favorite toppings. Cook at 350 degrees f for 8 minutes.

title: Tomato Rice
ingredients: 1 large white onion | 1 cup long grain rice | 3 -5 cups tomato paste
instructions: Place tomato paste in blender container and blend on med/high for 2 minutes. Add onion and sautee it for 3 minutes on med/high. Add rice and sautee for 2 minutes. Serve warm with a salad, raita, or any other main dish.

title: Tasty Tasties
ingredients:
2 cups red cabbage, shredded ( approx.
    - ) | 2 cups light cheddar cheese | 2 tablespoons breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup breadcrumbs, extra-sharp | 1 tablespoon mirin
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and roll into 1 inch balls then flatten with a rolling pin to make thin slabs. Cook on your favourite bbq or skillet and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: white bean,self raising flour,lemon wedge,salad dressing,lamb chop,white pepper,bacon,ricotta cheese
title: Lamb Chops With White Beans
ingredients: 2 lamb chops, fat trimmed and bone in | 1 cup ricotta cheese | 1 teaspoon fresh lemon wedge | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 1/2 cup self raising flour | 1/4 cup salad dressing | 1 can white beans, undrained | 1 tablespoon bacon, cooked and crushed
instructions: Combine ricotta cheese, grated lemon juice and pepper and stir in flour. Toss the chops in flour then coat well with cheese dressing. Cook chops over medium heat in a frying pan in a little fat for 3 to 4 minutes each side until cooked through. Combine beans and bacon and pour over the chops.

title: Pineapple Raisins
ingredients: 14 ounces pineapple slices drained and halved | 1/2 tablespoon garlic salt | 2 tablespoons raisins
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place one pineapple chunk into each serving dish. Rub raisins into raisins. Sprinkle the tops with garlic salt. Bake in preheated oven 10 to 20 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Farlos (Filling for Caliente)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs roma tomatoes | filling, as desired
instructions: Cut the roma tomatoes in half through the stem and gently squeeze out the flesh with your hands, leaving about 1/4 inch thick shell. Transfer the pulp and shells to a cutting board.

title: Noodle Salad
ingredients: 300 g spaghetti, cooked and drained | 150 g egg noodles ( egg noodle, if available ) | 50 g pecans, coarsely chopped | 1 teaspoon sage
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Season and mix well. Chill well. Serve with a green salad.

title: Nori Sushi
ingredients: 8 sheets nori | 4 ounces very finely chopped nori ( dry seaweed ) | 4 -5 dashes hot chili sauce ( to taste ) | 1/4 cup sherry ( japanese cooking wine rice wine )
instructions: Place a large piece of nori on a flat surface with about 1 1/2 inch of nori on it, leaving a 1 - ½ inch overhang all around. Toast over low heat in a 350 degree oven. Watch carefully, as steam rises and the nori tends to brown quickly. Spread the nori on a kitchen towel and rub the top layer lightly with the towel or paper towels. Spread the nori with about 1 tbls. Of nori and top with the hot sauce. Squeeze the moisture out of the nori and cut each into 1 inch squares along its width. Sprinkle the tops of the triangles with the nori and serve with hot sherry.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,black sesame seed,raisin,dijon mustard
title: Raisin Salad
ingredients: 1 pound seedless raisins | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon roasted and black sesame seeds | 1/3 pound freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine raisins and about 1 tablespoon of mustard. Spread the sesame seeds in a thin layer on a serving dish. Stir raisins to coat. Stir in cheese. Serve immediately.

title: Mexican Espresso Dessert
ingredients: 1 1/2 1 1/2 cups espresso powder or 1 1/2 cups instant espresso, warmed | 3 tablespoons brewed strong coffee or 3 tablespoons very strong coffee, cooled to room temperature | 1 cup finely ground espresso-flavored tequila | 3 -4 tablespoons arrowroot or 3 -4 tablespoons cornstarch
instructions: Pour 1 teaspoon of espresso into a bowl. Pour 1 cup of the cooled strong coffee into the espresso and stir vigorously to disolve coffee. Whisk in the tequila and arrowroot. Chill until ready to use, stirring occasionally. Use a mixer to beat the mixture until it has expanded and incorporated the coffee. Spoon the remaining cup of coffee into a small dish. Scoop out about 1 cup of the mixture and chill until ready to use. Dip the bottom of a 6 inch ring mold in the espresso coffee and line with the prepared mold. Pour the 1/2 cup of chilled espresso mixture into the mold, spread with a rubber spatula to even the top. Put the ring mold in a large freezer until the gelatin is set. Remove the mold from the freezer and transfer the gelatin to a serving bowl. Pour the remaining 1 1/2 cups of brewed coffee over the gelatin. Chill until the gelatin is set. To serve, stir 1/8 teaspoon of freshly ground espresso powder into the gelatin mixture as well. Spoon dessert into serving plates or glasses. Garnish with 2 to 3 to 4 teaspoons of the chocolate shavings.

title: Aniseed Mushrooms Antipasti
ingredients: 4 large cremini mushrooms, cleaned and stems cut off | 1/4 lb genoa salami, sliced | 2 teaspoons anise seeds
instructions: Using your fingers, separate the mushroom stems from the stems, being careful to keep them intact. Remove the stems from each mushroom. Rinse out any water released from the mushrooms and set aside. Over high heat, heat a dry skillet. Add the salami slices and cook them, turning them over often, until all of the slices are slightly crispy. Add the mushrooms and allow them to saute another couple of minutes or so. Dip the stems into the aniseed and transfer to a serving platter.

Random Ingredients: chicken broth,ice water,red salmon,ginger,chicken breast,spinach leaf
title: Salmon Soup With Ginger
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts, cooked and diced | 1 2/3 lbs red salmon, diced | 2 1/3 cups chicken broth, low sodium | 1 3/4 inches fresh ginger, peeled and finely chopped | 5 1/3 cups torn small fresh spinach leaves | ice water, for searing chicken breasts
instructions: Cook chicken in 3/4 cup water in 12 inch skillet or dutch oven until chicken is no longer pink.. About 5 minutes. Stir in salmon, salmon, broth and ginger. Heat to boiling over high heat. Reduce heat to low. Cover and cook until salmon is heated through, about 10 minutes. Stir in spinach. Cover and cook until spinach is wilted, about 2 minutes. Divide among individual serving bowls.

title: String and Raspberries Summer Bagel (Gyoza
ingredients: 1/4 lb string bean, trimmed and ends cut off | 1 -2 ounce fresh raspberries or 1 -2 ounce frozen raspberries, thawed and chilled | 2 sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained and chopped | 1 sheet gyoza skins
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f. Place the string beans and raspberries in a saucepan and cover with cold water. Bring water to boil, reduce heat and simmer gently, uncovered, for 5 minutes. Drain the hot vermicelli in a sieve and set aside. Heat a dry skillet over high heat. Add the sun dried tomatoes and reheat, turning once, until lightly golden brown, 1 - 2 minutes. Transfer to a bowl and set aside to cool. Bring the vermicelli water to a boil over high heat, stirring frequently. Remove with a slotted spoon and place in a large bowl of ice. Drain the vermicelli and place in a larger bowl, draining any excess water. Add the vermicelli, sun dried tomatoes, string bean mixture and sun dried tomatoes to salad bowl, then toss to coat. Transfer to a serving platter and serve.

title: Easy Baked Spicy Peas
ingredients: 1 package frozen peas, thawed | 1/2 lb pancetta, cut into 1/4-inch dice | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 2 tablespoons brown dark chocolate, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder | 8 slices bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 f. Arrange peas in a single layer on a baking sheet. Bake at 350 degrees f for 15 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes, or until tender and golden. Meanwhile, stir pancetta into maple syrup. Remove peas from oven and sprinkle with brown chocolate, garlic powder and salt. Cut bread in half, and arrange over a baking sheet. Bake at 350°f until lightly toasted, about 10 minutes.

title: Apple Strudel
ingredients: 1 medium head lettuce, rinsed and dried | 1 large cedar plank | 4 tablespoons unsalted butter | 2 apples, pared and sliced | 1/2 pound dry penne | 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 1 small head lettuce - rinsed, dried, trimmed, and torn into bite size pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place the cedar plank on the baking sheet, and bake for 3 hours until wood starts to become crisp. Remove from oven, and allow to cool. Cut a deep pocket into the side of the cedar plank so that it will be about 1 inch deep. Fill with enough water to cover the bottom of the plank. Place the apple slices inside of the pocket. Cover the apple slices with more water, and let soak for 2 hours, changing water as necessary. In a saucepan, melt butter over medium heat. Cook the lettuce in the butter for about 5 minutes, until beginning to caramelize. Stir in the spinach, and cook 2 minutes more. Place the drained pasta in a large bowl, and toss with the lettuce and apple mixture. Serve, and sprinkle with additional yogurt.

title: Mongolian Eggs
ingredients: 1/2 cup bean paste | 2 tablespoons sherry | 1/2 cup cashews, finely ground | 1 egg yolk | 1 tablespoon bean sauce
instructions: In a medium glass bowl, mix together the bean paste, sherry and cashews. Beat the egg yolk with the bean sauce until the mixture is creamy. Lightly fry the bean paste mixture in 1 tablespoon of oil, until lightly golden in color. Transfer to a bowl and serve.

title: Astrabel's Wine
ingredients: 1 lb port wine, from a specialty bottle | 4 star anise
instructions: In a double boiler over hot but not boiling water, add the wine. Reduce the heat to medium and cook very slowly until reduced to about 1 1/2 cups. Remove from the heat and let stand for 5 minutes. Add a 1 star anise. Drink it.

title: Arancini (Pilaf)
ingredients: 100 g arborio rice ( about a 1cm cube ) | 100 g bacon, cut into 2cm pieces | 1 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Using a strainer pour the arborio rice into it and pour boiling water on the rice for about 3 minutes. Take the rice and drain the water, but keep the cooking liquid. Wipe out the cooking pot with a small paper towel and put it into the heat on the stove.. Chop the bacon in small pieces. Bring the water on the heat, add arborio rice and boil it for a minute. Add the bacon, stirring constantly. After 2 minutes stir it to mix it.

title: Crema De Verde (Portuguese Okra Whip)
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs okra | 1/2 cup grated orange rind ( zest of 1 orange can be substituted ) | 1/2 cup fresh lemon juice ( from 1-4 lemons ) | 1 cup whipping cream, at room temperature ( or sour cream ) | 8 ounces sliced mushrooms | 1/4 cup brandy ( optional )
instructions: Place okra in a single layer on paper towels, then moisten with olive oil. Cover with plastic wrap, then press out excess moisture. Lay on a sheet of wax paper and set aside at room temperature to dry off for 12 hours. Wash okra under running water and wipe dry with absorbent paper. Cut into 1/2 slices, then set aside. Combine orange rind, lemon juice and whipping cream in a medium size bowl. Set aside at room temperature. When ready to use, arrange mushrooms in a circle on a platter. Cover with a few okra slices and orange slices, then drizzle brandy over all. Serve warm.

title: Glazed, Roasted Potato Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs russet potatoes, peeled, quartered lengthwise, and cut into 6 wedges each | 3 large apples, cored, peeled, and cut into large wedges | 1 cup cider vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 375° and adjust rack to middle. Line 2 heavy baking sheets with parchment paper or waxed paper. Arrange potatoes in rows of 4 wedges each. In large roasting pan, arrange apple wedges around edges of potatoes. In small bowl, combine reserved apple wedges with cider vinegar. Drizzle vinegar mixture generously over potatoes and apples. Cover and bake until potatoes are tender and top crusts are golden brown, 1 - 1 1/2 to 2 1/2 hours longer. Turn off oven, remove cover and let potatoes rest while preparing dressing. Drain well and shake off excess liquid from potatoes. Arrange cooled potatoes on serving platter.

title: Shamely Poke Dip
ingredients: 3 teaspoons miracle whip | 1 shallot, minced | 3 teaspoons taco sauce ( or more to taste )
instructions: Stir miracle whip and minced shallot together. Add taco sauce to taste. Serve with crackers.

Random Ingredients: paprika,red pepper,fast rising active yeast,vanilla ice cream,taco seasoning mix
title: Spicy Taco Pizza
ingredients: 1 package fast-rising active dry yeast | 1 1/2 cups vanilla ice cream | 1 cup taco seasoning mix | 2 teaspoons paprika | 1/8 teaspoon crushed red pepper
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup warm water. In a small bowl, combine 2 cups ice cream, taco seasoning mix, paprika and red pepper. Add to rest of the ice cream and mix well. Place dough on a clean surface and knead for about 5 minutes. Place dough back on the clean surface and place back in the refrigerator for an additional hour or so. Split and place 2 or 3 smaller pizza stones in the oven. Preheat oven to 500 degrees f. Remove dough from refrigerator and brush with some of the remaining water. Sprinkle with remaining taco seasoning, paprika and red pepper. Bake at 500 degrees f for 10 to 12 minutes or until crust is lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: pizza crust,purpose flour,self rising flour,vanilla sugar,apricot
title: Papas De Jamon (Pebre)
ingredients: 1 pizza crust | 3/4 cup dried apricot, chopped | 1 2/3 cups all-purpose flour, plus extra for dusting | 1 cup self-rising flour | 2/3 cup vanilla sugar, divided | 3 teaspoons vanilla sugar, divided
instructions: Preheat the oven to 475°. Roll out pizza dough for 1/4 thickness with a pizza peel, or use a regular biscuit cutter. Press the dough into circles about 1 1/2inches in diameter. You should have about 17 circles. Dust the dough circles with flour, and place on the hot pizza stone, or bake the rounds in the oven for about 10 minutes. Remove the pizzas from the oven, sprinkle with 2/3 cup of vanilla sugar, and let cool for about 10 minutes. Spread the dough with apricots or other dried fruit, and return to the oven for 2 more minutes, or until the dough is puffed and browned. Remove from the oven, and let cool. Spread the baked pizza rounds with the cooled syrup or vanilla sugar.

title: Lithos' Dressed Fish
ingredients: 2 cans hard alcoholic cider | 4 hard-cooked eggs, chopped | 1 1/2 cups panko breadcrumbs
instructions: Combine cider and eggs in a small bowl.

title: Korean Beef and Rice Noodle Salad
ingredients: 300 g beef steaks, thinly sliced | 1 green spring onion, chopped | 200 g rice noodles | 2 limes, halved
instructions: Arrange the steak, spring onion and pasta on serving plates topped with dressing.

title: Quick Bruschetta Appetizer
ingredients: 1 loaf of crusty french bread | 2 cups thinly sliced asparagus | 1 teaspoon white pepper | 1 cup of diced italian plum tomato
instructions: Slice french bread into thin layers. Cut a pocket in the bread, lay slices on a cookie sheet and microwave for about 2 minutes until heated through. Remove from microwave and top with asparagus, italian tomato, and white pepper if using. Let sit 5 minutes before serving.

title: Indian Grilled Corn Relish  -  Tasty,    Hearty Dip  from  australia
ingredients: 2 lbs coarsely ground white corn or 2 lbs sweet corn | 2 lbs coarsely ground brown onion | 2 lbs coarsely ground pecans or 2 lbs roasted almonds | 2 lbs finely ground cardamom seeds | 1 1/2 cups coarsely ground seasoning ( such as mccormick ) | 6 lbs finest chips ( such as mccormick's chip shop multi-colored corn relish )
instructions: Heat grill to high. In a large bowl, combine all the ingredients. Mix well with hands until a very sticky dough forms. Dip each rack into coarse sugar. Grill the dipped rack until it is golden brown, flipping once or twice, about 13 minutes. Let cool to room temperature. Serve with your favourite crackers and/or chips or enjoy on a cracker as a snack with vegetables or as an accompaniment to roast chickens, fish, or salads.

Random Ingredients: green chilies,cream cheese,sharp cheddar cheese,pear,floury potato,hard egg,chipotle pepper
title: Tex-Mex Cheese Ball
ingredients: 2 lbs medium floury potatoes, peeled | 8 ounces cream cheese | 10 ounces roasted green chilies ( from a jar ) | 1 1/2 cups sharp cheddar cheese ( shredded ) | 3 hard-boiled eggs | 12 chipotle peppers | 3 pears ( cored, quartered )
instructions: Cut potatoes in 1/2 cubes, and cook in boiling water until tender. Drain and cool under cold water. Remove and reserve potato water. Cook cheese in cream cheese over low heat until melted, and add chilies, onion and hard boiled eggs. Add salt and pepper or chilies to taste. Add potato water, and mix well. Place in an ungreased 9x13 pan. Spread cheese mixture evenly over potatoes. Bake uncovered in a 350 degree f. Oven for 20 - 25 minutes, until lightly browned. Top with pears and chipotle peppers, and return to oven for 5 - 10 minutes to brown pears and melt cheese.

Random Ingredients: red potato,cinnamon sugar,chicken thigh,wine vinegar,chili garlic sauce,ancho chilies,caster sugar,chinese rice wine
title: Hot Chili Chicken & Red Potatoes
ingredients: 4 red potatoes, quartered | 4 skinless chicken thighs | cinnamon sugar | chili-garlic sauce ( optional ) | 1/4 cup chili-garlic sauce | 4 tablespoons good quality wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon caster sugar | 2 teaspoons chinese rice wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 190°c line a roasting tin with baking paper. Boil potatoes in a pan of water for 10 - 15 mins until nearly tender. Drain and set to one side to cool. Remove and chill chicken. Remove skin and any excess fat from chicken. Slit, bone and joint chicken thighs, then split into two. Place in a bowl and add cinnamon sugar, chilli garlic sauce, vinegar, sugar and rice wine. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Stir to combine. Place chicken thighs, skin side up, on top of the potato mixture. Cover and place on a tray. Place roasting tin on top and pour over enough hot water to come half way up tin. Bake for 1 hour, then remove foil and cook for a further 20 minutes. The chicken is cooked when a skewer pierced with a skewer comes out clean, the juices run clear and the thick meat is tender.

title: Hot Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 lb cheese spread | 1 tablespoon chili paste | 1/2 teaspoon dry basil | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 jalapeno pepper, seeded and chopped
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Spread on bread slices.

title: Grilled Beef With Grapefruit and Chocolate Milk
ingredients: 350 g rump steak, cut into thick slices | 1 red grapefruit, peeled and cut into thin slices | 300 ml chocolate milk
instructions: Using a grill pan or barbecue plate with metal cooking handles, lightly oil the plate. Place one slice of rump steak on the bottom of the greased plate. Top with a slice of grapefruit and sprinkle with another slice of rump steak. Pour over chocolate milk. Top with remaining slices of rump steak. Cover and cook over indirect medium heat for 12 minutes, or until steak is tender when pierced with a fork. Remove lid and bake for 2 - 3 minutes, or until lightly browned.

title: Chinese Pork Skewers
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs pork tenderloin, cubed | 1 tablespoon sunflower oil | 2 tablespoons soy sauce
instructions: In a large bowl, place the pork cubes and combine with the light soy sauce. Cover and refrigerate for about 4 hours, stirring the meat once or twice. Thread the meat onto the skewer and thread onto the other skewers. Place on a metal or soaked wooden skewer that has been soaked in water for 5 minutes or in a steamer above boiling water.

title: Deep-Fried Chestnut Mushrooms
ingredients: 400 g chestnut mushrooms | 300 g puff pastry | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees celsius. Wash the mushrooms under cold water, trim the stems and finely snip off the tough outer leaves. Slice the caps in half lengthways. Cut the stems into 2 or 3 little pieces. Take each piece of mushroom from its body half and separate the leaves from surrounding them completely. Cut each half into 2 or 3 little strips. Dredge the mushroom strips in vinegar and deep fry in hot oil for about 5 - 3 minutes. Drain on paper towels and serve hot with sweet chutney or savoury relishes.

Random Ingredients: cinnamon,oriental flavor ramen noodle,corn syrup,ancho chile powder,escarole,rosemary,butter,coriander seed
title: Seared Escarole on Pho

instructions: Whisk together the pico de gallo, red curry paste, soymilk, sweet potato flour, oats, and barley in a bowl until well blended.

title: Simple butternut squash
ingredients: 1 large butternut squash, peeled and quartered | 1 cup cooked fruit | 1 cube chicken bouillon
instructions: Preheat oven to 400º f. Combine squash, diced chicken and fruit with bouillon, mixing until squash is covered. Place squash in a 9x13 inch baking dish dish. Pour boiling water over all. Cover and bake 45 minutes. Remove from oven. Let stand 15 minutes before serving. If the squash isn't crisp enough, bake for an additional 15 minutes.

title: Shiitake Mushroom Hash
ingredients: 1 large idaho potato, diced to 1-inch cubes | 1 lb deli sliced roast beef | 1 large leek, cut in strips | 1/4 lb shiitake mushroom, chopped | 3 ounces catsup | 2 fresh tomatoes, diced
instructions: Cook potatoes in lightly salted water until just tender. Drain well and set aside. Saute leeks and mushrooms in a pan or wok until mushrooms are tender. Set aside. Slice roast beef into thin strips. Heat the kettle over medium high heat. Add the catsup, tomatoes and veg to the pan and mix well with potatoes. Remove the pan from a burner and add the onions. Reduce heat to medium low and heat for 5 minutes. Then serve.

title: Quinoa Salad (Hara)
ingredients: 500 g quinoa | 3 -4 anaheim chilies ( depending on your taste, i use a combination of anaheim and chilies from asian food stores ) | 100 g toasted sliced almonds ( optional ) | 4 -5 kalamata olives, cut into small chunks ( optional ) | 1 -2 teaspoon cardamom ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons almond extract
instructions: Rinse quinoa over a bowl with water and drain. In a blender or food processor add cardamom and almond extract and whiz to a smooth, thick paste. Set aside some to sprinkle on top later if desired. This is really tasty. Rinse whole anaheim chilies over a bowl and drain in a colander under cold water until skins are clean and stems removed. Seed and cut the chilies longitudinally then chop them in the food processor or blender to obtain small pieces. Wash kalamata olives so that they're soft then add to a bowl. Drain quinoa into a colander and rinse well with cold water making sure the starch stays in the water. Rinse the peanuts in a colander with a little water then add to bowl. Add toasted seeds and chopped chilies, mix thoroughly. Add cardamom and almond extract and mix well. Place in fridge to chill for at least an hour to allow flavors to meld together. Stir occasionally, so as not to break down the quinoa too much. Add more almonds if desired.

title: Ziti Pasta With Lean Ground Beef
ingredients: 1 lb extra lean ground beef | 3/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, chopped | 2 cups ziti pasta
instructions: Brown ground beef in a large skillet over medium high heat. Drain the fat. Drain the fat from the pan. Add the sun dried tomatoes and the drained beef. Saute for 5 minutes until the beef is browned and the tomatoes are heated through.

title: Tequila and Cabbage Wraps - Cowboy Style
ingredients: 3/4 lb bacon | 4 -5 large head cabbage, finely shredded | 1 cup tequila ( the tequila should be a little shy of its original '' tequila '' flavor ) | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 4 tablespoons dry instant barley
instructions: Chop bacon to use for this recipe. Saute until crispy, turning often. Break apart while bacon is sauteing. Drain, chop bacon and set aside. Cook cabbage until tender crisp. Drain. Add salt and beer, mix and set aside til warm. In a small bowl mix together tequila and barley until dissolved. Add to cabbage mixture. Stir. Lay the tortillas on your work surface. Add 2 tbls. Of the cabbage mixture to the middle of a burrito. Fold up ends and pinch closed. Place seam side down in a pan. Add 1/2 tsp of tequila and the bacon over the filling. Roll the burrito tightly. Chill until serving.

title: Jholdi Ki Kiyaar

instructions: Wash and dry the daikon, and cut into long, thin strips about half an inch long. Remove as soon as they are done and drain on absorbent paper towels. In the same oil, fry the yellow peppers until caramelized. Remove all from the oil except for a few strips, then fry the green peppers. Remove as soon as they are crisp and drain on absorbent paper towels. Keep warm. Make the yoghurt sauce by combining all of the ingredients. Place the fried daikon in a bowl and pour the hot sauce over the daikon and mix well. Garnish with coriander leaves and serve.
