Add cornbread and xanthan gum, mix well and serve with rice or noodles.

title: Marinated Omelets
ingredients: 4 large eggs | 1/2 teaspoon minced garlic or 1/2 teaspoon bottled minced garlic | 2 tablespoons soya sauce | 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | confectioners'sugar
instructions: Place whole eggs in a pan and cover with a large pan over medium heat. Boil until whites are set. Cool a few minutes and flip over. Remove eggs from pan and set aside. Using a fork, stir garlic into egg, then coat. Beat eggs with electric mixer on medium speed about 1 minute. Reduce speed to low and slowly add soya sauce and oregano, beat until well combined and then pour over egg coated omelets. Sprinkle sifted confectioner's sugar over top. Note, can be served on italian bread as an appetizer serve with freshly grated parmesan cheese, as an an appetizer or as an entree.

title: Apricot Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 2 lbs beef tenderloin, tied | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 2 tablespoons jalapeno juice | 2 tablespoons dried apricots, chopped | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon | 2 cups frozen mixed vegetables
instructions: Prepare grill. Remove steak.

title: Mushrooms & Black Olives
ingredients: 1 cup self-raising flour | 2 cups cremini mushrooms or 2 cups button mushrooms, washed, cleaned and trimmed | 1 can black olives, pitted and chopped
instructions: Heat the oven to 190 degrees c. Spray a non stick muffin tin with cooking spray. Sift the flour into a large bowl and use a pastry blender or spoon to cut in the mushrooms. Add the black olives and mix with your fingers to combine. Pour the mushroom mix into the prepared muffin tin. Bake in the oven for 12 - 15 minutes or until risen and lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: cocoa,baking potato,pasta choice,sage leaf,rice roni,bean sprout
title: Oyster Baked Italian Baked Potatoes
ingredients: 4 baking potatoes | 1 bag uncooked dry pasta of your choice | 4 ounces uncooked rice-a-roni | 1 cup bean sprouts | 1 teaspoon ground sage leaf | 1 teaspoon unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Line a 10 baking sheet with parchment paper. Set potatoes in a pot with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, then drain. Add pasta and enough water to cover to boil again. Cook 40 minutes until tender. Meanwhile, preheat oven to 400 degrees. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. In a bowl, combine rice a roni and 1 cup bean sprouts. Season with sage and cocoa. Cut reserved potato with grain into 2 inch pieces. Arrange in a single layer in prepared baking dish. Stir rice mixture, then spread onto the potato layer in dish. Arrange bean sprouts on top and sprinkle with remaining 1 pinch of cocoa. Bake 40 minutes or until crust is golden brown.

Random Ingredients: natural bran,white wine vinegar,hot pepper sauce,portabella mushroom,rump roast
title: Hot Roast With Portabella Portabella
ingredients: 2 portabella mushrooms, trimmed and quartered | 2 teaspoons white wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon coarsely ground natural bran | 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1 1/2 lbs rump roast
instructions: Heat oven to 425 degrees. Rub the roast with the bran. Insert a meat thermometer and place roast on a rack in a 9 x13 inch roasting pan. Insert a thermometer so the roast reaches 130 degrees. Roast roast until thermometer registers 155 to 165 degrees on an instant reading thermometer, 25 to 35 minutes, depending on degree of doneness. Transfer roast to a platter when ready to serve. Pour off any accumulated juices that have accumulated on the cutting board. Let cool slightly. In a bowl, combine the mushrooms with the vinegar, bran and hot pepper sauce. Pour the mushrooms mixture over the roast. Toss to coat on all sides.

title: Sliced Heirloom Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 large heirloom tomato, sliced in thin wedges | 1/4 teaspoon ground dried chipotle chile | 1/8 teaspoon ladyfingers
instructions: Arrange tomato wedges across the edge of a serving plate. Sprinkle with ground chipotle, then drizzle with a little of the juices.

Random Ingredients: parsnip,cannellini bean,chicken stock,heavy whipping cream,vanilla,wheat bread
title: Tuscan Parsnips and Cannellini Bean Soup
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups chicken stock | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsnips | 2 cans cannellini beans, drained | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla | 4 pieces whole wheat bread | 1/3 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: In a soup pot, bring the chicken stock to a boil over high heat. Stir in the parsnips. Reduce heat to medium low, cover and simmer 15 to 20 minutes. Stir the cannellini beans into the soup then return to a boil. Cook 5 minutes, then stir in the vanilla. Remove from heat. Toast the bread until golden brown on both sides. Cut into halves and arrange on a serving plate covered with a plastic wrap to keep warm. Ladle the soup into bowls and top with a piece of toast in each. Stir the cream into the soup until well blended.

title: Hazelnut Rice Pasta Con Salted Ajo Blanco
ingredients:
450 ml pasta ( rice such as acini di pepe, spaghetti, vermicelli, gemelli, ditalini etc.
    - ) | 1/2 cup fresh hazelnuts, coarsely chopped ( skin on ) | 1 -3 teaspoon chili paste | 1 tablespoon dried roasted sweet-corn kernels or 1 tablespoon tequila | 1 -2 teaspoon fresh cilantro ( optional ) or 1 -2 teaspoon chives, minced ( optional )
instructions: Rinse pasta well under cold water, set aside. Place hazelnuts in a small heatproof bowl, and cook, shaking pan frequently, over medium heat, until fragrant, about 5 minutes, moving nuts around in pan. Cool nuts completely. Meanwhile, place chili paste and hazelnuts in small heavy saucepan over low heat and let sit, stirring frequently, until fragrant around edges, about 2 minutes or so. Stir in sweet corn, stir. Drain pasta well reserving 3/4 cup of the cup. Return pasta to large pot. Add pasta and sauce, and toss well. Serve warm or cold garnished with nuts and remaining nuts.

title: Quinoa Bliss
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 1/4 cup kahlua | 1 lime, juice of | 2 tablespoons oil | 1/4 cup creme fraiche or 1/4 cup sour cream | 3 drops tabasco sauce
instructions: Wash and rinse quinoa and place in a pot on low medium heat. Add kahlua, lime juice, oil, and cream. Simmer on low heat for 20 - 25 minutes stirring occasionally.

Random Ingredients: triple sec,dill weed,bay scallop,chicken drumstick,basmati rice,kielbasa
title: Kielbasa and Scallops over Rice (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried dill weed | 4 chicken drumsticks, skinned and cut in half | 2 bay scallops, sliced in half | 1 lb kielbasa, sliced | 1/2 cup triple sec | 1 1/2 cups basmati rice, washed and drained
instructions: Sprinkle the dill and 2 tbsp salt over the chicken halves and place them in the crock pot. Place the scallops around the chicken, spooning the rest of the marinade over the scallops. Set the chicken on top and then top with the kielbasa and scallops. Set the rice on high and cook 10 minutes to cook the rice. Remove the chicken from the crock pot, and keep it warm. Stir the remaining salt into the rice. Serve the chicken in bowls with sliced kielbasa and scallops on top.

Random Ingredients: salt pork,port wine,ranch bean,bottom steak,egg white,cheese,green,granny smith apple
title: Apple & Cheese Pate With Pork Ranch Ham
ingredients: 1 package cheese ( monterey jack or your choice ) or ( 5 ounce ) package farmer cheese ( monterey jack or your choice ) | 4 1/2 ounces salt pork or 4 1/2 ounces bacon strips, chopped | 1 1/2 lbs boneless bottom round steaks, cut into 1 1/4-inch cubes | 1 egg whites | 1/4 cup port wine, plus 2 for glaze | 1 package mixed greens ( spinach, cauliflower and red kale ) | 1 granny smith apple, peeled cored and thinly sliced | 1 can ranch style beans, rinsed and drained
instructions: To make the cheese. Place cheese cubes in a large bowl. Add the salt pork and bacon or ham. Using your hands, mix it gently until the cheese is melted. Place in the refrigerator until needed. The cheese stays together and will firm up as you work. Place the egg whites in a medium bowl and slowly beat in port. The liquid should look foamy. Gradually add in the cheese 1/2 cup at a time, stirring until well mixed. Cover with a damp paper towel and refrigerate until set. In a small bowl, stir together the greens and apple slices. Sprinkle with cheese and serve. Note, if making the pate on the counter, it is best to first crumble a bunch of the cheese into the pate. Then, in a medium bowl, stir in the farmer cheese until combined. Add the remaining cheese to the cheese, stir in until distributed evenly. To serve.

Random Ingredients: chicken broth,green,chocolate hazelnut spread,water chestnut,graham cracker crumb,kale,lime leaf,green olive
title: Chocolate Hazelnut and Kale Ramen
ingredients: 1 package graham cracker crumbs | 4 cups water | 2 cups low sodium chicken broth | 1 tablespoon of fresh lime leaves, minced | 1 bag fresh kale, chopped | 1 cup of sliced green olives | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained and chopped | 1 package chocolate hazelnut spread | 1/2 cup finely chopped green olives
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place baking sheet under broiler, and spray with nonstick cooking spray, or line with parchment paper. Spray a baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray, if desired. Stir together graham cracker crumbs and water in a bowl until well combined. Press crumb mixture into a 9x13 inch glass baking dish. Bake crust until golden brown and slightly darker in color, about 10 minutes. Cool on a wire rack. Meanwhile, bring chicken broth and lime leaves to a boil in a saucepan over medium heat. Reduce heat and simmer until reduced by half, about 5 minutes. Add kale, green olives and water chestnuts.

Random Ingredients: mozzarella cheese,orange food coloring,white wine vinegar,barley
title: Tartiflette
ingredients: 4 cups cooked white wine vinegar | 1/4 cup orange food coloring | 6 -8 cups cooked barley ( rinsed and cooked, see note below ) | 2 cups low-fat mozzarella cheese, shredded
instructions: Note, rinsed barley is usually called rinsed cooked barley while rinsing the barley. It is used as part of the dijon mustard horseradish sauce. Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl. Put about one third on a greased cookie sheet lined with wax paper. Cut another portion in half on the greased cookie sheet. Put a third portion also in the center of the wax paper. Wet hands, and press mixture into the wax paper. Repeat process with remaining two portions of mixture being used for each layer. Bake at 425 for about 45 - 60 minutes or until light brown. While still warm, cut into strips or squares, and serve. Note, for more orange flavor check out recipe #.

title: Italian Salad II
ingredients: 5 1/4 pounds swiss chard | 6 1/4 pounds celery with leaves, chopped | 1 1/2 pounds provolone cheese, diced | 2 packages processed cheese-and-mortadella cheese blend, cut into chunks
instructions: Fill a large pot with water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in 4 pounds of swiss chard, and bring to a boil again. As soon as the swiss chard is nearing the end of cooking, stir in the celery, and remove the stalks and leaves from the celery. Rinse under warm running water until the stalks have turned white and shrunk, and are no longer tough. Combine swiss chard, celery and provolone cheese pieces together in a large bowl. Season to taste with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Toss with 2 1/2 pounds truffle oil dressing.

Random Ingredients: red capsicum,dark brown sugar,red chile pepper,french,white breadcrumb,red onion
title: Stuffed Capsicum and Garlic
ingredients: 8 ounces french rolls, finely chopped | 4 ounces cooked red capsicums, finely chopped | 1 red onion, finely chopped | 1 red chile pepper, finely chopped | 1/2 cup chopped dark brown sugar | 2 tablespoons white breadcrumbs
instructions: Combine breadcrumbs, sugar, chile pepper and onion in a medium bowl. Stir in capsicum until well coated with breadcrumb mix. Form capsicum mixture into 6 small patties. Grill over hot coals for 3 minutes each side or until cooked through.

Random Ingredients: vanilla,apple cider vinegar,pink peppercorn,beef stew meat,beef bouillon cube
title: Easy Beef Consommé
ingredients: 1 teaspoon pink peppercorns | 1 cup apple cider vinegar | 2 tablespoons vanilla ( optional ) | 4 -6 beef stew meat, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 beef bouillon cube, and | 1 teaspoon apple cider vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon instant vanilla
instructions: Toast the peppercorns. Set them aside if they begin to color too much and can cause bitterness. Combine all dressing ingredients in a 2 1/2 or 3 quart casserole and heat on low until mixed well. When finished, add the peppercorns and mix. Cover and cook 10 to 15 minutes, stirring the Consommé frequently.

title: Herbal Rosemary Appetizers
ingredients: 1 package saffron threads | 1/2 cup sour cream | cooking spray | 1 sprig fresh rosemary, for garnish
instructions: In a small cup, mix the saffron with the sour cream. Heat a small nonstick skillet over medium heat. Dip the saffron into the sour cream mix until all of the saffron has soaked into the sour cream. Cook, stirring often, until it begins to brown. Transfer the saffron to a mortar and pestle, or a large cutting board, and carefully mash or press the saffron into the rosemary until the pieces are evenly coated with the spice. Place some saffron onto a plate, garnish with rosemary sprigs, and serve.

Random Ingredients: almond extract,wild rice,heavy whipping cream,coffee,chicken tender,grenadine,jalapeno pepper,french bread
title: Baked Chicken Sandwiches With Wild Rice Au Jus
ingredients: 1 can chicken tenders, drained | 1/4 cup brewed coffee ( i use starbucks brand ) | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 6 slices jalapeno pepper, very thin ( i use a serrano ) | 1/2 cup wild rice ( i use brown rice ) | 5 tablespoons heavy whipping cream | 1 teaspoon grenadine | 12 slices french bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Combine chicken in a small bowl with brewed coffee and almond extract. Spread the rice on the bread slices in a single layer in an ungreased 2 quart glass baking dish in a layer of sliced jalapenos. Spoon rice mixture on top of jalapenos and arrange chicken on top of rice. Cover with foil and bake for 30 minutes. Uncover the last 5 - 10 minutes to ensure all rice is browned evenly. Uncover, sprinkle with a little of the grenadine, and return baking dish to oven uncovered. Cook covered for 20 - 30 minutes. Remove foil and cook for 30 more minutes. Uncover and continue baking, uncovering every 10 minutes to brown the chicken and maintaining a light crust, until lightly browned, 5 - 8 minutes longer. Remove and let stand 10 minutes before serving. Garnish, ladle warm soup into bowls, and top with a drizzle of extra grenadine.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,orange blossom water,romano cheese,egg noodle,mustard powder,rosemary,hard egg,flat leaf italian parsley
title: A Perfect Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 package orange blossom water noodles | 1/2 cup hard cooked egg, chopped | 3 tablespoons dry mustard powder | ground rosemary | cooked long-grain white rice | 1 cup grated romano cheese | 1/2 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf italian parsley | 3 tablespoons grated romano cheese | 1 cup hard-cooked eggs
instructions: Place orange blossom water noodles in a medium pot.

title: Homemade Indian Flat Bread
ingredients: 1 cup canned chickpea flour | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 yellow onion, quartered ( about 1/4 cup )
instructions: Place chickpea flour, cardamom, and onion into a mortar and grind into a fine paste. Form mixture into a ball and knead in enough of the chickpea flour to achieve a rough mixture that is smooth but not too dry. The dough should be a little sticky and workable. Cover top of bowl and set aside to rest at least 15 minutes. Form mixture into a smooth ball and form into 4 balls. Wet hands and place each ball onto a flat plate. Flatten flat bread, about 1/4 inch thick, into a circle about 14 inches long and 3 to 4 inches in diameter, making it slightly thinner than an American round place bread on a cookie sheet. Preheat oven to 350°f place an ungreased griddle on medium high heat. Place bread and 1/4 teaspoon vegetable oil in a 10 inch f ovenproof skillet and bake until bread is lightly toasted, about 7 minutes. Slide bread onto a cutting board and cut 1/4 inch slices. Place slices cut side down on baking sheet and bake about 8 minutes longer until crust is deep golden brown.

Random Ingredients: basmati rice,dark chocolate,tomato puree,plain flour,emmenthaler cheese,lettuce leaf,basil leaf
title: The Ultimate Lunch
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice | 2 cups dark chocolate, melted ( or 1 cup semi sweet chocolate chips ) | 2 tablespoons plain flour or 2 tablespoons gluten-free flour | 1 tablespoon tomato puree or 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 5 large lettuce leaves ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons basil leaves ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon shredded emmenthaler cheese
instructions: Cook rice according to package or packet instructions. Add melted dark chocolate and the melted chocolate to the rice mixture. Stir to combine. Place the torn lettuce leaves on a serving plate and spread with the tomato puree. Divide rice onto four salad plates. Place a lettuce leaf on the lettuce leaf. Place the cheese in the centre of the lettuce leaf. Spread the filling on the lettuce leaf and serve. Repeat with more filling and cheese on top every bite, if desired.

title: Sizzlin' Risotto
ingredients: 1/4 cup shallot, chopped | 150 ml buttermilk biscuits, finely crushed | 3 tablespoons sesame oil | 400 g basmati rice | 300 ml triple sec
instructions: Place the diced shallots in a medium frying pan and cook over medium heat for 3 mins. Add the crushed biscuits and 2 tablespoons of sesame oil to the pan and fry for 1 min. Add the rice and stir well using a metal spoon. Add 300ml buttermilk and continue to cook over medium heat until you reach the consistency of risotto. Add 1 tsp of brandy if desired and stir to combine.

title: Lamb and Blueberry Salad With Fleur De Provencale
ingredients: 8 ounces boneless lamb shoulder, fat removed and cut into 1/4 inch slices | 10 ounces fresh figs | 10 ounces fresh berries ( or frozen ) | 1/3 cup pecorino cheese, freshly grated | 1 teaspoon orange zest, finely grated | 3 teaspoons fresh lavender, snipped ( or 1 teaspoon dried lavender flowers )
instructions: If using frozen berries, thaw at room temperature, if frozen, and cut into quarters. If using fresh berries, blanch in boiling water for 30 seconds or until bright green. Drain. If using fresh berries, cook in boiling water for 3 minutes, drain. Cut open and remove seeds and ribs. Cut flesh into 1/2 or 1 inch squares. Chop figs and berries. Combine with lamb and mix well. Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours or so. Adjust the time to your own taste. Before serving, add grated cheese and orange zest. Toss. If using fresh berries, put on serving tray.

Random Ingredients: splenda sugar substitute,cherry brandy,double cream,extra virgin olive oil,seasoning salt,porcini mushroom,vidalia onion
title: Paul's Mushroom  & Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried porcini mushrooms | 3 teaspoons extra virgin olive oil | 2 large vidalia onions, roughly chopped | 1 tablespoon splenda sugar substitute | 6 tablespoons cherry brandy or 6 tablespoons whiskey | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 500 ml double cream ( whipping cream works best )
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, mix together dried porcini mushrooms and 1 teaspoon of oil. Add chopped onions and mix well. Add remaining teaspoon oil and flour and combine and saute' on medium heat until onions are light brown and mushrooms are tender. Add brandy and ignite if the brandy smoke subsides. Cook for 5minutes, stirring regularly, then raise heat to medium and add the salt. Once liquid starts to clear, stir in the cream and heat to boiling. Turn off heat as soon as you remove the pot from the heat. Transfer the onion mixture to individual serving dishes and stir mushroom cream into the sauce. Serve immediately. Keeps in fridge for up to 1 week but if you have used up all of it, it will keep happily for months.

title: Ricotta-Foil Roll-Cream-On-Cream
ingredients:
1 head red cabbage ( approx.
    - 2 pounds ) | 2 -4 tablespoons fresh garlic, finely minced | 2 tablespoons fresh culantro, finely minced ( optional )
instructions: Steam the cabbage in a wok or large skillet that is coated with a little olive oil, until just starting to turn brown and a little bit charred on the edges, about 5 - 10 minutes. Cool the cabbage for about 10 minutes, then shred the cabbage with your hands. Mix in fresh minced garlic and culantro, if using. Let cool to room temperature. Serve very well chilled.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,cumin seed,chipotle chile,cardamom seed,vodka,half
title: Algerian Spicy Chipotle Blinis
ingredients: 1 cup unsalted vodka | 1/2 cup half-and-half | 1/3 cup self-rising flour | 1 teaspoon ground cumin seeds | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom seed | 1/2 teaspoon whole chipotle chile, minced
instructions: Stir vodka, half and half, flour, cumin, cardamom, and chilies together in a saucepan.

title: Berry Goodie Soup
ingredients: 400 ml raspberry-flavored soymilk | 1 tablespoon dried apple juice | 2 russet potatoes, peeled and cubed | 2 bunches spring onions, whites and greens tops thinly chopped | 4 tablespoons madeira wine ( or orange juice ) | 1 lemonade | 1/2 cup madeira wine or 1/2 cup white rum, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: In a bowl combine the soy milk and apple juice, and place in the freezer for half an hour. Place the potatoes in a pot of cold salted water, and bring to a boil. Boil gently for 12 - 15 minutes, or until fork tender. Drain and transfer to the blender. Add the spring onions and madeira or orange juice. Blend, stopping to scrape down the sides of the bowl and adding more water if necessary, until smooth. When soup begins to thicken, gently pour in the lemonade. Stir. Taste and add more if necessary and serve topped with the chopped lemon. Enjoy.

title: Pound-Sliced Vanilla Ice Cream!
ingredients: 8 ounces peanut butter or 8 ounces vanilla cheese | 2 tablespoons light corn syrup | chili pepper sauce or fresh lemon pepper, to taste
instructions: Place the cheese in a plastic bag or bowl and crush with a rolling pin or the paddle of a meat mallet to a chunky texture. Add the corn syrup and beat with a fork until creamy. Spread about 2 tablespoons of the cream onto the cheese, top with as many chili or fresh chili, as you want, then roll the cheese around the spread. Chill until firm, at least 2 hours. Slice with a knife.

Random Ingredients: cake flour,sun tomato oil,pinto bean,black peppercorn
title: Pinto Beans and Sun-Dried Tomato
ingredients: 1 lb dried pinto bean | 6 ounces sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained, coarsely chopped | 1 teaspoon cake flour, sifted | 1 teaspoon black peppercorns, crushed
instructions: If your beans are soaked in short time, drain them. Soak the beans in water overnight in a large pan of salted, clean and hot water. Place the beans over an open flame and steam vigorously until both the beans and the skins are very thick, stirring occasionally. They should take about 5 to 7 minutes. Pour the beans into a large, heavy saucepan in which they have been drained and cover with 1 cup water. Bring the water to the boil, reduce the heat and simmer, partially covered, until the beans are tender and the liquid is reduced considerably, stirring occasionally, about 1 1/2 hours. Meanwhile, make the topping while the beans cook. Heat a skillet large enough to hold the oil over medium heat. Sauté the chopped sundried tomato until it just starts to color, about 1 minute. Spoon 1/4 cup hot water into the tomato and reserve. Drain the beans and add them to the skillet. Stir well to blend. Stir in the sifted cake flour, pepper and reserved sun-dried tomato. Adjust the seasoning. Place the remaining 1/4 cup of hot water on the table in large, heated serving bowls for the serving. Pour the beans into the warm bowls, garnish with the tomato slices and serve at once.

title: Pareve Nuts
ingredients: 4 lbs pears ( pears are not known as but may be found in some areas ) | 1 teaspoon fennel leaves ( or french flat leaf parsley )
instructions: Peel and core the pears and leave them whole. Cut them in halves or quarters if they are large, depending on their size. Place them in a heavy pan that has been brushed liberally with oil, add the vinegar and fennel leaves. Place the pan over medium high heat and bring to a simmer. Cover and simmer until the pears are tender, adding a little water if necessary. When ready, remove the pears and place them on a warm platter, cover, and allow them to cool. Transfer to a container and store, covered, in the fridge. Store the pears in the refrigerator at this point, for up to a week. The nuts may be eaten immediately or allowed to cool. Store them in an airtight glass or stainless steel container.

title: Spicy Baked Venison and Spinach Sandwich
ingredients: 4 lbs venison ( or combination ) or 4 lbs beef brisket, of equal thickness | 4 slices bread, country-style | 1/2 cup dry sherry or 1/2 cup dry white wine | 1/2 cup white vinegar | 1 bunch fresh spinach leaves, washed and stemmed, soaked in cold water, drained, and chopped or 5 tablespoons thawed frozen chopped spinach | 1 package sliced fresh strawberries, well drained ( if using frozen, thaw first ) | 1/4 cup chopped fresh galangal or 1/4 cup fresh curry powder with garlic | 2 -3 whole dried bay leaves or 2 -3 whole thai basil leaves
instructions: Cut away any excess fat from the venison or beef and reserve as much fat as possible from the meat. Slice each piece into about 4 slices on a diagonal. Place the meat on a rack in a dutch oven or other deep pot or baking dish large enough to hold the meat in 1 layer and set aside. Bring the wine, vinegar, and some salt to a boil in a small saucepan. Return the meat to the dutch oven. Add the chopped or thawed spinach, cleaned or thawed frozen spinach, fresh or thawed frozen spinach and sliced fresh strawberries with the basil. Cover tightly and simmer on low heat for about 45 minutes or until the meat is fork tender. Uncover and boil for another 10 minutes or just until the spinach is wilted or tender. Remove the bay leaves. Remove the venison and beef slices to a plate. When cool enough to handle, slice into small pieces. Return the juices to the dutch oven with the cooking juices and simmer to reduce until thickened and syrupy, about 30 minutes. Taste for the seasonings and adjust. The more flavor the vinegar will absorb, the longer it takes to boil. Remove from the heat and cool to room temperature or warm slightly. Note, you may use a mixture of the following for marinating the venison and beef. A cup of sherry makes a lovely gravy, 1/4 cup water, 1/3 cup red wine, 1/4 cup lemon juice, and a few dashes of curry powder/chile paste. Add the venison and beef to the gravy and cook on low heat for 10 minutes. Remove the basil leaves from the gravy. Note, you may also use beef or beans instead of the spinach. This would allow the flavors to meld together more. If you're a vegans, i have suggested using bacon instead of the bacon.

title: Pasta Fagioli with Apple
ingredients: 1 lb rigatoni pasta ( preferably multigrain ) | 1 lb apple, peeled and thinly sliced ( i prefer a medium apple, such as a mcintosh variety ) | 8 slices bacon, cut into 1/2-inch pieces
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook until al dente, about 7 to 10 minutes. Meanwhile, in another pot of salted water, boil apple slices for about 5 minutes. When ready, drain pasta, reserving 1 cup of the cooking liquid.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,almond paste,cucumber,mascarpone,cumin,chicken breast,chinese red vinegar,sunflower oil
title: Chinese Spiced Chicken Salad
ingredients: 3/4 cup sunflower oil | 1/4 cup chinese red vinegar | 1/4 cup peanut oil | 4 tablespoons mascarpone, or more for garnish | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cumin | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 cucumber, seeded | 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts | 1 jar sunflower oil, or as needed, for brushing | 1/4 cup almond paste
instructions: Whisk 3/4 cup sunflower and chinese red vinegar together in a bowl.

title: Mustard Couscous With Whole Wheat
ingredients: 2 cups whole wheat couscous | 2 teaspoons mustard powder
instructions: Heat 1 1/2 cups water and 2 tspn mustard powder to boiling in small, nonstick skillet. Remove from heat.

title: Clams and Fruit Sandwich
ingredients: 2 pork chops, each 5 x 3 inches in diameter | 2 tablespoons mixed candied fruit, chopped | 1 can baby clams, drained | 1/2 cup cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Heat the grill pan at medium heat. Season each chop with salt and pepper and grill till golden brown on both sides. Remove from the heat. Mix the candied fruit with the clams and spread over each cutlet. Sprinkle grated cheese over the top.

title: Wild Rice With a Twist
ingredients: 1/2 cup wild rice | 1/2 cup drained canned chickpeas | 1 tablespoon grated orange rind
instructions: Rinse wild rice. Put rice, chickpeas and orange rind in a baking dish with cover and bake at 350°f for 45 minutes. Remove from oven and top with fresh whipped cream. Serve warm.

title: Blueberry Burgers
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 1 cup fresh blueberries | 1 thyme sprig
instructions: Combine hamburger, crumbles, and blueberries. Gently mix with hands so as not to break up meat into crumbles. Mold into 6 patties.

Random Ingredients: italian flat leaf parsley,kosher salt,kielbasa,beef brisket,tomato paste,thyme,farfalle pasta
title: Kielbasa and Tomatoes With Farfalle
ingredients: 3 lbs italian flat leaf parsley | 3 lbs kosher salt | 1 1/2 lbs kielbasa, 1 1/2x1-inch | 6 lbs kielbasa, 1 1/2x1 1/2-inch and 1 1/2-inch deep, cut lengthwise into 2-inch slices | 1 1/2 lbs tomatoes with basil, peeled, cored and cut lengthwise into 2-inch-wide wedges | 2 tablespoons tomato paste | 2 tablespoons dried thyme, crushed | 1 lb uncooked farfalle pasta
instructions: Cover the parsley with cold water and let sit until softened, then drain well. Cut 2 1/2x 1 2/3 inch lengths out of the parsley and set them aside. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. While the water is coming to a boil, season the kielbasa and tomatoes with 1/2 teaspoon salt and set them aside. When the water comes to a boil, add the kielbasa and tomatoes and return to a boil. Cook, uncovered, skimming from the top occasionally, until the kielbasa is cooked to your liking, 12 to 15 minutes. Drain the kielbasa and tomatoes well, and return them to the pot. Toss in the basil, the parsley, salt, kielbasa and tomatoes. Stir all together and cook until the sauce is slightly thickened, about 10 to 12 minutes. Add the crushed thyme and simmer uncovered until the flavors are blended, about 2 minutes. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add the farfalle and cook, covered, until tender, about 9 minutes. Drain the farfalle into a colander and rinse with cold water. Remove the casing and transfer to a platter or individual serving dishes if they have one. Garnish with the parsley. Serve the kielbasa and tomatoes with the pasta.

title: Pea, Garlic and Parsley-Chive Penne
ingredients: 1 head butter lettuces ( the large leaves ) | 2 boxes penne | 1/2 cup fresh peas and carrot, cooked | 1 clove garlic, crushed | 2 teaspoons snipped fresh chives | 1 tablespoon brandy or 1 tablespoon rum, to serve | 5 leaves fresh butter lettuce
instructions: Cut the cooked noodles into 5 even sized pieces. In a large pan place all the above ingredients, except the butter and the greens, together with the butter and boil for 8 minutes until the vegetables are soft. Add the drained noodles to the pan and mix in over a heat until they're heated through. Place in serving bowls. Random Ingredients: poblano chile,ginger garlic paste,taco seasoning mix

Place the sausages in the pan with the potatoes and cook for 40 minutes or until the potatoes become tender, basting every 10 minutes.

ingredients: 3 tablespoons olive oil | 1/2 cup chopped leek, white and light green parts only | 250 g ground lean pork sausage | 1 packet taco seasoning mix | 1 tablespoon ketchup, sweet | 1 tablespoon dry thyme sprigs | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 2 teaspoons white truffle oil

instructions: Preheat oven to 425°. Line baking sheet with waxed paper. Remove asparagus from pods, leaving 1/4 2/3/3 to 1 cup of liquid in shell. instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f place onions in a baking dish. Pour 1 1/2 cups of mayonnaise onto onions. Top with bread slices. Bake at 400°f for 12 - 15 minutes or until lightly toasted.

title: Gramma's Scalloped Lettuce and Salad

instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Line a 4 quart baking dish with aluminum foil, and spray with nonstick cooking spray. Toss the greens with as much salt as possible. instructions: Place ginger into food processor.

instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Toss cabbage with 4 tablespoons cold water. Place in a large oven proof bowl, tossing to coat. Sprinkle evenly with feta. Bake for about ten minutes or until tender. Pour tomato juice over cabbages. Serve warm.

title: Chili-Cheese Fondue
ingredients: 1 cup vegetable stock or 1 cup chicken stock | 1/2 cup finely chopped green onion | 1/2 cup finely chopped fresh mozzarella cheese | 1 tablespoon finely chopped red chili powder | 2 tablespoons lima beans ( optional )
instructions: If using broth in a saucepan, boil stock until dissolved. Add remaining ingredients, except lima beans, and heat through. Serve with garlic bread and a green vegetable for dipping.

title: Wasabi Caramel Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup whipping cream | 3 tablespoons wasabi paste
instructions: Put whipping cream and wasabi paste in a saucepan and mix with a spoon until blended. Heat until cream begins to simmer, then remove from heat. Cover and refrigerate sauce to allow flavors to meld. Bring to room temperature before serving.

title: Grilled Pig (Sausages) in Spinach
ingredients: 2 -3 links country-style pork sausages | 1/2 cup fresh baby spinach | 1 can baked beans
instructions: Cook sausages according to package directions, but omit the fat and only the grease. Meanwhile cut sausage into 1/2 inch thick slices. Remove leaves from spinach, cut in half and set aside. Heat up a grill pan or skillet. Add sausages and grill one minute per side. The fat should render and the sausages should brown around the skillet. Add the spinach leaves, making sure they are wilted and evenly distributed. Cover and cook an additional 2 - 3 minutes, making sure nothing is sticking together. Turn over onto a warm platter and serve. Note, for those with a budget, such as myself i use turkey sausage and tear off a bit of the raw bacon, then use the leftover sausage meat as in the recipe.

Random Ingredients: pecan,spanish onion,black sesame seed,crisco,extra virgin olive oil,salsa
title: Salsa Dip #RSC
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped spanish onion | 2 tablespoons finely chopped pecans | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 2 tablespoons finely chopped pecans, unsalted and toasted | 2 tablespoons black sesame seeds | 1/4 - 1/2 cup salsa | 1/4 teaspoon crisco, to taste
instructions: In medium mixing bowl, combine diced onion and 1/2 cup of the pecan kernels. Add olive oil and combine to make a paste like texture for serving. Mix in the remaining half cup of pecans, remaining cumin, black sesame seeds, 2 tablespoon of the salsa and mix with the salsa. Refrigerate at least an hour before serving.

title: Beef Shank Grilled Spring Rolls
ingredients: 2 fresh beef shank, trimmed | 1 small bok choy, chopped | 250 g blackberries, quartered | 1 small ladyfinger, sliced | 80 g halloumi cheese, cubed | 1 tablespoon chopped chives | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar | freshly ground blackberry ( to garnish )
instructions: Trim any excess fat from the meat and discard the trimmings. Put the meat in a pan with enough water to just cover the meat. Bring to the boil over high heat, then cover, reduce the heat to medium and simmer, stirring occasionally, for 20 minutes. Remove from pan. Place bok choy in a pan of boiling water. Remove cover, reduce heat to medium and simmer, stirring occasionally, for about 15 minutes or until just tender. Drain leaves from bok choy and reserve. Tear off the top 3 inches of bok choy root with kitchen shears. Cut roots off to within 1 to 2cm of root end. Blanch for 5 minutes, remove and set aside. Drain blackberries and reserve juice. Slice cooked beef thinly. Place bok choy leaves and blackberries in a large bowl. Toss all together and place on tray to drain juices. Place cheese in the centre of a roll. Place sliced meat on top of cheese. Top with bok choy mixture. Sprinkle with sifted black pepper to taste.

Random Ingredients: pesto sauce,red pepper flake,coconut oil,romano cheese,scallion,black bean,chinese vegetable
title: Caribbean Fried Beans
ingredients: 1 tablespoon coconut oil | 4 1/2 - 5 cups cooked chinese vegetables, such as zucchini, zucchini and or onion, cut into small bits ( like sirlocino or chinese cabbage ) | 8 ounces red beans, rinsed and drained | 2 tablespoons grated romano cheese | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce | 2 tablespoons chopped scallions | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Heat oil in small skillet over medium heat. Add vegetables and cook until just tender. Stir in beans and toss to evenly coat. Add cheese, pesto, scallions and crushed red pepper.

title: Linda's Chili Spaghetti
ingredients: spaghetti | chili powder ( optional )
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions. Add a few tblsps water or chili powder to the spaghetti sauce to make it a little spicier. Serve.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder,oregano,sirloin steak,lobster tail,chicken breast half,lemon zest
title: Sirloin Steak Roll-Ups
ingredients: 4 boneless, skinless pork shoulder | 2 boneless chicken breast halves, thinly sliced | 3/4 cup chopped fresh oregano | 1/2 lemon, zest of | 1/4 cup chopped fresh oregano | 1 lb boneless sirloin steak, cut crosswise into 8 thin slices | 2 lobster tails
instructions: Cut each pork shoulder crosswise into 1/4 slices. Combine all ingredients and let stand at room temperature 10 minutes or place in refrigerator overnight, turning occasionally. Arrange pork slices on waxed paper. Wrap each slice with a few pieces of lobster tail meat. Place in shallow roasting pan. Marinate at least 6 hours in refrigerator.. Preheat oven to 400°f heat oven to 400 f. Cook pork, uncovered, until just cooked through and almost completely browned and no pink remains, about 20 - 25 minutes. Serve with remaining marinade.

title: Spaghetti Con Spicy Filling
ingredients: 2 pounds filling | 2 packages spaghetti
instructions: Put filling into a plastic funnel and freeze overnight at room temperature. Filling should be easy to handle and easy to handle. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Grease a 9 x 13 inch baking dish. When the filling mixture is frozen, thaw. Using an electric mixer, cut the filling into strips about as wide as your fingers. Drain the pasta and transfer to the prepared baking dish. Use a spoon or pastry brush to fill the pasta with the filling mixture. Sprinkle with the sea salt on top. Bake the pasta in the preheated water, stirring occasionally, until the pasta is tender and the filling is hot and bubbly, about 30 minutes.

title: Chile Con Carne
ingredients: 1 can condensed tomato soup | tortilla, cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 1 dash onion powder | salt and pepper
instructions: Place tortilla chips in a pan and place in oven. Heat for about 20 - 30 minutes. Then add tomato soup and sprinkle with onion powder. Cook and serve.

title: Chicken and Pasta Salad
ingredients: 12 ounces chicken | 12 ounces farfalle pasta ( bowtie ) | 1 can diced tomatoes with juice | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/2 orange, zest of, finely grated
instructions: Boil the pasta and drain. Chop up the chicken. Prepare the dressing, combine the mayonnaise and mustard powder, and add the orange rind. Pour the dressing over and mix well. Add the pasta and chicken. Toss, and serve.

title: Pesto for Chips
ingredients: 200 g pesto ( or use pesto sauce ) | 3 poblano peppers | 2 slices pepperoni
instructions: Place poblano peppers on oven tray. Slice pepperoni into strips. Grill pepperoni until crispy. You could also use pepperoni in place of pepperoni in the sauce. Use pesto sauce. Add more pepperoni if desired.

title: French Onion Spaghetti
ingredients: 3 1/2 packages spaghetti sauce | 3 3/4 cups frozen french-fried onions ( cut up frozen- )
instructions: In a 3 quart pan, combine all ingredients and mix thoroughly. Cover and bake at 400 degrees for 10 minutes. Take out of oven and let stand for 5 minutes. Spoon into hot, preheated bowls and top with parmesan cheese or other desired topping.

Random Ingredients: irish whiskey,kiwi fruit,chili powder,topping,nutritional yeast,tabasco sauce,wheat bread crumb,kielbasa sausage
title: Kielbasa & Kiwi Stuffed Kiwi Balls
ingredients: 1 package kielbasa sausage, casing removed ( kielbasa sausage ) | 1 tablespoon extra light olive oil or 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 tablespoon chili powder ( or to taste ) | 3 cans whipped topping, divided | 2 kiwi fruits, peeled, halved, cut in chunks | 1 can original tatsoi sauce, undiluted | 1 1/2 cups whole wheat bread crumbs ( plain or flavored ) | 1 tablespoon nutritional yeast ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Lightly grease a large baking pan. Cut kielbasa meat diagonally into halves to fit on pan. Cut kielbasa meat crosswise into ¾ inch thick slices. Pour any remaining oil over kielbasa slices. Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add chili powder, 2 tablespoons whipped topping, and cook, stirring constantly, until the topping is toasted and kielbasa is just lightly browned. Spread kielbasa mixture in prepared baking pan. Top with remaining whipped topping. In a large bowl, mix tatsoi, bread crumbs, nutritional yeast and remaining 3 tablespoons of whipped topping. Spread in a single layer over top of kielbasa. With a tablespoon, carefully scoop up kielbasa meat from kielbasa, letting excess fat fall onto kielbasa. Place onto baking sheet coated with cooking spray. Bake at 375°f for about 40–45 minutes. Cut into halves at a slight angle, but do not remove side of pan to serve.

title: Feta Spread
ingredients: 1 package feta, crumbled | 1/2 cup chilled black coffee | 2 tablespoons basil pesto
instructions: Place feta in a small bowl and mash with a fork. Add remaining ingredients and mix well.

Random Ingredients: orange juice zest,pork shoulder,white wine vinegar,poblano chile,cream tartar,serrano pepper,balsamic vinegar,baking powder
title: Pork Carnitas
ingredients: 1 medium poblano chile, seeded and chopped | 1/3 cup orange juice, fresh juice and zest of, from 2 medium oranges | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons baking powder | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 4 1/2 lbs boneless pork shoulder, cut crosswise into 1/2-inch thick slices ( or use more fat and ask your butcher to do the work ) | 1 small serrano peppers or 1 small jalapeno, stemmed and seeded
instructions: In a heavy, very large noncorrosive pot, combine the poblano and orange zest, vinegar, baking powder and season with the cream of tartar and the pinch of the heavy cream. Mix so that the ingredients are completely blended and there are no lumps. Gradually add the pork in a single layer, working in batches, placing them in the mixture one at a time if they are crowded. Cover the pot and simmer over medium low heat until pork is almost completely tender, about 3 hours. Season pork with salt and stir to redistribute the drippings. Let cool. When pork is cool enough to handle, shred it with 2 forks. Return to the liquid the pork was cooked in and stir in all remaining ingredients. Cook pork for 1 hour and 15 minutes longer, stirring occasionally, until the pork is very tender. Serve with rice, refried beans, and guacamole.

Random Ingredients: dijon mustard,ra el hanout spice mix,mint
title: Mint Mustard
ingredients: 300 g dijon mustard | 1 cup mint | 1/4 cup dried ra el hanout spice mix
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together until well blended. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: tomato,rice wine,tamari,caster sugar,habanero pepper,kaffir lime leaf
title: Tomato Soup
ingredients: 2 -3 tablespoons rice wine ( optional ) | 5 kaffir lime leaves ( optional ) or 5 basil leaves ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon tamari | 2 -3 crushed tomatoes | 1 -2 teaspoon caster sugar or 1 -2 teaspoon superfine sugar | 1 habanero pepper, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Using the skewer, cut or rip the tomato or chilli leaves in half or quarters and mix with the tamari, sugar or superfine sugar. If using lime leaves, soak the slices in water for five minutes so they're flexible. Grind them finely using a pestle or a sharp knife. Alternatively, you can grind a little fresh lime or basil leaves. In a small saucepan, combine the tomato/lime/lactar/basil/nam pla and sugar and bring to the boil. Cook for five minutes and then add the habanero. Taste and adjust seasoning. To serve, spoon into bowls and pour over the lime broth.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder roast,vegetable,apple,cilantro leaf,lemon juice zest
title: Spiced Crock Pot Pork Roast - Crock Pot
ingredients: 1/4 cup fresh cilantro leaves, chopped | 3 medium apples, pared, cored and chopped into 1/2 inch cubes | 1 1/2 lbs pork shoulder roast | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | vegetable ( optional )
instructions: Place cilantro leaves along bottom of crock pot, scraping the browned bits from the crock pot with a sharp chef's knife. Add the apples, and sprinkle with lemon zest and juice. If you like, you can sprinkle with cilantro before adding meat. Place pork shoulder roast over apples, and season with salt and pepper to taste and place lid on crock pot. Cook on low for 8 - 10 hours, or overnight, or in the pressure cooker set to high for at least 1 hour. The meat should be tender and shred easily by the end. Using a slotted spoon, remove meat meat to serving dish and cover to keep warm. Allow juices to reduce slightly.

title: Lemon & Bleu Cheese Fajitas
ingredients: 1 lb deli honey-roasted kaselestein blue cheese ( or other good soft cheese ) | cracked lemon | heavy cream | kaiser ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees or 200 degrees c. Divide dough into 8 equal pieces. Spread on a cookie sheet and bake at 400 degrees for 10 - 15 minutes. Remove from oven and roll each piece flat and stretch into a long roll and slice diagonally into 1/4 inch strips. Set aside and roll each strip on a cutting board or other flat surface into a small flat, flat sandwich. Repeat with every strip or until all of the dough has been transformed into a long roll that will stick to your board. Slice each sandwich into 1/4 inch wide and 3 inch long pieces. Heat a grill pan or a skillet over medium heat until good and hot. Put blue cheese onto pan or skillet and spread out into an even layer. Place onto the grill until golden on one side and turn on the other side. Serve immediately on top of warmed chips or serve with your favorite toppings such as salsa, guacamole, sour cream, avocados or guacamole.

Random Ingredients: hard egg,chicken thigh,italian salad dressing,farfalle pasta,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Bowhead Potato Chicken Salad
ingredients: 2 -10 ounces boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut into thin strips | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 container wishbone® house foods dressing | 1 hard-boiled egg, sliced into wedges | 1 package farfalle pasta ( bowtie ), cooked and drained
instructions: Spray baking sheet with cooking spray, then place the chicken strips into the baking sheet so they are slightly overlapping. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours and up to 8 hours, tossing the meat a few times during that time. Heat oven to 450 degrees. Combine the dressing and egg in a small saucepan, and add just enough water to cover the bottom of the saucepan. Bring to a boil, but do not boil. Remove from heat. Drain the cooked bowhead, then place in a large bowl with chicken mixture. Toss lightly to coat with dressing mixture. Place in oven. Bake 10 minutes, or until bubbly and lightly browned. Serve, sprinkling with sliced egg wedges.

title: Sea Bass With Honey and Hazelnuts
ingredients: 1 sea bass fillet | 1 head garlic, crushed | 150 g hazelnuts, roughly chopped | 50 g raisins | 50 g fresh mint leaves | 75 g leeks, sliced | 1 teaspoon fine sugar | 2 tablespoons vinegar
instructions: Cut the tail off the sea bass fillet and leave it on a chopping board with the meat attached. Slice the meat from the bones as if you were cutting it for meatless entree. Place all of the ingredients, except the fish, in a large saucepan and bring to the boil, then simmer for 10 minutes. Add the fish and simmer until the fish flakes easily with the fork, then strain the stock. Return the fish to the saucepan and keep warm. Keep the sauce warm. Preheat the oven to 180°c. Arrange the strips on a tray, top with the honey and roast in the oven for 10 – 15 minutes. Remove from the oven and sprinkle the fish with the hazelnuts and raisins, and return to the oven for a few minutes more to dry them out. Serve on warmed serving plates with a drizzle of the sauce.

title: Spanish Pork
ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil | 3 lbs pork, cut into 1/2 inch wide strips | 2 tablespoons molasses | 6 tablespoons lemon juice, fresh is best | 5 lemons, sliced
instructions: Brown the pork in the olive oil. Add molasses, lemon juice and zest, bring to simmer and cook 5 minutes. Serve over white rice.

title: Lamb & Cashew Stuffed Fish
ingredients: 5 white fish fillets | 150 g ground cashews | 1 egg | 1 lemon, zest of | 1 orange, zest of | 1 breadcrumb, crushed | 1/2 cup dried breadcrumbs, extra
instructions: Preheat oven to 165°c. Put the muslin, zest and a little milk or water in a bowl, season to taste and set aside. Cut a 1/2 deep slit in the fillets, each side slightly to one side. Place both fillets under a hot grill and cook until golden. Leave on one side, but make sure you spray the cooking pan with oil. Put the nuts in a food processor with egg, lemon zest and orange zest. Add the breadcrumbs and process until they are mixed in and the mixture becomes a paste. Take off the heat and spoon the stuffing into the cooked fillets. Spray the pan again and bake the fish for 15 to 20 minutes, turning them over once or twice, depending on the thickness. Remove from the oven and top with the extra crumbs. Serve with salad and seasonal greens.

Random Ingredients: orange bell pepper,dark sesame oil,chipotle powder,lemon,rice cereal,italian breadcrumb,papaya
title: Crispy Chipotle Pops
ingredients: 1 lime | 1 orange bell pepper, sliced into thin circles | 1/2 cup crispy rice cereal ( such as rice krispies ) | 1/2 tablespoon sweet papaya ( chopped into a thin patty ) | 1/2 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 2 teaspoons crushed chipotle powder | 1/2 teaspoon sweetened italian seasoned breadcrumbs ( such as splenda )
instructions: Wash and dry the lime and orange pepper, then peel, then cut each into thin strips. In a small bowl, mash the chips with a fork or a pestle and mortar to mix. Toss together the shredded lime and orange pepper strips, crispy rice cereal or crisp papaya, sesame oil, chipotle powder and bread crumbs in a large bowl. Spoon into the pepper mixture and coat well. Arrange on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake in a preheated 450f oven for approximately 10 minutes, or until crispy and lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder,apple cider vinegar,italian parsley,heavy cream,apricot jam,muenster cheese
title: Pork Cordon Bleu
ingredients: 2 2 lbs pork shoulder or 2 lbs veal shoulder | 1 1/2 cups apricot jam | 1 1/2 cups apple cider vinegar | 3/4 cup heavy cream | 1/2 lb gruyere cheese, grated ( about 3/4 cup ) | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh italian parsley
instructions: Cut the meat into 1 inch cubes about 1/3 inch thick. Place in large heavy skillet over moderately low heat and pour in enough water to cover. Simmer covered, stirring frequently, until meat is tender about 1/2 hour. Drain and reserve 2 1/2 cups liquid. Return 1 1/2 cups reserved liquid to skillet. Heat remaining ingredients over low heat, covered, stirring occasionally, until cheese melts, about 5 minutes. Ladle sauce over meat.

title: Sizzlin' Hot Chocolate
ingredients: 2/3 cup canola oil | 1/8 cup grand marnier | 1/4 cup cocoa powder ( or less to taste ) | 5 -6 garlic-flavored croutons
instructions: Combine oil, grand marnier, cocoa, and garlic in a sauce pan. Cook until heated through. Add croutons just before serving.

Random Ingredients: pesto sauce,mace,walnut,baby bok choy,ice cube,basil,coriander powder,white vinegar
title: Grilled Berok Choy (Shoyu) Salad
ingredients: 1/3 cup white vinegar ( or 1/4 cup white wine vinegar, or use 1/4 cup white sugar ) | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder | 2 teaspoons dried basil | 1 teaspoon dried crushed mace ( or more, to taste ) | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce | 4 baby bok choy, tough ends removed, cleaned | 1/2 cup chopped walnuts ( or other nuts/optional ) | 1/2 cup chopped fresh basil ( optional )
instructions: Combine vinegar, coriander, 1/2 tbls. Of the basil and the mace in a bowl. Set aside. Rinse bok choy and cut away root and any tough outer leaf with a serrated knife. Cut bok choy in half lengthwise and remove stalk. Cut crosswise into 4 wedges. Repeat on other side of cut stems and leaves. Toss with remaining basil and pesto. Grill bok choy over medium heat until tender, about 5 - 10 minutes or until heated through. To serve, pile bok choy on salad plate, garnish with remaining pesto.

title: Baked Penne Potato Casserole
ingredients: 1 large baking potato, peeled and cut in slices | 1 package penne pasta | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly grease a 2 quart baking dish. In a large bowl, mix potatoes, penne pasta, garlic powder, and turmeric. Spread mixture into prepared baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven for 1 hour. Do not overcook.

title: Beer & Bacon (My Grandma's Recipe for Home Beer )
ingredients: 3 -4 ounces ale | 3 -4 ounces bicarbonate of soda | thyme
instructions: The night before, measure the beer and bacon into a pan with the thyme. Cover with boiling water. Put the lid on, reduce the heat and simmer for 5/8 hour. The bacon should be crisp and the bacon soft. At the end of the cooking time, check the salt content of the bacon to ensure it has been cooked, if it is still fairly dry, continue cooking. The bacon should be crispy on the outside but not completely dry. If it seems very dry, continue cooking, until all the liquid in the pan has been absorbed.

title: Garlic and Cod Fillets
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs cod fillets, skin removed | 1 teaspoon minced garlic | 1 cup fat-free half-and-half
instructions: Cook cod and garlic until done, about 15 minutes.

title: Asparagus and Mustard Pie
ingredients: 1 unbaked biscuit | 1 cup baby carrots | 3 tablespoons snipped parsley | 1 tablespoon snipped fresh asparagus | 1/4 cup snipped pecans | 1 1/2 cups tomato puree | 1 packet hidden valley original ranch dressing mix | 2 tablespoons dijon-style dry mustard powder | 1/2 cup sweetened flaked coconut
instructions: Preheat oven to 450f degrees. Line a 12x8 inch baking dish with parchment paper. Combine biscuit, carrots, parsley, asparagus, and pecans in a bowl. Pour in tomato puree, ranch dressing mix, and mustard powder.

Random Ingredients: thyme,chinese rice wine,milk,cheese sauce,chorizo sausage,cumin,soya sauce
title: Chorizo, Cheese Sauce and Chile Pepper Sausages
ingredients: 4 chorizo sausage, thawed | 1 teaspoon cumin | 1 1/2 teaspoons thyme, chopped | 1 cup tasty cheese sauce | 1 1/2 cups skim milk | 4 teaspoons chinese rice wine | 1/4 cup tasty cheese sauce ( see note ) | 1 tablespoon soya sauce ( see note )
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190c / 375°f. Put the chorizo, cumin, thyme and cheese sauces in a pie dish. In a small bowl, combine the milk and wine. Pour this over the cheese and chorizo. Cover the dish with foil and cook for 15 mins until the cheese is melted. To test, poke a chunk of cheese into a choclo. If it comes out a little cheesy, press it back into the choclo for a few mins to melt the cheese. Pour into a shallow serving dish and top with the sausages. Use the remaining cheese to dip sandwiches.

title: Fruity Beef Steak
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs of cut up steak | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar | 3 canned mixed candied fruit | 1 lb of chopped fish
instructions: Cut up the meat and make sure there are no pieces of fat on it. Put the meat into a pan, pour in the vinegar. Drain the fruit into the vinegar, and add the fish. Cook and stir until the meat is tender. Serve in a bowl with potatoes, with the remaining vinegar.

title:
Dumplings for a King.
