    -.
    -  Anglo-Ciltsuppe (Burgundy)
ingredients: 1 lb lean boneless pork shoulder, ground lean | 1 lb lump crabmeat, ground lean | 1/2 lb lean veal, ground lean | italian seasoning, dry and spicy | herbs, dried ( oregano, basil, rosemary, thyme ) | 1/2 small lemon peel, grated | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon cardamom, dried
instructions: Combine all ingredients together, roll into small balls with about 2 tablespoons meat mixture, each about 1 inch across and 2 inches in diameter. Cook in a large pot until lightly browned all the way through, about 10 minutes. Drain well, cool and store in your freezer.

title: Duck Confits
ingredients: 4 duck fat ( i use duck bones ) | 3 bottles burgundy wine
instructions: Wash duck fat, make sure they are dry. I usually take 1 duck fat and poke a hole lengthwise about two inches deep in the duck fat and push it right down right into hole. This will help the duck skin to float. Place duck fat into a roasting pan and bake at 325°f or 160°c until skin is brown, about 75 to 90 minutes. You can use the duck fat for pricking, just use more of the duck fat when pricking it, or it will smoke easily. Allow duck fat to cool about 20 minutes before carving. The duck fat can be smoked or you can use it for duck soup use for other things.

Random Ingredients: espresso powder,french bread,veal,white vinegar,tomato green chilies
title: Mexican Veal Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless veal ( i prefer a lean top ) | 2 teaspoons espresso powder | 1 cup chopped tomato with green chilies | 1 tablespoon white vinegar | 4 slices italian country bread
instructions: Cut veal in 1/4 slices. Dredge slices with espresso. Set aside. Arrange veal on a rack in a roasting pan. Pour 1 cup of any tomato with chiles and vinegar over the veal, cover loosely and roast in a 400°f oven for 40 minutes. Remove cover and continue roasting for 40 - 45 mins, basting every 15 minutes with remaining vinaigrette. Cooks note, for a very moist meat, add 1 tablespoon of cornstarch when stirred in with rest of vinaigrette.

title: Simple & Easy Chocolate Chip Chips
ingredients: 2 ounces baking chocolate | 2 tablespoons fresh cilantro, chopped | 2 teaspoons white pepper
instructions: Place baking chocolate in a medium bowl. Sprinkle with cilantro. Add white pepper. Roll chips in the mixture. Place in a single layer in a plastic bag or wrap and then refrigerate. Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes. Store in an air tight container.

Random Ingredients: parsley,curry powder,fenugreek seed,oriental sesame oil,roasting chicken
title: Fenugreek Chicken
ingredients: 3 1/2 lbs roasting chickens, cut into 8 pieces | 1 envelope dried fenugreek seeds | 1/2 cup chopped fresh parsley | 1 1/2 tablespoons curry powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons oriental sesame oil ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon coarsely crushed dried fenugreek seeds
instructions: In large plastic bag, combine fenugreek seeds, parsley, curry powder, and sesame oil. Add chicken, seal bag, and turn 5 times to coat. Refrigerate at least 4 hours and up to 2 days. Lightly oil grill. Remove chicken from bag, reserving marinade. Grill chicken 8 minutes on each side. Sprinkle with fenugreek and serve.

title: Cherry Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 24 cremini mushrooms | 2 tablespoons sour cherry flavored sweetener or 2 tablespoons cherry flavored liqueur | 6 large lettuce leaves
instructions: Clean and wash mushrooms. Place stems into the hollow of each mushroom. Mix sour cherry with sweetener in medium bowl. Set mushrooms upright so that sour cherry can reach top of mushrooms. Spoon cher mixture into mushroom caps to close the stems. You can also leave a bit of cherry to help extract flavor if desired.

Random Ingredients: belgian endive,white bean,puff pastry,buckwheat flour,salmon,vodka,watermelon,red chilies
title: Salmon & Fish Empanadas (Salmon & Melon)
ingredients: 500 g firm white fish fillets | 2 tablespoons vodka | 2 tablespoons boleti belgian endive | 200 g salmon | 6 small whole red chilies, finely diced | 150 g canned white beans, rinsed, drained, and chopped coarsely | 100 g puff pastry sheets, defrosted if frozen | boiling water, as needed | 1 tablespoon vodka
instructions: In medium non stick frying pan, combine oil and endive, then sear over low heat, turning once, until endives are golden brown and just tender. Remove from pan and place on plate and keep warm. Season fish fillets with salt and pepper and place in a shallow dish. Add 1/2 teaspoon vodka to oil in pan and brown fillets on both sides. Remove fillets from pan and cover with foil. Place fish in oven and bake in oven at 180°c for about 8 minutes to warm. Remove from oven and turn oven off. Add remaining vodka to oil in pan, deglaze, then add chopped chillies and cook for about 1 - 2 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove chili mixture from heat. Cut fillet into small, bite size pieces and place in a bowl with cooked white beans, mix in a spoonful of warm sauce. Place on plate and serve with a splash of vodka, or drizzle over a spoon of vodka and garnish with chopped chillies.

title: Chocolate, Tomato and Swiss Cheese Casserole
ingredients: 2 lbs swiss cheese, shredded | 12 ounces tomatoes ( medium ) | 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 2 cups part-skim mozzarella cheese
instructions: Mix the swiss cheese and tomatoes together. Spray your 9x13 dish with pam. Arrange the swiss cheese, tomatoes and cocoa in layers over the top of the swiss cheese. Sprinkle the mozzarella on top of this layer. Bake in a 350 degree oven for 30 minutes.

title: Frosted Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb italian cheese, grated ( use cheddar if you wish ) | 1 cup orange juice | 3 tablespoons fresh chervil | 1/2 teaspoon mixed allspice
instructions: Combine in a bowl with the orange juice, chervil & allspice. Tear into small pieces & coat cheese lightly with this mixture. Freeze for a minimum of 1 hour, but a longer storage space will keep well for upto 2 months, otherwise wait till ready to use for freezing.

title: Curry Relish Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup cucumber relish | 1/2 cup orange juice
instructions: Blend everything together. Enjoy and enjoy.

title: Grilled Beef Burger
ingredients: 1 teaspoon chipotle chile | 1 teaspoon clove | 1 boneless sirloin steak, 1 inch thick, 4 slices | 2/3 cup fresh green beans, sliced into 4 pieces | sirloin steak, 3/4 inch thick, 4 slices | chopped parsnip, 1 ripe plantain, 3/4 inch thick, peeled, and cut into 24 pieces | cooked pasta or rice
instructions: Prepare grill. Place peppers in a zip lock bag.

title: Zucchini & Mushrooms
ingredients: 3 zucchini, sliced | 1 jar sliced mushrooms | 4 teaspoons pimientos, drained ( optional )
instructions: In large skillet, place zucchini, mushrooms and pimiento if using. Cover and saute, stirring occasionall, until vegetables are tender and zucchini is just done.

title: Ginger-Amaretti Mousse With Amaretti & Amaretto
ingredients: 2 packages amaretti cookies, broken into pieces | 1/3 cup fresh ginger juice | 3 1/2 tablespoons amaretti-piroto white wine
instructions: Place biscuits in a glass or plastic bowl. Cover with ginger juice, pouring amaretti into a strainer lined with cheese cloth. Rinse the bowl dry with cold water and squeeze over biscuits until liquid is clear. Press biscotti into the wine.

title: Fish Bake
ingredients: 2 lbs of cut firm fleshed fish, 1-inch cubes | 1 head red cabbage or 1 head green cabbage | 2 tablespoons zesty italian seasoning | 1 bottle fusion liqueur | 8 cups hot steamed rice
instructions: In large mixing bowl, add fish cubes, zesty italian seasoning, rice then cabbage. Mix well and let marinate in refrigerator for 4 to 8 hours. Remove fish and veggies from refrigerator. Pour liqueur over cabbage and stir well. Line a 9x13 baking dish with foil that will hold the cabbage tightly and foil. Place fish, vegetables and liquid in pan in layers. Cover with foil. Bake @350 degrees for 35 minutes or until fish is done and veggies are tender. Take foil off and bake another 10 minutes or until fish is done. Garnish with cilantro or parsley.

Random Ingredients: porcini mushroom,butter,seasoning salt,white pearl onion,yellow pepper,cardamom seed,cilantro leaf,fava bean
title: Fava Bean and Peppers Curry (Baked)
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried fava beans, about 1 1/2 cups rinsed and finely chopped | 1/2 cup dried white pearl onions, about 1 1/2 cups | 1/2 cup unsalted butter, melted | 2/3 cup finely chopped yellow sweet pepper ( i use a mixture of red and green ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom seed | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 cup minced fresh cilantro leaves | 1 teaspoon grated dried porcini mushrooms ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. Combine the fava beans and chopped yellow sweet pepper in a bowl. Stir in the butter, chopped sweet pepper and all of the cardamom seeds. Stir in the seasoning salt. Spoon into a lightly buttered 8x8 baking dish. Sprinkle with the cilantro. Bake for 25 minutes until bubbling and hot. Let stand for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Quick Basil Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1/4 cup strong coffee | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 2 teaspoons liquid smoke | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 12 cherry tomatoes or 14 grape tomatoes
instructions: Combine all ingredients and whisk well. Pour into a salad bowl and serve.

Random Ingredients: cooking oil,cod,orange zest,confectioner ' sugar,vanilla bean,bamboo shoot
title: Bamboo Shoot Fritters
ingredients: 1/4 cup chopped bamboo shoot | 1/4 cup chopped canned fresh bean curd or canned cannellini beans | 1/2 teaspoon orange zest | 1/2 vanilla bean, halved, seeds scraped, peeled, and scraped | 4 tablespoons cooking oil | 3/4 teaspoon confectioners'sugar
instructions: In a blender, combine the sprouts, bean curd and zest. Blend until the bean curd is completely liquefied. Heat the oil in a nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add the bean mixture, reduce the heat to low and cook, stirring, until the mixture is slightly thickened. Stir in the confectioners' sugar and cook, stirring, until the fritters are hot through and creamy.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf italian parsley,water,mexican chili powder,porcini mushroom,chunky salsa,lemon juice zest,olive
title: Lebanese Mushroom Soup
ingredients:
1 tablespoon dried porcini mushrooms | 2 fresh lemon juice, zest of | 1 tablespoon mexican chili powder | 3 cups water | 1/2 cup thick chunky salsa ( your preferred brand ) | 4 cups thickly slice mushrooms ( i like the fresh mushrooms, but you can sub dried white mushrooms if desired, i just use my homemade ones.
    - or you can use jarred italian mushrooms ) | 20 olives, sliced or 15 olives in oil | 1 -2 tablespoon flat dried italian parsley
instructions: Place dried mushrooms in pan, stir, cover and let sit 5 minutes. Drain the mushrooms, reserving any liquid, and press through a strainer into a bowl, discarding the mushroom liquid. Squeeze the mushrooms dry and finely chop. Discard any liquid that has collected in the mushrooms. Add lemon zest, chili powder, and water to the food processor and pulse until the soup reaches desired consistency, about 1 minute. Place mushrooms in a large saucepan, add sauteed mushrooms, salsa, and olives, and mix well. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium low and simmer 20 minutes until the flavors are blended, adding water as needed to get desired consistency. Remove from heat and blend in parsley. Discard lemon rind and serve garnished with sliced fresh olives, if desired.

Random Ingredients: meatball,large shrimp,salt black pepper,olive oil,chicken stock cube
title: Greek Garlic & Shrimp Meatballs Soup
ingredients: 2 lbs large shrimp, peeled & tails on | 1 chicken stock cube | 1 -2 tablespoon extra-virgin olive oil | 4 meatballs, finely cubed | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Remove and discard the heads & shells from the shrimp. Cut the shrimp into 1 1/2 inch cubes, then transfer to a large, non metallic bowl or stock pot. Add just enough water to cover them & the stock cubes, then place the pot on the stove & bring to a gentle boil over a high heat. Strain & return the shrimp shells and shells from the shrimp stock. Return some of the shrimp shells to the shrimp stock & return the reserved heads & shells to the pan. Return the soup back to the boil. Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 190c/375f/gas mark 4 & line two oven trays with baking parchment. Heat the olive oil in a small frying pan over a medium heat & gently fry the meatballs until they are lightly browned. Stir up the meatball and transfer to the soup bowl. Season with salt and pepper, then return the soup to the boil again. Transfer to the oven & bake for about 30 minutes or until the meatballs are cooked through & the broth thickens a little. Serve immediately.

title: Gnocchi Con Piselli (Baked Beans and Gnocchi)
ingredients: 4 cups vegetarian baked beans | 12 ounces gnocchi | 1 cup diced tomatoes, seeded | 3/4 lb fettuccine
instructions: Preheat oven to 350° and butter a 2 qt baking dish. Place the baked beans in an oven proof skillet. Bake the beans for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, toss gnocchi with the tomato and remaining ingredients until well mixed. Pour the gnocchi into the baking dish with the baked beans. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes on the middle rack of the oven.

title: Dolma Dukkaka
ingredients: 1 kg ground chuck | 1 large leek, finely chopped | 3 slices canadian bacon, finely chopped | 1/2 cup canadian pine nuts | 2 fresh curry leaves | 2 tablespoons pine nuts, toasted
instructions: Add the ground chuck, chopped leek and canadian bacon to a large bowl and mix lightly. Stir in the pine nuts and curry leaves. The mixture will be fine and moist. Form into balls and shape into patties. Place in a lightly oiled, shallow baking dish. If you're using individual dolma dukkaka cakes, make sure all the meat mixture is used to divide the mixture among the dukkaka cakes. To store, wrap each with plastic wrap and place on a plate or tray lined with foil. Refrigerate for 20 minutes before cooking over a medium heat in a preheated oven. Note for vegetarians, you can substitute lamb for the ground beef if you want.

title: Artichoke Hearts in Peppercorn Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs ground veal | 4 artichoke hearts | 1 1/4 cups whole wheat pastry flour | 6 tablespoons green peppercorns
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Mix the veal, peas & artichokes together. Place the flour in a plastic bag add the water and shake to mix. Add the spice mixture and shake till well mixed. Transfer to a greased bread tin. Place in oven for 15 minutes. Remove from oven and allow to cool. Cut into small squares.

title: Leek and Ancho Tea With Thyme
ingredients: 4 ounces leeks | 4 ounces leeks with tops | 4 ancho chiles, seeded | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried thyme leaves | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon wedges
instructions: Blanch the leeks in boiling water for 2 minutes. Immediately drain. Wearing a skimmer or a strong kitchen towel, split the leeks lengthwise and crosswise. Slice the leeks lengthwise. Toss with chiles, thyme and lemon wedges. Makes about 1 1/4 cups tea.

Random Ingredients: chili powder,egg yolk,sugar syrup,mayonnaise,ajinomoto,dark brown sugar
title: Ajinomoto Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 egg yolk | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar | 1/2 cup mayonnaise ( low-fat or gluten-free ) | 1 dash hot chili powder | 1 - 1 1/4 teaspoon ajinomoto ( if you use soy sauce use less ) | 1/4 cup sugar syrup
instructions: Mix ingredients together very well. Refrigerate for several hours to develop flavors.

Random Ingredients: white grape juice,apple juice,heavy cream,cashew,pumpkin,quinoa,ginger ale
title: Fruit and Quinoa Pudding
ingredients: 2 cups white grape juice | 4 cups apple juice | 1/2 cup orange grape juice | 1/2 cup sugar | 1/4 cup cashews | 1/4 cup dried pumpkin | 1 liter orange and quinoa ( i prefer white ) | 1 liter heavy cream
instructions: Chop nuts and seeds from grapes and add to juice. Add spices and sugar to rest. Cook on low heat, stirring occasionally, until it thickens enough to coat spoon. Add fruit and stir to coat. Add 2 1/2 cups of heavy cream and simmer for 45 - 60 minutes until thickened. Refrigerate. When ready to serve, remove from refrigerator and add the rest of the heavy cream.

title: Apple Gravy
ingredients: 1 cup apple juice | 1 teaspoon cornflour | 1 tablespoon cilantro, chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients in medium sized saucepan and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer, covered 15 minutes.

title: Raspberry and Sun-Dried Tomato Dressing
ingredients: 1 pint fresh raspberry | 5 -6 sun-dried tomatoes, to taste finely chopped
instructions: Place all ingredients into a screw top jar, or in a jar with a tight fitting lid. Cover tightly and shake vigorously to combine. Chill before using. Note that i put my lid in the canning jar for a few seconds while shaking so the raspberries have soaked up the dressing and can be picked up by the fruit. Serves for salad, salads and snacks or as an accompaniment to pasta or just eat alone.

Random Ingredients: pomegranate seed,sage leaf,kumara,thyme sprig,green onion,chervil,hot pepper
title: Upping for Vegetables (Tomates)
ingredients: 1 3/4 lbs kumara, sliced about 1/2 inch thick ( or similar type of firm, tender potato ) | 3 green onions, sliced thin | 1/2 cup dried chervil, chopped | 1/2 cup pomegranate seeds, soaked in hot water until soft ( or other seeds ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage leaves | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme sprigs | 2 hot peppers, finely minced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Slice kumara in half and arrange cut sides on a baking pan in a single layer. Roast uncovered for 25 minutes or until lightly browned. Meanwhile, combine remaining ingredients in a small bowl. Set aside. When ready to serve, arrange kumara and green onions on the serving dish, add the cherry/pomegranate mixture and garnish with thyme sprigs.

title: French Onion Soup
ingredients: 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 1 can condensed french onion soup | 1 cup heavy cream
instructions: In a small bowl, sprinkle dry soup mix over soup. Heat cream and french onion soup in double boiler over low heat until cream is hot but not boiling, stirring frequently. Pour slowly into soup in crockpot. Stir gently until heated through.

Random Ingredients: potato variety,egg yolk,oyster,lemon pepper,onion,vanilla bean,extra virgin olive oil,barbecue sauce
title: Portuguese Omelet for Two
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups mashed potato ( # 5 variety, but # 6 is traditional ) | 3 tablespoons oyster pickle juice ( or 2 tablespoons bourbon ) | 1/2 medium onion, chopped | 3 large egg yolks | 2 teaspoons vanilla beans, mashed | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 3 - 4 tablespoons sweet barbecue sauce ( sweet & spicy ) | 1 teaspoon fresh lemon pepper
instructions: In a medium size bowl, combine mashed potato, oyster pickle juice, chopped onion and oyster powder. Mix together and set aside. In a large nonstick frying pan or omelet pan, place olive oil and heat. Put egg yolks in a medium bowl and whisk until lightly thickened, but slightly runny. Add sugar and whisk until thickened. Pour half of egg mixture into a mixing bowl and whisk until egg is nearly blended with no lumps. Pour half of egg mixture into another bowl containing the egg yolk mixture. Whisk on high until egg is almost fully incorporated into egg mixture. Add sweet barbecue sauce and lemon pepper into mixture, whisking until smooth. Add egg mixture back to mixture and whisk until egg completely has been incorporated into egg mixture. Add mushrooms if desired. Heat a 10 inch non stick skillet or omelet pan over high heat or very lightly butter if using a non stick or heavy skillet. Pour egg mixture into frying pan. Once skillet has reached the desired temperature, cook for 2 minutes on one side. Flip and cook on second side and allow to cook for 2 to 3 minute. Remove skillet from stove and let stand for 1 minute. Pour egg mixture onto plate with side of sliced portuguese hot potato salad or hot potato side on top. Let rest for 2 - 3 minutes. Serve with warm sweet potato side dish or hot potato side dish.

Random Ingredients: harissa,chili powder,red currant jelly,pork loin,broth,apple juice,anaheim chilies,rice noodle
title: Spicy Pork and Noodle Soup
ingredients: 2 cups chicken stock or 2 cups broth | 1 can petite diced tomatoes with juice | 2 ounces diced fresh anaheim chilies ( not in season ) | 1/4 cup orange-flavored harissa ( or more to taste ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili powder | 12 ounces dried rice noodles ( or linguine ) | 1/4 cup red currant jelly
instructions: Heat the stock to boiling and add the tomatoes, anaheim chiles and harissa, along with the chili powder. Lower the heat, and add the noodles. Cover and cook about 10 minutes. Add the jelly, stir to mix well and reheat to serving temperature. Serve on a bed of green lettuce.

Random Ingredients: cream,thai basil,pork tenderloin,grain white rice,carb italian salad dressing
title: Thai Basil Rice Balls
ingredients: 1 lb pork tenderloin | 1 package low-carb italian salad dressing | 3/4 cup sour cream | 1/4 cup thai basil | 1 cup uncooked long grain white rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Place pork tenderloin between two sheets of plastic wrap and pound to 1/4 inch thick, 1 1/2 to 2 inch square pieces. Sprinkle pork evenly with 1/4 cup salad dressing. Pour remaining salad dressing over pork.

title: Yogurt Sauce
ingredients: 4 ounces plain yogurt | 1 teaspoon oil
instructions: Sterilize your favourite sauce bowl and place the yoghurt on it. Mix thoroughly and enjoy.

title: Thai Spicy Pickled Lemongrass
ingredients: 8 stalks lemongrass | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon granules ( optional )
instructions: Wash the lemongrass, removing the hard 'white' inner stalks. Do not use any withether that may cause skin to become brittle. Cut off and discard the dark green stalks and discard. Using the tip of a paring knife, cut the stalks lengthwise into 3 - 6 sections, cutting through the thick membrane at the tough tip. Using a mortar and pestle, crush or coarsely tear the lemongrass into pieces the size of a dime, depending on the width of your lemongrass sections. Repeat with the remaining lemongrass sections. Put the lemongrass pieces in a bowl and add chicken bullion. If desired, leave it in the bowl. Cover and refrigerate for at least 3 hours. Drain the lemongrass and serve at room temperature or chilled.

title: Harissa (Crispy Cilantro Leaves)
ingredients: 500 g fresh baby spinach | 4 tablespoons mustard seeds | 1/2 bunch fresh mint
instructions: Wash and dry the spinach as thoroughly as possible. Remove the thick stalks from the mint and set aside. Heat the mustard seeds in a small frying pan over a medium to high heat. Add the mustard seeds to the hot dry mustard seeds and pop for 20 seconds. Quickly add the fresh mint. Pour the hot spiced mustard on the spinach leaves to cover and leave for a few minutes to wilt the leaves. Sprinkle the leaves with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Serve immediately or cool and then store refrigerated in an airtight container. The flavours will improve on standing.

title: Vegan Straw Potatoes (Oamc)
ingredients: 4 baking potatoes ( i used yukon gold ) | 1 teaspoon dried mixed herbs | straw mushroom ( optional )
instructions: Bake potatoes until just cooked. While they are still hot, slice into 3/4 inch thick slices. Drain potatoes and pat dry with paper towels. Place in bowl and sprinkle with the herbs. Toss with more herbs to taste. You can add some sliced mushrooms if you like.

title: Easy CurryYogurt (Nuts)
ingredients: 1 cup nonfat yogurt | 1 tablespoon thai curry paste ( i like patak telur brand ) | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon nanami togarashi ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl, stir, and chill in fridge for about an hour before serving. Great served over japanese rice.

Random Ingredients: panko breadcrumb,asafoetida powder,yellow onion,cooking spray,oregano,hoisin sauce
title: Panko Onion-Sizzled Dipping Sauce
ingredients: cooking spray | 1/2 cup hoisin sauce | 2 tablespoons panko breadcrumbs | 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/8 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1/8 teaspoon yellow onion, finely diced ( i use a food processor )
instructions: Coat a small nonstick saute pan with cooking spray and place over medium high heat. In a small bowl, combine the hoisin sauce, panko crumbs, oregano, and asafetida. Stir to blend. In a separate small bowl, combine the onion. Stir into the hoisin sauce mixture. Dip the onion rings into the onion rings and allow to sit for an hour or two so that the mixture can be drizzled with the liquid from the rings before dipping. Place on a baking sheet and bake in preheated oven for 10 to 15 minutes, until the onion is lightly browned and the crumbs have begun to brown.

title: Brazilian Steak Fajitas
ingredients: 1/4 cup bamboo shoots | 1/2 lb steak, cut 1 1/2 to 2 inches thick, trimmed of top fat | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: In a medium skillet over medium heat, combine the bamboo shoots and 1/2 teaspoon of salt. Allow the water to boil. When the water boils again, add the steak and stir fry for 2 minutes. Sprinkle the remaining 1/4 teaspoon salt and the cayenne pepper over the steak and allow the meat to cook 1 minute more, or until the meat is cooked through and the water is mostly evaporated, stirring gently several times. Serve with warm flour tortillas or fajitas.

title: Peach-Beef Bake
ingredients: 4 cans refrigerated crescent dinner rolls, thawed | 1 pound ground beef chuck | 1 jar peach slices, drained | 6 cups fresh blueberries, divided, or as needed | 1 cup diced cooked chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Arrange a single layer of crescent rolls into each of four 9x13 inch baking dishes, breaking crescents into thirds if needed. Place the ground chuck in a skillet over medium heat, and cook and stir until evenly browned, and crumbly, about 10 minutes, breaking it into crumbles as it cooks. Drain grease, and set aside. In a separate skillet over medium high heat, mix the pears and 1 cup blueberries. Cook and stir until heated through. Mix ground chuck, 1 can peaches with juice, and crumbles into skillet. Pour mixture into crescent rolls, and top with a few crumbles. Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Faux Thai
ingredients: 2 green capsicums | 2 lemons, halved
instructions: Slice the lemons thinly. Cut the green capsicum into 4 - 6 slices. Place on an oven tray that fits snugly into your oven tray. Cover with a clean dish cloth. Place the tray onto the preheated oven shelf and cook for 10 - 12 minutes, until the white of the capsicum is soft. Allow to stand for 5 minutes before removing. Cut in half and squeeze out the seeds. Place on a serving platter and keep in your fridge until ready to serve. Tip, if you do not have a lemonset, you can use a combination of green and purple capsicums.

title: Lebanese Curry Powder
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon curry powder | 1 tablespoon honey
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients and rub over any kind of raw vegetables they're cooking. If using any kind of roast chicken or lamb you may season with the curry powder after cooking. Variations you may also add some garlic, paprika for added flavor and taste, ginger garlic for extra spice. If using brined lamb, use the liquid, rinse lamb and add it in.

title: Potato Macaroni
ingredients: 8 medium potatoes, scrubbed and halved | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 package macaroni
instructions: In a large pot of salted water, bring the potatoes to a boil. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer until potatoes are tender, about 20 minutes. Drain, reserving cooking water. Place cooked potatoes in a large bowl.

Random Ingredients: mango,cardamom seed,wonton wrapper,sun tomato,lemon pepper,onion powder
title: Sundried Tomato Wontons
ingredients: 10 wonton wrappers, about 2 x 2 inch squares | 2/3 cup sundried tomato, sliced into rounds | 2 1/2 tablespoons grated sweet onions or 2 1/2 tablespoons garlic | 1 1/2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes | 1 teaspoon lemon pepper | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom seeds ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Line baking sheet with parchment paper. Place wonton wrappers on work surface and generously coat with cooking spray. Bake about 10 minutes or until crispy. Remove wontons from baking sheet. In a bowl, toss the sun dried tomatoes, chopped onion, lemon pepper, and cardamom seeds with one teaspoon olive oil. Set aside. Place about 2 tablespoons or so of the sun dried tomato mixture inside each wonton wrapper. Top with 1 teaspoon grated parmesan cheese. Continue to add the remaining ingredients except for wontons, in that order. Brush wontons with glaze and sprinkle with additional parmesan cheese. Serve immediately. Note, i had to roll the wontons over the mixture and then place on a pan filled with hot water and froze. You may have to do this in batches.

Random Ingredients: leek,kiwi fruit,parmesan cheese,flat leaf italian parsley,shoyu
title: Mixed Kiwi Salad
ingredients: 4 kiwi fruits | 2 tablespoons flat-leaf italian parsley | 2 tablespoons shoyu ( to taste ) | 2 teaspoons shoyu ( to taste ) | 1 tablespoon leeks ( to taste ) | 1/2 cup parmesan cheese
instructions: Peel and dice the kiwifruit lenghtwise, then roughly chop. Pour the shoyu in a strainer over a bowl and press gently for a few seconds to settle the flavour. When the juice is the consistency of coarse water, strain out the cloudy lemon juice and put the juice back in the bowl. Add the kiwifruit, parsley and parmesan cheese to the dressing, mix well. Serve.

Random Ingredients: sultana raisin,beer,beef cube steak,superfine sugar,spaghetti noodle,chunky salsa,cocoa
title: Beef Da Rio
ingredients: 3 cups superfine sugar | 1 1/2 lbs beef short rib steaks | 2 cups hot chunky salsa | 1 1/2 cups sultana raisins | 1 1/2 cups cocoa | 1 bottle beer | 8 ounces spaghetti noodles, cooked
instructions: In a large, heavy duty saucepan, combine sugar, meat and salsa. Bring to a boil over high heat, boil 3 minutes, then remove from heat. Cover and refrigerate for 3 hours or overnight. In 3 - ½ qt dish, combine raisins and 1½ cup cocoa and mix well. Place meat on top and press the raises into the meat. Add remaining cocoa.

title: Walnut Portabella
ingredients: 1 large portabella mushroom | 1 tablespoon walnut pieces, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Clean mushrooms. Cut in half, remove the stems, and cut the caps into thin slices. Set mushrooms aside. Heat a nonstick frypan over medium heat. Add walnuts, toss to coat, and cook 1 minute. Spoon mixture into mushrooms and serve.

title: Green Onion Chutney
ingredients: 1 can condensed onion soup mix | 1/2 teaspoon dried anonida powder ( optional ) | 3/4 cup green onions, chopped with tops | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon
instructions: Pour the onion soup mix, anonida, and green onions into a blender, and blend until smooth and creamy.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,soy sauce,marinara sauce,pistachio,currant,white pepper,amaretto,orange
title: Easy Amaretto Pistachio Glaze
ingredients: 1 jar marinara sauce | 2 cans condensed cream of chicken soup | 4 ounces white pepper | 1 1/2 tablespoons soy sauce | 1 orange, zest diced | 1/2 cup chopped pistachios | 1/2 cup dried currants
instructions: Mix all ingredients in small bowl with whisk until well blended.

title: English Cucumber and Tomato Tarte Tatin
ingredients: 2 english cucumbers | 1 pizza crust ( or regular if you have any ) | parsley, minced
instructions: Slice cucumbers in half diagonally. Place bread on cookie sheet. Brush with olive oil. Place cucumbers in a single layer on bread. Sprinkle with minced parsley and pepper. Bake at 375° for 10 - 15 minutes until crust is a light golden color and cucumbers are tender. Watch them carefully as the pit will usually stay closed, so don't burn your nose.

title: Homemade Indian Yogurt (Yogurtlu Kha)
ingredients: 2 cups plain fat free greek yogurt ( strained yoghurt ) | 3/4 teaspoon dried greek seasoning ( i use pampered chef greek seasoning, more or less to taste ) | 1 cup fresh cilantro leaves, rinsed
instructions: Combine all in a large bowl. Cover and chill for 1 hour up to 2 days, or leave in fridge for up to a week. Serve with pita bread, bread, or your favorite fillings..

Random Ingredients: semolina flour,onion flake,cornflour,seasoning salt,white bread,ginger garlic paste
title: Gingerbread Toasties
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups semolina flour | 1 ounce white bread, diced | 1/4 cup cornflour | 1/2 teaspoon maggi seasoning salt | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 cup sweet onion flakes
instructions: Mix the white bread, cornflour, maggi salt, and seasoned salt and keep aside for ten minutes. Shape each of the gingerbread sized pieces into a flat circle shape by moistening your thumb in water and holding the dough with your thumb in one hand. Place on the griddle you will cook with. Brush with oil, bake till light brown. Drain all of the excess oil onto a towel. Sprinkle gingerbreads with onion flakes.

title: Smoked Cod and turnip (Bok Choy)
ingredients: 1 lb skinless smoked cod fillet | 1/4 lb turnip, peeled and shredded | 1 package frozen bean sprouts, thawed | 2 teaspoons ground cumin | 2 limes, halved
instructions: Trim fish of fat and cut into 1 inch strips. In a non stick skillet, melt both the smoked fish and the garlic and the cumin over a medium heat, stirring occasionally. Add the turnip, sprouts and the juice and simmer, stirring occasionally, until the turnip is tender. Serve immediately with the halved lime halves.

Random Ingredients: hot paprika,lemon,serrano chili,oyster sauce,egg,red enchilada sauce,ginger,red food coloring
title: Egg and Coriander Spread
ingredients: 5 large eggs, hard boiled ( at least 5 days ) | 150 g red enchilada sauce | 1 teaspoon ginger, grated | 1 teaspoon ground red food coloring ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons lemons or 2 teaspoons lime juice | 1 1/2 teaspoons sweet paprika or 1 1/2 teaspoons smoked paprika, ground red chili, to taste | 1 - 1 1/2 dried hot red chili, deseeded ( optional ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons serrano chili, finely chopped ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons oyster sauce
instructions: Slice the hard boiled eggs in half horizontally and then into halves again so they resemble rectangular halves.. Soak the slices in a bowl of cold water for 5 - 8 minutes to prevent them from breaking. Remove the slices and put a colander. Break the hard boiled eggs into tiny pieces and place them in a bowl and stir to separate the eggs.. Beat the egg whites until frothy and then add the yolks. Gradually add the rest of the ingredients, stirring until the mixture is a light, light yellow color. Transfer the mix to a bowl and refrigerate at least an hour. Sprinkle with a bit of the red chilies before serving.

title: The Secret Ingredient Greek Yogurt Dip
ingredients: 1 container plain nonfat yogurt | 1 1/2 tablespoons low sodium sriracha sauce, divided | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 2 tablespoons plain nonfat yogurt
instructions: Line a medium baking sheet with parchment paper.

title: Easy Garlic Bread II
ingredients: 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | 1 loaf french bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly grease a 9 inch loaf pan. Stir flour into a medium bowl and stir in the bread. Pour bread mixture into the prepared pan. Bake in the preheated oven for 65 to 80 minutes, or until golden brown. Leave the loaf in the pan and cool on a wire rack.

Random Ingredients: chicken part,tomato,whipping cream,marshmallow,penne pasta,pepper sauce,french bread,pistachio nut
title: Chicken With Creamy Pistachio Croutons and Pimento Topping
ingredients: 1 package dry penne pasta | 2 tablespoons whipping cream | 2/3 cup canned stewed tomatoes, drained | 5 tablespoons chilled whipping cream | 2 tablespoons freshly shaved pistachio nuts | 1/4 teaspoon hot pepper sauce, or to taste | 8 ounces cooked, boneless chicken parts | 2 cans sliced marshmallows
instructions: Cook pasta in a large pot of boiling salted water until slightly undercooked, about 11 minutes.

title: Grillin Aspic With Grand Marnier
ingredients: 8 large sized oranges | 5 tablespoons grand marnier | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Peel the oranges, removing any pith. Cut the oranges into half and place on a plate. Brush both cut sides of each segment with the orange liqueur. Drizzle half the grand marnier into your palm and seal. Let stand at room temperature for 15 minutes, then refrigerate for up to 2 days. In a heavy pot with a tight cover, place the olive oil and bring to a boil. Pour the olive oil into the rum and let it boil until the olive oil is smoking. Add the orange segments and stir briskly. Return to a boil, lower and simmer 3 to 5 minutes longer.

Random Ingredients: mustard seed,bacon bit,red onion,white wine,veal cutlet,yellow pepper
title: Veal Rouladen
ingredients: 4 lbs veal cutlets | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 yellow pepper | 1 red onion | 1/2 cup dry white wine | 1 1/2 cups bacon bits | chopped red onion ( to garnish )
instructions: Preheat broiler. Place the bacon bits on a cookie sheet or in a large baking dish. Place the cutlets on top of the bits and sprinkle with mustard seeds. Broil 1 - 2 minutes, or until golden, but not burnt. Place a green pepper and chopped red onion on top of the slit up, and brush with the bacon bits. When it's crisp, remove it from the broiler, let it cook for about 1 - 2 minutes, or until it wilts. Slice the veal into slices to serve. Serve with the bacon bits and red onion.

Random Ingredients: white flour,lemon,cilantro leaf,egg yolk,red onion,grand marnier,marinara sauce
title: Marinara With Cilantro and Lemons
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups white flour | 2 eggs | 3 egg yolks | 1/3 cup fresh cilantro leaves | 3 tablespoons grand marnier | 3 tablespoons very thinly sliced red onions | 1 lemon, cut into thin slivers
instructions: Place the flour, eggs and egg yolks in a bowl and beat until thick and lemon colored. Stir in the cilantro, grand marnier grand marnier, onion, and lemon peel. Stir in half the cilantro leaves.

title: Lamb With Brown Lentils and Chocolate (Rachael Ray)
ingredients: 1 lb minced lamb | 2 cups yellow lentils | 8 ounces chopped lamb | 1/4 cup unsalted butter | 12 ounces dry rigatoni pasta ( or a 16 oz whole wheat linguine or fettuccine )
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add the lentils, cover and simmer over low until the lentils are just tender, 40 - 60 minutes. Meanwhile, chop the lamb and mix in a large skillet with 3/4 cup water and 1/2 cup of the butter for 10 minutes, or until the lamb is browned and begins to render its fat. title: Mexican Shredded Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 3 lbs lean ground beef stew meat | 2 lbs lean ground pork | 5 large fresh poblano chiles | 1 tablespoon all purpose greek salad seasoning | 1 medium avocado | 16 slices beef sirloin steak sandwich thin or 16 sandwich thin slices round cheese
instructions: In a large pot over medium heat, cook the beef and pork with the poblano chiles until meats are fully cooked. Drain pork. Return meat to pot and add greek seasoning, stirring until thoroughly blended. Wrap each sandwich tightly in paper towels to absorb any excess grease. Place a piece of meat on a warmed luncheon roll with some shredded cheese on the outside. Place the wrapped luncheon meat in the bottom third of the roll. Cover with other top portion of roll. You can eat it with chips, sour cream, fresh guacamole, salsa, salsa verde, sour cream.

title: Mustard Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup mustard | 2 tablespoons half-and-half | 1/4 cup salad oil
instructions: Combine mustard, half and half and salad oil in a small bowl and mix thoroughly so that each grain is well coated in the dressing, adding a pinch of salt to taste. Allow to stand for a few minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,anchovy fillet,picante sauce,plum sauce,beef bouillon cube,bread,lemon juice zest
title: Spicy Portuguese Bread Soup
ingredients: 1 small ripe crusty loaf round bread | 1 3/4 pints beef bouillon cubes | 14 ounces plum sauce | 1 jar picante sauce | 1 jar anchovy fillets or 1 tablespoon anchovy oil | 2 teaspoons cardamom pods, finely ground
instructions: Cut a small slice of off the top of the bread and scoop out the moist crumb.

title: Easy Pizza Dough for 1
ingredients: 2 packages active dry yeast | 3 1/2 cups unbleached all-purpose flour | 1 tablespoon crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Sprinkle yeast on surface of 1 1/2 to 2 cups unbleached all purpose flour. Make a well in the center of the flour. Pour yeast over the top. Let stand until bubbly, about 5 minutes. Pour flour over yeast. Stir in crushed red pepper and enough remaining flour to make a stiff dough. Turn dough out onto lightly buttered baking sheets. Knead until smooth, about 12 minutes. Place dough in a well oiled large plastic bowl. Cover with a damp towel or plastic container and let rise in a warm place until doubled, about 1 hour. Lightly dust top of dough with flour and turn dough over. Let rise until doubled, about 1 hour. Punch dough down and turn over. Knead about 1 minute. Divide into four pieces and stretch to fit your desired shape. Place dough in greased plastic bowl, cover and let rise until doubled, about 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Bake in preheated oven until the top is golden brown and the bottom sounds hollow when tapped, about 30 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes. Transfer to a wire rack to cool.

title: Cold Sliced Noodles With Kumara
ingredients: 1 cup sweet noodles | 3/4 cup cucumber, shaved or diced | 1 1/2 cups mandarin oranges or 1 1/2 cups other orange sections | 1 cup shredded kumara | 2 tablespoons prepared mustard | 1/4 cup crushed ice
instructions: Cook noodles. Drain and set aside. Cut mandarins into thin slices. Mix noodles, kumara, mustard, kumara, and noodles in a large bowl. Top with ice and serve.

Random Ingredients: pork sparerib,green pepper,head cabbage,new potato,pizza crust,baby spinach
title: Cabbage Spareribs
ingredients: 2 lbs pork spareribs, trimmed | 2 green peppers, thinly sliced | 4 new potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced | 1 head of cabbage, cored and thinly sliced | 1 package baby spinach, chopped | 1 prepared pizza crust
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Combine ribs, green peppers, potatoes and cabbage in a bowl. Place half of the spinach on the dough. Roll the meat mixture into a cylinder shape. Transfer the meat to a baking sheet and roast 12 to 14 minutes, until cooked through. Repeat with remaining meat and vegetables. Serve with gravy.

title: Irish Potato Salad With Molasses Syrup
ingredients: 1 head garlic, peeled | 2 lbs red potatoes, scrubbed | 4 cups fresh green ( spring mix ) or 4 cups scallions, chopped ( spring mix ) | 1/2 cup molasses | 1/3 cup packed light molasses ( if you have light molasses ) | 1/3 cup tomato paste | 1 1/2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 1/2 1 1/2 cups buttermilk or 1 1/2 cups water | 1 teaspoon cold water
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f. Rub unpeeled whole head of garlic with crushed garlic cloves. Heat remaining ingredients in oven to 475°f. Cook garlic on stovetop over low heat, stirring constantly with a wooden spoon 2 minutes or till garlic is golden. Remove cloves, mash and reserve 2 1/2 tbsp mashed garlic. Pour molasses syrup over warm garlic and mash well. Pour mashed potatoes over mashed garlic mixture. Drizzle with reserved mashed garlic cloves. Chill.

Random Ingredients: extra tofu,tarragon,red wine,dark rum,cognac,panko breadcrumb,peach,red wine vinegar
title: Tofu Steak With Peaches and Cognac
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sifted panko breadcrumbs | 4 ounces extra firm tofu, drained well | 1 teaspoon crushed fresh tarragon | 2 tablespoons cognac | 1 teaspoon red wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon dark rum | 1 tablespoon red wine | 4 firm ripe peaches, peachy
instructions: Soak the tofu overnight in cold water. Drain the tofu and cut it in half lengthwise. With a teaspoon, poke a small hole in the top of each half with the tofu's bottom crust. Combine the sifted panko with the tarragon, cognac, vinegar and rum in a small bowl and set aside. Lightly oil the grill. Pat the sliced tofu dry with paper towels and put under the preheated grill. Cook on each side for 1½ to 2 minutes for rare to medium rare. Transfer the tofu to a board and rest it for 5 minutes. Cut the peaches in half lengthwise, remove the pit and slice the flesh thinly. Arrange two peach halves on a warm serving plate, then top with the tofu and a drizzle of the cognac. Serve with a green herb sauce or a spicy mustard.

title: Carnival Lamb Lasagne
ingredients: 400 g cooked lamb, thinly sliced | 200 g raw pumpkin puree ( i used homemade pumpkin puree which the recipe said ) | 2 sheets of paper | 4 lasagna noodles | 400 g white beans, cooked ( cannellini beans ) | 300 g fresh pumpkin stock or 300 g fresh white bean paste | 2 tablespoons lemonade | coriander or fresh flat leaf parsley, roughly chopped
instructions: Put the meat and pumpkin together in a bowl and season with salt and pepper. Using two pieces of the paper, roll each one between sheets of clingfilm to form long strips, then place them in a heatproof dish. Use the paper to cover the meat mixture in a spiral with a piece of paper. Keep in a cool place for 30 minutes. Meanwhile, cook the lasagne noodles in boiling, slated water according to packet instructions, drain and cool with cold water. Lift the noodles out with a slotted spoon and cut on the diagonal into 3/4 lengths and set aside. To make the pumpkin stock, cut the pumpkin into cubes and combine with the stock. Add the lemonade and the beans and simmer gently for 10 minutes. Drain the noodles and combine all the beef and pork mixture together. Remove and discard the paper. Place two slices of lemon peel on the edge of 3 to 4 lasagne sheets. Top with a layer of noodles and a layer of cannelloni or cannelloni. Repeat the layers and layering twice with the tomato sauce, lemon peel, lasagne sheets, cannelloni and then finally tomato sauce. Sprinkle with coriander or fresh flat leaf parsley. Press the paper between sheets of paper to make it easier to roll the lasagne. Serve immediately.

title: Chinese Mushroom Skewers
ingredients: 1 lb shiitake mushroom ( or other chantrelles ) | 1 piece gingerroot, peeled and very finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seed
instructions: Trim mushrooms, trim stems, wash thoroughly, dry thoroughly. Dry and finely chop stems. Heat 2 cups water, 1 tablespoon salt, 1/2 inch ginger, cardamom in non stick pan. Add mushrooms, cook, stirring occasionally, just until water evaporates, stir in 1/2 teaspoon salt. Cool 15 - 30 minutes. Thread caps, cut stems into strips on skewers, sprinkle with the remaining teaspoon salt, serve.

Random Ingredients: onion powder,shiitake mushroom,self raising flour,taco seasoning mix,kielbasa,plain nonfat yogurt
title: Kielbasa and Mushroom Fritters
ingredients: 8 ounces dried shiitake mushrooms | 2 large onions, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning mix | 2 tablespoons plain nonfat yogurt | 1 cup self-raising flour | 1 teaspoon onion powder
instructions: Place mushrooms, onions and seasoning in bowl of food processor and process to a fine paste. Stir in yogurt till blended. Fold in flour and mix lightly. The mixture should be crumbly on the smallest possible form. Heat non stick pan. Drop spoonfuls of fritter mix into and cook on one side until nicely browned. Serve as a burger or spread with onion and tomato or salsa.

Random Ingredients: baking soda,red onion,yukon gold potato,brown rice,orange zest,ginger,tortilla
title: Baked Brown Rice and Ginger Potatoes
ingredients: 1/4 large red onion, chopped | 1 cup brown rice | 4 medium yukon gold potatoes, peeled and quartered | 1 teaspoon fresh ginger, minced | 1/2 teaspoon orange zest, grated | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 6 ounces tortillas, torn into 2-inch pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Line a jelly roll pan with foil or parchment paper. Combine 1/4 cup water, onions, rice, potatoes, ginger, orange zest and baking soda in a medium saucepan and bring to a boil. Pour boiling water into a 3 cup casserole dish. Place the tortillas on top of the water. Cover with foil paper and bake for 45 to 55 minutes or until rice is tender and the edges are beginning to crisp. Serve with a sprinkling of orange zest.

title: Carryover Island Style Crab Cakes
ingredients: 2 cups crabmeat | 1 purple onion, minced ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon allspice | 1 vanilla bean, split lengthwise
instructions: Put crabmeat into a large bowl and smash with the flat side of a meat mallet. Add remaining ingredients and mix until the lobster flavour is distributed. Spoon mixture out onto wax paper. Roll up or fold in half lengthwise.

title: Sweet Soy Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup soy sauce | 1/2 cup corn oil | 1 package pam cooking spray
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in medium mixing bowl. Cover with plastic wrap, and place plastic wrap directly on surface of soy sauce. Refrigerate 1 1/2 hours to blend flavors. If time permits, transfer to ziplock plastic bag, wrap tightly, and refrigerate 2 hours before use. Microwave method, prepare soy sauce by placing ingredients in ziplock bag, seal, and cook on high power in microwave covered dish for 5 minutes.

title: Kreatopita, Kreatopita and Meat Empanadas from Recipes
ingredients: 1 tablespoon ground lamb or 1 tablespoon ground turkey | 1/3 cup dry red wine | 1/2 cup finely chopped mixed dried fruit, such as apricots, prunes and pineapple cones ( kirby ) | 1 package phyllo dough | 2 cups dry red wine ( see note ) | 12 sheets white bread ( see note ) of stale bread ( see note )
instructions: Note, the quantity of fruit depends on what dried fruit you are preparing and what type of lamb/turmeric you use. If you’re using lamb, drain the wine before preparing the meat. Stir together the lamb spices, red wine, and fruit.

Random Ingredients: cottage cheese,corn,fontina cheese,apricot,yellow bell pepper,cheese,red pepper powder
title: Cottage Fondue
ingredients: 1 jar dried apricots, packed in syrup | 1/4 cup red pepper powder ( can use more ) | 1 package cottage cheese | 1 bunch small handfuls cheese, finely chopped | 1 small yellow bell pepper, chopped fine ( add in more to your taste ) | 2 -3 ounces fontina cheese | 1 teaspoon corn, canola or 1 teaspoon butter flavoring ( can use more )
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine all ingredients until creamy. You may want to add more red pepper powder to achieve the desired taste. This can be made up to 2 days ahead of time and refrigerated. Toss with hot, crusty bread, like fritos de frijoles.

Random Ingredients: sprite,yeast,eggplant,hamburger,pea carrot,pork tenderloin,asiago cheese,ancho chile powder
title: Mama's Crock Pot Empanadas
ingredients:
3 lbs lean hamburger, browned and drained | 3 lbs pork tenderloin, cooked and cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1 lb baby peas and carrot | 1/2 cup a.
    -1.
    - original essence | 1 -2 dried ancho chile powder, to taste | 3 packages active dry yeast | 2 packages sprite, well drained and well-rinsed | 1 package shredded asiago cheese ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees. In a mixing bowl, toss the meat with the garlic, salt and ajicitos. Let sit in the mixture while you prepare your dough. Mix all remaining ingredients in a large bowl. Add the meat and any extras from the bowl. Roll dough about 1/8 thick until fully flattened. Place 1 tablespoon of the filling at the center of the dough. Fold over the ends and tuck in the two halves of the dough, starting at the center with the peas and carrots. You should have at least a 3/4 cup of filling. Seal with a little water to make sure dough is sealed and doesn't leak out. Lightly grease the tops of the dough and then sprinkle with cheese and bake for 2 hours on lowest temperature.

title: Beets With Beets
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 8 medium beets | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce
instructions: Spray 2 baking sheets with spray and place beets on sheets. Sprinkle with worcestershire sauce, but not too much. Place the pan on the middle rack of the oven and bake at 220 degrees for about 40 minutes until tender.

Random Ingredients: fine egg noodle,almond extract,juniper berry,artichoke heart
title: Noodle Dressing With Artichokes, Juniper Berries and Almonds
ingredients: 1/2 cup fine egg noodles | 2 tablespoons minced artichoke hearts | 2 tablespoons finely chopped candied juniper berries | 2 tablespoons finely chopped toasted almonds
instructions: In a small bowl, toss the egg noodles with 2 tablespoons of the marjoram leaves. Stir them in the remaining ingredients and coat well.

title: Linguica Con Seda (Portuguese Pork and Linguica Sausages in Sesame Oil)
ingredients: 1 lb linguica sausage ( portuguese smoked ) | 8 lbs leeks | 14 ounces dark sesame oil | 1 lb leek, trimmed, cut into 1-inch lengths, washed, and chopped
instructions: Thinly slice the sausage, and place in a large saucepan. Slice the leeks lengthwise and wash thoroughly in a colander. Place over medium heat. Add 5 cups water and bring to a boil.

title: Dairy Free Mock Danish Froth
ingredients: 500 g bean sprouts | 2 -3 tablespoons white sugar | 1/4 cup sultana
instructions: Wash beansprouts roughly. Pour boiling water over them just a enough so that they float to the top of the water. Leave the sprouts in a pan of boiling water for about five minutes. Then drain and rinse them well to remove the excess water. Place the bean sprouts in a colander. Add the sugar and stir to dissolve. Add the sultana and return to the boil. Serve immediately to store in a cool place or cold for up to a week. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: molasses,asparagus,green chilies,pasta shell,superfine sugar,graham cracker crumb
title: Pasta With Creamy Chilies and Asparagus
ingredients: 20 small pasta shells | 1 lb asparagus, cleaned and chopped | 1 can green chilies, chopped | 1 package superfine sugar | 1/2 cup molasses | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Steam asparagus until tender, drain, and set aside. Cook green chilies in hot oil in a skillet until done. Stir in sugar and molasses. Boil mixture for 15 minutes. Pour over asparagus, mix well, and let cool. Mix graham cracker crumbs into the cooled mixture. Spoon hot chilli mixture over the asparagus mixture. Place in refrigerator for at least one hour.

title: Stefado de Viande (Stefado of Beef With Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 sirloin steak | 1 can whole lager beer | 16 ladyfingers | 1 can mushrooms | 1 small onion, sliced | 2 tablespoons instant espresso ( espresso powder )
instructions: Rinse steak with cold water and pat dry. Place steak in crock pot or slow cooker. Cover with beer. Add sliced mushrooms in the crock for 6 - 8 hours. Uncover and stir in espresso and serve over ladyfingers.

title: Bridies
ingredients: 3/4 lb cottage cheese, not fat-free | 1 cup sifted flour | 1/2 lb meat, lean, lean, cooked, drained fat | 4 -5 tablespoons raspberry jam, seedless | extra jam, for dipping
instructions: Blend cottage cheese, flour, and fat until well mixed. Let stand 10 minutes. Shape 1 tbs mixture into a 6 inch circle. Roll up and pinch to seal, press ends together. Cut each circle into 1 inch strips, each strip about 3 inches long. Dip strip into 1 - 2 tsp of jam, holding at 1 end. Arrange on greased baking sheet. Bake in 375° oven for 20 minutes or until golden.

title: Baked Sausages with Vinegar
ingredients: 12 sausages | 1/2 lb loaf ciabatta | 1 celery leaves, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Line a shallow baking pan with aluminum foil. Arrange sausages in a baking pan so that they fit snugly but not too closely together. Bake until sausages are browned and no longer pink inside, about 45 minutes. Remove from oven and tent with foil to keep warm. Meanwhile, cut loaf into thirds lengthwise and then crosswise into 1 inch thick slices. Scoop out the soft, white juices. Arrange slices on a serving platter. Place celery leaves and reserved juices in a small saucepan. Cook over medium heat until the celery is tender but not browned, about 10 minutes. Pour 1/2 the hot celery mixture into a blender or food processor and puree until smooth. When all the sausages are baked, remove all but 1/2 inch of the slices, and discard the rest of the marinade. Arrange them over the warmed bread pieces. Spoon reserved marinade over all and sprinkle with the chopped celery leaves. Serve at once.

title: Lamb and Mango Curry
ingredients: 450 g minced lamb | 450 g finely minced beef chuck ( shoulder ) | 4 cups fresh plum tomatoes, chopped | 2 -3 tablespoons mango chutney | 2 -3 teaspoons turmeric
instructions: If using a mortar & pestle, chop the meat finely. Put the tomatoes/mango chutney in bowl with the meat and mix well. Add the turmeric and mix. I use my mortar and pestle and pestle. Tip, if you've got any excess fat from the meat, drain off any liquid into the pot before adding the lamb & lamb. Cook the dish over medium heat for 3 - 5 minutes. Serve with naan bread or on rice.

title: Grampa Champagne Glaze(Gloria Hlach)
ingredients: 1 bottle port wine, chilled | 1 cup cherries ( fresh or pitted )
instructions: Combine the wine and fruit in a large glass bowl. Cover and refrigerate until serving time.

title: Vegan French Bread Pudding for Breakfast
ingredients: 1 loaf rye bread, torn into bite size pieces | 1 cup soymilk | 1 medium yellow bell pepper, sliced thinly and cut into thin strips | 1/8 teaspoon grated lemon peel | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: In a small saucepan, cover bread with cold water. Bring to a boil over high heat and then reduce heat to low.

Random Ingredients: anisette,caperberries,cheese,pecan,thai red curry paste,bread,black mustard seed
title: Spiced Red Curry
ingredients: 2 tablespoons anisette, seeds | 100 g capers, rinsed and roughly chopped | 1 tablespoon black mustard seeds | 5 tablespoons chopped pecans | 2 tablespoons thai red curry paste | 1 tablespoon aged cheese, grated | 35 g stale bread, chopped into small pieces
instructions: Place the ground spices into a small bowl. Add the capers and mustard seeds and mix well. Add the chopped pecans and red curry paste and mix well. Transfer the mixture in a small flat pan. Remove the pan from the heat. Add the grated cheese and stir well until it has melted. Put the bread into a large mixing bowl. Pour the curry mixture into the serving bowl and mix gently. Serve at once.

title: Chile and Pear Cannelloni
ingredients: 2 fresh pears, cored, peeled and sliced | 12 cannelloni tubes | 1 1/2 teaspoons chile cayenne
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Arrange the tomato slices onto a baking sheet, overlapping and fitting the slices slightly. Bake in the preheated oven until the skins are blackened, about 10 minutes. Remove from the oven and brush with the chipotle pepper. Remove the tomato and peel from the peel.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,white pepper,lime juice zest,red potato,french bread
title: Pine Grilled French Bread
ingredients: 6 red potatoes, scrubbed and cut into bite size pieces ( about 1 1/2 pounds ) | 4 tablespoons white pepper | 3 tablespoons ground white pepper | 2 tablespoons lime juice, from about 1/2 lime zest | 3 loaves french bread, sliced lengthwise into eighths ( or 4-6 slices of your choice, or use crusty )
instructions: Place the scrubbed potatoes, white pepper, and ground white pepper in a microwave safe bowl, cover the bowl with a lid, and cook on high power in the microwave until they are tender, about 8 minutes. Use an ice cream scoop to scoop out the potatoes and allow excess liquid to drain in a colander set over a bowl to drain as much liquid as possible.

title: Kidney Bean and Rice Salad
ingredients: 2 cups cooked macaroni rice | 1/2 cup oil | 1/4 cup rice wine | 1 teaspoon mustard | 1 can kidney beans, drained | 2 roma ( plum ) tomatoes, diced and seeded | 6 mint-topped basil leaves, chopped | 6 maraschino cherries, sliced
instructions: In a large bowl, soak rice with enough water to cover and let sit 30 minutes to an hour. Drain and rinse in a colander. Transfer drained rice to a salad bowl and set aside. Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat. Stir in rice wine & mustard.

title: Mushroom, Cheese & Hot Focaccia
ingredients: 4 slices low-fat cheddar cheese | 200 g shiitake mushrooms, sliced | 6 sprigs celery & leaves | 4 slices of cold country bread | 4 thin slices of cold salami | 100 g white chocolate chips | 1 teaspoon extra virgin olive oil ( evoo ) | 2 tablespoons olive oil ( evoo )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c / 180°c fan / gas. Line a baking tray with baking paper. Put the cheese on a piece of bread and put on 4 slices over the cheese. Break up the mushrooms slightly and scatter with celery & leaves. Put the remaining bread on the cheese. Cut up salami and spread with 1 teaspoon of olive oil. Place onto the bread and then the white chocolate chips. Drizzle the remaining olive oil over the cheese and bread followed by a teaspoon of olive oil. Place the tray on the oven shelf and bake for 20 minutes. Remove the tray from the oven and leave for 5 minutes to cool slightly before cutting into 4 portions to serve.

title: Langosteen
ingredients: 1 jar lasagna noodles, drained and rinsed | 3 hard-cooked eggs, chopped | 1 1/2 cups whole wheat flour
instructions: Cover noodles in salted water, bring to a boil and boil, uncovered for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Potato and Zucchini Wedges
ingredients: 4 medium potatoes, peeled and quartered | 8 large zucchini | 1 tablespoon unbleached all-purpose flour | 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar | 16 toothpicks
instructions: Heat grill to medium high. Toss potato sections with the flour and rice vinegar. Thread the zucchini onto the skewers. Let rest for 15 minutes, turning to allow all sides to brown evenly.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,apricot jam,apple,cardamom,ginger root,garbanzo bean,salt pepper
title: Slow Cooker Indian Apricot Chickpea Chickpeas
ingredients: 1 can garbanzo beans, drained | 1 tablespoon crushed dried apricot jam | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1/2 cup chopped, fresh apple | 1 tablespoon ground ginger root | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Combine garbanzo beans, apricot jam, chicken bouillon cube, apple, ginger, cardamom, salt and pepper in slow cooker. Cover, and cook on low until the beans are bubbling, 3 to 4 hours.

title: Gran Salmon Pie
ingredients: 600 g salmon, skin-on, skinned, boned, coarsely chopped | 1 capsicum, diced ( red pepper ) | 3/4 cup tasty cheese, grated | 1/4 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Pre heat oven to 180°c line a deep 7 inch pie tin with baking paper and spread salmon, capsicum and cheese evenly on the base and around the sides. Sprinkle cracker crumbs on top of the salmon. Bake in oven for about 30 minutes or until salmon is heated through and cheese is melted.

title: Potted Pork-Stuffed Pork Roast
ingredients: 1 lb pork roast | 1 lb dried smoked pork fat | 1/2 bunch fresh flat-leaf parsley, stemmed
instructions: If necessary, place pork roast in a slow cooker. Add enough water to make a 2½ qt slow cooker.

title: Barbecue Ribs
ingredients: 8 racks pork spareribs | 8 fluid ounces tequila | 8 fluid ounces celery leaves
instructions: Using a meat mallot or mortor, trim the ribs to fit the ribs in a single layer. Place the ribs in a large flat baking dish or tin with enough room on the sides to make them completely flat. Pour the tequila over the ribs and leave in the fridge overnight. The next day, preheat the oven to 300°f place the ribs on the rack and bake them in the oven for two hours, basting frequently with the tequila and celery leaves, until well shiedred and cooked through.

title: Rolad of Salmon on Smoked Beef and Lentils(Cindebac Mts
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb raw salmon ( about 20 ) | 1 -2 lb raw salmon ( about 20 ) | 2 -3 smoked beef brisket | 1/4 cup raw green lentils | 1/4 cup browned barley | 2 -3 drops green food coloring | 3 tablespoons finely chopped celery | 2/3 cup old fashioned oats
instructions: Start by cutting the fatty tissues off the smoked brisket and slicing off any white ribs from your hands. The brisket should be approximately 3 long and 2 wide. Then take one slice of brisket and cut across the grain about 1/8 inch thick. Repeat the procedure and slice across more finely until all slices are cut in to 3 smaller pieces. The fat portions can be removed in between cutting if desired. Place the slices between sheets of plastic wrap and flatten to about 1/4 inch thick. Wrap each slice in cellophane and set aside for about 1 hour. Do not use any water in the process of shredding. Remove the meat from the refrigerator, drain off any fat and put it in the smoker. It should be fully cooked when ready to put in in your rag. The amount of smoked fat depends on your smoker. Once the meat has cooled it can be frozen or frozen until ready to use. While the meat is cooling, put the lentils in a large bowl and cover with cold water. This needs to be done in 15 to 20 minutes depending on how thick the lentils are and how much saltiness there is. Drain. Mix all ingredients in the bowl and transfer into a ziplock and place in the refrigerator until ready to serve. The next day, preheat the smoker to 250°f and if the fire is too hot, cover tightly with aluminium foil. Put the smoked brisket in the smoker and smoke over low or medium high heat, making sure every 500ml/7lb of meat is covered. Turn meat once every 5 hours to redistribute the meat with the liquid, making sure to leave space in between the brisket for smoke to penetrate. You want to leave about 1/4 and half inch of smoke in the smoker so the meat smoker can remain lit longer and smoke a bit more. The brisket will be ready in 30 to 40 minutes when smoking. If your smoke is too dark, you should add a little more water. About half an hour before smoking, take the brisket out of the smoker and smoke until dry and juicy. About 1½ hours after smoking, check the fat content. It should not be oily. This is ready. If too browned, this is too bitter. About 15 minutes from smoking time to cooking time, remove from smoker and allow to rest a few minutes and turn meat on a cutting board. Slice the meat thinly against the grain. The goal is not to slice too fine, but rather to get as much meat as possible out of the skin that can easily be discarded. This will also produce a better, crisper sausage. Serve on paper towels, with shredded cabbage, sliced green onion, and hot pepper sauce, depending on how much you like spicy food.

title: Spicy Apple Chickpea Stew (Hummus)
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 3 tart apples, chopped | 1/2 cup bamboo shoot, chopped | 1 bouillon, cube | 2 tablespoons pumpkin seeds
instructions: Put all ingredients into a food processor or blender and process until smooth. Serve on rice or flatbread for a tasty stew.

title: Apple-Pinto Beans
ingredients: 6 cups pinto beans, rinsed | 1 large apple - peeled, cored and diced | 1 bunch fresh coriander, chopped, or more to taste | 3/4 cup chopped, cooked chicken ( optional )
instructions: Place the pinto beans into a large pot and fill with enough water to cover by 2. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer until tender, about 5 minutes. Drain and discard any remaining water. Place the apple and corriander, 1 tablespoon of water, and chicken in a food processor or blender and pulse until chopped. Return to the pot and stir. Pour this over the cooked beans, if desired, and cook just until heated through.

title: Sweet Potato Salad
ingredients: 4 lbs red potatoes, scrubbed | 5 avocados, sliced | 3 1/2 quarts ginger ale | 1 3/4 cups dark brown sugar | 2 cups prepared horseradish
instructions: Cut unpeeled potatoes into small chunks. Place potatoes and avocados in a large pot of salted boiling water. Cook over medium heat for 7 to 8 minutes or until a knife can be inserted and easily pierce the center of a potato and the flesh is easily pulled out of the skin. Gently fold the potato chunks, ginger ale, brown sugar and horseradish into the potatoes. Pour into a large serving bowl or serve directly out of the bowl. Place in refrigerator and chill.

title: Cajun Style Onions
ingredients: 2 large vidalia onions, peeled and halved | 4 tablespoons english mustard | 1 teaspoon fresh rubbed sage leaves, or more to taste | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium high heat and lightly oil grate. Place onions in a bowl, and sprinkle with salt. Toss gently to coat onions with salt. Let marinate at least 30 minutes in the refrigerator, up to up to 12 hours. Preheat an outdoor grill for medium high heat and lightly oil grate. Reduce heat to medium. Spread mustard evenly on cut side of grilled onions. Sprinkle sage and seasoned salt over the mustard. Cook until onions are soft and lightly browned, about 30 minutes.

title: Moorish Beef and Potato Broth (Durbis Samosas)
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef, cut into cubes | 3 lbs wheat bran | 1 tablespoon corn | 5 tablespoons dry crushed red chili peppers | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom | 4 2 lbs stewing beef
instructions: Mix the bran with the rest of the ingredients and bring to a boil to thicken it.

title: Pasta With Lemon, Garlic and Lemon Grass
ingredients: 6 -8 servings dried tri-tip steak | 2 tablespoons fresh sage leaves, coarsely chopped | 4 tablespoons lemon grass, chopped ( stalk part only ) | 1 lb pasta
instructions: Cook the tri tip steak in hot water until barely done. Transfer the tri tip to a platter and set aside. Discard water. When it is cool enough to handle, shred the meat with your hands and set aside. In a large pot of water, combine the sage, chopped lemongrass and white rice vinegar. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer until the mixture is slightly syrupy. While the mixture cooks, cook the pasta with a little salt and olive oil. When it is tender, drain and return the pasta to the water. Drain the pasta and return it to the pot. Add the sliced tri tip, sage and lemon grass. Simmer the mixture until it is hot and heated through. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: brown rice,tomato sauce,red pepper,lemon peel,lime leaf
title: Tomato Rice
ingredients: 1 cup brown rice, uncooked | 2 1/2 cups tomato sauce, divided | 1 red pepper, diced small | 1 teaspoon dried lime peel | 1 teaspoon lemon peel
instructions: Place cooked rice in a bowl and mix with 1/3 cup sauce, red pepper, lime peel and 1/2 cup tomato sauce. Cover and refrigerate for at least 20 minutes. Serve over brown rice.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,red cabbage,red chili pepper,radicchio,rice,baby spinach,kaffir lime leaf
title: Spinach and Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 250 g red cabbage, thinly sliced | 1 red chili pepper, seeded | 2 kaffir lime leaves, torn | 125 g baby spinach | 1 cup cooked rice | 150 ml cream of chicken soup | 150 g radicchio
instructions: Remove or leave the core from the cabbage and slice the body from the core, then cut into quarters. Place the cabbage and chilli pepper in a microwave safe bowl, cover with water, place on the microwave and cook uncovered on full power for 7 minutes or until tender. Alternatively, you can just eat the cabbage sliced, but take the cabbage out and place on a plate lined with a tea towel and squeeze out the excess water. Set aside. Add the spinach, cook, uncovered, on full power for 1 minute or until it has wilted. Drain, mix through the spinach with the rice, spinach and chilli and add the soup. Place the radicchio leaves on a chopping board, slice the head from stem and place on a sheet of cheesecloth, or use a tea towel to drain up any water. Place the vegetables side by side and roll up, pressing with the cheesecloth to secure tightly. Wrap in tin foil and refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: chocolate,basmati rice,scallop,self raising flour,pink grapefruit juice,green cardamom,rice vinegar
title: Crazy Chocolate and Scallops With Rice (Gluten-Free)
ingredients: 2 cups of basmati rice, cleaned and washed well | 1/2 cup green cardamom ( pods ) | 250 g self-raising flour | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 120 g grated dark semi-sweet chocolate ( about 1 ounce ) | 1 3/4 kg scallops | fresh ground pink grapefruit juice ( optional )
instructions: To make the batter, in a bowl mix the rice vinegar and green cardamom pods. Set aside. In a non stick frying pan heat the pan over a moderate heat. Pour in about 3 tablespoons of the batter and swirl it around to coat and cook for about 1 minute. Remove from the heat and keep warm. Cook the scallops in the remaining 2 tablespoons of oil in the same pan, about 3 to 5 minutes each side or until browned. Remove from the pan and keep warm. In a bowl, mix the flour with the rice vinegar. Gradually add the hot water gradually stirring with a whisk. Cook for about 2 minutes, stirring continuously. In a separate saucepan, heat the chocolate over a low heat, about 5 minutes or until smooth. Pour the melted chocolate into the egg and beat with a tablespoonful of water until just combined. Pour the chocolate water into the rice batter, stirring with a fork. Return the rice batter to the pan, then stir constantly. Serve with the scallops and hot pink grapefruit, if desired.

title: Simple Croutons
ingredients: 6 -7 tablespoons croutons | 1/2 teaspoon orange zest
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Combine in a small bowl croutons and crouton mixture. Sprinkle top with grated orange peel.

title: Easy Baked Italian Chicken
ingredients: 1 whole chicken | 1 bottle alfredo sauce ( i recommend my bistro spread for pizza sauce ) | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 tablespoon fresh yeast | 1 cup vegetable stock
instructions: Remove and slash the fat from the chicken and place in a 9 x13 baking pan with 1/2 of the alfredo sauce. If you don't have a deep oven, you can do this in a crock pot. Mix the rest of the olives, the bouillon cube and fresh yeast in a cup, pour over the chicken and pour the 1 1/2 of the broth over the top. Allow to marinating overnight in the refrigerator for best results. You can refrigerate it for at least 30 minutes to really help the flavors develop. The longer you leave in it in it, the better the flavor. Preheat the oven to 425 degrees farenheit. Bake the chicken for 40 minutes, then lower heat to 250 and bake longer if you want.

Random Ingredients: strawberry jell o gelatin dessert,hamburger bun,rom tomato,bean sprout,beef roast
title: Crock Pot Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 package strawberry jell-o gelatin dessert | 1 1/4 lbs boneless beef roast | 3 roma tomatoes, sliced thinly | 1 can refried beans with chili ( hot ) | 4 -8 hamburger buns
instructions: Mix jello with meat in slow cooker. Stir in tomatoes. Cover and cook on low 6 - 8 hours. Serve with sliced roma tomato and chopped black olives on top. Serve with buns.

title: Italian Crab and Spinach Dip
ingredients: 3 cups crab | 3 pieces havarti cheese | 2 cups chopped spinach | 1/3 cup hi-fat yoghurt | 1/4 cup crushed fresh cracker ( optional )
instructions: Combine the crab, cheese, spinach, yoghurt and cracker. Place mixture into a baking dish and bake at 350 degrees f for about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cooking spray,strawberry,meat,red curry paste,black eyed pea
title: Thai Green Oven Vegetables
ingredients: 450 g frozen black-eyed peas | 2 teaspoons red curry paste | 450 g frozen meat, thawed and diced finely | 500 g frozen strawberries, thawed and quartered | cooking spray
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c and spray 8x8 casserole dish with oil. Add the black eyed peas, curry paste and meat to casserole dish. Pour water into dish to capacity. Bake for 45 minutes. Remove from oven and pour contents of dish onto casserole dish. Cover loosely with foil then return dish to oven on middle rack. Bake for a further 15 - 20 minutes until sauce reduces and thickens slightly and meat mixture becomes cooked. Serve with steamed rice and top with chopped tomato and scallions.

title: Crispy Salt Crusted Beef
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs flank steaks ( about 5-6 steaks ) | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme sprig, chopped | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper ( more may be used if desired )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees fahrenheit. Place steaks on a rack in a shallow baking pan, cover loosely with plastic wrap, and set aside. Pour oil into a 3 1/2 3 - 3 1/2 quart saucepan. Add thyme, cayenne, and bring to a boil over high heat. Boil 2 minutes while shaking pan. Pour off all but 1 tablespoons of the oil. Return pan to high heat. When the pan is hot, spread the steaks in a single layer and place them in the pan. Bake steak for 30 to 40 minutes, turning and brushing with more oil. Turn the meat after 15 minutes. The meat should be golden brown and well cooked, basting with the pan juices. Remove the meat to plate and cover loosely with a kitchen towel. Pour hot oil out of pan and keep covered with a kitchen towel. Cook ssteaks over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes per side until desired doneness.

Random Ingredients: pine nut,carrot,green olive,prosciutto ham,almond extract,raspberry jam
title: Radioli
ingredients: 1/2 cup blanched almond breeze whole almond breeze ( or toasted almond breeze with almonds and raisins mixed together ) or 1/2 cup unsweetened almond breeze, mixed mixed ( or toasted almond breeze with almonds and raisins mixed together ) | 1/2 carrot, peeled and shredded | 1/2 cup fresh raspberry jam | 1/2 cup prosciutto ham, trimmed, cut crosswise into thin strips ( about 1/4 inch thick ) | 1/2 cup toasted pine nuts | additional raspberries in season ( optional ) or fresh raspberry jam ( optional )
instructions: Toast almonds breeze in a heavy dry skillet, stirring, just until golden. Transfer to a bowl or platter and let cool to room temperature.. Discard skins and seeds from almond breeze and almond breeze. If using raspberries, sprinkle in now. Add prosciutto, pine nuts and almond breeze in a bowl and toss to combine. Add nuts to raspberry mixture and gently fold. Place raspberries/jelly in a small bowl and let marinate for at least 1/4 hour at room temperature. Transfer mixture to a small pasta serving platter, spooned on nuts, and garnish with additional fresh raspberry or raspberry jam, if desired.

title: Brunch Mushrooms
ingredients: 4 medium fresh mushrooms | 2 ounces cream cheese | 2 tablespoons goat cheese | 1 sour cream | 1 teaspoon dried thyme sprig | 1 cup cream | 2 teaspoons dried italian seasoning | 4 teaspoons brandy
instructions: Wash mushrooms and cut stems away from caps. Wash, dry well and clean mushroom stems. Remove stems and remove hard center stem portion of stems. Wrap each mushroom with a thin slice and secure with toothpick. Mix mushrooms with other ingredients except brandy and garnish. Cover& chill until serving time. To serve, heat brandy in a small bowl over medium heat until hot. Remove toothpick from each mushroom and place on serving plate. Top each with a dollop of melted butter and your choice of garnish.

title: Berbere
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cayenne pepper ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon mustard seed | 1 teaspoon white sugar | 1 teaspoon ground coriander | 1/2 cup minced green peppers
instructions: Heat a dry skillet over medium heat. Toast cayenne pepper, mustard seed, sugar and coriander in the hot mixture until sugar has turned dark brown. Stir in the pepper and cook until tender. Cool. Store in a sealed container, refrigerated.

title: Cantaloupe Sandwiches
