ingredients: 1 can cantaloupe | 12 hamburger rolls
instructions: Slice cantaloupe 1/4 inch thick. Lay out 4 slices across the bottom of each roll. Fill each with 3 to 4 tablespoons of hamburger. Wrap with top two thirds of rolls. Enjoy.

title: French Fennel-Scallion and Fennel Seed Mousse
ingredients: 1 bunch scallion, coarsely chopped ( about 2 tablespoons ) | 1/2 cup half-and-half | 1 1/2 teaspoons fennel seeds
instructions: In a small bowl, stir the scallions with the half and half, 1 1/2 teaspoons of the fennel seeds and 1/2 teaspoon of the salt. Sprinkle the remaining fennel seeds over top, cover and refrigerate the mousse until ready to serve at least 6 hours, but overnight keeps in the refrigerator.

title: Tobiko
ingredients: 1 package cottage cheese | 1 container pickling spice | 10 canned mandarin orange segments, drained | 8 ounces nutella
instructions: Mix cottage cheese and 1 packet of pickling spice in a large bowl. Slice reserved mandarin segments in half if needed to fit into a cup. Strain mandarin juice to remove segments and reserve juice. Combine reserved mandarin juice and about 8 ounces of remaining spice mix with mandarin segments. Mix contents of reserved spice packet with cottage cheese mixture and set aside. Serve as an appetizer at room temperature.

title: Tarragon Hot Mallow
ingredients: 300 g marshmallows | 1 -2 teaspoon coffee granules | 300 ml hot coffee
instructions: Grind the marshmallows and coffee granules together to make a fine paste. Add half a cup of hot coffee to the marshmallow paste. Beat with a fork until the mixture starts to form clumps. Pour into an 8 inch square baking dish lined with aluminum foil. Add a little extra coffee if necessary. Place in the freezer for 4 to 6 hours. Turn out onto a serving plate.

title: Slow-Cooked Beef Rump
ingredients: 1 rump steak, trimmed | 1/2 red onion, chopped
instructions: Place all ingredients in a crockpot. Cover with lid. Place on high for 4 hours serve.

Random Ingredients: pineapple,tempeh,pearl barley,french onion,rice,hash brown potato,beef chuck roast
title: Crock Pot Baked Irish Stew
ingredients: 1/2 cup quick cooking rice ( i use brown rice per my recipes ) | 1 1/2 cups cubed fully cooked hash brown potatoes | 1 jar french-fried onions | 1 can crushed pineapple | 1/2 cup pearl barley, uncooked | 1 beef chuck roast, with bone | 1 package tempeh, cut in 1 cubes
instructions: Drain rice. Place the rice, hashbrowns, onion, pineapple and cooked barley in the crock pot. Mix together the remaining ingredients. Cook on high for one hour or low for three hours. Serve with crusty bread.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,golden syrup,kernel corn,chicken gravy,vanilla bean,poblano chile,beef bouillon granule,oregano leaf
title: Mexican Chicken & Corn Gravy(Diabetic Friendly)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground pork ( lean can use ham or can use turkey ) or 1 1/2 lbs ground turkey ( lean can use ham or can use turkey ) | 1 tablespoon golden syrup ( light mayo will also work ) | 1 can diced tomatoes and green chilies, undrained | 2 poblano chiles, roasted, peeled, seeded, chopped ( wear rubber gloves ) | 7 cups chicken gravy, canned | 1 can whole kernel corn, undrained | 1/4 cup tomato reduced-sodium instant beef bouillon granules | 2 teaspoons dried oregano leaves
instructions: If using meat, place in a 3 to 4 quart slow cooker. In a small bowl, combine undrained tomatoes and green chilies, cooked poblanos, gravy and other ingredients.

title: Beef With Leeks
ingredients: 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 750 g beef, chopped into 2 cm size pieces | 200 g leeks, cut into 2cm sections, white and green sections, washed thoroughly and halved lengthwise | 1 capsicum, chopped | 1 can water chestnuts, rinsed and drained | 1/4 - 1/2 cup chinese wine | 1 -2 teaspoon chili oil ( to taste )
instructions: Heat the oil in a large frying pan or wok and over high heat, add the beef and quickly stir fry until lightly coloured and cooked through. Remove beef from the heat and set aside. Add the leeks, capsicum and water chestnuts to the pan. Add the chinese wine and simmer, covered, stirring every now and again, for one hour or longer. If it is too watery, reduce heat, then stir in the oil. Serve with white rice.

Random Ingredients: vegetable juice,chinese five spice powder,venison,bean,parsley,broccoli rabe,prosciutto
title: Chinese Five-Spice Venison Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs center round venison, cut 2/3 inch thick and 1/2 inch thick | 1 tablespoon vegetable juice | 1 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 8 ounces bahong bao beans ( spicy vietnamese noodles ) or 8 ounces frozen peeled mixed beans, thawed ( spicy noodles ) | 2 1/2 cups frozen broccoli rabe, thawed | 2 ounces prosciutto, chopped | 1/4 cup parsley, chopped
instructions: Place the venison in a large baking dish, and spray with cooking spray. Sprinkle with five spice powder. Cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate 4 hours. Prepare the bahong bao noodles as directed on the package. Drain well, and toss with 1/2 cup of the beans and the broccoli rabe. Slice the venison and arrange on top of the bean mixture. Add the prosciutto and parsley, and drizzle with remaining 3/4 cup of vegetables for additional flavor. Cover, and refrigerate 4 hours, or overnight. Slice, and serve.

title: Simple and Fast Grilled Tilapia (Low-Grill)
ingredients: 4 tilapia fillets | 1/4 cup zesty italian salad dressing | 2 chipotle chiles ( chopped )
instructions: Marinated or purchased chipotle chilies with adobo sauce can be used depending on how spicy or salty the chipotles are. Lay the fillets on the work surface and spread generously with the salad dressing to coat the fillets evenly. Sprinkle with chipotles. Grill as directed on the label. Note, you can use your grill during the actual grilling stage to sear the fish nicely and give a 'cooked' flavor. The only thing i do is let it cool a bit before turning over the fish. Also if you grill on indoor coals, you can use a cast iron grill pan that has a good amount of olive oil and cooking spray on top of the fish.

title: Roast Beef Roll-Ups
ingredients: 200 g cooked spaghetti | 1 kg beef roll beef | 1 1/2 teaspoons five-spice powder | oat ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 230 degrees celsius. Mix the seasoning and roll mixture into meat roll, using 1 tablespoon of seasoning for each roll. Spread on oat if using, if using. Roast in oven for 5 hours.

title: Raisin Flour Tortillas
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cornflour | 2 cups vegetable broth
instructions: Mix corn flour and vegetable broth together. Dip tortillas into the broth and fry. The idea is to have the corn flour fully coat the entire tortilla. Drain on paper towels once all pieces are fried.

title: Crema de Crema
ingredients: 4 tablespoons crema ( or other anise flavored liqueur ) | celery rib, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Place the creme in a medium sized bowl. Add the onion, celery and a pinch of salt. Toss to combine well until well mixed and the salt has dissolved. Refrigerate until serving time.

title: Lazy Daisy
ingredients: 2 packages ladyfingers | 2 cans golden mushroom soup | 1 lb pork
instructions: Cut the pork up into bite sized pieces and put in crock pot so there is no stuffing or grilling. Add the mushrooms and soup. If you can watch youll miss that.

title: Eggplant Phyllo Triangles With Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 4 tablespoons oil, divided | 1 large eggplant | 1 bunch oyster | 1 -2 cup black olives, pitted and rough chopped | 1 package phyllo pastry sheets | 1 avocado
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Slice eggplant into large cubes. Saute in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat until lightly brown, stirring constantly. Add olives and cook for another 5 minutes. Remove from heat, add phyllo and set aside. Layer 1/4 of eggplant, 1/4 of olives, and 1 1/4 of the oysters in the bottom of the baking dish. Take a phyllo sheet and cut to 3 - 5 squares. Dot work surface with 1 tbsp of olive oil. Place 2 - 3 tbsp of eggplant mixture in the center, leaving about 1 - 2 in. Of phyllo bare on top of the sauce mixture. Place 3rd phyllo square on top and repeat steps 3 - 2 4, adding an additional 2 tbsp of oil if needed. Brush top of eggplant with eggplant mixture. Bake for 45 minutes until phyllo has puffed up and golden.

Random Ingredients: ouzo,brown gravy mix,lime wedge,rice noodle,italian bread,guinness stout
title: Lime, Garlic, and Ouzo Rice Noodle Loaf
ingredients: 8 ounces uncooked dry rice noodles | 1 can or bottle dark beer | 1 package brown gravy mix | 2 envelopes uzo | 1 can guinness stout | 2 lime wedges
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Arrange rice noodles in a 9x5 inch loaf pan. Pour beer over noodles. Cover with foil. Bake in the preheated oven until noodles have absorbed most of the beer, 20 to 25 minutes. Add brown gravy mix, and guiness. Remove foil, and continue baking until the rice gets a dark brown, about 7 to 10 more minutes. Remove from oven. Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a boil. Mix in uzo. Return to a boil and cook for 3 to 5 minutes, or until tender yet firm to the bite. Drain and discard water. Scoop guiness over rice. Serve in a punch bowl with lime wedges.

title: Stir Fry Beef, Parsnips and Blueberries
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, cut | 2 cups fresh blueberries | 1 medium parsnip, peeled and cut into 1/2 inch rounds | 2 tablespoons ghee | 1/2 cup light italian salad dressing | 7 ounces small shell pasta or 7 ounces linguine
instructions: Cook the beef, parsnips and blueberries in a medium pot of boiling water until the meat is tender. Melt the ghee in a medium frypan over medium heat. Add the salad dressing and stir to heat through, about one minute. Add the beef, parsnips and blueberries, and mix, cooking for two minutes. Serve with pasta.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,tomato puree,lamb chop,bean,lettuce green,penne pasta
title: Lamb Chops Pasta with Penne and Beans
ingredients: 20 ounces penne pasta | 2 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 1 lb lamb chop | 4 cups mixed lettuces ( green and white ) | 2 cans tomato puree | 8 ounces baked beans ( i prefer dark green )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Cook pasta as directed on package, until al dente. Meanwhile, heat flour in skillet over medium high heat until bubbly. Add lamb, reduce heat to medium and cook, stirring frequently, 3 - 5 minutes or until just golden brown. Add green, beans and tomato puree. Bring to boil and return pasta to pan. Mix well and transfer to a casserole dish. Sprinkle with bread crumbs and bake, uncovered, 15 minutes or until hot. Serve at once.

title: Eggplant Salad
ingredients: 2 large eggplants | 2 cans artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | 1/4 cup cold water | 1/2 - 3/4 cup peanut oil, you can use olive oil | 3 -4 tablespoons fresh mint, minced or 1 teaspoon dried mint | 2 -4 drops tabasco sauce ( to taste )
instructions: Slice the eggplants crosswise, about 1/8 inch thick. Heat oil in saucepan, add the eggplant slices, and saute, stirring occasionally, until eggplant slices are golden brown and tender, about 5 minutes. Add 1/4 cup cold water and the chives, mint, and tabasco, to taste. Mix well. Allow the salad to cool slightly, then store in refridgerator for up to a week.

Random Ingredients: xanthan gum,garlic salt,asparagus spear,beet,flat leaf parsley,french bread,cherry,red chilies
title: Beet Salad With Crispy Bread Chips
ingredients: 1 tablespoon beet, finely chopped | 2 fresh red chilies, seeded and diced | 1/4 cup flat leaf parsley, chopped | 2 tablespoons asparagus spears, chopped | 1/8 teaspoon xanthan gum | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/4 teaspoon french bread, cut into 8 thin slices | 4 cherry, halves for decoration, if desired
instructions: Mix the beetroot, chillies, parsley and asparagus together. Add xanthan gum, garlic salt and bread. Toss lightly. Sprinkle with a few drops of oil and decorate with some cherry halves, if desired.

title: Yummy Sushi
ingredients: 5 cups cooked jasmine rice ( cold ) | nori
instructions: Line a sheet of nori with plastic wrap. Place 1 - 2 cups of cold jasmine rice on the nori. Roll the nori up into a tight cylinder about 2/3 inch in diameter. Once rolled, cut into 12 - 15 squares. Serve as you would any sushi.

title: Lazy-Beef Broth
ingredients: 1 beef shank | 5 eggs | 4 lbs beef roast | canola oil
instructions: First trim off the excess fat or any fat that accumulates on the surface, as it has to be very fatty. Remove all of the sinew, then slice the beef thin, about 5 x5 inches. Break each egg into a small bowl, and set aside. Cut the shank into large chunks and set aside. In a large pan, heat 1/2 inch of canola oil over high heat. Brown the beef about 3 minutes or so a side dish of beef for frying is best for this. Remove the beef and set aside. In the same pan add 1/2 inch of canola oil, and fry the egg slices until they are nice and crispy, set aside on paper towels to drain oil from the pan. In the same pan, heat up about 1/2 inch of the canola oil. Drain the shank well, then place it in the pan with the fried egg slices. Mix the contents with the broth. If using a food processor, you may want to place the eggs in the food processor too. If using a blender, use a high speed to mix the contents and allow the broth to reach a boil before adding the raw scrambled egg. Bring the broth to a boil, scraping the bottom frequently. Add the beef and cook covered about 3 - 4 minutes, allowing the juices to run clear. Remove the beef and broth mixture to a slow cooker, then pour in the oil, beaten eggs, and enough beef or broth to cover the meat. Cook on low for 3 - 4 hours, stirring often until the meat is fork tender. Add salt & pepper to taste, and serve hot or warm.

title: Sherry Baked Chiles
ingredients: 1 bunch cilantro, stemmed | 3 serrano chilies, seeded | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 2 tablespoons dark rum | 1/2 cup dry sherry
instructions: Preheat oven to c. Seed the chilies, removing seeds, and place on a baking sheet. Bake until the skin loosens and darkened, 20 to 35 minutes. Remove chilies from the oven. Cool, remove skin and slit the chilies lengthwise. Remove seeds and veins, then mince. Process chile with rum and cilantro to a coarse paste. Place mixture in a food processor and puree to a paste. Place paste in a small bowl, cover, and refrigerate for 1 hour. To assemble, place chiles on a baking sheet. Pour sherry and hot tomato sauce over them. Serve at once.

title: Buttermilk Mint Sauce
ingredients: 1 ounce sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and finely chopped | 1 ounce mint, chopped finely | 1 ounce red onion, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon cornflour | 1 1/2 ounces golden syrup | 8 ounces buttermilk
instructions: Put all the ingredients in a blender, whiz on high and strain into a jug. Serve it cold and leave to cool. Note, the sauce will thicken and turn a lovely golden brown.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,beef broth,egg noodle,beef chuck,worcestershire sauce,beef tenderloin,turkey
title: Lennie's Beef Noodle Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs beef chuck, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1 lb beef tenderloin, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1 can beef broth | 1 jar picante sauce | 2 - 2 1/2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 4 cups egg noodles | 1 1/2 cups cooked and drained turkey
instructions: Brown hamburger and beef tenderloins in 3 quart dutch oven.

title: Spaghetti Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces spaghetti | 1 bunch fresh dill | 1 -2 dash tabasco sauce ( optional )
instructions: Cook the pasta. The pasta should be al dente. When cooked drain the pasta. Combine in a bowl with herbs, tabasco & dressing/sugar. Mix well. Serve over hot crisp bagels.

Random Ingredients: tabasco sauce,cheese,red kidney bean,rigatoni pasta,paad thai sauce
title: Rigatoni & Bean Pasta #RSC
ingredients: 250 g rigatoni pasta or 250 g pancetta | 2 red kidney beans | 1 -3 drops tabasco sauce ( or to taste ) | 80 g tasty cheese | 80 g paad thai sauce
instructions: Boil rigatoni. Drain and put under running water. Drain and put under running water for 3 5mins or until cooked. Fry pancetta and put into casserole dish. Break beans and add to casserole. Add remaining ingredients. Cover and cook in moderate oven for 25 30mins or until cheese is melted.

title: Pear and Garlic Rice
ingredients: 1/2 lb jasmine rice or 1/2 lb sweet rice, washed and drained | 1 medium onion, finely chopped | 2 medium pears, peeled, cored and sliced thinly | 2 spring onions, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons mirin | 1/4 cup ripe olives, sliced | 1 small apple, grated
instructions: Cover the bottom of a wok with oil. Heat, and add the rice, onion and spring onions. Stir fry for 2 minutes. Add the pears and olives and cook for a minute. Add the mirin. Cover and cook on medium heat until rice is cooked through. Serve at once.

title: Indian Beans
ingredients: 1 lb red beans ( or green beans ) | 3 cups fresh green beans ( or just green leaves ) | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Combine beans, green beans and turmeric and let slow cook overnight. Serve hot.

title: Xanthoxos' Scallops
ingredients: 1 tablespoon xanthoxo gum | 1 1/2 lbs fresh scallops | 1 lb beef, cut in 2-inchx1/4-inch slices ( i like spicy food ) | 1 celery rib, cut in 2-inch pieces | fresh mint sprig ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: In a large covered bowl, mix the xanthoxo, scallops and meat. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate 4 - 12 hours or overnight. Drain the vegetables and discard them. When you're done marinating remove wrap and pat scallops dry with paper towels. Heat oil in frying pan over medium heat. Using a slotted spoon, lower the scallops into the pan. Cook for 3 - 4 minutes on each side. Serve hot, garnished with fresh mint sprigs if desired.

title: Macaroni and Tuna in Tinga
ingredients: 1/3 cup self-rising flour | 1/2 cup dry elbow macaroni | 1 can tuna in water, drained | 8 tostadas | 1/4 cup grand marnier | 1 pinch ground nutmeg | 1 slice bread, torn into small pieces
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Cook elbow macaroni until tender yet firm, about 4 minutes.

title: Coconut, Prawn, Leek & Broccoli With Dill Pickle
ingredients: 1 tablespoon coconut oil | 3 medium leeks, sliced ( white part only ) | 1 large stalk broccoli floret, halved ( about 5 cups ) | 1/8 teaspoon anise seed | 2/3 lb prawns ( raw, uncooked ) | 5 tablespoons desiccated unsweetened coconut ( or a mixture of both to taste ) | 8 tablespoons chopped flat leaf parsley
instructions: Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan. Fry the leeks and broccoli on a high heat for 4 - 5 minutes, until soft and golden. Add the the anise seeds and fry for 3 minutes more. Add the shelled prawns and cover until just cooked through. While the prawns are cooking, in a large bowl combine all the ingredients except the coconut, garnish with some chopped flat leaf parsley and serve.

title: Ginger & Apricot Mini Tart
ingredients: 1 packet sweet pastry | 200 g italian tomatoes, sliced | 100 g strawberries, sliced | 125 g apricot preserves | 1 tablespoon tamari | 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger | 1/4 cup shredded ginger | 1 tomatoes, sliced
instructions: Roll out pastry to approx 6mm thickness, using a glass or round cutter. Line a 30cm x 20cm slice tin with pastry. Press 1/2 tsp jam decoratively into base of prepared tin. Layer over the jam apricot slices, the remaining tomatoes and the remaining jam. Seal the edge of pastry with a fork. Bake in preheated oven 180 c for 35mins or until pastry is risen & golden. Allow to cool.

title: Easy Brown Rice for One
ingredients: 1/4 cup water chestnut, chopped | 1 cup prepared brown rice, cooled ( long grain ) | 1 cup plain fat-free yogurt
instructions: Microwave water chestnuts in water 2 minutes. Stir and microwave 2 more minute. Add rice and stir again. Microwave yogurt. Stir to mix. Microwave for 2 more minute. Stir and microwave 2 more minute. Microwave 20 more minutes. Stir and microwave 10 more minutes for one minute. Add water chestnuts, heat through.

Random Ingredients: red chile pepper,liquid honey,basil leaf,cabbage,seasoning salt,spaghetti
title: Spaghetti Agria (Chile Slaw)
ingredients: 1 package spaghetti | 1 tablespoon dry crushed red chile pepper | 1 tablespoon sodium-free seasoning salt | 1/2 head cabbage, finely shredded | 1 tablespoon fresh basil leaves, chopped | 1 tablespoon liquid honey
instructions: Cook pasta in a large pot of boiling water for 8 to 12 minutes. Reserve 12 cups cooking liquid. Meanwhile, in a large bowl, mix chili, salt and pasta cooking liquid. Transfer to a separate bowl and add 1/2 of shredded cabbage, basil and honey. Toss to mix. Scoop some of the slaw, and squeeze as much excess liquid out as possible. Serve remaining slaw on a platter.

title: Quick Carrot Cream
ingredients: 600 ml double cream ( or whipping cream ) | 1 cup finely grated carrot
instructions: Whip the cream in a bowl with electric beaters, till it forms stiff peaks, but not yet frothy. Add a cup of finely grated carrot. Stir. Pour the cream into a large bowl or jug, and whip till it's just starting to stiffen, but not yet liquid, and is still very thick. Serve immediately. This will keep for up to 2 days in the refrigerator, tightly covered.

Random Ingredients: broth,chipotle chile,pinto bean,baby carrot,anise,green chile,maple syrup,beef sirloin
title: Santa Fe Beef & Bean Stew
ingredients: 12 fluid ounces broth | 2 lbs beef sirloin, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 can diced green chiles | 4 ounces canned diced chipotle chiles | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 1/2 cup frozen cut baby carrots | 1 large can pinto beans, drained
instructions: Put all ingredients into a crockpot. Do not drain. Cover and cook on low 8 - 10 hours.

title: Shortbread
ingredients: 1 lb vegetable shortening | 1/2 cup apricot jam
instructions: Cream shortening using a stand mixer and flour if necessary until mixture is smooth and fluffy. Whip in jam until blended and soft. Press into 1 lb cookie sheet or parchment paper and cut into rectangles. Bake at 325 degrees f. Filling will be very dry.

title: German Egg Salad II
ingredients: 1/2 lb hard-boiled egg, peeled and sliced | 1/2 lb green or green beans, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1/2 teaspoon dried dill weed | 2 tablespoons of chopped green onions or 2 tablespoons red onion | 2 slices rye bread, cut from crusts
instructions: Place eggs and green beans in large bowl. Slightly mash with fork. Mix in dill. Place bread slices on top of egg mixture, but leave a few crusty slices attached. Sprinkle with onions. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 2 hours, but overnight is best.

Random Ingredients: egg noodle,turkey breast,virgin olive oil,sun tomato oil,butter bean,white miso,linguine,dill leaf
title: Garlic Lover's Chicken
ingredients: 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained | 1 small garlic clove, smashed | 1 boneless skinless turkey breast, trimmed | 2 teaspoons sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained | 1 tablespoon virgin olive oil | 1 package dry linguine | 2 tablespoons butter beans, drained | 1/2 cup fresh dill leaves | 2 tablespoons low-fat white miso
instructions: Place sun dried tomatoes and garlic in a food processor with turkey and process until finely chopped. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add mushrooms. Cook, stirring often, for 5 minutes, until lightly browned. Stir in chopped tomato and cook about 2 minutes. While mushrooms cook, cook linguine in a large pot of boiling water until al dente. Drain well. Toss cooked noodles with butter beans and dill. Remove 1/3 cup of skillet liquid and stir into chicken and tomato mixture. Simmer, stirring constantly, 1 to 2 minutes, until sauce coats pasta. Stir miso into sauce just before removing from heat. Serve.

title: St. Brenden's Cafeteria Baked Beets
ingredients: 8 medium beets, cleaned and peeled | 4 slices prosciutto | 1 tablespoon dried savory | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh onion | 4 tablespoons lard, or as needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Place beets on paper towels, cover with a kitchen towel, and squeeze out excess moisture. Slice off the tops and bottoms of beets with a sharp knife, and place in a deep baking dish or roasting pan with a rack set 2 inches tall across. Insert an ovenproof handle with a large handle to lift beets, and weigh them down with a spoon a few inches above the tops. Sprinkle with savory, minced onion, and lard. Bake beets in the preheated oven until tender, about 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: Chinese Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 lb dry pasta, as per package direction on package ( bowtie, macaroni etc ) | 2 tablespoons ginger paste | 1 bunch lettuce leaf | 1/4 cup dark rum | 1/4 cup grand marnier ( the same thing to taste if using rum )
instructions: Put the pasta in a pot. Add enough water to cover the pasta. Cook on the stove, following package directions, then allow to boil for about 6 more minutes. While pasta is cooking, blend the ginger and garlic paste together. When pasta is done, drain the pasta water, keeping it hot. When the pasta is just shy of done, rinse under running cool water to get rid of the starch. Drain well. Put all ingredients except the dressing in a bowl and mix well. Add dressing and toss. If the salad is too dry, add a touch more water.

Random Ingredients: sesame chili oil,bamboo skewer,orange juice,tap water,shrimp,cornmeal
title: Shrimp Kebabs With Orange
ingredients: 2 1/4 lbs medium shrimp ( cleaned well ) | 2 -3 tablespoons sesame chili oil | 1/2 cup orange juice | 1 teaspoon cornmeal | 1 1/4 cups tap water | 12 bamboo skewers
instructions: Trim shrimp of any excess tail segment. Sprinkle with salt, to taste. Combine shrimp, sesame oil and orange juice in medium bowl and marinate at least 4 hours at room temperature. Dump shrimp onto oiled grill rack and grill over medium heat for 5 minutes. Turn shrimp over and continue to grill until shrimp is cooked through. Sprinkle shrimp with cornmeal and cook over medium heat for 1 more minute. Remove shrimp onto a piece of foil. Seal foil and warm under broiler. Serve with orange sauce.

title: Kulfi Murgh (Yogurt Lassi)
ingredients: 1 cup yogurt | 1 cinnamon stick
instructions: Place the yogurt in a blender. Add the cinnamon stick and puree until smooth. Add more yogurt if mixture is too thick to pour.

title: Mommy's Favorite Cheese Salad
ingredients: 1 loaf lettuce | 5 hard-boiled eggs | 1/2 lb velveeta cheese | 3 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 3 tablespoons cooking oil
instructions: Mix ingredients, add to shredded lettuce in glass dish. Cover with cheese, refrigerate. Serve cold or warm.

Random Ingredients: cayenne,spinach leaf,pine nut,shiitake mushroom,honey,red potato,serrano chilies
title: Sweet Potatoes in Pine Nut Dressing
ingredients: 2 lbs red potatoes, peeled and cut in 1/2-inch cubes | 1/2 cup pine nuts, toasted | 2 tablespoons honey | 3 serrano chilies, stemmed and finely diced | 4 ounces shiitake mushrooms, stemmed | 1 pinch cayenne
instructions: Boil potatoes lightly, about 30 minutes. Remove from heat and let cool until easily handled, about 10 minutes. Drain and put into bowl of ice water. Dry off any excess water from potato mixture. Combine the pine nuts, honey and serrano chiles in a small bowl and set aside. In a large nonstick skillet over medium heat, warm the remaining olive oil and saute the potatoes until they begin to brown, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat. Drain potatoes and add to bowl with spice mixture. Stir gently, coating potatoes well. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Aarsi’s Ultimate Green cardamom (Fish or Beef) Fritters
ingredients: 1 lb fish fillet | 8 green cardamom pods | 1/2 lb mushroom ( preferably wild ones, chopped, if available ) | 1/2 ounce unsweetened baking chocolate | 1 tablespoon blanched almond ( optional )
instructions: Place cardamom pods and cardamom pods in a small heavy saucepan over low medium heat.. When pods split open, remove from heat. Place cardamom pods under cold running water for 1 to 2 seconds. Remove the cardom pods, remove and discard the seeds, and set aside. Place sliced fish in a dry skillet. Season with salt. Heat, stirring occasionally, until fish is opaque throughout, 5 to 7 minutes. Reduce heat to low. Add sliced mushrooms and continue cooking 1 minute. Remove from heat. When fish is cool enough to handle, carefully peel, remove and discard cardamom pods.. Chop the fish and mushrooms into 1/2 inch chunks. Place in a bowl and season to taste with salt. Mix in chocolate and almonds using a fork until incorporated.

title: Greek 77
ingredients: 2 ounces galliano | 2 ounces lemonade
instructions: Strain ingredients into cocktail shaker and shake. Ladle into a martini glass, garnish with lemon wedge and a cherry.

title: Spinach Ala Vodka
ingredients: 1/2 cup rolled oats | 2 packages fresh spinach | 1/2 cup unsweetened coconut | 4 tablespoons dry unsalted peanuts oil or 4 tablespoons vegetable oil, plus more for frying | 2 tablespoons minced fresh spinach | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | seasoning salt, to taste | crackers, for serving ( optional )
instructions: Cook the oat bag according to package instructions. Drain off and save 1/2 cup of the liquid. Place the rolled oats on a plate and set aside. Cut the spinach into 1/2 inch pieces. If using frozen spinach, place in a colander and squeeze out all excess moisture. Cut the coconut in half lengthwise on the diagonal. Slice into matchsticks. In a nonstick skillet, heat the oil over medium heat until hot but not smoking. Add half of the dry shrimp to the oil. Cook, stirring, until the shrimp are pink and cooked through, about 1 minute. Add the frozen spinach and cook until it wilts, about 1 minute. Then, add the coconut, peanut oil and vinegar and stir to combine. Add the reserved liquid from the rolled oats and add season to taste. Cook, stirring to thicken, for 1 minute. Serve hot, topped with croutons, coconut shrimp, or mixed salad greens.

title: Chutney Rice
ingredients: 1 small cauliflower, chopped into florets | 1 tomatoes, chopped | 1 tablespoon chutney | 1 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 1/2 cups red wine ( dry, white, blush, or chardonnay ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground poblano chiles or 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 2 tablespoons walnut pieces ( optional ) | 3 cups coarsely crushed ice
instructions: Steam the cauliflower until just tender. Drain well and set aside. In a small bowl, stir together the tomato, chutney, asafoetida, and red wine until blended, then slowly drizzle over the cauliflower. Season to taste with salt and pepper while still chutney is being made. Stir in the chiles. When ready, put the walnuts in the ice. Add to the hot rice.

Random Ingredients: yellow food coloring,eggnog,nonstick cooking spray,espresso,orange juice zest,green pepper,macadamia nut,flat leaf parsley
title: Macadamia Nut Filled Green Peppers
ingredients: nonstick cooking spray | 1/4 cup orange juice, freshly squeezed | 1/4 cup eggnog | 1/4 teaspoon instant espresso, instant powder | 2 large green peppers, cut into short strips | 1/2 cup chopped macadamia nuts | 1/4 cup chopped flat leaf parsley | 1/4 teaspoon green food coloring
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place rack on the second lowest position in oven. Coat a large, shallow baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Line a baking sheet with foil. Combine orange concentrate, egg nog, espresso powder, and green pepper strips in a food processor.

title: Homemade Danish Sauce
ingredients: 3/4 lb cucumber, peeled and grated | 1/4 cup water, reserved from grating cucumbers | 1/4 cup dulce de leche | 1/2 tablespoon celery salt | 1/2 tablespoon ground allspice | 1/8 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Puree grated cucumbers in a food processor until very smooth and frothy. In a blender or food processor, place grated cucumber, drained water and dulce de leche, celery salt, allspice, and nutmeg, and add puree and process until well mixed, and smooth. Taste and adjust seasoning with more dulce de leche or celery salt. Enjoy.

title: Crock Pot Portuguese Sausages
ingredients: 2 lbs hot italian sausages | 2 -3 bananas, peeled | 1 cup apple cider vinegar | 1/3 cup roasted peanuts
instructions: Cut the sausage in 1 inch pieces. Slice the bananas 1/8 inch thick. Combine vinegar and vinegar ingredients and put in crock pot. Cook on low for 4 - 6 hours.

title: Danish Beets and Turnips
ingredients: 3 medium carrots, peeled and sliced | 1 3/4 pounds beets, scrubbed and sliced | 3 whole chickens
instructions: In a large pot, place the carrots and beets. Fill with water and bring to a boil.

title: Crispy Lemon, Ham and Liver Pate Chicken
ingredients: 375 g liver pate | 125 g ham, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup fresh lemon peel, finely chopped | 4 chicken thigh fillets
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees celsius. Put pate, ham, lemon peel and pate into a bowl and mix well. Put fillets, skin side down on a microwaveable plate. Pour 1/2 of the pate mixture onto each fillet. Put the chicken in a single layer on top of pate mixture. Pour remaining pate mixture onto fillets. Put chicken in oven for 20 minutes and stir up contents of dish, and put back in oven for further 10 minutes, or until mixture just starts to bubble. Rest for 5 minutes before serving. Serve with salad or vegetables.

title: Oriental Beef Roll
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs flank steaks | 1 can bamboo shoots ( about 1/2 packed )
instructions: Cut steak diagonally across grain into thin slices and place on a shallow pan. Pour 1/2 can of bamboo shoots into the pan. Cook uncovered over medium heat until mixture comes to a boil. Reduce heat to low. Sprinkle the mixture of steak with salt and pepper to taste. Cover and cook for about 1 1/2 hours or until meat is cooked, stirring once during cooking. When meat is tender cut into about 1/2 wide strips and serve over rice.

title: Wild Rice in the Microwave
ingredients: 1/2 cup wild rice ( not instant ) | 1/2 cup fresh basil ( packed )
instructions: Put everything in a large microwave safe bowl. Cover with cling wrap, and cut 3 diagonal slits through the top and bottom of the bag using scissors. Microwave on high for 20 seconds, then microwave on high for 2 minutes 20 seconds more, until the rice is tender and cooked through. Let cool completely, then cover and refrigerate.

title: Cajun Dipping Sauce - for Beef
ingredients: 1/4 cup catsup | 1 tablespoon arrowroot
instructions: Put the arrowroot in to a small bowl. Add the catsup, sugar, and catsup to the bowl. Mix, let cool. Add to meat. Let meat cure up to one week.

title: Chinese Barbecue Sausage Skewers
ingredients: 2 lbs of uncut kielbasa | 3/4 cup guacamole | 1 tablespoon cajun spicy seasoning | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1/3 cup light soy sauce | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained
instructions: Cut a slit in the kielbasa and stuff each with the guacamole. Add cajun spicy seasoning, cardamom seeds, soy sauce and bamboo shoots. Toss and place meat onto a medium bbq or grill. Grill for 30 minutes. Cook for 10 additional minutes serve.

title: Red Bean Hot Fudge
ingredients: 225 g almond slices | 225 g milk chocolate, chopped up ( or drinking chocolate ) | 125 g chopped almonds | 1 - 1 1/2 cup red beans, chopped | 3/4 cup maple syrup or 3/4 cup treacle ( or sugar ) | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 2 -4 tbsp grated chocolate ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 210c. Line a baking tray with baking parchment. In medium sized saucepan or microwave, toast the almond, chocolate, and almonds over a medium heat until smooth. Stir occasionally until melted. Stir in the red beans and maple syrup/treacle/sugar. Transfer to a bowl and allow to cool slightly. Stir in the dry spices. Put about 2 tbsp of mixture onto a greased tray. Flatten with the back of a fork. Repeat until all mixture is used. Sprinkle with grated chocolate and refrigerate until mixture is set.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,plain soymilk,lasagna noodle,pork fillet,white onion,lime juice,beef stew meat
title: Pork Carnitas
ingredients: 250 ml plain soymilk | 250 g beef stew meat, diced | 150 g pork fillets, thinly sliced | 1 small white onion, sliced | 2 tablespoons lime juice | 1 tablespoon grand marnier | 350 g lasagna noodles ( or other pastas )
instructions: Place soymilk, beef stew meat, pork, onion, lime juice, grand marnier in a saucepan. Bring to the boil then reduce heat to medium, stirring occasionally until mixture is warmed through. Put in a large freezer bag and freeze for later use if time permits. While the mixture is cooling, bring a large pot of water to a boil. Meanwhile cook the lasagne noodles until just al dente, then rinse under cold water. Drain well.

title: Garlic and Onion Dip
ingredients: 2 white onions, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, toss the onion and parmesan cheese together until the mixture becomes limp and the cheese has become creamy. Add cayenne, and stir with a fork until well combined. Serve warm.

title: Italian Pork Roast
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb boneless pork roast, with a nice crust | 2 loaves of crusty italian bread
instructions: Pre heat oven to 325 degrees f. In a roasting pan, lay loaves of bread out on a large board, cutting to fit if necessary. Spread the loaves with the pork seasoning you can then slice the pork into 1/2 slices. Place slices in the oven until crusty and brown, about 20 to 30 minutes. You can easily make this recipe in a crock pot if you do this as my crock pot method, but i prefer to cook roast on top of the stove at least 8 hours and up to 12 hours, depending on how you like your crusty bread.

title: Crazy Tweaked Eggs
ingredients: 1 can frozen limeade concentrate | 1/2 cup prepared horseradish | 4 baby eggplants, halved lengthwise and cut crosswise into 1/4 inch slices | 1/2 green bell pepper, seeded sliced into 1/4 inch thick pieces | 3 pounds lean salmon, bones removed, cut into chunks
instructions: Pour limeade concentrate into a large resealable plastic bag, and sprinkle with horseradish. Shake to mix, then divide among 4 resealable food safe plastic bags, squeezing out excess air. Place the eggplant, green pepper, and salmon into each bag. Squeeze out 1 1/2 cups water, and squeeze as much air as possible from the eggplant. Place the bag on a cookie sheet, and carefully push down with the heel of your hand to release air from the bag. Refrigerate for 30 minutes to chill sauce. Carefully remove bag of eggplants, and transfer to a serving bowl.

title: Spiced Lentils
ingredients: 1 lb lentils | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil or 1 tablespoon lard | 1/4 teaspoon saffron | 1/4 cup currants or 1/4 cup raisins | 1/4 cup chopped dried mixed color ( optional )
instructions: Sauté lentils in oil, stirring often for 5 minutes. Add saffron, currants, and optional ingredients to lentils and mix together. Simmer, covered 10 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Cantaloupe Meat Risotto With Risotto
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat, cut into bite-sized chunks or 2 lbs lamb stew meat | 2 lbs small white mushrooms, coarsely chopped | 10 white mushrooms, sliced | 1 package arborio rice | 1/4 cup dill, minced or 1 tablespoon dried dill ( optional ) | 6 cups prepared coloupe
instructions: Prepare the rice per package directions. In a large bowl, combine the meat, 1 cup of the dill weed or dill and chopped mushrooms. Toss with the rice until evenly coated. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Cover and refrigerate for 12 hours or overnight. Rinse the arborio rice well and add to the meat mixture, along with the remaining 1 cup of dill.

Random Ingredients: whipping cream,paper,chili sauce,grape juice,white sesame seed,green lentil,white sugar
title: Lebanese Grape Soup
ingredients: 20 fluid ounces grape juice | 10 fluid ounces whipping cream | 1 cup green lentils | 4 fluid ounces chili sauce | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 1/4 teaspoon white sesame seeds | 1 paper, cup toasted, cooled and cut into pieces
instructions: Rinse and drain the lentils. Place in a blender and turn on to high. Crush with a rolling pin until the lentils have lost a lot of their shape. Strain into a bowl and set aside. In a saucepan, combine grape juice, cream, and lentils. Mix together chili sauce and sugar. Bring to a boil and boil 30 seconds while continuously stirring. Stopping the mixture and immediately stir in sesame seeds. Cool to room temperature. Pour into blender and process for 1 minute. Pour into a bowl and serve hot with toasted sesame seeds to garnish.

Random Ingredients: tortilla,orange blossom water,plain flour,prawn,white chocolate,flat leaf italian parsley,garlic paste
title: Tortilla Prawns With Orange Bpli
ingredients: 250 g plain flour | 200 g prawns, raw, shelled and deveined | 1 tablespoon of garlic paste | 150 g white chocolate, melted | 125 g chopped fresh flat-leaf italian parsley | 1 1/2 tablespoons orange blossom water | 1/3 cup toasted crushed tortilla
instructions: Place the flour on a work surface. Make a well in the centre and add prawns, garlic paste and melted white chocolate. Mix. Add the parsely for a moment and adjust seasoning with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Mix well. Sprinkle prawn mixture on base. Use the palms of your hands to press the mixture until fully incorporated. Gather and roll into large flat walnut shapes. Wrap in parchment paper. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour or until set. Heat oven to 200c/400f and bake the tortillas for about 7 - 8 minutes. Serve with orange bpli sauce.

title: Lek and Pine Nut Stew
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs leeks, peeled, cut in half lengthwise, washed and dried | 1/2 cup pine nuts
instructions: Preheat a large saucepan over high heat. Add the leeks and pine nuts. Cook, stirring frequently, until all is lightly browned, about 15 minutes. Transfer the cooked leeks and pine nuts to a bowl. Puree in blender, food mill or food processor until smooth. Return to pan. Scatter over beef or chicken.

Random Ingredients: seasoning salt,celery,bread crumb,poppy seed,english muffin,lime juice,rustic bread,table salt
title: Magical French Bread
ingredients: 1 cup soft bread crumbs | 1 tablespoon poppy seeds | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 cup seasoned bread crumbs | 1 1/4 cups stone ground bread crumbs | 1/2 cup lime juice | 1/2 cup table salt | 1 package shredded rustic bread rounds | 6 stalks celery, julienned
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f. Sift together the bread crumbs, poppy seeds, seasoning salt, seasoned bread crumbs, lime juice, and table salt. Remove 1 package of each bread and celery, cut into 3 or 4 lengthwise slices, and divide the stuffing between the 4 thick, 5 long bread portions. Top with the remaining bread pieces, making sure to cover all of them. Starting at one side, roll the bread around the stuffing from side to side. Place them seam side down and place the roll, seam side down, directly on a rack in a baking dish lined with a sheet of waxed paper. Bake in the preheated oven until the bread tops are nicely browned and crusts have turned brown, around 40 minutes.

title: Herbed Corn With Red Currant Jelly
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs corn, whole | 2 cups italian red currant jelly | 2 tablespoons mixed italian parsley, chopped
instructions: Wash corn well and remove any excess husks. Cut corn off cob and cook 3 minutes under cold water. In saucepan combine remaining ingredients. Bring to boil, stirring continuously. Cook over low heat for 5 minutes. Drain hot corn and spread with red currant jelly.

title: Crock Pot Sweet-Scrumptious Catfish & Beef
ingredients: 4 catfish fillets | 8 ounces low-fat vanilla yogurt | 1/4 cup ketchup | 1 cup low-fat beef sirloin, sliced | 2 tablespoons celery, sliced into 1/8-inch rounds
instructions: Place catfish fillets in crockpot. Whisk together yogurt, ketchup and beef in a large bowl until smooth. Pour yogurt mixture over catfish fillets. Cover and cook on low 5 hours or on high 5 hours, or until catfish flakes easily when tested with a fork. Serve topped with celery.

title: Cabbage and Peaches in Pastry Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1 bag shredded cabbage ( i used fresh and i had to add about 5 or 6 on the own when i put the finished cabbage in the oven and it was well cooked ) | peach pie | 2 -3 tablespoons dried sweet sherry wine ( or a good white wine, i used about 1 2 oz. ) | garlic powder | fresh rosemary | french farina ( i like french fonduta, crumbs )
instructions: Combine all ingredients and stir well. You can refrigerate this for up to a week or freeze it for later use. To use this recipe, you can either just add a slice of cabbage to your pan and stir it through your filling and serve on a roll with a wedge of crusty french bread on the side. The key to success here is combining the filling ingredients well. The farina makes a great crusty bread roll that can be made ahead and can be served warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: gingerroot,red potato,champagne,tamari,almond extract,pecorino romano cheese,vanilla essence,tomato juice
title: Red Wine Baked Potatoes (Low-Fat)
ingredients: 14 ounces red potatoes ( about 6 medium ) | 2 cups dry champagne ( preferably full body, but sparkling wine is ok ) | 7 1/2 ounces canned diced tomatoes with juice | 2 teaspoons tamari or 1 teaspoon soy sauce | 2 teaspoons vanilla essence | 1 1/2 teaspoons almond extract | 15 g fresh grated pecorino romano cheese ( about 1/3 cup ) | 1/3 cup sliced toasted almonds or 1/3 cup toasted pistachios
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Grease a 6 - 8 cup capacity oven proof dish with butter or spray with olive oil. Place the potatoes in a medium size saucepan, fill with boiling water or enough to cover them. Bring to a boil, and then boil uncovered for 20 minutes, or until tender. Drain and set aside. Pour the wine into a medium size saucepan, and heat until just beginning to bubble. Add the tomatoes, tamari or soy sauce, almond extract, and ½ teaspoon each of the grated cheese. Bring to the boil, stirring. Reduce the heat and simmer for 5 minutes, or until the liquid has reduced by about quarter. Stir in the potatoes and their pasta. Pour into oven dish. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake uncovered for 15 minutes, or until topping is just lightly golden and bubbling. Watch closely, as flame burns quickly. Allow to cool. Cut into squares and serve warm or at room temperature with toasted pistachios. Serve warm. For extra flavour try adding a little lemon juice and or sugar to the red wine to give it a bit of zing.

title: Pumpkin and Kiwi Sandwich
ingredients: 1/4 cup pumpkin | 2 tablespoons chunky salsa | 2 slices romano cheese | 1 avocado - peeled, pitted and sliced | 2 wedges kiwi ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the grill. Lightly oil the grill grate. Cut the pumpkin into 1/4 inch thick slices and put slices on the grate. Drizzle with the salsa and top with a knob of cheese.

title: Toad in the Hole
ingredients: 1 lb hot italian sausage link, casing removed | 1/2 cup cranberries or 1/2 cup raisins, soaked in water for 15 minutes | 1 package frozen phyllo pastry sheets, thawed
instructions: Cook sausage according to package directions. Drain and cool. Preheat oven to 400°f line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Cut sausage into 1/2 inch slices. Arrange sausage slices in one layer in a large bowl. Drain cranberries. Place half the cranberries in a food processor. Process until ground. Spread half of the cranberry mixture on one side of phyllo sheets, then top with sausage slices, then sprinkle with cranberries on the sausage. Repeat layers, forming a total of 10 layers. Bake in oven for 20 - 25 minutes, or until pastry is golden brown.

title: Mom's Italian Pork
ingredients: 4 lbs boneless pork shoulder, cut into 1 2 thick chunks | 2 lbs fresh hamburger, cut into 1-inch cubes | 4 ounces minced onion | 1 tablespoon garlic salt | 1/4 cup sherry wine vinegar
instructions: Heat oven to 325 deg. F. Drain and rinse both pork shoulder meats. In roasting pan, put pork shoulder and its cubes in one layer. Pour the entire contents of the marinade over. Cover with alumimum foil. Add the ham, onion and garlic salt. Cover with foil & bake for 3 hours on middle rack in oven. Remove from oven, uncover & brown the outside of the ham. Place meat on platter and place roasting pan in oven for 3 hours. Remove from oven, sprinkle with flour & serve.

Random Ingredients: mozzarella cheese,spinach,french onion,cognac,muscovado sugar,italian dressing,black mustard seed
title: French Onion Salad With Cognac, Muscovado and Fresh Mozzarella
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh spinach | 3 ounces fresh mozzarella cheese, sliced ( about 3 ounces ) | 1/4 cup cognac | 1 tablespoon black mustard seeds | 1/4 cup muscovado sugar | 1/4 cup italian dressing | 1/4 cup french onion, sliced
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, toss together the spinach and mozzarella. In a small bowl, stir together the cognac, mustard seeds, muscovado sugar, italian dressing and french onions. Pour over the spinach salad, toss well, and serve immediately.

title: Simple No-Cook Swiss Steak Recipe
ingredients: 8 -12 ounces swiss steak, fresh and not on the frozen roll
instructions: Cut a 1 round slice or roll about 6 inches long, about 1/3 of an inch or so long, of the steak. You can also use any round steak you like, but be sure to leave a 1/4 to 1/2 inch margin at the cuts. Slice the roll very thinly on the horizontal cut of the roll. Place the roll in the steamer, just enough to give the roll room for swiss to brown. When the timer goes off, the meat should be cooked through, but still have that bite.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,pie filling,corn oil,sun tomato oil,green olive,scallion
title: Elegant Tarte Tatin (Olive and Sun-Dried Tomatoes Spread)
ingredients: 6 ounces fresh green olives ( not canned ) | 1 can sliced pimiento-stuffed green olives ( not drained ) | 2 teaspoons corn oil or 2 teaspoons other neutral oil | 1/4 - 1/3 cup olive oil | 3 -4 scallions ( or a combination of scallions and onion ) | 3 tablespoons lemon juice or 3 tablespoons lime juice | 1 pie filling, from a 9-inch pie plate ( or just enough to make a thick spread )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Pulse the lemons or limes in a food processor till just as smooth. Set out some olives to use for garnish. Slice remaining olives and place in a food processor. Pulse until finely chopped. Add the olives and the pimientos. Pulse for 1 minute or so, until the mixture forms a coarse paste. Add the oil and pulse another minute or two or until well mixed. Transfer to a bowl and let stand at room temperature for 30 minutes, or refrigerate overnight before using. Use in place of olive spread.

Random Ingredients: cornichons,self rising flour,ice,tomato paste,grain rice,chinese wine
title: Chinese Rice Pancakes and Tomatoes
ingredients: 2 cups self-rising flour | 1/4 cup chinese rice wine | 1 -2 cup water | 2 tablespoons tomato paste | 2 cornichons | ice
instructions: Sift the flour into a mixing bowl. Make a well in the centre and pour in the rice wine and water. Add the tomato paste and mix well. Dip 1 cornichon on a warm serving plate and arrange it in a circle around the edge of the flour. Drop 1 teaspoon of ice into the circle. Serve with any sauce the pancakes were cooked inches. Recipe from, http, //makeschuan. Com/kidney bean sauces/guide/kidney bean sauces/.

title: Chicken Hash & Potato
ingredients: 6 new potatoes | 2 lbs ground chicken
instructions: Poke holes in the chicken with a fork, then fry in oil, using a large frying pan, until coloured and cooked through. Add more oil if needed, as the chicken fat from cooking goes rancid. Stir in potatoes, and fry until the consistency you like. Drain on absorbent paper.

Random Ingredients: italian sausage,strawberry preserve,olive oil,chili sauce,rotini pasta,kale,lamb fillet,apricot preserve
title: Lamb-Roasted Kale Wrapped in Sausage and Goat Cheese
ingredients: 1 large head kale | 1 cup goat cheese ( i used light goat cheese ) | 1/2 cup apricot preserves | 1 loaf italian sausage, with casings removed | 5 1/2 ounces rotini pasta, uncooked | 1 teaspoon olive oil | 1 teaspoon chili sauce | 2 cups turkey cooked lamb fillets, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Line a 5 1/2 x 2 3/4 inch loaf pan with parchment paper. Cut kale lengthwise through bottom of leaves, making sure all leaves are removed.

title: Kumara Quinoa Burgers
ingredients: 1 cup raw quinoa | 400 g light lobster tails | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 1/3 cup brown sugar | 1/2 cup beef broth | 1 cup kumara, grated, cooked
instructions: Wash the kumara. If using canned kumara, drain well. Rinse well. Drain well in a sieve set over a bowl, discarding any brine that remains on the kumara. Place the quinoa in a large bowl and add 3 cups of cold water and the sugar and a tbsp of olive oil. Stir well with a wooden spoon until the sugar dissolves. This should give you a soft and slightly sticky quinoa that does not stick to the fingers. Add the kumara, mix and set aside for 10 minutes to allow flavours to mesh. Meanwhile, tip all ingredients into a flan dish, or use your hands to crumble the quinoa into the bowl. The quinoa is very sticky so you may need to use more olive oil. Use your palms to crumble into the bowl until you have a good mixture, then spread out evenly across a large plate. Allow to settle for about 30 minutes before eating. It should be firm and slightly soft and slightly crumbly. Break into chunks to serve as appetisers and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: ice water,garlic pepper seasoning,picante sauce,meringue,bartlett pear,ghee,onion powder,tamarind paste
title: Pears Negros
ingredients: 4 small firm bartlett pears, cut into quarters | 4 tablespoons ghee or 4 tablespoons vegetable oil, divided | 1 medium onion, minced | 1 tablespoon tamarind paste | 1 package frozen teriyaki marion snacks | 4 cups ice water | 1 tablespoon garlic pepper seasoning | 3 tablespoons onion powder
instructions: Heat half of the oil in a small sauté pan over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 4 minutes, stirring to keep the onion from burning. Set aside. Heat the remaining half of oil in a skillet. Add the tamarind paste and let it sizzle for 1 minute. Add the caramelized onion to the skillet and cook for 2 to 3 minutes or until the onions are soft. Stir in the frozen teriyaki sauce chips and water, bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 5 to 7 minutes, or until the pears are tender. Remove from heat and add the garlic pepper seasoning and onion powder. Cover and refrigerate overnight or for at least 8 hours.

title: Dolce's Bark
ingredients: 2 1/2 - 3 cups warm ( body temperature ) | 2 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 cup pecan nuts
instructions: Place warm, yeast and pecans in a large mixing bowl and let it stand until foamy, about 10 minutes. Place in a large mixing bowl and lightly grease the top with a little bit of oil. Beat in a little more then a tablespoon at a time, until batter is smooth. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface. Knead it lightly on a floured surface for about 5 minutes. Place in an oiled bowl and turn to coat. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and a towel to keep it warm. Let rise in a warm place for 2 hours to rise. Turn to lightly coat and rise again 1 hour. Turn onto lightly floured surface. Knead or coat dough. Divide in half. Roll each portion into ropes about 12 inches long and 2 inches in diameter. Arrange on buttered baking sheets and cover loosely with towel. Put in a preheated 375 degree oven. Let rise 20 minutes. Meanwhile preheat oven to 350°f. Bake for about 20 minutes.

title: Green Cabbage Soup
ingredients: 1 head green cabbage, shredded | 1 yellow onion, chopped | 2 cups chicken stock | 1 loaf french bread, cut into 1 inch slices | 1 dash fresh sage ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Bring chicken stock to a boil in a large pot. Mix with shredded cabbage, onion and sage. Pour into a large ovenproof bowl. Cover bowl with foil and bake for 2 hours, stirring every 20 minutes.

title: Island Chicken
ingredients: 6 chicken breasts | 1 can tuna, drained | 1 can mushrooms, drained, chopped, drained | 1/2 cup wild rice, cooked | 3 tablespoons light rum | 4 tablespoons butter, cubed
instructions: Heat oven to 200 degrees f. Place chicken breasts in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Blend chicken and remaining ingredients in a blender or food processor until smooth. Pour over chicken and bake 45 minutes, basting twice, until chicken is cooked through.

title: Easy Microwave Corn
ingredients: 1 package frozen cream-style corn, thawed and drained well | 1 can cream-style corn, drained
instructions: In 1 1/2 to 2 quart casserole dish combine cream corn, cream style corn and 1 can cream of mushroom soup.

title: Chile Con Queso (Chile Con Queso)
ingredients: 2 lbs pork, shredded | 3 chiles, seeded and finely chopped | 1 tablespoon dried rosemary | 1 cup irish whiskey
instructions: Combine all ingredients and refrigerate overnight for best results. Bring to room temperature and broil for 2 - 3 minutes on each side.

title: Fruit Spice Breakfast
ingredients: 2 cups grated flesh from fresh fruit ( mixed fruits ) | 1 teaspoon ground cumin
instructions: Process the grated fruit in a food processor, using batches if necessary until finely ground. Transfer the grated fruit to a bowl and stir in the ground cumin. Serve immediately or allow to rest for 1 hour before serving.

title: Mushroom Stuffed Chorizo (Chorreados De Chorizo)
ingredients: 12 grana padano ( about 1 1/2 ounces total weight ) | 1/2 cup chorizo sausage, finely chopped ( about 5 ounces ) | 1 teaspoon canned chipotle powder
instructions: Drain chorizo in a strainer, pressing gently to remove the excess moisture. Chop chorizo into 1/4 inch wide chunks by hand. If using chorizo with casing, drain the chorizo chunks in a bowl. Set aside. Heat nonstick skillet on medium high. Add chorizo pieces and chipotle chile powder, tossing constantly. Stir occasionally until chorizo and chorizo is crisp, and no liquid remains in chorizo, about one minute. Remove from heat. Roll each chorizo slice into a 6 inch long cylinder.

title: Pinchados
ingredients: 1 ounce dried apricot, diced | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil
instructions: Soak the apricots in hot water for about 20 minutes. Drain and leave to dry. Heat the sesame oil over a medium gas until smoking and brown all over. Reduce heat and add the diced apricots and fry for 3 to 4 minutes. Serve in slices with steamed green beans.

title: Tomato Soup - 2 Delicious!
ingredients: 1 liter vegetable stock | 1 can rotel tomatoes ( or tomato puree ) | 1 tablespoon dried orange zest, finely grated | 1 teaspoon sherry wine
instructions: Wipe the vegetables with a moist cloth and chop finely. Combine other ingredients. Pour into soup pot and bring to boil.

title: Ginger Beer
ingredients: 1 lb ginger, sliced | 14 ounces coconut milk
instructions: Pour coconut milk into a heavy saucepan and bring to boil. Pour ginger beer inches. Add ginger beer to warm coconut milk, stir and heat to warm.

Random Ingredients: panko breadcrumb,gouda cheese,red potato,romaine lettuce,quinoa,fennel seed,asafoetida powder
title: Quinoa-Wrapped Grilled Beef Wraps
ingredients: 2 lbs red potatoes, peeled and diced ( about 4 medium ) | 4 tablespoons quinoa ( or rice if using regular grain rice ) | 2 teaspoons fennel seeds | 1 1/2 teaspoons asafoetida powder | 4 large red wraps ( approximately 2-inch in diameter ) or 4 large spring roll wraps ( approximately 2-inch in diameter ) | 1 lb lean smoked gouda cheese, diced ( about 3/4 pound ) | panko breadcrumbs | romaine lettuce or spinach
instructions: Preheat grill to medium. Place potatoes in a medium saucepan with enough water to cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to medium low and simmer until potatoes are very tender, stirring occasionally, about 12 minutes. Drain, cool slightly, peel, and dice. In a medium bowl, combine quinoa and fennel seeds. Add 1 1/2 cups boiling water and let stand 5 minutes. Meanwhile in a small nonstick skillet, heat remaining 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat. Cook quinoa mixture until golden, stirring, about 2 minutes. Stir in asafoetida and cook for 1 minute. Meanwhile, preheat the broiler and position a large heavy duty cookie sheet into your oven. Place the beef wrap onto the cookie sheet, leaving 1 inch headspace around the wrap. Center the wrap on the cookie sheet, leaving 1 inch of space for steam to circulate inside. Brush roll with a little water. Cut out the center of the wrap with a meat tenderizing mallet, such as a rolling pin, using a knife or a pastry brush. Arrange wrap halves in a single layer on each sheet. Cut out center of the wrap and arrange a second sheet on top of the wrap. Lightly brush top and bottom surfaces of wraps with water and press down to compact them slightly. If the wrap is a little too small, spread water into a small, shallow dish. Cut wraps in half to tidy them. Serve wraps wrapped with cheese, potatoes, lettuce or spinach.

Random Ingredients: cream tartar,mint,madeira wine,white bread,baking potato,habanero pepper,tequila
title: Mint and Roasted Garlic Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 1 -2 habanero pepper, seeded and minced ( depending on how strong you want the garlic to be ) | 1 tablespoon finely chopped of fresh mint or 1 1/2 teaspoons dried mint, divided | 4 large baking potatoes, peeled and quartered | 1/8 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 tablespoon tequila | 1 loaf of crusty white bread, cut into 1 inch cubes | 2 tablespoons madeira wine ( optional ) or 2 tablespoons ruby port ( optional )
instructions: Preheat broiler. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add garlic, 1/2 teaspoon mint and 2 teaspoons salt and cook, stirring frequently for about a minute. Add potatoes and cook, stirring frequently, until well coated with garlic infused oil. Lower heat to medium, cover and cook until potatoes are just tender, about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Stir in tequila. Place bread, butter, salt and remaining mint in a large bowl and toss together to coat. Add potatoes and cheese and toss to blend. Serve warm. Tip, if you do not want to serve with mashed potatoes, you can substitute vegetable or chicken flavored croutons for the bread cubes and/or croutons. They may be accompanied equally with guacamole, salsa, etc.

title: Portuguese Veal
ingredients: 1/2 lb boneless pork shoulder, cut into 1/2 `` strips | 1/2 lb pork shoulder, cut into 1/2 `` strips | 1/3 lb linguica sausage | 3 tablespoons cocoa | 3 tablespoons vinegar ( optional ) | crushed tomatoes
instructions: In a 1 quart casserole, combine pork and sausage and brown thoroughly, then divide among 6 - 8 qt slow cooker crock pot crocks. Sprinkle cocoa and vinegar over pork mixture. Add undrained crushed tomatoes. Cover and cook on high for 7 10hrs, or on low for 2 3hrs. For low heat, cover and cook the pork for at least 8hrs. For thick, sauce like consistency, stir as desired.

title: Homemade Italian Meatballs
ingredients: 1 pound ground pork | 3/4 cup prepared pasta sauce | 1 can chopped water chestnuts, drained
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium high heat and stir in the pork. Cook until evenly browned. Stir in the pasta sauce and water chestnuts. Heat to boiling, then reduce heat. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.

Random Ingredients: golden raisin,plain flour,greek yogurt,prosciutto,chicken,marsala wine,italian dressing
title: Chicken Marsala
ingredients: 1 kg fresh chicken pieces | 200 ml plain flour | 250 ml greek yogurt | 100 g prosciutto, finely sliced | 100 g golden raisins, roughly chopped | 2 tablespoons sweet marsala wine | 1 teaspoon all purpose greek yogurt | 2 tablespoons italian dressing, extra | 1 tablespoon marsala wine
instructions: Rinse the chicken pieces under cold water and pat dry. Cut the chicken into 12 pieces using a sharp knife. Roll each piece between sheets of plastic wrap until completely coated.

title: Spinach and Spinach Salad
ingredients: 4 cups fresh spinach | 3 cups coarsely chipped fresh spinach | 1 large cucumber, peeled, seeded, sliced, and chopped | 3 tablespoons dried cranberries | 1 teaspoon dried saffron | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried paprika | 1 1/2 teaspoons all purpose greek seasoning | 1 dash hot pepper sauce | 1 1 tablespoon grated saffron | 1 teaspoon dried paprika | 1 teaspoon all purpose greek seasoning
instructions: Combine all prepared salad ingredients and coat well with 1 1/2 tbsp greek seasoning. Let stand for 10 minutes or refrigerate overnight. Combine remaining greek seasoning and spice ingredients and stir until well blended. Toss salad with remaining spice mixture.

title: Cheesy Collards
ingredients: 1 bunch collard greens | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack pepper cheese
instructions: Set oven rack 5 from broiler element. Lightly oil an 8 inch square baking dish. Cut the leaves off of the collards with a knife.

Random Ingredients: cooking oil,bamboo shoot,green chile pepper,tapioca flour,beef stock cube,red chile pod,flour
title: Thai Sweet and Sour Beef
ingredients: 350 g beef stew meat or 350 g similar stew meat | 100 g tapioca flour ( yellow cornflour ) | 150 g flour | 300 ml beef stock or 300 ml beef stock | 4 dried red chile pods, stems removed, deseeded | 1 -2 green chile pepper, seeded and deveined | 2 1/2 cm piece dried bamboo shoots ( optional )
instructions: Combine the beef flour and tapioca flour in a bowl and gradually add the beef stock to form a thick paste. Stir in the dried chilies and green chilies. Cover and refrigerate for about 1 hour. Cut the beef into 1cm cubes and dust each piece with flour. Heat a wok over high heat and add the cooking oil. Tip in the beef and stir fry until browned and almost cooked through. Push the meat up the sides of the wok and transfer to a casserole dish. Pour the sauce and water into the wok and heat to boiling, then immediately pour over the meat. Cover and cook in a preheated oven at 200c for about 1 hour or until the meat is tender. Stir in the bamboo shoots and serve with rice or noodles.

Random Ingredients: wonton wrapper,fenugreek,catsup,leg lamb,pecan,dark chocolate,green chilies,red pepper
title: Shoofat Spicy Beef and Pecan Stuffed Wontons
ingredients: 100 wonton wrappers | 600 g lean leg of lamb | 2 green chilies, cut lenghtways | 2 tablespoons dark chocolate, roughly chopped | 1 teaspoon ground fenugreek | 2 tablespoons catsup | 1 dash ground red pepper | 2 tablespoons pecans or 2 tablespoons walnuts, roughly chopped
instructions: Chop ground lamb meat finely. Soak wonton skins in cold water for 15 minutes. Cut up fine and set aside. Combine chillies, chocolate, fenugreek and catsup, chilli powder and ground red pepper in a bowl and mix well. Divide mix into 25 wontons. Place two heaped teaspoonfuls of meat mixture down the centre of a wonton wrapper. Moisten the outside corners with water, then fold over the mixture. Press firmly and tuck ends down. Place on greased oven tray. Heat in a preheated oven at 160 200°c/fan 160°c/gas 6 for 10 minutes, turning them over halfway through cooking. After 5 mins, remove and leave to cool. Repeat with the rest. These may be kept for up to a week in the fridge if keeping. To serve, place on individual serving plates topped with a little of the sauce and grated cheese.

title: Apple Mustard Cream Potato Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs idaho potatoes, red and light green, scrubbed | 14 ounces apple jelly, any flavor | 2/3 cup whiskey | 2 tablespoons half-and-half | 2 -3 drops vanilla essence | 24 whole cloves ( or 1/2 tsp ground cloves ) | 2/3 cup irish cream, regular cream is preferred
instructions: Slice potatoes thinly. Boil in salted water for about 20 minutes. They should not be soft just cooked, but firm. Drain well, and allow to cool until they are cold. Dump the cold potatoes in a large bowl, and set aside to chill in the freezer for 15 to 20 minutes. Cut chilled potatoes into slices about 1/2 inch thick. Whisk together the jelly, whiskey, half and half cream and vanilla essence or spices. Brush mixture onto the potato slices until evenly coated. Spread the potatoes onto waxed paper and chill while preparing the rest of the salad. When your cold potatoes are chilled, arrange them in a baking pan and put in the refrigerator until ready to serve. When ready to serve, place the chilled mustard cream in a bowl, and toss with the chilled potato slices. Serve immediately.

title: Italian Radiatore Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 cup green sprinkles | 1 tablespoon fresh basil or 1 tablespoon of fresh mint, finely chopped
instructions: Mix well and refrigerate if using as directed in recipe. Serve on lettuce leaves, with grated parmesan as an added garnish.

title: Black-Eyed Pea and Pear Salad
ingredients: 1 can sliced black-eyed peas, rinsed and drained | 1 cup frozen ear of corn leaves, thawed | 2 pears - peeled, cored, and chopped | 1 cucumber - peeled, seeded, and chopped | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh mint
instructions: In a large bowl, mix black eyed peas, corn leaves, pears, cucumber, and mint until thoroughly blended. Chill in the refrigerator to blend flavors before serving.

Random Ingredients: dijon mustard,ginger,red chili pepper,mustard green,golden raisin,cooking sherry,thyme
title: Raisin Mustard With Mustard Greens
ingredients: 20 ounces mustard greens, cut in 2 or 3 inch lengths | 6 tablespoons stone ground mustard | 1 tablespoon stone ground mustard green | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon golden raisin, roughly chopped | 1 pinch dried thyme, crumbled | 1 small red chili pepper, deseeded and finely shredded | 3 tablespoons cooking sherry
instructions: Place the mustard greens in a bowl and cover with cling film. Set aside for 2 hours or overnight. After 30 minutes, remove the cling film. Drain the greens and then arrange on a serving dish. Mix together the mustards, raisins, thyme and red pepper. Sprinkle over the mustard mixture and toss well. Serve with toasted whole wheat toast.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,cocoa powder,mustard,broccoli,semolina flour,granny smith apple
title: Sizzlin' Swiss Broccoli
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 3 tablespoons cocoa powder | 2 cups chopped broccoli | 1 tablespoon dry mustard | 6 ounces granny smith apples, chopped ( about 4 cups ) | 1/2 cup coarse semolina flour
instructions: Preheat your broiler. Lay a sheet of waxed paper directly on work surface or on a work surface. Spray 2 heavy duty aluminum foil cookie sheets with vegetable oil spray. Mix cocoa powder and vegetable oil in a medium bowl. Add broccoli, mustard and apples and mix to coat. Lay a sheet of waxed paper on top of the waxed paper. Carefully place broccoli onto the prepared plate. Cover loosely with the second piece of waxed paper. Gently press broccoli into the mixture. Carefully invert broccoli onto the foil cookie sheet. Allow to cool 10 minutes. Make an assembly by spooning some of the mixture onto the broccoli. Keep the broccoli covered with foil. Repeat steps 5 - 7 until all the ingredients are used throughout the broccoli mixture. To serve, cut the broccoli into pieces. Serve either warm or at room temperature.

title: Spicy Chili Sauce
ingredients: cooking spray | 1/2 cup prepared pasta sauce | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon red pepper flakes
instructions: Bring a saucepan of water to boil. Cook pasta shells following manufacturer's instructions or until al dente. Drain and cool. Coat with cooking spray and coat well with cooking spray. Spoon sauce over cooked pasta and sprinkle with red pepper flakes. Chill 3 - 4 hours to blend flavors.

title: Easy Mexican Rice and Beans
ingredients: 2 cups pinto beans | 1 cup long grain rice, uncooked
instructions: Rinse beans and place in an 8 x 8 glass baking dish. Cover with water and soak at least 2 hours or overnight. Bring to room temperature before serving.

title: Strawberry Trifle
ingredients: 100 g sponge cakes ( or fresh sponge cakes ) | 500 -600 g strawberries ( quartered or sliced ) | 60 ml wine
instructions: Layer sponge cakes in the base of a glass bowl. Sprinkle with slices of strawberries. Pour half the wine and half the wine into the bowl and lightly beat together all the ingredients. Garnish with strawberry rings. Chill before serving.

title: Barbecue Beef Rollups
ingredients: 4 slices beef, sliced thinly ( i use sirloin, or any style beef you like ) | 250 g soft whole wheat tortillas ( or low fat, cornflour, etc. ) | 1/2 cup vegetable stock | 2 teaspoons ginger paste | 1/4 cup barbecue sauce | 1 teaspoon cornflour | 250 g lettuce
instructions: Slice the beef thinly. Spread the cut surfaces of the tortillas with the vegetable stock. Divide the sliced beef among the tortillas and top with grated cheese. Roll up tightly. Serve as desired,. Note, you can also freeze these rolls in any manner you wish.

title: Melt-In-The-Mouth Scotch Eggs
ingredients: 2 tablespoons finely chopped toasted scallions | 1 cup very dark bittersweet chocolate | toothpicks
instructions: In a small heavy skillet set over medium high heat, melt the chocolate and scallions briefly, stirring just until melted. Remove from the heat and pour into a bowl of ice water. Using a tablespoon, pry the chocolate into 1/2 inch rounds, or 1/4 inch wide mouth by 2 inch wide slabs. Let cool for 1 hour, then coarsely chop. Break the eggs into a small bowl, and stir in the chocolate and scallions. Transfer to a pretty platter, and serve at once.

Random Ingredients: gingerroot,sourdough bread,beef chuck,beef chuck roast,rye flour
title: Beef and Rye Crisp
ingredients: 6 -10 lbs boneless beef chuck roast | 2 slices gingerroot ( about 12 slices peeled, about 3 inches thick ) | 2 lbs beef chuck roast ( can be bought already trimmed of excess fat ) | 2 cups sourdough bread, crust soaked ( use bread soaked in cold water ) | 1 3/4 cups rye flour
instructions: Place pork, ginger and beef in a dutch oven with 1 cup water and half of the rye flour, and cover with another 2 1/2 cups water and bring to a boil. Cover and reduce heat to low and simmer for 2 hours. Remove meat.

title: Easy Cajun Fried Chicken
ingredients: 1/4 cup margarine ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon chili oil ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Whisk together the other ingredients until emulsified. Stir in chicken, a few pieces at a time. Cook until nicely browned on the outside. Turn chicken over, and cook on each side for about 2 minutes more.

title: Spinach and Bacon Filled With Mushrooms (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 13)
ingredients: 1 bag baby spinach | 2 slices bacon
instructions: Cook bacon in frying pan.

Random Ingredients: beef roast,cannellini bean,bean sprout,cardamom pod,parsnip,spinach leaf,chipotle chile adobo
title: Mexican Beef Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless beef roast, frozen | 15 ounces cannellini beans, drained & rinsed | 8 ounces chopped parsnips | 14 ounces crushed tomatoes & chilies in adobo | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cardamom pod | 6 fresh spinach leaves | 1 cup dried canola beans or 1 cup navy beans, rinsed | 1 -2 chipotle chile in adobo, finely minced
instructions: Place frozen roast or beef in crockpot. Cook beef until outside is crusty and outside is browned, approximately 3 to 6 hours on high. If beef is frozen, use a metal spoon to scrape up all the browned bits from the bottom of the pan to help thaw roast. Drain beef and discard all fat except 2 tablespoons of the drippings. Place rest of the ingredients except spinach in a saucepan and boil until tender. Drain beans and puree in blender or with 2 tablespoons olive oil and 1/4 inch salt until smooth, about 2 minutes. Stir into mixture. Transfer beef and broth to crockpot. Cover, cook on low for 6 to 8 hours or high for 3 to 4 hours, or until meat is very tender.

title: Overnight Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 1 packet dry yeast | 300 g cocoa powder, mix
instructions: If you have a non stick pan, the best to use them is a non stick/vegatable pan. If you use the non stick pan, that is too. Mix up the dry yeast with 3/4 cup of warm water. Add the rest of the water and the cocoa mix. Let sit for about 10 minutes, then stir it into the yeast solution. The mix will be quite wet. If it appears too dry, add more water. If necessary, add more cocoa mix. Keep stirring, until the mix thickens. If too dry, add more cocoa mix. You can use a dough hook, but i prefer it without the dough hook. If too dry, add more water. You can even drop the mixture on the table right before you are ready to proceed. Leave the mixture to rise. The amount of dough depends on how big or how long the dough is. Once the dough has risen, transfer it into an oiled cake tin. Put some oil on your hands so the bubbles don't form. Cover with a cloth or cloth paper, so that the dough doesn't dry out. Leave it in a warm place and allow it to rise again until it has doubled in size. Punch down dough and make 2 or 3 smaller loaves out of it. Roll them out with the help of flour, and then cut out a slit lengthwise into the side for the filling. If you have bought 2 small loaves, you can fill it in the slit lengthwise with filling if you don't have a pastry bag. When you are ready to bake them, preheat the oven to 375°f. Bake about 4 minutes, then turn on the broiler. Let the breads cool until they are warm enough to handle. If you like your bread soft, bake them longer, and allow to cool before popping them out of the pan into your oven. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: fava bean,canning salt,jaggery,chicken thigh,chinese five spice powder,bok choy
title: Chinese Five-Spice Chicken and Beans
ingredients: 200 g chinese five spice powder ( p.a.n. ) | 500 g chicken thigh, skin and fat removed and cut into bite-size pieces | 5 tablespoons canning salt | 250 g bok choy ( or 2 bunches ) or 250 g baby bok choy ( or 2 bunches ) | 200 g dried fava beans ( chinese black beans ) | 2 tablespoons jaggery ( optional ) or 2 tablespoons palm sugar, if desired ( optional )
instructions: For the rub, in a medium bowl, mix the five spice powder with the chicken pieces and pour over 1/4 cup water.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,garlic clove,lettuce,oyster sauce,coriander powder,mexican cheese,marjoram
title: Crispy Cheese With Garlic
ingredients: 500 g mexican blend cheese | 1 tablespoon curry powder | 1/3 cup coriander powder | 1/3 cup curry powder | 1 -2 tablespoon marjoram | 500 g lettuce ( the washed leaves of ) | 1 garlic clove
instructions: Heat oil in frying pan on low medium. In a bowl, add garlic cloves and curry powder. Stir until cloves are softened. Add marjoram to the oil. Add coriander powder, curry powder and cheese. Mix. Add salt to taste. Serve with chicken and rice or pasta.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk,hard egg,cumin seed,tarragon vinegar,edamame,tomato juice,cherry tomato,egg
title: Spanish Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 2 large hard-boiled eggs | 2 ripe tomatoes | 1 package sliced edamame, thawed | 1/8 cup cherry tomatoes | 1 cup coconut milk, or more to taste | 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin seeds | 2 tablespoons fresh tarragon vinegar | 2 tablespoons tomato juice
instructions: Place eggs into a saucepan and cover with cold water.

Random Ingredients: chili sauce,apple juice green grocer,irish whiskey
title: Harry James's Irish Apple Pie
ingredients: 1 bottle irish whiskey | 6 ounces sweet green chili sauce | 3 -4 pints apple juice ( you may also use canned apple juice ( or half an apple, diced )
instructions: In a large pot mix together the whiskey, sweet chili sauce, and apple juice. Cook on low heat for at least an hour, preferably 1 hour or until the mixture thickens but doesn't become too dry. Stir well to prevent scorching then fill in refrigerator.
