If using the frozen apple, just cover with foil while heating and refrigerate overnight.

title: Linguine With Grapeseed Oil
ingredients: 24 ounces linguine | 2 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Cook linguine until al dente and drain. Return cooking liquid to pot and add crumbs. Stirring frequently, cook until thick. Serve over spaghetti.

title: Spinach With Green Tomato Chutney
ingredients: 10 green tomatoes | 5 green tomatoes | 2 tablespoons chile-flavored sherry | 100 g spinach | 3 tablespoons fruit chutney | 2 tablespoons dried marjoram | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda
instructions: Wash and deseed tomatoes and slice off the rind from around the core. Using your hands, remove the skins from the tomatoes, and discard. Skin the tomatoes and slice into cubes. Heat the chile in a heavy based saucepan over medium low heat. Add the spinach and stir around. Reduce the heat to low, then add the grated onion, tomatoes and sherry. Simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove from the heat and set aside to cool. In a small bowl, add the chutney and marjoram to the chutney and mix. Pour the cooled chutney into a small bowl and add the bicarbonate of soda. Stir to blend. Place the tomatoes in a serving bowl, pour over the chutney and stir to combine. Use a spoon to garnish with a spoonful of chopped coriander seeds if you like.

title: Chocolate Calzone (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 1 package ground round | 12 ounces italian cut green beans ( can use any shape you prefer ) | 12 -20 baby spinach leaves | 3/4 - 1 cup catsup | 1 tablespoon steak sauce | 1/2 cup semi-sweet chocolate sandwich thick chocolate hershey kiss
instructions: Spray a 10 inch quiche baking dish with cooking spray. Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Brown meat in saucepan. Slice green beans in half lengthwise and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Remove meat from skillet, set aside. Remove any remaining grease from skillet, place in baking dish, stir to release any browned bits from the bottom of the pan. Set aside. Place spinach leaves in a strainer and run under cold water for 2 to 3 seconds. Remove and dry on paper towels. Place green beans on cutting board and slice diagonally about half way through. Put green beans in baking dish, add meat and coat with catsup. Pour catsup mixture over top. Sprinkle with chocolate chips, sprinkle on chocolate sandwich and bake, uncovered for 20 - 30 minutes, covered.

Random Ingredients: corn,ajwain,biscuit,anise seed,steak,flat leaf italian parsley,avocado dip,balsamic vinegar
title: Crispy Beef Rolls
ingredients: 3 cups cooked beef, shredded | 1 can refrigerated biscuit | 3/4 cup red chili pepper sauce or 3/4 cup salsa fresca cheese | 1 cup canned corn, drained | 1/4 cup flat-leaf italian parsley, chopped | 1/4 cup aged balsamic vinegar | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 2 avocados, seeded, peeled, mashed
instructions: Heat oven to in bowl, combine stewed beef with biscuit crumbs.

title: Mama's Chicken and Potato Pie
ingredients: 2 -3 boneless chicken thighs, cubed | 2 tablespoons potato starch | 2 1/2 cups whipping cream | 1/2 cup brandy ( or rum ) | garlic salt | linguine ( optional )
instructions: In a medium sized bowl, mix the whipping cream. Dredge chicken in the potato starch. Then in the whipping cream mixture. Heat oil in a large fry pan. Coat the chicken in the paprika & garlic salt. Dip in the chicken mixture, then fry in oil for 5 - 7 mins on each side. Drain on paper towels then pour brandy over dish and ignite. Turn to the other side and ignite with a long handled match. Serve topped with chopped parsley.

Random Ingredients: cumin seed,cauliflower floret,chicken bouillon,green chili,marinara sauce
title: Italian Chicken and Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower floret | 1 green chili, chopped | 4 tablespoons chicken bouillon | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1 cup jarred marinara sauce
instructions: Cook cauliflower in boiling sauce 5 minutes, then drain. Heat remaining ingredients in medium saucepan over low heat until hot and bubbly. Stir cauliflower into hot sauce. Simmer, uncovered, 4 - 5 minutes, until cauliflower is tender.

Random Ingredients: yogurt,turkey breast half,ham,tomato green chilies,adobo seasoning
title: Gordita Chicken Salad (Gordita Maracen)
ingredients: 2 pounds skinless, boneless turkey breast halves | 2 cans diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1 package plain yogurt | adobo seasoning to taste | 12 fluid ounces cooked ham, cut into 1/4 inch pieces
instructions: Slice turkey in half lengthwise and pound to 1/4 inch thickness, then cut diagonally into 1/2 inch strips. Set aside. Place tomatoes and green chilies in a blender with 2 cups cold water.

title: Cashew Butter(Mock Ferrero Sauce) Made With Shallots and Salted Cashews
ingredients: 1/4 cup shallots, finely diced | 1 tablespoon cashews, finely shredded
instructions: Mix everything well. Serve. Mock agri yummy.

Random Ingredients: vanilla bean,toothpick,white wine,ricotta cheese,red enchilada sauce,cardamom powder,pattypan squash
title: Shredded Caramelized Squash
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated sun-dried tomatoes enchilada sauce | 1/2 cup light ricotta cheese | 1 cup diced pattypan squash ( about 2 pounds ) | 2 teaspoons vanilla beans | 2 teaspoons cardamom powder | 1 tablespoon dry white wine | 12 toothpicks | 1 tablespoon white wine | 1 tablespoon shaved powdered sugar ( optional ) or 1 tablespoon shaved powdered icing ( optional )
instructions: Prepare jelly roll pan, by rubbing with 1/2 tsp of salt until coated. In a saucepan set over medium/high heat, lightly coat with 1/2 tsp oil. Add squash.

title: Veal Saltimbocca
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs veal cutlets | 1 1/2 cups marinara sauce | 2/3 cup fresh basil sprig, tied with kitchen twine | 1 large radish, quartered
instructions: Rinse the veal cutlets under cold water and pat dry with paper towels. Cut the thin slices crosswise into 1/8 inch thick slices. Add the slices to a large skillet over medium high heat. Cook without moving the pan until they are toasted and just barely a little crusty, 3 to 4 minutes per side. Set aside on paper towels. Stir the marinara sauce into the skillet.

Random Ingredients: lime zest,chili powder,chocolate,italian tomato,chicken leg quarter,garlic clove,shrimp
title: Crock Pot Chili
ingredients: 1/4 cup chili powder | 2 garlic cloves, minced | 2 tablespoons fresh lime zest, minced | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 1 can italian-style stewed tomatoes, undrained | 2 1/2 lbs zesty chicken leg quarters | 8 large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1/2 cup shredded unsweetened chocolate
instructions: In a large nonstick skillet, combine chili powder, garlic, lime zest and chili powder. Stir in tomatoes and simmer 3 hours, stirring occasionally. Place chicken and shrimp in a 3 1/2 to 4 quart slow cooker. Pour chili mixture over chicken and shrimp. Cover and cook on low setting 3 hours, or until shrimp are done and chicken is thoroughly cooked. Sprinkle shredded chocolate over top and serve.

Random Ingredients: hard egg,deli roast beef,parsnip,yellow pepper,parsley,cider vinegar,lime leaf
title: Southern Style Parsnips and Eggs
ingredients: 2 pounds parsnips, peeled and cut into 2-inch pieces | 1 jar sweet pickles with liquid, such as kirkland signature garlic syrup | 1/2 cup cider vinegar | 12 fresh lime leaves | 2 cans deli roast beef, cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 yellow sweet peppers, seeded and cut into cubes
instructions: Place parsnips into a large pot and cover with water. Bring to a boil and then simmer until the parsnips are tender. Drain and set aside. Meanwhile, in a mixing bowl, combine the sweet pickle liquid with the cider vinegar and lime leaves and set aside. Drain the canned roast beef and chop into 1 inch pieces. Place the beef mixture into a bowl, and stir in the parsnips and peppers. Cover the bowl and refrigerate the mixture.

title: Spice-Marinated Shrimps or Windsored Carrots
ingredients: 2 cups baby carrots | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and chopped | 1/4 cup oil | 1/4 cup miso ( japanese sweet soy sauce ) | 1/4 teaspoon allspice
instructions: Place carrots in large resealable plastic bag. Add sun dried tomatoes and olive oil and toss well to combine. Seal and let marinate in refrigerator for 1 hour, tossing every 20 minutes. Place 2 teaspoons of miso in paper towel in a shallow dish. Drain allspice from bag and spread or shake allspice dry with paper towel. Serve carrots on top of miso.

title: Kasseri Kebabs
ingredients: 24 wooden skewers, soaked for two hours in cold water, drained | 1/2 pound thinly sliced prosciutto ham | 1 pound kasseri cheese, grated
instructions: Thread prosciutto ham onto skewers. Place kebabs on a baking sheet in a single layer, and press to even the thickness. Bake at 450 degrees f for 15 to 20 minutes, until golden. Grate kasseri cheese onto skewers when they are cool and serve with kasseri cheese flavored crackers.

Random Ingredients: coriander powder,beef brisket,bialy bun,basmati rice,chicken wing,romano cheese,extra virgin olive oil,poppy seed
title: Poppy Seed Beef Rolls
ingredients: 1 cup raw cacao poppy seeds | 1 can coriander powder | 1 1/2 lbs large beef brisket, scored | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 4 berryy buns, cut into 4 pieces ( or 6 ciabatta, split, lengthwise ) | 1/4 cup grated romano cheese | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1 lb romano cheese, thinly sliced | 4 poppy seed wrappers
instructions: Put poppy seeds and coriander powders in a spice grinder and grind coarsely. Spread both sides of brisket generously with the poppy seeds. Heat 1 tblsp. Olive oil in a heavy skillet over medium to high heat and sear brisket on all sides. Transfer to a roasting pan and add remaining 1 tblsp. Olive oil and brown brisket on all sides. Spread remaining spice mixture evenly over brisket and roast on a foil lined baking pan. Roast, uncovered, in a 400º oven until thermometer registers 135ºf, about 1 hour. Remove from oven, cover and set aside. When brisket is done, remove from oven and let it stand for 10 minutes. If using whole berry buns, spread half of each with grated romano cheese. Cut off thick edge, cut in 1/4 wide slices, then arrange on a serving platter. Cut brisket thinly. Warm sandwiches slightly and put on serving platter with bread slitts folded in half. Scatter with poppy seeds.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,carrot,serrano pepper,beef bouillon powder,spanish onion,nutmeg,red curry paste,corn cob
title: Spicy Thai Beef Kabobs
ingredients: 1 tablespoon light red curry paste | 1/4 cup pineapple juice | 1 tablespoon beef bouillon powder | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 1 carrot, cut into large bite size pieces | 1 small spanish onion, cut into large bite sizes pieces | 1 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1/2 serrano pepper, diced | 1/2 small corn on the cob, cut into thirds
instructions: Place all the ingredients except the corn, in the order given except for the corn, in a resealable plastic bag. Seal completely and gently shake. Alternate method, in a bowl place beef in the mixture and marinate at least 4 hours. Heat coals or grill.

title: Tomatillo Sauce (Mexican Style Tomatillos)
ingredients: 4 lbs tomatillos | 1 can cream of chicken soup ( mexican style )
instructions: In a large, tall saucepan, combine tomatillos and cream of chicken soup. Bring to boil and simmer on medium heat for about 30 minutes or until desired thickness is achieved, stirring constantly. Serve warm over your favorite mexican dish.

Random Ingredients: rose water,cracker crumb,lettuce leaf,kaffir lime leaf,watercress,vodka,bacon,jalapeno pepper seed
title: Thai Spicy Sour Cream and Wine Salad
ingredients: 4 ounces bacon, chopped or 1/2 lb fresh turkey bacon, chopped | 1 tablespoon rose water ( or more to taste ) | fresh rose petals or fresh rosemary leaf | 2 cans vodka ( or other type of good quality white wine ) | 1 lb lettuce leaf ( i like lettuce in this ) | 1 -16 ounce watercress, for garnish | 1 -2 jalapeno pepper, minced ( to taste ) ( optional ) | 1 handful cracker crumb | pot stickers made from scratch or canned whipped cream ( optional )
instructions: Melt the bacon in a microwave safe bowl in the microwave. Add rose water and continue to cook on high for 2 or 4 minutes to warm it up and start cooking the bacon. Combine the vodka and water, if using and set aside. Cut up the lettuce and watercress into small pieces. In a mixing bowl, mix all other ingredients together. Stir in the crispy bacon and serve immediately. Variation, add a couple shakes of fresh ground coffee to the mix for a smoother taste. Note, this really changes the taste of the dish. The bacon has a different flavor and smell than the turkey. Adding rosewater or rosemary is particularly nice in this dish.

Random Ingredients: clove,red pepper,paprika,coffee powder,mango,anise seed,bok choy,dill pickle
title: Chop Suey
ingredients: 3 mangoes, large | 2 bok choy | 3 dill pickles, minced | 1 teaspoon instant coffee powder, instant powder | 1/2 teaspoon ground cloves | 1/2 teaspoon ground blackened anise seed ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon paprika
instructions: Slice mangoes and bok choy. Mash with hands and put aside. Slice pickles lengthwise in half. Take 1 - 2 mangoes and cut them crosswise into 1/3 inch slices on the bias. Place slices in the bowl. Peel and mince the pickle. Add remaining ingredients except paprika to the bowl. Add remaining vegetables. Pour the mixture into a 2 quart baking dish. Sprinkle paprika over. Bake in a 350f degrees oven for 30 minutes. Stir before serving. Serve, this is good with ketchup as a side dish.

title: Spaetzle II
ingredients: 2 pounds sirloin tip steak, thinly sliced | 2 containers mascarpone cheese
instructions: Spread the shredded steak onto a plate, and sprinkle with a little salt. Cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate until ready to use. Slice the steak into thin strips, and toss them with the mascarpone cheese in a bowl. Cover, and refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: fingerling potato,seasoning mix,beef stew meat,chili paste,pineapple
title: Thai Fingerling Pot Roast
ingredients: 1/2 cup sweet chili paste | 1 1/2 lbs beef stew meat | 1 can crushed pineapple, drained | 1/3 cup fresh pineapple juice or 1/3 cup beef broth | 1 package dry sloppy joe mix
instructions: In 1 gallon plastic bag, add chili paste. Seal.

Random Ingredients: red bean paste,hash brown,cake yeast,phyllo dough,chili seasoning mix,italian sausage,cucumber,milk
title: Easy Sweet Italian Sausage Rolls
ingredients: 8 ounces sweet italian sausage | 0.5 package frozen mashed potatoes | 1 tablespoon red bean paste | 1 package potato-flavored cake yeast | 2 cups milk | 1/2 ounce chili seasoning mix | 1 cucumber | 1 tablespoon shredded phyllo dough
instructions: Remove fat from sausage, crumble, brown in large skillet over medium heat.

title: Pharaonic
ingredients: 2 lbs cooked meat, cut in thin slices | 12 green olives | 12 cantaloupe, peeled | 1 lb chicken stock ( or other stock ) | 4 tablespoons chopped fresh italian parsley | 1/4 cup ghee | 1 star fruit
instructions: Chop the star fruit into tiny pieces and fry the ghee with the starfruit. Add the meat and fry well until golden brown. Add the chicken stock and cook until meat is tender. Remove from heat and stir in the chopped parsley. Serve sprinkled with salt and pepper, and drizzled with a few tablespoons of ghee in a spiral at the beginning of the phaonic.

title: Easy Baked Chocolate Chicken
ingredients: 1 cup low-fat icing sugar | 1/2 cup chopped chicken breast, cooked or 1/2 cup shredded cooked chicken | 2 tablespoons semi-sweet chocolate chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Spread icing sugar on chicken, sprinkle with chocolate chips. Place on parchment lined baking sheet. Bake for about 15 minutes, or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: pepperoni,self raising flour,vegetarian bean,romaine lettuce leaf,cumin seed,pinto bean,balsamic vinegar
title: Ricciarelli (Olive Bread) and Bean Salad.
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon cumin seed | 1/3 cup vegetarian baked beans | 1/4 cup chopped pepperoni | 4 -5 romaine lettuce leaves | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons self raising flour | 1 can pinto beans or ( 16 ounce ) can white kidney beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f and place cumin powder in a food processor or spice grinder and process until fine. Add beans, pepperoni and 1 tbsp cooking liquid. Process until smooth. Turn onto a floured surface and knead lightly. Roll out on a greased baking tray until it is 1 inch thick, 15 times. Place on a tray while you make the dressing. Mix together the vinegar and the rest of the liquid, pour over the salad, cover and place in a bowl. Just before serving, drizzle with vinegar to finish.

Random Ingredients: garlic powder,beef bouillon cube,granny smith apple,tabasco sauce,kosher salt,anchovy,green chilies
title: Anjou's Spanish Meat Loaf
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef round ( or a combination ) | 1 granny smith apple | 1 can whole green chilies | 4 green anchovies, mashed | 3 tablespoons chopped garlic powder | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 1 bottle tabasco sauce
instructions: If using a loaf pan use a 13x9 baking dish or a roasting pan. It is necessary if the loaf pan is smaller than average size to allow room for the meat loaf filling. If using a pan for crock pot use only the bottom. Place all ingredients except the olive oil/oil and the top of the pan in your slow cooker and mix well. The oil will be very hot if you mix too much. The olive oil can be stored in fridge or frozen for use later. If using your slow cooker it will only need about 1 hour to cook. Set cooker to low and allow to cook for about 3 hours. Use two forks to push the liquid out of the loaf pan and place on a cutting board. In a large mixing bowl, add the cheese mixture, cheese mixture and the top of the pan. Mix thoroughly and set aside. When ready to use, slice the loaf into 1 slices or desired size. When ready to serve, coat both sides of the loaf with oil and either bake or place in a toaster oven for about 10 minutes to brown the crust. Or put in the toaster for 5 more minutes if you like crisp crust like i do. Serve with salsa and green beans.

Random Ingredients: yellow squash,barbecue sauce,egg,turnip,colby monterey jack cheese,french bread
title: Easy Slow Cooker Veggies
ingredients: 6 yellow squash, peeled with ends | 6 turnips, peeled with peel left on | 1/2 loaf french bread - cut into 6 pieces | 3 eggs, beaten | 2 cups barbecue sauce | 1/2 cup jack & jilapeno hot sauce, sriracha suggested
instructions: Place squash, turnips, bread, eggs and barbecue sauce in the slow cooker. Cook on high for 3 hours. Serve warm. Garnish with sriracha.

Random Ingredients: extra beef,stewing beef,fish sauce,pecorino romano cheese,bamboo shoot,mace
title: Beef and Nuts in Spicy Basil Soup
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs stewing beef, cut in 3/4 inch strips | 1/4 lb extra lean ground beef | 1 cup pecorino romano cheese | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 1 teaspoon fish sauce | 1 can bamboo shoots, sliced
instructions: Combine beef, onion, cheese, mace, fish sauce and 2 cups water in slow cooker. Cover and cook on high for 1 to 1 1/2 hours until beef is tender.

title: Cherie's Chicken Loaf
ingredients: 1 cup whole wheat flour | 1 cup neufchatel cheese | 1 tablespoon lime juice | 1 pound skinless, boneless chicken parts | 1 can stewed tomatoes, drained and chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Combine the whole wheat flour, neufchatel cheese, lime juice, and chicken in a bowl and mix well to blend. Roll 1/3 of the dough out into a 10x15 inch pan and arrange over the bottom of the pan. Arrange the tomatoes over the meat, followed by 1/2 of the crumpled loaf dough, covering the tomatoes. Continue layering until the top layer of bread is completely covered. Pour the remaining 1/3 of the dough over the cheese and top with remaining bread. Bake in the preheated oven until the loaf is golden brown, about 45 minutes.

title: Chili Cod
ingredients: 1 kg cod | 4 chilies, chopped | 1 tablespoon horseradish
instructions: First boil the fish for about 6 mins at boiling, then take out, cover and leave to cook for another 6 - 8 mins. Drain the fish and pat dry. Boil the chillies, pour in the water and add the fish. Cover for about 7 - 10 mins, then turn off the heat and leave the fish in it for another 5 - 10 mins. Mix the horseradish with the mixture and serve.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,egg,mushroom,nutella,italian dressing,beef bouillon granule
title: Crispy Italian Beef Breakfast Balls
ingredients: 4 eggs | 1 1/2 teaspoons beef bouillon granules | 1 1/2 tablespoons italian dressing | 1 package sliced fresh mushrooms | 1 yellow bell pepper, cut into slivers | 1 tablespoon nutella
instructions: Whisk the eggs and bouillon granules in a bowl. Stir in the italian dressing, mushrooms, bell pepper, and nutella.

title: Lentil Rice Cake Dessert
ingredients: 2 boxes yellow cake mix | 1 can of sliced pitted olives | 1 box brown lentils | 1 tablespoon brown rice vinegar | 1 teaspoon sugar | 1/2 cup raisins
instructions: Combine all ingredients and bake in bundt pan or 9x13 inch pan. Can be served with fresh fruit, if desired.

title: Halibut in Amaq
ingredients: 1 3/4 pounds halibut fillets | 2 cans crushed pineapple, drained
instructions: Preheat grill for high heat. Rub halibut with 2 tablespoons amaq. Place on hot grate. Cook to desired level of doneness.

Random Ingredients: pork rib,superfine sugar,pork shoulder,vegetable cabbage,romaine lettuce,baking soda
title: Bunuelos (Mexican Pork and Cabbage)
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons baking soda | 12 lbs pork shoulder ( cured pork ribs ) | 12 lbs pork shoulder, cured shoulder ( cured pork shoulder ) | 1 1/2 pounds veg. cabbage, shredded | 3 packages romaine lettuce | 3 lbs superfine sugar or superfine sugar, for caramelizing
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. In large bowl, mix together baking soda and salt. Add pork pieces and let sit for a while, then pat dry with paper towels. In a large dutch oven or other large oven safe pot, place pork pieces, pork shoulder and cabbage. Drain liquid from pork. Cover pork with water, bring to boil, then reduce heat to simmer. Cook for 1 to 2 hours. Turn once halfway through. Remove pork from pot, and set aside to cool on a cutting board. Remove meat from bones and shred meat. To caramelize, in a separate small pan, bring a small amount of oil to a medium heat just until oil shimmers. Add the sugar to the oil and stir well. Continue to stir until sugar is dissolved and the syrup is clear. Continue to stir for the entire hour.

title: Swiss Steakhouse Green Onion Sauce
ingredients: 2 1/2 pounds sirloin steaks | 1/4 cup worcestershire sauce or soy sauce | salt and ground black pepper to taste | 1 large green onion, thinly sliced
instructions: Season sirloin steaks with worcestershire sauce. Rub salt and pepper into both sides. Place steaks in a slow cooker. Place green onions on the steak. Pour the marinade over the steaks. Cover, and cook on low until steaks are easily pierced with a fork, about 6 hours.

Random Ingredients: pineapple chunk,worcestershire sauce,chunky peanut butter,red chili,lemon zest,cayenne pepper,wheat flour
title: Easy Pineapple Peanut Crisp
ingredients: 1 jar large chunk pineapple chunks, drained | 2 tablespoons chunky peanut butter | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 2 drops ground red chili | 1/2 teaspoon lemon zest | 1 -2 pinch cayenne pepper | 1 tablespoon whole wheat flour
instructions: In a large bowl, mash pineapple chunks with a fork. Add peanut butter, worcestershire sauce, chili, lemon zest, cayenne and flour. Stir until smooth. Scoop into buttered 8 x 8 inch baking dish and let set for at least 30 minutes or up to 3 hours before serving. Bake, uncovered for 30 - 45 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Spicy Baked Rub
ingredients: 2 teaspoons hot paprika | 1 teaspoon ground cumin
instructions: Mix it together. Use to brush onto meat of your favorite veggies, roast chicken or pork chops or bake as desired.

title: Cherry Tomatoes With Potatoes and Rosemary
ingredients: 6 medium red potatoes, cut into 1/4-inch slices | 2 cups cherry tomatoes, halved | 8 fresh rosemary sprigs | 12 sheets lasagna noodles
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil or parchment paper. Using a mandoline or kitchen shears, cut the potatoes lengthwise into 1/4 slices. Place the slices in a large bowl. Drizzle with 1/2 cup water and toss to coat. Arrange the tomatoes on the baking sheet. Gently sprinkle the top with 1/2 tablespoon water. Sprinkle with 2 rosemary sprigs. Using a sharp knife, cut the lasagna sheets crosswise into 6 even strips. Place a few at a time on the baking sheet. Bake until the tomatoes are slightly charred and the potatoes are tender, 15 to 20 minutes. Transfer the baking sheet to the oven and bake the lasagna for 2 to 3 minutes longer. Stir the cooked lasagna and the vegetables back together and remove from the oven. Scoop individual servings of the pan juices onto each serving plate. Spoon some of the tomato, potato and rosemary on top.

title: Mango & Tomatoes Pasta With Tomatoes
ingredients: 120 g shell pasta | 1 - 1 1/2 mango, ripe | 1 -2 clove, garlic ( or use 1/4 teaspoon of each ) | 1 pinch salt | 1 -2 teaspoon oregano leaves | crushed ice
instructions: Peel mango and discard seeds. Cut into pieces and boil with clove garlic or oregano until tender. Cut tomatoes into thin slice and place in a blender. Add mango and blend until smooth. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Add crushed ice and enjoy.

title: Pineapple Preserves
ingredients: 1 pineapple chunk, cut into 3 pieces | 2 oranges, zest of
instructions: Prepare your orange zest by peeling and removing the pith at the root end. This is easier if you wear rubber gloves while working with the peel. Cut the pineapple chunks into 1/4” to ¼” pieces. Take the zest off a piece of rind and cut into fine strips, then spread out the strips on a cutting board. In a ziploc place orange zest, pineapple bits, orange zest powder and sugar until all ingredients are mixed. Refrigerate for about an hour to allow flavor to blend. Place your serving platter on the table in what is to be your next day. Enjoy note, if your pineapple is not going to be eaten right away, store in a plastic bag for up to 6 weeks.

Random Ingredients: cheddar cheese,coriander powder,kale,vanilla yogurt,baby spinach,vidalia onion,barbeque seasoning,bay leaf
title: Indian Spinach
ingredients: 1 bag baby spinach | 1 large vidalia onion | 1 tablespoon barbeque seasoning | 1 bunch kale | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 1 bay leaf, optional | 1/4 cup low-fat vanilla yogurt | 1/2 cup grated cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven broiler. Place spinach and onion on a broiler pan and roast them just a minute or two on each side. While the veggies are roasting, blend kale, coriander powder, and bay leaf together in a blender until the kale is finely chopped. Add the seasoning mix to kale mixture and blend well. Spread mixture evenly over the spinach and place in the pan. Heat until the mixture starts to bubble, then reduce the heat and simmer for 3 or 4 minutes. Divide the mixture evenly among four small oven safe bowls. Top each bowl with the cheese.

title: Cauliflower Oat Nuggets
ingredients: 1 medium cauliflower, coarsely chopped | 1 small roma tomato, chopped | 1 1/2 cups quick-cooking oats | 1/3 cup rye flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 425. Place the cauliflower, tomato, oats, and rye flour in a 9x5 inch baking pan. Bake for 30 minutes, or until crisp. Sprinkle with more rye flour if desired and cook for an additional 5 minutes, or until dry.

title: Roasted Sweet Potatoes
ingredients: 1/2 cup balsamic vinegar ( i use kraft's tuscan-flavoured tuscan-vinegar ) | 2 lbs baking potatoes, peeled
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Coat a heavy 2+1/2 to 3 quart ovenproof skillet with cooking spray. Cut each potato lengthwise into 2 wedges and arrange them in the pan. Pour the vinegar over the potatoes and cover with foil. Bake until sweet potatoes are tender when pierced with a fork, about 45 minutes. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: puff pastry,red bell pepper,vegetable oil,sun tomato oil,cilantro leaf,soymilk,dark sesame oil
title: Vegetarian Quesadillas
ingredients: 2 ounces puff pastry | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 7/8 cup soymilk | 1 tablespoon sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained | 1/4 teaspoon roasted red bell pepper, finely chopped | 1/4 cup fresh cilantro leaves, torn
instructions: On a lightly oiled baking sheet, unfold half the puff pastry and flatten into a rectangle. Brush top with vegetable oil & sprinkle with sesame oil. Bake at 400f for 8 minutes. Meanwhile, heat soy milk, sun dried tomatoes & red bell pepper in small saucepan over medium heat until hot. When the pastry has been in the oven for 20 minutes, remove from the oven & cut into 8 squares. Top each square with 2 tbsp soy milk mixture, sprinkle with cilantro & serve.

title: Manchego Rice Salad
ingredients: 8 cups cooked rice ( leftover ) | 1 cucumber, sliced into thin rounds | 8 ounces manchego cheese, cut into thin strips | 1 -2 sprigs fresh savory
instructions: Wash and rinse rice. Soak in ice water until just soft. Remove rinds as it is very soft. Combine with cucumber and cheese in a salad bowl. Sprinkle savory on top. If you don't like savory, just chop it up and toss in.

title: Asian Beef Bowl
ingredients: 1/2 lb boneless beef top sirloin, cut diagonally across the grain into 1/4-inch-thick slices | 2 tablespoons hoisin sauce, divided | 2 tablespoons fresh italian parsley, chopped | 1 lb linguine, cooked according to package directions
instructions: Combine 1/4 cup hoisin sauce and 1 tablespoon parsley, stirring well. Add beef and toss until well coated. Heat remaining 1 tablespoon oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Add beef. Cook and stir until beef loses its redness. Add beef to bowls. Pour remaining 1/2 cup hoisin sauce over top and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: asparagus spear,chicken breast fillet,white flour,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Parmigiano-Reggiano Chicken
ingredients: 500 g chicken breast fillets | 100 g white flour | 1 1/4 cups parmigiano-reggiano cheese, freshly grated | asparagus spear, steamed
instructions: Place chicken between paper towel and pound to about 1 cm thickness with a meat mallet or a rolling pin. Place flour in a shallow bowl and toss chicken pieces to coat. Then use your hands to roll out the flour on a flat baking tray. Combine cheese and parmesan in a bowl and toss with chicken. Then use your hands to roll out the cheese until all the cheese has been addedand coated. Lay the chicken pieces on a tray and bake in a moderate oven until the meat reaches 170 degrees celcius on a digital thermometer. Or, you can place the chicken in a frying pan and grill until done. Garnish with steamed asparagus, serve with creamy garlic bread.

Random Ingredients: arugula leaf,asafoetida powder,grapefruit juice,shiitake mushroom,red chilies,crisco,tomato puree
title: Spicy Arugula Salad
ingredients: 200 g frozen grapesfruit juice | 200 g tomatoes puree | 80 ml crisco | 20 shiitake mushrooms | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 red chilies | 100 g arugula leaves
instructions: In a pot, put pineapple, grapesfruit juice, tomatoes, chillies, gosato puree and 3 cups of water. Cook for 15 - 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Let cool. Clean and cut arugula leaves.

Random Ingredients: tostada shell,chinese cabbage,beef tenderloin,mascarpone cheese,green pepper
title: Stuffed Beef Tostadas
ingredients: 12 tostadas shells | 1 lb beef tenderloin, sliced | 1/2 chinese cabbage, shredded | 1 cup mascarpone cheese | 12 slices green peppers, thin
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.

title: Sweet Curry Paste
ingredients: 3 tablespoons mild curry paste | 6 green cardamom pods
instructions: Dry roast the curry paste on the top flame of a grill or in a heavy skillet for 5 minutes. If the heat is too high, the seeds in the masala can burn. Take off the flame and carefully add the curry paste. Store in an airtight container.

title: Ancho Chiles With Salsa
ingredients: 2 large ancho chiles, seeded and peeled ( about 4 to 6 ounces ) | 3 cups salsa ( mild, medium or hot ) | 2 -3 tablespoons fresh cilantro, minced ( to taste )
instructions: Heat a dry skillet over moderate heat. Add chiles and toast, pressing them against the pan with a rubber spatula, until fragrant and slightly charred, 10 to 15 seconds. Using a slotted spoon, transfer chiles to a bowl and let stand, uncovered, at least 30 minutes. Strain chiles and discard soaking liquid. Place chiles in a large bowl and cover with hot salsa. Let stand at least 1 hour, stir before serving.

title: Asparagus With Mace and Mace
ingredients: 1/2 lb asparagus | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Snip off and discard tough ends from asparagus. Cut each spear diagonally in half lengthwise, then cut diagonally into 1 1/2 lengths or thirds. Steam the asparagus for 8 minutes or until tender.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast fillet,mexican corn,lamb,margarine,brown sugar,tarragon,pigeon pea,rhubarb
title: Chicken and Sheep's Poultry
ingredients: 2 tablespoons margarine | 4 chicken breast fillets | 1/2 ounce brown sugar | 1 sprig fresh tarragon | 3 ounces chopped rhubarb ( the frozen ones ) | 1/2 ounce split polished polenta peas | 2 ounces chopped frozen margarine | 1 tablespoon mexican crema or 1 tablespoon mexican crema mixed with a little tarragon | 1/2 ounce frozen pearl onions ( the sweet ones )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Spray a shallow ovenproof dish with vegetable oil spray. Place chicken breasts on top in dish and sprinkle brown sugar, tarragon, rhubarb and peas on top of chicken evenly. Put the olives onto the top of the chicken, then pour crema mix over all. Sprinkle remaining brown sugar and tarragon over. Bake in middle of oven for 40 minutes. Serve the meal with the extra crema, sliced spring onions and freshly steamed veggies.

Random Ingredients: filet beef,white rice,burrito flour tortilla,chuck roast,hungarian paprika,onion,chili oil,garlic clove
title: Baked Beef Burritos
ingredients: 1 -2 lb skirt steak | 1 teaspoon hungarian paprika ( or other mild hungarian hot paprika ) | 1 tablespoon chili oil | 1/2 lb steak, cut in 1-inch strips | 1 can chuck roast | 5 medium burrito-size flour tortillas | 2 garlic cloves, peeled and cut in half lengthwise | fresh sweet onion, sliced, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: The night before, cut the meat into thin bite size strips. Trim excess fat off the beef and any fat that leaks out. In a large, deep skillet, mix the paprika, chili oil and beef. Place beef mixture on top of the meat, and set it in the fridge overnight. The next day, remove beef mixture from the fridge. Preheat oven to 375°fGrease a 9x13 baking dish. Place meat, chopped garlic, sliced onions and whatever other desired toppings you like in between the tortillas. If desired, spread some paprika on top of the meat, and bake at 375°f for 1 hour.

title: Roasted Potatoes With Pepper and Garlic
ingredients: 4 medium russet potatoes, scrubbed but not peeled | 1 cup shredded roasted red sweet pepper | 24 slices crystallized red peppers
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. In a 13 x 9 inch baking dish, toss the potatoes with the roasted sweet pepper, then add the crystallized chilies. Smooth the surface of the potatoes with a spatula. Bake until the sweet pepper is tender, about 40 minutes and then serve immediately.

title: Vietnamese Mango Truffles
ingredients: 8 ounces rice vermicelli, broken into 2 inch pieces ( about 30 ) | 2 cups fresh mango, chopped | 2 zucchini, sliced | 1 carrot, cut crosswise into very thin julienne strips | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 1 tablespoon brandy ( optional ) | 1 graham cracker square, crushed
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f cook vermicelli in small pot of boiling salted water until tender, about 5 minutes. Drain well. Place mango, zucchini, and carrot in bowl of a food processor. Cover with plastic wrap.

Random Ingredients: madras curry powder,fish sauce,amaretto liqueur,parmigiano reggiano cheese,picante sauce,yoghurt
title: Hot Curry Sauce
ingredients: 1 jar picante sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons amaretto liqueur | 1 1/2 tablespoons pure greek madras curry powder | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 1 ounce yoghurt | 1 ounce parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated
instructions: Put the picante sauce, amaretto, madras curry powder, fish sauce and yoghurt in a shaker with ice and shake very well. Pour into a hot glass. Sprinkle with nutmeg and serve with toasted bread or assorted greens.

title: Jicama and Jicama Flatbread
ingredients: 1 sheet frozen puff pastry | 3 jicama, peeled, sliced, and cut into 8 wedges | 1/3 cup bread flour, or as needed
instructions: Prick pastry with a fork, and roll out into a 12x10 inch rectangle. Place a jicama wedge onto each pastry wedge, and sprinkle with bread flour. Fold the dough under, and pinch the edges together using a fork to seal. Bake in a 425 degree f oven for 20 minutes.

title: Spinach and Rice Krispies Salad
ingredients: 4 cups rice krispies | 1 red bell pepper, diced | 2 tablespoons salad greens | 1 tablespoon roasted sweet unsweetened applesauce | 2 tablespoons fresh spinach, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Place rice krispies in a mixing bowl or cookie sheet. Set aside. Over medium heat, in a skillet, sauté the diced red bell pepper in hot apple sauce until tender, 3 to 5 minutes. Remove from heat, stir in the rice krispies, green salad leaves and roasted sweet unsweetened applesauce. Chill until serving time. Remove mixture from the refrigerator and stir in the chopped freshspinach just before serving.

Random Ingredients: sea salt,ajwain,garam masala,white wine,tarragon,reynolds wrap foil,egg,lemon juice zest
title: Shahi Tukray
ingredients: 2 teaspoons dried tarragon | 2 teaspoons dried tarragon | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1 tablespoon ajwain | 1/4 teaspoon garam masala | 2 teaspoons white wine | 1/4 teaspoon sea salt | 4 eggs | reynolds wrap foil
instructions: Mix the spices in a small bowl and use to coat the shrimp. Melt the rasbutter in a 10 inch oven proof skillet over medium heat. Carefully add the shrimp and brown on all sides, 3 minutes. Turn the shrimp, raise the heat to high and cook until a total of 2 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside, keeping warm. In a small bowl, whisk the eggs with the lemon juice. In the same skillet over medium high heat, heat the remaining butter. Pour in the egg mixture, whisking continuously. When the eggs have thickened slightly, turn off the heat and pour the yolk mixture over the shrimp. Serve immediately.

title: Simple Veggie Noodles
ingredients: 1 package hot noodles | 1 tablespoon nutritional yeast | 2 medium carrots, minced | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 1 small bunch fresh mint leaves, chopped ( coriander )
instructions: In a large saute pan add the noodles and toast until they are cooked through but still firm up a bit. Drain the noodles and rinse under cold water until needed. Meanwhile in a large saute pan melt the nutritional yeast over medium high heat until just starting to foam up, about 2 minutes. Add the carrot, thyme and hot noodles and toss until coated in the yeast mixture. Top with chopped mint. Add salt and pepper to taste. Serve with bread or assorted crackers.

Random Ingredients: linguine,lemon zest,grape tomato,purpose flour,walnut half,hing,jicama,pork tenderloin
title: Linguine With Pork and Jicama
ingredients: 4 thick slices pork tenderloin | 2 teaspoons finely grated lemon zest | 2 teaspoons dried hing | 1/3 cup all-purpose flour | 1 package linguine | 1 cup halved grape tomatoes | 2 cups thinly sliced peeled jicama | 1/3 cup toasted walnut halves ( optional )
instructions: Place pork tenderloins between 2 sheets of waxed paper on waxed paper.

title: Masa's Feta Salad
ingredients: 3 cups feta cheese, crumbled | 1/2 cup raisin bran cereal | 1/4 cup salsa
instructions: Mix feta cheese, raisin bran, and salsa together in a bowl.

title: Panchaco-Style Green Salad
ingredients: romaine lettuce - rinsed and dried | cayenne pepper, to taste
instructions: Toss romaine lettuce with cayenne pepper to taste. Serve hot or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: chorizo sausage,chevre cheese goat,ginger powder,dark soy sauce,bamboo skewer,cardamom powder,honey
title: Aphrodisiac Savurri
ingredients: 2 pate arthur chorizo sausages ( or other savurri ) | 100 g chevre cheese ( or other goat cheese ) | 1/2 teaspoon ginger powder | 100 g dark soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder or 1 teaspoon ground cardamom | 50 g honey | wood skewer ( soaked in water for 2 hours, then drained )
instructions: Wash the chorizo with a damp cloth. Cut into 1 inch squares. Using a sharp knife cut 2 layers into the chevre. Using the middle of a wooden spoon, press and roll the chorizo into a cylinder. Using the same knife, firmly pack the chevre into the chorizo. Arrange in a glass jar or container. If using wooden skewers, soak wooden skewers in water until they are thoroughly soaked. Dry the chevre completely. Heat oven to 180c/355f/gas mark 3 and lay 1/2 cup of the chevre into a shallow dish. Spread the chevre with honey. Arrange other half of the chorizo wrapped churri over the honey and place in the oven. Bake for 20 minutes, or until chevre is crispy on top. Serve with your choice of main meal.

title: Blackberry Chops
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon beef bouillon | 1 package german chocolate, chopped into bits | 1/2 cup blackberries
instructions: Combine bouillon and chocolate and pour into a medium bowl. Stir well. Place blackberries into microwave safe bowl, cover with plastic wrap and microwave on high for 1 minute or until just heated. Spoon contents of bowl onto hot chops.

Random Ingredients: leek,sauce,bay leaf,self rising flour,sun tomato oil,black pepper
title: Leek and Sun-Dried Tomato Damperettes
ingredients: 3 cups self-rising flour | 1 large leek, trimmed and sliced | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, minced | 2 tablespoons light hot sauce | 2 tablespoons fresh coarse ground black pepper | 1/2 cup finely chopped fresh bay leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Prepare muffin tins, using a tea towel. Place flour, leek, dried tomato, hot sauce, pepper and bay leaves in large bowl and stir to blend. Knead dough on lightly floured surface until smooth, about 5 minutes. Place dough in muffin tin and smooth tops. Place muffin tin in oven and bake until damperettes have risen and are lightly browned, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: beef stock,cajun seasoning,chili oil,brown mustard seed,button mushroom,grain rice
title: Rack of N' Sausages
ingredients: 4 -6 links sirloin steak or 4 -6 links sausages ( 1/2 inch diameter ) | 1/2 - 1 cup brown mustard seeds | 1 cup button mushroom ( or baby bellas ) | 2 tablespoons cajun seasoning | 1 -2 cup beef stock | 1 tablespoon chili oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Using 2 knives slice the steaks diagonally into 3/4 inch wide strips and then diagonally into 1/2 inch wide slices. In a large cast iron skillet put in mustard seeds, then quickly add the mushroom and brown mustard seeds. Keep mustard seeds moving in the skillet so that they don't burn and cook until the mushrooms are golden brown and ready. Meanwhile cut sausage into 3/4 inch slices and brown in remaining fat. Add cajun seasoning, then pour in beef stock and chili oil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 10 minutes. Towards the end, remove lid and continue cooking until all gravy has cooked away. Serve over cooked rice.

title: Tasty Red Chili Sauce
ingredients: 1 jar red chili tomatoes and green chilies, undrained | 3 tablespoons flour | 1 can stir-fry sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan. Heat through.

title: Mexican Spice Muffins
ingredients: 1/2 cup salad greens, chopped | 1 jar salsa, medium strength | 2 cups quick-cooking oil, divided | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne powder | 2 cups baking powder | 1 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: Cook and stir salad greens, salsa, oil and cayenne powder in medium bowl 5 minutes or until greens are crisp tender. Let cool slightly. Add baking soda and mix well. Sift together turmeric and remaining ingredients.

title: Aubergine and Ham Rice Salad
ingredients: 2 small aubergines, halved lengthways | 2 cups basmati rice, rinsed | 1/2 cup pecans, chopped, toasted | 8 slices deli ham, chopped
instructions: Cook rice and beans together, covered, for 10 mins, until just tender. Mix rice, aubergine and pecans in large bowl, toss to combine with rice and ham. Serve immediately. Variation use half cooked zucchini, half sliced tomatoes and half sliced zucchini, half sliced onions.

Random Ingredients: milk ricotta cheese,oregano leaf,sesame seed,brandy,chicken bouillon,ra el hanout spice mix
title: Aegean Ricotta Cheese
ingredients: 2 lbs whole milk ricotta cheese | 1 1/2 tablespoons saffron threads ( arak ) | 1 1/2 cups brandy ( not syrup ) | 1/3 cup chicken bouillon | 1 teaspoon oregano leaves, crushed | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds, toasted
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large bowl. Mix well. Refrigerate 6 hours or overnight. Serve with toasted pita bread.

Random Ingredients: table salt,chili bean,caper,sharp cheddar cheese,ham,vanilla essence
title: Hot Ham & Cheddar Frijoles
ingredients: 375 g lean ham, chopped | 375 g sharp cheddar cheese, coarsely grated | 1/2 teaspoon table salt | 1/8 teaspoon vanilla essence | 2 cans chili beans, drained and rinsed | 50 g capers, drained, rinsed
instructions: Combine all ingredients, except capers, in a large bowl. Cover and chill for 2 hours or overnight before serving.

Random Ingredients: red wine,saffron,pesto sauce,french bread,flax seed meal,herb
title: Spiced French Bread Wedges
ingredients: 4 slices french bread, crusts removed, cut on the diagonal 1 1/2 cm thick | 1 cup prepared pesto sauce | 1/2 cup crumbled roasted garlic or 1/2 cup fresh garlic, from a jar, minced, from a jar | 2 -3 teaspoons crushed red passover seeds or 2 -3 teaspoons crushed fax seed meal | 1/2 teaspoon dried mixed herbs or 1/2 teaspoon fresh mixed herbs, finely chopped | 1/4 cup dry red wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 150 degrees celsius or 160 degrees celsius. Using a very sharp knife cut 4 - 8 rounds out of the bread. Arrange one round onto a non stick buttered baking tray. Spread half the pesto over half of each bread round, then top with half the garlic. Season each with 1 1/2 tsp of the crushed red passover seeds or 1 tsp of dried mixed herbs. Scatter top with half the remaining pesto. Using a skewer poke a few holes in the bread around the pesto and garlic. Bake in the oven for 30 - 35 minutes or until the tops are golden with puffed and bubbling.

title: Homemade Smokey Crabs
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons pepper flakes | 1 1/2 teaspoons black peppercorns, coarsely ground in grinder
instructions: To grind the peppercorns coarsely, put the peppercorns in a medium size bowl. Mix the pepper flakes and pepper together. Stir well. Pour the spice mixture over the peppercorns and mix well. Place in a tightly sealed plastic bag. Shake to combine.

title: Baja Fried Okra
ingredients: 1/2 package frozen or fresh okra, thawed | white wine vinegar ( use 1 whole or 2 t whole vinegar for a milder dish ) | onion powder, to taste
instructions: If using fresh okra thaw out and un thaw slightly. In bowl, put thawed okra, and add wine vinegar to thaw out and drain off excess liquid. Drain okra into a glass container with a tight lid.. Squish the okra around the edges of the bowl so okra can breath easily. Sprinkle over desired amount of onion powder. Let sit in the refrigerator until ready to serve. Can also be kept indefinitely in the refrigerator.

title: Crispy Corn Tortilla
ingredients: 9 ears fresh sweet corn kernels, husked | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon prepared mustard | 4 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 can white hominy, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place corn kernels in a baking dish, and brush with vinegar. Bake in the preheated oven, until corn kernels are tender and beginning to soften, about 20 minutes. Mix mustard and cornstarch in a separate bowl, and stir in hominy. When corn is cool, cut kernels off cob, and spread each cob with a 1/4 cup of mustard mixture. Cut the corn from the cob using a sharp knife, if desired. Place corn on a large serving platter, and spread corn into an even layer. Sprinkle with red wine vinegar to serve.

Random Ingredients: vanilla,parmesan cheese,black pepper,chunky salsa,gruyere cheese,cider vinegar,shortening
title: Mexican Quiche II
ingredients: 2 cups gruyere cheese, shredded | 2 teaspoons bacon fat | 2 teaspoons butter or 2 teaspoons margarine, melted | 1/2 cup chunky salsa | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla | 1 1/2 teaspoons grated parmesan cheese | 1/4 teaspoon black pepper
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a mixing bowl. Press mixture into buttered 9 inch pie crust. Bake at 350º for 20 - 25 minutes or until bubbly. Cool and serve.

title: Easy Irish Pie
ingredients: pastry dough | 1 1/2 cups vegetable stock | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c / 400f / gas mark sieve pastry dough and cut the dough into 3 or 4 pieces to form 2 sheets. Place 1 tablespoon of stock in the centre of the pastry sheet. Sprinkle with a little flour, then roll out the dough to a thickness of approx 3 4cm /. With the edge of the pastry nearest you, bring the two edges up over the contents of the pastry lid to create the lid. This creates air that increases the depth of the pastry. Press down firmly on the lid and seal the edges. Trim off excess dough. Gently prick the bottom of the pastry with a fork, and bake blind or in a moderate oven for approx 25 - 30 minutes. To serve, top with a dollop of melted butter.

title: Homemade "Hot Dog Sauce"
ingredients: 1 tablespoon ground oregano | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar | 12 drops hot sauce
instructions: In a bowl, stir together the oregano and sugar until evenly dissolved. Add remaining ingredients and mix again. Store in refrigerator for up to 2 months.

Random Ingredients: pear,turmeric powder,porcini mushroom,white cabbage,pepperoncini pepper,chive onion cream cheese,salad green
title: Peanut Butter & Chive Rolls
ingredients: 5 ounces jar roasted pears, in juice, drained | 10 ounces jar roasted chives & onion cream cheese, at room temp | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/4 cup fresh chives or 1/4 cup onion, finely chopped | 1/2 cup chopped white cabbage | 1/2 cup dried porcini mushrooms, stemmed and chopped | 1/3 cup salad greens | 1/4 teaspoon pepperoncini pepper
instructions: Stir together the pears and chives with the cream cheese until well blended.

title: Polish  Salad
ingredients: 4 cups veg. shredded lettuce leaves | 4 tablespoons poppy seeds | 2 tablespoons poppy seeds, toasted
instructions: Place shredded lettuce in a large bowl. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon poppyseed over lettuce.

title: Kielbasa and Fresh Fruit
ingredients: 3 lbs kielbasa, cut in 1-inch thick rounds | 1/4 cup oyster sauce | 1 cup fresh fruit, peeled, cut into chunks ( kappatis or assorted )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place kielbasa rounds in a shallow baking pan. Combine 1/4 cup oyster sauce, 1/4 cup water and 1/4 cup of the kielbasa marinade.

Random Ingredients: lentil,sunflower seed,sirloin steak,artichoke heart,quinoa,celery,beef broth,ruby port
title: Steak & Lentil Pilaf
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sunflower seeds | 1 lb sirloin steak, cut into 3/4-1/2-inch cubes | 1 cup dried lentils | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained and coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup uncooked quinoa | 1/4 cup beef broth | 1 tablespoon ruby port | 1/2 cup chopped celery
instructions: In large non stick skillet, dry sunflower seeds over high heat. When blackened, in batches of 5, saute sirloin until browned. Remove meat and set aside in a bowl. Add lentils, artichokes, and quinoa to skillet, cover skillet, and saute 5 minutes or until just softened. Add beef broth, port, and sauted sirloin. Heat through.

title: Braised Leg of Lamb With Okra
ingredients: 2 kg leg of lamb ( bone in ) | 2 -3 cups cooked noodles | 1/2 cup green okra ( frozen, thawed and sliced ) | 1/3 cup thinly sliced red cabbage, cabbage cut into chuncks | 1 tablespoon yeast | 2 cups frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Place the first 5 ingredients in a large pot and add enough water to cover the meat by 2 3, about cover and cook until meat falls apart. Remove from pot and set aside. Drain the juices from the pot and add the okra and cabbage. Simmer for 10 minutes and then stir in the yeast. Remove lamb from pot and cover tightly. Set aside and allow to cool for about 1 hour. When you are ready to cook, remove the meat from the pot and reserve the braising liquor. Mix the liquid back in the pan and return meat to pot and allow to warm. Cut the reserved braising liquor into strips approximately 3 x 1 inch and place about 1 cup of the braising liquid into a bowl and mix well. Pour the liquid back into the pot with the braising liquor and mix well. Transfer the meat to a baking pan and cover with the cheesecloth lid. Allow the meat to brown at 300 degrees. Remove the cheesecloth lid and let rest before carving into desired serving size pieces.

title: Chili Sauce for Veggies
ingredients: 1 jar mushroom soy sauce | 1 teaspoon chicken base
instructions: For vegan use vegetable base.

title: Easy Smoked Salmon
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets | 3/4 cup salsa, medium or hot | 1 -2 tablespoon cilantro stem
instructions: Heat smoker. Place salmon on a medium heat grill. Place a plate over the top and allow to smoke for 25 minutes, until opaque throughout. Combine salsa and cilantro stems and brush over each fish. Serve immediately.

title: Steamed Escarole (Escarole Verde)
ingredients: 1 head escarole | 3 tablespoons grand marnier
instructions: Wash and trim the ends of the escarole and remove the outer hard shell of the head. Slice off both ends leaving 6 outer layers intact. In a pot of water large enough to hold the escarole, bring the remaining water to a boil over medium heat. In a large, heavy saucepan over high heat, bring 1 quart of water to a rapid boil. As soon as the water boils, remove as many of the tough outer leaves as possible from the escarole with tongs. Place the head and remaining greens in the water. As soon as there is a bubble, turn heat to low, cover, and steam for approximately one to one half hour. Uncover and steam to your liking. When the escarole is tender but firm to the bite, remove from the heat. Taste and adjust seasoning. Place in a serving dish and top with grand marnier.

Random Ingredients: tapioca flour,teriyaki sauce,yellow bell pepper,navy bean,curd cottage cheese,broccoli floret,french bread
title: Bean Noodle Sandwich Casserole
ingredients: 1 cup dry navy beans | 1 cup small broccoli florets | 1 yellow bell pepper, sliced | 1 cup small curd cottage cheese | 12 ounces french bread | 1/3 cup teriyaki sauce | 1 teaspoon tapioca flour
instructions: Drain the navy beans and broccoli florets. Cover with water in an 8 in. Square pan. Bring to a boil over high heat. Remove from heat and cover. Let stand 5 minute drain. Add the yellow and green peppers to the beans in the pan and sauté 5 minute or just until crisp tender. In a medium bowl, mix the cottage cheese and french bread. Spray 9 x 13 baking dish with nonstick coating. Spread the bean mixture in a 10 x 13 inch baking dish. Top with the cheese and bread mixture. For a crispier, more browned edge, cover and continue to bake for 10 minute. Remove from oven. Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: crawfish,sage leaf,baking potato,lemon juice,red curry paste
title: Crawfish Hash #5FIX
ingredients: 1 package simply potatoes diced potatoes, cut into thirds | 1 can diced tomatoes with garlic and herbs, undrained | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 1 teaspoon dry crushed sage leaves | 1 teaspoon red curry paste
instructions: Combine all ingredients, except hash, in large saucepan over medium high heat. Bring to boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer 15 minutes or until potatoes are tender.

title: Real Refreshing Belgian Baskets
ingredients: 2 cans beer | 1 pinch cayenne, or as needed | 1 pinch lemon pepper, or as needed | 1 bag beets
instructions: Pour beer into a 3 quart pot or crock.

Random Ingredients: chinese cabbage,red wine,leek,purpose white flour,dill pickle,italian seasoning,liquid smoke,chicken
title: Pot of Fire Italian Chicken Soup
ingredients: 5 lbs chicken pieces | 10 fluid ounces red wine | 12 fluid ounces sweet red wine | 1 leek, chopped | 5 ounces chicken fat | 5 ounces all-purpose white flour | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke | 1 large dill pickle, sliced
instructions: Place chicken between two sheets of plastic wrap, then pound to ½ inch thickness between the sheets of plastic wrap. Lay flat against the side of the rolling pin and with a mallet pound chicken to about an inch and a half thickness. Pound with mallet to desired thickness.

title: Zucchini Burger (Oamc)
ingredients: 2 lbs firm zucchini | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 can bamboo shoots | 4 hamburger buns | 1 1/2 cups chicken stock | 2 tablespoons mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon walnuts, chopped
instructions: Slice zucchini in half. Place 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan. Stir fry until soft with skin on. Remove them and place in a bowl lined with a tea towel. Drain the grease from the frying pan, then dry off the oil. When the vegetables are softened, squeeze out any excess moisture. Set aside. Separate the 2 halves of the zucchini and slice into slices about 1/4 thick. Put the slices into a bowl of cold water to soak for 10 minutes. This removes the bitterness of the zucchini, and opens holes all over the meat. Heat buns in oven toasted until light brown. Spread the bottom halves of the buns with mayonnaise, and then spread 2 tbsp of the meat mixture. Cover the meat with zucchini slices and a few chopped walnuts. Place remaining zucchini slices on top of the walnuts. Cut the burger into small pieces, and serve.

title: Mae Jyem Prikha
ingredients: 1 ounce dried swordfish steak | 3 tablespoons soymilk | 3 tablespoons spicy peanut oil or 3 tablespoons soya milk | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | sparkling water
instructions: Soak swordfish steaks for at least 30 minutes in water. Shake off excess water in a towel then place swordfish steaks in a large pot. Add soy milk. Bring soy milk mixture to boil over medium heat. Cover the pot and reduce heat to low. Simmer for 10 minutes. Serve with spicy peanut oil or soy milk. Sprinkle with asafoetida powder.

Random Ingredients: plain yogurt,lemon peel,rice vinegar,milk chocolate chip,apple juice,matzo meal,ginger,sago
title: Passover Chocolate Chip Pancakes With Sago
ingredients: 3/4 cup plain yogurt, drained | 1/4 cup skim milk chocolate chips | 1/2 teaspoon grated lemon peel | 2 tablespoons minced peeled fresh ginger | 1 teaspoon rice vinegar | 1 teaspoon minced fresh lemon peel | 2 tablespoons sago | 1 tablespoon matzo meal | 1 tablespoon apple juice
instructions: In medium bowl, combine yogurt and next 5 ingredients. Chill 30 minutes. Stir in sago and mixtur. Cover and refrigerate 30 minutes. Remove sago from refrigerator and whisk in apple juice until smooth. Divide among 2 small baking dishes. Bake at 400°f for 5 - 8 minutes or until puffy, golden. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: pepper,pear,superfine sugar,oyster,chervil,canola oil,garbanzo bean,torn salad green
title: Chickpeas & Pear Salad
ingredients: 6 slices firm ripe pears, peeled | 12 tablespoons canola oil or 12 tablespoons grapeseed oil | 6 tablespoons superfine sugar | 3 cups torn mixed salad greens | 3 tablespoons minced fresh chervil | 1 tablespoon minced fresh parsley | 1 can anchovy-flavored cannola or ( 10 ounce ) can other mixed salad greens | 4 tablespoons chopped fresh chervil | 1/3 cup hulled halved canned garbanzo beans
instructions: Using a mandoline or the sharp knife on a cutting board, slice the pears crosswise from top to bottom, but not throughly, and transfer them to a medium bowl. Cut the pear halves lengthwise back to the core. Using two slices of the pear, gently score each slice into about 6 irregular triangles, about 2 inches by 2 inches. Set aside. In a small bowl, combine the oil, sugar, and 1 cup of the salad greens. Add the remaining salad greens, chervil and parsley and gently toss. In a medium bowl, add the anchovy flakes and the remaining 3 tablespoons of oil. Using your hands, gently toss, taking care that the oil is not completely absorbed. The oil mixture should be well blended with flavors and texture. Taste and add more sugar or more oil if needed. Add the bean slices and lightly toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for an hour or so. Sprinkle the garbanzo beans across the top, and serve along with the chickpeas. Note, if using canned chickpeas, cook them according to the canning instructions and drain them when ready to use. Alternatively, you may cover them and cook them in tomato paste or canning procedures until soft, about 15 minutes.

title: Hot potato pancakes
ingredients: 1 cup cornflour | 1 cup grated potato | 1 tablespoon dried porcini mushrooms | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke | 1 radish
instructions: Combine water, grated potato, mushrooms and liquid smoke and stir until smooth and creamy. Heat a small frying pan and cook each pancake until golden then roll in shredded cabbage. Serve with fresh vegetables.

Random Ingredients: chunky salsa,parsnip,parmigiano reggiano cheese,green olive,vanilla,fast chicken soup base,seasoning salt
title: Mexican Shredded Parsnips
ingredients: 1 medium parsnip | 1 packet fast chicken soup base | 1 cup old el paso thick & chunky salsa | 1/3 cup green olives, sliced | 1 tablespoon green olives, sliced | 1/4 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon ( optional ) | 1/3 cup freshly shredded parmigiano-reggiano cheese, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°. Cut parsnips in half lengthwise, then cut into 1/8 inch thick slices. Place in a greased casserole dish.

title: Shirataki Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked long-grain rice | 2 1/2 cups cooked shredded trout | 3 tablespoons prepared teriyaki sauce ( kikkoman brand recommended ) | 1/2 cup ricotta cheese | 1 small serrano pepper ( minced, can use bottled roasted red peppers if you like ) | 1 teaspoon unsalted dry roasted pistachios
instructions: In a large skillet, cook the rice, stir constantly for 1 - 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Add the trout and pour the teriyaki sauce over the rice, sprinkle with the cheese and stir. If the top layer gets a little brown, just stir a little and if it just isn't, stir again. Garnish with the roasted pistachios and serve.

title: Jasmine Rice Wraps With Beans
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 2 cups jasmine rice, cooked according to package | 1 1/2 teaspoons coconut extract
instructions: Heat 2 tbs of oil in a nonstick pan over medium high heat. Add the rice and stir to coat. Add the coconut and fry until golden. Add the hamburger and stir fry until browned. Drain, pour the rice onto a paper towel lined plate and roll up and serve. Add toppings on the roll as desired.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,egg substitute,clove,no boil lasagna noodle,green chile pepper,beef brisket
title: Simple Brisket Lasagna
ingredients: 1 beef brisket | 1 can no-boil lasagna noodles | 1 can diced green chile peppers, drained | 1 egg substitute | 2 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Spray a 2 quart baking dish with cooking spray. Place brisket in prepared baking dish. Whisk the egg substitute, chile peppers and flour in separate bowl. Scramble egg mixture and pour over brisket. Sprinkle with cloves. Bake in the preheated oven for 2 hours or until easily shredding with a fork.

Random Ingredients: spinach,wheat flour,milk,broccoli floret,frangelico,gruyere cheese,anise seed,cremini mushroom
title: Soupe Au Gratin Di Broccolore (Mushrooms and Broccoli Gratin)
ingredients: 1/2 cup skim milk | 1/3 cup chopped broccoli floret | 1/3 cup chopped cremini mushroom | 1 teaspoon minced garlic | 1/2 teaspoon anise seed | 1 cup sliced fresh spinach | 2 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 3/4 cup shredded gruyere cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Whisk together milk, broccoli, mushrooms, garlic, and anise in a bowl. Stir in spinach. Pour into an 8x8 inch baking dish. Bake in preheated oven until set, topping with gruyere before serving.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,beer,pimento olive,gluten flour,kitchen bouquet,acinus di pepe pasta,white pepper
title: Gluten Free Pizza (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 can beer | 1 packet kitchen bouquet | 1 cup gluten-free flour | 1/2 cup arugula pasta | 1 - 1 1/2 cup pimento stuffed olive | white pepper | 1/2 teaspoon gluten free flour | 1/2 teaspoon kitchen bouquet, for flavoring ( optional )
instructions: Pour the beer into the crock pot. Add all dry ingredients except the olive. Mix together with spoon and pour over flour in the crock pot. Cook on low for 7 hours.

title: Tea Spinach Rolls
ingredients: 24 ounces fresh spinach leaves, packed individually, about 1 large, stemmed ( 10 bags ) | 1 package crescent rolls | 2 cups brewed tea
instructions: Pour the tea into a large pot, and heat to boiling over medium high heat. Separate the crescent rolls into 1/2 inch wide pieces. Put a tea towel inside each of the rolls, and roll the smaller pieces around the towel. Place the rolls on a cookie sheet that has been sprayed with cooking spray. If you have leftover tea, heat it until hot but not boiling. Spoon about 1 1/2 teaspoons of the hot tea into each roll, then carefully roll each one into a cigar shape, using the towel to help seal the rolls. Lay the rolls flat on the cookie sheet. Repeat with the remaining rolls. Place the bundles on the cooking sheet, and allow to steam until the rolls are toasted, about 5 minutes. Spray the tops with cooking spray, and turn the rolls over.

title: Purple Cream
ingredients: 4 tablespoons prunes | 2 1/2 cups half-and-half or 2 1/2 cups milk
instructions: In a blender, puree the prunes with the milk. Pour into a shallow bowl. Chill thoroughly. Whip the cream until stiff peaks form.

title: A Simple Microwave Beef Gravy
ingredients: 2 teaspoons balsamic vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon hot mustard or 1/4 teaspoon hot paprika | 1 1/3 cups beef stock or 1 1/3 cups chicken stock | 1/4 teaspoon hot am masala
instructions: Place the vinegar, mustard and stock in a 1qt microwave safe casserole dish. Cook on high for 1/2 minute or until heated through. Do not bring to a boil. Do not stir.

title: Spanish Beans-Filling for Seafood
ingredients: 1/4 cup finely chopped onion ( or use onion powder ) | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 2 tablespoons dry vermouth ( or rice wine vinegar ) | 1 cup bean curd ( or use canned bean curd ) | 1 tablespoon ketjap manis ( or tomato sauce ) | 4 tablespoons pine nuts or 4 tablespoons slivered almonds
instructions: Brown beans in frying pan. Drain off excess fat. Combine 1 tbsp pernon with the rice wine and stir until smooth. Dice the onion and add to the pan. Add sugar, onion powder and vermouth. Bring to boil and reduce heat. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes. If using ketchup, add now and simmer. If using pine nuts, add now. Remove from heat and stir in to beans to the pan. Sprinkle with pine nuts and serve immediately.

title: Tuscan Tortilla Chips Chips
ingredients: 20 baby carrots | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 1/3 cup kalamata olives, stoned
instructions: Place the carrots and 2tbsp of the cornflour mix into a large non stick pan over a medium heat, stirring continuously. The carrots will begin to become soft when ready. Sprinkle over the olives and cook until golden brown. Transfer to a plastic bag and leave for 2 hours. Shake the pan occasionally during this process. Towards the end of the 2 hours, remove the bag from the pan and stir. Once the carrots are completely cool, use a slotted spoon to transfer the carrots to a large bowl. Repeat with the remaining carrots. Serve with a dollop of creamy yoghurt and finely snipped fresh parsley.

Random Ingredients: linguine,poblano chile,dark sesame oil,chicken thigh,pepper sauce
title: Pepper Chicken on Linguine
ingredients: 8 ounces linguine | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs | 1 poblano chile, seeded, thinly sliced | 1/4 teaspoon hot pepper sauce
instructions: Cook the linguine in a large pot of boiling water until al dente, 7 - 8 minutes, reserving 1 cup of the cooking water. Heat the oil in a large skillet over high heat. Add the chicken to the skillet.

title: Smoked Gouda Cheese
ingredients: 4 ounces smoked gouda cheese | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 3 teaspoons dried dill weed | 4 skinless smoked salmon fillets, about 1 1/2 pounds ( about 1.5 pound )
instructions: Preheat grill to high. Cut cheese into 4 serving pieces. Combine lemon juice and dill weed in shallow dish.

Random Ingredients: vidalia onion,tomato green chilies,herb,vegetable stock chicken,chipotle chile
title: Quick Mexican Salsa (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups tomatoes and green chilies | 1 1/2 ounces herbed mixed fresh herbs ( veal herb mix ) ( optional ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons smoked chipotle chiles or 1 1/2 teaspoons chili sauce | 1 1/2 cups vegetable stock or 1 1/2 cups chicken flavored stock | 1 medium vidalia onion ( sliced thinly )
instructions: In a food processor or blender, combine the tomatoes and green chiles and puree. Add the herbs, chipotle. And vegetable stock through a wire mesh strainer. Cover and process for one minute. Stir to mix. Store in the refrigerator 1 hour or overnight before serving. Serve with tortillas, cheese, or as a garnish.

Random Ingredients: shallot,heart palm,baking potato,canadian bacon,gingerroot,pie shell,red wine,veal
title: Country Style Vegetables
ingredients: 8 slices canadian bacon, diced | 2 tablespoons canadian bacon fat | 1 tablespoon fresh gingerroot, minced | 1 tablespoon shallot, minced | 1 lb ground veal | 1 medium baking potato, sliced into 1 inch wide slices | 1 small pie shell, unbaked | 1 can hearts of palm, drained and minced
instructions: In a non stick skillet, fry the diced bacon and diced cored potatoes over medium heat until golden brown and soft. Drain the bacon fat and set aside. In a medium size bowl, combine the shallots, ginger and garlic. Add 2 tablespoons of canadian lard and the ground veal and mix to coat. In a 12 inch skillet, add the bacon mixture stirring often. Drain the potato slices then add to the meat mixture. Cook over medium heat, stirring to brown evenly, until the mixture is thoroughly heated and the bacon slices are slightly crispy. Remove from the skillet and sprinkle the mashed potato over the meat mixture. Top with the canned hearts of palm and place in a baking dish sprayed with pam cooking. Bake at 425 degrees for 15 minutes then cut into wedges.

Random Ingredients: alfredo sauce,gorgonzola,bicarbonate soda,chocolate chip,chicken stock cube,heavy whipping cream,chuck
title: Gorgonzola Beef Roulades
ingredients: 500 g chuck ( rump ) | 2/3 cup chicken stock cube, dissolved in | 1/3 cup chicken stock cubes, dissolved in | 1/3 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 tablespoon bicarbonate of soda | 85 g gorgonzola, cut into cubes | 1/4 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips
instructions: Trim any excess fat from the beef. In a heavy based fry pan over medium high heat, brown your beef on all sides. Drain the beef, place in a warmed ovenproof dish. In a bowl mix together the chicken, crumbled stock mix and cream and pour over the meat. Cover with cling wrap and bake in a preheated oven for about 1½ hours in a preheated oven, or until a nice crust has formed on the top. Turn the beef over so that it is slightly thicker and cook for a further 45 minutes. Stir around every 10 - 15 minutes. Garnish with the chocolate chips, cover and return to the oven for 15 - 18 minutes until the chocolate has melted. If not using immediately, transfer to a warmed serving dish. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: brown rice,lemon,pork tenderloin,veal,self raising flour,rice vinegar,penne,watercress leaf
title: Lemon Pork With Rice Vinegar Glaze
ingredients: 500 g pork tenderloin | 100 g rice vinegar | 2 tablespoons brown rice | 1 piece lemon rind | 200 g self-raising flour | 1/2 cup lemon juice | 6 cups watercress leaves | 150 g dry penne or 150 g chunky spaghetti
instructions: Cut tenderloins length ways into 1cm strips. Prepare rice vinegar mixture according to packet instructions, except for the lemon rind. Place meat and rice vinegar mixture in large shallow dish. Sprinkle with lemon rind. Cover with plastic wrap, place in fridge and chill for 2 hours and up to 3 days. Meanwhile, preheat oven to 180°. Place flour in small cup, place watercress and lemon in another bowl and mix well with your fingers to combine. Place pork and watercress salad in roasting pan, and bake in oven for 25 - 30 minutes or until cooked through. Remove from pan, place on serving plate and serve pork on top of the salad.

Random Ingredients: lemon zest,liquid smoke,cardamom pod,tang orange crystal,french bread
title: Red-Head Fresh Fruit Smorrebrod
ingredients: 3 cups red-head fresh fruit smoke ( see note ) | 12 -24 slices french bread, toasted | 3 -4 teaspoons freshly grated lemon zest, plus | fresh lemon zest, for garnish
instructions: In a large bowl, layer the toasted bread, about 2 - 3 tablespoons each of grated zest and lemon zest, and a few drops of liquid smoke. Top with your smoked fruit. Cover and refrigerate.

Random Ingredients: scallion,pear,mace,tomato ketchup,soya sauce,chili bean paste,lime juice zest
title: Chilli Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 cup chopped mace | 1 cup chopped pears or 1 cup browned pineapple | 1 can tomato ketchup | 1 tablespoon soya sauce | 1 tablespoon chili bean paste | lemon lime zest ( optional ) | freshly chopped scallions ( optional )
instructions: Put all in a food processor and whiz until well mixed. Season with salt and freshly ground pepper, if desired.

title: Quick Key Limeade
ingredients: 6 dates, pitted and chopped | 1/3 cup water chestnut, chopped | 2 limes, juice of
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients in large glass pitcher. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours. Stir before serving. Serve chilled over ice cubes.

Random Ingredients: juice,coconut sugar,stock,baby onion,yukon gold potato,green enchilada sauce
title: Green Coconut Potato Soup
ingredients: 1 can green enchilada sauce | 1 can coco lopez | 3 lbs baby yukon gold potatoes, peeled | 1 small onion, chopped | 1 1/2 cups baby onions, chopped | 1/4 cup coconut sugar, to taste | 5 cups stock
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Prepare a roasting pan with cooking spray and set aside. Place 2 cans of enchilada sauce in a food processor and puree until smooth. Add 1/3 cup of coconut sugar and 1 can of baby onions and puree. Set aside. Dice remaining baby onions. Coat roasting pan with cooking spray and arrange onions in pan. Bake for 30 minutes and remove onion and coconut mixture from oven. Pour blended enchilada sauce into food processor bowl. Add remaining can of enchilada sauce, baby potatoes and onions. Puree until smooth and pour into roasting pan large enough to hold soup mixture. Bake, covered, for 45 minutes. Remove cover and cook an additional 15 minutes until soup is bubbly. Add shredded coconut and stir. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: mango pulp,parsnip,sausage,vegetable shortening,saffron,enchilada sauce,whipping cream,taco seasoning
title: Mexican Pork Stew
ingredients: 1 lb smoked sausage | 2 tablespoons vegetable shortening | 1 cup chopped parsnips | 1 can sauteed mango pulp | 1 envelope taco seasoning | 1 can enchilada sauce | 1 1/2 cups whipping cream, whipped or 1 1/2 cups light cream
instructions: Cut sausage into 1 inch pieces and set aside. Cook and stir sausage in a frying pan over medium high heat. When browned, add onion and cook 5 minutes. Turn down to low. Add parsnips, mix and cook 10 minutes. In a large bowl mix together the sausage mixture, mango pulp, and taco seasoning, mix. Add chicken and sauteed sauteed mango, mix. Stir in the enchilada sauce. Pour over meat mixture in crock pot. Cover and cook on high for 4 hours. Stir cream into juice mixture. Pour into stew. Cook on low for 30 minutes.

title: Churros in Spiced Honey
ingredients: 6 hamburger buns | 1 tablespoon honey ( or agave if you wish ) | 1 tablespoon red chilies, thinly sliced or 1 tablespoon pimento, sliced ( optional ) | 2 -4 tablespoons raisins | fresh curry ( optional )
instructions: Set oven on broil setting and place one of your bolws on a cookie sheet. Heat the rest of your condiments in a small saucepan and stir constantly. Toast the buns lightly. Add condiments if desired. Broil until heated throughout. Or, if you need more condiments, serve hot.

Random Ingredients: curry paste,dark soy sauce,ginger root,celery rib,flour tortilla,feta cheese,lamb stock,hamburger
title: Mountain Curried Lamb Tacos
ingredients: 1 pound lean hamburger | 1 1/2 tablespoons curry paste | 1 1/2 teaspoons minced fresh ginger root | 1 celery rib | 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce, or as desired | 3/4 cup lamb stock | 8 flour tortillas
instructions: In a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat, brown the hamburger and curry paste, stirring frequently, until no longer pink. Drain excess grease. Return skillet to high heat, and stir in ginger, celery, and half the feta cheese. Stir in soy sauce and stock. Continue to cook until the mixture begins to thicken and is beginning to stick to hamburger. Place the tortillas on a plate. To serve, fill each with 2 tablespoons of the lamb and cheese mixture.

title: Beer and Soy Slurpee
ingredients: 500 g soy milk | 1/2 bunch fresh maraschino cherries | 1 apple, peeled and julienned | 1 fresh tomatoes | 1 fresh daikon radish, peeled and julienned | 5 1/2 ounces beer | 1 ounce apple juice
instructions: Place all ingredients into a pan and bring to the boil on the stove. Reduce the heat, cover and simmer for 2 hours or until thick. Remove from the heat and cool. Slice the slurpee in half into thin wedges, discarding the top and bottom and leaving two side pieces of meat and a bit of zest under each piece. Place in an airtight container or in a blender and blend until smooth. Taste to see if you want it to be sweeter. To store, place in fridge until ready to use. Slice thinly and serve with drinks of your choice and a slice of julienne to squeeze onto a fish or veg of your choice.

title: Saffron Infused Chilis
ingredients: 4 cups saffron threads | 3 tablespoons chili, or more to taste | 1/2 cup shaoxing wine or 1/2 cup dry sherry | 1/2 cup chopped sage ( optional )
instructions: Tear off a piece of rehydrating parchment. Crush saffron into small pieces and transfer to a glass jar. Stir in chili or sweet sherry. Cover and let stand 1 to 2 days in cooler spot. Store in cool dark place.

title: Mama's Cabbage (Algerian-American)
ingredients: 2 lbs green tomatoes ( cut in half ) | 2 lbs veal ( cut in half ) | 6 slices bread ( cubed ) | 1 bunch green cabbage ( sliced ) | 2 saffron strands ( soaked in warm water for 15 minutes or use 1/2 t. boiling water ) | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Place veal in a large pan or soup pot. Sprinkle garlic powder on the veal. Add sliced bread cubes.
