Cut the green tomatoes into pieces about 1/4 inch thick, about 1/4 inch by 2 inches long. Add bread cubes and tomatoes to the veal and let sit for at least 4 hours. Take out veal after about 2 hours. Use the saffron water to rinse away the sourness from the saffron. Rinse the saffron out of the warm water. Use warm water to soak the saffron. Pour the saffron into the pan with the vegetables, along with the water. Bring to a boil. When it starts bubbling, cover the pan and turn the heat to low and boil for 60 - 90 minutes. Slice into strips about 2 by 2 inches each. If the slices aren't completely covered, you can use a spoon to drain out excess water. Serve over noodles and enjoy.

title: Easy Moose Dip
ingredients: 500 500 g moose or 500 g cod | 2 tablespoons curry powder | 300 g white beans | 1 bunch fresh spring onion | 125 g parmesan cheese | 1 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: Cut the moose or cod into cubes and fry in the curry sauce for about five minutes. Cut spring onions in half and chop some green parts. Serve in a bowl surrounded by the moose or cod cubes. Top with a handful of parmesan cheese and a few spring onions. Pour over a little water or beef broth and stir fry until the moose or cod is cooked through, and the green onion spring onion spring onion. Add some cayenne pepper as well if you think there isn't enough.

Random Ingredients: lettuce,grand marnier,beef broth,asafoetida powder,okra,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Okra and Okra Soup
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh okra, sliced to 1/4-inch | 1 can condensed beef broth | 1/2 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 tablespoon asafoetida powder | 1/2 cup chopped lettuce | 2 tablespoons grand marnier
instructions: Soak okra in water until pliable, 20 minutes maximum drain and cut in half crosswise. Rinse okra well and pat dry with paper towels. Cut stems off okra and add broth to broth in a dutch oven. Bring to boil, turn off heat and let stand 5 minutes. Drain off liquid and reserve 1 cup. Add broth and okra to soup. Add cheese and asafetida to taste and cook 1 more minute add okra and adjust seasoning. Add lettuce and add grand marnier and heat through, stirring constantly.

title: Maple Syrup Quinoa
ingredients: 1 cup dry quinoa | 1 cup maple syrup | 2 tablespoons marzipan, crumbled | 1/2 cup dried cherries
instructions: Rinse the quinoa well. Combine all ingredients in a saucepan and simmer over medium heat until the water has absorbed, about 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let sit for about 15 minutes, or longer, until cooled completely.

Random Ingredients: chili bean paste,banana,white breadcrumb,french bread,acorn squash,hominy
title: Fiesta Breadcrumb Squash
ingredients: 4 small acorn squash, halved and stalks removed | 1 can chili bean paste ( i used denel brand ) | 16 ounces cooked hominy, rinsed | 1 tablespoon white breadcrumb | 1 banana, sliced | 1 loaf french bread
instructions: Place squash halves on a cutting board and cut each half in half. Scoop out some of the flesh, leaving about 1/2 cup.

title: Juan-Carlos Cruz's Oyster and Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 12 large fresh mussels, scrubbed | 1/4 cup frozen limeade concentrate, thawed | 1/4 cup canned sliced celery, drained | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh sage | 1/4 teaspoon seasame oil | 12 egg yolks | 1/3 cup prepared juan-carlos cruz's country style tea
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Place the mussels in the pot, and continue to cook uncovered over high heat until the shells have opened, about 5 minutes. Discard any mussels that have not opened. Place the shrimp in a large bowl with the limeade concentrate, celery, sage, and seasame oil. Whisk the egg yolks with 1/3 cup of the juan angelico in a bowl, and whisk in the remaining juan angelico until smooth. Pour egg mixture into the bowl with the seafood, and stir until all is well combined. Taste, and add more juan angelico if desired. If necessary, refrigerate until ready to serve to allow flavors to mingle. Fill the mussels with the oysters. Garnish with additional sprigs of celery.

title: Ethiopian Broccoli for Soup
ingredients: 2 bunches broccoli | 1 tablespoon coriander seed, coarsely ground to a powder with salt
instructions: Fill a large saucepan with water and bring to a boil. Add the coriander and broccoli stems, and continue to boil until the broccoli is just tender to bite, about 3 minutes. Drain, and reserve 1 cup broth in a separate pot. Return water to a boil, and add the remaining broth, stirring to loosen the cauliflower. Cover and cook for a few more minutes to thicken the sauce.

title: Steamed Scallops and Beer
ingredients: 2 -9 scallops | 2 tablespoons tapioca starch | 1 tablespoon vodka | 2 cups chicken stock | 1 -2 teaspoon sea scallops, to taste
instructions: Prepare the tapioca starch per instruction on the bottle. Add the chicken stock to a medium saucepan and bring to a boil. While waiting for the stock to boil, heat the water in a non stick skillet to a medium temperature. Add the scallops and cook until nicely browned. Add the vodka to the boiling stock. Stir constantly until the alcohol in the bottle has reduced slightly. Pour sauce over the scallops, or serve right away as the scallops will absorb the sauce and look more and looser after steaming for several minutes. Serve on a bed of rice.

Random Ingredients: lamb meat,kosher salt black pepper,parsnip,cilantro,vanilla bean paste,grain rice
title: Gordita (Persian Rice Balls)
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground lamb or 1/2 lb ground turkey | 1/4 cup minced parsnips | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla bean paste or 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/2 teaspoon freshly chopped cilantro | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1/2 cup long-grain rice, washed
instructions: Using a mortar and pestle, mash the ground meat with the parsnip, vanilla bean paste and cilantro until thoroughly mixed. Add a little milk, if necessary, to bind the meat with a moist, compact consistency. Season to taste with salt and pepper, and set aside at room temperature for about 30 minutes. Make sure you don’t shape the meat into walnut sized balls. You should have about 1 1/2 pints. Dip the rice balls into the rice, and then lightly coat each ball in rice flour. Place on a tray or oiled cookie sheet. Let sit about 1 hour to soften.

Random Ingredients: coriander,white flour,chicken wing,beef brisket,vegetable stock,red pepper flake
title: Baked Chicken Brisket
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs chicken wings | 2/3 cup vegetable stock | 2/3 cup red pepper flakes | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground coriander | 1 1/2 teaspoons white flour | 1 cup coriander, finely chopped, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 ° f. Place all ingredients in a 2 quart baking dish. Cover with foil.

title: Lemon Grilled Lamb
ingredients: 2 1/3 kg leg of lamb, boned and tied | 2 sprigs orange peel | 4 teaspoons cornflour | lemon wedge
instructions: Remove giblets and silver skins from the lamb. Trim excess fat and place in a large ceramic dish. Add the orange peel, cornflour and enough fresh water to cover the lamb. Leave to marinate overnight in the refrigerator. Preheat a grill until very hot. Put the lamb on the hot grill and cook, brushing with oil, for 10 minutes for medium or 30 minutes for medium well. Cut the lamb into thin slices. Serve with lemon wedges and a large pot salad. Great with roasted potatoes or pasta.

Random Ingredients: yellow cornmeal,pesto sauce,bean,curry powder,yellow bell pepper,arborio rice,endive
title: Quick and Easy Curried Chard and Yellow Bean Polenta
ingredients: 1/2 cup yellow cornmeal | 1/4 cup arborio rice ( also known as risotto rice ) | 1 -2 tablespoon madras curry powder ( or to taste ) | 2 -3 cups canned refried beans | 2 -3 tablespoons pesto sauce or 2 -3 tablespoons other spicy pesto
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the yellow corn meal and the arborio rice. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to simmer and cook for about 5 minutes. Place a baking sheet with plenty of surface area on top of the rice mixture. Spread a layer of hot tap water evenly over the baking sheet. When the water is absorbed, stir the rice and vegetable mixture together in a circular motion just until the water is absorbed. Stir in the burghul pesto. Continue to stir the rice mixture until the mixture is creamy and the pesto is thoroughly distributed throughout the rice. If the pesto spreads it across the rice mixture, stir it inches. Spread another layer of hot tap water across the rice to stop it from sticking in the water.

title: Cheddar Mac with Farfalle
ingredients: 350 g farfalle pasta | 100 g sharp cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Cook the farfalle in salted boiling water, until cooked but firm. Drain and reserve. Mix cheese with the farfalle. Serve.

Random Ingredients: poblano chile,pizza sauce,food coloring,cotija cheese,ranch dressing,fettuccini pasta,pizza crust
title: Mexican Pizza With Creamy Poblano Chiles
ingredients: 1 pizza crust, refrigerated | 1/2 - 3/4 cup pizza sauce | 1/2 cup shredded cotija cheese | 3 large poblano chiles, chopped | food coloring | 1 packet refrigerated fettuccini pasta | 1 cup ranch dressing, low fat
instructions: Preheat oven to prepare the pizza crust according to direction on the package. Brush with a little vegetable oil. Spread pizza sauce on the crust of pizza. Scatter the cotija cheese on top. Peel poblanos and then place on top. Sprinkle the fettuccini over the poblanos and place on top of pizza sauce. Bake for 5 minutes. Remove from oven. Remove the crust with poblanos and spread with ranch dressing. Return pizzas to oven and bake for 10 to 15 seconds. Remove and sprinkle with a little food color. Return pizzas to oven and cook 3 to 5 minutes more, until pizza is nicely browned and poblanos are tender.

title: Mustard and Vinegar Crackers (For One)
ingredients: 1/3 cup white rice vinegar | 3 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1/2 cup self-rising flour
instructions: Combine dry ingredients in a large bowl. Beat 1 minute, beat in remaining ingredients. Spoon onto wax paper and form into a patty. Heat a cast iron griddle over high heat for 1 minute. Cook 3 - 4 minuts on top of each side. Turn each patty over and cook 1 minute more, or until golden brown.

title: Sirloin With Yellow and Red Pepper Sauce
ingredients: 1 sirloin | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 1/2 cup yellow pepper, finely diced | 1/8 teaspoon tarragon | 1/3 cup marsala wine | ice cube | 4 plum tomatoes, thinly sliced
instructions: Cut tip of beef tenderloin lengthwise into 1/4 slices. Cut away excess fat from under beef and cut slices lengthwise into strips. Combine confectioners' sugar, pepper, tarragon and marsala.

Random Ingredients: beef stock,vegetable,greek yogurt,tortilla,bok choy,chicken broth,yellow mustard,crabmeat
title: Tortilla, Crab and Beef Soup
ingredients: 1/3 cup plain greek yogurt | 3 tablespoons prepared yellow mustard | 3 tablespoons vegetable curry or 3 tablespoons indian yellow curry paste | 3 cups low sodium chicken broth | 3 cups beef stock | 1 lb frozen mixed vegetables | 1 lb frozen crabmeat | 4 large tortillas, sliced or 4 large fresh tortillas
instructions: In a food processor or blender, combine the yogurt, mustard, broth, and curry paste. Whirl until smooth. Pour 2 cups mixture into a large pot over medium heat. Add the remaining vegetable and stock. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover, and simmer, stirring frequently, for about 20 minutes or until the vegetables are tender. Remove the pot from the heat. Stir in the crabmeat. Cover and refrigerate for about 15 minutes or until the crabmeat turns bright red and the flavor is creamy. Serve tortilla strips with each serving covered with the sauce.

title: Chinese Spiced Noodles
ingredients: 1 cup hamburger | 1 tablespoon minced fresh ginger root
instructions: In a wok or skillet, fry hamburger and ginger together until hamburger is cooked through. Stir in noodles, and heat through.

title: Tender Italian Meatballs
ingredients: 1 lb ground meat | 1/4 - 1/2 cup dried italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1/2 teaspoon mustard ( to taste ) | 1 -2 tablespoon chopped of fresh mint | 0.5 can almond extract
instructions: Mix the meat through mint and add almond extract. Using your hands form into balls a little larger than a walnut. Put meatballs on cookie sheet and bake at 400 degrees for about 10 minutes, they should be firm on the outside, but they shouldn't be browned. You may try and freeze the meatballs for later. I like to use a cookie mold and cover each one tightly with waxed paper. Serve with sauteed carrots, parsley and/or green vegetable and/or broccoli.

title: Homemade Sun-Dried Tomato Dressing
ingredients: 12 sun-dried tomatoes, packed in oil | 3 tablespoons white vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon celery seed
instructions: Mix all ingredients and store in covered container.

Random Ingredients: basil leaf,tequila,shichimi togarashi,thyme,range egg yolk,cream chicken soup,nutmeg,deli ham
title: Hot Sam's Eggs
ingredients: 6 free range egg yolks | 250 g ham ( sliced thin ) | 1 can cream of chicken soup ( low fat or fat free to your liking ) | 1 liter shichimi togarashi | 10 -15 fresh basil leaves | 1 teaspoon thyme | 1/2 teaspoon nutmeg | 1/2 tablespoon tequila
instructions: Put your food processor into food and slowly begin to turn it. When the mixture becomes stiff, turn it onto the food processor and blend until all the mixture is smooth. Place mixture in a bowl on a plate and cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate for one hour, for better result it's ready now, but not too long.. To serve, simply roll the chilled egg and then cut in half with a knife, and arrange on a platter or serving dish. Dress with a dollop of tequila, and put a basil leaf, sliced ham, sliced thin slices of cream of chicken soup on top, and sliced shichimi on top of that.

title: Chili Banana Salad
ingredients: 1 ripe banana | 1/3 pint sunflower oil | 1 tablespoon dried mushroom, finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon mint extract
instructions: Peel the banana and cut into slices. Place the banana in a bowl and mash with a fork until it holds its shape. Add the oil, mushrooms, mint extract and mix thoroughly.

Random Ingredients: onion,dark soy sauce,rosemary leaf,salt pork,gingerroot,chicken tenderloin
title: Rosemary Chicken
ingredients: 1 large onion, cut into thin wedges | 1 tablespoon gingerroot, grated fresh | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 2 tablespoons fresh rosemary leaves | 1 lb chicken tenderloins, trimmed | 1/2 lb salt pork, cut into chunks or 1/2 lb lite bacon, cut into chunks
instructions: In a mixing bowl, combine onion, ginger, soy sauce, and rosemary. Cut chicken into bite sized chunks, discarding any fat or juices. Coat chicken cubes with soy sauce mixture, pressing gently. Place in a lightly greased 8x8x2 baking dish. Arrange bacon over chicken, and bake, uncovered, at 375°f about 25 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Crock Pot Apple Chicken
ingredients: 2 large chicken breasts | 1 large granny smith apple ( optional ) | 1 -2 tablespoon chicken bouillon
instructions: Pour the chicken bouillon from its bag into your crock pot on high. It will only get softer the longer it simmers. Add the apple, if using. Slice the chicken and add to the crock pot. Stir around. Cook on high to 1 1/2 hours. Check the temperature every 10 minutes. It should look fairly low, but will thicken as it simmers. When thickened serve over rice, topped with a bit of fresh chopped/chopped apple wedges and/or veggies. If you want to thicken some, add a small amount of flour to thicken it up.

Random Ingredients: pie crust mix,parmigiano reggiano cheese,lemon peel
title: Italian Lemon Pepper Pie
ingredients: 2 boxes pie crust mix | 3 tablespoons grated lemon peel | 3 tablespoons of freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Prepare pie crust according to directions.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,anchovy,beef stew meat,peanut,white pepper,pistachio ice cream,rice vinegar,guinness stout
title: Guinness Anchovy Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat | 1 ounce unsalted dry-roasted peanuts ( patted dry ) | 2 tablespoons minced green cardamom pods | 1 teaspoon white pepper | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce and 1/2 cup guinness stout | 12 anchovies, toasted, coarsely chopped | 2 pints peanut butter ice cream
instructions: Place meat in crockpot. Add all ingredients except peanuts. Cover and cook on low heat setting for 8 - 10 hours or on high heat setting for 4 - 5 hours. Remove from crockpot and stir until well combined. Serve over ice cream with garnish.

title: Baked Fritters
ingredients: 1 can mixed ripe olives | 1 can sliced, drained canned tomatoes ( or use fresh ) | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning mix ( or use taco bell seasoning ) | 1/2 cup thick & chunky salsa | 1/3 cup shredded low fat v8 cheese blend or 1/3 cup shredded low fat cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to spread tomatoes over bottom of a sprayed nonreactive baking dish. Pour olive mixture evenly over tomatoes, breaking up as necessary. Sprinkle taco seasoning over olives. Pour salsa over olives. Bake uncovered 20 - 25 minutes, until the bread is slightly browned and bubbly. Sprinkle with cheese. Serve immediately. Note, you can use a layer of tomato paste, if desired, for softer fritters. You may also sprinkle the cheese over the top.

Random Ingredients: kitchen bouquet,coriander seed,italian breadcrumb,amaretto liqueur,pork loin roast
title: Scotch Mustard-Crusted Pork Loin Roast  (Beef or Pork Loin)
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs boneless pork loin roast | 1 tablespoon coriander seed | 1 tablespoon kitchen bouquet | 1 1/2 cups italian breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons amaretto liqueur ( i use calvados. )
instructions: Heat oven on a low setting. Spray roasting pan with oil and sprinkle inside of pan with some kitchen bouquet. Dip roast in breadcrumbs. Bake uncovered for 45 minutes. Add amaretto to deglaze pan and bake for another 15 - 20 minutes depending on desired doneness.

title: Green Rice with Artis
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil | 2 cups arborio rice | 4 cups shredded lettuce leaves
instructions: Place the rice and 2 cups water in a heavy 2 1/2 to 3 qt pot, and bring to a boil. Drain and cool until easy to handle, about 5 minute cool further in a metal bowl. Peel the potatoes and potatoes, cut them into bitesized chips and set aside. Peel the garlic, cut in two lenghtwise, put the garlic and 1 cup water into a frying pan and bring it to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer until the potatoes are soft and the garlic cloves are brown, about 10 minute drain everything and rinse the pot. Turn heat down. Place the potato chips on a serving platter and top with the apple garlic tapas. Sprinkle with the coriander and spice mixture. Garnish with green onion tops.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,nectarine,green enchilada sauce,mozzarella cheese,cocoa powder
title: Nectarine Cheese Enchiladas
ingredients: 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 package sliced lemons ( with peel ) | 2 pounds fresh nectarines - peeled, pitted, and sliced ( about 4 cups ) | 1 pound fresh mozzarella cheese, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 30 ounces prepared green enchilada sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Stir together the cocoa powder and salt. Drain off any excess liquid. Stir in the lemon peel. Mix in nectarines and mozzarella cheese. Line a 9x13 inch baking dish with plastic wrap. Spoon 1/3 of the enchilada sauce into the dish. Tightly roll each nectarine bite in the sauce. Arrange nectarine cheese rolls in a layer atop the sauce. Continue to layer with nectarines and mozzarella cheese mixture on top. Pour remaining enchilada sauce over all and sprinkle with cocoa powder. Bake at 350 degrees f for 20 to 25 minutes or until bubbly and lightly browned on top.

title: Mangolian-Style Fish Tacos
ingredients: 3 large kaffir lime leaves ( about 1-inch long ) | 4 ounces boneless skinless firm white-fleshed fish fillets ( such as cod or halibut ) | 4 corn tortillas | 1 medium eggplant, halved lengthwise and crosswise | 1 teaspoon margarine, divided
instructions: In a 12 inch skillet, combine marinade ingredients except tortillas. Bring to a simmer over medium high heat, stirring often. Reduce heat to medium and cook fruit, turning often, about 8 minutes total. Remove from heat and stir in half of tortillas. Spoon fruit mixture into center of tortillas and top with remaining tortillas.

title: Bifteh
ingredients: 2 cups beets | 1 tablespoon black mustard seed | 1 onion, halved | 4 ounces sultanas
instructions: Bring a large pan of water to a boil. Add beet greens to the water and simmer for 3 mins until tender. Drain the greens, reserving the water. Mash them. Combine beetroot and sultanas with mustard seeds in a food processor. Spoon mixture into a shallow ovenproof dish and bake in a moderate oven for 25 minutes until golden.

title: Zucchini & Avocado Side Dish
ingredients: 1 medium zucchini or 1 medium yellow squash, cut into 1/4-inch slices | 1 medium avocados, cut into 1/4-inch slices ( about 1/4 cup ) | 1 cup tomato juice | 1/2 cup instant yellow rice ( uncooked ) | 1/8 teaspoon kosher salt ( to taste ) | 1 pinch ground mace ( optional ) | spaghetti or chickpea, cooked
instructions: Cut squash into 1/4 inch strips. Place the zucchini and avocado slices into a medium bowl. Stir together the tomato juice, rice and salt in a medium saucepan and heat to boiling over medium high heat. Cover and remove from the heat. Let stand 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Stir in the mace. Serve the vegetables and the vegetable mixture over cooked orzo or other pasta of your choice. Serve additional tomato juice and/or additional salsa as desired.

Random Ingredients: chicken cutlet,canadian bacon,red wine vinegar,stew meat,black olive
title: French Canadian Bacon Chicken
ingredients: 6 ounces stew meat | 8 ounces canadian bacon | 6 ounces black olives, sliced in half | 1 teaspoon red wine vinegar | 1/3 lb stew meat | 1/3 cup canadian bacon ( to garnish )
instructions: Cube stew meat, Canadian bacon, black olives. Heat canadian bacon. In a 9x13 baking pan combine stew meat chunks, stew meat, and canadian bacon. Stir. Do not drain the olives. Sprinkle with redwine vinegar and cover pan. Bake in 325°f oven about 2 hours or until beef is tender.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,curry paste,vanilla bean,arbol chile,shallot,beef broth,water chestnut flour,tarragon vinegar
title: Curried Beef Gravy for Two
ingredients: 1/2 cup water chestnut flour | 1 small shallot, minced | 2 teaspoons curry paste ( or chana dal ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla bean, scraped from seeds | 1/4 teaspoon dried tarragon vinegar | 1 cup beef broth | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, not drained | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh tarragon or 1 teaspoon cilantro ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a saucepan and simmer over medium heat until thickened. Transfer to a serving bowl and stir in chopped herbs. Can be made ahead. Refrigerate.

Random Ingredients: saffron strand,tuna water,green lentil,heavy cream,sauerkraut,beef bouillon cube,ginger ale
title: Savoury Beef Lentil Soup (Hokkaido Style)
ingredients: 10 ounces sauerkraut | 1 can light tuna in water | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 dash saffron strand | 1/4 tablespoon ginger ale | 2 tablespoons green lentils | 1 cup heavy cream
instructions: Cut the sauerkraut into small pieces and set aside. Dissolve the beef bouillon cube in half a cup of light cream, then add the sauerkraut and keep mixing. Add ginger ale slowly and continue to add the cream. Stir in the dashi soaked green lentils, cover and cook on low for 15+ minutes. Add the saffron strands and the saffron soaked green lentils. Cook for a further 15+ minutes and serve.

title: Crisp Ribs for a Crowd (For the Crock Pot)
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs pork ribs | confectioners'sugar ( icing )
instructions: In a crock pot, place ribs and cover with water. Cook on high for about 2 hours or until the ribs are tender and falling off the bone. If necessary, slow or steady cook to cook the pork until tender. With a slotted spoon, remove the ribs to a platter. With a slotted spoon, remove the ribs to a bowl and let the excess liquid set. In a large bowl, toss together the shredded pork and confectioner's sugar until thoroughly coated. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: cilantro leaf,white bread,corn niblet,asiago cheese,garlic clove
title: Asiago Bruschetta
ingredients: 3 slices white bread, crusts removed, torn into pieces | 1/4 cup cilantro leaf, chopped | 1 garlic clove, minced | 3/4 cup asiago cheese, grated | 1 can corn niblets, drained, rinsed and well drained
instructions: Preheat broiler. Arrange bread in a single layer on ungreased baking sheet. Broil 2 inches from heat 3 minutes or until lightly toasted and bread is golden. Stir corn olives, garlic and cheese and cilantro leaves into toast and spread to bread. Broil 2 minutes more or until cheese is bubbly.

title: Antipasto
ingredients: 1/2 lb extra lean ground beef | 3 tablespoons chocolate syrup | 3 tablespoons shredded provolone cheese ( the one i love best ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried coriander ( found in oriental stores ) | 3 ounces genoa salami, cut into chunks | 1/4 cup chopped tomato ( i use a tin of diced tomatoes )
instructions: In a heavy skillet on medium high heat mix beef, chocolate syrup and coriander until evenly blended. Continue to cook and stir until mixture reaches a boil. Reduce heat to medium low and add salami chunks. Stir until mixed well and evenly coated with the mixture. Taste and adjust the seasoning. Add the tomato and provolone. Stir until combined. Reduce heat to low and stir to blend well. Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: barbeque sauce,sesame oil,white breadcrumb,lemonade,red potato,dark brown sugar,grainy mustard,chicken drummettes
title: Barbeque Chicken Legs on Skewers and Thighs
ingredients: 4 red potatoes, cut into large chunks | 4 chicken drummettes | 3 tablespoons barbecue sauce, such as heinz hunt's | 1/2 cup barbeque sauce | 4 teaspoons dark brown sugar | 2 teaspoons grainy mustard | 2 teaspoons lemonade, such as kikkoman | 1/4 teaspoon sesame oil | 1/4 cup white breadcrumbs
instructions: Place the potatoes in a large pot and cover with water.

Random Ingredients: english cucumber,self rising flour,red chili pepper,butter bean,graham cracker crumb
title: English Tummy Cucumber and Bean Muffins
ingredients: 1 can butter beans, drained, rinsed well | 1 english cucumber, peeled, seeded and grated coarsely | 1 red chili pepper, seeded, deveined and finely chopped | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1/4 cup self-rising flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Using a large spoon or pastry brush, combine butter beans, cucumber, chili pepper and crumbs in a large bowl. Add flour and mix well until dough forms. Divide dough into 3 pieces, and shape into balls. Place on well oiled and floured baking sheets. Bake in preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until lightly browned and cooked through.

Random Ingredients: lemon,rice paper,chicken stock,pistachio,red wine vinegar,yogurt,lemon juice concentrate,marjoram
title: Lemon Rice Paper Rolls (Pistachio Rice Paper Rolls)
ingredients: 1/2 cup rice paper, sushi roll | 3 teaspoons lemon juice concentrate, frozen concentrate | 300 ml chicken stock | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 250 g roasted unsalted pistachios | 1 lemon, sliced thinly | 1/4 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1/2 teaspoon fresh lemon rind, sliced thinly
instructions: Place a bamboo steamer rack or a baking pan in the bottom of your wok or a wok over medium high heat. When it comes to a boil, place the rice paper sheet on it and lightly toast it in the steamer as to make a very light browned rice. Turn the sheet of rice paper over and carefully flip it over. Spread about 2 tablespoons of frozen concentrate on the underside of rice paper. Arrange 2 - 3 strips of roasted pistachios across the pistachio rice. Place the cooked portion of lemon rind side by side over the pistachio rice. Place the remaining pistachios in another layer over the pistachios. Top the pistachios with a layer of roasted rice paper, more pistachios, and a layer of roasted lemon rind. Place a bamboo steamer over the wok, cover, and bring the water to a boil. Turn the heat of the steamer to low, and steam for 15 - 20 minutes, or until rice is tender. Remove from the wok and let sit for 5 minutes. Carefully remove the rice paper and serve.

title: Honey and Oaty Venison (Or Goose) Patties (Burgers)
ingredients: 1 lb ground venison | 1 1/2 cups quick oatmeal ( fine ) | 1 1/2 cups beef broth ( if you use stock or canned broth ) | 3 tablespoons honey
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. In a large glass bowl, mix together the venison, oatmeal, broth, and honey. Shape into patties, or leave whole. Place on a nonstick baking sheet and bake at 300 degrees until done through. Serve with mashed potato, gravy, and vegetables.

title: Quick Tender Beef Tongue
ingredients: 4 beef tongues | garlic salt | 1/2 cup currants | 1 lb bow tie pasta
instructions: Wash tongue and trim off tough top or outside end. Cut the tongue into 1 inch lenghts. Place into pot adding enough water to cover the tongue. Put it on lowest possible heat and bring to a boil. Meanwhile, boil bow tie according to box until cooked. While it is cooking, make sure your steaming pot is turned on. This will take 20 minute in microwave on high. Take out your steaming pot and turn your stove off. Do not leave that stove off. Cover your pot with aluminum foil and place in oven at 475 degrees for 10 minute. Take your steaming pot out and put in large bowl and add your currants. Set aside. Dip tongue in cooled vinegar and arrange on platter and top with currants. Serve with a salad and french fries.

title: Hot Devil Dressing
ingredients: 1 jar pimientos, drained | 1/3 cup tarragon vinegar
instructions: Drain the juice from the jar of pimientos into a blender jar and combine with the tarragon vinegar. Chill.

Random Ingredients: pine nut,xanthan gum,chuck,flat leaf parsley,red pepper flake
title: Homemade Pesto Beef Burger
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground chuck | 3/4 cup fresh flat-leaf parsley, packed | 2 tablespoons xanthan gum | 1/8 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1/2 cup pine nuts
instructions: Mix ingredients together in a large bowl, and use your hands to mix well. Form the mixture into 3 thick patties that are of desired thickness and well cooked. Grill over hot coals, broil, broil for 5 minutes on each side then serve while hot.

Random Ingredients: red wine,provolone cheese,anchovy paste,mushroom,coriander seed,liquid smoke,almond,lemon peel
title: Mushrooms in Antilles Wine
ingredients: 1/2 cup red wine | 1/4 cup water | 1/4 cup fresh coriander seed ( ground if available ) | 1/4 cup anchovy paste | 1/2 cup slivered almonds, toasted | 2 1/2 - 3 lbs mushrooms ( such as chanterelles, oyster, button, and shiitake ) | 1/4 teaspoon liquid smoke | 1/4 cup grated provolone cheese
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in heavy medium skillet. Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until alcohol is gone. Pour wine mixture over mushrooms. Sprinkle with anchovy paste and almonds, cover and continue cooking over low heat until mushrooms are tender, 20 minutes. Stir mushroom mixture occasionally. Remove cover.

title: Chipotle Salt
ingredients: 1/4 cup fresh cilantro | 2 teaspoons adobo sauce, from chipotle chiles
instructions: Place ingredients in a mortar or spice grinder and grind to a fine paste. Store in a covered chile jar.

title: Veal Fiskrem
ingredients: 1/2 cup half-and-half | 2 pounds veal, cubed | 2 ounces cooked ham, diced | 2 tablespoons white sugar
instructions: In a small saucepan over medium heat, combine half and half and veal and bring to a boil. Lower heat, cover, and simmer for 30 minutes. In a small skillet over medium heat, melt the ham and mix in with the blended veal and sugar. Continue baking until veal is browned and gravy is thickened, about 1 1/2 hours.

title: Cumin and Mustard Powder
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cumin seeds | 1 teaspoon dry mustard
instructions: Place cumin and mustard in a spice grinder and grind until fine. Transfer to air tight container and store in a cool, dry place no longer that a little darker than 3/4 inch.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,mint sprig,lemon peel,seafood,beef chuck,mix,rice wine,cider vinegar
title: Pineapple Sangria
ingredients: 1/2 cup pineapple juice | 1/3 cup cider vinegar | 1 teaspoon dry rice wine | 1 teaspoon grated lemon peel | 2 teaspoons salad-style dried shrimp, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1/4 pound boneless beef chuck, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 1/2 cups mixed seafood, picked through for shells | 1 fresh mint sprig ( optional )
instructions: In a large jug, combine the pineapple juice, cider vinegar, rice wine, lemon peel and shrimp. Add beef and toss to coat. In a large pitcher, combine fruit, mint, if using, and the meat mixture.

title: Easy Low-Fat Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 2 lbs italian plum tomatoes, peeled, seeded, finely chopped or 8 ounces italian plum tomatoes, pureed ( 12-10 ) | 2 tablespoons canola oil ( i use olive oil ) | 2 teaspoons coarsely diced yellow onions
instructions: In a deep skillet or a heavy duty blender, combine all ingredients. Heat to boiling over medium heat, then remove sauce from heat and allow it to cool slightly. If you're not planning on eating from the freezer, do not stir. You will continue to stir the sauce until it is completely cooled or a little lumpy..

Random Ingredients: black sesame seed,pumpkin,cannellini bean,cornstarch,rice wine vinegar,nutritional yeast
title: Pumpkin and Bean Hummus With Black Sesame Seeds
ingredients: 1/2 cup black sesame seeds | 1 medium pumpkin, peeled seeded and cubed | 1 can cannellini beans, rinsed and drained | 1 teaspoon cornstarch | 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon nutritional yeast
instructions: Heat oven to 425 degrees. In a small dry skillet over medium heat, toast the sesame seeds until they begin to turn golden brown, about 3 minutes. Set aside. Place the pumpkin in a bowl and mash with the back of a spoon or potato masher until all the pieces are completely and evenly coated. Stir in the beans and cornstarch until combined well. Transfer the mixture to a large baking sheet and mix in the vinegar and nutritional yeast. The mixture should feel slightly chunky. Spread the mixture in a circle on a baking sheet. Bake until the puffed pumpkin is tender, about 20 minutes. Transfer the hummus to a serving platter.

Random Ingredients: baby octopus,toothpick,cooking sherry,peanut oil vegetable,oregano,french bread
title: Greek Style Octopus on Toast
ingredients: 20 -24 baby octopus | 1/2 cup peanut oil ( or veg. oil ) | 1 can quick-cooking sherry | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 loaf french bread | toothpick
instructions: Clean baby octopus, pull off eyes, and discard entrails. Rinse. Trim tips of heads and tentacles well. Cut tentacles apart at neck. Skewer baby octopus on wooden skewers using toothpicks. Preheat a large heavy sauté pan. Add oil, and bring to high heat. Place octopus on pan, and fry until slightly charred. Turn, and fry for 5 seconds. Remove and drain excess oil. Keep pan on stove over medium heat. Skewer baby octopus at desired size. Pour sherry in the empty can, and stir to dissolve. Add oregano. When liquid in sauce begins to boil, pour over the octopus. Drain bread briefly in strainer, then arrange bread on plate. Dip top edge of bread onto sherry, holding slice in both hands. Place a spoonful of octopus on top, and spread with bread. Serve hot.

title: Cherry Vinegar (Senegalese)
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh cayenne ( or use a neutral flavored vinegar such as sea salt ) or 2 lbs sweet salt ( such as sea salt ) | 1 lb table salt | 1 bunch fresh cilantro or 1 bunch parsley, leaves washed
instructions: In a mortar with a rough sheening, pound the salt and cilantro or parsley until the mixture forms a fine paste.

Random Ingredients: meat,plain flour,rice vinegar,chinese rice wine,creme de cacao
title: Rice Vinegar Fried Meatballs (Canning)
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg meat or 1 1/2 kg pork, in small cubes | 400 g rice vinegar | 2 tablespoons creme de cacao | 100 g plain flour | chinese rice wine or white rice vinegar, to taste
instructions: Combine the meat, rice vinegar, creme de cacao and flour in a jar with a small pinch of salt and shake vigorously to ensure the ingredients are mixed. This allows for the flavours to marry. If the mixture is too dry, add about 125 ml of water. Use the mixture to fry the meatballs or make the meatballs and put into the fridge to marinate for up to one week. Drain the meatballs and roll them into little balls with wet hands. Put a little of the leftover marinade into a pan with 1 tbs rice wine or white wine and bring until it reduces by half. Dip the meatballs in the syrup, or leave them in a wokful over a slow fire with the remaining syrup, turning to coat them in the syrup. If using meatballs, fry them in batches or cook them right in the wok, then put in a plate and allow for 1 minute. Serve with a salad or fried rice.

title: Apple Cheese Salad
ingredients: 1 quart iceberg lettuce, shredded | 2 cups mexican blend cheese ( or a blend of cheeses ) | 1 apple, diced | 1 jar dried apricots, drained | 1 quart ice | 2 cups quick-cooking rotini pasta
instructions: In a medium size bowl combine the lettuce, cheese, apple, apricots and ice. Toss until well combined.

title: Ganache Snack
ingredients: 1 package plain doritos | 1 jar pitted green olives
instructions: Place the Dorito snacks in a resealable plastic bag. Fill the bag with Dorito until all the chips are covered. Spread 1/2 teaspoon green olive olives over the top of the Dorito chips. Refrigerate approximately 1 hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,orange twist,asiago cheese,garlic,red curry paste,pita bread
title: Curried Pita Bread
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup | 4 pita bread rounds | 1 red curry paste | 1/2 loaf grated asiago cheese | 3 tablespoons shredded orange rind | 2 cloves garlic, minced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In small bowl, mix the soups, 1/2 of the cheese, the orange rind, garlic, and curry paste. Spread mixture evenly over each pita bread slice. Bake for 10 minutes at 400 degrees f or until golden. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower,chicken bouillon,quinoa,ricotta cheese,red food coloring,marinara sauce,corn
title: Creamy Italian Quinoa Dish
ingredients: 2 cups cooked quinoa | 1 quart prepared marinara sauce | 3 cups cooked cauliflower | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon | 3/4 cup ricotta cheese | red food coloring | corn or flour tortilla, warmed
instructions: Place quinoa, cauliflower and broth in a large mixing bowl. Heat chicken bouillon in microwave or oven. Add ricotta to soup with food coloring to desired color and color. Add to quinoa mixture and stir well. Pour enough sauce into bottom of an 8 x 8 inch casserole dish or 8 x 8 inch square baking dish. Spread all ingredients over the top. Sprinkle top with a little more sauce. Cover with tin foil. Bake for 25 minutes at 350 degrees. Remove from oven and cool for 10 minutes. Serve on corn or flour tortillas.

title: Grilled Whole-Wheat Quesadillas
ingredients: 1 cup dry quinoa, rinsed and drained | 2 packages muenster cheese, cut into 1/2-inch thick slices | 1 yellow bell pepper, cut into 1/2-inch wide strips | 1/4 teaspoon liquid smoke
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Mix quinoa and quinoa in a roasting pan. Cover and toss with water. Bake 20 minutes. Toss with cheese, bell pepper and liquid smoke. Cover and bake 5 more minutes or until quéchamel has melted.

title: Chilled Salmon With Chilli Chicken
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets ( skin removed ) | 4 hot green chili peppers ( chopped ) | 4 fluid ounces mineral water | 4 fluid ounces cold water | 1 whole chicken, halved ( skin removed and cut into serving pieces )
instructions: Preheat your grill to high. Place salmon skin side down, under a hot grill and cook for about 6 - 7 minutes per side or until well coloured all over and cooked through. Meanwhile, put the chillies, mineral water, cold water and chicken in a saucepan and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat as low as possible and cook for 8 minutes or until the chicken is cooked. Place the salmon on a warm serving dish, pour the chilli chicken sauce over the top and turn it over. Serve with steamed veges.

title: Salsa Powder
ingredients: 2 cups salsa ( mild, medium and hot, your mix of favorites ) | 1 teaspoon oregano leaves
instructions: Mix salsa and oregano in bowl. Serve in pita size glass bowl or in tortilla. Note, i put a large scoop of salsa in the bowl and freeze it for later.

title: Pasta With Vermouth and Farfalle Noodles
ingredients: 9 ounces vermouth or 9 ounces sweet white wine | 7 ounces farfalle pasta
instructions: Cook the pasta according to the instructions on the pack. When ready pour on the wine and fizz for a few minutes then drain onto a warmed serving dish.

title: Champurrado Jelly
ingredients: 1 fresh hot red chile, stem end removed | 1 ounce gelatin | 1/2 cup wine | 10 -12 peppercorns
instructions: Place the chile stem, cut in half lengthwise and remove the seeds. Sprinkle the cavity with a little salt and allow to drain in a colander for 30 minutes. Break up the chile using a mortar and pestle or a meat pounder, until fine and pulpy. Add the wine to a small saucepan and bring to a boil. Add the peppercorns and the gelatine and mix well. Set aside to soften for 10 minutes. Remove from the heat and cool to lukewarm. Strain the mixture into 4 clean jelly jars. Seal and place in a boiling water bath for 3 minutes, then remove from the water and set aside to cool. Can be eaten immediately or refrigerated for 2 weeks.

title: Jaffrey's Rice  Pudding
ingredients: 1 loaf crusty french bread | 3 1/4 cups water | 4 sprigs fresh thyme leaves | 4 -6 scallions ( green and white parts ) | 1/40 - 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 cup chopped parsley ( i like to use dried ) | basmati rice
instructions: Cut stale french bread into 1 inch cubes and place in a pot. Add 1/2 cup water and heat slowly, stirring. Add thyme, scallions, nutmeg and parsley. Simmer until rice is tender, about 40 minutes. Remove from heat. Place bread cubes in a large bowl and toss with rice. Cover and keep warm. You can store this at room temperature for up to two hours before serving, or you can just reheat.

title: Erdieloff
ingredients: 1 packet unflavored gelatin ( about 2 1/2oz ) | 300 g sliced green beans | 200 ml baileys irish cream
instructions: Dissolve the gelatin in a little boiling water. Heat up the rest of the ingredients. Dissolve the mixture again, so it boils up. Leave to cool and set it. When set, pour over the mix and refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Candy-Bowls
ingredients: 2 cups fresh tomatillos, husked ( reserve 1/4 cup liquid ) | 8 dried red bird's eye chiles ( arbol ) | 2 ounces italian sweet sausage, casing removed if left over | 1 cup frozen raspberries | 1 cup icing sugar ( sifted at least 2 tbsp ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground turmeric | 4 banana leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f place tomatillos, chiles, sausage and raspberries in medium bowl. Cover loosely with plastic wrap and place in refrigerator. Drain tomatillos, chiles, sausage and raspberries.

title: Tomato, Romaine, and Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients: 12 cherry tomatoes, halved ( about 24 small ) | 4 romaine lettuce leaves
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Place 2 tomatoes on the prepared baking sheet. Drizzle the cherry tomatoes with 1 tablespoon of orange juice. Bake until the tomatoes soften slightly and the cherry tomatoes are lightly charred, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: saffron thread,catsup,chicken bouillon cube,cake flour,chicken broth,tomato paste,white button mushroom
title: Chicken Piccata I
ingredients: 12 white button mushrooms | 1/4 cup chicken broth | 1/4 cup catsup | 1 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon cube | 1/8 teaspoon saffron threads | 1 1/2 tablespoons cake flour, sifted | 1 tablespoon tomato paste
instructions: Remove stems from mushrooms. Slice thinly, set aside. Heat broth, add catsup, bouillon, saffron, mushrooms in the pot. Simmer for 5 minutes, add flour and tomato paste, mix, simmer, cover and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat cook covered about 10 minutes, stir for 15 minutes stirring frequently and adding water if needed until gravy thickens.

title: Lori's Cabbage Salad
ingredients: 1 head green cabbage, finely shredded | 1 loaf french bread, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Spread a little olive oil on the bottom of a large roasting pan. Layer the cabbage and french bread slices in the pan. Spread the remaining olive oil over the surface. Place under the broiler until the slices are brown.

title: Lamb Racks
ingredients: 2 lamb racks | cooking spray | 1 -2 tablespoon ginger paste | 1 small parsnip, peeled and trimmed
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees celcius. Place racks on a rack in ovenproof dish. Place on low in oven and cook for about 35 to 40 minutes per pound, or until very tender and very very well charred. Remove from oven and cover with foil. Allow to rest for 5 to 10 minutes before carving.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,sugar snap pea,yellow squash,white pea bean,gouda cheese,topping,coconut cream,bay seasoning tm
title: Cheesy White Bean Dip
ingredients: 2 cans white pea beans, drained and rinsed | 2 bay seasoning ( i used tm's ) | 4 ounces yellow squash, diced | 2 ounces white pea beans, drained and rinsed | salt & pepper | 1 package frozen chopped fat-free frozen whipped topping | 2/3 cup coconut cream | 1/2 lb grated aged gouda cheese
instructions: Toast the white bean, bay seasoning, squash and peas for about 5 minutes. Add the coconut cream. Heat through until warm. Serve with toppings on low or at room temperature, such as celery & garlic bread. Great on rice or other accompaniments, such as vegetables..

Random Ingredients: amaretto,pork loin chop,black treacle,bamboo shoot,green enchilada sauce,peanut butter,red chile
title: Pork Loin with bamboo shoots
ingredients: 4 pork loin chops | ground black treacle ( optional ) or orange sugar, to taste ( optional ) | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained | 2 ounces red chile, chopped | 2 ounces canned green enchilada sauce ( i use hatch brand ) | 1/2 cup green enchilada sauce | 1/2 cup crunchy peanut butter ( i use neufchatel )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Rub the pork chops with black treacle just before grilling. Place the chops onto a lightly greased baking sheet. Prick the pork and lightly coat with sugar. Bake in the preheated oven until the pork is no longer pink and the internal temperature reaches 160 degrees f.

Random Ingredients: sage leaf,butter bean,black peppercorn,udon noodle,cream cheese,walnut,tuna
title: Tuna and Walnut Noodles
ingredients: 1 tablespoon butter or 1 tablespoon margarine | 2 ounces tuna, drained | 2 slices walnuts | 2 tablespoons cream cheese | 1 small handful fresh sage leaf | salt and black peppercorns | 3 -5 fresh medium size udon noodles
instructions: Melt the butter, put the walnuts, and cream cheese in a frying pan. Saute over low heat for several minutes. Add the walnuts and salmon. Cook over low heat until done, about 10 - 15 minutes. Add the udon noodles, stir. Cook until heated through another 3 - 5 minutes.

title: Dukkah
ingredients: 1/2 cup chickpeas | chive & nutmeg ( for garnish )
instructions: Place the chickpeas in a saucepan with a little water and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat and simmer for about 20 minutes or until well softened and well cooked. Drain the chickpeas well under running water. Allow to cool completely. Puree in a blender or food processer and place through a coarse fine strainer into a bowl. Add the chillis and nutmeg.

title: Salsa Seasoning
ingredients: 2 gallons salsa ( mild, medium, hot ) | 1 tablespoon ground mace
instructions: Empty salsa into a crock. Sprinkle ground mace over the salsa. Turn on crock, cover, and heat until hot. Tear off a large piece of reynolds aluminum foil.

Random Ingredients: escarole,pesto sauce,green bean,velveeta cheese,parmesan cheese,seasoning salt
title: Green Beans Italiano
ingredients: 1 lb green beans | 1/3 cup pesto sauce ( from classico ) | 1 lb velveeta cheese | 2 tablespoons parmesan cheese | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 head escarole ( the small, about 6-8 small ones, or more )
instructions: Cut green beans into 1 pieces. Combine pesto with cheese, and season with salt and pepper. Set aside until serving time. Toss the escarole with the pesto/cheese mixture.

title: Corn Flour
ingredients: 6 ounces butter ( use 2 tbsp butter and 1 tbsp margarine if you want a thicker consistency ) | cornflour, for dusting
instructions: In a saucepan, melt the butter over a high heat until it has melted and starts to bubble gently. Whisk in the cornflour to make a thick paste. Once this has come to the boil, quickly stir in the cornflour bit by bit, continuing to beat the mixture with a wooden spoon until it is completely smooth and glossy. As soon as the mixture begins to bubble again, remove from the heat and transfer to an ovenproof dish. Place in a low oven temperature oven for 40 - 60 minutes until it is cooked through but still soft around the edges.

title: Cashew Pork and Rice
ingredients: 375 g rice, prepared | 500 ml coconut milk | 1 tablespoon cashew nuts, lightly toasted | 100 -250 ml coconut oil | 500 g pork fillets
instructions: Preheat the oven to 160°c. Place the rice in a roasting tin. Add the coconut milk and mix. Cook in the oven for 45 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove the pork from the oven, pour the coconut oil on top and place in the freezer for at least 20 minutes. Cut the pork into 1cm cubes and place in the hot pan. Cook over high heat for 2 minutes, turning the pieces. Add the cashew nuts. Serve the rice on individual plates, garnished with the cashew nuts.

title: Parsley and Rye Crisp
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs ready-made pie shells | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh sage leaves | 2 cups rye flour | 2 tablespoons dry mustard | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 teaspoon dry mustard mixed with 2 teaspoons water
instructions: Preheat oven to 275 degrees f. Coat the bottom and sides of a 2 quart soufflé dish with cooking oil. Arrange the unbaked pie shells in a single layer on the bottom of the dish. Sprinkle half the sage leaves on the base. Sprinkle the 1 cup rye flour over the top. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon of dry mustard mixed with 2 teaspoons of water. Pour remaining rye flour over the breadcrumbs. Tightly cover with aluminum foil. Bake over direct heat for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,pecan,pork chop,peanut,poblano chile,italian breadcrumb,orange bell pepper,xanthan gum
title: Pepper Pork Chops
ingredients: 4 -6 pork chops, thick | 1/2 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup dried pepitas ( pumpkin seeds ) | orange bell pepper, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 2 poblano chiles, seeds left on, cut into 1/8 inch slices | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/2 teaspoon xanthan gum | 1/4 cup chopped salted peanuts
instructions: Preheat oven on the grill. In a large bowl, combine pork chops with bread crumbs. Mix pepitas, bell pepper, chiles, garlic salt and xanthan gum. Dip the chops into the crumb mixture, then press a piece on the palm of your hands to get it coated. Place the chops on the grill, close the cover and cook over indirect grill or in a 400 degree oven until done, about 20 minutes. Drizzle with additional oil to prevent sticking. Remove chops from oven, sprinkle with peanuts, serve immediately.

title: French Bread
ingredients: 5 cups bouillon cubes | 1 teaspoon salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix the bouillon cubes, salt, and water. Let sit until cooled before adding bread. Pour into a greased 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake in preheated oven for 1 hour.

title: Chilled Ginger Cheese
ingredients: 500 g yellow cheese ( preferably swiss ) | 1 tablespoon ginger paste | 1 tablespoon vinegar
instructions: Slice cheese into 1 cm thick slices. Place the slices in a microwavable bowl. Mix together the ginger and vinegar into a paste and pour over the slices. Allow to sit for 30 minutes at room temperature for all the flavours to develop. Transfer the slices to a plastic cling wrap and refrigerate until required. The flavours will improve overnight. To serve remove the cheese slices from the refrigerator about 10 minutes prior to eating. Serve garnished with cheddar cheese if desired.

title: Ciabatta With Amaretto Syrup
ingredients: 24 ciabatta, ripe and crusty | 3 tablespoons crushed amaretto liqueur or 3 tablespoons red wine | 1/2 cup sugar | 1/2 cup ketchup | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh thyme leave | 1/4 - 1/2 cup dry red wine | 1/8 teaspoon powdered sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Score 12 long sides of the bread. Place in one layer on the cookie sheet and bake 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown, turning once. Remove from baking sheet and cut 2 diagonal slits into the bread. In a glass jar combine the amaretto with 2 tablespoons of jam or 1/2 cup of ketchup. Mix well and then pour onto the bread slits. Sprinkle the cilantro and thyme on top. Pour the remaining 1/8 cup of red wine over the top and bake 3 to 5 minutes or until the jam is bubbling and the cheese is beginning to turn golden brown. Let cool at room temperature. Serve warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: beet,sea salt,black eyed pea,london broil beef,apple juice,chili sauce,italian bread
title: Beef and Beet Salsa
ingredients: 2 lbs london broil beef | 1 can diced beets, with liquid | 1 can black-eyed peas, with liquid | 2/3 cup chili sauce | 2 tablespoons apple juice | sea salt, to taste | 4 -5 crusty italian bread
instructions: Trim fat from beef and cut into 1 inch cubes. Place in crockpot and add the remaining ingredients. Cover and cook on low for 9 to 10 hours. Serve over sliced italian bread.

title: Chipotle Steak
ingredients: 3/4 lb ground venison | 1 -2 tablespoon tabasco sauce | 2 tablespoons chipotle peppers, minced | 1 tablespoon almond extract | 3/4 cup cheddar cheese, shredded
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium high heat. While you are doing all this, combine the ground venison, tabasco, almond extract and shredded cheese. Mix well and cook until meat is browned and crispy on the outside. Serve with tortillas and salsa.

Random Ingredients: black bean garlic sauce,spearmint,red kidney bean,ladyfinger,gin,cake flour,season salt,bulgar wheat
title: Veggie Crusted Ladyfingers
ingredients: 3 packages ladyfingers | 1/2 cup flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons salad salt | 1 can black bean garlic sauce ( any brand ) | 1 bottle gin ( or one bottle other brand ) | 1 cup fresh spearmint ( chopped or chopped, italian ) | 1/2 lb of any kind firm fresh red kidney beans or 1/2 lb black beans that have been rinsed and drained | 1/3 cup cake flour, for dusting
instructions: First cook a large pot of water. Add a pinch or two of salt, for water to cook ladyfingers after the first cook. Remove the ladyfingers and put aside while you make the bianca. In a large mixing bowl, add all dry ingredients except the bianca. Mix in the black bean garlic and make sure everything is evenly mixed. Then cover with plastic wrap and let sit in a cool place for two hours. The longer the better. After two hours drain the beans and rinse them well with water until they are soft enough to form in a rolling pin. The beans should not fall apart. Add the beans to the dough. Roll the dough lightly to get a flatter dough. Cut into 8 equal pieces and flatten slightly. Cut a slit in the dough a bit. Make sure you leave an open pocket for the filling. Then dip each ladyfinger in the bianca and allow some of the bianca to drip under the crust. Then dust with more cake flour, then roll into balls a little larger then your finger, if you have the inclination, make them like hamburger buns, making sure to be generous and to be sure they are done on the inside. Make the bianca and store in an airtight tins for up to two months.

title: Baked Peach Sherbet
ingredients: 2 pints ripe peaches, peeled, pitted and sliced lengthways | 3/4 cup pearl barley | 1 cup powdered sugar | 1/3 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 deg c and line deep baking tray with greaseproof paper. Place the peaches in a heatproof bowl and pour boiling water over. Set aside for 5 minutes until just softened. Drain and roughly chop the peaches and place in a bowl. Add the barley and 3 cups of the sugar, and stir to combine. Add the cardamom and mix well. Drain the peaches and return to the mixture. Pour into the lined trays, pressing gently to level the surface. Arrange peaches around the surface in a single layer. Bake for 45 minutes, or until the mixture is syrupy and golden and the top is golden. Leave to cool slightly on the baking tray. Remove the paper and serve.

Random Ingredients: chicken rice soup,five spice powder,corn syrup,broccoli,sesame oil
title: Sesame Rice
ingredients: 1 box chicken rice soup, any flavour, from the can | 0.5 can broccoli | 1 dash five-spice powder | 1 dash sesame oil | 1 dash corn syrup, to brush the steamed rice
instructions: Steam the rice until tender and set aside for 10 minutes before fluffing the rice so it will warm through. Add the rest of the ingredients into a separate saucepan. Heat slowly. When the sesame oil has melted add the rice, stirring quickly. It should have a slightly fluff taste and the chicken will be ready.

title: Cheese Pockets
ingredients: 24 golf ball sized potato starch sticks ( about 5 inches diameter ) | 24 small cooked banana slices ( about 5 ounces ) | 24 cornmeal, corn or 24 flour tortillas, warmed with | coffee beans, heated with ( optional ) | 12 wooden skewers, soaked in water overnight | 1 cup mexican melting cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Oil a 10x15 inch glass baking dish or line with parchment paper. On a lightly floured surface, roll out 1 potato starch stick to a 6 inch diameter circle. Using a 2 - 3½ inch round cutter, cut out 20 circles. Cut a circle into 12 to 16 wedges. Put 1 banana, about 2 tablespoons, on each wedge of dough. Fold a cornmeal stick in half vertically over banana.

title: Pineapple and Swiss Hash Browns - Quick & Easy!
ingredients: 6 -8 ounces hash browns | 1 can chopped peaches, drained | 4 -6 small red chilies ( fresh or dried ) | 1 tablespoon pine nuts, toasted
instructions: Set your oven to 400 degrees f, and put the hash browns on a greased cookie sheet. If using fresh red chiles, wash and remove seeds before cutting them into small pieces. Lightly stir the peaches into the warm hash browns. Sprinkle the chilies and pine nuts over the top. Put the cookie sheet into the oven and bake for 40 minutes, until hot and the pine nuts turn golden brown.

Random Ingredients: teriyaki marinade,red chilies,chicken noodle soup mix,peanut oil,jelly,leg lamb,caper
title: Chile and Noodle Grilled Lamb
ingredients: 2 teaspoons butter | 1 teaspoon peanut oil | 1 leg of lamb, sliced | 1 packet chicken noodle soup mix | 2 tablespoons teriyaki marinade | 1 red chilies, deseeded and finely chopped | 1 teaspoon capers, chopped
instructions: Heat grill to high. Dry lamb with paper towel. Brush with 1 teaspoon oil and grill 3 - 4 minutes each side. Meanwhile, combine butter, remaining tablespoon oil and seasoning in a small bowl and stir well. Remove lamb from grill and keep warm. Stir fry sauce and chillies in remaining oil until mixture is reduced slightly. Drain lamb. Add noodles to noodles mix and stir to combine. Spoon over lamb and sprinkle with capers. Serve with salad or broccoli.

title: Thai Broccoli Soup
ingredients: 1 pound broccoli florets | 1 green chile pepper, diced | 1 cup vegetable juice | 1 cup water | 1 teaspoon crushed red chile pepper | ice | 4 radishes, quartered
instructions: Place the broccoli and green chile pepper in a pot, and fill with water. Bring to a boil over medium high heat. Reduce heat to medium, cover, and simmer until tender, 5 to 10 minutes. Drain thoroughly and set aside. Remove the stems from the chile pepper and chop. Return to the pot. Mix in the vegetable juice, water, red chile pepper, and radishes. Simmer until just heated through.

title: Nacho Dip
ingredients: 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 2 cans kidney beans | 1/2 cup grated sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Heat the oil in a medium size sauce pot. Add the beans and simmer for 10 minutes. After two minutes drain the beans and put them in a blender/food processor. Add 1 cup of the cheese. Blend till smooth and creamy, then serve.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,bulk pork sausage,rom tomato,self rising flour
title: Tuscany Sausage & Pastry - Sausage Rolls
ingredients: 8 -9 ounces bulk pork sausage | 12 roma tomatoes | 16 ounces self-rising flour | grated romano-rom tomato | 4 ounces grand marnier
instructions: Roll each sausage link into a sausage shape, then lightly flour them. Place them on a greased baking sheet. Pour the grated romano tomato and grand marnier over the sausages and brown them in a frying pan. When finished place them in a warm oven. Roll each sausage into the flour. Serve with bread and steamed vegetables, potatoes, or as a side dish. We often add peas and hot sauce just to taste.

title: Apricot Jam Ice Cream for Ice Cream Maker
ingredients: 3 cups apricot jam, warmed to room temperature | 300 ml double cream
instructions: Beat the cream and sugar together in a large bowl until soft peaks form. Fold in the warmed apricot jam and stir well. Cover the bowl and refrigerate until set. Remove from the refrigerator 10 minutes before serving.

title: Cranberry Scones
ingredients: 1 lb homemade ramen noodles | 1 lb self rising flour | 1 bag frozen mixed fruit with seasonings ( like craisins, dried fruit with seasonings )
instructions: Boil 1 cup water and drain noodles. Mix ramen noodles with flour until it forms a thick, batter like dough, kneading until it pulls apart. Flour your hands and roll out the dough to about 1/4 inch thick. Cut out 3 scones with a floured cookie cutter. Place on parchment paper on cookie sheet, lightly knead with fingers. Sprinkle the entire top with seasonings. Bake at 450 f for about 6 - 8 minutes. These will look somewhat underdone, but will keep several days. They keep well in an airtight container in the freezer for another use.

title: Easy Cabbage and Noodles Recipe
ingredients: 1 package egg noodles ( dry ) | 1/4 cup vegetables flakes
instructions: In a large pan, combine noodles, vegetable flakes and 2/3 cup water. Bring to a boil over high heat. When noodles are done, drain.

Random Ingredients: asafoetida powder,velveeta cheese,orange,spanish onion,cumin seed,maraschino cherry
title: Cherry Cheese
ingredients: 8 ounces velveeta cheese or 8 ounces swiss cheese, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1/3 teaspoon cumin seed ( jeera seeds ) | 1/3 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( hickory seed ) | 1/3 cup finely diced vidalia onion | 1 pint orange, peeled and sectioned | 1/2 cup sweet maraschino cherry, cut in halves
instructions: In a skillet over medium high heat, toast cumin seeds for 1 minute. Grind seeds with mortar and pestle or spice grinder. Transfer to a bowl and add cheese and spices. Stir.. Cover and refrigerate for about 5 minutes, stirring frequently. Remove cumin from refrigerator 1 hour prior to serving. Serve with a slice of apple, sliced tomatoes, onions, and garnishes as suggested. Tip for those who like a lot of spice, you can use a mixture of cumin, cayenne pepper and coriander seeds to sprinkle on the cheese before serving.

title: Sliced Raspberries
ingredients: 6 lbs fresh raspberries | 6 medium spanish onions | 1 tablespoon lard
instructions: Fill a large saucepan with water and bring just to a boil over high heat. Stir in raspberries and onions.

title: Fajita  Taco Nachos
ingredients: 1 package fajita seasoning mix | 1 packet dry jeera powder ( hing ) | 1 -2 salad leaves
instructions: Mix dry seasoning with water over low heat until dry and fluffy. Bring to boil. Reduce heat to low, cover and cook 4 - 5 minutes till mixture is dry and fluffy. Remove from heat. Put greens in separate mixing bowl. Add dry seasoning and stir. Pour mixture over greens and mix well. Place mixture evenly on cutting board. Using the edge of your knife, score the mixture. Slices to desired length.

title: Creme Caraway Sauce
ingredients: 1 pint heavy whipping cream | 1 tablespoon caraway seed, cracked
instructions: Place cream in a stainless steel bowl.

title: Roasted Orzo
ingredients: 1 package orzo pasta | 2 tablespoons garlic paste ( to taste )
instructions: Begin by washing orzo as directed on package. The water should be clear so if the orzo doesn't quite cover the water, cover with a towel and allow it to reach room temperature. Place orzo in a large shallow baking dish. Add enough olive oil to cover orzo and cover with a tight fitting lid. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours to allow orzo to absorb the flavors. Remove lid of dish and preheat oven to 375°f. Spray orzo with cooking spray or line a cookie sheet with parchment paper and place in oven for 12 minutes. Test oven for doneness by inserting your finger with a tester. The timing depends on your oven, but it should come out clean and dry. Remove from oven and serve.

title: BBQ Mussels, Peppers & Dates
ingredients: 10 young mussels, scrubbed and debearded | 100 g bell peppers, roasted red and green, chopped | 25 g dates, chopped to eat
instructions: Add the peppers, chopped to eat mix, the mussels and dates together and grill on medium high. Serve with crusty bread or couscous, and some crusty bread.

title: Quick and Easy Cheesy Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cornflour | 1 cup marinara sauce or 1 cup chicken gravy
instructions: Add cornflour into saucepan and warm over gentle heat until cornflour is dissolved into sauce. Add gravy into mixture and whisk until sauce thickens.

Random Ingredients: vidalia onion,bean sprout,cooking spray,penne pasta,red chili,lime juice
title: Penne With Vietnamese Chili Dipping Sauce
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 lb penne pasta, cooked al dente | 1/2 medium vidalia onions, sliced thin | 1 can fat-free refried beans or ( 10 ounce ) can mixed beans ( 10 oz ) can fat-free refried beans | 1 large red chili, thinly sliced ( heat level specified on pasta box ) | 2 tablespoons lime juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Spray 9x7 baking dish with cooking spray. Put large pot of water on to boil for pasta. Meanwhile melt a little bit of the oil on medium low heat in a large nonstick skillet coated with cooking spray. Add the onion slices and cook until caramelized/tender. Drain on paper towels. In a large bowl, toss the hot drained penne pasta with the chili, lime juice, and 2 tbls. Of the oil. Transfer pasta to baking dish and spread with refried beans. Bake for about 25 minutes, until hot. Serve hot, with slices of red chile if desired.

title: Spinach Chips
ingredients: 8 toothpicks, each about 1 1/2 inches in diameter | 1 package baby kale ( about 8 cups total ) | 2 cloves, or more to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Wrap each toothpick in aluminum foil and place on wire rack. Bake in preheated oven until toothpicks are crispy, about 1 hour 20 minutes. Transfer toothpicks to a clean cloth covered plate and allow excess oil to drain off. Transfer cooked toothpicks to a serving bowl and cover tightly. Drain 1/2 cup oil from saucepan and add kale. Cook, covered, over medium heat, stirring occasionally with a wooden spoon and adding water if necessary, until kale is a glaze. Turn kale mixture into bowl and chill 8 minutes more to preserve crisp texture. Break up kale with hands or kitchen shears and add to kale and stir until kale is coated with the kale flavoring.

title: Accent-Free Seasoned Salt
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups kosher salt | 2 tablespoons coarse salt ( for salt rim )
instructions: Crush the salt into the salt with a mortar and pestle or the back of a spoon. Put into a small plastic bag large enough to make an opening in the salt. Add in the salt and shake to mix thoroughly. Refrigerate for 1 - 2 hours to let the salt release its brine. Then simply take out and use in your salt shaker.

Random Ingredients: black bean,braising steak,mango chutney,whipping cream,arborio rice,cooking tapioca
title: Mango and Baked Beef Rissoles
ingredients: 500 g braising steak | 400 g mango chutney | 125 ml whipping cream | 125 g quick-cooking tapioca | 125 g quick-cooking tapioca | 500 g arborio rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Grease a shallow, non stick, 2 3cm deep, ovenproof dish. Trim any excess fat from the steak. Place the steak in a large, shallow dish and pour over the mango chutney. Cover and marinade in the fridge for 2 hours, turning the meat once. Remove steak from marinade and pat dry. Preheat oven to 220c or gas mark 5, 230c if your convection ovens are fan forced. Line a baking tray with baking paper, then prick the base and sides lightly with a fork and place the steak on the tray. Bake until the meat comes away from the bone and starts to flake away from the bone and is cooked to your liking, about 30 to 35 minutes. Turn the steak over and bake for another 15 minutes. Remove steak from oven and allow to rest for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, combine the tapioca and tapioca in a bowl and season with salt. Set aside for 10 minutes or so. Meanwhile drain the rice and return the rice to a large bowl. Dice half the steak into 4cm pieces, then stir into the rice. Divide the rice between four individual, baking trays and then top each tray with 1/2 cup of the mango chutney. Cook one or two at a time, flipping each tray over if it becomes to dry and starts soggy. The rice should be crisp and lightly coloured, the chutney should be soft slightly crisp from the heat of the tapioca. Top with steak, drizzle with the mango chutney and serve.

Random Ingredients: red pepper,kaffir lime leaf,cornstarch,fish stock,pam cooking spray
title: Vietnamese Spicy Corn Chips
ingredients: 2 red peppers, halved lengthwise and seeded | 4 kaffir lime leaves | 1 tablespoon fish stock | 2 teaspoons cornstarch | pam cooking spray
instructions: Bring a pot of water to a boil and blanch the peppers. Remove from heat and drain. Place in a bowl of cold water until all the skin has loosened and then rinse. Peel and slice in half and set aside. Rinse and dry the lime leaves. Place a few kaffir leaves in a mortar. Add 1 tablespoon of fish stock and crushed kaffir lime leaves. Mix contents until well mixed. If it seems too dry add more fish stock. Fill a large bowl, cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes. To serve, remove the kaffir lime leaves from the water and then pat dry with paper towels. Take a kaffir lime leaf and roll it around a bit so that it sticks to the rolling pin. Transfer leaves to a plate when ready to make the cachun chips.

title: Pancakes With Chiles, Tomato and Grape Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups grape tomatoes or 1 1/2 cups cherry tomatoes, halved | 2 fresh green chilies, slit lengthwise | 2 cups double cream or 2 cups sour cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Place grape tomatoes in a bowl. Slit slit chiles lengthwise and place in bowl with tomatoes. Drizzle with cream or sour cream and sprinkle with chiles. Bake about 10 minutes or until topping is golden.

title: Pearl Onion Soup
ingredients: 4 cups frozen pearl onions | 1 can frozen limeade concentrate | 1 tablespoon minced fresh ginger root | 3 tablespoons horseradish, or to taste | 8 slices brioche bread, or to taste
instructions: Combine onion, limeade concentrate, ginger, and horseradish in a large saucepan.

Random Ingredients: ice cream,red pepper flake,passion fruit pulp,mace,tofu,chorizo sausage
title: Spicy Toad-in-the-Hole!
ingredients: 1/4 cup minced chorizo sausage or 1/4 cup breakfast sausage | 2 tablespoons diced firm tofu | 2 tablespoons chopped canned sweet red peppers or 2 tablespoons diced pimento-stuffed red peppers | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 1 package cream-style ice cream, softened | 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: In medium bowl, combine chorizo, tofu, peppers, mace, and ice cream. Spread cream mixture among 6 individual serving bowls. Sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes and remaining 1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes.

Random Ingredients: ice,chili pepper flake,napolitana spaghetti sauce,corn,white wine vinegar,turkey breast,french
title: Easy Chinese Tacos
ingredients: 1 lb ground turkey breast | 1 teaspoon hot pepper flakes ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons white wine vinegar | 4 cups napolitana spaghetti sauce, divided | corn, frozen, thawed, and microwaved in medium microwaveable dish on high for 10 seconds | french rolls, warmed | ice, for serving
instructions: In a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat, combine ground turkey, hot pepper flakes, vinegar, and 1 cup of spaghetti sauce or pasta water. Cook until turkey loses it pink color and is no longer pink inside. Using slotted spoon, remove turkey and set aside. Spoon remaining sauce over turkey and add corn. Heat through. While warming the sauce, place another pan on high heat, place a plate over the hot pan and turn it. Place about 1/2 cup of hot sauce in the pan, then dip rolls in the sauce and place on platter. Serve 1/4 cup of hot sauce on side of each plate.

title: Pomegranate Molasses Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb penne pasta | 1 cup pomegranate molasses | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar
instructions: Bring a pot of water to a boil. Cook penne pasta until al dente, about 4 minutes. Drain. While pasta water comes to a boil, combine pomegranate molasses and molasses mixture in glass baking dish.

title: Arancini Rice
ingredients: 4 cups arborio rice | 1 cup lite olive oil
instructions: In a large deep skillet, over medium heat, warm 1 cup of olive oil. Cook rice with 1 cup of olive oil over medium heat for a few minutes, or until the oil turns to a milky glaze. Stirring constantly. Cook for 1 minute and fluff rice with a fork.

title: Awesome  Mummy's Italian Carrot Rolls
ingredients: 1 box yellow cake mix | 2 1/3 cups grated baby carrots | 3 ounces tomato paste | 1 1/2 teaspoons tomato paste | 1 teaspoon gumbo allspice | 1 stalk celery, chopped | 1 dash ghee
instructions: Cook yellow cake mix according to package directions. Cool to room temperature. While cake mixes, prepare carrot puree by placing carrots in a blender.

title: Seed Tortillas
ingredients: 1 cup whole-wheat flour | 1/3 cup red pepper flakes, or more to taste
instructions: Whisk flour and red pepper flakes together in a bowl. Form flour mixture into a ball.

title: African Peanut Chicken Dip
ingredients: 1 container fat-free creamy peanut butter | 1 1/2 cups nonfat milk | salsa, for garnish, your favorite recipe ( i like jasmine )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Mix all ingredients in a medium sized bowl and mix thoroughly. Transfer mixture to a medium sized shallow baking dish or small casserole dish large enough to hold dip. Bake 10 - 15 minutes, or until hot. Serve with salsa.

Random Ingredients: pearl barley,golden raisin,graham cracker crumb,rhubarb,chicken stock cube,romaine lettuce
title: Rhubarb Barley  Salad
ingredients: 1 cup pearl barley | 8 ounces rhubarb, diced into chunks | 1/3 cup gold raisins | 1 chicken stock cube | 1 tablespoon graham cracker crumbs | 1 romaine lettuce, finely chopped
instructions: Place barley in a bowl. Add rhubarb, golden raisins, chicken stock cube, graham cracker crumbs and chopped romaine, mixing thoroughly. Serve in lettuce bowls along with fruit or milk.

title: Choy Sum Chips (Goya)
ingredients: 600 g choy sum | 1 -2 teaspoon mustard powder
instructions: Cut off a half inch of the green or white part of the choy sum and cut away the root part at the stem. Rinse and dry the choy sum. Tear off the root part and cut off the remainder. Using a very sharp knife make thin slices about 1 cm diameter. Dip the choy sum into the dry mustard powder and arrange them on a rack in a colander. Place the colander over boiling water to collect the excess oil. When the oil starts to form a golden color, reduce heat to low and simmer about 10 minutes or until the excess liquid is absorbed and the mixture becomes aromatic. Remove from stove and set aside to cool. After the choy sum chips have cooled, store in an airtight container for up to 2 weeks.

title: Potted Pork Aubergine
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless pork roast ( from shoulder roast cut into 1-inch cubes ) | 1 package no-salt-added frozen biscuits | 1 1/2 cups dried small macaroni | 2 tablespoons instant espresso | 1 teaspoon dried sage
instructions: Prepare biscuit dough by combining dry macaroni and instant espresso powder, in a 4 quart bowl. Add dry spices and sage. Add pork and mix well. Line a large, rimmed baking sheet with plastic wrap. Sprinkle top with dry ingredients and press the edges of plastic onto the prepared baking sheet to prevent a large air bubbles from forming.. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Remove pork from refrigerator, discard plastic wrap and sprinkle top of dough with additional dry ingredients if desired. Place on prepared baking sheet and bake 25 to 30 minutes or until top is golden brown. Place pork on platter and let it rest 10 minutes before slicing.

Random Ingredients: yellow squash,vanilla extract,graham cracker crumb,liquid smoke,tuna steak
title: Crock Pot Tuna Steaks with Yellow Squash
ingredients: 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs or 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs | 8 ounces tuna steaks, trimmed with sides | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 dash liquid smoke | 1 yellow squash or 2 cups red squash, sliced
instructions: Put cracker crumbs in a mixing bowl. Dredge tuna in the crumb mixture. In a 4 1/2 quart slow cooker, arrange tuna steaks in a single layer. Sprinkle evenly with vanilla extract. Pour enough boiling water over tuna to just cover and stir. Cook on high setting for 5 hours. Remove tuna steaks and drain excess liquid. Slice remaining vegetables. Serve in bowl alongside tuna and vegetables.

title: Oaty Oyster Casserole
ingredients: 1 package mixed firm-shell mussels | 5 tablespoons rolled oats | 1/2 cup currants | 1/3 cup apple sauce | 4 tablespoons vegetarian cheese ( daiya korma ) | 1/3 cup heavy cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Steam the mussels in boiling water for about 5 to 8 minutes, or until they open. Rinse mussels under cold water, split open and discard any shells that do not open. Rinse and dry the opened ones, and mix them with the oatyogurt and currants in a 2l baking dish. Spoon about half of the apple sauce around the mixture in the baking dish. Cover and bake 40 to 45 minutes. Top with cheese and continue baking until cheese is melted, about 5 minutes. Watch the cheese for bubbling up while baking if it does, just sprinkle with salt at the table.

title: Veal (Filling Only)
ingredients: 2 lbs thick veal | 2 lbs ground veal | 1 lb ground veal ( or 1 lb ground sirloin )
instructions: Wash and dry meat. Put ground meats, and saute thoroughly with a little oil stirring until they are browned, which should take about 3 minutes. Turn off heat and keep in the closed container. Meat should be moist. Keep in refrigerator 2 weeks, then remove. You can use this stuffing for a filling for sandwiches, roast chicken or pork. Use 1/2 lb ground veal for meat, etc, while filling and shaping other meats.
