ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat, lean | 2 cans mandarin oranges | 1/2 cup corn syrup | 1/3 cup light corn syrup | 1/4 cup liquid smoke | 8 slices white bread ( or toasted baguette slices )
instructions: Mix stew meat, oranges, 1/4 cup of corn syrup, and liquid smoke in crock pot. Cover crockpot with lid and cook on high setting 4 - 6 hours.

Random Ingredients: egg beater substitute,white sugar,mushroom soup,ketjap manis,taco seasoning
title: Egg Drop Soup
ingredients: 1 can condensed mushroom soup | 6 egg whites/4 cup tater tots ( or 1 egg, if desired ) | 1 tablespoon instant minced mushroom soup | 1/4 cup white sugar | 1 tablespoon ketchap manis
instructions: Put the soups in a bowl. Add the rest of the ingredients except paprika or tater tots and mix. If you want paprika, then add it when you mix. If not, add just 1 tbsp. At a time. If you want it less salty, add the taters during the last few minutes of mixing. Use a tooth pick to scrape the mixture out of the bowl and stir. The soup should have a consistency of soupy consistency if it is sloppy, it may need more condensed soup. It will thicken as it cools.

Random Ingredients: phyllo pastry,sesame oil,sharp cheddar cheese,dark chocolate,dill,purpose white flour,currant
title: Cheese and Dill Phyllo Fritters
ingredients: 12 ounces all-purpose white flour | 1 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh dill or 1 tablespoon dried dill | 1 teaspoon sesame oil | 12 ounces dark chocolate, chopped | 18 ounces frozen chopped spinach - thawed and drained | 9 ounces phyllo pastry
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Whisk flour, cheese, dill and sesame oil in a bowl large enough to hold all ingredients together until well blended. Add chocolate and spinach and stir until well coated. Place one sheet of phyllo pastry on lightly floured surface. Spread 1 tablespoon of filling along centre of phyllo pastry, leaving a 1/2 inch border at edges. Spread 1/2 of the filling over the phyllo, using slightly larger border as necessary. Repeat filling and phyllo layers, placing each in the center of the pastry. Gently press edges together to seal. Cut each fritter into 2 inch wide strips and place on baking sheets sprayed with cooking spray. Bake until phyllo pastry is golden brown and filling has set, about 12 minutes. Cut fritters diagonally into 3 or 4 wedges and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: tuna water,soy sauce,green enchilada sauce,brandy,dark raisin,cooking spray,vanilla extract,scallop
title: Tuna or Seafood Enchiladas With Brandy and Raisins
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 package sliced fresh scallops or ( 8 ounce ) package imitation crab scallops | 1 can tuna in water, drained and flaked | 2 teaspoons soy sauce | 2 tablespoons brandy ( such as kahlua ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 can red green enchilada sauce | 1/4 cup light-colored soy sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f spray an 11x7 baking dish with cooking spray. In a large bowl, mix together the scallops, tuna, brandy, vanilla, and green sauce and stir in the soymilk until smooth. Spoon about 2 tablespoons of the filling mixture into the baking dish, then spread evenly with a spatula to cover the filling. Repeat layering of filling and filling, using remaining filling mixture and filling as your last layers. Sprinkle with soy sauce and bake, uncovered, for about 50 minutes or until topping is golden brown and bubbly.

title: Creamy Spiced Lamb Ribs
ingredients: 2 cups sour cream | 3 tablespoons chili-garlic infused cumin | 2 tablespoons cornstarch roux | 1 tablespoon dried mixed spice | 2 lbs meaty pork spareribs | 8 lamb, bone-in | 8 lamb fat or 8 pork spareribs | 8 spaghetti
instructions: The night before, mix sour cream, chili garlis cumin & cornstarch in a shallow dish. Add a few shakes of mixed spice. Add the meat & set aside. In the morning, bone your lamb, lamb & spare ribs and toss in your mixed spice. Heat oven to 400f degrees. Wrap 1/2 cup of the sour cream mixture with foil, and place on a foil lined baking dish. Smear & pierce the top of your meat with a fork & place in the oven. Bake for 35 minutes then remove from oven & set on another plate. Leave in oven until desired doneness. Turn out the meat & allow to sit for 30 mins at least. Serve over your spaghetti.

Random Ingredients: bow tie pasta,green cardamom pod,sauce,tuna steak,lemon peel,cinnamon sugar
title: Tuna Kebabs with Spicy Bowties
ingredients: 2 lbs tuna steaks | 3/4 cup hot sauce | 1/4 cup lemon peel, grated | 1 tablespoon cinnamon sugar | 1 teaspoon green cardamom pods | 2 lbs bow tie pasta
instructions: Cut fish into 1/2 inch cubes. Place in zip bags, 1/4 cup hot sauce, lemon peel, cinnamon, and sugar. Close and refrigerate 6 - 8 hours, turning occasionally. Drain tuna and add to marinade. Marinate in refrigerator up to 4 hours or overnight, turning bag occasionally if desired. Combine pasta and remaining hot sauce and grill to desired doneness about 10 minutes per side. Serve with sauce.

title: Roast Beef Veal
ingredients: 5 lbs boneless round roast ( preferably a mix of round and sirloin ) | 1 cup dry white wine
instructions: Cut the roast into 3 pieces. Layer the meat in a crockpot. Sprinkle with the wine over the top. Submerge the crockpot liner in the refrigerator to help it dry out. The roast will need to sit for 4 hours in the crockpot. Preheat the oven to 300 f. Transfer the roast to the hot braising pan or grill. Cover with foil, and braise the roast for 4 hours at 300°f, or in the pan at 300°f in the oven. Discard the foil.

title: Chile Cream Cheese (Or Cheese)
ingredients: 1 cup gruyere cheese, grated or 1 cup swiss cheese | 2 ounces serrano chili peppers | whipped cream
instructions: Combine all ingredients, stirring well. Whip until smooth and set aside in refrigerator for at least 1/2 hour before serving. Keeps indefinitely.

title: Low-Fat Crab Covered Shrimp on a Baked Brisket
ingredients: 1/2 lb uncooked small shrimp ( or equivalent shrimp ) | 3 -4 tablespoons plain nonfat yogurt ( can be found as a substitute ) | 3 -4 tablespoons crabmeat ( optional ) or 3 -4 tablespoons imitation crabmeat, drained ( optional ) | 1 quart water
instructions: In a large bowl stir together the shrimp, yogurt, crabmeat, or crab meat, if using. Pour on top of shrimp mixture. Add enough water to just cover the shrimp. Put cover on the bowl and let it sit for at least an hour, preferably overnight. Remove shrimp mixture from bowl and place on a covered plate. Microwave approximately 30 seconds to 1 minute or until the cheese is melted.

title: Red Cabbage With Bacon
ingredients: 1 small red cabbage | 200 g smoked ham | 4 tablespoons coconut oil | red chili paste
instructions: Wash and dry the cabbage. Slice the cabbage into thin strips about 2 inches long. Cut the ham into thin slices 5 mm wide by 4 cm long. Heat the coconut oil in a pot until smoking. Add the red chili paste and stir fry for 1 minute. Add cabbage and continue to stir and fry for 25 to 60 seconds. Toss in the ham slices and heat through.

title: French Onion Salad - Jamie Oliver
ingredients: 1 large yellow onion | 1/2 teaspoon thyme | 1/4 teaspoon accent seasoning | 200 g gruyere cheese, grated | 1 -2 tablespoon pure vanilla essence
instructions: Cut the ends off the onion. Cut peel in half and remove hard core. With scissors cut out the core carefully, so all the vegetables stay together.. Slice the root to expose about 2/3 of the core, if it is in a v shape you can use a sharp knife to slice in a v around the root. Remove all the outer layers and the white part and place inside a small ovenproof bowl. Sprinkle the onion with thyme essence mix the oregano into the mixture and pour the mixture over the onion. Add grated swiss gruyere and cover with a cloth or aluminum foil, then leave in a warm place while preparing other ingredients for the salad. After 2 hours pour the liquid from the bowl into a small pot, bring to a boil and then remove the pot from the burner. Now place your straining apparatus, cutting through the onion with scissors through the onion to create fine, manageable sized fingers and kitchen shears. Place in the bowl and allow to cool. Cut in small bits and use as required on the bread before serving. Serve with thick slices of french bread.

Random Ingredients: orange zest,chipotle pepper,chicken cutlet,vanilla sugar,baby bok choy,cumin seed,pork loin chop,amaretto
title: Orange Pork Chops With Sweetened Chile
ingredients: 4 tablespoons a good-quality amaretto ( the orange liqueur ) or 4 tablespoons vanilla sugar | 1 tablespoon vanilla sugar | 1 tablespoon coarsely ground cumin seed | 4 pork loin chops | 4 baby bok choy, chopped | 4 orange zest ( the zest of 4 oranges ) | 2 dried chipotle peppers | 1 tablespoon amaretto
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the sugar, 1 tablespoon of vanilla sugar and the cumin seeds. Place the pork chops in a plastic bag with the the marinade and turn to coat. Let sit for 5 minutes if using, and then transfer the pork to an oven proof dish or on a sheet pan. In a small skillet, toast the bok choy until just fragrant, and add to the baking dish at the side. Bake for approximately 10 minutes. Then remove the pan from the oven and pour in the a bit of amaretto and a bit of water to deglaze, then place under a grill until brown. Remove the pan from the grill and place on a clean, dry towel with paper towels. Sprinkle with the remaining teaspoon of vanilla sugar and a bit of cumin. Drizzle with a bit of a bit of amaretto. Serve the pork chops hot with the chile sauce.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach,taco seasoning mix,italian seasoning,head cabbage,heavy whipping cream,escarole
title: Mom's Escarole and Spinach
ingredients: 2 heads cabbage | 1 bag baby spinach | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 tablespoon heavy whipping cream | 1 envelope taco seasoning mix | 1 head cabbage, sliced in thin wedges | 1 head escarole, sliced
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f. Place 1 pound of cabbage in the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Place 3 cups of baby spinach in the pot. Toss with 1 package taco seasoning and 1 tablespoon cream. Sprinkle 1 package of taco seasoning over the greens and repeat layering. Pour 1 cup of heavy whipping cream over the top of the casserole. Cover and bake in preheated oven for 30 to 35 minutes, until tender. Top with the remaining 2 cups of cabbage and recover. Bake for an additional 15 minutes to finish cooking.

Random Ingredients: tortilla,egg noodle,ranch dressing,almond extract,red potato,sun tomato oil,onion soup mix,apple juice
title: Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 package egg noodles | 1 package ranch dressing | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1 package dried onion soup mix | 1/2 cup apple juice | 1 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, chopped | 1 apple, diced | 1 cup red potatoes, cubed
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook pasta for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: pork loin chop,sherry wine,milk,madras curry powder,lemon zest,apricot preserve
title: Apricot Pork Chops
ingredients: 2 teaspoons madras curry powder | 1 1/4 lbs pork loin chops, thick trimmed | 1 jar apricot preserves | 12 tablespoons sherry wine, divided | 1 teaspoon lemon zest, grated | 1/3 cup skim milk
instructions: Coat grill with nonstick spray. Sprinkle pork with curry powder. Grill pork, turning once, 1 minute. Add preserves, 2 t sherry, lemon zest, and milk. Cover and cook 4 to 6 minutes, or until chops are done. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: andouille sausage link,ice,beef mince,jalapeno,black peppercorn,puff pastry,sriracha sauce
title: Sausage & Pepper Steak Tart
ingredients: 4 beef mince | 4 jalapenos, halved and seeded | 1 lb andouille sausage links, sliced 1/2 inch thick | ice | 1 frozen puff pastry | 1 cup sriracha sauce ( to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon cracked black peppercorns
instructions: Place mince on a clean surface and pat down with your hands to flatten it out to a thick round shape. Heat a large nonstick frypan over medium high heat. Add the jalapeños and sausages and cook, breaking them into rough pieces as they cook, until cooked through. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the sausages and jalapeños to a bowl. Allow them to cool slightly. Peel off the ends of the puff pastry sheets then remove the pastry leaves. Working with one sheet at a time, place the pastry on a clean, dry surface and lay another sheet directly on top. Repeat this process until all the sheets are used. Place the frozen puff pastry on a baking sheet with the long edge nearest you and then divide the pastry sheets into 4 parts, total filling 1 part. Roll out a small portion of the pastry to a circle that will approximate about 17 x 11 inch. Carefully transfer the pastry circle to the pan with the sausage and beef mince. Sprinkle with black pepper to taste. Top with the remaining pastry and cut steam vents in the pastry to allow steam to escape. Top with sriracha sauce and bake in 400 degree oven for 25 - 30 minutes until the pastry is puffed. Remove from oven and serve at once.

Random Ingredients: corn tortilla chip,seasoning salt,wine vinegar,pecorino romano cheese
title: Pecorino Ranchero Chips
ingredients: 1 pint pecorino romano cheese, shredded ( or parmesan ) | 1 pint corn tortilla chips, coarsely crushed ( about 11 oz. ) | 1 cup wine vinegar | 5 teaspoons seasoning salt
instructions: Combine well. Toss with salt. Serve immediately.

title: Potted Hazelnut Balls
ingredients: 3 cups hazelnuts, skinned ( about 10 hazelnuts ) | 2 cups pace picante sauce ( mild, medium, hot or your favorite store brand ) | 1/2 cup white sugar | 1 tablespoon white peppercorns, cracked ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325°f line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Toast the hazelnuts in the oven, shaking them occasionally, until the skin is very dark about 10 minutes. Let cool. Place the hazelnuts in a clean kitchen towel and rub it off. Place remaining nuts in a food processor and process until coarsely chopped. Combine all the ingredients together in a medium bowl, except the hazelnuts, and mix well. If the mixture is wet, add more of the hazelnut mixture and process again. Fill the hazelnut mixture into the prepared baking sheet, spacing them slightly apart, and place them in the oven. Bake the hazelnut balls until they have turned a light golden color, about 25 to 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: meat,blackberry,lime wedge,garlic clove,rosemary,rye flour,dripping,dark brown sugar
title: Maurice's Irish Rye Batter
ingredients: 450 g frozen meat, thawed | 2 fresh rosemary | 1 garlic clove, crushed | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 1 tablespoon coarsely chopped fresh rosemary | 60 g unsalted drippings | 2 tablespoons ground blackberry ( fresh or frozen ) | 1 lime wedge | 3 tablespoons rye flour
instructions: Place the thawed frozen meat into the work bowl of a food processor. Add the rosemary and garlic, then the sugar and mix well, then add the rosemary and continue processing until the mixture forms a thick paste. If the mixture is too sticky to your hands, you can sprinkle in the extra sugar a tablespoon at a time. Add just enough of the blackberry and mash with your fingers. You don’t need to knead or mix it all together. Place the dripping in a flat fry pan. When hot, add about half a tablespoon of the rye flour from a jar and cook over medium to medium high heat until the mixture turns a tan amber colour, stirring every now and then. Transfer the browned mixture to a mixing bowl to cool slightly. When the fat has cooled and turned an even 1/4 – 1/2ï¿½ coin size, add the remainder of the rye flour and beat into the batter with a wooden spoon. You should be able to form small, round balls out of the batter. This mixture makes about 6 - 1½ inch balls. Transfer the balls with 1 1/2½ tablespoons of the rye batter onto a tray lined with baking parchment or greaseproof paper. Preheat the oven to 200°c and set the tray in a baking dish lined with baking paper or a baking brick. You will need to bake them for around 20 to 25 minutes until golden outside. Meanwhile, warm up the grill or grill pan. Remove the sage sprigs and place on the tray. Cut any lumps from the frozen meat and transfer to a bowl. Stir through the ground blackberry, then sprinkle with the lime juice. Serve the meat with the cooked sprigs and the blackberry and lime salsa. A simple but equally attractive dipping option would be to serve with lemon wedges. Note, if you are using olives or other oil, use a combination of olive and lemon oils rather than the coarsely chopped oils.

Random Ingredients: vegetable broth,cider vinegar,rye bread,cocoa powder,chili paste,chipotle pepper adobo sauce
title: Hot Chocolate French Toast II
ingredients: 8 thin slices rye bread | 1 can reduced sodium vegetable broth, undiluted | 2 teaspoons chili paste, or more as needed | 1 chipotle pepper in adobo sauce, finely chopped, or to taste | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar, or more to taste | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa powder
instructions: Prepare a skillet by heating it over medium heat. Place rye bread into the hot skillet. Cook in the hot skillet until the rye bread gets browned, 2 to 3 minutes per side. Heat vegetable broth to boiling in a saucepan over medium heat. Stir chili paste into hot broth.

Random Ingredients: salmon,green bell pepper,coriander,swiss cheese,prawn,cashew,tuna olive oil
title: Prawn and Tuna Fish Cakes
ingredients: 400 g raw prawns | 200 g salmon, skin removed | 150 g swiss cheese, thinly sliced | 3 tablespoons coriander, chopped | 100 g cashews, coarsely chopped | 1 green bell pepper, sliced | 200 g tuna in olive oil, drained and flaked
instructions: Boil the prawns in water for 2 - 4 minutes, or until half cooked, then drain. Blend the prawns with all the ingredients except the tuna and cashews. Shape mixture into 4 patties, each weighing about 2 oz each. Cook on the grill, basting with oil, until golden, 3 - 5 minutes each side. Serve with a salad and couscous.

Random Ingredients: clove,spicy pork sausage,mayonnaise,rice noodle,chocolate,spring onion,maraschino cherry,white bean
title: American Rice Nests With Sausage and White Beans
ingredients: 1 link spicy pork sausage | 1 package dried rice noodles | 2 cans white beans, drained and rinsed | 6 -8 spring onions | 1/4 cup mayonnaise | 2 ounces chopped chocolate | chocolate piece, to decorate ( optional ) | 3 -4 maraschino cherries, to decorate ( optional )
instructions: Cut the sausage link into 1/2 inch strips, remove all but about 1/3 inch of the fat from the meat. Slice the pork sausage into 2 inch strips and set aside. Cook the noodles according to package directions. Drain. In a medium bowl, combine beans, spring onions, mayonnaise, chocolate powder, and sausage strips. When noodles are done, drain and rinse the noodles, removing as much grease as possible. Place noodles in a bowl with sauce. Pour hot noodles onto bowl, add the sausage and bean mixture, and toss well. Transfer to an open serving platter, and decorate with some chocolate, candied cherries, or chocolate curls.

title: Easy Lasagna Rollups
ingredients: 4 -6 lasagna noodles | 1 can small meatballs | 1 can refried beans | 1/3 cup sherry wine vinegar | parsley or chives
instructions: Cook the lasagna noodles. If your lasagna noodles have not already cooked, place in a plastic bag while still hot. Once done, remove from bag and rinse with cold water. Drain well, and then put in a medium sized bowl. Spread the refried beans evenly over the base of a 10x13x2 inch baking dish. Top with meatballs and cover with lasagna noodles. Spread sherry vinegar over the noodles, and then sprinkle with parsley or chives. Bake uncovered at 350 degrees for 30 to 45 minutes, or until hot and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,garlic scape,pork shoulder,beef stew meat
title: Scape-Grilled Caribbean Pork
ingredients: 2 boneless pork shoulder, trimmed and cut into chunks | vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 pounds garlic scapes, sliced | 2 pounds beef stew meat, trimmed and cut into chunks
instructions: Preheat the grill for direct heat. Lightly coat the grate with vegetable oil spray. Place the pork in the center of the grill. Grill for 6 to 8 minutes or until a digital thermometer reads 160 degrees f, turning once. Place the scapes on top of the pork about two minutes before the end of the grilling time. Grill the scapes for one to two minutes. Turn, squeeze on the scapes, and let cool for five minutes. While still warm, cut the pork into bite size pieces. Transfer to a serving platter and garnish with the scapes.

Random Ingredients: red pepper,potato,pork loin roast,manicotti,lime,celery salt,ice,flat leaf parsley
title: Lime Pork Baked in Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 2 medium potatoes, peeled | 1 medium red pepper, diced | 1 teaspoon celery salt | 1 fresh lime, juice and zest of, zested | 1 tablespoon fresh flat-leaf parsley, chopped | 1 boneless pork loin roast, trimmed of fat and cut across the grain into 1-inch pieces | 3 -4 tablespoons manicotti, cooked | ice, crushed
instructions: Boil the potatoes with the diced pepper and celery salt to cover for 20 minutes, until they are tender. Drain and cool. In a medium bowl mash together the lime zest, parsley, and pork. Fill the pork mixture with the potatoes and add the manicotti, tossing gently. Sprinkle with crushed ice. To serve place on a plate, drizzle with a little more lime juice, if wanted.

Random Ingredients: tomato sauce,arborio rice,beef tenderloin,parsley,grain rice,oregano,lasagna noodle,cornflour
title: Frikadelli
ingredients: 500 g beef tenderloin | 1 1/4 cups arborio rice | 1 1/4 cups long grain rice ( arborio or carnaroli preferred ) | 1 1/4 cups tomato sauce ( homemade or prepared ) | 1 teaspoon cornflour | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano ( i omit the dried ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried parsley | 3 sheets lasagna noodles ( i prefer the small flat kind or 1 medium size )
instructions: Cut beef into strips, about 1 inch long x 2 inches. Dice parsley or add a few drops of oil to a large pot on the stove. In a bowl, mix the tomato sauce and cornflour, and then set aside to get cold. Add rice, beef, and herbs to bowl, and stir to coat everything with the sauce. Heat a little oil in a frying pan, or a wok, and fry the strips for 3 - 5 minutes or so, until they are firm and cooked through. Set aside. In a large pot of boiling water, cook lasagna for 5 - 6 minutes or so, then drain and place back into the pot. Put a few tbsp of oil back in the pan, and fry the arborio rice for 1 - 2 minutes, until it starts to colour. Add the tomato sauce and stir to coat everything with tomato sauce. Bring to a boil, then lower heat and simmer for 15 minutes or until absorbed. Serve and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,beef stew meat,orange blossom water,egg substitute
title: Moroccan Beef Kabobs (Carao)
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat, cut into cubes 1 inch x 1/4 inch | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 1/2 cup egg substitute, yolk only | 1 cup orange blossom water
instructions: Mix the beef, bouillon, egg replacer and orange blossom water together until well mixed. Thread skewers alternating with cubes of beef. Broil over medium heat basting frequently with orange blossom water. Cook 7 to 10 minutes or until beef is browned and cooked through.

title: Grandma Ruth's Irish Friendship Cake
ingredients: 3 medium baking potatoes | 1 can mixed vegetables | 1 can maraschino cherries | 3/4 cup ketchup | 20 ounces crushed tomatoes | 1/4 cup red wine | 1/2 cup tea | 2 tablespoons chopped maraschino cherries | 1/4 cup chopped green olives | 1 cup miniature marshmallows
instructions: Wash potatoes and cut in half. Bake potatoes in oven at 425 for 45 minutes. Cool and cut into quarters. Place mixed vegetables in a large bowl. Add drained potatoes, cherries, ketchup, tomatoes, wine and tea. Stir until well combined. Place in a greased angel food cake pan. Sprinkle with cherries and chopped olives. Place pan on cookie sheet and bake at 450 for 15 minutes or until top is golden brown. Remove from pan and cool 1 minute. Remove cake from pan and cool completely. Cover with foil for storage. Can store at room temperature up to 3 months. To serve, heat syrup over medium heat until warm. Remove from heat and stir well. Pour warm syrup over cake and garnish with cherry and cherries.

Random Ingredients: gouda cheese,bay scallop,pear,confectioner ' sugar,curd cottage cheese,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Alfaze Scallops over Pierogi
ingredients: 1 cup small curd cottage cheese | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 2 tablespoons grated sharp smoked gouda cheese | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 bay scallops or 2 green scallops, cooked and sliced | 1 pear, peeled and sliced thin
instructions: Mix cottage cheese and confectioners' sugar together and set aside. Coat a hot saucer with vegetable oil and place the scallops on it. Place 1 tablespoon cheese mixture on top of an scallop. Place a second scallop on top of the first scallop and press together a little. Place the scallops on a hot plate, and drizzle each one with a little melted cottage mixture. Top with a slice of pear and a slice of scallop.

Random Ingredients: egg,snow pea,chocolate,thai chile,baby spinach leaf,graham cracker crumb,green chili,kale
title: Grain free Crunchy Kale Chips!
ingredients: 2 ounces unsweetened chocolate ( i used good quality semi sweet ) | 1 cup fresh baby spinach leaves, coarsely chopped | 1 cup fresh snow peas, sliced | 2 tablespoons thai chilies, chopped | 4 small cups of prepared graham cracker crumbs | 1/2 cup green chili, chopped finely | 4 ounces fresh egg, lightly beaten | 2 ounces chinese-style bittersweet chocolate ( i used good quality semi sweet ) | 2 teaspoons green chili, chopped finely | 3/4 cup fresh kale, chopped ( or coarsely chopped/chopped )
instructions: Set oven rack to middle position. Spray 12 cup muffin tin with cooking spray, set aside. Place 2 oz of chocolates in small bowl. Microwave spinach, snow peas and chilies on medium high 2 minutes or until hot. Stir until well combined. Combine chocolate, crumbs, and green chiles in medium bowl and stir well. Add eggs and mix well. Add the spinach mixture and cholates and mix well. Line muffin tin with parchment paper and fill cup 1/2 full with chips. Bake 10 to 12 minutes, until well browned. Let cool on wire rack. Remove parchment paper and let cool completely. Dust with powdered sugar, sesame seed, chopped green onions, etc.

title: Aussie Blueberry Appy
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs blueberries, fresh | 1/2 cup bamboo shoot, sliced | 2 scallions, sliced | cooking spray, as needed
instructions: Combine the blueberries, bamboo shoots, scallions and seasoning in a bowl. Cover and refrigerate 30 minutes or longer until well chilled. Cook over medium hot coals about 5 minutes or until edges are slightly charred. Remove and serve.

title: Quick 'n' Easy Beans
ingredients: 1 can baked beans | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh thyme leaves
instructions: Empty both cans of beans and thyme into a large skillet. Bring to a boil over high heat, then turn heat down to medium low, cover.

title: Punjab Style Paneer(Paneer)
ingredients: 2 lbs cauliflower, cut into small florets | 1/2 teaspoon saffron | 3 dozen fenugreek leaves | 2 scallions, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon powdered saffron
instructions: Place cauliflower in a medium saucepan full of cold water. Bring to a boil, cover and simmer until just tender, about 8 minutes. Drain and set aside to cool. Bring a medium saucepan of water to a boil and add the saffron. Boil until the saffron is browned and the fragrant strands of saffron are released, about 5 minutes. Drain. Remove from heat and transfer ½ the cauliflower to a large mixing bowl. Toss with a hand blender in enough cold water to cover. Blend in the remaining cauliflower. Set aside for 1 hour. Meanwhile, heat a nonstick skillet over medium heat, add saffron. Stir in 2­ 3­ tablespoons of the cauliflower mixture and the scallions. Add the remaining cauliflower. Cook and stir until the cauliflower is al dente, about 8 minutes. Transfer to a large serving dish and sprinkle with the saffron.

title: Spinach With Pepper & Saffron
ingredients: 450 g fresh spinach | 3/4 cup bulgur wheat | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried mixed herbs | 2/3 teaspoon saffron thread | 1 red capsicums or 1 green capsicum, thinly sliced
instructions: Place spinach, bulgur, herbs and saffron in a large bowl. Add a good twist of lime or lemon juice and cover. For best results, leave sit for an hour or two at room temperature before rolling out. Once rolled all the ingredients, cut each in half and place on a greased griddle or roasting pan with the lid slightly ajar to prevent sticking bake in a preheated oven at 170c for about 45 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Lime Green Beans
ingredients: 2 lbs green beans, blanched and peeled | 6 large limes ( i've had other limes too )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a non metallic bowl. Marinate several hours, mixing occasionally. Garnish with coriander.

Random Ingredients: water,white flour,bay leaf,red onion,apricot half,leek,lamb shoulder
title: Dumpling Braid (Posh)
ingredients: 1 large red onion, peeled, halved | 6 bay leaves | 1 leek, halved | 1/2 lb boneless lamb shoulder, cut into chunks | 2 cups white flour | 2 1/2 cups coarsely chopped dried apricot halves | 1/2 cup water
instructions: Cut the onion and bay leaves into very thin slices. Trim the leek, and cut crosswise into 1 inch rounds. Put into large bowl with the lamb, adding the flour and 1 1/2 cups of water. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Preheat oven to 190°c. Lightly oil a deep ovenproof dish, place the flour in a pile on a chopping board. Tear off a handful of the roughly chopped walnut pieces, and put into the bowl with the flour. Working with a handful at a time, work all the flour through the bowl with a large spoon to make a thick dough. Roll out the dough on a lightly floured surface quickly and evenly into a rectangle about 1/2 inch thick. Put the lamb pieces inside the rectangle. Sprinkle with the onions and bay leaves. Place in the oven and bake for around 1 hour, or until golden and cooked. Let cool. Release the meat from the oven and arrange the ham on top. Return to the oven for further 10 minutes or until the ham is browned all over. You want to fry it slowly, so make sure it doesn't stick to the outside. You can also slice into strips and serve with plain boiled or mashed potatoes.

title: Spicy Tacos
ingredients: 1 package taco shell | 2 teaspoons caraway seeds | freshly ground mustard ( optional )
instructions: Preheat grill to high. Brush taco shells with oil and lightly sprinkle with caraway seeds. Place on grill and lightly char with a fork. Serve in taco shells with desired condiments.

Random Ingredients: club soda,romaine lettuce leaf,celery salt,pie shell,beef chuck,horseradish sauce,coconut flake
title: Beef Coconut Nachos #5FIX
ingredients: 1/2 lb lean ground beef chuck | 1 teaspoon horseradish sauce | 2 cups club soda | 1/4 cup shredded light coconut flakes or 1/4 cup shredded dark coconut | 1/4 teaspoon celery salt | 1 package refrigerated pie shells | 6 romaine lettuce leaves, cut into thin wedges
instructions: Brown ground beef, add horseradish sauce, and club soda. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Combine coconut and celery salt and sprinkle over beef mixture. Top with plastic wrap and plastic wrap again and microwave on medium for 10 - 12 minutes, until coconut flakes and liquid start to form. Stir and microwave for a further 2 - 3 minutes until cheese is melted. Prepare the crust according to package directions, and cool in refrigerator for 4 - 5 minutes. Set aside. Slice pie crust into wedges.

title: French Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf ( sandwich size ) sweet bread, such as pumpernickel or white or wheat bread, cut 1 inch thick | 4 fluid ounces salad oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°f. Place bread, cut side down, on a flat baking sheet. Mix the oil and spread over the bread. Turn over and spread remaining oil. Bake for 50 to 60 minutes, until crisp and golden.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke,pork tenderloin,chili pepper flake,cream,cooking oat
title: Spicy Maple Beef & Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 -2 1 lb pork tenderloin | 1/2 cup quick-cooking oats | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke | 1/4 - 1/3 cup sour cream | 1 dash dried chili pepper flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Score tenderloins in a few places with tip of a small knife. Place tenderloins in a shallow baking pan with just enough room around them to ensure thorough soaking. Bake for about 1 hour, until internal temperature reaches 160 degrees f and internal temperature reaches 170 degrees f and juices run clear. Cut thermometer for you meat, as you prefer. After removing from the oven, allow to cool for 5 minutes. Remove meat from bones and slice against the grain. Use as you would any favorite style sliceable meat, or use what is your favorite for a meaty version.

title: Tamari Soup
ingredients: 500 g tamari | 4 tablespoons chicken bouillon granules | 1 1/2 liters beef stock
instructions: Blend the tamari paste in a blender with 2tbs of stock. Add the tamari paste to the beef stock and bring to boil. Simmer for 10 minutes, stirring regularly to avoid burning.

title: Roasted Shrimp by Sy
ingredients: 32 large fresh poblano chiles | 12 large shrimp, peeled and deveined
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. Line a medium baking sheet with foil. Place chiles on the baking sheet. Bake on the middle rack of the oven until blackened in spots and slightly charred, about 10 minutes per side. Transfer chiles to a bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and let steam as they cool, about 30 minutes. Transfer chiles to a plastic resealable bag, seal, and refrigerate overnight. When the chiles are completely cool, peel the seeds and roughly chop them. Set aside. Place poblanos on a clean kitchen towel and lightly pat dry with a paper towel. Place a baking sheet on the oven rack. Place a shrimp on one of the chiles. Arrange poblanos on the poblanos on the prepared baking sheet. Roast shrimp in the preheated oven until poblanos are tender and shrimp are pink in the center, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: caster sugar,broccoli floret,salmon,water chestnut,picante sauce,heavy cream,rutabaga
title: Salmon and Broccoli With Picante Syrup
ingredients: 3 tablespoons picante sauce ( preferably with tomato passata ) | 350 g salmon ( skinless, boneless ) | 3 cups broccoli florets | 1 cup rutabaga ( peeled, not just diced ) | 1/4 cup canned sliced water chestnuts ( drained ) | 1 cup caster sugar | 125 ml heavy cream | 2 -4 tablespoons caster sugar, to glaze
instructions: Preheat oven to 150°c. Line a 12 hole, oven proof dish with parchment paper.

title: Rice Flour Pizza Batter for 2  Loafs
ingredients: 8 ounces low-fat ricotta cheese | 1 tablespoon rice flour | 1 teaspoon horseradish
instructions: Mix all ingredients and put in large bowl. Spread out onto pizza paddle if you don't have a pizza paddle.

title: Easy Beef and Potato Wedges
ingredients: 1 lb ground sirloin | 1 lb roma tomato, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon clear honey | 2 large baking potatoes
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 f and lightly oil a medium ovenproof dish. In a large bowl, combine the beef and any juices and mix thoroughly. Wash the potatoes. Slice them into rounds and then into thin wedges, about 1/4 inch thick.

title: Oatmeal and Chips
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups quick-cooking oats | 3 tablespoons dark soy sauce
instructions: Using 4 - 6 ounces of dry oatmeal per mug, toast in the oven until it is light golden brown in color.. Remove and let it rest for five minutes. Place the remaining 3 oz of dry oatmeal in another 1/2 c mug. Pour the soy sauce on top of the oatmeal, then add to that the dark soy sauce. Stir well. Top with more soy sauce.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,jalapeno chile,chicken wing,cooking spray,lager beer,dijon mustard,bread flour
title: Smoky Beer Can Chicken Wings (Beer Can Chicken Wings)
ingredients: 4 lbs chicken wings, tips discarded and wings cut at joint | cooking spray | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1 cup white wine vinegar | 1 cup lager beer, heated and allowed to warm | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon jalapeno chile | 2 teaspoons bread flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Spray the chicken drumsticks in spray. In a gallon sized plastic bag, combine the mustard, vinegar, beer and chile. Mix well to combine. Place the chicken into the bag, seal the bag and shake to coat chicken evenly.

Random Ingredients: margarine,grape,beef stock,olive oil,tortilla,granny smith apple,pork shoulder,currant
title: Carne Asada
ingredients: 2 tablespoons margarine or 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 lb boneless pork shoulder, cut in 2 inch pieces | 1 granny smith apple, peeled, cored and sliced | 1/2 cup canned grapes, drained | 1/3 cup grape jelly or 1/3 cup currant jelly | 5 cups beef stock | 4 large tortillas, warmed
instructions: In large saute pan over medium heat, melt margarine and cook pork until golden, about 10 minutes. Add apple and grapes, saute 5 minutes longer. Pour in jelly, stock and bring to a boil over high heat, reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 1 hour. Serve with tortillas. Note, this makes enough for 12 dinner rolls. Preheat oven to 350°f place each roll on a baking sheet and pour some sauce over each. Bake, covered, 20 to 30 minutes or until rolls are hot and sauce is warm.

Random Ingredients: walnut,macaroni,sultana,green capsicum,extra virgin olive oil,salsa,margarita mix
title: Mexican Macaroni and Capsicum
ingredients: 300 -400 g macaroni, small shells | 1/2 cup sultana | 1/4 cup walnuts ( or pecans if you prefer ) | 1 cup green capsicum or 1 cup red capsicum, diced | 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1/2 cup salsa, i use la choy brand
instructions: Cook macaroni according to the packet instructions. Place macaroni and sultanas into a large saucepan or wok and cover with water. Bring to the boil. Cover and cook over a very low heat for 15 - 20 minutes. If the water is boiling over, turn the heat onto a higher heat and stir for about 1 minute. The macaroni should be tender enough to remove from the pan easily. Add the walnuts/pecans, capsicum and olives and mix well. Transfer macaroni in a large bowl, add the dressing and stir. Serve immediately.

title: Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 8 ounces dry fusilli | 1 small butternut squash, peeled, seeded, diced | 1 large bok choy, peeled, seeded, chopped ( about 1.5 cups ) | 8 -10 fresh crisp lettuce leaves | 1 tablespoon lard, heated | 4 crimini mushroom pieces ( optional ) or 4 fresh shiitake mushrooms, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.

Random Ingredients: celery seed,salmon fillet,salt black pepper,tomato green chilies,squash,vanilla essence,chicken breast
title: Frozen Salmon with Chilli Seeds and Tomatoes
ingredients: 350 g skinless salmon fillets, chopped into 3 cm chunks | 300 ml diced tomatoes with green chilies, drained | 300 g squash, cut into 1cm chunks ( approx 1 1/2 cups ) | 1/2 teaspoon celery seed | 1/2 teaspoon salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla essence | 2 -3 teaspoons coarse salt, to taste
instructions: Place salmon in a large non stick dish. Add all other ingredients and mix well with a spoon. Cover and allow to marinate in the refrigerator for 15 - 20 minutes. Alternatively, place oven to 200°c. Place the salmon in a single layer on a lightly oiled baking sheet. Bake for 4 - 5 minutes, allowing both sides to become golden and well cooked. Note, depending on your oven used, you may have to reduce the oven to its required temperature for the time required for the salmon to be cooked. Remove from the oven and sprinkle with finely grated lowfat tasty cheese, crushed low fat bread, fresh parsley leaves or coriander leaves.

Random Ingredients: yellow pepper,italian flat leaf parsley,ginger biscuit,vanilla bean,halibut fillet,dijon mustard
title: Halibut (Zwt 3)
ingredients: 1 large halibut fillet ( about 1 1/2-1/4 pounds ) | 3 tablespoons dijon mustard | 2 tablespoons fresh italian flat leaf parsley ( finely chopped, divided ) | 1 teaspoon ginger biscuit ( finely crushed ( available at natural stores or any small-size packet of ginger biscuits ) | 1/4 cup italian flat leaf parsley ( finely chopped ) | 1/4 cup chopped yellow sweet pepper ( a mixture of yellow and red sweet peppers ) | 8 teaspoons vanilla bean
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place halibut filets on a rack in a shallow baking pan. Combine mustard, 2 tablespoons parsley and 1/4 teaspoon ginger in a large bowl. Spread mustard mixture evenly over both upper and lower edges of fillets. Seal halibut by brushing the top with mustard mixture, then transfer fillets to rimmed baking sheet and bake 40 minutes or until desired doneness. Meanwhile, prepare biscuit crust by combining remaining 1/4 cup parsley, the yellow sweet peppers, remaining 2 tablespoons parsley, and vanilla bean in small bowl. Sprinkle 1 teaspoon ginger biscuit on each of 8 plates. Place halibut fillets on each plate. Spoon 1 teaspoon tomato sauce over each.

title: Grilled Watermelon
ingredients: 2 tablespoons walnut oil | 2 tablespoons halved walnut oil | 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 2 1/2 pounds watermelon, washed, seeded and cut into 3 inch chunks
instructions: Heat walnut oil and golden syrup together in a medium bowl. Cook watermelon in the hot oil syrup mixture, 4 or 5 minutes per side, until watermelon is bright green and blossom like. Remove from heat and toss with walnuts. Cover and let stand for 20 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: hungarian paprika,cranberry juice,red chili,beef roast,thai basil
title: Tianke
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb boneless beef roast | 3 tablespoons sweet hungarian paprika | 1 sprig fresh thai basil ( optional ) | 1 can cranberry juice | 1 -3 dried red chili | 1/2 - 1 cup red chili pickled cranberries
instructions: Cut roast crosswise into 3 or 4 serving size chunks. Place into crockpot and sprinkle with paprika. Add basil and 3 - 4 dashes of chili pickled cranberries. Set crockpot onto high for 1 hour. Set crockpot to low for a few hours or up to one day. Serve with baked potatoes and cabbage sticks. Yum.

Random Ingredients: chicken thigh,shortcrust pastry,ketchup,chili flake,chorizo,marsala wine,oregano leaf,corn syrup
title: Portuguese Chicken and Macaroon Pastry
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chicken thighs, skinned and cut into four pieces | 2 slices chorizo, thick ( or other hard-cooked sausages ) | 1 tablespoon ketchup | 2 tablespoons marsala wine | 1 tablespoon light corn syrup | 1/2 teaspoon chili flakes | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1 package frozen shortcrust pastry ( thawed if frozen if fresh )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degree f, using a vegetable peeler, remove the skin from the chicken thighs.

Random Ingredients: gruyere cheese,peach,white onion,broccoli floret,chile,vegetable stock,ketjap manis
title: Baked Peaches
ingredients: 3 medium white onions ( halved, sliced lengthwise then cut into slivers ) | 3 medium melonges ( peaches, peeled & cut into 8 wedges ) | 7 small broccoli florets | 9 small chiles ( dried jalapenos or green jalapenos ) | 1/2 cup ketchup or 1/2 cup chili sauce | 2 cups vegetable stock | 3 ounces gruyere cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Place 1 whole onion and melonges in a 9x13 baking dish. Arrange broccoli and chiles around onion and place in oven and roast for about 40 - 50 minutes or until melonges are softened but still hold their shape. While vegetables are roasting, place ketchup and vegetable or stock in a saucepan then bring to a boil, lower heat and simmer, covered approx five minutes. Place half the onion and chiles on a paper towel. Wrap chiles around onion and chiles. Roll and secure with tooth picks. Place onion and chiles around the edge of an ovenproof baking dish then place vegetables in oven and roast for approx 5 minutes or until heated through. Remove tooth picks/toothpicks. Stir in cheese. Serve immediately.

title: Smokey Cauliflower Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 1 medium onion, quartered and thinly sliced | 1 large cauliflower, trimmed and cut into small florets | 3/4 cup pomegranate, seedless variety preferred | 2/3 cup cold water | 10 cups water | 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke or 1/2 teaspoon coarse salt | 2 cans solid white tuna packed in water, drained | 10 -12 cups cold water | 4 large lettuce wraps, wraps ( or use corn ones as substitute )
instructions: Arrange the onion, cauliflower and pomegranate in a 5 or 6 quart dutch oven. Pour 3/4 cup water over the veggies and cover. Cook over medium heat stirring occasionally for 15 minutes or until cauliflower is very tender. Stir in the cold water, liquid smoke and water. Bring to boil and add tunas. Cover and reduce heat to low and simmer about 1 hour or until the cauliflower is easily pierced with a fork. Let cool for 10 minutes. Stir into the tuna. Warm the lettuce wraps or corn tortillas. Place a portion of the warm tuna mixture on each wrap or wrap. Spoon about 2 tablespoons of the remaining sauce over the top.

title: Mama's Russian
ingredients: 1 ounce vodka, good quality | white rum | 1/4 can whole kernel corn, drained ( i had to use frozen when i don't have fresh, and it turned out the meal ) | hulled ice ( to taste ) | 2 tablespoons vodka, good quality, but it had a much thicker texture ( optional )
instructions: Fill a tall glass with ice. In a cocktail shaker, pour in the vodka, then the corn. Shake, shaking a few times. Strain into the glass and garnish with a drizzle or two of honey. Drink immediately.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper flake,italian seasoning,pineapple orange juice,artichoke heart,eggplant,tempeh,salad
title: Low Fat Stuffed Eggplant (Hogao) Wraps
ingredients: 1 eggplant | 1 cup canned chunk pineapple-orange juice ( or pineapple juice ) | 1/8 teaspoon marinated artichoke hearts ( optional ) or 1/8 teaspoon marinated anchovy ( optional ) | 1 red chili pepper flakes ( or to taste ) | 1/8 teaspoon italian seasoning ( or to taste, or to taste ) | 1 -2 tablespoon salad oil ( for crisping eggplants ) or 1 -2 tablespoon corn oil ( for crisping ) | 14 ounces tempeh, cut lengthwise into 3-inch-thick pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Cut ends off of eggplant and remove skin if desired, then carefully scoop out pulp with large spoon. Discard pit. Cut shells in half lengthwise. Discard pulp and seeds. Set shells aside in bowl. If desired, combine chopped artichokes with any other filling ingredients mentioned above in a bowl and mix well. Drain pineapple juice through colander and discard juice. Place oil or corn oil in very large skillet. Heat over high heat until quite hot but not smoking. Drain eggplant pulp and place about 1/3 of pulp mixture into hot oil in skillet, being careful not to break up pulp. Stir and fry until golden brown, flipping. Turn over pulp and fry another 2 - 3 minutes until the mixture has become very dark and begins to blister.. Place eggplant halves on serving platter or individual plates. Remove excess oil. Starting at the edge of plate closest to you and using finger, push pulp toward edges of platter, and roll up tightly, securing with wooden toothpicks or cocktail twine to help prevent filling from oozing out of eggplant. Place on plate with slotted spoon and serve warm, or at room temperature. Makes about 15 appetizer servings.

title: Kiwifruit Crusted Cod
ingredients: 1 pastry dough ( ready rolled ) | 2 cups kiwi fruits | 2 1/2 lbs cod fish fillets ( skinned and cut into 5 x 3 inch squares )
instructions: Roll out pastry dough to 1/2/8 inch thick. Trim pastry and cut into 2 1/2 squares. Place cut squares on a flat baking sheet. Brush dough with oil. Place piwifruit and fish on top of dough, sprinkle lightly with salt and pepper. Add about 1/3 of the reserved pastry water and roll up. Place on top of dough and press edges. Turn fish over and press around edges. Repeat with remaining pastry. Bake in a preheated 450f oven for 12 minutes. Serve with a side of kiwifruit cocktail sauce or salad dressing.

Random Ingredients: red chili paste,chicken bouillon,white creme de cacao,salt pepper,lime wedge,ketjap manis,chuck,red wine
title: Carry-Beef Cocktail
ingredients: 4 ounces pork spareribs ( roughly 2.5 kg, each cut into 2 pieces ) | 1 lime wedge ( a few drops ) | 2 ounces ketjap manis | 2 ounces white creme de cacao ( see note ) | 2 tablespoons ketchup and red chili paste | 1 tablespoon red wine | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon | 1/2 pinch salt and pepper
instructions: Place all the ingredients except the steak in a small, covered pan and heat with a lid for 2 - 3 minutes until the sauce comes to the boil. Remove the lid and stir to combine. Arrange the steak on a serving platter. Pour the hot sauce over and garnish with an lime wedge and serve.

title: Belgian Safe
ingredients: 32 ounces dark beer ( budweiser ) | 8 tablespoons celery seeds
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a large freezer gallon bag. Seal airtight and chill for 5 days up to 4 weeks.

Random Ingredients: white cabbage,tapioca flour,bicarbonate soda,bouillon cube,sazon goya con culantro y achiote,parsnip,baking powder,taco seasoning
title: Cabbage and Parsnip Toss
ingredients: 1 large white cabbage | 1 parsnip | 1 packet sazon goya con culantro y achiote | 2 tablespoons tapioca flour | 1 bouillon cube | 3 tablespoons tapioca flour | 2 teaspoons baking powder | 2 teaspoons taco seasoning | 2 teaspoons bicarbonate of soda
instructions: Cut cabbage and parsnip into chunks and place in a deep roasting pan. Sprinkle with salt, place in a pre heated oven and roast until the skin has blackened and the vegetables look soft. Remove and allow to cool. After about 20 minutes, remove from oven and allow to cool to room temperature and remove as much skin and as much of the bitter juices that are stuck to the skin. Cut the parsnip into chunks and place in the roasting pan. Sprinkle with sazon and cook in a pre heated oven for about 40 minutes. In a large bowl, mix together the tapioca flour and the bouillon and add everything else and whisk until smooth. Remove cabbage and parsnips and discard. Mash and combine with a potato masher, pour into a bowl, mix well and return to the same saucepan or in the fridge. Add baking powder, stir well and leave in fridge for an hour.

title: Quick White Beans
ingredients: 1 can white beans or ( 15 ounce ) can navy beans | 1 teaspoon catsup
instructions: Drain beans, saving 1/4 cup of liquid,. Place beans in microwave safe casserole dish. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Cover and microwave on high for 5 minutes. Cover and microwave for 8 minutes or until liquid is absorbed, stirring once halfway through cooking.

title: Homemade Yogurt
ingredients: 10 ounces plain greek yogurt | cracker ( optional )
instructions: Place yogurt in the refrigerator. After about 1 hour, gently stir your curds. If you notice as much moisture as you desire inside, stir and continue until all of your excess moisture is absorbed. The longer you stir, the crumbier the yogurt will become. Transfer to a strainer lined with paper towels or a container lined with a lid. Store in the refrigerator, it gets better every day. Enjoy.

title: Onion Herb Sauce
ingredients: 2 medium anaheim chilies or 2 medium new mexico chilies | 1/8 teaspoon dried savory or 1/8 teaspoon rosemary | 12 fluid ounces whipping cream | 1 tablespoon dried onion flakes | snipped savory, to garnish
instructions: Cut stems off chilies and discard seeds and coarsely chop. Remove all seeds. Place chilies, rinds and chopped dried herbs in a food processor and process until finely chopped. Add whipping cream and process until mixture becomes thickened and smooth. Fold in dried minced onion flakes. Serve with chips, crackers or crudites.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon,margarine,seasoning,tasting pork vegetable oil,self raising flour,egg wrap,sun tomato oil,hash brown
title: Easy Baked Potato Turnovers
ingredients: 2 teaspoons tapioca ( see note ) or 2 teaspoons instant potato flour ( see note ) | 2/3 cup self-raising flour | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning | 3 tablespoons margarine ( see note ) | 1 egg roll wraps | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained ( see note ) | pecorino sultana or other dried fruit chutney | 2 pinches chicken bouillon
instructions: Note, the following step needs to be done within 30 minutes before adding other ingredients to ensure the potatoes don't get too soft and will break apart. I had a little difficulty with my fingers after poking my finger though, the potatoes had a little too soft and it took literally 20 minutes to make the job right. Use two sheet pans and a baking paddle if not doing these things. Measure out the tapioca flour in a large mixing bowl. Place the flour, seasoning, and margarine into a mixing bowl, and stir with your fingertips until the mixture resembles fine crumbs, then turn onto a floured cutting board and gently knead until your mixture resembles fine breadcrumbs. Add the egg roll wrappers and sun dried tomatoes to the dough and knead until the dough forms a ball. Divide the dough into 12 even portions to make a roll about 3 thick. Roll each portion out to about a 15 inch circle and use a 2 1/2 cutter to lightly fluted the edge. Place 1 teaspoon of the potato filling in the center of each circle and fold in half again. Press and crimp the edges with a fork, sealing the edge. Repeat with the rest of the dough. Grease a non stick frying pan or cast iron skillet with the margarine and begin frying the turnover. You want it to be just covering the bottom of the pan and not over the bottom. When the turnover has fully cooked, flip the turnover over, spread the remaining filling evenly, and cook for 2 minutes or until the filling has completely melted and the outside has browned evenly. Place the turnover onto a plate and cover lightly with foil, while making the topping. When serving, spread the topping evenly over the turnover and serve warm. Note, one of the steps i'm drooling about when shopping for potatoes and flipping them is to buy them, preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Bake the potato turnovers for about 20 minutes or until the tops are a deep golden brown and the potatoes have absorbed the extra moisture in a sizzle. Note, the basic potato substitution for potatoes is not potatoes that have the crisp texture of regular potatoes. Also, the basic potato substitute is shredded parmesean cheese that has been grated or shaved. If you substitute regular potatoes for dried potatoes, omit the chicken bullion and increase the spices.

Random Ingredients: yoghurt,steak,great northern bean,sea salt,raspberry,guacamole,sardine tomato sauce
title: The Ultimate Sangria
ingredients: 10 ounces ready to eat sardines, i recommend arrabbiata or 10 ounces sardines, of your choice | 2 1/2 cups seltzer-style yoghurt | 1/2 cup great northern bean, drained | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt | 1 cup sweet pickled rainbow, drained and rinsed | 1 cup guacamole, we use this dip for these | 1/2 cup raspberry, optional to serve
instructions: For your first attempt at making this delicious dish, start by slicing all your way through the bottom of the sardines so they are all flat, approximately 1 inches thick on one half. Place the sardines in a bowl, cover with your yoghurt, and refrigerate for about an hour. For those of you like a little bit of crust, serve an additional 1/3 cup of yoghurt along with some pimento in the bottom of each of the sardines. This can be served at your table with fresh fruit, chips, and vegetables.

Random Ingredients: lemon,rump roast,cream,balsamic vinegar,rye bread,habanero pepper,raisin,chipotle chile
title: Crock Pot Beef Rump Roast
ingredients: 10 lbs rump roast | 2 fresh habanero peppers, slit lengthwise into very thin slices ( or 1 chipotle chile ) | 4 cups sour cream or 4 cups greek yogurt | 2 large lemons, juice of | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons raisins | 5 -8 ounces seedless rye bread, toasted and cut into 1 inch cubes
instructions: Rub the inside of the crock pot with some vegetable oil. Arrange the pepper slices around the bottom in a decorative pattern. Pour over the yogurt. Slice the lemon into thin wedges. Combine the sour cream, lemon juice and vinegar in a large bowl. Stir in the raisins. Dip the meat into yogurt to cover. Arrange the roast on top of the sour cream mixture, and pour the lemon juice on top. Cover and cook on low heat 8 - 10 hours. When ready to serve, remove the roast and slice. Serve hot with cooked green beans or lettuce, or serve with tortillas.

title: Grape Tomatoes, Serrano Peanuts and Gruyère Croutons
ingredients: 2 slices thick white bread, crusts removed, cut into small cubes | 1 cup gruyere cheese, shredded | 1/4 cup roasted peanuts, coarsely chopped | 3 tablespoons pickled serrano peppers, chopped | 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved | 1/2 cup old fashioned oats, toasted
instructions: Position a rack 4 inches from the broiler. Mix the bread, cheese, peanuts and chiles in a large bowl. Divide the mixture among 6 individual plates or ramekins, leaving enough space for them to spread out. Sprinkle with the tomatoes. Top with the other 1/2 cup cheese mixture. Broil or bake until the tops are nicely browned and bubbling, about 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: green chile pepper,yogurt,celery,artichoke heart,pink lemonade,coconut milk
title: Green Chile Artichoke Dip
ingredients: 1 jar marinated artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 1 can coconut milk | 1 can chopped green chile peppers | 1 teaspoon pink lemonade, or to taste | 1 stalk celery, chopped, or to taste
instructions: Stir artichoke hearts, yogurt, coconut milk, green chile peppers, and lemonade together in a bowl. Cook and stir celery in the remaining coconut milk and green chile pepper mixture in a skillet over medium low heat until thoroughly heated, about 5 minutes.

title: Brisket Sauce - Salt Free
ingredients: 10 chicken parts ( i've never tried using thighs, drumsticks, wings and wings. my husband doesn't like them ) | 2 cups salt free broth ( chicken breasts free ) | 2 tablespoons tex-mex pete hot sauce | 1 tablespoon fresh parsley leaves, chopped
instructions: Combine salt free broth and pete style sauce in a sauce pan. Heat, without boiling, over a medium heat until broth thins and bubbly, about 5 - 10 minutes. Stir in parsley. Add your choice of meat pieces and marinade for at least two hours or overnight. Note, i use a whole chickens and it's messy, so adjust your marinade as needed.

Random Ingredients: thyme leaf,mustard powder,quinoa,white flour,brown rice,berry,celery,allspice berry
title: Quinoa and Rice
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 4 cups water | 2 cups brown rice | 15 -20 allspice berries | 1/4 cup chopped celery | 1 tablespoon mustard powder | 1 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 1 teaspoon powdered mustard powder mixed with 1/2 tablespoon thyme leaves | 1/2 teaspoon white flour, heaping
instructions: Rinse quinoa with cold water and drain in a strainer. Dry fry in a little oil until very fragrant about 2 minutes on high. Add 3 cups water, then rinsed quinoa. Wrap tightly and let simmer for about 20 minutes. Add rest of ingredients. Bring to boil and reduce heat to simmer. Simmer covered on low for about 30 minutes. Remove quinoa carefully and set aside. Stir, then leave on the burner off, you will be cooking the quinoa in the next step. Add the fluff and return to a nice, dark brown, crispy crust. Serve immediately with a nice green salad or ice cold beer.

title: Fried Cilantro and Dill
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh cilantro leaves, stems removed | 1 tablespoon dried dill | 1 tablespoon onion powder
instructions: Wash and stem the cilantro leaves. Place the cilantro and dill in a small skillet over medium heat. Stir the dill and onion powder into the cilantro and dill until the mixture begins to dry out. Remove from heat. Spread the mixture out in a small bowl onto a plate. Heat a nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Place about 1/2 cup of oil in the pan, tipping the pan occasionally to spread the oil evenly.

title: Fried Fish With Raspberry Sauce
ingredients: 2/3 cup cider | 2/3 cup kirsch | 1/3 cup fish or 1/3 cup shrimp, chopped | 2 tablespoons canned prawns or 2 tablespoons shrimp, cooked and sliced | 1 teaspoon fresh leeks or 1/2 teaspoon leek, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup fresh pineapple, chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh raspberries or 1 tablespoon frozen raspberries
instructions: Pour the cider into a medium saucepan, heat over medium high heat until almost boiling and boil for 15 to 20 seconds. Add the kirsch and fish, prawns/prawns, leeks or leeks, pineapple and raspberries. Stir and heat for 2 to 3 minutes until heated through.

Random Ingredients: artichoke heart,porcini mushroom,kalamata olive,oil,fish sauce,chicken breast,olive oil
title: Chicken Skewers With Artichokes and Olives
ingredients: 3 1/2 - 4 lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut into 2 inches long bite sized chunks | 1/2 cup sliced kalamata olive ( about 1/3 cup ) | 4 slices vinaigrette-cured artichoke hearts, halved and seeded | 1 jar marinated artichoke hearts, drained | 4 tablespoons chopped pitted kalamata olives | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 2 tablespoons oil | 2 tablespoons chopped dried porcini mushrooms or 2 tablespoons dried porcini mushrooms
instructions: Cut chicken into 1 1/2 1 thick strips. Thread 3 pieces onto each skewer, alternating with 4 pieces of artichoke and 1/4 cup of marinated artichokes. Toss lightly with enough olive oil to lightly coat. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate 12 hours or up to overnight. Grill over medium charcoal fire or under broiler until cooked through and lightly charred all over. Brush skewers and chicken with 1/4 cup marinated artichoke slices. While still warm, serve with remaining ingredients such as soy sauce, garlic chile powder, vinegar, and dipping sauce.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,button mushroom,parmigiano reggiano cheese,red chili powder,black truffle,coconut milk,chicken stock
title: Stolen Mushrooms, Mushrooms & Truffles in Coconut Stock
ingredients: 2 cups unsweetened coconut milk | 1/4 cup dark rum | 1/2 teaspoon red chili powder or 1/2 teaspoon chili powder | 3/4 cup chicken stock | 2 lbs button mushrooms, sliced | 1 teaspoon shredded fresh coconut or 1 teaspoon dried truffles ( 1/4 ounce ) | parmigiano-reggiano cheese, shredded
instructions: Place coconut milk and rum in a small, heavy saucepan. Stir or whisk to blend. Gradually whisk in stock. Bring mixture to a simmer over medium high heat. Add mushrooms. Simmer gently for 6 to 8 minutes. Stir in coconut or truffles. Cook for 6 to 8 minutes until mushrooms are cooked through. Serve hot or warm, garnished with shredded parmigiano reggiano cheese.

title: Crispy Chicken
ingredients: 3 slices chicken cutlets ( thin strips ) | pecan pieces or walnut pieces ( for garnish )
instructions: Spread one side of chicken with pecan pieces. Roll chicken up and secure with tooth picks. Preheat broiler. Place on a baking sheet and broil approximately 3 minutes, turning frequently. Sprinkle with walnut pieces.

title: Easy Noodle Sandwich
ingredients: 4 english muffins, split | 1 ram's ramen noodles, uncooked | 1 red chili pepper
instructions: Divide ramen noodles among half of each english muffin, breaking apart as necessary.

title: Simple & Delicious French Seasoning Mix for Pork Roast
ingredients: 2 tablespoons caster sugar | 2 teaspoons hot paprika | 2 teaspoons red pepper flakes
instructions: Put all ingredients in the bowl of a spice mill and whiz up into a smooth, thick paste. For pork roast, leave for 2 - 4 hours to marinade in the fridge overnight. Shake well after it has marinated overnight. This ensures that the fat in the meat will be covered in the marinade and cook on the same day the meat may need to be roasted and cut up into serving sizes to ensure that cooking times will be shorter per pound for a large roast. For best results, leave overnight, then cook with vegetables and potatoes for the final half hour of cooking.

title: Mustard-Radish Salad
ingredients: 3 -4 large radishes, washed and dried | herbes de provence | lemon catsup
instructions: Dry the radishes on paper towels. Mix thoroughly with herbs. Pour catsup on top before serving. This goes great with barbeque.

Random Ingredients: sherry wine,garlic chive,chili oil,tamarind paste,guinness stout,paprika
title: Homemade Tamarind Wine
ingredients: 3 -4 tablespoons smoked paprika | 2 tablespoons tamarind paste | 1 pint guinness stout or 1 pint other stout beer | 1 -2 tablespoon chili oil | 2 -3 garlic chives, finely chopped | 1 -2 tablespoon sherry wine
instructions: Wash tamarind thoroughly in clean, hot water. Place in a small saucepan on the stovetop. Place on medium low heat and leave for about 10 minutes. Place the pot on a burner, bring to a boil and gently simmer for about 20 minutes. Place the strained liquid into the bowl of your food processor or blender. Process till smooth. Place in a bowl and stir in the smoked paprika. Return to the saucepan and add the guinness or other stout. Stir and bring heat up to medium. Add the chili oil and garlic chives. Allow sauce to simmer slowly for about 20 minutes. Serve in the bottle with a twist on the top. Add a squeeze of sherry if desired.

title: Porces De Citron
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon olive oil ( for frying ) or 1 -2 tablespoon grapeseed oil | 1 large orange
instructions: Heat the olive oil or grapeseed oil at a heavy skillet. While the oil is heating up, peel the orange, removing white pith and most of the white pith. Slice the orange in half, then cut the entire thing in half again. Slice the orange into thin rounds, about 1/2 inch wide. Gently drop the slices in the hot oil. You want to coat them in the oil by pouring a drop or two of olive oil, but not so much it splatters. When the oil is ready, add oranges, and cover. Reduce heat, and simmer for another 20 to 30 minutes. Remove cover and continue to cook over low heat until you can pierce all the skin with a fork.

title: Mexican Chopped Eggs
ingredients: 8 ounces hard-boiled eggs, finely chopped | 1 serrano chili, fresh, chopped | 2 romaine lettuce hearts, finely chopped
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Refrigerate for at least an hour before serving. If you prefer crisp, chopped pieces this is a good idea.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil peanut,black olive,rye flour,mango,thyme sprig
title: Black and Mango Parfait
ingredients: 1 mango, ripe, peeled and segmented | 1/2 lb black olives, pitted | 1 1/2 ounces rye flour | 3 fresh thyme sprigs | 1 1/4 tablespoons sesame oil or 1 1/4 tablespoons peanut oil
instructions: Slice the mango and olives in half and place with the olives, rye flour and thyme in a bowl. Season, to taste, with salt and black pepper. Mix well until a sticky consistency is achieved. If you need to, add a few ice cubes to moisten the mixture.

title: Mexican Rum Chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chicken pieces, cut in half | 1 cup dark rum | 1 ounce green chili pepper | 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg | 1 tablespoon flour
instructions: Spray inside the skillet with cooking spray. Brown chicken on both sides in small amount of oil. Place in a large cassroleole dish. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over chicken. Cover and bake in 325°f oven for about 40 minutes. Remove cover and bake for 45 minutes more or until done.

title: Famous Mexican Rice Balls
ingredients: 4 cups leftover cooked rice | 1 tablespoon dutch-processed cocoa powder | 1/2 cup ranch dressing
instructions: Place leftover rice in a bowl and mix thoroughly with cocoa powder. Add ranch dressing while stirring thoroughly. Shape rice into 1 1/2 inch balls. Place balls in freezer until firm, about 12 to 20 minutes depending on size. Roll in dry bread crumbs and set aside.

title: Southern Style Corn
ingredients: 6 ears corn | 4 slices bacon | 1 bunch scallions | 1/4 cup lime juice | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place corn on a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until the kernels start to burst. Cut bacon in half and rub the bacon slices onto the corn. Sprinkle scallions on top of the corn. Mix lime juice and confectioners' sugar and sprinkle evenly over the cobs before baking for 20 to 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: lobster tail,flat leaf parsley,virgin olive oil,dark chocolate,chicken breast,lime,lime wedge
title: Lobster, Chicken and Chocolate Chicken Satay
ingredients: 4 chicken breasts | 4 thin lemon slices | 4 limes, cut into quarters | 1 3/4 cup chopped flat leaf parsley | 6 ounces dark chocolate | 1 1/2 tablespoons virgin olive oil | 24 ounces cooked lobsters ( about 1 1/2 lbs )
instructions: Place the chicken breasts in a food processor fitted with a metal blade and process until almost smooth. Rinse the chicken under cold water to cool. Combine the chicken, lemon slices, lime quarters and parsley in a bowl and fold the chocolate with a fork until the paste is smooth. Pour the olive oil in a clean, dry pan. Heat over low medium high heat until the oil starts to smoke. Add the shrimp and cook, shaking the pan, until they turn pink and curl slightly, 2 to 3 minutes. Remove from heat and transfer to bowl using a slotted spoon. Let cool, then remove the shrimp. Place the remaining shrimp in a bowl.

title: Grilled Cheese and Potato Kebabs
ingredients: 4 lbs russet potatoes, peeled and diced very small | 4 ounces fresh sage leaves, finely chopped coarsely | 1/2 - 3/4 cup whole pistachios, coarsely chopped | 1/3 cup basil leaves, shredded | 12 ounces sausage meat, crumbled ( your favorite brand ) | 1 ounce jicama, peeled and cut into 1/4-inch slices | 2 1/2 quarts cheese, finely shredded ( i use cheddar or jack )
instructions: Place the diced potatoes in a sieve or colander and rinse under cold water until thoroughly cold. Drain and put the potatoes in a large bowl. Season with sage, pistachios, basil, and sausage. Toss to combine. Stir in the shredded jicama. Place 1/2 cup of the potato mixture in the center of each slice of cheese and place on a baking sheet. Bake in a preheated 350 degree f oven for 40 - 45 minutes. Remove and let stand 5 - 10 minutes before serving.

title: Onion Rolls
ingredients: 4 large sweet onions, halved | 1/3 cup all-purpose flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Place onion halves, cut side up, on a baking sheet. Bake in preheated oven until they begin to soften, about 10 minutes.

title: Sweet and Sour Fenugreek Leaves
ingredients: 3 tablespoons palm sugar | 3 tablespoons picante sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried fenugreek seeds
instructions: In a bowl, dissolve the palm sugar in a little water. Stir in the picante sauce. Add the fenugreek seeds. Let cool to room temperature. Store refrigerated in a dry dark place.

title: Creamy Penzeys Pasta with Tequila
ingredients: 1 box whole wheat spaghetti | 8 ounces cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup beef stock | 1/4 teaspoon tequila
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Lightly grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Aunty's Spanish Rice
ingredients: 1 cup rice | 1 tablespoon hot sauce, such as tabasco | 1/4 cup cotija cheese, grated | 1/4 cup fresh parsley leaves, chopped
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions, omitting salt and fat. Add hot sauce, cheese, parsley and remaining hot sauce. Stir until cheese melts. Fluff rice. Can be served warm or cold. Keep covered with plastic wrap. Enjoy.

title: Grilled Mozzarella
ingredients: 1 green tomato, seeded | 1 lime leaf | 1 ounce mozzarella cheese | 2 small fresh marjoram ( optional )
instructions: Place the tomato and lime leaf on a heat proof plate and place under a hot grill. Grill the tomato just until soft and blackened. Allow to cool. Slice the mozzarella into 1/4 inch thick strips and place them in a small bowl. Cut each lemon half in half and squeeze the juice over top. Add 1/2 teaspoon of marjoram to the mozzarella with the zest and juice and place the pieces on the plate. Sprinkle the mozzarella with the zest and juice then grill the mozzarella until soft and slightly brown. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: roquefort cheese,white kidney bean,ice cube,salt,coffee granule,oyster sauce
title: Oriental Red Beans (Pickles)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons instant coffee granules | 1 cup chopped or crushed ice cube | 2 tablespoons fish sauce ( available at asian markets ) | 1 tablespoon instant roquefort cheese | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1 can white kidney beans ( drained ) or ( 14 ounce ) can cannellini beans ( drained )
instructions: Combine the coffee, salt, fish sauce and roquefort cheese in a plastic bag. Seal bag and place in microwave and on high for 6 - 7 minutes or until cheese is melted. Stir well. Place beans in a salad dish and microwave one minute or until mixture is hot. Stir the hot mixture into the beans, stir to coat. Note, you may also use store bought pesto and serve over lettuce, salad, etc. Enjoy.

title: Broccoli Rice Noodles & Broccoli
ingredients: 1 lb rice noodles | 1 lb broccoli floret | 4 tablespoons madeira wine or 4 tablespoons dry sherry | 1 -2 cup crumbled feta
instructions: Prepare rice noodles according to package directions. Heat 2 tablespoons madeira in skillet.

Random Ingredients: phyllo pastry,peanut oil,chuck,parmigiano reggiano cheese,vegetable oil cooking spray,bamboo shoot,asparagus,savoy cabbage
title: Chef John's Favorite Triples
ingredients: 3/4 lb ground chuck | 1/2 cup sliced roasted peanuts, coarsely chopped | 8 sheets phyllo pastry, thawed | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 cup sliced asparagus | 1 cup shredded savoy cabbage | 1/2 cup shredded parmigiano-reggiano cheese, plus more | parmigiano-reggiano cheese, for drizzling onto phyllo pastry
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Place the beef in a skillet over medium high heat. Cook, turning once, until no longer pink, about 5 minutes. Remove the beef from the pan and set aside. Pour off all but 3 tablespoons of the fat from the pan. Add the peanuts. Cook, stirring often, until golden, about 3 minutes. Remove from the heat. Spread the beef on a plate. Place the phyllo sheets on a clean, dry surface. Cover with a damp towel, and set aside. Heat a nonstick skillet over high heat. Coat with cooking spray. Working with 1 sheet at a time, place the phyllo pieces on the pan, flat on one end. Top with 2 sheets each, working quickly so they don't stack. Spread 1/4 of the beef on top of the phyllo, leaving a 1/4 inch border around the edge. Carefully flip the phyllo over, and press the phyllo in to completely crimp the edges. Lightly spray a 10x15 inch piece of parchment paper with cooking spray. Repeat, placing 3 sheets of phyllo at a time, then stack the sheets and beef on top, pressing gently. Place the parchment paper on your work surface, and place the stack on top of the parchment. Repeat with the remaining 3 phyllo sheets, then set the stack on top. Place 1/2 cup shredded cheese on top, drizzle with additional cheese, and sprinkle with some of the peanuts. Working from the short sides, roll up the phyllo, jellyroll style, enclosing the cheese. Wrap in parchment, and refrigerate 2 hours or up to 1 day before baking. The trimmings can be made in advance, wrapped in plastic wrap, for up to 2 days.

title: Miso Salad
ingredients: 3 cups shredded red cabbage | 0.5 package prepared whipped topping | 0.5 package white miso
instructions: Slice cabbage finely into 1 inch strips. Slice white miso into pieces. Toss cabbage with the miso. Chill 2 to 3 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: orange zest,coffee ice cream,self rising flour,lettuce,cornbread
title: Grilled Mexican Cornbread
ingredients: 1 cup self-rising flour | 2 tablespoons orange zest | 4 cups crushed cornbread | 1/3 cup brewed coffee ice cream | 6 cups shredded lettuce
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium heat. Whisk flour, orange zest, and cornmeal together in a bowl. Divide cornbread mix into 4 pieces. Roll one piece of cornbread in the flour mixture until fully coated. Repeat with remaining pieces of cornbread. Preheat grill for medium high heat and lightly oil the grate. Lightly sprinkle grilled grill grate with oil. Grill cornbread until heated through and lightly toasted, about 5 minutes. Top grilled grilled cornbread with lettuce.

title: Moroccan Nachos - My Mom's Recipe
ingredients: 4 large parsnips | 8 large mushrooms | 1/2 cup coriander | 1/2 teaspoon black peppercorns | 1 teaspoon salt | 3/4 cup hummus | corn chips ( optional )
instructions: Boil parsnips and then peel them. Cut off any dark green or light green parts. Skin and de cut into chunks. Boil mushrooms until tender, then drain excess liquid. Set aside. Chop coriander, pepper, and peppercorns. Heat up hummus or salsa. Add parsnips and mushrooms. Sprinkle with coriander and seasonings. Serve with corn chips if desired.

title: Potato Sour Cream
ingredients: 3 lbs russet potatoes | 4 tablespoons sour cream or 4 tablespoons creme fraiche ( see note ) | 1 envelope savory | 1 dash cream of tartar
instructions: Peel the potatoes, wash them thoroughly and pat dry with a paper towel. Cut into 2 inch chunks. Bring a large non stick saucepan of water to boil over high heat. Reduce heat to low. Place potatoes in a colander or sieve and set in the sink. Cover with cold water and let drain for 20 minutes. Drain. Combine sour cream or creme fraiche with water to form a thin paste. Place in refrigerator to mellow sour cream. Remove the russet potatoes from the water. Cover and let drain for 2 hours. Drain well and pat dry with a paper towel. Cut in half lengthwise and set aside. Place the potatoes in a large pot, cover and heat on low until tender about 20 minutes. Remove from heat and let cool. Using a cheese cloth, scrape the potatoes from the outer wall with a sharp knife or similar and set aside. Makes 2 servings. Note on savory, savory gives a lovely flavor such as rosemary or thyme. It can be dried and added to sour cream.

title: Chilled Cilantro Oil (Cilantro Tea)
ingredients: 1 bunch cilantro | 1 cup light olive oil
instructions: Place stems on waxed paper or plastic wrap, cutting away any damaged bits of the stems. Wrap tightly in waxed paper or plastic wrap. Refrigerate for 1 hour or overnight. Remove from refrigerator 45 minutes before using. Allow to stand at room temperature 10 minutes. Strain and serve.

title: Mock Garbanzo Sauce
ingredients: 2 pickled hot pepperoncini peppers | 2 tablespoons minced orange peel ( optional ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons minced fresh lime peel
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl. Stir to mix. Store in refrigerator, covered, for up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: carrot,jasmine rice,cornstarch,poblano chile,rump roast,cream mushroom soup,bread crumb,pasta sauce
title: Mexican Beef and Rice
ingredients: 1 lb rump roast | 6 poblano chiles, roasted, peeled and roughly chopped | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 can stewed tomatoes with jalapenos ( rotel ) | 1/4 cup uncooked bread crumbs ( about ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup dry bread crumbs | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 2 -3 cups cooked pasta sauce ( ragu )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350º. Combine all ingredients except meat and bread crumbs in a large oven proof casserole. Mix the cornstarch with a bit of milk to thin the sauce out.
