Drain meat evenly if it falls apart. Stir the meat, coating the meat evenly. Arrange the meat in an ovenproof casserole and bake covered for 6 - 8 hour or until the meat falls apart when slashed. Let meat rest a minute or two, remove the top of the casserole and sprinkle with some bread crumbs. This could be a meal, or make a side dish. Reheat meat in sauce in the crockpot or microwave and serve with pasta.

Random Ingredients: black cardamom pod,rice noodle,linguine,lemon zest,plain nonfat yogurt,plain flour,rocket,plain yogurt
title: Linguine With Yogurt, Black Cardamom and Rocket (Rice Noodle)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon plain nonfat yogurt or 1 tablespoon yogurt | 1 teaspoon lemon zest | 1 teaspoon plain nonfat yogurt | 1 1/2 tablespoons plain nonfat yogurt | 2 teaspoons plain nonfat yogurt | fresh ground black cardamom pod | 500 g uncooked linguine | 1/2 cup rocket ( to garnish ) | 3 -6 tablespoons fresh rocket, rinsed
instructions: Put the yogurt, lemon zest and ground cardamom into a bowl. Add the nonfat yoghurt and mix together. Drain the linguine and rinse well. Place in a large bowl and add the yogurt mixture and toss well using your hands. Turn into a large platter. Add the linguine to the linguine and top with the rasgiano and chopped rocket. Serve.

Random Ingredients: yellow squash,molasses,escarole,basil leaf,lasagna noodle,spice,dark sesame oil,ketchup
title: Skillet Vegetable Lasagna(Mock Ho
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 8 lasagna noodles, uncooked | 1/2 cup light molasses | 1/2 cup ketchup | 3/4 teaspoon ground mixed spice | 1/2 teaspoon dried basil leaves, crushed | 1 medium yellow squash, cut into strips or 1 medium zucchini | 1 -2 cup coarsely chopped escarole, stems and leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Rinse pasta and vegetables in a colander under cold running water.

title: Lamb or Fish Curry (Murgh Gosht)
ingredients: 600 g lamb or 600 g shrimp | 1 red chili powder | 2 tablespoons dried mint | 1 teaspoon ground allspice ( ajwain ) | 500 g cod
instructions: Marinate the lamb or shrimp with the allspice and mint. Bake the meat, covered, over a medium heat for 40 minutes in a preheated oven. Add more pepper or chili powder as needed depending on taste. Meanwhile, cook the fish or fish in an ovenproof skillet over medium hight heat, uncovered, for 3 to 4 minutes. Serve the hot curry with the boiled jasmine rice and the coconut ketchup ketchup or your favorite curry.

title: American Cheese Crisps
ingredients: 1 lb american cheese, shredded | 1/4 cup powdered sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 425º. In medium bowl stir together cheese, sugar and cheese mixture. With pastry cutter, cut into four 3 x 3 inch rectangles. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 12 to 15 minutes or until golden.

Random Ingredients: milk ricotta cheese,bay seasoning,pizza sauce,red cayenne pepper,cucumber,herb,pie shell
title: Cucumber & Herbed Ricotta Cheese Pizza-Crust
ingredients: 2 cups milk ricotta cheese | 1/4 cup herbs, chopped ( from about 15 leaves of a bunch ) | 1 bay seasoning | 2 tablespoons red cayenne peppers or 2 tablespoons black pepper | 1/4 cup prepared pizza sauce ( bottled or homemade ) | 1 large unseasoned pie crust | 2 small cucumbers, peeled, seeded, cut into thin, 2-inch slices
instructions: For the crust, preheat oven to 425°f. In a medium bowl, combine ricotta, herbs, bay seasoning and red pepper. Spoon 1 tbsp of the ricotta mixture about 2/3 cup on the edge of the prebaked crust. Drizzle 1 tbsp of pizza sauce over the ricotta. Top with the other 1/3 of the cheese mixture. Press together the edges of the crust with fingers. Add the cucumbers, pinch up excess and crimp the edges. Lightly flour the edges of the crust. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes, until crust is golden brown and filling is hot and bubbling. Serve with additional sauce.

Random Ingredients: zucchini,taco seasoning,steak,chicken breast,halloumi cheese,linguine,red food coloring
title: Garlic Veggie Stuffed Chicken Rolls
ingredients: 8 ounces boneless skinless chicken breasts | 8 ounces chicken breasts, boneless with skin | 8 ounces zucchini, ends trimmed, thinly sliced | 5 1/2 ounces halloumi cheese, cut into 4 1/2-inch chunks | 2 teaspoons taco seasoning | 1 bottle red food coloring | 10 ounces linguine
instructions: Mix seasoning and food coloring in a small bowl, set aside at room temperature about 1 hour. Cut each chicken breast in half lengthwise and crosswise. Cut a 2 long cross at 1 ends of each breast, then open each in half and remove 2 halves of each cutlet. Tear 1 of the halves along the spine of each cutlet. Starting at the wide end, roll each piece tightly. Using a little water, moisten remaining cuts and fold 1 end of each roll. Secure with toothpicks. Place seam side down on a lightly oiled rack that has been sprinkled with cornmeal. Set on a rimmed baking sheet, covered with a towel, and freeze for 30 minutes. Meanwhile, bring a saucepan of salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook until just tender, about 6 minutes. Drain and toss well with sauce. Spoon about 2 tablespoons of pasta sauce into each roll and place on a serving platter. Place 2 pieces of chicken across the pasta mixture and sprinkle with a little cheese. Arrange 2 to 3 toothpicks in a crosswise pattern, or a little more if desired. Serve.

title: Chinese Five-Star Food
ingredients: 1 star anise | 1 pound chicken meat
instructions: Heat a 12 inch frying pan over medium high heat until hot but not smoking. Crush the star anise into the mixture. Place the chicken meat into the hot pan.

title: Stuffed French Fajitas
ingredients: 1 package flour tortillas | 2 1/2 cups shredded italian bread | 6 ounces sliced mushrooms | 1 teaspoon onion, chopped | 1 teaspoon apple cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon cognac
instructions: Cut each tortilla into 4 wedges, place each wedge in a bowl of ice water and let sit 10 minutes. Drain and let cool. Mix salad dressing ingredients together in a small bowl. Place bread on baking tray and arrange on top of dressing. Preheat under broiler for 2 minutes to toast bread. Remove bread wedges from baking tray and cool slightly. Sprinkle bread with mushrooms and onion and arrange on serving plates. Place tortillas in a basket and carefully flip to coat with dressing. Serve with additional salad if desired.

Random Ingredients: okonomiyaki sauce,orange peel,bean,hoagie,red chilies,salt black pepper
title: Oriental Bunches With Hoagie and Asian Vegetables
ingredients: 1/2 cup hoagie rolls | 3/4 cup okonomiyaki sauce, plus | 2 tablespoons hoagie rolls | 1/4 cup red chilies, minced ( or kochujang ) | 1/4 cup frozen beans | 2 slices orange peel | 1/4 cup mixed sprouts, chopped | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Toast hoagie rolls over medium heat for 3 - 5 minutes until golden brown. In a small bowl, mix hoagie rolls and okonomiyaki sauce thoroughly. To serve, divide bean sprouts and bean mixture equally among the rolls. Spoon remaining hoagie rolls onto plate and top with orange peel and chili.

Random Ingredients: fenugreek seed,red wine vinegar,white poppy seed,chicken bouillon cube,beef bouillon,red chili paste,cauliflower
title: Chop Beef Stir Fry
ingredients: 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon roasted white poppy seeds | 1 teaspoon dried crushed fenugreek seeds ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon beef bouillon ( i use 2 in cube to make this vegetarian ) ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon red chili paste ( i use sriracha red chili paste ) ( optional ) | 2/3 cup coarsely chopped cauliflower | 1 chicken bouillon cube ( optional ) or 3 teaspoons beef flavored chicken stock ( optional )
instructions: In large mixing bowl, combine vinegar, poppy seeds, fenugreek, beef, water, red chili paste, and cabbage. Mix well to mix ingredients thoroughly. Add chicken bouillon or beef flavored stock and mix to mix well. Allow vegetables to marinate in mixture for 2 hours or over night in refrigerator.. If beef mixture is too dry, add a little water at a time, stirring well, until desired thickness is achieved. Serve with fideo, rice, or any side dish as the main filling is requested. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: mushroom,vanilla essence,sherry,italian sausage link,rotini pasta,almond extract,carrot,couscous
title: Moroccan Sausage & Pasta
ingredients: 500 g rotini pasta | 1 lb sweet italian sausage link | 125 g carrots | 100 g mushrooms | 1/4 cup sherry ( the good stuff ) | 1/2 teaspoon italian seasoning ( heaped 1tspns garlic & herb blend ) | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Cook pasta & drain. Brown sausages with carrots & mushrooms in a pan. Add remaining ingredients. Stir well & simmer on lowest setting for 2 hours. Serve immediately.

title: Pixie Dust
ingredients: 24 whole cloves | 12 vanilla wafers, crushed into small puffs
instructions: Put a few cloves into each vanilla wafer. Pack the crushed vanilla wafers into a cup. Fill the cup 1/2 inch or so full, with crushed vanilla wafers and leave room to set before removing from the carton. Store in an airtight freezer.

Random Ingredients: ice water,half cream,vanilla ice cream,anise seed,turmeric powder,pepperoni,paprika
title: Antilles-Style Rouladen
ingredients: 1 pint half-and-half cream or 1 pint whipping cream | 6 tablespoons ice water | 1 teaspoon paprika | 1 teaspoon anise seeds | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | pepperoni | vanilla ice cream
instructions: Pour the cream into a medium size saucepan with the whole spices. On medium heat bring the cream just to a boil. Stirring constantly, add the turmeric and pepperoni to the cream mixture. Once the cream is about to boil, turn off the heat and place in the refrigerator until it is time to serve. Serve the rouladen with vanilla ice cream.

title: Pwdin (Stuffed Crescent Rolls)
ingredients: 4 ounces prunes, chopped | 1/2 lb red currant jelly, melted | 3 ounces prune, chopped | 7 ounces crescent dinner rolls, split | 2 ml vanilla essence
instructions: Cook prunes and jelly with vanilla essence until the prunes have begun to release some water. Stir in prunes along with the split cresent rolls. Preheat oven to 175°c wrap each roll in greaseproof paper and secure with a floured fork. Put rolls in a casserole dish, then add enough hot water to come half way up the sides of the rolls. Cover and bake in the middle of oven for 40 minutes or until golden.

title: Hot Chili With Noodles
ingredients: 500 g uncooked rice noodles ( or rice sticks, cellophane noodles, dried noodles etc ) | 25 kaffir lime sweet chili peppers or 25 serrano peppers ( or any other hot chili like jamaican chilli paste, seeded and finely chopped )
instructions: Put the noodles in a colander over a bowl and pour boiling water over to cover. Leave for 3 to 5 minutes to soften, then drain. Place noodles and limes in a large heatproof bowl and cover with boiling water. Heat a small non stick frying pan over moderate heat. Add the sweet chili paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly. Quickly tip the noodles into the pan, and cover tightly with a lid. Allow the noodles to steam for a few minutes then drain, stirring the noodles every 5 minutes or so until they are sticky and coated with the sweet chili paste. You should have about 1 litre or more of hot noodle mix.

Random Ingredients: wide egg noodle,grain white rice,bailey irish cream,farina,extra virgin olive oil,double cream
title: Noodles With Whiskey Flavoured Bailey's Irish Cream
ingredients: 1 lb small wide egg noodles | 15 ounces reduced-sodium bailey's irish cream | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 2 1/4 cups long-grain white rice | 1 1/4 cups farina | 1 cup double cream
instructions: Simmer 1 cup water and 1 cup rice in a 3 to 4 quart heavy pot over high heat until rice is just tender. Meanwhile, in a small cup stir bailey's until smooth. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a medium skillet over medium high heat until shimmering but not smoking. Drain pasta, shaking off any excess. Add the drained rice and stir to coat. Add the bailey's and toss to coat. Taste, adjust seasoning with more bailey's if desired. Serve immediately.

title: Strawberries W- Peanut Sauce and Cool Whip.
ingredients: 1 package strawberries, washed and sliced | 3/4 cup sugar-free buttermilk | 1/2 cup crunchy peanut sauce | 2 cups cool whip ( i use dream whip )
instructions: In a deep baking dish spoon strawberries into the buttermilk.

title: The Perfect Tahini Sauce
ingredients: 4 tablespoons tahini paste | 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | hot sauce, to taste ( optional )
instructions: Mix well before serving. Use as an accompaniment to grilled meat, fish or noodles.

Random Ingredients: octopus,garlic salt,apricot,white truffle oil,pomegranate seed,mozzarella cheese,cider vinegar
title: Octopus Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 cups octopus, cut up | 2 tablespoons white truffle oil | 2 tablespoons pomegranate seeds | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 teaspoon cider vinegar | 1/3 cup white truffle oil | 1/2 cup chopped apricot, drained | 1 -2 cup shredded mozzarella cheese or 1 -2 cup fresh goat cheese
instructions: Prepare the octopus. Boil 10 minutes, then cool for 15 minutes. Remove and discard any large remaining bones. Separate the meat from the tentacles. In a bowl, combine truffle oil, pomegranate seeds, garlic, vinegar and olive oil. Add the octopus meat and marinate for 10 - 15 minutes. Before serving, add the feta and mozzarella and toss. Serve hot.

title: Wild Blueberry Veggie Salad
ingredients: 2 medium zucchini, halved and sliced | 1 cup frozen blueberries | 1 package cottage cheese | 1/4 cup celery rib, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon sazon seasoning | 1 carton frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Toss all ingredients together except whipped topping. Sprinkle mixture with whipped topping. Chill. This salad can also be made in a crockpot on high for the first few hours just keep on low while you prep the rest of the meal.

Random Ingredients: spring onion,eggplant,virgin olive oil,french onion,basil,wide rice noodle,meat
title: Ratatouille
ingredients: 1 medium eggplant | 1 bunch french onion | 2 tablespoons virgin olive oil | 1/2 lb ground meat or 1/2 lb sausage, cooked through in skillet until crumbly | 1 cup cooked broad rice noodles | basil | 1 -2 tablespoon fresh french fried onion
instructions: Peel eggplant, slice lengthwise and cut lengthwise into 1 slices. Scoop out core and seeds and cut in half crosswise. Put in a bowl, pour in enough water to cover and let stand for 15 minutes until fork tender. Rinse with cold water.

title: Irish Whiskey Glaze or Smoked Salmon (Smoked Salmon Glaze)
ingredients: 3 cups smoked salmon, from a can of smoked salmon ( you will likely need more if smoked salmon are on sale ) | 1 cup unsweetened cocoa | 1 cup whiskey ( or other liqueur ) ( optional )
instructions: If using smoked salmon, cut the skin lengthwise as thinly as possible. Place the salmon skin into a bowl and mash it with a potato masher for a couple of minutes so it is free of chunks. Add the cocoa, sugar, whiskey, or any other liqueur, and stir. This will make a nice spreadable glaze.

Random Ingredients: crabmeat,blueberry,white sugar,tamari soy sauce,chive,red potato,red leaf lettuce,sultana
title: Crab Blueberry Salad
ingredients: 1/3 cup tamari soy sauce | 1/4 cup white sugar | 1 can crabmeat, drained | 3 small red potatoes, cooked and cubed | 1/3 cup sultana | 1 red leaf lettuce, torn into bite-size pieces | 2 cups fresh blueberries, picked over, pitted and coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup chopped fresh chives
instructions: In a small bowl, mix 1/3 cup of tamari soy sauce and 1/4 cup of sugar. Spread the mixture over the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish, and set aside. In a large bowl, toss the potatoes, crabmeat, sultanas, and red leaf lettuce with tamari mixture. Pour over the reserved 1/3 cup of tamari soy sauce and sugar mixture, and toss to coat evenly. Arrange the blueberries over the top. Sprinkle with chopped chives, and serve.

title: Italian Breaded Peas
ingredients: 350 g fresh peas, cut in half | 1/2 cup sweet plain breadcrumbs ( about 20 slices of white bread ) | 50 g fresh white breadcrumbs | 60 g grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 degrees celsius. Place peas into a casserole dish with a little water. Cover and cook in the oven for about 45 minutes or until tender. Turn peas halfway through cooking. Place fresh breadcrumbs in a bowl and mix with the parmesan and 2 tablespoons of the grated fresh parmesan. Drain peas well. Toast bread in a frying pan over medium heat until golden. Place half of the breadcrumbs on top and sprinkle with the remaining cheese. Add remaining breadcrumbs and stir to combine.

title: Herb Chive - French Seasoned Salt
ingredients: 1 tablespoon snipped fresh thyme leave | 1 tablespoon snipped fresh lemon pepper
instructions: Mix thyme leaves, lemon pepper, and salt together in a bowl. Cover the bowl, cover and refrigerate 1 hour to develop flavors.

title: Bitterly Cinnamon Marsala Wine
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cinnamon ( about 2 inches square ) | 2 tablespoons dry marsala wine ( about 1/2 cup )
instructions: In a large wineglass, combine 2 tablespoons cinnamon and 1 tablespoon marsala. Stir to combine. Add the cinnamon mixture to the wine glass. Swirl in more cinnamon mixture if desired. Add 2 more cinnamon pieces if desired. Pour wine into glass. If desired, strain wine back into cup and return to empty pan to let the wine evaporate. Refrigerate until cold, usually a minimum of 3 hours. Stir to combine.

title: Swiss Cheese Side Item
ingredients: 1/2 cup shredded swiss cheese | 5 teaspoons dark sesame oil
instructions: Spread cheese on paper plate. Heat sesame oil in skillet over medium heat. Add swiss cheese. Cook until cheese is melted and bubbly. Turn cheese over.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,cream chicken soup,banana,coconut milk,ginger juice,ra el hanout spice mix,ice water
title: Banana Soup
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 1 cup coconut milk | 1/4 cup ginger juice | 1 large banana, cubed | 3 cups ice water ( as needed ) | ra el hanout spice mix ( optional ) or cumin ( optional )
instructions: Place all the ingredients into a stock pot and cook until bananas and vegetables are tender, about 2 hours. Mix together and serve.

title: Gluten-Free Spicy Quinoa With a Hint of Crunch
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 1/4 cup honey | 4 teapoon tea ( i use deco! ) | 1 chipotle pepper | 3/4 lb butchers kitchen twine
instructions: Boil the quinoa in salted water with the honey. As soon as the quinoa is almost done, throw in the teabags. It takes a while, the guar will be soft and loose like glue. It takes a few minutes to bind them together. Put the quinoa in a serving bowl. Toss with the chilie. Eat with your favourite vegetable. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: ziti pasta,tomato green chilies,bacon,bread crumb,butterscotch chip,noodle,lime zest,pasta sauce
title: Chicken Noodle Bake
ingredients: 12 ounces ziti pasta | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1 carton pasta sauce, i prefer butterscotch chip | 1/2 cup dry bread crumbs | 1 tablespoon lime zest | 1/2 cup butterscotch chips | 4 -6 slices bacon | 1 package precooked noodles ( i prefer butterscotch eggs )
instructions: Cook ziti according to package directions.

Random Ingredients: black cardamom pod,lemon pepper seasoning,canola oil,greek olive,jalapeno pepper,oregano
title: Spicy Greek Olives
ingredients: 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1/2 cup sliced jalapeno pepper | 1 cup sliced greek olives | 1 bunch fresh oregano, chopped | 2 1/2 tablespoons lemon pepper seasoning, or more to taste | 1/4 teaspoon ground black cardamom pods
instructions: Heat the canola oil in a skillet over medium heat. Stir in the jalapeno pepper, greek olives, oregano, lemon pepper seasoning, and black cardamom pods. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer until liquid has almost completly evaporated, 5 to 10 more minutes. Continue cooking and stirring frequently, 5 to 7 minutes more.

title: Southern Confectioners' Pepper Cream
ingredients: 1 tablespoon confectioners'sugar | 2 cups whole milk | freshly ground black pepper to taste
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the confectioners' sugar and milk. Heat the pepper cream in a small saucepan over medium heat until warm, but not hot. Pour the hot pepper cream over the confectioners' sugar mixture, and stir gently to combine until the confectioners' sugar is completely incorporated into the cream. Add black pepper to taste.

title: Sautéed Pumpkin and Pineapple With Oranges
ingredients: 1/2 large fresh poblano pepper | 1/2 medium yellow onion | 1/4 grated orange rind or 1/4 grated lemon, juice of ( i used both ) | 1 tablespoon cumin seed ( jeera ) | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon | 1/2 teaspoon dried dill | 3 whole pineapple slices with or ( 1 ounce ) canned pineapple, sliced | 1 cup old fashioned oats or 1 cup all-oat bran
instructions: Cut the pepper in half and remove the stem and seeds. Put in a medium pan, cover with water, add some salt. Bring it to a boil, then lower the heat and simmer for about 2 hours. Remove the pepper halves from the water and peel the skin. Chop coarsely, or grate coarsely. Cut onion into wedges. Put on a skillet and sauté with oil, cumin, lemon, cinnamon, dill, and the chopped pepper in the oil till vegetables are cooked, about 40 minutes. Add the pineapple slices and simmer till pineapple is hot through. Serve the pan with the orzo, or the cooked vegetables, and the orzo accompanied by grilled, chilled steak or chicken and fish.

Random Ingredients: strawberry jam,green chili salsa,almond paste,tomato jalapeno pepper,mustard,italian breadcrumb
title: Swiss Snack Dip II
ingredients: 1 can almond paste | 1 can tomato jalapeno peppers | 1 jar green chili salsa | 1 can strawberry jam | 3 teaspoons prepared mustard | 1/2 cup italian flavored breadcrumbs
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl. Shape into a party size amount or smaller, slice into serving size servings and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,macadamia nut,garlic salt,marjoram,butter,beef bouillon powder,spaghetti,corn tortilla strip
title: Chicken in a Tomato-Macadamia Nut Sauce
ingredients: 1 pound skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cut into strips | 1 tablespoon butter | 1/2 teaspoon beef bouillon powder | 2 teaspoons garlic salt | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1 teaspoon dried crushed peanuts | 2 teaspoons dried corn tortilla strips | 1 package uncooked spaghetti
instructions: Cook chicken in a large skillet over medium heat until lightly browned, about 10 minutes. Remove chicken from skillet, and set aside. Melt butter in the same skillet, and stir in the beef soup powder, garlic salt, marjoram, peanuts, and corn tortillas.

title: Pear and Olive Crostini
ingredients: 4 -5 medium ripe pears, peeled, cored and cut into 1/4 inch slices | 1 tablespoon potato starch | 7 -8 pitted black olives | salt and pepper | 1 baguette, sliced
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine pears, starch, and olives. Sprinkle salt and pepper over top.

Random Ingredients: irish cream,bamboo skewer,vegetable stock,lettuce,lemon juice,pepperoni,ladyfinger,white mushroom
title: Lettuce Wraps or "Lazy" Girl Scout Tiramisu
ingredients: 2 packages sliced fresh white mushrooms | 12 bamboo skewers | 24 ladyfingers, split | 1 1/2 cups fat free vegetable stock | 2 teaspoons lemon juice | 24 slices pepperoni, slices ( i use about 4-5 slices ) | 1/2 cup irish cream, such as bailey's | 24 lettuce, leaves separated
instructions: Prepare mushrooms and skewer the mushrooms and spayed skewers with a vegetable brush. In a small saucepan, over medium heat, bring the vegetable stock and lemon juice to a boil. Reduce heat, and simmer for 3 to 5 minutes. Reduce heat to low and stir in pepperoni slices. Soak lady fingers in the vegetable stock mixture for about 5 minutes, and then remove. Arrange on a plate with lady fingers, and place the hot pepperoni slices on them. Quickly drizzle the luscious hot stock mixture, and spread it over the lady fingers. Add 1/2 cup irish cream. Arrange remaining lady fingers in an even layer, and roll them up. Garnish with remaining irish cream. Serve with lettuce leaves if desired.

title: Glueys Fondue--Caramelized Orange and Lime
ingredients: 4 -5 very thin slices orange rind ( zest from 3 oranges ) | 3 tablespoons light brown sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Spread orange rind slices on aluminum foil and place in oven to dry for 8 - 10 hours or overnight. When done remove and place in stainless steel bowl. In bowl, combine brown sugar and orange juice. Beat on high speed until you can see small brown specks form by the liquid for around a minute or so. Do not be concerned about getting burned or the gloss from the orange will peel away. Transfer the syrup to a large glass bowl and allow to sit stirring occasionally. Note, be sure to remove the membrane from the side of each slice before blending, as it adds a subtle sweet flavor. Once it is completely dried, the color of the syrup will change and your goal is to get a caramelized/syrupy color with few tiny brown sugars.

title: Peanut Sauce for Steak
ingredients: 1 pound beef tenderloin steaks | 1 jumbo shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 cube chicken bouillon
instructions: Place steaks in a shallow baking dish. Add shrimp, bouillon cube, and enough water to cover.

title: Wild Gooseberry & Goatberry Stuffing
ingredients: 4 -5 ounces gooseberries, dried ( approx. 1 3/4 cups ) | 2 tablespoons mixed fresh chard leaves | 1/8 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 8 slices firm white bread
instructions: In a medium bowl, gently toss warm gooseberries with chard, nutmeg and pepper, to taste. Set a large square of well buttered or parchment lined baking dish at least 3/4 full with the gooseberry stuffing. Using a pastry wheel or sharp paring knife, trim off the crusts from the bread slices. Spread each with about 2 tablespoons goatberry mixture, spacing evenly to cover the inside. Roll the bread slices up, pressing any stuffing into the bread to adhere. Repeat with remaining bread slices. Arrange the coated bread slices in a single layer in the prepared baking dish and place under a preheated broiler or grill, about 4 to 5 minutes, or until the bottoms are browned. Let cool slightly on a wire rack.

Random Ingredients: crescent,french dressing,milk,curry powder,barbecue sauce,panko breadcrumb,breadcrumb,celery rib
title: Curried French Stick
ingredients: 1 can refrigerated crescent rolls | 1 cup milk | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 4 1/2 ounces refrigerated refrigerated french dressing | 3/4 cup panko breadcrumbs | 2/3 cup breadcrumbs | 2 celery ribs, chopped | 1/4 cup cattleman's original barbecue sauce
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f. Unroll crescent rolls and separate into 2 equal pieces. Separate dough into two balls. On a floured surface, lightly press each piece of dough to a 10 inch circle about three quarters of the size of your rectangle. Cut one of the circles lengthwise into three strips. Repeat until all 8 triangles are cut lengthwise at the center of each strip of dough. Tuck and crimp the edges of each triangles together with your fingers. Brush each triangle with the remaining milk. Place triangles 1 inch apart on an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until lightly browned. Meanwhile, combine panko, bread crumbs, and breadcrumbs in a large bowl. Stir in celery, barbecue sauce and baste. Dip each triangle into the panko mixture, coating well. Place on a serving platter and serve. If you are making the skewers and doing skewers in advance, place on cookie sheet and bake for 15 minutes. Serve with additional barbecue sauce.

title: Nana's Potatoes
ingredients: 1 broiler-fryer chickens | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 6 -8 small potatoes | 1 jar sliced pimientos, drained ( reserve liquid )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Dry chicken completely with paper towels. Place chicken on a wire rack in a roasting pan and sprinkle with baking soda. Place vegetables in roasting pan cavity. Cover with foil. Bake in preheated oven for 1 hour. Remove and pour off all but 2 tablespoons of the liquid in roasting pan. Sprinkle with pimientos, return to oven for 5 more minutes, stirring occasionally.

title: Curry Pork Chops
ingredients: 4 slices pork loin chops ( about 2/3 inch thick ) | 1/8 teaspoon coriander powder | 2 teaspoons curry powder
instructions: Combine coriander and curry powder in a small bowl.

title: Wedding Gift Special: Strawberries and Shreds
ingredients: 8 ounces extra firm tofu | 1 cup strawberry ( i use two medium ) | 2 slices white bread, crusts removed | 6 fluid ounces unsalted dry-roasted white wine ( such as chablis ) | cayenne, a few drops
instructions: Cut the solid block of tofu into bite size cubes about the size of the strawberries. If you prefer it to be somewhat chunky, slice into chunks about the size of the strawberries. The easiest way to do this is by hand to slice the block into four or eight even pieces of bread around about the size of the strawberries. If you don't have a food processor, you can grate the tofu pieces by hand. Cut the bread into small pieces about the size of the strawberries. If you use smaller bread, cut the bread in half horizontally. You can also cube the smaller cubes if you like a lotier texture, or you can cut in smaller pieces of bread in larger pieces. Wrap the pieces in aluminum foil and place them in the refrigerator for at least an hour. The longer you leave them in there the better and more flavor will come out.. When the mixture is firm and has the texture of ricotta cheese, rinse the blender with water to get rid of excess moisture a few times. Drain the tofu pieces on paper towels. Stir the wine into the liquid and set aside. Preheat the oven to 350°f. Take a baking dish and line the bottom of it with several layers of the bread, then a single layer of mixed pieces of tofu on top. Spread the strawberry puree on top of the croutons. The bread will be used to soak up the liquid, but the wine will be poured onto the strawberries and top with the shredded tofu. Sprinkle on a few shakes of cayenne pepper. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes. The tofu should be slightly crispy on top, and falling off of the bone. The pudding can be prepared ahead and frozen in an airtight container. The dish can also be served with saffron threads if desired.

title: Chicoryy Funghi Fry Bread
ingredients: 1/2 lb mushroom soup | 4 teaspoons active dry yeast ( or envelope ) | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1 1/2 cups unbleached oatmeal | fennel seed, crushed ( or black powder mixed with a little olive oil ) | 5 dried red chilies ( or more, depending on your heat tolerance ) | 1 envelope active dry yeast
instructions: In a small bowl soak or steam the dried red chilies in hot water for no more than 5 minutes do not scorch. Wrap the okra in plastic wrap or waxed paper and set aside. Mold mushrooms into 3 round balls. In mixing bowl, combine the two cans of mushrooms, soup stick, and yeast. Stir until combined and dissolved. Spoon into 4 - 5 quart greased loaf pans. Cover and store in a warm place for 4 to 24 hours. When cool, cover and refrigerate until ready to use. Sauce keeps well for several weeks in the refrigerator. Thin with a bit of water prior to making sandwiches or adding to bread or bread crumbs for bread crumbs.

Random Ingredients: white potato,white wine vinegar,thai fish sauce,kale,tart apple,pimiento,mayonnaise
title: Serve With Tuna & Cabbage & Smoked Potato Salad (Caldo Gallego)
ingredients: 6 cups white potatoes, scrubbed, peeled, cut in quarters ( about 2 medium ) | 1/3 cup mayonnaise ( or salad dressing ) | 2 teaspoons white wine vinegar | 1 jar sliced pimientos, drained, finely chopped ( or pimentos ) | 2 teaspoons thai fish sauce ( or soy sauce ) | 2 -3 cups kale, finely shredded or 2 -3 cups cabbage, finely shredded ( or green ) | 4 teaspoons fresh tart apple, julienned
instructions: Place potatoes in boiling water for 10 minutes or until tender but not overdone. Drain immediately. While potatoes are cooking dice potatoes. Place in a very large bowl. Mix in vinaigrette to salad until desired degree of doneness. Toss potatoes with mayonnaise and chopped pimentos. Arrange kale and chopped apple around potato mixture. Toss salad with vinaigrette.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,onion soup mix,beef brisket,watercress,linguine,corn syrup
title: Crispy Corn Beef Onions
ingredients: 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 1 pound beef brisket, trimmed | 1 onion soup mix | 1 cup water with 2 tablespoons corn syrup | 1/4 cup light corn syrup | 1 package dry linguine
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot until smoking over medium high heat. Sear brisket on all sides.

Random Ingredients: lemon zest,orange flower water,creamy peanut butter,topping,brandy,spanish onion,meat,rosemary sprig
title: Persian Meat Pie
ingredients: 3 lbs meat, patties | 1/2 cup creamy peanut butter | 1/2 cup brandy | 1/2 cup orange flower water | 1 sprig fresh rosemary sprig | 1 tablespoon lemon zest | 1 medium spanish onion, minced | 8 ounces frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Rinse meat well and dry with paper towels so the excess moisture can drain off before using. Prepare grill. Brush on a light mist of cooking spray or brush on melted butter. In a medium bowl, mix together peanut butter, brandy, orange flower water, rosemary and lemon zest. In a 9 pie plate, layer the meat in a line along the bottom with peanut butter sauce. Cover each layer with a layer of whipped topping, then a line of meat.

title: Thai Veal Curry
ingredients: 400 g veal, cut in thin strips | 1 tablespoon olive, minced | 3 slices coconut cut in half | 4 tablespoons hot lime hot chili sauce | salt & fresh ground pepper
instructions: Rub salt & pepper all over veal. Place 3 coconut halves in the middle of a double layer of foil. Place the veal strips on top, pressing down slightly. Sprinkle chili sauce on all sides of the veal. Top with remaining coconut slices, pressing down gently. Bake in an oven with the foil over medium heat for approximately 1 hour and 20 minutes, brushing once with lime juice before serving.

title: Quick and Easy Jalapeno-Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 250 g plain flour | 12 sheets lettuce leaves, stacked | 1 finely chopped jalapeno pepper
instructions: Mix the flour and jalepeno in a large bowl. Dredge one sheet of lettuce through the flour mixture until covered. Repeat with the remaining sheets of lettuce and lettuce. Heat a large non stick frying pan or cast iron griddle. Cook the wrapped wraps on both sides then remove them when they turn golden and crisp on the underside. Repeat the above process using the remaining stacked wraps.

Random Ingredients: meat,mushroom,serrano chili pepper,red curry paste,chicken wing,heavy whipping cream
title: Jamaican Steamed Chicken Wings (Laks)
ingredients: 1 lb chicken wings, separated at last cut in half crosswise | 2 fluid ounces red curry paste | 6 fluid ounces heavy whipping cream | 16 large mushrooms, cleaned sliced | 16 small serrano chili peppers, stemmed deseeded and sliced in half lengthwise | 2 cups cooked cooked meat, drained
instructions: Fill a wok with water and bring it to a boil. Dip the wings in the curry paste and let excess curry drip off. Add the cream to the water and bring mixture to a boil again. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes or until it thickens slightly. Remove from heat and transfer to a bowl to cool to room temperature. Arrange the mushrooms, peppers and the meat. Spoon the warm curry sauce over all and serve. Cook's note, chicken wings are best served slightly warm, but not hot.

title: Easy Mexican Barley
ingredients: 1 package frozen pearl barley | 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese | 1/2 cup shredded asiago cheese | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Bring a pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook Barley in the boiling water, stirring to separate the grains, until slightly tender, about 25 minutes. Drain and transfer to a 2 quart baking dish. Coat the mozzarella cheese with taco seasoning, and layer with barley in the baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven until the cheese is bubbling, 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Spicy Red Beans in Cuban Rum
ingredients: 1 can red kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 1/2 cup white wine | 3 tablespoons pineapple juice
instructions: Combine all ingredients, stir, and serve immediately over ice.

Random Ingredients: avocado,brandy,pork butt,green chili pepper,chili paste,cardamom powder,radish,heavy whipping cream
title: Smoked Pork Naan
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless pork butt | 1 cup brandy | 1/2 cup green chili pepper, chopped | 4 drops chili paste | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom powder | 15 green chili peppers, seeded, chopped | 1/8 teaspoon cardamom powder | 3 1/4 cups heavy whipping cream | radish | avocado
instructions: Preheat oven to 475 degrees f. Sprinkle pork with brandy and mix thoroughly. Place on a rack in a roasting pan and broil until browned, about 15 minutes. Let meat rest for 10 minutes. Place roasting pan on a larger baking sheet in oven, remove fat and set aside. Mix chili paste into cream the whipping cream in a large bowl. Remove top piece of string from chile peppers and cut lengthwise down center. With a small spoon make small indentations across mixture. Cut a slit in center of pork chop and stuff with cream mixture. Arrange stuffed chiles on top of meat and bake 15 minutes, basting occasionally with cream mixture. Garnish with green chili pepper, chili paste and cardamon. Serve with slices of avocado.

title: Easy Brazilian Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken breast fillets | 1 green bell pepper, chopped
instructions: Pre heat oven to 200c. Line a baking tray with baking paper. Using a sharp knife, cut the chicken between 2 sheets of baking paper into 2cm thick slices. Place the chicken onto the tray with the green pepper and cut another round of paper from the other side of the chicken. The strips will need to be long enough to make a single layer across the base of each slice, but it should not overlap the other side. Cook in the oven for about 25 minutes, or until cooked to your liking. Use your hands to serve straight from the tray.

title: Cloudy Asafetida (Aceh Rid of Blushing)
ingredients: cloudberries ( clean ) | 4 small water chestnuts | 2 tablespoons cloudberries ( clean ) | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder
instructions: Clean cloudberries and cut berries into small pieces. Clean water chestnuts thoroughly and remove any outer skin and seeds. Make the cloudberry water as instructed above. Do not wash the cloudberries and chestnuts clean. Take a spoon and place some water chestnut crumbs into the cup with which the cloudberries are packed and mix with a little asafoetida. After sprinkling on cloudberries, cloudberries will smell wonderful.

title: Carrots and White Bread
ingredients: 1 lb carrot, peeled | 4 slices white bread, lightly toasted
instructions: Peel the carrots and cut them into slices. Place them in a saucepan of boiling water, cover and cook for about 10 minutes. Strain the carrots and put in a bowl. Mash them with a fork, or mix them with the bread. Spread the carrots and bread on baking paper, sprinkle with salt and ground black pepper, broil in a hot oven for 3 to 5 minutes, or until crisp.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,red capsicum,cream tartar,cauliflower floret,cucumber,green cardamom pod,orange juice
title: Mexican Cheese Salad
ingredients: 2 ounces mild shredded mexican cheese | 1 red capsicum, sliced | 1 medium size cucumber, cut into long strips | 1 can orange juice | 1 green cardamom pod, ground | 1 small cauliflower floret, cut into small florets | 2 teaspoons cream of tartar
instructions: Combine the cheese in a medium sized bowl. Add the capsicum, cucumber, orange juice, cardamom pods and cauliflower. Mix well. In a small dish blend 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar with a little cold water to make a thin dipping consistency. Pour cream of tartar over salad and sprinkle with remaining cheese.

Random Ingredients: spice,corn tortilla,saffron,beef bouillon cube,cream chicken soup,grape tomato
title: Tortilla Soup IV
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 beef base or 1 beef bouillon cube | 2 cubes spices ( i like saffron ) | 1/2 cup grape tomatoes ( or any other tomato, i use kalamata ) | 12 small corn tortillas, cut into 1 inch squares | spices ( as preferred ) | saffron, to taste
instructions: In a large saucepan over medium heat and whip cream of chicken soup with beef base cube until well blended. Add all ingredients and simmer, stirring often, for 20 minutes. Serve in tortilla squares, sprinkle with spice and sour cream if desired. You can also freeze these in a plastic ziplock bag until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: topping,jumbo shrimp,black eyed pea,mint leaf,black bean,red pepper flake,cornflour
title: Spiced Black-Eyed Shrimp With Black Beans
ingredients: 1 lb jumbo shrimp, cleaned | 150 g black-eyed peas, rinsed and drained | 1/4 cup fresh mint leaves | 1/4 cup red pepper flakes | 1/2 cup frozen whipped topping, thawed | 3 tablespoons cornflour, dissolved in | 1 cup fresh black-eyed peas ( can be purchased in a jar in the supermarket ) or 3 tablespoons peas, from the can ( can be purchased in a jars in the supermarket )
instructions: Place shrimp, black eyed peas, mint leaves, red pepper flakes, thawed whipped topping and cornflour or plain flour in large bowl and stir to combine. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes or until shrimp curl slightly. Remove from fridge and toss through mixture. Serve immediately. Note, for a spicier dish, leave out the red hot pepper flakes and remove any skin that remains on the shrimp.

Random Ingredients: panko breadcrumb,chorizo sausage,picante sauce,tomato juice,golden syrup,ketchup
title: Picante Spud
ingredients: 2 cups panko breadcrumbs | 6 -8 chorizo sausages | 1/4 cup tomato juice | 1/3 cup ketchup | 1 - 1 1/2 cup picante sauce ( mild or medium `` hot '', if you can't find it ) | 2 tablespoons golden syrup
instructions: Sauté the chorizo in a skillet over medium high heat until starting to brown around its outsides, about 5 minutes. While the chorizo is sizzling, in a large bowl, stir together the panko crumbs, tomato juice, ketchup, picante sauce and golden syrup. Drain the chorizo, slice thinly and add to bowl with the panko crumb mixture. Mix well, adding water until the mixture is just moistened. Turn the heat to low. Pour a few tablespoons of water into the skillet and stir until the mixture coats the bottom. Turn the heat up up to medium/medium high and quickly stir in the picante sauce. Let simmer until the sauce has thickened and coats the back of a spoon, 10 - 15 minutes. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: black eyed pea,green salsa,salt pepper,sugar,italian seasoning,allspice berry,tomato
title: Italian Black-Eyed Peas
ingredients: 3 tablespoons mild green salsa ( or more ) | 1 can diced tomatoes ( regular canned tomatoes works just as good ) | 1 can black-eyed peas, rinsed and drained ( or frozen peas ) | 1/2 teaspoon allspice berry, spice blend | 1/2 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon sugar | salt and pepper
instructions: In a 2 - ½ quart baking dish, mix all ingredients except for the beans, mix well. Place the frozen peas on top and sprinkle with spice mix. Do not stir. Cover with plastic wrap and let marinate for 24 hours. Preheat oven to 325°f place the baking dish on a cookie sheet and bake 45 - 50 minutes or until peas are hot and bubbling.

title: Champagne Jelly With Cloudberries
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups chilled champagne | 9 ounces chancarrones mushroom | cloudberry jam or raspberry jam
instructions: Place theChampagne and chancarrones in a pan, bring to a boil, then lower the heat and simmer until the chicarones have dissolved. Remove from the heat, drain, and cool. Remove the tough stems of the chicarrones. Chop the chicarones into cubes. Break off any stems of cloudberries or raspberries with your fingers. Cut into 1/2 inch lengths and put them in a small bowl with some of the hot chicharones. Add a few tablespoons of the hot champagne to each cloudberry, fold into the cloudberry mixture. Spoon half of the mixture into two or three jelly jars. Cover with remaining champagne mixture and seal the jars. Place three or four cloudberries on each of the 4 plates. Serve warm, but not hot.

title: Spinach With Yogurt and Honey
ingredients: 1 cup loosely packed baby spinach | 1/4 cup fresh lemon juice | 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
instructions: Place spinach leaves in a large serving bowl and sprinkle with lemon juice and vanilla.

Random Ingredients: caraway seed,szechuan peppercorn,peanut oil vegetable,chambord raspberry liquor,cognac,bouillon cube,sage leaf
title: Grpa-Ri-Pao(Maltese Hot Chocolate)
ingredients: 1/4 cup salted peanut oil or 1/4 cupvegetable oil | 3/4 tablespoon caraway seed | 2 tablespoons szechuan peppercorns | 6 -8 large fresh sage leaves | 3 1/2 cups bouillon cubes | 2 cups cognac | 1 tablespoon chambord raspberry liquor ( or raspberry liqueur )
instructions: Combine the peanut oil, caraway seeds, peppercorns, sage and bouillon in a small sauté pan, on medium low heat. Keep stirring over low heat. Add the liquer. Keep stirring until the contents become a rich orange color. This should take 3 to 6 minutes or so. Remove from heat. Place over low heat and add the cognac. Mix a few seconds until the alcohol cooks off. Then pour over ice to serve.

Random Ingredients: fine sea salt,yellow bell pepper,cheese,corn,cannellini bean,gold tequila,snow pea
title: Tequila Bean and Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces canned cannellini beans, drained | 3/4 cup yellow bell pepper, chopped | 1 cup frozen corn, thawed | 2/3 cup extra light gold tequila | 1/4 cup canned corn, drained | 1/2 cup canned sliced sweet corn ( yellow or white ) | 2 tablespoons coarsely chopped gourmet cheese, such as grana padano ( preferably a mexican blend, such as valda garlic ) | fine sea salt, to taste
instructions: Combine beans, bell pepper, frozen corn, and tequila in a large bowl. Fold in half of the corn. Stir in remaining corn, sprinkle with cheese, and sea salt. Toss. Serve immediately. Recipe courtesy of salsa verde by marjestom dianersley ~ for more of an east indies touch ~.

title: Cheesy Fava Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 can fava beans ( drained ) | 1 package velveeta cheese | 1/2 cup half-and-half cream ( i prefer vanilla ) | 2 teaspoons oyster sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in blender and mix well. Microwave on medium high for 30 seconds or until cheese is melted and mixture is slightly thickened. Serve in pie bowl with toasted bagels and crackers.

title: Thai Lemongrass Stock
ingredients: 1 teaspoon fresh lemongrass, stalk trimmed | 2 bay leaves
instructions: Cut ends off lemongrass stalk and discard. Cut away and discard inner membrane. Slice lemongrass into 1/8 inch rounds. Place lemongrass into a medium bowl. Stir in bay leaves.

title: Crock Pot Pork Medallions
ingredients: 6 pork tenderloin or ( 2 lb ) pork tenderloins | 4 cups chopped snow peas
instructions: Place tenderloins in a slow cooker. Add snow peas, if using. Cover and cook on low 4 - 5 hours. Uncover and cook on high 3 minutes. Serve.

title: Spicy Grilled Fish
ingredients: 1 1 lbs fresh broccoli ( cleaned and cut into florets ) | 1 teaspoon ground anise seed | 1 tablespoon curry powder | 1/3 cup barbecue sauce | 1/3 cup corn ( fresh or canned ) | 1/2 cup hard-boiled egg
instructions: Combine first 7 ingredients. Place on rack over gas grill or place under broiler as desired cook for 8 - 10 minutes until fish flakes easily with fork. Garnish with egg. Serve with rice or fried plantains.

Random Ingredients: triple sec,pizza sauce,artichoke heart,white pepper,maple syrup,green chili pepper,confectioner ' sugar,green tomato
title: Artichoke Salad
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs green tomatoes, sliced | 2 cans artichoke hearts, in water, drained and chopped | 5 cans mild pickled hot green chili peppers or 5 cans hot red chili peppers, chopped | 1 bottle pizza sauce | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar | 1/2 cup maple syrup | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper | 3 teaspoons triple sec or 3 teaspoons grand marnier
instructions: In deep frying oil, stir fry green tomatoes and artichoke hearts in batches to coat. Drain on paper towels. Mix pizza sauce, confectioners sugar, syrup, pepper and triple sec in a small bowl. Spoon equal amounts of sauce into a large bowl and top with artichoke mixture. Chill until ready to serve.

title: Mango and Beet Salad
ingredients: 4 large beet leaves, scrubbed | 1 tomatoes, sliced | 1 cup mango, peeled with skin on, seeded and thinly sliced | 3 green olives, pitted, halved | 1 ripe mango, peeled, pitted and cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1 pinch nutmeg
instructions: Place the beet leaves in a large shallow bowl. Toss with a little oil or water, then add to the beet leaves. Add the tomato, mango, olives, and nutmeg. Mix well. Mash the beet leaves with a potato masher over boiling water to loosen the crunchy, sticky greens.

title: Chef John's Lettuce Appetizer
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1 pound butter flavored lettuce, shredded | 1 cup crushed unsalted butter flavored crackers
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a skillet over medium heat. Cook butter flavored crackers in the oil until golden brown, 3 to 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,orange,turnip,baking cocoa,red chile pepper,pizza sauce,red spanish onion,tamarind pulp
title: Mexican Turnip Muffins
ingredients: 2 pounds turnips - peeled, halved, and peeled | 2 tablespoons red chile pepper, chopped, or more to taste | 4 red spanish onions, finely diced | 1/2 cup plain graham cracker crumbs | 1 tablespoon baking cocoa | 1 can store-dried tamarind pulp | 2/3 cup store-bought pizza sauce | 2/3 cup taco-flavored prepared pizza sauce
instructions: Preheat grill for medium high heat and lightly oil the grate. Combine turnips, red chile pepper, and red onions together in a large bowl.

title: Baked German Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb cream cheese, at room temp | 1 tablespoon vodka ( or brandy if very sweet ) | 3/4 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1/2 teaspoon dark sesame oil
instructions: Mix the cream cheese, vodka, marjoram and oils until well blended. Cover and chill for up to 24 hours before spreading on bread. The cheese must be spread to 1/4 thick or thicker. Spread on a piece of wax paper or parchment paper until it is all gone. Place in refrigerator to chill overnight. Variation, for a slightly heavier or more festive touch, omit paprika, paprika, and/or other ground spices.

title: Pasta de Frijoles Con Limoncello (Pasta with Beans and Chicken)
ingredients: 1 package dried farfalle pasta | 1 lb fresh jalapenos or 1 lb red chili peppers | 1 lb carrots or 1 lb baby carrots, coarsely grated | 1 cup cooked beans ( your choice, i use frozen ) | lemon ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Cook pasta according to directions, until al dente. Cool to room temperature. Chop canned vegetables fine and mix with pasta. Add lemon, if using. Serve.

title: Pesto Dipping Sauce (Yummo)
ingredients: 1/2 lb pesto sauce ( refrigerated ) | 1/2 lb pistachios, coarsely chopped
instructions: Pesto sauce, bring large pot of water to simmering. Remove from heat. Stir in pesto and pistachios. Cover and let stand 10 minutes. Place in jar and shake well to coat. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Trout With Tomato Sauce and Oats
ingredients: 2 large tomatoes, chopped | 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 1 large garlic clove, minced | 1 lb ripe fresh mixed vegetables or 1 lb frozen mixed vegetables | 1/4 cup tomato sauce or 1/4 cup tomato puree | 2 tablespoons grated oat | 1/2 teaspoon hot sauce ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in medium shallow bowl. Cover and chill 3 hours, tossing once or twice. Place vegetables in another medium non reactive bowl, drizzle with olive oil, tossing to coat. Heat heavy large non stick skillet over high heat. Sprinkle vegetables with salt and pepper.

title: Pasta in the Vineyard
ingredients: 2 ounces pasta of your choice | 1 tablespoon grapeseed oil or 1 tablespoon sunflower oil | 20 dates, pitted and coarsely chopped
instructions: Bring a pan of water to the boil. Add the pasta and cook for 10 mins or until just cooked. Drain and set aside. Heat the oil in a deep skillet and brown the grapeseeded tomatoes for a couple of mins, then add the pasta and simmer for 2 mins stirring often. Sprinkle over the dates and serve immediately.

title: Curried Apple With Apricots (Or All Tomatoes)
ingredients: 6 tart apples, sliced into small pieces ( i prefer the mcintosh brand ) | chopped dried apricot ( or dried plums ) | 2 tablespoons curry powder | 2 tablespoons curry
instructions: Put the curry powder into a skillet and fry until fragrant. Add the curry and cook for about a minute until it is fragrant. Add all of the apples and half the apricots, mix well and cover. Place on low heat for 15 minutes without turning. Serve on toast.

title: Roasted Pumpkin and Brie Stir Fry
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1 1/2 lbs pumpkin ( about 2 3/4 lbs ) | 3 ounces prepared brie cheese | 2/3 cup dry spinach
instructions: Preheat broiler. Line baking sheet with tin foil and spray generously with cooking spray. Slice pumpkin 1/3 in thick. Cut brie in half crosswise. Sprinkle 1/3 of onions on cut side of each piece and top with pumpkin slices, then drizzle with olive oil, tumeric, and 1 tbs water.

title: Mexican Rice
ingredients: 12 ounces white rice, uncooked | 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 1/4 teaspoon saffron | 1/2 cup picante sauce | 1 can cream-style sweet corn | hazelnuts or crushed almonds, toasted
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. Meanwhile, heat syrup, saffron, picante sauce, and corn. Drain rice and add to mixture. Scoop into serving bowl and garnish with hazelnuts or crushed slivers.

Random Ingredients: white fish fillet,orange zest,dill pickle relish,pearl barley,green pepper,tomato,beet,mango
title: Tropical Fish Barley Salad With Mango Dressing
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs red skinned firm white fish fillets | 1/2 cup pearl barley | 2 large tomatoes, diced | 1 large ripe mango, diced | 1/2 green pepper, diced | 1/2 cup peeled seeded diced beet | 3 tablespoons reduced fat dill pickle relish | 2 teaspoons orange zest
instructions: Bring 2cups water to the boil in a heavy bottomed saucepan. Add the barley and cook, uncovered, for 30 minutes. Cool completely. Cut fish into 3/4 thick slices. Pour 2 tablespoons water into cold, nonrhined saucepan. Add tomatoes, mango, and green pepper and simmer, partially covered, for 5 minutes. Drain, then toss with barley and diced, cooked beets, relish and orange zest.

title: Mixed Raisins
ingredients: 4 -5 cups mixed raisins, rinsed, patted dry and damp | salt & pepper
instructions: Place raisins in a pan and cover with cold. 7 cups of water. Cook over a low heat until dry but not mushy. About 1 hour 30 minutes should be plenty of moistness at this point. Some kinds of raisins may require a more tender gravy than others. I have tried it with other types of currants, prunes and prunes. I don't quite understand what this is, it is about the salt and pepper, and i like them both. If yours are on a firmer raisin, just cook them longer and drain any excess moisture from the frying pan. Pour the mixed raisins into a mixing bowl and add the salt and pepper and mix well until all ingredients are incorporated and the raisins are evenly mixed. Let the stew cool to room temperature slightly, then chill overnight. The next day, remove the salt from the stew, stir well and serve.

Random Ingredients: worcestershire sauce,basil pesto,thyme leave,dark chocolate,fillet tilapia
title: Pesto Steak Fillet With Crispy Chocolate
ingredients: 1 lb flank steaks or 1 lb sirloin steak fillet | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon basil pesto | 1 teaspoon thyme leave | 1 dark chocolate piece
instructions: Heat a medium skillet to medium high heat. Add the beef and cook until browned, about 3 minutes per side or to taste. Add worcestershire sauce and pesto. Place on a warm plate. Melt chocolate and sprinkle on top. Serve with strips of beef.

title: Blueberry Chicken Dinner
ingredients: 1/2 lb bacon | 1 lb fresh frozen cooked meatballs | 4 lbs red potatoes | 24 fresh blueberries ( from nova scotia or british berry ) | 8 medium boneless skinless chicken thighs, halved crosswise
instructions: In 12 inch skillet, heat bacon until just crisp. Using slotted spoon, transfer bacon to paper towels and reserve. Using slotted spoon, remove all but 2 tablespoons grease from skillet and set aside. In second skillet, cook meatballs until browned and crumbly, about 10 minutes. Stir half of reserved bacon drippings into meatballs.

Random Ingredients: cumin,mexicorn,cremini mushroom,thai red chili pepper,garlic clove,curry powder,asparagus spear
title: Quick Curry Nests
ingredients: 1/2 lb asparagus spear, tips cut off | 1/2 lb cremini mushroom, cut diagonally into 1-inch sections | 1 cup canned mexicorn | 3 garlic cloves, peeled and slightly crushed | 3 -5 small thai red chili peppers, seeded and chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons curry powder | 1/2 teaspoon dried cumin
instructions: Boil asparagus tips for 2 minutes. Drain and cut tips into 1/2 inch pieces. In a large skillet, sauté mushrooms and garlic over medium heat until limp.

Random Ingredients: rosemary leaf,sausage,shallot,white sugar,white cheddar cheese,italian parsley
title: Sausage, Cheddar & Rosemary Rolls
ingredients: 1 package sausages | 8 ounces white irish cheddar cheese | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh italian parsley | 2 tablespoons chopped shallots | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh rosemary leaves | 1 teaspoon white sugar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Using a serrated knife, cut the sausages 3/4 inch thick. Place the sausages in a shallow baking dish. Break off any excess fat from the sausages, and sprinkle over the cheese, then scatter over the parsley, shallots, rosemary and remaining ingredients. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes in the preheated oven, until the cheese has melted and the sausage is bubbly and filling is heated through, and bubbling.

title: Wild Rice-Rice Salad
ingredients: 3/4 lb wild rice | 1 tablespoon fresh ginger root, grated | 1 cup plain yogurt | 1 head bibb lettuce, washed and trimmed
instructions: Cook wild rice according to package directions. Let cool. Combine wild rice with grated ginger in a bowl. Add yogurt, and gently stir to combine. Toss with rice, and serve. Note, use extra yogurt to drizzle over top.

title: Dee's Applesauce & Meat Stuffing
ingredients: 1 kg ground veal | 1 kg applesauce | 1 kg chopped frozen apples ( no need to peel ) | 1 liter chicken stock | 100 g bread, cubes | 100 g parmesan cheese | 60 ml balsamic vinegar
instructions: Put ground veal through a bowl and mix with the other ingredients. Put stuffing in casserole put in mix. Bake. Bake for 1 hour on 180°c remove after 30 minutes and stir with fork.

title: Sangkhaya
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups rice, prepared | 1/2 cup rhubarb, chopped | 3 teaspoons anise seed | 3 teaspoons cashews, chopped | 1 1/2 cups apple juice ( or use apple cider with a little sugar ) | 1/2 cup appenzane bean ( or use canned beans )
instructions: Soak rice until water is clear. Boil rice in 2 cups water until it is tender. Drain well and add to rhubarb. Garnish with cashews, anise, cashew nuts, apple juice, and the beans. Enjoy.

title: Mexican-Style Rice Bowl (Rice)
ingredients: 1 cup rice, uncooked | 1 cup chunky salsa ( homemade or from a jar of your favorite salsa ) | 1 mint leaf ( optional )
instructions: Mix the rice and salsa. Place a mint leaf ( optional ) in the rice for color and flavor, if desired. Serve piping hot.

Random Ingredients: cashew,salad oil,potato,ear corn cob,white pepper powder
title: Spicy Indian Corn on the Cob #5FIX
ingredients: 1 package simply potatoes diced potatoes with onion | 1 bunch ear corn on the cob | 2 tablespoons salad oil | 1 teaspoon white pepper powder | 1/4 cup cashews, chopped for garnish
instructions: Heat the oven to 400 degrees. Combine all ingredients in a nonstick pan and bring to the boil. Simmer over low heat for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally and adding additional cashew nuts if desired. If the cashews are not completely coated with oil or are dry, stir them into the cooking until they are a little crispy. If you wish to thicken the sauce for serving, simply warm it through in a medium saucepan. Enjoy,.

Random Ingredients: lime juice,caramel ice cream topping,dark rye bread,tuna,pecorino romano cheese,oat bran,allspice
title: Tuna and Pearls
ingredients: 12 slices dark rye bread, crusts removed | 12 pieces canned tuna, drained | 1/2 cup old-fashioned oats, such as bob's red mill scottish oat bran ( about 5 slices whole wheat or white ) | 1/4 cup pecorino romano cheese, freshly grated | 2 tablespoons freshly squeezed lime juice | allspice, ground | caramel ice cream topping, optional ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Place 1 slice of the bread on your counter and sprinkle with a pinch or two of salt. Using a melonballer, squeeze out the center part of a pearlet about 2 tablespoons of the bread. Cut the larger piece in half and set aside. Repeat with the tuna, oat bran and the bread to make 3 more tuna slices. Toss the filling ingredients together in a bowl except for the caramel topping. Divide the filling among the bread slices. Top each slice with a second slice of bread, making sure the fillings are evenly distributed. Top each sandwich with the caramel topping if using, if desired. Place a large bamboo skewer or long toothpick in the center of each sandwich and set over a plate. Place a small, heavy object on top of each sandwich, keeping the weight firmly on your hand as you roll. Repeat with remaining sandwiches until the filling serves up to 2 sandwiches. Wear a long, heavy metal bowl or small serving platter to set the sandwiches before your guests arrive. Serve with ice cream for a wonderful treat or a delightful treat of your choice. The pearls can be served hot or cold. Variation, for a more substantial meal, you could serve these with a combination of the caramel sauce and a dollop of caramel ice cream.

Random Ingredients: milk chocolate,agave nectar,topping,sirloin steak,jalapeno pepper,ancho chile powder
title: Achiote Beef
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin steak, cut into about 1-inch cubes, about 2 cups | 4 tablespoons agave nectar | 4 tablespoons milk chocolate, melted | 1 tablespoon dried ancho chile powder | 1 medium chopped jalapeno pepper
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well.

title: Pizza Caccia
ingredients: 1 pizza dough ( or more ) | 2 -3 slices prosciutto or 2 -3 slices soudon cheese, 1-inch thick | 1/4 cup canned tomato soup
instructions: Mix all ingredients in processor. Use with knife to cut pizza dough into 2 pieces or more. Place on lightly greased baking sheet. Bake in hot oven for 15 - 20 minutes until crust is golden, bubbling and browning. Variation, substitute 1/4 cup sliced provolone cheese for provolone or provolone cheese.

title: Spicy Low Cal Low Fat French Silk Pie
ingredients: 3 large low fat potatoes, peeled and diced into 1/2 inch cubes | 2 -3 scallions, chopped into 1/2 inch pieces ( depending on how sweet you want it ) | 1/2 cup vanilla-flavored soymilk | 1 teaspoon chili paste ( optional )
instructions: Steam your potatoes and scallions until semi soft and almost falling apart. While still warm, blend with soy milk and spices. Put the pot on the stove and cook until the sauce thickens.. Pour mixture onto plate and refrigerate at least 4 hours. Enjoy with a tall glass of ice cold black chocolate or a cup of tea sweetened by vanilla essence.

title: Saffron Tarte Tatin (Baked or Filled)
ingredients: 4 -6 tablespoons flour | 1/4 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1/8 teaspoon saffron | 2 tablespoons tamarind paste ( see note ) | 1 ready-made pie crust, chilled ( see note )
instructions: Preheat oven to 475 degrees fahrenheit. Mix the flour, seasoned salt and saffron and spread evenly over the bottom of the pie crust. Mix the tamarind paste with 1 tablespoon water and add to the filling. Do not stir, just shake off a little bit of the excess flour. Make sure mixture is moist enough to cover bottom of pie crust. Cover with top crust. Bake 5 minutes, then reduce heat to 375 degrees fahrenheit and bake 50 minutes. If pie starts to get brown too quickly, cover with foil. Celine the edges and serve with butter. Note, a pinch or a pinch of saffron seeds can be added to thicken the sauce just before serving if desired.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno pepper,golden raisin,beef bouillon cube,white flour,tomato,rye bread,cocoa
title: New York Style Irish Bread
ingredients: 1 lb sourdough round rye bread, sliced into 4 sections | 2 lbs ground beef round | 2 tablespoons light cocoa | 1 can fire-roasted crushed tomatoes, undrained | 1 3/4 tablespoons golden raisins | 1 jalapeno pepper, sliced | 1 beef bouillon cube
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. In a bowl, mix all ingredients, except for the bread, together until they are well blended. Line a large, oven proof skillet with foil. Transfer the bread mixture in a layer onto the foil. Wrap the foil around the bread and bake for one hour in the preheated oven. When done, remove from skillet and let cool for at least 20 minutes. Cut into 1/2 inch slices.

title: Mango Chutney on Toast
ingredients: 3/4 cup mango chutney ( korma ) | 3/4 cup sugar
instructions: Combine all ingredients in small bowl.

title: Smoky Sage Crisps
ingredients: 3 cups coarsely ground shortening ( such as crisco ) | 1/3 cup light vegetable smoke flavoring | 1 teaspoon dried sage | 2 1/2 teaspoons liquid smoke
instructions: Stir together the shortening with the vegetable smoke flavoring, sage, and liquid smoke. Shape the mixture into 1 inch balls and roll each in the toasted marshmallow crumbs to coat. Store the crumbs in a tightly covered, heavy resealable plastic bag for up to 2 weeks.

Random Ingredients: english cucumber,black pepper,cheese,tart apple,clear honey,baby back rib,water,golden raisin
title: Apple, Raisin and Honey Tender Ribs
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg baby back ribs | 6 slices cheese, sliced | 1 slice english cucumber, halved, deseeded and thinly sliced | 50 g golden raisins | 1/2 teaspoon black pepper | 85 g water | 1/4 cup clear honey | 1 medium tart apple, unpeeled, cored and thinly sliced | 1/2 cup english cucumber, halved, deseeded and thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat a grill pan or barbecue grill to medium high. Using a sharp knife, score the membrane on the underside of each side of each rib. Spread 2 slices of cheese on each side of each rib. Place the cooked rib on the grill base. Top each rib with a slice of english cucumber, followed by the raisins, followed by the black pepper, followed by the water. Place the lid on the grill and cook until the sugar has dissolved. While the sauce is cooking transfer the remaining ingredients to a saucepan and place over a high heat. Cook, stirring, until the honey is hot. Serve straight from the cooking pan.

title: Pollo Con Chianti--Pollo Con Arrabbiata
ingredients: 100 g chicken | 1 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Cut the chicken into pieces about 4 to 6 inches long by 1 to 1 1/2 inches wide and 1 tablespoon each. Put the pieces in an oven proof casserole dish. Sprinkle the cheese over, cover and roast in a 350°f oven for about 45 min, or until the chicken is cooked.

Random Ingredients: yeast,french bread,graham cracker crumb,salt black pepper
title: French Bread With Crust
ingredients: 1 (.25 ounce ) package active dry yeast | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1 pinch salt | 6 3/4 cups french bread, sliced thick | 3 cups salt black pepper
instructions: Place oven rack in middle of oven. Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a large bowl, dissolve yeast in water. Let stand 10 minutes. Meanwhile, lightly grease a glass baking dish. Sprinkle graham cracker crumbs over bottom of an 8 inch baking dish. Dunk sliced bread slices in yeast mixture, then in crumbs, coating generously. Place bread in prepared baking dish. Cut a slit in top of bread with a sharp knife, and poke a few holes in the bread with a skewer. Let dough rise 1 hour, then spread with cracker crumbs. Sprinkle top with salt and pepper. Place in a preheated oven, and bake until crust is lightly browned around the edges, about 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheddar cheese,pastry,red food coloring,rice wine,jumbo shrimp,gingerroot
title: Shrimp & Rice Wine Pie (Pressure Cooker)
ingredients: 32 jumbo shrimp, uncooked, peeled | 1 teaspoon fresh gingerroot, finely grated | 1/2 medium size crusty pastry dough ( prepared from a 17 ounce pastry disc ) | 1/2 cup rice wine ( dry or medium ) | 1/2 cup monterey jack and cheddar cheese blend cheese blend and finely shredded gingerroot | 1 drop red food coloring ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees. Cut the crust of the pastry disc in half. Carefully remove the edge of the pastry shell to cut out an edge. Place the shrimp, peeled and deveined, 1/4 inch cube of ginger and 1/2 teaspoon salt in a 9 pie plate, cover with the crust, and smooth out the top. Drizzle rice wine evenly on top, using a teaspoon to drop small droplets of wine in, if necessary. Combine cheese and shredded ginger. Sprinkle over shrimp. Make a slit in the crust in the crust, and run a spatula along the side of the crust to loosen. Press the shrimp to the sides of the rim, and place in a small baking dish. If possible, spray the bottom crust of the pie shell with cooking spray. Spritz the top crust with water, and spray water again. Place in the oven and bake pie for 45 - 55 minutes. If the crust crust is a pale gold, you will likely need to add a little more water in the cooking process. Note, you may have to use a bit more wine, to get the right color.

title: Pasta With Beans and Chiles
ingredients: 1 can great northern beans | 1 cup pasta, any shape | 4 -6 serrano chilies
instructions: Drain both cans of beans, reserving 1 cup of the liquid from the beans. Put beans in a large pot, adding the reserved liquid, pasta and chillies. Toss pasta mixture until well mixed. Cover and cook until the pasta and chile flavors are blended. It will look a bit dry but it will be. The pasta is done when the pasta is tender. Serve warm.

title: Port Paste
ingredients: 2 cups port wine | 1 teaspoon garlic granules | 2 ounces tomato paste
instructions: Combine the port, garlic and tomato paste together. Pour the mixture into a freezer safe container and freeze. Remove from freezer and allow to stand about 10 minutes before using as a sweetener for fish and poultry.

Random Ingredients: french bread,red chili pepper,dijon mustard,buckwheat flour,salt pepper,saffron,lemon peel,chipotle chile
title: Chipotle Bread
ingredients: 10 slices french bread, or | 1 loaf french bread, crusts trimmed | dijon mustard | 2 tablespoons saffron or 2 tablespoons turmeric | 3/4 - 3/4-1 cup buckwheat flour, warmed | 1 -2 medium red chili pepper, seeded and finely chopped | 1 tablespoon finely grated fresh lemon peel | 1 tablespoon finely chopped chipotle chile
instructions: Preheat broiler. Cut the french bread into 1 inch thick slices and spread 1/2 the dijon mustard on each. Place 1 toast slice on a cookie sheet. Broil under preheated broiler, 10 - 12 minutes, or until golden brown and crisp. While toast is broiling, combine remaining ingredients in a small saucepan,. Bring to simmer and cook, stirring frequently, until butter melts and mixture is smooth. Remove from heat. When bread is cool, spread another layer of mustard on toast, followed by the chile pepper mixture and sprinkle with remaining dijon dijon mustard. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: cornflour,kale,oyster sauce,green pea,adzuki bean,chicken bouillon cube,lamb shank
title: Adzuki Kale and Lamb Soup
ingredients: 500 g adzuki beans, rinsed and soaked ( you can find these in the ethnic aisle of the grocery store ) | 150 g boneless lamb shank ( optional ) | 1 chicken bouillon cube ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon cornflour | 3 stalks finely sliced kale | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 cup frozen green pea
instructions: Wash the adzuki beans thoroughly in hot water and drain in a strainer. Set aside. In a large pot, place half of the soaked adzuki beans on the bottom of the pot and sprinkle with half the lamb shank, if using. Top with the other half of the lamb shank and add stock, bouillon and cornflour. Bring the soup on medium heat for about 20 minutes or until the lamb is cooked tender. Add the remaining beans, cook for about 2 minutes and then you turn up the heat a little to reduce the soup. Add in the kale, cook for about 3 - 5 minutes and then serve with rice and garnish with the other half of the green peas.

title: Chiles
ingredients: 12 poblano chiles | 1 onion, roughly chopped | 1/2 cup icing sugar, sifted | 1/4 cup cooking oil
instructions: Using an oiled griddle grill pan or frying pan, warm the chiles over medium heat until they begin to smoke and burst, about 3 minutes per side. Remove and rub with sifted icing sugar, keeping the chiles moving so the browned bits don't burn. Spread out on paper towels to drain for 5 minutes. Spray skillet with cooking spray. Add onion and cook for 2 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add chiles. Sprinkle with sifted icing sugar. Place pan over medium low heat and cook, shaking the pan so the bottom of the chiles brown evenly. After 30 minutes, lower the heat and cook 45 minutes more, sprinkling chiles with more icing if desired.

title: Chinese Mushrooms(Chinese)
ingredients: 1 large onion soup mix ( optional ) | 1 package dried chinese mushrooms, reconstituted
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a bowl. Refrigerate until serving time.

Random Ingredients: bread flour,dark sesame oil,tomato juice,stewing beef,chipotle pepper,creamy peanut butter,chicken meat,mexican cheese
title: Chipotle Beef Skillet
ingredients: 1 small stewing beef, cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 tablespoons bread flour | 1/4 cup creamy peanut butter, creamy kind | 1 can stewed tomatoes and juice | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 3 tablespoons mexican blend cheese | 1 tablespoon chipotle pepper | 1/4 cup chicken meat, finely diced
instructions: In a large skillet, melt sesame oil and brown beef over medium high heat until evenly browned. Remove beef from pan and set aside. Stir in tomato juice, peanut butter, stewed tomatoes, jalapeno chili powder, cumin and cheese. Stir until combined. Add broth and beef to skillet by the handful. Bring to boil and then return beef to skillet. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer for 35 minutes or until meat is almost tender and mixture is thick. Serve over rice.

title: Thai Green Curry Paste and Eggs (Nhieu Kaeng)
ingredients: 1 bottle thai green curry paste | 1/4 cup vanilla extract ( see directions ) | 6 large eggs
instructions: Wash and soak curry paste overnight in a cool place. Heat 1/4 of the curry paste in a saucepan over medium heat stirring occasionally until it begins to darken, about 2 minutes. Do not burn, add the eggs stir. Add the vanilla extract and continue to stir. When eggs are almost set, take off heat and stir. Transfer mixture to a serving platter and chill until serving time.

title: Spicy Mustard Tuna
ingredients: 1 can tuna, drained and flaked | 1 tablespoon yellow mustard seeds | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds
instructions: Place the tuna, mustard seeds, and a pinch of salt in a small bowl. Mix in the seeds. Cover and refrigerate the tuna for 3 hours.

title: Tuna On the Barbie
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds tuna, cut in chunks, or to taste | 2 sprigs fresh rosemary, leaves stripped
instructions: Warm the grill for high heat and set a small dish in the preheated grill for easy cleanup. Place the tuna chunks onto the grate in a bowl, about a tablespoon per chunk of tuna per chunk. Sprinkle each chunk with a sprig of rosemary. Grill the tuna for about 4 minutes, or until cooked through and juices run clear.

Random Ingredients: alfredo sauce,garlic salt,sambal oelek,white bread flour
title: Spaghetti Sauce Italian
ingredients: 1 lb dry white bread flour | 1 tablespoon sambal oelek | 1 jar alfredo sauce | garlic salt, to taste
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Knead with hands if necessary. Place back in to refridgerator for an hour or so. Shape dough into desired shape. Deep fry until brown.

title: Couscous Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces uncooked penne pasta | 1/4 cup couscous | 4 fluid ounces carbonated lemon-lime beverage, or as needed | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro
instructions: Cook pasta in a large pot of boiling water for 8 minutes. Drain, and rinse with cold water to cool. Combine the couscous and lemon lime soda in a bowl.

title: Crispy Papaya
ingredients: 3 ripe papayas | 2 teaspoons sultanas | 2 teaspoons light soya sauce
instructions: Peel papayas with a peeler and cut diagonally. Place the cut papayas in large bowl. Add all remaining ingredients and mix thoroughly. Serve at room temperature or chilled.

Random Ingredients: mirin,chili garlic sauce,andouille sausage,cream wheat,bread improver knead,maraschino cherry,garlic paste
title: Andouille Cheese Patties
ingredients: 1 lb andouille sausage, crumbled | 1/2 cup cream of wheat | 1 tablespoon chili-garlic sauce | 1 teaspoon garlic paste | 1 tablespoon andouille sausages or 1 tablespoon smoked kielbasa | 1 teaspoon bread improver ( i used bread improver ) | 1 tablespoon mirin or 1 tablespoon sake | 3 maraschino cherries
instructions: Mix the meats together, adding the flour and the wine mixture and mix until everything is well mixed. Form the mixture into patties about 1 inch in diameter and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Cover with a damp towel and leave to stand at room temperature for 45 minutes. Preheat the grill to high. Brush the patties with the oil and grill for 5 - 6 minutes on each side, or until they are cooked through. Place on a board lined with paper towels to cool. Split the pitas if they have opened and scoop out the soft meat with your fingers. Chop the meat into chunks or crumbles. Stuff with the meat. Top with the meat pieces and a cherry.

title: Amish Sausages
ingredients: 6 pounds hot sausages | 1 1/2 cups buttermilk | 4 bay leaves | 1 1/4 pounds chopped pecans
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Arrange sausages on a foil lined sheet pan. Cut an x over the sausages and stuff with buttermilk. Sprinkle the bay leaves and pecans over all, securing with wooden picks. Bake in preheated oven for 45 to 60 minutes, or until sausages are easily removed from casings.

Random Ingredients: mustard powder,lime wedge,sage,pineapple,sausage,greek yogurt,mung bean sprout
title: Baked Bean Sprouts With Pineapple Sage Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 4 medium pineapples | 20 ounces mung bean sprouts | 1/2 cup greek style yogurt ( i have used low fat milk ) | 3 -4 tablespoons mustard powder | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage | 1 lime wedge | 12 sage, leaves ( i use fresh )
instructions: Preheat broiler. Lightly salt and pepper mung bean sprouts to taste. Place the remaining ingredients in a casserole dish and mix well. Add sprouts and bake in a 400f oven about 30 minutes until sprouts are tender and the dressing is bubbling. Serve immediately or let cool to room temperature before serving.

Random Ingredients: egg yolk,rigatoni pasta,beef bouillon granule,orange juice concentrate
