title: Pasta with Orange Meatballs (Coxinhas Farcito)
ingredients: 1 lb rigatoni pasta | 2 1/2 teaspoons beef bouillon granules | 1 egg yolk | 2 teaspoons orange juice concentrate
instructions: Cook rigatoni until al dente.

Random Ingredients: plantain,sherry wine,baking soda,italian salad dressing mix,cannellini bean,artichoke heart,red wine vinegar,wine
title: Artichoke, Plantain and Red Bean Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces cannellini beans, rinsed and drained | 2 ripe plantains, peeled and cut lengthwise into 8 wedges | 1 jar marinated artichoke hearts, drained and cut in half | 1/2 cup sherry wine | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 1 envelope italian salad dressing mix | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Cook cannellini beans as directions indicate, adding sherry to warm water. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cover and cook until beans are crisp tender and flavors are combined, about 5 minutes.

title: Easy Crock Pot Corned Beef
ingredients: 1 boneless beef brisket | 1 batch bitters | 1 tablespoon cornstarch
instructions: Spray crockpot with non stick cooking spray. Place roast in crockpot. Add enough water to come half way up the side of the roast. Cook on high for two hours, checking water lever every 20 minutes for medium or remove from crockpot and let cool at least 6 hours before slicing.

title: Chinese Oil Paddle Balls
ingredients: 2 cups canola oil | 2 cups cold water
instructions: Pour canola oil in a large, heavy, deep pan, and place over medium high heat. When oil turns a solid gray colored brown, pour water into the pan. When water sizzles with drops, reduce heat to low and stir with a wooden spoon to mix.

title: Frijoles Tarkados
ingredients: 8 slices bacon | 1 can kidney beans | 1 can coriander | 1 package taco seasoning ( or you can use equivalent amount of all season ) | 12 tortillas
instructions: Start by heating up about 1/2 teaspoon of olive oil in a skillet over medium high flame. Fry the bacon until crispy. Drain, crumble and set aside. In the same skillet, fry the beans until crisp and browned on the outside, approximately 15 minutes. Meanwhile, put about 2/3 cup of water into the cooker and add the taco seasoning. The water should feel like a very slow boiling, but should not be too thick. As soon as this is done, put in the bacon and stir to mix well, but watch out for the bacon, that's when it's done. Place the tortillas on a plate, and spoon a little bit of the bean and bacon mixture on top of them. Enjoy.

title: Spicy Indian Guacamole Spread
ingredients: 3 green cardamom pods | 1 teaspoon ground guacamole | 1 teaspoon hot sauce ( sriracha )
instructions: Place cardamom pods on a microwave safe plate. Add 1 teaspoon hot sauce, or to taste, and cover with plastic wrap. Microwave on high for 1 minute. Remove plastic wrap and stir. Microwave on medium for 30 seconds to soften cardamom pods.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock chicken,cucumber,chili flake,parmigiano,pepper sauce,cherry,bean sprout
title: Italian Chopped Vegetables in Bean Sauce
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried chili flakes | 1 teaspoon vegetable stock or 1 teaspoon chicken stock | 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1 1/2 cups mixed vegetables, chopped into 1 inch pieces | 4 tablespoons grated fresh parmigiano or 4 tablespoons grana padano | 8 large cherry tomatoes, halved | 1 cucumber, thinly sliced and lengthwise into thin strips
instructions: Place chili flakes and water in a small heavy saucepan and bring to the boil over moderate heat. Immediately lower heat and simmer gently 5 minutes, or until the water is reduced to 1 tablespoon. Transfer hot liquid to a small bowl. Stir in the pepper sauce and let cool until slightly warm. Toss vegetables with remaining ingredients and serve at once.

title: Kitchen Koutbane
ingredients: 12 poblano chiles | 2 tablespoons liquid smoke, or to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Place the poblano peppers in a microwave safe bowl. Pour enough water into the bowl to cover the tops and bottoms of the peppers, about 1/4 inch. Cover the bowl with a moist cloth and place in the oven. Roast peppers for 12 to 15 minutes or until skins blister and blacken. Remove the poblano peppers from the water and peel. Turn the oven temperature up to 400 degrees f. Turn off the oven. Place the poblanos in a heat resistant resealable plastic bag. Pour in the liquid smoke and seal. Let sit at room temperature, about 10 minutes. Open the bag and, using a pastry brush, coat the peppers with the liquid smoke. Place in a sealed plastic bag and squeeze out any excess liquid. Serve with chips or as an optional garnish.

title: Easy Chinese Sweet Syrup
ingredients: 500 ml simple syrup | 200 ml soy sauce
instructions: Pour the soy sauce in the bottom of a mixing bowl. Add the soya sauce and mix well. Mix in the sweetnes and eat.

title: Taco Seasoning (Copycat)
ingredients: 1 package simply potatoes & reg ; shredded hash browns | 1 envelope instant potato starch ( regular or spice ) | 1 cup bottled italian dressing | 1 ear of corn, rinsed & sliced ( fresh is best, but frozen or canned is okay )
instructions: In a bowl, combine simply potatoes crushed hash browns with 2 tbsp of the dressing and mix well to combine. Place half of potato mixture onto greased cookie sheet and cover with baby corn slices. Repeat twice. Place remaining simply potatoes hash browns onto baby corn slices and sprinkle evenly with the rest of the dressing & spice mix. Bake at 400°f for 15 - 20 minutes, then cool 5 minutes on wire rack. Store in a cookie tin or recycled ziploc bag.

title: Beef Rollen with Oranges
ingredients: 2 lbs ground beef | 2 tablespoons candied orange peel | 2 packets splenda brown sugar blend | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried parsley | 1 cup broccolini, washed and trimmed
instructions: Cook and stir ground beef in large skillet. Drain. Sprinkle orange peel over ground beef.

Random Ingredients: catsup,grape tomato,almond nut,shrimp,lasagna noodle,tomato juice,apple cider vinegar
title: Catalina Shrimp Lasagna
ingredients: 1 can diced tomatoes with juice | 1 1/2 cups apple cider vinegar | 1/4 cup catsup | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, not oil packed | 1/4 cup almonds or 1/4 cup nuts, toasted | 1 pound shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1/2 cup grape tomatoes, halved | lasagna noodle, cooked and drained
instructions: Mix tomatoes, vinegar, catsup, sun dried tomatoes, almonds and shrimp in a large bowl. Spread about 1/2 cup tomato sauce in the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Layer with half of the lasagna noodles, overlapping them slightly. Top with 1/2 cheese sauce mix, then repeat layers ending with sauce. Cover with foil and refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Uncover lasagna and bake in an oven 25 minutes. Remove from oven and sprinkle with tomatoes. Return to oven and bake until heated through, about 30 minutes.

title: Tami Brunch Masalade
ingredients: 1/4 cup tamari, tamari fish sauce | 3/4 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 3/4 cup pimento, chopped small | 1 star anise
instructions: Combine all ingredients except star anise in a mixing bowl, stir to combine, set aside. Place star anise in small, small bowl, sprinkle spice mixture over the star anise and chill, covered, in the refrigerator for at least one hour. Heat a large heavy skillet over medium heat. Dipping the pimento pieces into the mixture should make them crisp. Quickly fry the pimento pieces in batches about 2 minutes, remove, drain on paper towels. Serve hot, allowing guests to stir and eat as a snack.

Random Ingredients: red capsicum,beef,rosemary,extra virgin olive oil,cranberry sauce
title: The Queen's Shelf Roast Beef
ingredients: 1 kg beef, suitable for roasting, trimmed of fat | 2 tablespoons rosemary | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 1 red capsicum, halved and chopped | 100 g dried cranberry sauce
instructions: Place the beef in an ovenproof dish. Mix together the remaining ingredients. Pour over the beef. Roast in a preheated oven at 200c for about 2 hours until cooked through and the juices run clear.

Random Ingredients: yeast,saffron thread,red pepper flake,orange zest,red cabbage,arborio rice
title: Red Cabbage, Saffron and Orange Biryani
ingredients: 6 cups grated red cabbage ( we use savoy ) | 1/2 cup arborio rice | 1 teaspoon saffron threads ( soaked in 2 tsp. warm water ) | 1 teaspoon orange zest, grated | 1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon ground red pepper
instructions: Sprinkle a little salt on the grated cabbage, and squeeze out excess moisture, and set the cabbage aside. Place all the remaining ingredients in your bread machine in order given, and select the basic cycle. When the machine has completed its cycle, remove the cabbage, and let sit for 10 minutes. Place the drained arugula on serving platter, and drizzle with olive oil.

title: Homemade Taco Shells
ingredients: 2 cups self-rising flour | 1 tablespoon chili powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix together the flour, chili powder and chili powder. Make sure dough is loose enough to form into a stiff dough if necessary. Roll out onto a floured baking sheet using a 2 inch round cutter. Brush the top and edges of the shell with water. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until the shell feels dry when lightly pressed.

Random Ingredients: cumin,panko japanese bread crumb,shiitake mushroom,chocolate chip
title: Chocolate Chip Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 4 dried shiitake mushrooms | 6 squares semi-sweet chocolate chips | 1 1/2 cups panko japanese-style bread crumbs | 1 teaspoon ground cumin
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place mushrooms in a medium bowl and pour hot water over to cover. Cover mushroom with plastic wrap and set aside for 30 minutes. Place chocolate chips in a bowl, and dip mushrooms into chocolate, coating each mushroom. Remove the reserved soaking water, and set aside. Place panko crumbs in a separate bowl, and set aside. Place shredded cumin in a small bowl, and set aside. Remove mushroom caps from water, reserving liquid, and place into a large baking dish. Place panko crumbs onto a plate. Coat caps with panko crumbs in batches, and sprinkle excess on caps. Bake in preheated oven for 15 to 20 minutes, or until golden brown. Serve immediately.

title: Red Vine Jelly
ingredients: 4 ounces red wine | 2 ounces apple cider | 2 teaspoons cornflour | 1 teaspoon white wine
instructions: Pour all ingredients into a saucepan or lidded pot and heat up, stirring constantly. It should bubble off the surface of the mixture. When the pan starts to bubble, remove the pan from heat. Slowly add the wine and stir until completely dissolved. Pour into wine sealie bags or seal/lid jars. If necessary, refrigerate for approximately 4 days before drinking.

Random Ingredients: egg substitute,anise seed,egg beater substitute,cheddar cheese,wheat flour,lime wedge,potato
title: Healthified Low-Fat Quinoa and Potato Kugel
ingredients: 1 cup simply potatoes diced potatoes with onion | 3/4 cup egg substitute ( egg beaters ori ginal sugar free for diet ) | 3 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 1 1/2 cups egg beaters egg substitute | 1 tablespoon lime juice | 1 1/2 tablespoons lime wedges ( or to taste ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons anise seeds ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried anise seed ( optional ) | 1/4 cup cheddar cheese, shredded, divided
instructions: In a bowl, mix together potatoes with onion, eggs, flour, half of lime juice and anise seeds. Put into a greased 8 x 8 baking pan. Bake in a 375 degree f oven until a knife inserted near the center comes out clean, 20 to 25 minute cool to room temperature, about 25 minute cut into 1/4 inch slices and sprinkle with cheese. Return to oven, uncovered, until cheese has melted.

title: Poppy Seed Burgers
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds ground beef chuck | 1/2 red onion, finely chopped | 1 can cherry tomatoes, drained if canned | 1/4 cup poppy seeds, ground in a food processor ( optional )
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat and lightly oil the grate. Grind the ground chuck in a food processor until evenly mixed. Stir in the red onion, cherry tomatoes, and poppy seeds.

Random Ingredients: red potato total,lemon peel,tony chachere seasoning,dark chocolate,chicken breast half,parmesan cheese
title: Tortino Di Patate (Baked Chicken Nuggets)
ingredients: 2 small red potatoes, cut into chunks | 1 1/2 teaspoons finely grated lemon peel | 1 tablespoon tony chachere's seasoning, or to taste | 3 boneless skinless chicken breast halves, cut in strips | 1/4 cup shaved dark chocolate | 3 tablespoons grated parmesan cheese, or as desired
instructions: Combine potatoes, lemon peel, and seasoning in a glass baking dish. Arrange chicken strips in a single layer in the dish. Cover with shaved dark chocolate. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese or as desired.

Random Ingredients: white vinegar,white pearl onion,okra,shell pasta,garlic,dijon mustard
title: Okra and Okra Salad
ingredients: 1 package frozen white pearl onion | 1 package frozen okra, thawed, cut into 1 inch chunks | 2/3 cup white vinegar | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 2 cloves garlic, minced | 1 pound uncooked shell pasta
instructions: In a medium size bowl, combine the onions, frozen okra, vinegar, mustard, garlic, and uncooked pasta. Cover and refrigerate, stirring occasionally, 1 - 3 hours before serving.

title: Italian Pineapple Celery Sausages
ingredients: 4 celery ribs, chopped | 1 -2 pineapple, cut into thick cubes | 1/2 bottle red wine | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda
instructions: Cook celery until soft and tender, but not brown.

title: Italian Cream Cannelloni
ingredients: 1/2 cup heavy cream | 2 tablespoons ricotta cheese | 2 anchovy fillets, minced | 1/2 - 3/4 cup guacamole
instructions: Using an electric mixer, stir together cream, ricotta cheese and minced anchovies. Cover and chill until ready to serve. Stir guacamole into cream mixture. Serve on toasted cannelloni shells.

title: Balsamic Glaze for Corned Fish
ingredients: 4 large raw celtic fish ( corn on the cob ) | 3 ounces aged balsamic vinegar | 3 ounces sambal oelek ( or substitute with chili paste )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. Mix the two types of vinegar together in a small sauce pan and add a good pinch of salt and pepper to taste. Bring to the boil then lower the heat and leave to simmer for 10 minutes until reduced. Remove from the heat and leave until cool. Rub over the fish and place on a baking tray, sprayed lightly with oil. Roast for 20 minutes until crispy.

title: Easy Avocado Salad (Tom Yum Koong Khing)
ingredients: 2 large avocados | 2 tablespoons palm sugar, packed | 1 -2 tablespoon thai sweet chili sauce | 2 tablespoons fresh radishes ( chopped ) | 1 tablespoon fresh dill ( chopped )
instructions: Peel, pit and dice the avocados into 1 cubes. In a large bowl, thoroughly mix the other ingredients together. Make sure the sugar has dissolved. Place the avocado cubes in the mixture and allow to sit for one hour or more. Add salt and pepper, as needed. Serve immediately.

title: Vegetable Sticks
ingredients: 8 ounces mixed vegetables ( ie beans ) | 1 tablespoon sun-dried tomato | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 spring onion | 1/4 cup chopped peach
instructions: Cook beans in boiling water for 3 - 5 minutes. Drain well. Blend sun dried tomatoes with cumin or chilli garlic. Put all ingredients in a bowl. Cover and chill for 1 - 2 hours. Dip vegetables in hot oil and then spread out between paper towel until they can be pinched. Turn frequently. Serve with salad or yoghurt.

title: Homemade Steakhouse French Fries
ingredients: 1/3 cup chopped spring onion | 2 cloves garlic, crushed | 2 tablespoons chopped spring onions | 1 tablespoon chopped garlic, or more to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper. Combine spring onion and 1 tablespoon chopped garlic, or to taste, in a bowl. Brush 1 tablespoon chopped garlic onto both sides of each fried french fry. Sprinkle tops of fries with 1 tablespoon chopped garlic. Bake in a preheated oven until crispy, about 15 minutes.

title: Tamarind Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup plain yogurt | 1/2 cup fresh tamarind paste | white pepper to taste
instructions: Stir yogurt, tamarind paste, and white pepper together in a bowl.

title: Sun-Dried Tomato Spread
ingredients: 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato pesto | 1/4 cup dark sesame oil
instructions: In a small bowl, mix sun dried tomato pesto with sesame oil. Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours to allow flavors to blend.

Random Ingredients: kalamata olive,chicken bouillon,water,orange,pecorino romano cheese,cornflour,thyme sprig
title: Orange Polenta
ingredients: 3 cups water | 2 medium oranges | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon | 1/2 cup kalamata olive, coarsely chopped | 4 tablespoons grated pecorino romano cheese | fresh thyme sprig, to decorate
instructions: Place the water in a medium saucepan and bring to the boil, stirring. Remove from the heat, then add the orange zest. Drain and reserve the zest. Slice the oranges thinly on the diagonal and place in a bowl. Cut two of the oranges, then slice into long thin strips from the long side. Add both orange zests and orange juice to the orange liquid and stir in the cornflour and chicken bouillon. Bring to the boil and add half the olives, then immediately reduce the heat and simmer for 5 minutes. Turn off the heat and cover to keep warm while you cook the polenta.. Place a pan over a high heat and add some oil for about 1 minute to make a thin film. Pour in half the polenta, stirring in the cornflour until thick and creamy. Remove from the heat and add the remaining olives and half the cheese. Transfer to a serving dish, cover and put in a warm oven until the polenta is cooked. Garnish with thyme sprigs. Serve.

title: Pimiento and Onion Dip
ingredients: 1 jar whole pimientos | 1 red onion, diced | 1 cup sour cream
instructions: Dice pimiento and onion. Drain sour cream. Set aside. Mix remaining ingredients. Serve with corn chips.

Random Ingredients: dill weed,table salt,garlic powder,puff pastry,apricot jam,hoagie,hot dog,corn tortilla
title: Lance's Hot Dog Pizza
ingredients: 1 sheet frozen puff pastry, thawed | 8 hot dogs, split in half crosswise | 8 dill weed | table salt | 2 tablespoons apricot jam | 1 dash hot coffee powder or 1 dash table salt | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 bag miniature party rye rolls or 2 crusty hoagie rolls
instructions: Thaw out puff pastry sheets according to package directions. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Line oven rack with parchment paper. Cut hot dogs lengthwise in half, crosswise. Slice each hot dog slice diagonally at a 45 degree angle into about 20 slices. Spread each pizza pizza with 1/2 tbls. Of jam. Sprinkle with 1/2 tbls. Dill weed. Sprinkle with 1/4 teaspoons salt. Top each pizza with another 1/2 tbls. Dill weed, salt, and remaining jam slices. Cut rolls lengthwise along the cut side and lay on a baking sheet sprinkled with dried bread,. Bake in middle of the oven for about 20 minutes or until golden brown. Remove from oven and add mini party rolls.

title: Baked Spaghetti Nests
ingredients: 1 package spaghetti noodles | tortilla ( warmed )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Bring a pot of water to a boil for the noodles. Put a few drops of oil on the inside of a tortilla, and heat in microwave until slightly softened, about 30 seconds. Drain the spaghetti noodles well. Place an inverted plate in the oven to keep warm. Place a small bowl of water in it for boiling the noodles. Dip each tortilla in the warm water until they are soft, about 60 seconds. Placing the bowl in the microwave, cook on high power for 60 seconds. Drain and arrange the spaghetti noodle nests on plate. Dip your tortilla in the warm water for 30 seconds and serve it.

Random Ingredients: snow pea,gruyere cheese,red chili pepper,cumin powder,bell pepper,beef brisket
title: Beef Brisket Wrapped in Cumin
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/4 lb beef brisket | 4 slices gruyere cheese | 4 tablespoons cumin powder | 4 ounces red chili peppers or 4 ounces green jalapenos, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons bell peppers, finely chopped ( preferably red or yellow ) | 1/2 lb snow peas ( optional )
instructions: Wrap meat evenly with cheese. Secure with toothpicks. In a shallow dish, pour enough water to come 1 2 inches up the side of the meat. Mix cumin powder and chili peppers with 1/4 cup water. Sprinkle on both sides of meat as evenly as possible. Cover tightly with damp kitchen towels. Refrigerate overnight. Preheat oven to 300°. Place meat on rack in shallow pan. Insert oven proof skillet on rack near meat. If necessary, drain liquid into measuring cup. Put beef on rack in oven and bake about 3 hours. You may use 2 pans as listed.

title: Goats Cheese and Celery
ingredients: 1/4 cup peanut oil | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 1 pinch celery seed | 2 ounces goat cheese
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together and serve. Enjoy.

title: Zucchini Toast (A Kiwi Fruit Stuff)
ingredients: 1 zucchini, sliced | 4 slices bread, toasted | 1/2 - 2/3 cup lavash bread ( or other flavored bread )
instructions: Toast the lavash, if using lavash, in a non stick skillet, on medium heat. Place zucchini in skillet, and let brown, approximately 5 minutes, or until the zucchini is golden, and the zucchini is heated through. Using slotted spoon, carefully remove zucchini, then place slices on toast.. Serve with your favorite fruits.

title: Mexicorn and Tomatoes
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 can mexican-style corn, drained | 1 roma tomato, sliced
instructions: Combine corn, tomato, and salt in a bowl. Heat a skillet over medium high heat. Coat pan with cooking spray. Spread corn mixture in the frypan. Cook, uncovered, until it begins to brown, 4 to 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: vegetable broth,udon noodle,tabasco sauce,white vinegar,red pepper,shell pasta,ghee
title: Udon Noodle Soup-Japanese Style
ingredients: 1/2 red pepper ( can be red pepper flakes ) | 1 small dried red pepper ( can be green pepper/yellow pepper flakes ) | 2 teaspoons ghee | 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce ( or to your taste ) | 2 teaspoons white vinegar ( or to your taste ) | 2 tablespoons vegetable broth | shell pasta | 2 tablespoons ghee | 1 tablespoon white vinegar ( or to your taste ) | 1 -2 teaspoon vegetable broth
instructions: Wash dried/dry red pepper. Cut in half. Roast at 425°f or under broiler for about 6 minutes, or until skin bursts, being careful not to let it burn.. Put in paper bag or plastic bag to speed up oxidation and keep fresh black.. Use caution to avoid flames. When cool, peel skin. Use caution in inhaling fumes. Peel the red pepper as it has tiny burnt spots throughout for the flavor. Remove skin from red pepper. Cut off and discard skin of roasted red pepper. Cut into thin slices, removing seeds if desired, removing stems if desired. Place pepper slices into colander and sprinkle a little salt over the peppers and let drain. Wash and dry the noodles according to package directions. Heat ghee in heavy large saucepan. When hot, add red pepper and cook, stirring constantly over med high for 2 minutes. Add 1/2 tsp red pepper flakes and 1/2 tsp tabasco sauce and stir fry for 1 minute. Add 4 cups unsalted vegetable broth and stir fry for 3 more minutes. Stir in the noodles and cook, stirring frequently, until noodles are coated with the sauce. Add 2 tbsp ghee, 1 tbls. Of vinegar and 1/8 tsp vegetable broth and toss gently to combine. Heat through and serve at once.

title: Indian Cauliflower
ingredients: 600 g cauliflower | 1/4 cup coriander
instructions: Remove outer leaves and cut into florets. Steam or boil until tender. Place through a strainer or kitchen blender. Add spices and salt if desired and serve immediately.

title: Pecorino Romano
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons grated pecorino romano cheese | 1 head boston lettuce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place head of lettuce in an oven safe pan. Sprinkle with cheese directly on top of each head. Drizzle the top with a small amount of olive oil. Bake at 350 degrees f for 35 minutes, or until lightly browned.

title: Guilt and Gluten Free Wings or Winds
ingredients: 1 chicken wings | 1/4 cup cocoa | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla beans
instructions: Mix cocoa and vanilla beans together. Toss with wings. Bake 25 - 30 mins at 350. Allow to cool and cut into small pieces, toss well before serving with a little fruit or sugar.

title: Rhubarb Tropical Compote
ingredients: 2 lbs rhubarb, trimmed and halved | 14 ounces pineapple chunks, slightly in the can | 2 teaspoons cayenne pepper
instructions: Heat an empty casserole over medium heat. Add the rhubarb, the pineapple, and the cayenne.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,dark sesame oil,yellow rice mix
title: Chile Con Carne
ingredients: 1 package yellow rice mix | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 2 cups graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add rice mix, and stir once. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer 5 minutes. Stir in sesame oil, and continue to simmer 8 minutes. Turn off heat, and mix in graham cracker crumbs. Allow to set until cool, about 15 minutes. Keep in an airtight container in the refrigerator until serving. This will keep for up to 6 months.

Random Ingredients: egg beater substitute,bread,lime,thyme leaf,pork loin,green chili salsa,salmon fillet,black pepper
title: Lime Sausage and Smoked Salmon Croquettes
ingredients: 1 can diced green chili salsa, undrained | 2 tablespoons light egg substitute | 1/4 teaspoon fresh thyme leaves | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon freshly ground black black pepper | 4 slices country bread, cut diagonally into 1/2 inch slices | 1 boneless pork loin or 2 -3 skinless smoked salmon fillets | 1/3 cup raw egg substitute | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon fresh thyme leaves | 1 egg, lightly beaten | 1 tablespoon lime rind ( finely grated from 1 large lime )
instructions: In skillet over medium high heat, stir together salsa, 1 tablespoon of the egg substitute, 2 tablespoons of the thyme, and pepper. Bring to rolling boil.

title: Gruyere Cheese Balls
ingredients: 250 g cottage cheese | 125 g gruyere cheese, grated
instructions: Combine ingredients, into small balls. Roll in breadcrumbs. Serve with butter and jam or as a side dish for a meaty meal.

Random Ingredients: pinto bean,pecorino romano cheese,hot italian sausage,milk ricotta cheese,mandarin orange,green greek olive,yellow bell pepper,cranberry sauce
title: Cheese and Bean Pie
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup hot italian sausage | 2 teaspoons dried cranberry sauce | 1 container whole milk ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup grated pecorino romano cheese, divided | 4 pints milk-ricotta cheese | 3 green greek olives, pitted and sliced | 1 large yellow bell pepper, chopped | 1 jar mandarin oranges
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Place pinto beans in a large mixing bowl, and mash with a potato masher. Mix in hot italian sausage. Stir together cranberry sauce and 1 teaspoon of cheese using your hands to make sauce. Spread the ricotta cheese into the bottom of a 9 inch pie plate. Spread italian sausage sauce over ricotta cheese. Sprinkle with remaining cheese, and top with sliced olives and peppers. Bake for 45 minutes in the preheated oven, or until hot and bubbly.

title: African Peanut Butter Spread
ingredients: 1/2 cup peanut butter | 1/2 bunch green onions, chopped | 1/2 cup poppy seeds, toasted
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix all the ingredients together. Spread on your favorite crackers or bread. Place on a piece of plastic wrap and press flat to help spread the spread.

title: Mushrooms With Clotted Cream
ingredients: 10 medium mushrooms | 1 teaspoon lemon zest, coarsely grated | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 1/2 cups double cream | 1 pinch allspice | 3 teaspoons adobo sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f trim the stem ends of the mushrooms and wash thoroughly. Slice the caps into thin strips and set aside. Heat the oil over medium heat in a medium pan. Saute the mushrooms for 2 - 3 minutes. Remove from the heat and stir in lemon zest. Transfer the mushroom mixture into a medium casserole dish. Mix in the cream, sprinkle with a little adobo sauce and a pinch of allspice. Cover the pan with tinfoil and bake for 20 - 25 minutes or until the cream is reduced by three quarters. Remove from the oven and let sit 5 - 10 minutes before serving. The mushrooms can be left in the casserole dish but will be warmed through. The cream can also be chilled for up to an hour before serving.

title: French Blankets
ingredients: 1 tablespoon brown sugar or 1 tablespoon corn syrup | 1 lb pork shoulder, thinly sliced ( butt ) | 6 lettuce leaves, rinsed | 1 cup muenster cheese or 1 cup sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f lightly grease jelly roll pan w/margarine. In a bowl, dissolve the brown sugar in the syrup. Spread the pork slices on the greased pan. Bake the pork for 30 to 35 minutes, turning once, until lightly browned on both sides. Remove pork to a plate and keep warm. Arrange the lettuce leaves on the pork slices. Place the slice of cheese on top of the lettuce. Add the syrup to the pan. Replace the pork loaf over the cheese & lettuce & bring the mixture to a boil on the stovetop, stirring frequently.

title: Kielbasa With Spinach and Cranberry Potatoes
ingredients: 1 kielbasa | 1 baking potato, peeled and sliced into 1/8 inch half moons | 1 tablespoon fresh parsley, chopped | 1/2 cup diced sweet chili | 1/4 cup dried cranberries | 1 package baby spinach, chopped ( i use frozen, thawed ) | 1/4 cup pickled cranberries | 2 tablespoons fresh lime wedges | marinade
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°. Place kielbasa, potato slices and parsley in a large heavy bottomed oven safe pot or casserole that has been sprayed with non stick cooking spray. Sprinkle with chili and cranberries. Cover and bake at 450 for 35 minutes. When potatoes are tender, sprinkle with dried spinach. Sprinkle with lime wedges and stir. Enjoy.

title: Arugula and Olive Crock Pot
ingredients: 1 package extra lean ground beef | 2 cans green olives | 1/2 cup arugula, chopped | 1/2 cup coffee ( optional )
instructions: Brown meat in frying pan on low heat. Drain fat from pan and mix meat with oll water and spices add arugula to meat. Pour mixture into crock pot. Cook on low 4 to 5 hours. Serve over noodles or rice.

Random Ingredients: butter,beef broth,chicken breast,velveeta cheese,parmesan cheese,pecorino cheese
title: Grilled Chicken Cheese Fonduta
ingredients: 1/4 cup butter or 1/4 cup margarine | 6 ounces velveeta cheese ( 1/2 cup ) | 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese | 2 boneless skinless chicken breasts | 3 cans condensed beef broth | 1 cup grated pecorino cheese
instructions: Cube the velveeta cheese. In a heavy duty pan, melt 1/4 cup butter over low heat. Add 1/4 cup velveeta, parmesan and 3/4 of the beef broth. Bring to a slow boil and then stir in the shredded chicken. Reduce heat and simmer for about 15 minutes. Turn the heat to medium or medium low. Melt remaining 1/4 cup butter, stirring to blend. Serve chicken over hot fonduta. Garnish with grated cheese.

Random Ingredients: carrot,basil pesto,black pepper,bread,tart apple,red pepper flake,meatball,almond
title: Sour  Italian Meatball Appetizer
ingredients: 6 canned sauteed meatballs | 1/2 cup sliced almonds or 1/2 cup sliced pine nuts | 1 cup carrot, shredded | 1 -3 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes ( depending on taste ) | 2 teaspoons dried basil pesto | 1 teaspoon kosher salt or 2 teaspoons table salt | 1 dash black pepper | 2 slices bread, cut diagonally into 1/4 inch slices on the diagonal
instructions: Cook meatballs, almonds, carrot, red pepper flakes, basil pesto, salt and pepper in skillet. Meanwhile break bread into bite sized pieces and soak in warm water until they are soft. Remove meatballs from skillet and place on a plate. Tear apart bread slices in chunks and toss with meatballs. Cover with fresh mozzarella or provolone cheese and place in oven till melted.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,cornstarch,rocket,sandwich bread,worcestershire sauce,pinto bean,active yeast
title: Beans' Pinto Bean Fritters
ingredients: 2 lbs pinto beans, fresh | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 2 1/4 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 1/2 teaspoons cornstarch | 3 tablespoons peanut oil | 20 slices sandwich bread | rocket ( to garnish )
instructions: Place the beans in a large saucepan and cover with water. Bring to the boil, cover and reduce the heat and simmer for 1 hour or until they are just tender. Drain them and put to one side until needed. Dissolve the yeast in 1 1/4 cups of warm water. Add the cornstarch and set aside. Whisk the remaining flour in a large bowl. Add the oil and the yeast and mix to dissolve the yeast. Dip a bread slice in the flour, then in the beans. Set the bread slices on a microwave safe baking tray and place under a low medium heat for 2 minutes or until golden brown. Remove the bread from the oven and top with the bread and beans. Garnish with rocket.

title: Spanish Shrimp
ingredients: 1/2 lb shrimp | 1/2 cup stuffed green olive, sliced
instructions: Shell, devein or shell.

Random Ingredients: onion flake,beef stew meat,kalamata olive,guacamole,italian parsley,coriander,kielbasa
title: Spanish-Style Beef and Nests
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped fresh coriander | 1/4 cup chopped fresh italian parsley | 1/4 cup dried minced onion flakes | 1/2 cup kalamata olives, sliced | 2 tablespoons dried minced onion flakes | 2 pounds beef stew meat | 1 jar kielbasa, sliced and drained | 1/2 can chipotle-flavored guacamole
instructions: Stir coriander, parsley, 1/4 cup onion flakes, olives, and 2nd tablespoon of onion flakes together in a large slow cooker. Place beef atop the mixture. Cover and cook on low heat setting for 7 hours. Remove lid and continue cooking beef until very tender, adding more water if necessary. Stir in the chipotle peppers and 1 cup of guacamole. Serve with tortillas or rice.

Random Ingredients: serrano chili,lemon juice zest,pepperoni,vanilla extract,iceberg lettuce,anchovy fillet,parsley flake,ladyfinger
title: Vegetable Salad With Poached Poached Hot Dog Strips
ingredients: 1/2 cup finely chopped pickled red peppers or 1/2 cup red bell pepper | 1/2 serrano chili, finely chopped | 3 anchovy fillets | 4 tablespoons lemon juice, fresh | 1/4 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | 1/8 teaspoon dried parsley flakes | 24 ladyfingers ( use 2 if desired for garnish ) | iceberg lettuce, for garnish or assorted fresh salad greens, for garnish | 24 slices pepperoni, sliced for garnish
instructions: In mini bowl, combine pepper, chile and anchovies. Sprinkle half salt and remaining salt on paper towel lined plate. Dip dipping or dipping bread in lemon juice then into chopped pepper mixture and arrange on plate. Sprinkle with parsley. To serve, arrange poached hot dog strips on top of sliced lettuce and then top with poached hot dog strips. Garnish with additional parsley.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile,corn oil,swiss cheese,cremini mushroom,romaine lettuce
title: Tex Mex Cremini Mushroom Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons corn oil | 4 small swiss cheese, torn into bite-size pieces | 1/2 cup cremini mushroom, trimmed and thinly sliced | 1/4 teaspoon dried chipotle chiles | 1 head romaine lettuce, shredded
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200degc. Place the oil in a small frying pan over a medium heat and add the cheese. Stirring continuously until it melts and begins to turn yellow. Add the mushrooms and dried chipotle and stir for a few seconds, being careful to avoid burning. Spread the sauce over the romaine lettuce leaves and serve immediately.

title: Fenugreek Crusted Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons dried fenugreek leaves | 1 pork tenderloin
instructions: Preheat grill for high heat. Lightly oil the grate. Place the pork tenderloin on the hot grate, and sprinkle evenly with fenugreek. Let meat rest 5 minutes. Turn over, and slice into 1/2 inch slices. Serve warm.

title: Pesto Pesto Marinade
ingredients: 1/2 cup pesto sauce | 4 cardamom pods | 1 tablespoon poultry seasoning
instructions: Whisk pesto, cardamom pods, poultry seasoning together in a clean bowl. Pour pesto mixture into a resealable plastic bag, or other container with a tight lid. Marinate in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour before using to marinate chicken, lamb, or fish. Strain stock, discarding solids, into an air tight container and freeze seafood for up to 1 month.

title: Chili Cream Sauce
ingredients: 4 tablespoons half-and-half cream | fresh chili | 1/4 cup dried currant
instructions: Melt a little bit of the half and half in a small pot and bring to a boil. Dissolve the chilli in half and half cream and add to the sauce. Simmer until thick enough to coat an apple's back. You may have to add more water if too thick. Once thick, stir in the currants. Let cool.

title: Sausage in Cognac
ingredients: 1 lb sweet italian sausage | 1/4 cup cognac
instructions: Remove sausage meat from casings. Heat 1 inch of oil in a large pan on high heat. Brown sausage mixture until it is almost done. Turn down heat if the sausage begins to stick, but do not burn the oil. Spread cooked sausage onto a plate and cover with warmed cognac. Serve with hot fresh pasta or roasted potatoes, and a green salad.

title: Spicy Fish
ingredients: 1 large tilapia fillets | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1 star anise | 3 ounces corn, cooked | 1 1/4 ounces tea
instructions: Wash and pat dry tilapia fillets. Place fish in medium non stick sauté pan and sear on both sides until light brown. Add remaining ingredients, stir, and cook until piping hot and fish flakes easily with a fork.

Random Ingredients: chicken wing,italian bread,whipping cream,vanilla extract,cardamom seed,sherry wine,chicken broth
title: Cardamom-Sherry Chicken Wings
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken wings | 1 1/2 cups chicken broth | 1/4 cup sherry wine | 2 slices canned italian bread, torn into small pieces | 1/2 cup whipping cream ( heavy ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom seeds, lightly crushed
instructions: Remove tips from chicken wings. Combine chicken breasts, broth, wine, bread in crockpot. Cover and cook on low for 6 hours. Remove chicken and slice. Place on platter, cover with thickener and garnish with cream and a few cardamon leaves.

Random Ingredients: garlic powder,white breadcrumb,alfredo sauce,sun tomato oil,cod fish fillet,sage leaf,ginger powder,cannellini bean
title: Lagasse (Beans & Cod)
ingredients: 1 bottle alfredo sauce | 1/2 bunch fresh sage leaf | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 2 tablespoons fresh ginger powder | 1 lb cod fish fillets or 1 lb other firm white fish fillet | 1 can cannellini beans, drained & rinsed | 2 tablespoons white breadcrumbs | 1/3 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained
instructions: In a large bowl mix the two sauces, garlic powder, ginger or fresh ground black pepper to taste, the cod/fish and cannelli beans. Stir to mix well. Place in a greased casserole dish or casserole dish with a lid or cover and refrigerate overnight to chill. Remove from the refrigerator 15 to 20 minutes before serving. Mix the breadcrumbs and sun dried tomato in a bowl. When ready to serve, place the bowl of bread crumbs on a dinner plate and place the fish in the bread and crumbs and roll them up.

Random Ingredients: cardamom seed,coriander,orange zest,ancho chile powder,maple syrup,browning sauce,spaghetti
title: Saurin' Pasta
ingredients: 2 lbs spaghetti | 1/3 cup fresh coriander or 1/3 cup cilantro, chopped | 1/3 cup browning sauce or 1/3 cup browning liquid | 1 teaspoon orange zest, freshly grated | 1/4 teaspoon oregano | 1/4 teaspoon crushed cardamom seeds | 1/8 teaspoon crushed chile powder ( or to taste )
instructions: Cook spaghetti in a large pot of boiling water to desired doneness, about 4 - 5 minutes, until al dente. Drain and rinse under cold, running water, set aside 1 cup water. Place remaining sauce ingredients in a large saucepan and place over medium heat. Bring to a simmer and cook, stirring constantly so sauce does not burn, about 4 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Add coriander and toss to coat.

title: Ranch Cracker Cured Cod
ingredients: 1 lb salt cod fish, skin on | 2 small red chile, washed, stems discarded, and chopped | 7 1/2 fluid ounces brandy | 1 large red onion, peeled and chopped ( about 3/4 cup )
instructions: Place cod in a bowl and sprinkle with salt. Cover and refrigerate for 24 hours. Remove cod from refrigerator 20 minutes before cooking. Discard salt used to cover. Place cod onto a lightly greased baking sheet. Roast, uncovered, in a small 425 oven, stirring the cod occasionally, about 10 minutes, or until it is opaque throughout and beginning to turn opaque and flakes easily when tested with a fork. Place in a large bowl and let cool to room temperature. Remove skin and discard. Strain chilies, discarding seeds and stems. In a small saucepan, combine chilies with brandy. Keep warm until ready to serve. In a serving bowl, combine the cod and onion. Add chilies mixture and serve.

title: Meatballs in Vanilla Sugar (Sødde Breton)
ingredients: 1 can frozen precooked meatballs | 1 teaspoon garlic salt ( to taste ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla bean ( to taste )
instructions: Remove and thaw 1 can of meatballs, reserving 1 1/2 cup of the juice per meatball. Boil the meat balls until they are no longer pink inside. When the meatballs are thawed, pour off the remaining juice, using just enough to get some of your meat juices into the skillet. Dice the meatballs, discarding the skin and bones, into bite size pieces and place them into the skillet. Add the flavorings and cook an additional 30 - 45 minutes.

title: Easy Sazon
ingredients: 1 packet sazon goya | 1 packet ajinomoto | 2 tablespoons garlic salt
instructions: In mortar and pestle crush the goya. Add ajinomoto and a pinch of garlic salt. Mix and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: golden syrup,egg noodle,maple syrup,canola oil,apple juice,sake
title: Maple Syrup Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1/3 cup maple syrup | 1/2 cup apple juice | 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 3 tablespoons sake ( optional ) | 4 ounces egg noodles | 1/4 cup canola oil
instructions: Combine the syrup, apple juice, syrup, and sake in a small pot simmer until the syrup is reduced to 3 tablespoons, about 5 minutes. Toss the noodles with the syrup and oil. Serve at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: virgin olive oil,hamburger bun,marinara sauce,cream mushroom soup,molasses,tea,pork loin roast
title: Pork Loin Rollups
ingredients: 2 cans cream of mushroom soup | 2 cans marinara sauce | 12 slices cooked pork loin roast | 2 tablespoons molasses | 2 tablespoons virgin olive oil | warmed sandwich buns | 1 tablespoon molasses, warmed
instructions: Mix one can of soup, the milk, and the molasses in a saucepan until smooth. Bring to a boil. Remove from heat and set aside to cool, then pour into a large bowl. Set aside. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium high heat. Place half of the roast into the bowl with the soup mixture, then quickly add the remaining roast, stirring well to separate. Cook for about 5 minutes per side, or until browned on the outside. Spread each sandwich with warmed sandwich buns. Spread cream soup mixture over all, then roll the roast up, placing seam side down in a baking dish that has been sprayed with cooking spray. Continue with the remaining roast and soup mixture until you've used up all of the pork and beans. Spread the remaining tablespoon of molasses on top of everything and let stand for 15 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: sushi rice,linguine,apple juice,chinese five spice powder
title: Five-Spice Sushi Linguine
ingredients: 2 tablespoons five spice powder | 1 cup sake or 1 cup rice wine | 1 can unsweetened apple juice ( i used apple juice concentrate ) | cooked linguine or flatbread
instructions: Boil water for linguine in a large saucepan. Drain and rinse linguine well in cold water. Place linguine in the pot and add the 3 spice rub and the apple or pineapple juice concentrate. Cook over medium heat for about 10 minutes or until pasta is tender and liquid is reduced considerably. Serve in bowls.

title: My Favorite Panna Cotta
ingredients: 2 cans refried beans | 1 cup beef broth | 1 1/2 tablespoons gelatin ( i use veggie ) | 1/2 cup toasted pine nuts
instructions: Place refried beans in a jelly roll pan. Pour broth over them. Sprinkle gelatin over the top, then sprinkle pine nuts over that. Place in preheated oven and heat through, about 15 - 20 minutes. Unmold onto platter, drizzle with remaining broth to taste, and serve.

title: Leafy Style Guacamole
ingredients: 4 avocados, ripe | 1 leek, white part only, chopped roughly 1 cm | 1 small onion salt | 2 tablespoons oil
instructions: Chop everything into really small, rough bits. I tend a hand held immersion blender for some seconds until all the ingredients are incorporated. Heat oil in skillet to medium heat and make sure that the surface of the mixture does not touch the surface of the pan. When oil is warmed up just throw in as many leeks as you can fit into the pan and stir fry them on medium heat for about 2 minutes, stirring regularly. Transfer the contents of the skillet to a bowl. With a slotted spoon, move the leeks, using your hands, down the length of the bowl. You can break the leeks into shreds and throw them into the bowl with the guacamole until all the leeks are gone and everything is thoroughly mixed together. Serve on warm pitas with lettuce, chopped tomatoes, salsa, fried onions and other toppings you may wish to use such as sour cream.

Random Ingredients: cumin seed,olive,yellow pepper,vanilla bean,apple,thai red curry paste,bacon
title: Thai Red Curry Paste
ingredients: 3 tablespoons olive, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon apple, finely chopped | 1 -2 teaspoon spanish thai red curry paste ( or other red curry paste ) | 1 teaspoon cumin seeds or 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 vanilla bean, split and scraped ( seeds intact ) | 1/3 cup yellow sweet pepper, finely chopped | 1/3 cup yellow sweet pepper, finely chopped
instructions: Place the olive, apple and curry paste in a blender in batches and puree. Add the cumin seeds and scraped vanilla bean. Season to taste with salt and pepper. If the paste is too thick, with a little water, stir in 1/2 teaspoon of salt. If too thin, add a little more water. Place the yellow and sweet peppers into a bowl and add the paste. Mix the paste until the ingredients are coated. Chill before using. Store in a tightly lidded jar in the fridge for up to 3 days.

Random Ingredients: asiago cheese,clear honey,avocado,horseradish,self rising cornmeal,cumin powder
title: Horseradish-Avocado Griddle Bread
ingredients: 6 ounces self-rising cornmeal | 1/4 cup clear honey | 1/4 cup chopped fresh horseradish | 1 pinch cumin powder | 1/4 - 1/3 cup asiago cheese, grated | 4 small avocados, halved and pitted
instructions: Preheat the griddle to medium/high heat. Beat together the cornmeal, honey, sourdough, horseradish, cumin and asiago. Brush the cut side of the bread with cold water. Spread about 1 tablespoon of the bread mixture over the entire surface and toast under the grill for about 10 minutes or until toasty and golden brown. Serve warm. Top with guavados. Enjoy.

title: Orange-Chile Roulades
ingredients: 4 cups egg whites | 1 cup raisins | 2 dried orange bell peppers
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees f. Grease a 10x15 inch jelly roll pan. Beat egg whites in a nonstick skillet until stiff. Fold in raisins and orange bell peppers. Pour into prepared pan. Bake in preheated oven until puffed and golden, about 1 hour.

title: Peanut Butter Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 10 ounces peanut butter | 6 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 ounce brandy | 1/4 piece ginger, skinned and grated
instructions: In a food processor blend the peanut butter with the oyster sauce and brandy until smooth and stir well. Serve with chicken or fish.

title: Easy Prime Rib Roast
ingredients: 4 lbs prime rib roast | 1 1/2 lbs mexican blend cheese, grated ( or other cheese of your choice ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried minced garlic
instructions: Preheat oven to place a non stick skillet in oven and turn oven off to set aside a 9x13 baking dish in the oven for at least 8 hours. While oven is heating up, place meat in a large skillet and add the cheese in small chunks. Sprinkle on dried garlic. Remove the roast from skillet and let cool until you can handle it, so you don't have extra cheese on top. With a sharp knife or very sharp butcher knife, slice the meat as thinly as possible, resulting in thick slivers that fall off the bone. It will be easy to work with. Return the meat to a bowl and sprinkle over the cheese and garlic. Place the roast in the oven on your oven rack, making sure you leave space between the meat and the cheese. Turn oven to broil. The best way to check temperature is to carefully lift the roast from the pan and place a piece of roast in the oven with the cheese inside. Turn oven off and place the baking dish in your oven.

Random Ingredients: pastry flour,sesame seed,grain white rice,skirt steak
title: Scottish Skirt Steak
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked long-grain white rice | 3 1/2 - 4 lbs skirt steaks | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds | 1/2 cup all-purpose pastry flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 f or 218 c degrees f. Spray a large baking sheet with cooking spray. Stir the rice into a bowl, add seasoning and stir to combine. Cut meat into serving sized pieces, such as flank steak or skirt steak.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,oil,pepper sauce,asafoetida powder,corn oil,snow pea,chicken
title: Chinese Stir Fry With As-Su (Sesame Oil)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon oil | 2 tablespoons corn oil | 12 ounces chicken, cut into small pieces | 2 ounces snow peas | 2 tablespoons asafoetida powder | 1/8 teaspoon hot pepper sauce ( optional ) | 8 ounces monterey jack cheese, shredded
instructions: Heat oil in hot wok. When oil is hot, add the asafoetida and stir fry for 2 minutes, stirring fry the chicken until it becomes light pink in color. Turn heat to low and add snow peas, asafoetida, and hot pepper sauce. Stir fry for 2 minutes till just heated. Sprinkle cheese on top and serve.

title: Radish and Yellow Squash
ingredients: 3 small yellow squash, peeled and halved | 1/2 cup radish, chopped | 1/4 cup raw cashews
instructions: Place squash halves in a microwave safe plastic bag, seal, and cook on high in microwave for 6 minutes. Using a slotted spoon remove squash, skin and seeds, and chop up into small pieces. Transfer squash to serving bowl, and sprinkle with radishes and raw cashews. Serve with plain yogurt or sour cream or sour cream sauce for dipping.

title: Spinach and Paneer Party Tray
ingredients: 2 cups baby spinach leaves | 1 cup frozen paneer, thawed, cut in pieces | 1/2 cup heinz chili sauce | 1/4 cup sweet pickled baby swiss cheese blend | 1/2 large green | mummy finger ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°. In a bowl combine spinach, paneer, and chili sauce. Place in shallow casserole dish that is. Bake, stirring occassionally, 5 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese. Place in preheated oven to cook 10 minutes more, or until cheese is melted. Remove from oven, garnish with baby swiss cheese and green.

title: Spicy Couscous
ingredients: 1 red pepper ( cored, seeded and finely diced ) | 300 g couscous
instructions: Pre heat the oven to 180°c. Spread the couscous in a large baking tray and leave in the oven to rise to 200°c/ 400°f / gas mark 5 for ten minutes. When it's ready, put the couscous in a bowl and pour over a little olive oil. Leave for 5 mins, or just until the couscous looks all set and slightly fluffy. Serve straight away with the red pepper and a side of green salad.

title: Pepperoni Chocolate Pizza
ingredients: 500 g whole wheat pastry flour | 2 teaspoons cinnamon | 2 teaspoons baking powder | 150 g pepperoni, roughly cut | 6 spring onions, white and green parts separated | 1/2 cup celery, chopped | 1 1/2 cups cocoa powder
instructions: Sift the flour, cinnamon and baking powder together and put into a bowl. Cut the pepperoni into 1cm slices, white part only and chopped stalks and chopped onions in 1cm pieces. Add the flour and pepperoni, mix and then put the spring onion whites and celery. Sprinkle the cocoa powder over the pastry, mix and then spread onto the bread and put in the oven for 12 minutes at 200°c. Turn off and leave for 10 minutes.

title: Italian Sausage and Salsa Pie
ingredients: 1/4 lb italian sausage | 2 pies crusts | 1 jar salsa
instructions: Preheat grill. When ready to cook, add sausage to hot grill.

title: Apple Cake (Gluten-Free)
ingredients: 9 ounces apples, fresh, peeled, halved, cored and sliced | 10 slices leek, white and a little purple, washed finely, cleaned and finely chopped | 1 tablespoon rosemary | 1/4 cup plain flour | 4 ounces cake flour, sifted | 2/3 cup rice vinegar | 6 ounces pecans, halved and coarsely chopped | 1 stalk fresh rosemary, extra finely chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c. Place the apples, leeks and rosemary in a casserole dish and sprinkle over the flour to coat all the surface. Add the rice vinegar to the pan juices in a thin stream. Stir to blend. Pour the liquid over the apples and leeks and stir gently to combine. Cover the casserole and bake for 15 minutes. Uncover the casserole and toss the pecans through it. Sprinkle generously over the top of the cake and place under the preheated broiler for 5 - 10 minutes or until golden. Garnish with extra rosemary leaves. Serve warm or cold.

title: Chile Cream Sauce for Chicken
ingredients: 2 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 1/4 cup chile cream sauce | 1 tablespoon tamarind paste, or to taste
instructions: Slice chicken crosswise into thin strips about 2/3x3 inches. Heat a skillet over high heat, and stir in chile cream sauce and tamarind paste. Cook and stir until heated through.

title: Tabbouleh With Carrots & Beans
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chickpeas, cooked | 20 g carrots, washed, peeled and cooked
instructions: Drain chickpeas & carrots and place in serving bowl with chickpeas & carrots. Toss well. Serve with a salad of fresh sprouts.

Random Ingredients: almond milk,chipotle chile adobo,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Chipotle Milk With Parmesan
ingredients: 1 cup almond milk | 2 chipotle chiles in adobo, seeded and minced | 1/4 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Heat the milk and chiles to simmer in a small saucepan over medium heat, stirring. Reduce the heat to low and add the cheese. Stir until melted, about 2 minutes. Cool slightly, then ladle into a shallow bowl, and refrigerate until chilled, about 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: farina,italian parsley,chicken stock fish,lamb shank,shrimp,peanut butter,yogurt,lemon zest
title: Spicy Lamb Shanks (Lamb Shank-Chicken Broth)
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg lamb shanks | 8 lamb shanks | 1 bunch italian parsley ( stalks trimmed ) | 300 ml chicken stock or 300 ml fish stock | 1 tablespoon lemon zest | 2 tablespoons dried shrimp ( optional ) | 3/4 cup yogurt | 150 g farina | 2 tablespoons peanut butter
instructions: For the stock, mix stock ingredients together in a pot and bring to a boil. Add meat on top of stock and reduce heat, cover and simmer for 1 - 1 1/2 hours. Remove meat and discard bones and discard bones. Skim fat as needed to remove excess fat. Add lemon zest to the pan and mix in shrimp and yogurt. Cut the lamb into thin slices. Cut lamb in half and cook in olive oil to the desired liking. For the soup, place farina flour in a bowl and pour boiling water over it. Leave for five minutes then stir well so farina flour is mixed well, then pour back onto top of beef. Add a little water if it becomes thick. Taste and make sure you have enough salt. Cover and leave for a further 45 minutes. Garnish, sprinkle with peanuts, finely grated parmesan or romano cheese and serve with a light dish, such as a salad and crusty bread.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning,bulgur,cardamom pod,bean sprout,asparagus,peppercorn,red food coloring
title: Asparagus and Bulgur Salad with Spicy Balsamic Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1 cup bulgur, fine ground grain | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning ( or seasoning of choice such as mrs. dash ) | 8 whole cardamom pods | 1 teaspoon peppercorn ( lightly crushed in a mortar and pestle or spice grinder ) | 8 -10 asparagus, cut into 1-inch pieces ( depending on size ) | 1 can fat-free refried beans ( i prefer fat-free ) | 1 cup red food coloring | 1 package frozen chopped asparagus
instructions: Place bulgar and taco seasoning in a bowl and set aside. Grind cardamom pods to a powder in a mortar and pestle or spice grinder, then rinse well under running water and then drain in a colander. In a large bowl, combine bulgar mix, 1 tsp. Taco seasoning or seasoning of choice, 5 or 6 asparagus pieces and 1 tsp. Hot water, mixing very until combined and well combined. Arrange asparagus in a single layer on a plate. Sprinkle remaining 1 tsp. Taco seasoning in a shallow serving dish or on top of the bulgar mixture in the shallow serving dish. Drizzle with about 1/2 cup of the refried bean liquid or remaining bean liquid in the bottom. Add asparagus and remaining 1/2 cup of refried bean liquid. Stir gently to coat. Sprinkle rest of the taco seasoning on top. Let sit 10 minutes or so to absorb flavors. Garnish with the remaining asparagus pieces. Note, asparagus may be eaten in the traditional manner, but it tastes much better if marinated for a few hours before cooking prior to cooking.

title: Chili Salt
ingredients: 5 -6 small dried red chilies | 2 -3 lbs beef eye
instructions: Grind dried chilies as fine as possible to a fine powder. Mix powder thoroughly with other dry ingredients. If using as ground meat, do not add oil until mixture is well mixed throughout. If not using as ground meat, drain off any fat. Pack in tightly, tightly sealed plastic bag, and refrigerate at least 2 days before using. Heat oven to 300 degrees f. Remove air from bag and close tightly. Place in roasting pan to keep oven safe and heat. Remove from oven when cold. Heat 3 - 5 minutes at 300 degrees f. Unwrap meat. Place on cutting board, using 3 forks to pull thin shreds of fat from bag. Using the slotted metal blade of a meat knife, tear the excess fatty tissue from the meat, and use to remove excess fat. The mixture can then be placed back in bags, tightly sealed, in a large roasting pan. The key is to do this in the oven, and not as tightly or as tightly packed as possible. You may also be able to cut and stuff the meat, which will last in the freezer for up to six months. Remove from pan, and store, tightly wrapped, at room temperature until ready to use about 5 months before eating the meat.

Random Ingredients: swiss chard,balsamic vinegar,kosher salt,banana,palm sugar,mexican cheese
title: Mexican-Style Greens
ingredients: 4 large bunches swiss chard, coarsely chopped | 2 medium bananas, cut lengthwise into 1/4-inch-thick slices | 1/4 cup unsalted roasted giardiniera ( see note in directions ) or 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 1/4 cup light palm sugar | 1/4 cup kosher salt | 1/2 cup shredded mexican mexican cheese or 1/2 cup cheddar cheese
instructions: Toss together chard leaves, bananas and giardiniera until well coated and set aside. In small saucepan, bring to boil half of the sugar, the salt and 2 tablespoons of the water. Stir and boil, without stirring, until melted. Remove from heat and cool to room temperature. Toss with greens and remaining sugar mixture. Serve sprinkled with cheese.

title: Japanese Barley Patties
ingredients: 1 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 2 cups fine dry breadcrumbs | 1 cup barley | 3 tablespoons tamari | 1/2 cup red bell pepper, chopped | 2 teaspoons fresh gingerroot, grated
instructions: Place 3 1/2 cups of the fine bread crumbs, barley and tamari in a medium bowl. Stir well. Add remaining ingredients and mix thoroughly. Use 1/2 cup of the crumb for every 4 or 5 hamburgers. Shape into patties or make into crescents and fry in oil until crispy.

Random Ingredients: hamburger bun,garam masala,hot red chili pepper,chicken wing,apricot preserve,bisquick,grainy mustard
title: Easy & Easy Barbecue Chicken Nuggets
ingredients: 4 lbs chicken wings ( trimmed and separated ) | 2 teaspoons garam masala ( or more if desired ) | 2 teaspoons coarse grainy mustard | 1 tablespoon dried hot red chili pepper ( or more ) | 2 cups original bisquick | 12 hamburger buns | 1/4 cup apricot preserves ( optional )
instructions: Place chicken wings in a bowl with the hot red pepper and garlic. Toss to coat. Coat the chicken with garam masala, mustard and chili and rub into chicken on all sides. Place chicken on a rack in the broiler pan. Broil or grill until golden brown, approx 11 minute or until chicken is just cooked through. Remove and wrap in plastic foil. Let bake on a baking sheet in a 250f oven for about 1 hour. Heat oven to 375 f. Line baking sheet with foil, then line with foil. Remove breasts from the wings and cut into bite size nugget pieces. In a large bowl, combine bisquick.

title: Russian Dill Tea
ingredients: 2 cups vegetable broth ( or water ) | 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour | 3 tablespoons dill sprigs ( dried ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons garlic ( minced or pressed )
instructions: Combine broth, sprigs and salt in a dutch oven and bring to a boil over high heat. Add garlic and sprigs. Reduce heat to medium heat and let simmer until sprigs float, about 5 minutes. Pour the giest off the sprigs and discard. Transfer the sprigs to the broth and stir. Remove the pot and heat for about 20 minutes or until it is piping hot. Serve hot or at room temperature.

title: Easy Pizza Crust
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs yeast, preferably active at room temperature or 1 1/4 lbs unbleached flour, preferably unbleached, for kneading | 1 1/2 cups warm olive | 1 1/2 cups grated fresh parmesan cheese, with garlic | of fresh mint ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Note, if using dried yeast, omit the yeast, used in this recipe and cover it loosely with a damp cloth. Allow to ferment at room temperature 15 minutes, then punch down the dough and let it rest until doubled in size, 5 - 10 minutes.. Add all the ingredients into the bowl and mix until just combined. Shape into one big rectangle on a greased jelly roll pan, cover with a damp cloth and let rise, covered, for an hour. While the dough is rising, preheat the oven to 375°f. Use a pizza stone or baking stone in a regular oven. Remove the dough from the bread pan and cut into four pieces. Using a serrated knife, divide the dough into four pieces, each piece about the size of a small fist. Roll each piece of dough out to about a 6 diameter circle on a lightly floured counter. With both hands, stretch each circle a little over 2/3 of the edge. Fold the dough over and pinch to seal. Place on a lightly floured baking sheet or parchment paper and let rise until doubled in size, about 45 - 60 minutes. Poke holes all over the surface of the dough, using the tines of a fork. Sprinkle with sugar, garlic or other herbs, etc. Place the pizzas on a lightly oiled baking sheet and put into the preheated oven, or on a pizza pan or grill. Bake on the middle rack or top shelf of the oven for 6 - 8 minutes. Serve warm. If not using right away, add a little water at this stage just before putting in the pizza crust..

title: Prawn Brik
ingredients: 500 g raw prawns | 1 tablespoon cream of tartar | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1 tablespoon tamari | 1 tablespoon lime juice | 1 sheet phyllo pastry
instructions: Shell and devein prawns, reserving heads and shells, leaving the heads intact and leaving them whole if necessary.

title: Grilled Okra with Truffles and Lime-Caper Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups fresh okra, sliced lengthwise 1/8-inch thick | 1 cup tahini paste | 3 tablespoons sugar | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/2 teaspoon peppercorn, cracked | 1 can refrigerated cooled whip, thawed | 3/4 cup shredded coconut | 6 lime wedges
instructions: Prepare grill to high. Place okra on grill rack coated with cooking spray.

Random Ingredients: onion flake,water,goat cheese,thai fish sauce,green chili,vanilla pudding mix
title: Dees French Dip
ingredients: 1 package instant vanilla pudding mix | 2 tablespoons water | 2 tablespoons red thai fish sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons onions flakes | 2 tablespoons goya mild green chili, drained and minced | 16 ounces goat cheese, grated
instructions: Mix all ingredients in mixer and refrigerate for a minute or two. Serve with crackers.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,fish sauce,bread crumb,vegetable oil,rice noodle,glace cherry,strawberry
title: Cherry and Strawberries Noodles
ingredients: 4 cups vegetable stock | 1 tablespoon gluten-free fish sauce | 1 tablespoon rice noodles | 2 tablespoons shredded glace cherries ( optional ) | 1 package frozen unsweetened strawberries | 2 tablespoons seasoned bread crumbs
instructions: Heat the vegetable stock, fish sauce, and rice noodles in a saucepan over high heat, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer until the noodles are tender, and the liquid has cooked down, about 5 minutes. While the noodles are cooking, remove the stems from the strawberries and cut into 1/4 inch slices. Dry the strawberries in a large bowl. Set aside. Arrange the bread crumbs on a large dinner plate, and spread the crumbs in batches on another plate. Set the noodles aside on a clean surface and keep warm in oven. Preheat the oven's broiler and set the oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. When the noodle mixture has been heated through briefly, stir in the strawberries, and sprinkle the top with the bread crumbs. Return to the broiler until the bread crumbs are golden brown, 3 to 5 minutes.

title: Baked Basil Rice With Basil (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs basmati rice ( about 12 to 16 ounces ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried basil ( optional )
instructions: Make a well in the rice and add the basil, if using. Make sure rice is covered with water by a few inches. Pour water over rice. Place lid on rice cooker, press cook. When it starts to fluff up on its own, recover cover and cook on high for 1 hour and 10 minutes or until the rice is tender and water has absorbed. Let stand 5 - 10 minutes and fluff with a fork.

Random Ingredients: littleneck clam,green apple,hellmann mayonnaise,black tea,cannellini bean,rice noodle
title: Tilapia and White Catfish Stew
ingredients: 1/2 pound fresh littleneck clams, rinsed and well drained | 1 1/2 cups cannellini beans, rinsed and drained | 2 green apple, cored and cubed | 1/3 cup uncooked rice noodles | 1/3 cup hellmann's mayonnaise | 1 1/2 cups hot black tea
instructions: Place clams in a large saucepan with cannellini beans and apple. Cover and cook over medium heat for 5 minutes until the beans are hot, stirring occasionally. Cook the rice noodles according to package directions. Drain well and transfer to a large bowl. Stir in the mayonnaise and then gradually stir in the hot black tea. Add the clams and cook for another 30 seconds and serve.

Random Ingredients: black olive,pimiento,basil leaf,rotini pasta,artichoke heart,baking soda,soya sauce,farfalle pasta
title: Pasta Antipasta (Pasta Salad With Artichokes)
ingredients: 2 cups farfalle pasta ( bowtie ) | 1 bunch fresh basil leaf, chopped | 2 artichoke hearts, chopped | 1 jar sliced black olives, drained | 1 jar pimientos, drained | 1 1/2 teaspoons soya sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons baking soda | 1/2 cup low sodium soya sauce | 0.5 package rotini pasta
instructions: Heat a large pot of water to boiling. Add pasta. Cook 10 to 12 minutes, or until al dente.

title: Indian Mushrooms Au Gratin
ingredients: 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 1/2 lb button mushroom, sliced | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 lime wedge | 2 tablespoons brewed coffee | 1 teaspoon masala | 2 tablespoons roasted peanuts
instructions: Mix golden syrup, mushroom, cumin and lime wedge in a bowl. Brush mushrooms with half the coffee. Arrange on a serving platter. Sprinkle with peanuts. Drizzle with remaining coffee.

Random Ingredients: potato,rice vinegar,cottage cheese,scotch bonnet pepper,white cheddar cheese,pistachio nut,prosciutto
title: Cheesy Baked Hashbrowns
ingredients: 1 cup cooked simply potatoes diced potatoes | 1/2 cup cottage cheese | 1/2 cup diced prosciutto | 1/2 cup shredded white cheddar cheese | 1/2 cup chopped salted pistachio nuts | 1/4 cup rice vinegar ( or cider vinegar ) | 1/4 cup chopped scotch bonnet pepper ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Mix all the ingredients together and pour in parchment paper lined cookie sheets. Bake for about 40 minutes until the top is golden brown and crispy. These freeze well and can be microwaved or deep fried.

title: Caribbean Beer & Melon Soup
ingredients: 2 tablespoons coconut cream ( optional ) | 6 cups reduced-sodium fat-free chicken broth | 1 can reduced-sodium fat-free evaporated milk | 1 can fat-free reduced-sodium beer | 1 cup frozen chopped melon ( such as melon pears, papaya, kiwi, melon balls or orange slice ) | 8 thin slices of fresh mango ( such as pineapple, mango, pineapple with papaya or papaya )
instructions: In a food processor, blend coconut cream, chicken broth and evaporated milk. Pour into the slow cooker stir in the beer. Cover and cook on low for about 5 1/2 hours. Serve soup in small soup bowls topped with the mango slices.

Random Ingredients: mccormick seasoning,egg noodle,yellow mustard seed,basmati rice,swiss cheese,nonstick cooking spray,mustard powder,yellow cornmeal
title: Quick and Easy Ham-Noodle Bake
ingredients: 1 lb egg noodles | nonstick cooking spray | 3/4 cup yellow mustard seeds | 1/2 teaspoon mccormick's montreal brand steak seasoning | 1/2 cup yellow cornmeal | 1 cup nonstick cooking spray | 1/2 cup nonstick cooking spray | 1 cup swiss cheese, shredded | 1 teaspoon dry mustard powder | 1/4 cup yellow mustard seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Cook and drain egg noodles according to package directions, omitting salt and fat. Drain noodles and return to pan and toss with 1/4 cup french's french's french' blend shredded cheese, 1 teaspoon mustard powder, 1/4 cup mustard seeds and 1/4 cup yellow mustard. Pour into 2 1/2 to 3 quart size round loaf pan and cover dish tightly with saran wrap. Bake uncovered for 35 - 45 minutes until golden brown and bubbly and cooked through. Remove from heat and cool to room temperature. Cut into 1 1/2 to 3 thick slices and serve with the remaining cheese. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: caster sugar,garlic powder,seasoning,chicken bouillon,green pea,white pepper,linguine
title: Linguine With Pease, Garlic and Seasonings
ingredients: 400 g linguine ( or small shells ) | 100 g green peas ( frozen or fresh ) | 2 tablespoons of fresh garlic powder | 1 -2 teaspoon white pepper ( optional ) | 10 1/2 ml chicken bouillon | 2 g maggi seasoning, packet | 2 -3 drops of good quality maggi seasoning, powder
instructions: Boil 3 cups of water. While boiling, place the peas in the saucepan and add a couple tablespoons of salt and pepper. Drain. Pour the boiling water and salt into a pan and on high heat stir in the peas. Stir and cook for 5 to 10 minutes. Add the garlic powder, white pepper, and a couple of tablespoons of salt and pepper, if using. Mix well. Now, drain the linguine and set aside. Now drain the linguine and put back into the frying pan. Pour the boiling water and about 2 tablespoons of salt and pepper into the frying pan and stir to mix. Make sure that the lid is on. When the pan is half full, put the lid back on and cook for about 15 minute. This will ensure that your sauce will not stick to the noodles. The noodles will not cook evenly. To keep them, let your stove stand on medium heat until the noodles are almost cooked. This could take up to 15 minutes. If i happen to have a huge linguine pot, i'll put my lid back on and cook them for 15 more minutes. To serve, add the remaining maggi seasoning, stir until well mixed. Serve the linguine with sauce on the side.

Random Ingredients: winter squash,mustard powder,chili garlic sauce,sharp cheddar cheese,pineapple juice
title: Spicy Squash
ingredients: 500 g winter squash ( approx 175g ) | 60 ml pineapple juice | 30 ml mustard powder | 2 teaspoons chili-garlic sauce | 1 teaspoon grated sharp cheddar cheese or 1 teaspoon monterey jack cheese
instructions: Slice the squash in half, scrape out any seeds and throw into a saucepan on the stove with the rest of your ingredients. Simmer until squash are tender and sauce thickens. Serve over mashed potato, noodles or rice.

Random Ingredients: spinach leaf,jalapeno pepper,mushroom,farfalle pasta,lasagna noodle,kosher salt black pepper,lebanese cucumber,liquid smoke
title: Spinach and Mushroom Lasagna
ingredients: 1 package lasagna noodles, broken into bite-sized pieces | 5 ounces mushrooms, sliced | 1 lebanese cucumber, sliced | 1 package sliced fresh spinach leaves | 1 can sliced jalapeno peppers | 1 can liquid smoke, divided | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped kosher salt and ground black pepper, divided | 1/2 cup chopped kale
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. Place lasagna noodles into a large bowl of hot water to soften, about 5 minutes. Drain and set aside. Place mushrooms, cucumber, spinach, 1 jalapeno pepper, and 1/2 liquid smoke in a bowl, and toss to combine. Heat remaining liquid smoke in a skillet over medium heat. Stir in the sausage to cook. Pour hot sausage mixture into the bottom of the prepared baking dish. Top with sausage mixture, then top with noodles. Spoon the mushroom mixture on top in an even layer. Bake in the preheated oven until bottom is browned, about 40 minutes. Sprinkle top with coarsely chopped kale.

Random Ingredients: red cherry,white fish fillet,salad green,baking soda
title: Fish, Forest Capsicum, and Red Salsp
ingredients: 1 lb white fish fillet ( salmon, halibut, snapper, cod, orange roughy work best ) | 8 red cherries | 4 ounces mixed salad greens | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 4 ounces mixed salad greens
instructions: Cut the fish in half and remove any large bones. Score the flesh and discard. Slice into 1 inch slices on either side of the fish, then arrange one slice on top of each other on a serving platter. Place the cherries in a small bowl, fill with water, and cover with the plastic wrap. Place a cutting board or sharp knife alongside the fish to prevent chunks of fish from peeling off of fish. Chill for at least 30 minutes and up to 6 hours. Preheat the oven to 400°f line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Arrange the mixed greens on a serving platter and top with the cherry slices. Bake for about 10 minutes or until the cherries are warm to the touch. Remove the wrap from the fish and garnish with the cherry slices.

Random Ingredients: red jalapeno,cider vinegar,coriander sprig,lime peel,parsnip,cannellini bean
title: Parsnips, Chickpeas and Bean Relish - Caribbean, Caribbean
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 2 medium parsnips, peeled and julienned | 1 medium red jalapeno, seeded and chopped | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1 1/2 teaspoons fresh lime peel | 1/4 cup fresh coriander sprig
instructions: Place beans in a medium bowl. Add parsnips, red jalapeño, cider vinegar, lime peel and coriander. Mix thoroughly. Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve within 2 hours so vegetables develop a crisp crust. Makes about 1 cup.

title: Sesame-Geezed Garlic Filling for Beef Rolls
ingredients: 1 teaspoon sesame oil | 1 can beef bouillon cubes | 1/2 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon lime ( or 2 tablespoons lime juice and 1 tbsp lime juice ) | 1 teaspoon sesame oil | 1/4 teaspoon italian seasoning, to taste
instructions: Combine all ingredients & mix until smooth. Cover & chill for at least 8 hours before using as a seasoning for meats, fish or vegetables. Use in buns.

title: Edamame Beef
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef stew meat | 1 1/2 lbs fresh edamame, cut into 5 inch pieces | 2 teaspoons cardamom pods | 1 package brie cheese, sliced
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add edamame and cook for 8 minutes, or until tender but firm. Drain. Add cardamom and cheese and stir. Top with meat and veggies. Cover and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes or until cooked through.

Random Ingredients: mace,english cucumber,rice noodle,superfine sugar,sesame seed,stewing beef,carrot
title: Mae's Beef Noodle Vegetable Stir-fry
ingredients: 8 ounces stewing beef | 6 ounces rice noodles | 3 ounces carrots | 2 english cucumbers | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 1 teaspoon sesame seeds | 1 teaspoon superfine sugar
instructions: Get your beef or chicken tenderised so the noodles won't stick. Soak the rice noodles in rapidly boiling water so the noodles don't stick to each other, about 5 mins drain thoroughly. Cut up your vegetables, but leave just a few minutes, or they will become too tough. Meanwhile mix all the other ingredients together and stirfry together in a wok until coated. Put the beef on top and stir for another 10 mins or until the beef is cooked through. Serve with noodles and some kho's.

Random Ingredients: green bean,red kidney bean,apricot jam,salmon steak,garlic powder,thyme leaf
title: Smoked Salmon and Beans
ingredients: 4 salmon steaks | 4 green beans | 4 dried apricots with jam | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 1 -2 clove garlic powder | 3/4 cup canned red kidney beans ( optional )
instructions: Wash beans, cut off ends, then remove and discard green beans, and split them in half. Cut beans lengthwise, then lightly blanch them for about a minute or two. Remove from water and set aside. Rinse salmon steaks in cold water, dry with crisco, drain, and then cut salmon in 6 portions into 4 portions. Place one portion of each ingredient, such as jam for apricot jam, or salt and pepper if desired, in small casserole dish. Spread half the cooked beans over the top of each portion of salmon and place remaining portions of salmon on top of the beans. Dot salmon with remaining cooked beans and sprinkle remaining chopped tomato on top of. Cover with thick foil and bake in preheated 350 degree oven for about 1 1/4 hours or until cooked. Serve warm with a green salad or salad of your choice.

Random Ingredients: red snapper fillet,maple syrup,brown sugar,chicken stock,bacon dripping,cumin seed
title: Red Snapper With Maple Syrup
ingredients: 3 lbs red snapper fillets | 150 ml chicken stock | 1 teaspoon brown sugar | 1 teaspoon ground cumin seed | 4 slices bacon drippings | 2 tablespoons pure maple syrup
instructions: Rinse the fillets under running water. Rinse well. Heat the bacon drippings in a large skillet over medium high heat. Add the white side of the fillets.

title: Lemon Salad With Potatoes
ingredients: 1 baking potato, peeled and cut in chunks | 1 lb green cabbage or 1 lb other green cabbage, chopped | 1/4 cup mixed salad oil | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 1 lemon, cut into 6 wedges, to squeeze juice over
instructions: Boil potato in a large pot of salted water until just soft, not breaking or discarding its skins. Drain, cool, and cut into 1/2 x3/4 chunks. In a large bowl, combine cabbage with potato, oil, and balsamic vinegar. Mix well. Pour into a serving dish and garnish with the lemon wedges.

Random Ingredients: ketjap manis,rice wine,red wine vinegar,tart apple,tomato puree,peanut butter,green bean
title: Green Bean Salad
