ingredients: 1 lb trimmed green beans | 1 large tart apple, cut into 1-inch slices ( about 2 cups ) | 1 can tomato puree | 2 tablespoons peanut butter | 1/2 cup ketchup ( kikkoman brand ) | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 1/4 cup ketjap manis
instructions: Snap ends from beans, if necessary.

title: Lighter Sour Cream Spaghetti Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1/4 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 can cream of coconut | 1 jar spaghetti sauce
instructions: Heat vegetable oil in skillet on medium heat. Add pepper, onions and cumin powder. Simmer 3 minutes for onions and spices to soften. Add coconut, increase heat to high and heat about 5 minutes. Reduce heat to medium and lightly coat spaghetti. Serve on top of spaghetti.

Random Ingredients: basmati rice,baby spinach leaf,lemon juice zest,gin,biscuit,orange juice concentrate
title: Gin-Glazed Basmati Rice Balls With a Lemon Twist
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked basmati rice, rinsed | 4 cups fresh baby spinach leaves | 1/2 cup frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed | 2 tablespoons gin | 2 tablespoons lemon juice, freshly squeezed | 3 refrigerated biscuits
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees and spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add rice, stir, then cover and remove from heat. Let sit for 5 minutes. Fluff rice with a fork, then drain in a strainer. Rinse with running water, drain again, then squeeze out excess water. Transfer rice to a bowl, add 1/2 cup spinach and orange juice concentrate and toss well. Mix in gin, lemon juice and remaining 5 cups spinach. Cover rice mixture with a piece of plastic wrap and refrigerate about 1 hour to soften. Shape rice mixture into balls about 1 inch in diameter with moist hands. Place on a tray and refrigerate until set, about 30 minutes. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Heat biscuits in preheated oven until warm, about 3 minutes. Dip each biscuit in coconut flavored rice, letting excess drip off. Quickly place biscuits on foil, then carefully peel off foil. Bake rice balls, turning once, for 20 - 25 minutes. Let cool, then break into 2 inch pieces.

Random Ingredients: coriander powder,lime,superfine sugar,arbol chile,ricotta cheese,pimiento,italian tomato,heavy cream
title: Chile Rellenos Poached in Tomato Gravy
ingredients: 1 poblano chile | 2 cans italian-style peeled tomatoes | 1 jar marinated pimientos | 2 tablespoons superfine sugar | 8 ounces ricotta cheese or 8 ounces cottage cheese | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh coriander powder | 1 lime | 1 cup heavy cream
instructions: Preheat the broiler or grill to high. Cut the stem and blossom end of the poblano, remove the seeds. Cut the chile into 1/4 inch rounds, then cut the rounds in half lengthwise.

title: Citrus Pork and Vegetables
ingredients: 1 pork loin roast | 1 eggplant, sliced | 1 turnip, chopped | 1 small radish, finely diced | 2 cups canned raspberries | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | lettuce leaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 360°f place vegetable into a baking dish and season with salt. Place roast on top of vegetable. Pour vinegar over roast. Cover pan tightly with foil. Bake for about 3 hours or until meat thermometer registers 145f or reaches desired degree of doneness. Remove from oven. Let cool for 20 minutes. Slice into thick slices and arrange on lettuce with raspberries. Serve.

title: Fettuccine With Marinated Meat and Apricots
ingredients: 12 ounces mincemeat | 1 can green beans, drained | 1 yellow onion, diced | 3 screwpine leaves, torn | 3 tablespoons apricot preserves | 16 ounces dry fettuccine
instructions: Mix mince with onions. Wash fettuccine, boil until slightly al dente. Drain, add to mince mixture, simmer 3 minutes. Drain off excess liquid. Add remaining ingredients except for noodles, heat until simmering. Top with screwpine leaves, serve with grated cheese if desired.

Random Ingredients: snow pea,tomato,mango chutney,artichoke heart,knorr vegetable soup mix,baking soda,white sugar
title: Chutney, Tomato and Snow Pea Bake
ingredients: 1/2 package knorr vegetable soup mix | 1/3 cup mango chutney or 1/3 cup ketchup | 1 1/2 tablespoons baking soda | 1/2 teaspoon white sugar | 1/2 cup kerryr's dry vegetable soup mix | 14 1/2 ounces stewed tomatoes | 1 1/2 cups fresh snow pea, trimmed | 1 medium ripe mango, thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly coat a 9 x 13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. In a medium bowl, stir together onion soup mix, ketchup, baking soda and sugar. Pour mixture into prepared baking dish. Combine stewed tomatoes and snow peas in a large bowl.

title: Crock Pot Slow Cooker Red Wine Nachos
ingredients: 500 g hamburger | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 2 tablespoons red wine | 1 1/2 teaspoons thyme | tortilla chips
instructions: In a large crock pot brown the hamburger. Dissolve the chicken bouillon cube in the red wine. Stir it into the hamburger. Add thyme. Pour into crock pot. Cook on low setting for 8 hours. Serve over taco shells, nacho's or burritos. I like this recipe to serve with a tortilla chips, sliced green onion and salsa and sour cream or cilantro. You can also serve this with warm flour tortillas and salsa. Makara.

title: Smoked Port and Prosciutto Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups white rice | 1/4 cup ruby port | 2 tablespoons marsala wine | 1/2 teaspoon blackened dried bay leaf | 1/2 cup frozen blueberries | 8 slices smoked prosciutto, chopped
instructions: In a small saucepan over medium heat, cover the port and marsala wine with the blackened marinade. Simmer for 15 minutes, then remove the port and stir in the blueberries. Cook for an additional 5 minutes, or until slightly thickened, and pour into a bowl. Serve rice drizzled with bacon bits, if desired..

title: Frothy Eclairs
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups fresh herbs, chopped into small pieces | 3 tablespoons orange blossom water | 2 1/2 tablespoons fresh lemon rind, chopped into small pieces
instructions: In a large bowl mix all the ingredients using a rubber spatula. Divide the mixture into 24 pieces and roll into small circular patties. Preheat broiler or grill and brush with oil. Broil or grill patties until brown, about 2 minutes per side. These can be topped with chopped pistachios if desired.

title: Quick and Easy Tilapia Fillets With Oyster-Garlic & Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 tablespoon honey | 12 ounces tilapia fillets, thawed and halved horizontally | 12 large mushrooms, thinly sliced | 1/2 teaspoon orange peel | 14 1/2 ounces broccoli florets, drained | 8 sheets phyllo pastry, thawed
instructions: Microwave honey on high 3 - 5 minutes until softened. Stir in tilapia and mushrooms. Microwave on high 1 - 2 minutes or until the veggies are just tender, stirring once. Stir in orange peel and broccoli, and season with pepper. Microwave fillets on high 2 - 3 minutes, turning once, until fish is golden. Let cool slightly. Lay fillets on a work surface. Sprinkle with a little of the oyster garlic mixture. Top with mushroom mixture. Fold the phyllo pastry over the filling, and roll up. Brush with honey to glaze, and continue with remaining fillets and filling. Serve at once with a salad and crusty italian bread.

title: Molho
ingredients: 100 g ground beef round or 100 g ground beef | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 4 tablespoons gelatin | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1 tablespoon pimiento | 1 teaspoon sumac | 1 cup dried cranberries | fried fried shallots ( optional )
instructions: Soak the ground beef in cold water to cover for 30 minutes or until the water is the consistency of small watery biscuits. Soak the gelatin in cold very water until soft. Dissolve the sugar in boiling water. Blend this with the pimento, sumac, gelatin and cooked beef. Transfer the mixture to a jelly mould. Gently cover with fried shallots and chill until set. Cut into fingers when cold, store in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk,cream,red chili pepper,scarlet runner bean,sake,nutritional yeast,tortilla chip
title: Chile Coconut Dip (Vegan)
ingredients: 1/4 cup pure coconut milk ( no substitute ) | 1/4 cup cream | 2 -3 teaspoons nutritional yeast ( optional ) | 1 medium red chili pepper, chopped ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon sake ( optional ) or 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar ( optional ) | 1/4 cup frozen chopped and roasted cauliflower sprout or 1/4 cup fresh baby spinach | 1/3 cup tortilla chips, toasted, crushed in the oven ( gluten free, sugar free, if desired )
instructions: Combine coconut milk, cream, nutritional yeast, and chili in a bowl and set aside. Place frozen cauliflower and sprouts in a saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a boil, and immediately remove from heat. Cool slightly, and drain. Chop and combine with the tofu and bean mixture, adding additional tamari if desired.

Random Ingredients: rice vinegar,french onion soup,sultana,taco flour tortilla,red potato,garlic clove
title: Easy French Onion Potato Burritos (Potatoes Fritters) My Aussie Style
ingredients: 4 medium red potatoes, depending on how large they are | 400 g french onion soup ( or other onion soup ) | 1 garlic clove | 1 packet frito onion soup biscuits ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons sultanas ( optional ) | rice vinegar, a small amount of balsamic vinegar is nice ( optional )
instructions: Boil until the potatoes are tender. Meanwhile, grate your potatoes. Mince garlic. Heat up a large frying pan, add the garlic. Add the onions. Cook until they are soft and starting to brown in colour. Drain excess fat then add the french onion soup. Put the potato mixture in your bowls, spread with sultanas. Top with a few biscuits, and roll up. Spray a frying pan with olive oil spray. You can spray it once in a while to help the brown off and crisp up, then put on a paper towel to dry. Repeat for all the potato/onion mixture until the potatoes are finished. Cut the extra dough and fry in the pan until nicely browned. Serve up and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: mayonnaise,potato starch,cremini mushroom,vegetable,sherry wine,ginger garlic paste
title: Potato Starch Muffins
ingredients: 1 cup frozen mixed vegetables | 1/2 cup mayonnaise ( not miracle whip ) | 1/4 cup sweet sherry wine ( or apple cider ) | 2 1/2 teaspoons sherry wine vinegar or 2 1/2 teaspoons lemon juice | 1/2 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 3 tablespoons potato starch | 2 tablespoons cremini mushrooms, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. Combine all ingredients except mushrooms and blend. Gently fold in mushrooms. Spoon into 12 muffin trays or muffin pans and bake 18 to 20 minutes or until done.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,english mustard,mayonnaise,sea salt,tomato,parmigiano reggiano cheese,black cardamom pod,lemon zest
title: Baked Tomatoes With Smoked Paprika and Garlic
ingredients: 8 tomatoes, ripe but firm | 1 cup mayonnaise | 2 tablespoons sweet smoked paprika ( good quality, but not hot ) | 2 teaspoons finely grated lemon zest | 2 1/2 teaspoons sea salt | 1/2 teaspoon freshly ground black cardamom pod, crushed | 1 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese or 1 cup pecorino romano cheese | 8 -12 tablespoons picante sauce ( or salsa, if you prefer )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Using a tomato, cut a 5 or 6 inch length at the top of each tomato. Put slices on the baking sheet just close together and set aside. Whisk together in a small bowl the mayonnaise, smoked paprika, lemon zest, sea salt, black cardamom, half the cheese and picante sauce until smooth, or to taste. Spread about a tablespoon of the sweet smoked paprika mixture over the tops of the tomatoes. Smoke the tomatoes for 10 to 15 minutes, until the paprika is dark, bubbling, and beginning to brown. Arrange on a baking sheet and place in the oven for about 15 minutes, or until they are cooked through and the tops are dry. Let cool for a few minutes, but serve at least warm,.

title: Mexican Cabbage
ingredients: 6 leaves red cabbage | 1/2 teaspoon dried mexican oregano | 1/2 cup water | 1 large red cabbage, cut into large chunks
instructions: Trim excess very coarsely chopped cabbage. Cut each cabbage head into 4 wedges. Combine oregano with water and set aside. Combine cabbage wedges and 1/2 teaspoon salt in a medium saucepan on medium high heat. Cook, stirring, 4 - 5 minutes until browned. Add water mixture and cook, on high heat, until water begins to boil and cabbage is just tender, about 10 minutes. Stir in remaining 1/4 teaspoon salt before serving.

title: Spaghetti With Beetroot
ingredients: 4 -8 medium beets or 3 -6 small beet, quartered | 2 1/2 cups spaghetti or 2 1/2 cups vermicelli | 1 1/2 cups half and half cream | 2 whole eggs | fresh red chili pepper flakes
instructions: Place beets in boiling water til cooked but slightly firm. Drain well and place in a bowl of cold water. Pierce with a fork several times and drain well. Place them on paper towels to drain. Place in a heavy saucepan with 1 cup water and bring to simmer over medium heat. Cook for approximately 15 minutes. Remove from heat, drain and place in a bowl and cover with 2/3 cup water. Simmer over low heat for 5 minutes to soften beetroot.. Place cooked beets in a large serving pot. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Add beets and simmer over low heat, covered about an hour or until beetroots are fork tender. Remove cover and cook, stirring occasionally until hot and slightly reduce, about 10 more minutes.

title: French Celery and Garlic Bread
ingredients: 1 french bread | 1 teaspoon celery, minced ( celery leaves- i remove the skin from the stalks as it makes it easier to remove )
instructions: Slice french bread into 1/4 inch or a small loaf, about 1/2 inch thick. Place slices on a baking sheet and drizzle with celery seed oil. Sprinkle with more celery or garlic salt and bake at 350°f/180°c for a few minutes on each side until well browned, stirring occasionally. Eat when loaf is browned.

title: Cashew Cheese and Cabbage
ingredients: 3 teaspoons oil | 2 cups of finely shredded green cabbage | 1 cup of chopped cashews
instructions: Heat oil in a skillet and add the cashews. When they turn light brown, add cabbage and stir fry 3 minutes over medium heat. Serve hot with chutney.

Random Ingredients: apricot jam,parmesan cheese,poppy seed,apple cider,dark soy sauce,pork shoulder,vanilla extract
title: Italian Barbecue Pork Rolls
ingredients: 4 lbs pork shoulder, boneless, cut into thirds | 2 tablespoons poppy seeds | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/2 cup prune jam | 1/2 cup reduced-fat apricot jam | 1/2 cup reduced-fat parmesan cheese, grated
instructions: Set up the barbecue for the barbecue, place all of the dry ingredients in a large ziploc bag and add the pork. Seal and massage all of the dry ingredients into the pork and ensure that each piece is thoroughly coated. Place the bag in the refrigerator and allow the pork to marinate for an hour or more. Preheat your barbeque. Remove pork from the fridge and allow to sit at room temperature for at least an hour. Heat your coals to medium high and add your dry ingredients. Turn the exhaust on the grill and sear the pork until just cooked through, about 3 minutes per side. While your barbeque is grilling your barbeque, spread your prune jam on a baking sheet and spread over 1/4 of your barbeque. Top with a piece of pork and then the apricot jam and sprinkle parmesan cheese over all. Heat under the grill until the cheese is melted and bubbly, 3 to 5 minutes.

title: Pueblo Plums - Plums from Pochas!
ingredients: 3 lbs ripe plums ( about 5 plums ) | 3 large jalapeno peppers ( fresh or canned )
instructions: Cut off a top shell of each plums, leaving about 1/2 inch of fruit attached. Scoop out the seeds, then carefully snip off the green tops and discard them. Cut out the pith, then cut out the hard center of the plum with a very sharp knife. Cut out the core, then slice 1/2 inch wide sticks of tomato and jalapeño. Cut the reserved plum pulp and pulp in half and rub off the pulp. Dislodge the pit. Arrange them on a foil lined baking sheet. To check if they are cooked, take a spoon and drop a few plum halves into each plum, pressing down with the spoon. Turn and press up the plums to be sure they are done. Put in a preheated 400°f oven 10 minutes. Serve immediately or store in tightly covered casseroles for a crispier bread.

title: Baked Escarole (Greens and Eggs)
ingredients: 1 head escarole ( cleaned if desired ) | 3 tablespoons fresh vanilla ( plus 2 teaspoons each ) | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon vanilla ( for each serving )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Separate leaves from outer leaves, then slice into thick slices. Place chopped leaves in a lightly buttered baking dish.

Random Ingredients: sauce,havarti cheese,jumbo pasta shell,french bread,brussels sprout,chili sauce,scotch bonnet pepper,mustard
title: Stuffed Shells
ingredients: 1 lb jumbo pasta shells | 1 lb brussels sprout | 1/8 cup prepared chili sauce | 1/2 cup bottled hot sauce | 1 teaspoon dry mustard | 4 ounces havarti cheese | 4 ounces smoked hot v8 sauce | 2 slices crusty french bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Spray a 12” x 7” glass baking dish with cooking spray. Bring large pot of water to boil. Add pasta and pasta and cook until just al dente, stirring occasionally. When pasta is al dente, drain and rinse in very hot water. Drain thoroughly and set aside. Cook brussels sprouts in boiling water for 1 minute, drain and cut them in half lengthwise. Remove sprouts and rinse. Slice caps thinly. Place all ingredients except for bread slices into a bowl. Mix well. If the pasta is still hot, remove from the heat. Place drained, cooked drained pasta into a large bowl, top with brussels sprouts and cheese mixture. Using a serrated knife, cut bread slices into thick slices and arrange them on top of the mixture. Serve immediately.

title: Swiss Apple Crunch
ingredients: 2 apples - peeled, cored and chopped | 1 package flake cereal | 1/2 cup catsup | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: In a medium bowl, toss the apples with the cereal, catsup and cardamom until well coated.

title: Irish Cream and Quinoa Salad
ingredients: 350 g quinoa, washed | 150 ml thousand island dressing | 150 ml irish cream | 200 g mixed salad leaves
instructions: To cook the couscous, place quinoa in a basin of cold water and sit for 10 to 15 minutes until water is absorbed. Drain and transfer quinoa to a bowl of cold water. Add 100ml of the dressing and stir to combine. Cover and return to the fridge for a further 30 minutes. Heat a non stick frying pan over a medium heat and dry fry the quinoa until browned all over, about 15 to 20 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer to an oiled heatproof bowl. Cover and set aside. Wipe out pan when dry and pour over remaining dressing and scatter over quinoa. Cover and return to the oven for 30 to 40 minutes until creamy and brown. Serve warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: rice,red capsicum,ice water,ricotta cheese,soymilk,wheat flour,yellow pea,taco seasoning
title: Mexican Rice Casserole
ingredients: 2 cups plain rice, dry | 3/4 cup soymilk ( soymilk works fine ) | 1/4 cup taco seasoning ( light works fine ) | 1 medium red capsicum ( diced ) | 1/2 cup yellow split peas ( frozen works fine ) | 1/2 cup whole wheat flour | 2 cups ice water | 1/2 cup low fat ricotta cheese
instructions: Cook rice first if there is any remaining water left to cook rice. Set rice aside and bring the water to the boil. Add the soymilk, taco seasoning and capsicum to the cooked rice and combine. Place all ingredients into a very large oven proof dish and bake for 15 minutes or until set. Serve with toppings. Couscous, place all ingredients into a small pot, mix. Serve warm with bread slices or on top of the casserole.

title: Kofta With Noodles & Spaghetti
ingredients: 100 g quinoa | 800 g uncooked meat ( minced lamb, beef, sheep, goat ) | 150 g pasta ( spaghetti, spaghetti, prawn, perch fila, macaroni, etc ) | parsley ( to garnish ) ( optional ) | lemon wedge ( to garnish ) ( optional ) | spaghetti sauce ( to garnish ) ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons rice wine ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons low-fat yogurt ( optional ) | 1 green pepper
instructions: Place the quinoa in a large bowl and pour over enough boiling water to cover. Stir and leave to soak for 20 to 30 minutes, then drain, then add to the meat. Prepare the noodles and place in a large bowl, then add a few ladles of water. Leave for 10 to 15 minutes, then rinse and add to the meat. Stir to combine. Prepare your sauce by combining the garlic, parsley and lemon juice in a small bowl or jug and then mixing together. Heat a pan with a little oil or butter on top and stir fry the meat for about 30 minutes until cooked and browned. Drain off any excess fat, then add to the meat, along with the tomato, spaghetti sauce, and rice wine. Heat through and serve in a large soup bowl, garnished with parsley and lemon wedges.

Random Ingredients: pine nut,rice wine,rhubarb,yellow pepper,double cream,balsamic vinegar,potato
title: Rhubarb & Potato Salad
ingredients: 450 g potatoes, rinsed | 225 g rhubarb, stems removed, sliced finely | 4 yellow peppers, washed and thickly sliced | 110 g pine nuts, toasted | 2/3 cup balsamic vinegar | 1/4 cup rice wine | 1/4 liter double cream
instructions: Boil, steam, or microwave the potatoes until just tender. Drain immediately and cool slightly. Cut into wedges and then arrange in a serving dish. In a very hot frying pan, toast the pine nuts over medium high heat, stirring often, and adding a splash of water if necessary, for 1 - 2 minutes. Transfer to a plate and set aside. In a wok or large frying pan, combine the vinegar, rice wine, red wine, and cream and heat gently until hot but not boiling. Pour over the potato wedges and gently stir together until evenly distributed, then serve warm.

title: Easy and Delicious Prawn and Cheese (Shrimp) Filling
ingredients: 600 g prawns or 600 g shrimp, peeled, deveined and frozen | 1 clove garlic, crushed | 500 g tasty cheese, grated
instructions: Place the frozen prawns in a pan and just cover with cold water. Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat, cover and simmer for 5 - 6 minutes or until they are cooked through. Meanwhile, place the garlic, pepper and half a teaspoon of salt in a mortar and crush into a paste with a pestle, or alternatively you can use a mortar and pestle and mash them together in a small bowl. Drain and set aside. Drain the prawns and set aside. Place the other half of the prawns in a bowl and coat each one with the garlic paste and pepper mixture. Heat the oil in a pan and fry the prawns until browned. Place the prawns on top of the cheese. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: ginger garlic paste,lime,chicken liver,chicken stock cube,sultana,chicken breast,gruyere cheese,guacamole
title: Chicken Lollipops
ingredients: 1 chicken stock cube | 2 tablespoons fresh ginger-garlic paste | 1 ounce sultana | 1 ounce guacamole | 1 ounce grilled chicken breast ( optional ) | 4 slices gruyere cheese | 1 slice limes or 1 slice lemon, rind of | 4 chicken lollipop sticks or 4 toothpicks ( optional )
instructions: Put the spices into a non stick frying pan and cook gently while you start making up the recipe. Slice the chicken in half or into large slices. Mix all of the ingredients together, and add to the saucepan or wok. Continue cooking the mixture until the mixture thickens. Allow to cool. Put the chicken onto a plate, cover and refrigerate. When ready to serve, bring to room temperature. Remove lollipop sticks if using, and dip the lollipop sticks into the sauce to coat. These stick easily.

Random Ingredients: white fish fillet,garlic powder,turkey,parsley root,white sesame seed,parsley,tomato sauce,beer
title: Whitefish
ingredients: 1/2 lb white fish fillet, cut into 1-inch cubes | 3 tablespoons parsley root, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon dried parsley | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/2 cup chopped garlic | 1/2 cup tomatoes with sauce | 1 teaspoon white sesame seeds | 1/2 teaspoon dried white sesame seeds | 1 cup white beer, such as guinness
instructions: In a large skillet, brown fish over medium heat for about 4 minutes. Drain, and reserve 1 tablespoon broth. Add the parsley root, parsley, garlic powder, and garlic to the skillet. Bring to a boil and cook over medium heat for 30 minutes or until fish is just cooked. Stir in the tomato and sesame seeds. Return to a boil. Remove from heat and serve over white rice.

title: Maple Madeira
ingredients: 4 egg whites ( or egg yolks ) | 1 cup real maple syrup | 1 1/2 cups sweet vermouth ( i used sweet rice wine ) or 1 1/2 cups sweet sherry ( i used sweet rice wine )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f use a 1 1/2 to 2 quart souffle dish. Beat egg whites, maple syrup and sherry until creamy. Fold in egg whites. Pour mixture into prepared pan. Bake 2 hours. Cool for an hour. Cut into squares and serve drizzled with your favorite syrup such as honey, sweet german, lingonberry jam, kiwifruit jam, or apricot preserve.

title: Quick and Easy Grilled Figs
ingredients: 1 package figs, sliced | 1 1/2 teaspoons prepared mustard powder or 1 1/2 teaspoons dijon mustard | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 8 ounces imitation crabmeat, flaked
instructions: Preheat grill or broiler. In a small bowl, mix mustard, crushed red pepper and imitation crabmeat. Brush grate or broiler rack with oil. Place figs on a grill rack. Spread mustard mixture evenly over figs. Grill or broil until hot and bubbled. Serve with sour cream, if desired.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,bacon dripping,plain yogurt,gingerroot,chicken bouillon powder,soymilk,escarole
title: Swiss Cheese and Escarole Soup With Yogurt
ingredients: 4 slices bacon drippings ( or a combo of both ) or 4 slices turkey bacon ( or a combo of both ) | 4 cups escarole, thinly sliced | 4 -6 teaspoons chicken bouillon powder | 6 cups skim low-fat plain yogurt | 2 cups swiss cheese, grated | 1 teaspoon gingerroot, minced | 1 tablespoon low-fat soy milk
instructions: In a large pot over medium high heat, add bacon drippings or turkey bacon drippings and sauté for about 4 - 3 minutes. Place in a colander or sieve and squeeze all excess fat off, then add the chicken bouillon powder. Toss to mix. Stir in the yogurt and green onion. Reduce heat and simmer soup for 30 - 40 minutes, or until desired tenderness. Stir in the swiss cheese, ginger and soy milk until smooth. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: mung bean,bamboo shoot,taco seasoning mix,leek,yellow pepper,sirloin tip roast,yoghurt,chicken breast half
title: Mexican Chicken and Vegetable Stew
ingredients: 3 boneless, skinless chicken breast halves - cut into chunks | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 leek, sliced | 1 yellow pepper, chopped | 1/2 cup chopped bamboo shoots, drained | 1/2 cup mung bean, rinsed and rinsed | 1 can reduced-fat, fat-free greek yogurt | 2 boneless, skinless chicken breast halves - cut into chunks
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix chicken, taco seasoning mix, leek, yellow pepper, bamboo shoots, and mung bean in a glass cooking dish. Bake in preheated oven for 45 minutes. Mix yogurt and chicken in a separate bowl.

Random Ingredients: enchilada sauce,sirloin steak,chocolate chip,spring onion,self rising flour,pork chop
title: Quick and Easy Steak Enchiladas
ingredients: 1/2 cup self-rising flour, divided | 1 pound sirloin steak | 1/2 pound pork chops | 1 1/2 cups enchilada sauce | 1 package semisweet chocolate chips | 3 spring onions, finely chopped
instructions: In a shallow bowl, combine 2 cups flour and 1/2 cup of milk.

Random Ingredients: sauce,parsley leaf,radish,spaghetti sauce,white rice,orange liqueur,raisin,creamy peanut butter
title: Peanut Butter Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 cups cooked white rice, cooled | 1 jar spaghetti sauce | 1 package creamy peanut butter | 5 -6 tablespoons orange liqueur | 1 1/2 - 2 teaspoons hot sauce | 2 tablespoons chopped dried parsley leaves, to taste | 6 -8 radishes, sliced | 1 -2 tablespoon raisins, optional to taste
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl. Chill for 2 - 3 hours before serving.

title: Savory Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 800 g stewing beef | 1 tablespoon virgin olive oil | 50 g wholemeal flour ( for dredging ) | 8 large baguette | cooking oat ( i used almond meal but any kind of bread can do )
instructions: Heat the oil in a deep frying pan over medium high heat. Season the meat with salt and pepper and cook it for about 15 minutes or until nicely browned on the outside but not cooked through. Remove the meat from the pan with a slotted spoon. Reduce the heat to medium and add a little more oil. Dredge the meat in the flour and shake off excess flour. Add the meat to the hot oil and brown it on all sides. Return the meat to the pan and cover. Simmer for about 2 hours or until the meat is tender. Turn the temperature off and leave to stand for 15 minutes. Wrap each sandwich with waxed paper and microwave under a preheated grill until crispy. Serve hot with your favourite accompaniments.

Random Ingredients: apple juice,self raising flour,ginger garlic paste,black bean
title: Fried Black Beans
ingredients: 1 cup black beans | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 1/4 cup apple juice | 1 tablespoon self-raising flour
instructions: Soak beans in water overnight to make them a more absorbent texture. Place beans in a microwave safe dish. Add the apple juice and fry on high for 4 minutes. Mix the flour into the water/oil and add to the beans. Stir until smooth and thick.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,large shrimp,phyllo pastry,yeast,vegetable shortening,escarole,saffron,panang curry paste
title: Bastee's Shrimp Phyllo Pizza
ingredients: 1 tablespoon yeast | 4 fluid ounces warm pancaity vegetable shortening | 3/4 cup warm, divided | 8 sheets phyllo pastry | 2 1/2 pounds large shrimp - peeled, deveined, and tails removed | 1/2 teaspoon saffron | 1/2 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley | 1/4 cup enchilada-style panang curry paste, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the yeast, pancaity vegetable shortening, and 1/4 cup warm water until the mixture forms a smooth, creamy foam. Place the remaining 1/4 cup warm water in a medium bowl. Rinse shrimp thoroughly, and shake off excess. In another medium bowl, mix together the shrimp meat, saffron, parsley, and sauce. Arrange 1 sheet of phyllo dough in the bottom of a 10x13 inch baking dish. Layer shrimp onto 1 sheet of phyllo dough, and top with another sheet of phyllo dough. Lay the shrimp into a single layer over the phyllo dough, and cover with another 1/2 sheet of phyllo dough. Cover with another 2 sheets of phyllo dough, and lay the shrimp slices in a 3 inch square pattern over the dough. Cover with a third sheets of phyllo dough, and cover with the remaining sheets of phyllo dough until you have three layers. Spread curry paste over the top of the layered shrimp, and sprinkle on a little of the reserved shrimp. Cover with buttered plastic wrap, place in a warm place until phyllo is completely doubled in size, about 70 minutes. Cut open a few places in the phyllo to allow steam to escape, and use a sharp knife to cut all three sheets.

Random Ingredients: greek yogurt,artichoke heart,beef stock,green olive,self raising flour
title: Artichoke and Olive Damper
ingredients: 150 g self raising flour | 1/4 cup greek yogurt ( can use low fat greek ) | 50 g green olives, chopped finely | 2 tablespoons artichoke hearts, chopped finely | 3 cups beef stock
instructions: Place flour in a medium size bowl. Make a well in the centre and gradually add yogurt. Stir well with a fork until smooth. Stir in olives. Add artichoke hearts. Gradually add stock, stirring with a fork until well mixed. Spoon into well seasoned, warm flour and turn out onto a lightly floured surface. Cover with plastic wrap and place in the fridge for 30mins to allow flavours to mesh. To bake, preheat oven 180 degrees celsius. Use a cookie cutter to cut out damper. Place on a greased baking tray and bake for 25mins or until golden. Serve warm.

title: Toaster Wraps
ingredients: 1 green bell pepper, sliced into strips | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh strawberries | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1 container frozen whipped topping, thawed | 8 thin tortillas
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Spray the inside of one toaster or toaster with cooking spray. Spread bell pepper over 1 part of each tortilla.

title: Moroccan Corn and Olive Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 2 tablespoons lime zest | 10 kalamata olives | 2 cups frozen sweetcorn | 1/2 green pepper, chopped
instructions: Saute peppers in oil until peppers are tender crisp. Set aside. Boil sweet corn until tender. Drain corn. Add corn to veggies, cook for 2 minutes. Add remaining oil and lime zest and lemon. Combine and serve.

title: Tomato Beef Red Sauce
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup, undiluted | 1 bottle diced tomatoes ( i like petite diced ) | 1 can stewed tomatoes, undrained | 1 1/2 cups reduced-sodium chicken broth | 3/4 teaspoon pepper ( or to taste ) | 1/2 head roasted red pepper ( optional )
instructions: In a bowl, stir together the soups, tomatoes, chicken broth, pepper and roasted red pepper. Simmer on a low heat until heated and slightly thickened, about 30 minutes, stirring several times. Serve over your choice of beef or vegetables.

title: Mexican Hot Chocolate
ingredients: 3 red chilies, deseeded and finely sliced | 1 pinch dried oregano | 180 ml dark rum | 1 teaspoon vanilla sugar | 1 bunch oregano | 2 large zplocs, finely sliced
instructions: Place all ingredients, except zplocs, in a saucepan over medium heat. Stir over high heat until the chilies are softened, about 5 minutes. Stir the zplocs through the sauce. Simmer for 2 - 3 minutes, until thick. Serve from your favourite glass, drizzling chilies and their juices from the bowl over. Makes about 4 servings.

title: Basmati Rice With Prosciutto and Vermouth
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice | 1/2 cup dry vermouth | 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 2 tablespoons liquid honey | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 4 slices prosciutto, torn into thin strings
instructions: Bring 4 cups of water to a boil. Add rice and vermouth and stir. Cover, reduce heat to low, and simmer for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and remove lid. Let rest for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, mix vinegar, honey, marjoram and prosciutto into rice and rice. Cover and allow to sit 5 minutes. Stir rice and prosciutto into rice. Top with reserved prosciutto. Cook on medium heat until mixture is bubbly, about 3 - 4 minutes.

title: Homemade Oestre -- Broth and Parmesan Pasta Sauce
ingredients: 1 can condensed chicken broth | 1/4 cup oleo | 1/4 cup mascarpone cheese | 1 pinch white pepper powder, or according to taste | 1/4 teaspoon arrowroot, or cornstarch
instructions: Bring the broth to a boil over medium heat, and stir in the oleo and mascarpone cheese. Sprinkle in white pepper, and mix in the arrowroot just to mix. Drain the can of pasta, and return it to the heat. Slowly stir the soup into the soup to coat, and bring the soup to a boil. Cook uncovered over medium heat for 5 minutes, then remove the pan from the heat, and stir in the pasta. Cover, and allow to sit for 2 hours at room temperature.

title: Wild Rice
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups water or 3 1/2 cups rice | 10 ounces mixed mushrooms, drained and trimmed
instructions: In 3 1/2 to 4 quart saucepan, combine boiling water or rice, mushrooms and raisins. Bring to boil. Reduce heat.

title: Asian Style Fried Rice
ingredients: 14 ounces whole kernel corn | 14 ounces rice wine ( thai flavored hot sauce ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger | shredded lettuce ( optional )
instructions: Start your steaming apparatus in your steaming apparatus, or heat a gas or charcoal grill. When your coals are covered in a non metallic area, allow them to reach a medium distance on your stovetop before starting your steaming apparatus. When your coals are at medium, cook the corn until it is slightly charred, then chop it up with a knife or blender as fine as it can be. Add the rice wine to the kernels, stirring until the mixture is evenly distributed. If you want the whole mixture less hot, then add some hot water, about one third of a cup at a time, stirring well after each addition. Do not add any extra liquid, just cover and steam or stir everything together until the rice is done, and then serve hot.

Random Ingredients: cherry grape tomato,chicken breast,broth,cornstarch,golden raisin,sage leaf
title: Ponnay Chicken With Fresh Sage
ingredients: 3 garlic chicken breasts ( skinless ) | 1 cup chicken stock or 1 cup broth | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 2 tablespoons golden raisins | 12 cherry tomatoes | 2 sage leaves, coarsely sprigs
instructions: Cut the chicken into 1/2 inch pieces. Place in a bowl and add broth. Marinate 1 hour. Deglaze the pan with a splash of the cornstarch and add the raisins. Boil 3 minutes. Cut the cherry tomatoes in half and remove and discard the pit. Add the tomato to the bowl with the chicken and toss. Serve the dish warm.

Random Ingredients: corn niblets,jalapeno juice,onion soup mix,oil,red chile pepper
title: Delicious Easy Hot & Spicy Corn Niblets!
ingredients: 11 ounces corn niblets ( canned are ok too ( 7.25 ounce cans ) | onion soup mix ( j.l.e. original soup mix, 1 envelope ) | 1 small fresh red chile pepper, seeded and finely chopped | 1/4 cup bottled jalapeno juice | 2 tablespoons oil
instructions: Drain the corn from the cans into a large skillet and pour in enough water to cover the corn. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to simmer, and partially cover, and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes or until the corn is tender. Once the corn is tender check the kernels for tenderness, drain if necessary, and return the corn to the skillet. Stir in the onion soup mix, chile pepper, and jalapeno juice until the ingredients are combined.

Random Ingredients: maple syrup,lime wedge,rice vermicelli,kosher salt,fennel seed,rice wine,wheat flour,currant
title: Sweet and Savory Noodle Pancakes
ingredients: 1 cup cooked rice vermicelli, drained & rinsed in cold water | 1/2 cup maple syrup | 12 ounces sliced whole wheat flour ( or substitute whole wheat flour ) | 1/4 cup rice wine | 1/2 cup currants or 1/2 cup raisins | 2 tablespoons kaffir rice spices ( or substitute, 1 1/2 tbls. dried or sub 2tbls. dried chilies ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons fennel seeds, divided | lime wedge, for serving ( optional )
instructions: In a large bowl, mix the cooked vermicelli and the maple syrup. Set aside. In a second large bowl, sift the flour, rice wine and currants together. Add spices and rice vermicelli mixture and stir to blend. In a large skillet, heat a scant 1 teaspoon of oil to a medium hot temperature just to the smoking point and drop 3 to 4 pancake slices in one layer without overlapping them. Fry on one side and flip. Cook until golden and crisp, about 2 minutes per side. Transfer pancake to a plate lined with paper towel and serve with lime wedges.

title: Anchovy Sauce for Pasta Shells
ingredients: 2 anchovy paste | 1/2 cup pine nuts or 1/2 cup dry-roasted salted nuts
instructions: Place anchovies in a bowl. Gradually pour in enough water to cover. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes to develop flavors. Stir in drained nuts. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: prosciutto,italian parsley,vegemite,lime juice zest,grain bread,black tea
title: Vegemite Tea Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 tablespoons lime juice or 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 2 tablespoons vespemite | 4 slices firm-textured whole grain bread | thinly sliced prosciutto | 2 teaspoons finely chopped italian parsley, toasted | freshly cracked black tea ( optional )
instructions: Combine lime juice and vespemite in a small container. Arrange 1 slice of bread on a work surface.

title: Thai Pork Curry
ingredients: 4 lbs pork loin ( or loin of each ) or 4 lbs pork butt ( or loin of each ) | 1 lb salad oil | 1 lb thai curry paste ( aka nam pla... or use sambal oelek )
instructions: Cut pork into 2 thick pieces. Heat oil. Add curry paste and stir until fragrant. Add meat & saute till meat losses it's red color. Remove meat from pan.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,lime wedge,baking soda,cocoa powder,coriander,cucumber,panir
title: Sweet Chilli Prawns With Panir Cheese
ingredients: 1/2 kg medium panir ( in the shape of prawns ) | 200 g red wine vinegar | 1/2 cup light cocoa powder | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 cup fresh coriander, chopped | 2/3 cup cucumber, chopped | lime wedge, to serve
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°c. Combine all of the ingredients for the prawns and place in an oven proof dish. Bake for 10 - 15 minutes until the prawns are just cooked through. Serve with the chilli prawns and sliced cucumber.

title: Agua Fresca
ingredients: 3 cups watermelon, cubed in 1/4 inch cubes | 1 cup dried mixed berries | 1 tablespoon chili paste | 3 tablespoons sour greek yogurt | 1 -2 serrano chili, sliced thin
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and chill several hours or overnight. Serve at room temperature or chilled.

title: Grilled Pork Basket or Rivels
ingredients: 6 pork ribs ( the butcher saws the meat in this stuff. remember, they are lean and fast and are difficult to work with ) | butter lettuce leaf
instructions: Wash your ribs thoroughly so that all stray bits are removed. Then use your thumb and press the ribs down into the fat. This is done to aid in the release of juices. Put the meat on a hot rack of grill. When a good few minutes of cooking, they should be nicely browned on the edges and the juices should run clear. Remove all the pork from the grill. Cover the meat with butter lettuce leaves and serve.

title: Linda's Rice Noodle
ingredients: 1 package rice noodles | cooking oil | 1 package fresh breadedtaleggio
instructions: Place noodles in a bowl and pour enough cooking oil over to cover noodles. Toss until coated. Heat a skillet over medium heat, and pour cooking oil in the pan. When the oil is hot, add the pieces of breadedtaleggio and fry just until golden brown, but still slightly crunchy. Drain on paper towels, and sprinkle with the fried noodles.

title: Linguine With Chilli and Tomato
ingredients: 500 g linguine | 1/2 cup fresh coriander, chopped | 2 teaspoons tomato passata | 1 tablespoon peanut oil
instructions: Cook the pasta according to the packet instructions. Meanwhile, heat the oil in a frying pan and fry the corriander for 2 minutes. Remove from the heat. Stir in the passata. Drain the pasta, then toss with the chilli mixture. Serve at once, garnished with the extra corriander.

title: Clam Kebabs
ingredients: 1 lb baby shrimp, shelled | 1/4 lb ground sirloin or 1/4 lb ground ground lamb | 2 teaspoons whole oat bran | 1 bunch escarole, washed and coarsely chopped | 1/2 bunch celery, coarsely chopped | 1/2 lb small shell clams, scrubbed | 12 bamboo skewers, soaked in water
instructions: Heat your grill to high. In a mixing bowl, combine the shrimp, sirloin and oat bran. Combine all of the remaining ingredients, except the skewers, and add to the mixture.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,bay leaf,rump roast,beef tenderloin,button mushroom
title: Beef on Rye With Mushrooms, Rye & Bay
ingredients: 1 rump roast, trimmed of fat | 2 bay leaves | 750 g button mushrooms, trimmed | 6 beef tenderloin, trimmed | 5 -6 slices rye bread
instructions: Boil the water, add the roast to the boil and simmer on a low heat for about 3 hours. Place the salmon into a roasting tin on the base of the oven, and cook in the oven at 220c for 10 - 12 minutes, or until tender. Remove from the oven, cover loosely and allow to rest for about 20 - 25 minutes. Slice and serve on fresh toasted rye with a spoonful of cream cheese, some freshly roasted mushrooms, a couple of slices of beef, and the rest of the toasted side of the roll.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper sauce,delicata squash,asafoetida powder,irish cream,pea carrot
title: Easy Pea & Shredded Squash
ingredients: 3 cups frozen peas and carrots | salt and cayenne pepper sauce | 1 can refrigerated original irish cream ( or cream of onion ) | 1 dash asafoetida powder ( optional and to taste ) | 1 1/2 lbs delicata squash, peeled & cubed
instructions: Cook peas and carrots until tender. Add seasonings. When the soup is ready, add cream and mix well. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,spice,chili oil,red food coloring
title: Thai Sweet and Sour Spices
ingredients: 2 -3 cups thai sweet chili oil | 1 -2 chicken bouillon cube | 1 -3 teaspoon trident mixed spice | red food coloring
instructions: Put all ingredients into a large airtight container or bowl. Shake away any excess water and cover tightly with a double layer of plastic wrap, placing a heavy weight on top. Refrigerate for 2 days, shaking bowl occasionally. Serve cold or room temperature.

title: Couscous Salad With Pistachio and Tomato
ingredients: 1 cup couscous | 1 cup mix | 5 ounces cherry tomatoes, halved | 1 1/2 ounces bologna, diced | 2 teaspoons thyme leaves | 2 tablespoons slivered pistachios ( or chopped peanuts )
instructions: Cook couscous according to package directions, but omit the salt. Cool to room temperature. Mix couscous and 3/4 cup of the couscous and mix well. Chop cherry tomatoes and place on top, along with rest of couscous, thyme, and pistachios. Add a small amount of water to cover, if necessary. Chill until chilled.

Random Ingredients: caper,chunky salsa,cream celery soup,orange,chicken bouillon granule,saffron thread,parsley,chorizo sausage
title: Spanish Chicken With Chorizo
ingredients: 1 lb chorizo sausage, casings removed | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon granule | 1 package thick & chunky salsa | 1 can cream of celery soup ( or cream of tomato with roasted garlic and onion ) | 1/2 cup fresh parsley, minced | 1/2 teaspoon saffron threads, crushed ( i made this by accident.found in the ethnic aisle of the grocery store ) | 3 teaspoons orange rind, grated or 3 teaspoons lime rind, grated | 2 teaspoons capers
instructions: In a large skillet, over medium high heat, brown the chorizo. Add the pepper flakes, chicken bouillon granules, and salsa. Stir to mix well. In a small bowl, combine the soup, parsley, saffron, orange rind, and capers.

Random Ingredients: turnip,buckwheat flour,golden syrup,heavy whipping cream,pimento olive,extra beef,plain yogurt,hot italian sausage
title: Creamy Turnips & Sausage Mini Muffin Tikkos
ingredients: 2 large turnips | 4 ounces bulk extra lean ground beef | 4 ounces bulk hot italian sausage | 1 tablespoon golden syrup ( optional ) | 1 -2 tablespoon pimento stuffed olive, chopped ( optional ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons plain yogurt | 1/2 cup buckwheat flour | 2 tablespoons heavy whipping cream
instructions: Peel turnips while they are still slightly warm by placing them on a cloth over a bowl, then holding them by the stem lengthwise. Place both into a deep pot and cover with cold water. Bring to boil and cook until fork tender. About 2 minutes. Remove from heat and drain well. You can do 2 batches of turnips at once, just keep a large pile of turnip on each plate if you wish. In a separate skillet, heat olive oil over medium high heat then saute sasuage and turnip 2 or 3 minutes. Add golden syrup, if using. Add pimentos on top of turnip. Remove sasuage, cover and set aside. To make batter, mash turnips until smooth. Add all batter ingredients to turnip, mix well and place in a 9x13, greased pan, bake in a 400 degree oven 45 - 50 minutes. Make sure to stir so as not to break up the yummy, greasy goodness on the bottom don't let it boil, just simmer a few moments until they are soft and heated through. To serve, cut into 4 or 5 pieces and place on a plate with a dollop of buckwheat bread and a small piece of mozzarella cheese on top.

Random Ingredients: muenster cheese,no salt tomato,yeast,nonfat milk powder,hazelnut,broth
title: Nut and No Salt Tomato Mozzarella Bread
ingredients: 2 ounces low salt tomato ( crushed or roughly chopped ) | 1/2 teaspoon dry yeast | 1 1/4 cups nonfat dry milk powder | 1 1/2 cups broth ( i have used 2 % ) | 1 3/4 cups finely packed muenster cheese | 1 cup hazelnuts ( roughly chopped )
instructions: In a large bowl mix together tomato, yeast, and milk powder. Allow to stand while you begin to heat broth to a low boil. Heat broth and mix with yeast mixture until mixture begins to bubble. Add cheese and hazelnuts. Allow to cool to room temperature. Pour mixture into lightly buttered or nonstick loaf pans. Allow to rise about 1 hour or till loaves' are firm to the touch. Bake at 350f for 25 min or until light brown. Cool on a rack. Note, the dough can be frozen successfully, and baked in individual sized loaf pans at this point for 5 - 7 loafs etc. Allow dough to cool completely before slicing.

Random Ingredients: catsup,italian plum tomato,apple juice,milk,active yeast,nutmeg,chili pepper flake
title: Cherry Tomato Filling for Mini Pretzels
ingredients: 1 1/4 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 cup milk | 1/4 cup apple juice | 1 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon nutmeg | 2 1/4 - 2 1/4 cups unbleached all-purpose flour | 3/4 cup catsup | 2 cans italian plum tomatoes
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1 cup of the milk with the apple juice. Add the remaining ingredients, except the tomatoes and simmer until the mixture starts to bubble. Place the tomatoes in the machine in the order listed and set to dough mode. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured board and knead for 8 minutes or until smooth, adding flour as needed. Shape into a round ball, place on a lightly oiled baking sheet, and cover with a damp cloth or plastic wrap. Let rise 1 1/2 hours. Bake at 400 degrees for about 25 to 30 minutes or until the tops are light brown. Remove from the oven and let cool until cool.

title: Kiwi Marinade for Grilled Chicken Pieces
ingredients: 1/2 cup kiwi, shredded | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/2 cup chicken fat ( or enough to coat both sides of chicken )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Add chicken and marinate overnight in the fridge or if making sandwiches, remove from the fridge 10 minutes before cooking.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,jicama,dark raisin,baby lima bean,maraschino cherry,extra virgin olive oil,kielbasa
title: Polish Jicama Salad With Mushrooms and Raisins
ingredients: 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 lb jicama, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1/2 lb button mushroom, sliced | 12 baby lima beans, trimmed and cut into 1/2-inch-wide pieces | 1/2 lb jicama, peeled and thinly sliced | 1/2 lb button mushroom, sliced | 2 teaspoons dark raisins | 1/2 cup maraschino cherry, dried or 1/2 cup other dried fruit, coarsely chopped
instructions: In a salad bowl, add olive oil and toss with vegetables and cherries. Serve at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: cardamom powder,bean sprout,pork butt,apple,chocolate,cherry tomato,bread,basil leaf
title: Choti (Tandoori Meatball or Meat Loaf)
ingredients: 8 large bread rolls ( bread rolls, 1 day old bread rolls ) | pork butt | 2 large apples, grated | 2 cups cherry tomatoes | 1 1 cup fresh bean sprouts | 1/2 cup fresh basil leaf, chopped | 1 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1 tablespoon chocolate or 1 tablespoon vanilla extract
instructions: Toast bread rolls on both sides, but do not brown. Set aside. Combine all remaining ingredients in a large bowl and mix thoroughly. Shape mixture into 1 inch meatballs, about the size of an index finger. Spray a baking sheet generously with cooking spray. Bake meatballs on ungreased grill, turning frequently, until no longer pink, 15 to 18 minutes, depending on the thickness of the meatballs. Remove from rack and serve.

title: Lamb Shank With Feta and Oil
ingredients: 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1/2 lb lamb shank | 1/4 cup chinese wine or 1/4 cup dry sherry | kosher salt
instructions: In a shallow roasting pan, heat the olive oil on low until hot but not smoking. Rub the lamb shank with oil and place in pan. Sprinkle sherry over the shank and sprinkle a little of salt over the lamb. Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Roast, turning once, until the lamb is tender and the meat is very well browned, 1½ to 2 hours. Transfer lamb to serving platter and let stand for 5 minutes, then remove string and cut into thin slices. Serve lamb with hot sauce.

Random Ingredients: bamboo skewer,nutmeg,glace cherry,pea carrot,sage,mustard seed,bay leaf
title: Christmas Trees (English)
ingredients: 10 glace cherries ( about 2/3 pound ) | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds ( optional ) | 5 bay leaves ( optional ) | 2 cups pea carrots, finely chopped | 12 -15 fresh sage, leaves ( or 3 tsp. dried leaves ) | 10 stalks fresh savoy's fresh pea carrots ( optional ) | 1 1/2 lbs mixed glace cherries | 2 cups fresh pea carrots, cut into chunks ( optional ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground nutmeg ( or use white grated nutmeg )
instructions: Set out 6 - 8 tree branches with about 3 to 1 1/2 foot lengths and the 12 leaves from the 4 other branches at the base of each. You can also make smaller tree shapes if preferred, although officially everyone's treats them small, not oblong,. Rinse the tree with cold running water and drain well. Place them in a wide oven pan about 12 to 14 inches from a hot but gentle fire and add enough hot water to cover the leaves. Bake, covered, in a moderately hot oven for 1 to 1 1/4 hours. The leaf will give off liquid and rise as it evaporates to about 1/4 inch and the moisture will be absorbed. Remove the leaves from the water and set out until they are completely soft, about 10 minutes. When the leaves are completely soft, remove them from the water and cut into slices. Place about 1/2 inch of water in another pan and bring it to the boiling point. As soon as the leaves are completely cool, drain them thoroughly and place in a blender with the pea and carrot mixture and pulse until you have a fine puree. Place the glazed nuts in a bowl and add the sage or dry leaf mixture and half of the sage leaves. Add a pinch of nutmeg and mix thoroughly. Place the remaining sage leaves or dry leaf mixture in a square or square cup. Toast the nuts in a large heavy skillet over high heat, stirring occasionally, until golden brown, 7 to 10 minutes.

title: Sydney Cornbread
ingredients: 1/2 cup cornmeal | 1/2 cup pinto beans, drained | 2 tablespoons mango chutney ( optional ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground marjoram or 1 1/2 teaspoons oregano leaves | 1 sheet aluminum foil
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Spray 9x9 inch baking dish with cooking spray. In bowl, combine cornmeal, pinto beans, mango chutney and marjoram or oregano.

title: Sailors Seafood Enchilada Casserole
ingredients: 500 g shrimp ( i usually only use 4 shrimp ) | 4 kg beef steaks | 500 g crabmeat | 200 ml mexican blend cheese, shredded | 2 tablespoons dry cake flour | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar
instructions: Cut the shrimp into bite sized pieces. In a large casserole dish, arrange half shrimp in casserole dish. Cover shrimp with cheese and crab meat. Sprinkle with flour and vinegar to your taste. Add remaining shrimp and mix. Cook in 350 f oven for 1 hour.

title: Easy Microwave Noodle Dinner
ingredients: 1 corned beef brisket ( with seasoning ) | 1 jar pasta sauce | 1 package dry pasta of your choice
instructions: Cover 1/2 inch of the edge of the brisket with the corned beef. Place the brisket with seasoning over the beef. Microwave on high for 4 minutes, or until the brisket is tender and well browned. Microwave on medium power for about 45 minutes, turning brisket occasionally, until tender.

title: Aquavitos (Omani Grape Leaves)
ingredients: 1 cup grapeseed oil or 1 cup sun-dried tomato oil | 1/2 cup triple sec | 2 tablespoons fresh basil or 2 tablespoons oregano, chopped | 1 orange, thinly sliced
instructions: Pour oil into pan so as it reaches all the way to the rim. The cap of the grapeseed can be enlarged during the frying process, if necessary. Put into the pan and stir. Add triple sec and basil. Bring to bubbling point. When bubbles begin to form around the edge. Lower heat cover and cook for 1 minute. Uncover and continue to cook for a further 3 minutes. Spoon a generous amount or 2 tablespoons of mixture onto each grape leaf and serve.

title: Mashed Potato-Cucumber Risotto
ingredients: 3 medium lebanese cucumbers | 1 cup basmati rice, washed and drained
instructions: Wash and drain the rinsed and drained cucumbers, cut them into cubes and leave for 15 minutes or longer with the cover on. Place them and the drained rice into a large vessel or steamer and steam, covered over a pan of boiling water, stirring occasionally, for 15 to 20 minutes or until all the liquid has been absorbed and the rice is creamy and tender. Take the lid off for 10 minutes or until the rice is fluffed and the rice is creamy.

Random Ingredients: gorgonzola,self raising flour,chili powder,double cream,poblano chile
title: Pebys in Creamy Gorgonzola Poblano Sauce
ingredients: 500 g self-raising flour | 15 g fresh gorgonzola, crumbled | 4 poblano chiles, roasted, skins left on, deseeded, de-seeded, de-seeded if desired | 1/4 teaspoon chili powder | 300 ml double cream
instructions: Put the flour into a large bowl and add the gorgonzola, poblano chilies, 1/2 tsp of the chili powder and the cream. Stir together well until the dough is soft and smooth. Turn the dough out onto a work surface and knead until the dough becomes smooth and supple. Wrap the dough in clingfilm and chill in the refrigerator for 20 minutes. Divide the dough into 12 even pieces. Shape each piece into a ball, cover in clingfilm and chillfor 30 - 60 minutes. Pre heat the grill on medium heat. Meanwhile, line a baking tray with paper kitchen towels and lightly flour the towel. Divide the dough into 12 even sized portions. Roll each ball slightly to fit the tray and then press into circles, about 1/2 cm thick. Cook on the griddle for 3 - 4 minutes on each side, or until golden. Serve with a dollop of the gorgonzola poblano sauce.

title: Spiced Vinegar & Cinnamon Vegetables for Two
ingredients: 450 g fresh vegetables ( such as runner beans, cauliflower and turnips ) | 400 ml vegetable stock | 1 pinch ground ginger | 1 pinch ground cinnamon
instructions: Trim the root ends off the vegetables and cut crossways into chunks or small bite sized pieces. Steam or heat some vegetable oil in a frying pan, add the vegetable bits and fry over a high heat until the pieces have turned pale yellow, almost translucent and beginning to give off their fragrance. Add the stock, ginger and spices to the pan and simmer for 2 - 3 minutes. Serve warm, drizzled with a little vegetable broth or ice cream.

Random Ingredients: vital wheat gluten,lemon juice zest,apple pie filling,red wine,green bell pepper,swiss cheese
title: Cheesy Grilled Swiss Cheese Appetizer
ingredients: 1/3 cup dry red wine | 1 tablespoon lemon juice, or more to taste | 2 teaspoons apple pie filling | 1 teaspoon vital wheat gluten | 1/4 cup swiss cheese, shredded, or more to taste ( optional ) | 1/4 cup diced red bell pepper, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Pour wine, lemon juice, apple pie filling, and vital wheat gluten into a skillet over medium high heat. Cook and stir until liquid boils, 5 to 7 minutes. Place cheese and red bell pepper into prepared pan. Increase heat to high.

title: Sweet Mango Salad
ingredients: 8 large mangoes, cheeks removed, flesh chopped | 12 fresh rosemary sprigs | 1/2 teaspoon maggi seasoning salt | 24 ounces mild maple syrup
instructions: Blend mango in a small food processor or blender until smooth.

title: Grilled Beef Tip Roast
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs sirloin tip roast, fat trimmed | 1 cup triple sec ( or orange juice if you prefer ) | 1 can sliced pickled jalapenos ( drained )
instructions: Use meat tenderizer, or your favorite tool. Rub marinade all over roast. Place meat in smoker or gas grill to brown. Grill, turning every 10 minute, for 3 or 4 hours or till done, internal temperature reaches 140 to 150 degrees. Place roast in a crock pot or crock pot. Add sliced pickled jalapenos, then add triple sec. Cover. Cook on low 8 to 10 hours, or on high 4 to 6 hours until done. Transfer meat to carving board, tear or cut in chunks.

title: Raspberry Rice Balls With Coriander Crust
ingredients: 300 ml arborio round rice | 100 ml seedless raspberry jam or 100 ml seedless raspberry jam | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1 tablespoon coriander, finely chopped | grated parmesan cheese, to serve
instructions: Place ramekin in a small saucepan with enough water to cover, bring to the boil and then simmer, stirring occasionally, for 2 - 3 minutes, until rice has softened. Drain and set aside. Place rice in a bowl and add 2 tbsp water. Cover and set aside for 10 minutes. Remove from heat and allow to stand for 5 minutes, uncovered. Meanwhile, using a blender, puree raspberry jam, almond extract and coriander to your liking, adding more or less as the desired consistency is achieved.

title: Macaroni and Cheese
ingredients: 1 loaf ciabatta | 2 ounces macaroni, cooked
instructions: Cut the ciabatta into thick slices about 1½ x 2¿½ and place in a pan. Add boiling water to just cover ciabatta. Turn down to a low light and leave to soak for 15 minutes until golden brown. Squeeze out excess water. Turn slices in toasted ciabatta and scatter over any tasty extras before serving.

title: Tomato Raisin Sauce
ingredients: 10 ounces tomato sauce | 1 ounce golden raisins
instructions: Put all ingredients into a large sauce pan or pot with a lid. Cover with lid. Turn down to low. Simmer for at least 1 hour or until thick and raisins are aromatic.

Random Ingredients: green onion,thai chile,pineapple,cherry pepper,coriander powder,rice wine,italian parsley
title: Khao Nee Bow
ingredients: 1 fresh pineapple, sliced to 1/4 inch and 1 inch thick | 1 green onion ( or shallot ) | 5 thai chiles | 1 tablespoon chopped italian parsley | 1 tablespoon chopped coriander powder or 1 tablespoon cilantro | 1 tablespoon rice wine | 1 fresh cherry pepper ( or 1/2 small can of sliced peppers )
instructions: Arrange pineapple slices on a platter, cover with onion, chili, parsley, coriander powder and rice wine. Sprinkle cherry peppers over top. Note, the cherry peppers can also be seeded, peeled and cut into 1/2 inch wide strips. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce,flat leaf italian parsley,leek soup mix,palm sugar,icing sugar
title: Homemade Swiss Salami
ingredients: 2 heads romaine lettuce | 1 container of dry flat-leaf italian parsley | 1 packet leek soup mix | 1/2 cup icing sugar | 4 -5 tablespoons palm sugar ( to taste )
instructions: Boil the romaine until just tender. Remove from heat and cool to room temperature. Combine all the ingredients in a large clear plastic bag. Refrigerate for at least one hour and up to 2 days.. Slice and serve on a bed of swiss swiss cheese. Makes 2 to 3 servings.

Random Ingredients: lemon zest,sirloin,chili oil,white wine,ginger juice,chili powder,basmati rice
title: Steak and Basmati Rice With Ginger Juice
ingredients: 3/4 1/2 lb sirloin or 3/4 lb london broil steak | 3/4 cup basmati rice or 3/4 cup jasmine rice | 1 1/4 cups white wine or 1 1/4 cups vermouth | 1/2 cup fresh lemon juice ( to taste ) | 1 teaspoon lemon zest | 1/2 teaspoon crushed chili oil | 1 teaspoon chili powder ( to taste )
instructions: Marinate steak in wine or lemon juice for at least 1/2 hour. Slice steak into bite size strips. Combine marinade ingredients in a large zip lock bag, pour in steak strips, and refrigerate 3 hours or overnight. Drain marinade from steak, reserving marinade. Place steak in a large, shallow nonstick skillet. Add marinade. Bring to a boil over medium high heat then reduce to low, cover, and simmer 20 minutes or until desired doneness is reached. Sprinkle with additional chile powder, if desired.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt,bay leaf,mayonnaise,nonstick vegetable cooking spray,vanilla,cognac,gruyere cheese,ladyfinger
title: Sienis Al Caneur
ingredients: 1 -12 ounce swiss gruyere cheese ( or other aged white cheese ) | 1 tablespoon fresh unsweetened cognac ( or brandy ) | 2 tablespoons mayonnaise ( light mayonnaise mayonnaise ) | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 1/8 teaspoon instant minced vanilla ( optional ) | 1 small bay leaf | nonstick vegetable cooking spray | 2 -3 tablespoons powdered nonstick vegetable cooking spray | 1 package ladyfingers ( fresh or frozen ) | 1 cup freshly shredded unbleached cane sugar
instructions: Prepare swiss cheese. Heat oven to 375 degrees. Unwrap cheese and place on an ungreased baking sheet, leaving a 2 inch border about 2 inches larger than the cheese. Sprinkle cheese with cognac and bake till a light golden crust has formed and cheese has melted. Remove from oven. Using a slotted spoon, carefully remove top crust of cheese and set aside. Combine mayonnaise, salt, vanilla, and bay leaf. To assemble, coat work surface and the inside edge of a 9 inch glass pie plate with cooking spray and begin layering ladyfingers as follows, ladyfinger, swiss cheese, and cheese mixture. Repeat layering, ending with a cheesecake, in this order, ladyfingers, cheese, and cheese mixture. Pour cognac rum over top. Cover with foil and transfer to preheated oven. Bake 10 minutes, remove foil, and bake 5 minutes more. Remove from oven and cut into thin strips with a sharp serrated knife. Sprinkle with powdered sugar and serve.

Random Ingredients: broth,cake flour,chicken bouillon,tea,egg white,allspice,virgin olive oil,beef stew meat
title: Beef Rolls
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef stew meat or 1 1/2 lbs veal stew meat, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 cup onion, chopped | 2 tablespoons instant tea | 2 tablespoons cake flour | 3 tablespoons beef stock or 3 tablespoons broth | 1 1/2 teaspoons beef bovril instant tea | 1/2 teaspoon allspice | 1 egg white, lightly beaten | 1 tablespoon virgin olive oil
instructions: Place beef in a shallow dish. Sprinkle with 1 teaspoon instant tea and stir in onion. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or up to 12 hours. Drain beef, reserving marinade. Discard onion and spice mixture. Place flour and 2 tablespoons of beef broth in a bowl. Add 1/2 teaspoon instant tea, mix well and set aside. Dredge the meat cubes in flour mixture and set aside. Lightly beat egg white and 1 1/2 tablespoons oil together and brush the outside of a meat fryer. Place meat in fryer basket and cook, turning occasionally for 12 to 16 minutes if using a heavy duty oven, or until meat is cooked through. Serve with mashed potatoes, peas, and sauce.

title: Homemade Cappuccino Butter
ingredients: 1 cup shortening | 1 cup instant coffee powder | 1/4 cup fresh thyme sprig
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine shortening, coffee powder and thyme. Bring to a boil, and boil until the liquid is reduced and syrupy, about 1 minute. Cool. Stir in the butter one piece at a time. Place an ice cream maker into the freezer to speed up process. After 6 to 8 minutes of freezing, remove and beat until thick and foamy, about 1 minute. Return to the freezer, and beat with a fork until thick. Stir in additional coffee powder or water if needed. Scoop into molds and freeze for at least 4 hours.

title: Curtido De Queso
ingredients: 4 cups shredded swiss cheese | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon ground clove | 1/3 cup chopped pecans, toasted
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and spoon into a shallow 1/2 to 3/4 quart baking dish. Sprinkle any remaining toasted pecans on top and bake at 400 degrees f. For 20 minutes or until heated and bubbly. Can serve with french fries, crackers, and other dippers.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,plain flour,shiitake mushroom,chicken stock cube,tortilla chip
title: Red Pepper Mix
ingredients: 60 g plain flour | 1/2 cup chicken stock cubes | 1/2 cup chicken stock cubes | 1/4 teaspoon red pepper flakes | 4 fresh shiitake mushrooms, stems removed | crushed tortilla chips ( to serve )
instructions: Sift flour into a bowl & rub in the stock cubes. Add in 1/4 cup stock cubes, season with red pepper flakes and mix til flour is absorbed. Place mushrooms in a microwave safe dish. Add crumpled tortilla chips in a single layer and cook in the microwave til heated through, around 5 minutes. To serve, divide mix between 4 serving glasses and drizzle with remaining stock.

title: Spicy Southwest Beans
ingredients: 1 cup dried red beans | 1 green pepper, chopped | 1 teaspoon mild adobo sauce
instructions: Combine red beans and green pepper in a pressure cooker. Add adobo sauce. Close, lock lid securely, and process at high pressure for 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: garbanzo bean,meat,sharp cheddar cheese,ketjap manis,thyme leave,white pepper,almond extract,tofu
title: My Favorite Vegan Quiche
ingredients: 1/2 cup garbanzo beans, dried roasted, cooked, and cooled | 1/2 cup tofu, crumbled cooked | 1/2 cup meat, ground ( optional ) | 16 ounces meat | 8 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, grated ( approx 4 cups ) | 2 teaspoons white pepper | 2 teaspoons ketchap manis ( sweet soy sauce, optional ) | 1 teaspoon thyme leave | 1 teaspoon almond extract ( optional )
instructions: Combine everything in a large bowl. Mix well. Line the bottom of a 9 pie plate with parchment paper. Add about 1/4 of the mixture. Add the tofu/meat mixture and the remaining half of the mixture. Mix well. Spread the cheese on top of the quiche. Top with the rest of the tofu/egg mixture. Top with the other 1/4 of the prepared quiche. Bake for 25 - 30 minutes at 350 degrees. Remove from oven and cool for 15 minutes before serving.

title: Spicy Thai Asparagus and Corn Soup
ingredients: 1 lb asparagus | 14 ounces chicken broth | 1 can creamed corn | 2 teaspoons low-sodium ketjap manis | 5 cherry tomatoes, quartered | 1 jalapeno | season salt
instructions: Snap asparagus stems, trim leaves, place upright in a large saucepan cover with water. Bring to a boil, lower heat, cover and simmer until tender. Drain, rinse under cold water and drain again. Combine broth, corn, kecap manis, tomatoes and jalapeno. Pour over asparagus and heat for 5 minutes or until hot. Turn off stove, stir well and serve with salt.

title: Spinach Cheese Balls
ingredients: 1 package frozen chopped spinach | 1 tablespoon garlic paste | 1/3 cup whipping cream | 3/4 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Put spinach, garlic, and cream in a food processor and process till well mixed. Turn mixture into a ball and form into a ball with your hands. Roll between your hands till completely covered. Then roll in graham cracker crumbs. Repeat the same with other mixture. Roll balls till coated. Chill for an hour. When ready to serve, preheat oven to 350 degrees. Place chilled cheese balls on a foil lined cookie sheet.

title: Japanese Shoyu Mushroom Hot Pot
ingredients: 1 lb mushroom, cleaned, stems removed, caps sliced ( oyster, shiitake, shitake, oyster, shirataki, etc. i use a mix of both ) | 1 teaspoon cinnamon, to taste
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f on a baking pan or rimmed baking sheet, add the mushrooms, a few drops of water, and a sprinkling of cinnamon. Bake for 5 minutes or until the mushrooms and cinnamon are completely tender, or until all juices have been absorbed by the mushrooms. If they have turned brown before the mushrooms are done, put the pan back on the oven. If necessary, keep an eye on them to make sure they don't burn. Note, for those looking for lower fat, omit the amount of cinnamon or salt called for on the cinnamon package.

title: Stove Top Corn Relish
ingredients: 1 cup corn kernel ( frozen or fresh ) | 1 cup half-and-half or 1 cup whole milk
instructions: In a deep heavy bottomed pan, heat corn and milk over medium heat. Heat to boiling.

title: Baked Parsnips
ingredients: 4 lbs parsnips | 1 cup parsley leaves
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f. Peel and cut the parsnips into slices approximately 1 by 1/3. Arrange the parsnips in a single layer on a lightly greased and heated baking sheet, then sprinkle lightly with salt. Roast for about 40 minutes, until just tender. Transfer the parsnips to a large mixing bowl. Make a well in the parsley leaves and add the drained parsley. Using a fork, stir until they are the texture of a paste. Transfer the parsnips to a food processor or blender. Add as much of remaining parsley leaves as is needed to make a thick paste. Transfer the parsnips to a serving bowl and serve.

Random Ingredients: coriander seed,cottage cheese,white pepper,green chilies,dark sesame oil,steak
title: Steak in Spicy Curry Cheese Dip
ingredients: 16 ounces cottage cheese, drained | 1/2 tablespoon coriander seed | 1 cup dark sesame oil | 4 -5 ounces fresh chilies, sliced thinly ( depending on heat desired ) | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper | 1 1/2 lbs steak
instructions: Mix cottage cheese, coriander seeds and the dark oil in a large mixing bowl. Add the chillies, pepper and white pepper. Marinate steak in mixture for 1 hour or more in the refrigerator. Remove meat and reserve marinade. Grill the steak until golden.

title: Frijoles a La Mexicana
ingredients: 2 cups dried pinto beans, rinsed and sorted | 1/4 cup cornmeal | 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 1 1/2 cups ice water | 1/4 teaspoon guacamole
instructions: In a large pot, place the pinto beans and just enough water to cover them. Bring water to a boil, reduce heat and simmer until tender, 45 to 60 minutes to an hour. Drain, reserving the cooking liquid. In a medium bowl, combine cornmeal, vinegar and reserved cooking liquid. Stir until mixture has combined. Add drained beans to the cornmeal mixture, tossing until well coated. Transfer the mixture to a medium bowl and stir in the guacamole. Transfer mixture to a plate and cool to room temperature. Break into serving sized pieces and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: marmalade,cocoa,marshmallow,raisin,ranch dressing mix,grape tomato,red wine vinegar,tarragon
title: Dressy Daze Cannoli Salad
ingredients: 4 cups grape tomatoes, halved and quartered | 2 cans mixed marshmallows | 1/2 cup light red wine vinegar | 1 cup shaved mexican chocolate ( or use real mexican chocolate ) | 2 tablespoons marmalade | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1 package ranch dressing mix | 1/2 cup raisins
instructions: Whisk together all of the ingredients and set aside. In a very large glass bowl, drizzle each jar half of the marmalade on the tomatoes and marshmallows. Sprinkle with dried tarragon and raisins. Sprinkle with more marmalade and raisins just before serving.

Random Ingredients: sea salt,quinoa,sirloin,steak,apricot jam,flat leaf parsley,peppermint extract
title: Steak, Apricot and Quinoa Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces sirloin | sea salt, to taste | fresh ground pepper, to taste | 1/2 cup quinoa | 24 canned apricot jam | 12 leaves curly flat leaf parsley | 1/4 teaspoon active dry yeast
instructions: Cut sirloin into thin strips. Grind quinoa into coarse pieces. Bring a large saucepan of water to boil and stir in quinoa, lower heat and simmer, covered, for 15 minutes, or until just tender. Drain and cool completely. Cut steak crosswise into 1/4 inch strips. Put sirloin in a skillet with enough water to cover, salt and pepper and bring to a boil. Place meat in the boiling beef and return to a boil. Add apricot jam to the skillet, then cover and cook over low heat for 2 to 2 1/2 minutes, stirring occasionally. Toss sirloin, quinoa, and parsley with mustard and salt and pepper to taste. Top with sirloin and serve.

Random Ingredients: beet,black pepper,poblano chile,sesame seed,rice noodle,tabasco sauce,mirin,apple cider vinegar
title: Pancitos Noodles With Beet Filling
ingredients: 4 poblano chiles | 4 large strawberries | 4 tablespoons sesame seeds ( white or green ) | 1/2 teaspoon black pepper | 1 -2 tablespoon mirin ( sweet rice wine ) | 1/2 apple cider vinegar | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce ( to taste ) | 4 ounces rice noodles or 4 ounces linguine, cooked to al dente
instructions: Remove chiles from the stems and cut off and discard the central seeds. Seed them if using a less mild chile and leave the seeds intact. Slice the chiles in half lengthwise and remove the seeds if using a more mild chile. Arrange on a plate and cover with a clean dish towel to weigh them down. Place under a grill for 5 minutes to char. Remove and place in a heatproof bowl to steam for a few minutes until charred but not blackened. Set aside to cool. Wash, peel and devein the strawberries. Cut off the remaining berries. Slice the strawberries into quarters and set aside. Finely chop the poblanos and add to a medium bowl. Place the strawberries into the bowl along with the chile, salt, white pepper, mirin, apple cider vinegar, tabasco and the mustard. Mix well with a wooden spoon or mashing and set aside. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the noodles and boil for 3 - 4 minutes until just tender but still slightly firm. Drain and toss with a little of the chile mixture. Pour over the beet mixture and toss to coat evenly. Drain the noodles and divide among 4 plates. Sprinkle with the sesame seeds and a grinding of black pepper. Serve immediately with steamed white rice, pickled vegetables, and steamed fresh vegetables.

title: Mexican Spiced Hot Wings
ingredients: 10 cups green salsa | 20 whole almonds, toasted and skinned | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 tablespoon mixed spice | 1 jar salsa verde
instructions: Combine everything except the wings on a large dish and marinate overnight. Place the wing pieces on foil covered casserole dish and bake on 325 degrees for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Turn off heat and remove the skin and bones. Drain the hot wings and serve warm or cold. Serve with your choice of condiments.

title: Curd
ingredients: 100 g shelled fermented beans sprouts | 1 tablespoon dried cranberry sauce | 1 tablespoon shelled pimientos ( optional ) or 1 tablespoon other small-diced ham ( optional ) | 500 ml skim milk | 1 green cardamom pod, crushed with rolling pin
instructions: Place all ingredients in blender jar and process until creamy. Serve warm or cold.

title: Polish Sausages
ingredients: 4 polish sausages, casings removed | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper, or to taste | 1/2 cup bread crumbs, or as needed
instructions: Fill a large skillet with lightly salted water, and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once it is boiling, stir in the cayenne pepper, and return to a boil. Cook the sausage over high heat until the sausage is slightly browned, about 5 minutes on each side. Remove from heat, and drain. Heat the oven broiler. Line a shallow 3x9 inch baking dish with aluminum foil. Arrange sausage onto the prepared pan. Sprinkle crumbs over the sausages. Place the baking dish into the oven, and broil sausage until the tops are dark golden brown, 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Pine Nut Baskets
ingredients: 3 lbs swordfish steaks ( or cod or halibut steaks ) | 1 cup pine nuts | 3 1/2 teaspoons crisco | 2 drops red food coloring ( optional )
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together. Score top of fish and let dry in a colander overnight at room temperature. When dry, score top 1/2 to 1/3 of the way through each piece to make diamond shaped cuts. Serve as directed by baskets.

Random Ingredients: anchovy fillet,beef broth,molasses,egg yolk,sharp cheddar cheese,italian seasoning
title: Italian Grinder
ingredients: 1 tablespoon mixed italian seasoning, divided | 5 1/2 ounces beef broth | 2 egg yolks | 3/4 cup molasses | 9 ounces shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 1 1/4 teaspoons anchovy fillets
instructions: Spray a 6 oz. Casserole dish with nonstick cooking spray.
