In a saucepan over medium heat, bring the beef broth and half of the italian seasoning to a boil, scraping the browned bits off the bottom of the pan. Remove the broth, set it aside and whisk in the remaining 3/4 tablespoon italian seasoning. In a bowl pour in the egg yolks. Stir the egg mixture into the beef mixture in the saucepan. Stir in molasses until the mixture is smooth, and stir in the cheese and anchovy. Pour mixture into the prepared casserole. Cover the top with a piece of buttered aluminum foil if your cheese doesn't melt right away. Place baking pan on oven rack. Heat the broiler to high. Broil the grinder 5 to 6 inches from the heat, for 3 minutes or until toasted and bubbly. Let cool 10 minutes. Cut into 8 servings.

title: Madeira Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup madeira wine | 1 teaspoon dried dill weed
instructions: Combine the madeira and dill. To the remaining sauce, stir together. To store, refrigerate unused portions.

title: Baja Fish
ingredients: 1/2 cup honey | 1 1/2 lbs white fish fillets | 1 head iceberg lettuce, cored and torn into bite-size pieces | 1/2 cup liquid smoke
instructions: Whisk together the honey and liquid smoke until blended. Rinse fish. Lay fish fillets in 1 or 2 shallow serving dish. Pour honey mixture over the fish. Pour liquid mixture over fish. Cover and refrigerate overnight before serving.

title: Mexican Pastry Triangles
ingredients: 3 sheets puff pastry | 1 1/2 cups crushed cashews | 1/2 cup triple sec | 1/2 - 3/4 cup sherry or 1/2-3/4 cup apple juice | 1 -2 tablespoon vanilla flavoring
instructions: Combine cashews and triple sec. Lay pastry sheets on counter and cover with a damp paper towel. Place pastry sheet on top, allowing an unappealing layer. Place several tablespoons of cashew mixture on top of pastry sheet. Moisten around pastry with water, then using your fingers, press a couple of cashew mixture together. Continue pressing until pastry sheet is used up. Cut into 4 - 6 triangles and place on baking sheet. Prick all over with a fork. Bake in oven pre heated to 450 degrees. Remove and set aside until crisp. This can be done by putting foil in a microwave safe bowl, heating in the microwave for 2 minutes, then putting it on top of the pastry and pressing with a fork.

title: Cheese and Scallion Salad
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs sharp cheddar cheese, coarsely grated | 4 bunches scallions, minced | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Combine cheese, scallions, and oyster sauce. Stir well and store in a dry, cool place until ready to be served.

title: Tzatziki III
ingredients: 3 cups plain greek yogurt | 2 pounds smoked ham, thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Prepare tzatziki sauce using a fork or hands. Rinse ham and cut into cubes. Place a layer of tzatziki on the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Place a layer of ham over yogurt. Continue layers, beginning with ham, and ending with a top layer of tzatziki. Cover dish with aluminum foil and bake in preheated oven for 90 minutes. Remove aluminum foil and bake another 15 minutes in the preheated oven, or until desired color has been achieved.

title: Easy Black Bean Lentil Chili (Vegan)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups lentils ( yellow or white ) | 1 cup black beans
instructions: Wash lentils and beans. Wash and add lentils. Let cook on med high until most of the water dries up. Serve and enjoy.

title: Quick and Easy Spiced Churros
ingredients: 1 box vanilla pudding mix, any flavor | 2 teaspoons ground chili pepper
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Mix well and chill in the fridge until firm.

title: Pineapple Ribs
ingredients: 2 tablespoons pineapple chunks, canned | 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 3 lbs pork spareribs
instructions: In a medium bowl, with the pineapple chunks, combine the soy sauce, oil and spareribs. Cover and refrigerate for at least 3 hours, but be sure the spareribs are thoroughly cooked. Preheat the oven to 375ºf. Place the spareribs in a roasting pan and roast until browned, about 30 minutes.

title: Quick Sushi
ingredients: 1 lb flank steak, cut in 3/4 inch slices | 2 cups chunky salsa | 2 cups sushi rice | 4 cups cooked chicken, cut up | 1 teaspoon sugar | your favorite seasoning ( salt, garlic, white pepper, mushroom etc )
instructions: Spray meat with cooking spray then toss with salsa. Wash rice well and drain. Arrange rice on a bamboo mat. Arrange meat on top of rice. Turn over to coat second side. Press rice so meat is firmly packed in shape. Roll meat so steak is firmly packed in salsa. Seal seams with a towel and place on a flat surface or other non stick baking sheet. Using a rolling pin, roll meat like a jelly roll without tearing. Cook approximately 25 minutes in the bamboo mat steamer then remove meat from bamboo. While rice is cooking, heat up chicken and sugar until sauce thickens. Slice meat across grain and serve with sauce.

Random Ingredients: mustard oil,sauce,white onion,sauerkraut,feta cheese,red snapper,celery root
title: Sauerkraut and Fish
ingredients: 750 g sauerkraut, drained and rinsed well | 2 tablespoons mustard oil | 80 g feta cheese | 1 large white onion, finely chopped | 3 stalks celery root, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon hot sauce | 225 g red snapper ( about 5-6 ounces )
instructions: Place sauerkraut in a small saucepan with 1 tblsps oil. Cover and cook over medium low heat until hot, about 25 - 30 minutes. Drain. Place in the food processor and process until smooth. Add the cheese, onion, celery root and hot sauce. Process until combined. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Drain the fish and pat dry with paper towels. Dip each fillet on both sides. Heat 1 tbsps oil in a large non stick frying pan. Fry the fish until just cooked through. Serve over the sauerkraut.

title: Kielbasa and Potatoes
ingredients: 6 yukon gold potatoes | 3 pimento stuffed olives | 4 slices kielbasa | 1 cup plain yogurt | 1/4 cup thousand island dressing
instructions: In a large pot, fill potatoes with water. Bring to a boil, then add olives and kielbasa. Reduce heat, cover and simmer 20 minutes. Remove from heat, let stand 15 minutes to finish cooking. In a small bowl, mix yogurt and dressing. To serve, place drained potatoes in a warm bowl, and top with yogurt mixture. Garnish with the pimento stuffed olives. Makes 4 servings.

Random Ingredients: ice water,salad oil,hot red pepper flake
title: Homemade Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1/4 cup salad oil | 2 tablespoons ice water | 2 cups prepared salad dressing ( from scratch, or storebought salad dressing )
instructions: Combine all ingredients together in a shaker container. Process in food processor or vita dressing blender until well blended.

Random Ingredients: pesto sauce,parsley leaf,soy sauce,pork chop,haricot bean,apricot jam,chuck roast
title: Baked Potangaroo
ingredients: 2 chuck roast ( bone in, about 1.5 kg ) | 1 can haricot beans or ( 250 g ) can kidney beans, undrained or 2 cans other dark beans, undrained | 4 tablespoons smooth apricot jam or 4 tablespoons tomato jam | 2 tablespoons low sodium soy sauce | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley leaves | 4 -8 teaspoons prepared pesto sauce
instructions: Soak haricot beans overnight if using black beans with 1/2 cup water. Rinse and drain well then drain beans. Combine beans and haricot or kidney beans with remaining ingredients in dutch oven or other heavy based ovenproof pot or a lidded casserole dish. Cover and bake in preheated 420c oven for 2 hours. Remove cover and bake for another half hour, until meat is tender. When meat is almost cooked, remove from pot to warm board, carve with a sharp knife. Remove bones and skin if required. Replace meat in pot with other ingredients. Heat to boiling then reduce heat and simmer uncovered for about 25 minutes. Sauce should thicken slightly and richly flavourful. To serve, spoon over warm noodles or rice. Top with a dollop of tomato sauce. To freeze or reheat, place pot in freezer until chilled.

title: Duck and Broccoli Pie
ingredients: 500 g pierogies ( small circular slices ) | 500 g steamed broccoli ( steamed as per your preferences ) | 150 g wienzer-style cheese balls ( small circular slices ) | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon ghee
instructions: Cook dumplings according to package directions. In a medium size frying pan, pour ghee. Add ginger garlic paste. Toss and fry until golden brown. You can also use bhaji or a little cayenne pepper. Spread the pierogies over a greased oven tray, and top with the fried garlic, broccoli and duck meat. Pour ghee over the vegetables on top. Bake at 180c or 200c, for 15 mins so that the cheese melts.

title: Hazelnuts in Mustard-Pepper Blend
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds hazelnuts, skins removed and split in half | 1 1/8 cups coarsely ground mustard mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon coarsely ground black peppercorns
instructions: Place hazelnuts on a clean, dry surface. Place a cast iron over medium high heat until the heat is about 400 degrees f. Place hazelnuts in a small pan of boiling water and place to one side. Place mustard seed and black peppercorns in a spice grinder and pulverize into a coarse powder.

Random Ingredients: anise seed,apple cider vinegar,cayenne powder,dinner,white sugar,basmati rice,head cauliflower
title: Quick Cauliflower Samosas
ingredients: 4 cups apple cider vinegar | 1 head cauliflower, chopped | 1 large head white sugar | 3 teaspoons darjeeling anise seed ( sesame seeds ) | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne powder ( optional ) | 1/4 cup dry white sugar | 3 packages dinner rolls | 2 tablespoons anise seed
instructions: Place the cauliflower and the 3 cups of cider in a large saucepan and cook until cauliflower is tender. Drain. Meanwhile, mix together the 1/2 c sugar, the darjeeling, and the 1/4 c c cayenne in a large bowl. Add the cauliflower to the caramel and season with salt, to taste. Toss the cauliflower and sugar mixture well, and set aside to cool. Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Roll the rolls in the 1/4 c sugar mixture, and set on a greased cookie sheet. Sprinkle the inside of a baking dish with anise seed. Spoon the cauliflower mixture into the center of the rolls leaving 1/2 inch of the headspace. Bring the top of the rolls up, to form a tight seal, and lay across 1/2 inch depth of caramel. Place in preheated oven and bake for 35 - 40 minutes, or until caramel on top turns pale golden brown. Remove from oven and allow to cool to room temperature, about 15 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Cheaters Nachos With Corn Chips
ingredients: 2 scallions | 1/4 cup pitted ripe olives | olive oil, for frying, preferably cast iron
instructions: Slice the scallions lengthwise into 1/4 inch strips and set aside. Place the olives in a medium bowl. Drain the olives of any excess liquid and then mash them together with the scallions. You will need to use your hands for this. Divide the mixture evenly between your tortilla crisps and then fry in your cast iron pan, working from the inside out, on medium heat, until crisped on both sides. Serve hot with salsa or tortilla chips.

title: Pasta with Beef and Chiles
ingredients: 500 g beef or 500 g chicken, cut into small pieces | 100 g currants | 4 tablespoons white wine vinegar ( or 2 tsp vegetable juice ) | 150 g fresh pasta, preferably cooked | 4 fresh chopped green chili peppers
instructions: Place all ingredients in a pan and cook over low heat for approximately 1 hour or until the meat is tender. Season with salt and pepper and serve.

title: Mexican Chicken Bundles
ingredients: filling : | 1/2 cup margarine | 3 tablespoons instant espresso | 1 pound chicken breast meat, cubed | 2 teaspoons lemon extract | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric | 1/4 teaspoon saffron | 12 guacamole ( ceviche )
instructions: Melt margarine in a saucepan over low heat, and quickly whisk in espresso. Add chicken breast, lemon extract, turmeric, and saffron. Reduce heat, and simmer for 15 minutes. Stir guacamole into chicken mixture.

title: Lamb's Kebab
ingredients: 2 lbs lean chicken pieces, split and separated | 8 green cardamom pods | sodium free chicken fat ( optional )
instructions: Place chicken pieces in a pressure cooker and add enough water to cover. Push 2 pods of cardamom close to the top of the chicken. Bring to a boil. Cover, turn down heat, and cook for 25 minutes. Turn heat off and let rest for 15 minutes. Pour chicken fat into a bowl or saucepan and discard the pods. Cool and skim fat into the fat drippings. Stir until well blended. Discard cardamom pods. Serve the cooked chicken pieces with onion and/or green gram for a complete main meal.

Random Ingredients: beef roast,rigatoni pasta,italian sausage,tomato,curry,okra,beef tenderloin,cool whip
title: Italian Sausage and Okra Skillet
ingredients: 1 lb italian sausage, sliced | 4 beef tenderloin, sliced into 1/4 inch pieces | 2 packages frozen okra, thawed | 2 cans stewed tomatoes | 1 1/2 tablespoons curry | 1 package frozen riggly quick rotelle rigatoni noodles | 1 cup low fat cool whip
instructions: In a large skillet, brown the sausage. Remove into a bowl. Drain all but one tablespoon of fat. Spray a large skillet with cooking spray. Add okra, and cook until tender and lightly browned. Remove okra, and drain. In the same skillet, stir in the tomatoes and curry, heat through. Add the beef and okra to the skillet. Pour in the noodles so all is covered. Cook until hot and bubbly. Top with topping of whipped topping.

title: Saffron and Saffron Pockets
ingredients: 1/4 cup saffron | 4 tablespoons wine vinegar | 4 pie shells
instructions: Warm the saffron in 2 tablespoons water in a small saucepan over medium heat until pliable, about 5 minutes. Remove from the heat.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,french bread,garlic salt,herbes de provence,hominy,breadcrumb,corn,mozzarella cheese
title: French Fondue
ingredients: 3 ounces dry hominy | 2 cups canned corn ( drained ) | 2 1/2 teaspoons herbes de provence | 2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese | 4 teaspoons dried breadcrumbs | 1/2 english parsley, coarsely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/4 teaspoon italian parsley, coarsely chopped | 1 loaf french bread
instructions: In saucepan, cook hominy, corn and herbes de provence over medium heat, covered, stirring occasionally, for 7 minutes or until tender. Remove from heat and stir in 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese, bread crumbs, parsley, garlic salt and italian parsley. Transfer mixture to fondue pot. Serve warm.

title: Spinach & Masala in Syrup
ingredients: 1 kg baby spinach | 1/2 cup skim milk | 1 1/2 tablespoons golden syrup | 3 tablespoons sweetened condensed milk | 1 tablespoon chili oil
instructions: Boil the spinach with the water in a large saucepan over the heat until cooked completely and the liquid has almost completely evaporated.. Drain & toss the spinach to coat evenly with the cooked milk. Meanwhile, place 1 tbsp sweetened condensed milk in a microwave safe bowl. Drain excess liquid from the spinach and add remaining condensed milk. Cover & microwave on high for 1 minute. Stir & microwave for another 1 minute. Then stir again until combined, then microwave for 2 minutes, stirring once more. Pour into a serving dish & refrigerate for 1 hour before serving.

title: Toffee Shortcrust Chicken
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin or 2 lbs round steaks, lean | 2 chicken bouillon cubes | 7 ounces dark chocolate or 7 ounces pecorino romano cheese, cut into chunks
instructions: Slice the meat thinly and place on a lightly greased shallow dish. Pour over the stock cubes and cover with aluminium foil. Place in the fridge and leave to marinate overnight. About 30 mins before dinner, grease a barbecue, place the steaks on one side of the grid, then the beef on the other. Bbq for about 30 mins, turning after 5 mins, so that the meat is cook to your liking. When cooked, place the steaks on a baking tray, cover and cook for 5 mins each side. Once done, remove the meat and slice into strips across the grain and place on platter. Pour on the extra stock.

title: Chilled Port Wine Jelly
ingredients: 250 ml port wine | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Put port, vanilla essence and port into a small pan and heat until simmering. When boiling, reduce by a quarter. Stir in the jelly stirring continuously until jelly thickens, boils, and sets around the outside.

Random Ingredients: curacao,soy sauce,basil leaf,soymilk,peanut,basmati rice,red cabbage,clam juice
title: Mexican Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 2 cups cooked basmati rice | 3/4 cup reduced sodium soy sauce | 8 tablespoons curacao ( try try anise-flavored liqueur! ) | 1/2 cup chopped fresh basil leaves | 1 teaspoon chopped peanuts ( or more ( i used cashews ) | 6 large red cabbage rolls | 1 1/2 cups soymilk
instructions: Place rice, soy sauce, curacao, basil and nuts into a food processor. Process until chopped fine.

title: Smoky Coconut Chicken Filo
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sloe gin | 1 cup couscous | 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - roughly chopped | 8 ounces cheese, cut into pieces | 8 ounces shredded cheese | 1 jar diced tomatoes, drained | 1 package frozen phyllo pastry sheets
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Combine sloe gin and couscous in a bowl. Stir to mix.

Random Ingredients: pinto bean,clove,bouquet garni,icing sugar,golden syrup,avocado,dashi stock
title: Guatemalan Beans
ingredients: 1 lb dried pinto bean | 2 -3 cloves | 2 tablespoons icing sugar | 5 -6 cups dashi stock | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 1 bouquet garni | 1 ripe avocado or 2 green bananas
instructions: Soak beans overnight. Rinse beans and boil them with the cloves and 3 - 3 3/4 cups of water till they are soft and falling off the bone. Remove the soup from heat and strain. Discard bones or any beans that have not disintegrated before the water boils. Mash the beans and add the sugar, dashi, and syrup till beans are smooth. Serve with sliced avocado, sliced green bananas, and sour cream. Note, to make the soup, use 1 1/2 tbsp of corn starch mixed with 1 1/2 cups water to make a paste.

title: Yogurt-Lassi
ingredients: 1/4 cup plain yogurt | 1/4 cup brown sugar, packed ( dark is best but it can be found in health food stores )
instructions: Stir all ingredients together until well combined. Enjoy.

title: Lamb or Broccoli Cutlets With Avocado
ingredients: 1/2 kg lamb cutlet, trimmed | 200 g frozen broccoli | 200 g cherry tomatoes, halved | 150 g mangoes or 150 g papaya, halved | 100 g avocados, ripe | 1/2 cup greek yogurt | 1/4 cup dry marsala
instructions: Mix yoghurt and marsala till smooth then add yoghurt dressing. Marinate lamb in mixture till fat has been rendered. Bend salmon and vegetables together with marinade till coated thoroughly. Chill 30 minutes. Wrap in aluminium foil and put in roasting pan with remaining marinade. Bake in c for 50 minutes in 425f oven. Serve with salad, vegetables and honey.

title: Baked Red Beans
ingredients: 6 medium baking potatoes | 10 ounces white beans, drained ( i used can be drained and rinsed ) | 1 can small enchilada sauce | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1 teaspoon dried basil ( or 1/2 tsp. fresh ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon
instructions: Preheat oven to 375f degrees. Dice potatoes and place in a roasting pan. Bake for 30 minutes, stirring once halfway through. Meanwhile combine beans, enchilada sauce, tarragon, basil and cinnamon in a medium sauce pan and heat until boiling.

Random Ingredients: date,beef bouillon cube,chicken bouillon,chicken thigh,chicken stock powder,chive
title: The Best Chicken Broth Ever
ingredients: 2 whole chicken thighs | 1/8 cup chicken bouillon | 1/8 cup chicken stock powder | 10 beef bouillon cubes | 5 tablespoons fresh chives, chopped | 5 tablespoons fresh chives, chopped
instructions: Place thighs in a large pot. Sprinkle with bouillon, and add chicken stock. Add chives, and cook over low heat for 2 hours. Add water every hour until thighs are very tender. Serve over rice.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,yellow squash,chicken,white bread flour,sake,thai fish sauce,bell pepper
title: Dried Chicken or Noodle Rolls
ingredients: 200 g ground chicken | 1 medium bell pepper ( seeded and chopped ) | 1 medium yellow squash ( roasted, shelled, deseeded and chopped ) | 1 tablespoon white bread flour, plus extra for dusting | 1 tablespoon sake | 1 tablespoon thai fish sauce | 1 green cardamom pod
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a medium bowl, mix well and cover to keep it refrigerated. Heat frying pan in a medium heat for 1 - 2 minutes or until very hot. Stir fry the chicken/chili mixture in batches for 3 - 4 minutes or until cooked through. Remove from pan and dust with flour, place on serving sheets and serve in a warm dish.

title: Tunisian Drumsticks
ingredients: 4 chicken legs, separated at joints | 2 tablespoons olive oil ( can use more ) | 2 tablespoons dry breadcrumbs
instructions: Roll chicken legs in bread crumbs. Heat oil in frypan. Add chicken legs, turning to coat evenly. Cook slowly until browned, about 20 minutes.

title: Smoked Salmon Poblano
ingredients: 1/2 lb salmon, fresh | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 2 poblano chiles, roasted and chopped | 1 serrano pepper, roasted ( optional )
instructions: Remove skin from the salmon and cut into 1” lengths. Place the salmon in a bowl and sprinkle with the nutmeg. Chop the poblano chiles, chile, and pepper. Place salmon in roasting pan, put the chile over the salmon, and wrap tightly in aluminum foil. Put in the oven at 325°f for 10 minutes. Unwrap foil, open, and continue to bake for at least an hour, or until salmon is flakey. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: panko breadcrumb,beef bouillon cube,superfine sugar,confectioner ' sugar,agave nectar,rice vinegar,pistachio,bok choy
title: Teriyaki - Japanese Sweet Soup
ingredients: 15 cups bok choy | 1/2 cup pistachios, coarsely chopped ( or cashews ) | 2 tablespoons superfine sugar | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 2 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil | 2 beef bouillon cubes or 2 chicken bouillon cubes | 2 cups very coarsely toasted panko breadcrumbs | 2 teaspoons agave nectar ( optional )
instructions: Trim and discard the greens from the beet bottoms. Remove and discard the dark center part of the beet. Cut the greens into long, thin strips, then remove the woody stems. Place the greens, pistachios and sugar in a food processor and process until finely chopped. Stir in the vinegar and garlic and process until the mixture is smooth. Transfer to a bowl, set aside. Heat 2 tablespoons of the olive oil in a wok over medium high heat. When hot, add the beef and stir fry until the cubes are browned slightly. Return 1/4 cup of the pesto to the food processor or blender and blend until smooth, then pour the mixture over and stir to mix. Repeat with the remaining oil and pesto. Stir the soup in batches and reheat as necessary. Garnish with pistachios and serve.

title: Bahama Cod Spread
ingredients: 16 ounces smoked cod fillets or 16 ounces other mild white fish | 16 ounces cream cheese | 2 tablespoons dried shredded coconut or 2 tablespoons flaked coconut | 2 tablespoons mixed spice ( baharat aka middle east mixed spices - the real mix )
instructions: In food processor, process fish until smooth. Add cream cheese and 1 tbsp coconut or flaked coconut and blend until well combined. Add another tsp or 2 of coconut if desired. Add the spices, mix well. Store in refrigerator and serve on a flatbread or pita bread.

title: Taco Street Tacos
ingredients: 2 medium heads iceberg lettuce, torn into bite size pieces | 2 teaspoons chili powder | 1 dried ancho chile powder
instructions: In a bowl toss together the lettuce, chili powder and dried ancho chile powder. Spread the mixture in a tortilla chip tray or plastic wrap, and top with the optional toppings.

title: Greek Yogurt With Chocolate
ingredients: 600 g greek yogurt ( with or without the goat cheese, for a richer, more flavourful consistency ) | 3 ounces dark chocolate, chopped ( i use dark )
instructions: Line a large serving dish or baking tin with silicone paper. Set aside. In a low, microwave safe bowl, combine the yoghurt with the chopped chocolate. Heat, stirring every minute, just until hot. Pour into bowl and refrigerate until set.

Random Ingredients: tomato juice,cooking spray,yucca root,bean,parsley leaf,hoisin sauce,mustard
title: Vegetable Jalfracha
ingredients: 250 g yucca root | 1 liter tomato juice | cooking spray | 2 tablespoons hoisin sauce | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley leaves, plus extra for garnish | 2 tablespoons chopped parsley leaves, plus extra for garnish | 1 teaspoon dry mustard
instructions: Peel the yucca root and cut it into bite sized cubes. Place it in a pan with a little water over a high head. Cover & bring it to the boil. When the water comes to a boil, remove the lid, reduce the heat to medium and simmer for 45 minutes or until the water is absorbed and the root is very tender. Drain off the water. Peel off the skin and the root, then cut into chunks. Place in a bowl with the remaining ingredients and stir to combine well. Serve immediately or refrigerate for up to a week.

title: Mexican Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 2 packages frozen mixed vegetables | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1/2 teaspoon aniseed | 2 teaspoons cumin seeds | rye bread, triangles for dipping
instructions: Place vegetables, tomato soup, aniseed& cumin seeds in a pot with water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes, or until vegetables are tender. Gently stir in the rye bread and serve hot.

title: Tropical Sweet Sour Curried Salsa
ingredients: 1 purple onion, cut into wedges | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 -2 hot red chili pepper, chopped ( with seeds, less for hotter ) | 2/3 cup drained unsweetened coconut, flaked
instructions: Preheat the broiler or grill. Place onions and chopped peppers on a foil lined baking sheet. Broil for about 5 - 6 minutes until lightly charred, turning the peppers as needed. Scoop into a bowl and drizzle with all the sweet sour sauce. Add the coconut and stir lightly. Season to taste.

title: Beef Nachos
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef chuck | 1 lb stewing beef, cut into 1 inch cubes | fennugreek ( optional ) | 4 fresh plum sauce ( e.g. bertolli or encore brand ) | 2 cups corn chips, coarsely broken ( optional ) | 2 packages refrigerated plain corn chips, broken in half ( optional )
instructions: In a large skillet or dutch oven, brown the beef and stew beef with fennugreek, onions and sauces.

title: Crispy Pita Cakes With Crab and Beans
ingredients: pita pockets | 1/2 lb crabmeat, canned | 1/2 cup green beans, cut into 2 in segments | 1/4 cup water
instructions: Combine crabmeat and onions in large mixing bowl.

title: The Perfect French Toast
ingredients: 1 package frozen puff pastry sheets, thawed | 12 slices french bread | 1 cup cooking oil | 1/4 cup peanut oil
instructions: Heat wok until hot. Add peanut oil. When oil is hot, add pastry slices and place in oil. Slightly fry bread till golden brown on each side. Add oil to wok or skillet to make a sauce. When sauce is ready, add french toast to wok.

title: French Crusted Cheese
ingredients: 8 ounces mozzarella cheese, preferably fresh | 1/2 cup cold water | 4 tablespoons maple syrup | 8 maraschino cherries, halved | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice | 8 dried apricots, halved
instructions: Cut cheese into chunks. Place the cubes into a nonreactive bowl and pour in cold water. Stir to coat and set aside. Meanwhile, combine the maple syrup and cherries in a small saucepan. Simmer over medium heat until the cherries just start to soften, about 2 minutes. Stir the cherries into the cheese mixture. Continue simmering for 4 minutes without stirring, until the cheese is firm enough to hold its shape slightly when pressed. Remove from heat and cover with plastic wrap. Let cheese stand an hour or more before serving. Garnish with more cherries and a drizzle of maple syrup. Can be topped with additional cinnamon, paprika, or other spices to taste before serving, such as oregano or basil.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach,cumin,sunflower seed,natural peanut butter,yellow onion,turmeric,mexicorn,wide egg noodle
title: Spinach, Noodle and Corn With Nuts
ingredients: 1 bag wide egg noodles | 2 tablespoons sunflower seeds | 2 cups low-fat natural-style peanut butter | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 1 medium yellow onion | 1 red birdseye chinese birds eye chili ( optional ) | 2 cups fresh baby spinach | 1 cup mexicorn ( small can )
instructions: Bring large pan of water to a boil and cook the egg noodles according to the package directions. While noodles are cooking, toast sunflower seeds in a dry pan for 1 minute.

title: Sour Cream Frites - Potato & Leek Dip in Pressure Cooker
ingredients: 2 lbs russet potatoes, peeled & cut in half | 4 tablespoons chopped leeks | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme, minced | 1/2 cup sour cream | 2 tablespoons ground coriander ( not ground, more to taste, if the mix is a little dry )
instructions: Place all of the ingredients except for the coriander in the pressure cooker and stir thoroughly, being careful not to let the liquid come into the seal. If the potato pieces are still wet, they will release liquid. Set the cooker on high heat and bring to high pressure. When the time reaches the time that your timer rings, stop the automatic read on the'mixture' and start the cooker carefully, so as not to break up the potato pieces, stir them regularly and add water if the mixture is still moist. When the time has elapsed, release the'mixture' from the cooker and transfer to a serving dish.. Sprinkle the top with the coriander, if using and serve warm or room temperature.

Random Ingredients: leg lamb,monterey jack cheese,ginger garlic paste
title: Roast Lamb Sandwich (Yum)
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs leg of lamb, fat trimmed ( or use a leg of lamb that has been flattened ) | 2 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste | 2 ounces monterey jack cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Place ovenproof skillet or other casserole dish in oven after you have heated up the olive oil. Spread the lamb generously with the ginger garlic paste. Spread the cheese evenly over the lamb and spread it out evenly. Place the skillet in the oven and cook for 20 minutes, or until browned and crusty. Note, the oven temperature may take up to 50 minutes. Be sure to check that the lamb is cooked well before it can be pierced easily with a skewer. Cut the lamb into slices. Serve with your favorite sandwich. This is good served over white rice and hot rotisserie chicken.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,yellow squash,greek yogurt,red capsicum,ladyfinger,dark rum
title: Warm Slice
ingredients: 1/4 cup low-fat greek yogurt | 2 tablespoons dark rum, plus extra for serving | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 1 roasted red capsicum, deseeded & roughly chopped | 3 ounces baby finger rolls, roughly halved lengthways | 1 medium yellow squash, deseeded & roughly chopped
instructions: Set the oven to 200c/400f/gas line a shallow xanthan ovenproof dish with baking paper, allowing the paper to extend over the sides of the dish. In a bowl, mash the yogurt with a fork, until completely smooth, adding the rum. Stir in the vinegar, chopped Capsicum, & the baby finger rolls and gently mix together. Spoon into the lined tin and smooth the surface. Bake for 40 mins or until the top is golden brown & crisp. Serve straight away with extra dark rum, extra yogurt & lots of napkins for a complete and satisfying chew after dinner.

Random Ingredients: orange marmalade,mint leaf,peanut oil,ginger,mini chocolate chip,panko bread crumb
title: Soy Chunk Fried Green Peanuts
ingredients: 1 pound green giant natural pound of chunk peanut oil | 3/4 cup orange marmalade | 1/2 cup mini chocolate chip | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh mint leaves | 1 tablespoon ground ginger | 1 tablespoon panko bread crumbs
instructions: Heat the peanut oil in a wok over medium high heat for 4 minutes. Stir in the marmalade, mini chipotle candy bars, mint leaves, and ginger. Cook and stir until the candy coating is fragrant, about 2 minutes. Remove the pan from the heat, and stir in the panko crumbs until evenly combined. Spread the peanut peanut candy coating on the top of the peanut candy coating, and pat peanut candy firmly onto each piece.

title: Dried Banana Pepper Lascia
ingredients: 4 red large-hot banana peppers | 8 ladyfingers, split | 1/2 teaspoon anise seed
instructions: Trim the ends off each banana pepper. Remove and discard the very tops. Slice the chiles lengthwise in half lengthwise, scrape out the seeds. Wash and dry the ladyfingers, place in a bowl and cover in water. Refrigerate for 15 to 20 minutes. Drain, dry well with paper towels and sprinkle with the anise seed. Fill a small saucepan with 1/2 inch to 3/4 inch of water, place over medium heat. Heat until very hot. Carefully place the banana peppers and ladyfingers, upright in the water. Cover, reduce heat, and simmer 3 to 4 minutes or until tender.

Random Ingredients: corn oil,red bean,cheddar cheese,pepper,apple pie filling,bean,chuck steak
title: Beef and Bean Roundup (Pressure Cooker)
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs chuck steaks | 2 cans baked beans | 1 can red beans | 1 can apple pie filling | 2 tablespoons corn oil | 1 tablespoon pepper | 1 cup cheddar cheese ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in pressure cooker. Select one brown/green/white/white/heavy duty pan for cooking. Set pan over medium high heat. When it becomes to hot to the touch, brown roast on both sides. Set meat over browned meat. Once the roast is no longer pink, set pan on the side over medium high heat. When heated through, pour contents of one can of baked beans and one can of apple pie filling into pressure cooker. Mix well. Close lid of pressure cooker. Close the lid and let the steam escape. After one whistle, place the pressure cooker with meat in a strainer and allow to depressurize naturally. Remove and place on a warmed platter and serve.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,peanut,chicken thigh,brown mustard seed,corn,sherry,peanut butter
title: Chili Chicken
ingredients: 3 lbs chicken thighs ( or breasts, with bone in ) | 2 teaspoons peanut butter | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 1 tablespoon mustard seed | 1 small kaffir lime leaf ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 1/3 cup corn or 1/3 cup apple juice, warmed
instructions: Trim any excess fat from breast meat or chicken. Cut pieces of meat into 1 inch cubes or chunks. Place the peanut butter in a plastic bag.

title: Green Goddess Dip (Or Burritos)
ingredients: 2 cans mild tomatillo salsa | 2 tablespoons finely chopped ham, or as needed | 1/2 cup sliced sun-dried tomatoes | 1 cup thinly sliced calf liver, rinsed and chopped
instructions: Mix tomatillo salsa, ham, sun dried tomatoes, and liver together in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: cooking oil,vegetable oil cooking spray,rom tomato,wheat flour,orange zest,red bean,pineapple juice
title: Quick Caribbean Fried Beans
ingredients: 1/2 cup pineapple juice | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 4 roma tomatoes or 2 medium tomatoes, cut in 1/2 | 3/4 bean | 1 teaspoon orange zest | 3 tablespoons vegetable oil | 3 tablespoons whole wheat flour ( may need more ) | cooking oil
instructions: Warm up the pineapple juice in a skillet. Add zest and oil in a bowl, and add the tomatoes. Bring to medium high heat and fry for about a minute or two until the tomatoes have sweated down a bit. Turn up to high heat and add the flour, stir well. Add the warmed pineapple juice a little at a time until the dough starts to thicken. It should have a nice slightly sweet smell. The dough should be sticky, not like glue. When you have a dough that is a little sticky and pliable, you can begin to add more flour to make dough dough easier to work with and to form balls, but don’t overdo it if you are adding the oats, you’ll’t want them to break apart. If you can, mix them briefly. After some of the flour has absorbed the mixture, add additional flour and stir well. After some of the flour has absorbed the mixture, continue to add water if it feels too dry. Turn heat off and let mixture rest for about 5 - 10 minutes, then transfer the dough onto a lightly floured surface. Using a floured hands, work out some dough and form into a round ball about a quarter inch thick. You should have about 12 balls. Repeat with the rest of the dough.. You’ll need 18 rolls for this recipe. If you’re not using oats, don’t worry. I took my chances with the recipe to see how much more flour is needed to get this mixture off the counter. If so, add it a little at a time until you have the desired consistency. With the dough, you should have 24 balls on each tortilla. I used a floured hands to make a few small indentations about 1 inch deep and created a depression for the bread to drop into the fried beans later. I placed four bread on top of each bean, then dipped them into the batter and then into the oil so they brown. If you’re not using rolled oats, cook these for 1 minute on each side. Remove from the oil and place on paper towels to soak and absorb any excess oil. Serving ideas. I also arranged the fried beans on a platter on a festive side. They also have a salad or tomato sauce with a dollop of sour cream.

title: Quick Guinness Mustard Pasta
ingredients: 450 g dried guinness stout | 1 cup mustard seeds | 450 g tortellini or 450 g spaghetti | 75 g golden caster sugar ( to taste )
instructions: Dissolve mustard seeds in the guinness and leave to cool to room temperature. Cook pasta in boiling water until al dente and drain. Toss warm pasta with mustard seeds, tortellini, and sugar. Eat warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: chinese five spice powder,meat,venison,lard,sharp cheddar cheese,yellow bell pepper
title: Chinese 5 Spice Hamburgers
ingredients: 500 g stew meat | 1 medium yellow bell pepper ( sliced thinly ) | 1/4 cup lard ( i always use organic ) | 1/2 teaspoon chinese five spice powder ( or to taste ) | 550 g sharp cheddar cheese ( shredded or coarsley grated to make 6 oz grated ) | 1 medium bird's eye chinese five spice powder
instructions: Cook meat, if using raw meat, heat lard in a frying pan, add bell pepper, 5 spice powder and 3 tbsp water. Cook over low heat until meat is cooked and vegetables are crisp. When meat is cooked, drain oil from pan but leave in just enough water to make a gravy. Add gravy to meat and vegetables and mix throughly. Serve on bread as normal.

title: Rice and Beans
ingredients: 2 cups dry kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 3 cups cooked white rice | 1/3 cup dry wakame | 1/2 cup sweet red pepper, diced | 1 tablespoon marsala wine
instructions: Combine the kidney beans and rice in a saucepan. Add 3 cups of water cover and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, and cook until rice is tender. Drain off any excess water if necessary. Mix in the wakame. Cover, and set aside 20 minutes. Stir rice mixture into wakame mixture. Cover, and let stand 5 minutes. Fluff rice with a fork. Serve.

title: Sultan's Tent Kibbee
ingredients: 1 lb fresh medium-sized tart apple | 2 kiwi fruits | 1 bunch kirshichiki candied tangerine | 1/4 cup tahini | 1/2 teaspoon tahini | 1/2 teaspoon tangerine juice | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne, to taste | 1 dash freshly ground white pepper, to taste ( optional ) | crabmeat
instructions: Peel and dice the fruits, being careful not to over rip the kibbee. In a medium bowl combine everything except the crabmeat & fish. Stir well to combine and place in refrigerator for an hour at least to allow flavors to blend. Remove from refrigerator and drain any excess juice. In a small bowl combine the crab meat, kibbee, and sauce. Garnish with sprigs of tangerine.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,american cheese,corn black bean salsa,ginger garlic paste,salt black pepper,corn kernel
title: Mexican Corn Dip
ingredients: 15 ounces low-sodium corn on the cob, with corn and black beans | 2/3 cup pineapple juice | 2/3 cup salsa | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1/4 teaspoon salt and ground black pepper to taste | 1 package frozen corn with jalapenos and corn-black bean salsa, thawed, processed
instructions: Preheat an oven to 425 degrees f. Line the bottom of a large baking dish with aluminum foil. Combine the corn and canned black beans in a food processor. Blend corn, black beans, pineapple juice, salsa, ginger garlic paste, salt, and pepper in the food processor until smooth.

Random Ingredients: banana pepper,cream cheese,lard,soya sauce,garam masala,baking powder,grapefruit juice
title: Pavlova! Easy and so Delicious Banana Pepper Muffins
ingredients: 12 banana peppers | 12 tablespoons lard | 1/2 cup soya sauce | 1/3 cup grapefruit juice | 1 tablespoon garam masala | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 6 tablespoons melted butter
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f. Dunk banana peppers in boiling water for 5 - 10 seconds and then in ice water for 20 minutes. Rinse peppers under cold water and drain well. Using 2 table spoons, scoop out black pulp and seeds and place these in a large bowl. Add remaining ingredients to the black pulp. Mix them well with hands and put the mixture into muffin tins and bake about 20 minutes.

title: Salmon Taco Bake
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs salmon, cleaned | 1/2 cup taco sauce | 1/2 cup nonfat dry milk powder | 4 tablespoons sesame seeds, toasted, divided
instructions: Cut salmon into 3 equal pieces. Spray 9x13 pan with cooking spray. Combine taco sauce and dry milk in small bowl and whisk until blended. Stir into salmon mixture. Spoon fish mixture over salmon and spread evenly. Top with two tablespoons sesame seeds. Sprinkle remaining sesame seeds over top. Bake at 400° for 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,kalamata olive,white bread wheat,chinese five spice powder,ginger juice,pasta,chili paste
title: Chinese Grilled Peppered Wheat
ingredients: 2 cups fresh white bread, and wheat ( from crusty italian baguette ) | 1/4 cup ginger juice | 2 cups kalamata olives, chopped | 1 yellow bell pepper, diced | 1 teaspoon chili paste | 1/3 cup chinese five spice powder
instructions: Remove crusts from bread. Line a baking sheet with foil, allowing excess to overhang. Cut bread into cubes, or into quarters. Place bread on prepared pan, and grill until bread is browned, about 5 minutes, turning frequently, or to desired doneness. In a medium bowl, add the ginger juice, olives, bell pepper, and chili paste. Toast the bread in a dry skillet or griddle over medium heat for 3 to 5 minutes, or until toasted. Remove from heat, set aside and allow to set. Stir the 5 spice powder into the bread, then pour over the bread mixture. Keep remaining toast toasts hot while serving.

Random Ingredients: colby monterey jack cheese,nutmeg,kiwi fruit,chinese cabbage,pork shoulder,cherry tomato
title: Easy Pibley Kiwi Pork Salad
ingredients: 2 cups shredded chinese cabbage or 2 cups swiss roll cabbage | 3/4 cup finely chopped kiwi fruit, like a kiwi fruit | 1/2 cup sliced cherry tomatoes | 1/4 teaspoon freshly grated nutmeg | 1/2 cup shredded colby-monterey jack cheese | 1/2 lb pork shoulder, cooked and shredded ( approx 1/2 lb. )
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the cabbage, kiwi fruit, fruit, nutmeg and cheese. Toss to mix well. Top with the pork. Taste and adjust seasonings, if needed.

title: Sunflower Hash
ingredients: 20 g sunflower seeds, lightly crushed | 1 potato, washed, peeled and grated
instructions: Heat a non stick frying pan over a medium high heat. Add the sunflower seeds, taking care not to let them burn. Allow to darken. Once the sunflower seeds are dark, toss in the grated potato and let it fry, stirring often, for 5 - 10 minutes, till the potato is golden brown. Serve..

Random Ingredients: mascarpone,fettuccine pasta,red bell pepper,ham hock,chicken stock,pancetta,fennel
title: Fettuccine With Bacon, Fennel and Red Peppers
ingredients: 250 g fettuccine pasta ( good quality ) | 200 g ham hocks | 150 g pancetta, strips or 150 g thick slab bacon | 2 tablespoons fennel or 2 tablespoons rosemary | 300 g mascarpone ( mascarpone flavour ) | 3/4 cup chicken stock | 1 red bell pepper, cut into slices | 2 tablespoons chopped fennel or 2 tablespoons rosemary
instructions: Cook the fettuccine according to the packet. Cut the ham hocks into strips, and fry in a frying pan with a good pinch of salt until crispy. Put the fennel or rosemary into one tablespoon of oil – heat with the butter underneath – fry for a few minutes until softened. Put the olive oil in a saucepan, and add the pancetta – brown lightly – remove the pan from the heat – add the fennel or rosemary – mix well. Stir in the mascarpone, followed by the chicken stock, simmer until reduced by half, stirring occasionally – about 10 minutes. Add the cubed ham and red pepper to the soup and stir well. Drain the pasta, and add to the soup, mixing well. Divide between bowls and serve with a fresh green tossed salad.

title: Parmesan Fudge
ingredients: 4 cups parmesan romano cheese mix | 4 teaspoons baking powder | 1 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: Mix baking powder and turmeric together. Add the baking cheese and mix. Spread on a slice of cake to bake.

title: Pate (Pattie of Beef)
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground beef | pasta, of choice | 4 slices deli-style italian ham or 4 slices deli sliced swiss cheese ( 8 slices each )
instructions: Cook ground beef in a pan with a little salt, and set aside. When meat is brown, mix in pasta, add cheese, and cook in pan for 3 - 5 minutes, taking care not to allow cheese to burn..

Random Ingredients: green olive,walnut half,saffron thread,kosher salt,rice,sherry wine
title: Walnut Rice With Sherry and Saffron (Rice Cooker)
ingredients: 3 cups rice ( long grain or long grain ) | 1/2 teaspoon saffron thread ( the size of a golf ball ) | 1 cup walnut halves | 1/4 cup green olives | 1/4 cup sherry wine | 1/4 teaspoon saffron thread | kosher salt ( as needed )
instructions: Place rice and saffron in rice cooker. Add walnuts, olives, sherry and saffron to the rice and stir. Cover rice cooker and push start. When done remove lid and fluff rice. If rice looks dry add a little water. Remove all saffron threads. Stir and serve immediately.

title: Italian Style Sushi Rolls (Kolbolicnitzke)
ingredients: 4 cups small curd | 4 teaspoons baking powder | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 4 teaspoons dried mixed nuts
instructions: Mix all ingredients in bowl and refrigerate covered for 1 hour or longer. Divide mixture into 10 equal portions. Shape each portion into long, thin log. Roll each log into a 2 inch diameter log and place on sushi mat. Cut each log into 4 equal parts. Wrap each piece of log in plastic wrap and roll each piece of log into sushi roll shape. Wrap each piece of log with plastic wrap. Freeze until firm, about 3 hours, or overnight. Slice log into 2 inch long, diagonally slices, or cut each piece into 4 pieces. Serve at once.

title: Easy, Sweet, and Salty Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup peanut oil | 2 tablespoons chopped garlic | 1 1/2 cups chunky salsa, hot
instructions: Blend all the ingredients in a blender. Heat in a skillet over medium heat, stirring occasionally.

Random Ingredients: tortilla chip,flat leaf parsley,bean,red chile pepper,taco seasoning mix,cointreau liqueur,double cream
title: Tortilla Bean Dip with Cilantro Cream
ingredients: 15 ounces refried beans | 3 tablespoons cointreau liqueur | 3 tablespoons toulouse's cointreau liqueur | 7 ounces tortilla chips | 2 tablespoons chopped flat leaf parsley | 2 red chile peppers, minced | 1/4 teaspoon taco seasoning mix
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Line a 9 inch round cake pan with parchment paper. In a large, deep skillet, heat cointreau, and toulouse until hot, about 1 to 2 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in refried beans. Spread mixture into prepared pan. Bake until heated through, about 15 minutes. Remove from the oven, and break up with a fork. Stir the tortilla chips, parsley, red chiles, and taco seasoning into the dip. Spread mixture onto the cake, and return the pan to oven. Bake for an additional 15 minutes, or until the crisp topping on the surface is golden and the bean dip is hot. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: tea,balsamic vinegar,vegetable oil cooking spray,dark brown sugar,pineapple juice,cracker
title: Balsamic and Sweet Chilli Smoked Ricard
ingredients: 3 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons fresh pineapple juice | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons cooking spray ( i use cooking spray ) | 2 teaspoons dark brown sugar | 1 -2 tablespoon teapoon unsweetened pineapple chunks | cracker, to serve
instructions: Combine first six ingredients in a small bowl, add a bit of water if needed to blend. Cover and refrigerate until required. Heat smoker. Smoke until reduced by half. Stir often. Serve on toasted biscuits with crackers.

title: Sourdough and Horseradish Mayonnaise (Savouries) for Mayonnaise
ingredients: 3 cups good quality basic sourdough bread flour | 1/2 cup prepared horseradish, grated | 3/4 cup tomato juice
instructions: Mix flour, horseradish and tomato until well combined. Knead dough until smooth. Add more flour if required.

Random Ingredients: pork tenderloin,wheat flour,ginger garlic paste,white sugar,tea,greek oregano,water chestnut
title: Steamed Pork Tenderloins
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon dry whole wheat flour | 1 teaspoon ginger garlic paste | 1 teaspoon dried greek oregano | 1/4 cup water | 1/4 cup tea | 1 can water chestnuts, cut into 1/2-inch dice | 8 slices pork tenderloin
instructions: Mix flour with ginger garlic paste, m oregano, and 1/4 cup water, stirring until smooth. Spread mixture evenly over tenderloins, and roll the meat up loosely.

Random Ingredients: red wine,chicken stock cube,lettuce leaf,hominy,sriracha sauce,chickpea
title: Chickpea and Hominy Salad (Low-Fat, Low Cal and Healthy)
ingredients: 1/2 cup chickpeas ( shelled or canned ) | 1/2 cup hominy ( or yellow rice ) | 1/2 cup red wine | 1/3 chicken stock cube | 2 teaspoons sriracha sauce | 1 cup lettuce leaf ( optional )
instructions: Place the chickpeas and the hominy in a bowl. Add the red wine and the stock cube. Add the sriracha, and toss to mix. Serve the mixture in to lettuce leaves on a salad plate.

title: Venison Wrapped in a Spooky Spider
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce, prepared | 2 tablespoons chocolate | 4 teaspoons skewer, soaked in water | 4 teaspoons dried venison, chopped
instructions: Warm the vinegar with the pesto in a pan, stir in the chocolate until melted and then add the chopped meat. Remove from heat. Brush the wrap with the melted chocolate. If you wish, wrap in foil, and then store in the refrigerator several hours or overnight. Keeps for weeks.

title: Spicy Hot Chocolate
ingredients: 2 2/3 ounces prosciutto ham or 2 2/3 ounces ham, finely crumbled | 1 small poblano chile
instructions: Use scissors to cut a slit into the chile, making a cross hatch pattern. Put the ham, cheese, and chili into a bowl and combine well. Put the mixture into the chile and stir to combine.

title: Yellow Pepper Relish
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 medium yellow bell pepper, cut into chunks
instructions: In a small bowl, dissolve the cornstarch in enough water to make a paste. Add the bell pepper chunks, and toss well.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,corn syrup,bread crumb,pea,caraway seed,wonton wrapper
title: Pea Dumplings
ingredients: 1 cup yellow sweet bell pepper, chopped | 1/2 cup frozen peas, thawed | 1/4 cup corn syrup | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 2 tablespoons dry bread crumbs | 2 teaspoons caraway seeds, or to taste | 40 wonton wrappers
instructions: Mix sweet peppers, peas, corn syrup, worcestershire sauce, bread crumbs, and caraway seeds together in a bowl. Place 1 teaspoon of filling in the center of one wrapper. Moisten the edges of the wrapper with water. Pull the two sides together to seal. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Place about 6 wonton wrappers in a wrapper, and gently drop them into the boiling water. Boil the dumplings until the dumplings float to the top, 3 to 5 minutes.

title: Lamb and Pineapple Skewers
ingredients: 12 large mushrooms | 1 small firm pineapple, peeled, core removed and chopped | 1 bunch fresh herb, finely chopped | 16 fluid ounces whipped topping
instructions: Soak the mushrooms in iced water for 30 minutes. Drain, then gently squeeze out excess water. Cut the mushrooms into 1 inch squares. Slice the pineapple into thin slices and put into a shallow dish. Cut herb pieces in half, then roughly chop. Add mushrooms and herbs to the pineapple and pineapples. Mix well and place the top of one of the skewers onto the mixture. Wrap well and skewer with thread or string. Barbecue or grill for 3 - 5 minutes each side until the toasty is golden.

Random Ingredients: lettuce leaf,red curry paste,pea,purpose flour,tortilla,liquid smoke
title: Thai-style Wraps
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups frozen peas | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | 1/3 cup red curry paste | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke | 4 crisp tortillas | lettuce leaf
instructions: Mix peas and flour in medium bowl. Stir in curry paste, liquid smoke. Lay tortillas on work surface with peas and flour mixture in the center of the tortillas. Starting at one end of the tortilla spread approximately 1 tablespoon of the frozen vegetables on each tortilla sprinkle with desired amount of desired amount of lettuce.

title: Creamy Mango Pizzas
ingredients: 1 bottle mango-flavoured vodka | 4 cups almond milk | 2 packages whipping cream | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1/2 cup pimento pepper, chopped | italian seasoning | 1 can sliced almonds, drained
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients with electric mixer on low speed until well blended. Cover and chill several hours or overnight. Remove foam from mango mixture with spatula, stir in 2 tablespoons olive oil and italian seasoning. Spoon 4 oz cream into a medium size glass dish. Cover and chill until cream is thick and subtly flavored, at least 1 hour. Place a scoop of cream in a small cup, garnish with the mango, spreading evenly. Garnish with diced tomatoes. Enjoy.

title: Gado - Vegetable Fried in Eggplant (India)
ingredients: 5 tablespoons ghee ( clarified butter ) | 1 pinch pepper | 1 large eggplant ( peeled and sliced lengthwise into thin slices or sticks ) | 1 chicken bouillon cube | chopped coconut
instructions: Place all ingredients except the coconut into a wok or heavy skillet and bring to a boil. Add the fried eggplant and continue to boil until the eggplant is cooked.. Serve hot with naan bread or chapati.

title: Baby Bok Choy (Pickled)
ingredients: 1 lb baby bok choy | 1 fresh jalapeno, finely sliced
instructions: Rinse off the outer leaves of fresh bok choy with cold water. Drain well and remove any loose stalks or hard muscle. Rinse off the hard stalks inside. Cut away the hard muscle from the head. Cut the stem of the bok choy from at least 1 inch of the top. Place the leaves of bok choy in a stainless steel bowl and add about 3 tablespoons of water. Cover with cling film and let rest for 2 hours. Rinse the bowl with cold water. Drain the leaves, cut each one into half and separate carefully. Do not remove the heads. Rinse well and drain. Rinse the leaves again and drain. Do not remove the stalks. Wash the rinsed bok choy well. Wash and dry the jalapenos. Slice about 1 inch of the jalapeno's width and lay out on top of the leaves. Wrap your hands inside the bok choy leaves and tighten it so that the bok choy is fully packed with the leaves of chokoy. Place the wrapped bok choy onto a tray and tie it with kitchen string. Place it directly on a hot grill or wood burner and grill on each side. The bok choy will give off a whiteish grilled aroma and a rich flavor. Turn the bok choy after a few minutes so it will be slightly crisp. Remove from fire and place on a serving platter lined with napkins.

title: Chocolate Baked Manicotti
ingredients: 3/4 cup sweet dark cocoa powder | 1/3 cup quinoa | 1 package manicotti, cooked and drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Lightly spread the dark cocoa powder over a 15 x 10 inch baking sheet, and coat the surface with butter or margarine. Spread uncooked quinoa evenly over the cocoa in a 9x13 inch pan. In a medium size bowl, spread the cooked, drained manicotti evenly over the quinoa, starting from the flat of the pan. Starting with flat side up, spread the chocolate mixture over the manicotti. Using an electric mixer, beat the mixture on medium speed until smooth and creamy. Spread quinoa evenly over the manicotti and chocolate mixture. Spread the ricotta evenly atop the manicotti. Bake, uncovered, for 25 minutes. Remove from oven. Leave in the pan, and let cool 15 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: pork loin chop,beetroot,brown sugar,rosewater,peach,basil leaf,double cream
title: Sweet and Spicy Pork Chops
ingredients: 1 beetroot, peeled, sliced and cut into wedges | 2 sweet pork loin chops | 1 ounce brown sugar | 1 pint double cream | 1/2 pint water | 1 ounce rosemary leaf | basil leaves, if using ( to garnish )
instructions: Bring the cream, water, rosemary and sugar to a boil. Remove from heat, and cool. Arrange the chops in the base of a baking dish. Spoon the cream mixture over the chops, and sprinkle with basil leaves. Cover, and refrigerate the chops for at least two hours before serving. Serve the chops with vegetables and a salad or vegetable accompaniment.

Random Ingredients: mint leaf,sake,thai basil,half,meat,white wine vinegar,ramen noodle,whipping cream
title: Ramen Soup
ingredients: 4 ounces instant ramen noodles | 1 cup sour cream | 1/4 cup half-and-half | 4 mint leaves | 1/2 cup of fresh mint leaves, chopped | 3 tablespoons dry white wine vinegar | 1 slice meat | 1/4 cup sake | 3 tablespoons whipping cream
instructions: Boil noodles and drain. Combine soup, sour cream, half and half, mint, vinegar, meat, and mint in a medium sized heavy non stick saucepan over low heat. When it simmers, stir in the sake. Garnish soup with chopped mint.

title: Seared Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 5 tablespoons garlic salt | 1 pork tenderloin, trimmed
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high place pork tenderloin on grill rack. Brush evenly with garlic salt. Cook until the internal temperature reaches 145 degrees f, about 5 minutes. Remove from grill, slice and cover with plastic wrap. Let stand 5 minutes before slicing into 1/4 inch thick slices.

title: Quick Chickpea Salad
ingredients: 1 cup cooked and cooled chickpeas | 1 medium zucchini, cut into bite size pieces
instructions: Steam the zucchini for 2 minutes. Drain and rinse the chickpeas. Toss all ingredients together. Refrigerate until serving time.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,red jalapeno chile,parsley,soya sauce,yellow pepper,cardamom pod,cranberry
title: Sweet Onion Spicy Cranberry Stir Fry
ingredients: 1 package red jalapeno chiles | 1 can sweetened cranberries, well drained | 1 bunch parsley, chopped | 1 medium onion soup mix | 1/4 cup soya sauce | 2 tablespoons dried parsley | 1 teaspoon cardamom pod, crushed | 1 -2 teaspoon red jalapeno chile, minced
instructions: Put red jalapeños, cranberries, and chopped parsley in bowl. Add onion soup mix, soy sauce, cinammon, cardamom, and red jalapeños and mix well. Let sit covered in refrigerator overnight as best as possible to let flavors meld together.

Random Ingredients: anise seed,red cabbage,asafoetida powder,serrano pepper,kielbasa,alfredo sauce,leek
title: Spicy Saag Pies
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried anise seed | 1/2 teaspoon anise seed | 1 leek, minced | 1 serrano pepper, minced | 3 tablespoons alfredo sauce | 2 cups shredded red cabbage | 16 ounces frozen sliced asafoetida peppers, thawed and drained | 12 ounces thinly sliced kielbasa ( turkey or link )
instructions: Toast the anise seed in a large skillet over medium high heat until it begins to darken, about 3 minutes. Add the leek, serrano pepper and anise seed mixture, and cook briefly. Stir in the alfredo sauce, cabbage and asafetida. Cook until the cabbage is softened, about 3 minutes. Remove from the heat, and refrigerate until chilled, at least 30 minutes or overnight. Slice the kielbasa into 1/2 inch slices, and place on a slice of saag with the anise seed mixture.

title: Low Fat Buttermilk Cream Substitute Creamers
ingredients: 2 tablespoons butter | 1 box splenda sugar substitute or 2 tablespoons granular sugar | 1 1/4 cups buttermilk | 1 cup whipping cream | 12 slices raw almonds or 12 slices raw hazelnuts
instructions: Over medium heat melt butter in large pan. Saute splenda and cream together for 2 minutes. Add buttermilk and cream mixture.

title: Shirataki's Mizuhito Beef
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb sirloin steak, cut of fat but no more than 1/4-inch thick | seasoning salt ( i use morton's organic salt ) | 1 package ramen noodles | 3 tablespoons mirin ( mizuhito sake ) ( optional ) ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon molasses ( mizukasa ) ( optional ) | 2 -3 cups milk
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Season beef with salt and pepper. Place meat on a cutting board and lay in a single layer in a roasting pan. Toss lightly with your hands. Use your fingers to rub seasoning salt into meat on all sides. Place in oven and bake for 15 minutes. While meat is roasting open the package of ramen noodles, and remove any fat. Rinse noodles with cold water and drain. Add noodles to a large pot of simmering water and bring to a boil. Remove the noodles when cooked through. Place all of the hot noodles on a large platter. You may have to do this in batches depending on the size of the platter. Pour beef mixture into the noodle lined plate and put the platter in the oven while you get back to the oven. As you continue adding the ramen noodles, reheat the ramen mixture until all are done. This step can take up to 10 - 15 minutes depending on how thick the meat is. This step is not necessarily to have a time to complete. If your noodle line is large enough, you can place the bowl of noodles directly on top of the meat mixture and quickly mix the bowl with your hands without spilling over the noodles. This step is not necessary, but it adds a bit of variety.

Random Ingredients: plum sauce,amaretto,ouzo,snow pea,red pepper,broth,cooking spray,green chile pepper
title: Champarecrispy Snow Peas
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 box frozen snow peas, thawed | 3 tablespoons ouzo | 1/3 cup plum sauce | 1/3 cup diced green chile peppers | 1/3 cup finely chopped red pepper | 1/3 cup chicken stock or 1/3 cup broth | 1/4 cup ouzo | 1 1/2 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped green chile peppers | 1/8 teaspoon amaretto | 1 teaspoon ouzo
instructions: Prepare a large skillet or wok coated with cooking spray over medium high heat. Unroll frozen snow peas and divide between them in the middle of a circle. Spray the center of the snow peas with cooking spray. Fold both sides of snow peas over in a half moon shape. Repeat with remaining snow peas. Whisk the ouzo, plum sauce, green chile peppers, red pepper, and broth together in a small bowl. Arrange snow peas in a large serving dish. Pour ouzo mixture over them. Garnish with an extra green chile pepper and an extra sprinkle of amaretto.

Random Ingredients: green apple,baby corn lengthwise,mango chutney,palm sugar,bamboo shoot,cherry,extra tofu,yellow onion
title: Tofu Tacos
ingredients: 2 packages extra firm tofu ( cubed ) | 1 container mango chutney | 1 package baby corn, halved lengthwise ( or 1 small packet frozen corn, thawed ) | 1 green apple, cored and thinly sliced lengthwise | 1 yellow onion, thinly sliced into wedges | 1 can sliced bamboo shoots, drained | 1 -2 tablespoon palm sugar | 1/2 green chutney ( for topping )
instructions: Spray nonstick skillet with nonstick oil, and cook tofu on hot, 1 - 2 minutes per side. Sprinkle with brown sugar, remove from pan, and keep warm. Spread coconut chutney on one side of taco shells, and top with remaining ingredients except bananas and corn. Serve topped with bananas and corn.

Random Ingredients: spinach leaf,romaine lettuce,tomato juice,tomato paste,red curry paste,jicama,basil
title: Napa K's Thai Spinach Salad Rolls
ingredients: 2 bags fresh spinach leaves or boxes frozen spinach, thawed and drained | 2 medium roma romaine lettuce, washed, dried cut in long thin strips | 12 -16 ounces tomato juice | 1 can tomato paste | 2 tablespoons fresh basil | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon red curry paste | 1 small jicama, peeled and thinly sliced
instructions: Prepare roll, rinse and drain spinach well, and place on serving platter. Arrange greens on top, and serve with tomato and tomato sauce.

Random Ingredients: black bean,white bean,rice noodle,chuck steak,kosher salt,curry leaf,corn oil,green bell pepper
title: Curried Beef With Noodles, beans, and Hot Peppers
ingredients: 1 lb chuck steak, trimmed and cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1 teaspoon corn oil | 14 -16 fresh curry leaves ( i usually buy the frozen type, but use your own if you have it ) | 1 small white beans, cleaned and cut into small chunks or can small white beans | 1 small green bell pepper, coarsely chopped | kosher salt | 8 -10 ounces dried rice noodles ( preferably medium in size ) | 1 tablespoon curry leaf, cut into 4 sections
instructions: In a wok, heat the oil over medium high. Place the curry leaves in the oil, and quickly stir. Add the beef, and stir to coat with the oil. Add the white beans and white peppers and cook until the meat is browned on all sides, about 3 minutes. Season with salt. Remove and discard the bay leaves and curry leaves. Cover and cook over medium heat for about 5 minutes, or until the meat is no longer pink and the vegetables are crisp tender. Meanwhile, bring about 2 quarts of water to boil. Add the rice noodles and let sit for 10 minutes, or until al dente. Drain. Remove the meat mixture to a plate and set aside. Add the curry leaves and stir until the noodles are heated through. Serve immediately. Note, if you want to add other vegies like, mushrooms, onions, cabbage, and carrots, you can use them. I have made this with mushrooms, eggplant, and shrimp and it tastes great.

title: Quick and Easy Grilled Pork Chops
ingredients: 1 lb boneless pork loin chop, thinly sliced | 1/2 teaspoon hot sauce
instructions: Season pork with hot sauce. Grill or broil for 4 to 5 minutes per side, depending on thickness.

title: Mexican Mashed Rutabaga
ingredients: 1 large rutabaga | 2 tablespoons soymilk | piquillo peppers, cut into large squares or chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Wash your rutabaga, cut it in large dice, cut the skin off, and cut into 1/2 inch cubes with a peeler. Place them in a bowl, cover with cold water, and squeeze out excess water. Place the rutabaga cubes in a casserole dish, pour the soymilk over, and sprinkle with a few piquillo or other decorative pieces of garlic. Bake in the preheated oven until the cubes are tender, about 25 minutes.

title: Fresh Mint Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried mint leaves | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 2 cups tomato puree
instructions: Pour boiling water over fresh mint leaves. Leave to drain. Place baking soda in a small bowl. Stir well. Add tomato puree and stir well. Stir in fresh mint leaves to finish.

title: Pepperoni Appetizers
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon celery salt | 1/8 teaspoon hot paprika | 12 tablespoons roasted hazelnuts, chopped | 2 1/2 ounces sliced pepperoni | 1 tablespoon sherry wine vinegar
instructions: Stir celery salt, hot paprika, hazelnuts, pepperoni and sherry in medium size bowl to blend. Cover. Refrigerate until ready to use. Serve with crackers, or sliced vegetables.

title: Shake-And-Bake Spicy Tomato Pie
ingredients: 1 cup plain flour | 3/4 cup white flour | 2 teaspoons gingerroot, grated | 1 tablespoon saffron, crushed ( i have used saccharine ) | 20 fluid ounces marinara sauce | 1/3 cup dark rum
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together. Pour into a glass pie plate. Bake at 200 degrees celsius for 30 minutes until golden brown.

title: Peanut Butter Rolls
ingredients: 1 cup crunchy peanut butter | 1 package plastic wrap
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with plastic wrap or parchment paper, or line it with several small, uneven strips of aluminum foil. Mix peanut butter, and flour together in a bowl. Work with fingers to form a smooth paste. Spread 1/2 cup peanut butter on one side of each sheet of foil. Spread 2 teaspoons peanut butter paste on each sheet of foil. Bring the edges over the peanut butter to form a seal. Repeat with remaining sheets of peanut butter paste and peanut butter paste. Let roll up, sealing the ends with your fingers. Bake roll in preheated oven until the peanut butter is melted, about 20 minutes.

title: Crazy Huevos Fajitas
ingredients: 1 cup canned black beans, rinsed and drained | 1/2 cup chopped fresh parsnips | 1 sweet red bell pepper, seeded and cut into thin strips | 6 cups shredded iceberg lettuce
instructions: Combine the beans, parsnips, red bell pepper, and lettuce.

title: Hot Sausages With Asparagus and Wine
ingredients: 2 lbs flank steaks | 2 quarts green creamed green | 4 links hot italian sausage | 1 cup pinot grigio wine | 1/3 cup dry sherry | 1 large orange, sliced into 6 wedges | 1 sprig fresh rosemary
instructions: Cut flank steak across the grain into 1/2 inch thick slices. Trim ends of creamed green. Cut three 1/2 inch lengths about 3 inches long from each side of creamed green. Place 1 steak slice in the center of an orange slice, then 1 piece of creamed green across the surface and 1 slice of hot italian sausage across the orange slice. Roll up from the bottom to the far end. Repeat with remaining steaks and italian sausage. Spread roll with both mixtures. Wrap each tightly in aluminum foil, then in heavy duty aluminum foil. Place on a rack in a shallow roasting pan. Pour sherry into pan and place oven on 475°f. Place the orange slices around sausages, and weigh them down with a 2 lb. Weight. Roast for 40 - 45 minutes or until tender, brushing with pan juices after 30 minutes. Turn out meat, remove foil and sprinkle with additional sherry and orange slices. Serve immediately.

title: Azerbaijan, Antilles-Style Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 6 -10 lbs meat ( pork, beef, or poultry ) | 1 yellow sweet pepper ( red or green is best ) | 1 large ripe pork tenderloin | 1 tablespoon chili oil | 3 tablespoons marjoram
instructions: Trim off ends of pepper and cut into pieces similar in size to the pork tenderloin. Slice tenderloin into 4 - 5 sections. Coarsely chop tenderloin, and add to skillet. Cut yellow sweet pepper into 2 inch squares. Add to skillet. Toss together with chili oil, and marjoram. Add to skillet for 5 minutes, until peppers are tender and tender, stirring often. Serve with a hearty grain bread and salad of your choice.

Random Ingredients: tomato,chicken fillet,hamburger,walnut half,stew meat,thai chile,chicken breast half
title: Walnut Chicken
ingredients: 4 skinless chicken breast halves | 2 lbs stew meat | 3 tablespoons walnut halves | 1/4 cup tomson's chile, chopped ( or crushed canned tomatoes ) | 1 can stewed tomatoes, undrained | 1 lb hamburger or 1 lb turkey fillet, chopped | 2 fresh thai chiles, chopped
instructions: Combine stew meat, walnuts, chile, undrained tomato, and undrained stewed tomatoes in a large dutch oven or slow cooker. Add beef or turkey and stir together. Cover, and cook on low heat setting for about 8 hours, or on high heat setting for 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Discard chile pods or pieces of canned chili. Serve over rice. Note, stew shredded coconut, drained on paper towels, or in a pita can, can be stored and reheated in a saucepan. Note, walnut chicken can be substituted for any type of meat. If available refrigerate leftovers. Note, you may find a substitution for stewed tomatoes if you prefer.

title: Queso Filling (Arroz Blanco)
ingredients: 6 medium cooked hamburger | 12 poblano peppers, sliced ( or more ) | 1 bunch fresh cilantro, chopped, divided | 15 maraschino cherries, or more if desired | 1 bag crispy tortillas
instructions: Grill or broil poblano peppers, or more if desired, until blackened. Peel and chop. Place hamburger in a large bowl with the chopped poblano peppers, 3/4 of the chopped cilantro, and 1/4 of the cherries. Mix thoroughly. Add remaining chopped cilantro and cherries. Add remaining sliced poblano peppers. Mold 2 triangles onto a hot griddle or large skillet. Spread tortillas with desired amount of filling. Place on griddle, and cook until browned on one side, then turn and brown the other side. Continue cooking, turning and browning until the filling is cooked through. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: yellow potato,allspice berry,cinnamon,vanilla extract,lasagna noodle,garlic paste,poppy seed
title: Homemade Potato Cheese Pastries
ingredients: 1 lb yellow potato, peeled and cut in half | 1/2 lb poppy seed | 2 tablespoons garlic paste | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/2 teaspoon allspice berries or 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon | 2 tablespoons dried lasagna noodles
instructions: Boil potatoes until almost done. Drain and run cold water over potatoes to loosen skins. Mash potatoes and mix well with poppy seeds, garlic paste, vanilla extract, allspice berries or allspice, cinnamon and dried lasagna noodles. Place in a container and refrigerate until ready to use. Store in a closed container to keep fresh for up to 7 days.

title: Savoury Madeira Burgers
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups breadcrumbs | 1 1/2 cups grated cheese | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 2 eggs or 1 egg substitute, lightly beaten | 1/2 cup madeira wine | 1/2 cup eggnog
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the breadcrumbs, cheese, mustard seeds and oregano. Add the beaten eggs and mix well. Stir in the madeira. Form into 6 patties. To cook, set aside 4 patties. Heat skillet over medium heat, pour in 3 tbsp oil. Cook patties for 6 - 7 minutes each side. Note, the time depends on the thickness of your burger. Serve on toasted buns and enjoy.

title: Thai Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup thai prepared yellow mustard | 1/2 cup chili paste
instructions: Mix together and heat well. Chill 3 to 4 hours before using. Use as needed.

Random Ingredients: nonfat milk,artichoke heart,pea,pomegranate seed,salt,black bean,vanilla bean
title: Artichoke Hummus (Artichoke, Pea, and Pomegranate)
ingredients: 2 cans black beans, rinsed drained | 1 can frozen peas, thawed | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained | 3/4 cup nonfat milk | 1/2 cup pomegranate seeds | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla bean
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together beans, peas, artichokes, milk, pomegranate seeds, salt, and vanilla. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 1 hour, or overnight. Serve hummus with pita chips or warm pita bread.

Random Ingredients: hard salami,beef sirloin steak,green cabbage,chipotle powder
title: Grilled Swiss Steak on Cabbage
ingredients: 2 lbs beef sirloin steaks | 1/4 cup chipotle powder ( mccormick's chipotle ) | 1 head green cabbage | 1 can refrigerated italian-style green cabbage, drained
instructions: Heat coals for direct heat. Place steaks into a lightly greased grill pan or heavy duty aluminum foil that has been placed in the direct heat. Top with chipotle powder. Grill steaks 5 minutes per side for medium. While steaks are grilling, prepare cabbage. Slice off the root end of the cabbage. Slice crosswise. Place cabbage on a flat surface. Cut off the top of the cabbage so that it will be easy to separate at the ends. Place a cabbage leaf on the leaf, and roll the leaf around the meat. Press together with the help of the cabbage. Set the roll on the cutting board and press around the roll to tighten. Take care not to tear the roll or tear it apart.

title: Greens and Rice (Rice Cooker)
ingredients: 5 cups long-grain white rice | 15 ounces fresh spinach, washed, stems removed, leaves cut in half | 1/2 cup fresh spinach, washed, stems removed
instructions: Place rice in the rice cooker. Start at the inner level, stir rice, cover with lid, turn on machine, and set to the keep warm. Heat a large nonstick frying pan with lid over medium high heat, pour in 1 cup of water, just enough to cover the bottom of the pan. Place spinach leaves on top of the rice.

Random Ingredients: angostura bitter,canola oil,rotini pasta,nori,espresso powder,lamb chop,o'brien potato
title: Aglio Eoxtrot
ingredients: 1/2 cup canola oil | 8 lamb chops ) | 16 ounces o'brien frozen potatoes, thawed | 1 package o'brien frozen mixed vegetables, thawed and drained | 2 tablespoons instant espresso powder | 1 tablespoon ground angostura bitters | 2 sheets nori
instructions: Heat a wok over high heat. Add canola oil and lamb chops. Cook 3 - 4 minutes or until lightly browned on both sides. Add potatoes, vegetables, instant espresso powder and bitters. Heat through. Cut nori sheets in half and then in half crosswise on a diagonal. Serve with broth.

Random Ingredients: eggplant,garlic salt,coriander,spanish olive,lime juice,yellow pepper,green chilies,mexican hard french bread
title: Melting Potatoes & Green Chilies
ingredients: 4 large spanish olives, rinsed ( may use black ) | 1 can whole green chilies, sliced | 4 large yellow sweet peppers, patted dry seeded and halved - may use combination of the peppers ( red is recommended ) | 1 medium eggplant, cut into 1-inch cubes | garlic salt | 1/4 cup ground coriander | 1 tablespoon lime juice | 8 slices crusty mexican hard bread, toasted
instructions: Slice the olives in half. Remove the seed from the peppers. Rinse and drain and set aside. Heat a grill pan or skillet over medium high heat. Meanwhile lightly season each of the above ingredients with the salt. Spray with non stick cooking spray. Place the sliced olives in to a single layer on the grill pan. Grill the vegetables, turning once, until the bottom of the vegetables have a nice char, about 10 - 15 minutes. Flip and cover the grill. Continue cooking until the peppers are roasted or soft, about 5 to 10 minutes longer. While the peppers grill, preheat the grill pan. When the peppers are roasted, add all the ingredients into a food processor and blend until well mixed. Place the mixture on a plate or serving dish and spoon onto toast slices, passing the slices a la cranaise. Note, in the old fashion, a cranaise takes the form of a star from the ground star.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,bourbon,french bread,tamarind paste,cranberry sauce
title: Tamarind French Bread
ingredients: 4 slices french bread, 3/4-inch thick | 2 tablespoons bourbon, chilled | 2 teaspoons tamarind paste | 1/2 cup cranberry sauce | 1/2 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Spread 2 tablespoons bourbon on each piece of bread, then top each slice with cranberry sauce and cheese. Place bread in a large, heavy skillet over medium low heat. Add remaining bourbon and tamarind paste. Simmer for 10 minutes.

title: Greek Sushi Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup apple cider vinegar | 1 cup pitted kalamata olives, chopped
instructions: Combine vinegar, olives and hot pepper flakes in a small bowl. Let stand 15 minutes for flavors to blend.

Random Ingredients: white vinegar,rye flour,allspice,pineapple chunk,farfalle pasta,red chili powder,golden syrup
title: Cape Crunchy Farfalle With Pineapple
ingredients: 8 ounces farfalle pasta ( bowtie ) | 1 cup light golden syrup | 1/2 cup pineapple chunk, drained and juice reserved | 1/4 cup distilled white vinegar | 1/4 cup red chili powder ( gochu garu jhang ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice | 1/4 teaspoon crushed dried pineapple ( chun mam )
