instructions: Cook pasta until al dente. Drain and run under cold water to cool. Cook pineapple in the microwave on high until soft, about 5 minutes depending on size. In a medium size saucepan, heat the golden syrup and reserved pineapple juice. Blend in golden syrup mixture while continuously stirring. Next, mix in the other ingredients and adjust spices. Add the pasta and stir so that the spaghetti absorbs the sauce. Serve warm or cold.

title: The Wise and Scordic Sausage Salad
ingredients: 1 kg sirloin meat | 2 bunches broccoli, stems and leaves, trimmed | 2 bunches fresh mushrooms, cleaned and thickly sliced | 1 cup canned beet, cooked ( in oil ) | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh tarragon or 1 tablespoon fresh oregano leaves | 1/2 cup sliced prosciutto | 2 tablespoons finely sliced fresh tarragon
instructions: Bring a large pan of water to the boil. Trim away rinds from steak and slice it thinly across the grain. Put steak in a colander. Discard marinade. Place a large saucepan over high heat and add 1/2 tbsp of marinade to the pan. Add all the other vegetables except for the mushrooms and stir. Cover and put a lid on set pan. Cook, stirring every 5 - 7 minutes or so, until vegetables are steamed but crisp. Remove lid and mix in tarragon. Remove meat from the marinade and place on a plate. Serve sauce on the side.

title: Ginger-Filled Pasteles
ingredients: 2 squares fresh ginger root, peeled and finely chopped | 1 pound kalamata olives, pitted and finely chopped | filling : | 1/2 cup tamari | 3 tablespoons finely cut kalamata olives
instructions: Mix ginger, 1/2 cup olives, and tamari in a bowl. Bring remaining 1/2 cup olives to a boil. Drop pasteles into olive oil in a pot of boiling water. Cook for about 5 minutes, or until pasteles float to the surface. Drain and transfer to a bowl to cool. Top with remaining 2/3 cup reserved olive oil.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,lemon juice zest,monterey jack cheese,spinach leaf,tomato soup,dill seed,cream chicken soup,soy sauce
title: Spinach Diced Casserole
ingredients: 2 boxes spinach leaves, frozen | 2 cans condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup soy sauce | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1/4 cup dark rum | 1 teaspoon dill seed | 1 cup grated monterey jack cheese or 1 cup colby cheese
instructions: Remove the green leaves from the spinach, squeeze out any excess water, then finely tear. Add all the above ingredients except the cheese, into a blender and blend until smooth. Pour into a casserole dish and sprinkle the cheese with grated cheese. Bake at 350°f approximately 50 minutes or until bubbly and lightly browned on top.

Random Ingredients: shell pasta,water artichoke heart,egg yolk,corn oil,parsley flake,pea,dark brown sugar,swiss cheese
title: Ham & Artichoke Pasta
ingredients: 1 box dry small shell pasta | 1/2 cup water-packed artichoke hearts, drained | 1 cup frozen peas ( thawed if fresh ) | 1 egg yolk | 1/4 cup low-fat swiss cheese, shredded | 2 tablespoons corn oil | 1 tablespoon packed dark brown sugar ( packed ) | 1/3 cup fresh parsley flakes
instructions: Cook your pasta in boiling water until it is just tender. Drain and reserve. Slice up artichoke hearts and microwave one at a time on high for 1 - 2 minutes. Add the peas, artichokes, egg yolk, cheese, and corn oil and combine. Toss. Turn off the heat and add the dark brown sugar. Stir and remove the pan from the heat. Add the parsley and stir to combine.

title: Italian Rice Balls
ingredients: 6 ounces glutinous rice | 1 cup mayonnaise | 16 ounces apricot preserves ( or cherry preserves ) | 2 serrano peppers, stemmed and thinly sliced lengthwise | 1 bunch basil leaves | salt to taste
instructions: Place the rice and 1 cup of mayonnaise in a rice cooker, and turn 2 or 3 times during cooking. Set the rice cooker to the regular setting. Once the rice has finished cooking, press start the mixing with the remaining mayonnaise until smooth. Remove the rice to a mixing bowl. Place a dollop of preserves in the pot on the rice and mix until well incorporated. Stir the mixture to blend in the preserves into the rice. Chop the basil leaves in half and stir into the rice. Add more mayonnaise if needed for the consistency of a spreadable spread.

Random Ingredients: couscous,baking soda,poblano pepper,pork rib,green chili pepper,chili garlic sauce,pita bread
title: Mexican Pork Ribs
ingredients: 8 pita bread halves | 4 1/2 lbs country-style pork ribs | 3 tablespoons chili-garlic sauce ( i use paul prudhomme's chili-lili sauce ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons baking soda | 1 chopped green chili pepper | 3 tablespoons diced poblano peppers | additional green chili pepper, slices ( optional ) | chili-garlic sauce ( optional )
instructions: Prepare the ribs. Preheat oven to 350°f. Slice them in half if desired. Pour half the chili sauce in a roasting pan and top with the ribs. Drizzle with half the baking soda. Cover tightly and bake for 4 hours or until the ribs are very tender. Remove chops from pan. Reserve remaining sauce. Combine remaining sauce and chiles in a separate sauce pan. Bring to a boil then simmer until slightly thickened. Cool and then stir in the parmesan cheese. Slice pork and serve, placing some pieces on each pita and topping with chile sauce, if desired.

title: Tapioca with a Twist
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups whole milk | 1/2 cup whole milk | 1/2 cup tapioca starch or 1/2 cup plain non-pareil starch | 2 tablespoons dried flat-leaf parsley
instructions: Bring whole milk, tapioca starch, and parsley to a boil in a medium saucepan. Reduce heat to medium and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes, or until thickened. Serve warm.

title: Lentil and Mushrooms  Rolls
ingredients: 12 red fresno mushrooms, wiped dry to remove excess moisture | 16 cremini mushrooms | 2 -3 cups torn lettuce leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. In a small bowl, add your dried lentils, fresh mushrooms, and torn lettuce leaves. Set aside. Roll the mushrooms, a bit at a time, into your fingers, and secure with a toothpicks. Spread the rolls with stuffing mixture. Place the rolls on an ungreased cookie sheet, and bake for 25 to 30 minutes, or until light golden in color.

Random Ingredients: rigatoni pasta,parmesan cheese,wheat tortilla,pizza crust,halibut fillet,sage leaf,mushroom,penne
title: Pasta and Fish Pizza
ingredients: 1 package dry penne | 2 halibut fillets | 1 can sliced mushrooms | 6 whole wheat tortillas | 4 tablespoons grated parmesan cheese | 18 fresh sage leaves | 1 package refrigerated pizza crust, thawed | 1 package rigatoni pasta
instructions: Preheat oven according to package directions to prepare crust. Place penne in a large pot of boiling water. Cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Mexican Round Steak for Two
ingredients: 1 poblano pepper, halved, seeded, and sliced thin | 1 cup pace salsa, hot | 1 lb bottom steak
instructions: Brush poblano with 1/4 cup salsa. Place sliced poblanos on a cutting board. Use your finger to slice thin, then slice thin more or less of the way you like. Wrap meat with aluminum foil, and place inside a medium pan, with any remaining salsa. Cover and broil on a high heat. Let bottom of meat reach room temperature or just barely hot, for about 20 minutes at most, turning the meat with a spatula halfway through. After 10 minutes, remove foil, wrap tightly in foil and bake at 300 degrees, turning meat once, for about 30 minutes or more, or until internal temperature reaches 155 to 155 degrees when taken with the side of a spoon and reaches 170 degrees on a instant reading thermometer. Let meat rest at least 10 minutes before carving.

title: Namurrah
ingredients: 1/4 cup chili paste | 1/4 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1/4 teaspoon coriander powder
instructions: Stir together all ingredients in a small bowl. Store in a cool, dry place.

title: Chipotle Beef Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 lb rigatoni pasta, cooked and drained | 2 cups mayonnaise | 2 chipotle powder | 2 -3 yellow bell peppers, chopped | 1 teaspoon dried dill
instructions: Mix in a small bowl, mayonnaise and chipotle powder. Pour into a covered dish and refrigerate for 2 hours. Serve chilled over a bed of shredded lettuce.

Random Ingredients: polenta,parsley leaf,chicken wing,brown mustard seed,canadian bacon,baking powder,potato,cherry
title: Corn and Canadian Bacon Hash Browns
ingredients: 4 potatoes, peeled and coarsely chopped | 8 slices canadian bacon ( thin slices ) | 8 ounces chicken wings, trimmed | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1/2 cup polenta | 1/2 cup firmly packed fresh parsley leaves, chopped | 1 pinch brown mustard seeds | 1 tablespoon dried cherries
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f. Put the potatoes in a large pot with just enough water to cover and bring to a boil. Cook over high heat until soft, about 12 minutes. Drain and transfer to a mixing bowl. Dice the bacon and cut the wings crosswise into 2 to 3 pieces. Combine the potato, bacon, chicken wings and baking powder in a large bowl and mix with your hands until evenly mixed. Spread the polenta on a baking sheet and bake in the preheated oven until browned and crispy, about 20 minutes. Stir the parsley, brown mustard seeds and cherries into the hash brown mixture. Return to the oven and bake until the hash browns are crispy on top and the potatoes are golden brown and crispy, about 12 to 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: apple cider vinegar,white sugar,bow tie pasta
title: Sweet and Sour Pasta
ingredients: 7 ounces dry bow tie pasta | 2 tablespoons apple cider vinegar | 1/4 cup white sugar
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add bow tie pasta, and cook for 5 minutes, or until al dente. Drain. In a medium saucepan over low heat, stir together apple cider vinegar and sugar. Bring to a boil, then stir in drained pasta. Cook and stir for a few minutes to combine with the vinegar and sugar. Serve warm.

title: Irish Potatoes and Cauliflower
ingredients: 5 tablespoons ghee | 1 pound spinach potatoes, cubed | 1 pound cauliflower florets | 1 roma ( plum ) tomato, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes, coarsely chopped
instructions: Melt ghee in a large pot over medium heat. Mix in the potatoes, cauliflower, tomato, and salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until potatoes are coated with oil and just tender, about 15 minutes.

title: Cauliflower-Green Chili Pancakes
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cake flour ( or plain flour of choice ) | 1 1/2 cups cauliflower florets ( about 1/2 head ) | 2 tablespoons canned green chili, chopped
instructions: Coat a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray and set on moderate heat. In a large measuring cup combine flour with about 1/4 cup cold water, and stir until combined. Spray pan with cooking spray, add cauliflower and green chiles and mix in flour mixture until smooth. Cook mixture over medium heat, stirring frequently, until underside of pancake is lightly browned. Remove from heat, and top with additional chilies to serve.

title: Simple Microwave French Gate Gate Cucumber Gate
ingredients: 50 g prepared gelatin | 5 lebanese cucumbers
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in 1/4 cup of boiling water and beat with electric mixer for approx 5 minutes.

title: Yellow Bell Pepper Chips
ingredients: 6 large yellow bell peppers ( about 6 ounces total ) | 3/4 teaspoon sea salt | 2 whole cloves
instructions: Position a rack in the center of the oven and preheat to 450 degrees. Remove the stem and seeds from the bell peppers and cut the bell peppers lengthwise into halves. Working with 1 bell pepper at a time, gently and evenly flatten onto a baking sheet with the flat beater of a cleaver to a 1/4 inch thickness. Sprinkle the bell peppers with the sea salt and place on the baking sheet. Alternatively, you can spray the pincers with vegetable oil, then bake for 6 to 7 minutes, until crisp and lightly browned. While the bell peppers are baking, lightly fry the cloves in a small nonstick frying pan over medium heat. Remove from the heat, shake the pan and let cool until the spices are cool. Transfer the bell peppers to a cutting board and, working quickly, slice the peppers diagonally into 1/4 inch wide slivers. Place 1 sliver in the center of each chip and press with a fingertip to pick up and overlap the sliver slightly. Garnish with more of the green onion.

title: Rice Cooker-Naked
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cooked brown rice | 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Place rice, cheese and cheese in rice cooker. Place rice cooker on medium setting until cheese is melted.

title: Maggie's Big Country Rice in an Oven Cooked Spiral
ingredients: 250 g farfalle pasta | 1 tablespoon olive, oil or 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 1 pinch salt ( optional ) | 300 ml cooked vegetables ( cauliflower, spinach, broccoli or zucchini ) | 1/8 teaspoon sea salt | 1/8 teaspoon splenda granular | 1/2 cup extra light olive, extra for sprinkling ( optional ) | cooked whole-grain rice ( optional )
instructions: Cook pasta in a large pan of boiling salted water for 12 - 15 minutes or until tender. Meanwhile heat oven to 200°c or mark spoon hot pasta into a large bowl and toss to combine. Heat a non stick flat based fry pan or cast iron griddle over medium heat. Add olive oil and caster sugar, tossing over medium heat until sugar is melted and syrupy. If the sugar starts to burn, add a splash of water to the pan and stir. Add salt, mixed vegetables, cooked pasta and seasoning. Toss to combine. Spoon into ovenproof serving dish. Sprinkle with olives to serve.

title: Homemade Beer Can Cheese
ingredients: 400 g cheese, grated ( or similar type cheese ) | 2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon chili oil
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl and mix well by hand until everything looks like the same cheese. Press the mixture into the can/can and place into a baking dish or in a canning tin.

Random Ingredients: cream,yogurt,skor candy bar,mexican cheese,cheddar cheese,flour tortilla,penne pasta
title: Mexican Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 package penne pasta | 1 lb american cheese, cut into 1/4 - 1/2 inch thick slices ( i like to use cheddar ) | 1/2 cup fat-free sour cream | 1/2 cup low-fat yogurt | 2 flour tortillas, cut in half crosswise | 8 ounces cheddar cheese, shredded | shredded mexican blend cheese or monterey jack cheese, to sprinkle on top before serving
instructions: For the salad, bring 6 cups of water to boil for the pasta. Add a splash of salt in the water to make it cold to the taste. Drain the pasta when it is just about done, and set aside. Meanwhile, make the dressing by using the sour cream and yogurt. Keep in a bowl. Dip tortillas in the hot water, and set aside for five seconds. Drain and arrange on a platter. Set the salad mixture in the center of the tortilla, top with the shredded cheese. Dollop the dressing on top of the cheese, and dig.

title: Napa Dave's Oats (Southern)
ingredients: 1 package oatmeal | 1 head romaine lettuce, chopped | 1 small yellow pepper, chopped
instructions: Prepare the oatmeal according to directions on the package. Meanwhile, bring oil and water to a boil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Add the lettuce and pepper.

Random Ingredients: asafoetida powder,coffee granule,sambal oelek,tomato paste,bean,beef bouillon
title: Quick Oven Roast Beef and Beans
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs round steaks, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 tablespoon instant coffee granules, i use 1-1/2 teaspoons | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 8 ounces tomato paste | 1/2 tablespoon sambal oelek ( to taste ) | 8 ounces hot refried beans
instructions: Combine instant coffee powder with asafoetida in a small bowl and rub evenly on meat. In a 13x9 glass baking dish, layer meat, beans and paste starting with the meat chunks, making sure the roast is completely covered. Pour hot refried beans over meat and bake in oven at 350°f for about 1 hour or until meat is tender and is golden brown and beans are tender. This dish can be made ahead of time and reheated for the quick roast beef and beans and served over plain rice.

Random Ingredients: lime juice,ginger juice,plain yogurt,extra virgin olive oil
title: Easy Ginger & Lime Frozen Yogurt Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups plain yogurt ( not fat free ) | 2 tablespoons fresh ginger juice ( or 1 tsp. dried ginger ) | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 6 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Place yogurt and ginger/lime juice in a bowl. Whisk in the olive oil until well blended. Refrigerate for 20 minutes. Serve with warm pita bread for dipping.

Random Ingredients: grape tomato,jelly,orange zest,pasta sauce,baking soda,cream tartar
title: Jelly Stuffed Grape Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 cup grape tomatoes | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 1/4 teaspoon grated orange zest | 1/4 cup pasta sauce | 1/3 cup sour cream
instructions: Cut a grape tomato in half, lengthwise. Place inside of each of two grape tomatoes. Drizzle with ½ tsp of cream of tartar, baking soda, orange zest, and pasta sauce. Roll up jelly roll style and secure with cocktail sticks or toothpicks.. Bake at 425 degrees for 45 - 60 minute.

title: Barbecued Stuffed Leg of Lamb
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg leg of lamb, trimmed ( you can use lamb racks if you want to ) | 3 teaspoons fresh dill, chopped | 3 teaspoons coriander leaves, minced | 2 limes, halved | 200 milliliters corn
instructions: Slice thick slices about 4cm deep on both sides of lamb. Combine the rest of the ingredients for the stuffing and rub over the lamb all over. Leave aside for about 1 hr, then place lamb on greased grill and grill till the lamb is cooked. Serve with lemon wedges and fresh vegetables.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,chicken bouillon,baking potato,broth,italian seasoning,thyme
title: Italian-Style Potato Soup
ingredients: 2 pounds baking potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced | 2 cans chicken bouillon | 2 cups broth | 2 teaspoons dried italian seasoning | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 1/2 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: In a dutch oven or stock pot, boil sliced potatoes until tender. Remove potatoes and reserve. Place potatoes into a food processor and process into a fine, slightly chunky consistency. In a large bowl, mix potatoes, chicken stock, italian seasoning, thyme and parmigiano reggiano cheese. When potatoes are done, ladle into soup bowls and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: rose lime juice,soy sauce,mix,tamarind paste,sultana,cream mushroom soup,baking powder
title: Lime & Rose Sultanas
ingredients: 2 packages ready-to-use dried saultanas | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup, undiluted | 1/4 cup rose's lime juice | 2 teaspoons tamarind paste | 1/4 cup soy sauce | 3/4 teaspoon baking powder | 1 tablespoon sultanas, raisins or other dried fruit for garnish
instructions: Cook saultanas according to package directions, or microwave them in a dry skillet for 2 minutes per side. Stir in soup, lime juice, tamarind, soy sauce and baking powder. Spread sultanas on a platter. Serve topped with raisins or other dried fruit. You may serve this over hot buttered noodles or rice.

title: Scotch Dogs
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground veal sausage | 2/3 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup slivered almonds | 1 tablespoon minced garlic or 1 tablespoon garlic powder | 1/2 cup good quality vodka | 1 cup fresh vegetables, finely cut ( broccoli, cauliflower, potatoes-i use frozen ) or 1 cup frozen vegetables ( broccoli, cauliflower, cauliflower, potatoes-i use frozen ) | 2 -4 tablespoons irish whiskey
instructions: Meat. Combine all ingredients except the whiskey and whiskey. Form into 4 patties about 3 to 4 inches across. Grill until golden brown. Turn frequently during this process, so they reach the desired doneness. Watch closely and watch for burning. Brush tops with whiskey. Serve with a mixed greens.

title: Beef and Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 500 g frozen broccoli florets | 500 g frozen dried chinese-style sliced black olives | 400 g shallots, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon chili pepper, chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons instant yeast
instructions: Boil, steam or microwave ingredients until tender, drain. Place broccoli, mayonnaise, worcestershire sauce and chilli in large bowl. Place cheese mixture over salad. Cover and let stand a few minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: green bean,egg,chili pepper flake,grand marnier,italian salad dressing
title: French Fried Green Beans
ingredients: 1 package frozen chopped green beans | 1 egg, beaten | grand marnier or any other orange liqueur | 1 tablespoon chopped chili pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons italian salad dressing
instructions: Cook green beans according to directions. Chill until serving time. Combine remaining ingredients and mix well. Spread over the green beans, coating well. Makes 6 servings.

Random Ingredients: pasilla chile,tomato juice,lobster meat,sea scallop,turnip,grain white rice,chili pepper flake
title: Jambalaya (Mexican Seafood Rice)
ingredients: 1 cup long grain white rice, uncooked | 1 cup tom & light tomato juice | 1 -2 chili pepper flakes, to taste | 1 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 8 -10 sea scallops | 1 cup lobster meat, chunks | 2 tablespoons fresh minced chili peppers ( optional )
instructions: Saute the shrimp in a medium size frying pan or paella until the pink color disappears add the tom and light tomato juice. Then stir in the dried chile flakes.

title: Chinese Vegetable Stew (Sopa Pangwan)
ingredients: 1 large onion, unpeeled | 4 large tomatoes with green chilies, seeded and cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 chinese cabbage, thinly sliced in half | 1 medium pearl onion, halved
instructions: Trim onions of root ends and core and cut into 1/2 inch pieces. Remove skin from cabbage and discard. Place cabbages in boiling water and boil for 3 minutes. Separate leaves from cabbage and slice into halves or quarters. Peel onion, removing outer green stalks, then slice into 1 inch pieces. Place a layer of onion, cabbage, tomato and green chilis into a heavy, large casserole.

title: Pumpkin Salad
ingredients: 1 large ripe pumpkin, peeled, seeded, cut into 3/4-inch cubes | 1 leaf of red leaf lettuce ( about 2 cups ) or 1 leaf green leaf ( about 2 cups ) | 2 teaspoons thinly sliced radishes ( optional ) | 1 large lettuce, for serving ( optional )
instructions: Steam the pumpkin until it is fork tender, about 5 to 7 minutes or till tender, but still firm. Meanwhile, arrange the lettuce on 4 plates. With a 1/2 inch slice of pumpkin on each plate, and sprinkle on some radice if desired. Drizzle the remaining radice into the radish slices, and sprinkle with the radish slices. Serve.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,sesame oil,vinegar,lotus seed,cream tartar,purpose flour,rump steak
title: Pepper Steak With Shiitake Vinegar
ingredients: 3 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1 lb fresh whole steak, pounded thin | 1 tablespoon light cream of tartar | 1/2 teaspoon sesame oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons unbleached all-purpose flour | 3/4 cup lukewarm sour cream or 3/4 cup low-fat sour cream | 1 tablespoon minced fresh garlic | 1/2 cup pecorino romano cheese, grated | 1 teaspoon unbleached all-purpose flour | 2 tablespoons dry sesame oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons unbleached all-purpose flour | 3 tablespoons pecorino romano cheese, grated
instructions: Place flour in shallow dish and lightly dust steak. In small bowl combine cream of tartar and sesame oil. Sprinkle both sides of steak with both flakes.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,american cheese,baking potato,ginger,apple,chick pea,vermouth,caraway seed
title: Papa Drexler's Hot German Potatoes
ingredients: 2 baking potatoes, peeled and cut into bite-size pieces | 2 tablespoons unsweetened dried unsweetened cocoa powder | 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger | 1 can low-sodium chick-peas, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup dry vermouth | 4 tablespoons unsweetened dutch-processed cocoa powder | 2 teaspoons caraway seeds | 4 slices american cheese, thinly sliced | 1 can chunk-style peeled, unpeeled whole-wheat sweet apples, drained
instructions: Place potato pieces in a large pot and cover with water. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to medium low, and simmer until tender, 15 to 20 minutes. Meanwhile, stir 1/2 tsp cocoa, 1/2 tsp ground ginger, chick peas and vermouth together in a small saucepan. Heat until hot. Stir in 2 tbsp cocoa and caraway seeds. Return pot to a low simmer. Meanwhile, place the remaining 2 tsp cocoa, 2 tsp ground ginger, and apples in a bowl. Stir to blend with the apples, cover and keep warm. When potatoes are done, stir the potato mixture, cheese, and chick peas into the cheese mixture and heat. Serve with warm fries.

Random Ingredients: cooking wine,brandy,kale,bow tie pasta,pimiento,parsnip,chicken breast half,pumpernickel bread
title: Kale Salad II
ingredients: 1 package bow tie pasta | 4 bone-in chicken breast halves with skin | 3 tablespoons cooking wine | 2 pimientos, chopped | 4 stalks fresh kale, cleaned, stems removed, and coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup chopped chard or 1/2 cup parsnip | 1 tablespoon brandy or 1 tablespoon rum | pumpernickel bread ( optional )
instructions: Fill a large pot with water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Prepare bows according to package directions. Meanwhile, using 2 forks, carefully pull the skin off the chicken breasts. With a meat mallet or small spoon, pound the chicken to 1/4 inch thickness on all sides. Trim off any excess fat and cut the breasts into 1 inch cubes. Arrange the chicken on a serving platter. Discard any excess fat. Mix the cooking wine, pimentos, kale and chard together in a large bowl, reserving liquid. Stir in the brandy and refrigerate until needed. Before serving, sprinkle with bread crouton and serve.

title: Cousin Pete's Lamb Chops and Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 lb ground lamb | 2 large russet potatoes, cut into 6 chuncks | 1 can sliced button mushrooms | tortilla chips
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high. Combine lamb and potatoes in a large bowl.

title: Pecorino Veneziana from Olive Garden
ingredients: 3/4 cup grated pecorino-romano cheese | 2 1/2 teaspoons garam masala | 2/3 teaspoon dried rosemary, crushed in pestle or 2/3 teaspoon fresh rosemary, pounded
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the grated cheese with the garam masala, rosemary and freshly rubbed rosemary. The mixture should have a consistent but slightly droppable consistency.

title: Cajun Sausages
ingredients: 6 links cooked sausage, cut lengthwise in half ( hot or mild ) | 1/4 cup pimento, diced
instructions: Cut about 12 slits into the sausages with scissors and place in a frying pan with 1/2 inch of water or vegetable oil to cover. Simmer over low heat, turning frequently, for 20 minutes or until tender. Drain and reserve liquid. In the same pan on medium high heat, saute sausage half a minute or until meat is heated through. Slice sausage thinly and stir in pimentos. Serve hot.

title: Champagne Mushrooms
ingredients: 12 ounces chestnut mushrooms | 1 cup ice water | grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese, to cover
instructions: Clean mushrooms well and cut open at one end, making sure that the stem was removed.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,salt black pepper,superfine sugar,rum,chuck,ice water
title: Steak Flamande (Carbonnade)
ingredients: 2 teaspoons olive oil | 1 1/2 lbs chuck, top steaks cut into 3/4-inch wide by 3/4-inch thick ( cut into strips about 2 inches wide by 2 inches long ) | 2 tablespoons superfine sugar | 2 tablespoons rum | 1 1/2 cups ice water | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Brown meat quickly on both sides.

title: Indian Spinach
ingredients: 1/2 cup raw spinach, chopped | 1/4 cup cashew nuts, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1/4 teaspoon arrowroot ( optional )
instructions: Grate the zest from the ginger and garlic and spread the grated mix over the spinach. Add all the other ingredients and mix well. Cover and leave to marinate for at least an hour. Serve hot or cold.

title: Ginger Milk
ingredients: 1 piece fresh ginger root, minced | 1/3 cup millet
instructions: Place the ginger in a bowl and pour enough water over to cover. Let soak for 1 hour. Pour millet into a pot, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, and place lid on top to keep hot. Simmer until all liquid is absorbed, 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Hummus and Beet Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups beet, cooked ( small chunks, about 16 ) | 1/2 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon dried tarragon, crumbled | 1/2 cup apple juice | 1/2 cup prepared hummus | 6 soft tortillas
instructions: Combine beet & vinegar in small bowl, sprinkle with tarragon & cilantro, add juice & blend well, season to taste. Warm tortillas in microwave or in a frying pan, cut side up, over medium low heat 1 to 2 minutes, until flexible. Spread with hummus & place a few pats of veggie mixture on top. Fold edges of cheesecloth over, press down & fold over edges of tortilla to form a taco & serve immediately.

title: Sweet Annatto Salt (Mexican Salt)
ingredients: 1/2 cup fine salt | 1 tablespoon annatto seeds | 2 cups sugar or 2 cups light brown sugar
instructions: Put salt in a bowl and pour boiling water over. When it comes to a boil, stir in the annatto seeds. You might have to make this 1 or 2 days in advance. Leave for 5 to 10 minutes to drain off the water, then stir again. Pour off seeds from the mixture until later, or if using the sugar, this could take anywhere from 30 to 72 hours. Pour into a glass jar, or container. Seal and store away from direct sunlight for up to 1 year. Use sparingly as salt can become solid if left in a bowl in a cool, dry place, such as a tea towel or dishwasher. This can sometimes be kept in the refrigerator for up to 3 weeks. Note, the salt can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 6 months. It should not be eaten before this time.

title: Italian Sausage With Beer (Cajun-Style)
ingredients: 1 lb bulk italian sausage | 12 ounces dark beer ( corona or pacifico recommended ) | 6 1/4 cups whole wheat flour
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f. Set the sausage on a board and cut into bite size pieces. Brown the sausage pieces in a large, heavy skillet over medium heat for approximately 10 minutes, stirring constantly. Pour off most of the fat. Put the beer and flour in a large bowl. Stir in the sausage pieces and coat with the beer. Bake, uncovered, for 25–30 minutes, basting occasionally. Remove from oven and allow to cool slightly.

title: Chicken Rice Soup With Cream and Coconut
ingredients: 1 cup rice | 1 cup vegetable broth | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric | 10 ounces chicken breasts | 1 tablespoon asafoetida powder | 1 cup fresh raspberries or 1 cup frozen raspberries | 1/2 cup creamed coconut | 1/2 cup rose syrup
instructions: Place rice and broth in a large soup pot and bring to a boil. Turn the heat to low, cover and simmer for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, cube chicken breast into small chunks and place in a medium skillet. Toss with asafoetida and fry until no longer pink, remove with a slotted spoon and set aside. In the skillet, combine the chicken, red chili powder and coconut. Let sauté for 3 minutes and add in rose syrup and cook, stirring constantly, for 2 minutes. Puree soup slowly and add into the soup pot, cook covered for 10 minutes. Serve in warm bowls over basmati rice.

title: Sautéed Spinach With Linguine
ingredients: 1 cup rice flour | 3 packages baby spinach ( about 8 spinach per package, cleaned, washed and chopped into bite sized pieces ) | 2 cups tomato ketchup | 1/2 teaspoon accent seasoning | 4 -5 ounces linguine, cooked
instructions: Prepare all ingredients before you put the linguine on to boil and set the timer for 18 minutes at about 400°f. Remove the stove from the stove and mix the riceflour with water to make a paste and then pour over the hot noodle to absorb the sauce. Cook until just a few minutes and just barely translucent but do not overcook. While the linguine is cooking, get a sauté pan and add the chopped spinach, tomato ketchup and accent seasoning and cook until all and just tender. Drain the pasta and toss with the skillet sauce. Serve immediately and enjoy.

title: Corn Tortilla Pudding
ingredients: 7 corn tortillas | 1/3 cup prepared custard powder | 3/4 cup hot water | 1/2 teaspoon cumin ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place 2 corn tortillas in a non stick pan or a lightly greased 1 1/2 quart oven proof dish. Spread 1/3 custard powder on tortilla closest to you. Top with hot water and cumin, if desired. Bake about 15 - 20 minutes until set. Serve warm with guacamole if desired.

Random Ingredients: chestnut,sun tomato oil,yellow bell pepper,kaffir lime leaf
title: The Best Chestnut Salad Ever!
ingredients: 250 g chestnuts, skinned, halved and thickly sliced | 1 medium yellow bell pepper | 2 kaffir lime leaves | 3 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil ( or olive oil )
instructions: Place the chestnuts in a large mixing bowl. Slice the pepper into thin strips and put them in as good a heap onto the chestnuts. Sprinkle with a couple of handfuls of the kaffir lime leaves. Toss gently. Pour the sun dried tomatoes onto the salad and pile in. Use remaining kaffir lime leaves to season. Serve immediately, otherwise, eat them straight away with a salad leaf in the middle.

title: Tortilla Wild Mushroom Quesadillas
ingredients: 1 tortilla | 3 tablespoons curry powder | 1 ounce wild mushrooms, sliced
instructions: Heat nonstick skillet over medium heat. Spread 1 teaspoon curry powder over half of tortilla. Layer with wild mushrooms. Top with remaining tortilla, pressing down lightly. Cook until underside begins to brown and bottom begins to crisp, about 30 seconds.

Random Ingredients: green bean,olive,white vinegar,ancho chile powder,artichoke heart
title: Green Beans with Antancho Sauce
ingredients: 8 ounces fresh green beans, trimmed | 4 ounces canned artichoke hearts, drained | 1/4 cup olive, oil-packed, drained and finely chopped | 2 teaspoons dried ancho chile powder | 1 teaspoon white vinegar
instructions: Combine beans, artichokes, olives, chili powder and vinegar in a large bowl.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,cardamom seed,iceberg lettuce,tomato soup,pineapple juice,coconut oil
title: Fried Plantains (Afghani)
ingredients: 1/2 lb pineapple, peeled, cored and diced ( may substitute 2 cans of pineapple slices ) | 2 tablespoons coconut oil | 3 bay leaves | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1 can condensed tomato soup | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 2 cups shredded iceberg lettuce
instructions: Heat oil in a heavy skillet over medium low heat. Add bay leaves to the skillet.

title: Crispy Meatballs in French Fries
ingredients: 12 frozen meatballs | 6 large flour tortillas
instructions: Lay one tortilla out flat on rolling pin. Sprinkle with about 1/2 teaspoon of flour to coat the tortilla. Place 2 meatballs on tortilla and spread evenly. Bring the ends together and roll up tightly. Place the meatballs on a rack of paper towel. Let drain overnight. Cook slowly until all of the meatballs have been frozen. Let cool on a cooling rack. Eat with your favorite fries or dip.

title: Panchoke achiote
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon achiote ( annatto ) | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds | celery salt
instructions: Dissolve annatto and sesame seeds in 1 tablespoon of water. Mix in celery salt to taste.

title: Tasty and Easy Sausage and Chunky Salsa Filling for Pierogi
ingredients: 1 lb sausages, any brand | 1 jar chunky salsa | amaretto or vodka, for drizzling
instructions: Preheat stove top and broiler to high. Line a cookie sheet with aluminum foil. Remove casing from sausages and slice into 3/4 inch thick slices on the diagnall surface. Place slices onto the foil lined cookie sheet. Brush both sides of sausages with saurer and drizzle with amaretto or vodka. Place under broiler until browned. Serve warm with your favourite filling recipe for patties.

title: Raspberry and Lime Soup
ingredients: 1 1/2 liters beef stock | 120 ml lime juice | 3/4 cup fresh raspberries or 3/4 cup frozen raspberries
instructions: Place the stock, lime juice, raspberries and 1 tablespoon of butter in a saucepan and bring to the boil, stirring. Reduce the heat to low, cover and simmer for 45 minutes or until the raspberries melt and the meat falls from the bones. Serve at once, garnished with additional raspberries.

Random Ingredients: serrano chilies,scotch bonnet pepper,broth,sugar,basmati rice,shrimp paste,green onion,black olive
title: Camarones De Pina
ingredients: 2 cups basmati rice | 1 1/2 cups scotch bonnet peppers or 1 1/2 cups jalapeno peppers, seeded and minced | 2 serrano chilies or 2 jalapenos, seeded and minced ( optional ) | 1/4 lb small shrimp paste | 3 tablespoons sugar | 16 ounces broth, canned | 1/2 cup chopped green onion | 2 tablespoons coarsely chopped black olives, drained
instructions: Heat broiler. In small skillet, stir scotch bonnet, chiles, and shrimp paste together. Bring mixture to boil. Stir rice, reduce heat, cover and simmer, gently undisturbed til rice is tender, about 15 minutes. Stir in green onion and black olives.

title: Kosher Appetizer's Easy Salad
ingredients: 15 pepperoncini peppers, sliced | 10 ounces iceberg lettuce, shredded | 10 ounces kalamata olives, sliced
instructions: Wash and dry lettuce. Place all ingredients in a large bowl. Toss well. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: grape tomato,buttermilk,miracle whip,chunky salsa,black mushroom,tahini paste
title: Aa's Homemade Buttermilk Dressing!!!!
ingredients: 1/2 cup buttermilk | 1/4 cup miracle whip | 2 teaspoons tahini paste | 2 teaspoons grape tomatoes ( or cherry tomatoes with jalepeno ) | 1 teaspoon black mushrooms ( button, red, or baby bellas ) | 1 dash chunky salsa, or to taste ( optional! )
instructions: In a bowl or jar with a tight fitting lid, whisk together buttermilk, miracle whip, tahini paste, grapeseed oil, mushrooms, jalepenos and black olives with a pinch of salt. Cover, and refrigerate. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,red chilies,cannellini bean,vanilla essence,taco sauce
title: Tasty Refreshing Cannellini Bean Dip
ingredients: 2 cans cannellini beans ( drained ) | 400 g canned pineapple in juice | 1 tablespoon taco sauce ( mild or hot ) | 1 tablespoon red chilies, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Place the beans, pineapple, taco sauce, chillies and vanilla essence in a blender and mix until smooth. Transfer to a serving bowl and chill for a few hours until firm. Serve with tortilla chips, fresh sliced cucumber and pita chips.

Random Ingredients: peanut,caper,tabasco sauce,vegetable broth,white wine vinegar,cream mushroom soup,soymilk,spaghetti sauce
title: Tastes so Yummo
ingredients: 2 teaspoons vegetable broth, low sodium | 1/2 cup reduced fat cream of mushroom soup | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon capers | 1 lb thin spaghetti sauce | 1/3 cup soy milk | 3/4 cup peanut, julienned and sliced | 1/4 teaspoon tabasco sauce
instructions: Preheat wok to medium, add broth and bring to a boil. Add the 1/2 cup of cream of mushroom soup, vinegar and capers. Heat for a minute or two until warm. Add the spaghetti sauce, soy milk and julienned peanut. Stir well and remove from the heat. Taste to see if you need to add more salt, pepper or seasoning. Serve in small bowls, dipping bowl underneath the noodles to keep hot. The sauce can also be frozen and reheated in a microwave to make your dinner later.

title: Frangelico Cappuccino Butter
ingredients: 1 1/2 ounces fragrant frangelico or 1 1/2 ounces other liqueur | 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt | 1/4 teaspoon fresh ground black pepper | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Place the frangelico or liqueur in a small bowl. Shake very well to combine. In a small saucepan over low heat, warm the remaining ingredients. Stir constantly for 2 to 3 minutes. Pour into small decorative martini glasses. Garnish with sprigs of cinnamon.

Random Ingredients: asparagus,fruit,king mackerel fillet,soy sauce,mustard seed,brown sugar,espresso powder
title: Equal parts of the Asparagus Mackerel
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried mixed fruit | 1/2 pound king mackerel fillets, sliced | 1 tablespoon dried mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon instant espresso powder | 1 tablespoon brown sugar | 1 tablespoon finely chopped dried mixed fruit | 1 tablespoon soy sauce
instructions: Toss the dried fruit with 1/2 teaspoon of the soy sauce, the coffee powder, brown sugar, mixed dried fruit, and finely chopped dried fruit. Spread 1 tablespoon of the olive oil over the side of each mackerel fillet. Arrange in a small, nonmetal dish, and sprinkle with remaining 1/4 teaspoon of soy sauce and a sprinkling of the sesame seed powder. Cover loosely with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Remove the plastic wrap from the dish and arrange the mackerel skewers on a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven for about 30 minutes, basting every 5 minutes as needed, until the fish flakes easily with a fork. Remove from the oven, and serve hot.

title: Strawberry-Kaffir Lime Soup
ingredients: 2 kaffir lime leaves, shredded | 2 cups diced fresh strawberries | 1 teaspoon msg ( optional ) | 1/4 cup peanut oil
instructions: Remove white and green ends from lime leaves. Place a few kaffir leaves into a bowl of cold water, and squeeze out water with your hands until they look like fresh, not dried out leaves. Rinse the kaffir leaves and squeeze again until you have about 4 tbsp. Of water from the leaves. Combine the kaffir leaves, strawberries, and msg and set aside. Heat the oil in a medium size saucepan over medium heat. When the oil is hot add about 1/2 tablespoonful of water. This will loosen the frozen bits in the pan and give it a nice, green color. Be sure to keep it moving around the oil so it doesn't burn. Pour in a bit of the soup base mixture and the juice from the kaffir leaves and then continue to stir. After about 10 minutes add the strawberry mixture to the pan, and continue to stir for about 30 seconds. If you can smell it coming to a boil, you know you have it. Turn off heat and let sit for about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: lime juice,white wine vinegar,spring onion,sun tomato oil
title: Sun-Dried Tomato Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon lime juice | 2 spring onions, chopped
instructions: Mix the tomatoes, vinegar, and lime juice together in a bowl. Toss with the onions.

title: Quick & Easy Turkey Pho
ingredients: 1 cup instant rice noodles | 1 1/2 lbs ground venison or 1 1/2 lbs ground turkey | 1/2 cup thinly sliced salami | 4 teaspoons cornstarch | 1/2 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules | 2 teaspoons cracked peppercorns | 3 cups monterey jack cheese, shredded
instructions: Prepare instant rice noodles according to package directions using the package directions, omitting salt and fat. Drain well. Meanwhile, brown ground meat. Drain the meat and add the salami, cornstarch, and bouillon over hot noodles, stirring to combine well. Sprinkle half of the cheese over noodles and toss to coat. Sprinkle the rest of the cheese over the top, then layer the noodles in a greased 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake, uncovered, at 350 for 30 minutes, or until bubbly.

title: Honey and Spice Sauté Onions
ingredients: 4 large spanish onions, halved and sliced about 1/4 inch thick | 1/2 cup honey or 1/2 cup other sweetener | 1/2 cup apple cider
instructions: In a saucepan, heat the honey and cider just until boiling, about 1 minute. Add the onions and cook over medium heat, without stirring, 5 minutes, or until onions are translucent, stirring so the onions cook evenly. Remove from heat, cover and let stand while making the syrup. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: hamburger bun,kielbasa,coriander seed,rice noodle,turkey sausage,black tea
title: Kielbasa Sandwich
ingredients: 4 teaspoons coriander seeds | 1 pound kielbasa, cut into 1/2 inch thick slices | 4 teaspoons black tea, divided | 8 hamburger buns | 4 slices crispy rice noodles | 4 slices thin sliced smoked turkey sausage, or as needed
instructions: Preheat a skillet over medium high heat. Grind the coriander seeds into pieces with a mortar and pestle or spice grinder. Mix half of the kielbasa slices, the coriander, 1 teaspoon of the black tea, pepper, half a slice of the remaining smoked sausage, and a few more drops of black tea in the skillet and place over med high heat. Cook for about 5 minutes, or until kielbasa is browned, bubbling, and crispy. Serve in the hamburger buns with crispy noodles, remaining sausages, and remaining black tea.

Random Ingredients: chili paste,yellow bell pepper,cherry,basil leaf,lima bean,olive oil,cooking spray,oregano
title: Lima Bean Salad (Pizza)
ingredients: 1 yellow sweet bell peppers or 1 orange sweet bell pepper | cooking spray | 4 -6 fresh basil leaves, chopped | 1 cup cherry, halved | 2 tablespoons lima beans ( from a can or frozen ) | 1 teaspoon chili paste ( to taste-use 1/3 ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | fresh basil leaf ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Using a small, sharp knife, cut 1/4 off the bottom of the pepper lengthwise, almost like a cone. Cut the pepper lengthwise into 1/4 in thick slices. Lay it on a lightly oiled baking sheet, with the cut side facing up. Spray with cooking spray, and bake at 350 f for about 20 minutes or until skins blister, turn, and blacken well. Remove from oven and let sit about 5 minutes. Peel off the skins, rinse, and pat dry. Place the pepper, basil, cherries and lima beans in a large bowl. Spray with cooking spray, and toss gently. Stir in the chile paste, oregano, and basil. Top with fresh basil if using.

Random Ingredients: marinara sauce,chili sauce,rice wine,eggplant,pumpkin pie spice,ginger juice
title: Spiced Roasted Vegetable Eggplant (Aubergine) Salad
ingredients: 2 large eggplants | 2 tablespoons rice wine | 1 teaspoon pumpkin pie spice | 2 -3 tablespoons chili sauce | 1 tablespoon fresh ginger juice | 1 tablespoon light sweet marinara sauce
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400f degrees. Use a large oven proof dish. Cut ends off the eggplant and remove the skin. Using a sharp knife cut the eggplants into 2cm cubes. Place them in a large bowl and add the rice wine and pumpkin pie spice. Beat until smooth. Spread the sauce on the eggplants and sprinkle over the ginger and rice mixture. Put in the oven and bake for 20 - 25 mins turning them over halfway through the cooking time. They should still be tender and tender. Serve warm with a dipping sauce.

title: Old Baked Parsnips
ingredients: 2 lbs parsnips, peeled ( i use large ones, just a few larger ones if desired ) | 2 teaspoons msg ( or to taste ) | 1 1/4 teaspoons vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325°f. Peel parsnips and cut into 4 to 6 long wedges. Bake for about 40 minutes until the skins are starting to crisp. The key is just removing the skins, not burning the parsnips in your oven. When the skins have browned, set them aside to cool and cool. Then cool and peel all the skins off the parsnips and discard the cores. Place into a large bowl. Add the rest of the ingredients. Mix well. Line a shallow baking pan with greased parchment paper. Pour mixture into the parchment paper. Bake for 2 hours, until crispy and golden. Let stand 5 minutes before attempting to dig in. Use a tooth pick to remove the parsnips and allow your guests to open up to remove the meat without breaking the skin. The parsnips can take as many pans as you want, depending on your pan size.

Random Ingredients: gherkin,ra el hanout spice mix,grain white rice,soya sauce,breadcrumb,beef chuck roast
title: Algerian-Syrian Bazella - Beef and Rice Stuffed With Herbs (Slow Cooker)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons soya sauce | 1 3/4 lbs boneless beef chuck roast, trimmed of excess fat and gristle | 1/4 cup whole grain white rice | 1/3 cup ra el hanout spice mix ( recipe id # 11470 ) | 1/4 cup breadcrumbs | all purpose gherkin
instructions: Place soy sauce and beef in crockpot and set on low for 8 to 10 hours until meat is very tender. Remove beef and discard all but 2 cups of meat juices and set aside. In medium bowl, drain liquid from crockpot and skim off any fat, then reserve. Meanwhile, using two forks, shred the meat into large pieces and place into food processor. Add the rice, ra el hanout, rice liquid, and gherkins. Pulse until well mixed, leaving about a 1/4 inch or so of meat and rice kernels. Transfer to shallow bowls, top with meat and sprinkle with gherkins and serve.

Random Ingredients: ice,chili oil,cream chicken soup,pastry flour,oyster sauce
title: Chili-Your-Sea Pie
ingredients: 5 pie crusts, baked but refrigerated ( i've found that a large can of plain flour works great in this recipe ) | 1 can cream of chicken soup, condensed | 1 cup ice | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | sweet chili oil, for topping | powdered ice, for topping ( optional )
instructions: Mix soup, oyster sauce, and chili oil until well incorporated. Pour into pie shell. Top with top crust. Pour remaining soup mixture over top of pie, spreading evenly to cover. Sprinkle with powder sugar. Bake in 350 degree f oven for 15 minutes or until top is brown and crust is light golden. Let sit about five minutes before removing from oven. Serve hot, drizzled with sweet chili oil.

Random Ingredients: oyster sauce,red bliss potato,cardamom,serrano pepper,swede,orange zest,brandy
title: Spicy Stuffed Red Bliss
ingredients: 1 cup red bliss potato, medium size, halved lengthwise | 1 cup swede, medium size, halved lengthwise | 1 orange, zest of | 3 teaspoons oyster sauce | 1 1/4 teaspoons ground cardamom | 1 tablespoon brandy | 1 tablespoon soy sauce
instructions: Preheat the broiler heat the oven to 350 degrees. Put potato and swede in a baking dish, cut side down. Grate orange zest onto potato and swede. In a small bowl, combine oyster sauce, cardamom, brandy and soy sauce. Add mixture to potato mixture. Smooth mixture and place potato on the broiler rack, skin side down so it bakes. Broil 3 minutes, turning over. Serve warm with plain steamed greens or hot green vegetables.

Random Ingredients: white breadcrumb,puff pastry,oyster sauce,cider vinegar,chili powder,wheat flour,garlic clove,prosciutto
title: Sweet and Sour Puffs
ingredients: 4 puff pastry sheets | 1/4 cup whole wheat flour | 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 2 garlic cloves, shredded | 6 slices prosciutto | 1/4 cup white breadcrumbs
instructions: Boil water in a small saucepan. Add the flour and cook for 3 mins, remove and set aside. Deglaze pan with oyster sauce. Add chilli powder, stir for 1 minute. Remove from heat. Place 2 tbsp of the flour mixture in a bowl, add the garlic and prosciutto and mix til coated, add the remaining flour mixture. Roll the puff pastry to a rectangular shape that is 3 wide. Place 2 tbsp of filling on the centre of each pastry, brush edges with water. Roll to enclose filling, brush with water and place on a lightly oiled baking tray. Cover and refrigerate for 15mins. Bake for 15 minutes at 180c/350f / gas mark 4 / 5 until brown. Serve with steamed green vegetables and hot red chili sauce.

title: Beef or Pork Kebabs (Yogurt and Sour Cherries)
ingredients: 1/4 lb stewing beef or 1/4 lb pork, cut into bite size pieces | 2 tablespoons sour cherry or 2 tablespoons apricot jam | 2/3 cup yogurt
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl. Divide among your favourite bread or veggie bowls, and serve as is. Note, this would also work as a sandwich, adding lettuce, carrots, sliced onion and hot peppers as desired.

title: Raspberry Queso Dip
ingredients: 1 cup queso fresco, crumbled | 1 cup chopped fresh raspberries or 1 cup frozen raspberries | 1 -2 tablespoon pickled jalapeno chile, chopped | cooked basmati rice
instructions: In small bowl combine queso fresco, raspberries and chilies. Spoon into serving platter. Sprinkle with additional feta cheese if desired. Serve with brown basmati rice.

title: Italian Romaine Wrapped Salad
ingredients: 1 romaine lettuce heart | 1 salami | 1/2 cup grated coconut oil
instructions: Chop or tear into bite size pieces, and store in refrigerator a 1/2 inch layer. Chop salami, and stuff with a good grind of pepper, a squirt or two of coconut oil, if you like it a little bit spicier. Heat up a frying pan, add the entire bag of romaine lettuce and salami, then place on a large warmed platter. Sprinkle the bottom with more coconut oil and a squeeze of lime. Serve and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,italian sausage link,sirloin steak,parmigiano reggiano cheese,hazelnut liqueur,radish,tarragon,soy sauce
title: Pan-Fried Italian Sausages With Hazelnut-Liqueur Grilled Skewers
ingredients: 1 lb fresh whole wheat italian sausage links or 1 lb fresh thick italian sausage, casings removed | 1 lb raw hazelnuts, shelled | 1/3 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/4 cup grated fresh tarragon | 1 tablespoon dried tarragon ( or 2 tablespoons fresh tarragon leaves chopped ) | 1 -2 tablespoon mild curry powder ( depending on your taste ) | 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 1 tablespoon minced fresh tarragon | 4 -6 radishes, washed and thinly sliced on the diagonal ( optional ) or 4 -6 shallots, with greens ( optional )
instructions: Toast hazelnuts in a dry frying pan over med high heat for 5 - 8 minutes, stirring several times, until crisp. Let cool, remove skin and discard. Cut the sausages crosswise into 2 inch cubes. In a blender container, pulse the hazelnuts with the parmigiano, minced tarragon, dried tarragon and curry powder until well mixed. Transfer to a large bowl. Add the sausage and marinate in the refrigerator, stirring once or twice, for at least 2 hours or overnight. Heat grill or broiler. Spray the skewers with spray oil. Remove sausages from the marinade and drain. Thread the meat onto the skewers and arrange on oiled grill or broiler rack 4 inches above the heat. Grill or broil for 6 - 10 minutes or until cooked through, turning and turning every 2 - 3 minutes until cooked to your taste. Sprinkle with salt and pepper, to taste.

title: Ricotta Roll-ups (For Crock Pot)
ingredients: 10 ounces ricotta cheese | 1 cup marmalade | 1 bunch fresh cilantro stems ( optional ) | 1 cup flour ( i use whole wheat )
instructions: In mixing bowl thoroughly stir together all ingredients. Using a rolling pin roll out dough until it forms a rectangle or even less. Cut into 2 inch squares. Put about a teaspoon of ricotta mixture between the squares and roll up tightly.. Place seam side down on a greased and floured cookie sheet. Bake at 375 for 20 minutes. Serve with fresh cilantro and your favorite jam enjoy.

title: Stir-Fried Spinach With Berries
ingredients: 1/4 cup low-fat buttermilk | 1 tablespoon raspberry vinegar | 1 bag frozen mixed baby spinach, defrosted
instructions: Place buttermilk, vinegar, and spinach in a blender. Cover and process until well mixed. Cook and stir a few minutes longer. If mixture is too watery, blend in 1 tbsp water or more. Serve the mixture in a bowl and garnish with raspberries.

title: Mexican Colada Pork Sausages
ingredients: 8 ounces pork sausage | 1 tablespoon lime juice | 1 teaspoon mustard powder
instructions: Grill or pan fry them until done.

title: Tuna-On-A-Dish
ingredients: 8 -12 lettuce leaves | 1/4 cup mayonnaise
instructions: Wash lettuce until water runs clear and gently toss with mayonnaise.

title: Tortilla Roasted Mexicano
ingredients: 1 can pumpkin | 1/3 cup dry sherry wine | 1 sprig fresh thyme | 4 large tortillas
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Pierce pumpkin with a fork.

title: Prick the Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin, trimmed of excess fat | 1 tablespoon malt vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 475 degrees f. Spray a baking sheet with cooking spray. Place pork on the prepared baking sheet, and rub the mustard, garlic and salt onto the pork. Let stand in the preheated oven for 30 minutes. Brush salt onto the pork and return to the oven for about 20 minutes or until meat thermometer registers 145 degrees f.

Random Ingredients: sea salt,fruit,pork,italian green bean,genoa salami,head cauliflower,ghee,barley
title: Spanish Galician Salami and Cauliflower With Barley
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ghee or 2 tablespoons butter | 1 small head cauliflower, broken into florets | 6 sea salt | 12 slices genoa salami | 1 lb lean ground pork | 1 cup barley ( i used jasmine white ) | 1/4 lb dried mixed fruit ( i used dried ) | 1 cup whole mixed-caper ( i used fresh )
instructions: Heat the ghee or butter in a large frying pan over moderate heat. Fry the cauliflower gently for 10 minutes, stirring frequently, for medium to dry vegetables. Remove the cauliflower with a slotted spoon. Sprinkle the salami with salt, shaking off any excess. Fry the salami over moderately high heat until well browned stirring constantly, for 2 minutes. Stir in the pork and fry for 4 - 5 minutes, stirring and breaking apart any lumps. Stir in the barley and increase the heat to moderately high and fry for 8 - 10 minutes, stirring and breaking up the barley. Stir in the mixed dried fruit and capers, increase the heat to moderately high and fry for 3 - 4 minutes, until the barley is crunchy and glistered. Remove the pan from the heat and stir in the cooked salami and cauliflower. Serve, at least, immediately.

title: Yogurt Homemade Cheese
ingredients: 2 cups plain low-fat yogurt | 1 1/2 cups tomato puree | 1 1/2 cups half-and-half | 1 teaspoon dried oregano
instructions: Using a strainer or strainer and a strainer, run through the yogurt a few times to get the excess liquid out. Add tomato puree and oregano. Mix thoroughly. Cover and chill. It's ready to use in about 10 - 15 days. It's also a wonderful in burritos, enchiladas, as a sandwich spread. Store the yogurt and tomato mixture in the refrigerator in the liquid type jug for about 6 hours. Garnish top of the cheese with chopped cilantro.

title: Simple Curry Powder
ingredients: 1 tablespoon curry powder | 4 tablespoons superfine sugar | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1 tablespoon celery, diced
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients together. Store in an air tight jar in the fridge.

Random Ingredients: white fish fillet,pickle,cardamom powder,cayenne,rosemary,water,dark brown sugar,chili pepper
title: Moroccan Fish
ingredients: 2 lbs white fish fillets | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne | 1/2 teaspoon dried rosemary | 2 tablespoons pickles, chopped | 1 fresh chili pepper | 3 cups water
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Arrange half of the fish in a baking dish. Combine brown sugar, cardamom, cayenne, chili pepper, pickles, and water and pour half over fish. Cover and bake until fish flakes easily with a fork, about 1 hour. Remove fish from oven, cover with foil, and let stand 15 min., then serve.

title: Gruyere Cheese Salad With Chocolates
ingredients: 1 cup gruyere | 2 tablespoons celery root, grated | 1 small roma, halved, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup half-and-half | 2 tablespoons milk chocolate, melted | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla | chopped nuts, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Stir the gruyere, celery root, and tomato in a salad bowl with half and half, milk chocolate, and vanilla until well mixed. Chill in the refrigerator for 1 or 2 hours to allow flavors to blend.

Random Ingredients: paper,sesame seed,lemon,belgian endive,plain nonfat yogurt,vodka,catfish fillet
title: Lemon Catfish (Greek Style Catfish) with Smoked Labhe
ingredients: 5 tablespoons sesame seeds | 24 ounces smoked catfish fillets, boned and skinned | 1/2 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1/2 cup fat-free yogurt or 1/2 cup nonfat sour cream | 9 leaves belgian endive, washed and dried, stems removed, gill removed | 1/3 cup vodka | 1 lemon, juice of
instructions: Sprinkle seeds over fillets on a cutting board. With a sharp knife, slice 3 diagonal slits into flesh from the center of each fillet. Fill each slit with smoked fish. Mix yogurt with yogurt mixture until blended. Fold in endive leaves. Place catfish on a greased baking sheet and pour vodka over fish. Using rubber spatula or your fingers, turn catfish over and brush with vodka mixture. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 1 hour or up to 4 hours, or refrigerate up to 3 hours. Remove bagel from refrigerator and wipe off any remaining vodka. Heat grill. Remove the catfish fillets from yogurt mixture. Brush grates with remaining vodka. Grill catfish 4 - 5 minutes per side for medium rare. Serve.

Random Ingredients: tabasco sauce,baby portabella mushroom,rotel tomato chilies,cheddar cheese,oregano,red pepper
title: Mexican Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 can rotel tomatoes & chilies | 10 baby portabella mushrooms, sliced | 1/2 cup shredded low cheddar cheese | 2 teaspoons crumbled oregano | 2 teaspoons finely chopped red peppers | 1 -2 tablespoon tabasco sauce
instructions: Heat skillet over medium heat in which you will be cooking your meat. Once skillet is heated combine all the ingredients in a large bowl and mix well. Sprinkle top with additional monterey jack cheddar cheese and/or black pepper. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: red chili sauce,chicken stock,grain mustard,colby monterey jack cheese
title: Spicy Chicken Queso Dip
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 cup chicken stock | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon chicken stock | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon whole grain mustard or 1 -1 1/2 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon sweet red chili sauce | 1 - 1 1/4 cup shredded colby-monterey jack cheese, for topping ( optional )
instructions: In a deep fryer or large saucepan, heat the chicken broth until it begins to simmer and pour into blender. Add the mustard and chili sauce, taste and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper if necessary. Pour the mixture into a medium size bowl, mix well. Cover and refrigerate if desired. Serve with tostitos, crackers, or hot, buttered crackers.

title: Japanese Onion (Sweet) Vegetable Stock
ingredients: 4 medium onions, 1 large, quartered ( or 2 small ) | 1 cup water | 1 tablespoon soy sauce or 1 tablespoon tamarind paste | pepper | 6 -8 large dried bonito flakes | lime wedge ( for garnish )
instructions: Wash onion in cold water. Drain. Cut onion crosswise into 1/4 inch slices. Place onions into a wide 2 1/2 quart saucepan and add 1/2 cup water, 1 tbslp butter or margarine, 1/2 tbspn soy sauce or tamarind paste, and 3 or 4 pinches of pepper and the dried bonito flakes. Cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Place lid in saucepan and reduce heat to low. Simmer for an hour, uncover, and simmer for an additional 1/2 hour, or until the onions are almost tender. Remove from heat and let sit in soup pot to cool. When onions are cool, place in blender or processor and puree until smooth.. Remove onion puree from blender and set aside. Pour stock into strainer to eliminate solids. Bring 2/3 cup water to a boil and add remaining 2/3 cup water or tamarind concentrate. Stir with a whisk until solids have been completely dissolved. Pour through a fine mesh strainer or cheesecloth.

title: Easy Enchiladas
ingredients: 3 cans old el paso enchilada sauce, divided | 2 cups thick & chunky salsa
instructions: In 9 x 13 pan layer about 2/3 of enchilada sauce. Top with remaining 1 cup of sauce. Layer salsa over all. Cover with foil and bake at 350 degrees for about 1 hour or until heated through. Enjoy.

title: Grilled Chicken for Two
ingredients: 2 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1/4 cup yogurt | 1/2 orange
instructions: Heat a charcoal grill and grill chicken on both sides for 12 to 15 minutes or until tender, and juices run clear. Cut into bite size pieces. While chicken is grilling, mix yogurt and orange zest together. Serve with chicken.

Random Ingredients: ginger,chinese five spice powder,rigatoni pasta,chili pepper flake
title: Char Siu Bow
ingredients: 200 g short rigatoni pasta ( or any other long pasta of your choice ) | 1/2 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1/2 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 1/2 - 3 cm piece fresh ginger, peeled and finely grated
instructions: Boil the pasta till just tender, according to packet instructions. Drain the pasta and return to the pan. Meanwhile, add the chilli flakes, five spice powder and grated ginger and combine thoroughly. Note, alternatively, you can add your own chili powder to this for a milder flavour and add a few tablespoons of water. Toss the pasta with the sauce. Serve hot, warm and plain.

title: Roast Vegetables in Peanut Oil
ingredients: 2 lbs raw peanuts or 2 lbs soybeans
instructions: Wash dry the peanuts by soaking them overnight in hot water. Wash thoroughly in hot water. Remove the skins. Place all the ingredients in a covered pot and cook slowly until all the water is absorbed. The water will continue to simmer as it thickens. The oil will be a little thin and will bubble. Scoop out excess foam as it accumulates. Season to your taste with salt.

Random Ingredients: vanilla,baking soda,white rice,tahini,mini chocolate chip,okra,red onion
title: Quick & Easy Okra Snack (Rice Snack)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups white rice or 1 1/2 cups brown rice | 1 medium red onion | 1/2 lb frozen okra, thawed | 1/3 cup tahini | 2 tablespoons vanilla | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1/2 cup mini chocolate chip
instructions: Wash your rice to get rid of the excess water. Drain well and bring to a boil with salt and water. Turn down heat a bit so the water doesn't boil over. Cover and cook for about 10 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes, until rice is a little firmer. Let cool. Dice the onion, removing as many outer leaves as possible. Slice the ends off the okra then slice lengthwise into 1/4 inch slices. Heat up 1/4 cup of tahini in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Keep on a low heat while stirring so it does not boil over. Add the diced shallots and mix. Cook until it starts to brown, stirring as necessary to prevent burning. It will only take a couple of minutes, but they will get cooked right away and will keep on the bottom. When done, turn heat off. Add diced okra. Stir until well coated and heated through. Transfer mixture to a small casserole. I use a 5 by 5 glass pan so it does not spread out. Place baking soda on a dish or dinner plate. Pour about 1/2 cup of the hot water on the baking soda and let sit for about five seconds. This is so that it can cool. It won't curdle and get a little sticky. Stir baking soda into the okra mixture. Turn off the heat. Stir in the chocolate chips. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti,agave nectar,rice paper,hamburger bun,russet potato,yellow bell pepper,dark soy sauce
title: Spaghetti Potato Noodle Roll-Ups
ingredients: 8 ounces cooked spaghetti | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1/3 cup agave nectar | 2 lbs russet potatoes, cut into 1 inch pieces | 2 yellow bell peppers, cut into thin strips | 8 inch round rice paper, soaked in warm water and cut on the diagonal into 8 squares | 4 hamburger buns, sliced into 8 pieces
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the soy sauce with half of the agave syrup and set aside. In another large bowl, combine the potatoes, half of the pepper strips and half of the matzo flakes. Add enough warm water so the potato starch mixture just covers the potato. Dip each piece of bread into water then fry in a preheated skillet until light brown. Remove from pan and slice into 1/4 inch slices. Set aside. Cook the noodles in a large pot of boiling water just until tender, but not mushy. Drain well and rinse in a colander. Fill a wide, heavy pot with water. Heat to boiling, then add the noodles. Cover and cook over low heat for 5 minutes. Uncover, sprinkle with remaining matzo flakes and continue cooking for 5 more minutes. Serve with a side of dipping sauce for dipping.

Random Ingredients: cucumber,chili garlic sauce,broiler fryer chicken,thyme sprig
title: Thai Fried Chicken (Chicken Breasts-1-2 Ww Points)
ingredients: 1 broiler-fryer chicken, about 4-12 ounces total, skin removed | 1 stalk fresh thyme sprig, leaves picked | 3 tablespoons thai basil sauce or 3 tablespoons bottled chili-garlic sauce | 1/2 small cucumber, peeled, halved lengthwise, seeded, and cut into matchsticks
instructions: Cut off excess fat. Rinse chicken thoroughly under cold running water and pat dry. Cut chicken crosswise into medallions. Place 1 chicken medallion in the centre of a work surface or cutting board and sprinkle generously with a little salt. Place 1 or 2 pickled cucumber on top and roll up chicken, securing with toothpicks if desired. Place chicken, seam side down, on a cutting board. Spread all 4 sides of the chicken with basil, chili garlic sauce, and cucumber. Fold or roll chicken jellyroll style, and slice crosswise into thin slices.

title: Pizza Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 package fully-cooked large portabella mushroom caps, drained | 1 package frozen miniature wonton wrappers, thawed | 1/2 cup shredded provolone cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven's broiler and set the oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source. Spray a baking sheet with cooking spray and place the mushroom caps into a bowl. Sprinkle the mushrooms with a little salt. Use a fork to mash the caps into chunks. Transfer the mushrooms to a bowl. Use a fingers to stuff holes all around the mushrooms with the filling. Place the wonton wrappers on a dry surface. Working with a mushroom about ¼ cup at a time, place the mushroom caps onto the wrappers. Spoon about 3 tablespoons of the provolone cheese into each mushroom, and roll the mushrooms up. Place onto the prepared baking sheet. Broil until the tops are golden brown and the bottoms are crispy, about 15 minutes.

title: A Simple, Tropical Rice Milk
ingredients: 1 cup rice milk | 2 tablespoons mango chutney
instructions: Pour the rice milk into a pan and stir until warm. Pour over the rice and mango chutney, and serve.

Random Ingredients: pickling onion,green,vegetable bouillon granule,apple juice,white vinegar,anise seed,white,shiitake mushroom
title: Diana's Pickled Noodles With Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 teaspoons vegetable bouillon granules | 1/4 cup distilled white vinegar | 1 green bag shiitake mushroom | 2 1/4 cups apple juice | 1/2 cup pickling onions | 3 1/2 teaspoons white sugar | 1/4 teaspoon anise seed
instructions: Blend onion, sugar, and aniseed in a blender until smooth. Add bouillon and vinegar. Heat until boiling. Add mushroom and cook 2 minutes. Stir frequently then remove from heat. Cool. Add syrup to taste. Cool completely. Cover and refrigerate up to 2 weeks.

Random Ingredients: pesto sauce,flap steak,gouda cheese,tamari,plain flour,bell pepper,plain biscuit cracker crumb,red curry paste
title: Roast Beef and Pepper Burgers
ingredients: 2 tablespoons plain flour | 2 teaspoons tamari or 2 teaspoons soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon red curry paste | 300 g sliced peppa cheese ( about 4 cups ) | 200 g gouda cheese | 1/2 kg patty steak | 1/4 cup pesto sauce | 1 kg plain biscuit cracker crumbs
instructions: Toss flour, tamari, curry paste and half of the peppa in a large shallow dish. Add steak and turn to coat to coat. Spread meat mixture over to marinade. Cover and set aside for at least half an hour or up to 12 hours. Heat grill grill pan on high. Brush with oil. Brush steak with oil. Cook for 6 - 8 minutes on each side or until cooked to your liking. Meanwhile, place cheese in a large casserole and set aside. Turn the grill pan on medium high heat, add remaining peppa and cook until golden. Mix pesto with remaining peppa. Toss beef and sauce in casserole, then leave to sit for 5 minutes. Serve with biscuit crumbs.

title: Yams and Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 1 lb peeled and cubed yams | 2 large baking potatoes, peeled and sliced | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1/2 cup diced raisins | 1 package frozen mexican crema ( optional ) | 6 sheets lasagna noodles, cooked and drained
instructions: Cook and stir potatoes, yams and almond extract in a large saucepan over medium high heat for about 2 minutes, stirring frequently. Stir in raisins, and cook for 5 minutes. Remove from heat, and stir in half of the crema. Preheat oven to 350°f. Arrange half of the noodles on the bottom of a casserole dish. Top with half of the potatoes and yams and continue adding the last layer. Drizzle with cream or milk, if desired. Cover the top with aluminum foil. Bake for 30 minutes, then remove foil and bake 5 - 15 minutes more.

Random Ingredients: rice wine,spinach linguine,pea,snow pea,iceberg lettuce,papaya,apple pie filling
title: Spinach Napoleanes
ingredients: 1 package frozen sweet peas, thawed | 1 package frozen chopped spinach linguine | 2 tablespoons rice wine | 1/2 cup apple pie filling | 1 cup fresh peas | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh spinach | 1 cup chopped fresh snow pea | 1 cup shredded iceberg lettuce, or to taste
instructions: Place the thawed frozen peas into a pressure cooker, and pour in the apple pie filling. Press firmly.

title: Beef and Caribbean Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 lb thinly sliced deli roast beef ( cut into 1/4 inch slices ) | 1 can coconut-flavored beans, drained | 1 can baby spinach, rinsed and patted dry | 1 can sliced chilies | 3/4 cup frozen asparagus, thawed and cut into thirds
instructions: Combine beef, coconut beans, spinach and chilies. Gently mix together in a large bowl. Serve.

title: The Best Ricotta Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups creme fraiche or 2 cups milk | 1/2 cup milk
instructions: Combine creme fraiche and condensed milk in a saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring constantly. Once it boils, remove from heat. Slowly stir in the milk. Cover and refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Chilli & Cream Panini Bites
ingredients: 1 cup hoagie roll | 2 tablespoons double sec ( or to taste ) | 1/4 cup diced red chili ( i use chipotle or jalepeno seeded instead ) | 1/3 cup chopped pancetta or 1/3 cup bacon | 2 tablespoons whiskey | 1 tablespoon chopped guacamole ( i use kraft organic shredded garlic ) | olive oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 f degrees. Prepare the panini buns by placing the hoagie rolls in a large baking pan, lightly pressing down, then brushing the top of each roll with olive oil. In a small bowl combine, red chilis, pancetta, whiskey, guacamole and mix thoroughly. Spread each roll with about 1 teaspoon of chile mixture and bake 25 minutes or until crisp and golden on top.

title: Beef Tenderloin - New Years' Style
ingredients: 1 beef tenderloin ( about 3 pounds ) | 1 bunch fresh italian parsley
instructions: Using sharp scissors, cut a lengthwise slit in the center of the tenderloin. This will prevent the butcher from cutting into the tenderloin if you do not remove the ends, just make sure the openings are removed. Cut the tenderloin crosswise into 1/4 inch slices, cutting along the surface with scissors to make a pocket. Place the slices between 2 sheets of plastic wrap and pound to 1/4 inch thickness. Trim off any excess fat or gristle. Cut the tenderloin slices in half, horizontally, making sure to completely flatten each slice. Reserve any scraps of meat for stock, if necessary. Place slices on a plate or tray, cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, but no longer than 4 hours, turning and stirring them twice daily. If your refrigerated meat may be frozen for longer than 24 hours, place the meat in a freezer safe plastic bag. Pour enough water to reach half way up the side of the bag. Place a metal steamer insert into a large pot of boiling water. Place the bag in the steamer, and place on the steamer over the boiling water. Place a steamer rack in the sink, and place a large bowl of ice into the bowl. Cover tightly with aluminum foil. Place the bag in the steamer and turn the steamer clockwise to warm through. Cover the steamer lid with a kitchen towel. When ready to serve, place a large plate over the top of the steamer and invert it. When the time is up, transfer the meat to a dinner plate. Spoon about 1 tbs of the reserved cooking liquid onto the dish, and drizzle with the parsley. Serve immediately.

title: Chinese Style Pork Belly
ingredients: 3 cups rice vinegar | 1 lb pork belly, sliced, excess fat removed | 1 egg yolk | 1 star anise | 1 slice cheese
instructions: Combine the rice vinegar and pork belly in a large skillet, bring to a boil. When the pork belly has come slghtly from the edges, reduce heat to medium. Keep stirring until the pork belly is almost completely cooked, but is not overcooked. When the meat is mostly cooked, add the egg yolk and star anise, stir thoroughly, and cook to thicken. The mixture will get runny, like scrambled eggs. Scoop mixture into a shallow bowl and top with cheese. Serve hot.

title: Crock Pot Tuscan Tuna
ingredients: 6 skinless chicken thighs ( about 1 1/2 pounds ) | 4 cans albacore tuna ( drained and crushed ) | 1 1/2 cups fine semolina ( white rice flour )
instructions: Place the chicken thighs in the bottom of the crockpot. Mix the tuna, 1 cup white rice flour, 1/2 cup plus 1/4 cup water together in a bowl and pour over the chicken thighs in the crockpot. Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours or until the chicken thighs are almost cooked through and the rice flour is fully absorbed and the meat is tender. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,broth,yeast,bay leaf,pineapple chunk,beef stew meat,parsley
title: Sweet Sour Beef Buns
ingredients: 3 lbs beef stew meat or 3 lbs boneless chuck roast | 2 quarts beef stock or 2 quarts broth | 12 ounces pineapple chunks ( drained ) | 6 ounces red wine vinegar | 3/4 teaspoon dried yeast | 3 bay leaves | 1 - 1 1/4 teaspoon dried parsley
instructions: Remove the beef from the container, leaving the pieces attached at 2 to 3 feet intervals. Cut the meat into about 1/3 inch cubes. Place the meat into a deep saucepan fitted with a metal bowl with a trivet. Pour the stock over the meat. Add the drained pineapple chunks to the stock, discarding the woody pulp. Bring to a strong simmer. Add the vinegar, dissolved yeast, bay leaves and parsley. Stir to combine. Cover tightly and cook very slowly over low heat until the liquid thickens somewhat and comes to a boil, approximately 3 to 5 hours, stirring occasionally. Taste for salt and adjust the seasoning. Ladle 1 1/2 to 2 cups or enough to make 1 1/2 cups. Cool to room temperature and freeze overnight. Reheat to just below room temperature, just as the buns will be served. Place the frozen meat into serving bowls, cover with the sauce and serve.

title: Green Tomatoes With Red Chili Cream
ingredients: 20 -24 green tomatoes, large ( or red ) | 2 red chili peppers, fresh, seeded and sliced ( or use 2 serrano chilies, seeds not thinnish ) | whipping cream
instructions: Slice tomatoes into thin rounds and place in a small shallow baking dish. Place chiles at the root end on a cutting board and slice crosswise into a cross and crosswise twice each. With a sharp knife cut each chile into thin strips. Combine chile strips and cream in a small bowl. Spoon cream over tomatoes and sprinkle with chile mixture. Serve.

Random Ingredients: red chili powder,black bean,creme fraiche,yellow squash,eggplant
title: Chilli and Black Bean Omelette
ingredients: 3/4 cup creme fraiche or 3/4 cup sour cream | 1 pinch red chili powder | 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed | 2 small eggplants, peeled and coarsely grated | 1 medium yellow squash, trimmed and grated ( or zucchini )
instructions: Heat creme fraiche in a small saucepan until reduced to 1 cup. Sprinkle in red chili powder and remove from heat. Cover and set aside to cool slightly.
