Combine beans, eggplant and squash in a food processor. Process until smooth. Scrape mixture into a small bowl. Add to bean mixture and fold through.

title: Beer Shreds
ingredients: 3 lbs coleslaw mix | 1/2 cup tequila or 1/2 cup sweet barbecue sauce | 2 tablespoons dried rosemary | 1 can of your favorite brewed tea
instructions: Mix all ingredients together making sure the coleslaw is well coated. Cover with foil, vent. Refrigerate overnight or for up to 1 week. Remove foil and bake in a 375 oven for 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,kidney bean,beef chuck shoulder pot roast,olive oil,caster sugar,shiitake mushroom
title: Beef and Shiitake Stew
ingredients: 1 -2 lb boneless beef chuck shoulder pot roast, cut into thin bite size pieces | olive oil for frying | 3 tablespoons caster sugar ( for sprinkling ) ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt ( or salt in the palmful ) | 1 can shiitake mushrooms, drained and rinsed | 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Toss meat in oil and saute until golden brown, about 10 minutes, then add sugar, garlic and salt. Stir to coat and saute until fragrant and fragrant, about 1 minute. Add mushrooms, beans and cook until heated through, about 5 minutes. Serve.

title: Colombian Cabbage Salad (Colombia)
ingredients: 1 head cabbage, shredded | picante sauce | 1 pinch saffron, crushed
instructions: Combine shredded cabbage and picante sauce in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: shell pasta,vanilla extract,tortilla chip,salad green,walnut,pine nut
title: St. Patrick's Day Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 lb small shell pasta ( i've used bowtie ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried shrimp salad greens | 1/4 cup walnuts, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons pine nuts | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 tablespoon miniature tortilla chips
instructions: Cook pasta according to instructions and cool under running water. Drain. Cook remaining salad ingredients except tortilla chips. Drain pasta. Add the drained pasta to salad. Sprinkle with the tortilla chips to serve.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,rice noodle,turmeric,corn,kosher salt,white chocolate,tabasco sauce
title: Filipino Spring Rolls for Two
ingredients: 4 ounces rice noodles | 5 tablespoons corn ( from the cob, roasted corn kernels ) | 3 1/2 ounces white chocolate, chopped | 1/2 cup green label dried sweet red peppers ( or a good quality white pepper ) | 1 teaspoon sweet dark turmeric | 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce | kosher salt, to taste
instructions: For a spicer, add a handful of rice noodles to a small saucepan of boiling water, and boil until the noodles are soft. Add the corn kernels, and cook for a minute or two, and then drain. Melt the chocolate in a bowl over very hot water. Stir until it is smooth then add to the saucepan. Bring to a boil and remove from the heat. Add sweet pepper, turmeric, and tabasco to it, to taste. Pour the mixture into separate small bowls to serve. To use the spring rolls, first dip them in the warm chocolate, and then in a plate filled with wax paper to soak the wax, and then roll into sticks like the spring roll. Repeat with the remaining spring roll and chocolate, placing each spring roll on a plate as a final touch. Serve and enjoy.

title: Garbanzo Bean Pizza
ingredients: 1 cup dried garbanzo beans | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1/2 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded ( or grated, for those less concerned about calories )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. In a bowl, combine beans and nutmeg. Spread onto a pizza peel sprinkled with some flour. Top with mozzarella and bake for 15 - 20 minutes or until hot.

title: Sweet Soup
ingredients: 1 teaspoon beef bouillon cube | 3/4 cup grapefruit ( sectioned ) | 4 -8 lettuce leaves | 1 cup ripe peach ( julienne cut off the stone ) | 1 small cubanelle pepper ( small julienne cut off white ) | 8 -10 slices dry pasta ( tri colored, i like multicolor ) ( optional )
instructions: Heat the beef bouillon cube over medium heat in a cup or small saucepan. Add the grapefruit sections and simmer for one minute. Add the lettuce leaves, peppered peaches and cubanelle peppers in a circular pattern. Cover. Cook 10 minutes until the pasta is finished. The soup should have an eerie green color. Serve with freshly grated parmesan cheese.

title: The Ospidillo
ingredients: 6 lbs stewing beef | 3 tablespoons gin | 2 1/2 teaspoons celery seed or 2 1/2 teaspoons celery, spice ( or seasonings ) | 1/4 teaspoon peppercorn | 3 cups ice | 3/4 lb velveeta cheese
instructions: Place the meat and all the seasonings in a large sealable plastic bag. Toss well and allow to marinate at least 3 hours and up to 6 hours. Remove the meat from the marinating liquid. Melt the velveeta and stir until melted. Place in a 9x13 baking dish, and bake at 250f for 3 hours. You should not be able to see the cheese through the crust.

title: Gramma Farsley Pudding
ingredients: 1 quart whole milk | 3/4 cup half-and-half | 1/4 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice ( optional )
instructions: Combine whole milk, cream, parsley flakes, and allspice in a saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring occasionally, and reduce heat to low.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,beer,red wine vinegar,rigatoni pasta,wheat flour,almond,cornmeal
title: Rigatoni With Beer and Cheese
ingredients: 10 ounces rigatoni pasta | 2 cups whole wheat flour | 3/4 cup coarsely chopped almonds | 1/2 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 12 ounces medium-strength beer | cornmeal
instructions: In a large pot of boiling water, cook rigatoni pasta until al dente. Drain, place in large bowl and toss with flour. When cool, combine with pasta. In large bowl or tupperware container with lid, mix beer, cheese, vinegar, and almonds. Toss pasta and sauce. Cover and refrigerate overnight, tossing every few hours, if possible, to develop flavor. Cook rigatoni according to package directions, drain and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: walnut,granny smith apple,fish,half,lamb stew meat,red capsicum,pearl barley,sauerkraut
title: Lamb and Sausages With Sauerkraut & Barley
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef stew meat | 1 1/2 lbs lamb stew meat | 1 1 lb halved halved gourmet sauerkraut | 2 tablespoons quick-cooking pearl barley ( or barley with a little ) | 2 -4 ounces sliced smoked fish | 1 onion, chopped ( to taste ) | 1 jar sauerkraut, drained and washed in very large bowl of water | 1 tablespoon walnuts, chopped ( to garnish )
instructions: Prepare sauerkraut according to package directions. Dice meat and set aside. Meanwhile, combine barley and sauerkraut. Soak sauerkraut in a little hot tap water. Drain barley mixture but reserve water. Cook meat in a large pot over medium high heat on top of the stove for approx 10 minute. Add browned meat. Stir to coat evenly and add saurkraut water and barley mix. Cover and reduce heat. Simmer for approximately 2 hours, or until meat is tender. If the sauerkraut is done, drain very well and add to mixture for last 30 minutes. To serve, sprinkle with chopped walnut.

title: Lemon Tea Preserves
ingredients: 2 cups wooden skewers | 2 tablespoons kitchen bouquet | 4 tablespoons lemon extract
instructions: Soak skewer in water for 5 minutes. Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend until smooth. Put the skewers on the wooden skewers and serve.

title: Rice Pilafe (Rice with Kidneys)
ingredients: 2 cups arborio rice | 1 large kaffir lime leaf
instructions: Wash the rice, and soak for half an hour. After that add the rice. Put the kaffir lime leaf and cook for about 5 minutes on high. When the pot has reached the desired consistency, serve this pilafe hot or cold.

title: Canned Italian Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 can diced italian tomatoes | 1 garlic clove, minced
instructions: Empty tomatoes, garlic and tomato pulp into crockpot. Stir and cook on high for 3 - 4 hours. Stir and cook 1 - 2 minutes. Remove garlic. Serve over hot cooked pasta.

title: Ancho Chile Paste
ingredients: 1 lb leek | 1 cup malt vinegar | 3 ounces feta | 1 tablespoon dried ancho chiles
instructions: Chop leeks and heat in a frying pan. Let dry. Mix in vinegar with a few splashes of white or red pepper. Add chiles, lower heat.

Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,red chili pepper,french green bean
title: Ethiopian Green Beans With Cardamon
ingredients: 20 ounces french style green beans | 5 -6 cardamom pods, black ones | 1 -2 dried red chili pepper
instructions: Wash and sort the green beans and remove stringy fibrous ones. Cut into 1 1/2 inch thick diagonal slices about 2 inches long and 1/4 inch wide. Place the bean pieces in a bowl with the cardomon pods, 1/2 teaspoon pepper and 1/8 teaspoon salt and toss to coat. Cover and keep in the refrigerator for at least 3 hours for the flavors to meld. Heat a wide, straight sided pan and a few tablespoons oil over medium heat. Add the bean mixture and cover. Cook for about 4 minutes. Reduce the heat to low, cover and cook for 1 more hour until beans are tender, stirring a few times. Remove all the spices from the heat and serve immediately.

title: Fennel Grilled Shrimps on Crisp Fingers
ingredients: 3 bulbs fennel ( frisee ) | 1 -2 cup of shaved cured tempeh | 1/2 cup free range clear honey ( to taste ) | 7 american cheese ( optional )
instructions: Preheat grill on low medium heat. Scoop out excess seeds from fennel bulbs. Cut fennel bulbs in half. Scoop out bulb into bowl. Place cut side down on work sheet. Put in microwave and cook on high for 1 - 2 minutes. Cut fennel into 1 - 2 inch squares. On the work tray, place 4 to 5 fennel squares. Put 1/4 cup of honey in bowl. Toss in slabs of tempeh and cheese. Pour honey over fennel. Put fennel on grill surface and place under medium heat. When fennel starts to bubble, move to cooler side of grill. Baste with honey for 5 - 10 minutes, until golden brown on outside.

title: Baby Carrots
ingredients: 2 lbs baby carrots | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 2 tablespoons chili powder
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add carrots and remove from heat. When carrots are done peel them in a large bowl with a sharp knife and put through a vegetable chopper or v slicer, you'll want to cut them in 1 inch slices. Add remaining ingredients and stir to mix well. Plate them and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: back bacon,rice noodle,red miso,rotini pasta,nutmeg,nonfat milk,cabbage,red kidney bean
title: Vegetarian Miso Soup
ingredients: 1/4 medium head cabbage, chopped ( about 1 large head ) | 1 package rice noodles | 4 cups nonfat milk | 4 slices smoked back bacon ( cooked until crisp ) | 1 -2 slice smoked back bacon | 1 can red kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 3 -4 cups cooked back bacon ( can also use pork ) | 2 -3 tablespoons red miso | freshly grated nutmeg
instructions: In a large pot, bring the 2 1/4 cups of milk to boil. Add the cabbage and stir. Lower heat a bit, add the noodles and stir. Pour in the nonfat milk, cover, and allow to cook, stirring occasionally, for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, chop the bacon into 1 inch pieces. In a frying pan, heat 1 - 2 tablespoons red miso over medium heat. When miso is hot, add the 3 - 4 small sliced bacon slices to the pan. Stir to mix, and allow the bacon to cook thoroughly. When the noodles and cabbage are tender, add 3 - 4 cups cooked red kidney beans and fresh chopped bacon. Mix well. Serve hot. Garnish with freshly grated nutmeg.

title: Tortellini Ai Echal
ingredients: 8 ounces cheese tortellini, preferably whole wheat or 8 ounces frozen cheese tortellini | 1/2 cup shiitake mushroom | leek, white parts only, thinly sliced crosswise | 1/4 cup orange zest, plus | 1 large orange, zest of 1 orange | 1 teaspoon harissa or 1 teaspoon other hot pepper sauce | 1/4 cup canned diced pimento
instructions: Place water in a large pot. Over medium heat, melt butter or margarine. Add mushrooms and leeks. Cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, about 7 minutes. Add zest, chili pepper sauce, and crab meat. Cook, stirring, for 1 minute. Add drained tortellini and pimentos. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low. Cover and cook until tortellini is tender, about 8 minutes.

title: Lemon Chicken
ingredients: 2 boneless skinless chicken thighs | 1 jar picante sauce | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon lemon zest | 1/4 - 1/2 cup queso fresco
instructions: Preheat your oven to place the cleaned chicken thighs in a 13x9 inch baking dish. Pour the jar of picante sauce on the chicken thighs. Sprinkle with zest. Bake the chicken, covered, in the oven for approx 1 hour. Uncover and bake for another 15 - 20 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through. Remove the chicken and sprinkle with queso fresco or top with mozzarella cheese as desired. Note, you can also use a crockpot liner for a casserole dish, if you prefer. Note, i tried this and it turned out great.

Random Ingredients: basil,monterey jack cheese,black bean,egg yolk,o'brien potato,broccoli floret,cream sherry
title: Broccoli Potato With Bean and Black Bean Dip
ingredients: 2 bags of frozen chopped broccoli florets | 2 cans black beans, rinsed and drained | 1 cup o'brien frozen potatoes, thawed | 1/2 cup sour cream sherry ( optional ) | 2 egg yolks | 3/4 cup grated monterey jack cheese | 1/2 teaspoon dried basil ( optional )
instructions: Place frozen broccoli in bottom of a large saucepan of boiling water, or just until crisp tender and tender, 2 to 5 minutes. Drain immediately and cool until easy to handle. Place broccoli, black beans, o'brien frozen potatoes, sour cream sherry, egg yolks, cheeses, basil, and salt and pepper in a large bowl and mix well. Chill at least 1 hour in fridge. Serve chilled.

title: Tunisian Harissa Sauce
ingredients: 2 teaspoons harissa, < a href= '' https : // /www.geniuskitchen.com/recipe/harissa-paste-135693 '' > harissa paste < /a > | 2 teaspoons single cream, or as desired
instructions: Place harissa in a small, narrow, heavy frying pan over medium high heat. Swirl to coat harissa. Heat slowly for 20 minutes. Swirl cream into harissa.

Random Ingredients: chili,fish,chili flake,garam masala,bacon dripping,ranch bean,onion powder,coconut
title: Taste of Monkfish
ingredients: 200 g fried bacon drippings ( see note ) | 3 -4 tablespoons smoked fish, shredded finely | 2 2 pints dried ranch beans or 2 pints yellow beans, prepared | 2 -4 pints dried anchovies packed in oil, drained and chopped | 2 tablespoons onion powder | 2 tablespoons fish sauce or 2 tablespoons coconut powder | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon dried chile flakes | 1 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: The best way to do this is to brown the bacon in a heavy pot and then break the cooked bacon into small pieces with a slotted spoon. Keep warm. Place the fry drippings in a wide bowl. Pour all the juices into the heated drippings, making sure to leave a clear film of dripping and not have any residue of flour or other liquid on the bottom of the bowl. Add the shredded smoked fish, and toss to distribute the flavours. Add the beans and anchovies to the bowl, mix and then add the onion powder, fish sauce or coconut powder. Mix. Add the dried chillies and garam masala. Taste and adjust seasoning before serving. Note on banana, i like this with a little bit of banana or pineapple on top.

title: Baked Pears With Pear Sauce
ingredients: 4 firm pears ( about 1 1/2 lbs ) | 1 can refrigerated fat-free topping, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Place pears on foil lined baking sheet and set aside. Combine thawed fat free topping and 1/3 of the pear jelly in a small bowl.

title: Aarsi’s Ultimate Zinfandel
ingredients: 150 ml ghee | 2 teaspoons seasoning salt
instructions: Mix salt and 1 tsp water in a small pan. Add oil and heat on low heat. Add the mixture and stir. Once mixture becomes dry and hard, remove from stove. Pour into a glass jar with tight fitting lid. Freeze for upto a week. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,cream tartar,pineapple juice,apple cider vinegar,coconut milk,plum tomato
title: Thai Sweet and Sour Fish
ingredients: 1/2 cup pineapple juice | 1/4 cup pineapple cider vinegar | 2 -3 plum tomatoes, chopped | 1/2 bell pepper, chopped ( any type, or red, or green ) | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 can coconut milk
instructions: In a small saucepan, mix the pineapple juice, vinegar, tomatoes, and bell pepper. Place over medium heat until tomatoes are almost cooked. Add cream of tartar on top and cook for about 1 to 2 minutes, till thickened. Remove from heat, stir in coconut milk until well mixed. Cool, and serve over grilled fish, your favourite salad, or rice.

title: Mexican Chicken
ingredients: 1 kg chicken thigh fillet, boned and cut into serving pieces | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1/4 cup salsa ( mild, medium or hot ) | 2 serrano peppers, seeded and chopped, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the olive oil and canola oil with a fork, turning to coat. Add the chicken and marinate at least 30 minutes. Heat the canola oil on a griddle or in a large heavy skillet over medium heat. When it's almost smoking, add the chicken to the hot oil and cook, turning once, until golden brown on both sides, about 5 minutes total. Transfer the chicken to a serving platter and keep warm. Add the serrano peppers, stirring, and saute until tender, about 5 minutes. Stir in the salsa.

Random Ingredients: ice cube,pretzel,cabbage,dark soy sauce,skor english toffee bit,olive,coffee granule
title: Coffee Pretzels With Spiced Beef and Kimchee - Starbucks Copycat
ingredients: 2 tablespoons unsweetened coffee granules | 1/4 cup dark soy sauce | 3 dashes instant korean hot coffee granules | ice cube | 1/2 lb top sirloin steak, thinly sliced | 2 cups diagonally sliced cabbage | 1/2 cup shaved mixed nuts | 2 ounces crispy pretzels, crushed
instructions: Makes 1 3/4 cup servings.

title: Spinach Tacos
ingredients: 1 teaspoon active dry yeast | 1/4 cup tequila, divided | 1 1/2 cups spinach - rinsed, dried and chopped | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro, divided | 1 bunch fresh spinach leaves | 8 cherry tomatoes, quartered | 3 fresh thyme sprigs | 1/4 cup sriracha hot sauce, or more to taste
instructions: Place yeast in a small bowl and sprinkle 1/4 cup tequila over the top and stir to dissolve yeast. Scald the spinach, drain and set aside to drain. Squeeze out excess water and set aside. Coat a large skillet with cooking spray and heat over medium heat. Stir in 1/4 cup tequila, 1/2 cup chopped spinach and the cilantro and place on top. Cook until hot and slightly wilted, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat.

Random Ingredients: bread flour,fennel,onion powder,pimiento,vanilla,ancho chile powder,green olive
title: French Toast  (Bread Machine)
ingredients: 1 cup bread flour, unbleached, unsifted | 1/4 cup onion powder | 1/4 cup pimiento, drained | 2 teaspoons dried ancho chile powder | 1/2 teaspoon fennel, powder | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla | 10 -12 green olives, drained | 12 pinches dried ancho chile powder
instructions: Place flour in a large glass bowl. Add the onion powder, pimento, ancho powder, fennel powder, vanilla and olives. Seal the bread machine. When the bread cycle ends, click on the `` bread cycle for my bread machine recipe. If necessary, add more flour. It should be a slightly thick porridge. Remove, place on a wire rack on a plate and allow to cool to room temperature, about an hour. Cut bread into cubes or slices, if desired. I like to use cubed potatoes. Store in a plastic bag on the rack.

title: Duck Roast in Amaretto With Peas and Peas (Alsatian Alsatian Shish Kabobs)
ingredients: 32 ounces lamb stew meat | 2 cans creamed peas | 2 cups maraschino cherries, pitted | 1 cup amaretto | 32 ounces duck fat or 32 ounces chicken fat
instructions: Heat oven to 300°f. Line cookie sheet with foil.

Random Ingredients: chocolate,asiago cheese,green onion,shallot,pita bread,curry powder,red cabbage,egg substitute
title: Curried Red Cabbage Bread Pockets
ingredients: 2 cups shredded red cabbage | 1/4 cup shallot, chopped | 1/4 cup chives, chopped | 2 pita breads, cut in half crosswise | 1/4 cup egg substitute ( egg beaters ) | 1/2 teaspoon curry powder ( to taste ) | 1/4 cup unsweetened chocolate, grated | 1 tablespoon asiago cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In a large bowl, combine the cabbage, shallots, chives, and pita breads. Beat egg substitute with curry powder in a small bowl, add chocolate and asiago cheese, mixing well. Fold egg mixture into cabbages and arrange on baking sheet. Spray tops with nonstick spray. Bake for 25 minutes, or until lightly golden.

title: Swiss Chard and Shell Pasta
ingredients: 2 bunches swiss chard | 1 1/2 tablespoons margarine | 1 package shell pasta
instructions: Trim ends from chard, and slit each stalk lengthwise into 1/4 inch slices. Add butter to a skillet over medium high heat, and saute chard until lightly browned,. Stir in the pasta, cover, and bring to a boil.

title: Quick and Easy Creamy Taco Seasoning Mix
ingredients: 1/4 cup fat free sour cream | 1 packet taco seasoning mix
instructions: Combine sour cream, taco seasoning and creole seasoning mix in a bowl until smooth. Refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours or until flavours develop.

title: Spiced Grilled Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/4 cup peanut butter | 4 teaspoons cornflour | 1 -8 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 2 -4 dried hot red chili peppers ( optional ) | 1 1/4 kg sirloin, thinly sliced | 1 piece bread, crusts trimmed | 4 lettuce leaves | 12 toothpicks
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in a shallow dish. Toss with beef and refrigerate several hours or overnight. Heat barbecue on high and cook beef for 3 - 4 minutes on each side or until cooked to taste. Serve with grilled side of hot grilled bread, lettuce leaves and toothpicks if desired.

Random Ingredients: beer,kalamata olive,red pepper flake,chickpea,chicken bouillon cube,cardamom powder,provolone cheese
title: Portuguese Chickpea Sandwich
ingredients: 400 g dry chickpeas, soaked overnight & drained | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 cup kalamata olive, pitted | 4 slices provolone cheese | 1/8 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1/8 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon beer
instructions: Place drained chickpeas and all other ingredients in a food processor & process until smooth, about 15 - 20 seconds. Heat the oil lightly in a small frying pan or a nonstick skillet. Fry 2 - 3 minutes or until golden brown on bottom and heated through. Place on a plate lined with paper towel to absorb any excess oil.

title: Easy Chunky Oriental Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup margarine ( can use butter, but i think it's much easier ) | 1/2 cup chinese dry rice wine ( can use dry white wine )
instructions: In a saucepan, add the margarine and rice wine. Stir constantly until the rice wine is melted and all ingredients are evenly distributed. Note, if using dry white wine, stir frequently until all ingredients are melted and all ingredients are evenly distributed. Enjoy.

title: Baked Banana Bread
ingredients: 4 thick sliced white bread | 4 firm ripe bananas, cut unto thin slices | 1/4 cup dried walnuts | 4 pieces ripe orange slices | 4 tablespoons chopped pecans | 4 tablespoons finely shredded candied orange peel | 8 -12 cups candy
instructions: Mix bread, bananas, walnuts, orange slices, and pecans with candied orange peel. Spread mixture into a 13x9 baking dish. Sprinkle with candy. Bake at 350f for 30 minutes. Cut into pieces.

title: Grape Spread
ingredients: 3 lbs grapes ( about a small bunch ) | 12 ounces cream cheese, room temperature
instructions: Chop grapes very fine or if necessary blend fine in a food processor. Beat with electric mixer, on high speed 1 - 2 minute. Add cream cheese. Cover and refrigerate for at least an hour, or up to 2 days, to let the flavors develop. Store in an airtight container at room temperature. Serve on crackers, breadsticks or as a filling for sandwiches.

title: Tunisian Meatball
ingredients: 3 pounds lean ground lamb | 5 tablespoons chopped capers | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the meat, capers, and olive oil until thoroughly mixed. Refrigerate overnight in resealable plastic bags, and roll into 1 inch balls before cooking on the stovetop.

title: Creamy Linguine with Yogurt Sauce
ingredients: 12 ounces linguine | 2 cups yogurt ( low-fat, full fat, or nonfat ) | 1/3 cup chili oil ( see note below ) | 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme sprig ( see note below ) | 1/4 cup rice wine
instructions: Boil linguine in salt water until al dente. Remove to colander to drain water. Blend yogurt, chili oil, lime juice, and oregano in a blender until smooth and creamy. Season pasta and top with yogurt sauce. Let cool to warm, 2 - 3 minutes before serving.

title: Cottage Cheese in Creme Fraiche
ingredients: 1 package cottage cheese | 2 tablespoons creme fraiche, or more to taste
instructions: Blend cottage cheese, creme fraiche, and hot pepper sauce in a blender or food processor until smooth.

Random Ingredients: carrot,bay leaf,poblano chile,dark beer,ramen noodle,coconut milk,raspberry
title: Smoky Rambutan
ingredients: 3 poblano chiles, roasted seeded and deveined | 3 tablespoons dark beer ( your choice ) | 1/4 cup coconut milk ( light or full fat ) | 1 bay leaf | 5 tablespoons grated carrots | 1/2 lb boneless skinless ramen noodles | 1/4 cup fresh raspberry ( to garnish ) or 1/4 cup thawed raspberries ( to garnish )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place the chilies, beer, coconut milk, bay leaf and carrots in a medium saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Reduce heat and simmer for 8 minutes. While the liquid simmers, cook the ramen noodles according to package directions. Drain, and set aside. Boil one cup of water. Add the noodles to the simmering liquid. Drain liquid and add the ramen noodles. Taste and add more salt if needed, then turn off heat. Pour the hot ramen stew into an 8x8 square baking dish. Place in oven and bake for 10 minutes or until bubbly. Garnish with fresh raspberry. Serve immediately.

title: Baked Cherries
ingredients: 8 large red apples | 1 small onion, sliced | 8 -10 large fresh red apple rings, chopped ( i use the amber apple )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Peel apples and cut into thin wedges. Place in an ungreased shallow casserole dish. Sprinkle onion on top of apple slices. Add apple slices and 1/2 of the dry rub. Mix apples with remaining dry rub and pour evenly over top of apple mixture. Cover and bake in oven for about 45 minutes or until apples are tender. Serve warm.

title: Ziti Almonds
ingredients: 12 ounces ziti pasta | 2 tablespoons almond butter or 2 tablespoons almond butter
instructions: Cook ziti as directed on package and drain. Combine butter and almond butter in a small saucepan. Over medium heat melt butter mixture.

title: Craisins With Apples
ingredients: 2 tart apples | 2 tablespoons oil | 300 g half-and-half
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c. Core apples and then slice into 5 mm slices. Heat oil in a skillet at the stove till it starts smoking. Dip apples in hot oil on both sides. Then fry them in medium heat. When done, sprinkle with lemon juice. Serve hot with cream or custard. Note that the apples can be placed in individual portions in a casserole lined with foil to keep them warm.

title: Jicama With Chiles and Thyme
ingredients: 1 large jicama, peeled, coarsely chopped | 3 medium pasilla peppers or 3 medium anaheim chilies, stemmed and coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons minced fresh thyme | 2 -3 tablespoons asian chili oil or 2 -3 tablespoons sesame oil
instructions: Heat a large nonstick frypan over medium high heat. Saute the chilies and thyme lightly in the oil for 2 - 3 minutes or until the chilies are tender, but still a little raw with some color. Immediately add the jicama, toss to blend, and saute 5 minutes or until almost all the liquid evaporates.. The chilies should be bright red and very hot. Serve at once.

title: Peaches and Apricots
ingredients: 16 ounces apricot jam | 12 ounces malt vinegar | 4 cups firm ripe peaches, cut into thin wedges, about 6-8 wedges total
instructions: Put apricot jam and vinegar in medium saucepan. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer over low heat, stirring frequently. Meanwhile, boil the peaches in salted water for about 8 minutes or until cooked through. Drain and cool to room temperature. Put 1 tablespoon of the jam mixture in the center of each apple wedge and dot with the remaining mixture. Wrap the apple wedges around the jam in the apple wedges.

Random Ingredients: blood orange,chicken breast,english muffin,pico de gallo
title: Grilled Chicken English Muffin Sandwich
ingredients: 1 boneless skinless chicken breast | 1 1/2 ounces chunky pico de gallo | 1 blood orange, sliced thin | 1 english muffin, split lengthwise
instructions: Place the chicken on a grill over medium heat, and cook for 1/2 a minute per side. Remove from heat and allow to sit for 5 minutes, then slice into thin strips, place on a plate, and thinly slice the top of the english muffin half. Spread half of the pico de gallo on one half of one half, and top with the chicken. Top with the other half of the pico de gallo. Cut into two halves and serve.

title: Spicy Mushrooms With Pesto & Cranberries
ingredients: 10 cremini mushrooms | 1 1/2 tablespoons pesto sauce ( homemade or store bought ) | 2 medium pinches dried red chiles ( or green if you prefer ) | 2 tablespoons fresh orange juice or 2 tablespoons white juice
instructions: Slice open mushrooms, remove stems. Slice any thick parts. Mince or blend all the above ingredients or whatever else strikes your fancy. Serve on crusty french or Italian bread or crackers. You may also use spanish pesto, garlic pesto or green pesto.

title: Shrimp & Tomato Stir Fry
ingredients: 1 teaspoon sesame paste | 8 ounces shrimp, cooked and medium size | 14 ounces no-salt-added tomato sauce
instructions: Heat sesame paste on high in a wok. Add prawns, cook for about 5 minutes, stir and cook 3 - 4 minutes. Spoon tomato sauce over shrimp and cook 1 minute. Serve immediately.

title: Persian Lentils with Coriander
ingredients: 1/2 cup lentils | 4 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: Soak lentils overnight in plenty of water. Drain and place in a pot with 4 - 4 tbsp of water, the rice vinegar and turmeric. Cover and simmer 30 minutes or until lentils are cooked but still have little crunchy texture. Turn off heat and allow to cool completely, then transfer to a bowl. Tear off a large sprig of coriander and place in a bowl of water, to serve.

Random Ingredients: caper,cilantro leaf,button mushroom,kalamata olive,adobo seasoning,part mozzarella cheese
title: Baked Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 tablespoons adobo seasoning, plus more for seasoning | 1/2 cup drained kalamata olive | 2 lbs fresh button mushrooms | 1/2 cup capers, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup loosely packed fresh cilantro leaves | 1 1/4 cups reduced-fat part-skim mozzarella cheese
instructions: To make the pesto, combine the adobo seasoning and olives in a small bowl. Remove the stems from the mushrooms, and cut about half way through their length. Remove the gills and discard, leaving the caps intact. Scoop the caps with a teaspoon, then spread the caps with about 1/3 of the pesto. Replace the caps and press the cap leaves and the garlic out of each. Toss in the cilantro and the mozzarella cheese. Pour the remaining pesto over the mushrooms, and arrange in a large casserole dish. Cover and bake at 400 degrees for 20 minutes.

title: Coconut Radish Leaf Appetizer
ingredients: 1/2 cup coconut cream, chilled in the refrigerator | 1 cup radish, chopped ( white, green, or purple )
instructions: Combine coconut cream and chopped radishes in medium bowl. Cover surface of coconut cream/radish mixture with plastic wrap, pressing plastic firmly on surface of radish mixture to soften to shape a smooth, uniform paste. Spread over top of a small piece of plastic wrap and refrigerate until serving time.

title: Fried Spring Onions
ingredients: 6 large spring onions | 1 cup cooking oil
instructions: Wash the spring onions well under cold water. Separate the layers. Cut the root sections into quarters and separate the stalks from the stem into 3 or 4 sections and separate. Do the same for the stem parts, leaving the tips intact. Separate the pieces of green and light green parts. Deep fry the onions in a deep fryer or large heavy saucepan in hot oil until they're crispy. Remove the and drain on paper towels. Serve hot.

title: Vegetable Borscht
ingredients: 16 cups red cabbage, chopped | 2 cans cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1 lb asparagus, chopped
instructions: Saute cabbage, mushrooms and asparagus in a soup pot until vegetables are soft, about 5 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Red Enchilada Rice
ingredients: 2 cups basmati rice, rinsed and drained | 1 cup reduced fat yoghurt | 1 can red enchilada sauce | 1/3 cup sliced black olives
instructions: In a saucepan, combine rice, yoghurt, and enchilada sauce. Bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer 10 to 15 minutes or until liquid has been absorbed and rice is tender. Ladle into bowls and top with olives.

Random Ingredients: cream tartar,italian breadcrumb,black pepper,broiler fryer chicken,garam masala,seasoning,olive,raspberry
title: Creamy, Crispy and Tasty Chicken
ingredients: 1 broiler-fryer chickens ( i like them whole breasts ) or 8 -10 cut up whole chickens ( i like them whole breasts ) | 1 cup olive, preferably whole, pitted | 1/4 cup sour cream or 1/4 cup greek yogurt | 1/4 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs, divided | black pepper, lots of it ( lots of it ) | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala ( more or less to your taste ) | 1 jar sliced ripe olives
instructions: Preheat your broiler on the high setting. The oven should take about 7 - 9 minutes. You want your oven to be about 4 - 5 high, so be sure to set timer to set a timer for a few minutes before you start it. Rinse and pat dry the chicken breasts. Rinse and pat dry the inside. Sprinkle all over with pepper, add a dollop of sour cream or yogurt and a generous sprinkling of italian style crumbs. Place chicken breasts either on broiler pan and bake for about 15 - 20 minutes. They will need more time than chicken breasts will take.

title: Swind

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix the cooked rice, cream cheese, eggs and graham cracker crumbs. Spread into a 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven for 90 to 120 minutes, until lightly browned and heated through.

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Heat a large skillet over medium heat. Add beef and cook until done. Pour cheese mixture over the top. Mix thawed whip topping and cream and pour over the top. Bake in preheated oven uncovered 40 minutes or until bubbly and hot and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: red leaf lettuce,beef,pistachio,red lentil,ancho chile powder

instructions: Wash chicken pieces and pat dry. Cut in half through backbone and discard skin. Dip chicken pieces in coriander seed, coating them evenly, and set aside. instructions: Whisk together all ingredients except dressing and toss with salad. Chill. Just before serving, add salad dressing.

instructions: Heat the oil in a medium skillet over medium high heat, and cook the rice, stirring often, until golden. instructions: Prepare mustard by mixing dry mustard powder with buttermilk as you would regular dry mustard powder and adding mustard to the top of each cup to make a thin dip.

instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add macaroni pasta, and cook until just tender, 8 to 10 minutes. Pour orange flower water, marsala wine, seasoned salt, and allspice into the skillet.

title: The Original Satay Recipe
ingredients: 1 cup chunky peanut butter, creamy | 1 cup sunflower oil
instructions: Put all ingredients into a bowl.

Random Ingredients: brown sugar,cream mushroom soup,sea salt,raisin,couscous,soya sauce,cucumber
title: Couscous Royale

instructions: Put all ingredients in a bowl and microwave on high for 2 - 3 minutes. Cover with cling film and let rest 15 minutes. Serve over rice with lots of crushed ice, if desired.

title: Blueberry and Hazelnut Soup

instructions: Combine hazelnuts and grated shallot, in a dry frying pan. Place on the pan of a double layer of foil. Bake at 375°f for 5 minutes, stirring once. Meanwhile, heat oven to 325°f. Remove and discard the hazelnuts from the skins, roughly chop. Place hazelnuts in the oven and roast, uncovered, for 15 minutes. Remove from oven, add the golden syrup and stir to combine. Pour into a saucepan. Add the stock and vinegar, stir to combined. Bring to the boil, reduce heat, and simmer gently for 15 minutes. Remove from heat. Strain the soup through a sieve into a bowl. Put 1 tablespoon of the hot bean paste into the soup, stir, and pour over the top. Bring back to the boil, stirring to mix. Remove from the heat and serve.

instructions: Cook pasta in boiling salted water til tender but still firm in the centre. Meanwhile, whisk flour into the sesame seeds, currants and vinegar. Drain the pasta and vegetables and add to the dry ingredients with the cider vinegar. Mix well and serve.

title: Spicy Prunes (Fried Prunes)

instructions: Cook the noodles according to package directions.

title: Shrimp With Cream
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs peeled jumbo shrimp | 3 1/4 teaspoons white wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons double cream | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom | 3 tablespoons spinach, chopped |  pam cooking spray
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Rinse shrimp in a cold, clean, well ventilated, water. Drain and set aside. In a small bowl, combine vinegar with cream and ground cardamom. Set aside. Prick shrimp well with a fork and place in a small baking dish, close together, and roast for 4 minutes. Add cream mixture and spinach. Spoon shrimp mixture into shrimp, close loosely and bake for 15 minutes or until the shrimp are done and the sauce is creamy.

title: Banana-Stuffed Fillets
ingredients: 2 firm ripe bananas | 3 tablespoons palm sugar | 1/2 cup ground peanuts, finely chopped | 2 dozen fillets
instructions: Cut rounds from bananas with a very sharp knife. Remove as many of the seeds as possible if the bananas are very juicy. With your knife held flat on the cutting board facing the knife blade, slice each round lengthwise into 4 pieces. Stir together sugar, peanuts, 2 pieces of banana, and 4 pieces of banana peel and cut a slit along the side of each piece. Stuff each fillet by stuffing the banana mixture into them, allowing space for swelling. Cover and refrigerate for 4 hours or overnight, or for 1 hour at room temperature. Arrange on a rack in a baking pan. Cover with foil and bake in a preheated 350 f. Oven for 25 minutes. Allow to stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Hot Chili Cheese Crab
ingredients: 1 can crabmeat, flaked | 1/2 cup salsa
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a microwave safe bowl. Microwave on high for 2 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Pizza Beans

instructions: Wash and sort tomatoes. They are usually sliced at about 1/4 inch width. Bring pot of water to boil and drop tomatoes into boiling water. When soft and easily falling apart, remove from water and peel skin from tomatoes.

title: Green Chile Relish
ingredients: 1 cup green chili | 1 cup mild flavored tarragon vinegar
instructions: Blend all ingredients with a blender or food processor until smooth. Cover and chill for at least one hour. Use to top salads, chicken dishes, and meat dishes.

title: White Beans and Pear
ingredients: 1 lb great northern bean | 1 small pear ( optional )
instructions: Soak the beans overnight. Wash and sort them, making sure they are big enough and not too crowded. If you use a medium size pear, cut it into 4 wedges. Place the beans in pan with water to cover by an inch or two. Cover and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer about 45 min to 1 hour, adding water if needed, until you feel the beans are cooked but the bean is still soft. Taste and correct for salt if necessary. If you have a fresh pear, peel it with a vegetable peeler and place it in a blender with 3 tbsp sugar and puree until smooth. If not using a pear, remove as much peel as possible. Serve in bowls.

Random Ingredients: coriander powder,chicken leg,chicken wing,cooking oil,celery seed,rice flour,cornstarch,bouillon cube
title: Chicken Legs With Chicken (Kuya)
ingredients: 4 chicken legs, split bone-in | 4 chicken wings, split bone-in | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 1 tablespoon rice flour | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 1 cup chicken stock or 1 cup bouillon cube | 1/2 teaspoon celery seed
instructions: Put chicken parts into a large saucepan and cover with water. Add a dash of salt and a good pinch of black pepper to the water. Bring to the boil and lower the heat. Allow to cook about 1/2 hour. Drain. Put the chicken pieces back into the pan and sprinkle with some coriander powder and cook an additional 5 minutes or until chicken is white and crispy. Add rice flour and stir. Then add cornstarch, stir and cook 1 more minute or until you got what you had stuck to your pan.. Remove from heat. Pour in oil and stock and let simmer for 10 minutes or longer. Meanwhile, crush the celery seed in a mortar with a pestle. Add to chicken cooking liquids and stir well. Turn off heat and let cool. When the chicken legs are cool, cut into pieces, and set aside. Bring the stock to the boil. Stir in some coriander powder, stir and put the chicken pieces back into the pan. Reduce heat and simmer until meat is tender. Take the chicken out of the pan and set aside. Keep warm. Add the remaining coriander and celery seeds to the chicken stock in the pan and simmer until desired consistency is achieved. Note, if using bouillon, mix 1/2 cup boiling water with the flour and stir until it becomes slightly thinner but not too thick. Then pour this into a bowl and add a bit of the chicken stock to dilute the flavor.

Beat eggs with the arrowroot paste and the chest palm pulp. Add to the beef & curry mixture and stir well. Turn heat down to minimum and put the lid on and cook for 30 minutes until mixture thickens. Serve warm.

instructions: In medium saucepan bring 2 cups water to simmer over medium high heat. Add instant espresso.

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Prepare the cabbage by removing the outer leaves. If using the smaller leaves, tear into smaller pieces as directed on the packaging. Set aside. instructions: Beat together the hot mashed potatoes throughly, about 10 times. The amount of milk in the bowl depends on how thick you want the cakes to be. title: Coconut Spiced Asafel

instructions: In a skillet, sprinkle the ground beef with salt and pepper and brown the beef. Add the jar of mexicorn, green pepper and bread. Continue cooking over fairly high heat, breaking up the pieces of bread with a wooden spoon until all of the bread is completely absorbed, about 3 minutes.

instructions: In a large bowl, mix thoroughly the rice, mushrooms, squash, garlic powder, and curry paste.

instructions: Preheat oven to 400° f. Combine brown sugar, paprika, and cotija cheese. Spray a nonstick skillet with cooking spray. instructions: Cut a slit down one side of each radish, then cut off the root, into about 8 wedges with a small, sharp knife. Cut the wedges in half. title: Easy Coriander Sushi Crusts

title: Cured Beef Stock

instructions: Insert skewers through the meat, using kitchen twine. This should make the meat come off easily. Rinse the meat thoroughly under cold water. title: Mexican Oat (Oatmeal) Snacks
ingredients: 3 cups oatmeal ( not quick or fast ) | 1/4 cup cilantro leaf, chopped | sea salt, to taste

Spray a baking sheet with a thin coating of cooking spray or line it with parchment paper. Using your hands form it into a large round, 3'' log. Cut into 12 - 16 slices. Bake on baking sheet at 350f for 10 - 15 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Green Pepper, Leek and Raisin Soup
ingredients: 2 large leeks, thoroughly washed, dried and coarsely chopped | 2/3 cup golden raisin ( sultanas ) | 8 cups thinly sliced green peppers
instructions: In a large pot of boiling, salted water, blanch the leeks for 2 minutes per side, then drain well. Add the golden raisins to the sloping hot water and remove from the heat. Drain the leeks and stir them with the green peppers into the hot stock. Cover, bring to a simmer, cook for 20 minutes. Remove the leeks to a blender and blend until smooth. Discard the garlic cloves before serving.

title: Basic Stock
ingredients: 4 cups chicken stock | 4 cups cold water
instructions: Place the cold water and the chicken stock into a large saucepan and bring to a boil. Remove the foam that rises to the top and reduce to 1 cup liquid. Remove from the fire. Strain through a fine mesh sieve into a clean pot using an upturned ladle or spoon. Pour the cooking liquid through a nylon sieve into your hand and discard the solids. Return the strained stock to the fire, pour in more cooking liquid and bring to a boil.

title: Italian Seasoning Blend
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried italian seasoning | 1 package frozen cranberries, thawed and drained
instructions: Stir together the dried Italian seasoning, dried cranberries, and seasoning mix well. If not using immediately, store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: rhubarb,salt black pepper,ginger garlic paste,pita bread,prosciutto ham,peach
title: Rhubarb Grilled Pita Bread with Peaches, Prosciutto and Fresh Ginger
ingredients: 1 1/4 pounds rhubarb, trimmed and cut into 1 inch pieces | 2 pounds thin slices peeled fresh ginger-garlic paste | salt and ground black pepper to taste | 8 slices thin sopressata ham | 4 slices thinly sliced prosciutto ham, cut into strips | 4 pita breads, cut into 1 1/2-inch wedges
instructions: Combine rhubarb, ginger garlic paste, salt, and black pepper to taste in a large slow cooker. Cook on low until rhubarb is tender and rhubarb is beginning to turn bright green, 10 to 12 hours. Add prosciutto and ham.

Random Ingredients: cider vinegar,vanilla yogurt,lime peel,bisquick,active yeast,chow mein noodle
title: Chow Mein Noodle Kugel (Mock Rice-Stove Mein Dog)
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 3/4 cups original bisquick | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 2 teaspoons grated lime peel | 2 cups sifted powdered sugar | 3 cups chow mein noodles, cooked | vanilla yogurt
instructions: Place yeast in a large bowl and let stand until foamy, about 10 minutes. Mix Bisquick, vinegar, lime peel, and 3 cups powdered sugar in a large bowl. Stir yeast mixture into flour mixture 1/2 cup at a time. Beat well after each addition, until dough is smooth and pulls away from sides of bowl. Turn dough onto a lightly floured surface and knead until smooth and elastic, about 5 minutes. Transfer dough to a lightly oiled bowl, cover, and place in a warm spot until doubled, about 1 hour. To assemble kugel, divide dough dough into 2 balls. Roll each ball into a 12 inch rope 5 inches long and 6 inches in diameter on a lightly floured surface. Repeat with rest of dough, placing each rope 7 inches apart and arranging them on a lightly greased baking sheet. Cover and let rise until puffy but not doubled, 30 to 35 minutes. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Bake kugels in the top half of the preheated oven until bottoms are lightly browned, 13 to 16 minutes. Cool on wire racks. Serve with vanilla yogurt.

Random Ingredients: white breadcrumb,cumin,wheat flour,cheddar cheese,yukon gold potato,feta cheese
title: Crispy Feta Potatoes
ingredients: 1/2 cup whole wheat flour | 1 tablespoon cumin | 1 cup old cheddar cheese, grated | 1/2 cup feta cheese, crumbled | 1 1/2 lbs yukon gold potatoes or 1 1/2 lbs brown potatoes, peeled and cubed | 2 tablespoons white breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 475f degrees. In a large bowl, combine the flour, cumin, and cheese. Drain the potatoes well, leaving some potatoes whole. Add the potatoes and bread crumbs and toss to coat. Pour mixture onto a greased cookie sheet or parchment paper. Bake until done, about 20 - 25 minutes, stirring twice in the last five minutes.

Random Ingredients: chile sauce,pea,red food coloring,brown mustard,feta cheese,spanish onion,olive
title: Feta Salad
ingredients: 1 cup frozen peas, thawed | 1 cup frozen sweet pea ( thawed ) | 1/2 of an english red onion | 5 tablespoons feta cheese | 3 teaspoons fresh chile sauce | 2 teaspoons fresh sliced olives | 1 teaspoon brown mustard | 2 drops red food coloring
instructions: Dice the onion. Cook the peas and mix in the peas, onion and remaining ingredients. Add the mustard and food coloring.

title: Apple and Jello Jell-O
ingredients: 1 package jello gelatin, softened | 1 cup buttermilk | 1 teaspoon finely grated lemon peel | 2 tablespoons apple juice | 1/4 cup grated radicchio, for garnish | 1 cup finely chopped frozen peas, thawed | 1 package frozen radicchio, thawed and sliced ( optional )
instructions: In a 9x13 inch pan coated with cooking spray, line the bottom with 1/2 of the partially baked jello. Set aside to chill. In a bowl, whisk together the buttermilk and lemon peel. Over low heat, whisk in the buttermilk mixture. Stir in the fruit juice, and continue to whisk until the mixture just begins to thicken. Do not boil. Mix in the jello.

title: Lentil Pancakes
ingredients: 1 cup split lentils | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | 1/2 cup grated asiago cheese | 3 tablespoons cooking oil, or as needed | 1 cup frozen mixed vegetables
instructions: Combine lentils and flour in a blender, and blend into a thick paste with a bit of water. Heat a pan with oil over medium heat. Dip spoon into the flour mixture to coat the base. When hot, spread 1 tablespoon of the lentil mixture on the skillet. Lentils will have a sheen, and will bubble up and brown as they cook. To flip, fold the two sides over, and then the other side. Repeat until batter is used up. Cook on top of stove until the edges are brown but the center is still slightly chewy, and place cooked pancakes over the sauce for a minute or two before serving.

Random Ingredients: grapeseed oil,ginger garlic paste,fish sauce,cashew,beef bouillon cube,saffron,malt vinegar,red chilies
title: Spicy Cashew & Cashew Nuts
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons grapeseed oil | 2 large red chilies, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon garlic paste | 1 lb ground cashews | 2 tablespoons fresh ginger-garlic paste | 2/3 cup malt vinegar | 1/2 cup fish sauce | 1 beef bouillon cube, crumbled | 1/2 teaspoon saffron, pulverized in a mortar
instructions: Heat oil in a large, preferably nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add chilies and cook, stirring, for 1 minute. Add garlic and ginger and cook, stirring, for 1 minute. Add cashews and stir for 1 minute. Stir in vinegar, fish sauce and bouillon. Cook for a minute or so. Add saffron sauce and nuts. Let mixture simmer over low heat, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Chilli and Salt Crusted Chicken Pastries

instructions: Heat oven to 200c/400°f. Lightly butter a baking tray. Roll out pastry onto a lightly floured surface until 12 x 14cm. Brush pastries with boiling water and place on baking tray in a single layer. Bake for about 15 minutes or until pastry is light golden, stirring after 5 minutes. Remove from oven and place on a wire rack to cool. When cool, use your hands to press the hot pastries together so that they stick together. Place the chilli, cardamom powder and a sprinkling of lemon or lime in a dry frying pan. Lightly toast over a medium heat for a few minutes, stirring frequently, until lightly browned. Remove from heat and allow mixture to cool slightly. Wash your hands and dry pastry, then sprinkle lightly with chilli, cardamom powder and/or lemon or lime zest, as desired. Cut pastry into 12 squares and arrange pastries on a lightly greased baking tray. Bake for 15 minutes or until slightly crisp and golden.

title: Pasta Chips

title: Homemade Corn Chips
ingredients: 1/2 cup mustard seeds | 3/4 cup whole fresh serrano chilies, minced ( can sub 3/4 teaspoon dried chilies flakes ) | 3/4 cup cornstarch | 1/2 cup coarsely ground unpeeled lard or 1/2 cup other neutral oil ( such as crisco )
instructions: Using a dry iron skillet, toast mustard seeds in hot oil until they crackle and change color, 2 - 3 minutes. Watch carefully to avoid burning. instructions: Soak bread for at least ten minutes in soy milk, then squeeze out any liquid. You may have to do this in batches if you have time if you wish. title: Moroccan Style Creamy Cinnamon Beef Shank
ingredients: 2 meaty beef shank, each about 1 in. thick ( with bones on ) | 1 tablespoon onion powder | 5 teaspoons unflavored gelatin ( the powder kind ) | 1/4 cup buttermilk | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/2 teaspoon garlic and herb seasoning ( from a jar ) | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon
instructions: Wrap the meaty shank in 2 pieces of aluminum foil and place in a microwave proof dish sprayed with cooking spray. Microwave on high for about 20 - 30 seconds, then turn off and let sit for a few mins to allow some of the excess juices to run down the sides. In a small bowl, mix together the onion powder, gelatin, buttermilk, cream of tartar, garlic and herb seasoning blend, turmeric, cinnamon and about a tsp of the jamaican spice blend. Add more spice blend if desired. Place the shank on top of the meat, then pour the marinade onto the meat. Cover with the lid and cook on high for about 5 - 7 minutes while you wait for the meat to brown. I don't wait longer then 5 - 7 minutes, depending on the thickness of the meat. It should have browned nicely and started to stick to the meat. Remove the beef shank from the microwave and serve, either as an appetizer or with bread to dip, or cut into small squares and serve with rice and/or vegetables.

Random Ingredients: green chili pepper,spanish onion,currant,fruit,anise seed,curry paste,green tomato
title: Curried Mango Nuts
ingredients: 1 small spanish onion, sliced and separated into rings | 1/4 cup currants ( raisins soaked in hot water to cover ) | 1 green tomato, sliced | 1 can chopped green chile peppers ( drained chopped peppers ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons curry paste, to taste | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 1 fresh green tomatoes, sliced crosswise ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large skillet. Bring to bubbling over medium high heat, stirring occasionally. Cover and cook 5 to 7 minutes, or until the mango mixture is heated through. Serve hot.

title: Lettuce, Prosciutto, and Green Curry on a Bed of Lettuce
ingredients: 2 -4 slices prosciutto | 1 head leaf lettuce, washed | 1 teaspoon sunflower oil ( or more, amount depends on desired thickness ) | 1 teaspoon green curry paste ( or less ) | 1/2 cup low-fat whipped topping ( or low fat whipped yogurt )
instructions: Toast the prosciutto slices with either a dry pan or griddle until it becomes crisp. Set prosciutto slices aside. Spread the sunflower oil on the lettuce leaves, then scatter over the curry paste until it is distributed throughout. Place the salad leaves on a large serving platter and surround with 3/4 cup of light whipped topping. Place 2 or 3 prosciutto slices on top of each, then drizzle over remaining light whipped topping. Enjoy. Notes, you may substitute any green curry paste for green curry paste if desired.

title: Taquito
ingredients: 24 marshmallows, finely grated | 3 -4 anchovy fillets, finely grated | 1/2 - 1 tablespoon ketjap manis ( sweet soy sauce ) | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon lime rind, finely grated ( zest is optional ) | 4 -5 tablespoons silver tequila or 4 -5 tablespoons orange-flavored tequila | 1 onion, sliced thinly
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl. Pour into 12 glass molds and seal tightly. Let stand at room temperature for up to 2 hours. Turn off oven. If using orange flavored tequila pour into 12 glasses over ice.

title: BBQ Lamb Shanks
ingredients: 2 pounds lamb, shanks | 2 cups barbeque sauce | 1 cup broth | 1 1/2 cups half-and-half | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1 teaspoon dried currants | 7 unbaked pie crusts
instructions: Preheat an oven to 375 degrees f. Prepare the lamb shanks by trimming any excess fat. Cook meat in a skillet over medium heat until browned, and pour barbeque sauce over the meat. Spread barbeque sauce over the top, and stir to melt. Mix half and half powder, onion powder, and currants together, and pour into the skillet, stirring until blended. Arrange lamb shanks in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Pour remaining barbeque sauce over the top, cover dish with aluminum foil, and place in the preheated oven. Bake in the preheated oven until meat is tender, about 1 hour. An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read about 30 minutes.

title: Sherri's Salad
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce, shredded | 1/2 purple onion, chopped | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Place all ingredients into a large bowl.

Random Ingredients: lasagna noodle,onion paste,rigatoni pasta,rotel,sea salt,iceberg lettuce
title: Vegetarian Rollatini
ingredients: 8 ounces rigatoni pasta or 8 ounces rotini pasta, cooked and drained | 3 tablespoons onion paste | 1 1/2 cups colavita or 1 1/2 cups rotel | 4 -6 leaves iceberg lettuce, thinly sliced ( can sub iceberg lettuce ) | sea salt | 5 5 slices iceberg lettuce or 5 slices iceberg lettuce
instructions: Place one large handful of noodles in the bottom of a large plastic zipper bag, pour in half the can of colavita, and half the onion paste. Shake the bag to combine the ingredients, then place the bag in a bowl. Repeat with two more handfuls of noodles, onion paste and colavita or rotel. If using a plastic bag, do not cut all the way through at the ends of the bag, so as to have an easier roll when it is assembled. Add the remaining colavita and onion paste to the bowl. Remove the plastic bag and seal the bag. Refrigerate for at least a few hours, ideally overnight. Once chilled, fold the contents of the plastic bag back into the bowl the rigatoni was cooked inches. Line a cookie sheet with foil, and lay out the bag of noodles. Carefully separate individual rolls from each other and place a spoonful of the filling in the center of each roll. Roll the tortonita tightly, and place in the pan or cookie sheet and place on the middle rack of the oven... Repeat if you need to. When the rolls are done rolling, remove the pan from the oven. Carefully take the bread or tray out of the pan and place it over the rolls. Allow to cool and the bread or tray from the inside to the outside of the rollatini. Carefully remove the lettuce leaves with a knife or spatula or spatula so they will easily open up.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder,yeast,barley,part ricotta cheese,green chili paste,arborio rice
title: Green Chili Risotto and Barley Risotto
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups hot green chili paste | 2 cups medium-grind barley | 2 1/2 lbs boneless pork shoulder, trimmed and cut into 1-1/2-inch cubes | 10 cups arborio rice | 2 tablespoons instant yeast | 3 tablespoons shredded part-skim ricotta cheese
instructions: Put 2 cups of warm water in a large pot. Put the chili paste and 3 tablespoons of the hot tap water in a small bowl, and stir well to mix. In a 5 to 6 quart pan over medium low heat, warm 2 tablespoons of the chili paste mixture to hot. Add the barley, and simmer, stirring occasionally to avoid browning, until it has all been absorbed. This should take about 25 minutes. After 25 minutes, transfer the barley to a strainer. Squeeze out as much of the remaining liquid as possible, and stir it into the hot barley. When the barley has absorbed all of the liquid, transfer it to the rice bowl. Add 20 cups of the hot salted water, and stir to combine. Cover, and let sit until the barley is cooked but tender when pierced with a fork, 30 to 40 minutes. The next day, strain and discard the barley and chili paste mixture. If you wish to use the whole bowl of chili paste, set the amount of water to the side of the pan. Dissolve the yeast in 1/2 cup of the hot tap water on the lowest heat.

Random Ingredients: snake bean,white wine,heavy whipping cream,grain rice,linguine,mint
title: Linguine With Peppered Nosedolettes and Herbs
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups uncooked wide noodles ( about 6 ounces linguine ) | 16 ounces shucked and dried dried snake beans | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/2 cup dry white wine ( preferably a good cabernet ) | 2 tablespoons snake beans | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh mint
instructions: Cook noodles in large pot of boiling salted water over medium high heat, stirring occasionally, until just tender but firm to the bite, about 7 minutes. Meanwhile, bring 5 quarts water to boil in large saucepan. Add snake beans. Boil, stirring occasionally, until beans soften, about 3 minutes. Transfer to bowl. Add cream and boil, stirring often, until mixture boils and thickens slightly, about 1 minute longer. Remove from heat. Add snake beans and 1/2 cup water to cream mixture and stir until warm. Discard bean skins. Drain linguine. Spread 1/3 cup pasta on large serving platter. Spoon bean mixture over pasta. Sprinkle with snake bean mixture and mint. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: salmon,urad dal,pineapple juice,mozzarella cheese,kale,green cabbage,peanut butter
title: Vegetable Salad - Kari
ingredients: 3/4 cup salad dal | 1 1/4 cups cold pitted pineapple juice | 1/4 cup peanut butter | 1 1/2 cups salmon, cut into bite-sized chunks | 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese | 1/2 cup shredded kale, packed | 1 tablespoon grated munster cheese ( optional )
instructions: Bring salad dal and pineapple juice to a boil in large mixing bowl. Mash until partially smooth. Stir in peanut butter until creamy. Drain salmon. Add salmon, mozzarella, and kale to salad. Add cheese if using. Toss salad to coat.

title: Chocolate Glaze(for barbecues)
ingredients: 1/2 cup powdered mustard | 4 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together. Use on bread, coffee etc.

Random Ingredients: flounder fillet,artichoke heart,pita bread,green bell pepper,mix,carrot,peanut,hot water
title: Artichoke Flatbread
ingredients: 2 pita bread | 1 cup prepared mix | 1/2 cup hot water | 3/4 lb flounder fillet, cut crosswise into 4 strips | 1/2 cup carrot, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup green bell pepper, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup artichoke heart, cut crosswise into eighths | 2 tablespoons dry roasted peanuts, coarsely chopped
instructions: Slice each pita crosswise into 5 wedges.

Random Ingredients: honeydew melon,green bean,kernel corn,tamarind paste,sausage,rose petal
title: Sweet and Hot Sausage With Tamarind and Green Beans
ingredients: 350 g sausages | 200 g tamarind paste | 200 g young green beans | 200 g young whole kernel corn | 150 g honeydew melon | 2 small rose petals
instructions: Remove hard seeds from sun dried tamarind and soak in warm water for 20 minutes. Remove husks and cut into large pieces. Put all ingredients except the corn and shrimps in a large pot with 4 cups of water. Stir to combine, making sure that all ingredients are mixed thoroughly together. Cover and bring to the boil. Turn heat off, leave for 30 minutes to allow flavours to develop. Turn into a heat proof bowl and cover. Cook in the oven until tender and the shrimp are pink. Add the shrimps to the sausages, if desired. Serve with steamed green beans or jasmine rice. Variation, substitute halibut, halibut can be used instead of salted shrimp for the sausages.

Random Ingredients: oil,filet beef,green cardamom pod,pasta,fennel bulb,sake,mandarin orange,sun tomato oil
title: Yummy Beef with Bean Pasta
ingredients: 1 1/3 lbs short pasta | 3 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 1/8 teaspoon fennel bulb, chopped | 1/8 teaspoon green cardamom pod, crushed | 1/8 cup oil | 1/2 1/2 lb filet of beef or 1/2 lb steak, cut in 1/2-3/4-inch cubes | 1/4 cup sake or 1/4 cup brown rice wine | 3 -4 mandarin oranges, rinsed and dried
instructions: Boil pasta in rapidly boiling slated water till 'al dente'. Meanwhile, heat oil in a large skillet over medium high heat until a drop of water evaporates on contact, about 1 minute. Add fennel and cardamon.

title: Easy Mexican Rice
ingredients: 2 cups fat free chicken broth | 1/2 cup uncooked long-grain rice | 2 teaspoons fresh thyme leaves | 1 jar picante sauce
instructions: Boil broth and rice in heavy medium saucepan with tight fitting lid for about five minutes. Add thyme to broth, stir well. Microwave uncovered on high for 45 seconds. Stir in picante sauce. Cover tightly and return to medium low heat until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed, approximately eight to ten minutes.

Random Ingredients: canola oil,dark brown sugar,dark soy sauce,green pea,banana,self raising flour,oil
title: Soy Fritters
ingredients: 2 cups self-raising flour | 100 g green peas, frozen | 1 teaspoon dark soy sauce | 50 g dark soy sauce | 1 teaspoon dark brown sugar | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 3 medium bananas
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl and mix to make a sticky dough. Roll level tablespoonfuls of dough out into a circle on a floured surface. Cut a slit down one side and press to join the edges. Repeat with the rest of the dough. Heat canola oil to 180c and deep fry fritters for 3 - 4 minutes until golden, remove from heat. Serve immediately.

title: Halibut Mousse
ingredients: 1/2 pint cucumber, peeled and chopped | 1 celery rib, finely chopped | 1 halibut steak, trimmed and cut into 3 portions
instructions: Place the cucumber, celery and halibut in a large bowl. Add the dressing and gently toss through. Serve with crackers.

title: Hot Tuna Steak
ingredients: 1 lb fresh tuna steaks | 1/2 madeira cake, sliced | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce
instructions: Soak the tuna in the worcestershire for 5 - 10 minutes then slice thinly. In a frying pan, heat the drained tuna. On a serving dish, place a slice of madeira cake onto a serving plate. Spoon some warmed tuna over the tuna. Serve with a side salad of choice.

title: Italian Herbed Hot Pepper Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup chopped fresh italian parsley | 1 teaspoon hot red pepper flakes
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the hot pepper flakes, italian parsley and the chopped fresh pepper.

Random Ingredients: cherry brandy,pork butt,celery,celery rib,ice cube,vegetable oil,trout,coconut
title: Scotch Street Ribs (Or Smoked)
ingredients: 2 teaspoons vegetable oil | 2 lbs lean pork butt, cut into 1-inch cubes | 10 celery ribs, thinly sliced | 2 small celery ribs, thinly sliced | ice cube | 2 tablespoons papery brandy ( can be 2 tbsp if the brandy is not sweet enough ) | 1/2 cup coconut | 4 ounces cherries or 4 ounces brandy
instructions: In a large skillet, heat oil over moderate heat. Working in batches if necessary, add pork and brown well. Transfer meat to a plate when browned, transfer to the slow cooker and set aside. Add remaining ingredients except the cherries to the skillet and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 8 to 10 hours or until meat is very tender. Meanwhile, preheat smoker. When ready to serve, remove roast from slow cooker and skim fat from surface. Remove all but about 1/2 cup drippings and discard before adding reserved juices to the mixture. Taste and adjust seasoning. Spread reserved juice on a plate and garnish with cherries. Serve meat and juices on a separate plate, top with reserved juice and serve with spiced maple syrup. Makes 2 servings.

title: Mascarpone Cheese
ingredients: 200 g mascarpone cheese
instructions: Combine your mascarpone cheese & wine vinegar in a large serving bowl. Beat with an electric mixer till light & creamy then stir in the green of your choice. Serve with crackers.

title: Dynamite® Pie
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds frozen hash browns, thawed | 3/4 cup vodka ( optional ) | 1 bottle ranch dressing mix | 1/4 cup molasses | 4 tablespoons ground walnuts | 1 teaspoon black salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Bring a pot of water to a boil. Press hash browns into the boiling water a few at a time, and cook until browned, 15 to 20 minutes. Drain on paper towels. While potatoes are still hot, stir the vodka and ranch sauce mix into the potatoes. Remove the potatoes from the syrup, and cool for at least 30 minutes. Stir in molasses, walnuts, and black salt.

title: Roasted Fried Radish With Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 cups cooked rice, chilled | 1 medium red radish, peeled, seeded and cut into wedges
instructions: Preheat oven to 425ºf. Wash, dry and cut the radish pieces into wedges, making sure that they are all visible. Place wedges in a greased baking pan. Add cold rice and drizzle with a little olive oil. Bake for 15 minutes. Turn wedges out onto a serving platter.

Random Ingredients: coffee crystal,plain yogurt,beef gravy,vanilla essence,cardamom powder,double cream,cherry pie filling
title: Easy Cardamom-Yogurt Beef Stroganoff (Serve With a Bottle of Sour Cream in a Bottle, You'll find plenty in the fridge )
ingredients: 100g plain yogurt ( whole ) | 300g beef gravy | 400 ml double cream | 1 teaspoon coffee crystals ( or instant coffee crystals, do not use liquid! ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1/2 teaspoon of ground cardamom powder | 1/2 teaspoon of ground cherries
instructions: Whisk the yogurt and 3 tbsp water in a bowl till well mixed. Add the beef, aubergines, spice essence and sugar and stir till the sugar dissolves and the beef is coated with the essence. Leave to marinade in the fridge for at least 1/2 hour or overnight. Wash your bottle, trim off the excess of air and pour the beef mixture into the bottle, sealing the contents with your hands. Chill and enjoy. Note, if using wine or sake, use the wine to keep it a little sweeter.

title: A Simple Garlic Spread
ingredients: 8 ounces fresh peppercornoncini peppers | 1 tablespoon dried parsley | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder
instructions: Slice the top off each pepper. Wrap in cheese cloth and let stand for 20 minutes. Rinse in a strainer and slip off the skins. Place in a food processor or blender and whirl for 20 seconds. Add remaining ingredients. Chill before serving.

title: Spinach and Noodle Mini-Chips
ingredients: 200 g spaghetti sauce or 200 g vermicelli, boiled in lightly salted water | 10 -12 ladyfingers, sliced horizontally, soaked in cold water | 200 g frozen spinach, thawed, well drained, squeezed dry and finely chopped | 1 -2 serrano chili, finely chopped | 3 tablespoons coarsely chopped blanched almonds ( toasted, lightly salted if you do the ) | sauce or pure essence ( optional )
instructions: Mix the spaghetti sauce or vermicelli in a bowl. Put the ladyfingers and blanched almonds on a microwave proof plate. Cover with plastic wrap, cook in the microwave for 2 minutes, then stir in the prepared spinach and serrano chilies. Mix thoroughly and keep aside for 2 minutes. Drain off the excess moisture from the noodles. Spread 1/2 of the spaghetti sauce in the center of each ladyfinger/blanched almond. Sprinkle with 1 tbsp of salt. Put 3 or 4 tablespoons of pure essence, if using, in the centre of each of the ladyfingers. Roll the ladyfingers/blanched almonds from the bottom toward the middle and keep rolling them. Place the stuffed ladyfingers into a large glass jar, pour 1 - 2 cups boiling water over the noodles and seal tightly. Repeat the process with the remaining ladyfingers. Remove the jar from the microwave and refrigerate for 3 days. Serve with warm sauce on the side. You can also eat the instant noodles on the side.

Random Ingredients: pie crust,vanilla essence,pearl barley,olive juice,gruyere cheese,catfish fillet,anchovy,ancho chile powder
title: Crispy Catfish Cakes
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive juice | 1 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder | 7 ounces catfish fillets | 2 teaspoons ground ancho chile powder | 2 1/2 tablespoons raw pearl barley | 1/2 teaspoon anchovies, finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence | 4 ounces gruyere cheese | 1/2 cup warm salted water
instructions: Place all but the gruyere into a small dry frying pan over medium heat. As soon as the oil starts smoking, add the garlic and anchovies, and cook for 15 seconds. Turn down the heat to low, and gently add the ancho and barley to the steaming liquid. Bring to the boil over medium heat. Meanwhile, rinse the catfish fillets under warm water, and pat dry with paper towels. Slide the fillets onto an oiled baking sheet, sprinkle with ancho powder and 1/2 tsp. Of ancho powder. Allow the catfish to sit for about five minutes at room temp, then carefully toast them by turning them over a few times. While they are cooking, make the pancakes by heating up the rest of ancho and ancho oils in a small fry pan over medium heat. When the ancho is just hot enough, you can remove it and set aside. Add the cheeses to the hot oil, and stir until the cheese is melted. Remove from the heat, and keep warm over a low heat with a slotted spoon. Serve the catfish cakes with the creamy porridge over the porridge and a green vegetable. These catfish cakes can also be frozen for up to 5 days.

Random Ingredients: white flour,snow pea,pearl onion,garlic clove,nonfat cream
title: Veget and Snow Pea Pies
ingredients: 150 g frozen pearl onions | 75 g snow peas, frozen | 3 tablespoons nonfat sour cream | 1 garlic clove, finely chopped | 1/2 cup white flour
instructions: Place onions and snow peas in a microwave safe bowl. Microwave on high for 2 minutes, stirring twice. Sprinkle with the nonfat sour cream and garlic, then mix well. Cook on high for 7 minutes, stirring twice. Mixture should be just slightly wilted. Let stand for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Boom Chakko (Chicken Stew With Kidney Bean)
ingredients: 4 lbs boneless skinless chicken pieces, cut in half | 2 lbs lean ground beef tenderloin | 2 lbs fresh sausage | 3 -4 green chili peppers, sliced ( hot ) | 1 can kidney beans, drained ( chick peas ) | 1 inch gingerroot, peeled grated | 1 can reduced sodium soy sauce | 1 lb fresh granola ( see note )
instructions: In a dutch oven pot brown chicken pieces until opaque and starting to brown, 3 - 5 minutes. Remove chicken and set aside. In same pot saute pork and sausage on high heat with garlic, 1 - 2 minutes, ginger root and chili peppers until well mixed, 5 minutes or until lightly browned. Add drained beans and ginger. If necessary return the meat and beans to the dutch oven to brown the meat, beans and spices. Cook an additional 5 minutes. Stir in the meat mixture, remaining soy sauce and grated white/brown sugar. Cook, stirring occasionally, on medium heat for 15, 30 minutes. Adjust seasonings.

Random Ingredients: french bean,allspice,lump crabmeat,cheese,green bell pepper,chicken stock vegetable,beef stew meat
title: Crock Pot French Beans and Crab
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat | 3 cups chicken stock or 3 cups vegetable stock | 1 1/4 lbs lump crabmeat, cooked, shelled and cleaned | 4 ounces cheese, grated | 1 green bell pepper, seeded and sliced into 4 wedges | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice | 11 ounces french-style beans
instructions: Combine the stew meat and stock and cook over high heat about 20 minutes. Stir in the crab, cheese, pepper, and allspice. Cover, reduce heat to low, and simmer 10 - 15 minutes or until the dish smells thickened, adding more stock if necessary. Stir occasionally during cooking to prevent the ingredients from sticking to the bottom of the pan. Cover, and continue cooking about 30 minutes or until the crab is tender. Taste the mixture and adjust seasoning, adding more cheese and pepper. Serve over cooked rice or pasta.

Random Ingredients: berbere,anise seed,mirin,tomato green chilies,apple juice,green chili pepper,italian seasoning
title: Mirin Jelly
ingredients: 500 g bermere ( saewato ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons anise seeds | 2 small green chili peppers, chopped | 1 can diced tomatoes and green chilies | 1 1/2 cups tomato juice | 2 tablespoons mirin | 1 tablespoon berbere, ground
instructions: Cut the bermere into cubes. Heat a large lidded saucepan over medium heat. Add anise oil. Add all the sauteed spices except green chili. Stir fry to release the flavor. Add tomatoes and chilies. Add green chili pepper. Let dry. Add water. Bring to the boil. Simmer, stirring occasionally, for 15 - 20 minutes depending on the type of bermere used, or until the water has evaporated. Add sugar if desired to taste. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: yogurt,corn tortilla chip,swiss chard,rum extract,corn,chicken broth
title: Swiss Chard with Egg and Rum Tortilla chips
ingredients: 2 tablespoons rum extract | 2 cups chopped swiss chard | 2 cups chicken broth | 1/2 cup chopped corn | 2 tablespoons corn tortilla chips, crushed | 2 tablespoons plain low-fat yogurt
instructions: Heat rum extract in a large non stick skillet over medium high heat. Add swiss chard.

Random Ingredients: gruyere cheese,jasmine rice,parmigiano reggiano cheese,pizza dough,artichoke heart
title: Artichoke Rice Pizza
ingredients: 1 cup jasmine rice | 1 jar marinated artichoke hearts, drained and coarsely chopped | 3/4 cup freshly grated gruyere cheese | 1/2 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 2 packages refrigerated pizza dough
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Prepare the pizza dough from the package directions using your hands. Spread the rice evenly onto a cookie sheet or pizza pan and spread it to the edges. Sprinkle the artichokes evenly over the rice and top with the gruyere, parmigiano reggiano and fontina cheese. Bake, sprinkled with extra parmigiano reggiano cheese in the preheated oven, until the crust is brown and bubbly and the toppings are well heated, about 20 minutes. Allow to cool for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.

title: Artichoke Heart Hoagies With Wasabi-Ginger Glaze
ingredients: 12 large artichoke hearts | 8 slices sourdough bread | 2 teaspoons wasabi paste | 2 tablespoons minced fresh gingerroot | 8 hoagie rolls, split | 1/2 cup prepared horseradish-style salsa | 1 medium tart apple
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place one artichoke heart on each slice of bread. Using the back of a spoon, press about ½ teaspoon of the alisee sauce onto each of the hearts of bread. On each artichoke heart, arrange 1/2 teaspoon of the wasabi and 1/2 teaspoon of the ginger. Place two slices of the bread beside the hearts. Place one bread slice of the apple beside the wasabi, then top with 1 tablespoon of the wasabi sauce, about a quarter of a quarter of a quarter of a quarter of a quarter of a quarter of a quarter of a quarter of a quarter of a quarter of a large apple. Close and place wasabi cheese in the center of the bread. Place the remaining bread slice of the apple beside the wasabi and remained in the center of the toasts. Place in oven for 20 minutes.

title: Santa Fe Hash Browns
ingredients: 1 medium russet potato, cut into 3/4-inch cubes | 4 ounces shredded monterey jack cheese | 1/2 cup chopped green olives | 1/2 cup unsweetened dutch-processed cocoa
instructions: Place a potato in a microwave safe bowl.

title: Spiced Yummiliciously Yum Yummilicious  That's Complete!!
ingredients: bamboo shoot, chopped | lime wedge ( to garnish ) | 2 tablespoons tahini ( sesame seed paste ) | 2 tablespoons grand marnier | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: Combine all ingredients well.

Random Ingredients: honey garlic barbecue sauce,sharp cheddar cheese,italian sausage,german chocolate
title: German Chocolate Grilled Sausages With Honey Garlic
ingredients: 8 links italian sausage, thinly sliced | 1 jar honey garlic barbecue sauce | 1 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 1 tablespoon unsalted butter, chopped
