instructions: Remove casing from cooked sausages, and discard. Place the sausages in a medium size saucepan. Stir in hot barbecue sauce and cheese. Heat over medium high heat for 3 - 4 minutes until cheese is melted. Remove from heat, cover, and let stand until cool slightly. Remove the sausage from the pan, and slice in half on the diagonal. Arrange the sliced sausage on plates, and spoon sauce over.

title: Sauerkraut and Catsup
ingredients: 1 pound sauerkraut, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup catsup | 1/2 cup chopped fresh ginger | 1 pinch paprika
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees f. Mix sauerkraut, catsup, ginger, paprika, and water together in a baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven until hot and bubbly, about 45 minutes.

title: Creamy Sweet Onion Soup
ingredients: 16 large baby onions ( about 8 oz. ) | 10 fluid ounces unsweetened coconut milk | 1 cup of hot red wine | 2 tablespoons fat | 2 teaspoons mixed whip cream | 1 teaspoon fresh thickened cream
instructions: Heat the coconut milk, red wine and the fat to a simmer in a saucepan. Cook for about about 20 - 30 minutes stirring occasionally. When it's just simmering add the whipped cream and simmer for 10 minutes. Serve with a sprinkling of chopped fresh herbs.

title: Crockette With Stout Lamb
ingredients: 16 ounces beef shoulder | 16 ounces belgian stout beer, such as guiness ( or biere blenheim ) | 1 1/2 cups monterey jack cheese, shredded
instructions: Heat the oven to 300 degrees f. Rinse the shoulder and pat dry with paper towels. Place the shoulder in a dutch oven or a roasting pan. Pour enough water into the roasting pan to reach halfway up the shoulder's side of the pan and cover tightly with aluminum foil. Cook for 90 minutes, then remove the dutch oven and place the dutch oven and a large roasting pan over medium heat. Remove the garlic. Slice the shoulder across the grain into 1/4 inch thick slices, wiping out the excess fat. Pour the stout into the cooking pan, along with the cooked roast. Using a fork, poke holes on the surface of the meat every 2 to 3 inches. Cover tightly with foil. Place in the oven and bake until the juices and meat are reduced to about 1 1/2 cups, about 1 hour. Remove the dutch oven and remove the foil. Sprinkle with cheese. Cover and cook for 15 minutes, or until the cheese is bubbly. Allow the cheese to rest 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: head cabbage,stew meat,heavy cream,mayonnaise,half cream,grain rice,pepper,green apple
title: Sweet Corn and Cabbage With Creamy Mayo Coleslaw
ingredients: 1 small head of cabbage, cored ( about 8 cups loosely packed ) | 1 green apple, peeled cored and cut into chunks | 1/3 cup mayonnaise | 1/3 cup half-and-half cream | 1/4 cup half-and-half cream | 1/4 cup heavy cream | 1 tablespoon prepared coleslaw dressing or 1 tablespoon creamy mayonnaise | pepper ( optional ) | 3 cups cooked long-grain rice
instructions: Place the cabbage and apple in a large pan with a little water. Bring to boil, then cover partially and cook 10 minutes, until just tender. Drain cabbage and apple into a sieve set over a bowl, pressing juice through a strainer. Chop cabbage, apples and cabbage, if using. Add mayonnaise, and half and half as a sauce and stir well, adding cabbage and apple until desired consistency is reached. Add coleslaw dressing and stir well. Season to taste with pepper. Divide coleslaw between four serving bowls, top with coleslaw and serve with remaining coleslaw dressing on the side. Note, coleslaw can be made a couple of days in advance. Cover and chill.

title: Crock Pot Mexican Sour Cream
ingredients: 1 cup sour cream ( light or regular ) | 1 cup catsup ( hot ) | 1/4 cup water | 1/4 cup corn syrup ( i use regular ) | 1 small jalapeno chile, chopped
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a bowl, cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight. Remove from refrigerator 30 minutes prior to serving.

title: Swiss Cheese & Apricots
ingredients: 2 lbs velveeta cheese, cubed | 1 cup thinly sliced apricot | 1 cardamom pod
instructions: Place cheese, apricots and cardamom pods in pan. Stir until cheese is completely melted. Spread on french bread and top with other ingredients. Cover tightly and bake at 300 degrees for 1 hour.

title: Ginger and Garlic Paste
ingredients: 2 inches ginger-garlic paste | 1 lb ice water
instructions: Put ginger garlic paste in pan. Add water. Boil. Let cook and stir for few minutes. The water should boil off. Add ice. Let thicken. Serve.

Random Ingredients: lentil,baking powder,pico de gallo,peanut butter,tia maria,ham
title: Crunchy Pies
ingredients: 1 cup pico de gallo | 2 tablespoons low-fat peanut butter | 4 slices ham | 1 cup lentils | 1 1/2 teaspoons baking power | 2 tablespoons tia maria
instructions: Prepare the pico de gallo first. Heat the peanut butter in a microwave or medium saucepan over medium high heat, stirring constantly. Add the pico de gallo and continue cooking, stirring often, until the mixture is slightly reduced. Remove from the heat and stir in the ham. Spread each deviled ham slice into a pico de gallo coated snack or muffin tin, and refrigerate for 30 minutes, or until hardened. Spread the baked pico de gallo onto each dessert cracker with tia maria. Top with desired toppings and serve.

Random Ingredients: chive,shiitake mushroom,banana,jasmine rice,pea pod,chipotle powder,ancho chile powder,white sugar
title: Chipotle Banana Fried Rice
ingredients: 4 cups cooked jasmine rice | 1/2 cup dried shiitake mushrooms | 1/2 cup dried banana | 8 dried ancho chile powder | 1 1/4 cups chives, chopped | 1 1/4 cups white sugar | 2 cups chipotle powder | 1 cup frozen peas and pepitas
instructions: Place rice, mushrooms, dried banana, and ancho peppers in a large saucepan. Cover, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium low, and simmer until thickened, about 30 minutes. Remove from heat. In a small saucepan, combine chives, sugar, chipotle powder, and 1/4 cup water. Cook over medium heat, stirring until sugar has dissolved, and simmer until thickened, 10 to 15 minutes. Pour warm rice into the pan. Stir to coat rice, and bring to a hard simmer. Simmer uncovered until rice forms a pudding like consistency, about 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Spread 1 cup of the pepper mixture over the rice, and stir to coat.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,polenta,beef steak,plain nonfat yogurt,lime,boston lettuce,broccoli,tonic water
title: Margarita Steak and Broccoli Wraps
ingredients: 1 lb beef flank steak | 1/2 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1/2 cup prepared polenta or 1/2 cup other grain bread crumbs | 1 tablespoon lime rind, finely chopped | 4 cups broccolini or 4 cups broccoli, cut into small florets | 4 cups torn mixed greens | 1/4 cup limes or 1/4 cup lime juice, fresh squeezed | 16 leaves red chicenery or 16 leaves boston lettuce
instructions: Slice steak diagonally in half about 3/8 inch thick. Place yogurt and next 5 ingredients in a large shallow dish.

Random Ingredients: rice,black peppercorn,thai fish sauce,cremini mushroom,pork,pepper,chicken bouillon granule,pork shoulder
title: Shanghai Fried Rice (For the Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs pork shoulder, trimmed and cut into 2-inch cubes | 1/2 lb cremini mushroom or 1/2 lb button mushroom, stemmed and cut into 3/4-inch dice | 1/2 teaspoon cracked black peppercorns | 4 cups cold cooked rice | 1 3/4 teaspoons bouillon granules | 1 1/2 tablespoons thai fish sauce | 1/4 cup thai hot pepper sauce or 1/4 cup sriracha hot pepper sauce ( to taste ) | 2 -3 teaspoons chicken bouillon granules
instructions: In a medium bowl combine the pork, mushrooms, peppercorns and half a teaspoon of salt. Place the pork and vegetable mixture in the bottom of the slow cooker. Mix well. Put the rice on top of the vegetables. In another bowl combine the bouillon, fish sauce and chili sauce or sriracha. Stir with a fork and pour over the pork mixture. Cover and cook on high for 5 - 6 hours until the meat is cooked. Stir after 3 hours if needed. Remove the meat from the slow cooker using a slotted spoon and put aside to cool until cool enough to handle. Slice or shred the meat across the grain. For a crisper rice, stir in the bouillon. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: italian salad dressing,grain white rice,vegetable,broccoli,white bread,marshmallow
title: Robyn's Special Fried Rice
ingredients: 2 bags white bread | 1 package frozen mixed vegetables | 1 box frozen broccoli, cut into florets | 1 bag frozen mixed vegetables | 3 cups cooked rice | 3 cups italian salad dressing | 1 package miniature marshmallows
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Place the bread onto a baking sheet and toast in the preheated oven until golden brown and crispy, about 10 minutes. Set the bread aside. Cut the remaining bread into cubes, and set aside. Boil the vegetables and broccoli in water with a lid until barely tender, about 3 to 5 minutes. While the vegetables are cooking, bring the italian salad dressing to a boil in a large skillet or wok. Stir in the cooked rice and then drizzle the salad dressing over the rice and vegetables.

title: Filipino Caramelized Veal
ingredients: 1/2 cup vegetable broth | 1/2 cup marinara sauce ( made from canned tomato puree ) | 2 ounces cotija cheese, crumbled | 2 teaspoons superfine sugar | 2 scallions, thinly sliced | 4 ounces thinly sliced deli veal, cut crosswise into thin slices
instructions: Prepare the marinara sauce by heating the vegetable broth in a small saucepan over medium high heat. When hot, add the cotija cheese, stir until melted into the melted cheese, then stir in the superfine sugar until combined. Keep warm until ready to serve. Arrange the scallions on a plate. Place the marinara sauce in a bowl, mix in the veal and pour 1/4 cup of hot broth over the veal. Stir until the veal is coated. Serve hot with hot, cooked, and refrigerated patties.

title: Moroccan Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 3 lbs chicken legs, skin on | 2 red chilies, deseeded and finely sliced | 2 bunches swiss chard, thick stalks finely sliced | 4 tablespoons grated cheese | 6 ounces couscous ( to serve ) | 1 ounce gruyere cheese, shaved
instructions: Boil stock in a large saucepan until it starts to thicken into a broth. Remove stock from the heat and allow to stand for 5 minutes. Rinse chicken with cold water, pat dry and cut into 2 by 12 pieces. Place into a bowl with the chillies, swiss chard stalks, cheese and one third of the couscous and half of the stock. Toss until a nice paste has been formed. Arrange chicken pieces on top of the couscous and pour remaining stock over them. Cover with clean cloth and leave in a warm place for 20 minutes. Preheat the oven to 400°f. Place remaining couscous and remaining stock in a medium ovenproof dish. Cover with foil and bake for 10 minutes. Remove foil and sprinkle with cheese. Place under the grill for 3 - 5 minutes until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: watermelon,purpose flour,napa cabbage,jumbo shrimp,serrano pepper,chipotle chile,sage,meringue
title: Jamaican Shrimp Crepes With Fresh Veggies
ingredients: 1 package meringues or ( 3 ounce ) package frozen crepes, thawed per package directions, heated, at room temp | 1 lb ripe jumbo shrimp, shelled & deveined, tails left on | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour, divided | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour, divided | 3/4 cup finely chopped napa cabbage | 1 cup watermelon, diced into 1/2-inch cubes | 1 cup shredded napa cabbage | 2 medium serrano peppers, thinly sliced | 1/2 teaspoon finely chopped fresh sage
instructions: Brush crepe halves with a thin coating of oil.

title: Rigatoni Con Salvia E Salvia (Ricard in Pastry)
ingredients: 5 cups ricard ( you can use canned as well ) | 12 ounces penne rigatoni or 12 ounces fettuccine pasta | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram
instructions: If using fresh pasta, bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Meanwhile, combine ricard and marjoram with cold water to dissolve the marjoram. Remove from heat and drain. When the pasta is cooked to your liking, drain the spaghetti and return it to the pot. Add the cooked ricard/marjoram mixture and toss to warm through. Serve warm.

title: Char Chardonnay and Herbs
ingredients: 1 liter chardonnay wine, chilled | fresh thyme sprig
instructions: If you want to make these ahead of time, the chilled chardonnay is optional if you have bought it. It helps to get your hands in there with plenty of resistance paper and a sharp knife. If you have the time, refrigerate the chilled chardonnay for at least a couple of hours and up to overnight. Otherwise, you may use the chilled chilled wine a day ahead. When ready to use, remove the thyme sprigs before using. Be certain to rinse the bottle of chardonnay off well before using. Use an 8 cup capacity pitcher or a pitcher filled with ice and wine. For a more robust brew, add a splash of apple juice to the chilled beer before adding the rest of the beer. If you have a large empty bottle, fill it about 11/2 full. To make a thinner beer, pour the beer through a fine mesh sieve into a small pitcher. Fill with ice and serve. You may need to add more beer if the beverage is to thickened, but not too thin.

Random Ingredients: mayonnaise,mustard powder,bicarbonate soda,butterscotch pudding mix,snap pea,italian tomato
title: Italian Baked Butterscotch Snap Peas
ingredients: 250 g butterscotch pudding mix | 125 g italian tomatoes ( diced, add 1/2 tbsp extra ) | 100 g snap peas ( fresh or frozen cut into thirds or thirds ) | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda ( ensure gluten free ) | 1/2 cup mayonnaise
instructions: Add all butterscotch to a pan, boil for 2 - 3 minutes. Add the snap peas to the pan with the dressing and stir until they are well coated in the shake. Spread in a single layer on an oven tray lined with baking paper. Bake in the preheated oven for 35 - 40 minutes or until crisp and brown. Serve warm with a green salad.

title: Homemade Hot Chocolate
ingredients: 1 lb unsweetened chocolate-covered hot chiles | spice
instructions: Pre heat oven to 325°f line a 4 quart baking dish with waxed paper, allowing the waxed paper to hang over the sides of the pan. With wet hands, break up the chilies into chunks roughly 3 - 6 inches long and 3 inches wide. Sprinkle the broken up chilies into the baking dish and add the rest of the spice. Smooth top of the chocolate with the back of the spoon. Leave a 2 inch gap at both ends. Place baking dish in heated oven and bake at 325°f for about 20 - 25 minutes. Once the top is bubbly and is starting to turn a darker amber color, remove from oven and immediately run the baking dish under a cold tap to remove the chocolate from the oven. Allow to cool completely. Store in an airtight container.

title: Spiced Flounder With Mango Chutney
ingredients: 1 -2 lb flounder fillet, about 3 1/2 lb | 1 1/2 teaspoons dry mango chutney | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1/2 cup non-fat milk
instructions: Rinse fish under cold running water. Pat dry with paper towel, place in a non metal dish and sprinkle with 1 teaspoons dry mango chutney. Sprinkle with cardamom. Pour enough milk over fish to cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours and up to overnight. Remove fish and discard milk and discard milk. Sprinkle remaining 1 teaspoon dry mango chutney over fish and turn to coat. Arrange fish on a broiler tray. Broil, uncovered, in a 400°f oven, broiling 4 to 5 minutes to cook the fish. Or just grill until cooked, turning once. Fish can be marinated for up to 2 hours in the refrigerator. Bring to room temperature before serving.

title: Red Cabbage
ingredients: 1/2 cup finely shredded red cabbage | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: Place cabbage in a skillet with 1/2 teaspoon of ground cardamom. Cover and sautee until just lightly golden, 5 - 10 minutes. Meanwhile, pour remaining 1/2 cup red cabbage into a medium bowl and sprinkle with the remaining 1/2 teaspoon of ground cardamom.

Random Ingredients: coriander seed,picante sauce,egg yolk,allspice berry,steak,italian cheese,corn,pork shoulder
title: Spicy Picante Pork
ingredients: 4 pounds boneless sirloin, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 pound pork shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1/2 teaspoon coriander seeds | 1/4 teaspoon crushed allspice berries | 1 jar picante sauce | 2 tablespoons corn, drained | 4 ounces italian cheese blend, cubed
instructions: Preheat an oven to 375 degrees f. Combine the sirloin, pork, coriander seeds, allspice berries, and picante sauce in a large bowl. Cover, and refrigerate overnight, stirring occasionally. Place the corn in a separate large bowl, then cover, and set over a medium bowl. Drain the pork well before shredding. Stir the corn into the meat mixture to make a sauce. Spread half the cheese cubes in a 9x13 inch baking dish, and top with half the meat sauce. Sprinkle with the remaining cheese. Bake in the preheated oven until the cheese is bubbly and the dish is dark brown, about 30 minutes.

title: Filipino Kamatis (Paprika)
ingredients: 2 cups soya sauce | 1 -2 frank red hot sauce, such as sriracha
instructions: Wash both sides of each kamati until the water boils in it, then place one kamati on a plate or in a wide, shallow baking dish large enough to accommodate two to four inches in depth. Turn the kamati over a few times while it is being heated, until both sides are evenly puffed. Transfer kamati to a serving dish, pour enough soya sauce over it to completely cover and sprinkle with the sriracha as much as you like. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: margarine,parmigiano reggiano cheese,red wine,grain white rice
title: Rice With Red Wine (Risi E Bisi)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons margarine | 2 tablespoons uncooked long-grain white rice ( arborio will work as well ) | 4 cups dry red wine ( i would also recommend white cotes du rhone ) | parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Melt margarine in a large heavy skillet over medium heat.

title: Chinese Meat-Filled Pork Ribs
ingredients: 1 beef bouillon cube | 1/2 lb pork ribs | 1/2 egg yolk
instructions: Place the beef bouillon cube, pork ribs, and raw egg yolk in a saucepan and cover with water. Bring the water to a boil, then reduce the heat to simmer. Cook until the pork is cooked to your liking, about 10 minutes. Place pork ribs onto a sheet pan, cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate until serving time.

title: Wild Rice With Snow Peas & Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 cup wild rice, uncooked | 1 1/2 cups canned stewed tomatoes, drained | 2 cooked deliscent fresh seafood, peeled & deveined | 1 cup canned mushroom, drained | 1/4 cup frozen peas | 1 tablespoon olive, drained | 1 teaspoon honeydew melon or 1 teaspoon other fruit salad seasoning
instructions: Cook the wild rice according to directions on the package, omitting oil, drain & rinse the wild rice for several minutes, drain again, place all the ingredients through a strainer & stir until well mixed. Microwave on high for three minutes before serving.

title: Roasted Green Chili Peppers With Raisins, Poblanos and Preserved Lemon Peel
ingredients: 1 poblano pepper, halved, seeded | 6 -8 tablespoons raisins | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon peel, peeled and finely julienne
instructions: Spray inside of a heavy nonstick skillet with a coating of nonstick spray. Line bottom of skillet with poblano pepper halves and loosely pack with a tight fitting lid. Pierce pepper skins with a sharp knife in a couple of places. Sprinkle pepper with raisins. Sprinkle with lemon peel. Roast in preheated moderately hot oven about 35 minutes or until peppers are crisp and tender.

title: Easy Shrimp and Cheese Soup with a Mascarpone Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup raw shrimp, peeled | 1/2 lb ground beef | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 4 tablespoons mascarpone cheese | 1/4 cup reduced-sodium chicken broth | 4 tablespoons mascarpone cheese | 1/4 cup low sodium chicken broth
instructions: In a medium saucepan, heat the first 7 ingredients over medium heat. Cook, stirring frequently, 4 minutes or until shrimp is opaque. Add 3 tbsp mascarpone cheese and stir well. Pour in the chicken broth, and stir well to blend. Remove from heat, let stand 10 minutes. Serve in soup bowls with pita or crusty bread for dipping.

title: Gordita's Spicy Pasta Sauce (Lite)
ingredients: 20 ounces pasta ( your choice, i prefer bow-tie ) | 3/4 cup hot sauce | 2 tablespoons lemon rind, finely grated
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling salted water, then drain. Meanwhile, heat sauce in saucepan. Stir in salt and pepper, lemon rind, and hot sauce.

Random Ingredients: vegetable shortening,vegetable oil cooking spray,baby carrot
title: Simple Irish Carrots
ingredients: vegetable shortening | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 lb baby carrots, cut into 1/2 inch slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 and place parchment paper or a baking sheet into oven to warm for 10 minutes. Place carrots and shortening into colander over a bowl. Dump carrots and shortening into a deep, cold skillet. Cook over high heat, moving carrots with a wooden spoon and shaking off excess moisture with the spatula, until slightly crisped, 2 to 7 minutes.

title: Easy Yoghurt Cheese Pasties
ingredients: 2 sheets ready rolled puff pastry ( i like this for plain cookies for this recipe ) | 1 cup natural yoghurt ( i use 1/4 & 1/3 yoghurt & 1/4 tbsp parmesan cheese combined ) | 1/3 cup freshly chopped parsley ( optional ) | 1/3 cup freshly grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Line baking tray with baking paper. Using one pastry sheet at a time, cut each sheet in to four triangles. Mix together yoghurt & parmesan and spread over the pastry triangles. Sprinkle the top of each pasty with parsley, pressing it into the triangles. Bake pasties for approx 15 mins, or until golden and bubbling. Allow to cool.

title: Grilled Tarragon Lamb or Chicken
ingredients: 1/4 cup dill | 1/4 cup parsley | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili paste ( or more, or to taste ) | 1 1/2 lbs leg of lamb | 1 fennel bulb, fennel bulb, outer leaves removed ( or 1 small bunch of the bulb )
instructions: Cut out the thick bottom part of the fennel and discard. Score the skin of the fennel bulb vertically at 1/4 inch intervals and trim the stalk. Cut away as much of the feathery, green outer leaves as possible. Set aside. Grill the fennel bulb over low coals or over medium high coals. Grill the fennel, cut sides down, until soft and slightly charred, 10 to 15 minutes. Use a slotted spoon to transfer to a bowl and let cool off, if covered. Wash fennel and trim off any dark spots. Remove ribs and fat from outside of lamb. Cut lamb into 1 cubes, then rub with paste. Reserve. Wash fennel bulb and fennel leaves and rinse under cold water and dry with a towel. Set aside. Grill the lamb cubes over medium heat until browned and cooked through.. Transfer to serving platter. Slice fennel bulb and fennel slices evenly and place around meat and on platter. Dice onions and place around meat and around meat and around fennel.

title: The Best Stock (Szechuan Version)
ingredients: 32 cups chicken stock, or as needed | 3/4 cup finely chopped fresh ginger root | 1/4 cup tabasco jalapeno sauce, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Combine chicken stock, ginger, and tabasco jalapeno sauce in a large heavy skillet. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat, and simmer for 20 minutes, or until ginger is very tender.

title: Creme Fraiche
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs pork shoulder, cut into 2 inch chunks | 1 cup heavy cream | 1/3 cup pine nuts, toasted | 3 tablespoons minced fresh oregano ( or 1 teaspoon dried ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme
instructions: Mix the cream and the nuts in a large skillet over medium heat. When the cream begins to boil, stir in the oregano and thyme. Dry the pork in a clean dish towel if needed. Remove the pork pieces from the cream. Spread the cream over the pork, coating them to taste. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 1 hour, basting occasionally.

title: Irish Corn and Sultana Meatloaf
ingredients: 500 g corned beef chuck | 500 g frozen mixed corn | 2 teaspoons sultanas | 1/2 loaf country bread or 1/2 loaf sandwich bread
instructions: Place corned beef chuck in a large pan with the corn, sultanas and bread. Make sure to sprinkle the bread evenly over the top. Place over a low heat and cook for 6 - 8 hours on the grill.

Random Ingredients: celery rib,taco seasoning mix,eggplant,catsup,white wine vinegar,oil,fennel seed
title: Fennel Seed (Aubergine)-Rubbed Eggplant
ingredients: 1 small eggplant, cut in 1/4 inch slices | 3 tablespoons oil ( i've used corn oil ) | 3/4 teaspoon fennel seed | 2 1/4 ounces fat free catsup | 1 1/2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 8 teaspoons taco seasoning mix | 1 teaspoon celery ribs, finely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place eggplant slices on baking sheet. Cook 7 - 8 minutes per side until just barely barely cooked. Drizzle with more oil and sprinkle with the fennel and allow to cool for 5 - 10 minutes. Spread catsup on top of eggplant and then sprinkle remaining ingredients over the top. Bake 20 minutes, or until veggies are tender.

title: Homemade Pfeffernusse
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons green cardamom pods | 1/2 teaspoon whole coriander powder | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice | 1/4 teaspoon molasses, or to taste
instructions: Combine the cardamom pods, coriander, allspice and molasses in a small bowl. Store in a tightly closed glass jar with a tight fitting lid.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,cilantro,white rum,meat,french bread,kaffir lime leaf,ginger
title: The Singles of the Earth
ingredients: 500 g frozen meat, of your choice, thinly sliced into strips or cubes | 1 tablespoon thick curry powder | 2 small kaffir lime leaves, crumbled ( or equivalent ) | 1 inch fresh ginger, sliced thinly | 1 sprig fresh cilantro, chopped | 2 tablespoons white rum ( optional ) | 3 slices french bread or 3 slices other dry bread ( depending on the size )
instructions: Place the meat in a large bowl, drizzle with the curry powder, mix lightly and refrigerate for at least 4 hours. About 10 - 20 minutes before cooking, prepare the rum. Heat a few tablespoons of oil in a large pot with just a touch of oil and fry the kaffir leaves, ginger and cilantro for about 1 minute. Then add the meat mixture and cook over high heat for 1 minute. Add the rum and simmer for another 5 minutes. Remove from heat and serve with the french or pita bread.

title: Speedy Chicken and Pecan Cheese Fondue
ingredients: 1 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 1 cup pecans, coarsely chopped | 2 cans chicken meat, in gravy
instructions: In fondue pot melt cheese and stir in pecans until they just begin to darken and smell nutty. Add chuteed chicken meat to cheese mixture. Mix well and let flavors meld meld for several hours. Serve over crackers.

Random Ingredients: ladyfinger,english cucumber,dark soy sauce,cumin seed,cherry tomato,icing sugar,acorn squash,flat leaf parsley
title: Summery Veg & Cherry Tomato Salad
ingredients: 2 ounces good quality dark soy sauce | 1 english cucumber | 2 cups fresh red cherry tomatoes or 2 cups grape tomatoes, halved | 2 teaspoons sesame seeds or 2 teaspoons golden seedless seeds | 2 teaspoons ground cumin seeds | 10 -12 ladyfingers | 1 1/2 cups icing sugar | flat leaf parsley, to serve
instructions: Toss together all ingredients in a bowl, season & mix well. Cut the vegies into finger sized pieces. Heat a wok over medium high heat &, when very hot, add the sesame seeds/parsley. Cook for 1 - 2 minutes or until golden, stir in the whole house to coat & leave to cool then transfer into a bowl. To serve, decorate each plate with a dollop of the chilled vegie mix + sprigs of parsley.

title: Spicy Strawberry-Carrots in Fajita Seasoning
ingredients: 1 package frozen baby carrots, thawed | 1 jar sliced strawberries with juice ( reserve juice ) | 1 package taco seasoning | 1/2 cup green pepper, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper ( or to taste )
instructions: Place the carrots in a microwave safe casserole dish. Cover and microwave on high for 3 minutes or until tender. Remove from microwave, stir, and microwave on high for 2 more minutes. Stir. Stir in the remaining ingredients. Bake in 375°f oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until hot and lightly browned. Serve and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: spring onion,cherry tomato,chicken,star anise,rogan josh seasoning
title: Roasted Chicken
ingredients: 8 -10 lbs chicken pieces | 1 1/2 tablespoons star anise | 1 teaspoon josh seasoning, blend | 3 spring onions, chopped | 8 -10 cherry tomatoes, quartered
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f degrees. Heat oven to season chicken with salt, pepper and anise. Arrange in a large roasting pan. Toss with onion and cherry tomatoes. Roast for 1 hour or until juices run clear.

title: Lazy Zucchini
ingredients: 2 lbs zucchini, coarsely grated and unpeeled | 1 can liquid smoke, such as e.g. taber's or ( 7 ounce ) can hickory-smoked sausage, such as woodcock
instructions: Rinse zucchini well in a colander. If it is large, cut away any excess tough pulp. Transfer to a crockpot. Add remaining ingredients, except zucchini. Cook on low 6 - 8 hours. Drain juice. Turn zucchini onto a platter. Shred using forks. Serve with hot crackers or rye bread.

Random Ingredients: stout beer,rice noodle,red lentil,sake,belgian endive,saffron,red wine vinegar,orange zest
title: Belgian Endive Noodle and Beer Salad
ingredients: 1 liter belgian endive, sliced | 350 330 g dry rice noodles | 1 liter red lentil | 3 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1 oranges or 1 lemon, zest of or 1 lemon, zest of | 1 pinch saffron | 1 liter belgian stout beer | 1 teaspoon sake
instructions: Put endive in a microwave proof bowl with a tight fitting lid. Cover with a film of olive oil. Add 1 3/4 cups water. Cover dish with microwave proof paper. Microwave on full power 7 - 8 minutes, stirring twice. Remove bowl from microwave and shake off excess water. Return to microwave and again cook on full power 3 - 4 minutes. Turn off microwave. Put noodles in a large bowl of boiling water and boil for 3 - 5 minutes, or until just soft. Transfer noodles to separate bowl. In a jug, combine vinegar, oil and saffron. Pour half over noodles and stir to combine. Pour remaining vinegar oil mixture over noodles, add beer and stir well to coat. Taste mixture for sweetness. The balance between sour taste/flavor and pleasantly grainy is needed. Refrigerate until chilled. Taste for sweetness. Cover with cling film, refrigerate for 4 - 5 hours. Turn off microwave and let stand 30 minutes before serving. Pour endive on a large platter, scatter over the rest of the cooked ingredients. Serve chilled with red rice.

Random Ingredients: poultry seasoning,coleslaw mix,grain white rice,chili oil,thai basil,beef loin steak,mint leaf,cauliflower
title: Grilled Beef and Cauliflower Wraps
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked long grain white rice, such as jasmine or basmati | 1 tablespoon chili oil | 2 lbs beef top loin steaks, about 1 inch thick | 1 package refrigerated coleslaw mix | 8 large cauliflower, tips trimmed and broken into florets | 2 teaspoons dried mint leaves | 1 teaspoon dried thai basil | 1 teaspoon poultry seasoning
instructions: Preheat a grill or broiler | 2 cups boiling water. Prepare rice according to package directions. Brush grill or broiler pan with oil and arrange steaks. Close lid and grill for 5 minutes, turn steaks and continue cooking for 5 minutes to desired doneness. Meanwhile, combine slaw and onion in a bowl with remaining ingredients. Season with poultry seasoning and salt and pepper. Divide mixture between wraps and serve.

Random Ingredients: mint,romano cheese,plum tomato,pepper,red chile,bamboo shoot,tabasco sauce
title: Chili Tomato Relleno Salad
ingredients: 1 canned plum tomatoes or 4 fresh plum tomatoes, chopped | 10 -20 fresh cilantro leaves | 1/4 cup red chile, minced | 2 -3 teaspoons tabasco sauce, to taste | 2 -4 teaspoons grated romano cheese, to taste | pepper, to taste | 1/4 cup bamboo shoot, thinly sliced
instructions: Put tomatoes, chiles, tabasco, cheese and pepper into blender. Blend for a few seconds to mix. Pour into a bowl and serve.

Random Ingredients: lipton onion soup mix,onion,canadian bacon,asparagus,mustard,pomegranate seed
title: Liptauer Onion Mini Meat Loaf
ingredients: 1 lb fresh asparagus | 1 lb sliced canadian bacon, chopped | 1 small onion, chopped | 2 packages frozen grated onions with garlic soup mix | 1/4 cup prepared mustard | 1 package lipton onion soup mix
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 °f. Place a sheet of aluminum foil on a baking sheet and place top sheet on cookie sheet in oven to warm. Remove asparagus from water and blanch with your hands. Slice asparagus lengthwise into 2 inch pieces. Place the canadian bacon, onion and soup mix in a large mixing bowl. Add mustard and mix well until combined. Spread mixture onto the prepared sheet and form into a loaf. Place loaf in oven and bake until the top has nice and brown color, about 50 minutes, stirring every 10 minutes. Remove from oven and allow to cool 5 minutes before slicing. If the top of your loaf becomes brown, place it back in the oven to finish cooking and browning the loaf.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,soya sauce,green olive,ancho chile powder,green chili pepper,chicken breast fillet
title: Brazilian Chicken Mole
ingredients: 4 chicken breast fillets, sliced | 1/6 green olives, finely chopped | 1 green chili pepper, finely chopped | 50 g butter or 50 g margarine | 3 tablespoons soya sauce | 1/4 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder | 1/4 teaspoon cocoa powder
instructions: In a bowl, combine all ingredients. Melt the butter or margarine over a low fire. Dip each piece of chicken in melted butter/margarine mixture. Place on a large non metal skewer, brushing with any leftover melted butter/margarine mixture. Broil or grill for 5 - 6 minutes on each side, turning once, until nicely browned and cooked through.

title: Mark Twain Beef Barley & Barley Crock Pot Pilaf
ingredients: 1 lb chuck, trimmed and cut into bite-size chunks | 2 1/2 cups unbleached pearl barley | 1/4 cup pectin, powder ( or 1 egg mixed with 2 tbls. water, 1/2 tbls. vanilla & 2 tbls. water ) | 1/2 teaspoon lemon peel, coarsely grated | salt and pepper
instructions: Place the meat in the bottom of your crock pot and sprinkle the barley over it. Make the pectin by placing the 1/2 cup mix, grated lemon peel and salt& pepper into a bowl and mixing until well combined. Pour the mixture over the meat and barley. Cook on low for 4 to 5 hours, and on high for 5 to 6 hours, or until the meat is tender, and barley is nice and tender. Serve over your favorite savoury or mashed potatoes.

Random Ingredients: pork loin,lentil,taco seasoning mix,sesame oil,iceberg lettuce
title: Mexican Pork Salad
ingredients: 1 lb boneless pork loin | 1 cup uncooked lentils, uncooked | 1/2 cup taco seasoning mix | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 2 tablespoons iceberg lettuce
instructions: Trim fat from pork. Cook pork in a skillet over medium heat just until browned, about 5 minutes. Stir in lentils and taco seasoning. Cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until lentils are tender, about 30 minutes. Drain off fat and set aside. Stir sesame oil into reserved pork juices. Add vinegar and lettuce. Toss salad and pork. Serve.

Random Ingredients: sunflower oil,napa cabbage,beef roast,leek,peanut oil,red chile pepper
title: Peking Beef Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1 piece beef roast, trimmed, cut into thin strips | 1 tablespoon sunflower oil | 1 leek, sliced | 1/4 cup chopped peanuts and olive oil | 1 teaspoon finely chopped dried red chile pepper | 1 napa cabbage, julienned
instructions: Heat a wok over medium high heat.

title: Quick and Easy Filipino Pork Shabu
ingredients: 5 lbs pork roast, cut into small cubes | salt and pepper | 1 cup vegetable oil | 1 package dry yeast | 1/2 cup shredded coconut ( not sweetened ) | 2 boxes pasta shells, cooked and drained
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Mix with oil in a large pot and place the pork. Mix well and add salt and pepper to taste. Cover with a kitchen towel and set aside to rise for about 30 minutes. In a large bowl, mix the coconut with some water and spread evenly over bread and roast cubes. Cover with a kitchen towel or a clean kitchen towel and leave to rise until dough has risen. Meanwhile, put the bread cubes in an oven safe pan and add enough water to cover or use a pan with several inches of space. You don't need to wet your hands when doing this in the oven, and you don't want the bread to soak up the water. Place in the oven on lowest heat setting and leave in a warm spot for 45 minutes to an hour. When the roast is done, remove from pan and shred meat and return to the pan. Cover with a lid or aluminum saucepan and let cool to room temperature. Mix the shredded coconut with some of the water and spread over the top of the shredded pork. Serve over egg noodles.

title: Tasty Pizza
ingredients: 1 pizza dough, for your pizza machine ( i like focaccia or king arthur pizza ) | 1/4 cup parmesan cheese, shredded | 1/8 - 1/4 fluid ounce hot spice, your favourite | 1 -2 tablespoon dried cherries
instructions: Preheat your pizza stone or pizza pan on the pizza's lowest setting. Grease the pizza with oil. If you use a regular oven setting like mine, check the dough every 10 - 15 minutes to make sure it's sticky. When your crust is ready, place on the pizza machine, and pop in the dried cherries. If using a pizza pan for a regular pizza, it should slide off easily with your finger. Once the bread has risen from the middle of the oven, remove from the pan and place on your pizza peel or stone. Sprinkle the top of the dough with the parmesan cheese. Cut a circle or two around the pizza to make your pizza easier to eat. Place the pizza on the preheated pizza stone or pizza pan and bake for about 30 minutes at 450°f.

Random Ingredients: bacon,greek yogurt,mushroom,pork tenderloin,tamarind paste,garam masala,taco seasoning mix
title: Tamarind Pork Tenderloin Tacos
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin | 2 tablespoons tamarind paste | 1 teaspoon salt | 1/4 teaspoon garam masala | 1 cup greek yogurt ( plain ) | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning mix | 1/4 cup crumbled bacon
instructions: Place tenderloin between two pieces of plastic wrap. Pound to 1/4 inch thickness. Cut several small slits in top of tenderloin to vent steam. Combine tamarind paste, salt, and garam masala in bowl. Brush onto pork. Cover and chill 12 hours. When ready to bake, preheat oven to 350ºf. Remove marinade. Arrange meat on a foil lined baking sheet. Bake 25 minutes. Remove from oven. Brush on remaining tamarind paste mixture. Baste meat with yogurt and sprinkle with taco seasoning. Cover and return to oven 5 minutes. Remove from oven. Cut into 6 servings.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,mustard,wheat bread,kale,pea,habanero pepper,shiitake mushroom,pine nut
title: Mushroom, Corn, and Pine Nut Crumble
ingredients: 2 cups frozen shiitake mushrooms | 1 large habanero pepper | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1/4 cup whole wheat pastry bread, such as boboli | 1 teaspoon ground mustard | 1 cup chopped kale | 1/2 cup peas | 1 tablespoon toasted pine nuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Rinse the mushrooms under cold running water, remove stems and coarsely chop caps. Slice habeneros crosswise into 1/2 inch wide strips. Place shiitake mushrooms, habanero pepper, graham cracker crumbs, pastry bread, mustard, and kale in a bowl. Spoon mushroom mixture into a medium size casserole. Top with pea pods, toasted pine nuts, and a sprinkling of coarsely chopped habenero.

Random Ingredients: za'atar spice mix,lemon juice,mustard powder,pineapple chunk,salsa
title: Yummus Island Dip
ingredients: 8 ounces salsa | 1 ounce za'atar spice mix, recipe follows | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 tablespoon fresh squeezed lemon juice | pineapple chunk, garnish
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and stir until well mixed, serve immediately. Garnish with pineapple chunks, if desired.

Random Ingredients: rice vinegar,raspberry jam,lemon extract,tarragon,hot pepper,creme de banane,stewing beef,vegan margarine
title: Beef and Raspberry Stir Fry
ingredients: 1/4 cup vegan margarine | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar or 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1 teaspoon lemon extract | 1 lb lean stewing beef, cut into strips ( i use 1/2 to 1 inch cubes ) | 10 1/2 ounces frozen raspberries in light syrup ( you can use light lemon juice and or or raspberry or blackberry preserves if desired ) | 8 ounces creme de banane | 2 -3 hot peppers, sliced in 1 inch strips ( to taste ) | 2 -4 sprigs fresh tarragon | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh tarragon | hot pepper sauce ( optional )
instructions: In a large skillet melt 1/4 cup margarine over medium high heat. When margarine is melted, add both the rice vinegar, lemon extract and beef and stir to coat. Add raspberries and hot peppers. Cook until meat and pineapple are tender. Add creme de banane. Stir until mixed. If desired, add hot sauce. Top with fresh tarragon and chopped fresh tarragon. This is a low carb meal.

Random Ingredients: biscuit,kingfish,garlic clove,dragee,no boil lasagna noodle,thyme leaf,chili pepper flake,garlic
title: Crazy Kingfish Lasagne
ingredients: 6 -8 kingfish, sliced into 4 equal parts ( depending on your preferences ) | 4 garlic cloves, crushed | 1 chili pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon thyme leaves, crumpled | 4 cans no-boil lasagna noodles | 3 tablespoons garlic, crushed | 4 tablespoons chopped fresh thyme leaves ( or dried and crushed basil ) | 1 teaspoon crushed chili pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon chili pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon crushed garlic | 4 tablespoons no-boil lasagna noodles ( or regular lasagne noodles ) | 1 cup craisins or 1 cup marinara sauce from fridge | 1/2 cup reduced-fat cayenne pepper | 4 teaspoons bottled horseradish sauce or 2 2 teaspoons bottled horseradish paste
instructions: Cut the fish into 4 equal portions. Crush the garlic. Crush the thyme. Mix together all the ingredients except the noodles. In a medium saucepan, boil a large pot of lightly salted water. Once it boils, add the lasagne noodles and cook for about 6 minutes or until al dente. Drain and rinse with cold water. Spread a small amount of prepared horseradish sauce on the bottom of a lasagne pan. Layer noodles on the horseradish sauce. Spread a few slices of fish on top of the noodles, then one portion of garlic, another portion of the fish, and finally add a layer of sauce. Add one more layer of noodles, and repeat layers and finishing with sauce. If it looks like it needs more sauce, drizzle with additional horseradish and a sprinkle of cayenne pepper. Bake covered at 180°c for about 20 minutes.

title: Chipotle Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower | 2 leeks | 1 package taco sauce | 1/2 cup cornstarch | 1 teaspoon dried chipotle chile | 1 teaspoon dried oregano
instructions: Break cauliflower into florets.

title: Apple Asparagus Pasta
ingredients: 500 g fresh asparagus | 1 apple | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/2 teaspoon mint | 250 g farfalle pasta, pasta
instructions: Cut the end off the asparagus. If large, cut in two lengthwise. Cut the base and bottom of the asparagus into 2 inch segments.. Wash and slice the apple into thin wedges. Wash the asparagus, and slice into 2 inch segments. Heat a large frying pan over medium high heat and add the diced apple. Quickly cook it for 3 minutes, until it starts to soften but the apple is still a bit crisp. Add 1/2 teaspoons of cumin powder. Add asparagus, and let it sizzle for 2 minutes. Add 2 teaspoons of mint and 1/2 teaspoons of cumin powder. Add the farfalle pasta and salt and pepper to taste. Stir well and let cook for 3 - 4 minutes until the pasta is done, stirring as necessary. Serve it warm, drizzled with a bit more of the mint.

Random Ingredients: white bread,jalapeno pepper,sunflower oil,worcestershire sauce,el patio jalapeno chili sauce
title: The Best White Chili Bread
ingredients: 3 tablespoons sunflower oil | 1 lb white bread, stale | 1/4 cup worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon jalapeno pepper, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons jalapeno pepper sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Grease cookie sheet with oil. Cut crusts off bread. Cut bread into triangles. Place triangles in single layer on cookie sheet. Bake in the preheated oven for 10 to 12 minutes, until lightly golden brown. For the sauce, heat oil in small saucepan over low heat. Add 1/2 cup water, worcestershire sauce and jalapenos and simmer 2 to 3 minutes. Cool 5 minutes, then pour sauce over toast.

title: Pork Roast in Red Wine
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 1/2 lbs boneless pork shoulder | 3/4 cup red wine | 1 teaspoon salt | 1/8 teaspoon seasoning salt
instructions: Place pork in a roasting pan that has been coated with cooking spray or a light film of non stick spray. Rub the meat with seasoning salt. Cover and refrigerate. To cook, bring to a boil in a 2 quart sauce pot of boiling water.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,apple juice,sherry wine,orange zest,sauerkraut,broccoli floret,coconut cream
title: Sauerkraut with Grilled Apples and Broccoli
ingredients: 2 cups apple juice | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 tablespoon sherry wine or 1 tablespoon marsala wine | 1 teaspoon grated orange zest | 1/4 teaspoon grated fresh orange zest | 3 cups sauerkraut, rinsed and drained | 1 1/2 lbs fresh broccoli florets | 1 1/4 cups coconut cream
instructions: Combine apple juice, cream, sherry, orange zest and orange zest in a saucepan. Heat until hot but not boiling. Add sauerkraut.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile adobo,patis,grain rice,orange juice,sauerkraut juice,rice krispies,potato,thyme leave
title: Rice Krazy
ingredients: 2 cups cooked long-grain rice | 1 cup sauerkraut with juice | 1 -2 chipotle chile in adobo, chopped ( or to taste ) | 2 teaspoons dried thyme leave | 1 teaspoon patis ( or soy sauce ) | 14 ounces chipotle-patis | 1 tablespoon orange juice | 16 ounces sweet potatoes ( or use your favorite kind ) or 16 ounces yams ( or use your favorite kind ) | 3 cups crispy rice krispies, toasted or as needed ( optional )
instructions: Cook rice as directed in the package. To serve,. Put hot rice on plate. Spoon over hot krispies/sweet potatoes if desired, then top with crispy rice. If serving with kraut, sprinkle on the chipotle patis. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: ancho chili,pistachio,baking soda,sazon goya,marjoram,grain white rice,beet
title: Baked Shredded Beets With Pistachios from El Yucatecan Restaurant in Riz Madame
ingredients: 4 medium ripe beets | 2 tablespoons coarsely chopped pistachios | 1 teaspoon salt | 2 1/2 cups short-grain white rice | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1/2 teaspoon ground ancho chili | 1/2 teaspoon ground marjoram
instructions: Prick bottoms of beets with fork in 2 - 4 places. Bake at 400 degrees for 1 hour or until tender when pierced with knife joint. Scoop out center of beets and set aside to cool. When cool, slip off beets and discard skins. Remove stem and shred beets in grinder. Bring 2 cups of water to boil in medium skillet, then add rice and stir. Reduce heat and simmer until water is absorbed and rice is just tender, approximately 12 - 14 minutes. Combine beets with 1/4 cup pistachios, salt, baking soda, chili, and marjoram in small bowl.

title: Strawberry Pizza
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/4 lb pizza sauce | 1 cup frozen strawberries ( or fresh ) | kosher salt or soy sauce
instructions: You need a 9x13 baking dish that has been placed in the oven. The dough,. Wash your counter and get your fruit. If you are using strawberries cut them in half and slice them in half to get all the pieces. Place in the baking dish you want to be using. If not use a 9x13 dish. It helps to have the strawberries and all the other ingredients. It will take about 20 to 25 minutes for the dough to rise properly, so be aware of the water temperature. If the dough doesn't rise properly just use the back of a spoon. Turn your oven on to 400 degrees and get your baking dish ready. You want to heat about 5 to 10 minutes to get the water to boiling then remove from the oven. It is going to get very hot so your oven won't burn. Let it cool. Now slice your crust and place on your working board. Spread your pre cooked pizza sauce over the dough and then top your toppings. Press your tomatoes into your pizza slices. Use a spoon or pastry brush if you have a bread knife to spread the pizza sauce over the top and on the sides to get the juices out of your tomato slices. Use a fork to dip your tomatoes into your sauce. You want the skins to stick to the tomatoes, they should be just slightly peeled. This will make a little bit of a mess in your oven. Place the cookie in the oven, with the tomato and bread facing up, and leave for 12 to 15 minutes, or until it begins to brown. Let it cool on a rack. I like to serve this warm from the oven.

title: Peas and Peppers in Green Spice
ingredients: 1 cup green peas, shelled ( or frozen peas ) | 4 yellow peppers, small | 1 cup of finely chopped green vegetables or 1 cup of finely chopped yellow chili | 2 -3 tablespoons turmeric | 1 -2 drop green food coloring
instructions: Combine green and yellow peppers in a blender and puree until smooth. You will need about 1 - 2 cups of puree in equal parts. Put the pureed vegetables, turmeric, red food coloring and green food color in a medium sized bowl and mix well using your hands to mix. If too much water is mixed away, add more. If too much water is mixed away again, add more. Refrigerate for up to 12 hours before using. The turmeric powder can also be used in other dishes or as a spice spread/indian meal.

title: Barefoot Contessa's Beetroot
ingredients: 2 pounds fresh beets - washed, peeled and sliced | 2 tablespoons cumin seeds
instructions: Fill a large pot with enough water to cover the beets. Bring to a boil and cook them uncovered until soft, about 30 minutes.

title: Duck and Dressing
ingredients: 1 lb duck, boiled in water until cooked | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1/2 cup catsup | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 1/4 cup freshly grated sweet italian parsley | 2 romaine lettuce or 2 red leaf lettuce
instructions: Remove bones if necessary and cut through the duck meat in a meat grinder so the pieces have uniform pieces of meat. Combine all ingredients and chill before serving.

title: Kosher Crushed Risotto
ingredients: 2 tablespoons kosher salt, plus more for seasoning the risotto | 1 cup arborio rice | 1/4 cup chopped fresh thyme
instructions: In medium saucepan, bring 2 quarts salted water to a boil over high heat. Cook rice for 10 minutes, or until it turns very pale gold in color. Drain in a sieve. Dry with paper towels. Meanwhile, stir 2 tablespoons kosher salt into 1/2 cup of arborio. Stir chopped thyme into risotto until it barely holds its shape on the bottom. Spread rice on a large plate, and spread it 1/3 the way up the risotto bowl. Drizzle the salt mixture over the rice. Sprinkle about 1/4 cup of kosher salt and 1/4 cup of kosher salt over the rice. Press a toothpick through the rice to release the air pockets. Gather the other 1/4 cup of kosher salt and 1/2 cup of kosher salt together with the thyme. Arrange the rice on a platter, and spoon the remaining cheese over each piece before serving.

Random Ingredients: lasagne noodle,mozzarella cheese,lime juice,balsamic vinegar,white wine,english cucumber,hamburger,provolone cheese
title: Lorilla's Classic English Lasagna
ingredients: 12 -15 lasagne noodles ( or whatever size noodle you are going to use ) | 1 lb hamburger ( or more ) | 1/4 cup white wine | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 1 lime, juice of | 1 lb provolone cheese or 1 lb gruyere cheese, grated | 1/2 english cucumber, grated | 4 ounces of either fully cooked regular or 1 package mozzarella cheese, cut in sticks
instructions: Brown hamburger in a skillet until cooked and drain. If using regular cheese, drain excess fat. Add wine to meat mixture and stir well. Simmer on low medium for 15 minutes to reduce meat slightly. Add balsamic and lime juice to meat mixture and mix. Set aside to cool completely. Preheat oven to 375°f. Place noodles in a single layer in a large roasting pan. Pour meat mixture over noodles until all noodles are covered. Add grated cheese, cucumber and cheeses. Bake in oven for 40 minutes. Remove and serve warm.

title: Jahiri (Amaretto & Soy Dessert)
ingredients: 1 cup dried mung beans | 1/4 cup amaretto or other almond liqueur | 2 teaspoons sesame seeds ( optional )
instructions: Wash, drain and rinse the beans. Soak them in water in a bowl overnight. Bring water until 1/2 cup of the water is boiling. Add the soaked beans and allow it to simmer until they are soft and almost transparent. They are done when they fall apart in the center. Drain the beans in a sieve or colander. Place the liquid in a small bowl and slowly stream in 1/4 cup of the amaretto or other almond liqueur, stirring constantly until it is fully absorbed into the liquid. Pour the mixture onto a serving dish, sprinkle with the sesame seeds and chill for several hours or overnight. Serve chilled.

title: Spinach Salad II
ingredients: 8 spinach leaves | 7 tablespoons tarragon vinegar | 3/4 teaspoon summer savory | 4 dashes red pepper, to taste
instructions: Wash and dry spinach leaves. Remove veins and tough stems with fingers. Set spinach aside to let it drain. In a microwave safe bowl, combine the vinegar, savory and pepper. Microwave on high for two minutes or until syrupy, stirring every 30 seconds. Toss with spinach. Enjoy.

title: Peruvian Stewed Beef and Rice Vermicelli
ingredients: 4 beef tenderloin steaks, 1-inch thick | 1/2 cup rice vinegar | 2 tablespoons tomato puree, divided | 2 -3 poblano peppers, roasted | 2 garlic cloves, minced | 1 lb white potatoes, unpeeled, cut lengthwise into wedges | 1 lb medium pasta shells or 1 lb cavatappi pasta | 2 tablespoons grated romano cheese
instructions: Pound steaks to 1/4 inch. Place steaks in baking dish and pour vinegar over them. Marinate in refrigerator for 30 minutes. Peel potatoes and cut into wedges. In food process fitted with metal blade, grind poblanos with garlic and cook in a large skillet till very soft, not brown. Add tomatoes and cooked poblanos. Drain and add to meat mixture in soup bowl and toss.

title: Scotch Steak and Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 3 cans crabmeat, drained and picked over | 1 teaspoon crushed kalamata olives | 1/8 teaspoon ground cumin seed | 12 whole wheat lasagna noodles | 1 beef rib ( optional ) | 2 fluid ounces irish whiskey
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f spray a 9x12 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Spread 1 can of crabmeat on top of each noodle. Sprinkle with cumin seed. Cover with another third can of crabmeat and olives. Repeat layering, ending with a single layer of noodles. Pour irish whiskey over all. Cook in preheated oven for 50 minutes to 1 hour, uncover and bake for an additional 15 minutes, until hot.

title: Wasabi Crusted Tuna
ingredients: 1 cup wasabi paste ( kewpie wasabi ) | 1 can tuna | 2 tablespoons virgin olive oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f.

title: Mexican Avocados
ingredients: 5 avocados, peeled and pitted | 11 3/4 ounces tagliatelle pasta noodles
instructions: Mash avocados with a fork or potato masher. Season to taste with salt. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook tagliatelle in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 10 minutes. Drain and transfer to a bowl. Toss with avocado mixture until well mixed. Serve warm.

title: Greek Feta Chips (Feta Cheese)
ingredients: 8 ounces feta, frozen | vegetable oil ( corn or canola )
instructions: Thaw feta. You will need to defrost it. If your pan is big you need lots of paper towels between each portion. Cut the block of feta across into 1/4 chunks, about 2 or 3 to 3 inches in width. Cut fetta into chunks as soon as it gets half frozen. If it is fresh, put it into a zip lock bag and use the freezer for 1 hour to allow it defrost. Meanwhile, warm your oven to 300 degrees fahrenheit. Once the oven is ready, put the frozen feta chips in the oven for 5 to 10 minutes, depending on their size. Drain on a paper towel or in a sieve. Allow the butter to harden, but don't let it sit too long. Place the feta in a microwave safe bowl, drizzle with enough oil to coat, and microwave in microwave for another couple of minutes until the melted and slightly caramelized, stirring frequently, until the chips are crispy. Enjoy with greek salad.

instructions: First make the jerk marinade. Put pumpkin pie spice, tomato, seasoning mix and mint/pignoli into a food processor and blend with the peppers and chilie. Brush with oil and grill meat until just cooked through, 1 - 3 minutes each side. Serve with sauce.

title: Ziti Neapolitan Salad With a Pear-Orange Flair

instructions: Cook the ziti according to package directions, drain and cool. Combine all ingredients and toss with the dressing.

title: Pounded Pork with Chicken and Peanuts
ingredients: 6 pork loin | 4 ounces chicken breast strips ( or you could use thighs too ) or 4 ounces pork tenderloin ( or you could use thighs too )
instructions: Cut each pork loin crosswise into about 6 pieces. Lay out the chicken breasts or pork tenderloins onto a cutting board. Using the flat side of a meat mallet, pound the meat about 1/8 thick. Spread the pounded chicken slices onto the pounded pork. Use your fingers to make sure they are evenly spread all over the pork and chicken. Place the breaded meat on a large nonreactive baking sheet or cookie sheet. Place the baking sheet in a 400°f oven for about 15 minutes or until brown and crispy. Turn the oven down to 350°f and continue to bake the pork, turning every few minutes, for 40 - 50 more minutes or until nicely browned. During the last 20 minutes of baking, add 1/4 of your favorite dry sauce to a skillet and heat on medium heat. Put the crispy pieces of chicken or pork loin onto heated skillet and sprinkle with some dry parsley. Cook the chicken and pork for about 6 - 8 minutes on each side or until the meat reaches 165°f serve immediately.

title: Tahini-Stuffed Peppers-Packed With Almonds
ingredients: 5 medium yellow bell peppers | 2 cups almond slivers, unblanched | 1/4 cup unsweetened applesauce | 2/3 cup tahini | 1/3 cup nutritional yeast | 3 teaspoons minced fresh ginger
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees. Place bell peppers on ungreased cookie sheet, and bake 20 minutes until the skin is blistered and black. Remove from oven, and allow to sit 5 minutes. Remove from saucepan. Peel off blackened skin, and dice the bell peppers. Place the bell peppers in a large bowl, and add the almonds and applesauce. Mix well. In a small bowl, combine the tahini, nutritional yeast and ginger.

Random Ingredients: cream tartar,baby onion,nutmeg,sage,coconut cream,cheese,corn tortilla chip
title: Baby Onions & Chips With Creamy Chocolate Sauce

instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 deg c. Boil the baby onions with cream tarter in a pan of salted water until the onions are very soft and the water has reduced considerably. Drain, and roughly chop the onion. Tip the onions and cooked water into a food processor or blender, add the sage, nutmeg, shredded cheese and coconut cream, and pulse to make a fairly smooth sauce. Place the tortilla chips in a large dish. Heat a few teaspoonfuls of the sauce and spoon onto the chips to cover, then sprinkle with the shredded cheese. Place under the grill until golden to the touch, and serve.

title: No-Bake Alfredo Baked Noodles
ingredients: 2 jars no-boil lasagna noodles | 10 ounces red currant jelly | 4 ounces grated pecorino romano cheese ( or parmigiano-reggiano ) | 1/2 teaspoon orange peel, grated | 1/2 cup grated cheddar-monterey cheese blend
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Spray a 9 x 13 x 2 inch baking dish with nonstick spray. Using a 1 1/2 quart capacity ovenproof casserole dish or 9 x 13 inch baking dish, spread 1 cup of the currant jelly across the bottom of the dish. Place the 3 1/2 cups of noodles along with 1 1/2 cups of the pecorino romano, the orange peel and the cheeses in a food processor or blender and process until mixture is smooth. With the motor running, pour the sauce over the noodles in the dish. Bake, uncovered, for 45 minute.

title: Spicy Pizza-Pizza Wedges
ingredients: 12 ounces pizza sauce ( homemade, homemade or from a jar ) | 1 tablespoon chili paste ( or more, to taste ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons sea salt | 1 lb mixed dried fruit, such as currants, dried cranberries, dates, raisins, prunes and peaches
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 °f. Cut the dried fruit into smaller pieces, roughly 2 or 3 smaller ones depending on the size of the pieces. Divide the dried fruit and 1 tbs water in half, keeping water separate. Put the other 2 tbs water with the chili paste/sea salt in a large, non stick frying pan. Spread the chili paste on the dried fruit. Drain the excess water from the dried fruit and make sure the sauce is completely covered. Put the mixture in the prepared baking dish. Sprinkle the dried fruit evenly on the pizza sauce. Bake for about 30 minutes or until the sauce has reduced and the dried fruit is crispy and has a rich, reddish color. Let cool slightly before serving.

title: Mango Chili Lasagna
ingredients: 2 lbs lamb, trimmed and cubed | 8 ounces pinto beans, drained and rinsed | 1/2 lb lasagna noodle | 8 ounces mangoes, peeled and cubed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Bring 2 quarts of water to boil, add lamb and boil for 20 minutes. Drain. Transfer lamb to a large pot and add remaining ingredients. Simmer uncovered for 2 hours, stirring occasionally. Ladle hot meat mixture into lasagna baking dish, cover with foil and bake until heated through and bubbly.

title: Aglio E Olio
ingredients: 1/3 cup polenta | 32 ounces chicken broth | 1/4 cup blanched almond | 1 cup mixed sprouts
instructions: Cut polenta into four squares. Heat chicken broth to boiling. Add sliced polenta in small increments, stirring until the polenta is thoroughly melted throughout. Add almonds. Pour hot broth over almonds. Serve.

Random Ingredients: vanilla pudding,balsamic vinegar,sharp cheddar cheese,tomato,red curry paste,spring onion
title: Cheddar and Tomato Red Curry Dip
ingredients: 500 g red curry paste ( or more, to taste ) | 400 g chopped tomatoes ( canned, drained ) | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 2 spring onions, thinly sliced | 150 g sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 1 box instant vanilla pudding ( i use vanilla-flavoured instant )
instructions: Using oven trays, place curry paste in a large non stick pan and heat, stirring often, until fragrant. Add tomatoes, vinegar and spring onions and bring to the boil. Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, stirring occasionally, for 20 minutes or until the mixture is thick and smooth. Stir in grated cheese and simmer for a further 3 - 5 minutes or until cheese is melted. Serve with the vanilla pudding.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,fennel seed,sherry wine,cashew,kosher salt black pepper,asafoetida powder,lasagna noodle,gingerroot
title: Cashew Nut Lasagna
ingredients: 2 lbs cashews, roasted, unsalted, skinless, coarsely chopped | 5 tablespoons sherry wine or 5 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon gingerroot, peeled, minced | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( optional ) | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper | 12 lasagna noodles or 12 sheets thin eggroll sheets | 1 jar picante sauce | 1 teaspoon fennel seed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Combine cashews, sherry or vinegar, ginger, asafoetida and salt and pepper to taste in a food processor or blender and pulse until nuts are ground into fine powder. Spread noodles on a baking sheet and lightly tap with a spatula to dry. To assemble, lightly oil a 10x15 inch jelly roll pan. Spread each lasagna sheet with 2 tablespoons of the picante sauce and spread over them 1/2 cup of the nut filling. Place the lasagna in the oven and bake 20 minutes.

title: Spiced Shrimp
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/3 lb shrimp, peeled, deveined, butterflied | 1/3 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, minced | 3 tablespoons brown sugar ( packed ) | 1 pinch cayenne
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. When it shimmers, add shrimp. Sprinkle each shrimp with 1/3 t.Of the sun dried tomato and sprinkle with 1/3 of the brown sugar. Sprinkle evenly with 1/3 t. Of the cayenne. Cook, without stirring, until shrimp are pink, about 4 minutes. Serve with white rice.

Random Ingredients: ancho chile powder,french bread,american cheese,canola oil,kokum,ketjap manis
title: Cheese & Ancho Snack Sandwich
ingredients: 1 -2 slice french bread | ketjap manis, sauce ( see ketjap manis ( indonesian soy sauce ) ) | 1 teaspoon canola oil | 1 teaspoon fresh ground ancho chile powder ( if deseeded, 2 tsp. if fresh chile powder is unavailable ) | 1 large kokum, sliced thinly | 6 ounces grated american cheese
instructions: Cut the bread into 6 or 7 pieces and put them on a baking tray lined with foil. Pour the ketjap manis over the bread until it's completely covered. Bake at 375f for about 10 minutes. Take out of the oven and turn the oven off, leave the bread on, while you're waiting for it to cool. When it is cool, spread ketchup on the untoasted bread. Sprinkle with a little chile powder, if using. Add cheese on top and put back in the oven for about 5 minutes or until melted. Take out and serve hot. Keep chcken.

title: Pumpkin Vinegar
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh pumpkin | 1 1/2 cups dry white wine vinegar
instructions: Cut out top and bottom of pumpkin into 8 or 10 small pieces. Wash them well and pat dry. Arrange the pieces in an aluminum roasting pan or baking dish. Combine the vinegar and white wine and pour over the pumpkin pieces, turning to coat and shaking off excess vinegar. Cover tightly and refrigerate at least 6 hours or overnight, shaking the pan occasionally. Bake slowly in the oven at 350°f for 3 - 5 hours or until tender when pierced with a skewer.

Random Ingredients: poundcake,splenda sugar substitute,tamarind pulp,vanilla bean,pinto bean,chili flake,italian sausage
title: Pork-Stuffed Italian Sausages
ingredients: 2 lbs sweet italian sausage | 1/2 cup sugar substitute | 1 large vanilla bean | 4 ounces pinto beans | 8 ounces tamarind pulp | 1/4 teaspoon chili flakes | 1/2 lb poundcake, cut into strips ( you can use chocolate )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Combine the sausage, sugar, and scrapings in a large bowl and mix using knuckle or other tool that will hold the sausage together. Cut off the tip of the vanilla bean from the vanilla bean and scrape out the inside. Combine the vanilla bean inside the bean and the bean and add the seeds. Roll in about half the cinnamon and tie with twine. Place sausage on a rack in a roasting pan and bake, covered, for 2 1/2 hours or until dark and slightly sticky. Remove stuffing and place on serving tray. Wrap in chocolate and wrap with plastic wrap and refrigerate up to 2 days.

Random Ingredients: limoncello,pasta,serrano pepper,white vinegar,coconut milk,superfine sugar,rice noodle
title: Coconut Rice Noodles with Limoncello
ingredients: 1 cup superfine sugar | 1 tablespoon white vinegar | 1 cup light coconut milk | 1 tablespoon limoncello or 1 tablespoon other orange-flavored liqueur | 1 package rice noodles, cooked and drained | 1/2 cup diced serrano pepper | 2 teaspoons finely chopped fresh italian plum tomato and basil leaves or 2 teaspoons other chopped fresh basil leaves
instructions: In a small saucepan over medium heat, stir together the sugar, vinegar and coconut milk. Heat until the sugar dissolves. Bring to a boil, then remove from the heat. Stir in the limoncello and noodles. Set aside to cool to room temperature. Add the chopped chilies. Transfer to bowl, then pour into refrigerator. Refrigerate until serving time. Garnish with italian plum tomato and basil.

title: Vegan Barley Pearl Barley Beans
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups pearl barley ( i use 2 bags of brown rice barley barley that has been rinsed in cold water ) | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1 can black beans, rinsed ( canned is fine )
instructions: In medium saucepan, boil water, barley, extract and black beans over medium heat until barley is tender and barley is al dente. Reduce heat to low and allow rice to simmer. When the rice is done, remove from heat and allow to sit for a few minutes to allow it to absorb the flavors. Serve and enjoy.

title: Fennel and Rice
ingredients: 1 fennel� starburst fennel | 4 cups rice
instructions: Finely seed fennel and cut into half and set aside. Place rice in a 5 qt saucepan and cover with salted water. Bring water to a boil over high heat. Cover and cook rice until tender, about 35 minutes, but remove from heat and let stand for 5 minutes. Run knife around top of rice to loosen. In a small skillet, roast fennel in a small amount of oil over high heat until browned, stirring. To serve, spread fennel in shallow bowl, sprinkle with a little fennel and serve.

Random Ingredients: basil leaf,italian green bean,linguine,beef bouillon cube,graham cracker,mustard powder,sherry wine
title: Beef and Green Bean Linguine
ingredients: 3 garlic rolls, sliced and threaded onto toothpicks | 1 lb ground beef | 3 ounces fresh basil leaves | 1/4 cup sherry wine | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1/4 teaspoon basil leaves | 1/4 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 lb fresh linguine, cooked
instructions: Cook ground beef, stirring, in a skillet over medium heat until cooked through then drain. Add basil and sherry to meat in skillet. Heat until the liquid is almost evaporated. Stir in beef bouillon cube, basil and mustard powder. Stir to combine. Serve over linguine.

title: Green Curry Paste
ingredients: 3 tablespoons tahini | 2 tablespoons fresh orange juice | 3 tablespoons green curry paste, or to taste
instructions: Blend tahini, orange juice, and curry paste together in a blender until smooth.

Random Ingredients: bean sprout,sauce tabasco,black bean,rosemary,cocoa powder,chili bean,prune
title: Black Bean Sprout Balls
ingredients: 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained ( or white kidney beans and drained ) | 1 can crushed ice chestnuts ( i used 1 cup dried ) | 1 tablespoon chili bean sauce ( i used tabasco ) | 1 tablespoon dried rosemary | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 1/2 cups dried prunes | hot sauce ( such as tabasco, for extra spice )
instructions: Place all ingredients except for the hot sauce in an electric mixer. Blend until well mixed. Cover and chill for 1 hour. Roll chilled mixture into 1 inch balls and transfer to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Chill for 30 minutes. Brush with hot sauce and serve.

title: Frijoles Borrachitos
ingredients: 350 g pinto beans or 350 g garbanzo beans, undrained | 250 g bean sprouts | 2 tablespoons herbs de provence ( or use herbes de provence leaves ) | 200 g fruity port wine
instructions: Combine the beans and water in a pot. Stir in the herbs and port and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat and simmer gently for 15 minutes to meld flavors.

title: Japanese Party Flavoured Colby Jack Cheese Appetizer
ingredients: 1 package colby-monterey jack cheese | 1 shallots or 1 green onion, trimmed if desired | 1/2 cup mirin | 2 -4 tablespoons prepared italian dressing ( or any sweet italian dressing, such as miracle whip )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Slice colby jack cheese into about 3/4 thick slices. Place in a bowl with a sprinkling of onions, mirin and dressing. Toss until well incorporated. Place in a buttered 9 inch square pan. Bake at 400°f for about 5 - 7 minutes or until the cheese starts to brown.

title: Fried Ancho Chili Paste
ingredients: 1 1/2 ounces dried ancho chile powder | 1/3 cup tahini
instructions: Finely grind the ancho chile powder. Stir in the tahini, mixing until the mixture resembles fine breadcrumbs. Keep in refridgerator while forming patties.

title: Beef Oratori (Filled Thin Rings)
ingredients: 1 lb nonfat beef broth or 1 lb veggie broth, of choice | 1 1/2 tablespoons yeast or 1 1/2 tablespoons active dry yeast
instructions: Place the broth and yeast in the bowl of your mixer. Whisk at high speed with a paddle attachment for 1 minute or until foamy. Let stand till foamy about a minute. Add enough broth for the loaves to fit the cup. With the mixer at low speed knead for 5 minutes or until dough is smooth and creamy, adding more broth if necessary. Place in an oiled bowl with a rim, cover with a cloth and let rise in a warm place until doubled in bulk. About 45 minutes. Divide dough into 14 equal rings. Cover and let rise 20 more minutes. Roll dough and stretch with hands to cover as much fat as possible. Place on a floured work surface and knead a few times. Place in an oiled container and refrigerate. Bread must cool completely before serving. This makes enough when refrigerated it will last up to 2 weeks.

title: Gourmet Mushroom Bruschetta
ingredients: 2 roma tomatoes, diced small | 20 cremini mushrooms, sliced thin | 1 teaspoon dry sherry ( or 2 tbsp sherry granules ) | 1 cup cheese | basil leaves or other fresh herb, to taste ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients.

Random Ingredients: cotija cheese,lemon peel,italian tomato,green lentil,farfalle pasta
title: Finger-Lickened Lentils and Tomatoes With Cotija Cheese
ingredients: 12 ounces dry green lentils, rinsed and picked over ( puy lentils ) | 1 cup chopped italian tomato | 2 teaspoons grated lemon peel ( packed of about 1 lemon ) | 1/4 cup crumbled cotija cheese ( about 3.5 oz. ) | 9 ounces cooked italian style farfalle pasta, with a bite, drained ( bowtie pasta )
instructions: Bring 2 quarts lightly salted water to boil in a large pot. Add lentils, heat to boiling, reduce heat and simmer until lentils are just tender, about 8 minutes. Drain. Transfer lentils to bowl. In 4 - 8 inch nonstick skillet, add tomatoes, peel, and cotija cheese. Heat over medium high heat until just hot, about 1 minute. Add lentils and enough warm water to just cover. Cover, reduce heat to low, and simmer just until lentils are bubbly and slightly thickened, about 10 minutes. Stir in cooked italian style farfalle pasta and remaining 1/4 cup water. Heat to boiling, reduce heat and simmer, covered, until pasta is tender and most of the liquid has been absorbed, about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: bamboo shoot,worcestershire sauce,thai red chili pepper,shiitake mushroom,serrano pepper,tap water,mango
title: Sour Mushroom, Tomato & Banana Stir Fry
ingredients: 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 serrano pepper, finely sliced | 1 teaspoon thai red chili pepper, very finely sliced | 3 ounces shrimp mushrooms, sliced | 3 ounces bamboo shoots, sliced | 1 tablespoon tap water | 2 slices mangoes, peeled, halved
instructions: Combine worcestershire sauce, serrano, chile, mushrooms, bamboo and tap water in a small bowl and set aside. Add mango and gently stir to coat. Add sauce mixture to vegetables and gently stir through. Serve immediately.

title: Pesto Baby Spinach
ingredients: 7 cups packed baby spinach | 1/4 cup dressing, or to taste
instructions: Place baby spinach in a large bowl. Cover the spinach with the dressing, and stir until evenly coated.

Random Ingredients: wheat pasta,cranberry sauce,gruyere cheese,spaghetti sauce,cream,xanthan gum,penne pasta
title: Swiss Macaroni and Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb penne pasta | 1 cup whole wheat pasta | 1 jar spaghetti sauce | 1 cup sour cream | 2 cups shredded gruyere cheese | 1 teaspoon xanthan gum | 1 cup fresh cranberry sauce
instructions: Prepare pasta as directed on package, adding spaghetti sauce and sour cream to the water, to prevent the pasta from sticking to the bottom of the pan. Drain pasta well and return to pan. Add cheese sauce, cranberry sauce and xanthan gum to the pasta and lightly coat. Transfer to a 3 quart casserole and bake at 350ºf for 40 minutes, stirring to combine. Garnish with sliced cherries if desired.

Random Ingredients: dark grape juice,baby spinach,serrano pepper,cayenne pepper,nutmeg
title: Mexican Spinach
ingredients: 8 ounces fresh baby spinach | 3 1/2 cups dark grape juice | 4 fresh serrano peppers, stemmed and minced | 1/8 teaspoon freshly grated nutmeg | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Cook spinach at a high boil in a kettle of salted water for 5 - 8 minutes or until just tender.

title: Tortilla Bread
ingredients: 1 package masa harina mix | 2 teaspoons fennel seeds | 1 corn tortillas
instructions: Mix masa harina, fennel seed, and corn tortilla together in a mixing bowl with a fork until a dough forms. Roll out dough to desired thickness and shape.

Random Ingredients: angostura bitter,orange juice,cocoa powder,cranberry juice,rice noodle,pimiento,stuffing mix,egg white
title: Rice Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup orange juice | 3/4 cup cranberry juice | 4 tablespoons sweet unsalted pimientos, chopped | 1 cup seasoned stuffing mix | 1 cup rice noodles, cooked | 1 egg white | 1 tablespoon cocoa powder | 1 1/2 tablespoons angostura bitters
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients thoroughly. Cover and refrigerate for up to two hours. Mix together egg white and cocoa powder in a small dish. Sprinkle bitters over the salad mixture. Drain the noodles, then arrange them on top of the mixture and serve.

title: Quick & Easy Low-Carb Crock Pot Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 lb lean stewing beef | 1 medium green capsicum | 14 1/2 ounces vegetable broth
instructions: Dice beef into bite sized pieces heat oil in a frying pan and brown the meat quickly.

title: Tomato Freezes
ingredients: 1 can diced tomatoes with juice | 1 apple, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon mixed spice
instructions: Mix all together. Spread in ziplock bag, or other freezer proof dish. Label and freeze.

title: Pine Nut and Pea Saute
ingredients: 1/2 cup finely chopped fresh dill seed | 1/4 cup pine nuts | 1/4 teaspoon crushed dried split peas | 1 can low sodium chicken broth
instructions: Mix the dill seeds and pine nuts in a small nonstick skillet set over medium high heat. Toast the pine nut mixture, stirring constantly, for about 5 minutes. Stir in the split peas, and bring the mixture to a boil. Reduce heat to low, and simmer 5 minutes, stirring frequently. Transfer the paesean mixture to a warm serving bowl, and cool for about 30 minutes.

title: Baked Spicy Beef and Pineapple
ingredients: 1 lb ground meatballs ( i use extra lean ) | 1 jar crushed pineapple | 2 teaspoons ground cinnamon | 1 -2 cup parsnips, grated
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Mix together the meat, pineapple, cinnamon, and parsley. Grease a 2 quart baking dish with the fat, add pieces of the meat mixture and mix thoroughly. Bake approximately 35 - 45 minutes until browned and heated through.

title: Potstickers
ingredients: 450 g egg noodles | 1 red capsicum or 1 red pepper, sliced | 2 tablespoons dried oregano | 400 g semisweet chocolate
instructions: Cook the noodles in a large pan of boiling water for 10 - 12 minutes or until tender. Drain. Meanwhile, heat a small non stick frying pan, then fry the capsicum for 45 - 60 seconds. Place the dried oregano on a plate. Drain the noodles, return to the pan and dry them slightly. Add the capsicum, stir and cook for 30 seconds. Using 2 tablespoons of the reserved pasta water, stir in the chocolate until the mixture is smooth. Remove from the heat and serve.

title: Pasta Salad from the Country House
ingredients: 8 ounces macaroni, medium heat ( i use ronzoni ) | 8 cups shredded romaine lettuce
