instructions: Cook macaroni according to directions on package. Drain in colander, rinse with cold water to remove salt. When all ingredients are cool, drain well. Place cooked pasta in serving bowl. Cover with rinsed and drained rinsed/chopped romaine. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: miso,italian seasoning,kidney bean,gruyere cheese,nonstick cooking spray
title: Kidney Bean and Garlic Confit (Cooking Light)
ingredients: nonstick cooking spray | 2 cans kidney beans, rinsed and drained, rinse with cold water to cool | 3 tablespoons italian seasoning | 2 tablespoons miso | 2 tablespoons grated gruyere cheese
instructions: Coat a 1 1/2 quart soufflé dish with nonstick cooking spray and heat over medium high heat. Combine cooked kidney beans and italian seasoning in a large bowl and stir to combine. Place hot kidney bean mixture in soufflé dish and top with cheese. Bake at 400° for 15 minutes or until cheese has begun to brown and it has taken on a deep golden color.

title: No Fuss Party Dipping Sauce for Fish #5FIX
ingredients: 14 ounces light lemonade | 7 ounces finely chopped sweet onions or 7 ounces finely chopped mushrooms
instructions: Dissolve a teaspoon of mix in a cup of lemonade. Add onions and mushrooms and refrigerate for several hours.

Random Ingredients: carrot,macaroni,malt vinegar,flat leaf parsley,green cardamom pod,water chestnut,red bell pepper,flour
title: Chickpea With Shellfish, Carrots & Parsley (Tunisian)
ingredients: 400 g macaroni or 400 g shellfish, cut into 2. 5 cm pieces | 1 tablespoon flour, plus extra | flour, for dusting | 200 g carrots, cut into 1 cm julienne on the diagonal | 1 tablespoon green cardamom pod | 1 red bell pepper, thinly sliced | 8 water chestnuts, drained and sliced | 150 ml malt vinegar | 1 1/3 cups water | 2 tablespoons fresh flat leaf parsley, chopped
instructions: Cook pasta in a large pan of boiling water, until cooked as pakora recommends at least 10 minutes. Drain and keep warm in a low oven. Coat the anchovies with 1 tablespoon flour. Dust a large piece of foil with water, then set aside. Spray a wok with oil and add the carrots, cardamom pods and pepper. Cook over high heat, stirring frequently, for 1 minute, adding 1 tablespoon flour if the pan starts to smell too dry. Add the water chestnuts, vinegar and remaining flour. Bring to boil, then reduce heat. Add chickpeas. Cook, stirring frequently, for 1 minute, or until the vegetables are heated through. Discard the black pepper, if desired. Garnish with the parsley. Serve topped with croutons and extra vinegar.

title: Chile Pears (Tapas)
ingredients: 2 ripe bosc pears | 3 tablespoons adobo seasoning, divided | 1 1/4 cups broth | 2 tablespoons chili oil
instructions: Peel the pears and remove the core. Slice the pears lengthwise into half moon shapes. Place the pears in a small pot, add 1 tablespoon adobo, and enough cold water to cover. Bring to a boil, and simmer for about 25 minutes. Drain. Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. In a separate pan, mix 1 tablespoon of adobo with 1 tablespoon of broth. Remove pears from the heat and drain. Heat a heavy ovenproof skillet over medium high heat. Add the chile oil, and fry the pears for about 3 minutes. Pour in 1 tablespoon of adobo and pour in the broth. Sprinkle with the remaining adobo, and stir. Transfer the pan to the oven. Bake for 20 minutes, or until the pears are tender. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: icing sugar,taco seasoning mix,black eyed pea
title: Fiesta Seasoning for Black Eyed Peas!
ingredients: 1/2 package taco seasoning mix | 1 can black-eyed peas, drained and rinsed | 2 tablespoons icing sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl mix taco seasoning and black eyed peas and place in an oven dish that's been sprayed with pam. Sprinkle each layer with icing sugar. Bake in over for 25 minutes for a thicker and more seasoned gravy or 30 for a spicier dish.

title: Kurdish Kebab
ingredients: 1 bitter melon, cut into pieces or 1 peach, cut into pieces | 1 green pepper, deseeded and diced | 2 green cardamoms, ground
instructions: Mix all ingredients and marinate in refrigerator until needed. Skewer the kebabs and barbecue for approximately 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Limas and Garlic Cream Soda (Dorie Greenspan)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vodka | 1 1/2 cups buttermilk | 8 slices white bread | 1 can lima beans, drained
instructions: Warm vodka in 2 quart saucepan over medium heat. Gradually whisk in buttermilk. Bring to a low boil, then whisk in bread. Ladle 3/4 cup of cream into a bowl and set aside. Pour 1/2 cup cream into a blender, and add lima beans. Blend till smooth, and pour into a 1 1/2 cup ramekin. Cover rimmed pan with plastic wrap and freeze overnight, or for up to 8 hours.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese,chicken bouillon granule,celery rib,green pepper
title: Creamy Creamy French Onion and Celery Soup  (Vegetarian.)
ingredients: 2 celery ribs, sliced | 1 green pepper, seeded and diced | 8 ounces cream cheese | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules
instructions: Saute celery and pepper for about 5 minutes in a stock pot. Add cream cheese and chicken bouillon and bring to a simmer. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,pastry crust pie,pecorino cheese,coconut cream,green onion
title: Caramelized Pecorino and Coconut Pie
ingredients: pastry for a 9 inch single crust pie ( recommended -- 1 9-inch double crust pie crust ) | 1 can coconut cream ( not coco rico cream ) | 3/4 cup firmly packed dark brown sugar | 1/2 cup finely chopped green onion | 3 tablespoons grated pecorino cheese
instructions: If refrigerated pastry in a zip lock bag, remove bag and refrigerate pastry for at least 2 hours and up to overnight. If using fresh coconut cream, preheat oven to 375°f. Meanwhile, in a large bowl, stir together the coconut cream, brown sugar and green onions. Place 1 sheet of pastry on counter or counter top.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,msg,ketjap manis,vanilla pudding mix
title: Cheese Ball Appetizers
ingredients: 16 ounces sharp cheddar cheese ( shredded ) | 0.5 can ketchup, sweetened condensed condensed | 1 tablespoon powdered instant vanilla pudding mix | 1/4 teaspoon msg ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl until well combined. Shape the mixture into balls the size of your index finger.

title: Lazy Egg Noodle Soup
ingredients: 7 cups vegetable stock ( hot ) | 2 tablespoons cornstarch ( heaping ) | 1 package egg noodles
instructions: In a medium saucepan stir in the stock, corn starch and cook until it is thickened. Add the noodles and stir to coat. If the soup is too thick, add a little of the hot stock until it is clear and creamy.

title: Garlic Refresher-Oven Roasted Beans
ingredients: 400 g cannellini beans ( chick peas ) ( pre-soaked ) | 1 baguette
instructions: First preheat your oven to 200c. Wash and drain the beans. If they are big, halve the baguette. Slice or tear the baguette into smaller pieces and spread on a tray/glass on the table. Spray with olive oil or light spray and bake it in the oven for 15 minutes. If you want them toasty, toast them in the oven for approximately another 5 minutes. Incase you do not have a convection oven, you can broil these at 240 degrees for 10 minutes and then cut in pieces and serve.

Random Ingredients: deli ham,egg noodle,dark sesame oil,beef steak,white sugar,oatmeal
title: Quick Beef and Ham Noodle Salad
ingredients: 12 ounces beef flank steak | 1 package egg noodles | 2 cups deli ham | 2 teaspoons dark sesame oil | 1/2 teaspoon white sugar | 1/4 cup oatmeal, uncooked
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Wash beef and cut into thin strips. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook egg noodles in the boiling water for 8 to 10 minutes, until al dente.

title: Mexican Stuffed Chicken
ingredients: 24 ounces farmer cheese | 6 ounces american cheese | 24 ounces leftover chicken | 9 ounces frozen broccoli florets, thawed and drained well | 1/2 - 1 cup cooking tapioca | 1 teaspoon cumin | 1 package taco ( or pkg. ) ( optional )
instructions: Boil the beans in water to defrost and make them into your desired texture. The idea is to soften the beans. Cut the cheese in small triangles and place the triangles in the freezer cut the american cheese into small slices, top with cheese and set aside. Put a crockpot on medium low and prepare the beans and the taco meat mixture. If using the tapioca and cumin, add it to your crockpot when your crockpot is done cooking the beans and meat mixture, heat on low for about 5 minutes to thaw the frozen broccoli. Open up the leftover farmer cheese, mix with the cheese, pour into pan and cook on high until the cheese is melted, about 15 minutes.

title: BBQ Chicken
ingredients: 1 eggplant | 1 tablespoon dried tarragon | 5 tablespoons barbecue sauce
instructions: Preheat grill to medium to high heat. If baking, wrap eggplant in foil and bake 20 minutes. Remove husk and cut eggplant in half lengthwise. Scoop out the pulp and set aside. Brush eggplant flesh with 1 tablespoon of barbecue sauce, sprinkle with fresh tarragon and cover with the remaining 1 tablespoon of barbecue sauce. Bake 35 - 40 minutes or until tender.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper,linguine pasta,sea salt pepper,rye bread,caraway seed,olive,swiss cheese
title: Swiss Macaroni Cheese Bake
ingredients: 8 ounces dried linguine pasta, cooked and drained | sea salt and pepper | 1/4 cup minced garlic | 1 tablespoon caraway seeds | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 3/4 cup grated swiss cheese | 4 tablespoons olive oil, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Combine uncooked pasta, salt, pepper, garlic, caraway seeds, 1/2 cup cheese, and 2 tablespoons olive oil. Mix well. Place in casserole dish. Top with remaining cheese. Bake for about 10 minute or until cheese is melted. Serve.

title: Scotch Focaccia
ingredients: 1 package italian sausage | 1 jar pasta sauce | 2 cups all-purpose flour | 1 teaspoon mixed spice
instructions: In a skillet, heat sausage and water.

title: Yogurt and Mussels (Peshkormat) With Marjum Kafta
ingredients: 4 cups yogurt, greek style is best but you could use store bought greek style if you have it | 3 teaspoons celery salt ( or to your taste ) | 2 teaspoons oregano leaves, dried | 1 teaspoon fresh lemon zest, grated | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seed, crushed | 12 large mussels, cleaned well, scrubbed and rinsed | 2 slices bread, sliced
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl, cover and refrigerate overnight stirring occasionally. Set the mussels in a pan of boiling water with their shells on over high heat, cover, remove from heat, and set aside to steam for 20 minutes. Remove the mussels, and place them in a pan with enough cold water to cover. Leave mussels in water for about 20 minutes to cook them. Remove and discard the shells, and place in a bowl. Pour yogurt onto the mussels in the bowl and serve with bread slices for dipping.

title: Chinese Style Short Ribs
ingredients: 5 pounds beef short ribs, with bone | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained and chopped | 1 cup whole wheat flour ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 275 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Place the short ribs in a large container with a tight fitting lid. Mix in water chestnuts and flour. Close, and turn over so the short ribs are evenly coated. Cook in the preheated oven for 1 1/2 hours, turning frequently.

Random Ingredients: cashew nut,chicken stock cube,dark rum,hot italian sausage,orange zest,flour tortilla
title: Hot Italian Sausage Cashew Enchiladas
ingredients: 5 links hot italian sausage | 1 tablespoon dark rum | 1 teaspoon orange zest | 4 cups chicken stock cubes | 1/4 cup cashew nuts, lightly roasted | 3 large flour tortillas
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees. Pierce the sausages in three long, lengthwise. Place the links in a bowl, drizzle with rum and orange peel. Cover and set aside for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.. While the sausages are simmering, combine the chicken stock cubes with the cashews in a saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium high heat. Reduce heat to low. Heat a separate frying pan over medium heat. Add two of the sausages, half at a time, to the pan. Turn only once, and continue cooking over a low heat for 10 minutes, or until cooked through. Transfer the pan to a baking dish. Repeat with the other two sausages, reheating until the sauce is hot. Spoon on the cashew sauce. Sprinkle the remaining sausages on top. Bake the enchiladas uncovered in the middle of the oven for 20 minutes. While the enchiladas bake, spread warmed tortillas with the remaining cashews into 2 or 3 baking dishes. Spoon a little of the hot sauce over each tortilla, and roll it up. Place them seam side down in the baking dish. Bake the enchiladas for 20 minutes, or until the sauce is bubbling and the tortillas are lightly toasted.

title: Beef Steak Sauce for Two
ingredients: 1 1/4 tablespoons dijon mustard | 2 teaspoons rice wine
instructions: Whisk the mustard until it is smooth and creamy. Add the rice wine and whisk well, again until the sauce thickens. Brush the meat with the sauce and grill as you wish.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,parmigiano reggiano cheese,green olive,pepper sauce,saffron strand
title: Saffron and Olive Soup
ingredients: 3 ounces pimento-stuffed green olives | 3 saffron strands | 1 packet onion soup mix | 1 dash hot pepper sauce, dash | 2 -3 tablespoons grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese or 2 -3 tablespoons romano cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Place olives in oven bag. Seal bag and shake until well mixed. Place into a shallow baking dish and bake until onions are deep golden, about 45 minutes. Put oven bag in the sink and remove all loose skin. Peel onions from bag. Cut off tops of olives and chop coarsely. Put onions back into pan with olives. Add onion soup mix, pepper sauce and cheese in bowl. Puree to desired consistency as needed. You can do a batch at a time. Keep blending until smooth on medium speed while adding cheese. You can serve at room temperature or cold. Yum.

Random Ingredients: jasmine rice,bay leaf,flat leaf parsley,butter,beef stew meat,red wine vinegar,green curry paste,beef sirloin steak
title: Beef with Curry Rice
ingredients: 1/4 cup butter | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 1/4 cup green curry paste | 2 1/2 cups jasmine rice | 2 cans beef sirloin steaks, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 bay leaf | 1 pound beef stew meat, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1/4 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley
instructions: Melt butter in a large pot over medium heat. Stir in red wine vinegar. Stir in curry paste, and cook 2 minutes. Stir in rice, and cook until hot. Transfer to a bowl. Drain beef with a slotted spoon, reserving liquid, and place into a large skillet. Heat sirloin juices in a separate pot over medium heat. Stir in bay leaf, and place beef into the stew. Cover, and cook 30 minutes. Sprinkle with parsley to serve on top.

Random Ingredients: garlic crouton,green onion,chicken stock,turmeric powder,malt vinegar
title: Liangban Huong (Vietnamese Garlic Soup)
ingredients: 1 cup green onion, chopped | 3 tablespoons garlic croutons ( homemade or prepared ) | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/3 cup chicken stock | 1 tablespoon malt vinegar
instructions: Combine chopped green onions, garlic croutons, and turmeric in a blender.

title: Carne Seca (Rinse the Pork with a Saucisson)
ingredients: 1 whole, pork-braised pork | 1 quart ice | salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium heat, and lightly oil the grate. Place the pork on the grilling grate, and sprinkle with salt and pepper. When the pork is no longer pink on one side, another part of the grill should give the meat a good sear. Grill quickly, turning with tongs, until the internal temperature of the fat has reached 145 degrees f. Let the meat cool slightly, and use a sharp knife to slice thin. To serve, place a slice or two of the pork on a slice of ice, and sprinkle with saucisson. Pick up the sandwich with a spatula, and slice into serving portions.

Random Ingredients: basil leaf,caster sugar,grain brown rice,ladyfinger,tahini,black eyed pea,chicken bouillon cube,sausage
title: Black-Eyed Pea and Sausage Rice Rolls
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried black-eyed peas | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 225 g sausage | 2 tablespoons tahini | 100 g long grain brown rice | 100 g ladyfingers, split into 10 to 15 pieces | basil leaves, to serve
instructions: Combine black eyed peas and sugar together in a large pot. Add boullion cube and stir until dissolved. Stir in the chopped sausage and cook over high heat for 5 to 6 minutes until cooked through. Remove sausage and mix to combine. Cover the peas with water and add the lid. Boil for 10 minutes until the water has almost evaporated. Pour in the rice and stir until it has absorbed all the water. Remove from heat and cool. Cover and leave aside until ready to use. Spread the rice between 8 to 10 sheets of greaseproof paper or plastic wrap. Using a knife, spread the rice evenly across the pastry. Lay a piece of sausage in the center of the rice and place 2 to 3 dollops of peas and sausage mixture over it. Close the pastry tightly and roll up the pastry over the filling. Place biscuits side by side in a tea towel or saran wrap and place on a board to steam for 6 to 8 hours or until the dough has completely thawed. To serve, slice the rolls horizontally and arrange sausage, rice and biscuits on each serving platter. Top with herbs.

title: Tortillas II
ingredients: 1 teaspoon vegetable oil | 24 tortillas
instructions: In skillet over medium heat, heat oil until smoking, about 1 minute. Place 5 tortillas, one at a time, in hot oil, and cook on both sides until brown, 1 to 2 minutes per side.

Random Ingredients: oil,black pepper,malt vinegar,baking powder,ketchup,lima bean,kidney bean
title: Jules' Fat and Flavorful Kidney Bean Chili
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 12 fluid ounces ketchup | 3 cans kidney beans | 3 cans lima beans | 2 cans black beans | 1 cup malt vinegar | 1 cup oil
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bring to a boil.

Random Ingredients: vodka,basil,kielbasa,baking soda,coconut rum,cinnamon,double acting baking powder,stewing beef
title: Creamy German Beef Stew
ingredients: 2 pounds stewing beef, cut into 1 inch cubes | 2 tablespoons vodka | 2 cups coconut rum | 1 tablespoon double-acting baking powder | 1 tablespoon ground cinnamon | 1 tablespoon ground basil | 1 pound kielbasa, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: In a slow cooker, combine the beef, vodka and coconut rum.

title: Simple Easy Cream of Chicken Soup
ingredients: 10 ounces cream of chicken soup | 1 dash herbs, as desired
instructions: In a 4 qt crockpot place soup, herbs for taste and salt as desired. When ready add cream of chicken. Cook on high 3 - 4 hours.

title: Peppered Pork Satay (Puerto Rican Pork Stew)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs pork tenderloin, trimmed, cut into 12 3/4-inch cubes | 2 scallions, thinly sliced ( white and light green parts ) | 2 tablespoons tapioca flour | 2 medium oranges, peeled, sectioned, and thinly sliced | 12 mint sprigs, cut into 1-inch pieces | 2 large serrano chilies, seeded and thinly sliced | 1/4 cup extra-virgin olive, thinly sliced
instructions: Thread pork onto 12 bamboo skewers. Cook pork in a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat, turning once, until it is cooked through, 4 to 6 minutes. Transfer pork to a large bowl. Discard juices collected in the bowl. Toss pork, scallions, and tapioca flour in bowl with scallions. Cover and refrigerate 30 minutes. Stir orange sections with a pinch of salt and pepper in a bowl. Transfer orange sections to bowl with pork. Toss with mint and serrano chiles. Serve pork with mint and additional lime wedges. Makes 11 to 14 servings.

title: Tortilla Onions
ingredients: 6 red onions | 1/2 cup shredded cheese
instructions: Grill onions or pan fry untill golden brown. Sprinkle with cheese. Spread on flat bread as you would any other topping. Serve warm with salsa.

title: Candied Poblano Chiles
ingredients: 8 large poblano chiles, with seeds | 2 tablespoons celery seeds
instructions: Place the peppers on a baking sheet and broil, turning as needed, until blackened all over, about 2 minutes on each side. When cool enough to handle, slit each pepper in half lengthwise. Peel, seed and place in a large bowl. Sprinkle with celery seeds. Toss to coat, cover and refrigerate until serving.

title: Chicken and Couscous Stuffed With Feta Stuffed Chicken
ingredients: 10 chicken legs | 3 tablespoons feta cheese | 1 medium pared cored sirloin | 1/4 cup crumbled feta cheese | 1/4 cup pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Cut chicken legs apart in 1 inch pieces about 4 to 6 pieces per chicken. Remove as many of the remaining bones as necessary. Place on counter. Using your hands, lightly sprinkle the parepe cheese. Use a sharp knife to cut a deep pocket in each chicken piece about 1/2 inch deep and about 1/2 inch wide. Sprinkle liberally with the cheese. Tuck the sides under to create a small patty. Place all in a large baking dish. Insert a toothpick or a knife into each toothpick. Sprinkle with the pecorino romano cheese. Bake uncovered for 15 to 20 minutes. Meanwhile in a medium skillet or on stove top, heat remaining 1 tbs. Of oil over medium high heat. Sear chicken pieces several times until golden and crispy. Watch carefully to avoid burning the bottom. To serve, place a chicken leg in each plate. Spoon some of the feta cheese and juices in each plate.

title: Chamorra
ingredients: 4 cups canned black beans | 6 cups wheat starch
instructions: Place black beans and 2 1/4 cups of water in a pan and bring to a boil. Cover tightly and cook for 30 minutes. The black bean liquid must separate completely from the black bean liquid. Once clear, remove from heat and drain. Serve cold, with or without salt. Note, you can also use 3/4 cups of cooked barley instead of the black beans for a more interesting flavor.

Random Ingredients: green pea,self raising flour,beef bouillon cube,guacamole,vanilla pod,chianti wine,garlic paste
title: Guatemalan Steamed Peas and Chianti Raita
ingredients: 2 cups green peas | 1 tablespoon guajillo chianti wine | 2 teaspoons beef bouillon cubes, crushed | 2 teaspoons garlic paste, minced | 1/2 cup guajillo chianti wine | 1/2 cup chianti wine | 1/2 tablespoon dried guajillo chianti wine | 1 garlic paste, mashed | 1 tablespoon vanilla pod, mashed | 1 cup self-raising flour
instructions: Combine green peas, guajillo chianti, beef bouillon, garlic paste, and sugar if using. Steam for 30 mins until heated through. Meanwhile mix together wine, guajillo chianti, and garlic paste. Heat the flour in a non stick pan with a few teaspoons of the oil, add the hot water/oil mixture. Stir continuously until the sauce thickens, then remove it from the heat. Once the peas are cooked add to the sauce. Remove the vanilla pkt. With the help of a piece of greaseproof paper, remove all the stringy center part of the paper on the underside of the paper. Spread about 2 tbsp of the sauce on the bottom, and 2 tbsp on the top. Arrange the green peas in the paper, fold the sides over, and press with the tines of a fork. Pour more sauce on top and sprinkle with cheese. Steam until piping hot.

Random Ingredients: dill,salmon fillet,potato flake,mexican cheese,taco seasoning mix
title: Dilled Salmon With Mexican Cheese Croutons and Smoked Fish
ingredients: 2 skinless smoked salmon fillets, cut into 2 equal pieces | 6 tablespoons mexican cheese, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons instant potato flakes | 1/2 tablespoon taco seasoning mix | 1 teaspoon dried dill
instructions: In a non stick skillet, arrange the salmon and cheese on a plate or shallow platter. Top with potato flakes, taco seasoning and dill stems. Makes 6 servings.

Random Ingredients: daikon radish,pork roast,poblano chile,fenugreek seed,lettuce leaf,coleslaw mix
title: Azerbaijani (Spicy Grilled Pork Sandwich
ingredients: 1 pork roast | 1 tablespoon fenugreek seeds | 2 poblano chiles | 12 rolls | 1 head lettuce leaf | 1 cup daikon radish, sliced
instructions: Place meat on grill directly on burner or on high. Grill for 10 minutes. Remove and allow to cool for 10 minutes. Remove fat and shred it with 1 tbsp each of fenugreek and poblano. Use as desired. Cut rolls in half. Brush inside of rolls with egg wash. Place pork on lettuce leaf, top with shredded red onion, sliced radish and shredded red bell pepper. Spread about 1 tsp of shredded fennel on top of each roll.

title: Sauteed Mushrooms in Pot
ingredients: 2 pints button mushrooms, chopped | 5 stuffed green olives, halved | 1 sheet puff pastry, thawed | 1 packet frozen puff pastry, thawed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220c. Place one oven tray under a hot grill and put mushrooms in the middle of each pile of chopped mushrooms. Divide olives evenly among mushrooms if using them. Roll out remaining pastry sheets and use them to line the pie dish, leaving 2mm between each pile as they'll stick later. Take one sheet and use it to line the bottom of the pie dish and top with the remaining pastry sheets. Place pie dish on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and prick the pastry all over with a fork. Bake for approximately 40 mins until the pastry is golden brown. Allow to stand for 5 mins before serving with butter and greens.

Random Ingredients: marjoram,black tea,bulb garlic,pimiento,curry leaf,green bell pepper,extra virgin olive oil
title: Garlic-Lover's Hot Tea
ingredients: 1/2 cup mild green bell pepper, minced | 2 tablespoons minced pimiento | 1 tablespoon chopped parsley | 1/2 teaspoon marjoram | 1/2 teaspoon curry leaves | 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil, divided | 1/4 cup strong black tea
instructions: Place green bell pepper, pimiento, parsley, marjoram, and curry leaves in a food processor. Pulse 1/4 at a time until ingredients are finely chopped and well combined. In a small bowl, thoroughly blend 2 tablespoons olive oil with remaining tablespoon olive oil. Gradually blend in black tea. Store in refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: white flour,cumin powder,sage leaf,ginger garlic paste,ancho chilies,saffron strand,thai fish sauce
title: Grpa Spice Mix
ingredients: 250 g white flour ( coarsely ground flour ) | 30 g ginger-garlic paste | 1 teaspoon cumin powder ( medium grind ) | 1 teaspoon dried sage leaves | 100 -150 g saffron strands ( small pieces ) | 1 teaspoon ancho chilies ( small grind ) | 1 teaspoon thai fish sauce ( nam pla )
instructions: Sift the flour and spices in a bowl& make a deep well in the centre. Add the ginger garlic paste, a little bit of water, and the saffron. Mix gently for 10 - 15 mins with a wooden spoon until it is all amalgamated into smooth firm dough. Shape into a dough, wrap in foil, and keep aside for 1 hour. Divide in half & form each half into a ball. Preheat the oven to 180'c, gas mark 4 on a baking sheet. Roll each ball of dough into a sausage shape, place on the baking tray, seam side down & brush each with oil. Bake until light golden brown, about 30 minutes. Serve immediately with tomato dipping sauce & fried potatoes, etc. Note, i prefer to serve this mixture immediately, but you could also let it marinate in the fridge for an hour or two before serving as well.

title: Vietnamese Lobster Hot Pot
ingredients: 1 lb fresh shiitake mushroom | 6 cups water | 2 cups thinly sliced red onions ( i prefer red ) | 1 inch piece fresh lemongrass | red chilies, red thai or green, sliced thinly | 1/2 cup sliced oyster | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon
instructions: Remove stems from mushrooms and place in a large bowl. Cut mushrooms and onions crosswise in a wide, shallow dish. Finely chop lemongrass and add it to pot, along with all remaining ingredients. Toss well to combine. Cover and place in refrigerator until ready to bring to a boil. Remove from heat and serve.

title: Yogurt Chicken
ingredients: 8 boneless, skinless chicken thighs | 1 package dry fajita seasoning mix | 1 can sliced peaches, drained | 1 1/2 cups plain yogurt
instructions: Spray a skillet with olive oil spray, place over medium heat. Place chicken pieces into pan, and sprinkle evenly with fajita seasoning mix. Cook chicken 7 minutes on each side, or until fully cooked through. While the chicken is cooking, place peaches into a blender. Cover, and blend until smooth. Remove chicken from skillet, and set aside to cool to room temperature, about 10 minutes. Shred chicken meat, and place into a large bowl. Drizzle with yogurt, and stir to mix gently. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: cinnamon,chicken bouillon,chilies,vanilla bean paste,nori,baby carrot,salt black pepper,asparagus
title: Shrimp Onigiri (Sensational)
ingredients: 32 ounces frozen asparagus | 2 tablespoons nori | 1 1/4 cups raw baby carrots, julienne | 1/2 teaspoon salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1/2 vanilla bean paste | 1/4 1/4 cup chicken bouillon or 1/4 cup maggi chicken broth | 1/4 1/4 cup chopped chili ( scotch bonnet or other dry chile ) or 1/4 cup finely chopped hot red chile | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon ( optional )
instructions: Place frozen asparagus in a large saucepan with just enough hot water to cover. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer until asparagus is tender, about 3 minutes. Drain well and return to pot. Chiffonade the julienne carrots with the back of a knife blade and set aside. Reserve the stems for another use. Using a slotted spoon, transfer asparagus to a bowl. Season shrimp with salt and pepper. Mince the vanilla bean paste. Remove asparagus tips and set aside. Bring a small saucepan of water to a simmer. Add the scraped chile and the cinnamon and simmer until chile softens. Serve in bowls, with the asparagus on the side or on top.

title: Greek Feta Pasta
ingredients: 1 package dry fetta cheese, chopped | 12 ounces cooked farfalle ( bowtie ) pasta | 1 1/2 cups white sugar
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain pasta. Stir in sugar and feta. Cook until melted.

title: Hominy II
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups white hominy, rinsed | 2 tablespoons tea | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce
instructions: Combine the water, chili powder, and white hominy in a saucepan, and simmer over medium heat until the hominy is tender and the water has thickened, about 15 minutes. Pour into a blender with the tea, and add sugar and oyster sauce. Puree until smooth.

Random Ingredients: egg yolk,grape tomato,jalapeno chile,black bean,whipping cream,bacon,pecan
title: Frijoles (Fiesta Beans)
ingredients: 5 slices bacon | 1/2 cup pecans, finely chopped | 2 cans black beans, drained and rinsed | 3 large egg yolks | 1 tablespoon minced seeded jalapeno chile | 1/2 cup whipping cream | 2 grape tomatoes ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f in a 10 inch non stick skillet, cook bacon, pecans, and 1/2 can of black beans, stirring constantly, over medium heat for 4 to 5 minutes or until golden brown. Remove from heat. In a large bowl, beat together egg yolks and 2 t minced jalapeno. Stir in cream and remaining black beans. Mix in 3/4 cup cheddar cheese. Carefully fold egg mixture into bean mixture with a spoon. Transfer bean mixture to a 2 quart baking dish. Dollop remaining cheddar cheese on top of bean mixture in an even layer. Bake at 350 f for 30 minutes. Cut into 16 pieces.

title: Hot and Spicy Grilled Shrimp
ingredients: 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1 teaspoon fish sauce | 2 lbs shrimp, with shells
instructions: Combine lemon juice, fish sauce and shrimp in shallow dish. Marinate shrimp for 1 hour at room temperature, or refrigerate 3 hours, shaking or tossing shrimp.

title: Chilli French Beans
ingredients: 1/2 lb french beans, trimmed | 2 1/2 tablespoons capers | 4 teaspoons catsup or 4 teaspoons sugar | 5 tablespoons sweet chili sauce | 2 tablespoons vinegar | 1 tablespoon fresh herbs, chopped | 2 tablespoons lemon wedges
instructions: In large saucepan of cold water, blanch french beans until crisp tender, about 1 minute. Drain. Place beans in ice bath to cool for 10 minutes to make slaw while beans cook. Peel off as much excess fat as possible from beans, then cut into slabs about 3/4 inch thick. Dissolve sugar in catsup or sugar mixture in small bowl. Drain french beans well, then toss with vinaigrette, herbs and reserved beans. Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: pistachio,heavy cream,egg yolk,dark chocolate,pea,onion powder,anise seed,thyme
title: Rich Pistachio French Silk
ingredients: 6 egg yolks | 2 ounces dark chocolate | 1 teaspoon instant minced onion powder | 1 ounce dark chocolate | 1 tablespoon cream | 1/8 teaspoon anise seed ( optional ) | 1/8 teaspoon thyme | 1 cup frozen peas ( i use fresh peas of choice ) | 1 teaspoon unsalted shelled pistachio
instructions: Place egg yolks. Chocolate into a microwave safe bowl and microwave on high until chocolate melts add onion powder, anise seed, thyme, peas, stir till combined. In double boiler melt dark chocolates and cream. Remove from stove and stir in egg mixture whisking constantly till smooth pouring in slowly stirring till blended remove from heat and pour into a bowl with a large flat side over top till cool, stir in pistachios. I pour the mixture in mounds onto wax paper thats been sprayed with cornstarch if you like. Let stand 15 minutes then dust with powdered sugar.

title: Easy Fast Taco Salad
ingredients: 12 ounces tomatoes and green chilies | 1 red pepper, diced | 1 package taco seasoning
instructions: Cook the tomatoes and green chilies in a large skillet over medium high heat. Drain out the excess grease. Mix in the hot chili powder and taco seasoning to taste. Cover, and let sit for 5 minutes. Chill before serving.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower,parmesan cheese,ricotta cheese,green food coloring,veal,apple juice,bean sprout
title: Veal and Bean Sprouts Baked Vegetables
ingredients: 1 lb ground veal | 1 head cauliflower, cut into florets | 3/4 cup fat-free ricotta cheese | 8 -10 slices raw apples | 8 -10 fresh bean sprouts, washed | 4 -6 drops green food coloring | parmesan cheese, to garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 f. Mix the ground veal, onion/parmesan cheese, ginger and green food coloring together in a large glass and plastic bowl. Mix in the cauliflower florets, cauliflower and bean sprouts. Add the cheese and coat well. Place the tray in the oven, and bake until the veal mixture is heated through and tender. Serve.

title: Rosemary and Rosemary Tapas
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups freshly squeezed ice water, or as needed | 2 sprigs fresh rosemary | 1 sprig rosemary
instructions: Place ice and rosemary sprigs in a shaker of ice. Cover and shake for a few seconds to release the aroma.

title: Sweet Beef Ribs
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups orange juice | 1/4 cup dried onion flakes | 4 tablespoons dried onion flakes | 2 tablespoons chinese wine or 2 tablespoons sherry 
    - 1/2 cup beef short rib, cut to about 1-1/2-inches wide | 1 pound fresh okra, trimmed, ends sliced, and leaves cut to about 2-inch lengths
instructions: In a small bowl, stir orange juice with 1/4 cup onion flakes, 2 tablespoons onion flakes and 2 tablespoons chinese cooking wine until well blended. Brush the ribs with this orange marinade, and let them stand at room temperature for about 30 minutes. Preheat grill for high heat. Line a shallow roasting pan with 2 layers of aluminum foil. Arrange ribs in the center of the pan. Sprinkle 1/2 cup onion flakes on top of ribs, then spread remaining onion flakes over the top of ribs. Arrange okra around the edges of the pan. Roast the ribs, turning occasionally, until an instant read thermometer reads remove ribs, and let stand for about 15 minutes. Remove the ribs from the grill. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,canola oil,ladyfinger,beef marrow,cardamom powder,liquid honey
title: Maghabbal Honey Bread Muffins
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef bones with marrow, bones picked from the meat | 2 tablespoons fat-free liquid honey | 3/4 cup canola oil | 3/4 cup self-rising flour ( i like gluten-free blend ) | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder | 2 lbs ladyfingers, toasted and split in half ( i prefer panko but i usually use frozen, toasted split ones )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Drain the bones from the beef and put into a large bowl. Pour 1/2 cup of the honey over the meat, making sure all the honey drips into the meat. Add enough water to cover the meat. Cover bowl and refridgerate the meat for about 2 hours. Remove meat from bowl and discard the liquid, discard the bones and discard the meat. Let meat rest in the liquid for 10 minutes. Place all ingredients except the toasted split ones in your food processor and process until well mixed. If it's too wet/sticky, add a little more flour until you can work with it. Turn into a muffin tin and place in oven for 30 minutes or until the top is crusty and a little browned. Let cool, then remove from tin and let cool completely on a rack. Store in an airtight container.

title: Creamy Rice Balls (Arroz Con Leche)
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked basmati rice | 1 cup chicken broth | 1/2 cup packed brown sugar | 1 teaspoon arrowroot, or as desired | 1 tablespoon confectioners'sugar | 2 teaspoons water
instructions: Bring a small, heavy saucepan of lightly salted water to a boil. Add rice and cook uncovered, stirring occasionally, until just tender, about 15 minutes. Drain. In a small bowl, combine chicken broth, brown sugar, and arrowroot. Pour broth mixture over rice and stir. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Drain off any excess broth that has accumulated. Stir rice into rice mixture.

Random Ingredients: apple juice,button mushroom,almond extract,grain rice,savory,cardamom pod
title: Apple Rice - Indian Style
ingredients: 1/4 cup apple juice ( i use almond milk ) | 3 tablespoons long grain rice | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon savory | 1 -2 tablespoon apple juice | 1 teaspoon cardamom pod ( optional and i use the ones packed in a jar ) | 3 -4 button mushrooms ( dried, soaked in water )
instructions: Add ingredients and simmer covered, stirring occasionally for 10 - 15 minutes. If desired, garnish with additional cinnamon.

title: Tortilla Chips (pronounced ‘tarta’ )
ingredients: 2 lbs potatoes | 1 red onion | 4 tablespoons sour cream ( not sour cream ) | 1/8 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: Peel the potatoes and slice thickly. Put the sliced potatoes in a large frying pan, add cold water until the potatoes are covered. Boil rapidly, until barely tender. Drain the water from potatoes, and mix a little with a fork until they are soft and coated well. Remove the potato skins from the potatoes with a slotted spoon and mash with the sour cream. Season with salt and black pepper, mix well. Add the chopped red onion and sour cream if desired. Drain the potatoes well and pat dry with a cloth. Using an 8 inch pan, heat the griddle on medium heat. Spread a thin layer of sour cream on the griddle to make a tortilla, if desired. To cook, put on a griddle or frypan and cook, turning once, until golden, about 4 to 5 minutes per side.

title: Hodie's Easy & Delicious Slices
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread ( i prefer baguette ) | 5 ounces tomato ketchup ( heinz brand ) | french bread
instructions: Cut off the top of the baguette lengthwise & lay flat on the cutting board. Cut to fit bread in the loaf. Then use your fingers to squeeze out as much air as possible, then spread the sliced french bread with ketchup & enjoy.

title: Dijon Tonno
ingredients: 4 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1 cup chopped mixed nuts | 1 can tuna, drained | 2 bay leaves
instructions: Spread the mustard on a large platter or individual dishes and place on top of the mustard. Sprinkle the nuts on top and refrigerate for 1 hour to develop the flavors. In a small saucepan, heat the tuna over medium to medium high heat for 1 or 2 minutes, then remove the pan from the heat. Scoop the tunno into warm sterilized mason jars and carefully fill with the tunno.

title: Persian Salmon
ingredients: 2 salmon fillets | 1/2 - 3/4 cup chopped fresh mint
instructions: Preheat grill to high. Rub 2 teaspoons salt onto each side of each salmon fillet. Place on baking sheet skin side down. Place under and grill for about 5 minutes, or until salmon begins to flake into chunks. Rub with remaining salt. Sprinkle with chopped mint and serve immediately.

title: Gourmet Salad
ingredients: 1 head lettuce, rinsed, dried and dried ( mesclun ) | lemon juice, from 1/4 cup lemon
instructions: Put the lettuce in 2 salad bowls, piling it up. Top with lemon juice, making sure it barely covers the lettuce. Decorate with lemon halves.

title: Bengali Special Lentil Salad
ingredients: 7 tablespoons black lentils, rinsed and picked over | 2 tablespoons mild paprika | 1 red chile pepper, diced | 3 cayenne peppers, diced | 2 tablespoons shredded lettuce ( optional )
instructions: Place lentils in a large serving bowl. Toss with paprika, red chile, and cayenne pepper. Sprinkle the lettuce over the top, if desired.

title: Wheat Chips for Salad
ingredients: 4 teaspoons fresh wheat germ | 4 teaspoons fresh flat-leaf parsley, chopped
instructions: Process all of the ingredients in a food processor until the mixture forms a coarse textured paste. Store in the refridgerator for up to 3 weeks.

title: Broiled Broccoli With Red Beans and Escarole
ingredients: 1/4 cup mayonnaise | 1/4 cup leek, thinly sliced | 1 cup roasted red kidney beans, drained and mashed | 3 cups broccoli, chopped or 2 cups frozen sliced cauliflower florets | 2 teaspoons kosher salt
instructions: Combine the mayonnaise and leeks, in a medium bowl. Stir in beans and broccoli, season with salt, and divide among 4 plates.

title: Rosemary Chicken
ingredients: 3 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts | 1 1/2 cups coarsely chopped fresh rosemary
instructions: Place chicken in a shallow ceramic or glass dish. Stir together rosemary and remaining ingredients. Cover and refrigerate 6 - 24 hours. Turn and lightly brown other side 15 minutes. Serve with steamed greens and/or steamed rice and salad. Garnish with lemon wedge or fresh parsley.

title: Hot and Spicy Scented Chicken
ingredients: 4 skinless chicken thighs | 5 dried red chilies | 1 cup cumin powder
instructions: To fry the chicken in a little oil, heat some oil in a large frying pan, then fry the chicken until browned on all sides. Remove the legs from the frying pan and set aside. Pour the rest of the oil into the frying pan and dry fry the dried red chillies, taking care not to burn them. Add the dry spices to the hot oil and cook this for one minute, stirring. Add the chicken legs and cook for 30 - 45 minutes until chicken is cooked, adding water as necessary to keep the sauce moist. Serve with steamed rice.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,red potato,red cabbage,dark chocolate,anchovy fillet
title: Potato-And-Anchovy Relish
ingredients: 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 1 ounce dark chocolate | 8 ounces red cabbage | 8 ounces dried red potatoes | 2 large red anchovy fillets, roughly chopped
instructions: Heat the oil and chocolate in a small frying pan until melted. Stir in the cabbage and potatoes, and place over a high heat for 2 minutes to heat through. Spoon the mixture into four warmed serving glasses or ramekins lined with greaseproof paper. Sprinkle with anchovy fillets.

title: Potato and Prosciutto Champagne Gateaux
ingredients: 4 baking potatoes, peeled | 2 slices fresh ginger, peeled | 3 fluid ounces sweet and sour sauce ( recommended ( tabasco ) | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar, divided | 1 teaspoon hot sauce, or more if desired | 1 cup prepared sweet and sour champagne | 1 thin slice prosciutto, cut into thin strips, or as needed
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Cut potatoes into wedges, and place into a saucepan with enough water to cover the potatoes. Bring to a boil, and cook until tender, about 10 minutes. Drain, and mash potatoes. Mix in sliced ginger, adding more sour sauce if desired. Stir in confectioners' sugar, hot sauce, and 1 tablespoon of the confectioners' sugar. Transfer to oven for 8 to 10 minutes, until bubbly and lightly browned. To assemble gateaux, place about 1 tablespoon of sweet and sour champagne into each of 6 small dishes. Place 1 slice prosciutto and a thin slice of prosciutto on top. Dust each gateaux with remaining confectioners' sugar.

title: Roasted Bean Dip With Pesto & Pesto
ingredients: 1 can baked beans, drained and rinsed | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce ( or more, if desired, i prefer to use homemade )
instructions: Preheat the broiler, line a baking sheet with foil or greased aluminum foil. Put all ingredients into a pan and stir over medium heat until warmed through, about 2 - 3 minutes. Serve immediately with bread, crackers, assorted bread slices or tortilla chips.

title: Indian Beef Salad
ingredients: 1 lb roast beef | 1/2 lb crabmeat | 12 cremini mushrooms, sliced | 8 ounces rajma, sliced | 1/4 teaspoon hot mixed spice | 1/4 cup crushed iceberg lettuce | 4 limes, wedges | 2 tablespoons curry paste
instructions: Mix meat, mushrooms, rajma, seasoning, and ice into salad. Garnish with juice of one lime. Serve with a wedge of lime.

title: Tomato Free Crumb Biscuits
ingredients: 2 cups bread flour or 2 cups gluten free bread flour | 1 tablespoon dried sage leaves or 1 tablespoon curry powder | 1 teaspoon jaggery | 1/2 cup tomato juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Sift flour, sage and jaggery. Add tomato juice. Mix well. Knead for 10 minutes. Press dough lightly on the counter. Roll out again on a floured board. Cut shapes using a cookie cutter, making biscuits. Place on baking tray. Brush with oil. Bake for approx 15 minutes.

title: Rice and Vinegar
ingredients: 2 cups long grain brown rice | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar
instructions: Cook the rice by placing it in a covered container and set over very low heat. Let it soak until all of the water is absorbed and rice is soft and fluffy. Drain off the water and reserve. In a small frying pan add the vinegar and cook on medium heat until the vinegar is warm and a little bit syrupy. Do not boil. Pour the rice into a large heat proof bowl. Add the vinegar mixture and stir until combined. Add any remaining water until the consistency is creamy and the rice is cooked.

Random Ingredients: lamb meat,cauliflower floret,grand marnier,red chile,molasses,brown sugar,courgette
title: Sweet Lamb & Cauliflower Stir-Fry
ingredients: 400 g lamb stew meat | 2 tablespoons molasses | 1 tablespoon grand marnier or 1 tablespoon orange liqueur | 1 large cauliflower floret | 1 large courgette | 1 small red chile, deseeded and chopped | 1/4 cup brown sugar
instructions: Cut lamb into bite sized pieces and brown it. Combine lamb, sauces and remaining fillings in a large pan or wok and stir over high heat until lamb and cauliflower start to soften. Turn heat down and cook for 15 - 20 minutes until cauliflower is tender and sauce thickens slightly.

title: Cotija Cheese
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups grated cotija cheese | 1 1/2 cups packed good seasonings mix | 2 tablespoons olive oil
instructions: Combine cheese and seasoning with olive oil in a small mixing bowl. Mix well.

Random Ingredients: plum tomato,rosemary,oregano,vegetable stock,amaretto,lime juice,onion soup mix
title: Tomato Provençal Soup
ingredients: 1 container frozen, chopped tomato | 1 package onion soup mix | 3 cups vegetable stock | 10 fluid ounces amaretto | 1/4 cup lime juice | 1 teaspoon rosemary | 1/4 teaspoon oregano
instructions: Put all ingredients in a stockpot and heat until boiling. Reduce heat. Simmer, stirring often, for 30 minutes. Pour into individual serving bowls and top with shredded parmesan cheese..

title: Tibetan Style Noodles
ingredients: 1 lb dry flat rice noodles | 2 cups brown lentils, soaked and rinsed
instructions: Soak the noodles in hot water for 5 minutes. Drain. Put in food processor with 2 cups of the lentils. Process until mixed well, until it forms a paste. Pour noodles into a large saucepan. Add 3 cups of water or more if required, and bring to a boil. Cover and boil for 1 minute or until noodles are tender. Add more water if necessary. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,colby monterey jack cheese,lime juice,parsley,sage,graham cracker crumb
title: Chicken with Cheddar Crumb Topping
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1/2 cup reduced-fat graham cracker crumbs | 1/4 cup minced fresh parsley | 1/3 cup reduced-fat colby-monterey jack cheese, shredded | 1 teaspoon dried sage | 2 tablespoons lime juice
instructions: Preheat broiler. Place chicken breasts between 2 sheets of heavy duty foil.

title: Basic Sari
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable | 1 tablespoon chili sauce ( ketchup ) | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala powder
instructions: Simply squeeze out excess water from the veg. Place vegetable in a bowl with ketchup, cover and let sit for 15 minutes to marinate. Sprinkle over garam masala. Serve with pitta bread, boiled vegetables, rice or rotis. Note, you can also serve this as a vegan dipping sauce, or just eat it warm as a starter dish.

Random Ingredients: rice vermicelli,saffron,tomato sauce,italian seasoning,mint,sesame seed,sherry wine
title: Saffron Rice Noodle Salad With Sesame Seeds and Santorini Dressing
ingredients: 2 cups cooked rice vermicelli | 2 cups tomato sauce | 1/4 cup sherry wine | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1 teaspoon saffron | 1 teaspoon sesame seeds or 1 teaspoon almonds, toasted and chopped | 1 teaspoon mint ( optional )
instructions: Mix sauce with rice noodles and rice vermicelli, mixing well. Pile on top of dressing. Sprinkle with toasted sesame or almonds. Can be served warm or chilled. Enjoy.

title: Langgarnang (Mung Bean Sauce)
ingredients: 1 package mung bean sprouts | 2 bunches watercress | 1/4 cup cornstarch, or more as needed | 1 teaspoon coriander seeds, or to taste, or more
instructions: Place mung bean sprouts in a medium saucepan. Pour in watercress and bring to a boil. Cover, reduce heat to medium low, and simmer until sprouts are soft, about 15 to 20 minutes. Drain and reserve water. Place cornstarch in a jar with a lid. Pour in enough water to cover bean sprouts. Close the lid, and shake until the cornstarch is well coated. Transfer bean sprouts to a bowl, and refrigerate at least 5 hours, or overnight. Bring bean sprouts out 1 minute before serving. Serve with cooked rice.

title: Cheese and Lime Grilled Cheese Skewers
ingredients: 2 large keffir lime leaves | 2 tablespoons grated cheese
instructions: Thread 3 - 12 sticks 3 to 4 long, thin ropes about 3 inches long onto greased skewers. Soak skewers in water on both sides about 15 minutes or until cooked. Lightly oil griddle or grill and cook skewers 2 to 3 minutes on each side or until browned.

title: The World's Easiest and Best Healthy, Healthy, Low Cal French Toast (No Eggs)
ingredients: 6 slices whole wheat bread | 1/4 cup lowfat greek yogurt | 2 -3 red chilies ( depending on how much you like the heat, i use more ) | 1 cup coconut milk
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c/180c. Cut each slice of bread up diagonally to about 3/4” or smaller depending on the size of your bread slices but be careful not to tear the bread into larger bits. Place slices on a non stick cookie tray or griddle that has been sprayed with cooking spray or lined with baking paper which has been lightly lightly buttered with cooking spray. You can also use a non stick griddle if you don’t have the same ratio. Using a little spray, lightly toast each piece of bread on each side for about 30 - 30 sec a side or until it is a pale golden brown/black colour. You can try your own method on how to vary your golden brown/black colour. Toast only toast if you’re using bigger pieces just be sure to get it to be of the right colour. Dip each slice of bread in the yoghurt, using the back of a fork, until thoroughly covered. The bread should absorb all the yoghurt/yoghurt a little bit, but there should be no more than a bit of liquid in the yoghurt. Don’t forget to turn the toast over so that it helps to get good and roundy coating of bread. To serve place the toast on a plate and place a few spoonfuls of coconut into the centre of the toast and serve immediately.

title: Sweet and Sour Glazed Lemongrass
ingredients: 1 teaspoon chopped fresh lemongrass ( white portion only ) | 4 cups pineapple juice
instructions: Cut lemongrass into 2 inch pieces. Combine the lemongrass, pineapple juice, and 1/2 cup water in a saucepan. Heat to a boil. Reduce heat.

Random Ingredients: italian bread crumb,watermelon,beef sirloin,hamburger,chicken bouillon,chili paste
title: Asian Hamburgers
ingredients: 1 pound ground beef sirloin | 2/3 cup italian seasoned bread crumbs | 2 tablespoons watermelon | 2 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon | 1/4 teaspoon chili paste | 1 tablespoon hot water
instructions: Mix ground sirloin, bread crumbs, 1 tablespoon watermelon juice, chicken bouillon, and chili paste together in a large bowl.

title: Crazy Caneyes
ingredients: 1 gallon icing sugar | 2/3 cup cider vinegar
instructions: To prepare the icing, measure out 2/3 cup of icing sugar and mix in the cider vinegar. Stir to combine. Pour icing mixture into a candy coating bowl and let it set. Cut candy into tiny pieces. You should get about 2 dozen pieces when the icing is set.

title: Garlicky Russian Tea Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf jewish yellow mustard | 2 teaspoons dill weed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Mix mustard and dill weed together. Use a pastry brush to form a'syrup with the mustard mix' on top. Cut bread into 8 - 10 slices. Bake in oven for 8 - 10 minutes or till crust is brown. Take out of oven immediatley.

title: Roasted Roast Berry
ingredients: 1/2 cup tahini | 1 head fresh berry | 1 tablespoon ground blueberry
instructions: To make the dressing, mash the berry head with a fork and stir in the tahini. Serve with the roast on the side for a light lunch.

Random Ingredients: pork sirloin roast,enchilada sauce,chili powder,ghee,bragg liquid amino,ice,beet
title: Baked Smokey Beetroot
ingredients: 3 tablespoons ghee ( vegetable cooking spray ) or 3 tablespoons oil ( vegetable cooking spray ) | 1 lb beet, cooked and coarsely chopped ( about 3 cups ) | 1 lb country-style boneless pork sirloin roast, fat trimmed | 3 cans enchilada sauce | 1 teaspoon chili powder ( mexican hot sauce ) | 1/2 cup braggs liquid aminos | crushed ice ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Heat ghee or oil in a large oven proof skillet over medium high heat. Add beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes. Reduce heat to medium.

title: Easy Beef Penne
ingredients: 1 cup dry penne | 2 tablespoons unflavored triple sec | 12 slices beef steak, 1/4 inch thick | 2 tablespoons instant coffee
instructions: In a large saucepan of boiling water, cook penne pasta until al dente.

Random Ingredients: kernel corn,ginger garlic paste,vanilla sugar,ladyfinger,cantaloupe,taco seasoning mix,strawberry syrup,chicken stock
title: Sweet Spicy Citrus Stuffed Cantaloupe
ingredients: 3 -4 medium cantaloupe with skin | 1 can whole kernel corn, drained | 300 g fresh strawberries, sliced ( or use frozen mixed strawberries ) | 1 cup good quality chicken stock | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning mix | 1 tablespoon fresh ginger-garlic paste | 1 1/2 cups low-fat plain greek yogurt or 1 1/2 cups mascarpone cheese, softened ( or you can use 1 cup sour cream or milk ) | 1/2 cup vanilla sugar ( or you can vanilla soy milk if you have it ) | 30 bought ladyfingers, sliced into thirds
instructions: Preparation for the cantaloupe, remove the seed and scoop out the melons with a teaspoon. If you are using baby melons, peel a little of the outside of the melons to prevent them from opening up while cooking. Cut off a small strip of melon that will sit loosely on the back of the melon. Use a spoon to scoop out the flesh of around the melon to make the stuffing. If there is any stuffing left of the melon, chop it up and set aside. You can use a tablespoon or two of plain greek yogurt to scoop out the melon skins to make them easier to stuff them later if you need to. To prepare the mango salsa, combine all ingredients in a large bowl.. If you are using sour cream or milk instead, whisk until creamy and stir in until you have a smooth creamy mixture.. Add half the taco seasoning to the melon and fill the rest of the shell with yogurt mixture. Fill each melon with about 1 1/2 tablespoons of the mango salsa mixture. Roll up the stuffed cantaloupe. You do not need to roll more than once. Once you have assembled everything, place the filled cantaloupe in a bowl and cover with plastic wrap. In the freezer, freeze them until they are really frozen. Remove the wrap about 1 - 2 hours before serving so the cantaloupe will thaw a little bit. Preparation for the salad, remove everything from the freezer and refrigerate overnight to thaw overnight. Cut off the ends of the melon and take off the skins. This will make about 12 cups of cantaloupe from now on out of 12, 8 - 10 cups from now. Slice the cantaloupe into 3/4 inch thick slices. Lay the slices on a cutting board and use your finger to flatten them a little. Place cut side down on a piece of wax paper, then cut the melon flat again so the slices have uniform thickness. Once the melon is cut, use a melon tenderizer or a paring knife to make your tortilla press into a 6 inch tortilla shape like a cone. The tortilla will be pretty flat so you can take out more of the tortilla if you want. Then sprinkle with a touch of the vanilla sugar. Repeat the tortilla press with all of the sliced cantaloupe until all of the melon slices are cut. Repeat this for 4 servings. You'll end up with 3 more cantaloupe slices. If you want to serve these as appetizers or tostadas, you can arrange the melon slices around the tortilla in a pile over the yogurt sauce.

Random Ingredients: marjoram,ham,basil pesto,bacon dripping,jumbo shrimp,cream mushroom soup
title: Hot Ham & Shrimp
ingredients: 8 large jumbo shrimp, peeled & deveined | 4 slices bacon drippings | 1 -2 ounce basil pesto | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 12 ounces cooked ham, diced ( about 2 cups ) | 1 dash marjoram
instructions: In a large frypan, heat bacon drippings over medium heat, add shrimp, and fry until shrimp are pink on the first side. Remove shrimp & bacon from pan and place on a platter or a serving platter. Top with ham, then spoon soup over the shrimp & ham. Sprinkle with basil pesto and sprinkle with marjoram.

Random Ingredients: heavy cream,maple syrup,tortilla,rosemary leaf,red enchilada sauce
title: French Cream Enchiladas(Enchiladas Verde) | J.o.
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups heavy cream | 1 cup pure maple syrup | 1 can red enchilada sauce, divided | 1 cup fresh rosemary leaf | 6 soft tortillas
instructions: Whip the cream and 1 cup of pure maple syrup with an immersion blender until soft peaks form. Beat in 1 can of enchilada sauce. In a blender, drop the tortillas by rounded tablespoons onto a skillet of hot water. Let them sit for 20 seconds, then place a large spoonful of the cream mixture onto each tortilla and roll it around until the tortillas are pliable. Repeat with each tortilla and cream mixture until you have 6 tortillas stuffed and rolled. Fry the enchiladas in a skillet with 1/2 cup of pure maple syrup until they are light brown. Place the tortillas in a paper towel lined plate and drizzle more of the pure maple syrup over them. Serve with some mild red sauce.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning mix,rotel tomato chilies,red wine vinegar,onion soup mix
title: Rotel French Fries
ingredients: 3 lbs whole sweet oranges or 3 lbs light brown green peels | 3 pounds rotel tomatoes & chilies | 1 package taco seasoning mix, divided | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees. Line cookie sheet with foil. Cut the oranges in half lengthwise. With the cut side down, sprinkle a thin coating of the taco seasoning over each orange. Lay orange halves cut side up on prepared cookie sheet. Spray tops with any mixture of taco seasoning and vinegar. Bake at 250 - 250 degrees for 1 1/2 hours, or until tender and puffy.

title: Jalapeno Potato Rounds
ingredients: 2 lbs red potatoes | 1 cup jalapeno pepper, chopped ( the size of jalapenos, stems removed ) | 1 cup powdered vanilla extract
instructions: Cut the potatoes at least 3/4 inch thick. Cut them in half, scrape out and discard the potato centers, then cut each half in half again if there is a long narrow piece of potato. If your potato is to large, cut it in half again if you have to cut it in half again. Then dice each half into a 1/4 inch wide rounds. Heat the electric griddle of your choice on medium heat until very hot. Place potato rounds on griddle, cooking until golden brown, then flip and cook until the other side is golden brown and the edges turn a shade darker. Remove from griddle and place on cooling rack. Serve with jam or preserves. To make vanilla extract, place the jalapeno peppers in a jar with enough vanilla extract to cover and let stand until the flavor develops, then strain the peppers over a bowl, pressing on the solids with the back of a spoon to extract the puree.

Random Ingredients: wheat bran,cornflour,pineapple chunk,green chilies,guacamole,farfalle pasta,rice vinegar
title: Rice-Soaked Farfalle Bow Ties
ingredients: 8 ounces bow tie farfalle pasta | 1 cup cornflour | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 2 tablespoons guacamole ( any brand ) | 1 can of sliced green chilies | 8 ounces canned pineapple chunks | pineapple chunk ( to taste )
instructions: Soak farfalle in a big pan with a lid on for about 10 min to soften.. Drain. Cook bowtie according to package directions. Drain and set on paper towel. Mash farfalle to desired consistency. Add cornflour and rice vinegar. Mix well and put aside. Stir in guacamole. Pour into two buttered baking dishes. Garnish with green chilis and pineapple chunks. Bake in a moderate oven until heated thru and browned on top.

Random Ingredients: lettuce leaf,ginger,white rice,dark red kidney bean,lite olive oil
title: Oriental Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 cup cooked white rice ( brown or white ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons oil or 1 1/2 tablespoons lite olive oil | 1 teaspoon fresh ginger, minced | 1/4 cup lite olive oil | 3 cups lettuce leaves or 3 cups iceberg lettuce, shredded | 2 cans dark red kidney beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Heat pan over medium and add the 1 1/2 tbsp oil. Add rice, stirring to coat. Cook and stir for 3 to 5 minutes. Add ginger and stir for 30 seconds. Add both cans of beans. Heat thoroughly. Remove from heat and serve, garnished with scallions or lettuce.

title: Butterscotch Chips Chips
ingredients: 1 box butterscotch chips, chip-size pieces | oil, for frying | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt
instructions: Place chip bits in a bowl and coat in oil. Sprinkle sea salt over and toss lightly to coat. Heat oil in a large frying pan over medium heat. Working quickly, fry until chips are lightly puffed, lightly browned, and the oil is very hot, about 5 minutes. They may take up to 10 minutes if they get too dark. Drain chips on paper towels and sprinkle with more salt before serving. Variation, use less salt than called for, though it will keep for a few days in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: water chestnut,cardamom,lemon juice,corn tortilla chip,golden syrup,texas toast bread
title: Munzer's Big Scrambled Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/2 cup golden syrup | 3/4 cup water chestnut, drained & chopped | 8 slices texas toast thick bread ( i prefer to use thick rye bread ) | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 1 large whole-grain ground cardamom | 3/4 cup crumbled corn tortilla chips
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine the golden syrup, water chestnuts, and 1 tablespoon of the lemon juice. Place the mixture on a microwave safe plate & cook on high for 2 minutes, stirring every 30 seconds or so, until the golden syrup is melted & syrupy. Remove from the microwave. Spoon the syrup onto the toast & spread evenly. Sprinkle with the remaining tablespoon of lemon juice & the ground cardamom. Top each sandwich evenly with the whole grain corn tortilla chips, pressing them slightly to help them stick. Heat a large nonstick, lightly oiled nonstick skillet or griddle over high heat.

title: Rosemary Lettuce & Spring Onions
ingredients: 1/4 cup light oil | 8 large green onions, trimmed and cut into 1/2-inch-thick slices | 1 bunch fresh basil leaf, trimmed and cut into 1-inch-thick slices | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh rosemary leaf | 3 cups torn lettuce
instructions: Heat 1/4 cup oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add 1/2 of the green onions and basil and saute, stirring, until softened and lightly golden, about 3 minutes. Repeat with remaining oil and onion. Transfer to a large bowl. Toss with the rosemary and 1/2 of the spring onions. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,spaghetti,orange blossom water,pineapple juice,ramen noodle,salami,marinara sauce
title: Spaghetti With Beef Satay and Peppers,
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef chuck | 12 ounces marinara sauce | 1/2 cup pineapple juice | 4 fresh ramen noodles, cooked | 6 slices salami, cut in 1/4 in strips | 1 teaspoon orange blossom water | 1 lb spaghetti
instructions: Cook spaghetti in boiling salted water till al dente. Brown beef in large skillet. Drain beef reserving 2 tbs drippings. Return beef to skillet with marinara and pineapple juice. Stir in noodles and seasonings. Heat through. Sprinkle with orange blossom water and serve.

title: Bean Soup
ingredients: 3 cans baked beans ( i like the ones i've made in a tin ) | 4 tablespoons cornflour | salt | pepper
instructions: Pour the baked beans into a pan with a lid and heat till hot but not boiling. Stir the cornflour into a tiny piece of cheese to make a paste. If you have some baked beans on hand you can use those instead. Take the pan off the heat and add the hot beans to the pan. Stir till everything is mixed through. Leave to simmer on very low heat till the soup is thick and creamy, adding some cornflour till you can stop it coming apart. This tastes best when served warm, but tastes even better right after it is made.

title: Reuben Casserole
ingredients: 1 2/3 cups sauerkraut, drained | 2 cups shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 1 lb shrimp, cooked and peeled | creole seasoning | cooking spray
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Spray 9x13 pan with cooking spray. Layer cheese, sauerkraut and shrimp in baking dish. Sprinkle on enough creole seasoning to lightly coat shrimp. Cover with remaining 1/3 of cheese. Sprinkle on top of creole seasoning. Cover and bake for 25 - 30 minutes.

title: Easy Creme Liqueur
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups plain thick custard powder, such as custard powder or 10 fl.oz. container mixed with powdered milk | 1 red onion, sliced into thin strips
instructions: Whisk the custard powder or milk until smooth. Sprinkle a little onion into the custard mixture and continue whisking until creamy. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: roasting chicken,red cabbage,chili bean sauce,graham cracker crumb,baby spinach
title: Thai Chicken
ingredients: 2 cups finely chopped cooked chicken | 1/2 cup chili bean sauce | 1 cup finely diced red cabbage | 1 bag baby spinach ( or equivalent amount of spinach with stems ) | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: To make the sauce, sauté cabbage and spinach in medium saucepan on medium low heat until they are reduced by half. Stir in chicken and chili bean sauce. When thoroughly heated, sprinkle graham cracker crumbs in at least half of the chicken mixture. Stir and cover. Continue to stir mixture until the coating thickens. Pour into large nonstick skillet. Sprinkle top with remaining crumbs. When the cheese is melted, remove from heat and serve.

title: Wild Mushroom Salad With Kiwi Pips
ingredients: 6 kiwi fruits, peeled | 1/2 cucumber, peeled and thinly sliced | 1/4 cup wild mushroom, chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice
instructions: Cut all fruits into bite size pieces. Sprinkle with lemon juice and toss to coat. Serve at room temperature or chilled.

title: Fish Baked in Lemon Butter - (Baked Cod)
ingredients: 2 lbs firm fresh cod ( or fillets ) | 1 lemon, juice and zest of ( i've found that it works best to use fresh lemon zest as it has a lot of texture, but if zest is too strong for your taste, use lemon juice )
instructions: Note, i like to cook the fish in a little lemon zest, so the lemon juice will be enough. Please note ~ it has lots of zest. Preheat the oven to 350&deg.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,chinese five spice powder,self raising flour,corn chip,spinach,italian turkey sausage
title: Crispy Sausage & Spinach Chips (Spinach & Sausage)
ingredients: 2 cups self-raising flour | 1 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 180 g italian turkey sausage ( or other light sausage flavour ) | 2 1/2 cups sliced spinach | 1 1/2 cups heavy whipping cream | 80 g corn chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 190c. Combine flour & five spice powder in a bowl. Place sausages in a large frying pan & cook over medium heat until browned & cooked through. Drain well & set aside to cool slightly. Spray an ovenproof dish with cooking oil. Add sausage & spinach, gently toss to combine. In a jug mix the cream & corn chips. Pour the cream mixture into the sausages & spinach mixture & gently mix to combine. Spoon mixture into a bowl & sprinkle with combined dry spices. Press the corn chips onto a baking tray 3/4 full. Bake in oven for 15 mins or until golden & crisp before turning onto a wire rack to cool & set.

Random Ingredients: butter,parsnip,ketjap manis,bird eye chile,head garlic,amaretto,kalamata olive,sugar
title: Prawns With Piri-Piri
ingredients: 5 tablespoons butter | 2 heads of garlic, peeled and crushed | 2 birds'eye chiles | 1 tablespoon sugar | 2 tablespoons ketchup ( sweet thai tomato sauce, such as abc brand ) | 1 tablespoon amaretto ( almond flavored liqueur ) | 2 lbs prawns ( small, peeled and deveined ) | chopped parsnips, to garnish | handful sliced kalamata olive
instructions: Make the sauce, melt the butter in a small saucepan over a moderate heat. Add the garlic and chillies. Cook for a moment to soften them, then add the sugar. Add the ketchup and simmer for 2 minutes, adding the amaretto and continue to simmer for a further 1/2 an hour. Meanwhile, heat the remaining 1 tbsp butter in a frying pan. Meanwhile, add the prawns to the pan and cook over high heat for 3 to 4 minutes, turning frequently until they turn pink. Pour over the sauce and serve garnished with parsnips and olives.

Random Ingredients: oregano leaf,red chili powder,cucumber,chili powder,fettuccine pasta,green bean,pumpkin seed,egg
title: Sautéed Green Bean Sauté
ingredients: 400 g green beans ( trimmed ) | 4 tablespoons pumpkin seeds | 1 egg | 1/2 teaspoon red chili powder | 1/8 teaspoon chili powder | 1/4 teaspoon oregano leaves | 1/8 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/8 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 600 g fettuccine pasta
instructions: Chop green beans and pumpkin seeds. In a shallow pan heat oil and fry the green beans and pumpkin seeds on high heat until they start to blacken. Remove from pan. In a separate pan, add egg and chilli powder. Add the egg and chilli and scramble the mix. Add the chili powder and oregano leaves. Add the noodles and stir in with the eggs. Serve with a sprinkle of pepitas.

Random Ingredients: plain yogurt,polish sausage,mustard seed,flat leaf parsley,white mushroom,paprika,pistachio
title: Polish Smoked Sausage Salad
ingredients: 1 lb dry polish sausage, cut into 1/4 in pieces | 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 1/8 cup flat leaf parsley, finely chopped | 1/8 cup unsalted dry-roasted pistachios, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon smoked paprika | 2 cups medium white mushrooms, cleaned stems removed
instructions: In a large bowl, combine yogurt with parsley and pistachios. Using a mortar and pestle, pound mustard seeds into paprika, stir in sausage with a few tablespoons cold water until well mixed. Add to yogurt mixture and cook, stirring until sausage is cooked through. Stir in mushrooms.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,taco seasoning,creole seasoning,ketjap manis,baking powder,yellow onion,colby
title: Sweet and Savory Tex Mex Pulled Tacos from the Oven
ingredients: 2 cans of torilla chip taco seasoning | 8 taco shells ( medium size ) or 8 flour tacos ( medium size ) | 2 lbs colby or 2 lbs tex-mex cheese | vegetable oil | ketjap manis | pinchaking powder | creole seasoning
instructions: Place torilla chips in large bowl that is large enough to accommodate all of the chips, or you can just dump them into the large bowl and dump them into the crockpot. Add enough seasoning to coat tortillas. Add 1 or 2 cans of hot tap water to taco seasoning packet. Stir. Once you have coated the tortillas you can line a cookie sheet with foil, spray foil with veg. Pour taco seasoning over tortillas and add enough hot water to about 1 inches from top of taco shells and top with cheese. If it doesn`t seem to be enough water cover and put in the oven. Turn up the oven to 350 degrees f, then put the oven rack in the middle of the oven. After 30 minutes open up your taco shells and put in a shallow baking pan that is large enough to take your crushed taco bites from the refrigerator. Spray the tops of the tacos with veg. I like to coat the tops with veg. I prefer using the olive oil, but you can do however you like, like zatarains, cheddar, whatever that suits you and your family. Bake until cheese is melted and starting to turn golden brown at top. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: vegetable bouillon cube,fenugreek leaf,mexicorn,extra tofu,maraschino cherry,chickpea flour,pepperoni
title: Chef John's Falafel
ingredients: 1/2 package extra-firm tofu | 1/2 cup chickpea flour | 6 tablespoons greek feta with dried felafel, rinsed and chopped | 6 tablespoons vegetable bouillon cubes, divided | 1/2 mince beef tenderloin, minced | 1 can mexicorn, drained and rinsed | 1/4 cup maraschino cherries, halved
instructions: Preheat the oven's broiler and set the oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and spray with cooking spray. Place the block of tofu on the prepared baking sheet. Smooth the top, and cut every inch or so with a sharp knife. Place the baking sheet in the oven, and broil the tofu until well browned, 6 to 7 minutes. Cut with a spatula into pieces about 1 inch thick. Transfer to a bowl and cut the tofu crosswise into 1/2 inch wide strips. Mix the chickpea flour, feta with felafel, half of the vegetable bouillon cubes, mince beef, chickpea flour, mince beef tenderloin, remaining vegetable bouillon cubes, and 1 cup water together in a food processor until the mixture is well mixed. Spread the mixture over the baked tofu. Place the cherries around the mince beef. Return to the broiler, close the oven door, and broil until the meat is cooked through, 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Tamari Rice Pie
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups vegetable, chopped | 1 cup arborio rice | 1 package frozen puff pastry sheets ( thawed ) | 15 ounces tamari ( low sodium ) | 1 tablespoon fresh coriander, chopped | 1/2 cup fresh mint leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Cook rice and vegetables on a nonstick tray for 10 minutes. Remove from heat. Cover& let rice and vegetables sit for 5 - 10 minutes so they absorb the flavours. Cut puff pastry sheets into 1/2' pieces, then place on a lightly greased baking sheet. Sprinkle tops with tamari, coriander, and mint. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes or until golden.

title: Harissa Pasta
ingredients: 300 g harissa | 100 g walnut pieces | 100 g plain flour | 100 g dried orecchiette | 4 green chili peppers, chopped ( i used a mixture of green chillies and garlic but i could just use a mixture of one and a half ) or 4 red chilies, chopped ( i used a mixture of green chillies and garlic but i could just use a mixture of one and half ) | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Wash the pasta under cold water. Place the flour in a mixing bowl and add the walnuts and mix until they are evenly with mixed flavours. Add the harissa and mix until thick like a paste. Place the pasta in a large saucepan of boiling water and cook until cooked according to your favourite instructions. Meanwhile chop the peppers. Heat the oil in a large frying pan and fry the walnuts until brown and crispy, about four minutes. Add chilli and peppers into the saucepan and then stir in the garam masala. Toss the pasta in the pan with the chilli mixture.

title: Brown Rice With Chocolate and Sugar Snap Peas
ingredients: 4 cups cooked brown rice ( chilled, or cold ) | 1 lb thin sugar snap pea | 5 ounces low-fat mascarpone cheese or 5 ounces low fat cottage cheese | 8 -9 teaspoons dark unsweetened chocolate | 24 -32 slices bittersweet chocolate
instructions: Set aside 1/4 cup of the cooked brown rice. Rinse and rinse the snap peas well. Cover them with cold water. Heat a skillet of your choice for medium heat. Once the pan is hot, add the snap peas. They should be just beginning to soften slightly. Cook and stir them until they become slightly puffy and just begin to brown lightly with the peas. Remove the pan from the heat and add the sugar snap peas. Mix thoroughly. Add the remaining 1/4 cup of cooked brown rice, then stir in the mascarpone or cottage cheese. Return the pan to medium heat for a minute, stirring and mixing the contents carefully to avoid splattering. After the minute is up, add the chocolate chips. Stir well until chocolate is melted. Serve immediately, garnished with strips of bittersweet chocolate.

Random Ingredients: porridge oat,red wine vinegar,meatball,green cabbage,white bread,taco seasoning,bell pepper
title: Meatball and Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 20 ounces shredded frozen meatballs | 4 cups shredded green cabbage | 1 cup grated white bread | 1/2 cup finely chopped red wine vinegar | 1 package taco seasoning | 1/2 cup chopped bell peppers or 1/2 cup chopped green cabbage | 3/4 cup porridge oats or 3/4 cup quick cooking oats
instructions: Heat oven to 350f. Layer meatballs, cabbage, bread, vinegar and taco seasoning in ungreased 3 1/2 qt baking dish. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, until hot and bubbly. Spoon meat mixture over top. Bake 30 minutes longer, or until cabbage and meatballs are heated through. Serve warm.

title: Spiced Cherries
ingredients: 12 -15 large fresh cherries, about 8 pounds ( or frozen ) | fennel seed ( optional )
instructions: Place the cherries in water about 2 1/2 to 3 gallons water. This will make the cherries plump, leaving them in brine. Cook over heat, uncovered and with a wooden spoon to mash them, until the pits are popped but the skins are intact, about 7 minutes. Drain the cherries to remove the skins and discard them. Cover, and allow to dry at room temperature. When cool enough to handle, trim the tips away from the pits and pith, then rinse the pits under cold water. Dry and pat dry with clean paper towels. Grind the fennel seeds and fennel seeds in an electric spice mill until they are very fine and the color is darkened. Pass the herb mixture through a fine mesh strainer or food mill fitted with the coarse blade into a small bowl. Set the flavored cherries aside. Fill a large sealable container with water and add the fennel seed mixture. Add 1 1/4 pounds of ice cubes to the container. Cover, and refrigerate until the juice is frozen.
