Use a slotted spoon to remove the ice from the container. Pour the cherries into the container to give them room to return to the freezer. Repeat, with the remaining ice cubes. Use scissors to cut the cubes, using scissors that have been soaked in hot water for 30 seconds only. Pack the ice into a container. Place the cherry halves on the ice. Cover and freeze for another 20 minutes before serving.

title: The Simplest Perfect Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups dry red wine, such as a merlot or cabernet sauvignon | 1 cup finely chopped flat leaf parsley, such as cilantro, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a non reactive glass or ceramic bowl. Allow to marinate at least 1 hour, but no longer than 24 hours.

title: Thai Sweet Chili Sauce
ingredients: 3 tablespoons brandy, or more to taste | 2 tablespoons red wine | 1 tablespoon sweetened cream | 1 teaspoon thai fish sauce | 1 teaspoon finely chopped fresh chile paste
instructions: Whisk the brandy, red wine, cream, fish sauce, chile paste, and chile paste together in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: almond,sandwich bread,green chile pepper lengthwise,ketchup,taco seasoning mix
title: Spicy Cheese Toast
ingredients: 1 package sandwich bread | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 can chopped green chile peppers, undrained | 1/4 cup ketchup | 1/4 cup sliced almonds, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Cut each sandwich bread diagonally into 2 or 3 pieces. Arrange on a baking sheet. Stir together taco seasoning, green chile peppers, ketchup, and almonds in a bowl. Spread evenly atop top of each piece of bread. Bake in the preheated oven until the cheese is browned and bubbling, about 15 minutes.

title: Chinese Five-Spice Powder
ingredients: 2 teaspoons cumin seeds | 1 teaspoon dried ginseng root
instructions: Grind cumin seeds in a mortar or spice grinder. Crush ginseng roots using coarse blade of knife, not using a mortar and pestle. Heat remaining 1 tsp of cumin seeds, and 1/2 tsp of ginseng root spices in small saucepan over low heat. Stir constantly until water turns white and fragrant, about 2 minutes. Remove dark and dusty spices from heat.

Random Ingredients: pinto bean,black bean,pork loin,egg white,pecorino cheese,mustard powder,kahlua
title: Chocolate Paddle Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 can black beans, drained | 1 can pinto beans, drained | 1 lb pork loin, diced | 4 ounces pecorino cheese, finely grated | 2 ounces kahlua or 2 ounces other coffee-flavored liqueur | 1 egg white | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 tablespoon pecorino cheese, for garnish
instructions: Mix together and place in refrigerator for at least an hour. Serve in individual bowls, topping with extra pecorino cheese as desired. May be served warm, too.

Random Ingredients: thai chili sauce,serrano chilies,bow tie pasta
title: Simple Thai Bow Tie Pasta
ingredients: 8 ounces bow tie pasta, uncooked | 1 teaspoon thai sweet chili sauce | 2 -3 serrano chilies
instructions: Bring boiling water to a boil. Add bow tie pasta, reduce heat and simmer 10 - 15 minutes, until pasta is al dente. Drain pasta, reserving 3/4 cup water and serving pasta, for another use. Meanwhile, warm chili sauce in small pot over medium heat. Add chilies, stir until heated through. Serve over pasta.

Random Ingredients: barley,lemon juice,egg,olive oil,phyllo dough,riesling wine,table salt
title: Chef John's Wine Filled Phyllo Cigars
ingredients: 12 sheets frozen phyllo dough or work sheets, thawed | 12 thin-sliced ous-style lemons | 2 teaspoons table salt | 3/4 cup light olive oil, divided | 1/2 cup dry riesling wine | 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 1 pound barley-stuffed, stemmed, rinsed and dried piello dough | 2 eggs
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Lightly oil an 8 inch square glass baking dish. Cut sheets of phyllo dough with a sharp knife into 1 inch strips and lay them in the prepared glass baking dish. Brush the strips with olive oil and sprinkle with lemon slices. Sprinkle with salt and 1/2 cup of light olive oil. In a small bowl, stir the riesling wine with lemon juice and stir to combine. Drizzle over phyllo layers and top with 3 more strips of phyllo dough. Drizzle with 1/2 cup of light olive oil. Repeat for 8 more strips or more. Lightly beat 2 eggs with a fork and stir into dish. Tuck the last 4 phyllo sheets through the pastry so they cover the baking dish. Spread remaining 1/2 cup of light olive oil over the top and sides of the dish. Place phyllo cigars on top of the baking dish and brush liberally with egg mixture. Bake for about 20 minutes, or until golden brown and the pastry is crisp and puffed. Let stand for 5 minutes and then cut crosswise into squares.

Random Ingredients: feta cheese,ginger garlic paste,palm sugar,chipotle chile adobo,tomato paste,bengal,malt vinegar,cardamom pod
title: Sweet Chipotle Dip
ingredients: 2 cups bengal gram flour available at ethnic specialty food stores ( yellow or green indian gram flour can be used if desired ) | 2 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste or 2 teaspoons garlic powder | 1 cup palm sugar or 1 cup light brown sugar, grated | 1 cup feta cheese or 1 cup light greek yogurt | 1/2 cup tomato paste | 2 cardamom pods, crushed ( about 2-3 pods if using cardamom pods ) | 1 -2 tablespoon malt vinegar ( can also be bought from asian grocery stores or asian stores ) or 1 -2 tablespoon rice vinegar, to taste | 1 -2 chipotle chile in adobo, seeded and minced ( or to taste )
instructions: Sift the flour into a medium bowl. Add 1 cup of the palm sugar or brown sugar, 1 cup of the yoghurt, tomato paste, cardamom pods, vinegar, and chipoltes. Mix until thoroughly blended and then add some more flour if desired. Add 1 1/2 cups of water, a little at a time, to prevent sticking. Dunk the bowl in hot tap water, then dip the bowl in to the hot water for about 5 seconds each turn, then let the dip cool completely before storing in airtight plastic containers or containers. Also excellent as fingerfoods, especially if you eat it all day before, rather than eating it, it will taste like eating tacos. A little bit goes a long way.

Random Ingredients: worcestershire sauce,thyme leaf,caper,prosciutto,sherry,extra beef,beef chuck roast,vanilla
title: Oops! Roast of Beef(ATK)
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry spanish sherry | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 7 tablespoons capers | 8 sprigs fresh thyme leaves | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 2 -3 lbs boneless beef chuck roast, trimmed | 1/2 lb prosciutto, cut into 5 x 2-inch strips | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Prepare sherry,. Preheat oven to 300 degrees. In a heavy bottomed roasting pan, combine sherry, worcestershire sauce, capers, thyme, oregano, and 1/2 cup water. Whisk to mix. Place beef in pan. Toss lightly. Place prosciutto on top of beef and pour marinade over beef. Cover tightly and bake at 300 degrees for 2 1/2 to 3 hours. Uncover and roast about 1/2 hour longer or until internal temperature of meat reaches 155 degrees. Remove from oven and let stand 10 minutes. Slice. Serve with sauce for dipping.

title: Oysters on the Half Shell
ingredients: 1 pint tomato puree | 8 oysters
instructions: Fill a medium size saucepan approximately 5/8 full of water. Boil water and tomato puree together for 5 minutes or until mixture boils and begins to thicken. Reduce heat and simmer for 1 minute. Remove water and allow to cool. Place oysters in the sauce and gently lower the shells for 2 - 3 minutes until the shells open.

title: Korean Sesame Pot Roast
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds pot roast | 1/4 cup sesame seeds
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for direct heat. Lightly oil grill grate. Place sesame seeds on the grate, and toast in the preheated grill until fragrant and fragrant, about 5 minutes. Grill roast meat on the preheated grill until the internal temperature reaches 145 degrees f, about 20 minutes. Cut into thin slices to serve.

title: Irish Cauliflower and Trout Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 large cauliflower | 1 trout ( halibut or other firm-fleshed fish ) | 2 teaspoons cider vinegar | 2 teaspoons cider vinegar | 4 slices sandwich buns, sandwich buns ( i prefer onion-pick ) | 1 tablespoon vinegar
instructions: Set oven to 400 degrees f. Cut cauliflower head into 1 inch florets. Break the fish up gently in a bowl, and toss with 2 teaspoons of cider vinegar, 2 teaspoons of cider vinegar, and 1/2 teaspoon of garlic salt. Spread cauliflower fish on the cut sides of the sandwich buns. Layer with tomato slices, onions, and cauliflower. Drizzle each sandwich with 1 tablespoon of vinegar, and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: chinese cabbage,pepper,amaretto liqueur,rosemary leaf,beef tenderloin,spinach,chili paste garlic
title: Beef Tenderloin with Chinese Spinach
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin | 1/2 inch thinn chili paste with garlic | 2 packages fresh spinach | 4 tablespoons amaretto liqueur | 2 tablespoons coarsely chopped fresh rosemary leaves or 2 tablespoons fresh oregano leaves | 1 package fresh chinese cabbage or 3/4 lb napa cabbage, shredded | 1/2 teaspoon cracked pepper
instructions: Slice meat crosswise about 1/16 inch thick. Marinade, combine marinade and meat. Cover and refrigerate until meat is chilled. Slice crosswise about 1/2 inch thick. Arrange 1 steamer basket on top. Line basket with cheesecloth. Place steamer basket on basket and cover with lid.

Random Ingredients: rosemary,star anise pod,confectioner sugar,asafoetida powder,green olive
title: Greek Olive Balls
ingredients: 8 ounces green olives, pitted and chopped | 1 star anise pod, crushed ( optional ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground asafoetida powder | 1 sprig fresh rosemary | 1/4 cup confectioners'sugar, for dusting
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper. In a bowl, toss together the olives, star anise, ground asafoetida, and rosemary. Form the olives into small balls, and gently roll in confectioners' sugar until coated. Place on the prepared baking sheets, and refrigerate for 1 hour.

title: Soy Fish With Rosemary
ingredients: 8 swordfish steaks | 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 4 teaspoons dry crushed rosemary | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Combine, soy sauce and season with salt and pepper to taste. Place the fish on skewers, season to taste. Brush with glaze. Grill over medium coals or broil for about 8 - 9 minutes for medium rare. The longer the cook time, the more often you add the soy sauce to the fish. The fish should be slightly firm at this stage. Serve immediately. Note, if you would like a vegetarian dish replace the vegetable with a spinach salad and serve with some thai rice.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,sirloin tip roast,caper,green bell pepper,garlic powder,avocado,jalapeno chilies
title: Sirloin Tips With Green Bell Pepper, Avocado, and Chiles
ingredients: 1 boneless sirloin tip roast ( trimmed of fat, i used roast sirloin tip ) | 2 tablespoons capers | 2 cans cream of chicken soup | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/4 cup green bell pepper, seeded and chopped | 1/2 cup roasted jalapeno chilies, chopped | 1 cup avocado, diced
instructions: In skillet over medium high heat, sear roast on all sides for about 5 minutes, or until it is browned on top, but not burned. Remove from heat, cover and keep warm. Combine soup, capers, green pepper, jalapenos, and avocado in a bowl. Heat through. Serve on plate with roast. Note, i served this with a round or oval loaf of french bread for dipping.

title: Apricot Apricot Glaze for Chicken
ingredients: 5 apricot jam or 5 apricot preserves | 1/3 cup catsup | 3/4 cup green bell pepper, finely chopped | 1/4 cup desiccated coconut
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.

title: Creamy and Creamy Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 package cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1 cup heavy cream
instructions: Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Mix the mushrooms and cream together in a bowl. Spoon the cream mixture onto the prepared baking sheet and spread evenly. Cut into squares and serve.

title: Shabang Kurma
ingredients: 1 lb asparagus | 2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 3 tablespoons chopped oil | 2 tablespoons curry paste | 1 lb meat | 4 -5 chipotle chiles | 2 cups crushed ice
instructions: Cut the asparagus into sticks about 1 1/2 inches wide. Trim and cut the stem part into about 2 lengths and then cut the rest into 2 more sticks about 2 to 3 inches long, about 3 inches long. Soak the strips in water for about 25 minutes, then drain them, dry them for a few minutes and then dry them lightly on paper towels. Heat 1 tbs of the oil in a wok, the curry paste and the chiles in it briefly, but don't let them burn but it turns out a nice fragrant aroma as soon as the red part is light brown. Add the meat and stir fry for about 30 seconds or until it changes in color. Add the asparagus in a single layer and stir until they are just cooked over that side, about 2 minutes. Add the ice and stir well to blend it in, then add the remaining 1 tbs of oil and stir. Serve it at once.

title: Creamy asparagus Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 6 ounces frozen asparagus, thawed and drained | 0.5 can cream of chicken soup | 1 sheet phyllo pastry
instructions: Preheat oven to brush a 10x15 inch jelly roll pan with cooking spray. Trim ends and cut asparagus diagonally into 1 inch pieces. Place triangles one at a time in prepared baking dish, allowing 1 inch to side of triangles to extend over sides of pan. Mix together soup and soup. Distribute soup mixture evenly over top of asparagus. Cover with a sheet of parchment paper and a towel and spray with cooking spray. Bake covered with foil 30 minutes, uncover and continue baking, 15 to 30 minutes, until crisp and golden. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Homemade Kourhi Balls (Paneer)
ingredients: 1 cup all-purpose flour | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/2 cup extra-virgin greek yogurt
instructions: Mix flour and turmeric in a bowl. Make a well in yogurt and add the yogurt. Dip your hands in a little water, then knead to form an even dough ball. Cover and refrigerate for at least 15 minutes or as long as overnight. Remove the dough from the refrigerator 15 to 20 minutes before its use. The longer you knead, the softer the ball will be. Cover the dough and refrigerate until the desired texture is achieved. Divide the dough into 12 pieces. Roll on a lightly floured surface into long cylinders about 3 inches diameter using your rolling pin. Wrap in extra virgin olive oil or cornmeal if desired. Slightly stretch each piece of dough so that they are thin enough to roll out without breaking. Using a rolling pin, roll the kourhi into balls about 1 1/2 inches wide by 3 1/2 inches in diameter. Set aside on a tray while you make the dipping sauce. Heat oil in a heavy bottomed saucepan. Add 4 - 5 kourhi kourhi at a time and allow to sizzle, turning over once. When the bottoms of the kourhi are golden, remove from heat and place on the tray lined with wax paper covered with another paper covered sheet of wax paper. Place in the refrigerator until the kourhi have chilled. Drain off excess water. To serve, drizzle warm dipping sauce over the top and serve with paneer.

title: Homemade Mousse
ingredients: 1 quart heavy whipping cream | 1/8 teaspoon liquid smoke
instructions: In a large bowl or platter, combine the cream and liquid smoke. Heat the cream in a heavy skillet over medium heat until it begins to boil. Remove from heat. Pour the cream mixture into the cream bowl or platter.

title: Tuna With Raspberry, Lime & Coriander
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon coriander seed | 500 g sour cream | 1/2 cup lime juice, freshly squeezed | 300 g cooked beef roast, thinly sliced, cut into strips | 400 g fresh raspberries | 1/3 cup finely chopped fresh coriander | 1/2 bag ladyfingers
instructions: Place the seeds in a small frying pan over medium low heat and toast, or toast them in a dry frying pan. Cook 1 minute or until aromatic, then allow to cool to room temperature. Put the sour cream, lime juice, beef and half the coriander seeds in a food processor and blend until well combined. Transfer to a serving dish. Mix in the remaining coriander if using and season with salt and pepper. Spoon the salad into bowls and serve.

Random Ingredients: chicken wing,italian bread,sirloin,bamboo shoot,ro tel tomato,pine nut,hard egg,chocolate syrup
title: Grilled Italian Loaf
ingredients: 1 lb ground sirloin | 1 can ro-tel tomatoes | 1 1/2 cups chocoholiche chocolate syrup | 2 loaves italian bread | 1 can bamboo shoots | 1 hard-boiled egg | 2 hard-boiled eggs, quartered | 1 cup toasted pine nuts
instructions: Brown hamburger in skillet and drain off fat. Spread meat on a greased round slice of bread. Bake at 400f for 10 minutes. Spread ro tel tomatoes on bread, then top with chocolololto sauce. Add rest of ingredients, sprinkle with pine nuts, bake for 15 - 20 minutes until hot. Serve with french bread.

Random Ingredients: cranberry sauce,bacon,miracle whip,bocconcini,cheddar cheese,pepper,water,tomato green chilies
title: Mexican Bacon and Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 package crumbled bacon, cut into 1 pieces | 1 can stewed tomatoes and green chilies | 1 1/2 cups chopped fresh cranberries in tomato sauce | 5 ounces cheddar cheese, shredded | 1/4 cup miracle whip ( optional ) | 1/2 cup water | freshly ground pepper | 8 bocconcini, halved ( about 24 slices )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f in a medium bowl, combine bacon, tomatoes and green chilies, cranberries, cheese, miracle whip and 2/3 cup water. Season with pepper. Spread mixture in a 9x13 inch baking dish and cover with foil. Bake in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, then sprinkle evenly with remaining cheese. Return to oven and bake an additional 5 minutes, or until cheese is browned.

instructions: Place everything in a food processor and process to a chunky salsa consistency, adding more water as needed. Adjust salt and pepper if necessary. Serve with chips.

title: Beef Stock
ingredients: 6 dried shiitake mushrooms | 5 cups beef bouillon granules
instructions: Place mushrooms, stock, and granules in a large saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium high heat. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer until mushrooms are tender, 1 to 3 hours. Drain most of the liquid from the mushrooms and set mushrooms aside.

Random Ingredients: alfredo sauce,cumin seed,garam masala powder,chive,grouper fillet,half
title: Grouper in Creamy Alfredo Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup light cream or 1/2 cup half-and-half | 1/4 teaspoon cumin seed | 1/4 teaspoon garam masala powder | 1/8 teaspoon grouper fillet, cut into 1 inch pieces | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh chives
instructions: Heat cream in a large skillet over high heat, until just bubbly.

title: Macaroni & Chilies
ingredients: 1 package shell macaroni | 1 -2 cup chopped fresh dill ( or 1/2tsp dried dill weed ) | 2 cans diced tomatoes and green chilies | 1 shallot, chopped | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh dill | 1/2 cup chopped spring onion
instructions: Cook macaroni as directed on package. Drain and rinse. Toss macaroni, chilies, shallots, and dillweed in a small skillet, with tomato mixture. Bring to just boiling.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,white wine,kirby cucumber,green,banana liqueur,chicken stock,black peppercorn,cider vinegar
title: Beef & Green
ingredients: 3 slices fresh kirbys cucumbers or 3 slices regular cucumbers | 3 slices green ( i like to use a mix of both ) or 3 slices regular beet | 1 teaspoon whole black peppercorn | 1/3 cup white wine ( use any wine you like ) | 1 teaspoon cider vinegar | 1 1/2 tablespoons chicken stock | 1 teaspoon kirby cucumber liqueur | 1 teaspoon beef chuck, cooked and thinly sliced | 1/2 teaspoon pickled green onions, sliced and separated
instructions: In a food processor, finely chop both cucumbers and beet greens. Remove and discard all but 1 tablespoon of the greens. Add peppercorns, wine, vinegar, and stock. Process to a puree.

title: Hot Roast Turkey
ingredients: 1/2 cup grape jelly | 1/8 cup tomato juice | 1/2 banana, sliced | 8 ounces deli turkey
instructions: In small bowl, whisk together grape jelly, tomato juice and banana slices. Brush turkey with jelly mixture. Rub turkey with remaining jelly mixture. Prepare barbecue. Bake about 20 minutes or until internal temperature of turkey reaches 165 degrees f, brushing with remaining glaze after 5 minutes. Insert carving thermometer.

title: Sage and Poblano Sticks
ingredients: 4 poblano chiles | 1 bunch fresh sage leaves | 2 loaves sandwich bread | 5 ounces sliced pimento stuffed green olives
instructions: Roast the chiles on a grill or in a dry frying pan or oven under medium heat until skin loosens, 15 to 20 minutes, turning once. Remove from pan and rub off skins and stems. Cool. Remove stems and seeds and grind chiles in a grinder. Cut bread into 4 inch squares.

title: Tortillas with Parsley-Stir-Fried Shredded Wheat
ingredients: 12 flour tortillas | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley, or more to taste ( optional )
instructions: Preheat an oven to 450 degrees f. Grease a baking sheet. Spread 1 tortilla with 1 to 1 1/2 tbls. Shredded wheat by hand, or with the grain of a food processor, to a 1/4 inch wide rectangle. Spread 1 to 1 1/2 tbls. Shredded wheat on top of the wheat, leaving a 1/4 inch border on all sides. Sprinkle 1 to 1 1/2 teaspoon chopped parsley on top. Fold the entire tortilla in half. Using a spatula, transfer the folded tortilla sections to the prepared baking sheet. Repeat with remaining tortillas, sprinkling each with 2 tbls. Shredded wheat as needed to cover the entire tray. Spread the remaining shredded wheat evenly over the top of the tortillas. Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Gurumby or Grilled White Fish With Tahini Sauce
ingredients: 4 firm white fish fillets, such as salmon, snapper, hake, etc | 1/3 cup tahini | 1 tablespoon tahini, for dipping fish
instructions: Place fish in a baking dish. Mix together 1/3 cup tahini with the 1 tablespoon tahini. Spread 1 tablespoon tahini sauce on each fish fillet and then rub remaining tahini overtop. Cover, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 4 hours. Oil grill, or set a fire in the oven to its lowest heat. Place fish on the grill about 10 minutes a side. Serve with warm, lightly seasoned tahini sauce. Note, the sauce can be prepared ahead and chilled. Serve fish with the tahini sauce.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon,head cauliflower,garlic paste,sherry wine,red wine vinegar,garlic powder
title: Garlic Coated Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, cut into florets | 1 clove garlic, minced | 3 tablespoons sherry wine | 1 -2 teaspoon chicken bouillon | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/4 teaspoon red wine vinegar
instructions: Toss cauliflower with garlic in 2 tbsp sherry. Season with chicken bouillon, garlic powder or whatever flavor you prefer. Let marinate a minimum of 30 minutes or overnight in refrigerator. Meanwhile, in a large skillet cook the head of cauliflower under your broiler or in the oven. When slightly browned, place cauliflower on plates. Spoon some remaining sauce around cauliflower if desired.

title: Brandy Yogurt
ingredients: 2 1/4 lbs ripe white yogurt, strained and picked through ( about 10 large ) | 3/4 cup finely grated fresh parmigiano ( about 2-1/2 oz., about 2.25 oz. ) | 2 tablespoons brandy ( preferably german lily liqueur ) | 1 -2 tablespoon white wine vinegar
instructions: Lime the rind from the yogurt. Place it in a bowl and cover it with very cold water. Let it sit at room temperature about an hour before making the yogurt. Rinse, drain, and pat dry. Put the yogurt in a colander and press with fingers to extract all the moisture. Discard any large pieces of rind. Let drain at least 10 minutes. Place the drained yogurt in the work bowl of a food processor and process until smooth adding more grated grated cheese as needed and pulsing until the mixture is fairly smooth but not completely smooth. If you have a machine with thin metal blade, make sure the machine is on, otherwise the yogurt will curdle, leaving it in thin strips. Taste and adjust the seasoning with salt or pepper. Transfer to a bowl and let stand for 20 minutes. When ready to serve, stir in the brandy and drizzle over the top.

Random Ingredients: brandy,button mushroom,sausage,red bell pepper,white wine vinegar,almond extract
title: Mushroom, Cheese and Red Pepper Salad
ingredients: 24 ounces sausage, sliced 1/3 inch thick, cooked and drained | 1/8 teaspoon almond extract | 2 red bell peppers, cut into 2 inch strips | 1/2 cup dry white wine vinegar | 10 ounces button mushrooms, sliced | 1 tablespoon brandy, cooking juice or 1 tablespoon orange juice
instructions: Place sausage in a bowl.

title: Korean Beef Stir-Fry

instructions: In a large skillet on medium high, stir together beef, peppers, and soy sauce. Cook stirring occasionally, for 3 or 4 minutes. Spoon beef mixture into a bowl.

title: Easy Beef and Turkey
ingredients: 1 envelope dry mushroom soup | 1 box shredded cooked turkey | 1/2 bottle grand marnier
instructions: Heat gravy in saucepot on medium heat and cook until it begins to boil. Remove from heat and let cool a little bit. Add turkey and mix well. Spoon into shallow serving bowl that contains no stuffing or stuffing on top. Pour gravy over and coat turkey with gravy. Sprinkle cheese on top and serve with french bread or crackers.

Random Ingredients: salt,chicken thigh,tart apple,ginger garlic paste,rice vinegar,dijon mustard,vegetable
title: Crispy Apple Salsa
ingredients: 2 tart apples | 1 teaspoon salt | 1 pound skinless, boneless chicken thighs, cut into bite-size pieces | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 teaspoon rice vinegar | 1 teaspoon minced fresh ginger garlic paste | 1 teaspoon dijon-style mustard
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees f. Core and cut potatoes into 1 inch chunks and place in a large bowl. Sprinkle chicken with salt. In a 12 inch nonstick skillet, heat oil over moderately high heat until just smoking, about 1 minute. Add chicken and cook until golden brown on all sides, about 5 minutes. Stir in the potato chunks and ginger garlic paste. Remove from heat and stir in the mustard. Toss the chicken and potato mixture with the hot salsa. Transfer to a baking dish, cover and refrigerate at least 3 hours.

title: Korean Kimchi
ingredients: 1 head napa cabbage, rinsed, core removed and cut crosswise into 1/4 inch wide strips | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Using a sharp knife or small spoon, cut cabbage into thin slanted slivers. Place slivers in a pot with a cover and steam over high heat until lightly browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Turn pieces over and steam for an additional 5 minutes to steam dry. Add bay leaf and remove bay leaf.

title: Stir Fry Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs beef, cut into 1 inch cubes | 3 cups peanut oil | 2 tablespoons light soy sauce | 2 tablespoons asafoetida powder | 1 can sliced bamboo shoots, drained
instructions: Heat the peanut oil in a wok on high heat. When it's hot, add the beef and stir fry for 2 minutes. Add the light soy sauce, asafoetida and bamboo shoots. Season with hot pepper if necessary. Add salt and pepper to taste. Serve right away, or refrigerate for later.

title: Braised Lamb
ingredients: 4 lbs lamb, cut into bite size chunks | 1 cup navy beans | 5 tablespoons whole black peppercorns | 1 vanilla bean, split
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 f degrees. Rinse and soak beans in water for 30 minutes. Place the lamb in a dutch oven. Mix all other ingredients together and pour over lamb. Cover tightly and bake 2 1/2 hours, or until the meat is tender and all the liquid is absorbed. Remove the cover 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: aubergine,corn kernel,soymilk,self raising flour,lemon wedge,tomato juice
title: Aubergine and Tomato Pies
ingredients: 1 grated aubergine | 6 fresh tomatoes, skinned and chopped | 3 cups self raising flour, sifted | 1 cup soymilk | 1 tablespoon lemon wedge | 3 tablespoons corn kernels, drained
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190 deg c. Grease 4 non stick patty tins with cooking spray. Place the aubergines in a roasting pan and drizzle with 2 tblspn oil. Bake for 8 - 10 minutes or until soft and lightly browned. Place the tomatoes on a tray. Scatter over the flour and bake for 8 minutes, until the flour is golden and starting to brown. Remove from the oven and add the milk with the lemon juice. Mix well and season with salt and pepper. Bring to the boil and boil for 3 - 4 minutes, stirring all the time. Pour the mixture into the tins and spread to about 3/8 inch thick. Arrange the saugages on top. Bake for 20 minutes or until golden.

Random Ingredients: lamb shoulder,red food coloring,sirloin,gruyere cheese,cherry tomato,mushroom
title: Grilled Lamb and Gruyere Burger
ingredients: 1 1/3 lbs lean ground sirloin | 4 teaspoons grated gruyere cheese | 3/8 cup halved cherry tomatoes, cut in half | 3/8 cup sliced fresh mushrooms, thinly sliced | 1/4 lb sliced deli hamostra cheese or 1/4 lb fresh mozzarella cheese, cut into 4 1/2-inch slices | 1 pinch red food coloring
instructions: Heat grill to high. Combine bread crumbs and cheese. On lightly oiled griddle, press meat mixture lightly in center of griddle until surface is smooth. Top with tomato halves, mushrooms, hamostra, and cheese. Sprinkle with food coloring.

Random Ingredients: tomato soup,mustard,hominy,beet,shell pasta,coriander seed,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Beets Poached in Macaroni and Shells
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb beet, peeled & diced ( depending on size ) | 4 tablespoons tomato soup ( or tomato paste ) | 4 cups dry shell pasta ( or macaroni or other small curd cottage cheese of your choice ) | 1 can condensed hominy, drained and rinsed ( reserve about 1/2 cup juice ) | 1/2 teaspoon coriander seed | 1/2 cup chopped coriander | 1/2 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: In a medium sized pot, place the beets in a little water and bring to a boil. While still covered, turn down heat to low. Simmer, covered, about 5 minutes. Remove the beets with slotted spoon and place on paper towels to absorb any excess water. When they are cool enough to handle, add the soup and heat for about 2 minutes. Meanwhile, to the soup and juice add the pasta, hominy, coriander and 1 1/2 cups of the reserved beet juice. Cover and simmer about 15 minutes or until the pasta is cooked and vegetables are fork tender. Remove from heat. Stir in coriander and cheddar cheese.

title: Chicken and Date Lasagna
ingredients: 1 lb lasagna noodle | 6 ounces chicken breasts, roasted, skinned, diced | 1 cup chopped dried apricot | 1 lemon peel | 1 medium apple, peeled, cored, sliced | 8 ounces chicken tenders | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. In baking dish, combine first 5 ingredients.

Random Ingredients: thai basil,red onion,greek yogurt,marshmallow,garlic crouton,tamarind paste
title: Gfcfgi
ingredients: 1 jar marshmallows | 1 jar roasted red onions | 1/2 cup minced garlic-flavored croutons | 1/2 cup greek yogurt | 1 pinch tamarind paste ( optional ) | 1/2 cup chopped fresh thai basil
instructions: Spread marshmallows on a plate or platter and place it in the refrigerator while preparing other ingredients. After several hours, take marshmallows out of refrigerator and place in a food processor or blender. In a separate bowl, sprinkle crushed garlic croutons over the marshmallow/crouton mixture, and mix. Add the onion and yogurt. Taste and balance with tamarind paste or green pepper powder if desired. Add basil and mix. Place in refrigerator and chill for 3 or more hours.

title: Vodkatino (Steamed Beef and Tofu)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon unflavored gelatin | 1/2 cup vodka | 1 lb stewing beef | 1 lb tofu | 6 chicken thighs | 6 slices orange rind | 1 package soft tofu | 1/2 lb soft fresh goat cheese ( chevre )
instructions: Rinse meat well and pat dry. Cut meat into bite sized pieces. If serving with soup or mashed potatoes, add gelatin in 1/4 cup of vodka to meat. Mix well and set aside 1/4 cup vodka. Sprinkle meat with salt, set aside. Heat 1 stick oil in a heavy pot. While heating oil, remove chicken from bone. Dice meat. Add to pot and stir in remaining vodka. When the mixture comes to a boil, skim off any scum that rises to the top. Return meat to pot. Add remaining 1/4 cup vodka. Cover and cook over low heat to blend flavors. Add fish, tofu, and orange rind. Cook for 1hour or until liquid is reduced to 1/. When serving with soup or mashed potatoes, add soft cheese and mix well until cheese melts. Pour over meat at table and garnish with the remaining orange rind.

Random Ingredients: tiger prawn,beef tenderloin,brown sugar,limeade concentrate,rye flour,sea salt,brandy
title: Pearled Cornish Indian Beer
ingredients: 2 lbs beef tenderloin | 1 lb tiger prawns, peeled ( with shells on ) | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt | 1/2 cup frozen limeade concentrate, thawed | 2 tablespoons brandy | 1 teaspoon brown sugar | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt | 2 tablespoons rye flour
instructions: Place beef tenderloin in shallow dish. Sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon each salt and freshly ground black pepper. Mix limeade concentrate, brandy, brown sugar and sea salt in small bowl. Dip meat into mixture, coating well. Remove meat from pan, reserving marinade, and place on foil lined baking pan. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Bake in 425 degree oven for 30 minutes, or until meat is desired doneness and no longer pink near the bone. Remove meat from oven and let rest for 10 minutes. Slice beef thinly and serve with reserved marinade and sliced prawns.

title: Roquefort Potato Casserole.
ingredients: 4 -6 medium potatoes, peeled | 250 g fresh roquefort cheese | 125 g sharp white cheddar cheese | 80 g ghee
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 degrees celsius. Cut the potatoes in half lengthways then cut them into about 12 thick slices. Place the potatoes into a greased casserole dish with the swiss cheese. Cut up the roquefort and cheddar into about 18 pieces and spread over the potatoes. Mix the ghee and the 80g with a fork to make butterflied crumbs and put them onto the potatoes. Use a fork to coat the top of the potatoes with the butterflied crumbs. Bake for 45 minutes.

title: Artichoke (Nori) Sushi Rolls
ingredients: 1/2 cup nori ( japanese seaweed ) | 1/4 cup bicarbonate of soda | 1 yellow onion | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained
instructions: In the bottom of an 8 x 8 inch pan, place a sheet of nori and a sprinkling of the salt over the nori. Tilt the pan so that the seaweed begins to turn light green. If it does, spread it a little on the nori. Place a slice or so of onion into the middle of the nori and arrange a couple artichokes on top of it. Tear the nori into bite size strips and place into the hot pan. When the surface starts to sizzle, give the pan a quick stir. The nori will puff up and turn golden brown in some places. Slide the nori over with a spatula so the heat of the pan is evenly distributed and immediately move the pan over with a spatula. Repeat, removing the nori once the other nori is toasted to your liking. Remove the nori with a spatula, being careful not to tear it into smaller pieces. Spread some sesame seeds evenly over each roll.

Random Ingredients: anchovy,pad thai noodle,sherry wine vinegar,black olive,cabbage,peanut
title: Prawns With Lemongrass
ingredients: 12 anchovies | 1/2 teaspoon black olives, minced | 1/3 cup crispy dry-roasted peanuts, finely chopped | 1/4 cup cabbage, shredded | 12 ounces pad thai noodles | 1/3 cup sherry wine vinegar | 1/3 cup green sprout ( for garnish )
instructions: Place anchovies and finely chopped olives in food processor. Process until blended. Add peanuts, cabbage, noodles, and vinegar. Process until the mixture is just mixed. Serve immediately.

title: Chilled Minty Apple Coffee
ingredients: 1 cup chinese five spice powder | 1 1/2 cups chopped fresh mint or 1 1/2 cups frozen ground meyer brown tea leaves | 1 1/4 cups unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 tablespoon dried yeast | 2 apples, peeled chopped and cored ( about 2 cups )
instructions: Combine chili powder, mint or brown tea leaves, cocoa powder and yeast in a large bowl. Cover and let stand until foamy about 10 minutes. Stir in apples, cover and let stand for 20 minutes. Spoon into mug.

title: White Seashells-Cherry Beans (Navy Beans)
ingredients: 1 lb dried navy beans, picked over and rinsed | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon extract ( or more ) | 1 lb cherries, cut in half ( to measure the cherries, you will need 1 pint, or more ) or 1 lb grape tomatoes ( to measure the cherries, you will need 1 pint, or more )
instructions: Place the navy beans in a large saucepan, add 2 cups water. Cover partially, bring to a boil, skimming any foam that rises to the surface and then reduce the heat slightly. Simmer for about 1 1/2 hours, or until beans are tender. Drain, discarding the water. Dry beans. If you have time, refrigerate the beans at least 6 hours or overnight. Remove beans. If not, let them stand at room temperature for about 5 minutes and work with your fingers to loosen them into strands and to break them up. Rinse them and then place in a bowl and toss in the lemon extract. Taste and adjust for seasonings. Serve chilled, or at room temperature. They can also be refrigerated for several days.

Random Ingredients: worcestershire sauce,mustard powder,green chili pepper,vegetable,salt water
title: Easy Homemade Hot Sauces
ingredients: 1/2 cup vegetable oil or 1/2 cup deep frying oil | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon dry mustard powder | 1/4 cup finely diced green chili pepper | salt, if desired
instructions: Combine all the ingredients. Let stand about 20 minutes before serving as well as adding as hot sauce.

title: Spaghetti Alfonso
ingredients: 1/2 cup sultana, coarsely chopped | 1/3 cup pistachios, chopped | 1/2 cup masa harina | 1 lb spaghetti
instructions: Put sultanas into a bowl. Add pistachios to bowl. Stir in masa harina and mix well. Heat wok or lidded frying pan over medium heat. Add the spaghettini and shallow fry each side until light golden brown. Take the spaghettini out and drain on paper towels.

title: Fiesta Corn
ingredients: 1 -2 cup frozen corn, thawed | olive oil flavored cooking spray | cayenne pepper ( optional but i like lots )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Coat a 9x13 pan with cooking spray. Shake corn in bag and shake out excess. Rinse corn under cold water, shaking in bag to remove excess water. Coat pan with cooking spray and put corn on it. Bake 20 - 25 minutes or until corn is tender. Note, if corn has too much liquid left in it, remove from oven and let stand about 5 - 10 minutes before cutting. If the sauce is too thin, remove from heat and set aside.. Spray the corn with more cooking spray and serve.

title: Ethiopian Beets
ingredients: 6 medium beets - scrubbed, trimmed and sliced into thick-slices | 2 tablespoons honey | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh ginger root | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh flat-leaf italian parsley | 4 whole cardamom pods
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Brush slices of beet with honey. Sprinkle with ginger, cardamom, parsley, and whole cardamom pods. Spread the beet slices into the baking dish. Bake for about 40 minutes in the preheated oven, or until puffed and lightly browned.

title: Pepperoncini Appeared Salmon
ingredients: 1/2 cup crunchy peanut butter | 1/2 cup chopped pepperoncini peppers | 4 skinless, boneless salmon fillets | 3/4 cup peanut butter, or as needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Mix 1/2 cup of peanut butter, pepperoncini peppers, and 2 peanut butter dressing sauce together in a bowl until thoroughly combined.

title: Red Lentil Burritos (Red Lentils
ingredients: 1 cup red lentils | 4 red tortillas | 1/3 cup orange peels, freshly grated mixed spice, finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne powder
instructions: Boil the lentils in a large sauce pan for 5 minutes or till they are just starting to soften. Meanwhile, place the tortillas on a microwaveable plate and microwave for 2 minutes or till just starting to show colour. Spread half of the lentil mixture on the two tortillas, and spread to cover. Sprinkle with the grated orange peel and the other half of the lentils mixture. Fold in the sides over the oranges and place on a greased baking tray. Place the tray under the grill, which should take 3 - 4 minutes or till lightly charred over. Remove from the grill with a spatula and leave till cool a minute. Cut into 2 equal sized segments. To serve, cut into pieces or cut into fingers and serve. Alternatively the pieces of lentil are laid over the tortillas in the middle of the burrito and buritto, piling over the remaining buritto ingredients in a pile. Roll tortillas in a buritto shape, serve and enjoy.

title: Cornflour Pasta
ingredients: cornflour | salt and pepper
instructions: Place all ingredients in a saucepan and cook until thick and creamy. Serve with pasta.

Random Ingredients: cumin,hot red pepper flake,pecan,tomato juice,white vinegar,coconut extract,poblano pepper,cornstarch
title: Smoky Poblano Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup tomato juice | 1/4 cup tomato paste with roasted, peeled, and finely chopped peppers | 2 tablespoons coconut extract | 4 tablespoons white vinegar | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1/4 teaspoon crushed hot red pepper flakes | 3 poblano peppers, cut into chunks | 1 cup finely chopped pecans
instructions: Combine the tomato juice, tomato paste, coconut extract, vinegar, cornstarch, crushed red pepper flakes, poblano peppers, and pecan nuts in a saucepan. Bring to a boil, then mix in the pecan pieces. Pour into a shallow container, or ziploc bag, and chill for at least two hours, preferably for up to two days.

title: Easy Lentil Soup
ingredients: 2 cans condensed milk | 1 cup chopped yellow onion | 1 1/2 cups lentils | 1 can rotel diced tomatoes and green chilies, undrained | 1 -2 head fresh escarole, chopped
instructions: In a large saucepan over medium low heat, combine 1st 8 ingredients. Bring to a boil, stirring frequently. Reduce heat, and simmer 20 minute or until lentils and escarole are tender. Remove from heat and allow to cool for a few minutes. Garnish with shredded cheddar, if desired.

title: Thai Chicken Phyllo Rollups
ingredients: 32 sheets sheets phyllo pastry | 400 g chopped mixed greens | 1 tablespoon desiccated coconut ( coconut flour is a healthier substitute ) or 1 tablespoon coconut milk ( coconut flour is a healthier substitute ) | 1 can chick-peas, drained | 8 ounces cooked chicken wings, cut into chunks | 8 ounces frozen cooked broccoli, thawed and cut into small pieces | 1/4 cup chopped raspberries
instructions: Put together the filling and the vegetables in a large bowl. Set aside for half an hour. Take the phyllo pastry sheets and brush lightly with oil. Take one sheet and brush generously with oil. Lay half of it on a tray, leaving it lying slightly apart, as though it were doing so. Sprinkle some more coconut or coconut flour on top. Take a large handful of the phyllo sheet, and spread it out on the tray. Put a heaped teaspoonful of filling on 4 of the sheets over the phyllo. Fold over the pastry in half, and roll tightly like a swiss roll. You should have something rollable but with a slightly thinner roll. Cut the rolled rolls into six long, thick slices. Repeat with the other sheets, brushing with oil and placing on top of each other. Put a pan on the stove on the heat. Brush the remaining phyllo sheet on the oil. When hot, put all six sheets on top and cook over a low heat for about 8 minutes, turning only once, until they are nice and golden on the tops. Dont let them burn or burn a bit, and then carefully remove it. Put the tray under the grill for a few moments until golden on the underside. Keep hot while rolling. Serve immediately.

title: Crawfish Soup
ingredients: 1/2 cup chicken stock cubes | 1 cup cooked crawfish tails | 1 teaspoon dry mirin
instructions: In a soup pot, combine the chicken stock cubes and water, bring to boil and simmer for 2 - 3 minutes or until slightly reduced. Add the crawfish tails and simmer further 3 - 5 minutes. Sprinkle with mirin to taste.

Random Ingredients: mandarin orange,chili pepper flake,carrot,velveeta cheese,green bell pepper,savory,tarragon vinegar,avocado
title: American Deli Velveeta Pinwheels
ingredients: 1 lb ground round | 1 lb velveeta cheese, cut into sticks | 1 green bell pepper, chopped | 1 jar mandarin oranges, drained & pressed | 3/4 teaspoon savory | 1/2 teaspoon basil | 1/8 teaspoon tarragon vinegar | 1 small jalapenos or 1 small chili pepper, chopped | 1 diced avocado
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Brown ground round, drain fat. Remove from pan & set aside. Stir in pepper, zucchini, & rest of ingredients. Pour 1/2 of mixture in ungreased 13x9 pan, or a 9x12x2 pan. Sprinkle with 1/2 of the cheese sticks, then the remaining cheese sticks. Bake until cheese is melted and golden brown, and hot, approximately 20 minutes and serve. You can serve this with some rice or noodles, depending on how you like it.

title: Simple Pillsbury Crescent Rolls
ingredients: 1 can pillsbury refrigerated crescent dinner rolls | 2 bay leaves or 2 teaspoons dried bay leaves
instructions: Heat oven to 375°f in bowl, combine all ingredients and knead well. Cut into 24 pieces and place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes or until golden brown. Cool on cookie sheet for 5 mins before removing and cutting into 18 pieces.

Random Ingredients: parmesan cheese,pecan,italian salad dressing mix,vinegar,gorgonzola cheese,tabasco sauce,cointreau liqueur,napa cabbage
title: Spicy Gundrukake
ingredients: 5 lbs napa cabbage, outer leaves removed, chopped coarsley | 1 cup pecans, toasted and chopped | 1 package dry italian salad dressing mix | 1 cup coca-cola or 1 cup pepsi | 1 cup gorgonzola cheese, crumbled | 1 -6 teaspoon mild hot tabasco sauce | 3 tablespoons vinegar | 2 tablespoons cointreau liqueur
instructions: Combine the italian dressing mix and cointreau. Mix thoroughly in a large bowl with napa cabbages and nuts. Cover tightly and refridgerate overnight. Place 1 cup of cointreau mixture in blender and blend. Place in a bowl and add rest of sauce. Mix well. Serve atop noodles.

Random Ingredients: celery leaf,purpose flour,trout,pork sausage,self rising flour,cider vinegar,guacamole
title: Baja Sausages and Trout
ingredients: 4 links pork sausage | 1 package trout | 1 cup self-rising flour | 1 cup guacamole | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 4 tablespoons dried celery leaves | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar
instructions: Cook sausage over medium heat until browned on all sides, about 10 minute. Remove and discard grease. Remove from heat and let cool to room temperature. Cut off heads then remove the veins from the fish and cut off the head from head. Chop into 1/4 by 2 inch pieces. Slice the fish into 1/2 inch pieces. Mix flour and guacamole together. Coat the turkey and fish pieces with the flour and guacamole mixture. Place in a 9x13 baking dish. Bake at 375°f for 25 minute. Serve over rice.

Random Ingredients: corn,curry paste,water,pineapple juice,sesame oil,bacon,malt vinegar,white bread
title: Stir-Fried Corn With Pineapple
ingredients: 5 slices white bread | 1/2 cup pineapple juice, from concentrate | 1 teaspoon corn, from concentrate | 1 teaspoon curry paste | 1 teaspoon sesame oil | 2 teaspoons water | 1 tablespoon malt vinegar | 2 slices bacon
instructions: Cut each slice of bread in half diagonally. Soak the bread until soft enough to slice. Remove crusts from the bread but leave the crumbs intact. Cut a slit lengthways with scissors at both ends and remove the top piece of crust. Slice bread in half diagonally. Put the pineapple concentrate, corn, curry paste and sesame oil into an electric blender. Blend, then add the water and vinegar, and pulse into a rough paste if it's too thick, or leave a few chunks. You want the mixture to be a little runny but pourable. Heat the oil over medium heat in a large non stick frypan which has a lid. Fry the bread until crispy and golden on both sides. If necessary, keep the pan lid as close to hot as possible during frying to keep the toast warm. Remove from pan and leave to drain on absorbent paper. Remove the frying pan from the heat and set it on its side. Pour a few teaspoons of the curry paste and vegetable oil on the toast and sprinkle with a quarter teaspoon of the reserved crumbs. Cut the bacon into 1cm pieces and fry in the pan until crisp and browned. Serve with the toast and pineapple.

title: Easy Soft Tacos
ingredients: 1/2 cup cherry, halved | 1 cup enchilada sauce, divided | 1 package lettuce greens, rinsed | 1 can diced tomatoes with basil
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Open a cherry in each of two large tortilla wraps.

title: Cheesy Chutney Corn on the Cob!
ingredients: 600 g frozen corn, thawed | 1 tablespoon mild curry paste | 1 teaspoon paprika | 1/2 tablespoon chutney, sweet | 1/4 cup blue cheese, crumbled
instructions: Bake corn as per the packet instructions or oven on mark 2 c for approx 15 minutes or until cooked. Meanwhile make cheese dressing by combining all the other ingredients and heating gently in a saucepan, till creamy and hot. Stir in corn and remove from heat. Sprinkle generously with cream and/or milk if you wish, before serving.

title: Dill and Mint Chutney With Cauliflower Cheese
ingredients: 1 teaspoon fresh red chile, finely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/2 cup cornmeal | 300 ml milk chocolate, roughly chopped, melted | 2 tablespoons fresh dill, chopped | 1 small cauliflower, chopped coarsely | 2 cups fresh blueberries | 1/2 cup fresh mint leaves, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c/160c/gas pour the chilies and tumeric into a bowl and mix. In a large bowl, mix the cornmeal, melted chocolate, dill, cauliflower and blueberries into the chilies. Stir to combine and pour into a lightly greased and lined 2 litre ovenproof dish. Place the mint leaves on top and bake for 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: brown rice,artichoke,onion salt,dill weed,sun tomato,cilantro,garlic clove
title: Salsiccia With Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups brown rice | 2 -4 garlic cloves, crushed | 1 onion, grated | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon fresh cilantro or 1 -1 1/2 tablespoon fresh coriander, chopped | 1/4 - 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon oregano or 1/2 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon dried dill weed
instructions: Boil brown rice until soft, about 40 to 50 minutes. Drain well. Add more water if necessary. While the rice is cooking, prepare other ingredients. Mix rice, garlic, onion, cilantro, sun dried tomatoes, oregano, and dill in a large bowl. Cover with a dish towel and let sit out at room temperature for 20 minutes. Enjoy.

title: Homemade Indian Griddle Bread
ingredients: 1/2 cup coconut, grated | 14 tablespoons tomato paste | 1/3 cup grated coconut ( optional )
instructions: Griddle bread in oil or on griddle or on electric griddle on lowest rack. Spread griddle with griddle bean curd if using.

title: Soy Sauce Beef
ingredients: 1 lb top round steak, cut into thin strips | 1 cup buttermilk | 1/2 - 2/3 cup sweet rice, cooked | 2 drops green food coloring | 12 raspberries
instructions: Heat 2 pans.

Random Ingredients: cherry,crawfish,flour tortilla,custard powder,rice noodle,cream,chicken broth,vanilla bean
title: Creamy Noodle Rice Dessert
ingredients: 1/2 of a 9 oz can condensed cream of creamed coconut ( cream of coconut, creme fraiche works best ) | 1/2 cup sour cream | 3 tablespoons custard powder | 1 vanilla bean | 1/4 cup chicken broth ( approx ) | 8 flour tortillas | 1 1/2 cups raw crawfish, diced ( optional ) | 1 bag rice noodles ( can use other flavour )
instructions: In a small bowl, mix condensed cream of coconut with sour cream, custard powder, and vanilla bean to make creamy cream sauce. Set aside. In a large pot, add rice noodles and 3 cups water and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer on low. While the pasta is cooking, drain the crawfish/nuts of any remaining liquid. Set aside. Heat a non stick pan or griddle on high. Dip each tortilla into the coconut cream sauce until the cream is absorbed and starts to stick on the tortilla. Remove from heat. Sprinkle each rolled tortilla with chopped crawfish/nuts. Place in a serving plate with the rice noodles on one side of the plate. Then, place a dollop of the creamy cream on top of the noodles. Then, remove the vanilla bean from the cream.

title: Sicilian Sweet Potato Fritters
ingredients: 6 small sweet potatoes | 2 tablespoons brandy | 1/4 cup white onion, chopped | 1 teaspoon paprika | 1/4 cup seasoned bread crumbs | 1/4 cup seasoned dry bread crumbs | 1/8 teaspoon ground red chili, or to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Cut the ends off the sweet potatoes, and grate them using a large grater.

title: Homemade Chiles
ingredients: 2 large dried hot chiles | 2 teaspoons of ground mace | 1/2 cup cumin ( or use ground allspice )
instructions: Wearing rubber gloves, wipe chiles with damp cloth and put in a large pot, along with remaining ingredients. Cover and let stand for an hour shaking or shaking the pot, or until the chiles are very soft and the water has been absorbed. Put it in the refrigerator, shaking the pot every 2 - 3 days, for at least 6 weeks.

Random Ingredients: orange juice,chili pepper flake,chinese five spice powder,crabmeat,monterey jack cheese
title: Crab Grilling for One
ingredients: 1 package imitation crabmeat, frozen | 1 cup orange juice | 1/2 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1 1/2 teaspoons chinese five-spice powder | 3/4 cup monterey jack cheese, shredded
instructions: Prepare a large saute pan according to package directions. Combine the orange juice, chili flakes and five spice powder in a large bowl. Pour one cup of mixture into the pan and mix to dissolve the mixture. Cut the imitation crabmeat into 1/4 cubes. Serve the crab and crab mix over the shredded cheese.

Random Ingredients: beef brisket,hamburger,creole seasoning,green plantain,red onion,tart apple
title: Easy Smoked Beef and Plantains
ingredients: 3 pounds boneless beef brisket | 2 pounds fresh green plantains, ripe | 1/4 cup creole seasoning | 1 large red onion, halved and sliced | 2 medium tart apples, sliced | 2 teaspoons creole seasoning | 2 cups thinly sliced red onions | 2 cups shredded cooked hamburger
instructions: Slice brisket across grain into 1/2 inch wide strips. Place in a large pot and cover with water. Add plantains and bring to boil. Cover and let simmer until plantains are tender, about 30 minutes. Drain and set aside. Add 2 more quarts water, the 2tbsp of creole seasoning and the 2nd half of the sliced red onions to pot.

title: Guinness Tacos
ingredients: 1 cup guinness stout | 1 cup shredded coconut | 1 cup chopped peanuts | 2 corn tortillas
instructions: Combine guinness stout, coconut, and peanuts in a bowl. Set aside. Place tortillas on a microwave safe plate. Place about 2 tablespoons of the guinness mixture in the center of each tortilla. Wrap and microwave on high for 2 minutes. Repeat microwaveing and adding the remaining guinness mixture until all tortillas are in the soup. Heat in the microwave until warmed through, about 5 minutes.

title: White White Bean Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup iceberg lettuce | 1 can great northern beans, rinsed and drained | 1 can white beans, rinsed and drained
instructions: In large bowls, toss together lettuce, beans, and white beans. Serve.

title: Tortilla Chip Beef  Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger ( i use 93 % lean ) | 12 slices asparagus spears | 6 slices honey-roasted tomatoes | 6 slices apple juice | 12 ounces tortilla chips
instructions: Place hamburger in a skillet and brown over medium heat. Add asparagus and cook until lightly browned. Add the tomatoes, tomato juice and apples. Spoon meat mixture onto tortillas and top with cheese and chips.

Random Ingredients: squash,beef stew meat,kalamata olive,marinara sauce,cilantro,caraway seed,onion flake,plain yogurt
title: Zesty Italian Beef Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless beef stew meat | 1 jar marinara sauce | 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 2 tablespoons dried onion flakes | 2 tablespoons caraway seeds | kalamata olives | 1/4 cup fresh cilantro | 1 cup small fresh squash ( peeled, seeded, quartered )
instructions: Preheat your oven to 425 degrees f. Slice and chop the stew meat into a 4 or 5 ounce bag. Put the beef in a dutch oven. Combine half the marinara sauce with the yogurt and the 1 tablespoon dried onion flakes and pour over the beef. Sprinkle with the caraway seeds and half the olives. Add the rest of the marinara sauce and 1/4 cup fresh chopped cilantro. Bake at 425 degrees f for 3 hours, or until the meat is tender and the top is browned. Serve immediately, or refrigerate for up to 3 days, or freeze up to 3 months. Thaw your squash 15 minutes before serving. Serve with bread and crackers. Also great with pasta.

title: Taco Sauce
ingredients: 4 scoops whipping cream | 2 tablespoons tamari | 1 package taco seasoning
instructions: In the microwave, combine cream, tamari and taco seasoning with fork. Heat for about 15 seconds on high in small saucepan, stir with fork. Serve over chips.

Random Ingredients: fish sauce,jalapeno pepper,beef stock,head cabbage,liquid smoke flavoring
title: Smokey Korean Pickled Cabbage
ingredients: 1 pound lean ground beef | 2 tablespoons minced jalapeno pepper | 2 tablespoons beef stock | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke flavoring ( optional )
instructions: Place the ground beef in a skillet over medium heat, and cook and stir until evenly browned, 15 to 20 minutes. Drain grease from the skillet. Stir the jalapeno pepper into the beef. Pour the beef stock, fish sauce, and liquid smoke into the beef mixture. Simmer the mixture 15 minutes. Remove the pickles from the skillet, slice into rings, and serve hot.

title: Vegan Mexican Chocolate Lace Cookies
ingredients: 1 cup sliced multicolored sprinkles | 1/2 cup shredded raw vegetables | 3 1/2 teaspoons baking powder | 3 1/2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Line baking sheets with parchment paper. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Spread margarine onto a baking sheet. Sprinkle sprinkles over butter. Layer vegetables into a single layer. Bake in the preheated oven until golden, about 15 minutes. Mix baking ingredients together and add to vegetables. Mix well. Drop by spoonfuls onto baking sheets. Return to oven and bake an additional 7 minutes. Cool on baking sheets until warm. Do not store in airtight container.

title: Bunel Ka Saagwalla Tunisiya (Tunisian Savoy Cabbage Salad)
ingredients: 1 head savoy cabbage ( about 1.5 kg ) | 1 tablespoon fennel, chopped ( anise seed also works ) | 200 g reduced-fat ricotta cheese | 4 tablespoons light feta cheese, crumbled | 1 medium green, red, yellow, orange, yellow or lemon sized grated zest of your choice | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon | 1/4 teaspoon pepper
instructions: Cook the cabbage in boiling water for 6 - 8 minutes until tender, remove. Meanwhile, rinse cabbage well and slice finely. Place in a large bowl, add the fennel, ricotta, half the feta and most of the seasoning. Stir well to combine and set aside while you prepare the dressing. Combine the cinnamon and pepper and pour over the salad mixture and toss. Serve warm.

title: Individual Beef St. Thomas Onion Rolls
ingredients: 16 ounces beef tenderloin, chopped | 8 sheets phyllo dough, sheets | 1/2 cup chopped dates | 1/2 cup chopped red onion | 1/4 cup golden syrup | 4 -5 slices cooked ham
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. In a large mixing bowl, combine beef, dates, onion and golden syrup. Arrange 1/4 cup meat mixture in center of phyllo sheet. Fold edges of phyllo over mixture to make a triangle shape. Repeat for remaining phyllo and meat mixture. Spread evenly with remaining butter. Bake 45 - 60 minutes, until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: herbes de provence,red potato,button mushroom,vanilla,pork sausage,sugar maple syrup
title: French Breakfast - Slow Cooker
ingredients: 1 lb smoked pork sausage or 1 lb mild pork sausage | 4 -6 red potatoes or 2 -3 medium red potatoes | 4 ounces sliced button mushrooms | 1 teaspoon herbes de provence | 1 tablespoon dried herbes de provence | 1/4 cup sugar free maple syrup | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla
instructions: Remove the rind from the potatoes, cut the skin on the sausages and cut them into half moons. Use a sharp knife to cut the potatoes into 2 inch sections then cut those into halves. Slice the mushrooms and put them into the bottom of the slow cooker, with the sausage. Add the maple syrup, sugar, herbs, vanilla. Place the potatoes on top of the sausage mixture by pouring the maple syrup mixture all over the meat. Cook on high 4 - 6 hours until the potatoes are tender and the sausage is bubbly. You can remove the lid to thicken the sauce if you want a thicker sauce, simply stir in some cornstarch or flour or cornstarch to thicken and cook for 2 minutes. Turn slow cooker to low and leave for 1 hour and then remove the lid to thicken the sauce. Taste for sweetness if you're not terribly fond of the maple syrup, add more. Enjoy with your favorite side dishes.

Random Ingredients: clear honey,sushi rice,fine salt,hazelnut,curry leaf,peppercorn,bell pepper,pearl barley
title: Barley Forbidden Rice
ingredients: 100 g dried barberries or 100 g raisins | 200 ml rice | 10 -25 g pearl barley | 2 -3 cm fresh curry leaves ( optional ) | 5 -6 peppercorns | 100 -75 g fine salt | 2 tablespoons clear honey | 200 -300 ml warm sushi rice
instructions: Soak the dried barberries or raisins in water for 1 - 2 hours. Place in a pot with a good quantity of water. Boil it until just tender, approx 15 - 20 minutes. Drain and reserve the water. Allow the barberries and raisins to cool and then drain them. Slice the barberries or raisins and combine them with the fried rice in a large bowl. Taste and adjust the seasoning. Serve and enjoy.

title: Blueberry French Bread
ingredients: 1 chicken | 1 cup blueberries | 1 teaspoon active dry yeast | 1 tablespoon dried thyme leaves ( can use fresh. i just use fresh. just add more, but the more dried we use ) | 1 pear, peeled, cored & sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400^f. Skin & bone the chicken. If you use fresh thyme you can use the same fresh herbs which are used in making the bread. Wash the chicken and place in a 9 x5 inch loaf pan. Mix the dried yeast with warm water and sprinkle over the chicken. Allow to proof. Remove the chicken from the loaf pan and add the blueberries. Place in the oven and bake for 45 minutes. When cooked remove from the oven, slice & cover with the pear slices. Top with your favorite fresh veggies & bread toasted. Enjoy.

title: Frozen Corn
ingredients: 2 ears fresh corn | 1 cup arrowroot powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Cut kernels from the cob, and remove the husks. Place corn between 2 sheets of aluminum or parchment paper and put a piece of waxed paper over the bottom. With the back of a knife, slash the corn all around the cob. Bake in the preheated oven until tender, at least 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cumin,monterey jack cheese,worcestershire sauce,kernel corn,paneer,string bean,galliano,french bread
title: Carnival Toast
ingredients: 10 -12 slices firm crusty french bread | 1 can whole kernel corn ( drain and reserve half ) | 1 can string beans | 1 can paneer, cut into thin strips | 3 tablespoons grated monterey jack cheese | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon cumin | 2 tablespoons galliano
instructions: Slice french bread into 12 to 15 slices crosswise.

Random Ingredients: wheat germ,neufchatel cheese,chunky peanut butter,cardamom,garlic granule,liver sausage,pepper,amaretto
title: Easiest and Easiest Liver Pate
ingredients: 1/2 cup neufchatel cheese | 1 tablespoon wheat germ | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh pepper | 1/4 teaspoon caramom | 1/2 teaspoon garlic granules ( more if you wish ) ( optional ) | 1/2 cup liver sausage | 1/4 cup chunky peanut butter | 1/4 teaspoon freshly grated cardamom ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a food processor and process until smooth. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Beetroot Sliders (With Hot Chocolate!)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon red currant jelly | 500 g chuck rump steak | 500 g beets | 1/2 cup chocolate morsel | 100 g red currant jelly
instructions: Slice meat into thin diagonal slices. Place meat and beets into a heavy based saucepan with 150ml boiling water – this should cover the meat and be boiling on a high element with the lid on. Once this stage is achieved remove and discard the lid and bring to the boil over high heat and simmer for 1 hour or until the meat is very tender and very tender. Remove from the heat and leave to cool in the liquid, then remove the meat and vegetables and shred with two forks. Melt the chocolate morsel over a saucepan of simmering water, and stir until smooth, then strain through a sieve into a bowl.

title: Beef With Potato
ingredients: 1 lb lean beef chuck, trimmed | 3 large red chiles, halved | 8 large ripe russet potatoes, peeled, cut into wedges ( about 3/4 pound total ) | 3/4 lb tapioca, cooked
instructions: Cut chuck roast into 3/4 inch cubes.

title: Smoky-Smoked Red Beans and Quinoa
ingredients: 2 cans kidney beans, rinsed and drained ( reserve liquid ) | 1 cup hot cooked quinoa | tabasco sauce | 1/4 - 1/3 cup red wine or 1/4-1/3 cup white wine vinegar | fresh basil leaf
instructions: Combine beans, quinoa, and tabasco. Pour enough water to equal 1 cup above mixture. Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce heat to low. Simmer, loosely covered, until quinoa is tender and most of the liquid has been absorbed. This takes approximately 25 - 35 minutes. This is a good time to test the seasonings with a fork, or a ladleful of the reserved bean liquid. Taste, and adjust seasonings if necessary.

Random Ingredients: cherry pie filling,chicken stock,pepper flake,thyme sprig,french fry,spring onion
title: French Pea Fries
ingredients: 1 3/4 pounds frozen french fries, thawed and drained | 1 can cream of potato soup, or more as needed | 1 jar cherry pie filling, or more to taste | 3 spring onions, chopped | 1/2 tablespoon dried thyme leaves | 1/4 teaspoon hot pepper flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place peas in a large saucepan with just enough water to cover. Cook over high heat until tender but still slightly firm, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: lamb,beef roast,pork baby back rib,filet beef,marjoram,ham steak,pepperoncini pepper
title: Lamb With Steak and Pepperoncini (Cacienne)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lamb, cut into 2-inch slices | 1 1/2 lbs beef roast | 1 1/2 lbs beef short ribs ( about 10-12 ribs ) | 1 lb top sirloin steak, cut into 2-inch slices | serve steaks or prime rib with bone | 6 pepperoncini peppers | 2 tablespoons minced fresh marjoram or 2 teaspoons dried marjoram, to taste | 1/4 cup sliced pepperoncini pepper ( fresh or jarred )
instructions: Soak 12 wooden skewers in water to which a fewpoons of salt have been added or 1 tablespoon salt, and a pinch of pepper have been added to beef for 30 minutes. Cut beef into very thin slices. Trim excess fat from meat slice, then cut each slice in half lengthwise and into 3 pieces. Pat dry with paper towels. Wash and pat dried meats dry with paper towels. Set aside. Trim excess fat from steak under running water. Cut steak into 2 equal size pieces. Stack meat and steak on a cutting board. Place meat in a 12 by 14 inch shallow dish. Add pepperoncini, marjoram and any juices collected on board. Mix well. Cover. Refrigerate overnight or up to 4 hours. Preheat barbecue grill or preheated broiler. Line 2 metal skewers with heavy duty paper towels. Place meat, steak, steak, steak and remaining pepperoncini on oiled rack. Grill 2 to 3 minutes on each side, or until steak is medium rare. Remove from heat and brush with a bit of oil. Grill or broil on second side 2 - 3 minutes. Transfer to a serving platter. Surround with peppers as directed above and serve with steamed vegetables and crusty bread.

title: Homemade Chicken Bouillon
ingredients: 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 teaspoon cumin
instructions: Rinse and pat dry chicken. Place in the container of your food processor. Pulse until all ingredients come together. Pour into a medium dish and add 2 cups of water. Cover and refrigerate for 2 days before serving.

Random Ingredients: white vinegar,chili powder,graham cracker crumb,chicken leg,thyme,granny smith apple,cheddar cheese,water
title: Pennsylvania Dutch Chicken
ingredients: 3 chicken legs | 1/2 cup shredded cheddar cheese | 2/3 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder, or to taste | 2/3 cup white vinegar | water, as needed | 1 granny smith apples - peeled, cored for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease a 9x9 inch baking dish. Place chicken legs into a resealable plastic bag, seal, and shake to coat evenly with the cheese. Reserve 1/2 cup of the graham cracker crumbs, and the thyme, chili powder, and vinegar in a bowl, stirring together. Dip the chicken pieces into the reserved cheese until completely coated, and coat with cracker crumbs. Place coated chicken legs on the prepared baking dish, and coat with remaining cracker crumbs. Arrange apple slices over the chicken, and drizzle with any leftover vinegar. Sprinkle with reserved crumbs and drizzle with reserved vinegar. Bake in preheated oven until no longer translucent in the center and the cheese is browned, about 50 minutes.

title: Sailor's Beef  (Stew)
ingredients: 500 g stewing beef, cubed | 1/4 cup ice, crushed | 2 tablespoons cashews or 2 tablespoons peanuts, roughly chopped ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons coriander, chopped | banana
instructions: Place beef in a bowl and sprinkle with salt and crush with a fork. Add remaining ingredients. Cover and leave to stand overnight. If using nuts as garnish, sprinkle with a little extra salt. This serves up to seven.

Random Ingredients: walnut half,topping,cinnamon sugar,asiago cheese,great northern bean,white sesame seed,white flour,coffee
title: White White Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups white flour | 1 cup white sesame seeds, lightly toasted and chopped | 3/4 cup finely crumbled asiago cheese | 1/4 cup finely chopped walnut halves, lightly toasted, shelled | 2 tablespoons freshly brewed strong coffee | 3 tablespoons sesame seeds | 1/2 cup hot brewed white sesame seeds | topping ( optional ) | cinnamon sugar ( optional )
instructions: Mix flour, 1 cup of the toasted sesame seeds, asiago cheese and nuts together in large bowl until just combined. Slowly add coffee.

title: Baked Cod With Anchovy (Cenourini)
ingredients: 2 cod, approx 1lb, cleaned | 1 bunch spring onion, finely chopped | 3 anchovy fillets, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c boil the anchovies in boiling water for about 3 minutes, drain and set aside. Season the cod with salt and pepper, then arrange on a greased, foil lined baking sheet. Make a space in the cavity of the fish by pouring the anchovy mix into the cavity. Bake for about 15 minutes, then sprinkle the fish with the spring onions and cook for a further 15 minutes. Serve warm or hot.

Random Ingredients: grain mustard,orange peel,extra virgin olive oil,bacon dripping,tabasco sauce,tomato green chilies
title: Deviled Eggs With Tomatoes and Chilies
ingredients: 4 teaspoons bacon drippings or 4 teaspoons other fat, plus extra for greasing | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 3 slices orange peel, cut into matchsticks with thin strips ( or 1 tsp. yellow ) | 10 large tomatoes and green chilies, ripe but firm, deseeded ( or 1 large spanish chilies ) | 2 tablespoons coarse grain mustard | 2 teaspoons tabasco sauce | 3 teaspoons extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Heat the oven to 180 c or 350°f grease a shallow 7 inch shallow ovenproof dish. Make the bacon drippings, heat a frying pan over medium. Add the bacon fat or fat, when it starts to bubble, sprinkle in the tabasco sauce and cook, stirring, for one minute, just to heat the fat. Add the orange peel or strips of orange peel, stirring often, and cook, stirring often, for another minute. Add the remaining ingredients, stirring. Cook for 2 minutes, until heated through. Pour into the prepared dish and smooth the top. Bake for 25 - 30 minutes, until firm and golden..

Random Ingredients: pork tenderloin,hungarian paprika,turkey,egg yolk,edam cheese,yellow food coloring,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Hungarian Pigs-Au-Glace
ingredients: 1 lb pork tenderloin ( i like to use beef tenderloin or lamb medallions ) | 1/2 lb sliced edam cheese ( about 1 1/2 lbs. or more to taste ) | 3 ounces pork gouda-style red polish sausage links or 3 ounces smoked turkey link steak, cut into 1/2-by-1/4-inch strips | 1 large egg yolk | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/3 cup yellow food coloring
instructions: Slice the pork medallions into 1/4 inch to 1/4 inch slices across the grain. Place the meat slices on a plate with a paper towel and towel to absorb moisture. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat, about 1 tablespoon of oil. Spray the entire surface of the pan with vegetable oil spray. Working in batches of 3, add the pork to the pan, spreading them flat with the back of a spoon. Don’t crowd the pan. When the pork is nicely browned on the bottom, place on another plate and keep warm. Keep warm while you cook the gouda, slice the sausage links into 1/2 inch wide strips. Remove the rendered fat from the pan to a second plate. Spray the skillet again with vegetable oil spray and sauté the meat over medium low heat until browned. Drain the pan, leaving the drippings in the skillet. Stir the sausage in to the skillet. In a small bowl, whisk the egg yolk with the enough water to make an egg wash. Spray 1/2 tablespoon of the water in the skillet. Stir the egg wash into the skillet and cook over moderate heat, stirring, until slightly thickened, about 1 minute. Remove the skillet from the heat. Add the food color and stir briefly to scramble it. Taste and sprinkle with salt. Serve with the gouda.

title: Pasta With Mushrooms and Chirmerelles(Pasta Con Le Cauda E S
ingredients: 1 lb ziti pasta or 1 lb small penne pasta | 1 cup chopped fresh mushrooms | 1 cup chopped fresh chanterelle mushrooms | 1/4 cup sherry wine | 2 tablespoons chopped walnuts | freshly sliced bamboo shoot, for garnish
instructions: In a large pot of boiling water, cook the pasta until almost done. Drain the pasta and return it to the pot. Add the mushrooms, chanterelles and sherry and mix well. To serve, garnish with walnuts and chopped bamboo shoots.

title: Beef and Bean Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons mirin ( sweet japanese rice wine ) | 1/2 cup brown onion, thinly sliced | 1/8 cup packed fresh cilantro stems | 12 ounces sirloin, thinly sliced | 32 ounces cannellini beans, rinsed and drained
instructions: Pour mirin and brown onion into a small bowl set over several inches of warm water and let stand 10 minutes to draw out the flavors. Drain off soaking liquid and reserve. Toss beans with reserved soaking liquid until coated. Add sirloin and gently toss to coat. Transfer to serving dish and top with reserved caramelized onion mixture.

Random Ingredients: mango chutney,garlic paste,green chile,green peppercorn,cardamom pod,sherry,mustard powder,serrano chili pepper
title: Hot Green Chile Chutney
ingredients: 1 cup mango chutney | 1 finely chopped green chile | 2 teaspoons dry mustard powder | 1 teaspoon green peppercorn | 1/4 cup dry sherry | 3 teaspoons finely chopped fresh serrano chili peppers | 1 teaspoon garlic paste | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom pod
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Store refrigerated.

title: Salami And Chilli Melt (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 14)
ingredients: 1/2 cup reduced fat monterey jack cheese | 1/4 cup canned sweetened flaked coconut, drained | 8 slices salami, cut diagonally 2 x 1 cm
instructions: Place cheese, coconut and salami on a large board and press together gently so that bread can'sandwich'. Cut through edges with a sharp knife and secure with 2 toothpicks. Repeat process with remaining ingredients. Lightly brush oil on each slice of bread and allow to air dry slightly before using.

title: Roasted Pineapple Slices
ingredients: 4 pounds pineapple, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch pieces | 2 cloves garlic, minced | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh tarragon | 1 teaspoon ground black cumin | 3/4 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees f place the pineapple halves in a shallow baking dish. Mix the garlic, tarragon, black cumin and garlic salt together in a small bowl. Pour the marinade over the pineapple. Marinate for 2 hours or overnight in the refrigerator. Bake pineapple skewers in preheated oven until the pineapple are browned, 12 to 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,red food coloring,lemon extract,taco shell,balsamic vinegar,cheddar cheese
title: Mini Balsamic-Cheese Rounds With Crunchy Crackers
ingredients: 1/4 cup low-fat cheddar cheese | 1/4 cup light balsamic vinegar | 2 teaspoons lemon extract | 1 pinch fleur de sel or 1 pinch other non iodized sea salt | 1 package fat free taco shells | 1 large ripe rye bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 400ºf. Line an ungreased cookie sheet with foil. Combine cheddar cheese, vinegar, lemon extract, and salt in a blender and puree until smooth. Cut an x in the top of each taco shell and place on the prepared cookie sheet. Dot each with about 1 tablespoon of the reduced cheese mixture. Bake for 10 min or until cheese has melted. Remove from oven and let sit for 3 min so that the cheese can begin to set up. Remove tops, cut into wedges and serve warm.

title: Sausage Salad with Vinegar
ingredients: 8 ounces johnsonville sweet italian sausage, cut into 1in pieces | 1 teaspoon red wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons mirin
instructions: In a small bowl, combine vinegar and mirin. Place sausage in a bowl and pour the vinegar mixture over. Let stand for 15 minutes. Stir gently until sausage is coated. Let sit for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Serve hot or chilled.

Random Ingredients: chuck steak,green onion,lobster meat,onion soup mix,jalapeno pepper,caster sugar
title: Lobster & Beef Steak Sandwich
ingredients: 1 lb chuck steak, cut into thin strips | 4 ounces lobster meat, sliced | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 1/8 - 1/4 fluid ounce green onion, chopped | 1 ounce onion soup mix ( i use vegemite ) | 2 ounces jalapeno peppers, chopped, to taste | butter, to spread on top, to serve
instructions: Melt the butter in a lrg skillet. Season the steak strips with the sugar, onion & soup mix, cook them just till they are cooked but not overdone. Serve the beef strips and the chops with the onions on top.

title: Quick and Easy Heirloom Tomatoes
ingredients: 2 jars heirloom tomatoes | 1/2 cup olive, sliced thin | 2 tablespoons vinegar
instructions: Slice heirloom tomatoes thin. Place, tomatoes and olives in a jar with tight fitting lid.

Random Ingredients: horseradish,monterey jack cheese,nutritional yeast,iceberg lettuce,thai basil,green cardamom pod,rice,beef liver
title: Beef Liver Lettuce Gyros
