ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1/4 lb beef liver, very thinly sliced | 1 1/2 teaspoons horseradish, fresh ( i prefer aged balsamic ) or 1 1/2 teaspoons horseradish paste ( i prefer aged balsamic ) | 2 teaspoons dried thai basil ( i prefer thai basil ) | 4 green cardamom pods, seeds of | 4 leaves iceberg lettuce, washed and torn in bite-size pieces | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack cheese or 1/2 cup colby-monterey jack cheese | hot cooked rice ( i like our gf brown rice! ) | freshly grated nutritional yeast ( as garnish for gyros )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Heat oil in a skillet and add the sliced beef liver. Stir fry over high heat until it is cooked through about 2 minutes. Remove to a paper towel lined plate and drain any fat remaining in the skillet. Place the horseradish paste, basil, and green cardamom in a food processor and pulse until blended. Add the chopped lettuce to the food processor and pulse until it is chopped a bit but not to the size that you would like the lettuce to be able to chop. Add to food processor with the monterey jack cheese, beef liver, and cheese mixture and pulse to combine. Transfer to a serving dish and serve with warm rice garnish on top. Garnish with fresh grated nutmeg if desired.

title: Baharat Aka Hot Pepper
ingredients: 2 large cardamom pods | 5 fluid ounces coconut rum | 1 dash hot pepper sauce ( i use tabasco, but you can use any hot sauce you like ) | 3 tablespoons oil
instructions: Grind cardamom pods into fine crumbs. Transfer to a bowl and add coconut rum. Heat oil in skillet over medium heat till smoking, but not smoking. Once heated, add cardamom and pepper sauce.

Random Ingredients: coconut cream,maple syrup,mandarin orange,tea,sharp cheddar cheese,chili
title: Lone Star Tea
ingredients: 8 tea bags ( such as lipton ) | 8 ounces sweetened condensed coconut cream | 8 mandarin oranges, chopped | 8 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 2 cans chili ( with or without syrup ) | 1/2 cup maple syrup or 1/2 cup honey
instructions: Put all ingredients in your blender except for syrup and syrup and pour into a pot with ice. Cover and chill for 2 hours. Strain through a cheesecloth and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: cream tartar,jalapeno chile pepper,chili paste,peach,corn oil
title: Papa Dobles
ingredients: 2 tablespoons corn oil, plus | 1 teaspoon corn oil | 3 tablespoons sour cream or 3 tablespoons yogurt | 1/4 teaspoon chili paste, chili paste | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | jalapeno chile pepper, seeded and chopped | freshly carved peach, optional to garnish
instructions: Place oven rack in middle of oven. Heat oven to 400 degrees. Heat oil and sour cream in a small skillet over moderate heat. Bring to a boil, then remove from heat. Mix in both chili paste and cream. Line a baking sheet with tin foil. Drop a handful of spam onto tin foil, spacing it about 3 inches apart. Drizzle with oil, then spread the salsa mixture in a thin layer over the spam. Sprinkle with jalapeno. Bake 7 - 10 minutes, until hot and bubbly. Cut into squares and serve with fresh peach wedges for garnish.

title: Burmese-Baked Eggs
ingredients: 4 eggs | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 tablespoon bean paste ( bahratli kibbeh ) | 200 g diced smoked salmon
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Peel and chop eggs roughly. Place egg yolks in a bowl, add the oil and mix together. Add the bahratli, spread bean paste over the egg whites and mix thoroughly. Add diced smoked salmon and mix. Using the back of a spoon, mix the egg whites until smooth then carefully place on a baking tray and bake for 15 – 20 minutes until they are light in colour. Serve immediately.

title: Tandoori Masala
ingredients: 1 inch fresh ginger paste, peeled and sliced | 1 bunch fresh cilantro stems, washed and torn
instructions: Put the ginger paste in a bowl. Add 1 1/2 cups of water. Mix well and leave to sit for 10 minutes. Strain the water and pour the drained ginger water through a fine sieve. Discard the ginger pieces. Place the cilantro/cilantro bundle in an electric blender. Grind into a smooth paste. Keep aside to later use in indian dishes. Transfer the tandoori masala paste to an airtight container and keep it in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: broccoli,clam juice,tart apple,confectioner sugar,mango chutney,pecorino romano cheese
title: Spicy Seafood Cones
ingredients: 1 tablespoon confectioners'sugar | 1 jar clam juice | 1 package frozen artichocados - thawed, peeled and diced | 2 tart apples, cored and diced | 18 slices cajun-style fried broccoli, divided | 1/4 cup mango chutney ( optional )
instructions: Mix confectioners' sugar into clam juice in a large bowl. Stir in artichocados, apples and 1 cup of the cooked broccoli. Spoon mixture evenly onto cookie or pretzel pans. Cover and refrigerate until cool. Spoon about 1/2 tablespoon of mango chutney over the edge of each serving.

Random Ingredients: confectioner sugar,kale,extra virgin olive oil,peach,colby monterey jack cheese,bulb garlic,cranberry,mace
title: Grilled Kale and Cheese Skewers With Grilled Peach and Cranberry S
ingredients: 1 bulb garlic, cloves separated and peeled | 2 teaspoons ground mace | 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1/2 cup chopped fresh cranberries | 1/2 cup chopped fresh peaches | 1/4 cup chopped walnuts | 3 pounds kale, stemmed and torn into 3 pieces | 1 1/2 cups confectioners'sugar | 1 tablespoon extra-virgin olive oil
instructions: In a large, resealable plastic bag, combine the garlic, mace, 1/2 cup of olive oil, cranberries, peaches, and walnuts. Seal and turn to coat all of the pieces of kale with oil. Marinate in the refrigerator for 8 hours, turning the bag occasionally. When ready to grill, remove the kale mixture from the refrigerator and reserve the marinade. Heat a grill pan to high heat and add extra virgin olive oil. Place the coated kale in the oil with the sauteed pieces of kale. Cook, turning once and brushing with leftover marinate, until the kale is tender, about 20 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Easy Peppers & Yellow Buffalo
ingredients: 4 tablespoons yellow sweet peppers, chopped into small squares | 4 ounces roasted yellow peppers, chopped into small squares | 4 ounces roasted yellow pepper, chopped into small squares | 4 ounces roasted yellow pepper, chopped into small squares
instructions: Microwave sweet pepper squares for 2 minutes on high in a bowl, stirring once, until they are soft remove from microwave. Once all peppers are removed, add the sweet peppers & yellow peppers & mix well. Place in a large plastic bag or other container that you can seal. Allow to sit for 5 minutes so the sweet peppers can absorb the moisture & flavours. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours to completely marinate. Serve with lots of crackers.

Random Ingredients: bean sprout,plain white flour,harissa,cider vinegar,ginger powder,watermelon,hot red pepper flake
title: Crispy Harissa Sprouts
ingredients: 1 cup plain white flour, sifted | 1 tablespoon ginger powder | 2 teaspoons hot red pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1/2 cup water, plus extra as needed | 1/2 cup bean sprouts | 1 tablespoon harissa, sauce made from harissa paste ( from middle eastern or mediterranean food isle )
instructions: In a large bowl mix together flour, ginger powder, red pepper flakes, and salt and pepper. Gradually blend in remaining ingredients until combined. Divide mixture into two equal portions. Roll each portion out on a lightly floured surface so as to form a circle about 12’ in diameter. Brush mixture with a little water, then press the dough into the centre of the circle. Brush top side with a little water and press dough out further. Set aside on a greased tray. Repeat with other portions of dough and water, again brushing each piece with a little water. Sprinkle with harissa sauce, making sure the bean sprouts are covered. Place tray on oven tray and bake at 200°c / 400°f / gas mark 4 for 20 mins or until crust is golden brown and crisp. Serve warm with warm crusty bread. Variation, you can use more water and red pepper flakes instead of red pepper flakes.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,pearl barley,green bell pepper,beef stew meat,red pasta sauce,tomato puree,bell pepper,raisin
title: Mexican Beef and Barley
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat | 1 green bell pepper, chopped | 1 red bell pepper, chopped | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained | 1 can tomato puree | 1 jarred raisins, drained | 1 can tomato puree | 2 1/2 cups uncooked pearl barley, rinsed | 1 can hot red pasta sauce
instructions: In a dutch oven brown stew meat, bell peppers, tomatoes, 1 of diced chilies, tomato puree, 1/2 of the raisins and 2 cups water. Bring to boil.

Random Ingredients: steak,french bread,rice wine,apple,triple sec,cilantro leaf,chicken breast half,tabasco sauce
title: Chicken-And-Pepper Burgers
ingredients: 1/2 cup rice wine | 1/2 cup triple sec | 2 tablespoons minced fresh cilantro leaves | 12 ounces boneless skinless chicken breast halves, sliced 1/4 inch thick | 3/4 cup shredded cooked chicken breast half | 1 tablespoon chopped peeled apple | 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1 loaf french bread, halved lengthwise ( about 3 1/2 inches thick )
instructions: Prepare grill. Combine first 3 ingredients in medium bowl.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,iceberg lettuce,red onion,chili pepper flake
title: Low Fat Spicy Slaw
ingredients: 150 g self-raising flour | 1 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 1 red onion | 150 g iceberg lettuce
instructions: If you are short on time, cook the flour in a pan for a few minutes over a medium low heat, stirring until there are no more lumps. Add the chili flakes, mix and cook for a couple of minutes. Cut onion and lettuce into thin slices. Tear the lettuce into pieces, pour half of the spiced flour into a small baking dish or jug and scatter over the lettuce, mix and scatter over the rest of the flour. Cook in a 350 degree oven until golden brown and bubbling.

title: Fenugreek Dessert Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup finely chopped onion | 1 cup half-and-half | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 1 tablespoon fenugreek ( dried fenugreek leaves ) | 3 tablespoons margarine | 2 tablespoons sweetened condensed milk
instructions: Fry the chopped onions until they become transparent in a little oil, but not browned. Add the half and half, chili powder, fenugreek leaves and margarine. Stir well. Add condensed milk. Cook over low heat for 30 - 40 minutes. Serve hot in your favourite dishes.

title: Cashew and Caraway Filling
ingredients: 2 1/2 tablespoons cashews, chopped | 1 tablespoon caraway seeds
instructions: Process cashews in blender.

title: Creamy Cashew Crunch
ingredients: 2 tablespoons crunchy peanut butter | 1 tablespoon chili-garlic sauce | 2 tablespoons dry breadcrumbs | 4 tablespoons grated carrots | 1 teaspoon poultry seasoning | 1 tablespoon cashews, chopped
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together peanut butter, chili garlic sauce, bread crumbs, carrots, and poultry seasoning. Mix in cashews until well combined. Spread out onto a cookie sheet to the size of a pea pod. Bake in a preheated 300°f oven for 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon granule,chicken base,sweetcorn,brown sugar,tomato green chilies
title: Tex-Mex Sweetcorn and Chorizo Hot Dogs
ingredients: 1 can sweetcorn | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon granules | 2 tablespoons chicken base | 2 teaspoons brown sugar
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium high heat. Mix sweetcorn, tomatoes with green chilies, chicken bouillon granules, chicken base, and brown sugar together in a large bowl.

title: Almond & Onion Soup
ingredients: 1 packet dry onion soup mix | 3/4 cup almonds ( chopped ) | 1/4 cup dry chopped onion
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and cook on low heat for 20 - 30 minutes.

title: Pasta With Beans and Pistou
ingredients: 350 g farfalle pasta | 150 g passata | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 4 bamboo skewers | 1 tablespoon mirin | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 400 g good quality bean slices, drained
instructions: Cook pasta in salted boiling water, uncovered, for 8 minutes, or until al dente. Meanwhile heat oil in a frying pan over moderate heat. Add skewers and cook for 8 minutes, turning until cooked through. Drain pasta and place into a large bowl with the passata. Toss for 1 minute over low heat to heat through. Add the mirin, vanilla and beans. Toss for 2 minutes.

title: Gnocchi Soup With Scallops
ingredients: 1 ounce shortening | 1 pint vegetable stock | 1 pint mixed salad leaves | 3 scallops, peeled and chopped | 2 ounces gin or 2 ounces dry vermouth | 1 tablespoon fresh basil, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons grand marnier | 1 ounce scordalia or 1 ounce cilantro leaf | 8 ounces fresh gnocchi, to serve
instructions: Heat the shortening and stock in a pan, then fry the mixed salad leaves and add the scallops. Bring to the boil, cover and simmer for 2 - 3 minutes. Pour over the gin or vermouth, stir well and simmer for 5 minutes. Remove the scallop and set aside. Stir in the basil, grand marnier and coriander. Bring to the boil, cover, reduce the heat and simmer for 15 minutes. Return the scallop to the pan, remove the cover and put in a warm serving bowl. Serve with crusty bread and a few extra leaves to garnish.

title: Coconut Porridge
ingredients: 1/4 lb pork tenderloin, cut into matchstick-size pieces | 2 cups unsweetened light coconut milk | 1 1/2 - 2 cups arborio rice | 1 tablespoon baking powder | 1/4 cup shredded coconut ( optional )
instructions: Put pork in a large pan with enough water to cover.

Random Ingredients: thyme leave,lemon grass,chicken bouillon powder,chunky salsa
title: Saucy Salsa
ingredients: 1/2 cup chunky salsa ( homemade or canned ) | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon powder | 1 teaspoon lemon grass, chopped ( i use frozen, defrosted-useable ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme leave
instructions: Mix the all ingredients in a mixing bowl. Cover and refrigerate to allow flavors to blend.

title: Classic Steamed White Wine
ingredients: 1 quart white wine | 1 lime, juice and zest of
instructions: First add the lime peel in the center of each square of waxed paper. Roll over the peel, and tie with kitchen string. Place in a steamer over boiling water, and steam for 1 hour or until liquid has reduced and syrupy. Remove and allow to cool. The wine can be used immediately as a marinade for meat, seafood, or poultry.

title: Barbecued Chicken with Bay Scallops in Raita
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken pieces | 1/4 cup rice wine | 1/4 cup prepared horseradish | 2 tablespoons rice wine | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh horseradish | 1 cup chicken, cut into pieces | 1 3/4 cups chopped fresh bay scallops ( optional )
instructions: Place chicken in a shallow dish.

title: Fenugreek-Punch Penne (Mushroom & Fenugreek)
ingredients: 1 lb penne pasta | 2/3 cup fenugreek leaves ( optional )
instructions: Prepare pasta according to package directions. When pasta is finished cooking, drain but do not rinse. Return pasta to pot and add fenugreek. Toss to combine. Serve immediately.

title: Cauliflower and Bean Hotpot
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower | 1 can kidney beans, drained | 2 cans condensed tomato soup | 4 slices hard-boiled eggs | 2 bay leaves
instructions: Cut cauliflower into florets and boil in water for 12 minutes. Drain. Place all the ingredients in a casserole dish or saucepan and stir well. Bake at 350 degrees for 2 hours.

title: Greek Pears and Yogurt Dip
ingredients: 10 -12 medium pears, cut in halves and cored | 2 cups greek yogurt | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1 cup greek-style yogurt ( plain yogurt ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1/8 cup chopped walnuts | 1 tablespoon nuts ( chopped almonds or raisins )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Combine soup and yogurt and mix well. Add sugar, vanilla and nuts. Toss with pears place pear halves on a cookie sheet, pour soup mixture over and bake 40 min or until hot and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: strawberry,italian bread,graham cracker crumb,pork butt roast,italian parsley,ginger root,wheat pastry flour,baby lima bean
title: Lima Bean and Coconut Pork Pie
ingredients: 3 pounds boneless pork butt roast, cut into 1 inch pieces | 2 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs | 1/2 cup italian parsley | 1/4 cup chopped fresh italian parsley | 1 1/2 1 1/2 teaspoons grated fresh ginger root | 1 pound fresh baby lima beans | 1 cup sliced strawberries | 1 cup sliced italian bread, or as needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Mix graham cracker crumbs, italian parsley, parsley, ginger, and lima beans together in a saucepan. Pour mixture into a 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven until browned and bubbly, about 1 hour. Remove ham from drippings and mix into graham cracker crumbs and italian parsley until well mixed. Return mixture to the preheated oven and bake until topping is browned and bubbly, about 45 minutes. To serve, slice pork and put on top of a spoonful of cream sauce to coat. Spread some or all of the filling on the crumb cake.

Random Ingredients: thai red curry paste,plum tomato,vanilla extract,chili garlic sauce
title: Red Curry Tomatoes
ingredients: 6 plum tomatoes | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 2 tablespoons thai red curry paste, or to taste | 1 tablespoon chili-garlic sauce, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Peel, halve, and quarter the tomatoes, depending on size but being careful not to cut all the way through. Scoop out the pulp with a spoon. Place the tomatoes in a small skillet, and add vanilla, curry paste, and chili garlic sauce. Cook uncovered, stirring frequently for about 10 minutes, or until the tomatoes have begun to caramelize.

Random Ingredients: beef,cottage cheese,tarragon leaf,sea salt,lasagna noodle,baby carrot,salt,white breadcrumb
title: Baby Tarragon Meatball Lasagna
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground beef | 1/2 cup fresh white breadcrumb | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon leaves | 12 baby carrots | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1/3 cup low fat cottage cheese | 1/4 teaspoon sea salt | 1/8 teaspoon dried tarragon leaves | 1 egg white, lightly beaten | 12 sheets uncooked lasagna noodles
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Lightly coat a large cooking pan with oil and set over medium high heat. When pan is hot, add hamburger and crumbs and cook, breaking up the meat with a spoon, until meat is no longer pink. Remove hamburger, stir in tarragon leaves, carrots and salt. Add egg and 2 tablespoons water.

Random Ingredients: garam masala,cocktail onion,oregano,japanese eggplant,self raising flour
title: Baked Sautéed Japanese Eggplant With Garam Masala
ingredients: 1 tablespoon minced garlic | 1 tablespoon finely minced kashmiri-style dried oregano | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 2 medium japanese eggplants | 1 tablespoon self-raising flour
instructions: Peel eggplant cut in half lengthwise. Score into 3/8 thick slices. Brush with garlic oil and sprinkle chopped oregano and garam masala over slices and place on lightly oiled barbecue grill. Cook 3 to 4 minutes over medium heat, then turn slices over and grill 3 to 4 minutes on the other side. Allow to cool slightly before serving.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke flavoring,watercress,harissa,egg yolk,tamarind paste,dijon mustard,chipotle chile
title: Chipotle and Tamarind Egg Nests
ingredients: 3 large egg yolks | 1/3 cup tamarind paste | 1/3 cup liquid smoke flavoring | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 2 -3 whole chipotle chiles | 1 cup watercress ( to garnish ) | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh harissa
instructions: Whisk together the egg yolks, tamarind paste, liquid smoke, dijon mustard and ground chipotle chiles. Whisk until uniform and add water by the spoonful until incorporated. Transfer to a serving dish, garnish with finely chopped watercress and harissa or serve plain or with plain yogurt and bread.

title: Charmie's Vegan Favourite Mmm. Sticks
ingredients: 3 tablespoons peanut oil | 400 g low fat ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 2 tablespoons tamari | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh coriander | 3 medium ripe avocados, diced | pepperoni, to garnish ( optional ) | grated chocolate ( optional ) or chocolate pieces ( optional )
instructions: Melt 2 tbsp peanut oil in a frypan.

title: Homemade Flour Rounds from Coconut Milk
ingredients: 4 cups whole wheat flour
instructions: Put all ingredients into a bread machine. Add 1 tablespoon olive oil to a saucer. Place 1 round of dough onto the saucer and flatten it into a circle about the size of your hand. Add 1 - 2 teaspoons each of coconut oil and water, if using. Place a small piece of aluminium foil on top and press the flack on top of the seal. Place the flack on a pizza sheet and cover with another piece of foil. Bake at 220°c for about 20 minutes or until a bit crusty. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: fennel seed,hard egg,lettuce leaf,five spice powder
title: Fennel Fried Eggs
ingredients: 12 hard-boiled eggs | 250 g lettuce leaves | 1 teaspoon five-spice powder | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed
instructions: Slice the eggs in half, remove any yolks or whites. Leave the yolks in the whites as well. Soak a lettuce leaf in a large bowl of boiling water for about 7 minutes, or until bright green and dry. Drain the lettuce leaves well, and cut them lenghtwise into thin strips about 1 3mm across, depending on their length. Place all the ingredients in the bowl of yolks and mix by hand until everything is well mixed. Place the mixture in the egg whites and shape into patties, about 5cm in diameter. Cook the patties on a lightly oiled griddle or frying pan over fairly high heat until they are crisp on the outside and well browned on the inside. Serve right away, with salad or a cucumber salad.

title: Gram's Simple Swedish Meatball Soup
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lean ground beef or 1 1/2 lbs ground goat meat | 2 cans beef broth or ( 8 ounce ) cans beef consomme
instructions: Combine meat and remaining ingredients in slow cooker. Cover and cook on low 6 to 8 hours or until meat is thoroughly cooked.

title: Ravioli with Pease Peease Cheese Sauce
ingredients: 1 package cheese ravioli | 1 small yellow onion, chopped | 1 cup canned chickpea flour
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add ravioli and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Couscous With Pork & Mushrooms
ingredients: 1/4 lb dried shiitake mushroom | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh lavender | 1/4 cup dried red chile, seeded and chopped | 2 lbs boneless pork shoulder, cut into 1 1/2-inch cubes | 5 1/4 cups hot cooked couscous | 1 1/2 cups coarsely chopped cabbage | 1/3 cup cashews or 1/3 cup peanuts, lightly toasted
instructions: Soak mushrooms in small bowl of boiling water for 30 minutes. Drain caps and coarsely chop.

title: Pressed Hoagies
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dry red wine | 2 -4 hoagie rolls | 1 tablespoon icing sugar, to drizzle
instructions: Heat the red wine in a saucepan until almost boiling. Spread the cooked hoagie rolls with icing sugar. Spoon the hot red wine down the center of the roll. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: rice vinegar,orange liqueur,chicken stock,turnip,chicken bouillon cube,chicken breast half
title: Chicken Bog
ingredients: 4 chicken breast halves ( bone in, about 1 1/4 pounds total ) | 1 bag shredded chicken bouillon cube | 12 1/2 ounces chicken stock | 4 tablespoons orange liqueur | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1 small turnip, peeled, and cut into thin wedges
instructions: In a 4 quart clay cooker, combine chicken, bouillon cube, and 8 cups of chicken stock. Arrange turnips around chicken and pour in liqueur and rice vinegar. Cover and refrigerate 12 to 24 hours. The longer the chicken simmers, the more flavorful it will be. Preheat oven to 425°f. If you have a gas oven, place chicken in a roasting pan and place in preheated oven, then bake for 40 minutes. Turn chicken over and bake for 35 to 40 minutes more or until chicken is cooked throughout. The juices from the chicken may be thinened slightly with some of the hot chicken juices.

title: Corn on the Cob
ingredients: 16 ounces whole kernel corn | 1/8 teaspoon dried thyme | 1/4 cup white wine ( or more to taste )
instructions: Combine corn, thyme and wine in a large saucepan. Heat to boiling and steam, covered, until corn is just tender. Transfer corn and liquid to a platter and serve immediately.

title: How to Make Oatmeal - the Healthyest& Easiest!
ingredients: 600 g wholemeal steel cut oats | 300 ml skim milk | 350 g chopped dried pork
instructions: Cook oats according to the directions & lightly cover in a sieve. Set in the fridge to stand for 30 minutes or so. Mix milk & pork thoroughly, and place in a casserole dish. Cover, bake in a moderate oven for 30 minutes or until a knife inserted comes out clean. Turn out of oven & leave covered for at least 30 minutes before serving.

title: Steamed Fennel Tea
ingredients: 4 cups water chestnuts, cut into 1 -inch pieces | fennel seed, crushed
instructions: Place the water chestnuts into a blender and blend until fine. Transfer the water chestnuts to a bowl and sprinkle with the fennel seed. Pour the brewed tea into 4 small cups. Serve.

title: Samaki Sauce
ingredients: 3 tablespoons ketjap manis | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1 teaspoon ginger powder | 2 tablespoons ketchup ( heinz or ketchi ) ( optional )
instructions: Put all the ingredients, except for the ketchup, and the olive oil into the blender. Blend till it has formed a thin paste. Pour the mixture into a small sauce pan and cook slowly until it begins to thicken, around 10 to 15 minutes. If there is any excess liquid, pour in a little at a time. Turn the mixture into small ramekin bowls. If you have a canning jar, secure it with a lid that fits snugly into the canning jar. Pour the hot mixture over the samaki, allowing it to soften slightly for about five minutes. Serve with hot or dark rye bread slices.

title: Parmesan Cheese Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup cottage cheese | 1/4 cup green olives, sliced | 1/8 cup orange juice
instructions: In bowl combine cheese, olives and orange juice. Chill. Serve over pasta of your choice.

Random Ingredients: pie crust,herbes de provence,pork butt roast,salt pepper
title: Herby Roasted Pork Tartlets
ingredients: 5 lbs boneless pork butt roast | 2 teaspoons herbes de provence | 1 teaspoon salt and pepper | 1 unbaked pie crust
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Trim the roast of any strings and remove any excess fat. Trim any excess fat and gristle. Cut the roast into 3/4 inch cubes. Add the herbes de provence, salt and pepper to the pork. Using a fork, combine the meat and rub into the crust. Bake until the internal temperature reaches 190 degrees f, approximately 1 1/2 hours. Serve with french bread for sandwiches.

Random Ingredients: rice,taco sauce,chipotle chile adobo,fig,texas toast bread
title: Chipotle Rice and Fig Sandwich
ingredients: 1/4 - 1/2 cup texas toast crumbs | 1 lb dried fig, sliced into 1/4-inch pieces | 3 -4 chipotle chiles in adobo, seeded and coarsely chopped | 2 - 2 1/2 cups cooked rice, preferably uncle carraway's | vegetable oil or cooking spray
instructions: In a skillet, toast bread until light and toasty. Spread 1 tablespoon of the crumbs on another plate. Set aside. In another skillet, toast figs until crisp and golden. Drain figs, then place in bowl with 1 tablespoon of the chipotle mixture.

Random Ingredients: veal demi glace,ricotta cheese,trout fillet,italian bread
title: Trout Au Fromage
ingredients: 1 whole trout fillet | italian seasoned bread | 1 cup ricotta cheese ( fat-free or cream-style ) | 1/2 cup veal demi-glace
instructions: Rinse the trout, removing as many scales as possible. Cut the trout in half lengthwise. With floured hands, press into a 1 inch thick rectangle. Spoon approximately half the ricotta cheese onto each half. Top with the trout.

Random Ingredients: poultry seasoning,oyster sauce,rose wine,dark soy sauce,chive,creme fraiche,tahini,pork loin chop
title: Roasted Barbecued Sweet Pork With Tangy Sauce
ingredients: 4 sweet pork loin chops | 8 ounces creme fraiche or 8 ounces sour cream | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 2 teaspoons creme fraiche or 2 teaspoons sour cream | 1 teaspoon poultry seasoning or 1/2 teaspoon dried poultry rub | 2 tablespoons chives, chopped | 2 tablespoons rose wine ( or rum ) | 2 teaspoons tahini
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place the chops in a shallow casserole dish. Toss with a good amount of seasoning to coat. Add the creme fraiche, oyster sauce, horseradish, creme fraiche, chicken curry, chives and rose to the pork chops and turn to coat. Place in the oven and bake for 20 mins or until the sauce is glazed. Serve with rice.

title: Apple and Kiwi Fruit Salsa
ingredients: 3 kiwi fruits | 5 apples, cubed | cayenne to taste
instructions: Cut the kiwifruit into chunks, peel them if you want and chop the rest into chunks. Peel apples if wanted. Place them in a bowl, with the other ingredients and toss. Chill.

title: Caribbean Chorizo
ingredients: 1 cup pork, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1/2 cup banana, fresh sliced | 3 cups poblano chiles ( roasted, peeled and seeded ) | 3/4 cup dark rum or 3/4 cup light rum | 1/4 cup brown sugar
instructions: Fry pork cubes until they are browned on all sides. Add banana, poblano peppers and rum/light rum. Simmer 15 min or until most of the liquid is absorbed. Stir in brown sugar and cook a few more minutes.

title: Cheater Nests
ingredients: 1 jar marshmallows | 1 lemon, juice of | 1 beef bouillon cube | 2 jars sliced button mushrooms | 1 jar jalapeno peppers | 1 head cauliflower | cracker, for serving ( optional )
instructions: Mix the marshmallows, lemon juice, and bullion cube together. Cut the cauliflower heads and mushrooms in half lenghtwise. Then core and remove the eyes and thick stem part of the stalks. Slice the cauliflower into small pieces. Place in bowl. Pour 1 tsp of the marshmallow mix over each serving of cauliflower. Serve with crackers if using.

title: Green Pea Filling for Peroshky
ingredients: 1 lb freshly shelled green peas | 16 ounces superfine sugar
instructions: To make the filling, put the peas and sugar in a pan and stir over low heat for 5 minutes. Remove from the heat, and let cool slightly. Stir into the cooled peas, and chill in the refrigerator for 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: stewing beef,lamb,chipotle chile adobo,shortening,crouton,jicama,chinese five spice powder
title: Pork Stew With Jicama (Frui)
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs stewing beef | 2 tablespoons shortening or 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 4 canned chipotle chiles in adobo, chopped | 4 medium jicama, peeled and sliced ( about 1 1/2 cups, can use other sweet potato ) | 2 1/2 teaspoons chinese five spice powder | 10 -15 dry croutons, to serve ( optional ) | 1 large bag chinese five spice powder, for dusting
instructions: In a large stew pot, melt the shortening or vegetable oil over medium heat in a large mixing bowl. Add the minced chipoltes, jicama, and 5 spice powder to the hot shortening mixture and cook, stirring occasionally, until the jicama is golden brown, 5 - 7 minutes. Add the beef and 3 cups of water and simmer, covered, for about 1 hours. If necessary, more water will be added. At this point you may serve the stew with french fries, hot cooked white rice, a side of fried shallots or fresh green beans.

Random Ingredients: slab bacon,tofu,red chile,thai red curry paste,olive
title: Spicy Tofu
ingredients: 1 package firm tofu | 12 slices thick slab bacon | 1 tablespoon olive, or more as needed ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 1 small red chile, chopped
instructions: Place tofu on a work surface, and cut crosswise into very large wedges. Slice bacon crosswise into thick strips. Spread bacon slices out on a paper towel lined plate. Squeeze excess moisture from tofu, and place between paper towels. Pat with some of the bacon fat until tofu is covered. Sprinkle curry paste on tofu along with some of the chopped fresh chili. Squeeze slices of bacon again to secure. Lay bacon on top of an inverted wok or other large skillet that can be placed directly over medium high heat. Scatter tofu over the bacon. Turn heat down until it smokes, about 10 minutes. Remove tofu from the skillet, using a spatula. Slice crosswise into triangles, and serve with warmed chile flavored rice. Note, if using salted tofu you may want to drain some of the liquid from it.

Random Ingredients: mexican oregano,digestive biscuit,heavy cream,chutney,cheese,black eyed pea,lime wedge,beef marrow
title: Guilt Free Heart Attack Crab
ingredients: 1 jar chutney | 1 package digestive biscuits | 1 3/4 cups beef marrow | 12 black-eyed peas | 8 tablespoons shredded cheese ( i used sharp cheddar ) | 1 cup heavy cream | 1/3 cup mexican oregano | 1 lime wedge
instructions: Drain meat, bone and remove marrow from bones and mash. Cut out heart shaped sections of hearts. Fill small casseroles with bread and put in bottom of crockpot. Stir remaining ingredients in blender and pour over the bread. Bake at 200 degrees c for 2 hours or at 250 degrees f for 5 - 6 hours. Stir every 30 minutes. This makes an easy meal for dipping with the crab. The meal can be prepared in advance and refrigerated. The bread will stay hard.

Random Ingredients: bay leaf,russet potato,beef chuck,kosher salt black pepper,cardamom powder,ramen noodle,grain white rice
title: Ramen-Ramen-Smoked Beef & Vegetables(Or Egg-Free Version )
ingredients: 3 lbs beef chuck, cut into 3/4 pieces | 1 tablespoon kosher salt | 1 tablespoon cardamom powder | 3 bay leaves, broken up | 1 packet top ramen noodles | 3 cups kern brown rice | 1/3 cup chopped mixed vegetables ( broccoli, cauliflower, carrot )
instructions: Preheat grill to medium. Line a rack 6 inches from the heat. Sprinkle beef with 1 tbsp salt, cover, and set aside. In a medium saucepan, heat enough water to cover meat by 1/2 inch, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand 30 minutes. Drain liquid from meat and set aside. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, combine 1/4 cup of reserved liquid and 2 tbsp of the seasoning packet from Top Ramen noodles. Add the ramen noodles and toss to combine. In a large skillet, brown meat in remaining oil, about 3 minutes. Remove from pan. Add noodles to pot, stir in rice, and remaining ingredients except veg and heat until hot and sticky, about 2 minutes. Serve in bowls with meat on top.

title: Ricciosi (Baked Crab)
ingredients: 12 ounces imitation crabmeat, picked with tails intact | 1/2 - 3/4 cup dry marinara sauce | 1/2 - 3/4 cup crumbled cooked bacon
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f in a 9 pie pan, combine crabmeat, marinara sauce and bacon. If desired, sprinkle with additional bacon slices to cover the mixture evenly. Make sure to cover crab mixture entirely. Bake for approximately 15 to 20 minutes or till golden on top.

title: Creamy Basil Soup for One!
ingredients: 28 ounces cream of chicken soup | 2 tablespoons dark rum, you can use dark ( or more to suit taste ) | 20 -30 thai basil
instructions: In a bowl, mix together the soup, rum and basil and serve in large bowls.

Random Ingredients: cherry,walnut,avocado oil,picante sauce,prosciutto,extra virgin olive oil,honey
title: Picante Guacamole
ingredients: 3 ripe avocados | 2 tablespoons honey | 1/4 cup picante sauce | 1 lb prosciutto | 1/4 cup walnuts | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 2 tablespoons cherries
instructions: Preheat broiler. Cut avocados lengthwise and remove pit. Place avocados in a bowl. Add honey, picante sauce, proscuitto, walnuts and olive oil. Mix well. Spice mixture with serrated knife. Broil until nuts are light brown and bubbly approximately 3 minutes of high broiler time. Place pita on serving plate or serving platter. Top with guacamole and cherry.

title: Red Beans (From Paula Deen)
ingredients: 2 cans red beans, drained and rinsed | 1 1/2 cups seasoned bread crumbs | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Place red beans in a large bowl, and mash them with a fork.

Random Ingredients: wine,cod fish fillet,pasta,beef stock,active yeast,cashew nut,hoagie,pork sparerib
title: Chinese Hot Pot
ingredients: 1/3 cup dry wine | 2 1/4 cups homemade beef stock, heated | 3 lbs boneless pork spareribs, cut in half | 2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 8 hoagie rolls, split | 1/2 cup cashew nuts, coarsely chopped | 1 cup fresh pasta ( optional ) | 1 lb raw swiss chard, stemmed julienned, leaves washed
instructions: In a large saucepan, stir all the ingredients together and cook for 30 minutes over low heat. Cook the pasta, drain and cut it in half. Spoon the hot broth over the pasta, sprinkle on the cashew nuts and serve immediately.

title: Smokey Prosciutto Bakes Appetizer
ingredients: 2 cups sfrito sauce | 1/2 lb prosciutto, thin | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning | 1 1/4 cups italian seasoned bread, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1/4 cup chervil, chopped
instructions: In a small saucepan, stir together the sofrito, prosciutto, and taco seasoning. Remove from the heat, and let cool. Mix together the bread, baking soda, and chervil in a bowl. Stir into the sofrito mixture. Form each piece of sofrito into a 4 or 5 torpedo shape. Place on a foil lined baking sheet, and bake at 400°f for 5 minutes. The bottoms should be a little crispy. Remove from oven, and leave a 2 to 3 inch slit in the top. With a wide spatula, turn up the sofrito on a heated slice of bread. Using a knife dipped in water, slice the bread in half, and serve.

title: Mashed Eggs With Knockwurst
ingredients: 3 eggs | 4 -6 knockwurst | 1 jar sweet italian parsley, minced | 1 tablespoon capers | 1 teaspoon rose water | 3 tablespoons sweet tequila
instructions: Bring eggs to a boil. Meanwhile, place knockwurst in a skillet with capers, rose water, and margarine. Heat over low flame until eggs are fully cooked. Mash with fork. Transfer to a serving bowl as soon as egg is done. Add more capers and/or margarine for garnish or to taste. Note, for added flavor, add a few teaspoons of lemon juice.

title: Banana & Green Bean Coconut Curry
ingredients: 2 bananas | 300 g green beans | 2 -3 tablespoons garlic paste | 400 ml coconut cream
instructions: Place coconut cream in pot and heat on medium heat till mixture reduces into a thick sauce. Chop bananas and place in sauce. Slightly cook bananas and bananas and add to sauce. Add green beans. Serve when you feel it is ready.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,tabasco sauce,pea,linguine,ice cream,cauliflower floret,squash,milk
title: Spicy Spring Pea Pasta
ingredients: 4 ounces linguine or 4 ounces spaghetti | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 1 squash, sliced thin ( about 1-1/2 cups ) | 1 cup frozen peas | 3 tablespoons skim milk | 3/4 cup skim milk | 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce ( or to taste ) | crushed ice cream | 1 -2 sprigs fresh cauliflower floret
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain and keep warm. Meanwhile, heat the sundried tomato oil in a medium nonstick skillet over medium low heat to medium high heat. Add squash and stir to warm through. Stir in peas, milk, tabasco and cooked pasta. Heat, stirring, until heated through. Spoon the pasta over hot, scallion sauce. Garnish with chopped fresh parsley.

Random Ingredients: cannellini bean,molasses,rice wine,lettuce leaf,garlic paste,dark raisin,bread
title: Honey Garlic Raisin Sandwich
ingredients: 1/2 cup dark raisin | 1 1/2 teaspoons garlic paste | 1 1/3 cups dried cannellini beans | 1/2 cup olive oil or 1/2 cup canola oil | 2 tablespoons rice wine or 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 10 -12 large bread rolls | lettuce leaf
instructions: Place the rice and raisins into a large bowl with enough hot water to cover. Soak, uncovered, for 15 - 20 minutes until plump. Meanwhile, in a mixing bowl or a coffee cup, crush the garlic paste with a fork. Add the beans and 1/4 cup of oil. Drain the soaked beans, and then add them to the bowl with the garlic. Set aside for 15 - 30 minutes. Cut the rolls into 10 - 12 slices. Brush each bread sandwich with a little more of the garlic oil. Spoon some of the drained raisin soaked beans onto the top half of the bread, and then pile the top with the remaining bread slices. Serve the sandwich warm with lettuce leaves.

Random Ingredients: superfine sugar,water artichoke heart,pesto sauce,sesame seed,soy burger crumbles,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Super Food: Super Simple and Tasty Pesto Dogs
ingredients: 1/2 - 3/4 cup sesame seeds | 1/4 cup superfine sugar | 1/2 teaspoon superfine sugar | 1/3 cup water-packed artichoke hearts | 1/4 cup store-bought pesto sauce | 16 ounces soy burgers ( such as terra chips ) | 1 -2 teaspoon crumbled pecorino cheese
instructions: Place the first five ingredients in a blender, and pulse until well mixed. In a large bowl, stir together pesto sauce and a small amount of oil from the artichokes. Stir the pesto mixture into the other ingredients, mix well. Preheat your pizzelle iron. Drop the burgers by heaping tablespoons onto the pan, and cook until puffed up and lightly browned on the edges, about 3 to 5 minutes. Turn to bake about 3 minutes, or until golden in spots, and serve with the pesto side.

title: Cremini Mushrooms and Kaffir Lime
ingredients: 1 lb cremini mushroom, halved and seeded | 4 large kaffir lime leaves, torn into large chunks | 3 tablespoons crushed peppercorns
instructions: Combine mushrooms, lime leaves, and crushed peppers in a large nonstick skillet. Cook over medium heat, stirring frequently, until mushrooms and lime leaves are reduced and liquid is reduced, about 6 minutes.

Random Ingredients: baby arugula,sausage,queso fresco,cottage cheese,flour,extra sharp cheddar cheese
title: Cheesy Sausage and Fresh Herb Lasagna Rollups
ingredients: 1/2 lb sausage | 2 ounces queso fresco, crumbled | 2 ounces cottage cheese | 1 ounce crumbled queso fresco | 2 teaspoons flour | 1 tablespoon extra-sharp cheddar cheese | 8 baby arugula
instructions: To cook the sausage in, cook sausage in a nonstick skillet over medium heat. Drain and set sausage aside to cool until warm. To make the cheese filling, combine cheese, flour and cheddar in a separate bowl. Preheat oven to 350°f. Roll sausage into small balls, about the size of a walnut. Place meatballs on a parchment paper lined sheet to cool. Place them in a baking dish. Spoon the cheese mixture from the center of each meatball and roll again. Top with the goat cheese and arugula. Bake for about 15 minutes until cheese begins to melt and arugula is hot.

title: Grilled Pear Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup pear juice | 1/2 cup pineapple juice ( unfiltered ) | white pepper, to taste
instructions: Combine the ingredients in a small pitcher. Cover and chill in the refrigerator till you are ready to serve. When ready to serve, remove the fruit from the refrigerator and sprinkle over the pepper as desired. Enjoy.

title: Spinach & Cheese Salad
ingredients: 2 bags baby spinach | 2 bags cheese | 3 lemons, zest of
instructions: Chop cheese into slices. Chop spinach finely. Cut lemon into wedges. In large bowl, toss with greens until spinach is coated and cheese has totally melted. Chill well for 30 mins prior to serving.

title: Finger-Licking Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs frying chickens, cut up | 2 lbs rutabagas, cut into 1 inch chunks | 1 cup frozen green pea | 3/4 cup of diced white onion | 1 anchovy, sliced ( optional ) | salt and pepper
instructions: Put chicken, rutabagas, peas, white onion and anchovy in a pot. Cook on medium heat for about 3 minutes.

title: Faux Onion & Coriander Potatoes
ingredients: 6 medium peeled baking potatoes ( about 800g ) | 2 spring onions | 1 tablespoon fresh coriander, chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c line a baking tray with foil and put the potatoes in a mixing bowl. Put on to the baking tray so they get to room temperature. Wash the onions in to the bowl of water you sprinkled over the potatoes and put some water on them. Put them in your microwave for about 4 minutes, stirring every minute and making sure they are evenly and evenly covered with onion water. Put the bowl back onto the shelf and cook for 10 minutes. The onions will have softened a lot. Turn off the oven. Put the potatoes back into the pan and give them a stir every so often so they stay crispy on the outside and the moisture isn't getting absorbed. Take them out of the oven and let come to room temperature. Place the lid of the pan on and put back in the oven for about 1 hour. Check that they are tender and then take them out and put the potatoes on a chopping board. Cut into thick slices. Add the chopped coriander to the butter mix that you cooked them inches now put the slices back onto the pan again and put back on the heat in the microwave for 8 - 10 minutes to cook and thicken up the butter. Serve with warm breads, if you wish enjoy.

title: Salmon Steak Salad
ingredients: 1 lb salmon steak, cut into 1-inch squares | 3 cups lettuce, chopped ( mixed ) | 1 cup jicama, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 cup jicama, cut into 1-inch cubes ( mixed ) | 1/2 cup vegetable broth | 1/4 cup maraschino cherry, cut into quarters ( optional ) | shredded lettuce ( optional )
instructions: Drain the water from salmon in a small mesh strainer set over a bowl. Squeeze the salmon to remove any remaining juices. Arrange the salmon in a layer on a platter. Chill until ready to serve. If serving the salad in advance, chill the salmon in the refrigerator. In a large salad bowl toss together the lettuce, citrus supremes, jicama, vegetable broth, and maraschino cherries. Arrange the salmon on top of the lettuce. Garnish with additional cherries.

Random Ingredients: pork loin,green grape,dark brown sugar,lettuce leaf,turkish bread,pine nut
title: Pork Loin and Green Grapes Salad
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb pork loin, trimmed of all fat, and cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1 loaf turkish bread, cut into 1/2-inch slices ( toasted and cut into half-moons ) | 2 cups green seedless grapes, quartered | 20 basil leaves | 2 tablespoons pine nuts, toasted | 1/2 cup packed dark brown sugar ( optional )
instructions: Spread cut bread onto baking sheet and toast in toaster oven until golden brown. Place pork on platter. Place grapes and 1/2 cup basil leaves in separate piles on top of the pork. Sprinkle pine nuts on top of pork, if desired. Pour remaining basil and chopped basil from a large dinner plate onto pork. Sprinkle with remaining basil and pine nuts serve.

Random Ingredients: black eyed pea,corn tortilla,cremini mushroom,kidney bean,red chili pepper,sultana
title: Black Eyed Peas and Mushrooms Breakfast Tacos
ingredients: 400 g kidney beans | 100 g corn tortillas | 15 g sultanas | 1/2 red chili pepper, deseeded and finely chopped | 100 g cremini mushrooms, finely chopped | 1 red chili pepper, deseeded and finely chopped | 400 g black-eyed peas, drained and rinsed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees celsius heat a large frying pan and cook the tortillas, one at a time, until crisp and golden. Drain on kitchen paper. Add all the remaining ingredients to the fried tortillas in the pan. Bring to the boil, then simmer for about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally and breaking up any lumps with a wooden spoon. Gently reheat tortillas for a few minutes, then remove from the heat. Spoon some bean filling into the centre of the tortilla. Fold it over and serve.

title: Strawberry-Cotija Dip
ingredients: 6 tablespoons olive oil | 1 pound strawberries, hulled and quartered | 1/2 white onion, chopped | 1/4 cup crumbled cotija cheese
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together the olive oil and strawberries. Gently stir in the onion and cheese until they are evenly coated.

Random Ingredients: shallot,sea salt,vegetable broth,rice wine,slab bacon,flat leaf parsley
title: Braised Shallots
ingredients: 2 slices thick slab bacon, chopped | 4 shallots, peeled and halved | 1 1/4 cups vegetable broth | 1 2/3 tablespoons rice wine or 1 2/3 tablespoons dry sherry | 1 tablespoon diced flat leaf parsley ( or flat leaf parsley ) | sea salt ( to taste )
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium high heat 2 minutes. Add bacon and cook until crisp, about 3 minutes. Drain bacon pieces on paper towels and set aside. Place shallots in the skillet along with the broth, rice wine and parsley. Cover and reduce heat to low. Simmer for 30 minutes. Sprinkle with salt and serve.

title: Hainanorean Pizza
ingredients: 1 prepared pizza crust | 1 tablespoon shaoxing wine | cooking oil | 4 ounces sliced mushrooms ( caps ) | crackers, sliced into wedges
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 f degrees. Slice the pizza crust into 4 squares. Place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Brush the crust with oil and bake for 10 minutes or until golden. While the crust is baking, boil about 4 ounces of sliced mushrooms in hot shaoxing wine for about 2 minutes or until tender. Reserve. When the crust is done, spread the sliced mushrooms with 1 teaspoon of cooking oil. Place the cooked mushrooms and the fried mushrooms in the crust and top with cracker crumbs until the crust is almost dry. Place the pizza onto a large platter. Cut into wedges and serve.

title: Herb Bread Fingers
ingredients: 4 cups seasoned bread crumbs | 3 1/2 tablespoons dried basil | 12 firm bread cookies, split in half
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a small bowl, stir together the bread crumbs, basil and enough of the bread crumb mixture to form firm, moist fingers. Place about 2 teaspoons of fingers in the center of each cookie half.

title: Homemade Cornflour
ingredients: 450 g cornflour | 1 tablespoon fine salt
instructions: Put corn flour and salt into a mixing bowl. Make a well in the centre and add the fine salt slowly. Knead to form a soft dough. Place dough onto a greased baking tray and knead lightly to bring round the edges. Preheat the oven to 190 degrees celsius. Take a large sheet of baking paper and cut out six circles. Using a 3 cm round cookie cutter, cut out circles of dough. Use a 3 cm diameter circle cutter and stamp out more circles. Repeat with 5 more circles. Brush each with a little melted butter and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Repeat with all of the dough. Place the cornflour rounds on the baking tray and bake in the oven for 25 minutes or until crisp. Remove from baking tray and cool on the baking tray. Store in an airtight container.

title: Apple and Pimento Pizzas
ingredients: 1 pizza crust | 1 jar sliced pimiento | 1 cup apple, coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Open pizza crust on a flat surface. Spread pimentos, apples, and pimentos evenly over crust. Top with second pizza crust, and top with fourth pizza crust. Heat in a preheated oven for 7 minutes, or until underside is browned.

title: Gramma's Beef Brisket
ingredients: 5 pounds beef brisket, fat trimmed | 1 cup blackberry jam | 2 vanilla beans, split | 1 banana, sliced | 1/2 cup basmati rice
instructions: Place the brisket fat side up on a large piece of aluminum foil. Spread 1 cup blackberry jam over meat. Place a vanilla bean split in the center of the jam and secure with a toothpick. Arrange the banana slices on top of the meat. Heat oven to 300 degrees f. Place the brisket fat side up on a rimmed baking sheet. Bake uncovered for 3 to 4 hours. Remove from oven, and slice across grain into 1/4 slices. Serve with basmati rice.

title: Chicken and Honey Stuffed Whole Chicken
ingredients: 1 whole chickens | 2 teaspoons clear honey | 2 teaspoons fresh flat-leaf parsley, chopped ( or 1 tsp dried )
instructions: Heat oven to 220 c/fan 180c/gas trimming the outside of the chicken and remove any giblets or excess fat. Rinse chicken inside and out and cut out the neck and giblets, taking care not to cut into the meat. Remove any excess fat and neck fat. Rinse chicken and place in an oven dish with enough hot water to cover. Bake for 1 1/2 hours or until cooked through. Meanwhile place honey into a small non metal pan or pan with the parsley. Heat gently whisking all the while. Cut the bird up into serving sized pieces. When the chicken has been cooking for about 25 - 30 mins, remove from the baking dish and pour into a large saucepan. Reduce heat to low and warm through for about 5 mins or until warm through and honey has melted. Serve chicken with the honey sauce and remaining chopped parsley if using.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock cube,buttermilk,italian tomato,tomato sauce,golden syrup,mozzarella cheese
title: Tasty Italian Muffin Chocloaf
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups diced fresh italian tomatoes | 1/2 cup tomato sauce | 125 g mozzarella cheese, grated | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 1 chicken stock cube | 1 cup low fat buttermilk
instructions: Combine ingredients in a large bowl, stir well. Line an ovenproof dish with non stick baking paper. Pour mixture into paper lined dish and bake at c for 50 - 60 minutes or until firm. Take out of the oven, leave to cool slightly before cutting. Serve warm with your favourite things. Delicious to serve in a loaf shape as a sandwich with some roasted veggies as a snack.

Random Ingredients: arborio rice,superfine sugar,chunky salsa,pecan,worcestershire sauce,sunflower oil
title: Sunflower Rice Salad With Risotto, Roasted Pecans and Herbs
ingredients: 4 tablespoons sunflower oil | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 3 cups arborio rice | 3/4 cup thick thick & chunky salsa | 1/2 cup superfine sugar | 1/2 cup toasted pecans, coarsely chopped
instructions: Heat oil in small heavy saucepan to medium boil. Stir in worcestershire sauce and rice stirring until rice is creamy and all the surface are coated with oil. Transfer rice to serving dish and toss with salsa, sugar, pecans.

Random Ingredients: eggplant,golden mushroom soup,dill pickle,red onion,escarole,metal skewer,beef rib
title: Escarole Beef and Eggs
ingredients: 1 small eggplant ( approximately 1 lb. ) | 2 lbs beef ribs ( or chicken ) | 1 cup dill pickle, chopped | 1 medium head escarole, coarsely chopped | 1 can condensed golden mushroom soup | metal skewer ( optional ) | 1 small red onion ( optional )
instructions: In a very large skillet, preheat oven to 350 f. Cut stem off eggplant and cut in half crosswise. Halve and core egg lengthwise. Turn each half into a 2 x 2 x 2/8 inch rectangle, cutting all the way to the edge of the slice. Starting at the long side, carefully roll each slice lengthwise. Place in an 8x8 inch baking dish. Slice beef diagonally across the grain into 1/4 inch slices. In bowl, combine pickle and escarole. Sprinkle over the meat. In small bowl combine the soup with the remaining soup and divide among the beef slices. Cover dish with foil and bake at 350 f for 25 - 35 minutes. Uncover, sprinkle with onion and bake for 10 minutes longer. Serve.

title: Vegan Fried "whatever You Have on Hand" Peas
ingredients: 1 bag frozen peas, defrosted | 1/2 cup dark soy sauce ( low sodium preferred ) | 1 envelope taco seasoning mix
instructions: Preparation, microwave the peas until tender, approximately 5 minutes. Add the dark soy sauce, taco seasoning mix and microwave until thoroughly mixed. I like to microwave this just to make sure that it is fully incorporated. Once peas are hot, drain them using a colander to rinse the peas and let them cool slightly. Note, if using a bag of peas, drain the liquid as well. Once the peas are cool, stir in the soy sauce. Cover and refrigerate until chilled, preferably overnight.

Random Ingredients: orange juice,pepper sauce,ditalini pasta,italian seasoning,hot green chili pepper,banana,mango chutney
title: Stirfry Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 pound ditalini pasta | 3 hot green chili peppers, seeded and sliced | 1 cup orange juice | 2 bananas, sliced | 1 mango chutney, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1/2 teaspoon italian seasoning
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil. Add pasta and return to a boil. Cook at a boil, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 13 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Meanwhile, heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Stir in green chilies, orange juice, bananas, and mango chutney. Season with hot pepper sauce and italian seasoning.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed,chicken breast half,rock salt,tart apple,chilies,olive oil,apple juice
title: Chicken With Apple and Sesame Nuts (Healthy Version)
ingredients: 1 cup raw honey roasted chilies ( preferably california ) | 1/2 cup unsweetened apple juice | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 1/4 teaspoon rock salt | 6 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1 cup coarsely chopped tart apple
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Place the chiles on a baking sheet coated with cooking spray, and bake in the oven for 5 minutes or until skins blister and darken, turning every 10 minutes. Set aside to cool. Remove the seeds from the chiles using a teaspoon. Place in a mixing bowl, and add the apple juice, oil, sesame seeds, and salt, blending and stirring well. Add the chicken breasts and turn until well coated. Roast the breasts for about 30 minutes per side, basting frequently with the chile mixture. Serve with plain rice and vegetables.

title: Rice with Almonds and Carrots
ingredients: 1/2 cup uncooked long-grain white rice | 2 cups sliced baby carrots | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Place rice, carrots, and almond extract in a microwave safe dish, cover, and microwave for 3 minutes on high, or until noodles are tender.

Random Ingredients: stewing beef,half,pineapple chunk,parsley flake,flour,sultana,red enchilada sauce,zucchini
title: Mexican Beef & Pineapple Stew
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1 can pineapple chunks, in own juice | 1 -2 tablespoon fresh parsley flakes | 2 tablespoons flour | 2 cups half-and-half or 2 cups milk | 1 can red enchilada sauce | 2 tablespoons sultanas ( optional ) | 1 zucchini, cut into 1/2 inch slices
instructions: In a large pot, saute diced beef in onion and flour till cooked. Add pineapple juice, stewed beef, and drained pineapple. When meat is almost done, add milk and red enchilada sauce and simmer, covered over low heat for at least two hours adding more juice if needed. Add sultanas and zucchini and simmer 15 minutes more.

title: Pickled Red Pepper Relish
ingredients: 4 medium red peppers | 1 jar red currant jelly
instructions: Quarter the peppers.

title: Chicken Korma with Pita Pies
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups quinoa | 3/4 cup reduced-sodium chicken broth | 1/2 cup kalamata olives, sliced | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 8 6-inch pita bread rounds | mixed salad green | 1 large rotisserie-cooked chicken, shredded
instructions: Place quinoa and chicken broth, in a microwave safe bowl over high heat. Cover, venting steam vents, and set aside. Combine olives, cardamom and garam masala in a medium bowl. Add the quinoa and chicken.

title: Pumpkin Gnocchi
ingredients: 250 g pumpkin ( about 10 medium sized winter pumpkin ) | 500 g unbleached white flour ( or gluten-free flour ) | 100 g tomato ketchup | 600 ml greek yogurt | 3 tablespoons pine nuts
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c. Place the pumpkin in an ovenproof dish, skin side down. Scatter over 100g of flour and place in the oven. Cook for 1hr and 20 25mins on the middle shelf, until the pumpkin is tender. Turn the pumpkin over and cook for 15 moremins. Remove the pumpkin from the oven, place on a board and spread the potato out like normal using a sharp knife. Add the ketchup and 1 2mm/3tsp water to the potato in the dish, then mix well together. Roll a handful of pumpkin into a smooth log and lay on top of the potato on the flour. Roll lightly with the rolling pin to flatten it as much as possible. Repeat with the rest of the pumpkin and dough, and lay them on top. Turning as needed so they are evenly covered with dough. Spread the yoghurt over the gnocchi, and sprinkle with grated pine nuts. Cover the dish with a sheet of baking paper. Bake for 40 minutes, until the crust is nicely browned and the filling is heated through. Cool slightly then serve straight away.

Random Ingredients: bean,sage,sultana,olive oil,triple sec,garlic paste,chow mein noodle,golden raisin
title: Chow Mein With Noodles
ingredients: 1 lb fresh chow mein noodles | 1 1/4 cups sultana ( golden raisins ) | 1 1/4 cups golden raisins | 4 teaspoons olive oil | 2 tablespoons garlic paste | 5 tablespoons triple sec | 10 cups refried beans | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon dried sage
instructions: Boil the chow mein noodles according to package directions. Drain and rinse in cold water. Set aside. Meanwhile, mix all other ingredients except the bean beans and sage together in a large, dry frying pan. Set heat to medium high. Add beans and sage and stir fry for 2 - 3 minutes. Spread the mei noodles in a large microwave safe dish or serving bowl, layer them on top of the bean mixture, then spoon the bean bean mixture onto the noodles in the dish. Serve while hot.

Random Ingredients: roasting chicken,crabmeat,avocado,cumin seed,kalamata olive,cider vinegar,onion powder
title: Ceviche by Neil Perry
ingredients: 1 roasting chicken | 1 cup cider vinegar | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1 can crabmeat, drained | 2 cans kalamata olives, drained and minced | 1 avocado, mashed
instructions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees f. Rinse and clean the chicken. Place chicken in a roasting pan. Cover breast with aluminum foil and bake in the preheated oven for 10 minutes. Turn oven to broil and broil for 5 minutes. Remove the chicken from pan, tent with a tent of foil, and place under a baking rack so the juices run clear. When the chicken is done, remove the foil, and place the roasting pan on a kitchen towel. Rub chicken with the oil from the roasting pan. Sprinkle the chicken with onion powder and cumin seeds. Combine the vinegar, onion powder, and cumin in a microwave safe bowl, and heat in the microwave 10 to 20 seconds, or until boiling and thickened. Remove the baking pan from the oven. Pour the warm vinegar mixture into the roasting pan. Top chicken and broil for 2 to 3 minutes. Turn chicken over and broil 2 to 3 minutes until brown. Remove from oven and top with olives, avocado, and crabmeat. Pour cocktail sauce over chicken before serving.

title: Spicy Stuffed Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 lb ripe tomatoes or package spanish onion | 1/2 cup pitted pimento stuffed olive ( can use pimento stuffed olives ) | 1/2 cup finely chopped spanish onion | greek yogurt ( i just use one low fat plain yogurt ) | salad, of choice ( enough for 4 servings ) | 3/4 tablespoon tomato puree
instructions: Cut the top off of the tomatoes, and scoop out the pulp into a bowl.. Put the pulp into a blender, and puree, adding a bit of water, if necessary.

title: Tasty Onion Dip
ingredients: 2 medium red onions | 1 1/2 - 2 teaspoons turmeric powder | 2 tablespoons grated red onions ( indian onion may also be used ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons sesame oil | 1 jalapeno pepper, finely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Wash the onions and slice them into rings about 2 inches long and 3/4 of an inch thick. Place a layer of them on the bottom of an 8 inch nonstick skillet or a wok/dutch oven, then sprinkle evenly with the turmeric powder. Place the onion slices on top of the turmeric in the pan and lightly sprinkle over the red onion slices. Continue adding layers as you're adding the red onion & onion. Heat the sesame oil over medium heat and sprinkle over the onion as before. Serve hot with pita chips or toasted whole wheat pita bread.

Random Ingredients: black pepper,corn oil,dark chocolate chip,fillet tilapia,celery root,currant
title: Glazed Tilapia With Brown Butter
ingredients: 1 tablespoon corn oil | 1 stalk celery root, coarsely chopped | 1 ounce butter | 1/4 cup dark chocolate chips | 1/8 teaspoon black pepper | 1 fillet tilapia
instructions: Preheat broiler. Grease a broiler pan with corn oil. Place celery root in a pan with just enough water to cover. Bring to boil, and immediately immediately turn off heat. Immediately drain into a bowl, allow to cool, and then peel away outer shell. Cut into 1/8 strips. Melt butter in a saucepan over low heat, and then mix in the dark chocolate. Remove from heat and mix in the black pepper. Lightly grease a 9x13 inch oven dish. Arrange the tilapia over the bottom of the dish. Spread with the melted chocolate mixture, and broil for 3 to 5 minutes, until just barely cooked. Serve immediately.

title: Rice Puffs
ingredients: 3 tablespoons cornflour | 100 g raw shrimp ( shelled and deveined ) | 1 tablespoon marjoram | 1 teaspoon unflavored gelatin | 4 slices rye bread ( crusty or white sandwich bread ) | 1/4 cup golden raisin | 1 teaspoon cocoa
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Place all the ingredients in a small pot and bring to the boil over high heat. Immediately remove the mixture from the heat and stir until dissolved. Place the mixture in a food processor and blend until smooth. Spoon the mixture into 4 ramekins. Smooth out any lumps. Place ramekins in an oven dish and add enough hot water to cover them. Place on a baking tray. Cook for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden. Remove from the oven and leave on the tray until cool. To serve, cut a ramekin in half and sandwich together with a slice of rye bread and a ramekin.

Random Ingredients: peach preserve,beef chuck,ha avocadoes,coconut pecan frosting
title: Texas Cowboy Bon Bon Boneless Beef
ingredients: 4 cans sliced peaches in light syrup | 8 large hass avocadoes, halved lengthwise | 2 packages coconut pecan frosting | 1 pound boneless beef chuck, cut into 1/2-inch strips
instructions: Spread peaches evenly on a microwave safe plate and microwave on high for 6 minutes. Cool slightly. Spoon a portion of the peaches into each of the 8 avocado halves.

title: Creamy Chickpea Soup
ingredients: 1 cup fresh cheese, cut in small cubes | 1 large cooking onion, chopped | 2 stalks celery, chopped | 1 can vegetable stock | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon dried italian parsley | 1/2 cup greek yogurt
instructions: Put the block of cheese in the slow cooker. Next, add cooking onion and celery. Pour in the remaining stock. Then add thyme. Cook on low in the slow cooker for 4 hours. Before serving stir in the yogurt if using.

Random Ingredients: beer,potato,black pepper,chicken bouillon cube,white vinegar,egg yolk,chocolate baking square
title: French Hot Potato Nuggets
ingredients: 4 large potatoes | 6 -8 chicken bouillon cubes | 4 ounces bittersweet chocolate baking squares | 3 -4 tablespoons white vinegar | 1 cup beer | 1 large egg yolk | 1 pinch fresh ground black pepper
instructions: Scrub and peel potatoes and cut into thin slices. Place in cold water to prevent them from browning. Place the bouillon cubes in a medium saucepan over medium high heat. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Add the potatoes, and let boil for 5 minutes. Drain the potatoes using a colander or strainer into a bowl of cold water to prevent the potatoes from cooking unevenly. Pour off any remaining water. While the potatoes are boiling, combine chocolate and vinegar in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Stir constantly until melted and smooth, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat and pour into bowl containing the hot potato mixture. Stir slowly into the chocolate mixture until no lumps are present. Add egg yolk, stirring just until incorporated. Add pepper, continuing to stir. Pour into a buttered 1 1/2 quart baking dish. Bake in 400 f. Oven for 30 minutes, or until mixture is firm. Serve warm or cold.

title: Sherry Paste
ingredients: 1 cup sherry | 1 tablespoon grated gingerroot
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small saucepan and cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until mixture is hot but not boiling.

Random Ingredients: rice wine,ham,dill,salsa,chuck,chicken wing,green chilies,black eyed pea
title: Rice Wine Beef-Chicken Dinner (Dees)
ingredients:
5 lbs chuck ( cut in bite size pieces ) | 8 -10 lbs chicken wings ( cut in serving pieces ) | 2 lbs cooked ham ( cut in bite size pieces ) | 4 cans salsa | 4 cans diced green chilies, drained | 1 can black-eyed peas, drained | 1 cup cilantro and dill 
    - 2 cups rice wine
instructions: Marinate meat& wings overnight in rice wine, salsa, chilies, and black eyed peas until ready to assemble and heat thoroughly. This will make them easy to serve. Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Line a large pyrex dish with foil or baking pan. Place the chicken pieces in layers in dish, alternating it with the meat& wings. Pour the remaining ingredients over the top and bake for 2 1/2 3 hours, or bake for 3 hours, depending on your oven.

Random Ingredients: cream tartar,cottage cheese,cauliflower floret,chipotle chile adobo,pearl barley,ginger,apple,bread
title: Quick and Easy Spicy Cardamom Cauliflower With Chipotle Cream
ingredients: 1 cup instant pearl barley | 3 cups cauliflower florets | 1 tablespoon butter | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground ginger | 2 canned chipotle chiles in adobo, finely minced | 1 apple, peeled cored and cut into 1/4-inch thick slices ( optional ) | 1 cup low fat cottage cheese
instructions: Cook the pearl barley according to package directions in boiling water or a large pot of salted boiling water until just tender. While the barley is cooking, steam the cauliflower until tender. Drain well and place on a large platter that has been sprinkled with a generous amount of sea salt. Heat the butter in a skillet over medium high heat, add the cream of tatrar and allow it to heat through. Stir in the ginger and chipotle and cook for two or three minutes, taking care not to burn it. Spread the cauliflower evenly over the bottom of the platter and sprinkle the cardomon on top. Add the apple slices, if using, and spoon the chipotle cream over all. Serve.

title: Homemade Caviar
ingredients: 2 lbs firm plum tomatoes, halved lengthwise | 2 cans pitted black olives, drained
instructions: Place tomatoes, cut side down, on a foil lined baking sheet. Sprinkle with salt. Bake at 425 degrees f for about 20 minutes, or until skins loosen. Peel and coarsely chop tomatoes. Place in large bowl and stir with olives. Cover and refrigerate for 3 hours or until needed.

title: Red Cabbage (Shredded)
ingredients: 1 medium red cabbage ( about 1 pound ) | 8 ounces fresh fruit juice ( such as pulp from canned fruit such as fruit of choice )
instructions: Core cabbage and cut into 1/2 inch thick slices. Pour fruit juices into a 2 quart casserole. Add cabbage and cover. Bake in a preheated 350°f oven, stirring several times until all juices bubble.

title: Tikka's Simple Sweetheart Kiss
ingredients: 1/2 tablespoon cumin seeds, toasted and crushed | 24 ladyfingers | ladyfinger, for dipping
instructions: Combine cumin seeds and crushed toasted cayenne pepper in a small bowl. Set aside to cool a few minutes to allow cumin flavor to infuse for flavors. Split ladyfingers in half horizontally and dip into cumin mixture. Set aside and repeat until no more moist fingers touch. Dip ladyfingers first in the remaining cumin mixture and allow to dry for a few minutes. Serve with desired icing.

Random Ingredients: topping,cayenne pepper,tomato green chilies,flour tortilla,rosemary,green pepper,creamy peanut butter
title: Savory Veggie Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 cup sour cream | 2 tablespoons creamy peanut butter | 1 package dried tri-colored peppers or ( 10 ounce ) package green peppers | 2 cans diced tomatoes with green chilies | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh rosemary ( or more ) | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper ( or more ) | 10 large flour tortillas
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix sour cream, peanut butter, chilies and rosemary in large bowl. Drain peppers, reserving liquid. Cut peppers and remaining vegetables into 1 strips. Stir sour cream mixture until well blended. Pour 2/3 cup reserved liquid and half of peppers into medium bowl. Stir in tomatoes. Sprinkle evenly with cayenne salt, if desired. Arrange two tortillas on clean workspace spread each with about a rounded tablespoon of the sour cream mixture. Roll up each enchilada and place seam side down in lightly greased 15x10x2 baking dish. Repeat with remaining tortillas and sour cream mixture. Sprinkle with remaining cayenne pepper if desired. Cover with foil and bake until enchiladas are hot, about 45 minutes. Uncover and bake about 7 minutes more or until topping is lightly browned.

title: Tender Beef Cubes for a Crowd
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs ground veal | 1 medium onion, chopped fine | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 teaspoon dill weed | 1 english cucumber
instructions: Heat oven to 450 degrees. In a bowl, combine ground veal, finely chopped onion, soup, dill weed, cucumber and mix well. Spoon meat mixture into ungreased rectangular baking dish or other pan. Bake uncovered for 45 minutes or until meat loses its pink colour and is cooked through. Serve with a crisp salad of lettuce, vegetables.

title: Tangy Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 beef tenderloin | 1 teaspoon ketchup | 1 teaspoon mango chutney | 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper
instructions: Place tenderloin in a ziplock with pepper. Pierce with a fork. Combine ketchup, chutney and red pepper in a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: mango,hard egg,sauerkraut,pork shoulder,grand marnier,wheat bread crumb,escarole,filling
title: Grand-Marnier-Mango Pork
ingredients: sauerkraut : | 2 pounds pork shoulder | 4 hard-cooked eggs, chopped | 1 mango - peeled, seeded and chopped | 2 pounds fresh escarole, chopped | sauerkraut : | 4 cups plain whole wheat bread crumbs | 1/4 cup grand marnier
instructions: Place pork shoulder in a skillet over medium heat and drizzle with enough water so it is 3/4 full of water. Bring to a boil then reduce heat to medium low and simmer until pork is very tender and falling off the bone, about 2 1/2 to 4 hours. Remove pork to a bowl with a slotted spoon and skim off any surface fat. When done, cut away any large pieces of pork left behind, and slice into thin strips. Return to the pan, cover and simmer until most of the liquid has been reduced and sauerkraut is creamy and sticky, about 15 minutes. Remove sausage to a separate bowl and reserve cooking liquid.

title: Indian Lentil Chutney
ingredients: 2 cans red lentils, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup coconut oil | 1 tablespoon olive oil or 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme | 1 teaspoon allspice | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin
instructions: Heat all ingredients except red and white chutney in a large saute pan over medium heat until hot. Simmer a few minutes more. Add the chutney through a fine mesh strainer.

title: Oriental Noodle Bread
ingredients: 7 cups rolled oats | 2 limes, zested and juiced | 1 (.75 ounce ) package active dry yeast | 2 tablespoons grated ginger | 3 whole carrots, peeled and grated | 21 ounces arugula | 1 jar picante sauce | 2 cups farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta
instructions: Place 6 cups rolled oats in the bowl of a food processor and pulse until coarsely ground. Transfer half the ground oats to a bowl, mix in the lime zest and juice, yeast, ginger, and carrots. Add the remaining ground oats, 1/2 the arugula, and the picante sauce and mix until blended. Mix in the farfalle and cover with a towel. Set aside to rise until doubled, about 1 hour. Drain and place the remaining arugula and sauce in a large bowl and let it chill until ready to use. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Gradually stir in the farfalle pasta and remove from heat. Let stand for 5 minutes, then drain well, stirring occasionally. Transfer to a well buttered 2 quart casserole. Cover and let rise until slightly puffy, about 35 minutes. Preheat the oven to 500 degrees f. Bake the bread for 10 minutes in the preheated oven, then reduce heat to 350 degrees f and bake for an additional 10 minutes. Remove from the oven, then cool on a wire rack. Cut the bread into wedges if desired. Serve.

Random Ingredients: squash,pasta shell,puff pastry,rotisserie chicken,chicken,pea,ranch dressing mix,white flour
title: Delicious Crock Pot Chicken Pie
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons white flour | 1 package ranch dressing mix | 1 1/2 lbs cubed cooked chicken | 1 lb ground round | 1 cup frozen peas | 1 whole rotisserie-cooked chicken | 1 cup frozen squash, sliced | 2 ounces frozen puff pastry, cut into 4 equal pieces | pasta shells, cut into 4 equal portions
instructions: Stir first five ingredients together in a medium bowl. Divide chicken and then peas between 4 - 4 quart crock pot or high wall crock pot. Layer chicken, peas and roti over chicken. Top with puff pastry squares. Cover with plastic wrap. Cook on high for 6 hours or low for 6 - 8 hours. The chicken may be frozen and refrigerated for upto 4 days.

Random Ingredients: banana,spring onion,italian dressing,yellow mustard,ziti pasta,iceberg lettuce,bread flour,anise seed
title: Bake Sale Style Ziti (Dairy Free)
ingredients: 1 package ziti pasta ( about 15 ounces ) | 6 spring onions, finely chopped ( about 40 grams ) | 5 bananas, peeled & halved lengthwise ( about 8 ounces ) | 1/2 cup light italian dressing | 1/4 teaspoon anise seed | 1/2 teaspoon yellow mustard | 1 cup finely chopped iceberg lettuce or 1 cup swiss roll | 4 tablespoons finely chopped bread flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Lightly oil a 9x13 baking pan or baking sheet. Cook ziti in boiling water until just tender, drain, and set aside. While ziti is cooking, make the marinade, in a small bowl, stir together the dressing, onion, bananas, mustard, lettuce & 1/4 cup water until mixed, adding more water if dressing seems dry. Stir in the pasta and marinated ziti. Spread the remaining 1/4 cup of dressing marinade over the top. Sprinkle with the remaining 1/2 cup of bread flour, cover tightly with foil, & bake until heated through and the ziti is brown.

Random Ingredients: dark chocolate,white peppercorn,plain flour,garlic powder,parsnip,spaghetti sauce,cardamom seed,pizza sauce
title: Pancake Parsnip Fritters
ingredients: 500 g parsnips, unpeeled | 2 -4 teaspoons white peppercorns, coarsely crushed | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/2 cup red spaghetti sauce | 1/2 cup pizza sauce | 100 g dark chocolate, chopped | plain flour, for dusting
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c. Line a large baking tray with baking parchment. Slice the parsnips diagonally into rounds about 1cm thick. Place the parsnips into a mixing bowl with the pepper and cardamom. Season with salt and pepper. Toss well. Add the garlic powder, spaghetti sauce and pizza sauce. Mix all together. Spoon about 1 tbsp onto a flat surface or tray. Using a small desert spoon, cover the parsnip mixture evenly with the mixture and press lightly. Bake on the centre shelf for about 10 minutes or until cooked through. Do not overcook the mixture. Transfer the fritters onto a paper towel lined baking tray. Cover and store in the refridgerator until needed. Melt the chocolate in a small saucepan over a low heat, stirring frequently until smooth. Dust plates with flour and serve fritters with chocolate sauce and dipping sauces.

title: Spice Crusted Chickpeas  (Baked)
ingredients: 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs ( plain or flavored ) | 1/2 cup finely chopped red bell pepper | 1/2 cup chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 2 cups couscous
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit. Lightly grease a 3 qt baking dish or line with parchment paper and spray parchment.
