In a small bowl mix the graham cracker crumbs with the bell pepper and chick peas. Add the couscous and stir until all ingredients are evenly coated. Spread half the crumb mixture in the baking dish. Bake until it is beginning to brown, about 25 minutes. Remove from oven, cover with foil and let cool for 10 minutes. With a spatula, transfer the casserole, to the serving dish and serve. If desired, serve with a dollop of aïoli on the side.

Random Ingredients: cherry,wine vinegar,gingersnap cooky,orange flower water,cake flour,cream mushroom soup,tilapia fillet
title: Sopapilla
ingredients: 2 -3 tilapia fillets | 3 tablespoons cake flour | 1/4 cup sweet wine vinegar | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 can sliced almonds or 1 can sliced almonds | 1 small orange, juice of | 2 tablespoons sweetened dried cherries or 2 tablespoons dried cranberries
instructions: Preheat oven to season tilapia with salt and pepper. Rinse and pat dry with paper towels. Place fillets on a greased cookie sheet. Mix together the flour and sweet wine vinegar in a small bowl and dip each fillet in flour mixture coating both sides. Arrange fish in an ungreased 13 x 9 inch pan. Cover with the sauce. Bake for 30 minutes, or until fish flakes easily with a fork. While fish is baking mix soup, almonds& orange juice together in a small bowl. When fish is done baking add the soup mixture and heat to boiling, remove from the oven. Remove fish from pan and serve.

Random Ingredients: fruit,skin chicken thigh,kaffir lime leaf,salsa verde
title: Skinny Chicken Thighs (Kha Kai)
ingredients: 4 large skin-on chicken thighs ( about 3 pounds total ) | kaffir lime leaf, or 3 lime wedges, cut into 6 pieces | 1 jar salsa verde, chilled ( chunky salsa ) | 1 large sweet potato, peeled and cut into 3/4-inch cubes or 2 large turnips, peeled and cut into 3/4-inch cubes and peeled ( about 2½ pounds total )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Coat a shallow baking dish with cooking spray. Place chicken thighs in dish in single layer. Sprinkle chicken with kaffir lime leaf or lime peel. Pour jar of salsa verde over chicken. Cover dish tightly with plastic wrap. Bake in middle of oven about 30 minutes and turn chicken and bake about 30 minutes longer, or until chicken is cooked through, skin is golden and vegetables are tender and liquid is reduced to about 1 1/4 cups, or to taste.

title: Knoepuse
ingredients: 300 ml double cream | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1/2 teaspoon allspice | 1/2 teaspoon ketchup | 1/4 teaspoon mixed spice
instructions: Sieve the cream through a fine sieve and place in a glass bowl. Add allspice and mix to combine. Add the ketchup and mix well. Pour the cream mixture into the bowl of cream and leave overnight to thicken slightly. Serve chilled.

title: Dynamite
ingredients: 1 can tuna | 2 tablespoons water chestnuts, cut into bite size pieces ( optional )
instructions: Drain tuna and toss with the water chestnuts. Cover and refreeze.

title: Smoked Salmon Stew
ingredients: 1 medium spanish onion, chopped | 1 medium eggplant, chopped | 1 zest from a 2-oz. lemon | 3/4 lb ground round | 2 cups salmon, cooked and diced | 1/2 cup black olives, minced | 1 package frozen cut okra
instructions: In large saucepan cook onion, eggplant, zest and lemon zest in 1 t. Oil over medium heat until the onion is slightly soft add the ground beef and season with salt and pepper to your taste. Add salmon.

title: Corn Wontons with Won Ton
ingredients: 24 wonton wrappers | 60 g butter | 400 g corn kernels, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Melt butter in pan over low heat. Stir in corn and return to heat. Remove from heat. Pipe mixture into wonton skins and sprinkle tops with a little sugar. Cook in oven for 10 - 15 minutes, until golden brown and crisp.

title: Walnut Posole
ingredients: 6 ounces uncooked white hominy | 1 3/4 cups finely chopped walnuts | 2 bunches anaheim chilies, seeded and chopped | 2 cans madeira wine | 1/3 cup peanut butter
instructions: Put the hominy and 1 3/4 cup water into a large pot. Bring to the boil, then simmer, stirring occasionally, until tender, about 25 minutes. Drain and transfer the liquid to a food processor or blender. Pulse until finely ground. Return this to the pot, along with 1 1/2 cups of the walnuts and chiles. Pour into a large saucepan. Add the madeira and simmer until warmed through, about 1 minute. Stir in the peanut butter. Stir 1 - 2 teaspoons cold water into the mixture. Bring to a boil, then cook for 5 minutes. Remove from heat and refrigerate overnight, reheating the pot 2 - 3 times to mix flavors.

title: Sticky Buttered Dough I
ingredients: 4 1/2 cups wholemeal bread flour or 4 1/2 cups fine dry bread flour | 1 cup light corn syrup | corn syrup
instructions: Place the flour in a mixing bowl and make it a little stretch with your fingers. Mix the corn syrup and melted butter into the dry ingredients until everything is fully incorporated and the mixture forms a sticky dough. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead gently until smooth. The dough can then be cut into small balls. Roll out each ball into an 8 inch round that is about 1/8 thick on all sides and place on a lightly greased and floured cookie sheet. Prick the top with a fork a few times and brush with a little of the corn syrup. Sprinkle additional corn syrup on top. Bake in a preheated 350f oven for about 25 minutes or until light brown and crusty. Keep in an airtight container at room temperature. Store leftovers in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 2 weeks.

title: Baked Sausages on the Noodle Side Of the Noodle
ingredients: 12 links sausage, the kind with the rind on | 3 tablespoons hoisin sauce | 1 teaspoon red chili powder | 1 lb cooked lasagna noodles or 1 lb thin spaghetti sheets
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees. Rinse the sausage with cold water to remove the excess liquid. Put the rinds in a colander and sprinkle with red chili powder. Set aside. In a shallow casserole dish, put the noodles and drizzle with some of the hoisin sauce, toss until coated. In the prepared dish, lay out the whole sausages with rind on the noodles. Spoon some of the sauce on them, top with remaining sauce and sprinkle with more hoisin sauce. Cover, bake for about 30 minutes, or until the pasta is tender.

Random Ingredients: rice wine vinegar,mexican chocolate,vanilla essence,fine salt,chicken bouillon cube,lemon juice
title: Mexican Hot Chocolate Mix
ingredients: 3 tablespoons fine salt | 4 tablespoons instant rice wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon vanilla essence | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 2 chicken bouillon cubes | 1 1/2 cups mexican-style chocolate, coarsely chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl, whisking well with an electric mixer. Cover, and store in a cool place, stirring every few hours. Use immediately for hot coffee.

Random Ingredients: winter squash puree,red potato,cream,shell pasta,liquid egg substitute,tamari,garam masala,strawberry
title: Strawberry and Potato Korma
ingredients: 1 box small shell pasta | 1 cup dried winter squash puree | 2 cups cubed red potatoes | 1 cup egg beaters egg substitute | 1/2 cup light cream, whipping cream or 1/4 cup sour cream | 4 teaspoons garam masala | 2 tablespoons tamari | 1 pint fresh strawberries, coarsely chopped
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions, then drain. Meanwhile, in a large bowl, combine squash puree and cubed potatoes.

title: Chipotle's Basic Spice Mix
ingredients: 2 tablespoons mexican oregano | 1/2 cup apple cider ( i like spicy )
instructions: Mix with apple cider to make a mildish sauce. Store tightly capped in an airtight container. The mild Spanish style of chipotle's can be used on tacos, pico de gallo, salsa, etc. This is the first sauce i have tried that has had a mexican flavor.

title: Herbed Minced Beans
ingredients: 2 ounces dried great northern beans, soaked overnight | 1 1/2 teaspoons coconut oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons fresh herbs, chopped
instructions: Cook the beans, covered, in a large pan of boiling water, covered for 12 - 15 minutes or until tender. Drain the beans, reserving some of the cooking liquid. Return the beans to the same pan.

title: Guiness and Bean Stew
ingredients: 400 g butternut squash, peeled and cut into 1cm-thick rounds | 400 g broccoli, cut into 3cm-wide florets | 1/2 cup canned cannellini beans | 2 teaspoons golden syrup | 1/2 teaspoon unsweetened cocoa | 2 tablespoons brandy | 1 shallot, chopped | 2 teaspoons butter
instructions: Combine squash and broccoli in a large saucepan. Pour in remaining ingredients and bring to the boil. Reduce heat and simmer, covered about 20 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Serve hot.

title: Cousin De Spinaci (Spinach and Rice With Shrimp) (South Beach Diet)
ingredients: 3 cups spinach, cleaned and stemmed | 1 cup yellow rice | 1/2 cup mushroom, halved ( baby portobello ok ) | 1/2 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated | 1 lime wedge ( optional )
instructions: Boil the spinach and rice in salted water until tender, 7 to 10 minutes. Remove with a slotted spoon and set aside. Drain and then cool, about 1 minute. Drain the spinach. Squish into small pieces. Place the spinach and rice in an 8 to 10 inch skillet and add the mushrooms, parmigiano, and lime wedge. Toss to mix. Add the shrimp and stir with a wooden spoon until the shrimp turn pink. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: mint,parmesan cheese,granny smith apple,salt pepper,red wine
title: Solo Granny Smith Apples
ingredients: 2 granny smith apples | 4 ounces good red wine | 1/4 teaspoon dry mint, crushed | salt & pepper | minced fresh mint ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Peel and dice the apples into 1 cubes. Cook the apples in a fry pan with the wine and dried mint. Cook, stirring frequently, until apples are tender. Remove from heat, season to taste with salt & pepper, garnish with diced mint if desired and serve hot or cold.

Random Ingredients: pepperoncini pepper,vanilla bean,russet potato,maraschino cherry,onion paste
title: Papaya -- Papaya Spice Mixture
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs russet potatoes, peeled and cut into 1-2-inch pieces | 1 onion paste | 20 pepperoncini peppers | 10 maraschino cherries | 1 teaspoon vanilla bean, split down the middle
instructions: Mix ingredients in a blender container or bowl. Process to yield about 1 1/2 cup of mixture.

title: Cheesy Cretons
ingredients: 1 loaf of fresh white bread, cut into 1 1/2 inch pieces | 2 cups of shredded four-cheese mexican blend cheese
instructions: Take the butter out of the bowl and put 1/2 cup of cheese in the center of each slice of bread. Then sprinkle the four cheese over the bread. Wrap up in foil.

title: Holiday Sauce
ingredients: 30 g dried curds ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons vodka | 1 tablespoon honey or 1 tablespoon agave syrup | 3 green onions ( optional ) | 12 dates ( optional )
instructions: Wash, boil and drain the curd, place in a blender or food processor. Add honey or agave syrup and process until it is a smooth paste. Add the amount of dates required, one green onion for each. Process until smooth, remove from blender. If you want to add sliced almonds, a small handful at a time, cut them into tiny pieces. Add to your favourite sauce or serve cold in small glasses.

title: Cardamom Snow Peas and Snow Peas
ingredients: 2 cups fresh snow peas, trimmed | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: Place snow peas in a large bowl and sprinkle with cardamom over top. Cover with plastic wrap, and place in the freezer about 8 hours. When ready to serve, remove snow peas, and drain on paper towels. Allow snow pea mixture to sit at room temperature for 20 minutes before serving.

title: Maggie Beer's Flambée
ingredients: 1 pound ripe olives | 1/2 cup cold water | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar | 1/8 teaspoon dry mustard | 1 bay leaf, crushed
instructions: Grind olives in a food processor. Stir in cold water, confectioners' sugar, dry mustard, and bay leaf until smooth. Refrigerate 2 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: french baguette,pork loin,guacamole,lemon juice zest,white pepper,dark beer
title: Guacamole Crouton
ingredients: 1 garlic-infused pork loin, trimmed | 1 cup guacamole | 1/3 cup dark beer | 2 tablespoons freshly squeezed lemon juice | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper, or to taste | 1 french baguette, cut into 1/2-inch slices
instructions: Cover pork with plastic wrap and place in a microwave safe dish. Microwave on high until pork is cooked through, 3 to 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: french bread,vanilla bean,graham cracker crumb,wheat tortilla,chicken wing,serrano pepper,beer,beet
title: Drunken Chicken
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs whole chickens wings, separated | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla bean | 1/4 cup graham cracker crumbs, for topping | 8 whole wheat tortillas or 8 corn tortillas | 12 slices thick-cut french bread | 12 slices thin sliced beets | 1/2 cup canned evaporated low-fat beer | 1/2 cup pickled serrano peppers, drained on paper towel
instructions: Bring 6 quarts of water to a boil.

Random Ingredients: beef stock,red food coloring,juniper berry,chicken breast,half cream
title: Creamy Smothered Chicken With Sage Gravy
ingredients: 4 chicken breasts, skin removed | 2 cups heavy cream | 3 tablespoons half-and-half cream or 3 tablespoons cream | 2 tablespoons instant coffee granules or 2 tablespoons freshly ground coffee | 1 teaspoon juniper berries ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Combine cream, half and half, and instant coffee with a fork. Place chicken pieces in a glass dish, pour cream mixture over. Place into oven and bake for 45 minutes. Remove chicken and let rest for 5 minutes. Remove the skin from the chicken and return the chicken to the pot. Pour the liquid into a saucepan, add juniper and simmer until liquid is reduced by half. Strain in a cheesecloth or a cheesecloth bag and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight. Serve with your favorite side dishes. If refrigerated for longer storage, cool and use within 10 days or freeze for future use.

Random Ingredients: tomato ketchup,chuck roast,cilantro leaf,beef brisket,potato traditional,rice wine vinegar,scotch bonnet pepper,spring wrapper
title: Beef and Potatoes With Seafood & Fresh Coriander
ingredients: 4 medium potatoes ( about 500g total weight ) | 1 beef brisket | 1 beef brisket, with the bone | 10 spring roll wrappers | 2 tablespoons coriander leaves | 1 teaspoon finely minced scotch bonnet pepper | 1 teaspoon tomato ketchup | 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar | fresh cilantro leaves, to serve
instructions: Place the coriander in a pestle and mortar and pound to a smooth paste with a pestle. Cut the brisket meat into 4 5cm lengths and put them in to the mortar with 4 tbsp coriander paste. Pound together to make a thick paste, then season with salt and pepper. Spread 1 tbsp coriander paste onto each potato, then put 1cm meat in centre. Using a spring wrap as a guide roll the meat up and pinch the edges tightly together. Chop 1 tablespoon coriander leaves and scatter over the meat and potato. Roll up the potato like a leaf, pinching the edges firmly together. Place on a wire rack and allow to dry out for 1 hour. Remove the paper and coriander leaves. To make the dipping sauce, place the tomato ketchup, rice wine vinegar, and pepper in a medium sized bowl, then stir until combined. Drizzle over the meat and potato and serve with fresh cilantro leaves.

Random Ingredients: tilapia fillet,tofu,tuna water,nutmeg,orange peel,chicken breast half,bean sprout,self rising flour
title: Tunisian Fish Katsu
ingredients: 2 tablespoons self rising flour | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 cooked tilapia fillet, cut into chunks | 1 cooked boneless chicken breast half, cut into chunks | 1/2 cup fried tofu, crumbled | 2 tablespoons bean sprouts | 1 teaspoon finely chopped orange peel | 3/4 cup hot tapioca root sauce with tuna
instructions: In a small bowl whisk flour, nutmeg, tilapia, chicken, tofu and sprouts until well combined. Spread a little tapioca root sauce over the bottom of a shallow pan. Place a fillet into the pan followed by a layer of the fish mixture and a little of the bean sprouts. Repeat two more times, top with more tapioca root sauce and tuna. Bake in a hot, lightly oiled pan, uncovered, for about 15 minutes, or until fish flakes easily with a fork.

title: Spinach With Shrimp and Sprouts
ingredients: 1 package fresh baby spinach, cleaned and stems removed | 1 bag frozen brussels sprouts | 1/2 cup orange peel, chopped | 1/2 cup cucumber, julienne | 2 tablespoons dry mustard | 2 tablespoons tabasco sauce | 2 tablespoons tabasco sauce
instructions: Tear off about 1 inch of the top of the brussels sprouts. Cut the sprouts in half, then cut them open lengthwise with a sharp knife. Drop the sprouts into cold water, and set a pan of water on to boil. Once the water comes to a boil, add the sprouts and return to a boil. Cook for 5 minutes, then remove the lid, and place the pot on a burner. Cook the brussels sprouts for about 5 minutes, until they are bright green and slightly wilted. While the brussels sprouts are cooking, in a small bowl, mix the sprouts, orange peel, cucumber, dry mustard, and 4 tablespoons of tabasco sauce. Serve immediately, or freeze for up to 3 months.

title: Spiced Pumpkin Soup
ingredients: 3 quarts broth | 3 pounds fresh pumpkin, washed and peeled | 2 tablespoons grated fresh ginger root | 1 pound crumbled gorgonzola | 1 lime, juiced | 3 tablespoons hot sauce, or to taste | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley, or to taste | 3 tablespoons syrup, or as desired
instructions: Bring chicken broth to a boil in a large pot. Slowly cook the pumpkin in the hot broth until tender, 30 to 40 minutes. Cut pumpkin into cubes, and set aside to cool completely. Puree pumpkin through a chute press.

title: Beef With Cheese
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs steak | sliced provolone cheese or mozzarella cheese | 4 slices sourdough bread | oil or melted butter | 1 dash asafoetida powder | 12 ml half-and-half cream
instructions: Slice steak thin and set aside. Cut the cheese into thin sticks. On a baking sheet put slices of meat. Brush meat with melted butter or a little cooking oil. Place on top a little bit of the meat as you would lasagna noodles. Sprinkle the asafoetida on top of this. Bake for 20 minutes. Serve with tomato sauce, pasta or rice and with a side salad.

Random Ingredients: chocolate chip,maraschino cherry,avocado,bread,stewing beef,pecan,green pepper,garlic clove
title: Irish Cowboy Bread Salad
ingredients: 2 large ripe avocados, halved lengthwise and sliced | 1/2 cup pecans, chopped | 1/4 cup green pepper, diced | 1/4 cup sweet red pepper, diced | 1/4 cup green pepper, diced | 2 -3 garlic cloves, minced | 15 ounces stewing beef, shredded | 12 -14 slices bread ( diagonally cut or regular slices and toasted ) | 12 -14 maraschino cherries ( optional )
instructions: Remove and pit avocados. Halve each half and scoop out pulp. Blend pulp with remaining ingredients. Sprinkle with toasted bread slices and garnish with cherries if desired.

title: Aioli from Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs beef tenderloin, cut into chunks | 1 1/2 tablespoons tamari
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Spread tamari on one side of each beef chunk, then place meat chunks on the tamari. Place meat into a cookie sheet and bake in oven for 1 hour, or until meat is tender and juices run clear. Serve with french bread, potatoes, green beans, etc.

title: Fresh Peach and Chile Preserve
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh ripe peaches, cored and coarsely chopped | 4 tablespoons fresh lime juice, more to taste ( about 1 tablespoon if from concentrate )
instructions: Pack peaches into a 9x13 baking pan. Drizzle lime juice over peaches and sprinkle with 1 tablespoon of freshly grated parmesan.

Random Ingredients: herbes de provence,garbanzo bean,lacinato kale,blueberry,olive oil
title: Quick and Easy Chickpeas, Greens With Blueberry
ingredients: 1/3 cup dried garbanzo beans ( chickpeas ) | 2 tablespoons herbes de provence | 2 tablespoons minced fresh garlic, about 4 cloves | 3 cups chopped greens such as swiss kale, baby bellas, swiss chard, chard, and arugula | 3/4 cup 1 seedless blueberries, about 6 cups
instructions: Rinse well before using, then drain. Soak the beans in water to cover for 1 hour and drain. In a large heavy skillet, heat the herb de provence and garlic over medium heat until golden, about 5 minutes. Stir in the beans and green vegetable mixture. Simmer, stirring occasionally until heated through, about 5 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Belgian Waffles
ingredients: 1 cup pumpkin puree ( canned pumpkin ) | 1 can solid white chick-peas ( drained and rinsed ) | 1 tablespoon brown sugar ( optional )
instructions: In a large bowl, combine 1 cup pumpkin puree. Add chickpeas and mash with a potato masher or wooden spoon until mostly smooth. Set aside. Sprinkle remaining 1 1/2 cups pumpkin puree over top of pumpkin mixture. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours. When ready to serve, stir once every 15 minutes to combine puree and chickpeas. Serve.

title: Warm Salad
ingredients: 225 g cottage cheese | 2 leeks | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 1 tablespoon chopped green olives | 225 g snow peas
instructions: Chop the leeks into thin rings, then cut them into 5 cm lengths. Heat the oven to 180c/350f/gas rub your leeks with the cornflour and a pinch of salt and then place them in a roasting tin or gratin dish and scatter over the cheese. Scatter over the chopped olives and scatter over the snow peas. Cook in the oven for 15 - 20 minutes, then turn out onto a serving platter and serve.

title: Apricot Broccoli
ingredients: 1 cup finely chopped broccoli floret | 1 package chicken or vegetable stock | 2 tablespoons mirin | 1 jar apricot preserves
instructions: Place the chopped broccoli in a pot and cover with 3 inches of water. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer for a few minutes. Meanwhile, bring just to a boil and stir in the stock and mirin. Return to boiling. Lower temperature, cover and simmer until broccoli is just tender, stirring occasionally, about 5 minutes. Take off the heat. When broccoli is done, stir in the apricot preserves. Heat through then transfer to a serving dish. Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: broccoli,parmesan cheese,yellow food coloring,green zucchini,plain flour,ginger ale,star anise,pineapple
title: Capsicum's Broccoli Slice
ingredients: 1 yellow food coloring ( green ) | 300 ml chilled pineapple, chunks | 180 g broccoli, cut in florets | 450 g green zucchini, finely grated | 1/4 cup parmesan cheese or 1/4 cup asiago cheese, grated | 2 teaspoons ground ginger ale | plain flour, for coating | 1 star anise | grated parmesan cheese, for topping
instructions: Place food coloring on a plate and set aside. Place pineapple chunks around the outside of a gratin dish and sprinkle over a handful of parmesan or asiago cheese, ginger ale, and food coloring of your choice. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour or more. Coat the base and sides of a 2 cup capacity ovenproof dish with flour, making sure the pieces overlap so the dish will not be crowded. Cut remaining parmesan and zucchini into 2cm lenghts and place on top of the pineapple. Place star anise inside the star anise and sprinkle over remaining cheese. Place under a heated grill for 2 - 3 minutes until evenly coloured. Remove star anise and serve with a piece of swiss, swiss roll or bread.

title: Chinese Noodle Soup (Moo Shu)
ingredients: 3 cans condensed beef broth | 1 package uncooked chinese noodles
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine broth and noodles. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat.

title: Nama Mama's Glio Sauce for Fish
ingredients: 1/2 cup sweet chili sauce | 1/2 cup caster sugar | 3 slices lemon peel | fish, heads to flake or chunks | salt and pepper
instructions: Put all the ingredients into a food processor. Process until it becomes a smooth paste. Serve with any grilled, grilled, or cooked fish.

title: Beef With Cashews
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef or 2 lbs chicken, cut into serving pieces | 1 1/2 cups roasted cashews | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 1 french bread, cut into 1/2 in cubes
instructions: Brown meat in oil. Remove meat, add cashews and lemon juice. Cover and bake about 1 hour or until meat is tender. Serve over rice or noodles.

title: Beef and Sausage Casserole
ingredients: 2 lbs rump steak, cut into cubes | 1 lb polska kielbasa, cut into chunks | 1 lb ham, cut into squares | 2 cans roma tomatoes | 1 lb capers | 2 cans rump steak, quartered
instructions: Toss meat with a little salt, pepper, and sugar. Brown in butter. Cover the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish with the meat. Add all other ingredients. Dot with butter. Bake covered casserole at 350 degrees for 30 to 45 minutes. Remove cover, increase heat to 400 degrees and bake for an additional 15 to 20 minutes. Serve with rice or buttered noodles.

Random Ingredients: oregano leaf,green chili pepper,chicken breast,vegetable oil,beef brisket,vanilla pudding mix,crescent dinner
title: Santa Fe Crock Pot "stove Pot" Chicken Pizza
ingredients: 1/2 cup vegetable oil | 1 package beef brisket, sliced thin | 1 package prepared vanilla instant pudding mix | 1/2 cup chopped green chili pepper | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves, crushed | 1 can refrigerated crescent dinner rolls, cut in half ( 12 to 12 rolls ) | chopped fresh oregano leaves ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Place flour seasoned salt in shallow dish. Dredge meat in flour. Heat oil in skillet on medium heat. Add beef, cook, stirring often, until browned.

title: Baked Mangoes with Pork (Peruvian Style)
ingredients: 1 lb ground meat | 1/4 cup ground guajillo chili-pepper sauce ( to taste ) | 5 ounces cumi-tortilla rice seasoning or 5 ounces other chicharrones de arbol | 1 ripe mango, peeled and cut into 1/4 inch slices and then chopped | 3 cloves fresh garlic, minced | 20 ounces chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 1 1/2 cups bamboo shoots
instructions: Set oven to 400°f cook rice using box directions, following the package directions. In a large baking dish, layer meat, guajillo pepper sauce, rice seasoning, and chopped mango and garlic. Pour chickpeas over this and top with the sliced bamboo shoots. Bake in the middle of the oven 25 minutes. Check the meat and cook just a bit longer so it’s cooked through.

title: Tasteful Strawberry Sundae
ingredients: fresh strawberries in syrup, to taste | strawberry puree | tamari | red chili pepper
instructions: Wash fresh strawberries and remove hulls. In a tall glass mix puree, tamari and chilli pepper. Mix strawberry puree into the strawberry mixture. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: trout,rom tomato,galliano,greek yogurt,cardamom pod,yellow onion,chili oil
title: Turduk's Trout in Laxkine Yogurt-Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 1 dozen medium-sized whole trout, cut into portions | 1 large yellow onion ( small, minced, about 1 cup ) | 1 cup greek yogurt | 10 roma tomatoes, sliced lengthwise in half | 1 1/2 cups galliano ( or other strong, creamy liqueur ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons cardamom pods | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili oil
instructions: Place yoghurt and chili oil in a lrg serving dish. Mix all ingredients up to & including garlic. Dress fish with oil & arrange on top. Garnish with onion. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: yellow squash,dark sesame oil,cooking apple,chuck steak
title: Oriental Beef With Yellow Squash
ingredients: 2 teaspoons dark sesame oil | 1 lb chuck steak, cut into 3- to 4-inch cubes | 1 lb yellow squash, cut into 2- to 3-inch pieces | cooking apple, sliced into 3- to 4-inch lengths ( optional )
instructions: On a rimmed baking sheet, rub oil onto beef. Add squash to oil. Cook on high broil for 2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper,nutmeg,marshmallow,oregano,white vinegar,club soda,rigatoni pasta,mustard seed
title: Pasta Cocktail
ingredients: 24 ounces rigatoni pasta, cooked al dente | 1 ounce ground nutmeg | 1 1/2 teaspoons mustard seeds | 1 -2 tablespoon white vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 2 tablespoons dry oregano | 4 cups club soda | 1 cup miniature marshmallows
instructions: Combine all ingredients except for club soda and marshmallows. Mix thoroughly and store in the refrigerator until required. Shake off excess fat and serve with crushed marshmallows or chocolate on top.

title: Paella With Saffron and Milk
ingredients: 100 g baby peas | 300 ml sherry wine ( port or marsala can be substituted depending on your taste preference ) or 300 ml sweet marsala wine ( port or marsala can be substituted depending on your taste preference ) | 100 g pork bones ( in the pod ) | 100 g saffron threads, soaked in water
instructions: Prepare a sauce by adding the peas and then pouring the wine into a large saucepan over high heat. Bring to boiling, then reduce heat to very low to keep it simmering. Remove the saffron threads. Once the peas are hot, remove from heat and set aside. Place the pork bones into a medium to large frying pan and add a good dash of salt and enough water to just cover them. Bring to just under a boil and then reduce the heat to medium. Simmer until the surface of the pork is translucent, then remove from heat. Drain the peas and then set aside. In a bowl, add the soaked saffron and enough water to just cover them, the saffron water and add the pork bones. Taste and adjust the seasoning with salt and pepper as needed. Now, place the pan over medium high heat and add the milk to just enough to make the sauce come together. Bring the milk to a slow bubble. Immediately reduce the heat to simmer and add the peas and pork bones in a separate saucepan. Cook until meat is cooked through. It should only take about a few minutes to thicken up a bit and the peas should still have a lot of bite. Serve hot with polenta and parmigiana reggiano on top.

title: Grilled Eggs and Lavender
ingredients: 4 hard-boiled eggs, peeled and sliced | 1 tablespoon fresh lavender, chopped | 2 slices italian bread, toasted
instructions: Place the eggs and lavender on a piece of bread. Slather with the lavender. Grill until the lavender is fragrant. Variation, add fresh mozzarella cheese for the lavender.

title: Watermelon Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups bottled clam juice, reserved | 1 tablespoon unflavored gelatin | 1/8 teaspoon anise seed | 1/2 cup chopped walnuts, toasted | 1 cup sliced watermelon | 1 cup sliced fresh mushrooms | 4 slices swiss cheese
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in 2 cups clam juice. Sprinkle gelatin mixture and anise seeds over boiling water.

title: Homemade Noodles
ingredients: 1 package of dry wide egg noodles | 1 package corn syrup | 1/2 - 3/4 cup dried basil, crushed
instructions: Start cooking the noodles according to package directions. Mix all ingredients together in a saucepan. Simmer for 3 to 5 minutes. Place noodles in a large serving dish. Garnish with parmesan cheese.

title: Caribbean Pumpkin Dip (Vegan)
ingredients: 125 g mashed pumpkin | 1/2 - 3/4 cup brown sugar, to taste | 1/2 - 3/4 cup brown sugar, to taste | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon pepper | 1/2 - 3/4 cup sour orange ( zest and juice ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup orange rind, juice and zest of | 1/2 - 3/4 cup dried apricot jam | 1/2 - 1 cup shredded coconut
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°c. Combine pumpkin, sugar, cornflour, pepper and orange zest with lemon juice and orange juice and apricot jam and mash together. Fold in the coconut. Spread in a tray or pie dish and bake for 25 - 30 minutes.

title: Raisin Corn Chips
ingredients: 1 bag corn chips, crushed ( about 2 packages ) | 1/2 cup raisins ( about half a small jar ) or 1/2 cup slivered almonds, toasted ( about half a small jar )
instructions: Mix the crushed chips with raisins or almonds and place on a paper towel lined plate. Refrigerate for 2 hours to firm the chips, stirring every few hours. When ready to serve, spread popcorn mixture to 1 1/2 inch intervals with a wooden knife.

Random Ingredients: cake flour,black mustard seed,baby carrot,cream cheese,chicken thigh
title: Cheesy Mustard Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken thighs | 1 tablespoon coarse cake flour | 8 ounces cream cheese | 1 tablespoon black mustard seeds | fresh baby carrots
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f. Toss the chicken pieces thoroughly in a mixing bowl and sprinkle them with flour. Place in a deep roasting pan and place into the oven for 45 minutes or until the chicken is cooked, brushing with a little oil while cooking. Meanwhile, place the cream cheese, mustard seeds and carrot in a blender bowl and blend with the remaining oil until smooth. Remove the chicken from the oven and pour the cream cheese mixture over the chicken and return to the oven. Continue baking until the sauce is reduced and creamy. Stir in a couple of heaped tablespoons of hot mustard from the roasting pan. Serve with fresh vegetables, toasted or toasted asian bread.

title: Soya Sauce for Steak
ingredients: 5 tablespoons soya sauce | 5 tablespoons canned tomatoes and green chilies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together making sure all the ingredients are mixed together. Keeps well for a few days or longer in the fridge.

title: Easy Beanie Puffs - Prawns & Macallen
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried kidney beans | 300 g cooked prawns, finely chopped | 400 g strong coffee, to mix
instructions: Soak kidney beans for 1 hour in enough water to cover, until nearly soft. Rinse and drain. Place a large frying pan over high heat, add beans and cook for 3 minutes or until the water has been absorbed. Add prawns and cook, stirring frequently, for 2 more minutes. Stir in the coffee and cook stirring until the mixture is hot. Serve sprinkled with scallions.

title: Indian Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 tablespoon salad oil | 1 clove pressed, peeled fresh ginger | 1 can vegetarian baked beans | 2 tablespoons store-bought pesto sauce | 1/2 cup shredded coconut
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil and salad oil together in a skillet over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,lemon juice,apricot jam,peanut oil vegetable,grape
title: Doloreshakeh
ingredients: 800 g seedless grapes, hulled | 2 teaspoons lemon juice | 1 tablespoon peanut oil or 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 tablespoon hot chili oil ( sambal oelek ) | 250 g dried apricots or 250 g pitted prunes, halved lengthways
instructions: Halve grapes and then cut diagonally. Place in a bowl with the lemon juice and mix well. Heat the oil and sauté the honey and chilli oil for 2 seconds. Add the grapes, toss gently and cover for 2 minutes. Add the apricots and toss gently. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,channa dal,self raising flour,rice wine,black mustard seed,chambord raspberry liquor,yellow onion
title: Zee's Channa Dal (Rice Vinegar Dessert)
ingredients: 2 cups channa dal | 1 large yellow onion, sliced, sauteed or julienned | 60 ml rice wine | 4 tablespoons chambord raspberry liquor | 4 tablespoons lemon juice, fresh | 2 tablespoons black mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon channa dal, channa | 1 teaspoon self-raising flour
instructions: For the channa dal, rinse and drain the chana dal in a sieve. Place it in a saucepan with 100ml water, chopped onion and 2 tablespoons water and simmer for 20 - 30 minutes until the lentils are cooked. The lentils will be like a sauce. Remove from heat, stir in the rice wine, chambord, lemon juice, mustard seeds and chick peas and mix well. Add the remaining ingredients and mix thoroughly until you have a smooth consistency. Pour into individual serving glasses, refrigerate until chilled and set the next day. Enjoy.

title: Texas Sea Bass with Molasses-Pimentón
ingredients: 1/2 cup salted dry roasted peanuts | 1/2 cup molasses, or more as needed | 1/4 cup picante sauce | 1 tablespoon shortening, melted | 1/4 cup flaked sea bass fillet
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Spread peanuts on a baking sheet with a metal spatula, and bake in the preheated oven until fragrant and lightly blackened, about 5 minutes. Mix molasses and picante sauce in a small bowl. Brush fish with melted shortening. Dip fillets into molasses mixture on both sides. Allow to cool 5 minutes on baking sheet.

Random Ingredients: mint sprig,chicken stock cube,eggplant,chili oil,extra virgin olive oil
title: Eggplant in Oil and Chili Oil
ingredients: 2 eggplants | chili oil | extra virgin olive oil | 900 ml chicken stock or 900 ml vegetable stock | mint sprigs or coriander
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°c. Cut off all the ends from the eggplants and using a grater, cut them into 1cm thick slices. Brush with a little chili oil and place on a baking dish. Heat the extra virgin olive oil in a large pan and fry the eggplant until just soft. Transfer the eggplant to a baking tray and bake for 20 minutes. While these are cooking, mix the stock with 2 tbsp of hot chili oil. Remove from the oven and pour over the stock mixture. Sprinkle with the mint and bake for another 10 minutes until the eggplant is cooked and the stock is absorbed. Serve with coriander.

Random Ingredients: gingerroot,linguine,golden syrup,tomato paste,red potato,mozzarella cheese,flat leaf parsley
title: Linguine With Ginger Potatoes
ingredients: 6 medium red potatoes, cut into quarters | 8 slices fresh gingerroot | 1/4 cup golden syrup, plus 2 tablespoons | 7 ounces tomato paste | 8 slices mozzarella cheese | 1/4 cup fresh flat-leaf parsley, chopped | linguine, cooked
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add potatoes and boil until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain, reserving 1 cup liquid in pot and set potatoes aside. Cut remaining potatoes into 1/4 inch slices and set aside. In blender, combine ginger and 1/4 cup of reserved potato liquid and puree until smooth. Transfer puree to a small pot. Add tomato paste and cook on medium heat for a minute or two until thickened. Set aside. Cut cheese into quarters and toss with reserved potato liquid. Spread potato mixture in a layer over a 10x6x1 inch caserole dish. Arrange 5 slices of potato on top of potato and top with 2 slices of tomato. Sprinkle with 2 slices of mozzarella and 2 basil leaves. Repeat layering with remaining ingredients and top with remaining mozzarella. Cover with a tight fitting lid and bake in a 425 degree fahrenheit oven for 20 minutes. Remove cover. Let stand for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Quick and Easy Vegan Calvados
ingredients: 1/4 ounce yeast cakes ( one envelope ) | 3 cups flour | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 teaspoon orange zest | 8 ounces fillets ( use any size and cut into 4 equal pieces ) | 8 large flour tortillas, cut into 6 wedges
instructions: In a mixing bowl, add the yeast cakes, flour, garlic and orange zest. Mix well. Cover and allow to rise in a warm spot for 10 to 12 minutes or until doubled in bulk. Spray an 8x8x4 deep dish or jelly roll pan with cooking spray. In a frying pan fry the fillets over medium heat, turning to lightly brown on all sides. Add to the baking dish. Dividing evenly, cover and allow to bake in a 375° oven for 45 - 50 minutes. Serve warm with desired toppings like lettuce, tomato slices, etc. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,pork sparerib,heavy whipping cream,cornstarch,kaffir lime leaf,pimiento
title: Costilian Spareribs
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 2 tablespoons heavy whipping cream | 4 lbs pork spareribs | 2 ounces pimientos, diced | 1 cup fontina sharp cheddar cheese or 1 cup emmenthaler cheese, shredded | 3 kaffir lime leaves
instructions: In shallow dish, dissolve cornstarch in cream.

title: Zesty Beef and Couscous With Scallops
ingredients: 1 lb beef flank steak, 1-inch thick slices | 1/2 lb sea scallops, thawed if frozen | 7 cups watercress, stemmed, washed and chopped | 1/2 cup couscous, medium grain
instructions: Coat a large skillet with cooking spray and set over medium high heat. Add meat and cook without stirring until it is just cooked through, 2–4 minutes. Using a slotted spoon transfer meat to a plate. Repeat process, using 1 t. Of the meat drippings from the pan.

Random Ingredients: pepperoncini pepper,garlic powder,head iceberg lettuce,barbecue sauce,sirloin,spaghetti sauce,egg white,spinach
title: Marvelous Shredded Beef and Spinach Rolls
ingredients: 1 lb extra lean ground sirloin | 2 tablespoons bottled bottled roasted garlic powder, divided | 3/4 cup spaghetti sauce, divided | 1 cup chopped prepared spinach | 2 egg whites, divided | 10 ounces refrigerated barbecued pepperoncini peppers, sliced | 1 head iceberg lettuce | 5 tablespoons barbecue sauce
instructions: Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Coat pan with cooking spray. Add beef.

Random Ingredients: cottage cheese,bulk hot italian sausage,chicken,white wine,gold tequila,turmeric powder,apricot
title: Cottage Cheese and Sausage Crockpot Chicken
ingredients: 1/4 lb bulk sweet italian sausage | 1/2 cup dried apricot, quartered | 8 ounces low fat cottage cheese | 6 ounces white wine, such as guiness | 3/4 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/4 cup golden tequila | 1 chicken, cut into 8 pieces
instructions: In a 10 inch skillet, cook sausage over medium heat until no longer pink. Remove sausage from skillet. Add apricots, cottage cheese, wine, and turmeric until mixture is moistened. Place mixture in slow cooker. Put chicken pieces over top. Cover and cook on low for 4 to 6 hours or on high for 8 to 10 hours, until chicken is tender. Spoon off excess fat.

Random Ingredients: fennel bulb,brandy,baking powder,chicken stock,extra virgin olive oil,japanese soy sauce,cherry
title: Cherry Braised Fennel and Japanese Soy Glaze (Kareen Aji No-Yaki)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fennel bulbs, trimmed, cored and cut into 4-inch pieces | 1/4 cup japanese soy sauce | 2/3 cup chicken stock | 1/3 cup brandy ( i prefer sherry ) | 1 tablespoon brandy | 1 pinch baking powder | 5 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 2 tablespoons canned whole canned cherries
instructions: In medium nonreactive frypan, sauté fennel in 2 tablespoons olive oil over high heat 3 minutes. Stir in cherry and sauté an additional 2 minutes. Pour in soy sauce and chicken stock and bring to a boil. Cook, stirring until reduced to half, then continue cooking, uncovered, over medium heat until gosling, 4 - 8 minutes. Season, to taste with salt. Meanwhile in small nonreactive frypan over medium high heat, bring 1 cup water, nestlé style, to boil. Add brandy and ignite. Pour into pan and cook, uncovered, over high heat 1 minute. Stir. Remove from heat and pour into bowl. Cover and refrigerate until mixture is cold, about 30 minutes. Just before serving, season with baking powder and keep warm, covered.

title: Quick-Fix Beef Ribs
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs beef short rib ( or equivalent beef cut ) | 1 1/2 cups half and half
instructions: Place ribs in single layer in a 9 x 13 pan or roasting pan. Mix together half and half with beef broth and pour over the ribs. Cover pan tightly and marinate overnight at room temperature. Preheat oven to 150 degrees f. Bake the short ribs or beef until the meat falls apart when pierced with a fork. Remove meat and let sit 10 minutes before carving. Note, i prefer to marinate my ribs for up to 3 days before eating, but overnight or up to 8 hours may be okay. The longer you soak them, the more flavorful they'll be. If desired you may slice the short ribs into long strips before cooking. This lets the flavors marinate together and it's a great way to cook things. Cook time will vary so make sure your ribs are done when they are nicely browned.

title: Quick Beef Roast
ingredients: 4 -5 lbs beef roast | 1 can plum tomatoes, with liquid
instructions: Pre heat the oven to 450 degrees. Drain the beef roast if you have it, reserving any liquid. If not you might get as much juice out of the tomatoes as you'd like, but i think you should probably have enough juice to cover the whole roast and they should be put into a roasting pan. I use a 1/2 pound can of stewed tomatoes and i have just had them for my family. Throw everything into your roaster, making sure the roast is sitting upright in the pan. Pour the liquid over the roast and bake in a heated oven for about 1 to 1 1/2 hours. I don't know.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,white flour,cilantro leaf,white wine vinegar
title: Mexican White Rice
ingredients: 1 cup long grain white rice ( such as arborio ) | 1 tablespoon dry white wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons white rice flour | 1 tablespoon fresh cilantro leaves, minced
instructions: Start cooking the rice in a pot with about 2 litbs water, with the vinegar, stirring until all of the water has been absorbed. Cover, turn the heat to very low, and cook gently undisturbed for 15 to 20 minutes. Uncover the pot and, while checking the rice, stir once or twice. When the rice is tender, uncover the pot. Add the cilantro, and cook covered for 45 to 50 minutes longer. Remove from the heat and let stand for 15 minutes. Fluff with a fork before serving.

title: Spice Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon allspice or 1/2-3/4 teaspoon red pepper | 1/4 - 1/2 cup maraschino cherry, drained | 1 1/2 - 3 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces | 1 large red bell pepper, cut into 1/2-inch pieces
instructions: Combine all of the ingredients and toss together thoroughly. Place in a 9x13 inch baking dish coated with cooking spray. Cover and bake in a 350 degree f oven for 35 to 40 minutes or until the chicken is tender.

title: Spicy Cantaloupe
ingredients: 1 cantaloupe | 1 tablespoon oil | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 2 teaspoons harissa | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard
instructions: With a sharp knife, cut cantaloupe lenghtwise through the membrane. Cut 1/2 inch lengths diagonally, cutting diagonally across the fruit. Using a cleaver, remove melon from plastic pod leaving some of the flesh intact. Wash and dry melon and set aside. Rub oil and sesame oil on cantaloupe. Sprinkle with harissa and mustard. Place cantaloupe on a large platter and pour sauce over. Toss well to coat, serve right away or refrigerate.

title: Grandma's Sauerkraut Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 can sauerkraut, undrained | 2/3 cup ketchup | 2 tablespoons mangoes, sliced | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 package spaghetti sauce, any flavoring
instructions: In a slow cooker, place sauerkraut, ketchup, mango, garlic powder, and spaghetti sauce. Cover, and cook on low for 5 hours.

title: Easy Chinese Chicken Wings
ingredients: 1 tablespoon corn oil | 1 pound chicken wings, split in half if desired
instructions: Heat corn oil in a frying pan or wok over medium high heat. Stir fry wings for about 5 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese,scallion,anaheim chili,parsnip,marjoram,vegetable stock,curry paste,cumin powder
title: Soup Poached Chops
ingredients: 12 medium parsnips | 1/2 lb anaheim chili, sliced very thin | sour cream | fresh marjoram | shredded mild curry paste | curry powder | 1 can vegetable stock | 1 bunch green scallion, chopped
instructions: Chop parsnips as above but not too fine. Cook peppers in vegetable stock and when done remove from heat. Set aside. In a separate pot, heat some margarine. Sauté onions till slightly golden. Add curry powder, curry paste, marjoram and parsnips. Add some of vegetable stock. Cover and cook for 10 minutes. Add sour cream and marjoram. Cook for 5 more minutes. Serve with white rice that has been sautéed in a few tablespoons of margarine or oil. Garnish with mint.

title: Spicy Phyllo Pasta
ingredients: 10 sheets phyllo pastry | 500 ml ditalini pasta | 1/2 cup brown sugar | 1/2 cup fresh coriander powder | 125 g powdered saffron
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Boil pasta until al dente. Drain water and set aside. In a pan mix the sugar and saffron and stir until dissolved. Add coriander and mix well. On a 9 x 13 baking tray spread some saffron mixture in each sheet of phyllo. Brush all around with egg wash. Pound in a pan until you have a square of pastry. Add some of the pasta then spoon in most of the sugar/saffron mix. Continue adding phyllo sheets until all the pasta is used up and topped, brushing with more egg wash every few sheets. Bake on the middle shelf of the oven for approx 30 minutes or until top is crisp.

Random Ingredients: orange bell pepper,red capsicum,mozzarella cheese,graham cracker crumb,maple syrup,black bean,curry,anise seed
title: Tasteedy Mashed Sweet and Savory Black Beans
ingredients: 2 cans black beans, drained and rinsed | 1 cup mozzarella cheese or 1 cup parmesan cheese, shredded | 1 medium red capsicum, deseeded and diced | 1 medium orange bell pepper, deseeded and diced | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 1/2 teaspoon ground anise seed | 1/2 teaspoon curry | 6 graham cracker crumbs, finely crushed
instructions: In a large mixing bowl combine the drained black beans, cheese, capsicum, onion, maple syrup, anise seed, curry, and crumbs. Mix thoroughly until the mixture is well combined. Place the mixture into the ramekins or equivalent, and press firmly with a spoon. Cook in the oven at 150c/300f/gas 6 for around 20 - 25 minutes, or until the mixture has the gooey consistency you like. Allow to cool for 5 mins then transfer to a serving plate and dig in.

title: Italian Baked Tomato Soup
ingredients: 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1 can tomato juice | 1 1/2 teaspoons onion powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients and place into a casserole dish. Bake in 350 degree oven for 35 minutes. Serve with bread, rolls, pretzel crackers, sauerkraut, or ketchup.

title: Chicken for the Holidays
ingredients: 5 boneless skinless chicken breasts, 1kg | 1 tablespoon saffron | 2 -3 fresh chilies, washed, deseeded and finely chopped | fresh mint sprig ( to garnish )
instructions: Preheat oven to 160 degrees celsius. Place the chicken pieces, in a casserole dish. Sprinkle the saffron over the chicken and scatter over the chilies. Cover with boiling water and bake for about 45 minutes. Uncover the chicken and stir in the fresh mint. The chicken can be eaten straight from the oven or transferred into a gravy boat for supper.

title: Lobster Mousse
ingredients: 1 cup lobster meat, finely diced | 1/2 cup cream
instructions: Combine all ingredients until blended. Serve chilled.

title: Uncle Joe's Shrimp
ingredients: 2 pints shrimp, peeled | 2 pints vanilla sugar | 1 lb vanilla sugar
instructions: Prepare shrimp as directed by directions below or place in ice cube tray as directed for freezing. Remove shrimp from the freezer and place in fridge to firm up. After the shrimp have been chilled, drain and discard shells. Cut shrimp in half lengthwise. Place shrimp on a tray cut side up. Sprinkle with pam or other favorite flavor of choice. Cover with 1/2 lb of vanilla sugar. Place tray on cookie sheet with parchment paper and bake at 225 degrees for 6 - 7 minutes or until sugar turns light brown around the edges. Serve immediately, while still hot.

title: Turmeric & Fish Rolls
ingredients: 4 cups shredded yellow squash | 8 medium turkey fillets, thawed if frozen | 2 tablespoons shredded sweetened coconut | 2 lemons, juice and zest of | 1 cup lettuce, coarsely shredded | 2 cups cooked turkey pieces, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place the yellow squash in a colander and toss with the turmeric to coat. Arrange the turkey slices on a piece of plastic wrap and drizzle with the zest to coat the turkey. Wrap the turkey around the squash in the plastic wrap, pressing to compact it tightly. Lay on a baking sheet. Bake at 400 degrees f for about 20 minutes or until cooked through. While the turkey is baking, combine the coconut, lemon juice, and zest in a small bowl. To serve, line 4 individual baking sheets with foil and scatter the lettuce around them. Heat the rolls by placing a pat of the coconut mixture on each slice of turkey. Serve the rolls with the lemon salad.

title: Mashed Green Pea Soup
ingredients: 1 cup green peas, shelled | 3 whole fresh lime leaves | 4 cups ice water | 1 cup matzo meal
instructions: Add peas and lime leaves to ice water and allow to soak for 15 - 20 minutes. Add matzo meal in small chunks and stir well. Bring to boil and simmer on low heat. Stir occasionally and stir occasionally until heated through. Remove from heat and serve with a lime wedge.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,black olive,taco seasoning mix,beef sirloin steak,mirin,radish,lime
title: Beef Tataki
ingredients: 1 pound beef sirloin steak, cut into strips | 1 tablespoon prepared taco seasoning mix | 1 tablespoon chili oil | 1/4 cup mirin | 1/4 cup chopped fresh black olives | 1/4 cup radish, thinly sliced | 1 lime, cut into wedges, or more to taste
instructions: Place beef strips in a glass dish, and sprinkle with taco seasoning. Cover, and marinate in the refrigerator at least 20 minutes, or overnight. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add lettuce sprigs to the water, and cook about 2 minutes. Drain, and set aside. Heat chili oil in a skillet over medium heat. Stir in the beef strips.

Random Ingredients: herb,seasoning salt,guacamole,half,chicken stock cube,vidalia onion,graham cracker crumb
title: Guacamole Onion Chicken
ingredients: 2 lbs vidalia onions, peeled, cut into chunks | 2 tablespoons mixed herbs | 1 maggi chicken stock cube | 2 tablespoons herb, crushed or 2 tablespoons mixed herbs | 1 cup half-and-half | 1/2 cup guacamole | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Mix together onions in a large bowl, add salt, mixed spices and half and half and set aside in fridge to marinate for 60 minutes, mix together and add more spices if desired. Take a small piece of aluminium foil approximately 10 inches long and wrap each half piece in the foil and fold over, make a pouch for the chicken to sit on. You may want to line your baking dish with tin foil to avoid leakage, so the moisture can escape. Place the wrapped chicken onto the foil in a single layer and bake at 180c for 10 minutes, this will help with browning. Turn chicken over and bake at different times so the chicken browns and it stays tender. Once done, remove from oven after 25 to 30 minutes, remove aluminium foil and bake for 10 minutes more then check for doneness to be sure juices aren't too runny.

title: Amaretto Woodhose
ingredients: 2 tablespoons amaretto liqueur | 1 dash dried onion flakes | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained
instructions: Combine glaze ingredients. Serve in a glass bowl.

Random Ingredients: dark soya sauce,orange bell pepper,palm sugar
title: Chinese Orange Pepper and Palm Sugar Flavored Peel Sugar
ingredients: 2 large orange bell peppers | 4 tablespoons dark soya sauce | 1 tablespoon palm sugar, packed firmly in a plastic bag
instructions: Roast the orange bell peppers on a dry hot griddle or under a preheated griller until charred all over. Turn frequently and do not burn or blacken. Do not inhale the smoke. When cool enough to handle peel away any skin. Place in a clean jar, cover with a few drops of dark soya sauce and give it a good shake. Store the jar in a cool, dark place. It will last for up to a year. I keep mine in my pantry or decorative jar that had oil, butter or even a little vegetable oil. It will last for weeks in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: french onion soup,orange bell pepper,green olive,white rum,beef stock,heavy whipping cream,cod,beef cube
title: Baked Cod With Green Olive Stew
ingredients: 2 cups beef stock | 1 pint heavy whipping cream | 4 boneless beef cubes | 9 ounces cod, in one piece | 2 small green olives, coarsely chopped | 1/2 small orange bell pepper, cut into thin strips | 2 tablespoons french onion soup | 1 tablespoon white rum
instructions: Combine the beef broth and cream in a saucepan and boil until reduced by half and almost syrupy, about 10 minutes. Meanwhile, place the groun beef in a roasting tin, fat side down. Place in a pre heated oven and roast at 150 degrees for 1 hour. Remove and set the beef on absorbent absorbent paper. Remove any fat floating on the top, then drain off any liquid. Leave the beef on the counter to cool before thinly slicing. Place the olives and orange pepper in a bowl or small sieve and mix well. Heat a frypan on the stove, until very hot. Place the cod in the pan and sprinkle with salt. Add the beef cubes. Drain any excess water. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes or until the fish is opaque and cooked. Remove the fish and stir fry until glazed, about 2 minutes. Spoon over the green olives and orange pepper and garnish with the french onion soup and rum. Serves.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,beef bouillon granule,cardamom pod,sirloin,orange,pesto sauce,cream tartar
title: Sirloin in a Ziploc Bag
ingredients: 1 cup low-fat sour cream or 1 cup plain yogurt | 1/4 cup chopped orange peel | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom pod, ground | 1 1/2 teaspoons beef bouillon granules | 1 1/2 teaspoons lemon juice, freshly-squeezed | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 lb thinly sliced sirloin, cut into strips ( i used a beef blade slicer )
instructions: Mix all the ingredients except for the sirloin in the container of a ziploc bag. Add the sirloin, coating it completely.

title: Quick and Easy Baked Beans
ingredients: 2 cans baked beans | 2 pinches celery seed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Combine the beans and celery seed in a baking dish. Bake on the top shelf of the preheated oven until the beans are hot.

Random Ingredients: serrano chilies,cream chicken soup,half cream,kirby cucumber
title: Creamy Cucumber Pickle
ingredients: 3 kirby cucumbers | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/2 container sour cream and half-and-half cream | 2 green serrano chilies
instructions: Dice one kirby cucumber into 1 inch squares. Mix together the cream of chicken soup and sour cream, and pour over the cucumber. Chop the green chillies and add to the mixture. Chill in the refrigerator for 1 hour, stirring occasionally to coat. Enjoy.

title: Ziti Primavera (Italian Ziti Salad)
ingredients: 1 lb ziti pasta | 1 english cucumber, shredded
instructions: Cook ziti according to package directions or until done, drain. Meanwhile, shred ziti into fine pieces. While ziti is cooking, slice cucumber into thin rounds. Combine ziti, cucumber, and garlic in large bowl. Mix well until flavors are blended. Pour dressing over salad slowly, stirring to coat and mix well. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,cremini mushroom,pastina,extra virgin olive oil,monterey jack pepper cheese,garlic powder,turkey
title: Beef in Pastina
ingredients: 1 bag pastina | 1/2 - 3/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1 cup shredded cheese or 1 cup monterey jack pepper cheese | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1 1/2 cups leftover cooked lean ground turkey or 1 1/2 cups leftover cooked chicken, torn in bite sized pieces | 1 can cremini mushrooms, drained, coarsely chopped
instructions: Cook pasta as directed until al dente to desired doneness.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,brown sugar,white cheese,pepperoncini pepper,asiago cheese,red curry paste,island dressing,pepper sauce
title: Cracker-Crusted Asiago Cheese
ingredients: 2 1/2 pounds fresh asiago cheese, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup asiago cheese, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup white cheese, coarsely chopped | 1 bunch ramps, chopped with stems removed, or more to taste, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup red curry paste, or more to taste | 3 tablespoons mayonnaise ( optional ) | 1/2 cup hot pepperoncini peppers, chopped ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon instant onion soup mix ( optional )
instructions: Toss the asiago cheese, asiago cheese, white cheese, ramps, curry paste, mayonnaise, hot peppers, and onion soup mix in a bowl with a fork until evenly combined. Transfer the mixture into a resealable, 1 1/2 quart dish. Cover, and refrigerate at least 1 hour, or overnight. Remove the cheese from the dish, and shake off excess flour. Arrange the asiago cheese dish in a layer in the prepared dish, cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate at least 2 hours and up to 2 days, stirring the dish after about 1 1/2 hours. Bring a small amount of water to a boil in a saucepan, and set aside. Cook and stir the cheese until it has melted, about 1 to 1 1/2 minutes. Drain excess water, and stir in the chopped chiles. Spread the cheese in a thin layer on a round piece of waxed paper, and chill until it is completely cool. Remove the waxed paper. Cut the top layer off of the waxed paper, and place the block atop the cheese. Use a spatula to slice the block in long, thin strips.

title: Basic Spanish Sauce
ingredients: 3 -5 spanish onions, peeled and diced | spanish spices ( like rosemary, sage and cumin )
instructions: Brown your onions in a little bit of hot oil. Then add the spanish spices and the rest of your cooked onion. Pour mixture into a crockpot and set on low. After a few hours, taste and add more spice if desired.

Random Ingredients: pasta,egg noodle,dark brown sugar,beef stock,mustard powder
title: Dirty Brown Beef Noodle Soup
ingredients: 2 cups beef stock | 1 teaspoon dark brown sugar | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 lb boneless lean beef, cubed | 1 package small egg noodles, uncooked
instructions: Heat soup stock to boiling in heavy large stockpot over medium heat. Stir in brown sugar, mustard powder, and beef.

title: Sweet Refreshing Okra and Rosemary Focaccia Bread
ingredients: 2 packages expired active dry yeast | 1 cup light molasses or 1 cup honey | 3 -4 lbs okra, peeled, ends trimmed | 1 -2 teaspoon rose essence
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/3 cup warm water and set aside. In 2 quart saucepan and set on stove top, on lowest heat, combine molasses, okra and rose essence. Heat until okra start to wilt, and mixture starts to bubble on the bottom. Turn heat down to simmer and allow to simmer about 8 minutes or until okra is very tender. Transfer okra mixture to a large bowl, cover with plastic wrap and let cool 2 hours or until warm. Stir, then refrigerate until cold, up to two weeks.

title: Deviled Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 500 g brussels sprouts | 250 g smoked papayas | 200 g red yellow peppers | 200 g yellow peppers | 5 g dried chipotle chiles | 200 g gruyere cheese
instructions: Wash the brussels sprouts in boiling water. Slice the spnayas, including the stalks, into thin strips about 3cm long. Peel and halve the peppers, remove the seeds and place in a colander. Place the sprouts on a baking tray, drizzle with a little oil and sprinkle with salt. Place under a hot grill for 3 - 4 minutes on each side or until the sprouts are cooked and slightly charred. Combine the remaining ingredients in a bowl and toss until the vegetables are coated in the mixture. Serve with grated cheese on the side.

Random Ingredients: pomegranate,egg yolk water,vegetarian oyster sauce,olive oil
title: Pomegranate Egg Yolks
ingredients: 1 cup pomegranate, hulled and crushed | 1 1/2 teaspoons vegetarian oyster sauce ( vegetarian oyster sauce can be substituted ) | 1 teaspoon olive oil | 2 egg yolks, beaten with 1 tbsp cold water
instructions: In a blender or food processor, blend 1 cup pomegranate with oyster sauce until smooth. Set aside, refrigerated. Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat. Pour 1/4 cup pomegranate mixture into the middle of a warm cast iron skillet. Swirl the pan gently as the egg begins to set around the edges. Place the skillet in the oven on the lowest rack of the oven. Let the pan heat for 1 to 2 minutes. The eggs should not begin to set up. Carefully slide the yolks into the caramelized mixture in the skillet. Sprinkle the egg yolks over the top of the yolks and continue cooking until the egg is just set. Be sure to turn the egg yolks as they cook. If the eggs do not set up sufficiently, you can stir in some of the egg liquid. Carefully remove the skillet from the oven. Let it cool 5 minutes before removing from the skillet. Let the egg set for about 15 minutes. The yolks will harden more if they become too cold. Slice the yolk from the tip onto a plate. Pour a thin stream of the warmed egg water into the eggs. You can serve the egg yolks warm or cold straight from the skillet or in the microwave. If serving the eggs cold, remove as a serving and cover with plastic wrap, placing the plastic wrap in microwave for about 1 minute until the egg is warm. It can be eaten hot or cold.

title: White Mushroom, Ginger and Basil Quesadillas
ingredients: 3/4 cup grated monterey jack cheese | 2 ounces white mushrooms or 2 ounces cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1 tablespoon minced fresh ginger | 8 medium fresh basil leaves, minced
instructions: Preheat griddle. Combine all ingredients in a bowl and set aside. Heat 1 to 2 tablespoons in griddle. When bottom side of each tortilla starts to get slightly brown, turn over to brown other side, 1/2 to 3/4 minutes total. Transfer both quesadillas to a baking sheet and serve warm or at room temperature with condiments of choice.

title: French Vanilla Sugar-Free Pizza
ingredients: 1 pizza crust, frozen or fresh | 2 tablespoons catsup | 1 teaspoon vanilla bean, scrape and scraped | 1/8 teaspoon cinnamon | 1/8 teaspoon taco seasoning | 1 dash cinnamon ( optional ) | 1 dash ghee
instructions: Place the pizza crust on the bottom of a pizza pan or pizza stone, about half way full. Spread the catsup on the crust. Place the vanilla beans on top of the catsup, sprinkle with cinnamon, then sprinkle with taco seasoning and dash of cinnamon. Bake in 400f degrees oven for 5 - 10 minutes until the crust turns golden brown, then turn the pizza out onto a cooling rack or a pizza peel. While still hot, drizzle with cinnamon and serve warm or cool.

title: Wild Rice and Vegetables
ingredients: 1 cup wild rice | 1 cup mixed turnip | 1/2 cup small peas, peeled | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Place wild rice, mixed turnips and mixed greens in a medium size casserole dish. Add a small spoonful of vanilla flavored molasses, if desired, and pour mixture over the mix. Sprinkle remaining vanilla if using.

title: Easy Mexican Pizza
ingredients: 4 cups panir or 4 cups mozzarella cheese | 1 cup lentils | 2 cans mangoes | 1 bunch kielbasa | 1/3 cup dry sherry | 1/3 cup guacamole
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Arrange onion slices in casserole dish. Combine lentils and lentils, and spread evenly with a spoon. Slice kielbasa, and place on top of lentils. In a small bowl, combine sherry and guacamole.

title: Simple and Delicious Fried Bamboo Shoots
ingredients: 1 can bamboo shoots, sliced | oil ( for frying )
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a pan, add bamboo shoots, and stir through. Remove from heat, and let sit for 1 minute. Pour mixture into a clean dish. Serve.

title: Simple Pilaf
ingredients: 1/4 cup short-grain rice | 1 1/2 - 3 cups water | salad oil, optional
instructions: Place the rice and water in the pot on high, and bring the mixture to a boil. Once the rice is boiling, stir well. Turn the heat to low, cover and leave very gently for 10 minutes. Fluff the rice gently with a fork and place onto a warm serving dish. Drizzle with oil or salad oil if desired. Enjoy.

title: Pork With a Hint of Smothered Chicken
ingredients: 8 ounces pork tenderloin, trimmed | 1/4 lb sirloin, trimmed | 5 cups chicken broth | 2 tablespoons brewed tea | 2 tablespoons fat free lebanese hot-roasted salted chicken fat
instructions: Heat oven to 550 degrees. Cut pork loin crosswise into 6 slices. Cut beef crosswise into 4 slices. Place pork and beef slices in a shallow baking dish and place in centre of oven, leaving a 1/4 inch thick rim around edges. Using a sharp knife, split slices in half. Place 2 pork pieces on top of each portion.

Random Ingredients: chicken wing,tagliatelle pasta noodle,bulgur,red chili powder,eggplant,white wine,lamb shoulder chop,bay seasoning tm
title: Tuscan Lemony Lamb Stew (Tunisian)
ingredients: 1 ounce uncooked tagliatelle pasta noodles ( also known as rigatoni pasta noodles or tagliatelle ) | 8 skinless lamb shoulder chops with bone ( or boneless, lamb-back thighs ) | 4 -6 small eggplants | 1 tablespoon red chili powder | 1/4 cup white wine | 2 bay seasoning tm ( see note ) | 2 cups uncooked bulgur ( see note ) | hot cooked ground red chili powder ( see note )
instructions: Combine the lamb shoulder, eggplant and red chili in small bowl.

title: Steamed Spinach With Shallots
ingredients: 4 large shallots | 1 lb fresh spinach leaves, washed, well drained | 1 teaspoon dry mustard | 1 teaspoon fresh rosemary leaf, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons brown sugar | 1/3 cup chopped fresh mustard
instructions: Wash and dry the shallots and cut lengthwise into halves. Arrange in layers on a dish. Cover with boiling water and allow to stand for 15 minutes. Drain well. Wash and dry the spinach and divide into 6 portions. Place the spinach in a saucepan along with the 1 teaspoon mustard, rosemary and sugar. Bring to the boil and turn the heat to high. Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer for 1/2 hour. Check for seasoning.

title: Naxos - South American Corn and Green Salad
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon vegetable oil or 1 -2 tablespoon light olive oil | 10 -12 cups mixed fresh vegetables, such as spinach, carrots, cauliflower, onion or chard | 1/2 cup sliced green olives | 2 -3 teaspoons anise seed | 1 1/2 - 2 tablespoons cornflour or 1 1/2-2 tablespoons cornstarch | picante sauce, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: In a large skillet heat oil on high heat. Sauté vegetables until crisp tender, but still tender.

title: Steak Crunchies
ingredients: 2 lbs flank steaks | 1/4 cup onion | 1/2 cup greek yogurt ( plain or chunky ) | 1/4 cup sweet dark soy sauce | 1/4 cup dark chocolate
instructions: Cut the flank steak into 1 1/2 inch thick strips. Combine the greek yogurt, dark soy sauce, and dark chocolate in a bowl, breaking up with the back of a spoon. Add the thinly sliced flank steak strips and stir well. Cover and refrigerated for at least 15 minutes. Line an ungreased square baking pan with foil and lay the steaks out in a single layer on the foil. Refrigerate for 3 hours, stirring occasionally. Take the foil off and pour the chocolate mixture evenly over the steaks, leaving about an inch between each one. Let sit for 10 minutes. Place the baking pan in a preheated 300°f oven for 30 to 40 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool for 10 minutes before turning out onto a wire rack and sprinkling with more dark chocolate sauce to serve.

title: Dip Bread Snack
ingredients: 1 bag rye bread | 1 tablespoon dill pickle relish
instructions: In a large bowl, add the rye bread and the relish and mix thoroughly. Take out one bag of the rye bread and cut it into 1/2 cubes. Place back into the bowl with the rye bread. Scoop out the other bag of rye bread and add to the bread. Work the bread cubes using your hands a few at a time until no bread clumps together. Transfer the bread to a cookie sheet and place in the refrigerator. If making a sandwich, toast the bread on a griddle. Use a small amount of oil on your griddle if necessary.

title: Apple Tart Filling (Pork Empanadas)
ingredients: 12 large tart apples | 6 tablespoons tart apples, melted
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl and blend well. Cover and chill for 1 hr before using. Fill tart shells and bake at 400°f for 25 minutes or until warm. Variation, use 1 tbsp tart sherry to replace the gala or grapefruit. May also use orange flavored liqueur to replace the gala or pear juice.

Random Ingredients: molasses,golden syrup,jalapeno pepper,white fish fillet,coriander seed
title: Pickled Fish
ingredients: 4 ounces fine white fish fillets | 2 ounces molasses | 1 tablespoon pickled jalapeno peppers, chopped | 2 teaspoons coriander seeds | 4 tablespoons golden syrup
instructions: Cut fish into bite size pieces. Mix all ingredients together in a bowl. Cover and marinate fish for 3 days in the refrigerator. Serve the fish with the pickled sauce.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,danish blue cheese,cherry,au jus mix,sugar,liquid smoke,basil
title: Bleu Cheese Baskets
ingredients: 1 cup dark sesame oil, divided ( or use regular sesame oil ) | 1 cup au jus mix | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke | 1/4 teaspoon sugar | 12 ounces danish blue cheese, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 12 -14 cherries, cut into 1/4-inch slices | 1/4 cup chopped fresh basil
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees f. With a 3/4 cup measuring cup or glass measure, lightly pour 1/2 of the oil into a 9x13 inch baking dish. In a medium bowl, combine remaining 3/4 cup of oil with the au jus mix, liquid smoke, and sugar. Stir in blue cheese. Add cherries and basil. Sprinkle on remaining oil and toss. Bake 45 - 50 minutes, until golden brown and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: italian turkey sausage link,baby bok choy,white cheese
title: Bacon, Sausage, and Fresh Bok Choy
ingredients: 8 links bulk italian turkey sausage links | 2 pounds baby bok choy | 4 cups shredded white cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Lay sausage links onto a baking sheet, and place pan into oven. Cook sausage until brown, about 10 minutes. Turn them over, and cook until browned on the other side. Remove from oven, and set aside. Return the oven to 400 degrees f. Place bok choy into the oven, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove, and sprinkle with a little cheese. Return to the oven for 5 minutes, or until cheese is melted. Serve in sandwiches with a green salad.

title: Pepperoni Sushi
ingredients: 1 dill pickle | 1 cup cooked pepperoni
instructions: Cut the dill pickle into 4 chunks. Slightly flatten the pepperoni with your hands. Roll each piece into a tight cylinder, about 4 inch long. Tie each portion with a piece of sushi stick so the pickle will firmly eat its own without falling apart. Arrange the rolls on a large sushi mat, and cut into 3 or 4 smaller pieces. Press the sushi stick into the rolls to form links that will fit in your bowl. Use a sharp knife to cut each sausage into 3 or 4 long thin slices. Serve with warm, hot water.

title: Roasted Vegetables for Two
ingredients: 1 quart vegetable broth | 3 lbs red potatoes, scrubbed ( about 8-10 ) | 6 cups assorted whole kernel corn ( about 4 cups total ) | 1/4 cup olive oil | 1 1/2 tablespoons ghee, plus | more ghee ( or butter, or other cooking oil )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f rinse potatoes, place them in a large baking dish, and bake for about 30 minutes or until tender and lightly golden brown. Cool slightly, then cut in 1/3 inch cubes. Meanwhile, in a medium saucepan combine the broth, potatoes, corn, and oil. Bring to a simmer and cook for 3 - 5 hours, stirring occasionally until the potatoes are very tender. When ready to serve, place 3 tbsp ghee on a dinner plate, place the roasted vegetables, and spoon the broth atop. Sprinkle over more ghee. Serve warm.

title: Soy Milk With Shiramei Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 tablespoon italian parsley ( finely chopped ) | 7 8 ounces low-fat soymilk | 7 3/4 cups half-and-half cream | 1 ounce shiitake mushrooms ( cut in half )
instructions: Place the italian parsley and the italian soy milk in the blender and process until you’ve a smooth and creamy consistence.

title: Saucy Vegetarian Empanadas
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cabbage, shredded | 1 cup shredded cabbage ( optional ) | 1/2 cup green pepper, finely chopped | 8 shiitake mushrooms, finely chopped | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 6 ounces plain sweet biscuits | 1 tablespoon oregano ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 2 tablespoons tequila ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. In a medium bowl, combine cabbage, green pepper, mushrooms, syrup and chopped coriander. Mix well. Place a biscuit onto a nonstick spray coated baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Place 1 tablespoon of mixture onto the biscuit. Bake for 5 minutes, turn half way through or until firm. Top with your choice of topping. Serve warm.

title: Cajun Rub for Chicken and Tender Vegetables
ingredients: 1/2 cup celery rib | 2 teaspoons cayenne pepper
instructions: Mix together until a crumbly mess of crumbs is formed. Rub the cayenne pepper all over the chicken and vegetables. Store leftover Rub in refrigerator.

title: Mexican Stuffed Avocados
ingredients: 1/2 cup madeira wine, chilled | 1 1/2 pounds ground sweet pumpkin | 1 tablespoon ground cumin | 1/2 teaspoon ground cayenne | 2 avocados - peeled, pitted and sliced lengthwise | 1 jalapeno chile, minced
instructions: Blend the madeira and pumpkin together in a blender until completely smooth. Season with cumin and cayenne pepper. Fill the avocado cavities with the pumpkin mixture. Arrange the jalapeno chile slices around the avocado. Serve the avocado slices on a plate with wax paper between each mound.

title: Roasted Herring Skewers With Apricots, Artificial Sweetener and Capers
ingredients: 1 teaspoon fennel, finely chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons capers ( drained ) | 1 teaspoon hot chili pepper | 2 1/2 teaspoons artificial sweetener | 4 ounces herring fillets ( chopped & packed ) | 14 ounces apricots ( chopped )
instructions: In a large jar, mix 1 teaspoon of the fennel, 1 1/2 teaspoons capers, chile pepper and sweetener. Add the fish fillets, coating them evenly. Marinate the fillets in this mixture overnight in the refrigerator. Preheat the oven to 375°f rub the remaining 1 teaspoon fennel mixture on the outside of the pickle and sprinkle on the remaining 1 teaspoon sweetener. Roast the pickle skewers, skin side down, in the oven for about 1½ minutes, or until the fillets are easily pierced with the tip of a knife. Serve with the chopped apricots and the remaining marinade.

Random Ingredients: chicken meat,crabmeat,ricotta cheese,pesto sauce,peppercorn,bean thread noodle
title: Chicken and Crab Manicotti
ingredients: 8 ounces egg noodles | 1 lb chicken meat, cooked and chopped | 1 can baked bean thread noodles | 1 cup ricotta cheese | 3 tablespoons pesto sauce | 1 teaspoon dried peppercorns, crushed
instructions: Place noodles and noodles in pot of boiling water. Turn off heat, stir and set aside. In a mixing bowl combine chicken, baked bean thread noodles, ricotta cheese, pesto sauce, peppercorns and drained noodles. In a 9x13 baking dish spread 1 cup mixed mix in mixture until all noodles are covered. Then spread 1/3 sauce on top. Sprinkle remaining 3 oz. Of mixed cheese on top. Cook in oven or microwave, uncovered for 60 - 70 minutes.

title: Cheshire Onion Soup
ingredients: 1 liter vegetable stock | 1/4 - 1/2 cup crouton ( homemade or from the supermarket is fine )
instructions: Use the soup pot to cook the soup. You can also use a crockpot.. Add enough cold water to cover. Add the croutons and boil for about 5 minutes. Check them for doneness. Do not boil. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: ghee,vermicelli,rose water,kosher salt,pecorino romano cheese,water chestnut,horseradish
title: Seared Vermicelli With Horseradish and Pecorino
ingredients: 4 ounces vermicelli, dried | 2 tablespoons ghee | 1 1/2 cups water chestnuts, finely chopped | 8 ounces pecorino romano cheese, grated | 2 teaspoons kosher salt | 1 tablespoon water | 1 teaspoon fresh grated horseradish
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f. Place the vermicelli in a bowl and cover with hot water. Let stand about 10 minutes, until softened. Drain and pat dry. In a large skillet, heat the ghee over medium heat. Add the water chestnuts and cook, stirring constantly, until the water is evaporated. Remove from heat. Add drained vermicelli to skillet and toss to coat. Transfer to a baking pan, sprinkle with the swiss cheese and the salt. Drizzle with the horseradish. Bake in the oven until heated through and beginning to brown, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: nam pla,curry paste,part mozzarella cheese,vegetarian bean,lime juice
title: Jiffy's Super Stuffed Bean Dip
