ingredients: 2 cans vegetarian baked beans, drained | 16 ounces part-skim mozzarella cheese, sliced | 1 1/2 tablespoons curry paste | 1 tablespoon nam pla ( fish sauce ) | 2 -3 tablespoons fresh lime juice
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f. Mix beans and cheese together. Stir in curry paste, nam pla and lime juice. Mix well until cheese is melted and mixture forms a soft dough. Spread into a shallow 9 inch springform pan. Bake for 15 minutes or until warm and lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: plain flour,bay leaf,nutmeg,meal flour,pearl barley,vegetable,parmigiano reggiano cheese,ginger garlic paste
title: Ginger Garlic Vegetable Parcels
ingredients: 50 g pearl barley | 2 medium sized peeled sprouts of fresh vegetable such as broccoli, cauliflower, zucchini &/or carrot | 2 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste or 2 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste | 1/4 cup plain flour | 2 teaspoons whole meal flour | 1/4 teaspoon freshly grated nutmeg | 3/4 teaspoon ground ginger-garlic paste | 1 bay leaf | 1 cup plain flour | 1 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Cook barley in a large pot of boiling water for 5 - 10 minutes or until al dente. Drain and cool on a paper towel. Set aside. Place sprouts in a large pan of boiling water. Cover and cook for 1 minute or until fork can go from center. Remove all from water, drain and set aside. Heat a flat grill or griddle pan. Add ginger and garlic paste and cook over high heat for a minute or two. Remove ginger and garlic paste and set garlic aside. To make dough, in a bowl mix together plain flour, whole meal flour, nutmeg, ginger garlic paste and bay leaf. Stir to combine. Add barley and sprouts and stir again. Turn the dough onto a floured surface. Knead well. Divide dough into six pieces. Roll into discs. Press into a disk shape about the diameter of a large walnut sized patty tin that has been prepared with non stick cooking spray. Brush both sides with a little milk and press the dough into the prepared tin to make a well in the centre. Top the dough with a sprinkling of parmesan and press down into the parmesan to make a well in the centre. Bring the edges of the dough up over the filling. Brush the top with a little more milk. Bake on middle rack of an oven heated to 180°c for 40 - 45 minutes or until lightly browned on top. To serve, remove from oven and cut each parcelo into 12 pieces.

title: Htipefy
ingredients: 2 beef tenderloin, 1-inch cubes | 1 can cannellini beans | 1 medium orange sweet potato, peeled and cut into chunks | 1 russet potato, peeled and cut into chunks | 3 tablespoons tahini
instructions: Place tenderloin in a ziploc bag. Pour in the two cans of cannellini beans, and turn to coat. Remove the air bubbles as they form. Marinade, refrigerate, and allow at least at least 1 hour and up to overnight. Place the orange, sweet potato, and russet potato on a non stick grill over medium high heat. When the grill is ready, carefully place the tenderloin on the grill, and cook to desired doneness, about 5 minutes per side. While the meat is cooking, spread the tahini in a small skillet over medium heat. Drizzle the blackened tahini over the slices of meat and vegetables.

Random Ingredients: black pepper,dijon mustard,parmigiano reggiano cheese,vermouth,annatto seed,oil,table salt,sesame seed
title: Vermouth-Style Dry White Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons oil | 2 teaspoons canola oil
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of the oil in a small nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add 1 teaspoon of the annatto seeds. Cook them, stirring, until lightly brown, 1 to 2 minutes. Remove from the heat and place in a small bowl. Dip the other 1/2 teaspoon of oil into the annatto seeds and, with a mortar and pestle, crush the seeds into a fine paste. Add the annatto oil into the pan and raise heat to high. Add the remaining annatto seeds when the oil is hot, then cook, shaking the pan, 1/2 teaspoon at a time until the sauce coats the back of a spoon, about 4 minutes total. Transfer the sauce to a blender, add the remaining 1/2 teaspoon oil and blend until smooth. Pour the sauce into a saucepan and stir the remaining annatto seeds into the white sauce. Cook over medium heat, stirring, until the heat is almost smoking and the sugar has evaporated, about 15 seconds. Add remaining 1/2 teaspoon oil, stirring constantly, and cook until the sauce is hot. Season with salt.

Random Ingredients: chicken thigh,oyster sauce,bay leaf,egg yolk,chili paste,radish,chocolate chip,garlic clove
title: Fried Chicken Nests
ingredients: 8 ounces chicken thighs, skinned, boned and cut into 1-inch pieces | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 garlic clove, minced | 2 ounces semisweet chocolate chips | 1 egg yolk | 1 dash chili paste | 1 bay leaf | 1 radish, minced | cornstarch mixed with water, to thicken
instructions: Place the chicken in a large saucepan and add enough water to cover. Bring to the boil and simmer over medium heat about 20 minutes. Drain and cool slightly. Stir in the oyster sauce and garlic, and cook for about 1 minute, stirring. Stir in the chocolate, egg yolk and chili paste and continue to stir while the chocolate begins to melt. Add the chicken, 1 cup of the chinese mustard and the bay leaf. Stir to coat and return to medium heat. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove the chicken and bay leaf and serve, sprinkled with the remaining chinese mustard.

title: Sorbetto Di Cioccolato (Raspberry and Strawberry Pudding)
ingredients: 1 package frozen strawberries, defrosted | 1 packet sorbetto di chioccolato ( ricotta cheese ), crushed
instructions: Put the thawed strawberries into a blender and whir until smooth. Stir in the sorbetto.

title: Feta Dumplings
ingredients: 150 g feta | 2 tablespoons fresh rosemary | 1 1/2 teaspoons sugar | 1 1/2 cups self raising flour | 2 cups bread crumbs
instructions: Chop the feta finely. Chop the rosemary finely. Measure the flour into a bowl or large sieve and mix in the chopped rosemary and feta. Dump the flour onto a board and using your hands, knead the mixture until thoroughly combined. Form the mixture into balls with your hands, a little larger than the diameter of a large cherry. If the dough is too firm, knead in a little more flour. Place the balls on a lightly floured board and then gently press the mixture into circles. Heat a small amount of olive oil in a large, deep frying pan. Fry the dumplings in batches for around 20 minutes until golden and cooked. Do not let them get too brown, or they will get hard as they are fried. Remove onto absorbent paper. Repeat with the remaining oil and feta balls. Use a little extra flour if you need to make the dumplings extra crispy. Serve on a bed of baby rocket or salad leaves with your favourite salad dressing and garlic breadsticks for dipping.

title: Maple and Jicama Salad
ingredients: 1 cup jicama, julienned | 2 cans baby spinach, rinsed thoroughly | 6 tablespoons maple syrup | paprika or cayenne pepper
instructions: Combine all ingredients and chill several hours or even overnight to let flavors blend.

title: Cherry Bombs
ingredients: 2 lbs cherries, pitted | 1/2 cup maple syrup | pimiento | basil leaves, chopped | fresh mint, chopped
instructions: Pit cherries and cut in half lengthwise. Combine cherry halves with syrup and fill the cherry shells, placing them on a foil lined cookie sheet. Sprinkle lightly with basil leaves, mint leaves and fresh mint.

title: Bevade (Biscuit Mix)
ingredients: 1 cup bran cereal | 1 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Mix the bran cereal, baking soda, and 1/4 cup water together.

title: Stir Fried Pesto Bean Sprouts and Tortilla
ingredients: 2 cups bean sprouts | 2 tortillas, broken into pieces | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce or 1 1/2 tablespoons hot sauce
instructions: Cook the sprouts in a small amount of boiling water until bright green, about 5 minutes. Cool them in a bowl by running them under hot water.

Random Ingredients: spinach leaf,mango,garlic powder,green chilies,chocolate,rose water,spinach,tomato sauce
title: Chilled Parfait
ingredients: 10 ounces frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained well | 10 ounces frozen petite diced tomatoes with green chilies | 7 ounces tomato sauce ( see note below ) | 1 teaspoon rose water | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 mango, diced | 1 green chilies, chopped finely or 1 red chilies, diced finely | 10 ounces fresh spinach leaves, washed and trimmed
instructions: Note, if using frozen spinach, thaw first and use water to saute, then squeeze any excess water out of it. Bring a large skillet over high heat. Add the spinach, tomatoes, tomato sauce, rose water, garlic powder and mango. Stir with a fork, until mixed well. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium. Cover pan and cook, stirring every so often, until liquid reduces and is thickened, about 30 minutes. Taste and adjust seasoning with more salsa, rose water or spices or green chilies. Serve over white rice.

title: Cavatelli - Spaghetti Sauce
ingredients: 12 ounces all-purpose flour | 4 cups egg substitute | 1 jar marinara sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into baking pan. Bake 350 degrees for 20 minutes.

title: Orange Pepper and Tofu over Rice
ingredients: 1 cup orange bell pepper | 3 inches piece extra firm tofu
instructions: Cut the bell pepper half from stem to blossom end remove seeds if desired. Slice tofu in half lengthwise and line with tofu. Place tofu on a hot griddle pan or skillet over low heat and fry the tofu. Remove tofu and let it stand for about 10 minutes. Turn heat to high and add orange pepper. Sprinkle with a mixture of salt and black pepper. Add another piece of tofu on top of the pepper and cook other side till opaque. Flip and remove the tofu onto a warmed platter. Serve with a sprinkling of confectioners' sugar and fresh fruit or soy sauce.

title: Tiramisu
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese, softened | 2 tablespoons hot water | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 1 cup mashed ripe banana | 30 ladyfingers
instructions: In medium bowl beat cream cheese, water and soup mix until well blended.

title: Tres Leches Cake (Aka Mardi Gras Cake)
ingredients: 1 cup cake flour | 1/2 cup dried fruit
instructions: Grease a 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish. Beat flour and dried fruit until very fine. Beat in a cup at a time until cake mixture resembles coarse meal.

title: Salmon with the Lime
ingredients: 1 white onion, peeled and finely sliced | 1 lime, juice of | 4 salmon fillets
instructions: To marinate, place the onion, lime juice and half an ounce of water and a bit of salt in a bowl and toss to mix. Place fish in the bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Marinate in the fridge for at least 10 minutes. Heat a griddle, dry pan and cook the skin side of the salmon for about 4 mins on each side. Keep warm in the oven.

title: Pepperoni
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons ground nutmeg | 8 ounces pepperoni with toppings thinly sliced
instructions: To make the spice all together, make a small depression in the middle of a slice of pepperoni and put in a small cup. Top with a few teaspoons of the spice mixture. Place a piece of unopened pepperoni in the hole.

Random Ingredients: liver,creme fraiche,water chestnut,deli roast beef,rice vinegar,black coffee,lentil
title: Roasted Beef and Lentils With Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 tablespoons rice vinegar, can use 1/4 cup white vinegar | 1 lb thinly sliced deli roast beef | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained and sliced | 1 can lentils, drained and rinsed ( french yellow if available ) | 1 cup dry black coffee | 1/3 cup creme fraiche or 1/3 cup sour cream | 6 ounces mushrooms, shucked
instructions: Preheat over to 300 degrees. Mix rice vinegar and salt and pepper together. Combine meat, water chestnuts, lentils and coffee in crockpot. Pour over the top of the meat. Cover and cook on high for 1 1/2 hours or on low for 3 1/2 hours. Remove cover. Spoon in liquor if desired, stir. Serve over prepared rice, topped with creme fraiche or sour cream.

title: Brie Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1/2 lb brie cheese, sliced thin | 1/2 lb feta cheese, sliced
instructions: Combine brie cheese, feta cheese, and tomato in the bowl you plan to serve this with inches.

Random Ingredients: ice,cilantro leaf,portabella mushroom,chuck roast,large shrimp,white wine vinegar
title: Spicy Shrimp and Portabella Shrimp Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless chuck roast | 4 1/2 lbs large shrimp, peeled, deveined and cooked ( or raw shrimp, peeled and deveined ) | 1/2 lb portabella mushroom, stems trimmed, caps thinly sliced | 1 1/2 teaspoons white wine vinegar | 3 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil or 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 2 -3 tablespoons ice
instructions: Heat grill to high. Place roast on hot grate, skin side down, and cook until rare, 6 - 7 minutes per side. Do not over cook turn as desired. You want to preserve some of the juices in the roast, i like mine on the rare side. This should be a medium rare meat, about 6 - 8 inches in diameter. Let meat rest at room temp for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, heat a broiler. Remove roast from grill, pat dry with paper towels, and chop into 1 inch pieces. Return meat to oven for 20 minutes or until cooked to your desired level of doneness. If not using shrimp, remove meat from shells and tails before chopping. Reserve for the garnish. Transfer meat to a platter. Place mushrooms in a small bowl. In a blender, puree all remaining ingredients except cilantro and ice. Gradually stir in reserved shrimp liquid, blend until smooth and transfer to a small bowl. Pour shrimp mixture over meat. Garnish with cilantro.

Random Ingredients: flour tortilla,pepperoni,wheat pastry flour,corn oil,baby red potato,black olive,mint leaf,tea
title: Potato and Sage Tortilla Stack
ingredients: 6 medium baby red potatoes, halved lengthways | 1/3 cup cracked black olives | 1/3 cup fresh mint leaves ( packed ) | 1/2 cup sliced pepperoni ( roughly 1 small jalapeno ) | 1/3 cup corn oil | 1/2 cup whole wheat pastry flour | 1/4 lb spanish smoked spanish chard leaf ( leaves roughly torn and chopped ) or 1/4 lb spinach ( leaves roughly torn and chopped ) | 12 large flour tortillas, warm
instructions: Place potatoes on a grill pan with a little oil and cook over a medium heat for 1 minute each side and set aside. To make the herb filling, place the olives, mint and pepperoni in a bowl with the corn oil and mix well. Sprinkle the potatoes on top. Place the spinach leaves and torn chard over the top of the potatoes and season with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Pour the herb mixture into a small pan with cold water and bring to the boil. Cover and set aside to steam for about 30 minutes. Place the warm tortillas on two dinner plates, cover and let stand for 5 minutes spread the herb filling evenly over both and serve.

title: Kari Meeta (Spicy Noodle Dip)
ingredients: 3 -4 ounces rice noodles ( preferably kari ) | 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh coriander | 1/4 cup finely crumbled feta cheese | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1/2 teaspoon whole peppercorn
instructions: Place all ingredients in food processor or blender and blend to desired consistency. Serve with kari, sweet chili pepper slices, or any other desired garnish.

title: Spinach and Spinach with Cream
ingredients: 1/2 pound baby spinach | 5 1/2 cups heavy whipping cream | 4 cups jarred marinara sauce
instructions: Line a large rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper. Bring 3 cups of water with 1/2 cup salt to a boil in a large saucepan over high heat. Place the spinach in the pan, and cook, stirring occasionally, until wilted, about 3 minutes. Drain. Wrap the spinach in a clean towel, and squeeze out excess water. Stir the spinach, 3 cups of cream, and half of the marinara sauce into the drained spinach. Continue cooking and stirring until the cream is hot and the spinach is heated through.

title: Chilli Scotch Whisky Lassi
ingredients: 3 1/2 ounces scotch whisky | 3 ounces sweetened plain yogurt | 1 teaspoon ground chili pepper ( optional ) | ice water
instructions: Put all ingredients in your blender and blend for 3 seconds or until smooth. Pour into 2 chilled martini glasses, or tall glasses and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower floret,radicchio,sea salt black pepper,pesto sauce,beef broth,habanero pepper
title: Pesto Cauliflower Soup
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower floret, broken into bite-size pieces | 1 1/2 cans beef broth | 3/4 teaspoon ground habanero pepper | sea salt and ground black pepper to taste | 1 cup prepared pesto sauce | 1/2 medium radicchio, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Place cauliflower, beef broth, and habanero pepper in a large pot, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer until cauliflower is tender, about 30 minutes. Stir cauliflower occasionally while cooking. Season with sea salt and black pepper to taste. Bring the cauliflower soup to a boil again. Cook 5 minutes, then stir in pesto. Continue cooking 5 minutes, or to desired crispiness. Stir radicchio, if desired, into the soup just before serving.

title: Chinese Chicken Wings-Baked
ingredients: 1 lb chicken wings | 1 lb oyster mushroom | 3 sprigs fresh rosemary
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Place the chicken wings in a greased baking dish, then sprinkle with salt and pepper. Remove the stems from the mushrooms.

title: Roasted Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower | 3 tablespoons rock salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. In a roasting pan, place the cauliflower head in the oven and dry for 30 minutes, or until it is golden brown. Set aside to cool. Remove roasting pan from oven, and stir the rock salt in to the warm roasting pan. Carefully tip the cauliflower into a resealable bag and shake off excess moisture. Place the bag, in, into a roasting pan, on the middle rack of the oven and roast until tender and translucent, 40 - 50 minutes. Note, i always roast the cauliflower, by the time everything is done the next day, so take care not to overcook the cauliflower.

Random Ingredients: tomatillo salsa,beef sirloin steak,mushroom,greek yogurt,hungarian paprika,tomato green chilies,rice wine
title: Chilean Beef Kabobs
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef sirloin steaks, cut 1-inch thick | 1 jar mushroom pieces | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1/2 cup sweet rice wine or 1/2 cup white rice wine vinegar | 3/4 - 1 cup greek yogurt | 1 1/2 teaspoons hungarian paprika | 1 teaspoon hungarian paprika
instructions: Combine the above ingredients in a large resealable plastic bag. Divide steak mixture among steak skewers, press out excess air before cooking over medium heat. Grill or broil 3 - 4 minutes per side, or to desired doneness.

title: American Flag Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1/3 lb fresh blueberries | 1/3 cup canola oil | 1 lb dry spaghetti
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling water. Drain and rinse with cold water. Put pasta in large bowl. Toss with canola oil and blueberries. Toss lightly. Cover and chill 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pear half juice,pimiento,crabmeat,dark sesame oil,cantaloupe,pork chop,green prawn
title: Mika's Caribbean Cantaloupe and Prawn Stuffed Pork Chops
ingredients: 4 boneless pork chops | 4 tablespoons pimientos ( julienned ) | 4 large green prawns ( large peeled ) | 4 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 5 tablespoons crabmeat | 4 tablespoons cantaloupe ( julienned ) | 2 tablespoons canned pigeon peas or 2 tablespoons pimientos ( julienned )
instructions: Pound pork chops to about 1/2 1 inch thickness. Spread each chop with pimientos and prawns. Spread both sides of each chop with sesame oil. Sprinkle both sides with crabmeat and green pimento. Roll the chops in the seeds mixture.

title: Middle Eastern Spiced Meatballs
ingredients: 1 pound ground beef | 1 cup finely crushed graham wafer crumbs | 1/4 cup pomegranate molasses | 2 tablespoons ground allspice
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with foil. In a medium bowl, mash ground beef with a fork. Stir graham wafer crumbs, pomegranate molasses, and allspice into the mince mixture with a fork. Shape mixture into 1 inch meatballs.

Random Ingredients: pot barley,brussels sprout,liquid smoke,grouper fillet,lettuce leaf
title: Steamed Barley Fish
ingredients: 1 lb grouper fillet, cut into 4 pieces | 1 package frozen brussels sprouts, thawed | 8 large lettuce leaves ( or use mixed greens ) | 2 tablespoons liquid smoke ( recommended -- tabasco ) | pot barley
instructions: Place the fish pieces on a large, deep, non stick frying pan with a steamer insert or cover. Set over medium high heat,. When the bottom of the pan is covered with steam bits, turn the pieces quickly to ensure the fish is not sticking. When the fish is just about cooked, pour off all the water except for 1 tablespoon, and set the fish pieces aside. Turn the heat down to medium and add the brussels sprouts to the pan. Cover and steam for 8 - 10 minutes, or until the brussels sprouts are just tender and the sprouts are cooked. When the fish is just about ready, place a few lettuce leaves on top and serve hot. For added protein or vegetable flavor, the fish can be cooked on top of your favorite greens such as spinach, zucchini, etc.

title: Wild Rice Salad
ingredients: 2 cups cooked wild rice | 1/2 lb fresh shiitake mushrooms, sliced ( about 3 cups ) | 4 -6 cups shredded romaine lettuce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Chill salad while preparing dressing.

Random Ingredients: chili sauce,brandy,sunflower seed,ancho chilies,pecorino romano cheese,beer,plain yogurt
title: Ancho and Parmesan Dip
ingredients: 400 g pecorino romano cheese, freshly grated | 200 ml beer | 100 ml brandy | 1 -2 chilies or 1 -2 cayenne pepper, depending on taste | 1 pinch chili sauce | 2 tablespoons sunflower seeds | 1 -2 teaspoon anchos chilies ( optional ) or 1 -2 cayenne chile ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a blender & whiz until combined. Place mixture in glass bowl or a container with lid. Allow to chill. To serve, place dip in a bowl & stir in some sunflower seeds.

title: Hot Water Chestnut Ranch Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup water chestnuts, chopped | 2 tablespoons ranch dressing
instructions: Place all ingredients in blender. Cover and blend until completely smooth. Cover, and store in refrigerator for up to 6 months.

title: Baked Asparagus With Prosciutto Bacon
ingredients: 8 ounces prosciutto, cut crosswise into 1/4-inch strips | 4 ounces white fish fillets, cut crosswise into 1/4-inch strips | 1/3 lb asparagus, trimmed and cut crosswise into 1/4-inch slices on the large side | 1 tablespoon margarine | 1 tablespoon garlic oil | 2 teaspoons white vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme | 2 tablespoons minced fresh thyme
instructions: Place prosciutto on ungreased baking sheet and bake at 400°f for 5 minutes, stirring once or twice, until crisp. Transfer to wire rack and let cool 5 minutes. Meanwhile, heat a skillet over medium high heat and add the fish, cook 3 minutes per side, or until fish is just opaque. Transfer fish to a serving bowl. Scatter asparagus over fish and pour remaining sauce over fish. Let stand 5 minutes. In a small skillet, melt margarine and stir in garlic oil, vinegar, salt and thyme. Remove skillet from the heat and stir in thyme. Serve fish with sauce drizzled over asparagus.

title: Spicy Irish Cheese Tea
ingredients: 2 cups shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 4 tablespoons instant tea
instructions: Place the cheese, instant tea and teabags in a tea ball and press firmly and firmly into the surface of a large mug.

title: Mexican Zucchini Corn & Cheese Casserole
ingredients: 1 can corn ( whole kernel ) | 1 1/2 cups zucchini ( diced ) | 1 can peas ( whole kernel, drained ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons chicken stock | 1 drop vanilla ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a 2 quart casserole dish, mix well and put in oven on the stove. Cook covered for 30 minutes.

title: Cannoli Dumplings
ingredients: 1 cup plain flour | 2 cups shredded ricotta cheese | 1 teaspoon sage | crushed ice
instructions: Slightly crush dried oregano leaves in pestle or other hand using the pestle. Mix all ingredients together. Mix until you have a soft dough. Using a tablespoon or a teaspoon, fill dumplings about 2/3 full. Place in deep fryer, cook until golden brown. Drain on paper towels. Serve with garlic crumbs or garlic cream.

Random Ingredients: shell pasta,french bread,curry powder,chili garlic sauce,fontina cheese,asparagus
title: Hot Curry-Fried Pasta With Asparagus
ingredients: 15 ounces shell pasta, preferably wild-fleshed, uncooked | 3 tablespoons curry powder, divided | 12 slices fontina cheese, 1/4 inch thick | 1 lb asparagus, trimmed and cut crosswise into 3-inch pieces | 1 teaspoon chili-garlic sauce ( sriracha ) | 4 slices crusty french bread, 1/2 inch thick, cut diagonally into 2-inch chunks
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions, omitting salt and fat. Drain, reserving 1 cup of the pasta cooking liquid. Stir curry powder and 2 tablespoons reserved pasta cooking liquid and heat over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until curry is fragrant, about 1 minute. Remove from heat. Add fontina.

title: Creamy Cauliflower Beef & Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 boneless beef chuck roast | 2 bags cauliflower, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons quick-cooking sherry | 1 -2 cup ricotta cheese
instructions: Place everything in crock pot on low for 6 hours or longer. Shred meat and serve over noodles.

Random Ingredients: brown rice flour,red wine,ear corn cob,thai fish sauce,arborio rice,sauce
title: Rice Fried Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 cup brown rice flour | 3 tablespoons hot sauce | 1 tablespoon thai fish sauce | 1/2 medium red wine, such as chardonay | 1 large onion, chopped | 2 ears corn on the cob, husked | 2 1/2 cups arborio rice, warm
instructions: Mix rice flour with hot sauce in a small bowl until well mixed.

title: Tasty Hummus for One
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 can chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 2 tablespoons buttermilk
instructions: Spray a nonstick frying pan with cooking spray. Heat oil to medium on stove. Meanwhile, in a food processor, combine chickpeas and buttermilk and process until smooth.

Random Ingredients: flour,red pepper flake,vanilla sugar,caper,panko breadcrumb,vinegar,black cumin seed
title: The Best "luscious" Panko Breadcrumb Cookies
ingredients: 500 g flour | 500 g panko breadcrumbs | 1 teaspoon vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon red pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon black cumin seeds | 1 teaspoon vanilla sugar | 1/2 teaspoon black cumin seeds
instructions: Mix all and knead for a few minutes. Shape into a ball and leave to rest for an hour covered with parchment paper for a few hours and then roll on a floured board. Cut into squares and press each into a small cookie cutter. Place on a greased tray and bake them at 180ºc. Keep them in an air tight container and let them come about half way away. When cooled cut into fingers and brush with milk.

Random Ingredients: salad oil,cooking sherry,roasting chicken,bay leaf,red chili
title: Red Chile Braised Chicken
ingredients: 1 roasting chickens, cut up | 2 tablespoons cooking sherry | 2 bay leaves | 1 dried red chili | 2 teaspoons salad oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f and place chicken on rack in roasting tin so that it fits snugly around bird and roasts in the centre. In a small bowl, mix together sherry, bay leaves and red chili.

Random Ingredients: apple juice,tomato juice,extra virgin olive oil
title: Tomato Wine - Vino Con Pomodoro (Vino Toscano)
ingredients: 1/2 cup sugar | 2/3 cup tomato juice | 1 1/2 cups apple juice | 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Combine sugar, tomato juice, olive oil, and apple juice in a medium saucepan. Heat over medium low heat until sugar dissolves. Cool to room temperature.

title: Hot Irish Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf raisin bread | 2 tablespoons celery ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons hot chili sauce | 2 teaspoons hot chili sauce
instructions: Slice bread into 3/4 slices. Place on cookie sheet. If using celery, sprinkle on top of bread. Brush on chili sauce and sprinkle on hot sauce. Bake at 375 for 15 minutes or untill just beginning to brown. Turn off oven and leave bread in oven for about another 5 minutes. Remove from oven and sprinkle with more hot sauce. Note, if not used, double the amount of water. If used as an accompaniment, remove seeds and membrane or just add salt to the hot sauce.

title: Mexican Shrimp on the Side
ingredients: 2 lbs shrimp | 2 tablespoons taco seasoning | 1 can tomato and olive oil | 1 cup beef broth
instructions: Sear the shrimp in a frying pan. Put them on a plate and add taco seasoning then add tomato and olive oil. Cook in low heat and let the flavors meld.

title: Raspberry & Bean Sprout Burger
ingredients: 2 tablespoons diced raw hamburger | 1 tablespoon chunky salsa | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/2 cup fresh raspberries or 1/2 cup frozen raspberries | 1/4 cup prepared chunky salsa | 2 cups prepared guacamole or 2 cups prepared prepared baked hamburger
instructions: Pound hamburger til cooked through. Mix in salsa and garlic powder. Spread mixture evenly in greased 9 inch pie dish. Cover with raspberries & salsa. Top with guacamole & bake at 400° for 5 - 8 minutes or until heated through. Cut into 6 thick slices and serve.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,rice wine,courgette,sea salt,cherry,roast pork,ancho chile powder
title: Sausage and Veggies
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon sea salt, plus more | sea salt, to taste | 1 1/2 lbs ground roast or 1 1/2 lbs pork | 1 large courgette, grated coarse | 2 bell peppers, chopped coarse | 1 small spanish chile powder ( to taste ) or 1 small dry ancho chile ( to taste ) | 1/4 cup sweet rice wine or 1/4 cup sherry wine vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f season the meat with salt, about 1/2 teaspoon per batch. Cook in a 9 inch cast iron or other heavy skillet until browned, 1 to 2 minutes on each side. Arrange on a baking sheet. Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until tender. Remove from oven, cool, and slice across the grain about 1/4 inch thick, and set aside. Heat the rest of the pan over medium heat and add the courgette and chile powder. Saute quickly until the vegetables are just tender, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Cool for several minutes. Add the rice wine or vinegar and stir to combine. Return to heat and cook until most of the liquid has evaporated, 1 to 2 minutes. Add the meat slices and heat through.

title: Lahanna's Orzo Lasagna
ingredients: 12 sheets lasagna, cooked | 1/4 cup orzo pasta or 1/4 cup other small pasta | 1 -2 tablespoon mint, chopped ( optional ) | 1 cup buttermilk, well shaken
instructions: Preheat oven to combine orzo, mint and buttermilk. Layer the orzo/butter mixture in an oblong baking pan with sides beginning and ending with the pasta. Cover and bake for 30 - 35 minutes, until cssuscious. Let stand for 10 minutes, then cut into squares and serve.

Random Ingredients: cayenne,natural bran,sun tomato oil,cream cheese,tomato sauce
title: Sun-Dried Tomato & Cream Cheese Bran Pesto
ingredients: 14 ounces tomato sauce | 1 ounce sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 3 ounces natural bran | 1 1/2 ounces cream cheese | 1 pinch cayenne
instructions: Pesto, put all the ingredients in a food processor and process for 15 seconds or so to make it smooth and creamy. Spoon into a warm jar and seal. This takes several hours to infuse, depending on the quality of the pesto and the age of the sun dried tomatoes. Enjoy.

title: Lecherita De Pepino (Pep Dip)
ingredients: 6 -8 tablespoons mexican crema, for dipping | 3/4 - 1 teaspoon grated lemon peel | 3/4 - 1 teaspoon maggi seasoning salt | 1 teaspoon quatre-epices
instructions: In a mixing bowl, mix the crema with the mrs dashé’s seasoning salt, grated lemon peel and quatre épices. Cover and chill for up to 4 hours.

title: French Fondue
ingredients: 4 pounds russets potatoes, peeled | 1 lb hamburger | 2 tablespoons savory | 4 onions
instructions: Cut russets into chunks.

title: Plum Tomato Rice With Rice
ingredients: 1 cup white rice | 1 -2 plum tomato, sliced into wedges ( optional )
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. In a saucepan, saute garlic over low heat for about 3 - 5 minutes or until it turns golden in color. Add plums and a pinch of salt to rice. Toss rice until plums are hot and plums are heated through. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: mandarin orange,cabbage,red chili pepper,taco seasoning mix,green plantain,sea salt,clove
title: Award Winning Fried Plantains
ingredients: 2 teaspoons sea salt ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons red chili pepper | 4 large green plantains, cut into 1/4 inch slices diagonally across | 1 cup cabbage, finely shredded | 1/4 cup mandarin oranges, drained ( or other orange ) | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1/2 teaspoon ground cloves | 1/4 teaspoon sea salt
instructions: In large bowl, mix together flarole mix, sea salt, and chilli, tossing to coat. Set aside. Place plantains, cabbage, mandarin oranges, taco mix, and cloves in separate large bowl. Sprinkle with the salt. Toss gently to coat evenly with seasonings. Heat nonstick 12 inch nonstick skillet over medium high heat until hot.. Working in batches, add oiled plantains and saute until plantains turn golden brown, about 3 minutes per side. Transfer plantains to paper towels to drain. Serve plantains asap.

title: Kielbasa and Grape Wraps(Antilles)
ingredients: 5 lbs kielbasa, sliced paper thin | 1 pint grape, halved | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce
instructions: Place kielbasa on paper towels. Place grape halves around kielbasa and sprinkle with worcestershire sauce. Tie with kitchen string.

Random Ingredients: beef sirloin,coriander powder,virgin olive oil,fenugreek seed,chicken bouillon,lettuce
title: Lettuce Wrapped Beef Kabobs
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon fenugreek seeds | 1/2 tablespoon whole coriander powder | 1 lb boneless meatloin, trimmed, cut into 2-inch-diameter pieces | 1/3 cup virgin olive oil | 1 cube chicken bouillon | to taste lettuce or to taste lettuce
instructions: In a shallow dish or tray, combine fenugreek and coriander powders. Add meat.

title: Peachy Peach Dip
ingredients: 1 pound fresh peaches - peeled, pitted, and chopped | 1 can pearls in light syrup
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together peaches, pearls, and water. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour.

title: Easy Berry Scones
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups self raising flour | 1 tablespoon herbs, powder ( your favorite ) | 1 teaspoon garam masala | milk, as required to blend ( i use a whisk to blend it to a good consistency ) | berries ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Combine all the ingredients and mix. Form into a flat, thick & somewhat ovalish circle, place on a non stick tray and bake on a low heat setting for approx 20 mins until golden brown. Once removed, allow to cool & serve with jam/cream, or with your favourite topping. Note, if making savoury pastry, just use 1/3 less fat milk & 1/3 less fat margarine.

Random Ingredients: cotija cheese,celery,red chilies,fennel seed,wheat flour,picante sauce
title: Picante Flour Tortillas
ingredients: 3 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 40 small dried red chilies | 2 tablespoons grated cotija cheese or 2 tablespoons other mild cheese | 1 tablespoon minced celery | 2 teaspoons fennel seeds | 2 tablespoons picante sauce, or salsa, for drizzling
instructions: Combine all and stir well. Let sit for 10 minutes. Preheat oven to 350°f. Heat a well seasoned cast iron skillet over medium heat. Lightly sprinkle flour over top of batter. Cook, turning once, for 1 minute or until lightly browned, turning with tongs. Sprinkle with chiles and cheese, then cover tightly.

Random Ingredients: baby potato,marshmallow,parmesan cheese,white onion,red chilies,maraschino cherry,milk,pine nut
title: Papa's Super-Delicious Mini Meat Balls
ingredients: 1 lb baby potatoes | 1/2 white onion, peeled and finely chopped | 1 can evaporated milk ( you may use skim ) | 1/4 cup light parmesan cheese, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon pine nuts or 1 tablespoon almond oil | 3 -5 slices canned red chilies, finely chopped ( depending on heat preference ) | 1/2 cup finely chopped white onion | 1/2 cup maraschino cherry ( or red cherry juice, to taste ) | 1 -2 tablespoon crushed dried maraschino cherries
instructions: Pre heat oven to 400°f. Place the whole potatoes on a baking sheet lined with parchment or foil. Sprinkle the top of the potatoes with salt. Bake at 400 degrees f for about 45 minutes or until the potatoes are tender and starting to brown in the centers. Remove from oven and allow to cool completely. Peel the outer layer of the potatoes and cut away any very soft center part of the potato's shell. Slice the potatoes finely but not as coarsely or completely as smooth as you'd like. Place in a large bowl. Mash them well using a potato masher. Add the onion, milk, parmesan and pine nuts or almonds, stirring until all ingredients are mixed. Add the chilies and stir well. Add the chilies, white onion, maraschino cherries and the reserved potato. Mix gently until the mixture is well combined. Form the mixture into small, bite size balls. Roll them into the crushed dried fruits. Place on a tray lined with parchment or foil/parchment paper. Bake about 20 minutes until the meat balls are light tan. Serve hot or warm with your favorite gravy or veggie. Enjoy note, this freezes well.

title: Crunchy Curried Bulgur Wheat
ingredients: 1 cup bulgar wheat | 4 tablespoons margarine | 1/2 cup white flour | 1/3 cup curry paste | 2 tablespoons dry catsup | 1/2 - 3/4 cup lime juice ( depending on your own tastes ) | 1 cup dried cranberries, chopped
instructions: Wash bulgur, not breaking it into smaller chunks. Mix bulgur, margarine, flour, curry paste, catsup, lime juice in medium bowl. Mix well to combine. Pour into a greased 9x13 baking dish. Bake at 350 for about 30 - 45 minutes, till golden brown. If desired, spread a glaze of your choice on top before serving.

title: Shrimp Burgers
ingredients: 18 large uncooked shrimp, cleaned and shelled | 6 medium granny smith apples, peeled, cored, and cut into 3/4 inch cubes ( i use `` granny smith '' brand ) | 2 tablespoons salt | 2 teaspoons cayenne | 1/2 teaspoon clove powder ( i use allspice )
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together except the shrimp. Shape into 6 patties on a hot griddle. Fry over medium heat until golden brown on both sides.

title: Turkey and Rigatoni With No-Boil Noodles
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground turkey | 1 1 lb rigatoni pasta | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Meanwhile, in large nonstick skillet over medium high heat, cook turkey about 6 minutes, stirring to break up meat.

title: Homemade Smoked Sausages
ingredients: 1 whole rib, ground | 1 tablespoon dill seed
instructions: In a small bowl, combine half the dill seed and half the ground meat. Form a ball with the remaining dill and ground ground meat using your hands. Place the balls onto a floured surface. Using your palms, roll the balls until they are about 1/4 inch thick. Cut the sausage diagonally into approximately 12 to 15 - 1 1/2 inch wide links. Place on a grill over medium coals or over a medium hot coals. Cook until well browned, about 10 minutes. Allow to rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Grilled and Peeled Red Snapper
ingredients: 1 red snapper | 2 medium peaches, pitted and quartered
instructions: Remove the skin from the snapper and rinse. Cut in half lengthwise and remove all the flesh.

title: Irish Bratwurst With Crisp Nests
ingredients: 3 -4 large bratwursts | 1/2 cup capers, chopped | 1/4 cup irish cream | 16 corn tortillas, warm | 1/4 cup saffron strand
instructions: Heat grill, set to medium high heat. Spray or brush grill with non stick spray. Grill bratwurst, for 5 - 7 minutes turning once until golden brown and crisp. Add capers. Continue cooking for 3 additional minutes. Transfer to bowl. Top with warm tortillas, sprinkle with irish cream. Serve.

title: Salmon Mushroom and Eggplant
ingredients: 1 eggplant, sliced | 4 ounces white mushrooms, sliced | 8 ounces boneless skinless chicken meat, thinly sliced | 1 lb salmon, sliced ( about 3 to 4 servings ) | coarse salt and fresh ground pepper | finely chopped fresh thyme | 1/2 teaspoon finely chopped sage | 8 ounces frozen peas | 1 teaspoon sesame oil
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Arrange eggplant on a lightly greased baking sheet and bake until just beginning to get golden, about 40 minutes. Meanwhile, combine chicken and veggies in a large bowl. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Sprinkle with thyme and sage. Dot with sesame oil. Bake uncovered for 15 to 20 minutes, flipping the veggies as needed. Serve hot or warm.

title: Simple and Delicious Low Cal Cal Calzone
ingredients: 1 package sweet italian turkey sausage | 1/2 cup skim milk cream, warmed ( non dairy ) | 1 teaspoon pepper
instructions: Cook the sausage in a non stick skillet over medium heat until fully cooked and no blood seeps from the meat. While the sausage has hot, in a medium bowl whisk together the warmed milk, pepper and hot cream until blended. Place the hot sausage in a baking dish and pour the warmed cream mixture over the sausage. Sprinkle the top with additional pepper and bake, covered, at 400 degrees for 20 minutes, or until hot and bubbly.

title: Gluten Free Hot Dog Mix
ingredients: 4 tablespoons gluten-free flour ( gluten-free if available ) | 1 teaspoon dried sage leaves ( gluten-free if available, use 1 tablespoon for a packet ) | 1/4 teaspoon dried arbol chile ( gluten-free if available )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a food processor.

title: BBQ King Peter
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin steaks | 1/2 cup kielbasa ( kielbasa with papery root ) or 1/2 cup spicy sausage meat, cut into pieces | 1 red chile, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons sultanas or 2 tablespoons raisins | 2 packages crispy chicken tortellini ( also referred as cheese tortellini, a white or brown giant jell-o )
instructions: Trim any visible fat from the sirloin steaks. Cut them into cubes. Place beef in a large, non stick fry pan with the red chile, sausage meat, and raisins, season with salt and pepper. Over medium heat, cook the steaks for 3 - 5 minutes, turning once or twice. Cook until browned. If mixture starts to get dry, add a little more water. Serve with a salad, fresh vegetables, or some cooked pasta such as potatoes.

Random Ingredients: penne,pepper,cannellini bean,pork shoulder,buttermilk baking mix,lime wedge
title: Pork Cannellini, White Beans and Pasta
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless pork shoulder, cut into 1/2-inch thick chunks | 1/2 cup dry buttermilk baking mix | 3 cups canned cannellini beans, drained and rinsed well | 4 cups dry penne ( about 12 ounces ) | lime wedge | fresh ground pepper
instructions: In a 5 to 6 quart slow cooker, toss pork with baking mix. Add beans and stir to combine. Cover and cook on low setting 3 to 4 hours. In a large pot of boiling salted water, add pasta. Cook, uncovered, over medium heat until tender but firm to the bite, stirring occasionally, about 8 minutes. Reserving ¾ cup cooking liquid, drain pasta and return to pot. Toss with remaining cooking liquid. Season to taste with salt. Top with a squeeze of lime juice and fresh ground pepper, if desired.

Random Ingredients: serrano pepper,cider vinegar,thai chile,paprika,veal cutlet,lemon peel
title: Filipino Chicken Adobo (Veal)
ingredients: 1 lb boneless veal cutlet | 1 cup cider vinegar | 2 teaspoons paprika | 1 teaspoon lemon peel, minced | 4 whole serrano peppers, minced | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon thai chile
instructions: In a bowl, combine all ingredients except the veg.

title: Mexican Pasta Salad With Groundnuts
ingredients: 1/4 cup dry sherry | 1 tablespoon onion salt | 2 tablespoons corn | 1 cup guacamole | 1 cup sweet and sour salad dressing | 12 ounces rigatoni pasta or 12 ounces ziti pasta, cooked and drained | 1/4 cup raw peanuts, finely crushed
instructions: Mix sherry, salt, corn, guacamole and sour salad dressing until well blended. Add pasta. Serve.

title: Italian Parsley and Water Chestnut Salad
ingredients: 1 head purple cabbage, sliced | 1 jar water chestnuts | 1/2 cup fresh italian parsley, chopped
instructions: Mix cabbage, water chestnuts, and parsley together in a bowl. Refrigerate at least 8 hours before serving.

title: The Old-Fashioned French Dried Lamb
ingredients: 600 g lamb, cut int 3cm cubes | 1 kg mushrooms | 200 g crabmeat | 500 g creme de menthe | 3 star anise | 1 liter dry creme de menthe
instructions: Pound the lamb with the spices and salt to make fine schnitzels. Add mushrooms and crab meat. Add creme de menthe and tie with kitchen string. Add to the pan, cover with a lid and let it dry for at least 2 hours. Serve in a dish with crackers.

Random Ingredients: cointreau liqueur,rosemary,kidney bean,self rising flour,basmati rice,tahini
title: Rice-Rice Bean Sushi
ingredients: 1 lb small fully cooked whole-wheat jumbo beans | 2 1/2 cups unbleached self-rising flour | 1/4 cup tahini | 2 tablespoons cointreau liqueur | 1/2 teaspoon dried rosemary | 1 cup cooked basmati rice or 1 cup other short-grain white rice, cooled
instructions: Combine the beans, flour, tahini, curreau, rosemary and rice together in a medium bowl. Stir in 1/4 cup water. Use your hands to form the mixture into long, thin, round rice cakes. Repeat with remaining mixture. Use a sharp knife to carefully cut 1 inch from one side of the rice cakes to the other, leaving a 3 inch space on both sides, creating space for steam escape. Steam rice cakes over boiling water for 9 minutes, or until they turn golden brown all over.

Random Ingredients: russet potato,chili oil,basil leaf,hot chili sauce,irish cream,date,ice cube,yellow pepper
title: Vegan Bubble and Squeak Potatoes
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chili oil or 1 tablespoon other oil | 2 -4 large russet potatoes | 4 fresh hot chili sauce ( or green chili sauce-optional ) | 4 ounces dates, chopped | 4 ounces yellow peppers, chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped fresh basil leaves ( or 2 tbsp of fresh ) | 2 tablespoons irish cream or 2 tablespoons water | 4 cups ice cubes, crushed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Put the oil into a large roasting pan over medium heat. Slice the potatoes into about 1 inch or 3/4 inch slices and arrange them into the oil. Slice the hot chiles and fry for about 5 minutes or until slightly softened. Add the chopped dates and cook another 2 minutes. Turn the potatoes over and add chiles, peppers, basil and stir fry about 5 minutes. Add the garlic chile sauce and the ice and stir. Cover the pan and bake for about 25 minutes. Remove from the oven. After the 20 minutes, increase heat to medium and stir in the dry ingredients. Cover the pan and continue baking for another 20 or 25 minutes.

title: Beef Birds
ingredients: 1/2 lb sirloin, cut in strips | 2 bay leaves | 4 tablespoons flour | 1 head cauliflower, cut into florets | 1 pint strawberry, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. In skillet. Sprinkle beef with bay leaves. Brown beef in olive oil. Pour out drippings. Arrange cauliflower, berries and mushrooms around beef. Sprinkle with flour, cover and bake 2 hours or until beef is tender.

title: Sour Ham Nuggets
ingredients: 500 g ham ( very lean ) | 2 tablespoons rice flour
instructions: Cut the ham into thin squares. You should end up with approximately 6 squares. Rinse the ham under running water, rubbing between all uses. Drain and dry. Heat a large non stick frying pan or wok over high heat, once hot add the ham and cook until darkly brown all over. Be careful it burns easily so watch as not to burn your mouth and stir as needed. When it starts to turn a beautiful golden brown colour, remove from the heat. Using a large spoon, scrape the ham pieces from the pan and then place onto a large serving platter. Sprinkle the rice flour over and top with a few warm onions and crumbled bacon. Serve immediately.

title: Swedish Pea Salad
ingredients: 4 cups frozen snow peas | 2 slices rye bread, or other crusty bread | 2 tablespoons white vinegar | 1 tablespoon white vinegar | 2 tablespoons finely grated chocolate | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Place the peas in a pan with water to cover. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes, or until the peas are tender. Transfer the peas to a food processor. Add the rye bread and process to a crumbly texture. Add 2 tablespoons of the white vinegar and 1 tbsp of rice vinegar and process until you have a medium smooth mixture. Add 1 tbsp of the white vinegar, 1 tbsp of chocolate, and the bay leaf and process until well mixed. Season to taste.

title: Downhome Clamato
ingredients: 1 cup watercress leaves, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon prepared mustard | 1 1/2 cups bottled clam juice | 24 small broccoli florets, coarsely chopped
instructions: Place chopped watercress leaves and prepared mustard in a blender.

Random Ingredients: feta cheese,pepper,dark soy sauce,parmesan cheese,corn oil,self rising flour
title: Baked Peppers
ingredients: 8 ounces feta cheese, crumbled and mixed with | 3 tablespoons corn oil | 2/3 cup parmesan cheese or 2/3 cup romano cheese, grated | 1/3 cup self rising flour | 1/4 cup dark soy sauce | pepper ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. In a mixing bowl mix all ingrediants together and combine well. Place peppers on a greased baking sheet and flatten into a 4 - 5 inch circle. Cover with foil and bake for 25 - 35 minutes, check they are done and remove foil if need be. Serve with hot sauce or dipping sauce.

title: Braised Lobster in Apple Sauce
ingredients: 4 live lobsters, scrubbed clean | 2 teaspoons salt | 2 teaspoons freshly ground cayenne pepper | 12 tart apples, cored and cut into wedges | 12 sprigs fresh chives
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Toss the lobsters with the salt, cayenne pepper, and apples to coat them. Place them on a cookie sheet and lightly oil the top. Place a dollop of apple juice into the bottom of the crock. Add the lobsters to the crock. Cover the crock with foil. Bake in the preheated oven until the lobster is opaque in the center and the apples are soft, 25 to 30 minutes. Remove, reserving about 2 tablespoons of the cooking liquid for gravy.

title: Perfect Raisin Pancakes
ingredients: 2 cups rice flour | 4 1/2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 4 1/2 tablespoons golden raisins
instructions: Whisk flour and sunflower oil in medium size bowl. Stir in raisins. Cover and let stand 10 minutes. Preheat frying pan over medium heat. Add 1 3/4 ltr of batter and tilt to coat edges around pan. Reduce heat to low on frying pan and cook 2 - 3 minutes. Turn pancakes with slotted spatula and cook another 2 - 3 minutes until golden brown. Serve with favorite topping.

Random Ingredients: orange peel,thai red chili pepper,yellow bell pepper,basil leaf,pear
title: Pepper, Pear and Red Pepper Salad
ingredients: 1 lb ripe pear, peeled, cored and diced coarsely | 2 fresh thai red chili peppers, seeded, stemmed, thinly sliced lengthwise | 1 small yellow bell pepper, seeded, seeded and chopped | 1/4 cup basil leaves, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon orange peel, grated coarsely
instructions: In a large bowl, toss the pear with the chiles, bell pepper, basil, orange peel. Serve immediately.

title: Italian Ziti
ingredients: 1 package ziti pasta | 2 tablespoons shredded coconut | 1/4 cup dark rum | 1 can refrigerated crescent dinner rolls
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add ziti pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Lemon-Pineapple Italian Grill Party Melt
ingredients: 3 tablespoons flour | 1/2 cup prepared sweet-and-sour mix | 2 tablespoons drained bottled pineapple juice | 1/8 teaspoon lemon zest | 1 tablespoon capers, drained | rosemary sprigs or rosemary sprig
instructions: Mix flour and sweet and sour mix. Mix in pineapple juice, lemon zest and capers. Pour into a greased 12 inch pizza pan or a regular ovenproof skillet. Sprinkle with rosemary or rosemary, if using. Bake at 375°f for 10 minutes or cook as directed on package. Serve hot with a green vegetable, such as tomatoes and green peppers.

Random Ingredients: red chilies,cream chicken soup,scotch bonnet pepper,tomato juice,parsnip,cream cheese
title: The Great Canadian Smoked Spicy Parsnip Dip
ingredients: 3 medium parsnips, peeled, halved and left whole | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 2 tablespoons cream cheese | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 2 small dried red chilies ( i remove the seeds and veins ) | 3/4 cup tomoto juice | 3 small scotch bonnet peppers or 3 small jalapeno chiles, seeded and chopped
instructions: Cook parsnips in boiling water till tender tender. Reserve. Drain well. While waiting for the parsnips to cool slightly break apart with a fork and reserve. In a bowl combine remaining ingredients and mix well. Pour the vegetable mixture into a crock pot. Cover, turn on low to get ingredients hot throughout. After the parsnips are tender serve with crackers or as accompaniment for a hearty, quick meal. You can also prepare this up to a day ahead and let the flavors blend while preparing the rest of the meal.

Random Ingredients: bean,bread flour,green onion,red pepper flake,mexican oregano,chinese rice wine
title: Tasty Beans & Rice Bread
ingredients: 2 cups brown and white mexican rice blend | 1 can baked beans ( optional ) | 2 green onions, sliced ( optional ) | 2 -3 tablespoons toasted bread flour | 2 teaspoons sesame seeds or 2 teaspoons rice wine | 1 teaspoon mexican oregano ( optional )
instructions: Mix rice & beans. Pound with a meat mallet until rice is a uniform consistency. Fluff with a fork.. Spray a baking pan with nonstick cooking spray. Put 1 tbls. Bean mixture, 1 tbls. Green onion, & 1 tsp sesame seeds, in the pan with the meat mallet. Make sure the pan is not big & it doesn't get crowded. Make a few small slits on the top of the bread dough. Bake at 425 for 45 minutes, or until bread crusts. Let cool slightly & enjoy.

title: Baked German Sweet Bread
ingredients: 3 medium baking potatoes | 1 tablespoon baking soda
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Bring a pot of water to a boil. Place baking potato in the boiling water. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes, or until tender. Drain. Return to the pot. Remove and discard any grease and grated potato. Place in a large bowl and mix in baking soda. Spray a 9x5 inch loaf pan with cooking spray. Spread the potatoes on the bottom of the pan and sprinkle them with bread crumb mixture until they are evenly covered. Bake in the preheated oven for 30 minutes, until bubbly.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,pecorino romano cheese,beef stock,green olive
title: Quick Beef Ragu With Olives
ingredients: 1 1/4 liters beef stock | 4 tablespoons of good curry powder ( or enough to make a very thick paste ) | 50 g green olives ( sliced thinly, i used the ones in the jar. ) | 8 -10 pieces pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Place beef stock, curry powder in a saucepan and bring to boil on stove. Reduce heat, add the olives and simmer about 5 minutes. Stir in cheese and remove from fire. When cool, break into pieces.

title: Pork Tenders with Creamy Chiles
ingredients: 2 lbs pork tenderloin, cut into 1 inch cubes | 4 cups cream | 2 tablespoons tapioca | 1 dried red chile, seeded, minced | 1/2 cup semolina or 1/2 cup flour, plus | 1 tablespoon semolina, flour
instructions: Combine all ingredients except corna in a slow cooker on low setting for about 4 hours. Turn off cooker, allow to rest for 10 minutes, then stir to mix well. Serve meat on plates. Accompany with steamed rice.

title: Turkish-Style Eggplant Dip
ingredients: 2 lbs japanese eggplants, peeled | 1 tablespoon kosher salt, plus more for topping | 1/3 cup red lentils, rinsed | 1 1/2 cups confectioners'sugar | 1/3 cup fresh cilantro, chopped | 1/3 cup whole cranberries, washed, picked over and spun dry
instructions: Cut the eggplant in half lengthwise.

title: Beef Satay
ingredients: 1 - 2 1/2 lb chuck ( very lean ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons salt | 1/4 teaspoon tamari soy sauce | 1/4 teaspoon poppy seed | 6 -8 lime wedges | 1 tablespoon dry sherry
instructions: Cut stew meat into about 2 inch long strips or bite sized chunks. Place meat in dish, sprinkling with salt, coating well. Marinate at least three hours or overnight. Thread meat strips onto soaked wooden skewers, leaving center of skewers clean. Sprinkle lightly with cornstarch and roll in poppy seeds. Grill over hot coals, or on gas grill, turning for even cooking. Baste well with sherry, if desired.

Random Ingredients: white wine,shrimp paste,chicken bouillon cube,greek seasoning
title: Portuguese Shrimp
ingredients: 500 g raw shrimp paste | 150 ml white wine | 2 chicken bouillon cubes | 1 teaspoon all purpose greek seasoning
instructions: Crush shrimp paste with mortar and pestle on a cutting board. Put in deep pot. Add 1 - 2 tbs wine and chicken bullion. Put on stove on low till liquid is reduced to a sticky consistency. Turn off heat. Let marinade stand for 15 minutes. Transfer shrimp paste to a dish, pour remaining wine into pot and heat till mixture boils. Turn off heat. Add greek seasoning and mix well. Let mixture cool. Remove shrimp paste onto a large serving dish. Serve with rice.

title: Easy Taco Dip
ingredients: 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 2 tablespoons taco seasoning | 1 tablespoon fresh lime juice
instructions: In small bowl, combine all ingredients. Cover and refrigerate. Place in refrigerator for up to 2 hours. Serve with tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: kalamata olive,sherry wine,apricot jam,mint extract,kielbasa,pear,creole seasoning,monterey jack cheese
title: Apricot Cheese Kebabs
ingredients: 1 cup kalamata olives ( drained, patted dry ) | 1/3 cup pickled creole seasoning ( mccormick a-1 recommended ) | 1 cup shredded monterey jack cheese | 2 tablespoons unsalted shelled apricot jam | 4 tablespoons sherry wine | 1 teaspoon dried mint extract | 8 ounces kielbasa
instructions: Toss all ingredients except the kielbasa together. Place the kielbasa in the center of the skewer. Brush the kielbasa with a little of the sherry. Grill the kielbasa skewers 3 - 4 minutes per side, turning several times and brushing with the rest of the sherry. Cut into 1 chunks.

title: Salty Soy Fudge
ingredients: 1 cup soymilk, warmed | freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Pour warmed soymilk into a medium bowl. Gradually add black pepper. Cover bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate 30 minutes or overnight. Break off chunks of plastic wrap and gently squeeze the soymilk into the bowl with the black pepper. Use your hands to mix all ingredients. Break chocolate chips, for topping, into bite sized pieces and dip into the soymilk mixture.

Random Ingredients: cider vinegar,green chili pepper,vanilla sugar,scotch whisky,chili without bean,sesame oil
title: Devill's Chilled Chilli
ingredients: 1 lb dried scotch whisky | 4 ounces chili without beans | 4 ounces cider vinegar | 1 teaspoon vanilla sugar | 2 teaspoons toasted sesame oil | 2 tablespoons green chili peppers, chopped
instructions: Soak the scotch in cold water for 20 minutes, remove it before using. Put all the ingredients in a blender and blend. Pour into a saucepan and heat through, it doesn't boil put on lid and leave to simmer for 5 - 10 minutes stirring occasionally so it does not stick to the bottom of the pan.

Random Ingredients: lychee,lettuce leaf,anchovy fillet,green cardamom pod,tarragon vinegar,spam,taco seasoning
title: Spam Tacos-Aussie Style
ingredients: 10 ounces spam, canned | 1 1/2 teaspoons tarragon vinegar or 1 1/2 teaspoons white wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1 green cardamom pod, crushed ( or 1/8 teaspoon cardamom powder ) | 2 -3 teaspoons taco seasoning | 20 lettuce leaves, romaine | 10 -12 large flat bread or 10 -12 large leaf taco shells
instructions: Mash the spam. Stir in the remaining ingredients. Add a little vinegar if necessary. Cover and refrigerate until ready to use. Cut the bread into small cubes or wedges. To serve, spoon the spam into a serving bowl, add lettuce leaves and taco or pita chips. Serve with salsa, if desired. Alternatively, to serve, use a fork and knife to cut the spam into wedges.

Random Ingredients: mustard powder,whipping cream,yellow bell pepper,beef brisket,stewing beef
title: Beef and Pepper Hash
ingredients: 3 lbs beef brisket or 3 lbs chuck beef, cut in 1 inch cubes | 3 teaspoons ground mustard powder | 1 large yellow bell pepper, cut in wedges | 4 tablespoons whipping cream | 3 cans stewing beef, undrained
instructions: Combine the beef, mustard powder, and bell pepper in a bowl. Divide the beef evenly among the 8 ovenproof skillet. Spread the cream over the meat. Bake at 400 degrees f for 15 to 20 minutes, or until meat is no longer pink. Serve the beef and pepper hash with the cooked beef and pepper soup.

Random Ingredients: stilton cheese,chicken breast,chanterelle mushroom,graham cracker crumb,saffron
title: Enchanted Chicken
ingredients: 12 ounces boneless chicken breasts | 8 ounces chanterelle mushrooms | 1/4 teaspoon saffron | 1 cup toasted graham cracker crumbs | 12 ounces stilton cheese ( or other blue cheese )
instructions: Cut chicken into very thin strips. Dry chicken out and combine with remaining ingredients. Pour breadcrumbs into bottom of your food making station in a deep casserole dish or baking dish. Place chicken on top and bake in a 375f degree oven for 30 minutes.

title: Nuoc Cham (Vietnamese Vinegar Dipping Sauce)
ingredients: 1/4 cup regular vietnamese rice vinegar or 1/4 cup seasoned rice vinegar | 1 fresh parsley sprig
instructions: Combine the vinegar and parsley in a small bowl. Cover and shake to combine.

Random Ingredients: tahini,turkey,bay leaf,ranch dressing mix,anise seed,brown rice,basil pesto,plum tomato
title: Pesto-Fried Turkey
ingredients: 2 cups brown rice ( i use jasmine ) | 1 can plum tomatoes, drained and chopped | 3 tablespoons tahini | 1 packet dry ranch dressing mix | 2 teaspoons anise seeds | 1 teaspoon dried basil pesto | 1 whole bay leaf | 1 small whole turkey, cooked and finely chopped
instructions: Put ingredients in a large food processor or blender and blend until well mixed. Pour into a bowl. Add desired amount of oil, spices and seasoning. Stir well and let marinate in refrigerator for 45 minutes. When ready to serve, heat 2 tsp oil on medium high in a 12 inch nonstick skillet. Add marinated turkey and cook until heated through and browned on all sides. Add to white rice.

title: Roasted Sesame Beef
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 lb thinly sliced flank steak or 1 lb leftover beef, cut into thin strips | 2 yellow bell peppers, cut in 2 '' strips with 1 inch end towards the end, stems and seeds removed | 2 cups beef broth or 2 cups chicken broth, if desired | 1 teaspoon mixed spice
instructions: Heat oven to 300 degrees f. Heat oil in a large ovenproof skillet over medium high heat. Add beef and all vegetables, stir fry 3 minutes. Stir in broth and mixed spice.

title: Microwave Nuts
ingredients: 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 1 tablespoon taco sauce | 3 teaspoons quatre-epices | 1 teaspoon agave syrup | 1 teaspoon oil ( to roast nuts )
instructions: Put all the ingredients but the nuts in a glass bowl and stir to mix. Add the peanuts and stir. Cover the bowl with cling film. Cook in the microwave for 10 - 12 minutes. Open the bowl and check the peanuts if they are soft and browned. Remove the bowl, remove the seasoning and serve. You can also eat these nuts as a snack.

title: Crunchy Peppers & Relish.
ingredients: 1 red bell pepper, chopped | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon oil
instructions: Combine the bell pepper, rice vinegar and oil in a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: mandarin orange,red chili pepper,parmesan cheese,yogurt,duck breast,jalapeno pepper,vegetable broth,vanilla pudding mix
title: Quick and Easy Low Fat Trifle
ingredients: 2 teaspoons jalapeno peppers, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons fresh red chili peppers or 2 teaspoons hot red chili pepper, finely chopped | 2 cups low sodium vegetable broth | 1 bag of vanilla pudding mix | 1 package mandarin oranges or ( 16 ounce ) bag yellow sugar snap peas, cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces | 1 cooked duck breast | 1 cup low sodium yogurt ( natural or vanilla ) | 2 tablespoons parmesan cheese, grated
instructions: Heat broth in 3 quart saucepan until boiling. Mix in jelly or sugar snap peas and duck. Simmer on low until heated through. To serve, add 3/4 cup yogurt and half of parmesan to each plate and then stir in remaining parmesan.

title: Beef Phyllo Samosas
ingredients: 3 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 2 1/2 pounds beef stew meat, fat trimmed and cut into chunks | 2 1/2 tablespoons prepared mustard | 1 package frozen phyllo dough
instructions: Mix flour into meat, and coat meat with italian seasoning. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Lay phyllo dough onto a baking sheet with a lightly floured rolling pin, and brush with oil. Arrange 3 1/2 phyllo sheets in a single layer on top of the lightly greased sheet of parchment paper. Bake in the preheated oven until phyllo dough is browned and crisp, 20 to 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder,frosting,thai red curry paste,vanilla essence
title: Quick & Easy Slowcooked Pork Shoulder
ingredients: 2 pork shoulder | 1 teaspoon thai red curry paste ( red curry powder ) | 0.5 can fat-free sweetened condensed milk | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Trim fat from pork and cut into about 20 pieces. Sprinkle the pork with salt and pepper between each layer of pork. Rub a little tsbpn of curry paste between each layer on all sides of the pork. Repeat process until all of the pork is coated. Empty the sweetened condensed milk and vanilla into a small baking dish with a tight fitting cover. Place the pork in the dish and cover with cling wrap. Refrigerate overnight. The next day, remove the cling wrap and microwave the pork for about 3 minutes at high. Carefully flip the heat back to back then to microwave on high for 30 seconds uncovered. This will open up the whole can of condensed milk. It is easier and faster to scoop and mix all of the contents of the can, then reheat for 20 - 30 seconds uncovered. When the pork is cooked, place in a large deep pan or pot and pour in sweetened condensed milk around it. Cover tightly and cook at low heat, flipping every few minutes until most of the liquid has evaporated, but before the pork and its juices have dried. This can take between 45 min or more to an hour to get the hang of an oven temperature. If you feel the cooker is drying out too quickly, raise the heat a little.

title: Okra and Lamb Chops
ingredients: 1 lb beef sirloin, cut into � inch slices | 4 -6 okra, trimmed of stems, washed and chopped | 2 cups soymilk or 2 cups skim milk | 1 lamb loin chops, trimmed of fat
instructions: Slice meat across the grain into 1/2 to ¼ inch thick slices. Place in a casserole dish. Saute okra in a little olive oil with salt and pepper until okra is crisp tender. Remove okra to a plate. Add lamb to pan.

title: Blackberries and Plums With Corn
ingredients: 1 lb assorted plums, such as chanterelles, tarragon stalks, and nasturtium stalks, stemmed, washed, and quartered | 1/4 cup corn oil | 2 pints pitted blackberries, picked over
instructions: For each plums and fruit, remove the pits. Scoop out the flesh from the plums and reserve the fruit for later use. Fill a heavy nonreactive saucepan 3/4 full of water. Add the corn oil and bring to a simmer. Add the pitted plums and cook over moderate heat, shaking the pan with tongs, until the plums are soft and tender, 15 to 20 minutes. Discard any unopened pits. Serve warm or at room temperature with the blackberries.

title: Tarragon Chicken
ingredients: 1 tablespoon tarragon | 1 chicken or 1 vegetable tenderizer ( see note below ) | 1/8 teaspoon turmeric powder ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. To a heavy baking sheet, place tarragon. Wash chicken and pat dry. Place on top. Poke the tarragon with a fork in several places and sprinkle on turmeric. Bake 45 - 55 minutes, until chickens are cooked. Note, tarragon is not used in bread. Sprinkle with salt when it comes to chicken. Note, to cut down on spiciness, remove the fat from the chicken. Instead you can leave some on the chicken just before serving. Note, this freezes well. If leftovers are to be placed in freezer, place frozen vegetables in a ziplock bag and add the chicken. Seal and shake, then place back in the fridge for a few hours. Note, if not using vegetable tenderizer, add 1/8 to 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder and 1/8 to 1/4 teaspoon of cayenne pepper.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,feta,potato starch,chicken bouillon,bourbon,manchego cheese,red pepper flake
title: Bourbon Feta Chicken
ingredients: 12 -14 ounces chicken bouillon ( depending on how thick chicken meat is, use according to taste ) | 2 1/2 lbs potatoes starch ( approximately 1lb ) | 1 large yellow bell pepper ( for color ) | 1 large red bell pepper ( for color ) | 2 -3 tablespoons bourbon ( or a little more ( to taste ) | 1 lb manchego cheese, grated ( depending on how much gravy you like ) | pam puree or cream flavoring ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes ( optional )
instructions: Boil the water in a large pot and add salt to taste. Add potatoes starch and simmer for another 20 - 30 minutes. After 30 minutes, remove the water. Add the peppers and bouillon to the pepper mixture and stir.. Continue to simmer for another 45 - 60 minutes until the peppers begin to soften. Cool. While the peppers are cooling down, grate cheese or blend finely. Add all ingredients to the pepper mixture in a large bowl. Mix until all the ingredients are incorporated right before serving. You may refrigerate for about 1 hour or freeze for later consumption.

Random Ingredients: bacon,vegetable,green bell pepper,flat leaf parsley,golden syrup,red chili powder
title: Vegetables Korma
ingredients: 5 slices bacon ( i remove the casings ) | 3 cups mixed vegetables, such as carrots, zucchini, turnips and cauliflower, cut into thin sticks | 2 tablespoons golden syrup or 2 tablespoons brown sugar | 1 1/4 teaspoons crushed red chili powder | 1/2 cup flat leaf parsley ( chopped fine, if fresh leaves are used, may sub cilantro ) | 1/4 cup green bell pepper, finely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Place the bacon slices in an 8 inch frying pan or frying pan over moderate heat. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the fat is rendered and the bacon is crisp but not brown, about 3 minutes. Drain all but 2 tablespoons of the fat and then wipe out the pan. Dip the vegetables and then the bacon slices into the hot fat and cook, stirring, until the vegetables are just tender at the tips, about 3 minutes. Sprinkle with the golden syrup or sugar, crushed red chile and the chopped parsley. Serve hot or warm. Note, the bacon can be replaced by bacon fat. Try substituting 1/2 cup plus 1 teaspoon chopped fresh parsley for the green pepper and/or add 1/2 teaspoon pepper to your taste.

title: Sultan's Chickpeas With Beef and Feta
ingredients: 1 lb ground sirloin | 1 tablespoon lemon juice, zest of, in juice | 1 can chickpeas | 1 cup fat free greek yogurt | 1 ounce fat free feta cheese or 1 ounce part-skim mozzarella cheese
instructions: Brown ground beef, zenest and juice chick peas, drain. In 9x13 pan combine the beef mixture. Slice fat free cheese into thin slices and put over the meatball mixture. Then put feta on top. Bake at 350 for 20 - 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: almond extract,cream chicken soup,macaroni,oatmeal,chicken breast,shrimp,marinara sauce
title: Quick Chicken and Shrimp  Bake
ingredients: 6 chicken breasts, cooked and shredded | 1 cup oatmeal | 2 cups cooked macaroni | 1 1/2 cups cooked shrimp, chopped ( from the can ) | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1/4 cup low-fat marinara sauce | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Preheat your oven to 350°f. Combine the oatmeal, shrimp, soup, and marinara. Grease an 8 x 8 baking dish, pour in the mixture. Bake in the oven for 45 minutes. Top with your favorite toppings.

title: Halloumi Cheese Soup
ingredients: 120 g halloumi cheese, cut into small cubes | 2 1/2 cups chicken stock ( or half and half ) | 3 tablespoons cointreau liqueur
instructions: Place all ingredients into a saucepan. If you don't like cointreau, you can add a bit of honey or brown sugar to taste. Cover and simmer until cheese is completely melted. Remove from heat and serve.

Random Ingredients: seasoning salt,chicken breast,pimiento,bok choy,chicken wing,lettuce,romano cheese
title: Buffalo Style Chicken Rollups
ingredients: 2 tablespoons mrs. dash seasoning salt or 2 tablespoons other salt and pepper blend ( or other seasoning salt ) | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs chicken wings, cleaned | 1/3 cup pimiento, chopped | 1 romano cheese or 1 grated cheese | 4 pieces chicken breasts, cut in thirds horizontally | 2 bunches bok choy, cleaned and coarsely chopped ( large leaves picked from stems ) | lettuce ( optional ) or mixed greens ( optional )
instructions: Rinse chicken with cold water and pat dry with paper towel. Season chicken with salt and pepper blend in a blender or food processor until mixture is a smooth paste. Transfer mixture to bowl and stir in pimentos or cheese and romano cheese until evenly mixed. Tear off 4 large leaves of bok choy. Bring a saucepan of water to a boil. Using tongs, place 1 chicken breast in water.

title: Grill Halibut
ingredients: 12 ounces uncooked fresh linguine | 1 1/2 lbs halibut fillets | 1 can vegetable broth | 4 ounces frozen whipped topping, thawed | 1 tablespoon adobo seasoning | 1/4 cup chopped fresh mint leaves
instructions: Cook linguine according to package directions. Meanwhile, season fillets with adobo seasoning on both sides in a medium skillet over medium heat. Place halibut in the skillet. Pour vegetable broth and 2 cups of the water into the skillet. Cover.

title: Tortillas With Chicken, Spices & Weetabix
ingredients: 2 tortillas | 500 g boneless chicken thighs, halved crossways | 30 g weetabix | 2 teaspoons mustard seeds
instructions: Preheat the grill or chargrill fan. Wrap two pieces of greaseproof paper in a large piece of foil, double pleated, to make a double layer of foil. Place the chicken, join side down, on the centre of each tortilla, top with 1/4 tsp of sesame seeds. Wrap the parcel tightly to make a double layer of foil. Grill for 8 - 10 minutes, until charred and cooked through, turning once. Cut into strips. Serve hot or warm with dips or dips. Variation, add 1 tsp vegetable satay powder to oil or fat, or substitute other spices if desired.

title: Potato, Spinach and Cheese Strata
ingredients: 500 g white potatoes | 250 g baby spinach | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 400 g crisp rye bread
instructions: Peel and dice potatoes. Fry until golden. Mix all ingredients together in a pan. Heat but do not boil. Remove from heat.

Random Ingredients: tahini,hazelnut,brown gravy mix,picante sauce,creme fraiche,lemon,anise seed
title: Roasted Hazelnut Dip
ingredients: 1/2 cup hazelnuts ( skins removed ) | 2 tablespoons creme fraiche or 2 tablespoons sour cream, for drizzling | 1 can brown gravy mix | 1 jar picante sauce ( r-bush wonderful salsa wonderful salsa wonderful salsa ) | 2 tablespoons tahini ( for drizzling ) | 2 teaspoons anise seeds | 1/2 lemon, juice of | 1/2 lemon, zest of
instructions: Toast the hazelnuts in a skillet over a medium heat, stirring constantly, just until they brown. Immediately cool them under running water, shaking off any extra. Using a blender, process all the ingredients until all ingredients are combined. Transfer the dip to a bowl and sprinkle the hazelnuts on top. Serve chilled, or at room temperature. To make the topping, mix all ingredients, except the anise seeds, together in a food processor and blend well. Strain off the hazelnuts, discarding the skins. Spread the topping on the hazelnut dip.

Random Ingredients: white breadcrumb,cornstarch,thyme,seltzer water,rigatoni pasta,baby spinach leaf
title: Spinach With Thyme and Shellfish
ingredients: 1/2 lb rigatoni pasta | 7 ounces white breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 2 tablespoons thyme ( fresh & chopped fresh ) | 16 ounces baby spinach leaves | 1 -2 cup seltzer water
instructions: In a large pot of boiling, salted water, cook pasta until just tender.

title: Pistachio Pizzelle
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon espresso powder ( instant coffee cubes ) | 2 cups cold water | 6 tablespoons finely shredded pecorino cheese or 6 tablespoons parmesan cheese | 2 tablespoons finely shredded unsalted pistachios, or 2 tablespoons roasted salted pistachios
instructions: Place the espresso powder in a small bowl, pour the water on top, and set aside. Place the cheese in a small bowl, stir in the espresso water, and set aside. Place an ovenproof ramekin or a nonstick cooking pan on a flat surface. Heat the oven to 325 degrees f. Line the bottom of an ovenproof bowl with a silicone slab, or a silicone liner. Line the bottom and up the sides with the silicone slab. In a small saucepan, stir together the cheese and pistachios. Pour the coffee over the pistachios, or cover tightly and place in the oven. After 15 minutes, remove ramekin. Place the ramekin back on top of the baking sheet, place the rack in the oven and bake 40 to 45 minutes, until the top of the crust has darkened and the pizzelle is bubbly and the pistachios are golden.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom,mirin,bacon dripping,shrimp,chicken meat,salami,pesto sauce,spanish paprika
title: Paella
ingredients: 1/4 cup pork drippings | 2 tablespoons dry spanish paprika ( pimenton de la vera ) | 2 green cardamoms | 1 pound uncooked shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 pound skinless, boneless chicken meat, cut into strips | 1/4 pound cooked bacon drippings | 1/2 pound salami, cut into strips | 1 cup prepared pesto sauce | 4 ounces spanish paprika ( pimenton de la vera )
instructions: Heat pork drippings in a skillet over medium heat until the fat becomes very hot, and stir in the paprika. Crush pods with the back of a spoon, and spread on a rimmed baking sheet. Sprinkle with cardamom, and set aside. Heat a large skillet over medium heat. Add shrimp.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,meat,italian breadcrumb,scallop,ancho chile powder,pizza dough,yellow tomato,cashew
title: Quick Italian Spaghetti Sauce With Shellfish
ingredients: 1 jar fire-roasted yellow tomatoes, chopped ( about 3 cups ) | 5 ancho chiles powder | 1 lb cooked meat | 1 lb scallops | 1 lb pizza dough or 1 lb homemade dough, in patties | 1/2 lb chopped cooked italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon italian seasoned dry breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup roasted cashews ( optional )
instructions: Prepare sauce, bring to boil a small, large saucepan of water. Add tomatoes, anchos and chiles and cook on medium heat for about 5 minutes or until they are barely tender. Remove from heat, drain tomatoes and set aside. Meatballs, mix meat, crumbs, breadcrumbs, and seasonings until thoroughly moistened and blended. Preheat oven to 450°f. Roll out dough on lightly floured board. Using a 2 1/2 inch cookie cutter cut out 10 1/2 inch circles. Place 1 teaspoon pasta dough in the center of each circle. Top with 3 tablespoons of tomato mixture. Wedge sausage around sausage.

Random Ingredients: mustard,granny smith apple,taco seasoning,apple,nori,gouda cheese,cooking spray,green chile pepper
title: Fruit Tacos
