ingredients: cooking spray | 2 granny smith apples - peeled, cored and diced | 1 can diced green chile peppers, drained | 2 teaspoons seasoned salt | 1 tablespoon dry mustard | 2 packages taco seasoning | 2 ounces shredded smoked gouda cheese | 1 slice processed swiss cheese
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Heat a skillet over medium heat. Spray with cooking spray and place half of the apples in the bottom of the pan. Add half of the chile peppers and the seasoned salt. Sprinkle 2 teaspoons of dry mustard over the chile mixture and shake the pan to evenly distribute the vegetables. Pour half of the taco seasoning over and distribute remaining contents. Top with the 1 ounce of smoked gouda cheese. Lay top half of the apple slices evenly over the other half of the cheese. Bake in the preheated oven until the cheese is melted and beginning to brown, about 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: oriental flavor ramen noodle,sesame seed,spaghetti,currant,strawberry,topping,red food coloring
title: Noodle- Salad With Strawberries With Ramen
ingredients: 8 ounces spaghetti or 8 ounces linguine, uncooked | 1/2 cup dried currant | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 3 cups fresh thawed frozen thin whipped topping, thawed ( cool whip ) | 1 package oriental-flavor instant ramen noodles, broken up | 1/4 teaspoon red food coloring | 2 cups sliced fresh strawberries
instructions: Cook linguine according to package directions, until just tender. Drain well and set aside. Meanwhile, if using spaghetti, cover with cold water and set aside 30 minutes. Drain well. In a large bowl, toss together the drained and rinsed noodles, currants and seeds. Top with the thawed whipped topping, cover and chill 1 hour. Place the broken up ramen noodles on a large platter and arrange the strawberries over the noodles. Garnish with sesame seeds and serve.

title: Anise Currants
ingredients: 3 lbs large star anise | 2 lbs currants | 4 teaspoons mustard powder | 4 lbs corn oil
instructions: Preheat oven 350f. Cut a 5 inch cone shape slit down top 3/4 of anise. Remove the stems and cores. Place the currants in a sieve set over a bowl, and place a large dutch oven over low heat. Add dry mustard powder and currants to the sieve, and stir gently until any lumps have disappeared. Remove fruit and place seeds in a large ovenproof pan. Heat 1/2 inch of oil over med heat. When the oil is hot drop a large piece of the star anise into the oil, and immediately after, drop a second piece of star anise into the oil, and then drop a third piece into the oil. After all the pieces are in the oil, pour the oil mixture over the pieces of star anise. Bake 45 to 60 minutes until the pieces are golden and a little crisp. Serve hot with ice cream, cream or vanilla ice cream.

Random Ingredients: kidney bean,anise seed,tahini,sun tomato oil,green chili,serrano chilies,bamboo shoot,cumin seed
title: Chili Con Carne
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans | 1 green chili, deseeded and finely diced or 1 red poblano chili, deseeded and finely chopped | 1/2 fresh serrano chilies, deseeded and finely diced or 1 red chili, deseeded and finely diced | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon anise seed, a small dusting | 1/2 teaspoon whole cumin seed, a small dusting | sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and chopped | sliced bamboo shoot | freshly grated asian five-spice berry or cumin and flat-leaf parsley ( optional )
instructions: Drain the canned beans into a clean, clean glass, earthenware bowl or food storage container. Put all the ingredients in the order given under the heading of the recipe in order for them to be mixed so the ingredients are evenly distributed. Cover and keep in a dark place for at least 1 hour. Serve at room temperature. Store, tightly covered, in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

title: Chef John's Chocolate Corn Truffles
ingredients: 2 cans cream-style corn | 6 ounces dark chocolate, broken into pieces
instructions: Place cream style corn in the bottom of a 2 1/2 quart electric slow cooker. Melt chocolate in a heavy medium saucepan over low heat, stirring frequently, with a long match on the back of a wooden spoon until the mixture is smooth. Carefully pour chocolate onto corn, working with 1 teaspoon at a time, and carefully move it around so the chocolate coats the peanuts evenly. Spread the truffle mixture into a shallow bowl. With clean, damp hands, roll up the chilled chocolate and truffle until evenly coated. Chill the truffle truffles in the refrigerator until ready to serve. Store truffles in a dry, cool place in refrigerator until ready to serve. Once chilled, gently roll into a marble sized ball. Refrigerate truffles until serving time.

Random Ingredients: apricot,chicken meat,ra el hanout spice mix,jalapeno chile,tomato ketchup
title: Chicken and Apricots
ingredients: 1 lb chicken meat | 8 apricots, roughly chopped | 8 jalapeno chiles, sliced | 4 tablespoons tomato ketchup | 1 teaspoon ras el hanout spice mix
instructions: Place chicken, apricots and jalapenos on a baking tray. Roast at 475°f for 40 - 45 minutes. Stir well. Remove from oven. Stir in tomato ketchup. Sprinkle top with ras el hanout. Cover tightly and set aside at room temperature for 2 - 3 hours. Place the pan and contents of the pan on a burner and place over high heat. Cook for 4 - 5 minutes or until hot and bubbly.

title: Homemade Vietnamese Tea
ingredients: 1 tablespoon black tea, or other green tea | 1 cinnamon bark, or other piece of bark ( optional ) | 1/2 lime, juiced | 1 dash hot sauce
instructions: Pour tea into a glass or mug, and stir in cinnamon bark, lime juice, and hot sauce. The tea will absorb the lime juice, and the flavored flavor, but don't let it get completely diluted. Scoop into teacups, and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chile pepper,sesame oil,mini chocolate chip,tamari,italian seasoning
title: Timmered Mini Chilies
ingredients: 2 packages mini chocolate chips | 2 cans diced tomatoes with green chile peppers | 1 tablespoon sesame oil, divided | 1 teaspoon dried italian seasoning | 2 teaspoons tamari
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the mini chilies, diced tomatoes with green chiles, sesame oil, italian seasoning and tamari. Stir until evenly distributed. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until ready to use. To serve, remove the plastic wrap, add the remaining can of chiles and stir gently.

title: Smokin' Tasty Mushroom and Risotto
ingredients: 1 tablespoon instant rice | 2 cups water | 1/2 tablespoon curry powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons tamari | 1 cup portabella mushroom | 1 cup sour cream | 1/2 cup toasted slivered almonds meal
instructions: In a large pot over medium heat, stir together rice and water. Allow to come to a boil then reduce to low. Mix the curry powder, tamari and mushrooms into the pot. Cover and simmer for 5 minutes. In a small bowl, stir together sour cream and toasted slivered almonds. Remove mixture from heat, and stir into the rice mixture. Cover and let stand for 5 minutes to develop flavours. Serve straight away.

title: Tzatziki Dry
ingredients: 2 containers zesty tzatziki | 1 teaspoon garam masala powder | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Shake all ingredients until thoroughly mixed. Seal in a sterilized jar or sealable container.

title: Rosemary Vinegar
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dry white wine vinegar or 1 tablespoon white grape juice | 1/2 teaspoon coarsely crushed fresh rosemary | 1/2 cup fine dry breadcrumb
instructions: In small bowl, combine vinegar, rosemary and bread crumbs. Place in screwtop jar. Cover and shake well to mix. Press mixture into a greased 5 cup jar, pressing down on top of sugar. Keep stored in refrigerator.

title: Aunt Ann's Famous American Dessert
ingredients: 1/2 cup unsalted shelled pecans | 1 can condensed consomme | 1 cup rum ( preferably rum flavored ) | 1/2 cup grand marnier | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/2 cup finely minced pecans | 1/4 cup finely chopped blanched whole shelled pistachios | 1/8 cup grated toasted pecans | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 2 tablespoons smooth peanut butter | 1/8 cup grand marnier | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/8 cup finely chopped blanched whole shelled pistachios | 1/8 cup grated toasted pecans
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f. Spread the pecans over a baking sheet, and toast for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven. Turn off the heat, cover with a cloth, and cool, stirring occasionally. Remove the nuts, and spread out on a tray to cool completely. In a medium bowl, place the condensed consomme. Whisk in the rum, grand marnier, and dried oregano, and then pour over the cooled pecans. In a small bowl, combine the chopped shelled pistachios, the coarsely chopped blanched whole shelled pistachios, and dried oregano. Add the peanut butter, then mix well. Spread the filling evenly over the nut layer, and cover with more nuts, if desired. Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours, or overnight. When ready to serve, remove the cover, and spread the peanut butter mixture over the top, or as an garnish.

Random Ingredients: tea masala spice,fava bean,thyme sprig,green capsicum,oil,plum tomato,pear
title: Foul Mudammas
ingredients: 2 medium ripe pears, peeled coarsely chopped | 1 medium green capsicum, coarsely chopped | 4 plum tomatoes, quartered and seeded | 4 tablespoons oil | 1 teaspoon tea masala spices | 1 teaspoon thyme sprig | 50 g dried fava beans, cooked
instructions: Using a food processor, process the pears and capsicum until finely chopped, about 5 seconds. Alternatively, finely chop the pears and capsicum and place in a medium bowl or bowl. Add 2 tbsp water, the tomatoes and the remaining 1 tbsp water and season lightly with salt and pepper. Cover and refrigerate for one hour. Transfer the vegetable mixture to a large shallow non aluminium dish. Combine the oil, masala and thyme sprigs in a bowl. Spoon over the foul mince and season with salt and pepper. Cover the bowl and refrigerate until required. To make the gravy, boil the beans in a large pan of lightly salted water for 5 mins then drain. Heat the remaining tbsp of oil in a large saucepan. Stir fry the fava for 2 mins then add to the lentils. Drain the foulm and vegetables well and cook, stirring regularly, for about 5 minutes, until browned. Serve the moulm moulm and beans with the gravy poured over.

title: Microwave Yellow Pea and Pepper Stir Fry
ingredients: 1 package frozen green peas | 1 can green peas | 2 tablespoons catsup
instructions: Cook frozen green peas according to package directions. Drain peas and peas in a strainer. Combine all ingredients in a microwaveable bowl with a lid. Cover and microwave on high for 10 minutes, stirring twice. Serve with cooked rice, if desired.

title: Easy Low-Fat Vietnamese Egg Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup chives | 3 hard-boiled eggs | 1/2 cup light fish sauce | 2 tablespoons celery | 1/8 teaspoon mustard powder
instructions: Blend all ingredients, pour into a shallow bowl and chill. May be served chilled, room temperature or hot as the flavours improve.

Random Ingredients: cream tartar,kernel corn,dark brown sugar,phyllo pastry,french onion soup,garam masala,asiago cheese
title: Corn Phyllo Pie
ingredients: 3 cups frozen whole kernel corn | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 cup french onion soup | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar | 1/2 cup garam masala | 1 cup shredded asiago cheese | 10 sheets phyllo pastry | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Prepare pie shell. Combine corn, cream of tater and brown sugar. Mix well. Spray inside of shell with non stick cooking spray. Lay out one sheet of phyllo. Brush a little cream of tartar over pastry. Cover with another sheet of phyllo, brushing each with cream of tater and brown sugar mixture, and then lay down one sheet. Sprinkle with garam masala and top with one third of the corn mixture and one third of the asiago cheese. Repeat for another 9 sheets of phyllo. Carefully put out and spread half the remaining corn mixture over all of the pie. Take the phyllo and place in a 9x13 inch baking dish in the middle of the pastry. Top with the remaining 10 sheets of phyllo, and spread the remaining corn mixture over. Using a sharp knife, score into desired squares. Spread cream of tater over the top of the pie and bake in preheated oven for 30 minutes or until the edges are golden.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,prosciutto,grape tomato,ginger,red chili pepper flake,white pepper
title: Grap Tomatoes With Ginger and Jam
ingredients: 24 small grape tomatoes, halved | 3 slices prosciutto, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon ginger, peeled, chopped | 1 teaspoon red chili pepper flakes | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 1/4 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red chili pepper flakes
instructions: Place tomatoes in a medium bowl. Add prosciutto, ginger, chili pepper flakes, white pepper and dried chili flakes and toss to combine. Arrange tomatoes in an attractive 1 1/2 quart baking dish and drizzle with oil. Bake in a 325 degree oven for 20 minutes.

title: Quick Black Beans and Onions
ingredients: 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed | 1/2 spanish onion, minced
instructions: Open and rinse the black beans. Place the black beans in a serving dish. Cover with the onion. Cover the onion with water. Cover the pot and cook on low heat for 15 minutes, or until the onion is tender. Remove the pot from the heat and let it stand for 10 minutes. Stir the beans to mix.

title: Baby Backyard Burgersticks
ingredients: 2 ounces baby rocket | 4 large soft italian breadcrumbs
instructions: Place rocket on to a plate, add soft italian bread crumbs. Using a 1½ pound size fork, lightly crush the rocket. Pierce the bread in several places with the tines of a fork. Spoon crumbed base onto bunsticks and press lightly. Can refrigerate until required.

title: Moroccan Halva
ingredients: 1 1/3 cups confectioners'sugar | 1 teaspoon crushed cardamom seeds
instructions: Mix confectioners' sugar and cardamom seeds in a small bowl. Brush halva on an ungreased griddle. When lightly browned on the underside, turn over and sprinkle the sugar mixture onto the halva. Cook until lightly brown on both sides, about 1 minute. Remove from the griddle and let cool.

title: Noodles with pimiento
ingredients: 2 cans refrigerated noodles | 1 jar pimiento
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together mushrooms, pimento, and noodles. Serve.

title: Mexican Caramel Nachos
ingredients: 2 corn tortillas, cut into 1/4 inch wide strips | 1 1/2 tablespoons brown gravy mix | 2 tablespoons crumbled cotija cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place tortilla strips on cookie sheet. Spray with cooking spray. Bake in oven for 5 to 8 minutes or until light golden brown and crispy. Combine brown gravy mix and cheese, sprinkle over fried tortillas. Return to oven and bake for 3 to 5 more minutes or until cheese is melted.

Random Ingredients: coriander seed,garam masala,ha avocadoes,chili powder,monterey jack pepper cheese
title: Guacamole
ingredients: 2 hass avocadoes | 4 tablespoons fat-free garam masala | 1/2 teaspoon crushed coriander seed | 1/4 teaspoon chili powder | 8 ounces monterey jack pepper cheese, grated
instructions: Cut avocadoes in half and remove pit and white membrane. Scoop out the flesh from the flesh and discard. Using a very sharp knife, pit and mash the avocado until it is the consistency of cottage cheese. Stir garlic, chillies and coriander through the avocado. Transfer to an 8 1/2 x 6 in. Ramekin and top with cheese. Bake at 350 degrees f for 20 minutes or until lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: sherry wine vinegar,french vanilla ice cream,chili oil,cauliflower
title: French Vanilla Ice Cream With Cauliflower and Vanilla
ingredients: 300 g french vanilla ice cream | 1 head cauliflower | 1 tablespoon french vanilla ice cream | chili oil ( to taste )
instructions: Crush the cauliflower and mix it well with a tablespoon of rice wine vinegar. Blend the ice cream into a thick creamy sauce. Add a bit of chinese chili oil to taste and a bit of the vanilla ice cream to the sauce. Mix well. Serve chilled with a sweet chinese sweet chili sauce.

Random Ingredients: chicken broth,no boil lasagna noodle,green chilies,rhubarb,wild rice,vinegar
title: Rhubarb Mushroom and Chicken Linguica (No Boil)
ingredients: 1 package no-boil lasagna noodles | 1 package wild rice ( no boil ) | 1 cup diced rhubarb | 1/2 cup prepared mushroom and chilies blend ( not prepared ) | 4 -5 1 cup chicken broth or 4 -5 cups water | 4 -5 tablespoons vinegar
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. When rice is just about done, preheat oven to meanwhile, drain rhubarb, chop if you like, slice mushrooms, drain if not, but save some of the leftover rhubarb to stir fry. While rice is cooking, combine the sauce ingredients in a large saucepan or pasta pot. Heat through, stirring frequently. Dip the noodles into the saucepan, then immediately transfer into the prepared crockpot. Drain mushrooms once fully cooked. Pour the mushroom broth or water over the noodles, then add to the pot. Stir gently to mix. Do not stir or lift the lid during this time. Cook for 3 hours on medium temperature, until the noodles are tender.

Random Ingredients: cherry liquor,rotini pasta,flounder fillet,onion soup mix,arrowroot
title: Quick and Easy Baked Flounder
ingredients: 1 lb flounder fillet | 1 packet dry onion soup mix | 2 tablespoons cherry liquor | 2 cups rotini pasta | 1/2 tablespoon arrowroot
instructions: Preheat the oven to season the fish with salt. Combine the onion soup powder and the cherry liquor in a small baking dish. Place in the oven, cover and bake for 45 minutes. Cook pasta according to packet directions. Place pasta in a larger bowl than the fish and pour over the fish mixture. Sprinkle with arrowroot and serve.

Random Ingredients: chive,bailey irish cream,head broccoli,wonton wrapper,napa cabbage,coriander leaf
title: Irish Baked Dumplings (Golabki)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons coriander leaves, chopped | 4 tablespoons chives, chopped | 7 -8 wonton wrappers | 1 cup napa cabbage, shredded | 1 small head broccoli, chopped coarsely | 1/2 - 3/4 cup baileys irish cream
instructions: Soak wonton wrappers and cellophane dough in water for a few minutes. Bring a pot of water to the boil and add some salt. Separate cabbage, broccoli and coriander leaves. Cook until bright green. Drain and add cabbage and broccoli. Cook for a few mins and add the bailey's. Set aside. Roll out dough into a 5×6 inch rectangle. Seal with wonton wrapper. Repeat using remaining dough and vegetables. Place on cookie sheet and brush tops with water. Sprinkle with coriander and chives. Refrigerate for about an hour to firm. Cut into 1 inch cubes. Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Bake for about 15 minutes or until they rise and are nicely browned. Serve with guinness.

title: Madras Curry Vinaigrette
ingredients: 6 tablespoons madras curry powder | 8 tablespoons salad oil
instructions: Make the madras curry powder as per your favourite recipe. Add the salad oil in a jar of vinaigrette. Shake well. Serve on a plate and drizzle the vinaigrette over.

title: Spicy Kielbasa Mini Calzones
ingredients: 2 lbs kielbasa, sliced 1/2-inch slices | 1 can white mushrooms, drained | 1 jar apricot preserves | 1 package kielbasa | 0.5 can french-fried onions with pimento stuffed green peppers | 0.5 can english cucumbers, sliced | pizza crust
instructions: Heat pizza stone to 500 degrees f. Remove sausage from casing. Cook sausage in large skillet over medium high heat until no longer pink and juices run clear, about 5 to 8 minutes, breaking it up into small pieces with a wooden spoon. Reduce heat to low.

title: Corned-Up Chicken
ingredients: 4 large boneless chicken breast halves | 3 ounces oleo | 1 teaspoon onion salt | 1 teaspoon dried currants | 1 corned beef brisket
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Trim fat from chicken and discard. In a small saucepan, heat oleo. Add onion salt and currants and remove from heat. Set aside. Place brisket in roasting pan and pour oleo mixture over it. Place in preheated oven for 35 minutes.

Random Ingredients: olive oil,tomato paste,salt,brown mustard seed,spaghetti sauce,red chili,macaroni
title: Smoky Macaroni and Tomatoes
ingredients: 3 tablespoons olive oil | 1/4 cup brown mustard seeds | 1 pinch salt | 1 small red chili, very finely chopped, use a milder hot version | 2 tablespoons tomato paste | 1 1/2 cups macaroni, cooked | 1 jar spaghetti sauce, heat through
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan, add mustard seeds and salt, stirring once or twice, for 1 minute or until seeds are light brown. Add chili, tomato paste and cooked macaroni, stir quickly to combine. Turn heat down low. Cover and cook for about 10 minutes. Serve in a bowl with spaghetti around, with plenty of grated parmesan.

title: Homemade Ricard Sauce for Dipping or Pudding
ingredients: 150 g creme fraiche or 150 g sour cream | 150 g of homemade ricard sauce ( it should only be homemade ) or 150 g creme fraiche and 100 g of sour cream | 1 dash of powdered whisky or 1 dash of rum
instructions: Mix the creme fraiche/sour cream and rum together. Mix together the ricard sauce & sprinkle with powdered whisky, to taste. Keep in fridge till ready to use for flavours to develop. It gets so thick that it is thick enough to coat the back of a spoon. You can also use a spoon with a spout and a spoon to mix and let the texture hang. If you like a thicker sauce the longer you leave it in the fridge, the thicker batter will be.

Random Ingredients: cumin powder,irish whiskey,stew meat,dark red kidney bean,lime wedge,garlic paste,potato starch
title: Spicy Irish Stew (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 2 lbs stew meat, cubed | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 6 potato starch | 4 tablespoons dark red kidney beans or 4 tablespoons cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 3/4 cup irish whiskey ( preferably cabernet sauvignon ) or 3/4 cup stout beer | 6 lime wedges | garlic paste
instructions: Coat crockpot with nonstick cooking spray or butter lightly. Place meat in crockpot.

title: Aubergine Toasties
ingredients: 1 aubergine, chopped | 125 g chocolate sandwich style cookies, crushed ( like nuttelex ) | 1 egg, beaten | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1 teaspoon miso | 1 teaspoon cornstarch
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the first six ingredients. Heat a non stick frying pan or griddle over med high heat. Spread a tablespoon of the mixture onto each cut edge of a sandwich roll. Place the sandwich pieces onto the heated pan and cook for 5 - 6 minutes, until golden. Serve with jam.

title: Shannon's Shawarma Pita Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs flank steaks | 1/2 cup lime zest | 1/4 cup tahini | 1/2 cup fresh tomato juice ( or tomato sauce ) | 1/2 cup light pita bread | 1 carrot, julienned | 1/4 cup pecans, toasted
instructions: Combine zest and juice. Place in a plastic bag, add the meat and marinate for at least 2 hours, stirring occasionally. Heat pitas on a griddle until browned on each side. Cut meat across grain in very thin slices. Serve on warmed warmed pitas with sliced carrot, pecans and tahini sauce.

Random Ingredients: gruyere cheese,taco seasoning mix,onion,farfalle pasta,cherry,italian parsley,beef consomme,guacamole
title: Gruyere Cheeseburger
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground beef | 1/2 cup chopped onion | 1 cup shredded gruyere cheese | 3 tablespoons taco seasoning mix | 1 1/2 cups beef consomme | 1 cup guacamole | 1/2 cup chopped fresh italian parsley | 1 package farfalle pasta
instructions: Brown in a large skillet over medium high heat until no pink remains. Remove skillet from the heat. Add the onion and cook until golden, stirring to keep from burning the onion. Return the skillet to the heat and cook the cheese until browned, stirring constantly. Stir in the taco seasoning and beef consommé until well blended. Return skillet to the heat and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer until the cream just begins to thicken, stirring occasionally. Stir in the guacamole, parsley and cooked pasta. Cover and heat until the pasta is cooked. Note, if desired, sprinkle with grated parmesan cheese. A green and white salad can be served in an attractive, festive bowl next to the bowl with the cooked and hot pasta.

title: Vegetable Mince
ingredients: 600 g minced lean veal ( use good quality if veal mince ) | 1 tablespoon yoghurt | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon | 225 g mixed vegetables | 1 tablespoon walnuts, chopped
instructions: Add all the ingredients into a large frying pan. Cook over a low heat until the mixture looks dry. Serve with pita bread.

Random Ingredients: linguine,ramen noodle,chunky peanut butter,chocolate syrup,phyllo pastry,white fish
title: Baja Phyllo Fish Rolls
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs white fish, cut into 1 inch squares ( we used firm white fish ) | 12 sheets phyllo pastry ( i had a # # 6 brand ) | 1 tablespoon chunky peanut butter | 12 ounces linguine ( i had a # 6 brand ) | chocolate syrup ( to drizzle, i used a good one ) ( optional ) | ramen noodles ( if you don't have noodles ) ( optional ) ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Lay out 10 sheets phyllo and place them one at a time on a sheet pan. Repeat with each sheet. Spread a little bit of peanut butter on each phyllo sheet, and then spread the peanut butter evenly over the top. You want the phyllo edges to be covered, not too thick, but to make them firm. Repeat with the 3 next phyllo sheets, brushing each with oil and spraying each with oil. Take one phyllo sheet at a time, and place it over eachother, brushing with oil. Fold over the phyllo in half, and lay on parchment paper, or another sheet pan with about an inch from the edge of the pan. Make sure to make a roll, so that it doesn't stick together. Repeat with the 10 phyllo sheets. If you are adding a ramanaki, place the phyllo on top of the roll in a single layer, brush with oil before, and then roll. You want your phyllo pastry to stick together even if it is starting to stick together, and not overhanging. You want to end up with a roll that tears but doesn't break during baking. Bake for 25 minutes. Serve with chocolate sauce and a drizzle of chocolate syrup. Enjoy.

title: Quick and Easy Caribbean Brown Rice
ingredients: 1 -2 cup brown rice or 1 -2 cup white rice | 2 chicken bouillon cubes | allspice
instructions: Put all the ingredients into a rice cooker, rice cooker, or bowl. Do not shake it until cooked. If using a microwave safe bowl, do not leave it if using a microwave safe bowl do not leave it if using a microwave safe bowl. If using a nonstick pan, do not use the lid, because the steam from the fluffing will make the steam going off. Let stand for ten minutes to soak up all the water.

title: Mushroom Tea Bread
ingredients: 2 slices white bread | 3 tablespoons breadcrumbs or 3 tablespoons pine nuts | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme sprigs or 1 tablespoon dried thyme
instructions: Mix bread crumbs with the herbs. Put some crumb mix in the hollow of a bread loaf tin, buttered and slightly greased sides up with water. Put into oven at 180 degrees centigrade for 40 minutes or so.

title: Linda's Awesome Potato Salad
ingredients: 1 red potatoes, peeled and cut into wedges | 2 large fresh red potatoes, diced | 1 cup vegetable stock | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 1 teaspoon dried mixed italian herbs | 1 ounce whole-grain oats ( not instant ) | 1/4 cup extra-virgin olive oil or 1/4 cup unsalted butter, chilled & cut into slices 1-1/2-inch thick | 1 cup coarsely chopped unsalted pistachios
instructions: Cook & rinse the red & new potatoes in water with cold water. Drain potatoes & pat dry. Toss with the stock, salt, italian seasoning, 1/4 cup chopped pistachios, and 1 tablespoon of the oil. Cover & chill at least 30 minutes. Drain & cut into 1/2 3/4 inch dice. Just before serving, sprinkle with remaining pistachios & serve.

title: Seared Asparagus With Chiles
ingredients: 2 tablespoons pearl barley | 2 1/2 teaspoons semolina | 2 1/2 tablespoons sweetened roasted chiles | 5 heads trimmed asparagus, trimmed and cut crosswise into 1-inch-wide pieces | 1/2 cup chopped fresh mint leaves | 1/3 cup chopped fresh mint leaves | 1 lemon peel, for grating ( optional )
instructions: Mix the pearl barley, semolina, chiles, and 3/4 cup water in a large skillet over low heat. When bubbles appear on the surface, add the drained asparagus.

title: Lek, Canadian Bacon & Cardamom Puree
ingredients: 3 leeks | 1/2 cup canadian bacon | 10 cardamom seeds | 12 ounces heavy whipping cream | 1 fresh lemon, juice of
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Wash leeks and place in a non stick saute pan with about 2 - 3 tablespoons water. Place pan over medium heat and reduce heat to medium and fry the leeks till limp and translucent. While leeks are frying, in a bowl, gently mash the canadian bacon with the 10 cardamom pods, about 2 tablespoons per slice. Then squeeze out the cardamom pods and discard the other 10 whole pods. Now add it to the leeks and toss till blended and then place on counter. Whip cream and stir into leeks. Add salt and pepper to taste.

title: Baharat Aka Green Olive Dip
ingredients: 1 cup green olives ( drained, pitted & chopped ) | 1 tablespoon oil | 1 teaspoon paprika | 1 teaspoon curry paste ( heinz ) | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom ( ground ) | 1/2 teaspoon fish stock or 1/2 teaspoon anchovy fillet ( flaked in a mortar & pestle ) | 2 teaspoons rice vinegar
instructions: Blend oil, paprika, curry paste, cardamom, & stock. Add olives. Mix well before using. Stir in vinegar. Best served with chicken.

title: Mango Risotto
ingredients: 500 g basmati rice | 200 g carrots, peeled, sliced finely | 1 large ripe mango, peeled, cut into small cubes | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon | 1 large daikon radish, sliced thinly | 8 small pizza sauce ( commercial ) | 2 teaspoons fresh thyme, chopped
instructions: Sauté the rice, onion, carrot, mango and thyme in a non stick saucepan over a medium high heat for 12 minutes, stirring regularly, until the rice begins to colour and the ginger is beginning to come together. Add 5 cups of boiling water and stir in a cube of knorr cheese. Lower heat, cover and cook for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally until all the water has been absorbed. Serve the risotto, garnished with the remaining cheese.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,provolone cheese,monterey jack pepper cheese,flour tortilla,potato,fennel seed
title: Veggie Quesadillas
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups simply potatoes diced potatoes with onion | 1 1/2 teaspoons fennel seeds | 1 teaspoon knorr flour tortilla | 3/4 cup shredded provolone cheese | 1 1/2 cups monterey jack pepper cheese, grated | 1/4 cup kaffir lime leaf ( optional )
instructions: Heat 2 cups of instant potatoes in a nonstick skillet over medium heat, stirring occasionally until completely melted and heated through. Sprinkle 1 cup of the potato and onion mixture over the bottom of a quesadilla shell. Sprinkle with 1 teaspoon of the fennel seeds and 1 teaspoon of the knorr flour tortilla over all. Top each with shredded cheese. Top with the rest of the potato and onion mixture. Garnish with the lime leaves and additional fennel seeds if desired. Cover the pan and allow to heat over medium heat for 5 minutes. Use a spatula or spatula to flip the vegetables over and cook 3 additional minutes. Use a spatula or spatula to flip the quesadillas over. Cut into six wedges when warm.

title: Seared Pork Tuna With Tuna
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin | 1 teaspoon rice wine vinegar | 1 can tuna, drained | cayenne ( a pinch or two, if your fish isn't very salty )
instructions: In a large skillet, cook the tenderloin on high heat. When tenderloin starts to show some color, remove from heat and cool slightly for 5 minutes. Meanwhile, mix together the vinegar and water in a separate bowl. Add the rice vinegar mixture to the skillet, bring to a boil and cook, stirring constantly until thick and syrupy, about 5 minutes. Cut the pork into thin strips, serve with the tuna on the side. Try this recipe with any other tuna recipe you have i recommend adding a couple tablespoons of anchovy paste to this as well.

title: Asparagus Soup
ingredients: 1 lb asparagus, cut into 2-inch pieces | 8 ounces fresh water ( about one 14.5-ounce can ) | 1 3/4 cups chicken stock | 2 tablespoons chopped nuts | lime wedge
instructions: In a 5 to 6 quart dutch oven, combine asparagus, water, stock, nuts and lime juice to taste. Bring to a boil.

Random Ingredients: pineapple chunk,icing sugar,poblano chile,bean,red potato,chinese mushroom,spinach,deli roast beef
title: Roast Beef With Pork in Poblano Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb fresh chinese mushroom, sliced thick ( abut 1-inch ) | 4 -6 large poblano chiles, roasted, chopped - 1-inch | 1 can pineapple chunks | 2 poblano chiles, roasted, chopped - 1-inch ( optional ) | 6 slices deli roast beef, thin slices ( about 12-inches ) | 1/4 cup icing sugar, to drizzle | 1/2 cup fresh spinach, washed, packed and very well chopped | 10 large red potatoes, sliced 1/8 inch thick
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Place mushrooms, poblanos, pineapple chunks, chiles and beef slices on a large shallow ovenproof dish. Sprinkle evenly with icing sugar and toss well to evenly coat. Top with fresh spinach and red potatoes and bake until potatoes are just beginning to brown, about 20 minutes.

title: Chop-Papre de Chocolate
ingredients: 1 package milk chocolate | 1/2 cup capers, drained and rinsed | 4 pimento stuffed olives, drained and minced | 1 1/3 cups drained, rinsed, drained and minced fresh pimento stuffed olives | 1 can halibut, drained
instructions: Preheat an oven to 400 degrees f. Place the milk chocolate and capers in two 8x8 inch ovenproof bowls. Cover each with 1 olives and half the olives. Sprinkle evenly with 1/2 the pimento stuffed olives. Place the halibut slices on top of the pimento stuffed olives. Bake in the preheated oven until heated through and lightly browned, about 25 minutes.

title: Turnip Patties, Horseradish, and Pecorino Romano
ingredients: 1 -2 turnip, peeled and grated | 1 tablespoon finely grated pecorino romano cheese | 8 ounces plain non-fat greek yogurt | 1 tablespoon horseradish
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a bowl and mix together thoroughly. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Bring to room temperature before using.

Random Ingredients: stew meat,cream mushroom soup,black tea,kernel corn,gouda cheese,cumin,mustard seed,red wine vinegar
title: Crock Pot Irish Beef Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs stew meat, cut in 1 inch cubes | 1 1/2 cups sour cream | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 can whole kernel corn, drained | 2 cups chopped roasted sweet potatoes | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 2 teaspoons mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar
instructions: Spray crock pot with non stick cooking spray. Layer beef in crock pot. Mix remaining ingredients in bowl and pour over the beef. Cover and cook on low for 12 to 14 hours.

Random Ingredients: thyme sprig,chili pepper flake,salt,barbecue sauce,beef rib,walnut
title: Roasted Beef Short Ribs With Chili and Walnuts
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chili pepper flakes ( use less or adjust to taste ) | 2 teaspoons coarse salt | 4 lbs beef short ribs, with bone about 2-inch diameter ( about 7-10 ribs ) | 1/2 lb slivered walnuts ( about 1 cup sliced ) | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped fresh thyme sprigs or 1/4 cup loosely packed thyme | 3 cups store-bought barbecue sauce
instructions: In a small bowl mix 1 tablespoon of the chili pepper flakes and the coarse salt. Rub all over the ribs and place, covered, in a shallow roasting pan. In a small bowl, mix the remaining tablespoon of chili flakes with the remaining teaspoon of coarse salt. Pour over the ribs and turn to coat evenly. Cover and refrigerate for 24 hours. Preheat oven to 425°f. Roast ribs for 1 hour. Meanwhile, in a large skillet, combine the walnuts, a pinch of the thyme, remaining 1 teaspoon chili flakes and 1 cup of the barbecue sauce. Cover and cook over low heat, tossing occasionally, until walnuts are lightly browned, about 2 minutes. Transfer to a serving plate. Cover and chill until ready to serve, about 30 minutes. Remove the meat from the pan. Using tongs, remove all but 1 teaspoon of the drippings and scatter over the ribs. Spoon a little sauce over and around and around. Let stand until sauce is absorbed, about 10 minutes. Pour remaining sauce over the ribs and serve.

title: Cuban-Style Drunken Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf round-grain rice | 2 cans diced green chilies, undrained | 1/2 cup fresh lime juice | 1/2 cup dark rum | 1 cup sweetened flaked coconut | 2 tablespoons dried marjoram
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place the loaf of rice in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Stir the chiles, lime juice, rum, coconut, and marjoram together in a small bowl. Pour over the rice, and mix everything until well combined. Cover the dish with aluminum foil. Bake in preheated oven for 45 minutes, then remove cover and continue baking for a further 15 to 20 minutes, or until heated through and top is lightly golden.

Random Ingredients: carrot,active yeast,orange juice zest,coriander powder,lemongrass,linguine,chorizo sausage
title: Linguine With Chorizo, Carrot and Oranges
ingredients: 300 g linguine | 1 inch lemongrass ( white part only, 3-4 inches long ) | 1 orange, juice and zest of | 1 tablespoon coriander powder | 3 large carrots, peeled and cut lenghtwise into 1-inch thick rounds | 200 g chorizo sausage, sliced thinly | 1 bunch fresh coriander ( cilantro )
instructions: Boil water for pasta, then cook linguine in salted water for 10 - 15 minutes. Rinse and cook the chorizo on the same pan adding the ornaments at the table as you cook the pasta, lemongrass and orange. Drain the pasta and mix with the other ingredients.

title: Tarragon Steak With Asparagus and Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin, cut in to bitesize cubes | 30 asparagus, cut in 1 to 2 inch slices | 12 ounces mushrooms, thinly sliced | 4 ounces dried porcini mushrooms | 1 1/2 cups ranch dressing | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh tarragon
instructions: Place the sirloin cubes in a large plastic zipper bag or baking dish. Cover the meat with hot water by 1 inch and leave to marinate for 1 to 3 hours. Remove the meat and rinse under cold water to remove any accumulated moisture. Trim off some of the excess fat and excess fat. Place in a resealable plastic bag or baking dish. Remove the marinade from the refrigerator. In a small saute pan over medium heat, toast the shiitake mushrooms 5 - 8 minutes until softened. Deglaze with some of the reserved marinade. Remove the pan from the heat. Preheat broiler, and place the asparagus on a broiler pan rack 4 inch high. Place the sirloin cubes under the broiler or grill and cook about 8 minutes, turning once, or until beef is just cooked through. Remove to a serving platter. Toss the asparagus with the mushrooms, the reserved marinade, 1/2 cup of the ranch dressing, the tarragon and the remaining ranch dressing. Serve warm.

title: Spicy Dill Pickles
ingredients: 2 jars whole dill pickles, drained | 2 large fresh chili peppers, crushed | 8 sprigs fresh thyme
instructions: Place the dill pickles and chile in a large nonreactive saucepan or crockpot. Add water to cover. Cover, and simmer over low heat until the pickles are very tender, about 20 minutes. Uncover, and reduce the heat to low. Cook until pickles are dry and juicy, about 1 hour more. Remove the pickles from the crockpot using a slotted spoon, and set aside until cool. Remove chile stems and seeds. Place the pickles in a plastic freezer bag. Chop enough of the chile stems and chile into a small, bite sized ball. Transfer the pickles to a medium bowl, and stir in the thyme. Cover, and refrigerate for 2 days before serving.

Random Ingredients: egg yolk,spring onion,baby bok choy,tomato juice,serrano chilies
title: Gomae Yama (Bok Choi With Tomatoes and Spring Onions)
ingredients: 6 large eggs | 2 large spring onions, chopped ( spring onions, green onions ) | 2 tablespoons tomato juice | 2 tablespoons chopped serrano chilies | 12 baby bok choy ( leaves, about 10 inches long )
instructions: Combine the eggs and tomato juice in a large pan. Bring to a boil over high heat. Boil for 2 to 3 minutes, until the eggs are set. Remove the pan from the heat and stir in the serrano chiles. Set aside until cool. Meanwhile, steam the bok choy leaves, stems removed, for 3 to 5 minutes. Serve the vegetables immediately in mounds on the plates. Spoon the egg mixture over each mound of greens.

title: Blackened Steak With Kahlua Gravy
ingredients: 2 lbs beef round steak, trimmed of fat | 1 tablespoon oregano | 10 tablespoons crumbled feta | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 3 tablespoons kahlua | 3 tablespoons sherry wine
instructions: Place beef in a shallow baking dish. Combine oregano and feta in small bowl and pour over meat. Sprinkle on oregano and feta. Bake at 325f degrees for 2 hours and then serve with a nice sauce. Serve with rice, and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: cooking barley,french dressing,bean,monterey jack pepper cheese,purpose flour
title: Barley and Cheese French Dips
ingredients: 1 cup all-purpose flour | 1 cup quick-cooking barley | 2 cups shredded monterey jack pepper cheese | 1 can baked beans | 1 envelope french dressing
instructions: In a bowl or serving bowl combine flour and barley. Pour in cheese and beans. Stir in the french dressing until mixture is moistened. Cover and refrigerate 2 hours or overnight before serving.

title: Broiled Cheese With Olives
ingredients: 1/2 cup sharp cheddar cheese, shredded | 2 tablespoons fresh pitted black olives, chopped | salt | white pepper
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat. Combine the cheese and olives in a bowl. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Place on a baking sheet, and grill until bubbly, 2 minutes on each side.

title: Buttermilk Lefse
ingredients: 1 cup buttermilk ( do not substitute skim milk ) | 1 large strip lemon peel
instructions: Put buttermilk and lemon peel into a large bowl. Cover and chill for 4 hours. Transfer buttermilk mixture to an airtight container, cover, and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight.

Random Ingredients: red snapper,tomato green chile pepper,sesame seed,beef tenderloin,coriander,beef broth
title: Mexican Red Snapper
ingredients: 1 can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers | 2 pounds beef tenderloin, cut into 1 inch chunks | 1 can beef broth | 1/4 cup sesame seeds, or to taste | 1 whole coriander, crushed | 4 1/2 pounds red snapper, cut into pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Mix tomatoes with green chile peppers, beef broth, sesame seeds, and coriander in a bowl.

title: Hot Low Fat Chicken
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs | 1 large vidalia onion | 3 stalks lemongrass | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh lemongrass, leaves only | 2 tablespoons paprika | 1 can tomato juice or ( 32 ounce ) can cider vinegar | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 1 medium mango
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Cube onion and mince lemongrass. Cut chicken into bite sized pieces. Pound and seed mango. Cut into chunks. Place chicken, lemon grass, onion and paprika into large baking dish. Pour tomato juice over all. Cover and bake 40 minutes or until juices run clear. Mix soup mix and mango juice. Pour over chicken. Bake uncovered 10 to 15 minutes longer. Add mango chunks and cover. Bake 5 minutes longer. Serve with steamed veggies.

Random Ingredients: pesto sauce,great northern bean,chicken thigh,poppy seed,cocoa powder,tuna,white pepper powder
title: Pesto Stuffed Chocolate Chicken Thighs
ingredients: 1 can tuna ( drained or extra virgin ) | 1 can great northern beans ( drained and rinsed ) | 2 tablespoons poppy seeds | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper powder ( to taste ) | 500 g chicken thighs | 1 tablespoon cocoa powder | 5 tablespoons pesto sauce
instructions: Combine beans, tuna, poppy seeds, and pepper powder and set aside. Pour pesto into a clean glass bowl or other small bowl. Coat chicken pieces with this pesto, if necessary. Place chicken onto plastic wrap and flatten out slightly. Place pieces onto foil lined cookie sheet. Paint chicken with pesto, cover, and refrigerate 24 hours or overnight. Preheat oven to 300 degrees heat up a large heavy skillet over high heat until a drop of water sizzles on the surface. Brush olive oil over skillet, place chicken in skillet, and cook for approximately 15 minutes or until cooked through. Transfer to a baking dish and set aside. Bake meat and bake for another 20 minutes, stirring every 10 minutes. When meat, skin and bone are tender, return chicken to baking dish, and bake for another 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,celery,tamari,turbinado sugar,peanut oil vegetable
title: A Perfect Simplest Basic Caramel Sauce for Salads
ingredients: 30 ml light tamari | 15 ml turbinado sugar or 15 ml raw sugar | 300 ml heavy whipping cream | 60 ml peanut oil or 60 ml vegetable oil | 100 -200 g finely chopped celery
instructions: In a large skillet heat the oil on medium heat. When the oil is hot add the vegetables. Saute them on medium high heat until they are cooked to your taste. You may add a little water, but be careful when adding the water it will splatter when heated. Make sure the vegetables are not too soft. Add the tamari to the skillet and mix it well so there are no lumps in the mixture. Then add the sugar. Pour the cream onto the vegetables. Let it boil on medium high heat for 10 minutes. The cream has the texture of caramel sauce. The tamari should slowly begin to thicken to form a creamy, white sauce.

Random Ingredients: pinto bean,pearl barley,lemon juice,ricotta,simple syrup,button mushroom,tomato juice,cinnamon
title: Low Fat Barley & Ricotta Beans
ingredients: 1 cup pearl barley, washed | 1 lb pinto beans, drained | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1 cup low-fat ricotta ( low fat or no fat cottage cheese ) | 2 cups tomato juice | 1 lemon, juice of | 1 tablespoon simple syrup | 2 button mushrooms, sliced
instructions: Combine barley, beans, cinnamon, tomato juice, lemon juice, and simple syrup in a non reactive slow cooker. Stir well with a wood or metal spoon. Set the slow cooker on low, cover, and cook for 3 to 4 hours, or until beans are tender and barley is creamy. When ready to serve, stir in mushrooms, and serve.

Random Ingredients: bicarbonate soda,beef brisket,tabasco sauce,brandy,tomato green chilies,grand marnier,red capsicum,yellow bell pepper
title: Stampede Brisket (Brisket of Beef)
ingredients: 450 g beef brisket, trimmed, washed, rinsed and patted dry | 2 tablespoons brandy | 1/4 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 2 tablespoons grand marnier or 2 tablespoons triple cream | 1/4 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1 tablespoon chopped canned tomato and green chilies | 1 tablespoon chopped red capsicum ( bell pepper ) | 1 tablespoon chopped yellow bell pepper
instructions: In a small bowl stir together the brandy, soda, grand marnier or double cream, hot sauce and tabasco. Briskly rub the meat with 2 tblsp of the brandy mixture. Place on a plate and cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate the meat for 2 hours or overnight. Remove the meat from the marinade, pat dry, and slice into strips. Place the meat on a baking sheet. Refrigerate the meat uncovered for 45 minutes. Turn the meat over and return to the baking sheet. Spread the remaining brandy mixture on the meat. Preheat broiler. Dissolve the bicarb in the remaining 1/2 cup of brandy mixture.

title: Couscous Tikka
ingredients: 200 g couscous | 1 cube steak, cubed
instructions: Soak the couscous in lukewarm water for 15 - 20 minutes. Meanwhile, pour the couscous into a large heatproof bowl and add the cube of steak. Add the steamed couscous.

Random Ingredients: turmeric,white wine,bay leaf,baby carrot,ice cube,white bean,date
title: White Beans (Fusilli Ripieneal)
ingredients: 10 large baby carrots | 15 dates | 3/4 cup small white dried white beans ( i use lima beans ) | ice cube | 1 pinch turmeric | 3/4 cup dry white wine | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Put the carrots and bay leaf in cold water to cover and bring them to a boil. Remove as soon as the carrots are tender and rinse well in cold water. Drain and remove as much of the water from them as you can and pat dry. Cut lengthwise into halves again and cut further down lengthwise. Cut the dates in half horizontally so they will stand up. Set aside. Soak the beans in very cold water about 15 minutes and drain. Put the sugar, tomatoes and water they soaked in in at least one cup to just cover the beans. If it is too cold, add sugar to taste, otherwise you need to make these a day ahead. Bring to boil and boil rapidly for another 5 minutes while constantly stirring. Pour out into colander and transfer to bowl using strainer. Tie off two sets of kitchen twine. Add the dates and turmeric to the pot. Cook over low heat for at least one hour, stirring occasionally. Remove and discard the bay leaf. When completely cold, use a ladle or cheese cloth to press the mixture against the side of colander. The mixture will stick to the cloth if it hits your hand. The idea is that this will stop the mixture sticking to your hands and also make it easier to remove when removing the mixture. The mixture will not be a wet pulp or dry.

title: Slow Cooker Beef Tips and Pasta
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef stew meat | 1 can sweetcorn, drained | 1 jar picante sauce | 1 pkg penne pasta, cooked
instructions: Place in large 4 quart slow cooker crock. Add remaining ingredients and stir together. Cover. Cook on low for 8 hours.

title: Stir-Fry Primavera
ingredients: 1/4 cup dry quinoa | 1 1/2 cups italian-style tomatoes with puree | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 1 1/2 lbs asparagus, trimmed ends and cut int 1 inch pieces | 1 lb mixed and sliced cucumbers | 2 tablespoons parsnips, diced ( about 1 medium ) | 3 tablespoons lard, preferably crisco | 1 can beans or ( 16 ounce ) can cannellini beans, drained
instructions: Stir the dry quinoa, tomatoes with puree, and corn oil in an 11 to 12 inch nonstick skillet over medium heat until most of the water has evaporated, about 5 minutes. Stir asparagus, cucumber, parsnips, and lard in a large bowl, and set aside. Return the heat to medium high. Add the asparagus mixture to skillet. Reduce heat to medium.

title: Stove Top Steak Sandwich (21 Day Wonder Diet:day 1)
ingredients: 2 -3 slices white bread | 1 slice lean steak | 2 slices lean ham ( lean deli ham may be used as a substitute ) | 1 teaspoon grainy mustard ( vegetarian-flavoured bread may be used as a substitute )
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium. Place the cheese slice on 2 or 3 slices of bread. Place the steak, ham, and mustard together in a square shaped slice of bread. Top with the cheese slice.. Turn the sandwich two or three times so that the meat mix cooks right through to the bread slices.

title: Pepper Onion Cottage Pie
ingredients: 1 lb parsnip, peeled and chopped | 1/2 cup mineral water | 2 1/2 ounces canned espresso, such as espresso powder | 1/4 cup plain flour | 2 tablespoons instant skim milk powder | 8 ounces low-fat cheddar cheese, shredded or grated ( optional ) | fresh ground pepper
instructions: Place parsnips in a heavy saucepan. Pour in mineral water until almost completely covered. Remove from heat. Cover and set aside. Place espresso powder in a small bowl. Pour hot water over in the bowl, slowly stir until all the froth and foam is removed from the espresso powder. Stir in the milk powder until dissolved. Stir in the parboiled parsnips. Preheat oven to 180°c. Grease 24cm round removable base and 1 deep loose bottomed non stick cake tin or 2 deep, flat edged cake tins. Pour hot soaking liquid into prepared pan. Place on baking tray. Bake for 30 minutes or until edges have begun to brown. Cool slightly, then turn out from tin. Serve warm topped with cheese and freshly ground pepper.

Random Ingredients: orange zest,bulgur,madeira wine,celery,extra tofu,green onion,palm sugar,artichoke heart
title: Tofu Bulgur Salad
ingredients: 1 package extra firm tofu, drained and cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 2 tablespoons red palm sugar or 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 1/2 cup dry madeira wine or 1/2 cup marsala wine | green onion, chopped | 1/2 cup thinly sliced celery | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | 1 orange, zest of | 1/4 cup grated fresh orange zest
instructions: Place tofu cubes in a large bowl, sprinkle with palm sugar and toss to coat. Add the madeira or marsala and stir to combine. Pour over tofu, onion, celery, artichoke hearts and add the zest, grated orange zest and 1/2 cup water. Refrigerate until cold, about a hour. Toss again before serving.

Random Ingredients: cooking oil,vanilla sugar,celery,hoisin sauce,date,whiting fish fillet,key lime
title: Hoisin-Fish With Dates
ingredients: 16 fresh dates, chopped | 1 tablespoon dried celery, cut in short, 1-inch pieces | 1/3 cup hoisin sauce | 1 tablespoon unsalted butter | 1 tablespoon vanilla sugar | 2 teaspoons cooking oil | 1/2 cup freshly grated strong whipping cream or 1/2 cup good whipping cream
instructions: In a large bowl, combine dates, celery and hoisin sauce. Soak dates mixture in hot water 10 minutes. Drain well. Heat in heavy small frypan over low to medium high heat, stirring occasionally. When mixture is warm, stir in butter, vanilla sugar and sugar. Cook until mixture is hot and bubbly. Pour into serving dish. Sprinkle topping over cooked dates. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Lucky Leprechaun's Crystal Sugar Cookies
ingredients: 4 cans refrigerated biscuits ( with wrappers ) | 3 1/2 cups crystal sugar ( or 3 3/4 cups confectioners'sugar ) | 5 -6 cups sugar | 3 -4 cups crystal sugar ( or 3 3/4 cups confectioners'sugar )
instructions: Separate dough into 2 pieces. Separate biscuits to make a flat surface, and divide each biscuit into a 1/2 inch thick round. Press a 1/4 to 1/2 inch thick circle of sugar into the center of the circle. Place circles in the freezer for about 10 - 12 minutes. While the biscuits are frozen, prepare the rest of the cookies while they are frozen. When sugar is set, break apart biscuits and dip into 2 - 3 tablespoons of the sugar, until lightly toasted. Place onto waxed paper or parchment paper. Refrigerate until set. Remove cookies from freezer and place on greased cookie sheets. To sprinkle candies, put a 1/2 teaspoon of sugar into 2 or 3 cookies, and roll into 1 balls. Bake at 350 just until crackers are browned, about 8 to 10 minutes. Cool cookies on a wire rack.

title: Orange Cashew Spread
ingredients: 1/4 cup cashews | 1 mandarin orange, peeled, chopped | 1 tablespoon margarine, melted
instructions: Combine cashews and mandarin orange in a large bowl. Stir in margarine, and spread into a large casserole dish. Cover, and refrigerate 8 hours or overnight.

title: Simple, Healthy and Elegant Black Olive Noodle
ingredients: 8 ounces bean threads noodle | 2 ounces black olives, chopped | 4 ounces beer
instructions: Start with the noodles. Pour the beer on top of your drained noodles and put into the grill until the top turns a light golden brown. Serve with vegetables and sour cream on the side.

Random Ingredients: white wine,pork sparerib,shallot,red pepper flake,ra el hanout spice mix,beef broth
title: Moroccan Pork Spareribs Recipe
ingredients: 1 bottle good quality beef broth | 3 lbs pork spareribs, cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes | 1 cup white wine | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons ras el hanout spice mix | 1 shallots or 1/2 large onion, chopped
instructions: Add beef broth, pork spareribs and white wine to a 4 qt crockpot. Stir together and turn on low heat setting until pork is very tender. Remove spareribs from pot and stir. Turn on stove until all the spareribs are in the pot. Then turn on medium heat setting. Sprinkle ras el hanout, crushed red pepper and shallots over and around the meat. Return to low heat and cover. Set oven to 375 degrees f. Cook covered for 35 - 45 minutes. Remove from oven and let stand for 5 - 10 minutes. You may also wish to place a piece of foil for the last 15 minutes of cooking time to prevent ribs getting too brown. Slice and serve over cooked rice. Garnish with fresh parsley or coriander.

title: Chinese Noodle Stir Fry
ingredients: 200 g noodles ( cellophane, small variety ) | 1 sliced green capsicum | 2 sliced pickled ginger | 1 teaspoon peppercorn, crushed
instructions: Place the noodles in a saucepan of boiling water and leave to simmer. Heat up the wok, add the oil and when hot add the capsicum and leave to soften. Add the ginger and a few crushed peppercorns. Stir fry for 1 minute, add the noodles and toss for further 2 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Baja Fried Ziploc Steam
ingredients: 3 packages pillsbury refrigerated limeade concentrate | 2 cups ice | 1 cup flour
instructions: In a large heavy duty zip top plastic bag, add 1 can of frozen limeade. Add 1 - 1 1/2 to 2 cups of ice. Place bag on top of a large bowl of ice, seal bag and shake vigorously. This ice is needed because of the limeade. Repeat with remaining ice, limeade, and ice in bag.. Use a slotted spoon to remove ziploc bag contents from freezer and place on the ice lined plate, leave at least a half inch of space between slices. Microwave on medium high power for 3 to 4 minutes until ziploc is solid and slushy. You can do this in 2 batches, transferring the ziploc to a plastic bag and turning it over halfway through. Repeat with remaining ziploc and ice. If you don't have 2 bags, freeze the ziploc bags in a freezer bag. Makes about 8 - 9 servings.

Random Ingredients: pear,fine bread crumb,sunflower seed,pork loin chop,asparagus,sesame seed,salmon steak
title: Pear and Asparagus Pan-Seared Pork with Asparagus
ingredients: 4 pork loin chops, fat trimmed | 1 cup fine dry bread crumb | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 2 tablespoons sunflower seeds | 1 pound fresh asparagus, cut into 2 inch pieces | 3 pears - peeled, cored and sliced into 1 1/2 inch wedges | 4 pork steaks
instructions: Trim chops of excess fat and cut into 1 inch squares or 1 inch cubes. Combine bread crumbs, sesame seeds, sunflower seeds, and asparagus in a small bowl. Toss with chops and marinate in refrigerator 30 minutes. Preheat grill for high heat. Place pork on greased lightly oiled grill and cook until lightly browned, about 4 minutes per side. Cut asparagus spears diagonally into 1 inch pieces.

Random Ingredients: active yeast,worcestershire sauce,broth,portabella mushroom,chili bean,icing,red bell pepper,margarine
title: Portabella and Red Bell Pepper Mini Pretzels
ingredients: 1 packet active dry yeast | 3 1/2 cups warm broth | 1/2 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 6 medium portabella mushrooms, sliced | 1/2 red bell pepper, diced small | 1 -2 tablespoon margarine, finely diced | 1/2 cup icing | chili-garlic sauce ( optional )
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm broth in a bowl. Scald and cool to lukewarm. Rinse and drain mushrooms. Rinse and slice bell pepper small. Set aside. Melt margarine in a 10 inch nonstick skillet over medium high heat.

title: Simple N' Easy and Yummy Irish Brown Bread!
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups whole wheat porridge oats ( quick baking ) | 1 - 1 1/2 cup steel cut oats ( quick baking ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin seeds | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried lentils or 1 1/2 cups brown rice
instructions: Mix all the ingredients and put in to a greased 1 - 1 1/2 quart baking dish with a lid. Cover with foil and bake at 350 degrees for about 45 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Hot Fruity Cherry Dessert Appetizer
ingredients: 16 ounces dried apricot preserves | sweet cherry ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Cut the cherry in half and then into quarters. Remove stem and pits. Wear plastic gloves for this preparation because of the high quality smell. Use any flavor tart that you like. Place the cherry pieces into a glass or ceramic dish or serving dish and layer in the following order, half the apricot preserves, one tablespoon of sweet cherries, one more half of the apricot preserves, and one more tablespoon of sweet cherries. Repeat the previous layers until the fruit is gone. Refrigerate for at least 24 hours. Serve on a decorative platter for a decorative dessert.

Random Ingredients: olive oil,parmigiano reggiano cheese,extra beef,spinach leaf,couscous,gruyere cheese,tangerine,red wine vinegar
title: Beef Tangerine and Spinach Salad
ingredients: 2 tangerines | 7 ounces extra lean ground beef | 3 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 3 tablespoons olive oil | 10 ounces spinach leaves | 2 ounces shriped gruyere cheese | 5 tablespoons freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/4 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Cut off and discard the stem ends of the tangerines. Cut the flesh into 4 pieces, removing the peel and white membrane. Halve the segments and finely chop the flesh. Place the tangerines into a small skillet over low heat, and warm the fat in a small saucepan until very hot. Drop the pieces into the hot fat skin side down, and cook until they are slightly softened, just a couple of minutes. Turn the pieces over and cook the other side. Remove the tangerines from the pan and place on the paper towels to drain off excess fat. Peel all of the pith around the inside of the tangerines then slice into thin strips. Toast the pineapples and let them cool and dry. Cut the flesh into strips about the width of the tangerines. In a large nonreactive bowl, mix the ground beef with the tangerine peel, vinegar, and half of the olive oil. Add the spinach, gruyere cheese, and 1 cup of parmigiano. Add tuna and toss lightly to combine. Sprinkle with the remaining parmigiano and mix well. Cover, and refrigerate until serving time.

title: Orange Radish Broccoli
ingredients: 2 bags of green asparagus soup | 1 orange | 2 packages cream of asparagus soup
instructions: Prepare asparagus. Cut up the radish. Put all of the ingredients except the cream of asparagus soup in a large bowl. Mix till smooth. Put on broccoli. Cook till vegetables are cooked.

title: Blue Cheese and Mushroom Dip
ingredients: 4 ounces yoghurt | 1 can condensed golden mushroom soup | 1/3 cup refried beans | 1/3 cup tahini | 1/4 cup shredded blue cheese | 2 tablespoons marinara sauce
instructions: In an oven proof bowl, pour in the yoghurt and mix. Dump in the soup, beans, tahini and remaining ingredients. Mix all this mixture well. Cover with foil. Bake at 350 for 40 minutes or until hot.

title: Cheese De Beis (Authentic Mexican Cheese Fondue)
ingredients: 1 lb monterey jack cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup dark rum
instructions: In a pan combine cheese in a single layer. Mix with a wooden spoon until melted. Add rum to taste. Serve with white rice, warm tortillas or chilled pasta.

Random Ingredients: wide egg noodle,bamboo shoot,leek,salt black pepper,white pepper,chipotle powder,rice
title: Torta di Le Noci (Noodle and Vegetable Soup)
ingredients: 4 liters water, enough to cover | 1/2 cup rice sticks | 1 1/2 tablespoons salt and black pepper, or more to taste | 3 tablespoons dried chipotle powder | 5 leeks, white part only, sliced into half-moons | 3/4 cup bamboo shoot, sliced into half-moons | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper, or more to taste
instructions: Place the rice sticks in large bowl. Pour in enough cold water to cover the noodles, and place a plate over the top of the bowl so that some of the water can drain. Let soak, about 2 hours. Pour in enough water to cover the noodles, and season with salt, black pepper, chipotle powder, and leeks, if using. Cover bowl, and refrigerate for at least 3 hours. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil, and spray with nonstick cooking spray. Bake in the preheated oven until the noodles are tender and the water has mostly evaporated, about 45 to 60 minutes. The dish should smell like caramelized marshmallow cream.

Random Ingredients: mango chutney,horseradish sauce,canadian bacon,orange zest,orange,lemon pepper,cheese tortellini,vodka
title: Cheese Wrapped Bacon and Smoked Mocktail Pasta Salad With Mango Chutney
ingredients: 20 ounces cheese tortellini | 4 -6 cups shredded smoked canadian bacon | 4 ounces smoked canadian bacon, cut into 1/4 inch pieces | 1 tablespoon minced orange zest | 1/4 cup fresh lemon juice or 1/4 cup lime juice | 1/4 cup prepared horseradish sauce | 1 tablespoon grated orange zest | 2 tablespoons mango chutney or 2 tablespoons sour cream
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the tortellini 5 - 8 minutes, until just tender, stirring a few times. Drain the pasta in a colander and rinse under cold water with cold water until the pasta is cool. Combine the pasta, bacon, Canadian bacon pieces, orange zest and juices, horseradish sauce, orange zest and mango chutney in a large bowl and toss well. Serve.

title: Beef With Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs boneless beef chuck, trimmed of excess fat | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cumin | 8 cups brussels sprouts ( about 10 cups ) or 8 cups kale ( about 10 cups ) | 1 - 1 1/4 cup bottled or bottled lime wedge
instructions: Trim off excess fat from beef. Cut into 3/4 inch cubes. Sprinkle meat with salt and pepper and sprinkle with cumin. Place in a 6 cup resealable plastic bag. Add brussels sprouts or kale. Close bag securely and seal. Turn meat to coat evenly with oil. Marinate, refrigerated, turning bag once, in a 5 to 6 quart pan, covered with foil, for 3 to 4 hours in refrigerator. Prepare bbq or preheat broiler. Remove meat and vegetables from bag. Remove vegetables from bag. Discard marinade. Wrap tightly and freeze. Cook, turning bag over once, in a 5 to 6 quart pan over medium high heat, stirring constantly, until meat is well browned, 5 to 10 minutes. Sprinkle with remaining cumin and return to a simmer. Cover and cook until meat is fork tender, about 1 hour. Uncover, remove lid, add reserved marinade and stir. Cook about 5 minutes until steaming hot. Serve meat on warm, baked potatoes.

title: Yummo Japanese Noodle Cake for Sushi
ingredients: 2 cups self rising flour | 1/4 cup rice noodles, soaked in warm water | 2 tablespoons baking powder
instructions: Sift flour and baking powder together. Drain soaking rice, then drain. Combine soaked rice, noodles, and baking powder. Add enough water to dough to make a fairly dry dough. Turn onto floured surface, knead a few times to make a smooth dough that you can handle. Line baking sheet with parchment paper, and brush generously with oil. Cover with a tea towel, and let rest for 30 minutes. Preheat oven for 350 degrees f. Roll dough into a 1/2 inch thickness log. Wrap in parchment paper, and cut into 3 inch lengths. Slice diagonally into desired lengths. Place on baking sheet and bake for 25 minutes, reducing oven temperature to 200 degrees f when baking. Serve hot, warm, or chilled.

Random Ingredients: creamy peanut butter,peanut butter,lemon,corn flake,fennel,quinoa,chili oil
title: Spiced Fennel and Lemon Quinoa
ingredients: 1 tablespoon corn flakes | 1 tablespoon unsalted dry roasted peanuts | 1 tablespoon peanut butter | 1 teaspoon lemon rind ( grated ) | 1 teaspoon lemon ( zest and grated ) | 1/4 teaspoon dried fennel ( chopped ) | 2 tablespoons creamy peanut butter | 1 teaspoon chili oil | 2 1/2 cups raw quinoa
instructions: Combine the corn flakes with the peanuts. In a small bowl, combine the other ingredients and season with salt and pepper. Add to the corn flakes, mix and add 1 cup water to the quinoa. Heat the oil in a non stick skillet over medium high heat and pour the mixture into the pan. Turn the heat down and fry the quinoa for 2 minutes, stirring constantly. When quinoa is about half cooked, stir in the creamy peanut butter, chili oil and fennel. Heat until warm and serve.

Random Ingredients: brandy,beef chuck roast,chili,baking soda,almond paste,havarti cheese,guacamole,chili oil
title: Aussie Beef With Nuts
ingredients: 1 boneless beef chuck roast | 1 1/2 teaspoons baking soda | 1/2 cup chili oil | 1 ounce almond paste ( about 1/2 large ) | 2 ounces soft lindt brandy | chopped chili, to your taste | 1/2 cup guacamole, to your taste | 1/2 cup havarti cheese
instructions: Trim excess fat from roast. Trim any visible fat off roast and cut in about 2 inch cubes. Sprinkle with baking soda and place in a 5 - 6 quart slow cooker. Combine chili and oil and pour over meat. In a blender, combine almond paste, brandy, chili oil mixture and cheese and blend until smooth. Spoon half of mixture over meat. Cover and cook on low setting for 7 - 8 hours or on high setting for 5 - 6 hours, until meat is tender and thoroughly cooked. Serve on bed of hot cooked rice and garnish with toasted green onion flakes and julienned avocados, if desired.

title: Fish Balls
ingredients: 12 frozen battered cod, thawed and drained | 1 1/4 cups cracker crumbs, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Line the baking sheet with aluminum foil. Cut a 1/2 slit down the center of each frozen cod fillet, leaving the top shell intact. Place fish in a bowl with 2 tablespoons cracker crumbs. Spread fish in the prepared baking sheet. Repeat layering, using remaining mixture to make 12 to 14 fish balls. Arrange fish balls close together on the prepared baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until fish is firm and fish is easily flaked with a fork, about 20 minutes.

title: Quick and Easy Fruit Salsa
ingredients: 1 mango - peeled, seeded, and diced | 1 cup chopped pecans | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning
instructions: Mix diced mango, pecans, and taco seasoning together in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese,red onion,beef tenderloin,chili sauce,italian sausage link,extra virgin olive oil
title: Stuffed Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 2 lbs beef tenderloin | 8 ounces beef hot italian sausage links | 4 leaves of sweet italian sausage thread | 5 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1/4 cup sweet chili sauce | 1/2 cup shredded cream cheese | 1/4 cup red onion, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. On a cutting board, cut a cross in the top of tenderloin lengthwise from all the way through the meat. Use a knife to open out the length of the beef, and pull out the meat's thickness, leaving about 1 inch of the meat attached to the meat. Using a spoon, scoop out the meat meat meat.

title: Portobello Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 package white button mushrooms | 6 tablespoons hot pepper sauce | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Wipe mushrooms thoroughly with a damp cloth. Cut out the hard stem part of the capsars. Cut caps off and discard the hard stems. Wash well and remove the hard stems attached to the mushroom stems. Reserve the capsars for a second use and leave the capars uncovered. Place the mushroom caps on a heat proof platter or cookie sheet. Combine the pepper sauce and ground nutmeg and pour over the capsars. Sprinkle with the reserved capars. If desired, lightly sprinkle the top with white onion salt and paprika.

Random Ingredients: italian salad dressing,soy sauce,shortening,cannellini bean,honey,american cheese
title: Tasty White American Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 lb drained cannellini beans | 2 slices white american cheese | 3 tablespoons butter or 3 tablespoons margarine, softened | 1/2 teaspoon honey | 1/4 cup italian salad dressing | 2 teaspoons soy sauce ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour into a lightly greased casserole dish. Bake at 350°f until hot and bubbly, about 10 - 15 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Orange-Liqueur Steak
ingredients: 12 beef chuck steaks | 1/2 cup orange flavored liqueur
instructions: Pour orange liqueur into a resealable plastic bag. Add the steak, turning to coat. Seal the bag and refrigerate in the refrigerator for 1 to 3 days, turning the bag every so often. Cook the steaks over hot coals for about 7 minutes per side.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,thyme leaf,shrimp,ginger garlic paste,pasta,lettuce leaf
title: Shrimp Wrapped in Pasta
ingredients: 500 g pasta | 2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 1 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 4 springyme leaves | 125 g fresh shrimp, cleaned and deveined | 60 slices rye bread, toasted
instructions: Boil the pasta in plenty of water for 10 - 15 minutes or until it can be easily pierced with a skewer. Drain. Meanwhile, in a small bowl combine the ginger and garlic with the thyme leaves. Brush the shrimp with the ginger garlic oil, sprinkle with the thyme mix. Slice the bread and lay them on the pasta. Spread the shrimp paste on the bread slices and roll the bread up. Wrap the pasta in the remaining slices. Arrange the rolled pasta on a serving platter.

Random Ingredients: liquid honey,phyllo pastry,dijon mustard,head iceberg lettuce,rosemary leaf,clear honey,vermouth
title: The Ultimate Phyllo Salad
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce ( washed and dried ) | 2 tablespoons clear honey | 1/4 cup vermouth | 1/2 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1/2 teaspoon rosemary leaf ( optional-increase if using dried rosemary ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried rosemary leaves ( optional-increase if using dried rosemary ) | 1 package phyllo pastry sheets | 1/4 cup liquid honey
instructions: In a large salad bowl, place lettuce and 1 tablespoon each of honey, vermouth, dijon mustard, rosemary, and rosemary leaves. Allow the lettuce mixture to marinate while filling the phyllo pastry sheets with a pastry brush or a pastry spool. Lay a phyllo sheet on a flat surface. Brush top with the remaining honey and spread 2 - 3 tablespoons of honey on the top. Cover the phyllo with a damp cloth or kitchen towels. Set this in the refrigerator. When all phyllo pastry sheets are prepared, remove the pastry sheets from the refrigerator. Take a sheet of phyllo pastry, place it on your work surface and cut in half vertically. Working quickly, brush one side of the phyllo with a pastry brush or the spool. You want to brush all the phyllo with this new way of brushing. Place a sheet of phyllo on top. Top the phyllo with another sheet and brush with the melted honey. Repeat this process until two sheets are layered. Repeat with another 2 tablespoons of honey and 2 sheets of dough until you reach the desired top layer. Once you reach the desired top layer of phyllo pastry, place another phyllo sheet on top, brush with the honey, and spread with a pastry brush. Repeat this process with the remaining phyllo sheets. Spread the phyllo pastry with a remaining phyllo pastry brush, brush with the remaining honey, sprinkle generously with the dried rosemary leaves, and fold the phyllo pastry, brushing with the honey with the edges of the phyllo dough. If all four phyllo pastry sheets are in the refrigerator, tightly wrap the phyllo pastry in foil. Pre heat the oven to 400°f place the phyllo pastry on a cookie sheet lined with aluminum foil or parchment paper. Cook for 10 - 12 minutes. Remove your phyllo pastry from the oven and place onto a large cutting board, using one hand to create a cone shaped indentation in the top with a sharp knife. This will prevent you from cutting all the way through. Turn your oven off and leave overnight to crisp. In the morning, remove the phyllo pastry from the oven and place on a parchment lined serving platter. Using a sharp knife, slice open the phyllo pastry and cut into thirds lengthwise. To serve, cut the phyllo pieces lengthwise into 1/2 inch slices. Place a scoop of ice cream in the center of a piece of phyllo and top with a large spoonful of ice cream. Garnish with a dollop of vanilla and/or almond butter.

title: Spicy Oil-Free Pepper Rings
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh red chili pepper, or you may use 1 1/2 tsp dried chili flakes ( if unavailable, 4-5 tsp ) | 1/4 lb butter, softened at room temperature
instructions: Place dry red chilies in a dry skillet. Cut in half, remove seeds and veins. Place on comination board, add softened butter and stir until mixture is smooth, about 10 minutes. Dip hands in warm water for a few seconds. Set chilies upright on cutting board. Cut vertically into thin rings with sharp knife, then cut rings lengthwise into strips about 3-4 x 1 1/2. Transfer to baking sheet, spread thin coating of oil on rings. Bake in 375f oven until fragrant, about 10 minutes..

Random Ingredients: olive oil cooking spray,buttermilk,lemon extract,kiwi,greek yogurt
title: Grilled Kiwi Yogurt and Fresh Buttermilk
ingredients: 2 ounces organic buttermilk | 2 1/2 tablespoons organic natural greek yogurt | 2 tablespoons olive oil flavored cooking spray | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon extract or 2 tablespoons vanilla extract | 2 firm kiwi, peeled and halved lengthwise
instructions: Mix the buttermilk and greek yogurt. Stir in the oil and zest of the lemon. Pour the mixture into a buttered shallow, nonreactive dish and spread out to cool. Sprinkle the kiwi halves with remaining buttermilk mixture. Turn onto the grill over medium heat and cook, turning once and turning occasionally until desired toasty consistency. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon,chicken bouillon cube,nutmeg,water chestnut,dark brown sugar,vidalia onion,red potato,italian seasoning
title: Sweet Potato, Water Chestnut, and Chicken Soup Mix
ingredients: 1 small vidalia onion | 1 can water chestnuts, drained | 2 red potatoes, diced | 3 cups chopped cooked chicken with bone chunks | 2 chicken bouillon cube | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon concentrate | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Cut onion and water chestnuts into small 1 inch pieces. Place onion, potato, chicken and bouillon in slow cooker. Cover and cook on low for 6 - 8 hours or high 3 - 5 hours. When ready to serve, remove 1/2 cup broth from the slow cooker.

title: K-Jon's Foolproof Creamy Guacamole Salad
ingredients: 4 ripe guacamole with ice ( not canned ) | 2 cups whipping cream | 2 tablespoons sweet chili sauce | 3/4 cup finely diced white onion | 3/4 cup frozen strawberries, thawed & drained | 1/4 cup chilled whipping cream
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl & garnish with fresh strawberries.

Random Ingredients: sofrito sauce,ginger puree,cooking oil,oregano leaf,chunky salsa
title: Omani
ingredients: 2 cups sofrito sauce | 1 jar chunky salsa | 1 tablespoon tomato puree | 2 teaspoons quick minced ginger puree | 2 teaspoons dried oregano leaves
instructions: In a large jar with a tight fitting lid, combine sofrito, salsa, tomato puree, ginger, and oregano.

Random Ingredients: lime wedge,sharp cheddar cheese,curry powder,olive oil
title: Curried Cheese and Lime Wedges - Quesadilla
ingredients: 1 lime wedge | 1/2 teaspoon curry powder | 1 teaspoon olive oil | 1 ounce sharp cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Squeeze the juice of the lime wedge over the top of the cheese.

Random Ingredients: chili paste garlic,grape,bay scallop,beer,peanut oil,malt vinegar
title: Beer and Seafood Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons malt vinegar | 1 teaspoon chili paste with garlic | 1 lb whole sea scallops or 1 lb other seafood | 2 bottles beer | 4 tablespoons grapes | 2 tablespoons dry roasted peanuts oil
instructions: Strain out any excess salt before removing the scallops from the shells. Put them into a bowl of cold water and set aside. Dry the shrimp in a clean dry cloth towel. Remove all the shells and the veins if any. Set them aside. In a small bowl, toss together the malt vinegar, chilli paste and garlic. In a large bowl, whisk together the beer, grapes and oil. Stir in the shrimp and add the malt vinegar mixture. Toss until evenly coated and warm.
