Random Ingredients: cumin powder,mace,sea salt,chili pepper flake,five spice powder,farfalle pasta,duck breast,sunflower oil
title: Seared Prawn - Shrimp, Duck, and Farfalle
ingredients: sea salt, white pepper, coarse salt, coarse salt, to taste | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 -2 pinch chili pepper flakes | 1 pinch mace | fresh ground sea salt or coarse sea salt | 1 pinch five-spice powder, pinch | 3 -8 ounces farfalle pasta | 2 duck breasts | sunflower oil
instructions: First, prepare the farfalle according to the package instructions, omitting the oil and other ingredients. In the meantime, sprinkle the sea salt and all spice over the shrimp. Add the farfalle to a pot of boiling, salted water and allow to boil for about 10 minutes or until the shrimp is just pink. Remove from the heat to prevent the farfalle from sticking to the base of the pot, then drain and rinse under running water to cool. Set aside. Heat a little oil in a pan and sear the prawns on all sides until just coloured. Remove the prawns temporarily from the pan. Add a couple of tables spoons of water from the pan, if the pan seems dry. If you need to, add more water. Reduce heat, season to taste with salt and all spice, and simmer slowly. Now place the farfalle on a plate, pour over a little oil and toss in any excess oil. When ready to serve, garnish with the prawns and serve with a green salad and extra oil, if desired.

title: Tortilla De Arroz (Mexican Onion Soup)
ingredients: 1/4 cup uncooked spanish onion | 2 cups whipping cream, or as needed
instructions: Place Spanish onions in a small saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a boil over medium high heat, and stir in cooked onions.

Random Ingredients: mandarin orange,tamarind pulp,spice,basil leaf,orange peel,udon noodle,cherry juice,beef stew meat
title: Goulash and Mandarin Orange Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 cup orange peel, white part only, finely julienned | 8 medium mandarin oranges, julienned | 4 tablespoons tamarind pulp, soaked until liquified | 1/2 cup cherry juice | 8 ounces beef stew meat, cut in 1/2-inch cubes | 1/2 cup dried sweet basil leaves | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon mixed spice, divided, to taste | 1 package udon noodles, prepared as directed on package
instructions: Place the orange peel on a piece of waxed paper, and roll it in the paper to remove excess moisture. Spread a small amount of the soaked tamarind on a cutting board, and place the meat on the paper. Cut the meat into 1/2 inch cubes. Place the meat cubes, tamarind pulp, cherry juice, and 1/2 tsp of the spice mix in a large saucepan. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 30 min., covered. Add the remaining spice mix. Cook for 10 minutes more, then remove from the heat. Add the basil and stir well. Add the remaining 1 tsp of spice mix and the udon noodles, stir to mix, and return heat to medium. Keep the stew on the medium low heat, uncovered, stirring occasionally for about 10 min., until udon is cooked.

title: Sage and Jicama Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups jicama, julienne strips | 2 stalks lemons | 300 ml stock or 300 ml broth | 2 teaspoons stevia ( optional ) | 1 fresh sage leaf | 4 cups rice, to serve later
instructions: Combine all ingredients except rice. Cover and leave in fridge to allow flavours to mature. Strain out sage and discard. Serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: cream,spanish onion,thai red curry paste,red bell pepper,corn,maraschino cherry
title: Thai Corn on the Cob or Grill
ingredients: 3 ears sweet corn or 3 ears sweet potato, cut on the cob | 1 container sour cream | 2 -3 ounces red bell peppers, cut on the cob | 1 small spanish onion, peeled and cut in rings | 2 -3 teaspoons thai red curry paste | maraschino cherry.
instructions: Grill corn over medium flame for 5 - 7 minutes on each side, or until light brown grill marks appear. Mix sour cream with peppers, onion rings, curry paste, and cherry halves. Serve right away, or refrigerate.

Random Ingredients: wasabi paste,portabella mushroom,chicken breast half,cocoa,caper,red chile,sirloin
title: Spicy Grilled Skewered Chicken
ingredients: 3 tablespoons wasabi paste | 1 red chile, seeded and minced | 1 portabella mushroom, trimmed and sliced | 2 tablespoons capers | 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breast halves, cut into 3/4 inch strips | 2 tablespoons cocoa | 2 tablespoons drained excess fat from a jar of capers | 1 lb sirloin, trimmed and sliced
instructions: Combine wasabi paste, chopped chiles, portabella mushroom and capers in large bowl. Add chicken and turn lightly so all is coated. Cover and marinate at room temperature 1 hour. Light grill. Remove chicken from marinade and place strips on grill rack. Grill, turning once, until just cooked through, about 4 minutes total. Slice beef and add to same saucepan with marinade, coating all. Bring to boil. Boil, stirring, about 1 minute. Turn off heat and sprinkle chicken with cocoa, stirring constantly. Serve right away.

title: Rice with Rum
ingredients: 1 cup risotto rice, or as needed | 1 teaspoon dark rum
instructions: Stir rice with rum until coated with rum.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,beef tenderloin,cornflour,chili paste,orange blossom water
title: Bunuelos
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat, cut in 1-inch cubes | 6 tablespoons chili paste | 1 teaspoon orange blossoms or 1 teaspoon orange marmalade | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 1 teaspoon cornstarch
instructions: Brown beef in a frying pan.. Remove beef and set aside. Reserve any remaining fat in frying pan. Add 1 tablespoon of chili paste to fat. After a few seconds, remove pan from heat. Add 1 tablespoon of orange blossoms or marmalade. Stir to blend in. In a small bowl, combine 1 cup or less of cold water. Heat cornstarch in a teaspoon or two of cold water until boiling. Add dissolved cornstarch water to pan and stir constantly. Return meat to pan. Heat until boiling. Reduce heat to low. Cover. Simmer for 90 minutes or until meat is tender. Stir occasionally.

title: Chefs Spiced Italian Spices
ingredients: 1 can italian-style tomatoes | 1 can consomme ( use only heinz ) | 1 tablespoon finely chopped gingerroot | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 -2 dash seasoning
instructions: Put everything except for the vanilla in a blender or food processor. Blend on high, setting till mostly smooth/tangy. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon powder,corn tortilla strip,orange juice,bulgur,coriander,yukon gold potato,chicken bouillon granule,dark brown sugar
title: Tortilla Potato Kugel With Bulgur and Caramelized Onions
ingredients: 12 corn tortillas or 12 short-grain corn tortillas, quartered | 1 lb yukon gold potato, peeled, halved lengthwise and cut into 1/4 inch slices | 12 slices littleneck fresh coriander ( cilantro ) | 1/2 cup bulgur, broken into small pieces | 1 quart chicken bouillon granule | 2 tablespoons minced orange juice | 1/4 teaspoon low-sodium instant chicken bouillon powder | 1/3 cup dark brown sugar or 1/3 cup packed brown sugar | 2 teaspoons cornstarch dissolved in 1 tablespoon water
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place tortilla or tortilla wedges on baking sheet. Bake tortillas, turning once, until golden brown and crisp, about 8 minutes. Transfer tortillas to bowl. Heat large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add potato pieces and coriander.

title: Mexican Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 6 pounds boneless beef chuck cut into 1 inch cubes | 6 pounds fresh new mexico chiles, halved lengthwise, seeded
instructions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees f. Toss cubed beef with 3 or more of the chiles. Arrange in a 9x13 inch baking dish lined with parchment paper, and roast in the preheated oven in the preheated oven, turning over after 30 minutes to brown evenly, about 80 minutes per pound of mixture. Remove chiles from heat, and serve with remaining stew to dip.

title: Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 lb american cheese, grated | 1 can tomato sauce | chili oil
instructions: Combine all ingredients and chill for 3 hours. Serve with crackers.

Random Ingredients: manicotti,rye flour,romaine lettuce,brandy,vegetable oil cooking spray,turnip,tart apple
title: Irish Manicotti
ingredients: 12 manicotti | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 cup diced riced turnip | 2 tart apples, peeled, cored and diced | 1 cup crumbly rye flour | 1/3 cup brandy | 1 cup shredded romaine lettuce
instructions: Prepare pasta as directed, except omit cooking water if using fresh pasta. Spray 11 x 7x2 baking dish with vegetable oil spray. Place riced turnips into a medium bowl. Add apple. Spoon half of riced turnip mixture onto the center of a pastry piece. Fold pastry over the mixture toward the center, making an envelope shape. Repeat with remaining ingredients. Place half of the filled manicotti into baking dish coated with vegetable oil spray. Cover with remaining manicotti. Bake at 350 degrees 15 minutes. Remove from oven and top with any remaining riced turnip mixture.

title: Roasted Brussels Sprouts for Two
ingredients: 1 lb fresh brussels sprout, trimmed and halved lengthwise, tops cut off ( about 14 ) | 2 teaspoons beef suet
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°. Pat brussels sprouts dry with paper towels. Coat a baking sheet with cooking spray. Arrange brussels sprouts on the dish and sprinkle with suet. Bake brussels sprouts until tender, about 25 minutes.

title: Veal and Mango Meatballs
ingredients: 4 lbs veal, trimmed of excess fat and cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 lb sugar pumpkin, peeled, seeded and cubed | 12 scallions, including tender green tops, cut into 1/2 inch lengths | 1 tablespoon ground mango powder or 1 tablespoon ground turmeric | 2 tablespoons ground flaxseed
instructions: Preheat your oven's highest setting. Place the meat in a large ovenproof bowl and sprinkle generously with salt. Toss with your hands to coat the meat. Place on a rack in a roasting pan and roast in the preheated oven until the crusts are dark brown, about 2 hours. Let cool slightly, then transfer the meat to a meat grinder and grind into a fine powder. You can also use your hands to combine the meat, powdered spice and flaxseed in your food processor. Using a fork, mix in 3 tablespoons of the meatball liquid. Transfer to a small saucepan and bring to a simmer. Remove from heat and whisk in the remaining tablespoon of meatball liquid and serve.

title: North African Olive Pies
ingredients: 1 package egg roll wraps | 1 3/4 cups shredded iceberg lettuce | 1 teaspoon instant tea ( optional ) | 8 ounces pitted green olives or 8 ounces black olives, sliced | 2 tablespoons minced pimiento | 1/2 packet hidden valley & reg ; original ranch & reg ; dressing and seasoning mix | coarse kosher salt | shredded trident greece farella cheese or monterey jack cheese
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f coat baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray.

title: Tarragon Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup tarragon | 2 tablespoons apple cider | 2 tablespoons dry tarragon | 2 teaspoons garlic salt
instructions: Combine the tarragon, cider, tarragon, and garlic salt in a food processor. Process to a paste.

title: Bacon And Anchovy Dip
ingredients: 200 g bacon, chopped | 15 anchovy fillets | 250 g ricotta cheese, greek
instructions: Cook bacon in a non stick frying pan for about 5 - 10 minutes or until crispy and golden brown. Drain on paper towels, if desired. Add anchovies to the bacon drippings in pan and let sit for 10 seconds. Place bacon on a paper towel and drain off any excess fat if desired. Stir in the ricotta and mix well. Transfer the dip into a lightly oiled tin or pie dish. Using a spatula, spread evenly on the top. Chill. Serve with crackers and/or bread.

Random Ingredients: soy sauce,confectioner sugar,red chilies,puff pastry,orange peel,spinach,cider vinegar
title: Spinach in Mini Volcanoes
ingredients: 1 teaspoon orange peel, minced | 4 dried red chilies, minced | 1 bunch fresh spinach, chopped | 1/8 teaspoon soy sauce | 1/8 teaspoon cider vinegar | 1/8 teaspoon confectioners'sugar, or as needed | 1 sheet frozen puff pastry
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Mix minced orange peel, red chilies and spinach in a bowl and set aside. Place a microwave safe bowl on top of a burner and heat on full power until hot, about 40 seconds. Transfer the skillet to the oven and heat for 5 minutes, stirring once or twice. Remove from oven and stir in soy sauce, vinegar and confectioners' sugar.

title: Maraschino Chicken With Cauliflower
ingredients: 3 lbs chicken wings | 2 1/2 cups vidalia onions or 2 1/2 cups other sweet onion | 1 1/2 cups roasted almonds, skinned | 1 bag cauliflower florets | 1/2 cup shallot, minced | 1 pint maraschino cherry, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Place wings on baking sheet. Roast for 45 minutes. Let cool and chop. Sauce. In a medium size skillet, sauté onions for about 3 minutes. Add almonds and cook for about 3 more minutes. Remove from heat to a bowl and mix in cooked cauliflower, shallots, and maraschino cherries. Place in an ovenproof dish. Bake in upper half of oven for 20 minutes. Place chicken on top of cauliflower and cover with sauce. Bake 30 minutes or until done, basting occasionally. Serve.

title: Jumbo Shrimp
ingredients: 20 jumbo shrimp, peeled and deveined | 4 ounces cornflour | 5 -6 pepperoncini peppers
instructions: Place the shrimp in the freezer and cut off their tails.. Roll the shrimp in cornflour, making sure they are coated. Grill, oven or frying pan until they turn pink. Drain excess water off and place on serving plate. Cut the peppers into thin strips and arrange around the shrimp and pepperoncini peppers. Serve hot.

title: Scallop and Noodles
ingredients: 16 ounces medium egg noodles, cooked until almost tender | 1 lb scallops, cleaned and head removed
instructions: Cook noodles in boiling salted water until just tender, about 3 minutes. Drain and set aside. Cut scallops crosswise into 1/4 inch slices. Place noodles in a large bowl. Top with scallops. Add the noodles and toss. Divide among 6 hot plates. Serve with salt and pepper.

Random Ingredients: lamb cutlet,gingerroot,onion soup mix,savory,greek olive,red capsicum
title: Roast Lamb Cutlets
ingredients: 4 lamb cutlets | 1 packet onion soup mix | 1 red capsicum | 1/2 cup greek olive | 1 teaspoon dried savory | 1 teaspoon grated gingerroot
instructions: Mix onion soup mix, capsicum, olives, savory together with lamb cutlets in a large frypan, and cook till meat is cooked. Stir to combine, and set aside. Preheat oven to 180°c. Place all ingredients in a baking dish, cover with foil and bake for 30 mins. Turn the meat & vegetables over, cover and bake 10 mins or till cooked.

title: Blueberry, Pine Nut, and Guinness Berry Jam (Pheasant)
ingredients: 1 pound fresh blueberries | 2 pounds fresh pineapple slices, cut into chunks | 1 pint guinness stout, or more as needed
instructions: Blend blueberries and pineapple chunks in blender until smooth. Pour the guinness into a large dutch oven or other large pot, and bring to a simmer over medium low heat. Add the blueberry mixture.

Random Ingredients: wild mushroom,olive oil,baking soda,oyster sauce,pistachio nut
title: Wild Mushroom With Pistachios(Pistachio Nut Cookies)
ingredients: 1/2 - 1 cup pistachio nut | 2 tablespoons light olive oil | 2 cups mixed wild mushrooms, cleaned and quartered ( you may substitute crimini mushrooms ) | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon red baking soda | 1 cup unsweetened oyster sauce
instructions: Put all ingredients in food processor. Process until finely chopped and mixture forms a solid mass. Roll into large balls about the size of a golf ball. Refrigerate for 1 - 2 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: turmeric,coconut milk,green chili,crab juice,white flour,saffron,white bean
title: Creamy White Bean Soup (Sopa De Pina)
ingredients: 500 250 grams white beans or 250 grams white pearl beans | 250 -250 g fresh crab ( or other imitation crab ) | 250 -250 g green chili, deseeded & sliced | 2 -3 tablespoons white flour | saffron | 400 ml coconut milk, warmed | 1 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: In a large saucepan, heat coconut milk, saffron, turmeric & coconut flakes to a boil, then add white bean and crab. Keep the pan on medium heat & bring sauce to a boil. Turn down heat & simmer at low heat for 20min, or until beans are cooked thoroughly. Add white flour & mix thoroughly. When soup thickens a little, stir in the warmed coconut milk. Remove & discard crab from top & place back on heat. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: brown sugar,deli roast beef,non cooking spray,wine vinegar,lasagna noodle,garlic salt,rib eye steak
title: Beef Rolls
ingredients: non-stick cooking spray | 1 jar of sliced deli roast beef, julienned | 1/2 lb sliced rib eye steak | garlic salt | 1 teaspoon brown sugar | 2 sheets thick sliced lasagna noodles, thawed | 1 tablespoon wine vinegar
instructions: Spray a deep 8 skillet with cooking spray, add beef and sliced steak and garlic salt, stir fry for about 7 minutes or until beef is just cooked. Add onions and mix. Spoon half of roast beef mixture into ungreased 9 x 9x2 inch baking dish. Cover beef mixture with noodles. Spread beef mixture over noodles and top with rest of roast beef mixture. Cover with foil and bake in preheated 450 degree oven for 25 minutes, or until noodles are tender and liquid is absorbed. Spray rolls with cooking spray and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: orange peel,salt pepper,spinach leaf,ice water,lime juice
title: Fresh Spinach Salad
ingredients: 1 pint fresh spinach leaves | 1 tablespoon lime juice | 1/2 teaspoon orange peel, grated ( optional ) | salt and pepper, to taste | 1/4 cup ice water, or as needed
instructions: Wash and tear the spinach into leaves. Chill in the refrigerator until the water is ready to use. Place the spinach, lime juice, orange peel, salt and pepper in a blender and process until the mixture is smooth. Add more ice water if needed while blending so the blades don't blend too long. Taste and correct for seasoning, adding water as needed as needed.

title: Homemade Chicken for the Starters Grill
ingredients: 1/2 cup chicken fat or 1/2 cup vegetable fat ( i use the oil packed variety ) | 2 1/4 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 ounce vodka
instructions: Heat a large, deep sided frying pan or cast iron skillet until it reaches 350°f or just a light haze rises to the surface. In the pan, heat the fat to 350°f or until a bead of tiny bubbles forms around a small piece of bread when slipped inches mix together the yeast and vodka in a small piece of warmed fat and let stand until foamy, 2 - 3 minutes. Strain the yeast mixture and pour into the hot fat, stirring constantly with a wooden spoon. Heat to 130f but not temperature. Turn out the heat to 130f. Break the chicken into pieces and add to the liquid in the pan. Cover, and allow 2 - 3 hours for the yeast to become creamy and somewhat foamy. If the yeast mixture is loose, cover and transfer to a warmed container. Cool until warm, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: orange zest,kielbasa,iceberg lettuce,pam cooking spray,red potato,canadian bacon
title: Canadian Bacon Kielbasa & Potato Salad
ingredients: 1 lb kielbasa, cut into 1/2 inch slices | canadian bacon ( use turkey bacon or other smoked sausage ) | 1 large red potatoes | iceberg lettuce ( use all ) | 2 tablespoons orange zest, grated | pam cooking spray
instructions: Preheat oven to in a large bowl toss sausage with the potato slices. Spray pam in an oven proof skillet over medium high heat.

title: Black Bean Grape Tomatoes
ingredients: 600 g grape tomatoes | 1/2 liter fermented black beans, rinsed and drained
instructions: Wash and remove tops of tomatoes if necessary. Slice into wedges. Place tomatoes in a pan of boiling water, bring back to the boil, cover and simmer for 10 minutes. Drain and rinse in cold water. Place in a serving bowl and sprinkle over plenty of sea salt to taste. Add remaining ingredients and toss around to coat evenly.

Random Ingredients: salmon,steak,taco sauce,pizza crust,sea salt,liquid smoke flavoring,asafoetida powder,parsley
title: Roast Salmon En Papillote Filling
ingredients: 1 lb cooked steak, thinly sliced | 1 can refrigerated pizza crust, thawed ( near ) | 1 jar taco sauce | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | chopped parsley | 2 teaspoons liquid smoke flavoring | sea salt | djalapenos or other hot pepper, to taste
instructions: Stir steak, taco sauce, sambel, parsley and liquid smoke together. Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Spoon mixture onto pizza crust. Sprinkle with any seasoning you like. Place in the oven and bake for 10 - 12 minutes, until crust is browned. Cut into wedges to serve.

Random Ingredients: porcini mushroom,bicarbonate soda,steak,beef consomme,vanilla bean,sauce,stewing beef,peach
title: Peach and Beef Porcini Beef Stew (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 whole steak, cubed | 1 can beef consomme | 1/2 pint beef broth, boiling | 1 vanilla bean, split lengthwise, scraped | 1 teaspoon cumin | 2 teaspoons steak sauce ( mild ) | 1 teaspoon beetroot extract or 1 teaspoon aubergine extract | 1/2 cup dried porcini mushrooms | 1 large peaches or 1 large peach, split in half lengthwise
instructions: Brown meat in skillet with a little oil and drain off fat. Combine consume, spices, and sauces. Pour over meat and brown in remaining oil. Transfer to crock pot.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,extra beef,barbecue sauce,guacamole,kalamata olive,plain yogurt,peanut butter
title: Easy Shredded Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 6 ounces extra lean ground beef | 1/3 cup reduced-fat plain yogurt | 1 tablespoon light brown sugar | 1 tablespoon barbecue sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons peanut butter or 1 1/2 tablespoons salad dressing | 2 tablespoons kalamata olives | 4 teaspoons guacamole
instructions: In a small skillet, cook beef over medium heat for about 3 minutes, until cooked through. Drain fat. Stir in remaining ingredients. Spray 8 - 10 inch sandwich roll pan with nonstick cooking spray. Spread half the filling ingredients evenly over the roll.

title: Kadai (Yemenite Steamed Rice Paper Cups)
ingredients: 4 cups plain rice paper ( squares ), about 20 x 15 inch | 1 tablespoon fenugreek seeds ( methi seeds ) | 1 shallot or 1 green onion, thinly sliced | 4 tablespoons mango chutney ( can substitute with dipping sauce ) | 2 large limes, cut lengthwise into 6 wedges, juice only | 2 tablespoons ghee ( canola or peanut fat can be substituted )
instructions: Soak the rice papers in a large bowl filled with water on the countertop for 20 minutes. Drain well. In a dry skillet, toast the fenugreek seeds over low heat, stirring constantly, until dark amber, about 2 - 3 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl and set aside. In a deep skillet or wok, heat the ghee on medium heat. When hot, add the sesame, then the shallot. Stir fry until fragrant, about 1 minute add the fenugreek mixture and continue stir frying the mixture for 1 minute. Add the lime juice and let stand 2 - 3 minutes. Stuff each rice paper cup with about 1 teaspoon of filling and serve.

title: Beef and Vegetables over Rice
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless beef chuck, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 tablespoon celery salt | 2 cups fresh vegetables, cut into wedges | 1 cup sliced yellow pepper | 2 cups canned chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 2 medium bananas
instructions: Place beef cubes into a large slow cooker. Sprinkle celery salt over beef. Add vegetables, yellow peppers, and chickpeas. Cover. Cook on high 4, 7 hours or low 4, 8 to 10 hours. Remove beef from cooker. Cut into 3 inch chunks. Serve on a platter, surrounded by remaining ingredients.

title: Minty Peas and Rum Roasted Peas
ingredients: 20 -30 white pea, green | 1/2 cup dark rum | mint sprigs or chives, for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 250°. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil, and toss the peas with the rum. Bake for about 2 hours, until the peas have softened. Towards the end of the cooking time, toss the peas with a little sugar and serve with mint and chives.

Random Ingredients: mustard seed,jumbo shrimp,water chestnut,green olive,rice noodle,golden raisin
title: Shrimp and Noodles
ingredients: 4 ounces rice noodles | 1 cup water chestnuts, drained and diced | 1 cup green olives, sliced | 1/4 cup golden raisin | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 pound jumbo shrimp, peeled and deveined
instructions: Fill a pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the noodles, recover, and return to a boil. Cook the noodles uncovered, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but still firm to the bite, about 3 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Transfer the cooked noodles to a large bowl and set aside. Stir the canola oil, chopped green olives, raisins, and mustard seeds in a wok or skillet over low heat. Add the shrimp and cook and stir constantly, tossing constantly, until the shrimp are no longer transparent, about 5 minutes. Pour over the cooked noodles and toss until evenly coated.

title: Coconut and Almond Jam
ingredients: 250 g blanched almonds | 1 cup raw sugar | 450 -500 ml cold water | 1/2 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Peel the almonds, and grind finely. Put the almonds into a bowl of cold water. Remove the starch and rinse the bowl. Sprinkle the nuts with a few drops of cooking oil and set aside. Put the sugar in a large saucepan. Place 1/4 cup of water into another saucepan and bring to the boil. Stir till it is dissolved, and boil for 2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: beet,lemon juice zest,golden syrup,sirloin,garlic clove,preserve,green cardamom,plain nonfat yogurt
title: Beet-Lemon Burgers
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin, cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 teaspoons golden syrup | 1 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 2 teaspoons lemon juice, from fresh lemon | 2 garlic cloves, minced | 1/4 teaspoon green cardamoms, crushed | 1/4 teaspoon ground beets | preserves, washed
instructions: Place the beef in a medium mixing bowl. Sprinkle the marinade over the beef, set aside, covered for at least 1 hour, stirring from time to time. In a medium bowl, stir together the golden syrup, yogurt, lemon juice, garlic, cardamom and ground beet. Add the beef to the marinade and toss to coat. Preheat the broiler element to high. Heat a large cast iron or non stick frying pan until very hot. Using 2 forks, tear the beef into a 1 inch pieces and drop them into the hot pan. Reduce the heat to medium, cover and cook for 5 minutes or until the beef is brown on the outside and cooked through. Transfer the beef to a plate, drain off any excess oil, and keep warm. Spoon about 1/2 cup of the warm marinade into a small mixing bowl and set aside. Place the rest of the marinade in the pan and add the reserved beetroot syrup mixture. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover and simmer for about 15 minutes or until the beetroot is cooked but not mushy. Stir in the preserves, cook for another 10 minutes and serve with the meat.

title: Creamy Coq Au Chocolat
ingredients: 10 large chicken legs, rinsed, drained ( about 3kg ) | 2 tablespoons ground cumin, half a large pinch | 180 ml double cream | 90 ml champagne | 2 -3 tablespoons double cream
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c. Place chicken legs in a roasting tin or baking dish. Sprinkle with half a teaspoon of cumin, half a large pinch of salt and half a large pinch of sugar and half a large pinch of freshly ground black pepper. Add 100ml water to the tin, cover with foil and set aside at room temperature for 3 hours before basting with the champagne. After the third hour add the remaining cumin, half a large pinch of salt and a small pinch of sugar and a small pinch of pepper. Remove the chicken legs from the marinade, cover tightly and reserve the reserved marinate in the tin for use later. Turn the chicken legs over every so often in the juices until they are golden brown and crisp. Remove the chicken legs from the tin, spread a little of the reserved marinate on each chicken leg, then gently slide them underneath for a couple of minutes to get good crusty breadcrumbs on top. Pour the double cream over. Increase oven temperature to 200°c and bake for 40 - 45 minutes until the chicken is cooked and the sauce is bubbling.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti sauce,butter,vinegar,salad dressing,olive oil,brown sugar,pine nut
title: Spaghetti Salad - Gluten Free
ingredients: 1/2 lb spaghetti | 8 ounces brown sugar, splashed | 1/2 cup salad dressing | 1 teaspoon vinegar | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1/4 cup butter | 1/4 cup pine nuts, toasted and chopped ( optional )
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package, drain and toss with remaining ingredients. Sugar is optional. Serve immediately and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: alfalfa sprout,maple syrup,chicken,chocolate cookie crumb,topping,plain flour
title: Maple Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 cup reduced-fat plain flour | 3/4 cup chocolate cookie crumbs | 2/3 cup finely shredded low-fat chicken ( can use more or less for desired consistency ) | 3/4 cup fat-free whipped topping ( fat free reduced-fat or fat free cream ) | 2/3 cup maple syrup | 1/4 cup alfalfa sprout ( optional ) | 1/2 cup low fat baked miniature chocolate cookies ( i have tried hershey's brand to make them a little sweeter )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°c. Mix flour, cookie crumbs, cheese and 1/2 cup of the whipped topping together until well combined and then press all the topping evenly into a square baking dish sprayed with a non stick cooking spray. Bake for 20 minutes or until slightly golden on top. Mix syrup, remaining whipped topping and remaining topping in a saucepan. Bring to the boil and stir until the syrups have melted into the syrup. Turn the temperature down and add alfalfa sprouts.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,chicken stock,basmati rice,chicken tender,broccoli floret,sharp cheddar cheese,cucumber,poppy seed
title: Cheddar and Broccoli Hash
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1/2 cup chicken stock | 1 cup light cream or 1 cup sour cream | 1/2 cup basmati rice | 1 cup broccoli floret | 2 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 2 tablespoons poppy seeds | 1/2 medium cucumber, chopped
instructions: Spray large non stick fry pan with non stick cooking spray. Heat pan add beef in a single layer and brown meat. Add stock and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer until beef is completely tender remove beef and set aside. Increase heat to medium high. Add cream and stir fry until mixture just begins to thicken. Stir in rice and broccoli. Cook until rice is almost to steaming. Stir beef mixture into soup. Cook until thoroughly heated. Spoon into serving dish. Sprinkle cheese and poppy seed over mixture. Serve with cucumber.

Random Ingredients: apricot nectar,irish mist liqueur,baking soda,red wine
title: Easy Apricot Red Wine
ingredients: 1 can apricot nectar or ( 14 ounce ) can raspberry-nectar | 1/2 cup sweet red wine | 1 tablespoon irish mist liqueur | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Muddle apricots in the bottom of the pan. Fill with remaining ingredients. Mix well before pouring over your hot red wine.

Random Ingredients: panko breadcrumb,pork shoulder butt,green pea,margarine,monterey jack cheese
title: Gorky Pork
ingredients: 1 pork shoulder, trimmed | 8 ounces frozen green peas, thawed | 8 ounces monterey jack cheese, shredded | 3 teaspoons margarine, melted | 1/2 cup panko breadcrumbs, or as needed | 1 1/2 tablespoons margarine, melted
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place the pork shoulder in a roasting pan. Pour enough water into the pan to just cover the meat. Bake meat for 2 hours, or until just cooked through. Transfer to a platter and allow it to cool until it can be handled. Set the meat into a bowl and set aside. Strain the fat from the roasting pan and discard any accumulated juices. Shred meat and measure 1 cup. Place back into the pan with the frozen green peas and heat until hot. Stir in the cheese and warm through. Stir in the panko and 3 teaspon of melted margarine. Remove from the heat. Stir the panko mixture into the pork. Transfer pork to a large ovenproof serving dish. Drizzle with remaining melted margarine. Sprinkle with remaining panko and brown under the oven's broiler until well browned.

title: Mixed Brown Onion Dip
ingredients: 4 -5 medium brown onions | 1 teaspoon dried thyme leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Peel and slice onions, and place in a saucepan. Cover with 5 - 6 cups of warm water and bring to the boil. Turn to simmer and cook gently for 5 minutes or until onions are just tender. Drain, and place in a blender or food processor and blend for 10 - 15 seconds, stopping frequently to scrape down the sides. Transfer to a container. Add thyme leaves. Serve hot, warm or cold. To serve chilled, place in an oven safe container and bake for 10 - 15 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bubbling around the edges.

title: Cauliflower Ki
ingredients: 3/4 cup yellow food coloring, plus additional for garnish | 2 large carrots, cut into thin rounds, cut in half | kielbasa, for garnish | 1 medium cauliflower floret, cut into florets | 1/2 cup plum, cut into thin slices ( optional ) | 1 medium sprig turmeric powder, for garnish
instructions: Heat a nonstick wok on high heat. Add the kielbasa and stir fry it till it is light brown, stirring often. Immediately add the carrots and cook further 5 minutes. Toss well and add the cauliflower. Add the plum.

Random Ingredients: tahini,watermelon,deli roast beef,mexican cheese,curry leaf,kalamata olive,shortening,chicken meat
title: Grilled Philly Beef Sandwiches With Spicy Dip
ingredients: 1 lb thinly sliced deli roast beef | 1/4 cup watermelon, seeded and cut into 1/4 inch by 1/8 inch strips | 6 kalamata olives, pitted and quartered | 1/4 cup smooth tahini | 1/2 teaspoon curry leaf | 1/2 cup shredded mexican blend cheese | 2 tablespoons shortening | 1 cup shredded fat free hot chicken meat
instructions: Combine the beef, watermelon, olives, tahini and curry leaf in a large bowl. Melt the shortening in a large nonstick frying pan over medium heat. Add the beef mixture and spread the mixture over the steak, making sure it coats the meat. Place the skillet in an oven and grill for 10 - 15 minutes or until the beef is cooked to your liking. Remove the skillet from the oven and let stand for 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: soymilk,part mozzarella cheese,dill,italian turkey sausage,gorgonzola,feta cheese,white vinegar
title: Feta Sausage Cheese Pies
ingredients: 3 cups crumbled gorgonzola | 3/4 cup chopped part-skim mozzarella cheese | 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese | 1 cup plain soymilk | 3 tablespoons distilled white vinegar, or as needed | 1 1/2 tablespoons minced fresh dill, or more as needed | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried italian turkey sausage, or more to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line 2 baking sheets with aluminum foil. Stir the gorgonzola cheese, mozzarella cheese, feta cheese, light soy milk, vinegar, dill weed, and sausage together in a bowl.

title: Chilled Asparagus
ingredients: 10 lbs fresh asparagus | spices
instructions: Wash and trim asparagus of woody base with a sharp knife. Cut spears into 2 inch lengths. Place in large pot of boiling salted water, cover and simmer 2 minutes. Drain and cool completely. Combine and store tightly covered in refrigerator. Makes enough for 10 small servings. Great with steamed carrots, pasta with butter and fresh green beans.

Random Ingredients: squid,orange,granny smith apple,green food coloring,strawberry,jalapeno pepper
title: Calamonicata on Stick
ingredients: 1 small green apple | 1 granny smith apple | 3 drops orange food coloring | 2 -4 drops strawberry, if desired | 1 -2 squid | 1 pinch green food coloring
instructions: Wash the outer surface of the green apple and the outside of the york. Cut away any white stalk with skin on. Cut zest from inside of the yellow apple. Cut away the hard core and slice zest. Cut green apple into 2 equal pieces for the marinade. Put all ingredients in a bowl and mix thoroughly. Let stand for 1 hour. Arrange the vegetables on wooden skewers. Fill the skewers with the marinated vegetables in skewers. Cook at medium high for about 25 minutes or until tender.

Random Ingredients: red potato,vanilla ice cream,cranberry juice,kale,extra virgin olive oil,cumin
title: Creamy Red Potatoes and Cranberry Rice
ingredients: 1/3 cup extra virgin olive oil | 2 red potatoes, cut into 1/3-inch dice | 2 cups small whole blueberries or 2 cups red currants | 4 -5 thin kale or 4 -5 spinach leaves | 1 container low-sodium cranberry juice | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 scoop vanilla ice cream ( optional )
instructions: Add 2 tablespoons olive oil to 1 qt. Potatoes. Add the red potato cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the oil. Spray a 9x13 baking pan with cooking spray. Add the potatoes, blueberries, kale or spinach leaves, diced cabbage and juice to a pot, and bring to a boil. Cover, turn the heat to low, and cook until potatoes are tender and the kale is bright green and slightly wilted, approximately 7 - 10 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in the cumin and 1 scoop of ice cream if using.

title: Cheesy basmati rice
ingredients: 2 cups white basmati rice | 2 cups grated monterey jack cheese
instructions: Add the rice, and let it sit 2 - 3 minutes. Sprinkle cheese on top. Heat in micro or oven. Place oven rack on top, and cook for 20 minutes, until the cheese is bubbly. Serve warm.

title: Creamy Chorizo Linguine
ingredients: 8 ounces linguine | 1 lb spanish chorizo sausage | 7 ounces heavy cream
instructions: Boil the linguine noodles according to the package directions. Meanwhile, brown the chorizo slices in a skillet, set aside. When the linguine comes to a boil, add the cream to the pan and stir with a fork, cooking the cream until thickened. Drain the linguine and add to the cream sauce along with the cheese. Toss to coat.

title: Lasagna Rolls
ingredients: 2 packages pillsbury refrigerated pizza crust sheets | 2 medium carrots | 1 1/2 cups orange juice and 1 tablespoon orange marmalade | 1 medium orange, sliced thinly
instructions: Roll out dough on lightly floured surface. Cut out 12 circles. Chop and core carrots, set aside. Place the orange slices in a small bowl, and cover with cold water. Allow to stand for 10 to 15 minutes, drain, and reserve juices. Pour juice and orange marmalade over carrots, and reserve liquid. Lay out one biscuit dough round on workbench, and stretch dough to fit the size of the rolling pin, about 2½ inches in diameter. Place 2 teaspoons of the carrots on the dough round, leaving about ½ inch bare around edge. Starting with the long edge, roll up dough, pinching the ends tightly to seal. Repeat with second dough round, carrots, and orange slices. Place rolls on dull, round baking sheet, and cover with plastic wrap. Let rise in refrigerator for at least 1 hour. Bake at 350°f about 30 to 35 minutes, or until golden.

title: Stuff Your Cabbage
ingredients: 1 head savoy cabbage | 500 g stewing beef | 1 tablespoon tomato puree | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh basil or 1 1/2 teaspoons dried basil | 1/3 cup chopped parsnip
instructions: Wash and finely chop the cabbage and place in a dish. Cut the beef into fine pieces and place into the dish. Add the tomato puree, basil and parsnip and simmer gently for about 45 minutes or until the cauliflower is tender and the sauce is reduced a little bit.

title: Leringonberry Scented Chicken
ingredients: 3 lbs chicken pieces, with skin | lingonberry
instructions: Marinate chicken overnight or up to 1 day in refrigerator. Drain and lightly pat dry. Thread 1 dozen pieces of chicken with skin on to long, narrow metal skewers. Grill or broil to desired degree of doneness.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,chicken stock vegetable,herbes de provence,red potato,cabbage,spanish onion,yellow onion,currant
title: Potato Cabbage Soup
ingredients: 2 heads cabbage, roughly chopped | 1 small spanish onion, chopped | 3 red potatoes, pared | 1 small egg, whisked | 1 garlic clove, peeled and sliced | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme and rosemary leaves or 1 tablespoon fresh thyme, chopped | 4 cups chicken stock or 4 cups vegetable stock, heated | 1/4 cup dried currant | minced cilantro or dill
instructions: Put cabbage, onion, potatoes, egg, garlic, and herbs in a large saucepan and add enough stock to cover vegetables. Bring to boil and lower heat. Cook for 1 hour. Remove the thyme leaves. Place in blender or food processor and blend to make fine puree. Add puree to remaining stock in saucepan and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer until the stock has reduced to 1 cup. Add the currants and stir well. Chill and ladle into bowls, garnish with cilantro or dill, if desired. Note, this soup can be served cold as soon as you use the stock. A little goes a long way.

title: Rabas Con Salsa Verde
ingredients: 4 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro ( coriander ) | 4 medium red chilies | 5 large egg yolks | 1 bunch collard greens, coarsely chopped | 8 ounces fresh spinach leaves
instructions: To make the salsa verde, in a food processor, combine all the ingredients. Blend until very smooth. Alternatively, you can use an immersion blender to blend everything and pulse it to desired consistency. If you have extra time, allow the process to rest for a few minutes before using. For me this is a bit like salsa. Note, you can put the chopped collards, if using, into the food processor too. I find that with the motor running, the texture of the salsa is much smoother.

title: Apple Butter With Chocolate
ingredients: 3 small tart apples | 80 g dark chocolate
instructions: Peel, core and slice the apples into thin slices. Melt the dark chocolate, melt it in the microwave to 180 to 185 degrees celsius. Add the chocolate to the apples and stir to coat the apples. Transfer to an ovenproof dish and bake for 20 minutes or until lightly brown.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,butternut squash,chorizo sausage,lemon zest,cold water,pie shell
title: Spicy Butternut Squash
ingredients: 1 butternut squash, ends trimmed | 4 tablespoons chorizo sausage, chopped | 3 tablespoons cold water | 1 lemon, zest of | 1 tablespoon chili oil | 2 ready-made pie shells
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c/ 400°f/ gas mark cut the butternut squash into 2cm chunks and spread them out on a roasting tray and bake for 40 50mins, stirring half way through, until just tender and well softened. Stir in the chorizo, water, zest and chili oil and season. Heat through, then leave to cool. Spread the cooled butternut squash with the zest and spoon filling into the pastry cases.

title: Simple Noodle and Squash Soup
ingredients: 1 cup butternut squash, peeled, chopped, fresh or canned | 1 box medium egg noodles, no egg added, uncooked
instructions: Combine squash and noodles and cook until done, 15 minutes. Enjoy.

title: Lebanese Green Olives
ingredients: 1 jar green olives, drained | 1/4 cup tomato sauce | 1 tablespoon grated lemon peel
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Heat olives in a microwave safe bowl in the microwave until warm to the touch, about 5 minutes. Turn the olives from top to bottom in a spiral to create a nice pattern. Combine tomato sauce and lemon peel in a small bowl and drizzle over sliced olives.

Random Ingredients: sorghum,eggplant,cool whip,japanese mayonnaise,beef bouillon cube,vanilla bean,wild rice,swordfish
title: Soho Crab Dip
ingredients: 1 lb swordfish, cut into chunks | 2 eggsplants, chopped | 8 ounces japanese mayonnaise | 1/4 cup vanilla bean | 1/2 cup japanese-style mayonnaise | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 pinch of salt | 1/4 cup wild rice
instructions: Put all ingredients in medium sized serving bowl. Combine until well incorporated. Serve with rice or noodles.

Random Ingredients: coriander seed,cherry pie filling,baby shrimp,lobster tail,tri tip steak
title: Seared Lobster Beef
ingredients: 1 lb tri-tip steak, sliced to 1/4 inch thick | 2 tablespoons coriander seeds ( cracked ) | 8 baby shrimp | 1 1/2 inches piece lobster tail | 8 ounces canned cherry pie filling ( any size )
instructions: On grill over medium heat toast coriander seeds for 1 - 2 minutes or until fragrant. Set in a small plate and crush with your fingers set aside. Heat a large nonstick skillet over high heat. Add beef and cook about 3 - 4 minutes, or until no longer pink, turning once. Transfer to plate. Remove all but 1 tbsp of fat from skillet. Add shrimp. Cook until shrimp turns pink, 1 - 2 minutes, or until pink all over. Place in same skillet as meat. Remove from heat. Stir in shrimp mixture, juice and coriander. Cover. Let sit until shrimp softens, about 1 - 2 minutes. Stir in the cherry pie filling. Slice and serve.

Random Ingredients: bean sprout,garlic clove,egg bread white,syrup,chicken bouillon cube,pepper,cheese
title: Chicken Fried Brunch Sandwiches - Tyler Florence
ingredients: 2 cups frozen egg bread rounds (, crustless ) | 2 tablespoons crushed dried garlic cloves | 1 chicken bouillon cube | freshly ground pepper | pounded cheese ( for topping ) ( optional ) | oil or melted butter ( for frying ) | freshly sprout ( for garnish ) ( optional ) | syrup or jam ( for topping ) ( optional )
instructions: If using the cheese, lightly press cheese in mixture and fry on both sides until crisp and golden brown.

Random Ingredients: quinoa,green cardamom pod,white vermouth,half,onion soup mix,eggplant
title: Persian Eggplant (Aubergine) and Quinoa Pilaf
ingredients: 1 large onion, roughly chopped | 2 green cardamom pods | 4 medium eggplants, peeled, cubed | 4 cups cooked quinoa | 1 cup dry white vermouth | 12 cups half-and-half
instructions: Place the onion, cardamom pods, and eggplant in a large pot with water. Bring to a boil, and partially cover the pot. Cook until the eggplant turns from translucent to mushy tender, or about 5 minutes. Transfer the eggplant to a bowl and mash with a potato masher. Stir in the quinoa and vermouth, and let cool to room temperature. Heat the half and half and half in a saucepan over medium heat, just until hot but not boiling. When the pilaf begins to bubble, mix all of the contents of the pot into the hot half and half mixture in the pan. Bring to a boil, and reduce heat until the liquid is almost the consistency of a thin cream sauce, about 5 minutes.

title: Potatoes Stuffed With Herbed Herbs
ingredients: 12 -20 lbs potatoes, peeled | 1 -2 cup finely shredded lemon peel | 1 -2 cup finely chopped leaf oregano | 1 loaf rye bread
instructions: Cut rind from 1 large unpeeled potato.

title: Quick Shrimp and Noodle Meal
ingredients: 2 cups elbow macaroni | 1 pound peeled and deveined large shrimp | 2 packages top ramen noodles, crushed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place the elbow macaroni in a large casserole dish with enough water to cover the pasta. Cover the dish, and bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes. Remove the lid, and sprinkle the shrimp over macaroni. Bake 30 minutes in the preheated oven, or until the shrimp are cooked through. Stir the pasta, shrimp, noodles, and seasoning packet contents together in a bowl until the shrimp are hot.

title: Japanese Shrimp Donburi
ingredients: 1 lb shrimp, raw ( uncooked ) | 5 tablespoons fresh dashi | 1 cup white mushroom | 1 carrot ( medium size peeled, cut into chunks ) | 1 cup beef broth | 1 tablespoon paprika | 4 tablespoons sesame oil, divided
instructions: Cook shrimp until pink and slightly done. Add dashi and mushrooms simmer for 20 minutes. While mushrooms are cooking cut carrot into very thin slivers. Remove shrimp and mushrooms from dashi and place on top of carrot. Saute shrimp and mushrooms until shrimp are cooked. Add paprika and sesame oil. Serve immediately.

title: Thai Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 1 large head cabbage | 1/2 lb meat | 1 mango, peeled, cut into bite size pieces | 8 -12 ounces crabmeat or 8 -12 ounces surimi | 5 tablespoons rice vinegar | 3 tablespoons chili sauce | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon | 3 cups cooked rice
instructions: Cut the cabbage open like you would for a burrito leaving the stem on. Carefully cut out the outer leaves of the cabbage. Wash the head carefully in a sink of cold water, and dry with paper towels. Dice the meat. Mix ingredients together in a big bowl until it can be fully combined but isn't too soft or too dry. Fill each cabbage leaf about 1/4 of the way with the mix, and roll the leaf up. You will have to use more than half of the roll. Place some rice on your work surface or on toasted plastic wrap, to help absorb moisture during the steaming process. Poke holes in the roll to let steam escape. Steam the rolls over a bamboo steamer or grill for about 15 minutes, turning once or twice or until they are golden brown. Serve over boiled or steamed white rice.

title: Saffron Soup
ingredients: 2 cups vegetable stock | 8 ounces unsalted butter | 24 -25 saffron ( to taste ) | 4 scallions ( to garnish ) | 2 -3 teaspoons celery seeds
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the stock, butter, saffron and scallions. Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring occasionally. Cover and simmer gently for 40 minutes over medium low heat, stirring occasionally. Puree soup through a food mill placed in a small saucepan or a blender. Return soup to heat and stir in pureed soup. Serve with celery seeds and a dollop of ice yogurt if desired.

Random Ingredients: halibut fillet,scotch bonnet pepper,jalapeno chile,lemon,raspberry,garam masala,cream cheese
title: Grilled Fish with Raspberry Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 whole raspberries ( canned okay ) | 4 fresh jalapeno chiles, chopped fine | 1 tablespoon garam masala | 4 ounces low fat cream cheese | 4 salmon fillets | 2 lemons | 2 scotch bonnet peppers ( fresh or pickled )
instructions: Marinate salmon for 6 hours. Rinse and drain salmon of marinade, and lightly squeeze out fillets, reserving marinade. Cut cream cheese into 5 - 6 slices. Add cream cheese to bowl and mix well with whisk till fluffy, and add the chiles, garam masala and lemon juice and stir to blend. Grill fish on preheated grill for 7 - 8 minutes, turning once for med rare, 15 - 17 minutes for medium rare, and 18 - 20 minutes for slightly underdone. Serve with sauce.

title: Beef on the Hole
ingredients: 1 lb ground sirloin | 8 ounces dry bow tie pasta | 1 bunch fresh cilantro, chopped | 8 ounces hoagie rolls | 2 loaves round steaks
instructions: Heat electric skillet on medium high. Add beef. Cook and stir until no longer pink, about 6 minutes. Add pasta and cilantro to beef and stir. Transfer beef mixture to cutting board. Cut off ends of roll. On one side of roll, place a pile of meat. Season with salt and pepper and cut in half lengthwise, across the beef. Close roll tightly, leaving one inch at each end. Place steak on top of roll. Heat a skillet over medium high heat. Sear roll.

Random Ingredients: yellow pepper,red wine,angel hair pasta,spanish onion,artichoke heart,chow mein noodle,chutney
title: Chutney Salad
ingredients: 6 cups angel hair pasta | 1/2 large spanish onion, thinly sliced | 1/2 yellow pepper, diced | 1 can quartered artichoke hearts | 1 cup chutney | 1 cup dry red wine | chow mein noodles ( optional )
instructions: Cook and drain pasta. Add onions, peppers and artichoke hearts. Mix wine and chutney together. Pour over salad and toss. Serve in individual bowls i put the chow mein in the middle of the salad.

Random Ingredients: cilantro stem,dark chocolate,chicken breast half,sake,philadelphia cream cheese,bean sauce,cardamom seed,oregano
title: Chipotle Chicken
ingredients: 2 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 2 ounces white dark chocolate, coarsely chopped | 1 package philadelphia cream cheese, softened | 1/2 cup chopped fresh cilantro stem, packed | 2 dashes dried oregano | 1 tablespoon sake | 1 tablespoon prepared chinese garlic and herb seasoning or 1 tablespoon minced fresh cilantro | 1 teaspoon cardamom seeds
instructions: Place chicken breast between 2 sheets of wax paper, cut in half horizontally, then crosswise into 1/2 inch thick strips. Chop chocolate into 1 inch chunks, and place in a medium bowl. Beat cream cheese& cilantro in medium bowl, using an electric mixer on medium speed until combined. Add cream cheese mixture with dried oregano, sake, chinese garlic herb seasoning and cardamon seeds.

title: Pigs in a Blanket
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef roast | 12 beef figs ( about 8 ounces, with stem ) | 2 lbs beef ( preferably italian-style ) | 1 lb asparagus | 2 packages dry red lentils | 3 table spoons dijon mustard | 1 bottle butteriyaki sauce
instructions: Cook roast on grill or on cookie sheet that has been sprayed with pam. Remove from grill and let stand for 10 minutes. Cut thin to size of figs and place on top of roast. Place beef on top of figs. Prepare idaho oven as instructed until idaho oven is hot. Bake for about 3 hours, or until a meat thermometer registers 155 degrees and figs are tender. Remove from oven and remove the figs, letting them cool. When cool enough, remove the figs from the stems with a slotted spoon and set aside. Slice the beef thinly against the grain. Cut the asparagus into 1 inch pieces. Cook on grill with the asparagus until just tender. Add the red lentils to the asparagus, about 5 mins before serving. Slice the beef thinly against the grain. Dill the figs. Combine the mustard and butter into blender or food processor. Add enough mustard mixture to form a paste. To serve, place some figs in the bottom of each of 4 plates, top wit mustard mixture, and sprinkle on the remaining figs.

title: Tarragon Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 1 broccoli | 3 cups thinly sliced salted grilled broccolini ( about 1/2 pound ) | 6 key limes, juice of | 2 tablespoons tarragon vinegar
instructions: Separate broccoli from stems and cut stem ends off.

title: Basic Microwave Taftas
ingredients: 4 -6 small lettuce | 1 teaspoon saffron threads
instructions: In a microwave proof dish place half a lettuce. Cover it with the saffron, cover the dish with a damp dishcloth and microwave for about 1 minute, rearranging the lettuce for a couple minutes. Using a fork gently rub the saffron over the lettuce until the saffron melts and is evenly distributed. Serves.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,orange juice concentrate,fennel seed,citric acid,lamb chop
title: Maraschino Lamb Shanks
ingredients: 1/4 cup frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed | 2 teaspoons citric acid | 1 1/2 teaspoons maraschino cherries | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed | 8 lamb chops | fresh orange juice or bottled lemon juice
instructions: Mix orange juice concentrate, citric acid, maraschino cherries, and fennel seed in a large zipper top plastic bag. Add lamb, coat well with marinade, squeeze out excess air, and seal. Marinate in refrigerator for 24 hours. Preheat grill on high. Drain lamb, reserving marinade, and oil from the lamb. Reserve marinade. Grill lamb, 4 inches away from heat, and baste with reserved marinade. Grill for 10 to 15 minutes, until cooked to desired doneness. Serve with orange or lemon juice.

Random Ingredients: black cardamom pod,cayenne,walnut,chicken stock,soymilk,celery seed,curd cottage cheese,lemon
title: Finnish Spicy Cheese Soup - Cottage Cheese Free
ingredients: 1 teaspoon walnuts ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon celery seed ( if using ) | 1/4 teaspoon black cardamom pod ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne ( or to taste ) | 2 pinches cheddar ( optional ) | 14 ounces low-fat curd cottage cheese | chicken stock ( optional ) | 2 -3 lemons ( zest and juice ) ( optional )
instructions: Grind the walnuts into fine crumbs using all the spices and cheese in a food processor or blender. Add in the chicken stock and lemon zest and juice, if desired, to make a smooth creamy soup. If using a blender, pulse the mixture very briefly in the blender, until fine and well mixed. Add in the paneer and stir for a minute or two. Serve at once.

title: Poached Pears With Fresh Spring Onions
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs bartlett pears ( or 4 firm but lrg ones ) | 5 1/2 - 6 cups chicken stock ( approx ) | 2 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast
instructions: Wash pears and put in bowl. To a heavy pot, add 5 1/2 cups of the stock. Cover and let rise till doubled. Pour over pears, cover and let rise till almost doubled again. Remove pears and peel, reserving the stock. Put pears in pot and bake, uncovered at 400 for 40 - 50 min or till soft. Drain the pears in a sieve lined with a kitchen towel. Save the cooking water used to measure the liquid. Add some of the reserved stock to a blender or food processor and puree, adding a little cooking water if necessary. Return pears to strained stock. Measure 4 cups of the liquid from the pears and pour back into pot or bowl. Heat the remaining stock, add yeast to taste, bring to boil, pour over pears and let stand 5 min or till pears are tender. Transfer to a container and refrigerate till lukewarm, at least 12 hrs or overnight. Heat oven to 400°f. Serve pears warm with bread slices.

Random Ingredients: tomato,red wine,cayenne pepper,wheat pita bread,beef bouillon granule,chicken
title: Spanish Tomato and Chicken Pitas
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef or 1 lb ground chicken | 1/2 cup tomato, minced | 1/4 cup dry red wine | 3 tablespoons beef bouillon granules | 1 tablespoon cayenne pepper | 1 whole wheat pita bread, split and warmed
instructions: Combine beef, tomato, and wine in medium sauce pan. Cover and bring to boil on low heat.

title: Linguine with a Plot Twist
ingredients: 1 package linguine | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh dill | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh thyme | 1 jar prepared sweet peppers with herb pesto sauce | 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1/4 cup shredded asiago cheese | 1 dash hot pepper sauce
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook linguine at a boil until cooked through yet firm to the bite, about 11 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Crookies for 2
ingredients: 1 cup low-fat yogurt ( i used greek-style ) | 3 tablespoons creamy peanut butter | 1 teaspoon catsup | 1 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 can sliced broccoli florets, well drained | 1/2 cup thinly sliced unpeeled cucumber ( i used regular cucumber ) | 25 fresh ladyfingers, halved length-wise ( i used fresh pita pockets )
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the pita pockets in a bowl and mix well. Add enough yogurt to make a paste, but don't get too sticky, otherwise the mixture might not be as uniform as you want it or the crookies will break. Put a few ladyfinger halves on the bottom edge of each crookie, and spread a thin layer of the peanut butter mixture evenly over them. Fold them over the filling to seal them, then sprinkle with more bread crumbs. Chill until serving.

Random Ingredients: black pepper,chinese ham,self rising flour,kalamata olive,icing sugar
title: Fried Honey Ham With Olive and Cinnamon Recipe
ingredients: 1 kg black honey ham ( honey weight ) | 1/4 cup icing sugar | 2 tablespoons self-rising flour | 1 teaspoon ground black pepper | 1/2 cup kalamata olive, chopped
instructions: Wrap the ham in foil and put into the microwave for 5 minutes to dry slightly. Remove ham from microwave and cut in approximately ¼ inch slices. Dip the ham slices into the icing sugar and coat well. Fry the ham slices on both sides in a hot frying pan for approx 5 minutes or until crisp and golden. Place ham on a serving plate and scatter chopped olives on top. Eat with jam or cream. Cooking time of 3 minutes depends on quantity of ham you use. Note, cooking time does not include drying the olives.

Random Ingredients: chinese five spice powder,onion,chicken stock,haddock fillet,vanilla sugar,fennel bulb,baby potato,white bean
title: Fennel and Cod Coddle
ingredients: 500 g baby potatoes, cut in half | 100 g smoked haddock fillets, skinned and diced | 300 g fresh white beans, blanched | 1 onion, diced | 1 fennel bulb, diced | 1 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 2 cups chicken stock | 1 teaspoon vanilla sugar | 1 teaspoon white cooking beans
instructions: Put the baby potatoes into a saucepan with a lid and add water. If they have not completely covered, add a little extra stock. Bring to the boil, boil 2 - 3 minutes and then drain them. Return the potatoes and any cooking liquid to the pan and simmer over low heat for a further 15 minutes. Put the fish, beans, onion, fennel and five spice into a saucepan, add the chicken stock. Break up the fish with a fork then bring to the boil. Simmer for 10 minutes. Stir in the white bean liquid, white cooking beans and the vanilla sugar, bring to the boil and simmer for another 5 minutes, remove the fennel bulb and serve warm.

title: Perfect Oats to Have on Wholemeal or Corned Flour
ingredients: 1 cup wholemeal or cornmeal | 1/2 cup oatmeal | olive oil
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and leave to rest for 10 mins or so. Preheat oven to 220ºc. Use an oiled cookie sheet or cookie sheet, or a non stick cake tin to put rolled or to have a circle on your work space. Put a heaped spoonful of batter onto the tomoato, or cornbread, and bake for 5 - 7 mins or until edges are golden brown and crisp. Leave to cool for a couple of mins before lifting up with a spatula and sliding onto a plate. Serve sprinkled with a little freshly ground black pepper or oregano if desired.

Random Ingredients: skirt steak,plain yogurt,black peppercorn,beef chuck,kosher salt,red chile pepper,artichoke heart
title: Artichokes Tzatziki
ingredients: 4 fresh red chile peppers, sliced | 1 jar marinated artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | 1 pound boneless skirt steak | 1 pound fresh beef chuck, cut into 1 inch cubes | kosher salt to taste | 12 whole black peppercorns, cracked | 1 quart plain yogurt
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium heat. Stir in chile peppers, artichokes, and ground chuck. Cook and stir until beef is just browned, about 5 minutes. Remove skillet from heat. Season with salt, peppercorns, and plain yogurt.

title: Easy Pudding
ingredients: 2 packages instant vanilla pudding mix | 5 tablespoons whipped topping
instructions: Spray a 1 quart casserole dish with cooking spray. Pour hot vanilla pudding mix over pudding. Chill well. Top with whipped topping.

Random Ingredients: chocolate syrup,brown rice,picante sauce,cream tartar,chicken tender
title: Mexican Chicken
ingredients: 1 cup brown rice | 1/4 cup picante sauce | 2 tablespoons chili-flavored picante sauce | 1 tablespoon cream of tartar | 1 pound chicken tenders
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a large bowl, stir together the brown rice, picante sauce, and one of the chili flavored hot sauce. Lay the chicken in the baking dish. Pour the rice mixture over the chicken. Cover, and bake for 45 minutes in the preheated oven, until the chicken pieces have begun to turn opaque. Uncover the dish, and continue baking for 40 minutes to an hour, until the chicken is thoroughly cooked. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: apple juice,mandarin orange segment,garlic,velveeta cheese,yellow pepper
title: Cheesy Mandarin Peppers
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs velveeta cheese ( mild or extra mild ) | 1 cup apple juice | 2 tablespoons garlic, minced | 8 large yellow sweet peppers, seeded | 0.5 can mandarin orange segments, drained and juice reserved
instructions: Cut velvetta into 1 to 1 1/2 inch cubes and place in food processor, or blender. Add apple juice and garlic and process briefly or until smooth. Pour mixture into baking dish or crockpot with peppers. Bake, uncovered, in preheated 400 degree oven for 20 minutes until lightly browned and bubbly.

title: Strawberries and Leeks
ingredients: 2 leeks | 500 g raspberries
instructions: Blanch leeks under running water, then halve lengthways and remove white portion of root. Slice leeks at least a quarter the width and scrape out the white centre. Slice leeks thinly on the diagonal. Bring large pot of water to boil. Add salt, stir in leeks and simmer until leeks are tender. Add raspberries and cook until warmed through. Serve immediately.

title: Simple Garlic Crusted Stuffed Lumpia
ingredients: 20 large lumpia skins | 1 pint sour cream | 1 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Cook about 5 minutes so the lumpia can open up. Then remove from the pan, pat dry with a paper towel on the underside and side of your pan and carefully remove. The lumpia should still be a little lumpy. While the lumpia is working, make the sour cream. Place sour cream on low in a bowl and whip until it is light and creamy. Add the garlic salt. The longer the sour cream sits, the better it tastes. Add about a dozen or more lumpia shells to the sour cream. I usually add about 20 to 30 more and roll with a rolling pin to make sure the lumpia is well coated. Lay them out on a wax paper lined cookie sheet that they are close to each other. I get two sheets of cookie paper each individually. You are essentially just trying to wrap each package around the sour cream and stick it in there. If you want to be fancy, you can just make a bag of the sour cream and add it to the wrapped lumpia. If you are making the bag of filled wrappers, roll each wrapped wrapper, and then wrap the entire bag in a plastic wrap. Once all your wrapped wrappers have been wrapped, heat a skillet on medium to medium high heat. When your pan is hot, place the wrapped lumpia in the pan, they should start to bubble right up. Make sure they are all closed. If you want a more golden brown or crunch, turn the heat down slightly and flip them right side up. Turn the lumpia over when they are all facing up in the pan. Allow to cook for approximately 30 seconds or so until the bottoms are nicely browned. Turn the heat off and then remove the lumpia from the pan. I usually slice the lumpia and then place on a plate covered with a paper towel. Spray the pan with pam, it is very important to heat the pan as long as you can. Add just enough water or cooking spray to just cover the entire bottom of the pan. Try not to cover the bottom by too much. I usually turn my stove down to low and put a paper towel over the pan so that the water will drain off at least a couple of tablespoons of the pan drippings. Once the pan is covered with the water, put a lid on it and let sit for approximately 2 to 3 minutes. I usually let this sit for about 10 minutes to soak up some of the water. Turn the burner off and open up a sink full of ice and ice water and a clean sink full of ice and water. Then drain all your lumpia and place some into the ice water. After several minutes, flip and repeat with the rest. You should end up with a beautiful browned lumpia on top. Remove the lumpia from the pan and place onto a clean plate covered with foil. I usually then serve these on a small plate with a salad and a glass of wine. They are great on top of rice. You definately can use bread or anything.

title: Low Fat Creamy Primavera
ingredients: 8 medium baking potatoes | 1 lb medium asparagus | 8 ounces whole wheat spaghetti, broken into bite sized pieces | 1 cup half-and-half | 1/2 cup raspberries ( to taste ) | 1 egg | 1 1/2 tablespoons vanilla
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Prepare a non stick 9x13 inch baking dish. Peel potatoes and slice into 1/8 inch thick rounds. Bring a large pot of water to boil, add potato slices, and cook until tender but still firm, about 12 - 18 minutes. Drain, and set aside. Bring a large pot of water to boil. Add asparagus and cook until tender crisp tender, about 3 minutes, drain well. Combine pasta, half and half, raspberries, egg, and vanilla in a 1 1/2 quart glass measure. Mix well. Spoon into prepared baking dish and top with the asparagus mixture. Bake for 30 minutes, or until heated through and top is golden.

title: Pasta With Coconut Milk
ingredients: 1 quart coconut milk | 1 package dry pasta | 1 cup confectioners'sugar
instructions: Combine the coconut milk and pasta in a large saucepan. Bring to a boil, then immediately remove from heat. Let cool, and stir in the confectioners' sugar. Pour pasta into a large shallow bowl, and pour over the coconut milk mixture to coat. Cover, and refrigerate until chilled, about 3 hours.

title: Aardappel - a Fresh Ginger, Almond and Fennel Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup slivered raw almonds | 1/4 cup thinly sliced fresh gingerroot, peel left on and finely diced if using fresh gingerroot | 2 -3 teaspoons yellow mustard seeds, white | 1/2 teaspoon fennel, ground or 1/2 teaspoon cardamom, ground | lettuce ( to garnish ) | 1/2 cup slivered raw almonds | 1/3 cup sliced almonds | 1/2 cup thinly sliced fresh gingerroot ( to garnish )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f. Place a few almonds on a sheet of wax paper and toast them until lightly golden brown, about 6 to 8 minutes remove from the oven and set aside. In a blender or food processor, puree the almonds with the ginger and mustard seeds and add the ground fennel. Place a mound of lettuce on a large serving plate. Top with the almond ginger salad and sprinkle with some slivered almonds. Garnish with the reserved almonds. Serve.

title: Buckwheat and Apple Damper
ingredients: 2 cups bread flour | 1 cup beet flour | 1 cup peas | 1 cup sliced apple | 1/2 teaspoon dijon mustard ( optional )
instructions: Combine flour and beet and put in a bowl. Combine sliced apple into bowl until well mixed and put aside. Mix dry ingredients together until they form a coarse, similar mixture. Put a little filling onto each section of bread, add a bit of dijon and mix well. Put bread on a greased tray and leave at least 30 mins before using. They don't have to be greasy.

title: Green Olive & Tahini Vinaigrette (Huitres)
ingredients: 1 box malt vinegar or 1 box vinaigrette salad dressing | 1 can pitted green olives, drained | ice cube | 2 tablespoons tahini | margarita mix
instructions: In a blender, mix the vinegar, olives and remaining ingredients. Blend until smooth. Pour mixture into a glass bottle that has been lightly rinsed and dusted with margarita mix.

title: Danish Green Chile Appetizer
ingredients: 1 whole green chili, cut lengthwise into very fine rings, stems removed, seeds and membrane removed, and membrane cut crosswise into 2 or 3 thin slivers | 5 cardamom pods, bruised | 5 tablespoons ketjelly liqueur
instructions: Place chili rings, cardamom pods, and kirsch into a blender or food processor.

title: Apricot and Mustard Salad
ingredients: 1 cup sugar | 1 tablespoon wasabi powder | 1 teaspoon mustard greens or 1 teaspoon mustard greens | 1 tablespoon apricot, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon wasabi powder | 1/4 cup rum or 1/4 cup cognac | 1 tablespoon tarragon vinegar | 12 amaretti cookies or 12 other crisp tart cookie
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together and add rest of ingredients. Add cookies and stir through. Allow to sit for 30 minutes and enjoy.

title: Parmigiano-Reggiano-Arrangement Rice
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups rice or 1 1/4 cups arborio rice | 1/4 - 3/4 cup coconut, shredded | 1/2 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese, freshly grated ( or you may use a combination of cheese and grana padano ) | 1 lime, zest | 3 tablespoons fresh grated coconut, to garnish | ice cube, for serving ( optional )
instructions: Place the rice, shredded coconut, 1/2 cup of the parmigiano reggiano, and lime zest in a food processor or a hand blender. Cover tightly and process until the mixture is chopped and well mixed. Transfer to a serving bowl and sprinkle with more reserved parmigiano reggiano if desired. Garnish with lime slices and extra freshly grated coconut if using. Serve immediately.

title: Grilled Orange-Pepper Beef Filets
ingredients: 1/4 cup crumbled feta | 1 tablespoon orange bell pepper, chopped | 5 beef tenderloin steaks, 1-inch thick
instructions: Mix feta and orange pepper in shallow dish. Sprinkle steaks generously with salt and pepper. Place steaks in feta mixture, turning once. Place steaks in resealable plastic bag.

title: Tofu and Dashi (Kinoko Donburi)
ingredients: 1 piece firm tofu, cut into small squares about 1-inch square | 2 cups dashi | nanami togarashi ( japanese seven spice )
instructions: Place tofu in a steamer set over a pot of lightly salted water and bring to a boil. Carefully remove tofu's top shell. Remove and discard skin. Pour enough dashi to cover tofu, about 1 cup, about 1/3 cup, on a baking sheet. Cook over high heat in a preheated Japanese skillet until dashi is reduced to about 1 cup, about 5 minutes. Flip, recover, and simmer briefly to dry a bit, about 2 minutes. Meanwhile, heat a skillet with at least 1 inch of water. Drop in nanami togarashi pieces.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,icing sugar,rice noodle,xanthan gum,kosher salt,wide egg noodle,five spice powder,baking potato
title: Crunchy Five-Spice Noodles With Peanut Oil and Soy
ingredients: 4 teaspoons five-spice powder | 1/2 lb rice noodles, small | 4 teaspoons peanut oil | 1 large peeled baking potato, cut into 1/2 inch chunks | 1 teaspoon kosher salt, to taste | 1 package icing sugar | 1 package xanthan gum | 3 cups peanut oil | 2 1/2 teaspoons five-spice powder, divided | 4 cups icing sugar
instructions: For the pikka, in a small bowl mix the five spice powder with 1/4 cup water. In a deep pan, heat one tspn of the peanut oil. Meanwhile, in a second fry pan put the baking potato, followed by a pinch of salt. Sprinkle the potato with 1/2 tspn of the five spice powder. After 15 seconds, transfer to a plate lined with paper towels, then drain on paper towels, then squeeze excess water out. Set aside the rest of the oil. For the noodles, in a large deep frying pan, add one tspn peanut oil and when it’s very hot, add the potato, and stir fry for a few minutes. Then add 2/3 of the package of icing sugar and stir to dissolve the sugar. After another minute, add 2 cups of the measured fizz oil. After that, stir in three 1/2 tspn five spice powder. After that, add one cup of the measured fizz oil. After that, stir in another cup of the measured fizz oil, 4 tspn of five spice powder and the fried potato. When the last 2 tbspn of fizz oil has separated, stir in 1/4 tspn of the five spice powder. Add the noodles to the frying pan and cook over medium high heat for about 3 minutes, stirring often, until crisp and golden. Drain on paper towels. Once cooled, mound the pakka on a platter and sprinkle with remaining ¾ tspn five spice powder. Enjoy.

title: Homemade Pumpkin Seeds and Peppers
ingredients: 3 cups peeled, cubed pumpkin seeds | 1 bunch fresh pepperoncini peppers, chopped | 1 clove grated fresh ginger root
instructions: Combine pumpkin seeds, pepperoncini peppers, and ginger together in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook and stir frequently, making sure that gizzles as the seeds cook, until the seeds break up and are tender, about 10 minutes. Allow mixture to cool, then use immediately as directed by a guide.

title: Green Cabbage with Tomatoes & Pecorino Romano
ingredients: 1 lb medium green cabbage, about 3/4 inch | 2 medium grape tomatoes | 4 tablespoons finely grated pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Trim any tough outer leaves from cauliflower. Wash well, then break into small florets about 1/3 inch wide. Core, and finely chop tomatoes and put into a bowl. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add small pieces of cauliflower and cook until just soft, about 2 minutes. Drain well, then put in a bowl of ice water to stop the cooking. Drain again. Transfer to serving bowl, sprinkle with cheese and serve.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck roast,marmite,mozzarella cheese,peanut oil vegetable
title: Peking Roast Sandwich
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs boneless beef chuck roast | 1/2 cup marmite | peanut oil or other vegetable oil | 4 thick slices of toasted bread or 4 hoagie rolls
instructions: Cut roast crosswise into 1/4 inch wide slices. In a 10 1/2 x 20 inch jelly roll pan, lay slices in overlapping circles of meat. Sprinkle generously with marmite. Heat oil on stovetop over medium heat. Working in batches, add slices to oil. Cook until golden brown. Drain on absorbent paper to remove excess oil. Meanwhile, heat sandwich rolls according to package directions, or arrange on cookie sheet in single layers. Slice roast crosswise into 1/4 inch slices. Toast sandwiches in oven at 400f or 150° for 8 to 12 minutes.

title: Raspberry & Black Ricotta
ingredients: 400 g fresh raspberries | 1/3 cup orange flower water | 1 1/2 teaspoons black cumin seeds, toasted & ground
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c, gas mark 5 /230°f. Place the raspberries in a roasting tin, scatter over the ground spices & press in a bit of the orange flower water. Roast for 40 - 45 mins, until the raspberries are starting to blacken around the edges. Serve straight away.

title: Balsamic Glaze Okra (Glut & Drambuie)
ingredients: 8 okara ( cut into 1/2 inch thick slices ) | 1 tablespoon gelatin ( or cream of wheat ) | 1 tablespoon cooking wine ( optional ) | 1/2 cup balsamic vinegar ( can use 1/2 & 1/2 % ; add more to taste ) | 3 cups rambuie ( the tiny-sized pieces are what i like to add ; if you don't're going to use them )
instructions: In a glass bowl, sprinkle gelatin on the okara. Stir in a bit of cold water to dissolve the gelatin. Put okara in glass bowl and pour cold glaze over and leave for about a half an hour before serving. This is best stored in an airtight container in the fridge. You can eat right away. title: Carnitas with Chilean Beef
ingredients: 1 package beef stew meat, cut into pieces | 1 jar maraschino cherries, drained and juice reserved
instructions: Mix stew meat, cherries, and reserved beef juice in a saucepan. Cook over medium heat until juice simmers.

title: Chinese Sugar Pork

instructions: In a large bowl, toss pork tenderloins with sugar until thoroughly coated. Place coated pork in a steaming rack set over a pan of hot water. title: Oyster and Pineapple Soup

instructions: Place the oysters in a pan and cook over low heat for a couple of minutes until they are cooked. Remove the oysters from the pan and set aside. Discard the shells and the shank. Stir in the fresh mint and serve hot.

title: Beef and Quinoa Stew
ingredients: 500 g beef chuck, cut into 2. 5cm cubes | 2 tablespoons tomato paste | 4 tablespoons creme fraiche or 4 tablespoons sour cream | 1 1/2 cups quinoa, cooked
instructions: Brown the beef in a little oil. Add the tomato paste and quinoa. Cover and cook over a low heat for 1 hour.

title: Tortilla Chip Eggs
ingredients: 2 eggs noodles | 2 -3 slices banana | salt and pepper | tortilla chips or crumbled tortilla chips
instructions: Fry noodles until tender. Drain noodles, toss in mashed banana, cover and keep warm. Serve with tortilla chips or crumbled tortillas.

ingredients: 14 ounces tomatoes with green chile peppers, canned, drained and chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons dark chocolate, melted | 1/2 teaspoon chopped fresh tarragon | 1 cup self-rising flour | 1 dash hot pepper sauce ( optional ) | 1/4 cup chopped scallions
instructions: Mix tomatoes, chocolate, and tarragon in a bowl until well combined but not overmixed. To prepare bread, mix flour, and pepper sauce together in a separate bowl. Add to the blender.
