title: Sun-Dried Tomato Noodles
ingredients: 6 ounces bow tie pasta | 1 tablespoon asafoetida powder | 1/2 lb ground pork | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Meanwhile, in a skillet, brown the smoked pork over medium high heat, turning the meat and breaking apart as it cooks, for 5 minutes. In a small bowl, combine the asafoetida, sun dried tomatoes, onion powder and salt and pepper and mix well.

title: Fantastic Fish (Lobster)
ingredients: 8 fish fillets | 2 teaspoons mustard powder | 2 teaspoons celery, chopped | 1 tablespoon tarragon, chopped | 1 teaspoon celery
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Use two pieces of aluminium foil to protect your hands from any hot water on your kitchen towel. Place fish in a single layer on the foil with mustard powder, celery, tarragon and pepper. Do this twice during the process. Wrap the foil around each fillet and place on a non stick baking tin, seam side down. Cover with a large piece of aluminium foil and bake for about 15 minutes. Allow to cool off, and serve. These will stay fresh for a few days if refrigerated. If refrigerated, place fish on its foil, skin side down. Bake for another 7 minutes, then turn the foil over. Cook for another 7 minutes.

Random Ingredients: coriander leaf,vanilla flavoring,okra,sunflower oil,white bean,pesto sauce,halloumi cheese,red bell pepper
title: Fried Okra and Halloumi With Vegetables
ingredients: 6 slices halloumi cheese ( thin slices ) | 6 tablespoons pesto sauce | 1 slice grated fresh cheese ( approx 4 tbsp per slice ) | 1/2 red bell pepper, diced | 1 cup white beans, blanched ( approx 2 small baby cos-beans ) | 3 tablespoons sunflower oil | 1 teaspoon red vanilla flavoring | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh coriander leaves ( approx 2 tbls. )
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of the oil in a wok. Fry each slice of halloumi for 1 - 2 minutes or until cooked crisp, turning once. Remove each slice as cooked and set aside. Fry the bell pepper in the remaining oil 1 - 2 minutes or until tender. Tip in the beans and continue to fry for 2 more minutes. Sprinkle over the cooked peppers and season to taste with sea salt and pepper. Spoon the pesto over the okra and top with cheese and sunflower seeds.

title: Niter Kebab - Ground Beef and Fritters
ingredients: 500 g ground beef or 500 g lamb | 1 tablespoon fenugreek seeds | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil or 1 tablespoon ghee
instructions: Mix the meat, fenugreek and oil and mix well. Wet your hands with water to keep them from sticking. With wet hands shape balls and press each ball gently on a flat surface to flatten. Repeat with the other balls. You should have approximately 8 mini kabobs.

title: Granny's Awesome Chicken Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 6 medium russet potatoes | 1 teaspoon grated orange rind | 2 cups bottled hot green chili peppers, sliced | 1 large head lettuce | 2 cooked cooked boneless skinless chicken breast halves, shredded | 1/2 cup malt vinegar ( or white wine vinegar ) or 1/2 cup cider vinegar
instructions: Place chicken breasts on foil lined cookie sheet,. Cut sides away from the cheese slices. Brush cheese slices with raspberry vinegar. Sprinkle with orange rind. Place hot green chilies over chicken. Broil until tops start to char and turn golden brown. This is not necessarily a heat, but it's how the chilie and vinegar cook... Slice potatoes vertically into quarters, place in a bowl, add ice cold water to cover, and squeeze out excess water. Cook potatoes by your preferred method.. This method works best for me, just make sure the potatoes are well drained and hot. Remove potatoes from pan when cool enough to handle. Chill while preparing lettuce wraps. Place lettuce wraps on a plate with a lettuce leaf, and spoon chicken breast on top.

title: Quick 'n' Easy Applesauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cumin powder | 1 -2 tablespoon green chili, finely chopped ( optional ) | 1 hot green chili, finely chopped ( optional ) | 1 can mixed vegetables
instructions: In medium pot over medium heat cook and stir chilies and green chilies for about 5 minutes, stirring constantly. Add mixed veggies and stir until mixed well. Cook and stir until veggies are crisp and tender and heated through.

Random Ingredients: mint,granny smith apple,egg noodle,pizza sauce,clove,grouper fillet,corn tortilla
title: Grouper Tacos
ingredients: 4 frozen thin-cut grouper fillets, thawed | 1/2 cup pizza sauce | 1/4 chipotle pepper in adobo sauce, finely chopped | 1 pinch ground cloves | 1/4 cup chopped fresh mint, or to taste | 1 egg noodles, cooked and drained | 1 corn tortillas, warmed
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 f on a baking sheet. Whisk pizza sauce, chipotle pepper, and cloves together in a small bowl. Spread bread crumbs on a small plate. Place chicken breast fillets on top of bread crumbs while keeping a small pile of crumbs remaining around edge of the bread crumbs. Bake in the preheated oven until the fish flakes easily with a fork, about 20 minutes. While chicken is baking, warm sauce in a small saucepan over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: ginger garlic paste,mustard powder,bean sprout,pinto bean,vanilla essence,chicken wing,dark brown sugar,coriander seed
title: Yummy, Yummy Chicken Wings
ingredients: 1 lb chicken wings, cleaned | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar | 1/2 cup cooked pinto beans | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 1/2 teaspoons crushed coriander seeds | 1 1/2 teaspoons mustard powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla essence | 1 cup bean sprouts
instructions: Dice chicken wings into 2 inch lengths. In a dry pan put the dark brown sugar, chicken wings and dark brown sugar and bring over low heat for about 2 minutes. Add cooked beans, ginger garlic paste, crushed coriander and mustard powder and continue to cook for about 5 minutes. Add in the vanilla essence and stir. Reduce to medium heat and cook for about 3 minutes. Add in the coriander seeds and mix well. Allow to simmer for 2 - 3 minutes. Transfer to a large bowl and mix to coat the chicken wings evenly in the mixture. Enjoy.

title: Cayenne Iced Tea
ingredients: 2 1/2 teaspoons black peppercorns | 2 teaspoons cayenne pepper or 2 teaspoons red chili pepper flakes ( or to taste ) | 2 teaspoons tea
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a small tea infuser and bring them to a boil. Remove from the heat and stir. Let it stand to steep for 2 minutes. Strain through a fine tea filter or a tea brewer. Serve immediately. Store in the refrigerator.

title: Spiced French Fries
ingredients: 2 green cardamom pods | 1 teaspoon vegetable oil or 1 teaspoon of oil
instructions: Separate the cardomomom pods and white in thin segments and set aside. Heat the oil. After 10 seconds, add the cardom and fry on medium to high heat. Turning once until they turn a deep golden brown colour. Using a slotted spoon, remove cardom pods, taking care not to break them. Set aside and keep warm in a small bowl.

title: Maurice's Mulligatawny Soup
ingredients: 1 lb beef sirloin steak, trimmed of all fat, sliced into thin strips | 2 medium onions, sliced into thin slivers | 1 cup dry red wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon palm oil | 2 cups canned tomato puree, undiluted | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon black cardamom pod | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 cup brewed coffee
instructions: Marinate meat and onions in mixture of the vinegar, oil, tomato puree, cardamom and bouillon. Cover and refrigerate overnight for best flavor. Soup can be made several hours before serving.

title: Yummy Margaritas
ingredients: 2 lbs yellow onions, peeled | 2/3 cup tequila
instructions: Mince yellow onion in food processor. Add tequila and process until finely milled. Transfer to airtight container.

title: Thai Peanut Salad
ingredients: 400 g plain roasted peanuts at room temperature | 400 g coriander leaves
instructions: Toast the peanuts as per the package instructions without any oil. Place them in a bowl, and combine with the coriander leaves. Pour over any remaining olive oil from the peanuts. Use as a dip for vegetables. Variation, use cashew nuts instead of peanuts.

title: Broiled Blueberry and Curry
ingredients: 1 tablespoon coriander seed, crushed | 1/4 teaspoon sea salt | 3/4 cup fresh blueberries or 3/4 cup frozen blueberries | 1 packet thai red curry paste | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning mix | 1 teaspoon coarsely ground dried blueberries ( optional ) or 1 teaspoon thawed frozen blueberries ( optional )
instructions: In medium size skillet, toast coriander seeds until fragrant, 30 seconds to 1 minute or over low heat, moving around and flipping once. Transfer the coriander to plate and toss with salt.

title: Penne With Fish Sauce by Sy Sy
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs penne | 4 ounces galangal, finely chopped | 3 shallots, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon vinegar
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. To make sauce, combine first 8 ingredients. Add remaining ingredients and saute until fish is heated. Serve over fresh pasta with salad.

ingredients: 3 pounds mozzarella cheese, shredded | 2 cans chopped green chiles | 2 cups beef bouillon granules | 2 tablespoons chopped green chile pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix the cheese, green chilies, beef bouillon granules, and green chile peppers. Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake at 350 degrees f for 1 hour.

title: Curried Leeks, Chocolate Mousse
ingredients: 1 envelope german chocolate cake mix | 2 packages active dry yeast | 2 tablespoons cold water | 1 cup golden raisin, divided | 6 leeks, well washed and sliced | 1 teaspoon curry powder
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine all ingredients and stir until well blended. Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Mexican Pizza Squares
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated crescent dinner rolls | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning | 1 cup shredded gruyere cheese | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees f. Prepare the rolls according to package directions. Flatten the rolls to make crusts from the cresent dough. Place the dough in a large cast iron skillet. Mix the taco seasoning and cheese in a small bowl.

title: Raspberry Corn Dip
ingredients: 2 cans creamed corn | 1 small yellow sweet pepper | 1 small sweet red pepper | 2 packages cream cheese | 1/4 cup chopped fresh raspberries | 1/8 teaspoon asafoetida powder | salt and pepper | 1/4 cup extra-sharp cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Cut a slit lengthwise in each sweet pepper, lengthwise. Remove seeds from peppers and remove stem. Slice into rings. Wrap each pepper onion style with 2 rings of cream cheese. Place peppers and cream cheese in crockpot and stir until cheese is melted and light golden brown. Stir in raspberries. Cover. Cook on high 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Stir in asafetida, salt, pepper and cheese. Serve immediately or refrigerate for up to 6 hours.

title: Rick Bayless's Puerto Rican Red Chile Rice
ingredients: 1/3 cup cachaca ( mexican dark rum ) | 2 tablespoons red chile, stemmed and minced | 2 cups long-grain white rice, rinsed well
instructions: In a large skillet, combine the cachaça and chiles. Add rice, stir with a wooden spoon and cook over low heat until most of the liquid has been absorbed, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: purpose flour,soda water,sourdough bread,vegetable oil cooking,pomegranate seed,currant
title: Currant Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups dry currant | 1/2 cup pomegranate seeds | 250 g all-purpose flour | 1/2 cup soda water, approximately | 1/2 cup vegetable oil or 1/2 cup cooking oil | 8 slices sourdough bread
instructions: In a bowl, blend currants with pomegranate seeds just to make them a little bit more fluid. In a separate bowl, blend pomegranate liquid and flour. Add soda water and oil to sugar/currant/pecan mix slowly until smooth. Divide the currant batter into 8 portions. Roll each portion flat and cut the bread into 8 slices. Using your hands, stretch each slice of bread until it's about 2cm thick. Place on a lightly greased baking sheet, brush with a little milk, and bake in the oven at 170°c for 10 - 15 minutes, or until golden and crispy over the edges. If your bread is done before the kids take the first bite, warm through the baking soda in a pot, then serve straight from with tea.

title: Mandarin Sprit Smoothie
ingredients: 1 cup plain greek yogurt | 1 can mandarin oranges, drained and chopped | 1 can black olives, drained and chopped | 1 green bunch spinach, chopped | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne ( or more to taste ) | 1/4 cup orange juice
instructions: Mix all ingredients and serve.

title: Oaxacan Shrimp
ingredients: 1 lb perch-oelted medium shrimp, shelled and deveined ( about 40 per shrimp ) | 4 scallions, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup oaxacan fragrant fragrant fragrant seafood flavored cooking sauce ( kecap manis )
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together shrimp. Cover, and refrigerate for approximately 30 minutes.

title: Irish Bay Scallops
ingredients: 3 ounces canadian bacon, chopped | 1 teaspoon butter | 2 bay leaves | 1/2 teaspoon butter | 8 ounces sea scallops | crushed ice-cold tea | salt and freshly ground black pepper, to taste
instructions: Place bacon in dutch oven or large skillet. Over medium heat, cook bacon until crisp and fat is rendered, 10 to 15 minutes. Remove bacon to large bowl with slotted spoon, leaving drippings in pan. Add butter.

title: Currant Couscous
ingredients: 1/4 kg currants | 1/4 kg coconut | 2 pints couscous, cooked | 1 tablespoon coriander powder
instructions: Put all the ingredients in a pan, bring to the boil. Stir. Cover and simmer for 20 mins, until all the liquid is absorbed.

title: Tortilla Chips With Vegetables
ingredients: 1 package corn tortilla chips | 1/3 bag fresh broccoli | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained and sliced | 1/3 cup margarine, melted ( do not substitute )
instructions: Place 1/2 bag of corn chips in a greased bowl. Sprinkle the vegetables over the chips. Sprinkle the margarine over that. Sprinkle with the remaining 1/2 bag of chips. Microwave for one minute. You may add other vegetables to the pan if preferred.

title: Artichoke Balls
ingredients: 2 cups sultanas | 1 package artichoke hearts, drained | 2 tablespoons prepared mustard
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a small bowl, thoroughly blend sultanas, artichoke hearts and mustard.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,lettuce,plum tomato,lemongrass,fettuccine pasta,liquid smoke,olive oil,pepper sauce
title: Sweet and Sour Fettuccine
ingredients: 8 ounces dry fettuccine pasta | 6 plum tomatoes, seeded and diced | 1/4 cup sliced pickled lemongrass | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 1/2 tablespoons dark rum | 2 tablespoons mild hot pepper sauce | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke | shredded lettuce
instructions: Cook fettuccine in large pot of boiling, salted water until al dente, about 8 minutes. Meanwhile, combine tomatoes, lemongrass, olive oil, rum, hot pepper sauce, and liquid smoke in bowl. Gently toss to coat. Add tomato mixture to pasta and toss to mix.

title: Camarones Al Pimenton (Shrimp on Fiddle)
ingredients: 1 lb raw shrimp, shelled, deveined and butterflied | 1 teaspoon celery salt | 1 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: Melt butter in skillet over medium heat. Saute shrimp for about 5 minutes per side before turning. Remove shrimp from skillet with slotted spoon and place on a paper towel. Sprinkle shrimp with celery salt and pinch of baking powder. Return butter to skillet and stir. Cook for 2 minutes while continuing to cook shrimp over medium high heat until liquid boils and shrimp are browned, stirring constantly.

title: Mandarin Orange Trampie
ingredients: 1 bag baby spinach | 1 can mandarin oranges | 1 package ladyfingers
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. In a bowl, mix the baby shrimp with the mandarin oranges. Place a layer of the shrimp in the bottom of two ramekins, and sprinkle with a little of the spinach. Repeat layers, starting with the shrimp, and sprinkling each layer with a little more spinach. Repeat the layers to create three trampies. Place ramekins on a cookie sheet. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes in the preheated oven, or until the shrimp are opaque and the spinach is tender.

Random Ingredients: bulb garlic,oyster sauce,spinach leaf,chili pepper,daikon radish
title: Fresh Spinach With Daikon Pickles
ingredients: 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 teaspoon chopped chili pepper | 1 lb daikon radish, very thinly sliced | 8 ounces spinach leaves, packed | chopped fresh chili pepper, garnish | roasted garlic, garnish
instructions: In a glass or ceramic bowl or other nonreactive serving dish, mix the oyster sauce with 1 teaspoon of chopped chili pepper. Add the daikon radish, followed by the spinach. Cover, and refrigerate for about 10 minutes or up to 4 hours. Just before serving, garnish with chile pepper.

Random Ingredients: chorizo sausage,asafoetida powder,salt black pepper,tomato paste
title: Easy Low-Fat Spicy Chorizo Appetizer
ingredients: 1 lb smoked chorizo sausage | 14 ounces tomato paste | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 0.5 envelope asafoetida powder
instructions: Cut the sausage into 1 inch pieces. Place all ingredients except for the asafetida or tomato paste, into blender or food processor and purée until smooth. Sprinkle asafoetida on sausage mixture and process on low speed until mixed well. Sprinkle salt and pepper to taste in a small dish or bowl and place in refrigerator to let flavors develop.

title: Foolproof Lentils With Cardamom and Pearl Sugar
ingredients: 400 g lentils, washed, picked over to ensure good drainage | 1 teaspoon lard ( optional ) or 1 teaspoon olive oil ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: Place all ingredients in a pot and cook slowly on low heat until the lentils become soft. Fluff with fork and serve with warm bread.

title: Chinese Fried Snow Peas
ingredients: 1 lb frozen mixed vegetables | 1/4 lb snow peas, strings removed | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon instant minced onion ( optional ) or 2 teaspoons onion powder, from a jar ( optional )
instructions: Slice or dice all vegetables as desired, and saute in hot oil just until crisp tender. Just before serving, saute onions and mushrooms in oil until browned well. Serve immediately.

title: Italian Hot Pego Bar Chicken Wings
ingredients: 1 tablespoon garlic granules | 1 gallon chicken wings, tips removed | 1 cup green olives, pitted and halved | 1 quart skirt steak, cut into thirds
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. In a large baking dish, cover chicken wings with hot tap water.

Random Ingredients: iceberg lettuce,coleslaw mix,french bread cube,beet,wild rice,peanut oil
title: Wild and Cheater Wild Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 can or bottle dark beer | 1 box coleslaw mix | 3 cups chilled cubed raw beets ( about 1 pound ) | 1 package frozen french-style salad-style mixed vegetables | 2 tablespoons peanut oil or 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1 loaf crusty french bread cube
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the beer with coleslaw mix and vegetables. Allow the mixture to thaw. Slice french bread in half lengthwise and remove crusts. Brush both halves of the bread with oil. Place the bread pieces between two paper towels, and pound to flatten slightly. Divide the salad onto 4 dinner plates. Top with french bread cubes, and serve with croutons or sourdough bread wedges.

Random Ingredients: anise seed,mushroom,swiss chard,green onion,squash,cuban bread,italian parsley
title: Swiss Chard Panini
ingredients: 1 teaspoon crushed anise seed | 1 bunch swiss chard, stemmed and chopped | 1 cup sliced mushrooms | 3 green onions, chopped | 1 tablespoon dried italian parsley ( or cilantro ) | 2 packages sliced squash | 4 thin slices cuban bread, toasted
instructions: Place anise seed and chard in a small skillet over medium heat, and cook until the chard has softened, about 5 minutes. Transfer to a bowl, cover, and refrigerate. Meanwhile, place the mushrooms, green onions, parsley, and chard in a large skillet. Cover, and cook until the mushrooms are tender, about 10 to 15 minutes. Remove the cover, stir in the chard, and allow to cool. Place 2 slices of bread, toast, and spread the swiss chard mixture over the toasted bread.

title: Achaari
ingredients: 1 box soft cheese tortellini | 1 box pearl barley | 1 box durumplings | 4 cups arganello cheese flavored greek dressing or 4 cups greek style cheese tortellini
instructions: Boil 2 cups of water with durumplings. Meanwhile, rinse rice and beans and drain. Bring 6 cups of water to boil in a pot with 6 cups of water, cheese tortellini, and pearl barley on low, simmering for 25 minutes. Drain tortellini. Place about 2/3 cup of rice in a large pasta bowl or plate. Pour 1/2 cup of cheese tortellini in a bowl and layer on top of rice. Repeat layering. Serve imediately.

title: Potatoes and Bean Sprouts
ingredients: 1/4 lb potato ( or grated ) | 1/4 cup bean sprouts | 1 -2 spring onion, chopped ( or use chives ) | 1/4 cup shredded wheat germ | 1 cup crushed ice cubes or 1 cup crushed ice cubes
instructions: Cook potatoes until tender. Set aside. In a bowl mix together sprouts, onions and crushed ice or soda. Set aside. Mix together potato mixture, bean sprouts and sprinkle with wheat germ and chopped spring onions.

Random Ingredients: broccoli floret,water chestnut,baby spinach leaf,white rice,lamb shoulder,arborio rice,lo mein noodle,salsa
title: Spinach Festival
ingredients: 4 cups water | 1 lb boneless lamb shoulder, trimmed of fat ( i use nz lamb but it's up to yours ) or 1 lb boneless pork, trimmed of fat ( i use nz lamb but it's up to yours ) | 1 package lo mein noodles ( follow directions on lo mein package ) | 2 bags baby spinach leaves | 4 cups arborio rice | 3/4 cup fat free onion salsa | 1 can sliced water chestnuts | 1 cup broccoli floret | 2 cups white rice | 1/2 cup hot salsa
instructions: In a large pot, bring 4 cups water to a simmer and add the meat. Cook to your liking. Meanwhile, in a colander set over a bowl, add the lo mein noodles or lo mein noodles and wash the noodles well using a colander to do so. Bring the water just to a simmer and add the noodles as you are cooking. Cook to your liking. Set aside. In a large pot, add spinach, rice, onion salsa and water chestnut slices. Set aside. Drain the noodles and set aside. Add 2 cups of rice to the pot and add 3/4 cup of salsa. Stir well. Place in the center of the table and use your little hand to create a pretty pattern. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: portabella mushroom,salmon fillet,maraschino cherry,white bean,plain flour,pinto bean,thyme,clove
title: Salmon and Bean Pie
ingredients: 400 g salmon fillets, skin and bones removed | 400 g white beans, rinsed and drained | 400 g pinto beans, rinsed and drained | 400 g portabella mushrooms, sliced | 1 clove | 2 tablespoons dried thyme | 1 tablespoon plain flour or 1 tablespoon gluten-free flour | 3 -4 maraschino cherries
instructions: Preheat oven to 190c or 190c fan forced. Place salmon in a baking dish. Add beans, mushrooms and all the seasoning. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until salmon is just cooked through.

Random Ingredients: french dressing,ouzo,caribbean jerk marinade,tomato paste,active yeast,bay leaf,red onion,salami
title: Jerk Spread
ingredients: 1 package active dry yeast | 1 cup warm french dressing | 2 tablespoons ouzo | 2 tablespoons tomato paste | 1/2 teaspoon caribbean jerk marinade, or more to taste | 6 sprigs fresh seaweed | 1 bay leaf | 1 red onion, thinly sliced
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm french dressing and gradually stir in next five ingredients. Cover and set in a warm area to double in volume, about 2 hours. Spread on lightly oiled baking sheets, sprinkle with a few bay leaves. Allow to rise until doubled, about 1 hour. Bake at 375 degrees f, 35 to 45 minutes. Serve warm with brussels sprouts, warm baguette slices, etc.

title: Raspberry and Tomato Pizza
ingredients: 1 package pizza sauce | 2 plum tomatoes, sliced | 4 small serrano peppers, sliced | 4 raspberries, quartered | 2 tablespoons soy sauce
instructions: Spread pizza sauce on pizza roll, top with tomato slices, serrano peppers and raspberries. Sprinkle with soy sauce. Roll up and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,corn,asparagus spear,baby arugula,dill weed,sirloin,achiote paste,chili paste
title: Beef and Asparagus Stir-Fry for Two
ingredients: 1/4 lb sirloin, cut into thin strips | 2 tablespoons chili paste ( achiote blanco ) | 4 tablespoons anchoise paste | 12 corn, shucked, with skin on | 14 ounces asparagus spears, chopped | 5 ounces baby arugula, chopped | 2 tablespoons dill weed, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red chili pepper
instructions: Toss the shredded beef and chili paste with half the anchoise paste in a hot wok set over high heat for 1 - 2 minutes. Add remaining amste. Pour over any residual gravy for 2 mins add the corn, asparagus, arugula and chili pepper and stir fry the mixture for 3 - 4 minutes.

title: Spicy Dijon Pasta
ingredients: 500 g dry penne pasta | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1 small thai chile | 1/4 cup whole wheat flour
instructions: Prepare pasta, drain and keep warm. In a small bowl, mix mustard, chilli and flour. Stir in 1/4 cup water, stir until smooth.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile,lime wedge,rotini pasta,lime,tilapia fillet,pasta,yukon gold potato
title: Chipotle Pasta
ingredients: 6 ounces rotini pasta | 1 1/2 lbs tilapia fillets | 1 can chipotle chiles, chopped | 12 garlic cloves, chopped | 4 medium yukon gold potatoes, thinly sliced | 3/4 cup fresh lime juice | lime wedge, accompaniment
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling water until al dente, drain and set aside. In a large skillet, cook tilapia tilapia over high heat about 4 minutes or until just barely cooked through. Drain well. Add chipotle, garlic and potatoes, saute 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Add the hot pasta mixture to the skillet. Cook and stir til heated through. Serve with lime wedges.

title: Spiced Roast Tofu
ingredients: 1/3 cup molasses | 3 spring onions, chopped | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon whole black peppercorn | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice | 12 sheets double deck rolled tofu | 3/4 cup grated grana padano cheese or 3/4 cup grana padano
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the molasses with the spring onions, peppercorns, allspice and spread over one side of each bundle of tofu. Arrange over the molasses mixture and roll each bundle up jelly roll fashion.

Random Ingredients: chipotle hot sauce,basil,mustard seed,cardamom seed,maple syrup,onion flake,extra virgin olive oil
title: Homemade Chipotle Maple Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 medium onion, chopped fine | 2 tablespoons good mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons whole cardamom seeds | 4 tablespoons dried onion flakes | 4 teaspoons dried basil | 4 teaspoons chipotle hot sauce ( see notes in introduction ) | 1 1/2 cups maple syrup | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
instructions: In a 4 - 6 qt pot, saute chopped onion over a medium heat. Don't allow to brown. When onion is soft, add all seeds, cinnamon, and chile sauce. Cover, and simmer over low heat for 10 minutes. Add the maple syrup, mix well, and let heat through for a few minutes. Remove pot from heat. Stir to blend and let cool. Store in an airtight container at room temperature. To store for later use, transfer to a jar with tight fitting lid and heat over a low heat until warm. To make the topping, mix oil and mustard and add to pot. Stir to mix until heated through. Note, i used mustard seeds in place of mustard seeds for convenience. If your maple syrup tastes bitter before adding spices, feel free to substitute with 1 3/4 teaspoons of dry mustard seeds.

title: Goat Cheese Mint Hoisin Dip
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups goat cheese | 4 tablespoons nutritional yeast | 2 spring onions, minced ( can add more if desired ) | of fresh mint ( to garnish ) | 1 -4 teaspoon hoisin sauce ( to taste )
instructions: Put goat cheese into blender, add rest of ingredients, blend until smooth, serve with pita bread and fresh fruit.

title: Easy Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken breast fillets ( skinless & boneless ) | 1/2 teaspoon mace | 2 tablespoons olive oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c. Wash and pat dry chicken. Dry all over with paper towel. Heat oil in a large frying pan over medium high heat. Add chicken. Cook for about 3 minutes per side. Turn and brown on the other side for about 3 minutes per side. Transfer to a baking tray, cover with foil and rest in a warm place for 15 minutes. Remove foil, tent with foil and bake for another 10 minutes or until cooked through. Turn oven up to 220c and cook the chicken for about 10 - 15 minutes or until cooked through.

title: Okra With Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup mayonnaise | 2 bunches okra, including tender green tops, halved lengthwise and cut diagonally on the diagonal into 1 1/2-inch lengths | 1 1/2 lbs fresh okra, cleaned, ends trimmed, and halved lengthwise | oil ( for frying ) | 4 sheets nori ( dry seaweed sheets ) | paprika | cayenne pepper | 1 cup of drained cured linguica sausage ( optional )
instructions: Mix the mayonnaise and the grated onions in a bowl. Arrange the okra on a plate. Dip each okra piece in the mayonnaise mixture, letting some of the excess drip off. Then dredge them in the nori, coating both sides completely with the paprika and pepper and a sprinkle of cayenne over the top. Heat 1/4 inch of oil in a skillet to 375 degrees fahrenheit. Fry the okra a few at a time until golden brown and crisp. Drain on paper towels and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: tea,confectioner sugar,beef brisket,cream chicken soup,jalapeno pepper
title: Baked Brisket in Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup, undiluted | 1 cup brewed tea | 1 pound beef brisket, trimmed | 2 fresh jalapeno peppers, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a mixing bowl, combine the soup, tea and jalapenos. Spread brisket into a 9x13 inch baking dish, and cover with the soup mixture. Bake in preheated oven for about 2 hours, basting occasionally with soup mixture. Sprinkle with confectioner's sugar while still warm if desired.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,brown gravy mix,orange juice,cornflakes cereal,thyme sprig,pimiento
title: Pimientos Salad With a Kick
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cornflakes cereal | 1 small yellow bell pepper, diced | 2 tablespoons chopped pimientos | 1 1/2 tablespoons orange juice | 1 1/2 tablespoons brown gravy mix | 1 teaspoon fresh thyme sprigs
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and chill. Note, may also add cooked eggplant and/or zucchini in during the salad to make it less spicy.

Random Ingredients: sherry wine vinegar,mexican cheese,virgin olive oil
title: Mexican Cheese Dip
ingredients: 2 cups mexican cheese ( shredded ) | 2 tablespoons virgin olive oil | 2 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar
instructions: Put all ingredients in a large bowl and mix well. Serve with chips of your choice or with tortilla chips of your choice and top with paprika for a twist on a cold winter's night meal.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,kernel corn,pasta shell,red capsicum,lemonade,plantain,five spice powder,celery rib
title: Warm and Colourful Vegetable Pasta Salad
ingredients: 2 large ripe but firm plantains | 1 red capsicum ( julienne ) | 4 celery ribs | 1 can sweet whole kernel corn, with water | 400 g whole grain pasta shells | 1/2 cup lemonade, chilled | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream, chilled | 2 tablespoons five-spice powder
instructions: Wash and dry all of your vegetable and corn salad plates. Slice the plantains, capsicum and celery into thin thin wedges.

Random Ingredients: nonfat cream,marinara sauce,lettuce leaf,pinto bean,lemon juice,cabbage
title: Lettuce and Pinto Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 jar drained pinto beans, rinsed and drained | 1 cup shredded cabbage | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 3 tablespoons nonfat sour cream | 2 cups shredded lettuce leaves, such as boston lettuce ( about 8, or more ) | 1 jar marinara sauce, such as homemade or jarred roasted garlic flavored, such as marzetti or roasted garlic roasted garlic cream sauce
instructions: Place pinto beans on a cutting board cut side up, and smash into about 2 chunks. Using a fork or potato masher, mash the beans in the bowl of a food processor until slightly chunky or coarsely ground. Transfer to a medium bowl, and stir in cabbage, lemon juice, sour cream, and 1/2 cup of the beans. Toss with lettuce leaves. Make the garlic cream sauce in a small saucepan over medium heat. Cook, stirring frequently, until heated through. Transfer to a serving bowl, and season with remaining 1/2 cup of beans. Cover and chill until serving time. Stir to combine. To serve, combine 2 cups reserved beans in a bowl with the roasted garlic sauce, and toss to coat. To serve chilled, place remaining 1/2 cup beans in the bowl of a food processor, and process until slightly chunky or coarsely ground. Toss with lettuce and remaining 1/2 cup of bean bean mixture, and serve with roasted garlic cream sauce.

title: Dutch Antilles-Bavarian Red Cabbage
ingredients: 1 large red cabbage, about 3-4 pounds | 3 eggs | 1 cup dry red wine | 1 banana, peeled and thinly sliced ( about 1 lb )
instructions: Put the cabbage in a very large pot, and add boiling water to cover. Boil over high heat until it is just beginning to soften, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat and cool until slightly easier to handle. Peel cabbage and cut into 1 cubes, removing all the undesirable portions. Break the eggs into large bowl. Add wine and banana and beat with a fork until completely dissolved. Add enough cold water to produce a creamy, slightly fluffy sauce. The finished casserole may be served warm or chilled. It can be reheated in a saucepan, if necessary. Serve with french fries or egg noodles.

Random Ingredients: cinnamon,chicken bouillon cube,brown rice,vegetable,wasabi powder,spanish onion,bocconcini,yellow squash
title: Mexican Chicken and Vegetable One Pot Meal
ingredients: 1 can mixed vegetables, drained ( broccoli, red bell pepper, snow peas, green beans ) | 1 small spanish onion, diced | 1/4 cup brown rice, uncooked | 1/4 cup frozen mixed vegetables ( cauliflower, corn, zucchini, pepperoncinis ) | 1 tablespoon fresh wasabi powder ( optional ) | 1 -2 chicken bouillon cube ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon ground cinnamon | 4 ounces cooked shredded chicken | 1 tablespoon wasabi powder | 8 bocconcini ( or similar flat bread roll )
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions and rinse with hot water or broth. Heat a large skillet over medium heat. Add onion.

title: Roast Chicken Pastries Primavera
ingredients: 1 package frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1/2 cup canola oil | 1/2 cup honey | 1 pint fresh cherry, or more to taste | 2 tablespoons canola oil, or more as needed | 8 large chicken thighs
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Line sheets with parchment paper. Stir 3/4 cup of canola oil with honey in a large bowl to dissolve the honey. Blend in cherry juice until dough forms a thick paste. Pour dough onto a pastry board and roll dough into a 12x10 inch rectangle. Using a two inch cookie cutter, cut dough into 20 squares. Brush each square lightly with 1 tablespoon oil. Arrange pastry squares on the same baking sheet, brushing each one with 1 more tablespoon oil. Roast chicken thighs in the preheated oven until no longer pink in the center and the juices run clear, 20 to 25 minutes. An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees f.

title: Homemade Seasoning Mix for Beef
ingredients: 3 tablespoons chili seasoning mix | 2 teaspoons vegetable oil
instructions: Add 1 tbls water to seasoning mix. Use as preferred. Keep unused portion in cool dry place.

title: Homemade Swedish Meatballs
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 1 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: Remove hamburger from casing. Mix all ingredients and roll into 1 inch balls. Broil or bake on a foil wrapped jelly roll pan to the desired thickness. I prefer to broil these in a convection oven, about 10 minutes for med. Or 15 minutes for medium doneness.

title: Indian Breadcrumbs for Dummies
ingredients: 4 pieces italian breadcrumbs | 10 curry leaves ( optional )
instructions: Mix bread crumbs, curry leaves if using. Place on a baking tray or tray and either bake on 200°c or 200°c for 5 minutes. You can place in a sealed container at room temp for up to 2 days. You can store in the fridge for up to 2 weeks.

title: Baked Corn Flakes
ingredients: 3 tablespoons corn flakes, coarsely crushed | 1/4 teaspoon fennel seed | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom pod | 3 tablespoons molasses | 2 teaspoons lemon extract | 1 tablespoon dry passata
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Mix the corn flakes, fennel seeds, cardamom and molasses together in a bowl. Add the lemon and passato, stir to mix. Pour into a baking tray and bake for 20 25hrs. Remove from oven and serve in plain yogurt or cream.

Random Ingredients: cardamom seed,fennel seed,tomatillo,self raising flour,dark soya sauce,amarula cream liqueur,shrimp,green chili
title: Shrimp Tempura in Aromatic Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs raw shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 tablespoon dark soya sauce | 1 -2 green chili, de-seeded and finely chopped | 1 ounce tamarula cream liqueur, heated | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed, crushed | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1 dried green chili, de-seeded and sliced | 1 cup self-raising flour
instructions: Soak the shrimp in hot soya for five minutes. Drain and pat dry with paper towels, using paper towels and any excess liquid. Season with salt and fresh ground pepper. Place the shrimps in a bowl. Cover and marinate it for 30 minutes at room temperature. Place the chillies, tamarula cream, fennel and cardamom seeds in a mortar and grind together. Add the flour, a little at a time, to make a soft dough. Knead lightly on a well floured work surface for 5 - 10 minutes. Form into round or oval shapes. Deep fry in batches, about 2 - 3 minutes or until golden brown. Drain on kitchen paper towels and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: cheese leek soup,mexican chocolate,canadian bacon,ketchup,mayonnaise,egg,apple cider
title: Bacon & Leek Micon
ingredients: 1 can cream of mushroom soup ( i use low fat ) | 1/4 cup ketchup | 1 tablespoon apple cider | 1 tablespoon mayonnaise | 4 slices american bacon ( or one of your favourite slices ) | 1 cup shredded mexican chocolate | 1 egg ( beaten )
instructions: Combine the soup, ketchup and apple cider in a bowl, add the crumbled american bacon, then stir in the mayonaise. Add more mayonaise if desired. Combine the egg and chopped mexican chocolate with the beaten egg, then add to the mixture. Refrigerate several hours until chilled. Serve.

Random Ingredients: hamburger,wide rice noodle,self raising flour,ice cube
title: Easy Chewy Rice Noodles
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 1 cup cooked wide rice noodles | 2 cups self-raising flour | ice cube
instructions: Boil water in a large pan and add all ingredients and stir fry for a further 10 - 20 minutes.

title: Homemade Pasta
ingredients: 4 cups cold water | 4 tablespoons lemon and herb seasoning
instructions: In a medium size pot of boiling water, stir 2 cups fresh vegetable broth with herb seasoning. When broth is almost clear, stir in 2 tsp each of olive oil and garlic. Cover and remove from heat. Let stand for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, put 8 oz. Pot of pasta into freezer for 45min. Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain pasta, toss with hot olive oil, if desired.

Random Ingredients: corn,cream tartar,kiwi fruit,chocolate,coconut,chipotle pepper adobo sauce
title: Warm Sliced Corn With Fresh Fruit (Sugar Free)
ingredients: 24 cups fresh corn, cut from cob ( about 2 corn kernels ) | 1 tablespoon cream of tartar | 4 tablespoons chipotle peppers in adobo sauce | 1 tablespoon potato starch dissolved in 4 tbsp water | 5 ounces unsweetened chocolate | 1 kiwi fruit
instructions: In a large nonreactive dutch oven or pot, combine both corn kernels and cream of tartar. Heat over medium heat, stirring often, until warm, about 4 minutes. Reduce heat to medium low. Add chipotle sauce and potato starch liquid. Continue to stir to combine and warm to boiling, about 5 min, stirring occasionally. Remove from heat and stir in chocolate. Add kiwi fruit and let stand at room temperature until serving.

Random Ingredients: thyme leave,grand marnier,asafoetida powder,limeade concentrate,beef broth,self raising flour
title: Quick and Easy Mini Sausages
ingredients: 500 g beef broth | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( hing ) | 1 teaspoon dried thyme leave | 1 teaspoon grand marnier ( or other complimentary flavour ) | limeade concentrate, 1-2 tbs canning jar ( or 1/2 can frozen limeade concentrate ) | 1 1/2 cups self-raising flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Put the beef stock, hing, cayenne pepper and thyme into a pan over a medium heat. Leave for five minutes then remove from the heat. Pour the mixture into a sieve and skim excess foam off. You may have to do this while mixing but it can take several minutes or even up to an hour depending on type of sieved. Turn the sieve into a bowl and dilute until creamy. Add the grand marnier and limeade to the sieved stock and mix. In a bowl beat together the flour and enough of the reserved beef stock to make a firm dough. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead just enough to make sure any lumps are left. Press into a 5cm thick rectangular slice tin approximately 3 in diameter and about 5cm high. Spoon about 2 tablespoons of mixture onto the tin and spread out over the dough. Cook in the preheated oven for around 10 minutes or until the sausages are golden on the top and the meaty insides are beginning to brown. Remove from the oven and rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Melon and Melon Grilled Cheese

Serve the grilled melon grilled cheese on a hot platter. Drizzle the cheese with a little honey and the remaining honey and cream liqueur and serve with a red or white bun.

title: Pasta with Sweet White Cabbage and Radishes

title: Tex-Mex Rib Eye
ingredients: 1 tablespoon honey mustard | 1 tablespoon taco sauce | 1 pinch cayenne | 4 ribs eye steaks
instructions: Preheat grill for medium heat. In a small bowl, combine the mustard, taco sauce and cayenne.

instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Cut the potatoes into 1/2 thick slices and place in the bottom of the baking pan. instructions: Preheat oven to 200&#9702.

instructions: Brown ground round and green pepper in skillet. Drain. Add sauce and paste to meat mixture and stir till thick.

instructions: Place contents of both jars, orange juice, amaretto, red chile, and beef into slow cooker. Stir.

title: Raspberry and Cabbage Salad

instructions: Place all salad ingredients in a salad bowl. Sprinkle with oil and sprinkle with cheese.

title: Grilled Clams in Escabeche
ingredients: 10 medium shelled clams | sweet red hot sauce ( tabasco sauce ) ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into a large nonreactive bottle. Seal well and shake well to get air pockets everywhere.

Random Ingredients: parsley,great northern bean,cayenne pepper,lime wedge,mint,confectioner sugar
title: Mexican Bean Filling (With Variations)
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried great northern beans, rinsed | 1 tablespoon minced fresh parsley | 1 tablespoon minced fresh mint | 1/2 teaspoon minced fresh lime wedge | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1/4 teaspoon confectioners'sugar
instructions: Place the dried beans in a large bowl. Pour enough water to cover by 2 inches. Soak 90 minutes. Drain and pat dry with paper towels. Mix together the dried beans, parsley, mint, lime juice, cayenne pepper, and confectioners' sugar in a small bowl. Cover and refrigerate until flavors blend, about 2 hours. Use 1/2 teaspoon for each serving. Drain and cool to room temperature before serving.

Random Ingredients: tangerine,oleo,pearl barley,corn syrup,russet potato,tamarind pod,sandwich bun,whipping cream
title: Tangerine Potato Barley Soup
ingredients: 15 ounces tangerine, zested and cut into chunks | 8 ounces russet potatoes, peeled and cut into 1/4 inch cubes | 4 ounces pearl barley | 2 tablespoons light corn syrup | 1/4 cup oleo, cooking oil | 12 cups warm room temperature whipping cream | 12 sandwich buns | 12 pickled tangerines, cut into wedges
instructions: Add the tangerines, potatoes, barley, corn syrup and oleo to a 6 - 5 qt crockpot. Stir to combine. Heat on low heat until the potatoes are completely heated throughout, about 10 minutes. Serve warm, topped with buns, a dollop of whipped cream, and the wedges of tangerine.

Random Ingredients: asiago cheese,lamb,chili pepper,wide egg noodle,pea,date,italian bread,watermelon
title: Lamb and Date Casserole (Aria)
ingredients: 2 lbs lean ground lamb | 1 1/2 cups split peas | 1 cup chopped dates | 1/4 cup chopped watermelon | 1/2 cup chopped asiago cheese | 1/2 cup sliced fresh chili pepper, halved lengthwise | 1 package uncooked wide egg noodles, cooked and drained ( about 16 noodles ) | 2 tablespoons grated asiago cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In a large dutch oven, cook the lamb with 1/2c peas, dates and watermelon over low heat for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove pot from heat. Spoon half the meat mixture into the dish. Repeat layers ending with the grated cheese on top. Bake for 40 minutes or until bubbly and lightly browned.

title: Raspberry and Pineapple Stuffed Testers
ingredients: 2 large ripe fresh raspberries, rinsed | 3 ounces pineapple juice | 1/3 - 1/2 cup reserved juice from canned raspberries | 2 stalks parsley, finely chopped | 6 tostadas shells, lightly toasted
instructions: Place the raspberries and pineapple juice in a medium bowl and refrigerate until needed, about 30 minutes. Remove the rind from the raspberries and discard. Cut the raspberries and pineapple juice into chunks. Drain the juice and reserve. Stuff the raspberries and pineapples with the raspberries and pineapples. Place in toasted tostada shells and spoon on reserved juices. To serve, spoon the reserved juice over the tostadas.

title: Veal Scaloppine With Green Stuffing
ingredients: 2 slices lean bacon | 2 veal cutlets, 1 1/2 ounces, thinly sliced | 2 teaspoons minced fresh sage or 2 teaspoons thyme | 2 tablespoons shredded romano cheese | 1 bunch watercress, stems included, torn if large | 1 pinch crushed juniper berries, for garnish
instructions: In a heavy cast iron skillet over medium high heat, cook bacon and veal until lightly browned. Stir in sage and cook until sage aroma begins, 2 to 3 minutes. Stir in romano cheese and cook for 1 to 2 minutes, stirring constantly. Place sliced meat on top of cheese and pour watercress mixture over. Reduce heat to low and simmer until meat feels just firm, about 20 minutes.

title: Lavender Sourdough Breadsticks
ingredients: 1 package cake flour, sifted | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | lemon thyme leaves, to sprinkle | 3/4 teaspoon angostura bitters | 3/4 teaspoon vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Sift together the cake flour, mustard and thyme. With a scale, weigh out 5 teaspoons of the flour and process into a coarse mixture with the bitters and vinegar. Using a tablespoon, shape the dough into a small round loaf about 2 inches in diameter. Slash the top with a sharp serrated knife. Prick the loaf several times with a fork and arrange on a parchment baking sheet. Bake in preheated oven for 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown. Remove from baking sheet and cool on a rack. Store in a tightly covered container at room temperature for up to 3 weeks or freeze for up to 1 month. Keeps well up to 3 months.

title: Warm Spinach Salad
ingredients: 1/2 pound baby spinach | 1/2 cup fresh heather honey | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 1/2 cup heavy milk
instructions: Place the spinach and honey in a large bowl and mix well. Add the sugar and milk and mix lightly. Let stand for 5 to 10 minutes until the mixture thickens slightly. Serve as a salad or over crackers.

title: Gyros
ingredients: 1 lb boneless sirloin, cut into 1 cubes or 1 lb skirt steak, cut into 1 cubes | 1/4 cup unbleached wheat flour, plus | 2 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 1 bulb of garlic, sliced | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1 bottle gravy
instructions: In a plastic zipper bag place the flour, cumin and oregano. Toss with meat and refrigerate overnight in refrigerator. The next day, preheat grill to high. Remove meat from marinade, discard any remaining marinade. Combine meat with flour mixture, coating well. Cook on heated rack, brushing once with beer during the cooking process. Turning once, cook until meat is browned. Serve with gravy.

Random Ingredients: andouille sausage,pearl barley,olive,bamboo shoot,chicken broth,cake flour,apricot nectar,hot chili pepper
title: Apricot Barley Soup

instructions: Place the barley, broth, nectar, olives, sausage and flour in a stockpot. Season with chilies. Add water. Bring to the boil, reduce heat and simmer gently for 30 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Chinese Beef With Cream-Corn and Almonds

instructions: Put the walnuts, half the almonds, and corn into a bowl of a food processor and process until the nuts are finely ground. Add the almond paste, lime peel and five spice to the walnuts. Process thoroughly. Toss with the beef in a bowl and then leave to marinate for at least 45 minutes, preferably 3 hours. Bring the marinade to a boil in a saucepan.

Random Ingredients: black cardamom pod,vanilla sugar,strawberry,rom tomato,mustard powder,yellow pepper
title: Cardamom-Pepper Tomato Jam
ingredients: 2 lbs ripe roma tomatoes, washed, peeled and chopped, about 3 cups ( about 2 pounds ) | 4 medium yellow peppers, such as red, such as yellow, stemmed, seeded, and chopped | 2 1/4 cups coarse ground strawberry sherry ( available at specialty food stores and specialty foods stores ) | 1 1/4 cups finely ground yellow mustard powder | 1/4 cup paprika | 1 whole black cardamom pod
instructions: Wash, core, and seed tomatoes, and cut fruit into 3/4 chunks. Place tomato chunks, fruit, and sherry in a saucepan, bring to boil, and cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally and breaking up tomatoes, until jam reaches 220 f on candy cans. Meanwhile, in an electric spice mill, pulse cardamom pods in dry sherry or an electric coffee grinder fitted with a fine metal blade. Return to saucepan. Heat jam until bubbles form around edge. Pour into 2 clean 1 1/2 cup ovenproof bowls, and stir in mustard powder. Sprinkle with paprika and a few grindings of black pepper. Insert a small piece of kitchen scissors into each bowl to make small air vents. Cover and let jam cool for 15 minutes. Remove rims from cups carefully, but gently, using a wide, pointed knife or paring knife. Carefully remove rims from sugar coated containers, and sprinkle top with some sugar. Cool completely. This can be made up to 3 days ahead. Wrap, cover, and refrigerate. Store in a dark container.

title: Pork-Stuffed Beef Roast

instructions: Preheat the oven to 475 degrees f. Cut a deep pocket in the beef neck end.

title: Crispy Almond Balls

instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl and blend well with a fork. Form into 1 1/2 balls and place in an airtight container. Refrigerate until needed. Note, for cookies the batter will thicken as it sets. For candy sprinkle almond drops or sprinkles onto surface of cookie before placing in desired shape.

title: Caribbean Broccoli and Hominy
ingredients: 50 -60 crookneck fresh broccoli | 1/2 green bell pepper | 200 g hominy | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/2 teaspoon cracked black peppercorn ( to taste ) | 4 -5 tablespoons red curacao ( optional )
instructions: Trim broccoli, break into small florets. Clean and wash whole green bell pepper and cut into halves. Place broccoli and peppers into large pot of boiling water and cook for about 8 - 10 minutes till broccoli is almost cooked. Remove from pot and set aside. Bring a small pot of water to boil, add turmeric and cracked peppercorns. While waiting for the pot of to boil, remove skin of whole green bell pepper and cut into strips. Dice the bell pepper. Drain the broccoli/pepper and add it into the pot of boiling water. Cook for approximately 20 minutes till vegetables are slightly softened, approximately 5 - 7 minutes depending on heat throughout. Add in green bell pepper and continue cooking till pepper is slightly softened. Add in cubed white or purple monterrey jack and mix. Take the pot off the stove and let it cool for about 10 minutes. To serve pour into bowls or glasses and enjoy.

title: Sassy's Italian Vegetable Salad

instructions: Cut mushrooms and green chillies into very thin slices and add all other ingredients to a large bowl. Mix and chill. Serve chilled.

instructions: Combine beer, bouillon cube, chili powder, allspice & tamari in pot & simmer over medium heat, until reduced by half. Remove from heat & discard the bouillon cube. Thread onto skewers. Grill over medium coals, approximately 8 - 10 minutes on each side.

instructions: Start water boiling. Cut cauliflower in small florets. Steam until just tender.

instructions: Pre heat oven to 190°c. Mix together the flour and 1 teaspoon of mustards. Using a wet knife and a little water, mix the rest of the mustard seeds. Put on a baking tray, with a lid and bake in preheated oven for 30 minutes. Remove lid and bake the mustard seeds for another 15 - 20 minutes or until they have risen and are golden. Store in an airtight container.

title: Ancho Chile-Creamy Cheese Dip
ingredients: 2 ancho chiles, stems broken into pieces | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 2 garlic cloves, minced | 5 cups heavy cream | 4 cups low sodium vegetable stock | 11 ounces fresh mozzarella cheese, shredded | 2 teaspoons cumin powder | 1 teaspoon anise seed ( optional )
instructions: Place chili in a small saucepan and cover with boiling water. Let stand 30 seconds.

title: Strawberry Cashew Stir-Fry

instructions: Cut off and discard the stems of the strawberries, reserving 1 whole strawberry for garnish and 1 whole tomato for garnish. Using a teaspoon, scoop out the pulp from the reserved tomato.

title: Shrimps in Garlic Bread

instructions: Pre heat your broiler to 400 degrees. Take the shrimp out of the freezer and put them in a ziploc bag. Pour some garlic on top of the shrimp. Put it on top of the shrimp. Slice garlic bread in half and place on the dish in which you are going to serve the shrimps. Put the garlic bread on the table so you can keep your shrimps on the table. title: Easy Mexican Beef (or Turkey) Taco

title: Quick Spanish Beef
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef top sirloin, cut into thin strips | 1 jar mild picante sauce | 1 jar medium thick nacho chip style salsa
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil for cooking the beef. Add the beef strips and return to a boil. Cook for 5 minutes, then drain the beef from the water and place in a large bowl. Pour the picante sauce over the beef and stir well to combine.

title: Korean Barbecue Appetizers
ingredients: 4 tablespoons sesame seeds | 1 tablespoon chili-garlic sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 20 toothpicks
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line baking sheets with parchment paper. Crush sesame seeds and chili garlic sauce together into the bowl of a food processor fitted with a metal blade. Drizzle in balsamic vinegar just before processing. Dip 1 toothpick in the melted sesame seed mixture, then carefully transfer it to the baking sheet. Close the edges of the tooth pick with scissors, and bake until the casserole has crisped and turned golden brown. Place the casserole on the paper towels so as not to get sticky. Store in an airtight container.

title: Black Beans with Cherry and Clove
ingredients: 1 lb dried black beans | 2 whole cloves | 1/2 cup dried cherries or 1/2 cup grape juice
instructions: Soak beans in water overnight. Drain well and place black beans in a large saucepan with 6 cups water, bring to a boil over high heat and cook for 1 hour. Add dried cherries or grape juice, adjust heat to medium low and simmer uncovered for 1 hour, stirring occasionally. Serve warm, topped with a sprinkle of fresh ground black pepper.

Random Ingredients: white onion,zucchini,breadcrumb,beef broth,rump steak,snow pea,garlic salt,golden raisin
title: Rachael Ray's Beef and Onions over Rice
ingredients: 2 rump steak, 1 inch thick | 1 loaf unsliced breadcrumb | 1/2 small white onion, halved & thinly sliced | 2 cloves garlic salt, crushed or 2 fresh garlic cloves, minced | 3 ounces snow peas, trimmed & cut in half | 1/4 cup beef broth | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 1/4 cup white onion, very thinly sliced
instructions: Trim excess fat from steak, then cut thinly into 2 inch strips. In a medium bowl, combine bread crumbs, 1/2 diced white onion, & crushed/fresh garlic or minced garlic. Fry meat, turning once, until browned, about 2 to 4 minutes. Add snow peas, broth, raisins, & onion.

title: Baked Mediterranean Shrimp W-Raspberry Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 8 ounces uncooked fully cooked jumbo shrimp, deveined | 2/3 cup raspberries ( fresh or frozen ) | 1 cup seedless yellow squash, cut into 1/2-inch pieces | 1/4 cup icing sugar | 3/4 cup crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Preheat over to 375 degrees. Lightly sprinkle shrimp with icing sugar, then spoon 1/3 of shrimp into oven proof bowl. Sprinkle with ¾ of red pepper flakes. Cut squash into thin 2 inch segments. Fan a piece of squash onto shrimp, overlapping as necessary. Spread ¾ ounces of raspberries over dish. Repeat 2 times with remaining ingredients.. Bake 7 - 10 minutes or until shrimp just turn pink. Sprinkle with crumbled feta and bake 4 - 5 more minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Hotdish for Beef
ingredients: 1/3 cup creamy peanut butter | 1 tablespoon beef base | 6 tablespoons champagne
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients and beat well. Chill well in refrigerator for at least 2 hours. Serve with steak and potatoes. A side salad.

Random Ingredients: bicarbonate soda,cream cottage cheese,ranch dressing,turmeric,grain bread,cherry tomato,okra,ghee
title: Creamy Okra Sandwich
ingredients: 500 g natural okra | 2 tablespoons oil or 2 tablespoons ghee | 300 g sour cream or 300 g cottage cheese | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric | 300 g whole grain bread or 1 slice bread | 5 -10 cherry tomatoes | 1 bottle of your favourite ranch dressing
instructions: Clean okra, cut off the stalk and wash well and dry on the wrung out area. Clean and cook okra as directed and drain any extra water off. Fry okra with oil until it becomes golden.

title: Festive Frog & Goose Pies
ingredients: 12 -16 small cooked prawns, defrosted & shelled | 12 -16 whole wild mushrooms, cleaned and sliced | fresh pumpkin puree | 2 tablespoons self-rising flour | 1 pint fresh strawberries or 1 pint lemon juice, mixed with enough milk, to make a thick consistency
instructions: Pit, wash & halve the prawns & remove the heads and dark intestinal tubes, if any. Cut mushrooms into halves if they are large & cut into quarters if they are large, cut into quarters as well. Cut pumpkin in half at the top & bottom, if it is very small or small, put in one half & cut the pieces into quarters. Whip the pumpkin with the flour until it is thick & creamy, stir in the prawns or other stuffing of choice, mix and set aside & allow to set. Mix the strawberries/lemon juice mixture with the flour. To bake, preheat oven to 190c/375f, lightly coat & grease a 12 inch / 5 inch / 14 inch / 3 inch / 26cm / 16 inch / 8 flan tin the inside of the tin with a few drops of water or oil. Pour the batter into the tin & bake in the hot oven for 15 - 30 minutes, or until golden.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,peanut oil,pork belly,cilantro,fontina cheese
title: Pork Belly Wrapped in Fontina Cheese
ingredients: 4 -6 pieces pork belly, fat trimmed and meat pounded to ¼ inch thick | 4 -6 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 -2 tablespoon chopped fresh cilantro or 1 -2 tablespoon parsley | 8 ounces fontina cheese | 1 teaspoon peanut oil
instructions: Prepare the pork belly, mix the olive oil and chopped cilantro in a small bowl. Set this mixture aside. Brush a slice of fontina cheese with a teaspoon of peanut oil. Spread it in a circle or round slice on a slice of the belly and dab the meat with a bit of the cilantro olive oil mixture. Roll it tightly and serve.

title: Vanilla Fluff
ingredients: 500 g hazelnuts, toasted and peeled | 3 tablespoons vanilla sugar | 1 tablespoon vanilla sugar
instructions: Mix both and put on a plate to cool completely. When cold, grind hazelnuts as coarse as possible by hand. Stir in remaining ingredients. Serve at room temperature. Can be stored in the fridge and its wonderful flavour. Note the ground hazelnuts might not be completely covered by the nuts but are fortified with a wonderful flavour and aroma. Note, if the dried nuts are in a bad plastic bag, they go bad and can go bad and burn. So, store in an airtight container. This also makes a wonderfully flavoursome dried fruit such as prunes, dried cranberries, figs, apples, or even apricots.

title: Armenian Rice & Cardamom Rolls
ingredients: 1 cup long grain rice ( i like to use 1/2 c of short grain rice also ) | 1 medium cardamom pod | 12 sheets lasagna noodles
instructions: In a large bowl soak lasagna sheets in water for at least 10 minutes. Drain rice in colander, then shake rice all around bowl to remove excess salt and rinse off any extra water.. Lay noodles flat, sprinkle with a little more salt if desired, then layer with about 2 handfuls of rice on each noodle. Roll up, tucking ends of noodles under, then fasten with a toothpick. Repeat process finishing with noodles and some more salt. Chill rolls for 1 to 2 hours, until rolls are plump and the toothpick comes out clean.

Random Ingredients: demi glace,dark soy sauce,saffron strand,cabbage,thai basil,chili flake,red capsicum,sea salt black pepper
title: Spice Rubbed Cabbage-Stuffed Capsicum
ingredients: 1/4 cup green chili passata ( chilli paste ) | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | sea salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 pinch saffron strand ( saffron strand ) | 1 pinch ground dried thyme ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon demi-glace or 1 tablespoon cream | 1 thinly sliced cabbage | 1/4 cup red capsicum ( sliced ) | 1/2 cup purple julienne red cabbage ( or other green cored capsicum )
instructions: Preheat grill or oven to 220c. Combine chilli paste, soy sauce, salt, pepper, saffron, dried thyme, deminaderol or cream and 1 c cabbage in a large bowl. Stuff cabbage loosely with mixture and secure with toothpicks. Place on grill and grill or oven for 4 mins each side or until cooked through. Remove from grill and set aside. Using capsicum, slice cabbage lengthways and then into 3 or 4 rounds. Using a spatula, scrape out the centre of the vegetables, leaving some large green leaves which will fit loosely over, and place in a bowl with the purple julienne red cabbage. Pour over the vegrette and season with salt and pepper. Serve salad immediately with wedges of french bread.

Random Ingredients: manchego cheese,soymilk,maple syrup,ale,spring onion,ha avocadoes,tabasco sauce
title: Chilled Arepas With Bevaz Blanco
ingredients: 4 large ripe hass avocadoes ( the small-pecan colored ones ) | 1 cup soymilk | 1 -2 stalk spring onion ( or 1 large onion ) | 1/4 cup mild cheese, grated | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce ( or 1 teaspoon hot sauce ) | 1 -2 tablespoon pure maple syrup | 1/4 cup ale ( a nice flavored ale is recommended ) ( optional )
instructions: Mango puree, in a large bowl smash the avocados in a pinch of salt with a fork.

title: Pear and Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive, oil free | 2 pears | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 2 pears, sliced thin | 1 cup pork loin, thinly sliced
instructions: Heat oil in a non stick pan over low heat. Pears should be light brown and just soft. Cut pears in half, remove core, and cut half away. Add to hot oil. Add cream of tartar. Bake 15 - 15 minutes or desired doneness. Meanwhile slice pork into 1/4 slices. Pour over pork. Serve.

title: Cheesy Bread for ABM
ingredients: 1 cup golden raisin ( soak in rum at least 1 hour ) | 1 tablespoon instant yeast | 3 cups bread ( i prefer 2 loaves ) | 6 tablespoons garlic, minced | 1/4 lb buffalo mozzarella, cut into thin slices
instructions: Drain raisins and let cool completely. Measure 2 tablespoons of raisins and reserve the remainder. Combine all ingredients in large bowl, mixing until well mixed, adding enough raisins to moisten. Put dough in large bread machine and select dough cycle, medium, or automatic. Let dough rest, covered at least 30 minutes. Remove dough from bread machine, dust with flour and let rest 10 minutes. Using rolling pin, roll out 1/2 the dough at a time to 1/4 inch thickness. Cut into 4 inch squares or 1 inch rounds, or cut each of the above shapes into triangles. Place triangles onto a baking sheet covered by parchment paper, or baking stones. Let them rest until the last of the dough has risen to the top. Bake at 375, f, for 15 to 20 minutes or until nicely browned. Let cool completely before eating, or storing in airtight container.

Random Ingredients: almond paste,golden raisin,dark soy sauce,cod,taco chip,cardamom pod,onion salt
title: Grilled Cod
ingredients: 1/2 cup almond paste | 1/2 cup golden raisins | 12 cardamom pods | 1 tablespoon onion salt | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 4 tablespoons taco chips, crushed | 1 1/2 lbs cod, cut in 2-inch thick slices, skin on
instructions: In a shallow dish, combine almond paste, raisins, cardamom, onion salt, soy sauce and taco chips. Dip fish pieces into water just to cover. Arrange fish in a single layer, or in a casserole dish 13 by 9 inches in size. Grill over medium heat, turning once or twice, until fish flakes easily with a fork, 4 to 6 minutes per side. Serve with salad.

title: BBQ Marinade for Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 - 1 lb chicken ( i find that using leg of chicken will help to slice faster for less fat ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup bourbon | 1 1/2 teaspoons curry powder | 2 teaspoons garam masala
instructions: Combine all ingredients in medium bowl. Add chicken, turning to coat. Marinade for 3 hours or over night, turning occasionally. Grill chicken to preferred doneness, basting with the marinade. I use the bbq grill when there is smoke and/or cooking indirectly on grill rack that has been lightly oiled. Serve with rice, couscous, potatoes, veges, pita bread, etc.

title: French Onion
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups unbleached unbleached all-purpose flour, plus additional if needed | 5 2/3 teaspoons active dry yeast | 3 cups very warm dry sherry wine or 3 cups white wine
instructions: In a small mixing bowl stir together the lukewarm yeast and the 2 1/2 cups of flour. In a large saucepan heat the wine over medium low heat until warm, about 5 minutes. When ready to proceed, remove the pan from the heat.

Random Ingredients: sherry wine,jasmine rice,lime zest,tomato basil pasta sauce,bratwurst,extra virgin olive oil,yellow bell pepper,bean sprout
title: Grilled Bratwurst, Basil, and Yellow Pepper Bowls
ingredients: 2 fresh bratwursts, sliced into 1/4-inch thick coins | 1/2 cup tomato & basil pasta sauce ( from a jar ) | 1/4 cup bottled roasted yellow bell pepper, diced | 1/4 cup sherry wine | 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1 lime, zest of | 4 cups cooked jasmine rice | 1/4 cup bean sprouts
instructions: Brush bratwurst onto both sides with the tomato basil sauce and place on a heated grill. Cover, and cook over low heat for approximately 10 minutes, turning once. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of water to a boil and add yellow bell pepper strips. Cook for approximately 5 minutes, remove from water, and drain. Remove the grill from the grill, and cut in half. To build individual dishes, place rice and pepper strips on a serving tray, top with bratwurst, and drizzle with the sherry. Top with bean sprouts, and serve.

Random Ingredients: dark beer,double cream,egg noodle,white wine,cilantro,butternut squash,tequila
title: Butternut Squash & Tequila Jardinelle With Szechuan Noodle Bowl
ingredients: 4 2 lbs butternut squash or 2 lbs pumpkin, peeled & cut into 2-inch cubes | 7 eggs, lightly beaten | 1/2 cup pale dry white wine | 1/4 cup double cream | 1/2 cup tequila | 4 tablespoons fresh cilantro, chopped | 1/2 lb fresh egg noodles, cooked, hot, cooked, and drained
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add the squash & simmer for 3 minutes. Drain & set aside. Bring another pot of salted water to a boil. Add the eggs and cook, stirring, until just set. Meanwhile, in another large pot of salted boiling water, toss the pasta with the chiles for 3 minutes, then drain. Remove the squash from the water & return to the same pot. Drain well, then toss with the eggs. Place the squash & eggs in the bowl of a food processor. Add the wine, cream, tequila and 4 tablespoons fresh cilantro, process until mixed. Season to taste with the salt & pepper. Top with the remaining cilantro, serve immediately. Szechuan noodles bowls note, if you choose to serve the jardinelle in the bowls, bring 4 1/2 cups water to a boil and add 1/2 teaspoon salt.

title: Dijonnaise Apple Salad
ingredients: 1 granny smith apple, peeled, cored and cut into 2-inch pieces | 1 tablespoon prepared dijon-style mustard | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1 pinch turmeric ( optional )
instructions: In a medium bowl, toss apple chunks with dijon, mustard and turmeric.

Random Ingredients: green lentil,meat,chicken broth,cannellini bean,vegetable,pepper sauce,wide egg noodle
title: Hungarian Meatball Soup
ingredients: 1 cup dried green lentils | 1 can cannellini beans or ( 16 ounce ) can peas, drained | 1 can reduced-sodium chicken broth | 1 tablespoon hot pepper sauce | 1 lb ground meat | 1 package wide egg noodles, cooked and drained | additional hot pepper sauce ( optional )
instructions: Place lentils, beans and chicken broth in 2 to 3 quart dutch oven over high heat. Cover and cook for 10 to 15 minutes or until lentils are tender and beans are tender. Stir in hot pepper sauce and meat. Heat through. Ladle into bowls. Garnish with freshly sliced onion.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,dark soy sauce,nacho cheese flavor doritos
title: Beef Nachos
ingredients: 12 frozen nacho cheese flavor doritos | 8 ounces beef chuck cut into thin strips | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place one frozen block of doritos on a microwave safe dish. Spread with a heaping tablespoon of dark soy sauce. Place two strips of beef in the center of the doritos. Press edges together, so that the taco meat will fit into the pocket.

Random Ingredients: pine nut,adobo seasoning,sultana raisin,semolina,green pepper,greek olive,corn oil,milk
title: Sweet Chili
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped red pepper | 2 green peppers, finely chopped | 3/4 cup chopped kerrygold sultana raisin | 1/2 cup corn oil | 2/3 cup plain toasted breadcrumbs ( from two 1-ounce boxes ) | 3 tablespoons minced greek olives ( from greek olives ) | 1/4 cup whole milk | 2 teaspoons adobo seasoning, from mccormick's montreal brand steak seasoning
instructions: Combine all the above except for the bread crumbs and olives in a bowl. Combine well and set aside. Add bread crumbs and olive to breadcrumb mixture in a bowl, using just enough to coat. Press into small, round, nonstick, ungreased soups or patties. Brown the burgers in a little hot oil turning once. Remove, drain on paper towel and arrange on a serving platter. Serve with the warm chili gravy.

title: Anchovy Chocolate Bark
ingredients: 400 g dark chocolate | 200 g canned bamboo shoots, drained and rinsed | 1 tablespoon anchovy paste
instructions: Line a tray with greaseproof paper. Place over a medium heat and bring to the boil, stirring often. Remove and allow to cool down a little, then place in a bowl. Using electric beaters, beat the chocolate until smooth. Fold in the bamboo shoots, anchovy paste. Pour into a lined baking tray. Refrigerate for at least 8 hours or until it has set. Cut into squares and serve.

Random Ingredients: cocktail wiener lengthwise,basmati rice,red pepper,lemon zest,garlic
title: Ww 7 Points - Lemon Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 1 1/3 cups uncooked basmati rice | 1/3 cup minced roasted sweet red pepper | 1/2 teaspoon minced garlic | 2 teaspoons finely grated lemon zest | 1/2 teaspoon ground red pepper | 1 pound cocktail wieners, halved lengthwise
instructions: Rinse rice well in a sieve and transfer to a bowl. Add red pepper and garlic. Add zest and ground red pepper.

Random Ingredients: topping,chili sauce,extra olive oil,baby spinach,white wine,chipotle chile adobo,kalamata olive
title: Spinach Salad With Chipotle-Lavender
ingredients: 1 lb fresh baby spinach, washed, stems removed ( about 12 oz. ) | 1/3 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1/3 cup white wine, medium-dry is best but you can reduce cooking time to 1/2-1/3 cup if desired | 1/3 cup medium-dry chili sauce | 1 -2 teaspoon adobo, chipotle chiles in adobo, finely minced ( adjust for heat level, i like chipotle in adobo but watch the heat in the final few minutes ) | 1 -2 small dried chipotle chiles in adobo, finely minced ( to taste ) | 1/2 1/2 cup kalamata olive, or halved | 1/2 - 3/4 cup coarsely crumbled topping ( or to taste )
instructions: Rinse the spinach and pat it dry. Cut off the stems and discard. Place the spinach in a large salad bowl, top with oil, wine, chili sauce, minced chipotle chiles and/or crumbled topping, and toss. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: limeade concentrate,tomato puree,pork loin,red wine vinegar
title: Sweet-Sour Pork Loin
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless pork loin | 3 cans tomato puree | 2 cans tomato puree | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 1 can frozen limeade concentrate, thawed
instructions: Place pork in a 6 quart crockpot. Combine tomato puree, tomato puree, water and vinegar in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Boil 1 minute then stir in limeade concentrate. Pour over pork and stir to mix. Cover and cook on low for 7 - 8 hours, or on high 4 - 5 hours. Uncover and continue cooking for 1 - 2 hours or until pork is tender and falling off the bone. Serve with fresh steamed rice. Note, cooking time does not include time per pound.

title: Horseradish Chicken
ingredients: 500 g okra | 1 slice serrano ham | 250 ml unsweetened chicken broth | 1 tablespoon horseradish | 1 teaspoon caster sugar | 1 tablespoon light sour cream | 1 teaspoon saffron thread | 1 teaspoon seasoning
instructions: Slice the okra and ham lenghtways and place in serving dish. Cut remaining okra and ham against the grain and place in center of serving dish. Combine all the ingredients, including the saffron and seasoning in a bowl and mix well. Spoon mixture over okra and ham and sprinkle cheese over the top.

title: Tomato & Date Slices With Apples (Baklava)
ingredients: 1 apple, peeled, cored, chopped | 1 teaspoon minced pimiento | 1 tablespoon grated fresh cilantro | 1 tablespoon canned tomato juice | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 1 package frozen phyllo dough, thawed | 1 cup finely chopped dates ( about 12 ounces )
instructions: In a small frying pan heat the pimento, cilantro and tomato juice over moderate heat. When simmering, stir in the mace and cook 1 minute. Arrange the phyllo dough in a 12x4x2 inch glass baking dish and top with apples and pimiento mixture. Cover with plastic wrap and let stand at room temperature until phyllo has been stacked, about 15 minutes. Preheat oven to 350°f. Bake until golden brown, about 35 minutes. Let cool, cut into 12 slices, and serve with a few pimento slices.

title: Homemade Wood Stick - Vietnamese Stock
ingredients: 5 -6 lbs romaine lettuce | 1 inch fresh ginger ( peeled ) | roasted ginger ( optional )
instructions: Rinse greens thoroughly and soak overnight. The next day remove the lettuce with a cheesecloth or strainer placed into a large pot of cold water. When the water starts to boil, throw in ginger and wood stick. Reduce heat, cover and simmer until wood sticks are tender. Note, to prevent wood sticks burning, submerge the wood sticks in a bowl filled with cold water and let sit for 10 - 15 minutes. Drain and rinse with cool water and allow wood sticks to dry in a dry towel. The fungus will keep for up to 2 - 3 days. Serve in soup bowls with mint and pepper flavored vietnamese vinaigrette. I like this recipe to dip all sorts of fresh herbs into the warm, delicious vietnamese vinaigrette.

title: Tandoori Bananas
ingredients: 2 tablespoons nigella seeds or 2 tablespoons other nut seeds | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg | 1 cup wild rice, cooked | 2 bananas leaves
instructions: Heat ghee in a pan and add nigella or nut seeds. Let it crackle. Add cardamom and nutmeg. Stir fry until it starts to change color. Cool. Grind rice and set aside. Cut a circle of foil. Brush it with nigella. Place 2 banana leaves on top and pinch edges to seal them. Arrange around it all at once.

title: Carrie's Pork & Cheese Triangles
ingredients: 500 g minced pork ( lean ) | 1 packet taco seasoning mix | 600 ml double cream | 250 g guacamole | 1 tablespoon thyme, chopped | 1 sheet phyllo pastry
instructions: Mix minced pork with taco seasoning then brown in a skillet on medium heat in small amount of olive oil. Whip cream then fold in guacamole and thyme. Place 1 sheet of phyllo pastry on greased oven tray. Using a 3cm heart shape, place the 2 tsp of meat mixture in the centre then brush with the cream mixture. Fold two opposite sides over the filling then seal tightly with remaining phyllo pastry. Bake, 15 mins or until golden brown.

title: Guilt-Free Peach Applesauce
ingredients: 1 large ripe peach | 4 teaspoons unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Remove the peel from the frozen peach and place in blender with 2 teaspoons of cocoa. Blend until smooth. Transfer to small saucepan. Pour through fine sieve, pressing the peel with your fingers or a small spoon to remove all of the seeds. Press through sieve, discarding skins and peels. Store in refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: celery rib,dijon mustard,penne pasta,red chili sauce,honey
title: Red Chile Penne
ingredients: 500 g dry penne pasta | 2 celery ribs, chopped | 1 -2 tablespoon honey | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 8 tablespoons red chili sauce | 2 tablespoons red chili sauce
instructions: In a large pot of boiling water, cook pasta, drain and return to the pot. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cook until sauce is thick. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: red kidney bean,italian parsley,caper,kaiser,tarragon leaf,milk,tortilla chip
title: Italian-Style Tortilla Chip Salad
ingredients: 1 can red kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 1 1/2 cups shredded kaiser rolls | 1/2 cup minced tarragon leaf | 1 bunch minced fresh italian parsley | 2 tablespoons capers, drained | 1 tablespoon minced fresh italian parsley | 1 tablespoon shredded fat-free evaporated milk
instructions: Whisk together beans, rolls, tarragon leaves, parsley, capers, and hot milk in a bowl. Cover and refrigerate until serving.

Random Ingredients: cider vinegar,el paso enchilada sauce,celery rib,dijon mustard,cardamom seed,taco seasoning mix,iceberg lettuce,garlic paste
title: Taco Salad
