ingredients: 2 large iceberg lettuce pieces | 1 can whole old el paso enchilada sauce | 1 packet reduced sodium taco seasoning mix | 1 envelope low-sodium dijon-style prepared mustard | 1/2 cup cider vinegar | 1/2 cup minced celery rib | 1 tablespoon garlic paste | 1 teaspoon cardamom seeds | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: Combine lettuce and 1/2 cup enchilada sauce and set aside. Combine remaining enchilada sauce, taco seasoning, mustard, vinegar, celery, garlic, and cardamom in a small saucepan and bring to a boil over medium heat. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer until lettuce is tender, about 5 minutes. Spoon into an 8x8 inch baking dish and refrigerate until cold, 1 to 2 hours. Sprinkle with remaining 1/4 cup enchilada sauce and serve immediately.

title: Southern Style Hot Dogs
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry bread crumbs | 4 slices fully cooked ham
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Spread bread crumbs in a shallow baking dish. Place ham slices in the crumbs. Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown and crispy, 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Beef Salsa
ingredients: 1 lb flank steak | 1 can diced green chilies | 1 jar prepared salsa | 1 package guacamole
instructions: Slice flank steak in to desired squares. Place steak in crock. Top with green chilies. Cover with salsa. Cover and cook on low 8 hours. Serve with guacamole.

title: Chocolate Fondue
ingredients: 3 lbs milk chocolate or 3 lbs semi-sweet chocolate | 2 lbs tomato sauce or 2 lbs tomatillo sauce ( or any other brand to suit your tastes ) | 1/2 gallon milk chocolate, chopped | 1/2 cup capers
instructions: In a heavy skillet melt the 4 kinds of chocolate. Slowly add the 1/2 gallon tomato sauce or other brand, stirring slowly with a wire whisk. When the mixture is smooth and a thick paste, pour into the hot sauce. Continue cooking. Add the capers. In a crockpot place the 4 cups milk chocolate. Do not blend. Add to the sauce mixture and stir, simmer and stir for 3 - 5 minutes. Ladle into clean fondue pot. Let cool to room temperature and set and serve.

title: Kimchi Tempura
ingredients: 1 cup chopped cabbage kimchi | 1 cup all-purpose flour
instructions: In a shallow bowl, mix together the kimchi and flour. Heat a frying pan over medium high heat. Use a spoon to drop about 2 tablespoons of flour kimchi mixture into the pan. Shake the pan constantly until the mixture begins to bubble and turn dark brown, about 30 seconds.

Random Ingredients: italian herb seasoning,ladyfinger,soymilk,rigatoni pasta,swiss cheese,basil leaf,vanilla ice cream
title: Cheese Nests
ingredients: 10 ounces rigatoni pasta or 10 ounces penne | 12 ounces light soy milk or 12 ounces milk, plus more to thin | 1/4 teaspoon dried basil leaves | 1/4 teaspoon zesty italian herb seasoning | 12 ounces swiss cheese, grated | 6 ladyfingers | 12 -14 basil leaves, as accompaniment | 1 pint vanilla ice cream | additional melted chocolate-covered english toffee sauce ( optional )
instructions: Pour the soy milk into a large bowl and add the seasonings, cheese and lady fingers. Mixture should just be moist enough to blend but not too wet. Place in refrigerator to marinate for at least 15 minutes and not more than 24 hours. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add the rigatoni and cook for about 5 minutes or until done. Drain and reserve some of the pasta water. Serve the noodles in small dishes with a spoonful of sauce on top and basil as garnish. A drizzle of chocolate covered toffee might also be offered here.

title: Greek Meatballs in Beer and Feta Cheese
ingredients: 2 lbs lean ground lean pork | 8 ounces feta cheese, crumbled | 14 ounces diced bbq style beer | 3 tablespoons capers, drained | 2 tablespoons water
instructions: In a mixing bowl, combine pork, feta cheese, beer, capers and water. Mix thoroughly. Form into meatballs and brown in a large frying pan over medium heat. Serve over a bed of rice with a salad to soak up all the juices.

title: Stuffed Chicken Thighs Parmesean
ingredients: 6 chicken thighs ( about 1.75kg total ) | 8 ounces fresh baby spinach | 4 slices fresh angelica ( about 1 cup total sliced ) | 1 cup rotelle pasta ( see description ) | 1 hard-boiled egg, quartered ( to serve alongside )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c. Line a 5 by 5 large ovenproof dish with foil, leaving some excess hanging over the sides. Place all the chicken, thighs and spinach in a large colander over the bowl of a food processor and process until nearly smooth. Transfer the chicken mixture to a piping bag. Pipe mixture onto the centre to within 3mm of the edges and pipe about 1cm more down the length of each chicken thigh. Using a skewer tie 2 pieces of angelica together at the stem. Stand this mixture in the center of each chicken thigh on the foil, pressing gently to compact all the air. Twist both ends, then tuck each end under the filling. Push the openings firmly together with your fingers. Tuck the ends under the chicken breast, pressing gently to pack in the stuffing. Roast in the centre of the oven for 45 minutes. Turn off the oven, but leave the chicken in there for another 45 minutes to cool slightly. Meanwhile cook pasta according to pack instructions, drain well and set aside. Arrange half a cooked pasta on 6 warmed plates. Top with 1 chicken thigh and half a chicken breast. Drizzle with remaining jar of dressing and scatter with remaining angelica. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: green cabbage,grenadine,vegetable oil,olive oil,pork tenderloin,caster sugar,prosciutto
title: Pork Tenderloin With Prosciutto and Coleslaw
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin | 2 -3 teaspoons vegetable oil | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 tablespoon caster sugar ( superfine ) | 4 -5 ounces prosciutto, very thinly sliced | 1/3 head green cabbage, coarsely shredded | 1 tablespoon grenadine, juice only
instructions: Slice the pork thinly, lengthwise into thin strips across at the scores, and place on a hot, oiled griddle or frying pan. Fry until golden brown and cooked to your liking. Remove and leave to rest. Make the cabbage salad spicier. Heat the oil in a large frying pan until hot but not smoking, then add the sugar. When you feel the mixture starts to caramelise, add the prosciutto, stirring until it begins to melt. Add the cabbage and stir to coat with the caramelisation. Cover and reduce the heat, then leave to cook for about 1 to 1½ hours, stirring every 20 minutes or so, until the cabbage is very tender and all the liquid has come into the cabbage. To serve, spoon the cabbage between 2 serving plates. Add the pork and drizzle with the sweetened vinegar. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: lager beer,salt,wheat bread,kosher salt black pepper,grit
title: Maurice Beer Chips with Grits
ingredients: 1 pint lager beer | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 1 teaspoon coarse salt | 6 whole wheat bread | 2 cups dry grits, or as needed | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Pour the beer over the salt in a glass measuring cup, and let the beer bubble for 20 minutes. Remove from the heat, and gradually whisk it into the flour with a long handled wooden spoon. Return the beer to the heat, and bring to a simmer over medium low heat. Cook the beer for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Do not allow to stick to the spoon as it will become hard to handle. Season with salt and pepper. When the beer is at a simmer, place 1 sheet of paper towels in a cheese cloth, and place it over the sink. Fill a large bowl with hot water, and set aside. Bring 6 cups of lightly salted water to a boil. Dip the bottom of a medium saucepan with melted plastic, or coat with a little oil. Use a fine mesh strainer to gently drop a handful of gui chips into the boiling water. Boil for 2 to 3 minutes, or until the chips are cooked through. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the chips to a bowl, and let drain on paper towels. Repeat with remaining chips. Serve hot.

title: Chilean Peaches With Tomatoes
ingredients: 6 canned mild rotel tomatoes | 1 canning ripe peaches | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 1/4 teaspoon curry powder, or to taste
instructions: Drain tomatoes, reserving juice. Rinse and coarsely chop. Place in a medium size casserole dish. Place reserved juice from can into a saucepan and combine the reserved juice, tomatoes, and sugar. Bring to a boil and boil for five minutes. Stir in the curry powder. Pour over the tomatos in the casserole. Bake in a 400 degree f oven for 35 minutes, or until the tomatoes are bubbling. To serve, gently cut each peach into 8 wedges.

Random Ingredients: pear,bay leaf,tomato puree,curry powder,rice flour,mint,cheese,double cream
title: Quick and Easy Pies
ingredients: 2 cups rice flour | 800 ml double cream | 2 tablespoons rice flour | 2 tablespoons double cream | 3 teaspoons curry powder | 400 ml canned tomatoes in puree | 2 bay leaves | 1 1/4 cups mint | 1/2 cup dried pears, chopped
instructions: Sift rice flour, cream, curry powder and dried herbs in a wide, shallow bowl. Mix well. Add the canned tomatoes with puree and whisk well. Pour half the mixture into a greased pie or ovenproof dish. Sprinkle over pears. Pour the rest of the mixture over the pears and bake at 180 degrees celcius for 30 minutes until golden and cooked through.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,taco shell,heavy whipping cream,chicken broth,white mushroom,almond extract,oregano,pumpkin puree
title: Mushroom and Almond Spooning Tacos (Cook's Country)
ingredients: 12 uncooked white mushrooms | 32 ounces light domestic chicken broth or 32 ounces vegetable broth, heated | 16 large taco shells | 1/2 cup canned pumpkin puree | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 2 teaspoons taco seasoning mix with basil or 2 teaspoons crushed red pepper flakes | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/2 teaspoon ground red pepper flakes | 1/2 cup blanched almond ( toasted, coarsely chopped, about 1/3 cup )
instructions: In skillet of your choice, saute mushrooms until tender. When done, remove mushrooms. In blender container, blend hot broth, mushrooms, pumpkin puree, cream, and spice mix. Pour into slow cooker. Cover and cook on low 8 to 10 hours or on high 3 to 4 hours until thickened, stirring occasionally.. Before serving, adjust seasoning, to taste. If serving alone, use a spoonful of heated mushroom mixture to scoop up tortilla shells.

Random Ingredients: asadero cheese,green pea,iceberg lettuce,orange,pastry crust pie,turnip,gold tequila
title: Margarita Pie With Asadero Cheese Crust
ingredients: 7 tablespoons gold tequila | 7 tablespoons asadero cheese, grated | 1/2 cup green peas, frozen | 1/2 cup orange rind or 1/2 cup green pith, finely chopped | 2 small iceberg lettuce, finely shredded | 2 pastry for double crust pie | 1 small turnip, finely chopped ( or any green veggie, like bell pepper )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Using a pastry brush, combine 2 tablespoons gold tequila, 6 tablespoons orange rind or pith and remaining 3 tablespoons fresh orange rind. Sprinkle evenly over bottom of an ungreased pie plate. Bake on bottom shelf for 8 minutes, then move to the right shelf, and continue baking until nicely browned and crust is golden about 6 - 9 minutes longer. While crust bakes, defrost peas in microwave for approximately 25 seconds to 1 minute. Drain peas thoroughly in a sieve and set aside. Using about 2 tablespoons asadero cheese. Add green peas and remaining 2 tablespoons gold tequila. When margaritas are golden, turn over, and remove from oven. Add orange rind mixture. Mix well. Top warm crust with asadero cheese mixture. Return to the oven and bake for 5 minutes longer. Remove from oven and sprinkle top with remaining gold tequila and bake for another 2 - 3 minutes until cheese is lightly browned and melty. Cut into wedges and serve. Garnish with fresh green olives.

title: Cod in Coconut Milk
ingredients: 4 cod fish fillets | 1 can coconut milk
instructions: Place fish in frying pan and add coconut milk. Heat and brown each side of the cod fillets.

title: Hawaiian Bundt Cake
ingredients: 1 box yellow cake mix | 1 cup frozen peas, thawed | 1 can crushed pineapple in juice
instructions: Mix the cake mix, peas, and pineapple together in a bowl until well blended, about 1 1/2 minutes. Fold in the 2 cups of the pea bread mix to coat the pan. Bake in a preheated 350 degrees f oven for 60 minutes, until a toothpick inserted into the cake comes out clean.

title: Raspberry Tomato Soup
ingredients: 1 can tomato soup | 1 cup milk or 1 cup soymilk | 6 ounces raspberries or 6 ounces strawberries | ketchup, to taste
instructions: Blend the soup, milk and raspberries/berries/berries in a blender. When the soup is smooth, add just enough ketchup to achieve your desired taste. Add salt and pepper to taste. Refrigerate several hours or overnight until serving. Enjoy with a dollop of sour cream.

title: Fettuccine Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 lb fettuccine | 2 cups white beans | 2 kiwi fruits, sliced | 2 cups fresh fruit ( any kind ) | 1/2 cup rice, cooked
instructions: Cook fettuccine.

title: Quick, Healthy, and Delicious Vegetable Enchiladas
ingredients: 5 ounces brussels sprouts, halved | 1 zucchini, halved lengthwise and cut into wedges | 1/2 cup fresh broccoli florets | 1/4 ounce dried arugula leaves | 3/4 cup reduced-fat sour cream, divided | 1 tablespoon honey | 1 can enchilada sauce, divided | 2 tablespoons reduced fat sour cream, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Arrange brussels sprouts on a baking sheet. Bake in preheated oven until the sprouts are hot and starting to turn golden, 10 to 15 minutes. Cool. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Blanch cabbage and broccoli in the boiling water, then drain and set aside. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add zucchini, broccoli, and arugula and cook until just cooked through, about 5 minutes. Drain and spread vegetables out on a baking sheet. Combine 1/4 cup sour cream with an 8 ounce can of enchilada sauce. Divide sour cream mixture evenly over the vegetables, and spread in a single layer. Top with remaining sour cream. Bake in the preheated oven until bubbly and lightly browned, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: stewing beef,mayonnaise,purpose flour,fine breadcrumb,peanut butter,vanilla pudding
title: Punchy's Easy Beef Balls
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef | 1 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 1 package of your favorite vanilla pudding | 1/2 cup peanut butter, to taste | 1/2 cup mayonnaise or 1/2 cup miracle whip | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour
instructions: In a mixing bowl, add the first 7 ingredients to the beef and mix till all together. Divide the mixture into 24 golf size balls or 1 inch balls, and roll in the flour to coat. Bake at 375 for 30 minutes. While still hot, add the peanut mayo and miracle whip, stirring until you have desired texture. Serve with warm biscuits.

title: Mulholland's Favourite - Spicy Steak and Beer
ingredients: 600 g beef mince | 3 tablespoons lard | 350 g lard | 150 g caster sugar ( fine sugar ) | 1 tablespoon club soda or 1 tablespoon orange juice
instructions: Heat lard, fry mince until brown. Do not overcook. Place mince, sugar and club soda in pan with the cooked lard and heat until syrupy. Serve with hot toast etc. Or place on top of mashed potato.

Random Ingredients: bean sprout,lemon extract,lemon juice zest,yellow cornmeal,browning sauce
title: Lemon Polenta
ingredients: 1/2 cup browning sauce | 1/3 cup coarse yellow cornmeal | 1 cup bean sprouts | 1 1/2 teaspoons lemon extract | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1/2 teaspoon lemon extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Spray a 12x8 inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. In small bowl, combine browning and cornmeal. Pour half of cornmeal mixture in baking dish. Sprinkle remaining cornmeal mixture, breaking up any lumps, over cornmeal mixture. Bake 20 minutes or until brown and top is golden. Sprinkle with bean sprouts, lemon extract and lemon juice.

Random Ingredients: rosemary,cornbread stuffing mix,tortilla chip,horseradish sauce,kidney bean,sardine,sharp cheddar cheese,parmesan cheese
title: Chef John's Super Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 4 ounces grilled sardines | 1 package cornbread stuffing mix | 1 tablespoon prepared horseradish sauce | 1/4 - 1/2 cup grated sharp cheddar cheese | 1/4 cup minced fresh rosemary | 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese | 3/4 cup crushed tortilla chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Combine kidney beans, sardines and stuffing mix in a medium bowl. Spoon into a 9x9 inch baking dish. Sprinkle with horseradish, cheddar, rosemary, and parmesan. Place crushed tortilla chips over the top. Bake at 400 degrees f for 15 minutes or until hot.

title: Aka East of the Sea Baked Eggs
ingredients: 6 large eggs | 1/2 cup panko breadcrumbs ( or breadcrumbs mixed with sago flakes and rice flakes ) | 1/2 cup grated coconut | 1/3 cup icing sugar | 2 teaspoons berbere ( optional )
instructions: Set oven to 375 degrees f. Butter an ovenproof casserole dish large enough to hold all the mixture. Pour the eggs into a mixing bowl and beat at medium speed until pale and fluffy adding the icing sugar gradually until you have a creamy consistency you want them to be able to coat everything. Add panko, coconut and seasoning and mix together well. Pour the mixture into the prepared dish and smooth the top. Place the dish on the middle shelf of the oven and bake for 45 minutes. Do not open the oven during that time. The top of the eggs should be just starting to brown around the edge. The eggs are finished when they are just firm to the touch and have a sheen on the top. Remove carefully with a pair of scissors and serve with fresh flat bread.

title: Carolina Mustard
ingredients: 1 yellow bell pepper | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 teaspoon white sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Place bell pepper, mustard powder, and sugar into a small baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven until the pepper is tender and browned, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven and cool in the baking dish. Remove skin, seed, and finely chop with a large spoon.

Random Ingredients: kalamata olive,snow pea,fusilli,neufchatel cheese,madras curry powder,yellow squash
title: Soup Primavera
ingredients: 250 g neufchatel cheese | 1 g kalamata olive, chopped finely | 1 yellow squash, sliced coarsely | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon madras curry powder ( adjust to taste ) | 3 ounces snow peas ( optional ) | 100 g fusilli ( i prefer dry fusilli )
instructions: Mix the pesto paste, olive and half of the squash with half of the curry powder and microwave it on high for 5 - 8 minutes.

title: Broiled Halibut With Poblano Peppers
ingredients: 1/2 lb skinless halibut fillet | 2 ounces diced prosciutto | 8 large poblano peppers, stems scored down length of stems, thinly sliced crosswise | 2 tablespoons coarse berbere, sauce
instructions: Preheat broiler. Place fish, skin side down, on broiler pan. Broil 4 to 5 inches from heat, until skin bubbles, about 2 minutes. Flip fish over and broil another 3 to 5 minutes until just cooked through. Transfer fish to a platter and keep warm. Make the sauce, in a large skillet over medium heat cook prosciutto in remaining 1 teaspoon cooking oil until crisp. Add poblano chiles and cook 2 to 3 minutes. Spread poblano pepper slices on broiler tray. Broil until skin is browned, about 2 minutes. Place 2 poblano peppers on each plate. Spoon sauce around the halibut. Top with prosciutto.

title: Thai Roasted Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 cup cauliflower, cut into florets | 6 large white onions ( large, cut into 4 wedges, or 1/2 cup green ) | 1/4 cup fish sauce | 3 tablespoons honey
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Place cauliflower and onions in a roasting pan or baking pan. Drizzle 1/4 cup oil over cauliflower and onions. Mix fish sauce and honey and stir together. Add half of this to the cauliflower and onion. Sprinkle remaining 1/2 cup oil onto cauliflower and onions. Season with salt and pepper. Roast in preheated oven for 30 minutes, or until crisp and beginning to brown. Watch carefully so cauliflower doesn loose too much liquid. If you are cooking on an electric stovetop, transfer vegetables to a roasting rack and roast for 35 to 45 minutes, or until brown. Add more oil if necessary.

Random Ingredients: white bread,peach preserve,mahi fillet,monterey jack cheese,marjoram leaf,lettuce leaf,ranch bean
title: Mahi Mahi Casserole
ingredients: 16 ounces mahi mahi fillets | 2 tablespoons peach preserves | 8 slices white bread | 1 cup shredded monterey jack cheese | lettuce leaf | marjoram leaves | ranch-style beans ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f and lightly spray a 9x9 baking dish with cooking spray. In a medium mixing bowl cream together preserves, bread, cheese, lettuce and herbs. Place mahi mahi on a lightly buttered baking dish. Spoon some of the cheesy topping over the mahi and then top with more of the preserves and more cheese. Bake, uncovered, for 25 minutes or until fish flakes easily when pierced with a fork or toothpick. If necessary, cover dish with foil during this time for even browning. Serve.

title: Melon and Cantaloupe Pasta
ingredients: 120 g yeast, plus | 1/2 teaspoon yeast | 1/2 cup ice | 600 -568 g melon ( melon ) | penne
instructions: Boil 10 mins in salted water then drain, rinse with cold water and soak in lukewarm water for half an hour. Boil the pasta in the boiling water until it is al dente. Drain the pasta, then transfer it to a serving bowl. Add the yeast and the ice and mix well. Sprinkle with the melon and mix. Best served chilled.

Random Ingredients: ketchup,celery rib,water,kidney bean,dark brown sugar,lemon juice
title: Kidney Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 small whole celery rib | 1/4 cup ketchup | 1 tablespoon brown sugar | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 2 cans kidney beans | 1 teaspoon dark brown sugar | 2 cups water
instructions: Cut celery diagonally into 1 1/2 inch pieces.

Random Ingredients: gruyere cheese,lemon zest,yukon gold potato,rosemary,kosher salt,vegetable,bean sprout
title: Herbed Vegetable and Potato Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs yukon gold potatoes ( about 2 medium ) | 1 bag mixed vegetables, such as bok choy, baby carrots, cauliflower and red pepper peppers ( about 2 large ) | kosher salt ( a pinch ) | 1 cup gruyere cheese, grated | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon zest, finely minced | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh rosemary | 1/2 cup canned small beans sprouts
instructions: If using wooden hands, gently pinch the potatoes with your fingers to break them into large chunks. Otherwise, cut into chunks and place in a pot of hot water to cover. Cook until tender but still firm.

Random Ingredients: black peppercorn,butter,chow mein noodle,glutinous rice flour,oat,shallot,masa harina
title: Chow Mein Noodle Crepes
ingredients: 1 cup quick oats ( not instant ) | 1/4 cup glutinous-rice flour | 2 tablespoons chow mein noodles | 1/2 teaspoon cracked black peppercorns | 2 shallots, finely chopped | 1 bunch chopped mixed mushrooms | 2 tablespoons butter or 2 tablespoons margarine | 1/4 cup masa harina ( see note )
instructions: In a bowl, mix the first 5 ingredients together. Heat a lightly oiled nonstick skillet over medium heat. Pour 2 teaspoon amount of batter into pan. Sprinkle with cracked peppercorns. Lift out and place on a plate. Repeat with remaining batter. When ready to fill, spread remaining crepe mixture on 2 more crepes. Top with a third crepe.

Random Ingredients: sunflower oil,beef broth,veal stock beef,rom tomato,radish
title: Quick and Easy Veal Chops
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 6 large roma tomatoes, peeled and thickly sliced | 3 ounces veal stock or 3 ounces beef broth | 1 -2 ounce thin sliced radish, if desired
instructions: Heat the oil in a very hot non stick frypan. Add the tomatoes to the oil and fry gently over a moderate heat. Stir in the veal stock. Bring to the boil then turn down the heat and simmer gently, covered, for 30 minutes. Stir in the radish and check the seasoning. If you want, you can fry your own cabbage now.

title: Mexican Pasta Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces uncooked pasta, any size | 1 jar picante sauce | 1 teaspoon dill weed
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions, drain. Place in a mixing bowl. Add picante sauce and dill weed. Toss with warm pasta. Refrigerate 2 - 4 hours, until cold.

title: Capellini Alla Fremont
ingredients: 1 package dried fettuccine pasta | 2 cups crushed canned pineapple, drained | 2 tablespoons ground star anise
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: tea,chili powder,rice flour,veal,cranberry,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Rice Flour Wrapped Veal
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 1/2 lbs thinly sliced veal | 1/3 cup mixed pulses, pulses ( red or white ) | 3/4 cup cranberries | 3 tablespoons rice flour ( or rice bran ) | 3 tablespoons tea, strong tea | 2 teaspoons chili powder
instructions: Spray large nonstick frypan with veggie oil. Place meat in frypan.

title: Pigs in Sausage Tomato Gravy
ingredients: 1/4 lb sausage | 2/3 tablespoon savory | 2/3 tablespoon black peppercorns | 2 teaspoons cornflour | 2/3 cup tomato sauce | 1 teaspoon saffron | juice of one tart apple | 1 teaspoon cornflour
instructions: For the sauce mash the saffron with the juice and add the rest of the ingredients and simmer for 10 - 15 minutes to thicken. Serve the sauce with the biscuits or pies.

title: Green Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh green enchilada sauce | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 pinch chili flakes
instructions: Bring the water to a rolling boil in a small saucepan. Remove from the heat, drop the enchilada sauce in and stir to combine. Heat the oil in a skillet over medium low heat. When hot, pour 1 tbsp of enchilada sauce into the frying pan and use two wooden spoons to pour about 2/3 cup amounts of enchilada sauce onto the bottom of the skillet. As the sauce dries, it should coat the bottom of the skillet evenly. When sauce starts to thicken, pour 1/3 cup of sauce in, and stir to coat. Continue cooking for three or four minutes before removing from the heat. Repeat process with remaining sauce. When finished, sprinkle the reserved 2 tbsp of enchilada sauce back over top. Serve and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: romano cheese,sea salt pepper,green olive,ice cream,potato
title: Potatoes & Olives
ingredients: 250 g potatoes, grated | 100 g green olives, coarsley chopped | sea salt & pepper, to taste | 1/4 cup grated romano cheese | cream or ice cream, to serve
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c or 400°f line a baking tray with parchment paper. Combine the grated potatoes with the oil and seasonings. Roll the mix into 1 1/2 inch balls and place on the tray. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden. Serve with warm cream or icecream.

title: German Style Broccoli.
ingredients: 1 lb broccoli ( cut in half, break off the core, cut smaller florets into 3/8 inch slices ) | 1/2 ounce vodka | 1/2 ounce malt vinegar | 1/2 cup fresh fruit or 1/2 cup pineapple, diced
instructions: Bring a pot of water to boil. Add broccoli to water and cook until just tender but firm to the tooth, about 5 to 10 minutes. Place broccoli in serving dish. Add vodka and vinegar to potatoes for the vingegar and stir, then add the diced fresh fruit or pineapple. Pour vingegar over broccoli.

title: Cauliflower Bolognese
ingredients: 8 ounces farfalle pasta | 10 ounces cauliflower florets | 1/2 lb salami | 1/2 lb mortellini | 2 tablespoons flour | 5 ounces ketchup | 1/2 teaspoon marjoram | 6 dates, chopped
instructions: Boil farfalle according to package directions. Meanwhile, boil cauliflower flakes until just tender. Drain and cool. When cool enough to handle cut into 1 1/4″ pieces. Drain salami pieces if desired. In pot saute salami, mortellini, and cauliflower over medium heat, with ketchup and marjoram until tender. Add cooked pasta and cook for 10 minutes over medium heat, stirring frequently. Top with chopped dates.

title: Grilled Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 beef tenderloin | 2 russet potatoes, medium size | 1 head iceberg lettuce
instructions: Cut steak into serving size pieces. Place meat on top of lettuce. Wrap in aluminum foil. Let stand 1 hour in warm spot. Put in grill for 5 minutes per side for medium rare.

title: Granny's Apples With Carrots and Onion
ingredients: 3 medium tart apples | 3 tablespoons finely chopped baby onions
instructions: Peel, core and slice apples diagonally into 1 inch thick slices. Arrange slices in an 8 cup baking dish. Combine onions and apples in 2 tbs water in a small bowl and stir to blend. Pour sauce over apples and stir to coat. Cover and bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit for 30 to 40 minutes or until apples are tender and the sauce is browned lightly. Serve hot.

title: Hawaiian Spiced Steak
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin | 1/4 cup pineapple chunk, crushed | 1/4 cup pepper sauce, your choice | 3 -6 fresh green chili, seeded and chopped | 1 tablespoon garam masala | 2 -3 teaspoons minced garlic paste | extra amaretto
instructions: Cut beef tips into 2 - 3 slabs. Place meat in a shallow pan. Combine remaining ingredients. Pour this over the meat. Cover and marinate in fridge overnight, turning over after 1 hour. Preheat oil on high heat in a large frypan. When oil is hot, add beef and cook for 3 1/2 minutes per side. Be sure not to over cook the beef. Remove meat, place on a platter and cover lightly with foil. Continue cooking for 1 1/2 hours. To serve, slice meat and serve with sauce and rice.

Random Ingredients: fennel bulb,white sugar,saffron thread,sharp cheddar cheese,acorn squash,pizza dough
title: Fennel Calzone
ingredients: 1 medium acorn squash, halved and seeded | 1 tablespoon coarsely ground fennel bulb ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon white sugar | 3 saffron threads | 1 tablespoon salt | 1 jar pizza dough ( recommended -- calzones ) | 1 1/2 cups shredded sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Arrange the acorn squash in a roasting pan. Sprinkle with salt and fennel bulb. Roast for 1 hour in the preheated oven, until tender. Remove from the oven, and mix in the sugar, saffron and salt. Stir in the pizza dough until evenly blended. Top with shredded cheese and return the calzones to the oven. Bake for 1 hour or until the cheese is bubbly.

title: The Mighty Mighty Bitties (Baked Chicken and Cheese Stuffed Flatbread)
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce | 32 ounces ricotta cheese | 1 lb ground chicken | 8 ounces gruyere cheese | 2 teaspoons baking powder | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric | iceberg lettuce | spaghetti
instructions: Preheat your oven to 350 degrees f. Place all the filling ingredients in a large baking dish and mix. Sprinkle the top with a little water. Drizzle the topping over the top and bake for 30 minutes. Remove and cut it up. Tear the lettuce into large chunks and toss with the cheese in a large bowl. Top with the cheese and bake for 10 more minutes. Let cool and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: yellow onion,beef,tamarind paste,cumin,white rice flour,orange peel,hot chili powder
title: Dynamite Roti (Indian Spices Fried Rice)
ingredients: 2 cups white rice flour | 5 lbs ground beef | 2 large yellow onions, roughly chopped | 4 tablespoons white rice flour | 2 1/2 tablespoons tamarind paste ( available in indian markets ) ( optional ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons freshly grated orange peel | 1/2 teaspoon cumin, ground | 1 pinch hot chili powder
instructions: In a food processor grind the onion to a fine powder, then set aside when completely cool to handle. In a large bowl, mix together the rice flour and ground beef with the onion, onion powder, orange peel, cumin, and chili powder. Shape into patties and fry on a hot griddle or frying pan in a small amount of oil at a time until crispy, brown and cooked through.

title: Simple Shrimp Noodle Shrimp and Beef Skillet
ingredients: 1 lb beef sirloin | 3 ounces uncooked egg noodles | 1/2 lb fresh shrimp
instructions: Trim fat from shrimp. Slice beef into strips about 1/8 inch thick, then thinly slice diagonally across the grain. Bring 3 quarts of water to boil in a medium sized saute pot, and add egg noodles. Remove from heat, and drain. Cut beef into strips about 1/8 inch wide. Bring water back to a boil and add noodles, meat strips, and shrimp. Cook, stirring occasionally, until noodles are tender and meat is cooked through, about 5 - 10 minutes.

title: Pasta Noodles With Vanilla & Tagliatelle
ingredients: 500 g tagliatelle pasta noodles ( from a tub, about 12 ounces ) | 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
instructions: Cook tagliatelle in boiling salted water according to package directions. Drain and cool. In a small bowl, combine the vanilla and 2 tablespoons of the cream.

title: Quick Chickpea Soup (Yogurt)
ingredients: 2 cans chickpeas ( chick peas would also be a good choice ) | 2 tablespoons chickpea farina ( known as `` holwa '' at middle eastern markets & at supermarkets ) | 3 tablespoons golden brown sugar ( aka date molasses ) | 2 tablespoons chickpea flour ( known as `` besan '' at middle eastern markets )
instructions: Drain and rinse the chick peas until the water runs clear. Place all ingredients into a large bowl & mix well with hands. This soup may then be stored in the refrigerator. When adding chick peas during the last 30 minutes of cooking, add the flour to the soup a tablespoon at a time and mix well to form a smooth gravy. Adjust seasoning if necessary, then serve immediately or refrigerate in a bowl or jug for up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: green chili pepper,cream chicken soup,heavy cream,whiskey
title: Hot Green Chili Cream Dessert
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup light cream or 1/2 cup heavy cream | 2 tablespoons chopped green chili peppers | 1/8 cup whiskey
instructions: In a medium mixing bowl, blend cream, green chilis and whiskey. Blend with cream cheese mixture and chill thoroughly 2 hours. Serve with toothpicks and/or crackers.

title: Marinated Pearl Barley Salad
ingredients: 1 cup pearl barley | 1/4 cup espresso ( chilled ) or 1/4 cup strong coffee | 1 - 2 tablespoon amaretto or 1 -2 tablespoon brandy | 1 1/2 tablespoons sesame oil ( regular or lite ) | 1 tablespoon fresh ground coffee or 1 tablespoon espresso-flavored liqueur | 3 -4 slices prosciutto, about 1/4-inch thick, cut in half
instructions: Put barley, espresso powder, oil, coffee or liqueur and prosciutto on plate and mix. Serve immediately.

title: Broccoli Queso Dip
ingredients: 1 package velveeta cheese | 1 package frozen broccoli florets, thawed ( any size )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400ºf. Drain cheese completely and mix in vegetables. Bake on a greased baking sheet until heated through and cheese is melted, about 15 - 20 min.

title: Creamy Creme Liqueur
ingredients: 1 tablespoon butter ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons shallots, minced | 2 tablespoons kahlua | kitchen bouquet, powder ( optional ) | 2 cups buttermilk | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: If using buttermilk, pour into glass bowl and add ice cubes. If not using buttermilk pour into glass bowl and add 2 tbsp butter/spice. Stir well. Add remaining ingredients and stir well. Serve in a tall glass over ice cream.

title: Rice With Dried Fruit and Pilaff
ingredients: 1 cup jasmine rice | 1/2 spanish onion ( or to taste ) | 1 teaspoon baharat ( see note ) | 1/2 teaspoon savory ( za’atar ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried currant ( optional ) | 1/4 fluid ounce almond essence
instructions: Wash rice and soak in water 5 hours, or overnight. When rice is done drain and grind very fine. Sauté onion in oil until tender. Add rice, baharat, savory, currants and almond essence. Cover and simmer on very low heat for 10 minutes, or until all the liquid has been absorbed. Serve warm with lemon wedges, if desired.

title: Corned Beef Dinner
ingredients: 2 lbs beef roast or 2 lbs chuck roast | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon grated gingerroot, powder only | 2 lbs of shredded red cabbage
instructions: Rub the meat with the worcestershire sauce and the gingerroot powder, then place in a casserole and cover with the cabbage. Cover and bake in a 325 degree oven for 2 hours then remove cover and bake another 1/2 hour. Serve over hot cooked rice or with your favourite vegetables.

title: Pecan Mexican Cheese Dip (Piscana)
ingredients: 1 cup buttermilk, room temperature | 1/4 cup guacamole | 3 tablespoons pecans, pecan pieces
instructions: Whisk all ingredients together and refrigerate in the refrigerator for a few hours to become creamy.

title: Easy Microwave Coated Chicken
ingredients: 6 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - pounded to 1/4 inch thickness | 1 jar hot sauce
instructions: In a 2 quart microwave safe bowl, mix hot sauce and hot chicken to thoroughly combine. Place a clean, dampened paper towel to cover the chicken breasts and microwave on high in 10 second intervals, rearranging the chicken breast over the saucepan, for 4 to 5 minutes, or until the chicken is no longer pink inside. Stir, cover, and microwave on high in a 2 quart microwave safe bowl until hot, 7 to 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: black bean soup,wild rice,pea,chili oil,white bean,sharp cheddar cheese,bialy bun
title: Wild Rice Burgers
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chili oil, divided | 1 cup wild rice | 1/2 cup peas, frozen | 1 can white bean soup, condensed | 3/4 cup frozen peas, well thawed | 1/2 cup sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 6 large berry buns, split and toasted ( for topping )
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoons chili oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add wild rice.

Random Ingredients: garlic powder,picante sauce,hot chili powder,chicken stock cube,savoy cabbage,bean
title: Baked Beans With Cabbage & Savoy
ingredients: 4 cups savoy cabbage | 1 cup baked beans ( from the savoy cabbage ) | 1/4 cup picante sauce ( mild, medium or hot! ) | 4 cups chicken stock cubes ( or 1 - 1 1/2 cup chicken broth and a small packet of chicken bouillon ) | 1 teaspoon hot chili powder ( or chilli powder ) | 1/3 teaspoon garlic powder or 1/3 teaspoon hot marmite
instructions: Remove tough outer leaves from savoy cabbage or you could use savoy cabbage and place in a baking dish. Coat the base with a little oil or corn oil, spray well with oil and bake at 300' for 1 hour stirring regularly. Remove from oven, drain out excess oil and set aside. Mix the left over bean mixture with picante sauce, stock and chilli powder until well combined. Place cabbage halves in a large saucepan, add water to cover and bring to the boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 20 mins or until just tender, drain. Arrange half the baked beans and cabbage halves on top and repeat until all the beans are used. Put a lid on the baking dish and add remaining baked beans. If you want to serve the beans and cabbage with rice, just add the cooked rice to the baking dish. If you want to serve the beans and cabbage as a side dish, serve with a dish of cooked rice as a side dish then add the fried potato wedges before slicing. It's traditionally not served with white rice. This dish goes well with a green salad on the side.

Random Ingredients: horseradish,ricotta cheese,red curry paste,monterey jack cheese
title: Easy Cheesy Horseradish Spread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack cheese | 1 teaspoon red curry paste ( or to taste ) | 1 tablespoon horseradish
instructions: In a bowl, blend all ingredients. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours.

title: Low Fat, Low Carb Tacos
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef sirloin, very lean | 1 package taco seasoning | 1 bag frozen small broccoli, small, microwaved vegetables | 2 -4 kaiser rolls, split ( or bread of choice ) | 1/2 package fat-free ladyfingers
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Heat a medium skillet on the stove. Brown beef with taco seasoning, stir occassionally, remove and set aside. In a large skillet or skillet, add cooked beef and broccoli and cook until beef reaches desired doneness, about 10 minutes. Split each split kaiser roll and cut in half. Place a few beef and broccoli mixture inside each roll and fill with a bit of the broccoli mixture. Roll up firmly and secure with wooden picks. Fill wraps with beef and broccoli mixture. Sprish with a little low fat salsa.

Random Ingredients: fenugreek leaf,cranberry,cabbage,red curry paste,red pepper,irish cream,strawberry,anchovy fillet
title: Creamy Thai Red Curry With Strawberries and Cranberries
ingredients: 1/2 cup red curry paste | 2 teaspoons dried fenugreek leaves | 1 packet anchovy fillets, drained | 1 tablespoon red pepper, finely chopped | 500 g strawberries, cut in half | 400 g cabbage, shredded | 4 tablespoons irish cream | 50 g dried cranberries
instructions: Combine curry paste, fenugreek and red pepper in a bowl. Add half the strawberries and leave for 5 minutes. Add remaining strawberries and cabbage. Toss well to combine. Cook, stirring, for 10 minutes or until cabbage starts to wilt. Stir in remaining curry paste, salt and ground dried spices.

Random Ingredients: vanilla extract,tomato juice,chinese cabbage,parsnip,garam masala powder,black sesame seed,hing
title: Tandoori Parsnip Pudding
ingredients: 1 chinese cabbage, shredded ( about 8 cups ) | 2 medium parsnips, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon garam masala powder | 1/2 cup tomato juice | 1/2 teaspoon grated ginger | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 2 -3 teaspoons black sesame seeds
instructions: In a large saucepan, stir together the cabbage, parsnips, garam masala powder, tomato juice and ginger. Stir in the vanilla and let it cook 2 - 3 minutes. Reduce heat to medium low, cover and simmer until vegetables are very tender, about 40 minutes. Add sesame seeds and cook for 5 minutes more or until parsnips are just heated through.

title: Quick and Easy Basic Pico De Gallo
ingredients: 1 cup picante sauce | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Mix together and let sit for several hours to let flavors meld. If you can find a picante sauce that is thick and smooth, do the trick.

title: Saffron Pork Pitas
ingredients: 1 lb pork skin or 1 lb pork tenderloin | 1 1/2 teaspoons saffron | 2/3 cup non-dairy topping, divided | 2 pita bread or 2 whole wheat pitas
instructions: Grind saffron with knife in spice grinder or mortar and pestle, until fine. Mix in half cup non dairy topping. Cut pork into 1/4 inch rounds. Heat skillet over medium heat. Add pork and saffron and saute until browned and pork is cooked through. Spoon 1/4 cup fat in pan. Stir remaining non dairy topping into fat and simmer stirring constantly for 3 - 4 minutes until thick and syrupy. Serve hot with pita, crusty french bread or rolls. Freezes well.

Random Ingredients: courgette,mint leaf,chicken breast fillet,manchego cheese,basil,yellow squash,eggplant,pork loin
title: Manchego-Chicken and Vegetables
ingredients: 400 ml mixed salad leaves | 150 g manchego cheese, cut into 3cm cubes | 400 g chicken breast fillets, thinly sliced | 150 g pork loin, thinly sliced | 1 small courgette, halved and thinly sliced | 1 eggplant, halved and thinly sliced | 1 small yellow squash, halved and thinly sliced | 1/4 cup basil leaves | 100 g salted roasted salted roasted garlic or 100 g roasted garlic oil
instructions: To make the salsa, put all the ingredients into a large bowl, cover and leave in the fridge for around 20 minutes if you wish to make them ahead. Preheat the grill or chargrill pan on medium. Toss the chicken in a chargrill and then cook for around 4 - 5 minutes each side or until golden brown. Leave to rest. For the chicken, toss all of the ingredients into a large bowl adding the cheese. Shake to combine. Season. To assemble, place the manchego chicken on a plate with a piece of courgette and a piece of eggplant. Top with a good sprinkling of the roasted garlic. Divide the manchego chicken evenly between the 4 bowls. Put a couple of sprigs of basil leaves on top, and serve.

title: Tandoori Masala (Served Smoked) Meat Tikkis with Black Olive Chutney
ingredients: 2 pounds finely chopped meat ( use a combination of beef, lamb, turkey, chicken or goat ) | 2 cans black olives, drained and coarsely chopped | 1 jar sliced pimientos, drained | 2 tablespoons garam masala | 1 gallon of hot green tea
instructions: To make the chutney. In a large saucepan add the meat, olives, pimentos, garam masala and green tea. Bring to a boil over high heat, stirring occasionally, then remove from the heat. Cover, and allow to sit at room temperature for 3 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: white vinegar,beef tenderloin,tomatillo,apricot preserve,stewing beef,green chili pepper
title: A New Texas Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds beef tenderloin, cut into 2 inch pieces | 1 1/4 cups dried apricot preserves | 1 can diced green chili peppers, undrained | 1 can stewed tomatoes with liquid | 4 leaves fresh tomatillos, husks removed, chopped | 2 tablespoons distilled white vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Arrange beef strips in a deep baking dish. Mix apricot preserves, chilies, tomatoes with liquid, tomatillos, and vinegar together in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: vanilla bean,chicken thigh,udon noodle,chili oil,chicken stock
title: Asian Chicken in Noodle Bowl
ingredients: 8 chicken thighs, skin removed cut into bite size pieces ( approx 3 lb. ) | 1 cup chicken stock | 1 tablespoon chili oil | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla bean ( optional ) | noodles or chow mein noodles
instructions: Cook the chicken in the chicken stock for about 10 minutes in a wok or large skillet. Remove the chicken, keep warm. In the same skillet, heat the chili oil over high heat. Add the chicken, cook about 3 minutes. Add the rice or noodles if using and chicken stock. Place the chicken on a serving platter and top with a spoonful of the noodles or chow mein noodles. Serve.

title: Skewered Beef and Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti | 1 lb penne pasta ( cooked or dried ) | 2 beef roast, thinly sliced | 1 scallion, cut diagonally into thin rounds, then crosswise into 1/4 inch ( white ) | 1 lemon, cut into 4 wedges | 4 orange liqueur | 1 1/4 cups bread, crumbs | 1/4 cup vinegar
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions until just tender, about 10 minutes. Drain, return to pot, add 1 tbls of the lime and all ingredients except bread crumbs and toss well. Tear apart or tear apart with the back of a wooden spoon or a wide, heavy cleaver. Place in a well buttered shallow serving bowl and sprinkle with bread crumbs. Let stand for 10 minutes to absorb most of the flavor. Serve right away.

title: Blueberry-Tomato Jam
ingredients: 1 lb ripe plum tomato, peeled, seeded, chopped | 10 cups fresh blueberries, cleaned and patted dry | 2 tablespoons kirsch ( cherry brandy or other dark dark sweet orange liquer )
instructions: In a large heavy kettle, cook the tomato and blueberries over low med heat for 15 minutes, or until tender, stirring often. Remove the pan from the heat. Transfer all the tomato mixture to a large heavy baking pan and cook over med heat uncovered, stirring frequently, until the jam almost reaches 215°f on a candy thermometer in a few slices and 240°f on a candy mill. Continue mashing the jam with the back of a spoon until the mixture resembles soft jam, about 20 minutes. Transfer to a heavy 3 quart saucepan. Meanwhile, warm the kirsch until thick and syrupy, about 10 minutes, stirring frequently. Scoop the jam into 1 1/2 gal. Ramekins and seal the ramekins or wax paper with a few strands of wax paper as directed on the pack. Let stand at room temperature 1 hour, or cover tightly and refrigerate up to 4 days. The jam can also be made up to 3 days ahead, or frozen. Bring to room temperature before storing, in an airtight container.

title: The Best Jasmine Rice
ingredients: 1/2 cup jasmine rice ( about 1 ounce ) | 1/2 cup white sugar ( or more to taste )
instructions: Wash the rice and place in a large saucepan. Add enough water to cover the rice by 2 inches. Bring to a boil, cover, and cook over low heat for 15 minutes or until tender. Drain water. Add sugar, cover, and continue cooking, stirring constantly, until the rice is fluffy and completely cooked.

Random Ingredients: tabasco sauce,parsley flake,pepper flake,cold water,udon noodle,egg wrap,tequila
title: Tequila Egg Rolls
ingredients: 1 package egg roll wraps | 3/4 cup cold water | 1/2 cup tequila | 1/2 cup parsley flakes | 2 -3 drops hot pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons tabasco sauce | 1 tablespoon fresh ground pepper | 1 lb firm tofu
instructions: Drain excess moisture from tofu, crumble and place in paper towels to dry in an extra large bowl. Combine with rest of ingredients except dumplings. Place 1 egg roll wrapper in the bottom of a greased 9x13 inch baking dish. Spoon in the egg mixture, folding in the wrapper until the egg roll completely encloses the filling and the wrapper is sealed on all sides. Bake in a 350 degree oven for 50 minutes. Remove wrapper and brush outside with some of the beaten egg. Let cool 5 - 10 minutes. Cut the wrappers into strips 1/16 inch wide and 1/8 inch thick. Place 3 strips of dumplings on top of the dumplings, fold the right and left corners over the dumplings and pinch together tightly to seal on all sides. Serve on a lettuce leaf with a sprig of mint.

title: Tofu Ice Cubes in Vanilla Bean Sauce
ingredients: 1 can tofu, drained ( not oil packed ) | 1 vanilla bean
instructions: Using a fork, poke holes in the tofu with a fork, until it is well coated. Break off the vanilla bean and scrape it out.

title: Greek Olive Triangles
ingredients: 1 sheet filo pastry | 1/4 cup kalamata olives or 1/4 cup chopped sun-dried tomato
instructions: Cut pastry into 5 rectangles. Place 1/5 cup of the olive or sun dried tomatoes on each rectangle of pastry. Roll the rectangles tightly starting at the edge and working over the ends. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Preheat oven to 450 f remove the plastic wrap from the dough and cut into fingers. Return to refrigerator and chill for 1/2 2 hours. Cut each pastry heart in 4 triangles. Place 1 cut side down on a lightly greased baking sheet. Bake for 8 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Pear Garlic Sauce for Pasta
ingredients: 1/2 lb small shell pasta | 1 pear, peeled, halved, cored and chopped | garlic pepper seasoning, to taste
instructions: Place pasta in a large pot of rapidly boiling water. When pasta is just shy of al dente, drain and place in a large mixing bowl. Stir in pear, garlic pepper seasoning, and parsley leaves. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: pastry crust pie,caper,green onion,sea bass fillet,saffron strand,hot chili sauce
title: Chile-Caper Sea Bass & Saffron Pie
ingredients: 1 pastry for single-crust pie, thawed | 1 cup saffron strand, crushed | 4 tablespoons hot chili sauce | 1/4 cup capers | 1 green onion | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh thyme or 1 teaspoon dried thyme, crushed | 1 lb sea bass fillet, trimmed of excess fat, cut diagonally into 3 pieces
instructions: Cut three pieces of plastic wrap about the size of your food processor. Spoon saffron into center of wrap.

Random Ingredients: green bean,thai fish sauce,fish sauce,thyme leaf,ra el hanout spice mix
title: Lime Green Beans
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs green beans | 2 tablespoons fresh thyme leaves, chopped | 1 teaspoon thai fish sauce or 1 teaspoon red pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon thai fish sauce or 1 teaspoon red pepper flakes | 2 teaspoons ras el hanout spice mix
instructions: Separate each string of green beans with parboiled and blanched beans. Trim and cut each string crosswise 1/2 inch to one half inch below beans. Drop off tips of beans and carefully scrape any remaining moisture from around the beans with a spoon so as not to damage them. Cover beans loosely with aluminum foil. Cook beans on stovetop or grill over medium or high heat until tender, about 20 minutes, turning to insure even cooking. Check often to prevent burning at end of cooking time. If necessary, cook longer. When beans are tender but still crisp, drain water and add thyme leaves, sauces, & seasoning. Note, these can be served hot or cold. Variation, if you have an extra cup of vegetable juice such as lime juice, you may substitute the lime juice with a can of unsweetened pineapple flavored juice before cooking if desired.

Random Ingredients: green onion,red kidney bean,cucumber,milk,rice wine vinegar,bay leaf,arrowroot,salt pepper
title: Spicy Low Fat Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 1 large cucumber, peeled | 1 can red kidney beans, drained | 1 1/2 cups skim milk | 3 green onions, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup rice wine vinegar | 1 1/2 tablespoons arrowroot | 1/2 teaspoon salt and pepper | 3 bay leaves
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl and mix well. Cover and chill overnight. Garnish with additional green onions.

title: Bangers and Mash
ingredients: 1 kg beef gravy mix ( or roxtail gravy mix ) | 500 ml beef broth ( home made is best ) | 1 bunch mixed salad leaves | 2 red capsicums ( bell peppers ) | 1 bunch broccoli | 2 tablespoons irish cream | pepper
instructions: Preheat the oven to 150c/fan 160c/gas saute the roxtail and vegetables in your favourite pan on gentle to low heat, stirring occasionally until the steak has browned to your pleasing liking. Serve in big deep bowls topped with the irish cream and plenty of pepper. For your favourite flavours i recommend rosettes and yams or asparagus and cauliflower.

Random Ingredients: pepper,salt black pepper,hoisin sauce,pecorino romano cheese
title: Italian Pepper Spread
ingredients: 2 1/3 cups pecorino romano cheese, freshly grated | 2 cups fresh ground coarse salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1/2 cup hoisin sauce
instructions: Pulse cheese in a food processor until it becomes a very finely crunched consistency. Add pepper, hoisin sauce and salt. Pulse until combined well. Store in the refrigerator in an airtight container at room temperature until ready to use.

title: Cajun Asparagus
ingredients: 1/2 pound fresh asparagus, trimmed and cut into 2 inch pieces | 1 1/2 cups plain unsweetened soymilk | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 1/2 teaspoon dried basil | 1/4 teaspoon cajun seasoning
instructions: Place asparagus in a large skillet over medium heat and spray with nonstick cooking spray. When asparagus starts to soften, stir in 1 1/2 cups of the soymilk, baking soda, basil, and cajun spices. Cover and simmer until the asparagus is tender and no longer translucent, about 15 minutes.

title: Scotch Oat Balls
ingredients: 1 cup quick-cooking rolled oats | 1 1/2 cups vodka
instructions: Mix quick cooking rolled oats and vodka together in a bowl until thoroughly blended. Using a 1½ inch star shaped cookie scoop, drop small spoonfuls of dough into a bowl of cold water and allow to set. Cook for about 5 minutes, or until balls begin to turn golden brown. Remove from the bowl and serve.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,french bread,fenugreek,onion powder,cold water
title: Beef Fritters
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground round ( or use 80/20 % fat ground beef ) | 1 beef bouillon cube | 2/3 cup cold water | 1/4 teaspoon onion powder | 1/8 teaspoon fenugreek | 8 slices french bread
instructions: Brown beef well. In a skillet, brown onion in hot water and bouillon cube for 10 minutes. Stir and return meat to skillet. Squeeze liquid back into skillet, cover and cook over low heat for 10 minutes. Break up meat with a spoon or two on top of fritters and sprinkle with onion and fenugreek. Broil or bake for 15 - 20 minutes, or until heated through. Serve over hot cooked noodles, rice or as is with your favorite bread.

title: Buttermilk Enchiladas
ingredients: 2 cups buttermilk | 1/3 cup plain confectioners'sugar | 1/4 cup double cream | 2 teaspoons enchilada sauce | 1/8 teaspoon ground turmeric powder | 12 radishes, sliced into half-moons | 1/4 cup seedless raisins
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the buttermilk, confectioners' sugar, cream, enchilada sauce, and turmeric. Pour into a small 9x13 inch baking dish. Place the radishes on top of the mixture, then sprinkle with raisins. Cover with foil, and chill in the refrigerator for 2 hours. Uncover, uncover, and bake at 375 degrees f for 10 minutes, then remove from oven, and remove foil.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,chocolate chip,cheese spread,panko breadcrumb,marsala wine,tea,soy sauce
title: Sweet and Smoky Mochi
ingredients: 250 g strong cheese spread | 2 tablespoons marsala wine, warmed | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar, warmed | 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 60 g shaved semisweet chocolate chips | 2 tablespoons panko breadcrumbs, plus extra to serve | marsala wine, for serving
instructions: Place the cheese spread, marsala, balsamic vinegar, soy sauce in a medium bowl and mix well. Spread onto the shaved chocolate chips in a shallow, non stick, golden brown baking dish. Place under a grill. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 - 6 minutes until cheese is melted. Serve with the panko, toasted breadcrumbs and extra marsala.

title: Blackened Beef With Shrimp
ingredients: 1 lb beef chuck, cut into 1-inch pieces | 2 1/2 cups black tea, heated | 1 lb shrimp, prawns or 1 lb prawns, deveined
instructions: Brown beef in large skillet. Combine tea and shrimps, cover and simmer over low heat 15 minutes or until beef is done.

title: Leiden Cheese and Peppered Peppers for Baked Pastry
ingredients: 200 g shortcrust pastry | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 1 teaspoon peanut oil, extra | 175 g gouda cheese, finely grated | 200 ml half-and-half
instructions: Pre heat your oven to 200°c. Line a large baking tray with baking paper. Roll out the pastry thinly, to about 5mm thick, and line the baking tray with baking paper at least 4mm deep. Heat the extra oil in a small saucepan, then add the cheese, and melt over a medium heat. When the cheese has melted, stir in the half and half until smooth and creamy and set aside. Spread out the cheese mixture evenly on the pastry. Use a piping cutter to score the cheese into strips roughly 2 1/4 wide. Bake for about 15 minutes. Take out of the oven, and stand for 5 minutes to cool.

title: Italian Balsamic Vinaigrette Dressing
ingredients: 1 1/3 cups white flour | 1/2 cup balsamic vinaigrette | 3/4 cup cider vinegar
instructions: Combine dry ingredients in a bowl. Pour in balsamic vinaigrette and vinegar. Stir to blend. Cover and refrigerate. Shake well before serving.

Random Ingredients: celery rib,russet potato,baby spinach,syrup,coriander leaf,yukon gold potato
title: Irish Potato Salad with Hot Corrind, Wilted Spinach and Spicy Whipped Sausages
ingredients: 4 small russet potatoes, scrubbed | 8 baby spinach, washed | 3 -4 tablespoons fresh coriander leaves, chopped, roughly | 1 celery rib, chopped | 2 tablespoons crispy syrup | 4 large fat free wafer-cut irish sausages, such as jarlsberg
instructions: Par boil the potatoes until tender.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,green cardamom pod,peach preserve,chipotle pepper adobo sauce,shrimp paste,curry powder
title: Shrimp Embutido
ingredients: 1 pint shrimp paste | 1/4 cup chipotle pepper in adobo sauce ( canned chipotle pepper in adobo sauce may be used, if desired ) | 1/4 cup mild curry powder | 1/2 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese, finely grated | 4 pods green cardamom pods, crushed with open tops | 2 chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, minced | 1/2 teaspoon shrimp paste
instructions: Combine 1 pint shrimp paste with 1/4 cup water in a small bowl, cover, and refrigerate for 3 hours or overnight. Heat 1/8 inch non stick skillet over medium low heat until very hot. Add 1/2 cup shrimp paste mixture to skillet, spreading evenly to cover. Cook 5 minutes. Sprinkle 1/4 cup grated cheese on top of the shrimp mixture and cook 3 minutes until melted and shiny. Remove from skillet and spread onto serving plate. Repeat process with remaining shrimp paste mixture. Add remaining 1/3 cup grated cheese to top of shrimp. Heat 1/8 inch nonstick skillet over high heat until very hot. Place cardamom pods with open tops in center of skillet's crushed starches and cook about 1 minute. Crush pods into a powder with fingers or a mortar and pestle. Place in a serving bowl, sprinkle with 1/2 of the crushed chipotle peppers, and top with 1 teaspoon of the chipotle powder. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: brown sugar,italian breadcrumb,parmigiano reggiano cheese,cocoa,table salt,chinese egg noodle
title: Italian Chocolate & Noodles
ingredients: 2 ounces chinese egg noodles | 8 ounces unsweetened good quality italian breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa | 1 cup packed light brown sugar | 1/3 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese | table salt or salt
instructions: Soak the noodles in hot tap water for 15 minutes, then cut into strips, and drain. Place noodles in a strainer or colander, and sprinkle cheese over just the noodles. Dry excess water off the noodles with a paper towel, toss with the bowl of cheese and noodles until the cheese becomes coated. Melt butter in a 2 qt sauce pan over medium heat, then stir in the brown sugar, cheese, and salt. When butter and sugar start to melt, turn down the heat to low and gently stir in the noodles. The mixture will be soupy. Do not stir too hard, when noodles have a chance to melt and all the cheese has melted, remove from heat and stir in the dry ingredients.

title: Easy French Bread
ingredients: 1 ounce fresh yeast | 2 1/2 cups bread, divided | 1/2 cup black olives
instructions: Dissolve the yeast and 1/2 cup of bread in the 1 c bread. Allow the mixture to sit for about 10 - 15 minutes, or until it is nice and foamy. Dump the black olives in and mix well. Stir in the rest of the bread, 1/4 c bread if you wish. The amount of water should be about 2 c in a small pan, but enough to let everything mix together. Let rise in a warm place at least 1/2 hr or overnight. When finished, turn out on a clean, well floured board and cut into 2 or 5 large pieces. Drop on a hot griddle, spreading oil as needed. I always use a butter knife to do this, but you can do it any way you like.

title: Chef John's Easy Kebabs
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 1/4 pounds bamboo skewers | 1/4 cup vodka
instructions: Preheat grill for medium heat and lightly oil the grate. Prepare grill for cooking vegetable skewers, using the indirect grilling method. Coat the bamboo skewers in a heavy skillet with cooking spray and arrange them on the grilling grate. Let them sit, covered, for 15 minutes before grill guests arrive. Pour vodka into the skillet and bring to a boil. Cook for one minute. Remove from heat and place the skewers on the skewer skewers. Brush skewers with vodka, and cover the grill. Cook the skewers for about 5 minutes, or until desired doneness.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,almond,pear,green,green food coloring,pepper,black bean,cabbage carrot coleslaw mix
title: Cousin's Holiday Salad
ingredients: 4 cups cabbage-carrot coleslaw mix | 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed | 1 package frozen peppers, crisp style | 1 small ripe pear, peeled, cored and chopped, thawed | 1 bunch green top 2-green part of the bunch | 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1 -2 drop green food coloring ( optional ) | 1/4 cup slivered almonds, toasted ( optional )
instructions: Prepare all the ingredients, and chill overnight or up to 4 hours. Toss together all ingredients except the almonds in a large bowl. Add in almonds. If desired serve at room temperature.

title: Avocado, Asparagus & Chocolate Salad #5FIX
ingredients: 1 tablespoon watercress, chopped | 1 avocado, peeled & cut into chunks | 1 tablespoon chocolate, grated | 1 pear, cored & chopped ( optional ) | 1/4 cup avocado, diced | 1 tablespoon avocado, chopped | 1 tablespoon cocoa powder, for dusting
instructions: Mix together & chill till ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: active yeast,italian parsley,rice noodle,worcestershire sauce,plain yogurt
title: Noodles & Bread
ingredients: 5 cups strong plain yogurt | 15 1/2 ounces italian parsley-based stewed tomatoes, undrained ( about 3-4 cups ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 2 packages active dry yeast | 1 package rice noodles, cooked, drained, and rinsed
instructions: Stir the yogurt and 1/2 cup of the parsley in a large bowl. Add the stewed tomatoes and worcestershire sauce. Stir in the yeast. Let stand about 5 minutes. Drain yogurt mixture well. Combine 3 cups yogurt mixture and noodles in a large, microwave safe bowl, then cover bowl with plastic wrap. Cover and microwave 30 seconds. Remove dough from microwave bowl after 30 seconds and place on a lightly floured surface. Knead until smooth and elastic, about 8 minutes. Place dough in a well buttered bowl, turn dough over and knead just until dough is smooth and elastic. Place dough in a lightly oiled bowl, cover and let dough rise until doubled in size, about 2 1/2 hours. Place the dough on a floured surface. Punch down dough. Roll the dough into a rope, about 1/3 inch in diameter and 2 inches long. Starting with the strand to the right, move it to the left over the middle strand take the strand farthest to the left and move it over the new middle strand. Continue to move it to the left over the middle strand take the strand farthest to the left and move it over the new middle strand. Continue to move it over the new middle strand. Continue to push it down gently into the bread's shape, 1/2 inch in diameter. Repeat with remaining dough and 2 cups yogurt mixture. Cover and let dough rise until double, about 1 1/2 hours. Deflate dough and then spread the remaining 1 1/2 cup yogurt mixture on top. Top with remaining 1 1/2 cups yogurt mixture. Cover with a towel and let rise in a warm spot until risen, about 20 minutes. Preheat the oven to 400°. Bake the bread in the middle of the oven until golden brown, about 30 minutes. Serve warm. If desired, cool 5 minutes. If you would like a crispier crust, cover loosely with foil and serve warm.

title: Black Forest Cherry Barbecue Sauce - Copycat Recipe
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups canned cherries, drained | 2 quarts chicken bouillon | 1 tablespoon hot sauce or 1 tablespoon sambal oelek | 1 tablespoon lemon balm, powder or 1 tablespoon oregano
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a pot and simmer over low heat for 15 minutes or until slightly thick. If you like your sauce a little thinner, you could add a little more juice. Use as required.

title: Cuban Beans With Rum
ingredients: 2 lbs dry beans, soaked overnight | 1 bottle dry spanish onion | 2 tablespoons fresh oregano leaves, chopped | 1 1/2 ounces slab bacon, cut into strips | 8 ounces rum, heated
instructions: Cook the beans in water in a large pot, uncovered, until very tender, 7 to 10 minutes. Drain, reserving the liquid. Transfer the beans to a food processor and grind to a fine paste. Transfer the bean liquid to a pitcher, place in a large bowl and set aside. In a large skillet over medium heat, stir the onions with oregano and bacon until bacon is evenly browned. Let cool at room temperature, covered, stirring occasionally. Stir in the rum and bean liquid and bring to a simmer. Simmer over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the beans are warm, about 1 hour. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: romano cheese,egg white,white sugar,coconut milk,vegetable,lipton onion soup mix
title: Coconut Mousse (No Boil)
ingredients: 1 cup vegetable, chopped ( frozen ) | 4 cups frozen mixed vegetables, thawed ( any combination, mixed ) | 3 large eggs | 4 tablespoons white sugar | 1/2 cup unsweetened coconut milk | 3 tablespoons ricotta cheese | 1 tablespoon parmesan cheese, for garnish
instructions: In a large serving bowl, combine all the ingredients except the parmesan cheese and mix well. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: German Meatball
ingredients: sirloin tip italian sausage, sliced | 1 lb ground beef | fettuccine pasta | hot italian sausage, cut into slices | 4 egg whites | 3 tablespoons kirsch
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Mix sausage & ground beef together with egg whites. Form into balls about 3 or 4 inches in diameter. Arrange in a casserole dish & bake for 30 minutes. Meanwhile, place kirsch & cook noodles in a pan until 'al dente'. Remove meatballs from the oven & drain. Add kirsch to juices in pan & heat until it's almost boiling. Pour over cooked pasta & serve.

title: Pistet-Pumpkin Smoothies (Alcoholic Beverage)
ingredients: 6 cups milk | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley flakes | 1 tablespoon crushed amaretto | 2 green cardamom pods, crushed | 1 tablespoon grated fresh nutmeg | 2 cups sparkling water ( made with white-rice vinegar and salt )
instructions: Combine milk, parsley flakes, amaretto, cardamom pods, nutmeg, and sparkling water in a large saucepan. Heat over low heat, stirring often. When almost boiling, remove from heat. Add sweetener and blend, or use food processor to blend. Store in clean, dark container, refridgerator.

title: Creamy English-Style Fruit Dip
ingredients: 200 g low-fat yogurt | 1/8 cup pecans, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon celery, chopped | 1 tablespoon yellow food coloring | 1 tablespoon apricot, chopped | 1/2 tablespoon fresh maraschino cherry, chopped | 2 radishes, sliced
instructions: Place all of the ingredients except the radishes into a food processor, and process until very smooth. Place half the mixture into an ovenproof dish. Top with remaining fruit. Sprinkle with chopped radishes. Bake in a preheated oven at 180c/350f/gas 6 for 20 - 25 minutes, until the top is crisp and the fruit is hot through. Serve warm with fresh cream.

Random Ingredients: purple onion,pickling spice,corn syrup,spice,dill weed,salt,canola oil,soya granule
title: Sweet and Sour Seasoned Dressing
ingredients: 2 cups splenda sugar substitute or 2 cups regular sugar | 1/2 - 1 cup light corn syrup | 1 teaspoon mixed spice | 1 garlic, finely chopped | 2 -3 teaspoons dried dill weed or 1 tablespoon fresh dill weed | 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1 -2 purple onion, sliced | 2 teaspoons salt or 2 teaspoons salt substitute
instructions: Mix all ingredients together place in a covered container and refrigerate for several hours or overnight. Store tightly covered up to 3 days.

Random Ingredients: feta,american cheese,chicken,tortilla chip,dark brown sugar,coriander,chili oil,fig
title: Sweet and Savory Chicken Nachos
ingredients: 8 -10 dried figs | 2 cups cooked chicken, sliced | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar, dark | 2 cups tortilla chips | 1/2 lb american cheese | 1/2 lb feta | 1/2 teaspoon coriander | 1/2 teaspoon chili oil | 1/2 teaspoon dark brown sugar
instructions: Cut up figs and place in saucepan then add chicken. In microwave safe bowl, heat tortilla chips until they are just softened. Stir frequently until hot. Transfer chips to a plate covered with paper towels. Top each chip with 1 tablespoon chicken and some cheese. Heat fig mixture in saucepan until bubbly. Stir until melted. Remove from heat when chips are warm. Spread remaining chips over the top of the chicken mixture. Pile the heated figs on top of the cheese. Sprinkle with black pepper. Serve with your favorite dippers. Enjoy.

title: Quick Kibocha-Roasted Kebabs
ingredients: 1/2 cup kalamata olives | 1/2 kabocha squash, halved lengthwise and cut into 1/4 inch cubes | 1/2 beet, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup panko crumbs | 1 package farfalle pasta | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 pinch ground cardamom, or to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place kalamata olives on a plate and drizzle with olive oil. Combine kabocha squash and beet in a large bowl.

title: Cranberry Thyme Marinade
ingredients: 1/2 cup red currant juice or 1/2 cup cranberry juice | 2/3 cup dried cranberries, with juice | 1 teaspoon harissa ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Let the chicken marinate in the refrigerator for a minimum of two hours or longer.

title: Pumpkin Seed-Ribatoni Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 cup soymilk or 1 cup milk | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 1 jar pumpkin seeds, undrained | 1 loaf focaccia bread, halved horizontally then cut crosswise into 6 slices | 1/2 lb fresh ravioli or 1/2 lb fresh ravioli | 1/2 cup water
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine soymilk, salt, and lime juice. Bring to a boil over high heat. Remove from heat. Stir in pumpkin seeds. Cut focaccia diagonally into 6 thick slices. Spread bread with water and dip slices in milk mixture. Arrange bread pieces on cookie sheets. Toast under broiler or in toaster until golden brown, 3 - 5 minutes.

title: Nutty Pesto Gnocchi
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups walnuts | 1 cup unsweetened soymilk ( or low fat soy milk ) | 1 cup low-fat unsweetened soymilk ( or low fat soy milk ) | 3 tablespoons sherry wine | 2 tablespoons chunky peanut butter | 1/2 cup lite warm milk | 1 -2 teaspoon fresh pressed yeast ( i prefer active dry ) | 1 liter ice
instructions: Blend ingredients until smooth. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: The Best Kicker Cocktail
ingredients: 4 ounces red enchilada sauce | 1 ounce light miso or regular miso | 1/2 teaspoon red wine vinegar or 1/2 teaspoon vinegar | 2 ounces low-skewer red enchilada sauce | 20 very thin slices bacon
instructions: Mix the first three ingredients in a small bowl. Thread 3 slices of bacon onto 2 skewers if desired. Place the bacon onto each skewer. Serve with lime wedges.

title: Pebre
ingredients: 2 poblano chiles ( fresh or dry roasted ) | 3/4 cup bread flour | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( sesame seed-optional ) | 1/2 cup hazelnuts ( toasted )
instructions: Place the poblanos on a cutting board and coarsely chop them. Place the chopped poblanos on a baking tray that is lined with parchment paper or silpat. Place the chiles on the baking tray. In a bowl, mix together remaining ingredients. Spread the mixture evenly over the poblanos. The poblanos will look kind of gross because of how they are shaped. Bake at 350 f for 10 - 12 hours, depending on how soft they are. Let cool for about 10 minutes then cut into 1 - ½ inch slices.

title: Quick & Easy Smoked Salmon Dip
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 500 g low sodium ricotta cheese | 4 drops tabasco sauce | 400 g smoked salmon, chopped into chunks | 1/2 cup snow peas, chopped
instructions: Combine the beans and ricotta in a large bowl. Spoon over the fish pieces and toss to coat completely. Sprinkle with tabasco and garnish with snow peas.

title: Quick-Fix Beef Brisket
ingredients: 4 pounds beef brisket | 1 can italian-style whole plum tomatoes, undrained | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom, or to taste
instructions: Place brisket, fat side up, in a large roasting pan. Add tomatoes, with liquid, and cardamom. Reserve 1/2 cup tomato juice for dipping, if desired. Bake in a preheated oven, at 325 degrees f, until tender and sauce is thickened, about 1 1/2 hours. Be sure to baste during cooking.

title: Tortellini Tacos
ingredients: 1 lb fresh tortellini | 1/2 bunch fresh peppercorn | 1 garlic clove | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning | 1 teaspoon fresh ginger-garlic paste
instructions: Rinse tortellini and place into a large pot of boiling water and set aside. Meanwhile, combine all other ingredients and set aside. When the tortellini are cooked, drain and rinse with cold water and set aside. Add more cooking water to the pot if pasta appears dry. This will help soften the tortellini. When everything is evenly coated and heated through, toss the tortellini to coat. Add more cooking water to the pot if necessary so that your tortellini can absorb the flavors, but before it looks cooked it is cooked to your liking.

title: Wild Rice in Your Pressure Cooker
ingredients: 1 package farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 1 yellow pepper, chopped | 1 can salmon - drained and flaked
instructions: Place farfalle in pressure cooker. Add pepper, salmon and rice. Close lid. Heat on high pressure for 8 minutes.

title: Shrimp and Spinach Soup
ingredients: 1 cup chopped onion | 1/4 cup rice or 1/4 cup barley | 10 1/2 fluid ounces dashi stock | 3 cups mixed baby shrimp, cleaned | 2 cups spinach ( optional ) | 2 red chili peppers, sliced | 1 lb chopped fresh pancetta or 1 lb sliced smoked bacon
instructions: Cook onion in a skillet. Add rice or barley and saute, stirring occasionally, for 1 minute or until soft, translucent or caramelized.. Add stock and stir thoroughly. Add shrimp, spinach, chili peppers and pancetta. Cover and bring to simmer, stirring occasionally, for about 10 minutes. Remove from heat and stir through.

Random Ingredients: havarti cheese,date,sage leaf,liquid smoke,lemon juice zest,cayenne,salt pepper
title: Havarti Stuffed Dates
ingredients: 24 large whole pitted dates | 4 -6 ounces havarti cheese, preferably aged, cut on the bias ( about 4-5 ounces ) | 6 tablespoons fresh sage leaves, coarsely chopped | 1/3 teaspoon dried lemons or 1/3 teaspoon grated lemon zest | 1 teaspoon salt & pepper | 3 -4 tablespoons liquid smoke | 1 pinch cayenne ( optional )
instructions: Dunk dates in cold water, remove the stones, and wash thoroughly, pat dry. Combine all ingredients and mix well. Stuff dates with mixture and place in a glass casserole dish, or large baking dish covered with plastic wrap so it ends up in the casserole. Cover the stuffed dates with plastic wrap, and refrigerate them for several hours, preferably overnight, or up to 3 days.

Random Ingredients: ice water,white fish fillet,beet,herbes de provence,english cucumber,vodka
title: Potato Crusted Fish
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs white fish fillets, cleaned with skin on ( such as cod or halibut ) | 2 teaspoons herbes de provence | ice water | 3 tablespoons dried red potatoes snipped snipped ( about 12 or 5 ounces ) | 3 teaspoons herbes de provence | 1/4 cup vodka | 1 cup shredded english cucumber, about 2 medium cucumbers, cut to a half inch thick
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Arrange a 12 inch baking dish as you would a pie dish. Put 1 tablespoon of snipped dried red potatoes in the center of the baking dish. Toss the fish fillet with the herbes de provence and salt and pepper each side. Dot with 1 tablespoon of vodka. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon of snipped dried red potatoes. Top with 1/4 cup shredded cucumber. Dot with 1 more teaspoon of herbes de provence. Drizzle 1 cup ice water around the fish. Top with 1 more cup of ice water. Bake for 20 to 30 minutes, or until fish is done and potatoes are tender.

title: Indian Seasoning Mix
ingredients: 2 tablespoons italian seasoning | 1 1/2 tablespoons ground cardamom powder
instructions: Mix together.

title: The Best Vegetables on Earth
ingredients: 5 shallots, halved | 3 -4 small turnips, peeled and sliced in half ( i prefer red bell peppers ) | 1 can refrigerated remoulade sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. On the center rack of the oven, place shallots and turnips. With a spatula, toss turnips slightly. After all the turnips are coated with the shallots and turnips and shallots in remoulade. Place on a cookie sheet, skin side down and bake 20 minutes. Turn off oven, open door slightly and place in oven for an additional 20 minutes or until lightly browned. Remove from oven, open door slightly, and serve.

title: Chili Snack Toast
ingredients: 1 loaf bread | 8 ounces hot coffee | 1 tablespoon cumin powder ( or cayenne ) | 1 teaspoon brown sugar | 2 tablespoons canned sweet pickled chili peppers, coarsely chopped ( jalapenos or other hot hot pepper ) | 3 -4 fresh strawberries, cleaned and sliced | 2 tablespoons chopped pimiento
instructions: Cut bread into 1 inch cubes. Spread a layer of coffee on each portion, using your fingers and soaking up as much coffee and coffee as possible. Add the remaining ingredients at the beginning, then spread out evenly but generously on each of the bread slices and the slices.
