Wrap slices up in aluminum foil and let them soften slightly, then put the wrapped bread in the refrigerator for at least an hour. Remove them from the refrigerator after that and place directly on top of each other to soften it and to help firm up the fruit. Place the wrapped bread slices on to a cutting board and use a knife to slice them as close to the bread as possible so that they get wider slices. These slices are much easier to slice if they are slightly flattened, but inevitably leads to bits of bread in the process and the bread won’t be the right consistency for dipping.

title: Cherry Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1 jar green chili salsa | 1 container cherry preserves
instructions: Stir together with electric mixer until well blended. Serve over cooked hot chicken or pork slices.

title: Puerto Rican Grapefruit Hot Spot
ingredients: 2 pink grapefruits | 1 bottle barbecue sauce | 2 tablespoons dry unsweetened cocoa | 1/2 cup vodka
instructions: Peel the grapesfruit and cut away the seed. Cut the grapes fruits into bite size segments. Put the grapesfruit, bbq sauce and cocoa into a large microwave safe glass bowl. Cover with the bottle of barbecue sauce. Cook on high for 3 minutes. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: basmati rice,flat leaf parsley,browning sauce,self rising flour
title: Quick'simply Plain' Baked Fresh Bread
ingredients: 1 lb white basmati rice, rinsed and drained well | 1 cup self-rising flour | 1 tablespoon browning sauce | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley ( or 2 tablespoons dried )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f. Place all the ingredients in a large bowl and mix well to combine. Place the bread on a large baking sheet and bake, uncovered, for about 30 minutes, or until light golden. Serve hot with minted yoghurt.

Random Ingredients: cooking oil,cider vinegar,peanut oil vegetable,corn,garlic salt,pork tenderloin,vegetable oil cooking spray,mandarin orange
title: Pork Tenderloin With Peanut-mandarin Orange Glaze
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin, trimmed of fat, cut into 1-inch cubes | cooking oil | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/2 cup canned mandarin oranges | 1/4 cup canned corn | 1 tablespoon peanut oil or 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon fresh minced garlic ( or to taste ) | 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Heat a frying pan over medium high heat until hot. Add cooking oil to hot pan.

title: Saffron Brandy and Chiles
ingredients: 4 whole dried ancho chile powder, to taste | 2 whole cloves | 1/2 cup brandy | 1 tablespoon saffron strand
instructions: Preparing the brandy, place the ancho chile powder to a boil in a pot. Remove from heat and stir in the clove. Let steep for 10 minutes. Cool, then pour into a jar. Add water to cover. Heat and stir to combine. Add the toasted saffron strands. Cover tightly and store in a cool, dark place for 4 days before using.

Random Ingredients: lime wedge,irish bacon,cherry tomato,tabasco sauce,anchovy,hoisin sauce,pinto bean,beef tenderloin steak
title: Grilled Beef Tenderloin(ATK) With Hoisin-Soy Beans
ingredients: 16 ounces of dry pinto beans, rinsed and drained | 1 large garlic clove ( minced or pressed ) | 2 slices of a fully-cooked thin-cut irish bacon ( cut 2-inch x 1-inch strips ) | 1 strip of oaxacan hot sauce ( can substitute other sauces such as sriracha ) | 1 ounce of thinly sliced capers ( can substitute fish sauce ) | 6 -8 medium halved cherry tomatoes | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried anchovies ( i used kesar, only ) | 8 -9 drops tabasco sauce ( to taste ) | 2 lbs beef tenderloin steaks
instructions: Place the pinto beans, garlic, bacon strips, oaxacan hot sauce, capers, tomatoes and anchovies in a resealable bag and toss until well mixed. Lay the steaks on a lightly oiled rack of foil and brush both sides heavily with olive oil. Place the steaks in a shallow pan. Pour the desired amount of hoisin/soy sauce over the steaks. Cover tightly and marinate for up to 3 days in the refrigerator. Grill the beef.

title: Grilled Mexican Radishes
ingredients: 2 large radishes, very fresh ( about 1 pound ) | 1 cup thick'n chunky salsa, warmed
instructions: Remove and discard both ends of each radish. Wash radish with cold water and blot dry with paper towels. Cut radishes into very thin slices. Heat grill or grill pan over medium hot heat. Place sliced radishes in pan and cook for 2 to 3 minutes on each side, until browned and heated through. Remove from heat if desired. Serve on heated plates with warmed salsa.

title: Broccoli-Feta Dressing
ingredients: 1 large tomato sauce | 1/2 cup feta, crumbled | 3 tablespoons broccoli florets, minced | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar
instructions: Blend tomato sauce, feta, broccoli, and rice vinegar in a blender until smooth.

title: Clams on a Sausage
ingredients: 2 lbs ground lamb | 12 ounces sauerkraut | 1 pint cherry tomatoes | 1 large sweet chili powder | 3 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 pint sour cream ( optional )
instructions: Brown meat and drain. Mix with rest other ingredients. Chill for at least 45 minutes. Serve in shells.

Random Ingredients: tiger,peanut butter,chicken bouillon cube,parsley sprig,baking potato,parmesan cheese,chicken,coriander seed
title: Roasted Tiger  Chicken
ingredients: 1 whole chickens, cut into 10 pieces | 4 large baking potatoes, whole cut into quarters | 1/2 cup good quality peanut butter, creamy | 1 chicken bouillon cube, crushed | 3/4 cup fresh parsley sprig, leaves only | 1/4 cup fresh coriander seed, cracked away from stems | 1 small chicken, skin removed, wing left on | 1/2 - 3/4 cup parmesan cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 450º f. Tear the chicken pieces into pieces about 2”x2”, about 2” x1”. Heat a large oven proof skillet on oven rack set over a burner. Arrange chicken pieces in skillet. In small bowl, mix peanut butter, chicken and 1 cube of the bouillon with 1/2 cup of the parsley and 1/2 cup of the coriander seeds. Pour peanut butter mixture evenly over chicken. Place chicken pieces in skillet in single layer and spoon hot peanut butter mixture into chicken pieces. Stir well. Cook for about 45 minutes, or until tender and chicken juices run clear. Add pepper. Stir in the parmesan cheese and 2 teaspoons of oil. Continue cooking 5 minutes longer, or until heated through.

Random Ingredients: scallion,sultana,panir,jumbo pasta shell,parmigiano reggiano cheese,spinach,no salt tomato
title: Jumbo Shells With Spinach and Pesto and Spicy Pesto
ingredients: 20 ounces jumbo pasta shells | 2 bunches scallions | 1/4 cup chopped spinach, stems removed | 1/2 cup sultana | 1/3 cup chopped pistachios | 1 can no-salt-added crushed tomatoes ( hunts ) | 1 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Shells, bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the pasta in boiling water until al dente, 11 to 15 minutes. When the pasta is done, drain and rinse in cold water until cool. Rinse with cold water and reserve. Scallions, trim the green tops from the scallions and thinly slice on the diagnol. Cut the white part of the scallions into 3 inch lengths. Remove and discard the dark green parts. In a mixing bowl, put all the pesto ingredients except the cheese. Toss until creamy, season with salt, to taste. Pasta, cook the pasta until al dente. To unmold the pasta, top it with a dollop of pesto, sprinkle on the cheese and squeeze a handful with your hands. Place under a preheated broiler until golden.

Random Ingredients: green chili pepper,gingerroot,lettuce,curry powder,sazon goya,savoy cabbage,watermelon
title: Spiced Cabbage With Melon and Chilis
ingredients: 1 leaf savoy cabbage | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh gingerroot | 1 mild green chili pepper, seeded and chopped ( such as jalapeno ) | 1 cup mixed lettuce | 1/2 teaspoon sazon goya | 1/2 teaspoon curry powder | 1 cup watermelon
instructions: Separate the leaves of the savoy and cabbage and slice along the centre lengthwise. Stack the two until you have 18 individual leaves. Place half of ginger, half of the chilli, half the lettuce, all of the sazon, and all of the curry and water in a food processor and process until smooth. Spread half the mixture over each leaf and sprinkle with the rest of the ginger and chilli flakes. Place equal amounts of the melon on each of the leaves, and wrap lightly in bundles of leaves. Serve immediately.

title: Rabo Sarno
ingredients: 3 lbs beef | 2 jars dried curds | 2 packages chicken bouillon | 2 -3 tablespoons sherry wine | 2 packages dashi | 4 cans tiny dried red peppers, with liquid | 2 cups roasted peanuts
instructions: Dissolve boullion in 1 cup of the hot water a few at a time, and set aside to cool. Cut the beef into thin strips. Rinse the curds and drain. Put into a large pot and put on the stove. Do not let it touch the sides of the pot. Keep stirring it as it will burn. When it starts getting to a boil, stir in the sherry and chicken bouillon. Mix well. When the boullion has dissolved, add the beef and red peppers. Mix well. Do not overmix. You may have to do it in two batches. The sherry and bouillon will settle at the bottom of the pot as you mix, but you want your sherry flavor to penetrate everything in the pot. Pour the contents of the pot into an oven proof dish, or 2 or 3 quart oven safe crockpots. Cover the contents with a lid and set in a warm place. Do not stir. If you set the pan in a warm place, it will burn a lot. Do not stir. This can also be done in a wok. You will have to mix well before adding the other ingredients, but no more than necessary as the sherry will burn, becoming rancid. After about an hour, remove the lid and set on low. Let this stew simmer for another 30 to 45 minutes, or until the meat is very tender. You will have to remove the lid while stew thickens a lot and the sherry will settle, and the beef will taste a bit nutty. Add the roasted peanuts and pulse into a fine paste.

title: Smoked Halibut Fyi -- Halibut With Soy Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon light-colored cooking sherry ( or cooking spray ) | 1/8 teaspoon coarse-ground seasoning salt | 1/2 cup soymilk ( light or full fat ) | 1 1/2 lbs halibut fillets
instructions: Preheat the grill. Combine the sherry, salt, and soymilk in a shallow dish and place in the refrigerator until the fish is ready. Remove any skin or bones from the fish. Place the fish in a nonstick ovenproof dish, or a shallow roasting pan to just below the center of the grill. Brush the fish with the sherry mixture. Broil until the fish is barely opaque in the center, 15 to 20 minutes, depending on the size and thickness of the fillet — and turning once. Fish should flake easily with a fork.

title: Spinach and Chilli Masala
ingredients: 500 g baby spinach ( or other bunches ) | 1 teaspoon coriander seed, crushed | 1 teaspoon dried chili | 1/2 teaspoon sweet onion flakes ( or to taste ) | 1 green chilies, finely chopped
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large frying pan, cover and cook on low heat for about 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, or until vegetables are tender. Serve hot with chapatis or naan bread for an elegant, simple and quick lunch snack, or as an accompaniment.

title: Fresh Beetroot Soup
ingredients: 600 g raw shelled beetroots | 4 tablespoons champagne vinegar | 1 tablespoon fresh chervil, finely chopped | 8 cups chicken stock | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 1/2 cup whipping cream | fresh corn ( fresh coriander ) or spring onion, to garnish
instructions: Rinse the beetroot in cold water and place in a medium pan, add cold water to cover, bring to the boil and simmer for 3 minutes. Drain and place in a separate saucepan and cover with cold water. Boil for 15 minutes until the beetroot is tender but still holding its shape. Drain the beetroot. Place in a food processor or blender and process for 1 minute and then place back onto the cold water. Blend for a further 3 - 4 minutes before blending again. Remove the beetroot with a slotted spoon and set aside to cool. Cut into cubes and place into a pan of boiling water, bring to the boil and cook for 20 minutes until tender and water has been absorbed. Drain and refresh in cold water. Remove the beetroot chunks from the skin and place into the pan, add the vinegar, chervil, stock and fish sauce and stir to combine. Bring to the boil, reduce the heat and simmer for 10 minutes until the soup is reduced by half and the flavours infuse. Transfer to individual serving bowls and garnish with whipped cream and coriander or spring onions.

Random Ingredients: baby carrot,baking soda,red wine,plain yogurt,bacon grease,white wine
title: Baby Carrots With Wine & Bacon!
ingredients: 500 g baby carrots | 2 tablespoons bacon grease | 1 1/4 cups dry red wine | 1 cup white wine | 1/4 cup low-fat plain yogurt | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 2 -3 tablespoons browned crumbled bacon fat
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200 deg celsius or 140 degrees c/350 deg fahrenheit. Slice the carrots into approx 2cm pieces and toss in a baking tray with the bacon grease and bake in the oven for approx 12 minutes. While they are baking, heat the liquids in a saucepan and add in the carrots. Heat the mixture and bring to the boil, stirring occasionally. Add the yogurt and baking soda to the carrot mixture. Once carrots are crisp add to the saucepan with the bacon fat and heat through, stirring occasionally. Serve drizzled with extra yogurt.

title: Gugelhito - Greek Potato Wedges
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs potatoes, peeled | 1/3 cup superfine sugar | 1/2 cup roasted peanuts, coarsely chopped
instructions: Place unpeeled potatoes in a medium saucepan with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil over high heat, and cook, uncovered, until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain liquid, and set aside. Place sugar in a medium saucepan over medium low heat, and stir 1 tablespoon of hot water to dissolve. Remove from heat, and stir in peanuts. Stir sugar mixture into potatoes, stirring until sugar dissolves. Let cool to room temperature, then chill, covered, for 8 hours, or overnight. Turn wedges out onto waxed paper, and cut off one of the wedges.

Random Ingredients: phyllo dough,bacon dripping,lettuce,cream mushroom soup,active yeast,penne,cucumber,lime juice
title: Bacon Wrapped Vegetable Rolls
ingredients: 1 tablespoon bacon drippings | 2 teaspoons active dry yeast or 1 teaspoon instant dried yeast | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 dash lime juice | 1 tablespoon lime juice | 16 sheets phyllo dough ( i prefer frozen, thawed ) | 6 sheets cooked bacon, chopped | 20 leaves lettuce | 1 cucumber, sliced
instructions: Brown bacon in pan. Drain bacon grease from pan. Add yeast to grease. Stir to dissolve yeast. Add condensed soup, lime juice and lime juice. Beat until well combined. Cover and set aside to rise for about 10 minute. Preheat oven to 350°f. Cut 2 sheets of phyllo dough in half. Take a phyllo dough piece and brush with melted bacon drippings. Place about 1 1/2 t of the vegetable mixture along the edge closest to you. Fold in the sides, brushing with more of the melted fat toward the top with your fingers. Fold the ends in like a flag and then roll up like a burrito. Repeat process for the rest of the dough. Arrange a sheet of phyllo in a 9x13 baking pan. Cut 2 slits into the top of phyllo. Bake for 20 minutes. Remove from oven and cover with foil to keep it warm. Repeat with a layer of phyllo, bacon, cucumber and remaining vegetable mixture. Bake for 15 more minutes or until phyllo is lightly browned.

title: Morel Rice with Rice
ingredients: 6 3/4 ounces pork roast | 12 ounces morels, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon margarine | 1 tablespoon margarine | 1 ounce honey | 2 cups cooked long grain rice | 1/2 lb hot italian sausage, crumbled
instructions: Brown the meat in large fry pan, drain. Add morels and cook for 5 minute add margarine, honey. Place in microwave safe pan and heat till heated through. Serve with rice.

title: Pumpkin Seed Snack Mix
ingredients: 1/4 cup peposeed seeds | 1/2 cup unsalted butter | 1 loaf italian bread
instructions: Crush the peposeeds in a mortar to form a fine meal. Add 1/4 cup of butter and crush again til creamy. Slice the loaf in half horizontally and line with italian bread. Spread pumpkin seed crumbs on top. Bake in 375 oven for 20 - 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: steak,ginger garlic paste,catsup,maple syrup,xanthan gum,cucumber,tahini,kaffir lime leaf
title: Spicy Carpaccio
ingredients: 1/3 cup catsup ( heinz ) | 2 tablespoons pure maple syrup | 2 tablespoons tahini ( i used light ) | 1/4 teaspoon xanthan gum ( optional ) or 1/4 teaspoon soy sauce ( i used light ) | 1/2 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 2 -3 fresh kaffir lime leaves | 2 tablespoons minced seeded cucumbers or 2 tablespoons red bell peppers | 1/2 lb flank steak
instructions: Dissolve cayenne pepper paste in tomato paste and mix with remaining ingredients. Pour sauce in freezer covered zip loc bag with contents. Refrigerate 2 hours overnite. Place steak between two sheets of waxed paper.

title: Indian Honey Glazed Corned Beef
ingredients: 3 pounds corned beef brisket, trimmed of all visible fat and silverskin | 3 cups mango chutney | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Wash the corned beef under cold water to remove and discard any excess salt and excess moisture. Place in a large roasting pan, spread evenly, and cover tightly with aluminum foil. Bake for 1 1/2 hours in the preheated oven. Remove aluminum foil and allow the brisket to cool. Remove any excess fat from the cooled meat and discard. Place in a serving dish and cover with plastic wrap. Let it stand at room temperature while you prepare the mango chutney, in a small saucepan, melt the mango chutney over low heat. Remove from heat and let cool. When the corned beef has cooled, remove the meat from the bones and cut into 1/2 inch slices. Reserve juices and meat for later use. Shred across the grain of the meat and set aside. In a small bowl, blend together the graham cracker crumbs with enough corn oil to make a thick paste. Coat the meat well with the cracker crumb paste, cover, and refrigerate for at least 10 minutes. Arrange meat in a roasting pan. Place the mango chutney in a pan and heat slowly, stirring often, until thickened. Arrange meat and reserved juices in a serving dish. Brush generously with remaining corn oil and bake in the preheated oven for 1 hour and 15 minutes, until meat is tender.

Random Ingredients: dijon mustard,linguine,sugar substitute,extra large egg,pork loin roast,chicken tenderloin,green onion,nutritional yeast
title: Pork Noodle Salad
ingredients: 3 lbs pork loin, cut in 1-inch chunks | 3 lbs boneless chicken tenders | 8 ounces linguine | 1/4 cup nutritional yeast | 1/4 cup green onion, chopped | 1/4 cup dijon mustard | 2 packets fat free low sodium soy sauce | 3 extra-large eggs
instructions: Place pork and chicken in crockpot. Sprinkle with salt, pepper and worcestershire sauce. Add rest of the ingredients. Cover. Cook on low for 5 - 7 hours. Remove from crockpot and shred easily using two forks. Add to individual bowls and serve. Great over cooked spaghetti or fresh pasta.

title: Pesto Pesto Dip
ingredients: 1 jar prepared pesto sauce ( or any bottled pesto ) | 1 lb pepperoni sausage, cut in half lengthwise and slightly flattened to create pocket | 12 ounces jarred roasted sweet peppers with peppers ( or other good pepper ) or 12 ounces roasted salami, cut in small to small pieces ( or other good pepper )
instructions: Cook sausage and pepper until sausage is cooked thoroughly and sausage is no longer pink. Drain. Chill in refrigerator or freeze. Serve on italian rolls, or use immediately on bread, rolls or bread sticks.

Random Ingredients: baking potato,salt black pepper,butter,sea salt black pepper
title: Roesti Roasted Potatoes
ingredients: 4 medium baking potatoes, about 2 1/2 pounds, scrubbed and trimmed | sea salt and freshly ground black pepper | 1/4 cup unsalted butter | coarse salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and scatter the potatoes evenly with sea salt. Drizzle with olive oil and season with coarse salt and pepper. Roast the potatoes in the preheated oven until they begin to caramelize and begin to show some browning at the edges, about 25 minutes. Allow them to dry on the pan side in a warm area for up to 1 hour before moving to a chopping board. When the potatoes come out of the oven, transfer them to a cutting board. Cut each potato lengthwise into 1/2 inch slices, and return them to the baking sheet. Let steam for about 20 minutes. Remove from the oven and scatter with unsalted butter. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: cardamom seed,romaine lettuce,oregano leaf,green bell pepper,basil,feta cheese,deli beef,pepperoni
title: Grilled Patty Salad
ingredients: 1/2 green bell pepper, cut into 1 1/2-inch strips | 1 teaspoon dried basil ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom seeds ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano leaves ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground pepperoni | 6 thin slices deli corned beef brisket, halved | 1 cup crumbled feta cheese, divided | 2 leaves romaine lettuce
instructions: Preheat grill for medium heat. Combine green bell pepper, basil, cardamom, oregano, and pepperoni.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,pita bread,grain white rice,clementine,chocolate,green curry paste
title: Green Curry and Coconut Rice Sandwich (Microwave)
ingredients: 2 cups pita bread | 1/2 cup long grain white rice | 1 - 2 1/2 tablespoon green curry paste | 1/2 inch clementine | 14 1/2 ounces condensed light cream of coconut salad packed in oil or 14 1/2 ounces light cream of coconut flavoured yogurt | 2 3/4 teaspoons natural-style gluten free blended self-rising flour
instructions: Combine the first five ingredients in a microwave safe bowl, pour into microwave, and cook until rice is cooked. Let stand for 5 minutes, stir to cool slightly. Cut rice into two 1/2 by 3 inch sticks. Mix the second five ingredients together in a bowl using 1/2 teaspoons of the curry paste, stir into rice until mixed thoroughly. Spoon mixture onto each bread slice, top with the second bread slice. Cover with cling film and microwave on full power until heated through.

title: Tuna Cabbage-Cabbage
ingredients: 1 can tuna packed in water | 1 head cabbage, thinly sliced | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/4 cup pecans, optional, to taste
instructions: Mix tuna and water in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Cover and refrigerate 4 to 6 hours or overnight. Add cabbage to remaining ingredients.

title: Broccoli with Cinnamon
ingredients: 1/2 tablespoon ghee ( clarified butter ) | 1 large head broccoli, trimmed and florets cut into florets | 1/8 teaspoon ground cinnamon
instructions: Heat the ghee in a large pot over medium heat and cook the broccoli florets, stirring often, until it begins to soften, about 5 minutes. Stir in the cinnamon and cook until the broccoli is bright green and beginning to wilt, about 2 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Quinoa and Chocolate Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 cup quinoa, soaked in water overnight and drained | 1 cup fresh bean, cooked or canned | 3/4 cup milk | 1/8 cup chopped green onion ( including tops ) | 1/3 cup chopped semisweet chocolate ( optional ) | 1/4 cup marshmallows | 2 chicken breasts, cut into four-wheat strips and fried
instructions: Drain quinoa well and set aside. Heat 1/4 cup milk and the green onions and 1/3 cup of chocolates in a medium saucepan over medium heat and cook 1 - 2 minutes, stirring frequently until hot. Do not boil. Add quinoa and bean and mix thoroughly. Add hot milk to green onion mixture and cook until thickened stirring frequently. Remove from heat and stir in 1/3 cup of chocolates. Spread mixture over 2 plates, top with fried chicken strips. Spread remaining green onion mixture over chicken strips and serve.

title: Smoky Poblano Raisin Molasses Snack
ingredients: 1/4 cup molasses | 1/4 cup golden raisin | 2 poblano peppers | 2 tablespoons caster sugar ( superfine sugar ) | 1/4 teaspoon salt ( kosher )
instructions: To remove black spots, break poblano into large pieces approximately 1 x 3. Roast the pieces under broiler until a dark amber colour for about 5 - 6 minutes, turning the pieces as necessary. The poblanos are light brown and look blistered on outside and slightly charred at the edges. Remove poblanos from the oven and set aside to cool on a cooling tray for about 20 minutes while you finish preparing the poblanos. Remove the seeds from the poblanos by rubbing the rind off of them with your fingers and set all in a bowl of ice water to halt the oxidation. Cut away the top stem of the poblanos, then cut about 3/4 in from the base of each. Carefully remove skin with your hands and discard the hard black skin. Slice open each poblano slice slightly and remove the seeds as well as any loose membrane. Cut each poblano slice in half and place on a sheet of parchment paper. To prepare the molasses syrup, put the molasses in a small bowl and heat the sugar, salt and sugar in the top pot over medium low heat for about 5 minutes. Don't let this boil as the molasses will form lumps. As soon as the sugar dissolves, stir in the poblanos. Remove from the heat and pour into a nonreactive cup or bowl. When cool, ladle into sterilized jars and seal.

title: Apple Cider Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1/4 cup tahini sauce | 1/2 cup apple cider, chilled ( from a bottle ) | 1 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and serve over salad greens.

title: Bavarian Cottage-Maker's Steak
ingredients: 4 lbs boneless beef cubes | 4 tablespoons dried onion soup mix | 1 teaspoon celery seed | 1 teaspoon ground mace | 1/2 pint sour cream | cantaloupe ( optional )
instructions: Put all in crockpot, cook on low all day.

Random Ingredients: tomato,whipping cream,corn tortilla chip,coriander powder,english muffin,rosemary,yellow mustard,sake
title: Mexican Party Melt - No-Yeast Party Dip!
ingredients: 1 cup whipping cream | 2 tablespoons yellow mustard | 1/3 cup chopped fresh coriander powder | 1 tablespoon sake | 1 tablespoon fresh rosemary, minced | 1 1/2 lbs tomatoes, chopped | 1 english muffin, cut into 1/4-inch slices ( cut in half ) | 1 package corn tortilla chips, broken into small pieces
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk cream with mustard, coriander powder, sake and rosemary. Add tomatoes and stir to mix well. Let stand, covered, for 20 minutes. Arrange muffins on a baking sheet. Dividing evenly, top with dip. Bake at 400°, uncovered, for 20 minutes, or until hot and bubbly.

title: Tandoori Chicken
ingredients: 6 chicken cutlets | 1 cup raw frozen corn, thawed | 4 tablespoons chives ( chopped ) | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 2 cups mashed potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Heat oil in a medium skillet. Fry chicken over medium high heat until light, golden brown and cooked through. Remove from skillet and place in a baking dish. Pour 1 cup of the corn onto the chicken. Sprinkle evenly with turmeric and chopped chives. Cover the chicken with mashed potatoes. Bake at 400f for about 20 minutes till the gravy is bubbly and the chicken is slightly browned.

title: Creamy Party Appetizer Tray
ingredients: 1 tablespoon butter at room temperature, softened | 2 teaspoons prepared horseradish | 1/2 tablespoon chopped fresh red chile pepper | 1/4 cup chopped grapes and tomatoes | 1 serrano chile pepper, seeded and minced | 1 can mixed vegetables, drained | 1 can sauerkraut with chives, drained | 1 package cream cheese, cubed
instructions: In a small bowl, mix butter, horseradish, red chile pepper, grapes and tomatoes. Spread about 1/4 cup of the mixture into the base of a 9x10 inch metal baking pan. Arrange mixed ingredients on top. Sprinkle with the serrano chile. Spread sauerkraut over the sauerkraut. In a blender, combine the cream cheese and green chile. After blending, gradually blend in the cream cheese mixture until smooth. Spread over the sauerkraut. Let stand for about 5 minutes before serving.

title: Dee's Turkish Delight
ingredients: 3 cups shredded cantaloupe | 15 ounces red beans | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne | 1 cup prepared greek yogurt
instructions: Pre heat oven to 400 f. Lightly spray a large baking dish with oil. Put beans in dish. Mix cayenne with 1/3cup yogurt. Toss with remaining ingredients. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes.

title: Cauliflower & Red Cabbage Revelation
ingredients: 1/4 lb medium red cabbage ( any shredded color would do ) | 1 -2 dash cayenne pepper
instructions: Place cabbage into a large microwaveable bowl. Sprinkle with cayenne pepper and microwave on high for 4 - 5 minutes or until the cabbage is tender. Serve with bread, crackers or crisp rolls, or as a side dish to eat with other dishes.

title: Nana's Fried Radishes
ingredients: radish skins ( nana's fresh or frozen if no nannies available ) | 4 radishes, peeled | 3 tablespoons cake flour | 1 tablespoon chipotle chile, minced
instructions: Take your nana's and roll them in the cake flour. Chop them very finely to do this. Fry them in medium high heat, turning once, until golden, a few minutes should do. Remove them from the pan immediately and place on a cooling rack lined with a paper bag. Let cool. Heat up your favorite cooking oil. Fry the drained radishes for a couple of minutes or until just limp, adding more oil as needed. Serve them warm, with fresh guacamole and sour cream.

Random Ingredients: pimento olive,cream chicken soup,asparagus,red wine vinegar
title: Easy Bleu Cheese Asparagus with Pimentos
ingredients: 20 ounces asparagus, fresh frozen or canned, thawed and halved | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 1/2 cup pimento stuffed olive, diced ( about 20 or large olives )
instructions: Place frozen asparagus in a microwaveable bowl.

Random Ingredients: white vinegar,yellow pepper,cabbage,canadian bacon,sultana,green food coloring,serrano pepper,ginger paste
title: Achar Ghost (Stolen English Cabbage)
ingredients: 1 cabbage | 1 package canadian bacon | 2 teaspoons grated fresh ginger paste | 2 serrano peppers | 2 teaspoons white vinegar | vegetable green food coloring ( optional ) | 1/4 cup sultana ( optional ) | 1/3 cup red food coloring
instructions: Core the cabbage, removing thick stem area of leaves. Trim the excess and shred into thin strips. Cut the bacon into small pieces and fry in a pot with enough water on the bottom of range to cover the bacon. Add the ginger paste, chilies, vinegar, food color/water and simmer until all the water has evaporated or has been absorbed. Add the sultanas and set aside. When the liquid has almost completely dryed, add the shredded cabbage and cook on low heat for 30 - 45 minutes or until the cabbage has dried out. Stir to redistribute the cabbage. Taste foe salt to your taste.

Random Ingredients: chipotle powder,dark rum,double cream,red onion,red bell pepper,juniper berry,cabbage,raspberry
title: The Perfect Cabbage Crunch
ingredients: 2 lbs cabbage, finely shredded | 1 red onion, finely chopped | 3 red bell peppers, chopped | 2 ounces dark rum | 7 juniper berries | 2 -3 teaspoons chipotle powder | 1 red onion, finely chopped | 1 red bell pepper, chopped | 7 ounces raspberry preserves or 7 ounces raspberry ketchup
instructions: Place all ingredients in a big bowl and mix well. Place cabbage in the middle and fill the cabbage base with water. Bring to a boil, and lower the heat to a simmer. Cook 5 minutes, then remove lid and cook for an additional 20 - 25 minutes. Spoon into serving bowls and serve with ketchup or preserves.

title: Spinach and Yam Tilapia
ingredients: 3 medium yams, about 1 1/2 pounds, peeled ( about 2 pounds ) | 1/4 lb tilapia fillet, about 1 1/2 pounds | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | chopped fresh spinach leaves ( optional ) | yogurt or sour cream
instructions: Combine the yams and tilapia in a large bowl, and coat with the sesame oil.

Random Ingredients: zucchini,pomegranate seed,cinnamon,heavy whipping cream,sharp cheddar cheese,pickle relish
title: Zucchini Chicons Au Pomegranate
ingredients: 2 zucchini, thinly sliced | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 tablespoon sweet pickle relish | 1 1/2 tablespoons pomegranate seeds | 1 tablespoon heavy whipping cream | 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon | 3 1/2 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat broiler. Place zucchini slices on a baking sheet. Spray broiler rack with nonstick cooking spray. Roast zucchini in oven until tender and lightly browned, about 8 to 10 minutes. Transfer to bowl, cool. Whip 1 cup heavy whipping cream with relish, pomegranate seeds, and 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon. Stir in 1 teaspoon grated cheese. Spread mixture evenly over zucchini. Broil until golden, about 2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: red currant jelly,maraschino cherry juice,italian parsley,anise,mango chutney,turmeric powder,lemon juice zest
title: Italian Mango Chutney
ingredients: 1 teaspoon ground anise | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/2 cup fresh mango chutney ( i used mango chutney ) | 1/4 cup red currant jelly ( i used jamtender dessert sauce, but you can use any jelly that you like ) | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice ( i did not peel this ) | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1/2 cup of fresh mint leaves ( chopped finely ) or 1/2 cup italian parsley ( chopped finely )
instructions: Combine all of the ingredients in a medium bowl, stirring to mix well. Heat a 2 1/2 cm. Pan with a little oil. Swirl to coat the bottom of the pan evenly. Add the mixture and swirl till smooth and bubbly. Cook on medium, stirring frequently until the mixture comes to the boil, then remove from the heat. Transfer to a small serving bowl. Top with mint leaves or parsley if using. Cook's note, it should be served as soon as it is cool.

title: Rice with Chocolate and Limes
ingredients: 4 1/2 cups raw rice | 2 tablespoons white vinegar | 1 tablespoon superfine sugar | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1/2 lime, juice only | 4 ounces shaved chocolate ( or use semi sweet chocolate chips )
instructions: Place rice in a bowl and cover with boiling water. Stand for 15 minutes, then drain, stirring once, and allow to cool. Place vinegar, sugar, vanilla and lime juice into a blender and purée. Bring rice to the boil in boiling water and simmer uncovered for 5 to 10 minutes until tender, stirring constantly. Transfer rice to a bowl and chill until cold. Whip the chocolate into small pieces using a large metal spoon. Once it has melted, fold into rice. Serve warm and cold.

title: Thai Green Salad Dressing
ingredients: 2/3 cup plain soymilk | 1/3 teaspoon minced fresh dill | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh thai fish sauce | 1 tablespoon adobo sauce ( optional )
instructions: Stir the soy milk, dill, and thai fish sauce together in a mixing bowl.

title: Apple Mango Chutney
ingredients: 2 -3 tablespoons apple juice | 2 tablespoons mango chutney
instructions: Put apple juice into the microwaveable container/bowl/ramekin. Add mango chutney into the jar. Cover and microwave on high for 3 minutes, take off lid and stir. Allow to cool on microwave and serve with indian chapatis etc.

title: Shred
ingredients: 1 cup dark rum | 2 teaspoons hot pepper sauce
instructions: Preheat grill to medium. In a small bowl, combine rum and hot pepper sauce. Place shredded meat on the grill, and brush with rum mixture. Grill to your liking, and serve with your favorite side dishes.

title: Quinoa With Chilies, Chucks, Coriander Seeds, and Coriander
ingredients: 7 ounces quinoa ( arborio or calrose's ) | 4 poblano chiles, chopped | 1 tablespoon coriander seed | 2 1/2 cups vegetable stock | 1 tablespoon channa dal ( bengal gram lentils )
instructions: Rinse quinoa to remove any excess moisture, until the water has drained.

title: Garbanzo Bean Chicken Soup (Nasi Lemony)
ingredients: 5 cups chicken drumsticks, with skin | 1 cup dried garbanzo beans ( chickpeas ) | 3 cups rice noodles
instructions: Soak the chickpeas in warm water overnight. The next day drain and rinse. Place in pot along with 2 cups of water. Bring to boil and add 1 cup of rice noodles. Cook 7 minutes or until tender.

title: Spinach and Potatoes Au Jus
ingredients: 3 russet potatoes, scrubbed, unpeeled and cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1 pound fresh spinach, washed, trimmed and trimmed
instructions: Place the potatoes on a baking sheet with a small rim around the edges. Bake at 450 degrees f for about 25 minutes. They should be tender and lightly colored. Remove to a small bowl and mash with a potato masher. Set aside to cool. When cool enough to handle, scoop the flesh out of the skins into a bowl. Stir in the spinach, and sprinkle with salt. Serve immediately, or cover and refrigerate for up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,bacon,plum tomato,maple syrup,cold water,yeast
title: German Red Bell Peppers Stuffed With Tomatoes and Bacon in Maple Syrup
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cold water | 1 tablespoon yeast | 4 plum tomatoes, cut in large pieces ( about 5 oz each ) | 1 small red bell pepper, seeded, cored and cut in rings | 1/2 cup bacon fat or 1/2 cup other fat | 1 -2 tablespoon maple syrup
instructions: Put the water and yeast into a large bowl and pour into the bowl with the tomatoes. Stir with a fork, breaking the tomatoes into chunks or smaller pieces. Cover with a cloth and let stand in a warm place until the dough has doubled in size, about 1 1/2 hours. Stir in the red bell pepper and bacon fat. Turn the dough onto a floured board and knead until the dough is smooth and elastic about 10 minutes. Form into a ball and place onto a floured breadboard, turning once to grease the top. Cover with a cloth and let rest until doubled, about 40 minutes. Press the dough down and divide into 12 even sized pieces. Roll each piece into a 6 inch diameter round. Heat a large, heavy nonstick skillet over moderately high heat until the fat almost shimmers but does not smoke, about 2 min. Add half of the dough and, flipping once, brown on each side, about 1 minute per side. Transfer the stuffed bell peppers to a baking sheet. Cook the remaining peppers, covered, over moderate heat until soft and slightly browned, about 10 minutes. Sprinkle with maple syrup. Cut crosswise into quarters and serve warm.

title: Red Chile Sauce for Fish, Chips or Crudites
ingredients: 1 cup chick-peas ( canned ), drained | 2 red chilies, seeded | 2 tablespoons saffron | 1 1/2 tablespoons vodka
instructions: Place all ingredients in blender and blend, stopping to scrape down sides, until thoroughly incorporated. Note, if using canned chick peas, remove and discard seeds before processing.

Random Ingredients: cilantro leaf,orange juice zest,bisquick,egg yolk,white sugar,bay leaf,cardamom pod
title: Bisquick Orange and White Squares
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups bisquick | 1/2 cup white sugar | 1 egg yolk | 1 orange, juice and zest of | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1 bay leaf | 1/2 cup orange juice and zest of | 1 tablespoon minced cilantro leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to mix the Bisquick with the sugar, egg yolk and orange zest. Add cardamom, bayleaf and orange juice and stir. Pour into a 9 x 13 inch baking dish coated with cooking spray. Bake 40 - 45 minutes or until inserted toothpick comes out clean. Remove from oven, sprinkle with cilantro, and allow to cool for 5 minutes. Cut into squares.

Random Ingredients: vanilla extract,garlic paste,dark sesame oil,sharp cheddar cheese,kale
title: Tantalizing Spanish Kale
ingredients: 1 bunch kale ( i use a handful of this but any kale will do ) | 2 teaspoons garlic paste | 2 teaspoons dark sesame oil | 2 teaspoons vanilla extract | 2 ounces sharp cheddar cheese ( mild, but can use a mild cheese )
instructions: Wash the kale. Wash and roughly chop into 1 inch lengths. Place greens in a bowl of hot water for five minutes or until wilted. Rinse and pat dry with paper towels. Place the garlic on a large plate. Heat a cast iron pan or non stick frying pan over medium high heat. Add the oil. When the oil is very hot, add the garlic paste. After a minute or so, add the kale. Let the kale wilt and the oil will start to bubble up over the kale. The leaves will wilt, but in a matter of seconds, and they shouldn't be. It won't matter, just a moment or two. Add the sesame oil and vanilla. Give the greens a stir. Toss the greens well. Add the cheese. Toss again. It can be enjoyed immediately, but just don't let the cheese melt completely. They're supposed to be soft, but there's such a strong flavor this can be very messy to use.

Random Ingredients: center pork chop,salmon,sage leaf,snow pea,salad oil
title: Pot Sticker Places
ingredients: 5 -6 thick center piece of pork chops or 5 -6 thin pork loin chops | 2 tablespoons salad oil | sage leaf | 12 ounces fresh snow peas, washed | 4 -6 ounces salmon, cubed
instructions: Cut chops into 2 chunks. Coat with salad oil. Sprinkle with sage leaf and allow them to stand 15 minutes. Place snow peas 1/4 of fish in center of each piece of pork and top with salmon cubes or other optional fillings and vegetables to serve.

Random Ingredients: purpose flour,grape leaf,chipotle powder,chicken meat,poblano pepper,chocolate pudding mix,cream tartar,leek
title: Chocolate Chip Chicken
ingredients: 1 cup sour cream, divided | 1 package instant chocolate pudding mix | 4 teaspoons all-purpose flour | 1/4 teaspoon ground chipotle powder | 1/8 teaspoon cream of tartar | 15 ounces sliced chocoholicd frozen chopped poblano peppers | 10 ounces fresh grape leaves, drained | 1 leek, trimmed, sliced 1/2-inch
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a small saucepan, combine 1/4 cup sour cream, pudding mix, flour, chipotle powder, and cream of tartar. Bring to a simmer over medium heat, stirring occasionally. Remove saucepan from heat. Heat remaining 1 1/2 cups of sour cream over medium heat, then stir in poblano peppers, grape leaves, and leek. Spoon 1/4 cup of the hot cheese mixture into the center of each grape leaf. Roll up. Place 1/2 tablespoon of the chocohocan cheese mixture in the center of each roll, and continue shaping rolls to form a spiral. Arrange grape leaves in a 9x13 inch baking pan, and cover with remaining cheese mixture. Bake at 350 degrees f for 25 minutes, or until lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: green chilies,oil black olive,thyme sprig,lime,dashi stock,herb,coffee granule
title: Albal Oolib
ingredients: 1 ounce fresh herb ( optional ) | 2 fresh thyme sprigs | 2 ounces firm oil-cured black olives | 1 ounce instant dashi stock ( or beef stock cubes ) | 2 tablespoons strong brewed coffee | 1 tablespoon instant coffee granules | 1 lime, cut into wedges
instructions: Gather herbs and thyme sprigs into a bundle and finely chop a small bunch of them. Place into a bowl, pour over the coffee and set aside for 15 minutes. Remove herb bundle and thyme sprigs from coffee. Blend the remaining herbs and mix well with the liquid in the bowl. Pour coffee into a heat proof bowl using a little of the coffee stock to moisten and soak the flavored coffee for 2 minutes, then strain into the bowl with the herbs. Bring to the boil and stir in the coffee granules. Add the oil a drop at a time, stirring briskly with each addition. Return to the boil, then boil for 5 minutes or until it has reduced by two thirds. Garnish with a wedge of lime and serve.

title: Basic Rub for Chilean Chicken
ingredients: 3 -4 tablespoons spicy mustard | 1 teaspoon ground mace | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Combine mustard and mace in a small serving bowl. Sprinkle seasoning on chicken, rubbing all over. Refrigerate until ready to grill or use immediately as directed and can be frozen.

title: Sweetened Grilled Cheese Fettuccini
ingredients: 4 ounces ground pork | 12 ounces fettuccine pasta | 3/4 cup pineapple juice | 1/2 pint milk | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne ( adjust for heat level in a pinch )
instructions: Cook the fettucini according to package directions. Set aside in a large bowl. In a saucepan over medium heat, add the pork and cook until no longer pink. Drain any excess fat but reserve a tablespoon or two. Toss with the fettuccini and pineapple juice. Heat just until warm. Add the milk and stir until melted.

title: Dolmades
ingredients: 250 g veal ( pounded thinly ) | 300 g cream cheese | 1 can chopped tomatoes | 2 teaspoons vanilla sugar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 °c. Line a cookie sheet with aluminium foil. Spread a piece of veal out as you would do if it were in a sandwich tin. Spread on a layer of cream cheese. Place another layer of veal on top of this, and cover with cream cheese. Spread chopped tomatoes over all. Sprinkle the vanilla sugar over all. Cover the pan with a piece of aluminum foil. Press firmly at the top. Bake for 8 - 10 minutes. Remove the foil, and bake again for 5 - 10 minutes or until the tomatoes are lightly brown.

title: Boom Chakor -- Curried Tasty Tart Sent from Heaven
ingredients: 1 ready-made pie shell | 1 - 1 1/2 - 1 1/2-1 1/2-1 1/2-1 1/2-1 1/2-1 tablespoon madras curry paste or 1 - 1 1/2-1 tablespoon cayenne pepper, to taste
instructions: Preperatory note, this is a very different filling than some curry paste.

Random Ingredients: deli ham,nonstick cooking spray,heavy whipping cream,potato traditional
title: Ham and Potato Stuffed With Potato Wedges
ingredients: 8 ounces deli ham, cut into 1/2-inch squares | 3 medium potatoes, boiled and shredded traditional style | 1 quart nonstick cooking spray | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f using a 3 1/2 inch diameter round cake tin, press a ham square into the center of the tin. Sprinkle with shredded potato and dot with non stick vegetable spray. In a small mixing bowl, mix a tablespoon of heavy cream with the remaining 1 tablespoon cream. Spread mixture over ham then cover the ham with a layer of shredded potatoes. Repeat layering until all ingredients are used. Bake for 20 minutes or until golden brown and potatoes are tender, stirring after 10 minutes.

title: Chili Dogs (Dry)
ingredients: 3 large tomatoes, peeled, seeded and chopped | 1 teaspoon dried red chili powder
instructions: Combine the tomatoes and chili powder in a shallow pan and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat to low and simmer until the liquid has reduced to about 1 cup. Serve warm with plain or flavored salt.

Random Ingredients: orange peel,kidney bean,egg yolk,red bell pepper,basil,bean sprout,shiitake mushroom,nori
title: Japanese-Style Deviled Eggs(Vegetarian Times)
ingredients: 3 eggs | 1 red bell pepper, chopped | 1 teaspoon orange peel, chopped | 8 fresh shiitake mushrooms, sliced | 1/4 cup bean sprouts | 3 leaves fresh basil, chopped | 3 sheets nori, cut into thin strips | 1 can kidney beans, drained ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Spray four 8 or 9 inch diameter slices of heavy duty aluminum foil with cooking spray. In a small bowl, beat egg yolks until thick and creamy. Place red bell pepper in a small dutch oven or other large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Cook until crisp tender, about 3 minutes per side. Transfer to a bowl when cool enough to handle. Place egg yolks in a large clean bowl. Add red bell pepper, orange peel and shiitake mushrooms, and toss to coat with egg yolks. Spread bean sprouts on a platter. Spoon bean sprouts into a small bowl. Arrange nori strips in a decorative bowl. Fill each of the four 8 slices of foil with 1/4 cup bean sprouts. Arrange basil, red bell pepper, mushrooms and nori strips on top of bean sprouts, leaving 1/2 inch on all sides of foil. Carefully lift up foil, and place on a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until tops are golden brown, about 15 minutes.

title: Cumin Seeds and Mozzarella Fingers
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cumin seeds | 2 tablespoons icing sugar | 1/2 cup fresh mixed herbs
instructions: Grind cumin seeds with 3/4 cup water or milk using a spice grinder.

title: Green Olive Brine Sauce
ingredients: 3/4 cup green olives in brine, drained | 3/4 tablespoon heavy whipping cream
instructions: Drain olives. Place in an electric blender, and pour the cream into the container. Cover, and blend on medium speed for 2 to 3 minutes, or until smooth.

title: Veal with Gravy (Veal Creole Style)
ingredients: 1 lb veal, cut in 1-1/2-inch pieces | 1 -2 celery rib, in 1/8th slices | 1 teaspoon hot chili paste | 1 cup beef gravy
instructions: Cut veal diagonally into 1 inch pieces. Rub veal with hot chili paste. Cover and refrigerate overnight, or for at least an hour. Drain excess liquid from veal and place in casserole dish. Reserve spices. In a small saucepan, cover veal with water. Bring to a simmer, cover and simmer slowly for 30 - 40 minutes until tender. Remove veal from liquid and set aside for 10 minutes. Cut veal in slices and arrange on platter.

title: Green Chile Quorn Wedges
ingredients: 16 ounces quorn tenders | 1 can green chilies, diced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Cut quorn tenders in 10 wedges. Spoon green chilies onto lightly greased baking sheet. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Bake in preheated oven about 10 minutes, or until crisp. Remove wedges with a spatula. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: dill pickle relish,hamburger,aubergine,beef sirloin steak,brown rice,carrot
title: Dill Beef Roll up
ingredients: 1 lb beef sirloin steak | 1 large aubergine, sliced into 8 pieces | 1 carrot, sliced | 1/2 cup brown rice, cooked | 1 package hamburger roll ups | 1/2 cup dill pickle relish
instructions: Trim excess fat from meat and cut into 8 pieces. Roll each piece with a pickle on the inside edge with the bottom to make a pocket. Place diagonally in the center of each roll and top with some cooked rice and pickles. Fold roll up into quarters and serve immediately.

title: Hot Mustard Sauce-Muffins
ingredients: 1 jar pimientos, drained, sliced in half if they have it | 4 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 tablespoon spicy brown mustard, of your choice | 1 tablespoon fresh grated ginger
instructions: Preheat your grill. In a med. Bowl, blend all ingredient and set aside. Put about 2 tablespoons of filling in each muffin tin and brush tops with sauce. Grill about 5 minutes or until golden brown and crisp.

Random Ingredients: black bean sauce,plain yogurt,pecorino cheese,extra virgin olive oil
title: Easy and Good Black Bean Lassi
ingredients: 1 can black bean sauce | 2 cartons plain yogurt, or to taste | 1/4 cup fresh grated pecorino cheese | 1 teaspoon extra-virgin olive oil
instructions: Blend black bean sauce, plain yogurt, pecorino cheese, and olive oil together in a blender until smooth.

title: Pixie Dust
ingredients: 1 cup grapeseed oil or 1 cup ghee | 1/4 cup chili sauce | 1/4 cup sweet chili wine | 1/3 cup chopped fresh italian parsley
instructions: Heat oil in a small skillet over low heat, stirring constantly. Add chili sauce and heat slowly, stirring constantly until mixture is hot. Pour into a small bowl. Cool. Stir in parsley. Dust with more cinnamon if desired. Serve.

Random Ingredients: rosemary,zatarain jambalaya mix,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Rosemary Zatari Fritters
ingredients: 1 package zatarain' jambalaya mix ( zatarain recipe mix ) | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 -2 teaspoon dried rosemary or 2 teaspoons fresh rosemary, minced
instructions: Combine the zatarain mix and rosemary in a small bowl. Coat the inside of a fry pan with cooking spray. Place over high heat. When it starts to bubble, add a layer of batter, and repeat until all batter is cooked. Let cook about 2 minutes. Remove from heat, and let rest for 7 - 10 minutes. Cut into desired size chunks. Serve with butter, or as a snack on a salad.

Random Ingredients: hamburger,dill weed,white wine vinegar,salt,cabbage,kaffir lime leaf,almond meal
title: Danish Hamburger Salad
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 1/4 head cabbage, chopped | 1/2 cup slivered almonds meal or 1/4 cup walnut meal | 1/4 cup dry white wine vinegar | salt ( adjust with salt if needed ) | 1/4 teaspoon dried dill weed | 1 -2 kaffir lime leaf, cut into 4 strips
instructions: Brown hamburger and cabbage, drain fat. Combine all the ingredients, except the lime, and toss into hamburger. Garnish with lime slices and serve immediately.

title: Mongolian Soba
ingredients: 1/2 cup yellow onion, chopped | 1/2 cup dried kaffir lime leaves, soaked in warm water until softened | 2 tablespoons sake or 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: In a skillet, combine the onion, lime leaves, sake, and cayenne to make a thin sauce, about 3 minutes. Stir to blend with the kaffir lime syrup. Cook until the mixture begins to stick to the bottom, then pour into a bowl. Cover, and set aside to mellow for up to 2 weeks. Serve over hot cooked white rice. Store in refrigerator.

title: Tarragon Beans and Rice
ingredients: 2 cans pinto beans, drained, rinsed | 1 can diced tomatoes and green chilies | 1 can enchilada sauce | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon
instructions: Pour all ingredients into a saucepan, bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer over low heat for 40 minutes, stirring occasionally.

title: Paneer With Green Beans
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups panir, cubed | 2 lbs fresh green beans, cut in 2 inch pieces | 1 tablespoon cumin powder | 1 tablespoon butter | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon | 3 ounces farfalle pasta
instructions: Cook pasta according to directions on box, drain and set aside. In a pan with butter, add cumin and fry until fragrant, add farfalle and fry for a minute. Add green beans and a couple of tablespoons oil and brown on each side. When green beans are just tender, add the pasta and stir to combine well. Put in green bean mixture and toss well. Serve and enjoy.

title: Anchovy Vichyssoise
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon anchovy paste, or more to taste | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh dill | 1/4 square unsweetened chocolate, grated
instructions: Heat the corn oil in a skillet over medium high heat.

title: Italian Herb-Rubbed Dipping Sauce for Fish
ingredients: 1 teaspoon garlic, minced | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried oregano leaves | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1/4 teaspoon coconut extract ( optional ) | 1 1/4 teaspoons honey ( optional )
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine all ingredients. Seal and refrigerate. Use in all types of fresh seafood. Use in fish dishes.

Random Ingredients: artichoke heart,white sesame seed,white cheddar cheese,ranch dressing,herb
title: Artichoke Dip With Sun-Dried Dried Herbs
ingredients: 4 ounces white cheddar cheese, shredded | 2 ounces marinated artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | 1/2 teaspoon dried mixed herbs | 2 tablespoons roasted white sesame seeds, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon herbed dijon-style salad dressing
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients in a bowl until well blended. Add the sesame seeds and herbed dressing and stir until thoroughly combined. Store in a tightly covered container in the refrigerator.

title: Poblano Macaroni
ingredients: 1/2 lb macaroni | 1 poblano pepper | 1/2 cup olive oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried orange peel
instructions: Clean and cut poblano pepper into 1/4 inch dice. Place olive oil in pan with poblano pepper. Lightly dust with salt. Boil the macaroni with salt and pepper. Drain and toss in the macaroni. Turn off the burner and toss in the orange peel.

Random Ingredients: dark chocolate,anise seed,large shrimp,vegetable stock,black cardamom pod,single cream,cashew,blueberry
title: Chocolate-Spice Shrimp With Blueberry and Cashew Sau
ingredients: 300 g large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1/2 cup cashews, chopped | 1 teaspoon lightly crushed anise seed | 2 tablespoons light vegetable stock | 1 teaspoon black cardamom pods, lightly crushed | 1/2 cup double cream | 1 cup fresh blueberries, halved | 5 teaspoons dark chocolate, broken into chunks
instructions: Heat a shallow frypan over medium high heat. Add shrimp to pan. Cook, stirring frequently, for 1 1/2 mins until shrimp is just pink. Transfer to plate. Add cashews and anise seeds. Drizzle stock over. Sprinkle over with crushed cardamom pods. Cover and set aside for 3 mins to marinate. Bring cream to a boil in medium saucepan. Remove from heat. Stir in blueberries. Serve sauce with prawns and raw green vegetables.

title: Easy Chicken and Veggie Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup vegetable oil or 1/4 cup olive oil | 1/4 cup pesto sauce ( i like pesto ) | 1/2 lb fresh vegetable, halved ( broccoli, cauliflower, peas or zucchini )
instructions: Prepare the veggie stir fry pan or wok, heat oil over medium heat. Stir fry vegetables until soft, about 5 minutes. Add pesto stir fry sauce.

title: Scandinavian Baked Arugula

title: Chipotle and Tomato Jam

instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Transfer tomatillos to medium saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes. Drain and coarsely chop. title: Salmon En Bleu Ala Jeanette
ingredients: 200 g pineapple chunks ( fresh ) | 200 g tomatoes and basil pasta sauce | 50 g soy sauce | 50 g pumpkin or 50 g tomato puree | 50 g icing sugar | 80 ml grape juice or 80 ml pineapple cream | 1 -2 tablespoon capers ( optional ) | 80 g gruyere cheese, grated

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,bing cherry,goat cheese,baking powder,spanish onion

Note, for a thicker dish, using a little milk instead of cream can be difficult to get the right consistency.

title: Porcini Mushroom and Vanilla Wrap
ingredients: 250 g porcini mushrooms | 4 english cucumbers | 10 g liquid smoke | 1 vanilla bean | 4 large tortillas | 10 g speculaioso capers ( aka mozzarella cheese )
instructions: Wash and cut your mushrooms into pieces. Take a medium bowl, mix in the liquid smoke, and add 1 vanilla bean. Place a piece of plastic wrap on top so that the wrap is completely covered. Set aside. Remove parchment from foil and cut in half. Place one half of everything down on the outside of the wrap. Place other wrap on top to completely wrap the wrap. Take another piece of plastic wrap and carefully pat the wrap to soften the wrap. Then flip the wrap back up and wrap completely again. Set aside and let rest for several hours or longer. Toast your tortillas, then slice on the diagonal into two slices if preferred. Serve with a little speculaioso caprese on the side, and a drizzle of your favorite dark brown drink or coffee sauce.

title: Chicken Breasts With Brie Apples
ingredients: 4 apples, peeled, cored and cut into wedges | 3 thick bone-in chicken breast halves | 2 tablespoons dijon english mustard | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh dill | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh dill | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh tomatoes | 8 ounces brie cheese ( or more, depending on desired thickness of cheese )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Toss apples with mustard, dill and tomatoes in a large bowl. Place chicken on a large baking sheet lined with aluminum foil. Spoon about 1 tablespoon apple mixture over the top of each chicken breast and spread evenly. Place cheese slices over the top of each chicken breast and bake for 30 to 35 minutes, or until chicken is no longer pink and juices run clear.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno pepper,wine vinegar,jiffy cornbread mix,sherry wine,bulk italian sausage
title: Sausage Loaf
ingredients: 1 lb bulk italian sausage | 1 package jiffy cornbread mix | 1 1/2 cups sherry wine | 1 1/2 cups sweet wine vinegar | 1 sweet jalapeno pepper, seeded and minced
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees. In bowl, mix sausage, mix cornbread mix, wine vinegar, chili, and pepper. Mix well, pat mixture into 2 13x9x2 inch greased loaf pans. Bake 45 - 50 minutes, or until no longer pink in center. Cool 10 minutes. Use serrated knife to cut into 1 inch slices.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,corn kernel,greek yogurt,black tea,kalamata olive,cognac,marinara sauce
title: Cumin-Stuffed Olive Parsley Leaves
ingredients: 1 jar marinara sauce | 1/4 cup greek yogurt | 1/4 cup cognac | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 box frozen corn kernels | 10 black olives | 1/4 cup chopped kalamata olives
instructions: Heat the marinara sauce on lowest heat in microwave until warm but not hot. In a medium bowl, whisk together yogurt, cognac, cumin and vinegar. If using fresh corn, defrost corn kernels and slice black olives vertically so they will remain a bit frozen when cooking. Add to yogurt mixture, stir to coat. Chill before using. Preheat oven to 350°f. Place a couple of damp paper towels in a medium bowl, place a handful of the reserved marinara sauce in the center, and roll each olive leaf, placing it in a 9 x 13 inches baking dish. Pour olive/tomato mixture into dish and spread evenly. Drizzle reserved sauce over the entire package, place in preheated oven, bake, uncovered, for 50 - 60 minutes, or until bubbly. Serve at once with some warmed pita bread for dipping and with warm pita chips for dipping and with warmed pieces of bread for dipping. To prepare pita chips, slice olives in half and use a toothpick to cut 2 or 3 crosswise pita breads into 12 wedges.

Random Ingredients: no salt tomato sauce,allspice,ghee,green food coloring,ginger paste,water chestnut,red chile,black bean
title: Baked Black Bean Chunks
ingredients: 3/4 cup no-salt-added tomato sauce | 1 tablespoon ginger paste | 1/2 teaspoon ground black bean | 1/2 teaspoon dried red chile | green food coloring | 3/4 teaspoon allspice | 2 teaspoons ghee or 2 teaspoons butter | 1/2 cup water chestnuts, sliced thinly
instructions: Preheat oven to 350â°f line an 8” x 5” baking dish with aluminum foil. Combine all of the ingredients except the food coloring, in a mixing bowl and stir till the sugar has dissolved. Spread the mixture onto the baking dish with a spatula. Bake in a preheated oven for about 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, or till mixture is lightly browned and mixture has thickened. Remove from oven and immediately brush with the ghee. Sprinkle with the water chestnuts. Return to oven, and bake another 5 minutes until desired color has been achieved.

title: Apricot & Apricot Appetizers
ingredients: 150 g apricots | 100 g cannellini beans ( with brine )
instructions: Cook the cannellini beans for five minutes on high heat. Cut apricots and cannellini beans into slices approximately 5 cm thick. Place in food processor with apricots & cannellini beans. Process until smooth. Alternatively, place mixture in container tightly covered with plastic wrap & refrigerate overnight. Remove plastic wrap, reheat gently and serve.

title: Gluten Free Irishman Wedges
ingredients: 3/4 cup cornmeal | 1 cup pear or 1 cup peach pickle, chopped | 1 cup red potatoes, peeled | 1 cup frozen peas | 2 tablespoons honey | 1 tablespoon olive or 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 190°c. Place the cornmeal, pears, chilli and potatoes in a mixing bowl. Add the honey and olive or balsamic vinegar and mix well. Roll into 4 walnut sized wedges. Place on a tray, bake 15 mins until crisp/brownish and serve immediately.

title: Praline Molasses Crumbs (Biscuits for Pyroshky)
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups graham cracker crumbs or 1 1/4 cups graham cracker crumbs | 3 tablespoons molasses | 5 beef bouillon cubes ( or equivalent ) | 1 tablespoon molasses ( optional- for a little kick ) or 1 tablespoon butter ( optional- for a little kick )
instructions: Mix graham cracker crumbs and molasses together. Dissolve bouillon cubes in a little water. Dip crumb mix into molasses mixture slowly while stirring. Place in a bowl and add some extra water if necessary to blend. Let sit for 5 - 10 minutes before serving. If using for gravy use a small amount of butter if desired.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,candy sprinkle,artichoke heart,vegetable shortening,celery rib,vanilla essence
title: Artichoke Hearts With Vanilla Candies
ingredients: 1 box artichoke hearts | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 2 tablespoons vegetable shortening or 2 tablespoons canola oil | 2 celery ribs, diced small | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 3/4 cup candy sprinkles ( optional )
instructions: Heat small nonstick skillet over medium heat and add 1/2 cup of olive oil. Cook artichoke hearts for several minutes, turning often with tongs. Drain artichoke hearts and cool to room temperature. Cut hearts into 1 inch pieces. Place into a bowl, add salt and freshly ground pepper and toss to coat hearts in oil. Add celery and cook over medium heat for 2 - 3 minutes. Add the remaining olive oil and cook for 3 - 4 minutes until crisp tender. Toss with the vanilla essence. Serve warm, or slightly warm. Optional, when preparing the icing, stir hot icing on the warm artichoke hearts and sprinkle with a few tablespoons of the icing. Note, if using candy sprinkles, roll around in the icing to soften. If making for st. Joseph saumon, drizzle with 1 teaspoon warm rum to lighten the rum if desired.

Random Ingredients: great northern bean,graham cracker crumb,self rising flour,kidney bean,avocado,ziti pasta,yellow pepper,rhubarb
title: Citrus Ziti
ingredients: 3 cups uncooked jonie frozen rhubarb | 1 can great northern beans, rinsed and drained | 1/2 cup sliced yellow peppers | 3/4 cup self-rising flour | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1 1/2 cups rinsed and drained canned kidney beans | 1 small ziti pasta | 1 large avocado - peeled and cubed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Coat a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook rhubarb in the boiling water, stirring frequently, until cooked but tender, 3 to 8 minutes. Drain, retaining 1 cup of rhubarb liquid. Drain white beans and cut into bite sized pieces. Heat 2 tablespoons cooking oil in a skillet over medium high heat.

title: Grilled Bananas
ingredients: 2 bananas, ripe but firm | 1/2 celery rib, leaves coarsely chopped
instructions: Slice bananas diagonally 1/4 1/4 inch thick. Arrange 1/4 cup onion in a 12x10 inch piece microwave safe or other glass dish. Sprinkle celery leaves evenly over top.

Random Ingredients: coriander,cornstarch,herb,chili pepper,black bean sauce,cayenne pepper,chicken breast
title: Simple Chilli Beef
ingredients: 12 ounces boneless beef, thinly sliced | 1 red chili peppers or 1 green chili pepper, deseeded and sliced | 1 tablespoon coriander, roughly chopped | 1 tablespoon herbs, roughly chopped | 1 tablespoon black bean sauce | 1 teaspoon sweet chili pepper, deseeded and sliced | 1 teaspoon cornstarch | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: In a wok, stir fry the meat in a little water for about 2 minutes or until golden brown. Stir in the chilli, herbs, and black bean sauce and simmer for 3 - 4 minutes, or until the meat is cooked. Stir in the cornstarch and cook until the mixture has thickened. Serve with the steamed rice and vegetables.

title: Grapes
ingredients: 2 pounds grapes, seedless | 1/2 cup butter
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Rinse grapes under running water, then drain once. Rub skins off grapes with butter. Arrange on shallow baking dish or platter. Sprinkle grapes with parsley. Bake in preheated oven until skins are beginning to blacken and tops spring back when lightly pressed, 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Simple Chili Oil
ingredients: 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1/2 teaspoon chili flakes ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1/8 teaspoon chili powder
instructions: Heat oil over medium heat. Add chili flakes, worcestershire sauce and chili powder. Keep cooking for 20 - 30 seconds. You should smell the oil, and the chili will start to smell. Pour into a small pitcher. Leave to cool then pour into a bottle. You may have an extra batch of chili oil stored in the refrigerator now. You can put it in bottles and refrigerate for up to 2 - 3 days.

Random Ingredients: serrano chilies,scotch whisky,salt pepper,white hominy,pea,shallot,monterey jack cheese,sun tomato oil
title: Chile Verde
ingredients: 2 lbs white hominy, rinsed | 1 1/2 cups frozen peas | 1 teaspoon salt | 12 -16 ounces of diced sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, undrained | 2 - 2 1/2 cups diced serrano chilies, drained | salt and pepper | shredded monterey jack cheese | scotch whisky
instructions: Combine the rinsed hominy, frozen peas, salt and chiles in a saucepan, add water just to cover them. Bring to a boil, lower the heat and simmer slowly until the vegetables are tender. Adjust the seasonings if necessary. Meanwhile, drain the contents of the pan into a measuring cup and set aside. When the vegetables are cool enough to handle, remove the skins and discard, set aside and use as desired. To serve, pour the contents of the pan into a heated soup pot and add the reserved sun dried tomatoes. Add enough water to cover the contents of the pan. Cover and simmer slowly, stirring occasionally as the stew reduces. The finished stew will be thinner than the packaged versions so you may need to add a little more water to thin it. Garnish with shredded cheese and chopped sun dried tomatoes.

title: Chinese Style Mock Beef Rollups
ingredients: 1 package dry yeast | 1/4 lb veal, chopped 1/4-inch cubes ( or ground beef for flavor ) | 1/4 lb ground veal ( or ground beef for flavor, or ground beef for flavor, or ground pork for flavor ) | oyster sauce | brandy ( you 'll need 2-3 tablespoons ) | 8 -10 leaves fresh lemon grass, cleaned, washed, and finely chopped ( or as needed ) | 1 bag fresh bean sprouts
instructions: Preheat oven to 300f degrees. Combine beef and veal with the yeast. Form small balls of meat and place on a lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake for 15 minutes in the preheated oven. Place sprouts in a food processor and grind to fine bits. Add the garlic, oyster sauce, and brandy. Process to the correct consistency. Roll the meat out to 3/4 inch thickness and cut each roll into 3/4 inch squares. Place on a warm tray and bake for 15 minutes or until they have slightly browned. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack pepper cheese,white wine,eggplant,caster sugar
title: Fiery Eggplant Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 large eggplant, medium size | 100 g monterey jack pepper cheese, grated | 2 teaspoons caster sugar | 2 teaspoons white wine
instructions: Pre heat the oven to 190c or 160c if using a fan forced oven. Place the eggplant in a microwave proof bowl and cook on full power for 3 - 4 minutes or until tender. Drain and allow to cool so the skin can be removed. Remove the flesh from the skin and leave until completely cooled off. Peel the skin off the eggplant and slice the flesh into rounds about 1cm thick, and place into a large bowl. Sprinkle over the cheese and sprinkle in the sugar. Add in the wine and mix until well mixed. Line a non stick or greased tray with baking paper. Place the eggplant pieces flat side down in the paper cases, brush with oil and bake at 220c for 15 minutes. Serve with crusty bread.

title: Chilean Pork and Rice Casserole
ingredients: 300 g minced pork shoulder | 2 tablespoons olive or 2 tablespoons corn oil | 1 cup arborio rice | 1 cup half-and-half | 1 tablespoon sweet herbs ( like sage, bay leaf, parsley and thyme, but i've seen others used ) | 1/2 a lime, juice of | cornmeal
instructions: Preheat oven to 170°c or 180°c. Brown pork in olive oil or corn oil.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms (Hibachi Style)
ingredients: 1 jar chopped fresh chile peppers | 20 ounces fresh mini fresh strawberries | 20 ounces bean sprouts | 4 ounces shredded mozzarella cheese | 1/2 cup tahini | 1/2 cup chopped fresh herb, such as parsley, chives ( optional ) | 1/2 cup crushed fresh strawberries | 1/4 cup hot teriyaki sauce
instructions: Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add sliced chile peppers, and fry, stirring, until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Remove from heat, and finely chop the chili peppers. Arrange the chopped peppers and sliced strawberries in a large bowl, and stir in shredded cheese. Stir in tahini, herb, and crushed unpeeled unpeeled unpeeled unpeeled unpeeled unpeeled unpeeled unpeeled unblanched ripe fresh strawberries. Place plastic wrap between the plastic wrap, and place in a large microwave safe bowl. Microwave on high power until the cheese is melted. Remove plastic wrap, remove plastic wrap, and stir in chile pepper mixture. Allow vegetables to cool for 20 minutes. Place the unpeeled unpeeled unpeeled unpeeled unpeeled unpeeled unpeeled unpeeled unblanched ripe fresh strawberry in a resealable plastic bag, and marinate in the refrigerator for 2 hours. Stir filling after filling with strawberries into the vegetables. Serve in chilled bowls, as desired. To store, wrap reserved filling in plastic wrap and place in freezer for at least one month. To serve, remove filling from freezer one at a time and stir well in the hot teriyaki sauce.

title: Crock Pot Beef Brisket-Thin
ingredients: 2 lbs beef brisket, fat and visible fat removed | 1 pint bouillon, made according to package directions ( for crock pot ) | 0.5 package phyllo pastry sheets ( i have found that one or two sheets are perfect to brush over each other ) | 2 jalapeno peppers, sliced ( optional ) | 2 -3 cucumbers, halved lengthwise ( optional )
instructions: Trim the brisket of all visible fat. Place beef brisket in a slow cooker. Add enough water to the beef to cover. Cook beef on low setting 7 hours. Remove beef and slice against the grain as thin as possible, shredding with two forks. Add bouillon to beef liquid. Bake at 200°c for at least one hour, depending on how tender you like your beef. Let cool 5 - 10 minutes, then remove beef from broth and place in a freezer bag and allow to cool for at least 20 minutes. Heat oven to 350°f. Trim excess fat and thaw phyllo sheets if flat. Dry the phyllo pastry sheets with a paper towel and brush lightly. Lay the phyllo sheets on a baking sheet, lightly brush with some of the beef bullion, then place on the baking sheet. Place 1/2 inch of beef slices around the edge of the phyllo sheets, then top with a slice of cucumber. Repeat for the other two sheets, then brush with remaining beef bullion. Bake for approx 40 minutes or until the brisket is hot and the cheese is crisp.

title: Mushroom Soup With French Bread
ingredients: 5 cups vegetable stock ( vegetable or chicken ) | 1 french baguette | 1/2 lb button mushroom
instructions: Soak the baguette slices in boiling water for 10 minutes, then cut off the ends. Slice off the crust of the baguette slices and set aside. In a large pot, add the stock, bring slowly to a boil. Cut the mushrooms into small bits, add to the soup, and simmer for 20 - 25 minutes. Drain the bread and discard the broth, chop the bread finely, and return to the soup. Stir well to blend the soup, serve hot, and enjoy.

title: Spiced Hot Pepper Soup
ingredients: 10 large dried prunes, with stems | 1/4 teaspoon ground ginger | 3 lbs beef bouillon cubes | 1/8 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace | 3 hot peppers, seeded and chopped ( scotch pickles )
instructions: To clean hot peppers, remove seeds, stem ends & core. Remove seeds, but do not remove black membrane. Place peppers in boiling water for 3 minutes to soften. Drain, rinse & drain again. Remove stems, seeds and veins if desired. Set aside. Place prunes in a dutch oven or 2 - 4 quart stock pot. Place beef bouillon cubes in pot & add water to cover by 1 inch. Simmer on low heat for 3 hours. If desired, remove cover and simmer on high another hour to soften prunes & to thicken liquid. Remove prunes with a slotted spoon and transfer to serving bowl. Add cinnamon, mace & pepper to broth. Serve hot with plenty of freshly crushed rye bread & crackers.

title: Strawberry Mousse
ingredients: 1 pint strawberry jam | 1 pint blueberries ( fresh or frozen )
instructions: Combine jam and berries. Pour into a buttered glass or ceramic bowl. Cover and chill in the refrigerator for 4 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: gruyere cheese,swiss cheese,tahini,maraschino cherry,celery rib,pineapple juice,golden raisin,red wine
title: Tahini Nests
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tahini | 1/4 cup golden raisin | 1/4 cup pineapple juice | 1/4 cup pineapple juice | 1/2 cup shredded swiss cheese | 1 cup shredded gruyere cheese ( you can use edam or gruyere ) or 1 cup gouda cheese, grated ( you can use edam or gruyere ) | 4 pieces celery ribs ( optional ) | 1 maraschino cherry ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Put tahini, raisins, and pineapple juice in a food processor. Pulse several times to get all the raisins and raisins into the food processor. Add swiss cheese and gruyere cheese and pulse just till it is well blended. Stir in the celery and cherry. Divide filling among 4 nests. Bake for 30 - 35 minutes, until hot. Allow to cool.

Random Ingredients: creme fraiche,peach,za'atar spice mix,tuna,cotija cheese,ginger juice,mace
title: Dynamite
ingredients: 2 cans tuna or ( 6 ounce ) cans white tuna, drained | 3 tablespoons fresh grated cotija cheese or 3 tablespoons other light cheese | 3 tablespoons fresh ginger juice | 1 -2 tablespoon creme fraiche | 1/4 teaspoon ground mole | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 1/8 teaspoon za'atar spice mix
instructions: Drain tuna as much as possible of its liquid, and then combine well with other ingredients, stir and serve.

Random Ingredients: baking soda,snow pea,thyme leaf,currant,rotini pasta,coconut oil,ginger root,herb
title: Rainbow Mac
ingredients: 10 ounces uncooked tri-colored spiral pasta | 2 tablespoons coconut oil | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh thyme leaves | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh herb or dried basil leaves | 1 1/2 teaspoons chopped fresh ginger root | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 2 cups dried currants | 1 can snow peas, drained
instructions: Cook pasta to desired doneness as directed on package. Drain. While pasta is cooking, heat 2 tablespoons coconut oil or cooking spray in a large skillet over medium high heat. Add thyme, basil, ginger, and baking soda and stir well. Cook, stirring often until fragrant, about 1 minute. Add carrots and peas. Stir fry until hot, about 3 minutes. Pour pasta into hot skillet, sprinkle with coconut oil, and toss to coat. Serve warm or cold.

title: Artichoke & Ham Dip
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1/2 lb cooked ham, chopped | 2 cans refried beans | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained & sliced | 1/4 teaspoon onion flakes
instructions: In crockpot, combine soup, ham, beans, artichokes, & onion flakes. Mix well and stir until combined. Cover& cook on low heat setting for 9 - 10 hours or until heated through.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,breadcrumb,raisin,sake,white bread flour,barbecue sauce,bamboo skewer
title: Baked Raisin BBQ Chicken
ingredients: 1 cup raisins | 2 tablespoons white bread flour | 2 tablespoons barbecue sauce | 1/8 cup finely diced ripe banana or 1/8 cup chopped cooked chicken | 1/8 teaspoon dry crushed quebrusco or 1/8 teaspoon caribbean jerk seasoning | 1/2 cup fresh breadcrumbs | 8 bamboo skewers
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees fahrenheit. Put raisins in a bowl and cover with hot tap water. Let stand 20 minutes or until just softened. Drain and shake dry. Combine flour, bread crumbs, raisins and seasoning in a small bowl. Dredge chicken pieces in flour, shaking off any excess. Dip chicken pieces in crumb mixture and arrange in a shallow baking dish or a 9x9x2 baking dish. Pour marinade over and cover tightly. Bake 15 minutes. Uncover chicken and bake 30 minutes or until done. Serve on top of mashed or rice, or serve over steamed rice. Note, if basting chicken with the sauce, cover the dish or pan with aluminum foil so it doesn't burn. Cook time does not include the time for soaking the raisins.

Random Ingredients: seasoning salt,methi seed,grand marnier,dill weed,pecan,white onion
title: Tartar Sauce
