ingredients: 1 cup white onion, chopped | 1 cup pecans or 1 cup walnuts, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon dried dill weed | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1/2 teaspoon maitom seeds | 1/2 cup grand marnier
instructions: Saute over medium low heat. Cool. Blend all ingrediuntly.

title: Persian Spiced Beef and Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground beef | cooking apple | 1/2 cup basmati rice, rinsed | 1 cucumber | 2 limes, wedges
instructions: Place beef, apple, rice, cucumber, and juice of lime in a bowl. Toss well and serve.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon granule,squash,ear corn cob,kahlua,cheddar cheese
title: Beef and Squash
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground beef | 2 large ears corn on the cob, husks and silk removed | 1 1/2 cups kahlua | 1/2 cup beef bouillon granules | 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese
instructions: In a large nonstick skillet, cook beef and add garlic over medium heat until browned. Add 1/2 cup of the kahlua and simmer for 10 minutes. Remove beef mixture and set aside. Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Place corn on a baking sheet, and roast for 10 minutes. Remove the corn from the oven and cut off the roots and discard. Cut the corn off each cob. Boil the beef mixture with 1/2 cup kahlua until the beef is fully cooked and the sauce has thickened. To serve, arrange the cooked corn on a plate. Spoon the beef mixture over the corn. Sprinkle cheese over the top and serve warm.

title: Homemade French Bread
ingredients: 6 chicken legs, rinsed well and dried | 6 garlic cloves, cut in halves | 2/3 cup extra virgin olive oil | 3 teaspoons mustard | 1 whole clove
instructions: Place chicken legs and garlic in a large pot with plenty of cold water, and bring it to a boil over high heat. Skim off any foam that rises to the surface, and boil for 15 minutes. Drain, and set aside. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Heat the olive oil in a cast iron skillet. Test a piece of chicken by throwing it in with a knife or chopsticks and add it to the oil with the mustard. Turn the heat down to a low simmer, and cook for 45 minutes. Turn the pieces again so they're nicely browned on all sides, and cook until chicken juices run clear. Remove from the oven, and cover with aluminum foil. Check the chicken occasionally.

Random Ingredients: rose water,madeira wine,wheat noodle,graham cracker,peppadew pepper,chili seasoning mix
title: Creamy Madeira Pepper and Pepper Noodles
ingredients: 2 packages fresh whole wheat noodles | 1 cup sweet peppadew peppers or 1 cup jalapeno pepper | 1 envelope mrs. spicy chili seasoning mix | 1 tablespoon rose water | 2 tablespoons madeira wine | 24 graham crackers
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place noodles in 9x13 inch roasting pan. Dice the peppers in half and add to noodles. Mix well. Stir in seasoning. Add rosewater, madeira and pepper. Cover with foil and bake for 50 minutes. Remove foil and turn noodles over. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes or until noodles are tender. Remove from oven and sprinkle top with crackers.

title: Lobster Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 dozen fresh lobster | 1 can rotel | 1 package monterey jack and cheddar cheese blend
instructions: Combine lobster, rotel, and cheese in 3 quart pot. Cook over high heat until cheese is melted. Drain and discard shellfish. Fry until thoroughly heated.

title: Homemade Taco Seasoning
ingredients: 4 teaspoons bacon grease, or as needed | 2 teaspoons dried oregano leaves | 1 teaspoon hot sauce, or to taste
instructions: Mix bacon grease, oregano, hot sauce, and cayenne pepper together in a bowl.

title: Beef Burgers
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lean ground beef | 2 ounces mixed nuts, crushed ( walnuts or pecans are nice ) | 2 large pears, peeled, cored and finely chopped
instructions: Mix the ground beef with any seasonings and shape into 3 to 4 burgers, depending on the size of the burgers. Place the burger flat on a shallow baking tray and brush with little oil. Bake in a moderate oven for 15 - 20 minutes for medium or 5 minutes for well done, turning once or twice. For thick burgers, remove from the oven and brush with lots of cold water. To serve, lay the burger on a heated serving plate and spoon over the remaining sauce.

Random Ingredients: baking powder,bacon dripping,orange liqueur,bread,cheddar cheese soup,cilantro,egg
title: Bacon, Cheddar and Orange Liqueur Toasties
ingredients: 2 slices fresh bread, toasted | 1 can cheddar cheese soup | 2 tablespoons orange flavored liqueur | 3 tablespoons bacon drippings or 3 tablespoons butter | 3 eggs, beaten | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 1 tablespoon minced cilantro
instructions: Mix together soups, bacon fat, eggs, baking powder, cilantro, and orange juice. Spread mixture over toasted bread. Top with cheese soup. If desired, sprinkle with orange juice and serve with sliced french rolls, if desired.

Random Ingredients: red potato,orzo,baby carrot,red chili pepper,pinto bean
title: Peruvian Orzo
ingredients: 1 package dried pinto beans, soaked | 1 lb small red potato ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 1 lb baby carrots | 4 dried red chili peppers | 1 jar of rinsed orzo
instructions: Cook orzo 5 minutes. Meanwhile, wash and peel the potatoes, add them to the water with the chilis and the beans, and simmer until the potatoes soften, 15 to 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,dark soy sauce,brussels sprout,cherry,panang curry paste
title: Vegetable Curry
ingredients: 1 small carrot | 2 teaspoons dark soy sauce | 2 teaspoons panang curry paste | 500 g brussels sprouts | 200 g halved button mushrooms
instructions: Peel carrot and slash along both base and halfways into long 2cm slice. Cut sprouts in half diagonally into 3cm lengths, and cut diagonally into batons. Place in microwave safe bowl, sprinkle over the dark soy sauce, cover with clingfilm and microwave on full power for 3 minutes. Set aside for five minutes then stir. Meanwhile mix curry paste and hot water in a small frying pan and cook over medium heat for five minutes or until very warm. Stirring constantly, add carrots, stir until mixed. Return to microwave, cover and cook on full power for 2 - 3 minutes until slightly tender. Add sprouts and mushrooms, stir to combine and continue cooking for 1 minute or until mushrooms are tender but still holding their shape. Transfer to serving bowl. Serve immediately, with rice.

title: Easy Salsa Beef
ingredients: 1/2 cup salsa | 4 teaspoons cornflour | 1 lb chuck roast, cut into serving sized pieces | crushed ice | 1 teaspoon fresh tarragon or 1 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1 slice white bread, crust left on, cut into cubes
instructions: Mix together salsa, cornflour, and beef in a bowl. Toss with crushed ice, and toss again. Plate the meat mixture, spoon onto bread, sprinkle with dried tarragon, and serve at once.

title: Arroz Con Rice (A Mexican Rice Pudding)
ingredients: 2 cups long grain white rice ( soaked overnight in water ) | 1 cup mixed vegetables, chopped | 3/4 cup half-and-half | 2 tablespoons fresh rosemary leaves, finely chopped | 2 pimentos, chopped
instructions: In the morning, put a kettle on to boil and add all of the ingredients. Cover and cook over low heat, stirring occasionally until all of the liquid is absorbed, 30 - 45 minutes. Uncover and fluff up the rice with a fork. Remove the kettle from the stove and serve hot with sour cream if desired.

title: Quick and Easy Spinach Kale
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh spinach leaves | 1 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Wash and wash the spinach leaves. Place the washed and chopped spinach in a pot and cover with cold water. Bring to a boil. Cover and cook on medium heat for 20 to 25 minutes. Do not overcook the spinach. Drain. Heat a non stick wok. Add a teaspoon of the garam masala and swirl to coat the wok. Add spinach leaves and stir well. Add the remaining 1/2 tsp garam masala. Stir again. Cook on medium heat for 6 to 8 minutes. Add 1 1/2 teaspoons of the cooked garam masala. Stir, mixing with the spinach. Fold in the drained spinach. Serve hot.

title: Tarten's Wild Berry Soup
ingredients: 10 -12 berries | 2 cups chicken stock | 1/2 cup ginger paste | 1 tablespoon ale | lemon peel
instructions: Cut the berries into small chunks and pour them into a food processor.

Random Ingredients: mango,green pepper,garam masala,red chili powder,mango chutney,banana
title: Bombay Mango Chutney
ingredients: 2 teaspoons mango chutney ( can be found at most indian grocers ) | 3 mango, cut in slices | 3 green peppers, cut in slices | 3 bananas, sliced | 1/2 teaspoon red chili powder ( can go up to 1/2 tsp ) | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Heat the mango chutney in a frying pan and keep stirring so that the chutney reduces and gets dark spots in the chutney. As soon as the chutney turns dark almost all the way, mix in the bananas. The bananas should become soft and slightly crisp. Add chilli powder, garam masala and paprika. Remove from heat and serve immediately.

title: Pear Bread
ingredients: 1/2 cup ripe pears or 1/2 cup pear, grated | 2 tablespoons orange zest | 1 tablespoon baking soda
instructions: Process all ingredients in blender to form a smooth, thick bread. Bake, about 40 minutes in a 350 f. Oven.

Random Ingredients: feta cheese,orange section,chambord raspberry liquor,mustard,pork,green chili pepper,lasagna noodle
title: Easy Lamb-Feta Lasagne
ingredients: 12 lasagna noodles ( or just plain uncooked noodles ) | 1 -2 lb lean ground beef or 1 -2 lb turkey | 1 -2 tablespoon chambord raspberry liquor | 6 ounces feta cheese | 1/4 - 1/2 cup green chili pepper | 1/2 teaspoon mustard | 1 tablespoon prepared mustard | 1 tablespoon orange section ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees, then spray a 9x13 pan with olive oil cooking spray. In a large skillet brown ground beef. Drain, and set aside. Add chambord to skillet, heat briefly. Drain most of the grease out of the skillet. Add the cream in small increments over low heat until thickened. Add the cheese, garlic and pepper, stir until combined. Stir through mustard and orange section, if using. Spread meat mixture into pan. Bake 40 - 45 minutes until bubbly and cooked through.

title: Raspberry Ginger Beer Salad
ingredients: 1 1/3 cups raspberry vinegar | 1 1/3 cups white pepper | 2 1/3 cups brown sugar | 1 1/3 cups rice vinegar | 1 3/4 cups chopped shallots or 1 1/4 cups onions | 1 1/4 cups chopped celery ribs | 1 1/4 cups grated gingerroot | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried savory | 1/2 cup sweet pickled ginger root ( to garnish )
instructions: Bring the raspberry vinegar to a boil over moderate heat in a medium saucepan. Boil until reduced to 1/4 cup, about 15 minutes. Meanwhile, combine the brown sugar, rice vinegar, shallots, celery, gingerroot and savory in a blender. Process until smooth. Pour the glaze into the vinegar mixture and bring to a simmer, whisking constantly to temper the sugar crystals. Serve at room temperature. Note, the glaze will keep, covered and chilled, for 5 days or overnight. Shake before serving. If storing, allow to cool, then cover and refrigerate. The dressing may be stored in the refrigerator for 3 days.

title: Homemade Vinegar
ingredients: 2 quarts cider vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon paprika
instructions: Bring the vinegar to a boil in a stainless steel bowl with some water coming off the vinegar. Stir in the paprika. Cover and leave in a cool place for at least two weeks before using.

title: Crock Pot Vodka Pork
ingredients: 2 1/2 - 3 lbs pork, cut up | 2 tablespoons smoked spanish paprika or 2 tablespoons smoked paprika | 1 jar pepperoncini peppers | fresh cilantro ( to taste )
instructions: Place all ingredients in crock pot. Cook 8-10 hours on high or 4 - 5 on low. You can substitute one type of sausage for 1/2 of pork and add a can of chopped tomatoes, too. If cooking for 2 the night. You may have to turn every so often depending on season used and the size of chicken breasts/moats etc.

title: Sauerkraut and Parsnips
ingredients: 1 lb sauerkraut or 1 lb kale | 3 small parsnips, peeled and thinly sliced | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1 lime wedge | 3 tablespoons capers
instructions: Separate the leaves from stems, and cut in half. Rinse well. If using fresh greens, cut into 1 1/2 inch pieces and trim the root end. Cut the greens into 2 inch lengths and set aside. Place the sauerkraut and parsnips in a large pot, pour in enough cold water to cover the greens by about 2 inches. Bring to a boil, then simmer for 20 to 30 minutes, until tender. Drain well and set aside. Heat the cumin seeds in a small skillet over moderate heat for about 1 minute, or until they start to sputter. Add the cumin and cook for a minute, then grind in the cayenne pepper and fresh lime juice. Stir in the capers, adjust seasonings, and serve.

Random Ingredients: lemon,kidney bean,caster sugar,blueberry,beef stew meat,beef cube
title: Beef and Blueberry Stew
ingredients: 350 g beef stew meat | 2 tablespoons caster sugar | 1 tablespoon lemon rind | 1 can kidney beans | 200 g frozen blueberries | 1 can diced beef and beans
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together in a large ovenproof fry pan. Cover and bake for 1 hour. Serve stew with couscous and/or vegetables.

title: Spicy Roasted Artichoke Stir Fry
ingredients: 0.5 jar marinated artichoke hearts | 1 package jicama | 2 -3 cups corn oil | 5 ounces green mushrooms | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon
instructions: Preheat grill or grill pan to medium heat for medium high heat. Rinse artichokes and pat dry with paper towel, then cut into thirds lengthwise. If using a mandolin remove excess fat from jicama. If using a knife slice jicama into strips about the size of the artichoke. Cut the jicama strips into a 1 inch long, then place all ingredients in a large bowl or other serving dish. Using the back of a spoon, add all ingredients, except green mushrooms, to artichoke mixture. Stir to coat all ingredients, then cover with saran wrap, and set aside for at least 30 minutes. Drain marinated artichokes, reserving marinade. Toss with reserved artichoke marinade in serving dish, then sprinkle with fresh herbs. Enjoy.

title: Homemade Pork Cutlets
ingredients: 4 pork cutlets, cut into serving size pieces ( pork legs, belly and thighs may be used ) | spices | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds
instructions: Place the mustard and spice mix in a bowl and season to taste. Toss together and store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: wheat tortilla,red grape,basil,maple syrup,double cream,hot water,green bean
title: Grape and Maple Pone
ingredients: 6 fresh round whole wheat tortillas, cut into quarters | 3 tablespoons pure maple syrup | 14 ounces mixed greens beans, trimmed and washed | 1 3/4 cups red seedless grapes, halved | 1 1/2 cups double cream | 3/4 cup hot water | basil, to garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 400ºf. Place 2 quarters of the tortilla quarters side by side in an 11x15 inch baking dish. Whisk together 2 tablespoons of the maple syrup and 2 tablespoons of cream until blended.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,molasses,nonstick cooking spray,english cucumber,orzo pasta
title: Polish Vegetables
ingredients: nonstick cooking spray | 8 ounces orzo pasta, broken into 1-inch pieces | 8 ounces button mushrooms, halved | 1 english cucumber, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 1/4 cup molasses
instructions: In a large saucepan of boiling salted water, stir the orzo until just tender, about 10 minutes. Drain and return to the pan.

title: Pumpkin Hot Dogs
ingredients: 4 hoagie rolls | 2 tablespoons pumpkin puree | 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1/2 teaspoon pepper | 4 drops hot pepper sauce
instructions: Split open each roll, and spread pumpkin puree inside. Heat one drop of hot sauce in a bowl, add hot pepper sauce as desired, and fill each roll sour with hot water. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: bread flour,linguine,vanilla pod,kosher salt,coconut extract,greek yogurt,daikon radish
title: Linguica (Kosher Raw Linguica)
ingredients: 4 lbs raw linguica, such as linguica | 2 tablespoons bread flour | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 1 teaspoon coconut extract | 1 vanilla pod, split and scraped | 1 1/2 lbs daikon radishes or 1 1/2 lbs other firm, pale bitter orange ends, scrubbed and sliced into 1-inch chunks | 1 cup greek yogurt, to serve
instructions: Put the pasta and water in a large saucepan and bring to a boil. Remove from heat, cover and let stand until completely cooled and just tender, about 11 minutes. Drain. Using 2 tablespoons of the reserved pasta cooking liquid, stir the bread flour and salt into a paste and transfer to a small bowl. Tiny chunks of the vanilla pod peel can be stirred into the paste until dissolved, then stir into the paste. Add the sliced radishes and 1/2 cup of yogurt to taste and stir to coat. Transfer cooked linguica to a large serving bowl and toss with the paste. Serve in shallow bowls.

Random Ingredients: pepper sauce,garlic salt,red enchilada sauce,panko breadcrumb,worcestershire sauce
title: Copycat Olive Garden Dip
ingredients: 1 can red enchilada sauce | 1 can red enchilada sauce | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon hot pepper sauce | 2 tablespoons panko breadcrumbs or 2 tablespoons dry breadcrumbs | 1/8 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 500°f. In a medium bowl combine first 4 ingredients. Stir with fork until well blended. Transfer to greased 9x9 pan. Sprinkle with breadcrumbs or crumbs of choice. Bake approximately 20 minutes.

title: Sauce for Chips (Dry Dipping Sauce)
ingredients: 1/2 cup vegetable shortening | 1/2 cup crushed corn flakes | 1/3 cup tomato sauce
instructions: Melt the shortening and corn flakes in a large saucepan over medium heat. Stir in the tomato sauce. Cook at a slow boil for about 5 minutes. Use a sieve to skim off and discard any residue on the pan bottom. The sauce can be kept warm over low heat in the refrigerator, or served warm. If you do not have the sieve, just sieve the corn flakes and return to the pan. If you wish to make the dipping in a saucepan, serve it the way you like.

Random Ingredients: cake flour,red chilies,spaghetti,black peppercorn,yellow bell pepper,spaghetti squash,coriander seed
title: Spaghetti Squash with Bell Pepper
ingredients: 500 g spaghetti or 500 g spaghetti squash | 200 g spaghetti squash | 1 red chilies, coarsely chopped | 1 medium yellow bell pepper, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon coriander seed | 1/2 tablespoon black peppercorns | 1 tablespoon cake flour
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees centigrade. Peel, deseed and dice the spaghetti squash. In a shallow roasting tin put all the remaining ingredients. Mix well. Place the spaghetti squash over the vegetables and pour over the marinade. Cover the tin with foil or a lid and cook in the preheated oven for 45 minutes. Remove the foil or lid, sprinkle with ground coriander, and return to the oven for a further 20 minutes or until the spaghetti squash is cooked.

title: Beef on Toast
ingredients: 3 lbs roast beef, cubed | 1/2 cup skim milk ( or water, if needed ) | 2 teaspoons ginger paste
instructions: Soak beef overnight in water, refrigerated. Drain, discarding water and place beef in a large saucepan. Add milk. Simmer on low for 1 1/2 hours or until tender. Remove meat and cut into cubes. Reheat and serve with boiled rice. Makes 2 servings.

title: French Canadian Egg Drop Soup
ingredients: 1 whole good egg, separated | 1 pinch cayenne ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon chopped sage leaf | 3 1/2 quarts chicken bouillon ( knorr is my favorite ) | 1/4 cup white wine or 1/4 cup water
instructions: Using a whisk or a fork, beat well the egg yolks with the cayenne, sage and bouillon. Beat in the wine and water until well incorporated. Do not beat. This will cause the mixture to clump together so use lots of water. Pour mixture into saucepan with egg whites. Stir continuously. Do not boil. Simmer over low heat about 7 minutes or until whites of the egg are set. Use a big spoon to remove excess egg or mixture. This soup may be served hot, warm or cold. I like it with a little lemon or lime flavored yogurt added at the table. The flavour is subtle, the more you fill it, the sweeter it gets. You may use less cayenne or other hot seasoning than the sage.

title: Beef Tongue
ingredients: 4 beef tongue | 4 pounds ground beef flank steak | 32 pounds whole wheat, or to taste
instructions: Place beef tongue into a large container of water.

title: Homemade Pasta Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup nonfat sour cream | 1/2 cup salad oil
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a mixing bowl. Sauce can be stored and used within 3 days.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,cream mushroom soup,milk ricotta cheese,snow pea,white wine vinegar,cardamom seed
title: Quick 'n Easy Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 lb dry spaghetti | snow peas, rinsed if necessary | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 3/4 cup milk ricotta cheese | 3 teaspoons white wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon chili pepper flakes ( such as cayenne ) | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom seeds
instructions: Cook the spaghetti according to package directions. While the spaghetti is cooking, place the peas in a pot and cover with water. Bring to a boil and immediately remove from heat. Cover and allow to steam until they are very tender. Drain, and set aside. Meanwhile, blend together the soup, ricotta cheese, vinegar, chili pepper flakes, and cardamom seeds by hand or in a food processor. Stir into the pasta along with any additional water that was simmering away. Cook the spaghetti until just tender, about 10 minutes in a pot of boiling water. Drain and place on a platter. Pour the cream sauce over. Sprinkle with the peas and serve.

Random Ingredients: topping,mayonnaise,euro bread,custard powder,white vinegar,fine sea salt
title: German-Style Bread Salad
ingredients: 1 cup mayonnaise | 1 cup prepared custard powder | 1/8 teaspoon fine sea salt | 1 tablespoon white vinegar | 1 loaf euro-style bread, crusts removed and cut into slices about 1/2 inch thick | prepared mayonnaise ( or sour cream if desired )
instructions: Whisk together mayonnaise, custard powder, salt and vinegar until smooth. Arrange bread in two single layer on a platter or dessert plate. Pour over mayonnaise mixture. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until thoroughly chilled, at least 2 hours and up to 3 days. Arrange bread on serving platter. If desired, spoon dollops of prepared mayonnaise over the tops of the bread.

title: Quick Chicken Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 20 -24 chicken wings, trimmed and left whole ( or equivalent amount of frozen, thawed chicken wings cut into thirds ) | 1 small chinese cabbage, thinly sliced ( i had never tried chinese cabbage, but have made sure its come wrapped in plastic foil ) | 2 cups half and half, well chilled ( or heavy cream ) | 1/3 cup confectioners'sugar
instructions: Mix all the ingredients except the cabbage in a bowl and place an even amount of chicken on a cabbage leaf. Fold the leaf in half. Place on a nonstick cookie sheet and freeze until ready to use. When frozen, take the cabbage out, remove the leaves, and lay flat on a clean towel. Cover with hot water and wrap tightly in double fold plastic wrap. Refrigerate while making the rolls. Bring back to room temperature. Heat oven to 375°f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Remove one piece of chilled cabbage from the freezer, place on a clean towel, and squeeze out excess water as you take the cabbage out of the freezer. Brush cabbage with the cream, and place on baking sheet. Bake for approximately 12 minutes, remove from oven and sprinkle with the confectioners' sugar. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper,bell pepper,cream chicken soup,no salt tomato,broccoli,plain flour,mustard seed
title: Creamy Broccoli Soup
ingredients: 250 g broccoli, chopped | 2 tablespoons bell peppers, chopped | 200 ml low-fat cream of chicken soup | 300 ml no-salt-added whole no-sodium canned tomatoes | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 pinch cayenne pepper | 1 teaspoon plain flour
instructions: Saute broccoli, peppers, soup, mustard seed and cayenne pepper. Remove from heat add flour, stir fry. Serve with crusty bread.

title: Quick & Easy Indian Potato Casserole #5FIX
ingredients: 3 -4 potatoes | 1 -2 tablespoon curry paste ( depends on taste, i use 1/2 amount if the recipe is a bit on hot ) ( optional ) | jalapeno pepper ( optional )
instructions: Scrub potatoes and boil until just about cooked. Cut into chunks, boil until just a little soft. Set cooked potatoes aside. When potatoes are just about cooked, pour 1 - 2 tsp of curry paste into a small frying pan, heat until hot. Add jalepenos and curry paste if using to fry up the garlic. Serve hot with crackers, crackers, etc.

title: Mom's Quesadillas
ingredients: 2 flour tortillas | 2 tablespoons chopped garlic | hamburger buns ( we like these with the buns )
instructions: Heat your grill. Brush one side of each tortilla with olive oil cooking until golden. Top with your favorite ingredients. Cut in 10 slices.

title: Mexican Cheese Bread (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 4 slices bread, about 1-2 inches thick, toasted or 5 slices sourdough bread | 1/4 cup mexican cheese, shredded ( i use kraft brand ) ( optional )
instructions: Spread cheese on both slices of toast. Top with the cheese. Put into a slow cooker. Cook on high for 6 to 8 hours or low for 7 to 8 hours.

Random Ingredients: rice noodle,pork cutlet,brown sugar,pepper,garam masala,egg,kidney bean,shrimp paste
title: Garam Masala Padri
ingredients: 1 package rice noodles | 4 eggs | 1 teaspoon ground pepper | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 2 tablespoons beef sirloin steak seasoning ( indian beef seasoning ) | 2 tablespoons shrimp paste ( available at asian markets ) | 1 can kidney beans, including their liquid ( drained ) | 1/2 cup brown sugar
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together all ingredients. Add rice noodles and stir. Coat with oil and grill for 3 - 4 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cooking apple,olive oil,chili bean,apricot preserve,garam masala
title: Apple and Bean Bhaji
ingredients: 1 teaspoon garam masala, or to taste | cooking apple, grated | 1/2 cup chinese-style apricot preserves | 1 tablespoon olive oil, or as needed | 1 cup cooked and cooled chili beans
instructions: Combine garam masala and grated apple in a bowl. Stir 1/2 cup apricot preserves into apple mixture. Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat. Stir in chili beans.

Random Ingredients: lemon peel,pork shoulder,phyllo pastry,peanut oil,vegetarian worcestershire sauce,garlic clove,whipping cream,chicken
title: My Favorite Chicken & Pork Strudels
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless skinless chicken pieces | 1 tablespoon lemon peel, finely grated | 2 garlic cloves | 1/3 cup peanut oil | 4 sheets phyllo pastry | 1/2 cup whipping cream | 1 tablespoon vegetarian worcestershire sauce | 1 cup shredded sweetened, chocolate morsels
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. In food processor or blender blend together chicken pieces, lemon peel, garlic, & peanut oil. Place chicken mixture on top of phyllo sheets, spreading to cover evenly. Top with remaining 1/2 c of chicken mixture. Whisk cream, worcestershire & chicken sauce together in small bowl to blend. Pour mixture across chicken. Using sharp knife, score top of strudels with sharp knife marks. Bake strudels until golden brown and tender, 40 - 45 minute.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower,thyme sprig,phyllo pastry,pie crust,black pepper,romaine lettuce leaf,no boil lasagna noodle,kosher salt pepper
title: Lasagna With Cauliflower and Thyme(Barefoot Contessa)
ingredients: 1 lb cauliflower, chopped into florets and cooled | 1/2 teaspoon minced fresh thyme sprig | kosher salt and pepper, to taste | 12 sheets 9-inch ready rolled pie crust | 1/3 lb no-boil lasagna noodle ( about 4 sheets ) | 24 sheets frozen phyllo pastry, thawed | 9 tablespoons freshly grated parmesean pecorino romano cheese | 1 large oven rack the middle of an oven and half an oven rack will accommodate 2-6 inches of convection oven
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees. To prevent the cauliflower from bleeding, place the cauliflower, thyme, kosher salt and pepper in a saucepan with just enough boiling water to cover. Bring the water to a boil, then remove from the heat. Cover and place in the refrigerator. Prepare a baking sheet with parchment, then spray the sheet with nonstick cooking spray. In a medium bowl, toss the thawed sheets of phyllo with 1/3 cup of parmesan and 1 tablespoon of baking powder and toss until evenly coated. Take one sheet of phyllo and layer it on the parchment so it doesn't stick out. Sprinkle with half of the cauliflower and thyme mixture and top with half of the lasagna sheets. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup of cheeses. Repeat this procedure 1 more time, layering as many sheets as possible without overlapping it. Layer with the remaining sheets, the final 2 tablespoons of cheese, remaining cauliflower, thyme and baking powder. Spray the entire baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray. Spread 1 cup of water into the bottom of the oven and bake for 15 minutes, then uncover and bake for an additional 15 minutes. Remove the baking sheet from the oven and set on a kitchen rack. Allow to sit for 5 minutes before cutting into 6 slices.

Random Ingredients: white vinegar,stew meat,chocolate,white peppercorn,green cardamom pod
title: Kerala Beef
ingredients: 1/2 kg stew meat, cut in 2 to 3cm cubes | 2 tablespoons white peppercorns | 1/2 teaspoon crushed unrefined green cardamom pods | 1/2 cup white vinegar | 50 g thick thickly sliced semisweet chocolate
instructions: Place all the ingredients, except the chocolate, into a large nonmetal bowl, pour boiling water over and leave for 1 hour. Add the chocolate to the beef in a little increments and stir with a fork until the chocolate melts and the sauce resembles thick paste consistency. Allow to set for 5 minutes. Place the beef in a serving dish and pour the sauce over.

title: Penne With Apricot Sauce
ingredients: 1 package uncooked penne pasta
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the penne, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta is cooked but still firm to the bite, about 11 minutes.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,jam,lemon zest,miso,dark brown sugar,rice wine vinegar,oregano,coconut cream
title: Caribbean Sweet Blend, No Glaze
ingredients: 2 tablespoons miso | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon lemon zest, grated | 2 tablespoons sweet molasses | 14 ounces coconut cream | 1 tablespoon fresh flat-leaf parsley, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon oregano, leaves chopped ( or 1/4 tsp. dried )
instructions: In a small bowl, mix miso and brown sugar.

Random Ingredients: sugar,hot red chili pepper,acorn squash,msg,lamb,spinach,belgian endive,grand marnier
title: Bourekakia (Sweetened Lamb, Vegetables and Spinach Bourekas)
ingredients: 2 lbs small lamb, very thinly sliced | 1/4 cup grand marnier, plus | 1 teaspoon grand marnier | sugar | 2 1/2 lbs small belgian endive, finely sliced | 4 1/2 tablespoons chopped fresh spinach ( packed ) | 2 1/2 tablespoons sweetened chili pepper, plus | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh hot red chili pepper | 1/8 teaspoon msg | chopped belgian endive
instructions: Remove any giblets from inside the lamb. Slice the meat thinly against the grain. Place it in a large bowl and add the grand marnier, sugar and 2 1/4 tablespoons water and mix well. Set aside to marinate at least 2 hours or overnight. Arrange endive, in neat rows on your work surface. Cover with plastic wrap and keep in the refrigerator until ready to use. Drain off excess marinade. Place meat slices on wooden skewers or metal skewers and brush generously with the grand marnier. Set aside to marinate at least 1 hour at room temperature or overnight at room temperature or overnight in the refrigerator. In a small bowl, combine the chile and the chili pepper. Thread skewers, beginning on your work surface and ending with a slice of endive. Pour any leftover marinade over the skewers. Set the skewers aside. For the bourekas, heat 1 teaspoon grand marnier in a small pan over low heat until boiling. Remove from heat. Taste and adjust seasoning. Transfer to a bowl and garnish with a few chopped endive leaves.

Random Ingredients: cola,rye bread,oil,pepper sauce,carrot,safflower oil,pappardelle pasta,canola oil
title: Irish Cola Fritters
ingredients: 1 package pappardelle pasta | 1/4 cup safflower oil ( optional ) or 1/4 cup canola oil ( optional ) | 1/2 cup cola | 1 bunch carrot, peeled and thinly sliced | 1/4 cup shredded cola | 1 tablespoon crushed pepper sauce | 2 tablespoons oil | rye bread
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 7 minutes or until tender. Drain.

Random Ingredients: tomato juice,broccoli rabe,cream celery soup,dark chocolate,cardamom powder,tortilla chip
title: Broccoli Rabe & Chocolate Chip Rabe
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 2/3 cup dark chocolate ( not margarine! ) | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1/4 cup tomato juice | 1/2 lb broccoli rabe, cut and chopped | tortilla chips, and or sesame crackers
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the soup, chocolate, cardamom and tomato juice. Bring just to a boil over medium high heat. Reduce heat to medium. Add the broccoli. Stir and cook just until the broccoli is hot. Top with chips and sesame crackers for a crisp garnish.

title: Baked Mango Chutney
ingredients: 2 cups mango chutney ( chutney mix, 1/2 cup ) | 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme | 1/2 cup seedless roasted pumpkin seeds, roughly chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f in a bowl, stir together the mango chutney, dry mustard, thyme and seeds. Scoop into an 8 inch square baking dish, and spread the pumpkin seeds on top of the chutney. Cover with foil and bake for 40 minutes. Remove foil, and bake for 10 minutes more, or until the chutney has reduced and thickened.

title: Jamaican Beans
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups dried pinto beans, washed and picked over | 1 1/2 tablespoons coriander seeds
instructions: Place beans in a saucepan and cover with several inches of water. Bring to a boil, and then reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes, or until tender. Drain. Allow to cool slightly, and then transfer to a heavy duty freezer bag. Sprinkle the coriander seeds over and tie with kitchen twine. Remove air from bag and freeze for 2 to 3 hours. To serve, remove bag from freezer, and store in freezer bag in freezer. If necessary, thaw overnight. Makes about 1 lb of beans. Variation, add a handful of jamaican beans, chopped into bite size pieces and mix with the rest of the spices. Add a generous dose of cayenne pepper, depending on how hot you like your food.

title: Homemade Alfredo Sauce
ingredients: 250 g flour | 1 teaspoon instant garlic flavored butter or 1 teaspoon garlic-flavored butter | 1 teaspoon whole milk powder | 1 teaspoon milk powder, for drizzling
instructions: Stir flour and garlic flavored butter with your fingers until smooth. Sprinkle milk powder and milk powder over all. Mix with your hands or a wooden spoon. Let rest 10 - 15 minutes or so, covered, for a soft dough to work with. Cover and leave in refridgerator until needed. Preheat oven to 425°f. Pour mixture in a small saucepan. Cook over low heat, stirring continuously, until bubbles form around the sides. Add water as needed until dough is firm enough to handle, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat, press a few doughnuts with your fingers to make a smooth ball and roll them into balls. Arrange balls on a baking sheet, lightly oiled side up and let rest for about 15 minutes or so. Bake about 7 - 10 minutes or until golden brown and bubbly. Serve with warm spaghetti. Enjoy.

title: Homemade Corn Relish
ingredients: 2 cups whole kernel corn ( fresh or frozen ) | 1 cup red wine vinegar | 1 cup cornflour ( corn flour ) | 1 teaspoon old bay seasoning
instructions: Mix the corn flour and old bay together in a bowl, add vinegar and beat with electric mixer at slow speed until well mixed. Pour into a bowl or container and sprinkle in the old bay. Cover and store for up to 1 week.

title: Blueberry-Stuffed Blueberry Bread
ingredients: 6 ripe blueberries | 1 sprig flat-leaf italian parsley
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil, and spray inside of foil with cooking spray. Break off a piece of the loaf of blueberries just larger than the loaf.

title: Pasta With Pesto and Onions
ingredients: 1 can or bottle zesty red pesto pasta sauce | 1 package penne
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the penne, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still slightly firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Place the pesto sauce in a jar, and pour in enough of the pasta sauce to coat. Cover and refrigerate the sauce.

title: Austrian Chocolate and Hazelnut Torte
ingredients: 1/4 cup hazelnuts ( or slivered almonds ) | 1 teaspoon coriander ( dried, crushed ) | 1 3/4 cups low sodium vegetable broth | 1 teaspoon instant chocolate chips ( or other chocolate melting power ) | 1/4 cup rauberg cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Remove and discard hazelnuts from can and coarsely chop fine. Mix with coriander and set aside. Bring vegetable broth to a boil in a medium saucepan over med high heat. Add nut mixture. Continue to cook and stir until hazelnuts are toasted and mixture softens, about 5 minutes. Add chocolate chips and 1/4 cup cheese and stir to melted cheese. Mix thoroughly. Add the remaining 1/2 cup of cheese and stir to combine. Transfer mixture to a serving bowl, and sprinkle with remaining nuts. Let cool to room temperature. Cut into 1/2 inch slices.

Random Ingredients: malt vinegar,garlic salt,chicken stock,vodka,beef sirloin,porcini mushroom,hoisin sauce,thyme leaf
title: Grilled Beef and Mushroom Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh porcini mushrooms, cleaned, quartered, caps and ribs removed ( not dried ) | 1/8 teaspoon thyme leaves | 1/4 cup hoisin sauce | 2 tablespoons malt vinegar | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/4 cup chicken stock | 2 lbs boneless beef sirloin, trimmed cut crosswise into 1/2 inch thick slices
instructions: In a jar with a tight fitting lid, combine the mushrooms, thyme, hoisin sauce, vinegar, worcestershire sauce, garlic salt, and chicken stock. Cover and shake until well combined. Place the beef and mushrooms in a large dish and pour the sauce on top. Let stand at room temperature 15 to 20 minutes. Preheat grill to medium high. Pour the rest of the sauce over the beef and mushrooms and let stand 5 to 10 minutes. Meanwhile, place 3 to 4 large sheets of foil on the center of a large rimmed baking sheet.

Random Ingredients: corn oil,chicken stock vegetable,bourbon,anisette,bouquet garni,cooking oatmeal,pancetta,salmon
title: Salmon With Anisette
ingredients: 500 g smoked salmon | 500 ml chicken stock or 500 ml vegetable stock | 175 ml quick-cooking oatmeal | 200 g pancetta | 3 1/4 tablespoons anisette or 3 1/4 tablespoons other light-colored oatmeal | 4 tablespoons bourbon or 4 tablespoons sherry wine | 10 -15 drops of your favourite bouquet garni | corn oil | anisette
instructions: Cut your smoked salmon into four pieces. Mix together the stock, oatmeal, pancetta, and anisette. Heat the corn oil in a frying pan. Place the salmon in and add it gradually to the oil. When the salmon is half cooked, turn off the heat and stir well until the salmon is heated through. Serve with anisette.

title: Whole Wheat Pastries Using Lamb, Beef or Pork - Dairy Free Option
ingredients: 600 g ground lamb | 6 tablespoons whole wheat pastry flour
instructions: Soak a 5ltr deep oiled lamington or a flat based lamington tray in water for 30 minutes to humidify your hands. Combine the ground lamb with the pastry flour and season well with salt and pepper. Line the tray with parchment paper and carefully remove it. Using your hands flatten the mixture into a disc shape by rolling it over 1/2 the length of the tray so that it fits evenly on the lamington. Gently lift the cling film around the pastry, trying not to tear the lamb. Once you can tightly roll the pastry out onto the lamington, it can be rolled out again and stored in freezer for up to 1 month. Preheat oven to 200°c. Line the pastry with baking paper, and sprinkle with flour. Pierce the pastry in several places with a meat pick. Place the tray in the preheated oven. Cook for 15 - 20 minutes, then set aside. Remove the lamington from the tray, allow to cool completely and slice into 3cm thick slices or as big as you like.

title: Basic French Style Sourdough Pickles
ingredients: 5 lbs good pickling cucumbers or 5 lbs other firm pickling cucumbers ( i prefer the yellow with the white ) | 2 cups vinegar or 12 cups distilled vinegar | 2 cups celery salt | 3 teaspoons cardamom seeds | 1 1/2 teaspoons sea salt
instructions: Pack the cucumbers into cheesecloth or cheesecloth lined jelly jars to within 1/2 inch of the top, making sure to have the ends of the jars placed where you need to fit the pickle to tighten in the pickle. Place in refrigerator for about 10 days then drain off liquid. Combine the salt ingredients in a saucepan and stir to dissolve. Add liquid from the pickle jar into the pickle jar and mix well. Bring to a boil.

Random Ingredients: golden syrup,leek,icing sugar,chicken drumstick,fine bread crumb,cherry brandy,basil leaf
title: Laksonicky Drumsticks
ingredients: 16 fluid ounces good quality boneless chicken drumsticks | 1 leek, trimmed and finely chopped | 1 -2 1 -2 fluid ounce cherry brandy or 1 -2 fluid ounce whiskey | 5 -6 basil leaves, shredded | 4 -6 tablespoons icing sugar | 1/4 cup fine dry bread crumb | 1 -2 tablespoon golden syrup
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180c or gas mark wash, dry and dry the chicken pieces. Place in an ovenproof dish and add the chopped leek, brandy or whiskey. Sprinkle over the basil and lightly crush them with your hands. Place onto a rack in a roasting tin. Bake in the hot oven for 40 minutes or until tender. Remove from the oven and place the chicken on two oven trays. Return to the oven and continue to cook until the chicken is golden, adding a splash water or a little more if necessary. To make the icing, mix the icing sugar with the bread crumbs and syrup set aside until the icing is thick or to your liking. Take the chicken out of its oven and leave to stand for 15 minutes, then cut into thick slices and serve sprinkled with the icing.

title: Gado Gado (Yellow Squash, Daikon and Pineapple Salad)
ingredients: 2 yellow squash ( or two small-sized zucchini, 1/3 pound ) | 2 celery ribs, trimmed and thinly sliced | 1 can crushed pineapple, drained | 1/2 small daikon radish, cut diagonally into 1/4-inch dice
instructions: Cut diagonally into slices about 1/2 wide and 2 thick. Place in a large, shallow, nonreactive dish large enough to hold all the ingredients. Pour the pineapple over the vegetables. Sprinkle with the daikon and radish and cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour or up to 8 hours. Remove the plastic wrap, serve on a lettuce leaf.

Random Ingredients: cooking spray,roast beef,mascarpone cheese,curry paste,anise seed
title: Anise Curry Roast Beef
ingredients: cooking spray | 2 teaspoons anise seed | 10 ounces prime rib roast beef ( or whatever cheap cuts you prefer or have on hand ) | 2 teaspoons mild curry paste | 8 ounces mascarpone cheese
instructions: Preheat your oven to 300 degrees f. Heat up a nonstick skillet lightly sprayed with cooking spray over medium heat. When hot, add a tablespoon of the anise powder in the oiled pan. As soon as that is bubbling, add the roast beef and cook it until the roast is cooked all the way through, 15 to 20 minutes depending on how cheap you cut the beef. Spread the curry paste on the meat and return it to the oven. Bake for about 8 more minutes. Remove the meat from the oven and mix the mascarpone into a smooth paste with a fork, then spread the mascarpone mixture on top of the roasted beef. Return to the oven and bake until the cheese is bubbly and warmed through, about 5 - 10 more minutes.

Random Ingredients: hot water,rosemary sprig,breadcrumb,chicken breast meat,romaine lettuce heart
title: Italian Chicken Salad II
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast steaks | 1 jar sweet breadcrumbs | 1 1/2 cups hot water | 1 can romaine lettuce hearts, drained and chopped | 6 fresh rosemary sprigs, finely chopped
instructions: Place chicken breasts between sheets of waxed paper and pound out. Mix breadcrumbs and water together and sprinkle 1 cup of crumbs over chicken.

Random Ingredients: celery rib,lime wedge,breadcrumb,mint leaf,ladyfinger,cream mushroom soup,curry paste,amarula cream liqueur
title: Curried Mini Brunch
ingredients: 1 package ladyfingers | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1/4 cup amarula cream liqueur | 4 tablespoons light curry paste | 2 ounces fresh breadcrumbs | 1 celery rib, diagonally sliced | 2 tablespoons dried mint leaves | lime wedge, to garnish
instructions: Arrange half of ladyfingers in the bottom of a 12 cup muffin tin. Combine the soup, sauce and curry paste in a bowl. Place bread crumbs in a separate bowl. Dip half of ladyfingers through coconut rum to coat. Dredge in bread crumbs.

Random Ingredients: tortilla,garlic clove,black olive,beef chuck,cajun seasoning,ginger root,serrano chilies
title: The Best Crock Pot Indian Grilled Beef Roll-Ups
ingredients: 12 1/4 ounces beef chuck, trimmed & cut into bite size chunks | 1/2 tablespoon cajun seasoning | 1 garlic clove, crushed | 1 piece fresh ginger root, minced | 2 large serrano chilies, minced | 1 cup black olives, drained | tortillas or bread
instructions: In a small bowl combine the cajun seasoning, garlic, ginger & serrano chilies. Place the meat & 1/2 of the herb mixture into a large plastic zip lock bag. Add the rest of the herb mixture to the bag and shake to combine. Place the bag in your crock pot and stir to combine. Cover the cooker & cook on low 8 - 10 hours or high 4 1/2 hours. Serve on tortillas or bread.

title: Kassutta (Sweet Cheese Dip)
ingredients: 6 ounces imitation crabmeat, fresh or canned | 6 tablespoons whipping cream | 2 large kiwi fruits, peeled, cut in half lengthwise, then thinly sliced lengthwise, seeds removed | 4 -5 leaves fresh sage, chopped | salt and white pepper
instructions: In a medium size bowl, stir whipping cream until stiff peaks form, then fold in imitation crabmeat, then toss. Taste test for heat and add salt and white pepper.

title: Pork & Chocolate in a Mug
ingredients: 300 g ground pork | 400 g milk chocolate
instructions: In the microwave, you need 400g of chocolate melt for 20 minutes while watching for the temperature to rise, stir every 5 minutes. In the mug, combine about 300g of water with a dash of white sugar. When the mug has reached the desired stage, add the ground pork. Serve while the mugs are hot and enjoy.

title: Green Beans and Nori (Japanese Bread Fritters)
ingredients: 4 pieces nori ( i 'd use wheat gluten ) | 1 lb fresh green beans, cut in 1/4 inch slices or 1 lb frozen peas, defrosted | 1 loaf bread flour ( i use gluten free flour )
instructions: Place the bread flour in a pan large enough to have enough room to stand the green beans and peas in one layer. Break apart any larger pieces of nori like sushi nori. Take one piece of nori and stretch it slightly to fit your bento box. Place a thin layer of defrosted green beans and a few blobs of the nori on the nori. Make sure to leave about a 1/4 inch gap at the top. Repeat with the remaining nori. Sprinkle the top with flour and gently pinch up to make sure that everything is covering it. Set a flat working surface on the top of the nori to weigh you down. Place the nori, covered with flour, on the work surface so the seaweed comes up at the top about 1/2 inch. Fold the top a bit over so the seaweed fills the gap. Fold the loaf over the nori, folding the excess to make sure everything is in the shape of dough. Wrap with clean, dried cloth. Refrigerate at least 1 hour if time permits. Remove the plastic wrapping from the cloth and lightly flatten the top with your hands.

title: Spiced Tomato and Pepper Delight
ingredients: 1 lb fresh tomato, sliced in thin strips with stems and seeds included ( a 12 inch, 16-ounce can ) | 1 lb frozen topping, thawed and refrigerated ( see below ) | 1 bell pepper, sliced | 1 teaspoon fresh ginger paste, grated
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a 1 quart resealable freezer bag. Turn the bag to distribute the filling and marinate in the refrigerator for at least one hour and up to overnight, turning bag several times. Serve immediately. Store in refrigerator up to 3 days.

title: Prawn Pies (Shrimp) Pakistani Style
ingredients: 100 g small green prawns | 2 medium red chili powder ( or a little less ) | 10 -24 marasichino cherries ( fresh or frozen ) | 3 -4 tablespoons dates, finely chopped
instructions: Peel the prawns and devein them. Wash and pat dry the prawns and the maraschino cherries. In a pan, add 5 tbsps of oil, add the prawn prawns and fry till pink colour comes. Remove from the pan and drain on clean absorbent paper and keep aside. Add another tsp of oil. Heat. After 1 minute, add the chopped cherries. When they become soft, add the chopped dates. Then add the red chili powder and fry till they turn dark green colour. Add the prawns back to the pan. When everything is mixed well, cook until the prawns become light and golden brown in colour. Transfer to a flat dish and garnish with maraschino cherries. Serve with bread, raita, pakora, mint or corriander leaves.

title: Peppered Pineapple Eggs
ingredients: 40 g fresh pineapple juice, juice from, strained | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 2 large egg whites | 1/8 teaspoon pepper | 30 g peanut oil
instructions: Pour 1 tablespoon of the pineapple juice into a bowl, add the sugar, egg whits, and pepper and using a fork. Stir briskly with a fork until well mixed. Dip spoon into egg, then into remaining juice, taking care that the egg spreads evenly. Heat an 8 inch griddle over a medium heat or a moderate heat, using a ladle. When they start to sizzle, add the peanut oil and heat until it shimmers and the oil is smoking. When the oil is smoking, add the pineapple egg mixture in the long rods, working quickly so they don't stick together. Cook for 5 minutes or less until the underside is lightly golden. Carefully remove the egg yolks with a spatula and carefully slide them into the pan. Cook for 3 - 4 minutes, until the underside is set and the pineapple is lightly browned. Remove from heat, and serve.

Random Ingredients: pork tenderloin,club soda,lemon juice,wheat pastry flour,flat leaf parsley
title: Scotch Sausage Wraps
ingredients: 1 lb pork tenderloin | 4 tablespoons club soda | 1/2 cup fresh flat-leaf parsley, chopped | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 2 cups whole wheat pastry flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. In a large bowl, toss the pork with club soda and cover with plastic wrap. Allow it to marinate at room temperature for 30 minutes. Remove pork from bowl and shred with two forks. Reserve 1/4 cup of the marinade. Line a 9x5 inch loaf pan with parchment paper, then spread out the pork mixture on the parchment paper. Place the breaded pork in the loaf pan and bake for 40 minutes. Remove from oven and allow to cool at least 15 minutes. Meanwhile, in a large bowl, whisk together the parsley, lemon juice and reserved marinade. Add cheese crumbles to the cheese mixture and mix thoroughly. Spoon the cheese mixture onto the warm breaded pork and roll up. Serve as soon as the roll has been removed from the loaf pan, allowing you some of the cheese mixture to spill out.

title: Low-Fat French Onion Dip
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons chicken bouillon granules | 1 tablespoon lemon juice
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender on low speed or on high speed until well mixed, stopping after it begins to thicken. Transfer to a shallow dish and refrigerate about 30 minutes to combine flavors. Serve with raw or under baked potatoes, crackers or vegetables.

title: Tomatoe Gazpacho
ingredients: 8 grape tomatoes | 1 cup ice water ( optional )
instructions: Place the tomatoes into a bowl, pour in ice water and cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate until ready to use. Pour about 1/4 cup of ice water into a blender and process until smooth.

title: Shannon's Okra and Date Stuffed Tomatoes
ingredients: 3 medium firm okra | 15 -20 medium dates, pitted | 1 1/2 cups tomato sauce, canned | kalamata olives ( i use a good quality black ) or fresh green olives | 1 tablespoon quick-cooking tapioca | 1 tablespoon quick-cooking tapioca | 1 teaspoon mrs. dash seasoning salt | 1 can tomato sauce, canned
instructions: Scoop insides of okra with a small spoon. Cut a few in half and scoop out excess pulp and place on serving plate. Place tomato sauce on the okra. Stuff each tomato with okra. Sprinkle with tomspderia.

title: Spicy Escargots
ingredients: 300 g helix snails | 1 chicken stock cube | 1/2 teaspoon savory
instructions: Rinse the snails thoroughly. Remove the heads and intestines if necessary. Slice the heads into bite sized lengths. Combine the snails, heads, intestines and savory in a large saucepan. Add water to cover the ingredients and bring to the boil. Cover and simmer over a low heat for 20 minutes. Remove from the heat, remove the snails with a slotted spoon and reserve. Strain and serve. Keep the liquid hot and remove the fish from the pot.

Random Ingredients: red chilies,taco seasoning,french bread,espresso powder,egg beater substitute,soymilk,saffron,american cheese
title: Vegan Chocolate French Toast
ingredients: 6 slices french bread | 1 tablespoon instant espresso powder ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons soymilk | 2 eggs ( or soymilk ) | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning | 1/2 tablespoon saffron ( optional ) | 1/4 cup red chilies ( or to taste ) ( optional ) | 1/2 cup fresh white american cheese ( shredded ) or 1/2 cup cheddar cheese ( shredded )
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees. Spray a 12 nonstick fry pan with cooking spray. Arrange bread slices in a single layer in pan. Combine espresso powder or soy milk, egg/soymilk powder or taco seasoning, saffron and chilies if you like, and pour over bread slices. Bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit 10 minutes or until bread is slightly browned on top. Slice french toast in 1/4 inch thick slices and serve with a sprinkle of cheese or avocado/rotel mixture.

Random Ingredients: pea,basmati rice,rice vermicelli,pork,habanero pepper,tart apple,mango powder
title: Habanero Stuffed Rice Balls
ingredients: 2 cups basmati rice ( white if possible ; use long grain or long grain plain rice ) | 2 ounces pork fat ( fat free pork or beef will work but the pork meat is vegetarian ) | 1/2 cup sweet tart apple ( such as kumara ) | 1/2 cup frozen peas ( thawed ) | 0.333 package rice vermicelli ( 2 sheets ) | 1/4 cup chopped dried mango powder ( or to taste ) | 2 jalapeno peppers ( roasted, peeled, seeded, and chopped ) or 2 habanero peppers ( roasted, peeled, seeded, and chopped )
instructions: Place the rice and 1 1/2 cups water in a saucepan and bring to the boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cover. Cook for 15 minutes, or until rice is tender. Drain and allow to cool. If using the pork, trim excess fat and shred. If using the meat, mince the pork fat and place in a skillet with the pork fat drippings and cook over medium heat until the fat is crispy. Set aside. If using vermicelli according to package directions, soak in hot water until soft. Add the remaining ingredients and mix until combined. Cut a 1 1/2 inch hole in the middle of each rice ball and fill the hole with stuffing. Scoop the stuffing into the rice ball and wrap the rice around the stuffing and twist the stuffing to make a ball. Bake at 375 degrees f for 20 minutes, or until rice is slightly firm and stuffing is hot and melted.

title: Creamy Caribbean Chicken
ingredients: 4 boneless chicken meat, skinned | 2 tablespoons fresh ginger-garlic paste | 2 cans cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1/4 cup light cream ( optional ) | 1/4 cup chopped fresh dill
instructions: Combine chicken, ginger garlic paste, cannellini beans and cream in slow cooker. Cover and cook on low setting 8 to 9 hours. Remove lid and stir in dill.

Random Ingredients: prawn,puff pastry,seasoning salt,tomato green chilies,parmigiano reggiano cheese,pork shoulder
title: Prawn Pastry Roll
ingredients: 2 packages puff pastry sheets | 3/4 lb lean pork shoulder, diced coarsely | 3/4 lb jusly raw prawns, shelled and deveined | 1 can diced tomatoes with mild green chilies, undrained ( hunts, you may use rotel brand ) | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 1/2 cups grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese, divided
instructions: Cut pastry sheets into three pieces, then cut each piece into 8 squares and place on a foil lined baking sheet. Cover with a damp towel and let stand in a warm place about 20 minutes, or until pastry is puffed up and dry. Meanwhile, put pork shoulder in a pot and cover with water. Bring to a simmer over medium high heat and cook until the pork is half way cooked, about 15 minutes. Drain pork and reserve cooking liquid, and set aside. When the pork is cool enough to handle, shred it, discarding bones, skin, and shredded fat. If the pork is lean and fatty, cut it into 1/2 inch cubes and toss with the tomato and chilies. Warm a small amount of oil in a skillet on medium high heat. Saute prawns and half of the sausage mixture in the hot oil until prawns are beginning to turn opaque. Add prawn mixture and season with salt and remaining sausage mixture. Preheat oven to 450 degrees. On a lightly floured surface, roll out the pastry into a rectangle 1 inch thick and 6 inches in diameter. Spread with 3/4 cup of the sausage mixture and sprinkle with 1/4 cup of cheese. Roll pastry into a 15 inch long cylinder, folding in both ends and pressing the ends of the cylinder to seal. Repeat with other pastry sheets and sausage mixture. Spread sausage mixture from a long side onto the bottom third of pastry, leaving about 1 inch border on all sides. Fold the unfilled side over the filling to about 1/4 inch deep, then roll to seal. Repeat with remaining ingredients and sausage mixture. Place pastries on two lightly floured baking sheets, brush tops with oil from skillet, then sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake pastries in preheated oven until pastry and filling are golden brown and prawns are heated through, approximately 25 minutes.

title: Bacon Wrapped Fish on Skewers
ingredients: 8 slices bacon, chopped | 1 cup self-rising flour | 4 teaspoons fish sauce | 2 packages frozen whipped topping
instructions: Combine the sugar and fish sauce in a bowl and set aside. Add the bacon and flour to the bacon fat in the fry pan and cook until the bacon becomes crispy. Meanwhile, thread two pieces of fish on each bamboo skewer, securing it with a toothpick. Heat the oil in a large, straight sided cast iron frying pan. Add the fish wrapped fish and stir fry over fairly high heat until the flour turns golden brown. Remove any excess flour from the fish and serve immediately over cooked rice.

Random Ingredients: ladyfinger,mix,raspberry,celery rib,black sesame seed,plum,garlic paste,glace ginger
title: Peppered Savoiardi
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon white sesame seed | 1/2 - 1/2-1 teaspoon minced fresh garlic paste ( or 2 teaspoons bottled minced garlic ) | 3 packages ladyfingers | 2 -3 tablespoons gluten-free glace ginger ( or homemade ginger ginger or ginger grated using 2 tsp. grated ginger or 1/2 tsp. ginger & 1/2 tsp. ginger powder ) | 1/4 cup chopped celery rib | 1/4 - 1/2 cup seedless raspberry jam ( optional ) or 1/4-1/2 cup chopped strawberry ( optional ) | 2 cups fresh raspberries ( optional ) or 2 cups frozen raspberries ( optional ) | 1 sprig fresh rosemary, cut into 1-inch pieces ( optional, for garnish )
instructions: In a small bowl spread 1/4 tablespoons of the chunky ginger spread evenly over the bottom of an 11x7 glass baking dish. Line up ladyfingers in a single layer on the bottom of the dish, allowing room to spread out. Sprinkle with sesame seeds. Spread the garlic paste/ginger over the ladyfingers, covering as much of the chunky ginger spread as possible. Spread the 2 - 3 tablespoons of the glaze evenly over the ladyfingers. Spread the celery over the glaze, cover and chill for a minimum of 1 hour. Preheat the oven to 350°f slice rhizberries in half and spread over the surface of the tiramisu, starting at a right side. Garnish with fresh raspberries, if using, and rosemary.

Random Ingredients: bamboo shoot,saffron strand,pomegranate molasses,black olive,grapeseed oil,italian plum tomato,tabasco sauce,banana
title: Al Kabsa
ingredients: 1 lb italian plum tomato, ripe and each cut in 8 wedges | 1 can pitted black olives, drained and cut in half lengthwise | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained and cut in half lengthwise | 1/2 cup grapeseed oil | 1/3 cup pomegranate molasses | 1 tablespoon paprika and saffron strand ( soaked in a little warm water for 5 10 minutes ) ( optional ) | 1 large ripe banana, sliced thinly | 1 -2 dashes tabasco sauce
instructions: In a food processor or blender, combine the tomato wedges, pitted olives, bamboo, guavas and pomegranate molasses. Puree until thick, about 5 - 10 pulses. Stir in the saffron soaked in hot water, if desired. If using a blender, transfer the puree to a clean dish, cover and leave at room temperature for several hours. Serve over brown rice as an appetizer or with saffron flavored rice. For vegetarian use the banana, pomegranate molasses, and a sprinkle of kosher salt. For vegetarian use the olive, pomegranate molasses, and a healthy splash of tabasco.

title: Homemade Stock
ingredients: 3 pounds fresh flat-leaf parsley | 1 container bottled marjoram
instructions: Place 1/2 the parsley in a large container or mortar and pestle, or if using a mortar and pestle, mix well. Place the remaining 1/2 the parsley in a pestle, and grind to a coarse soup mix. Pour the dried marjoram into a large pot with 1/2 the parsley, and stir in the remaining 1/2 parsley. Bring to a boil, and boil 5 minutes, then remove from the heat. Let cool to room temperature, or cover and refrigerate for up to 2 days.

title: Barley with Chiles -- Mexican Barley Beans
ingredients: 1 cup pearl barley | 1 can stewed tomatoes with green chilies, undrained
instructions: Drain and discard liquid from barley. Stir barley with chopped canned tomatoes into the liquid. Heat to boiling.

Random Ingredients: golden syrup,steak,pineapple juice,red kidney bean sauce,rice vinegar,simple syrup,orange blossom honey,vanilla essence
title: Swiss Steak With Pineapple Fried Beans
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs flank steaks | 1 can red kidney beans in sauce | 1/2 cup pineapple juice | 1/2 cup rice vinegar ( i prefer white vinegar ) | 1/2 cup light golden syrup | 1 small orange blossom honey | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla essence | 2 teaspoons simple syrup
instructions: Marinade and steak, in a large ziplock bag, mix black bean sauce, pineapple juice and rice vinegar together and add the steak. Refrigerate for 24 hours to marinate. In a small bowl mix together orange blossom honey, vanilla and simple syrup, add to the marinade. If desired cook at room temp or warm in the oven for approx 20 minutes, turning once during this time if desired. Grill steaks to desired doneness. Use a slotted spoon or barbecue tongs to serve on a bed of steamed beans and top with crispy fried beans. Great with a side of rice pilaf.

title: Chinese Sweet  Sausage Meatballs
ingredients: 1 lb chinese sausage, casings removed ( you may use more or less ) | 1 can whole mixed mushrooms | 1 can anchovies | 1 dash almond extract | 1 dash asafoetida powder | 1 vanilla bean | 1 dash chinese sausage ( optional )
instructions: Drain mushrooms and set aside. Dice sausage. Dump contents from both cans into crock pot, add remaining ingredients. Cook for at least 3 hours on high or more.

Random Ingredients: broth,salad oil,cinnamon raisin bread,pecorino cheese,chicken stock cube,apricot preserve
title: Cinnamon Raisin-Apricot Stuffing
ingredients: 1 package cinnamon raisin bread, torn into 1-inch pieces | 4 cups store-bought stock cubes, crushed | 1/3 cup salad oil | 1 packet chicken stock cubes | 1 tablespoon ground cinnamon or 2 teaspoons ground cinnamon | 1 cup apricot preserves | 1/4 cup freshly grated pecorino cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Place raisins in a large bowl and add the stock cubes. Mix well and rub in one direction until the cubes are covered loosely with a moist cloth or paper. Add the oil and mix well. Add the stock cubes and mix well. Cover and put in oven for 1 hour. Do not remove the lid until the last 30 minutes to 1 hour. Remove from oven and stir gently with a wooden spoon or spoon so that the stuffing is well coated with the sauce. Topping, put apricot preserves in microwave and heat on high for 15 seconds or so until melted. Stir well and mix in with the stuffing. Sprinkle top with grated cheese just prior to serving.

Random Ingredients: rice noodle,chicken breast,semolina flour,parmesan cheese,whiskey,beef bouillon cube,italian parsley,grand marnier
title: Easy Chicken and Broth Noodle Soup
ingredients: 2 ounces uncooked dry rice noodles | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 -2 cup whiskey | 1 tablespoon semolina flour ( not salt ) | 1 1/4 cups broth or 1 1/4 cups beef bouillon | 1 1/4 cups mixed grains ( jasmine, basmati, arborio ) | 1 tablespoon dried minced parsley | 1 chicken breast, cooked and chopped ( optional ) | grated parmesan cheese ( optional )
instructions: In a large pot, combine all ingredients except parmesan cheese. Simmer over low heat for 30 minutes. Garnish with parmesan cheese.

Random Ingredients: hazelnut,chicken breast half,spicy mustard,red currant jelly,pepper,pork roast,mayonnaise
title: Wildhogs
ingredients: 1/2 pork roast | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1/2 cup red currant jelly | 1/2 teaspoon hot mustard | 1 pound skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cut into 1 inch pieces | 1/2 cup hazelnuts ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Rub roast with mayonnaise, jelly, and hot mustard. Arrange chicken breast halves on a shallow roasting pan, and sprinkle with hazelnuts. Sprinkle with pepper, and top with remaining ingredients. Bake, uncovered in the preheated oven for 1 1/2 hours, or until a meat thermometer inserted into the center of the meat registers 170 degrees f. Remove from oven, and let stand for 10 minutes before cutting.

Random Ingredients: red wine,fish fillet,active yeast,tart apple,grain white rice,extra virgin olive oil,green cardamom pod
title: Spicy Fish and Chips
ingredients: 1/4 cup red wine ( not cooking wine ) | 1/2 cup wildflower red wine or 1/2 cup dry red wine | 1 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil ( see note ) | 8 slices fresh tart apples ( about 3/4-inch thick ) | 5 cups lightly buttered rounds white bread | 1/2 teaspoon thinly sliced green cardamom pod
instructions: Combine first 2 ingredients in a large bowl. Cover and let stand at room temperature 1 hour. Drain wine through a fine mesh strainer into a measuring cup. Measure out 1 cup, reserving 1 cup for later use. Transfer olive oil to a 12 skillet over medium heat. When hot, add apple slices and 3/4 cup reserved wine. Cook and stir until apples soften, about 6 minutes. Remove from heat and spread apple mixture evenly in skillet. Cover and let stand at room temperature until cool, about 30 minutes. Meanwhile, toast bread until lightly browned and puffed, about 3 minutes in a preheated 400 degree f. Oven, about 8 minutes. Remove bread and bake on a baking sheet until browned evenly, about 2 minutes. Meanwhile, return cider mixture to saucepan. Stir in cardamom. Heat through, about 3 minutes. Cool completely and transfer to a bowl. Stir chip mixture into the cider mixture. Let flavors meld and divide among 4 serving glasses. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: lime,sugar snap pea,burgundy wine,semolina,italian sausage link,red potato,pecan
title: Sweet Italian Sausage and Vegetables
ingredients: 1 lb sweet italian sausage link | 1 lb red potatoes or 1 lb baby portabella mushrooms | 1/2 cup pecans, chopped | 2 lbs granulated sugar snap peas | 1 cup burgundy wine | 1/2 cup semolina | 1/2 cup italian-style chopped pecans | 1 lime
instructions: In a large skillet, brown sausage in hot oil until thoroughly cooked. Set aside. Add other vegetables to skillet, and brown lightly in reserved olive oil. Stir in sausage and all other ingredients except pecans and pecan nuts. Cover, turn up to high and simmer for about 35 minutes. Sprinkle with pecans before serving.

Random Ingredients: fish fillet,olive,rigatoni pasta,chive,plum tomato,apricot preserve,sirloin,red onion
title: Rigatoni with Beef and Apricots
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin, cut into strips | 1 red onion, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup pitted ripe olives, cut in half | 1 cup plum tomatoes, quartered | 1 cup apricot preserves | 3 cups rigatoni pasta | 1 bunch fresh chives, chopped
instructions: In a soup pot, cook sirloin and onion in olive oil. When beef is browned add plums and tomatoes. When it has turned a rich red color, add apricot preserves. Add rigatoni. Cook over medium heat, stirring often, until rigatoni is tender and sauce is as rich or syrupy as you like. Garnish with chives.

Random Ingredients: spanish onion,lemon zest,cake yeast,green chile,marshmallow,whipping cream,habanero pepper,cajun seasoning
title: Spanish Style Shredded Red Enchilidas
ingredients: 1 lb spanish waller cheese or 1 lb cheese tortillas, cut into 1/4 inch thick slices | 3 tablespoons cajun seasoning | 1/2 large spanish onion, thinly sliced ( about 3/4 cup ) | 6 habanero peppers, diced | 2 cans sweetened condensed whipping cream, well chilled | 1/2 medium onion, finely grated ( about 2/3 cup ) | 2 1/2 teaspoons lemon zest, grated or 2 1/2 teaspoons lime zest | 2 pinches cajun seasoning | 1 -2 ounce marshmallows, finely chopped
instructions: Place a 10 inch skillet in a single layer. Layer cheese with 2 tablespoons cajun seasoning. Cover with another layer of cheese. Sprinkle with remaining 1/4 ounce cajun seasoning and 1/2 teaspoon lime zest. Repeat layering until all layers are used, ending with cheese on the top. Spoon cream into a small bowl. Working quickly, add 3 tablespoons to a small pan containing 1/2 the grated onion, 2 minced jalapenos, 1/4 cup onion, lemon zest and 2 1/2 teaspoons cajun seasoning and heat over medium heat until butter melts, 2 or 3 minutes, stirring frequently. Remove from heat and set aside. Pour cream mixture into skillet and bring to a boil over medium high heat until slightly thickened. Cover and cook over medium heat until almost all liquid is absorbed. Add more hot water if necessary to prevent burning. Remove from heat and set aside. Serve warm.

title: Salsa Rellenos
ingredients: 2 cups salsa | 1 cup egg white | kosher salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Mix salsa and egg whites together. Pour into a shallow baking dish and sprinkle on salt and pepper. Bake at 350 degrees f for 25 to 30 minutes, until the whites are firm and the salsa is slightly runny.

title: Cantaloupe and Sun-Dried Tomato Hummus
ingredients: 1 package cantaloupe ( honey limooms ) | 1 1/2 cups pinto beans, drained and rinsed ( black beans ) | 2 tablespoons fresh herbs, chopped ( or 1/4 teaspoon dried, crushed ) | 1/2 cup low-fat spicy salsa | 2 sun-dried tomatoes, chopped
instructions: Arrange cantaloupe in a single layer in a microwave safe bowl with a cover, and cook on high for 1 minute or until beginning to soften. Carefully peel off the skin, and set aside. Rinse and drain 2 tablespoons cantaloupe from the jar and chop finely. Add the remaining cantaloupe to the bowl with the olives, salsa, and chopped sun dried tomatoes. Stir to combine. Spread hummus on serving plates and sprinkle with remaining olives, if desired.

title: Red Curry Sauce from the Tofu or Pantai
ingredients: 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 14 fluid ounces coconut milk | 14 fluid ounces sweetened heavy cream
instructions: Put curry paste into a small pan over medium heat. Stir gently until dissolved, about 30 seconds. Pour in coconut milk. Stir until dissolved. Continue stirring until hot, about 5 minutes. Pour cream into hot mixture. Cook about 5 minutes. If sauce thickens more before sauce thickens, stir in a little water.

Random Ingredients: bamboo skewer,pork butt roast,cooking spray,lardons,wheat flour,coriander powder
title: Lebanese Pork Bites
ingredients: 4 teaspoons ground coriander powder | cooking spray, or as needed | 4 teaspoons lardons, sliced | 1 1/2 pounds boneless pork butt roast, trimmed of fat | 1/4 cup wheat flour, or as needed | 24 bamboo skewers, soaked in water 30 minutes
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Spray a baking sheet with cooking spray. Mix together coriander powder and ground coriander powder in a small bowl. Roll meat cubes in flour to coat. Heat lardons in the preheated oven until evenly browned, about 10 minutes. Transfer to an unlit, dry skillet.

title: Leek-Crusted French Bread With Chicken and Corn
ingredients: 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 6 boneless skinless chicken breasts | 6 leeks ( trimmed ends and cut into 3-4-inch lengths or 1/2-3/4-1 inch lengths, rinsed well in cold water ) | 1 teaspoon cardamom ( very freshly ground seeds, not powdered ) | 3 tablespoons corn or 3 tablespoons grapeseed oil | 1 1/2 lbs french baguettes, toasted | 2 ounces citron, coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°f. Line a rimmed baking sheet with foil. Place the chicken breasts on a baking sheet, and coat each with the cream of tartar. Bake until barely done, about 15 to 20 minutes. While the chicken is baking, put the leeks in a large saucepan and add water to nearly cover. Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until tender, about 20 minutes.

title: Spaghetti and Smoked Mozzarella
ingredients: 500 g spaghetti, broken into 3/4 inch pieces | 1 tablespoon dried apricot, chopped | 60 g polenta ( coarse instant polenta ) | 1 tablespoon dried lime juice, zest of | 2 teaspoons campari or 2 teaspoons table salt | 1 can consomme, undiluted
instructions: In a large skillet cook the spaghetti pasta in boiling water according to pack directions. Meanwhile, place apricots in a small bowl and pour boiling water on to cover. Let cool until easier to handle, then chop finely. Set aside. To make polenta, put all ingredients in the bowl of a food processor together and process until well combined and creamy. Season to taste before adding any extra flavouring.

title: Pavlova Chips (Portuguese Candy)
ingredients: 1 package corn chips | 1/2 cup sugar | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Place corn chips into a medium bowl, sprinkle with sugar, and toss to coat. Spray a nonstick frypan or large cookie sheet with nonstick spray. Spoon candy onto the corn chips in a circular motion, forming a mound in the center of the cereal. Cook about 2 minutes, flipping frequently with a spatula so that the candy doesn't stick to the pan. When the tortilla is light brown, transfer it to an oven safe dish, and bake about 25 minutes, until crisp and dark in color, and the cheese has melted and has begun to brown. Cool the candy and break it into bite sized pieces.

Random Ingredients: burrito flour tortilla,flat leaf parsley,lasagna noodle,chick pea,extra virgin olive oil,heavy whipping cream,cream chicken soup
title: Chicken and Chickpea Lasagna
ingredients: 1 package lasagna noodles | 2 teaspoons extra virgin olive oil | 2 cans condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 1/2 cups crushed cooked chicken breasts or 2 cups cooked chick-peas | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley | chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil, and cook the lasagna noodles until just done.

title: Pinto Beans Vegan
ingredients: 1 cup pinto beans or 1 cup white beans, washed and dried | 1 tablespoon grated fresh coconut or 1 tablespoon coconut milk | 1 small radish, sliced
instructions: Soak the beans in cold water overnight. Drain the beans and wash thoroughly. Place the beans in a saucepan, add enough water to cover them by one inch, and bring to a boil. Cook over medium high heat for about one hour. Add the coconut or coconut milk. Reduce heat.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,clear honey,bacon,soymilk,grand marnier,salad oil,rice vinegar
title: Malaysian Sweet Grilled Bacon With Soy Milk
ingredients: 125 ml soymilk ( soy milk ) | 12 slices bacon, thickly sliced and fried crisp ( see notes ) | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar, plus extra | clear honey | 1 tablespoon grand marnier or 1 tablespoon orange-flavored liqueur | 1 tablespoon kaffir lime leaf, dried | 1/2 teaspoon clear honey | 1 tablespoon salad oil
instructions: Note, if you use australian sweet grilled bacon, you should use about 1 - 3 tbsp of chopped kernals from Asian food section available at your local supermarket.

Random Ingredients: margarine,white button mushroom,dark beer,feta cheese,salmon fillet,baking potato
title: Smoked Salmon With Feta and Beer
ingredients: 4 medium baking potatoes, unpeeled cut into 8 wedges | 2 teaspoons margarine | 1 cup soft fresh goat cheese ( no substitutes ) or 1 cup feta cheese | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped fresh white button mushrooms | 1/2 cup dark beer | 1/2 lb smoked salmon fillet, cut into 4 equal pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f degrees. Arrange 1 wedges potato in 10x15 baking dish. Brush with 1/2 teaspoon margarine. Sprinkle with 1/4 cup cheese, mushrooms, and remaining wedges of potato. Mix remaining ingredients in small bowl. Sprinkle over potatoes. Bake covered about 40 minutes or until potato is tender. Note, you can prepare this ahead and refrigerate it for up to 1 week or even freeze it for up to 1 year.

Random Ingredients: green bean,bake pie crust,cauliflower floret,ginger paste,daikon radish
title: Baingan Ka Halwa (Indian Veggie Pie)
ingredients: 4 small baking pie crusts ( made with water- i like the tarte flour ) | 1/2 cup daikon radish, julienne ( optional ) | 12 ounces cauliflower florets ( fresh or frozen ) | 1/4 teaspoon ginger paste | 1/2 lb green beans, chopped ( fresh and frozen )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350â°f. Cut potatoes in half lengthwise and scoop out the core and seeds. Arrange potatoes on a foil lined baking sheet. Mix together radishes and the daikon. Top each potato with 1 tbsp daikon mixture, 1/2 tsp ginger paste and 1/2 tsp green beans. Bake in an oven toaster until golden brown and hot throughout, 15 - 20 minutes.

title: Caribbean-Ish Cocktail
ingredients: 1 1/4 ounces dark chocolate ( optional ) | 1 ounce catsup | 12 ounces coconut cream, light ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons fresh bread, crumbs ( optional ) | 1 -2 tablespoon garlic salt | 1 -2 lemon, juice of
instructions: Cut the choclate in half and scoop out and discard the soft bally seeds in the center, leaving a small crater in the middle. This should leave you with chunks of choclate that will keep forever in the fridge. Measure the chips into a bowl and add the sauce ingredients. Whisk until thick and creamy.
