Add the choclate and stir until mixed. Add the bread crumbs and stir until breadcrumbs or crumbs are mixed inches. Spray a barbeque grill with olive oil, and set the fire up to medium. Drizzle a little bit of this cocktail sauce over the warm coals. If you have a grill with a tight cover, it will smoke easily. Place a handful of coals on the grill and cook until a toothpick inserted in the center of a chunk of chocolate melts, about 3 to 5 minutes per side. A toothpick should come out clean from the side of the grill if it is bent to the pan, the meat should feel shuddly and very similar. The trick is to take the toothpick out of the pan and pull a toothpick right through the meat without breaking it into chunks of chocolate. It is important to keep the toothpick in the pan if you have an empty, empty metal bowl. This is a critical step, especially if you have an empty metal bowl or coffee filter on hand. The chocolate will melt and give off a nice smell. Add the additional 2 tbsp of sauce at this stage if necessary. Serve, and make sure you serve it hot or cold.

title: Lime Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup rice vinegar | 1 teaspoon confectioners'sugar | 1/4 cup lime wedges
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the rice vinegar, confectioners' sugar and lime juice. Cover and refrigerate until serving.

title: Hot Dogs
ingredients: 1/2 cup catsup | 1/4 cup milk
instructions: Mix catsup and milk in crockpot. Drop by tablespoonfuls on top and place in crockpot. Cook on high for 6 minutes, then reduce to low and cook for 5 more minutes.

title: Asian Chilli Beef Salad
ingredients: 200 g sirloin, thinly sliced | 300 g ham, thickly sliced | 1 tablespoon pumpkin seeds or 1 tablespoon pumpkin seeds | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds, lightly toasted | 2 spring onions, finely chopped | romaine lettuce or iceberg lettuce
instructions: Heat grill to medium high. Brush a barbecue plate with olive oil or spray with oil spray and add sliced beef and ham, toss to coat and then set the beef and ham mixture aside to cool. Combine sesame seeds and spring onions in a shallow ovenproof bowl. Stir in lettuce, then place salad on lined plate. Place beef and ham mixture on top, pressing down firmly. Top with sesame seeds to serve.

title: Indian Seasoned Salt
ingredients: 3 cups finely ground salted cereal ( like corn flakes ) | 1/2 cup cayenne pepper
instructions: Bring 2 cups of cereal to a boil in a large, heavy skillet. Stir in 1/4 cup of cayenne pepper and 2 tablespoons of cumin. Remove from heat, cover and rest for 5 minutes. Stir again and fluff with a fork. Serve with hot crackers.

title: Tamari and Coriander Scones
ingredients: 1 cup self-rising flour ( aka plain flour ) | 1 tablespoon tamari | 1 tablespoon mirin | 1 tablespoon ground coriander powder
instructions: Place all ingredients into a large bowl. With your hands mix with hands until the mixture feels smooth. Sprinkle the dough with a little extra tamari if using. Heat a large baking sheet over an oiled griddle. Lightly coat with oil. Using a 3 to 5cm scone cutter, cut out and discard dough. Scone off a piece of dough with a rolling pin, then cut out and divide into 3 or 4 equal parts. Place pieces in batches onto the griddle, using 2 tablespoons of the mixture for each. Cook for 5 minutes on each side or until light golden brown.

Random Ingredients: mint leaf,chili flake,chocolate hazelnut nutella,ramen noodle,habaneros,kiwi fruit,yellow onion
title: Minty Noodle Kebabs
ingredients: 3 cups ramen noodles, preferably cellophane noodles ( broken into quarters ) | 1 -2 tablespoon chili flakes, to taste ( optional ) | 1/2 cup chocolate hazelnut spread ( i've also used nutella ) ( optional ) | 1 small ripe yellow onion, halved and vertically sliced | 2 -3 sliced kiwi fruits, of choice ( about 3/4-inch wedges ) | 1 tablespoon chopped of fresh mint leaves | 2 -3 habaneros, sliced diagonally ( more is better ) ( optional )
instructions: Place noodles in a large zip top plastic bag or a bowl with the chili flakes, chili flakes, chocolate hazelnut spread, onion, kiwi wedges, mint and habaneros. Seal or shake until blended. Skewer noodles onto metal or bamboo skewers. Grill or broil until tender and firm. Serve with a drizzle of the sauce. Variation, add chopped, crushed black olives or green onion to taste. Variation 2, use green and red bell peppers or tomatoes instead. Instead of chili flakes, add more chili flakes and 1 -2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro.

title: Fried Cottage Cheese and Salami Skewers
ingredients: 1 lb cottage cheese | 1 orange, juice of | 1/2 lb meat | 1 teaspoon coriander seed, crushed | 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard | 2 ounces salami | 2 ounces semolina | 1 tablespoon thickened cream or 1 tablespoon thin yogurt
instructions: Break meat into small pieces and roll into a large circle, about 2 inches long. Dice salami in 1 inch squares and then put all into a large bowl with the cottage cheese. Mix all the ingredients together. Leave to marinate for at least one hour. Thread onto long soaked wooden skewers about 5 - 6 per skewer. If using bamboo skewers place in water to soak for 2 hours. Grill on high until browned. Serve hot with warm breads or breads.

Random Ingredients: vegetable,fire tomato,clam juice,carrot,white bean,salmon,pork sparerib,chicken breast
title: Smoked Clam Chowder
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs smoked pork spareribs | 1 bottle clam juice | 1 can chopped clams with juice | 1 can solid white beans, rinsed | 1 can canned whole vegetables | 15 cherry tomatoes, halved | 3 frozen cooked chicken breasts | 6 -10 small smoked ham slices ( about 8-1/2 ounces )
instructions: Rinse pork spareribs under warm running water and place on several layers of paper towels, sprinkling each with salt, for at least two hours. Remove fat from clams with your hands, throwing away what clams or clams haven't opened. Place in a large soup pot over low heat. Add any leftover clams or chicken broth or water. Allow to simmer. Combine clam juice, beans peas, vegetables, and ham slices in a freezer bag, close, and freeze. Remove ham slices from freezer bag with a slotted spoon. Set out frozen ham pieces, and place frozen clams or chicken breasts into soup pot along with any leftover ham pieces. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to a bare simmer, or place in a crockpot and reduce to a low setting to allow flavors to combine. Let braise approximately 20 minutes, depending on how full you like your ham and clams on the flavor. Serve immediately.

title: Corn Nachos
ingredients: 1 cup fresh fruit, chopped | 2 corn tortilla chips | 1/2 cup mango chutney | 2 tablespoons peanut butter
instructions: Place chopped fruit in a bowl and season with salt and pepper. Spoon mango chutney into the bowl and combine with the peanut butter. Sprinkle the mixture onto the chips and toss to coat. Serve with fruit. Make ahead tip, for a crispier, spongier or spongier nachos use corn chips. If needed, cook a few minutes longer. For a crisper nachos, reduce the heat to medium and lightly saute the nuts. Add them and the mango chutney to the peanuts when finished cooking.

title: Herby Swiss Steak
ingredients: 1 beef flank steak, about 6 ounces | 1/2 cup snipped parsley
instructions: Score the fat of steak on an angle with a sharp knife. Then make criss cross marks and insert a small spoonful of snipped parsley. Cook over hot coals, basting frequently until well flavored, about three minutes per side.

title: Garlic With Shrimp  (Camarao de Piri)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs shrimp, peeled and deveined ( i use baby shrimp ) | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 cup raspberries ( optional ) or 1 cup blueberries ( optional )
instructions: Slice tops off shrimp, remove shells. Tear shrimp in half and set aside. Sprinkle shrimp with remaining shrimp, salt and garlic. Marinate until rind is glittering gold, about 6 hours to overnight, stirring once. Drain shrimp, reserve marinade. Pour reserved marinade into a skillet and boil over high heat until it thickens, about 5 minutes. Serve shrimp on a large platter with raspberries or blueberries.

Random Ingredients: rotel tomato,mini chocolate chip,red curry paste,beef consomme,stuffing mix,parsnip,ginger paste
title: Roolash
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb ground round | 1 package frozen chopped parsnips, thawed | 1 jar rotel tomatoes | 1 can beef consomme, undiluted | 1 tablespoon ginger paste | 1 teaspoon red curry paste | 2 cups seasoned stuffing mix
instructions: Cook and stir the ground beef, breaking it up as it cooks, until it is no longer pink, drain excess liquid. Add remaining ingredients and mix thoroughly. Put into a casserole dish. Bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit for 45 minutes or until hot and bubbly.

title: Moroccan Saffron and Thyme Tea
ingredients: 8 -10 saffron threads | 1 1/2 cups thyme leaves or 1 1/2 cups fresh thyme, loosely packed and coarsely chopped
instructions: Place the saffron threads in a small bowl, add water, and set aside. Combine the thyme leaves with the saffron water until the mixture is smooth, then set aside. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Place the tea bags on the pan, close the lid slightly, and steep 10 minutes. Remove the tea bags, and discard them. Pour the water into the tea bags, bring the water to a boil, and immediately lower the heat to medium. Simmer for 5 minutes, remove the tea bags, and steep 15 minutes longer. Strain the tea, and serve at once. If you like, you can chill the tea completely before serving, just be sure to refrigerate the tea before serving. You can do this in advance. Saffron water is made by crushing saffron threads with a mortar and pestle, then discarding all of the water.

Random Ingredients: pickapeppa sauce,plain nonfat yogurt,baking powder,red food coloring,broccoli floret,red enchilada sauce,chick pea,cayenne
title: Red enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 2 cans red enchilada sauce | 1 can chick-peas, drained | 1 package broccoli florets, chopped | 1/2 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 2 cups shredded low-fat plain nonfat yogurt | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne | 1/5 cup pickapeppa sauce
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. In a large bowl, combine first four ingredients. Stir well. Pour about 1/2 the sauce into a 9x13 inch dish. Spread in an even layer. Top with remaining sauce. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes. Uncover and bake for 15 more minutes. Remove cover, sprinkle with Pickapeppa sauce, and bake for 5 more minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Quick and Easy Quesadillas
ingredients: 3 flour tortillas, cut into 3 inch strips ( about 8 x 13 inches ) | 2 cups orange marmalade, divided
instructions: Arrange 3 strips on each serving plate, leaving about 2 1/2 inches between each piece. Evenly spread 2 tablespoons of marmalade over tortillas. Wrap each quesadilla in plastic wrap and refrigerate 5 minutes, then make them while the tortillas are chilling. Heat a griddle or skillet over medium high heat. Dip the quesadillas in the marmalade and fry until golden on both sides, 1 to 2 minutes per side. Repeat with remaining 3 quesadillas and marmalade.

Random Ingredients: fish fillet,bamboo shoot,salmon fillet,stew meat,green pepper,yellow pea,flat leaf parsley,orange peel
title: Smoked Salmon and Pea Stew
ingredients: 600 g stew meat, cubed | 200 g red peppers, seeded and diced | 200 g yellow peas, shelled | 5 green peppers, seeded and diced | 2 tablespoons finely grated orange peel | 200 g smoked salmon fillets, skinned and chopped | 200 g bamboo shoots, sliced | 2 tablespoons chopped flat leaf parsley
instructions: Layer meat, peas, peppers, orange peel in a large bowl. Mix thoroughly. Cover and refrigerate 8 hours, or overnight. Add sprouted leaves to bowl. Toss gently. Sprinkle with parsley.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,celery rib,celery salt,fennel seed,applesauce,sesame seed
title: Beef Applesauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs beef stew meat ( i have always used a mix of this and for a few pounds of meat i use a 1kg. ) | 3 cups applesauce or 3 cups apple juice | 1/4 teaspoon celery salt | 1/4 teaspoon celery salt | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds | 1 teaspoon fresh ground fennel seed or 1/4 teaspoon ground fennel seed
instructions: Note, i don’t know the other stuff i’ve added to the applesauce or sauce in this recipe. It’s just that i thought it was there. The amount of applesauce or apple juice i use depends on how thick you like your sauce. You can add up to 1/2 cup if you’d like, but i don’t recommend making the sauce too thin unless it’s very thick.

Random Ingredients: canola oil,cheddar cheese,chili pepper flake,worcestershire sauce,linguine,frying chicken,yogurt
title: Cheddar Chicken Linguine
ingredients: 3 lbs frying chickens | 3 lbs grated cheddar cheese ( not prebaked ) | 1/2 cup worcestershire sauce | 1/4 cup canola oil | 2 tablespoons chili pepper flakes | 1 carton yogurt | 1 1 lb linguine ( or linguine, cooked and drained )
instructions: Mix all sauce ingredients except yogurt and linguine. Add enough yogurt to coat, just enough to cover chicken. Refrigerate overnight. Saute chicken in oil until it is cooked and lightly browned on outside about 10 minutes. Drain chicken on paper towels. Remove any loose fat. Saute linguine according to directions. Serve with sauce.

title: Nacho Cheese Dip

instructions: Shake all together in a jar and leave to stand for a least half an hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,black eyed pea,strawberry preserve,cardamom seed
title: Korma
ingredients: 16 ounces canned black-eyed peas, drained | 2 packages sharp cheddar cheese, shredded | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seeds, crushed | 1/2 cup strawberry preserves, any flavor
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Line a glass 9x13 inch baking dish with aluminum foil. Add black eyed pea to a bowl and mash well with a fork or potato masher. Stir in half of the cheese, cheese and crushed cardamom seeds. Spread mixture into the pan. Sprinkle the rest of the cheese over the top. Cut off a chunk of the remaining black eyed peas from the can. Sprinkle the rest of the cheese over the top. Cover and bake for 45 to 50 minutes at 350 degrees f, or until center is set. Remove from oven, and cool 5 minutes. Cut into squares.

title: Herbed Spiced Beef and Coffee Mix
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried herbs | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 cup pecans ( finely chopped ) or 1 cup walnuts ( finely chopped ) | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 2 lbs ground round | 3 tablespoons dried tarragon | lettuce ( to serve ) | 12 ounces brewed tea
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Put herbs and beef oxo in a small bowl and mix together well. Add nutmeg and tarragon to beef and nut mixture.

title: Wayne's Okra and Okra Stir Fry
ingredients: 1 pound baby okra | worcestershire sauce to taste
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Blanch the okra briefly in boiling water and set aside to cool, about 15 minutes. Transfer the okra and okra to a large, nonstick skillet. Place the coated okra in the hot water. When the okra has begun to soften but is not browned, remove it to a plate lined with paper towels. Sprinkle the okra with worcestershire sauce and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: pepperoncini pepper,potato starch,grape tomato,ice water,cassava,cayenne pepper,self rising flour
title: Chef John's Papas Con Papas
ingredients: 1 potato starch, for dusting | 1/4 cup self rising flour | 1/4 cup cold water | 1 teaspoon pepperoncini pepper | 4 ounces cassava, hulled and peeled | 1 1/2 cups grape tomatoes, halved | 1/8 teaspoon ground cayenne pepper | 1/3 cup grape tomatoes, halved
instructions: To make the dough, mix potato starch and cold water together in a bowl to blend. Add pepperoncini pepper, cassava, and grape tomatoes.

Random Ingredients: walnut,meat,apricot jam,water chestnut,egg substitute,taco seasoning mix,parmesan cheese,wonton skin
title: Taco Bites
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated wonton skins | 1/2 cup dried apricots or 1/2 cup dates | 1/4 cup water chestnut | 1 can reduced-fat meat, drained | 1/4 cup reduced sodium taco seasoning mix | 1/4 cup parmesan cheese | 1 egg substitute ( optional ) | 1/3 cup walnuts, coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°. Spray a 13x9 casserole dish with nonstick cooking spray. Spray wonton skins with nonstick cooking spray. Sprinkle the nuts on the wonton skins. Combine the marinade ingredients in a medium size bowl and spoon into wonton skins. Add the filling to the prepared baking dish, breaking it evenly. Bake in the preheated oven until heated through and heated through, about 7 to 8 minutes. Stir the wontons to loosen them and serve warm or at room temperature. Tip, if the pan has not been sprayed with nonstick cooking spray, you may bake several bites to allow the skins to crisp.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,palm sugar,apple juice,salt black pepper,red food coloring,cocoa
title: Apple Ginger Fondue
ingredients: 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 3 large apples - peeled, cored, and chopped | 1/3 cup apple juice | 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa | 1 green snake food coloring ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons palm sugar | 1 pinch salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Heat oil in a small skillet over medium heat and cook and stir the apple and cocoa together until the mixture is slightly reduced, about 1 minute. Stir in the apple juice and cook, stirring, until heated through again, about 1 minute.

title: Hot Chocolate
ingredients: 1 teaspoon instant coffee | 1 cup chopped onion | 1 scallion, chopped
instructions: Add all ingredients into a mug and stir well.

Random Ingredients: lasagna noodle,pepper flake,egg substitute,speculoos biscuit ginger cracker,raspberry
title: Luxury Low Carb Pepper Hush Puppies
ingredients: 9 ounces lasagna noodles | 2 ounces speculoos biscuits ( ginger & spice crackers, crushed or grated ) | 1/8 teaspoon dried crushed pepper flakes | 1 cup fat free egg substitute ( egg beaters ) | 1/4 cup berries
instructions: Bring large pot of water to boil with 3/4 teaspoon salt. When boiling, add noodles and cook for 2 minutes, or until tender. Rinse under cold water and drain. Mix in biscuit crumbs, crushed pepper and remaining salt. Lightly oil a frying pan and fry until golden. You may need to use an oven spray, but it will help it firm up more in the end no matter how much water has passed out and the cookie dough will firm up and chewy. Serve hot, or leave to cool.

Random Ingredients: hazelnut,sauerkraut,cheddar cheese,cherry tomato,self rising flour,steak,balsamic vinegar,green chilies
title: Cheese Manteles (Dip)
ingredients: 12 ounces self-rising flour, sifted | 12 ounces lean grated steaks | 8 ounces aged cheddar cheese | 2 canned green chilies | 7 ounces hazelnuts | 6 cherry tomatoes, halved | 2 teaspoons balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons chopped walnuts, toasted
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Cut the veg. Rise in half lengthways and scrape out all the soft white pulp from inside the veg. Place in a large bowl and crumble over the cheese. Mince the chillies and add to the cheese with the hazelnuts. Mix and season well with salt and pepper. Stir the flour and knead lightly until it is shaggy. Add the sifted cheeses, alternating with the chillies, to the cheese mixture. Roll out one third of the dough into a circle about 20 inches in diameter, and place on a greased baking sheet. Place in the oven and bake for 20 minutes until crisp, golden and springy. Remove from the oven, cut in wedges. Sprinkle with walnuts and serve.

title: Vegetable Chocolate Oatmeal Casserole
ingredients: 1 cup quick cooking oats | 1 cup half-and-half | 1 can yellow squash | 1 small zucchini | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa powder
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large bowl and mix with your hands. Press into an oblong casserole dish that's been sprayed with cooking spray. Bake at 375 degrees for 25 - 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chocolate candy bar,cardamom,marjoram,orange peel,onion,dark sesame oil
title: Onion-Sesame Spiders
ingredients: 1/4 cup dark sesame oil | 1/2 small onion, finely chopped | 1 chocolate candy bar | 2 oranges, peeled and grated | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1/2 teaspoon marjoram | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom
instructions: Place the sesame oil into a small skillet over medium, and cook slowly, stirring constantly, until fragrant. Stir in the onion, and cook until clear. Mix together the chocolate candy bar, orange peel, salt, marjoram, and cardamom.

title: Indian Riggies With Cucumber and Ginger
ingredients: 500 g rigatoni pasta | 3 kirby cucumbers ( or 2 small unpeeled cucumbers ) | 1/4 cup fresh ginger | 1 can sliced cardamom seeds
instructions: Wash the zucchini and cut into 2 inch cubes. Peel the ginger and cut it into 5 slices. Place the sliced cucumbers in a microwave safe bowl and top with 1 cup boiling water. Cover and microwave on high for 3 - 5 minutes. Drain the zucchini and add both to the bowl with the ginger. Stir to combine. Add the cardamom and stir to combine and set aside for 15 minutes to firm up. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: red enchilada sauce,serrano pepper,vegetable broth,swiss cheese,sugar
title: Green Mexican Enchiladas
ingredients: 24 ounces can vegetable broth ( v8 or swanson's, use your favorite brand ) | 1/4 sugar or 1/4 splenda sugar substitute | 1 serrano pepper, seeded and diced ( optional ) | 1/4 cup red enchilada sauce | 1/2 cup swiss cheese, grated ( optional )
instructions: In a small saucepan or skillet, combine broth, sugar and diced pepper. Heat to boiling and add drained salsa and enchilada sauce. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 15 minutes. While warm, drain liquid and add cheese. Heat briefly to combine. Serve and enjoy.

title: Sofiya (Spiced Soy Custard)
ingredients: 12 ounces plain breadcrumbs | 3/4 cup soymilk | 1 teaspoon red chili powder | 1/2 teaspoon ground red chili powder | 1/3 cup fresh breadcrumb | 1/3 cup custard | 1 tablespoon soy sauce
instructions: Line a baking tray with aluminum foil or greased parchment paper. In the bowl of a mixer, combine the bread crumbs, soymilk, chilli and red chili powder, then mix on high speed until combined. Add the breadcrumb mixture in a steady stream, blending for 10 seconds after each addition. Spoon mixture into the prepared baking tray and smooth out the top. In a jug, combine the fresh bread crumbs, milk, soy sauce and custard. Mix until smooth. Spoon mixture into an 8 ounce glass and smooth out with a spatula. Let stand 5 minutes then turn out onto a serving dish, and serve with hot fresh vegetables or rice.

title: Aniseed Chicken
ingredients: 2 cans pinto beans | 1/2 lb hamburger | 3 teaspoons anise seed | 1 teaspoon cornmeal | 1 tablespoon salt, divided | 1 teaspoon onion flakes | 2 dashes anise ( or one clove if desired ) | 1 teaspoon allspice
instructions: Drain beans and put through a colander.

Random Ingredients: sausage,french bread lengthwise,yellow cornmeal,serrano chili,poultry seasoning,apricot,lite olive oil
title: Mexican Sausage Cornbread
ingredients: 1 lb sweet sausage, cut in 1/4-inch slices approximately 3/4-inch wide | 2 tablespoons lite olive oil | 6 -8 slices french bread, 1/4-inch sliced lengthwise | 1 1/2 teaspoons paprika or 1 1/2 teaspoons fajita seasoning ( to taste ) | 3/4 cup yellow cornmeal | 1 serrano chili, seeded and finely minced ( i use chipotle ) | 1/2 teaspoon poultry seasoning
instructions: In a large skillet, heat oil over medium high heat. Add sausage and cook, turning with a wooden spoon, until sausage is browned, about 8 minutes. Transfer mixture to a plate and set aside. Drain excess fat from skillet. Return skillet to medium heat. Drain excess grease. Return skillet to medium heat and add bread slices. Sprinkle each round with paprika/fajita seasoning. Serve bread on plates with sausage and/or bread slices and garnish with minced serrano chile, additional paprika, poultry seasoning, or chile oil.

title: Tunisian Cream Soda
ingredients: 1 cup half-and-half or 1 cup milk | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 teaspoon vanilla-flavored soymilk | 1/2 teaspoon harissa
instructions: In a mixing bowl, whisk together all the ingredients. Then pour into a small glass or non metallic container that is just large enough to fit all ingredients in a single layer. Allow to set at room temperature for about 1 hour, stirring occasionally. Use after that time, and check for sweetness as desired.

title: Mango Fool (Pink)
ingredients: 2 mangos in juice | 1 liter mango juice | 3 celery ribs | 1 bottle sherry wine
instructions: Peel and chop mango. In a blender add mango and 1 liter of the mango juice and puree for 5 minutes. Pour remaining mango juice into a bowl and add sherry. Refridgerate for 2 hours. Serve topped with whipped cream or ice cubes.

title: Mcdonald's Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb chuck roast | 1/2 cup thousand island dressing ( not dressing any more ) | white vinegar, to cover roast
instructions: Place roast in a crock pot.

Random Ingredients: ginger,broccoli floret,asiago cheese,rom tomato,deli roast beef,dark muscovado sugar,celery
title: Roast Beef with Broccoli and Heirloom Tomatoes
ingredients: 1/2 cup dark muscovado sugar | 1 whole top round roast beef, cut diagonally in half | 1/2 cup broccoli floret | 1/4 - 1/2 cup celery, thinly sliced diagonally ( about 4 stalks ) | 1 roma tomato, sliced very thinly | 1/4 - 1/2 cup parmi grana padano or 1/4-1/2 cup asiago cheese, shredded ( about 3 oz ) | 1/8 teaspoon ground ginger, if available
instructions: Place sugar in small bowl with 1/2 cup water, stirring well. Microwave on high until sugar becomes very light brown, 2 - 3 minutes, stirring once or twice.

Random Ingredients: spanish onion,leek,arborio rice,plum tomato,vegetarian bean,black eyed pea,margarine
title: Rice Bean and Leek Bake (Rice and Beans)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons margarine or 2 tablespoons butter | 1/4 spanish onion, finely sliced or 1/4 green onion, finely sliced | 1 leek, thinly sliced | 1 can vegetarian baked beans or ( 16 ounce ) can black beans, rinsed and drained | 1 cup arborio rice ( not instant ) | 1 plum tomato, thinly sliced | 1 1/2 cups arugula or 1 1/2 cups spinach
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit. To prepare rince & beans, in heavy medium saucepan heat margarine over med high heat. Add onion and leek then cook until tender, about 3 minutes. Stir in beans & cook until heated through, about 3 - 4 minutes. Add rice and tomato, stir to combine. Transfer to 2 - ½ qt baking dish. Cover with foil & bake 15 minutes. Uncover & sprinkle with top fresh coriander. Return to oven & bake until top starts to turn golden brown, about 5 minutes. Top with tomato, parsley, & greens before serving. Serving suggestions, serve with warm bread and crusty french bread to mop up extra broth.

title: Easy Irish Muffins
ingredients: 3/4 lb baking potato, scrubbed and cut into 1/2 inch peices | 1 teaspoon quick-rise yeast | 1/4 lb suet, chopped roughly | 3/4 cup lemonade
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Place potato peices in a large skillet and sprinkle lightly with salt and pepper. Add one tsp of quick rise yeast. Add remaining ingredients and stir, cooking 2 - 3 minutes. Set aside 5 minutes over medium low heat. Stir and place on a large greased baking sheet. Bake for 35 - 40 minutes or until golden brown and crispy. Let cool for 5 minutes and serve.

Random Ingredients: carrot,horseradish,plain nonfat yogurt,cheddar cheese,water,pine nut,white rice
title: Greek Rice With Carrots, Cheese, and Horseradish
ingredients: 2 cups cooked white rice ( i use kohl brand ) | 1 cup shredded carrot | 1 1/2 cups cheddar cheese, grated | 2 tablespoons pine nuts, toasted ( optional ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup plain nonfat yogurt ( to taste ) | 1/8 - 1/4 cup horseradish | 2 -4 tablespoons water
instructions: Cook rice and carrots according to package directions. Place grated cheese in a small bowl. In a small bowl, mix together the desired amount of yogurt, horseradish, and water. Pour yogurt mixture over rice mixture in bowl and mix until well combined. Serve in individual serving bowls with pine nuts. Garnish with additional tzatziki on the side.

Random Ingredients: white bean,part ricotta cheese,thai red curry paste,apricot preserve,enchilada sauce
title: White Bean and Curry Dip
ingredients: 1 can white beans, rinsed and drained | 1 jar apricot preserves | 2 tablespoons thai red curry paste | 1/2 lb part-skim ricotta cheese | 1 can enchilada sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a medium saucepan. Cook over medium heat until bubbly. Lower heat and simmer uncovered 4 - 5 minutes, or more. Serve warm with tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: apricot,chipotle chile adobo,chervil,spinach leaf,black pepper,chili flake,pork sausage link,beef chuck
title: Beef & Spinach Sausage Rolls
ingredients: 3 garlic sausage links, casing removed | 2 beef chuck, links cracked | 2 teaspoons dried basil | 2 teaspoons chili flakes, preferably fresh or 1 1/2 teaspoons hot pepper flakes | 1/4 teaspoon black pepper | 2 chipotle chiles in adobo, minced | 1/3 cup chopped dried apricot | 2 cups chopped fresh spinach leaves | freshly torn fresh chervil ( garnish )
instructions: Brown the sausage pieces over medium heat with the garlic and chili powder. Remove from the heat when almost browned. Add basil, chilies, and pepper flakes. Add the meat and stir until combined. Cover the pan and simmer for 2 hours, stirring every 15 minutes. Add the apricots and spinach if using, and bake for 30 minutes or until the meats are cooked through.

Random Ingredients: white button mushroom,bread,guacamole,wheat bread,granny smith apple,peanut,white vinegar,sesame oil
title: Apple and Mushroom Patties With Hoisin Sauce
ingredients: 8 slices white bread | 4 ounces white button mushrooms, finely chopped | 2 granny smith apples, peeled, cored and roughly chopped | 1/4 cup white vinegar | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 2 tablespoons hoisin sauce or 2 tablespoons soy sauce | peanuts, chopped to serve
instructions: Remove crusts from bread, leaving a little crust on each slice. Heat 2 tbsp sesame oil in a frying pan over a medium heat. Add the mushrooms and apples. Cook, stirring, for about 3 mins or until the apple and mushrooms are soft and the apple starts to brown. Add vinegar and soy sauce and bring to boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 mins or until thick. If the sauce is too thin, stir in little water. Meanwhile toast bread lightly. Cut each slice in half and put into a large bowl. Toss with 1 tbsp sesame oil. Divide the mushroom mixture between 2 bread halves. Top each with a handful of toasted bread. Heat over a hot griddle or skillet until bubbling.

Random Ingredients: cottage cheese,mint leaf,puff pastry,sherry wine,reg dressing,taco seasoning
title: Puffed Pastry Pastries With Taco Nests
ingredients: 12 ounces puff pastry, thawed if frozen if frozen | 1 cup fat-free cottage cheese | 2 tablespoons roasted shredded taco seasoning | 2 teaspoons dry sherry wine | 1 tablespoon hidden valley & reg ; original ranch & reg ; dressing | 1 teaspoon minced fresh mint leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°. On a lightly floured surface, roll out the pastry to a 14 inch square. Place in a 14 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish.

title: Halloumi With Shrimp
ingredients: 600 g shrimp | 200 g halloumi cheese | 1 large pork chop
instructions: Remove and set aside large shrimp from shells. Cut the shrimp into 3cm cubes or smaller. Preheat oven to 180c or 400f. Cut cheese into 4 equal pieces and then cut into slices on the diagonal. Sear the pork chop in a baking dish with a touch of olive oil, adding a little salt. Place half of the shrimp on a piece of cheese and roll with the shrimp. Place the breaded pork chop on top, drizzle over a little olive oil and bake for 30 mins until the top gets a lovely crisp crust.

Random Ingredients: cashew milk,allspice,dark rum,yellow miso,quince,green onion,vanilla essence
title: Miso Glazed Goat Cheese With Dried Fruit
ingredients: 8 ounces yellow miso ( i prefer pumpernickel ) | 2 quinces, peeled and cut in half ( see notes below ) | 1 cup cashew milk | 2 tablespoons green onions, sliced ( optional ) | 2 drops vanilla essence | 1/8 teaspoon allspice
instructions: Combine the miso, quinces, cashew, milk, green onion, vanilla and allspice in a small saucepan over low heat. Bring to simmering point, then lower heat and simmer gently to infuse for 20 minutes. Drizzle in a few drops of rum just before serving. Note, the dried fruit can be replaced with a few canned or vacuum packed blueberries or strawberries. It will keep in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks.

title: Ethiopian Spice Mix
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups breadcrumbs | 1 1/2 teaspoons cardamom pods, powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons celery salt | 1 teaspoon dry red chili pepper, crushed
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl.

title: Noodle Pilaf
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable broth or 1 tablespoon chicken broth, if possible | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla | 1/4 - 1/2 cup cold minute rice-noodle ( rice- noodle flavor )
instructions: Pour broth into a blender and puree until smooth.. Add vanilla and blend until well mixed and smooth. Add some of the flavored broth if necessary, or more or less of the desired amount. Set aside and refrigerate or freeze in an airtight container until cold. To serve, reheat gently on the stove top, stirring constantly. If using rice noodles, follow the package instructions or if using rice noodles, follow the package directions for soaking. If using rice noodles, rinse.

title: Chop & Fry Burger
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/4 lb hamburger | 1 teaspoon maple syrup or 1 teaspoon tamari | 2 teaspoons grated orange zest | 1 teaspoon dried onion | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon chili flakes | 1 cup frozen raspberries | fresh chutney ( optional )
instructions: Combine hamburger, maple, orange zest, onion, turmeric, chili flakes, berries, & tamari in bowl. Form into patties & fry on medium heat, about 5 minutes per side, topping with fresh chutney if desired & serving.

Random Ingredients: hamburger,hot chili pepper,gingerroot,red curry paste,straw mushroom,beef stock,anchovy,brown mustard seed
title: Red Curry With Beef and Mushrooms, Quickly
ingredients: 1/2 cup beef stock | 4 -5 teaspoons red curry paste | 3 tablespoons brown mustard seeds | 4 -5 pieces anchovies | 2 medium fresh hot chili peppers, chopped ( or less ) | 1 piece gingerroot, grated | 1 1/2 lbs hamburger, precooked meat, cubed slightly ( or more to your preference ) | 6 -8 fresh firm-ripened straw mushrooms, washed and slit
instructions: Combine the stock and curry paste together in a skillet and bring to the boil over high heat. As soon as the curry starts to boil, stir in the mustard seeds and anchovies. Cover and turn down the heat just a bit if it starts to sizzle. Boil rapidly for several minutes. Add the green chillies, ginger, and meat and continue to cook for a few minutes more. Add straw mushrooms, close the lid, and return to heat. Cover and simmer a few more minutes. Remove from heat and allow to sit for a few minutes. Turn off the heat. Check the seasonings and serve over white rice.

title: Vietnamese Onion Rice Salad
ingredients: 2 cups basmati rice | 1 small serrano peppers or 1 small red chili pepper | 3 tablespoons rice vinegar
instructions: Wash and soak the rice for 2 hours. Put in a sieve and shake the rice until the water starts to clear. Add all ingredients and mix well. Serve as a side dish, or as an accompaniment with meat, poultry or vegetables.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,chicken leg,monterey jack cheese,black bean
title: Cuban Black Bean Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken legs with thigh | 4 cans black beans, rinsed | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 2 cups shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Arrange chicken legs on a baking sheet. Roast the chicken in preheated oven until no longer pink in the center and juices run clear, about 35 minutes. An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees f when taken from the oven. Turn the chicken legs over and continue to bake until the chicken is no longer pink from the bone. An instant read thermometer inserted into the thickest part of the thigh should read 165 degrees f when taken from the oven. An instant read thermometer inserted into the thickest part of a thigh should read 165 degrees f when taken from the oven. Remove chicken legs from the oven, pour off any remaining juices and set aside. Bring black beans and balsamic vinegar to a boil in a saucepan over medium heat, then reduce heat to medium low and simmer until the liquid is reduced to about 2/3 its previous consistency, about 20 minutes. Stir in the cubed cheese until melted. Serve chicken legs with black beans and balsamic flavored sauce on the side.

title: Peach & Cappuccino
ingredients: cooking oats | 4 frozen peaches, cut in slices | 1 acorn squash, cut in slices | 4 frozen peach slices, drained | 1 packet shake-and-pop coffee | 2 tablespoons quick-cooking oats | sweetened condensed milk, to drizzle during last 2 minutes of cooking
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f spray 2 - 2 1/2 inch ovenproof cups with oil. Combine oats and peaches in a medium bowl. Place squash slices, cut side up, on top of oat mixture. Pour in coffee and bake 18 minutes or until tender. Spread sliced banana pieces atop with remaining oat mixture. Sprinkle with sweetened condensed milk.

title: Yellow Squash in Muffins
ingredients: 2 large yellow squash, halved lengthways, scooped out seeds and cut in half if they are large | 1 large red bell pepper, chopped into small cubes | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 teaspoon dried cornflour or 1 teaspoon arrowroot
instructions: Boil all the ingredients in a pan on medium heat until they are tender. Add the corn flour or arrowroot to thicken. Serve with toast.

Random Ingredients: nectarine,bean,self rising flour,white bread,orange zest,pistachio,white chocolate
title: Nectarine and White Chocolate Friands
ingredients: 6 ounces strong white chocolate | 12 ounces mixed beans, such as red chilies, such as cannellini beans, and | orange zest, finely chopped | 4 nectarines, halved and deseeded | 4 ounces self-rising flour | toasted crushed shelled pistachios | 6 ounces white chocolate | 2 ounces white bread, crumbs
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f melt the chocolate with the orange zest in a bowl set over a pan of boiling water. Keep stirring until the mixture is smooth. Meanwhile, whisk the beans and zest together. Set aside to cool. Whisk the flour in a large bowl to a smooth paste with a pinch of salt. Add the softened white and white chocolate mixture and stir to combine. Add the nectarines and mix again. Place a piece of white or brown bread at the base of six friands pans. Spread half the nut mixture over the base and sides of each friand. Spread the mixed beans over the nuts and friands, then spoon the remaining nut mixture into the pan. Sprinkle with the pistachios and cook for 15 to 20 minutes in oven until golden.

title: Chinese Butter Cream
ingredients: 1 lb cold unsalted butter | 1/2 lb sake
instructions: Peel the butter and cut it into 2 or 3 pieces, then put it through a sieve to remove the rind and hard pieces. Pour the cold butter in a jar just large enough for the butter to soften slightly. Place the sifted butter in a large frying pan, put the lid on and leave it to melt slowly, stirring occasionally for 30 days or longer, adding a little extra butter as needed, stirring occasionally until the butter is pale golden in colour. Pour the melted butter into a clean jar and keep it in a cool place until ready to use.

title: Roasted Garlic Leeks
ingredients: 2 1/4 lbs leeks | 2 tablespoons hoisin sauce
instructions: Trim the leeks & cut off the tough stems. Cut a 1 inch lenghtwise slit lenghtwise, making about 3/4 full. Put the leeks in a bowl & add the hoisin sauce. Mix well & let the leeks marinate at room temperature for 2 hours. Preheat the oven to 350f degrees. Roast the leeks in the oven for about 45 minutes, or until the bottoms are tender and the top lightly browned. Remove with a slotted spoon & place on a dish. Drizzle the leeks with the caramelized juices.

Random Ingredients: yellow squash,picante sauce,saffron,extra virgin olive oil,fillet,cream cheese
title: Mexican Yellow Squash
ingredients: 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 1/2 lbs yellow squash, halved and thinly sliced | saffron | 1 jar salsa | 1 package cream cheese, softened | 1 bag fried fillets, warmed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add sliced squash and saute until squash is warmed through and slightly browned, about 5 minutes. Season squash with saffron and transfer to a large baking pan. Stir together salsa and 1/2 the cream cheese and spread over squash. Add another layer of saffron and cover. Bake until squash is tender, about 40 minutes. Uncover, toss with remaining cream cheese and cover and bake until cheese is melted, about 10 minutes longer. Place hot fillets on a plate and top with hot cheesy cream and remaining saffron. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: vegetable broth,poblano chile,vidalia onion,noodle,fennel bulb,almond extract,spaghetti,mostaccioli pasta
title: Pasta Al Morroccan
ingredients: 8 ounces mostaccioli pasta or 8 ounces penne | 1 large vidalia onion, sliced thinly | 1 large poblano chile, diced | 3/4 cup prepared vegetables, such as broccoli floret, bell pepper strips, mushrooms, zucchini or black beans | 3 cups vegetable broth | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract | 1 lb noodles, such as ditalini or 1 lb spaghetti, of choice | freshly grated fennel bulb, to garnish ( optional )
instructions: Bring 3 quarts of water to boil with 1 tablespoon salt. Add the pasta and cook until al dente, approximately 5 minutes. Drain and set aside to cool for 2 minutes. Drain pasta completely and place back in the pot. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a saucepan over medium heat. Saute the onion and poblano chile for 3 - 4 minutes or until onion starts to soften. Add the frozen vegetables and broth, increase heat and bring to boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 20 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Add almond extract and stir to combine. Toss pasta with the vegetables, vegetable broth, pasta, vegetables and sauce mixture. Garnish with fennel bulb if desired.

title: Barefoot Contessa's French Canadian Hard Boiled Eggs
ingredients: 6 hard-boiled eggs | celery seed
instructions: Remove tops and shells from hard boiled eggs. Carefully remove yolks with a vegetable peeler and discard. Wash thoroughly under running water to remove some of the black membrane. Slice in half lengthwise and carefully remove yolks. Insert 1/2 inch meat into each of the yolks. Close opening of egg yolk in a criss cross manner, making sure to leave some hole in the middle. Place the egg yolk in a large, heavy skillet. Fill each shell with approximately 1/4 cup water. Cover and simmer over low heat until yolks are just beginning to solidify. The water should be covering the eggs as you make them. This will take about 1 1/2 hours total for medium or 5 - 6 hours for well done. Remove from heat and allow to cool to room temperature before opening. To make creme anglaise, place egg whites in a glass baking dish that has been dipped in cold water for a few minutes, then cover dish with a dish towel and put in refrigerator to drain moisture. After at least 15 minutes, drain soaking water carefully.

title: Hot Peaches in Curry
ingredients: 4 large ripe peaches, cut into chunks | 3 -5 tablespoons szechuan dried ancho chili, crushed | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1 fresh poblano pepper, halved, seeded, deveined, and cut into thin strips | 3 tablespoons shichimi togarashi
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large non reactive saucepan. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer. Simmer, covered, turning pan occasionally, until peaches are tender and liquid has reduced, about 25 minutes. Ladle into individual ramekins, top with more shichimi togarashi and serve.

title: Quick and Easy Shortening for Salmon
ingredients: 1 tablespoon shortening | 24 fresh boneless skinless salmon
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. In a saucepan, combine shortening and salmon. Bring to temperature and allow to cook over low heat. Using a spoon, stir mixture until melted. Pierce a few holes all over salmon just under the skin. Place salmon on foil lined cookie sheet or in glass roasting pan. Cover with foil and allow to roast for 20 minutes. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,green chili pepper,shallot,oyster sauce,feta cheese,french green bean,cilantro,sole fillet
title: Thai-Style Sole Fillet (Phy) With Green Beans
ingredients: 1/2 cup finely chopped shallot | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro | 1 lb beef stew meat | 1 can french style green beans, drained | 1 package fish sauce | 1/3 cup chopped fresh cilantro | 1 tablespoon chopped green chili pepper | 1 1/2 lbs sole fillets | 2 soft fresh-type fresh-picked fresh green chili peppers, cored | 3/4 cup crumbled feta cheese
instructions: To make the dressing, combine shallots, 2 tbs. Of the reserved green bean liquid, and the fish sauce in a jar and shake. Place beef in a large, deep skillet. Add the green beans and 2 tbs. Of the reserved green bean liquid. Bring to a boil, turn with a spatula. Reduce heat.

title: Chinese Chilli Hummus
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 100 g bell peppers or 100 g red bell peppers, seeded and cut into 1 cm pieces
instructions: Place all ingredients in a food processor and buzz until smooth and creamy. Serve drizzled with soy sauce.

Random Ingredients: stewing beef,ice,mango pulp,coleslaw mix,chicken broth,curry powder,brown sugar
title: The Best Beef Curry Ever!
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs stewing beef | 2 -3 quarts chicken broth | 2 -3 teaspoons curry powder ( to taste ) | 4 cups mango pulp ( frozen or fresh ) | 1/2 cup brown sugar | ice | 6 cups coleslaw mix
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Cut stewing beef into 2 inch cubes. In a large crock pot, add beef, water, chicken broth, and curry,. Stir to combine. Turn slow cooker to high. Add mango pulp and brown sugar, mixing well. Pour over stewing beef.. Cook for 2 - 2 1/2 hours in crock pot. After 2 hours, remove from slow cooker and drain off liquid through a sieve, and add to a serving bowl. You may need to add a little water to keep the liquid moist. Taste and add sugar, seasoning if required. Pour over coleslaw and enjoy.

title: Armenian Country Style Pilaf With Dried Apricots and Beans
ingredients: 1 lb dried apricot, cut into wedges | 1/2 lb dried plums, cut into 2 3 inch pieces | 1 cup sweet potato, cut in rounds | 1/3 cup frozen green pea | 1/4 cup fresh spring onion, chopped | 5 tablespoons lard, cut into tiny cubes | 1 cup short grain rice
instructions: Soak fruits 10 minutes at room temperature in boiling water. Drain and rinse. Cut into 1/2 inch slices and place in a bowl. Add all remaining ingredients, except rice, and stir well. Divide mixture among 6 serving dishes. Cover and refrigerate several hours. Place rice in a large shallow baking pan. Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Dip each dish with cold water to moisten. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes. Serve rice topped with apricots and beans.

title: Hot-and-Sour Sushi Rolls
ingredients: 1 cup wasabi paste | 1 small pepperoncini pepper, seeded and diced | 1/2 cup celery, diced | 1 red chilies, minced or 1 small hot pepper, minced | 5 teaspoons chicken bouillon
instructions: Mix all ingredients and stir until well mixed. On a lightly floured surface, roll the sushi to 1/8 to ¼ inch thick, and cut the roll into 3 pieces. Serve with wasabi paste for dipping.

title: Garlic-Lavender Rice Noodles
ingredients: 1 package rice noodles | 1/4 cup cornstarch | 1/2 cup canola oil | 1/2 cup dried lavender, crumbled | freshly ground coarsely ground coarsely
instructions: Wash and soak rice noodles for 20 minutes in hot water. Drain and rinse under lukewarm running water. Cook noodles at a boil 3 - 5 minutes or till tender but firm. Drain and rinse under cold running water. Drain well. Coat large nonstick fry pan with oil and add noodles. Stir fry over medium high heat 2 - 3 minutes or till noodles are dark golden. Drain well. Set aside. Whip cornstarch, and mix in oil and lavender. Cook and stir over low heat for 1 minute longer or till well thickened and bubbly. Stir in noodles. Serve immediately, if desired.

Random Ingredients: bread flour,turmeric,tomato sauce,picante sauce,canadian bacon,sofrito sauce,white pepper
title: Bacon-Spoon Chili
ingredients: 2 slices canadian bacon, cut into 1/2 cm strips | 1 tablespoon tomato sauce | 1 tablespoon canadian bacon fat, cut into 1/2 inch pieces or 1 tablespoon canadian ham, cut into 1/2 cm pieces | 1/8 teaspoon turmeric, ground | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper | 1/8 cup picante sauce ( kikkoman ) | 2 cups bread flour
instructions: Brown bacon pieces in a large skillet on high heat, about 5 minutes, stirring frequently. Remove pieces and reserve. Brown remaining pieces of bacon in skillet, about 5 minutes. Return all pieces of bacon to pan. Sprinkle with turmeric, white pepper, and picante sauce. Bring to a boil. Add bread flour. Cover, reduce heat to simmer, and cook 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. If mixture becomes too thick, stir frequently. Note, use tomato sauce instead of picante sauce.

title: Nuoc Cham (Watercress Watercress) Soup
ingredients: 24 cups watercress, washed and stems trimmed | 2 teaspoons fish sauce, or more to taste
instructions: Place 10 cups watercress into a large, heavy bottomed pot. Bring to a boil, then simmer 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: egg substitute,ancho chile,shaoxing wine,currant,pork tenderloin,kosher salt,vegetable stock,pepperoni
title: Pot Sticker Beef Liver
ingredients: 2 lbs pork tenderloin | kosher salt, to taste | 1/2 teaspoon pepperoni, minced ( optional ) | 4 large eggs | 3 tablespoons shaoxing wine ( dry sherry ) | 2/3 cup fat free vegetable stock | 2 tablespoons dried ancho chiles ( crushed ) | 1/4 cup currants ( optional )
instructions: Slice the top 1/4 inch off of the tenderloin, then slice it thinly across the grain. Sprinkle with salt. Place on cutting board and slice into slices about 2 inches wide. Place slices on baking sheet. Place a baking sheet over the strips. Toss the slices with salt and pepperoni. Let sit at room temperature to marinate, ideally overnight. Whisk eggs, wine, and chiles together. Pour over the meat and let sit at room temperature for an hour. Preheat oven to 475 degrees fahrenheit. Place currants in a shallow baking pan, then coat with butter. Bake for 10 minutes. Serve with gravy, and garnish with fresh chopped cilantro.

title: Bread Machine Indian Bread
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups self-rising flour | 1 package of cornbread mix | 4 ounces of powdered sugar | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom
instructions: Put first six ingredients in bread machine. Turn on to dough setting. When cycle ends, press start check. If its too short, switch to baking. I've never had to add other ingredients, but if you make any other loaf, mix the sugar with the cardamom. Spread onto ungreased cookie sheet. I've seen recipes about bread machine adding yeast and butter to your mix. If its too runny, sprinkle in some cornmeal.

Random Ingredients: broccoli,pearl barley,chicken thigh fillet,asparagus,cardamom seed,turnip,veal,strawberry preserve
title: Quick and Easy Vegetarian Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 12 ounces chicken thigh fillets | 12 ounces chicken thighs fillets | 1/4 lb veal, sliced | 1/4 lb asparagus, cut into 2 inch pieces | 1 large turnip, sliced | 1 large broccoli, cut into 2 inch pieces | 1 -2 cup strawberry preserves | cardamom seeds ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 deg celsius. Cut chicken into small pieces. In an oven safe dish, place the chicken, veal and turnip, then add the broccoli and cover with the strawberry preserves. Sprinkle with a little cardamom seeds if using. Cook for 5 - 7 minutes. Serve with a salad and biscuits.

title: Sam's Easy Peanut Butter Peanut Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 can sliced bamboo shoots ( undrained ) | 1/4 cup peanut butter ( creamy or chunky )
instructions: Open one can of bamboo shoots and drain liquid. In a bowl, mix peanut butter and liquid. Stir well until peanut butter is completely mixed into peanut butter. Chill for a minimum of 30 minutes. Enjoy it and enjoy.

title: Best Ever Easy Bean Dip
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 can fat-free refried beans | 1 can frozen limeade concentrate, thawed and undiluted
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Spray two 9 inch round baking dishes with cooking spray. Spread bean dip in one dish and the taco sauce mix on the other dish. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until warmed through. Serve warm with tortilla chips.

title: Classic French Seasoned Salt
ingredients: 5 -6 tablespoons coarse salt | 1 tablespoon white coarse sea salt
instructions: Poke holes about 1/4 inch deep with a fork. Stick with fingers. Mix well and store in a cool, dry place for a week in a cool dry place. After several days, taste while curing, season with salt and continue curing until desired flavor and blemishes develop.

Random Ingredients: chocolate chip,radish,bacon,white wine vinegar,garlic powder,asiago cheese,dough,green
title: Faux Asiago Rolls
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups grated asiago cheese | 1 1/2 cups shredded green asiago cheese | 2 tablespoons shredded radishes | 3 tablespoons asiago cheese | 1/2 cup dry white wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 3 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 3 ounces bacon, sliced | 1 package prepared dough
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease two 12x18 inch baking sheets. Stir 2 grated asiago cheese, 1 1/2 cups grated asiago cheese, radishes, white wine vinegar, garlic powder, and 3 tablespoons white wine vinegar together in a bowl.

title: Tandoori Vegetable Saag
ingredients: 1 large courgette | 1 tablespoon red chili powder
instructions: Wash the courgettes and cut in 3 - 4 cm cubes. Add a tablespoon each of red chili powder and red chilies in each piece and put aside. Heat oil in a non stick pan. Add the courgettes and fry. They should not be sticking. Drain on clean paper napkins. Serve hot.

title: Cupy's Southwestern Bread
ingredients: 1 package active dry yeast | 1 1/2 cups dry chunky salsa ( like pace ) | 1/4 cup sugar ( or to taste ) | 1 package powdered sugar
instructions: Place the yeast in a large bowl, and let sit for 5 - 6 minutes. Stir in the salsa, mixing to dissolve the sugar. Place the bowl into a warm oven and let it sit for 1 hour. Turn the oven heat to 400°f. Grease a 15 x10 x1 baking pan or line it with parchment paper. Pour the batter into the prepared pan. Allow it to rise, uncovered, for 35 - 45 minutes. While the bread is rising, dissolve 1/4 cup sugar in 1/4 cup water in a small pan. Bring to a boil, then simmer on low for 5 minutes, then remove from the heat. When the bread reaches 40 - 50 minutes, remove it from the oven and spread the cake with the glaze. Allow to cool until it just starts to set. Cut into 6 portions, and serve warm. These can be frozen.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon powder,white wine vinegar,mozzarella cheese
title: Italian Chicken Sandwiches (Low Fat)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon powder ( or to taste ) | 2 tablespoons dry white wine vinegar | 5 -6 ounces fat-free mozzarella cheese, thinly sliced and cut into 1/3-inch cubes
instructions: Combine bouillon powder, vinegar and cheese in pie plate. Add chicken and turn to coat thoroughly. Add bread cubes, cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate at least 20 minutes before serving.

title: Quick Beef Spirals
ingredients: 4 veal cutlets, pounded to 8x16 inch thickness | 1/3 cup flour | 1 cup buttermilk | 2 tablespoons caper liquid ( or liquid from capers ) | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh basil | 2 -4 seedless grapes
instructions: Place cutlets between 2 sheets of wax paper, cut in half. With a meat mallet, press thinly to flatten. Repeat with remaining cutlets and sprinkle each with flour. In a small bowl, mix half the buttermilk with caper, basil, and remaining buttermilk. Drizzle one side of each roll with about half the caper mixture and a few grapes. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium low heat and add rolls. Simmer for 3 - 4 minutes. Turn and cook for another 3 - 4 minutes. Remove roll slices to a plate and keep warm in a low oven. Add remaining caper liquid to skillet and whisk until almost all evaporated.

title: Roasted Green Chile Beans
ingredients: 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed | 1 poblano chile, roasted, peeled and shredded - or more to taste | 1 tablespoon distilled white vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Spread beans onto a baking sheet. Roast in oven, stirring twice and sprinkling with a pinch of salt, about 10 minutes, until fragrant and slightly charred. Let cool, then cut into 1 inch chunks, or puree them in a blender. Place poblano and vinegar in microwave safe bowl, drizzle with a few tablespoons of oil and stir for just a few seconds. Place tomatoes onto a baking sheet, bake in the oven, turning them once, until tomato skins start to peel away, about 10 minutes. Immediately remove skin from tomatoes with a slotted spoon and set aside. Roast beans in the oven, stirring every 5 minutes, until they look soft and chewy, 25 to 30 minutes total cooking time, adjusting oven temperature as necessary to prevent burning. Place beans on a platter and sprinkle with a small amount of salt. Sprinkle with some tomato puree, garnish with a sprig of cilantro, and serve.

title: Sweet Potato and Olive Fritters, Cyprus (Barefoot Contessa)
ingredients: 16 ounces sicilian olives, drained | 1 lb sweet potato, peeled and chopped | 1/2 lb dried cherry, finely chopped | 1/2 lb dried sweet onion, finely chopped | 3 ounces vegetable shortening | 1 teaspoon vanilla sugar
instructions: Place the olives, sweet potato and onions in an electric mixer on high speed. With the mixer running and scraping off the vegetables as necessary. Add the shortening and vanilla sugar and mix until mixture is fluffy and smooth. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Transfer to a serving dish and pour liquid over. Allow mixture to sit for 30 minutes before serving.

title: Italian Sausage and Chile Rellenos
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs italian sausage, casings removed | 8 large julianne-style roasted red chili peppers | 6 ounces smoked pork fatback, cut into 1/2 inch dice | 3 hard-cooked whole-grain rye bread, cut into 1/2 inch cubes
instructions: Toast the julianne style chile in a toaster over moderate heat, covered, stirring until most of the liquid evaporates, about 7 minutes. Transfer the chile to a medium bowl, and cover with plastic wrap. Let stand, covered, for 10 minutes. Pulse the chile in a mini chopper, or mortar and pestle until it is coarsely chopped, and grind in a food processor. Strain the puree through a sieve into a bowl, pressing hard on the chile with the back of a spoon to extract as much liquid as possible. Return the puree to the pan. Add all of the sausage, pork fatback, and half of the bread cubes and simmer, stirring occasionally and breaking up the meat with a wooden spoon, until the fat is crispy and beginning to brown, about 20 minutes. Remove the meat from the heat. Stir in the remaining bread cubes until well mixed.

title: Pecan Beef and Penne
ingredients: 1 package barilla couscous | 1 lb boneless pork loin, cut into 3x1/2-inch squares | 1 can beefsteak tomatoes, undrained and chopped | 1 cup bean sprouts, drained | 3 tablespoons dijon mustard, divided | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 8 ounces penne, cooked and kept warm | 1/2 cup chopped pecans, toasted
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f prepare pasta as directed on package. While pasta is cooking, stir pork, tomato, bean sprouts, mustard, and oregano in large bowl to blend. Add pasta.

title: Apple Breakfast Burritos
ingredients: 3/4 lb hamburger | 3/4 lb apple | 3/4 cup cooked hamburger | 4 1/2 teaspoons brandy or 4 1/2 teaspoons whiskey | 1/2 teaspoon dates, dried ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon apple, grated ( optional ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons heavy whipping cream ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon chopped dates | 1 tablespoon chopped pitted dates, dried ( optional )
instructions: Melt the fat in a skillet and brown the hamburger and apple till cooked through. Turn out meat mixture and let cool, add rest of ingredients. Shape burrito mixture into balls, place on a lightly oiled cookie sheet. Bake at 350 for about 15 minutes.

title: Chocolate Peach Salad
ingredients: 1 peach, peeled, halved, and sliced | 2 slices nori ( sweet soy seaweed ) | 1 tablespoon currants | 2 teaspoons dried oreo cookies | 3 tablespoons wine ( optional )
instructions: Arrange half the peach slices in the center of the nori sheets, then sprinkle with half the nori sheet and all the currants and oreo cookies. Drizzle with a little wine if using. Repeat with the other half of the nori sheets and fruit. Wrap tightly and chill before serving.

title: Jamaican Style Dry Rub for Pork
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons dried marjoram | 1 teaspoon dried fennel | 1/2 teaspoon ground milled fennel | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Tie dried spices together with kitchen twine. Store at room temperature. Rub 1/3 cup onto pork before grilling.

title: Simple Snack Time: Apricot
ingredients: 4 apricots, cut into 4 pieces | 1 can rotel tomatoes ( or 1-2 lg. tomatoes )
instructions: Dip the apricots in tomato sauce for about two minutes and put aside.. Put the rotel and the remaining can of tomatoes on the apricots then dip the apricots in the rest of the tomato sauce. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: milk,fish stock,watermelon,thai red curry paste,mint leaf,soymilk
title: Thai Fish Curd
ingredients: 1 2/3 cups milk or 1 2/3 cups cream | 1 1/3 cups watermelon, peeled cored, cubed | 1/4 cup fish stock | 1/4 cup light soymilk | 2 tablespoons chopped of fresh mint leaves ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons thai red curry paste
instructions: Heat milk or cream in a heavy medium saucepan over medium heat. Stir in watermelon and remove from the heat when it starts to bubble and curdles. Set aside. Mix the fish stock with soy milk gradually.

title: Ginger Beef and Tortellini
ingredients: 1 beef brisket, trimmed | 1/4 cup ginger paste | 1 smoked ham, sliced | 1 package tortellini | 1 package refrigerated cooked beef tips
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spread a layer of cheese cloth inside a 9x13 inch roasting pan. Arrange brisket and ginger paste over cheese cloth. Bake brisket, uncovered, in the preheated oven 1 hour. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add a layer of tortellini and return to a boil. Reduce heat to low.

Random Ingredients: asiago cheese,pepperoni,red pepper,chicken leg,gouda cheese,green onion,olive oil
title: Chicken With Asiago Cheese & Peppers
ingredients: 3 chicken legs | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 ounce asiago cheese, grated | 1/2 ounce gouda cheese, grated and room temperature | 24 slices pepperoni | 1/2 cup mixed finely chopped red peppers | 1/4 cup green onion, finely chopped
instructions: Rinse chicken. Place 1/3 of the asiago, gouda and pepperoni on work surface. Place each chicken leg on top of the cheese. Place 1/4 of the green onions or some other veggies around chicken. Roll each chicken up and place seam side down on a greased baking tray.. Cover with remaining asiago and most of the pepperono. Drizzle with oil. Bake at 425°f for about 30 - 40 minutes or until chicken browns and peppers are tender. You may add more pepperoni to the peppers if desired for more color. Serve with a side of spaghetti if desired.

Random Ingredients: mustard seed,cardamom powder,angel hair pasta,mozzarella cheese,white sesame seed,swiss cheese,rose water,garlic
title: Quick & Easy Swiss Bread Salad
ingredients: 1 lb angel hair pasta | 1 cup swiss cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup swiss cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup mozzarella cheese, shredded | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds, slightly crushed | 2 -4 cloves garlic, crushed | 2 teaspoons rose water | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1/2 teaspoon white sesame seeds ( optional )
instructions: Cook pasta till tender drain. In large bowl mix together all ingredients except the pasta & stir well. Add drained pasta and toss well. Serve chilled.

title: Lamb in Brandy Sauce
ingredients: 800 g lamb, cut into 1. 5 cm x 1. 5 cm | 1/2 cup brandy | 1 teaspoon star fruit, dried ( optional )
instructions: Combine the lamb and brandy and marinate the lamb for at least an hour, or overnight, turning occasionally. Sprinkle the star fruit over the lamb when ready to cook, it is best to baste. Alternatively you can cook the lamb in a bbq grill.

Random Ingredients: wheat tortilla,pork shoulder,gouda cheese,self rising flour,self raising flour
title: Momma's German Breakfast Burritos
ingredients: 1 lb ground pork shoulder | 1/8 cup self-raising flour | one 6 inch whole wheat tortillas | 3 ounces self-rising flour, approximately | 1 slice gouda cheese | 1 egg white or 1 tablespoon egg substitute
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Grease two 10 inch cast iron skillet. Place pork in a bowl, add flour and mix well. Wet the entire tortilla with cold water and press to remove as much water as possible. On a lightly floured surface, roll the tortilla into a 5 inch long burrito shape on the counter. Place the burritos into the skillet, seam side down. Spray a nonstick griddle with cooking spray and place the burritos in the skillet. Cook the burritos, flipping once until all sides are browned. Repeat with remaining ingredients. Serve warm.

title: Persian Beef and Broccoli Lovers
ingredients: 4 ounces plain chocolate, good quality | 4 ounces beef tenderloin, sliced very thinly | 12 1/2 ounces broccoli, cooked ( stems removed and florets finely chopped ) or 12 1/2 ounces cauliflower florets ( stems removed and florets finely chopped ) | 4 slices apple | 4 slabs roasted pistachios, chopped finely ( optional ) | 25 saffron strands | 5 plain croissants, toasted ( optional ) | 1/2 cup artichoke heart, sliced finely ( optional )
instructions: Melt chocolates in double boiler over simmering water.

Random Ingredients: rice wine,extra beef,monterey jack cheese,brown onion,green apple,italian tomato,palm oil,collard green
title: Mashed Pot With Beef
ingredients: 1 lb extra lean ground beef | 1 red shallot, minced or 1 green shallot, minced | 1/4 cup palm oil | 1 teaspoon brown onion, minced | 2 cups collard greens, cleaned and chopped | 1 can italian-style stewed tomatoes, drained and chopped | 2/3 cup rice wine or 2/3 cup dry white wine | 1/2 lb chopped monterey jack cheese or 8 ounces other green cheese, cut into 1/2-inch cubes
instructions: Preheat a large, deep skillet to high heat. Crumble beef into skillet and cook until no longer pink.

title: Russian Breakfast Mix #2
ingredients: 2 carrots, grated | 2 tablespoons red peppers | 50 g steamed smoked spanish breakfast tea | salt and white pepper, to taste
instructions: Spray or grease your oven trays. Mix all ingredients together. Bake at 200c for 25 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender. Enjoy.

title: Creamy Coronation Beef Liver Wraps
ingredients: 500 g ground beef | 1 tablespoon beef base or 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | lettuce leaf
instructions: Place beef, worcestershire sauce and salt in a bowl, mix very well using your hands. Form into roll shape, wrap in leaves or aluminium foil and leave to stand for 10 minutes. Heat griddle, fry one side until golden.

Random Ingredients: potato flake,romano cheese,strawberry,yellow bell pepper,strawberry jam,white balsamic vinegar,avocado,cherry tomato
title: Strawberry Avocados
ingredients: 3 large ripe avocados | 1 container sour cream | 3 tablespoons romano cheese | 1 tablespoon white balsamic vinegar | 1/4 cup potato flakes | 8 ounces strawberry jam | 1 -2 cup fresh cherry tomatoes | 3 fresh strawberries
instructions: Mash avocado with a fork in small bowl. Add the sour cream and romano cheese. Stir until mixed. Spread mixture on ungreased cookie sheet. Cook in preheated 450°f oven for 7 - 9 minutes or until lightly browned. Remove and cool until easy to handle. Slice tops off strawberries. To build, place avocado halves on lettuce or other leaf with stem and fruit in the center. Place slices of strawberry on top of the avocado. Dollop sour cream on top. Garnish with a cherry tomato.

title: Green Goddess Soup
ingredients: 2 cups vegetable stock | 1 bunch spring onion, chopped | 1 stalk lemongrass, finely chopped | 1/4 cup triple sec | 200 g berry beans | 1 cup watercress, cleaned and finely chopped
instructions: Heat vegetable stock in a saucepan over high heat. Add the spring onion, lemon grass and triple sec. Stir together, then add the beans. Cover and cook for 3 minutes until the beans are steaming hot, then add the watercress. Stir to combine. Ladle into bowls and serve hot.

title: Swiss Green Beans
ingredients: 1 lb fresh green beans, trimmed | 1/4 cup dried white whole wheat flour
instructions: Bring 2 quarts of water to a boil in a large kettle.

title: Rose petal and Pistachios Skewers
ingredients: 1/2 cup greek-style pistachio, chopped ( can use cashews ) | 1/2 cup roasted peanuts | 1/2 cup fresh parsley flakes | 1 tablespoon dried rose petals | 2 tablespoons rice wine or 2 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar | 2 -3 tablespoons yoghurt or 2 -3 tablespoons cream, to taste ( i like to use greek style, i use low fat )
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients. If using regular yoghurt, mix the yoghurt with the dry ingredients. Add yoghurt mixture to pistachios and mix well. Soak 10 skewers in cold water for 10 minutes, then thread with the pistachios and nuts. Keep skewers on a baking sheet lined with foil. Broil until golden brown.

title: Santa Fe Coleslaw III
ingredients: 1 package coleslaw mix | 1 container cool whip, thawed
instructions: Mix coleslaw mix with cool whip until evenly coated.

title: Oven Sweet Crumb Topping
ingredients: 1 can light coconut milk | 1/4 cup brown sugar, packed | 1/4 teaspoon ground red pepper | 300 g plain flour | 1/2 cup breadcrumbs
instructions: Heat oven to 180°c. Butter ovenproof dish. Combine milk, sugar and chile. Stir in flour. Spread evenly into greased dish. Sprinkle with breadcrumbs. Bake for 50 - 60 minutes or until golden and bubbling. Serve warm.

title: Crock Pot Chipoltes
ingredients: 1 -2 lb beef chuck, cubed | 1 chipotle peppers or 1 teaspoon canned chipotle pepper
instructions: Toss shredded beef with chipoltes. Place on the top of crockpot. Cook on high for 4 - 5 hours. Beef will be tender and the liquid will be absorbed.

title: Chile De Arbol Tapas
ingredients: 10 chipotle chiles in adobo, chopped ( about 2 ounces ) | 1/4 cup icing sugar | 2 tablespoons good quality worcestershire sauce
instructions: Place chiles and adobo in the blender. Add icing sugar and worcestershire sauce. Blend until thick. Refrigerate until needed.

Random Ingredients: sesame paste tahini,rice wine vinegar,eggplant,cherry tomato,kaffir lime leaf
title: Chinese Eggplant Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs eggplants ( or 1 or 2 asian eggplants ) | 1/3 cup sesame paste ( i used tahini which was very strong ) | 2 teaspoons rice wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon cherry tomatoes ( dried tomatoes can also be used, i actually used 3 ) | 4 kaffir lime leaves, torn in half crosswise
instructions: Preheat the oven or grill to high. Slice the eggplant thinly or slice all of it into 1/4 inch slices or slice all of the other way in thin strips. Place the eggplant in a colander and season lightly with salt. Dry the slices briefly using paper towels and set aside. Drain the eggplant, reserving the juice. Heat a grill pan to medium. Add a bit of oil to coat and saute the eggplant until lightly browned, remove the slices and leave to drain on paper towels. In a bowl, combine the reserved juice, sesame paste, rice wine vinegar, cherry tomatoes, kaffir lime leaves and salt and pepper to taste. Put the seasoned eggplant in a glass bowl on top and stir until evenly coated. Add the eggplant and coat with the mustard dressing. Serve at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: clove,burgundy wine,ginger root,wheat flour,orange bell pepper,chocolate,tamari soy sauce,curry paste
title: Moroccan Spiced Chocolate Crisps
ingredients: 2 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 2 tablespoons low-sodium tamari soy sauce | 1/2 cup dry burgundy wine | 3 tablespoons grated orange bell pepper | 2 tablespoons hot curry paste ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon minced fresh ginger root | 1/8 teaspoon ground cloves | 1 ounce semisweet chocolate, chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper or aluminum foil. In a glass or ceramic bowl, stir together the flour, tamari, wine, orange bell pepper, curry paste, ginger, and cloves to make a smooth batter. Pour the batter over the flour mixture. Using a slotted spoon, fold the mixture gently to coat.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,berry,thyme,angostura aromatic bitter,chicken,bay leaf,ginger,mushroom stem
title: Chicken Phrikas
ingredients: 1 whole chickens, cleaned | 1 bunch fresh mushrooms, cleaned | 2 cans mushroom stems and pieces | 1 bottle picante sauce ( or your favorite brand ) | 1 sprig fresh thyme | 1 sprig fresh thyme | 1 bay leaf | 1 1/2 teaspoons angostura aromatic bitters
instructions: Place chicken, and mushrooms in a large pot. If you prefer, it can be covered with a lid, to prevent the moisture from rising into the meat. Pour picante sauce on top of the chicken, then sprinkle herbs and thyme over everything. Add bay leaf, and angostura. Cover pot, and set the pot on medium heat. Cook for 1 hour and 45 min in a pot that has been sprayed with a nonstick spray. The liquid should be reduced and syrupy.

title: Broccoli and Celery Salad
ingredients: 1 medium celery rib, chopped | 1 head fresh broccoli floret | 1 tablespoon poppy seed
instructions: Boil broccoli in a large pot of salted water for about 5 minutes. Drain and cool slightly. In a blender or food processor, combine the celery, broccoli and poppy seeds, until mixture is a chunky consistency. Store tightly covered for up to 3 days at room temperature or freeze for up to 6 months.

title: Asian Style Vegetables With Yeast
ingredients: 1 lb veal | 1/2 cup green beans or 1/2 cup beans, cut into small cubes | 1/2 cup edamame, steamed ( frozen or fresh ) | 1/2 cup snow peas, finely chopped | 1 leek, sliced | 1 serrano pepper, diced ( use more or less, to taste ) | 8 1/2 ounces hoisin sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons instant yeast
instructions: Cube veal and saute in butter until cooked through. Add rest of ingredients. Let cook covered until veggies cook down. When done, remove cover. Cook until heated thru. Remove from heat and serve on toast or noodles of your choice. This recipe works best if you leave a small amount out and use other dishes as desired.

Random Ingredients: chicken meat,maraschino cherry,salad oil,prosciutto,curry powder,black bean
title: Curried Chicken Salad With Black Beans
ingredients: 1/2 lb chicken meat | 1 can black beans ( drained ) | 7 tablespoons salad oil | 4 slices prosciutto | 1 ounce maraschino cherry ( drained ) | 1 tablespoon curry powder
instructions: Chop off chicken meat and dice into thin strips. Heat oil in wok and add pepper strips, curry and mix into oil. Add chicken and black beans and stir fry for about 2 - 3 minutes, or until chicken is cooked. Dice prosciutto into tiny bits and add to wok. Stir in salad dressing and add cherries. Adjust to taste with salt and pepper.

title: Italian Soda Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups raisins | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 1/2 cup italian salad dressing | 2 cups soda water, cold
instructions: Place raisins and turmeric in a small bowl. Add salad dressing and stir to coat. Let sit 1 hour. Pour soda water into a small pitcher. Pour raisins into pitcher, then stir. Cover, and refrigerate overnight.

title: Cassava Chocolate Mousse
ingredients: 500 g cassava ( dried peeled desiccated ) | 1 liter thickened broth | chocolate baking squares
instructions: Put the cassava, 1 liter of chicken sauce and the 1 liter of broth in a food processor. Cover and process until smooth. Strain into a bowl and leave to cool in the liquid until it is just cold. Transfer the mixture into a pan. Heat the remaining broth. Remove the peel and the centre part of the cassava. Break into pieces, place into the soup and boil for around 5 minutes. Remove from the heat and stir in a piece of baking paper. Divide the almond meal between 4 serving bowls. To serve, spoon the cassava mixture into the bowl, top with the almond meal. Chill well and serve with a little extra chocolate.

title: Roast Beef and Fontina Cheese - No Boil
ingredients: 1 boneless beef roast | 1/2 cup fat-free brine-cured brine-cured lard | 1/4 cup water | 1 1/2 cups shredded fontina cheese ( about 4 ounces )
instructions: Line a 14 by 8 by 2 inch metal roasting pan with plastic wrap. Place roasting pan on a rack in a 12 ovenproof pan, about 11 to 13 inches in diameter. Turn rack in center of oven. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Pat beef dry with paper towels. Sprinkle beef with brine. Pour lard evenly over meat. Cover with plastic wrap. Working with one roast at a time, place roasting pan on rack. Working with one roast at a time, spread roast with 1/2 cup brine. Using the end of a fork or pastry brush, spread brine over brisket. Starting with a long side, roll up roast, beginning and ending with the short end. Starting and ending with the short end, roll up roast. Using a sharp knife, place a few slices lengthwise in pan. Repeat with remaining slices. Place pan in second roasting pan. Pour warm water into roasting pan. Cover tightly and refrigerate overnight or for up to 24 hours. When ready to cook, pour beef and brine mixture into roasting pan. Cover tightly and bake to desired doneness, about 1 hour 20 minutes. Sprinkle with fontina cheese. Let beef rest 15 minutes before slicing.

Random Ingredients: splenda sugar substitute,ketchup,snow pea,banana,active yeast,romano cheese
title: Mashed Bananas, Italian Style
ingredients: 3 tablespoons splenda sugar substitute, granular | 1/4 teaspoon active dry yeast ( not rapid-rise, but use an electric mixer for easier-spread ) | 1/2 cup ketchup | 1/2 cup shredded romano cheese | 8 large ripe bananas, peeled and sliced diagonally | 1/2 lb snow peas, trimmed
instructions: In a bowl, dissolve yeast and sugar in warm ketchup. Let stand 5 minutes or until bubbly. Stir in cheese. Spread in an 8 x 8 inch pan. Arrange half the banana over the sauce, followed by the remaining bananas and the peas. Bake at 400 degrees for 30 - 45 minutes, or until bubbly and lightly browned.

title: Gramma's Zoodles
ingredients: 1/4 cup molasses | 1 cup low sodium beef broth | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme | 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/2 teaspoon green cardamom pods | 1 large zucchini, trimmed, quartered lengthwise and sliced | lettuce, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Stir molasses, beef broth, chopped thyme, garlic salt, green cardamom pods, and zucchini together in a large saucepan and bring to a simmer over medium high heat. Reduce heat to low and simmer until zucchini is just tender, 2 to 3 minutes. Transfer to a separate dish and set aside to cool to warm. Transfer to a plate and stir cold zucchini mixture into chilled zucchini mixture. Cover and refrigerate until serving time. Garnish, if desired, with shredded lettuce.
