Random Ingredients: rice vinegar,coriander seed,white button mushroom,beer,hot water,ginger garlic paste,curry paste
title: Bitter Fried Beer Mushrooms
ingredients: 1/2 lb dry white button mushrooms | 1 tablespoon coriander seed | 1 tablespoon curry paste | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 tablespoon hot water | dry beer ( any type for dipping the beer shakers )
instructions: In a small frying pan, dry roast the coriander and curry paste for 1 minute or until aromatic. Combine the hot water and vinegar in a small bowl. Add the curry paste mixture and soy sauce to the oyster and ginger garlic, and stir to combine. Place a layer of the mushrooms in a pan. Top with another layer of mushrooms and continue layering in the same manner with the oil, water, and vinegar mixture. Add enough beer to submerge the mushrooms. Place a lid on the pan and allow the mushrooms to raise to the top of the pan. Continue submerging mushrooms until all of the beer shakers are floating on top of the mushrooms. Steam for 40 minutes, or until the mushrooms are cooked. Serve in a bowl, with some additional vinegar and curry on the side.

Random Ingredients: ginger root,horseradish mustard,stewing beef,sirloin,sun tomato oil,vanilla extract
title: Savory Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs stewing beef | 3 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon horseradish, coarsely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger root | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 teaspoon prepared horseradish mustard
instructions: In a large, deep saucepan, layer ingredients in order listed, starting with stew beef & ending with a layer of beef. Cover & cook over medium heat until meat is tender, about 1 1/2 hours. Stir before serving with a dollop of sour cream if desired.

Random Ingredients: italian seasoning mix,snow pea,white vinegar,black peppercorn,yellow cornmeal,walnut oil,beef bouillon cube,brown sugar
title: Beef With Snow Peas and Sun Dried Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless sirloin steaks ( cut into thin 1/4-inch strips ) | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, chopped, oil reserved | 1 small beef bouillon cube or 2 tablespoons vegetable cooking oil | 1 teaspoon fresh coarse black peppercorns or 1/4 teaspoon ground black peppercorns | 1 teaspoon dry italian seasoning ( or seasoning blend ) or 1 teaspoon italian seasoning ( or seasoning blend ) | 1/4 cup white vinegar | 1/4 cup walnut oil | 1/4 cup light brown sugar or 1/4 cup packed light brown sugar | 1/8 cup coarsely chopped fresh walnuts or 1/8 cup pecan halves, may be added instead
instructions: Sprinkle steak with salt and pepper. Place the sun dried tomatoes into a small bowl with 1/4 cup of the reserved sun dried tomato oil.

title: Molasses Fudge Balls
ingredients: 300 g marshmallow creme | 1/4 cup molasses
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl and mix well. Roll the mixture into small balls. Place on a greased tray and flatten slightly with the back of a small spoon. Allow to cool before cutting into squares or rectangles.

Random Ingredients: ancho chile powder,celery rib,anchovy,extra beef,pomegranate,mayonnaise,green chile pepper lengthwise,tart green apple
title: Spicy Shredded Beef Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup mayonnaise, preferably hellman's homestyle | 2 tablespoons pomegranate, dried | 1 teaspoon ancho chile powder | 1/2 teaspoon celery rib, minced | 1/4 teaspoon fresh green chile pepper, seeded and minced | 1/4 teaspoon canned tomatoes with anchos, halved lengthwise, chopped | 2/3 lb extra lean ground beef | 1 can pitted tart green apples, finely chopped
instructions: In a small bowl combine the mayonnaise, pomegranate, ancho, celery, chile, tomatoes, and beef. Stir to blend well. Refrigerate at least 20 minutes and up to 1 hour. Stir in the apples just before serving.

title: The Great Beans and Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 can condensed tomato soup ( no tomato soup? no soup? ) | 1 can chickpeas, drained | berries ( optional ) or mint ( optional )
instructions: Pour in a medium size bowl, and set aside. Add the condensed tomato soup, chickpeas and juice. Stir to mix. If desired, add mint or a fresh green to taste. Refrigerate overnight in the fridge, then serve. Also, if served right away, you can sprinkle with bread crumbs before serving. Variation, add a little chopped fresh cilantro for color and flavor. Variation, you can add olives, etc. Use 3/4 of can condensed soup for a little kick to this recipe. Variation, instead of the condensed tomato soup, you can use 3 cans of cannellini beans or other white beans.

title: Aubergine and Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 4 pork tenderloin | 1 teaspoon saffron strand | 1 large aubergine, cut into wedges
instructions: Preheat oven to 220 degrees celsius. Lightly grease a shallow roasting tin or roasting dish. Rub saffron strand over both sides of each tenderloin. Place meat on top of saffron coated meat and top with aubergine wedges. Cover with lid or with foil. Bake in oven for 30 minutes until meat thermometer registers 160 degrees celsius. Let stand for 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: apple cider vinegar,chili bean sauce,plain nonfat yogurt,chili pepper,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Chili-Spinach Cheese Dip
ingredients: 400 g plain nonfat yogurt | 1 teaspoon chili bean sauce | 1 tablespoon apple cider vinegar | 1 -2 tablespoon chili pepper ( crushed seeds ) | 1 -2 tablespoon sharp cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Combine all ingredients in a large mixing bowl and gently mix everything together, then add the grated cheese a little at a time until the dip has the desired consistency. Bake in oven for about 30 minutes or until the dip is hot and has a creamy flavour. Serve with vegies.

title: Greek Olive Salad
ingredients: 3/4 cup pitted kalamata olives, cut in 1/2 inch pieces | 1 bay leaf | 1/4 cup chopped salad greens
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a serving bowl. Chill until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno pepper,fruit,granny smith apple,lemon zest,cherry tomato,plum tomato,espresso
title: Mexican Jalebi Salad
ingredients: 1 pint cherry tomatoes | 1 pint plum tomato | 1 -2 jalapeno pepper | 1 -2 lemon, zest of | 1 -2 teaspoon instant espresso ( optional ) | 1 pinch dried fruit ( optional ) | 2 -3 tablespoons candied cherry tomatoes ( optional )
instructions: Cut cherry tomatoes on the diagonal in half and put on the rimmed salad plate. Chop plum tomatoes roughly and add in to the plate. Trim stem, and cut jalapeno pepper in half and cut in half. Dice up lemon zest to give you about 1/4 tsp zest of. Cut the lemon into pieces and put them along the top of tomato shells and cherry tomatoes. Wisk espresso in a small bowl and stir in the lemon zest. Add fruit of choice and whisk again. Drizzle the espresso mixture over the tomatoes and cherries. Tear up cherry tomatoes and drizzle over the top. Enjoy.

title: Slow-Cooker Spiced Beef With Rigatoni and Molasses
ingredients: 3 lbs stewing beef, cut into 1-inch chunks | 1/2 cup molasses | 1 star anise | 1 1/2 cups bottled molasses | 1 lb rigatoni pasta or 1 lb penne pasta
instructions: Combine the first 3 ingredients in a 5 - 6 quart slow cooker. Cover and cook on high setting for 3 hours on high, or 9 - 10 hours on low. While beef is cooking, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to boil. Put rigatoni in the boiling water and cook until tender but firm, about 10 - 12 minutes. Drain. Place drained rigatoni in a bowl with 3/4 cup of the molasses and toss to coat. Top with beef mixture and remaining molasses mixture. Serve over hot prepared pasta.

title: Pasta With No-Leftover Buttermilk
ingredients: 1 package rigatoni pasta or 1 package rotini pasta | 1 cup buttermilk | 1 tablespoon extra-virgin olive oil | 1 1/2 cups dry whole-milk pasta or 2 1/2 cups short pasta
instructions: Place the rigatoni in a large pot of boiling salted water. Cook until almost tender but not yet tender, about 5 to 7 minutes. If the pasta seems dry while cooking, continue to cook according to package directions. Drain the rigatoni and immediately transfer it to a bowl of ice water until cold. While pasta is cooking, warm the buttermilk in a saucepan over medium heat. Stir the olive oil into the pan and bring to a boil. Drain pasta and toss with warmed buttermilk. Add the drained pasta, and toss to combine. Place a large serving platter on top of the pasta and pour the hot buttermilk over it. Serve.

Random Ingredients: gin,vegetable,lemon zest,plum tomato,purpose flour,orzo pasta,pork rib,goat cheese
title: Pork-Stuffed Orzo
ingredients: 1/2 cup orzo pasta | 1 cup minced plum tomato | 1/2 pound pork ribs, cooked and cut into 1/4-inch slices | 1 tablespoon grated lemon zest | 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour | 1/2 cup crumbled goat cheese | 1/2 cup chilled chopped vegetables
instructions: Bring a pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add orzo, and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, or until tender. Drain, and rinse with cold water. Stir in the tomato, and allow orzo to cool. Stir in the pork slices, lemon zest, and flour until well blended. Mix in the goat cheese and vegetables. Fill the orzo with the stuffing. Roll the stuffing in cornmeal to coat. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: shoulder lamb chop,coconut milk,garlic,onion flake,cocoa powder,mint
title: Brazilian Lamb Chops
ingredients: 4 shoulder lamb chops | 1 tablespoon dried minced onion flakes | 1 teaspoon dried minced garlic | 1/2 cup unsweetened coconut milk | 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 tablespoon dried chopped mint
instructions: Place pork chops onto baking sheet. Coat with nonstick cooking spray. Mix onion, garlic and coconut milk in a small bowl.

title: Amaretto Truffle
ingredients: 1/2 - 1 tablespoon amaretto liqueur | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon cardamom | 1 teaspoon soft brown sugar
instructions: Blend all ingredients in a small bowl using a coffee gun or molcajete. Note, amaretto is a almond flavored liqueur, and is not watered out in this recipe. If you do not care for the amaretto color or fragrance, buy it in shot glasses.

title: Strawberry & Hazelnut Spiders
ingredients: 1 cup dried strawberries | 1 cup raw mixed vegetables | 1/2 cup hazelnuts ( pieces ) or 1/2 cup walnut pieces | 1 tablespoon tequila | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Place the strawberries & raw mixed vegetables into a bowl & cover with water. Let soak overnight. When ready to eat, drain and gently mix with nuts. Spoon nuts onto serving plates & top w/the spiced berries & tequila. For a spicier treat, try using 1 tsp of tequila instead of turmeric.

title: Anchovy in Lemony Cream
ingredients: 1 anchovy, fillet 'll of anchovy'| 1/3 - 1/2 cup of fresh cremuscandy or 1/3-1/2 cup chili pepper flakes
instructions: Combine all ingredients until well combined.

Random Ingredients: chicken,linguica sausage,salad dressing,lemon peel,banana,self raising flour,pinto bean,nigella seed
title: Nigella's Baked Beans
ingredients: 1 lb cooked chicken, chopped | 1 lb cooked pinto beans ( or other white beans ) | 4 ounces linguica sausage, chopped | 1 tablespoon nigella seeds, raw | 6 ounces self-raising flour | 1/4 cup salad dressing | 1 lemon peel, grated | 2 bananas, sliced into rounds
instructions: Mix all ingredients except the banana together until coated in the dressing. Place the banana rounds on the bottom and the top of the bean mixture as a covering. Place in an ovenproof pan and bake at 350 degrees f for 45 - 60 minutes until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: pea,red food coloring,salmon fillet,lime zest,green chilies,lima bean,vinegar,yellow bell pepper
title: Salmon with Lima Beans & Peas
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless salmon fillets | 1 can lima beans, rinsed, drained and patted dry | 1/2 cup frozen tiny peas, thawed if frozen | 1/2 cup peas | 1/2 cup yellow bell pepper, cut into 1-inch chunks | 1/4 teaspoon grated lime zest | 1 tablespoon finely chopped green chilies | 6 drops red food coloring ( or red food coloring of your choice ) | 1/4 cup fresh lime juice | 1 1/2 teaspoons vinegar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Place the salmon, beans, peas, bell pepper, lime zest, chilies, and food coloring in a large dish, stir to combine. Place in the oven and bake for 1 hour. Drain the beans, peas and bell pepper, discard any fat. Place the frozen salmon fillets in a shallow baking pan, top with the peas and pepper, then drizzle with lime juice. Bake for 15 more minutes or until the edges are firm and salmon is just cooked. Serve in soup plates with a light garnish of fresh lime wedges.

title: Green Chili Almond Crumble Cake
ingredients: 300 g cake flour | 1 can tomato and green chilies | 1/4 cup sherry wine | 1/4 cup sliced almonds
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Combine all cake ingredients in a bowl. Spread evenly in a 9x13 cm baking dish. Bake for 40mins or until cooked. Serve with salad ingredients.

Random Ingredients: crabmeat,chunky salsa,boston lettuce,port wine,broth,brie cheese,lemon grass
title: Brie & Crab Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chunky salsa | 1 tablespoon port wine | 1 tablespoon chopped lemon grass | 8 cups torn romaine lettuce | 2 cups fresh crabmeat | 1/2 cup chicken stock or 1/2 cup broth | 1/2 cup crumbly brie cheese
instructions: Combine salsa, wine, lemon grass and chicken broth in medium bowl, stir well to mix. Divide lettuce among eight lettuce lettuce leaves.

title: Low-Fat Casserole
ingredients: 1 egg noodles, broken up | 1 can cannellini beans ( drained and rinsed ) | 1 teaspoon tamari, low sodium | 1 teaspoon fresh orange rind, minced ( or 2 tsp. powdered orange peel ) | 2 tablespoons reduced-fat feta | 1/4 cup nonfat milk | 1/4 cup chopped walnuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Prepare egg noodles and drain. Combine noodles and beans, tamari, orange rind, feta, and milk. Mix well. Stir in nuts. Pour into 2 lightly greased 8x8 glass baking dishes. Bake uncovered 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chicken broth,spaghetti sauce,white wine,red currant jelly,cilantro,chicken bouillon,curry paste
title: Curried Spaghetti Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups chicken broth, heated | 1/2 cup spaghetti sauce | 6 leaves fresh cilantro | 1/4 cup red currant jelly | 1/4 cup curry paste | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon, or more as needed | 1 cup white wine, or as needed
instructions: Combine chicken broth, spaghetti sauce, cilantro, jelly, curry paste, and chicken bouillon in a saucepan.

Random Ingredients: seasoning salt,tea,hot dog,anchovy paste,italian turkey sausage link,lime wedge
title: Sweet Italian Sausage Dogs
ingredients: 1 lb hot italian turkey sausage link, sliced 1/4 inch thick | 1/2 teaspoon hot dry mustard powder or 1/2 teaspoon sweet hungarian paprika | 1/2 teaspoon anchovy paste ( to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 16 lime wedges | fresh hot dog ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients together except hot dogs in medium saucepan. Heat to boiling.

Random Ingredients: chili paste,cream mushroom soup,red wine,tahini,dark brown sugar,white onion,porcini mushroom,vinegar
title: Crock Pot Creamy Mushroom Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 6 cups sliced white onions | 2 cups sliced red mild or hot red peppers | 1 package dried porcini mushrooms, reconstituted and sliced | 2 cans cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup vinegar | 1/2 cup tahini | 1 1/2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 3 tablespoons vinegar | 1 tablespoon chili paste ( to taste )
instructions: Sauté chopped onions and peppers in butter. Place in crock pot and sprinkle with rehydrated mushrooms. Stir in remaining ingredients, and cook on low until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: garam masala,roasting chicken,fontina cheese,lemon grass root,turmeric powder,beef sirloin
title: Spicy Grilled Chicken
ingredients: 5 lbs whole roasting chickens | 3 lbs beef sirloin or 3 lbs top sirloin | 1/4 cup garam masala | 1 1/2 teaspoons turmeric powder | 1/4 cup minced lemon grass root | 4 cups grated fontina cheese or 4 cups gruyere cheese
instructions: First, prepare all your ingredients as instructed here. Grill the roast on a hot griddle pan for no more than 5 minutes to a side. Turn and grill the other side. If you have to cover the chicken with foil, remove the foil and let sit for one or two minutes, flip, and let sit for five minutes. Cut into serving sized pieces, and enjoy.

title: Dilly Hot Dogs
ingredients: 12 dry corn husks | 12 lbs corned beef bouillon cubes, undissolved | 4 tablespoons ground dry mustard | 2 tablespoons ground gingerroot | 1/2 teaspoon ground cayenne crushed juniper root in dry mustard | 1/2 teaspoon dill ( or 1/2 tsp. dried dill flakes ) | 4 tablespoons dill ( or 1/2 tsp. dried dill flakes )
instructions: Place corn husks on a cookie sheet. Bake at 500 for about 2 - 3 min. Or. Heat a few inches of water in a pot to boiling. As soon as bubbles appear, remove them from the heat and let them sit, covered, to cool to room temperature. When ready, place dired bullion, mustard, ginger, cayenne, dill, and salt in a large bowl. Place soaked and cooled corn on it. Roll in a towel to remove excess moisture, and place it in a large, heavy pot with 6 - 8 oz. Roolings. Cover and set over very low heat. Simmer for about 3 - 4 hours until the meat is very tender. Uncover, and stir frequently to keep hot. Cook about 3 hours, stirring occasionally, until the dills are dark brown and crispy.

Random Ingredients: enchilada sauce,pimiento,black greek olive,mustard powder,lasagna noodle,apple cider,beef brisket
title: Spicy Brisket
ingredients: 1 beef brisket, trimmed | 1 jar enchilada sauce | 1 jar sliced black greek olives | 1 jar sliced pimento | 3 tablespoons prepared mustard powder | 2 teaspoons apple cider | 1 package lasagna noodles
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Add brisket to skillet, and cook 7 to 10 minutes, until meat is browned on the outside. Spoon 1/3 of enchilada sauce into the slow cooker. Layer the olives and pimentos over top of the enchilada sauce. Sprinkle mustard powder, and cider over the olives and pimentos. Place brisket back over the top. Cook for 4 to 5 hours on high. Remove from the slow cooker and shred with two forks.

title: Rice Salad With Hazelnut Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1/2 cup pizza sauce ( or more, to taste ) | 1 cup long-grain white rice, cooked and cooled | 2 -3 tablespoons hazelnuts or 2 -3 tablespoons chopped almonds
instructions: In a small bowl, combine mayonnaise and pizza sauce.

title: Coffee Flavored Indian Lamb (Kashmiri Jeera Kebab)
ingredients: 1 kg leg of lamb, cut into 2-inch cubes | 4 teaspoons coriander seeds | 1 teaspoon tamarind paste
instructions: Put all the ingredients in a heavy based saucepan and bring to the boil, stirring constantly. Reduce the heat and simmer uncovered, stirring occasionally for about 1 hour and 40 minutes, or until the lamb is tender. If the lamb becomes too dry, add a small amount of water. It should be sticky to the touch. If necessary add a little water.

Random Ingredients: pumpkin,premade puff pastry,corn kernel,onion paste,green cardamom pod,white pepper
title: Pumpkin and Corn Rolls
ingredients: 1 can pumpkin | 1 tablespoon corn kernel, frozen or | 1 small pumpkin, defrosted and chopped | 1 medium onion paste or 1 medium onion, chopped | 4 green cardamom pods or 1 teaspoon fresh cardamom, seeds only | white pepper or black pepper
instructions: Empty the pumpkin, corn and onion paste into a microwaveable bowl.

title: Peachy Shake
ingredients: 1/2 cup peach schnapps ( apple schnapps with or without seeds ) | 1/2 cup plain greek yogurt, plain ( plain greek yogurt with or without sugar or sugar or artificial sweetener ) | 1 teaspoon grated garlic | 1/4 cup light sweet smoked oyster | 2 tablespoons chopped mint leaves ( optional ) | salt and pepper
instructions: Place all ingredients in blender or food processor and process until smooth. Serve on toast, crackers or toasted pita bread.

title: Baklava
ingredients: 3 cups all-purpose flour | 10 sheets frozen phyllo dough, thawed | 1 quart warm water
instructions: Place thawed phyllo dough in a large, round baking dish or pie plate. Paint phyllo pastry with a layer of warm water, allowing it to drip to the bottom of the dish. Cover phyllo pastry with a damp towel to prevent drying out the dough. Cover phyllo dough with a damp towel placed over the top of the dish. Place pastry in a steamer basket over a large pot of boiling water. Cook until phyllo pastry turns a deep golden brown color. Remove from water and set aside in a warm, dry place to dry. Heat an electric skillet to 400 degrees f. Place approximately 2 1/2 tablespoons of flour in a shallow dish. Place another shallow dish in the same skillet and turn heat to high. Working with 1 sheet at a time, gently and carefully roll and stretch pastry sheets, adding more flour if necessary, until pastry is very thin.

title: Herbed Eggplant (Aubergine)  Dip (Greece)
ingredients: 8 ounces eggplants, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1 cup watercress, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup fresh chives, snipped
instructions: Place 1/2 cup watercress in a small bowl, toss with salt, add 1 tblsps watercress, stir well. Cool, then chill. Combine eggplant, remaining cilantro and half cup of watercress mixture in a large bowl to make a dressing, blending well. Cover and chill. If necessary, may be made in advance. Serve with other assorted vegetables, such as french fries, pita breads crackers, etc.

title: Apricot Hot Dogs
ingredients: 10 -12 hot dogs | 1 jar dried apricots, packed in brine
instructions: Remove hot dogs and discard brine. Grill hot dogs under broiler or bake in a nonstick pan at 350 degrees until meat is browned and crisp on the outside. If it appears too thick, add a little water. Arrange hot dogs on a warm platter. Spoon apricot brine around hot dog. Serve.

title: Baked Cod Portuguese Christmas Eve Sandwich
ingredients: 1/2 lb cod, freshly ground | 3 tablespoons traditional turkish delight, finely ground | 1/4 teaspoon epazote, finely grind | 1/8 teaspoon almond extract | 1/2 french bread
instructions: Mix the turkish delight, epazote, and almond extract with the finely ground cod, stirring to coat and form the paste all the way. Split the french bread into two layers, lengthwise, and arrange a few pieces cut sides up on each loaf. Spread the cod paste, over each piece of bread, and cover with the remaining bread slices, securing with a toothpick. Place the fish on a flat tray under a hot broiler and grill about 30 seconds each side until crispy and fish is cooked through. Wonderful with a fruit salad, mixed with a green salad, and dipping in an oil.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,grain bread,cornflour,part ricotta cheese,potato butter
title: Irish Potato Griddle Croutons
ingredients: 2 cups mashed potatoes, cold | 1/2 cup part-skim ricotta cheese | 1/3 cup cornflour | 1/2 cup coarsely country bread, crusts removed or 1/2 cup chopped toasted bread | salt and pepper
instructions: Combine potato and ricotta in a bowl and mix well. Stir in the cornflour until the mixture is sticky enough to hold together when you squeeze. Shape the mixture into balls or patties about 1 1/2 inches in diameter. Heat a griddle or nonstick skillet over low heat. When the griddle is hot, carefully place the patties about 1 1/2 inches apart over the surface. When the griddle begins to smoke, place a large plate over the griddle and turn off the heat. When cool enough to handle, cut the cooked patties into 1/4 inch slices. Serve the croutons warm or at room temperature with butter and fresh chives and onions and fresh green beans added to them.

title: Vegetable Mix
ingredients: 1/2 lb assorted vegetables, cut into 1-inch chunks ( red and green beans, red and or green ) | 1/2 teaspoon oregano, crushed | 1 pinch msg ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl. Let sit for 2 hours in the fridge before serving.

title: Potluck Soba with Watermelon and Mango
ingredients: 1 cup watermelon, cut into cubes | 2 1/2 cups red potatoes, cut into chunks | 1/2 cup mango - peeled, seeded, and sliced | 1/4 can or bottle sweetened chutney | 1 1/2 cups bite-size pieces frozen soba noodles
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix watermelon, potatoes, mango, chutney, and soba noodles together in a bowl. Transfer mixture to an oiled 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven until soba is tender, about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: saffron strand,shrimp,curry powder,pumpkin puree,green onion,button mushroom
title: Easy Jumbo Shrimps
ingredients: 600 g medium shrimp | 3 green onions, chopped | 300 g button mushrooms, chopped | 2 tablespoons curry powder | 3 -4 saffron strands | 250 ml pumpkin puree | 1 teaspoon powdered saffron ( soaked in )
instructions: Shell and devein shrimp, add shrimps to shrimp and mix in all ingredients and marinate in fridge for 1 hour. Cook shrimps in oil, stir until just cooked, remove and serve along side a bowl of curry for a finale.

title: Quick Macaroni Cheese
ingredients: 225 g elbow macaroni, uncooked | 2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 1 -2 teaspoon dried marjoram | 220 g dry sherry
instructions: Cook macaroni in boiling water with a pinch of salt until just tender, drain & set aside. Heat the oil in a frying pan over a medium heat & cook the marjoram, stirring for about 30 seconds, until fragrant. Toss in the sherry & macaroni, add just enough of the water to moisten the top, bring to the boil, cook for 2 - 3 minutes, until the last 2 - 3 minutes of cooking time. Serve.

Random Ingredients: turmeric powder,margarine,fenugreek seed,hokkien noodle,chicken stock,ketchup,beef,red cabbage
title: Fenugreek Beef & Noodle Soup
ingredients: 3 tablespoons margarine | 1 lb lean beef, stew meat or 1 lb lamb, cut into 1 x 1/2 pieces | 1 cup sliced red cabbage | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 1 tablespoon hot fenugreek seeds ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 1/2 cups chicken stock | 1 cup coarsely chopped hokkien noodles
instructions: In a large saucepan melt margarine and brown meat.

title: Cardamom Chicken Liver
ingredients: 1 lb chicken liver, in 1-inch sections, then cut each section in half | 1 teaspoon cardamom powder
instructions: Rinse the chicken livers under cold water. Put in a large saucepan with enough cold water to cover by 1/4, and bring to a boil. Cover and simmer over medium heat until the liver is no longer pink inside, about 12 to 15 minutes. Drain the livers, and serve on a platter. Combine the cardamom powder with a little extra cold water, and sprinkle on the liver.

title: Basil Pesto Buns
ingredients: 4 frozen burger buns | 2 tablespoons prepared basil pesto | 1 tablespoon prepared horseradish | 1 teaspoon dried basil pesto sauce | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Heat oven to 400°. Split buns in half lengthwise. Split each in half horizontally. In small bowl, stir together pesto with horseradish, basil pesto and allspice. Spread each half with 1 teaspoon pesto mixture. Place buns, cut sides up, on foil covered baking sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until lightly toasted. Remove foil and top with remaining pesto mixture. Sprinkle with cilantro.

title: Quick and Easy Tamari Chicken
ingredients: 2 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 1 1/2 cups pasta sauce | 1 tablespoon dried thyme | 2 teaspoons tamari
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Coat pan with cooking spray, and place chicken in the pan.

Random Ingredients: apple brandy,curry powder,caster sugar,tabasco sauce,pistachio,linguine,cornflour,red chilies
title: Linguine With Apple Chilli Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 4 tablespoons caster sugar | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 1/2 teaspoon curry powder | 3 teaspoons apple brandy | 10 small dried red chilies, chopped or 5 small thai chillies | tabasco sauce | 1/4 cup roasted pistachios | 4 tablespoons fresh coriander leaves ( optional ) or 4 tablespoons basil, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Mix sugar through sifted cornflour and gradually stir in brandy till smooth then stir in chillies, tabasco sauce and pistachios. Heat oven 180 deg c. Place a teaspoon of the chilli mixture in the centre of each piece of dried linguine. Stuff each with a quarter of the mixture and place on an ovenproof dish. Top with coriander or basil. Bake for 2 - 3 mins until golden brown.

title: Salsa
ingredients: 3 cans diced tomatoes with green chile peppers | 1/4 cup cooking wine
instructions: Bring a pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the tomatoes and cook uncovered 10 to 12 minutes, until heated through. Drain. Stir in the cooking wine. Cover and simmer until the wine is absorbed.

title: Roasted Green Bean and Cheese Manicotti
ingredients: 8 ounces uncooked small dried manicotti shells | 1 jar dried blueberries | 1 can cauliflower | 1 tablespoon ground cumin | 1 tablespoon fennel seed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Combine dry pasta, blueberries, cauliflower, cumin, and fennel seed in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven for 40 minutes, or until pasta is tender.

title: Quick Molasses Smoked Peppers
ingredients: 4 tablespoons olive, plus | 3 tablespoons olive, divided | 1 large yellow sweet pepper, chopped | 3 chilies, chopped ( preferably small red ones ) | 1/2 cup molasses
instructions: Preheat a grill or broiler. Wrap the peppers tightly in foil. Place on foil, and broil, turning from time to time, for 5 - 7 minutes, or until charred and beginning to char. Place in a bowl, cover, and set aside. Put the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil in a skillet over medium low heat, and cook the peppers until slightly softened. Stir in the remaining olives, and cook about 5 minutes. Stir in the chilies. In a small bowl, stir together the molasses and remaining 2 tablespoons of olive oil. Add this to the skillet. Stir molasses mixture and scrape up any browned bits on the inside. Serve warm.

title: Mexican Hot Dog
ingredients: 1 package sliced pepperoni | 1 can tomato passata | 3/4 cup mexican-style stewed tomatoes | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 2 teaspoons dry mustard
instructions: Place pepperoni in a 9 inch round casserole dish. Drizzle with tomato passata. Arrange stewed tomatoes over the pepperoni. Spread cream over tomatoes and sprinkle with dry mustard. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Uncover and bake at 350 degrees 15 to 20 minutes or until hot.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt black pepper,tomato green chilies,spice
title: Pancho Villa Seasoning
ingredients: 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained ( hunts ) | 1/2 tablespoon spice, blend ( paul prudhomme's aromatic spice blend ) or 1/2 tablespoon mrs. dash seasoning blend ( paul prudhomme's aromatic spice blend ) | kosher salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: In a bowl, combine all ingredients and mix well. Serve on hot, crusty french bread.

title: Simple, Memorable and Delicious Ambrosia Fish Curry from Narnia
ingredients: 250 g salmon, cut into 6 6mm rings | 2 tablespoons green curry paste ( thai kitchen brand ) | 250 ml soy yogurt | 125 g sliced almonds ( optional ) | 1/3 cup brandy ( optional ) or 1/3 cup rum ( optional )
instructions: Marinate your seafood in the curry paste in the soy yoghurt for 2 - 24 hours. Boil your seafood and seafood on medium heat for 5 minutes. Add sliced almonds, if using and brandy, if using. Serve while still on low heat.

title: Spicy Peanut Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups jasmine rice | 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 1 green bell pepper, sliced | 3/4 cup chopped dry roasted peanuts
instructions: Place the rice and soy sauce in a saucepan, and bring to a boil over medium heat. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer until the rice is tender, and the liquid has been absorbed, 20 to 25 minutes. Fluff rice with a fork and mix in the remaining ingredients, removing any seeds or loose pieces if desired.

title: Tandoori Parsnips and Sumac Fries
ingredients: 2 parsnips, cut into fries | 2 -3 tablespoons ground sumac | 2 tablespoons garam masala
instructions: Fry the parsnips in a pan over medium heat. Once they are golden on all sides, sprinkle in sumac, stir and turn the heat down. Serve in a bowl with basmati rice, along with raita.

title: Pista Badam
ingredients: 12 -15 medium tomatoes, diced small | 3 tablespoons paramin masala | 2 tablespoons dried pistachio nuts
instructions: Heat water and add the dried pistachio. Add the paramin and sun dried tomatoes. Cook for 20 - 30 minutes or till the water dries up and the pistachio is golden. Serve at once with pitta.

title: Thai Red Curry
ingredients: 1 teaspoon crushed red chili pepper | 1 small red chili pepper | 1/4 cup raisins
instructions: Dry fry the red chili pepper, if you'd like a milder version, add a teaspoon extra oil to the pan. Add the raisins and fry on medium high heat until dried out. Add the red curry paste, cover and simmer until the liquid has reduced and the raisins just start to colour. Add water, if needed, to cover the raisins and cook uncovered until the curry has a nice thick consistency. Add your hot water to thin if needed, and mix in. Serve over steamed jasmine rice, and enjoy.

title: Apricot-Radish Gratin
ingredients: 2 cups chopped apricots | 1 cup grated parmesan cheese | 2 cups thinly sliced radish
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Spray a 13x9 inch baking dish lightly with cooking spray. Mix apricots, parmesan cheese and radishes in baking dish. Spread mixture into dish. Bake, uncovered, for 20 to 25 minutes, until bubbly and hot.

Random Ingredients: italian tomato,jalapeno pepper,vegetable stock,spring onion,cheese whiz,lasagna noodle,glace cherry,squid
title: Squid Lasagna
ingredients: 1 lb sea bass or 1 lb squid, cleaned | 2 cups vegetable stock | 1 can italian-style diced tomatoes | 4 spring onions, chopped finely ( spring onions only ) | 1 jalapeno pepper, seeded and chopped finely | 1 cup chees whiz | 3 lasagna noodles | 1 cup glace cherries
instructions: Wash the sea bass, if necessary. Cut into 1/2´´´´´´thick slices. Place it in a large saucepan, pour over the stock, and bring the liquid to a boil. Reduce the liquid by 2´´. Stir in the tomatoes, spring onions, jalapeño, and 1 cup of chechee whiz. Put the whole lot in a large baking dish, place in the oven on low. It should take about ½ hr.. Meanwhile, bring a large pan of water to boil. Add the lasagna noodles, and boil for 15 minutes, until they are al dente. Drain thoroughly. In the mean time, heat the remaining chechee in a frying pan. When bubbling, stir in the cherry halves. Dissolve the rest of the chechee in just enough stock to make the sauce a bit thinner.

Random Ingredients: dark molasses,egg yolk,active yeast,dark beer,milk,rice wine vinegar,stir fry sauce,shallot
title: Beef Steakhouse-Style Red Beer
ingredients: 1 teaspoon active dry yeast | 1/2 cup dark beer, room temperature | 1 cup dark molasses | 1 cup skim milk, room temperature | 1 1/2 teaspoons dark molasses | 1/2 cup shallot, finely chopped | 2 large egg yolks | 1/2 cup skim milk | 2 1/2 cups quick stir-fry sauce ( i make my own with the rice wine vinegar ) | 1 tablespoon dark molasses ( optional )
instructions: Place yeast in a large metal bowl, add beer, and let stand until foamy, about 5 minutes. Whisk in 1 cup molasses, 1/2 cup milk, half the shallots, egg yolks, dark molasses, and 2 1/2 cups milk. Stir in remaining milk and molasses, whisk until combined. Cover and refrigerate for 3 days or up to 3 days, until yeast is bubbly. Pour batter into a large nonstick skillet and heat at medium high temperature until very bubbly and very thick, about 10 minutes. Add the remaining shallots and cook until dark golden. Pour in the beef and marinade, reduce heat to medium low, and cook, turning often, until an instant read thermometer inserted into the center registers 125°f, about 45 minutes or longer.

title: Heritos
ingredients: 1 kg cherry, cut into halves | 2 cups fresh mint, washed and chopped | 3 cups dried cherries
instructions: Rinse and dry the cherries. Place the cherries in a bowl. Add 1 cup of fresh and dry mint, then pour over enough boiling water to cover. Let stand 1 hour. Rinse the cherries and then drain. Chop the herbs and toss with cherries in a bowl. Serve at once. Variation, sprinkle with black gram flour before serving.

Random Ingredients: brown rice,maple syrup,avocado,garam masala,tomato green chilies,basil,lemon,clove
title: Vegetarian Arroz Verde
ingredients: 1 can diced tomatoes and green chilies, with liquid | 1 can diced tomatoes and green chilies | 1 lemon, juiced | 1 tablespoon pure maple syrup | 1 tablespoon basil | 1 teaspoon garlicam masala | 1/8 teaspoon ground cloves | 1/8 teaspoon garam masala | 1 cup basmati rice
instructions: Place the diced tomatoes and green chilies in a medium saucepan over medium low heat. Stir in the green chili juice, diced tomatoes with liquid, maple syrup, basil, garlic, garam masala, ground cloves, and garam masala.

Random Ingredients: tabasco sauce,candy,red onion,taco seasoning mix,bean sprout,baking soda,rosemary
title: Baked Bean Sprouts
ingredients: 1 cup baking soda | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 red onion, diced small | 1 tablespoon dried rosemary | shredded fresh taco-seasoned bean sprouts | 1/4 cup shredded candied rosemary | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1/8 - 1/4 cup brandy | 2 tablespoons shredded candy sprinkles
instructions: Place baking soda in a bowl, mix well. Add taco seasoning mix, onion, rosemary and bean sprouts. Mix well until well mixed. Dump into a lightly greased 1 quart casserole dish. Bake for 30 minutes in a 400°f oven. Brush or spray with the brandy when baked and sprinkle with candied rosemary.

title: Rice and Tuna Casserole
ingredients: 1/2 cup uncooked long-grain rice ( use basmati rice ) | 1 can tuna, undrained | 1 can consomme ( vegetarian ) | 1 bouillon cube | 1/2 teaspoon methi seeds | 1 -2 turnip, diced | 1 -2 tablespoon pancake mix ( or rice balls for risotto )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Cook rice for 20 minutes while the oven heats up. Drain the tuna, put into an oven safe casserole dish, add consomme and broth. Add rest of ingredients. Cover. Bake at 350 for 1 hour or until thickened and bubbly. You can add additional broth or water if you want.

Random Ingredients: lime juice,asparagus,sriracha sauce,white sugar,philadelphia cream cheese
title: Philly Asparagus Rollups
ingredients: 4 ounces philadelphia cream cheese, softened | 1 tablespoon minced fresh asparagus | 1 teaspoon sriracha sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 1/4 teaspoon white sugar
instructions: Preheat the oven broiler. Spray a cookie sheet with non stick cooking spray and set aside. In a bowl, mash together cream cheese, garlic asparagus, sriracha sauce, lime juice, and sugar until well combined. Line a roll pan with plastic wrap. Pile cream cheese mixture evenly into the baking sheet, about 2 to 3 inches thick. Bake in the preheated oven 25 to 30 minutes, until heated thoroughly.

title: Low Fat Turkey Pasta With Black Sesame Oil and Low Sodium
ingredients: 2 lbs turkey, strips ( bone-in ) | 1/2 cup low-fat dry pasta ( penne or rigatoni ) | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 2 teaspoons cornstarch
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f. Lightly oil a 9x9 inch glass baking dish. Cut turkey’s lengthwise through the center of the turkey. Pull out and discard any loose sections of meat and neck, leaving what's left of the turkey. Rinse and dry turkey and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Heat a large nonstick skillet over high heat and add sesame oil. Cook turkey until golden and cooked through. Stir pasta into turkey and drizzle turkey with dark sesame oil. Stir cornstarch into a little more than a tablespoon of broth and pour into skillet. Bring to a boil and stir over low heat. Add more broth if necessary. Pour into heated baking dish. Serve.

title: French Bread on the Grills
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread, cut in 1 inch thick slices | 1/4 cup liquid smoke
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium high heat. Brush 1 side of each slice with the liquid smoke. Put the on grill, sprinkle generously with more liquid smoke. Grill until the bread just begins to crisp out of the sides. Remove, place on a slice of french bread, and top with a couple of spoonfuls of the liquid smoke before eating.

title: Albondigas
ingredients: 2 medium eggplants, peeled, cut in half lengthwise and sliced into 1/4 inch thick rounds | 2 medium yellow squash, cut in half lengthwise and sliced into 1/4 inch thick rounds | 2 tablespoons adobo seasoning | adobo seasoning | 2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 5 leaves kale | kale ( or other herb ) | 1 -2 tablespoon flour or 1 -2 tablespoon breadcrumbs | 1 -2 tablespoon salsa
instructions: Place eggsplants, squash, adobo seasoning & minced garlic in a large bowl mix well. Coat each eggplant& squash vegetable in adobo seasoning& then roll up in breadcrumbs or bread crumbs. Repeat process for all 12 eggsplants& squashvets. Heat a large skillet or wok on medium heat. Add 1 - 2 tblsps olive oil to skillet or wok. Add vegetables, sprinkle with salt & saute' for a few minutes. Serve with salsa and/or sour cream. Recipe easily doubled.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,dressing,ginger garlic paste,vegetable shortening,lime,tahini,chicken carcass,thyme
title: Tahini Chicken and Daube
ingredients: 4 lbs chicken carcasses | 4 1/2 ounces dried tahini | 1/2 pint sour cream or 1/2 pint cream cheese | 2/3 cup vegetable shortening, diced | 1 tablespoon fresh ginger-garlic paste | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme ( optional ) | 1 1/2 liters cold ready-made tahini soup | 2 -3 limes, quartered ( see note )
instructions: Combine chicken carcasses with tahini, sour cream/cream cheese, peanut butter, vegetable base, vegetable base and thyme and blend thoroughly. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Cook slowly in the oven at 170°c/ 350°f/ gas mark 5 for 1 1/2 hours. Garnish with lime quarters.

Random Ingredients: molasses,beef bouillon cube,celery seed,passion fruit pulp,rice wine vinegar
title: Szechwan Spiced Beef
ingredients: 1/4 cup molasses | 1/4 cup rice wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons beef bouillon cubes | 1 tablespoon celery seed | 1 -2 passion fruit pulp ( or your fav. jelly )
instructions: In a small saucepan on the stove, stir molasses, vinegar, bouillon and celery seed until blended. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat to simmer, and cover, stirring occasionally. Cook for 1/2 hour or longer. Add passion and continue cooking for an additional 30 - 45 minutes, or until desired consistency. Serve with steamed vegetables.

Random Ingredients: ketjap manis,part mozzarella cheese,turkey breast,mayonnaise,chili pepper flake,button mushroom,hard egg
title: Spicy Turkey Covered Eggs
ingredients: 3 tablespoons part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded ( soft ) | 3 tablespoons lowfat mayonnaise | 2 teaspoons ketchup ( low sodium ) | 1/2 teaspoon chili pepper flakes ( or more to taste ) | 4 hard-boiled eggs | 3 cups chopped cooked turkey breast | 2 hard-boiled eggs | 1/4 cup sliced button mushroom
instructions: For the mayo spread, combine all ingredients in a small bowl and stir until cheese is thoroughly melted. Set aside until ready to use. For garnish, toast the hard boiled eggs under broiler until slightly blackened and softened. Place on a platter and spread each egg with 1/4 teaspoon mayonnaise. Place the turkey on top and sprinkle with the black boiled eggs.

title: The Cider Shop Shredded Beef Brisket
ingredients: 1 large fresh clementine | 2 1/2 lbs large-thick beef brisket, with enough space left on the corse to hold meat | 2 tablespoons rum extract | 2 teaspoons poultry seasoning | white pepper
instructions: Quarter clementine lengthwise. Seed and chop the clementine. Place in bottom of a large sauce pan. Cut brisket into 3/4 inch thick slices and add to pan. Sprinkle with rum extract, poultry seasoning and white pepper. Cover and place in refrigerator. About 1 hour before meat is to be served, bring to room temperature, removing cover and cook at low temp. Pour out juices and stir. Remove corse meat, reserving liquid. Chop brisket into 1/2 inch strips and stir into juices and bring to boil. Cover and cook over medium low heat for 2 hours. Turn meat over and continue cooking for 2 hours.

title: Chinese Five Minute Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup water | 3 small serrano peppers, sliced lengthwise into strips | 1 can condensed cream of celery soup
instructions: Combine ingredients in a glass bowl, cover tightly, and refrigerate for at least one hour before serving. This can also be made ahead.

Random Ingredients: grain rice,kalamata olive,white wine vinegar,red chilies
title: Peruvian Arrabbiata Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups long grain rice, washed | 1 red chilies, seeded, finely chopped | 2/3 cup kalamata olive, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar
instructions: Place rice in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Add enough water to cover rice. Bring to boil. Reduce heat. Simmer, covered, for 15 minutes or until water is absorbed. Stir in the remaining ingredients. Heat through, stirring gently.

title: Prosciutto and Parsnips With Rice
ingredients: 3 packages dry egg noodles | 1 cup basmati rice, cooked and cool | 2 parsnips, sliced thin | 8 slices prosciutto | 2 romaine lettuce, leafs | 1 teaspoon fresh parsley, chopped
instructions: Cook noodles until tender, drain well. In a hot skillet, sauté prosciutto until lightly browned, then remove from pan. Heat oven to 375 degrees. Spread rice in a 9 inch square baking dish, then add noodles, parsnips, and proscuitto. Bake uncovered about 25 minutes, then top with lettuce and sprinkle on parsley.

Random Ingredients: hazelnut,cardamom powder,red wine,bocconcini,almond extract,anise seed,dark sesame oil,marsala wine
title: Mastique Biscotti
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups hazelnuts, toasted and skins removed | 1 cup bocconcini ( small balls of bocconcini dough, cut in half, about 1 1/2 inches long ) | 3 tablespoons anise seeds, crushed ( seeds from 2 cardamom pods. ) | 1/4 cup dry marsala wine | 3 packages good-quality dry marsala wine | 1/4 cup almond extract | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Place the hazelnuts on a baking sheet & roast in the oven until skins crack and darken slightly, about 10 minutes. Let cool & remove peel & skins from hearts of the bocconcino. Slice the bocconcini into 1/4 inch thick slices then set aside. Place anise seeds in a coffee grinder or food processor & process until they begin to pop, then add the nuts & process until ground evenly. Heat an oven proof skillet on medium high heat & add marsala & almond extracts. Cook, stirring constantly, until reduced to about 3/4 cup, about 3 - 5 minutes. Stir in sesame oil & nut mixture. Strain marsala & reduce liquid to 1/2 & keep hot over low heat. Place the biscotti in a single layer on a baking sheet & bake until the tops have begun to brown, about 5 - 6 minutes. Turn the slices & bake until the tops have begun to darken, about 5 - 6 minutes more. Remove from oven, drain on paper towels & cool completely. Using a sharp serrated knife, cut diagonally into slices to serve, about 1 cup.

title: Vegetable Terrine
ingredients: 1 box vanilla instant pudding mix, any flavour | 1 can tomato ketchup | 1 bag turnips, grated, and peeled
instructions: Combine all ingredients and place into 1 loaf pan. Bake at 250 degrees celcius for 1 hour. Cut into rectangles and serve with ice cream or custard.

Random Ingredients: red wine,ghee,yellow mustard seed,thyme leaf,cooking spray,garlic,white corn tortilla,mayonnaise
title: Garlic Dipping Pinwheels
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 teaspoon yellow mustard seeds or 1 teaspoon white sugar | 2 teaspoons fresh thyme leaves, finely minced | 1 teaspoon finely minced garlic ( bottled is fine ) | 1 teaspoon ghee | 2 small white corn tortillas, cut into thin strips, 3-inch long | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1/2 cup red wine
instructions: Preheat broiler. Coat the outside of a large frypan with cooking spray on medium high. Toast the mustard and sugar in the hot oil, swirling to cover the surface evenly. Stir in the thyme and garlic. Reduce heat to low and continue to cook the mixture, stirring constantly, until the garlic mixture is slightly reduced and the oil starts to separate slightly, about 10 minutes. Add the ghee, corn strips and mayonnaise. Stir well to blend. Spread the mixture evenly over the cut side of each tortilla strip. Broil just until the bottoms begin to brown, 4 - 5 minutes. Let cool until slightly warm. Transfer to a small serving plate. Drizzle with more ghee or mayonnaise if desired. Serve piping hot.

Random Ingredients: chicken thigh,milk,heavy cream,apple cider vinegar,cinnamon,vodka,herring fillet,bean
title: Herring in Vodka With Beer
ingredients: 4 tablespoons vodka | 1 cup milk | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 3 chicken thigh | 1 smoked herring fillet | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 2 tablespoons peach cider vinegar | 2 apples, peeled, cored and sliced
instructions: Dry the herring. Cut into cubes. Strain the liquid that escapes and goes into a glass bowl. Heat the vodka and milk in a saucepan over high heat, stirring. Bring to a boil, lower heat and simmer. Whip the cream, adding the cream gradually. Stir the puree into the cream. Bring to a boil and reduce heat. Simmer, uncovered just until sauce thickens. Place chicken in an ovenproof dish. Add puree and cinnamon, stir and pour the vodka mixture over. The herring will be served in the dish at the table. Serve with steamed vegetables.

title: Cabbage (Swiss Version)
ingredients: 1 medium red cabbage, shredded | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed
instructions: Remove outer leaves of cabbage from head. Place cabbage in a pot with enough water to cover it 1/2 inch above leaves. Bring to a boil. Cover pot, reduce heat, and simmer 20 minutes. Uncover pot, and simmer covered 10 minutes, or until all liquid is absorbed and cabbage is tender. Allow to cool. Remove top layer of leaves, and cut into thin strips. Add fennel and any additional water to cabbage. Place cabbage in a serving bowl and cover with sauce.

title: Rice with Celery Seeds
ingredients: 1 bunch celery seed | 3 cups long-grain white rice, rinsed
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f line 9x13 inch baking pan with a heavy double layer of heavy duty aluminum foil. Combine celery seed and celery seed in a small bowl. Combine rice in a large bowl and toss with celery seed mixture.

title: French Foil (Oignon)
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon corn oil | 1/2 cup marmalade | 1/2 teaspoon grated orange zest | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Heat corn oil in a skillet over medium high heat. Stir in marmalade, orange zest, and salt and pepper.

Random Ingredients: pizza dough,phyllo pastry,thyme,extra beef,bay leaf,italian parsley,asiago cheese
title: Meat Pies
ingredients: 1 lb extra lean ground beef | 2 tablespoons extra-lean grated italian parsley or 2 tablespoons fresh parsley, minced | 1 tablespoon snipped fresh thyme ( sub oregano if fresh unavailable ) | 2 bay leaves | 2 frozen miniature pizza dough, thawed | 1 lb pizza dough, at room temperature | 4 ounces shredded asiago cheese ( can substitute swiss cheese )
instructions: Cook beef in large nonstick skillet over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until well browned. Pour off drippings. Add parsley, thyme, and bay leaf.

Random Ingredients: food coloring,apple cider,camembert cheese,asafoetida powder,white breadcrumb,vanilla essence,bamboo shoot
title: Frozen Camembert (Fruit Salad)
ingredients: 12 slices firm white breadcrumbs | 200 g camembert cheese | 2 tablespoons white breadcrumbs ( dried flakes ) | 4 tablespoons apple cider | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon ground aafoetida powder or 1 -1 1/4 teaspoon chili powder | 1 dash food coloring, according to your favourite colouring ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Break the camembert slices into smaller pieces and put them in a blender or food processed/grinder. Add 5 tablespoons white breadcrumbs, 2 tablespoons dried breadcrumbs, 4 tablespoons fresh white breadcrumbs, 4 tablespoons dried white breadcrumbs, 4 tablespoons dried white breadcrumbs, 2 - 3 drops food colouring, and two drops vanilla essence. Mix well. Transfer mixture into moulds or moulds/tins. Cover and rest in the fridge for at least 3 hours, preferably overnight. Cut out the centre hole of each slice of fruit and place on a tray. Spread the camembert pieces very thinly on their slices, leaving spaces between them. Place a slice of the fruit on top of each slice of breadcrumb and bake on either oven tray or non stick griddle pan until lightly coloured, approximately 8 - 10 minutes. Serve hot with yoghurt. To cut out the centre hole of the slices, break them into small pieces and serve on the tray.

Random Ingredients: pork,cream chicken soup,bailey irish cream,pistachio nut
title: Bailey's Irish Pork Dip
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup ( or cream of pork ) | 1 jar roasted pork ( or shredded pork ) | 3 ounces bailey's irish cream | 2 tablespoons toasted slivered pistachio nuts ( or sliced raw almonds )
instructions: Combine soup, undrained, and pork in a medium serving bowl. Stir in bailey's and cover. Refrigerate at least 2 hours. Sprinkle with nuts just before serving.

title: Spareribs
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lump crabmeat | 1/2 gallon vinegar | 10 cloves
instructions: Clean crabmeat well. Crack each clove of garlic, place in a gallon of boiling water and simmer for 20 mins this will change the color of the clove, but once done remove from heat add water in a little at a time. After about 10 mins, take off the foam. Place the crab meat into a sterile jar, with the vinegar, cloves and garlic. Pour into the hot vinegar and cover. Place a heavy plate or foil over the lid, so only the meat is submerged in the vinegar. The meat will take on a white, somewhat metallic appearance, but it should be submerged after 15 mins. This can be made in the morning, and then refrigerate for months. It is well worth the time it takes to marinate.

Random Ingredients: green pea,vanilla extract,pancetta,cilantro leaf,rotini pasta,coriander,arborio rice
title: Coriander Rice Pasta (Rice Cooker)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups uncooked rotini pasta ( rice-shaped pasta ) | 10 slices pancetta, thick cut | 1/2 cup frozen green pea | 2 tablespoons fresh cilantro leaves | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground coriander | 1/4 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | 1 1/2 cups arborio rice, risotto rice | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro leaves ( optional )
instructions: Rinse the rice in a fine mesh strainer under cold water until the water runs clear. Drain any excess water from the rice. Rinse the rice under cold water, and place it in the rice cooker as per directions. Set the machine to the regular white rice cycle, and press start. Line the rice cooker with a round paper towel about 2 inches in diameter. Pour the rice into the lined paper towel, filling the paper towel to just below the rim. Press the rice down firmly, and cover the rice cooker. When the machine switches to keep warm, remove the paper towels from the cooker. Tightly press the rice again, and let the rice steam for about 30 minutes, until the water becomes cloudy and the rice grains begin to firm up. Stir the rice with a wood spoon to separate and fluff the grains slightly until the rice is fluffy and rice grains are evenly distributed. Remove from the rice cooker as soon as the rice switches to keep warm. While the rice is still hot, remove the paper towels from it, and sprinkle it with the chopped fresh cilantro. Set aside. Stir the chopped cilantro, vanilla extract, and 2 1/2 cups of the arborio rice into the reserved rice water. Set it aside to use in a sauce. Transfer the rice to a serving bowl, garnish with the crispy pancetta slices, and serve immediately.

title: Tropical Oatcakes
ingredients: 1/2 cup old fashioned oats | 1 teaspoon ground coffee | 2 tablespoons oil | 1/2 lb crab, cooked
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Mix all ingredients together and roll into balls. Place on cookie sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake 6 - 8 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: dark chocolate,brandy,jasmine rice,enchilada sauce,purpose flour,rice vinegar,chicken liver
title: Liver and Chocolate Basmati
ingredients: 3 cups cooked jasmine rice ( about 1/2 pound- or other fine ) | 3 tablespoons brandy ( not margarine ) | 1 2/3 lbs boneless skinless chicken livers, cut crosswise into 1/2 inch strips | 1/4 - 1/2 cup all-purpose flour, more as needed | 1 teaspoon dark chocolate ( optional ) | 2 cans enchilada sauce | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar
instructions: In a bowl, combine rice and brandy. Add livers.

title: Fried Egg Rolls
ingredients: 1 egg, beaten | 2 1/2 tablespoons tamari or 2 1/2 tablespoons sesame paste | 3/4 cup french breadcrumbs | 3/4 cup sliced roasted garlic kalamata olive, chopped | 10 sliced radishes | 8 lettuce leaves | 6 lettuce leaves | 2 medium eggs, beaten
instructions: Combine the first 4 ingredients. Combine breadcrumbs and olives and roll the egg mixture into 3/4 inch diameter cylinders. Arrange on the lettuce leaves. Divide egg rolls between the two lettuce leaves. Roll up the lettuce tightly. Repeat with remaining egg rolls and lettuce. Heat a wide nonstick skillet and fry rolls until golden and cooked through, 6 minutes each side. Serve immediately with dipping sauce. To serve, fry eggs with dipping sauce. Serve with dipping sauce.

title: Nana's Collegiate Colcannon
ingredients: 8 cups shredded cabbage | 1 pint heavy whipping cream | 1 1/2 cups thinly sliced green onions
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Blend shredded cabbage, whipping cream, and sliced green onion in a large bowl with a mixer until the mixture is smooth and creamy.

title: Fresh Pea Carrots (From the Dutch Antilles)
ingredients: 8 -12 cups fresh peas and carrots, peeled | 1/2 cup dry white wine
instructions: Trim carrots of any dark spots, cut them in 1 inch lengths and steam them over boiling water for 15 minutes. Drain them well in a sieve, run them under cold, dry water, and toss them in a mixing bowl with the salt, then pour in the wine. Place a pan on which peas and carrots are packed just enough to hold the vegetables in a single layer, and bring to a boil. Add the carrots, and simmer them briskly for 20 minutes, or until they are just tender when pierced with a fork. Remove the pan from the heat and let them stand 10 minutes. Drain them well in a sieve while they are still hot. Pour them into a mixing bowl and fold them in the dry seasonings. Serve at once, allowing others to be added to taste.

title: Sauza-Style French Ham
ingredients: 1 ham | pepperoncini peppers, to taste | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar, packed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Place the ham in a roasting pan, and stud with pepperoncini pepper slices. Sprinkle brown sugar evenly over ham. Bake for 3 1/2 hours in the preheated oven. Increase oven temperature to 250 degrees f, and continue baking, ham should become crispy but moist. Cool ham for 10 minutes, then slice and serve.

Random Ingredients: orange zest,blue curacao,black olive,tuna steak,cherry tomato,lemon pepper
title: Tuna-Stuffed Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients: 16 large orange-flavored cherry tomatoes | 2 tablespoons orange zest, finely grated | 1 tablespoon lemon pepper | 14 ounces tuna steaks, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 12 large black olives, halved ( about 2 cups ) | 3/4 cup low-fat blue curacao or 3/4 cup other coffee-flavored liqueur
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°. In a large bowl, whisk together the orange zest, lemon pepper and tuna. Gently press each tomato, along the rim of a cherry, inside out, into the zest mixture. Spoon 1/4 of the tuna mixture onto each half, leaving 1/4 inch of tuna exposed. Spoon some of the orange/lemon mixture into each tomato, being careful not to dislodge the tomato from the shell. Spoon remaining tuna mixture into hollowed tomatoes. Spoon the olives equally onto each tomato. Arrange cherry tomatoes on a baking sheet, cut side down. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes, until the tuna is firm.

title: Tofu and Chickpea Salad
ingredients: 2 cans chickpeas, rinsed and drained | 60 large torn fresh salad green | 1 package firm tofu, cut into 1 inch cubes
instructions: Mix chickpeas and fresh salad greens toether with 2 to 3 tablespoons of dressing in a bowl. Divide between serving plates. Top with tofu cubes.

title: Fajita Style Roasted Frogs
ingredients: 24 frog legs | cooking spray or butter | 1 medium cauliflower, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Place frog legs on a foil lined baking sheet. With a sharp knife, cut a slit in some of the skin. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes or until lightly brown. Remove the legs from the oven and drain off any accumulated juices. Spray the outside of the frog legs with cooking spray or cool completely. Arrange in a serving dish and scatter cauliflower overtop. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until cauliflower is tender, and frog legs are browned. Serve with taco sauce for dipping and sour cream for an appetizer.

title: German Style Stale House Mustard Pickles
ingredients: 1 head red cabbage, sliced into thin wedges | 6 tablespoons stone ground mustard
instructions: Place cabbage in a large bowl and toss with mustard. Let stand 30 minutes.

title: Bread Machine Moroccan Pizza Bianca
ingredients: 3 cups plain fat free greek yogurt | 1/2 cup molasses ( i used honey & agave ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons lemon zest | 1 1/2 teaspoons turmeric | 5 teaspoons instant yeast | 1/2 cup cheese
instructions: Add all ingredients in bread machine in order suggested by your bread machine manufacturer. Bake on white or low setting or regular bake at 375°f for 18 - 25 minutes. Note, i usually bake the whole loaf at 425°f. Yields about 1 1/2 cups. This pizza can also be stored in the refrigerator for up to a week or freeze for at least 3 months.

Random Ingredients: green olive,spring onion,chicken breast half,corn chip,chicken leg,part mozzarella cheese
title: Chicken Mexican Casserole
ingredients: 1 package chicken wings ( or drumsticks if you want ) | 1/2 cup green olives, chopped | 1/4 cup fresh spring onion, chopped ( or 1 tbsp dried ) | 8 ounces frozen whole-grain corn chips, crushed | 3/4 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded | 4 boneless chicken breast halves, cooked and sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Spray a 13 x 9 in dish with cooking spray. Cut wings in two. Sauté chicken in a nonstick pan coated with cooking spray for 7 - 8 minutes until cooked through. Add olives, onion and half the crushed corn chips. Layer chicken mixture, cheese and remaining crushed corn chips on top. Cover and bake for 50 minutes. Note, to thaw, place frozen chicken breast halves between 2 pieces of heavy duty foil. Seal, and place on baking sheet with seam side down. Bake at 350°f for 20 - 25 minutes. Turn chicken halfway through baking, and cook an additional 5 - 10 minutes until the juices run clear.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,cola drink,bean sprout,icing sugar
title: Cupcakes
ingredients: 1 can bean sprouts, drained ( i used mixed sprouts ) | 4 cups cola-flavored drink | icing sugar ( to coat ) | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: Place sugar in a bag and shake thoroughly to dissolve then coat with icing sugar. Add cream to can of bean sprouts and shake well to coat, then drain. Cut mini muffin tins or muffin pans into six equal squares. Fill each muffin or pan with 2/3 cup bean sprouts, then spread 1 cup cola over and top with bean sprouts. Cover each pan with aluminum foil and bake at 300 - 350 f for 10 - 12 minutes. Uncover and bake for another 5 minutes or until nicely browned and bubbly. Cut into 2 squares and place in an iced cupcake dish to cool.

title: Fried Mexican Burritos
ingredients: 8 inches burrito-size flour tortillas | 1 1/2 teaspoons anise flavoring
instructions: Take one burrito size flour tortilla, put the mixture inside and roll it up. Wrap in waxed paper and place in the freezer to harden.

title: Mandarin Guacamole
ingredients: 2 mandarin oranges, skinned and sliced | 1/4 cup prepared guacamole | 1/4 cup dried oregano, crushed ( or to taste )
instructions: Mix all together in a bowl. Serve with hot chips.

Random Ingredients: vital wheat gluten,za'atar spice mix,margarine,coconut flake,chili sauce
title: Easy Thai Chicken (Gluten Free, Vegan, Vegan
ingredients: 2 cups za'atar spice mix | 2/3 cup coconut flakes ( or more depending on how chewy you like it ) | 1 cup margarine | 2 tablespoons sweet chili sauce | 1 cup gluten free dry whole wheat gluten
instructions: Heat 1 cup of water to boiling and add the za'atar mix, stir well. Remove from heat. Add the margarine and sweet chili sauce to the za'atar mix, stir well to mix. Add in the celtic flakes and half the coconut. Mix well. Add in the other half of the coconut and mix. Spray the sides of a 9x13 pan with cooking spray, pour mixture into the pan and flatten out evenly. Cover with tin foil.

title: Spaghetti Breakfast Nests
ingredients: 6 slices bacon, diced | 1 teaspoon cumin | 1 package spaghetti, broken | 1/2 cup long grain rice, uncooked | 1/2 cup black sesame seed, coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees fahrenheit. In a large skillet, cook chopped bacon until crisp.

title: Mashed Potatoes With White Potatoes
ingredients: 400 g new potatoes, unpeeled, scrubbed and washed, ends trimmed | 400 g white potatoes, unpeeled, scrubbed and scrubbed, ends trimmed
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees centigrade. Line a medium sized ovenproof baking dish with non stick baking paper. Put the potatoes in a large saucepan of boiling, salted water and bring to the boil. Boil for 12 minutes or until cooked though. Dry on paper. Drain well then mash with a fork. Scatter over the white potatoes. Make an indentation in the centre of the potato with a fork or skewer, then pop in the hot potato mixture. Bake in the oven for 30 minutes or until heated through. Serve straight away.

title: Easy Mexican-Style Chicken Wings
ingredients: 4 corn on the cob, husks | 1 medium poblano pepper, chopped | 1 parsnip, peeled and sliced | 2 1/2 tablespoons chicken wings, split down the middle, tips left on | 1 1/2 tablespoons vodka
instructions: Boil corn in water until very tender, drain. Cut corn off cob and remove husks. Cut remaining cobs into 3 or 4 pieces, each about 12 inches long. Place corn, poblano, parsnip and wings in a large plastic bag. Pour in vodka. Seal and shake to coat. Refrigerate the chicken for a couple hours or up to two days. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Remove wings from bag and pat dry. Place breasts side by side on the foil, skin side up. Brush tops with vodka. Fold aluminum foil over, and seal edges and ends. Bake in preheated oven for 45 minutes.

title: Fruit & Oat Breakfast Muesli
ingredients: 2 large poblano chile peppers, halved lengthways, deseeded and chopped | 1 apple, peeled, cored and finely chopped | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 2 tablespoons tarragon | 1 sheet oatmeal | 1/4 cup rolled oats
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c or 160c fan forced. Line a baking tray with baking paper. Place poblano chile halves on the tray. Toss with apple, syrup and tarragon. Spray a small frying pan with cooking spray. Toss 1/4 of the fruit mixture with half the oatmeal. Top with half the oat mash and then half the remaining fruit mixture. Repeat with remaining oatmeal and fruit mixture. Bake for 10 - 15 minutes until crisp and golden. Serve with reserved yoghurt for dipping.

title: Bahama Mama's Pinto Beans
ingredients: 2 lbs dried pinto beans or 2 lbs pinto beans | 2 serrano chilies | 2/3 cup dark rum ( to taste ) ( optional )
instructions: Sort and wash the pinto beans in several changes of water until they are clean and place in a pot with enough water to cover the bean by at least 3 inches. Bring to a rolling boil, then reduce the heat and cook until done, adding about 4 cups water while cooking. Meanwhile, start the sauce by putting the chilies in a skillet with 1 cup water. Simmer on medium until warm and very fragrant. Do not let them burn. When the beans are almost soft, and the chilies have turned a brighter red, take them out of the saucepan and put them in a blender with the chilies and the rum. Blend for about 1 minute, until everything is well mixed. Transfer the mixture back into the saucepan and add 3 cups of water and bring to a boil, stirring often. Reduce the heat, stir and simmer until thickened. You should have about 1 1/2 cups left. The syrup should be hot but not boiling. Remove from the heat. Cover and keep in the refrigerator overnight, stirring occasionally. It is best to have everything ready the night before. The flavor will develop, and the bean will be ready to use. The next morning, remove the chilies and taste for heat. Add more rum, if you like. This would be yummy served over rice or queso fresco.

Random Ingredients: flour tortilla,red chili pepper,sherry,meatball,green capsicum,romaine lettuce heart,chinese black mushroom,granny smith apple
title: Meatball-Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 1/4 cup dry sherry | 1 kg cooked meatballs, cut into strips ( meatballs if you wish ) | 1 green capsicum, finely diced | 1 red chili pepper, finely diced | 1/4 cup chopped romaine lettuce hearts | 4 slices romano cheese or 4 slices cheddar cheese, shredded | 4 flour tortillas | 2 tablespoons sliced chinese black mushrooms ( optional )
instructions: Combine the sherry, meatballs and capicum in a large bowl and stir well using a fork. Add the lettuce hearts, cheese and mushrooms. Toss lightly with your hands. Divide mixture among the tortillas, top with remaining ingredients, roll up and serve.

Random Ingredients: anchovy fillet,sage leaf,semolina,pumpkin seed,basil pesto,hoisin sauce
title: Pumpkin Seed & Lime Ricotta
ingredients: 4 1/2 cups unsalted pumpkin seeds ( about 3/4 pound ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons basil pesto | 1/3 cup hoisin sauce | 3 anchovy fillets, drained | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh sage leaves | 2 1/4 cups semolina, fine | 1/4 cup whole, unblanched whole almonds or 1/4 cup pecans
instructions: Toast the pumpkin seeds in a skillet over medium heat, shaking and stirring frequently, until they are lightly colored and darker in color, 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Rice With Mascarpone
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice | lady finger
instructions: In a small, heavy pot over low heat, combine the rice with 1/2 cup cold water. Cover the pot and cook until the water is absorbed and the rice is tender, about 20 minutes. Line a baking sheet with a piece of aluminum foil. Remove the rice from the heat. Spread the rice in a circle on the foil. Refrigerate until cold, 20 to 30 minutes. Working with one ladyfinger at a time, carefully slide the rice onto the ladyfinger, shaking off any excess. Arrange it in attractive pattern onto a platter.

title: Scotch Turkey Baked in Brown Sauce
ingredients: 4 turkey | 1 tablespoon seasoning salt | 2 tablespoons caster sugar
instructions: Place the turkey in a non aluminium aluminum baking tin. Sprinkle the turkey with seasoning and sugar. Brush the top with oil. Bake uncovered for 30 - 40 minutes at 200 degrees c.

Random Ingredients: cannellini bean,belgian endive,rye flour,mirin,splenda granular,bulgar wheat,sandwich bun
title: Belgian Endive and Bulgur Sandwich
ingredients: 1 head belgian endive ( about 2 lb. ) | 1 can cannellini beans, drained | 1/2 lb wheat sandwich bun | 1/2 cup bulgar wheat | 4 tablespoons light miracle-style miracle-style miracle-cooking sherry or 4 tablespoons regular sherry | 1/4 cup splenda granular or 1/4 cup sugar | 2 tablespoons mirin
instructions: Cut endive in half lengthwise. Thinly slice crosswise. Arrange endive slices in single layer on foil lined or jelly roll baking sheet.

title: French Dip
ingredients: 1 french roll | 2 teaspoons beef bouillon granules ( or other equivalent )
instructions: First, cut a slit across the roll about 1/3 of the way through. Open it with your fingers. Place this in the bowl on the top of the roll. Sprinkle bouillon over the roll and roll the roll. Cut french rolls in half and serve.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,sausage,egg yolk,potato,chicken thigh,ham hock,cream mushroom soup,mango
title: Ham-Fly
ingredients: 3 potatoes, cubed | 1 ounce cream of mushroom soup | 2 boneless chicken thighs or 2 boneless chicken drumsticks | 4 ounces smoked ham hocks | 4 ounces smoked sausage | peanut oil | 2 egg yolks, beaten | 1 mango, sliced, for topping ( optional )
instructions: Boil potatoes in salted water. Drain and mash with soup, chicken or turkey fat. In a large frypan melt the choclate, fry ham hocks and sausage, drain and keep warm. Make a hole in potato mix with the egg yolks, pour in soup mixture and heat through, add cheese and mash if using, heat for just a moment. Pour over ham hocks and sausage. Garnish with mango slices. Serve with rice.

title: Macaroni & Tortellini Rice
ingredients: 1 white tortilla | 8 ounces macaroni ( uncooked ) | 12 ounces tortellini ( refrigerated, frozen or fresh ) | 2 1/2 cups white corn tortillas, cut in pieces
instructions: In a large pot of water, cook tortellini for 5 minutes, drain. While tortellini is cooking, heat white tortilla and macaroni. Heat the tortellini for 5 - 6 minutes more, or until tortellini is browned and tortelli is softened. Add water as necessary, just to cover the tortellini and macaroni. Stir and cook over medium heat for 5 minutes. In a large serving dish, layer the rice and tortellini mix, sprinkling each layer with the green beans and tortellini. Repeat, ending with the green beans.

Random Ingredients: soy mozzarella cheese,au jus mix,cranberry,heavy cream,white pepper,kosher salt,serrano chilies,citrus infused vodka
title: Cranberry-Serrano Mousse in Sweet Spiced Yogurt Sauce (Rick Bayless)
ingredients: kosher salt, to taste | white pepper, to taste | 8 cups thickly sliced whole wheat soy mozzarella cheese, 1/4-inch dice | 1 package au jus mix ( jugo ) | 1 tablespoon citrus-infused vodka | 1 cup heavy cream | 1 teaspoon fresh ground white pepper | 4 serrano chilies, stemmed
instructions: Sprinkle the grates of a grater with 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/2 teaspoon white pepper.

Random Ingredients: soya sauce,dark rum,phyllo pastry,walnut,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Walnut & Nut Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 1 lb walnuts, shelled | 7 ounces phyllo pastry, defrosted | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/4 cup soya sauce | 2 teaspoons dark rum
instructions: Place walnuts on paper towel and pat dry. Place 2 sheets of phyllo in a plastic bag, and spray tops of triangles with vegetable oil or nonstick spray. Place in freezer for 20 minutes or until sheets are about 7 by 13 inches in diameter. Spray bottoms of phyllo triangles with vegetable oil or nonstick spray and place in cold oven to toast. After 10 minutes, remove from oven and spread phyllo triangles with soya sauce until they are about 1/2 inch thick. Sprinkle toasted walnuts over phyllo triangles and sprinkle with rum. Allow to cool for about 15 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: canadian bacon,spaghetti sauce,pepper sauce,spice,cider vinegar,rom tomato,italian tomato,horseradish
title: Canadian Bacon Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti | 1 can italian stewed tomatoes | 1 can canadian bacon | 1 jar spaghetti sauce | 2 teaspoons mixed spice | 1 cup cider vinegar | 2 teaspoons hot pepper sauce | 2 teaspoons prepared horseradish
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f grease a 3 quart round casserole dish. Prepare spaghetti according to package directions, drain and set aside. Dice Canadian bacon and add to spaghetti. Mix together all other ingredients and pour into prepared casserole dish. Bake at 400f for 15 minutes. Remove from oven and sprinkle with grated cheese. Return to oven and cook an additional 10 minutes.

title: Indian-Spiced Nuts
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 cup sunflower seeds, toasted | 1/4 cup ground hazelnuts | 1/4 cup amaretto or 1/4 cup almond-flavored liqueur | 1 tablespoon thai fish sauce | 2 -3 tablespoons tomato, chopped fresh | 1/2 teaspoon salt and pepper
instructions: If using sunflower seeds, soak them in warm water for 10 minutes, then drain and toss with nuts. Let cool completely, then stir in remaining ingredients until well combined.

title: Oriental Tofu
ingredients: 2 packages light extra firm tofu, crumbled | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 package lard | 6 tablespoons lard | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 6 teaspoons molasses
instructions: Brown crushed cornstarch in lard. Add soy sauce and molasses.

Random Ingredients: cilantro stem,caper,cayenne pepper,plain nonfat yogurt,allspice,cardamom seed,dark brown sugar,basmati rice
title: Rice With Cardamom and Cilantro
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups plain nonfat yogurt | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 2 tablespoons fresh cilantro stems, minced | 1 teaspoon whole cardamom seed, crushed | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 2 teaspoons allspice, ground | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1/4 cup capers, drained | 4 cups cooked basmati rice
instructions: Combine yogurt, sugar, cilantro, cardamom, cayenne, allspice, cardamom and capers in a medium bowl. Cover and chill at least 8 hours or for up to 4 days. When ready to serve, heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add drained rice and saute for 2 to 5 minutes, or until golden brown, stirring constantly. Remove from skillet and serve with a dollop of yogurt sauce.

Random Ingredients: apple,arborio rice,masa corn flour,vegetable broth,onion salt
title: Apple Risotto
ingredients: 1/4 cup masa corn flour, divided | 2 cups vegetable broth, divided | 2 cups basmati rice | 1/4 cup minced onion | 1/2 teaspoon dried arborio rice
instructions: Combine 1/4 cup masa corn flour with 1/4 cup broth and stir until smooth. Set aside. Bring remaining broth to a boil in a 2 quart saucepan and stir in the rice. Cover and remove from heat. Let stand for 10 minutes. Fluff with a fork and mix in the masa corn mixture and onion. Cover with plastic wrap and set aside to stand for about 2 hours so the flavors can soak into the rice. To serve, stir risotto into the broth and heat through.

title: Sweet and Sour Turnips
ingredients: 3 lbs turnips, peeled cored, cut into 1-inch slices | 10 ounces watermelon, cut into 1-inch slices ( remove the seed for less juice ) | 3 tablespoons fresh coriander seeds | 1 cup fresh pumpkin seeds | 1 cup saskatoon berry cranberry sauce or 1 cup water | 1/2 cup fresh lime juice | ice cream ( optional )
instructions: Toast the coriander seeds in a dry skillet until fragrant, about 2 minutes. Place in a small skillet and add the watermelon, pumpkin, and cranberry sauce or water. Bring the mixture to a boil, cover and cook on low heat until the turnips are fork tender, about 20 minutes. Add the lime juice during the last 5 minutes of cooking.

Random Ingredients: hamburger,cayenne,whipping cream,thyme leave,cake flour,wheat flour,cardamom,coffee granule
title: Quick and Easy Beef Stroganoff
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 1 tablespoon whole wheat flour | 1 tablespoon cake flour | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne | 1/4 cup whipping cream | cardamom | thyme leave | 1 tablespoon instant coffee granules
instructions: Brown hamburger and saute until cooked through. Set aside. Sift together flours & cardamon, sift over mixture. Heat cream and coffee. Add to meat. Stir until sauce thickens. Serve over noodles.

Random Ingredients: baby bok choy,green chilies,tarragon,red chili powder,green cardamom pod,pecorino romano cheese,brown rice,salt black pepper
title: Green Rice and Vegetables With a Fresh Pecorino
