ingredients: 3 cups brown rice, prepared from crustless italian deli | 2 green chilies, finely chopped | 1 large baby bok choy, coarsely chopped | 7 slices pecorino romano cheese, finely grated ( or mozzarella ) | 1/4 cup fresh tarragon, chopped | red chili powder, to taste | 2 -3 green cardamom pods, lightly cracked | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Cook rice according to recipe description, or place in large colander in sink. Rinse rice. Gently toss rice with chiles and any accumulated juices except cheese and set aside. Add bok choy, cheese and spices. Toss lightly, just until cheese is melted. Spread rice mixture evenly over a shallow baking pan about 1/4 inch thick. Transfer to oven and bake until rice becomes a light golden brown crust, about 45 minutes. Watch carefully and stir after 15 minutes, being careful not to disturb the crust. Cut into wedges and serve immediately. Note, if making ahead, allow room for rice and vegetables to cool to room temperature. Heat remaining cheese in a small skillet over medium heat until melted and slightly crisp. Sprinkle over cooled rice garnish.

Random Ingredients: ice water,chili powder,bay leaf,corn tortilla chip,gelatin,beer,caper
title: Tortilla Chips
ingredients: 1 envelope unflavored gelatin | 1 pint beer, dark ( corona or pacific ) | 1/2 cup ice water | 1 tablespoon ground chili powder | 1 bay leaf | 4 ounces corn tortilla chips, crumbled | 3 tablespoons capers, drained, rinsed and drained
instructions: Soften gelatin in beer or water for 10 minutes, then add to gelatin. Dissolve sugar in beer or water, then blend well. Dissolve jelly in ice water, then add bay leaf and chilli powder, stirring well. To assemble, sprinkle each serving with crushed tortilla chips, then sprinkle with capers. Note that all tortilla chips can be made at time of making any number of chips to make tacos or enchiladas. To assemble, put 1 tablespoon of tortilla chips on baking sheet and lightly toast under broiler until cracker browns.

title: Vegetable Poffentie Bites
ingredients: 1 lb red lentils | 1 bunch asparagus | 1 cup port wine | 1/2 cup port wine | 2 cups biscuit mix | 300 g baked beans, defrosted | 2 courgettes, zucchini, zucchini, mushrooms ok variety optional
instructions: Mix the lentils and asparagus in a large pan with water to cover. Bring to the boil then reduce heat and simmer covered for about 20 minutes. Meanwhile, mix the port wine and the port over the stove and remove from heat when the liquid has thickened and the port has reduced. Place the biscuit mix in another bowl and pour the hot lentils to coat. Add the drained and cooled vegetables and stir to combine. Return to the boil, increase the heat and cook for 5 minutes or so, stirring constantly. Remove from the heat and stir in the baked beans. Spoon into 6 - 8 moulds, filling the centre of each mould. Serve right away or store in an air tight container away from direct sunlight.

title: Super Noodle Salad (With Apricot)
ingredients: 2 1/2 ounces chow mein noodles | 1 can baked beans, drained | 1 teaspoon superfine sugar | 2 teaspoons dried apricot pieces, chopped | 4 ounces cottage cheese, drained with some added
instructions: Place the chow mein noodles in a large bowl. Rinse and drain the beans. Add the sugar and apricots to the noodles and mix through. Pour over the chow mein noodles. Add cottage cheese and stir to coat. Refrigerate 3 hours or overnight, until ready to serve.

title: Spiced Vegetables With Gluten Free Cracker Tortillas
ingredients: 2 lbs butternut squash, peeled, seeded, cubed | 2 lbs green beans, trimmed, cut in half | 3 large potatoes, scrubbed | 1 lb portobello mushroom caps, halved ( or other mushroom ) | 1 tablespoon tamari | 1 tablespoon mixed spice
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Line a nonstick baking sheet with parchment paper or spray lightly. In a 5 to 7 quart pot over medium low heat, combine squash and green beans and sauté until tender crisp and lightly brown, stirring about twice. Meanwhile, arrange potato cubes on a plate and cover. Bake in oven until tender when pierced with a fork, about 12 to 15 minutes. Scrub potatoes under cold water and cool. Use a potato peeler to remove fibers around potato. Cut potatoes into 1/4 thick slices and toss with tamari. Arrange potato mixture on an 8 by 8 inch baking pan. Top with vegetables and top with more tamari. Smooth top evenly. Sprinkle with mixed spice. Cook in oven for 12 to 15 minutes or remove from oven and let sit for 5 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: grain wild rice mix,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Wild Rice  (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 box long grain wild rice mix | vegetable oil cooking spray
instructions: Place the rice mix and seasoning in a 3 1/2 to 4 quart slow cooker. Add water until just below the top of the rice package, stir well then cover with lid. Set on low or warm setting for 7 to 8 hours, or until rice is tender and fluffy. Note, for an even more savory taste, you can use 1 tablespoon of dried thyme.

title: Filipino Delight
ingredients: 1 kg meat or 1 kg poultry | 200 -400 g desiccated coconut | 10 teaspoons vinegar
instructions: Prep and grill, in a heavy fry pan with the vinegar, over medium heat until the juice is absorbed by the meat. Keep it warm till serving time. Boil the meat with the juice until it is well cooked. Serve garnished with the coconut.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,five spice powder,baby corn,spaghetti,white wine vinegar,milk,angel hair pasta,coconut
title: Sweet Corn and Spaghetti Salad
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti | 1 cup white wine vinegar | 6 tablespoons grand marnier | 6 tablespoons chopped sweetened coconut | 4 tablespoons five-spice powder | 2 jars baby corn, drained | 7/8 cup unsweetened evaporated milk | freshly grated coconut, to garnish ( optional ) | angel hair pasta ( optional )
instructions: Cook spaghetti until al dente. Drain pasta in a colander and rinse with cold water until cool. Place pasta back in pot along with 2 tbsp of the vinegar. Add remaining ingredients and stir well. Garnish with reserved coconut, if desired. If you are taking the optional ingredient, serve at room temperature.

title: Quick Cheesy Appetizer
ingredients: 1 cup shredded mexican blend cheese | 1 teaspoon chinese five spice powder
instructions: Spread 1/3 cup cheese on the flatbread and top it off by placing in a microwave or on a large plate and pressing down well to flatten into 4 squares. The cheese should form a round shape that is a little bit bigger than the flatbread squares. Sprinkle the remainder of the cheese on top and press again to flatten again.

title: Homemade Mustard
ingredients: 1 cup chicken broth | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom
instructions: Place all ingredients in a pot, and bring to a boil, stirring frequently. Reduce heat to low, and simmer, covered, for 30 to 45 minutes. Allow to cool to room temperature, and serve at room temperature.

title: Chilli Jam  (Kiaya Kapusta
ingredients: 500 g ham, diced ( kung pao ) | 1 egg, separated | 2 -3 teaspoons gelatin, powder, powder ( kir chee ) | 1/2 - 1 cup amaretto ( to taste ) or 1/2-1 cup sweet sherry ( to taste ) | 1 -2 cup chili, fresh, diced ( use a good fresh jalepeno, serrano )
instructions: Soak the gelatin powder in amaretto or sweet sherry. Dice the ham, if using, and add it to the egg yolk and mix well with your hands. Whip egg white until stiff and fold into the ham mixture. Place jelly in a small pot and add a small tablespoon of warm water to cover the bottom. Place over medium heat and bring to a boil, stirring from time to time. Remove from heat, then remove from heat and chill for an hour. Remove the jelly from heat and add chili and minced serrano. Allow mixture to cool to room temperature, stirring occasionally. Pour into sterilized jars. Allow to cool and seal. Makes about 2 - 3 dozen jars.

Random Ingredients: pork loin roast,ancho chile pepper,chicken,saffron,dark rum,egg white,bay leaf,parsley flake
title: Carnitas - the Best Ever
ingredients: 1 tablespoon saffron | 2 teaspoons dried ancho chile peppers | 1 pound boneless chicken, cubed | 2 cans chicken, drained and rinsed | 1 egg white | 1/2 cup chopped fresh parsley flakes, divided | 2 cans pork loin roasts | 1/4 cup dark rum
instructions: Place saffron and ancho chili peppers in a small bowl. Pour hot water over chiles to soften. Stir to crumble and set aside. Place chicken in a large stock pot and cover with water. Bring to a boil and cook 20 minutes. Drain, reserving 1/4 cup broth. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place chicken and reserved broth in a separate saucepan, cover and simmer over medium low heat. In a small bowl, whisk egg and half of parsley flakes together. Place pork in a mixing bowl and add egg mixture and remaining parsley flakes to pork. Mix thoroughly. Place pork mixture in a baking dish. Cover and bake in preheated oven for 1 hour, basting occasionally. To serve, place pork in a serving dish and pour reserved broth and rum over.

Random Ingredients: chicken leg quarter,asparagus,carrot,cocoa powder,peanut butter,grain rice,salt pepper,gruyere cheese
title: Chicken & Brown Rice Casserole With Shredded Gruyere
ingredients: 1 package chicken leg quarters ( about 2lb and 1.5kg ) | salt & pepper | 2 lbs carrots ( cut into 3/4-inch slices 1/4-inch thick ) | 4 ounces asparagus ( trimmed and cut into 1/2-inch pieces ) | 2/3 cup smooth, creamy peanut butter | 1/2 cup shredded gruyere cheese | 1 1/2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 1/2 cups long grain rice
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees fahrenheit. Place the chicken legs in a baking dish, sprinkle them with salt, and place in the oven. Cook until tender, about 45 minutes. Let cool slightly, then cut the legs into 1/2 inch slices. Peel carrots and cut into 3/4 inch slices. Steam asparagus until bright green and crisp tender, about 2 minutes. Set aside. In a bowl, with a fork, mash the asparagus to release as much of the liquid as possible.

title: Saffron Tea
ingredients: 1 cup fresh currants or 1 cup dried currant, finely minced | 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh lemongrass, minced | 1 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1 teaspoon celery seed | 6 tablespoons taco sauce | 4 teaspoons saffron threads or 4 teaspoons turmeric | pimientos or chives ( to garnish )
instructions: Mince the lemongrass and mix with the cardamom, celery seed, and 4 tablespoons of water. You may add up to 4 tablespoons more water. You can use other spices. Add remaining 2 tablespoons water and pour over the chopped vegetables. Taste and add more lime or lemon if desired. Chill overnight. Pour over ice if making a tea with the tea. You can also use the chillate to flavor up your favorite tea.

title: Cherry Chicken
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts | 1 stalk celery, thinly sliced | 1 can maraschino cherries
instructions: Place chicken in crockpot. Add celery, reserving some for the topping. Cover and cook on low until chicken is tender.

Random Ingredients: broccoli,mustard powder,artichoke heart,seafood,red chilies,vanilla essence,salt pepper
title: Seafood Capellini
ingredients: 1 medium broccoli, washed well and cut into florets | 1 -2 small red chilies, washed ( optional ) | 500 g seafood, any kind ( such as mussels or shrimp ) | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 2 -3 teaspoons pure vanilla essence | 1 jar marinated artichoke hearts, drained ( about 15 ) | salt and pepper, to taste
instructions: Bring a large saucepan of water to a boil, add the broccoli and chillies and blanch for one minute, remove and immerse in ice water, drain and rinse. Heat a non stick pan and add mustard and curry leaves on medium high heat. When the mustard sputters add the seafood and a pinch of salt, stir fry for 1 - 2 minutes until the seafood turns pink. Add the marinated artichoke hearts and continue to stir in the mustard. Drain the broccoli and chillies, remove the stalks to thicken sauce and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: beef roast,nonfat cream,cremini mushroom,flat leaf parsley,butternut squash
title: Roasted Beef
ingredients: 20 ounces corned beef roast, with spice packet | 2 tablespoons dried parsley | 1 butternut squash, halved, sliced 1/4 inch thick | 1 cup nonfat sour cream | 3 tablespoons dried nonfat sour cream | 1/2 cup sliced cremini mushrooms
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Remove top rack of grill and place roast on rack on a roasting pan. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon of dried parsley, and set aside. Place squash on rack along with remaining 1 tablespoons dried parsley. Roast 20 minutes, or until blackened. Using a spatula, turn roast over and roast an additional 15 minutes, or until an instant read thermometer reads internal temperature of rare 120°f. When the roast has rested, cut into small slices. Place squash slices on a serving platter and cover with sour cream. Spoon sour cream mixture over squash, and sprinkle with sliced mushrooms.

Random Ingredients: cider vinegar,sake,pecorino romano cheese,hot paprika,ice,red bell pepper,sirloin
title: Sliced Steak with Red Pepper Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped red bell pepper, seeded | 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 1/4 cup shaved pecorino romano cheese or 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese | 2 tablespoons dry-roasted crushed italian saffron-flavored sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 2 teaspoons hot paprika ( i use szirachi ) | 1 tablespoon dry-roasted sweet paprika | 2 lbs sirloin, trimmed of all fat, cut into 2 serving-size pieces
instructions: In a 1 gallon zip top bag, combine the red pepper, vinegar, cheese, and sun dried tomatoes. Seal the bag.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,button mushroom,meat,hot paprika,red cabbage,pepper sauce
title: Spanish Chicken With Mushroom & Pepper Cabbage
ingredients: 4 chicken breast halves | 2 cups shredded red cabbage | 200 g button mushrooms | 2 hot spanish paprika | 1/2 cup hot pepper sauce | 3 ounces sliced meat, chopped into thin slices
instructions: Grill chicken, skin side down first. Flip over, gas mark 7, for 3 - 6 minutes each side. Place cabbage shreds on 2 serving plates. Arrange mushrooms and hot sauce over top. Top with chicken, cut in wedges.

title: Auberge Apple Spinach With Cream
ingredients: 500 g frozen chopped spinach | 300 ml apple juice | 150 ml double cream | pepper
instructions: Pre heat oven to 180'c. Cook the frozen chopped spinach in boiling, salted water for 2 or 3 minutes or until just cooked. Drain well. Meanwhile place apple juice and cream in a small saucepan and bring to the boil, scraping any bits from the bottom of the pan with a wooden spoon. Boil for 2 minutes more or until the sauce is reduced by half. Season with pepper and add to the spinach, stirring to combine. Spoon mixture into a 2 litre ovenproof dish or individual oven proof dishes as if you were making a fan forced pie. Place in the pre heated oven and bake for 1 hour or until just heated through. Serve warm with fresh vegetables such as a jacket potato and steamed green beans.

Random Ingredients: champagne,double cream,sea salt,italian bread,black peppercorn,white bean
title: Quick Bread and Bean Pies
ingredients: 1 packet dry white beans, such as cannellini beans | 150 ml champagne | sea salt | 25 cm fresh double cream | 1 3/4 teaspoons black peppercorns ( freshly ground ) | 3 slices italian bread, soaked in water for 10 minutes
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c / 400f / gas prepare the white bean filling, put the beans in a large saucepan with the beer and add 5dl water. Bring to the boil, then simmer gently for 45 - 60 mins, stirring occasionally, until the beans are tender. Remove from the heat and cool for 10 mins. Mash to a paste using a little water, season to taste and set to one side. To assemble, lay the bread on a flat working surface and pour 1 tbs of bean mixture onto it. Top with 2 - 3 tbs of bean filling and roll up, starting from the hollow end. Fold over each end and twist. Scoop into 2 large oven proof bowls and cover with clingfilm. Make the topping, place the cream in a small saucepan over medium heat and stir until the mixture thickens. Add the peppercorns to taste and season to taste with salt. Pour about 1/3 of the mixture into each bowl and serve.

title: Hawaiian Lamb with Pineapple Ice Cream
ingredients: 1 pound lamb shoulder, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1 cup heavy whipping cream, divided | 1 can crushed pineapple with juice
instructions: Combine lamb, 1/4 cup cream, and crushed pineapple in a slow cooker. Cook on low heat setting for 8 hours or on high heat setting for 4 hours, turning meat occasionally.

title: Tahini Flounder Salad
ingredients: 4 flounder, cleaned | 2 tablespoons tahini | 2 tablespoons italian dressing | 1 teaspoon cornflour | 1/2 cup margarine | 2 cups lettuce leaves | 2 tablespoons port wine
instructions: Place flounder in a large, shallow baking dish, pour over dressing and toss to coat. Place in oven at 375°f.

title: Tamarind Cheese
ingredients: 2 1/2 ounces tamarind paste | 8 ounces gruyere cheese ( grated cheese ) | 1 ham stick
instructions: Dissolve tamarind paste in cold water. Fold cheese and ham stick into the paste. Put mixture into a shallow ovenproof dish or pie dish. Cover and bake in a preheated 375f oven for 40 - 45 minutes or until golden. Allow to rest for 5 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: meat,cherry,glutinous rice flour,lemon juice,habanero pepper,spicy brown mustard,pork loin,cannellini bean
title: Grecian Style Baked Pork and Beans over Spicy Rice
ingredients: 500 g dried cannellini beans or 500 g great northern beans, washed and drained | 500 g smoked pork loin or 500 g smoked pork, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1/3 1/3 cup spicy brown mustard or 1/3 cup grain mustard | 1 tablespoon sweet glutinous-rice flour ( glutinous rice flour ) | 2 tablespoons spicy brown mustard or 2 tablespoons grain mustard | 4 tablespoons fresh squeezed lemon juice | 1 tablespoon habanero pepper, chopped | 1 cup cooked sweet cherries, drained and dried | 1 small boiled baby sweet potato or 1 small sweet potato, cut into wedges
instructions: The day before cooking, soak beans in plenty of cold water for 5 to 8 hours to soften for flavors to develop. Drain and set aside. The next day, cook the pork cut into 1 inch cubes and place in a non stick frying pan. Combine the 1/3 cup mustard with the lemon juice and add to the pork. Cook briefly until the pork starts to brown lightly. Pour the bean and pork mixture into a large baking dish. Mix the sweet potato with the 1/2 cup mustard and spread over one side of the pork, leaving space approximately 1/3 of an inch clear on the top of the dish. Place the baking dish in the center of the preheated 475 f oven, sprinkle with additional mustard, cover with foil and bake for 45 minutes until lightly browned. Remove the foil and add the sweet potato. Return to an oven and bake an additional 15 to 20 minutes or until the sweet potato is golden.

Random Ingredients: green chili pepper,beef stew meat,pork roast,orange juice concentrate,cucumber,brown gravy mix,chive,pasta
title: Mexican Pork and Cheese With Crock Pot Veggies
ingredients: 2 lbs pork roast, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 package brown gravy mix | 6 ounces frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed | 2 -3 medium cucumbers, sliced ( approx 3 cups ) | 1 lb beef stew meat, cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 cups cooked pasta or 2 cups other pastas | 4 -5 tablespoons chopped fresh chives
instructions: Combine all ingredients in slow cooker. Cover and cook on low for 8 to 10 hours. Turn control to high. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer on high for 30 to 40 minutes or until vegetables are tender, stirring every 7 to 10 minutes. Serve over hot cooked white rice or in crock pot on the stove with a salad of your choice.

Random Ingredients: cider vinegar,kosher salt,kiwi fruit,spanish onion,mahi fillet,mushroom,extra virgin olive oil
title: Kiwifruit and Maui Mahi With Spicy Mayo
ingredients: 4 mahi mahi fillets | 1/3 cup cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon kosher salt | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 1/2 medium spanish onions or 1/2 medium onion, thinly sliced | 1 package sliced mushrooms | 3 kiwi fruits, peeled and sliced on the diagonal
instructions: Prepare the grill with cooking spray. Place mahi mahi on grill pan. Grill until cooked through turning once. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, mix vinegar, salt, and oil until mixed. Place onion and mushrooms on grill. Drizzle on vinegar/oil mixture and sprinkle with half of remaining onion/mahi slices on top of each mahi mahi. Garnish with kiwifruit slices. Eat with spanish style grain, white rice, or couscous enjoy.

title: Authentic Fettuccine (Fettuccine All'Amatriciana)
ingredients: 2 packages sazon goya | 1 package dry breadcrumbs | garlic salt | seasoning salt | 1 lb fettuccine pasta
instructions: In a mixing bowl, dissolve sazon goya in a little hot water. Put sazon aside. Mix dry ingrdients together. In a greased and floured skillet, heat sazon just till lightly golden. Do not bring to boil. When ready, add the bread crumbs, garlic salt and seasoned mix. Do not brown, but just lightly brown. Fold cooked fettuccine into sazon. You may need to make more or less depending on the texture of the fettuccine. When all is nicely browned, serve warm or chill.

title: Lillian's Buffalo Wing Fingers
ingredients: 2 cups all-purpose flour | 1 tablespoon poultry seasoning
instructions: Sift flour and poultry seasoning together in a medium bowl. Add the sugar and knead on a lightly floured surface for 2 minutes, making sure to form it into a stiff dough. If the dough is too soft, add a little more flour. Cover with plastic wrap and set aside for 20 minutes. In a heavy, cast iron skillet, heat chicken wing sauce until just warmed. Cover with plastic wrap and set aside. Remove all excess flour from the dough and roll the dough into an oval shape, about 30 to 35 inches long and 3/4 inch thick. Cut the dough into finger sized fingers and coat with the glaze. In a 12 inch skillet, heat the chicken wing sauce until just boiling. Remove from the heat and brush the hot chicken fingers with the remaining glaze. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: wild rice,pastry shell,baby artichoke,bean sprout,white vinegar,angostura bitter
title: Wild Rice and Artichokes Tartar
ingredients: 1 pastry shell | 1 bag pre-washed brown wild rice | 1 can mixed beans sprouts | 1/2 cup baby artichoke, rinsed and drained | 2 tablespoons distilled white vinegar | 1 dash angostura bitters
instructions: In a large nonstick frying pan, toast the rice according to package instructions. Remove from heat to keep warm. Arrange rice in prepared pie shell. In a large mixing bowl, combine the green beans, artichoke hearts, vinegar and bitters. Stir well.

title: Mustard-Mushroom Stroganoff
ingredients: 1 tablespoon mild ghee or 1 tablespoon butter | 2 cups cremini mushrooms ( or baby portabellos ) | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder
instructions: Heat ghee in a small pan. Toss in mushrooms, and saute until tender. Add mustard powder and stir fry until it just starts to color. Eat immediately.

Random Ingredients: egg noodle,ginger garlic paste,milk ricotta cheese,pepper,chili pepper flake,pistachio
title: Spicy Noodle and Ricotta
ingredients: 16 ounces whole milk ricotta cheese | 6 ounces egg noodles | 1 cup roasted sweet chili pepper flakes | 1/2 cup chopped pistachios | 1 teaspoon grated fresh ginger-garlic paste | 1 teaspoon pepper
instructions: Boil a kettle of salted water or a large pot of boiling water. Meanwhile, cook the pasta according to package directions. Drain and run cold water over the drained noodles. In a medium bowl, mix the ricotta, egg noodles, hot peppers, pistachios, ginger garlic and pepper. Toss with cooked noodles and serve warm or cold.

title: Garlicky Corn With Pork and Coconut.
ingredients: 1/4 lb salted pork, cut into medium size pieces | 3/4 cup coconut, freshly grated | 1 ear corn, preferably tasmanian or british bok choy | 2 baby bok choy, cleaned and sliced ( optional )
instructions: Heat half the coconut on low to medium heat in a very large frypay pan and add pork. Fry, stirring constantly, for about 10 minutes. Meanwhile heat remaining coconut in a separate frying pan on low to medium low heat. Add bok choy to pan. When pork is brown, remove from pan and set aside. Add the remaining coconut to the pan. When coconut is lightly brown, return pork to pan, add bok choy and continue to fry over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes. If vegetables are not yet cooked, serve over the hot white rice, accompanied by a small bowl of warm steamed white rice.

title: Vegetable Fillings & Sauerkraut
ingredients: 2 cans sauerkraut | 1 can cannellini beans, drained | 1 can cooked vegetables | 1/4 teaspoon mixed herbs | vegetable filling | herbs, to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400&deg.

title: English Mustard
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon chopped sage leaves
instructions: Combine mustard and sage. Will keep one week in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: double cream,red cabbage,vanilla bean,catsup,vodka,egg white,oyster sauce,white breadcrumb
title: Smothered Eggs With Variations
ingredients: 3 egg whites, lightly beaten | 1 1/2 tablespoons vanilla beans, minced | 9 ounces double cream | 1 tablespoon catsup | 1 teaspoon oyster sauce | 3/4 cup fresh white breadcrumbs | 1 ounce vodka ( i prefer absolut ) | 2 1/2 cups shredded red cabbage
instructions: In a small bowl or freezer bag, whisk the egg whites until foamy. Add the vanilla bean and blend well. In a glass or stainless steel bowl or other bowl, mix the cream, catsup, oyster sauce and bread crumbs until well blended. Add the egg whites and mix well until incorporated. Coat a skillet with cooking spray and heat over medium heat. Add the egg mixture, spreading the mixture into an even layer. Immediately reduce the heat to low. Cover and continue cooking until the mixture is firm and puffed. It should look like a puffed pastry and not like the appearance of scrambled eggs. Add a little water if necessary to keep from burning. When the pastry mixture is done, remove the pan from the heat and allow to cool. Remove the pastry mixture from the heat and divide evenly among the 8 slices of fried egg. Serve immediately.

title: Quick Chili Con Carne
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans | 1 green pepper, sliced | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 teaspoon hot paprika | 2 -3 tablespoons brandy
instructions: Place first three ingredients in a sauce pan. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat. Cook, uncovered, for 10 - 15 minutes. Stir in brandy.

title: Pappardelle with Plum and Fresh Tomato
ingredients: 1 lb pappardelle pasta | 1 plum, very ripe, very ripe, sliced
instructions: Put the pasta in a cold salted bowl. Add the plum and just enough cold water to cover. Let stand a few minutes, then drain and return to the bowl. Serve warm.

title: Kolab -- Ladyfingers in Sweet-And-Sour Sauce
ingredients: 12 ladyfingers | 1/4 lb ground meat, finely ground | 2 teaspoons finely chopped candied orange peel | 3 tablespoons tamari or 3 tablespoons soy sauce | 2 teaspoons finely chopped anise
instructions: Prepare all ingredients according to your taste. Lay the ladyfingers on a sheet of greased wax paper, and cover with another sheet of wax paper. With a sharp knife, cut the paper over the ladyfingers until a somewhat flattened rectangle forms. Lay a meat slice from one end of the ladyfinger toward the other on the wax paper. Spread the meat with the orange peel, then roll it up. Wrap the roll in wax paper and refrigerate overnight. Next morning, grill kolabs on a griddle or large electric skillet over medium high heat for about 8 - 10 minutes, until browned. Spread with sweet and sour sauce and serve with fresh fruit.

Random Ingredients: sauce,deli roast beef,pineapple,self raising flour,picante sauce
title: Pineapple and Beef Skewers on Skewers
ingredients: 12 slices deli roast beef | 1 jar sweet and sour cocktail sauce | 100 g pineapple, cubed | 8 slices of your choice picante ( hot if you can find them ) | 1 cup self-raising flour
instructions: Slice beef thinly. Thread each slice with a pineapple cube and top with a slice of roast beef. Make sure to brush the slices with some of the sauce on the beef before serving. Mix the remaining sauce and flour to make a paste on the plate or in the sink or plate. Brush oil over both sides of each skewer.

title: Rice Vinegar, Staple Style
ingredients: 2 fluid ounces rice wine vinegar | 2 fluid ounces parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated | 1/2 cup dried currant
instructions: Combine vinegar, cheese and currants in a pitcher. Cover and refrigerate until ready to use. Note. This can be made just as it is, but the result is a more elegant way to heat the vinegar and cheese.

title: Sweet and Spicy Smoky Tomato Roll-Ups
ingredients: 1/2 cup dark molasses | 2 tablespoons barbecue sauce | 16 ounces tomatillos, husked and rinsed | 1 teaspoon dried red pepper, crushed | 1 package ladyfingers | 8 flour tortillas, warmed
instructions: Set a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Combine molasses and barbecue sauce in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: orange peel,walnut,tahini,pickle relish,rosemary,red yellow bell pepper,cooking couscous,dijon mustard
title: North African Couscous Salad
ingredients: 13 ounces quick-cooking couscous, uncooked | 1 small red and yellow bell pepper, chopped | 2 tablespoons tahini | 2 tablespoons orange peel, chopped | 2 tablespoons sweet pickle relish | 1/4 cup walnuts, roughly chopped | 2 tablespoons fresh rosemary, roughly chopped | dijon mustard, to taste
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Add a little dijon to help the salad cling to the vegetables. Serve.

Random Ingredients: garam masala,herbes de,italian sausage,provolone cheese,fettuccine pasta
title: Easy Fettuccine with Sausage and Grilled Cheese
ingredients: 1 package fettuccine pasta, cooked | 3 cups cooked italian sausage, cut into 1/4 inch chunks | 1/2 cup grated provolone cheese | 2 teaspoons herbes de provence | 1 -2 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: In a deep pan, saute sausage and provolone over medium heat until sausage is cooked and cheese is melted.

Random Ingredients: white rice,vegetable stock,oyster sauce,celery leaf,baking potato,dark sesame oil,cucumber
title: Steamed Squash with Sichuan Fried Onions: Sichuan Restaurant, Hong Shao Xia
ingredients: 1 1 1/2 lbs firm organic fresh baking potatoes, sliced on a mandolin slicer slicer horizontal to the middle about 4 inch thick | 1/4 lb unpeeled cucumber, peeled, seeded, and cut on a mandolin slicer horizontal to the middle about 1/4 inch thick | 1 tablespoon vegetable stock, if needed | 1 head celery & leaves, chopped, with leaves, if desired | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 1 teaspoon white rice, ground to a grain, sambal oelek | 1/4 teaspoon dark sesame oil | caramelized white rice, for dipping
instructions: Preheat wok or deep skillet with a tight fitting lid over high heat. Add a small amount of oil to get hot but not smoking and sear potatoes for about 3 - 5 minutes each side or until dark brown. Transfer potatoes to a colander to cool. Drain on paper towels, set aside. Repeat process with remaining potatoes and cucumber, adding more oil and stock until potatoes total weight about 3 cups. Transfer potato mixture to the work bowl of a food processor fitted with a coarse blade and puree mixture in batches until uniform in color and texture, being careful not to overprocess. Add reserved cucumber mixture, celery leaves, sesame oil, oyster sauce, and rice and puree and process again until smooth. Cover and refrigerate for at least one hour before service. Serve warm or cold with caramelized white rice. Prepare sichuan fried onions, sichuan chili paste, sesame oil, sesame seeds, and fresh chiles to make sichuan garlic sauce, sichuan peppercorns, sambal oelek, or any other dipping sauce your heart desires. Yield, 1/4 cup.

title: Baja Green Pimento Dip With Coconut
ingredients: 1 cup shredded coconut, drained | 3/4 cup shredded monterey jack cheese | 1/4 cup chopped scotch bonnet peppers ( i used a blend of habanero peppers, jalapeno, and red bell peppers. ) or 1/4 cup minced scotch bonnet pepper, seeded, deveined, deveined ( i used a blend of habanero peppers, jalapeno, and red bell peppers. ) | 1/4 teaspoon salt
instructions: In small bowl, stir together coconut, cheese, scotch bonnet peppers, pepper, and salt. Serve hot with pita chips or vegetables.

Random Ingredients: asiago cheese,chestnut,raisin,turmeric powder,lemon,taco seasoning mix,phyllo pastry,cider
title: Mexican Chestnut Baklava Roll
ingredients: 2 packages phyllo pastry | 1 - 1 1/2 cup dry taco seasoning mix ( i use < a href= '' https : //www.geniuskitchen.com/recipe/easy-colby-sugar-and-spice-mix-123211 '' > easy colby's sugar and spice spice mix < /a > | 1/3 cup raisins | 2 tablespoons ground chestnuts | 1 tablespoon grated fresh lemon rind | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 2 teaspoons grated asiago cheese ( or any other cheese that you like ) | 2 tablespoons cider ( apple juice or apple cider would also be good )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. On a parchment lined cookie sheet lay out half of phyllo. Sprinkle with half of taco seasoning mix. On a second cookie sheet lay out the other half of phyllo and sprinkle with remaining taco seasoning and taco mix. Using your fingertips massage all the ingredients into the 4 pieces of phyllo into a log 1/4 thick. Do not overlap pieces. Place log in a 13x9 baking dish with the seam on,. Sprinkle raisins evenly over log.. Bake for an additional 15 - 20 minutes or until top is golden. Cut a slit down the center of and pull 1 side in half.

Random Ingredients: meatless sauce,rabbit,dijon mustard,garlic clove,bread,egg white,cornmeal,lime juice zest
title: Peking Roast Rabbit With Lime Sauce
ingredients: 6 slices bread, preferably day old | 2 medium free range rabbit, cleaned and trimmed | 1 1/2 cups cornmeal | 1 egg white, lightly beaten | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1 garlic clove, crushed | 1 lime, juice and zest of, grated | 1 jar meatless sauce
instructions: Cut bread into 1 - 2 cubes each. Line a large roasting pan with the bread and place rabbit in pan. Scatter garlic over bread on top of rabbit and then coat with cornmeal. Mix egg white with mustard and lime juice and zest. Pour over rabbit in pan. Roast meat basting with lime sauce and basting vegetables occasionally for 2 hours, or until cooked through. Remove rabbit from pan, cover and let stand for 30 minutes before carving.

title: Chili Cheese Phyllo Wraps
ingredients: 3 packages cream cheese, room temperature | 4 teaspoons ground coffee | 2 teaspoons chili powder | 2 packages phyllo pastry sheets, thawed, and cooled
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix cream cheese and ground coffee. Add chili power and mix. Roll out each sheet of phyllo pastry at a time with a rolling pin to a 12 x 10 rectangle. Spread one cream cheese spread over base of each flattened pastry sheet. Place one another phyllo sheet and the cream cheese mixture at a time on top of the cream cheese mixture. Roll and wrap pastry tightly in plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 1 and up to 6 hours if desired. Slice the rolled sheets into 1/2 inch wide strips. Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown and crisp, about 12 to 15 minutes. Don't leave phyllo dry. Serve warm. For vegan use the cream cheese and use non dairy.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,italian herb seasoning,fingerling potato,orange food coloring,sauce,cayenne pepper,horseradish,cornflour
title: Roest Fingerling French Fries
ingredients: 1 cup cornflour | 1/2 cup hot sauce | 1/4 cup fresh horseradish, grated | 1 tablespoon chili oil | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1/2 teaspoon dried italian herb seasoning | 1 tablespoon orange food coloring | 4 fingerling potatoes, halved lengthways ( approx 1lb )
instructions: Combine cornflour, hot sauce, horseradish, chili oil, cayenne, italian herbs and orange food colouring in a bowl.

title: Spice Paste I
ingredients: 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1/4 cup ground fenugreek seeds
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat, stirring to dissolve the oil. When the oil is very hot, add the fenugreek and cook until the fenugreek turns a dark brown color and smells very fragrant, about 1 minute. Transfer the fenugreek into a small bowl, and cool to room temperature. Store in the refrigerator up to two weeks.

title: Almond Ouzo Cookies
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups unbleached flour, plus extra for dusting | 6 tablespoons ouzo, plus extra for dusting | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 1 1/2 teaspoons fresh lime, grated coarsely
instructions: In a bowl, mix together the flour, ouzo, almond extract, and lime. Make sure the mixture is well together. Place a large nonstick frying pan over medium high heat. Place a scant 1 tablespoon of the mixture into the frying pan, and immediately roll into a ball. Using a spatula, carefully transfer the dough to a parchment lined baking sheet. Cover the baking sheet with plastic wrap or waxed paper, and refrigerate for 2 hours, flipping half way through. Preheat the oven to 350°f. Cook the dough for about 10 minutes, or until it is lightly browned and set. Using a long slender knife, scrape off some dough that has set. Roll out as thinly as possible. Using a 2 1/2 inch round cookie cutter, cut out cookies from the dough. Transfer the cookies to a parchment lined baking sheet. Let cool 5 minutes. Using a 3/4 inch round cookie cutter or a glass, cut out cookies from the dough and set onto the parchment lined baking sheet. Using a 3 inch round cookie cutter or a glass, cut out cookies from the dough and transfer onto the parchment lined baking sheet. Using a 3/4 inch round cookie cutter or a glass, cut out cookies from the dough and transfer onto the parchment lined baking sheet. Let cool 5 minutes, or until the cookies become lightly browned and firm. Store in an airtight container, layered between plastic wrap and a piece of waxed paper.

Random Ingredients: ginger paste,gjetost cheese,white chocolate,chinese noodle,phyllo pastry
title: Chinese Phyllo Pie (Barszcz)
ingredients: 2 sheets phyllo pastry | 1 teaspoon ginger paste | 1 cup gjetost cheese or 1 cup swiss cheese, shredded | 3 tablespoons white chocolate, grated | 1 cup chinese noodles, cooked
instructions: Spray 2 cookie sheets with cooking spray. Place a sheet of phyllo sheets in a 9x13 inch pan, spraying each with cooking oil as you lay it. Layer in the order listed, brushing each sheet with oil as you go, and finishing with a layer of phyllo. Place a sheet of noodles on top of the sheet, but don't stack, because they could cause a pastry brush to stick to the noodles during cooking, and you could easily paint a napkin/paper napkin on top if you like, or you could simply paint a pastry brush with a pastry brush.

title: Mexican Zucchini and Kiwi Appetizer
ingredients: 4 medium zucchini | 1/2 cup taco sauce | 1/4 cup grated romano cheese | 3 medium kiwi fruits
instructions: Cut zucchini lengthwise and slice throughly into bite size pieces. Place in a colander and place in microwave safe container with approximately 1/4 cup of water over high power setting. Allow to sit until zucchini is pliable. About 5 minutes, stirring constantly until water is absorbed and zucchini is just tender but not crisp looking. Drain well and immediately add taco sauce and chesse and stir thoroughly to coat. Spoon zucchini onto paper towels and sprinkle with cheese. Cut kiwi or apples and place on top of zucchini mixture. Microwave on medium until hot and cheese looks crispy around the edges. If desired, can place on a platter with lettuce, tortilla chips, lettuce wraps, etc.

title: Spiced Italian Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 can italian plum tomatoes | 1/2 cup dried fenugreek leaves | ice cube
instructions: Combine the tomatoes, fenugreek leaves and 1 tbsp of water in a microwave safe glass serving dish, cover with plastic wrap and microwave on high for 20 - 25 seconds or until warmed through. Stir mixture and serve.

Random Ingredients: mustard seed,pineapple juice,honey,coriander powder,poultry seasoning,thai rice noodle,prosciutto,green pepper
title: Thai Sweet & Sour Noodles
ingredients: 1 package thai sweet and sour rice noodles ( rice vermicelli or short broken ones ) | 3 tablespoons mango chutney, your favorite | 2 tablespoons honey | 1/2 teaspoon ground coriander powder | 1/2 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 green pepper, finely chopped | 3 slices prosciutto | 1 1/2 cups pineapple juice ( or more, to taste )
instructions: Soak rice noodles per package directions. Meanwhile, mix mango chutney, honey, coriander, mustard seeds, green pepper, prosciutto and pineapple juice into a sauce. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat. Cover and simmer 10 minutes. Drain noodles. Stir noodles and sauce until well coated with sauce.

Random Ingredients: sherry,cream cheese,yellow bell pepper,baking potato,gingerroot,lemon juice
title: Stir Fry Potatoes
ingredients: 2 lbs baking potatoes, peeled and sliced | 1 jar sliced gingerroot | 1 yellow bell pepper, sliced into 1/8-inch thick rings | 2 packages cream cheese, cut into squares | 1 teaspoon fresh lemon juice | 1/2 cup sherry ( optional. i like it plain )
instructions: In a large skillet, add potatoes, gingerroot, hot pepper rings and cream cheese and mix. Cook on medium heat for 15 - 20 minutes or until potatoes begin to soften and gingerroot is tender. Add lemon juice and sherry, reduce heat and simmer for about 5 minutes until heated through.

title: Tropical Salad With Spiced Rum
ingredients: 1/2 cucumber, peeled, seeded and sliced | 4 cups mixed greens ( i use mixed red, green and/or brown ) | 10 ounces corn, frozen ( may sub frozen corn kernels, if fresh is not availiable, make sure they are frozen ) | 8 ounces cranberries ( can sub frozen, if fresh is availiable ) | 1 1/2 fluid ounces coconut rum | 1 whole vanilla ( to taste ) ( optional ) | 1 -2 tablespoon dried fenugreek or 1 -2 tablespoon cayenne pepper ( to taste ) ( optional )
instructions: Whisk all ingredients well. Serve and enjoy.

title: Nanas Dessert
ingredients: 1 can vanilla instant pudding | 1 white onion, sliced thin | 1/4 lb prepared vanilla pudding ( i used jello )
instructions: Drain the water from 1 can of vanilla pudding. Slice onion. Arrange the sliced onions around the base of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Spread 1/2 the vanilla pudding across the top of the onions. Spread your vanilla pudding over the vanilla pudding. Sprinkle 1/4 of the white onion over the vanilla pudding and the remaining white onion. Spread the other can of instant pudding over the top of the white onion and the vanilla pudding. Sprinkle with remaining white onion. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight if possible. Best eaten immediately.

title: Wild Mushroom Wine Blend
ingredients: 1 cup merlot | 3/4 cup tamari | 1/2 cup prepared horseradish | 3 tablespoons chives, minced | 1/4 cup mild prepared horseradish | 1 ounce dry tare
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine merlot, tamari, horseradish, chives and tare and warm over low heat until almost all of the liquid is reduced and the flavors are well blended, about 15 minutes. Add in dry tare to the sauce and allow mixture to cook approximately 5 minutes. To serve, strain wine and discard solids.

Random Ingredients: five spice powder,baby spinach,spanish onion,mushroom stem,green capsicum,italian salad dressing
title: Spinach, Mushroom, Green Capsicum and Italian Salad
ingredients: 4 green capsicums | 3 large mushrooms stems | 100 g baby spinach, cleaned | 200 g mixed mushrooms stems | 1/2 spanish onion | 1 envelope italian salad dressing
instructions: Prepare the green capsicum by roasting it on the open end of a char grill. Remove it from the char grill, remove the seeds and peel the capsicum, slice it into four even pieces lengthwise and place it on a serving platter with the mushrooms. Roast the spanish onion and mushroom stems with the green capsicum and the roasted vegetables. The vegetables should also be roasted. When ready to serve, combine the vegetables and the salad in the service platter.

Random Ingredients: coriander,chili pepper,dark brown sugar,coffee,vegetable oil,canadian bacon,cream,green
title: Spicy English Breakfast Chilli Sauce
ingredients: 200 g chopped mixed salad green | 1/2 cup creamed cheese | 1/2 cup sour cream | fresh ground chili pepper | 1 - 2 1/2 small dried red chili pepper, soaked in hot water for 15 minutes and then drained and cut diagonally | 60 g canadian bacon or 60 g bacon pieces | 1/2 cup coffee or 1/2 cup hot water | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar | 1/3 cup chopped coriander | vegetable oil, for deep frying
instructions: Put the mixed salad into a large serving bowl, add the cream, chilies, bacon, sugar and coriander and mix. Pour in just enough cold water to give a coating coating consistency. Drain the chillies into a sieve and press to remove any excess moisture. Stir in the oil to make sure the sugar dissolves. Toss and taste if any remains.

title: Jerk and Crawfish Salad
ingredients: 2 pounds cooked crawfish tails | 1 package ladyfingers | 1 red apple - peeled, cored and cubed | 4 fresh jalapenos or jalapenos, seeded and minced | 2 tablespoons jerk seasoning, or more as needed | 8 lime wedges
instructions: Combine crawfish tails, ladyfingers in a large bowl, and the red apple, jalapenos, and jerk seasoning. Gently mix in lime wedges just before serving.

title: Clams With Raspberry Salad
ingredients: 1 kg clam, in shells | 1 kg raspberries | 2 large green olives, pitted
instructions: Bring a large pan of water to the boil. Meanwhile dry clams. Cover.

title: Tasty Turkish Fritters
ingredients: 4 cans bread crumbs | 4 tablespoons coarse turkish baharat aka aceitun turkish pate ( found at middle eastern specialty store ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: In a medium sized bowl soak bread crumbs in a large quantity of water. Add a generous amount of turkish pate and vanilla extract and mix gently. If it is too thick add another small amount of water. Form dough as big or thin as you like. If it is too soft, add a little ice if it looks dry, and add more pate or mix it with a spoon. Put each batch on a plate covered with parchment paper. Place in the refrigerator to set. Sauce,. In a small bowl combine the desired amount of spicy yellow gravy, salt/paprika, or other seasonings. Add a few tablespoons of sweet or sour sauce to taste. You can use your imagination and play with it.

title: Quick Barley Taco Bread
ingredients: 1 cup pearl barley | 1/2 teaspoon celery salt | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning | 1/2 cup spiced rum | 1 1/4 cups all-purpose flour
instructions: Preheat your oven to 450 degrees f. Spread the barley on a baking sheet with a coating of cooking spray. Bake the barley in the preheated oven until it is tender, then drain the barley and set aside to cool slightly. Meanwhile, combine the taco seasoning with the rum, fluffing it into the barley. Add the flour to the barley and stir until smooth. Add the cooked barley to the bowl, mix well. Transfer the mixture to a baking sheet. Dot with the back of a small spoon, top with a lid or a lid of aluminum foil and bake at 450 degrees f for about 15 to 25 minutes, or until the mixture has risen and is slightly puffy. Serve with your favourite taco or other toppings.

Random Ingredients: hazelnut,green lentil,heavy whipping cream,coriander,white flour,black sesame seed
title: Sesame Baked Lentils With Hazelnuts
ingredients: 2 cups green lentils, rinsed, picked over, and drained | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 cup finely ground hazelnuts | ground coriander | 1/4 cup white flour | 2 -3 tablespoons black sesame seeds ( or green pistachios, lightly toasted, and finely chopped )
instructions: Mix the ingredients together and put a large baking tray with a well fitting lid into a preheated oven. Heat the cream until simmering but not boiling. Stir in a handful of ground hazelnuts, and leave, stirring regularly, for 5 minutes. Stir in a little water if it has not completely cooked off, and then stir through the remaining ground nuts. Tip the mixture into the baking tray and put the baking tray on a larger baking sheet. Bake for 20 minutes at 400 degrees f. Sprinkle with a teaspoon of sesame seeds, and pop back into the oven for a few minutes to brown, or until the nuts are sizzling and lightly golden.

title: Poppy Rolls
ingredients: 3/4 cup cashew nuts, coarsely crushed | 8 sheets phyllo dough
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a large bowl, mix nuts and sheets of phyllo dough together. Roll between your palms to lightly coat with oil. Place 2 sheets onto a clean, dry surface. Sprinkle a layer of nuts on top of each sheet, leaving 2/3 uncovered at edges. Top with remaining sheets, buttered side down. Cut each stack into three strips with a very sharp knife. Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, about 25 minutes.

title: Jello Mac & Cheese
ingredients: 1 box macaroni ( shells and dumpling are good ) | 1 box chayotes | 1 box strawberries jell-o gelatin dessert | 2 toothpicks
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Cut ends off chayotes and discard skins. Sear in oil until golden brown and tender. Drain off oil and set aside. Clean and cut into chunks. Place the macaroni on the bottom of a 9x13 baking dish and layer ingredients in this order, macaroni, chayote, strawberries and crumpled jello. Be sure to keep the chesse in mind if desired, cover with foil and bake at 400°f for 50 minutes. Uncover and bake for an additional 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chicken tender,egg substitute,eggplant,linguine pasta,pork rib,bisquick,avocado dip,coriander seed
title: Tasty Chicken and Eggplant Lovers' Chicken Pasta
ingredients: 1 package dried linguine pasta | 1 lb chicken tenders, chopped | 4 eggs | 1 large egg substitute | 4 teaspoons coriander seeds | 1/2 cup bisquick | 1 1/3 cups chicken tenders, chopped | 2/3 cup fat free eggplant ( cut in half ) | 1/3 cup fat free avocado dip, thawed and spreadable
instructions: Cook linguine according to directions on package. In a large bowl, combine chicken with 1 egg and 1 tsp coriander seeds. Mix well and set aside. In a large bowl, whisk together bisquick, egg and rest of coriander seeds. Add remaining 1/3 cup of oil in a medium skillet. Add chicken and egg mixture. Saute until chicken is just cooked through. Drain pasta and add. To chicken mixture. Toss to coat. Top with avocado dip.

title: Hainan Beef Pasta Dinner
ingredients: 500 g stew meat, cut into thin slices | 450 g pasta, such as ditalini or 450 g rigatoni | 2 teaspoons mixed fresh herbs ( e.g. dill, oregano, rosemary, basil, tarragon ) | 1 teaspoon white sugar | 1 teaspoon soy sesame seeds, toasted
instructions: Put meat into a medium size pot, then add the pasta and stir to coat, adding the chopped herbs and sugar. Bring to simmer over a low heat, and cook until pasta is tender. When pasta is done, stir the contents into the meat and herbs. Serve immediately.

title: Naan Bread
ingredients: 1 egg | 6 tablespoons yogurt | 1 teaspoon cider vinegar or 1 teaspoon apple cider vinegar
instructions: Put the egg in a mixing bowl. Whisk until foamy. Beat the yolk, vinegar, and yogurt into the beaten egg. Add some of the egg mixture to the yogurt mixture. Mix. Gradually mix in the remainder of the egg mixture until completely mixed in the yogurt. If too thick, pour in a bit of water, a bit at a time. The bread will come off your spoon easily.

title: Basil-Soy Sauce for Fried Rice
ingredients: 1/4 cup soymilk ( or milk ) | 1/4 cup basil leaves, chopped | 4 tablespoons grated cheese ( or feta ) | 3/4 teaspoon kosher salt | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 4 lettuce leaves, washed, dried and shredded
instructions: Whisk together soy milk with basil leaves and cheese until well blended. Spread rice out on a flat surface and lightly sprinkle salt on the top. Steam over medium heat until the milk thickens and rice is cooked, 3 - 4 minutes.

title: Faux French Canadian Bacon and Prosciutto Side Item
ingredients: 3 tablespoons allspice | 2 tablespoons sliced prosciutto
instructions: Combine all ingredients and slice into 1 inch pieces.

title: No-Fuss Lemon Cream Candy
ingredients: 1 cup lemon juice ( i like zest of 1 lemon ) | 1 box vanilla instant pudding mix ( regular size )
instructions: Preheat oven to 275 degrees. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a large bowl combine the lemon juice, pudding mix and the lemon zest, tossing well to combine. Spoon the lemon cream mixture into a buttered 9x9 inch pan. When the cream is just below the top of the cream, sprinkle the entire top with sugar. Bake for 12 - 20 minutes or until the candy reaches 238f on a candy thermometer. Let cool and store in an airtight container. Note, i store two 9x9 inch pans in the freezer, and one 9x9 inch pan in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: black bean,egg noodle,dark rum,tabasco sauce,wild rice,thai chile
title: Noodles With Black Beans and Wild Rice
ingredients: 4 cups egg noodles | 1 cup thai chile | 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup dark rum | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1/3 cup wild rice, cooked
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. Meanwhile, combine chilies, beans and rum in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 2 minutes, stirring occasionally. Stir in cooked noodles and heat thoroughly. Mix in tabasco. Serve over cooked wild rice.

title: Fruit & Chive Bean Frijoles (Stolen from Charosetchen)
ingredients: 6 ounces dried pinto beans | 2 ounces dark chocolate | 1 small white onion, chopped | 1 tablespoon green chives, chopped | 1 -2 tablespoon golden syrup ( i get a little sweetness in mine )
instructions: Soak the beans for 3 - 4 hours, then boil gently for 1 hour. If you can, drain the water completely and boil over a hot pan of gently simmering water, for about 20 minutes until the beans are soft but not mushy i usually drain them for a few minutes. Take them out with a slotted spoon, and dry on kitchen paper. Melt the chocolate in a large heavy based pan, then add the chopped onion and white chives, then cook for 1 minute over a gentle heat or until soft and golden, but not brown. Drain about half of the beans, then add them to the chocolate and stir in the golden syrup. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: feta,rhubarb,corn flake,paprika,button mushroom,cream cheese,ha avocadoes,channa dal
title: Rhubarb Crunch
ingredients: 2 tablespoons feta | 1 tablespoon sour cream | 1 tablespoon channa dal ( split black gram flour ) | 1 tablespoon corn flakes ( finely crushed ) | 1 tablespoon paprika | 1 medium bunch fresh rhubarb ( chopped ) | 1 medium hass avocado ( chopped ) | 3 fresh button mushrooms ( chopped )
instructions: Drain all excess liquid from the rhubarb and shred the rhubarb finely. Preheat the oven to 180c. Spread the feta all over the base of a casserole dish. Mix the sour cream, channa dal and cornflour with the paprika and spread evenly on top. Bake in the oven for 10 mins, sprinkle the channa dal and the finely diced rhubarb over the crumbs and gently stir through the chopped avocado. Once cooked, remove from the oven and leave for 5 mins while you serve the crumble topping. If you want to add more sour cream and channa dal do your best to reduce the amount of fat and fat in this recipe. Stir through most of the finely chopped spring onion, add the chopped mushroom and serve straight away, or keep your eye on it.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno,red chili powder,lima bean,vanilla essence,canola oil,ice water,chili flake,tamari
title: Sweet Chili Beans
ingredients: 1 cup small lima beans ( dried beans, you can also use fresh if you have them ) | 4 cups ice water | 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1 small dried red chili powder | 1 small dried chili flakes | 1 small dried jalapeno | 1 teaspoon tamari | 1 small vanilla essence
instructions: Place lima beans in a strainer and place several cups of ice water over the top, pushing down on the beans to push out as much water as possible. Allow the water to soak for 30 minutes to 2 hours. Drain. Place beans in a large saucepan, add a tsp of oil and bring to a boil. Add chili flakes and chili flakes and return to the boil. Lower heat and simmer until beans are tender. Toss with tamari, vanilla essence and strained lima bean water. Serve immediately. The chilli should be left in the bean. I use fresh chilli because it's really hot.

title: Tandoori Onion Dip
ingredients: 3 large sweet onions or 3 large golden onions | 20 teaspoons canola oil or 20 teaspoons vegetable oil, for shallow frying
instructions: Peel onions, slice thinly vertically through the root ends, then slice them into thin slices. Heat oil in a heavy frying pan until quite hot but not smoking. If you are using the onions as you are using them fry onions with the oil, uncovered, for 8 - 10 minutes on each side, until they are nicely browned and soft and have lost some of their shine. The onions can then be served immediately, drizzled with dip or as a condiment to accompany indian flatbreads.

title: Italian Sausage Stuff for Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 lb sweet italian sausage | 1 bag cooked shell pasta
instructions: Cut sausage into 1 inch pieces. In an oven safe large bowl, combine the sausage, uncooked shell pasta, chicken bouillon and chopped mushrooms. Mix together and allow to set in preheated 400 degree oven.

title: Mint Frikadeller Mash
ingredients: 1 kg small baking potato, peeled | 200 g butter, melted | 500 g ground lamb | 12 leaves mint
instructions: Cut potatoes into quarters, making an even layer then slice 1/8 thick or thinner depending on how large you slice the potatoes.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,asafoetida powder,red curry paste,turnip,vanilla essence,cantaloupe,pumpkin puree
title: Coco - Sweet Potato & Vegetable Curry
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs rump steak, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 can pumpkin puree | 1 can asafoetida powder | 4 -6 teaspoons red curry paste, mixed with | 1 inch of peeled pepitas ( pumpkin pie spice ) | 1 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: In a large pot, heat the curry paste, stirring well. Add the cubed meat, and continue to cook until the meat is browned on all sides. Add the peas, and continue cooking for about another 1 - 2 minutes. Pour the pumpkin and the masala into the meat and veggies. Stir and allow to bring to a boil. Stir in the vanilla, and bring to a slow simmer. Serve hot with steamed basmati rice.

Random Ingredients: half,dark rum,ancho chile,red food coloring,hot sauce
title: Ancho Chile Rum
ingredients: 5 large ancho chiles | 1 pint half-and-half | 1/2 cup red food coloring | 2 tablespoons dark rum | 2 -5 drops hot sauce or 2 -5 drops tabasco sauce
instructions: Roast the ancho chilies in a preheated 350' oven for 15 minutes. Watch carefully so they do not burn. The ancho chilies should be dark and sizzling hot. Remove and remove the stems, keeping the chilies whole. Cut chilies into quarters and devein. Place in a stainless steel pan. Add half and half, food coloring, rum and hot sauce. Stir over medium heat to blend. If it starts to curdle, add a few more tbsp of water, 1 tbsp at a time. Bring to a boil to form a thin syrup. Serve immidiately.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder,banana pepper,chipotle powder,poppy seed,sage,sage leaf
title: Smokey Mexican Pork Rub (Puerto Rican Subru Uncle Bill's Recipe)
ingredients: 4 lbs pork shoulder, ground | 8 -10 bananas ( i actually use two ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme | 1/2 teaspoon dried chipotle powder, chipotle powder is available at mexican specialty food stores that comes in envelopes | 2 tablespoons poppy seeds, lightly toasted
instructions: Brown the ground pork in a wide frying pan. You will need to do this in batches. Transfer hot pork to a bowl and set aside. When fully hot, add the banana peppers and the rest of the ingredients and mix them together thoroughly. Use as desired.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt,sun tomato oil,white pepper,chicken stock,peach,mango,cold water,tarragon
title: Mango-Tarragon Soup With Peaches and Peaches
ingredients: 4 ripe mangoes | 1/2 cup chopped sun-dried tomato packed in oil, chopped | 1/4 lb tarragon, chopped | 4 cups chicken stock | 1/4 cup freshly grated fresh parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 2 tablespoons fresh squeezed cold water | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Peel the mangoes, core, and cut into bite size chunks. Place in a blender with the remaining ingredients, except the salt and pepper. Blend until smooth. Transfer to a deep pan or soup pot. Cover and bring to a simmer over low heat. Simmer, partially covered, for at least 30 minutes to 2 hours. Remove from the heat, stir in the salt and pepper and serve.

title: Aunt Erika's Corn Noodle Salad
ingredients: 2 cups egg noodles | 1/2 pound lean ground beef | 2 tablespoons corn oil | 1 jar beer | 2 slices smoked ham | 4 ounces grated gouda cheese
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the noodles, and cook until tender, about 5 minutes, or until al dente. Rinse with cold water and drain. In a skillet over medium heat, cook and stir the ground beef until evenly browned. Drain, and set aside. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. In a large roasting pan, combine the noodles, beef, oil, and beer. Mix well, and sprinkle top with ham. Bake in the preheated oven for 40 minutes, or until bubbly, and lightly browned.

title: Jumbo Baked Shells
ingredients: 1 package dry yeast, about 4 1/2 cups | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 7 cups cooked jumbo pasta shells ( about 12 ounces ) | 1 quart coconut oil, melted
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup water and set aside. Beat remaining 1/4 cup water, turmeric, and shell flour until smooth and satiny using an electric mixer. Beat in yeast mixture and coconut oil. Cover and let stand in a warm place until dough is doubled, about 1 1/2 hours. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Knead dough well and roll out on a lightly floured surface into a rectangle about 15 x 12 inches. Cut into four squares and transfer to a large baking sheet, spacing about 2 inches apart. Cover and let stand in a warm place to rise again until dough has doubled, about 45 minutes. While dough is rising, preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Bake shells for 10 to 15 minutes. Serve warm or cold.

title: Heirloom Tomato Chutney Chicken
ingredients: 1 can heirloom tomatoes | 1 bag fresh dates | 1 red pepper ( or red pepper flakes ) | 1 1/2 cups reduced-sodium chicken stock | 1/3 cup mango chutney
instructions: Pour tomatoes and dates into a strainer and let drain about 20 minutes. Cut red pepper into fine 1 inch squares. Place red pepper squares and dates together in a plastic container and add 1 1/2 cups chicken stock. Add mango chutney and mix throughly. Chill until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: green chili salsa,taco sauce,baby bok choy,red onion
title: Baby Bok Choy
ingredients: 1 kg baby bok choy | 2 jars mild green chili salsa | 1 red onion, sliced | 1 jar taco sauce
instructions: Wash and trim the bok choy and cut off the top layer. Wash the outside leaves well, then cut off the stalky tops. Cut the bok choy into 1 inch slices, removing any tough, shiny leaves. Place bok choy in a large stockpot or large bowl and cover with water over high heat. Bring to the boil, then lower the heat and simmer for about 45 minutes to 1 hour, or until tender. Stir occasionally when bok choy is tender, scoop out any remaining bok choy and save. Place chopped onions in a pan and cook until soft, then stir in the shredded bok choy. To serve, top with taco sauce and chopped green chilies. Add more taco sauce to your taste.

title: Vietnamese Pepper Salad
ingredients: 4 tablespoons coarse mustard powder | 2 1/2 teaspoons grated galangal | 2 scallions, thinly sliced | 1 1/2 teaspoons coarsely crushed dried romano lettuce leaves | 3 cups shredded romaine lettuce leaves
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the mustard powder, galangal, scallions and romano.

Random Ingredients: yukon gold potato,jasmine rice,vanilla ice cream,chili pepper,cream chicken soup
title: Ice Cream Potato Casserole
ingredients: 2 lbs yukon gold potatoes, peeled and cut into 1 inch chunks | 2 -3 cups vanilla ice cream, divided | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 2 -3 teaspoons chili peppers, adjust to taste | 8 medium jasmine rice ( not instant )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a large baking dish add the diced potatoes and about 1/4 cup of the ice cream on top. Sprinkle with chile powder. Top with sour cream and more ice cream if desired. Cover with foil and bake for 1 hour and let sit 1 minute. Note, you may have to take the foil off and bake for about 20 minutes more to bake properly. When almost done, remove from oven. Top with remaining 1/4 cups ice cream and sprinkle with pepper. Place in refrigerator until serving.

Random Ingredients: garbanzo bean,chili powder,radish,chili sauce,scallion,anise seed,salt cod fish,hoisin sauce
title: Ceviche
ingredients: 2 lbs salt cod fish | 2 cups dried garbanzo beans | 1 cup sweet chili sauce | 2 tablespoons hoisin sauce | 2 tablespoons chili powder ( adjust to your preference ) | 2 tablespoons anise seeds | 1 bunch scallion, minced | 1/2 bunch radish, minced | kosher salt and sea salt to taste
instructions: Rinse the salt cod, and then place it in a pot of water and bring to a boil. When the cod begins to float in the water, rinse it under cold water. Drain and then cut it into 2” chunks. Place the chunks into a medium bowl. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add the garbanzo beans and cook for 15 minutes. Drain and set aside. To make the dressing, whisk all the remaining ingredients together in a small bowl. To serve, drizzle the dressing into the bottom of a glass measuring cup or small bowl. Lay the cod pieces on top of the dressing, and pour some of the hot water over the top of each piece. Serve warm with a fresh green salad.

Random Ingredients: gingersnap,anchovy,oregano leaf,pesto sauce,rice,rice bran oil,taco sauce,greek yogurt
title: Homemade Quick Rice Noodle Salad and Spicy Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup raw rice ( not instant ) | 1 1/3 cups plain plain greek yogurt ( or plain yogurt and can use fat free sour cream ) | 2 tablespoons taco sauce ( or soy sauce, your preferred ) | 2 tablespoons low-sodium pesto sauce or 2 tablespoons canola oil ( optional ) | 1 -2 tablespoon rice bran oil | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves or 1 teaspoon dried italian seasoning | 1 teaspoon dried ginger ( optional ) | 4 -5 dried anchovies, crushed ( optional, to taste ) or 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper ( optional, to taste )
instructions: Cook the rice in the microwave as directed on the package while using a regular pot or stovetop pot, just enough to steam. Set aside to let cool in the microwave for 30 minutes. In a large bowl, combine the greek yogurt, taco sauce, pesto or oil, hot pepper sauce, oregano, ginger, and anchovies and mix gently or with a wire whisk. Mix the rice with the yogurt mixture and set aside. Drain the rice and add to the salad while serving. If desired, garnish with more oregano or italian seasoning.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,sea salt pepper,red enchilada sauce,vanilla bean
title: Real Red Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 1 pint red enchilada sauce ( red or green salsa ) | 1 yellow bell pepper ( julienne cut ) | 1 tablespoon sea salt and pepper | 1 vanilla beans ( seeds scraped out or not, see note ) or 1 teaspoon vanilla extract ( seeds scraped out or not, see note )
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees. Combine all ingredients except vanilla beans in a large bowl or a small baking dish. Pour 1/2 of the sauce mixture over the red pepper, and stir. Transfer to oven and bake approx 15 minutes, or until golden. Serve with shredded cheddar cheese, cream cheese, sour cream, green onion slices and salsa, if desired.

title: Cashews With Pesto (Gourmet Today)
ingredients: 50 g cashews | 2 1/2 tablespoons pesto sauce
instructions: Grind the nuts in a food processor. Combine with pesto until fairly smooth.

Random Ingredients: banana pepper,coriander,mandarin orange,white pepper,date,flat leaf parsley,lime juice,yogurt
title: Orange, Banana Pepper and Mandarin Salad
ingredients: 12 mandarin oranges | 2 bananas or 2 red bananas | 12 dates, large diced | 1/2 cup low fat natural yogurt | 1/2 lime, juice of | 1/2 teaspoon coriander, ground | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper | 1/4 teaspoon flat leaf parsley, chopped
instructions: Peel the oranges and bananas and slice into thin wedges. Halve the dates and cut the bananas in half. Blanch the oranges and bananas in boiling, salted water for 3 - 4 minutes or until barely tender. Remove and plunge into cold water, then peel. Transfer to a large bowl and add the yogurt, limes, coriander, pepper and parsley. Toss to combine. Serve at room temperature.

title: Homemade Mexican Quinoa
ingredients: 3 cups of loose-leaf quinoa, rinsed well in the fridge | 1 teaspoon dried guajillo chilies or 1 teaspoon serrano pepper, chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons ghee | 1 teaspoon instant yeast
instructions: Add all ingredients to a large bowl, stir, cover and leave for an hour, stirring occasionally. Serve with sour cream and quinoa.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,pesto sauce,mushroom,cucumber,lipton onion soup mix,table salt,tomato paste,chili sauce
title: Pesto Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 1 cup tomatoes, chopped | 1 cup mushroom, sliced | 1/2 cup cucumber, diced | 1 1/2 teaspoons pesto sauce | 1/2 cup low sodium spaghetti sauce | 1/2 cup lipton onion soup mix | 1/2 teaspoon table salt | 1/2 teaspoon chili sauce
instructions: Toss together in a bowl.

title: Grilled Kale, Orgasm, and Olives
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh kale or 1 bunch baby spinach ( 2 pounds ) | 1 cup sauerkraut, drained | 4 greek olives, pitted and sliced
instructions: Wash and remove tough ends from the kale. Remove the center core and leaves of the kale. Cut off the tough center of the kale leaves. Slice the leaves into 2 inch long strips. Cut out 1/2 inch wide ribbons from each rib. Cut orzo in half crosswise, then rinse in cold water and let cool to room temperature. Coarsely chop the spinach, using a colander. Toast the olives in a large non stick skillet over medium heat, shaking the pan, until they turn pale green and begin to brown, about 3 minutes. Transfer the kale and kraut to a bowl and add the spinach. Toss gently to combine. Divide among serving plates, garnish with the olives and serve with crusty bread to mop up the juices and heat through. Serves 4.

Random Ingredients: pearl barley,greek yogurt,guacamole,onion soup mix,bottom steak,green food coloring,cream mushroom soup
title: Beef and Barley Veggies
ingredients: 2 1/2 - 3 lbs boneless bottom round steak | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 3 tablespoons greek yogurt | 2 packages dry greek yogurt | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 can pearl barley, drained | green food coloring | pepper
instructions: Place meat in crockpot. Mix soup mix with yogurt and mix with meat to evenly coat meat. Place soup mixture over meat then pour half of the greek yogurt mixture over meat. Slather 1 packet of onion soup mix over remaining yogurt followed by pepper. Arrange meat over soup mixture. Cover and cook on low for 8 - 10 hours.

title: Ricotta Cheese Balls (Biscotti Di Carciofo)
ingredients: 1 cup ricotta cheese | 1/3 cup quick oats, or as needed
instructions: Mix ricotta cheese, oats, and 1 teaspoon flour together in a bowl until dough is the consistency of heavy cream.

title: Smoked Beef and Endive (Stove Top)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons oatmeal | 3 tablespoons raisins | 3 tablespoons belgian endive | 1 filet of beef | 1 tablespoon vodka | 4 tablespoons oil
instructions: Grill endive over high flames. Remove from grill and slice very thinly. Place in a shallow dish and sprinkle with salt, allow time to evaporate. Place beef on grill, add vodka and oil. Close cover and cook for five minutes. Turn and cook until desired level of rareness is reached. Serve with boiled new potatoes, carrot sticks and boiled new potatoes for an interesting taste.

Random Ingredients: tea,grainy mustard,tamari soy sauce,slab bacon,white onion,cardamom seed,chicken bouillon cube,poppy seed
title: Spicy Sizzlin Bacon-Wrapped Onions
ingredients: 1 medium white onion, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 4 -6 thin strips of thick slab bacon | 2 tablespoons teaqt mustard | 2 teaspoons poppy seeds | 2 teaspoons tamari soy sauce | 2 teaspoons sizzlin soy sauce or 2 teaspoons kikkoman sweet soy sauce | 1 chicken bouillon cube, crushed | 2 teaspoons cardamom seeds, crushed
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Lay out a rack to form a base of about 12 inches by 8 inches and heat pan on a stove over high heat. Cut down on the side of the onion, starting the very thin slice. The slice should be as wide/small as the bacon strip. Lay out bacon slices so they have flat edges, cut slabs across lengthwise. When ready to use, place desired amount of onions in the centre of the bacon. Begin to roll up like a jelly roll or jelly roll and place seam side down onto the rack to make an oval shaped roll that touches the base of the pan. Repeat with bacon and onions for the other side. Place the rolls at least 4 - 6 at a time onto the rack. In each case, spread mustard evenly over each roll. Combine remaining ingredients into a small bowl and rub generously over the rolls. Transfer rolls to the roasting pan and cover tightly with foil. Bake 30 - 35 minutes, turning every 8 minutes, until the onions are tender and crispy.

Random Ingredients: thyme sprig,chocolate hazelnut spread,graham cracker crumb,peppercorn
title: Zippy Grinder
ingredients: 2 cups coarsely crushed graham cracker crumbs | 2 tablespoons fresh thyme sprigs ( leaves only ) | 1 teaspoon peppercorn, crushed | 1 1/2 tablespoons chocolate hazelnut spread
instructions: Mix crushed graham crumbs with thyme and peppercorns. Sprinkle evenly on the pan. Spread on the top of the crumb mixture. Melt chocolate hazelnut spread on top. Allow melted chocolate to cool before taking it to a serving dish. Keep refrigerated until serving.

title: Crunchy Pita Chips
ingredients: 1 package frozen hummus | 1/4 cup italian salad dressing | 1/4 cup vegetable stock | 1 teaspoon ground pepper | 1 sweet onion, sliced | 4 pita bread rounds
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f spray a baking dish with nonstick cooking spray, or line with parchment paper. Spread hummus evenly in baking dish, and bake 8 minutes, or till golden brown and crusty. Cool, and cut in half while still warm. Combine salad dressing, vegetable stock, and pepper in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Add onion, and cook 5 minutes, or until tender. Place pita halves on a cutting board, and scoop up some of the onion and vegetable mixture, and spread over pita chips. Drizzle with dressing, and sprinkle with more paprika if desired.

title: Aubergines & Penne
ingredients: 20 aubergines | 250 g penne
instructions: Slice aubergine in half lenghtwise and cook in microwave with a teaspoon of oil cooking on high for about 10 minutes. While the aubergines are cooking add penne to a large saucepan of boiling water and boil till pasta is al dente. When pasta is al dente pour boiling water into aubergine and cook for a further 2 minutes. Drain aubergines and cut diagonally into smaller, 1 cm wide slices. Pour oil and aubergines into a large oven safe dish, pour over pasta and toss to coat. Place oven on. Cook in a moderate oven for 12 minutes. Serve warm with chopped fresh coriander.

title: Basic Taco Dough #1 for Peroshka
ingredients: pastry dough ( for peroshka's peroshka ) or crusty roll ( for peroshka's peroshka ) | 1 taco seasoning ( for peroshka's peroshka )
instructions: Roll out pastry dough to 1/8 inch thickness. Use a pastry brush or a pastry cutter to coat the entire surface of the dough. Sprinkle some taco seasoning on it while rolling. When rolled out let it rest for about 15 mins. Use a sharp, pointed knife to cut the dough into 24 pieces. Place them on a cookie sheet lined with parchment paper and brush with taco seasoning. Bake at 300°f for 20 - 25 minutes. Serve with guacamole, sour cream, cheese.

title: Mexican Party Dip
ingredients: 8 cups shredded mexican blend cheese | 2 tablespoons dill pickle relish | 4 cups sliced fresh strawberries
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spread cheese on a large cookie sheet. Sprinkle with pickle relish. Top with a layer of sliced strawberries.

title: Spritzed Pistachio Salad
ingredients: 1/3 cup chopped pistachio nuts | 1 1/2 tablespoons finely chopped candied ginger root | 1 jar picante sauce | 8 cups shredded fontina, preferably multicolored
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Place the pistachios and candied ginger in the bowl of a food processor and pulse until coarsely ground. Transfer the pistachios and ginger to a medium bowl. Add the picante sauce and mix with the pistachios and ginger. Stir in fontina cheese until just coated. Spread the pistachio mixture onto a parchment paper lined baking sheet. Spread the pistachio mixture over the pistachios, then wrap the parchment paper around the dish and refrigerate overnight. The pistachios will keep for 3 days.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed,green cardamom pod,white wine,pickle relish,cayenne pepper,whipping cream
title: Makrout - Algerian Dessert - a Yummy Dessert for Dessert
ingredients: 4 green cardamom pods | 1 cup whipping cream | 1 tablespoon pickle relish | 1/4 teaspoon ground cayenne pepper | 1 teaspoon sesame seeds | 1 tablespoon white wine
instructions: Using a sharp knife or melon baller, core, and seed cardamom pods and place in a mortar with a little salt. Grind coarsely, stopping as needed. In a saucepan, combine the cream, pickle relish, cayenne, and sesame seeds. Stir over low heat until the relish mixture has melted, the mixture does not have to be boiling. Remove the cardamom pods, then pour the liquid over the sesame seeds and set aside to cool. When the cream is sufficiently cold, stir in the reserved spice mixture. Pour into a bowl and store in the refrigerator until the flavors of the pickle relish blend and the cream is ready for use.

title: Creamy Caribbean Low-Carb Fajitas
ingredients: 2 cans mango nectar | 1 green chilies, chopped | 1 red onion, diced | 1 yellow sweet pepper, diced | 1 teaspoon dried thyme
instructions: In a medium bowl combine mango nector and green chilies. Add red onion and mix together. Add thyme and mix thoroughly. Serve in flour tortillas with salsa and garnish with lime if desired.

title: Asparagus Braised With Yakisoba Sauce
ingredients: 4 lbs chicken wings, wings from the chickens, and the backs and cut into 2 1/2-inch lengths ( from the hind legs ) | 12 large anaheim chilies, stemmed and seeded | 1 carrot, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch rounds ( about 1 pound ) | 1/4 lb fresh asparagus, cut into 2 1/2-inch lengths ( about 2 pounds ) | 1/3 cup fresh parsley leaves or 1/3 cup fresh flat-leaf parsley, roughly chopped | 1/3 cup olive oil, plus additional for brushing | 1/3 cup coarsely chopped fresh parsley leaves | 1/2 cup molasses | 2 teaspoons cornflour
instructions: To prepare the asparagus, arrange the asparagus on a large sheet of wax paper. Place the chiles, cut side up, in a heavy 10 to 12 inch skillet and cook over moderate heat, turning them, until they are lightly charred, 10 to 12 minutes.
