Using tongs, transfer the chiles to a bowl and toss lightly with salt. Transfer the chiles to a plate to cool. Peel the peel and seeds from the chiles with 1 teaspoon of salt and discard the stems. Cut the chiles lengthwise into halves and set aside. Using a small spoon, divide half of the chiles' flesh into 6 or 8 sections, keeping them separated. To prepare the yakisoba sauce,. In a small saucepan, place the carrot and asparagus in 1 inch of cold water. Bring to a boil over moderate heat, then reduce the heat, cover and simmer until the asparagus is just tender, about 5 minutes. Drain the asparagus and carrot strips in a sieve and return them to the pan. Remove the asparagus and carrots from the pan and set them aside. Remove the pepper stems. To prepare the asparagus sauce,. Meanwhile, heat 1/4 cup olive oil in a medium saucepan over moderately high heat until it just begins to smoke, about 1 minute. Add the asparagus and carrot strips and cook, stirring occasionally, until very tender, about 3 minutes. Remove from the heat and season with salt. Working with 1 piece asparagus at a time, sprinkle with 1 teaspoon salt. Working with 2 asparagus, transfer to a large bowl and toss with 2 tablespoons olive oil. To finish the dish,. In a 12 by 14 inch jellyroll pan, arrange the asparagus in a single layer. Sprinkle with 1/4 cup of coarsely chopped parsley and set aside. Over moderately high heat, bring 2 cups water to a boil. Working with 1 asparagus at a time, cook the asparagus just until tender, 3 to 5 minutes. Transfer the asparagus to a paper towel–lined or wood surface.

Random Ingredients: cardamom seed,espresso coffee,kale,self rising flour,cream tartar,cucumber
title: Creamy Cucumber & Kale Flour Espresso Bread
ingredients: 4 1/2 cups unbleached self-rising flour or 4 1/2 cups spelt flour | 1 1/2 cups sour cream or 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour | 1/2 medium cucumber | 2 tablespoons espresso coffee, cooled or 2 tablespoons strong coffee | 1 1/2 tablespoons finely grated cardamom seeds | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: Whisk flour, sour cream and cardamom together in one medium sized bowl. Finely grate cucumber using a cheese grater and mash with a fork. Stir liquid, coffee and reserved cup of espresso/chili flakes into flour mixture. Mix together thoroughly. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured work surface and knead gently until dough forms a cohesive mass. Divide dough into 2 pieces.

Random Ingredients: chili garlic sauce,parsley,tomato,basmati rice,margarita mix,graham cracker crumb
title: Chilli Tomatoes & Rice
ingredients: 1 cup converted basmati rice | 1 can crushed tomatoes | 1/4 - 1/3 cup hot garlic sauce | 1/4 cup margarita mix, divided ( this consists of 2 pieces ) | 4 tablespoons fresh parsley, chopped ( optional ) | 2 cups crushed graham cracker crumbs | garnish with more fresh parsley, for garnish | basmati rice, for serving
instructions: Prepare rice according to package directions, adding crushed tomatoes, and hot garlic sauce. Set aside. Melt 2 tablespoons margarita mix in a small bowl with the remaining margarita mix in it. Stir in parsley and optional parsley, if using. Roll rice until it is covered. Place rice on a cookie sheet or tray. Press rice into a rectangle. Pour topping mixture evenly over the rice. Repeat for remaining rice. Garnish with more fresh basil or parsley, if desired.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper,fine salt,colby jack cheese,beef rib,tortilla,dynasty sesame oil
title: Quick Beef and Pepper Burritos
ingredients: 1 cup colby-jack cheese | 3/4 lb beef short rib | 6 -10 tortillas | 1/2 cup fried chili pepper | 2 tablespoons dynasty sesame oil | 2 teaspoons fine salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. In 9x12 dish, layer cheese onto tortillas, then place short ribs unto bottom layer. Cover with chili`slices’ and spread to all surfaces. Add 2 tbsp oil & sprinkle salt on the veggies. Continue layering, ending with cheese, and repeat process until all ingredients have been used. Bake until hot and bubbly, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,epazote leaf,golden syrup,cilantro leaf,pimiento,malibu coconut rum
title: Flamb Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 25 g alcapocino mixed peppercorns, leaves torn between your hands | 1 tablespoon chopped cilantro leaf | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 1 teaspoon malibu coconut rum | 1/2 teaspoon aquavit golden syrup | 1/2 teaspoon sliced pimiento
instructions: Whisk together sesame oil and peppercorns. Dress salad, herbs and citrus. Garnish with sesame oil, if desired.

title: Spiced Cauliflower Pot Pies
ingredients: 3/4 lb red potatoes | 3/4 cup cauliflower flakes or 3/4 cup broccoli floret | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 sheet frozen puff pastry sheet, thawed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f. Mix the potatoes, cauliflower, turmeric, and salt together in a 2 quart baking dish. Sprinkle 1 layer of pastry on top of each layer. Sprinkle with remaining dough. Cut steam vents in top of each pie. Cover baking dish with foil. Bake for 35 minutes, or until pastry is lightly browned. Cut pastry into wedges for serving. This can also be served cold.

title: Puerto Rican Dry Red Wine Rub
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups dry red wine | 1/4 cup mirin ( sweet japanese sweet wine ) | 4 tablespoons dried oregano
instructions: Combine all ingredients and store in sealed container. For an elegant touch, place the bottle in a baking dish, and heat at least 5 inches from the heat source for 45 seconds to 1 minute.

title: Cilantro Fish Rollups
ingredients: 4 small white fish fillets, skin and bone removed | 1/2 cup chopped cilantro leaf | 3 ladyfingers
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Cut a slit in each fish fillet and stuff with the cilantro. Arrange the fillets in a pastry bag and bake until lightly browned, 40 to 45 minutes. Serve on toothpicks.

title: Tori No-Fry (Chinese Stir Fried French Beans & Bean Sprouts)
ingredients: 6 cups french beans, trimmed ( about 6 ounces ) | 2 teaspoons minced garlic | 1 teaspoon fresh coarse ground black pepper | 1/2 teaspoon dried ginseng root
instructions: Wash, drain and snap beans about 2 inches in length. Remove top 2 inches of leaves. Cut sprouts in half lengthwise. Wash sprouts and set aside. Combine garlic, black pepper and ginneng roots in a small bowl. Add remaining sprouts and toss to coat. Heat a wok or deep nonstick skillet on high heat until smoking. Add sprouts. Cook, tossing constantly, until golden, 1 to 2 minutes. Add the bean mixture and cook, tossing again, until a medium size piece of sprouts forms, about 1 minute longer.

title: Mexican Pecans
ingredients: 3 cups pecan pieces | 1 medium onion, cut into 1/4 inch dice | 2 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon oregano leaves, crushed
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees f. Mix pecan pieces, onion, sherry vinegar, and oregano together in a bowl.

title: Jalapeño Red Pepper and Herbs
ingredients: 2 tablespoons red peppers ( or hot, crushed ) | 2 cups fresh thyme sprigs ( not dried! )
instructions: Cut the peppers and thyme in half, core and remove the inner seeds. Place peppers and thyme into a deep pan or cajun cooker with a tight fitting lid. Stir the pan around until all pepper pieces are coated with thyme and the peppers are coated. Bring to a boil, then cover and increase heat to medium. Cook, stirring often, for 10 minutes more, or until peppers are tender. Remove lid, and continue cooking another 10 minutes, stirring occasionally until peppers are very soft.

title: Chile Con Queso (Red Chili Cheese Spread)
ingredients: 2 ounces italian cheese ( shredded ) | 1 -2 red chili pepper ( depending on choice of heat tolerance, i prefer a milder chili such as anaheim or new mexico ) | 2 tablespoons maple syrup
instructions: Place cheese in a cheese cloth bag and cover in a few drops boiling water. When cheese starts to soften, remove the cheese from the water and place it on a plate of paper towels to drain. Once completely dry, wrap the cheese in paper towels and place it in a bowl of warm water. Using a food processor, process the chile and about 2 tablespoons of the dry cheese until smooth. Add italian cheese to the cheese bowl and stir until the mixture is smooth and creamy. Add the maple syrup and stir. Remove from the stove and store covered in the refrigerator for up to 1 week or freeze for up to 2 months. To use, remove the cheese in a chile press.

Random Ingredients: cilantro leaf,beef stew meat,english cucumber,onion powder,marshmallow,genoa salami,apple cider
title: Italian Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat, cut in 1-1/2-inch cubes | 1/2 medium onion, cut in half and sliced thin | 1 container miniature marshmallows | 1 can french haricot vert ( small english seedless cucumbers ) | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1/2 teaspoon italian salami | 1/2 cup apple cider
instructions: Place beef, onion, marshmallows, beans and spices in 5 1/2 quart slow cooker dish. Cover and cook on low 6 to 7 hours or until meat and beans are tender. Stir in cilatro if desire. Serve over pasta or rice. Sprinkle with grated parmesan cheese. Note, may also use small onions, peeled and thinly sliced. Also, i like to use an extra large container of kielbasa instead of salami.

Random Ingredients: vinegar,orange zest,burrito flour tortilla,cinnamon,pine nut,yellow bell pepper
title: Moroccan Sweet Pepper and Pine Nut Pies
ingredients: 24 burrito-size flour tortillas | 1 yellow bell pepper, chopped | 1/2 cup pine nuts | 1 orange, zest of, grated and juiced | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 3 tablespoons ground cinnamon
instructions: First, make sweet pepper pine nut filling. Soak the pine nuts in a bowl of cold water for 10 - 15 minutes. Drain, and chop finely. Preheat oven to 350°. Spray a large, oven safe skillet with olive oil cooking spray, and sauté the yellow pepper until the color becomes a lighter orange, about 8 minutes. Remove pepper from the pan with a slotted spoon and set aside. Drain off any extra oil from the pan. Return the pan to the heat, and add the pine nuts. Sauté until the pine nuts smell aromatic, about 10 seconds. Stir in the orange zest and grated orange to the pan. Mix in the vinegar and cinnamon, stirring well and continuously for 4 minutes. Spread the sweet pepper pine nut filling evenly on the warm tortillas. Roll the tortillas up, and place on an ungreased baking sheet about 4 - 5 inches apart, seam side down. Place the filled tortillas on the bottom rack of the oven, and bake for about 20 minutes. Remove from the oven, and let cool slightly before removing from the baking sheet to a serving plate. Serve warm or at room temperature. Variation, omit cinnamon if using a sweet green pepper and omit the orange zest. Instead, you can add about 3/4 cup of orange juice to the filling and stir in a little more vinegar and chopped pine nuts before serving.

Random Ingredients: white bread flour,peach,walnut,garam masala,mango chutney,ginger garlic paste,mustard
title: Stuffed Fruits
ingredients: 3 tablespoons mango chutney | 500 g white bread flour | 20 g ginger-garlic paste or 20 ml ginger paste | 250 g walnuts ( optional ) | 1 kg ripe peach | 50 ml mustard ( to taste ) | 2 g garam masala
instructions: To make the dough, combine all the ingredients in a bowl. Rub everything together well with your fingertips. Roll out the dough very little on a floured surface. Cut out the fritters with a cutter. Bake in the oven at 120 c/400 f/gas 4 for about 30 minutes, or until golden brown. Leave to dry out on a rack or tea towel. Serve with fruits.

Random Ingredients: buttermilk,lime wedge,dark sesame oil,brown sugar,peanut butter,cherry tomato,soy sauce,peach
title: Chilled Peach with Sweet Soy Vinaigrette
ingredients: 3 fresh peaches - pitted, peeled, and cut into thin wedges | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1 tablespoon low sodium soy sauce | 1 tablespoon smooth peanut butter | 1 tablespoon light brown sugar | 1/2 lime, juice of | 8 cherry tomatoes | lime wedge
instructions: Whisk together the sugar, soy sauce, peanut butter, lime juice, and sesame oil. Toss with the fruit, and chill before serving.

title: Red and Green Poached Ancho Empanadas
ingredients: 6 -8 fresh ancho chilies, slit open and slit lengthwise | 1 teaspoon ground mixed herbs, such as oregano, marjoram, basil, fennel, fajita mix | chili powder, to taste | 24 sheets puff pastry, thawed if frozen
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees fahrenheit. Cut each pasilla on the diagonal into 16 equal pieces. Place 1 piece on a greased baking sheet and brush both sides with chili powder. Arrange 1 or 2 tablespoons of filling on each piece and sprinkle with cilantro, oregano and basil. Bake 10 - 15 minutes or until cheese is bubbly.

Random Ingredients: walnut,dark soy sauce,hot sauce,roast beef,margarine,active yeast,juniper berry,yeast
title: Fabulously Easy French Bread
ingredients: 1 cup warm margarine | 1/2 cup dark soy sauce | 1/4 cup packed dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon dried yeast | 1 tablespoon crushed juniper berries | 1 package active dry yeast | 3 hoagie rolls | 1 lb lean roast beef, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 1 tablespoon finely shredded walnuts or 1 tablespoon pecans
instructions: Place warm margarine in a small bowl. Stir in dark soy, dark soy, yeast, and crushed juniper berries. Pour into 3 quart bowl, and allow yeast to begin foamy with body temperature at 105f for five minutes pour into a warm, very large bowl, and add 90f more air into bowl. Add 1/2 lb. Shredded roast beef slices, and mix well. Turn out dough onto floured hands, and knead for about ten minutes, being sure not to over work the dough. Place the bowl in a large, well greased bowl. With a dough hook, punch dough with flat scraper to remove air bubbles and knead into a dough that doesn't stick to your hands. Set dough aside to stand for 40 minutes and up to overnight. Preheat the oven to 300°f. Remove the dough from the bowl onto a well floured surface. Make diagonal cuts in the dough until it's about 1/4 inch in diameter. Starting at the wide end of the dough, pull the dough down into the bowl of the bowl, stretching all the way to the opposite side and corners. Do this until you have worked out the dough into a square 1/4 inch thick, long rectangle. Spread the meat mixture evenly on the dough, leaving about 1 inch uncovered at the narrow end of the dough. With scissors or scissors, snip the edges of the dough up into a 1 inch wide, straight diagonal lattice top. Do not twist up the ends of the dough, or they will break. Wrap the dough in the lattice top, and place on a baking tray lined with parchment paper. Cover the bread and allow to rise until doubled, about 1 hour in the middle of the oven. When the dough doubles, you can pinch the edges closed and poke with a toothpick to dimple the top. Allow bread to bake until it just turns golden on top, about 40 minutes. While this is happening, melt 2 tablespoons melted butter in a skillet, and saute the nuts about 2 minutes, until they are golden. Remove bread from oven and allow to cool slightly. Cut into wedges while still warm, and place on a serving plate with the melted butter and toasted nuts to show off the deliciousness of the nut bread.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,guinness stout,peanut butter,extra beef,ladyfinger
title: Guinness Beef and Rice Baked on Lazy Longboats
ingredients: 8 large ladyfingers | 1 1/2 lbs extra lean ground beef | 3/4 cup unsalted butter | 1/4 cup guinness stout | 1/4 cup plain smooth peanut butter | 1 1/2 cups long-grain white rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Grease 24 longboats. Split ladyfingers on a large cutting board and place in baking dish. Using your fingers or a sharp knife, make long, narrow slices about 1/2 inch wide. Repeat until you have 6 longboats. Using the flat end of a knife, make 4 long cuts across the top of the ladyfingers, being careful not to cut more than 1/4 inch deep. Place on top of a sheet of reynolds wrap heavy duty foil, and bake at 300 degrees for 30 - 40 minutes, until crispy and golden. While ladyfingers are baking, brown ground beef in a skillet over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until thoroughly cooked. Drain meat slices, but leave in skillet. Place 5 sheets of reynolds wrap in with meat. Boil juices in hot skillet over medium heat until slightly reduced. When ladyfingers are cooled, arrange in foil lined baking dish around meat. Place 2 sheets of reynolds wrap on top of meat and re foil, leaving about ½ inch at the top of the dish. Bake 25 minutes. In saucepan over medium heat, add reserved juice. Bring to boil and stir in butter. In a small bowl, combine guinness and peanut butter. Remove from heat and stir with a wire strainer. Pour half of sauce over ladyfingers and meat. Pour remainder over meat and vegetables. Sprinkle rice on top. Return to oven and bake for 20 minutes, until rice is absorbed and top is golden.

title: Spanish Bean and Veggie Salad
ingredients: 1 liter cannellini beans | 2 cups green beans, cut into 1cm pieces | 1/4 cup mild green chili, chopped | 1/4 cup sweet dried pimento, chopped | 1/2 cup sweet tea, brewed | 1/8 teaspoon salt | 1/8 cup finely minced chives | 1 teaspoon dried minced chives
instructions: Cook beans in boiling water for 3 minutes or until just tender, drain. Drain well. Combine beans, green beans, chilies, pimento, tea, salt, chives and chives in a bowl. Refrigerate.

Random Ingredients: rice,pineapple juice,steak,shrimp,asafoetida powder,sage,fennel seed,black eyed pea
title: Lobia Yebab (Spicy African Shrimp Stew)
ingredients: 1 lb raw shrimp, shelled | 16 ounces steak | 1 lb raw pineapples with juice | 1 lb dried black-eyed peas ( can also substitute dried chickpeas ) | 1 tablespoon asafoetida powder | 1 teaspoon fennel seed ( if you can find them ) | 1 teaspoon dried sage | 1 cup cooked rice
instructions: Cut meat, add spices and juice and cook till soft and done. Add peas and cook 1 hour.

title: Lemongrass Fettuccine
ingredients: 250 g fettuccine | 3 lemongrass, pieces | 300 g white truffle oil ( can be found at asian market ) | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder ( to taste )
instructions: Bring a pot of water to boil. Add fettuccine and cook for about 15 minutes. While the fettuccine cooks, mix together the lemongrass, oil and garlic powder. When the fettuccine is done, drain the water and add to the olive oil/lemon mixture. Toss thoroughly until it boils. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: kahlua,chicken bouillon cube,salt pork,black peppercorn,dark soy sauce,plain flour
title: Baked Chocolate Crusted Pork Roast
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 teaspoon chopped seeded black peppercorns | 2 chicken bouillon cubes, melted | 3 ounces sautéed salt pork, chopped into small pieces | 3 ounces plain flour | 1 teaspoon coarse salt
instructions: Preheat your oven to 220 c. Lightly rub the melted dark soy sauce onto the salt pork. Add the crushed blue oxo in an even layer, then place the salt pork on a baking tray, skin side down. Poke holes into the salt pork with a toothpick or skewer. In a large mixing bowl or roasting, combine the soy sauce, black peppercorns and the stock cubes. Place the salt pork in the bowl, then massage the mixture so that all surfaces are coated. Cover and return to the oven for 25 minutes, then reduce the temperature to 120c. Leave to rest for a further 40 minutes. Remove the salt pork from the oven, scatter over the flour and salt, then remove from the baking tray. Carefully transfer the breaded pork on to a baking sheet. Using a palette knife, cut a few slashes in the top of the pork, being careful not to cut all the way through. Bake, uncovered, at 120 c for 15 minutes, then carefully turn the temperature down to 120 c to brown the top crust. Serve.

title: Baked Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 can tomato sauce | 1/4 teaspoon dry mustard seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Combine tomato sauce and mustard seed in a 9x13 inch baking dish that has been coated with cooking spray. Bake in the preheated oven until tomatoes are bubbling, about 20 minutes. Transfer to a platter. Serve hot.

title: Nam Sod - Cold Bean Snack!
ingredients: 16 ounces dried beans ( such as pinto ) | 1 1/2 ounces low-fat sourdough bread, slices | 1 1/2 ounces ladyfingers ( preferably homemade, cut in half or use sourdough pita ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons chat masala | vegetable oil ( for frying )
instructions: Place the dried beans in a large bowl. Add enough cold water to cover them by approximately 1 inch, so that they float to the surface. Soak the beans for 2 - 4 hours or overnight in the refrigerator. Drain, and place them in a large bowl. Drain the water from cooking the beans through a cheese cloth extracting as much moisture as possible from the beans. Return the beans to the bowl, and mix with the sourdough bread slices. To cook, heat up enough oil in a large pan to approximately 1 - ½ inches, and fry the bread in batches until golden on both sides, and crisp. Drain on paper towels as soon as they are crisp. Serve the nam Sod warm as soon as possible.

title: French Beans and Chocolate Wraps
ingredients: 8 ounces whole wheat tortillas | 1 cup french beans, topped and tailed | 1 tablespoon cracked semisweet chocolate | 1 tablespoon pearl barley | 1 small lemon, zest of | coarse cracked ice
instructions: Place all of the tortillas in a bowl and spoon in the beans, chopped chocolate and barley. Toss lightly until everything is covered with everything and sprinkle with the zest of the lemon. Roll up the wrap and cut into 4 equal portions and serve.

title: Easy Faux Maple Syrup
ingredients: 3 cups pure maple syrup | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cardamom powder
instructions: Heat syrup and cardamom powder in a medium saucepan over low heat until it almost begins to bubble. Remove from heat. Gradually stir in additional syrup, mixing well. Remove from heat and let cool to room temperature. You can use in beverages, french breads, or muffins, or any sweeten type you fancy. Enjoy.

title: Creole Scallops
ingredients: 8 scallops, cleaned and split lengthwise | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 2 tablespoons sweet pickle relish | 1/4 cup dark rum
instructions: Brush each scallop with dijon mustard. Heat the rum over medium heat in a skillet. Add the scallops and cover. Simmer 5 minutes. Turn scallops and cover. Repeat process with remaining scallops. Serve hot.

title: Mexican Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups long grain rice ( or mexican style rice-can use mexican style ) | vegetable stock ( as needed ) | 2 -3 tablespoons fresh cilantro leaves ( or green leaf, not the dried leaves )
instructions: Cook rice according to directions on the package. While the rice is cooking, combine vegetable stock and cilantro in a saucepan. Bring to boil, then reduce heat to low and let simmer for 5 - 10 minutes. Meanwhile, fry the rice using as directed on the package. If the rice is not completely cooked, you may need to use more stock to cook the rice until it is cooked. Add salt and pepper to taste. Serve immediately.

title: Italian Sausage and Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 tablespoon mixed herb ( dried herbs, such as oregano or basil ) | 1 medium tomatoes | 1 1 lb italian sausage | ritz cracker | vegetable oil
instructions: Preheat broiler. Slice tomato in half. Scoop out seeds, leaving about 1/4 inch of each tomato in the bottom shell. Cut each half in half again. In a small skillet, toast the ritz crackers, approximately 10 seconds or until fragrant. Place crackers in a medium bowl and coat with oil. Place tomato halves, side by side, on a sheet of wax paper. Broil sausage until thoroughly crumbly and no longer pink, 3 - 4 minutes. Slice sausage into 1/4 inch slices and arrange on tomato halves.

title: Coleslaw
ingredients: 6 cups coleslaw mix ( about 8 medium ) | 1 cup arborio rice or 1 cup long-grain white rice | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon saffron thread ( to taste ) | 1/4 cup fresh chives, chopped | 1 tablespoon quick- and easy bread flour ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients except chives in a 3 1/2 to 6 quart slow cooker. Cover and cook on low 8 - 10 hours, or on high 3 and 1/2 to 4 1/2 hours. Stir the rice gently once during 3/4 hour. Remove cover and sprinkle with chives. Cover and cook 30 to 35 minutes, or until rice is soft and grains are tender.

title: Texas Steak Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 pound sirloin, trimmed and cut into thin strips | 1 can condensed tomato and green chile peppers, drained | mirin : | 1 tablespoon mirin | 5 slices sandwich bread, toasted
instructions: Stir tomato and green chile peppers, mirin, and sliced sirloin together in a large serving bowl. Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Add sirloin.

title: Tomato and Pepper Fritters
ingredients: 3 medium tomatoes with juice | 1 small bell pepper | 1 tablespoon cornflour
instructions: Cut up red tomato and bell pepper. Sprinkle with corn flour. Heat on a frying pan or in a wok until hot. Serve.

Random Ingredients: sugar,brown sugar twin,salad oil,corn oil,ice cube,mint
title: Spicy Salad Dressing!
ingredients: 2 tablespoons of fresh mint, chopped | 1 tablespoon light brown sugar twin light sugar | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 1/4 cup light salad oil | 1/2 cup ice cube, crushed | 2 tablespoons coarsely chopped of fresh mint, garnish ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a blender or food processor and process to thicken slightly. Add mint, garnish and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: potato starch,italian seasoning,deli roast beef,peanut butter,nonfat milk,golden raisin,tortilla chip,nutmeg
title: Savory Easy Roast Beef
ingredients: 6 ounces deli roast beef | 1/2 cup nonfat milk | 1/2 cup potato starch or 1/2 cup rice flour, mixed with | 1 tablespoon potato starch | 1/8 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning | 1/3 cup peanut butter ( optional ) | 8 ounces tortilla chips
instructions: Slice the roast into thin strips about 1/2 inch wide. Arrange the sliced beef strips in a single layer in a 9x13 glass baking dish. In a small bowl, whisk together the milk, flour, potato starch, nutmeg and 1/2 cup raisins until well blended. Pour over the beef. Cover and refrigerate for 24 hours. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Remove beef from refrigerator, uncover and bake for 30 - 30 minutes, until cooked. Serve with your favorite tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk,cream tartar,celery seed,celery rib,plain flour,cucumber
title: Celery Seed Coconut Maccheron
ingredients: 250 ml coconut milk | 2 cups plain flour | 1 teaspoon celery seed | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/2 cup finely chopped celery rib | 1/2 cup finely chopped peeled cucumber
instructions: Preheat the grill to high. Line a baking tray with aluminium foil. Place the coconut milk and celery seeds in a large saucepan. Bring to a boil over moderate high heat, remove from the heat and set aside. Sift the flour, baking powder and cream of tartar into a medium bowl, make a well in the centre and mix in the celery seeds, shredded coconut and chopped celery. Mix in the cucumber. Spoon the mixture into the prepared tray and brush the surface with melted butter. Bake for about 45 minutes.

title: Cardamom Stacks With Straw Mushrooms and Raisins - Norway
ingredients: 1 container cool whip | 8 cardamom pods, cracked | 200 g sultanas or 200 g raisins | 1/4 - 1/2 cup crystallised ginger, finely diced
instructions: Line the bottoms of 6 cake dishes with parchment paper, then fill 'with cool whip' or'miniature cake tin with the cooled sponge cake mixture. Top the sponge cakes with 2 tablespoons of raisins and 1/4 cup of sultanas or a small piece of crystallised ginger. Sprinkle a little cardamom powder on top. Bake in the top half of a slow oven for 10 - 15 minutes. Serve topped with your favourite cream.

title: Caramelized Apples
ingredients: 3 medium ripe tart apples, peeled, cored and quartered | 10 -12 fresh thyme sprigs | 2 tablespoons dark rum | 1 jar pimientos, minced | 6 raisins | allspice berry, coarsely crushed
instructions: Lightly coat a large saucepan with light film, add the apples, thyme, rum, pimentos, raisins and allspice berry. Cover and cook over medium low heat for 20 minutes or until the apples have softened. Remove lid, increase heat to moderate and cook, uncovered, until reduced by half. Cook until syrup has reduced slightly. Stir and serve warm or warm.

title: Potted Lemon Ice Cream (Chilled)
ingredients: 1 pint double cream | 1 lemon, zest of
instructions: Whip together the double cream, lemon zest and lemon juice in a bowl. Scoop a rounded teaspoonful of the cream mixture into a large ice cream scoop and top with lemon halves.

title: Basic Shortbread Cookies
ingredients: 1 cup all-purpose flour | 3 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1 cup coarsely chopped flat leaf parsley
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place 1 cup flour in a large bowl. Mix in parsley. Using hands or a rolling pin, mix in remaining flour until dough is crumbly and has the texture of rice cereal. Add more flour or water, if necessary. Form dough into balls and roll into balls with a rolling pin. Bake in the preheated oven for 12 to 15 minutes or until golden. Cool in the pan 15 minutes. Remove. Remove all cookies from pan. Turn over cookies and finish cooling on cooling rack.

title: Slow Cooker Texas Okra Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 pound pork loin, cut into thin strips | 1 jar sweet chunky salsa | 1 pound sauerkraut, drained and chopped | 1 1/2 cups dry spaghetti | 4 cups mixed salad greens | 1/4 cup semolina | 2 crusty french bread
instructions: Preheat slow cooker and spread 2 tablespoons salsa on the bottom of the slow cooker. Mix pork, salsa, sauerkraut, and spaghetti in a bowl, and place half into the slow cooker. Cover, set slow cooker to low, and cook 6 hours, or until meat is very tender. Combine greens and semolina in a food processor, and pulse until mixture resembles fine crumbs. Place cut meat in a separate bowl, and cover with water. Bring water to a simmer in a saucepan while pasta cooks. Remove meat from liquid, and cut into 1 inch cubes. When pasta is nearly done, place in a separate saucepan, and cook until tender. Mix meat, and 1/4 cup of salsa into meat, and stir well. Transfer to a crock, and mix in reserved 1/4 cup of salsa.

Random Ingredients: poblano chile,onion,orange juice,flat leaf parsley,chunky salsa,mexican oregano,ice cube
title: Poblano and Sweet Onion Dip (Crockpot)
ingredients: 4 large poblano chiles, stemmed | 4 medium sweet onions, sliced | 1/3 cup orange juice | 3/4 cup chunky salsa ( mild or hot, your choice, i use pace ) | 2 cups crushed ice cubes ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon mexican oregano, dried ( or more to taste ) | 2 tablespoons flat leaf parsley, chopped
instructions: Roast the chilies with their skins directly over a gas flame or in a grill, until charred all over, 4 to 6 minutes. Place in a food processor and pulse until coarsely minced. Transfer to a bowl. Slice the onions very thinly and stir into the chilies. In a medium saucepan, combine the orange juice, salsa, 1/4 cup water, oregano, and 1 tablespoon of fresh parsley. Stir over medium low heat until hot but not boiling. Pour the hot chili sauce over the sliced chiles and onions, cover, and refrigerate the dip for at least 1 hour. Remove the onions, discarding the skins, and place in a bowl. Remove the remaining saucepan from the heat just before serving. Top with the remaining 1 tablespoon of fresh parsley. Serve with toasted flour tortillas or corn chips.

Random Ingredients: beef sirloin steak,adobo sauce,sherry wine,olive,broccoli,cilantro,lettuce leaf
title: Beef and Broccoli Sandwich
ingredients: 2 lbs beef sirloin steaks or 2 lbs flank steaks, cut 1/4-inch thick | 10 ounces broccoli | 1 can sliced ripe olives | 2 tablespoons chopped cilantro | 2 tablespoons sherry wine | 1 jar fried olives | 6 large lettuce leaves
instructions: Heat grill to high. If serving this dish with chips, cut beef steak into strips and wrap in foil. Put to warm and broil quickly. Meanwhile, slice broccoli into small florets. Drain any juice from olives. Heat oil to 375 degrees in electric skillet or in toaster oven. Meanwhile, slice olives lengthwise into thin wedges. Toss beef, broccoli, and olives with all remaining ingredients. Divide among lettuce leaves. Serve with chips.

Random Ingredients: ketjap manis,baking soda,italian herb,mint leaf,mayonnaise,grainy mustard,cardamom pod,ham hock
title: Indian Ham Hock Wraps
ingredients: 1 bone-in ham hock | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped fresh mint leaves | 1/4 cup mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon ketchup ( heinz ) | 1 teaspoon grainy mustard | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1/2 teaspoon mixed italian herbs ( such as dill, parsley, and mint ) | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 1/2 teaspoon dried mint leaves, for garnish
instructions: Place the ham hocks and mint in a large skillet. Pour in enough water to cover the ham. Bring the water to a boil, then reduce heat to medium low.

title: English Chives
ingredients: 4 -6 ounces fresh chives, washed ( the big bunch ) | 2 -3 tablespoons snipped chives, plus ( to garnish ) | 2 -3 tablespoons sherry
instructions: Slice chives open lengthwise, and place on a serving platter. Stir snipped chives into a little bit of sherry, and pour over top. Sprinkle chives over.

title: Low-Fat Spaghetti Bolognaise Sauce
ingredients: lowfat quick-cooking spray | 1/2 cup low-fat soymilk | 1/2 cup spaghetti sauce, commercial style ( or spaghetti base ) | 2 teaspoons herbs, preferably cilantro or 2 teaspoons thyme | 1/2 cup lowfat beans, chopped, any type | fresh coriander, chopped or chopped ( optional )
instructions: Spray a 4 cup capacity oven proof dish with cooking oil spray. Put in the soy milk and stir until combined. Put in the spaghetti sauce and stir to 'coat' with the sauce. Add beans and herbs, if using, and mix well to combine. Pour into the prepared dish and bake for 45 - 60 minutes or until golden brown. Serve hot, warm or room temperature.

title: Homemade Pasta Cookies
ingredients: 250 g icing sugar | 4 teaspoons black pepper | 1 teaspoon black pepper
instructions: Put the icing sugar into a small bowl. Put the pepper into a bowl then add the icing sugar. Mix the mixture so that the pepper is distributed throughout the icing sugar. Then add the black pepper. Keep the icing powder to about 2 tsp size pieces and then mix them together. Take a small amount of the icing powder to brush onto your work surface. Dont use too much it will mix with your hands. Take the amount you put onto your work surface. If you don't get it spread out with your fingers. With your hands or a spoon mix all the ingridients until you have a paste. Put the rest in a plastic bag with your plastic back side to go. Make a small cup with your favourite paste. Pour the paste into the cup then cover the bowl with a lid or cling wrap. Keep the paste in the fridge until ready to use. If you got it the right thickness, take it out shortly before eating. For example, after it has been stored indefinitely you can then place in the fridge for about 40 days. After that take it out, place in clean airtight container and it will keep for 3 - 4 months.

Random Ingredients: collard green,jalapeno,yukon gold potato,sesame seed,lipton onion soup mix,kielbasa,pie shell
title: Collard Greens and Potatoes
ingredients: 1 pie shell | 2 bunches collard greens, rinsed, trimmed and chopped | 2 1/2 cups yukon gold potatoes, shredded on large chunks | 2 kielbasa, halved and cut in half lengthwise | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 2 packages lipton onion soup mix | 2 quarts dill pickle-flavored onion soup mix
instructions: Bake shell for 15 to 20 minutes at 400 degrees. Combine greens, potatoes, kielbasa, sesame seeds, and soup mix in a large saucepan. Bring the mixture to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Cool. Spoon soup mixture over the cheese mixture and cool at room temperature. Place pie crust in center of a 9x13 inch serving dish, top with potato filled pie crust. Sprinkle top with dill pickle soup mix. Bake at 400 degrees 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Baked Cucumbers
ingredients: 1 quart pickling cucumber | 1 cup quick-cooking oil | 1 tablespoon salt
instructions: Cut cucumbers lengthwise into 6 wedges. Squeeze out excess juice. Place in a saucepan with water. Add salt. Bring to a boil. Cook for 5 minutes. Drain. Toss cucumbers with oil and salt to coat. Serve warm.

title: Confetti Party Sushi
ingredients: 1/2 lb cooked pearl barley | 1/8 cup pickled sliced pepperoni, cut into 1 & quot, pieces ( hotness depends on your taste ) ( optional ) | 1/2 cup picante sauce | 1/2 cup radish, thinly sliced | 1 orange, cut into wedges | 1 nori ( seaweed ) ( optional ) | pepperoni, strips ( optional )
instructions: Drain the rice and barley in a sieve and let it dry. Mix the rest of the ingredients in a bowl and chill. If you will be using pepperoni strips, cut them into thin strips or strips as desired. Divide the rice and barley into 4 bowls, and divide the pepperoni between the 4 bowls. Drizzle with the salsa, and top with the pepperoni strips.

title: Osh-Tuna Tacos
ingredients: 20 -26 quick-cooking oil | 500 -500 g tuna, flaked | 250 g taco shells
instructions: Heat a pan, with about 3 tbsp of cooking oil, over medium low heat. Add the methi, not too much because this will be runny later. Add salt and pepper to taste, then add the tuna. Stir, then turn to medium until the tuna has changed colour for about 10 minutes. Serve on the taco shells. Sprinkle more of the methi with olive oil if desired, and some of any other favorite toppings on top.

title: Welsh Garlic Cheese Toasts #RSC
ingredients: 2 ounces wondra flour | 1 slice swiss cheese | 1/4 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/2 cup oil
instructions: Put the flour on a board and work in the parmigiano reggiano into it, trying not to get it all the way knead the cheese over the bowl. Roll the dough into a ball, wrap it in plastic wrap and refrigerate until you are ready to put the cheese on it. Heat the oil in a skillet to 300 - 350 degrees f. Take the dough out of the refrigerator and gently roll it out to about 1/8th inch thick. Using your fingertips, make indentations about 1 1/2 teaspoons deep with the cheese, and push the indentations with your fingers into the toasted side of the dough. Transfer to a plate to cool slightly. Serve in slices buttered with parsley and black pepper. Makes about 8 servings. Enjoy.

title: Warm Asparagus
ingredients: 2 bunches fresh asparagus, trimmed | 1 tablespoon jwain, crushed | 1/3 cup cornstarch
instructions: Place asparagus in a steamer basket over 1 inch of boiling water. Cover and cook until tender, 10 to 15 minutes. Meanwhile, stir together the crushed jwain and cornstarch in a saucepan. Remove asparagus and drain. Remove the cooked stalks from the asparagus and plunge into the cornstarch. Sauté asparagus for a few minutes. Garnish with asparagus tips.

title: Tastiest Vietnamese Stocker
ingredients: 1/2 gallon white wine | 2 teaspoons coconut extract | 2 teaspoons dried oregano leaves
instructions: In a large freezer bag, combine the wine, coconut extract, and oregano leaves. Close the bag, and freeze overnight. Turn bag several times during thinnest overnight, placing plastic wrap directly on top. The next day, remove the bag and refrigerate over night. Discard the aromatics before serving. Note, this stock can be frozen for up to three months.

title: Corn Chips With Tamarind Juice
ingredients: 2 lbs russet potatoes, peeled and cut in half | 1 quart tamarind juice | 2 ears fresh corn, in husk cut in half | 1/2 cup rice wine ( or to taste )
instructions: Scrub the potatoes, if necessary, and place them in a large pot. Place the potatoes, tamarind juice and half the corn in another pot, then pour over enough water to cover. Stir, place the lid on, and simmer until the potatoes are tender but not falling apart, about 30 minutes. Remove the corn, corn, and tamarind from the pot and discard any liquid. Transfer to a medium sized bowl and add the remaining corn. Dressing, whisk together the rice wine and tamarind juice in a small bowl and mix thoroughly. Pour the dressing over the potatoes and toss until coated. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: purple onion,black mustard seed,beef brisket,bean sprout,egg noodle,taco seasoning mix,edible flower
title: Noodle Mexi Style Beef Brisket
ingredients: 1 beef brisket, trimmed | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning mix | 1/2 cup sliced purple onion | 1 bag egg noodle ( recommended buddha's organic ) | bean sprouts | black mustard seeds | fresh edible flower ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees f. Place brisket in roasting pan.

title: Sour Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1 jar golden raisins, drained and chopped | 1 tablespoon seasoning, blend | 1/3 cup chilled whipped topping
instructions: Place raisins on a cookie sheet and cover with foil. Sprinkle raisins with the seasoning blend. Microwave on high for 1 minutes. Stir, then microwave for 2 minutes more. Sprinkle the whipped topping on top. Cool and store in refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: italian seasoning,bamboo shoot,asparagus,coriander powder,pizza sauce,plain yogurt
title: Chilled Pizza With Asparagus, Bacon and Black Sausage
ingredients: 2 cans sliced bamboo shoots, drained, juice reserved | 8 slices lean bacon, chopped | 1 tablespoon ground coriander powder | 2 tablespoons italian seasoning | 8 ounces plain fat-free yogurt | 1/2 cup prepared pizza sauce
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the juice from the canned vegetables, the chopped bamboo shoots and seasoning. Mix thoroughly. In a small dish, combine the yogurt and the chili pepper flakes from the jar and pour over the yogurt. Toss well to coat. Let sit for 20 minutes. To serve, place a small piece of pizza on a plate with about 1 teaspoon of the hot liquid mixture on each side. Spoon the yogurt on top and serve.

title: Mexican Corn Salad With Lime
ingredients: 1 bag frozen corn kernels, thawed | 5 tablespoons mascarpone cheese | lime wedge, for garnishes ( optional )
instructions: Cook corn according to package directions, rinse under cool water, drain and place in large bowl. Add mascarpone and toss to combine. Serve immediately.

title: Persian Sea Bass With Onions, Lemon and Pistachios
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh squid | 1/4 cup pistachios, shelled and coarsely chopped | 1 sprig mint sprig | 1 large spanish onion, chopped | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1/2 cup pistachios, coarsely chopped
instructions: Clean the squid, removing any tubes and tentacles, rinse and chop into long thin tubes. Discard the tough insides. Rinse the squid and pat dry with paper towel. Halve lengthwise and scrape out the ink sac. Cut the tentacles into pieces approximately the same size as the squid pieces, and set aside. Combine the pistachios and mint leaves in a small skillet over medium high heat, stirring, and cook, stirring constantly, until golden brown, about 5 minutes. Spread the pistachios over the base of a baking dish, and sprinkle on the onions. Season the onion mixture with salt and pepper, and place in the center of the oven. Bake, uncovered, on middle rack of the oven for about 15 minutes, then remove from the oven and place in the pan. Bake until the bread is crisp, about 5 minutes more. Remove from the oven and place on a plate, leaving the bread slices in their centers. Cover and keep warm in a low oven until ready to serve. To serve, cut each squid tube into 3 to 4 pieces, about 1/2 inch thick, and arrange each piece around the pistachios. Serve on a small serving platter with the nuts and pistachios alongside.

Random Ingredients: half cream,lemon juice zest,chinese rice wine,candy sprinkle,vanilla custard powder,sirloin,egg yolk,chocolate
title: Oven Brisket of Beef Au Chocolat
ingredients: 2 sirloin, cut into cubes | 2 egg yolks | 2 tablespoons lemon juice, and zest of | 3 cups half-and-half cream | 1/8 cup chinese rice wine | 1 teaspoon vanilla custard powder | 1/4 cup chocolate, of your choice melted | candy sprinkles ( optional )
instructions: Place cubes in ovenproof baking dish. In mixing bowl, place egg yolks, lemon juice, and zest. Whisk until well blended. Pour over sirloin and bake in 400 degree oven for 45mins or until meat has turned firm and cooked. Remove sirloin from oven and transfer to serving dish. Whisk cream into custard powder until dissolved. Spoon hot beef into cream mixture and pour over beef. Garnish with melted chocolate and sprinkle with sprinkles if desired.

Random Ingredients: cumin powder,lasagna noodle,pimento olive,kidney bean,italian plum tomato
title: Italian Cannelloni Lasagna
ingredients: 1 -2 lb italian plum tomato ( or any other tomato ) | 1 can kidney beans, rinsed and drained ( or white beans ) | 2 cans of sliced pimento stuffed olives | 2 1/2 cups dry lasagna noodles, preferably eggroll-type | 2 teaspoons cumin powder
instructions: Mix all ingredients together very well. Spread thin pieces of plastic wrap about 3/4 cup in the bottom of the slow cooker. Top with a layer of lasagna noodles. Fill them with the tomato mixture. Cover with noodles, then top with more lasagna and tomato mixture. Cover and bake on low for at least 6 hours.

Random Ingredients: egg white,flat leaf parsley,lemon peel,cream chicken soup,grain rice,shiitake mushroom,oat
title: Mushroom Oatmeal
ingredients: 1 package sliced shiitake mushrooms | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 cup quick rolled oats | 2 tablespoons fresh flat-leaf parsley | 1 egg white | 4 teaspoons shredded lemon peel | 1 cup cooked long-grain rice
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook mushrooms in boiling water until tender, 3 to 5 minutes. Drain. Cut into 1/2 inch pieces and place in a mixing bowl. Stir in cream of chicken soup. Stir in oats, parsley, egg white, lemon peel, and rice. Cover, and refrigerate until chilled, at least 4 hours. Serve chilled or at room temperature.

title: Vietnamese Caramelized Celery Ribs
ingredients: 4 celery ribs, cut crosswise into 2-inch pieces | 2 tablespoons sriracha hot sauce | 1/4 cup vegetable oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f scatter celery in a roasting pan. Drizzle with sriracha and toss to coat.

Random Ingredients: aubergine,pina colada nonalcoholic drink mix,cream cheese,baking soda,poppy seed,orange,rye bread
title: Aubergine-Poppy Seed and Aubergine Crumble
ingredients: 2 large aubergines, halved lengthwise and sliced 1/8-inch thick ( about 12 ounces, can use persian as well ) | 1/3 cup cream cheese, softened ( can use reduced fat ) | 1/3 cup light sour cream or 1/3 cup nonalcoholic drink mix | 1/4 cup pina colada nonalcoholic drink mix | 1 1/2 teaspoons grated orange rind | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 2 slices rye bread, thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Line two 1 1/2 quart baking dishes with plastic wrap. Arrange half of the aubergines on bottom of each dish, then top with 1/3 of the cream cheese, sour cream, colada mix, orange rind and baking soda. Top with half of the bread. Repeat layers, ending with crumbs and dot with melted butter. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, or until browned and bubbly. Let stand 10 minutes before slicing.

title: OAMC Peach Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 3 -4 firm peach slices | 15 -20 pepperoncini peppers | 10 -12 pickled gingerroot ( depending on size ) | 10 -12 mild dates | 10 -12 mild enchilada sauce ( see note about recipe ) | fresh ginger, chopped
instructions: Note, use a good mild enchilada sauce that is as close in flavour to mild enchilada sauce for your needs. Peel the peaches. I prefer a more interesting rip and flavourful peach. Using a mandolin or a vegetable peeler cut away any tough peaches, being careful not to peel them. Cut each peach in half and remove the pit. Place the cut out peaches into the bottom of a mixing bowl add the remaining ingredients. Stir until well incorporated. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Serve over enchilada, garnished with fresh ginger. Note, this serves best with steaming but you can also add 1 cup of cooked rice or spaghetti to the sauce, and just cook over medium heat until tender and a slight bite is left.

title: Penne a la Alighoku
ingredients: 12 ounces penne, broken into thirds | 2 1/2 ounces stout beer | 3/4 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: In a large pot of salted boiling water, cook the pasta until al dente. Drain and return to the pot. Add the beer, mix well and bring to a boil. Add the garam masala. Toss to combine, and serve.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach leaf,cocoa powder,habanero pepper,kidney bean,ancho chile powder,baking powder,berry,crisco
title: Michealacho Beans
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans | 1 can black-eyed peas, drained | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1/2 teaspoon ancho chile powder | 1 cup frozen mixed berries, thawed | 1 habanero pepper, diced | 1/2 cup crisp cajun-style cocoa powder | 1/4 cup unsweetened dipping cocoa powder | 1 package baby spinach leaves
instructions: In medium saucepan stir together beans, black eyed peas, baking powder, ancho chili powder and berries. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes, stirring frequently. Remove from heat, stir in habanero. Stir in cajun style cocoa powder. Cool and store in refrigerator. To serve, lightly spray 8 inch square baking dish with nonstick cooking spray.

title: Greek Pickernuts
ingredients: 4 lbs clean and hulled greek pickernuts | 3 tablespoons mustard powder
instructions: Place a colander in the sink and set a large bowl inside. Put the greek pickernuts into the colander, add enough water to almost cover. Put a weight on to keep the pickernuts at least a half inch above the top of the colander. Place the colander with the pickernuts into a large pan, fill it with enough water to boil the pickernuts, and bring to the boil. Place a large plate over the pickernut. Put the vinegar and mustard powder into a small bowl and whisk while adding. Gradually whisk in some of the hot pickling water, whisking after each addition until the mustard powder is absorbed. Drain the pickernuts, drain off the liquid, and dry.

title: Limoncello Oil
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups limoncello or 1 1/2 cups ice water | 1/4 cup dark sesame oil
instructions: With a fork, remove a small sliver of peel in long, thin shreds. Put the peel in a small bowl filled with ice, then squeeze the liquid out of the bowl and put it in a screw top jar. Mix in the sesame oil. Pour into a clean jar with a tight fitting lid, leaving a space of no more than 1/2 inch from the top, and let stand at room temperature for at least 3 days to allow flavors to develop.

title: Easy Brandy and Turnip Salad
ingredients: cooking spray ( olive oil or canola oil works too ) | 250 g mincemeat ( or beef or chicken ) | 1 fennel, bulb ( optional ) | 1 turnip, celery ( optional ) | 4 tablespoons brandy or 4 tablespoons red wine
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c/400°f/gas prepare 3 dinner bowls or bowls for your guests. Coat with cooking oil. Roll mincemeat or beef in the fennel bulb and cook in the oven for 8 - 10 minutes on each side or until golden brown. Set aside. Cook fennel in the same pan you cooked the fennel in with the brandy for 2 - 3 minutes or until just softened. Remove from the oven to cool for a few minutes. Peel the fennel and cut into thin slices. Arrange on serving plates and top with diced fennel. Sprinkle over the brandy and serve straight away with crusty bread.

title: Faux Indian Dessert
ingredients: 500 g rice vermicelli | 4 green chilies | 300 g dates
instructions: Wash chilies. Slit and devein dates. Grind the chilies to form a fine paste. Boil vermicelli in little water until dry, about 30 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside, covered. Break open chilies. Spread some vermicelli in a flat dish. Spoon a layer of vermicelli, one by one, over vermicelli. Add a layer of dates. Garnish with green chillies. Serve with ginger ginger and garlic chutney. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile,pork shoulder,green chilies,pinto bean,ham,salsa,meatball,green curry paste
title: Mexican Pork Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb meatballs | 1 lb pork shoulder | 3 ounces chopped green chilies | 2 ounces canned green chilies | 1 teaspoon red curry paste | 1 -2 chipotle chile, chopped | 1/2 cup salsa | 1 can pinto beans, drained
instructions: Brown meat and add the rest of the ingredients except the beans and sautee until heated through. Pour into a large casserole dish and top with bean slices. Bake in a preheated 350 degree oven for 30 minutes or until heated through.

Random Ingredients: yellow pea,kaiser,bay leaf,tomato puree,horseradish,oyster sauce,wheat bread,cream chicken soup
title: Beef Oyster Toast
ingredients: 2 yellow pea ( frozen or fresh ) | 1 cup frozen whole wheat bread, cut into 1 -inch cubes | 1 cup light cream of chicken soup | 1 cup light cream or 1 cup light cream | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon horseradish | 1/2 teaspoon chopped horseradish | 1 -2 teaspoon tomato puree | 2 whole bay leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Boil peas and water in heavy medium saucepan over high heat for 4 - 5 minutes, or until soft. Transfer peas to bowl of ice water to cool, drain and pat dry. Set aside. In medium size bowl, whisk soup, horseradish, tomato purée, and bay leaves, adjusting salt and pepper as needed to taste. Dip half of chicken into soup mixture and fry until golden brown. Dip half of peas into soup mixture, and fry on both sides until just barely golden. Repeat with remaining chicken and ingredients. Serve immediately with remaining soup mixture on the side.

title: Spicy Indian Crab
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef | 16 ounces crabmeat | 2 teaspoons minced fresh dill | 1 teaspoon minced garlic | 1 pinch allspice | 4 ounces american cheese, cubed
instructions: In a wok or large frying pan, stir fry the ground beef until golden brown, breaking up larger pieces with a side of spatula. Drain the excess fat. Stir in the crab and herbs. Sprinkle the american cheese over everything and bring to a light simmer. When the cheese just begins to melt, carefully flip the crab over with a spatula. Takes about 7 - 9 minutes.

title: Simple Udon Noodle and Onion
ingredients: 2 cups cooking onions, chopped | 1/2 cup quick-cooking onion | 3 tablespoons nutritional yeast | 1/4 cup udon noodles, dry ( or other small soft noodles, if desired )
instructions: Saute onions in olive oil until onion is soft and golden. Add water as needed to cover. Simmer until tender but not watery. Drain excess water from onions. Place noodles in a serving bowl. Pour sauteed onion mixture over noodles. Let cool at room temperature. Stir well before freezing.

Random Ingredients: coriander seed,marsala wine,vegetable stock,french onion,avocado,balsamic vinegar,jicama
title: Jicama & Mozzarella Caviar
ingredients: 1 large jicama, peeled and cut into cubes | 1 1 cup french fried onions | 4 tablespoons fresh coriander seeds | 1 teaspoon balsamic vinegar | 1/2 cup vegetable stock | 2 tablespoons marsala wine or 2 tablespoons port wine | 1 avocado, peeled and chopped
instructions: Heat grill plate over moderate heat. In food processor, blitz jicama until coarsely chopped. Add onions, coriander seeds and vinegar and blend until vegetables are coated. Add stock and marsala. Season to taste. Divide between 4 serving bowls. Top each with avocado.

title: Spicy Chili Broccoli and Kidney Beans
ingredients: 1 cup chopped broccoli | 1 1/2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 1 tablespoon unflavored gelatin | 3 cups cooked kidney beans ( fresh or canned ) | chopped fresh basil
instructions: Place all ingredients in a heavy pot over low heat. Simmer, stirring occasionally for 20 minutes. Ladle into jars to within 1 inch of rim. Place a hot, dry knife on top and seal. Let stand 10 minutes. Turn out of oven. If using canned beans, drain excess liquid.

title: Mexican Meatball Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 lb extra lean ground beef | 2 tablespoons chunky salsa | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh thyme | 10 eggs, beaten well | 8 frozen dinner rolls | dinner rolls, split
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°. Combine the beef, salsa and thyme in a large mixing bowl. Add the eggs and mix well. Shape 3 equal measures of mixture around each meatball. Arrange the meatballs in a 13 x9 baking pan and top with the rolls and cut steam holes in their outs. Bake until they are hot and toasted, about 10 to 15 minutes. Serve either fresh or hot. Note, we prefer the baked rolls in the crockpot for my old family. However, these freeze well and freeze them in quart sized freezer trays, defrosted in the microwave and reheated in the oven.

title: Yummy Mustard Manicotti
ingredients: 7 manicotti, uncooked | 2 tablespoons yellow mustard | 2 fresh rosemary sprigs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook manicotti in boiling water until tender yet firm to the bite, about 8 minutes.

Random Ingredients: grain mustard,anchovy,vegetable shortening,chorizo sausage,baby spinach,fusilli pasta,caper,topping
title: Spinach and Chorizo Fusilli
ingredients: 8 ounces fusilli pasta | 1 ounce vegetable shortening | 2 anchovies | 8 ounces chorizo sausage, sliced | 14 ounces baby spinach | 12 ounces low-fat frozen whipped topping, thawed | 12 ounces fresh anchovies | 2 teaspoons coarse grain mustard
instructions: Cook pasta until al dente. Drain, set aside. In a large frying pan or frying pan, over medium heat, melt the shortening. Add the anchovies and chorizo. Cook, stirring frequently, for 3 to 4 minutes until the anchovies are lightly browned. Add the spinach and stir through to wilt. Add the cooked pasta, stirring so the mixture coats the pasta. Toss to combine. Top with whipped topping and 2 anchovies. Drizzle with coarse grain mustard. Cover and refrigerate for an hour or so before serving. This will keep in fridge for quite a while.

title: Grouper Tacos
ingredients: 1/4 lb turkey, ground | 1/4 lb grouper, ground | 4 tablespoons dark sesame oil ( or other oil ) | 3 tablespoons low-fat cocoa powder | salt, to taste | 8 fresh tortillas or 8 flour tortillas | 3 tablespoons dark sesame oil ( or other oil )
instructions: Mix turkey with sesame oil, then season with salt to taste. Add ground turkey. Mix well and let stand 30 minutes. Form into 8 taco shells or 8 finger sized patties. Grill on high heat in low heat for 2 minutes being careful not to overcook. Add shredded cheese as desired. Serve with warm tortillas. Tips, one, when i was growing up in the old world, i didn't use any meat substitute because we had no fish left. So when making these i used meat, chicken, pork, pork butt or meatless chicken breast.

title: Easy Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1/4 cup cornstarch | 6 garlic chives | 2 tablespoons coarsely chopped chives
instructions: Prepare grill. Combine cornstarch, garlic chives, and chives. Place tenderloin on grill. Cook for 12 to 15 minutes. Slice to desired thickness. Note ~ cook time is approximate.

title: Bread and Butterfish Steak With Cashew Mustard
ingredients: 1 swordfish steak | 4 slices rye bread, with crusts removed | 1 bunch spring onion, sliced | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 2 tablespoons sweet vermouth | 50 g cashews, roasted
instructions: Preheat oven to 140c. Place bread on toasted oven tray and place under oven grill. Cook for 10 minutes until golden and slightly charred on edges. Place on toasted bread and set aside. Place onions on toasted bread to make dipping. Place 1 tbsp maple syrup in small frying pan. Sauté on medium low until onions are slightly caramelised. Wash and dry swordfish steak. Place bread slice on toasted sandwich and top with sliced coriander and remaining maple syrup. Toast under the grill for 2 minutes. Serve with roasted cashew mustard.

title: Daikon and Apple Cider Vinegar Salsa
ingredients: 3 1/2 tablespoons distilled apple cider vinegar | 1 1/2 teaspoons cornstarch | 1 cup prepared salsa | 2 1/2 pounds daikon radishes, peeled
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together the vinegar, cornstarch and salsa. Place the daikon radishes in a separate dish. Cover, and refrigerate for 30 minutes to 1 hour. Drain the daikon radishes, and transfer to a large resealable plastic bag. Drizzle with the flavored vinegar and marinate for 30 minutes at room temperature, or overnight in the refrigerator. Preheat the oven broiler. Remove the daikon radish and slice crosswise into thin strips. Arrange on a baking dish, and broil until lightly browned and tender, 5 to 7 minutes, turning occasionally.

title: Grandma's Mac and Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb egg noodles | 2 tablespoons breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 cup cooked tomato puree | 1/4 teaspoon salt
instructions: Cook the noodles according to directions, drain and set aside. Mix together the bread crumbs, parmigiano reggiano, cooked tomato puree and salt in a small bowl. Set aside. Bring a large pan of water to a boil. Add the egg noodles and cook until al dente, about 2 minutes. Drain noodles and add them into the sauce. Mix well, and serve.

title: Wild Rice and Ricotta Cheese Filling
ingredients: 6 cups milk ricotta cheese | 2 1/2 cups wild rice or 2 1/2 cups brown rice
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees. Add 1 cup water and wild rice to large bowl. Stir well. Bring 4 cups water with wild rice to boil. Remove from heat. Stir in ricotta with spoon and spoon onto waxed paper, spread so mixture fills well.

title: Peel the Turnips in 1/4 Cups of Boiling Water and Pick over
ingredients: 2 lbs turnips | 6 cups water | 1/2 cup thai basil
instructions: Cut the stem ends off the turnips and cut the peel into cubes. Bring the water to a boil in a large pot over high heat. Meanwhile, drain the turnits and toss with the basil. When the water returns to a boil, drop in the turnips. Place a plate on top of the turnips to keep them floating. Cover and turn the heat down to low.

title: Beef With Stove Polenta and Orange Peel
ingredients: 1 teaspoon vanilla bean | 1 1/2 lbs stewing beef, cut in 2 cm cubes | 2 cups polenta | 2 tablespoons orange juice | 12 flour tortillas, large | 1 ounce cheese, shredded | 12 slices oranges, peel on the peel
instructions: Bring 2 1/2 pts water to a boil. Add the vanilla bean and beef. Cover and simmer until meat is tender 30 minues. Dissolve 1 tblsp butter in 1 cup cold water, then add to beef along with polenta. Heat. Stir until thick, and set aside. In a separate bowl, stir 2 tblsp orange juice into the remaining orange peel. Arrange 1 cup of rice on plate, pour beef, orange peel over, then spoon some over. You now have 2 options,. Option 1 add cheese then top with remaining orange peel.

title: Maple Syrup Bread
ingredients: 1 cup plain yogurt | 1 1/2 tablespoons maple syrup | 1 3/4 cups flour | 1 tablespoon plain fat-free yogurt | 2 teaspoons dried dill | 6 cups bread flour | 1/4 cup chocolate, grated ( optional )
instructions: In a bowl stir together 1cup of the plain yogurt and maple syrup. Mix in flour, and stir until mixture forms a large clump. Stir in the remaining yogurt, yogurt and dill. Turn mixture into a greased, floured loaf pan. Tightly cover with plastic wrap or a towel, and refrigerate for 3 hours or over night. Drain off the excess juice from the loaf pan. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Spread the bread batter evenly into the loaf pan. Sprinkle the chocolate over the top. Put on a baking sheet. Bake in the hot oven for 40 to 50 minutes, or until firm. When baked, let the loaf cool for 5 minutes on a rack, then gently peel from the pan and let cool completely. Cut into 16 slices. Store the slices, wrapped in plastic wrap, in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: green chilies,turkey breast,masa harina,beef bouillon cube
title: Taquito (Chicken Mexican Style)
ingredients: 1 1 lb lean boneless turkey breast, cubed | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 6 green chilies, chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons instant masa harina
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a plastic bag and marinate overnight. Next day, remove meat from bag and cook 2 - 3 hours at low heat..

Random Ingredients: bamboo shoot,red chili pepper,pistachio,chili pepper,five spice powder,garam masala
title: Pistachio and Hot Peppery Nuts (Zarda Kebabs)
ingredients: 1 cup shelled pistachios | 10 bamboo shoots or 10 black mushrooms | 1 -2 dried red chili pepper | 1 teaspoon five-spice powder | 2 teaspoons ground red chili pepper ( optional ) | chopped fresh chili pepper ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Place the pistachios in a food processor or mortar. Pulse until finely ground. Trim and clean stems of the mushrooms and cut them into small pieces. Place the ground pistachios in a small bowl and add 1 - 2 tablespoons of water. Stir well and set aside. Remove the chili peppers from the seeds and slice them into thin strips with scissors, removing the seeds and membrane from the membranes if desired. Remove the stems and seeds and finely shred the flesh. Cut the bamboo into thin strips and soak in water for 10 - 15 minutes. Drain the soaked bamboo and put into a blender and process for 30 seconds or until puréed. Add the chili pepper strips, five spice powder, ground chili, 1 teaspoons ground red pepper and mix well. Add a few chopped chile peppers if you desire, or garam masala to taste. Pour the pistachio mixture into small, shallow serving dishes. Decorate with the sliced chile peppers and pistachios. Serve nuggets in a hot and sticky manner.

Random Ingredients: celery seed,raspberry,rice flour,pine nut,linguine,porcini mushroom,irish cream,chipotle pepper adobo sauce
title: Creamy Raspberry Crisp Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb linguine | 2 cups sweetened raspberry jam ( raspberry flavoured is best ) | 1 cup irish cream | 1/4 cup sweetened rice flour | 2 teaspoons celery seeds | 1 1/2 tablespoons smoked chipotle peppers in adobo sauce | 1/2 cup pine nuts, toasted | 1 large rind of an italian cheese
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Meanwhile, melt the raspberry jam with the irish cream until smooth. In a bowl, combine the rice flour, celery seeds and chipotle. Stir in raspberry jam mixture until blended and thickened. When you are ready to serve, preheat oven to 400 degrees. Spray a cookie sheet with non stick cooking spray. Add cooked pasta to the prepared pan. Top with the prepared sauce. Smooth out the top and spread out the peels evenly. Sprinkle the top with the pine nuts. Bake until golden brown at 400 degrees.

title: Cottage Cheese and Cheese Salad (Turos Teszhi)
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce ( or rocket ) | 1/2 lb cottage cheese, drained ( or a mix of the 2 ) | 2 teaspoons grated cheddar cheese
instructions: Wash and dry lettuce. Thinly slice the top 1/4 inch off the head and set it aside. Separate the head from the leaves, keeping the leaves intact, and set it aside. Break the lettuce into chunks and place it in a salad bowl. Add the cottage cheese and sprinkle with the cheese. Stir to mix together, cover and refrigerate for 3 hours or longer before serving. Serve chilled.

title: Baked Stuffed Japanese Spam Wraps
ingredients: 8 -10 pieces veal, each about 6 1/2 '' in diameter | 3 tablespoons flour | 1 tablespoon japanese soy sauce | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon cajun seasoning | 1 large coconut, grated or cans coconut milk
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Place veal between two sheets of wax paper, and pound with a meat mallet or rolling pin to flatten them slightly. Combine flour, soy sauce and cajun seasoning in a bowl, and stir until blended. Remove the meat from the veal slices with a spatula. Dip slices in flour and shake off any extra. Sprinkle coconut or coconut milk on each slice. Arrange slices in a 9x13 inch baking dish, in rows if desired. Bake for about 2 hours, or until brown and done. Serve very warm, or at room temperature,.

title: Caramelized Pineapple Chunk Pies
ingredients: 500 g pineapple chunks, canned | 1 cup corn oil | 1 teaspoon gelatin
instructions: Pour the pineapple chunks into a bowl, pour over about 6 tbsp of cold water and add all the remaining ingredients stir well. Add some extra water to help it mix well. Pour this batter into small, heavy sized moulds or ramekins. Let the moulds soak for 20 minutes in fridge before turning out. You can also refrigerate and freeze for upto 3 months.

title: Lebanese Chicken
ingredients: 2 tablespoons orange blossom water | 2 chicken breasts or 1 large chicken thigh
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Put the orange blossom water in a pot or pan. Add the chicken pieces, preferably legs and thighs. Bring to a boil and then simmer for 10 - 15 minutes. Add salt and pepper to taste then simmer for a further 3 - 5 minutes. It is likely that chicken pieces will break apart, this is normal. Turn off heat and leave for 10 minutes, then strain into a bowl or measuring cup. Reheat the chicken pieces on a preheated hot grill, brushing with the orange blossom water.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock,asparagus,green cardamom pod,peanut,pesto sauce,potato flake,wheat flour,herb
title: Herbed Asparagus With Potatoes and Peanuts
ingredients: 2 lbs asparagus, trimmed | 2 1/2 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 8 green cardamom pods, cracked | 1/2 cup pesto sauce | 1 cup chicken stock | 1/2 cup potato flakes ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons chopped dry roasted unsalted dry-roasted unsalted peanuts, chopped ( optional ) | herbs, as garnish ( optional )
instructions: Bring a large pan of water to a boil. When water comes to a boil, blanch the asparagus 3 - 5 minutes, then refresh with cold water and drain well. Drain well and set aside. To make the dressing, whisk the flour in a bowl with some salt and pepper. Add the cardamom pods and a pinch of salt. Whisk in the pesto and bring to a boil. Remove from the heat and whisk in the stock, potato flakes or if using peanuts, stir into the dressing. When ready to serve drizzle over the asparagus and toss. Garnish with freshly chopped herbs. Tip, i like my potato flakes a bit crunchy, so it is up to your taste.

title: Sausage Burritos
ingredients: 2 cups dried navy beans | 2 links bulk italian sausage | 3/4 cup raw jicama, diced | 3 tablespoons pimientos, diced | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh thyme | 8 tortillas | 2 cans pimentos, drained
instructions: Soak beans overnight drain and rinse. Return beans to pot. Add 2 cups water. Bring to a boil and turn down heat. Simmer 1 1/2 hours until beans are tender. About 1 hour before serving stir fry sausage, jicama, pimientos, thyme, and olives in a large skillet til well cooked. Break the sausages into pieces before adding to the beans. Cook tortillas in a skillet on a soft, damp towel. Fill each warmed tortilla with 2 tbs cheese and sausage filling then fold in half. Serve with remaining salsa on the side.

title: Chickpea Togari
ingredients: 12 ounces canned chickpeas | 2 teaspoons garlic powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons ginger powder | 1 1/2 tablespoons garlic powder | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 1/2 cup warm liquid smoke
instructions: Empty chickpeas in colander and rinse off excess water. Cover and let stand overnight. Drain chickpeas, and place in a large pot over medium heat. Add spices and cook 1 minute. Add water with meat, and meat to chickpeas and bring to boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer on very low heat for 1 1/2 2 hours, or until meat shreds easily. Serve over rice, or over basmati. Note on spices, feel free to season the liquid smoke to taste with a combination of salt, black pepper or cayenne pepper.

Random Ingredients: spanish olive,beef hot dog,capicola,cremini mushroom,pepper flake,asafoetida powder,floury potato,bean sauce
title: Beef Asafetida Hash
ingredients: 1/2 lb cooked shredded beef hot dog | 1/2 lb sliced asafoetida powder | 1/4 teaspoon hot pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons floury potatoes, finely chopped | 1/4 cup cremini mushroom, finely chopped | 1 cup capicola, finely chopped | 16 capicola, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup canned bean sauce | 1/2 cup jarred sliced spanish olives, drained and chopped
instructions: On a cutting board, chop together beef hot dogs, sausage, asafoetida, and hot pepper flakes. Place floury potatoes in a bowl. Add mushrooms and capicola. Place 1/2 the beef and onion hot dogs in the center of the mixture and top with remaining beef. Pinch edges of the hash together so as to allow for easier sealing. Heat a deep fryer to 325°f or an electric fryer thermometer reaches 160 degrees f. Cook hash in batches, until golden brown, 3 to 5 minutes, and place on a wire rack to cool. Transfer hash to a serving platter and serve with beans on the side.

Random Ingredients: parmesan cheese,green apple,sugar snap pea,white bean,steak,hamburger,tamari,parmigiano
title: Peppered Swiss Fondue
ingredients: 6 tablespoons tamari | 2 tablespoons sugar snap peas, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons grated parmigiano | steak, cut into thin sticks | 1 lb swiss hamburger, cooked, cut into 1 inch chunks | 1 lb white beans, cooked | 8 ounces parmigiano, freshly shaved | 1 tablespoon sugar snap peas, peeled, sliced
instructions: Place all the sauce ingredients in a small saucpan and simmer until the sugar snaps are softened and the sauce has thickened slightly, about 5 minutes. Transfer the sauce to a warmed fondue pot or fondue pot set over low heat and keep warm. Cook and stir the steak and beef in the fondue pot until the meat is well cooked, about 3 minutes. Add the white beans, stir, and cook and stir for 2 minutes, or until the beans are heated through. Transfer the mixture to a fondue pot and warm over medium low heat for about 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: american cheese,cannellini bean,deli roast beef,salt pepper
title: Cheesy Beef Nachos
ingredients: 24 slices deli italian cheese | 24 slices deli roast beef | 1 can cannellini beans, drained & rinsed | salt & pepper
instructions: Lay 2 slices of cheese on each slice of beef. Overlap one can of beans on top of beef. Season with salt & pepper & fold the entire top flap of cheese snugly against the exposed meat.

title: Persian Kebabs
ingredients: 2 pounds lean ground beef | 1 lemon peel, grated | 1 green bell pepper, chopped | 1/4 cup ground cardamom
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together beef, lemon peel, green bell pepper, and cardamom. Roll mixture into 1 inch balls. Place meatballs on a baking tray that has been coated with cooking spray. Bake kababs in a 350 degrees f oven 20 minutes, or until the internal temperature reaches 150 degrees f.

title: Tortilla Barley Beans
ingredients: 1 can pearl barley | 1 jar salsa
instructions: Drain the barley and place in a large saucepan with about 1/2 cup water. Bring to a boil, then reduce to low, cover and cook until tender, 1 - 2 hours depending on how dry the barley is.. While the barley is cooking, place the salsa in a saucepan and heat on medium to medium high until simmering. Add the beans and heat through, about 2 - 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cayenne,sausage,thai fish sauce,cumin powder,red chilies,tart apple
title: Apple Sausage Patties
ingredients: 350 g of ground sausage, casings removed or 400 g ground chuck | 1/4 cup tart apple, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon thai fish sauce | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 red chilies, dried, deseeded & chopped or 1 red chili, finely chopped | 1 pinch cayenne, per patties
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. If using patties, pat into patties & cook under a broiler or heat of a bbq or a grill, until well browned & cooked through.

title: Horse-Loved Beets
ingredients: 1 onion, chopped | 1/4 cup self-rising flour | 1/4 cup grated aged beet, cooked and mashed | 1/4 cup tahini | 2 teaspoons almond extract or 2 teaspoons pure almond extract, to taste ( optional ) | 8 slices prosciutto, cut crosswise into thin strips
instructions: Drain onion and pat dry with paper towels. Preheat oven to 300°f. In a large bowl, mix together onion, flour, beet, tahini, and almond extract using 1 tablespoon of the juice from grated beet. Add beef hash. Stir until dough holds together, then remove from bowl. Spread dough onto a baking sheet. Bake in preheated oven until bread is browned and crisp, about 1 hour.

title: Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups low-fat half-and-half | 1/4 cup chopped scallions | 1/2 teaspoon chopped scallion | 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Whisk all ingredients together in a small bowl. Taste and adjust seasonings if necessary. Place in refrigerator to cool.

title: Smoked Salmon & Mushroom Loaf
ingredients: 12 slices white bread, crusts removed | 12 thin salmon | 1 onion, finely chopped | 1/4 cup plain flour | 1 teaspoon onion salt | 2 tablespoons butter, softened
instructions: Preheat grill. Toast bread slices lightly. Place the 4 slices of bread, buttered side down on a grill tray and bush with oil. Place a fillet on top of each and sprinkle with onion seasoning. Top with remaining bread, salmon, mushroom mixture and a sprinkle of the softened butter.

title: Kurdian Style Noodles
ingredients: 1 -2 baking potato | 1 -2 long chili | 1 lemongrass | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon advieh ( or to taste ) | spices | 500 g yakisoba noodles, cooked
instructions: Skin the potato, if using a new one and cut it into slices 1/4 thickness. Cut the chili into thin slices long ways and de seed the chili and lemongrass. Place the chili and lemongrass in a mortar & pound or crush very fine. Peel, devein and chop the potato into thin slices and place it in a bowl. Peel and chop the potato into thin slices and add it to the mortar, pound or crush lightly until the potato pieces are ground well. The mixture should not be too liquid. Add the advieh or to taste and mix thoroughly with a fork. Stir in some seasoning so that the flavours are evenly distributed. Taste and add more as necessary. If you're adding fish, stir fry it in a little olive oil for a couple of minutes before seasoning. Place the yakisoba noodles in a bowl and mix them with the vegetable mixture. Heat a little olive oil in a frying pan or wok over a moderate heat and fry the noodles quickly turning them over, until they are a golden colour. Drain on paper towels before serving. Serve the noodles hot.

title: Anchovy Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons anchovy paste, paste ( see note below ) | 1 cup aged parmesan cheese, coarsely grated | 1 dash cayenne pepper
instructions: Combine anchovy paste, cheese, and cayenne pepper in bowl. Use immediately or let stand at room temperature for two days before using. Use on grilled chicken breasts or shrimp.

title: Apple and Guacamole Appetizer
ingredients: 2 medium apples | 1 tablespoon herbes de provence | 1 teaspoon papaya | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 500 g cool whip ( cool whip is good ) | 1 teaspoon herbes de provence | 1 teaspoon papaya | 1 teaspoon guacamole
instructions: Scoop out the core of the apple, leaving about 1 cm of around the apple. Cut into chunks roughly half an inch square. Put apple chunks, herbes de provence, papaya, and spices into a food processor or blender and blitz until finely chopped. Transfer mixture to an airtight container and refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight. Beat 1 t of cool whip on high speed until stiff. Put 1 t of cool whip into another bowl. Cut 1 t of cool whip in half and use to whip the remaining cool whip. Spread 1 t of herbes de provence onto the bottom half of a chilled apple. Then add 3 t of guacamole and 2 t of your chopped sweet apple. Then, with a spatula, spread guacamole on top of the apple, leaving about a third of an inch of apple clear at the edges. Spread your last 2 t of guacamole on top and cover with your sweetened sweet apple. Use your spatula to gently rock back the apples, a spatula, or the back of a spoon to help remove it from the sides of the apple.
