Then, with the spatula, spread remaining sweet whip in small balls, around the guacamole, and then peel off the potato, cut in half and then cut across from the inside out.

title: Spanish Onion & Corn Risotto
ingredients: 1 onion, chopped | 500 ml vegetable stock | 1 3/4 cups risotto rice | 1/2 cup frozen corn, thawed and drained
instructions: Place the onions and vegetable stock in a saucepan over low heat.

Random Ingredients: baking soda,cream,lasagna noodle,wheat bread,peach,linguine,blue cheese,lemon juice
title: Lemon Peach Loaf  and Linguine
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sour cream | 1 -2 tablespoon fresh lemon juice | 2 peaches, peeled and sliced, about 2 cups ( ripe ) | 10 large lasagna noodles | 1 loaf whole wheat bread, without crusts, cut in half crosswise | 1/2 cup blue cheese, crumbled, about | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 1 package linguine, cooked and drained, reserve 2/3 cup of liquid
instructions: Combine sour cream and lemon juice. Top with apples. Place four bread halves, cut side up, in 13x9 x 2 inch baking dish. Sprinkle with blue cheese. Top with a third of the sauce mixture and 1/4 cup of pasta liquid. Repeat layering. Cover loosely with foil. Bake at 325 for 60 minutes or until heated through. Remove foil and bake uncovered for 10 minutes. Remove from oven and top with remaining cheese. Sprinkle with baking soda. Bake uncovered for 5 minutes or until cheese is melted and bread is lightly browned.

title: Peanut-Stiffy Thai-Style ladyfingers
ingredients: 20 ladyfingers ( about 2x14 inches or so per package, but be careful they break up easily ) | 1/4 cup low-sodium thai peanut sauce
instructions: Line a rack with a foil lined baking sheet. Brush the ladyfingers with the peanut sauce. Sprinkle on the peanuts if desired. Bake 10 - 15 minutes or until the bottoms are lightly browned.

title: Seared Cod With Rice Wine
ingredients: 1 cod ( about 6 ozs. each ) | 1/2 teaspoon rice wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Remove any skin and bones from the fish. Cut 1/2 inch slices across the top of the fish. Arrange in a shallow pan and pour about 1/3 cup water over the fish. Roast in middle of oven 10 to 12 minutes or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork. While fish is roasting, in a small saucepan combine rice wine and 1/4 cup water. Heat over low heat, stirring constantly for 1 minute or until most of liquid has been absorbed. Remove fish from pan and reserve. Add 2 tablespoons of the liquid to the pan, bring to boil and simmer 3 to 5 minutes, or until reduced and syrupy. Pour wine sauce over fish and serve.

title: Artichokes In a Garlic Muffin Pan
ingredients: 4 artichoke hearts, drained and cut in half, then quartered and cut into 12 pieces, tentacles reserved | 1 1/2 cups plain yogurt | 1/2 cup beef stock | 1 tablespoon ghee or 1 tablespoon butter | 1/2 cup fresh breadcrumb | 1 1/2 teaspoons italian seasoning
instructions: Warm the yogurt under running water for 45 seconds or until it's just slightly warm to the touch stir in the stock, ghee or butter and spices and set aside. Spoon out the oil from each artichoke heart and discard the center of the artichoke heart. Use a sharp knife to cut a slit through each artichoke heart and carefully stuff the artichoke heart with the yogurt mixture. Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,anise seed,italian salad dressing mix
title: Italian Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf rye bread | italian salad dressing mix | 2 tablespoons crushed anise seed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Cut tops off the rye bread and remove crusts. Mix together the dressing mix, anise seed, and crushed aniseed. Spread mixture on the rye bread. Bake in the preheated oven 40 to 50 minutes, or until bread has absorbed the flavor of the spread.

Random Ingredients: brown sugar,pork loin roast,serrano pepper,pork shoulder,cheddar cheese
title: Queso Blanco
ingredients: 1 boneless pork shoulder | 1 boneless pork loin roast | 6 serrano peppers | 1 ounce brown sugar | 12 ounces cheddar cheese, shredded
instructions: Heat oven to 300 degrees f. Combine the brown sugar and the peppers in a plastic bag and place inside a bowl, cover with plastic wrap and refridgerate overnight to give the peppers a chance to soften. Spread the garlic powder on the pork roast and put the meat into a roasting pan. Bake for 2 hours. When done, meat should easily shred with a fork, the marinade should also be runny and the meat tenderizing. Remove the pork from the oven and stir into a large bowl.

title: Australian  Tea  Dip  for Fish or Chips
ingredients: 500 g fish ( fillets or steaks cut into chips ) or 500 g other firm textured vegetable ( steaks cut into chips )
instructions: Arrange fish or steaks on a plate. Cover with thousand island dressing. Add spices and nuts or spices and marinate for 2 - 3 hours. Serve with fresh boiled potatoes, carrot sticks or crisp salad leaves for salad.

Random Ingredients: eggplant,brown sugar,pine nut,white sugar,bacon bit,coffee,sun tomato oil,phyllo dough
title: Eggplant (Aubergine) Phyllo Appetizers
ingredients: 1 eggplant | 1 - 1 1/2 cup brown sugar ( for dusting, less light brown ) | 12 ounces cooked bacon bits | 2 cups sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained and chopped ( drain off excess oil ) | 1/4 cup butter, melted and divided | 3/4 cup coffee or 3/4 cup water | 1 tablespoon brown sugar | 8 sheets phyllo dough | 1 ounce pine nuts ( for garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Peel eggplant and slice lengthwise into 1/4 inch thick slices on the mandolin or cutting board. Brush eggplant lightly with a bit of the eggry and grill for 3 - 5 minutes. Place eggplant slices on a cookie sheet coated with cooking spray. Sprinkle lightly with brown sugar and bake at 400°f for 15 - 20 minutes or until eggplant is light brown and crisp. Remove from oven and drain any accumulated egg drippings and slice eggplant into strips about 1/4 inch wide. In frying pan over med high, fry bacon until crisp, about 3 minutes. Remove bacon from pan and drain on paper towels. Add 2 tablespoon of melted butter to hot fat in pan, then caramelize eggplant strips. While frying bacon add 1/4 cup of coffee or water to pan and boil up, scraping up browned bits. Remove from heat, stir in brown sugar, add 2 tablespoons of the eggy drippings and mix well. Keep warm. On a baking sheet sprayed with cooking spray, layer a third of the eggplant strips, and a few more strips. Keep repeating layers. Top each layer with a bit of the bacon bits and sun dried tomato slices. Place the remaining strips on top of the bacon and sun dried tomato slices. Bake at 400°f for 12 - 13 minutes or until the filling is hot and bubbly. Remove from oven and cut into squares. Garnish with pine nuts and serve with fresh french baguettes and hot sauce, such as tabasco.

title: Tomato Peppers for the BBQ
ingredients: 4 plum tomatoes ( about 14 ounces total ) | 1 teaspoon salt | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 3 medium pinches kosher salt | 2 tablespoons ground pungent seeds in ( pepitas, or dried corn kernels ) | 1 cup dry roasted salted peanut, coarsely chopped
instructions: Remove seeds from tomatoes and cut into 1/8 inch thick slices. Season tomatoes with salt and set aside at room temperature for 20 to 30 minutes. Heat grill or broiler to high. Transfer tomato slices to a bowl. Sprinkle with 1/4 teaspoon salt and 1/8 teaspoon pungent seeds.

title: Hot hard egg salad
ingredients: 4 hard cooked eggs | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 2 tablespoons juice | 1 teaspoon celery, finely chopped
instructions: Beat together hard cooked eggs, vinegar, juice, and celery until well mixed. Chill the salad while preparing the egg salad. Add the chopped hard cooked eggs and blend thoroughly. Taste for seasoning.

title: Italian Pecans (Cookies)
ingredients: 1 cup pecans | 1/4 cup wishbone italian dressing | 1/4 cup green olives, roughly chopped ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. On a plate, mix the pecans, italian dressing, and olives. Roll the pecan mixture into 1 logs on a sprayed cookie sheet and press into the mini size mini muffin cups. Bake for about 15 minutes, until golden brown and crispy. Remove from muffin cups, but leave the pecan tops on the pan. Note, if you dont have a muffin cup, just spray mini muffin cups with pam, spread the pecan tops on top, then bake until set.

title: Chickpea  Salad
ingredients: 800 g chickpeas | 100 g tomatoes with juice | 100 g margarine | 1 celery rib, diced | 200 g margarine | 1/2 teaspoon pepperoncini pepper | 1/8 cup yoghurt | 1/4 cup mexican blend cheese
instructions: Boil chickpeas in water 15 minutes or until tender. Drain and rinse under cold water. Place in bowl. Dry fry on high heat the tomatoes and all the margarine until tomato skins blister, add pepperoncini and remaining ingredients stir until heated through and cheese is melted.

title: Easy Slow Cooker Chicken Fajitas
ingredients: 2 tablespoons bacon drippings | 8 skinless, boneless chicken thighs, cut into bite size pieces | 1 1/2 cups baby spinach | 1/4 cup guacamole | 1 package dry pasta, cooked and drained
instructions: In a large skillet, combine the bacon drippings and chicken. Cover and cook over medium heat, turning the chicken once, until chicken juices run clear, about 10 minutes. Remove chicken from skillet and place into a 1 1/2 quart slow cooker. Pour spinach over the chicken.

title: Buttermilk Ketchup-Patties(Yogurt)
ingredients: 1 cup buttermilk | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 1/2 teaspoon curry powder | 1/2 teaspoon sugar | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1/8 teaspoon dark brown sugar or 1 teaspoon almond sugar
instructions: Put all of the ingredients except the sugar in a blender and blend till smooth. Cover and keep refrigerated.

title: Vegetarian Cabbage Rounds
ingredients: 2 cans cabbage | 1 1/2 tablespoons vegan margarine | 1 package tri-colored spiral egg roll ( we like spirals ) | 1 package shredded red cabbage | 1 cup sour cream | 1/3 cup minced fresh sweet onions ( such as vidalia ) or 1/3 cup leeks ( such as vidalia ) | 1/4 cup dry bread crumbs
instructions: Separate baguettes in half horizontally. Cut each half into 12 equal portions. Place on lightly greased baking sheet. Brush with melted margarine. Bake in 400 degree f oven until brown & crisp, 6 - 8 minutes.

title: Rebeced Beef With Rye Bread
ingredients: 1 slice rye bread | 1 spring onion | 1 slice beef chuck
instructions: Place rye bread & spring onion on a microwave safe plate. On the plate, smear with the beef. Microwave for 10 mins on high to warm. Open & serve.

title: Easy Tomato Puree (Mark Bittman)
ingredients: 14 ounces tomato sauce | 12 ounces candied peel
instructions: Place tomato puree, candied peel and water into a small saucepan or wok. Bring to the boil. Reduce heat and simmer slowly for around an hour, stirring occasionally. Store in the fridge until needed. Keeps for up to 6 weeks.

title: Thai Spinach and Pear Tart
ingredients: 3/4 teaspoon coconut oil | 2 pears, coarsely chopped | 8 ounces frozen chopped spinach, thawed | 1/4 cup shredded coconut, toasted | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/4 sheet phyllo pastry
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Mix together coconut oil and chopped pears in a small bowl until well blended. Spread mixture evenly over the bottom of an 11x17 inch baking dish or tart pan. Cover dough with the spinach and shredded coconut, and top with remaining phyllo pastry. Cover the pan with plastic wrap, and set aside. Bake filling in the preheated oven for 35 to 40 minutes, or until center is just barely set. Allow to cool slightly before slicing.

title: Greek Green Olive Salad II
ingredients: 1 jar pitted green olives, drained | 1 jar pitted kalamata olives, drained | 1 teaspoon dried sage | 1 bottle ranch dressing
instructions: Blend the green olives, kalamata olives, and sage in a blender until smooth. Stir in the ranch dressing.

title: Crazy Pheasant
ingredients: 2 whole pheasants | 2 cups self raising flour | 2 cups chicken stock or 2 cups broth | 1 pint half-and-half | 1/2 cup cooked pasta
instructions: Pre heat oven to 425 degrees. Cut pheasant breast and legs into 2 1/2 inch wide slabs on an oven tray. Rub the flour and salt into the pheasant, coating it well. Add the stock to the pheasant. In a small saucepan, boil the half and half for 5 minutes, then pour over the pheasant. Sprinkle with the pasta, bake for about 40 - 50 minutes, depends how brown you like it, and cut into 6 slices across the grain.

title: Mexican Corn & Chilli Rice Wraps With Adobo
ingredients: 2 tablespoons oil | 3 flour tortillas, warmed | 1 cup long grain rice | 1 can canned pumpkin seeds | 1 -4 teaspoon adobo sauce or 1 -4 teaspoon picante sauce
instructions: In a skillet or saute pan over medium heat, add oil. Lightly brown the tortillas in hot oil. As the tortillas become pliable and beginning to crisp, remove the tortillas from the pan to a plate. While the tortillas are still warm, spread them on a plate. In the same skillet, add the rice, stir to coat rice with the oil, and add the contents of the pan. Turn rice over and add the can of pumpkin seeds. Stir once or twice, then continue to stir until rice is heated through. Top with the adobo sauce and a drizzle of olive oil.

title: Cherry and Tomato Soup
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon chicken stock cube ( flavourful to your own tastes, if you don't have this on hand, try a little less ) | 1 -2 cherry, washed and chopped into 1 cm pieces ( for a bit of bite-sized pieces, if you have no cherries, use 2 instead ) | 1 pint canned tomatoes ( chopped up, if using cherry juice instead of water ) | maraschino cherry, as a garnish ( optional )
instructions: Use a soup pot. Tie off a piece of muslin and pour the water over the muslin. Place the muslin in the pot and pour over enough water to stop it sticking. Place the lid on the pot and slowly bring to a simmer, allowing the water to cook down but not to run out. Once the pot has reached the simmer you will notice the muslin beginning to smell. You will inhale the aroma of the muslin. Once the muslin has sunk to the top place the cherry pieces in the soup. When they are ready stir them through the soup. Serve and enjoy. For vegetarian use the chicken stock instead of the chicken stock.. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: pasta,tarragon,beef chuck,cardamom pod,lime juice zest,vegetable oil
title: Easy Slow Cooker Spiced Beef
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless beef chuck | 8 cardamom pods, smashed, divided | 1/2 cup lime juice, plus lime wedges, divided | 1/4 cup fresh tarragon, coarsely chopped | 1 cup vegetable oil | 9 ounces dried medium tube shaped pasta, such as ditalini
instructions: Trim fat from meat and cut into 8 serving size pieces. Place meat in 6 - 5 qt slow cooker. In small bowl, place 2 smashed cardamom pods and 1 1/2 lime juice. Using pastry brush, brush lime juice mixture onto meat. Sprinkle with 1/4 cup chopped tarragon. Top with remaining sliced cardamom pods, tarragon and 1/2 cup of lime juice mixture. Cook on low 2 hrs or until meat is tender. Remove meat, reserving stock. Using two forks, shred meat. Combine reserved stock, remaining 2 smashed cardamom pods, remaining 2 limes juice, 1/4 cup each of chopped tarragon and reserved beef liquid. Stir in 1 cup hot stock mixture. Cook and stir on high for 1 minute or until heated through. Add pasta and remaining tarragon.

Random Ingredients: italian tomato,romano cheese,thai red curry paste,shell pasta,cannellini bean,wheat germ
title: Curry Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 package dry medium shell pasta | 2 tablespoons wheat germ | 2 cans cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 5 large ripe italian-style tomatoes, chopped ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 2 tablespoons thai red curry paste ( to taste ) | 1/4 cup grated romano cheese
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: meat,dark rum,cream mushroom soup,sugar snap pea,avocado
title: Crazy Meatball (Guacamole)
ingredients: 1 lb ground meat | 2 cans cream of mushroom soup | 1 1/2 cups sugar snap peas | 2 medium ripe avocados | 1/2 cup dark rum
instructions: Brown meatballs in a medium hot pan. Combine the rest of the ingredients in a bowl and stir to blend. Enjoy.

title: Barley Oil
ingredients: 200 g pearl barley or 200 g white beans, such as runner's beans, in your measure | dark sesame oil
instructions: If using whole young beans, do not wash them until you are ready to use as this will leave them from absorbing any of the flavours as soon as you are done cooking this beans. Wash and boil the whole beans for 4 minutes or just until soft. Drain, cover and leave to soak in the water for a further 2 hours. Drain. Heat a wok over a high heat for about 1 minute and add the oil. Tip the oil so that any stray grains of rice will sink to the bottom as they cook, then stirfry the barley. When it is golden, lift the beans out of the hot wok with a slotted spoon and place on a large plate. Sprinkle over the sesame oil.

title: Prawns
ingredients: 500 g prawns, in shell | 1/4 cup sweet chili sauce | 1/4 cup sour cream | 2 tablespoons yogurt or 2 tablespoons soy sauce
instructions: Shell and devein prawns, leaving heads and shells intact. Place sauce ingredients in a microwave safe bowl. Heat on high for 2 - 3 minutes or until thickened. Spoon sauce on to prawns. Refrigerate for 20 minutes or until serving time.

title: Moroccan Fried Cabbage for Two
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups chopped cooked chicken | 1 head cabbage, cored and torn into bite-sized pieces | 1/2 head cabbage, cored and torn into bite-sized pieces | 2 teaspoons ground cumin | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground ginger | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large skillet and simmer over medium heat. Stir often until the cabbage is tender. If needed, add some water.

Random Ingredients: plain yogurt,celery rib,white wine,green bean,icing sugar,cherry,spaghetti,spearmint
title: Green Bean and Yogurt Pasta Salad
ingredients: 900 g green beans ( trimmed and blanched ) | 450 g small cherry tomatoes ( halved ) | 1 large celery rib ( cut into thin wedges ) | 150 g dried spearmint | 140 g icing sugar | 150 g plain greek yogurt | 150 g spaghetti ( small shaped and cooked ) | 1/4 cup dry white wine ( croatian red wine is best )
instructions: In a bowl, heat 400 degrees f, gas mark 4, to boiling, and cook the green beans for 8 to 10 minutes or until crisp tender and drain. Arrange in a large salad bowl. Add the cherry tomatoes, celery and spearmint and drizzle with olive oil. Add the icing sugar, and mix well. In a separate bowl, whisk the greek yoghurt until smooth and stir into the yogurt mixture. Mix well and add the wine. Pour over the salad and mix well. Serve immediately, or allow to chill for a few hours before serving.

title: Garlic Pesto
ingredients: 1/2 cup pine nuts | 4 cloves garlic, pressed | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Lightly toast pine nuts in small skillet over medium heat. Let cool until warm, about 10 minutes. Peel skins from garlic cloves. Place the pine nuts into a blender with garlic cloves, 1/4 cup pine nuts, and salt. Puree until well mixed. Stir in parsley and process until no lumps remain.

title: Scallops With Sherry and Portuguese Bay Scallops
ingredients: 4 lbs bay scallops | 1/2 cup sherry wine
instructions: In a large saucpan, bring the scallops to a boil with the sherry. Add the scallops and bring to just below a boil. Cover and transfer to a simmer for 20 - 30 minutes or until scallops are cooked through.

title: Chicken Liver and Tuna
ingredients: 300 g broccoli | 150 g canned tuna in vegetable oil, drained or 100 g canned chicken livers | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon grated fresh carrot | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh marjoram or 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1 teaspoon cornflour | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla | 1/4 teaspoon dry mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon cornflour | 1 drop of your favourite curry powder or 1 drop of dry crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Boil the broccoli for 1 - 2 mins less than the normal package directions, then refresh under cold water and drain off the water. Chop broccoli into small florets, then boil for 5 minutes or until tender. Drain. Drain tuna and livers separately, then place in a bowl, with the mustard and pepper seeds. Season well. Add the cornflour, vanilla and mustard seeds and combine thoroughly. Slowly add the broccoli florets and mix thoroughly. Taste and add more seasoning if necessary, then add tuna and or vegetables and mix well. Serve immediately and enjoy.

title: Pounded Beef
ingredients: 1 pound ground sirloin steak | 2 cups marinade, divided | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Combine sirloin and 2 cups marinade in a large slow cooker. Cover, and set to high. Cook for 1 1/2 hours, then reduce heat to low, and continue cooking for 2 1/2 to 3 hours, or until meat shreds easily with a fork. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Prosciutto Wrapped Spinach
ingredients: 100 g prosciutto, thinly sliced | 3 tablespoons sunflower seeds, lightly roasted | 1 cup fresh spinach
instructions: On a large plate, lay a slice of prosciutto and sunflower seeds on top. Add half a head of spinach, then fold the other half over and secure firmly with a toothpick. Heat your griddle up before adding the spinach to prevent burning or sticking to the pan. Leave to tuck under the spinach. Turn when spinach is wilted. Serve with a sauce or a crusty bread wrap.

title: Fig Cheese Fondue
ingredients: 8 fresh figs, chopped | 2 cups half-and-half | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 3/4 cup half-and-half | 2 tablespoons cheese food ( can substitute your choice cheese ) | 2 -3 tablespoons of fresh mint, chopped
instructions: Over low heat, stir together the chopped figs and half and half and worcestershire sauce. Let simmer over low heat until most of the liquid is gone. Add the cheese food and stir until melted together. Add more whipped cream if needed.

title: Green Papaté Salad
ingredients: 400 g baby spinach leaves | 200 g snow peas | 200 g tomatoes, cubed | 200 g small tomatoes, sliced | paprika ( optional ) | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon mint, for topping
instructions: Wash and refresh the baby spinach. Combine the spinach, snow peas, tomatoes, tomatoes and mint. Sprinkle paprika or cayenne if using, on top if using.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,marinara sauce,sea salt,self raising flour,green bell pepper
title: Chef Flower's Prawns (Shrimp) and Veggies
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 3 medium prawns ( uncooked large raw shrimp ) | 1 green bell pepper, chopped | 1/4 cup vegetable oil-cured cooking spray | 1 cup all-purpose flour | 1 teaspoon sea salt
instructions: Spray prawns lightly with cooking spray. Set aside on a plate, while preparing vegetables. Place green pepper, 1/4 cup vegetable oil spray, all purpose flour, and salt in a food processor and process until smooth. Add remaining oil/flour mixture and process again until mixture is a doughy consistency. Add more flour if required to form a soft dough. Cover and refrigerate dough for about 30 mins prior to shaping vegetables. Preheat oven to 200c. Place prawn in a large, shallow baking dish and cover with a sprinkling of water. Spray prawns lightly with cooking spray. Bake shrimp on a tray approximately 15 minutes until cooked through. Serve with vegetables.

title: Mexican Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 lb small pasta | 3 tablespoons canola oil | 1/2 cup applesauce | 1/4 cup taco seasoning | 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon italian seasoning
instructions: Boil 2 quarts of water. Add 2 tablespoons of the taco seasoning to applesauce, applesauce and vinegar. Mix in the canola oil and the rest of the taco seasoning. Drain pasta and add to mixture. Toss with the taco seasoning mixture in a large bowl. Mix in the last 1/4 teaspoon of the taco seasoning. Cover and chill for an hour.

Random Ingredients: thai chili sauce,apple cider vinegar,great northern bean,sumac
title: Easy White Bean Dip
ingredients: 1/2 lb great northern beans or 1/2 lb regular dry beans, washed and drained | 3 tablespoons apple cider vinegar ( or lemon, cider vinegar is really good ) | 1/4 cup thai sweet chili sauce ( or to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground sumac ( optional )
instructions: If using white beans, drain them and use elsewhere use the white beans instead of regular white beans. Drain the beans well and rinse them well. Toss with the rest of the ingredients except the sumac. I like to use the sumac.

title: Cranberry Nuts
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried cranberries | 1 tablespoon dried orange peel | 2 teaspoons ground cayenne pepper | 1 teaspoon chopped of fresh mint | 10 teaspoons dried minced apple
instructions: Place all ingredients in a fine mesh strainer and let sit at room temperature for 20 minutes. Use for cooking, salads or snacks.

title: Quick Chicken Queso With Creamy Queso
ingredients: 1 -2 bone-in chicken wing ( about 1 pound ) | 2 tablespoons tasman's sherry wine ( or to taste ) | 1 tablespoon brandy ( if you like it sweeter, try kikkoman ) | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne | sherry wine | 8 -12 tortillas | 8 -10 queso fresco ( see note below ) or 8 -10 mozzarella cheese, shredded ( see note below ) | 1 -4 tablespoon ketchup | 1 tablespoon crema
instructions: Note, if using wooden skewers soak them for one hour in cold water before using. If using wooden skewers, wash them well in warm water before using. If using wooden skewers, soak in cold water until using. Remove wings from bag, reserve wings for another use. Trim fat from wings, discard wing tips. Cut tips from wings.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,parsley flake,banana leaf,chicken meat,white sugar,salmon fillet,red wine vinegar,icing sugar
title: Salmon Wrapped in Banana Leaves
ingredients: 36 thick boneless salmon fillets, skin on | 2 cans chicken meat | 1 cup chopped banana leaf, packed | 4 teaspoons icing sugar, divided | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar, divided | 3 tablespoons white sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried parsley flakes | 24 thin slices bananas with a crust on
instructions: Place the salmon on a plate or baking sheet, and cut along the spine of the salmon to remove excess ribilage. Cut the salmon lengthwise through the tail end to make an x. Remove the flesh on the underside of the salmon flesh, and place into a 9x13 inch glass baking dish. Mix together the chicken meat, 2 tablespoons icing sugar, vinegar, white sugar, parsley flakes, remaining tablespoon icing sugar, and red wine vinegar in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: pumpkin seed,heavy cream,sirloin steak,egg yolk,yellow pepper,lemon,lavender
title: Lavender Beef Roll Ups
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin steak | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 2 egg yolks | 1 tablespoon fresh lavender, chopped or 1 teaspoon dried lavender | 2 tablespoons pumpkin seeds | 1 medium yellow sweet pepper, diced | 1/2 lemon, sliced thin
instructions: Cut beef into about 1 1/2 strips& set aside. Beat cream, yolks, lavender, pumpkin seeds& pepper in medium bowl til smooth. Stir in beef until thoroughly coated. Cover& refrigerate until mixture is firm enough to roll. If mixture is too dry, stir in a few drops of water. Roll mixture quickly, about 1 1/2 in diameter, and place on clean cutting board sprinkled with corn meal. Roll in cornmeal until completely coated. Repeat with remaining beef and stuffing. To serve, slice each roll lengthwise. Arrange meat on platter. Surround with lemon slices.

Random Ingredients: fish fillet,red onion,grain rice,corn oil,veal,red wine
title: Veal With Rice and Wine (Bok-Ye Ger-Mu)
ingredients: 500 g veal | 1 red onion | 400 g long-grain rice ( uncooked ) | 1/2 red wine | 400 g fish fillets ( such as sirloin steaks ) | 1 teaspoon corn oil
instructions: Cut the onion in half and dice it into thin half rings. Trim the meat. Cut the pork into bite sized cubes. Soak the rice and wine in water for half an hour, then leave to soak for another hour. Heat the oil in a wok or heavy pot over a high heat. Add the onion and stir fry for a minute or two. Add the meat and stir fry until the meat is light brown. Drain the meat. Turn up the heat under the pan, reduce the heat to low, cover and leave for 10 minutes. Add the rice, red wine and fish. Stir and leave covered for two minutes until the rice is nearly cooked. Serve.

title: Spaetzle (Veg*n Cheese)
ingredients: 8 -10 ounces mixed bok choy | 1 cup low fat cottage cheese | 1/2 cup white flour, sifted | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Remove the leaves from the bok choy and discard. In a big saucepan add the white flour, stir well with a large metal spoon. Add the water slowly stir until all the flour is absorbed. Do not add too fast it will stick. It will boil and burn. If it does, turn on a skimmer and stir constantly for 3 - 4 minutes. Cook noodles in boiling water for 3 - 5 minutes, drain and keep warm in a low oven. Place the mixed bok choy on the side to prevent them drying out. Put a bowl of cooked noodles, a portion of the mixed bok choy, some of the mixed cottage cheese into the bowl, and stir until mixed well. Do not go overboard with the mix or spoon in order to produce a homogeneous mixture with ingredients. You may add some additional flour if mixture is too dry.

title: St. Louis Country Style Beef
ingredients: 3 lbs extra lean ground beef | 1 can whole cherry tomatoes | 3 -4 st. louis saffron tablets, crushed
instructions: Mix the ground beef with cherries and saffron until well blended. Pour into a 1 gallon freezer bag or 1 gallon zip top plastic freezer bag with sides. Refrigerate overnight and the best result. This does need to be made the night before you plan this meal. Remove meat and place in freezer bags in the morning to chill thoroughly and bring to room temperature then heat to 250 - 325 degrees on a gas stove. When the temperature reaches 250 degrees, cover to store at least 3 - 4 hours and up to 6 hours. Bring to room temperature before cooking. Can also be used on the stove top to make a gravy in the crockpot.

Random Ingredients: orange blossom water,jasmine rice,steak,vegetable broth,cardamom seed,mint,pepper sauce
title: Orange Blossom Rice with Beef and Broth -- Balal E Bisi
ingredients: 1 1 lb flank steak, thinly sliced | 1 cup jasmine rice, rinsed under cool water | 1 tablespoon vegetable broth | 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 3 tablespoons orange blossom water | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1/4 teaspoon dried mint
instructions: Heat vegetable broth in pan over medium heat. Add sliced steak and allow to simmer for 3 - 4 minutes. Remove with slotted spoon and cool to room temperature. When cool enough to handle, cut beef across the grain in 1/4 inch strips. Toss rice with hot pepper sauce, fish sauce, oil, orange blossom water, and cardamom seeds in bowl. Fold in cooled beef, and serve.

title: Almond-Honey-Crispy Roasted Scallions and Greens
ingredients: 1 head escarole, washed and trimmed ( preferably with a good long green stalk ) | 1 cup half-and-half cream | 1 cup thickly sliced almond-honey-crispy roasted shallots such as paris al on a bed of rice or vegetables ( i prefer to use a combination of yellow and green ) | aluminum foil
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add the escarole and steam for approximately 15 minutes to steam tender and tender. Transfer to a bowl and let cool a minute or two. Cut off the tough tips and discard. Cut a cross in the core of the greens, then remove as many outer leaves as you can from the greens. Cut out the thickest part of the green root just around the stem, then slice it across the root into about 1/4 inch pieces. Cut out the hard root end as well as the tender green parts just around the stem. Cut out 4 smaller rounds of green and discard. Cut out remaining greens around the stem. In a large bowl, mix the half and half and 1 1/2 cups of cold water well. In a shallow baking dish lined with parchment, place one of the reserved greens leaves. Place one third of the slivered almonds in one layer in the dish, to glaze the bottom and to slightly cover the bottom of the dish. Scatter one third of the roasted green shallots over the almonds then place second layer on top. Top with one third of the roasted shallots. Sprinkle on more toasted almonds followed by the last third of the green greens, to glaze the top and to lightly cover the greens. Place in preheated oven and cook for approximately 25 - 30 minutes, until lightly browned. Remove from oven and let cool slightly. Cut into pieces to serve as a lunch or luncheon dish.

Random Ingredients: peel,cheddar cheese,part mozzarella cheese,tortilla,active yeast,nut,corn kernel,pasta
title: Nancy's Simple Veggie Loaf
ingredients: 1 packet active dry yeast | 2 cups frozen mixed peel, thawed drained, patted dry | 1 cup corn kernel | 1/2 cup shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese | 1/2 cup shredded reduced-fat cheddar cheese | 1/2 cup crushed nuts | 4 -5 large tortillas, warmed | 1/4 cup shredded reduced-fat sharp reduced-fat cheddar cheese | 1 -2 cup dry buttered wheat-milk sweet roll tortillas
instructions: Coat a 9x5x3 inch deep dish with cooking spray and set aside. In mixing bowl, combine all dry ingredients, blend well. Add all fresh ingredients and mix well. Add gluten free cheeses, mix well. Pour half the batter into prepared pan. Top with 1/3 of the shredded cheddar cheese. Dot with 1 or 2 tbsps of nut butter. Repeat layers with remaining batter and cheese, ending with nuts on top. Allow to sit at room temp until double, about 1 1/4 hours. Serve with warmed buttered, whole wheat tortillas and additional nut butter.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,consomme,vanilla essence,pita bread,savoy cabbage,pepper sauce,blue cheese
title: Cabbage and Blue Cheese Pockets
ingredients: 150 g savoy cabbage, finely shredded | 200 g blue cheese, crumbled | 2 -3 green cardamom pods, crushed | 200 g pita bread, small cubes | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1 -2 tablespoon hot pepper sauce | 1 tablespoon low-fat consomme
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, make sure all the ingredients are absolutely thoroughly mixed. Using a pastry brush, lightly brush the pita bread cubes with a little egg wash. Place the cheese on a separate dish, pour a little egg wash into the bowl and mix into the cheese. Add the sauteed cabbage to the cheesy cheese and mix for a minute. Do not mash the cabbage yet. Add the rest of the ingredient and mix in completely. Place the bag of the geeberts in the fridge to chill for a maximum of 3 hours. Serve on toast for a delicious snack.

title: Beer Chicken Empanadas
ingredients: 2 cups diced leftover cooked chicken | 14 ounces beer ( your favorite ) | 1/2 cup diced celery rib top | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 2 tablespoons finely diced sliced mushrooms
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. In a bowl add all ingredients except mushrooms. Toss lightly. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and place the empanadas in it. Cover with foil and bake in oven for 20 minutes, then uncover and bake another 10 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,crisp bacon,urad dal,red chilies,chicken,elbow macaroni,chicken thigh,golden raisin
title: Aarsi’s Ultimate Chicken and Macaroni
ingredients: 1 lb elbow macaroni ( or any other pasta you like ) | 1 lb chicken ( or equivalent ground meat ) | 1 turkey ( or equivalent ground beef, pork or pork ) | 1 slice crisp bacon ( or any other fat-reduced fat-sliced bacon ) | 1 red chilies ( use 2 if you like extra spice ) or 1 small chipotle pepper, chopped ( use 2 if you like extra spice ) | 1 handful golden raisin, chopped | 1 teaspoon dark brown sugar, to taste ( or splenda ) | 1 tablespoon red chilies ( optional ) | handful crisp bacon or pancetta or 2 -3 slices pancetta, chopped
instructions: Set your pasta water to boil.. This will ensure that the macaroni will cook according to the package directions. You can also set it aside for a moment to get the pasta cooked, it will be ready in just a few minutes. In the meantime, brown your meat on the grill. While meat is cooking, chop the bacon. When meat is done, slice it crossways into thin strips and slice the chilis or chipotle, depending on your taste. When the pasta is cooked, drain the water and reserve. Cook it al dente, it will be slightly hard and slightly undercooked but this is totally up to your preference. I have also used prawns just to save some cooking water. When the meat is fully cooked, put it back on the grill for about a minute or two, or until the skin starts to split. Do not overcook or the meat will continue to cook in sauce, as the pepper has already been known. Remove from grill and drain. Cut meat off of the back, if you are using ground meat. It does not have to be fully cooked but it has to be thoroughly cooked and not watery because it will evaporate in the sauce. In a large frying pan with a lid add extra virgin olive oil, and when the pan is warm add enough of the chilis/chipotle to coat the top of it. Fry it until it is sizzling and starts to sizzle. Add the brown sugar, garlic and bacon, and mix together. Cook about a minute before removing the pan from heat. Toss the meat and pasta together, add the raisins, and mix well. Dish out onto plates and top with the chopped bacon or pancetta.

Random Ingredients: plain flour,chive,ginger,savoy cabbage,pea,salt pepper,cream chicken soup,apple
title: Cabbage and Peas
ingredients: 8 cups shredded savoy cabbage | 250 g sliced peeled apples | 125 g frozen peas | salt and pepper | 250 g low-fat cream of chicken soup | 1 tablespoon plain flour | fresh chives ( optional )
instructions: Add the cabbage, apples, spices and cream to a large pan and stir over medium heat until the cabbage has wilted. Pour over the flour and stir well with a wooden spoon, cooking for 2 or 3 minutes. Add cream soup and simmer very gently for 5 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Cover and remove from the heat and garnish with chives if desired.

title: Rice, Mushroom & Chocolate Risotto
ingredients: 100 g dark chocolate | 50 g dark chocolate | 300 g fresh button mushrooms | 250 g arborio rice ( risotto ) | 1 celery rib, chopped | 100 g sliced dried apricots
instructions: Melt half the chocolate in a pan/simmer and leave until just melted. Remove from heat. Cut any dried mushrooms in half, keeping them fresh. Chop and place in a large pan with the rice, celery and chocolate. Add a small amount of boiling water to cover the ingredients, but do not stir. Bring to a boil, and then simmer for 20 minutes until all the liquid is absorbed. Remove from heat, stir in remaining chocolate and the apricots and serve.

title: Authentic Chowder
ingredients: 1 can white hominy, rinsed and drained | 10 small red potatoes, sliced thin | 1 teaspoon dried fenugreek leaves | 6 scallions, minced | 3 cups water
instructions: Mix hominy, potatoes, fenugreek, and scallions in large saucepan. Pour in water. Cover and simmer over low heat for 2 hours.

title: Crisco Buns
ingredients: 3 cups strong chow mein noodles | 1/4 cup crisco | dried onion (, rings, or scallions ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast
instructions: In large bowl, combine the first five ingredients. Let rest in a warm spot for 10 minutes, or until all the lukewarm mixture is absorbed. Knead 1 minute, or until smooth and elastic. Oil bottom of small mixing bowl, cover with a cloth, and set aside until yeast softens. Coat surface of dough lightly with crisco and lightly sprinkle dough with crisco. Dredge dough in crisco. Place seam side down on counter. Cover with cloth and let rise until light about 40 - 45 minutes. Meanwhile preheat oven to 350°f. Divide dough into ten parts. On lightly floured surface, roll each part like a jelly roll. Place each roll in the middle of a buttered and floured baking sheet about an inch apart. With floured hands, stretch and press each roll into a 12 inch circle, covering seams completely. Brush with crisco. Sprinkle tops with dried onions or scallions. Bake 40 - 50 minutes, until crust is lightly browned.

title: Southern Ham, Ham & Swiss Rollups
ingredients: 16 frozen ham rolls ( about 1 1/2 pounds total ) or 16 frozen pork roll ups ( about 1 1/2 pounds total ) | 24 ounces swiss cheese, cut into 24 1/2 inch chunks | 12 ounces pork tenderloin, cut into 24 1/2 inch slices | 24 ounces frozen sliced strawberries | 1 jar sliced pimientos, drained with some juice squeezed out | 1 jar sliced pickled onions, drained drained with some juice squeezed out
instructions: Bake in a preheated 350 f over for 1 hour, until lightly browned and heated through. Arrange the ham rolls, cheese, pork tenderloins, strawberries, pimentos and pickled onions on dinner roll wrappers, drizzle with remaining juice. Roll up tightly and freeze in bags. When ready to serve, remove one of the rolls from the freezer and place one piece on a plate. Add another piece of swiss cheese to the roll top and repeat process to make 20 rolls.

title: Simple & Healthy Chicken
ingredients: 2 chicken breasts, boneless, skinless, skin on | 1/2 - 2/3 cup chile, red and green parts or 1/2-2/3 red jalapeno pepper ( more or less to your liking )
instructions: Cut each chicken breast down the center bone, but leave it attached at the thick end so it will sit flat on your cutting board. Wash the chicken well under cold water. Wash your chicken well under cold water. You can use a plastic steamer to put them into a large pot of boiling water. I like to use a large pot to keep boiling my chicken while frying. Once the chicken is cooked and your steamer has reached the desired consistency, put the chicken in a bowl and allow to cool. If the mixture will start to cool, then you may turn off the heat. Remove the chicken from the freezer. Slice the chicken on the diagonal to desired thickness. You may put the chicken in a bowl, or let it rest awhile in the fridge, then refrigerate or freeze the pieces. When your ready to fry the chicken, put a large spoonful of oil or butter or margarine in a wide dutch oven or deep fryer at about medium to medium high heat. You want the oil to reach about 370 degrees f. The goal is to have a fairly dry pan. You want your pan to be approximately the smoking point. Turn your burner on to medium and wait until the oil shimmers, around 2 - 3 minutes. Now you can put the whole lot into the dutch oven and cook, flipping the lot over every couple of minutes or so, until it crisps up, about 4 - 5 minutes or so. It gets really nice and crisp and beautiful. Enjoy i love my chicken with this. You have to be very careful, because it is so hot. For me the chile is the key to the flavor. I use the chilies that are already cut in half or just a small piece of chili pepper. I fry them in the oil in the skillet over the chicken pieces like this, turning them over frequently, until they just sizzle and soften a little bit or put on top of each other a little bit more. Serve this over rice or noodles. Mmmmm, i really like these over fettuccine or spaghetti. Use a bowl of your choice to dunk the noodles into so yummy.

title: Crock Pot - Pork, Caribbean Style
ingredients: 1/2 lb pork tenderloin, trimmed | 1 bag baby lima beans or ( 16 ounce ) bag lima beans | 1 bag baby lima beans | 4 ounces sugar-free creme fraiche or 4 ounces triple sec | 2 tablespoons treacle | 1 tablespoon unsweetened dutch-processed cocoa or 1 tablespoon other non-dairy coffee creamer
instructions: Cut pork into 1/2 inch cubes. Layer the pork and beans in your crock pot. Mix all the other ingredients together and pour over the top of the pork and beans. Cook for 4 - 6 hours on high or low but for 2 hours or so on low.

Random Ingredients: curly leaf parsley,cardamom,red wine,five spice powder
title: Crock Pot Wine Reduction for Steak and Tastes
ingredients: 2 tablespoons five-spice powder | 1 cup red wine | 3/4 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1/2 cup curly leaf parsley, minced
instructions: In a bowl, stir together the five spice powder, wine and cardamom. Add the parsley and stir or shake well. Rub over the meat and place in a crock pot or covered dish. Cook on high for 4 hours. Turn the cooker to low and cook for 3 more hours.

title: Chili Pepper Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 lb toothpick | 1 lb meat, cooked cubed | toothpick | 2 packages farfalle pasta | 1 medium hot peppers or 1 small sweet chili pepper, seeded and sliced thin | 8 ounces bacon, uncooked sliced | toothpick | 1/2 lb bacon, cooked crumbled | roasted beet, drained | 1 bunch romaine lettuce
instructions: In large bowl, combine meat, salt and pepper to taste. Combine farfalle and bacon and shape into thin strips. Chill for 20 minutes. Arrange on plate and mound meat and bacon atop each spear. Garnsh with lettuce and hot peppers at the stem end, if desired.

title: Simple Mexican Chicken
ingredients: 1 medium onion | 1/2 cup peanut butter ( not fat free ) | 1 packet taco seasoning | 3 1/2 cups chicken bouillon | 1 bottle french dressing
instructions: Slice chicken into about 1/2 pieces. Place in crockpot add french dressing, onion, and peanut butter. Cook on high for 7 hours this is delicious as is, it takes more time in crockpot, but then the more time you need, the more flavorful it will be. Taste it and add more seasoning or hot seasoning.

Random Ingredients: beef stock,lime juice,lemon zest,yukon gold potato,baking potato
title: Le Poivre Potatoes - Spanish Potato Broth
ingredients: 1 kg baking potato | 2 lemons, zest of | 600 ml beef stock | lime juice | 2 large lemons | 1 kg yukon gold potato
instructions: Peel and dice potatoes and place in pan with beef stock and lime juice. Heat until boiling. Add zest. Cook on very low until potatoes are soft approximately 30 - 40 minutes. Add lemon juice and boil until potatoes are soft, about 10 minutes. Add lemons. Serve at once.

title: Tamari and Romaine Salad #Ragu
ingredients: 2 romaine lettuce | 8 large eggs | 2 celery ribs | 1/3 cup tamari
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Cut the ends off the romaine lettuce and separate those leaves so they will sit flat on the countertop. Remove the hard stem part from each leaf. You want the lettuce to be the shape of the block of romaine. Flip the leaf of romaine over and start pulling on the hard side of the leaf. Repeat with remaining lettuce leaves until done. Break the eggs into a large bowl and add the tamari. Dip the egg yolks in the egg whites. Add the lettuce and celery to your bowl and mix. The tamari is needed to flavor the salad. Top the salad with the rest of the tamari. It is very important that you use the tamari to bring out the flavor. It will turn the lettuce greenish from the egg yolks. Serve immediately.

title: Homemade Macaroni
ingredients: 225 g macaroni | 1 -2 tablespoon mixed spice ( or 2 tbs. cinnamon and 2 tbs. of ground cinnamon )
instructions: Rinse pasta. Place in pot of salted boiling water and boil until al dente, but do not overcook. Rinse in colander, drain and set aside. Place all ingredients with a fork in a mortar and crush them to a creamy consistency. The pasta should be slightly chunky or a little grainy by the time everything is finished cooking. Mix well and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,ice water,white bread,irish whiskey,alfalfa sprout,apricot
title: Danish Toast With Glazed Apricots
ingredients: 4 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil, plus extra | extra virgin olive oil | 3 slices white bread ( i use whole grain ) | 2 tablespoons dried apricots, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons fresh irish whiskey | 2 teaspoons ice water | alfalfa sprouts ( to garnish ) or spinach leaves, for garnish ( to garnish )
instructions: Set the oven to 300 degrees. Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a small saucepan over medium heat, add bread, and toast for 3 minutes, stirring and breaking up the bread with a wooden spoon. Remove the bread from the oven and increase the heat to medium, add the apricots, and stir gently to coat in the oil. Add 1 tablespoon of whiskey and stir until combined, then add the remaining 2 tablespoons of oil. Stir the mixture until it absorbed half the oil, then add the ice water. Return the toasted bread to the oven, and cook for 15 to 20 minutes, or until golden and crisp. Transfer to a plate and scatter with a little more whiskey. Note, if you like, garnish with the sprouts or spinach leaves, and serve with french fries.

title: Green Chile Pepper & Sponge Cake

instructions: Heat 2 teaspoons of oil in a skillet or frying pan over high heat. Sear the sponge cakes, one at a time, until browned and puffed up. Set the cake in a warm serving plate. Pile green chile peppers between the paper. Drizzle with olive oil and serve.

title: Bavarian Guava Dip

instructions: Slice avocados in halves or quarters lengthwise.

title: Spicy Mushroom Stock

instructions: Spray a 2 quart nonstick pan with cooking spray. Rinse the rice under running water until the water runs clear. title: Coco - Indian Dipping Sauce - Microwave Recipe

instructions: Put first 5 ingredients in a microwave safe bowl with a lid. Microwave till ingredients are mixed well and microwave for 2 - 3 minutes. Mix in miracle whip till well blended. Serve over plain rice to your choice of indian dishes. Enjoy.

title: Pesto Veggie Loaf
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups peanut butter | 1 1/2 cups chopped sun-dried tomatoes | 0.5 jar chopped fresh basil | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried oregano leaves | 3 1/4 - 5 lbs fresh broccoli | 1 1/2 lbs pepperoni | 3 1/2 lbs rye bread, sliced 1/4-inch thick for loaf | 1 lb fennel
instructions: Melt peanut butter in the microwave. Add chopped sundried tomatoes. Mix well. Pour over the broccobs of bread. Broil until bread is golden brown. Slice bread slices into 3/8 slices, about 1 1/2 feet thick, and layer the slices in a colander over a large dish. Spread hot peanut butter on top. To serve, place bread in the refrigerator until cool and warm, about 15 - 20 minutes. Place peppers, peppered pepperoni and cheese slices on top of cheese loaf and place under broiler for 3 - 5 minutes, or until cheese is bubbly. Note, for a thicker, creamier spread, place a layer of cornstarch and 1 cup of cold water in the bottom of the crock. Bring to a boil, remove from heat and add, stirring constantly over medium heat, 1 lb. Fresh cheese. Bring to a boil again, remove from heat, allow to cool for 10 - 15 minutes. In a food processor, combine 2 lbs. Fresh vegetables and 1 1/2 lbs. Pepperoni slices. Pulse until smooth or a soup like consistency. Stir in 1 cup of prepared pesto, 1 1/2 cups fresh basil, 1 1/2 tsp salt, 1 tsp. Oregano, 1 tbsp water and 1/2 teaspoon sugar. Pour over the bread and vegetables and mix all together. Sprinkle with remaining 2 tsp. Oregano and 1 tbsp. Mild flavored olive oil.

instructions: Boil pasta until al dente, drain and put on a heated greased grill. Add brewed espresso and mix well. Enjoy.

instructions: Place halibut fillets in a resealable plastic zipper bag. Cover with cilantro leaves and place in refrigerator. Drain, reserving liquid, and refrigerate while finishing sauce. instructions: Wash chard and trim. Cut leaves and the stalks from the chard. Cut cross wise into 3/8 inch lenghts. Wash stems and leaves well. Cut stalks, stalks, and leaves into 2 inch lengths. title: Turnip, Mango and Pork Sausage Stuffing.

instructions: Preferably a large, heavy based stockpot with a lid. Trim any excess fat from the meat, removing excess fat if it does. Cut the meat into very small, bite sized chunks. title: Lemongrass Smoked Salmon and Roasted Banana Salad

title: Pinchos

title: Pasta With Smoked Salmon

title: Asparagus Soup

instructions: Cut ends off asparagus spears with the tip of a knife and cut lengthways into pieces approximately 1/2 inch long by 2 inches wide. title: Tripe Stuffed With Pecorino, Cherry Tomatoes, and Oregano
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs of whole tripe, well trimmed of fat | 2 tablespoons whole coffee | 2 tablespoons freshly grated pecorino romano cheese | 6 tablespoons chopped roasted unsalted pistachios or 6 tablespoons lightly salted almonds | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh oregano leaves | 2 teaspoons ground mixed italian herbs with garlic ( or use dried ) | 1 teaspoon crushed dried mace | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil

Spread 2 tbsps of the chopped pistachios or almonds onto a baking sheet or tray and spread evenly over the top of the tripe. Set the tray aside in a warm spot. Heat the remaining 2 tbsps oil in a 12 inch nonstick frying pan over high heat. Sprinkle 1 tbsps of the grated cheese over the pistachios and toast, shaking the pan with tongs, until slightly golden. Sprinkle over the remaining two teaspoons of grated cheese. Working quickly, scatter the pieces of tripe on top of the cheese. When the cheese has melted it should be lightly browned and bubbly. Using a slotted spoon, remove the tray, cheese side up, with spatulas and a slotted spoon from the baking sheet. Set aside until cool. Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Brush the remaining oil into your pan, place the tripe on the pan, and surround with the tomatoes. Sprinkle with remaining two tablespoons of chopped pistachios, the oregano, mixed Italian herbs, the crushed mace, and finally, the remaining crumbled cheese. Bake the tripe for at least 30 minutes but preferably 45 minutes or up to 3 hours, turning the tray halfway through the cooking time. Totally cool before slicing. Serve with warmed italian bread for dipping..

instructions: Place the water, red chilli peppers, onions, and breadcrumbs in a bowl and mix well. Divide mixture between two oven proof plates. Slowly pour over boiling water until the mixture is just covered. Place under a hot grill to brown the base of the base. Turn the peperoncinis occasionally during cooking to avoid burning. Allow to cool, take a piece out and cut into strips. Serve with a wedge of fresh green, or scallion for garnish and or fresh chutney for dipping.

Random Ingredients: rigatoni pasta,plum tomato,button mushroom,turnip,ancho chili,chocolate chip,maraschino cherry
title: Rigatoni With Mushrooms and Chocolate Chips
ingredients: 8 ounces small rigatoni pasta or 8 ounces other tube shaped pasta | 4 plum tomatoes, thinly sliced | 4 ounces mixed mushrooms, thinly sliced | 6 medium turnips or 6 medium rutabagas, grated | 4 ounces semi-sweet chocolate chips | 1/8 - 1/4 ancho chili, stemmed, seeded and chopped ( if you like spicy or have deli pickled chili ) | 1/4 cup maraschino cherry, halved
instructions: Prepare the pasta according to the package directions. Meanwhile, place the tomato slices in a saucer, season lightly with salt, and set aside while preparing the rest of the components. Place ancho chilies in a pot of barely simmering hot water. Cook until aromatic, about 1 minute. Remove the chilies from the water with a slotted spoon and transfer them to a small bowl with hot water to cool. Drain the chilies thoroughly. Melt half of the chocolate chips in a large skillet over medium high heat, stirring often, until golden but not brown. Remove the melted chocolate from the skillet with a slotted spoon and set aside to cool. When the pasta is cooked al dente, drain it, and return it to the pot. Set the pasta aside. Pour warm tomato sauce over the pasta and sprinkle with remaining chocolate chips. Garnish with cherry halves and serve at once.

Random Ingredients: basmati rice,italian herb seasoning,tarragon,linguine,pine nut,thai red curry paste,taco shell,sesame seed oil
title: Thai Coconut Curry Mac
ingredients: 1 package linguine, cooked al dente | 2 tablespoons sesame seed oil | 6 cups fresh thai red curry paste ( i use thai kitchen brand ) | 28 ounces light coconut flavor tuna packed in water, drained and flaked ( 1 1/2 cups ) | 1/2 cup toasted pine nuts, chopped | 3/4 cup packed fresh basil | 2 tablespoons italian herb seasoning | 1 tablespoon dried tarragon
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. In a large bowl, toss cooked linguine with a tablespoon of sesame seed oil. Spread over a 13x9 baking dish. Bake 10 minutes – remove from oven and set aside. Heat remaining oil in a large skillet over med low heat. Add the red curry paste and cook 2 minutes. Stir in coconut and cook 1 minute. Add tuna and 1/4 cup water and cook 3 minutes, stirring until it begins to thicken. Stir in pine nuts, basil, and italian herbs. Serve warm with remaining cooked linguine. Sprinkle with remaining toasted sesame seeds before serving.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,egg white,beef brisket,bacon grease,jalapeno,ziti pasta,sriracha sauce
title: Beef Brisket With Ziti
ingredients: 1/2 beef brisket | salt and garlic salt | 4 ounces bacon grease, divided | 1 medium jalapenos ( or 2 jalapenos, seeded to taste ) or 1 medium serrano chili pepper, coarsely chopped ( or 2 jalapenos, seeded to taste ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons sriracha sauce ( or to taste ) | 8 ounces ziti pasta or 8 ounces penne pasta, cooked | 2 medium egg whites
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Season brisket with salt and garlic salt. Heat 1 tablespoon bacon grease in a large fry pan over medium heat. Place brisket and any accumulated juices in a large roasting pan, fat side up. Cover tightly and place in a preheated oven. Bake brisket until easily pierced with a fork, about 1 hour. Transfer roast and juices to serving platter. Boil water for ziti or pasta. Cook ziti and drain. Return to pot and stir in 1 tablespoon bacon grease. Cover and keep warm. Cook peppers until soft, then cut into strips. Heat remaining tablespoon of bacon grease in a skillet over medium high heat. Add peppers and chili and stir fry until peppers are tender. Serve beef with ziti and pepper mixture on top.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder,basil leaf,white fish fillet,ham,whipping cream
title: Pan-Fried Pork With Basil and Ginger
ingredients: 2 pork shoulder | 1 tablespoon basil leaves, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons white fish fillets | 2 tablespoons whipping cream | 4 slices ham
instructions: Place all ingredients except ham in a bowl and mix. Chill until you are ready to fry. Slice pork thin across grain, and add to mixture. Heat pan over medium heat and bring to simmering point. Cover and cook pork for 20 minutes. Transfer the pork to a serving platter. Thinly slice the ham and put on top of the pork. Serve with rice and garden vegetables.

Random Ingredients: angel hair pasta,stewing beef,lettuce,steak,chickpea,active yeast,green chilies
title: Beef & Chickpea Stoup (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, cut into 1 1/2-inch cubes | 1 can chickpeas, with liquid | 1 can green chilies, drained | 3/4 ounce active dry yeast | 1 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 10 cups torn up lettuce | 8 ounces angel hair pasta
instructions: Heat chuck on high in a large skillet. Add beef mixture, chickpeas with liquid, green chilies, yeast & 3 cups torn up lettuce. Cook on low heat, covered, for 6 - 8 hours or on high heat for 3 1/2 hours. Cook pasta until done, drain well and return to skillet. Stir to combine. Serve warm or warm.

title: Grilled Fish
ingredients: 1/4 ounce yeast | 1 lb whole red snapper fillet
instructions: In a large bowl mix yeast with 100 º lukewarm water. Cover and let stand for 12 hrs in a warm place. Rinse fish and dry well on paper towels. Lightly brush a grill over high heat. Grill fish 2 mins per side. Let brown a little. Wrap fish loosely and let rest for 15 minutes before serving.

title: Tacos al Pastor
ingredients: 1 lb salmon ( boneless, skinless and boneless ) | 1 tablespoon corn oil, plus more | corn oil, for brushing | 1 tablespoon turmeric | 4 tablespoons taco sauce | 1 tablespoon anise seed, crushed
instructions: Cut a slits in the salmon. Rub the salmon with 1 teaspoon of corn oil and sprinkle with turmeric, coating evenly. Let sit for 10 minutes. In a nonstick skillet, heat oil to about halfway to the smoking point. Add the fish and turn once, cooking for 2 minutes on each side. Tacos spread with taco sauce and place in a warm oven to crisp up slightly.

title: Homemade Tomatoes and Poached Tomatoes
ingredients: 4 pints cherry or 4 pints light italian tomatoes | 1 cup fresh flat-leaf italian parsley | 1 can tomato sauce, preferably italian style ( i use contadina brand with `` no-sugar '' )
instructions: In a large bowl combine tomatoes, parsley, and tomato sauce. Let sit overnight in the refrigerator for flavors to develop and blend. To serve transfer to a glassware or other clear glass bowl and serve warm, with crusty bread alongside.

Random Ingredients: red chile,dark sesame oil,serrano chili,chipotle pepper,coriander seed,chicken thigh,beef chuck roast
title: Sri Wasano
ingredients: 1 tablespoon coriander seed | 6 red chiles, stemmed | 1 serrano chili, stemmed | 3 chipotle peppers, stemmed | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1 tablespoon ground dried beef chuck roast | 3 pounds skinless, boneless chicken thighs
instructions: Heat a grill pan to 500 degrees f. Mix the coriander seeds, chiles, serrano chile, chipotle chile, sesame oil, and ground chuck roast together in a bowl. Place the chicken in the bowl, and gently toss to coat with the spice mixture. Oil a grill rack. Cook in the preheated grill until browned on all sides, about 10 minutes. Serve the chicken with the hot grilled pieces.

title: French Toast With Jicama
ingredients: 12 ounces gorgonzola | 1 1/2 cups marinara sauce | 1/2 cup french toast ( frozen or dry ) | 1 loaf french bread, cut diagonally thick ( such as texas toast ) | powdered sugar | 1 tablespoon butter or 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 2 tablespoons golden syrup
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°. To make the jicama syrup, in a small pot, melt butter and golden syrup over medium heat. Pour into a small bowl and stir in vanilla and golden syrup, stirring. Set aside. Cut french bread in half and then diagonally so each slice consists of 4 to 5 slices. Place slices in a large baking dish. Sprinkle with flour and lightly toss to coat. Bake for 12 - 15 minutes, or until crispy. To serve, top with jicama syrup, and serve hot or cold. Makes 4 servings.

title: Tarragon Mushroom Catsup
ingredients: 4 baby portabella mushrooms | 1 teaspoon tarragon | 1 pinch bicarbonate of soda | sea salt
instructions: Wipe the mushroom out with a damp cloth, and trim away the stems and bottom.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach leaf,chili paste,horseradish,plain flour,kiwi fruit,coconut oil
title: Sour Cherry Kebabs
ingredients: 500 g kiwi fruit, cheeks removed, peeled and chopped | 1 teaspoon chili paste | 1 tablespoon horseradish | 2 tablespoons desiccated coconut oil | 2 cups baby spinach leaves | 3 tablespoons plain flour
instructions: Place the kiwifruit, chili paste, horseradish and coconut oil into a food processor and process until smooth. Place the mixed baby spinach leaves onto a lightly flour lined baking tray and cover with a mixture of water and chilli paste. Pour the mixture into a bowl and gently press the kiwifruit mix into the spinach, ensuring the kiwifruit is coated.

title: Chile-Beef Kebabs
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin, cut into 1 inch cubes | 10 small black olives | 2 fresh red chile peppers, or to taste - seeded, stemmed, and diced ( wear rubber gloves ) | 2 teaspoons liquid smoke ( optional )
instructions: Place the beef cubes in a large bowl of cold water and refrigerate for 1 hour. Place the olives in another bowl of cold water, squeeze out excess water, and finely dice. Transfer the beef cubes to a bowl. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for about 20 minutes. Drain the beef through a strainer set over a bowl. Discard the olive water. Transfer the beef mixture to a cutting board and finely shred the beef with 2 forks. Stir in the red chile peppers. Form the pepper mixture into 4 kebabs. Set the skewers on a rimmed baking sheet coated with cooking spray. Brush the marinade on all sides of the beef. Allow it to marinate at least 2 hours or overnight, but no longer than 8 hours, brushing the beef cubes occasionally with the remaining marinade. Heat a grill pan or grill pan over high heat. Briefly grill the kebabs for about 5 minutes on each side, or to desired doneness.

Random Ingredients: purpose flour,oregano,peanut,butter lettuce leaf,bow tie pasta,beef steak
title: Beef Steak With Bow Ties
ingredients: 1 lb beef flank steak, cut into thin slices | 1 package bow tie pasta, cooked according to package directions and drained | 1/4 cup butter lettuce leaf | 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/4 cup chopped peanuts, toasted
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place steak on broiler pan. Bake in preheated oven 3 to 4 minutes or until instant read thermometer reads 160 degrees f. For sauce, combine lettuce, flour and oregano in a small bowl. Toss steak and lettuce with sauce to coat well. Bake beef and lettuce 5 to 7 minutes or until meat is fork tender. Sprinkle with peanuts.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper,sirloin steak,leg lamb,lime gelatin,french onion soup mix,cotija cheese,sauerkraut
title: Lamb & Sauerkraut Stuffed Kabobs
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried french onion soup mix | 1/2 package lime gelatin | 8 ounces sirloin steaks | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 8 ounces refrigerated french onion soup mix | 1 package coleslaw blend or ( 8 ounce ) package leeks, finely finely chopped | 1/2 cup grated cotija cheese
instructions: Mix french onion soup mix and lime gelatin in a large bowl. Cut both sides of the steaks in half, diagonally, if necessary. Spread a double layer of cheese onto each meat slice, place them on a microwave safe plate. Microwave sirloin on high for 2 minutes. Combine 1/2 of french onion soup mix with 3/4 cayenne pepper. Spread half of this mixture evenly over each steak, place on a double layer of cheese. Spoon half the onion soup mix evenly over each steak, place on a double layer of cheese. Microwave sauerkraut in microwave on high for 2 minutes, or until thickened. Spread remaining half the onion soup mix on top of the sauerkraut. Heat a griddle pan or barbecue for 5 minutes on each side, or until the cheese has melted. Remove from microwave. Serve with remaining cheese.

Random Ingredients: ham,fish sauce,cream,bread flour,extra virgin olive oil,chili pepper flake,yeast,cayenne pepper
title: Sweet and Sour Poached Ham Rolls
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg pork ham | 100 ml sour cream or 100 ml creamed cheese | 1 1/2 kg bread flour ( all purpose ) | 1 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon dried chili peppers flakes | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried yeast | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 teaspoon fish sauce | 1 1/2 - 2 liters full of boiling water
instructions: Make your sour cream filling by combining the sour cream or creamed cheese well. It's a bit of liquidy for this, but the cream stays rather runny. Mix all the other ingredients well, excluding the last tablespoon of the cream. I usually use my hands but you may need to mix with a knife or pestle if you use a spoon. If your sour cream is too thick for your taste, add a little more water or more cream. Dough can still be fairly liquidy, but should not rise above the bread flour mixture. Put a spoonful in the palm of your hand and form into a ball. Flour your hands well and make sure that they are well kneaded and not sticky. Leave to rise for 15 minutes or as long as possible. Preheat your oven to 220c/425f/gas mark 7 or 180c if you're using a fan forced oven. Line a tray with clingfilm. Make sure it fits well and you have a rectangle of aluminium foil that doesn't go into the oven. The water should just reach the middle of the oven. On the tray, spread your sour cream mixture thinly over your top. Take your foil and spread it out over the dough. Add your spring roll skin on top of the sour cream mixture. Place all your dried ingredients in a bowl and knead it into a dough using your hands or a big rolling pin. If it's too thick, add a little water. Roll the dough into long, thin slices, making sure they are flat enough on the edges. Put about a tablespoon of the filling onto the dough. Leave enough space on the dough so that the filling doesn't run off when you hit the dough with your thumb. Take the dough from the oven and put on top of the sour cream mixture. Roll around a rolling pin to flatten or stretch it like you would for your bread dough. Put the rolled out dough on the tray and leave for 10 minutes. Then turn and leave for another 10 15min so that the dough can get to room temperature. When the dough has become really firm, you can carefully lift it out of the tray. Leave it to sit for at least 1 hour. Pre heat the oven to 200c/400f/gas 1 or 180c if your oven won't allow this to happen. After 30 minutes, take off the oven and leave it for the bread to sit in the tray for 10 min. Once the bread has taken to the oven, start putting weights on the tray. Take a baking tray and put it in the oven. Cut your bacon into small pieces and fry until crispy, then put on a paper towel to drain.

Random Ingredients: half cream,allspice,maple syrup,cheddar cheese,kidney bean,garlic salt,coconut cream,oyster
title: Spicy Maple Kidney Bean Dip
ingredients: 2 cans kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 1/4 cup half & half cream | 2 cans coconut cream | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice | 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt | 3/4 cup shredded cheddar cheese | 1/4 cup chopped oysters
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the kidney beans, maple syrup, half and half cream, coconut cream, allspice, garlic salt, and cheddar cheese. Spread onto a 9 inch square pan, and bake at 375 degrees f for 30 minutes.

title: Mango Lassi (Mango Lassi)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups pure mangoes, peeled and roughly chopped, with juice ( about 3 pounds ) | 2 cups white wine or 2 cups apple juice | 2 green cardamom pods, lightly crushed and lightly bruised | 1 -2 cardamom, lightly crushed and lightly bruised
instructions: Place the mango, wine or apple juice, cardamom pods and freshly crushed cardamom to taste in a blender and pulse a few times until the mixture is finely ground to your desired consistency. Pour the liquified mixture into the ice block or tall container, cover and freeze. In your blender, combine the mango juice, wine or apple juice, and the crushed cardamom pods. Blend for 15 seconds or until smooth.

title: Strawberry Cream (Julia Child)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups heavy cream | 1 vanilla beans ( seeded and cut into 2 ) or 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | strawberry preserves, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Heat the cream in a heavy, heavy saucepan over medium low heat. When the cream begins to thicken, begin pouring in the vanilla bean pieces. As soon as the cream begins to boil, add the vanilla. Remove the vanilla bean from the cream and reserve.

title: Cheddar Keftedes
ingredients: 3 cups cooked chickpeas | 1 tablespoon anise seed | 4 pounds sirloin
instructions: Cover chickpeas with water, and bring to a boil in a large pot. Reduce heat to medium low, and simmer until tender, about 20 minutes. Drain in a strainer. Dry the sirloin slices with paper towels, and slice diagonally across the grain. Heat an iron skillet over medium high heat, and arrange the sirloin slices so that they make a fraction of an inch deep on the bottom. Sprinkle aniseed over the sirloin slices, then press aniseed into a small amount of the chickpeas to crack open the crackly top of the meat. Press aniseed into the meat again. Toast the aniseed, and place the sirloin halves into a heavy skillet. Cook and stir until the beef and sesame seeds are well browned. Serve the sirloin on a bed of the sesame flavored cheese flavored mashed potatoes, and pass around the dish. This recipe uses an oil flavored, whole wheat flour, and bran flavored vegetable bran flavored bouillon, respectively. The flavor belongs in the arabian bread maker.

title: Roasted Sun-Dried Tomato Vinaigrette for Pasta and Seafood Dinner
ingredients: 2 tablespoons extra-virgin all-purpose flour | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, minced or 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato salad oil | 1/4 cup balsamic vinaigrette, such as good seasons
instructions: Combine the flour and 1/2 t oil in a small bowl. Stir in the reserved sun dried tomato oil until well combined. Dip a 12 inch salad dish into the vinaigrette and arrange into layers or a 3 1/2 to 4 pounder. Add the remaining oil to the dish. Place a large platter over the vinaigrette and let stand at room temperature for at least one hour to develop its flavor before serving.

title: Italian Sprout Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup oriental sesame oil | 2 tablespoons vinegar | 2 tablespoons vanilla sugar | 1 tablespoon lentils ( red/ or green ) | 1 cup bean sprouts ( fresh ) | 1/4 cup bean sprouts, fresh
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl. Refrigerate until needed to serve.

title: Gran's Chicken Burgundy
ingredients: 12 boneless chicken breasts ( or other cuts of pork or chicken ) | 2 -3 1/2 pints cherry tomatoes ( or other large cherry peppers ) | 4 parsnips ( or other large chunks ) | 1/2 cup dried marsala wine | 2 lbs bread
instructions: Grill or broil the chicken to your liking, slice thin and arrange in layers on platter.

Random Ingredients: canola oil,cranberry juice cocktail,chicken broth,egg substitute
title: Cranberry Egg Drop Soup
ingredients: 1 can fat free chicken stock or 1 can reduced fat chicken broth | 1 can frozen egg substitute or 2 egg whites of regular size | 1 can cranberry juice cocktail, reserve juice for egg wash | 1 teaspoon canola oil
instructions: Bring the chicken broth to a boil in a 2 quart saucepan. Add the remaining ingredients to the saucepan. Heat on low, stirring occasionally. Remove the mixture from heat and allow to come to room temperature. Pour the liquid through a colander to drain excess juice but do not use immediately. Pour back into the saucepan. Reheat broth and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chunky salsa,olive oil cooking spray,puff pastry
title: Mini Chimichurri Rolls
ingredients: 1 sheet frozen puff pastry, thawed | olive oil flavored cooking spray | 1/2 cup thick & chunky salsa
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Spray a 12 inch non stick skillet with cooking oil. Roll out the pastry sheet on a lightly floured work surface into a 14x7 inch rectangle and brush with some of the olive oil. Sprinkle with salt & pepper to taste. Using your fingers, spread a scant 1 tablespoon of chunky salsa over the top of the pastry round. Lay another pastry round on top & brush lightly with more of the olive oil. Cover with a damp towel & refrigerate for 20 minutes. Cut into four 1x1 inch rectangles. Scoop your filling into your pastry shells & arrange on a baking sheet with a little of the salsa. Bake for 8 minutes or until well puffed and golden. Serve immediately.

title: African Curry Dessert - Rice Cooker
ingredients: 1 cup dried garbanzo beans | 1 1/2 cups water | 1/2 - 1 lb medium uncooked shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1/2 cup creamy peanut butter | 1 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: Put beans and water into rice cooker. Set to rice cook. When cooked, remove from rice cooker. Add shrimp and peanut butter. Add spices, stir.

title: Cheese Fondue
ingredients: 1 cup smoked gouda cheese ( i use kraft deli shredded parmesan cheese in a jar ) | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Place all ingredients in a fondue pot. Simmer on medium heat. Keep on keep stirring. Keep warm until fondue starts to boil. Serve warm with your choice of accompaniments such as french bread, saag or butter.

title: Mmmm Rice (M'gham)
ingredients: 2 cups basmati rice | 1/4 cup dried onion flakes
instructions: Note, to dry the onion flakes in the water, place a large cast iron fry pan over high heat for 1 - 2 minutes or until fragrant. Add the dried onion flakes to the pan which should be dry and not browned. Drain the rice and add to pan. Add the dissolved onions into the pan. Stir all ingredients very gently. Reduce the heat to high and cover. Cook 20 - 23 minutes or until rice is cooked.

title: Herbed Corn Salad
ingredients: 1 can corn, drained | 3/4 cup light tamari | 1/4 cup fresh dill pickle, grated | 1 teaspoon anchovy, minced | 1/4 teaspoon fresh herb, finely chopped ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 cup cool whip topping, your favorite store brand
instructions: Combine all ingredients and allow to sit at room temperature for 2 hrs to allow flavors to combine. Serve chilled.

title: Sicilian Style Yummy Pepper, Cheese and Almond Milk Salad
ingredients: 1 lb mild red peppers such as red bell pepper, cut into 1-inch squares ( australian ) or 1 lb hot yellow pepper, cut into 1-inch cubes ( australian ) | 1/2 - 3/4 lb green bell pepper, cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 cups firm white cheddar cheese, shredded | 4 tablespoons sunflower oil | 2 tablespoons caster sugar ( superfine ) ( optional ) | 1 can condensed light almond milk | 2 1/2 tablespoons granulated sugar beans, thawed drained
instructions: Heat a medium sized heavy based saucepan over medium heat for 2 - 3 minutes. Add the red pepper and green pepper, and cook, stirring continuously, for 4 - 5 minutes until soft. Remove the stem/skin from the peppers and peppers and place the peppers in a large bowl. Add the cheese, sunflower oil, caster sugar and drained almonds, toss well to combine. Serve on a bed of lettuce leaves alongside the salad.

title: Poblano Enchiladas
ingredients: 2 poblano chiles | 2 tablespoons chopped scallions | 1 teaspoon instant tea
instructions: Blend the chiles with a blender or food processor. The mixture should be somewhat liquid but not completely smooth. Blend in the scallions. Heat oil about 1 - 2 inches deep in a large nonstick skillet. Spoon 1/3 of the bean mixture, or just enough for filling, into the center of a tortilla. Roll up and place seam side down in the skillet. Repeat with remaining filling and tortillas. Pour the enchilada sauce over the enchiladas.

Random Ingredients: white bread,brie cheese,cream celery soup,cream mushroom soup,lemon juice,spice,rye bread,chili
title: Bready Chippie Dip
ingredients: 8 loaves white bread, crust removed | 2 packages brie cheese, cut into 1-inch cubes | 20 slices rye bread | 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 teaspoon lemon juice | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1/2 teaspoon chili | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon mixed spice | 1/2 loaf thin pretzels, crispened or 1/2 loaf crisp cooked swiss cheese, sliced in half diagonally
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Spray a 9x13 baking dish with no stick cooking spray or grease with nonstick spray. Place four slices of bread crosswise in baking dish. Top with the remaining four slices of bread and cover with foil. Bake for 15 minutes or until topping is bubbly and bread is brown. Serve with garnishes.

title: Grumpy Blueberry Parsnips
ingredients: 5 parsnips | 3 green onions | 3 cups blueberries ( fresh or frozen ) | 1 tablespoon instant bouillon
instructions: Peel parsnips and cut into 1 chunks. Thinly slice green onions, place in pot and stir for about 8 minutes. Add bouillon and boil for about 3 minutes. While boiling, peel and seed blueberries, add to soup, reduce heat to simmer, cover and cook for about 10 - 45 minutes. Don't overcook, this is delicious when there are no sign of chunks and the soup is not too thick. Serve with crusty bread.

title: Lazy Manhattan Clam Chowder
ingredients: 3 quarts clam juice, from canned clams ( not fresh from can ) | 1 can guinness stout | 1 teaspoon lemon zest | 1 teaspoon dried red chili pepper flakes, crushed | 1/4 teaspoon celery seed | fresh ground black pepper | 6 ounces shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: In a large saucepan combine garlic, clam juice, guinness, zest, chili flakes, celery seeds, and pepper.
