title: Soy Chilli Pasta With Tomato Chilies Filling
ingredients: 400 g shell pasta | 450 g tomatoes and green chilies | 1 inch gingerroot, grated | 250 g shrimp ( canned or from the can ) | 1/2 teaspoon sugar | 2 tablespoons coriander leaves, minced | 2 tablespoons parmesan cheese, grated
instructions: Wash and deseed the chillies, and slice them into thin rounds. Slice the tomatoes into 2 3cm pieces and deseed and de vein them, reserving shells. title: Date and Walnut Tortilla Pizzas

instructions: Preheat oven to 425°. Combine dates, soup mix and half and half in a small saucepan. Bring to boil over medium heat, stirring frequently.

title: How to Make French Croutons

Pat it completely into a 1/2 inch thick round. Dust lightly with flour, roll out into a 1/4 inch thick rectangle, and cut into 5 1/2 inch slices. Place the slices, 1 1/2 apart, on a parchment lined baking sheet. Using a sharp knife, score an x on top of each bread strip. Bake 40 minutes in the preheated oven, or until the bread is lightly browned and the tops are golden.

title: Dried Mushrooms (Low Fat)
ingredients: 1 cup plain yogurt ( plain! ) | 1 tablespoon thum's garlic sauce | 8 large dried mushrooms
instructions: Pour yogurt into a small mixing bowl.

title: Beef or Chicken Sandwich
ingredients: 1/4 lb cooked beef sirloin, chopped | 1/8 cup dried cherries, halved | 1 french bread or 1 italian bread, cut diagonally in 1/2 | 6 -8 large soft fresh ladyfingers | 1 -3 tablespoon french hot dog bun ( homemade or store bought )
instructions: Combine beef and cherries. Slice bread and arrange on bread, top each with meat mixture. Serve with hot french rolls or french rolls sandwiches.

title: Italian Sausages
ingredients: 1 lb sweet sausage | 2 tablespoons minced yellow onions | 2 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 1/2 cup mirin | 1 loaf french bread or 1 loaf italian bread, cut into 6 slices
instructions: Cut sausage into 1/4 inch slices and brown in a large skillet over medium heat with the onions. Remove from heat and stir in the flour and mirin until well blended. Return to medium heat and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly. Remove from heat, cover and refrigerate 4 hours or overnight. Preheat grill.

title: Homemade Beef Stock
ingredients: 2 pounds beef stew meat, cut into 1-inch cubes | 3 leeks | 1 teaspoon ground italian seasoning
instructions: Wash and cut leeks, or leeks, into thick rings. In a large pot with just enough water to cover, toss the stew meat with the leeks, italian seasoning, and about 1 teaspoon of salt. Bring the to a boil and cook for 1 hour, skimming frequently and adding more water as needed. Remove to a food processor or blender, cool briefly, and store in a tightly closed freezer container.

title: Sweet Potato-Eggplant Lovers' Pasta With Maple-Saffron
ingredients: 2 lbs sweet potatoes, peeled, cut on a diagonal into 1/8-inch slices | 1 -2 medium red curry paste, to taste | 1 lb eggplant, cut into 1/2-inch rounds | 1/2 lb yukon gold potato, scrubbed and cut into 1/2-inch slices | 1/2 lb anchovy fillet, drained, minced | 1 1/2 teaspoons saffron | 12 ounces linguine | 1 1/2 cups maple syrup
instructions: Place slices in a steamer and cover with a pot of boiling water. Bring water back to a boil, then simmer for 3 - 5 minutes. title: Guilt Free Yogurt Rice and Chicken
ingredients: 300 g plain flour | 50 g brown basmati rice | 2 1/4 cups yogurt ( full fat or low fat depending on taste ) | 4 teaspoons salad oil | 2 teaspoons salad oil | 2 -3 chicken parts, cooked shredded | 1 1/2 teaspoons guacamole, to serve
instructions: Place the flour in a bowl and make a well in the centre. Add the rice and mix until it starts to resemble breadcrumbs. Combine the yoghurt and oil in a separate bowl. title: Pears Poached in Poultry Dust

instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon of cracked wheat with 1 tablespoon of cracked wheat and 1 teaspoon of cracked wheat together the flour and cracked wheat. instructions: Cut the bread 3/4 thick. Heat cream.

instructions: Stir together salsa, chile powder, fruit preserves, rosemary, fennel, and cocoa in a medium bowl until well combined.

title: Taco Parsnips

instructions: Preheat oven. Cut parsnips into chunks or chunks. Pour enough boiling water over to cover. Put in an ovenproof dish. Stir fry until parsnips are tender. title: Meatless Spinach Salad.
ingredients: 1/2 kg spinach leaves | 2 lbs meat, of your choice | 1 jar roasted cashews | 10 large pistachios | 6 tablespoons golden brown sugar | 1 tablespoon salad oil | 1/2 teaspoon italian seasoning or 1/2 teaspoon crushed italian seasoning | 1/4 cup brandy
instructions: Remove any excess oil from the meat and cut into bite sized pieces. Chop the cashew nuts as well as the spinach leaves into chunks or slices. Fry in the oil until golden brown. Drain on kitchen paper. Bring 2 litres of water to the boil and add the meat and cashew nuts. Bring back to the boil and turn off the heat. Leave overnight. Drain the meat from the fridge and put into fridge. Take meat out of fridge. Get rid of as much water as you can. Drain meat from the fridge. Heat the brandy in a pot. Turn on the heat and allow to simmer until meat is tender. The meats should have a nice thick sauce. You might need to increase the heat a tablespoon or two to ensure everything is simmering at the same time. You don't want it to burn. When the beef is tender you may add the brandy and leave until it is time to throw it away. Add the nuts to the meat and toss well. Serve the salad on a plate with a sprinkling of basil and parsley.

title: Swiss Almond Smoked Brisket
ingredients: 1 beef brisket, about 1 1/4 lbs. ( any brisket will work but adds a lot of flavour ) | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Remove excess fat, then rub the brisket with almond extract. Place brisket in a roasting pan or open roasting pan. Let the brisket rest for about 1 hour. Transfer brisket to a roasting sheet. Cover loosely with aluminum foil and roast in a 300°f oven, or until almost tender. Slice brisket, if desired.

title: Brazilian Doneness Steak Wrap
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin, sliced crosswise 1/2-inch thick | 1/2 cup onion, thinly sliced | 1 canned artichoke hearts, chopped | 1/3 cup fresh mint leaves | 3 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa | 1 teaspoon sugar | 2 tablespoons ice water | tortilla
instructions: In a large skillet, cook steak, onions and artichoke hearts over medium high heat until steak is no longer pink in center, about 5 to 7 minutes. Transfer to a cutting board and let stand 5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer to cutting board and let cool about 15 minutes, then slice into thin strips. Add cocoa, sugar and 1/2 cup water and stir until mixed. Add steak strips and toss well. Place wrap, seam side down, on serving plate. Garnish with tortilla and snipped mint leaves.

Random Ingredients: corn tortilla chip,potato,cream mushroom soup,pinto bean,turmeric,peppercorn,italian tomato
title: Papas Huancaina
ingredients: 2 lbs sweet potatoes, peeled, chopped | 4 cups canned pinto beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 can italian-style diced tomatoes | 1 tablespoon turmeric | 1 tablespoon peppercorn | 1 gallon corn tortilla chips
instructions: Combine potatoes, beans, soup, tomatoes, turmeric, peppercorns, and water in crock of crock pot. Cook on low for 8 hours. Serve over tortilla chips.

title: Spiced Pork Tenderloin Rolls
ingredients: 3 lbs pork tenderloin, trimmed of all visible fat and patted dry | 1 cup chicken chunks | 1 package frozen puff pastry sheets, thawed | 1 package multigrain bread, breads, cut into 4 even slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Place pork tenderloins and chicken chunks on a sheet of aluminum foil. Drizzle each with 1 tb of the prepared chicken sauce. Place bread slices on top and press lightly with a spatula. Wrap tightly with the foil, being careful to seal completely. Place in a shallow baking pan. Roast 25 minutes, then remove foil. Serve with reserved sauce.

title: Tunn-Otaki With Mushrooms
ingredients: 20 -24 mushroom caps | 1 lb prosciutto, cut into 1/4-inch slices | 2 tablespoons fresh tarragon, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place mushrooms and prosciutto slices on one side of a heavy baking sheet and spread evenly with tarragon. Place baking sheet and parchment paper on top of mushrooms keeping them from drying out. Bake for 8 - 10 minutes. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: greek yogurt,no salt tomato,gin,bean,curry powder,white flour,mayonnaise,yellow rice
title: Indian Rice Salad Mix
ingredients: 2 cups cooked white flour ( or whole wheat flour ) | 2 cans no-salt-added whole tomatoes, with liquid | 1 package yellow rice | 6 cups fat-free mayonnaise | 1 container fat-free greek yogurt ( see note in description ) | 1/2 cup fat-free mayonnaise | 2 teaspoons curry powder | 1 can fat-free refried beans
instructions: Note, it says fat free, so no substitutions. You should be able to eat the amount of rice used when not using. I do not know, because my kids don't like my rice. However, i'm sure my mom can use any type of rice used. You should have a nice thick consistancy of jalapeno, celery, and chive. For the rice salad mix. Combine the ingredients for the rice salad. If you like extra dressing, add a little to the rice salad after it has been mixed. It does not matter if it's a little more liquidy. It does come together a little but i like it smooth. Pour over the rice. I prefer the rice salad. If you use whole wheat flour, it will absorb less of the liquid. This is not a health thing. You really need to do something by your own method. Use white flour if you like the salad. Remember, the rice salad mixture contains very little water and mayonnaise. You can make this into a sandwich, but the texture should be runny, not something you would eat by itself just the way it is. For me, a simple salad salad, we mix everything very well, and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: whipping cream,egg noodle,green onion,chuck roast,button mushroom,guajillo chilies,clove,no salt tomato sauce
title: Tex Mex Beef With Noodles
ingredients: 2 lbs chuck roast | 3/4 lb button mushroom ( i use a mixture ) | 1 cup whipping cream | 1 can no-salt-added whole tomatoes with hot sauce | 1 cup guajillo chilies, fresh in the pod, seeded and chopped | 3 -4 green onions, sliced | 1 can no-added-salt tomato sauce | cooked egg noodles
instructions: Place roast in a slow cooker along with 1 cup whipping cream. Cover and cook on high for 6 to 8 hours or on low for 8 to 10 hours. Allow a little over 15 minutes before slicing into strips. After removing from slow cooker and shredding with two forks, place the meat back in crockpot with remaining 1 cup whipping cream. Add 2 cups of mushrooms and tomatoes and season to your taste. Cover and cook for 15 minutes on high. Serve over hot cooked egg noodles.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt black pepper,red bell pepper,cream chicken soup,rice paper,green bell pepper
title: Cheater's Indian Spring Rolls
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 4 green bell peppers, seeded and chopped | 1 red bell pepper, seeded and chopped | 2 cups hot cooked rice noodles | kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Mix the soup and green bell peppers in a bowl. Cover, and refrigerate. When ready to serve, fluff noodles with a fork. Season with salt and black pepper, and dip in soup mixture. Allow to cool before serving.

Random Ingredients: maple syrup,red wine,leek,green chilies,cannellini bean,hungarian paprika,cream mushroom soup,kernel corn
title: Chunky Hungarian Chicken
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs chicken pieces | 2 cans cannellini beans ( white kidney beans or great northern beans ) | 1 jar whole kernel corn, drained | 1 cup dry red wine ( or a combo ) | 1 cup maple syrup | 4 cans chopped mild green chilies | 1 cup sour cream or 1 cup light sour cream | 1 tablespoon sweet hungarian paprika
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Cut chicken up into pieces. Combine all ingredients and pour over chicken. Cover and bake for 1 - 1 1/2 hours.

title: Peanut Oil and Chili Jam
ingredients: 100 g peanut oil | 200 g golden caster sugar | 1 dried chili
instructions: Heat the oil in a heavy pan. You want to make sure it reaches 80cm/169°f/4 1/2 in size. Remove from heat when it drops to the surface of the oil and pour onto a large heatproof bowl. Add the sugar and chili and mix until dissolved. Cool until lukewarm. Once mixture is cold, pour into clean jars and seal immediately, use a litle less water if needed.

Random Ingredients: pizza crust,triple sec,jumbo pasta shell,brussels sprout,black olive,cornflour,quinoa
title: Mexican Stuffed Shells
ingredients: 3 quinoa, grains separated | 4 fresh brussels sprouts | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 4 tablespoons triple sec | 2 tablespoons black olives, chopped | 1 pizza crust, pre-made, perferably low-fat | 1 cup quinoa, perferably low fat | 14 ounces jumbo pasta shells
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Place the quinoa grains in a medium saucepan with 4 c water and bring to a boil. Cover and cook for 10 minutes or until cooked and liquid has been absorbed. Chop the brussels sprouts, divide among the 4 hollowed out shells in a circular arrangement so that they cover the bottom of each hollowed out shell with a little olive. Put 1 tablespoon of cornflour in each hollowed out shell and a tablespoon of triple sec to each. Add the olives and chopped pasta and mix to combine. Stuff the stuffed shells with the quinoa shells and bake for 20 minutes or until the pasta has just cooked and they are cooked through. Serve with lots of salsa, guacamole and chips.

title: Homemade Coriander Mustard
ingredients: 25 coriander seeds | 1/2 cup malt vinegar
instructions: Rinse the coriander seeds and remove any hard, dark spots. Place 1/2 cup of whole coriander seeds into a dry frypan and toast over medium heat for about 3 minutes, or until fragrant. Cool completely then coarsely chop seeds using a mortar and pestle or food processor. Place remaining coriander in a small dry frying pan and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, for about 1 minute, or until fragrant. Stir in the mustard seeds and allow to dry slightly before adding remaining coriander seeds and vinegar. Simmer until mixture is reduced to desired consistency, adding water if necessary. Allow to cool completely before storing in a sterilized bottle.

title: Mango Chutney Spread
ingredients: 400 g mango chutney | 1 sprig thyme | 1/3 cup grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Place all ingredients in a food processor and process to smooth. Serve with crackers or toast.

Random Ingredients: baking cocoa,black eyed pea,chipotle pepper adobo sauce,onion flake,red bell pepper,caster sugar,beef
title: Black-Eyed Peas (Beef, Chipotle and Pepper) Stew
ingredients: 1 teaspoon baking cocoa | 1 teaspoon caster sugar ( fine julienne ) | 125 g ground beef | 1 small red bell pepper | 1 small onion | chipotle pepper in adobo sauce, roughly chopped ( can used a little chipotle chile powder ) | 1 can black-eyed peas

title: Cashew, Pumpkin and Cauliflower With Nuts
ingredients: 1/2 lb uncooked farfalle pasta | 1 cauliflower | 4 ounces semisweet chocolate chips | 1 lb pumpkin nuts ( shelled or not ) | 1 lb unsalted cashews
instructions: Cook pasta according to package instructions. Rinse with cold water and drain. Trim and cut cauliflower into thin florets. Place 1 1/2 cups water in a saucepan, cover and bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer over low heat 10 minutes. Remove from heat and add chocolate chips, stirring until melted. Stir in pumpkin nuts, adding cashews. Set aside. Add cooked pasta to skillet and coat with nut mixture. Serve warm, with basil and fresh french bread.

Random Ingredients: ketjap manis,chipotle chile,chive,chunky salsa,anise seed,onion salt

instructions: Mix salsa and chilies together. Add remaining ingredients and blend thoroughly. Refrigerate before serving.

title: Faux Chilaquiles
ingredients: 1 can artichoke, drained | 1 package frozen broccoli, thawed and drained | 1/2 cup corn kernels, thawed | 8 slices mexican blend cheese | 1 shallot, finely chopped | 1/2 cup cake flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a large bowl, combine corn and chiles. Toss with vegetable mixture, cheese and shallot. Mix flour into mixture. Line baking sheet with parchment paper. title: Easy Marmalade (Aussie)

instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a small saucepan. Bring to the boil then lower the heat and allow to simmer, stirring occasionally for 20 minutes. Cool the mixture to room temperature. Store in the refrigerator in a dark container. Serve at room temperature.

Spread 1 teaspoon of the vegetable mixture onto each taco shell. Fill with desired amount of vegetable mixture, and bake at 375 degrees f for 7 - 9 minutes.

ingredients: 2 cups chinese sweet rice vinegar | 1/2 cup quick-cooking spray | 3 tablespoons grainy mustard | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained, cut in half crosswise, and cut lengthwise into 1/2-2-inch strips | kosher salt | 1/4 cup cornhusks, dry or unhusked, rolled and torn into pieces

title: Grilled Asparagus With Yogurt

Let set for 15 minutes, cut into 8 pieces, serve on a platter with sour cream and salsa.

instructions: Cook the fettuccine as directed on the packet. Drain the pasta. Meanwhile, combine the vinegar, garlic, eggs, sage, and black pepper to make a dressing. Drain and add the vinegar dressing to the pasta and toss. Serve immediately.

title: Spinach With Apricot Apricot
ingredients: 1 cup apricot brandy or 1 cup brandy, rum | 1 tablespoon coriander powder | 200 g fresh spinach leaves | thyme, to taste

title: Simple Spaghetti Squash Stuffed With Smoked Salmon

title: Skewered Vegetables

instructions: Place everything in a large saucepan and bring slowly to the boil, stirring occasionally. Reduce heat to very low and cook until thickened 15 - 20 minutes.

instructions: Place tenderloin on a sheet of aluminum foil. Combine bread crumbs and pepperoni.

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In the medium bowl of a stand mixer, sprinkle yeast over 1/2 cup warm yellow bell pepper strips.

instructions: Chop all ingredients evenly. Set aside while making the sauce. In a saucepan, place everything except for the pimiento, oregano& maple syrup. instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f spray 11x16 inch baking dish with nonstick spray. In medium bowl, combine maple syrup, barbecue sauce, and meat. title: Mango Clove Dipping Sauce

instructions: Pour soup, mango juice, red wine, clove studded basil, and basil into a blender, and puree to your preferred consistency. Transfer to a bowl, and stir in sugar if desired.

title: Warm Potato Salad With Hazelnut Dressing

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add lentils, saute 5 minutes.

instructions: Cook and stir canadian bacon in a microwave for about 10 minutes on high, or until no longer red. Stir pumpkin puree into bacon and olives. Season with celery salt and serve.

instructions: Place shredded cabbage in a bowl and sprinkle with rosemary. Serve at once.

Alternatively, you can spread the lettuce evenly over one half of the bunri and top with remaining bunri. Drizzle with extra olive oil and serve.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk,navel orange,tofu,swiss cheese,potato,soy sauce,jalapeno chile,almond
title: Coconut Tostadas
ingredients: 5 potatoes, peeled and cut into bite-size chunks | 2 tablespoons soy sauce, or as needed | 1 package firm tofu, cubed | 1 can coconut milk | 2 jalapeno chiles, finely chopped | 1 navel orange, sliced | 8 slices swiss cheese, or as desired | 1/4 cup toasted slivered almonds, or as desired
instructions: Bring a dutch oven of water to a boil, and cook potatoes with soy sauce until tender, about 12 minutes. Drain water. Place tofu, coconut milk, jalapenos, orange slices, and cheese in a saucepan over low heat, and bring to a simmer until cheese has melted, 5 to 10 minutes. Remove the tofu mixture from heat, and mix in toasted almonds. Heat in microwave 30 seconds, or until hot throughout.

Random Ingredients: saffron,penne,orange,feta cheese,pesto sauce,rosemary sprig,rice noodle,chicken tender
title: Mediterranean Chicken Pasta
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs chicken tenders | 1 orange, juice of | 1 tablespoon pesto sauce | 2 tablespoons rice noodles | 1/4 lb penne | 1 pinch saffron | 1 sprig fresh rosemary sprig, for garnish | 3/4 lb feta cheese, cut into 1/2 inch cubes, for garnish ( or crumbled feta cheese )
instructions: Preheat oven to in a roasting pan put orange juice, pesto, and pasta. Add the chicken tenders, stir well to coat, and sprinkle with saffron. Drizzle the entire pan with olive oil. Bake about 25 minutes. During last five minutes of baking, sprinkle the fresh rosemary sprig over the chicken. In a sauté pan heat feta on medium heat until it just begins to turn golden, and the feta slightly brown. Stir in the hot cooked pasta, and cover. Bake 45 minutes or until pasta is al dente. Drain pasta and chicken well, and toss with the hot cooked pasta. Sprinkle with remaining saffron and serve hot. Serves 3 4, and 6 - 8 as an appetizer.

title: Crock Pot Meatloaf
ingredients: 500 g ground sirloin | 1 large yellow onion, finely chopped | 500 ml beef stock | 1 cup fresh grape, halved | 1 large loaf roll
instructions: Put beef in crock pot and add onions and stock. If using the fridge, put in the fridge at this point for a little over night and allow to come out very tasty.

title: Zucchini Salad With Cashews and Maple Syrup
ingredients: 3 tablespoons raw cashews | 1/2 cup sliced almonds | 1/2 cup dried cranberries | 1/4 cup bechamel sauce ( or brown sugar ) | 2 teaspoons chopped kimli brandy or 2 teaspoons apple juice | 3 tablespoons catsup or 3 tablespoons orange juice | chilled bechamel sauce, to serve ( maple syrup ) | 8 large zucchini, sliced
instructions: Toss together nuts and cranberries and set aside. Brush the cashewnuts on one side of a griddle. Grill over medium high heat for about 30 seconds, or until golden brown and crispy. Transfer to a towel and spread out on a towel. Place remaining cashews on a plate and spread with the bechamel. Serve zucchini cut on the dish with cashews. Sauce.

title: Chinese Barbeque Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup pineapple juice | 1 cup barbeque sauce | 1/8 cup herb ( try # 4 spice ) | 1/8 cup mirin
instructions: Heat 1 cup pineapple juice and 1/8 cup barbeque sauce in a medium saucepan over medium heat until heated through, about 3 to 5 minutes. Mix in 1/8 cup biben sauce. Mix in 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/8 teaspoon dried herbs, or to taste.

Random Ingredients: black bean,bow tie pasta,orange zest,pea,cream cheese,rice,nutmeg,almond
title: Bow Ties with Black Bean, Peas and Sun-Dried Orzo
ingredients: 1 package bow tie pasta, cooked to package directions, drained | 3/4 cup frozen peas | 1 can black beans, drained ( drained from can ) | 1 tablespoon orange zest | 1/8 teaspoon nutmeg | 1/2 cup toasted sliced almonds | 1/2 cup sour cream or 1/2 cup plain yogurt, room temperature | hot cooked rice
instructions: In medium bowl, toss together the pasta, peas, black beans, orange zest and nutmeg. Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Spread the pasta mixture evenly in the dish. Sprinkle the almonds over the pasta. Pour the sour cream over the black beans. Cover and refrigerate for up to 2 hours. To serve,. Sprinkle with the toasted toasted almonds.

title: Swiss Chard Roll
ingredients: 1 bunch swiss chard, trimmed and chopped to 1/4-inch | cooking spray | 1/2 cup sliced pepperoni | 1/2 cup triple sec
instructions: Preheat broiler. Spray a 2 1/2 quart baking dish with cooking spray. Combine chard leaves and pepperoni until coated with cooking spray.

Random Ingredients: green food coloring,fennel seed,graham cracker crumb,red wine vinegar
title: Pink Fennel Crumbs
ingredients: 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1/2 cup dry red wine vinegar | 1/2 cup finely chopped green food coloring | 1/2 teaspoon ground fennel seed
instructions: Using a hand held mixer, combine the ginger, garlic, and green food coloring into the crumbs. Add the water in small increments until the mixture becomes a very fine powder. If needed, add more water, a tablespoon at a time. Sprinkle with fennel seeds and refrigerate 3 hours to dry completely.

title: Steamed Brown Rice With Gruyerere Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 cup long grain brown rice | 6 -8 ounces gruyere cheese ( about 2 ounces ) | oyster sauce
instructions: Steam rice according to package directions. Cut cheese into chunks and lightly drizzle with oyster sauce.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,mayonnaise,pinto bean,american cheese,spice,sugar snap pea
title: American Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans, drained | 1 package shredded american cheese | 1 package frozen sugar snap peas, thawed and sliced | 1 jar onion soup mix | 3 tablespoons mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon spice
instructions: Place pinto beans in a saucepan with a small amount of water, and bring just to a boil. Reduce heat, and simmer 10 minutes. Drain in a colander, and mash with a potato masher. While the mixture is simmering, mix the cheese in a bowl. When the mixture has cooled, mix in the drained pinto beans, processed cheese and sugar snap peas. Topping, mix the soup mix, mayonnaise and spice in a bowl. Place in the refrigerator until the dip is easy to spread.

Random Ingredients: onion,oatmeal,romaine leaf,veal cutlet,demerara sugar,coconut,yellow bell pepper,gelatin
title: Veal Sandwich Fingers for the Crock Pot
ingredients: 8 small veal cutlets, thinly sliced ( or other tender steaks of your choice ) | 3 large yellow bell peppers, thinly sliced | 1 small onion, thinly sliced ( or 1 small shallot ) ( optional ) | 1 cup shredded coconut ( to dip ) | 1 envelope unflavored gelatin | 600 ml demerara sugar ( to sweeten ) | 8 large rolled oats ( or any packaged variety suitable to serve ) | 8 fresh romaine leaves
instructions: Line crock pot with waxed paper. Arrange cutlets in bottom of crock pot. Top with pepper, onion, and coconut on top of cutlets. Sprinkle gelatin over gelatin. Mix demarara sugar and oats in bowl. Dip cutlets gently into the egg, then toss with the syrup mixture. Spread cutlets with demarara sugar oat mixture, and stack on a platter lined with romaine leaves.

Random Ingredients: panch phoron,cream celery soup,ziti pasta,pimento,ice water,chocolate,italian seasoning,black pepper
title: Chocolate Pasta and Everything
ingredients: 6 cups ice water | 1 box ziti pasta | 1 package grated mixed berry ziti pasta ( ziti con una ziti ) | 2 packages shredded semisweet chocolate | 1 jar sliced pimentos, drained | 1 package cream celery soup ( or cream of celery soup ) | 1 tablespoon dried italian seasoning | 1 dash black pepper
instructions: In a large pot, stir together ice water and pasta in a large bowl. Bring to a boil, then cover and cook for 8 to 10 minutes. Stir ziti and return to the pot and repeat step 4 - 6 until sauce has been mixed inches. Spray a medium saucepan with cooking spray, add chocolate, pimentos, and cream of celery soup and mix well. Cook over low heat for 3 to 5 minutes while stirring frequently. Stir in the italian seasoning, black pepper and ziti and simmer for 5 minutes more or until pasta is done. Sauce may be made one day in advance, refrigerated.

title: Healthy Sunflower Toast
ingredients: 2 slices whole wheat bread, crusts removed | 1/4 cup sunflower oil | 1/4 cup bamboo shoot, shredded
instructions: Using a brush on your forefinger, smear sunflower oil onto one slice of bread. Top with another slice of bread and repeat with the remaining slices. Heat a griddle on low and grease lightly with oil before starting to cook.

title: Baked Thai Fish
ingredients: 4 tablespoons low sodium dark soy sauce | 2 tablespoons thai fish sauce | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs firm white fish fillets ( such as cod, hake, or salmon )
instructions: Preheat oven to place fish on foil in an 8 x 10 inch rimmed baking dish. In a small bowl, whisk together the dark soy sauce and fish sauce. Pour over fish. Bake at 425f for 15 - 20 minutes, or until fish flakes easily when gently flaked with a fork.

Random Ingredients: sherry,half cream,beef stock,plum,rhubarb,egg white,gouda cheese,chicken quarter
title: German Plum Soup
ingredients: 1 lb boneless chicken quarter, cooked and finely cubed | 1/4 cup dry sherry | 8 cups chicken stock | 4 tablespoons half-and-half cream | 4 medium plum, sliced | 2 medium ryves and spring turnips or 2 medium turnips, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 1 1/4 cups gouda cheese, aged, grated or 1 1/4 cups other german cheese cheese, grated | 2 large egg whites
instructions: Combine chicken with sherry in a heavy large pot, bring to a simmer over medium high heat.

Random Ingredients: raisin,wonton wrapper,beef,extra virgin olive oil,white pepper
title: Raisin Wrapped Buns
ingredients: 500 g ground beef | 1 teaspoon ground mustard | 2 tablespoons raisins | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper | 20 wonton wrappers
instructions: Mince the beef with the chill and mustard. Stir the beef, raisins and pepper into the ground beef. Divide the mixture into 10 equal portions, wrap the filling and put aside separately. Brush each bun with beaten egg.

title: Chiles on Pita
ingredients: 6 poblano chiles | 1 red onion, roughly chopped | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 2 pita bread | 1 lb cooked meat, cubed or 1 lb cooked chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Roast, peel and seed the poblano chilies, and cut them into roughly 1/4 inch dice. Combine poblano, onion, mayonnaise, and pita on large sheet pan and arrange them in a single layer.

title: Quick and Easy Refried Beans
ingredients: 1 can baked beans | 1 box biscuit mix
instructions: Stir cookie mix and baked, refried beans together until well combined. If biscuit mix is too wet, stir a bit more than one biscut at a time until it forms a soft crumbly texture. Press biscuit mix into the bottom and up the sides of a 9x13 baking dish. Spread refried beans evenly over the bread mixture. Sprinkle biscuit mixture over the beans. Bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit for 25 - 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: half,tomato,sun tomato oil,rice wine,basil leaf,paprika,chili powder,chunky salsa
title: Sun-Dried Tomato and Salsa Rice
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon chili powder | 2 -3 tablespoons fresh basil leaves, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon paprika | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, minced ( drained ) | 1 cup chunky salsa ( i use the chunky salsa ) | 1 1/4 cups half-and-half | 1 1/2 cups cooked rice ( mexican is best ) or 1 1/2 cups cooked jasmine rice ( mexican is best ) | 1 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, minced ( drained )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f whisk first 7 ingredients in large bowl.

title: Kathiyar Keema (Lamb and Pita Toasts)
ingredients: 2 medium pita bread | 2 tablespoons fresh ginger garlic paste | 2 lbs lamb, cubed | 1/2 cup coriander powder | 8 ounces mangoes, sliced | 4 ounces oysters, sliced
instructions: Cut pita breads in half lengthwise. Cut each half into 3 squares. Spread 1 tablespoon of ginger and garlic paste in each pita. Place lamb in center and surround with pita toasts and mangoes. Sprinkle with coriander. Wrap tops of toasts around the meat and secure with toothpicks. Place wrap, in a baking dish and refrigerate for 6 hours or overnight. Serve with a salad.

title: Fried Poblanos With Orange Flower Syrup
ingredients: 1 cup poblano chile | 1 cup orange flower water | 4 cups broth | 1/8 teaspoon saffron thread, dissolved in | 4 cups hot cooked fern-swiss cheese | 1 pinch ground cloves
instructions: Heat broiler on high. Line baking sheet with aluminum foil. Cut poblanos open and remove stem and seeds. Cut lengthwise into 1/4 inch thick slices. Arrange poblanos on baking sheet.

Random Ingredients: golden brown sugar,wide egg noodle,tea,shrimp,toblerone chocolate bar,zucchini
title: Chocolate Shrimp Noodles
ingredients: 1 box wide egg noodles | 1 2.5 boxes teabags gold medal bittersweet chocolate bars | 1/2 cup packed golden brown sugar, divided | 1 cup chopped raw shrimp | 6 medium zucchini, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 8 ounces toblerone chocolate bar, coarsely chopped
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook noodles according to package directions, omitting salt and butter, stirring occasionally. Drain. Meanwhile, melt chocolate in top of double boiler over simmering water, stirring frequently, 5 to 10 minutes or until mixture is smooth. Using a slotted spoon, transfer to a bowl and set aside. Add shrimp and zucchini to sauce.

title: Taco Seasoning
ingredients: 1 packet taco seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon salt substitute
instructions: Mix in small bowl.

title: Simple Grilled Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken breast fillets | 4 -6 tablespoons low fat sesame oil and four tablespoons balsamic vinegar
instructions: Heat grill to high. Place chicken on grill and season with salt and pepper. Close grill lid and allow to cook for about 10 minutes. Whisk together sesame oil and four tbs of vinegar in a small bowl to make dipping sauce. When chicken is done, brush with oil mixture and turn to coat. Serve with dipping sauce.

Random Ingredients: baking soda,coriander powder,plain nonfat yogurt,taco sauce,rice bubble,snow pea
title: Faux Thai Snow Peas (Tossed With Rice Crackers)
ingredients: 1 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 3 tablespoons taco sauce ( taco bell taco seasoning to taste ) | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh coriander powder | 10 -12 fresh snow peas | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 2 cups crispy rice bubbles
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl. Store in the refrigerator until serving time.

title: African Barbecue Salmon
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cumin seeds, toasted and ground | 1 teaspoon chili sauce, such as ketchup | 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric powder | 2 tablespoons olive, thinly sliced | 1 lb salmon, cleaned tail on | cooking spray
instructions: Heat a grill pan over medium heat until just beginning to smoke, then add the cumin, stirring, until they crackle and give off a pleasant smell. Stir in chili sauce and turmeric, then add oil. When oil is nearly smoking, add salmon.

Random Ingredients: peanut,mustard seed,phyllo pastry,greek yogurt,black olive,russet potato
title: Tyropita
ingredients: 1 large russet potato | 1 cup plain greek yogurt | 2/3 cup sliced black olives, drained | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 8 sheets phyllo pastry | 1/4 cup finely chopped peanuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Bring a large pot of water to a boil, and cook the potato 8 minutes.

title: Wasabi Powder
ingredients: 1/2 cup rice flour | 1/2 teaspoon mixed italian parsley | 1 teaspoon wasabi paste | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning
instructions: Combine rice flour, chopped parsley, wasabi paste and italian seasoning. Mix on medium speed for 1 1/2 minutes. Add more if needed to make a consistent paste. Continue to mix until desired consistency is achieved and form fine, compact dough to easily pipe onto a flat surface.

Random Ingredients: worcestershire sauce,kosher salt,sichuan peppercorn,fruit,cocoa powder,vanilla,margarita mix,cashew
title: Chewy Cashew Nuts
ingredients: 1/3 cup cashews | 1/4 cup chopped candied mixed fruit | 1 tablespoon good quality cocoa powder, sifted | 3 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 1 tablespoon granulated vanilla | 1/4 teaspoon sichuan peppercorns ( i just add some dried seeds to the mix ) | 1 -2 tablespoon raw agar-agar-agar mixed with | kosher salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. In a small saucepan, combine cashews, mixed fruit, cocoa powder, worcestershire sauce, sea salt, sugar, vanilla and sichuan pepper. Cook over low heat until mixture is heated through. Remove from heat and stir into cashew mixture. Place in an ungreased 8x8 inch pan, pour over agar agar mixture. Sprinkle with raw agar agar agar mix and bake for 45 - 50 minutes.

title: Simple Nutella Nests for Dogs
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups nutella, or more to taste ( optional ) | 2 cups broth ( optional )
instructions: Blend or process nutella in a blender until smooth, about 15 seconds. Stir broth and optional nutella into nutella.

title: Baked Phyllo Chicken
ingredients: 1 roasting chickens, cut into pieces | 1 package uncooked penne | 2 cups chopped pecans | 2 packages frozen miniature phyllo dough
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. In a large pot of water, boil the pasta and simmer until pasta is al dente. Drain. Transfer the pasta to a large bowl. Combine the pasta with the chicken and cooked pasta in a large casserole dish. Spread the pecans on top. Cover with the frozen phyllo sheets, leaving a 2 inch overhang. Bake in the preheated oven for 30 minutes. Remove from the oven, and allow to cool for 15 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: red cabbage,fruit,gochujang,soda water,broiler fryer chicken,chicken,adobo seasoning
title: Adobo Chicken With Chicken and Cabbage
ingredients: 7 -8 chicken pieces ( depending on your taste, i used 3 ) | 2 tablespoons gochujang ( or chile paste, for a milder dish ) | 7 -8 small dried fruit ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon gochugaru ( gochujang spice ) | 1 -2 tablespoon dried ancho chilies ( crushed, for the more heat i recommend `` crema di reggiano '' ) ( optional - i have never tried this, but it depends on how spicy you like your dish ) ( optional ) | soda water ( optional ) | salt & pepper
instructions: Add all ingredients except the chicken. Turn on broiler on high. Cook until chicken is done and juices run clear. Remove chicken to a warm platter and top with dipping sauce. Garnish with lime wedges. Tips, this is also great with pork, beef or lamb. Note, a suggestion is to let it cool before wrapping in plastic or placing in plastic/parchment paper, this will make the juices leak out of the chicken, and flavor. This chicken can also be used as a filling with dumplings or just eat it as is.

Random Ingredients: grain mustard,green bell pepper,splenda sugar substitute,cardamom pod,flat leaf parsley,onion
title: Green Peppers and Onions over Hard Salami
ingredients: 2 large green bell peppers, thickly sliced ( about 4 pounds ) | 2 medium onions ( about 4 pounds ) | 1/3 cup coarse grain mustard | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom pod, crushed | 1 tablespoon splenda sugar substitute, plus more for sprinkling | 2 tablespoons flat leaf parsley or 2 tablespoons coriander
instructions: Arrange prepared peppers in ungreased 13x9x2 inch glass baking dish in two rows, sprinkle with 1/4 teaspoon salt and pepper. Combine remaining 1/4 teaspoon salt, pepper, onion and mustard in a small bowl.

title: Tasty & Healthy Oatcakes
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups oatmeal, unsalted | 1 1/2 cups red wine | 1 1/2 cups zucchini, grated | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | pasta, of your choice
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200ºc or 180ºc if fan forced. Line a baking tray with baking paper. Measure 1 cup of the oatmeal into a large bowl, and set the bowl aside. Pour the wine into a saucepan and bring to the boil, keeping a tight fitting lid for later use. Add the zucchini and cook for a couple of minutes until all the liquid is absorbed, then remove the pan from the heat. Mix together the remaining oatmeal, oatcakes & red wine and stir in the grated zucchini. Transfer to a piping bag, and pipe 2 tbsps of cream into each bowl. Pipe or pipe the centre into small fingers using an ice cream / snow blade or 2 small star shaped star shaped star pappers. Dab each with the reserved cup of oatmeal / wine/zucchini mix, and place on the tray. Bake for about 30 - 40 minutes, until golden, and then allow to cool slightly, slice in half, and serve.

title: Spanish Tortillas (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 2 garlic cloves, minced | 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves | 1 1/2 cups chunky salsa, divided | 8 flour tortillas, 3-inch diameter
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f in a small saucepan, combine garlic, cloves, and 1/2 cup of the salsa and bring to simmer over medium low heat. Uncover pan and simmer 3 minutes or until garlic is golden brown.

Random Ingredients: red lentil,french bread,egg white,lamb shank,green bell pepper,rice vinegar
title: Lamb Shanks With Red Lentil & Rice Vinegar Filling
ingredients: 4 lamb shanks | 4 slices french bread, toasted | 4 egg whites | 1 green bell pepper, seeded & amp, chopped | 1/2 cup red lentils, rinsed and drained | 3 tablespoons rice vinegar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees. Wash lamb shanks and place on rack in roasting pan. Combine bread with egg whites& bell pepper& mix well. Rub lamb shanks with bread mixture. Rub remaining mixture onto lamb. Mix rice vinegar& salt& pepper and spread on lamb in pan. Roast for about 2 hours, basting & turning to brown evenly.

Random Ingredients: celeriac,sunflower oil,apricot jam,butter croissant,hot chili pepper,brown sugar,mint leaf,celery
title: Scrumptious Vegetarian Lunchbox Breakfast
ingredients: 1 tablespoon of fresh mint leaves, washed, dried and chopped finely | 2 tablespoons apricot jam | 1 -2 tablespoon brown sugar | 1/2 tablespoon sunflower oil | 2 teaspoons celeriac, grated | 1 -2 tablespoon chopped celery | 1 -2 tablespoon chopped hot chili pepper, sliced thinly ( or to taste ) | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon dried hot chili pepper, chopped | 1 tablespoon butter, softened | 4 crusty swiss croiss-bread or 4 croissants, split and toasted | mint leaf ( to garnish )
instructions: To prepare the dressing, place in a small bowl, the chopped mint, jam, olive oil, celeriac, celery and sliced chillies. Stir until well blended and the sugar dissolves. If needed add another tablespoon of oil or milk to achieve desired consistency. Place all the topping ingredients in a bowl and mix well. To prepare the sandwich, butter each croissant and spread with the dressing. Arrange the two toasted croissants on a hot plate and place two slices of toast on top of the dressing mixture and top the toast with the topping and mint leaves to serve.

Random Ingredients: steak,flat leaf parsley,liquid smoke,white wine,active yeast,garlic,anise seed,black bean
title: Cuban Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 lb flank steak, trimmed | 2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 2 cups unbleached cane syrup or 2 cups packed light-colored corn syrup | 2 tablespoons garlic, minced | 1 teaspoon ground anise seed | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke | 2 teaspoons liquid smoke | 3/4 cup dry white wine | 2 -3 tablespoons flat leaf parsley, chopped
instructions: To prepare steak, if using a beefsteak machine, place beef slices between waxed paper and flatten with mallet to slightly thinner. Dissolve yeast in 1 1/2 cups of the cane syrup or corn syrup until dissolved. Place sliced beef on a 12 inch square piece of heavy duty foil. Spread corn syrup all over beef. Sprinkle with garlic, anise, liquid smoke and liquid smoke. Fold up and pinch edges of foil tightly together to make an airy package. Place on a tray and refrigerate overnight. Remove beef from refrigerator and remove plastic wrap and bread and plastic wrap. Cover and let rest at room temperature for about 15 minutes. Meanwhile, combine remaining cane syrup with liquid smoke. Heat over low heat, stirring occasionally, until it reaches 185 degrees on a digital thermometer. Brush butter onto the meat and let stand 5 minutes. Slice and arrange on a hot platter. Drizzle with warm syrup and sprinkle with parsley. Serve at once.

title: Tofu-Sauce With Tomatoes, Onions and Apples
ingredients: 20 ounces firm tofu, drained | 1 medium tomato puree ( or v8 vegetable puree ) | 1 envelope taco seasoning mix | 3 tablespoons apples, shredded fine ( optional )
instructions: Cut tofu into 1 1/2 inch cubes. Heat up the taco seasoning according to package directions,. Place into a shallow baking dish. Toss tomatoes and tofu together with taco seasoning. Pour over tofu mixture. Cover with foil and bake at 400°f for 20 minutes, or until vegetables are tender and heated throughout.

title: Blueberry Rice With Mexican Cheese and Yogurt
ingredients: 5 cups cooked white rice | 1 1/2 cups low-fat mexican cheese, shredded and divided | 6 tablespoons triple sec | 2 tablespoons salad oil | 1 1/2 cups blueberries | 1 cup fresh blueberries ( to garnish )
instructions: In a deep saucepan over medium high heat, add 1 1/2 cups water and 1 1/2 cups rice. Cover and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer, covered for 10 minutes or until all liquid is absorbed, stirring occasionally. Place cheese and triple sec in a medium bowl. Mix in salad oil and blueberries. Add cooked rice and stir to coat. Serve hot.

title: Cock-Ahead Kale With Hominy and Chiles.
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs kale, washed and de-stemmed | 3/4 cup self raising flour | kale, washed and trimmed, plus more as needed, chopped into 1-inch pieces | 3 cans white hominy, drained and rinsed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f mix the kale, flour, and half the hominy together in a bowl to make a batter. When the oven reaches 400 f, spoon kale into an 8x8x2 inch baking dish. Scatter half the hot hominy over the kale mixture, sprinkle with the rest of the hominy and sprinkle with remaining hominy. Bake for 50 to 60 minutes or until the hominy is heated through and the kale is tender.

Random Ingredients: pear,lemon juice,neufchatel cheese,beef stew meat,hot water,hot paprika,sun tomato
title: Beef and Sun-Dried Tomato Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup lemon juice | 1 lb beef stew meat, cut in bite-size pieces | 1 cup neufchatel cheese | 1/4 cup hot water | 4 ounces dried pears, stems removed, cored, and coarsely chopped | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon hot paprika | 1/2 sun-dried tomato, thinly sliced
instructions: Combine lemon juice and beef in a 4 or 5 quart slow cooker. Cover and cook on high 2 to 3 hours. Remove beef and cool. Shred beef. Combine neufchatel cheese with 1/4 cup water in a small bowl.

title: Chinese Sweetheart
ingredients: 1 large chestnuts, finely sliced | 1 tablespoon grated fresh gingerroot | 1 pineapple, peeled cored and flesh cubed
instructions: Place the chestnuts in a pan, pour over just enough water to cover the chestnuts with about 2cm of water and place over a medium heat. Simmer gently for about 10 minutes until all of the water has gone. Remove from the heat. Add the gingerroot, chestnuts and pineapple. Toss to coat thoroughly and allow to cool then leave in the fridge to set.

Random Ingredients: cooking spray,chili oil,mustard powder,bacon,egg white,pepperoni,sage leaf
title: Spicy English Crumpets
ingredients: 8 slices bacon | 2 ounces pepperoni, chopped | 2 tablespoons cooking spray | 1 tablespoon mustard powder | 12 -14 sage leaves, finely chopped | 1 egg white | 4 drops chili oil
instructions: Heat a large non stick frying pan on high heat. Fry bacon, pepperoni, and sage stirring frequently until bacon is cooked. Set aside to cool. Whisk together egg white, chili oil and mustard powder in a medium bowl. Add bacon mixture back to base of pan. Stir well and coat bacon in eggwhite mixture. Cook over medium heat for 2 - 3 minutes or until browned. Turn onto plate and serve immediately with crackers.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,honey,dark sesame oil,english cucumber,coriander seed,saffron strand
title: Saffron Cucumbers
ingredients: 1 english cucumber ( about 1 cup or larger ) | 4 garlic cloves ( or more if you wish ) | 3 tablespoons honey | 1/2 teaspoon saffron strand ( soaked in 1 tbsp honey ) | 1 tablespoon coriander seed ( lightly crushed ) | 1/2 teaspoon dark sesame oil
instructions: Cut cucumber lengthwise into 12 slices. Using an sieve, remove all but 3 slices, leaving the remainder uncovered. Slice lengthwise again into 12 pieces. In medium bowl or serving bowl, combine cucumber slices with remaining ingredients.

title: Noodle and Celery Soup
ingredients: 6 cups water | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 1/4 teaspoon celery salt | 3 cups egg noodles, uncooked
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large saucepan, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium, and cook for 15 to 20 minutes, or until noodles are tender.

title: Beetroot and Raji Vegetable Dip
ingredients: 2 teaspoons red curry paste | 1 jar salsa | 8 sun-dried tomatoes, diced | 1 beet, peeled and shredded
instructions: Combine ingredients in a medium bowl and combine well with hands before serving.

title: Prawnfish Sauce - Thai-Style
ingredients: 10 prawns or 20 tiger prawns | 1 1/2 tablespoons cooking oil | chopped cilantro ( to garnish )
instructions: Shell and devein prawns, if using large raw prawns. Heat oil in wok or deep frying pan over medium high heat or until very hot, but not smoking. Add prawns, in batches, and fry until the prawns are just firm and cooked but not cooked through, stirring constantly. Remove from heat and stir in cilantro just before serving.

title: Ranch Chicken & Veggies With Cranberry Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs shredded cabbage | 1 lb fresh cranberries or 1 lb frozen cranberries | 1 jar pizza sauce | chili oil
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350° f. Line a 13 x 9 x 2 pan with the cabbage slaw, cranberries, and pizza sauce. Cook the chicken for 10 - 12 minutes in a saucepan.

title: Scottish Raisin Soup
ingredients: 1 cup sultana raisin | 6 cups unsalted chicken stock or 6 cups broth, heated
instructions: Place the raisins in a small bowl and pour hot stock over them. Cover and let stand for 45 minutes, or until raisins are soft. Using a ladle or skimmer, lift out the raisins.

title: Blue Cheese Spread
ingredients: 24 ounces blue cheese, soft | 4 tablespoons margarine
instructions: Place the cheese and margarine in a food processor. Process well, add the blue cheese and continue to process until it is well blended. This will create fine bread crumbs. Refrigerate several hours before using. Variation, add 1/2 cup fresh or frozen chopped broccoli or cauliflower, chopped into 1/2 inch chunks and stirred into the butter to thaw/mash. Instead of blue cheese, you can add crumbled smoked ham or bacon to the cheese.

title: Homemade Asafetida
ingredients: 1 pinch asafoetida powder ( canela powder ) | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa powder or 1 tablespoon sesame seeds | 1/4 teaspoon hot horseradish
instructions: Combine asafoetida and cocoa in a small microwave safe bowl and microwave on high for about 3 minutes. Stir and microwave until asafoetida is a light reddish in color. Drizzle into hot cooked ice cubes, if desired, and garnish with a sprinkle or two of sesame seeds, if desired. Makes about 3/4 cup.

title: Easy Mexican Mushrooms & Beans
ingredients: 2 cans black beans, rinsed & drained | 2 cans cremini mushrooms, sliced | 2 packages baby portabella mushrooms, quartered
instructions: Brown mushrooms on hi heat in 2 tablespoons olive oil over med hi heat. Add beans & mushrooms, stirring to coat beans.

title: Coriander-Crispy Beef
ingredients: 3 tablespoons coriander seeds, or more to taste | 1 pound beef chuck, trimmed and cut into 1/2-inch cubes | creole seasoning to taste
instructions: Place coriander seeds in a mortar and pestle or spice grinder. Stir together coriander seed mixture and beef. Grind beef mixture into a fine powder using a coarsely ground grinding tool, or press spices with your fingers until completely incorporated. Season with creole seasoning.

title: Quick and Easy Caribbean Dip
ingredients: 1 cup sour cream or 1 cup mayonnaise, regular | 1/2 cup diced onion | 1/4 teaspoon dried onion powder | 1/2 cup shredded coconut ( optional, but encouraged )
instructions: In small bowl, mix sour cream or mayonnaise, diced onion and dried onion powder. Stir well to blend. Spoon into serving glass bowl. Swirl coconut on surface of dip. Serve with toothpicks. You may use coconut whipped cream recipe #.

Random Ingredients: spinach leaf,dark soy sauce,chilies,red chilies,coconut cream,dark rum
title: Thai Style Sauteed Spinach
ingredients: 300 g spinach leaves | 6 red chilies ( birdseye ) | 3 long red chilies | 4 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 4 tablespoons dark rum | 400 ml coconut cream
instructions: Heat a large wok over a high heat. Add the chilies and fry for 30 seconds, just until they are softened and begin to sizzle. Stir in the coconut and continue to fry for 30 seconds. Using a slotted spoon, remove the chilies from the wok. Add the soy and half the rum to the wok. Stirring constantly, add this mixture. Leave to boil for 30 seconds, then pour in the coconut cream and stir fry for a further 30 seconds. Stir the spinach and remove from heat. Divide among rice bowls. Serve immediately with remaining rum and serve with lime wedges for squeezing.

Random Ingredients: white pepper,provolone cheese,cocoa powder,greek yogurt,cornstarch,salt black pepper
title: Pizza-Marinated Grilled Cheese (Antipasto)
ingredients: 1 cup plain fat-free greek yogurt | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 dash white pepper | 1 dash salt | 4 slices provolone cheese | 4 teaspoons unsweetened cocoa powder
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together yogurt, cornstarch, white pepper, and salt. Place cheese slices in mixture and allow to rest 10 minutes. Heat grill to high. Brush both sides of all 4 cheese slices with yogurt mixture. Brush grill with nonstick cooking spray. Grill cheese slices on both sides until cheese is completely melted and golden brown.

title: Pizzelles
ingredients: 6 maraschino cherries, or more to taste | 1 teaspoon lemon zest, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Stir the maraschino cherries, lemon zest, and lemon juice together in a bowl.

title: Pampered Easy Peanut Butter Chilies
ingredients: 1 can of rotel tomatoes & chilies | 1 medium onion, chopped | 12 ounces of real crunchy peanut butter | 1/16 teaspoon of real celery or 1/16 teaspoon onion powder
instructions: Add peanut butter to peanut butter can and mix well. Add in celery or onion and stir well.

Random Ingredients: phyllo dough,cilantro leaf,red pepper,red cayenne pepper,fine semolina,marjoram,lemon
title: Tunisian Brik
ingredients: 1 lb fine semolina | 1 bunch fresh cilantro leaves, minced | lemon, juice of | 1 teaspoon marjoram | 1/4 teaspoon red cayenne pepper, crushed | red pepper, for decoration | 8 sheets phyllo dough
instructions: Heat oil in pan. Add the cilantro. Add spices. Sprinkle 1/4 cup water in pan. Let it simmer until water becomes thick. Add remaining 3/4 cup water. Keep on stirring it until it becomes thick in colour of dark brown in color. Add the lemon juice and cook for 2 minutes. Add semolina. Stir frequently. Keep aside. Brush a 9x13 baking dish with oil. Line the bottom with a sheet of phyllo. Brush the top with oil. Sprinkle with black pepper. Layer the red pepper on top. Cover the dish with 6 more leaves. Place in oven for 25 minute. Turn on broiler. Remove the phyllo sheets from the oven. You can slice and lay on the serving plate and put 2 stacks to side on the next time or you can take them to table. Cut into serving pieces of desired width and decorate with the pepper bits and cilantro.

title: Tangy Black bread Crumble
ingredients: 2 tablespoons brown sugar | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 slice sourdough bread | 2 slices bread | 1 tablespoon dried breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Cut bread into cubes. Place bread cubes into baking dish. Add sugar and asafetida. Bake on cookie sheet for 8 to 10 minutes. Sprinkle bread crumbs on top and bake until crumbs are lightly browned and the bread is dry.

title: Minted Parsnip Pudding
ingredients: 2 medium parsnips | 1 bottle marinara sauce | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1/2 tablespoon hot paprika | 1 bottle sauerkraut, drained | 1 package instant lemon pudding, pudding | 2 cups hot cooked rice vinegar | 1 1/2 cups blueberries ( fresh or frozen )
instructions: Scrub the parsnips, cut on the diagonal in halves, then quarter lenghtwise. Drop the halves back into the jar with the marinara sauce, rice vinegar and hot paprika. Mix well. Stir in sauerkraut. Cover w/ a lid. And secure at the top with a wooden toothpick. Cook in a 350 degree oven over medium heat stirring every 10 minutes to insure even cooking until golden, about 1 1/2 hours. Cool pudding slightly. Place in a glass bowl or serving bowl, cover with hot rice vinegar. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Remove toothpicks from the pudding. Serve warm with hot, freshly made hot vinaigrette.

title: Cornstarch-Rhubarb Puffs
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 lb rhubarb, chopped including tops | 1 red bell pepper, chopped | 1 whole poblano chile
instructions: Put cornstarch in a saucepan and add rhubarb. Heat over medium heat stirring often. Stir rhubarb until coated with cornstarch. Add bell pepper and poblano. Cook for about 10 minutes or until rhubarb is tender.

title: Dill-Rye Bread
ingredients: 1 lb dill weed | 2 teaspoons baking soda
instructions: Dissolve the baking soda in 1 cup of the water. Finely mince half the dill and chop the rest. Combine with remaining ingredients and knead the mixture well by hand until it starts to come together. Place in a well buttered bowl, then cover with wet, but not sticky kneaded hands, allow to rise by 1/2 inch and knead by hand again several times. Turn out on a floured board and knead for 10 minutes or so, then place on a rack so air pockets can circulate. Return to baking sheet and place in a heated oven. Check the bread's color by putting a skewer in the hollow.

Random Ingredients: canadian bacon,thyme,spring onion,chili oil,beef stock,noodle,marshmallow creme
title: Sour-Stuffed Noodles With Canadian Bacon and Mushrooms
ingredients: 4 cups cold cooked noodles ( or your favourite flavour of noodles ) | 1 cup coarsely chopped canadian bacon, chopped | 1 cup finely chopped spring onion | 2 teaspoons minced fresh thyme | 1/2 cup beef stock | 1 tablespoon chili oil | 1/4 cup miniature marshmallow creme
instructions: In a saucepan, combine the noodles, bacon, onion, thyme, stock and chili oil. Cook over medium low heat, stirring frequently, until hot and melted. Remove from the heat and adjust the seasoning. Stuff the noodles, using toothpicks, if necessary, and gently transfer them to a baking tray lined with paper towel. Cover each noodle with foil and bake for 20 minutes. Increase the heat to high and cook for 5 - 10 minutes, or until noodles are just tender. Remove the foil and bake for 5 minutes more until crisp and lightly browned. Serve the noodle with the warm mushrooms and your favourite toppings.

title: Vanilla Bean Jam for the Soul
ingredients: 1 can whole vanilla beans, drained, plus extra for the soul | 1 1/2 liters vanilla cooking sherry or 1 1/2 liters rum | 1 1/2 liters caster sugar ( superfine sugar ) | 1 liter cooking sherry | 50 g cooking sherry wine
instructions: Place the extra vanilla beans, the 1/2 liter sherry or rum, and the sugar in a pan, heat slowly until hot but not boiling. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 15 minutes until syrupy. Pour in the sherry and stir well. Keep warm until serving time. To test for the essence, insert a small slice of vanilla bean in your thumb. If it stays in the middle of the slice, it should be ready.

Random Ingredients: pear,beef broth,plantain,vanilla essence,chick pea,red food coloring,taco cheese
title: Spicy Tostadas With Chickpeas & Plantains
ingredients: 6 small plantains, peeled | 300 g ground lean beef or 300 g ground turkey | 1 can chick-peas ( drained and rinsed well ) | 1/2 cup chopped pear ( optional ) | 1 can low-fat beef broth | 1/4 cup taco cheese ( mexican soft or fat free ) | 2 drops red food coloring ( optional ) | 1 dash vanilla essence ( optional )
instructions: Slice the plantains in thin slices lengthwise. You can get about 4 slices per row if you have to. Place on baking sheet lined with greased paper and let sit for about 20 minutes or till they start to soften slightly before flipping. Remove from the paper and set aside. Brown the meat with a tablespoon of water, breaking up the larger pieces. Add the chickpeas, pear, beef broth, optional pears and red food coloring and simmer till the mixture is reduced and thickened slightly. Spread out the bean mixture on the baking sheet. Place the plantain slices over the top, cover and bake til the plantains are brown. Remove from the oven and allow to cool, remove the plantains to a bowl or serving dish. Spread 1/4 cup of the mixture over the top of the plantains, using a toothpick to help hold the slices together. Serve with sour cream and salsa if you wish.

title: Homemade Sweet Potato Pasta Sauce
ingredients: 2 1/4 lbs russet potatoes | 2/3 cup chicken stock | 2/3 cup catsup, your favorite brand | 1 tablespoon superfine sugar | 1/4 cup semolina
instructions: Peel the potatoes well.

title: The Most Wonderful Lettuce Leaves
ingredients: 2 teaspoons celery seed | 3 1/2 cups shredded lettuce | 1 cup whiskey | 1/4 cup crushed ice
instructions: In a small bowl, season the celery seeds with salt. In a large bowl, toss the lettuce and whiskey. Gently lay handfuls of the lettuce in the ice, one or two at a time, and roll in the celery seed mixture. Repeat with remaining lettuce until all are rolled. Refrigerate any leftovers.

title: Chicken Nibbles on Fingers
ingredients: 3 lbs ground veal | 3 cups dark brown sugar | 2 lbs ground chicken wings | 1 dozen tortilla, triangles
instructions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with foil and spray with cooking spray. Combine dry meat, brown sugar, chicken wings and tortillas. Stir lightly until mixed to a paste. Divide mixture evenly onto tortilla triangles. Roll and arrange on baking sheet, placing seam side down. Spray tops of balls with cooking spray and place on lower rack of oven. Bake 15 minutes, lower oven temperature to 350 degrees f and bake 20 to 25 minutes more, or until crisp and golden. Eat with your fingers dipped into melted dark brown sugar.

Random Ingredients: black peppercorn,espresso coffee powder,cremini mushroom,black pepper,naan bread,chili garlic sauce,strawberry
title: Frugal Gourmet's Mushrooms and Peppers
ingredients: 5 ounces fresh mushrooms | 1/2 tablespoon instant espresso coffee powder | 1/2 teaspoon chili-garlic sauce | 1/2 teaspoon black peppercorns, cracked | 1 slice naan bread ( or other flat bread ) | fresh cracked black pepper, for seasoning | fresh strawberry, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: First preheat oven to 375 degrees. Cut off the tops of the mushrooms and discard. Remove stems using a spoon, then slice into 1/4 inch slices. Place mushrooms on a parchment paper lined baking sheet and lightly brush with warm coffee powder. Bake, flipping once, until tender, about 6 - 8 minutes. Remove from the oven and sprinkle pepper on the mushrooms, breaking apart any lumps with your fingers. Transfer to a serving dish, cover loosely with foil and set aside for 5 - 10 minutes, or put under a broiler to grill the mushrooms and peppers. Cut the bread into thin slabs. Lay each piece on a serving plate and sprinkle with cracked black pepper. Garnish with fresh strawberries and serve immediately.

title: Bacalitos (Beef and Raisins)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef chuck, trimmed, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1/2 cup raisins | 1 large egg white
instructions: Combine the meat and any accumulated juices and marinate in the refrigerator for at least four hours, or overnight. Remove beef from refrigerator 15 to 20 minutes before baking. When ready to bake, preheat oven to 375 degrees. Combine egg white and 1/2 cup of water in a small bowl. Heat a 12 inch cast iron skillet until it is hot but not smoking. Dip the beef in the egg and water mixture, turning until all sides are coated thoroughly. Arrange cooked beef in the skillet, seam side down. Cover and bake 40 to 45 minutes. Uncover and bake until nicely browned and bubbly, about 30 minutes longer. Cool completely on wire rack.

title: Brown Bread Flour Cakes
ingredients: 1 1/4 tablespoons brown rice flour | 1 teaspoon cake flour
instructions: Mix brown rice flour and cake flour together till crumbly. Put mixture onto well floured board, knead for 5 minutes on lightly greased board. Form into 2 balls. Press each ball on greased oven tray. Bake at 220deg celsius at 220 deg c for 15 mins or 15 mins at 160 deg celsius.

Random Ingredients: orzo pasta,fennel seed,water,iceberg lettuce,lemon juice zest
title: Orzo With Fennel and Orzo Salad
ingredients: 3 cups water | 3 cups orzo pasta | 1/2 cup packed fennel seed | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | shredded iceberg lettuce, and ( optional )
instructions: Bring water to a rolling boil over high heat. Add the orzo and cook until just tender stirring often, about 15 minutes. Drain and rinse with some cold water. Place in a large serving bowl. Combine the fennel seeds and lemon juice to form a paste. Add to the soup. Mix well. Add the fennel mixture and the orzo to the soup. Stir until thoroughly combined and serve on a bed of lettuce.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,cream celery soup,mint sprig,cinnamon,pineapple tidbit,lemon zest,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Crusty Pineapple and Cheddar Dip
ingredients: 1 can cream of celery soup | 1 package shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 1/4 cup grated lemon zest | 1 can pineapple tidbits, drained and juice reserved | 1 dash ground cinnamon, or to taste | 2 teaspoons balsamic vinegar | 1 fresh mint sprig
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Stir the cream of celery soup, cheddar cheese, lemon zest, pineapple tidbits, cinnamon, and balsamic vinegar together in a large saucepan. Bring to a boil.

title: Sweet Mexican Corn
ingredients: 3/4 cup golden syrup | 3/4 cup kahlua | 1/4 cup madeira wine | 1 teaspoon poppy seed | 3/4 teaspoon fajita seasoning, or more to taste | 1 can corn, drained
instructions: Mix golden syrup, kahlua, madeira, poppy seeds, and fajita seasoning together in a small bowl. Stir corn into syrup mixture until corn is evenly dispersed between the two bowls. Heat an electric skillet to medium heat, and pour corn mixture into the heated skillet.

Random Ingredients: chicken thigh,zucchini,egg white,tomato,chicken breast half,beef chuck
title: Italian Chicken and Beef Hash
ingredients: 2 medium zucchini, cut in 1/2-inch slices | 1 1/4 lbs boneless skinless chicken breast halves, cut in 1/2-inch strips | 2 chicken thighs, cut in 1-inch pieces | 1 egg white, lightly beaten, lightly beaten | 1 lb ground beef chuck | tomatoes, sliced crosswise into thin wedges
instructions: In a large bowl, mix the zucchini with the chicken and egg white.

title: Copycat Goya Sazon
ingredients: 1 ounce sazon goya ( sazon goya ) | 1 ounce tomatoes, roughly chopped | 2 teaspoons cider vinegar
instructions: Boil water in a frying pan on high heat. Add sazon goya and tomato. If mixture starts bubbling, add a little bit of water and keep on a low fire until liquid evaporates.

title: Grilled Bananas
ingredients: 1 ripe banana ( about 1 1/2 pounds ) | 1 tablespoon minced garlic
instructions: Cut banana in half lengthwise. Remove seeds. Slice crosswise into 3 pieces. Brush halves liberally with oil. Sprinkle with garlic. Place on medium hot grill 15 to 20 minutes or until tender, turning once.

Random Ingredients: confectioner sugar,vanilla extract,pie shell,curry powder,vegetable oil cooking spray,chicken thigh,chicken breast half
title: Quick and Easy Chicken Curry Pie
ingredients: 1 cup shredded part-skim cooked chicken breast ( about 1 whole chicken breast ) | 1 boneless skinless chicken breast half, cut into thin strips | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil flavored cooking spray | 1/2 teaspoon curry powder, or to taste | 2 teaspoons vanilla extract | 1 pinch confectioners'sugar, or as needed to coat meat | 1 unbaked pie shell
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place chicken in a mixing bowl, stir in curry powder, and coat with cooking spray. Melt the vegetable oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the chicken and cook until the chicken is browned on the outside and no longer pink inside. Remove.

Random Ingredients: italian spice,rigatoni pasta,chili pepper flake,spanish onion,vegemite
title: Rigatoni and Spicy Vegemite
ingredients: 400 g rigatoni pasta | 600 g spanish onions | 1 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 1/2 teaspoon spanish mixed italian spices | vegemite
instructions: Cut onion into thin slices. Heat some oil in a flameproof casserole over high heat. When hot, stir in onion and chilli.

title: Homemade Sesame Oil Roasted Lamb
ingredients: 600 500 g stewing lamb, trimmed of any fat and sinew | 16 tablespoons oil | 2 tablespoons toasted sesame oil
instructions: Prepare a marinade by mixing together in a small bowl a sesame oil, olive oil and 2 tbsp of sesame oil using your hands. Place the lamb in a roasting tin and cover with the marinade. Turn the lamb so the marinade covers it completely. It's best to cook the lamb at least 1 1/4 hours, but ideally, it's cooked at about 1 hour a side. Turn the lamb after the hour has passed. You may cook it for 4 to 6 hours depending on the size of the lamb, or if you have time in the oven this could even go longer.

title: Spicy Cod Portuguese Style
ingredients: 1 package frozen cod, thawed and drained | 2 packages italian sausage, sliced | 1 packet dry onion soup mix | 1/3 cup glaze
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Arrange the cod, sausage, onion soup mix, and glaze in a 9x13 inch dish. Bake, uncovered, for 30 minutes in the preheated oven. Remove from the oven and allow to stand for 5 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: cardamom seed,sriracha sauce,coriander root,macadamia nut,cocoa powder,vinegar,bicarbonate soda,veal
title: Macadamia Veal
ingredients: 1 kg veal, cut into 2 inch strips | 1 kg macadamia nuts, sliced thinly | 80 ml vinegar | 15 ml sriracha sauce | 200 g cocoa powder | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom seed | 15 ml coriander roots, crushed
instructions: Heat oil in medium saucepan with a medium flame. Add curry powder, bicarbonate soda, cardamom seed, and coriander roots and stir for a minute. Add veal and stir fry on high heat for 2 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in vinegar, sriracha sauce and macadamans. Cover and leave for 3 minutes. Transfer to a clean dish. Serve warm with naan breads or rice.

title: Yummy and Easy Yellow Lentils (Adas Polow Polow)
ingredients: 4 cups yellow lentils | 1 yellow bell pepper ( diced ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground coriander
instructions: Rinse and wash yellow lentils thoroughly. In a pot, mix yellow lentils. Add a few pinches of salt and black pepper. Cook over medium heat for 20 minutes. Add the bell pepper and the ground coriander. Cover and cook at low heat for 10 minutes or until lentils get soft and plump.

title: Chile Jam Jam
ingredients: 1/2 kg green chilies | 1 cup lemon juice
instructions: Wash, remove and deseed the green chillies. Boil them for 5 minutes. Add the lemon juice and boil off the rest of the liquid. Then add a few drops of hot water. Pour the jam onto a clean cloth lined plate or into 1 1/2 inch bowls. Store in a cool place. This jam can easily be kept up to 3 weeks.

Random Ingredients: almond extract,catsup,angel hair pasta,red wine vinegar,tomato paste
title: Pasta With Spicy Almonds
ingredients: 1 package angel hair pasta, cooked, warm | 1/2 cup catsup ( spicy ) | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 1 1/2 teaspoons tomato paste | 1 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Combine catsup, vinegar, tomato paste and almond extract in a saucepan.

Random Ingredients: clove,ginger paste,gouda cheese,dark sesame oil,brandy,peach half
title: Peach Melting French Peaches
ingredients: 2 fresh peaches, halves and pitted | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1 teaspoon ginger paste | 1/8 teaspoon ground cloves | 1/2 cup brandy ( optional ) | 1/2 cup diced smoked gouda cheese ( optional ) or 1/2 cup other smoked gouda cheese ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 f. In a small pan mix together oil and ginger paste. Place mixture on a baking sheet with a lip and bake for 10 minutes, stirring every minute. Slice peaches in half lengthwise and discard stone. Place sliced peaches in a bowl. Add sesame oil, ginger, and cloves. Mix well. Pour brandy all over the peach mixture and add cheese, if using. Add just a handful of this peach/sour mixture to the grated cheese mixture, making sure it gets absorbed evenly. Spread mixture over the entire top of the peach halves. Cook on middle rack for 10 minutes and then turn the heat down to 400 f and bake for 20 minutes or until the cheese is melted. Serve warm with sour cream.

title: Meatballs 101
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds lean beef sirloin, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1/2 cup dry bread crumbs | 1/2 cup chopped dates | 1/2 teaspoon ground coriander | 1 1/4 teaspoons rice wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Whisk bread crumbs, dates, coriander, rice wine, and beef sirloin together in bowl. Roll meatballs on all sides in bread crumb mixture.

title: Quick Tasty Falafel
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas, drained and rinsed ( garbanzo beans ) | 4 -6 fresh chili peppers ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons lowfat mozzarella cheese
instructions: Drain chick peas and discard liquid/sauce. Stir chick peas into chick pea mixture until well blended and smooth and fluffy. Shape into 3 patties with a little cheese on each & sprinkle with chili flakes. Enjoy with a side of your favourite sandwich or on crackers or toast.

title: Muesli
ingredients: 500 g sultanas | 4 tablespoons white vinegar
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a bowl. Store in a bowl in the refrigerator for up to 6 months.

Random Ingredients: napa cabbage,cilantro leaf,broccoli floret,chicken bouillon cube
title: Chinese Vegetable Mix
ingredients: 14 ounces broccoli florets, thawed | 9 ounces napa cabbage, shredded | 8 ounces chicken bouillon cubes | 1/2 cup fresh cilantro leaves, chopped
instructions: Cut the broccoli, napa cabbage, and chicken bouillon into 1 chunks, removing the core and any undesirable pieces. Place all ingredients in a glass 9 x 13 pan and toss to distribute. Cover tightly and refrigerate overnight. Bring to room temperature before serving.

Random Ingredients: oyster sauce,penne,artichoke heart,tomatillo salsa,green apple,pepperoni sausage,oregano leaf,white rice
title: Quick and Easy Spanish Rice and Artichokes
ingredients: 1/2 pound dry penne | 1 green apple, chopped | 3 fresh tomatillos salsa | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained | 1 can sliced pepperoni sausage | 2 cups cooked white rice | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon dried oregano leaves
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in penne, and return to a boil. Cook pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 13 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Transfer the pasta to a resealable plastic bag. Stir the apple, tomatillo salsa, artichoke hearts, and pepperoni into the pasta. Return to a boil, then reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer until heated through, about 10 minutes. Season with oregano and serve.

title: Couscous Muffins
ingredients: 2 tablespoons superfine sugar | 2 tablespoons slivered almonds | 1 teaspoon ground chives | 1 cup couscous | 2/3 cup sour cream | 1/3 cup bisquick | 1/3 cup desiccated coconut | 1/3 cup slivered almonds | 1/3 cup slivered coconut
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c place 1 teaspoons sugar, 2 tablespoons almonds and chives in a microwave safe dish or pan. Microwave on high, stirring occasionally, for 1 minute, until lightly golden. Let cool. Combine couscous and sourcream in a large bowl. Mix well. Stir in bisquick, ¾ cup plus 1 tablespoon desiccated coconut into couscous mixture. Spoon evenly into 6 greased paper lined muffin cups. Bake for 40 - 50 minutes or until done. Remove from oven and sprinkle with remaining coconut and remaining desiccated coconut. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,cremini mushroom,baby spinach leaf,peach schnapps
title: Spinach with Mushrooms and Peaches
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 package fresh baby spinach leaves | 1/2 pound cremini mushrooms, chopped | 2 tablespoons peach schnapps
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Bring a pot of lightly salted water to a boil and add the spinach. Cover and cook for 3 to 5 minutes or until tender. Drain and set aside. Heat the sesame oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add mushrooms and cook, stirring, until tender. Mix in the schnapps.

title: Simple Peanut Butter Chippers
ingredients: 4 fluid ounces milk | 4 fluid ounces smooth peanut butter | 1/4 cup turbinado sugar
instructions: Bring milk, peanut butter and turbinado sugar to a boil over medium heat. Remove from heat. Cover, and refrigerate 15 minutes. Strain mixture through a sieve lined with a clean coffee filter into a bowl, and discard solids. Stir occasionally until all mixture has been added and is smooth and creamy. Refrigerate at least 15 minutes before using, to blend flavors.

Random Ingredients: proof grain alcohol,kielbasa,lard,quinoa,mustard,egg yolk,tomato paste,flat leaf parsley
title: Kielbasa & Quinoa Casserole
ingredients: 2 tablespoons lard, melted | 4 packages kielbasa, cubed | 1 1/2 cups quinoa | 2 tablespoons tomato paste | 1 tablespoon flat leaf parsley, chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground mustard | 1 egg yolk, beaten | 4 dashes proof grain alcohol ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 375°f. In oven proof casserole dish, melt lard. Add kielbasa and cook in the heated lard until slightly brown. Remove from heat and add quinoa. Add tomato paste, parsley, mustard and egg. Mix well. Pour mixture into the casserole and arrange the kielbasa around it. Cover and bake for 1 hour or until quinoa is tender and sausage is cooked through.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile adobo,rice vinegar,wheat bread,sauce,goat cheese,chicken stock powder,oregano
title: Guilt-Free Chipotle Cheese Chicken Toast
ingredients: 8 slices whole wheat bread, without crusts | 4 tablespoons goat cheese ( or more ) | 1 chipotle chile in adobo, finely chopped, seeds and membrane removed | 1/2 cup chicken stock powder | 1/2 teaspoon hot sauce | 1 teaspoon oregano ( mexican preferred ) | 3 tablespoons rice vinegar
instructions: Cut each slice of bread into 4 equal rectangular slices. Combine goat cheese and chipotle. Spread mixture on toast slices, top with remaining bread slices, pressing out excess air. In a small bowl, mix remaining ingredients in small bowl. Brush the top of each toast with a little of the sauce. Spray nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Heat skillet over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,oil,vegetable,fava bean,green chile pepper
title: Karela (Fava and Chile Salad)
ingredients: 2 cans fava beans, drained | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon oil | 1/4 cup chopped fresh green chile pepper | 1 can mixed vegetables, drained
instructions: In a large bowl, mix the fava beans, red wine vinegar, oil and green chile peppers together. Place the mixed vegetables in separate small serving cups. Pour the dressing over the vegetables, and gently toss to coat. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: water artichoke heart,bicarbonate soda,peanut oil,baby carrot,chicken stock
title: Artichokes and Shredded Carrots
ingredients: 300 g baby carrots | 3/4 cup chicken stock | 1/4 cup peanut oil | 2 teaspoons bicarbonate of soda | 1 can artichoke hearts, sliced into ribbons
instructions: Peel carrots, halve and slice across grain into 1cm lengths. Combine chicken stock, peanut oil and bicarb soda in a saucepan and boil until carrot pieces become tender. Drain carrot mixture, return to pan and add hearts. Reduce heat to medium low and simmer for 3 - 4 minutes.

title: "gilded Hint -  Welsh Beet Salad
ingredients: 1 lb beet | 12 slices ham | 1 tablespoon parsley ( finely chopped ) | 1 lemon peel ( shredded )
