instructions: Cut the beet and ham into thin slices. Boil, salted water and add the beet and ham to the hot water, and boil for 1 - 2 mins until the ham is well cooked and the beet is tender. Remove from the heat and add the rest of the ingredients.

Random Ingredients: red potato,strawberry jam,black peppercorn,green pea,feta cheese,calamari
title: Kathmandu Potatoes (Served Cold)
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs small red potatoes, halved ( about 2 pounds ) | 1 lb fresh green pea, cleaned, trimmed, cut into 2-inch pieces | 20 black peppercorns | 12 large calamari, cleaned ( cleaned ) | 10 ounces feta cheese | 3/4 cup strawberry jam or 3/4 cup jam, for dipping
instructions: Bring large pot of water to a boil. Add potatoes and boil over high heat until just tender, 12 minutes. Meanwhile, place 1/2 lb. Green peas in colander and run under cold water until cool, 3 - 4 minutes. Drain, drain again. Pat dry with paper towels. Place potatoes on greased baking sheet. Scatter peas, peppercorns and 2 - 3 peppercorns in even layer over potato. Broil, uncovered, 4 - 5 minutes. Arrange 1 fillet on top of peppercorns leaving 1/3 inch bare around edge of cookie. With a sharp knife, slash a cross on top of each fillet about 3 inches wide. Place 1 crisscross crisscross on top of fish. Bake fish in 400f oven 40 minutes or until very beginning to crisp. Using a slotted spoon, transfer fish to serving platter and sprinkle with strawberry jelly. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: turbinado sugar,beef gravy,cube steak,cilantro leaf,grain white rice,table salt,spinach leaf,coconut
title: Caribbean Beef on the Rice Cooker
ingredients: 1 package long-grain white rice ( i used trader joe's brand ) | 1/2 cup turbinado sugar | 1 lb cube steak ( i use flank steak ) or 1 lb skirt steak, thinly sliced ( i use flank steak ) | 4 cups hot beef gravy ( i use low sodium ) | 2 1/2 cups steamed spinach leaves, packed | 4 ounces frozen chopped spinach leaves, thawed | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 1/4 teaspoon table salt
instructions: In rice cooker, combine both packages of rice and sugar. Set rice cooker to regular stir. Add steaming hot beef and next 3 ingredients. Close lid and process on low for 15 - 20 minutes. Note at 15 minutes for skirt steak. Check for tenderness at inside of cooker.

title: Sauerkraut Rollatini
ingredients: 2 cans sauerkraut, undrained | 1 can italian-style stewed tomatoes, undrained | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 2 tablespoons minced shallots | 2 tablespoons sweet chili sauce | 1/4 cup chopped maraschino cherries ( optional ) | filled rolls with maraschino cherries ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Pour the drained sauerkraut, undrained tomatoes, heavy cream, shallots, chili sauce, and maraschino cherries into a bowl, and stir to blend. Spread about 3 tablespoons of sauerkraut mixture onto the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish, and roll up the roll, reserving maraschino cherries for topping. Arrange rollatini in the baking dish, and bake uncovered in the preheated oven for 50 minutes. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon,pepper jelly,pasta,rosemary leaf,chicken stock,thyme,chunky peanut butter
title: Peanut Butter Macadamia Nut Pasta
ingredients: 5 ounces chunky peanut butter, creamy or | 5 ounces chicken stock | 1/16 teaspoon pepper jelly | 1/4 teaspoon dried rosemary leaves | 1/2 tablespoon chicken bouillon | 4 ounces uncooked macadamia nuts | 9 ounces dry pasta
instructions: Blend peanut butter, stock, pepper jelly, and rosemary leaves. Place macadamia nuts in a food processor and process until finely chopped. To the peanut butter mixture add the peanuts and process again until well incorporated. Season with salt and pepper. To serve add pasta and mix well.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,black olive,vegetable,hoisin sauce,vegetable juice cocktail
title: Peppered Veggies on Hoisin BBQ
ingredients: vegetables, chopped | 1 can chopped black olives | 4 sweet bell peppers, diced | 1 can v8 vegetable juice cocktail | 1/4 cup hoisin sauce
instructions: Put everything in a bowl. Enjoy.

title: Beef With Sultanas and Provolone
ingredients: 3 2/3 lbs boneless beef chuck steaks or 3 2/3 lbs sirloin steaks | 2 large ripe avocados | 1/2 teaspoon chopped fresh rosemary | 1/4 cup sultana, chopped | 2 tablespoons brown sugar | 4 ounces prosciutto, sliced | 1/3 cup kidney beans
instructions: In a large bowl, combine onion, black beans, rosemary, sultanas, brown sugar and beef or pork. Add enough water to moisten. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour or for several hours. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Line baking sheet with parchment paper. Remove meat from marinade, pat dry and cut into serving sized pieces. Heat skillet on medium high heat.

title: Hot  Dipping Sauce Base
ingredients: 1/2 1/2 cup mirin or 1/2 cup sweet rice wine ( preferably japanese sweet sake ) or 1/2 cup kurikake mirin | 1/4 cup dried chili pepper flakes
instructions: Whisk all ingredients together. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: italian bread crumb,shoulder lamb chop,fish,red lentil,salsa,scallion
title: Portuguese Meatballs I
ingredients: 4 bone-in shoulder lamb chops, with fat | 4 scallions, sliced thin | 1 jar salsa | 1 jar red lentils | 1 loaf italian style bread crumbs | 1 tablespoon fish or 1 tablespoon soy sauce
instructions: Pour salted water into a large pot and bring to a boil over high heat. Add in lamb and scallions. Reduce heat to medium and allow to cook uncovered for 15 minutes to cook through. Remove from heat and set aside to cool. While lamb mixture is cooling, wash and rinse the lentils under cold running water. Place in a large bowl with a bit of salsa, rice wine vinegar and fish sauce. Mix well until everything is coated and the salsa has been mixed inches. While lamb mixture is cooling, combine bread crumbs and salt on a plate and roll into long, oval shaped patties. Dip the meatballs in the dry bread crumbs, and arrange on a large baking sheet. Bake at 350 degrees f for 30 minutes or until they are browned. I use a broiler pan for this. The meatballs can be served right away or put them on a baking sheet and bake at 375 degrees f for about 30 minutes, or until well done.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,thyme,israeli couscous,white wine,tortilla chip,salt
title: Caramelized Thyme and Israeli Couscous
ingredients: 1 cup white wine | 1/4 teaspoon salt ( adjust to taste ) | 1 lb zatanna silver couscous ( the kind with the grains ) | 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme | 2 cups arrancia bitter orange or 2 cups dark brown sugar | 1/2 bunch thyme ( to taste ) | tortilla chips, to garnish
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 f and fit two 9 1/4 inch round cake pans together. Bring 1 cup of wine, the salt and 2 cups water to a boil in a medium saucepan.

Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,cinnamon,beer,italian parsley,white wine vinegar,tarragon,bulk italian sausage,pizza crust
title: Olive Garden Pizza
ingredients: 1 loaf frozen prepared pizza crust, thawed | 3/4 lb bulk italian sausage ( hot or mild ) | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 1/2 cup light beer | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/2 teaspoon tarragon | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom pod, lightly crushed | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/4 teaspoon fresh tarragon or 1/4 teaspoon dried tarragon
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Press pizza dough into an 11 x 7 x 1 inch baking dish. In a medium bowl, combine sausage and vinegar. Let stand 10 minutes. Add the beer, cumin, tarragon, cardamon, cinnamon and dry tarragon. Stir. Remove dough from pan. Place on pizza pan. Spoon sausage mixture over crust evenly. Sprinkle with remaining spiced italian sausage. Bake 25 minutes.

title: Szechuan Pork Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs spaghetti sauce ( or meat of your choice ) | 1 inch piece fresh ginger, peeled & grated | 1 tablespoon salt, divided | 1/2 teaspoon chinese peppercorns, cracked | salt and pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to in a roasting pan, combine sauce ingredients and pour over dry saucers. Tightly cover with foil and bake for 2 hours. Serve with cooked noodles.

title: Squash With Pork and Oranges
ingredients: 1 butternut squash | 2 plum tomatoes or 2 roma tomatoes, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup panko breadcrumbs | 2 ounces lean pork | 2 teaspoons orange zest, finely grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 190c. Peel, halve and slice butternut squash into rounds. Place in a roasting tin with a lid and cover. Bake for 50 minutes, or until squash softens and starts to soften. Meanwhile, remove skin and seeds from tomatoes. Cut in half, scrape out flesh. Place flesh in a bowl with rind, panko and orange zest. Toss with bread crumbs to coat.

Random Ingredients: fruit,caper,sofrito sauce,farfalle pasta,chili powder,nonfat milk powder,cocoa powder,bread crumb
title: Pasta with Cheese Sauce & Capers
ingredients: 2 cups farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 1 1/2 teaspoons nonfat dry milk powder | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1/4 cup nonfat dry milk powder | 1/4 cup dry bread crumbs | 1 cup low fat sofrito sauce | 2 tablespoons dried fruit, chopped ( see photo ) | 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder
instructions: Cook pasta until al dente.

Random Ingredients: tamari,monterey jack cheese,broccoli,marshmallow,apricot jam,grain mustard,catsup,cherry brandy
title: Tater Tot Casserole
ingredients: 1/4 cup apricot jam | 1 tablespoon catsup | 2 tablespoons tamari | 2 boxes frozen broccoli, thawed | 1 1/2 cups miniature marshmallows | 1/4 cup catalans or 1/4 cup other smucker's sweet pickle relish | 1 cup shredded monterey jack cheese | 1/4 cup miniature graham cracker crusts
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degress f/190 deg. F. Combine jam and catsup in a small bowl, stir until blended. Add the 1 tbsp apricot jam mixture and the 1 tsp tamari to the broccoli and microwave for 2 minutes. Microwave the remaining mixture and marshmallows in a separate bowl, stirring to melt, until well combined. Pour into casserole dish and spread evenly. Place on the top rack of the oven for about 5 minutes or until bubbly. Sprinkle with cheese and bake for 2 minutes more. Remove from oven and let set for 2 - 5 minutes.

title: Taquitos
ingredients: 6 corn tortillas | 1 teaspoon whole black cumin seeds
instructions: Heat cast iron or cast iron skillet over medium high heat. Place the tortillas into the skillet, cover with a lid, and cook until the tortillas are slightly soft, about 5 minutes. Remove from skillet and spread on paper towels to cool and harden. When completely cooled, finely grind the seeds with a spice grinder, pestle, or whatever you like. Spread tortillas out in a very thin layer on a tray, and put the tortillas in a single layer on the tray. When all of the tortillas have been stacked, stack them again and press them down with your finger. Repeat with the remaining tortillas to make 6 stacks of all the tortillas which will fit in your food processor. Store tortillas in the closed food processor for about 3 weeks. They will keep for up to a week.

title: Caldo Verde (Hominy)
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups undrained hominy, rinsed well | 1 1/2 cups vegetable broth | 3 1/2 teaspoons fast-rising yeast
instructions: Place the rinsed hominy in a 2 quart casserole. Add broth, and yeast and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Reduce heat to medium low, cover, and allow to infuse for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

Random Ingredients: hamburger,clove,peppercorn,almond extract,butcher kitchen twine,purpose flour,garbanzo bean
title: Hamburger Sarah (Hamburger Snacks)
ingredients: 4 hamburger hamburger | 1 bag garbanzo beans ( chick peas ) | 2 -8 unbleached all-purpose flour | 2 -4 cloves, whole | 1/2 teaspoon whole peppercorn | 2 -3 pinches clove powder ( about 2 tablespoons per hamburger ) | almond extract | 1 bag butchers kitchen twine
instructions: Wash and pick over your hamburger. Pat and coat the hamburger with flour. In a large frying pan or dutch oven fry hamburger in hot oil until nicely browned. Drain grease, if necessary, and add other ingredients except for dough, and bring to a gentle boil stirring slowly to avoid scorching. Reduce heat, and simmer uncovered about 40 - 45 minutes, stirring occasionally.

title: Ranch Red Beans & Pecorino Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb dried pinto bean ( about 4 1/2 cups ) | 1/2 cup grated pecorino cheese, about 3 1/2 ounces
instructions: Sort out any rocks or stones and stones that float to surface. Cover beans with hot water by using a 1/2 teaspoon of salt. Soak beans at least 4 hours, or overnight. Drain beans.

Random Ingredients: curry leaf,apple cider vinegar,self rising flour
title: Tippys Cakes
ingredients: 1 cup self rising flour | 1/2 cup apple cider vinegar | 1/2 cup curry leaf
instructions: Sift flour into mixing bowl. Make a well in center and add vinegar and curry leaves. Knead lightly on a lightly floured board. Roll out thinly and cut into 6 squares. Place on baking sheet lined with baking paper if not used immediately. Bake in a preheated oven or moderate oven about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,dark soy sauce,green chile paste,cider vinegar,almond
title: Almond Chutney
ingredients: 1/2 cup toasted slivered almonds | 1 1/2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons low sodium soy sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon green chile paste | 2 teaspoons sesame oil
instructions: Puree almonds and set aside. In a medium bowl, combine 1 1/2 tablespoons of soy sauce, 1 1/2 tablespoon of nonstick vegetable spray or 1 tablespoon of water, the vinegar and chile paste. Add the toasted slivered almonds. Stir, cover and refrigerate for at least 8 hours or overnight. This chutney can also be stored in the refrigerator in an airtight container for up to two months.

title: Aromatic Indian Chess Pie Crust with Cardamom Crust
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cardamom seed | 1 1/4 pounds pie crust | 1 1/4 tablespoons cajun seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Toast cardamom seeds in a small skillet over medium heat until fragrant, 2 to 3 minutes. Pour 1 1/4 cup jager onto a clean plate. Sprinkle 1 1/4 pounds of the crust onto the rim of pie dish. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon of cajun seasoning over the crust. Dust with 1 tablespoon of cardamom powder. Repeat with another layer of the crust and seasoning. Bake in the preheated oven until the crust is browned, 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Peking Dust
ingredients: 500 g savory, ground | 2 pinches red chili pepper flakes ( optional ) | 1 -2 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Combine all the ground savory. Pour the essence over a kg of ground savory. Mix well till all the savory is all coated with this paste. Leave to soak and rest for 2 hours. Put into a large bottle and store in a dry place. Seal up well and leave to mature in a dark cool dark place for 2 months before using. If you open the bottle while it is still liquid, it should smell strongly to balance the spices. Use sparingly, as the aroma of your savory will greatly improve after aging and use sparingly. Note, if using, pour the remaining flavoured savory paste into a clean cloth and tie. Use for making tea, pancakes, cakes, stews or soups.

title: Pineapple and Pineapple Crescent Rolls
ingredients: 1 can refrigerated pillsbury refrigerated crescent dinner rolls | 1 can crushed pineapple, drained well | sliced fresh pineapple ( to garnish ) ( optional ) | mace
instructions: Unroll dough on lightly floured surface. With floured rolling pin, make a well in the center and break down the dough several times. Place pineapple in the center of dough. With floured rolling pin, roll up dough tightly, forming a long, flattened, narrow roll. Repeat with remaining dough. Preheat oven to mix contents of dough with crushed pineapple, using a fork to mix thoroughly. Transfer to a greased baking sheet. Garnish with sliced fresh pineapple, if desired. Bake 25 - 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Hominy and Black Beans
ingredients: 1 package frozen hominy | 1 cup dry black beans | 2 jars hoagie rolls | 1 tablespoon unbleached cane sugar | 1 tablespoon water
instructions: Wash and drain the hominy. Bring the salted water to a boil in a large pot and add the black beans. Cook, uncovered and stirring occasionally, until the beans are soft, about 2 hours. Remove from the heat and remove the beans with a slotted spoon, reserving the cooking water. Preheat and oven to 350 degrees f. Place the hoagie rolls in the oven on the middle rack. Place on a baking sheet and toast under the broiler. To serve, remove and discard the husk from each of the cooked beans.

title: German Beef Rolls
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh spinach leaves | 1/4 cup bacon fat ( optional ) | 10 beef rolls | 4 -6 pieces cooked hamburger ( optional ) | 1 bouillon cube or 1 bouillon cube
instructions: Clean spinach thoroughly to remove grit. Place in pot that has plenty of water on the stove burner to heat at low. It takes about 5 - 10 minutes to prepare and clean the spinach, only washing it once during this time. After you do, the water in the pot will get hotter so be careful not to burn the spinach. Wash the beef rolls thoroughly and cut in 1 1/2 inch slices. If you like, you can use pork and hamburger slices. The rolls may be pounded slightly and wrapped individually in damp cloth or paper towels. You can either put a handful of spinach into a small bowl, or you can just stuff it in a bun if i do. If using a bolognese sauce, put bacon in a pan that has a small pan drizzle of olive oil. Add a small bouillon cube or equivalent and heat for 1 minute before adding to the pan, add the spinach with some salt on the bouillon cube, if using to the pan. Keep the temperature at low so it simmers gently for about 5 minutes. It will naturally become very fragrant. Put the rolls in a baking pan and bake at 350 degrees just until warm through. This does not take very long, but a few minutes might be in the microwave for a few seconds. Take the rolls out and spread with a little more of the bacon fat. Put the ham and burger back in the pan. If you like, roll it up like a burrito. I find that this recipe works best with a crockpot, but you can use a crockpot after you've set a crockpot on low to warm up the oil and bacon fat in it. I do mine in the crockpot which makes enough meat for 8 people. Note, add salt, pepper and bouillon cube to the crockpot, if you really feel like eating a lot of meat. This recipe can also be made in a dutch oven, but i don't remember how long this will be in the refrigerator.

title: Fiesta Snack  (Cocktail)
ingredients: 1 1/4 pints pico de gallo ( i buy this at taco bell ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons coriander powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients, stir and enjoy.

title: Spinach Wraps
ingredients: 4 cups fresh spinach leaves | 1/3 cup packed shredded provolone cheese | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder | 2 tablespoons guacamole
instructions: Mix spinach, cheese, chili powder, and guacamole together in bowl.

title: Pineapple Raisins Candy
ingredients: 3 cups crushed pineapple with juice | 5 teaspoons unsweetened cocoa | 3 packages raisins
instructions: Pour pineapple and juice into a medium bowl, and mix in cocoa. Cover, and refrigerate overnight. Stir in raisins. Store in a tightly closed jar.

title: Pork and Tortilla Panini
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless pork tenderloin, cut in 1/2-inch pieces | 2 tablespoons pickled pork bits, about 2 tablespoons | 1 boneless chuck, halved lengthwise and thinly sliced | 2 medium russet potatoes, scrubbed and sliced | 3 medium lge. frozen tortillas, cut into 1/2-inch strips | 1 1/2 cups seltzer water
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Coat a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray, or line with cooking parchment paper. Spray with cooking spray and place over medium high heat. Sprinkle pork with salt and pepper and add. Toss pork with pickled pork bits, then add. Toss pork with potato and then divide evenly among tortillas. Roll up and arrange in a single layer in skillet over medium heat. When crusty bottom forms, transfer skillet to oven and bake until internal temperature reaches 175°f. Carefully, remove top crust of tortilla from skillet and place in a warm bowl. Remove pork from skillet and place in a warm bowl. Repeat process until all pork is used. Spoon pork and potato mixture into toasted skillet and serve with seltzer.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,rock salt,tamarind paste,sherry wine,sunflower seed,tortilla chip
title: Soy Rind and Tamarind Beef
ingredients: 3/4 lb beef chuck, trimmed and cut into small cubes | 3/4 cup dried tamarind paste | 1/4 cup chinese fermented sunflower seeds, in oil ( i substitute ground almonds ) | 2 tablespoons sherry wine ( or red ) | 8 cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp. sunflower oil | tortilla chips ( to serve ) or other crudites
instructions: Put the beef in a dish and pour the tamarind paste over, cover and leave in the fridge until needed. Pour the sunflower seeds oil in a frying pan and dry roast them over a medium high heat with 1 tablespoonful of the sunflower seeds taken for this recipe. The seeds should not get coloured, but are toasted and browned. Put the sherry and remaining sunflower or almond oil in a saucepan, bring to a boil and add the corn starch mixture to thicken. Remove the beef from the fridge and add it to the saucepan and mix well. Put the lid onto the saucepan and simmer for 3 minutes stir a few times and check the seasoning. Serve on a bed of crushed tortilla or crudites with a dollop of yoghurt on top.

title: Beef With Red Gravy and Onions
ingredients: 1 teaspoon instant yeast | 4 1/2 cups warm mashed potatoes ( not instant, your grandmother would have used 2 pounds, not water ) | 1 large white onion, finely chopped | 1/2 lb white onion, finely chopped | 2 lbs sirloin
instructions: Sprinkle the yeast over 3/4 cup of lukewarm water. Sift 1 cup and let stand 5 - 10 minutes. Add the rest of the ingredients to the dry, mix well. Put into a 2 lb. Roulade bag, and let rise at room temperature for 1 hour. Remove from the refrigerator, drain and reserve. Slice the beef into thin slices, i. E., 1/4 inch wide and 1/2 inch thick. Heat a large cast iron skillet or a deep fryer. Drain the meat on paper towels. Fry the meat until brown. Serve hot with potatoes for the gravy.

title: Soft Taco Meat (Or Noodle of Your Choice)
ingredients: 1 box vermicelli ( or similar ) | 1 package frozen corn kernels or ( 16 ounce ) package frozen sweet peas | 1 teaspoon dried orange peel, grated | 1/4 cup dry vermicelli, crushed ( or other quick or low-fat pasta )
instructions: Using a box grater or a vegetable peeler, cut vermicelli into 1/2 inch lengths.. Cook in microwave or steam pot until almost tender about 3 minutes. Remove from microwave, add corn or frozen peas and orange peel and set aside. Drain any excess liquid from pot or noodles. In a large bowl, mix the meat mix with the noodles. Be careful adding crushed vermicelli or other dry vermicelli, if desired, to suit your preference..

title: Coconut Pancake and Beans
ingredients: 2 eggs | 2 egg yolks | 1 1/2 cups coconut milk | 1 teaspoon arrowroot | 1 teaspoon dried peppercorn | 1 1/2 lbs chicken wings | 2 cups cooked pinto beans
instructions: In a large bowl beat eggs, yolks, coconut milk, and arrowroot until smooth. Stir in peppercorns and chicken wings. Fry gently in a 1/4 cup of hot coconut oil, about 3 minutes a side. Spoon a portion of the batter into each plate. Spoon chicken mixture over, and top with bean slices.

Random Ingredients: new potato,fontina cheese,watermelon,walnut,lemon juice zest,beet,fruit chutney
title: Potato and Watermelon Salad
ingredients: 2 cups small new potatoes | 8 -10 small beetroots, peeled and cut into bite size chunks | 1 cup watermelon, cut into bite size chunks | 1 cup fontina cheese, grated | 1 cup mixed dried fruit chutney | 4 tablespoons fresh lemon juice ( can use 2/3 cup lemon juice ) | 1 bunch walnuts, chopped
instructions: Bring 1 quart water to boil then cook potatoes, uncovered, until tender crisp. Remove from heat then drain. In a large bowl, combine potatoes, beetroot, cheese, fruit chutney, lemon juice and walnuts. Toss thoroughly or serve on the side as soon as you finish tossing. Enjoy.

title: Mexican Fish With Roasted Cherries
ingredients: 1 can roasting chickens | 1 bunch fresh oregano leaves | 1/4 cup salsa ( i like spicy ) | 1/3 - 1/2 cup dried cranberries ( i use craisins ) or 1/3-1/2 cup currants | 2 tablespoons toasted sesame seeds
instructions: Pre heat oven to 375f and arrange the rack in the middle of the oven. Prepare the chicken by removing the giblets and removing any stray organs and membrane. Toss the chicken with the oregano leaves. Cut the chicken on the bias into 5 serving size pieces, the thickness of the bones depends on whether it's thicker than 1/2, or slightly thicker. Arrange the chicken, bones side down, in a large roasting pan or baking sheet which has a lid that fits snugly down around the chicken. Pour 1/2 jar salsa over the chicken, sprinkle with oregano, cover loosely with aluminum foil and bake 30 minutes. Remove the foil, scatter with dried cranberries and bake an additional 20 minutes, or until cooked through. Sprinkle w/ toasted sesame seeds before serving, if desired. Note, when i make this dish, i take the chicken out from the oven, open the door and let the chicken come to room temperature. Weigh or store a small cooking bag with the juices and it makes for a delicious and easy dinner for eating. Serve as is, or with crusty bread or as is, for a quick dinner with crusty bread.

Random Ingredients: oyster sauce,tequila,farfalle pasta,grain white rice,grape tomato,whipping cream,garlic clove
title: Pasta With Grape Tomatoes and Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups short-grain white rice, cooked | 1/2 cup low-fat whipping cream | 1/2 cup tequila ( or more to taste ) | 2 tablespoons chopped canned grape tomatoes | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 1 teaspoon minced garlic clove | 1 lb farfalle pasta or 1 lb other long grain white rice, cooked
instructions: Bring a pot of salted water to a boil. Add rice and cook uncovered for 12 minutes. Drain well and set aside. In a small bowl, combine whipping cream with tequila, garlic and tomatoes. Chill in refrigerator. In a 6 to 8 quart pot over medium heat, combine the oyster and rice. Cook, stirring constantly, until mixture begins to stick. Stir 1/4 cup of liquid from tomato mixture into hot liquid. Stir in remaining liquid, bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer, stirring occasionally until liquid is reduced to 1/2 cup. Add wine to tomato mixture and cook for 3 to 5 minutes. Stir 1/2 cup of tomato mixture into rice mixture and bring to a boil. Cover and reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes, stirring frequently. Serve hot.

title: Beef Cube Steak With Blueberry Sauce
ingredients: 1 can frozen limeade concentrate | 1 bunch spring onion, sliced | 1/2 cup blueberries, crushed | 1 tablespoon chives, chopped | 4 cube steaks
instructions: Preheat oven to 175c. Pour limeade concentrate into a shallow casserole dish. Add spring onions, blueberries and chives. Place steaks in mixture and cover. Bake in oven on 200c for 1 hour.

title: Red Pepper Powder
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons red pepper flakes, deseeded | 250 g vanilla sugar, lightly flavoured | 1 tablespoon lemon curd, deseeded
instructions: Place all ingredients in a non metal saucepan. Bring to the boil, then simmer for 1 - 2 minutes until thickened slightly. Pour into a piping bag fitted with a star tip, close and shake to smooth the mixture.

Random Ingredients: salmon,chicken broth,salmon fillet,flour,grape tomato,wheat pastry flour,lasagna noodle,poblano chile
title: Salmon Lasagna
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups chicken broth | 2 tablespoons wheat pastry flour | 1 poblano chile, chopped | 1/2 lb salmon, pulled or finely diced | 3 -4 tablespoons whole wheat pastry flour, as needed, divided | 1 package lasagna noodles, cooked | 12 grape tomatoes, halved | salt and pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Heat broth and cook poblano and salmon in a small pan until poblano is soft, but not browned. Add 3 tablespoon flour and mix well, then set aside. Bring a large pot of salted water to boil. Add lasagna and cook for 8 minutes, stirring occasionally, or until well done. Drain. In a small bowl, stir together the remaining 3 tablespoons flour and a little broth or water to make a roux. Place the flour roux in a measuring cup and add just enough to make 1 cup, stirring until the mixture forms a thick paste. Add a little broth or water if mixture becomes too thick. Set aside in a refrigerator for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, in a mixing bowl, combine diced tomatoes, salt and pepper, and set aside. Place sauce mixture in a 9x13 baking pan coated with 1 tbsp butter or olive oil. Layer a third of the pasta, a layer of tomato sauce and a pinch or two of salt and pepper. Repeat until all ingredients are gone, ending with a layer of tomato sauce and another pinch of salt and pepper. Top with fresh grated cheese, if desired. Cover with wax paper and foil and bake at 400 degrees for 45 - 50 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Note, you could also brown it in a small oiled frying pan, and serve atop individual servings of pasta for a lighter meal.

title: Quick Indian Spicy Chicken
ingredients: 12 -16 chicken thigh fillets | 1 -2 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Sprinkle the chicken with the garam masala. Place on an oven tray and bake in a moderately hot oven for 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: plain nonfat yogurt,portabella mushroom cap,chunky salsa,apricot jam
title: Chunky Salsa Crusted Portabella Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 portabella mushroom caps, stems removed | 2 teaspoons butter or 2 teaspoons margarine | 1 1/2 tablespoons chunky salsa | 2 teaspoons apricot jam
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Using a sharp knife, slice the mushroom stems diagonally 1/4 inch thick. Place mushroom caps in a 1 quart shallow buttered baking dish. Melt butter or margarine in a small saucepan. Stir in salsa. Pour salsa mixture over mushrooms. Bake 12 - 15 minutes or until mushrooms are tender and cheese is melted and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: ziti pasta,swiss cheese,linguine pasta,plain yogurt,coconut milk,taco seasoning,radish
title: Thai Style Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 9 ounces uncooked uncooked ziti pasta | 3/4 cup plain yogurt | 1 envelope taco seasoning | 1 can light coconut milk | 4 large radishes, sliced | 4 ounces reduced-fat swiss cheese, shredded | 12 ounces dried linguine pasta
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,farfalle pasta,spanish onion,basil leaf,black bean,head cabbage,vanilla essence,fig
title: Pasta With Nuts With Beans, Figs and Cabbage
ingredients: 1 large spanish onion, chopped | 2 -3 teaspoons basil leaves, firmly packed | 1 tablespoon vanilla essence | 400 g dried black beans, rinsed and drained | 450 g farfalle pasta, drained | 1 small head of cabbage, halved | 3 -4 fresh figs, cut in 12 slices | chili oil ( optional )
instructions: Place onion, basil and vanilla essence in a food processor. Blend until onions are well blended with the basil and essence and seasoning is well mixed and onion and herb flavour is achieved. This could also be done by hand if you have a mortar and pestle. Set aside. Cook pasta in a large pan of boiling water until just tender, but still firm.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,poblano chile,yukon gold potato,grain rice,bean
title: Tibetan Fried Brown Rice (Yummelitos Con Gandules)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups long grain rice ( i recommend arroz ) | 1 large green cardamom pod | 2 poblano chiles, seeded and chopped | 1 can baked beans, drained | 1 can yukon gold potatoes, drained and diced into 1-inch cubes
instructions: Heat a nonstick fry pan over medium heat. Add rice, cardamom pods, poblano peppers, beans and potatoes. Fry rice until mixture begins to brown, about 2 to 3 minutes. Remove from heat, pour into a bowl, and serve.

title: Kielbasa With Savoy Cabbage and Tortilla Chips
ingredients: 1 lb kielbasa | 1 head savoy cabbage | 16 ounces tortilla chips | dark brown sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. In a large covered roasting pan, cook kielbasa for 20 minutes. Cut cabbage in half, remove seeds, slice cabbage thinly into coins or bite sized chunks. Dice kielbasa into bite sized pieces. Set aside. Break tortilla chips into pieces and place in a single layer on a large sheet pan. Sprinkle with sugar and bake 6 to 8 minutes, remove from oven and sprinkle generously with dark brown sugar.

Random Ingredients: french bean,onion powder,ouzo,green chili pepper,extra virgin olive oil
title: Crock Pot French Green Beans
ingredients: 1 lb french beans, trimmed | 1 onion, chopped | 2 tablespoons ouzo | 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 can of chopped green chili peppers ( optional )
instructions: Cut french style beans in half, then into 1/4 pieces. Pour ouzo, extra virgin olive oil and green chili chili peppers into crock pot. Add the french onion. Cover and cook on low setting for at least 8 hours. Serve warm with corn tortillas.

title: Sesame Glaze  (Sesame Oil and Demi-Glace Powder)
ingredients: 4 cups sesame oil | 4 cups demi-glace | 30 -35 tablespoons cornflour or 30 -35 tablespoons cornstarch, mixed with a little water
instructions: Mix all the ingredient together and use as required. Store in an airtight container.

title: Cinnamon Cheese
ingredients: 1 box grated parmesan cheese | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder ( optional ) | 3 cardamom pods
instructions: Place the parmesan and the cumin powder in your coffee grinder. Grate a little of the cheese on top of the spices. Add more cheese as you like. Add the cardamom pods. Add a few drops of water or more if you want a milder cheese. If you like a sweeter cheese, add 1/5 more cardamom pods. Pulse until smooth. Put in refrigerator for a couple of hours to allow the flavors to blend up. Enjoy.

title: Mexican Stuffed Eggs
ingredients: 5 lbs fresh ground chuck ( at least 50 % fat, i prefer dark meat ) | salt pork | 1 -3 teaspoon cumin seed | mexican blend cheese ( optional )
instructions: Note, if using ground chuck, skip to the salt pork, and proceed accordingly. Drain the meat thoroughly. Dice the meat into about 1/4 cup sized pieces, place in small bowl of blender or food processor with the salt pork. Cover with a lid tightly, and process on high about 30 seconds until well mixed but not too smooth. Season to taste with salt – the texture shouldn’t be runny and will likely not hold its shape in your egg. Wet your hands with cold water, and take a tablespoon of the meat filling and moisten with the dry spice mixture, and carefully mix it with your hands. Make sure the stuffing is well incorporated into the egg. Line a cookie sheet with parchment paper and place the stuffed eggs face down on. They’ll shrink back in time if you leave them in too long. The trick is to not worry about them sitting in any gaps. If you’d use only the ground chuck, it will still absorb the salt from the meat. If you want to leave them, use a strainer or pair of kitchen shears. The best way to do this is to carefully drop the stuffing into a skillet of simmering water, cover, and bring back to a boil. This is only a quick final phase of the process so you really don’t want the eggs sticking to each other at the bottom. After the stuffing is ready, remove the heaping spoon of stuffing onto the parchment covered cookie sheet, leaving room at the top for the eggs to expand during the baking. Flatten the breads with the back of a spoon, and spoon about 2 tablespoons of stuffing into the center of each egg. Close the top edges of the cookie sheet, pressing the stuffing on the edge to seal the edges completely. You should have enough stuffing for a total of one large, or about 1 - 2 dozen eggs.. Bake in a preheated 350 degree oven for about 30 minutes, or until the eggs are set. Remove from the oven, and serve immediately with mexican style shredded cheese, and salsa at the table. My note, you may have to reduce the amount of ground chuck, according to taste. You may have to dice, depending on how fine or fine you like your stuffing. Instead, you can omit the cumin seeds, but it’s still considered a bit salty. I’ve also made this sandwich using pork, turkey and other favorite ingredients that you can find online. It was a hit, and loved it. This is also good topped with fresh diced tomatoes and fresh parsley or cilantro.

title: Creme Fraiche Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 14 sheets phyllo pastry | 1/2 cup creme fraiche | table cream, whipped
instructions: Lay a sheet of phyllo pastry over a damp towel, and brush with a little truffle oil. Use a pastry brush as a guide to avoid any sticking and burning. Sprinkle or sprinkle more pastry with creme fraiche to cover. Continue layering the phyllo until you have used 12 sheets stacked over the mixture. Spread some creamy creme fraiche on top. Cut out a heart shape from the pastry with a sharp knife the length of the phyllo pastry to form a diamond. Place triangles on a baking Stone. Brush with more truffle oil. Bake in a preheated 425°f oven for about 15 minutes, or until lightly browned.

title: Mexican-Style Asparagus (Ww 5 Points)
ingredients: 1 lb fresh asparagus, trimmed | 2 teaspoons cornmeal | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seed, crushed | 1/4 teaspoon crushed jalapeno pepper | 1/4 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1/4 cup toasted finely chopped pistachios | 1/4 teaspoon crushed cardamom seed | 1/4 cup toasted finely chopped pistachios
instructions: Steam asparagus 5 minutes. Remove asparagus from steaming water.

Random Ingredients: lemon,bread,butter margarine,vegetable broth,pink lemonade,cream celery soup
title: Lemon Chicken (Oamc)
ingredients: 3 cans condensed cream of celery soup | 2 cans vegetable broth | 1 1/2 tablespoons freshly grated lemon rind | 1/4 cup butter or margarine, melted | 1 loaf unsliced bread, cut into cubes | 1/2 cup fresh lemon juice
instructions: In a shallow 2 qt crockette baking dish, arrange bread cubes in a single layer. In large bowl, combine soup, broth, rind and butter. Pour soup mixture over bread.

title: Spiced Garlic Corn on Crostini
ingredients: 2 ears fresh corn, cut in half lengthwise | 1 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 1 tablespoon curry leaf, crushed | 1 baguette, cut into 1/2-inch-thick slices
instructions: Place corn on a plate and sprinkle with 1 teaspoon of five spice powder and curry leaf. Toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Preheat a grill pan or small griddle over medium high heat. Grill for 2 minutes per side, turning every few seconds. To serve, spread slices of baguette with remaining 1/2 teaspoon five spice powder, and top with grilled corn to serve.

title: Quick and Easy Sweet Carolina Baked Molasses
ingredients: 1/2 cup molasses | 3 tablespoons heavy whipping cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a small bowl, stir 1/2 cup molasses into cream. Fold cream into molasses mixture. In a 9x13 inch baking dish pour cream mixture, and spread evenly. Bake in preheated oven until bubbly, about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: white bread,lime juice zest,salt pepper,brown beef gravy,turkey,pork roast,baking potato,green bell pepper
title: Sweet Potatoes Stuffed With Roast Pork and Smoked Beef
ingredients: 1 lb pork roast | 14 slices white bread | 1 1/2 lbs smoked turkey, cut into thin pieces ( or use 2 large turkey roasts ) | 1 medium green bell pepper, diced ( green and yellow bell can vary ) | 4 slices soft light bread | 2 lemons, juice and zest of | salt and pepper, to taste | brown gravy, to your taste ( optional )
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190c/375f/gas in a large roasting tin, brown the roast in butter and half of the peppers and cook them down until they are a nice dark brown colour to your taste. Remove the meat from the roasting tin & put in a bowl on top of the vegetables. Put 3 slices of the bread, slightly crusty side up, on top of the meats. Divide the stuffing between the bread, pressing down to make a hollow in the middle. Squeeze the juice into the hollow and add the other half of the pepper, lemon rind and juice. Add salt and pepper and then sprinkle the brown gravy over the stuffing. Place in the oven and cook until meat is cooked to your liking. Cut the meat into serving sized strips then serve alongside your roasted potatoes and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: grapeseed oil,canadian bacon,italian spice,italian sausage,mango salsa
title: Sweet Italian Sausage With Mango Salsa
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs italian sausages | 1 container mango salsa | 1/3 cup grapeseed oil | 2 teaspoons all purpose italian spices | 1 1/2 lbs canadian bacon
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees. Spray 9 inch glass baking dish with cooking spray. Cut sausages diagonally across grain into 1/4 inch slices. Place slices in baking dish. In bowl, mix salsa, oil, spices and 1/2 cup water. Spoon over sausage slices. Cover. Bake 1 hour or until sausage is cooked through and browned. Transfer to cutting board. Cut in 1 inch pieces. Return sausage to baking dish. Bake, uncovered, 20 minutes longer.

title: Ginger-Ginger Sauce
ingredients: 1 pound fresh ginger root, peeled and cut into thin slivers | 4 tablespoons sugar
instructions: Place the ginger slivers into a blender, and pulverize the ginger bits before measuring. Combine ginger, sugar, and water in a saucepan over medium low heat. Bring to a boil, and cook gently until the sugar melts and the ginger starts to caramelize, about 5 minutes. You can watch it boil, and stir frequently as the sugar melts into the water the ginger so it browns. Watch it boil until the solids have dissolved. As soon as you can smell it, remove the pan from the heat and let the ginger sauce cool for 15 minutes. Transfer the ginger and the sugar liquid into a jar, and let cool completely before stirring to ensure that the ginger flavor coats the food.

title: Eggplant Omelette
ingredients: 2 medium eggplants, sliced lengthwise into halves | 2 -3 okra pods
instructions: Slice eggplants in half lengthwise. Heat griddle or frying pan up very medium heat. When the griddle starts to smoke, place a small amount of okra pods on eggplant half, roll up, and insert into hot griddle using tongs. Do not let eggplant burn. Place the rolled up okra pods on top of the eggplant in a criss cross manner. Continue to lightly brown both sides, making sure to watch the okra pods carefully for a few minutes each side.

Random Ingredients: green lentil,fava bean,celery rib,miracle whip,avocado,anise seed,pesto sauce
title: Lentil Salad With Yummy Dip
ingredients: 1/2 cup green lentil | 1/4 cup pesto sauce | 2 celery ribs, diced | 1/4 cup fava bean | 1 ripe avocado, peeled and diced | 1 1/2 teaspoons anise seeds, crushed | 1/2 cup miracle whip
instructions: Rinse lentils thoroughly and dry them in a towel using a paper towel. Combine lentils and 1 cup water in saucepan and bring to a boil. Lower heat and simmer for 20 minutes covered. Drain and allow to cool slightly. Remove lentils, reserving water, and place in large large bowl or a salad bowl.

title: Candy Rice With Cherry Chips
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice | 1/2 cup sliced fresh cherries | 1 head iceberg lettuce, cored and coarsely chopped ( about 12 oz ) | crusty french bread ( good quality, good quality, or sub sandwich buns )
instructions: In a large, deep skillet, bring 8 cups water to a boil over high heat. Meanwhile, in a medium sauté pan or skillet, cook rice in boiling water until just cooked. Drain and place in a large bowl. Toss with cherries and add romaine and dressing.

title: Apple Fettuccine With Tomatoes, Chilies and Apples
ingredients: fettuccine | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh cilantro | 2 tablespoons finely chopped canned tomatoes with green chilies, undrained | 1 jumbo firm tart apple | 1/2 serrano pepper, minced | 3/4 cup diced peeled carrots | 1/3 cup diced peeled fresh apple
instructions: Cook fettuccine at a boil according to package directions. When cooked, add cilantro, tomatoes with green chiles, and apples.

Random Ingredients: leek,ginger garlic paste,yellow onion,taco seasoning mix,chicken wing
title: Spicy Indian-Style Chicken Wings
ingredients: 1 pound chicken wings | 1 yellow onion, diced | 1 jar or bottle beer | 2 tablespoons garlic paste | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning mix
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease a medium baking dish. Rinse the chicken wings thoroughly in a large bowl of water.

title: Easy Spicy Salsa
ingredients: 1 can tomato paste | 1 teaspoon minced canned chili pepper | 1 can vegetable broth | 1/2 cup finely chopped apple | 1 cup finely chopped carrot, finely chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl. Cover and chill for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, before serving.

title: Grilled Stuffed Tomatoes
ingredients: 2 large jumbo shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1/3 cup mixed nuts, chopped | 2 tablespoons salad dressing | 2 boneless pork loin chops, cooked and thinly sliced | 4 slices prosciutto, thinly sliced | 4 leaves green and white part of a large red onion, thinly sliced | 4 -6 slices yellow tomatoes | 1/4 cup chopped drained canned water chestnut
instructions: Spray grill with non stick cooking spray, set in hot grid over medium low heat, cover and cook shrimp for 3 - 5 minutes or until just pink and remove shrimp and place in bowl. While shrimp are cooking mix together 1/3 cup salad dressing, pork slices, prosciutto, green onion and tomatoes in bowl. Stuff each shrimp with the stuffing and roll jelly roll style. Place on parchment paper lined grill, cover and cook over indirect heat for 10 minutes, turn and cook till lightly browned and cooked through. Place shrimp, tomato side up over a hot salad and drizzle with 1/4 cup remaining salad dressing and sprinkle with nutmeg and the chopped water chestnuts. Serve.

title: Brown Rice and Sun Dried Tomato Bake
ingredients: 8 cups milk chocolate, chopped | 3 cups russet potatoes, peeled and cut into cubes | 1 cup packed sun-dried tomato | 8 cups cooked brown rice, preferably cooked in water
instructions: Mix together all ingredients, except your favorite pasta and place into a 5 quart, oven proof casserole type baking dish. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 - 50 minutes, until the top is golden brown. Serve immediately.

title: Anise Spice Refresher
ingredients: 1 cup prepared sweet-and-sour mix ( prepared as usual by your favorite recipe ) | 1/2 can refried beans | 1/4 serrano pepper, seeded and minced | 1/4 teaspoon anise seed
instructions: Pour the prepared sweet and sour mix into a mixing bowl.

Random Ingredients: sirloin steak,shoulder lamb chop,yellow pepper,dark chocolate,savoy cabbage,tomato soup,horseradish,rye bread
title: Crock Pot Spiced Lamb Chops
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin steak | 1 ounce dark chocolate, grated | 1 cup beef soup, undiluted ( or 1 cup beef stock or juice ) | 1/2 teaspoon bottled horseradish | 10 -20 small new potatoes ( about 1-1/2 cups ) | 2 tablespoons chopped yellow sweet peppers | 1 cup savoy cabbage ( about 2 medium or 2 medium asparagus ) | 4 slices rye bread
instructions: Cut steak in half across the grain. In plastic food bag, combine chocolate, soup and horseradish. Seal and marinate steak 24 hours for flavors to develop. For a quicker dish, marinate beef in soup mixture while assembling potatoes. Boil potatoes until tender, drain, peel and cut in half. Set aside. Remove steak from marinade and grill 4 - 6 minutes on each side or until just barely cooked. Layer potatoes and reserved marinade in crockpot. Sprinkle with sweet pepper and shredded cabbage. Put steak on top, top with bread and broil in pan just until bread is toasted and bubbly. Serve with sauce.

title: Bread Dipping Sauce

instructions: Use blender to blend light mayonnaise, chicken cube and brown sugar together. Dip bread in sauce until coated. Place bread on serving platter. Arrange bread on top of bread. Pour remaining sauce on top of bread. Serve with garlic bread.

title: Chinese Noodle Sweet and  Sour Soup
