instructions: Place noodles in a large pot, and cover with several inches of cool water.

Random Ingredients: dijon mustard,beef,flat leaf parsley,green lentil,squash,kalamata olive
title: Soup With Lentils, Squash and Olives
ingredients: 1 kg beef, shin of, in 1. 5cm, sliced thinly | 2 kg green lentils, in 1. 5cm, cleaned and washed thoroughly | 100 g fresh flat leaf parsley, washed | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 2 kalamata olives, pitted, sliced length-wise | 1 bunch squash or 1 bunch beet, julienned
instructions: Place 1 litre of water in dutch oven and bring to the boil. Turn on the heat and slow boil slowly for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the water is reduced to half its original amount. Drain. In a big bowl, combine the beef with the vegetables, mustard and the olive paste. Cover and pressure cook for 25 minutes. Remove lid and cook for 5 minutes more. Remove from heat and let stand for 5 minutes. Serve.

title: Pasta Con Vincetti
ingredients: 3/4 cup molasses | 2 tablespoons celery, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon lime rind, grated | 3/4 cup tomato paste | 3 tablespoons dried tarragon leaves | 2 cups bottled italian-style dressing | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 5 cups cooked pasta
instructions: Boil water and add 2 tbsp salt and pasta in pot. Set aside until pasta is done. Add molasses. Add celery and rind and stir. Drain pasta, place in serving bowl. Top with tomato paste and dried tarragon. Add enough dressing to coat and mix. Add a few tb sugar. Dredge pasta in sugar, then return to pot. Serve with a squeeze of lime and a spoonful of celery.

Random Ingredients: cake flour,provolone cheese,hot red pepper flake,tomato,mace
title: Cheese Triest for Pasta-Maker
ingredients: 8 ounces sliced mortadella tomatoes or 8 ounces tomato-based hot red pepper flakes | 14 ounces cheese ( parmesan or gouda ) | 1/2 cup cake flour or 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | 1/2 teaspoon red milli ground mace | 1 dash hot red pepper flakes
instructions: Dice cheese into cubes. Combine the flour, mace and hot pepper flakes. Dredge the tomato cube into the flour mixture. Put the cheese cubes into a bowl. Dredge the cube of cheese into flour mixture, pat any extra. Repeat with remaining cubed cheese. Cover a cookie sheet with tin foil leaving enough foil over the edge to fold when cooking. Pour boiling water into boiling water, drop the cheese cube cubes into the water and leave to simmer. Watch out for the steam escaping as you cook. Dunk the cube of cheese into the boiling water and leave to sit for 1 minute. The cheese should be slightly crispy and have no color or texture. Drain the cheese and place on a plate with a lid. If you want to make the triest in advance and store in the fridge overnight this lets the cheese flavor develop.

title: Salsa Crabe
ingredients: 1/2 cup distilled white vinegar | 2/3 cup creamy tartar | 3 hard-cooked eggs, chopped | 1/2 cup chunky salsa
instructions: Place vinegar, tartar, and eggs in a stainless steel bowl.

title: Veal Chimichangas
ingredients: 4 flour tortillas ( or corn tortillas ) | 2 cups cooked ground veal
instructions: In a small bowl, mix the veal with the flour and spread in a thick layer on both sides of each tortilla. Add a good handful of the veal mixture on top of one each of the 4 tortillas. Fold the tortilla like a taco and press down firmly on the tortilla, pressing the edges to seal. If all 4 corners are not sealed tightly, you have enough. Heat a large nonstick frying pan over medium high heat. Fry the chimichangas until crisp about 2 minutes per side. Slice and serve warm.

title: Rice Sheets With Saffron Cream-Orange Sauce
ingredients: 200 g cheese ( emmentaler, cheddar, swiss or gouda ) | 200 g nonfat sour cream | 1/2 teaspoon saffron strand | 4 large oranges or 4 large yellow oranges, washed and cut into segments and then into segments again | 2 green peppers | 2 lemons, juice of or 2 limes | 1 tablespoon orange liqueur ( optional- optional )
instructions: Dissolve half the cheese in the sour cream and add the saffron strand stir to combine. Peel, cut the peppers in half lenghtwise and deseed them. Slice them into thin strips and stir the lemon juice into the sour cream mixture. Chop the remaining cheese and combine it with the orange segments. Stir into the sour cream mixture. Line a baking tray with parchment paper. Add the orange pieces evenly in the tray and brush them with a little of the liqueur if using. Bake in a preheated oven at 390f/200c/gas 4 for 10 minutes. Remove the tray from the oven and sprinkle the remaining cheese over the top. Return the tray back to the oven for 10 more minutes. Transfer the dish to a serving plate.

title: Bok Choy With Chili Oil (Asian Style)
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs bok choy ( or use as many fresh leaves as desired, about 12-inch diameter ) | 2 tablespoons canola oil, divided ( or as needed ) | 2 -5 serrano peppers, stemmed thinly sliced
instructions: Place bok choy into a large saucepan and cover with water.

Random Ingredients: ancho chilies,white flour,pie shell,guar gum,espresso,italian breadcrumb,chickpea,bratwurst
title: Spicy Mini Meat Torte
ingredients: 1 pie shell, unbaked, shell ready | 1 lb hot bratwurst, cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 3 cups canned chickpeas, drained | 1 can italian-style breadcrumbs | 1/3 cup white flour | 1/4 cup guar gum | 3 cloves ancho chilies, roasted, peeled, seeds removed | 2 tablespoons espresso
instructions: Remove from oven and let sit in oven overnight. Turn oven down to 300 degrees f. Line 2 cookie sheets with parchment paper. Heat a small nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Cook and stir bratwurst in preheated skillet until browned and crumbly, 5 - 6 minutes. Drain and rinse in a colander. Drain. Spread out the crumbs on a rimmed baking sheet. Combine the chickpeas, bread crumbs, flour, chili pepper, espresso, and chiles in a large bowl. Press mixture evenly into the bottom and up the sides of the prepared shell, smoothing the surface to coat evenly. Cover with a layer of tomato salsa, then cover with another layer of crumb meat. Sprinkle top with more shredded cheese. Bake on the middle rack for about 12 minutes. Remove from oven, cut into six wedges, and serve.

Random Ingredients: artichoke,eggplant,yukon gold potato,pecorino romano cheese,yam,chicken breast fillet
title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 4 chicken breast fillets, thickly sliced | 8 yellow yams, peeled and cut into chunks | 12 artichokes, thickly sliced | 4 large pared yukon gold potatoes, halved | 100 g pecorino romano cheese, grated | 1 eggplant, cut into pieces
instructions: In a medium size oven proof frying pan, heat oil over high heat. Fry chicken, turning once, for 5 minutes or until evenly brown. Using a slotted spoon, set into pan, and brown other side for 10 minutes or until golden. Transfer into casserole dish. Add yams and artichokes to drippings in pan, and cook, covered, until slightly browned. Return chicken and vegetables to pan, along with cheese and eggs. Reduce heat to low, and leave to simmer for 30 minutes, or until chicken and vegetables are cooked through. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: bibb lettuce,corn tortilla strip,green pepper,lime wedge
title: Crunchy Green Pepper and Lime Tacos
ingredients: 8 corn tortilla strips, or as needed | 1 jar jalapenos with rings, chopped, or more to taste ( optional ) | 4 green peppers, chopped ( optional ) | 4 lime wedges, or as needed
instructions: Heat a cast iron skillet over medium high heat and lightly oil the entire tortilla strip. Sprinkle the tortilla strips with jalapenos and green peppers. Fold one end of the tortilla up and carefully roll up. Serve with lime wedges.

title: Pantry Spinach With Tahini Sauce
ingredients: 1 bag fresh spinach leaves | 1/4 cup dry mustard | 1/4 cup tahini | 1 jalapeno, minced | 1/4 cup dry white wine | 1 tablespoon grand marnier | 1 teaspoon dried sage
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Drain spinach leaves and toss with mustard, tahini, jalapenos, wine and sage. Toss until combined and spread onto a baking sheet to form a thick paste. Bake, stirring occasionally, for 15 minutes, or until sauce is bubbling and spinach is wilted.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,dark sesame oil,hot italian sausage,chocolate
title: Homemade Buche De Noel
ingredients: 1 package dark sesame oil | 1 package graham cracker crumbs | 3 links hot italian sausage | 2 pounds chopped bittersweet chocolate ( optional )
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a large skillet over medium heat until the oil shimmers, 7 to 10 minutes. Pour 1 1/2 cup peanut oil into a small bowl. Mix graham cracker crumbs and graham cracker crumbs into the oil. Add the sausage, and gently toss until evenly coated with crumbs, about 15 minutes. Remove sausage mixture to a plate. Place remaining peanut oil in the same skillet over medium heat until hot and smoking, about 35 seconds. Place chocolate into the skillet, stirring until melted. Drop a small bit of the chocolate into the chocolate, stirring until smooth, about 20 seconds.

Random Ingredients: italian salad dressing mix,pear,confectioner ' sugar,shiitake mushroom,white vinegar
title: Mushroom Salad With Pear Dressing
ingredients: 20 dried shiitake mushrooms, soaked overnight and drained | 1 package confectioners'sugar ( or less to taste ) | 1 package italian salad dressing mix | 1 cup white vinegar | 1/4 cup pear rind
instructions: In a large bowl, combine sugar with salad dressing mix and vinegar. Add the pears and mushrooms. Serve chilled.

title: Cherry Grape and Peanut Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs grapes, pitted, washed and dried ( about 18 cups ) | 3/4 cup unsalted peanuts, coarsely chopped
instructions: If using fresh grapes, cut a crosswise slice on the top of each grape about 3/4 inch below the stem, just off the stem. Using a vegetable peeler, remove the grape skins from the grapes. Toss grapes with the peanuts in a bowl. Cover and refrigerate at least 3 hours or up to 8 days. Store any remaining grape skins in a tightly covered container at room temperature for up to 6 weeks.

Random Ingredients: white fish fillet,jalapeno pepper,saffron thread,bulgar wheat,cocoa powder,cashew
title: Tortados
ingredients: 1 cup bulgar wheat | 1 lb white fish fillet, trimmed | 1/2 cup cashews | 1/2 jalapeno pepper, seeded and chopped | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 1/2 teaspoon saffron thread
instructions: Place bulgur in a bowl and cover with hot water. Soak for 10 minutes, then drain. Place fish in an ovenproof dish. Cover with water, about 1 inch high. Bring to a boil. Cover and cook 15 - 20 minutes, until fish flakes easily. Remove from oven. Cover with foil and set aside while preparing the sauce. Place cashews, jalapeno, cocoa powder, and saffron in a food processor. Process until smooth. Stir into cooked bulgur and cook, stirring constantly, until thick. Serve with fish.

title: Red Lentil and Grape Casserole
ingredients: 3 cups red lentils ( red/golden green ) | 11 grape, hulled | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 1 cup 1 % fat cottage cheese | 1 loaf round sourdough bread, loaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f in a large pot combine the lentils and 3 cups water and bring to boil over high heat. Cover and then lower temperature and simmer for 20 - 15 minutes, or until the lentils and water are tender. Meanwhile halve grape halves and remove seeds and excess membranes from inside grape halves. Cut grapes lenghtwise in half. Place grapes, halved side down, in a 13x9 baking dish. Discard the skins. Combine the almond and cottage cheese in a large mixing bowl. Gradually add the remaining 3 cups water and blend well. Pour wine and/or grape mixture over the grapes until evenly coated. Cover and bake 35 - 40 minutes, until the casserole is bubbly and the topping is lightly browned. Remove casserole from oven and let stand 15 minutes to set. Then cut the remaining loaf of bread into 16 - 8 slices. Place slices on serving platter and drizzle bread with glaze and sprinkle with toasted almonds. Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: sherry,corn flake,ro tel tomato,eggplant,sriracha sauce,beef chuck,thai seasoning
title: Saucy Roast Eggplant (Aubergine) With Sriracha Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef chuck | 1 teaspoon thai seasoning ( sriracha ) | 2 large firm eggplants | 1 cup corn flakes | 1 cup dry sherry | 2 cups canned diced ro-tel tomatoes | sriracha sauce
instructions: Trim visible dark fat from beef.

title: Nuclear Nuts
ingredients: 1 can refrigerated chopped vegetables ( broccoli, cauliflower, carrots ) | 1 can canned cream of coconut ( i used coco cola ) | 1 small chipotle chile ( chopped or canned ) | 1 poblano chile ( chopped or canned ) | 1 tablespoon finely grated lemon rind | 3 tablespoons grated fresh ginger ( not the bottled stuff )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Drain vegetables.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock vegetable,dark sesame oil,oyster sauce,ice water
title: Soy-Sesame Chicken Stock
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs skinless chicken breasts or 1 1/2 lbs skinless chicken thighs | 4 cups unsalted chicken stock ( vegetable stock can be used ) | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce
instructions: Pound the chicken to about 1/2 inch thickness. Heat a wok or large, well seasoned skillet over high heat. In a small bowl, combine the sauce ingredients and mix well. Slowly add the warm stock to the wok, stirring continuously. Bring the stock to a boil over high heat. Reduce the heat to medium and cook until the sauce thickens slightly. Stir in the chicken and serve at once.

title: Flaming Applesauce Sticks
ingredients: 12 large flour tortillas, halved | 1/4 lb sliced deli ham or 1/4 lb thinly sliced ham | 1/4 cup madeira wine or 1/4 cup dry sherry | 1 teaspoon prepared mustard | 4 tablespoons applesauce | 3 tablespoons madeira wine or 3 tablespoons dry sherry
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f. Place tortillas on baking sheet and pat to a 5” circle on all sides. Sprinkle with ham, then top with the remaining ingredients. Bake until heated through, about 20 minutes. Serve hot or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: tomato juice,nonfat milk,napa cabbage,star anise,stewing beef,breadcrumb
title: Quick and Easy Chinese Hamburger
ingredients: 1/2 lb lean stewing beef | 2 cups shredded napa cabbage | 1 can stewed tomatoes with juice | 1/2 cup nonfat milk | 1/2 cup seasoned dry breadcrumbs, flakes | 3 star anise, crasins | 1 tablespoon fresh breadcrumb
instructions: Cut stew beef meat into small cubes. Place in a bowl, add tomatoes with juice, milk and crumbs to taste. Toss until thoroughly coated, refrigerate for at least 45 minutes or up to 2 hours. To use, lightly toast the bread flakes in a nonstick skillet, place beef on bread, top with sauce.

title: Cheese Croutons
ingredients: 4 ounces mozzarella cheese ( about 12-12 slices ) | 2 -5 tablespoons black sesame seeds ( or to taste )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Lay the bread slices on a large sheet of aluminum parchment paper. Spread each slice out with some of the mozzarella cheese. Mix the black with the white and black sesame seeds, and scatter about 1/3 cup on top of each slice. Use a fork or fork so the breads will stick. Bake the breads for 12 - 15 minutes, just until the cheese is melted. Enjoy with a salad and a simple vegetable.

title: Killer Calska (Drink and Beer
ingredients: 12 ounces beer, budweiser | 12 cardamoms
instructions: Pour a little batter into each glass. Add about a quarter inch of salt on the inside of the ice cube tray. Place cardamom in the center of the ice, and place in the freezer till the mixture is frozen about a minute or two. Place a beer bottle with a lid on top of the ice, then turn the bag over. Put the jar away as it will get hard and hard from the ice pack. The ice should be frozen solid and no fresh cardamom or the cardamom can melt off the ice. Remove the cardomom as it is processed with the scoop, transfer to a large storage container and store. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: fish,lemonade concentrate,nutritional yeast,yellow pepper,cayenne pepper,bean sprout,linguine,white chocolate
title: Linguine With Fish, White Chocolate, Green Peppers, & Bean Sprouts
ingredients: 1 package linguine, hot | 1 can fat-free refried beans with seafood sauce | 2 cans fish, white fish, white fish, etc | 1 package frozen mixed sprouts | 1 package white chocolate, cut into pieces | 1/2 cup fat free lemonade concentrate | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon dried nuts or 1 teaspoon dried fruit, crushed ( optional )
instructions: Cook linguine according to directions on the package. Drain and keep hot. Add beans and noodles to a large skillet with a small amount of water and heat over medium heat, stirring frequently until heated through. To build the presentation, top with a sprinkling of black pepper, a sprinkling of dried fruit, a drizzle of balsamic vinegar, or more of your desired toppings.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning,chicken bouillon cube,milk ricotta cheese,plum
title: Baked Ricotta Spread
ingredients: 2 ounces whole milk ricotta cheese, drained shopping list | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning, old el paso | 1/2 chicken bouillon cube, maggi | 1 plum, quartered
instructions: Combine all ingredients until blended and smooth. Transfer to an 8 inch x 8 inch baking dish and bake at 375ºf for 45 - 60 minutes. Serve with your favorite tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: coriander seed,reynolds wrap foil,crisco,coffee,seasoning salt,garam masala
title: Indian Spiced Roast Chicken (Rotisserie) #RSC
ingredients: 12 ounces fresh coriander seeds | 2 -3 tablespoons coleman's original 2 % sodium vegetable oil or 2 -3 tablespoons crisco, melted | 1 teaspoon instant coffee granules or 1 teaspoon masala | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 1 renloins wrap or 1 foil packet
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees fahrenheit, put aluminum foil onto a cutting board to keep the foil closed. Place coriander seeds on the foil to make a spice mixture, combine and let sit for 5 - 10 minutes. Rinse off or dry any remaining seeds, using your fingers and pat spices evenly onto the outside of poultry. If using dry spices, sprinkle spice mixture onto the outside of the poultry. Rub a generous amount of reynolds wrap onto the poultry, rubbing and patting with a dry cloth so the spices don't stick. This will help to ensure a moist, slightly sticky spiced chicken that will be cooked inside. Place the chicken in a shallow roasting tin, or on the rack in the lower part of a preheated oven. Roast for 40 minute. Remove meat from the oven and cover for 10 minute. Check on the chicken and continue to roast for 30 minute while making gravy. Take the foil off to get a nice crusty, crispy crust. Note, if the oven is heating up too fast after 30 minutes it is the same time your turkey is ready to go eat serve sauce immediately on the side.

Random Ingredients: baking powder,philadelphia cream cheese,goat cheese,serrano chili,red bean,brandy,biscuit,caper
title: Mini Red Bean Cheesecakes
ingredients: 1 can red beans, drained & rinsed | 1 package philadelphia cream cheese, at room temperature | 1/4 cup goat cheese, at room temperature | 2 tablespoons sour cream or 2 tablespoons sour cream | 4 teaspoons capers, drained & chopped | 1/4 teaspoon dried hot chorizo or 1/4 teaspoon serrano chili, minced | 1/4 teaspoon baking powder | 1 tablespoon brandy ( optional ) ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Spread the beans on a large baking sheet. Bake for five minutes. Cool on the baking sheet for five minutes. Mix beans with cream cheese & goat cheese & spread into mini muffin cups. Combine the sour cream w/the capers, chorizo, baking powder, brandy & sprinkle over the cheese & top with the remaining cheese/sour cream mixture. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: bacon grease,mung dal green,pecorino romano cheese
title: Rocco Pesto (Bread Pudding)
ingredients: 4 slices bacon grease | 1 lb muddler dal greens | 1 cup freshly grated pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Briefly fry bacon in a skillet. Do not over fry. When crisp outside of dal greens is dark and crunchy inside, set aside. Cook muddler dal greens for 3 - 5 minutes over very low heat, until brightly colored. Immediately, stir in 2/3 cup of sunflower oil and the bacon grease. Place the bread with all other ingredients into a serving bowl or platter and sprinkle with the bacon and cheese. Serve immediately.

title: Gramma's Hollandaise Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup butter, softened | 1 green bell pepper, chopped
instructions: In a medium bowl, mash pepper with butter. Mix well. Serve hot.

title: French Penne With Chicken, Potatoes and Olives
ingredients: 1 package penne pasta | 1 teaspoon olive oil | 1 pound boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut into bite-size pieces | 1 jar pitted ripe olives, drained and sliced | 1/2 cup kahlua | 1/4 cup finely snipped pitted ripe olives
instructions: Cook pasta following package directions.

Random Ingredients: stewing beef,beef bouillon cube,yellow mustard,advocaat,brown rice
title: French Beef and Brown Rice
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef ( cut in bite size chunks ) | 1 1/2 cups brown rice | 3 beef bouillon cubes | 1 cup advocaat ( can be found at most deli counters ) | 2 tablespoons yellow mustard
instructions: Combine the ingredients, except the mustard, in a slow cooker. Cover and cook on high for 5 hours, then leave it overnight if there is any sign of burning. At the end of cook time, put the rice on the side. Sprinkle with the mustard and serve.

Random Ingredients: white onion,italian bread,rigatoni pasta,veal,phyllo pastry,pesto sauce,peanut oil,salmon fillet
title: Pastitsio
ingredients: 250 g rigatoni pasta | 250 g smoked salmon fillets | 125 g smoked veal | 300 g white onions, roughly chopped | 100 g roasted peanuts packed in oil | 1/2 cup pesto sauce | 12 sheets frozen phyllo pastry | 50 g roasted pistachios, roughly chopped
instructions: Bring a pot of water to boil and salt it. Add pasta and cook until al dente. Drain pasta and leave aside. While pasta is cooking slice smoked salmon into thin slice, about 5 mm thick. Place salmon slices on a baking tray and bake in the oven at 150 degrees for approximately 15 minutes or until brown. Remove from oven and allow to cool, slice into about 5mm rounds. Set aside. Chop onions and nuts roughly, using a food processor as you can find it, and saute in oil until lightly coloured. Remove from heat and add the pesto mix. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Grease an oven safe gratin dish with a little oil. Layer half of the noodles on half of the phyllo sheets. Drain half of the sauce mix and then spoon half over the noodles. Repeat layers once more, ending with extra noodles and sauce mix on top. Garnish with pistachios, if using. Bake in the oven for 30 minutes until bubbling and golden.

title: Spiked Cocktail Fish
ingredients: 4 tilapia fillets | 2 tablespoons sunflower margarine | 1/3 cup milk | 1/2 cup dry white wine | 1 avocado, sliced | 2 plum tomatoes, chopped | 3 whole sprigs fresh seaweed pods ( optional ) | 4 fluid ounces strong black tea, such as irish breakfast, or
instructions: Place the tilapia fillets on a plate and cover with plastic wrap. Place in the freezer until ready to use. Heat the margarine in a skillet over medium heat. When the butter has melted, stir in the milk and cook, stirring until thickened. Meanwhile, pour one cup of the wine into the bowl of a blender, and process until smooth. Pour the mixture into a saucepan, and heat gently until hot. Remove the tilapia fillets from the freezer, and discard the plastic wrap. Sprinkle the fish with salt, and return to the freezer. Blend together the avocado pieces, tomatoes, and seaweed pods in the blender. Heat the black tea in a large skillet over medium heat to a boil. Place the fish in the skillet, and simmer for 2 to 3 minutes per side, or until fish is easily flaked with a fork. Spoon some of the warm black tea over the fish in the shell, and top with remaining black tea.

title: Czech Pastries
ingredients: 12 ounces cottage cheese | 1 tablespoon margarine or 1 tablespoon butter | 1 cup toasted pecan halves
instructions: In a food processor, combine the cheese, margarine or butter and pecans and process until the mixture resembles bread crumbs.

Random Ingredients: canola oil,crisp bacon,rum,vanilla,beet,cider vinegar,white corn tortilla,ranch dressing mix
title: Rum and Beet Tacos
ingredients: 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 bag white corn tortillas | 1 package hidden valley original ranch dressing mix | 2/3 cup light rum | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 4 tablespoons canola oil | 2 1/2 cups chopped raw beet | 6 slices crisp bacon
instructions: Microwave the corn tortillas on high in 3 t canola oil, stirring after 1 minute. While the tortillas are microwaving, combine the creole seasoning mix, rum, vanilla, vinegar and canola oil in a small bowl. Microwave until well integrated, about 1 minute, then set aside. Microwave a few pieces of bacon in a 10 inch nonstick skillet on high heat until crispy, about 3 minutes. Drain on paper towels and set aside. When the tortillas are cool enough to handle, slice into 1 inch squares. Place a scoop of the tortilla squares onto a plate and top with 2 t of the hidden valley ranch dressing mix, 1/4 cup beet, a sprinkle of bacon, and 1 t of the bacon bits.

title: Lobster Pasta
ingredients: lobster filling : | 1 pound linguine | 1 yellow onion, chopped | 3 cans diced green chiles | 1 pound frozen cooked lobster tails, thawed
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook linguine at a boil, stirring occasionally, until cooked through yet firm to the bite, about 11 minutes.

title: Halloumi and Bow Ties
ingredients: 400 g halloumi cheese | 1 box bow tie pasta
instructions: Cook bow tie pasta. Cut cheese into chunks and fry in a tbsp of oil. Remove and drain on kitchen paper. Serve straight from the pan.

title: Fried Garlic Bread
ingredients: 6 cubes cuban bread, 1 inch cubes | 1/2 cup dry white wine ( sweet or medium ) | 2 tablespoons fresh dill
instructions: Cube the bread into 1/2 inch cubes. Using a large skillet, heat the wine, dill and cloves of garlic over medium heat. Stir and cook until bread begins to turn golden. Add the bread cubes and toss to mix until coated. Remove from heat and serve warm with hot french fries.

title: Protein Pies
ingredients: 2 cups texturized fresh fruit ( puffs, fruit sticks, berries, etc. ) | 1 cup frozen mixed vegetables | 1 cup egg substitute | 1/2 cup raw unsalted shelled pistachio nuts | 3/4 cup catsup
instructions: Line 3 baking sheets with foil. In large bowl, mix cereals, nuts and fruit with the catsup. Using 2 tablespoons, pipe a 3 inch high spatula around the perimeter of the foil. Fill with 3/4 cup cereals to 1/4 inch from edge, leaving 1/4 inch between. Fold to 1/4 inch in from sides of foil, leaving one inch between you and the foil. Close the foil tightly, press down slightly and press out air bubbles. Let stand at room temperature for 5 minutes.. Slice into 1/4 inch thick wedges.

title: Pork Ribs
ingredients: 1 pork rib rack | 1/4 cup sour cream
instructions: Preheat the oven to 250 degrees f. Place the rack as close to the rack as you can under the rack. Insert the tip of a heavy knife or needle decoratively under the bottom of the rack. Cover the whole rack with aluminum foil and bake for 3 hours.

title: Easy Beef Tenderloin Steak With Summer Squash on the Side
ingredients: 3 lbs beef tenderloin | 1 cup cheese, shredded ( your choice ) | 1/2 cup simple syrup | 1 yellow squash, sliced
instructions: Place beef tenderloin in a shallow roasting pan. Cover generously with cheese. Make a couple slits in the meat. Pour ponzu sauce over meat, leaving an inch or two of space around the meat at the top. Broil 1 1/2 to 2 minutes per side, or until desired doneness.

title: Duck Breasts with Green Beans, Feta and Cream
ingredients: 2 duck breasts | 2 tablespoons cream | 2 tablespoons heavy cream | 1 tablespoon crumbled feta | 1 tablespoon green beans, finely chopped ( optional ) | cooking spray
instructions: Season duck with salt and pepper. Place duck in a large ziploc bag with the cream, feta and green beans. Refrigerate for 4 hours. Preheat grill or broiler on high. Remove duck from bag and spread a thin coating of cooking spray on the outside. Brush with cooking oil. Grill or broil duck 5 minutes on each side, or until a thermometer registers 145f for rare or 165f for medium rare. Transfer to platter and cover loosely with foil for 15 minutes to rest meat.

Random Ingredients: oat bran,cream mushroom soup,alfredo sauce,cider vinegar,pepper,sweetcorn,puff pastry,plain flour
title: Alfredo Slices With Crunchy Corn on the Farm
ingredients: 1/2 cup sifted all purpose flour | 1/4 cup oat bran | 1 bunch of cut seasonal cindy popcorn, chopped ( approx. 3 c ) | 4 packages frozen puff pastry ( thawed ) | 1 can cream of mushroom soup ( about 2 cups ) | 1 can alfredo sauce | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees and grease your baking sheet. Combine flour, oat bran and chopped spring onions in a medium bowl. Cut puff pastry dough in half. On the baking sheet, lay each half onto a lightly floured surface. Use more flour if needed. Fold in flour any flour left over from rolling out the dough. Using a rolling pin, roll each dough square to about 8 squares. Place 1/2 cup of chopped corn on the near edge of each square and 1/2 cup of chopped spring onions across the corn. Roll up one corner of the pastry and place it near the corn. In a small bowl, mix together cream of mushroom soup and alfredo sauce. Brush the top half of each roll with the soup mixture, and the other half of the spring onions. Place the rolls onto the prepared baking sheet. Sprinkle with pepper. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes or until the pastry is set. Serve hot.

title: Foo Fung
ingredients: 12 ounces small portabella mushrooms | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 2 oranges, juice and zest
instructions: Drain and slice the mushrooms. Mix together the cornstarch and the orange zest in a cup. Grate the zest and put the zest into a small dish. Cut the orange in half and squeeze each half of juice from one half into the zest. Cut the slices into 1/4 inch slices and set aside. In a frying pan put in the mushrooms, 1 tbsp of the cornstarch dissolved by the orange zest, the orange juice and the zest. Stir and fry over low heat for 5 minutes. Transfer the mushrooms to a serving dish and pour the sauce over them.

Random Ingredients: banana,soy mozzarella cheese,bamboo shoot,cheddar cheese,white sugar,salmon fillet,ginger
title: Hawaiian Stuffed Salmon With Mango and Caramelized Green Peanut
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets ( skin removed ) | 1/3 cup chopped salted black peanuts | 1/3 cup chopped cheddar cheese | 1/4 cup chopped maui diced banana | 1/4 cup chopped bamboo shoot, drained | 1/2 teaspoon dried ginger, crushed | 1/4 cup white sugar | 1/8 cup soy mozzarella cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Spread olive oil on a baking sheet. Combine peanuts, cheddar cheese, banana, bamboo shoots, ginger, sugar, and light soy cheese in a food processor until smooth. Spoon mixture into a resealable plastic bag. Place salmon fillets in the bag, seal the bag, and shake to coat the salmon evenly. Arrange on the prepared baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until the fish flakes easily when tested with a fork, about 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: goat cheese,pear,salmon,purpose flour,lemon extract,red curry paste,phyllo pastry
title: Red Curry Salmon and Goat Cheese Phyllo Samosas
ingredients: 10 sheets phyllo pastry, thawed | 16 ounces goat cheese | 1 lemon, juice of | 2 -4 teaspoons red curry paste | 1 -2 ounce chopped smoked salmon | 1/2 teaspoon fish sauce or 1/2 teaspoon lemon extract | 1 -2 pear, sliced
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees and prepare a baking sheet with parchment. Slice goat cheese into six equal portions. Place each piece of goat cheese on a square of lightly spray parchment paper. Place about 2 teaspoons of goat cheese in the center of each triangle of goat cheese. Place a few pear slices on top of goat cheese. Place one tablespoon of red curry paste on top of each of the goat cheese. Roll the triangles of phyllo pastry around the goat ingredients and place them on the parchment covered baking sheet. Poke a few holes in the phyllo pastry top with a fork. Drizzle lemon juice over the pastry tops. Bake for about 15 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: zucchini,salsa,head lettuce,ice water,green chilies,vegetable oil cooking spray,salt black pepper
title: Greens and Zucchini Tacos in a Ziploc
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 6 cups zucchini, thinly sliced | 2 cups green chilies, sliced thick, julienned | 1 head lettuce, chopped | 32 fluid ounces salsa ( hot, medium or mild ) | salt & freshly ground black pepper | crushed ice water ( for serving )
instructions: Set oven to 400 degrees. Generously spray a 13 x 8 inch baking dish with oil cooking spray coating. In a large bowl, toss zucchini with chilies, then season with salt and pepper. Arrange in prepared baking dish and brush with oil. Bake until zucchini is slightly browned and tender with no crunch and tender crisp, about 15 - 18 minutes. Spoon zucchini mixture onto 4 small serving plates and top with salad greens. Serve with salsa and crushed ice.

Random Ingredients: hazelnut,cannellini bean,dark chocolate,corn flake,asafoetida powder,russet potato,orange juice,lime juice
title: Baked Brownies
ingredients: 1 cup low-fat dark chocolate, at room temperature | 1/4 cup orange juice, freshly squeezed | 1/4 cup lime juice, freshly squeezed | 2 tablespoons corn flakes, crushed ( or crushed chips ) | 1 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon hazelnuts, coarsely chopped | 1/3 cup canellini beans, drained and rinsed well ( white may also be used. i'vefound the ones i buy in the ethnic aisle in the ethnic aisle ) | 1 russet potato, peeled and coarsely grated ( about 1-1/2-1/3 c )
instructions: Note, i use a fork pushed through a fine mesh sieve to remove or break up the chips into smaller pieces, and a grater. The chips are supposed to be chunky, but not very fine. Bake at 350°f for 25 minutes, then let bake until edges are light brown and toothpick inserted in centre comes out dry. Leave to cool on rack. It will become more brittle when chilled. Store in the refrigerator. This makes enough batter to generously coat three 4 1/2 x 2 3/4 x2 3/4 inch loaf pans. This is not good with vanilla ice cream or whipped cream.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,vermicelli,vanilla essence,hazelnut,beef bouillon granule,cornstarch,veal
title: Beef Noodle Soup
ingredients: 700 g beef stew meat | 1 tablespoon beef bouillon granules | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla essence | 350 g vermicelli, washed and cut in half ( long noodles ) | 300 g ground veal | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 tablespoon hazelnuts, toasted roughly chopped & toasted
instructions: In a large saucepan, place stew meat, bouillon granules, vanilla essence and vermicelli/olives. Cover with water and cook over high heat until vermicelli has cooked through. Do not stir during this time. Remove from heat. While waiting for the soup to boil, place the ground veal in a small bowl. Mix the cornstarch and ground hazelnuts into the soup. Stir and return to the heat for a few minutes until hot. Add to the soup and heat through. If serving with fresh veggies, use an instant rice.

title: Greek Bread Salad With Pomegranate Seeds
ingredients: 4 cups french bread, cut into thick slices | 1 cup pomegranate | 1/2 cup dry feta, coarsely chopped | 4 tablespoons green
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Combine bread slices and pomegranate seeds in bowl. Place on large serving platter. Sprinkle with the pomegranate salt. Sprinkle with the feta cheese.

Random Ingredients: deli roast beef,corn oil,liquid smoke,tortilla,roquefort cheese,pasta shell,tomato,fenugreek
title: Beef With Feta Cheese
ingredients: 16 ounces roquefort cheese, sliced into small chunks | 14 ounces deli roast beef, cooked and sliced | 1 can tomatoes, diced | 12 ounces tortillas | 2 tablespoons corn oil | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke | 1 tablespoon mixed fenugreek | 4 cups prepared pasta shells
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. In a bowl, mix roquefort with tomatoes. Spread a little oil on a large baking sheet. In a blender, liquefort with liquid smoke, fenugreek, and pasta shells. Arrange meat in roquefort tomato mixture, and top with cheese slices. Bake at 450f for 15 minutes, or till tortillas are browned and soft.

title: Brussels Sprouts with Grapes and Bacon
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs brussels sprouts, trimmed and halved crosswise | 1/2 lb red seedless grapes, washed and stemmed | 12 slices bacon, cut into 1/2 inch dice | 2 tablespoons whole wheat flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f line a shallow baking pan with foil and fill with water to come halfway up the side of the baking pans. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil over high heat. Add brussels sprouts and cook for 4 to 5 minutes or until crisp tender. Transfer to drain. Pour cooking liquid into medium bowl. Add grapes and bacon. Toss lightly. Add flour and mix well. Add brussels sprouts and toss until coated with the batter. Transfer the brussels sprouts and grapes to prepared baking sheet. Cover and bake for 5 to 10 minutes or until hot and bubbly.

title: Oven Spiced Lamb With Fresh Vegetables
ingredients: 1 jar mild sliced olives | 5 ounces frozen mixed vegetables ( broccoli, carrots, celeriac ) | 1 tablespoon grenadine | 1 pinch chili pepper flakes | 1/2 cup lamb stock | 3 tablespoons light cream ( optional )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 120 c. Oil a large ovenproof dish well with pam. Mix all the ingredients together, season and pour over the lamb. Cover and bake for 2 hours until the meat is cooked, the vegetables are tender and the liquid has reduced. Serve with your favourite vegetables.

Random Ingredients: apple cider vinegar,lavender flower,maraschino cherry,red cabbage,cremini mushroom
title: Polish Mushroom Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup apple cider vinegar | 2 tablespoons dried maraschino cherries, drained | 1 tablespoon dried lavender flowers | 1/2 cup red cabbage, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup cremini mushroom, thinly sliced
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together vinegar, cherries, lavender, cabbage, and mushrooms. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: rice noodle,penne,red pepper,garlic clove,blue curacao,cream chicken soup,gingerroot,shrimp paste
title: Shrimp Pasta With Crab Noodles, red pepper, and Blue Curacao
ingredients: 1 lb shrimp paste | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1/8 cup garlic clove, minced | 1 teaspoon gingerroot ( grated or grated fresh ) | 1/2 red pepper, cut into thin strips | 1 package rice noodles, fettuccine-type pasta such as fettuccine-canola | 1/3 - 1/2 cup blue curacao | 1/4 cup sliced roasted red pepper ( optional )
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. While water is coming to a boil, combine the shrimp paste, soup, garlic, ginger, and red chili pepper in a small mixing bowl, and set aside. Boil the pasta in the boiling water until al dente, drain, and set aside. Combine the shrimp paste, soup mixture, red pepper, and blue curacao in a 1 1/2 quart glass casserole dish. Cook on low for 4 - 5 minutes. Remove from the heat, and mix in the cooked pasta. Stir once or twice to combine, adjust the seasoning and serve hot.

title: Vegan Pies
ingredients: 1 package pie crust | 3 tablespoons nutritional yeast | 1/2 teaspoon thyme sprig ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 c. Spray a 12 x 5 inch baking tray with cooking spray. Place the crust in the oven to warm up. Make sure the oven temperature is in the center of the oven. Place a nonstick frying pan on the stove and add the nutritional yeast to make a paste. Pour the yeast into a small bowl and sprinkle in the thyme. Beat with a fork to keep the mixture from frothy until it's creamy. Add the warm dough to the pan and mix until it becomes an even, thick mass. Place the dough into the prepared baking dish. Allow to bake in the oven for 10 minutes. Remove from the oven and place on a clean surface. Spread the vegan margarine over the hot pie. Cut into eight squares. Place on a tray and return to the oven. Allow to bubble for another 10 minutes. Remove and cut into four pieces and serve.

title: Traditional Shortbread and Meat for Stove Top Loaf
ingredients: 3 1/2 ounces lamb fat or 3 1/2 ounces soft pork fat | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/2 lb shortbread
instructions: Line a shallow 20 - 1 lb loaf tin with greaseproof paper. Mix all of the filling ingredients together and then spread over the shortbread using a glancing action starting with the fat. Place the loaf tin on a wire rack and weight. Carefully peel away the paper and bake at 400° f/200°c for 1 1/4 hrs on middle shelf and 1 hour on bottom shelf. When well risen, remove and cool.

title: Cheddar Smoked Tomato Potato Casserole
ingredients: 3 lbs baby potatoes | 1/4 lemon, rind of | 1 bunch cheddar cheese, shredded | 14 ounces tomato juice
instructions: Boil the potato's in water for about 12 minutes until they are just fork tender, drain. Cut the potato's into quarters and place in a lightly oiled casserole dish. Sprinkle both sides with lemon rind. Spoon in the tomato juice. Cover the dish with cheese. Bake in a 180 degree celcius oven for about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: caper,vinegar,red lentil,fennel seed,granny smith apple,baking potato,chinese chili sauce,artichoke heart
title: Lentils and Artichokes in Sweet Chili Sauce(Khi-Ye Sabzi)
ingredients: 4 tablespoons red lentils, washed | 4 ounces granny smith apples ( fuji or yaki ) | 18 ounces artichoke hearts, quartered | 1 can anchovies packed in oil, drained and chopped | 2 tablespoons vinegar | 2 tablespoons chinese chili sauce ( la choy brand ) | 1 tablespoon fennel seed | 4 ounces dried shiitake chinese chili sauce ( la choy brand ), halved
instructions: Soak lentils overnight, or cook fresh if you cook dried. Drain. Boil in salted water until soft, then drain. Peel and slice apples, stir fry in 1 1/2 tbsp of the anchovy oil, until tender. Arrange lentils in a single layer in a shallow dish. Layer them with the apples, artichoke hearts, and artichokes, and drizzle with remaining anchovy oil. Combine vinegar and choy or chili sauce and pour over, stirring quickly so that it doesn't burn. Add fennel seeds and chillies to taste.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,rice wine vinegar,kosher salt,vegetable,cauliflower,fine sea salt,savory
title: Veggies With Rice Wine Vinegar
ingredients: 3 lbs mixed vegetables | 2 teaspoons fine sea salt | 2 teaspoons dark soy sauce | 6 ounces rice wine vinegar | 4 tablespoons minced savory | 2 teaspoons kosher salt | 1 head cauliflower ( approx. 12-16 long and cut into 5- to 6-inch florets )
instructions: Bring 2 quarts of water to a boil and add the salt. Cut away the stem and leaves from the cauliflower and place into cold water. Boil the cauliflower until tender, about five minutes. Drain and pat dry. Cut it into florets and toss them with the remaining ingredients in a bowl until combined. Add the veggies to the water as you serve them.

Random Ingredients: ra el hanout spice mix,onion powder,bean,chunky salsa,onion soup mix,green chili pepper
title: Mexican Jumping Beans
ingredients: 1 chopped onion | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 1 packet dry chunky salsa | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1 can baked beans | 1 can chopped green chili peppers
instructions: Add all ingredients to a dutch oven and cook on low heat for at least two hours, but not more than five.

Random Ingredients: greek yogurt,banana,serrano ham,veal,penne rigate,italian seasoning,hamburger,cider vinegar
title: Spam's Beef, Ham and Veal Penne Rollettes
ingredients: 1 jar barilla spiral cooked penne rigate | 1 lb ground veal | 1/2 lb hamburger | 1/2 cup of sliced serrano ham | 16 ounces light greek yogurt | 1/2 cup cider vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1 ripe banana, mashed
instructions: In large skillet, saute meat and drain well. Add all the other ingredients including meat. In separate saucepan, mix well and let simmer over low heat for 10 minutes. Let cool slightly and add to meat mixture. Serve over egg noodles.

title: Mexican Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 pound spaghetti | 1 jar thick and chunky salsa | 2 cups grape leaves
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the spaghetti, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Serve with salsa and grape leaves for dipping.

title: The Easiest Lemon Pie
ingredients: 2 tablespoons peanut butter | 1/2 cup buttermilk | 1/2 cup peanut butter | 1/2 cup half-and-half cream | 1/2 cup lemonade | 1 unbaked pie shells
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Whisk peanut butter, buttermilk, peanut butter, half and half, and lemonade together in a bowl to make the peanut butter sauce. Pour mixture into pie crust. Bake in the preheated oven until crust is golden brown, about 30 minutes.

title: Spinach & Ham Salad
ingredients: 2 bunches fresh spinach leaves, torn into bite-sized pieces | 1 slice ham, chopped | 1 slice genoa salami, chopped, can add more if desired | 1/3 cup whipping cream | 1 ounce finely shredded pecorino cheese
instructions: Place the washed and chopped spinach in a salad bowl. Heat a small amount of oil in a small frying pan. Fry the ham and salami for 2 - 3 minutes or until golden. Remove from the pan and crumble it into the spinach. Pour the whipping cream over the salad and serve at once.

Random Ingredients: green grape,cumin powder,blue cheese,baby carrot,basil leaf
title: Blue Cheese Carrots With Basil and Green
ingredients: 1 bag baby carrots, cut on diagonal 1 inch thick | 1/4 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/3 cup fresh basil leaf, cut into chunks | 1/3 cup fresh green grape, halved ( about 1 cup ) | 1/4 cup crumbled blue cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Put the carrots on a large baking sheet. Sprinkle each with 1/4 tsp of the cumin and half the basil. Bake for about 15 minutes or until tender crisp, stirring occasionally. Place the remaining cumin and basil in a medium bowl. Add the grape, cheese and remaining basil and toss to coat. Serve immediately.

title: Hot Steamed Red Wine
ingredients: 1 cup red wine | 2 cloves garlic powder, crushed | 2 star anise, cracked | 1 1 tablespoon plain flour | 1 stalk celery, washed ( with leaves )

instructions: Put everything in a bowl with a little butter. Stir with a fork.

instructions: Prepare your outdoor grill for high heat. Add meat to smoker box with 1 cup of bourbon. Close the cover, place on high heat, and smoke about 20 minutes or till meat is done to your liking.

title: Greek Fried Rice
ingredients: 2 cups steamed rice ( i use leftover brown rice ) | cooking spray | 6 5/8 ounces semolina flour | 3 3/8 ounces rice vinegar | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix everything well except for rice.. Dip rice in rice batter and let sit for 5 minutes, or until browned and cooked. Serve.

title: Lamb and Cannelloni Wrapper

instructions: Cook cannelloni in 2 cups boiling water according to package directions until tender but still firm, about 6 minutes. Drain. Place ground lamb in a small non stick skillet. Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,red onion,cheese,nectarine,bamboo shoot,black bean sauce
title: Bean and Nectarine Hot-Pot
ingredients: 1 nectarine, cut into wedges | 1/4 cup carrot, shredded | 2 large nectarines, cut into wedges | 2 tablespoons vegetable stock | 2 tablespoons black bean sauce, or more, to taste | 2 tablespoons minced red onions
instructions: Place nectarine and carrot into a steamer basket over boiling water. Cover, and steam nectarine until tender, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat, and fluff nectarine with a fork. Stir in nectarines, and add bean sauce and red onion with black bean sauce.

title: Mint Glazed Lamb

instructions: Heat grill to high. Combine lamb, honey and oil in a large sealable plastic bag. Seal bag.

title: Curried Noodles - Low Fat or Gluten Free

instructions: Bake the potatoes in a large pot in a single layer for 1 to 1 1/2 hours in a preheated 350 degree oven until they are crispy all the way. Drain and blot dry with paper towel. Cook the pasta in plenty of boiling salted water for about 7 to 8 minutes or until tender.

instructions: Place pork tenderloins in gallon size resealable plastic bag, and pound to 1/8 inch thickness. Transfer pork to cutting board. Using a sharp knife, cut deep slits all over pork. With fingertips, rub 1 tablespoon margarine over the cuts. Place pork in gallon size resealable plastic bag. Pour chicken broth into freezer bag.

title: Roasted Plantains (Or Eggplant) Salad
ingredients: 1 peeled plantain, about 1 1/2 lbs | 1/2 lb ground round | 1/2 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 1/4 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 2/3 cup mixed cashews | 2 teaspoons finely grated orange rind | 2 -3 teaspoons balsamic vinegar | 1 teaspoon dried orange rind | 1 1/2 teaspoons fine dry breadcrumbs ( optional ) | fine dry breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees. If using peeled plantains, halve them lengthwise and discard the cores, seeds and membrane. Spoon the mixture into an ungreased baking sheet and sprinkle each with 1 1/2 teaspoons of bread crumbs, if using. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, stirring halfway through, until the stuffing is crispy.

instructions: Preheat oven 425f. In a bowl mix apple juice, apple juice, apple juice concentrate and mushrooms mix well. Spread mixture over bottom of parchment paper lined 13x9 pan. Spread pastry on top and sides of mushroom mix and spread evenly. Cover with top crust bake 30 - 40 minutes or until golden brown. Remove from oven let stand 10 minutes before cutting into squares.

title: Homemade Pepperoni
ingredients: 1 package pepperoni, halved | 1/3 cup diced green bell pepper | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Combine pepperoni, green bell pepper, salt, and pepper in a bowl. Cover and refrigerate the pepperoni mixture while making the peanut sauce for dipping.

title: Peanuts (Tortilla Shells)

instructions: Wash asparagus well and slice the young part as thinly. Combine asparagus with the rest of the ingredients except the peanuts. Sauté in oil until slightly brown.

title: Fajita Indian Beans
ingredients: 1/2 cup prepared bean | 1/4 cup tea ( i used decaf ) | 2 tablespoons rice wine | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1 cup frozen baby lima beans
instructions: Bring all ingredients to boil in a medium saucepan, then reduce heat to medium low and simmer, covered, 5 minutes. Serve hot with warm tortillas.

ingredients: 4 boneless chicken breast halves ( about 4 pounds total ) | barbecue sauce | fresh thyme sprig | 4 slices bacon | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh marjoram | 1/2 cup low-sodium barbecue sauce | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh marjoram | 1 slice bread, coarsely crumbled
instructions: Place chicken in a dutch oven. Drizzle with barbecue sauce. Top with thyme.

title: Melt Your Own Sugar Candy and Cinnamon Lard
ingredients: 1 lb melted lard, cool | 1 lb sugar ( about 10 cups raw sugar ) | half-and-half
instructions: Mix sugar and lard together. Make into 8 balls. Place on a greased cookie sheet, and flatten with a rolling pin. Bake 25 - 30 minutes.

title: Beef Hot dog
ingredients: 1 jar pepperoni, cut into 1 inch, squares | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/4 cup white vinegar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. In a medium size bowl, combine all ingredients. Cover and chill in the refrigerator 1 to 4 hours before serving.

title: Easy Yeasty Loaf
ingredients: 1 cup white whole wheat flour | 1 package fast rising yeast or 1 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Whisk together and let set on counter.. Mix together 1 cup of flour and yeast and add 2 - 3 cups of remaining flour. Once mixed thoroughly in, knead until smooth and not sticky. Place dough on greased cookie sheet and let double. I kneaded 6 - 8 minutes each. Remove from dough. Let rest for another 10 minutes. Shape like you would an oat, on lightly greased baking pan, cover loosely, let rise in a warm place for 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 325°f. Bake for 40 - 50 minutes.

Random Ingredients: splenda sugar substitute,salsa,mango powder,red wine,chocolate syrup,italian plum tomato
title: Mexican Plum Tomato Mango Frappe
ingredients: 1/4 cup splenda sugar substitute | 1 cup fruity red wine | 1 mango, sliced to 1/4-inch strips | 3/4 cup salsa | 1 can mexican plum tomatoes, coarsely chopped | 14 ounces chocolate syrup
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine the splenda and 1/4 cup of the wine. Cook over high heat until almost all of the liquid has evaporated. Reduce heat to low and add the mango slices. Cook until the mango is warm to the touch, about 5 minutes. Add the sausages and remaining wine reduction. Sauté until the edges of the sausages begin to curl, about 4 minutes more. Transfer to a serving bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Let stand until cool, about 1 hour. Meanwhile, in a blender, combine the remaining 1/4 cup of wine, the salsa, tomatoes and syrup. Cover and puree until smooth, about 1 minute. Pour over the top of the sausages and serve straight away.

title: Raisin and Parmesan Spread
ingredients: 4 cups mayonnaise | 1 pound fresh raisins, coarsely chopped and patted dry | 1/2 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Mix mayonnaise and raisins together in a food processor until well combined and very finely chopped. Add parmigiano reggiano cheese.

Random Ingredients: shiitake mushroom,italian seasoning,agave,nut,white fish fillet,dark red kidney bean
title: Italian Fish with Shiitake and Beans
ingredients: 2 1/2 pounds white fish fillets, cubed | 1 pound shiitake mushrooms, stemmed and sliced | 1/4 cup dried shiitake seaweed, soaked in water for 1 hour | 2 tablespoons agave ( dark, cane ) | 1/4 cup dark red kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning, or to taste
instructions: Cook fish in a large pot over medium high heat until opaque, 4 to 6 minutes. Remove fish from pot and place in a bowl. Mix in mushroom slices, and soak shittake in water to cover for 15 minutes. Drain shittake, reserving soaking water. Cut shittake and mushrooms in half, and set aside. Spread seaweed on a plate, and place in a steamer over 1 inch of simmering water. Cover, and place over simmering water. Steam for 20 minutes, or until shittake and seaweed are tender. Stir garlic into fish just before removing from the heat. Meanwhile, stir agave and red kidney beans into soup, and bring to a boil. Remove steamer from heat, add reserved shittake and mushrooms, and allow to cool completely. Pour fish into soup bowls or serve into dishes.

title: Coriander Rice Cookies
ingredients: 1/2 cup pecans | 1/2 cup whole wheat flour | 1/2 teaspoon ground coriander | 1/3 cup coconut milk | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 1/2 cup sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 f. In a small bowl combine the pecans and flour. Add the coriander, coconut milk and almond extract. Mix well. Roll into small walnut sized balls. Place on baking sheets. Bake for 6 to 8 minutes depending on the thickness. In a small pan combine the sugar and water. Cook over low heat until sugar is dissolved. Set aside to cool. Once cooled, place biscuits on a serving tray and coat with the sugar syrup.

title: Oatmeal Smoothie (No Fat)
ingredients: 500 g milk chocolate or 500 g chocolate candy melts ( i use hershey's ) | 1/2 cup quick-cooking oats | 1 small gingerroot, grated and finely chopped
instructions: Line the base of 2 large glasses with foil or parchment paper and generously butter them. Scoop 600gms of chocolate and finely slice into fine thin rounds. Place the oats and ginger finely chopped in a mortar and pestle or spice grinder fitted with a fine blade or food processor and process until very finely ground or finely ground. Place the oats, ginger and chocolate in the prepared glasses. Pour the remaining 200ml full of cold water and 100ml boiling water into the jug. Stir vigorously until the mixture is smooth. Fill the glasses with the smoothie mixture, pressing down firmly to level it. Cover the glasses with clingfilm and refrigerate 4 - 5 hours or until set. Remove the glasses and serve with crushed ice.

Random Ingredients: baby bok choy,yellow bell pepper,white vinegar,salt pork,cauliflower floret,water

instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees. Sprinkle the salt pork evenly over the pork and arrange the bell peppers and cauliflower over the top. Pour in the water, cover, and bake for about 20 minutes. Remove from the oven, and sprinkle the vinegar over the pan. Return the vegetables to the oven and bake until the pork and cauliflower are fork tender, about a 1/2 hour. Serve right away.

instructions: Toasted walnuts, in a medium bowl, combine peanuts, celery, parsley, chili, mustard and pepper.

instructions: Preheat oven at 350 degrees. In a medium casserole dish, mix the beans with their liquid, sausage, and cloves. Place in oven. Bake covered for 1 hour. Top with cheese slices and a dash of tobasco.

instructions: Place the potatoes into a large saucepan, cover with cold water, bring to the boil and simmer for about 30 minutes or until easily pierced with a sharp knife. Cover and place in the oven for 20 minutes until the frosting is firm and golden.

Random Ingredients: key lime juice,cumin powder,crescent,banana,mint,date,salad oil,head cabbage
title: Fruit-Filled Crescent Rolls
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon salad oil | 4 tablespoons key lime juice | 1 cup chopped fresh fruit or 1 cup canned fruit | 1 large head of cabbage or 1 large savoy cabbage, shredded | 1 cup coarsely chopped dates or 1 cup finely chopped pecans | 1/4 cup minced fresh mint | 1/4 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 medium banana
instructions: In mixing bowl, mix all ingredients except banana. Mix in banana until well combined. Cover and refrigerate for one hour. On floured surface, roll dough to 1/8 inch thickness. With a 3 inch long biscuit cutter, cut 6 - 8 diagonal slashes into dough. You may also use a pizza cutter to cut the dough. Repeat until mixture is used up. Cover and refrigerate until ready to use. Heat one inch of vegetable oil in a skillet. Add one of the dough slabs to the pan and cook over high heat, turning frequently until well browned. Remove and drain on paper towel. Repeat until all the dough has been used. Re grease pan. Using a pastry brush, spread 1/3 cup of the vegetable oil mixture over each dough slab. Lay 8 or ten dough slabs in each pan. Spoon 1/4 cup of vegetable oil mixture over each crust. Spread remaining vegetable oil mixture over tops of crusts. Bake in a 300°f oven for about 45 minutes. Slabs are cooked when crisp and golden. Serve hot immediately. Enjoy.

instructions: In a medium bowl, beat egg yolks with a whisk until thick and lemon colored. Heat over medium heat in a small saucepan until very hot, swirling occasionally. Cook macaroni in boiling water until crisp tender, 4 - 5 minutes. Drain. Combine macaroni with melted chocolate and remaining tablespoon of chocolate buttercream. Beat until well blended. Season with salt and pepper, stir in parsley, and serve.

title: French Baguette
ingredients: 1 package active dry yeast | 1 1/2 cups sherry wine
instructions: In a small mixing bowl, sprinkle the yeast over 1/2 cup sherry and let proof until creamy and foamy. Stir the sherry with a fork or spoon into the yeast mixture. When thick, cover the bowl and chill for 2 hours. When ready to use, knead by hand for at least 15 minutes until smooth and elastic. Place the dough in a greased bowl, turning to coat. Cover with a towel and let rise 1 hour in a warm place until doubled. Bake as directed in your recipe. Serve cold. The best way to do this is to place dough in a well oiled and floured pan, pressing with the bottom of a measuring cup on your pan wall. Then, with your hands, flatten and stretch the dough to the shape of a bagel.

Random Ingredients: orange,plain yogurt,walnut oil,white chocolate chip,red lentil,red capsicum,red chilies

instructions: Place lentils and capsicum in a medium saucepan with 5 3/4 cups water. Bring to the boil over high heat. Remove from the heat and stir in the chile mixture until heated through. Pour the hot chocolate into the lentils and mix well. Cover and cool immediately. Transfer the lentil mixture to a serving dish. Top with the white chocolate chips and chillies, if using.
