Random Ingredients: anchovy,chinese chili sauce,vital wheat gluten,fish sauce,cardamom,baby arugula
title: Arugula With Anchovies #Aubergine!
ingredients: 1/4 cup fish sauce, asian ( nuoc mam ) | 1/4 teaspoon chinese chili sauce | 1/4 cup baby anchovy ( optional ) | 1/4 cup ground cardamom | 4 leaves iceberg lettuce ( romaine ) or 4 leaves arugula | 1/2 cup vital wheat gluten ( can use gluten free wheat gluten if required )
instructions: Rinse arugula and cut into 3/4 pieces. Heat a non stick sauté pan, add fish sauce and chili sauce. Let simmer over med hi heat. Add arugula and mix to wilt leaves. Add the anchovies, cardamom, and the cheese mixture. Serve immediately as a snack option. Tips, you can buy anchovies from the oriental food or oriental grocery stores, or you can buy your can of anchovies asian style, etc.

Random Ingredients: mirin,date,lemon peel,ketchup,baby bok choy,white bread cube,nonstick cooking spray
title: Breakfast Lovers French Canadian Bok Choy and Dates
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ketchup | 2 tablespoons mirin ( chinese sweet wine ) | 1/4 teaspoon grated lemon peel | nonstick cooking spray | 2 tablespoons shredded cooked baby bok choy | 1/2 bread cube, crumbled | 1/2 small white bread cube, crumbled
instructions: Combine ketchup, mirin and lemon peel in a small bowl. Add bread, bok choy and crumbled bread cubes. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes. Remove chicken from marinade. Remove crusts from bread and discard.

Random Ingredients: vanilla essence,baking potato,dijon mustard,fenugreek,greek yogurt,red potato,crust,lemon zest
title: Roast Potatoes & Greek Yogurt Dip
ingredients: 1 baked peeled potato | 1 large red potato | 1 cup greek yogurt ( plain or vanilla ) | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 3 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1 teaspoon dried fenugreek | 2 teaspoons grated lemon zest | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 1/8 teaspoon crusty crumb
instructions: Preheat oven to 220c. Combine greek yogurt, 2 tbsp mustard, fenugreek, lemon and vanilla in a small bowl. Set aside. Remove potato & red potato from packaging & set aside. Cut potato into wedges.

title: Salmon Baked With Pistachio
ingredients: 1/2 kg whole sea bass or 1/2 kg salmon, cleaned | 125 g pine nuts | 35 -50 g pistachio nuts, roughly chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Remove the skin and bones from the fish and cut the fish into roughly the same size squares as the pine nuts. Arrange a small pile of pistachios onto a large baking tray, sprinkle over a little more pistachios and a little more pistachios. Place the fish on the pistachios and bake in oven for approx 30 minutes or until crispy and flakey.. To serve, remove the pan sides and remove the fish from the oven. Scatter over the pine nuts and serve with extra pistachios.

title: Blueberry Fried Rice
ingredients: 1/2 cup long grain white rice | 3 cups fresh and diced cooked blueberries ( about 10 ounces ) | 2/3 cup hot sauce | 2 hard-boiled eggs, chopped
instructions: In a large nonstick skillet, cook rice until just golden brown, about 3 minutes. Transfer rice to a plate lined with paper towels. When rice is still hot, stir in blueberries, hot sauce and eggs.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,farfalle pasta,stove stuffing mix,poblano chile pepper,turmeric,shortening,horseradish
title: Mexican Shrimp and Farfalle
ingredients: 1 package dry farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 2 links steak-trimmed poblano chile peppers, thinly sliced | 1 1/2 cups turkey-style prepared horseradish | 1 1/2 cups stove top stuffing mix | 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the bow tie pasta, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still slightly firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Heat 1 tablespoon peanut oil in a large skillet over high heat. Add poblano peppers, and fry until lightly browned, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,rice wine vinegar,egg,kidney bean,lemon juice zest,coffee powder,shallot,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Kidney Bean Cheddar Soup
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable stock | 1 medium shallot, finely chopped | 2 cups kidney beans, cooked ( preferably cannellini beans with liquid ) | 1/4 cup strong coffee powder | 4 1/2 teaspoons rice wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice ( from 1-2 lemons ) | 1 large egg | 4 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, shredded
instructions: Mince the shallot very finely and set it aside. Add the remaining ingredients except the shredded cheese in the order listed, except the cheese, and mix well. Set aside. Beat the egg in a cup or small bowl until frothy. Set aside. Pour the soup mixture into a large saucepan and bring to a boil over medium heat. Pour in the egg, cook, stirring constantly until the egg is set. Remove the soup with a slotted spoon and place in a warm serving bowl. To serve, ladle the hot soup into bowls and sprinkle with the crumbled cheese.

title: Pork and Potato Fritters
ingredients: 2 tablespoons potato starch or 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 tablespoon curry paste | 400 g pork and beans, thawed and drained | 1/2 cup shredded mexican blend cheese ( optional )
instructions: Combine potato starch, curry paste, beans and half the cheese in a plastic bad. Add remaining ingredients and press mixture into a flatbread tin. Bake in preheated oven at 180c for 20 minutes.

title: Curried Rice
ingredients: 1 cup long grain rice | 1/2 cup shallot ( minced ) | 1 -2 cup curry ( hot based on your taste preference )
instructions: Cook rice according to packet instructions. Drain rice in a colander over a bowl. Stir in minced shallots and curry and stir to combine.

title: Horseradish Roast Honey Ham
ingredients: 1 ham | 1 tablespoon horseradish sauce | 3 drops yellow food coloring
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Make slits in the ham and insert a slice of ham into the slits. Place ham on a rack in a roasting pan. In a small bowl, mix together the horseradish sauce and food coloring. Brush the ham with the horseradish mixture. Roast ham until a thermometer inserted into the thickest part of the thigh reads 140 degrees f, turning once. Serve with horseradish sauce on the side.

title: Tucanadiere (French Bread Pizza)
ingredients: 1 pizza dough | 1 tablespoon amaretto ( light is ok ) | 1/3 cup creme fraiche | 1/3 cup shredded mozzarella cheese | 1/2 cup plain breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon sweet hungarian paprika
instructions: Pre heat oven to 450 degrees f. Roll out dough into a 9 circle and place on a baking sheet.

title: Easy Asian Ribs
ingredients: 1 cup cooked rib celery | 1/3 cup chopped pimiento | 1 egg | 1/3 cup soy sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients and blend well in a 1 1/2 quart casserole dish. Cover and bake@ 375°f for 30 minutes.

title: Pesto and Pesto Pesto Pizza Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup basil pesto | 1/4 cup pesto sauce ( homemade or jarred )
instructions: Place pesto in a jar with a lid and shake until the pesto is dissolved. Place pesto in a bowl and add the pesto sauce. Stir well. This pizza sauce is also delicious when refrigerated overnight.

Random Ingredients: thyme sprig,salt pepper,tomato soup,clove,jicama,pernod,salmon fillet,saffron thread
title: Salmon With Pernod-Scented Tomatoes
ingredients: saffron thread ( if you can't find this, use a saffron thread ) | 1/2 cup pernod | 3 fresh thyme sprigs | 1 1/2 lbs salmon fillets, skin on | salt and pepper | 12 medium tomatoes, each about 9 ounces in diameter, cut in half | 1 small jicama, peeled and cut in 4-inch pieces
instructions: Combine saffron threads and 1/4 cup of pernod in a 1 quart saucepan. Add thyme stem and bring to a low boil. Remove from heat. Rub fish with saffron strands, sprinkle with salt and pepper, and place flesh side up on a rack in a roasting pan. Pour enough hot water into pan to reach halfway up sides of fish. Place ramekins in a small glass or ceramic measuring cup and pour hot puréed liquid over fish. Season both sides and the fish generously with salt and pepper. Cover roasting pan tightly with foil, place in oven and bake for 35 minutes. Check for doneness by inserting a fork. It should come out clean. Serve warm. Garnish with tomato halves and jicama pieces.

title: Indian Scramble
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons asafoetida powder, or more to taste | 3 tomatoes with green chiles, chopped | 24 marshmallows, chopped
instructions: Mix asafoetida powder and tomatoes in a small bowl.

title: Greek Baked Onions
ingredients: 1/3 cup sliced pitted kalamata olive | 1/2 cup packed brown onion (, halved lengthwise ) | 1/8 cup reduced-sodium beef broth | 2 teaspoons minced fresh rosemary
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Spread kalamata olives out flat on ungreased baking sheet. Bake until slightly browned, about 10 minutes. Remove from oven. In food processor bowl, combine remaining ingredients. Pulse until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Scatter onions over olives. Bake until onions are golden brown and heated through, about 35 minutes.

title: Quick Peach Soup
ingredients: 2 cans sliced peaches, undrained | 1 can vegetable broth
instructions: Place peaches and vegetable broth in a large pot. Cover and simmer over medium heat for 15 minutes or until almost all the broth is gone. Blend in blender or food processor until smooth and serve.

Random Ingredients: thyme sprig,kaffir lime leaf,lasagna noodle,tart apple,rice,feta cheese,peanut oil,currant
title: Crispy Apple-Feta Lasagna(ATK)
ingredients: 2 lbs firm tart apples | 6 1/2-inch fresh thyme sprigs | 1 cup rice, uncooked ( arborio, carnaroli, calrose ) | 14 1/2 ounces low-fat crumbled feta cheese ( or goat cheese ) | 1/4 cup dried currant ( optional ) or 1/4 cup raisins ( optional ) | 1/3 cup peanut oil | 8 whole kaffir lime leaves ( optional ) | 8 -10 lasagna noodles ( small size )
instructions: Peel and core apples, leaving skin on.

title: Apple Sausage Tarts
ingredients: 1/4 lb pork sausage | 1/4 can tart apples, undrained | 1/2 cup ketchup, divided | 1 tablespoon vinaigrette | 1 pie shell, unbaked
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. In a medium bowl, combine all ingredients except 1/2 cup ketchup. Mix well and set aside. Bake tart shells for 5 to 7 minutes.

title: Tasty Sausage Rolls!
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef | 1 lb pork sausage | 5 pickled red beets, shredded | 1 cup frozen chopped peppercorn berries ( optional ) or 1 cup frozen raspberries ( optional ) | 1/4 cup chili-garlic sauce | 4 slices pepperoni, chopped fine
instructions: Cook ground beef and pork sausage in skillet over medium heat until beef is browned well and sausage is thoroughly cooked but not cooked through. Drain any fat. Remove sausage and beef mixture from skillet. Combine meat mixture and beets. Put together all ingredients in a large bowl and mix well. Pour mixture into 9x13 baking dish. Make sure beets aren't touching. Bake at 350 degrees for 35 minutes.

title: Champagne
ingredients: 2 ounces chives | 3/4 pint chicken stock
instructions: Trim the green top portion of the chives. Remove the stems and the spines. Cut them into halves along their size. Bring stock to the boil and add the chives. Return to the boil to boil and boil gently, stirring, without boiling vigorously for 5 minutes. Cover. Keep for an hour. Skim any scum. The sauce should have a thick, rich creamy consistency, and the chives will have made their own foam. If not, repeat the previous step of simmering gently another 20 minutes or so, but this should not take long before the chives have cooked.

Random Ingredients: lemon zest,ancho chilies,tart apple,head cabbage,egg white,tomato green chilies
title: Southwestern Christmas Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 1 head cabbage, cored and shredded | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1 -2 teaspoon grated lemon zest | 1 teaspoon ground ancho chilies | 1 can diced tart apples | 3 egg whites, lightly beaten
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°. Lay out shredded cabbage in a 9x13 baking dish. To make filling, in a medium bowl, combine tomatoes with green chilies, zest, ancho and apples. In a small bowl, whisk egg whites until foamy and set aside. Pour tomato mixture over cabbage and toss to coat. Spread approximately 1 teaspoon filling into bottom of baking dish. Fold cabbage dough into thirds. Roll each third of mixture up tightly from top to bottom. Slice crosswise into 2 thin slices. Place in single layer on top of tomatoes. Bake at 375f/190c for about 35 - 40 minutes or until browned.

title: Penne with Seafood and Broccoli
ingredients: 1 package penne pasta, cooked and drained | 1 package frozen broccoli, thawed | 1 bunch fresh spinach leaves | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 2 tablespoons cooked couscous | 1 cup hot cooked fish sauce
instructions: Cook broccoli with a bit of water until tender. Thaw frozen broccoli. Heat 1 t. Fish sauce in skillet over medium heat until it begins to thaw slightly. Stir in cooked pasta. Toss with cooked greens and cooked fish sauce. Top with extra fish sauce.

Random Ingredients: green onion,white bread,watermelon,spinach leaf,molasses,allspice,mandarin orange segment,polenta
title: Spinach Polenta Salad
ingredients: 1 cup dry polenta ( or more if desired ) | 1 1/4 cups warm water ( or more as desired - i prefer the cold method ) | 1 medium green onion, thinly sliced ( white parts only ) | 1 box frozen chopped spinach leaves | 1 can mandarin orange segments, drained ( reserve about 3-4 tablespoons of the syrup ) | 1/2 cup molasses ( or more to taste, i prefer the molasses-free variety ) | ground allspice, to taste | 2 loaves fresh white bread, crusts cut off ( cut or torn for serving )
instructions: Prepare polenta mix according to package directions. Cut frozen spinach into thin slices and slice the green parts of the onion. In a large bowl, toss with the prepared polenta and water to combine. To prepare salad, toss the spinach, mandarin orange segments, molasses, a sprinkling of allspice, and the warm corn syrup. To serve, place a piece of bread, cut side up, on a plate. Spread the polenta mixture evenly over the bread and sprinkle with the green onion and the green part of the onion. Serve with salad and a spoonful of the reserved syrup. Note, this can easily also be made in an 8 inch square baking dish. Cover tightly and refrigerate for up to a month.

Random Ingredients: white flour,apple juice,horseradish,nonfat plain yogurt,panir,italian turkey sausage,hamburger bun,chili pepper flake
title: Baked Turkey Sausage Burgers
ingredients: 1 cup white flour | 1/4 cup nonfat plain yogurt | 1/4 tablespoon chopped fresh horseradish | 1/4 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1/2 lb hamburger bun | 1/2 cup cooked italian turkey sausage | 1/2 cup panir, cut into 1/4 inch cubes | 2 tablespoons nonfat plain yogurt
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, 1/4 cup yogurt, horseradish, chili flake, 1/4 cup water and turkey sausage.

title: Beef & Mushroom Burger Mix
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg sirloin | 150 ml white mushrooms | 1 1/2 tablespoons cajun seasoning
instructions: Mix together all ingredients and store in an airtight container. Precook your sirloin steak as specified above. Heat up your smoker or gas grill with a light touch. Grill / bbq grill the sirloin until cooked to your liking. Serve on buns with your favourite topping for dipping.

title: Dukkah
ingredients: 4 lamb shanks, with bone | 2 2 tablespoons cottage cheese or 2 tablespoons gorgonzola cheese ( or any cheese with enough moisture to bind them, if you have it ) or 2 tablespoons greek feta cheese ( or any cheese with enough moisture to bind them, if you have it ) | 1 tablespoon chopped chives
instructions: In a roasting tin, arrange the lamb shanks in an overlapping pattern, skin side up, using some of the fat from the first layer. Strip the bones from the under meat by pounding them on the meat. Place the meat on top of the remaining fat in a roasting tin and season lightly with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Smooth the surface and pour water into the tin. If you have a lid on the thickest part of the meat it will be easy to see through when the water starts to bubble up. Bake in preheated oven at 180c/350f/gas mark 4, for 1 & 1/2 hours. Check the internal temperature after 1 hr, and if it begins to jiggle, loosen with a spoon, invert the lamb onto a serving platter. Allow to rest a couple of hours at room temperature. Remove the meat from the tray and set aside covered with foil. Remove the fat and discard then strain the fat from the juices on the tray. Shred or crumble the meat and return to the tray. Mix in the cheese and chives. Serve warm or cold over couscous.

Random Ingredients: fish sauce,corn tortilla chip,cinnamon sugar mixture,french bread,potato chip,rotel,cocoa powder,banana
title: Sweet Potato Chip Nachos
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread, sliced into 1/2 inch slices | 1 package sweet potato chips | 2 bananas, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 1 cup shredded rotel ( hot, your choice ) | 6 ounces tortilla chips | 6 ounces fish sauce | 1 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 cup coconut sugar mixture | 1 teaspoon cinnamon-sugar mixture, mixed with | 1/4 cup cold water
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Place unopened bag of french bread in a 13x9 baking pan, seam side down, and cut bread in half. Place 1 bread slice on each of 2 bamboo skewers.

Random Ingredients: margarine,tamari,beef bouillon,pinto bean,arbol chile,bay leaf,red currant jelly,cashew
title: Beef With Bean & Cashews
ingredients: 1 cup pinto bean ( drained ) | 1 ounce arbol chile ( stemmed washed & seeded chopped ) or 1 ounce dried arbol chile ( stemmed washed & seeded chopped ) | 1 bay leaf | 1 tablespoon tamari | 1/2 - 1 cup red currant jelly or 1/2-1 cup jelly | 2 tablespoons cashews ( ground ) | 1 tablespoon margarine | 1/2 1/2 teaspoon beef bouillon or 1/2-1 teaspoon vegetable broth bouillon
instructions: In a medium saucepan measure the bean liquid, add the beans, chiles, bay leaf, tamari & jelly. Bring to a gentle boil over medium heat uncovered & cook, stirring frequently for 3 minutes. Lower heat to low & simmer, uncovered & stirring often, for 15 - 20 minutes, or until beans are tender. Stir in cashews & continue to cook & stir for 1 minute. Sprinkle with broth or butter & serve.

Random Ingredients: brown bean sauce,quinoa,rice,tomato sauce,queso fresco cheese,mace
title: Mexican Quinoa and Beans
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa or 1 cup brown rice ( 3 cups ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace ( mexican preferred ) | 3/4 cup tomato sauce | 1 can brown beans in chili sauce, undrained ( undrained ) | 1 lb queso fresco cheese, drained and cubed ( about 6 ) | hot cooked rice
instructions: Stir quinoa or brown rice with mace. Cover and bake at 350 degrees f for 25 minutes or until heated through. Set aside. Meanwhile, combine tomato sauce and beans. Cover and simmer about 10 minutes until heated through. Spoon into 4 small shallow bowls. Spoon quinoa mixture overtop and sprinkle with cheese. Season with salt and pepper.

Random Ingredients: plain yogurt,baby pea,bulk italian sausage,purpose flour,pepper sauce,red chile,double cream,pumpkin seed
title: Smoked Sausages With Spring Peas
ingredients: 6 tablespoons plain low-fat yogurt, thick, not nonfat | 1 1/2 tablespoons double cream or 1 1/2 tablespoons yogurt | 2 teaspoons crushed dried sweet peppers sauce ( optional ) or 2 teaspoons hot pepper sauce ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1 small dried red chile, chopped ( or 1 tablespoon pickled jalapeno chile ) | 1 tablespoon pumpkin seed pieces, toasted | 200 g bulk italian sausage | 2 handfuls frozen baby peas
instructions: Preheat and lightly oil grill. In medium bowl combine yogurt, cream, sweet pepper sauce, flour, and chillies or pickled chiles. Stir to combine. In frying pan, cook sausage over medium high heat until cooked through, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and drain fat. Stir in peas, and warm through. Serve on bed of bread.

title: Toasted Almonds and Sazon
ingredients: 2 lbs blanched almonds | 3 packages sazon goya
instructions: Put almonds in a large saute pan and toast medium low heat, stirring occasionally, until golden brown and fragrant, 2 to 3 minutes total. Remove from heat and set aside to cool. When cool, chop 1/2 inch pieces and set aside. Toast remaining almonds in a small dry skillet over medium low heat, stirring occasionally, 4 to 5 minutes. Cool and grind until finely ground. In a skillet over medium high heat, warm sazon and bring to a boil. Cook, stirring frequently, until it is a thin syrup consistency. Remove from heat. Quickly pour 1 teaspoon sauce into a 9x13 inch baking dish and coat entire dish with almonds. Sprinkle with remaining sazon and dot with reserved almonds. Cover with foil and refrigerate until set, at least 4 hours and up to 48 hours. Cut slits randomly in top of the almonds and return to the oven for 10 minutes to brown lightly.

Random Ingredients: beef liver,chili sauce,cayenne pepper,picante sauce,cauliflower,baking cocoa
title: Hot Cocoa Beef Liver
ingredients: 5 tablespoons chili sauce | 2 tablespoons picante sauce | 2 lbs beef liver, chopped | 4 heads cauliflower, chopped up | 2 tablespoons baking cocoa or 2 tablespoons instant coffee granules | 1 dash cayenne pepper
instructions: Prep spiced chili sauce. Bring chili sauce to the boil. Turn off heat and let sit 15 minutes. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Prep beef liver. Brown liver and set aside. Cook chopped cauliflower and add to skillet with 1 tbsp of cocoa. Add 3/4 of a cup of hot chili sauce. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly. Add remaining chili sauce and mix through. Remove from heat, stir in cayenne pepper. To serve, place liver on platter, pour spiced chili over and serve.

title: Caramel Saute
ingredients: 1 medium carrot, peeled, julienned | 3 medium fresh thai green chili, stemmed | 3 tablespoons caramel topping
instructions: Toss carrots with 2 tbsp carrot drippings. Let stand at least 2 hours, stirring every couple of hours. Heat grill to high. Remove vegetables from drippings. Place in roasting pan. Roast 30 seconds. Place chili on top. Roast about 10 minutes longer or until charred. Add caramel topping. Cook about 2 minutes longer or until caramelized.

title: Furik Keema
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground lamb | 1 tablespoon fresh grated gingerroot | 2 serrano chilies, split, to taste | 2 1/2 ounces fine dry breadcrumbs | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1/8 teaspoon mixed spice | 1 can beef broth
instructions: Grind the ginger, chiles and the fine breadcrumbs into a fine crumb texture. Combine with all the meat ingredients. Shape into small, round balls about 1 1/2 in diameter. Place on a greased griddle and brown slowly on all sides, turning the pieces over after a few minutes. Serve hot or cold.

Random Ingredients: fast rising yeast,peanut butter,lamb chop,mirin,allspice,feta cheese,pork tenderloin,lemon zest
title: Grilled Pork With Feta and Chops.
ingredients: 2 cups plain fat-free yogurt ( sour cream or vanilla ) | 3 1/2 tablespoons fresh lemon zest | 1 1/3 tablespoons allspice | 3 tablespoons peanut butter | 1/2 cup reduced-fat feta cheese, crumbled | 3/4 teaspoon fast rising yeast | 1 lb pork tenderloin, fat trimmed and cut into 1/2-inch pieces | 1 - 1 1/2 lb lamb chop, trimmed | 3/4 teaspoon ground allspice | 3 tablespoons mirin | 1 tablespoon melted peanut butter
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together yogurt, zest, allspice, peanut butter, feta, yeast, and 2 cups warm water until smooth. Add pork, lamb, and 1/2 teaspoon allspice, stirring to coat. Cover and refrigerate 8 to 24 hours. Grill pork, turning once, until cooked through, brushing with half the glaze, about 25 minutes, depending on the size of your chop. Brush with glaze. While grilling, combine remaining 1/2 cup warm water, mirin, and the remaining allspice in a small saucepan, bring to a boil, and stir in 1 teaspoon butter. Remove from heat, and strain mixture through a fine sieve. Stir in remaining 1 teaspoon butter, season with salt, and garnish with lemon slices.

title: Zucchini Beef Pot Sticker Breadsticks
ingredients: 3 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast ( such as fleischmann's ) | 1 3/4 lbs red potatoes, cut on the diagonal into 1-inch chunks | 1 lb zucchini, cut on the diagonal into 1/2-inch chunks | 1/2 lb ground sirloin | 1 cup picante sauce
instructions: In a large nonreactive bowl, stir together the yeast and 1 cup lukewarm water until well blended, then stir in the potatoes, zucchini, and beef until the ingredients are well combined. Cover the bowl with some plastic wrap and set aside at room temperature for a few hours or overnight. Bring 2 1/2 quarts of water to a boil over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: filet beef,pecan,vegetable broth,black sesame seed,chili powder
title: Killer Beef Strips
ingredients: 1/2 cup pecans, chopped | 1/4 cup black sesame seed | 2 tablespoons vegetable broth | 1 1/2 cups filet of beef, chopped & cooked | 1/3 cup sweet chili powder
instructions: Combine the pecans, sesame seeds, & broth & set aside. Sprinkle beef with black chili powder and allow to sit for 15 minutes before serving. Serve with hot cooked rice or noodles or on italian toast.

title: Crock Pot Chicken Breasts With Mustard and Cherry Salsa
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts | 2 tablespoons lemon zest, fresh | 2 tablespoons lemon juice, fresh | 1 tablespoon prepared mustard | 1/2 lb cheddar cheese, shredded
instructions: Cut each breast lengthwise into halves or thirds depending on the thickness of the breasts. Place in the crockpot. Combine remaining ingredients and sprinkle on the chicken. Cook on low for 8 –10 hours or on high for 3 hours. Turn crockpot to high. Reduce temperature to low and cook for 1 hour or more. Turn crock pot to high. Cook for 30 minutes more.

Random Ingredients: salt cod fish,mango chutney,penne pasta,vanilla ice cream,coconut extract,peach,brown onion,picante sauce
title: Grilled Cod and Mango Salsa Pasta
ingredients: 1/2 cup picante sauce | 1/2 cup mango chutney | 1/2 cup brown onion, diced | 1 teaspoon coconut extract | 1 cup mango chutney | 1/4 teaspoon salt cod fish | 1 lb penne pasta | 1 mango chutney | 2 peaches | 1/2 brown onion
instructions: For the sauce, toss mango chutney, brown onion and coconut extract in a small bowl. Put aside. Cook pasta according to directions. Meanwhile heat mango chutney over low heat. When pasta is ready place it in microwave for a few seconds and drain, reserving about 1/4 of the water. Add 1/4 of coconut water. Mix well in pot and heat up until sauce thickens slightly. Top with reserved 1/4 of coconut water and serve with sauce and sliced peaches.

title: Parma Ham and Navy Bean Casserole
ingredients: 2 tablespoons palm ham fat | 2 cans navy beans, drained and rinsed | 2 containers coconut cream | 1 cup crispy cooked ham, cut into 1 inch cubes
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Heat palm ham fat in large skillet over medium high heat. Add navy beans, coconut cream, and crispy ham.

Random Ingredients: lettuce leaf,farfalle pasta,extra virgin olive oil,sauerkraut,pistachio,yoghurt,turkey breast,white wine vinegar
title: Kraut-Pounded Turkey Salad
ingredients: 1/4 lb thinly sliced turkey breast | 4 cups torn lettuce leaves | 1/2 cup prepared sauerkraut, canned or fresh | 1/4 cup dry white wine vinegar | 3 tablespoons yoghurt | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1/4 cup sliced dry roasted unsalted pistachios | 3 ounces uncooked farfalle pasta, cooked or 3 ounces other short pasta
instructions: Arrange turkey on lettuce leaves. Combine salad ingredients, tossing lightly. Add pasta and dressing and toss again.

Random Ingredients: head cauliflower,quinoa,greek salad dressing,ramen noodle,ice water,baby spinach,picante sauce
title: Taco Skillet (Cook's Country)
ingredients: 1/2 head cauliflower, broken into shreds | 1/2 head romaine lettuce, shredded | 1 1/4 ounces uncooked instant ramen noodles | 12 ounces frozen chopped spinach, defrosted and squeezed dry | 2/3 cup picante sauce | 1/4 cup fat free greek salad dressing | 1/4 cup ice water
instructions: Cut cauliflower and romaine in half on the diagonal. Cut into bite size pieces. Combine in a large bowl the ramen, spinach, picante sauce, greek dressing, and ice water. Mix well. Stir fry the salad greens and cauliflower approximately 5 minutes or until crisp tender. Plate the salad and add more dressing to taste.

title: Texas Florentine Noodles
ingredients: 8 ounces uncooked egg noodles | 1 can tomato paste | 1/3 cup barbeque sauce | 1 jar spaghetti, rinsed and drained | 1 red onion, diced | 8 ounces kielbasa, sliced | 1 can sliced strawberries, drained
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add egg noodles, and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: cardamom seed,apple cider,mole,orange extract,liquid honey,flat leaf parsley,cooking oil
title: Apple Baked in Mead
ingredients: 3 lbs apples ( about 6 medium ) | 3/4 cup quick-cooking oil | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley | 1/2 cup unsalted dried mexican oregano leaves | 1/2 cup dry apple cider or 1/2 cup dry white wine | 1/2 cup liquid honey ( can use up to 1/4 cup ) | 1 teaspoon orange extract ( can use more to taste )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 350 degrees. Prick apples all over with a fork, place in a large bowl, cover with water and set aside. Place oil in a large stainless steel or ceramic bowl. Add parsley and oregano and stir well. Add apples, pour in apple cider and honey and stir thoroughly. Cover bowl with a damp towel. Pour apple mixture into prepared baking dish. Bake for about 30 minutes until apples are tender and golden brown. Remove from oven and cool. For a variation, cover and refrigerate for several hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: dark chocolate,cooking spray,barbecue sauce,chicken stock vegetable
title: Barbecue Chicken Nests
ingredients: 2 teaspoons dark chocolate or 2 teaspoons chopped chocolate | 2 tablespoons prepared barbecue sauce | 1 3/4 cups chicken stock or 1 3/4 cups vegetable stock | cooking spray
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees c. Combine chocolate and barbecue sauce in small bowl and set aside. In a medium saucepan, bring stock to a low boil, stirring occasionally. Pour stock into a small heat proof jug and discard solids. Pour hot stock into chocolate mixture and stir until heated through. Stir in reserved sauce and allow to cool slightly. Place nests in an oven proof dish or baking paper lined 20cm x 30cm ovenproof dish about 1 1/2 inches deep. Spray nests with cooking spray and cook in oven for 5 minutes or until just cooked. Set aside to cool slightly. Using a small knife or a metal spatula, remove side of nests and place nests on a large plate. Cut into fingers to serve.

title: Coleslaw
ingredients: 1/2 cup shortening | 1/2 cup madeira wine | 750 g green cabbage | 1 head iceberg lettuce | 1 green capsicum
instructions: Fry the chopped cabbage and cut the greens. Crumble into pieces and add a few tablespoons oil and 1 1/2 teaspoons sugar. Chill and serve sprinkled with melted butter.

title: Salsa II
ingredients: 2 bunches scallions, chopped, white and light green parts reserved | 1 bunch fresh parsley, chopped, or more to taste
instructions: Place the scallions in a bowl. Stir in the parsley, and add water to cover. Mix together. Chill for 1 hour before serving.

title: Cambodian Grilled Lobster
ingredients: 3 large lobster meat | 1/4 cup rice vinegar
instructions: Using a sharp knife, make 3 diagonal cuts about 1/2 inch deep in the top of each lobster meat to keep lobster from easily curling while cooking. Lay the lobster meat in a nonstick skillet over medium low heat. Pour rice vinegar over the top of the lobster meat. Do not cover the lobster meat. Cook until the juices from the lobster run clear, 5 to 7 minutes. Cool uncovered for at least 5 minutes. Slice the lobster meat into serving pieces.

title: Pecan Chips
ingredients: 2 cups flour | 2/3 cup flake coconut | 1/4 teaspoon mixed herbs | 1/3 cup red bell pepper, chopped | 1/3 cup nuts, of your choice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, combine flour, coconut and herbs. Stir in the red bell pepper and nuts. Sprinkle with optional salt as desired. Mix until the dough is sticky. On a floured surface, knead for a couple times. Divide dough into 4 portions. Roll each portion out into a circle about 10 inches in diameter. Place onto greased baking sheets. Bake the chips 15 to 20 minutes in the preheated oven, or until slightly browned.

title: Thai Grilled Cheese
ingredients: 1/2 cup thai fish sauce | 8 ounces provolone cheese, cut into thin slices ( about 4 )
instructions: Whisk fish sauce and provolone cheese together. Dip cheese into sauce, then dip into cheese. Place on a serving platter and grill or broil, turning once, until lightly browned and bubbly, 2 - 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cider vinegar,white fish fillet,beef broth,salmon fillet,anchovy fillet,wheat bread,macaroni noodle
title: Salmon Soup With Macaroni Noodles (Macaroni) by Sy
ingredients: 1 package macaroni noodles | 4 anchovy fillets | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 1 can condensed beef broth | 1 teaspoon anchovy fillet | 2 lbs skinned white fish fillets | 1 loaf whole wheat bread
instructions: Cook macaroni until al dente. Drain and set aside. Place anchovies in a small pan with a little oil. Grill until lightly toasted and skinned. Set aside and remove skins. Mince anchovies. Saute in a little oil until fragrant. Set aside. In a bowl, add all the soup ingredients except bread. Mix well, except the bread. Place the toasted macaroni noodles in a pot with enough water to cover and boil until only slightly al dente. Drain and add to soup. Toast bread and place on top of the soup. Add the anchovy pieces on top.

title: Mexican Spinach
ingredients: 3 cups spinach ( washed and stemmed ) | 1 lime wedge ( fresh ) | 1 1/2 cups ice cubes
instructions: Put everything in an ice cream maker and freeze. Take off ice in the morning and squeeze out the excess water. Put the ice cream in a serving bowl. Top with some chopped tomato, spinach leaves, chopped green onions & lime wedge.

title: German Style Chicken
ingredients: 8 ounces chicken wings | 8 ounces rye bread, cubed | 8 duck breasts
instructions: Bake the chicken wings in two 9 x 13 baking pans on a pan lined with parchment paper. Remove the chicken wings from the pans and set them aside. Dry them thoroughly on paper towels. Place the rye bread in another pan, and melt it in the microwave. Pour melted rye bread onto the untoasted bread. Layer the chicken wings over the toasted rye bread. Spread a thin layer of unsalted butter on top. Grill on a non stick griddle or in one of the oven's hottest temperature ovens. Cook and flip the wings over at least 5 minutes or until the bread is toasty and chicken is cooked and browned on the top.

title: A Simple French Fries
ingredients: 2 -3 tablespoons ketchup | 0.5 can quick-cooking spray | 1/4 - 1/2 lb grated cheesecloth ( about 10 cups )
instructions: Spray a large frying pan with a little oil. Layer the ketchup in a bowl, stir well and set aside. Spray the cheesecloth in a paper lined sieve, place it over a bowl or cloth, pressing to squeeze out the excess moisture. Line up several layers of kitchen towels in the bottom of the frying pan. Spread the ketchup in a layer over the cheesecloth. Sprinkle with the cheese, spreading out the ketchup as evenly as possible. Fold the corners of the cheesecloth over the top of the ketchup. Lay the frying pan over medium heat, turn the stove to high and, using a large spatula, lift off the lid. When the lid is crisp, and the ketchup bubbling, remove from the heat. Carefully place the frying pan on its own. Cover and let sit for about 10 to 15 minutes. Carefully remove the lid, flip over the top of the pan and press firmly.. Let sit the other side of cooking for a few minutes before eating. This recipe is best if served at room temperature.

title: Butter Sausage #RSC
ingredients: 1/2 ounce unsalted butter | 1 package kielbasa | 1/2 cup medium-dry rice wine vinegar | 1/2 cup tequila | 1/2 cup canadian bacon, crumbles ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Heat butter in a skillet over medium heat. Crumble bacon, if desired, but add now. Cook bacon until cooked. Remove skillet, crumble, then crumble again. Slice kielbasa in half lengthwise, slice into 1/2 inch slices. Grease a 9x13 inch casserole dish with some of the butter. Layer kielbasa, bacon, and rice wine vinegar next to each other. Pour canadian bacon crumbles over mixture. In small amount of oil, lightly brown kielbasa with garlic in a skillet if using, but not burn. Drain. Serve hot.

title: Chutney on Provolone Prosciutto
ingredients: 1 cup mango chutney ( the real chutney! ) | 2 tablespoons fresh grated ginger powder | 1 tablespoon sweet mango chutney | 2 tablespoons prosciutto, diced finely | 1 bell pepper, diced ( red, or green with some red bell pepper bits )
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together in a 1 cup measure. Place in a bowl, and refrigerate at least 2 hours, overnight is best. To serve slice in half. Top each slice with 2 to 3 slices of cooked bacon or sausages.

title: Grilled Shrimp Salad With Mustard Seeds
ingredients: 1/3 cup mustard seeds | 1/4 cup light molasses | 2 jalapenos or 2 pickled pepperoncini peppers, sliced | 2 bunches scallions, trimmed and sliced into 1 inch pieces ( both white and green parts ) | 1 1/2 lbs large shrimp, peeled, deveined, tails on | 3 radishes, sliced crosswise into 1/2 inch rounds
instructions: In a medium bowl combine the mustard seeds and molasses and mix well. Set aside. In a large skillet combine the jalapeño peppers, scallions, shrimp and radishes. Stir fry over medium heat for 5 to 7 minutes, or until the shrimp are just pink. Stir in the reserved mustard seed and molasses mixture until well mixed. Serve in chilled bowls.

Random Ingredients: creamy peanut butter,heavy cream,green peppercorn,cooking spray,spice,iceberg lettuce
title: Tibetan Peppercorns and Lettuce Kebabs
ingredients: 400 g mixed fresh spice | 1 1/8 liters fresh cream, warmed | 125 g creamy peanut butter | 3/4 cup freshly chopped green peppercorn | 600 g iceberg lettuce or 600 g bibb lettuce, leaves separated | cooking spray
instructions: Combine the spice and cream in a small pan. Heat gently over medium heat until the cream has just reached the boil. Remove from the heat. Stir in the peanut butter, peppercorns & lettuce. Spoon the mixture into 6 individual ovenproof bowls. Spray with oil & bake at around 200c or 160c for 15 mins, remove from the oven & leave until cool. Serve on your favourite flavours.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,poblano chile,heavy whipping cream,shrimp
title: Shrimp Creole with Poblano Chile and Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups uncooked long-grain white rice | 1 pound cooked medium shrimp | 1 poblano chile | 1/3 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: Spray an 11x17 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Cook rice in a saucepan as much as possible over high heat, stirring frequently, until the rice is white, 2 1/2 minutes. Do not overheat place poblano chile in a food processor.

title: Pressed Asparagus
ingredients: 1 lb asparagus spear | chinese cabbage ( about 2 inches long ) | 2 bay leaves
instructions: Trim asparagus. Place asparagus in large pot of boiling salted water. Cover and cook over low hear for 3 to 4 minutes until crisp tender or slightly tender. Drain. Arrange on a bed of cabbage and bay leaves. Add enough water to cover asparagus.

title: Baked Feta Cheese
ingredients: 12 ounces crumbled feta cheese | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/2 teaspoon dried dill weed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Put feta cheese in a bowl and mash with a spoon. Stir in cumin and dill, then spoon mixture into an 8x8 inch baking dish. Cover dish. Bake in the preheated oven 30 minutes, or until top is melted and lightly browned.

title: Rotini Pasta
ingredients: 1/4 cup all-purpose flour | 1 package rotini pasta
instructions: Prepare pasta as per instructions on the package, drain and toss with flour. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: lettuce leaf,ice,spinach leaf,lamb,bulk italian sausage,poultry seasoning
title: Italian Sausage Meatloaf for Two
ingredients: 250 g bulk italian sausage | 1 lb ground lamb | 2 cups firmly packed spinach leaves | 1 1/2 cups packed chopped fresh spinach leaves | 1/2 teaspoon poultry seasoning | 1/4 cup finely shredded lettuce leaf | 1/4 small crushed ice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f degrees. In large bowl, combine sausage, lamb and spinach. Mix well to combine. In small bowl, combine poultry seasoning, garlic, salt, and pepper.

Random Ingredients: purpose flour,tahini,kale,corn,dark sesame oil,chunky peanut butter,self raising flour
title: Scd Friendly Peanut and Tahini Scrolls
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups self-raising flour | 1/2 cup chunky peanut butter | 1/2 cup light corn | 1/2 cup dark sesame oil | 1 tablespoon tahini ( sesame seed paste ) | 1 cup kale
instructions: Sift flour into a large bowl, make a well in the middle and then stir in peanut butter, corn, sesame oil and tahini mix well. Mix in kale just until leaves are covered with the mixture. Scoop tablespoons of scd mixture into scallop bowls. Scoop into the well and level with a fork, then flatten slightly. Place on a lightly oiled tray and bake in a moderate oven for 15 - 20 minutes.

title: Auntie Lori's Pistachio Nut Noodle Salad
ingredients: 500 g rice noodles ( i use 2 medium sized ones ) | 500 g sweet italian meatballs ( or 1-2 small ones ) | 1 teaspoon salt | 1 liter dry sherry or 1 liter white wine, of your choice | 1 tablespoon molasses or 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 2 drops bicarbonate of soda | 1 teaspoon saffron | freshly ground roasted pistachio nut, toasted
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to boil over a high heat. While waiting for water to boil, soak pasta in a large bowl of ice water for about 10 - 15 minutes. In a large non stick skillet, heat 1 litre of water, and when it boils, add meatballs, the salt and a pinch of salt. As they are cooking, remove them from the water from the water, and put them in a colander or strainer lined with a coffee filter with a few strands of moistened cheese cloth over the colander. Let drain while preparing other ingredients and to chill the meatballs and noodles. Meanwhile, boil the sherry or wine until it has reduced by half. Add the molasses or rice vinegar to the cooking sherry, and turn the heat up to medium. When meatballs are almost cooked, mix in the buicarb soda and saffron. Drain meatballs, and add them to the cooking sherry or wine. Bring to the boil, then turn the heat down, and simmer gently until flavours are blended. When the meatballs and noodles are cooked, remove them from the heat and cool slightly. Then, while still hot, add them. The idea is that they are still warm in the warm sherry or wine, with the meatballs still in the sauce. If serving immediately, garnish with fresh roasted pistachios.

title: Spinach and Lamb Soup
ingredients: 1/2 tablespoon dry yeast | 200 g spinach ( in the can ) | 2 celery ribs | 1 red serrano chili ( chopped or diced ) | 200 g ground lamb ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon malt vinegar
instructions: Dissolve the yeast in 1/2 cup of the milk. Bring the remaining milk to the boil, add the spinach and celery to the hot mixture. Reduce the heat and simmer, covered, about 5 minutes or until the celery and celery are tender. Stir in the chili and ground lamb if using. Set aside for 5 minutes or until it has warmed slightly. Stir in the vinegar, stir well and leave to chill in the refrigerator for 30 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: butter,white raisin,peach,yellow bell pepper,baguette,orange,pork shoulder,stew meat
title: Sopa Seca De Na
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless pork shoulder | 12 ounces pork fat | 6 -8 fresh peaches | 1 -2 baguette | 2 white raisins | 1 red bell pepper | 1 orange | butter, for browning
instructions: Trim and discard excess fat from the pork shoulder and place in a crockpot or crockpot. If there is less than 2 - 3 tblsps fat add some chicken broth and place on low. You may wish to have the baguette cut into large chunks so they fit inside the crockpot. Pour pork broth over the meat and add enough water to come about 3/4 of the way up the side of the meat. Cook on low for at least 7 hours or until meat shreds easily when pierced with a fork or toothpick. Slice the pork shoulder and chop the peaches into large chunks or chunks and add to crockpot. Prick the baguette lightly with a fork and sprinkle over the raisins. Add the red bell pepper and orange juice to crockpot. Let sit for about 10 minutes for the juices to redistribute. Toast the bread under the grill or a broiler.

title: Famous Rice Noodle Dinner
ingredients: 12 ounces spaghetti | 1/2 cup brown rice, uncooked | 12 dates, sliced thin on large platter
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to directions on package. Meanwhile, prepare brown rice according to package directions. Drain spaghetti and set aside. Add rice to bowls. Top with sliced dates and sliced canned tomatoes. Serve hot.

title: Chipotle Dust
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chipotle chile, minced | 1/3 cup mexican oregano, plus | extra oregano, for dusting | 2 teaspoons pure vanilla extract | 1/3 cup oil
instructions: In a small bowl, mash roughly 1/2 teaspoon chipotle chile with a mortar and pestle. Add the other 1/3 teaspoon of chipotle, the megano and vanilla and muddle until aromatic, about 2 minutes. Add 1/3 cup oil and blend well. Store in a dry bowl.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,chili oil,red pepper flake,red chile
title: Steamed Thai Hot Red Pepper Paste
ingredients: 5 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon chili oil | 1 tablespoon fresh red chile, finely chopped | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon dried red pepper flakes
instructions: Combine the dark soy sauce with the chili oil and red pepper flakes. Whisk or blend well. Pour mixture into a small cup and transfer to a sealed container. Variation, in a tablespoon of roasted red pepper paste, add 1/2 teaspoons of sugar or 2/3 cup of water.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,apple,extra sharp cheddar cheese,veal,cardamom
title: Apple Cheddar Veal Casserole
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds lean ground veal | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 3 apples - peeled, cored and finely chopped | 3 tablespoons grated extra sharp cheddar cheese | 2 teaspoons ground cardamom
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a large skillet over medium heat, cook and stir veal until evenly browned. Drain. Stir in soup. Mix in apples, cheddar cheese, cardamom and 1 tablespoon water. Cover, and simmer 15 minutes, or until reduced. Cover and return to oven. Bake at 350 degrees f for 30 to 45 minutes, or until heated through. Serve warm.

title: Parsnips and Couscous With Yogurt and Molasses
ingredients: 1 cup chopped parsnips | 1/4 cup molasses | 1/4 cup yogurt | 1/4 cup grated italian cheese | 2 tablespoons prepared mustard | 1/2 cup whole wheat couscous
instructions: Cook parsnips in boiling water about 4 minutes or until tender.

title: Sesame Clam Soup
ingredients: 12 -16 littleneck clams, scrubbed | 1/2 cup sesame oil
instructions: Wash clams under cold running water. Fill a large pot with water and place over high heat. When water boils, put in clams and bring to a boil, discarding any ones that do not open. Turn heat down and gently simmer, covered, until clams have opened, about 1 minute. Rinse in cold water and drain clams. Reserve clam cooking liquid, discard liquid. Discard shells and any clams that haven't opened. Add sesame oil to reserved clam liquid and cook over med high heat until slightly reduced, about 1 minute. Add clams and any juices from clams. Serve hot.

title: Almond Cheese Spread
ingredients: 5 ounces four-cheese italian cheese blend, shredded ( room temperature ) | 1/3 cup finely chopped peanuts | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Add the shredded cheese in the following order and place in the container of your food processor. Add the finely chopped peanuts. Pulse a few times until the mixture is in small crumbles. Sprinkle almond extract over top. Form into a log and chill for an hour.

Random Ingredients: margarita mix,irish cream,golden syrup,maple extract,salt pepper,celery
title: Irish Cream Mousse
ingredients: 2 packages lipton frozen margarita mix | 2 cups chopped celery | 1 cup golden syrup | 1 cup irish cream ( sweetened condensed cream ) | 1 teaspoon maple extract | 1/2 teaspoon salt and pepper
instructions: In a medium size bowl mix together all ingredients. Put in refrigerator until ready to serve.

title: Oaty Crème Brandy
ingredients: 1/3 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 1/2 tablespoons steel cut oats | 2 teaspoons fresh tarragon, chopped
instructions: Combine cream and oats in small bowl. Combine tarragon and 1 teaspoon pepper and sprinkle over cream mixture.

title: Rigatoni With Chili Peppers
ingredients: 1 lb rigatoni pasta | 1/4 cup butter or 1/4 cup margarine | 1/2 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon dried mint
instructions: Cook rigatoni according to package directions. While the pasta is cooking melt butter and when it is just hot add chili peppers. When pasta is finished drain and return to pot. Mix in the chili pepper mixture. Drain pasta. Serve warm, drizzling with chili pepper butter.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,clear honey,green bell pepper,egg
title: Glamorgan Scented Green Peppers
ingredients: 1 green bell pepper, sliced | 1 egg, lightly beaten | 1/4 cup clear honey | salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium high heat and lightly oil grate. Arrange the pepper slices on the hot grate. Grill the pepper slices until tender, about 5 minutes per side for larger peppers and 10 to 12 minutes for larger peppers. Remove from heat, cut in half, and set on a plate covered in foil to keep warm. Mix together the egg, honey, and salt and pepper in a bowl until well combined. Pour the egg mixture over the vegetables in the grill and cook, covered, until the gherkin filling is hot and sticky, about 5 to 8 minutes.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,garbanzo bean,potato,soy sauce,buttermilk biscuit,pork sausage,cooking spray
title: Sausage and Potato Bites
ingredients: 400 g potatoes, peeled and coarsely grated ( about 6 cups ) | 3 1/2 ounces pork sausage, crumbled | 2 tablespoons low sodium soy sauce | cooking spray | 3/4 cup low-fat buttermilk biscuits | 3 cups whole wheat flour | 1 can garbanzo beans, drained, rinsed well
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f and line 2 baking trays with baking paper. Place potatoes, sausage and soy sauce in a bowl, mix well, then set aside while making biscuit dough. Press biscuits into the baking tray in 5cm increments. Bake 5 - 6 minutes until golden brown, then remove from oven and set aside. Place flour and chickpeas in a food processor. Blend until just mixed. Add sausage mixture. Spray the biscuit dough with oil and process on high until dough is formed into a ball, adding more flour if dough is not tacky. Divide biscuits among 2 muffin cups or oven trays, then spoon the potato mixture evenly among. Top with remaining biscuits.

title: Couscous
ingredients: 3 cups vegetable stock | 1 white onion, diced
instructions: Heat the stock in a large bowl, add the diced onion and stir to coat in the onion. Leave to sit for 15 minutes, then serve straight away with plenty of crusty bread to mop up the juices.

Random Ingredients: fettuccine,active yeast,cheddar cheese,salmon fillet,beef stew meat,orange,saffron,basil
title: Broiled Salmon with Fettuccine
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds cubed, boneless beef stew meat | 1 pint light sour cream | 1/2 cup minced fresh basil | 1/2 cup minced orange rind | 1/2 cup minced saffron | 1 package active dry yeast | 10 cups water | 8 ounces dry fettuccine | 2 cups shredded cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees f. Lightly grease a 12x16 inch jelly roll pan with vegetable oil. Place meat in a large skillet over high heat, sprinkle with salt, and sear on all sides, about 10 minutes. Arrange meat in a roasting pan. In a large container, stir sour cream, basil, orange rind, and saffron with a wire whisk until blended. Combine yeast and water in a small bowl, and dissolve. Pour the yeast mixture over meat and spread into prepared pan. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Heat oven to 350 degrees f. Cook noodles 8 minutes in boiling water, or until al dente.

title: Pork With Spinach and Olives
ingredients: 400 g spinach | 600 g pork fillets, sliced | 300 g kalamata olives
instructions: Clean the spinach. ShWash it and leave it in the fridge to drain. Cut the pork slices into thin pieces. Heat the oil in a large size pan. Put pork and salt to taste. Fry the pork for 5 - 7 minutes on one side. Now add the olives. Stir the meat continuously, adding onions, spinach and olives when the pork is almost cooked.

Random Ingredients: garam masala,grand marnier,green chilies,artichoke heart,wheat spaghetti
title: Spicy Tomato-Artichoke Pasta
ingredients: 12 ounces whole wheat spaghetti, broken in half | 2 teaspoons garam masala | 1 can quartered artichoke hearts, drained and sliced | 6 sun-dried green chilies, sliced or 1 jalapeno pepper, chopped | 1/2 cup grand marnier
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Stir in garam masala and artichokes.

title: Pasta with Pork, Herbs, and Garlic
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro | 1 package farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 4 pork fillets, cut into strips
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add farfalle pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Homestyle Noodle Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 bag udon noodles | grated gruyere cheese | 1/4 - 1/3 cup rice powder
instructions: Boil noodles for 4 minutes or until tender. Drain. Mix rice and cheese together. Spread onto bread or pizza crusts. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: sea salt,grenadine,dark soy sauce,adobo sauce,curry powder,cannellini bean,red wine,curry leaf
title: Spicy Dark Beans
ingredients: 1 lb cooked cannellini beans | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon curry powder | 1 dash curry powder | 1 pinch coarse sea salt or 1 pinch kosher salt | 1 dash crushed dried yellow curry leaves | 5 dashes grenadine | 1 dash red wine
instructions: In a large skillet over medium heat, combine beans with soy sauce, curry powder, powder and salt. Turn heat to medium and cook for 3 - 5 minutes, stirring constantly, until heated through. Add remaining ingredients and stir thoroughly. Serve over noodles with rice.

title: Simple Onion Sauce
ingredients: 12 large red onions, finely chopped, leave peel on ( if you prefer, use the outer peel of one onion ) | 1 cup coriander powder | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar
instructions: Combine coriander and vinegar and mix well. Stir in onions. You can add grated tasty cheese and chopped parsley, also a good seasoning such as cumin and chilli. You can also mix with your favourite green vegetables such as leeks and red capsicum. I recommend just grating some of the onions over some cabbage to give it a little texture, although there is not such an accompanying costco. If you’re serving it at room temperature, leave it to cool for at least 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,grain mustard,farfalle pasta,white pearl onion
title: Pasta With Pearl Onions and Mustard
ingredients: 1/2 lb white pearl onion ( fresh, frozen or canned ) | 3 ounces dried farfalle pasta, rinsed | 1 pinch hot chili pepper flakes | 2 -3 teaspoons coarse grain mustard
instructions: Bring a pot of water to a boil and add the pasta and cooking tip. Cook for about 2 minutes, or until the pasta is tender. Stir in the chili, mustard and the onions. Serve warm.

title: Sun-Dried Tomatoes (Sun-Dried Tomatoes) and Mint
ingredients: 5 -6 pints sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 1 1/2 lbs fresh mint sprigs, washed well
instructions: Heat a large, heavy pan over high heat and add the sun dried tomatoes. Toss to coat with oil and let stand until tomatoes soften slightly, about 20 minutes. Transfer tomatoes to a large bowl. Gently squeeze out excess oil, reserving pan and sun dried tomatoes. Bring pan to high heat and add mint to pan. Quickly cover pan and heat for 1 minute. Transfer tomatoes to a large serving bowl. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Cut into quarters.

title: Barley-Scallops and Barley Skewers
ingredients: 2 cups pearl barley | 2 boxes bay scallops, rinsed and patted dry | 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese | 2 packages bamboo skewers
instructions: Dissolve barley in 1 cup boiling water in large bowl. Drain. Toss scallops, 1/4 cup parmesan cheese, and remaining parmesan in plastic bag with barley mixture and lightly coat with cooking spray. Thread scallops onto bamboo skewers, alternating with scallops.

title: Pesto-Port Wine Marinade
ingredients: 1 tablespoon prepared pesto sauce | 1 tablespoon shallot, finely diced | 2 tablespoons port wine, to serve
instructions: Combine all ingredients and pour into sealable glass dish. Seal and let marinate for a least 2 hours in fridge. Marinate for no more than 2 - 4 days for best results.

title: Zesty Mustard
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 2 teaspoons lemon juice ( from 2 lemons ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Mix the mustard ingredients together with a wire whisk and chill the mixture in the fridge. Variation 1, use 1 teaspoon mustard for each serving. Variation 2, add 1 ounce to each serving. Variation 2, for each serving, mix 2 ounces of spicy mustard with 2 oz of butter or margarine.

title: Chile-Tunisian Rice (Namecos de Ancho)
ingredients: 4 cups rice | 4 tablespoons dried ancho chile powder | 1 teaspoon dried thyme leave
instructions: Rinse rice under running water until it runs clear. In a bowl, mix together rice, chili powder and thyme leave. Refrigerate covered in the refrigerator for 2 hours. Dunk rice occasionally while standing.

title: Lime and Treacle Sauces
ingredients: 1 1/2 fluid ounces fresh lime juice, divided | 1 1/2 fluid ounces triple sec | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Stir 1 1/2 fluid ounces lime juice and triple sec together in a mixing bowl until combined. Add salt and pepper.

Random Ingredients: egg white,ramen noodle,spice,paprika,red onion,ginger root,cinnamon bark
title: Noodle Kebabs
ingredients: 25 ounces uncooked mirlitake-style ramen noodles | 1 large egg white | 2 slices red onion, minced | 1 teaspoon minced fresh ginger root | 1 teaspoon paprika | 1/2 teaspoon ground mixed spice | 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon bark, or as desired
instructions: Soak ramen noodles for 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: milk ricotta cheese,italian salad dressing,tofu,lump crabmeat,water chestnut
title: Tofu and Crab Meatball Gelato
ingredients: 1 container lump crabmeat | 1 can water chestnuts, drained | 1 package soft fresh italian-style thin-sliced tofu | 1 container whole milk ricotta cheese | 1 cup water | 1/2 cup italian salad dressing, or as needed
instructions: Place the crabmeat and water chestnuts in a saucepan over medium heat, and cook for about 5 minutes, until the water is absorbed. Place the tofu and ricotta cheese into a large saucepan over medium low heat, and cook and stir until the filling is smooth. Mix water with italian style dressing, or as needed, and pour over the cheese mixture. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 5 minutes. Refrigerate the filled cheese balls and water chestnuts for about 1 hour to blend flavors. Serve cold.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,coconut cream,date,red wine,clove,french bread,red curry paste,kale
title: Thai Red Curry Bread Salad
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread | 4 ounces cooked kale | 1 tablespoon red curry paste ( i have seen recipes or i make my own with that ) | 12 cups prewashed chopped kale | 3 tablespoons graham cracker crumbs | 1 can coconut cream | 1/3 cup dates, soaked in 2 t. hot water and drained well | 1/8 teaspoon ground cloves
instructions: Cube bread leaving them attached. Boil kale in 2 t. Hot water for 2 minutes. Place in bowl with cold water and soak until just softened drain off water. Shred kale or cut off stems of kale then chop coarsely. Mix shredded kale with crumbs, coconut cream, dates, cloves, and remaining red curry paste. Add water as needed to make dressing the consistency of light cream dressing. Chill before serving. This is good served with pita chips.

Random Ingredients: green chili pepper,gruyere cheese,beef broth,pork shoulder
title: Authentic Mexican Green Chile Con Carne
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs boneless pork shoulder, fat trimmed | 2 tablespoons finely chopped green chili peppers ( about 3/4 cup ) | 1 cup low sodium beef broth | 3/4 cup shredded gruyere cheese ( about 3 cups ) or 3/4 cup queso fresco ( about 3 cups )
instructions: Cut pork crosswise into 1/4 inch thick slices. Place slices, cut side up, in medium saucepan. Pour in broth.

Random Ingredients: vegetarian bean,yellow squash,pizza sauce,sugar cube,lemon zest,bean sprout
title: Vegan "lazy Ze" Bean Pizza
ingredients: 2 vegetarian baked pita bread ( i used my vegan fajita ) | 1/2 teaspoon lemon zest ( i used 1 tbsp. powdered zest, not the bottled stuff. ) | 1/4 cup skim-milk pizza sauce ( i used my vegan pizza sauce ) | 1 tablespoon raw sugar cube ( i used krisda ) | 1 yellow squash, sliced | 1 can vegan baked beans ( i used vegetarian baked beans ) | 1 can vegetarian baked beans ( i used my vegan baked beans )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Cut out the dough from center of the bread. If your bread is thicker than normal i had to cut it in two, then I cut a larger piece out, and put it back in the oven, after the oven comes out clean, for about 10 more minutes, after the 15 minutes, i put it back in the oven, turn down the oven to 300f, and let it cook for at least 1 hour. I had to test it in a few minutes on the top, it was a little crumbly. The loaf had the internal temperature of 190c/140c for about 15 minutes. Don't use a fan oven, it really ups the taste. Remove it right from the heat and cool slightly. Set it aside. Pour the pizza sauce onto each pita, sprinkle sugar, zest, squash, beans, and pizza sauce on top, and then put back in the oven. The bottom would have to be a little crispy, but it was delicious, after sitting and it was a little bit crispy on one side, my husband could take them out. Note, if you use a pizza stone, your crusts will not be crisp enough. Also, my husband loves the crust a bit, so i used 2 pizza oven bags, and it worked out great. You can make the crust ahead and cut the dough in half at the start, so that's just the start, if you freeze the dough it doesn't require to thaw at all. I had to bake it for a bit while, so it didn't freeze very long, like i said, but it's just personal preferences. I had a fresh pizza, so had to bake my own. My crust was done by the time my son had finished preparing and the kids were eating, and my pizza wasn't as crunchy. The kids were a little undercooked, so i took them out when they were ready to eat, then ate them at once, it was very good.

Random Ingredients: celery rib,cardamom seed,ginger paste,cheese,beef consomme,thyme sprig,fish sauce,veal

instructions: Combine all filling ingredients in a large saucepan, bring to the boil. Reduce heat and simmer covered for 10 minutes. Stir in cheese. Heat through gently. Serve with hot steamed rice.

title: Naked Naneh
ingredients: 1 bunch flat leaf parsley | 1/4 cup paprika
instructions: Put all the ingredients in a food processor or blender and process to a smooth paste. Serve at room temperature or chilled.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,vanilla bean,pickle,cake flour,yellow bell pepper,rom tomato,orzo pasta,lime wedge
title: Orzo Salad III
ingredients: 1 package uncooked orzo pasta | 2 pounds roma tomatoes, chopped | 1 yellow bell pepper, chopped | 1/2 cup sweet pickle slices | 1/2 vanilla bean | 1/2 cup orzo pasta | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 pinch lime wedges, for garnish
instructions: Place the uncooked orzo in a bowl, and cover with water. Let soak until firm, about 20 minutes. Drain. In a salad bowl, mix together the tomatoes, yellow bell pepper, pickle slices, vanilla bean, orzo and garlic salt. Set aside. In a separate small bowl, blend together the lime juice and/orzo. Toss the dressing with the orzo mixture until well combined, then serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: carrot,pork bean,green cardamom pod,egg noodle,za'atar spice mix,oil,yellow cake mix
title: Hajar's Easy Iraqi Style Spiced Noodle Sandwiches
ingredients: 3/4 cup pork and beans in broth and mixed with yellow cake mix | 2 green cardamom pods | 1 teaspoon za'atar spice mix | 1 container oil-packed, refrigerated egg noodles | 2 carrots, cut diagonally into 1-inch thick sticks | 1 hard-cooked egg noodles | 2 tablespoons grated carrots ( optional )
instructions: Drain and reserve broth. Place the noodles in a pot with 2 1/2 cups water, cover and bring to a boil. Remove from heat, and let sit until water has drained away, 1 to 2 minutes. Drain. Reserve about 1/4 cup of the reserved broth, and use to brush the noodles in a few batches onto a baking sheet and return to the noodles to dry. Repeat with the bean and meat mixture. Place the cardamom pods in a small skillet over medium low heat with the za'atar. Roast cardamom until fragrant and beginning to darken, about 1 minute. Set aside. Place the 1/4 cup reserved broth in a small bowl or skillet with a lid and set aside. Heat oil in a heavy skillet over medium heat. Using a slotted spoon, remove cardamom pods from oil and discard. Brush the noodles with oil and sprinkle with salt. Spread 1 to 2 tablespoons of reserved broth onto the bottom half of a large piece of aluminum foil. Place 1 noodles on each foil slice. Place 2 noodles onto each foil slice. Layer noodles and noodles with 2 or 3 reserved bean mix into each bread round. Lay 1 to 2 more noodles onto each bread round and top with 3 more bean mixtures. Top the bread round with 1 to 2 more bread rounds and 1 to 2 more bread rounds. Top the bread round with 1 to 2 more noodles. Top the bread round with the remaining 1 cup reserved broth, carrot strips and extra carrot strips. Cut the bag of noodles into 4 pieces about 1 wide and 3 long with kitchen shears. Cover and refrigerate the sandwiches, covered with plastic wrap, for at least 8 hours and up to 1 day. Preheat an outdoor grill for medium high heat and lightly oil grate. Place sandwiches on the grill, and cook for 3 minutes on each side.

Random Ingredients: corona beer,marsala wine,angostura bitter,cranberry,chicken breast half,wheat pita bread
title: Italian Wedding Soup
ingredients: 3 whole skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 2 cans cranberry flavored carbonated beverage | 3 tablespoons marsala wine | 2 tablespoons angostura bitters | 1 1/2 cups arborio beer | 1 whole wheat pita bread, warmed
instructions: Place the chicken breasts between 2 sheets of plastic wrap and pound them using the flat side of a meat mallet. Sprinkle the chicken with beer and stir in the marsala and bitters until dissolved. Pour into a saucepan and bring to a slow boil. Remove from the heat and place a few pieces of chicken in each soup bowl.

Random Ingredients: pine nut,tomato juice,triple sec,garlic powder,milk chocolate chip,pepperoni sausage,paprika
title: Grilled Spicy Italian Sausage Bake
ingredients: 1 package johnsonville mild hot dogs, cut in half lengthwise and then halved crosswise | 1/2 cup italian style chili sauce ( i used classico marinara sauce ) | 1/4 cup triple sec | 2 cups tomato juice | 1/2 teaspoon paprika | 1/4 teaspoon pepper | 1/2 cup milk chocolate chips
instructions: Heat the grill to high heat. Place the sausages on the hot grill. Grill the sausages to your liking.

title: Easy Pizza Dough
ingredients: 8 -10 cups flour | 2 2 teaspoons yeast or 1 tablespoon instant yeast
instructions: Sift 3 cups of flour onto a floured surface and add 1 - 2 tsp of yeast. Knead by hand or with a machine for about 1 - 2 minutes adding more flour in increments until a dough starts to cling to the bowl. Place in a greased bowl and cover. Let rise for 1 hour. Then divide or shape into either flatbreads or, for a traditional pizza, roll into balls by lightly flattening with a rolling pin. You could also place on a greased pizza pan, place in 375 degree oven with the toppings, and bake for 10 - 15 minutes. Bake as above, or as your favorite toppings serve over pasta.

title: Masa Empanadas (Tortillas With Cheese)
ingredients: 400 g masa harina flour | 1/2 liter warm bread | 1 teaspoon marjoram | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom | 1/2 - 3/4 cup grated cheese ( any of your choice ) ( optional )
instructions: Mix all the ingredients with your hands until they are the consistency of small egg sized lumps. Knead to a soft consistency, place in a bowl, cover with a damp cloth and set aside for about 15 minutes. Divide dough into golf ball sized balls. Cover again and place on your work surface. Take a golf ball sized piece of dough and stretch it over your palm, place some cheese if desired and roll into a ball about 1/8 in thick. Repeat until you have made 8 balls then flatten it out till it's of your desired thickness. Place on a lightly greased cookie sheet with a border on the top. Keep them from sticking to each other when shaping as so the tortilla will not stick to the work surface. Make them as thin as possible to avoid getting burned or over cooked though. Place in a preheated oven at 180°c to brown on both sides, turn them over and brown both sides. When done, place on a warm paper towel covered dish and keep hot in the oven.

title: Aunt Eva's Baked Beef
ingredients: 3 lbs extra lean ground beef | 2 tablespoons catsup | 12 ounces oranges, zest of, finely grated | 6 ounces dark raisins
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f roll beef 1/4 inch thick. Cut into 1 cubes. Place beef in a 9x13 inch casserole dish. Sprinkle with salt, then drizzle top with catsup. Top with orange zest. Arrange raisins in decorative circles on top. Cover with foil and bake for 40 - 45 minutes. Serve with a side of sauce and rice.

Random Ingredients: tarragon,dill pickle juice,cold water,ricotta cheese,lemon juice zest,basil leaf
title: Cannellini Salad
ingredients: 1 cup ricotta cheese | 1 tablespoon tarragon | 1 tablespoon basil leaves | 2 dill pickle slices, minced | 2 teaspoons lemon juice, freshly squeezed | cold water
instructions: Mix ricotta, tarragon, basil, pickle, and fresh lemon juice together in a bowl.

title: Vegetable Empanadas
ingredients: 1 shortcrust pastry, ready made | 2 tablespoons mirin | 1 tablespoon dry passover wine or 1 tablespoon a red wine | 2 tablespoons pimento stuffed olives | 2 teaspoons dry salsa | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne or 1/8 teaspoon paprika
instructions: Line baking sheet with baking paper. Preheat oven to 400 f. Line two baking trays with a double layer of butchers butter paper. Roll pastry into a rectangle about 8 x 12 inches. Transfer half of pastry onto centre of baking sheet, brush with mirin, then sprinkle with half of the flour, half of the olives, half of the salsa, half of the cardamom and the cayenne or paprika. Roll up the pastry as you would for a swiss roll. Cut into 4 rectangles about 8 x 12 inches. Repeat with remaining pastry, olives, salsa, cardamom and cayenne or paprika. Place empanadas on baking sheet. Bake for 10 - 12 minutes, until golden, and serve hot, garnished with coriander leaves or parsley sprigs.

title: Cabbage & Potato
ingredients: 4 medium baking potatoes | 1 medium red cabbage, sliced thin | 2 cups dry red wine
instructions: Peel and dice the potatoes and steam over medium heat about 15 minutes or until tender. Drain. Cut the cabbage into thin shreds and combine with the potatoes. In a saucepan, bring the wine to a boil and stir in the cabbage and potato mixture to coat. Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer about 15 minutes or until cabbage is heated through and potatoes are heated.

title: Quick Steak and Kidney Bean Pie
ingredients: 1 frozen 9-inch pie shell, thawed | 1 1/2 lbs boneless top round steaks, cut in 3/4 inch strips | 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup triple sec | 4 teaspoons chopped fresh thyme
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Press pastry shell into a 9 pie plate, and bake for 10 minutes to soften. Place steak, beans, triple sec, and thyme in a skillet and heat over medium heat.

title: Moroccan-Spiced Beef and Gravy
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs cubed beef meat | 3 cups cubed cooked ham | 1 teaspoon ground cumin
instructions: In a casserole dish, combine the first 4 ingredients. Cover and bake, covered, in a 350 degree f oven for 2 1/2 hours, until meat is tender.

title: Easy Refried Beans
ingredients: 1 can refried beans | 1 teaspoon mexican-style cheese blend | 2 teaspoons anise seed, divided | 1/2 teaspoon shredded fresh basil, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Stir refried beans, mexican style cheese blend, 1 teaspoon of anise seeds, and basil together in a roasting pan. Drizzle remaining anise seed over bean mixture.

title: Chile and Shallot Puree for Making Chips
ingredients: 4 shallots ( finely chopped ) | kosher salt
instructions: In a mortar and pestle, mix shallots and 1 teaspoon kosher salt and pound until a somewhat chunky paste. In a deep skillet, heat oil over medium high heat. Add paste to pan and saute until shallots become brown with a rich aroma and a crispy texture, 4 to 8 minutes per side. Transfer to paper towels to drain. Season with salt.

Random Ingredients: whipping cream,plain flour,herbes de provence,anise,pesto sauce
title: Pesto and Herbs in Cream

instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together the cream and flour. Stir in the anise, herbes and pesto. Pour the cream mixture into a pastry bag fitted with a 2½ inch plain tip.. Pipe in any desired shape onto a tray. Bake for 25 minutes or until very light and golden.

title: Green Chili Snack Tortillas

title: Green Beans Marsala for Two
ingredients: 1 lb green beans, trimmed and cut into 1 diagonal slices | 1/2 cup apple juice | 1/2 cup dry marsala
instructions: Cook green beans in water with apple juice, covered, over medium heat until tender, about 6 minutes. Drain and toss with marsala just before serving. Serve with additional marsala.

title: Apple, Beer and Rum Breakfast Sausages
ingredients: 1 tart apple, diced | 3/4 cup light beer ( such as guinness or an oregon trail ) | 1/4 cup dark rum ( or another rum flavored liqueur ) | 2 -3 firm sausages ( johnsonville makes a double amount of sausages ) | 10 leaves fresh strawberries ( to garnish ) | 1/4 - 1/3 cup orange peel, for garnish ( to garnish )
instructions: Combine apples, rum and rums in medium bowl. Cover and refrigerate at least two hours or overnight. Thread 1 sausagiel on each skewer, accordion style. Grill sausages on greased baking sheet 5 to 7 inches below medium hot coals, turning frequently, until cooked through, approximately 10 minutes per side. Serve with fresh fruit and orange peel.

title: Tuscan Beef Stew

instructions: Trim all visible fat from sirloin. Cut into 1/2 inch cubes. Cut mushrooms in half and then cut into 1/2 inch pieces. Slice sundried tomatoes in half. Cover and cook until the liquid in the pan evaporates. Serve.

instructions: Peel nectarines, remove the 'baby', flesh, and seeds. Slice the nectarines lengthways into halves. instructions: Stir the sesame seeds in a small frying pan over medium heat until lightly browned, about 1 minute. When the peanuts are cool, roughly chop them and place in a food processor with the chocolates. Cover and process or process until smooth. Transfer to an airtight plastic container and refrigerate at least an hour to allow the flavors to blend. Garnish with cilantro and serve.

title: Rhubarb and Corned Beef

instructions: Brown the corned beef in a pan with 1 1/2 pints of water and 1/2pints of water. Drain off all the fat and season with salt and pepper. Add the rhubarb chunks and the potato. title: Cracker Brownies

instructions: Mix egg white and graham crackers thoroughly in a bowl. Shape into 2 inch diameter balls. Bake at 300 degrees f with a toothpick inserted into the middle of each to test doneness. Let cool and store in refrigerator.

title: Lemon-Scented Chicken Tenders With Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 teaspoon canola oil | 1 lb chicken tenders | 4 medium tomatoes, cut into 2-inch, wedges | 1 can tomato paste | 3/4 cup vegetable broth
instructions: Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Sprinkle chicken with salt.

title: Canadian Baked Beef Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat ( cut into 1-inch cubes ) | 5 slices canadian bacon ( cut into 1/2 inch slices ) | 1 teaspoon chili powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Put all ingredients in a shallow 2 quart baking dish. Cover tightly with foil and bake 1 1/2 hours, or until tender.

Random Ingredients: chunky salsa,hamburger bun,kraft greek salad dressing,white wine,hot chicken broth,plum tomato

instructions: Split buns lengthwise in half. Place bun halves in a slow cooker. Combine 1/3 cup salad dressing and greek dressing. Pour in wine or water, mixing well. Pour over buns. title: Lutefisk - Rum and Vanilla Pudding
ingredients: 2 1/4 kg lutefisk | 2 tablespoons rum | 2 1/2 tablespoons vanilla
instructions: Combine rum and vanilla in a bowl, and leave to chill. Using a sharp knife, cut meat into chunks, and place in a large basin that will hold them in a single layer.
