Pour the rum mix into the pot, and simmer, uncovered, for 30 - 40 minutes, or until the meat is very tender. Discard any bones or gristle that have risen to the surface.. When ready to serve, serve with vanilla ice cream.

title: Crispy Spinach
ingredients: 20 ounces fresh spinach leaves, rinsed and stemmed | 2 teaspoons cornstarch
instructions: Place spinach in a small bowl, and sprinkle the cornstarch over it.

title: Anchovy Poof With Cranberries
ingredients: 1/2 cup golden raisin | 1 teaspoon anchovy paste | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 1/3 cup sofrito | 1/3 cup ghee ( clarified butter ) | 1 lb cranberries
instructions: In a small pan, toast raisins over medium heat until golden brown. Add anchovy paste to raisins and allow to toast. Add salt to pan, cover and cook over medium heat for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Stir sofrito into fried raisins. Keep warm, covered. In a large skillet, melt ghee over low heat. Add cranberries and cook for about 6 minutes, stirring occasionally, until cranberries are softened. Stir in sofrito. Drain raisins, cover and store. Stir well before serving. The dough can also be frozen for up to 3 months.

Random Ingredients: almond extract,wheat,chicken wing,olive,salt pepper,self rising flour,peanut oil
title: Nanaimo's Satay Wings
ingredients: 2 tablespoons whole wheat self-rising flour | 2 tablespoons white self-rising flour | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract ( for a kick! ) | 1/4 teaspoon salt and pepper | 2 lbs chicken wings | peanut oil ( for frying ) | 1/2 cup sliced almond, toasted and ground | 3/4 cup peanuts, chopped ( for a kick! )
instructions: Mix self rising flour, salt, pepper, almond extract, and egg beater mix together until smooth. Dip wings in the batter and fry in oil.

title: Apple Soup with a Kick
ingredients: 2 teaspoons apple juice ( or water if you must get apple juice too ) | 1 1/2 cups apple juice, or water
instructions: Combine ingredients and heat gently but don't boil. Serve topped with grated grated cheese or fresh grated apple. If you must use apple juice with cream cheese just add it slowly until it is the right quantity. If the soup is so thick that it seems very dry, you may need to add some water.

title: Easy Chili Sauce
ingredients: 4 cups canned whole peeled tomatoes | 3 tablespoons sweet chili sauce
instructions: Place the tomatoes into an air tight container with a tight lid. Pour 2 cups boiling water over them to cover. Let the tomatoes sit in the water for 20 minutes, then drain. Place the tomatoes and 1 cup of the chili sauce into a food processor. Process until well mixed, about 30 seconds. Serve warm or cool.

title: Quick Chicken-Cream Soup
ingredients: 8 cups chicken thigh, skin, defrosted | 3 cups half-and-half
instructions: Put the chicken thighs in a large soup pot. Place over medium heat. Add the half and half and heat until hot. Turn heat to low, and cook for at least an hour, stirring occasionally. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: rice wine,feta cheese,mozzarella cheese,prune,green cardamom pod
title: Creamy Fried Rice -- Ruz
ingredients: 1 cup rice wine | 2 tablespoons crumbled feta cheese | 1 green cardamom pod, split | 5 pitted prunes, chopped | 4 ounces shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: In a large dry skillet over medium heat, stir together 1 cup rice wine, feta cheese, cardamom, pitted prunes and 1/4 cup cheese. Bring to a boil, and pour into a 2 quart baking dish. Sprinkle with remaining 1/2 cup of cheese. Bake, uncovered, at 400 degrees f for 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: carrot,bean thread noodle,kahlua,salsa,baking soda,parmigiano reggiano cheese,marzipan
title: Easy Low-Fat Mexican Rice Cake
ingredients: 1/2 cup fat-free refried beans thread noodles | 3/4 cup fat-free salsa | 1/2 cup low-fat carrot, grated ( about 1/4 cup ) | 1/3 cup shredded parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/4 cup kahlua ( optional ) or 1/4 cup coffee-flavored liqueur ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 2 teaspoons marzipan
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Combine all ingredients in a bowl, stir to combine. Pour into a 9x13 baking dish coated with cooking spray. Bake for 40 minutes or until center is set and top is nicely browned.

title: Apple-Zucchini Beef Skillet
ingredients: 2 tablespoons italian parsley, chopped | 1 medium zucchini, sliced | 1 lean beef chuck, trimmed and cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 2 teaspoons dried oregano | 12 large sliced peeled tart apples
instructions: In a small nonstick skillet, cook parsley and zucchini in 2 tbs. Of water until the zucchini are tender, about 5 minutes. Drain the zucchini and parsley and place in a bowl. Add the beef to the skillet, and toss to coat. Add the remaining 3 tbs. Of water, the oregano and reserved parsley. Bring to a boil. Stir once.

Random Ingredients: red food coloring,black mustard seed,cantaloupe,corn oil,peppercorn,adobo sauce,tamari
title: Corn and Peppercorn-Wrapped Antojitos With Tamari
ingredients: 8 fresh tomatillos | 4 cups corn oil | 1/2 cup corn oil | 1/2 teaspoon black mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons tamari ( to taste ) | 2 tablespoons adobo sauce ( to taste ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons peppercorns ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon red food coloring
instructions: Remove husks from the tomatillos. Dry them on clean paper towels until dry. Fill the jar with the tomatillos. Remove all of the husks. Pull the top down and loosen the bottom layer, using your fingers. Put a weight on the top of the tomatillos. Seal tightly and store in the refrigerator for at least 24 hours. When ready to use, prepare the tamari. Place the corn oil in a medium size pot. Heat oil, mustard seeds and peppercorns, stirring, until the mustard seeds start popping, approximately 1 - 2 minutes. Add tamari and cook and stir until the liquids become very dark brown, approximately 30 seconds. Add food coloring a little at a time, tasting as you stir. If the mixture is too dark at this time, reduce the pan/skillet heat. The color will be more intense. Remove tamari from fridge and place in a bowl. Add peppercorns, red food coloring and remaining oil. Mix thoroughly. Place the coated tomatillas on a baking tray or baking sheet. Cover with the damp paper towel and place in the sun. Heat the oil on medium high until just starting to smoke – no more. Place the tamari sheets in the hot oil on top of each other. When they are fully cooked, remove from the oil and place on paper towels. Repeat with all of the tomatillas when all of the filling has been used, including some of the tamari sauce.

title: Spinach and Broccoli Saute
ingredients: 2 pounds baby spinach leaves | 12 ounces fresh broccoli florets, washed, trimmed and cut into bite-size pieces | 3 cups fresh baby arugula leaves ( i prefer baby kale )
instructions: Prepare a hot fire in a charcoal grill and set the fire to medium. In a large bowl, combine the spinach and broccoli, reserving 1 cup of the water from cooking the spinach. Toss with the reserved cooking water. Transfer the spinach and broccoli mixture to a platter, sprinkle with the arugula and serve.

title: Frozen Watermelon and Pea Puree
ingredients: 4 cups watermelon | 10 ounces frozen peas | 1 lemon
instructions: Place watermelon and peas in a blender and puree until smooth. Place remaining ingredients in a freezer bag. Pour puree into bag and freeze. After 4 hours, remove puree from freezer, stir through, and let set to thaw for 5 minutes. This makes an excellent substitute for lamb chops or chicken.

title: Super Easy "meatless" Spaghetti
ingredients: 3 tablespoons soy sauce ( to taste ) | 1 -2 tablespoon tabasco sauce ( optional ) | 1 package spaghetti ( or other type of noodle ) | 2 cups ricotta cheese ( about 1/2-1 cup )
instructions: Start by making a spaghetti. Boil water for spaghetti. In a large pot, make a sauce. Throw in the spaghetti. Stir fry for about a minute, stirring a couple times and breaking up any lumps along the way. Drain, and put to the side next. Add a dash of soy sauce or tabasco sauce, if using. Melt the ricotta cheese in the microwave for 30 second intervals, until it is fully mixed, until smooth and creamy. You could also use reduced fat cottage cheese.

title: Tamari Crisp
ingredients: 1/2 lb lard, melted | 1 cup bisquick | 8 ounces cream cheese, room temperature | 2 tablespoons tamari, sesame paste | 1/4 cup creme fraiche ( to serve )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl until well combined. Pat mixture into a 9 x 13 pan or greased jelly roll pan. Spread with creme fraiche. Bake in a 350°f oven until golden.

Random Ingredients: tamarind pulp,white pepper,picante sauce,nonstick cooking spray,kernel corn
title: Tex-Mex Shredded Red Sauce
ingredients: 3 cans whole kernel corn, drained | 1 jar picante sauce ( mild or hot, to taste ) | 1 package tamarind pulp or ( 1 ounce ) package tamarind paste | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper | nonstick cooking spray
instructions: Drain water from corn and place in a large bowl. Add the corn mixture, picante sauce & tamarind. Spray a 5 cup casserole dish with nonstick cooking spray. Set in a 350 oven or a 6 quart microwave safe container. Cook covered for 5 - 7 minutes, until bubbly. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,double cream,saffron thread,chili powder
title: Saffron Almond Ice Cream
ingredients: 4 tablespoons saffron threads | 150 -200 g sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained | 150 -200 g double cream | chili powder, as you prefer
instructions: Put the saffron in a large bowl and crush it so that it will be easier to pour out. Cut up two tomatoes and grate them into the bowl, squeezing as much pulp as possible from them. Pour in the sun dried tomatoes and crushed saffron mixture and mix well. Bring a saucepan of water to the boil then turn down the heat and simmer until the liquid has reduced by about 50%, about 25 minutes.. Meanwhile, put the cream in a seperate saucepan and heat gently. When almost boiling, turn off the heat. Pour the hot cream into the bowl with the saffron mixture and stir until it is well combined. Divide the mixture between four ramekin dishes. Use a spoon to swirl around the sides to give the mixture a floured appearance. Chill the dishes in fridge until set.

title: Easy Vegan Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup mayonnaise | 1/4 tablespoon lemon zest, finely grated | 1/8 teaspoon cumin powder ( or to taste )
instructions: Combine all ingredients and serve with salads, breadsticks, etc.

Random Ingredients: white mushroom,hard bread,half,egg white,cheddar cheese,italian bread
title: Italian Baked Mushrooms
ingredients: 4 slices hard bread, crusts removed | 2/3 cup half-and-half | 2 egg whites | 2 teaspoons italian bread crumbs | 2 ounces white mushrooms, thinly sliced | 1 1/2 cups shredded cheddar cheese
instructions: Set oven temperature to 400 degrees f. Arrange bread slices in a single layer on a baking sheet that has been sprinkled with a little water. Bake in the center of the oven, until golden brown, about 8 minutes. Set aside. Whisk together the half and half and egg whites in a medium bowl. Stir in the bread crumbs. Spread about 2/3 of the egg mixture in each bread slice, top with mushrooms, then sprinkle with 1/3 of the cheese. Repeat layers until all ingredients are used. Bake in the preheated oven until the top is golden brown, about 15 minutes. Cut into wedges.

title: Hot Duck With Chili Cheese
ingredients: 1 sirloin steak, sliced thinly in 8 x 6 slices | 1 small whole wheat sandwich loaf | 1 lb shrimp or 1 lb crawfish | 3 -4 canned lobsters, cleaned and chopped | 3 -4 mushrooms, chopped | 4 ounces shredded swiss cheese | 1/2 teaspoon monosodium glutamate ( optional ) | 1 package of mexican-style corn or ( 16 ounce ) package corn chip, broken into large pieces or
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Place bread slices in an oven safe dish. Slice roast beef thinly in the shape of crostini. Top bread with ham slices and the lobster, mushrooms or shrimp mixture. Sprinkle with monosodium glutamate to taste. Cover with foil and bake for 25 minutes, uncover and bake another 10 to 15 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: dill pickle,cayenne pepper,self raising flour,beef sirloin,green bean,peanut butter
title: Beef and Peanut Dumplings
ingredients: 375 g beef sirloin | 60 g green beans | 250 g self raising flour | 1/4 cup crunchy peanut butter | 1 tablespoon dill pickle, chopped | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Cube meat and cook til browned. Place into a bowl with rest of ingredients. Toss till smooth. Fill 2/3 of tins. To cook in pan, place in center and place in cold water to come up one side. Heat for 10 minutes til slightly bubbly and top with pickle and cayenne pepper to serve.

Random Ingredients: walnut,black bean,prosciutto,brown sugar,char siu sauce,kidney bean,ham,dark soy sauce
title: Char Siu
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans or ( 16 ounce ) can chickpeas, rinsed and drained | 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained | 3 slices ham, thick | 1 1/2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 3 1/2 tablespoons char siu sauce ( sriracha ) | 2 -3 tablespoons heinz house roasted garlic sauce or 2 -3 tablespoons other sriracha hot sauce | 8 slices prosciutto | 1/3 cup walnut pieces, toasted and coarsely ground
instructions: Stir together beans, ham and sauces in a bowl and chill until serving. Remove ham from sauce and finely dice. Drain beans and ham on a paper towel lined plate. Combine beans, ham and sauces in another bowl. Place prosciutto slices in another bowl. Add walnuts, tossing with hands to combine. Line a 9 x 12 inch cake pan with foil. Place ham in pan. Pour prepared bean mixture over meat. Bake at 375 degrees fahrenheit until heated through, about 3 to 5 minutes.

title: Lamb Frounda
ingredients: 500 g floury potatoes, peeled and sliced thinly | 1 pinch saffron | 1/4 cup sour cream or 1/4 cup low-fat sour cream | 2 tablespoons catsup | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar | 500 g diced lamb | 1 cup iceberg lettuce | 1 cup farfalle pasta, cooked
instructions: Heat oven to 200c or 450°f. Cook the farfalle as per the package instructions. Add sugar to the sour cream and mix in your catsup. Heat a little oil in a fry pan and add the sliced potatoes and saffron on medium heat. Cook, stirring, until they start to soften and then add the sour cream mix. Continue cooking the potato until all of the sour cream has been absorbed. Drain farfalle and add to the sour cream mixture. Mix well and then set aside. In a shallow ovenproof saucer, place the farfalle pasta. Arrange the potato salad on top and cover the farfalle with the tomato sauce. Bake on the center rack of the oven for 30 to 40 minutes or until the farfalle is cooked and the sauce bubbling.

title: Cherie's Polish Kielbasa and Potatoes
ingredients: 2 russet potatoes, peeled and sliced | 1 package kielbasa, sliced | 1 jar r alfredo sauce | 1/3 cup gluten
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add the sliced potatoes and cook until easily pierced with a fork, about 12 minutes. Drain the potatoes through a cloth, and set aside. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. In a baking dish, combine the kielbasa slices, rind, and alfredo sauce. Cover, and bake for 30 minutes in the preheated oven. Remove from the oven. Place an aluminum foil tent on a cookie sheet. Bake for 15 minutes in the preheated oven. Slice kielbasa, and serve with potatoes.

Random Ingredients: cooking oil,wheat lasagna noodle,heavy cream,mung bean
title: Yummy Yummy Mung Bean Lasagna
ingredients: 1 bag mung beans | 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 1 1/2 cups heavy cream | 1 package whole wheat lasagna noodles
instructions: Blend your mung beans with the cooking oil. Spread on a baking sheet and bake at 400 degree farenheit for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, mix together a cup or two of heavy cream with a small amount of salt. When the mung beans/cream mixture comes to a boil, remove from heat and stir in half of the cream. In a bowl, mix together the egg/salt, the remaining cream.

title: Fried Cheese in a Cast Iron
ingredients: 25 ounces corn flakes, ground | 1 tablespoon fast rising yeast | 1 ounce queso fresco, cut into pieces
instructions: Heat skillet or fryer until very hot. Drop cornflake in and fry just until golden. Drain on paper towels. Sprinkle with cheese while warm and enjoy they can also be served on top of a crisp bun or tortilla, or wrapped in a warm flour tortilla.

Random Ingredients: mexican chocolate,bread crumb,red lentil,graham cracker crumb,jumbo shrimp,maraschino cherry
title: Mexican Red Lentil Balls
ingredients: 1 pound jumbo shrimp, peeled and deveined | 4 ounces shredded mexican chocolate | 1 package dry bread crumbs | 3/4 cup dry red lentils | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1 tablespoon maraschino cherries
instructions: Prepare shrimp according to the package instructions. In a medium bowl, stir together the chocolates, bread crumbs and red lentils.

title: Jicama, Beans and Onions
ingredients: 1 can red kidney beans | 1 cup pickled jicama, cut in 1/2-inch dice | 1 1/4 cups sliced sweet bell peppers, strips | 1 1/2 - 2 tablespoons kosher salt | 1/3 cup light beer
instructions: Drain the beans well.

title: Macaroni and Arugula With Tequila
ingredients: 250 g macaroni | 1/2 cup arugula | 500 ml tequila
instructions: Cook macaroni in a pot of boiling water for 20 minutes, until al dente. Drain and run under cold water to stop the cooking. While the pasta is boiling, mix the arugula into a little water. Serve macaroni in large bowls with arugula and tequila on the side.

title: Berbere Orange Salad
ingredients: 3 oranges ( peeled, sectioned, sliced ) | 250 g cheese ( cubed ) | 4 teaspoons tahini ( sesame seed paste ) | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon mixed herbs | 1 teaspoon powdered berbere, coarsely crushed
instructions: Mix the tahini with the vinegar, herbs and grated cheese. Toss with the oranges and let stand to chill for about an hour. Garnish with mixed herbs and the zest of the orange before serving.

title: Creamy Baked Beans
ingredients: 1 pint papadams, such as rijo pkg | 1 liter sour cream | 1 1/2 lbs mutton, cut into 2cm chunks | 1/2 cup dry white wine | 10 lime leaves ( fresh only, not fresh ) | 1 green pepper, deseeded and cut into rings | 1 1/2 cups dry white wine | 1 can pinto beans, drained
instructions: Heat oven to 200°c. Place pint pice on oven trays and cover with foil. Cook for about 1 hour. Turn pice over and cook for another hour. Remove from oven and cool. Remove pice from casing and reserve for gravy. Put meat, wine, juice of limes and peppers into a pan and bring to the boil. Keep heat low and cook, covered for about 2 hours until meat and liquid are reduced by half. Serve warm with beans.

title: Czech Steak and Pepper Sandwich
ingredients: 2 lbs top round steaks or 2 lbs top blade steaks, 1-inch thick | 2 large yellow bell peppers or 2 large red bell peppers, thinly sliced into long thin strips | 8 ounces small limburger cheese ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon turmeric, optional or 2/3 teaspoon cardamom, and 1/8 teaspoon cinnamon ( or to taste )
instructions: Combine pepper slices and cheese in a small skillet and let stand about 5 minutes until soft and cheese is slightly melted. Spread some of the cheese mixture over the meat and sprinkle with spices. Slaw is great on french rolls.

title: Ninniku Jawa (Japanese Chicken Soup)
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs boneless chicken breast halves, cut into pieces | 1/2 cup dashi stock | 1 1/2 teaspoons kosher salt
instructions: Simmer chicken in a covered saucepan over high heat until it is cooked through but soft and very tender, approximately 20 - 30 minutes. Allow chicken to cool down completely before stripping. Use a strainer to pull out all of the bones. Measure dashi stock very carefully into a medium saucepan over medium heat to get about 1 cup. Stir dashi gently into broth to dissolve any large chunks of chicken or have little chicken stuck to the bottom. Bring to a boil over high heat then reduce heat to low. Add onions and stir for an additional 3 minutes. Place chicken pieces back onto the simmering broth, then leave the pan on the burner on high heat for 15 to 20 minutes until chicken is cooked through and creamy.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,cream mushroom soup,pine nut,italian tomato
title: Pine Nut and Tomato Swiss Rollups
ingredients: 3 cans cream of mushroom soup | 1 can italian-style diced tomatoes | 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 cup pine nuts, ground
instructions: Mix cream of mushroom soup with undrained tomatoes and cocoa powder until well combined. Place pine nuts onto a plate and set aside. Roll the pine nuts up jelly roll style and place on a sheet pan. Sprinkle the ground pine nuts over top of roll ups. Allow to cool completely. Serve cool.

Random Ingredients: flour tortilla,extra virgin olive oil,fajita seasoning mix,white onion
title: Oven Fried Quesadillas
ingredients: 1 teaspoon fajita seasoning mix | 1 teaspoon extra virgin olive oil | 8 ounces fajita-style flour tortillas, cut into quarters | white onion, thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix the fajita seasoning mix, olive oil, and tortillas for at least 15 minutes to a spreadable consistency. Spread the mixture on one quarter of the fried tortilla. Arrange the sliced onion on top of the fajita fried tortillas. Cover the mixture with the other fried tortilla.

title: Roasted Pear Dip With Vegan Mayo
ingredients: 8 large pears, peeled, cored, and roughly sliced | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 3 tablespoons nutritional yeast | 1 -2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon dried sage | 1 pinch cocoa ( optional ) or 1 pinch hazelnut ( optional )
instructions: Arrange the pears in a roasting tray or in individual salad bowls. Combine the vinegar, yeast, oregano, sage, cocoa, if using, and salt. Drizzle over the pears. Sprinkle with nuts if using, and drizzle the warm onion and garlic on top.

title: Mango Juice
ingredients: 1 pint mango pulp, pulp | 1 lemon ( optional )
instructions: If using lemon, peel it very thinly before removing the white pith from the fruit with a sharp knife. Place the fruit flesh, pulp, and lemon juice in a blender and blend until smooth.

title: Grilled Beef Sandwich With Daiquiri and Apple
ingredients: 1 lb beef ( preferably rare ) | 6 apple slices ( or 2 small apples ) | 1 small banana pepper ( or 2 small ) | 1 head romaine lettuce | 1 teaspoon dark rum
instructions: Cook the beef by making sure it has been cut in half. Grill or broil the meat for about 7 minutes, turning once, until it is rare, about 8 minutes. When the meat is completely cooked, make a cut in the top of the meat about 1 1/2 inches wide. Spread some dark rum on the top of the rum. When the loaf is ready, slice the meat into bite size pieces, and serve the meat with the daiquiri recipe. Note, the rum can sometimes be very hot but if that is the thing for you as long as you allow it to heat up before it starts to smoke. The idea is to smother the beef in the rum. Also, you want to be sponching the fruit back into the rum. This is very popular over the years. Note, the idea is not to allow the flames from the rum to burn.

title: Asparagus Lasagna
ingredients: 1 lb lasagna noodle | 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1 bunch fresh asparagus, trimmed, cut into pieces | 1 whole lemon | 7 sheets dried thin strips fennel seeds | 5 teaspoons dried rosemary | 3 teaspoons soy sauce | 2 tablespoons minced fresh rosemary | 1/4 cup canola oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f grease a 9 x 13 inch baking dish. Cook noodles according to package directions, drain noodles, rinse with cold water and set aside. In a small bowl sprinkle with 2 tablespoons of canola oil and mix well. Brush 4 sheets of pasta with canola oil. Arrange 3 asparagus pieces evenly over noodles.

title: Irish Beef Tenderloin - Slow Cooker Recipe
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin steaks | 1/2 cup raisins ( or more if desired ) or 1/2 cup sultanas ( or more if desired )
instructions: Trim fat and very tough parts of the fat from the steaks and cut them into 1/2 to 3/4 inch slices. Put all ingredients into crock pot except the raisins or sultanas or put the raisins into a small bowl with the raisins. Turn the slow cooker on high or low setting and cook for 3 hours on high, 6 to 8 hours on low if using raisins or sultanas.

title: Yum Yum Picky's Baked Oats
ingredients: 4 cups quick cooking oats | 1 teaspoon chili seasoning mix ( mccormick brand ) | 1 cucumber | 4 tablespoons brown mustard
instructions: Preheat oven to mix together oats and chili seasoning in a large bowl. Add sliced cucumber and mustard mix to coat well. Cut 1/4 off the end of the cucumber so it’s striped size. Place on cookie sheet and bake in the oven for 15 minutes, flip and bake for 15 minutes more. Cool for 10 minutes and enjoy.

title: Chilled Clamato Vomaki
ingredients: 2 cans of chopped clamsato juice | 1 medium mango, peeled, seeded and finely chopped | 2 tablespoons vegemite | 1 teaspoon cumin seed
instructions: In an 8 inch nonstick skillet, mix together the clamsato juice, mango and lemon juice. Add vegemite and stir to combine. Bring to a boil over medium heat. When boiling, lower heat to medium. Cook, stirring frequently, for 30 seconds. Add cumin seeds and continue cooking until they're cooked. Ladle warm clamato sauce over mango and serve.

title: Spiced Snow Peas (Spice Mix)
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon sweet paprika | 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves | 1 1/2 cups marinara sauce ( about two 1-ounce cans ) | 1/2 cup frozen chopped snow peas
instructions: Combine the paprika and ground cloves in a small bowl. Stir in ¾ cup of the marinara. Stir in the remaining marinara and snowpeas. Store in an airtight container for up to 1 week.

title: White Bean Habanero
ingredients: 1 lb great northern bean ( california will do ) | 1 small serrano pepper ( optional-i did not try it ) | pimiento, jarred
instructions: Rinse beans and remove outer layer from bean shell. Place bean and pepper in saucepan. Heat on medium until pepper starts to soften. Add jar of pimento jarred pimentos and about 1 1/2 cup water. Cover and cook for 25 minutes. Do not boil. Take the bean and pepper off the stove. Serve hot with fresh, warm bread and lots of black pepper on the side.

title: Spinach in Yogurt
ingredients: 8 ounces shredded fresh spinach leaves, washed | 1/2 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 2 tablespoons sweet paprika | 1/2 cup dry red wine
instructions: Line a baking sheet with foil. Toss spinach with yogurt, paprika, and wine until well coated.

Random Ingredients: fennel seed,ham,turmeric powder,escarole,lettuce leaf,sugar syrup,lime zest,cantaloupe
title: Award Winning Brazilian Pickled Eggs
ingredients: 4 heads lettuce leaves ( bordelaise ) | 4 -6 ounces ham, thinly sliced ( pref. prosciutto ) | 1 1/2 cups lebanese cantaloupe, thinly sliced | 1 cup frilled pickled escarole | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed ( saunf ) | 2 tablespoons lime zest | 1 tablespoon turmeric powder | 1 -2 tablespoon sugar syrup ( to taste )
instructions: Cut ends off lettuce leaves and place leaf in a serving bowl. Layer ham, cantaloupe, and escarole on lettuce leaves. Sprinkle with saunf frank salt, and then the fennel seeds. Add lime zest. Add turmeric powder. Makes 4 - 5 servings.

title: Cauliflower Stir-Fry With Swiss Chard (Prawn) Pimentos & Swiss Chard
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons sherry wine | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 2 1/2 tablespoons tomato sauce or 2 1/2 tablespoons tomato paste | 2 teaspoons chopped pickled cauliflower | 1 tablespoon chopped swiss chard | 16 prawns ( about 1 lb. at the tail of the tail )
instructions: Combine first five ingredients in a heavy large skillet. Cook over medium high heat, stirring occasionally, until mixture is thick and syrupy, about 5 minutes. Toss in cauliflower and chard. Cover and cook 2 minutes longer. Serve immediately or cool slightly and put in refrigerator until ready to serve. Variation, add 1/4 to 1/3 cup finely chopped cooked pork or 1/4 cup cooked chicken. Use a generous dose of chopped fresh parsley, chopped red onion and garlic for added color. Use 1/4 to 1/3 cup chopped or chopped cilantro for a different taste.

title: Noodles With Clementines, Nuts, And Preserves
ingredients: 1 lb potato, peeled, cut into 1 inch pieces ( if you prefer to use a whole or half pounder, a larger potato will mean you will actually need less cooking ) | 1 large spanish onion, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup butter | 1/2 cup walnuts, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup green olives, cut in half | 1 teaspoon cooking oil | 4 stalks le clementines ( see note for instructions ) or 4 candied citron peel, cut into thin strips | 3/4 cup sweet potato, drained, rinsed, drained, and cut into 1/2 inch pieces
instructions: To make the stew, bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add the peeled potato pieces, a few pieces at a time, and cook until tender, about 10 - 15 minutes. Drain. While the potatoes are cooking, prepare the topping. In a heavy bottomed saucepan over medium heat, fry the sliced onion until tender, 5 - 7 minutes. Remove to a platter. Increase the heat to medium high and stir in the walnuts and olives. Cook until hot, about 1 minute. Stir in the lemon peel. Deglaze the pan with 2/3 cup water. Add the cornstarch mixture and cook just until thickened, about a minute, stirring constantly. Add the sweet potato, stirring until coated evenly in the butter. Season with salt and pepper and serve over the stew.

title: Grilled French Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread | 2 tablespoons vodka | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh chives
instructions: Slice bread and spread evenly with olive oil. Place bread on a grill pan which has been sprayed very well with non stick cooking spray or over a grill. Grill over medium heat for about 7 to 10 minutes, turning once. Remove from grill and brush with vodka and chives. Serve at once, accompanied by your favourite salad.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,red onion,cream chicken soup
title: Bangalore Red Curry Dip
ingredients: 2 cups cream of chicken soup | 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 2 large red onions, thinly sliced
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix the cream of chicken soup with the curry paste. Stir in the red onions to coat. Transfer mixture to a greased 9 inch square baking dish. Cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or overnight. Serve chilled.

title: Strawberry Banana Sauce
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 2 bananas, sliced | 1 cup sliced strawberries | 1 cup oyster sauce
instructions: Combine soup, bananas, strawberries and oyster sauce in medium saucepan, cook stirring occasionally, over moderately low heat until bananas are softened. Spoon mixture into lightly greased 8 square baking pan. Cover with plastic wrap and freeze until firm.

title: Stuffed Swiss Chard
ingredients: 1 bunch swiss chard | 2 1/2 pounds ground beef chuck
instructions: Cover a large saucepan with water and bring to a boil. Add the chard and cook over medium heat until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain. Break off the tough stems from the washed chard stems. Tear the leaves and the stems into 3 or 4 pieces and chop finely. Set aside. Place ground beef in a skillet. Cover with water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium low and simmer until no pink remains, about 30 minutes. The meat should be no longer pink after cooking.

Random Ingredients: phyllo pastry,gruyere cheese,ice water,almond,apricot jam,ginger paste
title: Cheese Samosas With Apricots and Almonds
ingredients: 1/4 cup walnut halves or 1/4 cup slivered almonds | 1/4 teaspoon ginger paste | 1/2 cup apricot jam, smooth or 1/2 cup apricot jam | 2 tablespoons ice water | 1 package phyllo pastry sheets, thawed | 1/2 cup shredded gruyere cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Place walnuts and ginger paste on an ungreased baking sheet. Cook in oven about 2 minutes. Stir constantly so that they don't burn and watch carefully. Remove from oven and stir in apricot jam. Cool slightly. In a large bowl, cover phyllo with plastic wrap. Cut phyllo into strips about 12 inches long. Brush strip with egg wash. Arrange strips on waxed paper and cover with another sheet of phyllo. Repeat, brushing each strip with egg wash. Sprinkle with cheese and nuts. Roll out dough to a 6 inch square. Cut into triangles, place on the baking sheet in a single layer.

Random Ingredients: mayonnaise,parmesan cheese,parmigiano reggiano cheese,red wine,kosher salt,red curry paste
title: Italian Grilled Red Curry Cheese
ingredients: 1/2 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/2 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/3 cup mayonnaise | 2 teaspoons red curry paste | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 1/4 cup dry red wine
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and combine thoroughly. Cover, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.

title: Penne With Orange Glaze
ingredients: 12 ounces dry penne | nonstick cooking spray | 4 tablespoons orange liqueur ( can use white ) | 1 cup bean sprouts
instructions: Cook the penne as directed. Drain pasta when done and run under cold water to cool slightly. Spray a medium sauce pan with non stick cooking spray. Heat the orange liqueur in the microwave for 30 seconds. Toss hot pasta with orange glaze. Sprinkle bean sprouts on top. Sprinkle with more bean sprouts if desired.

title: Prawns Italian Style
ingredients: 500 g prawns | 1/4 cup chili pepper, de arbol blend
instructions: Shell and devein prawns. Marinate prawns in chilli pepper marinade. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Refrigerate and leave for at least 1 hour. Rinse and wash prawns. Place in a sauce pan with just enough water to cover the prawns. Simmer for 15 - 20 minutes. Add 1/3 of the basil and cook til tender.

Random Ingredients: chive,japanese sushi rice,cream chicken soup,baby spinach leaf,currant
title: Japanese Rice Balls
ingredients: 4 cups japanese sushi-style rice, prepared on package ( or other long grain rice such as nishiki ) | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup, undiluted | 1 package baby spinach leaves | 1 cup dried currant | 2 tablespoons fresh chives, finely chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients except for the dried and fresh chives in a bowl. If desired, add more chives, and stir to combine. Shape mixture into 1 inch balls slightly smaller than a golf ball. Gently roll balls in the dried chives. Store in an airtight container up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: american cheese,ra el hanout spice mix,tabasco sauce,betty garlic potato,strawberry,red chili pepper flake,butter,lobster meat
title: Lobster Thermidor
ingredients: 2 lbs lobster meat | 2 lbs american cheese ( cubed ) | 1 lb baby spinach | 1 jar ra el hanout spice mix | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 2 teaspoons crushed red chili pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons butter | 1 quart frozen cut strawberries
instructions: Clean lobster meat leaving tail on and clean of all claws or the meat. Chop up the lobster meat and set aside. Combine 2 lbs american cheese/ cubed american cheese, spinach, and crab meat with all of the seasoning except berries. Pour the lobster/cheese mixture evenly over the cheese and spinach mix. Arrange half of the berries on top of the lobster mixture and cover with remaining goat cheese cubes and chopped up american cheese. Bake in a 350 oven for 60 minutes.

Random Ingredients: garam masala,red capsicum,cream tartar,maraschino cherry,mozzarella ball
title: Indian Pizza With Scented Red Capsicum & Cheese
ingredients: 1 large mozzarella ball, cut into 2 cm wedges | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 medium red capsicum, cut into thin strips | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon finely chopped fresh maraschino cherries or 1 -1 1/2 teaspoon sherry wine vinegar
instructions: Place mozzarella wedges on a work surface. Combine cream of tartar with 1 teaspoon garam masala in a shallow dish. Rub ginger paste all over the cheese. Spread cream mixture over cheese.

Random Ingredients: bay leaf,icing sugar,baking powder,heavy whipping cream,white pepper powder,celery
title: Delicious Easy Flavourful Biscuits (No Flour)
ingredients: 1 cup icing sugar | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 1 teaspoon white pepper powder | 1 bay leaf | 1 stalk celery, diced | 1 1/2 cups heavy whipping cream
instructions: In a mixer, blend the icing sugar, baking powder, white pepper and bay leaf. Add the celery. Add the cream. Form small balls of dough, 2 - 3 cm in diameter. Place on a greased tray. Refrigerate for 2 minutes. Heat oven to 160°c. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cannellini bean,cayenne powder,brie cheese,yeast,turmeric powder,cheese,chocolate peanut
title: Antoine Bouillabaisse (Antoine Bouillabaisse)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs brie cheese, crumbled | 4 ounces salted cheese, crumbled ( from a jar of italian specialty cheeses ) | 4 ounces chocolates ( italian pungent chocolates-i buy a mix of both types of cheeses ) or 4 ounces peanut butter ( italian pungent chocolates-i buy a mix of both types of cheeses ) | 1 teaspoon instant yeast ( not fast action yeast ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons turmeric powder | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne powder ( or to taste ) | 1 can cannellini beans ( drained )
instructions: Mix the yeast with 1 tablespoons water, add 1 tablespoon lukewarm water, stir to combine. Mix in the rest of the ingredients. Pour into greased baking tin, sprayed with oil and bake at 350 degrees for about 1 hour. If browning too quickly add more water.

title: Spinach & Strawberry Bruschetta
ingredients: 7 ounces spinach leaves, drained | 3 ounces strawberries, hulled & halved | 4 teaspoons dried oregano, crumbled | crusty bread, to serve
instructions: Combine spinach and strawberries in a large bowl. Combine oregano and crumbled oregano. Add to spinach mixture. Serve on bread.

title: White Bread and Pepper Sandwiches
ingredients: 4 slices bread, toasted | 6 slices white bread | 6 lettuce leaves, lettuces
instructions: Spread toasted bread with mustard. Brush with mustard. Place on lettuce leaves.

Random Ingredients: rigatoni pasta,ciabatta,shrimp,red curry paste,purpose flour,broccoli floret,almond extract,plain nonfat yogurt
title: Thai-Spiced Shrimp
ingredients: 1/4 cup all-purpose flour | 1/4 cup red curry paste | 12 ounces fresh shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 3/4 cups broccoli florets, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 cup ciabatta, cut into 1/4-inch cubes | 1 1/2 cups plain nonfat yogurt | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract | 1 package rigatoni pasta
instructions: Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add the flour and curry paste and stir to blend. Add shrimp and cook 3 - 4 minutes, until the shrimp are pink and just cooked through. Stir in the broccoli and ciabatta. Cook 3 minutes, stirring frequently, until the shrimp just turns pink. Add yogurt and almond extract and cook until liquid is evaporated. Spoon onto rigatoni.

Random Ingredients: hot italian sausage,matzo meal,beer,almond extract,chile sauce,cottage cheese,rutabaga,egg yolk
title: Passover Chilt Glamiche
ingredients: 3 lbs rutabagas, peeled with the ends cut off | 3 lbs beetroots or 3 lbs beet, peeled with the ends cut off | 2 cups strong beer | 3 1/2 ounces chile sauce | 1 lb cottage cheese | 3 egg yolks | 1 tablespoon almond extract | 3 teaspoons hot passover hot italian sausage or 3 teaspoons hot italian sausage sauce
instructions: Place rutabaga in a large large pot, add just enough water to cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to medium as liquid begins to simmer. Cook for about an hour or until potatoes are tender. Drain and mash. Meanwhile, place chile sauce in a food processor. Process in 1/4 cup water. Heat over medium heat until steaming.

title: Gochujang Breakfast Roll
ingredients: 12 ounces grilled country-style french fries | 12 ounces grilled chunky-style grilled russet potatoes ( about 4 potatoes ) | 1 package ladyfingers | 2 teaspoons gochujang ( korean-style chile paste or sweet soy sauce ) | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper, or to taste | 1 can or bottle light beer ( such as coca-cola )
instructions: Place french fries in a large bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate until chilled, about 30 minutes. Place chunky grilled potatoes in a medium bowl. Sprinkle french fries with a pinch of cayenne pepper, and top with chunky fries. Repeat with half the ladyfingers, and half the rice and fries. Top with remaining ladyfingers and potato slices. Heat a small amount of canola oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the remaining cayenne pepper and a generous pinch of cayenne pepper. When the oil is hot, and beginning to smoke, carefully place the rest of the fried fries in the hot skillet. Cook until golden brown, 2 to 4 minutes per side, and transfer to a baking sheet. Continue to cook fries until cooked through, another 2 to 4 minutes per side. Serve immediately.

title: Mango Dip
ingredients: 2 tablespoons peanut butter | 2 mangoes | 1/2 cup cheese, grated
instructions: Grate mangoes and mix together with peanut butter. Then make into a mound in your food bowl, adding cheese. Enjoy you can also serve with biscuits, crackers or just eat it plain with puffy bananas.

title: Spicy Jalapenos
ingredients: 6 jalapeno peppers, halved lengthwise and seeded | 1 teaspoon tamari ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon chili paste | 2 tablespoons rolled oats | 2 tablespoons shredded cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat broiler. Line a baking sheet with foil. Arrange the marinated jalapenos on the prepared baking sheet. Sprinkle the tamari, chili paste, rolled oats and cheddar cheese on top of the jalapenos. Broil to melt the cheese and brown the cheese.

title: Spaghetti With Wine - Arve
ingredients: 1 package precooked spaghetti noodles | 1 tablespoon baking soda | 1 tablespoon rice wine ( dry )
instructions: Dice up the spaghetti and put it in a pan with boiling water. Add the wine and then add the baking soda. Cook until the desired texture has been achieved. You may then add salt while cooking, but we didn't like the taste of salt, so you might have to add another teaspoon of baking soda.

title: Easy Low Carb Taco Fritters
ingredients: canola oil ( for frying ) | 2 packets taco seasoning
instructions: Heat the canola oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the taco seasoning and mix together. Drop small teaspoons full onto the skillet and fry until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: rice flour,dark beer,beer,miso,basmati rice,dark sesame oil,sandwich bread
title: Beer Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 cup white basmati rice, rinsed | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1 can light beer or ( 12 ounce ) can dark stout beer | 3 1/4 ounces rice flour | 1 1/2 tablespoons miso | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1 sandwich bread, toasted ( such as boboli ) or 1 naan bread
instructions: In large bowl, combine rice, 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil and beer. Set aside. Combine rice flour, miso, 2 1/2 teaspoons sesame oil and remaining 1 tablespoon of sesame oil, and rice mixture in separate bowl.

Random Ingredients: tabasco sauce,pesto sauce,taco seasoning mix,white sugar,bean,lime juice
title: Pizza Melt
ingredients: 1 can refried beans | 4 teaspoons prepared pesto sauce | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1/4 cup white sugar | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning mix | 1 teaspoon lime juice
instructions: Spread the refried beans onto a sheet of aluminum foil. Spread the pesto sauce over the beans. Place the tabasco pepper sauce and sugar in a saucepan and heat over low heat until the sugar is dissolved. Mix the taco seasoning with the lime juice. Spread the seasoned pesto sauce over the pesto bean mixture.

Random Ingredients: american cheese,gruyere,pepperjack cheese,dark sesame oil,basmati rice
title: Cheese Con Puff
ingredients: 6 slices gruyere | 2 cups instant basmati rice | 1/4 cup crushed hot pepperjack cheese | 6 slices american cheese | 1/4 cup dark sesame oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spread sliced gruyere on one side of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Sprinkle hot pepperjack cheese over cheese. Bake in the preheated oven until the cheese is melted, about 10 minutes. Prepare the rice as directed on the package, but use a large spoon to mash the rice with the hot pepperjack and american cheeses. Drizzle the rice with the sesame oil, making sure it is thoroughly combined, and serve.

title: Homemade Sriracha Sauce
ingredients: 1/ 2 tablespoons sriracha sauce or 2 tablespoons red hot sauce | 2 tablespoons minced flat leaf parsley
instructions: In mortar with pestle or with flat top of a meat mallet, smash garlic with flat top of a large heavy knife until a paste forms. Transfer paste to small plastic storage bag. Combine sriracha and chopped parsley in small bowl until well blended. Pour over meat.

Random Ingredients: feta cheese,coriander powder,chicken thigh,chili oil,kernel corn
title: Corn and Feta Curry Chicken #2
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs chicken thighs ( boneless, skin on pieces ) | 1 can kernel corn | 1/2 cup feta cheese | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder | 1 teaspoon chili oil
instructions: Dredge chicken with flour, salt and pepper as directed on bag. Combine remaining ingredients. Pour over chicken in baking dish in a single layer. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350 degrees for 50 - 60 minutes, or until chicken is done. Uncover and bake for 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: fennel bulb,red chilies,sesame oil,sazon seasoning,deli roast beef,vinegar
title: Chile-Grilled Chuck Roast Beef
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs thinly sliced deli roast beef | 2 fennel bulbs | 4 -6 small dried red chilies, seeded and chopped | 3 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons vinegar | 1 tablespoon sazon seasoning ( mccormick recommended )
instructions: Place meat and fennel in a slow cooker and toss with all other ingredients except the meat. Cover and cook on low 7 - 8 hours. Remove meat and cover to redistribute liquid. Let sit about 5 - 10 minutes before slicing.

title: Sausage and Cardamom Bread
ingredients: 1 pound bulk italian sausage | 3/4 cup bread flour | 1 pinch ground cardamom | 1 pinch paprika | 1 pinch nutmeg | 1 1/2 teaspoons seasoning | 5 tablespoons golden tequila, divided
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Drain the sausage, and fry until browned and crumbly, and no longer pink inside. Drain off excess grease. Stir in the flour, cardamom, paprika, nutmeg, and 1 cup tequila. Mix well, and allow mixture to thicken. Turn into a 9x5 inch loaf pan. Sprinkle reserved 1/2 cup tequila on top.

Random Ingredients: italian seasoning,white vinegar,onion soup mix,potato,lemongrass,beef,tomato puree,vegetable shortening
title: Vietnamese Grilled Spicy Beef Kabobs
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef | 2 tablespoons dehydrated onion soup mix | 2 tablespoons tomato puree | 1 tablespoon lemon grass, minced | 1 tablespoon vegetable shortening, melted | 1 tablespoon grated onion soup mix | 2 tablespoons distilled white vinegar | 6 large potatoes, scrubbed but not peeled | 1/4 teaspoon italian seasoning
instructions: In medium sized bowl sprinkle ground beef with onion soup mix, tomato puree, lemon grass, and shortening.

Random Ingredients: syrup,rose petal,oriental sesame oil,pork tenderloin,paprika,dark rum
title: Pork-Stuffed Oriental Sesame Oil
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin | 2 tablespoons sweet paprika | 1 tablespoon oriental sesame oil | 1 tablespoon dark rum | 1 tablespoon rose petal, minced | 1 tablespoon syrup
instructions: Preheat an oven to 400 degrees f. Cut a very thin slice off just the top of the pork tenderloin and remove most of the white portion with each slice. Reserve for later. Cut the long slice of tenderloin lengthwise into 3/4 inch slices. Place the tenderloin slices in a shallow baking dish. Combine the paprika, sesame oil, rum, rose petal, and syrup in a small bowl.

title: Pigeon Peas, Stuffed and Spiced
ingredients: 1 can pigeon peas | 1/2 cup sliced dates ( about 15 ) | 1 tablespoon brown sugar | 1 1/2 tablespoons white pepper | 1 tablespoon sliced almonds | 1 1/4 cups wine | 1/4 cup granulated sugar
instructions: Combine all ingredients, except almonds, and mix well. Chill.

title: Filipino Macaroni Grill

instructions: In a bowl, combine the garlic, 1 tablespoon of the sour cream, dark soy sauce, mace, and brown sugar with a mixer on medium speed. Cover and refrigerate the mixture for at least 15 minutes prior to serving. Remove and discard the fish from the refrigerator at the suggested time for the sauce. Serve the macaroni topped with the remaining sour cream, a dollop of the nonfat sour cream, if desired.

title: Chef John's White Beans and Rice, a Martha Good Thing for Diabetics!
ingredients: 3 cups cooked white beans ( i've even cooked and drained the beans, so i've just left the skins on ) | 2 cups masa harina or 2 cups cornmeal | 1 cup italian salad dressing, warmed | 1 tablespoon calvados or 1 tablespoon apple cider vinegar, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: In a large bowl, add the beans, mash them with a wooden spoon, and let them sit while you mix the cornmeal and sugar together thoroughly, add the salad dressing if you use it, and stir until the mixture is just thick and uniform. Add the dough to the beans and mix well. Taste and adjust the seasoning, put in the refrigerator for 30 to 60 minutes to allow the starch to settle out. After the white bean dough has rested for about 20 minutes, knead it a few times, then divide it in half. With floured hands, roll or press each quarter into a circle about 8 inches in diameter.

title: The Chipotle Burger
ingredients: 1 green sweet pepper, diced | 1 chipotle chile in adobo, finely minced | lettuce ( we use iceberg lettuce ) | 2 tablespoons rum
instructions: Combine peppers and minced garlic. Mash the chilies in adobo with a mortar and pestle or a rolling pin until they form a paste. Add pepper mixture to ground paste. Serve on hamburger buns with a condiment of chili, onion rings, chopped tomatoes, sliced pickles, etc.

title: Torta Di Carciofi
ingredients: 4 teaspoons basil leaves, roughly chopped | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh rosemary | 1 tablespoon dried breadcrumbs or 1 tablespoon ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup pizza sauce | 1 cup baked beans | 1 tablespoon chopped nuts, toasted ( optional )
instructions: Mix together the basil, rosemary, crumbs, and a dollop of pizza sauce in a small serving bowl. Spread the bean mixture over the pizza in an attractive plate. Sprinkle the nuts over. Eat immediately or refrigerate until serving.

title: Broccole Vegetable Soup (Yoshinoya)
ingredients: 1 cup fresh broccoli, peeled | 1 can chickpeas, rinsed and drained | 6 cups fish stock
instructions: Place broth and chick peas in a pot.

Random Ingredients: mango chutney,corn oil,vermicelli,asparagus,pecorino romano cheese,kaffir lime leaf
title: Vermicelli and Asparagus Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 6 kaffir lime leaves, crushed | 18 large fresh asparagus, trimmed and cut into thirds ( about 1 pound ) | 1 tablespoon mango chutney | 2 ounces uncooked vermicelli | 1/2 cup grated pecorino romano cheese, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Combine 2 tablespoons peanut oil and corn oil in a small bowl. Add lime leaves and toss to coat. Set aside. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add asparagus, cooking until tender but still slightly crisp, about 2 minutes. Drain asparagus in a colander. Rinse under cold water. Repeat with remaining asparagus. Drain well. Transfer to a serving bowl. Top with mango chutney and vermicelli. Sprinkle with grated cheese. Repeat with remaining cheese.

title: Chipotle Moro (Fish Tacos)
ingredients: 1/2 lb white fish fillet, sliced thinly on an angle | 12 egg whites, beaten well | 2 tablespoons adobo sauce
instructions: Marinate fish in egg whites for 30 - 60 minutes. In a fry pan, cook fish in hot oil until just cooked through. Serve with pico de gallo and fresh pico de gallo.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,romaine lettuce,chicken stock vegetable,white wine,celery seed,chicken rice soup
title: Garlic-Rific Chicken Rice Soup
ingredients: 1/4 cup white wine | 1 whole chicken ( i use chicken breast ) | garlic salt | 2 quarts chicken stock or 2 quarts vegetable stock | 1 teaspoon celery seed | cooked rice ( to garnish )
instructions: Place stock and celery seed in medium pot. Turn down to a medium boil. Place chicken in stock and simmer over med heat about 1 1/2 2 hours until the chicken is cooked thoroughly and falling off the bones. When chicken is cool enough to handle, shred it and return bones and juices to pot. Remove fat if desired. Place about 4oz. Of uncooked rice in to a bowl and mash with a fork or pastry blender until it forms a fine textured, grainy texture. Add garlic salt to taste. Pour in water to just below the boiling point and allow soup to simmer for 15 minute while you prepare your other ingredients. To serve, ladle soup into individual soup bowls. Top each with a few tablespoons of cooked rice. Garnish with a little crushed roasted garlic. Serve.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,white chocolate,chicken broth,pecorino romano cheese,purpose flour,green bell pepper,greek oregano,dark sesame oil
title: Warm White Chocolate and Pecorino Pesto Pasta Sauce
ingredients: 3/4 cup chicken broth or 3/4 cup stock | 1 cup white chocolate | 1 1/2 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil | 1/2 lb prawns or 1/2 lb prawns, peeled deveined and cut into small pieces ( about 3/4 pound ) | 2 teaspoons greek oregano, minced | 3 tablespoons grated pecorino romano cheese, about | 1 tablespoon chopped flat leaf parsley | green bell pepper, chopped | 2 teaspoons dark sesame oil
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine chicken stock and chocolate and cook over medium heat, stirring, until chocolate melts and mixture is smooth, around 4 minutes. Remove prawns with a slotted spoon and set aside. Add oregano, cheese, 1 tablespoon parsley, peppers and 1 teaspoon sesame oil and 2 teaspoons water to pan.

Random Ingredients: tomato puree,thyme,clear honey,salad oil,kiwi fruit,irish cream,bamboo shoot,anise extract
title: Australian Kiwi Salad
ingredients: 3 tomatoes, cut into chunks | 3 kiwi fruits, peeled, sliced | 2 tablespoons clear honey | 2 tablespoons tomato puree | 3 tablespoons irish cream | thyme, to taste | 2 -4 drops anise extract | 1 tablespoon salad oil
instructions: In large saucepan heat honey, puree, rosemary and orange extract for 30 seconds, stir well then add kiwifruit juice and simmer 2 - 3 minutes stirring all the time to make a smooth sauce. Remove from heat, add kiwifruit juice, and stir well again. When cool, mix together in serving bowl. Top with finely sieved biscuits and grated fresh orange zest. Garnish with fresh thyme sprigs.

title: Pickled Squash
ingredients: 10 small squash, trimmed, but unpeeled | 1 jalapenos or 1 small poblano chile with seeds | 2 dill pickle slices
instructions: Bring 2 quarts of water to a boil. Add squash and cook until almost tender, about 5 minutes. Drain and cool. Cut squash in half lengthwise. Remove seeds. Place in a large jar with a tight fitting lid. Mince the garlic and add to the squash. Add the poblano and dill pickles. Cover loosely and chill for 1 hour.

title: Hot Cauliflower
ingredients: 3 heads cauliflower, thick bottom stems separated and the florets separated | 1/2 cup liquid smoke flavoring | 1/2 cup grand marnier
instructions: Preheat oven to 375ºf. Place head of cauliflower in a casserole dish. In a bowl mix liquid smoke and grand marnier. Pour over cauliflower so it gets coated. Cover with lid. Bake for 1 hour. Allow to stand, refrigerated for up to 2 days before serving.

title: Rice With Sausages and Parsnips
ingredients: 1 lb good quality sweet sausage | 1 bunch parsnip ( washed cut into half through centre ) | 4 cups basmati rice, washed in salted water
instructions: Place the sausages in saucepan with 3 cups of water. Bring to the boil and then cover and simmer for 20 minutes or until the sausage is cooked and the vegetables are tender. Remove the sausages from the pan. Skim any excess fat and reserve for step meanwhile add the parsnips, rice, and 3 cups of simmering water to a pot. Cover and slowly bring to the boil. Reduce the heat, cover and partially simmer for about 30 minutes or until all the water is absorbed. Remove from heat and allow to stand, uncovered, for 10 minutes. Place the sausages in the serving dish and serve immediately.

title: Quick and Easy Rice Balls (Bunuelos)
ingredients: 2 cups basmati rice, washed and cleaned | lemon pepper flakes ( as required ) | club soda water ( as required )
instructions: Wash your rice in 2 - 3 changes of water and drain it well. Place the rice in a bowl and add the lemon pepper flakes, club soda of your choice, stir gently and allow it to cool. Roll the rice balls into balls with your palms then put them on a tray and cover with a damp cloth. Repeat the above process for every ball then store in a cool place. Tips, you can play with the saltiness of the lemon pepper flakes, it is always better not to over season the rice balls as it will make it bitter and bitter tasting. If you are using club soda in the recipe then it will dilute the sweetness of the dish and make it unpleasant for your hands.

Random Ingredients: allspice,ginger juice,swiss chard,neufchatel cheese,yellow pepper,pizza sauce
title: Swiss Chard Appetizer (With Beets)
ingredients: 1 bunch swiss chard, stemmed ( about 1 1/2 pounds total ) | 1/2 cup prepared pizza sauce | 2 teaspoons fresh ginger juice | 1/2 teaspoon allspice ( optional ) | 1 medium yellow sweet pepper, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 1/2 cups neufchatel cheese, room temperature
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Snap off tough top stems of chard leaves. Remove leaves. Cut stems into 1/2 inch pieces. Cook in boiling salted water 1 minute. Drain, and rinse with cold water. Repeat 3 times. Set aside. Place chard leaves on a cutting board, and cut crosswise along center of stalks to separate leaves.

title: Balsamic Glaze
ingredients: 1 bunch spring onion | 1 cup cherry, halved or | 2 cups dry catsup, divided | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon dried chili pepper flakes ( optional )
instructions: Chop one spring onion and place them in a saucepan with the cherries and 2 tbsp of the reserved cherries. Add 1/2 cup warm water, then bring to the boil, stirring constantly. Allow to boil 2 or 3 more minutes, then remove the pan from the heat. Allow the glaze to cool 1 or 2, then whisk together the remaining cherries with the balsamic vinegar& chili flakes, if using.

Random Ingredients: salsa,graham cracker crumb,stevia,baking soda,green onion,chili powder,baby portabella mushroom,sunflower oil
title: Spicy Portabella Mushrooms (Gluten Free)
ingredients: 2 teaspoons sunflower oil ( or vegetable oil ) | 2 cups baby portabella mushrooms, quartered ( may use up to 3 cups in size ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons stevia ( gluten free & no msg ) | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1/4 cup salsa ( i've used regular salsa ) | 1/4 teaspoon stevia ( gluten free & no msg ) | 1 green onion, chopped | 1/8 teaspoon chili powder | 1/8 teaspoon baking soda ( or lemon juice ) | 1/2 teaspoon stevia ( gluten free & no msg ) | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Warm pan of boiling salted water on low heat, swirling to coat pan. Add mushroom and oil to oil and stir fry until tender, then remove and set aside. Heat water in pan. Add salt, stevia, chili powder, baking soda and stir to dissolve baking soda. Add salsa, green onion, chilie, chili powder, baking soda and stir until well mixed and hot. Spoon mushroom into four serving dish. Sprinkle with crumbs and drizzle with a little remaining oil. Enjoy.

title: Maggie's Mojito
ingredients: 1 bottle red enchilada sauce | 2 jalapenos, seeded and chopped | 1/4 cup dry roasted peanuts | 1/4 cup dark rum | 1 1/2 teaspoons tamari | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 1/3 cup white wine
instructions: Rinse and dry the shrimp. Chop and set aside. In a blender combine enchilada sauce, chopped jalapenos, dry roasted peanuts, dark rum, tamari, mace and white wine. Blend until smooth. Refrigerate until serving.

title: Root Beer
ingredients: 1 sheet frozen puff pastry, thawed ( just the kind on the package ) | 3 teaspoons grated gingerroot | 1 tablespoon cooking oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Thaw out pastry sheets. Press ginger into dough and roll flat into 1 inch circle. Place on a foil lined baking sheet. Heat oil in frying pan. Place ginger into oil and fry, stirring constantly, until golden.

title: Barbecue Ham With Pine Nut Stuffing
ingredients: 2 lbs ham | 2 ounces currants | 2 ounces dried corn | 20 g sunflower oil | 50 g roasted peanuts, chopped | 1 clove garlic, crushed | 1 teaspoon sunflower oil
instructions: Cut the ham into 2oz chunks. Put ham in a bowl, add currants, corn, sunflower oil and nuts. Mix well. Stuff in the ham to retain the shape. Brush with a little sunflower oil, grill or fry over a moderate heat for 15 mins until browned. Serve with bbq sauce, salad and plain boiled potatoes.

title: Easy Mexican Rice (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 3 cups cold mexican rice ( i prefer uncle ben's ) | 1 jar salsa | 4 slices bread ( i prefer to use ciabatta for this ) | scallion, chopped ( i like lots for the kick ) | carrot, diced ( optional ) | ice
instructions: Wash and soak rice in 4 cups of water for 5 hours. Place the rice directly on top of the salsa, stirring and adding water until liquid is nearly gone. Set it on low in a crock pot. Add chopped veggies if desired. Diners will enjoy the salsa in the house. When rice is done, remove rice, stir it through the broth and enjoy. We prefer the heat of the salsa.

title: Roasted Red Potatoes and Cream
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups heavy cream | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne | 1 bag red potatoes, scrubbed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Set potatoes in a large bowl.

title: Swiss Chard with Raisins (Roladitas)
ingredients: 1 lb swiss chard, in thin strips ( can sub a combination of leaves and chard ) | 2 tablespoons raisins | 1/4 cup chopped chocolate | salt and pepper | 1/4 cup bouillon | 1/8 teaspoon baking soda | 4 -5 lbs rump steak
instructions: Cook chard in boiling water for about 20 minutes and the chard and chard until tender. Drain well. Cool chard and chard and leave chard whole. Discard chard liquid and stems, and save. Heat oven to 375 degrees. Spray baking sheet with cooking spray and place rack in middle. Wrap a piece of foil and place over baking sheet and place in oven and bake for 45 minutes. In small bowl combine chocolate, salt and pepper. Remove baking sheet from oven and carefully add a thin coating of chocolate sauce onto the foil. Sprinkle chard with this mixture. When all chard is covered, place on plate and pour chocolate sauce over the chard and chard. Serve immediately.

title: Tortilla Chicken Wings
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg whole chicken wings | kosher salt, to taste | fresh ground pepper | 12 slices gruyere cheese | 12 crushed bamboo shoots | 12 tortillas ( preferably organic )
instructions: Wash the wings and place them in a colander in a large pot of salted water and set over low, the bowl covered, for 1 hour. Meanwhile, slice the cheese into 8 - 8 even slices. Rinse and dry the chicken. In a small bowl, combine the shredded cheese with the pepper and the oil. When ready to cook, drain and pat the chicken dry. Season each chicken thigh with salt and lay one piece of cheese on the chicken's back. Fold the chicken over the cheese, then wrap all around the cheese. Repeat for each chicken thigh. In a heavy skillet or ridged griddle over medium heat, place 6 pieces of plastic wrap and brush with oil. Add the chicken, skin side down. Raise the temperature and cook for 20 - 25 minutes, brushing occasionally with the pan oil and brushing liberally with oil. Flip the chicken over to cook the other side. You may also turn over the chicken after 20 - 25 minutes or so. Turn the chicken after 10 minutes, brush or sprinkle with oil and cook on the other side for another 10 minutes, brushing or sprinkling more salt and pepper. Serve the chicken pieces with the crushed bamboo shoots, sliced baguette and guinness stout.

title: The Secret is the Ancho
ingredients: 5 anaheim chilies | 1 teaspoon chili | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules
instructions: Fire up your grill. Place chilies on their wrap over a pan of boiling water. Let steam for 1 - 2 minutes. Take off the water and place chilies in a bowl of ice water. Allow to cool. Place chilies in the blender and process until smooth. Strain and add the rest of the ingredients. Refrigerate for half an hour. Transfer to a storage container and keep chilled. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: thai red curry paste,mint sprig,sherry,red wine vinegar,flour,orzo,brown bean sauce,ice water
title: Beef Orzo Salad With Thai Red Curry Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup orzo ( white ) | 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon thai red curry paste | 1/4 cup ice water or 1/4 cup potato water | 1 tablespoon brown bean sauce | 1 tablespoon of fresh mint sprigs ( or 2 teaspoons dry mint )
instructions: Cook the orzo as directed on package until tender but firm in texture, but still firm to the bite. Drain. For salad, place all dressing ingredients in a jar, tightly covered and shake vigorously to blend. Chill. Just before serving, toss with orzo just before serving.

title: Coconut-Herb Infused Rice Wine
ingredients: 1/2 lb thick fresh coconut | 4 cups rice wine | 1 tablespoon mixed italian herb seasoning
instructions: Place the coconut in a dry frying pan, cover and cook over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes or until golden. Transfer the coconut to a mixing bowl. Discard coconut husks. Place the rice wine and the herbs in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil.

instructions: Heat the broiler. Coat a baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray. Combine the chickpeas and asafoetida in a small bowl. Spray with olive oil. Add the pumpkin puree. Toss to combine. Spread 1/4 cup of the chickpea mixture in the bottom of a medium bowl.

title: Polish Dill Pies
ingredients: 200 g cornflour | 100 g all-purpose flour | 1 can dill pickles, diced | 500 ml stock or 500 ml broth | 200 g boiled cubed cold-pressed vegetable oil ( for frying )
instructions: Sift flour into a bowl, add all ingredients and mix well. Heat oil in a large, deep pan on one heat, then pour mixture in small bits of batter in, dropping batter by the teaspoonful into pan, frying until golden brown on both sides and cooked through. Drain on kitchen paper.

Random Ingredients: turnip,tequila,kosher salt black pepper,lamb,orzo pasta,broccoli floret
title: Kosher Halibut Supper
ingredients: 3 ounces uncooked orzo pasta | 1 3/4 lbs boneless lamb, cut into 1 inch cubes | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 cup chopped broccoli floret | 1/2 cup orzo pasta | 1/4 cup tequila
instructions: Heat a large cast iron skillet or ridged grill pan with a tight fitting lid over high heat until smoking. Meanwhile, cook the orzo until it begins to absorb the juice about 2 minutes. Add the lamb, turning once. Cook for about 5 minutes or until opaque. Season with salt and pepper. Stir in the broths and orzo and serve.

Random Ingredients: pine nut,parsley sprig,coconut extract,vegetable,cantaloupe,greek oregano,pasta sauce,navel orange
title: Vegetables & Pasta in Phyllo
ingredients: 2 cans mixed vegetables ( such as potatoes, carrots, peas, corn, and turnips ) | 3 tablespoons coconut extract | 3 cups favorite pasta sauce or 3 cups homemade pasta sauce | 4 large navel oranges | fresh parsley sprig | grated greek oregano | coconut nuts ( optional )
instructions: Combine the pasta sauce. Squeeze the juice and rind from the oranges using hands. Cut the fruit into 8 wedges. Place the oranges in a large non reactive mixing bowl and cover with cold water. Set aside 10 to 15 minutes. Drain and set aside. Cut the 4 largest vindes from the oranges using a sharp paring knife or kitchen shears. Cut the remaining orange into 8 wedges. Peel away all the white pith and membrane from the tomatoes and cut into 1/8 inch slices.
