Arrange the orange slices into four overlapping rows of strips on two of the pans. Top with equal quantities of the vegetable mixture. Drizzle generously with nutmeg mixture and sprinkle with oregano and coconut powder.

title: Easy Leek Pie
ingredients: 4 pie shells ( unbaked ) | 1 leek | 1 teaspoon coriander
instructions: Saute the leek in a little oil at the end of cooking. Add the coriander and coriander and mix well. Put them in a pie dish. Top it with the pie crusts, which aren't ready but are already floured. Bake at 200c for 15 20min until golden brown, and then cut into squares and serve.

title: Low-Fat Turmeric and Sage Saute
ingredients: 2 zucchini, 2cm slices | 2 broccoli stems | 1/2 piece zucchini, 2cm slice | 1/2 piece young broccoli stem | 1 3/4 teaspoons turmeric powder | 1 sprig fresh sage leaf, about 3inches | 1 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Slice zucchini and broccoli stems into 2 inch lengths. Place broccoli and zucchini in microwave safe dish and microwave on high power for approximately 2 - 3 minutes or until zucchini is just tender. Remove zucchini and broccoli pieces from microwave and spread out onto cutting board. Toast sage leaf in small cast iron skillet on high until lightly browned. Flip sage over and toast the other side for another 2 - 3 minutes. Remove sage leaf and set aside. In a small frying pan over medium low heat, toast almonds until they are brown, about one minute. Add turmeric mix and stir until fragrant, about 1 minutes. Be very careful not to burn. Remove from heat. Place raisins in a small glass bowl or cup and pour turmeric and water into it and stir until the turmeric dissolves. Drain sauteed vegetables onto a tray lined with foil, drizzle with a bit of turmeric and place in sautee. Serve with steamed basmati rice.

Random Ingredients: pearl onion,malibu coconut liqueur,maraschino cherry,nonfat cream
title: Sponge Cake
ingredients: 2 ounces malibu coconut liqueur | 4 fluid ounces nonfat sour cream | 1 ounce pearl onion, finely chopped | 4 maraschino cherries
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a mixing glass. Cover and shake vigorously until chilled. Then use to pour onto a sponge, cover and refrigerate up to 2 days.

title: Mushroom Poached Almonds(Champagne)
ingredients: 4 teaspoons lard | 2 cups sliced almonds ( or almond paste, if you must ) | 1 can condensed condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 teaspoon pure sherry or 1 teaspoon rice wine vinegar | 1 bouquet garni ( fresh basil, thyme, bay leaf, parsley, parsley ) | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 2 tablespoons minced fresh chives
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the cream of mushroom soup with the vinegar, powdered bouquet garni, chives and chopped basil. Heat the lard in a large skillet over medium heat, stirring constantly, and add the almond paste. Cook stirring constantly with a wooden spoon for 2 minutes, or until golden brown. Add the mushroom soup mixture to the pan, and simmer over low heat for 1 hour, stirring frequently.

title: Scottish Steamed Faggots
ingredients: 2 small swedes | 1 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Cut away the top part of each swede stalk and peel away the hard stringy stalk. Slice into rounds to resemble round scottish bread. Sprinkle each slice with the pinch of white pepper, pressing into the surface with the back of a spoon. Place on a steamer and cover. Steam for two to three hours until tender. Remove the scottish pieces from the steamer and place on a warm platter.

title: Cheese-Stuffed and Fried Linguine
ingredients: 6 ounces uncooked linguine | 1 pound shredded gruyere cheese | 3 packages lox frozen hash browns
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil. Once the water is boiling, stir in the linguine, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 11 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast,olive oil,red wine vinegar,tomato sauce,eggplant,red wine,ham,green bean
title: Chicken, eggplant and ham salad
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts | 2 large eggplants, sliced | 100 g ham, sliced and cut into thin strips | 4 red new potatoes | 250 g green beans | olive oil | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 150 g tomato sauce
instructions: Cut chicken breasts into 2 inch cubes. Slice eggplant into 5 inch long strips. Arrange on a platter. Top with ham and red potato slices. Combine oil, vinegar and tomato sauce in a separate bowl. Drizzle over salad. Serve salad immediately.

title: Bread and Butter Chicken
ingredients: 1 lemon peel | 3 tablespoons fresh thyme sprigs ( or 2 tsp dried ) | 4 tablespoons unsalted butter ( at room temp. ) | 2 lbs skinless chicken thighs, trimmed of fat
instructions: Place lemon peel, thyme, butter and salt in a plastic bag and shake to combine. Add chicken and shake of all excess. Refrigerate for 1 hour or longer. Preheat oven to 350, then transfer chicken and marinade to a shallow baking dish and bake for about 45 minutes, brushing with additional butter periodically, or until done.

title: Creamy Dumpers
ingredients: 3 medium celery root, peeled and shredded | 1 can cream of celery soup, undiluted
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Combine celery root, cream of celery soup, and celery soup mix in a 2 quart baking dish. Cover the dish, and bake 90 minutes in the preheated oven, until celery roots have softened and soup is bubbling. Cool 1 hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: cumin seed,romaine lettuce,arborio rice,plain flour,graham cracker crumb,cucumber
title: Kicked Up Risotto (Rice Balls)
ingredients: 250 g arborio rice | 1/2 cup plain flour | 2 cups cucumber, diced | 300 g romaine lettuce, washed and finely chopped | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs | 2/3 cup cumin seed
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Place rice in a glass bowl. Combine flour, cucumber, lettuce and crumbs in another glass bowl. Dough must be wet not dry. Make sure rice is not sticky. Roll out to 1cm thick about 10cm in diameter and about 7cm in size and cut out with cutter. Place rice on a baking tray and bake for 20 minutes and then remove from oven and cool for 3 - 5 minutes. Remove and place in a serving bowl, cover with a clean tea towel to keep warm. When cool, refrigerate until serving dish. Serve with yoghurt or sour cream. Yogurt is a good option if using yoghurt.

Random Ingredients: amaretto liqueur,mortadella,catsup,pie crust,rice noodle,beet,pork chop,cream chicken soup
title: Sweet and Sour Pork Chop and Noodle Pie
ingredients: 1/2 pound pork chops | 1/2 pound mortadella, cut in 1/4-inch slices | 1 jar sliced beets, drained | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup catalina amaretto liqueur | 1 1/2 tablespoons catsup | 1 package instant hot pie crust | cooked rice noodles
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Bring a pot of water to boil, and salt generously. Arrange bacon strips over the edge of a 9 inch pie plate. Place pork chops on the bacon strips. Arrange beets over the pork, and drizzle with a little Catalina amaretto and a bit of catsup. Pour the cream of chicken soup over all, and top with a layer of mortadella slices. Roll out the pie crust, and place onto a baking sheet. Bake at 350 degrees f for 35 to 45 minutes, until crust is golden and top is lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: vinegar,creamy peanut butter,dark chocolate,orange extract,maple syrup
title: Nigerian Peanut Butter Orange Cream
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups creamy peanut butter | 2 tablespoons maple syrup or 2 tablespoons brown sugar | 1/2 cup dark chocolate, grated ( about 4 ounces ) | 1 teaspoon vinegar | 1 teaspoon orange extract
instructions: Combine all ingredients thoroughly, beat until smooth, and refrigerate until well chilled. Serve with cream or ice cream.

title: Banana Roll-Ups
ingredients: 7 firm bananas, mashed | 1 graham cracker crust | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix mashed bananas, graham cracker crust, salt, and pepper together in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: turnip,mace,chorizo sausage,curry powder,cheese ravioli,green chilies,chili paste,mushroom
title: Chorizo and Turnip Ravioli
ingredients: 9 -12 ounces fresh cheese ravioli | 2 tablespoons green chilies | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 1/2 teaspoon chili paste | 1/2 teaspoon curry powder ( hotness to your taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 1/2 lb chorizo sausage, choped | 6 ounces mixed mushrooms, sliced | 4 ounces green chilies, sliced ( hotness to your taste )
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Meanwhile cut off stems and discard. Chop chorizo into small slices, about 1 1/2 inches long and place in a colander set over a bowl. Drain egg noodles, reserving 1/2 cup of the water in a small bowl. Place a pot of lightly salted water on to boil and cook ravioli until desired tenderness is reached, but not overcooked. Drain in a colander, rinse in cold water and drain again. Transfer to a pasta bowl. Add 2 tablespoons of green chilies to pasta water to begin the cooking process, but do not allow them to heat to boiling. Add 1/2 teaspoon mace and 1/4 teaspoon chili paste along with 1/4 teaspoon ground mace, 1/4 teaspoon mildness and 1/4 teaspoon curry powder. Stir to combine and set aside. Heat a large nonstick frying pan to medium heat, add 1 ounce chorizo, saute until crisp. Add green chilies, stir fry 1 minute or until crisp. Add mushrooms, stir fry until mushrooms are crisp tender. Add 2 tablespoons of the curry mixture, continue cooking about 1 minute on medium high heat. The final stir fry is to add some of the liquid from the pasta bowl, add ravioli and stir to combine. Remove from heat and serve.

title: Pecorino and Pecorino in Beer
ingredients: 1 lb pecorino romano cheese | 12 ounces beer
instructions: Pour the cheese in a medium size bowl. Pour the beer on top of the cheese and stir so the cheese is not getting too runny. Use as a sauce or top your favorite pasta. This works great with roasted meats or even poultry.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,chinese white rice vinegar,onion,olive oil,white wine vinegar,green bell pepper
title: Chinese Muslim Adobo
ingredients: 1 cup white wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons chinese white rice vinegar | 1 small onion, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon beef bouillon cube | 1/4 teaspoon olive oil | 1/4 green bell pepper, chopped
instructions: Combine the vinegar, rice vinegar, onion, and bouillon in a jar with a lid. Close, and shake once or twice to combine. Serve over green bell pepper.

title: Mock Bean Sprinkles
ingredients: 600 g canned kidney beans | 2 teaspoons red chilies, chopped | 2 teaspoons rice wine vinegar
instructions: Drain the kidney beans. Place all remaining ingredients in a small frypan or saucepan and bring mixture to a boil over medium heat. Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 15 to 20 minutes or until beans are very tender. Allow to cool slightly before using. Spoon bean sprouts into paper and serve.

title: Spinach and Lime Rice
ingredients: 1 bag fresh spinach, washed and trimmed | 2 1/4 cups cooked rice | 1 lime, zest of, plus | 1 lime, juice of lime | 2 tablespoons lime zest
instructions: Put rice, spinach and lime zest into the crockpot. Mix in lime juice and lime zest just before serving.

Random Ingredients: strawberry,veal,spinach leaf,coriander sprig,red potato,vegetable oil cooking spray,celery
title: Veal With Strawberry and Spinach Salad
ingredients: 6 small red potatoes, halved | vegetable oil cooking spray | 24 ounces boneless veal, leanest you can buy | 1 cup fresh spinach leaves | 1 cup fresh coriander sprig ( cilantro ) | 1/2 cup fresh strawberries, sliced | 8 fresh coriander sprigs
instructions: Place all ingredients except meat, spinach, and fresh coriander in a large saucepan, cover and cook over medium heat until the veal is browned about 8 minutes. Remove meat from pan and set aside. Cut veal in half horizontally, then slice diagonally across grain. Heat a large nonstick skillet or griddle over medium high heat, spray with veggie oil. Add meat and cook until browned about 2 minutes. Add spinach and cook just until moisture wilts or the spinach wilts. Remove the spinach with slotted spoon and pile on spinach. Serve hot.

title: Sausage and Pasta Salad
ingredients: 6 links links sausage | 2 lbs medium pasta | 1/2 large spanish onion, sliced ( optional ) | 1 cup of sliced banana ( optional ) | 10 -12 medium sautee sized fire-roasted tomatoes ( optional )
instructions: Cook sausage until browned, remove and cut into 1/8” pieces. Cook pasta according to directions, drain. Toss with sausage, onion and banana if desired. Chill to let flavors blend.

Random Ingredients: japanese soy sauce,fish sauce,red onion,vegetable oil,vodka,pea
title: Prawns, Avocado & Vodka
ingredients: 2 lbs prawns, shells on | 3 tablespoons vegetable oil | 3 cups red onions, minced | 12 ounces sweet peas | 4 tablespoons vietnamese fish sauce | 4 tablespoons japanese soy sauce
instructions: Peel the prawns & place into a saucepan with the 2 cups water. Bring to the boil & boil for 5 minute then drain.

title: Homemade Creamy Taco Seasoning
ingredients: 1 cup sour cream | 3 -4 tablespoons dried onion and chili powder
instructions: In a medium mixing bowl, combine the sour cream and dry onion and chili powder. Slowly sprinkle the seasoning blend on the sour cream. Serve with freshly made tortilla chips or warm pita bread.

title: Easy and Easy Balsamic Dip
ingredients: 1 package dry onion soup mix | 2 cups shredded haleb | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Stir together the onion soup mix, haleb, vinegar, and balsamic vinegar in a large bowl. Transfer to a baking dish, and toss to coat. Bake in the preheated oven until bubbly, 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Simple Tomato Seasoning
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons dried onion flakes | 1/2 cup chopped tomato | cooking spray | 1 tablespoon instant minced onion flake
instructions: Combine the onion flakes and the chopped tomato.

title: Chinese Chicken-And-Beame Nests (For the Stove Top)
ingredients: 1 lb chicken, cut up | 12 large walnut pieces | 8 cups bean sprouts | 7 tablespoons ground allspice
instructions: Place pieces of chicken and nuts in a large roasting pan and scatter with allspice. Cover with clean, dryed paper towels, and put in a warm oven. Cook 15 minutes at 350 degrees f, stirring to make sure chicken is still not burning. Remove from the oven, allow to cool 20 minutes, then remove the paper towels. Pour out the excess liquid, and refrigerate overnight in the refrigerator. The next day, drain, and mix with the cooked vegetables. Heat the oil in a separate pan, and fry the mixture quickly to golden brown, stirring regularly. Drain on paper towels. Eat warm, garnishing each serving with a drizzle of melted dark chocolate.

title: Spicy Chile Vinegar
ingredients: 2 dried red chilies | 3/4 cup cider vinegar
instructions: In a medium size non metallic saucepan, place chilies.

Random Ingredients: basil leaf,kaffir lime leaf,baby arugula,ham,mexican oregano,tomato paste,swordfish,ricotta cheese
title: Mexican-Inspired Swordfish Florentine Style
ingredients: 4 swordfish ( each weighing about 1-1.5 lbs. ) | 2/3 cup fresh tomato paste | 1 teaspoon dried mexican oregano | 1 bunch basil leaves | 1 bunch baby arugula | 1/2 cup ricotta cheese | 8 kaffir lime leaves, cut in half ( optional ) | 4 slices lean mexican smoked ham, cut into 2 inch pieces ( optional )
instructions: In a large saute pan or skillet, mix the tomato paste and oregano and cook over medium high heat until the tomato mixture bubbles and has thickened slightly, about 3 minutes. Transfer the tomato mixture to a bowl and stir in the basil and arugula. In a small bowl, mix the ricotta, kaffir lime leaves and smoked ham. Coat the Swordfish evenly with the herb sauce. Over high heat, warm the tomato sauce for 2 minutes. Immediately add the cooked swordfish, a few pieces at a time, and continue cooking until the sauce thickens slightly and the swordfish are cooked through, about 3 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Alfajores
ingredients: 1 lb beef chuck, lean, lean and about 1-inch thick, trimmed | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/2 lb fresh apricot, pitted and coarsely chopped | 1 cup fresh spinach, chopped ( about 12 ounces ) | 1 can bamboo shoots | 2 -3 tablespoons grated lemon peel
instructions: Rub beef with cream of tartar and set aside. In skillet, saute beef in hot oil about 10 minutes, breaking up any clumps. Add apricots and saute a few minutes longer. Add spinach and saute a few minutes until wilted. Transfer beef and any juices to 4 ramekins. Add bamboo shoots and lemon peel to skillet and heat through before loosening ramekin with a spatula and scraping off excess juices or using a metal spoon. Spoon hot beef mixture over hot beef.

title: Pizza Linguica's Chive Sauce
ingredients: 1 package spaghetti sauce ( chive ) | 4 leaves fresh chives, chopped | 12 ounces low-fat milk | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 3/4 cup chopped fresh chives
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Cook spaghetti until al dente, about 3 minutes. Drain. Toss spaghetti with milk in a large bowl until evenly coated. Meanwhile, heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.

title: Apple Peach Soup
ingredients: 1 can peach slices, with juice | 1 -2 canned chipotle serrano chili, pureed | 1 -2 tablespoon dried basil, or to taste | 2 cans reduced-sodium chicken broth | 1 apple, cubed ( optional ) | 2 cups fresh sliced button mushrooms
instructions: In a large pot over medium heat, combine the peach slices and apple.

title: Easy Swiss Cheese & Mushroom Lasagne
ingredients: 1 cup swiss cheese, grated | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup, undiluted | 8 ounces flour tortillas
instructions: Preheat oven to 400° degrees. Spray 13x9 inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Combine cheese, soup and tortillas. Pour half of mixture into each tortilla until it reaches just under the edges, reserving 1 tablespoon of cheese mixture in a spoonful. Arrange tortillas around the edge of the pan in a single layer. Spoon remaining soup mixture over tortillas. Cook 15 minutes or until mixture is bubbly. Let stand 5 minute before serving.

title: Balsamic Ouzo (Picante Watercress Watercress)
ingredients: 1 cup picante sauce, store-bought | 4 bunches fresh watercress | 3 tablespoons ouzo | 3 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 cup balsamic viniagrette or 1 cup olive oil | lime wedge ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Stir the picante sauce and watercress together in a bowl. Let stand 5 to 10 minutes, then transfer to a food processor or blender. Add the ouzo and puree until smooth, about 1 minute. Stir in the vinegars. Taste and adjust seasonings, if desired. Drizzle with the lime wedge if using. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk,saffron thread,oatmeal,acorn squash,flour,tomato paste,bean sprout,penne pasta
title: Ugandan Coconut Penne With Beans Sprouts and Squash
ingredients: 7 ounces dry penne pasta | 1 tablespoon flour | 1 sachet quick oats, gluten free | 1/2 cup coconut milk | 2 tablespoons tomato paste | 4 acorn squash | 4 ounces bean sprouts | 1 tablespoon saffron threads
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling water then drain. Meanwhile, mix together flour, oats and coconut milk in a large bowl. Slice acorn squash in half and cut into slices. Put pasta, squash into a large pan with coconut milk, tomato paste and saffron. Cook for 10 minutes or until the squash is just tender add to the bean sprouts. Drain the pasta and squash and put back into the pan with the cooking sauce.

title: Crema Di Carciofi
ingredients: 2 cups semolina, medium-grain | 1 1/2 cups brown sugar | 2 tablespoons ground cider vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 3 cloves garlic, minced | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla bean
instructions: Preheat ove to 325 degrees f. Mix semolina, brown sugar, cider vinegar, baking soda, garlic, and vanilla bean in a large bowl with your fingers until thoroughly combined. Spread the mixture evenly in a greased loaf pan. Bake for 1 hour, or until golden brown. Cool, and slice.

Random Ingredients: ricotta cheese,bamboo shoot,fontina cheese,barbecue sauce,cauliflower,cayenne,habanero pepper
title: Sweet, Spicy, and Creamy Cauliflower Gratin
ingredients: 1 cauliflower, broken into florets | 1/2 cup sweet barbecue sauce, your favorite, divided | 1 habanero pepper, seeded and minced, divided | 1/2 can bamboo shoots, drained and coarsely chopped | 4 ounces fontina cheese, rind removed, cut into strips | 4 ounces ricotta cheese | 1/8 teaspoon ground cayenne
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Butter a 10 in. x1 in. Baking dish. Arrange the cauliflower in the dish. Whisk together 1/2 cup of your favorite barbecue sauce with the habanero, and pour over the cauliflower and cauliflower. Sprinkle the top with fontina cheese and dot with ricotta. Bake about 45 minutes or until edges are golden and bubbly. Sprinkle cayenne over top and cook 1 - 2 minutes longer.

title: Queso Dip
ingredients: 10 ounces processed cheese | 1/2 teaspoon onion salt
instructions: Heat oven to 325 degrees f, place the processed cheese on a baking sheet, top with a single layer of onion salt, and bake for 15 minutes. Serve hot with salsa or sour cream, or hot with crackers or eat with your fingers.

Random Ingredients: chilies,cornflour,dill weed,pear,fontina cheese,rice paper,ham hock,orange juice zest
title: Pears With Ham Hock
ingredients: 2 cups cooked ham hocks | 1/2 cup shredded fontina cheese | 1/2 cup orange juice ( or 1/2 orange, juice and zest of 1 orange ) | 1/2 cup finely chopped fresh dill weed | 6 large ripe pears | 4 teaspoons cornflour | 4 sheets rice paper
instructions: Bring 2 1/2 cups water to a boil in a medium size saucepan, then add hocks and boil for 4 - 5 mintues until tender when pierced with a sharp knife 1 - 2 minutes cool hocks under running water, then drain well and pat dry with paper towels. Place meat side up on a board, then using a knife and sharp knife, cut ham hock into 1 inch x 1 inch squares. Place about 2 t. Of each cheese and 1/2 t. Of orange juice in a small plate. Sprinkle with dill weed and set aside. Peel pears and cut in half lengthwise. Using petticoat or melon baller, scoop out core from inside of core. Cut each half into 1 1/2 inch sticks, then set aside. Repeat with remaining ham hocks. To make a pocket, using about 1 t. Of cheese, fill each cavity with ham hock from the pocket.

title: Smooth & Fragrant Indian Grilled Chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs skinless chicken legs ( thighs, drumsticks & wings ) | 16 ounces cooked chickpeas ( optional ) | 1/4 cup pomegranate molasses | 2 teaspoons tamari | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( or 1/2 teaspoon turmeric ) | grated ginger and garlic powder or tamari
instructions: Wash the chicken & drumsticks & open them up to check that the thigh is completely dry. Place the chicken legs at the joints along with the chickpeas & pomegranate molasses, tamari, and asafetida. Rub the chicken legs with grated ginger and garlic powder or tamari. Place on a piece of foil & cover with another piece of aluminium foil. Keep placing the open chicken on top of the open foil & secure with toothpicks or skewers. Smoke or barbecue for about 10 - 15 minutes per side or until tender and done properly. Serve warm with boiled rice, indian breads, breads, breads or bread. Note, you can also cook the drumsticks on a ridged grill, grill pan or bbq and grill.

title: Tomato Mango Chutney
ingredients: 400 g diced mangoes | 1 cup tomato juice
instructions: Peel and dice mangoes. Place mango in heat proof bowl, add tomato juice and tomato conserve. Leave at least 2 hrs or overnight. Serve over toast or fresh vegetables.

title: Blackberry and Barley Mash
ingredients: 1 1/2 pints blackberries | 1 1/2 cups pearl barley
instructions: Puree or combine all ingredients in a large pan over high heat. Bring to the boil, then reduce heat and simmer until barley is soft but still has a little texture, 20 - 25 minutes. You should be able to easily mash with a potato masher, but not have the texture of raw mashed potatoes. If using toasted pumpernickel, it may also be a good idea to toast it a few at a time in a dry skillet over medium heat, watching for the fat to run out before it dries. The pumpernickel may need to sit for a few minutes until it is slightly brown and crackling.

Random Ingredients: vidalia onion,plum sauce,cooking oil,dark rum,beet,halloumi cheese,brown sugar
title: Halloumi Cheese Rollups
ingredients: 8 halloumi cheese or 8 mozzarella cheese | cooking oil, to lightly fry | 1 small vidalia onion | 8 tablespoons plum sauce | 1 tablespoon dark rum | 1 tablespoon brown sugar
instructions: Slice the cheese into 4 equal pieces. Peel the onion and finely dice. Brush each piece of cheese with oil. Place the onion on one side of a large piece of foil and place the cheese on it. Brush one edge of the foil with oil. Place a piece of cheese inside the foil and place the piece of cheese. Put on some plum sauce then put on some dark rum. Top the cheese with another piece of cheese, press it together. Place on a plate and roll up before serving.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast meat,cajun seasoning,chili pepper flake,vegetable oil cooking spray,herbes de provence,thyme sprig
title: Herbes De Provence and Thyme Chicken
ingredients: 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast meat | 1 teaspoon herbes de provence | 1 teaspoon dried thyme sprig | 1/2 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 2 teaspoons vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 pinch cajun seasoning, spice
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Using your fingers gently press the chicken breast into a large bowl of salt. Add in all remaining spices. Place chicken on a roasting pan and coat with cooking spray. Roast for 20 to 25 minutes, basting occasionally with herbes de provence and thyme.

title: Texas Pork
ingredients: 4 -6 pork fillets | 1 package taco seasoning | salt and pepper
instructions: Combine all ingredients together in a large zip lock plastic bag. Marinate in the refrigerator for at least 1 to 2 hours. Preheat oven to mix pork and salsa. Place pork onto ungreased casserole dish. Bake for 45 minutes or until cooked through.

title: Nana's Green Beans
ingredients: 1 lb fresh great northern bean ( or frozen or canned. ) | 1 tablespoon chicken soup base
instructions: Rinse beans well. Place in a 2 or 3 quart slow cooker. Cover beans with water. Add chicken soup base. Cook 1 hour on low or 3 hours on high.

Random Ingredients: cinnamon,matzo meal,vegetable oil cooking spray,cremini mushroom,mint sprig,walnut
title: Mushrooms With Matzo Filling
ingredients: 4 large cremini mushrooms, cleaned | 1/2 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1/4 cup walnut pieces, ground | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon | plain matzo meal, for dusting | paprika or fresh mint sprig, for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Wash and dry mushrooms. Set aside. Coat a sheet of waxed paper or aluminum foil with cooking spray. Remove stems from the mushrooms. Wash and dry mushrooms. Cut each mushroom in half lenghtwise. Lay on the waxed paper and scatter with walnuts, ground cinnamon and a sprinkling of paprika or fresh mint. Cover mushrooms with plastic wrap and place in refrigerator for 20 minutes. Drain excess liquid from mushrooms and wrap tightly in plastic. Refrigerate until serving time. Heat 1 1/2 tablespoons oil over medium high heat in a large nonstick skillet. Lightly spray mushrooms with cooking spray. Arrange on pan. Sprinkle tops with a few matzah meal pats. Turn heat to medium. Cook, uncovered, for 5 minutes until browned and crispy. To serve, remove wrap and sprinkle top with paprika or fresh mint.

title: Grilled Eggs on Rice and Fresh Fruit
ingredients: 6 hard-boiled eggs, peeled | 2 cups cooked sushi rice | 4 fresh tomatillo salsa ( see tomatillo salsa fresca ) | 1 cup fresh fruit, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1/4 cup fresh raspberry ( optional )
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high. Place the hardboiled eggs on the grill. Cook about 5 minutes or until the eggs turn a rich, translucent color. Remove from the grill and transfer the eggs to a plate to cool. Meanwhile, heat the salsa fresca over medium heat in a small pan. Bring to a simmer. Transfer the salsa to a serving bowl, and add the cooked eggs. Cover, and let the eggs cool slightly. Place the tomatoes and fresh fruit in a serving bowl. Spoon the cooled salsa fresca over the eggs and toss until evenly coated. Cover, and let stand at least 15 minutes to flavors blend. Before serving sprinkle the raspberries over top.

Random Ingredients: american cheese,bread,celery seed,chili paste,corn flake,marshmallow creme
title: Spicy Cheese Casserole
ingredients: 1 loaf country bread, torn into bite sized pieces | 2 cups american cheese, shredded | 3 cups corn flakes, crushed | 12 candied celery seeds | 1 tablespoon chili paste | 1/2 teaspoon celery seed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°. Arrange bread in a large casserole dish. Top bread with cheese, spreading evenly. Combine crushed corn flakes with celery seeds in a small bowl. Add chili paste. Sprinkle over top of cheese mixture. Sprinkle celery seed mixture over top. Bake uncovered about 25 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Sweet Potato Patties
ingredients: 2 -3 sweet potatoes ( i prefer dutch style ), grated | 4 eggs
instructions: Mix together and make into patties. You want medium sized patties, not too small. Bake 350 degrees until done.

Random Ingredients: brown sugar,lemon peel,french bread,beef chuck roast,rice wine,margarine,lemon extract,wasabi
title: Roast Beef Italian Style
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons packed light brown sugar | 1/2 teaspoon lemon extract | 1/2 teaspoon lemon peel | 5 lbs boneless beef chuck roast | 1 tablespoon margarine or 1 tablespoon margarine | 3 tablespoons rice wine | 1/2 cup firmly packed light brown sugar | 1/2 teaspoon wasabi | 1 loaf french bread
instructions: Dissolve 1 1/2 teaspoons of the light brown sugar and the 1/2 teaspoon of lemon extract in 1/2 cup of boiling water. Sprinkle the roast with this mixture. Place in a dutch oven or other roasting pan that is just large enough to hold it in one layer. Add the remaining ingredients except the french bread. Stir to blend. Cover tightly with foil. Bake at 325 degrees for 3 hours. Remove from oven and turn the roast over and roast on its side. Cook about 1 more hour or until desired doneness and juices flow clear. Slice the french bread into 1 or 2 rounds. This can all be done in advance. Do not brown the meat, just slice as desired to serve, adding the melted sugar to the finished dish.

title: Spinach and Red Cabbage
ingredients: 1 cup fresh baby spinach | 3 cups red cabbage, shredded | 4 teaspoons allspice
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Place spinach in a large pot of boiling water. Cook 8 minutes, or until liquid has evaporated. Drain well. Place spinach in a large bowl. Drizzle with remaining 1 tablespoon water. Stir in cabbage. Sprinkle with allspice. Serve hot.

title: Crispy Onion Rings
ingredients: 3/4 lb sausage | 14 1/2 ounces pizza sauce | 1/4 fluid ounce molasses | 1/4 fluid ounce white wine | 1 tablespoon white onion, grated | 1 teaspoon mango powder
instructions: Dice up sausage into small bite size pieces. I like them pretty small, so i tend to roll them in the palms of my hands. Brown them a little and set aside on a plate lined with paper towels to drain grease out. Spread the pizza sauce evenly over the bottom of a 13x9 casserole dish. Place the sausage into the dish. Pour the molasses into a bowl and mix with the white wine. Add the chopped up onion to the tomato sauce. Add the mango powder. Sprinkle a little bit of the paprika on the onion mixture while mixing. Don't worry a little bit of the mango powder will sizzle right out of it. Dot the tomatoes over the top of the other onion mixture. Cover and bake at 350f, or in a very low oven.

Random Ingredients: fenugreek seed,allspice,french bread,greek yogurt,philadelphia cream cheese
title: Fenugreek Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 package philadelphia cream cheese, softened | 3/4 cup greek yogurt | 1 teaspoon fenugreek seeds | 1/2 teaspoon allspice | 1 loaf french bread
instructions: Process cream cheese, yogurt, fenugreek seeds, and allspice in a food processor until smooth. Place french toast on a baking sheet and broil until slightly browned. Spread about 1 1/2 tablespoons of the cheese dip on the toasted bread and broil until the cheese is lightly browned. Serve with remaining cheese.

Random Ingredients: cream celery soup,caster sugar,chili,mace,cashew,fennel bulb,red chile,rose water
title: Cashew Mushroom Casserole - Cashew Nut & Chilli Sauce
ingredients: 1 fennel bulb or 1 red fennel bulb, chopped | 1 red chile, chopped | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 1/2 cup cashews, chopped | 1/3 cup rose water | 1 teaspoon red chile, chopped | 1 teaspoon dried chili
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Place chopped vegetables in a shallow ovenproof dish. Mix together sugar, mace, soup, cashews, rosewater, red chile and dried chili. Pour over vegetables in dish and bake for 25 - 30 minutes.

title: Baked Cottage Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb feta cheese, in cubes | 1/2 cup milk | 2 teaspoons dill, chopped | paprika, to sprinkle
instructions: Set oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Grease an oven dish generously with some of the oil or butter. Mix the feta cheese cubes, milk, and dill into the cheese. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake 15 - 20 minutes, until bubbly.

title: Chile Blanco (Mexican Green Chile Condiment)
ingredients: 2 teaspoons chopped fresh green chiles | 1 quart buttermilk
instructions: Combine the chiles and buttermilk in a blender.

title: Cajun Spice Mix
ingredients: 6 tablespoons grated pecorino romano cheese | 6 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 1 1/2 teaspoons hot sauce | 1/8 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients in bowl or food processor. Store in refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: cooking spray,self raising flour,lemon,banana pepper,heavy cream
title: Banana Pepper & Pepper Griddle Bread
ingredients: 4 large ripe bananas ( about 6-7 tablespoons ) | cooking spray | 2/3 cup self-raising flour | 2/3 cup heavy cream ( may need a little more or less ) | 1/2 small lemon, juice of ( optional )
instructions: Preheat grill to high. Spray 1/2 cup of your favorite non stick frying pan with cooking spray. Peel bananas from their skins. Dip banana into flour, then roll in cream. Place on preheated griddle and cook on each side or until golden brown. You may need a little more cooking spray or olive oil to cook them and to keep them moist. Don't over cook the bread though they should not be mushy they should be a little crisped up. They should be crispy and dark like the underside of a dark chocolate.

Random Ingredients: pepper,turmeric powder,beef stock,salt pepper,pine nut,turkey sausage,self rising flour
title: Smoked Turkey Sausage & Pine Nut Pies
ingredients: 2 cups self rising flour | 2 cups ground turkey sausage | 2 2 tablespoons pine nuts or 2 tablespoons almonds | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/4 teaspoon pepper | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 1/4 cup beef stock
instructions: Mix it all together thoroughly with hands. Roll out with 2 balls of plastic wrap. With floured hands, cut out circles with 2 - ½ inch round cutter. You should have 12 circles about 8 inches in diameter at the size of your waffle iron, but if any holes are left on them sprinkle a little salt between circles. If using a gas grill, brown them quickly, about every 5 minutes or so, until they are golden around the edges. Serve while hot while hot. They may also be served with yogurt and tomato sauce or green sauce, stirred once or twice to make a sauce. This recipe was provided by professional chefs on the international aisle of food. Com.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,avocado,corn tortilla,mint leaf,linguine,parmesan cheese,salt black pepper,mushroom
title: Linguine-Wrapped Tortillas With Wild Mushrooms, Avocado and Chive-Mint Pesto
ingredients: 2/3 lb linguine | 1 cup fresh mushrooms, thinly sliced | 1 avocado, halved, pitted, peeled, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup fresh dill leaves | 1/3 cup packed dark brown sugar, packed | 1/4 cup freshly grated parmesan cheese | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 24 thin corn tortillas, each cut lengthwise into 8 wedges
instructions: Cook linguine according to package directions, omitting salt, and drain. Toss together mushrooms, avocado and dill in medium nonstick skillet with brown sugar. Add parmesan and toss to mix well. Spread 1/4 cup pesto over 1 tortilla wedge. Starting at one end, wrap tortilla tightly and place in a 11 x 8 inch baking dish. Repeat wrapping and layering tortillas until all tortillas have been used. Pour half the pesto over tortillas. Sprinkle with remaining pesto. Bake uncovered at 375 degrees f for 20 minutes or until hot and puffed and hot. Turn off oven and prop open door on oven to remaining pesto. Cut through each wedge and serve.

Random Ingredients: lentil,extra virgin olive oil,red curry paste,raspberry
title: Spicy Curried Lentil and Raspberry Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon red curry paste or 1 teaspoon hot curry powder | 1/4 cup dried lentils, rinsed | 4 -5 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1/2 cup raspberries or 1/2 cup strawberry, halved
instructions: Spray pan with pam and heat over medium. Add a small amount of olive oil and fry the curry paste until fragrant about 1 minute. Add the lentils and cook for 1 minute. Add about 1/4 cup water and scrape out the browned bits off of the bottom of pan. Bring to a boil then reduce down to medium to medium low heat and cover, letting sauce simmer until lentils are tender, up to 30 minutes. Add remainder of the olive oil and remove from heat and stir. Cover and let the salad sit for 5 minutes. Top with raspberries, if desired.

Random Ingredients: soy sauce,cooking couscous,topping,scallop,chipotle pepper,brown gravy mix
title: Couscous and Steamed Scallops from the Goomb
ingredients: 1 lb fresh scallops, cut into large pieces | 1 package brown gravy mix ( you should have a packet of this, but you may not need all of it ) | 1/4 cup low sodium soy sauce | 1 package fresh quick-cooking couscous ( 3 1/2 cups ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried chipotle peppers | 1 carton frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Prepare a large pot of water with a drop or two of olive oil and a lid that is big enough to fit everything. Heat the water to a boil. Sprinkle in the oats and stir. Cook until the oats are just barely slightly golden. Remove the pot from the heat and set aside. Rinse and dry the scallops, and set aside. Spray a 10x15 metal cooking pot with cooking spray and add the scallops, and toss to coat with oil. Add the brown gravy mix and soy sauce. Toss again, and sprinkle in the dried chipotle. Cover, bring the water to a boil, and boil the scallops until tender. Stir the hot water into the sauce and season with salt and pepper to taste. Keep warm. While the scallops are boiling, cook the couscous. When the water is boiling, stir in 1 package of the noodles. Drain the scallops, reserving 1 1/4 cup of the broth, and place them in a serving dish of your choice. Drizzle half of the reserved broth over the noodles. Top with the rest of the scallops. To assemble the dish, pour the reserved broth over the noodles. Spoon sauce over scallops, and serve topped with the whipped topping.

Random Ingredients: belgian endive,ginger paste,mushroom stem,saffron,celery rib,beef chuck
title: Slow Cooker Mild Beef Burgundy
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs boneless beef chuck, cut in 1/2 inch cubes | 6 belgian endive, thickly sliced | 6 mushroom stems and pieces | 6 celery ribs, thickly sliced | 1 teaspoon ginger paste | 1/8 teaspoon saffron, crushed ( can use 1/4 tsp. ground ginger if you want ) ( optional )
instructions: Place the beef and all the ingredients in a slow cooker. Cover and cook on low for 10 to 12 hours. Serve over cooked rice.

title: Ribbons of Wheat
ingredients: 500 g french haricots vert | 100 g swiss cheese, finely grated | 75 g dried cranberries | 4 slices whole wheat bread | 1 -2 tablespoon superfine sugar
instructions: Heat a griddle or skillet until very hot. Peel the french haricots vert and cut into thin strips about 4 inches long by 2 inches wide. Grill or fry them in batches, until they become crisp and golden. Remove from the heat and crush with a wooden spoon. Place the crumbs in a bowl. Add the cheese and cranberries, tossing all together. Spoon the raibbons onto a flat surface, sprinkle with sugar. Roll the haricots vert in this way and serve immediately.

title: Beetroot Chicken (Russian style)
ingredients: 1200 g beetroots, washed and trimmed | 100 g shaved chocolate | 1 tablespoon virgin olive oil ( optional ) | 300 g cooked chicken ( or any other suitable chicken )
instructions: Wash the beetroot, trim it into 2 2cm long slices and leave the central core intact. Wrap the beetroot around 250g shaved chocolate and shaved chicken. Pour a small amount of virgin olive oil into a baking tin. Place in the oven and bake for 45 - 50 minutes, stirring occasionally to ensure the bottom is golden brown and the beets and skin tender. This can also be done on the grill as well. I have made this dish with a variety of roast vegetables from the british, gherkins, potatoes, carrots and other meat.

title: Pizza Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sherry ( or other dry white wine ) | 1 teaspoon anise extract | 1/8 teaspoon oregano leaves ( dried )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Note, for a thicker version of the pizza filling, you may use low sodium milk instead. The aroma is even better if it is reduced.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,lobster tail,italian tomato sauce,sesame oil
title: Lobster Spread
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 can italian tomato sauce | 1/2 teaspoon sesame oil | 2 pounds lobster tail, rinsed and patted dry
instructions: Preheat an oven to 325 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix cream of chicken soup, tomato sauce, sesame oil, and lobster. Transfer cream of chicken soup mixture to a 9x12 inch baking dish. Bake in preheated oven until the top is browned, about 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: sunflower seed oil,beef chuck roast,wasabi paste
title: Wasabi Marinated Beef
ingredients: 1 tablespoon wasabi paste, to taste | 2 tablespoons sunflower seed oil | 3 lbs beef chuck roast, trimmed of fat
instructions: Combine wasabi paste and 3 tablespoons of the sunflower seed oil in a large zipper top plastic bag. Place beef in a zipper seal plastic bag, seal, and shake to coat meat with marinade. Marinate in refrigerator, covered, for at least 24 hours and up to 2 days.

title: Lime and Chocolate Rissoto
ingredients: 1 cup chicken broth | 1/2 cup milk chocolate | 4 teaspoons grand marnier | 1/4 cup fresh breadcrumb | 2 teaspoons freshly grated lime wedges
instructions: In a small saucepan heat the broth and milk over medium heat until warm. Meanwhile, in a bowl, lightly stir together the chocolate and grand marnier. Stir about 1/4 cup of the warm broth mixture into the chocolate mixture. Pour mixture into a medium bowl, then sprinkle with bread crumbs and lime juice. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,vodka,red pepper,orange flower water,baking chocolate,shortening,ice,heavy cream
title: Red-Pepper Cream Filled Cookies
ingredients: 1 cup crushed ice | 1/4 cup vodka | 1/4 cup flaked wheat flour | 1/4 cup semisweet baking chocolate | 3 drops orange flower water | 1/2 teaspoon baking chocolate | 4 tablespoons shortening | 2/3 cup heavy cream
instructions: In a small bowl, combine ice, vodka, flour, and baking chocolate and stir until well mixed. In a large bowl, cream shortening and cream remaining ingredients with an electric mixer until fluffy. Cover. Shape chocolate mixture into 1 balls and roll gently in flour. Chill until firm, about 1 hour. To assemble, remove 1 ball from fridge and cut into 1/4 inch slices. Brush each slice with remaining cream and place 1 tablespoon of chilled dough in the center of 2 slices, then wrap both slices around dough and enclose filling. Secure with fingers. Arrange cookies around edge of a double layer glass baking dish. Cover and chill until serving. Repeat with remaining dough and chilled dough.

Random Ingredients: corn oil,yellow pea,fish cake,flour tortilla,turkey bacon,mint
title: Warm Beef Tacos
ingredients: 2 tablespoons corn oil, or as needed | 1 pound turkey bacon, chopped | 1 package frozen yellow peas, thawed | 1 package frozen yellow corn kernels, thawed | 10 flour tortillas | 2 tablespoons chopped mint, or to taste
instructions: Heat corn oil in a skillet over medium heat. Sprinkle turkey bacon pieces with salt and black pepper.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning,taco seasoning mix,sugar snap pea,tomato green chilies,pea,vegetable stock,cumin powder
title: Mexican Sugar Snap Pea & Tomato Soup
ingredients: 1 bag frozen peas | 1 bag frozen sugar snap peas | 1 packet taco seasoning | 1/3 tablespoon cumin powder | 32 ounces vegetable stock | 16 ounces diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1 packet taco seasoning mix | 3 tablespoons sugar snap peas
instructions: Heat pot on medium high and add bag of peas. Boil the peas for 2 minutes, mix and pour into strainer into a small pot. In a large pot add other ingredients except for sugar snap peas. Once soup comes to a boil add sugar snap peas. After the sugar snaps turn off heat and cover and let set for 3 minutes or so. Stir and serve with grated cheddar, sour cream or salsa.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,bacon grease,spearmint,thai red curry paste
title: Thai Red Curry Powder
ingredients: 2 pounds bacon grease, divided | 2 teaspoons curry powder | 1 package thai red curry paste, thawed | 1/3 cup chopped fresh spearmint
instructions: Heat 1/2 inch of the grease in a large skillet over high heat.

title: Fried Rum Couscous
ingredients: 1/4 cup margarine, melted | 1/4 cup rice flour | 2 tablespoons dark rum | 1 cup couscous | 1/2 red onion, diced | 1/4 cup chopped roasted sweet red peppers or 1/4 cup sliced deli-style hot peppers
instructions: Put oven on. Spray 10 inch nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Stir margarine in small bowl until creamy. Gradually stir in rice flour, rum, and flour, and set aside. Bring 3/4 cup water to boil in large nonstick skillet. Add couscous to boiling water. Cover.

Random Ingredients: tamari,heavy cream,lamb shank,celery salt,table salt,potato starch,extra tofu
title: Oamc (Bahama Mama)
ingredients: 2 lamb shanks, trimmed of fat and visible fat | table salt or sil nit packing, for cooking | 1/2 teaspoon table salt or 1/2 teaspoon salt, to taste | 1 1/2 tablespoons potato starch or 1 1/2 tablespoons cornstarch | 3/4 cup heavy cream | 1 1/2 tablespoons tamari or light soy sauce, for flavoring | 4 ounces extra firm tofu, cut into 1/8-inch chunks
instructions: Wrap the lamb shanks tightly in two sheets of aluminum foil large enough to fully wrap around each piece of meat. Tightly secure the strings with kitchen twine if necessary to prevent any escaping. To steam, bring a pot of water to a boil and add 2 t. Salt or salt, the lamb shank, and 1/2 t. Potato starch or cornstarch. Reduce heat to low medium and simmer until meat is very tender, 25 - 35 minutes, up to 2 hours depending on the amount of fat and meat used. If broth looks a bit dry during this time, cover with water and cook another 15 - 15 minutes and then taste for salt. While the broth simmers, strain the lamb shank through a sieve, discarding fat. Discard the solids, skim off any impurities that remain, and set aside. Using a large pan or skimmer, remove any solid pieces of meat from the stock and reserve. Reserve the stock. Shred with two forks, discarding fatty pieces. Discard fat and return the stock to the pan and bring to a boil for a few minutes to reduce sauce. In a small saucepan, stir together the cream, tamari and the broth. Cook over medium heat until heated through, about 10 minutes. Meanwhile, transfer the tofu to a plate. Drain liquid, reserving 3/4 cup of the liquid. Remove the strings and discard. If the soup is thicker than desired, bring the cooking liquid to a boil, then whisk in the tofu, heat to a near boil, and immediately stir in reserved broth mixture and the cream mixture. Divide soup among warmed bowls and add some shredded tofu, drizzle with some of the sweet cream sauce and top with some whole wheat pita bread.

title: Tahini Mascorbets
ingredients: 4 tablespoons tahini paste | 4 teaspoons packed dark soy sauce | 1 1/2 pounds ladyfingers | 2 green grapes, halved at equator ( optional )
instructions: Mix tahini paste, soy sauce into a glass bowl. Add the ladyfingers one at a time.

Random Ingredients: worcestershire sauce,fruit,ginger garlic paste,tomato sauce,basil leaf,buckwheat flour
title: Kourabiedes
ingredients: 1 cup buckwheat flour | 4 cups tomato sauce | 2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon dried basil leaves | 1 teaspoon dried mixed fruit
instructions: Combine and mix all ingredients with your favourite bread, or toast. Refrigerate or serve.

title: Corn Pies (No Flour)
ingredients: 1 package frozen whole kernel corn, thawed | 2 packages frozen whole kernel corn, thawed | 1 package frozen whole wheat pastry flour, thawed | 2 sheets frozen phyllo dough
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix together the thawed corn, corn flour, and pastry flour until well mixed, then use a fork to roll out each sheet so the pastry sheets can fit onto the cookie sheets. The dough should be about 1 1/2 inches in diameter. Sprinkle the frozen corn mixture on top of the corn mixture. Bake 25 minutes on the center rack of the oven, or until golden brown. Allow to cool for at least 20 minutes before popping the pies onto a work surface to cool completely.

Random Ingredients: red wine,bok choy,white wine vinegar,chicken bouillon,cellophane noodle
title: Korean Chicken Noodles
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 9 ounces cellophane noodles | 2 cups fresh red wine ( we use a japanese wine ) | 1 bunches bok choy, sliced
instructions: Mix the bouillon and white wine vinegar together in a small bowl. Place noodles in a bowl and pour in 1/4 cup of the vinegar mixture, and set aside. Heat remaining vinegar mixture in a large skillet over high heat. Add bok choy and remaining vinegar mixture.

title: Beef & Cheese Burrito
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs lean ground chuck | 1 small red bell peppers or 1 small green bell pepper, cut into narrow strips ( about 10 slices ) | 1 tablespoon neufchatel cheese | 2 3/4 cups cooked rice, at room temperature | 1/2 package shredded cheese-filled egg noodles or ( 12 ounce ) package egg noodles, cooked according to package directions ( 3 cups ) | steamed jasmine rice or jasmine rice ( 2 4 cups )
instructions: Combine beef, peppers, and cheese in a large skillet. Cook over high heat until beef is completely browned, stirring occasionally. Drain fat. Stir in cooked rice and vegetables. Heat until well heated. Cover and allow to heat through. Serve topped with additional cheese, if desired.

title: Herbalized Rosemary branches
ingredients: 1 kg rosemary sprig ( about 12 - 14 small ) | 8 medium fresh thyme sprigs
instructions: Wash and trim the rosemary sprigs, removing the stalks. Place in a dry pan, cover with cold water, and bring to the boil. Simmer for 5 minutes, then cool in cold water. Remove the rosemary stalks and stir into the boiling water. Lower the heat and simmer for 3 hours, stirring frequently. Remove the rosemary stalks and discard, set aside and allow to cool. Remove the thyme ribs from the water, remove the stem and any leaves and discard, leave the leaves whole and tie them together with kitchen string. Place in a non aluminium container and bottle or jar with a tight fitting lid and store in the fridge. To serve, wash the rosemary in cold, cool water and drain, place in a glass bowl, and pour over the infused rosemary leaves. Leave for about 1 week then cover and leave to marinate for up to 4 days in the fridge.

Random Ingredients: lime,spinach,hot pepper sauce,maraschino cherry,sesame oil,baby spinach leaf,polenta
title: Polenta Wedges With Veggies
ingredients: 2 cups polenta, cut into 8 wedges | 3 large hot peppers with sauce | 3/4 cup spinach, shredded | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 2 cups baby spinach leaves | 1 1/2 cups maraschino cherries, halved | 12 lime slices, cut into wedges
instructions: Preheat the oven to 500°f. Slice polenta wedge horizontally through the center horizontally to make two triangles each. Place wedges on a baking sheet and drizzle with 1/4 cup of the chili sauce. Bake for 20 minutes or until golden, stirring after 10 to 15 minutes. Set aside. Place remaining sauce ingredients in a 2 to 3 quart slow cooker. Cover and cook on low all day 8 to 10 hours or on high for 5 minutes, stirring halfway through. Remove wedges from the baking sheets and drizzle with remaining chili sauce. Return to the slow cooker and cover. Cook on high for 30 minutes. Serve with lime wedges and remaining hot sauce.

title: Homemade Chipotle Chicken Marinade
ingredients: 1 ounce fresh ginger paste | 1 cup canned chipotle chile, pureed | 1/4 cup instant prepared custard powder | 1/4 cup fresh cranberries | 1/2 teaspoon ground cayenne | 1/4 teaspoon ground anise seed | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne | 1/4 cup mirin ( sweet spanish cooking wine for authenticity )
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine ginger paste, chipotle puree, custard powder, cranberries, cayenne, anise seed, cayenne, mirin, and puree until smooth. Marinate chicken at least 18 hours, or overnight, turning chicken occasionally to redistribute marinade.

title: Bombay Potatoes
ingredients: 1 large red potato, scrubbed and skinned | 125 g red capsicums, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon coriander seed, crushed
instructions: Toss the potato, capsicum and coriander seeds in a large bowl. Toss with hot oil until the potato strips are coated well. Heat a non stick frying pan, add the potato mixture and cook, turning until the potato mixture has lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: macaroni,demerara sugar,irish moss,flour tortilla,orange,potato starch,chinese cabbage
title: Dubliner Fish Tacos
ingredients: 6 tablespoons demerara sugar | 8 cups mixed potatoes starch | 3 tablespoons irish moss | 2 oranges | 11 ounces macaroni, cooked | 200 g chinese cabbage, slice | 12 flour tortillas
instructions: Dissolve sugar in a cup of water. Combine the starch and water in a large saucepan. Bring to the boil, stirring all the time. Add the moss. When the liquid comes to the boil, add the orange slices and potatoes starch mixture. Simmer gently for 10 minutes. Add the cabbage. Simmer until the cabbage is soft. Spoon into tortillas and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: chili bean sauce,barbecue sauce,cocoa powder,ancho chile
title: Ancho Chili Sauce II
ingredients: 1 can chili beans in chili beans sauce | 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 2 -4 tablespoons hot barbecue sauce | 1/4 teaspoon dried ancho chiles
instructions: In large bowl mix all ingredients. Sauce can be prepared 1 day ahead.

instructions: Place the chicken breast half at a 45 degree angle in front of you on an open cutting board. Slice off the top and bottom portions of the breast. Using a knife, score across the thicker portion of the breast, and remove the bone. Then slice it into bite sized pieces. In a mixing bowl, mix the saffron, egg yolks and green peppers until well combined adding a bit of water to make the mixture pherder. Spread the saffron mixture over the chicken, and place in the kitchen over. Heat for about 40 minutes, flipping the chicken after 10 minutes. After 10 minutes, remove the chicken to a cutting board, and slice into strips. Stir the basil into the chicken. Serve warm.

title: Lebanese Spicy Fried Nuts (Yogurt Maris)

instructions: Place veal in a deep, heated pan. Put lid on pan. Keep aside for 5 minutes. Remove the lid. Fry till lightly browned. Drain oil from the pan. Add the green chillies. Heat. Allow the nuts to steam for 5 minutes. Remove from flame. Serve hot.

title: My Favorite Homemade Cream Substitute
ingredients: 1/2 cup milk or 1/2 cup soymilk | 1 -2 stalk lemon grass
instructions: Place all ingredients in a glass bowl stir with wooden spoon to blend well and let sit for at least an hour stirring every so often so the lemon grass does not burn. After you take the lemon grass out strain, discarding stalk. Transfer to liquidiser. Use as you would any other liquid that sinks into the cream and fat, and use as desired.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti sauce,pesto sauce,maple syrup,italian plum tomato,yellow bell pepper,rice wine,apricot brandy,white wine vinegar
title: Simple Italian Spaghetti, Sweet Peppers, Tomato & Apricot Salad
ingredients: 4 ounces uncooked spaghetti | 4 slices yellow bell peppers, 1/4-inch dice | 4 ounces fresh whole-leaf italian plum tomatoes or 2 teaspoons jarred sun-dried tomatoes, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon apricot brandy | 1 1/2 teaspoons white wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon maple syrup | pesto sauce ( optional ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons rice wine or 1 1/2 tablespoons dry sherry
instructions: Cook spaghetti as directed on package, drain and keep warm. Random Ingredients: colby monterey jack cheese,tortilla,nonfat milk,fish sauce,cashew nut,liquid smoke,alfredo sauce
title: Cashew N' Cheese Quesadilla

instructions: In small microwave safe bowl, combine milk and liquid smoke. Microwave on high 2 minutes or until warm. Stir. Transfer 1 cup of cheese in medium bowl.

title: Soup and Steak With Sun-Dried Tomatoes
ingredients: 700 -800 g skirt steaks or 700 -800 g flank steaks | 1 lb asparagus ( preferably from frozen ) | 150 g sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil ( about 1/2 pack ( packed ) | 150 g dark chocolate ( not unsweetened ) | 3 tablespoons soup, base ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c or 400f or gas mark place the steak on a rack in a roasting tin and brush and spray with olive oil or a little water. Cover the steak and roast in the oven for 30 minutes. Meanwhile, snap off the ends of the asparagus, making sure the asparagus is loose and with little woody ends attached. Cut the asparagus into long, thin strips and place in a large bowl. Tear off the tips of the sun dried tomatoes as they are found in the supermarkets, and mix with the chocolate until smooth. Drain the asparagus and place in a microwave safe bowl, cover and microwave in the microwave for 6 minutes, or until warm and starting to thicken. Remove the steak and cover and leave to rest for 5 - 15 minutes, depending on the size of your steak. Slice the steak thinly and place the beef and asparagus on warmed plates, spoon over the hot chocolate sauce and serve the rest of the sauce along the side.

Random Ingredients: anaheim chilies,ranch salad dressing,ziti pasta,rice wine vinegar,green curry paste,chicken stock,chili powder,chocolate shaving
title: Spicy Thai Noodle-Ziti
ingredients: 2 packages dried ziti pasta | 1 pint chicken stock | 1 can sliced anaheim chilies, drained | 1/2 cup rice wine vinegar | 1/4 cup green curry paste | 1/2 cup ranch-style salad dressing | 1/2 cup miniature chocolate shavings | chili powder
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine the water, peppers, rice wine vinegar, curry paste, ranch style salad dressing, chocolate shavings, and chili powder. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer for 6 minutes. Drain the noodles.

title: Grilled Okra
ingredients: 1 package frozen okra | 2 scallions, chopped | 1 can green chili, chopped | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper | 1/2 cup velveeta cheese, diced
instructions: Drain okra, and cut into half along the length and then cut those halves diagonally in half again. Slice scallions and chilies. Mix all ingredients together, and grill for 5 to 10 minutes until bubbly. Serve over rice. Also wonderful with cheese on top. Also makes wonderful sandwich filler.

title: Pesto for Bread (Tiromiso)
ingredients: 1 lb pomegranate-flavoured pesto or 1 lb pomegranate-flavoured cheese | 1 cup fresh parsley flakes | 1/4 cup pine nuts
instructions: Put the pesto, parsley and nuts into a food processor and pulse until it resembles a smooth paste. Use immediately, but refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Green Beans
ingredients: 1 lb green beans, washed and trimmed | 3 ounces water chestnuts, sliced | 1/2 cup water | 2 teaspoons olive oil
instructions: Cut beans in half, then remove tough ends leaving the beans whole. Using scissors or scissors, cut the water chestnuts into thin slices. Place beans in a steamer and add 2 cups water, cover, and steam for 5 minutes until tender. Drizzle with water, cover and steam for 1 - 2 minutes until water is absorbed and beans are well coated. Heat oil in a nonstick nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add green beans and water chestnuts. Cook and stir constantly for 3 minutes until slightly tender. To serve, arrange beans on a large serving platter. Add remaining sauce ingredients and toss to mix.

Random Ingredients: red pepper,almond,palm sugar,baking soda,pecorino romano cheese
title: Chef John's Baked Red Pepper Strips
ingredients: 1 cup red pepper, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup raw almonds | 1/2 cup freshly grated parmesan-romano cheese | 1/2 cup palm sugar | 1 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Heat a large mixing bowl in a microwave. Blend the red bell peppers, almonds, cheese, pepper mixture, palm sugar, and baking soda in the bowl with the contents of the bowl on top of a large plate of ice cubes. Use the ice to scoop up the mixture and stir it into the dough. If it's too stiff to shake in your hands, just wet your hands a little bit now, and you'll get a dough that sticks to your hands. If your hands are dirty and spry, mix in more baking soda. The amount of baking soda you use will depend on the type of pepper you use, and how hot the red pepper strips get. Place the mixture in the baking dish with oiled sides. Refrigerate for at least an hour. Use this to fill the peppers for sandwiches, or just on top of your favorite things. You can then, in a pinch, cover the dish and refrigerate for at least 24 hours, or up to 3 days. Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f and lightly grease a cookie sheet. Remove the dough mixture from the refrigerator and knead it for 8 minutes. Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper. Spoon the dough into the prepared pans. Bake in the preheated oven until the peppers are crispy and golden brown, about 15 minutes.

title: Lobster Tangerine
ingredients: 24 ounces cooked medium shrimp, peeled and halved | 1/2 teaspoon lemon juice, fresh | 1 tablespoon lemon juice, fresh | 12 limes, cut into 8 wedges
instructions: Using a small knife, remove the shell from each lobster tail. Discard the intestinal cord. Place the shrimp shells in an 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 inch glass baking dish. Place the shrimp halves, cut side down, onto the shrimp shells. Sprinkle with lemon juice and lemon juice. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour and up to 2 days. Heat the grill, on high. Grill shrimp for 5 minutes on each side, brushing with lemon juice. Serve the lobster tails on a bed of lime wedges.

Random Ingredients: phyllo pastry,white rice,brown lentil,tea,penne,egg yolk,vanilla essence,nutritional yeast
title: Veggie Pastries
ingredients: 1 cup cooked white rice | 1 tablespoon nutritional yeast | 3 teaspoons vegan instant tea ( or half and half ) | 1 white rice ( optional ) | 1/4 cup brown lentils, rinsed drained ( or any lentils that's not currently gluten-free ) | 6 sheets phyllo pastry | 2 egg yolks | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1 cup tasty teapsoon light-brown sugar ( or to taste )
instructions: In a small mixing bowl, mix together the rice and lentils and soak for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, combine the vegan butter, tea, and egg yolks, blend until pale yellow. Add to the rice and lentils and mix well. When rice and lentils are soaked, allow to come to room temperature for 20 minutes. Preheat oven to 350f degrees. Line a baking tray with some parchment paper, place one sheet of pastry on a tray and lightly brush with melted vegan butter. Sprinkle half the brown sugar on a work surface and place another sheet over the first over the sugar. Repeat with the remaining pastry, sugar, and butter. Spoon the rice and lentils mixture into a pastry bag close the lid or ziplock with a round tip. Gently ease the pastry bag into the baking tray, close the lid, and place in the oven. Bake for 15 minutes and leave to cool. Increase temperature to 425f degrees and bake for 15 minutes more, until pale golden brown. Remove from oven and sprinkle with nutmeg and cinnamon to serve.

title: Tarragon Potato Soup
ingredients: 6 red potatoes, peeled and sliced | 1 purple onion, chopped | 1 tablespoon vegetable broth | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1/2 teaspoon dried mint | 4 eggs, beaten
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine potatoes, onion, broth, tarragon and mint. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 60 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in eggs. Place soup in a food processor or blender, blend until smooth. Return to saucepan and heat through. Season with salt and pepper. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: cream celery soup,whipping cream,tagliatelle pasta noodle,spaghetti sauce,artichoke heart,meat,red onion
title: Gourmet Spaghetti Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti, cooked al dente, drained, and rinsed | 8 ounces sour cream | 1 package tagliatelle pasta noodles, cooked al dente and drained | 2 jars artichoke hearts, drained, quartered, and sliced thin | 1 small red onion, diced small | 1 jar spaghetti sauce, medium-hot, with flavor | 2 cans condensed cream of celery soup
instructions: Grease 13x9x2 inch baking dish or 2 quart casserole dish. In medium bowl, stir all ingredients except cream of celery soup. Cover and refrigerate 1 hour. Prepare sauce, combine cream of celery soup and remaining ingredients and mix well. Pour sauce over hot pasta and mix well. Bake uncovered at 375 degrees for 30 minutes or until hot and bubbly.

title: Steak with Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 1/2 cup uncooked mini mashed potatoes | 1/2 cup peas, thawed frozen | 1/4 cup finely chopped peeled sweet mcintosh apple | cooking spray | 2 thinly sliced boneless veal steaks ( each about 1/2 inch thick ) | 2 tablespoons finely chopped pimento
instructions: Prepare potato according to package directions. Add peas to potatoes and mash with potato masher until smooth and slightly thickened, about 2 minutes. Stir in apple, mixing until coated. Place steaks on a plate. Coat with cooking spray. Heat large nonstick skillet to medium high heat. Add steaks.

title: Catalina Applesauce
ingredients: 6 small tart apples | 1/2 cup vinegar | 1 1/2 cups grated monterey jack cheese ( about 4 ounces ) | 1 jar packed shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Peel and core apples, then coarsely chop into 1 inch chunks. Pour vinegar over apples. Place apples in a casserole dish or shallow baking dish and sprinkle with about half the cheese. Bake at 325°f for 30 to 40 minutes or until apples are tender and beginning to get crisp.

title: Baja Beef Sirloin
ingredients: 1 fresh jalapeno chile powder | 2 pounds boneless beef top sirloin, cut into 1-inch cubes
instructions: Mix jalapenos chile powder and 2 cups water together in a sealable plastic bag. Add beef cubes, coat with mixture, and shake to coat. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight. Preheat grill for high heat. In a medium bowl, combine marinated beef and remaining marinade ingredients.

title: Crazy Shrimp With Tortilla Chips
ingredients: 1/4 lb shrimp ( or if you prefer, a little less ) | 1/4 - 1/2 parsnip ( depending on size ) | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1/2 cup breadcrumbs | tortilla chips ( to serve )
instructions: Peel, devein and chop the shrimp the shrimp. Peel parsnip. Chop shrimp in the plastic bag with the shrimp to release any excess juices. Set aside. Take breadcrumbs and mix them together in a small bowl with a pinch of vanilla essence. Take one bag of tortilla chips and lightly moisten the outside of the bag with the vanilla. Fill the bag with about 1/3 of the shrimp mixture. Fold it around the shrimp on the bag then roll it out like a cigar. Repeat until all of the shrimp have been used. Arrange the tortilla chips on plates and eat with the breadcrumb breadcrumb mixture on the side.

Random Ingredients: margarine,monterey jack cheese,sushi rice,kiwi fruit,french bread,picante sauce,pasta,poppy seed
title: Kiwi Sushi
ingredients: 8 cups sauted sushi rice | 1 cup margarine | 1 cup picante sauce | 2 kiwi fruits, peeled and cut into thin slices | 2 tablespoons poppy seeds | 1 loaf french bread | 6 ounces sliced monterey jack cheese | 3 cups cooked tapenade or 3 cups picante sauce
instructions: Prepare sushi rice according to package directions. Heat one cup margarine into a skillet over low heat. Stir in the rice, and stir constantly with the skillet to coat the rice with margarine. When rice is shiny and dry, remove from heat. Cut bread into 1 inch cubes, and arrange in one layer in a skillet. Fill each bread cube with 1/4 cup warm sushi rice mixture. Place a cheese slice onto top of each bread cube. Place kiwi slices on top of cheese. Spread remaining 1/4 cup of olive oil onto the kiwi and cheese, and arrange the kiwi slices on top. Heat remaining 1/4 cup margarine in a skillet.

title: Smoked Salmon With Pimientos
ingredients: 500 g smoked salmon, preferably with skin | 1 packet pimientos | 1/4 cup soya sauce | 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1 -2 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour over smoked salmon and leave to marinate in fridge for at least 1 hour. Grill.

title: Easy Low-Fat Spareribs
ingredients: 2 cups skim milk | 2 cups hot water | 1 1/2 cups tomato sauce ( preferably home-made ) | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce ( or tamari with soy sauce )
instructions: Rinse and dry the ribs well. Make sure all excess water is removed to remove any residue from the membrane on the meat. Place the ribs in a large pan or crock pot and cover with the milk and water. Set the crock pot on low heat. Add the tomato sauce, and dark soy sauce. Mix well and set the crock pot on low heat. Cook for 4 - 6 hours. The meat will be tender. Turn the heat up to high and cook for about another hour or until the sauce is thick, and the meat is a rich, reddish color. The longer it cooks, the more concentrated it will be. You may also do this in your crock pot on high for 4 - 6 hours. Serve, in individual bowls, with sautéed green onions and hot pepper on the side.

title: Orange Peel Eggs
ingredients: 6 large eggs | 2 cups vegetable oil, for frying
instructions: Place the eggs in a saucepan in layers with enough oil to cover. Cover and gently heat until the eggs are just set. Dip a spatula into cold water, and carefully slip into the beaten egg and let drain. Serve immediately with syrup or chocolate syrup.

Random Ingredients: kidney bean,ice water,chinese five spice powder,turkey,plain yogurt
title: Chinese Five Spice Turkey Burger
ingredients: 200 g lean ground turkey | 230 g plain fat-free yogurt | 1 tablespoon chinese five spice powder | 400 g kidney beans, drained ( or can use 1 packet low-sodium beef or veg stock ) | ice water
instructions: Mix the turkey, yogurt and 5 spice powder together. Put in your fry pan over medium heat. When it starts to bubble, pour in enough ice water to just cover the bottom of the pan, or just enough to lightly cover your turkey. Turn temperature down to lowest setting, and press down on the burger to flatten it a little. Cook for 10 - 15 minutes, until it is lightly toasted and the top is just starting to turn golden. This usually takes a half hour to cook thoroughly, depending upon the size, but can also be done on the grill in the oven on low setting. I usually cook it in the toaster oven for 25 - 30 minutes. You want the burger to have a lovely, smoky consistency.

title: Turkey Hash #5FIX
ingredients: 1 package simply potatoes diced potatoes with onion | 1 1/2 cups cooked turkey, cut into bite size pieces | 1 medium yellow bell pepper, cut into 1/4 inch slices
instructions: Heat up a large frying pan. Add potato pieces and onion and stir fry until potatoes are golden. Remove from heat. Add turkey and bell pepper to pan and stirfry, until vegetables are warm. Add to the hash, and fold contents of potato mix into hash. Add salt, pepper, and garlic powder to taste.

Random Ingredients: celery leaf,chat masala,celery,salt pepper,tomato juice,heavy whipping cream
title: Tomato Soup for Two
ingredients: 6 stalks celery ( stalks cut into 1-inch cubes ) | 1/2 tablespoon smoked salt and pepper ( or indian pepper salt ) | 1/2 tablespoon chat masala | 1 tablespoon stewed tomatoes with juice, chopped | 1 tablespoon heavy whipping cream | fresh celery leaves ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine the celery with the water, salt, and pepper. Cover, and cook over low heat for 15 minutes, and then check the celery after 5 minutes with a knife blade. Remove the celery, and set aside to drain. Remove the seeds of the tomatoes if desired, and then mash or puree in a blender or food processor, or use a stick blender if you want a smoother and creamier consistency. Return the mixture to the pan, and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to medium, and simmer the soup for 30 minutes, skimming any foam that rises to the surface. Season with chat masala and stewed tomatoes. When cooked, pour into bowls, garnish with chopped celery leaves and serve hot with parathas or your favourite curry.

title: Randy's Gratinee Salad #2
ingredients: 1 red grapes ( or green if you prefer ) or 1 red grape ( or green if you prefer ) | 1/2 cup cheese, grated
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Refrigerate at least 30 minutes, or better overnight. Serve cold.

title: Blueberry-Saffron Lentils
ingredients: 1 lb dried lentils | 1/4 teaspoon saffron thread, threads crushed | 1 can blueberry pie filling | 2 tablespoons maraschino cherries, chopped
instructions: Sort and rinse the lentils. In a large sauce pan combine the lentils, saffron, and blueberry pie filling. Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring often. Reduce heat to low, and simmer, covered, for 45 minutes. Turn off heat and stir in the maraschino cherries.

title: Italian-French Baked Pork Roast
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs bone-in pork shoulder | 1/2 cup fresh mixed herbs ( thyme, parsley, and basil ) | 1 teaspoon basil | 3 tablespoons dry-roasted baking mix | 2 tablespoons caster sugar ( or superfine sugar ) | 500 g russet potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Grease a roasting tin with olive oil spray and preheat your oven's centre for the oven's british oven. Trim the pork with a sharp pairing knife. Slice the pork into 3 inch strips and place the meat in a bowl. Sprinkle with salt. Mix the herbs with the salt. Add the baking mix & sugar. Mix well. Add this slurry to the pork & mix well. Place the pork into the preheated oven & roast for about 5 - 20 minutes, depending on the thickness of the meat. Turn the meat over & continue to roast for a further 5 minutes. The temperature of the meat depends on the thickness of your meat. When you are ready, remove the meat from the oven & pour the juices into a saucepan over a low heat for a few minutes. Turn the heat under the pan to very low, set the meat aside & keep warm. Meanwhile, cut the potatoes into 3 inch pieces. Drain the water from the roasting tin & gently toss the potatoes in the tin. Pour the reserved juices over the potatoes, then stir through a couple of handfuls of basil and season with salt. Remove the meat from the oven & leave to rest for 5 minutes. Serve with the juices & potatoes.

title: Wonton Pillows
ingredients: 2 cups fresh shiitake mushrooms, stemmed | 4 leaves radishes, thinly sliced | 1 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Place mushrooms, radishes, and baking soda in a bowl, and toss to blend. Let stand 10 minutes before filling each cup.

Random Ingredients: green peppercorn,lettuce,portabella mushroom,garlic clove,almond essence,corn syrup,ricotta cheese
title: Mushroom Salad
ingredients: 4 tablespoons corn syrup | 1/2 cup blanched almond ( slivered or finely chopped ) | 1 tablespoon green peppercorn | 2 garlic cloves ( finely chopped ) | 1/4 cup ricotta cheese | 2 teaspoons almond essence | 2 medium portabella mushrooms ( sliced ) | 8 -12 leaves lettuce ( washed, dried, chopped )
instructions: Wash the lettuce leaves and set them aside. Wash and slice the mushrooms. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a frying pan. When hot, add almonds, prawns, crushed garlic, green peppercorns, almond essence. Fry for 2 - 4 minutes. Remove from heat. Put the lettuce in a bowl. Put the mushrooms in the bowl. Put one tbsp of the corn syrup in a bowl. Put the remaining corn syrup in a frying pan. Pour it on a medium flame. When it begins to boil, put the prepared almond mixture in. Add to this the corn syrup, mix well. Remove from fire when the syrup has cooked off. Pour the mixture over the lettuce, mix well and serve.

title: Chinese Snow Pea Crackers
ingredients: 1 package snow peas | 1 cup all-purpose flour, or as needed
instructions: Break snow peas into pieces.

Random Ingredients: white taro root,green bean,monterey jack cheese,plain nonfat yogurt,orzo pasta,chili bean,baking soda
title: Chili Yummy Orzo Bake
ingredients: 1 package orzo pasta | 4 cups plain nonfat yogurt | 1 can fat-free refried beans | 1 can chili beans | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 cup shredded monterey jack cheese | 1 green beans | 1 piece white taco root
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Grease 13x9 baking dish. Cook orzo according to package directions. Drain and rinse under cold water. In a large bowl, stir yogurt, green beans, chili bean soda, and baking soda. Layer orzo, orzo, rice, orzo, and cheese on in layers. Repeat layers until all ingredients are used. Bake for 20 minutes.

title: Chocolate Penne
ingredients: 1 lb penne pasta | 1 tablespoon cocoa | 1 tablespoon dried lemons ( optional ) or 1 tablespoon orange ( optional )
instructions: Cook penne in salted water. While you continue cooking, combine cocoa and lemon in a skillet over medium heat until fragrant and warm, about 2 minutes. Stir and add to pasta. Add salt and freshly ground pepper to taste. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: spring green,white wine vinegar,cardamom seed,swiss chard,cheddar cheese,ham
title: Swiss Chard Rollups
ingredients: 2 tablespoons coarsely chopped swiss chard | 1 tablespoon coarsely chopped ham | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom seeds or 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 teaspoon white wine vinegar | 1 -2 tablespoon shredded cheddar cheese | 1 large spring roll
instructions: Cook swiss chard, ham and cardamom seeds in 1 tablespoon water until chard has released its liquid. Spread about 2 tablespoons of the chard mixture in the center of a spring roll or fresh spinach leave. Roll up the roll and tuck the sides in tightly. Cut 2 slices along the length of roll, going from end to end so they will fit snugly into a casserole dish. Sprinkle swiss chard roll with cheese and drizzle with remaining vinaigrette. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until serving time. Cut roll into 1 inch slices or pieces.

title: Roasted Yellow Pepper Vinaigrette
