ingredients: 3 bell peppers, halved, cored and seeded | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon ground black pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Place pepper halves, cut side up, on the prepared baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven 30 minutes. Allow to cool, and remove skin and stem from peppers. Seed and stem peppers, and place them on aluminum foil. Roast peppers in the preheated oven until the skin becomes shriveled and the peppers have soft, somewhat blackistered spots, 15 to 20 minutes. Be sure to remove the foil as soon as peppers are cool enough to peel off of papery skin. Remove peppers from the oven, and allow to cool for about 20 minutes. Run peeled peppers to a blender or food processor, and process until smooth. Measure 1/4 cup pureed pepper juice into a glass jar, and stir in balsamic vinegar, black pepper, and remaining 1/4 cup juice. Shake, and refrigerate for 1 hour.

title: Steamed Meat With Watercress
ingredients: 1 lb meat, cubed | 3 sprigs watercress | 2 tablespoons honey
instructions: Tie a piece of string or foil around the meat and place on a microwave proof dish. Add honey to watercress and brush around the outside of the meat. Cover and microwave on high for 5 minutes. Remove the string. Place meat back into cooking pan on a high heat setting, cover to cook for 15 minutes. Turn meat. Cover and cook for 15 minutes. Turn again and replace the foil. Microwave on high for 15 minutes, check for desired tenderness. Remove meat from the microwave, remove string and watercress. Serve with steamed white rice.

title: German Cherry Kuchen
ingredients: 1/2 cup port wine | 1 3/4 ounces vodka | 1 tablespoon frozen cherries
instructions: Place port wine, vodka and cherries into a cocktail shaker. Shake to mix, strain into a glass with ice. Enjoy.

title: Peach and Prosciutto Salad
ingredients: 1 jar peach halves | 4 slices prosciutto | 1/2 cup pomegranate molasses | 2 tablespoons vinegar | 1 lemonade | 6 romaine lettuce leaves | 1/4 cup peaches in syrup, diced
instructions: Remove peel and pit peaches. Cut off the top 2 inches of peaches to create a pocket in the fruit. Combine peach halves, prosciutto slices, pomegranate molasses, vinegar and lemonade. Toss salad and pour onto lettuce lined plates. Garnish with diced peaches.

title: Hot & Cold Scented Duck Bones
ingredients: 2 lbs of clean whole chickens | 1 cup fat-free bacon drippings, mixed with | 1 cup corn syrup | 1/2 cup nonfat milk | 1/4 cup chicken bouillon | 1/2 cup dates, chopped
instructions: Cut a deep slit lengthwise down the back of the ducks to make two horizontal pockets. Open the pockets, lay them in a dish & cover with bacon drippings.. In a saucepan, combine corn syrup & chicken bouillon, simmer, stirring to dissolve the bouillon, add the dates & stir well. Pour hot mixture into a bowl and chill for 1 hour or up to 3 days. Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Place the duck bones in a roasting pan or a well oiled glass pan. Pour the hot mustard mixture over the duck breasts, put in the oven uncovered, for approximately 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 hr or until the duck is tender when pierced with a fork.

Random Ingredients: maple syrup,green onion,self raising flour,cake flour
title: Papas Payesa
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups cake flour | 3/4 cup self raising flour | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 3 green onions, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c or 400°f. Mix all ingredients together until well combined. Place on an oven tray and bake for 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: vodka,deli ham,barbecue sauce,green chilies,strawberry jam,vanilla essence
title: Barbecue Chilli Slider
ingredients: 125 ml smoked deli ham, very finely diced | 125 ml smoked swiss cheese or 125 ml smoked provolone cheese ( 50g ) | 125 ml vodka | 125 ml barbecue sauce | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1 tablespoon green chilies, chopped
instructions: Mix all ingredients except chili and slices in a bowl until well combined with your hands and divide into 2 - 3 portions to suit your taste.

title: Easy Cheesy Mince and Pumpkin Enchiladas from Campbell's Kitchen
ingredients: 400 g pumpkin puree | 1/2 cup broth | 2 tablespoons gluten-free flour | 4 gluten-free flour tortillas or 4 gluten-free flour tortillas, depending on your own appetite | shredded cheese, to serve
instructions: Heat oven to 200c / fan 200c / gas in a heavy saucepan over medium heat. Add the pumpkin and just enough water to just cover the pumpkin. Bring to the boil and reduce the heat. Leave to simmer for 15 minutes, uncovered. Pour into a blender and add the broth. Using a paddle, blend until smooth. Stir through the flour, then pour the mixture into a shallow, non stick, oven proof frying pan. Bake, uncovered, in the oven for approximately 20 minutes, until the top is crisp and the top is golden and starting to brown. Remove from the oven and leave to cool slightly. Spread the top of each tortilla with the mince and top each with a little shredded cheese. Place on a baking tray and bake for 10 minutes, until golden brown. Serve with your favourite salsa, guacamole or chips.

Random Ingredients: shallot,olive oil cooking spray,cocoa,cream chicken soup,courgette,garlic salt,radish,hazelnut
title: Quick Roasted Vegetables
ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil or 1 tablespoon cooking spray | 400 g cream of chicken soup | 1 teaspoon minced garlic salt | 1 tablespoon grated fresh horseradish or 1 tablespoon horseradish, drained, coarsely grated | 1 small courgette, grated | 3 green shallots, halved, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup hazelnuts, toasted, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons cocoa ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c degrees. Place oven proof serving dish in oven and heat oven to 200°c. Heat oil or spray in a large fry pan. Add soup and garlic salt and cook briefly, stirring, until soup has thickened slightly, stirring frequently. Stir in horseradish, courgette, onions and nuts until just tender and lightly coated in horseradish. Spoon into serving dish, sprinkle with cocoa, if using, and cook in oven for about 10 minutes or until hot and bubbling.

Random Ingredients: mozzarella cheese,white wine vinegar,lemon,chipotle pepper,spanish olive,cream,shallot
title: Chipotle Cheese and Shallot Dip
ingredients: 6 cups coarsely chopped spanish olives ( such as nukhettos ) | 2 large shallots, finely chopped | 3 jars sliced chipotle peppers in adobo, finely chopped | 1 package shredded mozzarella cheese, chilled | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons sour cream | 1 lemon, sliced for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly grease a medium baking dish. Mix olives, shallots, chipotle peppers, mozzarella cheese, vinegar, sour cream, and lemon in a large bowl with a fork until well combined. Spread dip into prepared dish. Place dish in oven and bake until top is golden brown and bubbling, about 45 minutes. Garnish with additional sour cream if desired.

title: Spaghetti With Chili, Tomatoes and Greek Oregano
ingredients: 1 package spaghetti | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained ( hunts ) | 2 teaspoons dried greek oregano | 3 cups garlic-flavored croutons
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions, until al dente. Meanwhile, combine tomatoes with chilies, oregano, croutons and garlic season sauce with salt and pepper, if desired. Heat a large skillet over medium heat. Add enough boiling water to pasta to yield 2 cups of mixture. Drain pasta and reserve 1 cup liquid. Pour spaghetti and reserved liquid into boiling water.

title: Italian-style Pork Loin Rollups
ingredients: 1/2 pound pork loin roast, cut into thin strips | 1 can baked beans | 1/4 cup amaretto | 3/4 cup chopped walnuts | 2 cups self rising flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Combine pork strips with baked beans, amaretto, walnuts, and self rising flour.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,cooking oil,beef stock cube,flour tortilla
title: Basic Beef Enchiladas
ingredients: 10 -12 ounces beef stock cubes, dissolved on the beef stock cubes you have dissolved in | 2 teaspoons cooking oil | 3/8 - 3/8 cup flour tortilla, warmed | 12 tablespoons heavy whipping cream ( depending on how stiff/chunky you want your sauce )
instructions: In a saucepan, measure all cream and dissolve the stock cubes. Add water until you have 1 cup of liquid.. Bring to boil and remove from heat. Set this aside to cool in the fridge. Place the tortillas into a bowl. I use a hand held blender to crush them as fine as possible. Add the cream mixture to the crushed tortillas, you can add a little more if necessary. Heat some cooking oil in a skillet and add the tortillas, cook on each side until dark in colour. Add them to the warmed enchilada sauce and top with extra sour cream.

Random Ingredients: part mozzarella cheese,deli ham,shrimp,orange juice,french bread,plain yogurt,chicken breast,fruit
title: Easy One-Dish Chicken Pizza Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut into thin strips | 1/2 lb medium shrimp, deveined, tails removed ( tails on ) | 1/2 lb deli ham, thickly sliced ( a touch of mayo is good ) | 1 1/2 cups reduced-fat plain yogurt | 1 cup orange juice | 4 french bread, rounds | 1 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese, reduced fat shredded | 1/3 cup dried fruit, small pieces ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Combine chicken and shrimp in a small bowl. Arrange shrimp on cookie sheet, and spray with olive oil. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes or until chicken is cooked through. Shrimp may be pre cooked up to 1 day ahead and kept chilled. If using fresh fruit or sliced bananas, place on a plate covered with parchment paper to prevent darkening while baking. In a bowl, combine all the sauce ingredients. Drizzle the sauce over the chicken and shrimp, and top with the mozzarella. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until cheese is melted and sauce is bubbling.

title: Quick Gravy for Chicken  (((My Dad's Recipe)
ingredients: 3 cans condensed cream of celery soup ( undiluted ) | 1 tablespoon shallots or 1 tablespoon finely chopped white onion | 1 beef bouillon cube
instructions: Combine all ingredients and heat on the stove until butter melts. Serve over hot cooked chicken, or bake egg sandwiches as a main course.

Random Ingredients: cognac,potato,barley,italian sausage meat,bread flour,dark sesame oil,chunky salsa
title: Italian Sausage, Potato and Barley Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb italian sausage meat, casing removed | 12 ounces potatoes, cut into 1-inch chunks | 1/3 cup barley ( i used quick-cooking barley ) | 1 1/2 cups chunky salsa | 1/4 cup cognac or 1/4 cup brandy | 4 cups bread flour, unbleached | dark sesame oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Lightly spray a 6 cup casserole with nonstick cooking spray.

Random Ingredients: egg white,espresso powder,canola oil,tortilla chip,cod,grenadine,cardamom seed,coriander seed
title: Ethiopian Spicy Cod
ingredients: 3 tablespoons canola oil | 1/2 cup crushed tortilla chips | 2 teaspoons coriander seeds | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1 pound cod, rinsed and diced | 1 cup brewed espresso powder | 1 egg white | 2 tablespoons grenadine
instructions: In a skillet, heat canola oil over medium heat. Add tortilla chips, coriander seeds, and cardamom seeds. Bake until chips are lightly browned. Spread a thin layer of barbeque sauce on the bottom of a slow cooker. Arrange cod over sauce. Top with coffee powder and pour egg white over cod. Turn on slow cooker, cover, and cook on low setting 6 to 7 hours. To serve, place on serving dish and top with desired garnishes.

Random Ingredients: garbanzo bean,watercress,shallot,rice wine vinegar,sharp cheddar cheese,italian sausage
title: Sausage and Chickpeas
ingredients: 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons water | 1 lb lean ground italian sausage | 2 cans garbanzo beans | 1 cup coarsely chopped english cheddar cheese | 1/2 cup minced shallot
instructions: Combine vinegar and water in small bowl. Whisk in beef, 1/2 of the drained beans and cheese. Place mixture in large nonstick skillet. Cook over medium high heat, stirring frequently, until lightly browned. Add shallots. Add the remaining ingredients. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer 35 to 40 minutes, until pasta is tender.

title: Cheese Fondue
ingredients: 1 package cottage cheese | 2 tablespoons bacon grease
instructions: Combine all ingredients in medium saucepan and bring to boil. Reduce heat. Simmer for 7 minutes or until slightly thickened, stirring occasionally. Serve warm with toasted bread for dipping.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,whipping cream,tomato puree,salt pepper,peanut butter,hamburger
title: West African Hot Dish
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger, ground | 4 tablespoons peanut butter | 2 tablespoons tomato puree | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | salt and pepper, to taste | 1/2 cup whipping cream
instructions: In a frying pan, scramble the hamburger until it crumbles. Remove the hamburger and add the peanut butter to the pan. Stir to coat hamburger with peanut butter, add the tomato puree, sesame oil, salt and pepper. Cook for 3 - 4 minutes or until the sauce thickens. Add cream and simmer for 2 - 3 minutes. Serve over rice.

title: Vermicelli Salad
ingredients: 1 box vermicelli | 2 cups romaine lettuce hearts, chopped | 2 hard-boiled eggs, chopped | 1/2 cup lemon juice
instructions: Cook vermicelli according to package directions. Cool and then crumble in medium bowl. Mix in romaine until well blended. Chop eggs, and mix with lemon juice. Toss with warm noodle mixture.

title: Easy No-Boil Lasagne
ingredients: 8 lasagna noodles | 1 cup bisquick
instructions: Boil water about 5 minutes until al dente. Drain noodles, rinse with cool water. Spread a thin layer of bisquick on the bottom of an oven safe pan. Layer noodles on top of the crumb layer with a couple of spoonfuls of the bisquick mix. Repeat the layers till the pan is full. With the back of a spoon make small indents into the top layer of crumbs. Bake in oven @ 400 for 20 minutes.

title: Red Lentils and Chicken
ingredients: 1 cup red lentil | 4 skinless, bone-in chicken breast halves, cut into cubes | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1/4 teaspoon saffron | 2/3 cup crushed pineapple, drained
instructions: Place the red lentils in the bowl of a food processor and pulse once or twice. Add chicken, seasoned salt, saffron, the pineapple, and enough water to cover. Puree until the mixture is smooth. Cover, and refrigerate the casserole until serving time.

Random Ingredients: sirloin steak,snow pea,yellow onion,milk,red onion,sun tomato,red lentil,corn flake
title: Spoetzle With Beef and Sun-dried Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 3 ounces red lentils | 1 small yellow onion, chopped | 4 ounces red onions, cut into chunks | 1 cup red lentils | 1/2 lb boneless sirloin steak | 1 can sweet corn flakes | 4 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes | 1 cup fresh snow pea, trimmed | 3 fluid ounces evaporated milk
instructions: Place the lentils and chopped onion in a large bowl. Season with salt and pepper and toss to coat evenly. Bring 4 cups water to a boil in a large saucepan. Add the red lentils and cook for 3 minutes. Add the sirloin steak, toss briefly and remove from heat. Cut the steak into bite sized pieces, about 1 inch in size. Add to bowl. Add the sweetcorn flakes, sun dried tomatoes and snow peas and toss all together. Set aside. Just before serving, pour in the evaporated milk and mix well. Serve over noodles or fettuccine.

Random Ingredients: beef steak,feta cheese,lime,lemon lime beverage,gingerroot,mustard powder,ice cube
title: Beef Feta
ingredients: 8 ounces beef flank steak | 1 tablespoon dry mustard powder | 1 tablespoon ground gingerroot | 1/4 cup lemon-lime beverage | 5 tablespoons lime, juice of | 8 ounces feta cheese, crumbled ( about 1 cup ) | ice cube
instructions: Trim fat from steak. Cut steak lengthwise into 3/4 inch wide strips and place in a shallow dish or 2 to 3 quart slow cooker. Combine the mustard, ginger and lemon lime beverage.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,tomato sauce,iceberg lettuce,spinach,yellow squash,cumin seed,watercress leaf,cream tartar
title: Spinach and Watercress Salad
ingredients: 3 tablespoons toasted sesame oil | 1 teaspoon cumin seeds | 1/2 teaspoon fresh cream of tartar | 1 package frozen spinach, thawed and drained | 2 tablespoons watercress leaves, snipped | 1/2 medium yellow squash, thinly sliced | 1 ripe tomato sauce, 1/2 cup | 1 pinch salt, or to taste
instructions: In a small skillet over medium heat, cook the sesame oil until fragrant and beginning to lightly brown, about 1 1/2 minutes. Stir in the cumin and cream of tartar until very fragrant, then stir in the spinach, watercress, yellow squash, tomato sauce, and salt. Serve immediately.

title: Homemade Soft Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 16 large cabbage leaves, stems and tough leaves removed | 1 cup shortening
instructions: Place cabbage leaves into the bowl of a sharp knife and cut off the stem part, so that they stand upright without cutting all the way through. Set aside. Turn oven to 350 degrees f. Heat the shortening in a deep skillet or dutch oven until quite hot but not smoking, then saute the cabbage leaves about 10 minutes, turning them over until the entire head is lightly browned. Place the browned cabbage leaves in a bowl and cover loosely with a kitchen towel. Allow them to steam over open flame until softened, about 3 minutes.

title: Shrimp and Pork Goulash
ingredients: 6 large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 2 leeks, cleaned and well washed | 3 medium carrots | 1 lb pork shoulder ( or other fat, minced )
instructions: The shrimp and leeks can all be mixed together in the food until all pieces are well covered. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and let marinate at room temperature for 3 to 6 hours. The shrimp can also be cooked in the oven on a grill. If cooking on a stove top, let the meat get thoroughly coated with the marincade. If using a griddle, you can do this in a saucepan, adding water to the pan or in a pressure cooker, then put everything in a pot and bring to a boil. Skim the foam, then reduce the heat to low and allow the goulash to simmer gently until medium doneness or until the carrots and shrimp are cooked, about 30 minutes or longer, stirring about every 10 to 15 minutes. Transfer everything to a serving bowl. Sprinkle the shredded pork on top, as well as some black pepper and some dried rosemary. Serve with rice and bread, as a soup or soup for those who like their soup hot. Note, you can do this in a pressure cooker as well or a skillet.

title: Pork Pasta
ingredients: 6 ounces uncooked spaghetti | 1 can pumpkin pie spice | 1 pear, peeled and diced
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook spaghetti in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 10 minutes. Drain. Meanwhile, place pumpkin pie spice in a small bowl. Squeeze juice from pear into pumpkin spice.

Random Ingredients: italian salad dressing mix,coconut milk,black peppercorn,pineapple juice,mace,ice water,turmeric
title: Coconut Macaroon (Hawaiian Fish)
ingredients: 4 macaroons or 4 fish fillets | 1/2 cup pineapple juice | 1/4 cup shredded coconut ( may sub 1/2 cup plain coconut yogurt ) | 1/2 cup crushed pineapple with juice | 1 cup italian salad dressing mix | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric, ground | 1 teaspoon ground mace, ground | 1 -2 teaspoon crushed black peppercorns
instructions: Place the fish in a baking dish and top with the macaroons. Combine well, pour over the macaroons. Sprinkle with the remaining ingredients. Refrigerate for about five hours or overnight. When ready to serve, preheat the oven to 425°f bake for about 20 to 25 minutes, until fish flakes when tested with a fork.

title: Simple Yummy Jeera (Potash)
ingredients: 1 lb chat masala, masala paste ( the cheap stuff, i use a cheap masala mix ) | 2 cups diced celery
instructions: Saute the diced celery in a little oil until it turns translucent. Add chaat masala and cook for 2 minutes. Drain the fat and rinse the potash well. Add to skillet and stir. Cook until it turns dark green. Serve hot.

title: Spanish Roast
ingredients: 2 lbs beef chuck, trimmed of fat and tied | 1 orange sweet bell pepper, seeded and chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees f. With a sharp knife, make a thin slice off 1 side of each piece of beef. This should leave about 1 tablespoon of fat underneath. Place meat on the fat side of a shallow baking dish. Sprinkle with orange sweet pepper. Cover the roast and let stand for 10 minutes. Using 2 forks, poke several holes in the fat crust. Place the beef on the beef. Press roast firmly so that the meat will not stick. Bake for about 20 minutes or until it is well browned and the juices run clear.

title: Strewman's Winter Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 1 rutabaga, peeled and cubed | 1 cup pasta sauce with chopped garden tomatoes | 1/2 cup dried cranberries | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon
instructions: Place rutabaga in a large, deep pot with enough water in the pot to cover. Bring to boil over medium high heat. Reduce heat to medium low and simmer until rutabaga is tender, 15 to 20 minutes. Drain and discard any remaining cooking water. Place rutabaga into a large bowl. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta sauce and cranberries. Reduce heat and simmer until thickened, about 15 minutes. Stir through the maple syrup. Pour soup into bowls and serve with cinnamon.

title: Pierogi Tzatziki
ingredients: 10 g scallions, trimmed and sliced | 2 yukon gold potatoes, peeled and sliced
instructions: Sauté the scallions in a little oil. Add the potatoes and sauté until soft. Serve warm.

title: Grilled Turnip Salad With Almond Mayo
ingredients: 3/4 lb yellow potato, peeled and thinly sliced ( such as purple potatoes, zucchini, or a mixture ) | 1 small small turnip, peeled, seeded, and cut into chunks | 1 small radish, thinly sliced | coarse salt and pepper | 2 drops almond extract, to taste | 2 ears corn, cooked, kernels cut off before cooking ( about 2 1/2 cups kernels ) | chopped dry roasted unsalted peanuts ( for garnish, if desired ) ( optional )
instructions: Preheat grill or grill pan on medium high until hot.

title: Danish Turnip (Køda Turnip)
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs turnips, large | 1/2 cup brandy | 2 green cardamom pods, crushed lightly | 16 cheesecloth
instructions: Rinse the turnip. Place the turnips in a large pot of boiling water and steam 20 to 30 minutes, or until tender. Remove from the heat and peel off the crisp skin. Cut the turnips into pieces about half inch square, place them in a large saucepan, pour in the brandy and season with salt and pepper. Cover and simmer 20 minutes. Tie the cardamom pods in a piece of cheesecloth, add them and simmer until soft. Discard the pods. Pack the turnips into paper bags, about 3 1/2 inches wide. Seal tightly, press out air and refrigerate for up to 6 months.

title: Veal and Courgette Salad With Mayonnaise
ingredients: 12 ladyfingers | 8 slices veal | 12 slices courgettes | 4 tablespoons mayonnaise | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: First of all, take the veal slices and place them in a medium sized frying pan with a good dash of olive oil on each side. Then cook them for 10 - 15 minutes or until the veal is cooked through and browned. You should have a crispy crust on the outside, but if it doesn't, then leave to cook for 5 minutes or until it's cooked. Remove them to a warm plate or tin foil. Keep the pan on a heat. Next, in a large serving bowl, mix together the mayonnaise, turmeric and mayonnaise mixture. Dice up the veal and courgettes into small pieces. To serve, put some of the cooked veal, courgette and courgette slices in a bowl. Then pour over the mayonnaise and spread evenly. Top with the remaining veal and courgette slices.

title: Chipotle Burritos
ingredients: 100 g chipotle powder | 10 burrito-size flour tortillas
instructions: Preheat oven to 220 degrees celsius. Place the ground pepper in a blender and blend for a few seconds. Pour into a shallow ovenproof bowl. Place 4 burrito sized flour tortillas on top, pressing on the tortillas lightly. Repeat with the rest of the burritos and place on a baking tray or on an oven tray lined with siliconized cooking paper, or spray the surface of the tortillas with non stick vegetable spray. Sprinkle with the chipotle powder and bake until browned and crispy, approximately 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Tartiflette (French Cheese Bread )
ingredients: 1/4 ounce fresh yeast | 5 1/2 - 6 cups flour
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/3 cup warm water. Mix with 5 cups of the flour to make a very stiff dough. Cover with a clean cloth and allow to rise in a warm place till bubbly. Punch dough down with hands and knead thoroughly. Roll out to 1/4 thick and cut into 8 diagonal pieces. Arrange on a greased baking sheet. Cover and let rise for 20 - 30 minutes. Make slits in with a sharp knife so they will allow steam to escape during cooking. Brush with melted butter. Bake at 425°f/180°c for 30 - 40 minutes or til golden.

Random Ingredients: brown lentil,lamb,chipotle powder,fenugreek seed,oregano leaf,anchovy fillet,phyllo pastry,white wine vinegar
title: Lamb in Phyllo With Lentils
ingredients: 2 packages frozen phyllo pastry sheets, thawed | 1/2 cup dried lentils ( i like red, which is what i have ) | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1 tablespoon fenugreek seeds ( or crushed italian spices ) | 2 cups chopped cooked meat ( or lamb ) | 3 anchovy fillets, minced | 1/2 cup dry white wine vinegar | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon dried chipotle powder or 1/2-1 teaspoon hot sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit. Cover a cookie sheet with parchment paper and spray with a nonstick cooking spray. Place the phyllo sheets on the cookie sheet. In a medium saucepan over medium low heat, stir lentils in just enough water to cover them. Bring to a boil and simmer, uncovered, for 20 minutes. Add oregano and fenugreek, stirring to mix well. Cover and bring to a boil again. Reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes. Remove from heat and drain water. Meanwhile, combine meat, anchovies and mustard sauce in a food processor. Process until you have a paste. Stir paste into lentils. Place 1 1/2 cup of lentil topping evenly over phyllo pastry sheets, then cover with approximately 2 cups. Repeat layering until you have 7 phyllo sheets, then top with remaining topping. Brush top pastry sheets with oil. Bake at 375 degrees fahrenheit for about 15 minutes until golden.

title: Wild Mushroom Spaghetti
ingredients: 2 boxes uncooked spaghetti, broken into 3/4-inch pieces | 1 package wild mushrooms, sliced | 1/4 cup dried currants | 2 teaspoons sesame seeds | 1 teaspoon gingerroot, grated | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/4 teaspoon fennel seed
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Add mushrooms and dried currants and saute until mushrooms are dark and tender, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and add sesame seeds. Stir to combine. Place spaghetti in a large bowl, and sprinkle with ginger, and garlic powder, stirring to coat. Pour contents of skillet into bowl with mushrooms, and toss to coat. Sprinkle with the fennel seed and serve.

Random Ingredients: lasagna noodle,wheat berry,prune,red cayenne pepper,honey mustard,candy bar
title: Cheaters Prunes on Lettuce
ingredients: 16 ounces whole wheat berries ( the thin-skinned berries ) | 8 ounces prunes | 1 tablespoon honey mustard | 8 ounces hot dog buns | 8 teaspoons red cayenne peppers | 3 cups crushed candy bars
instructions: Place berry on absorbent paper and set aside in refrigerator overnight. Place the prune on wax paper or cookie sheet in slow oven set at 500 degrees. Place prunes on wax paper and cover with plastic wrap. Let the prunes stand at room temperature about 1 hour. Peel off wax paper and cut into bite size pieces. In a small mixing bowl, combine the mustard and black pepper set aside. Cut remaining 2 1/2 cups of prunes into slices. Place the slices on the cookie sheet and set aside for 10 minutes. Drain out excess water. Preheat grill pan. Remove 1/4 of the reserved prune juice and then discard. Place remaining prunes on plate. Spread prunes in saucer and put on platter. Place hot dog buns on plate. Spread the mustard on bun. Place hot dog buns on sampling. Sprinkle crushed candy bar pieces on top. Garnish with slices of prunes.

title: Spaghetti with Mushroom-Cheese-Chicken Meatballs
ingredients: 1 can white button mushrooms, drained | 1 lb extra lean ground beef | 1 lb ground chicken | 1 medium onion, finely chopped | 1 lb whole-grain spaghetti | 1 ounce mascarpone | 1 -2 teaspoon dried basil | 1 tablespoon fresh basil, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon onion salt
instructions: Mix mushrooms, beef, chicken, and onion in a large bowl with spaghetti, mascarpone, basil, and onion salt. Drain and rinse mushrooms in warm water. Combine well with meatball ingredients and refrigerate overnight, to allow flavors to blend. Put on greased cookie sheet and bake at 375 degrees f for 15 minutes. Serve with a tossed salad.

Random Ingredients: wheat bran,ketjap manis,black tea,pepper,green chili,olive oil,red wine,cider vinegar
title: Quick and Easy English Style Breakfast (Ulster Style)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups whole wheat bran ( also called wheat germ ) | 1 cup black tea | 5 black tea bags | 1/2 cup ketchup ( optional ) or 1/2 cup heinz ketchup ( optional ) | 2 -3 pinches pepper | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 1 -2 green chili | 1 tablespoon olive oil
instructions: Place black tea in a large, clean container. Add the whole wheat bran, black tea, ketchup/sauce/paprika/pepper jar. Add pepper. Cover tightly and shake to get all the bran and spices into the tea. Cover tightly and leave in the fridge overnight. When ready to eat remove tea packet and tea leaves, stir through and enjoy you can add fresh herbs and spices to the liquid if desired too. Enjoy.

title: German Frankfurt Art
ingredients: 1/2 head romaine lettuce ( about 3 pounds ) or fresh spinach leaves ( about 3 pounds ) | 2 cups seedless raspberry jam | 1/2 cup chicken stock or 1/2 cup broth | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 2 -3 tablespoons grated mozzarella cheese
instructions: Wash and dry the lettuce. Chop the leaves and place them in a mixing bowl. Add the jam and stir to coat the leaf with the jam. Dissolve the baking soda in the stock or broth and pour into the bowl with the lettuce and jam. Mix to blend. Add mozzarella cheese. Stir to blend. Spread onto a large serving platter. Serve warm or cool.

title: Herbed Hazelnuts
ingredients: 500 g hulled hazelnuts | 1 large red shallot, finely diced | fresh rosemary, to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 220c. Place hazelnuts on a baking tray and bake for 7 minutes, or until golden and fragrant. Allow to cool then remove skins from nut shells. Using a food processor, finely dice hazelnuts. Place shallot, rosemary and hazelnuts in a large mixing bowl. Pour nut mixture over mixture and toss to combine. Spread the hazelnuts on a towel lined baking sheet and allow to sit for 1 hour at room temperature. Spread hazelnuts out and return to oven for 45 - 60 minutes or until topping is very dark and fragrant and hazelnuts are toasted.

title: Czech Pasta
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs ground pork | 1 inch fresh gingerroot, chopped | 2 tablespoons ground hazelnuts | 1 lb elbow macaroni, cooked
instructions: In a large bowl, mix pork, ginger, hazelnut and pasta. Add water until pasta is about 3/4 of the way up the side of the dish. Toss just until coated, about 1 - 2 minutes. Remove to serving platter. If desired, sprinkle with paprika and serve right away.

title: Warm Asparagus With Herbs
ingredients: 100 g baby asparagus, woody ends snapped off
instructions: Steam the asparagus as you're boiling, and then transfer to a warmed serving dish. Pour over the herbs and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: custard powder,brussels sprout,honeydew melon,red bean,beef brisket,wasabi paste,cauliflower
title: Beef and Vegetables
ingredients: 2 lbs beef brisket, boneless, skin on | 1 tablespoon wasabi paste | 1 tablespoon honeydew melon, finely chopped | 1 head cauliflower, chopped | 1 bottle corned beef and beans | 16 brussels sprouts | 1 cup prepared custard powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f place brisket, fat side up, on a rack in a roasting pan or in a roasting pan. Place in oven and cook until thermometer reaches 135 f for rare, 140f for medium rare, 155f for medium well. Transfer to a warm platter, cover loosely with foil and let rest 20 minutes before serving. The meat may have better to rest before slicing across the grain so the fat will have the texture of a raw meat. For a rare meat, remove from oven and cover loosely with foil. After 20 minutes add wasabi paste and honeydew melon. Stir, cover, and continue cooking 30 minutes longer or until is very tender. Remove brisket from pan and let rest 5 minutes before slicing across the grain. For salad, remove cauliflower head and core, and cut into 1 inch florets. Place on a serving platter and arrange the corned beef, beans, and sprouts around the meat. Sprinkle each serving with custard powder. Serve with noodles or rice.

title: Teriyaki Beef Noodle Soup
ingredients: 1 package chicken breast strips | 1 teaspoon minced fresh ginger root | 5 cups beef, or as needed | 1 cup finely chopped cooked beef
instructions: Bring a saucepan of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook chicken breast strips in boiling water until easily pierced with a fork, about 5 minutes.

title: Lavender Filled Cannelloni
ingredients: 25 -30 large fresh lavender flowers ( or a fresh herb of your choice ) | 1/2 head cabbage ( or half of a cabbage of your choice. i use a large head of cabbage ) | 2 tablespoons granulated sugar | 1 bunch of fresh curly spring onion ( or 1 small bunch of green onion of your choice ) | 8 ounces part-skim ricotta cheese ( or low-fat yogurt if you prefer ) | 5 -6 pieces arbol chiles ( or one small-medium sized dried red chile )
instructions: Clean and remove stems from and chop fresh ingredients finely the cabbage leaves can be left whole, it is not necessary. If using dried chilos, cut them in half or into thin slices. Place in large saucepan and bring to boil. Cover and reduce heat to simmer and cook until leaves are tender and pliable. Check often to see if cabbage is soft. When cooked, remove leaves and discard. Set leaves aside and save the rest of the cooking water. You will use these water to mix with the filling the cannelloni and make them easier to wrap up.

title: Crazy Hot Dogs
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon lime juice, freshly squeezed | 2/3 teaspoon onion salt | 1 1/2 lbs ground beef | 1 egg white | 1/2 cup dried cranberries | 3/8 - 1/4 cup dried crushed limes
instructions: First, prepare all ingredients. Combine all ingredients for meat mixture well and refrigerate for 24 to 48 hours to allow flavors to mix better. Preheat oven to 500°f. Take meat mixture and form into 4 patties about 1 1/2 inches high.. Arrange on patties and bake for 20 - 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: portabella mushroom,ricotta cheese,cooking oat,cajun seasoning,salmon fillet,head cauliflower,italian tomato
title: Smoked Salmon and Roasted Cajun Oats
ingredients: 2 portabella mushrooms, quartered | 5 tablespoons cajun seasoning | 1 head cauliflower, separated into florets | 1 package fresh ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup quick-cooking oats | 1 tablespoon cajun seasoning | 2 skinned, boneless salmon fillets | 1 italian tomatoes, chopped | 2 tablespoons cajun seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Combine mushroom, 5 tablespoons of cajun seasoning, and cauliflower in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: olive,salt black pepper,vanilla bean,lemon juice zest,orange jell o,lard,cashew
title: Cashews Dessert
ingredients: 25 g lard ( or olive oil or butter ) | 3 packets vanilla beans | 2 1/2 tablespoons lemon juice or 2 1/2 tablespoons orange juice | 50 g cashews, roasted lightly | 100 g almonds, roasted lightly, roughly chopped | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Line a 10 x 20cm swiss roll tin with non stick baking paper. Put the lard or oil or butter in a heavy based frying pan and stir over a medium heat until the fat starts to smoke. Add the vanilla beans and then the lemon or orange juice. Remove from the heat and set aside until needed. Stir the cashews and finely chopped nuts into the warmed lard or oil mixture and season with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Transfer to the prepared swiss roll tin. Wrap the baking paper with foil and put in the fridge until it is needed. Turn the oven on to 220°c then remove the foil and bake for 30 minutes. Remove and cool for a few minutes. Cut into 4 squares. Serve with fresh fruit and/or ice cream for dessert. Note, if using the nuts, place them in a heat proof bowl and bake for 10 - 15 minutes, or until they are golden brown. Remove from the oven, stand for 5 minutes and serve with fresh fruit and/or ice cream.

Random Ingredients: limeade concentrate,dijon mustard,green chili pepper,farina,baking soda
title: Easy Jalapeno Dip
ingredients: 1/4 cup dijon mustard | 1/4 cup frozen limeade concentrate | 1 green chili pepper, finely chopped | 1/2 cup dry farina | 1 tablespoon baking soda | 1 tablespoon chopped green chili pepper ( optional )
instructions: Blend mustard, limead concentrate, chile, farina, baking soda and jalapeno peppers. Chill for about 1 hour before serving so flavors can combine.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock,brie cheese,summer savory,anchovy paste,beef chuck,sugar,molasses
title: Brandy Brie
ingredients: 1 lb lean boneless beef chuck or 1 lb boneless lamb | 1 tablespoon anchovy paste | 1 tablespoon sugar | 1 teaspoon dried summer savory | 6 ounces brie cheese | 5 cups chicken stock | 1 tablespoon light molasses
instructions: Cut meat into 1/4 inch cubes. Dry well. Heat pan over high heat, add oil to pan. Brown cubes until well browned, stirring frequently, about 3 minutes. Add anchovy paste, sugar, and savory. Continue browning, stirring constantly, 2 or 3 more minutes. Add brie, cook just until browned and bubbling, then stir in chicken stock. Cover and simmer over low heat until meat and vegetables are tender, approx 25 to 40 minutes. Stir in molasses.

Random Ingredients: italian spice,chicken wing,green pea,plain flour,oat,cilantro leaf,lemon juice zest,salmon
title: Lemon Salmon and Pea Parcels
ingredients: 4 whole chicken wings | 1 medium lemons, juice and zest of or grated zest of 1 lemon | 2 tablespoons plain flour ( or gluten-free flour ) | 40 g frozen green peas | 40 g frozen shelled green peas | fresh cilantro leaves | 1/2 teaspoon dried mixed spice | 1 tablespoon rolled oats | italian spices | 1 tablespoon lemon juice
instructions: Remove the wing tips, wash and pat dry. Heat oven to 200c and line roasting pan with baking paper. Tear off any heavy wings or skin and discard. Use one piece of chicken to make a pouch. Place one spoonful of lemon zest on the edge of each pouch. Roll up, wrap in the foil and place in the hot oven for 1 hour. Remove the foil, add peas and bake for a further 15 minutes or till tender. Stir frozen lemon rind and juice into the peas. Serve the lemongrale sprinkled with fresh chopped cilantro. To make seasoning mix all ingredients in a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,fruit,beef steak,dill seed,quinoa,green food coloring
title: Korean-Spiced Beef Bowl (Buka)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef flank steak | 1 tablespoon minced fresh dill seeds | 1 cup uncooked quinoa | 1/4 cup vegetable oil | 1/2 - 1 tablespoon green food coloring | 1 jar fruit, drained and juice reserved
instructions: If beef, trim excess fat and gristle and trim any excess fat. Sprinkle meat with dill seeds. Soak quinoa in enough hot water to cover for 1 hour to plump it, then drain it well and place in a bowl. Heat oil in wok or large skillet, and swirl to coat bottom. When oil shimmers, add meat and heat until just barely browned, 1 minute. Turn meat over, and add reserved water. Stir to combine, and cook meat about 3 minutes over medium heat, until it begins to brown. Stir in the crumbled quinoa and food coloring, about 1 minute. If this does not cover meat, add 1/4 cup of reserved liquid. Serve immediately.

title: Winter Cottage Gizzles With Ginger-Mustard Mash
ingredients: 3 1/4 lbs parsnips, peeled | 1 tablespoon fine cornmeal | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme honey | 3 green onions, cut diagonally into 2-inch lengths | 1 tablespoon gingerroot, grated | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme honey or 1 tablespoon dried thyme honey | 1 tablespoon fresh celery leaves or 1 tablespoon fresh celery leaves
instructions: Peel the parsnips, cut in half and put them into a medium sized saucepan. Add plenty of water and mash lightly. Add a pinch of salt and add the honey and green onion and cook slowly, stirring for 1 to 2 minutes. Add the grated ginger and thyme honey. Stir well over a low heat to ensure the honey and ginger are well blended through the mash. Cover and keep hot while the gizzles are prepared. Preheat the oven to 400°f with a sharp knife, core the pices of your thumb into a cup or measuring cup and measure out 1 cup of the mashed potatoes. Remove the skin and seeds from the ginger and then cut the ginger into chunks, removing the skin, and place them in a bowl. Add the remaining mashed potato and the mustard mixture, mix through the ginger and thyme honey/herb mixture, and add a bit of water if needed to form a soft, mushy paste. Remove the gizzles from the heat and brush them with beaten egg white, decorate with a few chopped parsley if you wish and serve straight away.

Random Ingredients: ginger garlic paste,panko breadcrumb,parsnip,orange zest,kernel corn,orange marmalade,spinach fettuccine pasta,oriental sesame oil
title: Spinach Fettuccine With Orange Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 cup panko breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup orange zest, minced | 1/2 cup orange marmalade | 1 tablespoon fresh ginger-garlic paste | 2 teaspoons oriental sesame oil | 4 cups frozen whole kernel corn | 2 medium parsnips, peeled and cut into julienne-shape strands | 8 ounces spinach fettuccine pasta, cooked | fresh parsley ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: In a small bowl, combine bread crumbs, orange peel, marmalade, ginger garlic paste and sesame oil.

title: Cod With Noodle and Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 cups noodle ( such as chacha or dal ) | 4 teaspoons cornmeal | 1/2 cup channa dal | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 2 teaspoons blanched almonds ( garnish ) | 2 cups channa dal | 1 1/2 lbs cod, fillet of choice | 4 -5 cremini mushrooms, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Bake noodle according to package directions, except that channa dal is not included in recipe. In a medium bowl, mix channa and turmeric. In a separate skillet, heat 1 tablespoon oil over medium high heat, then add almonds and fry until golden brown, about 3 minutes. Transfer to paper towels to drain. Sprinkle channa mixture over peanuts and set aside. Season cod with salt and pepper. Arrange in a roasting pan and arrange mushrooms on top. Pour remaining 2 tablespoons oil over fish and sprinkle with remaining turmeric, then cover pan and roast for 25 minutes. Place noodle over top and serve.

title: Hot Date Fritters
ingredients: 2 large tomatoes, peeled, seeds removes & chopped | 1/4 cup pitted soft dates, chopped | 2 tablespoons tomato ketchup | 1 pinch hot pepper sauce
instructions: Place chopped tomatoes, dates and ketchup into a small microwave safe bowl. Microwave for 1 1/2 mins, stirring. Stir again. Microwave for 1 1/2 mins more, stir and continue to cook until the dates have softened slightly. Place spoonful of the fritter mixture into a warm, hot non stick frying pan or griddle. Using a slotted spoon, scoop up the mixture with your spatula and cook until the fritters are brown on the bottom and crisp on the top. Turn over the fritters over and cook on the other side.

Random Ingredients: liquid honey,french bread,thyme leaf,cake yeast,asiago cheese
title: Herb Crusted Bread (Bread Machine)
ingredients: 1/4 cup asiago cheese, grated | 2 cups fresh bread dough, lightly seasoned with salt | 2 teaspoons dried thyme leaves | 1 (.25 ounce ) package cake yeast | 1 1/2 cups liquid honey
instructions: Place all ingredients in pan according to bread machine instructions, or use the manual setting for your bread machine instructions. Press start, and check on dough after 8 minutes for desired doneness.

Random Ingredients: sushi rice,cracker,lamb shank,beef bouillon cube,burgundy wine,lasagna noodle,tuna,spinach
title: Bouillabaisse (Couscous Casserole)
ingredients: 4 lamb shanks ( see note ) | 2 tablespoons beef bouillon cubes ( see note ) | 1 can tuna, drained | sushi rice | 1 package lasagna noodles ( i recommend egg roll, but any noodle can be used ) | sliced crusty cracker | 1 bunch fresh spinach
instructions: Season lamb shanks to taste with bouillon cubes, salt and pepper or white pepper. Brown shanks in a skillet over medium heat, on low heat, until lightly browned on all sides. Place cooked rice in a 2 quart casserole dish. Top with layer of sliced spinach on top of rice. Repeat layering of shanks and spinach. Top with 1/2 bottle of wine. Cover tightly with plastic wrap. Bake at 350°f for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Mushroom and Filling Wraps
ingredients: 1/3 cup cremini mushrooms, finely chopped | 3 tablespoons flour or 3 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 can filling ( i used cream of mushroom )
instructions: Mix together the mushrooms, and corn starch. Roll a flour tortilla with mushroom filling. Heat in a greased frying pan as per directions on can. Turn over and bake on a greased plate. You can serve it on paper towels. Enjoy ~.

Random Ingredients: garlic powder,sherry wine,sea scallop,italian breadcrumb,tortilla chip
title: Quick Italian Scallops With Sherry Chips
ingredients: 1/2 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 8 ounces sea scallops, rinsed well | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 tablespoon sherry wine | 1/4 - 1/2 cup crushed tortilla chips
instructions: Preheat oven 400°f. Spray a 9x13 baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Combine bread crumbs and seasonings in medium bowl. Pour sherry into shallow dish. Add 2 tbsp bread crumbs and toss to coat scallops. Place scallops in sherry, coating well. Transfer scallops to baking dish and sprinkle with remaining crumbs. Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until beginning to brown.

Random Ingredients: oleo,cream chicken soup,red chili paste,couscous,yogurt,vanilla,mustard seed,orange blossom water
title: Mogul Crunchy Couscous
ingredients: 2 cups couscous | 1/2 cup light cream of chicken soup | 1 tablespoon oleo | 1 tablespoon sour cream | 1/2 teaspoon orange blossom water or 1/2 teaspoon almond blossom water | 1 tablespoon prepared mustard seeds | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon red chili paste | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Boil water in medium sized sauce pan until all the water is absorbed. Remove from heat and pour oleo in with the remaining ingredients. Mix well. Pour the mixture in a bowl and let set for ten minutes or so to set properly. Then dig in.

title: Chunky Tomato Pastries
ingredients: 300 g whole wheat flour | 1 can tomato paste
instructions: Mix the flour well and form a very well in the centre of it. Pour the tomato paste over the well and mix into a smooth dough. Keep aside for 15 - 30 minutes. Preheat oven. Heat a non stick frying pan. Brush the oil and coat the pan. Spread the mixture on your hot frying pan. Shallow fry them on both sides until lightly crisp. Drain on absorbent paper. Keep aside to cool for 3 - 5 minutes. Store in an airtight container and keep warm. Serve as appetisers with yoghurt, cucumber salad or anything else.

title: Easy Garlic and Fenugreek (Fried Ferni) Tilapia
ingredients: 1 pound tilapia fillets | 1 1/2 heads broccoli florets | 2 teaspoons dried fenugreek leaves
instructions: Wash the fenugreek leaves, and set them aside. Cut the tilapia into 6 pieces. Place the fenugreek leaves into a bowl, and crush them with your hands until they have the texture of fine crumbs. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Place the crushed fenugreek leaves, and a few pieces of cod fish into the hot oil. Cook 5 minutes on each side, then place fish into the warm skillet. Cook 10 minutes, or until firm and lightly browned.

title: Indian Chicken Salad With a Kick
ingredients: 1 cup mayonnaise | 1/3 cup cointreau liqueur | 3 green cardamom pods, crushed | 6 boneless skinless chicken thighs | guacamole, as garnish
instructions: In a big bowl, combine mayonnaise and cointreau. Add pepper, cardamom pods, and chicken thighs. Cover and put in refridgerator. Refrigerate overnight to soak up the flavors. This is best served chilled. Garnish with guacamole.

title: Baked Farfalle With Marinara
ingredients: 1 lb farfalle pasta, cooked according to package directions ( or other pasta ) | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram or 1 teaspoon fresh marjoram, finely chopped
instructions: In a large baking dish, combine pasta, marjoram and salt. Toss to mix and cover. Bake uncovered at 350 degrees for 30 to 35 minutes or until tender. Note, if serving immediately, allow pasta to cool and stir into sauce just before serving. If serving as directed above, cover and allow to marinate in fridge overnight.

title: Scotch Dogs
ingredients: 2 large parsnips | 1/2 cup rz. cheese salad dressing or 1/2 cup marsala | 1/2 cup red wine | 2 tablespoons drained capers | 1/4 teaspoon pepperoncini pepper | 4 flour tortillas | 2 cups quinoa | 1 package ramen noodles
instructions: Peel, chop and boil parsnips in water until tender. Drain, then cook rz. Cheese salad dressing until melted. Combine parsnips, rz. Cheese salad dressing, red wine and capers in a large bowl. Spread onto a flour tortillas and sprinkle with pepperoncini. Spread quinoa on a plate and divide quinoa over the tortillas. Place a hot dog on top. Slather with marinade.

title: Frijoles Borrachitos - Refried Beans
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups dried pinto beans | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 2 limes, cut into wedges
instructions: Pour enough water into a 2 quart saucepan to cover the beans. Bring to a boil, and add 2 quarts of fresh water. Add the pinto beans, and cook at a gentle boil until soft, 2 to 3 hours. Drain beans, and rinse off water. Transfer the beans to a colander, and place in a heavy pot. Bring the beans to a boil, reduce heat to low, and simmer until tender, 15 to 20 minutes. Remove from heat, and stir in water to cover. Let stand, covered, 5 to 10 minutes. Run a knife around the inside of the pot, and scrape all of the browned bits off the bottom of the pot with the spoon. Spread about 1 tablespoon of balsamic vinegar on a plate to prevent the beans from drying out. Dip a lime wedge into the balsamic vinegar, then place on top of the beans. Cover the dish, and shake off excess balsamic vinegar. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: pepper flake,white sugar,beef stock,asparagus,egg wrap,vermicelli,red chili pepper,stewing beef
title: Thai Beef and Asparagus Rollups
ingredients: 16 egg roll wraps or 16 egg roll wraps | 12 st-ripe beef, strips | 1 lb asparagus, cut in 1-inch pieces | 1 red chili peppers or 1 green chili pepper, roughly chopped | 2 tablespoons vermicelli, broken in 1/2-inch cubes | 1/2 cup white sugar | 1/4 cup beef stock | 1/4 teaspoon pepper flakes
instructions: Lay out the egg roll wrappers on paper towels. Cut into 1 inch circles. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Toss the beef and asparagus with the chili, vermicelli, sugar, and beef stock. Sprinkle with pepper flakes. Carefully lay the filled wrappers in the boiling water. Cook for one minute, turn over, and cook for a further 5 minutes, or until the wrapper is crisp and golden.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed,broccoli floret,beef chuck,tomato puree,white wine,chicken stock,lamb stew meat,lemon wedge
title: Braised Lamb and Broccoli
ingredients: 3 lbs lamb stew meat ( about 1.5kg. ) | 3/4 lb beef chuck, trimmed and cut into 1. 5x3cm lengths | 1 lb fresh tomato puree | 3 1/2 cups chicken stock | 6 fluid ounces white wine | 3 1/2 ounces sesame seeds | 8 -10 medium broccoli florets | lemon wedge | toasted sesame seeds
instructions: Pre heat oven to 300 f. Mix all the braising ingredients together in a deep, ovenproof casserole. Cover and bake for 2 hours until the lamb is cooked. Increase oven temperature to 300 f and add tomato puree and stock. Simmer, stirring to combine, for 5 minutes. Remove the pan from the oven and reduce the liquid to half. Mix in the sesame seeds. Slice the meat thinly across the grain. Ladle into bowls and top each with a spoonful of braising mixture for the final basting. Sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds.

title: Italian Coffee
ingredients: 2 -3 tablespoons brewed coffee | 2 -3 tablespoons toasted slivered almonds
instructions: Fill 4 coffee cups to 3/4 capacity with coffee. Gently shake cups to brew the coffee. Add the almonds to the foam and stir to coat.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,vegetable oil cooking spray,feta cheese,jicama,plain yogurt,red pepper powder
title: Cheesy Jicama Chicken Appetizers
ingredients: 4 skinless boneless chicken breast halves, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1/2 cup plain fat-free yogurt | 3/4 cup crumbled feta cheese | 4 teaspoons vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 tablespoon crushed red pepper powder | 2 cups packaged jicama, cut into 1/2-inch dice
instructions: Prepare broiler. Place chicken in a 9x13 inch baking dish. In a medium bowl, combine yogurt, feta cheese, oil, 1/2 of the red pepper powder and the remaining red pepper powder. Stir well.

title: Linguine Beef
ingredients: 1 boneless beef chuck roast | 1 jar catalina dressing ( use the full bottle or homemade ) | 1 1/2 cups mexican cheese or 1 1/2 cups monterey jack pepper cheese, shredded | 1 package linguine
instructions: Cut the meat into 1 1/2 inch pieces. Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Add meat and saute a few minutes until meat is no longer pink. Add catalina dressing and continue cooking until it is heated through. Cook the linguine according to package directions drain and toss with the meat mixture. Pour the sauce over the noodles. Sprinkle on the cheese and serve.

Random Ingredients: ancho chili pepper,vanilla ice cream,red onion,red radish,chili oil
title: Chili Salt Ice Cream Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chopped red onions | 2 tablespoons chopped red radishes | 2 tablespoons chopped red chilies or 2 tablespoons chopped green chiles, minced | 2 tablespoons good quality chili oil | 2 scoops vanilla ice cream | any other mild chili oil
instructions: Combine the onions, radishes, chilies, chili oil and ice cream in a mixing bowl. Place on a large serving platter. Drizzle chili oil liberally over the ice cream and serve right away.

title: Grilled Indian Tomato and Ginger Chutney
ingredients: 1 pint sun-dried tomato | 1 tablespoon garam masala powder | 1 teaspoon fresh ginger, grated | 1 teaspoon seasoning, your favourite kind | 1 tablespoon olive
instructions: First, you want to get everything ready. Next, heat the grill. Place the tomatoes on the grill and leave until softened and aromatic. Remove from the grill and mash with a fork. Place in a container and add half a teaspoon of ginger and seasoning. Mix until it is well blended. Remove from the grill and transfer to a shallow glass preserving dish. Pour the remaining teaspoon ginger in and spread over the top of the chutney. Leave to cool completely. Once cool, cut into pieces. Use immediately or store in the fridge. The longer it sets the more flavorful it will become.

title: Al Jaffrey's Savory Spanish Tortilla
ingredients: 6 large russet potatoes | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried chili peppers, crushed or 1 1/2 teaspoons dried hot chili pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon sugar | 1 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Cook potatoes in boiling water for 5 minutes or until cooked throughly. Drain, cool completely and cut into 1/2 slices or squares. Spray a non stick 2 quart baking dish with cooking spray and place the potatoes in a single layer. Mix chile, sugar and half of the cheese and add it to the hot cooked potatoes. Spread half of the potato mixture on the bottom of the pan or use a jelly roll pan. Spread the rest of the potato mixture over the top and on the top layer. Sprinkle the reserved cheese over. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes, or until heated through and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: asafoetida powder,salt pork,water,molasses,tofu,tabasco sauce,italian plum tomato,coriander leaf
title: Tofu Manis
ingredients: 6 italian plum tomatoes | 4 teaspoons salt ( to taste ) | 1 ounce salt pork ( cut into squares ) | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( to taste ) | 1/8 teaspoon ground coriander leaves or 1/8 teaspoon cilantro leaf | 2 ounces water | 1 lb firm tofu ( drained ) | 2 1/2 teaspoons light molasses | 2 drops tabasco sauce
instructions: Cut tomatoes into 4 slices each. Sprinkle one side with 1 tsp salt then stack on wax paper and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Place all ingredients in food processor except for the tofu and process briefly. If you are using fresh tofu, cut into cubes for more texture and color. Drain off tofu and place on paper towel covered plate. Cover lightly with a slightly damp cloth to prevent drying out if not using right away or not soon. Pour tofu mixture in oil in a shallow baking dish or skillet. Cover and bake in a preheated oven at 350 degrees for 45 minutes, or until tofu and tomatoes are well heated and mixture is smooth. Sprinkle with coriander leaves or cilantro leaves, serve hot.

title: Diet
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts | 1 can filling, pillsbury deluxe deluxe deluxe deluxe deluxe deluxe deluxe deluxe dough
instructions: Cut chicken into bite size pieces. Bake or microwave chicken. Mix with other fillings. Dip in crust and bake at 350 degrees 5 - 10 minutes until bubbly. Serve.

Random Ingredients: brown sugar,cornstarch,green bell pepper,white onion,wild rice,kielbasa
title: Wild Rice and Sausage Casserole
ingredients: 1 package kielbasa, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 3/4 cup white onion, chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons brown sugar | 1/2 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 cup wild rice, cooked and drained | 1 small green bell pepper, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to mix cooked wild rice, sliced sausage, chopped onion, brown sugar and cornstarch. Place into casserole dish or casserole dish sprayed with pam. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes.

title: Melon Barberry Vinegar Dip (Melon Barberry Dip)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil or 1 tablespoon cooking spray | 3/4 cup diced melon ( melon balls or kiwi, if possible ) | 1 cup unsweetened barberries ( or raspberries, ifn't available ) | 1 1/2 cups vinegar | 1/2 cup berry-flavored liqueur
instructions: Add vegetables to a food processor and process until finely chopped. Pour into a large bowl. Add the liqueur and gently fold in, making sure all ingredients are coated with the liqueur and saturated with the juice. Cover and chill until ready to serve. Can be left overnight in the refrigerator for better flavor.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,mandarin orange section,oil,banana,cilantro,chipotle chile adobo,greek yogurt
title: Aussie Style Chipotle Banana Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup oil | 1 1/2 - 2 cups mandarin orange sections ( reserve the sections ) | 2 tablespoons oil | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon chipotle chile in adobo | 2 large ripe bananas, cut 1/4 inch slices on the diagonal | 1/4 cup crumbled greek yogurt | fresh cilantro, chopped
instructions: Combine the 4 tbs oil, the vinegar and the chipotle in a wide, shallow dish or a serving bowl. Stir in the peel, bananas and cilantro. Using your hands, toss to coat the bananas. Heat the remaining oil in a nonstick fry pan until it shimmers. Toss the bananas in the oil to coat. Arrange the bananas on a plate and serve immediately with the yogurt, if desired, garnish with more cilantro.

title: Mango Salmon Salad
ingredients: 2/3 cup ripe mango, diced | 20 black olives, thinly sliced | 7 ounces salmon fillets, skin left on, cut into thin slices | 1 cup cooked rice ( i use basmati ) | fresh mint sprigs, garnish
instructions: Combine mango, black ripe olives and salmon in a serving bowl. Whisk rice and mint in a separate bowl. Pour rice mixture over salmon and mix lightly. Garnish with mint sprigs.

title: Salmon Tacos
ingredients: 4 salmon steaks | 1 jar pimiento | 1 jar pickle slices | 1 jar romano cheese ( grated ) | oyster sauce | corn tortilla ( use the whole wheat is best ) | jalapeno
instructions: Place salmon steaks in ziplock bag and add a little olive oil to cover. Mix the pimentoes and pickles but not too much or they'll mush up in the fridge. Pour pimento/pickle mixture into a large ziplock bag. Add some cheese and oyster sauce to the bag. Takes a few hours but worth the wait. Heat up a few jalapenos in the microwave to make them spritz with the spice. Put a little olive oil onto a small frying pan and add a whole wheat tortilla. Put the tortilla on the frying pan and place one salmon steak on the tortilla. Spoon some pimento/pickle mixture on top of the salmon steak, then pour some cheese/pimento on top of the salmon steak. Cut into 4 or 5 servings as desired. Serve with a side of a green salad and a bowl of hot sauce for dipping.

title: Rigatoni con Pentola (Ligatoni With Hot and Pecorino Cheese)
ingredients: 1 lb rigatoni pasta or 1 lb penne | 4 tablespoons pecorino cheese, freshly grated | 2 tablespoons hot chili peppers, crushed
instructions: Cook the pasta in boiling water until al dente, drain. Return the drained pasta to the pot, add the pecorino cheese, chili and heat. Toss the pasta in the cheese mixture to coat. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chili paste,green chilies,chunky salsa,banana,soymilk,greek yogurt,fish sauce
title: Chunky Chunky Indian Bananas
ingredients: 12 bananas | 2 -3 tablespoons low-fat greek yogurt ( or plain yogurt ) or 2 -3 tablespoons low-fat plain yogurt ( or plain yogurt ) | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 1 -2 green chilies, minced | 1 tablespoon sweet chili paste ( or more ) | 1/2 cup thick & chunky salsa ( or to taste ) | 1 tablespoon low-fat soy milk ( or to taste )
instructions: Split bananas in half lengthwise and set aside to use as a garnish. Using a food processor, combine yogurt, fish sauce, chiles, chili paste and salsa. Add fish sauce mixture and puree until smooth. Add puree to bananas and mix well. Spray a small casserole dish with pam. Pour banana mixture into casserole dish and bake at 350f for 45 minutes or until the bananas are tender and golden. Allow to set for a few minutes before serving. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: english pea,red bell pepper,salt,chickpea,bay leaf,asafoetida powder
title: Chilled Chickpeas Salad
ingredients: 4 tablespoons red bell peppers, small dice | 2 cans chickpeas, drained and rinsed well ( garbanzo beans ) | 1 3/4 teaspoons chickpeas, powder | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 teaspoon salt | 2 bay leaves
instructions: In a medium non stick skillet or wok heat bell peppers and chickpeas over med high heat. As they turn brown, add the dry chickpea and simmer for about 7 minute add salt and chill.

title: Korean Grilled Steak
ingredients: 1 lb chuck steak | 6 scallions, including tender green tops and greens, thinly sliced | 1 teaspoon ground allspice berry | 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar
instructions: Cut meat into thin slices about 1/4 inch thick and 1 inch long. Combine scallions, allspice and vinegar, rubbing into meat while grilling. Dry meat and grill over hot coals and place on a heated platter. Garnish with scallion greens.

title: Rosemary Rice
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups cooked rice, cold | 2 -3 tablespoons finely chopped fresh rosemary | 1 tablespoon finely chopped of fresh mint
instructions: Cook rice according to the package directions, and keep warm over low heat. Stir in rosemary and mint. Serve immediately. To keep rice soft, rinse well several times.

title: Savory Basil & Ricotta Croutons
ingredients: 1 slice whole wheat bread | milk ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh basil | 1 shallot, minced | 1 package soy gyros-style croutons ( or homemade ) | 1 can evaporated skim milk-free ricotta cheese | 2 teaspoons mirin
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 f. Lightly butter a large baking sheet or line with parchment paper. Cut a slice from the bread into a large dice. Place the bread cubes onto a baking sheet, and sprinkle the croutons and 2 tbs of the basil over and on top of the croutons. Bake 10 minutes, until the croutons are crisp and golden brown. While the croutons are baking, in a mixing bowl, combine the ricotta, milk soyjovies, and mirin. Stir well. When the 10 minutes are up, take the toast from the oven and spread the ricotta mixture onto the toast and top with the remaining basil and croutons.

title: Beef With Noodles and Bread
ingredients: 3/4 cup currants ( optional ) | 2 packages frozen shredded stringless american cheese, divided | 2 eggs | 10 slices dry bread, divided on the half pound ( about 1/2 lb per slice ) | corn oil ( for frying ) | 2 1/2 lbs boneless beef flank steak, cut into 1/2 inch strips ( or use sirloin steak cut into 2 inch long chunks ) | 1 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 cup thawed drained cooked egg noodles
instructions: Soak currants in 1/4 cup of water until softened, about 5 minutes. Drain and set aside. Cut cheese and bread into 1/4 inch cubes. In large bowl, beat eggs, then mix in currants. Coat beef with bread crumbs, then dredge in egg then crumbs. Transfer beef to a plate. Add a few tablespoons of oil to a heavy skillet, then heat to medium/high heat. Saute beef until browned, about 5 minutes. Turn beef, and drain fat. Add nutmeg and drained currants. Cover and cook 10 minutes or until tender. Place over medium heat, stirring and scraping up the bottom with a wooden spoon. Add noodles to tomato sauce and remove from heat. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: ricotta cheese,chili sauce,pork loin roast,pesto sauce,grain rice,strawberry,sake,shallot
title: Pesto Pork Loin With Rice and Strawberries
ingredients: 1 tablespoon prepared pesto sauce | 2 tablespoons prepared low-fat safflower oil or 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil, divided | 3 lbs boneless pork loin roast, fat trimmed | 2 shallots, thinly sliced | 2 cups fresh shucked strawberries | 3/4 cup commercial sweet chili sauce, < a href= '' https : //www.geniuskitchen.com/recipe/sauce-guajillo-39217 '' > guajillo marinade < /a > | 1/2 cup prepared low-fat ricotta cheese or 1/2 cup low-fat cottage cheese | 2 tablespoons prepared low-fat prepared pesto sauce or 2 tablespoons olive oil | hot cooked long-grain rice ( accompaniment )
instructions: To make the meat sauce, combine pesto and 1 tablespoon of the oil in a food processor or blender and process until combined. Brush remaining oil over pork and season with salt and pepper. Marinate in refrigerator, loosely covered, for at least 3 hours or overnight. Combine shallots and remaining 1/2 tablespoon oil and marinade in a large pan and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Reduce heat to medium low and simmer for 7 minutes. Add pork and turn to coat. Stir in strawberries and simmer, covered, for 8 minutes. Remove pork and strawberries from pan and allow to cool until warm. Heat remaining 1 tablespoon of oil in a saucepan over medium heat until hot but not smoking. Serve pork and marinade over rice and top with pesto.

Random Ingredients: roasting chicken,graham cracker crumb,millet,chicken thigh fillet
title: Chicken Millets in Microwave
ingredients: 150 g millet | 2 skinless chicken thigh fillets ( about 200gms ) | 250 g raw rice or 250 g graham cracker crumbs | graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Place millet in medium saucepan. Add 2 pints boiling water. Cover.

title: Apple and Black Bean Dip
ingredients: 5 tart apples, peeled, cored and diced | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 can black beans
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix apples and soup with a spoon or potato masher. Spread mixture in the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish and make a circle to fit in the dish. Bake at 350 degrees f for about 30 minutes, or until the dip is bubbly and apples are soft.

Random Ingredients: mint leaf,lamb kidney,veal cutlet,yellow pea,white bean,corn husk
title: Hasa Seda (Sweet and Sour Soup)
ingredients: 250 g yellow split peas | 250 g lean lamb bones, finely chopped | 150 g lamb kidney, finely chopped | 300 g fresh white beans, chopped ( tinned beans ) | fresh mint leaves, to garnish | 30 cornhusks ( soaked in water for 20 30 minutes )
instructions: Soak peas in plenty of water for 30 minutes & then drain & rinse. Combine in a non stick frying pan with dried kidney beans & meat. Cover & simmer for 40 - 45 mins, stirring occasionally. Add mint & simmer another 5 mins or until beans are cooked. Allow to cool & then process the soup until smooth, if too dry, add a little water. Fold in the white beans. Divide the soup between 4 individual heatproof bowl moulds or bowls or plates & sprinkle top with mint. Serve with grilled cornhusks.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,orange liqueur,cognac,vanilla ice cream,salt pepper
title: Mouton Noir
ingredients: 1 ounce cognac | 1/2 ounce orange liqueur | 1/4 ounce dark rum | 1 pinch salt and pepper | vanilla ice cream
instructions: Mix all the above ingredients in a glass mug and enjoy.

title: Pistachio-Sun-Dried Tomato Spread
ingredients: 1 cup shelled pistachio ( about 3/4 cup ) | 4 tablespoons honey | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained, rinsed and chopped
instructions: Process pistachios in a food processor. Add honey and process 1 minute. Stir in sun dried tomatoes and process until well blended. Transfer to a bowl and refrigerate for 2 hours or overnight. Serve either chilled or at room temperature.

title: Taco Salad with Lime
ingredients: 1 tablespoon minced of fresh garlic or 1 tablespoon dried roasted garlic | 1/4 teaspoon finely grated fresh lemon rind | 2 teaspoons finely chopped shallots | 10 large corn tortilla chips, lightly crushed | iceberg lettuce, for lining bowls | 1 lime, cut into slices
instructions: Combine the garlic, lemon rind and shallots in a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack pepper cheese,beet,red cabbage,vegetable oil cooking spray,irish whiskey,gruyere cheese,beef broth
title: Irish Pub Grilled Beets With Gruyere & Irish Whiskey
ingredients: 1 can beef broth | 8 slices corned beef ( or deli sandwich buns ) | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 ounces thinly sliced gruyere cheese | 2 ounces thinly sliced jamon or 2 ounces monterey jack pepper cheese | 1 cup small dice red cabbage | 1/2 cup irish whiskey
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high. In medium bowl, combine beef broth and beef slices to coat. Arrange beef slices on work surface. Spray surface with nonstick cooking spray. Place 1/2 cup cheese, horseradish/onion/pepper jack cheese and cabbage in a circle in a 1 gallon zipper lock bag. Top with beef slices and secure bag. Reshape bag by putting bag in large bowl with 1/2 cup cheese in bag and using hands gently squeeze bag until cheese is evenly mixed. Place bag in large heatproof serving dish. Arrange beef slices over top of cheese. Pour whiskey over all. Cover with lid or aluminum foil. Place under grill or broiler for 5 - 7 minutes or just until beef is heated through and bottom is slightly crisp on top. Let stand for 5 minutes before serving. Serve with fresh seasonal vegetables.

title: Grasshopper Pie
ingredients: 1 cup yellow cornmeal | 1 cup buttermilk | 2 1/2 cups yellow squash, peeled and diced | 4 -5 large egg yolks | 2 tablespoons brandy | 2 tablespoons chipotle chiles, minced ( i use canned ) | 2 packages ladyfingers, split ( savoiardi, not savoiardi ) | 1/2 cup chipotle sauce or 1/2 cup other hot pepper sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 375ºf. Grease a 10 inch flan pan. Combine cornmeal, buttermilk, squash, egg yolks, brandy, 2 tablespoons chipotle chili, and 1/2 teaspoon salt in a large bowl. Pour filling into prepared pan. Insert a knife along the edge into the center of the pan to trim any air pockets. Bake until custard is set and lightly browned, about 35 minutes. Meanwhile, heat an ovenproof skillet over medium heat. Cook and stir chiles until fragrant and beginning to turn golden, about 30 seconds. Using a slotted spoon, remove from the skillet and set on a plate to cool. Brush chiles with 2 tablespoons oil.

title: Italian Bread II
ingredients: 1 package dry italian-style salad dressing mix | 1 cup walnut oil | 1 cup italian-style salad dressing mix
instructions: Dissolve 1 package of dry Italian style salad dressing mix into 4 cups of water in a large bowl. Pour the walnut oil into a microwave safe glass baking dish. Place the baking dish with the dry salad dressing mixture into the microwave and microwave on high for two minutes. Remove the baking dish from microwave, stir, and serve.

title: Pizza Sauce
ingredients: 1 can condensed tomato sauce ( your choice ) | 1 1/2 cups chopped fresh fruit ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh oregano leaves or 1 teaspoon dried oregano
instructions: In a large skillet, combine tomato sauce, fruit and oregano.

Random Ingredients: dark chocolate,red chili powder,white wine,gnocchi,apple juice,flour tortilla
title: Gnocchi Di Choclo
ingredients: 8 ounces gnocchi ( about 1 1-3/4 cups ) | 1/2 cup apple juice | 1 tablespoon dark chocolate ( not unsweetened ) | 1 tablespoon dry white wine | 1/2 teaspoon red chili powder | 2/3 cup flour tortilla, torn into thirds
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Cook gnocchi in boiling salted water until cooked through. Drain well. Heat apple juice in microwave. Add dark chocolate or semisweet chocolate and white wine. Microwave, uncovered, for 30 seconds or until melted and smooth. Add hot melted chocolate to gnocchi and stir to combine.

title: Cardamom Glaze
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups vinegar, red wine or 1 1/2 cups white wine vinegar | 1/4 cup cardamom pod, crushed | 1 teaspoon juniper berries, crushed
instructions: Combine all of the ingredients in a medium size sauce pan over medium heat. Bring just to boil, reduce heat and simmer slowly, uncovered, for 5 minutes. Pour over desired glaze.

title: Green Chili Powder Dip
ingredients: 4 ounces chopped green chili peppers | 2 1/2 teaspoons onion powder | 2 teaspoons maple syrup
instructions: Preheat your broiler. Open the jar of chili powder and add to a small bowl. Add the chopped onions and green chilies. Mix everything together. Keep in refrigerator for up to 1 week for flavours to meld.

title: Easy Beet Soup
ingredients: 4 cups chopped cooked beets | 3 cups chicken broth
instructions: Place the beets in a saucepan with enough water. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer, covered, 20 minutes. Drain, and set aside to cool. Transfer the beets with their cooking water to a blender. Pour in 1 cup of the chicken broth, and puree until smooth. Return the pureed beets to the skillet, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer, partially covered, 20 minutes, or until the beets are tender.

Random Ingredients: leg lamb,baking soda,cherry tomato,kaffir lime leaf,coriander powder,pork roast,cheese,marsala wine
title: Sharlotka
ingredients: 4 lbs boneless pork roast, cut into 1 1/2 1/2-inch cubes | 4 lbs leg of lamb, cut into 1 1/2-inch squares or 4 lbs goose roasts | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 1 teaspoon kaffir lime leaf, crushed | 4 tablespoons marsala wine | 1 lb cherry tomatoes or 1 lb grape tomatoes | toasted baking soda
instructions: Combine all the spices and spices and marinate the meat for 4 hours or in the refrigerator overnight. Preheat oven to 325°f. Place 2 cups of the stew in a roasting pan. Fill the pan 1/3 full with cold water and bake, covered for 1 hour. Skim any foam from the surface of the stew. Reduce heat to 300°f. Add the remaining 1 cup stew, tomatoes and simmer for 30 minutes or until the meat is tender. Remove the meat and cut into thin slices.

Random Ingredients: cheddar cheese,garlic red chile paste,lemon curd,nonfat yogurt,creamy peanut butter
title: Super Easy Chunky Dip
ingredients: 2 tablespoons creamy peanut butter | 1/2 cup nonfat plain yogurt or 1/2 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1 tablespoon minced garlic and red chile paste ( sambal olek ) | 1 teaspoon lemon curd ( optional ) | 1/4 cup shredded reduced-fat cheddar cheese
instructions: Combine everything in a blender or large bowl. Process until smooth.

Random Ingredients: rotel tomato chilies,spanish onion,cabbage,blue curacao,egg noodle,nutmeg,marshmallow,plain yogurt
title: Breakfast Dream Noodles
ingredients: 1 large spanish onion | 3 cups shredded cabbage | 1 package refrigerated plain yogurt or 2 cups miracle whip | 10 1/2 ounces rotel tomatoes & chilies | 3 1/2 ounces rotel tomato & chilies | 1/2 teaspoon nutmeg | 1/4 cup blue curacao | 1 package egg noodles ( thin or medium as necessary )
instructions: In a medium saucepan put cabbage, onion, rotel tomatoes, rotel tomatoes, nutmeg, blue curacao and cooked noodles. Cook over medium heat until everything is hot and noodles are hot. Stir to mix. Serve.

title: Pepperjack and Chiles Rellenos
ingredients: 6 -12 small dried hot anaheim chilies ( anaheim peppers with the stem and seeds removed ) | 1 -2 teaspoon salt | 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard | 1/8 teaspoon dry crushed red pepper | 8 ounces cream cheese | 1 banana, sliced | pickled mustard
instructions: Remove stems from chiles and discard. Slit chiles in half lengthwise, remove seeds. Set chiles aside.

Random Ingredients: sunflower seed oil,yogurt,chili,velveeta cheese,lukewarm water,tahini,chocolate pudding mix
title: Lucky Leprechaun
ingredients: 1 tablespoon lukewarm water | 2 tablespoons sunflower seed oil | 1 package yogurt | 1 tablespoon tahini | 8 ounces reduced-fat velveeta cheese, cut into bite-sized chunks | 1 tablespoon instant chocolate pudding mix ( add extra as needed to prevent burn ) | 1 -2 dried chili, crushed
instructions: For the lemon curd topping, combine all ingredients in a food processor.

title: Creamy Cucumber Salad for Two
ingredients: 1 lb cucumber, peeled and finely diced | 1/4 cup dark rum | 1/2 cup light corn syrup | 1 pint double cream | 1 ounce whipping cream | pepperoni, slices to garnish
instructions: Place the cucumbers in a large bowl and mash with your hand. Add the rum, corn syrup, half the cream, and pepperoni. Taste for sweetness. Garnish with remaining cream and sliced pepperoni. Serve right away.

title: Cheese and Bacon Appetizer
ingredients: 1 package philadelphia cream cheese, softened | 1 package jarlsberg cheese
instructions: Mix cream cheese and jarlsberg cheese together in a bowl until well blended. If using a stick blender, place 1/3 to 1/4 of the cream cheese mixture on a piece of wax paper. Place some bacon on top of the cream cheese mixture. Roll the cream cheese into a log about 2 inches in diameter so it will stick slightly to the blade. Using a sharp knife, slice into thin cylinders. Spread the bacon around the cheese. Cut into 1 to 1 1/2 inch pieces as needed to allow for keeping cheese sticks from sticking out. Allow to sit for 5 minutes per side to dry out. Refrigerate until cold, several hours or overnight.

title: Chilli Queso Cheese Triangles
ingredients: 2 1/2 ounces fresh chilies, chopped finely | 2 ounces cheese, grated, pref. mozzarella | 1 package phyllo pastry, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Saute chiles with chopped cheese until cheese is light golden brown. Cut 1 sheet of thawed phyllo dough by cutting it into 2 circles about 3/8 inch x 3 inches.
