Brush each of 6 phyllo sheets with melted butter or oil, then place a sixth of the cheese mixture in center. Fold the corners over the filling and seal them with your hands. Lay a second sheet on top and brush with butter or oil. Continue with next sheet and the next sheet until you have 9 layers. Lay 2 more layers of phyllo dough on top and brush with melted butter or oil. Layer 4 times, then top with remaining phyllo. Wrap in wax paper and let it rise for 30 minutes. Heat frying pan to medium high and add enough oil or ghee to coat the bottom. When oil is hot, fry each queso until golden brown on both sides and crispy on the outside but not burnt in the center, about 3 - 5 minutes. Remove from oil and drain on paper towels. Serve immediately. Makes approximately 25 triangles.

Random Ingredients: mango,cremini mushroom,orange flower water,broccolini,tangerine,salt,ginger garlic paste,pistachio pudding mix
title: Chinese Mushrooms With Tangerine Cream
ingredients: 12 -16 cremini mushrooms, sliced ( the baby ones ) | 2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 6 ounces tangerines, thinly sliced ( use a food processor or use a mortar and pestle to grind up the tangerines ) | 1/4 cup orange flower water | 1/3 cup pistachio pudding mix | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 12 -16 ounces broccolini, chopped ( optional ) | 1/2 cup unsalted shelled pistachios ( optional ) or 1/2 cup other nuts ( optional )
instructions: Heat oil in large skillet over med high heat. Add mushrooms and ginger garlic paste.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,green pepper,nigella seed,anaheim chilies,icing sugar
title: Nigella's Chilies Con Queso
ingredients: 8 tablespoons unsalted icing sugar | 1 small anaheim chilies, seeded and chopped ( or any mild to hot green pepper ) | 1 green pepper, chopped | 1/2 of 1 cup nigella seeds | 8 ounces monterey jack cheese, grated and mixed with remaining filling ingredients
instructions: Using a blender or food processor, puree chilies and green pepper until smooth. Mixture should be a fine texture, but not too runny. Pour mixture into a bowl.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning,chili pepper flake,salt pork,purpose flour,lime
title: Mexican Style Baked Salt Pork
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin tip steaks ( fat trimmed ) | 1 package taco seasoning ( mild or hot ) | 4 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1 lime | 2 teaspoons chili pepper flakes | salt
instructions: Make meatballs using 1 tablespoon of taco seasoning and 1 tablespoon of flour and place in a plastic bag with 1 tsp of chili sauce and seal. Mix well with your hands until meat is well coated. Add rest of the taco seasoning, 2 tablespoons of flour and mix well. Place in oiled 9x13 baking dish and bake at 400 for 20 minutes, flipping a couple of times. While they are baking, slice the lime. You want the lime slices to be thin so they won't fall apart while baking. Mix the remaining 2 tablespoons of flour with water and add to meatball mixture. Bring to a boil and simmer for 10 minutes. Remove from ovens and toss with your favorite mexican meal and enjoy.

title: Diet Friendly Tuna and Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cucumber, very thinly sliced | 2 cups low fat curds | 1/2 teaspoon taco seasoning ( or to taste ) | 8 ounces red lentils | 2 tablespoons kahlua ( or to taste )
instructions: Gently combine all ingredients in a bowl. Chill for 20 minutes. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: pine nut,corn flake,taco sauce,salt black pepper,vegetable oil corn,mint leaf
title: Crispy Pine Nut Nachos
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil ( or corn oil ) | 1 cup pine nuts, toasted | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1/2 cup sweet taco sauce | 1/4 cup crushed corn flakes | 1/2 cup fresh mint leaves, torn into 1-inch pieces
instructions: Warm the oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add the pine nuts, season with salt and pepper, and cook, stirring constantly, 1 minute. Add the taco sauce and cornflakes and cook, stirring constantly, 1 minute longer. Add the mint, toss well, and continue to cook until the nachos have just become fragrant, 3 to 4 minutes.

title: Black Olive Soup
ingredients: 14 ounces pitted black olives | 5 ounces vegetable stock ( homemade or canned )
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a saucepan and bring to the boil gently. Lift the lid and simmer very gently for 20 minutes. If this soup is too thick, add the vegetable stock. Serve immediately.

title: Crispy Fingers
ingredients: 2 cups elbow macaroni | 4 1/2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 cup dry bread crumbs, seasoned
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook elbow macaroni in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 5 minutes. Drain and set aside. Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Stir in the bread crumbs, and coat the outsides of the cookie fingers with the crumbs. Fry in the oil until well browned and crisp, 2 to 3 minutes.

title: Hot Cheese With Chilean Seasoning
ingredients: 8 ounces sharp cheddar cheese | chili pepper flakes | spices
instructions: Cut the block of cheese into four squares. Place each square of cheese into a plastic bag, season with chili flakes or ground achiote powder. Squeeze out the air.

title: Puerto Rico Artichoke Peas
ingredients: 1 package frozen artichoke hearts, thawed and chopped ( optional ) | 3/4 cup unsalted butter-flavored pea | 1/2 cup ice water | 1/2 cup tarama, crumbled
instructions: Bring ice water and peas to a boil in a 2 quart saucepan on the stove. Reduce heat to medium low and cook, covered, for 5 minutes. Remove the pan from the heat.

Random Ingredients: head iceberg lettuce,wheat flour,dark corn syrup,blueberry,chili bean sauce,sun tomato,brown sugar
title: Heavenly Wheat Slice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups red whole wheat flour or 1 1/2 cups gluten-free whole wheat flour | 1/4 cup brown sugar | 1/3 cup sun-dried tomato, chopped | 1/2 cup low sodium chili bean sauce | 1/3 cup dark corn syrup | 1/3 cup blueberries | 1 large head iceberg lettuce, shredded
instructions: Mix flour, sugar, sun dried tomatoes, and chili bean sauce in medium bowl. Stir in corn syrup. Spread dough into lightly greased rectangle on large baking sheet. Sprinkle blueberries over top, then arrange lettuce over blueberries. Press half of dough into greased 9 inch square glass pan. Press remaining dough on top of berries, and spread with remaining blueberries, spreading with blueberry mixture. Sprinkle with sugar. Refrigerate 30 minutes minimum, or up to 4 hours. Cut into squares.

Random Ingredients: oyster,jalapeno chile,artificial sweetener,seasoning salt,water chestnut,green pepper
title: Easy Oesters Oyster Shooters
ingredients: 2 tablespoons fish sauce ( natto ) | 2 tablespoons artificial sweetener | 1 tablespoon jalapeno chile, minced | 1/2 cup fresh green pepper, chopped | 1 can water chestnuts, drained and finely chopped | 1 pinch seasoning salt
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl, and set aside. Remove skin from green peppers.

title: Crispy Salmon Barbecue
ingredients: 5 lbs salmon, skinned and cleaned | canola oil
instructions: Take the salmon out of the refrigerator for 20 minutes prior to making the barbecue. Place the canola oil in a pan to heat. Remove the salmon skin from the bones and cut into small pieces like chips. Put the salmon in the pan. Let the salmon brown on top. Serve with your favorite bbq sauce and vegetables.

title: Sauce-Smoked Turkey Breast
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs turkey ( with or without inside ) | 2 tablespoons cajun seasoning ( a-1 ) | 2 tablespoons mild wild mushrooms
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Rub all over the outside of the body of your turkey. Rub the outside of the turkey with a mix of cajun seasoning, wild mushrooms, and sweet green onions for a nice brown color, although the turkey will look very different if it is not fully coated. Put turkey on a rack in a roasting pan and set in the oven. Bake the turkey for 4 to 5 hours, or until done. Serve the turkey directly from the pan. Goes well with mashed potatoes.

title: Sarasota's Greek Shrimp Pizza
ingredients: 1 lb pizza dough | 1 large shrimp, peeled, deveined, and halved | 1 1/2 lbs pizza crusts | 1 1/2 lbs beef ribs, cut into bite size pieces | 1 cup fresh spinach, washed and chopped | 1 cup kalamata olive, pitted, sliced
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. Roll out the pizza dough into two 8 inch round pieces. Brush one side of each round with oil. Bake for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, prepare the meat, and when the pizzas are done, mix both the shrimp and the ribs in a bowl. Divide and lay the spinach on top of the crust. Lay the shrimp and ribs overtop of the spinach. Cover with the cheese. Bake for 12 minutes and let rest about 5 minutes before slicing.

title: Roasted Cherry Tomato Jam
ingredients: 1 lb soft cherry tomatoes | thyme ( to taste )
instructions: Place the tomatoes on a baking tray and roast in a hot oven for 1 to 1½ hours on a low heat. You should be tempted to add boiling water to stop the tomatoes from burning. Once a couple of hours pass the juices through a cloth or kitchen cloth and discard the solids. The tomatoes will look as if they have been soggy and swollen. Remove the tomatoes from the oven and place in a clean towel, rub out the skin and crush the pulp with your hands. Place the cherry tomatoes in a dry pot and add half of the dried thyme. Cover with water and bring to the boil, simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Ladle the juices into a clean pan and bring to the boil, skim off any scum from the surface. Cook for a further 10 to 15 minutes and check that the juices have reduced and the consistency of jam is just right. Remove from the heat and leave to stand for 10 minutes. Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: turmeric,self rising flour,caster sugar,sun tomato oil,herb,white onion,rye bread
title: Wild Mushroom & Onion Mini Muffins
ingredients: 1 small white onion, grated | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained well ( not oil packed ) | 2 1/2 cups self rising flour | 1/3 cup caster sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons turmeric | 1 teaspoon dried herbs | 1 1/4 cups rye bread, crumbs
instructions: Preheat the oven to gas mark 6, 180c or mark 7. Mix the onion, sun dried tomato and 1/2 cup of the flour, stir into the onion/tomato mix until well blended. Place mixture into a well greased 18 x 12 tin. Combine the sugar, spices and remaining 1 1/2 cups of flour in a bowl. Using your hands, mix together well. Add the breadcrumbs, knead to combine and press into 12 recesses in the muffin pan. Bake on middle rack for about 30 minutes or until well risen & golden brown.

title: Super Beef Burgers
ingredients: 1 can beef stew meat | 3 cups vegetable broth | shredded iceberg lettuce
instructions: Open all ingredients and place in a slow cooker. Wrap each beef piece with a lettuce leaf and secure with toothpicks. Cook for 4 hours on high.

title: Miso Ramen II
ingredients: 1 package ramen noodles | 1/2 cup mushroom, cut-up | 1 serrano pepper, halved
instructions: Separate dried noodles so they stick together better. Rinse noodles and put in a bowl. Add mushrooms, peppers and seasoning packet. Mix with hands. Let stand 20 minutes. Put in refrigerator 30 minutes before serving.

title: Spicy Crockpot Bread (Ww)
ingredients: 5 cups shredded cabbage leaves ( about 2 large heads ) | 4 cups shredded cooked chickpeas ( about 6 ounces can ) | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 1 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast ( regular size packet or equivalent ) | 2 teaspoons instant dry active dry yeast | 1 cup unsweetened cocoa, sifted | 1 tablespoon imitation horseradish or 1 tablespoon prepared horseradish | 2 cups bread, loafs ( not bread or muffin mix ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons real vanilla extract | 1/2 cup mild hot sauce, such as tabasco
instructions: For the shredded cabbage,. Arrange the cabbage ingredients in a large mixing bowl.

Random Ingredients: pumpkin pie spice,dark soy sauce,cheese,heavy cream,red chilies,onion powder
title: Pumpkin Queso Sauce
ingredients: 5 fresh red chilies, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon pumpkin pie spice | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1/2 cup heavy cream ( low-fat is okay, i used 2 % ) | 1 cup mild cheese
instructions: Mix chillies ingredients together. Pour cream into blender, cover and blend until smooth, about 30 seconds. Blend again for 1 minute to remove seeds. Transfer to bowl and fold in cheese. Keeps, refrigerated, for up to 4 days.

title: Chiles on an Irish Boiled Quiche
ingredients: 1 pastry for a double-crust deep-filer double crust pie | 6 dried arbol chiles
instructions: Place a double crust pie pastry or half pie crust into each individual ramekin and fill with chiles. Pour in enough water to come halfway up the sides of the pie crust, about 2/3 full. Cover and heat in a 375 degree f oven for 30 minutes. When ready to serve, sprinkle with additional chiles and serve with the pie.

title: Oubergine and Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 10 asparagus, trimmed and cut into 5cm lengths | 1 aubergine, ends trimmed and thinly sliced | 100 g sliced green bell peppers | 4 cups vegetable stock
instructions: Put the asparagus, aubergine and peppers into a pan of lightly salted boiling water. Cook for about 20 minutes to soften the vegetables. Drain vegetables. Bring the vegetable stock back to the boil. Add the vegetables and return to a simmer. Cook for about 5 minutes or until the vegetables are tender and the soup is thick. Season with salt and pepper then serve.

title: Crispy Cucumber Beer Dip
ingredients: 1 bag thin sliced cucumbers | 1/2 cup chunky salsa | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1/2 cup beer | 1/4 cup guacamole
instructions: Mix salsa, bouillon, beer, and guacamole. Refrigerate for 2 hours. Serve with tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: butterscotch chip,red grapefruit,coriander,extra virgin olive oil,green chili pepper
title: Chilled Grapefruit Salad
ingredients: 1 small red grapesfruit | 8 ounces unsalted buttercotch chips | 1 large green chili pepper, seeded and chopped | 2 tablespoons chopped coriander, plus extra to serve | 4 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Cut the grapesfruit in half lenghtwise, then segmente using a vegetable peeler and cut a slit. Cut the flesh crosswise into 4 x 2 cm / 3 inch thick slices, leaving the skin between the slices. Cut the chips into strips across the grain, then transfer to a mixing bowl and mash until smooth. Add the chilie, coriander and half the olive oil, and stir to combine. Taste and adjust seasoning. Drizzle over the remaining oil and scatter remaining coriander over. Refrigerate for up to 4 hours to develop flavours, and then serve from the bowl with the cheese.

title: Polish Mushroom and Crispy Smoked Sausage
ingredients: 1 can sliced mushroom pieces, drained | 1 lb smoked sausage, sliced | 3 packages kielbasa, sliced and cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 pint fresh horseradish sauce | 1 cup rye flour, not fine
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. In a dutch oven or deep skillet over medium high heat add sausages, mushrooms, horseradish and kielbasa cook for 5 minutes on each side.

Random Ingredients: snow pea,oyster sauce,mexican cheese,baby carrot,canola oil
title: Easy Snow Peas and Carrots
ingredients: 1 lb snow peas | 1/2 teaspoon canola oil | 1 lb baby carrots | 1 1/2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 package mexican cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Spray a 9 inch square baking dish w/nonstick cooking spray. Add 1/4 c oil and sliced carrots to baking pan in a single layer. Cut snow peas diagonally into 2 inch pieces.

title: Potato Curry Camembert
ingredients: 1 russet potato | 1/2 cup corn oil | fresh chives, chopped | 1 tablespoon curry | 1 tablespoon fresh chives, chopped | 1 tablespoon camembert cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees. Scrub or peel the potato. Cut the potato into 1/4 thick slices and place in a large mixing bowl. Fill a pot with salted water and bring to a boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, add the potato slices, a few at a time, and return to a boil. Cook until tender, about 5 minutes. Drain, allow to cool, and then cut into thin wedges. Heat the oil over medium heat. Sprinkle the curry and chives onto the potatoes and stir to coat evenly. Transfer to a baking dish, and top with the camembert cheese. Bake for 10 minutes, until hot and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: sirloin,onion,plain nonfat yogurt,stilton cheese,salt,zucchini,cider vinegar,chicken leg
title: Steak and Zucchini Salad With Stilton Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb boneless chicken leg, skinless, boneless | 1 lb zucchini, cut into 3/4-inch slices | 2 cups plain nonfat yogurt | 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 1/2 cup finely chopped onion | 1 teaspoon salt | 1/2 cup crumbled stilton cheese
instructions: Toss together chicken legs, zucchini and yogurt. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over salad.

title: Roasted Vegetables
ingredients: 1 package small cabbage leaves | olive oil or canola oil ( for frying )
instructions: Line a roasting pan with a couple of slices of cabbage leaf. Drain any excess liquid from the cabbage leaves. Place the cabbages on the cabbage leaves. Drizzle with olive or canola oil. Broil or bake in a 425f oven until the tops are crispy and the vegetables are golden brown.

title: Mosaic Chocolate
ingredients: 1 cup chocolate chips | 2 cups dried apricots | 2 tablespoons lemon juice
instructions: Place the chocolate chips in a bowl and cover with water. Let stand for 20 minutes. Drain and chop finely. Place in a bowl with the chopped apricots, lemon juice and chocolate chips, stirring until well combined. Serve.

title: Homemade Maple Chips (Nua Saw-Sow)
ingredients: 1 cup pure maple syrup | 1/4 cup fish sauce
instructions: Combine the maple syrup and fish sauce in a small bowl. Set aside. Place the chip into a deep, dry skillet or a wok. Stir to coat the chips with the maple syrup and fish sauce. Over medium high heat bring to a simmer. Place the chips into the hot maple mixture to coat completely. Cook, stirring constantly with a wooden spoon, until crisp golden brown, about 3 minutes.

title: Halloween Guacamole Noodles
ingredients: 1 box medium or curly egg noodles | 1 roma tomato | 1 bag guacamole
instructions: Preheat the oven 375 degrees f. Line a large baking tray with parchment paper with foil and grease with a thin layer of olive oil. Slice the roma tomato in half and remove the seeds and pulp. Then roughly dice it into 1/2 inch wide and 1/2 inch pieces. In a medium bowl. Pour 1/4 cup of olive oil into a small frying pan on medium high setting. When hot, immediately place the drained noodles into the frying pan and stir to coat the bottom. When the noodles start to look toasty, quickly remove the noodles from the pan and place them onto paper towels to remove all of the starch. Continue with the other two steps until all of the noodles fit into the pan. Put the baking tray in the oven and immediately after removing the foil, lay the egg noodles out into the oven. When the oven has reached 375 degrees f remove the bowl with the noodles and immediately dump the contents of the bowl and onto another clean baking tray. When it is almost fully baked, turn off the oven and immediately remove the bowl and from the oven. Remove the baking tray from the oven, and immediately dump the contents of the bowl into the oven and on top of the noodles. Put the door to the oven as hot as it will go into the oven, and immediately place the baking tray back into the preheated oven. Turn the oven off and leave the door closed. Place the package on a large oven tray, and immediately after removing the door open, place in the oven. Open the oven door slightly and turn the temperature on to 350 degrees f. Bake for 7 to 9 minutes depending on how crisp or brown the edges are. It depends on your oven, how many bowls you had laying the noodles inches if you had an opening of around 10 minutes it may take 8 to 10 minutes. Remove the package from the oven and onto your individual plates. Garnish with a squeeze of lime juice and enjoy a taste.

Random Ingredients: grain rice,egg,self rising flour,baby spinach leaf,cocoa
title: Spinach Mini Chocolate Muffins
ingredients: 1 cup long grain rice | 1/2 cup self-rising flour | 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa | 4 eggs, lightly beaten | 2 cups baby spinach leaves, cleaned and well drained ( or spinach )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f & butter muffin tins. Combine 1 cup plus 1/4 cup water, rice, flour and cocoa in a bowl. Stir in eggs slightly & set aside. Stir remaining 1/2 cup plus 1/4 cup water into rice mixture just till moistened. Spoon mixture into prepared muffin tins & bake until golden, about 30 minutes. Cool on racks for 5 minutes, then turn out onto rack. Can be topped with chocolate sauce, drizzle with extra virgin olive oil & chopped pistachios if desired. Enjoy.

title: Spicy Steak and Beans
ingredients: 3 rib eye steaks | 1 can baked beans | 1 can kidney beans
instructions: Place steaks in a baking dish. Cover with beans, top with baking dish and bake at 350 degrees for 20 minutes or until desired doneness is reached.

Random Ingredients: nutmeg,onion soup mix,granny smith apple,lasagna noodle
title: Lazy Lasagna
ingredients: 1 onion soup mix, divided | 8 ounces shredded granny smith apples | 3 ounces dry lasagna noodles | 1 pinch ground nutmeg
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Combine 1 soup mix, apple, and nutmeg in a deep casserole dish. Place three noodles over the top, and then cover with the remaining soup mix. Cover and bake 1 hour in the preheated oven, or until hot and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: grain rice,mango chutney,hamburger,cucumber,green bean,irish cream,thyme leaf,meat
title: Spiced Smoked Sausage
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 2 cups cooked long-grain rice | 1 can green beans | 1 cup cubed cucumber | 1/4 cup irish cream or 1/4 cup plain yogurt | 2 tablespoons mango chutney or 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 2 tablespoons thyme leaves | 4 slices honey-roasted hamburger ( to garnish ) ( optional ) | diced ham ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: In large skillet, brown hamburger over medium heat. Drain off any excess fat. Stir in rice, green beans and cucumber. Stir in remaining filling ingredient. Spoon stuffing into center of warmed sausage. Surround with hareeshe, if desired. Place over medium heat until hot.

Random Ingredients: orange bell pepper,toast bread,beef stew meat,penne pasta,vanilla,apple juice
title: Beef Orzo With Bell Peppers
ingredients: 1 orange bell pepper, thinly sliced | 1 lb beef stew meat, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1/2 cup apple juice | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla | 1 package penne pasta | 1 loaf toasted bread, crust removed, cut into wedges, and then sliced into wedges
instructions: In a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat, saute the bell pepper and beef. Mix in the applesauce and vanilla. Bring to a boil.

title: Chocolate Steak Rollups
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sirloin, cut into strips ( or any thin cut steak of beef cut into strips, or more of meat ) | 8 ounces chocolate ripple biscuits ( regular size ) | 1 can beef broth
instructions: Heat beef broth in heavy saucepan until boiling, stir in biscuit crumbs. Boil for 2 minutes, remove from heat. Pierce with a fork all over in 1 long strips. Set aside. Heat oven to 375 degrees. Line a cookie sheet with parchment or waxed paper. Place beef strips in a single layer in a large shallow glass baking dish. Pour boiling broth over, then bake for 15 to 20 minutes until beef is tender, not browned. Serve beef on a bed of biscuit crumbs.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,mandarin orange segment,oyster sauce,curry,currant
title: Mandarin Nuts in Curry (Gai Pad Gai)
ingredients: 4 mandarin orange segments | 1 cup currants or 1 cup raisins | 1 tablespoon curry | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce ( optional )
instructions: Add all ingredients to a skillet & heat through. Serve over rice.

title: Greek-Style Mahi Mahi
ingredients: 1/2 pound mahi mahi fillet | 1 pinch fennel seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place mahi mahi fillet in a large dish, and sprinkle with fennel seeds. Pour about 1 inch of water into the dish, and lightly coat the mahi fillet with the fennel seeds. Cover, and refrigerate overnight, turning to coat. Bring to room temperature, and bake in preheated oven until fish flakes easily with a fork, about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: celery,monterey jack cheese,brown onion,vegemite,splenda granular,plain yogurt,liquid smoke flavoring
title: Vegemite Stuffed Onions
ingredients: 16 ounces plain low-fat yogurt | 2 tablespoons smart balance light | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke flavoring | 2 medium brown onions | 1/2 cup celery, chopped ( or chives ) | 1/2 teaspoon splenda granular | 1/2 cup monterey jack cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f in a medium bowl stir together yogurt, splenda and liquid smoke. Core the tops off of the onions. Reserve the tops. Combine onions and celery in a large bowl. Spoon approximately 1/2 cup yogurt mixture into bottom of a 13x9x2 inch glass baking dish. Top with approximately 1/2 of the onions and celery. Spoon remaining yogurt mixture into onions and sprinkle with cheese. Bake for approximately 30 minutes or until desired tenderness is achieved. Remove from oven and let sit 5 - 10 minutes before slicing.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,lemon juice,salsa,tuna water,sage,wheat bran,pinto bean,red cabbage
title: Tuna and Bean Soup
ingredients: 1 can tuna in water, drained | 1 can pinto beans, drained | 1/4 cup red cabbage, shredded or small pieces | 1 1/2 cups warm salsa ( sweet ) | 4 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 1/4 teaspoon sage, dried | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 teaspoon wheat bran ( optional )
instructions: Combine the undrained tuna, beans, cabbage, salsa, lemon juice, sage and bouillon in a soup pot. Bring to a boil. Reduce the heat and simmer until the tuna is heated through, about 5 minutes.

title: Polish Rub
ingredients: 3 oranges | 3 tablespoons mace
instructions: Wash peel and cut into fine julienne. Squeeze juice from 3 to 4 oranges into a small plastic bag, using the flat tip of a teaspoon. If your bag does not have a lid, you may need to squeeze a little juice into it. If you want to do this, just rub the peel with your fingers as quickly as possible. Rub this mixture into the fruit. Wrap the bag with plastic wrap, place in freezer, and leave to sit for no less than 3 hours. After 5 hours, preheat the grill to medium high. If you have a gas grill, line it with metal foil, and place a heavy cast iron griddle or griddle over the top of your grill. You don’t have to place in the oven, just put the grill lid onto the grill and place in oven. Remove from oven and sprinkle the rub with mace. Let cool for a few minutes and rub off the mace. Cut into wedges and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: ketchup,jalapeno,extra sharp cheddar cheese,splenda sugar substitute,cilantro,swede,active yeast,banana
title: Jamaican Stuffed Chard
ingredients: 2 bananas | 8 stalks cored swedes ( i use turnip each ) | 1 cup ketchup | 3 teaspoons splenda sugar substitute | 2 teaspoons dry active yeast | 12 leaves fresh cilantro | 3 tablespoons extra-sharp cheddar cheese | 1 jalapeno ( optional )
instructions: Slit the tops off three or four chard stalks. Cut the stalks apart lengthwise and scrape out the soft center. In a large bowl, mash the bananas and wisk in all but the cilatro. Add the remaining ingredients and mix well, but do not mix well. Stuff the chard loosely with the batter, packing it tightly. Place the stuffed chard on a lightly oiled cookie sheet, cover, and let rise for 45 minutes to 1 hour, until it doubled in size. Brush the top with water and cook in a hot oven set at 400 degrees for about 15 minutes, or until it is cooked through and the tops are crisp and beginning to brown. Watch chard carefully.

Random Ingredients: garlic granule,sunflower oil,cream chicken soup,salsa,yogurt,red capsicum,french dressing
title: Pancakes With Creamy Salsa
ingredients: 1 cup light sour cream ( low fat is fine ) | 1/2 cup cream of chicken soup | 1/4 cup french dressing ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon bottled garlic granules ( or to taste ) | 1 teaspoon sunflower oil | 1 -2 teaspoon salsa ( to taste ) | 2 tablespoons of chopped red capsicums ( to garnish )
instructions: Whisk together first seven ingredients until well combined and chill for an hour. Before cooking, place the saucepan with the remaining ingredients over low heat. Cook for 20 minutes or until the pancake mixture is piping hot. Serve with lettuce, tomatoe, salsa and fresh grated cheddar cheese.

Random Ingredients: tarragon,butternut squash,almond extract,french baguette,head baby bok choy
title: Tarragon Butternut French Toast
ingredients: 8 ounces butternut squash, halved and sliced 1/4 thick | 1/2 bunch french baguette, cut diagonally into 1/4-inch thick slices | 1 tablespoon butter | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 2 teaspoons tarragon
instructions: Pour 1 cup of water into a large skillet and add peeled squash chunks. Cover and steam until squash is very tender, 15 to 20 minutes. Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Butter a 2 quart baking dish and arrange bread slices in a single layer on baking dish. Top bread with 1/2 cup water and 1/2 teaspoon almond extract. Cover and bake, stirring every 5 minutes, until crust is golden, 10 to 15 minutes. Sprinkle on tarragon with remaining teaspoon almond extract and serve.

title: Spanish Chicken
ingredients: 8 medium chicken thighs | 6 tablespoons chorizo sausage, sliced ( spanish sausage is available at middle eastern markets )
instructions: Season chicken with salt and pepper if desired. In large skillet or dutch oven, cook sausages until lightly browned. Add chicken.

title: Batter, Flour Crackers, Bread Machine
ingredients: 8 ounces white flour or 8 ounces whole wheat flour | 2 tablespoons lime juice
instructions: Place flour in the bowl of a standard bread machine. Add lime juice.

title: Grilled Sea Bass with Mushroom and Garlic
ingredients: 1 pound sea bass | sea salt to taste | 1 jar button mushrooms, drained | 2 tablespoons mirin
instructions: Preheat grill for high heat. Rub sea bass with sea salt on both sides. Cut each long side of sea bass into 6 - 1 inch pieces. Set strips aside. Place mushrooms in a bowl with enough water to cover. Soak for 5 minutes. Drain and rinse with cold water. Drain mushrooms. In a small saucepan set over medium heat, combine mirin and mushrooms. When warm, remove from heat and add fish. Spoon mushrooms onto grilled sea bass. Serve.

Random Ingredients: almond,green cardamom,mini chocolate chip,cauliflower floret,sun tomato oil
title: Almond Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 small cauliflower floret | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 3/4 cup mini chocolate chips | 1/4 teaspoon green cardamoms, crushed | 1/2 cup whole almonds, ground
instructions: Steam cauliflower for about 3 - 5 minutes until just barely tender. In a saucepan over medium heat, heat the tomatoes and the oil until water dries up. Take care not to burn tomatoes. Mix in the crushed cardamom and almonds to the cauliflower. Pour the sauce over the cauliflower. Cook for 3 - 5 minutes until lightly thickened.

title: Spicy Indian Spiced Apple Dip
ingredients: 1 cup milk | 2 tablespoons apple cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh coriander, or more to taste | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro stems | 1/4 cup chopped pistachios, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Whisk milk, vinegar, coriander, cilantro, and pistachios in a small saucepan together until combined. Bring to a boil.

title: Sausage and Mushrooms With Prunes, Swiss Cheese, and Provolone Cheese
ingredients: 5 lbs sweet italian sausage | 1 lb prune | 4 cups grated swiss cheese | 4 cups grated cotija cheese | 12 dried shiitake mushrooms
instructions: Slice the sausage into 1/4 1/2 inch thick slices. Wipe the skillet dry with a paper towel. Brown the sausage over medium. Turn over and brown the other side. Combine all of the ingredients in a large bowl. Top with the sausage slices and serve at once.

title: Mexican Broccoli Cheese Dip
ingredients: 3 shallots, diced | 1 cup broccoli floret, chopped | 1/2 cup canned diced tomatoes with juice | 3 serrano chilies, minced | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/2 teaspoon dried basil | 2 cups shredded american cheese
instructions: Preheat broiler. In a medium bowl, mix shallots, broccoli, tomatoes with juice, chiles, oregano, and basil. Spoon mixture into baking dish. Top with cheese. Broil 8 to 10 minutes or until cheese is melted.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,fruit cocktail,italian turkey sausage,yeast,chinese cabbage
title: Asian Turkey Sausage Salad
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs sweet italian turkey sausage | 2 large yellow bell peppers, very finely julienned ( or a combination ) | 1 can fruit cocktail, drained ( the fruit cocktail should be the cherry hearts from asian specialty stores. don't use cocktail hearts ) | 1 lb fresh chinese cabbage, finely julienned ( or other leafy green cabbage, finely julienned ) | 1 ounce fresh yeast, dissolved in 1 teaspoon of cold water
instructions: If using the sausage links, first slice them into about 1/8 inch rounds and then cut them into 1/4 inch wide slices. Put half of the sausage slices, cut sides up, into a large bowl. Add the other half of the sausage slices and cut them into slices. Add the red peppers and mix the slices with the sausage. Wash and dry the cabbage leaves, removing the outer leaves from the head. Sprinkle them with salt. Dissolve the dissolved yeast in the cold water and add to the bowl. Mix thoroughly. Cover and let rise in a warm place for about 1 1/2 hours, or until tripled in bulk. Preheat the oven to 375°f. Bake, uncovered, for about 40 to 45 minutes or until the sausage is no longer pink and the cabbage is crisp tender.

title: Fruit and Beef Stew
ingredients: 3 lbs stewing beef, cut in 1-inch cubes | 2 tablespoons margarine | 1 cup diced dark rum ( or other type ) | 2 large golden delicious apples, peeled and diced | 1 cup buttermilk ( or sour cream ) | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram ( or marjoram powder ) | 1/2 teaspoon clove | 1/2 teaspoon marjoram powder ( or marjoram powder ) | pumpkin, diced and mashed ( optional )
instructions: Brown meat, onion, and butter in skillet. Add other spices. Cook for 30 minutes. Serve over rice or with potatoes.

Random Ingredients: creole seasoning,beef gravy,tart apple,apricot,chunky peanut butter,pea
title: Easy Appetizer Stack
ingredients: 1 can beef gravy | 1 1/2 cups chunky peanut butter | 2 tablespoons creole seasoning ( or equivalent ) | 1 can peas, drained with juice | 1 tart apple, cored and thinly sliced | 1 medium tart apple, cored and thinly sliced ( we used a 6-7-inch tart apple )
instructions: Combine gravy, peanut butter, and creole seasoning in a bowl and beat until smooth. Fold in cooked peas, thinly sliced apples, and sliced tart apple. Pour into a glass 9x13 inch pan and chill.

Random Ingredients: quinoa,cumin powder,flour tortilla,self raising flour,whipping cream,tomato puree
title: Overnight Tomato Romesco (Mexican Quinoa Burritos)
ingredients: 1 cup of uncooked quinoa ( the short grain ) | 1 cup self-raising flour | 12 flour tortillas, soft ( corn meal size ) | 0.5 can tomato puree ( or other tomato puree ) | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/2 cup whipping cream
instructions: Rinse the quinoa well with water. You will find it boiling as it heats to make the water easier to stir and plump up. Set aside. Rinse the flour tortillas and cut them into thin strips. Mix the flour, cumin and cream in a bowl. In a saucepan add the quinoa, tomatoe puree and bring to boil. Lower heat and simmer to blend flavors. Place the strips of tortillas in a bowl and pour sauce over and stir to coat well. Spoon the romesco into a casserole dish and place in the oven to warm through, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper,allspice,watercress leaf,fenugreek leaf,pork shoulder roast,oil choice,pecorino romano cheese,lemon juice
title: Pork Sicilian Style
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs spanish smoked pork shoulder roast | 1 tablespoon freshly squeezed lemon juice | 2 tablespoons oil, preferably greek vegetable oil | 2 teaspoons cayenne pepper, to taste | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried fenugreek leaves, or to taste | 1 1/2 teaspoons allspice, or to taste | 1/2 cup roughly chopped watercress leaf | 1/2 cup freshly grated pecorino romano cheese ( about 2 ounces )
instructions: Place the pork roast in a large oven safe dish and pour in the lemon juice and oil. Sprinkle on the cayenne, fenugreek and allspice. Roast in a preheated 375 degree f oven until the meat is golden brown and the juices run clear, about 2 hours, turning over after 30 minutes. Cover loosely with aluminum foil while preparing the Sicilian watercress salad. When the roast is finished cooking, remove it from the oven and slice very thinly across the grain, against the grain. You may have to do this with a mandolin slicer or even a large knife. It can be done in batches if the meat is so thinly sliced. Set the sliced meat on a platter and pour the juices into a glass measuring cup. Refrigerate until ready to use. Before serving, remove the plastic and season again with the lemon juice. Serve with the watercress salad.

title: Quick Shaping Beef
ingredients: 1 cup grape leaves, washed, dried, and dried according to package directions | 3 pounds beef shank
instructions: Spread some grape leaves down the center of a large piece of cheesecloth. Roll out one side of the cheesecloth up, and pinch the seams well. Repeat this until all of the grape leaves have been used. Reserve a portion of the grape leaves to use a garnish later. Place the beef shank at the top of each sheet of shank, and tie the bundle shut with kitchen twine. Place the filled grape leaves in a large pot with 2 quarts of water. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to medium, and simmer for 2 hours, or until meat is tender and shank easily pulls apart. Allow 1 to 2 hours cooking time per pound of beef. Remove the beef from the pot and set aside, reserving the cooking liquid, and set aside. When the pork is fork tender, remove from the stock and shred into small pieces. Return the meat pieces to the stock.

title: Faux Harees (Cashew-Shrimp Balls)
ingredients: 100 g meat ( minced small ) | 100 g cooked shrimp | 100 g ladyfingers ( small-sized ) | 2 tablespoons roasted cashews or 2 tablespoons peanuts, ground fine | 150 g anchovies | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/4 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 turnip, peeled and finely chopped
instructions: Combine all the ingredients. Make into about 20 small balls. Steam fry on low medium in a little oil. You may also bake them right in the oven at 200 c for 40 - 45 min until nicely browned.

title: BBQ Pot Chicken Breast With Cheese & Chickpeas
ingredients: 2 chicken breast fillets | 4 slices brie cheese | 2 tablespoons chickpea flour | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/4 - 1/2 cup chopped pickled jalapeno | 1/2 cup chopped roasted chicken breast fillet
instructions: Heat your bbq to very hot. Place chicken fillets in the middle of the grill pan. Top with some brie. Sprinkle remaining cheese on top of brie. Close the lid immediately until the cheese has melted and the bbq is very hot. Cook for 3 to 5 minutes or until the cheese is melted. Remove the lid and flip each chicken breast. Slice crosswise into medallions.

Random Ingredients: buttermilk,spice,broth,grapefruit juice,green enchilada sauce,irish whiskey,pear,cottage cheese
title: Green Pear Parfait
ingredients: 1 large ripe pear, peeled, seeded, and mashed ( about 1/2 cup ) | 1 can green enchilada sauce | 1/4 cup unsweetened dried sourdough bread or 1/4 cup medium-grain rye breadcrumbs | 1/3 cup low fat cottage cheese | 1 1/2 cups low sodium broth or 1 1/2 cups canned reduced-sodium chicken stock | 1/2 cup orange juice or 1/2 cup grapefruit juice | 1/2 cup irish whiskey ( such as irish jack ) | freshly grated mixed spice ( such as mrs. dash, poultry magic, cinnamon, or cinnamon powder )
instructions: Combine all ingredients well.

Random Ingredients: seasoning salt,alfredo sauce,parsley leaf,guacamole,garlic powder,thai pepper,dark rum
title: Baked Alfredo Sauce
ingredients: 3/4 of a cup warmed alfredo sauce ( homemade or commercial ) | 1 cup of your favorite fiesta-flavored guacamole or 1 cup other favorite prepared guacamole | 1/2 tablespoon fresh parsley leaves | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1/2 teaspoon fresh garlic powder ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon dark rum ( or rum extract ) | 1 teaspoon thai hot pepper ( optional )
instructions: Mix ingredients with wire whisk in a 2 quart baking dish. Bake covered at 450 f for 15 minutes and let cool for a few minutes. Serve with tostito chips and fresh crisp french bread. Enjoy note, these can be frozen and reheated in the microwave.

Random Ingredients: adobo seasoning,cayenne pepper,linguine,sea salt black pepper
title: Cajun Baked Linguine
ingredients: 1 package linguine | 2 1/2 tablespoons adobo seasoning ( recipe above ) | 3/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | sea salt and black pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Place dry linguine in a large bowl. Rub adobo seasoning and cayenne pepper into the linguine and combine. Add pasta and toss.

title: Sweet Red Poppy Seed Dipping Sauce for Chicken
ingredients: 1 jar poppy seeds, preferably yellow | 1/2 teaspoon dried red pepper ( or to taste ) | 1/4 cup ketchup | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar | 1/2 cup currants ( or dried cranberries )
instructions: Place poppy seeds, dried red pepper or fresh cranberries, ketchup, brown sugar, and red pepper into a small saucepan. Add enough water to cover, bring to a boil, then cover and simmer for three or four minutes or until the berries soften. Remove from the heat, stir in the currants to serve, note, this may need to be made ahead and refrigerated.

title: Kiwi Butter
ingredients: 6 kiwi fruits, peeled and peeled | 1 tablespoon red chili powder | 60 g butter, melted
instructions: Cut kiwifruit into large chunks. Place the kiwifruit chunks and chili powder into a bowl, and stir to mix thoroughly. Pour the melted butter over the fruit and mix. Allow to refrigerate, covered, for at least 1 hour before serving. Serve with crudites, crackers, bread. Use a vegetable peeler to peel kiwifruit into long strips. Place the strips onto a tray, and drizzle with melted butter.

Random Ingredients: cream celery soup,lime zest,cherry,kiwi fruit,jalapeno chile,green chili,pork
title: Pork in Coconut Curry With Kiwi Nuts
ingredients: 6 -8 slices kiwi fruits ( or 4 slices fresh fruit of choice ) | 1/2 chopped green chili ( or to taste ) | 1/2 chopped jalapeno chile | 1 tablespoon grated lime zest ( or to taste ) | 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 1 pint cherry, halved, drained | 1 lb ground pork, cooked ( meat should measure 1 lb ) or 1 lb ground beef, cooked and drained to desired doneness before adding other ingredients ( meat should measure 1 lb )
instructions: Mix all ingredients except cherry throughly, and refrigerate until ready to serve. Add the cherry halves just prior to serving. Serve over jasmine rice.

Random Ingredients: mint leaf,candy sprinkle,chinese five spice powder,yellow cornmeal,beef sirloin,penne pasta,oil,serrano chilies
title: Sirloin Skillet Dinner
ingredients: 1 lb beef sirloin, cut into thin slices | 1 tablespoon light oil | 1/4 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 1 cup yellow cornmeal | 1 lb penne pasta | 12 mint leaves | 4 serrano chilies, seeded and minced | 4 tablespoons fresh unsalted butter | 1 bag candy sprinkles
instructions: In a small bowl, mix the beef brisket with the half cup seasoning and let sit for 1 hour. Preheat the broiler and brush a nonstick 9 inch cast iron skillet with oil. When hot, add the beef and cook, turning once, until no longer pink. Remove the beef. Turn the heat to high under the skillet, add the remaining seasoning and heat, scraping up any browned bits, for 1 minute. Reduce the heat to low and add the cornmeal. Stir and cook, stirring, until it is a thick, grainy paste and starts to thicken, about 3 minutes. Add the cooked beef back to the skillet and stir in the mint and chiles. Pour this mixture over the pasta. Add the butter in a thin stream, whisking constantly to incorporate. Toss, taste and adjust seasoning. Serve hot, with a sprinkling of the remaining candy sprinkles.

Random Ingredients: courgette,baking potato,turmeric powder,buttermilk biscuit,green onion,greek oregano
title: Grilled Greek Potato Cakes
ingredients: 5 medium baking potatoes, peeled | 1 1/4 cups buttermilk biscuits, cut cookies into small pieces | 1/4 cup diced courgette | 1/4 cup diced green onion | 1 tablespoon dried mediterranean oregano | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Preheat grill for high heat. Line the perimeter of a large baking sheet with aluminum foil. Brush the foil with oil to prevent smoking. Coat inside of baking tray with the buttermilk biscuits. Place potatoes and courgettes inside the middle of a greased baking sheet and brush with oil. Grill under high heat for 10 - 12 minutes, or until vegetables are crispy and lightly browned. Remove from heat and sprinkle with oregano, turmeric powder and toss everything together.

title: Taki's Yakisoba Salad
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce, shredded | 1 cup cream of tartar | 1 cup taki taki sauce ( or otheraki sauce ) | 1/4 cup agave syrup
instructions: Tear lettuce into 2 inch lengths. Cut cream of tartar into thin strips. Combine both with shredded lettuce. Top with your favorite dipping condiments of choice.

Random Ingredients: five spice powder,confectioner sugar,sharp cheddar cheese,vegetable,mirin,kaffir lime leaf
title: Japanese Five-Spice Cones
ingredients: 1 package frozen mixed vegetables | 1 teaspoon five-spice powder | 2 kaffir lime leaves, shredded | 2 packages sharp cheddar cheese | 1 cup confectioners'sugar | 1 1/2 tablespoons mirin
instructions: Place the frozen mixed vegetables and five spice powder in a large resealable plastic bag. Close and shake the bag to evenly coat the vegetables. Remove vegetables.

Random Ingredients: tamarind pulp,cream,scotch whisky,confectioner ' sugar,ginger garlic paste,beef brisket,cumin,italian sausage
title: Scotch Flavoured Brisket
ingredients: 1 beef brisket | 2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 2 teaspoons ground cumin | 2 cups scotch whisky | 1/3 cup tamarind pulp | 1/2 cup cream | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar | 6 tablespoons scotch whisky
instructions: Place brisket in large roasting pan and lightly season with salt and pepper. Blend ginger garlic paste, cumin, 7 cups whisky, tamarind pulp and cream in blender, add 3 tbsp sherry. Pour mixture over brisket and marinate for at least four hours basting frequently with marinade. Prepare grill to baste. Brush brisket occasionally with remaining whisky. Cook on preheated grill to desired doneness, 30 - 35 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cheddar cheese,drambuie,orange juice,half,rigatoni pasta,dark chocolate,saltine cracker,italian sausage
title: Rich and Creamy Spicy Orange Ragu
ingredients: 1 lb sweet italian sausage ( sweet or hot ) | 2 cups broken quail ice cream or 2 cups half-and-half | 6 ounces dark chocolate, chopped | 1 cup half-and-half, divided | 1/4 - 1/2 cup orange juice or 1/4-1/2 cup sweet lime juice | 2 tablespoons drambuie ( optional ) | saltine crackers ( optional ) | cooked rigatoni pasta or rotini pasta
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Bring water to boil in large skillet for pasta. If desired, add saltines. In a double boiler, melt chocolate over simmering water and stir until smooth. Drain off excess water from skillet and pour into chocolate. Add 2/3 of the half and half and stir until smooth. If more fat is needed, melt in microwave or in double boiler. Remove sauce from heat and whisk in drambuie. Cover and refrigerate overnight or while preparing your main recipe.. Pour sauce into 13x9 inch baking dish. Drain the ragu. Sprinkle the crackers evenly over top of ragu. Cover with aluminium foil and bake over hot water for 35 - 40 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes to ensure even browning. Remove from oven and serve over hot cooked rigatoni pasta or rotini pasta with orange slice on top and/or chopped green onions.

Random Ingredients: tomato basil oregano garlic,hot water,sriracha sauce
title: Sriracha Chili Gravy
ingredients: 4 tablespoons sriracha sauce | 1/2 can diced tomatoes with basil oregano and garlic | 1 cup hot water
instructions: Mix equal parts of chili sauce and water.

Random Ingredients: scallion,rice noodle,coconut milk,red bell pepper,hazelnut,bamboo toothpick
title: Hazelnut Noodle Bowl
ingredients: 1/4 cup hazelnuts | 4 scallions, coarsely chopped | 1 red bell pepper, coarsely chopped | 1 package rice noodles | 3/4 cup light coconut milk | 8 bamboo toothpicks
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium heat. Cook hazelnuts, scallions, and bell pepper in hot skillet until they begin to soften, about 2 minutes. Toss with noodles until coated with hazelnut mixture. Stir coconut milk into noodle mixture until well blended. Set skillet aside. Heat an air tight metal grill pan or grill pan large enough to hold noodles in a single layer. Cook noodles until golden brown on all sides. Using tongs, transfer noodles to a platter. Drain skillet. Return skillet to stove over moderate heat. Cook and stir warm noodle mixture until heated through, about 5 minutes. Divide noodle mixture among bowls.

title: Alitcha Macaroni
ingredients: 3 sheets puff pastry, thawed ( half pound ) | 4 tablespoons pepitas-epazote ( mexican sage powder ) | 1 tablespoon pumpkinseed oil | 1 pinch saffron threads ( optional ) | 4 -6 small potatoes, left whole
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f, or gas mark lightly grease a baking sheet with pepazote. Cut the puff pastry sheets in half lengthwise.

title: Mexican Chorizo (Or Portuguese Chorizo) Pancakes
ingredients: 1/2 pound chorizo sausage | 1/2 pound shredded mozzarella-piro chorizo | 1/2 pound bacon | 2 ripe mangoes, peeled and diced | 1/4 cup chopped fresh ginger root
instructions: Prepare a pancake hot and medium high heat according to manufacturer's instructions. Wrap the chorizo sausage in a slice or two and place into a skillet over medium low heat. Cook until evenly browned, then set aside to cool. When cooled, finely chop. Place the cooled chorizo and mozzarella or piro into a small mixing bowl. Mix in the mango, ginger, and about 1 tablespoon of water to loosen, then mix into pancake until well blended. Cook 1 or 2 minutes, then flip and cook briefly. To serve, cut warm pancake into wedges and drizzle with a little more piro as desired.

Random Ingredients: cheddar cheese,chicken bouillon,lasagna noodle,prosciutto,french bread,sugar substitute,mozzarella cheese
title: Lasagna French Bread Loaf
ingredients: 2 tablespoons instant chicken bouillon | 1/2 cup fat free sugar substitute | 8 slices reduced fat cheddar cheese | 8 slices fat free mozzarella cheese | 8 slices prosciutto | 12 -15 lasagna noodles | 4 slices shredded lowfat cheddar cheese
instructions: Combine instant chicken bouillon and sugar in a small bowl and set aside. In a 9 x 13 baking dish, layer ingredients in this order, 1/3 of the cheeses, 6 slices of prosciutto, 6 slices of mozzarella, and 8 more slices of prosciutto, 3 slices of prosciutto, and 6 more slices of mozzarella, 3 slices of prosciutto, and 1/2 of the instant chicken bouillon mixture. Repeat this layer once more, then finish off with the last layer of cheeses. Cover the baking dish with foil and refrigerate overnight. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Bake covered in preheated oven until heated through and top is golden brown, about 50 - 60 minutes. Allow to cool before cutting into 1 slices.

title: Lettuce in Garlic Oli
ingredients: 4 heads iceberg lettuce | 1 head minced garlic from a jar | 5 tablespoons garlic salt | 1 teaspoon ground cumin powder | 5 tablespoons honey | 1 tablespoon parsley or 1 tablespoon cilantro, chopped
instructions: Slice iceberg lettuce into 12 slices. Wash garlic in a colander. In a very big bowl add the garlic salt, cumin, and parsley. Add in the honey & pepper. Toss until the salt is completely dissolved. Now in a large casserole dish place the lettuce leaves on the bottom layer and fill with the garlic mixture. Cover tightly with foil. At this point you may add a little bit of extra dressing to keep them under the lettuce. Bake at 400 degrees fahrenheit for 20 - 30 minutes. Garnish with chopped cilantro.

title: Barbecue Beef Spread(Oamc)
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese, softened | 1 cup chopped cooked beef | 1 can enchilada sauce | 1/2 cup light corn syrup | 1/2 cup vinegar | 1/4 cup light corn syrup
instructions: Place cream cheese in a large mixing bowl. Add ground beef. Gently fold in remaining ingredients. Beat until well mixed. Spread onto a cookie sheet sprayed with nonstick cooking spray. Let stand at room temperature to soften slightly. Spread evenly onto an ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 350°f 3 - 5 minutes or until firm. Let stand 15 minutes before slicing.

title: Lamb or Pork Risotto With Swiss Cheese
ingredients: 1/2 kg lamb, cut into 5cm cubes | 150 g swiss cheese, halved | 1 1/4 cups arborio rice | 3 cups coconut milk
instructions: Heat half the coconut milk in a large pan. Add the lamb cubes and cook until lightly browned.

title: Figs in Chile Oil
ingredients: 1 package fast rising yeast | 1/2 cup canola oil ( or more ) | 1 tablespoon chili oil ( or more ) | 3 lbs fresh figs, sliced
instructions: Soak figs in boiling water, 20 minutes. Drain off any excess water and let figs cool. Place cooled figs into mixing bowl. Measure remaining ingredients into larger bowl and add figs. Beat with spoon until combined. Cover bowl tightly and let rise at room temperature 1 hour or until puffy and slightly spongy. Cover and put in a warm spot and let rise until doubled about 30 minutes. When the dough has risen, turn out onto a floured surface. Gently knead for 2 minutes by hand or with hands. Place on lightly oiled surface and cover with a warm damp towel. Let dough double, about 1 1/2 hours. Knead dough well until smooth and elastic.. Place dough into a greased bowl, cover and let rise at room temperature until doubled, about 30 minutes. Roll dough with rolling pin until 1/4 inch thick. Cut into 2 inch pieces. Dip each piece into flour. Repeat with remaining pieces. Heat oil in a heavy large skillet over medium heat until it shimmers, about 3 minutes. Add about 1/2 inch of dough and fry until bubbles rise to form, about 3 minutes. Turn dough over and fry until bubbles form on underside, about 1 minute. Using slotted spoon, transfer 2 dough pieces to a baking sheet. Fry remaining dough in same manner. Remove from pan and drain on paper towels. Cooks' note, figs may be frozen at this point if frozen. Baking instructions,. In a nonstick frying pan, fry figs in hot oil until golden brown. Turn as needed. Drain on paper towels. Serve warm.

title: Eggplant With Coconut and Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 medium eggplant, cut into 3 inch squares | 1 can mexican-style diced tomatoes, undrained | 1/2 cup fat-free evaporated milk or 1/2 cup skim milk | 2 tablespoons shredded coconut | 1 head iceberg lettuce, washed
instructions: Preheat broiler and position a rack 15 inches from the heat. Line a baking sheet, rimmed with foil, with a light coating of cooking spray, with tin foil and grease the foil with shortening. Arrange the eggplant in a single layer on the baking sheet. Broil 5 minutes, turning once, until lightly browned. Spread tomatoes evenly over the eggplant. Toast the coconut. Place lettuce on tomatoes. Sprinkle with peanuts, walnuts or cashews. Broil 1 minute, or until toasted.

title: Garlic Bites
ingredients: 1 garlic clove, minced | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning | 1/2 cup icing sugar, for coating
instructions: Place garlic in a small dry small skillet. Cook over medium heat until soft. Stir in the italian seasoning. Remove from heat. Stir in icing sugar. Use as directed.

Random Ingredients: guajillo chilies,mango,pineapple ring,picante sauce,tea,alfredo sauce,hot red pepper flake,vanilla bean
title: Tropical Mexican Hot Red Beans Dip Duo
ingredients: 12 ounces brewed hot red beans ( conrigrador ) | 12 ounces brewed tequila ( conical ) | 1 1/4 cups mangoes or 1 1/4 cups papayas, cut up ( 1 1/4 cups ) | 6 bananas, split lengthwise in half lengthwise then crosswise and into thirds | 10 -15 pineapple rings | 1 cup picante sauce | 3 -4 tablespoons grenadine sauce or 3 -4 tablespoons crema | 1 -2 tablespoon jalapenos or 1 -2 tablespoon crushed hot red pepper flakes, if desired | 1 small vanilla bean, split lengthwise and seeds scraped out and seeded
instructions: Mix together. Add 1 - 2 tablespoon water until desired consistency is achieved. Chill for at least 8 hours and up to 24 hours to allow flavors to blend. Garnish with a dollop of whipped cream on top of each serving if using, or top with a slice of banana.

title: Sweet and Sour Beef Ribs
ingredients: 1 kg meat ( eye of round, sirloin and top round ) | 2 tablespoons malt vinegar | 1 tablespoon dry oregano | 4 kielbasa sausage ( i used hillshire farms ) | 200 g kielbasa sausage | 1 tablespoon orange rind, grated | 1 tablespoon ketchup ( heinz )
instructions: Pre heat oven, 160 degrees. Cut rib heads into 6 portions and place into lightly grease or olive based fry pan that has been slightly brushed with oil. Spread out ribs evenly across pan. Top evenly with remaining ingredients. Put them in the oven and turn ribs over. Cover and cook for 40 min or until tender. This can also be made using a tender meat. Shake the pan to distribute the meat evenly. Serve while hot.

title: Easter Meatballs & Egg
ingredients: 4 ounces beef stock | 2 ounces tangerine zest | 1 tablespoon rum | 8 ounces oatmeal | 3 eggs | 2 ounces candied lemon peel, shredded | 1 1/2 cups broth
instructions: Whisk together the beef stock, rum and tangerine zest. Whisk the oatmeal to a paste with cold water, then add the oatmeal paste in slowly while making sure the oatmeal gets incorporated and the paste doesn't burn. Add the eggs in slowly while whisking. Then combine with the stock mixture. Heat gently, then simmer for a couple of hours. If you would like to make the gravy, stir in a tablespoon of the butter mixed with the rum at the end to keep it from becoming burnt. Serve the meatballs at the table with the gravy on the side. This goes well with a salad and boiled potatoes.

title: Lemon Peel Chips
ingredients: 16 ounces fine peanut oil | 1/2 lb finely grated lemons peel
instructions: Heat oil in a heavy base or pot until smoking hot. Quickly add peel and toss them quickly until they change color. Immediately cover the pan with saran wrap and place over medium heat. Watch them carefully once they are light in color. Carefully tap the pan to remove the peel, which stick can be seen as it crisps. The pith may be turned with the peel, and the peel should be golden brown. You can use your hands to press the peel with the peel to make coating easier to coat. If it does, blot it all over with kitchen paper towels. If it does not, use your fingers to press again and coat it with oil.

title: Chef John's Baked Fresh Broccoli
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried bran cereal | 1 tablespoon grated fresh ginger-garlic paste | 1 bunch cilantro leaves, rinsed
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Spread bran cereal in a shallow baking dish, and sprinkle the ginger garlic paste all over the cereal. Set aside while preparing the broccoli. Heat the oven's broiler and set a baking rack 1 1/2 inches below oven rack. Place broccoli in a large roasting pan and arrange its stems, straight sides up, on the baking rack. Roast uncovered in the preheated oven until tender and just beginning to brown, stirring regularly, about 40 minutes.

title: Super Easy Mexican Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 2 roma tomatoes ( not canned ) | 1/4 cup canola oil
instructions: Pour 2 tbsp of canola oil in a small saucepan. Over medium heat add peeled roma tomatoes into the pan and cook until they turn a lighter shade of green. Reduce the heat to medium. When the tomatoes are tender, drain off the excess liquid from the pan. Add the tomato juice back into the pan and continue cooking until desired consistency is achieved. Allow sauce to cool and transfer to container. Enjoy.

title: Baked Meat Pies
ingredients: 1/2 cup peanut oil | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs ground sirloin | 1 cup sliced onion | 2 tablespoons instant chicken bouillon | 1/2 cup chocolate syrup | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder
instructions: Preheat oven 375 400°f. Brown meat in the peanut oil. Add all ingredients and mix well. Line muffin tin with waxed paper or parchment paper and fill with meat mixture. Cover with waxed paper and crimp slightly to prevent steam from escape. Bake 25 minutes. Remove from oven and allow to cool.

Random Ingredients: rice wine,chili pepper flake,oregano,horseradish,taco sauce,white flour
title: Taco Barbecue Sauce (For Wonton)
ingredients: 1/2 cup white flour | 1/2 cup chili pepper flakes | 1 1/2 tablespoons horseradish ( we like beaver brand ) | 2 tablespoons taco sauce | 1 teaspoon oregano ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon rice wine or 1 tablespoon sherry wine ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to mix dry ingredients. Combine taco sauce with other ingredients. Serve sauce over wonton.

title: Tikka Salmon
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs salmon steaks, cut 1 x3 x3 | 2 large beef bouillon cubes | 3 tablespoons curry powder
instructions: Pour boiling water over salmon. Cover and let sit for 30 minutes. Remove salmon to shallow baking dish. Combine bouillon, curry powder in measuring cup. Pour over salmon and bake at 450 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Tofu With Chili and Hot Chili Sauce
ingredients: 1/3 lb firm tofu, well drained if frozen
instructions: Cut tofu into 2 to 3 inch square slices. Cut chili into thin slices or cut the length of chili pepper using a hot knife. Spread a thin layer of chili slices or chili pepper on a double thickness of plastic wrap. Place slices together, making sure they touch. Pinch corners or strings from wrap to hold tofu slices in the mixture. Place on paper towels. Let sit at room temperature for about 20 minutes. Lightly coat a grill or broiler rack with nonstick spray or set over medium high heat. Grill or broil tofu until lightly browned, 3 to 4 minutes, turning once, or until crisp and hot throughout. Serve hot garnished with chili and a drizzle of warm chili sauce. Note, to serve, place tofu slices in a warm dish or on 4 individual plates.

title: Kielbasa - Danish Pastry
ingredients: 16 ounces kielbasa | 1/2 lb blanched almond paste | soya sauce, to taste
instructions: Cut in 3 or 4 pieces and slice into 1/4 slices. Spread a small amount of soya sauce onto the sliced kielbasa. Sprinkle with almond paste and place on a parchment circle or greased baking sheet or baking sheet. Bake in the middle of preheated 400 degree oven until done. Serve with a bit of chopped parsley and/or minced garlic to dip into the sauce.

Random Ingredients: bamboo shoot,bartlett pear,green onion,heavy cream,rye bread
title: Irish Grilled Grilled Pear & Berry Pears Cheese Dip
ingredients: 8 ounces firm white-fleshed rye bread, cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 ripe bartlett pears | 4 ounces canned bamboo shoots, drained and chopped | 2 tablespoons sweet green onions, chopped | 1/3 cup heavy cream
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together rye bread cubes with chopped pears and chopped bamboo shoots. Chill until ready to use. Place cream in a small bowl and set aside. To serve, transfer pear mixture to grissini or other hot, greased pan. Top with green onions. Place grissini on top and serve warm.

title: Guacamole  for One
ingredients: 2 medium celery ribs | 1 tablespoon guacamole
instructions: Dice the celery and mix with the guacamon. You may use a mortar for this then mash the ingredients together. Store in the refrigerator for as much as one week.

Random Ingredients: chambord raspberry liquor,self rising flour,spanish onion,cilantro leaf
title: Easy Raspberry Onion Cake
ingredients: 1/4 cup chambord raspberry liquor | 1 large sweet spanish onion | 1/2 cup self-rising flour | 1/2 cup fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Peel and finely slice the onion in half and then cut into thick slices. In a small bowl, combine the chambord, olive oil and the cilantro. Spread the onion slices on a large round or square cake pan and place in a 450 degree oven, spreading evenly. When the bottom of the bread begins to brown, turn the slices and brown the other side. Continue to oven for about 1/2 hour or until the onions are soft and moist. Turn out onto a plate and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: banana pepper,puff pastry,kahlua,fine breadcrumb,halibut steak,red wine vinegar,french onion soup,whipping cream
title: Halibut Au Gratin
ingredients: 4 large halibut steaks | 150 g fine dry breadcrumbs | 200 g whipping cream | 1 1/2 liters sweet french onion soup | 1/3 cup red wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons kahlua | 300 g bananas peppers, sliced | puff pastry, to use oven proof dish
instructions: Season each steak with salt and pepper. Place in oven for 10 to 15 minutes until done. Mix soup, vinegar, kahlua, apricots and bananas in small bowl. Set aside. Remove steaks from oven and leave in oven for 5 minutes. Turn and leave for 3 to 5 minutes and then remove from oven and leave to rest for 5 minutes. Roll out pastry and line a 2 cm round baking dish. Brush all edges. Cover with pastry. Spread soup mixture evenly over pastry and top with slices of steak. Pile remaining slices of steak on top of steak. Bake for 40 - 45 minutes until heated through and starting to brown. Serve with french onion soup.

ingredients: 3/4 lb boneless beef top sirloin steak, cut into thin strips | marinade, : | 1/2 cup pesto sauce | 1/2 cup pine nuts | 1/3 cup dry sherry | 1/4 cup miracle whip | 2 tablespoons italian parsley | lettuce, thinly sliced
instructions: Combine marinade ingredients.

ingredients: 3 lbs beef brisket | sea salt | 2 tablespoons peanut butter, softened | 1 medium green pepper, chopped | 1 large cauliflower, chopped | 1/4 cup green olives or 1/4 cup black olives, chopped with liquid | 1 loaf french bread, with crusts removed
instructions: Put brisket and water in roaster. Cover with foil and bake for 2 hours at 325 degrees. While brisket bakes, mix together peanut butter, red pepper and green pepper. title: Green Peas and Harissa

instructions: Soak the dried green peas in cold water overnight. Rinse and drain. Place the peas, fenugreek and lemon grass in a food processor. Process until smooth. Add enough water to make a paste.

title: Mexican Mushrooms on the Grill

instructions: Combine first three ingredients in a medium bowl. Brush mushrooms with butter. Sprinkle mushrooms with cheese. Broil in oven, broil 3 - 4 minutes or until top is lightly browned.

title: Easy, Healthy Croissant

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Whisk the instant espresso powder with egg white and poultry seasoning in a large bowl. Add half the cheese and stir until melted. Bake until golden brown, about 15 minutes.

title: Vincent Price Ham With Carrots
ingredients: 8 slices prosciutto ham | 2 small carrots, peeled
instructions: Lay one sheet slice of prosciutto or thickly sliced thin ham on each piece of sliced ham. Roll the ham and carrots around each ham and place onto a large skillet or griddle. Lightly spray with nonstick cooking spray or brush with melted butter or margarine. Over medium high heat, cook carrots, turning occasionally, until lightly golden and crispy around the edges, about 7 minutes.

title: Quick Passionfruit Sauce
ingredients: 2 passion fruit pulp | 3 teaspoons curry powder
instructions: In a blender, place all the ingredients except for passionfruit puree, and puree until smooth. If you are using a food processor, place the passionfruit puree in a bowl, and pour it over the passionfruit puree. Leave for about 2 hours, or longer, to marinate. Do not cook the sauce to too dry. Transfer it to any moulds, and refrigerate for at least 6 hours before using.

Random Ingredients: spinach,tomato green chile pepper,flour tortilla,mustard,plum tomato,plum,plain flour,ice water
title: Spinach and Tomato  Enchiladas
ingredients: 12 large flour tortillas | 4 plums, chopped | 4 plum tomatoes, chopped | 1 package frozen spinach, thawed and drained | 2 teaspoons dried mustard | 2 pints plum tomatoes and green chile peppers | 2 cups plain flour | ice water, as required to make dough easy to mould into balls
instructions: Place frozen spinach, plum tomatoes and green peppers in a pan with just over a cup of water. Simmer gently, covered, for about 15 minutes until just tender. Meanwhile, place flour in a bowl, add oil and mix well between each addition. Turn flour into a ball with a good pinch of salt and add water a little at a time until mixture forms a ball. Remove from heat. Preheat oven to 400°f put frozen spinach mixture in a processor and add dry mustard. Process briefly to chop and start to work the spinach through the mixture. Add flour into the mixture and make a thin paste of the cold water with your fingers. Roll mixture into balls. Put a tortilla on a flat work surface and lay a ball in it. Cover it with 2 more tortillas and repeat process with the remaining tortillas. Place a few tomatoes and spinach mixture on the bottom part of each rolled tortilla. Roll each one tightly and place, seam side down, in a baking dish. Cover dish tightly with foil and bake in the oven for at least 30 minutes. Alternatively, you can place enchiladas in a slow cooker and cook them on low for 3 hours or until they are tender and have the texture of a thick tomato sauce. Serve with salsa, cheese, sour cream, guacamole or guacomole.

Random Ingredients: fine sugar,extra virgin olive oil,dill weed

ingredients: 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 2 teaspoons finely chopped fresh dill weed | 3 cups freshly chopped dill weed
instructions: Scoop out most of the coarse stems of the dill weed, leaving the soft leaves and stems intact. In a medium bowl toss together the dill weed leaves and the olive oil. Toss in the dill weed and taste.

Random Ingredients: chicken soup base,cherry tomato,basil pesto,date,taco seasoning mix,jalapeno chile

instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and heat slowly until heated thru. Serve with your choice of veggies.

instructions: Mix well in a jar, cover and refrigerate for up to 3 weeks.

instructions: Preheat bbq to 325f degrees. On a sheet of foil, combine bread slices.

title: Basil-Focaccia Cookies

instructions: Combine the flour, cocoa powder and basil in a small bowl.

instructions: Clean and trim the mushrooms with stalks about 2 inches long. Set aside. Prepare ginger powder by combining all ingredients. Stuff mushrooms with the above marinade, placing them in a small pan. Add fresh ginger to taste. Cook on low heat for about 5 minutes to give the mushrooms time for flavor.

title: Easy Pineapple Filling for Perfumed Perfumed

instructions: Combine pineapple juice, powdered sugar, and sugar in small saucepan over medium low heat. Heat until sugar dissolves. Remove from heat and stir vigorously until syrupy, about 5 minutes.

title: Smoked Halibut Tacos
ingredients: 1 pound smoked halibut fillets | 1 pinch dried fenugreek | 1 teaspoon hungarian paprika | 1 pinch ground chipotle chiles | 1 pound sweet italian sausage | 4 flour tortillas, warmed | 1 red onion, sliced
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium high heat and lightly oil grate. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add smoked halibut, and season with fenugreek, paprika, chipotle chile, and italian sausage. Cook, turning once, until no longer pink in the center and the meat is easily flaked with a fork, about 15 minutes, depending on the thickness of the meat. Cut each tortilla into 4 wedges, depending on how wide it fits onto the grill. Serve the fish with the warmed tortillas and onion, respectively.

Random Ingredients: prosciutto,jalapeno pepper,grape,olive oil,chickpea flour,cilantro leaf,pumpkin puree,chipotle chile
title: Spicy Citrus Hummus
ingredients: 1/2 cup canned chickpea flour | 2 tablespoons grapes, fresh ( hulled if possible ) | 1/2 cup canned pumpkin puree | 10 ounces prosciutto ( or smoked ham ) | 1 cup fresh cilantro leaves | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 jalapeno pepper ( stem and seeds removed, or to taste ) ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon canned chipotle chile, in adobo ( or to taste ) ( optional )
instructions: Place the flour in a large bowl and set aside. Make sure the chickpea flour is the proper texture before proceeding. Roughly chop the prosciutto and chop the cilantro. In another bowl, place the pumpkin, cilantro, olive oil, jalapeño pepper and chipotle powder. Toss to mix. Add the chickpea flour to the pumpkin and bread. The flour should bind the dough together with no lumps. Place mixture in a plastic zipper bag for 5 minutes to rest. Remove the plastic and knead dough with your hand until it is smooth. Place dough onto a plate and cover with plastic wrap. Set aside until ready to use. When ready, preheat the broiler. Line a baking sheet with plastic wrap. Divide the dough into 4 equal sized balls. Roll each ball into a thin circle about 1/2 inch thick. Cook the cookies one at a time under the broiler on the prepared baking sheet. The edges should take care not to blister. Place the cookies on the prepared baking sheet and broil, flipping halfway through, until slightly crisp and golden. Transfer the cookies to a metal cooling rack. Note, i don't allow the cookies to age in the refrigerator.

instructions: Mix all ingredients together except carrot in a bowl and reserve. Cut carrots into small chunks. Cook spaghetti sauce al dente according to package directions. Drain spaghetti.

title: Pesto-Naked Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb cappatappi pasta or 1 lb rotini pasta | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped fresh basil leaf | 1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder | 2 cups cooked long-grain rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Pour the pasta into a saucepan. Add 1/4 cup water and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Bring to a boil over high heat. Cover and reduce heat to medium low. Simmer for 10 minutes. Drain pasta, reserving 1/4 cup of the cooking liquid. Set hot pasta aside. Meanwhile, combine basil, baking powder, remaining 1/4 cup water and rice in a large bowl. Dump pasta back into saucepan. Add 1/4 cup basil liquid and 2 cups of reserved cooking liquid. Stir to combine. Cover and simmer over low heat for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Stir in basil mixture and serve.

title: Tropical Fish

instructions: Combine sweet potatoes starch and nuts in a small bowl. Dissolve potato starch in 2 c water and add to potato mixture. Dip fish pieces in starch, dip in sweet potato mixture, and dredge in cashews or almonds. Place in a shallow baking pan and bake at 375f degrees for 20 minutes. Serve hot or cold. Garnish with lemon wedges.

title: Spinach and Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked quick-cooking oil | 15 ounces frozen chopped spinach, thawed & drained | 2 tablespoons quick-cooking oil | 1 packet taco seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon garam masala | 2 cups hot cooked brown rice
instructions: Heat oil in a 6 quart pot over medium high heat. Add frozen spinach, stirring for about 1 minute. Remove mixture from heat. Stir in taco seasoning / garam masala.

ingredients: 425 g tuna fillets, drained and flaked | 1 cup parsnip, peeled & chopped | 250 g sweet potatoes, peeled and chopped | 1 teaspoon ground spice, of your choice ( spice blend mix ) | 1/4 teaspoon garam masala | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1/4 cup tomato sauce
instructions: Combine tuna, sweet potato, parsnip and chillies in a bowl, sprinkle spice mix over and whisk together until the combined. Pour tomato sauce over top and mix in well. Serve immediately.

instructions: Cook cauliflower in large pot of boiling water with 1 tblsps. Water, uncovered, about 5 min or until it turns bright green and is almost crisp tender. Drain.

title: Chicken Jambalaya for Two
ingredients: 2 chicken thighs | 3 tablespoons plain yogurt | 1/4 cup chopped cremini mushroom ( fresh ) | 1 egg and 2 tablespoons rice noodles | 2 chicken bouillon cubes | cranched plantain
instructions: Marinate chicken thighs in yogurt and garlic in refrigerator for 1 hour. Drain. Heat skillet and saute chicken thighs in heated skillet for 20 minutes or until fully cooked. While chicken is cooking, wash rice noodles under cold running water until slightly softened. Drain. Cook rice noodles in boiling water for 3 - 5 minutes or until soft. Drain. Arrange noodles in a 4 - 5 quart casserole dish. Place chicken in noodles. Pour marinated yogurt over chicken. Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes. Remove cover for 35 more minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Dip
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese | 1/2 cup peanut butter | 1 chopped jalapeno pepper | 1 chopped serrano pepper
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the jalapeno pepper.. If mixture is too thick add a little water. If it is too watery add a little water. Spread on hot pita bread.

title: Lentil Chowder With Crispy Apples
ingredients: 2 cups dried garbanzo beans, soaked overnight in water to cover | 1 cup nonfat plain yogurt or 1 cup sour cream | 1/4 cup vegetable oil or 1/4 cup virgin olive oil | 1 small zucchini, sliced and quartered | 1 granny smith apple, diced | 1 cup brown lentils, rinsed and picked over | 1/2 cup dark chocolate, chopped | nutmeg, freshly grated
instructions: In a large saucepan add chickpeas and water to cover and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 3 to 5 hour or until tender. While chickpeas are cooking, combine remaining ingredients in small bowl. Add to chickpeas, simmer, uncovered for 15 minutes or until heated.

Random Ingredients: flour tortilla,beetroot,chicken bouillon cube,vanilla,maraschino cherry,vegetable stock chicken,apple cider,red onion
title: Apple Beetroot Burritos
ingredients: 10 ounces beetroots, shredded | 1 red onion, diced | 2 cups vegetable stock or 2 cups chicken stock | 1 teaspoon apple cider | 1 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon cube ( optional ) | 10 flour tortillas ( about 4-6 inches in diameter ) | 8 ounces maraschino cherries, chopped | 1 dash vanilla
instructions: Put shredded beetroot and onion in a colander over a bowl, sprinkle with salt and let sit for 30 minutes. Squeeze liquid from beetroot and toss it through a strainer to drain excess salty liquid into a bowl. Add remaining ingredients to beetroot and onion in colander, mix and set aside. Pre heat oven to 400 degrees. When oven is hot, put a large baking dish under the broiler as it is heated. Warm tortilla in the microwave until pliable, wrap it in a damp towel or put into a towel, and warm in microwave for 20 - 30 secs. Pour about 1/2 cup of the beetroot and onion mixture into the tortilla, and spread the mixture into the tortilla, spreading in a circular motion so that it completely covers the mixture. Try to have the mixture evenly spread. Arrange burritos on the baking dish, seam side down. Wrap up in foil and put them in the oven for 15 minute remove foil, sprinkle with chopped pinches of cherry and vanilla before serving.

title: Mango Macaroni Salad

instructions: Stir egg yolks and mango chutney together in a large bowl until well blended. Cook shells and cut side down into thirds. Divide pasta among 4 serving plates. Divide lettuce between 4 bowls and top with mango mixture. Serve.

title: Spaghetti Yakisoba
