instructions: Cut the chicken and marinate it overnight in this. The next day, cook the spaghetti til al dente. Reserve 1 cup of the cooking water and keep hot. Drain the cooked spaghetti. Take off the bitter rind from the chicken and add the chicken pieces to the dry bowl containing the spice mixture. instructions: Put 1 cup mango chutney, 1 cup scotch bonnet or habanero chile, 1 cup chili sauce, and 1 cup wild rice in blender, process until smooth. Add remaining 1 1/2 cup mango chutney.

title: Mung Bean Noodle Salad

instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook penne in boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 10 minutes.

title: Aussie Risotto With Bacon
ingredients: 250 g quinoa | 1 small green capsicum, diced | 1 lb lean ground turkey or 1 lb ground chicken | 1 can tomato soup | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Cook quinoa according to pack instructions. Add capsicum to quinoa. Drain and return quinoa to pot. Cook until liquid has been absorbed. Brown ground beef and add contents of soup tin including tomato soup to meat. Stir and cook on low until beef is browned. Mix in the bacon and mix well. Stir occassionally.

Random Ingredients: head cauliflower,vegetable,lamb shoulder,chili pepper flake,veal,wheat germ
title: Veal-Stuffed Head of Cauliflower (Tse-Ye-Ye)
ingredients: 2 small heads cauliflower | 1/2 lb veal, ground | 100 g lamb shoulder | 100 g veal, chopped | 1 chili pepper flakes | 1/2 cup wheat germ ( wheat ) | 2 tablespoons wheat germ ( white wheat ) | 2 birds eye chilies or 2 red chili peppers, minced
instructions: Cut off the stem of the cauliflower and remove the heads of cauliflower. Grate enough of the starchy outer shells to remove the outer leaves. Wash and dry the interior by placing the starchy shells and water in a pot and boil over high heat for about 10 minutes. Immediately place the starchy heads in a bowl with a cover. Cover that with cold vinegar and set aside. Add the ground meat to the pot with the peppers, chili flakes, wheat germ, and wheatgerm. Mix well and allow to cook on low heat for about an hour. Remove from the heat. Using clean hands, work the mixture through a food processor to obtain a crumbly texture and then shape the meat into small balls slightly smaller than the size of the cauliflower. Add to the meat in the pot and mix the meat mixture with your hands. Continue cooking for about an hour or until the meat is cooked through and it becomes moist and all the liquid has been absorbed. Place in a serving dish and leave to cool and serve with rice or eaten with curried coconut and chutney.

instructions: Cook linguine or spaghetti according to package directions. Drain well and pour into large mixing bowl. Add chopped celery and pepperoni and mix well. title: Blueberry and Vegetable Salad

instructions: In a saucepan combine 2 cups apple cider vinegar, 1 cup sugar, dry wine, fennel seed and tabasco.

title: Seared Skillet Bratwurst
ingredients: 1/2 lb bratwurst, cut into 1 1/2 inch pieces with the bone | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 1 large chipotle chile, stemmed and seeded | 2 teaspoons grated fresh gingerroot, fresh | 1/2 cup low fat ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup dry sherry wine
instructions: Tie the bratwurst pieces with kitchen twine at 1 inch intervals. Coat skillet with sesame oil. Brown bratwurst in skillet over moderate heat, turning to brown evenly on all sides. Remove from heat and set aside. Remove any remaining oil from skillet. Scrape the chile meat into the skillet and add about one cup of the drippings. Cook over moderate heat, stirring until hot but not browned, about 30 seconds. Add the chipotle, ginger and ricotta and cook until heated through. Stir in remaining drippings and serve.

title: Scallops Italiano Style
ingredients: 1 pint raw scallops or 1 pint sea scallops | 2 sprigs fresh coriander, with leaves, lightly crushed | 1 spanish onion, thinly sliced | 4 star anise pods, bruised | 1 tablespoon shredded parmesan cheese
instructions: Shell the scallops, discarding the vein and any white matter matter. Rinse well in cold and cool water. Drain and keep the scallops warm. In a small, heavy based sauce pan, fry the onion over medium heat for 5 minutes. Add the the star anise and coriander and cook for 4 - 5 minutes longer, until the onion is very soft. Add the scallops and stir. Remove from the heat and stir in the parmesan. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: anchovy,cream tartar,red pepper,white vinegar,cherry,italian sausage,yellow bell pepper,anchovy fillet
title: Zimtster Fagioli (Hot Penguins)
ingredients: 1 lb italian sausage, casings removed ( sweet or hot, mild ) | 1/2 cup white vinegar | 1 star ancho ( fresh or canned ) | 1 tablespoon cream of tartar | 1 tablespoon anchovy fillet, cut into 1/8-inch dice | 1 teaspoon roasted sweet red pepper, chopped ( optional ) | 1 1/2 lbs sour prawns or 1 1/2 lbs raw shrimp, peeled ( prawns ) | yellow bell pepper, cut into 1/8-inch dice ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 450 degrees. Line rimmed 2 baking sheets with parchment paper. Combine all sausage ingredients in a large bowl and mix well. Using a slotted spatula, transfer mixture to baking sheet and place in hot oven. Bake sausage until browned all the way, about 10 - 15 minutes and transfer immediately to a cutting board. Set aside. Prick the raw prawns in a few places with a skewer or a fork.

Random Ingredients: new potato,chicken liver,sumac,curry powder,garlic clove,sake,beef bouillon
title: Curried Chicken Liver & Potatoes (Gluten and Vegetarian)
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs boneless chicken livers, trimmed and cut into bite-sized pieces | 1/2 cup new potato, cut into 1/4 - 1/2-inch dice | 1 garlic clove, minced | 1/3 cup sake ( japanese sweet wine with a good amount of flavour, but use your judgement. i used too much. ) | 1/2 teaspoon curry powder ( or to taste, i use mild ) | 1/2 teaspoon sumac | 1 teaspoon instant beef or 1 teaspoon beef bouillon
instructions: Put chicken together with potatoes, spices and sake and marinate for 30 minutes, refrigerated, undisturbed, overnight. Heat a skillet over medium high heat and dry fry liver pieces for about 5 minutes, turning over until they are dark in color. If you want them brown on the outside, add extra oil to the skillet and return them, browned side up, to pan. They should take about 3 - 4 minutes. Add more oil if necessary and cook on all sides, stirring often, until golden and almost cooked through. Transfer the fried liver to a bowl and toss in any leftover marinade, if using, and serve immediately, or keep warm in a pan.

Random Ingredients: egg noodle,midori melon liqueur,sage,sharp cheddar cheese,sugar
title: Quick Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 lb fresh egg noodles | 1 lb sharp cheddar cheese | 1 tablespoon sugar | 1 teaspoon dundee melon liqueur ( or other liquor ) | 1 teaspoon dried sage, crushed
instructions: Cover the uncooked noodles with boiling water. Cook until tender but firm. Drain and rinse under cool running water.. While noodles are cooking, cut cheese into cubes and cut into small cubes, then combine with other ingredients in a bowl. Stir well. Drain noodles well and toss with cheese mixture. Serve at room temperature or chilled.

title: Indian Jaggery
ingredients: 1 cup peanuts oil | 5 cardamoms | 5 fresh sage leaves | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Heat oil in a heavy bottom pan. While it's hot, add cardamoms to it. Fry a few seconds, stirring regularly until the are darker in color. Add turmeric powder and sage leaves to oil. Fry until leaves are golden brown. Remove from heat and serve hot.

title: Real Simple Beef Sausages #SP5
ingredients: 1 lb ground chuck | 1/2 lb bread flour | 1 jarred red currant jelly | pita bread, warmed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Spray baking sheet with cooking spray. In a large bowl, combine beef, flour, jelly, and mixed spice. If using your hands, form mixture into small meatballs about 2 pieces each. Put meatballs on pita bread. Bake in oven for 20 - 25 minutes or until cooked through, turning over halfway through cooking.

title: Auberge Asparagus With Raisins and Pecans
ingredients: 1 lb fresh asparagus | 3/4 cup golden raisin ( measure carefully and reserve any excess ) | 1/4 cup pecans, toasted and coarsely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda
instructions: Trim the asparagus of woody portions as it becomes tough. Break the stalks apart at the tips and discard those tough stems. Bring a large pan of water to the boil and add the asparagus. Cook just long until tender but still with a little bite. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the asparagus to a clean dish and set aside. Stir in the raisins and pecans and return the asparagus to the hot pan over a moderate heat and cook for 3 minutes. Remove from pan and set aside to soak for 5 minutes. Meanwhile, bring a small saucepan of lightly salted water to the boil and add the bicarb. Drain the brine and add it to the boiling brine and cook for 2 minutes, stirring occasionally. Drain the asparagus well and divide between 4 plates. Spoon over the flavored brine and serve.

title: Italian Baked Potatoes
ingredients: 1 cup cottage cheese | 1/2 cup chopped toasted pecans | 1 package baking potatoes, unpeeled and sliced
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Stir together the cottage cheese, pecans, and baking potatoes in a large bowl.

title: Homemade Chocolate Mousse
ingredients: 2 ounces dark chocolate | 3 ounces olive, diced | 6 sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained and chopped | 2 ounces gouda cheese, diced
instructions: Melt the dark chocolate in a small saucepan over a low heat, just enough for the chocolate to melt through. Pour chocolate into a small bowl and stir in the olive, sun dried tomatoes. Serve in bowls with extra cheese on top and toasted pumpernickel.

title: Broccole with Guacamole
ingredients: 1 medium haas avocados | 1 tablespoon baking soda | 9 ounces fresh broccoli florets, washed well, stems removed
instructions: Cut the avocado in half lengthwise and remove the pit. Using a spoon and melon baller scoop out the flesh of the avocado and discard. Using another spoon, scoop out the shell flesh, leaving about a 1/2 thick shell. Rinse off the flesh and coarsely mash with a fork. Add the baking soda to the mashed avocado shells. Set aside 1/2 cup of the avocado mixture. Gently peel and section the broccoli florets. Carefully peel the remaining 1/2 cup of avocado mixture and cut them into small pieces. Place the broccoli florets into a bowl of ice water and set them aside. Drain the broccole and immediately toss with the reserved avocado mixture. Serve immediately.

title: Phyllo Tarts
ingredients: 20 sheets phyllo dough, thawed | 3/4 cup cheddar cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Grease 24 miniature muffin tins. Divide sheets of phyllo dough among the tins so they fit snugly on tins. Sprinkle 1/2 cup of the cheddar cheese over the dough. Repeat with another 18 sheets of phyllo dough, laying them up in a single row, buttered side down. Sprinkle the rest of the cheese and cheddar over the phyllo. Bake in preheated oven for 12 minutes. Turn the tarts out onto a wire rack and let cool 5 minutes.

title: Veal and Orzo Pasta With Mint Scented Rice
ingredients: 1 package frozen mixed frozen vegetables or, fresh vegetables | 1 bunch fresh mint leaves, torn or 1/2 cup dried mint | 4 cups chilled orzo pasta | 1 lb ground veal | 1 1/2 teaspoons seasoning salt ( i like mccormick ) | 2 cups chilled tortellini ( from one package )
instructions: If using fresh vegetables, thaw them first. Otherwise, thaw completely and add to a large pot of boiling water. Cook for 4 minutes until vegetables are barely tender. Use 1/2 cup mint leaves for garnish. Drain, save liquid, and set aside. Cook rice according to package directions. Set aside. Cook meat using 1 tbsp of the veggie oil and seasoning until browned and slightly pink. Add to cooked rice and vegetables. Add enough reserved cooking liquid to moisten. Stir in rice and add remaining veggy ingredients along with reserved liquid. Chill. If using packaged tortellini, put 3/4 cup reserved tortellini liquid in a bowl and add 1 - 2 tbsp riced from rice. Use chopsticks to cut tortellini into chunks. Garnish.

title: Quick  Fried  Corn Chip  Nests
ingredients: 5 egg whites, plus 2 extra, lightly beaten | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed | 2 tablespoons corn chips
instructions: Heat griddle or large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Mix egg whites and fennel seeds in medium bowl. Add two tablespoons corn chips, one at a time. Dip each ingredient in egg whites, then coat with 1 tablespoon corn chips. Fry until golden brown, about five minutes. Drain on paper towels. Serve cool.

title: Mexican Hummus
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas, drained | 1 envelope taco seasoning mix | 2 teaspoons coriander powder | 2 teaspoons amaretto
instructions: Mix in 2/3 cup water. Let sit for 20 minutes at room temp, stir then store in refrigerator till ready to use.

title: Smoky Guacamole
ingredients: 2 teaspoons ground cumin | 2 -3 dashes tabasco sauce | 1/2 cup guacamole, if desired
instructions: Mix together well and add more tobasco if desired. Enjoy.

title: Aguado De Norte
ingredients: 1 fresh guava nectar | 2 fresh shin beef, shreaded into 4 pieces | 2 fresh anaheim chilies | 4 tablespoons tea, hot ( i prefer earl grey ) | 4 egg yolks
instructions: Dissolve the tea, chilies and tea in the hot guava nectar. In a bowl, beat the egg yolks and fold them into the yolk mixture. Add the shaved shreaded beef and continue beating until the mixture is smooth. Put in the refridgerator for 1 hour to set. You can garnish with slivered almonds or pecans, chopped scallions or cilantro.

title: Curried Chorizo
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon sambal curry powder | 1/2 teaspoon cumin seed | 2 -4 teaspoons fresh curry powder | 1 tablespoon minced scallion ( green onion ) | 1 tablespoon grated fresh lemon rind
instructions: Crush the cumin seeds in mortar. Add the curry powder, scallion, salt and lemon rind. Blend well. Note, this recipe is not really intended to be spread or spread with a spread/sweetener.

title: Spicy Chilli Rice
ingredients: 2 red chilies | 3 cups jasmine rice ( or white if you wish ) | 3 tablespoons roasted crushed red chilies
instructions: Wash, dry and deseed the chillies. Slice the chillies into long thin strips. Put the rice and chillies in a microwave safe bowl. Sprinkle the roasted red chilies over the rice. Mix until well coated. Cover with plastic wrap or a damp tea towel. Microwave on high for 30 - 45 seconds or until liquid is absorbed. Loosen the rice with a spatula and serve.

Random Ingredients: spinach,baking potato,grain white rice,mexican oregano,tart apple,shrimp,pastry double crust pie
title: Capellini De Fagioli--Spinach, Shrimp and Apple Pie
ingredients: 8 cups fresh spinach, coarsely chopped | 1 package frozen tart apples, thinly sliced | 1 package dried shrimp, thawed, cooked, shelled and cooked | 4 medium baking potatoes, peeled and sliced | 1 tablespoon mexican oregano | 2 teaspoons chopped mexican oregano | 4 pastry for double-crust pie, thawed | 1/2 cup uncooked short-grain white rice, rinsed
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f line two 9x5 inch loaf pans with parchment. Toss together spinach, apples, shrimp and 1 tablespoon of oregano. Toss with 1/2 teaspoon of oregano and 1/2 teaspoon salt.

Random Ingredients: grapeseed oil,bacon dripping,mustard powder,corn kernel,crescent,dark beer,vanilla bean
title: Carolina Crescent Cookies
ingredients: 2 tablespoons bacon drippings, or more as needed | 1 tablespoon grapeeed oil | 1/2 teaspoon ground mustard powder | 1 vanilla bean, split open and scraped | 1 can dark beer | 1 can refrigerated refrigerated crescent roll dough | 1 tablespoon corn kernels
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Mix bacon drippings with mustard powder in small bowl. Split the vanilla bean pod lengthwise and scrap out the pulp with a spoon. Split the scraped vanilla bean into 4 pieces and reserve for use. Crush bean pods and vanilla bean halves with the back of a cleaver, then stir into the bacon drippings. Pour in the dark beer.

Random Ingredients: sponge cake,lime wedge,pastry dough,yellow mustard,panko breadcrumb,chevre cheese tomato dill green onion,vanilla essence
title: Chevre and Lime Chess Pie Ivaji
ingredients: 1 pastry dough | 2 eggs, lightly beaten | 1/2 cup panko breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup yellow mustard | 1/2 cup shredded chevre cheese ( from a block such as velveeta ) | 1/2 cup panko breadcrumbs | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 2 tablespoons yellow mustard | 1 -2 teaspoon prepared yellow mustard, for the top | lime wedge, for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Mix the egg and 1/2 cup of panko with all of the remaining ingredients. Cut any dough from a block of chevre. Take out 3 - 4 tablespoons of the greek mixture and mix it in with the bread crumbs, vanilla and yellow mustard. Place the panko and 1/2 cup of panko mixture on a plate. Roll and flour a pastry cloth so it is easy to roll out. Cut the pastry into 1 inch rounds. Put the pastry circles on a greased or parchment lined baking sheet and make a slit in the centre of each round. Brush the edges with remaining milk. Place 1 - 2 tablespoons of the cheese filling onto each circle and put on top of the cheese tart. Close the pastry around the outside and pinch the edges to seal. Pinch the pastry gently to ensure the filling does not come out. Bake at 325 degrees for about 45 - 60 minutes, or until crust is golden brown and filling has puffed up. To serve, cut each pie diagonally and serve with a lime wedge. Variation,. Instead of panko, you can use plain greek yoghurt or sour cream, or your favorite dipping sauce. Add a little chopped parsley or basil to this if you are using this. Note, you can also add 2 tbs. Of chutney or preserves to the yoghurt. Note, you can also add dried herbs such as rosemary, thyme or chives. Note, to make filling, stir 1 to 2 teaspoons yellow mustard into 1 cup of finely chopped fresh herbs. Place the filling into a small serving bowl and spoon 1/2 cup of the warm yoghurt over the top.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce,cream mushroom soup,tarragon vinegar,fig,velveeta mexican cheese,horseradish,zucchini,chestnut
title: Vegetarian "Summer Salad"
ingredients: 4 cups lettuce, washed and dried | 24 frozen chestnuts, sliced in half lengthwise, then sliced | 1 cup zucchini, sliced | 8 ounces cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 fresh tarragon vinegar | 6 slices velveeta mexican cheese, cubed | 2 tablespoons fresh tarragon and 1 dash nutmeg for garnish | 5 -6 figs, diced
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine lettuce, chestnuts, zucchini and mushroom soup. Season with vinegar, nutmeg and prepared horseradish. Sprinkle with cheese. Top with figs.

title: Agua Fresca (Almond Side Item)
ingredients: 1/2 cup blanched almond ( unrefined, shelled ) | 1 1 large anaheim chilies ( seeded, charred and peeled or 1 large jalapeno, seeded and finely chopped ) or 1 large pasilla chile, seeded and coarsely chopped, for garnish
instructions: Place almonds in a heavy 1 quart saucepan.

Random Ingredients: cake flour,leaf lettuce,white pearl onion,pear,butter,ketjap manis
title: Pear Wrapped Spring Onion Salad
ingredients: 1 kg white pearl onion, peeled, washed and finely sliced | 125 g butter | 3 tablespoons ketchup ( kikkoman sauce ) | 1 bunch spring roll leaf lettuce ( cos ) | 30 g sliced pears | 3 tablespoons cake flour
instructions: Heat butter in frypan. Add onions and pears and fry, stirring often until onions are just wilted and starting to brown. Remove and cool off. Mix in flour and ketchup. Pour over the salad and let marinate for 15 to 20 minutes, stirring occassionally. This has to be served with rice, but goes great with a green vegetable.

title: Steamed Salmon With Rum
ingredients: 4 ounces smoked salmon, about 1.5 lbs per person ( or smoked salmon steak ) | 2 -3 tablespoons dark rum | 1/2 cup sweet wine ( we use madeira, for example ) | fresh flat-leaf parsley, to garnish ( optional )
instructions: Steam the salmon in a steamer over boiling water about 4 - 5 minutes until it flakes easily with a fork.. Transfer the cooked salmon to a serving platter and pour 2 tablespoonfuls of rum over it. Serve garnished with parsley and accompanied by steamed wine to go.

title: Spinach, Crab and Fresh Chili Peppers
ingredients: 3/4 lb fresh spinach leaves, washed well | 2 garlic chilies or 2 dried chili peppers | 1 tablespoon capers | 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce | 1 -2 teaspoon dried arugula
instructions: In a saaucepan, cover the spinach with water. Let the water boil and then stir in the garlic and chili peppers. After 2 minutes, drain the water out of the spinach and add to the boiling liquid along with the capers. Cover and bring to a boil. Lower heat and simmer for an additional 2 to 3 minutes or until the spinach is tender.

title: The Rebosado
ingredients: 2 tablespoons shallots, minced | 8 ounces greek yogurt ( preferably full fat, low in dairy, and cholesterol-free )
instructions: Combine, shallots, and half of yogurt. Mix well. Chill.

Random Ingredients: dark chocolate,onion soup mix,applesauce,cumin,mexican cheese,green bean,tomato puree
title: Mexican Style Stovetop Green Beans Casserole
ingredients: 1 tablespoon instant minced onion or 1 tablespoon dry onion powder | 1 tablespoon instant minced onion soup mix | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 teaspoon green beans, chopped | 1 can tomato puree | 1 1/4 ounces dark chocolate, chopped into chunks | applesauce | 2 cups shredded mexican blend cheese ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees. In a small bowl combine the onions, soup mix, cumin, and green beans. Mix to combine, then stir in the tomato puree and chocolate bits until combined. Spread half the corn chow mein over the bottom of an 8 inch casserole. Spoon the bean mixture evenly over the chow mein, then top with the remaining corn chow mein. Press together with the back of a spoon. Bake until bubbly and the casserole is hot and beginning to brown around the edges, about 40 minutes. Top with the mexican cheese if desired and let stand for a few minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: parsnip,lavender flower,double cream,chili pepper flake,white wine vinegar,sherry,udon noodle
title: Gourmet Noodle Salad With Dijon Vinaigrette
ingredients: 250 g udon noodles | 1/3 cup white wine vinegar | 3 tablespoons double cream | 1 -2 teaspoon dry sherry | 1 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh parsnip | 1 -2 tablespoon of finely chopped fresh lavender flowers
instructions: Cook noodles following directions. Toss with vinaigrette. Garnish with parsnip, fresh lavender flowers & chilli flakes.

title: Mexican Chipotle Cream Sauce (Dry Rub)
ingredients: 1/2 cup water | 2 teaspoons beef bouillon granules | 1 teaspoon fresh marinara sauce ( such as emeril's bristol cream or zatarains ) | 2 teaspoons chipotle chiles, stemmed, minced, plus | 1 teaspoon ground chipotle | 2 tablespoons minced shallots | 2 tablespoons shelled pistachios or 2 tablespoons slivered almonds
instructions: To make dry rub, in small bowl, mix water, bouillon, and marinara sauce. Cover and refrigerate 30 minutes. Dry grind chipotle with a mortar and pestle in to small batches, or in spice grinder. To serve, whisk cream sauce with chipotle pepper, shallot, and pistachios.

Random Ingredients: coconut cream,yogurt,pear,red chili powder,green cardamom,asafoetida powder
title: Curried Mango Lassi
ingredients: 250 g fresh pear, diced very finely | 150 g frozen yogurt, thawed | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1/4 teaspoon red chili powder | 5 -6 -6 green cardamoms | 1/4 cup coconut cream
instructions: Combine coconut cream and yogurt in a blender, using a little of the hot liquid to get a smooth consistency. Stir through asafoetida into yogurt mixture. Add red chilli and cardamoms. Cover. Chill at least 3 hours before serving.

title: Sausage or Kielbasa Stew
ingredients: 12 links kielbasa or 12 links link sausage, cut into pieces | 4 cups cooked kielbasa, chopped and brown | 2 cups chicken stock or 2 cups broth | 1 1/2 cups golden raisins or 1 1/2 cups sultanas | 1 cup uncooked small pasta shells | 2 cups quick cooking stock or 2 cups broth | 1 cup quick-cooking spinach
instructions: In large kettle, cook sausage, onions and broth over low heat until liquid is reduced and sausage is brown and onions are crisp. Stir in raisins and pasta and heat through. Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish or 2 1/2 quart casserole with cooking spray. Stir pasta mixture into sausage mixture and pour into dish. Bake at 325 degrees for 1 hour. To serve, warm throughly and serve with warm bread to soak up the juices. This stew keeps and ages well.

title: French Canadian Rib Roast
ingredients: 2 1/2 - 3 lbs boneless beef roast | 2 teaspoons vanilla | 1 can vegetable broth | 1/4 cup cognac | 3/4 cup half-and-half | 6 -8 pork ribs
instructions: Put roasting pan on middle rack of oven and set to 350°f, put heavy on top. Put roast on center rack and roast in oven until done. Cook for about 3 hours.

title: Creamy Shrimp Salad
ingredients: 12 fluid ounces sour cream soup | 12 fluid ounces buttermilk | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 2 drops green food coloring | 1 pound peeled and deveined jumbo shrimp
instructions: Stir sour cream soup, buttermilk, vinegar, and food coloring into sour cream soup until thoroughly blended. Place shrimp into a large serving dish, and pour the soup mixture over the shrimp. Refrigerate, covered, for at least 4 hours to allow flavors to blend.

title: The Best of the Best BBQ Butt Sausages
ingredients: 1 kg pigs feet | 1/2 cup vodka | 1/2 cup paprika | 2 tablespoons chipotle powder | 2 tablespoons basmati rice
instructions: Clean pig feet with cold water. Rinse in clear water. Put pig feet and pig feet together in a large pan and add enough water to cover the pig feet. Bring to the boil and leave for 45 mins per lb. Remove pig feet from pan and soak them in a large pot of water for about 1 hour or until there is no trace of blood or foreign matter. When the above pig feet are fully cooked, remove pig feet and pig feet to a large dish/bowl and set aside. After the 45 mins start soaking rice. When it is done, drain water and dump it into your basting dish. Pour the pig feet over the rice and mix together well so all the pig feet are covered. The more the thicker you can get them to the sausage stage, add the paprika, chipotle and mix together well. Keep tossing the mixture around so that all the pig feet are thoroughly coated with the paprika mix. Keep adding paprika and chipotle to your mixture until it is covered or else the sausage will fall apart.

title: Blueberry Custard
ingredients: 6 egg yolks | 2 pints fresh blueberries
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, whip egg yolks with an electric mixer. Add blueberries. Sieve over fresh berries. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Remove from refrigerator 30 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: puff pastry,vinegar,white sugar,heavy whipping cream,grape leaf,hard egg,salsa
title: Chilean Galette
ingredients: 1 frozen puff pastry sheet, thawed | 1/2 cup grape leaves, drained | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 1/3 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 teaspoon white sugar | 2 hard boiled eggs, sliced | 1 jar salsa ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Unfold puff pastry sheet on a lightly floured surface and cut into twelve rectangles. Bake pastry rectangles for 15 minutes in the preheated oven, until golden brown. In a medium bowl, stir together grape leaves and vinegar. Gradually stir cream into vinegar mixture until well mixed. In a small bowl, stir together sugar and eggs. Layer pastry rectangles onto a baking sheet. Top each with a layer of cream shrimp salsa, and spread remaining cream shrimp salsa around the edges of the pastry rectangles. Bake in the preheated oven until pastries are puffed and tender, and topping is lightly browned and heated through, about 20 minutes.

title: Barley Pudding (Pudding)
ingredients: 1 cup dried porcini mushrooms | 1 1/2 quarts water, divided
instructions: Put 1 cup water in large saucepan. Add dried mushrooms, about 2 inches in diameter. Bring to boil over medium high heat. Cover and boil over low heat for 5 minutes. Carefully remove from heat, stir, and allow to sit for 10 minutes. Pour 1 cup water in serving bowl. Drain mushrooms and set aside. Drain porcini mushrooms, discard liquid. Chop coarsely. Measure 1 cup water. Add 2 tablespoons water to soup. Pour soup over porcini mushrooms in serving bowl. Serve hot.

title: Italian Chicken
ingredients: 1 lb boneless chicken breast | 1 can pinto beans, drained
instructions: Cook chicken just until meat is no longer brown. Meanwhile boil water and put aside. Boil beans until soft drain water. Place chicken in baking dish. Pour beans over chicken. Cover and bake at 325 for 45 - 60 minutes.

title: Simple Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 5 cans italian stewed tomatoes | 1 onion, chopped
instructions: Drain tomatoes through a food mill, pressing the pulp with your hands to extract as much liquid as possible. Combine onions and tomatoes in slow cooker.

Random Ingredients: pizza crust,sharp cheddar cheese,salt black pepper,buttermilk
title: Cheese Pizza with Buttermilk
ingredients: 1 package prepared pizza crust | 1/2 cup buttermilk | salt and ground black pepper to taste | 2 cups shredded sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. Place pizza crust on a baking sheet.

ingredients: 8 -10 medium beets | 2 -3 lbs escarole, washed | 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 2 cups red wine vinegar | 1 ounce fast rising yeast | 1 cup white american cheese, grated | 4 4 slices thin deli-style swiss onions
instructions: Scrub beets well. Cut off top leaves and clean leaves.

title: Traditional British Beets
ingredients: 2 eggs | 4 tablespoons spelt flour | 4 tablespoons vegetable fat or 4 tablespoons shortening, cold ( 3/4 t., see note )
instructions: Whisk together eggs and flour.

title: Papas Fritos (Spanish Tapas)

instructions: Mix all ingredients together well. Heat frying pan on medium heat. Pour mixture into frying pan. Brown lightly. Serve with homemade tortilla chips.

title: German Radish Soup

instructions: Grate the radishes and place in a colander or strainer over a bowl. Cover with fresh water and let drain as long as possible. To serve, combine the radish mixture with 1 tablespoons of the hot liquid, and stir well.

title: Chermoula
ingredients: 1 small red pepper | 1/2 cup cilantro, chopped | 1 box stove top stuffing mix | 1/3 cup molasses | 1 tablespoon dry mustard | 1/2 cup low-fat yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon ( optional )
instructions: Combine ingredients in a medium bowl and mix very well. Refridgerate for a minimum of 8 hours for best flavor. Remove stuffing from refrigerator and allow to chill for several hours, so that spices permeate stuffing and flavors. Cook stuffing in skillet or over medium heat until cooked through. When fully cooked take stuffing from pan and stir in yogurt and cinnamon. Add spices and stir. Serve in tortillas, or over pasta, or use as a topping for meat and veggies.

title: Cholula's Queso
ingredients: 1/2 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/4 cup shredded colby-monterey jack cheese | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 1 teaspoon shredded fresh italian parsley | fresh ground black pepper | 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder
instructions: Stir together all ingredients. Spread onto a large, flat platter. Use your hands to spread it out to evenly distribute it. Sprinkle with papertowels or shredded cheese if desired. Cool for 30 minutes to develop the flavors. Store in a cool, dark place.

title: Figs Roasted In Red Sauce
ingredients: 5 lbs firm fresh figs, cut into wedges | 12 stalks celery salt | 1/2 cup sherry cured red pepper, chopped | 1/2 cup lemon thyme, chopped | 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 1/4 teaspoon old bay seasoning or 1/4 teaspoon black pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 475ºf. Arrange figs and celery salt in ungreased shallow 6 to 8 cup ring, spacing evenly. Place red pepper, lemon thyme, cream of celery soup and old bay seasoning or pepper in a large dutch oven, and heat over medium heat, stirring, until hot and bubbly but not simmering. Pour hot liquid evenly over figs and celery salt, sprinkle with paprika, cover loosely with foil and bake about 30 minutes. Uncover and bake until liquid is reduced to a glaze and stuffing is hot and crisp, about 20 minutes more.

title: Portuguese Squash and Chorizo Casserole #7FIX
ingredients: 6 large potatoes, about 3 pounds | 1 lb sweet potatoes or 1 lb yam, peeled and sliced across the grain into 1/4 inch slices | 1 lb chorizo sausage or 1 lb turkey chorizo sausage, sliced | 1/2 cup wine ( burgundy, chardonnay, riesling ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons tomato-flavored potato starch | 1 1/2 teaspoons turmeric ( i use szeged spice blend )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Lightly grease a 2 quart casserole dish with non stick cooking spray. Place the potato slices in a medium bowl and sprinkle with salt. Set aside. Cut the sweet potatoes into 1/4 inch slices. Place them in a large saucepan with cold water to cover. Bring to a boil and cook for about 10 minutes, just until the water starts to evaporate. Immediately drain the potatoes, and set aside. Place half the chorizo in an 8 inch skillet or a 9 inch pie plate. Add 1/2 cup of the wine or wine of choice. Bring to a boil, stir in the potato slices and turkey and return to a boil. Cover and bake for 2 hours. Mix together the tomato paste with the cornstarch, and place it into an oiled saucepan. Cook over medium heat for 10 minutes, stirring constantly. Reduce the heat and stir in the remaining wine or wine of choice. Simmer for 5 minutes. Remove the cover and bake for 15 minutes more, to thicken the sauce. Turn off the heat. Taste and add salt if needed. Serve over the casserole dish and sprinkle with the remaining chorizo.

title: Simple Pimento Peppers
ingredients: 8 pimento pepper, with their liquid | 3 tablespoons dried parsley
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with foil. Place the pimentos in a saucepan with enough water to cover with 5 to 10 large pimento pepper seeds. Bring to a boil and cook until tender but still firm, about 20 minutes for fresh peppers and 4 to 5 minutes for frozen peppers.

title: Taco Seasoning for Shrimp or Chicken
ingredients: 2 cups blood oranges ( can use orange juice packed orange rind too ) | 1 packet taco seasoning ( i like the spicy mix of taco and chili, you can use pampered chef or your own favorite )
instructions: Combine all ingredients into bowl. Add shrimp or chicken pieces.. Stir. Let sit in fridge for 1 hour before serving. Great with refried beans, burritos, etc.

title: Thai Basil Potato-Thai
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs small red potatoes | 1/4 cup of fresh thai basil | 3 tablespoons sour cream or 3 tablespoons yogurt
instructions: Place all ingredients in crock until well combined. Cover. Put lid on crock and cook on high until potatoes are tender, about 40 minutes. Serve..

title: Maggie's Hot Chocolate
ingredients: 6 ounces hot cooked ham, chopped | 1 jar vegetable juice | 1 jar roasted anchos chiles, chopped | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 1 tablespoon cocoa | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Combine ingredients in a saucepan and simmer for 10 - 15 minutes until reduced to a syrup. Cool slightly, then stir in toasted cocoa.

Random Ingredients: vegetable protein,cream,vegetable,basmati rice,crouton,tamari soy sauce,icing,italian salad dressing mix
title: Crispy Rice Salad With Dressing
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups mixed textured vegetables ( broccoli, celery tops and cauliflower ) | 1 1/2 cups basmati rice ( whole wheat or white ) | 1/2 cup sour cream | 3 tablespoons tamari soy sauce | 1 1/2 pints mixed vegetables | 1 1/4 cups icing prepared italian salad dressing mix ( storebought or see recipe below ) | 1 teaspoon vegetable oil or 1 teaspoon olive oil | crouton, for serving ( your favourite kind )
instructions: To make your rice salad place the rice grains in a bowl and rinse with several changes of cold water. Shake to dry. Add the sour cream, soy sauce, vegetable protein, and mixed vegetables to the bowl and mix thoroughly. To bake your salad place the bowl in your oven on the middle rack of your oven until piping hot and warm. Remove from the oven and pour the salad dressing into a serving bowl. Drizzle over croutons to garnish.

title: Buffalo Blueberry Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup blueberries ( fresh or unsweetened frozen ) | 1/4 cup blueberries ( fresh or unsweetened frozen ) | 1/4 cup ranch dressing ( i have used the blueberry flavor but you should not use it )
instructions: Place the berries in a medium sized glass bowl. Sprinkle the dressing over the berries and toss gently. Serve.

Random Ingredients: canola oil,espresso powder,tomato juice,millet flour,red pepper,vinegar,ice cream,chickpea
title: Smoky Refreshing Chickpeas (Vegan.)
ingredients: 1/2 cup millet flour or 1/2 cup potato flour | 1 1/2 tablespoons canola oil or 1 1/2 tablespoons canola oil, melted | 1 can chickpeas ( garbanzo beans ) | 1/4 cup dry red pepper ( finely diced ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons espresso powder | 1 1/2 tablespoons vinegar | ice cream | 1 1/2 tablespoons unsweetened instant espresso powder | 1/2 tablespoon low-fat milk
instructions: Stir fry red peppers and sugar in oil until soft. Add remaining ingredients and stir to combine. Stir fry 3 - 4 minutes. Serve hot in a tall glass with ice cream sprinkled with espresso powder..

title: Champurritto-Eintopuro
ingredients: 1 lb shrimp, cleaned and deveined | 1 pint strawberry, washed and sliced | 1 teaspoon arrowroot ( also known as cornstarch ) | 1/4 teaspoon monosodium glutamate ( optional ) | 2 dark chocolate
instructions: Place shrimp in a container with a tight fitting lid, and marinate in the refrigerator for 1 - 2 hours. Thread the shrimp onto a skewer and grill over hot coals or under a broiler until cooked through, turning as necessary and brushing with marinade every minute or two. Serve immediately. Variation, chocolates used in this dish are chocolate ganache, peanut butter, or vanilla extract with chocolate added.

title: Rice & Cream Bake
ingredients: 10 ounces arborio rice, washed | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 1/2 cup cashews, roughly chopped | 1 cup mixed dried fruit
instructions: Lightly butter an 11 1/2 x 7 x 1 1/2 inch shallow glass or ceramic baking dish. Put the rice into a heatproof bowl and pour boiling water over it. Sit for 30 mins, then drain through a fine sieve, pressing onto the rice to extract the liquid. Put the cream, cornflour and cashews into a small saucepan and bring to the boil over a medium heat, stirring until the mixture boils and thickens. Pour into the baking dish and leave to cool, then cut into squares or diamonds. Place into a lightly buttered shallow ovenproof dish. Place the mixed dried fruit into a bowl with plenty of freshly ground black pepper, then mix well into the cream. Drizzle the cream over the rice and sprinkle with dried fruit. Bake for about 40 mins, or until a skewer comes out clean.

Random Ingredients: pistachio,red cabbage,ajwain,beef stew meat,mint,tamarind paste,butternut squash,cocoa powder
title: Butternut Squash Beef Chop Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon ajwain | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 3 tablespoons chopped pistachios | 1 package refrigerated butternut squash, frozen | 1 tablespoon tamarind paste | 1 1/2 lbs beef stew meat, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 small red cabbage, cored and cut into 6 wedges
instructions: Grind the ajwain in a spice grinder or mortar and pestle. Combine the ajwain, cocoa powder, pistachios, squash, tamarind paste and meat in a large slow cooker. Bring to a boil and reduce heat to low. Cover and cook 30 minutes, or until the meat is no longer pink inside. Break the meat up into 1 inch pieces. Remove lid, stir in cabbage wedges, heat through.

Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,hard egg,mozzarella cheese,nectarine,pesto,ginger garlic paste
title: Nectarine Stuffed Mini French Toast
ingredients: 6 nectarines, cleaned and peeled | 6 hard-boiled eggs, sliced | 6 small firm mozzarella cheese | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 teaspoon cardamom pod | 4 tablespoons pesto, and basil pesto combination
instructions: Slice nectarines in half lengthwise, then crosswise into fourths. Set aside to drain for about 30 minutes. Combine nectarines, eggs, mozzarella cheese, ginger garlic paste, cardamom and pesto in bowl and beat with fork until it forms a soft mixture. Spoon mixture evenly into nectarines. Place 2 nectarines halves on each cookie sheet lined with wax paper. Sprinkle pesto on top of each nectarine half. Fold paper around nectarines and gently push to side of nectarine to contain filling. Allow to rest at room temperature 15 - 30 minutes before removing paper and wax paper.

Random Ingredients: parsnip,ice cube,roasting chicken,dinner,spinach leaf,italian turkey sausage,chili
title: Paella Filling
ingredients: 2 roasting chickens | 1 cup frozen chopped spinach leaves | 1 cup frozen chopped parsnips | 4 links hot italian turkey sausage | 1 jar chili | 3 packages dinner rolls | 1 cup crushed ice cubes
instructions: Rinse chickens and trim giblets. Place in a 9 x 5 x 3 inch roasting pan, top with spinach leaves, parsnips and hot sausage. Pour any meat juices that have gathered in the pan over the meat. Refrigerate, covered, at least 8 hours or overnight. Remove meat, sausage and vegetables from the refrigerator and place in a skillet. Remove casings of the hot sausage and chop. Stir into chicken mixture and cook over medium heat until heated through. Stir together chili and water in a small bowl and set aside. Cook rolls until golden brown. Remove roll from pan. Dip a piece of bread, crust side up, into a small amount of chili mixture then remove excess from pan. Brush roll with some of the chili mixture and place in a warm oven for 20 minutes to heat through. Slice roll in half. Serve with remaining chili sauce.

Random Ingredients: yellow onion,lemonade,popped popcorn,hard egg,red beet,fish sauce,velveeta cheese,mirin
title: Asian Beet & Egg Salad
ingredients: 6 hard-boiled eggs, hard boiled | 12 slices velveeta cheese ( thin slices ) | 12 large red beets | 1 large yellow onion | 2 cups prepared roasted sweet pickled popcorn | 1/2 cup sweet pickled poppy seeds ( optional ) | 1/2 cup sweet soy sauce or 1/2 cup mirin | 2 tablespoons fish sauce
instructions: Peel and slice onions. In a large bowl, mix together the egg strips, cheese, beets, onion and popcorn. In a small bowl, whisk the sauce ingredients together. Pour over the salad and toss to coat. Refrigerate for 1 hour or until cold.

title: Asafetida(Hot Asafoetida) Chili Powder
ingredients: 1/2 cup ground asafoetida powder | 1 cup marsala ( white sweetened or sweet ) | 1/2 teaspoon black pepper ( optional )
instructions: Combine asafetida, 1 cup marsala, and black pepper. Store any leftover powder with a tight fitting lid in the fridge.

Random Ingredients: fennel seed,water chestnut,pimiento,pork tenderloin,apricot jam,jumbo shrimp,liquid smoke,orange zest
title: Pork and Shrimp Jumbo Shrimp
ingredients: 6 tablespoons apricot jam | 2 tablespoons water chestnuts, diced | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed, crushed | 1 tablespoon dried pimentos, chopped | 1 teaspoon orange zest, minced | 1/2 lb boneless pork tenderloin, fat trimmed, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1/2 cup papricot jam | 2 tablespoons orange zest, minced | 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke | 1/4 - 1/2 cup water chestnut, sliced
instructions: In a medium saucepan, blend the apricot jam, water chestnuts, fennel seed, pimentos and orange zest. Add pork.

title: Quick and Easy Chinese Ground Beef Pastries(Crescent)
ingredients: 1 can crescent dinner rolls | 1 cup almond meal, for the crust | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 teaspoon ground beef bouillon or 1 teaspoon other spices
instructions: Heat oven to roll the can of crescent dough into a rectangle, about 10x15 inches. You won't be cutting as many as the crescents will line at once. Spread beef broth cubes on the top and sides of the dough. Spread the ground beef over the beef, leaving an inch or two of at least on each side of the rectangle to wrap around the beef and to absorb the broth. Sprinkle any spices of your choice evenly over beef. Starting with the longest edge, roll up crescents, twisting and folding to form long rolls. Brush the tops of the crescents with egg wash, and dust the crescents on with ground beef broth. Bake them at 400° for 45 minutes until golden.

title: Bread Toast & Mint - Minted Bread and Butter
ingredients: 1 loaf thick cut white bread, crusts trimmed | 1/4 of fresh mint, finely chopped
instructions: Trim bread of crusts. Slice bread into thick slices. Toss together mint and remaining half of the mint in a clean bowl. Spread bread slices with 1/4 of the mint mint butter. Fold both sides in to make a sandwich using the same flat method. Grill sandwiches for 1 to 2 minutes on each side.

title: Pandan Leaves (Rito)
ingredients: 3 lbs fresh pandan leaves | 5 -6 cloves garlic paste | 1/2 cup gin | 1/2 cup freshly grated parmesan cheese or 1/2 cup romano cheese
instructions: Put all ingredients except cheese in blender and process well for about 1 minute or until smooth. If leaves begin to stick, mix in 1 tbsp water. Spread on a serving dish and top with cheese.

Random Ingredients: cottage cheese,romaine lettuce,irish cream,zucchini,red wine vinegar,turmeric,mexican cheese,salsa
title: Savory Veggie Slaw
ingredients: 2 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar or 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 2 1/2 tablespoons dried chipotle powder turmeric | 4 cups zucchini, julienned ( about 3 medium zucchini ) | 1 cup cottage cheese | 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric | 4 teaspoons salsa | 4 teaspoons sour cream ( no fat ) | 1 1/2 cups romaine lettuce, torn into bite-sized pieces | 1 1/2 cups mexican cheese, shredded
instructions: In a large bowl, combine vinegar, salt and the 2 1/2 tbsp chipotle powder. Stir in zucchini and let sit for 5 minutes. Meanwhile, in a blender, mix cottage cheese, 2 tsp turmeric and salsa. Stir puree into the zucchini. Add sour cream and fold in the mexican cheese and lettuce. Divide mixture between a sprayed 10x15 baking dish. Broil in a 425°f oven until bubbly and beginning to brown, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: garam masala,elbow macaroni,chicken breast half,fuji apple,red wine vinegar,jumbo shrimp,tomato green chilies,chili
title: Shrimp Shrimp Kebabs
ingredients: 1 lb uncooked jumbo shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 medium tomatoes and green chilies, seeded and chopped | 3/4 cup elbow macaroni, cooked | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons garam masala | 2 teaspoons chili, seeds and stems removed | 2 tablespoons minced jumbo shrimp | 1 tablespoon minced fresh chili | 1 1/2 teaspoons diced firm tofu or 1 1/2 teaspoons ground pork
instructions: Toss the shrimp with the tomato, green chilies, macaroni, vinegar, garam masala, chili seed, and minced shrimp. Season with chili. Divide the shrimp mixture among four serving plates. To make the spicy garam masala sauce, combine chili, shrimp, and tofu with 1/2 cup water, and pour over salads. Cover and chill for 30 minutes to marinate. Serve salad bowls at once.

title: Karela and Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups fresh broccoli florets | 3/4 cup chopped red onion | 2 fresh dried hot red chilies, chopped | 2 tablespoons capers, drained | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 2 fresh karela
instructions: Thoroughly rinse the broccoli and chilies. Toss with onion, chillies, capers, marjoram and cream of tartar. Marinate for at least 2 hour. Break a few chips with a fork and serve.

title: Roasted Chicken Pasta Toss
ingredients: 3 large shallots, halved lengthways | 150 g pumpkin seeds | 2 tablespoons capers | 300 ml tomato puree | 1 1/2 kg roasting chickens | 1 liter parmesan cheese, shaved into 2 x 3 cm lengths
instructions: Preheat oven to 180ºc. Place shallots, pumpkin seeds, capers, and tomato puree in a food processor and process until smooth. Place roasting chicken in a roasting tin, pour the roasted vegetable mixture into and around the chicken, then spoon over the meat juices that are collected. Top with parmesan. Bake for 45 - 50 minutes, until chicken is just cooked. Remove chicken to a carving board or board. Skim as much fat as possible from the pan juices and return to the heat. Dice chicken into bite size pieces. Serve with pasta and a green veg on the side.

title: Cajun Beef for the BBQ
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs skirt steak | 1 can chopped ancho chilies, undrained | 1 jar roasted red peppers, strips drained
instructions: Cut the meat into 1 cubes and place in a slow cooker. Combine the chilies and red peppers and drizzle over the meat. Cover and cook on low for 8 to 10 hours, or on high for 3 to 4 hours. Serve with french rolls, rice, or mashed potatoes.

title: Muamba's Saffron Chicken
ingredients: 4 -9 lbs chicken ( thighs, breasts, drumsticks, meaty chicken portions... up to you ) | 4 bags fresh spinach | 0.5 package saffron | 1 jar guacamole
instructions: Rinse chicken very well with cool water. Pat dry with paper towels and place in a large pot. Cover the chicken with cold water and add saffron. The water should cover the chicken but it shouldn't touch the meat it doesn't matter if water covers most of the chicken. Place chicken in pot and cover with cold water. The water should never come to touch the chicken or the saffron. Allow the chicken to come to room temperature. Turn heat to 250°f and cook for about 20 hours. You should have a water bath of sorts when finished. If water does not stop boiling away, raise heat to 300°f. Note, the longer you bring to room temperature, the more tender you will be. After 20 minutes, turn off the heat and take chicken out and blot with paper towels to remove any traces of the saffron from the meat.

title: Cured Salmon
ingredients: 1 cup rye breadcrumbs | butter or margarine, for greasing dish
instructions: Place breadcrumbs in large bowl. Dip salmon in breadcrumbs coating completely. Place on a plate covered with parchment and refrigerate for at least 20 minutes before grilling or baking. Spray or brush griddle lightly with butter or margarine or oil. Grill salmon for 6 - 8 minutes on each side or until cooked. Serve with your favourite sauce or mustard.

Random Ingredients: parsley leaf,tilapia fillet,marsala wine,turmeric,thyme,rice vinegar,lemon peel
title: Spicy Tilapia Salad With Marsala Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs tilapia fillets, filets | 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 1/4 cup marsala wine | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1/4 cup fresh parsley leaves, minced | 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon | 1/4 teaspoon of dried thyme | 1 tablespoon grated lemon peel
instructions: Coat large sauté pan with nonstick cooking spray. Add tilapia fillets, and sauté until golden and opaque throughout, and barely cooked through.. Drain on paper towels, and allow to sit for 5 minutes. Combine the vinaigrette ingredients in a small bowl and set aside. Cut fillets into 1 inch wide strips, and toss to combine. Serve with salad.

title: Curried Cauliflower (Or Other Vegetables)
ingredients: 1 medium cauliflower, about 12-18 | 1 -2 teaspoon curry powder | 1/3 cup chopped fresh parsley
instructions: In a large casserole dish, place a generous layer of water on top. Cover and cook for about 25 - 30 minutes or until cauliflower is completely cooked. Add the remaining ingredients and stir to evenly coat. Serve.

Random Ingredients: poblano chile,mini chocolate chip,bell pepper,black mission fig,soy sauce,penne pasta,vegetable broth
title: Pasta Primavera
ingredients: 12 ounces penne pasta | 1 cup frozen vegetables with broccoli and pimento peppers | 1 cup chopped bell pepper | 16 ounces regular soy sauce | 1/2 cup finely chopped poblano chiles | 8 ounces mini chocolate chips | 2 1/2 cups low sodium vegetable broth
instructions: Preheat a large pot of salted water to boil. Season the pasta with salt, and transfer to a large serving bowl. Place the frozen vegetables in a pot with enough water just to cover. Bring to a boil, and cook for 5 minutes, or until tender but still firm. Drain, and set aside. Reserve 1 cup of the water. Place the vegetables and the reserved 1 cup of water in the bowl with the pasta, and toss to combine. Heat the soy sauce in a large saucepan, and stir in the poblano, bell pepper, and eggs. Cover, and set aside, about 10 minutes. To serve, place the pasta in the bottom of a large serving dish, and pour the veggies over. Sprinkle with parmesean cheese, and top with chocolate chips. Serve with black mission figs optional.

Random Ingredients: vegetable shortening,amish friendship bread starter,corn oil
title: Amish Friendship Breadsticks
ingredients: 1 bottle amish friendship bread starter | 1/2 cup vegetable shortening | 1 or cup corn oil
instructions: Mix starter with shortening and oil. Add more if needed. Form into 1 dozen sticks, place on a tray and cover with plastic wrap. Chill, and rise until doubled in size. Bake in preheated 300 degree oven 15 - 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: black mustard seed,taco seasoning mix,seasoning mix,pastry,butter,pork loin chop,strawberry jam
title: Grilled Cuban Pork Chops
ingredients: 4 pork loin chops, 1-1/2 inches thick | butter | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning mix | 1 teaspoon ground black mustard seeds | pimento stuffed olive, halved | 0.5 store-bought pastry for sandwiches ( recommended ( pillsbury ) | 1/4 cup strawberry jam
instructions: Rinse chops, pat dry, and cut into 4 portions. On a lightly greased griddle, cook pork until well browned, 1 to 2 minutes each side. Remove from grill and let stand while making gravy. Prepare gravy by placing jam in small bowl and heating over low heat, stirring constantly. Remove from heat and set aside. Cook chops in remaining skillet over medium heat for 5 minutes on each side or until instant read thermometer reads 120 degrees f. Brush chops with butter and sprinkle with seasoned salt. Add gravy and cook until sauce thickens slightly, stirring often, about 3 minutes. Slice chops, arrange on warmed platter and pour remaining gravy over. Serve immediater with warm corn bread. Garnish with pimento stuffed olives.

title: Beef Gravy (Beef Steak)
ingredients: olive oil | 1 1/2 cups beef broth
instructions: Heat oil in a saucepan over med high heat. Add the olive oil and pour in the broth. When broth comes to a boil, cover and simmer for 15 minutes. You might have to skim off some of the foam as the beef broth cooks, and add some salt and pepper while you are waiting for the broth to heat up.

Random Ingredients: turmeric,spice,grape tomato,olive oil cooking spray,garam masala
title: Mirchi Dukkah (Dukkah Style Tomato Cakes)
ingredients: 1 lb grape tomatoes ( approximately, about ) | 5 tablespoons olive oil flavored cooking spray ( i use pam ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons garam masala | 1 1/4 cups pravekah ( moroccan spice mix ) or 1 1/4 cups other spice blend ( i use zaar ) | 1 1/4 teaspoons turmeric
instructions: Wash a few grape tomatoes and cut off stem ends, if desired. Carefully scoop out the inside of the tomatoes and place in a colander to drain.

title: Mango-Stamped Shredded Pork
ingredients: 2 lbs pork blade roast, trim fat | 4 -6 fresh mangoes ( sliced into thin wedges and cut off the stone ) | 4 tablespoons black dark rum ( optional ) | 1 -2 cup unbleached white flour | cooking spray
instructions: If planning to serve immediately, place pork in large bowl.

title: Prawn and Ham Salad (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 3 )
ingredients: 24 large prawns, cleaned | 120 g deli ham
instructions: Wash prawns, remove heads and shells. Devein if large. Cut ham into 5cm cubes. Place prawns on a large plate. Arrange prawns on top of prawns, add 2nd piece of ham on top to cover. Cover with remaining ham, then wrap in foil and place in the fridge to chill. This recipe can also be eaten the day before, or just to go with a refreshing lunch.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,cottage cheese,fig,feta cheese,buckwheat groat,chipotle powder
title: Buckingwheat Stuffed Salmon Fillets
ingredients: 1/3 cup feta cheese, crumbled | 1 tablespoon goat cheese or 1 tablespoon goat cheese, crumbles | 1 tablespoon cottage cheese, low fat | 1/4 teaspoon dried chipotle powder ( to garnish ) | 2 tablespoons dried figs, coarsely chopped | 1 lb salmon fillets, skinless, boneless on the 1st side
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 and spray a baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray. Combine feta, goat cheese, cottage cheese, dried chipotle & figs in a small bowl. Cut a pocket deep in salmon fillet & stuff center with mixture, packing the filling in well, ensuring that it coats the pocket. Set aside. Pour 1/2 inch cooking oil into a 12 inch oven proof frying pan. Place salmon fillet in pan and cook 12 minutes. Remove fillet from pan. Carefully remove the stuffing from the pan and scoop out the stuffing. Using the back of a knife or a spoon or spatula, scrape up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan. Return stuffing to pan and bake 10 minutes or until heated through. Carefully slide fillet onto serving platter. Drizzle stuffing with a little more cooking oil, garnish with dried figs, serve or serve with side dish of couscous.

title: Chinese Steamed Artichokes
ingredients: 4 ounces dried artichoke hearts | 2 teaspoons chinese five spice powder | 2 1/2 cups chicken stock or 2 1/2 cups broth
instructions: Dry the artichokes on paper towels. Place them in a steaming basket in a saucepan. Add the stock or broth and the five spice powder and bring to a boil. Lower heat and cover and steam for 12 - 15 minutes. Remove and allow the artichokes to drain before serving.

title: Aubergine and Almond Soup
ingredients: 2 large aubergines, sliced | 4 ounces dried cherries tomatoes ( or other dry red plums ) | 5 cups milk | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 2 drops cream or 2 drops milk | 8 ounces all-purpose flour
instructions: Drop the aubergines into boiling water and leave to soften. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on absorbent paper. Remove the aubergine flesh and slice lengthways as thinly as possible, then cut into very thin slices. Place the apricots, tomatoes, milk, garam masala and cream in a pan and stir well. Simmer together, uncovered, for 30 minutes. Remove from the heat, cool slightly. Meanwhile, mix the flour with just enough water to form a thin paste. Use two large soup spoons to press the paste into the hot liquid in the soup spoons. Pour boiling stock back into the pan and stir, to blend the aubergines into the soup. Cover and simmer for 2 minutes. Pour into bowls and serve hot.

title: Pan-Fried Anise Bread
ingredients: 8 cups self-rising flour | 2/3 cup half-and-half | 12 teaspoons anise seed ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Knead until smooth, approximately 2 minutes. Let rise until double. Cut into 1/8 inch slices. Heat a heavy medium pan or cast iron frying pan. Dip slices in batter.

Random Ingredients: fruit,flour tortilla,kaffir lime leaf,active yeast,green bell pepper,clear honey,asafoetida powder,tilapia fillet
title: Fried Asafoetida Fish and Veggies
ingredients: 3 cups flour tortillas, cut into 1/4 in.m | 1 lb asafoetida ( fish thickener ) | 2 green bell peppers | 1/2 cup mixed fruit | 1 tablespoon clear honey | 2 green kaffir lime leaves, minced | 1 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 4 -5 lbs tilapia fillets
instructions: Heat oil in skillet over medium heat. Meanwhile, in large bowl of food processor, combine asafetida, green bell peppers, mixed fruit, honey, lime leaves, yeast, and kaffir lime leaves. Process until very smooth. Transfer to large bowl. Add meat and mix well. Cover and let rise about 1 hour. Dip fish into batter. Fry in hot oil on both sides until browned and cooked through.

Random Ingredients: coconut cream,caper,beef broth,maraschino cherry,tuna water,rosemary leaf,szechwan pepper
title: Cantonese Tuna-Cream Heart-Chop
ingredients: 2 cans tuna in water | 1 cup condensed beef broth | 1 can coconut cream | 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh rosemary leaves, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons szechwan pepper ( timur ) | 1/4 cup capers, drained and rinsed | 5 maraschino cherries, for garnish
instructions: Drain both cans of tuna and save liquid. Combine beef broth, coconut cream, rosemary, saffron, capers, and maraschino cherries in a stockpot and heat. To serve, divide tuna mix and cherry sauce among 4 to 10 serving plates. Garnish with fresh rosemary sprig.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,coconut cream,egg substitute,cilantro,chipotle pepper,peach,honey,white onion
title: Spiced Omelette With Peach
ingredients: 2 eggs or 1 egg substitute | 1/4 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 1 small white onion | 2 teaspoons canned chipotle peppers | 1 1/4 cups unsweetened coconut cream | 1 tablespoon honey | 2 tablespoons diced fresh cilantro | chili pepper flakes ( optional )
instructions: Heat a nonstick pan over medium high heat, spray with nonstick cooking spray if desired. Add the eggs to the pan and cook for 1 minute, turning once. Spread the chili flakes over the top of the omelette and set aside for 1 minute. Add the peppers to the pan and cook for 3 minutes until hot pepper flakes are evenly distributed throughout. Stir in the coconut cream and honey until well combined and cook for 1 minute. Remove from heat and sprinkle with cilantro. Pile the hot pepper pancake onto the hot pancake and serve.

Random Ingredients: seasoning salt,green cardamom pod,applesauce,splenda granular,wheat spaghetti,oil,arborio rice,avocado dip
title: Avocado and Green cardamom Risotto
ingredients: 1 tablespoon oil | 1 cup arborio rice | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1/2 cup unsweetened apple salsa or 1/2 cup regular salsa | 2 1/2 cups 2 % low fat cottage cheese | 2 tablespoons powdered avocado dip | 1 green cardamom pod, finely minced | 1 pinch splenda granular
instructions: Cook the rice according to package directions. When done, drain the rice and set aside. Warm the oil in a small skillet, stirring. Add the rice and cooking liquid. Stir until all of the water is absorbed, about 5 minutes. Add the salsa, mix well. Remove from heat and add the avocado dip and green cardamom pods. Place a plate on top. When the rice is done, place it in the plate, put on a large serving dish, and spoon some of the avocado and salsa mixture over it.

title: Ghoraybeh
ingredients: 1 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 2 tablespoons ghee ( clarified butter ) | 1/2 teaspoon lemon zest, grated ( zest from 1 lemon )
instructions: If using large shrimp, cut down on the back of the shrimp and discard the peel. Melt the ghee and the zest together in a small saucepan over low heat. Add the shrimp and, stirring until they are coated with the syrup, and continue cooking over medium low heat until the shrimp are just cooked through and the shrimp are bright pink and firm. Serve immediately.

title: Guilt Free Onion-Flesh Powder Mix
ingredients: 3 teaspoons smoked paprika ( or other mild smoked paprika ) | 1/2 teaspoon cocoa powder ( i use hershey's dark chocolate paprika )
instructions: Mix ingredients in a bowl to blend. Store in an airtight container for up to a week, or store in the freezer for up to 3 months.

title: Chinese Charred Orange and Raisin Salad

title: Red Chile Chile Enchiladas in Red Wine Jelly With Asiago Cheese

title: Chili-And-Potato Burritos
