ingredients: 4 lbs chicken wings, tips trimmed and tips trimmed | 8 slices prosciutto | 2 packages frozen broccoli florets, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Arrange chicken wings on a lightly greased large baking sheet. With a spoon, make deep slits in the wings. Insert a prosciutto piece into each one. Bake in a preheated oven until chicken is no longer pink in the center, about 20 minutes. Set onions, broccoli, and prosciutto on a platter and drizzle with a little of their cooking juices. Serve.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon,ginger garlic paste,mint sprig,dill,jalapeno jack cheese
title: Dilled Jalapeno Jack Cheese Dip With Fresh Herbs
ingredients: 2 cups jalapeno jack cheese, cubed | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic flavored instant chicken bouillon | 1 tablespoon dried mint sprig | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried dill | fresh mint sprig ( optional )
instructions: Dissolve the ginger garlic paste in 1 1/2 cups warm water, then add in the cubed cheese. Stir in the dried mint leaves and dill. Cover and chill in the refrigerator for a couple of hours to allow flavors to blend. Serve warm with toasted bagels or crackers. Enjoy.

title: Artichoke and Cinnamon Spiced Pasta With Beans
ingredients: 1 package angel hair pasta or ( 16 ounce ) package rotini pasta | 14 1/2 ounces artichoke hearts, in their liquid, drained | 1/2 1/2 cup masala or 1/2 cup cornstarch | cinnamon sugar, for sprinkling
instructions: Cook pasta as directed, drain. Toss with artichokes, masala. Sprinkle with cinnamon sugar. Serve cold.

title: Swiss Cheese, Not Thousand Island Style!
ingredients: 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 8 ounces swiss cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat broiler to high. Place cheese on a slice of swiss cheese. Broil until melted and starting to brown.

title: Braised Caramelized Onions
ingredients: 4 pounds sweet spanish onions | 1 cup turbinado sugar | 1/2 cup whipping cream | 1 package rigatoni pasta
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Mix the sugar and cream in a baking dish just large enough to hold the onions and onions. Bake covered for 1 hour. Add the rigatoni and bake for 40 minutes more. Turn off oven and let onions rest until dry, about 5 hours.

title: Ktipsy Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 lb sweet italian turkey sausage or 1 lb hot italian sausage, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 1 large baking potato, cut into chunks | 1 - 1 1/2 cup prepared spaghetti sauce | ground cinnamon, to taste ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Place sausage and potato in a medium size frying pan. Stir to combine and cover. Cook for 20 - 25 minutes on medium high heat until sausage just begins to brown, stirring occasionally. Remove from heat. In a small bowl, combine spaghetti sauce, and cinnamon. Toss to coat. Put sausage, potato and any drippings in a large casserole dish. Cover, and bake for 30 - 40 minutes stirring occasionally. It should be lightly browned. Serve with a sprinkling of cinnamon.

title: Spiced Mexican Grape Leaf Salad
ingredients: 1 package frozen grape leaves, thawed and dried | 3/4 cup colby cheese, shredded | 3 tablespoons half-and-half | 1 tablespoon tamari or 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Cook the frozen grape leaves in boiling water until tender, about 2 minutes. Drain well and cool slightly. Spread the cheese on the bottom half of a grape leaf and top with 1 - 2 tablespoons each of the colby cheese and grape leaves. Mix the next 7 ingredients and pour over the top. Let stand at room temperature for an hour before serving.

title: Sweet Potato & Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 cup shiitake mushrooms | 1 small red potato, peeled and sliced | 1/4 cup brown sugar | 1 pinch ground cloves | 1 pinch ground sumac
instructions: Wash and cut mushroom caps into very large pieces. Bring a large pan of water to the boil over high heat. Add shiitake mushrooms and red potato to the boiling water and cook for 3 - 5 minutes. Drain and put into a bowl of cold water. Remove caps and discard. Place brown sugar and spices in a microwave safe bowl. Heat in the microwave for 5 - 6 minutes, stirring every 2 - 3 minutes. The mixture should be hot and bubbling. Spread this onto the bed of mushrooms and gently press down with a palm of hands. Allow excess water to drip out of the mushrooms, then spread the hot sugar syrup over the mushroom slices.

title: Vanilla Pasta Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup brandy ( optional ) | 1/4 cup sesame oil or 1/4 cup vegetable oil | 2 tablespoons vanilla essence | 2 cups italian dressing ( any flavour to your taste )
instructions: Put all together in a bowl or small bowl and put in the fridge to develop the flavours. When ready to serve, let it sit for a few minutes until it is reduced for you.

title: Oriental Oyster Sauce Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon fresh sweet rice wine | 2 teaspoons minced oyster sauce
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together sweet rice wine and oyster sauce. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Beet Vins
ingredients: 500 g sliced beets | 2 tablespoons dark rum | 1 tablespoon port wine
instructions: Place sliced beets in a colander and sprinkle with salt, place in a bowl, cover with plastic wrap and leave to stand overnight. The next day drain. When the beets are cool enough to handle, peel off skin. Discard the skins. Mash beets using a fork until small lumps of raw beet have formed. Place into a mixing bowl. Add rum, port and rum into the same bowl and mix well. Pour over the sliced beets and stir to combine. Cover and chill for 4 hours or up to a day. This dish is excellent served with bread and pickles, and is easily multiplied to cater for variations.

Random Ingredients: brown mustard,kalamata olive,flax seed,confectioner ' sugar,herb,white onion,cannellini bean,heavy whipping cream
title: Cannellini Beans With Sun-Dried Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 medium white onion, finely chopped | 1/3 cup olive oil or 1/3 cup cooking oil | 2/3 cup heavy whipping cream | 2 tablespoons ground flax seeds | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped fresh mixed herbs | chopped kalamata olives ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon white mustard | 1/4 cup confectioners'sugar, sifted
instructions: Fry onion in oil until brown and onion transparent, about 5 minutes. Stir in beans and cook about 5 to 7 minutes. Stir in heavy whipping cream, ground flaxseed, chopped fresh herbs, and kalamata olives. Bring to boil over medium heat, stirring as needed. Cook about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and cool to room temperature. Cover and chill at least 1 hour, up to overnight. Stir in mustard and adjust seasoning. Transfer to a 1 1/2 quart casserole dish and chill 1 to 2 hours longer until ready to serve. Serve warm or room temperature. Garnish with confectioners' sugar.

Random Ingredients: yogurt,chocolate coffee bean,vegetarian bean,green cabbage,yoghurt,broccoli floret,plain nonfat yogurt
title: The Best Low Fat Chocolate Soup Ever
ingredients: 1/4 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1/4 cup green cabbage, shredded | 1/4 cup vegetarian baked beans | 1/4 cup broccoli floret | 1/4 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1 tablespoon low-fat yoghurt | 4 tablespoons low-fat yogurt | 1 tablespoon chocolate flavored coffee-flavored instant coffee-banana flavoring ( e.g. kahlua )
instructions: Garnish soup bowls with mint leaves.

title: Artichoke-Almond Drink (Mongolian)
ingredients: 1 cup water-packed artichoke hearts, thawed and finely chopped | 1 teaspoon finely grated peeled fresh gingerroot
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a blender and blend on high speed until the mixture is thick and smooth.

title: French Beans With Sage
ingredients: 8 ounces french dressing | 4 ounces fresh sage leaves | 1 can baked beans
instructions: Pour french dressing into a bowl, add sage leaves. Stir. Add baked beans and stir to combine. Serve immediately or heat in oven for 15 minutes or until hot.

Random Ingredients: rice wine,relish,rosemary,ha avocado,beef tenderloin steak,wheat flour,rose water,creole mustard
title: Beef Tataki With Avocado Salad
ingredients: 3/4 cup whole wheat flour | 1/4 cup sweet-hot mustard | 1/4 cup creole mustard | 3 tablespoons honey mustard | 2 tablespoons rose water | 1 tablespoon fresh rosemary, minced ( can also use 2 tbsp. dried ) | 2 hass avocados, halved lengthwise and thinly sliced ( about 1 cup each ) | 1/2 lb beef tenderloin steak, cut into 1/2 inch cubes
instructions: Heat flour in medium bowl until mixture is bubbly, stirring constantly. Stir in 1/4 the sweet+hot&#8260.

title: Tofu, Vermicelli and Fruit Appetizer
ingredients: 12 ounces firm tofu | 12 ounces medium sweet vermicelli, broken into pieces | 1/2 cup pancetta, thinly sliced | 3 tablespoons margarine ( not butter ) or 3 tablespoons butter ( not butter ) | 1/4 cup simple syrup | 1 pint grapefruit, juice of ( juice of ) | 1/2 cup creme fraiche, to serve
instructions: Place the tofu and vermicelli in a glass or ceramic bowl and sprinkle on the pancetta. In a small saucepan over high heat, melt the margarine, then stir in the simple syrup and grapefruit juice. Cook over low heat, stirring occasionally, to keep from scorching, for 2 to 3 minutes. Pour over the tofu mixture and stir to coat. Serve at once with creme fraiche.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,orange zest,tomato green chilies,nori,soymilk,barbecue seasoning,aubergine
title: Beetroot Mini Meatballs With A.1. Chilies & A.2
ingredients: 1 large baubergine ( eggplant ) | 1 bunch fresh tomato and green chilies, plus extra | grated orange zest | 1 1/2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 2 1/2 tablespoons barbecue seasoning | 3 tablespoons soy milk | 2 teaspoons dark soy sauce | 1 sheet nori, toasted
instructions: Trim top 1/2 cup of gill from baubergine.

Random Ingredients: marjoram,kalamata olive,creamy peanut butter,nonstick cooking spray,cilantro leaf
title: Simple Nummus
ingredients: nonstick cooking spray | 1/3 cup creamy peanut butter | 3 kalamata olives, halved | 3 pinches marjoram | fresh cilantro leaves, for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Lightly spray an ovenproof dish with cooking spray. In a small bowl, stir the peanut butter into the peanut butter. Place a handful of pita halves on the bottom of the dish. Top with 1/3 of the peanut butter mixture in a line. Add 1/3 of the olives. Repeat with remaining pita, olives, remaining peanut butter mixture, and remaining olives. Spread the peanut butter mixture over top. Sprinkle with the marjoram. Cover the dish with a kitchen towel. Bake in a preheated oven until the nassarloos are crispy, about 15 minutes.

title: Leche Chicken Wings
ingredients: 3 lbs pork fat ( i used 1 lb. and 1 pound ) | 1 teaspoon ground cayenne pepper | 1 tablespoon finely grated lemon zest | 4 lbs chicken wings
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Trim wings of visible fat. Place chicken wings in foil large enough to fit in a 10x15 inch pan. Place wings in a small bowl and sprinkle with cayenne pepper and lemon zest. Arrange wings in pan. Bake, basting with cayenne pepper and lemon zest every 30 minutes, until chicken is tender with color and fat, about 2 hours.

title: Chopstick Chipotle Roasted Chickpeas and Cauliflower
ingredients: 2 tablespoons kosher salt, or more if needed | 1 head cauliflower, trimmed and cut into thin wedges | 2 tablespoons chopped chipotle chiles, or more if needed ( wear gloves ) | 1 green pepper, cut into 1/4-inch dice | 1 banana, cut into 1/4-inch dice
instructions: Preheat an oven to 425°f line a baking sheet with foil, and spray lightly with nonstick cooking spray. Put the cauliflower in a large bowl, and toss generously with salt until evenly coated. Spread the cauliflower onto the baking sheet. Roast until tender when pierced with a point of a knife, about 45 minutes. Let cool for a few minutes. Cooks' note, chipotle peppers have a shelf life of about 3 to 4 days in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: lime,hazelnut oil,vanilla flavoring,bourbon,orange bell pepper,chicken bouillon
title: Pounded Citrus Tea
ingredients: 6 cups fresh ground hazelnuts in oil | 2 1/2 teaspoons chicken bouillon | 2 limes, juiced | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla flavoring | 1 orange bell pepper, finely diced | 1/2 teaspoon bourbon
instructions: Place ground hazelnuts in a blender.

title: Gosh-Gosh Root Stew with Curry
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs root fries, peeled and thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon fennel seed | 2 tablespoons curry paste | 1 tablespoon paprika | 1 tablespoon vegetable broth or 1 tablespoon butter | 1 tablespoon fennel seeds | 2 lbs potatoes, scrubbed ( about 2-3 cups ) | 1/4 cup guacamole, warmed ( may be substitued with salsa ) | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Fry root fries in oil in a soup pot in batches until golden brown. Drain on paper towels. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, combine 1/4 cup of the curry paste with the paprika and set aside. Sprinkle fennel and fennel seed over root fries. Add potato, 1/4 cup of curry paste, and 1/4 cup of the water. Stir well. Cover and simmer 20 minutes, or until potatoes are tender and most of the liquid is absorbed. Add more water if necessary.

title: Crock Pot Caramelized Apple and Beef
ingredients: 3/4 red cabbage, chopped | 1/2 cup chopped celery | 1 can cooked ham, chopped | 1 jar stewed meat, chopped | 1/2 cup apple juice | 2 tablespoons brown sugar | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1/8 teaspoon ground cinnamon
instructions: In the skillet you used for stewed meat, combine chopped cabbage, chopped celery and chopped ham, and brown sugar, and cook for 2 minutes. Place in crock pot. Stir in apple juice, vanilla, and cinnamon. Cover and cook on low for 4 hours. Serve over hot buttered noodles or rice.

title: Currant Jam  for Cornish Pastry
ingredients: 1 lb currants | 1/4 lb red pepper, seeded and chopped | 1 1/2 lbs pastry for double-crust pie
instructions: Wash and dry the currants finely. Put the currants in a pan with the red pepper, making sure the mixture is coated by the liquid. Cover, simmer until tender, about 45 - 60 mins. Remove the pepper and mash with a spoon. Stir back into the jam if desired. Roll out each pastry sheet to a 6 1/8 8 in circle on a lightly floured surface. Place into a pie tin, put a spoonful of the currant jam on top, then bring the edges up to the top. Cook in a preheated oven about 25 c for 10 minute or until pastry is puffed and golden. Serve.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,bratwurst,cinnamon sugar,spanish onion,hamburger,onion powder,chorizo sausage
title: Crazy Rum Burger
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 1/2 lb spanish chorizo sausage | 1 small onion | 1/2 lb spicy cured hamburger | 1 tablespoon light cinnamon sugar | 2 teaspoons onion powder | 1 teaspoon dark rum
instructions: Brown hamburger and chorizo together with onions and spices. Strain. Put browned hamburger mix into large bowl or loaf pan and add chorizo. Mix and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: garam masala,chunky peanut butter,baby corn,brown gravy mix,almond paste,garlic clove
title: Indian Sweetcorn Dip
ingredients: 1 can baby sweetcorn, drained | 2 tablespoons almond paste | 2 tablespoons chunky peanut butter | 2 tablespoons garam masala | 2 garlic cloves, minced | 1 envelope brown gravy mix
instructions: In a bowl mash corn with a fork and mix well with other ingredients. Place in a bowl and refrigerate for at least one hour. Serve chilled or at room temperature. May also be served warm.

title: Pasta With Tomatoes and Shells
ingredients: 1 lb pasta shells or 1 lb shellfish, cut into bite size pieces
instructions: Bring large pot of water to a boil and cook the shells in it for 2 minutes. Drain and add them to the boiling water. Keep the water on a very low simmer. Toss and cook for 9 - 10 minutes until most of the tentacles curl away from the shells. Note that the pasta should be just a little softer than normal. Drain completely and serve.

title: Green Olives Tapas
ingredients: 1 cup pitted green olives ( or marinated, pitted lima beans ) | 7 whole wheat pita bread | your favourite wine ( optional )
instructions: Place the olives and the beans in a food processor and process for about 1 - 2 minutes until fine. Spread the mixture onto each of the pita breads and place them in a baking dish. Pour a little wine over if desired. Bake at 200c for 10 minutes or until the bread edges have turned golden brown.

Random Ingredients: tomatillo salsa,de arbol,lime juice zest,serrano pepper,russet potato,corn chip
title: Taquitos (Potatoes for Tacos & Sandwiches)
ingredients: 5 lbs russet potatoes | 1 jar tomatillo salsa | 1 can petite diced tomatoes and green chilies | 1 lime, juice and zest of | 1 serrano pepper, thinly sliced | corn chips
instructions: In a large pot of salted boiling water boil the potatoes until tender, about 30 minutes. Meanwhile, place the tomatillo salsa, tomatoes, and chiles in a blender and juice each one until they are about the consistency of tomato sauce. When the potatoes are fork tender, mash with a potato masher. Add the tomato sauce and lime zest to the potatoes and stir until well mixed. Chill for at least 1 hour, stirring the mixture every so often so that it doesnt scorch on the bottom. Slice the peppers into strips and toss with the chips.

title: Fondant (French Grilled Cheese)
ingredients: 7 1/2 ounces queso blanco or 7 1/2 ounces ricotta salata ( 4 1/2 ounces ) | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder, lightly crushed | 3 1/2 ounces sliced black olives | 1 1/2 1 1/2 ounces grated gruyere cheese | 1/2 cup mild salsa | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish cream or 2 tablespoons baileys | 1/2 tablespoon sliced plum
instructions: Slice cheeses in half horizontally. Cut a slit lengthwise down the center almost all the way to the top, forming a small pocket, and fill the pocket with cheese mixture. Sprinkle olives, cheese and salsa over cheese and set aside. Mix cheese and malted butter together in a small bowl. Dip both sides of each cheese slice into melted butter. Set aside. Grill cheese over medium heat, 4 minutes or until cheese melts.

title: Chipotle Cod
ingredients: 2 lbs cod, fresh | 1 cup chopped roasted red peppers | 3 chipotle chiles in adobo, finely diced, canned with 1 can of chipotles
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large zip bag.

title: Italian Pepper Rice
ingredients: 1 cup long grain rice | 1 jar pepperoncini peppers
instructions: Wash it and soak it in water for 5 days. Drain water and rinse it well. Soak the rice for 2 days. Bring it to a boil. When it boils, add pepperoncini mushrooms and water. Cover, immediately remove from heat, allow to sit for 2 days.

title: Grilled Fish With Radish, Corn and Orange on an Apron and Apron
ingredients: 6 ears fresh corn | 4 radishes | 1/2 cup mixed fresh herbs | 3 oranges | crushed pepper flakes
instructions: Grill, with grill grates to desired doneness. Cut fish into serving pieces. Place fish, corn and orange in a heavy duty glass or ceramic bowl. Remove peel from oranges over fish. Add herbs. Sprinkle with salt and pepper flakes.

title: Wine Greens
ingredients: 2 bunches collard greens | 1/2 cup sour cream
instructions: Wash the bunches individually and cut out and discard any stems that float to the top. Separate the greens and cut from stems to a thickness of 1 inch. Wash each section in a colander, pulling off the tough stalks just underneath the leaves. Slice 1/2 inch thick, and put a portion on each of the greens, leaving a few for a handle if any. Sprinkle a little of the sour cream evenly on top, and set aside. Repeat with the remaining greens. Serve with a little or all of the remaining sour cream as an appetizer.

Random Ingredients: walnut,sharp cheddar cheese,milk,seasoning salt,kalamata olive,angel hair pasta
title: Greek-Style Macaroni and Cheese
ingredients: 3/4 cup milk | 1/3 cup sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 lb fresh angel hair pasta | 1/4 cup kalamata olive, sliced | 2 tablespoons walnuts, toasted
instructions: Pour milk into medium saucepan. Cook over medium heat for 3 or 4 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in cheese and seasoning salt. Set aside. Cook pasta in boiling water, or as directed on package and drain. Rinse with cold water. Drain. Transfer to large bowl and toss with milk cheese mixture and chopped olives. Sprinkle with walnuts and serve.

title: Creamy Gherkin Macaroni and Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 large cauliflower floret, finely chopped | 2 medium parsnips, finely chopped | 2 cups cooked macaroni | 1 cup chopped macaroni | 125 g cheddar cheese | 1/2 cup dried cranberries | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cherries
instructions: Cook macaroni separately until cooked. Preheat the oven to 300ºf. Mix and melt the cheese. Add remaining macaroni/vegetables. Mix and transfer to a large casserole. Sprinkle with the cheese. Bake for 1½ hours, stirring once or twice, till browned.

title: Chilli & Chilli Scones
ingredients: 500 g cake flour | 200 g caster sugar | 2 tablespoons bacon grease, melted | 1 teaspoon chili pepper, finely chopped
instructions: Sift flour into a large bowl& stir in sugar. Make a well in the centre & pour combined oil& chillies into this. Knead mixture into a firm dough. Turn onto a well floured surface& knead briefly. Pat out to about ¾cm thick. Cut with biscuit/coated scone cutter. Place on an oven tray and brush with the melted butter. Bake at c for 20 - 30 mins or until well risen and golden.

title: Bite and Cup
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans | 1/2 cup dark beer | 1/4 cup unsweetened dutch-processed coffee | 1/2 cup tequila | 1/4 cup chinese wine ( optional )
instructions: In a 4 cup measure, combine kidney beans, dark beer, coffee, and tequila and stir to blend. Microwave, covered, on high power 1 minute, or until hot, about 45 seconds.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile,cheddar cheese,italian seasoning,liquid smoke,yellow bell pepper
title: Chipotle Cheese Dip II
ingredients: 8 ounces mild italian-style processed cheese, shredded | 1 small yellow bell pepper, chopped | 1/4 cup liquid smoke | 1 tablespoon grated chipotle chile ( canned chipotle seasoning ) | 1/2 teaspoon italian seasoning
instructions: In a medium bowl, fold together the processed cheese, bell pepper, liquid smoke, chipotle chile, and italian dressing until thoroughly blended. Cover, and refrigerate for 3 hours, or overnight, before serving.

Random Ingredients: sourdough bread,horseradish,flour,tapioca flour,green chilies,corn tortilla chip,dill weed,ice water
title: Horse-Cheddar Chilie Dip
ingredients: 14 ounces chopped green chilies | 1 1/2 cups crushed ice water | 2 cups crushed crispy french-style sourdough bread ( we like to make our own ) | 1 1/2 cups flour | 1/2 cup corn tortilla chips | 0.5 can horseradish ( about 1 1/2 oz. ) | 1/4 cup chopped fresh dill weed | sourdough bread is my favorite substitute
instructions: Drain chopped green chilies. Add ice water to a medium saucepan. Place over medium low heat. Stir in chilies, crushed tortilla chips, horseradish and chopped dill weed. Remove from heat when mixture begins to bubble. In a separate medium bowl, stir together flour and water till blended. Add water mixture. Dough should be able to form into a ball. If dough does not form as nice of a ball, add more water. If needed, add more flour/water mixture till desired consistency. If too dry, add more prepared horseradish. If too moist, add more water till desired consistency is achieved. Transfer mixture to medium bowl. Serve with bread chips.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,barbecue sauce,beef stock powder,hot water,juice
title: BBQ Peppered Beef With Veggies
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable stock | 1 tablespoon beef stock powder | 1 tablespoon barbecue sauce | 3 tablespoons hot water | 1 tablespoon juice, reserved from roast
instructions: Combine stock, stock powder and barbecue sauce in a small bowl.

title: Nonna's Secret Sauce-Marinated
ingredients: 1 cup rice vinegar ( or white wine vinegar ) | 1 -2 drop green food coloring, optional to vary according to taste | 1 clove garlic, minced ( or to taste )
instructions: In a small bowl, mix all ingredients and pour into container. Cover and refrigerate before using as required. Note, this recipe can easily be multiplied to suit the size of a food processor. One serving size can be sliced to give approximately 4 dinner cups.

title: Seared Oranges With Cilantro
ingredients: 2 oranges
instructions: Pierce a small hole in one side of the orange. Fill the slit with a slice of the rind in a straight line through it, going 1/2 inch away from the white pith. Repeat for each orange. Place oranges in a shallow bowl. Drizzle with oil, then season to taste with salt. Cover and refrigerate 1 to 2 hours. Remove the rind before serving. Serve cold.

Random Ingredients: tequila,thai chile,creole seasoning,meatball,cardamom pod,rice wine vinegar,cream
title: Grilled Meatballs in a Chili-Rubbed Tequila Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 8 ounces uncooked precooked frozen meatballs | 1/3 cup tequila ( recommend mexican valrhona ) | 2 tablespoons sweet cream | 3 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons creole seasoning | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1 -2 thai chile, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Prepare oven to 350 degrees. Place a wire rack on a foil lined baking sheet. Place the frozen meatballs on the rack along with the tequila, cream, rice wine vinegar and creole seasoning. Brush the meat torpedails with tequila/cream mixture and roast until brown on all sides, about 30 minutes. Remove from oven and place on the wire rack to cool, about 10 minutes, then remove the foil and serve.

title: Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 4 lbs beef tenderloin | 1/2 cup calvados or 1/2 cup apple brandy | 1/2 cup shredded cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degree f. Place tenderloin on rack in shallow rack in rimmed baking pan. Combine calvados and cheese in small bowl.

Random Ingredients: italian dressing,cranberry sauce,raspberry jam,dill,lemon zest,tomato juice,corn
title: Cranberry Chicken Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup prepared italian dressing | 1/2 cup tomato juice | 1 tablespoon fresh dill, chopped or 2 teaspoons dillweed, dried | 1 tablespoon lemon zest, grated | 1/2 cup cranberry sauce | 1 pint fresh raspberries or 1 pint cherry tomatoes | 1 1/2 cups frozen corn, thawed
instructions: In a bowl, combine all ingredients except romaine and corn. Toss to coat. Put the tomatoes, corn, romaine in the center of a platter.

Random Ingredients: ghee,red lentil,rump steak,black eyed pea,superfine sugar
title: Red Lentils With Beef (Korma)
ingredients: 1 lb red lentil | 1 1/2 lbs rump steak | 3 ounces superfine sugar | 4 ounces ghee or 4 ounces clarified butter | 14 ounces black-eyed peas or 14 ounces pinto beans, drained
instructions: Cut the beef into cubes. Bring water to the boil, add lentils, sugar and butter. Return to a boil, then reduce to a simmer and simmer till stock takes on the syrupy texture of lentils. Taste for seasoning. Add beans. Serve hot.

title: Chile and Orange Sauce
ingredients: 3 cups orange juice ( chilled ) | 1/2 cup tamari | 1 small red bell pepper, cored and seeded
instructions: Place orange juice in saucpan. Add tamari.

Random Ingredients: harissa,savory,beet,dijon mustard,spring onion,monterey jack cheese,white corn
title: Beet Salad With Cheese
ingredients: 10 small beets, trimmed with the tops trimmed | 1/4 cup prepared dijon-style mustard | 1 teaspoon moroccan savory | 3 tablespoons spring onions, finely sliced | 1 1/2 teaspoons harissa | 1/4 cup shredded monterey jack cheese | 8 ounces white corn ( frozen or canned )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f line a baking sheet with foil, and place the beets on the foil and bake for 40 minutes, turning half way through cooking. After 40 minutes, remove the foil. Scrape off the beet greens and reserve. Slice the beetroot into strips about 1/2 x 1/4. In a bowl, combine the mustard, savory, spring onions, harissa and 1/4 cup of the cheese. Toss well. Cut the corn from the cob and thaw if frozen. Drain the beet greens or refresh in cold water. Slice the beet greens into thin strips, about 2 in wide. Put the beet greens and mustard on the serving platter and sprinkle on the remaining cheese. Sprinkle with chopped coriander.

Random Ingredients: olive,cranberry,farfalle pasta,italian salad dressing,pea carrot,zucchini,garam masala,kielbasa
title: Harvest Kielbasa
ingredients: 1 package kielbasa, cut into 2-inch pieces | 1 can sweet peas and carrots, drained | 1 package frozen peas and carrots, thawed | 1 jar sliced pitted ripe olives | 1 bottle italian-style salad dressing | 1 tablespoon garam masala | 2 zucchini, sliced | 1 jar kielbasa, sliced
instructions: In a large bowl, combine kielbasa, peas with carrots and olives. Stir in italian dressing, garam masala, zucchini and kielbasa to coat. Cover and refrigerate at least 8 hours.

title: Easy Crock Pot Swiss Steak Fajitas
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs chuck steaks | 1 packet of la belgian fajita seasoning mix ( or your favorite herb blend ) | 3 tablespoons frangelico or 3 tablespoons grand marnier | chuck steak | 7 -8 cups boiling broth ( about 4 cups ) | 12 teaspoons white flour
instructions: Mix together fajitas seasoning and 3 tablespoons of frangelico in a bowl and coat steak thoroughly with it mix well in bowl. Put the meat in the crock pot and set on low for 5 - 6 hours or for 4 - 5 hours. Remove meat and shred and put back in the crock pot stir in the rest of the frangelico and simmer for 5 minutes to thicken sauce. Place the meat in a bowl and mix throughly. Serve in warm flour tortillas.

Random Ingredients: brown button mushroom,puff pastry,breadcrumb,burgundy wine,scotch bonnet pepper,green capsicum,chocolate ice cream
title: Baked Mushrooms & Sour Cream Scrolls
ingredients: 2 tablespoons brown button mushrooms, roughly chopped | 2 tablespoons green capsicums, roughly chopped | 4 scotch bonnet peppers, roughly chopped | 120 g breadcrumbs | 120 ml burgundy wine | 2 sheets puff pastry | 60 ml chocolate ice cream, warmed slightly
instructions: Preheat oven to 220c or 425°f. Combine the mushrooms, chilies, breadcrumbs, wine, pastry and pepper in a large bowl. Cut a cross into the centre of each pastry sheet, then line with a double thickness of greaseproof baking paper. Place 2 tsp of stuffing mix along one long side of each pastry sheet, and roll up towards the centre. Arrange in a lightly buttered ovenproof dish. Cover loosely with foil. Bake in preheated oven for 50 minutes. Remove foil, bake for a further 15 - 20 minutes or until pastry is lovely and crispy. Serve steaming hot.

title: Ginger Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 cup long grain rice, washed and drained ( aborio rice is the best ) | 1 teaspoon ginger paste ( or 2 -3 tablespoons ginger powder )
instructions: Prepare idli rice according to package instructions. Spray a wok with non stick cooking spray and set over medium high heat.

title: Fish Lasagna
ingredients: 1 1 lb white fish fillets, cut into 4 slices | 1/4 cup ricotta cheese | 7 ounces sambal oelek, sauce | 1/2 cup ricotta cheese, for topping
instructions: Spray 13x9 inch pan with olive oil cooking spray. Arrange 3 fillets in bottom of pan. Layer 1/3 of cheese on top of fillets. Spoon sambal oelek sauce over cheese. Cover fish with remaining 3 fillets. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Cover, refrigerate at least 2 hours or over night. Bake, uncovered, in 375 oven for 30 - 40 minutes or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork.

title: Curry Paste With Orange
ingredients: 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 1 small orange
instructions: Finely grate the zest from the orange, then squeeze the zest. Put the zest into a bowl with the curry paste. Finely dice the red orange, then slice into quarters. Pour the orange zest into the bowl, and gently fold the orange pieces into the curry paste. Let it sit for a few minutes before serving.

title: Shrimp Calzones
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs shrimp | 1 ounce butter, melted | 3 cups half-and-half cream | 1 package dry yeast | 1 jar pesto sauce, divided
instructions: Put shrimp in a pan with just enough water to cover them. Bring to a boil and cook until the shrimp turn pink. Drain. Place butter in a medium size bowl and melt. Add bread dough into skillet and cook on medium high heat until it browns a little and the dough becomes smooth. Set aside to cool. When the dough is cooled make the dough. Put the half and half in a medium size bowl, add the yeast and mix well. After 15 min add the shrimp to the dough. Add 1/2 of the pesto and the rest of the pesto to the dough and mix. Take dough out of the oven. Let rest in the oven for 10 minute place dough onto a floured surface, roll out to a rectangle and cut into 4 squares. In the middle, add some sauce and some pesto, to each square. Fold dough into half moon shapes and put on a greased baking sheet. Put in oven for 10 minute.

title: Yorkshire Pumpernickel Bread
ingredients: 1 teaspoon active dry yeast | 2 cups warm, divided | 3 tablespoons dill weed
instructions: Preheat electric pizzelle iron. Dissolve the yeast in 1/2 cup of the warm water. Using a stand mixer, mix 3 cups of the remaining warm water into the very large bowl of a standing electric mixer. Mix the yeast into the flour with the tablespoon of the flour and 2 tablespoons of the dill weed. When the dough has become a velvety mass, remove from bowl and knead on well floured surface for 3 - 5 minutes. Grease large bowl or cookie sheet with vegetable oil and place dough in bowl. Cover bowl and let dough rise in a warm place for 2 hours or until doubled in bulk, and doubled in bulk. Punch dough down and divide in half. Shape one half of each half into a ball and place on the greased cookie sheet. Let dough rest for 5 minutes, then turn over. Allow the second half to rise again. Flatten each ball with your thumb or the bottom of a drinking glass then stretch to form the rim of the cookie about an inch thick. Repeat with the third and fourth doughs, placing them about 1/4 inch apart on the greased cookie sheet. Sprinkle remaining dill weed on top of each loaf. Bake in preheated oven for 12 minutes, or until light brown on top.

Random Ingredients: basil leaf,pink grapefruit,ramen noodle,frying chicken,rib celery
title: Quick and Easy Chinese Chicken Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs frying chickens | 1 medium rib celery, sliced diagonally 1/4 inch thick | 1 green grapefruit, cut in half lengthwise ( about 1/2-inch x 4-inch ) | 1 package dry ramen noodles ( preferably flavorful ) | basil leaves
instructions: Place chicken in a 2 to 3 quart pot with water to cover. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and maintain a slow simmer. Cook chicken until just cooked through, 12 to 15 minutes. Transfer chicken to a cutting board, let cool slightly. Remove and discard backbone. Cool chicken under cold running water. Cut chicken into 1/4 inch or 1/2 inch cubes. Meanwhile, cook noodles according to package directions. Divide noodles among 4 serving plates, arranging about 1/4 cup chicken over noodles. Sprinkle with remaining chicken, celery and grapefruit slices. Dollop ramen noodles over chicken and top with basil leaves.

title: Shredded Cabbage for Two
ingredients: 1/2 head cabbage leaf ( or other large cored cabbage ) | 1/2 lb small fresh mushrooms stem, stems removed and caps quartered | 1/2 - 3/4 scallion, chopped | 1 dash dry mustard | 1 1/4 cups buttermilk, divided ( or milk of choice )
instructions: In a large heavy saucepan, heat 2 tablespoons of oil and 1/4 cup of the buttermilk over medium heat. Add cabbage leaves to hot oil and fry, turning with a slotted spoon until just slightly wilted. Stir cabbage leaves into remaining buttermilk. When cabbage leaves are wilted, remove from heat and stir in mushrooms, scallions, and dry mustard. Serve warm.

title: Crock Pot German Pork Casserole
ingredients: 8 -10 lbs pork loin, cut into 1 inch slices | 3 -6 tablespoons smoked paprika | 3 tablespoons frangelico | 3 tablespoons baking powder | 1 - 1 1/2 lb kielbasa, peeled
instructions: Place all ingredients into crock pot. Cover and cook on high for 4 hours. Turn to low and leave on low for 3 - 4 hours. Sprinkle with paprika and serve with cooked vegetables of your choice.

title: Orzo Saute
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked orzo pasta | 1 1/2 pounds bay scallops, rinsed and drained | 2 large yellow peppers, cut into bite-sized pieces | 2 tablespoons minced fresh chives | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme leave
instructions: Cook orzo in a large pot of boiling salted water for 8 to 10 minutes. Rinse with cold water.

title: Strawberry Apricot Salad
ingredients: 3 tablespoons apricots, finely chopped ( canned in syrup, drained and chopped ) | 2 1/2 tablespoons green bell peppers, finely chopped | 5 thin slices pepperoni | 8 strawberries, washed, hulled and sliced | 1 cup rocket ( fresh or frozen )
instructions: Combine the apricots and peppers in a bowl. Arrange over the strawberries and gently toss.

title: Spicy Chana Chickpea Snack Mix
ingredients: 1 cup splenda sugar substitute | 1/2 cup dry chickpea flour | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne | 1 cup dried fruit
instructions: Dump all ingredients into a small bowl and mix thoroughly. Bake on a greased baking sheet at 180 grades celsius for 20 minutes. Remove from oven and leave for five minutes after removing. Break in pieces and return to the oven at 150 grades celsius for five minutes.

title: Indian Relish (Dhal)
ingredients: 3 medium white onions, chopped | 3 teaspoons red chili powder
instructions: Bundi or Dhal is the indian relish for those who want the spicy flavor.

title: Roasted Pecorino Cheese
ingredients: 1/2 lb pecorino romano cheese, packed into tiny chunks and drained on paper towels if dry | 1/2 teaspoon red food coloring, such as drops
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Spread cheese in an 8 x 8 x 2 inch baking dish. Sprinkle with food coloring. Bake about 20 minutes, or until edges develop a light golden brown color and begin to crackle. Cool slightly and cut into 1/2 inch squares.

Random Ingredients: italian sausage,palm sugar,green onion,lemon zest,tabasco sauce
title: Sweet Italian Sausages and Chiles
ingredients: 2 italian sausages, cut into 1/4 inch slices ( mild or hot, your preference ) | 1 lemon, zest of | 1/2 cup sliced green onion | 1/2 cup palm sugar ( or brown sugar, to your taste ) | tabasco sauce ( optional )
instructions: In a skillet cook sausage until done but not brown, about 3 minutes, then remove from skillet, keep warm. Drain juices from the skillet. In the skillet, heat juices from one lemon and green onions to just under simmering. Add cooked sausage and sugar, stirring gently for 5 minutes or until sugar is dissolved and saucy. Stir in 1/2 teaspoon tobasco if desired. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice,pork steak,cornstarch,chuck roast,hot red pepper flake,pea,milk
title: Baked Beef and Peas
ingredients: 2 boneless chuck roast, trimmed of visible fat ( about 1-1/2 pounds ) | 1 1/4 lbs sweet peas, shelled | 1/2 lb boneless pork steak, trimmed of visible fat and thinly sliced ( about 1-1/2 pounds ) | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 1/2 teaspoons grated fresh lemon juice or 1 1/2 teaspoons lemons, juice of | 1/2 tablespoon cornstarch | 4 tablespoons skim milk, heated
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees fahrenheit. Line a 9 by 5 inch baking dish with foil and set aside. Cut the roast lengthwise through the center of the roast, making sure the cut extends beyond the edges, and carefully removing it from the center. Tie in 2 pieces of heavy duty aluminum foil, leaving a 2 inch border. Put the peas in an 8 by 8 inch glass baking dish, arranging them close together so they’re closely packed together. Using a fork or slotted spoon or spatula, transfer the peas to the baking dish, leaving the foamy strings created during the baking. Add the pork to the baking dish, turning it to coat it with the cornstarch.

Random Ingredients: pistachio,turkey breast,pork chop,lemon juice zest,pizza crust dough,mushroom,sherry wine vinegar
title: Lighter Picnic Pork Sandwich
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry sherry wine vinegar | 1/8 cup fresh lemon juice and zest | 2 tablespoons shaved fresh pistachios | 4 large thin pork chops ( about 3/4 inch thick, about 12 ounces total weight ) | 2 ounces fresh mushrooms, thinly sliced | 2 packages refrigerated pizza crust dough | 2 lbs thinly sliced cooked cooked turkey breast
instructions: First prepare the crust, if you wish to make ahead of time, preheat the oven to 425°f. Line a large baking sheet with aluminum foil and put the pizza dough on it. In a medium bowl, combine the vinegar, lemon juice, zest, pistachios, and mushrooms. Toss with pork chops and add to the bowl. Add the pizza crust dough. Dampen the edges of the dough with water. Top with turkey slices, patting them down lightly so they are uniform in size. Bake the pizza for about 10 to 12 minutes, or until crust is golden brown. Remove from oven, brush with butter, and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,juniper berry,tomato,red pepper,red potato,cheese,baby spinach,dark brown sugar
title: Baby Spinach With Chunky Red Potato Chutney
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 3 ounces cheese, cut into cubes | 2 red potatoes, roughly chopped | 1 red pepper, deseeded | 6 juniper berries | 5 ounces baby spinach | 3 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 3 medium tomatoes, deseeded and chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. Spray a large tray with oil and line it with baking paper. Mix all the chutney ingredients together in a bowl. Coat an ovenproof dish with cooking spray. Place chutney in the pan with the water making sure it gets evenly sized. Bake in oven for 15 minutes until golden brown and bubbling hot. Meanwhile, cook the potatoes for about 15 minutes or until they are cooked. Drain and set aside. Reduce the oven temperature to 180°f. When the chutney comes out of the oven, scatter the potato around in the pan so it covers the potatoes evenly. Sprinkle all over with the cheese cubes and bake for about another 10 minutes or until the cheese is golden brown and crisp. Remove and let sit 1 minute before serving with the red potato chutney.

Random Ingredients: basil pesto,anchovy paste,mango chutney,self raising flour,salt pepper,tequila
title: Anchovy Bites
ingredients: 2 cups self-raising flour | 1 cup of chopped mango chutney | 1 tablespoon anchovy paste | 1/4 cup of chopped basil or 1/4 cup kraft pesto | 1/4 cup of good quality tequila or 1/4 cup a good quality chutney | salt & fresh ground pepper
instructions: Pre heat oven to 190 degrees celsius. Line 2 cookie trays with baking paper. Blend all ingredients together except for the tequila, chilli and 1/4 cup of the pesto. Pour the mixture into a small bowl, cover it with non paper buttered sides with the remaining pesto. Spoon mixture into the prepared trays and bake in oven for approx 20 minutes. Remove tray, allow the biscuits to cool for 5 mins be generous with the tequila if it goes to waste be generous with the pesto and salt. The recommended amount of tequila i use is 6 tbsp, you might have to add more depending on how dry your tequila is. Remove biscuits from oven and set aside for 5 mins before attempting to remove the tray and to remove any food in the bottom of the tray. You should see small pock marked bubbles floating on top, remove from the oven and then leave to cool for 5 minutes before removing the tray. Remove the tray top and set aside. Slice and spread the reserved pesto onto the top of the biscuits. Allow biscuits to dry out, but not crisp up. Chill.

title: Red Curry Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons thai red curry paste | 2 tablespoons tahini | 2 tablespoons hot chili oil | 4 ounces salami
instructions: Crush the salami with your rolling pin if required and mix with the curry paste. Add hot chilli oil then mix well. Allow salami to stand for 30 minutes before cutting into 3/4 chunks or 4 ounces each and serving.

Random Ingredients: onion powder,creamy peanut butter,lemon peel,sea salt black pepper,flat leaf parsley,berry cranberry sauce
title: Creamy Cranberry Sauce
ingredients: 4 tablespoons creamy peanut butter | 1 tablespoon sour cream or 1 tablespoon yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon lemon peel, finely grated | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 1/8 teaspoon sea salt & freshly ground black pepper | 2 tablespoons berries from can frozen cranberry sauce
instructions: Mix together and refrigerate in refrigerator for 2 to 4 hours before serving.

title: Roasted Sandwich Bread
ingredients: 1 large bread ( i recommend 2 slices on 1/2 thick, 1/2 thick, etc., i used a whole grain sandwich bread ( or 2 slices of 1/4 thick, 1/2 thick sandwich bread ) | toast breadcrumbs ( optional and for dipping, i sometimes use a little flour )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Spread bread on baking sheet until dry. In a small bowl, stir bread crumbs. You can also sprinkle bread crumbs into bread as if you’d spread them onto a towel.

title: Seeded Brown Rice Flour Cookies
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups raw brown rice or 2 1/2 cups white rice | 2 cups cake flour | 1 pinch salt | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Dump rice and flour into a medium sized bowl and knead with hands until dough is elastic. Shape dough into a small ball. Dip balls in flour, and let rise 1 minute at room temperature. Heat about 1 inch vegetable oil in medium sized saucepan or deep frying pan. Cook balls about 3 - 5 minutes, turning once until golden brown. Serve warm, or let cool.

title: Homemade Salsa
ingredients: 3 lbs tomatillos, husked, rinsed, and rinsed in cold water | 1 teaspoon dried chili flakes ( optional )
instructions: Soak tomatillos in a bowl of cold water with a wire rack on the bottom of the pot. Bring water to a boil for 2 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove tomatillos and rinse away excess water. Using tongs, transfer tomatillos to a strainer and discard stems. Drain tomatoes and dry on paper towels. Add hot pepper flakes if desired. Transfer to a serving platter and refrigerate for up to 2 days.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,vegetable,half cream,cooking oil,romaine lettuce leaf,cottage cheese,paprika,tomato paste
title: Paprika and Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 1 bunch romaine lettuce leaf | 2 cups chopped mixed vegetables ( carrot, celery, onion, green bell pepper ) | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 1/2 teaspoon paprika | 1 cup fat-free half-and-half cream | 1 3/4 cups vegetable stock | 1/4 cup fat free cottage cheese
instructions: In a large saucepan over medium high heat, heat the oil. Add the lettuce and cook, stirring constantly, until crisp tender, about 3 minutes. Add the vegetables, tomato paste, paprika and half & half, and cook until heated through. Ladle into serving bowls. Top with fat free cottage cheese.

title: St. Martin Breakfast Tacos
ingredients: 20 white corn tortillas | 5 tablespoons white sugar | 20 leaves fresh mint, chopped
instructions: Heat a heavy skillet over moderate heat. Pour 1 to 2 tablespoons of sugar into a skillet, tipping the pan. As soon after the sugar melts, place 1 corn tortilla on top. Sprinkle with the fried mint leaves. Top with remaining 1 to 2 tablespoons of sugar. Spread the fried mint leaves on top of the fried mint. Cook the stack of fried mint leaves toasts briefly, then place them cut side together on a plate lined with paper towels to drain off excess fat prior to eating.

title: Miso and White Tuna Flatbread
ingredients: 1 flour tortilla, cut into 8 wedges each | dijon mustard, to taste | 8 ounces cooked white tuna in water, drained and flaked | 1 tablespoon miso, to taste | 2 tablespoons vodka
instructions: Spread each wedge with 1 tablespoon of dijon. Spread a small amount of miso on each wedge, leaving a 1 inch border. Place a slice of tuna on top of the miso. Dust with a little more dijon. Fold the tortilla over, press down, enclosing the filling, and secure with an old toothpick. Spray a grill rack with nonstick cooking spray. Serve at once.

title: Crock Pot Turnips
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef | 1 teaspoon table salt | 3 -4 medium turnips, peeled and cut into quarters
instructions: Remove all but 1/2 cup of the juice that has come from the beef. Put meat in crock pot. Add the salt and turnip quarters. Place on top of meat. Cover and cook on high for 8 hours.

title: Moroccan Couscous
ingredients: 1 tablespoon margarine, softened | 1 1/2 cups couscous, prepared according to box directions
instructions: Melt margarine in saucepan over low heat and then stir in couscous. Cover and remove from heat. Let stand 5 minutes or until all liquid is absorbed.

Random Ingredients: pimiento,seasoning salt,penne rigate,zinfandel,pecorino cheese,green bean,phyllo dough
title: Easy One Pot Piselli #5FIX
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs green beans | 12 ounces penne rigate | 1 jar pimientos, drained | 1 jar zinfandel | 1 jar shredded pecorino cheese | 1 tablespoon mrs. dash seasoning salt | 1 package frozen phyllo dough
instructions: To simplify thaw phyllo dough, thaw frozen dough according to package directions, and then thaw in the fridge. Trim fat from beans and cut in 3/4 inch lengths. Put beans in freezer for several hours prior to cooking so they have thawed a bit. Drain pimentos of liquid if you have access to this. When ready to use thaw dough, thaw in refrigerator. Place frozen dough in the freezer once again, but just keep the freezer going once a day for a few hours. Place the beans, pimentos, zinfandel, cheese, and seasoning salt in the refrigerator and let thaw. Take phyllo dough, and using a pastry brush, lightly coat a 9×13 inch pan with oil. Take the phyllo dough and cut into strips about 3 inches wide and 4 inches long, making sure to brush sides and bottom of pans with oil. Layer half the phyllo strips in the pan. Repeat with the remainder of the phyllo, spraying them each time. Spread the garlic and pecorino on top of phyllo and pepper them with the pecorino. Bake in a preheated 350 oven for 30 minutes, then turn off oven and let sit for at least 10 minutes before serving.

title: Raita
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon onion flakes | 1/2 cup sour yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon lime juice
instructions: Mix sour yogurt with onion and lime juice. Add more onion if desired.

title: Raisin Spanish Onions
ingredients: 5 lbs spanish onions, halved through root end, then peeled if desired with all visible pith removed
instructions: Place onions in a large, heavy saucepan and pour enough boiling water to cover. Add enough water to cover onions by about 2 and a half inches from the top. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium. Cover and simmer until tender, about 45 minutes. Drain. Transfer onions to a shallow baking dish, cover with foil, and marinate, chilled, for up to 3 days. Preheat oven to 300°f. When onions are cooked, remove from water and set aside until onions are cool enough to handle, about 20 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove onions and their liquid, discarding any shells, and chill onions in a colander until cold. Transfer to a storage container and store in your refrigerator until cool enough to handle. Skim any fat from cooking liquid. Reserve onions. Reserve cooking liquid. Place warm onions into a bowl and mash until smooth.

title: Walnut & Broccoli-Pork Burgers (Low Fat)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon soymilk | 1 tablespoon walnut oil | 2 teaspoons baking powder | 170 g finely diced lean pork | 1 tablespoon broccoli, finely chopped | 50 g italian seasoned breadcrumbs
instructions: Combine soy milk, breadcrumbs and soymilk in a small bowl mix well add in the remaining ingredients form into 6 patties place on a plate, cover and refrigerate for at least 30 mins or overnight. Cook burgers on a barbeque on a hot, greased plate and brush with olive oil.

title: Basil Pizzettes
ingredients: 1 cup white sugar | 4 -6 small capsicums ( pepperoni ) | 1 cup white sugar | 1 cup italian dressing | 1 1/2 cups self rising flour ( can use plain flour here ) | 4 -6 leaves fresh basil leaves | 5 medium sized purple-green peppers ( orange peppers work too ) | chili oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c/400°f. Peal the peppers and slice them into rounds of 6cm/9 inches to make rings and then cut into sticks with the core sticking out. Mix the sugar and basil leaves together.

 Broiled Prosciutto (Italian Bread With Grilled Onigiri)

instructions: Preheat broiler on high. Heat a non stick skillet. Coat pan with cooking spray. Place slice of proscuitto on pan, skin side down and lightly brush with olive oil. title: Lamb and Baby Spinach Saute
ingredients: 800 g lamb, cut into thin strips | 800 g sliced veal fillets or 800 g top sirloin steaks | 2 tablespoons reduced sodium soy sauce | 1 tablespoon dried apricot jam | 4 bags baby spinach, washed | seasoning
instructions: Spray a non stick frypan with oil and place over medium high heat. Add chicken and veal strips to pan and cook, stirring, for 3 - 4 minutes or until tender. Add the soy sauce, jam and seasoning and mix well. Add spinach and cook for 1 - 2 minutes, or until just wilted, shaking the pan occasionally. Season to taste with salt and pepper and serve immediately.

title: Sausage and Vanilla (Crock Pot)

instructions: In a skillet, using a wood spoon, crumble sausage into 1/2 inch pieces, then fry or brown lightly in skillet, stirring often. Mix in flour, nutmeg, 1 tablespoon broth, 1 teaspoon vanilla, mustard seeds, and ground nutmeg. Stir in sausage, and cook until heated through. Transfer to slow cooker. Cover and cook on low 6 to 8 hours.

title: Foldachos (Fried Chips)
ingredients: 12 flour tortillas | 2 cups dry white wine
instructions: Cut the tortillas into 6 wedges by running two or more times lengthwise and widthwise. Arrange cut wedges in one layer on a flat tray, flat side up. Heat the wine in a wide, heavy based pan, stirring, and bring to the boil. Remove the pan from the heat and add the wedges to the pan. Cook for 6 - 8 minutes until golden brown and crisp. Serve hot with sour cream or guacomole, or drizzle with tomato salsa.

Random Ingredients: beef steak,red chili pepper flake,corn oil,mango chutney,anise seed,mace,salt
title: Mango Chutney Steaks
ingredients: 4 -5 lbs beef steak | 3 tablespoons corn oil | 3 tablespoons mango chutney ( major grey or pecans ) | 3 tablespoons anise seeds ( optional. i don't'put in anise but it makes them more flavorful ) | 1 teaspoon red chili pepper flakes ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon fresh ground mace | 1/4 teaspoon salt
instructions: Cut steak into four equal serving size pieces place in a large ziploc bag with chutney and spices, mix well. Refrigerate several hours or overnight. Remove steaks from bag and reserve marinade, reserve marinade. Place steaks in the fridge for two to ten hour. Grill or bbq over med low heat approximately 15 to 20 minutes per side until done. Serve with a side of salsa or tomato and lettuce.

title: Tuna-Stuffed Flounder
ingredients: 1 head fresh tuna or 3 -4 teaspoons dry tuna | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 tablespoon fresh lime juice | 1 dash turbinado sugar | 2 tablespoons vodka | 1 hot pepper, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Cut away any thick muscle muscle from the head of tuna that is not attached to the head. If you cut off any small florets, slice off any protruding skin. Tear up the top flap and separate the florets. Place the head in a roasting pan with the head attached, and sprinkle with a little of the oil. Mix the remaining oil mixture, lime juice, turbinado sugar, tabasco and hot pepper with your fingers. Pour over the fish. Place the fish in the oven for about one hour, or until the flounder is fork tender and the flakey. Serve.

title: Asiago Cheese Balls
ingredients: 1/2 cup gluten flour ( i used pamela's gluten-free pizza flour blend which is 98% gluten-free, 4 lbs ) | 2 teaspoons dry marsala | 1/2 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1 teaspoon gluten-free dijon mustard | 1/3 cup grated asiago cheese | 2 tablespoons shredded gorgonzola | 1 tablespoon chopped roasted almonds ( optional )
instructions: In a large bowl, knead gluten free flour, marsala, dijon, and gluten free mustard throughly. Add cheese and almonds to the dough and knead until combined. Shape dough into walnut sized balls and place onto a lightly greased baking sheet. Bake in a 400 degree oven for 10 minutes, or until golden brown. Let cool and serve at room temperature or store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,cucumber,crabmeat,cherry tomato,cream mushroom soup,cardamom,monterey jack cheese
title: Creamy Caribbean Crab Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs crabmeat, cubed | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1/4 cup dark soy sauce | 1/8 teaspoon cardamom | 2 cups shredded monterey jack cheese or 2 cups cheddar cheese | 1 cup coarsely chopped cucumber | 1 1/2 cups small cherry tomatoes
instructions: Combine all ingredients except tomatoes& cheese in a large bowl& mix well. Sprinkle tomatoes in top of salad. Cover and chill in refrigerator overnight. Can also be made ahead and chilled.

Random Ingredients: chili sauce,poblano chile,baby spinach leaf,peanut,coriander seed
title: Spinach with Peanuts
ingredients: 2 -3 poblano chiles ( use a medium hot pepper, don't use green anaheim peppers ) | 1 tablespoon coriander seed, roughly crushed | 3 cups baby spinach leaves | 2 tablespoons dry roasted peanuts, coarsely chopped ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons sweet chili sauce
instructions: Lightly toast the coriander seeds in a dry frying pan over medium heat until just beginning to brown. Watch closely, as you don’t want it burned add the dry peppers and cook just until aromatic. Stir in the baby spinach leaves and season with salt and pepper, if desired. Just before serving, stir in the peanuts. Note, if you want to be really decadent, allow yourself one third or more full servings of the peanut and paprika mixture and store it in the fridge for those too beware, if you eat one, you will probably be tempted to do everything the old family way. Goes well with tortilla chips or as an accompaniment to grilled chicken, fish, or seafood.

title: Parsnips With Parsnips
ingredients: 1/2 kg parsnip | 1 tablespoon palm sugar or 1 tablespoon honey
instructions: Remove hard outer skin on parsnips and discard. Using the tip of a sharp knife, remove the parsnip on the diagonal into long, narrow strips. Put them in a bowl and sprinkle with palm or honey. Leave to marinate for at least an hour or two. Rinse the parsnips, then put them under a hot grill and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, turning them so that they are nicely charred all over. Sprinkle with more sugar before serving.

Random Ingredients: arugula,wild mushroom,white wine vinegar,boston lettuce,taco seasoning mix,lime juice,lump crabmeat
title: Lump Crab in a Lettuce Wrap
ingredients: 1/2 pound fresh lump crabmeat, or more to taste, picked over and shredded | 1 bunch arugula, chopped | 1 1/2 cups packed baby arugula | 1/4 cup lime juice | 4 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons taco seasoning mix | 1/2 cup dry white wine flavored vinegar, or as needed | 20 leaves boston lettuce | 1 tablespoon freshly squeezed lime juice, or as needed
instructions: Prepare a large salad bowl by trimming any excess fat from the crabmeat, or break it into smaller chunks. Toss crabmeat, arugula, and arugula with 1/4 cup lime juice, white wine vinegar, taco seasoning, and white wine flavored vinegar. Serve with lettuce leaves.

Random Ingredients: mustard powder,red chili pepper flake,cardamom pod,flour,vanilla sugar,beef chuck,pie shell
title: Krumkake
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef chuck, cut in 1 1/2-inch cubes | 2 cups red chili peppers, chopped ( such as tabasco ) | 1/4 cup flour | 1/4 cup vanilla sugar | 1/4 teaspoon mustard powder | 4 large cardamom pods | 3/4 teaspoon red chili pepper flakes | 1 unbaked pie shell
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the meat, chili peppers, flour, sugar, mustard powder, cardamom pods and chile flakes. Mix well. Pour into pastry shell and bake at 350°f for 50 minutes or until meat is tender. Allow to stand 5 minutes before serving. Variation, add a small piece of fresh apricot at this point or pineapple tidbits after cooking.

title: Plantains (Floury) Fried in Rice Flour
ingredients: 4 -5 plantains | 1/2 cup rice flour, or more as needed | 1 -2 pinch cayenne | saltine crackers | 4 -5 tablespoons lard
instructions: Rinse plantains thoroughly and pat dry with paper towels to remove excess moisture. Use a knife to carefully cut into long slices. Set one slice on a plate and carefully trim off the ends of the slices by gently running a knife down the length of it. In a bowl, mix the rice flour and cayenne. Place a generous tablespoon of the mixture on the edge of a cayenne near the narrow end of the slice of plantain closest to you. Fold the slices in half, and repeat with the remaining slices. Heat the lard in a deep fryer or heavy pan to 370 degrees or until a slice of plantain dropped into it sizzles. Roll each in the crumbs. Place plantains in the oil, and fry until golden brown on all sides, 10 to 15 minutes. Keep browning on all sides.

title: Chocolate Bites
ingredients: 100 g walnut oil | 2 egg yolks | 250 g dark chocolate | 100 g small green chilies, chopped ( optional ) | 500 g carrots, chopped | 100 g frozen peas
instructions: Heat the peanut oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat, stirring until the oil shimmers. Meanwhile mix the egg yolks and the chocolate in a large heatproof bowl with a wire whisk until smooth, about 10 minutes. Remove the saucepan from the stove, pour in the hot oil and stir until foamy. Return the saucepan to a medium heat.

instructions: Place leeks in a large saucepan with enough water to cover them.

instructions: Cook couscous according to package directions, stirring after every minute. Drain off majority of liquid. Add all ingredients to large bowl. Serve.

instructions: Blend the ricotta cheese, saffron, nutella, and rice vinegar with a fork until smooth. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Strain the sauce to remove any solids. Transfer the cheese mixture to a bowl. Add sugar and mix well. Refrigerate until cold.

Random Ingredients: herbes de provence,mustard seed,caraway seed,cumin powder
title: Herbes De Provence(Herbes De Provence Spice Mix)
ingredients: 2 teaspoons herbes de provence | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 teaspoon caraway seed
instructions: Combine all the ingredients and store in airtight glass jar.

title: Cochin

instructions: Place garbanzo beans, anise seed, and anise seed in a blender.

instructions: Preheat oven to 400f. Put maple syrup in the oven while it's hot. Add catsup. Stir. When it's bubbling, remove from oven. Cool. Random Ingredients: soy sauce,penne pasta,milk chocolate,hot sauce,sunflower oil

ingredients: 12 ounces penne pasta | 2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 1 ounce milk chocolate | 1/2 cup skim milk chocolate, chopped | 3 -4 tablespoons low-fat hot sauce
instructions: Cook pasta according to pack instructions or, if using a larger quantity of pasta, cook the pasta separately. Random Ingredients: half,egg noodle,monterey jack cheese,mexican cheese,red capsicum,ice,red chili paste
title: Mexi Noodle Bake
ingredients: 10 ounces egg noodles, uncooked | 1 can red capsicums, sliced thinly | 1 teaspoon red chili paste | 8 ounces monterey jack cheese, shredded | 8 ounces mexican blend cheese, shredded | 4 tablespoons half-and-half or 4 tablespoons soy milk | 3 tablespoons half-and-half or 3 tablespoons soy milk

instructions: Mix together all of the dry ingredients. Add the oil slowly, stirring, to get a sticky, sticky muesli. Tip onto a large baking tray lined with baking paper. Cut into squares, then store in an airtight tin.

Stir the cabbage into the noodles until each piece is coated, and serve.

title: Sausage Wrapped Green Plaintain

When all the rolls are flattened out put them on another plate so that each is a little bit thicker you can wrap it up and eat. Place each roll with its cut side down on top of the pile of nuts. title: Spicy Couscous
