Simmer over medium heat, stirring constantly, for about 5 minutes, or until the onions are almost translucent. Stir in the bittersweet chocolate syrup. Add the clams and allow to cook for about 1 minute, allowing some of the water from the clams to clam juice. Top with shaved chocolate covered onion.

title: Gingerbread Bread (Muesli)
ingredients: 1 package unflavored gelatin | 4 slices bread ( such as wheat pita or multigrain bread )
instructions: Dissolve the gelatin in water. Dip bread slices in the gelatin to cover. Place in the refrigerator to soften. Cut into cubes. To serve, fill with gingerbread cubes.

Random Ingredients: stewing beef,chili bean,serrano pepper,blueberry,whipping cream,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Stovetop Beef and Blueberry Stew
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 can chili beans, rinsed and drained | 1 cup chopped fresh blueberries | 3 serrano peppers, chopped | 1 cup whipping cream | 1 tablespoon grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: In a large nonstick skillet, brown the meat on all sides, about 5 minutes. Add the chili beans, blueberries and peppers. Cover and simmer over low heat for 15 to 20 minutes, until the meat is tender. Remove the cover, stir in the cream, cover and continue to simmer until the liquid thickens slightly, about 5 minutes. Serve with grated cheese.

title: Spaghetti Pie II
ingredients: 2 packages spaghetti sauce mix | 1/2 cup heavy cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix together a 1/2 cup of sauce mix and 1/2 cup of heavy cream. Spread into a loaf pan or other large baking dish and bake for 5 to 6 hours, depending on oven.

title: Pesto Mango Salad
ingredients: 1 mango | 2 teaspoons pesto sauce
instructions: Chop mango and put in bowl. Add pesto sauce. Toss gently until mango is well combined. Serve cold.

Random Ingredients: cooking oil,cauliflower floret,dark sesame oil,thyme sprig
title: Cauliflower Stir Fry
ingredients: 1 lb cauliflower floret | 2 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme sprigs | 1/2 teaspoon cooking oil ( vegetable or canola )
instructions: Steam or microwave the cauliflower until barely tender. Rinse under cold water and set aside. Heat the sesame oil and thyme in a high sided fry pan or nonstick skillet and add the cauliflower, tossing it, until slightly browned on the edges, 2 - 3 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Remove from heat and stir in the oil.

title: Vietnamese Rice Balls for Two (Cook's Illustrated)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups long-grain white rice or 1 1/2 cups jasmine rice | 3 3 tablespoons apricot jam or 3 tablespoons apricot jam | 2 1/2 teaspoons fish sauce ( nuoc mam )
instructions: Rinse the rice and steam it in a steamer set over 6 inches of boiling water, covered, until it is tender. Let cool. Place all ingredients in a bowl and combine well. Shape into 1 inch meatballs and coat with rice flour. Heat a wok over medium high heat until hot. Add half the rice and stir fry, pressing the rice constantly with a spatula, until the rice is golden and sticky. Transfer the rice balls to a parchment lined baking sheet. Repeat with the remaining rice and rice. Use a slotted spoon to transfer the rice balls to a platter and serve warm or, as desired, as is.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,gorgonzola,beef mince,spanish onion,olive oil,sea salt black pepper,cream celery soup
title: Pizza Sauce
ingredients: 400 g pineapple with juice | 1 gorgonzola, crumbled | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 3 tablespoons cream of celery soup | sea salt & freshly ground black pepper | 600 g beef mince | 200 g spanish onions
instructions: Place pineapple cubes and garlic onion in a colander, and weigh them down with a heavy object, such as a rock or overturned sieve to drain off any excess liquid overnight. The weight increases when the sauce starts to become thick, about 20 - 30 minutes. Remove the tuna and cut in half. Remove excess juice with a spoon, and place it into a small pan to dry out a little. Squeeze out excess moisture, and set aside. Stir fry onions and mince until they are just browned and caramelized. Mix with the pineapple juice. Season to taste, and place in the fridge for at least 8 hours before serving to allow thickening. Re heat before serving.

title: Green Beans and Lettuce Salad (Ensaladilla Rusa Mexicana)
ingredients: 2 heads iceberg lettuce ( or other lettuce ) | 1 lb fresh green beans, trimmed
instructions: Separate each leaf of green lettuce from the outer leaf of the stalk. Pull off the hard stalk.

title: Black Beans and Onions (Tapas)
ingredients: 1 cup frozen sliced spanish onions | 3/4 cup chicken stock ( if possible homemade ) | 2 1/4 ounces beer ( dark mexican beer may be used if desired ) | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 3/4 cups fresh black beans, washed, picked over and rinsed well | 1 3/4 cups water
instructions: Drain the onions. In a large saucepan over medium high heat, add the chicken stock and beer and heat to boiling. Add the onions and salt and stir just until the onions soften, about 3 minutes for fresh and 2 minutes for frozen. Add the black beans and 3 1/4 cups water. Heat to boiling and let simmer about 5 minutes. Adjust seasoning with pepper and salt and serve.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper,fish sauce,chicken stock,self rising flour
title: Gently Parsley Fritters
ingredients: 3/4 cup fish sauce | 2/3 cup stock | 4 1/2 cups self-rising flour, divided | 1 pinch cayenne pepper ( optional )
instructions: Place half of the flour into a bowl and add fish sauce, stock and pinch of cayenne pepper. Stir to combine. Place remaining flour into a second bowl and add half of the fish sauce mixture to the flour. Mix to combine. Using your hands, rub the flour, 1/2 cup at a time, into the flour until the mixture resembles breadcrumbs. Add the remaining fish sauce mixture and remaining fish sauce mixture. Stir to combine. Heat non stick pan until hot. Brush lightly with oil. Drop batter by tablespoon into pan, they should be very thin in texture and will puff and cling to the pan. Turn when batter is puffed up and golden brown. Remove from pan and put on plate. Repeat with remaining batter. Serve with your favourite dipping sauce.

title: Easy Onion Dip
ingredients: 1 packet lipton onion soup mix | 1 package dried onion flakes
instructions: Stir together the lipton onion soup mix and dried onion flakes. Refrigerate for several days.

title: Almond Glazed Beef (Zwt- 8)
ingredients: 1 cup evaporated milk | 2 tablespoons sprite ( any brand ) | 1 pinch vanilla beans ( optional ) | 1 dash almond extract | 1/4 lb 80 % lean ground chuck
instructions: Mix the first 5 ingredients together in a bowl, blend well, set aside. Spray a large, non stick skillet with non stick cooking spray on medium heat. Sear the ground chuck until browned. Add the prepared glaze, reduce heat and simmer for 2 minutes more. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: green onion,dark soy sauce,cocoa,tap water,orange blossom honey
title: Sweet and Hot Chocolate
ingredients: 5 ounces dark sweet soy sauce | 2 ounces hot tap water | 4 ounces orange blossom honey ( aka huy hong ) | 1 tablespoon sweetened cocoa | 2 green onions, chopped
instructions: Pour all the ingredients into a heatproof bowl or jug with 1½ 1/8 cups of water. Leave at room temperature until required. Place the bowl or jug in a saucepan of simmering water. Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 5 mins until syrupy. Strain and leave to cool. Transfer the warm chocolate into an airtight container and store at room temperature until needed.

title: Pesto Ricotta With Pine Nuts and Ricotta Salata
ingredients: 5 ounces ricotta salata | 1 tablespoon pine nuts
instructions: Dived ricotta salata and pine nut into four equal portions and mould to a shape that sticks together well. Slice salata into six even lengths and place onto a warm serving plate. Heat the pesto, in a small saucepan over high heat, on the stove top. It's ready when it is slightly thickened and beginning to smoke. Pour over the ricotta salata and scatter with pine nuts.

title: Chile Con Frijoles Negros (Roasted Beans in Red Pepper Sauce)
ingredients: 1 lb red beans, in 1-inch pieces | 1 teaspoon black salt | canola oil ( for drying beans, not olive oil )
instructions: Place beans in a bowl and sprinkle black salt onto them. Toss well so that beans are all coated with seasonings. Heat oil in a heavy skillet over medium high heat. Pour beans into skillet and fry until browned, about 5 to 6 minutes, turning beans over after about 3 minutes.

title: Baby Kay Fajitas
ingredients: 8 baby king prawns ( raw ) | 200 g bleached plain flour | 2 tablespoons paprika | 1 tablespoon wasabi | 150 g blue cheese | 1 liter roasted red peppers ( drained ) or ( 15 ounce ) jar roasted piquillo peppers ( drained ) | lettuce ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons roasted pecans ( optional )
instructions: Prepare the batter by mixing the bleached flour, paprika and wasabi. Coarsely chop the roasted peppers and cheese. Add 1 - 2 cups of cold water. Whisk thoroughly with a fork. Cut prawns in half lengthwise and then in half again lengthwise. Spread 1 1/2 tablespoons each of the cheese and pepper mixture evenly on each half of the prawns. Roll each piece of prawn back into the cheese mixture. Wrap and chill until needed. Cut each roll into 1 cm wide strips. Coat well with non stick vegetable spray. Heat a frypan. When it is very hot, add a little oil. Fry the strips of prawns with a little oil until they are golden brown, remove and set aside. Add the remaining oil to the frypan and heat. Fry the peppers until the smell of the peppers is gone. Wrap in a lettuce leaf and place on individual serving plates. Top with the fried prawns. Garnish with pecans.

title: Green Mint Sauce
ingredients: 2 leaves mint | 1 teaspoon chili paste
instructions: Clean the mint leaves, then put them in a blender. Add chilipote.

title: Hot Chinese Noodles
ingredients: 1 lb napa cabbage | 1/4 cup flour | 2 tablespoons chili paste with garlic ( if you don't like that extra garlic, use 1 teaspoon garlic )
instructions: Shred cabbage coarsely. Stir flour into shredded cabbage, then mix thoroughly. Heat skillet to medium. Add cabbage and a few tbs of oil to pan. Sprinkle 1/4 tbsp of chilli paste over cabbage.

Random Ingredients: sea salt,lavender flower,leg lamb,carrot,farfalle pasta,red bell pepper,clove
title: Lamb Stew With Farfalle Noodles (Barefoot Contessa)
ingredients: 1 large red bell pepper | 2 pieces garlic cloves | 1 tablespoon ground cloves ( or more to taste ) | 1 teaspoon dried lavender flowers or 2 teaspoons crushed lavender | 1 teaspoon coarse sea salt or 1 teaspoon table salt | 1 boneless leg of lamb | 4 -6 ounces dry farfalle pasta ( bowtie ) or 4 -6 ounces any other short pasta ( bowtie ) | carrot, sliced for garnish
instructions: If using dried lavender, toast until fragrant in a large pan over medium heat. Then add cloves and next 5 ingredients. Simmer 15 minutes to allow most of the residual flavor to escape. Remove bell pepper and garlic. Remove stalk from lamb and season lamb generously with salt. Let stand 15 minutes or longer. When ready to serve, cook pasta until al dente, about 8 to 10 minutes. Drain or serve immediately with lamb on top and carrots on the side. Note, the longer cooking time is allowed for the salt to penetrate the meat, the thicker it will become. The taste can also be enhanced by adding some other vegetables that have not been previously cooked and serving alongside.

title: Ginger Pastries (Tajiyar)
ingredients: 2 sheets puff pastry | 2 cups cottage cheese | 4 large egg yolks | 3 tablespoons ginger, grated | 1/2 cup half-and-half | 3 tablespoons lemon rind, grated | 1 can chickpeas
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Unfold the pastry sheet and cut into 9 squares. In a bowl, combine 1 cup of the cottage cheese, and egg yolks, grated ginger, half and half, and lemon rind. Stir into the cottage cheese mixture. Set aside 1 cup. Place the chickpeas, on parchment paper, on the baking sheet and spoon the ginger mixture onto the empty half of the pastry squares. Place another sheet of pastry on top and bake for 25 minutes, or until golden brown. Serve warm with sour cream.

title: Pantry Spanish Steak
ingredients: 2 lbs tenderized sirloin steaks | 1 large yellow bell pepper ( medium, cut into 1-inch cubes ) | 2 medium onions, halved and quartered ( about 4 cups ) | 16 black olives, pitted ( optional ) | 1 cup broth, from sel beef soup can
instructions: Place steak and peppers in crock pot. Add remaining ingredients. Cover and cook on high 4 - 5 hours. When ready to serve, check for tenderness and add olives. Note, a note from jose, if you will be making this for company, you may want to reduce the broth to 4 cups.

Random Ingredients: radish,yellow squash,hot italian sausage,milk chocolate chip
title: Amazing Hot Sausage-Yellow Squash Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb hot italian sausage | 3 small yellow squash, cut in half lengthwise | 6 fresh radishes, each cut into 8 thin slices | 1/2 cup milk chocolate chips or 1/2 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips
instructions: Bake the sausage in a 9 inch baking dish, cut side up. When the sausage is cooked through, remove sausage from pan and place them in a mixing bowl. Drain of all but 1 tablespoon of drippings from the pan and add the yellow squash. Slice the sausage, return to the pan, and sprinkle evenly with the radishes. In a medium bowl whisk 2/3 cup of the milk with the chocolate chips until the chocolate is well incorporated.

title: Simple Sambal
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 tablespoon chili sauce | 1 teaspoon superfine sugar ( caster sugar ) | 1 tablespoon tamarind syrup ( syrup ) | your favourite syrup
instructions: First heat your caster sugar in a small saucepan, but do not go too overboard with it. As it's soft you shouldn't want to let it get to dark colour. When the sugar is bubbling, take it out of the stove and allow to cool. Add the tamarind syrup and a bit of the cooled syrup mixture and mix it in well. Mix in your favourite syrup. Keep refrigerated.

Random Ingredients: orange,extra virgin olive oil,cod,celery rib,kahlua,baby green
title: Easy Spicy Cod Salad
ingredients: 1/2 medium orange | 1 bunch baby greens | 1 bunch baby greens | 1/4 cup kahlua | extra virgin olive oil | extra virgin olive oil | 2 teaspoons celery ribs, diced
instructions: First cut fish into small chunks. Chop any large fish roughly like chicken, turkey, etc. You can leave the skin on if desired. Take a large pot and add water, kahlua, olive oil, olive oil in small increments to make 1/4 cup. Bring to rapid boil & remove from heat. Chop orange and add to bowl. Add the sliced celery. Serve immediately or refrigerate for later.

title: A Simple Cucumber Soy Cream (For Dessert)
ingredients: 200 g ground meat | 1 medium cucumber, peeled, seeded and chopped | 1/2 cup finely chopped green onion | 1 1/2 cups plain soymilk | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 1 teaspoon onion powder
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl and mix lightly. Cover and refrigerate for 6 hours or overnight.

title: Basic Gravy for Beef
ingredients: 1200 ml beef stock | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds or 1 teaspoon yellow mustard powder
instructions: Combine all the ingredients and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat and simmer. Let the gravy simmer for 3 hours, taste and adjust the seasoning before serving as desired.

title: Malt Vinaigrette
ingredients: 3 pounds pork shoulder, cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes | 1/2 cup malt vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spread pork evenly in a large baking dish. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, until dry enough to crack with a fork. Turn oven off, but leave oven turned off. Mix the malt vinegar and salt in a bowl. Pour vinegar mixture into a bowl, and stir to dissolve. Place pork in a large container. Cover, and refrigerate at least 4 hours. Transfer pork to an outdoor grill, and cook until well done.

title: Yummilicious Feta Spread
ingredients: 1 jar crumbled feta cheese | 1 tablespoon minced lemon juice, or to taste
instructions: Blend feta cheese, lemon zest, and hot pepper sauce in a food processor until smooth.

title: Brioche (Steak Sandwich)
ingredients: 1/2 baguette ( day old french ) | 1/2 cup tequila | 1 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon | 2 tablespoons fresh italian parsley | 1 tablespoon white wine
instructions: Cut bread into 5 serving size pieces. Combine tequila, bouillon, parsley and wine.

Random Ingredients: acinus di pepe pasta,green chile,cream chicken soup,lemon juice zest
title: Creamy Mexican Pasta
ingredients: 1 package acini di pepe pasta | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 can chopped green chiles | 1/2 cup lemon juice, or to taste | 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil, and cook acini di pepe pasta at a boil until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 11 minutes. Drain, and place acini di pepe pasta and cream of chicken soup in a blender, and blend until smooth. Reserve 1/4 c. Drippings for garnish, then stir green chiles and lemon juice into pasta mixture until combined. Transfer drained pasta to a serving dish, top with shredded cheese, and ladle sauce over it to serve.

title: Thai Coconut Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup pineapple juice | 1 cup coconut milk | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red chile | 2 tablespoons canola oil
instructions: In a small saucepan over medium heat, combine pineapple juice, coconut milk and crushed red chiles and bring to a simmer. Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, for 20 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside to cool completely. When cool, stir in canola oil. Store in the refrigerator.

title: Saffron Chicken
ingredients: 1 teaspoon saffron | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 2 lbs chicken hearts, skinned and cut into quarters
instructions: Combine saffron and sesame oil in small shallow glass or glass bowl. Add chicken and toss until coated. Marinate for a minimum of four hours. Preheat oven, place chicken in an ovenproof or casserole dish and bake for 35 minutes. Turn the chicken and bake for 5 more minutes or until meat is cooked through.

title: Green Chili Paste
ingredients: 2 cans chopped green chili ( canned ) | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon chili paste
instructions: Blend all ingredients in a food processor for a smooth paste. Allow to rest 10 minutes before using as a condiment on cooked meat.

title: Simple Creamy Chicken Hot Dogs
ingredients: 1 package instant vanilla pudding mix | 1 pound cooked, shredded chicken meat | 5 tablespoons chopped fresh dill | 5 tablespoons finely chopped fresh dill | 1 pound miniature marshmallows | 1 tablespoon chili powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Mix the pudding mix, chicken, 2 tablespoons dill, 5 tablespoons dill, chili powder and marshmallows in a large bowl. Drop by rounded tablespoon onto lightly greased baking sheets. Bake in the preheated oven until browned, about 8 minutes.

title: Enchilada Macadamia Oaty Roll (Abm)
ingredients: 4 1/2 cups rolled out oatmeal ( whole flakes ) | 1 1/2 lbs raw macadamia nuts ( finely chopped ) | 1 package dry yeast | 15 ounces enchilada sauce | kitchen bouquet
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup lukewarm water. Add rest of the ingredients. Let cool in refrigerator for 2 hours. Split and fill with dough. Stretch to fit bread machine, or roll out to about 1/4 inch by 4 1/2 inch. Do not stretch it. Bake on middle rack at 350 degrees for 30 to 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: bok choy,meat,mozzarella cheese,italian sausage,baking soda,english cucumber,white vinegar,beef chuck roast
title: Authentic Beef Goulash
ingredients: 1 cup kraft fully-fat shredded mozzarella cheese | 1 lb sliced meat | 1 lb sliced beef chuck roast | 1 lb italian sweet sausage ( hot ) | 1 1/2 cups chopped bok choy | 1/2 cup white vinegar | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 english cucumbers or 1 any other cucumber
instructions: Place meat, salt, and vinegar in a large bowl. Pour over the meat, mix well to combine. Add the italian sausage and cook the meat in the microwave until no longer pink inside, about 5 minutes per pound if using chuck roast. Remove meat from the microwave. When the meat is done and cool enough to handle, shred it and set aside. Put half of the cheese into a large baking dish. Place the shredded meat on top of the cheese and then put remaining cheese in the bottom of the baking dish. Layer the slices of beef on top of the meat and then add the sliced bok choy on top of it. Mix the vinegar and baking soda together and pour over the meat. Sprinkle the sliced cucumbers on top. Cover with a lid or foil and bake at 325 degrees for 2 hours. Remove the lid or foil and bake for an additional 30 minutes to brown the top of the goulash. Serve with crusty french or italian bread.

title: Faux Phyllo With Whipping Cream & Fava Beans
ingredients: 1 cup small dried fava beans ( or pepsi beans or macaroni, available fresh is available in health food stores ) | 1/2 cup boiling water chestnut ( or sliced canned chestnuts ) | 1/4 cup whipping cream
instructions: Wash and rinse the fava beans and the water chestnuts. Soak the beans until tender, 10 minute drain and place in the blender. Add the heavy whipping cream and pulse several times til it is very smooth. Fold in the drained fava beans. Spread into a buttered 9 x 13 inch pan. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and refrigerate till the phyllo is firm for at least 1 hour or up to 2 days. Remove from refrigerator and garnish with the sliced water chestnuts. Let stand at room temperature covered for 5 minute remove from pans and let stand at room temperature till well chilled, at least an hour.

Random Ingredients: olive,grape jelly,hard salami,mushroom,miso,black olive,red enchilada sauce,rock salt
title: Muzzy's Pizza Salami  Salad
ingredients: 3 ounces mushrooms, rinsed and sliced ( or any other hot mushroom ) | 1 ounce green olives, sliced | 8 ounces pickled peppers, thinly sliced | 2 ounces black olives, sliced | 1/2 cup pickled grape jelly | 3/4 teaspoon rock salt | 1 ounce mushroom, sliced | 1 teaspoon olive, sliced | 3 -5 servings shaved hot rock salt
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and enjoy.

title: Curried Beans
ingredients: 1 cup dried beans, soaked overnight and cooked | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1 can apple juice ( i use apple cider and add a bit of sugar ) | 1 package dried cranberries ( add more if you want ) | 10 curry leaves | cumin ( more or less to taste )
instructions: Drain beans and place in crock pot. Add all remaining ingredients. Cover. Cook on high for about 4 hours. Serve with plain yogurt, raitas, or whatever you like.

title: Creamy Mexican-Style Red Snapper
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds red snapper fillets, cleaned and cut into thick strips | 1 container plain yogurt | 1/2 cup chopped fresh jalapeno, finely chopped | 1 cup plain yogurt | 1/2 tablespoon mustard powder | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Combine red snapper strips, plain yogurt, jalapenos, 1 cup plain yogurt, mustard powder, and cocoa in a medium oven proof bowl and mix well. Bake in the preheated oven until snapper are no longer translucent in the center, about 25 minutes to 1 hour. Serve hot.

title: Grilled French Bread
ingredients: 1/2 lb bacon, cut into small pieces | 1/2 cup chicken stock | 1 loaf french bread | 1/4 cup fresh flat-leaf parsley, chopped
instructions: Place the bacon in a large skillet, add the remaining ingredients, except the parsley, and cook over medium heat, turning the bread slices over several times, for 15 minutes. Remove the bread slices and turn them over. Stir the bread so that it is well coated with the sauce. Place the pan on a preheated grill. Cook until the top is golden brown and the bread feels like it is starting to pull away from the sides of the pan just a few minutes. Top each slice with a generous amount of parsley, serve warm.

Random Ingredients: pastry shell,red curry paste,egg noodle,tomato green chilies,pesto sauce
title: Crimson Pie
ingredients: 0.5 box egg noodles ( about 1/2 inch diameter ) | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce or 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 teaspoon red curry paste ( i used homemade ) | 1 can rotel tomatoes and green chilies | 1 unbaked pastry shell
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Bring a pot of water to a boil. Cook noodles for 9 minutes, or until just tender but firm to the bite. Drain. In a large bowl, combine pesto sauce and red curry paste. Stir in drained noodles. Add tomatoes and green chiles. Pour mixture into baking shell and bake for 25 minutes or until bubbly.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,cabbage,ranch dressing mix,taco shell,dark brown sugar,beef sirloin,fennel
title: Mexican Meat & Cabbage Tacos
ingredients: 1 lb lean beef sirloin, cooked, cut into 1/2-by-3-inch strips | 1/2 cup ranch dressing mix | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar | 1 teaspoon fennel, finely chopped | 1 1/2 cups shredded cabbage | 2 cups packaged coleslaw mix | 8 taco shells | 1/2 cup red peppers or 1/2 cup yellow bell pepper, cut into 1/2-by-1/3-inch strips
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f. Spray 12x8x2 inch glass baking dish with cooking spray. Combine beef and dressing mix in medium bowl.

title: Chipotle and Anise Chips
ingredients: 2 cups all-purpose flour | 1/2 teaspoon anise seed | 1/3 cup palm sugar | 1/2 teaspoon ground chipotle chile
instructions: In a food processor, pulse the flour, anise seeds, palm sugar, and chipotle chile until the mixture resembles coarse meal. Pour into an oiled baking dish, and turn several times so the mixture coats the bottom evenly. Tap the pan lightly on a counter to settle the dough. Bake in a 375 degree f oven for 30 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Wasabi Beef Patties
ingredients: 2 tablespoons prepared wasabi ( or use regular wasabi powder ) | 2 tablespoons horseradish or 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 2 tablespoons molasses | 2 tablespoons purple onions, minced
instructions: Mix wasabi, horseradish, molasses and onions in a medium bowl. Add beef, keeping the mixture a little on the firm surface, and stir until fully coated or pressed into the ground beef. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Five-Spice Bacon
ingredients: 4 ounces pancetta, coarsley chopped | 1 tablespoon five-spice powder
instructions: Line a 20cm x 30cm slice pan with nonstick paper and grease with olive oil. Combine pancetta and five spice powder together and roll into 1cm balls. Cook over moderate heat for about 5 mins turning occasionally, until golden.

Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,green,baby shrimp,red cabbage,romano cheese,anise seed,lemon juice,saffron
title: Spice Cabbage Salad With Shrimp
ingredients: 2 quarts baby shrimp, shelled | 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 1 teaspoon saffron | 4 -5 teaspoons anise seeds, crushed | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom pod ( optional ) | 4 cups green cabbage, shredded | 1 cup red cabbage, shredded | 1/2 cup romano cheese, grated
instructions: Put the shrimp in a large pot, add enough water to just cover. Turn onto high and boil, then reduce to medium. Cook for 20 minutes, then drain shrimp into a colander to cool. Set aside and refrigerate. When ready to use, remove 1/2 cup of the liquid from the shrimp and discard. Return shrimp liquid to the pot, add lemon juice and saffron and bring to boil. Remove from heat, add cardamom, cilantro and optional crushed anise pods and place in a strainer, discard the spices. Set aside. In a large salad bowl, toss the brussels sprouts with the cabbage. Top the bottom of a serving bowl with some of the shrimp, then top with some of the shrimp brussels sprouts and the cheese. Sprinkle on some more of the saffron. Garnish with romano cheese before serving.

title: Udon Noodles with Capers
ingredients: 3 cups dry udon noodles | 1 jar capers, rinsed
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the udon noodles, and cook uncovered, stirring occasionally, until tender, about 5 minutes. Drain. Place drained noodles on a large serving dish, and sprinkle with capers.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,arborio rice,dark sesame oil,beef brisket,green bell pepper,corn oil,mexican oregano,vanilla
title: Sweet and Sour Beef Jerky
ingredients: 5 -6 lbs beef brisket ( with bones ) or 5 -6 lbs beef brisket, cut in 2-inch cubes ( with bones ) | 1 1/2 liters canola corn oil | 2 1/2 cups hot mexican oregano ( mexican preferred ) | 2 1/2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 2 teaspoons vanilla | 4 cups uncooked arborio rice | 1/2 cup grand marnier | 5 -6 green bell peppers, cut int 1/4-inch thick strips, about 4-6 inches in length
instructions: Place beef cubes in 2 gallon food bag. Reserve marinade and place in refrigerator. The day before cooking, in a small bowl, combine the oregano, sesame oil, and vanilla.

title: German Lentil & Cheese Pudding
ingredients: 3 ounces dry lentils | 2 tablespoons oil | 1 medium onion, chopped | 3/4 cup chopped pecans or 3/4 cup walnuts | 2 cups shredded emmenthaler cheese | 1 packet onion soup mix
instructions: Rinse lentils and place in a bowl. Add enough water to cover and leave until lentils are tender drain. Heat oil in a small saucepan. Saute onion in oil 3 minutes. When done add to lentils along with nuts, cheese, soup mix, and salt and pepper to taste.

Random Ingredients: wonton wrapper,hard egg,dill weed,dark soy sauce
title: Dai Fun
ingredients: 8 ounces fresh wonton wrappers | 3 hard boiled eggs, peeled and chopped | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon fresh dill weed, chopped ( or 1 teaspoon dill weed dry )
instructions: Bring 4 1/2 cups water to a boil, then stir in the wonton wrappers, remove and place in a small bowl of ice water to cool. Remove and set aside the wonton wrappers from the ice water. Cut each wonton into six squares, then separate and fill each square with the filling to within 1/2 inch of the edges. Slightly moisten the edges with your fingertip, then gently push them together and pinch together around the edges with your fingers to seal. Repeat until a square is filled with wonton wrappers and all the filling is used. Heat a wok or skillet over high heat. Add 1 tbsp of soy sauce and the chopped fresh dill, then add the wontons and stir fry, turning once, until golden and cooked through, about 4 minutes serve hot.

Random Ingredients: caper,ancho chile,cooking spray,egg yolk,snow pea,mustard powder
title: Spanish Snow Peas Salad
ingredients: 3 tablespoons prepared mustard powder | 1 package slivered snow peas | cooking spray | 2 egg yolks, well shaken | 3 tablespoons capers | 1 teaspoon dried ancho chiles
instructions: Combine mustard powder and snow peas, toss until covered. Place snow peas mixture on a sheet of wax paper and sprinkle with remaining mustard powder mixture. Toss to blend.

title: Scottish Baked Horseradish Beef Jerky
ingredients: 1 1/2 ounces scotch whisky or 1 1/2 ounces scotch whisky | 4 tablespoons good prepared horseradish | paprika
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Make sure the grinder is fine, with about half a teaspoon or so if it is. You need about 3/4 inch of grinder. Pour whiskey into a glass bowl, or a large measuring cup, preferably glass with a straight edge. Roughly grate the horseradish to your liking and add the horseradish into the whiskey. Stir. It should taste wet. Spray the grinder and pestle with a little extra virgin olive oil. Dip the jerky into the horseradish, then roll into a log. Wrap in plastic wrap and freeze until solid like a hard candy. You can store it if you like it, in it's plastic wrap for a up to 2 months, or in the freezer for up to 1 week. Just don't freeze it because of the whiskey the time is the heating point. When ready to serve, slice beef, about 2 mm thick. Then simply cut jerky in half, or in 2 inch strips if you desire, then cut strips in smaller sizes. Wrap in cellophane wrap and store in freezer for 3 months. You can also simply slice the jerky on a diagonal and freeze in a ziploc baggie, wrapped in plastic wrap for about 1 day, or you can store the slices in paper freezer bags. So keep in the freezer.

title: Gentle Bougene Au Gratinée (Bougene St Patty Melange)
ingredients: 12 aubergines | 12 courgettes | 3 1/2 2 1/2 teaspoons chicken bouillon granules | 5 g aubergines | 2 g chicken bouillon granules
instructions: Halve the aubergines and courgette and deseed, removing all the white pith. Slice the aubergines and courgettes thinly, place in a bowl and add the bouillon and a little water to bind. Cover and leave for one hour to soften slightly. Heat the olive oil in a frying pan and add the sliced aubergine and courgettes and cook over a low heat for 25 minutes until they are soft and beginning to color. Place in a blender and blend until finely chopped. Season with salt, mix again and then set aside. Cut out eight 2 1/2 inch circles from the remaining rectangle of bread. To make the bouquet garnée, peel the aubergine and courgette and cut crossways into 1 1/2 in slices. Put the slices into a mortar and crush with a pestle. Add the garlic and bouquet garnée and a little water to bind. Mix well and leave a few hours or overnight. Preheat the grill. Remove the bread squares from the oven and put them on to cooking paper while they are toasting. Toast under a grill for about 3 - 3 minutes on each side, and keep them warm.

title: Cranberry Pudding
ingredients: 1 can reduced cream of chicken soup | 1 quart cranberry juice | 1/3 cup ghee, melted | 1/2 cup orange juice
instructions: Mix everything together. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: pork cutlet,green chilies,fruit,baking soda,dark sesame oil,cotija cheese,pepperoni,flour tortilla
title: Pork and Green Chile Fajitas
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 4 thick cut pork cutlets | 1/2 cup chopped green chilies | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped cotija cheese | 1/4 cup finely chopped dry fruit ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 6 -8 flour tortillas | pepperoni, slices to garnish ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°. Brush oil on cutlets and place in a shallow glass baking dish. In a bowl, combine green chilies, cheese, and fruit. Pour over cutlets and marinate in refrigerator for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, spray bottom of a skillet with cooking spray. Heat over medium high heat until hot. Place one cutlet in skillet and cook about 2 minutes on each side or until browned. Add more oil as necessary. Transfer to a platter and sprinkle with pepperoni slices, if desired.

Random Ingredients: white vinegar,snow pea,mozzarella cheese,baby spinach,beer,dark soy sauce,liverwurst,clam juice
title: Spinach and Beef Liverwurst Salad
ingredients: 4 ounces baby spinach or 4 ounces arugula leaves | 12 ounces london broil hamburger | 5 ounces snow peas or 5 ounces sugar snap peas | 1/2 cup clam juice | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon white vinegar | 1/8 teaspoon dark soy sauce | 4 ounces beer ( white or dark ) | 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Cook spinach or arugula leaves in just enough boiling salted water to cover 5 to 6 minutes or until crisp tender. Drain and rinse under cold water. Drain well and then dry using paper towels.

Random Ingredients: italian salad dressing,swiss cheese,italian parsley,pam cooking spray,red cabbage
title: Italian Slaw
ingredients: 1 package shredded swiss cheese | 1 package shredded red cabbage | 1/4 cup italian salad dressing | 2 tablespoons italian parsley ( minced ) | pam cooking spray
instructions: Place all ingredients except for pam in crockpot. Mix well. Spray with pam & cook on high until cheese is melted.

title: Spicy and Delicious Polish Kielbasa.
ingredients: 1 lb kielbasa or 1 lb bacon | 2 -3 tablespoons flour | 14 ounces tomato soup | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 3 -5 finely chopped red chilies | 1 tablespoon garlic paste
instructions: In dutch oven brown kielbasa and drain off fat. Meanwhile, chop your tomato soup and mix with your chili paste. Add mixture. Put kielbasa mixture in crock pot and sprinkle the garlic paste on top. Cover and cook on low for 6 - 8 hours. Serve over noodles or mashed yummy food.

title: Homemade Flour Tortillas
ingredients: 1 cup wheat flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons sweet hungarian paprika
instructions: Combine all ingredients and knead for 5 minutes. Cut tortillas in 5 rounds by holding a flat spatula in your palm down, then turning and stretching it, until no longer sticky. Turn tortillas about 2/3 of the way and flatten out on the remaining side. Spray a skillet or frying pan with cooking spray and heat on medium high heat. Drop one or two tortillas at a time into the hot pan. Cook tortillas until the bottoms are a rich golden color and the bottoms are beginning to crisp up, about 2 minutes. Spread the tortillas out on paper towels to remove excess moisture. Reheat pan over medium heat. Cook until a bit darker in color, about 1 minute.

title: Pork and Tomato in Sauce
ingredients: 1 package lean ground pork | 3 cans tomato sauce
instructions: In a slow cooker, combine 2 cans of tomato sauce, pork, and remaining contents of can. Cover.

title: Mince Apple Rice 'n' Spices
ingredients: 600 g beef mince | 1 dried fish, chopped | 1/2 cup long grain basmati rice | 1 cooking apple, chopped | 1/2 tablespoon ginger | 1/2 tablespoon mixed spice | 1 tablespoon cooking oil
instructions: Cook rice in boiling water for about 20 minutes, drain. Fry mince in oil in saucepan, add all other ingredients except rice and stir. Add to rice and stir well. Cover and simmer for about 20 mins. Fluff rice and serve.

Random Ingredients: spanish onion,yellow onion,beef tenderloin steak,palm sugar,tomato green chile pepper,sambal oelek
title: Vietnamese Beef Filets (Vietnamese)
ingredients: 1/4 cup thinly sliced yellow onion | 1/2 cup thinly sliced spanish onion | 2 pounds beef tenderloin steaks, cut into cubes | 2 cans stewed tomatoes with green chile peppers, divided | 1 teaspoon ground spanish-style onion, or more to taste ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon sambal oelek ( vietnamese chili sauce ), divided | 1 teaspoon palm sugar
instructions: Preheat an oven for 350 degrees f. Lightly oil a rimmed baking dish with a nonstick cooking spray. Place 1 yellow onion and 2 Spanish onions vertically in the prepared baking dish. Toss the beef cubes with 1/4 cup each green onions and yellow onions. Spread half of the tomatoes with chile peppers in a layer atop the vegetables. Top with 1/4 cup sliced onions. Sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon ground spanish style onion and 1/2 teaspoon sambal oelek. Top with 1/4 teaspoon ground pam and 1 1/2 teaspoons palm sugar. Cover, and bake in the preheated oven until the beef is no longer pink in the center, about 1 1/2 hours. An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read. An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 160 degrees f.

title: Texas Beef Brisket
ingredients: 4 pounds beef brisket, fat trimmed | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 teaspoon cumin
instructions: Place brisket in a large stock pot. Cover tightly with water. Add cream, cover and cook over medium heat until meat is tender and falling apart, about 2 1/2 hours. Remove from heat and transfer brisket to a clean plate. Strain cooking liquid and discard solids. Return liquid to a simmer. Place brisket on a flat serving platter and spoon some cooking liquid over brisket. Sprinkle with cumin and stir.

Random Ingredients: coriander powder,tomato paste,vegetable stock,maple syrup,corn,spanish onion
title: Easy Spanish Corn & Tomato Soup
ingredients: 1 can corn | 1 can tomato paste | 3/4 cup vegetable stock | 1 medium spanish onion, diced | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | maple syrup, if desired
instructions: Drain corn in a sieve. Drain tomato paste & puree it. Add all ingredients except corn & bring to a boil. Add corn & heat through. Serve with a side dish of toasted french bread or crackers, if desired.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning mix,serrano pepper,white wine vinegar,dulce de leche,milk,self raising flour,rock salt,salmon
title: Dulce De Leche & Smoked Salmon Skewers
ingredients: 250 g self-raising flour | 1/4 cup dulce de leche | 2 tablespoons taco seasoning mix | 1 teaspoon rock salt | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 400 g smoked salmon | 1/4 cup milk | 1/2 cup dulce de leche | 3 serrano peppers, whole ( optional )
instructions: Soak 8 wooden skewers in cold water for 30 minutes. Mix all ingredients in a large bowl with your hands. Using wet hands, shape mixture into 2 inch balls. Cook on a lightly oiled grill/broiler tray, one piece at a time, for 8 - 12 minutes at 200 degrees centigrade/400 degrees f. Allow to stand for 5 minutes before carefully turning. Serve with lime wedges.

Random Ingredients: taco shell,sherry wine,cucumber,king hawaiian bread,cayenne,orange juice,oregano leaf
title: Knorr Ultimate Caesar Salad
ingredients: 1 baguette ( about 24 inches long or thinner ) | 12 ounces cooked king ( or other flavorful, firm white, creamy and crusty bread ) | 1 medium cucumber, peeled, seeded, pith removed and sliced thin ( i leave the skin on ) | 2 tablespoons fresh orange juice | 1/4 cup sherry wine or 1/4 cup dry white wine ( or to taste ) | 2 teaspoons dried oregano leaves or 2 teaspoons fresh minced oregano | 1/8 teaspoon ground cayenne ( to taste ) | cooked taco shells
instructions: Wash your bread and leave whole. Turn oven on to 300°f. Cut your bread into 1 inch cubes. In a large bowl combine the bread cubes with the cooked cucumber slices. Arrange bread cubes on a 9x13 inch baking dish sprayed with pam. Pour dressing over bread and vegetables. The bread should be in little shreds by now. Sprinkle with oregano and cayenne pepper. Cover tightly and bake for 40 minutes. Remove from oven, uncover and carefully transfer the sandwiches to a cutting board to allow them to cool. This should take about 15 - 20 minutes if it is too hot. Slice diagonally and arrange on a serving platter.

title: Steamed Fish, Okra, Pecan, and Vegetable Tortellini
ingredients: 1 package cheese tortellini | 1 pound fresh mussels, cleaned and debearded | 1 stalk celery, chopped | 1 package fresh okra, sliced | 2 packages processed cheese flavored tortellini, cut into 1-inch slices | 1/4 cup dried pecans | 1 teaspoon dried sage | 1 teaspoon dried crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a boil. Add the tortellini and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Rinse the mussels in a large pot of boiling water until the shells have opened, and place them into the boiling water. Remove the shells and set aside. Break the shells into pieces with a knife. Pour the oil into a large casserole dish. Stir in the tortellini, mussels, celery, okra, and tortellini in that dish. Season with dried pineapple, pecans, sage, crushed red pepper flakes, and salt and pepper to taste. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally until the seafood is cooked through, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: yellow squash,ham,rump roast,pinto bean,orange juice,chinese five spice powder,coffee
title: Grilled Cuban Beef Sandwich
ingredients: 1 cup canned pinto beans | 4 slices ham, 1-inch thick | 2 tablespoons instant coffee, cooled | 10 slices yellow squash, 1-inch thick | 1 tablespoon orange juice | 1 teaspoon chinese five-spice powder | 1 lb boneless top sirloin tip roast or 1 lb prime rib roast
instructions: For the beans, rinse and pick over beans. Place them in a large bowl with enough cold water to cover. Let sit about 30 minutes to soften beans. Drain, reserving about 1/2 cup of the liquid, and rinse the beans under warm water to rinse off excess sand and grit. Set aside 4 tablespoons of bean liquid. Stir in the beans, ham, 1 tablespoon of instant coffee, yellow squash, orange juice, and 5 spice powder. Cover, and refrigerate 2 hours. Prepare grill to medium heat. Remove roast from marinade and reserve marinade. Grill roast 12 minutes per side, or until desired doneness is reached and meat is browned on top. Let meat rest 10 minutes. Slice remaining roast thinly and serve on the side.

Random Ingredients: coconut cream,large shrimp,cream mushroom soup,jicama,mussel,green chilies,prune
title: Mussels and Shrimp
ingredients: 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 jicama, peeled, chopped | 16 -20 large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 can chopped green chilies, with seeds | 1 can light coconut cream | 4 -5 large shrimp, shelled, tails removed | 24 prunes, sliced ( to garnish )
instructions: Add mushroom soup, jicama, shrimp, chilies, and coconut cream to a large skillet or crockpot. Cover and simmer on low heat for 20 - 25 minutes. Add prunes, and cook an additional 5 minutes. Serve over couscous or rice cooked with lettuce and chopped tomatoes.

title: Cheddar, Ginger & Lemongrass Dip
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon gingerroot, grated | 1 lemon grass, bruised | 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 3 tablespoons cheddar cheese, grated | 1 bay leaf | 2 teaspoons parsley, chopped
instructions: Combine all the ingredients except the papaya. Chill for 1 hour to develop the flavours. Serve with papaya.

Random Ingredients: mint leaf,black bean,peanut oil,pear,spinach leaf,tamari,chicken breast half
title: Spinach and Chicken Salad With Black Beans
ingredients: 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 1 pound skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cut into 1/2-inch strips | 1/2 cup chopped canned black beans | 4 cups fresh spinach leaves | 1 tablespoon tamari | 4 sprigs fresh mint leaves | 3 whole fresh pear slices, for garnish
instructions: Heat peanut oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add chicken.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,chili pepper flake,mango chutney,scallion,chickpea,russet potato,filling,pork shoulder
title: Arafura (Filled Shiitaki)
ingredients: 1/2 cup chutney | 1/3 cup mango chutney | 3 tablespoons filling ( mango chutney ) | 1 lb of coarsely chopped pork shoulder | 5 slices of sliced scallions | 15 -20 button mushrooms | 1 pinch chili pepper flakes | 1 russet potato, peeled and grated
instructions: Heat 1/2 a cup of chutney in a skillet. Add 2 - 4 tablespoons of filling and cover. Cook on low heat for approximately 2 hours. The filling must be firm. Afterwards, you can let it cool down and add to the recipe. Cut up the shiitaki meat and combine with the stuffing. Fill rice cakes or saki with this filling and rice cakes. Top with paprika or chilly flakes.

title: Lime-Sage Potatoes
ingredients: 2 lbs small red potatoes, scrubbed | 9 ounces baby spinach | 1/2 cup beef gravy | 1 teaspoon chopped lime peel | 3/4 teaspoon ground sage
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°. Cut each potato in half, lengthwise. Place potatoes, cut side down in a lightly oiled 13x9 inch baking dish. Bake for 25 minutes or until potatoes are tender. While potatoes bake combine gravy, lime peel, and sage in a medium saucepan.

title: Bacon and Fennel Seed Powder
ingredients: 1 tablespoon bacon fat | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed | 1 pinch cream of tartar | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon powder
instructions: Heat bacon fat over medium low heat in a large skillet. Saute fennel seeds until fragrant and golden brown, about 3 minutes, stirring constantly. Pour in cream of tartar and stir. Add remaining ingredients and stir. Adjust seasoning to taste.

Random Ingredients: guacamole,raspberry jam,green chili pepper,icing sugar,picante sauce
title: Raspberry and Guacamole Party Sandwiches
ingredients: 12 raspberries and chili peppers | 1 packet icing sugar | 125 g guacamole, prepared | 125 ml picante sauce | 10 green chili peppers, sliced
instructions: Cut the raspberries and chili peppers in half and reserve. In a bowl add the icing sugar and guacamole. Using a tablespoon fill up with grapefruit juice until 3/4 full. Spread guacamole on top to create a star shape, and place in oven on a baking tray for approximately 10 - 15 mins, until the guacamole is light brown. Remove from oven and top with 2 green chile peppers, reserving a little as a garnish. Place on serving tray and cut through with a bread knife.

title: Elegant French Mushrooms for Diabetics
ingredients: 1/2 - 1 lb cremini mushroom | 2 cups french baguette or 2 cups french baguettes, cut on the diagonal
instructions: The french baguette or crostini should be toasted or sliced or slathered with a little more butter. Place half a large handful of sliced mushrooms on the sliced side of the french baguette. Place the other half of the baguette on top of the mushrooms. Place on a tray. Cut into halves to serve. You can also serve them plain or with a little sweetened yogurt.

title: Tomatillo-Orange Salad in Creme Fraiche
ingredients: 6 -8 firm tomatillos ( red, pink, and yellow ) | 1/2 cup creme fraiche ( creme fraiche, to taste ) | 1/4 cup finely chopped white pepper | 1/4 tablespoon grated orange peel
instructions: Gently unstrain the tomatillos and slice them thickly around the edges.. Place in a bowl and toss with remaining ingredients. Chill well before serving.

Random Ingredients: green chili pepper,taco seasoning,egg white,chicken meat,lemon juice zest
title: Empanadas
ingredients: 2 lbs cooked chicken meat | 1 egg white | 1 1/2 tablespoon taco seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon lemon juice and zest | 1 chopped green chili pepper
instructions: Combine both mcestersgrees and roll into small balls. Heat up oil in frying pan until hot. Cook balls till brown on each side. Top with hot sauce. Serve with mexican rice recipe #.

title: Lebanese Rice Balls
ingredients: 1 cup cooked white rice | 3/4 cup cottage cheese, room temperature | 1 egg | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1/2 teaspoon curry leaves | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper | 1/16 teaspoon ground cardamom | 2 packages frozen ladyfingers, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, thoroughly mix together rice, cottage cheese, egg, white pepper, cardamom, curry leaves, 1/4 teaspoon pepper, and 1/4 teaspoon extra virgin olive oil. Place uncooked rice balls into a single layer on a lightly dusted cookie sheet and refrigerate, covered with a dry towel, for 30 minutes. Bake rice balls in the preheated oven for 15 to 20 minutes, or until firm and lightly golden brown. While rice balls are cooking, cover cookie sheet with a slightly damp towel and lightly spray tops of rice balls with remaining olive oil. After rice balls have baked 15 to 20 minutes, remove them from cookie sheet to cool, and set aside on a plate covered tightly with a clean towel for 10 minutes. Serve warm, or cool completely and store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 months.

title: Pistachio Bean Stew
ingredients: 1 can great northern beans, drained | 1 can sweetened applesauce | 1 can sliced almonds | 1 -2 tablespoon unsweetened applesauce | 1/2 teaspoon dried apricot, crushed
instructions: Drain the beans and combine with the other ingredients. Let sit overnight in the refrigerator. Enjoy.

title: Fennel Crisps
ingredients: 1 fennel bulb ( or several small bunches - the fronds should sit in the center ) | 1/3 cup golden raisin, plumped in hot water until plump | 1 lb sharp cheddar cheese, grated | shortening ( for frying )
instructions: Cut the base of the fennel bulb or bunches off the fronds. Remove fronds and discard. Place fennel bulb in a bowl, add raisins, and mix. Roll up fronds in cheese, then in shortening to coat. Place on buttered baking sheet. Bake at 400 degrees f until tender. Drain on paper towels or on a rack.

title: Crock Pot Sausage-Stove Top Carnitas
ingredients: 2 packages breakfast sausage, chopped | 10 3/4 ounces beef consomme | 1 teaspoon dried sage | 1 tablespoon splenda granular or 1 tablespoon sugar | 1/2 orange peel or 1/2 lemon peel, cut into 1 inch sticks
instructions: In a crock pot, combine sausage, beef consomme, sage, splenda, and rind until thoroughly mixed. Cover and cook on low 7 - 8 hours. Garnish with orange peel and serve.

title: Lobster Salad with Lime
ingredients: 1 lb frozen cooked lobsters, thawed and drained | 1/2 lb cooked turkey, chopped | 1/2 cup ketchup | 3 teaspoons sake or 3 teaspoons sherry wine | lime wedge, garnish
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Chill 1 hour before serving.

title: Spicy Couscous With Beans
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked couscous | 1 can pinto beans, drained | 1 teaspoon minced fresh thyme
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400°f. Put couscous in a bowl and pour boiling water over the top. Stir to combine. Cover bowl tightly with plastic wrap and set aside until water is absorbed. Fluff with a fork and set aside. In a small bowl, mash up the beans, thyme and beans. Stir into couscous. Add the olive oil and mix to blend. Serve and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: meringue powder,monterey jack cheese,stew meat,coconut milk
title: Stir-Fried Jives
ingredients: 1 bag frozen stew meat | 1 teaspoon meringue powder | 8 ounces coconut milk | 1 ounce monterey jack cheese ( or use whatever cheese you like )
instructions: Slice mushrooms and set aside. Put meat in crockpot and cover with mushroom water. Cook on high for about 30 minutes. Then turn down to low and stir in meringue powder and coconut milk. Cook for an additional 20 to 30 minutes. After the 30 minutes check to see if meat is cooked and if it is, turn off and wait for another 15 minutes. If it is, add some cheese. If necessary, thaw meat in fridge until no longer hot or until mixture is easy to stir. Taste and season with salt and pepper if needed.

title: Crab and Chicken Curry
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs of shelled fresh crabs | 1 kg cubed chicken breast | 2 tablespoons garam masala | 1 tablespoon sherry wine | 2 tablespoons red wine
instructions: Clean crabs with cold water. Remove heads from crab, devein and chop. Mix all ingredients, except the crab, into the crab and mix well together. Add crab to marinade and mix everything together. Refrigerate for 24 hours or overnight. Bake in oven on 200 degrees for 45 minutes or until crab is cooked through.

title: Pork Chops for Two
ingredients: 2 boneless pork chops | 2 teaspoons lemon wedges | 1 pizza crust, baked
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 c / 400f / gas mark brush the pork chops well with a little of the lemon juice. Place the chops on a non stick baking sheet lined with baking paper and bake in the oven for 20 - 25 mins, turning them over once. Turn them over again. Turn back up and pour more lemon juice in the middle. Return to oven for another 20 - 25 mins or until cooked to your liking. Serve with a drizzle of olive oil and any side dish, like spaghetti, pasta or pizza. Enjoy.

title: Quick and Easy Sesame Beans
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans, rinsed and drained | 1 can tomatoes | 1 cup tomato sauce | 1 teaspoon sesame seeds | 1/2 cup shredded carrot | 1 teaspoon smoked sweet paprika
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Combine all ingredients in an oven proof serving dish. Bake in the preheated oven for 25 to 30 minutes, or until vegetables turn a golden brown.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,clam juice,cream,mace,french fry,vanilla vodka
title: Delicious Low Calorie Clam Fritters With a Twist (Pfad Lla)
ingredients: 12 -16 ounces clams in shell ( i use the bottled in the can ) | 2 cups self rising flour | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 tablespoon powdered clafrican vanilla or 1 teaspoon rum | 1 cup reduced-fat sour cream | french fries
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Mix flour nutmeg and clafrican vanilla in a small bowl. Set aside. Rinse your clams thoroughly and drain. Place in a shallow baking dish and toss to coat. Combine the sour cream with a fork or hands in a bowl and spoon over the clams. Bake for about 17 to 20 minutes or until they are warmed through and crust are golden brown. Serve with french fries.

title: Easy Herbed Salsa
ingredients: 1 jar picante sauce | 1 -2 tablespoon dried herbs
instructions: Combine picante sauce and herbs in bowl. Taste and add salt/pepper if needed. Store unused salsa in refrigerator.

title: Mulled Wheat Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup wheat flour ( white or brown ) | 1/2 cup currants ( seedless raisins ) | 1 tablespoon tamari ( or soy sauce concentrate ) | 1 tablespoon vanilla extract | 4 bay leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Mix all ingredients well. Use about 1/4 cup to 1 cup of milk for a thin dipping sauce. Heat a skillet over medium heat. Add 2 tablespoons of the currant mixture and stir continuously for 5 - 6 minutes or until mixture is thick and bubbly. Serve warm with rye bread or bread sticks.

title: Mexican Restaurant Pop
ingredients: 1 cup table salt | 1 cup medium-hot pimiento, in juice | 4 cups ice or 4 cups ice cubes
instructions: For the popcorn, in a food processor, pulse salt into pimento pieces with a metal blade. Add pimento liquid and pulse until mixture resembles coarse crumbs, about 10 seconds. Add the ice or ice cubes and pulse again until mixture forms a ball. Store in an airtight container. Variation, stir 1 cup coarsely chopped tomatoes with juice into the popcorn. Use only 1/2 cup crumbs. It has a tart flavor and texture. Note, it is not intended to be use as a dip for meat or poultry.
